novel_info.title: Longevity Clan Starts with the Patriarch’s Marriage
novel_info.author: Ride the wind while it's weak
novel_info.summary: After descending the mountain to take a wife, he discovered he had opened the fantasy world in the wrong way.He could rise to power just by lying flat, so why bother with arduous cultivation and endless fighting?Years later, the Eternal Clan began its quiet rise, its tendrils spreading across myriad realms, manipulating the Great Saints and Immortal Mansions from behind.One day, Han Li, sitting high in the Nine Heavens, watched over his countless descendants, narrating his glorious history.An Immortal Emperor crossed realms intending to obliterate the Han Family, but was flicked to death by Han Li with a snap of his fingers.Suddenly, all realms trembled at the revelation that Patriarch Han was so powerful![Eternal Flow + Family Flow + Survival Flow]

chapters.title: Chapter 1 - 1 The Ancestor Took Another Concubine_1
chapters.content:
1 Chapter 1 The Ancestor Took Another Concubine_1
Translator: 549690339
Lingjun City, on the main street.
A palanquin carried by eight was followed by a huge wedding procession, the sound of drums and gongs filled the air, creating an impressive presence as they headed toward The Li Manor.
Before long, after the wedding procession successfully picked up the bride, they began their return to the Han Mansion.
The ten-mile bridal procession was filled with auspicious joy; it was like a golden dragon robed in red, extending all the way to the Han Mansion.
“It seems that Elder Han of the Han Family has taken another concubine!”
“I heard that this time the concubine is the third miss from The Li Manor, a beauty unequaled, the number one beauty of our Lingjun City.”
“Elder Han certainly is lucky to marry such a stunning beauty at nearly two hundred years old, truly making us envious.”
“Elder Han is a powerful figure, a mere stomp of his foot could make Lingjun City shake thrice, he’s not someone that commoners like us can compare with.”
Many passersby on the streets started whispering to each other upon seeing this grand occasion.
At this moment, both inside and outside the Han Mansion, there was an atmosphere of happiness; the guests were brimming with joy, totally immersed in the festive air.
The Han Mansion had become the most bustling place in the entire city.
Ordinary people didn’t know, but those who were well-informed within Lingjun City, who didn’t know that this was Elder Han’s first time taking a concubine after his breakthrough into the Pihai Realm?
The Pihai Realm, that’s the realm of the truly powerful!
Even within the larger cities, one could dominate a territory, not to mention the small Lingjun City.
The most powerful in Lingjun City used to only be at the Ninth Grade of the Innate Realm, but after Elder Han’s breakthrough, he instantly became the strongest in Lingjun City.
Although Elder Han was close to the end of his lifespan when he made the breakthrough, a breakthrough was still a breakthrough, and the gap between the Pihai Realm and those below it is immense.
Elder Han alone could easily sweep through the entirety of Lingjun City.
Therefore, for Elder Han’s concubine-taking this time, all the large forces of Lingjun City came to offer their congratulations, presenting various precious gifts, all to form a good relationship with the Han Family.
The common people of Lingjun City were also very happy, because every time Elder Han took a concubine, he would hold a grand feast for three days and nights, allowing the people of Lingjun City to eat and drink for free.
This was often the best meal that many poor people would have all year round, so naturally, they were very happy and full of praise for Elder Han.
Some families even started to worship Elder Han, praying for him to take more concubines each year.
The Han Mansion occupied a vast area of three to four square miles, but at this moment, it was overcrowded, and everyone present had an extraordinary status.
They were either the high-ranking members of various powers, direct lineage, or wealthy merchants and influential figures of Lingjun City, even the city lord came in person to congratulate.
One could say that the gathering was filled with profound scholars and that there were no ordinary folk among the comers and goers.
The young and beautiful girls of Lingjun City were also mostly gathered here, following by the sides of the guests.
“Father, The Li Family is one of the three major families in our Lingjun City, is it necessary to let our treasured daughter become a concubine to Elder Han?”
In one corner of the mansion, a well-dressed young man quietly asked a middle-aged man, his face showing some discontent.
The middle-aged man glanced at him, saying coldly, “Put away those little thoughts of yours; the Han Family is not one we can afford to offend.”
The third miss of the Li Family, Li Mingmeng, was known as the number one beauty of Lingjun City and had many suitors, with his eldest son being one of them.
After glaring fiercely at his son, he then turned to a young girl beside him, speaking softly, “Xiaowen, you must perform well later; if Elder Han takes notice of you, our Zhang Family will soar to great heights.”
“You shouldn’t feel uneasy about anything; although Elder Han is nearly two hundred years old, his lifespan has greatly increased after breaking through to the Pihai Realm, and his appearance has even reverted to his youth, being as handsome as ever—an exceptionally good-looking man.”
Conversations like this were occurring in every corner of the Han Mansion.
This was also the reason why they brought beautiful young girls to the Han Family.
The recent breakthrough of the Han Family’s ancestor into the Pihai Realm meant that for the next hundred years, Lingjun City would be led by the Han Family. To form good relations, or even marital ties with the Han Family, would indeed bring about prosperity.
After all, that was a Pihai Realm powerhouse!
With a Pihai Realm powerhouse firmly in place, the future of Lingjun City would become several times more prosperous, bringing immense benefits.
Inside the main hall of the Han Mansion,
Han Li sat in the seat of honor, a faint smile gracing his face as he listened to the congratulations from his descendants and guests.
At this moment, his mood was quite good, even exhilarating.
After nearly forty years of perseverance, he had finally broken through to the Pihai Realm, which had been a huge relief to him. Now, at last, he had enough longevity.
As for marrying the number one beauty of Lingjun City as a concubine, that was just a bonus.
“I’ve finally seen it through,” Han Li thought, feeling particularly pleased.
More than a hundred years ago, when he arrived in this world, he was merely a fifteen or sixteen-year-old youth.
His family wasn’t well-off; his only claim to fame was his talent.
In this world, if you want to cultivate, you must have talent, which is innate and nearly impossible to improve later in life.
Without talent, one would live out their life as a mundane, ordinary person.
But those with talent could embark on the path of cultivation, growing stronger by degrees, and eventually achieving longevity, freedom, and ease.
Of course, talent also has its grades, a total of ten, from unranked to Ninth Grade, Eighth Grade… to First Grade.
An unranked talent could at most cultivate to the True Qi Realm, which is the third Big Realm. Starting from Ninth Grade talent, one has a chance to break through to the Innate Realm, and the better the talent, the easier it is to break through.
Only by cultivating to the Innate Realm does one truly transcend the ordinary and significantly increase their lifespan, up to two hundred years.
Body Forging Realm, Rebirth Realm, and True Qi Realm do not increase lifespan; it remains the same as that of an ordinary person, only their strength differs.
The better the talent, the faster the cultivation speed and the greater the chance of reaching higher and deeper realms; those with poor talent cultivate slowly, and the further they go, the slower it becomes. Achieving high realms requires either sufficient cultivation resources or continuous fortuitous opportunities.
Han Li’s talent was Eighth Grade, which was quite outstanding in his county.
Unwilling to settle for mediocrity and not wanting to join any minor sects, he left Lingjun City, and even Fengyang Manor, venturing into the vast Leizhou in search of cultivation opportunities.
Eventually, after enduring great hardships, he barely passed the entrance test of a major sect in Leizhou and was accepted into it.
Initially a registered disciple, Han Li diligently cultivated, achieving full mastery in Body Forging in three years, Rebirth Realm in nine years, and the peak of True Qi Realm in twenty years.
After that, he spent another three years comprehending the essence of heaven and earth and condensing an Innate True Qi seed, finally breaking through to the Innate Realm.
That is to say, he started cultivating at sixteen and took a total of thirty-five years to break through to the Innate Realm.
This was only possible because of his Eighth Grade talent, which allowed him to break through just as he reached the midpoint of his lifespan. For Ninth Grade talent, it would take at least sixty years to have a chance.
If he had First Grade talent, advancing to the Innate Realm from the beginning of his cultivation could have taken at most one year.
Once reaching the Innate Realm, one transcends the ordinary and becomes an “Immortal” in the eyes of common people, living up to two hundred years.
The Innate Realm holds a high status in the mortal world. In a county city, one could become a local powerhouse, and even in a manor city, they would thrive like a fish in water.
Upon reaching the Innate Realm, one is automatically promoted to the status of Foreign Disciple.
With increased cultivation resources, Han Li continued to practice diligently, reaching the peak of the Ninth Layer of the Innate Realm by the age of one hundred and twenty.
Based on Han Li’s talent, it was expected that he could break through to the Pihai Realm around the age of one hundred and fifty, but unfortunately, there were setbacks along the way.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 - 2 Blessings of Many Children_1
chapters.content:
2 Chapter 2 Blessings of Many Children_1
Translator: 549690339
After reaching the peak of the ninth level of the Innate Realm for ten years, Han Li felt fully prepared to break through to the Pihai Realm in order to become an Inner Sect Disciple and access better cultivation resources. In the end, he naturally failed.
Not only did he fail, but he also sustained serious injuries, and even his foundation was damaged, leaving him with no hope of breaking through to the Pihai Realm ever again.
Han Li did not give up and continued to cultivate diligently, hoping for a miracle.
After twenty more years of cultivation, he was still stuck at the peak of the ninth level of the Innate Realm and saw no hope of making a breakthrough. Han Li finally despaired.
He gave up on cultivating within the Sect and descended the mountain to return to Lingjun City, but by then his parents had long passed away.
With a sigh of sorrow, Han Li decided to get married and have children to continue the Han family line, which was what his parents had most hoped to see, but now they no longer had the chance.
That year, Han Li searched in Lingjun City and eventually found a quite suitable woman.
Named Liu Yuexin, she was eighteen years old with a graceful figure and stunning appearance, hailing from a minor family in Lingjun City. Her cultivation talent was unremarkable, and she was only at the eighth level of body tempering at the time.
With such talent, even Han Li’s full support wouldn’t have allowed her to break through to the Innate Realm.
After some consideration, Han Li decided to first take a concubine, and later find an opportunity to marry a wife with superior cultivation talent.
This was also for the consideration of future generations, as combining with a woman with high talent made it more likely to have descendants with high talent.
Since he could no longer break through to the Pihai Realm in this lifetime, he wanted his descendants to fulfill his regrets. It was his version of “hoping one’s child becomes a dragon.”
So, after making preparations, Han Li brought Liu Yuexin into his home as his first concubine.
Although she was a concubine, Han Li never mistreated her. He gave a generous dowry, and the treatment he provided made the Liu family almost dizzy with happiness.
Through his dedicated efforts, Liu Yuexin fell pregnant quite quickly.
Ten months later, Han Li’s first offspring was born, a daughter with ninth-grade talent.
This was a pleasant surprise for Han Li; his first offspring actually possessed decent talent.
Having his foundation damaged and cultivating for another twenty years after the failure, even if he cultivated for several more decades until his death, he had no hope at all.
What delighted Han Li the most was that once he had offspring, his golden finger finally arrived, though late, it brought him to tears of joy.
The Longevity Family System!
Its purpose was to cultivate the owner into building a family of longevity. Specifically, for every additional offspring Han Li had, he would receive corresponding rewards including life span, cultivation level, pills, divine weapons, and more.
Currently, for every additional offspring, he could gain one year of cultivation level, one year of life span, and one Supreme Grade yellow-class Cultivation Technique. Note that these rewards are not diminished; whether it’s the first generation, the second, or even the hundredth, the rewards for Han Li remain the same.
Additionally, if any of his descendants possessed cultivation talent, Han Li would receive corresponding rewards—the higher the talent, the greater the reward. Moreover, when a descendant begins their cultivation, it can also feed back a certain amount of cultivation to Han Li.
Once Han Li understood this, he was overjoyed. Indeed, having many children brings many blessings.
The daughter born by Liu Yuexin provided him with one year of cultivation, one year of life span, one Supreme Grade yellow-class martial technique, and some enhancement of Han Li’s own talent.
Every time, the rewards of cultivation level and life span were guaranteed, while pills, weapons, Cultivation Techniques, and treasures appeared randomly.
The first daughter had ninth-grade talent, which provided Han Li with partial feedback, enhancing his own talent—a reward that could only be obtained if the offspring possessed cultivation talent.
Even though his damaged foundation meant he had no hope of reaching the Pihai Realm in this life, the System’s reward of cultivation level broke this constraint. As long as he had enough descendants, he wouldn’t need to cultivate; he could still break through to the Pihai Realm, or even higher realms.
In light of this, Han Li simply stopped cultivating; he was already at the peak of the Innate Ninth Grade, and further cultivation would be futile. Taking more concubines and having more children was truly the path to prosperity.
In the blink of an eye, many years had passed, and Han Li was now 195 years old, nearing the lifespan limit of the Innate Realm.
Over the years, Han Li had taken quite a few concubines, each with mediocre cultivation talent, and they had given birth to many offspring for him.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to take more concubines, or that his body couldn’t handle it; the main issue was the system’s strict regulations about taking concubines.
They must have cultivation talent and a beauty score of at least eight.
This greatly narrowed the range of candidates for Han Li’s concubines, forcing him to search slowly. After all, in the eyes of others, he was an Innate Realm cultivator nearing his lifespan limit; even less talented beauties were seldom willing to become his concubines.
Since he couldn’t generate more resources himself, he decided to let his descendants procreate extensively. Although the rewards were less, they would accumulate over time.
Han Li encouraged childbirth and rewarded it heavily, allowing them to procreate to their heart’s content. His lineage had already reached the fourth generation, with ninety-seven descendants in total.
Of these, only eighteen had cultivation talent, four with Ninth Grade talent, the rest being mediocre. Yet, this had significantly improved Han Li’s own talent.
With his talent improved, Han Li expended the cultivation he had accumulated, resulting in a breakthrough to the Pihai Realm.
The Pihai Realm came with a lifespan of three hundred years, plus an additional fifty or so years he’d gained, meaning Han Li could now live up to three hundred fifty-two years.
Recently, Han Li was brimming with vitality. With close to one hundred sixty years of life remaining, he had plenty of time to break through to the next realm. Moreover, the accumulation in the early stage is the slowest; the speed of improvement actually increases later on.
Looking at the descendants and guests in the hall, Han Li felt a sense of pride in his heart.
Being in the Pihai Realm was enough to dominate Lingjun City, and in the whole of Fengyang Manor, he could be considered a local powerhouse. His status had already become quite high, and this was just the beginning.
In the future, his cultivation would continue to increase, and his status would rise further.
To avoid an untimely demise, Han Li decided to lay low for a while, taking things steady and not rush into taking risks for opportunities.
With the system in place, as long as he continued to take more concubines and have more children, the longer he would live, and the higher his cultivation would become—why bother with fighting and killing?
In the eyes of other cultivators, he must have seemed an anomaly. Who, with the hope of breaking through to a higher realm, would keep taking concubines, indulging in pleasures of the flesh? At most, they would find a like-minded partner to support each other.
Indulging in pleasure would only waste time, resulting in nothing in the end.
After his breakthrough to the Pihai Realm, Han Li’s status rose, and his influence in Fengyang Manor increased greatly. He was just about to look for a beauty with Ninth Grade talent to take as a concubine when the Li Family sent Li Mingmeng to his door.
Han Li was aware of the Li Family’s situation. The Li Family Patriarch was at the Eighth Grade of the Innate Realm, just a few years younger than Han Li, and did not have many years left to live.
Once the Li Family Patriarch died, the current family head, only at the First Grade of the Innate Realm, would not be able to hold the fort. The vast assets of the Li Family were likely to be unsustainable. Thus, after learning of the Han Family Patriarch’s breakthrough to the Pihai Realm, the Li Family sent Lingjun City’s number one beauty to become Han Li’s concubine.
Li Mingmeng became Han Li’s seventh concubine and the first with Ninth Grade talent, bringing the potential to produce offspring with Eighth Grade talent.
Although Han Li had several concubines, he treated each one kindly. Most of the resources awarded by the system, such as the Beauty Preserving Pill, Lifespan Extension Pill, Gathering Yuan Pill, and so on, were used for their benefit, to help them improve their cultivation and extend their lifespans.
Liu Yuexin, who had followed Han Li from the beginning, was of mediocre talent, but with Han Li’s various resources, she had already broken through to the seventh level of the True Qi Realm and extended her lifespan to one hundred forty years.
If possible, Han Li hoped that his concubines could accompany him even further on his journey.
After the wedding, the guests and the host were all delighted, and Han Li also entered the bridal chamber.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 - 3 Offspring of the Eighth-grade Talent_1
chapters.content:
3 Chapter 3 Offspring of the Eighth-grade Talent_1
Translator: 549690339
In the bridal chamber,
Han Li reached out and lifted the red veil from the bride’s head, revealing Li Mingmeng’s stunningly beautiful face. Her eyes were closed, but her pretty face was flushed with redness, as if she knew what was about to happen.
“Truly the most beautiful woman in Lingjun City.”
“This appearance, this figure… she really lives up to her reputation.”
Gazing at the eighteen-year-old beauty before him, Han Li thought to himself.
Although he was nearly two hundred years old, his tastes had not changed; who doesn’t love a beautiful eighteen-year-old girl?
After that, Han Li blew out a breath, and the oil lamp in the bridal chamber was extinguished.
A night of springtime is worth a thousand gold!
After working hard night and day for half a month, Han Li finally received some good news.
Li Mingmeng was pregnant.
A smile appeared on Han Li’s face; it didn’t matter whether it was a boy or a girl, what was important was having a descendant.
He possessed eighth-grade cultivation talent, Li Mingmeng had ninth-grade, and the probability that their first child would possess eighth-grade talent was not low.
Furthermore, he had recently broken through to the Pihai Realm, increasing the likelihood that the new child would have cultivation talent. The child in Li Mingmeng’s belly was the first offspring since his breakthrough.
With various buffs stacked up, it should at least be eighth-grade talent, right?
Thinking this, Han Li’s anticipation grew even stronger. If the child truly had eighth-grade talent, he would definitely send him to the Sect for cultivation when he turned eight.
Han Li was not indifferent toward his offspring; on the contrary, he tried his best to provide them with the appropriate resources.
Previously he was at the pinnacle of the ninth level of the Innate Realm; he might not have been the first in Lingjun City, but he was definitely in the top three, able to occupy a large amount of resources and wealth.
He had entrusted these resources and wealth to a few of his concubines and some capable descendants to manage, from which they could reap tremendous benefits.
As long as they didn’t commit any atrocities or engage in too much evil, Han Li would not interfere.
Those without cultivation talent could enjoy their blessings, receiving a corresponding allocation of resources monthly, among which those with the ability could also apply to manage family affairs.
If they wished to receive more resource rewards, then they should have more children.
For those with cultivation talent, when they turned eight and could begin cultivating, Han Li would send them off to various Sects.
He had eighteen descendants with cultivation talent, and he had sent each to cultivate in different Sects within Fengyang Manor; those with lesser talent went to lesser Sects, and those with better talent went to better ones.
In all of Fengyang Manor’s prominent Sects, there was at least one Pihai Realm individual presiding, and the very top ones even had individuals from the Gangyuan Realm.
For these cultivable descendants, Han Li was not stingy with cultivation resources; he wholeheartedly hoped they could cultivate to higher realms.
Not only could this expand the Han Family’s influence and spread the fame of the Han Family’s ancestor, facilitating the taking of more concubines, but it also provided some cultivation feedback for him. Although it was meager now, every little step adds up to a thousand miles.
“When this child is born, it will be time to visit the Sect,” Han Li thought to himself.
Unbeknownst to him, nearly fifty years had passed since he descended the mountain to enter the Mortal World.
Over a hundred years ago, he went through countless hardships to become a disciple in the major Leizhou Sects of Tianxuan Mountain, cultivating all the way to the pinnacle of the Innate Realm. Rushing for quick success led to his efforts falling short, ending in despair and a somber departure from the mountain.
For decades, despite having eighteen descendants with the talent to cultivate, Han Li never considered sending them for cultivation at Tianxuan Mountain.
Tianxuan Mountain is among the great Leizhou Sects, boasting Hollow Void Stage powerhouses and enjoys significant fame throughout the Daqian Empire; their threshold for accepting disciples is quite high, starting from Eighth Grade qualifications.
Han Li, who was at the pinnacle of the Nineth Grade Innate Realm, was inconspicuous within Tianxuan Mountain, merely a Foreign Disciple, and thus unable to secure entry for his descendants into the Sect, especially those with Ninth Grade qualifications or even less impressive talents.
However, this time he had broken through to the Pihai Realm, and upon his return to Tianxuan Mountain, he was automatically promoted to an Inner Sect Disciple, which granted him no small amount of power.
If his latest descendant possessed Eighth Grade qualifications, a simple gesture on his part would ensure that his fellow Sect members responsible for recruiting Disciples would not make things too difficult and weed them out.
This is what they mean by the saying, ‘One generation plants the trees; another gets the shade.’
If the first generation cannot achieve success and lay the groundwork for their descendants, the only option left is to produce more offspring and hope for a dragon among men, which is the same in the Mortal World—’the more children, the more blessings.’
Months later, Li Mingmeng’s belly had grown, and her face was radiant with a mother’s love, her eyes filled with affection whenever she looked at Han Li.
Initially, when the Li Family Patriarch betrothed her to the Han Family Patriarch Han Li as his concubine, she was quite resistant.
After all, she was Lingjun City’s number one beauty, exceptionally talented, and possessed Ninth Grade cultivation talent, with high hopes of breaking through to the Innate Realm and transcending the ordinary. She had numerous suitors, including some with Eighth Grade qualifications.
And what of Han Li, the Han Family Patriarch?
Only just managing to step into the Pihai Realm as he approached life’s limit, his hair frosted with age, a visage of greying temples. How could she, an eighteen-year-old maiden, accept marrying an elderly man in his twilight years?
But upon truly meeting Han Li, she realized her grave mistake; her impressions of the Han Family Patriarch had been based on hearsay.
Han Li was not only in his twenties in appearance but also elegant and distinguished, a first-rate handsome man with outstanding charm—calling him the most handsome man in Lingjun City would not be an overstatement.
After marrying her, Han Li treated her exceptionally well, showing consideration in every aspect and providing various resources.
The Beauty Preserving Pill ensured her beauty would remain unchanged for a century; she had a complete supply of pills and Cultivation Techniques needed for practice, and guidance for her cultivation, so she could break through to the Innate Realm as soon as possible.
A series of thoughtful gestures greatly increased Li Mingmeng’s fondness for Han Li.
With a change of heart, considering Han Li’s attainment of the Pihai Realm as Lingjun City’s strongest, and his life expectancy of more than a hundred years, Li Mingmeng wholeheartedly accepted Han Li.
Four months later, the first child of Han Li and Li Mingmeng was finally born.
Knowing how much Han Li cared about the cultivation talent of his offspring, Li Mingmeng took the initiative to test it.
“Husband, our son has Eighth Grade cultivation talent,” she said excitedly after testing, her child’s talent even surpassing her own, clearly related to Han Li’s cultivation level and talent.
With proper nurturing, Eighth Grade talent holds a not-so-small hope for breaking through the Pihai Realm.
“Mingmeng, you just gave birth to a child and need to rest more,” Han Li said, glancing at the baby and then turning to Li Mingmeng.
Feeling Han Li’s care and protection, Li Mingmeng breathed a sigh of relief, her love for him deepening. Her husband was not as rumored on the outside, taking concubines solely to produce more offspring.
Holding Li Mingmeng’s hand, Han Li chatted with her while glancing at the System’s prompt.
“You have sired your first descendant with Eighth Grade talent, your own talent has increased by one tenth, you have gained ten years of cultivation, and you have received a Profound Rank Lower Grade martial art, the ‘Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield.’
The birth of this son had increased Han Li’s own talent by one tenth, meaning he would need to sire nine more descendants with Eighth Grade talent to upgrade to Seventh Grade qualifications, and even more descendants with Ninth Grade talent or lesser talents would be required.
Han Li was not in a rush; his lifespan was plentiful, and in time, he was certain he would elevate to Seventh Grade qualifications.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 - 4: Pihai Realm Level 6_1
chapters.content:
4 Chapter 4: Pihai Realm Level 6_1
Translator: 549690339
“`
The first descendant with an Eighth-Grade aptitude also granted Han Li ten years of cultivation and a Profound Rank Lower Grade martial arts technique.
The cultivation awarded by the system was linked to Han Li’s real-time aptitude; with the same number of years of cultivation, the better the aptitude, the faster the increase in realm.
An Eighth-Grade aptitude had almost no hope of breaking through to the Gangyuan Realm, but reaching the ninth layer of the Pihai Realm was possible, albeit it would take a considerably long time. According to Han Li’s estimation, with his current aptitude, it would take over a hundred years to cultivate to the ninth layer of the Pihai Realm.
These ten years of cultivation allowed him to break through to the second layer of the Pihai Realm, and the sea of True Qi above his dantian expanded by half, significantly enhancing his strength.
Moreover, although the cultivation was a reward from the system, it also included the corresponding cultivation insights, as if he had diligently cultivated for ten years to achieve a breakthrough.
After feeling the expanded Qi sea within his body, Han Li directed his attention to the last reward.
Profound Rank Lower Grade Martial Technique: Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield!
Every time a descendant of each aptitude rank was born for the first time, he would receive a corresponding reward; the better the aptitude, the better the reward.
The first descendant with mediocre aptitude obtained a Yellow Rank High Grade Cultivation Technique, while the first descendant with Ninth-Grade aptitude acquired the supreme Yellow Rank martial technique, “Tiger’s Roar Iron Shirt”.
In this world, the levels of cultivation techniques and elixirs are divided into: Ordinary Rank, Yellow Rank, Profound Rank, Earth Rank, and Heaven Rank, each rank further categorized into Low Grade, Middle Grade, Top Grade, and Supreme Grade.
The Ordinary Rank cultivation techniques are studied by those below the Innate Realm; those in the Innate Realm and Pihai Realm usually learn Yellow Rank cultivation techniques and martial arts; those in the Gangyuan Realm can generally learn Profound Rank Low and Middle Grade techniques and martial arts…
Apart from the Han Family, the other two major clans in Lingjun City had no better martial arts techniques than the Yellow Rank High Grade, and they only had one or two such techniques.
As far as Han Li knew, the best cultivation technique or martial skill on Tianxuan Mountain appeared to be an Earth Rank Supreme Grade, and it was said that the entire Daqian Empire only possessed a few Heaven Rank techniques and martial arts.
The best cultivation technique Han Li previously owned was the supreme Yellow Rank Xuanyuan Scripture, which he could cultivate all the way to the peak of the Pihai Realm. He had exchanged for it on Tianxuan Mountain when he was preparing to break through the Pihai Realm.
The supreme Yellow Rank martial arts technique was the “Tiger’s Roar Iron Shirt,” which now was replaced by the Profound Rank Lower Grade Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield.
The techniques and martial arts of a Sect are strictly forbidden to be passed on to outsiders, even to one’s own descendants. If anyone is discovered privately teaching them, at the least, their cultivation will be abolished, and at worst, they will be executed on the spot.
If one acquires cultivation techniques or martial arts on their own, even if they offer them to the Sect, they still retain the right to pass them on, but they cannot be carelessly shared with strangers. For instance, Han Li’s obtained Yellow Rank High Grade practice method was given to the Han Family descendants to cultivate, giving them a significant advantage when they enter the Sect over ordinary disciples.
After reading through the Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield technique, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face; he was now on solid ground.
Profound Rank martial arts are generally delved into by cultivators in the Gangyuan Realm, yet he already possessed one in the second layer of the Pihai Realm, and what’s more, the techniques awarded by the system were all directly mastered to perfection, bypassing the initial, minor, and major achievement stages, needing only a little practice to be fully mastered.
Having both the Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield and Tiger’s Roar Iron Shirt perfected, although it wouldn’t make him invincible or instantly enlightened, almost no cultivator in the Pihai Realm could breach his defense. His life was now secure, allowing him to continue to grow stronger.
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, another year went by.
Liu Yuexin and the other five concubines had yet to show any signs, but Li Mingmeng was pregnant again, with a slight bulge already apparent. In a few more months, another child would be born.
Her right hand gently caressed her protruding belly, and a smile spread across Li Mingmeng’s face.
Through two years of being together, her love for Han Li, her husband, had deepened, and she was willing to bear more children for him.
Moreover, Han Li had also said to prioritize cultivation, allowing her to bear at most three children before focusing entirely on advancing to the Innate Realm. Only then could she accompany him for a longer period of time.
“`
Under Han Li’s resources provision and guidance, Li Mingmeng had already broken through to the Rebirth Realm, significantly enhancing her strength.
One day, as Han Li was conversing with Li Mingmeng and incidentally checking on the child in her belly, it was clear that she was six or seven months pregnant, her stomach now unmistakably showing.
As Han Li eagerly anticipated the child to possess Eighth Grade aptitude, the system prompt suddenly rang out.
“Your progeny count has broken through one hundred. You have gained fifty years of cultivation, one Pihai Pill, and the Profound Rank Lower Grade martial arts technique [Falling Star Arrow Manual].”
Han Li was briefly stunned before he realized that another of his progeny had been born.
Before marrying Li Mingmeng, he had ninety-seven progeny. In the past two years, Li Mingmeng had given birth to one, and the other descendants had reproduced one more, making a total of ninety-nine.
Now, another descendant had reproduced, bringing Han Li’s progeny count finally to over a hundred, and he received the rewards for surpassing one hundred.
He had long anticipated this reward, having received something similar when his progeny count broke ten, but this time the reward was more than tenfold better.
Fifty years of cultivation had directly elevated Han Li’s realm from the second level of the Pihai Realm to the late stage of the Sixth Heaven of the Pihai Realm, nearing the later stage of the Pihai Realm.
It had been just over two years since he had broken through to the Pihai Realm, and such a rate of cultivation could be considered astonishingly fast, comparable to those with Third Grade aptitude.
“What a great item!”
Looking at the pill in his hand that emitted a rich fragrance, Han Li exclaimed appreciatively. This pill was the Pihai Pill awarded by the system.
The Pihai Pill was a Profound Rank Top Grade pill that could increase the probability of a cultivator at the peak of the Innate Ninth Heaven breaking through to the Pihai Realm by fifty percent, an effect truly defying the heavens.
Tianxuan Mountain also possessed this type of pill, but the amount supplied each year was very limited, and the contribution required to exchange for it was extremely high. At least, the former Han Li would not have been able to afford it, mainly because it was very difficult to refine and had high costs.
The Pihai Pill created by the system even had a better effect, increasing the breakthrough probability by seventy percent.
Han Li stored away the Pihai Pill; the Han Family, for the time being, had no use for it since not one of the Han Family members had reached the Innate Realm, the highest realm being True Qi Realm Eighth Heaven possessed by Liu Yuexin.
Thinking about Liu Yuexin gave Han Li somewhat of a headache; she was the first concubine he had taken and could also be considered his lucky star, as she was responsible for the appearance of his system.
Liu Yuexin was knowledgeable, gentle, and virtuous. Usually managing the affairs of the Han Family with fair and just leadership, she won the hearts of many, ensuring harmony within the Han Family and Han Li’s inner courtyard.
Therefore, Han Li treated her exceptionally well over the years. She had the best cultivation resources the Han Family could offer, and Han Li also provided her with meticulous guidance, hoping she would soon reach the peak of True Qi Realm Ninth Heaven.
However, he had not obtained any treasures that could enhance aptitude or forcibly break through to the Innate Realm, so Han Li could only wait patiently. Fortunately, Liu Yuexin still had a long life ahead of her and could afford to wait.
Casting aside the distracting thoughts in his mind, Han Li turned his attention to the last reward, the Profound Rank Lower Grade martial arts technique [Falling Star Arrow Manual].
The Falling Star Arrow Manual contained three moves: Comet Piercing the Sun, Meteor Shower, and Star Shooting from Beyond the Heavens, each with extremely powerful might.
The first move required at least a mid-stage cultivator of the Pihai Realm to learn; the second move, a late-stage of the Pihai Realm, and the third move could only be learned by someone in the Gangyuan Realm.
Naturally, Han Li faced no such thresholds; he directly cultivated the Falling Star Arrow Manual to perfection, fully mastering all three arrow techniques.

chapters.title: Chapter 5 - 5: Pihai Realm Level 8_1
chapters.content:
5 Chapter 5: Pihai Realm Level 8_1
Translator: 549690339
“Fantastic, this makes things even more stable.”
Han Li pecked the somewhat surprised Li Mingmeng on the forehead, his heart brimming with joy.
The Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield and the Tiger Roar Iron Cloth Shirt secured his invincibility, while the Falling Star Arrow Manual greatly enhanced his offensive power, addressing his weaknesses.
With his late-stage Pihai Realm Sixth Heaven cultivation, possessing two Supreme Grade Yellow-Rank cultivation techniques and two Lower Grade Profound-Rank martial techniques, it would be hard to find an opponent in the Pihai Realm.
The Falling Star Arrow Manual required high arm strength, and the Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield and Tiger Roar Iron Cloth Shirt just happened to boost his physical strength and power, more than meeting the requirements for the Falling Star Arrow Manual.
Now, all he lacked was a bow of suitable grade.
A few months later, Li Mingmeng gave birth to their second child.
This time it was a daughter, with only Ninth Grade cultivation talent. Han Li felt a slight disappointment but didn’t show it; he kissed her forehead and still took great care of Li Mingmeng.
This eased Li Mingmeng’s mind. She deeply loved this man and had truly feared that the child’s poor talent would disappoint him.
“Mingmeng, after you recover this time, you should take precautions, focus on cultivating, and we can talk about the next child after you break through to the True Qi Realm,” Han Li said softly, holding Li Mingmeng close and whispering in her ear.
“Mmm~,” Li Mingmeng responded, but her heart disagreed.
Next time, she still wouldn’t take precautions or use her energy to force the essence out of her body; she wanted to bear another child with Eighth Grade talent for her husband.
After spending some time with her, Han Li left and collected two rewards from the System on his way out.
“You have sired an offspring with Ninth Grade talent, you receive one year of cultivation, you gain one year of life, you obtain a Supreme Grade Yellow-Rank cultivation technique, you receive a Beauty Preserving Pill, and your cultivation talent is enhanced.”
“The number of offspring with cultivation talent has reached twenty, you receive twenty years of cultivation, you receive a Seventh Grade Lifespan Extension Pill, and you obtain a Supreme Grade Yellow-Rank [Sun Chasing Bow].”
Inside the bedroom, Han Li looked at the two System messages and smiled.
He had anticipated the second reward—cultivation, pills, and a weapon—consistent with the rewards for siring ten talents. However, while the previous weapon was a Supreme Grade Yellow-Rank sword, this time it was a bow, which pleased him even more as it could be paired with the Falling Star Arrow Manual.
Otherwise, it would have indeed been difficult for him to find a Supreme Grade Yellow-Rank bow, as weapons were categorized the same way as cultivation techniques. Generally, those in the later stages of the Pihai Realm utilized weapons of this grade, and so did the less wealthy in the Gangyuan Realm.
The first reward turned out better than he expected. In addition to the usual rewards of cultivation, lifespan, and technique, this time there was an extra Beauty Preserving Pill, and the technique’s grade had been raised from Top Grade Yellow-Rank to Supreme Grade.
It seemed that after the number of offspring surpassed one hundred, each new child birthed would grant four types of rewards. But to get a massive reward like the one for reaching a hundred, the number of offspring would need to reach two hundred, three hundred…
Even though he had fathered a few more in this past year plus this child, the total was still less than one hundred and ten. There was a long way to go.
Shaking off these stray thoughts, Han Li chose to claim twenty-one years of cultivation. He sat down cross-legged, prepared to properly absorb and digest this influx of cultivation.
The scattered years of cultivation he had received so far hadn’t been enough to reach the peak of the Pihai Realm Sixth Heaven, but these twenty-one years of cultivation should be enough for him to break through to the later stages of the Pihai Realm. As for how far he could push, even Han Li was unsure.
Now that his talent had been enhanced further, the cultivation he acquired would be even more effective.
Han Li’s aura soared, quickly breaking through the realm’s shackles to reach the Seventh Heaven of the Pihai Realm, and continued climbing until the mid stages of the Eighth Heaven of the Pihai Realm before it finally stabilized.
“Huff~”
Releasing a breath, Han Li’s smile deepened as he felt the Sea of Qi within him expand yet again.
The Sea of Qi of an eighth level cultivator of the Pihai Realm was nearly ten times larger than that of a first level cultivator of the Pihai Realm; the difference in strength was immense. An eighth level Pihai Realm cultivator could easily overpower dozens of first-level cultivators in the same realm. Han Li’s strength was even greater than that of an ordinary eighth-level Pihai Realm cultivator.
“It will take roughly another thirty years of cultivation to break through to the pinnacle of the ninth level of the Pihai Realm.”
Han Li estimated and concluded that the cultivation needed was somewhat more than he had previously anticipated. But Han Li wasn’t concerned, as his breakthrough speed was already quite fast.
Since it would require some time before the number of his descendants reached the next stage, he might as well stabilize his current level. Time was what the old ancestor Han Li lacked the least, and now his lifespan had increased significantly.
Casually storing away weapons, pills, and cultivation techniques, Han Li arrived at the main hall of the Han Family and issued a summons.
An hour later, all the key members of the Han Family had arrived, each of them showing the utmost respect and deference.
Those qualified to handle the Han Family affairs were all intelligent, and their current status depended greatly on Han Li, the family’s ancestor. The stronger Han Li became, the more influential the Han Family was, and the higher their personal status would be.
If any descendant caught Han Li’s favorable attention, their status within the Han Family would greatly rise, they would be nurtured as key individuals and receive abundant resources.
Looking at the descendants beneath him, Han Li mused, “Today, I have summoned you here mainly for four matters.”
“Please, Father, speak!”
Han Li’s children promptly responded with reverence. The oldest among them was around forty years old, and the youngest was around their thirties.
Han Li nodded slightly and said, “Firstly, continue to encourage fertility. The rewards for childbearing will double. Every descendant of the Han Family, after marriage, should have at least four children. For each additional child, the reward will increase by another fifty percent.”
“Secondly, spread the message that I will be taking more concubines, five should suffice.”
“Thirdly, as I am nearing two hundred years old, prepare accordingly. This birthday celebration must be well-organized.”
“Fourth, our Han Family’s business has been confined to Lingjun City for quite some time. It’s time to expand to the entirety of Fengyang Manor. Deliberate carefully and divide the territories among yourselves—no one is to drag their feet.”
“If these tasks are well accomplished, I will not be stingy with rewards, be it Spirit Stones, medicinal pills, cultivation techniques, martial skills, Divine Weapons, or even Lifespan Extension Pills.”
After Han Li’s words fell, the entire hall fell silent for a moment before erupting into excited responses.
“Yes, Father.”
The children were all extremely excited. They had no cultivation talent and their natural lifespan was merely a hundred years; with nearly half their lives already behind them, the Lifespan Extension Pills were of utmost importance to them.
They had no objections to Han Li’s instructions and only wished to execute them as well as possible to earn their father’s rewards.
Watching his children depart, a hint of a smile flashed in Han Li’s eyes.
If he waited for the descendants to multiply slowly, he knew not how long it would take. It was far quicker to intervene personally and encourage fertility.
In pursuit of the rewards offered by Han Li, the descendants would naturally choose to have more children. As the number of descendants rapidly increased, Han Li would receive more system rewards, allowing him to swiftly enhance his cultivation and strength.
Of course, one should not put all eggs in one basket. He himself would continue to take concubines, creating more offspring from the source, ensuring there would be even more descendants in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 6 - 6 Tianxuan Mountain_1
chapters.content:
6 Chapter 6 Tianxuan Mountain_1
Translator: 549690339
News quickly spread from Han Mansion throughout Lingjun City, and then continued to disseminate throughout the entire Fengyang Manor.
Before long, everyone in Fengyang Manor knew of the three pieces of news coming from the Han Family.
The patriarch of the Han Family is taking another concubine!
The patriarch of the Han Family is approaching his 200th birthday!
The Han Family is expanding!
As for the first matter, that was an internal affair of the Han Family and did not need to be publicized.
The cultivation world cared most about the first two pieces of news and paid little mind to the third, as the Han Family’s business expansion was just a mundane wealth matter, useless to cultivators.
Many cultivators, upon hearing the first piece of news, couldn’t help but curse under their breath. That old geezer from the Han Family was way too fond of female company.
Right before his life’s limit, he had taken six concubines, and as soon as he broke through to the Pihai Realm, he took Lingjun City’s number one beauty as his concubine. That was just a few years ago, wasn’t it? And now he’s taking five more concubines!
If they were fortunate enough to make a breakthrough to the Pihai Realm, they would surely focus on cultivation, possibly stepping into the Gangyuan Realm, and then they could enjoy themselves without hurry.
“The patriarch of the Han Family will surely die on a woman’s belly one day,” many cultivators thought in unison.
Given the patriarch’s temperament, he had taken six concubines shortly after his breakthrough, and with a hundred years of life ahead, wouldn’t he take a hundred more?
Even a powerhouse of the Pihai Realm couldn’t withstand such indulgence!
Countless people were agonizing over this, wishing they could be in the patriarch’s shoes, enjoying themselves before dedicating their efforts to cultivation.
That being said, this was, in fact, a good opportunity to ingratiate oneself with a Pihai Realm powerhouse. In Fengyang Manor, there were scant opportunities to find such desirable women, making it hard to find an opportunity to curry favor.
Many cultivation families hastened to Lingjun City with their qualified and beautiful female cultivators, and even some attractive widows joined the rush, thinking perhaps the patriarch would like a change of taste.
Beyond that, other powers within Fengyang Manor also sent people to Lingjun City, at least those with a Pihai Realm powerhouse in their sect, to offer birthday wishes to the patriarch of the Han Family.
Being in Fengyang Manor, the influence of a Pihai Realm powerhouse was not insignificant, especially for someone like the patriarch who had just broken through and was unaffiliated with any sect, making him an ideal target for alliances.
The mortal world, on the other hand, was most concerned with the third piece of news. The Han Family, being a massive entity guarded by a Pihai Realm expert, was expanding its business throughout the entire Fengyang Manor, inevitably affecting their interests, yet they dared not offend.
However, some more perceptive individuals saw it as an opportunity, thinking they might hitch a ride on the Han Family’s powerful vessel. They took the initiative to reach out to the Han Family, willing to pave the way and offer conveniences for their business expansion.
While Lingjun City was abuzz with the news from the Han Family, Han Li, the patriarch, had already left Lingjun City quietly and without a trace.
After leaving Lingjun City by a hundred miles, Han Li promptly rode the winds through a void, swiftly flying towards a certain direction.
Upon reaching the Pihai Realm, a vast Qi sea opens up above the Dantian, increasing the quantity of Innate True Qi a hundredfold, which allows one to fly using their own strength, soaring between heaven and earth, from the North Sea to Cangwu in a day.
Even with Han Li’s eightfold cultivation in the Pihai Realm enabling fast travel, it still took him ten days and ten nights to reach his destination.
At this moment, Han Li stood at the foot of a mountain range spanning ten thousand miles, the entrance to the Leizhou Sects’ Major Sect Tianxuan Mountain, which was extraordinary, grand, and imposing.
He had left Fengyang Manor several days earlier, entering the vast Leizhou.
The Daqian Empire’s territory was enormously vast, stretching millions of miles from east to west, and nearly nine million miles from north to south, ranking among the Eight Great Forces of the Mysterious Region and one of the four major empires.
Leizhou was one of the eighteen provinces of the Daqian Empire, located on the border. Further south was the domain of the top demonic sect of the Yinyang Sect.
Leizhou had five major forces: Tianxuan Mountain, Hehuan Sect, Sword Cleansing Pool, True Sun Sect, and the Province City of Leizhou representing the Daqian Empire, with the government of the Province City being the strongest.
“`
Gazing upon the thirty-foot tall stone stele in front of him, Han Li’s eyes bore a complex expression. That was the mountain gate stele of Tianxuan Mountain, inscribed with three powerful and forceful characters—
Tianxuan Mountain!
It’s said that these were written by the Founding Master of Tianxuan Mountain, a true powerhouse who could be called a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
In this world, the cultivation levels are divided into Body Refining, Blood Exchange, True Qi, Innate, Pihai, Gang Yuan, Soul Refining, Void Piercing, Myriad Phenomena, True Martial… with each realm further divided into Nine Heavens.
The first three realms are merely mortal. Only upon entering the fourth realm, the Innate, does one truly transcend the secular world, greatly increasing their lifespan. From then on, every realm significantly extends one’s life, and it is said that a Grandmaster Wanxiang could live a millennium.
“Tianxuan Mountain, I, Han Li, have returned,” Han Li whispered softly.
Nearly fifty years ago, he had descended the mountain in despair, believing he would never have the chance to return to Tianxuan Mountain. Unexpectedly, after taking a concubine, his fortunes changed for the better, as if after the darkness and flowers, another village had come into view, and he had reached it thanks to his golden finger.
Some years ago, he made a breakthrough to the Pihai Realm and now he had further cultivated to the eighth level of the Pihai Realm in one fell swoop, which was the kind of cultivation speed you would expect, perhaps, from someone with Third Grade aptitude.
Gathering his thoughts, Han Li smiled freely and stepped towards the mountain path.
On an ordinary day, the mountain gate of Tianxuan Mountain was guarded by a dozen or so disciples, among them one from the Pihai Realm, three from the Innate Realm, and the rest from the True Qi Realm. Furthermore, hidden in the shadows was the Mountain Protection Array, which was typically not activated. After all, constantly maintaining the Mountain Protection Array was costly, and even the wealthy Tianxuan Mountain would bleed at the heart for the expense.
“Turn back the way you came; it is not yet time to accept disciples,” said one of the True Qi Realm disciples on guard, frowning as he spoke to an unfamiliar young man.
Tianxuan Mountain’s disciple acceptance event occurs once every three years. Those who missed the occasion or were eliminated often loitered around the mountain gate, relying on luck. This True Qi Realm disciple had been stationed there for several years and had encountered many such people.
Seeing that Han Li continued to ascend, the disciple was about to scold him again when the commotion attracted the attention of an Innate Realm disciple. He looked Han Li up and down, and his eyes suddenly lit up as he asked:
“Excuse me, are you Brother Han Li?”
The other disciples also looked over, their eyes filled with curiosity. Was there a Brother Han Li in the sect?
This person appeared to be in his twenties; could he also be of the Innate Realm? The True Qi Realm disciples were secretly shocked. A cultivator in the Innate Realm in their twenties must have excellent aptitude.
“Brother Han Li?”
Two more Innate Realm disciples arrived, and they were stunned as they looked at the exceptionally handsome young man before them.
Sensing the aura emanating from Han Li, the three Innate Realm disciples were somewhat taken aback. Brother Han Li had actually made a breakthrough to the Pihai Realm!
As Tianxuan Mountain’s Foreign Disciples, they knew Han Li from before, but as he had a middle-aged appearance back then and was now in his youth, they didn’t recognize him at first.
“My three junior brothers, long time no see.”
Han Li spoke with a smile, his demeanor gentle and courteous, without any arrogance. He even smiled at the True Qi Realm disciple who had scolded him, commending him, “Not bad.”
It had been nearly fifty years since he left Tianxuan Mountain. It was only normal that these True Qi Realm disciples, who had come later, did not recognize him.
“Congratulations, Brother Han Li, on your breakthrough to the Pihai Realm.”
The three Innate Realm disciples congratulated him in unison, envy in their eyes, but without a trace of jealousy or ridicule.
They knew of Han Li’s situation. Having failed his breakthrough to the Pihai Realm, his aptitude was damaged, and he was left with no hope of advancing further, thus descending the mountain in despair.
Although they did not know how he had managed to break through, a breakthrough was still a breakthrough, and even if it was achieved nearing the end of his life, Han Li was now a whole Big Realm higher than them. He would automatically be promoted to Inner Sect Disciple, with much better treatment.
“Congratulations, Brother Han, on your breakthrough to the Pihai Realm.”
The other disciples also offered their congratulations, their eyes full of admiration. Although some of them also possessed Grade Eight aptitudes, whether they could break through to the Pihai Realm was still uncertain.

chapters.title: Chapter 7 - 7 The Joy of Winning by Lying Down_1
chapters.content:
7 Chapter 7 The Joy of Winning by Lying Down_1
Translator: 549690339
“`
At that moment, the Pihai Realm cultivator guarding the sect’s entrance finally appeared.
Guarding the sect’s entrance was a relaxed duty, and this Inner Sect Disciple took on the task while cultivating, earning some Contribution Points in the process.
Generally, no one would disturb him as usual people would be stopped by other disciples and wouldn’t reach him at all.
The commotion of Han Li’s return was quite noticeable, and the Inner Sect Disciple was stirred, so he came out to take a look.
“Han Li?”
Observing the handsome young man, the Inner Sect Disciple pondered, and finally remembered who Han Li was. A hint of surprise flashed in his eyes, but his movements were not slow.
“So it’s Junior Brother Han Li, congratulations on breaking through to the Pihai Realm. Our Inner Academy has gained another exceptional individual, which is indeed a cause for celebration.”
Han Li had deliberately concealed his cultivation, only revealing the first layer of the Pihai Realm. He did not wish to be treated as a prodigy by the sect as that would attract too much attention.
With the Longevity Family System, all he needed was to develop low-profile. In the future, everything was possible—why rush to contend with those so-called geniuses?
The taller the tree stands, the stronger the wind blows!
Han Li only wanted to bide his time for now. Billions of years later, standing above all through the ages, the grass on the graves of these so-called geniuses would be sky-high.
The reason for his return to Tianxuan Mountain and his advancement to Inner Sect Disciple was also to build connections, facilitating the easy entry into the sect for future descendants with eighth-rank talent or higher.
Descendants with good cultivation talent should enter the sect to receive better training and improve their cultivation rapidly, which would also provide him with feedback for his own cultivation.
Tianxuan Mountain was the sect Han Li had chosen for his descendants.
“I’ve seen Senior Brother Zhang,” Han Li greeted with a cupped fist salute.
This Senior Brother Zhang was older than Han Li and had a talent close to seventh-rank. He had already broken through to the Pihai Realm before Han Li had left the mountain, and now he was at the middle phase of the Pihai Realm’s sixth layer.
Senior Brother Zhang had more than eighty years of life remaining, with no problem reaching the peak of the ninth layer of Pihai Realm. However, advancing to the Gangyuan Realm would be too difficult.
The probability for a seventh-rank talent to break through to the Gangyuan Realm is only about twenty percent, and for Senior Brother Zhang with his near-seventh-rank talent, the chances might not even be one in ten.
But no one could say for sure about the future—perhaps Senior Brother Zhang would have a special opportunity and break through.
After chatting casually with the disciple guarding the entrance, particularly with Senior Brother Zhang, Han Li formally entered Tianxuan Mountain.
Looking at the undulating mountain range rising before him and the uniquely majestic peaks, the corners of Han Li’s mouth curved slightly upward.
Tianxuan Mountain has a total of six peaks, which are the essence of the sect, with the Sect Leader and five Elders each presiding over one peak.
Tianxuan Mountain categorizes its disciples into Registered Disciples, Foreign Disciples, Inner Sect Disciples, and Core Disciples.
Registered and Foreign Disciples reside at the foot of the Tianxuan Mountain Range in designated areas, while Inner Sect Disciples live higher up on the mountainside in the Inner Academy, where the Spiritual Energy is even more abundant.
Those promoted to the Gangyuan Realm or taken as disciples by the Sect Leader or an Elder are the Core Disciples of the sect. Core Disciples are generally the disciples of a certain Elder, living on their respective peaks.
The Sect Leader is a Grandmaster of the Hollow Void Stage, with all five Elders being true people of the God Refining Realm. This is the greatest foundation of Tianxuan Mountain and also why the sect is one of Leizhou’s four major factions and has a bit of fame in the entire Daqian Empire.
Han Li continued onward, leaving the Outer Academy and arriving at the Inner Academy. After announcing his arrival, he was led into a grand hall.
In the hall sat an old man with white hair and beard, who was in charge of the affairs of the Inner Sect Disciples’ promotions.
“`
This elder was by no means simple; his name was Jiang Cheng, a mighty Pihai Realm ninth layer cultivator with a sixth-grade cultivation talent.
Looking old, he was actually only slightly older than Han Li. Originally a famous talent of Tianxuan Mountain, he broke through to the Pihai Realm in just a few decades, with hopes of reaching the God Refining Realm. Unfortunately, he encountered a seductress from Hehuan Sect and fell into a calamitous love trap.
When Jiang Cheng went out for experience, the Hehuan Sect’s seductress deliberately approached him and planted a love entrapment in his body. Jiang Cheng fell deeply in love with her, and in the end, she successfully harvested his affection.
After the Hehuan Sect’s seductress left, Jiang Cheng’s hair turned white overnight. He returned to Tianxuan Mountain but from then on, he was dispirited, never showing any more ambition or lofty aspirations.
His master and even the sect leader had visited him, and in the end, they only said, “Once Jiang Cheng can break through the love tribulation, he will be able to swiftly ascend to the God Refining Realm, otherwise he will not be able to advance to the Gang Yuan Realm in this lifetime.”
This elder brother’s experience was used as a cautionary tale within the sect, warning disciples to stay away from the seductresses of Hehuan Sect. It would have been difficult for Han Li not to know about him.
“Brother Jiang, is there anything else?”
Seeing that Jiang Cheng was lost in thought, Han Li spoke up to remind him.
Jiang Cheng shook his head and said, “Disciple Han proves to be a Pihai Realm cultivator. This is your Inner Sect token. From now on, you are an Inner Sect Disciple of Tianxuan Mountain.”
Seeing Jiang Cheng’s indifferent and uninspired demeanor, Han Li took the token and tactfully excused himself.
With the identity token in hand, Han Li moved about the Inner Sect unimpeded, going first to another area to receive his reward for being promoted to Inner Sect Disciple: ten mid-grade spiritual stones, three sea opening pills, a set of Superior Yellow-tiered inner armor, and a set of Inner Sect Disciple attire.
He then directly went to his assigned spacious courtyard. The scenery here was very beautiful, and the spiritual energy was abundant; the furniture inside was all-encompassing.
Han Li casually put on the inner armor underneath and wore the Inner Sect attire on the outside before looking at the bags and bottles on the table.
The bottle contained three sea opening pills that could help a Pihai Realm cultivator expand their inner sea more broadly, with each pill potentially increasing it by about 5%, a very impressive effect.
The bag contained ten mid-grade spiritual stones, equivalent to one thousand lower-grade spiritual stones, which was quite a nice perk.
Although he did not need the sea opening pills and spiritual stones, his descendants and concubines did, and this was also the reason why Han Li made a trip to the sect: the sect had given quite generously.
Below the Innate Realm, it was common to use worldly wealth for transactions. Once in the Innate Realm, spiritual stones became the hard currency of the cultivation realm, useful not only for transactions but also for accelerating a cultivator’s pace of cultivation.
Like Tianxuan Mountain, such a large sect was wealthy and generous with rewards for its disciples: fifty lower-grade spiritual stones for promotion to Foreign Disciples, ten mid-grade spiritual stones for Inner Sect Disciples, and a whopping two hundred mid-grade spiritual stones for Core Disciples.
In the following period, Han Li continued to live in this courtyard. The news of his breakthrough to the Pihai Realm and promotion to Inner Sect Disciple also spread within the sect, and many people he once knew, fellow senior and junior disciples, came to visit him.
Some of them had been promoted to Inner Sect Disciples over the years, while others were still in the Innate Realm, nearing the end of their lifespans.
Those nearing the end of their lifespans lit up when they saw Han Li; if he could breakthrough near the end of his life, then they also had a chance.
Han Li did not mock them but instead encouraged them, sincerely hoping that these fellow disciples with whom he had good relations could also make their breakthrough to the Pihai Realm.
Half a month later, Han Li left Tianxuan Mountain. His outward reason was to go out for cultivation experience, but in reality, he intended to return to Lingjun City to retire, watch the world’s tumult from afar, and develop slowly.
Typically, after being promoted to Inner Sect Disciple, one could choose a mountain peak to pay respects to and select an Elder or the sect leader to become a disciple of. If successful, one directly became a Core Disciple, gaining access to even more cultivation resources.
Han Li, well aware of his own situation, did not attempt to take a master. He had no need for one; after all, he didn’t practice cultivation. What use was a master to him?
For nearly fifty years, he had never cultivated, yet he had breezed his way through to the Pihai Realm, ascending all the way to the eighth layer.
Being able to impart all he knew at will, enjoying longevity and standing atop the eternal heavens, this was simply the ultimate delight!

chapters.title: Chapter 8 - 8 The Ancestor Took Another Concubine Again_1
chapters.content:
8 Chapter 8 The Ancestor Took Another Concubine Again_1
Translator: 549690339
After leaving Tianxuan Mountain, Han Li returned home, safely arriving back at the Han Family in Lingjun City.
His round trip had taken two months, and the whole Lingjun City was already festooned with lanterns and streamers. With less than three months to go until his two-hundredth birthday, the entire city had come to life.
The Daqian Empire was divided into provinces, manors, counties, and townships. Lingjun City was a county seat, and Lingjun County itself was quite large, stretching hundreds of miles and governing many villages and towns with a countless population.
The esteemed ancestor of the Han Family, a cultivator of the Pihai Realm, was the number one figure in Lingjun County. His upcoming two-hundredth birthday banquet had stirred excitement throughout the county. Many powers and families within Lingjun County and from Fengyang Manor’s territories practically tripped over each other trying to get into Lingjun City, resulting in the city reaching full capacity.
Even during normal times, Lingjun City had a large population, boasting over three million residents, but now the number had soared to more than four million. Aside from the various guests, the rest were there to watch the excitement, since it had been over a thousand years since a Pihai Realm cultivator had emerged from Lingjun County.
Despite Lingjun City’s large population, the number of those born with cultivation talents was very limited; in a year, less than a thousand emerged, most of whom possessed mediocre talent. A Ninth Grade talent was uncommon, an Eighth Grade talent even rarer, and as for a Seventh Grade talent or higher, one might not appear in ten years.
In the grand hall of the Han Mansion, Han Li was receiving reports from several of his children and, as he listened, a smile appeared on his face.
The first and second tasks he had assigned had been completed, while the third and fourth were still underway, all with commendable efficiency.
Indeed, hefty rewards spurred the Han Family’s younger generation to reproduce more quickly. He had only been gone for two months, and already more than a dozen women in the Han Family were pregnant. In time, when they gave birth, his progeny would significantly increase.
The selection of the five new concubines he planned to take had also been finalized. They were all top-notch beauties; the least talented still possessed mediocre talents, but among them, there was unexpectedly one with a Ninth Grade talent, which pleasantly surprised Han Li.
As the sole cultivator in the Pihai Realm in Lingjun County, his status was incredibly high. Coupled with his fondness for taking concubines, many families eagerly presented their beautiful daughters, giving the Han Family their pick.
Even if they weren’t chosen as a concubine by the esteemed ancestor of the Han Family, marrying into other branches of the Han Family was still a good prospect. Such marriages promised a life of luxury and glory, and the woman’s family would benefit from the connection to the influential Han Family.
Han Li distributed some resources as rewards to his children, which thrilled them immensely.
Soon, the Han Mansion became a hive of activity once again, as Han Li planned to marry the five concubines within the next few days, mainly to avoid overlapping with the possibility of taking more concubines after the big celebration.
Better to marry them sooner and start expanding the family earlier.
Although taking in five concubines at once made everyone in the Han Mansion extremely busy, they were experienced in these matters. The Han Family patriarch had already taken seven concubines, and his descendants went about the preparations methodically and adeptly.
Each time he took a concubine, Han Li’s ceremony was as grand as a cultivator’s wedding, reflecting the importance he placed upon his concubines, and this time was no exception.
While Han Li had taken many concubines, each held deep affection for him, with no one speaking ill of him. Despite his reputation for being a womanizer, his social standing remained positive.
“The Han Family ancestor is taking in concubines again, and this time five at once!”
“The Han Family ancestor is a powerful being of the Pihai Realm. It wouldn’t be strange even if he took fifty at once, let alone five.”
“Five female cultivators, can the Han Family ancestor’s stamina keep up?”
“…”
As the five bridal processions of the Han Family returned, each escorting a beautiful bride, Lingjun City was buzzing with conversation once again.
At nightfall,
Han Li entered the first bridal chamber, lifted the red veil, and looked at the shy and beautiful bride. With a light flick of his finger, the lamp went out.
Han Li spent a wonderful night here.
In the following two months, Han Li could be described as indefatigably tilling his fields, tending to a concubine each day, until finally all five ravishing women were with child.
He was almost worn out by these delightful days of an immortal’s life.
“Tsk, tsk, if it weren’t for my breakthrough to Pihai Realm and the Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield coupled with the Tiger’s Roar Ironcloth Shirt greatly enhancing my physical strength, not even an immortal could withstand this,” Han Li sighed. It was his first time facing such a situation, but fortunately, he had honed his techniques. He would definitely be more at ease next time.
In the following few days, Han Li stayed inside Han Mansion without leaving, contemplating life.
He now had one hundred and eight descendants, with two more little ones recently born; still, only twenty of his offspring possessed cultivation talent.
Now that his five concubines were pregnant and other descendants were also performing admirably, with over a dozen pregnant, the Han Family’s lineage would increase by at least thirty more within a year at the most.
Han Li was not worried about his future development. His cultivation level would reach the peak of ninth grade in the Pihai Realm next year, and his next step would be to strive for a breakthrough to the Gangyuan Realm.
With only eighth-grade cultivation talent, normally his chances of breaking through to the Gangyuan Realm were one in ten thousand. He wondered if the system reward could help him overcome the shackles of his talent and advance to Gangyuan Realm.
If not, he would have to wait patiently until his talent improved to the seventh grade before attempting the breakthrough.
Of course, Han Li also hoped the system would award some treasures that could enhance cultivation talent, so not only could he improve his own talent, but his concubines and capable descendants could also follow in his footsteps and go even further.
The hardest to retain are the times of life, the beauty bidding farewell to the mirror, the flowers to the trees!
If possible, Han Li hoped his concubines could accompany him forever. Liu Yuexin, the first he had taken, was already nearly seventy, and the other five concubines were not young either.
With Han Li’s assistance, they all maintained the appearance of their youth, and their lifespans were extended to one hundred and twenty or thirty years.
“In future years, if I should stand above the eternal heavens, I shall share the years with you all!”
Han Li wished he could say to his concubines this famous line by Shi Ritian.
“Alas~”
With only sixty years remaining, if he could not find a treasure that would increase his talent, he would have no choice but to forcefully aid his concubines in breaking through to the Innate Realm.
There are generally two types of pills for breaking through realms: one that increases the success rate without affecting subsequent promotions to higher realms, and the other that enables direct breakthroughs but has significant side effects, depriving the user of any chance to advance to higher realms upon consumption.
Han Li knew of a pill that could help one break through to the Innate Realm, called the Innate Pill; Tianxuan Mountain had it, not cheap but those who had a chance to break through the Pihai Realm would never choose to consume the Innate Pill.
If given the choice, Han Li would still prefer to improve the cultivation talent of his concubines so they could ascend with him and thus accompany him further on his journey.
He was not a heartless man; though having many sons brought blessings, he wouldn’t treat his concubines as mere birthing machines. He treated each one well, limiting to bearing no more than three children each. That was why his concubines were utterly devoted to him, each one profoundly in love.
Of course, while cutting expenses on one side, it was necessary to open up new sources of wealth—only by taking in more concubines could he enjoy the blessings of many sons.
At that moment, one of Han Li’s offspring rushed in hurriedly, interrupting his thoughts.

chapters.title: Chapter 9 - 9 The Essence of Immortality_1
chapters.content:
9 Chapter 9 The Essence of Immortality_1
Translator: 549690339
“`
“In such a rush, what is the meaning of this unseemly behavior?”
Han Li’s eyebrows furrowed slightly as he spoke indifferently.
Chastened by Han Li’s rebuke, the middle-aged man shuddered and said weakly, “Father, a man has arrived outside the manor, claiming that he has urgent business with you.”
To seek me?
Han Li’s eyebrows furrowed further. Apart from a trip to Tianxuan Mountain a few months ago, he hadn’t left Lingjun City in decades. Who would come looking for him?
Han Li carefully inquired about the appearance of the visitor and, upon reflection, realized he didn’t recognize the person.
After pacing back and forth, he made a decision.
“Bring that person to the great hall, I shall arrive shortly.”
Having said this, Han Li went to the side hall, intending to observe the visitor in secret and discern his true intentions.
Han Li sighed. He remembered how, when he was cultivating on Tianxuan Mountain, he too had a heart filled with bravery and diligence, daring to fight for cultivation resources.
After descending the mountain with the ‘golden finger,’ Han Li’s mindset changed, becoming one of conservatism. He insisted on certainty in all things — “A cautious driver will have a long life,” avoiding risks whenever possible. His life was important; the longer he lived, the stronger he would become.
He believed he had comprehended the essence of longevity and survival, condensed into one word: Persevere!
A stranger showing up unannounced with urgent business, and one he did not even recognize, made Han Li extremely cautious.
Was this person here to assassinate him?
Was he being asked to save someone?
Or was he being invited to some grand event?
Perhaps to explore the ruins of some great power?
…
All possibilities flashed through Han Li’s mind. He had recently advanced to the Pihai Realm, and had taken five new concubines, preparing to celebrate his two hundredth birthday, causing quite a stir in Fengyang Manor.
It had taken him nearly fifty years to break through to the Pihai Realm and the future was promising. Han Li certainly didn’t want to capsize in a gutter and die an anonymous death.
If he died, what would happen to his twelve concubines?
Han Li had no desire to let others do the plumbing repairs for him.
Shaking his head to clear away such thoughts, he saw his descendants leading a person into the great hall.
The visitor was a middle-aged man in his thirties, rough-looking with an appearance of urgency, seemingly with extremely urgent matters as he paced back and forth in the hall, occasionally rubbing his hands together.
After carefully observing for a while, Han Li breathed a sigh of relief when he confirmed that the man was only at the seventh level of the Rebirth Realm. With his eighth level cultivation in the Pihai Realm, unless the visitor was a Gangyuan Realm expert, it was impossible to conceal his cultivation level from Han Li.
If the man was of the Gangyuan Realm, he would have simply forced his way in, not bothering with this pretense. Moreover, there were only a few in the entire Fengyang Manor, and no one had a grudge against him.
