The Daqian Empire consists of eighteen provinces such as Leizhou, Huozhou, etc., with the highest authority in each province being the Protector General, who is empowered by the Emperor to govern and maintain peace in the province.
Each Protector General possesses extremely high cultivation, at least at the level of a Guru in the Void Realm. While they may not be able to turn the world upside down, shattering mountains and severing rivers is a trivial task for them.
A Guru in the Void Realm working together with four God Refining Realm masters, plus the Huozhou army, were nevertheless defeated, suffering heavy casualties. Was the White Lotus Cult too fierce?
Although there was an element of surprise attack, it would still require at least two Gurus in the Void Realm working together, as well as many in the God Refining Realm and Gang Yuan Realm, to cause such heavy losses to the imperial army.
A heretical cult emerging so suddenly with such a foundation undoubtedly had the backing of a top-tier power.
It was highly likely they aimed to destabilize the Daqian Empire, distracting the Empire’s attention. While Han Li felt that the White Lotus Cult was fierce, he didn’t believe that a mere cult could topple the entire Daqian Empire.
Even the White Lotus Cult could hardly capture Huozhou City. The main reason for the imperial army’s defeat was being caught off guard. Now that the details of the White Lotus Cult are known, how could they let the cult run rampant?
Many powerful arrays protect Huozhou City, and within the province city, there wasn’t just one Guru in the Void Realm who was the Protector General. Additionally, the major sects of Huozhou wouldn’t just let the White Lotus Cult wreak havoc, as this would be infringing on their territory and sabotaging the foundation of their sects; they might even join forces with the imperial army to extinguish the White Lotus Cult.
In every major sect, there is at least one Guru in the Void Realm in charge. The White Lotus Cult could only create such a disturbance by catching people off guard.
They likely couldn’t keep it up for long.
After understanding the situation, Han Li regained his composure.
“I’ve heard something about it too,” Liu Yuexin said timely, her brows knit with a thread of worry.
“It won’t come to us, will it?”
The concubines were somewhat frightened and asked anxiously.
Han Li chuckled, hugged Qiu Yueyao into his arms and kissed her, then shook his head and said, “Huozhou and Leizhou are still separated by Qingzhou, which is quite far away.”
“Although the Daqian Empire is showing signs of decline, it’s not something a mere White Lotus Cult could shake. This heretical cult will soon be eradicated.”
The women all breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this. Han Li was their pillar of strength, and since he said so, they naturally believed him.
That being said, Han Li also felt a sense of urgency, sensing an impending storm in the Daqian Empire, with the White Lotus Cult possibly being just a precursor.
He was only at the Gang Yuan Realm now, and his strength wasn’t sufficient to deal with such situations. In the coming days, he needed to focus on quickly improving his cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 18 - 18 Wusheng Laomu_1
chapters.content:
18 Chapter 18 Wusheng Laomu_1
Translator: 549690339
Since the rise of the heretical White Lotus Cult in Huozhou, which slaughtered the imperial army of the Qian Dynasty and sent it fleeing in a crushing defeat, the entire Da Qian Empire had turned its full attention to this matter. The court and the common people alike were all shaken to their cores.
Anyone with a bit of sense knew that Da Qian was in tumult and riddled with undercurrents. Whether the empire could quickly extinguish the White Lotus Cult had become a test of the Da Qian Empire’s depth and strength.
The matter of the White Lotus Cult was significant. After defeating Huozhou’s army, it rapidly spread in all directions, soon affecting the thirteen provinces of Huozhou. Only those core territories controlled by the major sects were still out of reach for the White Lotus Cult.
This led to Huozhou’s major sects temporarily holding back their forces and watching from the sidelines, which was somewhat different from Han Li’s predictions.
It had been said before that the previous Emperor Qian, during his reign, had been overly domineering. He had offended too many powers, both inside and outside the empire, including the empire’s major sects.
After successfully suppressing Buddhism and driving out the Buddhist Sect’s influence, the last Emperor Qian turned against them, wanting to leverage the prevailing momentum to coerce the major powers within the empire to truly submit and not remain in a quasi-independent state.
The true aim of the last Emperor Qian was to strengthen his grip over the internal affairs of the empire. He wanted to emulate the Ancient Empire, having the strong practitioners of the major sects obey the orders of the Da Qian Empire. Moreover, he even expected the sects to offer up their unique skills to enrich the imperial treasury.
This was practically asking for the sects’ very lives. Once agreed, they would become completely subservient to the Da Qian Empire, which led the combined forces to resist.
The external threats of the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and the Da Jing Empire, who were eyeing Da Qian with greedy intentions, suddenly became restless, mobilizing troops and readying to invade Da Qian at any moment to carve up its territory.
Faced with internal strife and external threats, the previous Emperor Qian eventually compromised. The situation had slipped beyond his control. If he truly moved against the sects within the empire, the three great powers would inevitably come crashing in fiercely.
At that point, the Da Qian Empire would likely face destruction at his hands.
In the face of internal opposition, he still allowed the sects to maintain their quasi-independence, even making some concessions and offers of reparation. Externally, however, he continued to be strong-willed, managing to repel the three great threats.
Since he couldn’t achieve these goals during his reign, he left this problem for his successor. Whoever would become Emperor Qian would have to confront this issue eventually.
The sects within the empire were originally just a temporary and loose alliance. Seeing that Da Qian had relented, they did not dare push their luck and had bided their time, continuing to coexist peacefully.
More importantly, the sects did not want to become cannon fodder. If they continued to resist, the three great powers would be pleased to see this, and might even add fuel to the flames. If the sects and the Da Qian Empire ended up in a bitter struggle, it would be then that the three great powers would join in to reap the fruits of victory.
Just like the previous Emperor Qian, the leaders of the sects also planned to leave this problem for future generations to solve.
Since they were developing within the Da Qian Empire, a great conflict with the empire was inevitable sooner or later. However, both sides understood that unless one party had an absolute advantage, a large-scale confrontation was unlikely to happen again.
If any sect produced an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, they definitely wouldn’t want to remain subservient to Da Qian and would be strong enough to become the ninth great power of Xuan Domain. If a Divine Yuan Realm warrior emerged, overthrowing the Da Qian Empire would be easy, and they might even unify the Xuan Domain.
The Da Qian Empire was the same. If they produced a fighter in the Divine Yuan Realm, the three great external threats—the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and Da Jing Empire—could be dealt with easily.
Without such power on either side, they were forced into mutual compromises and restraint, unless a good opportunity presented itself.
The current Emperor Qian could not stabilize the Da Qian Empire. There were many dissenting voices within the imperial court, and the suppression of the various sects had lessened. However, none of the sects acted rashly, as the Da Qian Empire had not yet shown signs of actual weakening.
According to the sects’ conjectures, the heretical White Lotus Cult was undoubtedly a pawn, used to test the mettle of the Da Qian Empire.
If the Daqian Empire were to eradicate the White Lotus Cult with the swiftness of thunder, then the hidden hand behind the scenes might lay low for a while, waiting for another opportunity; if the Daqian Empire couldn’t deal with the White Lotus Cult promptly, it would indicate that the Empire’s strength was somewhat lacking.
Then, the mastermind would increase support for the White Lotus Cult, thoroughly disrupt the inner workings of the Daqian Empire, hastening its decline before seeking an opportunity to overturn and carve up the territory.
The major Sects of Huozhou, and even the major factions from other provinces, all began to watch and wait, seeking to discern the depth of the Daqian Empire’s reserves.
If the Daqian Empire were really on the ropes, they wouldn’t mind switching allegiance to other top powers from the Xuan Domain, jointly partitioning the Daqian Empire and taking a hefty bite of the spoils during the overthrow.
The interests of the Sects and those of the Daqian Empire were not the same; they wouldn’t fight to the death for the Empire. Within the Daqian Empire, their Sects were only nominally subject to the Empire.
In the following months, the situation underwent new changes.
With the major forces of Huozhou looking on, the strengthened White Lotus Cult truly launched an attack on Huozhou City.
In that battle, the White Lotus Cult unveiled two Gurus in the Void Realm and eight God Refining Realm experts, shocking the Daqian Empire.
A cult emerging out of nowhere suddenly possessed four Gurus in the Void Realm, seventeen God Refining Realm experts, and over a hundred in the Gangyuan Realm…Such a lineup was incredibly lavish.
Although Huozhou City was the largest city in the entire province, there were only three Gurus in the Void Realm within the city, one being the Protector General of Huozhou, one the leader of the Jingye Office, and the last, a recluse Grandmaster.
The Jingye Office was a military agency of the Daqian Empire, used to strengthen imperial control, answering only to Emperor Qian and overseeing the entire Daqian Empire.
The lowest rank within the Jingye Office was the Pihai Realm. When Han Li broke through to the Pihai Realm, the Jingye Office extended an invitation to him, which he refused. He had no desire to sell his life for the court.
When the White Lotus Cult attacked, intent on seizing Huozhou City, the Daqian Empire was enraged. The rescript of Emperor Qian reached the ears of the Protector General and the leader of the Jingye Office on the very same day, ordering them to eliminate the White Lotus Cult with utmost speed.
The battle erupted; the White Lotus Cult launched a fierce assault, while the forces of the Daqian Empire defended behind the great city formation. Even after they persuaded the reclusive Grandmaster to take action, their strength was only on par with that of the White Lotus Cult.
Huozhou City also housed the Godslayer Army, Huozhou’s most elite force, under the command of the Protector General. Using the battle formation, they could unleash the Combat Ability of a Guru in the Void Realm, holding back a Dharma King of the White Lotus Cult.
Otherwise, the city’s great formation would not have lasted long under the sustained bombardment by a Guru in the Void Realm and several God Refining Realm experts.
Unable to breach the city after a prolonged siege, the head of the White Lotus Cult, the Ageless Mother, jumped into action, breaking the city’s defensive formation in three moves and displaying the terrifying combat prowess of a Grandmaster Wanxiang.
But in the end, the White Lotus Cult was defeated, suffering countless casualties. If the White Lotus Cult had a Grandmaster Wanxiang, wouldn’t the Daqian Empire have one too?
The Grandmaster Wanxiang in charge of protecting Huozhou, Leizhou, Qingzhou, and other provinces, had already rushed to Huozhou City, just waiting for the Ageless Mother to make her move. His strength was far greater than hers; after all, she was merely an early stage Grandmaster Wanxiang.
In this battle, most of the seventeen protectors of the White Lotus Cult died, three out of the four Dharma Kings fell, and the gravely wounded Ageless Mother fled with the last remaining Dharma King, going into hiding within the Daqian Empire.
When the news reached Han Li in Lingjun City, Leizhou, he was shocked.

chapters.title: Chapter 19 - 19 Qianyuan Divine Province_1
chapters.content:
19 Chapter 19 Qianyuan Divine Province_1
Translator: 549690339
“Troublesome times indeed!”
This was Han Li’s first thought after listening to the report.
The strength of the White Lotus Cult and the thunderous methods of the Daqian Empire left Han Li profoundly alarmed.
The White Lotus Cult was clearly just cannon fodder, used to test the chess pieces of the Daqian Empire, yet the strength of this chess piece was unexpectedly strong.
Not only did they have seventeen God Refining Realm masters and four Hollow Void Stage Grandmasters, they even had a Grandmaster Wanxiang, what kind of joke was this?
Such strength was superior to any of the Four Great Sects of Leizhou, and to Han Li’s knowledge, Tianxuan Mountain, Sword Cleansing Pool, Hehuan Sect, and True Sun Sect all did not have a Grandmaster Wanxiang.
Across the entire Daqian Empire, there were dozens of major sects, but those with a Grandmaster Wanxiang in residence wouldn’t exceed ten.
What this meant was that the mastermind behind the scenes was using a major sect that ranked in the top ten of the Daqian Empire as a pawn, prepared for complete sacrifice—truly a staggering move.
Even the official Grandmasters Wanxiang of the Daqian Empire numbered only around twenty, with the strongest foundation being in the True Martial Realm, but Emperor Wu had been in seclusion for several hundred years, and it was unknown to the outside world if he was still alive.
Grandmasters Wanxiang were too valuable to be used as cannon fodder. Such a move suggested that the hand behind the scenes might be more powerful than the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and Ancient Empire could manage.
The profound foundation and thunderous approach of the Daqian Empire also shook Han Li. Just how strong the Daqian Empire was remained unclear to anyone, hence the need for testing, and now the results of the White Lotus Cult’s provocation were out.
Although the Daqian Empire was not as flourishing as it had been during the era of the previous emperor, its foundation remained intact, and its formidable strength was still able to firmly suppress the entire territory.
In the attacked Huozhou, the Daqian Empire boasted three combatants at the Hollow Void Stage—the Protector General, the leader of the Jingye Office, and the Slaughter God Army; and there were only three sects in the entire Huozhou that had Hollow Void Stage Grandmasters.
In the eighteen provinces of Da Qian, each province had at least this configuration, and then for every three provinces, there was a Grandmaster Wanxiang stationed there; the number of Grandmaster Wanxiang in Emperor Wu’s City, where the emperor himself resided, was even greater.
“It seems the foundation of the Daqian Empire is still very deep,” Han Li remarked with some amazement, though it was within what he had expected.
The Daqian Empire was still at the end of its zenith, basking in the remnants of the brilliance of the former emperor’s era and had yet to decline. The current Emperor Qian was only capable of maintaining the status quo due to his limited ability.
If the next ruler, or perhaps one after that, turned out to be a formidable and visionary Emperor Qian, it was possible that the empire could rise to glory once again.
This was precisely what the mastermind behind the scenes did not want to see, which is why they caused trouble during the reign of the current Emperor Qian, gradually whittling down the empire’s strength. Even if a sovereign capable of revival emerged, it would be difficult to reverse the tide or support the shaky foundation.
Regardless, Han Li preferred that the mastermind behind the scenes would stop causing trouble, for if the entire Daqian Empire was affected, he could not remain uninvolved. Times of war and chaos were most prone to problems and greatly hindered his personal development.
“Better to keep a low profile. I cannot afford to be drawn into these power struggles; otherwise, I wouldn’t even know how I died,” Han Li decided.
The greater the risk, the greater the opportunity. Large-scale and protracted conflicts are more likely to give rise to higher-leveled powerhouses, and many formidable cultivators also emerge and stand out with opportunities obtained during such struggles.
But Han Li was different. He only needed to consolidate his position, develop in peace, and focus on the well-being of future generations to grow stronger. He had no interest in getting involved at all.
….
The influence of the White Lotus Cult had now thoroughly spread, eliciting various responses from all parties.
The various Sects within the Daqian Empire, seeing the Empire still held strength, continued to rest and recuperate, diligently developed their Sects, and trained outstanding disciples, in hopes of producing a cultivator who would reach the True Martial Realm or even the Divine Yuan Realm.
This was also the case with the three major Sects of Huozhou. Although they had stood by during the chaos caused by the White Lotus Cult, the Daqian Empire dared not openly act against them, at least not publicly, as this would unite all the major Sects in common enmity, which was a consensus.
On the other hand, in the Imperial Capital of the Daqian Empire, upon receiving news that the White Lotus Cult had nearly been eradicated, Emperor Qian and the ministers immediately convened a meeting.
A portion of the meeting’s outcome was soon leaked; the decree commanded the Protector General of Sanzhou, Wan Guiyuan, to continue searching for any remnants of the White Lotus Cult. It was crucial to completely exterminate the cult, preferably capturing the No Life Matron and bringing her back to the capital.
The Jingye Office of Sanzhou would be mobilized to assist in the search for the remnants of the White Lotus Cult. Once their whereabouts were discovered, the Sanzhou army would be dispatched to strike with thunderous force.
In addition to targeting the White Lotus Cult, the Daqian Empire had other moves to make—subtly sanctioning the three major Sects of Huozhou, trying to limit their ability to recruit disciples, and intercepting the talented youth in various regions as early as possible…
Publicly, the Daqian Empire awarded a substantial cultivation resource reward to the Loose Cultivator Grandmaster who had lent assistance during the turmoil caused by the White Lotus Cult, an amount that would make most Gurus in the Void Realm envious.
…
In Qianyuan Divine Province, the land stretches vast and boundless, extensive and endless.
After ancient times, the Divine Continent underwent a hundred thousand years of turmoil, finally forming a pattern of eight domains: Barbarian Region, Buddha Domain, Sword Domain, Demon Domain, Mysterious Region, Devil Region, Dao Domain, and Chaotic Domain.
Beyond the Divine Continent lie two seas, the East Sea and the South Sea.
The waters of the two seas are vast and endless, dotted with countless islands and teeming with numerous people, even larger than half of the Divine Continent. However, the spiritual energy is slightly thinner here than on the Divine Continent by one-third.
The current structure of Qianyuan Divine Province consists of the eight domains and two seas, which are far from tranquil, filled with strife.
The cultivators of the two seas wish to establish themselves on the Divine Continent and claim vast territories for development, which the native powers of the eight domains naturally do not approve of, as it would mean a loss of their interests.
When it comes to the issue of the cultivators from the two seas, the eight domains are nearly unanimous in their external stance. However, within the Divine Continent, the eight domains are filled with incessant disputes, as each domain seeks expansion and the encroachment of other domains’ territories.
The top powers of the eight domains constantly scheme, placing their pawns and intervening in other domains’ conflicts, mutually restraining each other, with tensions running high.
Several domains are already unified—in the Buddha Domain lies the Buddhist Sect’s base, in the Dao Domain lies the Dao Sect’s base, in the Devil Region lies the Demon Clan’s base, along with the Barbarian Clan of the Barbarian Region, the Demon Clan of the Demon Domain, and the swordsmen and knife-wielders of the Sword Domain.
The Mysterious Region is dominated by imperial dynasties, among which are four great empires. The strongest, the Ancient Empire, has the power to unify the Mysterious Region but is restrained by other domains who continuously meddle and plant their stakes in the region.
One of the Eight Great Forces of the Mysterious Region, the Kurong Sect, comes from the Buddha Domain, the Yinyang Sect from the Devil Region, the Qitian Teaching from the Dao Domain, and there is also the neutral Emperor Wu’s City.
Although the Ancient Empire aspires to unify the Mysterious Region, it has not been able to do so. The other domains won’t allow it and continuously interfere, planting their flags within each empire.
The last, Chaotic Domain, is the most tumultuous among the eight domains of the Divine Continent. Various forces are present, congregating Human Clan, Demon Clan, and Barbarian Clan—Buddhist, Devil, Daoist, swordsmen, and knife-wielders clash fiercely, and even the four great empires of the Mysterious Region get involved.
Besides, there are numerous forces without backgrounds, either native to the Chaotic Domain or having fled there—utter chaos prevails, with no semblance of law, as conflict and slaughter are rampant.
Without sufficient power, one simply cannot survive in the Chaotic Domain.
However, alongside the chaos, the Chaotic Domain is a prosperous place, nearly every major force of Qianyuan Divine Province is represented here, and even the cultivators of the two seas can trade in this region.

chapters.title: Chapter 20 - 20 Behind the Scenes_1
chapters.content:
20 Chapter 20 Behind the Scenes_1
Translator: 549690339
Chaotic Domain,
A sprawling mountain range stretches for tens of thousands of miles, brimming with spiritual energy, with cranes soaring in flight.
Here, superficially, there are the mountain gates of several major Sects. These Sects do not get along with each other, engaging in incessant skirmishes, yet, they secretly belong to the same force.
Deep underground in the heart of the mountain range, several voices were in conversation.
“The White Lotus Cult failed, unable to throw Daqian Empire into turmoil, and even lost three Hollow Realm Masters.”
“Dead is dead, being able to probe some of the Daqian Empire’s underlying strength, their deaths were not in vain.”
“With the White Lotus Cult gone, we’ll just set up another one in a few years. On the upside, the young girl Tianxiang has broken through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, a pleasant surprise.”
“Shall we recall her and make other arrangements?”
“Let it be, let her stay incognito in the Daqian Empire for now. In a few years, we will provide her with some manpower to rebuild the White Lotus Cult.”
“…”
The voices of several terrifying powerhouses continued to exchange, showing little concern for the White Lotus Cult. However, they still placed great importance on the breakthrough of Wu Shenglaomu to the Grandmaster Wanxiang.
When Wu Shenglaomu left the Chaotic Domain, she was at the peak of the Hollow Realm. Unexpectedly, she made her breakthrough in the Daqian Empire within three to four years.
This was a truly terrifying force, lurking in the shadows, already covertly controlling one-third of the Chaotic Domain’s powers, yet seemingly non-existent on the surface.
…
Daqian Empire.
On the frontier of Huozhou, near a manor close to Qingzhou, within a village.
In a certain civilian household, a sound close to chanting echoed, loud enough, yet no passerby outside heard a thing.
“Life is like a prison, all beings suffer; the cycle of reincarnation never ends, troubles are ceaseless; pity us mortals, a god descends; the White Lotus incarnate, the people overturn their fate; Wu Shenglaomu, from the homeland of true emptiness.”
After the prayer ended, the secret room fell into silence. It was a long time before a voice was heard.
“Sect Hierarch, what should we do next?”
The speaker was a middle-aged man in a white robe, looking somewhat perplexed.
In front of him was a barefoot young girl, her face veiled by a light scarf, making it hard to discern her features. Behind her, three halos flickered in and out of existence, each of a different hue, as if a Heavenly Immortal graced the earth.
These two were none other than Wu Shenglaomu and the Dharma King of the White Lotus Cult, having escaped from the battle in Huozhou City.
No one would have guessed that Wu Shenglaomu was actually a young girl. In people’s minds, Wu Shenglaomu should have been old and wrinkled, with a benign countenance (or a ferocious one).
“There’s nothing we need to do, just lie low here for ten years to heal. If discovered, we’ll move. After ten years, we will travel to Leizhou to preach. I believe the Sect will give us plenty of support.”
Wu Shenglaomu spoke indifferently, clearly unperturbed by the failure to disrupt the Daqian Empire. She knew very well that the White Lotus Cult could never subvert Daqian; at best, it could only stir up the situation. When Daqian struck like thunder, the White Lotus Cult would be wiped out.
But the mission of the White Lotus Cult was complete, having probed some of the underlying foundations and attitudes of the Daqian Empire.
Actually, she did harbor some grievances; being sent to establish the White Lotus Cult in the Daqian Empire seemed like a good opportunity to gain merit, but the risks were too high.
If it weren’t for her breakthrough to the Myriad Phenomena Realm two years ago, becoming a Great Grandmaster, the White Lotus Cult would have truly become cannon fodder, with no one able to escape. Even so, only the two of them were left.
The other followers either perished directly or were seized and thrown into the dungeon. Wu Shenglaomu didn’t have the slightest intention to rescue them, as those captured were not high-level core members and unaware of the true origins of the White Lotus Cult.
“Very well.”
The Dharma King of the White Lotus Cult sighed and said nothing more, following behind the Mother of Myriad Phenomena for safety’s sake. Otherwise, he feared he wouldn’t be able to escape the pursuit of the Daqian Empire.
In a secret chamber, the Mother of Myriad Phenomena looked in the direction of Leizhou, a glint of sharpness flashing in her eyes.
Her willingness to come to the Daqian Empire was partly due to personal reasons, and it was also why she was able to make rapid breakthroughs to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, becoming a Great Grandmaster.
She once had a great opportunity, obtaining a fragment of a Cultivation Technique which, despite its incompleteness, was still of lower grade Heaven Rank, showing how extraordinary this technique was.
A lower grade Heaven Rank Cultivation Technique was one that directly pointed to the True Martial Realm, which meant that as long as she was sufficiently talented, she could use this technique to break through to the True Martial Realm.
Her talent was naturally exceptional; even within that mysterious major power, she was considered a rare genius. At a young age, she had cultivated to the peak of the Hollow Void Stage, and this was because she was being restrained, not wanting her technique to be discovered.
This technique was related to faith. As long as she could gather a sufficient number of believers and obtain their faith, she would be able to make rapid breakthroughs in her cultivation.
In the Chaotic Domain, she dared not to spread her religion widely, but once in the Daqian Empire, she no longer had as many concerns.
The White Lotus Cult spread rapidly across five or six manors, which was also due to her, for after obtaining faith, she directly broke through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Although the White Lotus Cult later affected an even wider area, in order to test the Daqian Empire, she didn’t have the luxury of time to slowly proselytize. The faith was sparse and couldn’t provide her with much assistance.
Now, she lay in hiding. As long as she could endure the initial pursuit of the Daqian Empire, the pressure would be much less later on, and she would be able to go to Leizhou to secretly spread her religion.
If she could develop most of Leizhou into believers, her strength would soar to the peak of the ninth layer of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. If she could take over the entire Leizhou, she might even break through to the True Martial Realm in one fell swoop and become a core high-ranking member of the mysterious forces, no longer at the mercy of others.
Even if the situation arose, leading to another encirclement by the Daqian Empire, she could quickly flee Leizhou and enter the territory of the Yinyang Sect.
The Yinyang Sect would not assist the Daqian Empire in encircling her; they might even offer help.
…
Lingjun City.
Han Mansion.
Han Li looked at the invitation letter in his hand, lost in thought.
Two to three years had passed since the calamity of the White Lotus Cult, and as he was preparing to take new concubines, he received this invitation letter.
It was sent by someone in the Innate Realm. Han Li took one glance at it and accepted it.
“A Loose Cultivator gathering?”
After some hesitation, Han Li decided to attend.
Although the disturbance caused by the White Lotus Cult had been quelled, the seeds had already been sown. The Daqian Empire was filled with undercurrents; panic spread everywhere, and everyone felt insecure.
Cultivators backed by major powers were relatively fine, but Loose Cultivators were fraught with worry. If another calamity like the White Lotus Cult were to erupt, it could easily affect them.
Thus, Loose Cultivators from various areas began to move closely together, holding markets and gatherings, exchanging information and trading, taking what they needed in preparation for any potential disasters that could occur later.
The Loose Cultivators from Fengyang Manor were no exception.
This time, the one inviting Han Li was one such gathering, with participants all being Loose Cultivators of the Pihai Realm. With everyone at the same level, it was less likely for incidents of killing for treasure to occur, offering a sense of security.
Han Li thought the same way. A gathering for Loose Cultivators of the Pihai Realm would be a good opportunity to trade for various items he needed such as pill formulas and refining blueprints, which he could produce and then sell back to them.
Han Li felt he had quite a knack for business.
Besides, he was at the Gangyuan Realm. Those Pihai Realm Loose Cultivators didn’t pose a threat to him. He was the only one who could kill and claim their treasures. Of course, he wouldn’t normally do such a thing, unless… he truly couldn’t resist.

chapters.title: Chapter 21 - 21 Han Taigong Fishing_1
chapters.content:
21 Chapter 21 Han Taigong Fishing_1
Translator: 549690339
Another reason was that Han Li wanted to step out for some fresh air and gather some information.
He had been laying low in Lingjun City for over a decade and it was about time to start preparing the herbs required for the Rebirth Pill.
For more than ten years, no one had come to Lingjun City in search of him, and Han Li felt there probably wasn’t anyone who knew he possessed the Rebirth Pill Formula.
It was quite possible that Qiu Xuan and those two assassins were the only three who knew, and having likely all died, he no longer needed to worry.
Han Li was half right in his guess. In reality, only Qiu Xuan knew the Rebirth Pill Formula, the two Pihai Realm assassins who attacked him were unaware of it.
At that time, Qiu Xuan had stumbled into a heritage site while adventuring outside, where he found the Rebirth Pill Formula. Although there seemed to be many more treasures inside, Qiu Xuan resisted his greed and left immediately.
When he left, he appeared out of thin air at a certain place in Dingyuan Manor, with excitement, thrill, and happiness written all over his face, just as two Pihai Realm cultivators happened to pass by and saw him.
Those two Pihai Realm cultivators realized Qiu Xuan must have come across a great opportunity; not bothering to find out what it was, they lied in ambush to kill him and seize his treasures, only to be counter-slain by Qiu Xuan.
After this incident, Qiu Xuan didn’t dare to show any signs of his find and forcefully calmed himself, enduring his serious injuries as he flew back to Fenglei City. Not long after Han Li arrived, Qiu Xuan passed away.
…
Several days later, Han Li left Lingjun City and flew towards Lingyuan County.
Lingyuan County, like Lingjun County, was one of the hundreds of counties within Fengyang Prefecture, with its county town being Lingyuan City.
The Loose Cultivator gathering of the Pihai Realm was taking place within the boundaries of Lingyuan County but not in Lingyuan City itself. Instead, it was in a secluded area, away from the prying eyes and the hustle and bustle, to avoid leaking information and to facilitate an easy departure for everyone after the gathering.
It took Han Li less than half a day to reach his destination.
Instead of entering, he found a hidden spot nearby to wait and watch; there were still three days left until the start of the Loose Cultivator gathering.
Han Li wanted to see who would be attending this time, whether there were any Gangyuan Realm cultivators mingling among them, or if there were any cultivators with ill intentions.
Two to three miles in front of him, there was a steep mountain peak that soared into the clouds with cliffs and precipices, and where Spiritual Energy was rather weak. It was scarcely visited by people, but now, four individuals were guarding at the foot of the mountain.
All four were Innate Realm cultivators concealed at the base of the mountain, ready to come out and guide any Pihai Realm Loose Cultivators who arrived.
Han Li saw an Innate Realm cultivator leading a Loose Cultivator with a concealed face up the mountain. They vanished halfway up the slope, an obvious sign of a hidden Formation; the gathering was taking place inside.
Han Li had a lot of patience and waited there for three days. He noticed that more than twenty Pihai Realm Loose Cultivators came, mostly in the early or middle Pihai Realm. However, there were also cultivators in the late or even peak Pihai Realm, with pure and potent auras that might have hailed from prestigious sects.
The origins of these Loose Cultivators were complicated and varied. Han Li didn’t delve into it deeply; he just wanted to know how many there were to avoid being caught off guard by someone pretending to be weaker than they were.
He even discovered a ninth-tier Innate Realm Loose Cultivator sneaking in, who possessed an item that could conceal his aura, undetectable by Pihai Realm cultivators, but Han Li was a Gang Yuan Realm cultivator.
After another two hours of observation, seeing that no one else was coming, Han Li slowly flew towards them, pretending he had only just arrived. The aura he displayed was merely that of a second-tier Pihai Realm cultivator.
But if someone tried to undermine him, Han Li could instantly transform into a sixth-tier Gang Yuan Realm cultivator. His accumulated cultivation was even likely enough to advance to the latter stages of the Gang Yuan Realm.
Arriving late, Han Li was immediately approached by one of the Innate Realm cultivators at the foot of the mountain, who respectfully asked, “Senior, are you here to join the grand gathering?”
A grand gathering?
“These loose cultivators really know how to flatter themselves, not even having a single Gang Yuan Realm among them and yet daring to call it a grand event,” he thought, but he still nodded his head.
“Senior, please follow me. I’ll show you the way,” said the cultivator of the Innate Realm respectfully.
Although he knew where to go, Han Li didn’t show it; he simply waved his hand, enveloping the young fellow in his energy, and together they flew up the mountain under his guidance.
When they were halfway up the mountain, the youngster immediately said, “Senior, we have arrived.”
The two landed, and Han Li casually rewarded him with some resources before walking into the formation. Watching Han Li disappear and then looking at the bottles of pills in his hand, the youngster felt a burning desire for the Pihai Realm.
Upon entering, Han Li found the place to be quite expansive—at least seven or eight square kilometers. Nearly half of the central portion of the entire mountain had been hollowed out.
Some twenty or thirty people gathered here, and it didn’t feel crowded. There was still plenty of open space, with many loose cultivators already setting up stalls, selling various cultivation resources, and some gathered in groups, conversing in low tones.
After Han Li arrived, he did not conceal his appearance and was recognized by many loose cultivators. His displayed cultivation level wasn’t high, but he was well-known throughout Fengyang Prefecture. Didn’t everyone know of Han of Lingjun City’s fondness for taking concubines?
Some loose cultivators’ eyes lit up, seeing him as an easy mark; others merely glanced and averted their gaze, their eyes filled with contempt, looking down on Han Li for his lascivious nature and lack of commitment to proper cultivation; some cultivators appeared thoughtful, while others were expressionless, indifferent to Han Li’s arrival…
Han Li took note of everyone’s expressions, remained silent, and gave the Innate Realm cultivator at the ninth layer, who seemed like a scoundrel, an extra glance. Even though he couldn’t clearly see the cultivator’s face, Han Li felt there was something more to him.
His participation in the loose cultivators’ gathering was not only to genuinely exchange for some pill formulas, refining blueprints, and other cultivation resources but also to go fishing.
Not concealing his appearance was the bait he’d cast, and later, when he exchanged items and revealed his wealth, if any loose cultivator harbored ill intentions, they would surely ambush him along the way, which would allow Han Li to conveniently capture them.
This way, he would acquire some cultivation resources—after all, no one gets rich without unearned wealth—and display some of his cultivation level, hence letting the outside world know his progress. This was another net he’d cast, to confuse any potential enemies.
When Old Han went fishing, he always welcomed those who wished to take the bait.
“Han my friend, you truly possess the art of maintaining a youthful appearance, it’s really enviable,” said an old man clad in a bright red robe, his eyes flashing with envy as he looked at Han Li.
Both being Pihai Realm cultivators and over two hundred years old, Han Li and most of the Pihai Realm loose cultivators present were complete opposites.
Most Pihai Realm loose cultivators looked middle-aged or older, some even white-haired and wrinkled, obviously of advanced age.
Han Li was completely different; he looked like a handsome twenty-year-old youth, vibrant and elegant with a noble bearing, dressed in brocaded garments, with a zeal jasper hanging at his waist, the very picture of a learned and romantic figure.
“Hmph—just a pretty old face,” some loose cultivators muttered enviously.
“Li my friend you possess the air of a celestial being, now that’s truly enviable,” Han Li said offhandedly.
This man, named Li Deshun, was quite famous in Fengyang Prefecture, a seventh-layer Pihai Realm loose cultivator with a place of his own in the manor city. He had organized this gathering of loose cultivators.
Li Deshun was quite ambitious, aiming to rally the Pihai Realm loose cultivators and actively connect the Fengyang Prefecture Cultivator Alliance to ascend to the position of the alliance’s leader. Many cultivators were aware of this but paid it little mind.
“Hahaha~”
Li Deshun laughed, finding Han Li to be quite the sociable man and a talent. Should Han Li run into any trouble, he wouldn’t mind lending a hand to help.

chapters.title: Chapter 22 - 22: The Honest Man Han Li_1
chapters.content:
22 Chapter 22: The Honest Man Han Li_1
Translator: 549690339
“Now that Han Daoist has arrived, the assembly of Daoist friends is complete,”
Li Deshun looked around and spoke, acting as a leader and half a host, he had expended a lot of energy to facilitate this gathering of loose cultivators, with each invitation carefully considered.
Yet, he had invited twenty-two Pihai Realm loose cultivators, but there were twenty-seven present, with an excess of five, uncertain of who had leaked the news.
Soon, the gathering of loose cultivators officially began.
It consisted of two parts, the first being a transaction, where each person took their turn: the person whose turn it was could present treasures for others to bid on, seek to purchase treasures, or simply pass.
The second part was the exchange, an opportunity to share cultivation insights, information each had gathered, to privately invite others for joint experiences, or even to explore relics and so on.
As the initiator, Li Deshun naturally took the stage first. The red-robed elder pondered for a moment and then said:
“This old man has an Eighth Grade Pill Recipe—’Open Sea Pill,’ a Yellow Rank Extreme Grade Cultivation Technique ‘Crimson Sun Scripture,’ and two Yellow Rank High Grade Cultivation Techniques. I wish to exchange for Lifespan Extension Pill, a secret technique for liquefying True Qi, or an elixir that speeds up the liquefaction of True Qi.”
As his voice fell, silence engulfed the room. Some loose cultivators scoffed coldly, others shook their heads, and finally one cultivator said:
“Daoist Li, the Open Sea Pill formula is indeed precious, but it still falls far short of the Lifespan Extension Pill, a secret technique for liquefying True Qi, or an elixir that accelerates the liquefaction of True Qi, even if you add three more cultivation techniques.”
The other loose cultivators nodded, feeling Li Deshun was harboring delusions. How precious were the three items he needed? Even disciples of large sects would find them hard to obtain, let alone loose cultivators like themselves.
If they possessed these three items, they could use them directly, and perhaps even have a chance to break through to the Gangyuan Realm and become a Great Master.
“This old man can add some Spirit Stones and elixirs; I only need one of the items,” Li Deshun continued to say.
Unmoved, the loose cultivators remained indifferent, while Han Li felt a slight interest. Cultivation techniques and such he had plenty of, but he did take note of the Open Sea Pill recipe, although Han Li remained silent.
Seeing this, Li Deshun had no choice but to say, “Very well, they can also be exchanged for Spirit Stones.”
If the loose cultivators did not have or were unwilling to part with such items, there was nothing he could do. He would simply exchange some for Spirit Stones and then check the mansion city or province city to see if there was a chance to obtain them.
Li Deshun quickly obtained a large amount of Spirit Stones, leaving him with only one pill formula in hand. The Open Sea Pill could enhance the cultivation of Pihai Realm practitioners, but he was asking too high a price, which the loose cultivators were all too reluctant to pay.
Han Li never made a move.
Following Li Deshun, one loose cultivator after another carried out transactions and made purchases, the scene bustling with activity as many wore happy expressions, having acquired the items they desired.
Even Han Li made several purchases, securing two pill formulas and a Refining Blueprint, all of Eighth Grade, costing him a considerable amount of Spirit Stones.
When it was Han Li’s turn, he laid some items in front of him and said in a deep voice:
“Fellow Daoists, I have here three Yellow Rank Extreme Grade Cultivation Techniques, two Yellow Rank Extreme Grade martial skills, twelve Yellow Rank High Grade Artifacts, and six bottles of Eighth Grade Elixirs, each containing ten pills… Priority will be given to exchanges for Eighth Grade or higher pill formulas, Refining Blueprints, followed by Spirit Stones.”
Astounding!
All the loose cultivators turned to look, fixating on the pile of items in front of Han Li, each feeling incredulous.
The treasures Han Li brought out were almost half of what the previous fourteen loose cultivators had combined—a wealth that even disciples of great sects could not match.
How could the old ancestor of the Han Family possess so many treasures?
Was he not just a common cultivator who, greedily indulging in the pleasures of women and nearing the end of his life, had luckily broken through to the Pihai Realm?
Could it be that some stroke of fortune allowed him to break through to the Pihai Realm and obtain a large amount of treasures?
Could this only be a part of it, with Han Li still hiding even more treasures?
…
All sorts of thoughts flitted through the minds of the loose cultivators, and the way they looked at Han Li instantly changed.
In the eyes of many loose cultivators, a glint of greed flashed by, and some even openly displayed their murderous intent, quickly concealing it again, planning to commit murder and robbery after the gathering.
“Han, my friend, you… you… sigh!”
Li Deshun was startled by the scene, quickly regaining his composure, his expression turning somewhat ugly.
For loose cultivators, flaunting wealth is taboo, something absolutely not to be done—too easily attracting fatal disasters. Loose cultivators have no backing; if they’re killed, they’re killed, and claiming their treasures is what truly matters. Even disciples of large sects occasionally fall victim to murder and robbery.
He also believed that Han Li had luckily stumbled upon a fortune to achieve a breakthrough to the Pihai Realm. Having always stayed in Lingjun City and not yet roughed up by the cultivation realm, he was too na?ve and dared to display so many treasures—something not even Li would dare to do.
Regardless of whether Han Li’s trade was successful or not, he had already been targeted; he would certainly be ambushed on his way back in an attempt to seize all his treasures and resources.
After giving Han Li a deep look, Li Deshun made a decision, not to get involved in these troubled waters.
Although he wanted to win over Han Li, the man truly lacked wisdom. Moreover, Li did not have enough strength to deter those cultivators with malicious intents. Risking his life for Han Li was not worth it; he, too, had aspirations to break through to the Gangyuan Realm.
However, it wouldn’t hurt to give Han Li a heads-up before leaving. Whether he could survive the trip back depended on his own destiny. Li Deshun had a good idea of whether a cultivator at the second tier of the Pihai Realm could withstand repeated ambushes.
Han Li took note of everyone’s expressions, especially those who showed their murderous intent. He discreetly marked them, waiting for these fish to take the bait.
For Han Li, the treasures he had presented were quite ordinary; he had many, and these were just a small part that he didn’t hold in high regard.
Sacred treasures such as Profound Rank cultivation techniques, martial techniques, and Lifespan Extension Pills would not be brought out by him.
He had been rewarded with hundreds of Yellow Rank Extreme Grade cultivation and martial techniques by the system. Treasures like Eighth Grade Elixirs and Yellow Rank High Grade Artifacts were all self-refined by him, conveniently marketed here.
After a silent moment, many loose cultivators sprang into action. Some cultivators in need traded with Han Li, resulting in him obtaining an Eighth Grade Pill Recipe and Refining Blueprint, along with a vast number of Spirit Stones.
There were more loose cultivators watching from the sidelines, their expressions varied, not coming forward to trade. Either they had no need, or they lacked the treasures and Spirit Stones to offer, or they didn’t see the merit in trading when they could acquire them by killing Han Li.
A mere Pihai Realm second-tier loose cultivator was easy to ambush and kill.
Since coming down from the mountain, Han Li had never used his Tianxuan Mountain Disciple identity. Almost no one knew he came from Tianxuan Mountain, and even if they did, they wouldn’t care too much about it.
Seeing no one else coming to trade, Han Li casually stored the remaining treasures into his Space Ring, his face showing a hint of distress, seemingly mourning the fact that he hadn’t sold everything.
An honest man!
Many loose cultivators instantly labeled Han Li with this tag, some looking at him with pity; this honest man wouldn’t live much longer.
As a Gangyuan Realm great master, Han Li saw everyone’s reaction and let out an innocent and honest smile, while inwardly thinking: Little fish, do keep taking the bait!
Since having to reveal a part of his strength, he didn’t mind gaining some extra wealth in this way, which would also add to his record of achievements and extend his influence.

chapters.title: Chapter 23 - 23 Sending the Treasured Child_1
chapters.content:
23 Chapter 23 Sending the Treasured Child_1
Translator: 549690339
“`
After Han Li, one Loose Cultivator after another took the stage to trade, either selling items, seeking treasures, or…
As Han Li watched, he organized his gains. This time, he had obtained three Eighth Grade Pill Recipes, namely the Qi-Returning Pill, the Qi-Gathering Pill, and the Root Consolidating Pill.
The Qi-Returning Pill was used to restore True Qi, with one pill able to recover one-fifth of Innate True Qi; the Qi-Gathering Pill could accelerate cultivation speed, though its effects were not as good as the Sea-Opening Pill, only expanding the Qi Sea by 2%; the Root Consolidating Pill was for consolidating one’s foundations, helping to quickly stabilize one’s realm after a breakthrough.
Han Li already possessed one Eighth Grade Pill Recipe for restoring True Qi, but its effects were inferior to those of the Qi-Returning Pill.
He was also interested in the Sea-Opening Pill recipe held by Li Deshun. One Sea-Opening Pill could expand the Qi Sea by 5%, allowing a cultivator to rapidly advance in cultivation level, yet the ingredients were exceedingly rare and valuable.
Han Li had obtained a few Sea-Opening Pills only after advancing to an Inner Sect Disciple of Tianxuan Mountain, and if he wanted more in the future, he would have to spend a large number of Contribution Values to exchange for them.
Besides the three pill recipes, he also had two Eighth Grade Refining Blueprints, which could be used to forge a Yellow Rank High Grade Artifact, the Tiger-Slaying Blade, and a Yellow Rank Supreme Grade Artifact, the Sun Splitting Spear.
This trip to the gathering of Loose Cultivators was indeed fruitful; once he refined these pills and Spiritual Artifacts continuously, he could obtain a large number of Spirit Stones, and the Han Mansion would not have to worry about insufficient cultivation resources for the time being.
One by one, the Loose Cultivators at the Pihai Realm finished their trades, but to Han Li’s disappointment, not another pill formula or refining blueprint appeared.
Soon, it was the twenty-fourth Loose Cultivator’s turn. Han Li looked over and couldn’t help but let a hint of amusement flash through his eyes.
This Loose Cultivator was none other than that rascal in the Innate Realm level nine.
The rascal was wearing a black cloak, with a veil hiding his face, barely revealing an aged visage.
Quickly, the rascal spoke up, his voice quite hoarse and deep, sounding like an old man.
“Fellow Daoists, this old one doesn’t have many years left and has lost interest in other matters. I only wish to exchange for a Pihai Pill to help my family cultivate a new Pihai Realm protector.”
“If any fellow Daoists have a Pihai Pill, please name your price. I am willing to spend all of my fortune to buy it.”
There was silence throughout the venue once again.
One Loose Cultivator could not help but scoff, “Has this fellow gone mad?”
“The Pihai Pill is incredibly precious. Although it’s useless for us in the Pihai Realm, who doesn’t have a family, relatives, or friends? Why would we trade with you?”
The other Loose Cultivators nodded their heads, agreeing with this sentiment.
Pihai Pill: Profound Rank Top Grade medicinal pill, capable of increasing the odds of an Innate Realm ninth layer peak cultivator breaking through to the Pihai Realm by fifty percent. Regardless of success, there are no side effects.
The Loose Cultivators present were very familiar with the grade and effects of the Pihai Pill; they had all once hoped to acquire one when they were stuck in the Innate Realm to breakthrough.
Such a heaven-defying pill was not even possessed by an esteemed Leizhou Sect like Tianxuan Mountain, and likely, only the Daqian Empire and sects within the top ten rankings had it.
If they could obtain a Pihai Pill, they would certainly not trade it, but would use it to nurture the next generation.
Having an additional Pihai Realm individual in the family would add two hundred years of glory, and perhaps even produce a genius who could cultivate to a high realm, allowing the family to continue to grow in strength.
Seeing the situation, disappointment appeared on the rascal’s face; he had gone through a lot of effort to get this news and sneak in, all for the sake of exchanging for a single Pihai Pill, but unfortunately, none of the Loose Cultivators here had one.
Han Li watched the rascal, smiling to himself; it turned out exactly as he expected—the rascal had come for the Pihai Pill.
Since this gathering of Loose Cultivators was comprised of Pihai Realm individuals and the items traded were needed by those of the Pihai Realm, what else could an Innate Realm cultivator who sneaked in possibly seek other than a Pihai Pill? The other items were of no immediate use to him.
Just as the rascal prepared to step back and allow the next Loose Cultivator to trade, Han Li suddenly spoke up.
“`
“I do have a Pihai Pill here, but I wonder what price you could offer for it?”
This Pihai Pill was obtained when the number of his descendants broke through one hundred. At that time, no one in the Han Family could use it, so he had put it away.
The other Pihai Pill, along with the Profound Rank Lower Grade martial skill [Cloud-Dispersing Palm], was obtained when the count of his descendants exceeded two hundred.
Because of inferior aptitude, Liu Yuexin and other concubines with such aptitude were stuck at the peak of the ninth level of the True Qi Realm, temporarily unable to break through to the Innate Realm; whereas the concubines like Li Mingmeng, who had Ninth Grade aptitude, were also in the True Qi Realm and hadn’t been learning from Han Li for long.
Yet, for Qiu Yueyao, a concubine with Seventh Grade aptitude, she had now cultivated to the eighth level of the Innate Realm. With her aptitude, breaking through the Innate Realm was easy, without the need for a Pihai Pill.
As soon as Han Li spoke up, all eyes once again converged on him, and the various Loose Cultivators realized the situation when they saw it was him.
None of the Loose Cultivators present had a Pihai Pill; only Han Li did, which further proved he had once acquired a great opportunity.
The previously mentioned cultivation techniques, weapons, and pills were just a portion; Han Li held even more treasures, such as the Pihai Pill, of which he surely had more than one. Perhaps he even had more valuable pills, like the Lifespan Extension Pill.
A living treasure trove!
The Loose Cultivators felt their hearts stir, and in their minds, they added another label to Han Li.
Without the power but daring to show off like this, what else could he be but a living treasure trove?
Some Loose Cultivators who had not initially planned to ambush him had now changed their thoughts, deciding to join the ranks of those plotting to kill Han Li.
With Han Li’s second-level Pihai Realm cultivation, he was unlikely to escape this calamity anyway, so they might as well share the spoils, eliminating the risk.
Li Deshun, who aspired to be the leader, had his pupils constrict, and he marveled inwardly at the abundance of treasures Han Li possessed.
He was somewhat tempted, but he could not make a move; otherwise, his reputation would be ruined. Who would dare to join a gathering of Loose Cultivators led by him in the future?
How then would he gather Loose Cultivators around him, uniting those in the Pihai Realm under his leadership to become their chief…
The rascal was momentarily stunned, and then excitedly said, “I am willing to trade all my possessions for that Pihai Pill.”
With those words, he took out an array of items—Spirit Stones, pills, weapons, cultivation techniques, Spiritual Medicines, and so forth, causing many in the Pihai Realm to look on with envy.
Yet no one said a word, and some Loose Cultivators even wore cold smirks, for if Han Li agreed, those cultivation resources would also be theirs.
“Not enough,” Han Li glanced at the offerings and uttered two words.
The rascal clenched his teeth, about to say something more, but then he heard Han Li continue, “But we can make a trade, I only need you to do one thing for me.”
Overjoyed, the rascal immediately said, “As long as it doesn’t involve sending me to my death, there’s no problem. I still want to live a few more years.”
“This rascal is quite convincing, always referring to himself as ‘this old fellow’ as if he’s afraid others won’t know he doesn’t have many years left,” Han Li mused to himself.
Han Li nodded; indeed, he had a task in mind but hadn’t found a suitable candidate yet.
Once this rascal had broken through to the Pihai Realm, he would barely meet Han Li’s requirements.
Han Li took out a Pihai Pill and completed the trade with the rascal.
Afterwards, the remaining three Loose Cultivators also took out their items to trade, none of which Han Li needed.

chapters.title: Chapter 24 - 24 Fisherman Fishing_1
chapters.content:
24 Chapter 24 Fisherman Fishing_1
Translator: 549690339
“`
The first segment of the Loose Cultivator gathering had ended.
The coordinator, Li Deshun, said a few words, and with that, the second segment began.
Originally intended for exchanging cultivation experiences and intelligence information, very few cultivators were doing so at the moment.
Most people’s attention was on Han Li, curious to see if this “Consort-taking Ancestor” was as honest and naive as he appeared and whether he would flee beforehand.
At least seven or eight Pihai Realm Loose Cultivators had the idea of ambushing Han Li to rob him of all his fortuitous treasures.
These people exchanged glances, instantly understanding each other’s intentions. They would first ambush Han Li, and whether they would share the loot or rely on their own abilities was a matter for later.
As Loose Cultivators, almost all who could cultivate to the Pihai Realm were cunning individuals, not ones to fight each other without reason beforehand.
Other cultivators, who had no plans to participate, watched the developments with an air of spectatorship. They would not join in the ambush of Han Li but would not offer him assistance either, unless he asked them to lend a hand.
Of course, he would have to pay a hefty price to solicit their help.
In a corner of the gathering, a low-profile cultivator in blue garments observed the scene, his eyes filled with mockery.
His aura fluctuations were merely at the first level of the Pihai Realm, even lower than Han Li’s, and he had no reputation to speak of. He had not made a move during the transactions and was seldom noticed by others. Even if their gazes occasionally swept over him, they quickly moved away.
“Idiots!”
“Do you even deserve Han Li’s great fortune? Hah…”
The cultivator in blue scoffed inwardly. He had arrived at the right place, nearly missing this opportunity.
He had come from Qingzhou, belonging to a major sect there, and caused a significant event in Qingzhou before fleeing all the way to Leizhou.
His destination was not Leizhou but to pass through Leizhou to leave the Daqian Empire’s jurisdiction and head to the Yinyang Sect to evade the pursuit. Then, he would slowly cultivate; with that treasure, he was sure to rise.
Passing by Fengyang Manor, he had chanced upon news of the Loose Cultivator gathering. At first, he had no intention of attending, but upon learning of the gathering’s location, he changed his mind since it was on his way, seeing no harm in taking a look.
If he had not attended the Loose Cultivator gathering, how could he have encountered Han Li, the boy delivering treasures right to his doorstep, and missed such a fortune.
As for those cultivators, he did not take them seriously. When the time came, he would deal with them together, obtaining additional cultivation resources to pave the way for his rise to power.
However, to be cautious, Lu Renbin decided to lie in wait, playing the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.
If those planning to ambush Han Li started fighting among themselves, it would save him effort. If they planned to divide the spoils, he would have to strike first and decisively, assassinating two or three, then deal with the remaining cultivators.
As a peak Pihai Realm cultivator hailing from a major sect, Lu Renbin believed he had the strength to do so.
Both the cultivator in blue and those seven or eight cultivators did not take Han Li seriously, considering him meat on the chopping block, awaiting their carving.
If Han Li decided to flee beforehand, that would suit them even better. They could just go ahead and intercept him, not wanting to wait any longer.
Since Han Li was not running away, they might as well let this naive treasure-delivering boy live a little longer.
Under the watchful eyes of the crowd, Han Li seemed oblivious, not only showing no intention of fleeing but also appearing rather enthusiastic.
He first approached several cultivators to gather intelligence, seeking to understand more information. Everyone who conversed with him looked at him with a stunned expression.
Had Han Li, by some stroke of luck, broken through to the Pihai Realm and then muddled his mind with too many consorts? At such a time, he was asking about trivial intelligence instead of preparing to flee.
After asking around, the cultivators were unwilling to talk much to Han Li, feeling it was unlucky to do so. In their opinion, Han Li was as good as dead.
Realizing this, Han Li inwardly heaved a sigh. Perhaps he had overacted. It seemed he would not be able to exchange any useful intelligence now.
With this in mind, Han Li abandoned the idea of exchanging intelligence and decided to do two more things before leaving. The fish had been on the hook for a while, all that was left was to pull in the net.
In another corner of the gathering, a lurker, unaware of when he had withdrawn there, was secretly observing, ready to make an early escape.
“`
At that moment, a figure appeared in front of him, blocking his path.
“Where do you think you’re going?”
From his elevated position, Han Li looked down at the somewhat hunched figure.
The figure: “???”
At this moment, the figure was a bit stunned, with a large question mark appearing above his head.
As he faced Han Li, who was blocking the way, the figure’s face under the cloak became serious, his eyebrows tightly furrowed.
What does this person want?
Upon realizing that the gazes of the loose cultivators had been drawn over by Han Li, the figure inwardly cursed his luck and had no choice but to speak, “Fellow Daoist Han, may I know what business you have with this old one?”
He just wanted to quickly get rid of Han Li and continue to be invisible, looking for an opportunity to make a getaway.
This thick-skulled patriarch consort was really too careless—what was the use of asking questions here? If he didn’t run now, there wouldn’t be a chance left, even if he obtained some precious intelligence, it would be of no use.
He didn’t want to accompany Han Li to his death.
The Pihai Pill was extremely precious, but with Han Li there, stealing the spotlight, everyone’s attention was focused on Han Li, thus overlooking him.
The figure had already noticed the malevolent gaze of a loose cultivator, clearly targeting him, probably planning to kill for treasure.
He only had the strength of the ninth level of the Innate Realm, and even with some hidden tricks up his sleeve, it would be difficult to escape from the pursuit of a veteran at the Pihai Realm.
“Has fellow Daoist forgotten what he promised Han earlier? The Pihai Pills of this old man are not so easily obtained.”
Han Li, seeing how desperate the figure was, decided to tease him and intentionally raised his voice.
The figure fell silent, blinking at Han Li, and muttered to himself, “Help you with something? But do you even stand a chance?”
Han Li didn’t care what he was thinking, simply saying, “After the gathering of loose cultivators, you must visit Lingjun City within a month.”
“Fine,” the figure immediately agreed, eager for this harbinger of doom to hurry off somewhere else.
As Han Li turned and walked towards Li Deshun, the figure had just breathed a sigh of relief when Han Li’s voice echoed in his mind, “Little guy, I’ve marked you. If you don’t come to Lingjun City on time, you won’t be able to escape me even at the ends of the earth.”
The figure’s pupils contracted sharply, and as he watched Han Li’s retreating figure, a trace of alarm flickered in his eyes, internally regretting having caught the attention of such a shameless old man.
At the Pihai Realm, one cannot transmit sound; only after cultivating to the Gang Yuan Realm and the Divine Spirit being nourished and strengthened by the physical body can one transmit sound, although the range is limited.
Han Li’s ability to use sound transmission indicated that he was indeed a Great Master of the Gang Yuan Realm and not the second level Pihai Realm patriarch consort that the outside world believed him to be, the insatiable “Consort Collector.”
This was too deep a disguise!
Being targeted by such an old man made him very uneasy, especially since this old man had a penchant for taking consorts, which made him even more uneasy.
He was hesitant about whether to go to Lingjun City or simply to run away. Would this old Master Han really be able to find him?
After some thought, he decided that after leaving, he would find a place to check himself. If he found the mark, he would remove it and then make his escape.
Casting a glance at the several Pihai Realm loose cultivators planning to ambush Master Han, the figure’s eyes revealed a hint of pity.
Ambushing a Great Master of the Gang Yuan Realm was practically courting death!
“However, this Han Li has a really dark heart!” the figure silently complained.
You, a Great Cultivator of the Gang Yuan Realm, conceal your cultivation and come to participate in a gathering of Pihai Realm loose cultivators, all the while playing the honest man and fishing for information—you truly are an old silver piece.
At the same time, he reminded himself to be extremely careful in his actions in the future and to never fall into the hands of fishermen like Han Li.

chapters.title: Chapter 25 - 25 It’s All Old Six_1
chapters.content:
25 Chapter 25 It’s All Old Six_1
Translator: 549690339
Under the watchful gaze of the entire venue, Han Li slowly made his way to Li Deshun’s side, causing many to frown slightly.
Could it be that the old ancestor was about to seek assistance from Li Deshun?
Li Deshun was a Pihai Realm seventh-layer Loose Cultivator; among all present, his strength was enough to rank in the top three.
If Han Li received help from Li Deshun, then killing him would become somewhat troublesome for them.
The inconspicuous Lu Renbin silently watched, his lips curling into a slight smile, everything under his control.
The rogue gave them a glance, desperately wanting to shout, “You’ve all fallen into this old sixth’s trap.”
“Cultivator Han, what business do you have?” Li Deshun’s eyebrows arched, his face cold. He also had no desire to get entangled with Han Li at the moment.
Even if Han Li had come to his senses now, it was already too late. No matter what was offered, Li Deshun would not escort Han Li back to Lingjun City; he wasn’t willing to risk his life, especially when he still aspired to ascend to the Gangyuan Realm in his lifetime.
The treasures that Han Li brought out for sale were impressive, but they still weren’t enough to move him. Did they really think an old ancestor could be so easily persuaded?
Han Li smiled and said, “Doesn’t Cultivator Li wish to purchase a Lifespan Extension Pill? I just happen to have a seventh-grade one.”
Li Deshun’s expression changed instantly, replaced with a smile, and in a voice smooth as silk, he said, “As long as Cultivator Han sells it to me, Li can agree to one condition from you.”
Delightful!
Li Deshun found Han Li to be quite agreeable and someone worth developing a relationship with; he was genuinely selling a pill. Who wouldn’t want a treasure like the Lifespan Extension Pill for themselves?
It seemed he would have to escort Han Li back to Lingjun City after all. Perhaps he could even get one or two Lifespan Extension Pills from Han Li. Surely, the pills must have been obtained through some fortunate adventure; there was likely more than one.
He had considered simply taking them by force, but if Han Li only carried one and hid the rest, then killing Han Li would mean losing any further opportunities to obtain them—a loss not worth the risk.
“I want the pill formula for the Sea-Opening Pill in your possession, and the rest can be converted into Spirit Stones,” Han Li stated directly.
Li Deshun pondered for a moment, then said, “It’s possible, but I will need to gather some Spirit Stones.”
A single Lifespan Extension Pill was worth at least a hundred thousand Lower-Grade Spirit Stones on the market. Although the Sea-Opening Pill’s formula was precious, it was at most worth forty to fifty thousand Lower-Grade Spirit Stones, and he only had about thirty thousand Lower-Grade Spirit Stones on hand, still a considerable amount short.
With the successful trade, Li Deshun acquired a seventh-grade Lifespan Extension Pill and Han Li obtained the Sea-Opening Pill formula and thirty thousand Lower-Grade Spirit Stones. Li Deshun promised the remaining Spirit Stones would be delivered to Han Mansion in Lingjun City within half a year.
Han Li agreed. Li Deshun’s reputation was sound, and in order to continue buying his Lifespan Extension Pills, he should not default. If he did default, Han Li would have no choice but to collect in person, and at that point, the cost would be much greater.
After acquiring the Lifespan Extension Pill, Li Deshun assimilated it on the spot to prevent others from coveting it. Once assimilated, he turned to Han Li with a solemn expression and said:
“Cultivator Han, shall we leave together later?”
His hopes for extending his lifespan rested on Han Li, so naturally, he wanted to ensure Han Li’s safety as much as possible. With enough lifespan and his aptitude, he had hopes of breaking through to the Gang Yuan Realm and becoming a Great Master.
“Damn it!” Witnessing this scene, several Loose Cultivators felt their hearts sink, simultaneously turning their gazes towards one individual.
“Hehe~”
A red-robed elder with his hands in his pockets and a vicious expression sneered, signaling them not to worry.
Even if Li Deshun truly intended to help Han Li, there was no cause for concern. Also in the Pihai Realm seventh layer, although his strength was slightly inferior to Li Deshun’s, he would have no problem stopping him for a while.
His greed was even greater; Han Li surely had more Lifespan Extension Pills on him. Once Han Li was killed, all the treasures would be his.
“Damn it!” Lu Renbin cursed softly in the corner.
This was his Lifespan Extension Pill, which Li Deshun had actually consumed, causing Lu Renbin great displeasure. He set his sights on him, planning to finish off the yellow bird before going to kill Li Deshun.
Upon seeing Han Li really produce the Lifespan Extension Pill, an uproar surged through the crowd. Many Loose Cultivators’ eyes glistened with desire. Two of them even made up their minds on the spot to ambush Han Li. If they couldn’t acquire the Lifespan Extension Pill, they would at least share some of his other treasures.
After giving those two a glance, the rascal lowered his head, mumbling to himself, “Two more heading to their deaths.”
Han Li shook his head, declining, and said that he had other important matters to attend to shortly.
Li Deshun’s expression stiffened. Was Han Li truly unaware? Or was he playing the pig to eat the tiger?
He felt the first possibility was more likely, for Han Li had advanced to the Pihai Realm too recently. His talent seemed to lack, making it impossible for him to be playing the pig. So, he must be a genuine pig.
Li Deshun quietly warned, “Fellow Daoist Han, be careful on the way.”
He couldn’t elaborate, lest he offend those Loose Cultivators. He decided to secretly follow along. If danger arose, he would offer his help. After all, Han Li was his hope for breaking through to the Gangyuan Realm.
Not long after, the gathering of Loose Cultivators came to an end. They started to leave one by one. Those who had plans lay in wait outside, ready to ambush Han Li.
Han Li took a look around and noticed that the rascal had disappeared without a trace. He bade farewell to Li Deshun and left the mountain peak.
Gliding through the air, Han Li admired the magnificent landscape along the way, seemingly on a leisurely trip. He did not hurry at all, much to the surprise of several groups following behind.
Is Han Li a real pig? Is he so accustomed to dominating Lingjun City that he thinks he can roam the world unchallenged, fearing no danger?
That’s what most of the following Loose Cultivators thought. Yet, two or three sensed something amiss. They slowed down, then turned around and left.
Although Han Li was tempting, sensing something off meant an immediate retreat. This was their code of conduct, unbreakable. Many who defied it had died.
Lu Renbin frowned, sensing something wrong as well. Han Li’s flight path was not heading back to Lingjun City but further into uninhabited lands. Was this intentional or unintentional? Was he really just admiring the scenery?
After considering the intelligence on Han Li, Lu Renbin slightly relaxed and continued to follow, though at a slower pace. He was resolved to flee immediately should anything go awry.
Elsewhere, Li Deshun was following from a distance, his brows tightly furrowed, greatly puzzled. What was Han Li trying to do?
After flying another hundred li, Han Li stopped and smiled, saying, “The scenery here is pretty good, truly a place of idyllic beauty.”
“Indeed, it’s not bad, seldom tread by humans, suitable as a burial ground,” a voice replied.
At that moment, sounds of cleaving wind rose as several figures sped toward him, surrounding Han Li. The leader, a red-robed sinister Loose Cultivator, sneered.
Gazing at the landscape below, Han Li nodded and said, “This is the burial ground I’ve carefully selected for you all.”
What?! The Loose Cultivators were taken aback. Three Early Pihai Realm Loose Cultivators immediately turned to flee, while several Mid Pihai Realm Loose Cultivators’ eyes darted around, ready to retreat.
Han Li had known about their intentions all along, which explained why he had come to this deserted area. He was playing the pig to eat the tiger, planning to counter-slay them.
“Hmph—what is there to fear? Han Li only broke through to the Pihai Realm a dozen or so years ago. How high can his cultivation be?”
The red-robed sinister Loose Cultivator was frustrated. These so-called partners were terribly unreliable, running away at the first sign of danger. They must be cowards for sure.
With unreliable partners, he had to take the lead, otherwise, the group would disband, turning the ambush into a farce. Truth be told, he was somewhat uncertain himself, evaluating Han Li’s strength. Having partners would increase his odds of success. At the worst, they could serve as cannon fodder to buy him time to escape.
Sure enough, after he spoke, the three Early Pihai Realm Loose Cultivators reluctantly returned. They were all well aware of Han Li’s situation; he had advanced to the Pihai Realm only as his life neared its end. His aptitude was surely poor, and his cultivation couldn’t have improved much in a dozen or so years.
Perhaps he possessed some powerful weapons. As long as the others could withstand the brunt of those weapons, there remained a great chance to rob and plunder.

chapters.title: Chapter 26 - 26 Kill!_1
chapters.content:
26 Chapter 26 Kill!_1
Translator: 549690339
“`
The loose cultivators who came to intercept Han Li each had their own thoughts, but none of them were fools, overcome by greed? That simply didn’t exist!
“Is that so?”
Han Li’s figure flashed, appearing behind the red-robed loose cultivator, and suddenly slapped out. Before the cultivator had time to react, Han Li struck him hard on the back.
Boom!
The red-robed loose cultivator crashed into the ground, creating a ten-foot-deep pit, with stones flying and dust filling the air.
As the dust settled, the loose cultivators who had already fled to a distance couldn’t help but look back. They saw that the red-robed cultivator had a large hole in his chest, a through and through wound, with his organs being burned by a purple fire.
The eyes of the red-robed cultivator were wide with disbelief. He lifted his hand as if he wanted to speak, but in the next second, he was dead.
“Hiss!”
The loose cultivators in the distance couldn’t help but gasp in shock, running even faster, sparing no cost to use secret techniques to increase their speed.
The red-robed loose cultivator was the strongest among them, a seventh-layer Pihai Realm practitioner, and he was cut down in a single move. Han Li was undoubtedly a Gangyuan Realm great master.
They actually thought about intercepting a sixth-layer great master?
The loose cultivators silently swallowed their saliva, filled with immense regret; they shouldn’t have come for the interception.
“Do you really think I’m so idle?”
Looking at the red-robed loose cultivator who died with his eyes open, Han Li shook his head, too lazy to waste his breath, and immediately went all out.
Han Li took out the Sun Chasing Bow, looked toward the six fleeing loose cultivators, drew the bowstring to the limit, and released it, with six True Yuan condensed arrows chasing after them like shooting stars.
Falling Star Arrow Manual, Second Style: Meteor Shower!
This style of archery was most suitable for the current situation, capable of firing up to ten arrows at once, each possessing eighty percent of his full power.
