Although the six loose cultivators had run away the moment Han Li made his move, their cultivation was not high, so how far could they run?
They were quickly overtaken by the meteor arrows, and even though they struggled to defend themselves, they were directly killed without exception.
Without cleaning up the battlefield, Han Li immediately flew in another direction, and soon arrived at a place ten miles away.
“Oh, running quite fast, but can you really escape?”
There was no one else around, and in the distant sky, a figure was rapidly fading into the distance. It was Lu Renbin, who had planned to cash in on the chaos.
“Damn it!”
“How did I encounter such a shameless great master.”
Lu Renbin felt somewhat unlucky. He had just joined the loose cultivators’ gathering along the way, and ended up in the net of a sixth-layer great master.
He had already slowed down when he sensed something was wrong, even staying behind ten miles away to wait. The moment Han Li showcased his power and attacked the red-robed loose cultivator, he immediately fled without daring to delay.
If that old money was to discover him, it would be disastrous – he couldn’t defeat a Gangyuan Realm great master, and the hard-earned treasure he had stolen would fall into the hands of another.
After flying out for over twenty miles, Lu Renbin looked back and saw no pursuers, allowing himself to breathe a sigh of relief.
With his ninth-layer Pihai Realm cultivation and using a secret technique, his speed was even faster than that of an ordinary Gangyuan Realm practitioner. It was normal for Han Li not to catch up, perhaps Han Li hadn’t even noticed him.
“It seems I must be more cautious in the future. The cultivation realm is too dangerous.”
Lu Renbin sighed softly, about to continue his flight and leave the Daqian Empire, but he froze.
A few hundred meters ahead on a small hill, a figure was standing erect, hands behind his back, facing away from him. Though the face wasn’t clear, Lu Renbin recognized the brocaded robe. It was Han Li!
“Why aren’t you running anymore?”
“`
The subtle sound of wind arose as Han Li appeared ten meters away from Lu Renbin, staring at him with interest, causing Lu’s scalp to tingle.
Lu Renbin inwardly groaned in distress but steeled himself and said, “This junior was merely passing by; may I ask what matter has led senior to block my way?”
Han Li looked at Lu Renbin with a smile that was not quite a smile, saying nothing.
Seeing this, Lu Renbin continued, “This junior hails from the Canghai Sect of Qing Province. If I have inadvertently disturbed senior, I am willing to make amends.”
Knowing Han Li could not be easily deceived, Lu Renbin earnestly reported his sect, intending to intimidate with the reputation of his backing, hoping that Han Li would be somewhat wary. He indeed intended to compensate, to settle this matter quickly. Compared to a precious treasure, mere resources were trivial.
The Canghai Sect was one of the major sects in Qingzhou, well-known in Leizhou, Qingzhou, and Huozhou. It served as a decent protective charm, even though the Canghai Sect would rather flay him alive at the moment.
Han Li remained silent. He had naturally heard of the Canghai Sect, but since it was far away in Qingzhou, it did not intimidate him.
Just then, Lu Renbin made his move. His waist-long blade unsheathed, sending a meter-long blade aura slashing through the air towards Han Li.
Lu Renbin swung his blade in a frenzy, going all out, executing his strongest swordplay in hopes of catching Han Li off guard and grievously injuring him, or even killing him.
Since Han Li remained impervious, showing a determination to eradicate him, Lu Renbin had no choice but to strike first as a matter of survival; otherwise, he would surely die.
“Bang~Bang~Bang~”
Clashes echoed one after another, accompanied by resonating roars of dragons and tigers, deafening to the ears.
“How is this possible?”
Lu Renbin, seeing Han Li unscathed in the distance, was momentarily stunned, then without hesitation, he turned to flee for his life, even using a life-draining secret technique to boost his speed.
“The power is not bad, but it still cannot break through my protective divine skill,” Han Li commented.
He had been on guard against Lu Renbin’s sudden attack. The Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield and Tiger’s Roar Iron Shirt were already in motion secretly, imbued with True Yuan, these two protective divine skills were not something a mere Pihai Realm could damage.
His clothes were not even slightly torn.
Over the years, he had obtained hundreds of cultivation techniques, martial skills, and secret methods. He understood many offensive and defensive skills, with the Golden Bell Shield and Iron Shirt among the most outstanding.
All thoughts vanished in an instant, and as he spoke, the Sun Chasing Bow materialized in his hand. He pulled it to full draw again, and an arrow made of True Yuan “whooshed” through the air.
Falling Star Arrow Manual third form: Celestial Falling Star!
Lu Renbin, who was hurriedly fleeing at the cost of his life, had already reached some ten-odd miles away. He was fast, but not as fast as the Celestial Falling Star.
In front of Lu Renbin, an arrow tore through the sky, carrying overwhelming power like a meteor falling from beyond the heavens, steadfastly locking onto Lu Renbin.
“No!!!!”
Lu Renbin immediately brought out a spiritual artifact shield to protect himself, and threw out all his spiritual artifacts in a desperate attempt to attack the meteor. His blade swung continuously, desperately using his sword technique, which even reached perfection in this mad state.
Unfortunately, all his resistance was in vain.
Boom!
A meteor struck, and a crater at least thirty feet wide appeared on the ground, scattered with fragments of spiritual artifacts. In the center of the crater lay a charred, mutilated corpse.
Han Li descended, frowning slightly at the sight.
Lu Renbin was dead, and his space ring had shattered too, its contents exposed, all shattered and extinguished.
Han Li felt a twinge of pain; after all, those were his spoils of war. This was the first time he used this move, powered by a substantial amount of True Yuan. He did not anticipate that Lu Renbin wouldn’t survive even one arrow.
“Huh?”
With a flash, Han Li appeared in the crater, reaching under the destroyed body to retrieve an item.
If it had survived that arrow without destruction, it must be a treasure. Lu Renbin had buried it underneath himself before his death, not wanting Han Li to discover it.
After a careful examination, Han Li’s pupils narrowed, a look of shock emerging on his handsome face.

chapters.title: Chapter 27 - 27 Body-Cultivating Furnace 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Body-Cultivating Furnace 1
Translator: 549690339
“Is this really the precious treasure?”
Gazing at the treasure in his hands, Han Li’s expression was somewhat uncertain.
It was an item resembling a furnace, palm-sized, with all kinds of runes carved on the furnace walls, lid, base, and interior.
He recognized what it was.
A Body-Cultivating Furnace!
This was a famous magical treasure, renowned throughout the Daqian Empire. It was said to be at least an Earth-Level Supreme Magical Artifact and was the Canghai Sect’s treasured heirloom.
Qing Province’s Cang Hai Sect had Great Grandmasters from the Myriad Phenomena Realm within its ranks, making it a top-tier power in the Daqian Empire, easily ranking among the top ten.
Legend had it that the ancestor of the Canghai Sect rose to power by acquiring the Supreme Body Nourishing Furnace, eventually cultivating to the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm and establishing the vast Canghai Sect.
The Body-Cultivating Furnace was also the Canghai Sect’s greatest reliance in becoming one of the Ten Great Sects of Daqian, with each generation’s Sect Leader being a Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivator. For five thousand years, there had been no break in succession, and their history was even older than that of the Daqian Empire.
Han Li had also heard a legend that the Body-Cultivating Furnace was nothing more than a flawed imitation.
In ancient times, there was a Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace. Although it was not an Immortal Artifact, it was indeed a divine weapon of the highest quality, with awe-inspiring power and infinite might.
There was once a powerful being who tried to imitate the Life-Prolonging Furnace and forge a supreme treasure but ultimately failed, leaving behind only two flawed artifacts, one of which was the Body-Cultivating Furnace, and the other, the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
Although the Body-Cultivating Furnace and the Soul-Cultivating Furnace were flawed, failing to reach the level of the ancient Life-Prolonging Furnace, they were still Heaven Rank Supreme Magical Artifacts.
Though he had not thoroughly examined the Body-Cultivating Furnace in his hands, it was at most a Lower Grade Heaven Rank Magical Artifact, far from being a Supreme Grade. While it may seem only three levels lower, the difference was like a chasm between heaven and earth.
Therefore, Han Li felt that the legend was highly likely to be a rumor, with no actual Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace in existence.
“But how did this precious treasure end up here?”
Turning the small furnace over in his hands, Han Li looked towards the charred and broken corpse, recalling an intelligence report he had stumbled upon ten days ago.
Half a year earlier, the White Lotus Cult’s Mother Wusheng had fled to Qingzhou and struck the Canghai Sect while its Sect Leader was away visiting friends, intending to steal their heirloom, the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
Mother Wusheng spent significant time breaking the grand formation, infiltrated the Canghai Sect, and got hold of the Body-Cultivating Furnace. However, as she was about to escape, the Daqian Empire’s pursuers arrived.
The three forces’ commander along with two Hollow Realm Masters arrived first and engaged in a fierce battle with Mother Wusheng that shook the heavens. The three Hollow Realm Masters of the Canghai Sect also took action, seeking to annihilate Mother Wusheng and reclaim the Body-Cultivating
Furnace.
In the chaos, Mother Wusheng couldn’t withstand the pressure and had to abandon the treasure. She threw the Body-Cultivating Furnace aside and then escaped amid the confusion.
The three forces’ commander continued to pursue Mother Wusheng, but his two Hollow Realm Masters stayed behind, attempting to snatch the Body-Cultivating Furnace and continued battling the three Canghai Sect Masters.
By the time the Canghai Sect Leader and the Supervisor of Jingye Office arrived, the precious Body-Cultivating Furnace had already gone missing. No one knew where it went—perhaps it hadn’t been found yet, or perhaps it had already been found but nobody was willing to admit it.
The Canghai Sect Leader was furious. He struck out at the two Hollow Realm Masters, blaming their interference for the disappearance of the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
The Supervisor of Jingye Office intervened to prevent the killing; naturally, he wouldn’t watch two Hollow Realm Masters of the Da Qian Empire be slain.
Following an intense battle that concluded without a victor, the Supervisor of Jingye Office led the two Hollow Realm Masters to safety.
That left the Canghai Sect Leader raging helplessly on the spot, not even daring to utter harsh words. Having already attacked the Hollow Realm Masters and the Supervisor of Jingye Office of Da Qian without success, if he went any further, the Daqian Empire would annihilate the Canghai Sect with the force of thunder.
Deep in his heart, he loathed Mother Wusheng and began to hold animosity against the Daqian Empire.
If it weren’t for Mother Wusheng attacking the sect and drawing the Daqian Empire’s attention, the empire would not have had the chance to act against the Canghai Sect.
For a major sect like the Canghai Sect, the Daqian Empire had long wished to deal with them, but the right opportunity had never arisen. Tugging at one thing would affect everything, so they had to wait for the right moment.
When the Wu Sheng Old Mother threw out the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the chance they were waiting for appeared. As long as they seized the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the Canghai Sect would lose their support, and would they dare to attack Province City then?
It was with this certainty that the Sanzhou Garrison Commander ordered two Grandmasters to attempt the seizure. Even if they failed to take it, as long as the Canghai Sect did not recover the Body-Cultivating Furnace, it would still be a great achievement.
Without the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the Canghai Sect would gradually decline and pose less of a threat to the Daqian Empire. That’s why the
Supervisor of Jingye Office decided to fight a battle with the Canghai Sect Leader, allowing him to vent and prevent him from causing any trouble.
“Damn it!”
After venting his rage somewhat, the Canghai Sect Leader regained his rationality. He knew better than to continue accusing the Daqian Empire of lacking martial virtue and could only swallow the bitter pill in secret, while also sending a large number of people to search for the furnace, praying that it had not been picked up by someone else.
Without the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the Canghai Sect was just an ordinary major sect in one province, but if they could recover the furnace, then the
Canghai Sect would remain one of the top ten elite sects in the Daqian Empire.
It was rumored that after searching for a month, the Canghai Sect narrowed down their suspects to a certain sect disciple, suspecting that the Inner Sect Disciple had hidden the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
But then, the Canghai Sect found out that the disciple had taken the opportunity to flee half a month earlier. Hence, the whole sect was in an uproar, with disciples and elders alike mobilized to search for the whereabouts of that disciple, but they found no trace of him.
“Could he be that lucky one?” Han Li muttered to himself.
The conclusion was obvious; this green-robed Loose Cultivator was the fortunate one who had found the Body-Cultivating Furnace, enjoying an incredible stroke of luck which even helped him escape all the way to Leizhou; just going through two or three more prefectures would take him into Yinyang Sect territory.
Who knows, maybe picking up the Body-Cultivating Furnace had exhausted all his luck, leading him to fall into Han Li’s hands at the end.
“If I had known, I should have asked for his name first,” Han Li realized he still didn’t know the name of this great benefactor before he vanquished him.
“Sigh-
With a light sigh, Han Li now harbored yet another secret, one that absolutely must not be discovered by others, or else he would have nowhere to bury his body.
He had already decided to keep the Body-Cultivating Furnace; after all, it was a cultivation treasure. He couldn’t really throw it away, could he? As for returning it to the Canghai Sect, Han Li entertained no such thoughts.
He already had enough secrets: the Longevity Family System, the Rebirth Pill Formula, and now the Body-Cultivating Furnace. Any one of them, if exposed, could bring him lethal disaster.
Flying out of the giant pit, Han Li used his True Yuan to command the sand and soil to refill it, covering up the battlefield, and incidentally providing a burial place for this good man.
Han Li examined the area thoroughly again, erasing all traces as much as possible to avoid detection.
Afterward, Han Li headed towards the first battlefield; he still had an important task to complete.
Elsewhere, in a certain prefecture in Huozhou.
Wu Sheng Old Mother was hiding here, along with the last Dharma King of the White Lotus Cult, who now had a severed arm and looked dispirited.
Wu Sheng Old Mother herself was quite pale, urgently healing her wounds. If pursuers arrived before she had recovered some of her strength, she feared that escape would be impossible.
Thinking that the Body-Cultivating Furnace had been picked up by a lucky thief and stolen from the Canghai Sect, Wu Sheng Old Mother was also distressed.
She had stolen the Body-Cultivating Furnace to speed up her healing, as being constantly hunted would inevitably lead to trouble; the furnace’s cultivation acceleration function was actually of less use to her.
Unfortunately, trying to steal a chicken only to end up losing the rice, now she was wounded even more.
She also wanted to flee to Leizhou, but the borders of Leizhou, Qingzhou, and Huozhou were under martial law with numerous powerful beings stationed there, making it difficult to sneak in..

chapters.title: Chapter 28 - 28 Bottom Line_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: Bottom Line_l
Translator: 549690339
The first battlefield, Han Li casually took the Space Rings from seven Loose Cultivators, pondered for a moment, and decided not to destroy the corpses or traces.
If someone were to investigate, they would definitely trace it back here, and upon finding clues, they would think he was feeling guilty. Whether it was him or not, they would come knocking to inquire.
After determining the direction, Han Li quickly pursued, even employing a Secret Technique to accelerate his flying speed.
In his perception, there were a total of three groups of people who had followed him here. The first two groups of Loose Cultivators had died, but the third group had not yet.
That person was Li Deshun.
No matter what Li Deshun had in mind when he tracked him, if he witnessed him eliminating the green-robed Loose Cultivators, Han Li would have no choice but to silence him.
The news about the Body-Cultivating Furnace in his possession must not be leaked out at any cost.
Half a quarter of an hour later, Han Li caught up to Li Deshun a hundred miles away. At this time, Li Deshun was sweating profusely, looking quite nervous, far from the image of an immortal with a calm and righteous aura.
During the gathering of Loose Cultivators, he knew that many were planning to ambush Han Li. Unable to dissuade Han Li, he followed secretly, planning to help at a critical moment.
But he never expected to witness a sight that utterly shocked him.
The red-robed Loose Cultivator was killed with a single palm strike from Han Li.
The red-robed Loose Cultivator emitted the aura of a seventh layer of the Pihai Realm; to kill a late-stage Pihai Realm with just one palm, one had to be at least a Great Master of the Gangyuan Realm.
Han Li was actually of the Gangyuan Realm?
The lecherous, concubine-gathering old patriarch was actually a Great Master!
Even if reluctant to admit it, the reality was right before his eyes: Han Li possessed the strength of the Gangyuan Realm. All that information about Han Li was false, nothing but smoke and mirrors.
When he saw Han Li take out a bow and arrow, ready to shoot and kill six Pihai Realm Loose Cultivators, Li Deshun quietly retreated, not daring to delay any longer.
He feared that Han Li would see him as another treasure hunter there for an ambush, and get rid of him as well, especially since he had discovered the secret of Han Li’s strength in the Gangyuan Realm. He certainly needed to get away.
After rapidly flying for hundreds of miles, Li Deshun was exhausted, with only less than twenty percent of his True Qi remaining.
Thinking he might be killed to keep him quiet, he quickly took out some medicinal pills to swallow, hoping to recover his True Qi and continue his escape. But then, a voice like that of a devil arose by his ear.
“Fellow Daoist Li, we really are fated to meet, to encounter each other in this desolate wilderness,” Han Li said with a chuckle.
Li Deshun’s body stiffened; Han Li’s voice was for him the sound of doom. A Great Master of the Gangyuan Realm had just killed those Loose Cultivators and was now pursuing him; the implication was all too clear.
Li Deshun wanted to feign composure, saying he was just passing by, but he couldn’t speak; Han Li was putting too much pressure on him.
Cold sweat formed on his forehead, which Li Deshun wiped with his sleeve, but it kept beading up, and no matter how he wiped, it wouldn’t stop.
“Fellow Daoist Li, how long do you intend to keep wiping? Do you need this old man to help you?”
Han Li appeared in front of Li Deshun, still wearing a smile.
“No need, no need,” Li Deshun hurriedly declined, already trembling.
He still remembered the scene he just witnessed, where Han Li was talking to the red-robed Loose Cultivator but suddenly acted ruthlessly, killing him with one palm strike.
He feared that Han Li would do the same to him; as a fellow seventh layer of the Pihai Realm, he estimated he would not be able to withstand a single palm strike from Han Li.
“Didn’t Fellow Daoist Li say earlier that he wished to depart with me? Now that I have finished my business, we can travel together,” Han Li proposed.
Han Li continued speaking, but his gaze kept observing Li Deshun. Li Deshun’s reaction was too suspicious, and Han Li really wanted to silence him by killing him then and there.
However, recalling Li Deshun’s behavior at the gathering, he temporarily restrained himself, deciding to watch a bit longer and give him a chance, lest he kill the wrong person.
“Forget it.”
Upon hearing this, Li Deshun suddenly let out a breath, no longer afraid. Han Li had made up his mind to silence him, and any further argument from him would be futile.
It was just that, having just seen the hope of making a breakthrough to the Gangyuan Realm, it felt somewhat regrettable to face death now.
Li Deshun closed his eyes to await death, but after a good while, Han Li still hadn’t made his move, prompting Li Deshun to ask, “Fellow Daoist Han, why don’t you take action?”
“There’s no need to take action for now. I’ll ask you a few questions, and all you need to do is answer them honestly, Fellow Daoist Li.”
In his heart, Han Li already had his answer; Li Deshun probably hadn’t witnessed that scene, since with Li Deshun’s flying speed, he wouldn’t have made it this far.
But Han Li was naturally cautious and needed to confirm it repeatedly. Otherwise, if the news leaked, it would be his own life at stake. Should it be confirmed that Li Deshun truly hadn’t seen anything, sparing his life wouldn’t be an issue.
“Please ask, Fellow Daoist Han,” Li Deshun said with an extremely solemn expression, knowing that his very life depended on what he would say next.
Han Li nodded and asked him several key questions, then had Li Deshun recount in detail everything that had happened after the gathering ended.
Throughout this process, Han Li watched Li Deshun closely and noticed that the more Li Deshun spoke, the more tranquil he became. He even made eye contact without so much as a hint of evasion in his eyes, and his complexion no longer appeared flustered.
From the end of the gathering, Li Deshun had been following secretly, but he hadn’t caught sight of the Loose Cultivator in blue. Perhaps the two were not on the same path, or maybe due to the Loose Cultivator’s higher cultivation level, Li Deshun simply was unable to detect him.
After listening, Han Li pondered for a while, while Li Deshun silently waited. Han Li’s decision held the power over his life and death, and he didn’t have the slightest ability to resist.
“I have a favor to ask of you, Fellow Daoist, and I hope you won’t refuse,” Han Li said cheerily.
“Please tell me, Daoist Han. Li will do his utmost to comply,” Li Deshun swiftly promised, realizing that Han Li wouldn’t silence him after all.
“It’s nothing big. Once we return to Lingjun City, I will spread the news that I encountered an ambush, and that Fellow Daoist, acting righteously, came to my aid. Together, we repelled those bandits,” Han Li explained the pretext he had in mind.
“Of course, in this story, you were the main contributor, and I merely assisted.
We both sustained severe injuries.”
Han Li laid out the story he had concocted.
He had his own principles and bottom lines. Li Deshun was a good person, and his following him had indeed been meant for protection. Although it was driven by self-interest, the gratitude was genuine.
Since he hadn’t seen the Body-Cultivating Furnace, it seemed fair to spare him, settling the debt of gratitude and, at the same time, concealing his own cultivation level.
This time, Han Li intended to publicly announce that his cultivation level was at the fifth tier of the Pihai Realm, which, though a rapid progression, was starkly different than breaking through to the Gangyuan Realm.
Another reason for releasing Li Deshun was to have him serve as a witness. Before he had killed anyone, two other Loose Cultivators had already turned tail and run.
Some information might leak out, but those two Loose Cultivators had not seen the Loose Cultivator in blue catch up either. As long as Han Li and Li Deshun kept their stories straight, no trouble would arise.
Li Deshun readily agreed, having thought that even if Han Li spared him, he would have to work for Han Li like an ox or horse. He hadn’t expected it to be such a trivial matter.
Not only could he save his life, but he could also increase his influence. Why wouldn’t he agree?
So, the two left together, and only outside Spirit Balance City did they part ways. Han Li returned to Han Mansion, while Li Deshun headed back to Fengyang City.
A year later, a figure in a black leather outfit, with a voluptuous figure, appeared at the first battlefield and carefully surveyed the scene, her brow furrowing deeply..

chapters.title: Chapter 29 - 29 Witch and Fairy_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Witch and Fairy_1
Translator: 549690339
“Not here.”
The fiery witch felt somewhat irritable. Where the hell had that lucky bastard gone?
The Canghai Sect’s treasured artifact was lost, stolen by an Inner Sect Disciple, and despite their full-force pursuit, the Canghai Sect had yet to reclaim it. This news had long since spread throughout the Daqian Empire.
Bordering the Daqian Empire and not far from Qingzhou, the news also reached Yinyang Sect, stirring interest in many.
As one of the Eight Great Forces of the Mysterious Region, the Yinyang Sect also coveted the Body-Cultivating Furnace. Out of fear of the Daqian Empire, they had refrained from seizing it. But now, an opportunity had arisen.
After analyzing the intelligence, the Yinyang Sect discovered that the lucky fellow’s destination was within their territory, prompting the higher-ups to issue corresponding tasks.
Many Yinyang Sect Disciples took on the mission, flocking to the border to lie in wait for their prey. If fortune favored them and they encountered the fugitive, the Body-Cultivating Furnace would be theirs.
The lucky guy’s entry into the Yinyang Sect’s domain had nothing to do with the sect, nor did he intend to offer the treasured artifact to them. His sole purpose was to use their influence as a shield against pursuit.
The Yinyang Sect, being part of the demon path, acted on whim and without scruple, caring little for means. Even if the lucky fellow genuinely desired to surrender the artifact in exchange for the sect’s protection and cultivation, many disciples would slay him outright to snatch his treasure.
The Yinyang Sect was only interested in the Body-Cultivating Furnace, indifferent to whose hands it was in.
Yinyang Sect Disciples had been squatting for the better part of a year without so much as a glimpse of the guy, not a single hair in sight.
Half a year ago, there was information that someone resembling the lucky fellow had appeared in Fengshui Manor. Logically, it would have taken no more than three months for him to flee to the Yinyang Sect’s domain, especially with the formidable cultivators of the Canghai Sect hot on his heels.
With no sign of his arrival, some speculated that the fugitive was hiding somewhere else in Leizhou and wouldn’t come to Yinyang Sect territory, or that he had already been secretly captured by the Canghai Sect, so they withdrew.
Others remained on guard still, convinced the lucky guy would inevitably show up, as hiding in Leizhou was futile against the thorough search of the Canghai Sect.
The last few, more aggressive ones, took significant risks to infiltrate Leizhou and covertly trace the artifact. The fiery witch was among them.
“Dammit!” the fiery witch cursed under her breath.
After sneaking into Leizhou, she began her search at once, scouring from the border to Fengshui Manor, only to find that the man with the artifact had long since entered Fengyang Manor.
She returned to Fengyang Manor and continued her secret search, unearthing several clues. This spot was where the last clue led before vanishing.
She didn’t know if the guy had already been killed and the artifact taken, or if he changed his identity to hide even deeper from his pursuers.
Along her way, she discovered many others doing exactly what she was, which only added to her irritation. Had someone beaten her to the prize?
She couldn’t afford to search openly, for she was a witch of the Yinyang Sect. Exposure would surely draw the hostility of Leizhou authorities.
With her early God Refining Realm cultivation base, it was almost impossible for her to escape back to the Yinyang Sect, but to give up after expending so much effort was equally unbearable.
Just as the fiery witch was about to leave and continue her clandestine pursuit, a figure flew rapidly towards her, triggering her alertness.
“Jiang Baiye, why has she come here?” The fiery witch’s figure flickered and disappeared from the spot.
Three breaths later, a woman garbed in a white palace dress, with a Divine Sword strapped to her back, descended.
Her fair face was gentle as a melon seed, lips bright and lush, a well-sculpted nose, eyes like autumn waters beneath arched brows, delicate features in a stunning arrangement, complemented by a flowing mane of silver hair. She was as elegant as a celestial swordswoman stepped out from a painting.
She was none other than Jiang Baiye.
After landing, Jiang Baiye scrutinized the battleground attentively, then stood contemplatively where the fiery witch had been.
“A Great Master of the Gang Yuan Realm?” Jiang Baiye murmured, her red lips parting slightly as she gained some insight into the situation on the battlefield.
Being able to kill a late-stage Pihai Realm cultivator with one palm strike and almost simultaneously shoot dead six Pihai Realm cultivators, this strength is definitely of the Gangyuan Realm.
As far as she knew, when Lu Renbin stole the Body-Cultivating Furnace, he was only at the ninth level of the Pihai Realm with a seventh-grade aptitude, so it seemed improbable that he could have advanced so quickly. Could it be the effect of the Body-Cultivating Furnace?
Fleeing to Fengyang Manor but having his tracks discovered, someone sought to kill him and seize the treasure; or perhaps these people just happened to encounter Lu Renbin passing by and attempted an assassination, only to be killed in retaliation?
However, Lu Renbin specialized in saber techniques, whereas these people were killed by palm and archery techniques…
If the Gangyuan Realm cultivator is not Lu Renbin, could it be that Lu Renbin was killed by this Gangyuan Realm individual? There were no traces at the scene—were the corpse and evidence destroyed thoroughly, or did Lu Renbin simply leave after attending the Loose Cultivators’ gathering and never actually come here?
Jiang Baiye felt the latter possibility was more likely. If that Gangyuan Realm cultivator was adept at erasing all traces, they would not have left seven corpses at the site.
Of course, there was also the possibility that the person did it deliberately as a diversion.
Suddenly, the Divine Sword on her back gave a ‘Clank’ as it unsheathed itself, and a wave of sword energy swept across.
“Bang!”
A rock turned to dust and drifted away with the wind.
“Jiang Baiye, you’re still so heartless. Someone greets you, and you respond by stabbing me with your sword.”
As the voice sounded,
a girl dressed in black leather with a hot figure appeared not far from Jiang Baiye, her face full of resentment, as if Jiang Baiye was a heartbreaker.
Before Jiang Baiye could say a word, she continued, “Have you thought it through? Whether you want to come back to the Yinyang Sect with me to cultivate. The Canghai Sect will only bury your talents, not to mention they’ve lost their sect treasure, the Body-Cultivating Furnace.”
Jiang Baiye’s pretty face turned icy as she said coldly, “Yun Miaoyi, give up on that idea. I will find the Body-Cultivating Furnace myself.”
“And one more thing, get out of the Daqian Empire!”
Yun Miaoyi appeared unconcerned and chuckled, “Tsk, tsk, protecting the Daqian Empire now, are we? Your Canghai Sect can’t escape responsibility for losing the Body-Cultivating Furnace.”
Jiang Baiye pressed her red lips together, remaining silent.
If not for the interference from the Daqian Empire, the Body-Cultivating Furnace would never have been lost, nor would it have remained unfound for so long.
The Canghai Sect was trying to track down the Body-Cultivating Furnace, but the Daqian Empire kept obstructing them. Otherwise, how could Lu Renbin have escaped from Qingzhou?
The Daqian Empire was interfering with the Canghai Sect while covertly searching for Lu Renbin, eager to snatch the Body-Cultivating Furnace first.
For the Daqian Empire, it was imperative not to let the Canghai Sect recover the Body-Cultivating Furnace and, even more so, not to allow Lu Renbin to take it to the Yinyang Sect’s realm. If it fell into the hands of the Yinyang Sect, the threat would be greater than it being with the Canghai Sect. The best outcome was for the Body-Cultivating Furnace to end up in the hands of the royal court.
“Considering how the Daqian Empire has treated your Canghai Sect, don’t you want to retaliate?”
“Now there’s an opportunity. If your Canghai Sect cooperates with our Yinyang
Sect, we can throw the Daqian Empire into chaos from the inside out. When the
Daqian Empire falls, your Canghai Sect might even inherit its position.”
Yun Miaoyi tempted her deliberately and even secretly employed a Secret Technique, attempting to influence Jiang Baiye.
If Jiang Baiye was an Immortal Fairy, then Yun Miaoyi was definitely a Witch.
Her beauty was stunning, with a melon-seed face, a red dot between her eyebrows, a pair of enchanting peach blossom eyes, fiery red lips, and a coquettish face. Her every smile and frown brimmed with charm.
Coupled with her lustrous black hair and the hot figure under the black leather, she was captivating and unforgettable..

chapters.title: Chapter 30 - 30 The Ancestor Takes Another Concubine Again_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: The Ancestor Takes Another Concubine Again_l
Translator: 549690339
“You Yinyang Sect are no saints either.”
Jiang Baiye sneered coldly, unmoved.
She understood Yun Miaoyi very well, having dealt with her many times. Nine and a half out of ten sentences from her mouth were lies.
If Canghai Sect were really collaborating with the Yinyang Sect, the Daqian Empire would be the first to attack and annihilate Canghai Sect; even if the Yinyang Sect did provide some support, once the Daqian Empire was overthrown, Canghai Sect would also perish.
Within the Yinyang Sect territory, all the sects were of the Demon Path, but the strongest only had a Guru in the Void Realm. Once any other sect produced a Grandmaster Wanxiang, there would only be two options: leave their original sect and join the Yinyang Sect, or face destruction.
The Yinyang Sect’s control over its territory was even more stable than that of the Daqian Empire, which was related to the ruthless and unscrupulous style of the Demon Path. The Daqian Empire still had many concerns, while the Yinyang Sect would directly suppress those who did not submit.
Yun Miaoyi smiled seductively, unconcerned, and directly asked, “You’re here to search for the Body-Cultivating Furnace, aren’t you? Have you found any clues?”
“Hehe- Witch, you think I would tell you?”
“Get back to the Yinyang Sect immediately, and stop coveting our sect’s Body-Cultivating Furnace, or I will definitely kill you.”
Jiang Baiye sneered coldly, her longsword behind her seemed eager to move, its sword aura soaring to the sky, as if she would take action the next moment. “Yo, you’ve become quite capable, even thinking of killing me. Can you do it?” Yun Miaoyi stretched out her fair, jade-like hand, made gestures in the air as if pinching Jiang Baiye’s face, and seeing that Jiang Baiye was about to erupt, she immediately blinked away.
Watching Yun Miaoyi leave, Jiang Baiye did not take any action, knowing it would be futile.
Yun Miaoyi was a Core Disciple of the Yinyang Sect, and she was one of the ten great Disciples of Canghai Sect. Both had similar status, and their strength was almost equal.
The two of them had been fighting since the Pihai Realm, and it continued until the God Refining Realm, still evenly matched. Even if she disliked Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye had to admit that this woman had exceptional talent, a true genius who could compete with her.
“This matter concerns our sect’s treasure, so I have to apologize to you,” Jiang Baiye murmured softly, her figure disappearing.
Yun Miaoyi was originally a Disciple of Hehuan Sect, one of the Four Sects of Leizhou, and she had been promoted all the way up until she finally joined the Yinyang Sect, becoming a Core Disciple, well-regarded within the sect.
In the past, when Yun Miaoyi secretly returned to the Daqian Empire to fight her, Jiang Baiye wouldn’t spread the word, to avoid exposing Yun Miaoyi’s identity and getting her hunted down.
The Body-Cultivating Furnace was vital to the sect’s destiny, and must be reclaimed. Yun Miaoyi was there for the Body-Cultivating Furnace too, making her one of Jiang Baiye’s strongest competitors.
She had no choice but to cause some trouble for Yun Miaoyi to hinder her search for the Body-cultivating Furnace.
After returning to Lingjun City,
Han Li just continued to lay low, still pretending to be gravely injured, not seeing any outsiders. He was healing in the backyard of Han Mansion, arranging flowers, playing with jade, eating sweet peaches, etc. He even arranged the flowers and jade into rectangles, circles, and various other shapes to admire.
As a consequence of Han Li deliberately leaking information, a message started to spread.
The old ancestor of the Han Family was invited to a Loose Cultivator gathering not long ago, but was ambushed by despicable Loose Cultivators. Fortunately, he had already cultivated to the fifth level of the Pihai Realm, greatly increasing his strength, and with the assistance of the Li Family patriarch from the manor city, he was barely able to suppress a few thieves.
After the message spread, the manor city also released news confirming the truth of the Han patriarch’s claim, and many even saw the Li Family patriarch personally visit Lingjun City to meet Han Li, the two enjoying a pleasant conversation (in reality, it was to return some Spirit Stones and to casually inquire about purchasing more Lifespan Extension Pills).
Lingjun City was abuzz, even Fengyang Manor felt the shockwaves, as Han Li’s influence greatly increased and he was paid much more attention.
In the past, although Han Li was famous in the Cultivation Realm of Fengyang Manor, it was mostly for the wrong reasons. People’s impression of him included: poor talents, a fluke advancement to Pihai Realm as his lifespan neared its end, exhausted potential, and a penchant for women and taking concubines.
Now, the Cultivation Realm’s impression of Han Li had been refreshed: likely possessed serendipitous fortune, had substantial strength, the future magnate of Fengyang Manor, and still, a penchant for women and taking concubines.
Being able to cultivate to the fifth level of the Pihai Realm in just over a decade, everyone believed that Han Li’s talents must be at the seventh grade. He must have been held back by something in the past. With about ninety years of lifespan remaining, there was a high likelihood he’d cultivate to the ninth level of the Pihai Realm.
With only a few powerhouses in the Gangyuan Realm in Fengyang Manor, they were considered the overlords. Thus, reaching the ninth level of the Pihai Realm would make one a magnate in Fengyang Manor, possessing significant influence in the neighboring manors as well.
Thus, the doorstep of Han Mansion was nearly worn through; families and powers from Fengyang Manor and the neighboring manors sent people, wishing to marry beautiful women to Han Li as concubines.
Han Li’s future prospects were bright and worth investing in. Mainly because other Pihai Realm powerhouses were difficult to deal with; only Han Li was so lustful, frequently taking concubines, making it easy to cling to his powerful coattails, a support to rely on.
The Han Family members were all smiling from ear to ear. Although frequently arranging weddings for the old ancestor was somewhat exhausting, it was worth it.
The higher the old ancestor’s cultivation, the stronger his influence, and their own status, power, and prestige grew along with it. Even the resources for cultivation and worldly wealth provided by the family had risen substantially.
As for these blessings that knocked on his door, Han Li didn’t just accept anyone. The descendants of the Han Family would first screen them, and only then would Han Li personally make his selections.
Han Mansion’s Great Hall,
The newly built great hall was spacious and imposing, lavishly decorated, and capable of accommodating hundreds. Han Li received the blessings in this hall. Old Ancestor Han had accumulated good deeds throughout his life, and taking multiple concubines was the fortune he deserved.
This time there were quite a few blessings, and even after a screening, twelve families remained for Old Ancestor Han to personally review for potential concubinage.
Inside the hall, representatives from the twelve families and powers stood on either side, each led by someone at the Innate Realm, accompanied by a stunningly beautiful young woman. Although some of these women were no longer young, their cultivation was not weak, and with techniques to preserve their youth, their appearances remained like that of young girls.
Clearly, these families understood Old Ancestor Han’s tastes, sending blessings from their own homes.
“Old Ancestor, this is my daughter, Zi Lan, who has long admired you,” said the patriarch of a cultivating family with a respectful tone, giving a signal to the young woman beside him.
Other family heads and sect leaders also spoke in turn, with one message implied in their words: Old Ancestor, kindly take them as your concubines.
Han Li looked at the maidens in the great hall, a flock of charming and beautiful women surpassing standards by a wide margin, showcasing various styles, all like tender blossoms waiting to be picked.
With some young women feeling shy under Han Li’s gaze, lowering their heads, others looked back directly, and some daring ones even closely observed their future husband.
For some of the young women who had reservations, seeing Han Li changed their attitudes. His handsomeness left them spellbound; with high status and great strength, he was simply too perfect to be their husband.
After observing for a while, Han Li waved his hand, and the descendants of the Han Family led the crowd to wait outside the hall.
It didn’t take long for the news to spread throughout Lingjun City and even Fengyang Manor: Old Ancestor Han of the Han Family had started a new round of taking concubines, causing a stir in Fengyang Manor.
Old Ancestor Han’s libertine nature remained unchanged!
This time, Old Ancestor Han intended to take quite a few concubines, each with a remarkable background. In their own powers’ domains, they were considered the most beautiful women, with numerous admirers.
Yet, each willingly became a concubine of Old Ancestor Han, causing countless cultivators to beat their chests in frustration and agony..

chapters.title: Chapter 31 - 31: Nine Levels of the Gangyuan Realm – Part 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: Nine Levels of the Gangyuan Realm – Part 1
Translator: 549690339
Within Lingjun City, one wedding after another was continuously held.
The brides came from the families and powers of Fengyang Manor and other three manors, but there was only one groom.
As things developed to the present, although he was still taking concubines according to the standards set by the System, Han Li’s requirements for taking concubines kept getting higher.
To become his concubine, one must have at least ninth-grade cultivation talent and a beauty score above eighty-five.
The days ahead were long, and as his cultivation increased, the number of his concubines would grow more and more. So, Han Li deliberately controlled the quality of his concubines.
Taking too many concubines at once was not good either; it would leave Han Li overwhelmed and unable to cope.
For the common people of Lingjun City, the frequent taking of concubines by the old ancestor of the Han Family was a joy, and each occasion of taking concubines was the liveliest time in Lingjun City, driving its economic development.
For example, this time he took quite a few concubines. For each one, a grand wedding was held, lasting three days, making a total of thirty-six days.
During these days, the Han Family would hold a grand feast with continuously served dishes, where anyone willing could come to eat and drink for free. This went on for over a month, consuming countless secular riches and greatly booming the economy of Lingjun City.
It could be said that countless ordinary people lived off Han Li taking concubines, always praying for the old ancestor Han to take more concubines, which would then lead to the purchase of their large amounts of goods.
Unnoticed, a year passed.
Since the last time he took concubines, Han Li had not continued to take more, but the number of his descendants kept increasing.
On one hand, he personally opened the source, allowing each newly taken concubine to become pregnant in succession and bear offspring; on the other hand, Han Li continued to encourage procreation, and his descendants were still busily reproducing, adding to the Han Family’s population.
In just four years since the turmoil caused by the White Lotus Cult, Han Li’s number of descendants had already broken through three hundred, earning him numerous rewards such as fifty-eight years of cultivation progress, lifespan, a great number of cultivation techniques and martial skills, a large amount of Beauty Preserving Pills, and so on.
“Your number of descendants has broken through three hundred, you obtain fifty years of cultivation progress, you obtain three Pihai Realm Pills, you obtain the Profound Rank mid-grade martial skill [Sun Collapsing Sword Technique].”
As the number of descendants increased and with Han Li himself working hard, over sixty talented descendants also made breakthroughs, significantly enhancing Han Li’s cultivation talent.
“The number of your descendants with cultivation talent has reached sixty, you obtain twenty years of cultivation progress, you obtain one seventh-grade Lifespan Extension Pill, you obtain thirty years of Formation experience.”
This wave of rewards caused Han Li’s growth rate to explode, allowing him to surge ahead once again.
Originally having stored up eighty-five years of cultivation progress, now he nad gamed an additional one nunared twenty-elgnt years, totanng two hundred thirteen years. Even after spending a considerable amount of cultivation progress to advance to the Peak of the Gangyuan Realm, Han Li still had sixty years of cultivation progress left unclaimed, which he couldn’t use for the time being.
Although his cultivation talent had increased quite a bit, it was still far from the sixth-grade, and he could only use the old method to break through.
Last time, breaking through from the Peak of the Pihai Realm to the Gangyuan Realm took one hundred years of cultivation progress; this time, he needed three hundred years of cultivation progress to break through to the God Refining Realm, which would be much more difficult.
What could Han Li say? Just slowly accumulate!
His cultivation progress shot up like a rocket from the first level of the Gangyuan Realm to the Peak of the Gangyuan Realm; he only needed to spend a small amount of time absorbing it before he transformed into a Great Master at the Peak of Gangyuan Realm.
Just four to five years equated to the hard cultivation of others for over a hundred years; even the cultivation speed of geniuses with third-grade aptitude wasn’t this fast.
He was now only two hundred twelve years old, yet his lifespan had already exceeded seven hundred fifty years, and his growth rate would only get faster and faster.
“The fourth Profound Rank cultivation technique and martial skill.”
Having absorbed the Bhrum Sword Technique, he automatically cultivated this Profound Rank mid-grade martial art to the perfection level, which significantly enhanced his strength once more.
The lower-grade Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield and Cloud -Dispersing Palm, the mid-grade Sacred Heart Scripture, and this Bhrum Sword Technique all were cultivated to the perfection level.
Most cultivators in the Gangyuan Realm practiced lower and mid-grade Profound Rank cultivation techniques and martial skills; only disciples of major forces could access higher-level techniques and skills earlier.
With Han Li’s cultivation at the Peak of Gangyuan Realm and the perfection level Bhrum Sword Technique, Dragon’s Chant Golden Bell Shield, and
Heart-Shattering Palm, he had the power to dominate below the God Refining Realm with few adversaries.
“Three hundred years of cultivation, ah, who knows how long it will take to accumulate.”
He then glanced at the breakthrough progress bar; it had only accrued to 60, and there were still 240 points to go, which made Han Li somewhat weary.
If his cultivation talent were Sixth -grade, he would only need one hundred and fifty years of cultivation to advance to the God Refining Realm, but as a Seventh-grade talent, the required cultivation doubled.
The advancement from the Gangyuan Realm to the God Refining Realm is a
major threshold; practitioners in the Gangyuan Realm could only be addressed as Great Masters, while those in the God Refining Realm could be called True Masters and obtain a considerable status anywhere.
For example, in Tianxuan Mountain, one could become an Elder at the God Refining Realm; in the God Refining Realm one could be an inner sect Elder in the Canghai Sect, or an outer sect Elder in the Yinyang Sect.
In the Pihai Realm, one condenses True Qi into True Yuan, and after more than half is amassed, one can break through to the Gangyuan Realm, where True Yuan will continue to increase within the body during cultivation.
As these True Yuan circulate within the body, they partly enhance the Divine Spirit, allowing cultivators to slowly strengthen their Divine Spirit without the need to practice any secret techniques, and they acquire abilities such as sending secret messages with their voice and captivating people with a glance, among others.
When a Great Master of the Gangyuan Realm cultivates to the peak of the Nine Heavens, the Divine Spirit will also strengthen to a threshold, which is the threshold of the God Refining Realm.
If one can break through this threshold, the Divine Spirit will become fully formed, enabling the transition from the Gangyuan Realm to the God Refining Realm.
Refining the God in the God Refining Realm!
In this realm, the cultivator’s Divine Spirit can continue to grow, significantly enhancing their senses, easily concealing perceptions from those below the Gangyuan Realm, and also affecting cultivators of the Gangyuan Realm.
An explosion of the power of the Divine Spirit will enable a cultivator to develop Spiritual Sense; the stronger the power of the Divine Spirit, the wider the coverage of the Spiritual Sense, which has boundless utility.
“I hope I can break through to the God Refining Realm soon.”
Walking to the window, Han Li stood with his hands clasped behind his back, watching his concubines playing in the garden, yet he carried a heavy weight on his shoulders.
The current situation in the Daqian Empire is becoming increasingly inscrutable, with undercurrents too turbulent for even a Great Master of the Gangyuan Realm to navigate.
In the past five years alone, the White Lotus Cult wreaked havoc in Huozhou, and the number one sect in Qingzhou, the Canghai Sect, lost a precious treasure, resulting in endless turmoil; yet the Daqian Empire has been slow to take effective measures.
The White Lotus Cult’s fleeing Sect Hierarch Wu Sheng’s Old Mother and the Law King have not been captured, and the Canghai Sect’s precious Body-Cultivating Furnace has not been found; the true foundation of the Daqian Empire remains unfathomable.
In these surging undercurrents, it is predictable that the next great turmoil is not far away.
Although Han Li lives in relative seclusion, he too must have strength by his side; otherwise, when an accident occurs, he will have no power to resist.
Should the Han Family be obliterated, even if he manages to escape successfully, years of accumulation would be lost, forcing him to start anew, which is what Han Li does not wish to see.
Shaking his head, Han Li received thirty years of formation experience and took some time to absorb it.
After the absorption was complete, Han Li’s eyes lit up; it perfectly filled a gap for him..

chapters.title: Chapter 32 - 32: Looking Towards the Future 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Looking Towards the Future 1
Translator: 549690339
Formation, alchemy, and artifact refining are all one of the four major secondary professions in the Cultivation Realm, also divided into nine grades down to the first grade.
After absorbing thirty years of experience in formations, Han Li became an Eighth Grade Formation master, capable of setting up some simple basic formations such as Spirit Gathering Arrays and so on.
If he had the corresponding level of array diagrams, he could also set up an Eighth Grade Formation that could contend with the Pihai Realm.
Formation, alchemy, and artifact refining were three skills that Han Li was not yet very proficient in, at only Eighth Grade, which were not very useful for him, yet they were extremely beneficial for his concubines and the Han Family’s descendants.
For example, with formations, he could now set up Spirit Gathering Arrays to enhance the spiritual energy of Han Mansion, speeding up the cultivation rate of the Cultivators in Han Mansion; with blueprints, he could set up Killing Arrays, Instant Arrays, Maze Arrays, Defensive Arrays, and so on, to greatly increase the security of Han Mansion.
Allixirs and refined artifacts could be supplied to the Cultivators of Han Mansion to enhance their strength, as well as being sold to the outside, opening up financial sources for Han Mansion, and continuously earning spirit stones.
Han Li also hoped someone could help him share the burden, but Han Mansion really didn’t have capable people for the task.
His concubines, although they all had cultivation talent, with Qiu Yueyao having the best at Seventh Grade, still needed to practice cultivation to improve their realms, otherwise their lifespans wouldn’t be long.
There were two types of Han Family descendants, one with talent, who would be sent to various sects for cultivation upon reaching the age of eight, initially focusing only on cultivation. After reaching a certain realm, they could start learning alchemy, artifact refining, and formations; otherwise, those with poor talent would end up mastering neither.
The other type was those without talent. Those capable helped Han Li manage the family affairs, earning worldly wealth to support the operations of the Han Family; those who weren’t capable simply enjoyed the family benefits, receiving the allocated wealth each month, which was not much. If they wanted more, they had to reproduce and spread the family line.
All of this needed time to support. In hundreds of years, or even a thousand years, the Han Family would definitely be able to share all these responsibilities, and he, the old ancestor, wouldn’t have to worry anymore.
By then, the Han Family’s descendants would have grown up, such as those with Seventh Grade talent reaching the Gangyuan Realm; without hope for the God Refining Realm, they could turn to study alchemy, artifact refining, formations, and so on. As long as they achieved something and made a certain contribution to the family, they could apply for the family’s help to break through to the God Refining Realm.
By then, the Han Family would have a large number of Alchemists, Artifact Refiners, Formation Masters, etc., as well as countless mighty individuals to suppress one area, and Han Li, the old ancestor, would only need to take care of taking in concubines.
By then, the Han Family would also have many geniuses, Third Grade talents, Second Grade prodigies, First Grade monsters… adventuring abroad, becoming famous in the vast world, and spreading the prestige of Han Mansion.
After envisioning the future, Han Li returned to reality. In fact, there was another solution, which was to recruit externals who cultivated pills, artifacts, and formations.
But there were few who studied these arts, and even fewer who achieved something significant. With the prowessHan Li demonstrated, at the Fifth
Layer of the Pihai Realm, it would be difficult to hire Eighth Grade Alchemists, Artifact Refiners, and Formation Masters.
“Forget it, let’s take it step by step,” he said.
Shaking his head, Han Li decided to take it slowly and not to try to achieve everything at once; recruiting some Ninth Graders would be enough for now. This way, he would only need to be responsible for refining elixirs and weapons for the Pihai Realm, greatly reducing his workload.
Once he showed a higher level of cultivation to the outside world and advanced to the Gangyuan Realm, he should be able to recruit Eighth Graders.
In the following two months, Han Li spent his time inside Han Mansion.
He first set up a large Spirit Gathering Array for the Han Family, and then placed an enhanced version of the Spirit Gathering Array in the backyard of the Han Family, which he had paid for the array diagrams.
Han Li had long instructed the descendants of the Han Family to collect pill formulas, array diagrams, and refining blueprints, the more the better.
He also set up an Eighth Grade Trapping Array and an Eighth Grade Defensive Array, plus a host of Ninth Grade formations, which would not be breached by the typical Pihai Realm attackers even after three days and nights of continuous assault.
During this period, Han Mansion recruited several Ninth Grade Alchemists and Artifact Refiners who were willing to serve the Han Family. Han Li had them stationed within the Alchemy Pavilion and Artifact Refining Pavilion, which greatly reduced his workload. He only needed to spend about half an hour each day concocting Eighth Grade Elixirs and forging Eighth Grade Spiritual Artifacts.
At the last gathering of Loose Cultivators, Han Li collected many Pill Formulas and Refining Blueprints, such as the Sea Opening Pill, the Returning Origin Pill, the Tiger-Slaying Blade, and so on. He refined some of each and, after selling them, gained a large number of Spirit Stones.
The Sea Opening Pill, in particular, was very popular and in high demand. Han Li’s output was also very limited, primarily because the ingredients were rare.
If it weren’t for the large number of Spirit Stones he gained at the gathering of Loose Cultivators, the repayment of the owed Spirit Stones from Li Deshun, as well as the nearly one hundred thousand Spirit Stones obtained from killing seven Loose Cultivators, the Han Family wouldn’t have had enough Spirit Stones to purchase the materials for Alchemy and Artifact Refining.
After depleting nearly all of the Spirit Stones in Han Mansion by stockpiling a massive amount of medicinal ingredients and Refining Materials, the inventory skyrocketed, increasing by six to seven times, when Han Li transformed these into Elixirs and Spiritual Artifacts to sell.
With a large number of Spirit Stones at his disposal, Han Li began to assemble the ingredients for refining the Rebirth Pills, but for the time being, he only took out those that were relatively easy to gather.
As the Han Family entered a virtuous cycle, Han Li began to reform the family traditions, establishing stricter family rules to prevent the descendants from causing trouble and inadvertently offending hidden powerful figures, which could bring great trouble to the Han Family.
Every ten years, he would personally deal with a batch of people from the Han Mansion, including some of his descendants who had committed serious crimes. The lighter punishment was whipping, while he personally put several incorrigible descendants to death.
Under Han Li’s strict constraints, the descendants of the Han Family became more sensible, daring not to indulge in oppressive or harmful behaviors toward others or cause trouble for civilians.
Otherwise, if caught by the Han Family’s enforcement team or reported by civilians, they would be locked in the family jail for severe punishment.
Furthermore, Han Li once again increased family welfare. Those capable descendants who managed family affairs effectively were all rewarded with Beauty Preserving Pills, Lifespan Extension Pills, and other Elixirs, to boost their enthusiasm.
Descendants with lesser abilities also saw their monthly resource allocation increase by thirty percent, while the rewards for producing offspring doubled, as an incentive to encourage the expansion of the family lineage.
Aside from these matters, Han Li spent the rest of his time with his concubines, naturally attending to the well-being of his descendants, occasionally forming various shapes for play.
As his cultivation reached the peak of the ninth level of the Gangyuan Realm, his combat strength also increased countless times over. Apart from Qiu Yueyao, who had reached the Innate Realm and could barely hold her own, the other concubines could not.
Therefore, Han Li often played the game of Landlords with multiple concubines at once, just to determine a winner.
In a certain part of Han Mansion, there was a small courtyard, which was the residence of the head of the guards, Zhang Xuan.
He was the First Disciple of Han Li’s good friend Qiu Xuan and the only one who followed Han Li to Lingjun City, receiving many benefits as a result.
“Life here is much more comfortable than in Fenglei City,” Zhang Xuan sighed.
Han Li took good care of him, providing ample cultivation resources and giving him several pointers that helped Zhang Xuan break through to the True Qi Realm.
Of course, the True Qi Realm was somewhat lacking for a head of Han Mansion’s guards, but due to the relationship between Han Li and Qiu Yueyao, no one voiced any objections, they were just envious of his good fortune.
Over the years, Han Mansion had recruited a large number of guards below the Pihai Realm, with only those in the Innate Realm qualifying to be head guards, while those in the True Qi Realm could only serve as team leaders.
As head guard, Zhang Xuan also enjoyed a lot of downtime. Besides leading people to escort Han Family descendants to various Sects, there was not much else to do.
But he did not idle away his time; instead, he cultivated assiduously, aiming to break through to the Innate Realm as soon as possible and legitimately become the head of the Han Mansion’s guards..

chapters.title: Chapter 33 - 33 The Four Great Powers 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: The Four Great Powers 1
Translator: 549690339
Han Mansion, the backyard.
“Truly a splendid treasure, no wonder it has allowed the Canghai Sect to survive for five thousand years without falling.”
Han Li toyed with the small furnace in his hand, exclaiming in awe.
During this period, he had already refined the Body-Cultivating Furnace and understood its functions. The more he understood, the more shocked he became.
There was a reason why Tianxuan Mountain couldn’t compare to the Canghai Sect.
As an Earth-Level Lower Rank magical treasure, the offensive and defensive powers of the Body-Cultivating Furnace were only equivalent to those of an ordinary Earth-Level Lower Rank magical treasure, but these were just the subsidiary powers of the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
The true purpose of the Body-Cultivating Furnace was to aid in cultivation, mainly with four major powers.
First, it increases the speed of cultivation. The Body-Cultivating Furnace automatically absorbs higher-level spiritual energy from the unknown, and within its range, the speed of cultivation can be increased by tenfold. This is only for the cultivation of one person. If the range is expanded, and more people cultivate within it, the effect will decrease.
The Body-Cultivating Furnace was placed by the Canghai Sect in a forbidden area under heavy protection of formations, with strict restrictions on the number of cultivators and the duration of cultivation. Even the Sect Master could not monopolize it by force.
To make better use of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the Canghai Sect’s rule was that only one person could cultivate at a time, for a period of two months. Compared to quantity, the Canghai Sect valued quality more.
The Sect Master, Elders, and Core Disciples ranked in the top ten geniuses were qualified to use it, except for the Sect Master and Elders, who all needed to spend a large amount of Contribution Value and then queue up.
Of course, if one made great contributions, there was also a significant chance of obtaining an opportunity to cultivate within it.
Generally speaking, the Sect Master and Elders seldom used the Body-Cultivating Furnace to speed up cultivation. Their realms were already very high, and going there once to increase a year and a half of cultivation was of little significance.
Second, it breaks through realms. Half of the higher level spiritual energy absorbed by the Body-Cultivating Furnace is automatically intercepted and stored, condensed into a higher level spiritual liquid.
Consuming the higher level spiritual liquid has a chance to break the shackles of one’s realm. Below the God Refining Realm, the success rate is one hundred percent. Beyond the God Refining Realm, the probability gets lower and lower.
Third, it heals injuries. Using the higher level spiritual liquid can quickly repair physical injuries. Although it can’t achieve regeneration from a drop of blood, regrowing limbs is no problem, truly a lifesaving treasure.
Fourth, it improves aptitude. Long-term cultivation within the range of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, under the baptism of higher level spiritual energy, can improve one’s cultivation talent.
According to the Canghai Sect’s records, the worse the talent, the better the improvement effect. A Ninth Grade talent could improve by one grade after one cultivation, an Eighth Grade talent could improve after three times, Seventh Grade after ten times, Sixth Grade after twenty times, Fifth Grade after fifty times, and could only advance from Fifth to Fourth Grade at most. Those with Fourth Grade talent or higher could only increase a portion.
“Could the legend actually be true?”
Gazing at the Body-Cultivating Furnace in his hand with surprise and doubt, Han Li pondered.
Although it was an Earth-Level Lower Rank magical treasure, its powers were too terrifying, even more powerful than other Heaven Rank Lower Grade magical treasures he knew of.
Any one of its main powers could be considered a feature of an Earth-Level Supreme Magical Artifact. The normal Heaven Rank Lower Grade magical treasures that aid in cultivation only have two or three functions, and their effects are inferior to the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
Perhaps the Body-Cultivating Furnace truly is one of the replica items of the ancient Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace, only that after countless years, it has become damaged or perhaps sealed, leading to its grade falling to that of a Heaven Rank Lower Grade magical treasure.
If the speculation is true, how powerful would a Heaven-Level Supreme Grade Body-Cultivating Furnace be? What about the other replica item, the Soul-Cultivating Furnace? What are its powers?
The Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace, this legendary supreme divine weapon, what kind of unfathomable power might it possess?
Han Li shook his head, feeling it was better to be realistic. Complete Body-Cultivating Furnaces, Soul-Cultivating Furnaces, and the legendary Life-Prolonging Furnace were too far out of reach for him.
“How can I make use of this Body-Cultiva ting Furnace?” Han Li was somewhat troubled.
Possessing a valuable treasure but unable to use it freely for fear that if the news leaked out, the Han Family would be destroyed in an instant.
With the Body-Cultivating Furnace, he no longer needed to rely on the System to temporarily improve his aptitude. To raise his aptitude from a seventh-grade to a sixth-grade, he only had to cultivate within the scope of the Body-Cultivating Furnace for a year and a half.
Speeding up cultivation was useless to Han Li; he was too lazy to cultivate; healing injuries was good, but temporarily unnecessary; making a realm breakthrough was very powerful, but it required the accumulation of higher level spiritual energy for over a year.
After some thought, Han Li planned out how to use the Body-Cultivating
Furnace.
Normally, it would be placed in his oversized bedroom, hidden by an array formation, so his concubines would not discover it and inadvertently leak the secret due to gossip.
When Han Li and his concubines played the game of ‘Fight the Landlord’, he could improve their aptitudes, accelerate their cultivation, and when they were close to a breakthrough, he could secretly control the Body-Cultivating Furnace to infuse them with spiritual energy.
If he had to leave, he would take the Body-Cultivating Furnace with him to prevent any accidents, and also as an additional safeguard. Although the offensive power of the Body-Cultivating Furnace was weak, it compared to
Earth Rank Lower Grade Treasures and could save lives in a critical moment.
Both the Body-Cultivating Furnace and the Rebirth Pill could enhance aptitude, one up to Fourth Grade and the other up to Fifth Grade, both requiring time.
Han Li decided to pursue both, to be strong on all fronts. For now, he couldn’t overtly allow his concubines and family descendants to use the Body-Cultivating Furnace, but the Rebirth Pill was an option.
Of course, the assignment of the Rebirth Pill also needed careful choice of recipients, for not everyone could receive such a precious thing, with rare materials and difficult refinement ensuring they would always be scarce.
“Still lacking in strength,” he sighed.
If he were Grandmaster Wanxiang, or even Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, he could openly use the Body-Cultivating Furnace and Rebirth Pill— who would dare to plunder them?
But Han Li was currently just a cultivator at the peak of the Gangyuan Realm and still far from the Myriad Phenomena Realm and the True Martial Realm, so he clearly knew he still had to lay low.
Although he still needed to develop in the shadows, Han Li was pleased; the Rebirth Pill was not yet perfected, but the Body-Cultivating Furnace was already in effect.
Han Li had previously worried a great deal about his concubines’ low cultivation talents. With their low aptitude, they could hardly reach high cultivation realms Decause memr cultivation speea was coo Slow co support tne longevity needed to advance.
Unless they encountered fortuitous adventures that increased their aptitude, or gained a vast array of cultivation resources to accelerate their cultivation, they had a chance to level up step by step.
For the concubines, Han Li was their greatest opportunity. He was deeply concerned about their cultivation talent and always tried his hardest with each one.
Han Li didn’t want to see his concubines, as beautiful as flowers and captivating as cities, perish like vanishing incense, leaving his side; that would be unbearable.
As he looked back on the countless ages and oversaw the cycle of epochs, standing alone in eternity, the solitude was just too much for him to accept.
Motivated Han Li immediately got up and returned to his bedroom to summon Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, and the others in succession. He was going to teach them and increase their infusion of spiritual energy, to speed up their cultivation.
After instructing everyone at different spots in the bedroom, all the women were exhausted but felt they had benefited greatly, as their cultivation had significantly increased, and they silently marveled at why this session was so effective.
However, they did not ask questions, attributing it to Han Li’s advancement in cultivation, which they believed had improved the efficacy of his instruction and spiritual energy transmission.
One day, as Han Li was enjoying the flowers and watching dances in the back garden, frolicking with his many concubines, the layabout who had been missing for a year came looking for him..

chapters.title: Chapter 34 - 34 Lin Yiwu 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: Lin Yiwu 1
Translator: 549690339
“Hasn’t this little fellow run away?”
Han Li was somewhat surprised, but he still had someone lead the scoundrel to the side hall to wait.
Back when he had participated in the loose cultivators’ meeting, he sold a Pihai Pill to this person. Since the scoundrel’s spirit stones were insufficient, he had to do him a favor.
The scoundrel had planned to sneak away, but after searching for a long time, he could never find the marker Han Li had mentioned and could only sulkily make his way to Lingjun City.
He had always been cautious, for fear of what Han Li might do to him, only to find out he had been overthinking, and Han Li really just wanted him to do one thing.
After completing that task, the scoundrel had fled, never contacting Han Li again. More than a year had gone by, and Han Li never expected to see him again.
After saying a word to his concubines, Han Li left the backyard, moving swiftly as a shooting star, arriving at the side hall. He sat in the high seat, looking down on the scoundrel from above.
Feeling the evaluating gaze of Han Li, the old ancestor who had taken in concubines, the scoundrel felt uncomfortable all over. He would never have come to seek Han Li’s help if he had any other choice.
“Yi Wu, right? You only have a quarter of an hour,” said Han Li.
The last time they met, the scoundrel had called himself Yi Wu, and Han Li hadn’t cared. Even if he was merely at Innate Realm, and had now broken throuqh to the Pihai Realm, he still didn’t matter to him.
Yi Wu pressed his lips together, his hands involuntarily clenched into fists, and then limply fell. With a hint of pleading, he said, “Please, elder, save my younger sister’s life.”
In his life, he had never begged anyone, but at this moment, he had no choice but to beg; otherwise, his sister would truly be finished. A glint flashed in Han Li’s eyes, and he remained silent.
Was he, Han the Ancestor, lacking in dignity?
To ask him to help someone unrelated was absurd; he was far too busy being a diligent old farmer who toiled every day, planting and sowing seeds.
“I am willing to join the Han Mansion and attend to your orders for a hundred years,” Yi Wu spoke for a second time.
Looking at the figure in the cloak in the hall, Han Li let out a snort of derision and said indifferently, “What use do I have for a Pihai Realm cultivator?” Yi Wu was stunned.
It was with great hesitation that he had made this decision, thinking for sure that Han Li would agree.
After all, he was a Pihai Realm cultivator and not too old, with excellent talent. Though he could only serve the Han Family for a hundred years, he would certainly bring substantial help to them.
As far as he knew, the Han Family didn’t have a single Pihai Realm cultivator at the moment, only Han Li, the concealed sixth elder, a Great Master.
Little did he know, Han Li truly didn’t care about his Pihai Realm status; even if he could break through to the Gangyuan Realm in the next hundred years, what use would that be to him?
In a few years, when he revealed his Gangyuan Realm cultivation level, he could easily recruit some Pihai Realm cultivators as Guest Elders. In several decades, by the time he reached the God Refining Realm, he would be able to recruit Great Masters at the Gangyuan Realm as Guest Elders too.
Yi Wu stood there, at a loss.
What he considered as confident bargaining chips were dismissed as insignificant by Han Li, unable to persuade Han Li to move to rescue his sister.
What was he to do?
Perhaps, there was only that one option left…
Time passed by each second, and the quarter of an hour was quickly coming to an end.
Yi Wu was still hesitating, standing there like a block of wood, in the throes of an inner struggle.
At that moment, Han Li stood up, not saying a word, ready to leave.
“Wait!” Yi Wu suddenly spoke out, her tone resolute.
Han Li stopped in his tracks and turned his head to look at the figure below the stage but did not speak.
Yi Wu paused before taking off her wide-brimmed hat and carelessly throwing it to the ground, revealing an aged face full of wrinkles and a head of white hair.
Then, she slowly reached her right hand beneath her left ear and gently tore away something, as a layer of human skin fell off, uncovering a new face that seemed to brighten the side hall by threefold.
Han Li’s throat moved slightly.
“If the elder is willing to lend a hand, this junior is willing to marry the elder as a concubine and serve you for life,” Yi Wu said softly, yet unbeknownst to her, two streams of clear tears had traced their path down her beautiful face.
Han Li looked at that breathtakingly beautiful face that could make fish sink and geese plummet straight from the sky, then slowly shook his head.
Lin Yiwu’s pupils contracted sharply, and her cold, stunning face was full of shock and despair.
She had been sensible from a young age and knew well the dangers of the world. After certain events, she had prepared two human skin masks for herself and her sister to conceal their true appearances and cultivate in low
profile.
Many cultivators had lusted after the beauty of her and her sister along the way, wanting to forcefully take them as concubines, but she had managed to elude them all.
But now, she had offered herself to be a concubine willingly and was rejected; and the one who rejected her was the notorious ‘Old Ancestor of Taking Concubines,” Han Li. What infuriated her the most was that Han Li had just taken twelve concubines not long ago…
It wasn’t that she was arrogant, but none of those twelve concubines could compare to her in either beauty or figure. They were not even in the same league.
After the shock, only despair was left in Lin Yiwu’s heart.
Without the assistance of Han Li, the Great Master of the Gangyuan Realm, how could she possibly rescue her sister?
With her own strength, it was simply impossible; attempting to do so would be suicide, and it would cost her own life as well.
Among those Lin Yiwu knew, Han Li was the most powerful cultivator. Although he was known for his romantic ways, his reputation was good, and he hadn’t made things difficult for her the last time they had finished a task together; otherwise, Lin Yiwu wouldn’t have come to seek his help.
