Seeing Lin Yiwu’s expression, Han Li knew she had misunderstood, but he offered no explanation and merely said, “First, tell me the whole story, and then honestly inform me of the cultivation level of your enemy.”
In fact, Han Li had seen through Lin Yiwu’s disguise at their first meeting. A human skin mask could only be effective below the Gangyuan Realm. A Great Master of the Gangyuan Realm, with a progressively strong Divine Spirit, could easily see through it.
Although Lin Yiwu was very beautiful, exceptionally so, more beautiful than all his concubines and all the women he had ever seen, so what?
Han Li had his own principles and would not casually take a stunning beauty as a concubine, nor would he be unable to walk after seeing a ravishing beauty, turning into a foolish ogler.
Unless that stunning beauty possessed supremely high talent, enough to warrant Han Li’s exception. For the sake of his development and increasing his strength, Han Li did not mind forcefully taking a beautiful woman with high potential as a concubine, for he was not a stickler for convention.
Lin Yiwu, who had been intending to leave, lifted her head to look at the figure on the high platform, her heart filled with indescribable emotions. Suppressing various feelings, Lin Yiwu then began to recount her story.
It went roughly like this: At the Loose Cultivator’s gathering, she had obtained a Pihai Pill and found her sister, Lin Yiyin, after completing a task given by Han Li, and the two planned to head to Luzhou.
On their way, they arrived near Zhenyi Manor in Qingzhou and temporarily settled in Zhenyi City to recuperate. Lin Yiwu went out to replenish their cultivation materials and instructed her sister not to leave, but Lin Yiyin sneaked out to wander through the city and ended up being discovered by a Pihai Realm Great Master.
A city-toppling beauty would not normally incite such desires in a cultivator of the Gangyuan Realm, but Lin Yiyin was one of those rare devastating beauties. The Pihai Realm Great Master took her away, intending to make her his concubine.
When Lin Yiwu returned and received the news, she was dumbstruck, but she dared not barge into the Pihai Great Master’s residence to take her sister back that would be like delivering herself into his hands.
Upon making inquiries in Zhenyi City, she learned that the Great Master had an ugly visage and cultivated a certain Collection and Supplement Method, having harmed countless women.
Although the Pihai Realm cultivator wanted to formally take Lin Yiyin as a concubine, it was inevitable he would use her for his cultivation technique. Lin Yiyin would not be able to withstand it for long, and with her temperament, she would likely choose to end her own life in advance.
Thus, Lin Yiwu thought to find a savior and hurried to Lingjun City to ask Han
Li for help..

chapters.title: Chapter 35 - 35: 98% Certainty_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: 98% Certainty_l
Translator: 549690339
Han Li couldn’t help but feel like laughing. Leaving Leizhou, crossing Qingzhou, and heading for Luzhou—did they really think they could avoid him?
As for the two sisters encountering an accident, that was only to be expected.
Generally, Great Masters of the Gang Yuan Realm could travel between states safely and without incident. Cultivators below the Gang Yuan Realm, if they
wished to cross states, would do well to travel at noon; otherwise, they would surely meet with misfortune.
The two sisters were also peerless beauties, which only increased the likelihood of trouble. Human skin masks were of no use in front of a Great Master of the Gang Yuan Realm.
Despite there being fewer than twenty in Fengyang Manor, the Gang Yuan Realm cultivators were not so scarce in the whole of Leizhou.
Leizhou, one of the eighteen provinces of the Daqian Empire, spanned tens of thousands of miles and had twenty-three manors, including Fengyang Manor, Zhenyi Manor, Fenglei Manor, etc.
Excluding those from the Four Sects and the cultivators from Leizhou’s city, the twenty-three manors had roughly five hundred cultivators in the Gang Yuan Realm. The five great powers had slightly fewer, around four hundred or so.
This meant that there were approximately nine hundred cultivators in the Gang Yuan Realm within Leizhou, primarily concentrated among the five great powers, followed by various manor cities, and lastly within the prefecture-level sects.
There were so many other places the two sisters could have gone; instead, they headed straight for the city of Zhenyi Manor, where the probability of being discovered by a cultivator of the Gang Yuan Realm was quite significant.
To think of traveling to another state to escape his covetous gaze, only to run back to him for help in the face of danger, was truly ironic.
“What’s the name of this Gang Yuan Realm cultivator and what’s his cultivation level?” Han Li inquired.
He was inclined to agree to Lin Yiwu’s request. To take a peerless beauty as a concubine, especially since Lin Yiwu was young and, for some reason, had not yet joined a major sect. She had cultivated all the way to the Pihai Realm on her own, which suggested that her talent was not lacking and might be even better than that of Qiu Yueyao.
But the old ancestor Han was always cautious. He didn’t want to rush into a rescue without understanding the enemy’s situation; to know both the enemy and oneself is to be victorious in every battle.
Simply put, he wanted to increase his chances of a successful rescue.
If the said Great Master of the Gang Yuan Realm was too powerful and the risk of rescuing them too great, Han Li would abandon the attempt.
If he wished for eternal life, he had to be stable and not reckless!
Before coming, Lin Yiwu had already spent a considerable sum to purchase intelligence from the Tianji Pavilion. She responded immediately, “His name is Cui Pingyu, with the seventh layer of the Gang Yuan Realm, coming from the
Hehuan Sect.”
Having said this, Lin Yiwu looked at Han Li with a hopeful expression, her eyes filled with pleading.
Han Li was her last hope, but she had no confidence whether he would agree. After all, this was a late-stage Great Master of the Gang Yuan Realm from a major sect. Although Han Li was also of the Gang Yuan Realm, it was highly likely that his cultivation was not as advanced as Cui Pingyu’s, which meant the chances of him agreeing were extremely slim.
Meeting Lin Yiwu’s eager gaze, Han Li’s lips curved slightly upward as he said indifferently, “I don’t mind dealing with a late-stage Great Master of the Gang Yuan Realm, but it will cost extra.”
Extra charge?
Lin Yiwu’s expression changed from surprise to astonishment, feeling a heaviness in her heart.
She blinked and said weakly, “Elder, 1…1 do not have that many Spirit Stones or treasures.”
As a cultivator who had just broken through to the Pihai Realm, she had already exhausted most of her Spirit Stones and treasures at the gathering of loose cultivators; she hardly had enough left to hire a Great Master of the Gang
Yuan Realm.
No money to offer, no life to give…it seemed she had nothing at all!
“I do not need your Spirit Stones or treasures,” Han Li said with a smile.
Biting her lip, Lin Yiwu steeled her heart and asked directly, “Then, elder, what do you need to offer your help?”
No matter what, she had to enlist Han Li’s help. She could see that Han Li was willing to assist but was being cautious, needing a higher price to act without restraint.
Han Li gave her a deep look and said indifferently, “Just you alone is not enough.”
Lin Yiwu was first startled, then violently shook her head and said, “No way!”
This old ancestor from the Han Family actually wanted her sister Lin Yiyin to also become his concubine. Wasn’t she enough?
If she really agreed, what would be the point of asking Han Li to rescue her sister Lin Yiyin?
Han Li said nothing, leaving the pressure on Lin Yiwu.
Why would he go out of his way to provoke a late-stage Gang Yuan Realm Great Master and possibly bring trouble from the Hehuan Sect without sufficient benefit in return?
A mere Lin Yiwu was not worth the risk of exposing his cultivation for his help.
Either the sisters marry him together, or she could find her own way.
It might seem like taking advantage of someone’s vulnerability, but Han Li didn’t care about that. He just wanted to give two peerless beauties a home, protect them from harm, prevent the sisters from being separated by life and death. What was wrong with that?
“Sigh-”
Lin Yiwu was silent for a long time before she finally let out a long sigh, trembling as she said, “Han Li, you’ve won.”
This sentence seemed to drain all her strength, and she appeared rather dejected, lowering her proud head without expression.
Faced with the choice between having Lin Yiyin forcibly taken as a concubine by an ugly Great Master and drained to death, and both sisters marrying Han Li as concubines, she ultimately chose the latter.
At least Han Li was handsome and a top-notch attractive man, at least Han Li would not drain his concubines, and treated each of them well, at least Han Li had a long life ahead of him, with prospects of advancing to the God Refining Realm, at least her sister wouldn’t be separated by death, at least…
In an instant, Lin Yiwu found many reasons for herself, continuously convincing herself, but unbeknownst to her, she had already burst into tears, the drops falling like pearls onto a jade plate.
“Sister, I’m sorry,” Lin Yiwu murmured in her heart.
When Lin Yiwu looked up again, she found that Han Li had disappeared without taking advantage of the situation, which brought a trace of relief and…
gratitude to her heart.
She had genuinely feared that Han Li would do something to her at that moment, deliberately delaying the rescue of her sister Lin Yiyin.
In the bedchamber, Han Li’s figure appeared here.
Although he had agreed with Lin Yiwu, Han Li was not going to recklessly charge in; he needed to make preparations, and fortunately, he had sufficient time.
Cui Pingyu placed great importance on Lin Yiyin, intending to give her a grand concubine wedding ceremony seven days later; perhaps he was also hoping to lure Lin Yiwu into trying to rescue her, and then capture Lin Yiwu to take her as a junior concubine as well.
“A late-stage Gang Yuan Realm Great Master, definitely not easy to handle,” Han Li frowned slightly.
Cui Pingyu, a core disciple from one of the Four Sects of Leizhou – the Hehuan Sect, had learned many Profound Rank cultivation techniques and martial skills which made him very strong.
To snatch someone from his grasp, safely take them back to Lingjun City, and not reveal his identity was by no means an easy feat.
The Cui Manor would certainly be protected by formations, and even if he managed to sneak in, it wouldn’t be easy to take Lin Yiyin away without drawing Cui Pingyu’s pursuit, greatly risking the exposure of his own identity.
With his current identity, it was also not suitable to approach Cui Pingyu for a trade, offering treasured items for Lin Yiyin’s return. Would a late-stage Gang Yuan Realm Great Master care about a mere Level 5 cultivator from the Pihai Realm? He might even kill to seize the treasure, and a fight could also expose his identity.
The best solution was to kill Cui Pingyu; then, for the time being, no one would chase after him, and by the time the Hehuan Sect started investigating, he would have already erased his traces.
The problem was that Cui Pingyu was no easy target. This man had connections with several Great Masters in Zhenyi City, and if a battle occurred, it was highly probable that they would come to support him.
Over the next three days, Han Li made intensive preparations until he felt confident enough, and then he quietly left Lingjun City, heading for Zhenyi
Manor..

chapters.title: Chapter 36 - 36: The Ancient Catastrophe_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: The Ancient Catastrophe_1
Translator: 549690339
Zhenyi Manor.
Among the twenty-three Manors of Leizhou, nine are the most prosperous, and Zhenyi Manor is one of them.
Qingzhou’s terrain takes the shape of a key, conveniently separating Leizhou from Huozhou. Luzhou is also not adjacent to Huozhou, and is situated in another direction from Qingzhou.
Zhenyi Manor borders Qingzhou and is one of the three Manors connecting Leizhou to Qingzhou. Entering Qingzhou from Zhenyi Manor and continuing forward, crossing Qingzhou will lead to Luzhou.
In Zhenyi City, the sixth floor private room of a top-grade restaurant,
Han Li, clothed in a moon-white brocade robe, stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing at the bustling cityscape from the window. After a long while, he heaved a lingering sigh.
Stepping onto the path of cultivation marked the beginning of transcendence. Upon breaking through to the Innate Realm, one’s lifespan doubled, a barrier between mortals and immortality erected.
The cultivators in the first three realms still mixed with the Mortal World, having great need for worldly wealth, but once they stepped into the Innate Realm, none of that mattered anymore.
Upon reaching the Innate Realm, one naturally no longer needed food, with daily absorption of Spiritual Energy sufficing for survival. They interfaced with the Cultivation Realm, using resources like Spirit Stones, and rarely interacted with the Mortal World.
Reaching the Pihai Realm and beyond, they truly severed ties, no longer concerning themselves with the Mortal World as their attention turned solely to the matters of the Cultivation Realm.
“To vie for a life span of two hundred years, upon looking back, one has already become an Immortal!” Han Li murmured to himself.
Now, as a Great Master at the peak of the Gang Yuan Realm, his life expectancy neared eight hundred years, which to mortals, he was indeed an Immortal. “I wonder if there really are Immortals in this world?”
Han Li suddenly looked towards the heavens, his eyes shimmering with a trace of longing.
In his past life, he had read numerous fantasy cultivation novels where Immortals usually lived in the Immortal Realm—a world superior to the one he resided in, often requiring one to transcend calamities and ascend to become an Immortal.
However, those fantasy novels were merely mortal fantasies, and Han Li wouldn’t take them as references for his world. Employing them verbatim would lead to significant losses, especially since those “references” lacked foundation.
Over the years, Han Li had come to understand more and more about this world, yet he still didn’t know if there truly were Immortals. Only occasionally would there be records in miscellaneous books mentioning their existence before ancient times.
Legends say that countless eons ago, the Cultivation Realm was at its peak of glory, with Immortals descending to the world from time to time and powerful beings emerging one after another. Heroes and geniuses were everywhere, and there were hundreds of blessed lands occupied by those above the Divine Yuan Realm.
Suddenly one day, a Divine Sword fell from the sky, triggering a great calamity with countless casualties, thus bringing an end to the Ancient Era, and the Cultivation Realm began to decline.
After ancient times, Qian Yuan Divine Province was turbulent for a hundred thousand years, eventually forming a structure of eight territories and two seas, and only after another thirty thousand years did it become the era it is now.
In today’s Cultivation Realm, it seems greatly declined; one doesn’t even find
Immortals or great beings above the Divine Yuan Realm, not to mention
Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm or Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm. They might be lurking in seclusion, devoted to their close-door cultivation.
“Huh-”
Exhaling deeply, Han Li’s gaze shifted to another direction in Zhenyi City, where stood a grand, expansive manor—the Cui Manor.
Thinking back on the information he had purchased these days, a faint smile appeared on Han Li’s face.
In Zhenyi Manor, there are twenty-four Great Masters of the Gang Yuan Realm. Fourteen are in the five major Sects in Zhenyi Manor, one in seclusion in a county town, and the remaining nine are in Zhenyi City.
Among them, four are affiliated with the Da Qian Empire, with two more on amicable terms with the Da Qian Empire.
If any conflict arises, the Da Qian Empire will surely not just watch, and other Great Masters, wary of the Da Qian Empire, may choose not to provide support.
Cui Pingyu, who hails from the Hehuan Sect, is still a Core Disciple there. He arrived in Zhenyi City fifty years ago to develop, and it was likely in accordance with the orders of the Hehuan Sect.
The Hehuan Sect is one of the Four Sects of Leizhou and is also a branch of the Yinyang Sect, one of the Eight Great Forces of the Xuan Domain, which is an open secret to those above the Pihai Realm.
The Yinyang Sect had always coveted the Daqian Empire, skulking around and causing friction in the shadows, yet no one had officially torn off their masks of civility.
The Yinyang Sect wanted the Da Jing Empire and the Kurong Sect to act as vanguards, to reap the benefits behind the scenes; the Daqian Empire was constantly in conflict with the Da Jing Empire, and also had to face the pressure from the Kurong Sect, so they didn’t want to easily break with the Yinyang Sect.
Otherwise, the Hehuan Sect would not have been able to develop in Leizhou, and would have been finished off by the Daqian Empire long ago.
Even so, the Daqian Empire was always limiting the infiltration of the Yinyang Sect, imposing various restrictions on the Hehuan Sect, with the most crucial one being to prevent the tentacles of the Yinyang Sect from leaving Leizhou.
The Hehuan Sect’s headquarters in Qingyun Manor, located adjacent to the
Yinyang Sect’s area, was closely monitored by the Protector General of
Leizhou, making it difficult for the Hehuan Sect to expand. Thus, they considered starting anew elsewhere.
Han Li withdrew his gaze, his smile even wider as he said to himself, “There is no deviation, the plan can be implemented now.”
He had arrived in Zhenyi City two days ago. Having entered in disguise, he had been observing and investigating to ensure there were no additional obstacles to the plan.
At night, the Cui Manor.
Underneath the brilliant lights, Cui Pingyu was drinking glass after glass of wine, feeling somewhat irritable.
“Bang!”
He carelessly smashed a wine glass onto the floor, grabbed two beautiful maids at his side and headed into the inner chambers.
The two maids wore expressions of terror yet dared not resist. Soon, suggestive sounds emanated from within.
An hour later, Cui Pingyu emerged, sat by the wine table, but the two beautiful maids were nowhere to be seen.
“When will these days come to an end?” After venting his frustrations, Cui Pingyu’s irritation subsided a bit, and he couldn’t help but complain.
Originally, he was a once-renowned genius within the Hehuan Sect, breaking through to the Gang Yuan Realm before the age of two hundred—he was spirited and had promising prospects.
When the sect decided to establish a new base, Cui Pingyu confidently took on the task and came to Zhenyi Manor on his own to develop it.
He needed to build a force in Zhenyi City and then infiltrateHuozhou with all his might. The task was heavy, the resistance great, but the reward was substantial; once successful, his chances of advancing to the God Refining Realm in the future would increase significantly.
However, after arriving in Zhenyi City, Cui Pingyu realized he had been too naive. Ten years in, he felt the chance of completing his mission was very slim.
The restrictions on him here were more than tenfold compared to those in Qingyun Manor, both overt and covert, and after fifty years of effort, he didn’t have any substantial achievements. His subordinates were nothing more than a few insignificant characters, nowhere near enough to complete the task assigned by the sect.
For forty years, Cui Pingyu had been stubbornly persevering, unwilling to accept that he had wasted so much time with little to show for it.
When he first arrived at Zhenyi City he was already at the fourth level of the
Gang Yuan Realm, but fifty years later, he had only reached the seventh level. Had he stayed in the sect all this time, he would have advanced to the ninth level of the Gang Yuan Realm by now.
Without completing his mission, returning to the sect might even result in punishment. Naturally, Cui Pingyu was not in a good mood, but he also didn’t want to waste any more time; to continue staying in Zhenyi City was just squandering it.
A few days ago, when he went out to clear his mind, he coincidentally encountered Lin Yiyin, saw through her disguise, and was taken by her beauty. He immediately captured and brought her back.
Cui Pingyu did not care for those women of beauty and grace he had taken over the years, having had countless already. But Lin Yiyin was different: her looks and temperament were supreme grade, the most breathtaking he had seen in fifty years.
That’s why he planned to formally take Lin Yiyin as his concubine and then exhaust her charm before moving on.
“I wonder when that Pihai Realm sister of hers will come to save her?” Cui
Pingyu thought, bored..

chapters.title: Chapter 37 - 37 Assassination_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: Assassination_l
Translator: 549690339
After kidnapping Lin Yiyin, Cui Pingyu cautiously probed and discovered that there was no major power behind her, only an old man in a cloak.
Lin Yiyin was disguised as a middle-aged man, Cui Pingyu felt that the person might not be an old man, possibly her brother or sister. After some probing, he confirmed that Lin Yiyin had an older sister, and she was only at the Pihai Realm.
Cui Pingyu thought this was his good fortune, allowing him to capture two peerless beauties as concubines before returning to the Sect, ah, sisters… tsk tsk…
Though he had dallied with many pairs of sisters, he had never seen, let alone played with, peerless sisters like Lin Yiyin.
Cui Pingyu had already decided that once Lin Yiyin’s sister came to rescue her, he would capture her too and forcefully take her as a concubine. One at the Innate Realm, the other at the Pihai Realm, how could they resist him?
If no rescue attempt was made, he would simply take Lin Yiyin back to the Sect. Although it was a pity, Cui Pingyu didn’t want to take any more risks—what if her sister brought a God Refining Realm true person?
The possibility was very small, but Cui Pingyu would never overlook it.
After drinking two more pots of liquor, Cui Pingyu felt somewhat restless, which made his brows furrow and a faint sense of foreboding arose in his heart.
After some thought, he put down the wine pot and strode towards the small courtyard where Lin Yiyin was imprisoned, wanting to see if any thieves had slipped past the guarding Formation to steal her away.
Half a quarter hour earlier.
Han Li, dressed in black with a black cloth covering his face, arrived silently on the roof of a house outside The Cui Manor. Underneath the black cloth was a mature man with a national face.
In a flash, Han Li reached the outside wall of The Cui Manor. The patrolling guards inside and out did not notice him. After careful observation, Han Li’s brows slightly furrowed.
The guardian Formation of The Cui Manor was of the seventh rank, capable of holding off a great master of the Gangyuan Realm for a while. Han Li was only an eighth-rank Formation cultivator, and breaking through this Formation would take a lot of time.
Sighing softly, a bead appeared in his hand, covered with intricate patterns. This was a seventh -rank Formation Breaking Bead he had acquired at a significant expense, which could be used twice and silently break through a seventh – rank Formation.
This bead cost him fifty thousand Lower Grade Spirit Stones, and it would be gone after two uses. Han Li felt the pinch; had he not recently sold a large number of pills and weapons to earn hundreds of thousands of Spirit Stones, he would have been reluctant to purchase it.
Between fifty thousand Spirit Stones and the Lin sisters, Han Li did not hesitate to choose the latter.
A stream of True Yuan infused into the bead—activating it. The power of the Formation enveloped Han Li completely.
He carefully stepped forward, not triggering The Cui Manor’s guardian Formation, then vanished outside the wall with a flicker.
Han Li had already figured out where Lin Yiyin was imprisoned—it wasn’t a secret. But instead of heading to the small courtyard, he lay in wait elsewhere.
This was the inevitable path Cui Pingyu would take from his sleeping chambers to the small courtyard. Cui Pingyu made the trip daily, and Han Li planned to strike here, betting that Cui Pingyu would never expect someone to sneak in
Originally, Han Li intended to act outside The Cui Manor, but after observing for two days, he noticed that the man hadn’t left, uncertain of his activities.
It was just as well to take action inside The Cui Manor. In the event of a battle with Cui Pingyu, even if others came to assist, the Formation would delay them, buying Han Li time to subdue Cui Pingyu.
Running the Breath Concealing Method to its fullest, Han Li lay in wait, ready to strike at any moment, preferably with a single, lethal blow.
Before coming, he had made full preparations and had almost no risk of exposure; otherwise, Han Li would never venture to put his life in danger.
As time ticked away, Han Li suddenly became alert, readying himself—he heard strong, robust footsteps approaching.
Cui Pingyu’s face showed signs of drunkenness, his eyes somewhat blurry, as he strode toward the small courtyard where Lin Yiyin was held, seemingly without a trace of wariness.
In fact, this was just a facade; his mind was very clear. He intentionally showed weakness to baffle the enemies lurking in the shadows, such as Lin Yiwu and a possible Great Master from the Gangyuan Realm.
He was uncertain whether anyone had evaded the formation and lay hidden, but he knew that caution was the parent of safety and that he absolutely must not capsized in a drain.
As he walked, Cui Pingyu’s sense of foreboding grew stronger; the next instant, he suddenly hurled himself to the side.
After Cui Pingyu entered the ambush zone, Han Li didn’t hesitate. True Yuan surged into the furnace in his hand. The mouth of the Body-Cultivating Furnace emitted a brilliant beam of light, which seemed to possess the power to slay gods and exterminate immortals, and in an instant, it struck towards Cui Pingyu.
Although Cui Pingyu sensed it, he had no time to prepare and was forced to hurl himself to the side, trying to dodge the attack.
Boom!
A multitude of rockeries exploded, all the debris was annihilated, and the area was levelled, startling everyone at The Cui Manor, as all the guards quickly rushed towards the commotion.
Such a commotion at The Cui Manor alarmed nearly half of Zhenyi City, drawing the attention of powerhouses from all directions.
The Grandmasters from the city lord’s residence and military barracks had intended to take action, but seeing that the incident involved The Cui Manor, they immediately stayed their hands, even making eye contact with some of the other Grandmasters who were about to go and investigate, indicating that they should not meddle.
They could not find an opportunity to execute Cui Pingyu, but if someone else took on the task, the Daqian Empire would be more than happy to see it done, and just needed to clean up the aftermath.
rlkvvo cultivators who had a good relationship with Cui Pingyu furrowed their brows tightly, but they did not dare go to help, with five or six Grandmasters watching them. The two exchanged glances and heaved a sigh.
Within The Cui Manor,
Han Li still lay in hiding, not pursuing his enemy relentlessly but waiting for the dust to settle, constantly circulating the Sacred Heart Scripture and holding a Divine Sword in his right hand, having pocketed the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
“Cough cough-”
As the dust was nearly clear, a series of coughs rang out, revealing Cui Pingyu’s ashen face.
At this moment, his injuries were severe, blood dripping from the corner of his mouth, his face and body covered in wounds, the most crucial being that his left hand was severed, and his right calf was missing…
After being attacked, he struggled to defend himself but to no avail; he suffered serious injuries. However, he did not tend to his wounds or seek an opportunity to flee but channelled his energy with all his might. If the enemy dared to follow up and chase into the dust, he would strike with full force, hoping to inflict severe injuries on them.
But the enemy was too cunning, not falling for the ruse. Cui Pingyu was infuriated, having been attacked without even seeing the enemy, only Imowing that they hid on the other side.
He wanted to flee, but he dared not, knowing that escaping would give his enemy the opportunity, and that it would undoubtedly lead to his death.
“He’s not dead?” Han Li muttered to himself.
Out of caution, he did not capitalize on his victory but just waited for the outcome, always on the lookout, knowing it wouldn’t be long before the dust dispersed.
The Body-Cultivating Furnace was a Heaven-Level Lower Rank magical treasure, its attacking power equivalent to Earth-Level Lower Rank treasures but still immensely powerful.
This was a weapon that only a Hollow Realm Master could fully activate. Its power was so immense that any cultivator at God -Refining Realm, caught off guard, would perish, or at the very least would be severely injured.
Clearly, Cui Pingyu had some treasure that had blocked the blow, but the treasure had been exhausted, or else he wouldn’t have been injured so gravely.
This situation was also within his plan; Han Li was not surprised. He would only use the Body-Cultivating Furnace once, as using it again might reveal his presence to other Great Masters.
Now, with Cui Pingyu seriously injured and his strength greatly reduced, how could he withstand Grand Ancestor Han at the Peak of Gangyuan Realm?

chapters.title: Chapter 38 - 38 Scapegoat_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: Scapegoat_1
Translator: 549690339
Silence.
“Ahem- Who are you?”
Cui Pingyu stared intently at the person across from him, he could sense someone was there, but they kept holding back, igniting a hateful itch in his teeth.
Despite his grievous injuries, the enemy still lurked, excessively cautious.
“Would the fellow daoist present please come out for a chat?”
“Fellow daoist, we had no grudges in the past and no recent hatred. Why go to the extent of a lethal blow?”
“Fellow daoist… fellow daoist, are you here for Lin Yiyin? I am willing to let her go and compensate with three hundred thousand lower grade Spirit Stones…”
Seeing no response from the enemy, Cui Pingyu had a thought. While secretly healing his wounds to restore his strength, he spoke to steady the person, waiting for backup.
“Fellow daoist, who hired you to kill me? I am willing to pay five times the price…” Cui Pingyu continued, but before he could finish, a sword light slashed toward him.
“Hum!”
The dazzling sword light, like the setting sun, brought forth boundless killing intent, dispersing sword qi in all directions.
Cui Pingyu wanted to buy time, while Han Li intended to lower Cui Pingyu’s guard and strike at the right moment. Who would want to waste words with him?
Old Ancestor Han knew a truth well: villains die from talking too much!
As the sword light came slashing down, Cui Pingyu reacted instantly, his cultivation technique running to its limit. his robust True Yuan auicklv forming a solid barrier to protect him.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The vast sword qi came sweeping through, destroying all in its path, and the True Yuan barrier shattered in less than two breaths, but this bought Cui Pingyu some time.
He formed a seal with his right hand and then slammed it forward, releasing a massive palm seal made of condensed True Yuan. With Yin and Yang energies swirling on it, it destroyed all the sword qi, seemingly possessing the power to annihilate heaven and earth.
One of the supreme skills of the Yinyang Sect: the Yin and Yang Palm Seal!
At the same time, Cui Pingyu didn’t dally any longer. Gritting his teeth, he used another secret technique and his aura exploded, returning him to his peak condition.
He didn’t wait to see the outcome, knowing that the Yin and Yang Palm Seal wouldn’t kill that sixth elder, especially since he had only learned the first half of it, so he immediately fled.
The battle lasted less than two minutes in total. If reinforcements were coming, they would have arrived by now. The lack of any sign meant they either didn’t want to come or couldn’t make it.
If he didn’t escape now, he truly faced death.
At that moment, the sword light flickered again, cutting through the Yin and Yang Palm Seal, and Han Li saw Cui Pingyu making some distance.
Without hesitation, he pursued with his treasured sword in hand, quickly catching up to Cui Pingyu. His sword qi filled the sky, forcing Cui Pingyu into a fight.
Cui Pingyu’s eyes nearly burst with fury. He didn’t want to fight; it cost him his life force every moment, and he realized that even at his peak, he couldn’t defeat this enemy.
Not only was this person’s cultivation and strength higher than his, but they were also extremely sly.
The fight ended quickly; with one sword strike, Han Li ended Cui Pingyu’s life, then collected his Space Ring and immediately vanished from the spot.
This battle shocked all the major forces in Zhenyi City, alarming every Great Master and cultivator of the Pihai Realm. Cui Pingyu, who had bullied Zhenyi City for fifty years, was dead.
Although there were suspicions of a sneak attack, the fact that this person single-handedly killed Cui Pingyu, who was in the late stage of the Gangyuan Realm, was undeniable, and it was done in less time than it takes to drink a cup of tea. Such strength would be at least the eighth or ninth layer of the Gangyuan Realm.
The two Great Masters who had thought about helping sighed; Cui Pingyu had provoked such a powerful Great Master, his death was not undeserved.
By the time two Gangyuan Realm Great Masters from the Daqian Empire arrived, standing above The Cui Manor, Han Li had already vanished without a trace, taking Lin Yiyin with him.
“Very strong!”
This was the conclusion the two Great Masters reached after observing the battlefield.
They already knew the assailant who attacked Cui Pingyu was formidable while watching from afar; now, after a closer inspection, they found him even stronger than they had anticipated.
“Since when did Zhenyi Manor have a nine-layer Gangyuan Realm Master who excels in swordsmanship?” pondered the lord of Zhenyi City.
The general, clad in armor and with a full beard, shook his head and said, “He must be a powerhouse from another prefecture of Leizhou, it’s unclear what Cui Pingyu did to provoke him.”
“He had it coming! I’ve wanted to kill him for a long time,” the city lord sneered coldly. He had always disliked Cui Pingyu but had never dared to take action.
Cui Pingyu had been in Zhenyi City for fifty years, always abiding by the rules, leaving no opportunity for the city lord to make a move. If he were to kill Cui Pingyu rashly, it would openly provoke conflict between the Yinyang Sect and the Daqian Empire, a responsibility he could not bear.
The offenses Cui Pingyu committed in Zhenyi City were all minor; at most, he captured beautiful female cultivators below the Pihai Realm for his own replenishment. He never targeted those with influential backgrounds. Such trivial matters were not enough to trouble a Gangyuan Realm Great Master, but they had truly disgusted the city lord for fifty years.
Now that Cui Pingyu was killed, he clapped his hands in approval. Finally, that fly was dead, and he no longer felt the lump in his throat, nor did he need to keep guarding against the infiltration of the Hehuan Sect.
The general nodded, his face showing a smile as well. As strong forces of the Daqian Empire, they had long wished for Cui Pingyu’s death.
“How shall we wrap this up now?” the general asked the city lord.
The city lord understood his meaning. A late-stage Gangyuan Realm Great Master had died, and the Hehuan Sect would definitely seek an investigation; they had to provide an explanation.
As for their inaction while Cui Pingyu was being killed, what of it? They had no obligation to help!
The Hehuan Sect had no leverage against them, except to make a note of it.
The city lord’s gaze returned to the battlefield, then suddenly paused, a smile forming on his face. “Got it,” he said.
Reaching out, a piece of black cloth fell on him, which the city lord nonchalantly tossed to the general and then left with a hearty laugh.
The general caught it and noticed a white lotus design on the black fabric; he too burst into laughter, clearly understanding the city lord’s plan.
They didn’t care whether the cloth was torn by Cui Pingyu during the battle or deliberately left by that Great Master. It was enough to settle the matter either way.
Blaming the White Lotus Cult would do.
The White Lotus Cult still had a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Mistress of No Birth and a late-stage Hollow Void Stage Dharma King. They were fully capable of killing a late-stage Gangyuan Realm Master, right?
As for why the White Lotus Cult would want to kill Cui Pingyu and what grudges they had, it was not their concern; let them investigate it themselves.
It would be perfect if the White Lotus Cult and the Hehuan Sect were to fight, pulling in the Yinyang Sect and the Mysterious Forces behind the White Lotus Cult into a few large battles, resulting in the death of several immortals, Grandmasters, and Great Grandmasters.
That very night, the news spread, and the entire Zhenyi City was abuzz with it, then it continued to spread throughout Leizhou.
Zhenyi City’s families and powers sighed in relief upon learning of the death of the demonic Cui Pingyu, feeling grateful toward the scapegoated White Lotus Cult, having suffered terribly from Cui Pingyu’s harms yet unable to retaliate. The Hehuan Sect’s secret base in Zhenyi City also received the news, and the person in charge was shocked and immediately hastened to send the message back to the Hehuan Sect, provoking their outrage and alarm.
As time passed, the news reached all the prefectures in Leizhou. They were not particularly concerned with Cui Pingyu’s death but wanted to know whether the White Lotus Cult was responsible.
If it was the White Lotus Cult’s doing, had they already spread to Leizhou?
This caused concern among the prefectures of Leizhou, but before long, they noticed that the official Leizhou response was muted, and they gradually felt at ease.
If the Great Mistress of No Birth and the Dharma King of the White Lotus Cult had truly come to Leizhou, Leizhou’s officials would have been the first to be unsettled and would have already called together the major powers for a joint
suppression..

chapters.title: Chapter 39 - 39 Prince Wu’an of Daqian_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: Prince Wu’an of Daqian_1
Translator: 549690339
Qingzhou, Dianyuan Manor.
There was a very secretive stronghold, where Mother Wusheng and the Dharma King of the White Lotus Cult were hiding.
In Qingzhou and Huozhou, they kept eluding capture, exhausting the pursuing imperial experts. Even with checkpoints set up on the borders, the duo easily escaped.
Both of them were extremely cautious, never staying in one place for more than half a month before switching to another stronghold.
Despite this, they still were hunted time and again by the Daqian Empire, never managing to shake them off, which greatly frustrated Mother Wusheng, as it left her no time to spread her teachings.
Luckily, over the years, their injuries had gradually healed, otherwise their situation would have been even more miserable.
“When did we ever run to Leizhou and kill a Gang Yuan Realm Great Master of the Hehuan Sect?”
Half a year had passed before the two learnt of this news and were completely dumbfounded, as scapegoating was not done this way.
In these past five or six years, they had been so busy fleeing that they had never been to Leizhou, so how could they possibly have attacked Cui Pingyu? It was definitely a setup.
Yet both knew they were marked for blame and had no way to explain it, nor did they dare to show themselves to clear their names, but instead held a deep resentment in their hearts.
If they ever encountered the real culprit, they were determined to crush them effortlessly, to vent their pent-up fury.
Huozhou, Province City.
At this moment, a group of high-ranking figures were gathered here, whispering amongst themselves and occasionally looking in the direction of the Capital City, as if they were awaiting some important personage.
Among those waiting were the Protector General of Sanzhou Wan Guiyuan, Yang Tianxiong—one of the four Supervisors of Jingye Office, and the Protector Generals of Huozhou, Qingzhou, and Leizhou, along with several Hollow Sect Grandmasters.
“Brother Wan, this time, you and I have truly lost face,” said Supervisor Yang Tianxiong with a bitter tone in his voice.
Protector General Wan Guiyuan wore a similar expression, as if he had swallowed a bitter pill.
The two mid -stage Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters, together with three Hollow Void Stage Grandmasters, had been hunting Mother Wusheng for six years. Although they had injured her severely on numerous occasions, they never managed to capture her; she always slipped away.
Keep in mind that Mother Wusheng was only at the beginning stage of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, far weaker than either of them. Their inability to eradicate the remnants of the White Lotus Cult had utterly humiliated them both.
Now the entire Daqian Empire knew of their repeated defeats at Mother Wusheng’s hands. Many powerful figures watched as though it were a spectacle, while Emperor Qian was furious beyond measure.
Having failed to eradicate the remnants of the White Lotus Cult in six years had shamed the Daqian Empire throughout the entire Xuan Domain, even spreading to other regions, damaging the empire’s influence.
Unable to eliminate the small White Lotus Cult, how could the Daqian Empire claim any strength? Could it possibly be hollow and frail inside?
Some Xuan Domain powerhouses who had initially restrained themselves were becoming restless again, but they still needed the right moment to unveil the facade concealing the true foundations of the Daqian Empire, and a new storm was brewing.
At such a juncture, the Kurong Sect, the Yinyang Sect, and even the archenemy of the Daqian Empire, the Da Jing Dynasty, showed no significant activity.
The White Lotus Cult was merely a pawn. Behind them was a mysterious force far more powerful than both empires and the two major sects.
If they were to confront the Daqian Empire first, wouldn’t they be cannon fodder for that mysterious force, allowing it to reap the benefits of the aftermath?
Amidst internal and external troubles, Emperor Qian heeded the advice of the current Grand Tutor and sent the capable and highly skilled Prince Wu’an to oversee the annihilation of the White Lotus Cult’s remnants.
“Here they come.”
Suddenly, Wan Guiyuan, Yang Tianxiong, and the others startled, without further discussion, they turned their gaze toward the distance.
A chariot was blazing across the sky; four extraordinary hybrid sea horses were pulling it, each at the God Refining Realm’s cultivation level, highlighting the mighty and domineering nature of the chariot’s owner.
As the chariot approached and landed in front of the city, an extremely strong aura swept over, causing Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong to frown slightly, but they said nothing, while the several Hollow Realm Masters behind them inwardly groaned.
At that moment, the overwhelming presence retracted, and a tall and valiant young man stepped out from the golden chariot, his features handsome, with sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes, a full Heavenly Court, his stride forceful and his demeanor embodying both dominance and dignity.
“Greetings to Prince Wu’an!”
A crowd of powerful individuals bowed respectfully, only Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, the two Great Grandmasters, nodded slightly.
Prince Wu’an, Chu Hao, nodded slightly in return and gave a special glance to the two Great Grandmasters before saying, “Gentlemen, please rise.” Afterward, several Great Grandmasters and Grandmasters followed Prince Wu’an into Huozhou City.
Meanwhile, Han Li quietly returned to Lingjun City with Lin Yiyin, as if they had never left.
Lin Yiwu was still dressed as an old man, while Lin Yiyin wore the attire of a middle-aged person. Han Li handed Lin Yiyin over to Lin Yiwu, instructing the two women to get changed before coming to see him.
Han Li then went back to his sleeping chamber, put back the Body-Cultivating Furnace, and began to review the rescue operation.
According to the plan, he would disguise himself to visit other manors to purchase thorough intelligence on Cui Pingyu from Tianji Pavilion, ascertain his current cultivation level, observe the situation in Zhenyi City, and look for an opportunity to strike;
If Cui Pingyu did not venture out, he would buy a seventh-rank Formation Breaking Bead, find out where Lin Yiyin was detained, and then set an ambush halfway through;
He would initiate the first strike with the Body-Cultivating Furnace, and if that failed to kill, he would then engage in battle using the Collapsing Sun Sword Technique to eliminate his target, being careful not to reveal any martial skills he had already used.
After the deed, he would erase all traces of his own presence, intentionally leave behind a piece of black cloth with a white lotus pattern to provide the
Daqian Empire with an explanation, and increase the difficulty for the Hehuan Sect to pursue the investigation.
Throughout the plan, Han Li wore a human skin mask, with another disguised face beneath it. Thanks to his cultivation at the peak of the Gangyuan Realm, even if a Great Master discovered he was wearing a mask, they wouldn’t be able to see his true face.
If any part of the plan went awry, increasing the risk, Han Li would consider whether to continue with the operation, but he definitely couldn’t be reckless.
The progression of events followed his plan almost exactly; having killed Cui Pingyu and taken Lin Yiyin, Han Li also heard the news coming from Zhenyi City.
Cui Pingyu was killed by the White Lotus Cult. The city lord’s mansion immediately dispatched troops to pursue and eradicate all strongholds of the White Lotus Cult (Hehuan Sect) to ensure local security.
Han Li then changed his appearance once more and went to Tianji Pavilion to buy intelligence related to the incident, only to discover that even Tianji Pavilion did not know who had killed Cui Pingyu.
He breathed a sigh of relief, but a shred of worry lingered in his heart. Legend had it that Tianji Pavilion possessed powerful experts capable of deducing heavenly secrets, and much of their top-secret intelligence was obtained in this way.
If the Hehuan Sect took him seriously enough to spend a lot of money asking Tianji Pavilion to divine the identity of the killer, could they trace it back to him?
Han Li didn’t know.
But he knew that even if Hehuan Sect did do this, it would be a considerable time later. The sect would first conduct its own investigation and, only if they failed to find any leads and were willing to pay a significant price, might they possibly trace the murderer back to him.
All he needed to do was to continue to cultivate in peace, strive to break through to the Hollow Void Stage, and then the Hehuan Sect would pose little threat to him.
At this moment, a maid came to report from outside the hall, stating that the sisters Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin had already dressed up and were waiting for their next instructions..

chapters.title: Chapter 40 - 40 1 am willing_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: 1 am willing_1
Translator: 549690339
“So soon?”
Han Li was slightly startled and realized that the review had taken quite a bit of time, so he said, “Bring them over, never mind, take them to Fragrance Garden.”
Although Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin were nominally his concubines, they had not yet been married into the family, and there hadn’t been a formal meeting. A direct meeting in his bedroom would be inappropriate and could make them feel disrespected.
Han Li was curious, as the previous appearances of Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin were all disguises, so just how stunning must their true appearances be?
At the same time, Han Li was also curious as to why the two sisters had not joined a Sect.
He could tell that the sisters were young, with one at the early stage of the Pihai Realm and the other at the later stage of the Innate Realm; their cultivation talent must be at least seventh-grade.
With such cultivation talent, they would have more than qualified to join the Leizhou Sects like Tianxuan Mountain, which meant there must be some hidden story.
Fragrance Garden.
This was one of the three gardens built after the Han Family’s expansion. It featured three artistic styles and was not small in size, containing many buildings.
Fragrance Garden used water as its centerpiece, with mountains and water intertwining, exquisite halls and pavilions, and lush flowers and trees, exuding a rich literary temperament. It was one of Han Li’s favorite places to spend time.
As he walked over, from afar he saw two stunning beauties leaning in Begonia Pavilion, admiring the landscape, occasionally whispering and sharing in hushed tones.
The beauty on the left was dressed in fluttering purple garments, her figure graceful and tall, her skin creamy, her features picturesque, her eyes like autumn waters, as if a Heavenly Immortal had descended to earth.
Her lips were thin, corners slightly upturned with a hint of a melancholy smile.
Her voice was cool and soft, irresistibly drawing people in; her appearance was so radiant that she seemed to outshine pearls and make jade grow dull, possessing an unparalleled elegance.
The beauty on the right was no less stunning, like spring orchids and autumn chrysanthemums, each with its unique charm.
She was dressed in a yellow palace skirt, her pupils like jewels, her cheeks round and luminous, her brows curved, her nose pert and high, her black hair falling naturally, soft and sleek, her beauty beyond compare.
Her skin was smooth and flawless, her demeanor cute and naive, gentle and well-behaved. She radiated a faint fragrance, her figure truly that of a “wet nurse.”
Hearing footsteps, Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin both looked towards the entrance of the Fragrance Garden and saw Han Li, dressed in brocade and looking handsome and refined, approaching.
Lin Yiwu pursed her lips, looking at the approaching figure without speaking, her expression somewhat complex.
“Sister.”
“It was this brother who rescued me. We talked quite a bit on the way, he’s knowledgeable and can discuss anything at length.”
Lin Yiyin extended her delicate, jade-like hand to tug at Lin Yiwu’s sleeve, her face showing excitement with a naive expression.
“Hmm.”
Lin Yiwu replied coolly, wondering how to tell her sister that they both had become this man’s concubines.
Lin Yiwu was incredibly shocked by Han Li’s strength. Although she had requested Han Li’s help to rescue Lin Yiyin, she hadn’t held much hope.
After all, Cui Pingyu was a Great Master at the later stage of the Gangyuan Realm, notorious with many victories to his name. And Han Li? He was practically unknown, with the outside world unaware that he was a Great Master of the Gangyuan Realm.
But she had no other choice. Asking Han Li for help offered a glimmer of hope; otherwise, Lin Yiyin’s fate would be miserable and her life wouldn’t be long.
Han Li’s demand was outrageous, wanting both sisters to marry him as concubines. After much consideration, Lin Yiwu still agreed.
Whether he could marry both sisters depended on whether Han Li was fortunate enough. If he failed to rescue Lin Yiyin, he would at best be gravely injured, or at worst, dead. Then she would have to leave the Han Mansion and devote herself to cultivation, seeking revenge for her sister in the future.
To her surprise, Han Li had truly succeeded and even killed Cui Pingyu without exposing his identity, pinning the blame on the head of the White Lotus Cult.
Was he really a Great Master at the Peak of the Gangyuan Realm? Had it all been an act before?
Thinking that the outside world was spreading that the old ancestor of the Han Family was merely at the fifth level of the Pihai Realm when he actually was at the peak of the Gangyuan Realm, Lin Yiwu felt she had guessed the truth.
Han Li was too low-profile, and his talent was also very good, the alleged last-minute breakthrough due to poor talent was all a ruse Han Li deliberately displayed to the outside world.
“Are you two settling in well here?”
Arriving at the Begonia Pavilion and looking at the two peerless beauties within reach, a gentle smile appeared on Han Li’s face.
Glancing at Lin Yiwu, Han Li naturally knew of her little schemes; he also had confidence, well, a ninety percent certainty before he went to rescue them. If any unexpected variables arose, he would not care too much and would simply run away.
Even if Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin were sisters, and even if they would become his concubines after the success of their plan, even if they both had great cultivation talent, and beauty unmatched…
Yet none of these compared to his own life.
Going through hell and high water for a goddess, doing all sorts of dirty and tiring work, risking life and limb, various styles of bootlicking, and even risking one’s own life—Han Li claimed he couldn’t do that, as he always put himself first.
He had ambitions too; since this world offered eternal life and he possessed a golden finger, then he wanted to stand at the pinnacle of this world, to live a long and eternal life, forever immortal.
Without invincible power, he naturally couldn’t afford to take risks lightly—for death would make everything naught; without invincible power, as long as he lived long enough, he could outlive those supreme beings, and in the end, it would still be him standing at the peak.
Under normal circumstances, he would stay in Lingjun City and wouldn’t venture out recklessly, unless the benefits were substantial and there was a great chance of success, or else Han Li would resolutely stay at home and never take the risk.
Lin Yiwu was somewhat reserved. Before she could speak, Lin Yiyin started chattering nonstop, not treating Han Li as an outsider.
“It’s quite nice here.”
“There are people to serve us, it’s been many years since we’ve had that, and those maids and guards are all very polite to us.”
“Compared to the Cui Manor, this place is like a prison; not free at all, and there was no one to talk to.”
“Your Han Mansion is really big, housing many people, and the scenery is quite nice too…”
Lin Yiwu pursed her lips, not speaking. She was somewhat worried that her sister couldn’t accept all this.
But now they had no choice. Han Li had taken a risk to rescue Lin Yiyin, and it was time for them to fulfill their promise, or else they would seriously offend a Great Master at the peak of Gangyuan Realm.
Would Han Li let them leave?
Lin Yiwu thought it impossible. Putting herself in his shoes, if she were Han Li, she wouldn’t agree either.
“If you were to stay here in the future, would you be willing?”
Looking at her delicate and lovely face, displaying an innocent charm, Han Li asked with a smile.
Han Li felt he was quite democratic, asking for their opinions. As for whether he would agree, was that important?
Lin Yiyin’s little head tilted as she blinked and said, “I’m willing.”
“But you have to protect me and my sister well. I don’t want us sisters to experience our past lives again.”
Lin Yiwu’s delicate body trembled, she glanced at Lin Yiyin, then turned her head to the side, tears glistening in her eyes.
Lin Yiyin reached out to hold Lin Yiwu’s hand tightly, not saying a word.
Though Lin Yiwu didn’t say it, Lin Yiyin was not stupid; she had long guessed that Lin Yiwu must have agreed to some conditions from Han Li.
Otherwise, why would Han Li, a stranger, risk the danger of offending a late-stage Gangyuan Realm Great Master to rescue her?
She and her sister relied on each other. Her sister didn’t know any Great Masters before, so Han Li was probably someone her sister met by chance at some Loose Cultivator gathering.
Compared to the disgusting Cui Pingyu, Lin Yiyin preferred to be with Han Li, at the very least Han Li was good-looking, powerful, and could protect her and her sister..

chapters.title: Chapter 41 - 41 Origin_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: Origin_l
Translator: 549690339
Han Li looked at Lin Yiyin with surprise, which refreshed his impression of her as a naive and adorable girl.
It seemed that after years of harsh experiences in the Cultivation Realm, Lin Yiyin had grown a lot. Although she still looked cute and naive on the outside, she was clear-headed inside.
“Of course,” Han Li solemnly promised, looking at the stunning sister duo.
“Then we’ll trust you,” Lin Yiyin said with an innocent look that revealed two small dimples on her face.
Glancing at Lin Yiwu, Han Li thought for a moment before saying, “With me, you don’t need to restrain yourself in any way, feel free to ask for anything you need.”
“You’ll find that staying in Han Mansion is a very fortunate thing,” he added.
“I understand,” Lin Yiwu met Han Li’s gaze and nodded.
Since Lin Yiyin had no objections, she had none either. Having been cautious and vigilant during their years on the run, she was tired of it and the idea of having someone to rely on seemed quite nice.
Despite Han Li’s reputation for being a flirt, his reputation was very good, so she wasn’t worried about them being wronged in Han Mansion.
“Then let’s go for a walk, and you can tell me about your past. If it’s inconvenient, you don’t have to talk about it,” he suggested.
After that, Han Li walked with Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin in Fragrance Garden, enjoying the scenery and learning about the sisters’ past.
The sisters were born into a powerful cultivation family in Yuanzhou. When they were very young, their family faced a calamitous incident and was annihilated.
The two sisters were saved by several loyal guards and fled all the way to Leizhou to settle down. In the end, only one guard was left, having sacrificed everything else just to steer clear of the enemy’s attempt to utterly eradicate them.
When Lin Yiwu was eighteen and Lin Yiyin was seventeen, the remaining female guard went out to search for cultivation resources and was killed. The enemies even found their residence and intended to disgrace the sisters.
Luckily, Lin Yiwu was smart and sensed the danger early. She took Lin Yiyin and fled, and since then, the two of them had led a difficult and nomadic life.
Being beautiful teenagers who were quite stunning and also sisters, naturally, they drew the covetous gazes of countless men, especially since they possessed low cultivation levels.
But Lin Yiwu resolved all these dangers, protecting her sister through hardships and cultivation. To avoid trouble, they even wore human skin masks, not daring to show their true faces.
Having come this far, Lin Yiyin was previously captured by Cui Pingyu, a Great Master. Their journey was incredibly arduous, but Lin Yiwu casually glossed over these details, not wishing to dwell on them too much.
Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin were both under thirty years of age, and the passing years hadn’t left any marks on their faces; they still looked like young girls in bloom. This was related to their talents.
Lin Yiwu had a fifth-grade aptitude, and Lin Yiyin was slightly lower with a sixth-grade aptitude. Even without joining a Sect, relying on their family’s cultivation techniques, they managed to cultivate to the first layer of the Pihai Realm and the eighth layer of the Innate Realm, respectively.
Of course, this was related to their initial guidance from a late-stage Pihai Realm guard, who continuously provided them with cultivation resources. Without that guard’s help, even with their good talents, their current cultivation levels would have been lower.
The reason they hadn’t joined a major Sect was related to the enemy responsible for their family’s demise.
Yuanzhou was the heart of the Daqian Empire, with the Imperial Capital located there, and it was where the most and the strongest powers of the Qian Dynasty were situated.
The Lin Family in Yuanzhou could only be considered a small clan. They used to have a Hollow Realm Master preside over them, but it had been several hundred years since a Guru in the Void Realm had emerged.
The destruction of the Lin Family was not the work of some great sect but rather the Daqian State Preceptor, specifically his third disciple, Yu Chengkong, a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage.
The beauty of the sisters was matchless and captivating, a trait inherited from their mother who, in her life, was a peerless beauty known far and wide, truly a supremely mature and beautiful woman.
While carrying out his duties, Yu Chengkong happened to pass through the city where the Lin Family resided and caught sight of Mrs. Lin. He was immediately struck by her divine beauty and lusted after her.
After inquiring about Mrs. Lin and learning that she was a married woman, Yu Chengkong grew even more interested and went directly to the Lin Mansion, demanding that the head of the Lin Family hand her over to him as a
concubine, assuring that he would take good care of her.
The head of the Lin Family was immediately enraged; this scoundrel was too outrageous. Naturally, he was unwilling to give away his wife, and he didn’t want to lay eyes on Yu Chengkong ever again, briskly showing him the door.
Yu Chengkong was rebuffed, but he didn’t directly take action. With his strength at the Hollow Void Stage, obliterating the Lin Family would hardly be difficult, but he had some reservations about recklessly triggering the laws of the Daqian Empire.
He kept this incident in mind and returned to the Imperial Capital where he checked the Lin Family’s information and found that they had three Longevity Treasures which could be processed into life-extending elixirs.
The Lin Family had hidden these treasures well. Had Yu Chengkong not spent a great price to obtain detailed information from the Tianji Pavilion, he would never have uncovered this secret.
Yu Chengkong immediately went to his master, the Daqian National Teacher, and reported this news. The National Teacher knew he had ulterior motives but didn’t care; he instructed Yu Chengkong to bring back the three Longevity Treasures, no matter the means.
With the National Teacher’s approval, Yu Chengkong felt emboldened, assembled some men, and immediately set out for the Lin Mansion.
The Lin Family was in the midst of preparing to move away to a distant place to avoid any trouble from Yu Chengkong, but they hadn’t expected him to arrive so soon.
With no more reservations, Yu Chengkong took action, slaughtering the strong members of the Lin Family. The Lin Family had dared to offend him; they were courting death!
Had they handed over Mrs. Lin when he initially visited, he would have looked after the Lin Family. Now, he would only exterminate them before taking away Mrs. Lin and the three Longevity Treasures.
The head of the Lin Family, at the God Refining Realm, wielding an Earth-Level Lower Rank Treasure to fight Yu Chengkong, was no match and could only desperately hold on, buying time for his family to escape.
In the face of certain doom, Mrs. Lin did not run away. Knowing she had brought great misfortune upon the Lin Family, she instructed her guard to take her two daughters and flee, then with a mournful smile, she took her own life.
With Mrs. Lin’s death, the head of the Lin Family fought with reckless abandon, using a life-draining secret technique to boost his power dramatically, and he actually managed to entangle Yu Chengkong.
Yu Chengkong was also furious. He had come for Mrs. Lin and now she was dead, which he greatly regretted. Enraged, he struck the head of the Lin Family with full force, putting him to death.
He then ordered his men to chase down and exterminate the members of the Lin Family, leaving no survivors, while he searched for the three Longevity Treasures.
The Longevity Treasures were of utmost importance; he had to find them and take them back. He could not afford to let the Lin Family members escape with them amidst the chaos, or he would not be able to explain himself upon his return.
If he brought back the Longevity Treasures, with the State Preceptor backing him, obliterating the small Lin Family wouldn’t provoke any harsh reaction from the court. However, if he failed to bring them, he feared for his life and risked being thrown into the dungeon, even if he did not die.
He knew his master’s temperament well. Having used the State Preceptor for his benefits, he wouldn’t receive help if he didn’t bring back what his master desired.
Under Yu Chengkong’s relentless pursuit, nearly all the Lin Family members were wiped out, save for a Pihai Realm female guard who miraculously escaped with the two sisters, hiding in Leizhou without daring to reveal their identities.
When Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin grew up, the female guard repeatedly cautioned them never to reveal their identity, not to think about joining a sect, cultivating to become stronger, and then seeking revenge, as there was no hope in that.
When joining a sect, the sect would investigate the disciples’ backgrounds, with the larger sects placing a great emphasis on this, to avoid infiltration by spies. Only those of clear heritage would be accepted into the sect..

chapters.title: Chapter 42 - 42 The Heritage of the Daqian Empire_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: The Heritage of the Daqian Empire_l
Translator: 549690339
The sisters have good aptitude, with important cultivation prospects—one may reach the Hollow Void Stage, the other the God Refining Realm—which is very significant for a major sect in a state.
Even a Leizhou Sect like Tianxuan Mountain only has one Guru in the Hollow Void Realm and a few in the God Refining Realm.
Under normal circumstances, with the sisters’ aptitude, sects would definitely compete to take them as disciples and list them for focused cultivation as core disciples.
But the situation of the sisters is abnormal.
Their enemy is the Daqian National Teacher!
The Daqian National Teacher, a late-stage Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, has stood at the pinnacle of the Qian Dynasty for over four hundred years, with a reputation that resounds powerfully, overwhelming authority, and having assisted two generations of Emperor Qian, is one of the true powerholders of the Qian Dynasty.
The Daqian National Teacher, skilled in scheming and ruthless in action, frequently annihilates entire families. Though he has many enemies, he has always firmly stood due to the profound trust of Emperor Qian and his unfathomable strength.
If any sect dares to recruit the enemies of the Daqian National Teacher into their ranks, it won’t be long before it is annihilated—there are precedents for this.
While recruiting the sisters could bring a grandmaster and a real person to the sect in the future, the two women would need over a hundred years to grow. If their identity gets exposed during this period, it could lead to the sect’s destruction.
As for how to make such a choice, the decision-makers of the sects are very clear-headed.
If the sisters attempt to join a sect, there is a high probability that they will be detained and then handed over to the National Teacher’s faction to curry favor with the Daqian National Teacher and receive his rewards.
Let alone ordinary sects, even the Ten Major Sects are extremely cautious of the Daqian National Teacher and dare not provoke him lightly.
The Qian Dynasty has the power to suppress all directions, and no sect dares to rebel—naturally, their strength is far too dominant, and the Ten Major Sects are not on the same level as the Qian Dynasty.
In the eighteen states of the Qian Dynasty, there are six Jiedushi, each a Great Grandmaster; there’s one Head Supervisor and four Grand Internal Supervisors in the Jingye Office tasked with overseeing the land, all Great Grandmasters; four main pillars of the country, two Great Generals, Prince Wu’an, the Grand Tutor, the State Preceptor, the Grand Internal Supervisor, and others are all Great Grandmasters.
The Imperial Astronomer has three Great Grandmasters, and even Emperor Qian is himself a Great Grandmaster; these are just the known figures, how many more are hidden is anyone’s guess.
At least twenty-five known Great Grandmasters on the surface, and there are definitely concealed Great Grandmasters in the shadows, not to mention Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm.
Among the Ten Major Sects, there are only one or two Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and no matter how secretly they hide, at most there would be three Great Grandmasters. How could they compare with the Qian Dynasty?
All combined, they do not have as many publicly known Great Grandmasters as the Qian Dynasty!
Only the top-tier forces such as the Kurong Sect, Yinyang Sect, and Da Jing Dynasty among the Eight Great Forces of the Mysterious Region can contend with the Qian Dynasty, and they dare not act rashly.
Their foundations may be stronger than those of the Qian Dynasty, but they are not confident to directly engulf it. Even if they could, it would be a pyrrhic victory, serving as a bridal gown for other forces.
The sisters have also considered leaving the Qian Dynasty for other forces’ territories, but they have many concerns, mainly that their cultivation levels are too low.
Within the Fragrance Garden.
After listening to the sisters’ story, Han Li got momentarily lost in thought.
Returning to his senses, he found the sisters looking at him with eager eyes.
Han Li knew the reason and said with a very solemn tone, “Rest assured, in my care, I will protect you completely.”
As he spoke, Han Li even reached out to ruffle Lin Yiyin’s hair, causing her to roll her eyes. Lin Yiwu also glared at Han Li.
With that, the sisters felt much more at ease. In fact, they weren’t very worried about the Daqian National Teacher. They were negligible to him, and as long as they didn’t publicize it deliberately, the Daqian National Teacher couldn’t be bothered to deal with them.
When the Lin Family was annihilated and they fled Yuanzhou, they were only four or five years old. Now they were almost thirty, and their appearances had changed greatly. No one knew their origin, and as long as they didn’t reveal themselves, they wouldn’t provoke the wrath of the Daqian National Teacher.
Now that they reside in the Han Family, with the protective presence of Han Li, a Great Master at the peak of the Gangyuan Realm, sheltering them thoroughly was quite easy. The sisters had been adrift for many years and just wanted to settle down but had never found a reliable person to trust.
The three of them wandered around the Fragrance Garden for a while longer, and it wasn’t until they were about to leave that Han Li said, “I shall make good preparations, and in some time, I’ll come to wed you sisters.”
It was only after Han Li’s figure vanished that Lin Yiyin snapped back to reality, blinking her gem-like eyes in surprise, she coughed and said, “Cough cough- Sister, did I hear that right? He said he would come to wed us in some time?”
She had guessed that her sister had agreed to some conditions with Han Li and even thought that her sister might marry Han Li, but she didn’t expect this.
Lin Yiwu nodded slightly, managing a bitter smile and said, “It’s too late for regrets now. ”
“Regret? Why should we regret?”
“I think it’s quite nice, in this way we sisters can always be together and never part.”
“Sisters should come in pairs, right? This way Han Li will treat us even better in the future.”
Lin Yiyin took her sister’s hand, speaking softly.
In the past, it was always her sister who sacrificed for her, guiding her through cultivation and survival; she was just a little drag. But now, she could also help her sister.
“Mhm-,” Lin Yiyin nodded emphatically.
Fengyang Manor, Fengyang City.
A silver-haired female sword saint and a black-clothed sorceress walked out of Tianji Pavilion, one behind the other, heading toward the inn.
The sword saint had a graceful figure and autumn-water-like eyes, her silver hair danced in the air, unrivaled in her coldness; while the sorceress in leather was curvaceous and seductively enchanting, her black hair fluttering.
These two people were none other than Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi.
Several months ago, the two met while tracking down clues, entangled in a skirmish, and then parted ways again.
To obstruct Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye secretly passed on information about her to Tianxuan Mountain, which indeed caused Yun Miaoyi a lot of trouble.
Tianxuan Mountain originally had a prodigious disciple, Jiang Cheng, with sixth-grade aptitude. He was a key nurturing target, and if nothing unexpected happened, it was almost certain he would reach the God Refining Realm. If Tianxuan Mountain was willing to incur a great cost, or if Jiang Cheng encountered some incredible fortune outside, he even had the chance to ascend to the level of a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage.
However, this genius disciple of Tianxuan Mountain who ranked among the top three met with ruin at the hands of a Hehuan Sect enchantress, squandering a century of potential, and to this day, is still trapped at the peak of the Pihai Realm.
Under normal cultivation, Jiang Cheng should have at least been at the peak of the Gangyuan Realm by now, or even ascended to be a true person in the God Refining Realm.
The very same Hehuan Sect enchantress that ruined Jiang Cheng was Yun Miaoyi, who had played him for a fool. He was utterly infatuated with her, deeply ensnared by love, yet he had never laid a finger on her.
Yun Miaoyi harbored great ambitions, and even though she was part of the Hehuan Sect, known for dual cultivation and harvesting energy from others, she kept herself chaste and never dared to lose her virginity.
She aimed to rise above the Hehuan Sect and join the Yinyang Sect, whose main cultivation technique required one to remain a virgin until the God Refining Realm; the Hehuan Sect was a branch that had strayed from the right path.
After retrieving the love seed from Jiang Cheng, Yun Miaoyi’s power surged, enabling her to break through directly to the Gangyuan Realm; with the credit of ruining Tianxuan Mountain’s prodigious disciple, the Hehuan Sect granted her a generous reward.
After putting forth all her efforts, Yun Miaoyi finally managed to ascend to the Yinyang Sect and after many years of cultivation, broke through to become a true person in the God Refining Realm.
Tianxuan Mountain had always wanted to cause trouble for Yun Miaoyi, but after ruining Jiang Cheng, she stayed put in the Hehuan Sect and then ran off to the Yinyang Sect, without returning, thus eluding them.
Upon receiving the news, Jiang Cheng’s master, a late-stage real person in the
God Refining Realm, took up his sword and charged forth, scouring Fengyang Manor for Yun Miaoyi’s traces. He cornered her several times, inflicting severe injuries, but in the end, she still managed to escape..

chapters.title: Chapter 43 - 43 Intelligence_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Intelligence_l
Translator: 549690339
Yun Miaoyi was as perceptive as they come, and she guessed right away that the news must have been leaked by Jiang Baiye.
She had come to track down the Body-Cultivating Furnace, and the only person who had seen her was Jiang Baiye, who also had plenty of motive to do so.
If Yun Miaoyi were being hunted by the real experts of Tianxuan Mountain, where would she find the time to hunt for the Body-Cultivating Furnace?
After escaping another pursuit from Tianxuan Mountain, Yun Miaoyi went directly to Jiang Baiye to inquire; Jiang Baiye did not bother to deny it, prompting Yun Miaoyi to clench her teeth in anger, though she was powerless against Jiang Baiye.
Hunted for several months, she was in quite a sorry state, while that woman Jiang Baiye wandered around like a female sword immortal. Yun Miaoyi was utterly frustrated and decided to simply follow Jiang Baiye.
Wasn’t Jiang Baiye looking for the Body-Cultivating Furnace? Wasn’t she trying to cause trouble for her? Then, Yun Miaoyi thought, she might as well follow Jiang Baiye.
If Jiang Baiye found traces of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, it would be the same as her finding it, thus saving her a lot of effort.
This placed Jiang Baiye in quite the dilemma, as if she continued to reveal Yun Miaoyi’s whereabouts, the real experts from Tianxuan Mountain would come and demand that she confront Yun Miaoyi alongside them, certainly making an issue out of Yun Miaoyi’s identity.
If she refused, Tianxuan Mountain might accuse her of colluding with the witch of the Yinyang Sect, which would impact the Canghai Sect as well.
With the loss of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the Canghai Sect was already in difficulty. If the Daqian Empire were to use this as an excuse, the sect could face further repression.
After a moment of internal struggle, Jiang Baiye consented; if they truly found the Body-Cultivating Furnace, there would be time to take action then.
This matter concerned the life and death of the sect, so if Yun Miaoyi insisted on intervening, Jiang Baiye would have no choice but to join forces with the real experts of Tianxuan Mountain to eliminate Yun Miaoyi.
“How did it go? Was it that old concubine-taking ancestor who made a move?”
Upon returning to the inn, Yun Miaoyi entered Jiang Baiye’s room, casually sat on the bed, and displayed her beautiful figure with a charm that was hard to ignore.
Months had passed, and she herself had made no headway, weary from dodging her pursuers. It was as if she was either being hunted or on the run from being hunted, yet she had never considered giving up and returning to the Yinyang Sect.
Jiang Baiye ignored Yun Miaoyi’s alluring figure and the expanse of snowy white skin that was revealed and did not respond to her question, just furrowed her brow in concern.
More than four months ago, Lu Renbin’s trail had gone cold at the first battleground.
In the months that followed, she had conducted thorough investigations and could confirm that Lu Renbin had not left Fengyang Manor, and no other manors reported any traces of him.
She had identified the identities of the seven Loose Cultivators who had died on the first battlefield, all of whom had attended the Loose Cultivator assembly. She had tracked almost everyone who attended the assembly and confirmed that Lu Renbin had been there, albeit inconspicuous, leaving a faint impression on everyone.
As for what Lu Renbin did after the Loose Cultivator assembly, whether he had gone to ambush Han Li, the Loose Cultivators claimed they had no idea.
The two Loose Cultivators who had attempted to ambush Han Li but fled midway were also sought out by Jiang Baiye for questioning. Both said they did not see Lu Renbin follow and were clueless about whether Lu Renbin had attempted to ambush Han Li.
Jiang Baiye had long heard about the fake news released by Han Li and had even personally approached Li Deshun to confirm it, asking about Han Li’s strength and whether he had seen Lu Renbin, if Lu Renbin had secretly tried to assassinate Han Li…
