As one of the only two survivors from that assassination attempt, Li Deshun certainly had the authority to speak.
Remembering that Han Li had also asked him if he had seen anyone, Li Deshun had a hunch that the Lu Renbin whom Jiang Baiye was searching for might be related to Han Li.
Considering that Han Li had not killed him to silence him over this matter last time, and considering that he still hoped to obtain a Lifespan Extension Pill from Han Li, Li Deshun eventually decided not to mention Han Li’s inquiries and merely acknowledged that the Loose Cultivators were those that he had helped Han Li subdue.
As for that Lu Renbin, he indeed did not see him follow to ambush Han Li.
Jiang Baiye did not make things difficult for Li Deshun, and she left The Li Manor, but doubts lingered in her mind.
The red-robed Loose Cultivator had been killed with a single palm strike, while the other six Loose Cultivators had been shot to death with archery. From what she observed, Li Deshun was skilled with the spear.
After a visit to the Tianji Pavilion, Jiang Baiye purchased information about
Han Li and Li Deshun.
According to the intelligence records, Li Deshun’s cultivation reached the seventh level of the Pihai Realm, and he excels in spear techniques. The most recent report was of Li Deshun collaborating with Han Li to suppress and kill seven Pihai Realm Loose Cultivators.
However, the intelligence on Han Li is rather interesting.
This individual is not a Loose Cultivator but an Inner Sect Disciple of Tianxuan Mountain. Decades ago, due to impaired aptitude, he was unable to advance to the Pihai Realm. He descended the mountain and returned to Lingjun City to spread his branches and leaves.
At the age of 195, he broke through to the Pihai Realm. His aptitude was suspected to have been restored, even improved, by an unexpected encounter.
In less than twenty years, he had cultivated to the fifth level of the Pihai Realm.
Han Li stays in Lingjun City all year round, avoiding conflicts and the competition for resources, with a distinct fondness for taking concubines.
Particularly infatuated with women, he preferred taking concubines. Before reaching the Pihai Realm, he had taken six junior wives. After his breakthrough, he madly added to his harem, taking more than twenty in nearly twenty years.
In these twenty years, Han Li left Lingjun City twice, once to leave Fengyang Manor and return to Tianxuan Mountain, and another time to attend a Loose Cultivator gathering.
Han Li was skilled in saber techniques and step techniques, but this intelligence was from eighty years ago, before he left Tianxuan Mountain. After descending, Han Li had almost never engaged in combat.
This is the part that vexes Jiang Baiye.
Han Li and Li Deshun both lack skill in palm techniques and archery, yet those Loose Cultivators were killed with palm techniques and archery. There’s definitely something amiss with these two.
She had met Li Deshun, who truly possessed only the seventh level cultivation of the Pihai Realm and was proficient in spear techniques. Consequently, it is very likely that the issue lies with Han Li.
In these seventy-plus years, he must have re-cultivated some powerful palm or archery techniques, possibly linked to his mysterious encounter, making it a significant possibility that Lu Renbin went to assassinate him.
Before attending that Loose Cultivator gathering, Han Li did not expose his fifth-level Pihai Realm cultivation. Lu Renbin might not have been aware of this. Even if he were, with his ninth-level Pihai Realm cultivation, killing Han Li would have been easy.
All signs indicate that Han Li might be the murderer of Lu Renbin. The Body-Cultivating Furnace is likely in his hands.
But with only the fifth level of the Pihai Realm, how could Han Li have killed Lu Renbin of the ninth level? Further, although the other seven Loose Cultivators weren’t highly skilled, among them was one who was at the later stages of the
Pihai Realm.
This is quite illogical.
Unless Han Li concealed his true cultivation, which is in fact at the Gangyuan Realm, only then could he have achieved this.
But is it possible for someone with eighth -grade aptitude to advance from the Pihai Realm to the Gangyuan Realm in the short span of seventeen years? That
seems even less plausible.
Could it be that Lu Renbin’s disappearance has nothing to do with Han Li?
Is it just that Lu Renbin has gone into hiding? Or could he have been taken by some other power?
Looking at the white-haired female sword immortal standing there with a deeply furrowed brow, the witch Yun Miaoyi stretched herself, suddenly revealing a vast expanse of snowy white skin, before leisurely saying,
“What’s there to be conflicted about? Just capture Han Li and ask him, then we’ll know.”
Yun Miaoyi was aware of the intelligence on Han Li, arriving at almost the same conclusion as Jiang Baiye. However, she is not a righteous person but a witch.
Jiang Baiye is wary of Tianxuan Mountain behind Han Li, and mindful of the Daqian Empire, not wanting to attract enemies for Canghai Sect without good reason. Yun Miaoyi doesn’t care about that.
In these past few months, Tianxuan Mountain has been hunting her mercilessly. It’s a good opportunity to vent her anger on Han Li, a Tianxuan Mountain Disciple, regardless of whether he’s the murderer or whether he’s concealing his cultivation.
None of that matters. In the presence of two God Refining Realm True Masters, what trouble could the insignificant Han Li possibly stir up?
“Huh-
Jiang Baiye exhaled a breath, having already made her decision.

chapters.title: Chapter 44 - 44 The Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine Again_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: The Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine Again_l
Translator: 549690339
Lingjun City.
With the news released by the old ancestor of the Han Family that he was to welcome two fairies as concubines, the entire city became bustling with excitement.
This was less than two years since the old ancestor had last taken concubines.
The citizens of Lingjun City were accustomed to this; whenever the old ancestor of the Han Family took new concubines, the Han Mansion would throw a grand feast where everyone could come and eat and drink for free for three days and nights.
It was a blessing for countless citizens of Lingjun City and the days they looked forward to the most each year, as they could easily indulge in fine food.
As Han Li’s cultivation level advanced to the fifth level of the Pihai Realm, the Han Family’s business also expanded significantly, and Lingjun City prospered even more. It had even begun to expand and would grow much larger in a few years.
As more and more people flooded into the city, property prices in Lingjun City also rose. Some profited from this, while others saw the opportunity to make a killing.
The various powers, families, and wealthy merchants in Lingjun City had their criticisms about the old ancestor of the Han Family taking concubines so frequently.
The main issue was the frequency with which the old ancestor took concubines. Each time he took a concubine, they had to present a congratulatory gift of considerable value, lest they offend the Han Family. The various families and Dowers felt that if this continued, their foundations would be drained.
Luckily, as Lingjun City prospered, they could also earn more profits, and the Han Family had delegated some of their businesses to them as agents; for example, they could use their channels to sell common pills, weapons, etc., allowing them to reap considerable benefits.
Regarding the Han Family, the various families in Lingjun City had mixed feelings. With this gigantic entity in their midst, they could not develop on their own.
There used to be three major families in Lingjun City, but now all of them honored the Han Family. The Li Family and the Zhang Family had given their beautiful descendants to Han Li as concubines, and their power had somewhat improved, though not nearly as much as the Han Family.
It could be said that the Han Family was like a mountain crushing down on the heads of all the other families and powers in Lingjun City, and the dominance of the Han Family was not likely to change in the future.
The old ancestor of the Han Family had taken many concubines and sired many offspring with cultivation talent, among them not lacking those with eight or even seven-grade talent. Additionally, as these descendants grew and spread out, the Han Family would only become stronger and stronger.
A grand wedding ceremony was held as scheduled, and Han Li finally wed Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, two sisters, bringing two stunning beauties of peerless elegance and charm into his home as concubines.
Among all his concubines, the sisters Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin had the highest beauty and the best talent, and even their cultivation levels ranked in the top three.
The wedding night was highly valued, a moment of spring worth a thousand gold.
Han Li spent a beautiful night.
In the following days, Han Li took good care of the two sisters, and Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin fully accepted their new reality and settled down.
Both sisters’ cultivation levels were too low at the moment, but with their talents and the support and guidance of Han Li, their cultivation would soon enter a period of rapid advancement.
Han Li did not forget about his other concubines and would take the time to accompany them as well.
During such moments, the concubines would considerately say, “Husband, please go and accompany the two sisters first.”
Having been through it themselves, they understood that the newlyweds needed their husband’s company more after marriage. They were pure in thought, harboring no ideas of scheming or rivalry.
They were diligent in their cultivation, spending most of their time practicing when not in Han Li’s company.
In the past, they rarely had such thoughts, but over the past year or so, the concubines found their cultivation speed gradually accelerating, for reasons unknown.
This excited them, as it meant they could reach higher realms and gain longer lifespans.
Nobody wanted to be short-lived, given the choice, everyone would opt to be long-lived, enabling them to stay by their husband’s side for much longer.
Han Li saw all this and knew it was the effect of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, but he didn’t explain, only frequently giving pointers on the concubines’ cultivation.
That day, Han Li was enjoying leisure time in the Fragrance Garden.
Lying in a recliner chair, he propped his chin in one hand, occasionally opening his mouth to accept the delicacies fed to him by Li Mingmeng, Liu Yuexin, and other concubines; some were giving him shoulder rubs and massages.
Other concubines formed a dance troupe, performing various shows.
Currently performing were the peerless sisters Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, their exposed fair skin, graceful figures, and hair fluttering in the wind ignited a fiery passion in Han Li even though he had already played with every inch of the sisters’ skin.
This was Han Li’s daily divine life, laying flat and rising high, not having to crazily grind like those cultivators, sometimes secluding himself for decades, or going out to experience hardships in search of opportunities, fighting over resources.
Han Mansion was divided into five main parts, the front courtyard, middle court, left and right courtyards, and the back courtyard, which was off-limits to the Han Family descendants to enter at will; this was the reserved area for Han Li and his concubines.
Male members, even his sons and grandsons, were not allowed to enter; daughters could enter only with permission, and usually, only the personal maids of the concubines could come and go. They were strictly forbidden to speak of the back courtyard’s affairs, or they would face the severest family laws.
After all, it was not uncommon for Han Li to spend his days in the garden admiring flowers, arranging them, watching dances, or playing with jade—scenes not meant for other males to see.
When a sword dance performance ended, Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin approached, glistening with sweat. Han Li stood up and wrapped an arm around each of them, planting a kiss.
Lin Yiwu, somewhat shy, had trouble accepting such public displays of affection, but Lin Yiyin offered her other cheek, and Han Li rewarded her with another kiss.
At that moment, a maid hurried in; she too was quite beautiful, scoring eighty out of a hundred, handpicked by the concubines for her pleasing looks were more soothing to the eyes.
After reporting to Liu Yuexin, the maid withdrew, envy evident in her eyes. She very much desired to become one of the Han Family patriarch’s concubines, but she had not been chosen.
Liu Yuexin approached Han Li, and compared to other concubines, she was more mature and composed, exuding an air of grace and luxury, like a ripe peach that is one way on the outside and another at home.
“My lord,” Liu Yuexin spoke, “Tianxuan Mountain has sent a message, summoning all disciples in the Pihai Realm and above to return to the Sect.”
There was a hint of worry in Liu Yuexin’s voice; she knew Han Li’s background and her love for him was unwavering, as she was the concubine who had accompanied Han Li the longest.
It was a rare occasion for Tianxuan Mountain to summon all disciples in the Pihai Realm and above back to the Sect, an event that seldom happened in history, and it was also a first for Han Li.
As astute as Liu Yuexin was, she sensed something amiss in the summons and was worried about potential dangers Han Li might encounter upon his return to the Sect.
Han Li was the Han Family’s stabilizing talisman and the backbone of all his concubines; if anything were to happen to him, their fate would be dire..

chapters.title: Chapter 45 - 45 Arriving a Step Too Late 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: Arriving a Step Too Late 1
Translator: 549690339
Tianxuan Mountain’s summons?
Han Li’s eyebrows knit slightly, his thoughts rapidly shifting, wondering why Tianxuan Mountain would issue this summons.
In history, Tianxuan Mountain had issued several summonses, all relating to significant events with far-reaching impacts.
Yet now, nothing of consequence had occurred in Leizhou, even the restless
Mother Wusheng in Qingzhou and Huozhou had been keeping a low profile for a long time.
Could it be because of Prince Wu’an?
The thought flashed through Han Li’s mind; it was a piece of news he had learned only in the past few days.
Half a month ago, a group of influential figures from Sanzhou gathered in Huozhou City to welcome Prince Wu’an of Daqian, who had arrived from the Imperial Capital.
Prince Wu’an was the previous emperor’s ninth son, while the current Emperor Qian was the eldest son. The two had an acrimonious relationship, primarily due to the conflict over the imperial throne.
Prince Wu’an was a capable commander with a proven track record in battle. During campaigns against the Da Jing Dynasty, he had annihilated vast numbers of Da Jing troops and even struck down a Great Grandmaster in formation, earning himself tremendous military prestige and significant influence within the army.
During the previous emperor’s reign, Prince Wu’an had always guarded the northern border, preventing invasions by the Da Jing Dynasty, making him one of the strongest contenders for the throne.
Although Emperor Qian had also cultivated to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, he relied more on his status as the crown prince, with vast resources forcefully piled upon him.
There had always been strong calls for Prince Wu’an to ascend the throne. He had many followers within the Daqian Empire, far outmatching even the crown prince. Yet when the previous emperor abdicated, it was the crown prince who succeeded to the throne.
To the surprise of many both inside and outside the Daqian Empire, Prince Wu’an seemed indifferent to this decision, allowing for a smooth transition of the empire’s highest authority.
Despite this, Emperor Qian remained vigilant. Prince Wu’an’s influence was so significant that he could feasibly seize the throne with little resistance.
Emperor Qian was aware of his shortcomings in talent, cultivation level, abilities, and influence compared to Prince Wu’an, but who could deny that he was the one in the emperor’s seat?
Having taken the throne and gained the highest authority of Daqian, he had no intention of being dethroned. Therefore, he imposed certain restrictions on Prince Wu’an to test his reaction.
For example, Emperor Qian recalled Prince Wu’an from the northern frontier to the Imperial Capital, and he downgraded Prince Wu’an’s title from a single-character “Emperor Wu” to a two-character title “Prince Wu’an.”
Emperor Qian also did not dare to act rashly. Prince Wu’an was one of the top combat forces within the Daqian Empire, immensely powerful. He only wished to reduce Prince Wu’an’s power and influence, without any thoughts of harming him.
The outside world speculated on how Prince Wu’an would handle these maneuvers by Emperor Qian. Surprisingly, yet again, Prince Wu’an paid no heed to them, content to stay within his manor and seldom leaving.
Although Prince Wu’an had become less prominent, no one within or outside of the Daqian Empire dared to overlook his presence.
For instance, when Prince Wu’an of Daqian arrived in Sanzhou, he directly took over supreme authority. The governors of Sanzhou, the Supervisor of Jingye Office, and other Grandmasters of Myriad Phenomena Realm had to obey his commands without any objections.
Han Li thought it highly likely that there had been no mention of a major enemy attacking Tianxuan Mountain. If there really were such an enemy, summoning Pihai Realm cultivators would be of little use; they wouldn’t make much difference.
After contemplating for a while, Han Li decided it would be better to go. If he openly defied the Tianxuan Mountain summon, he would be immediately expelled from the sect.
Upon reaching Tianxuan Mountain, he planned to collect the resources that had been accumulating for nearlv twentv vears, assess the situation. and iust go through the motions. If things looked amiss, he would make a quick exit.
The gratitude he owed Tianxuan Mountain was not worth his life; when he grew stronger, there would be time to repay Tianxuan Mountain.
“Returning to the sect sooner rather than later is advisable; I will depart this afternoon,” Han Li said pensively, looking at the array of beautiful concubines surrounding him.
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, and the rest of his consorts were left with their words at the tip of their tongues, ultimately condensing into a single sentence: “My lord, take care on your journey; we will wait for your return at home.”
They too understood the gravity of the situation, leaving Han Li no choice but to go. After all, their lord was only at the fifth level of the Pihai Realm, hardly a match for the major powers of Tianxuan Mountain.
As for sisters Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, they were not particularly worried. They had some understanding of Han Li’s true strength; being at the peak of the
Gang Yuan Realm, he would be considered high ranking even within Tianxuan Mountain.
Han Li had given instructions to his concubines and left some contingencies at Han Mansion before he left with peace of mind.
One day after Han Li departed from Lingjun City, two stunning figures arrived, stealthily infiltrating Han Mansion to investigate without a sound.
They were indeed Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi.
The Seventh Grade formations that Han Li had secretly purchased and arranged couldn’t stop the two women, who were the favored daughters of their respective Sects, with many methods at their disposal, and were also true beings of the God Refining Realm.
The two women searched Han Mansion several times over, and then were dumbfounded; Han Li was not at home. Only a group of concubines were resting and playing in the backyard.
After purchasing information from Fengyang Manor, Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi rushed to Lingjun City. Fengyang City was tens of thousands of miles away from Lingjun City, but they traveled as swiftly as lightning, arriving in less than half a day; their speed was undeniably fast.
They were worried that others might beat them to it, and also concerned that Han Li might have already received a warning and fled; now, the worst-case scenario had occurred.
“Could Han Li have really received a message and run off ahead of time?” Yun Miaoyi muttered.
She had wanted to tame Han Li thoroughly, if not able to defeat the true beings of Tianxuan Mountain, then take out her frustrations on Han Li.
Wasn’t Han Li known for indulging in the pleasures of the flesh and fond of taking concubines?
She happened to be from Hehuan Sect and Yinyang Sect, specializing in such matters, perfect for handing him over to some of her Sect sisters, letting Han Li thoroughly enjoy himself.
Jiang Baiye shook her head and said in a low voice, “It’s impossible for Han Li to have known in advance that we were coming.”
“Moreover, all of Han Li’s concubines and offspring are still here, including the two new concubines he just took in.”
“According to the intelligence, although Han Li is licentious and lecherous, he treats his concubines well and values his family’s descendants greatly, preferring to stay and help develop the Han Family rather than going to Tianxuan Mountain, which shows his commitment to the family.”
“That makes sense.”
Yun Miaoyi stuck out her little tongue and licked her red lips, eager to try, “Why don’t we abduct his concubines and have his offspring send a message, calling him back to save them?”
Han Li’s concubines were all of outstanding beauty, especially the two new ones, with their matchless grace and celestial allure. Alone, they were slightly less remarkable than the two women, but combined as sister flowers, they always had an added allure.
Yun Miaoyi had taken an interest in Jiang Baiye and had always been tempting her to join Yinyang Sect, then cultivate together, but Jiang Baiye had persistently refused.
If she couldn’t have Jiang Baiye, then having a bit of fun with Han Li’s concubines wasn’t a bad idea either. After all, Han Li’s concubines were very attractive and varied in style, suiting her taste.
“Whether the Body-Cultivating Furnace is on Han Li or not is still a question, and even if it is, it has nothing to do with those concubines.”
Jiang Baiye gave her a cold stare, her icy voice resounding.
As a woman herself, although she disapproved of Han Li’s lifestyle, she could see that Han Li’s concubines were living well in the Han Family.
She Imew Yun Miaoyi all too well; if those concubines fell into her hands, they were likely to endure some untold mischief.
“So prudish.”
Yun Miaoyi pouted her lips but said no more; she had only mentioned it out of casual interest.
Undeterred, the two women wandered around Han Mansion again and found that Han Li truly was not there. Though there were some treasures, none caught their eyes.
But the two managed to learn something; the previous day, news from Tianxuan Mountain had reached Han Mansion, and after hearing it, Han Li immediately set off, leaving Lingjun City to return to Tianxuan Mountain.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi exchanged glances, both seeing a hint of helplessness in each other’s eyes—they were one step too late and weren’t sure if they could still catch up now.
Thereafter, the two figures vanished from Han Mansion, heading in the direction of Tianxuan Mountain, intending to intercept Han Li halfway..

chapters.title: Chapter 46 - 46: Return to Tianxuan Mountain 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: Return to Tianxuan Mountain 1
Translator: 549690339
Three days later.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi finally caught up with Han Li.
But what almost made them spit blood was that they simply could not capture
Han Li.
At this moment, Han Li sat on a huge flying sword; its speed was not fast, he even leisurely admired the magnificent mountains and rivers, as well as the human world below.
On that massive flying sword, apart from Han Li, there were several others. The two women from Pihai Realm and Gangyuan Realm did not care about them, but they had to pay attention to the person standing at the tip of the sword.
He was an elegantly dressed middle-aged man clad in blue, holding one hand behind his back, occasionally twirling his slightly white sideburns, with a strong aura.
The two women could only watch from a distance, not daring to approach, or else they would be detected by his Spiritual Sense.
“Jiang Baiye, should we go for it? Together, we have a chance to take Han Li away,” Yun Miaoyi said, her beautiful eyes swirling with charm.
At that moment, she had changed into a new outfit: black leather pants for the lower body, a black bustier for the upper body, generously endowed, exposing a large area of snow-white skin around her waist and above her collarbone, her hot figure unmistakably on display.
Jiang Baiye ignored it; she still wore the same outfit as before, her eyebrows deeply furrowed, but she shook her head.
“Are you sure? The Body-Cultivating Furnace is most likely on Han Li. If it falls into Tianxuan Mountain’s hands, your sect will have no chance to take it back,” Yun Miaoyi tried to cajole.
She indeed wanted to intercept, but she could not defeat that Elder of Tianxuan Mountain. The late stage of the God Refining Realm was no joke, an extremely powerful strength.
Although she was the favored daughter of the Yinyang Sect, with many methods at her disposal, her strength was only comparable to the mid-stage of the God Refining Realm. Otherwise, she would not have been chased by that damn Qiu Shuilin for several months.
Jiang Baiye firmly shook her head.
The two of them together, although not a match for Qiu Shuilin, could still surprisingly capture Han Li if they caught him off guard.
By doing so, Qiu Shuilin would definitely guess that their capturing Han Li was for the Body-Cultivating Furnace. After all, it was well-known that the Canghai Sect had lost the Body-Cultivating Furnace. As the favored daughter of the Canghai Sect, she had taken a huge risk to capture a Pihai Realm cultivator without any obvious reason, which was far too conspicuous.
The Body-Cultivating Furnace was too important, and with Yun Miaoyi attracting hatred, that real person in the late stage of the God Refining Realm would definitely launch a massive manhunt for them and vie for the Body-Cultivating Furnace at all costs.
If matters worsened, attracting the attention of various powers, even more formidable experts would take action, and the chances of her bringing the Body-Cultivating Furnace back to the Canghai Sect would be very low.
Moreover, if the Body-Cultivating Furnace was not on Han Li, her actions would incur Tianxuan Mountain’s enmity , and the fact that she had collaborated with the witch of the Yinyang Sect would undoubtedly be spread, possibly leading the Daqian Empire to take advantage and target the Canghai Sect.
The risks were too great at the current moment, and the uncertainties too many. Jiang Baiye preferred to play it safe, even if it meant waiting a few more years.
By the time Han Li returned from Tianxuan Mountain, it was unlikely that his cultivation would have broken through to the God Refining Realm. Then, capturing him silently would pose almost no risk.
“That works too.”
Yun Miaoyi stretched her waist, displaying various enchanting poses, her lips curving into a smile.
This outcome wasn’t bad for her either; at least she could be rid of the nauseating Qiu Shuilin’s relentless pursuit and enjoy some peace for a while.
She just didn’t understand what had happened at Tianxuan Mountain, why they suddenly summoned back all disciples from the Pihai Realm and above— even Qiu Shuilin had given up the chase to kill her.
She had already made up her mind to follow Jiang Baiye. If Jiang Baiye found the trace of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, she would fish in troubled waters; if someone else got the Body-Cultivating Furnace, she would join hands with Jiang Baiye to fight for it.
Watching Han Li’s fading figure in the distance, Yun Miaoyi’s eyes flashed with an amused smile, and she mused to herself, “I hope you, the ‘Elder Taking a Concubine,’ will be just as lucky next time.”
The first time she tried to capture Han Li, he had coincidentally left the day before; the second time, that man was following a late-stage God Refining Realm true person, leaving no opportunity to make a move.
Once Han Li returned to Lingjun City, it would be her third attempt to take action, and she did not believe that his luck could be so good forever, that he would still find a way to escape. On the giant flying sword,
Han Li sat on a chair with a small tea table in front of him, with a pot of Spiritual Tea brewing on it. Han Li drank leisurely, causing the frowns of the people around him.
They were from other manors outside Fengyang Manor and had heard of Han Li’s reputation as the “Elder Taking a Concubine,” feeling that it brought shame to Tianxuan Mountain. Fortunately, Han Li never claimed to be a disciple of Tianxuan Mountain; otherwise, they would regard him with even more disdain.
In their view, cultivation should be focused, with a heart set on the Dao, not coveting pleasure. At most, one should have a partner to seek progress together to reach higher realms of cultivation.
But what about Han Li?
Coveting pleasure, infatuated with the charms of women, frequently taking concubines, spending days and nights holed up in Han Mansion, not going out to temper himself or seek opportunities, not even staying in Tianxuan Mountain to cultivate properly, comprehend the mysteries of the Dao, or listen to the teachings of the elders.
Although they disapproved of Han Li, no one disturbed him, and they chose not to look at him anymore. Out of sight, out of mind, to avoid disturbing their Dao hearts.
They considered Han Li not to be one of them, without a future, and that’s why he indulged in such sensual pleasures.
Among them, some had Lower Grade aptitude, and others only Middle-Grade aptitude. Generally, reaching the Pihai Realm would be their limit, but there was still a slight hope of breaking through to the Gangyuan Realm—that would require fortuitous opportunities.
With no one disturbing him, Han Li felt pretty good about it. The fellow disciples from Tianxuan Mountain all had good manners, and that elder, Qiu Shuilin, didn’t mind his behavior at all, or else Han Li would have had to restrain himself.
After leaving Fengyang Manor, he encountered Elder Qiu. He recognized the man; he was the master of Jiang Cheng, who had become useless, one of the high-standing, influential elders of Tianxuan Mountain, but why he loitered around Fengyang Manor was a mystery.
After meeting Elder Qiu, Han Li naturally boarded his giant flying sword, and along the way, they picked up some Tianxuan Mountain disciples who had received the news.
Han Li noticed that these disciples had a trace of worry on their faces, not knowing what they would face when they returned to Tianxuan Mountain, whereas Elder Qiu seemed very calm, as if he Imew something.
What Han Li didn’t know was that while he was observing Elder Qiu, Qiu Shuilin had also been observing him.
Qiu Shuilin had been in Fengyang Manor for several months, and although he was busy chasing the witch Yun Miaoyi, he had also heard a fair bit about Han Li.
As an elder of Tianxuan Mountain, he was clear about the identities of the disciples of the sect and felt mixed emotions upon hearing about Han Li’s frequent concubine-taking and lingering fondness for the company of women.
Everyone has their own aspirations. Indulging in pleasure when there is no hope for the future, and developing a family, is a personal choice. Qiu Shuilin had no prejudices; he even thought it would be better if his disciple Jiang Cheng could be so open-minded and not be perpetually trapped by emotional calamities.
This was Qiu Shuilin’s first impression of Han Li.
But after Han Li came aboard, unlike the concerns of the other disciples, he was quite indifferent, even sitting down to sip tea. It was unclear whether he was confident or had truly come to terms with life and death.
Regardless of the reason, Qiu Shuilin felt that Han Li was different from the others. Given that Han Li had progressed to the fifth level of the Pihai Realm in less than twenty years after his breakthrough, he thought Han Li still had some hope of breaking through to the Gangyuan Realm. If he were willing to cultivate with enough resources, the probability of success would increase.
Qiu Shuilin decided to observe Han Li for a while. If he performed well, he would take him as his disciple and give him a chance to break through to the Gangyuan Realm. Whether he could seize this opportunity or succeed in breaking through was up to Han Li himself..

chapters.title: Chapter 47 - 47 Suspicion Abounds 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: Suspicion Abounds 1
Translator: 549690339
Tianxuan Mountain.
Han Li and the others landed halfway up the mountain, while Qiu Shuilin vanished in a flash to head towards the Sect’s grand hall; the remaining disciples also went their separate ways.
Han Li returned to his residence in the inner courtyard for a short rest before heading to the foothill area to check on the progress of his descendants’ cultivation.
He had several children with eighth and seventh-grade talents, and the two who were over eight years of age had both been sent to Tianxuan Mountain. They were now in the Rebirth Realm and had become registered disciples.
After giving guidance on their cultivation and leaving behind some resources, reminding them to cultivate well, Han Li left.
The Sect did not mind Han Li sending members of his family to join, as long as they met the talent requirements and their cultivation improvements were satisfactory. The more the better—they could strengthen the Sect’s foundation and expand its influence, among other benefits.
Han Li felt somewhat constrained when it came to nurturing his descendants; the Han Family’s history of development was not long, and many things were incomplete, lacking a strong foundation for an effective and systematic cultivation training.
Therefore, he sent all descendants with cultivational talents to be nurtured by the Sect, allowing them to learn better cultivation techniques and martial arts and also to increase the influence of the Han Family.
Eventually, when his own power surpasses that of Tianxuan Mountain and other Sects, those descendants who had joined the Sects would naturally prioritize the Han Family and gradually return. It was akin to borrowing eggs to hatch chicks, saving him much worry.
By that time, the reach of the Han Family would naturally expand to most of the Sects in Leizhou, becoming a pivotal ruler in the region.
On the other hand, sending the talented descendants to the Sect for systematic training meant they could cultivate faster and grow more quickly, which was also greatly beneficial to Han Li.
Let’s not forget that Han Li could receive a feedback of cultivation from his descendants, although at the moment he didn’t have many talented descendants, even fewer were on the cultivation path, and none had reached the Pihai Realm, so the feedback on his cultivation was minimal.
But when he has tens of thousands of descendants, each diligently cultivating, even lying down he could gain massive cultivation feedback, much faster than cultivating by himself.
Han Li also knew this was similar to the growth of a family—it required time to accumulate, and the effects would become larger over time, his gains would increase, and his cultivation would improve faster.
After visiting his descendants and utilizing the time before Tianxuan Mountain officially released the news, Han Li went to the inner courtyard to claim the resources he had accumulated over the years before heading to the Sect’s Artifact Refining Pavilion, Pill Refining Pavilion, and Array Pavilion, among other places.
He exchanged some items from the Han Mansion for Sect contribution points, such as the Sea Opening Pill, and then used those contribution points along with Spirit Stones to exchange them for Pill Formulas, Refining Blueprints, Array Diagrams, and so on from the Sect.
Han Li focused on exchanging for Eighth Grade Pill Recipes and blueprints, even obtaining Seventh Grade Pill Formulas, Refining Blueprints, and Array Diagrams of each kind, spending a significant amount of contribution points and Spirit Stones.
Luckily, the Han Mansion had earned a considerable number of Spirit Stones recently, and by slaying the Great Master Cui Pingyu, he had obtained over three hundred thousand Lower Grade Spirit Stones, as well as cultivation techniques, martial arts, and some treasures.
Otherwise, Han Li simply could not afford so many items, and even so, he immediately became as poor as could be, with less than a hundred Spirit Stones in his possession.
Han Li believed it was well worth it. With the new Eighth Grade Pill Blueprints, as well as the Seventh Grade ones, the Han Family could continuously earn more cultivation resources.
Although he currently could not refine Seventh Grade pills and weapons, Han Li was not in the least bit anxious—it was only a matter of time.
Among the items in Cui Pingyu’s Space Ring, the most important were the cultivation techniques and martial arts. He had no need for the techniques of the Hehuan Sect, but the “Yin and Yang Palm Seal” made Han Li envious.
The Yin and Yang Palm Seal was one of the Yinyang Sect’s secret skills, with the complete skill being an Earth-Level Extreme Martial Art. Even with only half of it, it was still Earth-Level Lower Rank. Cui Pingyu had spent all his contribution points and was deep in debt to exchange for this half of the skill.
Han Li would practice it in his spare time but wouldn’t devote too much time to it, mainly because it was too difficult to master. Cui Pingyu had only achieved minor success, while Han Li had yet to even begin learning it.
By comparison, he preferred the martial arts rewarded by the System: they were at the complete level and came with various cultivation experiences—truly delightful.
Even if he truly mastered the Yin and Yang Palm Seal, Han Li dared not use it recklessly. If exposed, he would be hunted by the Hehuan Sect, and even the Yinyang Sect would pursue him to the death.
This ultimate technique of the Yinyang Sect was not meant to be revealed to outsiders. If the Yinyang Sect really went after him, not even the Daqian Empire would protect him, nor could they.
Xuantian Hall.
The Sect Leader of Tianxuan Mountain, the Elders, and six other high-ranking officials gathered here. Qiu Shuilin, who had previously brought Han Li back to the Sect, was also present, and his position was quite prominent.
At the deepest end of the grand hall, the Sect Leader sat in the seat of honor, a middle-aged man dressed in a purple jade robe. His stature was upright, his face gentle as jade, his eyes profound, exuding a mature, stable demeanor with an elegant grace.
He was none other than Gongsun Yun, the Sect Leader of Tianxuan Mountain.
A Guru in the Hollow Void Stage, he was known in the Cultivation Realm as the “Jade-Faced Gentleman,” possessing formidable strength and holding a pivotal status in Leizhou.
“Everyone is aware of the news. Let’s share our opinions,” Gongsun Yun said as he looked around, voicing his thoughts.
The five Elders in the hall exchanged glances, and Qiu Shuilin was the first to speak: “Brother, Prince Wu’an has come with ill intentions.”
The other Elders nodded in agreement; they were somewhat aware of the situation with the Daqian Empire and Prince Wu’an.
“I know, but do we have any other options?” Gongsun Yun sighed, his expression worried.
The Elders fell silent.
The balance maintained in the Xuan Domain for a thousand years was showing signs of being disrupted, with a very likely breaking point being the Daqian
Empire.
Of the eight great forces in the Xuan Domain, the Daqian Empire had the weakest foundation. Top forces from the Xuan Domain and the other seven domains were eager to place their pieces, plotting openly and in secret, hoping to break the stalemate here.
The Ancient Empire sought to unify the Xuan Domain—or at the very least dominate half of it; the Kurong Sect representing the Buddha Domain wished for Buddhism to spread east, gradually encroaching upon the Xuan Domain; the Yinyang Sect representing the Devil Region and the Qitian Teaching representing the Dao Domain both harbored these ambitions; the Da Jing Empire wanted to seize the opportunity to annex the Daqian Empire to become one of the top three in the Xuan Domain…
The Da Liang Empire was isolated in a corner, Emperor Wu’s City remained neutral, the Chaotic Domain also made its move, the Sword Domain had long placed its pieces, while the Barbarian Region and the Demon Domain watched with predatory eyes. Once a monumental war broke out in the Xuan Domain and drew the attention of the other domains, the Demon Barbarian Regions were very likely to invade, seizing the territories of the Human Clan.
Even the Daqian Empire itself was plotting; they could not hide the movements of other top forces from their eyes.
But Daqian was incapable of standing against so many forces, and therefore could only opt to counter scheme, hoping to leverage one power against another, trigger a battle among those forces, and ideally, preserve Daqian’s foundation before planning for the future.
Why did the previous Emperor Qian suddenly abdicate? Why was the Crown Prince the successor and not Prince Wu’an? Why did the Daqian Empire choose to eradicate only Buddhism and not defend against the devils and uphold the Dao…
These questions were riddled with doubts.
The White Lotus Cult’s chaos was a move by mysterious forces to test the foundation of the Daqian Empire. Other forces chose to watch, but there were also suspicions that the Daqian Empire was going with the flow, seemingly plotting something.
Prince Wu’an of Daqian, with his formidable reputation, had repelled the Da Jing Empire at the northern border for two hundred years. Was such an important figure truly just coming to deal with the remnants of the White Lotus Cult?
A while back, Prince Wu’an had convened the leaders of the various factions in Sanzhou and announced some news, urging them to cooperate as much as possible—even deliberately leaking certain information for the leaders of the Sanzhou factions to know.
After Gongsun Yun returned to Tianxuan Mountain, he issued a summoning order, calling back all disciples of Tianxuan Mountain who were of the Pihai Realm or higher to return to the mountain..

chapters.title: Chapter 48 - 48 Reactions from All Sides_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: Reactions from All Sides_1
Translator: 549690339
In the Xuantian Hall, a pall of gloom hung heavy.
Although Tianxuan Mountain was one of the Four Great Sects of Leizhou, with a Hollow Realm Master sitting at its helm, it fell far short of the level of the Daqian Empire, not even ranked among the Ten Major Sects.
Faced with the formidable Daqian Empire, Tianxuan Mountain had no choice but to comply with its orders. Otherwise, the Daqian Empire wouldn’t hesitate to annihilate any disobedient sects.
Caught in this great maelstrom, Tianxuan Mountain did not hold the Daqian
Empire in high regard, yet it was forced to side with it. This didn’t mean that Tianxuan Mountain would serve the Daqian Empire wholeheartedly and willingly.
“Prince Wu’an’s presence in Sanzhou surely has hidden agendas. Exterminating the remnants of the White Lotus Cult is just the first step, a test for the various factions in Sanzhou to see if they are aligned with the Daqian Empire,” spoke an Elder of the God Refining Realm in a deep voice.
Qiu Shuilin nodded and continued, “What we need to do is to appear united with the Daqian Empire on the surface while sparing our efforts as much as possible to preserve our strength, so we don’t end up as cannon fodder for the Daqian Empire.”
The other three Elders also put forth their opinions and suggestions and then collectively turned their gaze to Sect Leader Gongsun Yun.
After pondering for a moment, Gongsun Yun slowly said, “Let’s do this, Junior Brother Qiu, go to the inner courtyard to announce this matter, calling upon the disciples to join and trace the remnants of the White Lotus Cult.”
“We don’t need to exert much effort, just participate, and of course, if we accidentally discover the traces of the White Lotus Cult’s remnants, we must immediately report it to the sect.”
The five Elders let out a sigh of relief upon hearing this, and smiles emerged on their faces. They were fortunate that the Sect Leader was not blinded by the rewards promised by Prince Wu’an; otherwise, Tianxuan Mountain might be in trouble.
Among the three provinces of Sanzhou, Leizhou had four major factions, Huozhou also had four, but Qingzhou was the strongest with five, among which the Canghai Sect was one of the Ten Major Sects.
Tianxuan Mountain, Sword Cleansing Pool, Canghai Sect, and even Hehuan Sect shared this sentiment; none were willing to go all out for the Daqian Empire. If the Daqian Empire fell, they could survive by allying with other forces – merely exchanging one overlord for another.
Leizhou, Hehuan Sect.
A high-level meeting was also convened in the main hall, and the countermeasures were quickly determined.
Watching the various Elders depart, Sect Master Yan Liulong sighed. Being a Sect Master was truly exhausting.
In the past, when the Yinyang Sect wanted to get involved in the Daqian Empire and place their agents within, they sent out four groups. In the end, only her group succeeded in gaining a foothold in Leizhou.
The other three groups, including three Hollow Realm Masters, all perished when they attempted to establish sects in neighboring provinces, serving as a warning from the Daqian Empire.
Her lineage survived mainly due to luck, as Leizhou was adjacent to Yinyang
Sect’s territory. The Daqian Empire’s bottom line was to allow Yinyang Sect to establish a presence in Leizhou. If they attempted to do so in other provinces, the Daqian Empire would not hesitate to crush those chess pieces.
Her decision to come to Leizhou took this into account, as the Daqian Empire could not afford to push Yinyang Sect into a corner, leaving some room for retreat, which was Leizhou. Without support from behind, she wouldn’t have been able to choose Leizhou.
Hehuan Sect had been based in Leizhou for over a hundred and forty years, but had yet to make a significant breakthrough, as they were tightly controlled by the Daqian Empire.
The Daqian Empire dared let them in because they were confident they could keep Hehuan Sect in check and prevent it from infiltrating other provincial cities.
“But the end is in sight at last.”
Thinking of the message received from her master, a smile crept onto the seductive face of Yan Liulong.
In just a few years, she would be able to return to the Yinyang Sect and obtain the treasure she had long coveted, allowing her to ascend to the rank of a Great Grandmaster in the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
As for the tasks assigned by Prince Wu’an of Daqian, Yan Liulong did not care. Hehuan Sect was nominally under the rule of the Daqian Empire, but who didn’t know it was a branch of the Yinyang Sect?
She would just have the sect disciples show some token effort while investigating the death of Cui Pingyu, giving Prince Wu’an some face.
Han Li blamed the White Lotus Cult, and Zhenyi Manor added fuel to the fire, but Yan Liulong wasn’t fooled. The absence of major action by the Leizhou officials meant that the Mother of No Birth and the Dharma King of the White Lotus Cult were still on the run between Qingzhou and Huozhou.
Qingzhou, Canghai Sect.
Sect’s grand hall.
“Bang!”
The Canghai Sect Leader smashed the armrest into dust with a single blow, and anger still evident on his face.
“This impudent whelp has pushed my Canghai Sect too far!”
In the great hall, nearly twenty Hollow Realm Masters and God Refining experts also wore expressions of rage, their resentment towards the Daqian Empire reaching a breaking point.
The loss of the Sect’s treasured Body-Cultivating Furnace was a responsibility that the Daqian Empire could not evade. Had it not been for the Empire’s failure to eradicate the remnants of the White Lotus Cult, had it not been for the Empire’s scramble for power, had it not been for the Empire’s interference at every turn… the Body-Cultivating Furnace would have been recovered long ago, or would never have been lost in the first place.
However, Prince Wu’an’s arrival in Huozhou and his summoning of the leaders of various factions to announce certain matters further stressed the Canghai Sect.
He emphasized that, as the only one among the Ten Major Sects in Sanzhou, with profound heritage, and with Qingzhou as its stronghold, Canghai Sect must contribute even more to the eradication of the Mother of Non-Existence, promising an array of rewards from the Daqian Empire upon success, which only served to disgust the Canghai Sect.
Though furious, the Canghai Sect Leader wasn’t foolish and understood that the Daqian Empire was not an opponent the Canghai Sect could confront alone. When it was time to bow, one had to bow, so he made the necessary arrangements.
Of course, they wouldn’t actually contribute effort; even if the remnants of the White Lotus Cult were to be eradicated, the Body-Cultivating Furnace could not be retrieved, and while the Canghai Sect might have gained some satisfaction, the Daqian Empire would be the one to reap tangible benefits.
“How is the progress on Bai Ye’s side?”
Having calmed his anger, the Canghai Sect Leader’s expression returned to one of calm, as he inquired of a Hollow Realm Master.
The white-bearded and white-haired Hollow Realm Master smiled and said, “Sect Leader, my disciple recently sent word, we have a lead on the
Body-Cultivating Furnace, but it still needs further confirmation.”
“Tell her to hurry, the Body-Cultivating Furnace must not fall into someone else’s hands.”
After a moment of thought, the Canghai Sect Leader added, “If Bai Ye successfully retrieves the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the spot for the End of the World Secret Realm will be hers.’
The Canghai Sect Leader glanced at the restive crowd and said indifferently, “The same goes for your disciples and grand-disciples.”
Having said this, the Canghai Sect Leader departed as the many elders of the Canghai Sect exchanged glances with mixed feelings and dispersed.
“End of the World Secret Realm, I hope Bai Ye succeeds,” the last to leave, the white-bearded Elder sighed.
In Huozhou, Province City.
Prince Wu’an strolled leisurely in the garden with his hands clasped behind his back, admiring the scenery.
“Your Highness, one would think you’re here in Huozhou just for pleasure,” a middle-aged man in a blue robe said with a smile.
Chu Hao replied with an impassive look, “Pretty much.”
Was it necessary for him to personally hunt down the mere remnants of the White Lotus Cult and the newly ascended to Myriad Phenomena Realm Mother of Non-Existence?
With a simple command, it wouldn’t be long before the Mother of Non-Existence was eliminated; Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong could easily handle it.
He didn’t care if the factions of Sanzhou made an effort or not. He needed them to make a statement, and should any Sect rebel, it would give him an opportunity to establish his authority.
He had other important business in Sanzhou, involving strategizing for the entire Daqian Empire. If successful, Daqian would have a future; if not, Daqian could be doomed overnight.
“Opportunity, oh opportunity, the Prophet said that my chance to ascend to the True Martial Realm lies within Leizhou, Qingzhou, and Huozhou, but where exactly? And when will it appear?”
Prince Wu’an, with eyes as deep as the stars, looked at the koi swimming in the pond and murmured to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 49 - 49 1 Will Step Back_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: 1 Will Step Back_1
Translator: 549690339
Tianxuan Mountain, Inner Courtyard.
At this moment, all the Inner Sect Disciples and Core Disciples who were still at Tianxuan Mountain had gathered in the central square of the Inner Courtyard, buzzing with activity, clustering in groups of threes and twos, conversing in hushed tones.
Many disciples who had been out on experience or missions had also rushed back, eager to find out what major event had transpired at Tianxuan Mountain.
Han Li was among them, positioned in the middle of the crowd, not wishing to stand out and reveal his presence.
Around him were two or three acquaintances, friends he had made on Tianxuan Mountain in the past. Although they had advanced to the Pihai Realm before him, they were not as highly cultivated as he was, their cultivation only at the third or fourth tier of the Pihai Realm.
Han Li chatted casually with his three friends, the conversation also revolving around the happenings at Tianxuan Mountain. Everyone was curious, wondering what matter was important enough for Tianxuan Mountain to make such a grand move.
Soon after, a figure descended from the sky, landing on the high platform at the front of the square, standing with hands clasped behind his back, looking down at the people below.
“Silence!”
With a shout from Qiu Shuilin, a formidable aura burst forth, instantly enveloping everyone present, bringing all the disciples to silence, their attention fully focused on Qiu Shuilin.
A trace of satisfaction flickered in Qiu Shuilin’s eyes, then he spoke solemnly, “I won’t beat around the bush, I’ve called you back for an important matter.”
“Several years ago, the White Lotus Cult caused chaos in Huozhou, poisoning countless lives. Although they were annihilated, remnants fled and have been lurking in the lands of Qingzhou and Huozhou, with elusive whereabouts, thwarting complete eradication.”
Upon hearing the words “White Lotus Cult” , Han Li’s brows furrowed slightly and he quietly slipped to the back of the crowd.
As he had conjectured, this grand action of Tianxuan Mountain was related to Prince Wu’an. It wasn’t in Tianxuan Mountain’s nature to confront the White Lotus Cult without reason, nor would they be able to.
With the No-Life Mother being a Grandmaster Wanxiang, all of Tianxuan Mountain combined wouldn’t be a match, and he certainly did not wish to go to his death in vain.
It doesn’t matter, I will… back off!
“To utterly destroy the White Lotus Cult, the Daqian Empire has dispatched Prince Wu’an to guard Sanzhou. He has already mobilized troops and will soon launch the final strike against the No-Life Mother,” Qiu Shuilin continued.
“Should the No-Life Mother by chance escape, no matter which state she flees to, her whereabouts must be swiftly determined. You are to return and mobilize your family’s forces to track her down as much as possible. Once discovered, report immediately.”
The square immediately erupted into commotion, buzzing with discussions as the many disciples showed a range of expressions on their faces.
So this was to deal with the White Lotus Cult, no wonder the Sect mobilized to such an extent.
With Prince Wu’an, the Daqian war god on the scene, the No-Life Mother’s days are likely numbered.
If Prince Wu’an makes a move, even if the No-Life Mother is lucky enough to escape, she’ll surely be gravely injured. Could one then capitalize on the opportunity?
“Brother Han, should we…’
Where Han Li had been standing, a junior Brother Tu spoke excitedly, but before he could finish, he noticed something amiss and exclaimed in surprise, “Eh? Where’s Brother Han?”
The other two were slightly taken aback. Hadn’t Brother Han just been right beside them? When had he disappeared?
The disappearance of Han Li didn’t seem of much concern to the three, who continued their conversation, intending to inform him after the gathering dispersed.
From behind the crowd, Han Li silently watched the scene unfold, pondering Elder Qiu’s words, and came to a conclusion in his mind.
Tianxuan Mountain was planning to put on an act without exerting itself.
The speech was grandiose, sending everyone to track down the No-Life Mother should she by chance escape, clearly intending to mobilize these disciples’ family powers behind them.
The disciples of Tianxuan Mountain came from families across all the counties of Leizhou, and if roused, they would indeed form a considerable force. Coupled with other Sects which would surely execute similar orders, tracking down the No-Life Mother wouldn’t be difficult.
The No-Life Mother was an exceedingly dangerous person; tracking her down came with great risks, and carelessness could result in annihilation. Without substantial rewards, who would put in the effort?
After the disciples mobilize their family forces and put much effort into finding the No-Life Mother’s whereabouts, enduring great losses or even facing annihilation, yet without compensation, no one would be willing to take on that task.
Tianxuan Mountain’s decision exactly matched Han Li’s thoughts. Even if Tianxuan Mountain demanded a full investigation, Han Li would slack off; it was impossible for him to truly pursue the matter.
Capable of cultivating in the Pihai and Gang Yuan Realms, the disciples of Tianxuan Mountain were very astute. Initially, they felt excited, but they soon calmed down, savored the hints in Qiu Shuilin’s words, and understood what to do.
If by chance the Deathless Mother escaped to Leizhou, then naturally they would pursue the investigation, but without exerting effort, just going through the motions would suffice. Of course, if they were truly lucky enough to encounter her, they would certainly have to report it.
On another front, Tianxuan Peak.
Tianxuan Peak is the main peak of the Tianxuan Mountain Range, where the Sect Leader, his relatives, and his disciples reside. The Sect’s grand hall and other important buildings also stand tall on this peak.
Atop the peak, two figures stood firmly, overlooking the entire Tianxuan Mountain. One of them was the Sect Leader, Gongsun Yun, and the other was his daughter, Gongsun Yue.
Gongsun Yun was silent for a long time before finally speaking, “Yue’er, go to the Dao Domain.”
“I won’t go.”
Gongsun Yue refused without a second thought.
Gongsun Yun looked at his daughter and said in a deep voice, “Don’t be obstinate. You know you must go.”
“It’s too far,” Gongsun Yue said, still refusing while maintaining eye contact with him.
“The Daqian Empire is about to become a nexus of gathering storms, and amidst the swirling undercurrents, our Tianxuan Mountain is but a small boat, at any moment it could capsize and sink to the bottom of the sea without stirring a single wave.”
Gongsun Yun did not attempt to persuade her further but said with a bitter expression on his face.
Standing high allows for a more distant view, just like at this moment, he could overlook Tianxuan Mountain. As Tianxuan Mountain’s Sect Leader and a Hollow Realm Master, he keenly perceived the constantly changing situation.
In this tempest, Tianxuan Mountain’s strength was too weak to protect itself. Leaving aside Tianxuan Mountain, even the Daqian Empire with Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm as its defender, could not dare to guarantee its own survival.
As the head of Tianxuan Mountain, he knew many secrets, such as the fact that the Founding Master of Tianxuan Mountain actually came from the Dao Domain and was a disciple of the Tai Xuan Sect there.
The Dao Domain also had eight major powers: Bai Yujing, Sky Sect, Earth Sect, Human Sect, Tai Xuan Sect, True Martial Sect, Chun Yang Palace, and Dragon Tiger Mountain.
Unlike the Xuan Domain, the Dao Domain is unified under the entire Dao Sect, with Bai Yujing as the orthodox and ancestral home of the Dao Sect.
The other seven Dao sects are nominally subordinate to Bai Yujing, but in reality, they are branches that separated from Bai Yujing, evolved over the vicissitudes of time.
The Tai Xuan Sect is very strong, even stronger than the Daqian Empire, and has high requirements for accepting disciples.
Watching his daughter’s figure descend the mountain, Gongsun Yun’s voice echoed in her ear, “Yue’er, think it over carefully once more.”
In any case, he wanted his daughter to leave this vortex as soon as possible; she would be safe once in the Dao Domain.
Gongsun Yue paused for a moment, then disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Gongsun Yun withdrew his gaze and spread his Spiritual Sense over the entire Tianxuan Mountain Range.
The nascent Spiritual Sense of the God Refining Realm could cover a hundred li at its early stage, a thousand li at its peak, and upon reaching the Hollow Void Stage, the Spiritual Sense would significantly enhance, easily covering ten thousand li, reaching its peak, it could cover an area of fifty thousand li.
With the situation changing daily, Gongsun Yun would scout the Sect every day to prevent any unexpected incidents.
As Gongsun Yun’s Spiritual Sense swept over the inner courtyard’s plaza, it coincided with witnessing Han Li frowning and stepping back, and he even perceived Han Li’s true cultivation level.

chapters.title: Chapter 50 - 50: Becoming an Apprentice_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: Becoming an Apprentice_1
Translator: 549690339
“This youngster…”
Gongsun Yun’s face revealed a hint of a smile.
It was a fortunate matter that Tianxuan Mountain has gained a promising talent. Unfortunately, his emergence came at an inopportune time; had he appeared a hundred years earlier, perhaps Tianxuan Mountain could have witnessed the birth of a second Grandmaster.
Now with the situation being so unpredictable, there simply wasn’t enough time for a genius to grow.
After the inner courts’ grand assembly ended, the numerous disciples dispersed. Han Li had intended to return immediately to Lingjun City. He had achieved his goal of coming to Tianxuan Mountain, but Qiu Shuilin suddenly appeared, announcing that the Sect Leader wished to see him.
Feeling Qiu Shuilin’s meaningful smile, Han Li’s scalp tingled slightly, and with a thump in his heart, he wondered, what could the Sect Leader suddenly want with him?
Since joining Tianxuan Mountain, he had only seen the Sect Leader from a distance a few times, but now he was being summoned alone. It definitely wasn’t without reason; the Sect Leader must have discovered something.
Han Li soon calmed down, realizing there wasn’t much to worry about. Other than concealing his cultivation level, he hadn’t done anything to wrong Tianxuan Mountain.
Qiu Shuilin’s Spiritual Sense had been secretly observing Han Li, and he nodded to himself approvingly at Han Li’s reaction, although he did feel a pang of regret.
Upon returning to the sect, he had thought about taking Han Li as his disciple, wanting to observe him a little longer first. Little did he expect Han Li to be so adept at hiding his true potential, and now the Sect Leader had snatched him away.
Han Li had deliberately hidden his cultivation level, and even Qiu Shuilin, who was in the late stages of the God Refining Realm, hadn’t noticed anything odd. Had it not been for the Sect Leader informing him, he would have continued to think that Han Li was merely at the fifth level of the Pihai Realm.
Peak of Gangyuan Realm, among all the disciples of the current Tianxuan Mountain, such a cultivation level was enough to rank him first.
Qiu Shuilin had seen Han Li’s records—eighth-grade talent, failed to break through the Pihai Realm and descends the mountain, only managing to break through the Pihai Realm as his lifespan neared its limit.
If the intelligence was accurate, then Han Li had advanced from the first level of Pihai Realm to the Peak of Gangyuan Realm in less than twenty years. Such a speed of cultivation was truly frightening.
It was uncertain whether the testing of Han Li’s talent had been mistaken earlier or if he later encountered some great opportunity that greatly improved his cultivation talent.
Qiu Shuilin harbored no greed; he just regretted not being able to take on a good disciple. With Han Li already at the Peak of Gangyuan Realm and on the verge of advancing to the God Refining Realm, with a future hope of becoming a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage, becoming a disciple of the Sect Leader was the best choice.
After escorting Han Li to the Xuantian Hall, Qiu Shuilin left for the inner court’s grand hall, thinking that he needed to have a serious talk with Jiang Cheng.
Having left Jiang Cheng to wallow in depression for decades, he still had not seen through his emotional entanglements. If this continued, the hope of advancing to the God Refining Realm would become increasingly slim.
Inside the Xuantian Hall.
As Han Li entered, he saw a figure standing at its deepest end, clad in a purple jade robe, standing tall with an extraordinary demeanor, hands behind his back, facing away from him.
“Greetings, Sect Leader.”
Han Li said while bowing, deliberately showing a mix of panic, surprise, excitement, and confusion on his face.
“Come forward.’
Gongsun Yun’s indifferent voice came through, causing another thump in Han Li’s heart. What did the Sect Leader mean by this?
At that moment, Gongsun Yun turned around, looking at him with a smile that was not quite a smile, “Still pretending in front of me?”
He had indeed been seen through by this old man.
Han Li inwardly sighed; he didn’t know what gave him away and attracted the Sect Leader’s attention.
He had a Secret Technique that allowed him to conceal his cultivation level. With his cultivation at the Peak of the Gangyuan Realm, it was nearly impossible for someone in the God Refining Realm to see through him, and even a Guru in the Initial Stage of the Hollow Void Realm wouldn’t notice unless they looked carefully. Only a Grandmaster in the intermediate stage of the Hollow Void Stage or higher could see through it at a glance.
“The Sect Leader is wise indeed.”
Having been seen through, Han Li no longer pretended and said with a chuckle.
The Sect Leader’s demeanor didn’t seem to indicate he would harm him, so Han Li felt quite relieved.
Gongsun Yun was very pleased with Han Li’s behavior, saying,
Upon discovering Han Li, Gongsun Yun reviewed the Sect records pertaining to him.
Last time Han Li returned to Tianxuan Mountain, he had just broken through to the Pihai Realm. Gongsun Yun’s Spiritual Sense had swept over Han Li, but he hadn’t paid it much attention. At that time, even if Han Li had concealed his power, he was still in the Pihai Realm.
However, this time Han Li returned, he had advanced to the peak of the Gangyuan Realm, which was too conspicuous. With his cultivation at the late stage of the Void Realm, Gongsun Yun saw through it at a glance, a level of power that he could not help but take seriously.
Even when accounting for Tianxuan Mountain’s hidden strength, being at the peak of the Gangyuan Realm could be ranked within the top ten.
Looking at Gongsun Yun’s expression, full of smiles around his eyes and brows, Han Li knew he was lying. A slight difference? More like a world of difference!
“May I ask why the Sect Leader has summoned me?”
Han Li cut to the chase and was inwardly on guard. Even though the Sect Leader seemed amiable, who knew if it was pretense?
He did not know Tianxuan Mountain’s Sect Leader very well. The outside world spoke of the Sect Leader as a handsome and chivalrous gentleman, fair in his dealings and with a good reputation. But appearances can be deceiving, and caution is paramount.
After all, he had many secrets on him. If the Sect Leader didn’t match his outside reputation and found out any of these secrets, he might be attacked; he had to be vigilant.
In a short period of time, Han Li had already planned out his actions. Should the situation turn sour, he would immediately activate the Body-Cultivating Furnace to withstand an attack from the Sect Leader, then use the momentum to fly backwards, immediately seizing an important person to negotiate for his life.
Gongsun Yun had been observing Han Li all the while, taking in all his reactions. He smiled, unconcerned, as he indeed harbored no ill intentions toward Han Li.
No matter what opportunity Han Li had seized or what secrets he held, those were his own. If Han Li did not speak of them, Gongsun Yun wouldn’t pry.
Although Han Li had concealed his cultivation, he hadn’t done anything detrimental to Tianxuan Mountain and rarely returned.
Gongsun Yun could tell Han Li seemed reluctant to stay at the Sect. If it wasn’t for the summons, which called back all inner and core disciples, Han Li would likely have continued to lay low in the small region of Lingjun City.
“I have summoned you because I wish to take you on as a disciple. Are you willing?
Gongsun Yun looked at Han Li with keen eyes, a hint of hope flickering within. He hoped even more that Han Li would agree.
Under his guidance, Han Li stood a good chance of being promoted to the Hollow Void Stage within fifty years, providing another pillar of strength for the future of Tianxuan Mountain.
If Han Li were unwilling, he wouldn’t press the issue. He could let Han Li be. After all, a Guru in the Void Realm wouldn’t be of much help in this storm.
Upon hearing this, Han Li fell silent and didn’t answer right away. Gongsun Yun did not rush him, allowing him the time to make his decision.
To be honest, as a representative figure who could “outcompete everyone by lying low,” Tianxuan Mountain wasn’t of much help to Han Li. Had he awoken with a “golden finger” upon crossing over, he might not even have considered joining the Sect.
But given the unpredictable nature of the situation, and that his cultivation was not high, having yet to grow, the patronage of a Void Realm Grandmaster would still be useful.
After some thought, Han Li asked, “If I become a disciple, will the Sect or the
Sect Leader force me to do anything?”
It It meant being torcecl to do certam tmngs—llke navmg to stay at tne sect, focusing only on cultivation, eschewing romance, handing over opportunities, or being thrust into conflicts—Han Li would absolutely refuse.
“Everything is at your discretion,” Gongsun Yun shook his head.
He saw it clearly; for someone like Han Li, binding him by force was impossible. The best approach was to bestow favors and invest in him early on.
“Disciple pays respect to the Master.”
Without further hesitation, Han Li paid respects again, his tone now filled with respect.
This was his first time accepting a master in his life, and perhaps it would be the last.
