chapters.title: Chapter 51 - 51 Closed-door Cultivation_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Closed-door Cultivation_l
Translator: 549690339
After becoming a disciple of Gongsun Yun, Han Li gained many benefits. Just in terms of Mid-grade Spiritual Stones, he received twenty thousand, equivalent to two million Lower Grade Spirit Stones.
Furthermore, he received an Immortal Conservation Pill, the Wenxuan Sword, the Five Elements Destruction Formation, three Formation Breaking Beads, two Small Teleportation Charms… he was also taught Tianxuan Mountain’s most powerful cultivation technique, the “Tianxuan Scripture, ” along with two exceptional skills, the “Xuantian Punch” and the “God Slaying Sword Technique.”
The Immortal Conservation Pill is a sixth-grade medicine, which aids cultivators at the Gangyuan Realm in advancing to the God Refining Realm, with just one pill capable of increasing the success rate by twenty percent; its effects are incredibly potent.
The Wenxuan Sword is a Profound Rank Extreme Grade Spiritual Artifact, usually wielded by cultivators in the God Refining Realm; the Five Elements
Destruction Formation is a sixth-grade Formation that Gongsun Yun gave to Han Li in consideration of his long-term stay in Lingjun City, designed to defend against enemies in the God Refining Realm, challenging even a Hollow Realm Master to break it within five or six breaths’ time.
A sixth-grade Formation Breaking Bead, two seventh-grade Formation
Breaking Beads, in case Han Li gets trapped within a great Formation; using a Small Teleportation Charm instantly transports one to a random location within a hundred thousand miles.
The Tianxuan Scripture is an Earth-Level Extreme Grade Practice Method, consisting of nine revolutions, each corresponding to a different realm theoretically reaching the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. However, aside from Tianxuan Mountain’s Founding Master, no one else has reached the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
The Xuantian Punch is an Earth-Level Extreme Martial Art, and the God Slaying Sword Technique is an Earth-grade Superior Martial Art; both are exceptional skills of the Myriad Phenomena Realm level and are extremely precious.
Realizing the value of these items, Han Li was shocked. Only his
Body-Cultivating Furnace and the Pill Formula for the Rebirth Pill on him were of greater worth; the Longevity Pill couldn’t be compared to any of these, for it was just a seventh-grade one, unless he had a Fifth Grade Longevity Pill.
Han Li felt somewhat ashamed for having been so cautious and wary of Gongsun Yun in the past. Of course, this sense of shame was fleeting; given the choice again, he would act the same way.
Not everyone is as open-hearted towards him as Gongsun Yun. The human heart is the most complex and the most difficult to fathom, something Han Li had experienced profoundly.
Surviving in the Cultivation Realm requires supreme caution; sooner or later, carelessness leads to a great downfall, possibly leaving no opportunity for recovery.
Remembering Gongsun Yun’s kindness, Han Li kept it close to his heart; other than his parents, this was the first time anyone had treated him so well.
Should Tianxuan Mountain ever face any calamity and he possesses the strength to aid, he would do so, even if it meant taking some risks.
Inside the Xuantian Hall, Sect Leader Gongsun Yun said with a smile, “Disciple, in a few days, I will announce your acceptance as my last closed-door disciple.”
“Before you, I took in eight disciples. Including you, that makes nine. You are the latest to join, but you have the highest cultivation.”
Han Li gave a wry smile under the intense gaze of Gongsun Yun and said, “Sect Leader, making the announcement is fine, but let’s keep my cultivation level a secret.”
Han Li, once considered unremarkable in Tianxuan Mountain, would certainly cause a stir by suddenly becoming the Sect Leader’s last closed-door disciple. If his cultivation level were to leak, it might attract unwanted trouble.
It had not been easy to conceal his cultivation level, and if it were made known to the outside world, it could have some adverse effects, especially since he had quite a few hidden enemies.
“As you wish,” Gongsun Yun nodded without dwelling on the matter. He would only tell a few people and make sure they too kept it to themselves.
“By the way, you should stay on Tianxuan Mountain for now. When you have successfully converted the techniques, and have a basic understanding of Xuantian Punch and God Slaying Sword, you may leave the mountain. If there’s anything you don’t understand, feel free to come to me for guidance.”
Gongsun Yun was quite optimistic about this disciple who knew the value of concealing his talents. Although he had many Gang Yuan stage disciples and some with fifth-grade cultivation talents, the path to reaching the Hollow Void Stage was difficult.
Having talent and practice methods doesn’t guarantee an unimpeded journey in cultivation. The path of cultivation is fraught with various obstacles; one must undergo trials to break through the shackles of the realms.
Take Jiang Cheng, for example. With a sixth-grade cultivation talent, he was generally expected to reach the God Refining Stage, even holding some hope for advancing to the Hollow Void Stage. However, troubled by emotional tribulations, he remained at the ninth layer of the Pihai Realm.
The path of cultivation becomes increasingly difficult the further one progresses. Talent is merely a ticket to entry, indicating the realm one might theoretically achieve.
Those with insufficient talent, but wishing to ascend to higher realms, must find ways to enhance their talent or seek out great opportunities to accelerate their cultivation and thus obtain their entry ticket.
Han Li agreed and left the Xuantian Hall with complex emotions.
Throughout the entire time, Gongsun Yun did not ask what opportunities Han Li had come across or what his current cultivation talent was. This sense of trust left Han Li somewhat at a loss.
On the way to Tianxuan Mountain, although Han Li appeared quite composed, in his heart he felt a bit uneasy, worried that some great disaster might really occur on Tianxuan Mountain.
Unexpectedly, upon his return, he had transformed into a disciple of the Sect Leader of Tianxuan Mountain, advanced directly to core disciple,
With the token given by Gongsun Yun, Han Li took possession of a cave dwelling on Tianxuan Peak, knowing he would reside there for the coming years.
After casually exploring, Han Li found the layout of the cave dwelling to be quite favorable, with an alchemy room, artifact refining room, spiritual medicine garden, meditation chamber, living room, bedroom, and more.
The spiritual energy was already abundant in the small courtyard within the inner section, about five times denser than the outside world, but here it was even three times denser than in the inner section, with a high-grade Spirit Gathering Array gathering spiritual energy.
Soon, Han Li settled down on Tianxuan Peak and, after many years, started cultivating with effort once again.
He needed to transform the True Yuan condensed by the Sacred Heart
Scripture into the True Yuan of the Tianxuan Scripture. The Sacred Heart Scripture was only of Profound Rank mid-grade, but the Tianxuan Scripture was an Earth Rank supreme grade. Once the transformation was complete, his strength would surge significantly.
In addition, he had to cultivate Xuantian Punch and God Slaying Sword, the two ultimate skills of Tianxuan Mountain, and by the way, also cultivate the upper half of the Yin and Yang Palm Seal.
Since he had to cultivate anyway, he might as well cultivate them all together.
Originally, Han Li had wanted to wait for direct rewards from the system, which would immediately be at the perfect level. According to his estimate, rewarding Earth Level Cultivation Martial Skills would probably require thousands of descendants.
That would need at least several decades, and Han Li could not wait that long. Plans cannot keep up with changes, and since the grade of the three ultimate skills was so high and cultivating them could improve his strength, Han Li had no hesitation.
After cultivating in the cave dwelling for a few days, Han Li exited his seclusion. It was not that he had succeeded in his cultivation, but he needed to handle a matter.
During these past days, the news of Han Li being taken as a personal disciple by the Sect Leader had spread throughout Tianxuan Mountain. At Han Li’s request, no grand ceremony was held for accepting him as a disciple; he preferred to keep a low profile.
He sent a junior brother to Lingjun City in Fengyang Manor to deliver a message to the Han Family, to report his safety. Otherwise, with his prolonged absence, not only the Han Family, but other powers in Fengyang Manor would have cause for speculation.
This junior brother was only at the third layer of Pihai Realm and was an old acquaintance of Han Li; he felt quite at ease entrusting this matter to him.
The junior brother agreed immediately without even asking for a reward. Although he did not know why Han Li was taken as a disciple by the Sect Leader, the junior brother felt happy for Han Li.
With Han Li’s connection, his influence on Tianxuan Mountain would also increase. If Han Li broke through to the Gangyuan Realm and became a Great Master, he would also lend his junior brother a hand.
After handling the matter, Han Li returned to his cave dwelling to continue his secluded cultivation; he was eager to complete it and return to Lingjun City.
Having not enjoyed the company of his women, such as Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, for quite some time, and teaching them his ways, Han Li found himself missing them a great deal.
A few more days passed, and suddenly a voice sounded outside the cave dwelling.
“Junior Brother Han, are you there?”

chapters.title: Chapter 52 - 52 Versatile_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Versatile_l
Translator: 549690339
In the cave dwelling, within the seclusion chamber.
Han Li’s eyebrows furrowed slightly. Although he was in seclusion, he kept a strand of spiritual sense monitoring the movements inside and outside the cave.
“Who would come looking for me?”
As this thought emerged in Han Li’s mind, his monitoring spiritual sense probed toward the exterior of the cave dwelling, and he instantly saw an extremely beautiful figure.
The person was dressed in a purple palace robe, with a tall and outstanding figure, delicate and beautiful features, fluttering purple hair, and a lofty and ethereal temperament, like a secluded orchid in an empty valley, stunningly peerless.
“Gongsun Yue?”
Although he had never seen this woman before, he knew that the sect leader had a daughter named Gongsun Yue, regarded as a goddess in the eyes of countless disciples of Tianxuan Mountain.
If someone had come to his cave dwelling on Tianxuan Peak, it must be the sect leader’s daughter.
The two had not had the slightest contact, so why had Gongsun Yue come to find him?
Retracting his spiritual sense, Han Li did not end his seclusion but continued to cultivate. If Gongsun Yue did not leave, he would go out later.
Outside the cave dwelling, Gongsun Yue’s delicate brows furrowed slightly. Her spiritual sense transmitted a message into the cave, which Han Li should have heard by now, yet there was no response.
Was his cultivation too profound? Or was he not in the cave dwelling?
After waiting for the time it took to drink a cup of tea and still no movement from inside the cave, Gongsun Yue took a deep look at the cave dwelling and turned to leave.
News of Tianxuan Mountain’s sect leader taking a new close-door disciple had also reached Gongsun Yue’s ears, and she went to read about Han Li, finding nothing special. His talent was poor, and he was getting on in years.
Gongsun Yue knew her father’s character well; he wouldn’t accept disciples lightly, especially during such turbulent times, so she wanted to see for herself what was so special about Han Li that her father would take him as a close-door disciple.
Unfortunately, she didn’t get to see him.
At the summit of Tianxuan Peak, father and daughter met again.
Gongsun Yun, with his hands behind his back, looked down at the majestic and beautiful mountains and took a deep breath before suddenly asking, “Yue’er, have you made up your mind?”
Beside him, Gongsun Yue, with natural divine beauty and an aura of radiance, her purple hair and gown fluttering as if she could ride the wind away, becoming a heavenly fairy.
Gongsun Yue smiled but did not answer. Instead, she asked, “I heard that father recently accepted a new disciple named Han Li?”
“Indeed. ”
“Why?” “Just following my instincts.”
“Why?” “This disciple and I share a karmic connection.”
“Why?”
Gongsun Yun turned his head to look at his stubborn daughter and sighed in his heart, saying, “Tianxuan Mountain needs an heir, and Han Li is likely to live a longer life.”
That was his inner thought. If Tianxuan Mountain were to be destroyed in this catastrophe, Han Li would inherit the legacy of Tianxuan Mountain, and in the future, he could rebuild it.
As for whether Han Li would die?
Gongsun Yun felt that even if he himself died, Han Li would not.
This disciple of his was too adept at surviving!
Over the past days, he had taken the time to understand his close-door disciple, and the more he knew, the more he felt at ease.
Han Li was very stable, patient, strategic, and cautious. He knew how to conceal his abilities, but most importantly, he knew how to survive.
In over seventy years since leaving Lingjun City, the number of times Han Li had departed was few and far between, hardly ever stepping out of his abode, a perfect, undefeated warrior.
What struck him most was that when Han Li heard Qiu Shuilin mention the White Lotus Cult, his brow furrowed, and he retreated to the back of the crowd, ready to flee the fastest if the situation went awry. This was simply too steady.
Now that Han Li had his chance, Gongsun Yun had imparted all he could and laid out the path for him.
Originally, he had placed his hopes on his daughter Gongsun Yue, but she was stubborn and refused to take refuge at Tai Xuan Sect, wishing to stay with her family instead.
The legacy of Tianxuan Mountain cannot end in his hands; otherwise, in death, he would have no face to meet the ancestral Grandmasters. Fortunately, Han Li appeared at this time, meeting various requirements. He simply decided to pass on the torch of inheritance to Han Li, though he did not state it explicitly.
Otherwise, for a mere seclusion disciple, would he offer such a generous gift for becoming an apprentice?
“A mere Pihai Realm practitioner, living merely three hundred years, how can one speak of long life?” Gongsun Yue frowned, expressing further disbelief in this claim.
Gongsun Yun chuckled and shook his head, “You, oh you, are still too young.”
“Could it be that Han Li is in the Gangyuan Realm?” Gongsun Yue asked again.
Gongsun Yun smiled without speaking, having promised Han Li not to disclose it indiscriminately, he intended to keep his word.
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, half a year had gone by.
At Tianxuan Peak, a long-sealed cave dwelling opened, and a figure of handsome appearance stepped out.
Arriving at the back mountain, Han Li stood on a huge rock with a smile on his face.
Since Gongsun Yue’s disturbance, no one else had bothered him. Han Li devoted himself to cultivation, and after half a year, he finally completed the conversion of his cultivation technique and even made initial progress with the Yin and Yang Palm Seal.
The Xuantian Punch and the God Slaying Sword Technique were of higher grade and more profound and abstruse, but he also gained considerable insight, confident that with more time, mastering them would not be difficult.
Compared to before he returned to Tianxuan Mountain, his strength had increased by two or three times, and once he mastered the two ultimate skills, his strength would rise again.
By then, he might be able to compete with an ordinary cultivator of the God Refining Realm.
After stepping out for a break and appreciating the beautiful scenery, Han Li was preparing to return to the cave dwelling to continue his secluded cultivation.
But a figure blocked his way.
Han Li stopped and looked at the stunning figure before him, frowning slightly, wondering why Gongsun Yue had come to find him again.
Gongsun Yue’s beauty was no less than that of the Lin sisters, Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, but so what?
Han Li was well aware of his own limitations. Unlike the Lin sisters who were helpless and alone, Gongsun Yue was the daughter of the Tianxuan Mountain
Sect Leader, with outstanding talent and a cultivator in the powerful Gangyuan Realm. A daughter cherished by heaven itself, why would she easily marry him and bear his children?
Even if he demonstrated his own cultivation level, there was no guarantee he could successfully pursue Gongsun Yue.
Thus, Han Li had no intention of wasting time on her. With the time spent pursuing Gongsun Yue, he could take many concubines and sire numerous offspring. Who knows, he might even have a breakthrough to the God Refining Realm.
“Sect Sister Gongsun?” Han Li called out, seeking confirmation once again.
The aloof and ravishing Gongsun Yue nodded slightly and said, “I’ve heard that Junior Brother Han has profound cultivation and exceptional strength, skilled in the arts of longevity and is a distinguished individual of our generation; I specially came to meet the junior brother.”
Junior Brother?
Well, sort of.
Han Li did not dwell on the appellation and shook his head, “Where did Sect
Sister hear such rumors?”
“Who in the Sect doesn’t know I have not long to live? My strength is nothing to boast of, just an ordinary talent at best, so how can one speak of distinction?” Han Li replied with a wry smile, his tone sincere.
He just wanted to send Gongsun Yue away as soon as possible and then return to his secluded cultivation. Once successful, he would leave the mountain and return to Lingjun City. Life without beautiful wives and concubines was unbearable indeed; even trying to be an upright support was difficult.
Upon hearing this, Gongsun Yue’s exquisite eyebrows furrowed slightly. She couldn’t see anything special about Han Li, and his tone was very genuine, not seeming to be false. Could her father have been mistaken?
Or was Han Li’s disguise that superb?
Gongsun Yue decided to probe further. If Han Li was truly just an ordinary talent, he could not be entrusted with the Sect’s legacy.
She was about to speak when she heard Han Li say, “I’ve heard that Sect Sister has a tough temperament, not softened by gentleness or hardness – so which is it that you truly favor, softness, or hardness?”
Seeing that Gongsun Yue didn’t give way, Han Li was at a loss on how to proceed; he could only keep her company and play along.
“I can take both, soft and hard.”
Gongsun Yue felt something was amiss, but couldn’t put her finger on what exactly, and responded with a cold voice..

chapters.title: Chapter 53 - 53 Indestructible Vajra Divine Skill 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: Indestructible Vajra Divine Skill 1
Translator: 549690339
“Senior Sister really knows how to… enjoy herself.”
Han Li paused for a moment, then said with a smile.
“What do you mean by that?” Gongsun Yue raised her eyebrows, always feeling that Han Li was saying something she couldn’t understand.
“It’s nothing.”
Han Li shook his head, sincerely saying, “Junior Brother seldom interacts with others and is not good with words. I hope Senior Sister will be indulgent and forgive my lack of eloquence.”
“If I, your junior brother, am ignorant, Senior Sister can educate me verbally as much as needed. Whether in the past or in the future, Junior Brother will certainly not let Senior Sister down.”
Upon receiving the “hidden message” from Han Li, Gongsun Yue nodded her head, a smile appearing on her cold and stunning face as she said,
“Since that’s the case, I, as your Senior Sister, will put more effort into speaking in the future during our cultivation.”
She had read the reports about Han Li, who stayed in Lingjun City for years without venturing out, even Tianxuan Mountain, which explained his lack of interaction with other cultivators; it was understandable.
Having received the goodwill from Han Li, Gongsun Yue felt she should take it seriously. As Han Li was her father’s cherished disciple and held in high hopes, she naturally had to care for him more and must ensure he did not take the wrong path.
Han Li was “moved to gratitude” and said, “For Senior Sister’s kindness, like a drop of water, Junior Brother will certainly return the favor with a spring of gratitude in the future.”
Gongsun Yue faintly felt his words carried a slightly different connotation, but she didn’t think too much of it and decided to start giving more verbal guidance to her little junior brother from that day on.
“Junior Brother, since you have been taken in by the Sect Leader, you must cultivate diligently. It’s best to forget worldly affairs so you can climb to the pinnacle of the Great Path. With your talent, it’s not impossible for you to achieve the status of a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage in the future.”
Gongsun Yue said these words without much confidence. Han Li’s aptitude was only eighth-grade; even if he recovered from an adventure or improved further, it still wouldn’t exceed seventh-grade. Making it to the Hollow Void Stage was tremendously difficult.
Yet, Han Li had asked her to speak more and give more verbal guidance. Considering Han Li’s indulgence in worldly pleasures and the frequent taking of concubines in Lingjun City, Gongsun Yue felt compelled to advise him.
In her eyes, under the focused cultivation at Tianxuan Mountain, Han Li still had hope of becoming a real person of the God Refining Realm in the future.
A trace of surprise flashed in Han Li’s eyes; this Gongsun Yue really couldn’t understand, pure as an untainted white lotus.
“Then, Junior Brother will return to his cave abode to cultivate.” Han Li bowed his hands, his face taking on a solemn expression.
“Go.” Gongsun Yue cleared the way for him.
Her purpose for coming here was almost accomplished, and she even seemed to have steered her little junior brother onto the right path. Watching Han Li’s disappearing figure, she always felt she had forgotten something.
After Han Li walked into his cave abode, the formations and prohibition mechanisms restarted, and he entered a state of secluded cultivation.
Time flew by, and it was four months in the blink of an eye.
In the cultivation room, Han Li was practicing the God Slaying Sword technique. With a thought, strands of sword energy condensed out of thin air, gathering into a longsword and then assembling into a wheel of swords, shining brilliantly as though possessing the might to slay immortals and gods.
“Very good, the first move of the God Slaying Sword technique is finally mastered,” Han Li said, his face breaking into a smile. He had indeed practiced hard for several months.
The God Slaying Sword technique only had four moves: the first to slay mortals, the second to slay the earth, the third to slay the heavens, and the fourth to slay gods.
Someone at the Peak of Gangyuan Realm could barely learn the first move, and after mastering it, they would be able to spar with a real person of the God Refining Realm for a short while.
The Xuantian Punch was of an even higher rank and more difficult to train. Once mastered, one’s combat ability could match a real person of the first level in the God Refining Realm. Han Li had not yet mastered it and estimated that it would take about ten more days.
Just as Han Li was about to continue his seclusion to master the Xuantian Punch in one stroke, a series of prompts echoed in his mind, causing his expression to change slightly.
According to his estimation, the exceptional sisters, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin, were likely to give birth to their offspring soon, with an error margin of no more than half a month.
There had been no hints in the past few days, and he thought there was still time, that he would make it back to Lingjun City to witness the birth of the sisters’ first child.
“Never mind. ”
Typically, he would be present at the birth of a concubine’s child. Since he had missed it, Han Li decided he would compensate the sisters well upon his return.
Immediately after, Han Li checked the system prompt.
“You have fathered your first offspring with sixth-grade aptitude. Your own
cultivation progress, and you acquire the Supreme Grade Profound Rank martial skill [Step Booster Technique].”
“Your cultivation talent has been promoted to sixth-grade.”
“You have fathered your first offspring with fifth-grade aptitude. Your own aptitude has increased by one third of ten percent, you gain fifty years of cultivation progress, and you acquire the Lower-grade Earth-Level martial skill [Golden Bell Shield].”
After reading, Han Li smiled. Indeed, this was like timely rain.
His own talent had already been close to sixth -grade. Having a sixth-grade talented offspring directly promoted him, and the added talents from the fifth-grade talented offspring made his talent quite good among sixth-graders.
In the system’s rewards, below third-grade and middle third-grade talents were thresholds; the birth benefits for fifth and sixth-grade talented offspring were much richer.
Keep in mind that for his first seventh -grade talented offspring, he only received twenty years of cultivation progress and an Intermediate Profound Rank martial skill.
The Supreme Grade Profound Rank martial skill [Step Booster Technique] was precisely the kind of footwork Han Li needed as he previously didn’t possess any noteworthy footwork techniques.
Step Booster Technique could be used not only for traveling but also in combat. When used in a fight, steps shift and change unpredictably, as if stepping upon the constellations; while traveling, one’s feet step upon the Big Dipper’s seven stars. Though one cannot step from star to star, spanning thousands of miles in a single step is no trouble at all.
When perfected, the Step Booster Technique is not inferior to many Lower-grade Earth-Level martial skills.
The [Golden Bell Shield] is even more powerful, arguably an ultimate body-refining technique. After cultivation, the body’s strength surges. When the technique is activated, one turns into a little golden figure. For half an hour, one becomes invulnerable, blades and spears cannot penetrate, nor can thousands of poisons invade; it is exceptionally strong.
This body protection technique has incredibly strong defense. When perfect, an invisible Gang Yuan energy forms around the body extending three feet out. Enemy attacks, whether blades or strikes, are repelled by this invisible energy before they even reach the body.
Not only are enemies unable to harm Han Li’s body, but they may also injure themselves in the process. It harms the opponent unseen.
Unless the enemy’s cultivation far exceeds his, they would not be able to break through Han Li’s defenses.
After claiming these two martial skills, Han Li spent some time absorbing and digesting them, gaining countless cultivation experiences and quickly reaching the perfected level.
Now equipped with powerful footwork and his body protection technique upgraded from the [Golden Bell Shield] and [Iron Cloth Shirt] to [Golden Bell Shield], his weaknesses could be said to have been remedied.
Once he had mastered the Xuantian Punch to a certain degree, his offensive power would greatly increase, and his combat ability would rise once more.
If possible, Han Li would prefer to crush his enemies with a higher level of cultivation than engage in battles beyond his level; but if his cultivation was lesser, he found it acceptable to have a combat ability greater than his true cultivation level, as long as he could defeat his enemies.
Exhaling a breath, Han Li did not delay and continued his closed-door cultivation.
Nine days later, Han Li emerged from his training room once more.
He had been just a step away from entering the threshold of the Xuantian Punch, and with a burst of effort over these nine days, he stepped in and successfully mastered the Xuantian Punch.
The Xuantian Punch consisted of five moves: Earth-Shattering Tide, Dragon in the Field, Traverse the Eight Desolations, Sun and Moon in the Sky, and Xuantian Limitless.
It was said that upon mastering the fifth move, Xuantian Limitless, one would possess a might comparable to a Lower-rank Heaven-Level martial skill.
Han Li didn’t know whether this was true. Nevertheless, his master, Gongsun Yun, had told him so, and warned him never to pass it on privately.
The young seedling of a new book needs nurturing. So far, this book hasn’t even received 100 monthly votes yet.. I’m hoping for your support with more monthly votes, promising a surge of updates upon hitting the shelves!

chapters.title: Chapter 54 - 54 Breakthrough into the God Refining Realm_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Breakthrough into the God Refining Realm_l
Translator: 549690339
After taking a sip of Spiritual Tea in the great hall, Han Li returned to his closed-door cultivation chamber.
Having waited for so long, it was time to break through to the God Refining Realm and become a true person of the path.
By his calculations, his cultivation had accumulated enough.
Previously, he had 60 years of cultivation that had not been claimed, and over the past year, many descendants were born, adding to the ninety years of cultivation he just received, Han Li had amassed approximately 170 years of cultivation.
The difficulty for someone with a seventh-grade aptitude to break through to the God Refining Realm is immense, requiring 300 years of cultivation, but for those with a sixth-grade aptitude, it decreases sharply, requiring only about 150 years.
After settling himself into the lotus position, Han Li directly claimed 150 years of cultivation.
In an instant, this vast cultivation transformed into a mysterious force that entered his Divine Spirit, breaking the restraints that temporarily held it at its limits and beginning its ascension.
Han Li’s Divine Spirit grew four to five times in an instant, and then continued to grow, until, after the mysterious force was spent, his Divine Spirit was nearly seven times stronger than at the peak of Gangyuan Realm.
As his Divine Spirit grew, the Power of the Divine Spirit also surged, and the might of his Spiritual Sense increased dramatically, with its ultimate range reaching a radius of two hundred miles, far surpassing that of many newly advanced cultivators of the God Refining Realm.
Upon becoming a true person of the God Refining Realm, Han Li’s five senses were greatly enhanced; even without using his Spiritual Sense, he could perceive all movement within a radius of three thousand kilometers, with even the crawling of insects unable to escape his perception.
“Huff-
Han Li exhaled a breath, a refreshed expression surfacing on his face.
The sensation of the God Refining Realm was truly exhilarating.
The main enhancement during a breakthrough to the God Refining Realm is to the Divine Spirit, but the internal Gang Yuan also increases, though not as much as the Divine Spirit, by about threefold.
A cultivator at the first layer of the God Refining Realm could easily defeat dozens of Grand Masters at the peak of Gangyuan Realm, and it’s not out of the question for the formidable ones to defeat a hundred, such as Han Li.
Although he currently only had the cultivation of the first layer of the God Refining Realm, his actual combat ability far exceeded his cultivation level, thanks to higher-level cultivation techniques, powerful martial skills, and advanced level martial techniques, which all contributed to a massive increase in Han Li’s comprehensive strength, potentially on par with the mid-stage of the God Refining Realm.
The mid-stage of the God Refining Realm mentioned here refers to ordinary cultivators of the realm, which are those who broke through by cultivating Profound Rank Supreme Grade techniques and who command multiple Profound Rank Top Grade and Supreme Grade martial skills, and may even grasp one or two Earth -Level Lower Rank martial skills.
Having not fought, Han Li did not know his own limits.
Atop Tianxuan Peak, at its summit.
Gongsun Yun looked at Han Li with a complicated expression. Although Han Li tried his best to conceal his aura, he was still detected by him.
Han Li had returned to Tianxuan Mountain for less than a year, and had already broken through from the peak of the Gangyuan Realm to the God Refining Realm. Even with the aid of his Immortal Conservation Pill, the speed was startlingly fast.
Gongsun Yun had originally estimated it would take Han Li ten years to ascend to the God Refining Realm, and with the Immortal Conservation Pill he had given, that time could be significantly shortened.
What Gongsun Yun did not know was that Han Li did not use the Immortal Conservation Pill at all; it was still collecting dust inside his Space Ring.
Speaking of Space Rings, he had also switched to a new one, which was Cui Pingyu’s; its space was dozens of times larger than Han Li’s former one.
Suppressing the shock in his heart, Gongsun Yun asked, “Should we announce the news?”
Han Li was his personal disciple, the one he sought to inherit the legacy of
Tianxuan Mountain, and thus the higher his talent and cultivation, the better.
It was for this reason that he was quite indulgent towards Han Li, granting him great autonomy, as long as he did not privately teach the divine techniques and secrets of Tianxuan Mountain.
Han Li shook his head.
It had been almost a year since he was taken as a personal disciple by the Sect Leader. Initially, the disciples of Tianxuan Mountain were shocked, envious, and jealous, but now they had nearly forgotten him, all because Han Li was too low-profile, remaining on Tianxuan Peak without leaving.
The outside world’s impression of him was still that of a little cultivator, who, luckily enough to become the Sect Leader’s disciple and gain a fortuitous encounter, was at the fifth layer of the Pihai Realm, indulging in his lust for women.
The last label was probably going to follow Han Li for life.
If the news of his breakthrough to the God Refining Realm were to spread, the whole of Tianxuan Mountain would be in an uproar, and all of Leizhou would cast their watchful eyes upon him.
A newly emerged powerhouse of the God Refining Realm could already stand among the upper echelons of Leizhou, with only the four major faction leaders, the Protector General of Leizhou, and the like being higher in status.
Gongsun Yun nodded; he too felt it was better not to announce it; otherwise, it would bring Han Li a lot of trouble.
After a moment of thought, Gongsun Yun asked again, “Is it not too soon to descend the mountain today?”
He was somewhat puzzled by Han Li’s intentions. Wasn’t it good to stay on Tianxuan Mountain? The conditions here were more than a hundred times better than those of Lingjun City.
Han Li was in a hurry to return to Lingjun City, and it couldn’t just be because he missed his group of concubines, could it?
Seeing Han Li nod, Gongsun Yun couldn’t help but say, “My disciple, it is better for a cultivator to keep away from the allure of women.”
“Those wives and concubines of yours, though no doubt beauties of exceptional charm, how long can they accompany you? When the prosperity fades, it all ends in sorrow; not even a beauty can resist the blade of time. In the end, the bloom withers, leaving you only with a desolate remainder of life.”
He had deep understanding of this, for he too once had his own beloved under the moon, but she lacked the aptitude. Despite his utmost efforts to prolong her life, she inevitably left him, beyond his ability to retain.
“Master, there’s no need for you to persuade me further.”
Han Li shook his head slightly, looked toward the vast landscape, and spoke softly, “I fear not only the fading of a beauty’s charm but even more the fragility of her life.”
“Even if a beauty cannot resist the blade of time, at least I have had her once, haven’t I?”
Women like Liu Yuexin and Li Mingmeng, and even the concubines like Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin—who, though only married to him as concubines, could enjoy a life of safety and luxury.
Under his tutelage, their aptitudes had greatly improved, and in the future, they might also step into higher realms, possibly keeping him company into old age.
Gongsun Yun was taken aback and said no more. Such words he would only speak once, but he couldn’t help recalling some beautiful memories that had long been buried.
“Disciple is descending the mountain this time with an indefinite return date, is there anything else you wish to say, Master?” Han Li sighed.
If he didn’t have that golden finger, he would have been willing to lie low on Tianxuan Mountain. But without that golden finger, how could he have caught the eye of the sect leader and been taken as a disciple?
He had almost learned everything he could on Tianxuan Mountain and would not return easily without an extremely important reason.
“Da Qian has already pinpointed the exact whereabouts of the Mother of No Birth; they will take action soon. If she is fortunate enough to escape, you must be extremely cautious,” said Gongsun Yun with a solemn expression.
The Mother of No Birth was a Grandmaster Wanxiang, far more powerful than he, able to suppress him with just a few moves, even if he fought desperately.
Han Li nodded. If the Mother of No Birth were to flee to Leizhou, even gravely injured, she would not be someone he, a real person of the God Refining Realm, could contend with.
“Here I have a Breath Concealing Method that can better help you hide your cultivation level. Remember to cultivate it well after descending the mountain.” “Certainly.”
“Although you act prudently and wisely, knowing when to hide your strengths, you still have room for improvement. Today, as your teacher, I will give you a sixteen-character maxim, which I hope you will heed well.”
Gongsun Yun turned around, looking at Han Li with a serious expression, and said.
“Please speak, Master.”
“Conceal your edge, hide your wisdom, abstain from desire, reflect on oneself, seek substance, speak cautiously, regulate emotions, and incline towards goodness,” Gongsun Yun articulated slowly and clearly.
Seeing Han Li’s perplexity, Gongsun Yun explained further, “Conceal your edge to be invincible, hide your wisdom for self-preservation, abstain from desire to be unfettered, reflect on oneself for awareness, seek substance over form, speak cautiously to avoid disaster, regulate emotions to lessen sorrow, and incline towards goodness to correct oneself.”
Han Li nodded heavily, sensing Gongsun Yun’s earnest concern. Indeed, these sixteen characters merited being called “maxims.”

chapters.title: Chapter 55 - 55 Awareness of Ambush_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: Awareness of Ambush_l
Translator: 549690339
He himself adhered to most of these principles, such as hiding his sharpness, concealing his wisdom, preserving his body, seeking truth, and speaking cautiously, among others.
After decades of dedicated research in these areas, he had become quite proficient.
He even practiced part of abstaining from desires and regulating emotions. Abstaining from desires did not mean eliminating all desires, and regulating emotions was not about becoming emotionless, but about controlling greed, lust, and the other six desires, and mastering one’s own happiness, anger, sadness, and joy.
As for being charitable? Han Li remained noncommittal. He often acted kindly towards others, had his own set of moral standards, and defined goodness in his own terms.
“Master, your disciple shall take his leave.”
Han Li bowed ninety degrees to Gongsun Yun, then turned and left the mountain without looking back.
Watching the departing, upright figure, Gongsun Yun sighed softly. He had done and said all that was necessary. Whether Tianxuan Mountain would survive the impending calamity was now a matter of making the best effort and leaving the rest to fate.
Once he left Tianxuan Mountain, Han Li flew to a sparsely populated area before he started to use the Step Booster Technique, crossing thousands of miles in a single step, heading towards Lingjun City.
The straight-line distance between Lingjun City and Tianxuan Mountain was over two hundred thousand miles. It used to take him a long time to fly there, but with the Step Booster Technique at the perfected level, it was a matter of two hundred steps and wouldn’t take much time at all.
Huozhou City, Royal Manor.
Prince Wu’an was fishing by a pond. There was neither a hook nor a line on his fishing rod, yet he was able to catch fish.
“Marvelous.”
The middle-aged scholar dressed in a blue scholar’s robe clapped his hands in applause.
After fishing for a while longer, Prince Wu’an put the fishing rod aside and asked unhurriedly, “How goes the plan?”
The middle-aged scholar put down his book and replied seriously, “Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong have already carried out your plan. The result will emerge within the month.”
Prince Wu’an picked up the fishing rod again, sitting like an old fisherman with patience to spare.
Eradicating the remnants of the White Lotus Cult was a minor matter to him. He was only concerned about two major issues: one was the opportunity to ascend to the True Martial Realm, and the other was when the mysterious forces stirring troubles in the Daqian Empire would make their next move.
The middle-aged scholar picked up his book and continued to read, a playful smile appearing on his face. If one took a closer look, they would notice three big characters on the cover of the book.
Chaotic Domain.
Deep underground in a mountain range spanning tens of thousands of miles.
“Prince Wu’an has gone to Huozhou to intimidate the Sanzhou region; it will be difficult for little Tianxiang.”
“Should we offer her some support?”
“Little Tianxiang is already a Grandmaster Wanxiang; she naturally cannot be discarded at will.”
“No rush. Prince Wu’an has other objectives in Sanzhou and won’t take action against little Tianxiang personally. Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong are not her match,” someone else said.
“Other objectives? Prince Wu’an is already at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. It’s rumored that he could step into the True Martial Realm at any moment, but he has always been suppressing the breakthrough. Could there be a chance in Sanzhou?”
“Hehe, Prince Wu’an dreams of condensing a Third Grade True Elixir, which is wishful thinking… They will intervene,” said another voice.
Voice after voice rose continuously, revealing an incisive understanding of the situation within the Xuan Domain Great Qian Dynasty, and even Prince Wu’an’s motives were crystal clear to them.
Leizhou, Fengyang Manor.
On a five-thousand-zhang-tall mountain, Yun Miaoyi, scantily clad, displayed her fiery physique with much of her pale skin exposed. She sat on a large rock, idly swinging her crystal-clear bare feet.
This was a necessary passageway from Tianxuan Mountain back to Fengyang Manor. Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi had been guarding this place for almost a year, just waiting for Han Li to return to Lingjun City from Tianxuan Mountain.
Both women were cultivators in the God Refining Realm, with spiritual senses that could cover a hundred miles around, constantly monitoring a vast area. Nothing could escape their notice, and they took turns keeping watch.
They had purchased the latest intelligence on Han Li, knowing that he had been taken in as a head disciple by the Sect Leader of Tianxuan Mountain, Gongsun Yun. It was obvious that he would be given a wealth of resources and treasures.
However, the two women were not the least bit afraid. What could a Gangyuan Realm cultivator do with even the most formidable treasures to escape their grasp?
They were both the favored daughters of their respective sects, endowed with numerous treasures and having practiced their sects’ ultimate techniques. Their strength was not something ordinary God Refining Realm cultivators could match.
“Hey, Jiang Baiye, how much longer until Han Li will be back in Lingjun City?
Could it be that he won’t return?”
After enduring for two hours, Yun Miaoyi couldn’t hold it in any longer and shouted at Jiang Baiye, who was sitting behind her with closed eyes in deep meditation.
Jiang Baiye reluctantly opened her eyes, thoroughly annoyed with Yun Miaoyi, but she couldn’t pretend not to hear, or else Yun Miaoyi would disturb her with a spiritual sense transmission.
“Let’s wait another year. If Han Li doesn’t return by then, we’ll take his entire family,” Jiang Baiye said, then closed her eyes again.
They already knew the reason why Tianxuan Mountain was recalling its disciples, so they were sure that Han Li would return to Lingjun City.
But if Han Li stayed hidden in Tianxuan Mountain and delayed his return, then she would have to do things against her will. She must retrieve the Body-Cultivating Furnace, or else the Canghai Sect would find it difficult to survive this calamity.
Considering how much Han Li cared for his concubines and descendants, if he knew that Han Mansion was in trouble, he would likely rush back immediately. “A year is too long, half a year, at most half a year,”
Yun Miaoyi muttered, but realized that Jiang Baiye wasn’t paying her any attention. Yun Miaoyi didn’t care; she would wait for half a year.
She didn’t have the patience to continue accompanying Jiang the little girl in lying in wait, like guarding a tree stump waiting for rabbits.
One hundred and eighty miles away, a figure stood tall against the sky, furrowing his brow as he looked ahead.
This person was Han Li, returning from Tianxuan Mountain.
Even with the Step Booster Technique, which allowed him to cover thousands of miles in one step, and made traveling very fast, Han Li was still cautious, spreading his spiritual sense along the way to avoid any possible ambush by powerful beings.
With his speed, even if he couldn’t win, he could still escape. The perfected level of his Step Booster Technique allowed him to travel at speeds comparable to an ordinary Grandmaster Wanxiang.
The moment he stepped to this location, as he extended his spiritual sense over the area, he saw two stunning figures on a distant mountain and heard their conversation.
These two beautiful women in the God Refining Realm were actually waiting for him, and it seemed they had been waiting for quite a while.
“As expected, an ambush,”
Han Li muttered to himself. He was just being cautious, but now it seemed there really were people lying in wait for him.
If it weren’t for some fortuitous opportunities he had gained at Tianxuan Mountain, which allowed him to also advance to the God Refining Realm, he would likely have fallen into their hands.
Han Li studied the appearances of the two women carefully, realizing he didn’t recognize them, which puzzled him.
Why would they ambush him without any reason?
And they said that if they couldn’t find him, they would capture his entire family. Clearly, the two women knew a lot about him, including his weaknesses.
Was it the Hehuan Sect acting on the news of Cui Pingyu’s death at his hands, sending someone to assassinate him?
Han Li shook his head; the sultry one looked like a demoness who practiced Devil Cultivation Techniques, but the other one was definitely not from the
Hehuan Sect.
If the Hehuan Sect really found out, they wouldn’t be so courteous, and would have already attacked Lingjun City, destroying the Han Family by now.
The Rebirth Pill formula leaked? The news that he has the Body-Cultivating Furnace? The Daqian National Teacher learned that the Lin family’s remaining members had become his concubines?
After some thought, Han Li concluded that only these matters could bring him such trouble, with the last possibility being very slim, for the same reason as the Hehuan Sect.
Han Li took a long look ahead, then turned and detoured, deciding to avoid the two women and return to Lingjun City first.
For him, it was just a matter of taking an extra step. He would return and plan carefully. Whether it was the Rebirth Pill formula or the Body-Cultivating Furnace, both were of great importance.
He was not confident in taking down the two God Refining Realm women. Since they dared to ambush him, they likely had more than simple tricks up their sleeves.
He preferred to make plans and act later, minimizing risk. After all, he had at least half a year’s time.

chapters.title: Chapter 56 - 56: Big Trouble 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Big Trouble 1
Translator: 549690339
Lingjun City, Han Mansion.
Han Li silently passed through the barrier and entered the back garden. The three ladies resting in the garden, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin, were startled at the sudden appearance, but then their faces bloomed with joy as they gathered around.
“This husband has finally returned-” said Lin Yiwu.
“Husband, I missed you so much- I‘ said Lin Yiyin.
“Husband, did you miss Yao’er?” asked Qiu Yueyao.
Embracing each one and planting a kiss, Han Li then said, “As a husband, I’ve thought of you day and night at Tianxuan Mountain.”
“You’re lying. If you missed us, you wouldn’t come home only once a year,” Lin Yiyin pouted.
“Isn’t it because there were important matters at Tianxuan Mountain?” Han Li rubbed her little head and pinched her cheek.
“Husband, was everything safe on your trip?” Lin Yiwu asked, her pretty face tense with worry that Han Li might have been hurt.
Han Li shook his head and replied, “No, I even gained quite a few opportunities.”
“That’s really wonderful,” beamed Qiu Yueyao, knowing that her husband had gained opportunities and his cultivation would surely improve.
Soon, the news of Han Li’s return spread, and concubines like Liu Yuexin and Li Mingmeng came out one after another to greet and inquire after him.
After a casual chat with them, Han Li cautioned them to keep his return a secret for the time being.
Otherwise, the two female assassins lying in wait would hear the news and come directly to Lingjun City, which would not be good at all.
Back in his bedchamber, Han Li pondered how to deal with the two enemies.
Worried about being discovered, Han Li only spied from afar, aware that the two women were at the early stage of the God Refining Realm, but he was not sure which specific stage they were at. He guessed it was probably the first, otherwise, they would have detected his spying.
The two looked young, clearly talented geniuses from a major sect, with top-tier cultivation techniques and abilities at their disposal, far surpassing his own.
Han Li had the indestructible Vajra body, at the complete level, and the two God Refining Realm True Individuals were still unable to penetrate his protective Gang Yuan Qi, granting him an innate invincibility.
He also possessed the powerful Step Booster Technique, which allowed him to cover a thousand miles in one step, rendering the two God Refining Realm True Individuals unable to catch up with him.
When he sensed the ambush, he didn’t directly break through because he was afraid of alarming them, and he was also concerned that they might have set up a formation.
With three Formation Breaking Beads, even if there was a formation, he could still escape. The two women did not know his true cultivation level, so they most likely did not set up a formation, but it was always best to be careful.
If a battle was inevitable, he would rather choose the battlefield himself and make some preparations in advance.
Before that, he needed to ascertain whether the two were drawn by the Pill Formula for the Rebirth Pill or the Body-Cultivating Furnace so he could respond more effectively.
In the next moment, Han Li’s figure disappeared from Han Mansion, reappearing at Zhenyi Manor.
Now, he had disguised himself thoroughly and even changed his appearance. With his cultivation level, unless a powerful Hollow Realm Master faced him directly, his true identity would remain undetectable.
Once inside Tianji Pavilion, Han Li described the two women’s appearances and purchased the corresponding intelligence. He spent a great deal of Spirit Stones and realized the gravity of the situation.
“This is troubling.”
Back in Han Mansion, Han Li looked at the two jade slips in his hand, which contained the intelligence, his expression solemn.
The jade slips detailed the general information of the two women, and he knew why they had come; it was all because of the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
Jiang Baiye: 72 years old, Fourth Grade aptitude, at the first level of the God Refining Realm, a Core Disciple from Canghai Sect, one of the Ten Major Sects of the Da Qian Dynasty, ranked third. She practiced the “Canghai True
Scripture” and mastered the “Heavenly Sword Technique” and “Canghai Sword Scripture” among other Earth Level Martial Arts. Skilled in swordplay, her strength was comparable to the mid-stage of the God Refining Realm.
Yun Miaoyi: 76 years old, Fourth Grade aptitude, at the first level of the God Refining Realm, a Core Disciple of the Yinyang Sect, practiced the “Extreme Yin
Divine Canon,” and mastered the “Yin and Yang Palm Seal” and “Triple Yin Jie Finger” among other Earth Level Martial Arts. Her strength was also comparable to the mid-stage of the God Refining Realm.
“Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi.”
Han Li murmured the names of these two individuals with an extremely grave expression.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi both hailed from major sects and possessed comparable strength, each almost on par with an average cultivator in the mid-stage of the God Refining Realm. However, Han Li was of the same caliber, and in this respect, he wasn’t worried.
Even if he were to battle the two women, they wouldn’t be able to breach his protective Gang Yuan Qi, nor capture him.
But now that these two had set their sights on him, desiring the
Body-Cultivating Furnace he held, shaking them off wouldn’t be easy.
Whether it was the Canghai Sect behind Jiang Baiye or the Yinyang Sect behind Yun Miaoyi, he could not afford to offend either.
“Why have these two set their sights on me?”
Han Li meticulously recollected the past events. When he killed Lu Renbin, he had destroyed the body and eliminated all traces very neatly, even thoroughly erasing any signs of the battlefield.
Han Li suspected that the primary cause of suspicion was likely from the first battlefield. In order to mislead others, he had not destroyed the corpse and erased traces there. In retrospect, he realized it was a misstep.
During the slaying of the seven loose cultivators, he had used palm techniques and archery, which did not match the martial arts he was known for, nor the spear techniques Li Deshun was proficient in.
Under normal circumstances, no one would step forward for these loose cultivators, nor would they go out of their way to look into these matters or notice the inconsistencies.
But once someone started to seriously investigate, things would not add up. The martial arts used did not align with either of the two, yet the killings were tied to him and Li Deshun, making the discrepancy all too obvious.
“Indeed, the one who stands out gets shot first. The moment one’s strength is exposed, trouble follows,” Han Li chuckled wryly, roughly guessing the situation.
He still wasn’t cautious enough, his actions not secure enough. It had been too long since he had made a move, which resulted in leaving such conspicuous clues. This served as a silent warning for Han Li.
If fishing could be avoided, it should be. He would lay low and keep to himself. Even with a ninety percent certainty, any action that risked exposing his strength was absolutely not to be undertaken.
At this moment, in Han Li’s mind, ninety percent certainty had become synonymous with courting death.
Participating in the loose cultivators’ assembly, he had judged it to be almost a sure thing, with his cultivation more than enough to dominate the scene. The chance of successful fishing without exposure was ninety percent sure.
But in reality, he truly could have exposed himself. But who could blame him when he couldn’t bear to part with the all-important Body-Cultivating Furnace?
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi did not directly approach him, possibly because they hadn’t confirmed their suspicions, given that the level of cultivation he displayed was only at the fifth level of the Pihai Realm, which made it unlikely that he was a Gang Yuan Realm cultivator.
It’s also possible that they did come to his doorstep, but since he wasn’t home, they might be lying in wait outside, expecting him to return from Tianxuan Mountain.
From this, it was evident that the two women had a good understanding of his situation, knowing his whereabouts and weaknesses, otherwise they wouldn’t have thought of using the Han Family to threaten him.
Fortunately, he had hidden his strength well. When he went to Tianxuan Mountain, he was already at the peak of the Gang Yuan Realm, and having returned, he had broken through to the God Refining Realm, significantly boosting his power.
Otherwise, he would have been captured by those two young women.
In rescuing Lin Yiyin and slaying Cui Pingyu, his thoughts were the same. With ninety percent certainty, he proceeded, and although he had not been exposed for the time being, there was still an element of risk.
If the Hehuan Sect were to find out, he would find himself in a great deal of trouble.
In the previous decades, after acquiring the golden finger, things had gone too smoothly for him. A trace of complacency had unknowingly crept into his heart. In simpler terms, he was arrogant, convinced that he would never be exposed, confident in the strength he had concealed, convinced that…
And then, this crisis ensued.
The more Han Li thought about it, the more fearful he became, and the clearer his mind grew. He decided from then onward to be more cautious, to live even more conservatively; without absolute certainty, he could not afford to act.
Once he did, he would leave traces behind, and one day, someone would track them down. After all, he wasn’t too familiar with the strategies of those large forces—who knew if they had any hidden tracking methods?
Without even attaining the True Martial Realm, why should he flaunt himself out there?

chapters.title: Chapter 57 - 57: Ten Principles of Gou Dao—I
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Ten Principles of Gou Dao—I
Translator: 549690339
“Don’t be hardheaded, just lay low,” Han Li muttered to himself. “Life gives you plenty of time to find a hole and burrow into.”
“If you don’t want to cause trouble, just stay at home,” he said. “As long as you don’t go out, you’re the perfect, unbeatable god of war.”
“What’s the point of killing? They’ll still come to your door,” he scoffed. “Kill the young ones, the old ones come; kill the old ones, even older ones show up; and even if you kill them all, you still have to deal with the equivalent of uncles, aunts, direct and distant family; annihilate a whole clan, and there will still be mentors, senior brothers, benefactors, disciples, and even righteous partners…”
“What’s the use of hacking people to pieces,” he grumbled. “It’s better to stay in and lay low, especially when you’re not even in the True Martial Realm; how dare you go out and act recklessly?”
“Laying low until the end, outliving all your enemies, the gifted prodigies and monsters—that’s the way to achieve greatness,” he reflected. “Staying alive is a victory in itself.”
“Never think that just because you’ve transmigrated or have a golden finger, you’re the main character,” he warned. “What if you run into other transmigrators, reborners, or the reincarnation of a powerful being? You could still be cunningly killed.”
“If you want revenge, don’t seek it,” he advised. “Just outlive your enemies, then dance on their ancestors’ graves. Isn’t that delightful?”
Once he calmed down, Han Li’s mind was exceptionally clear, and the Ten Principles of Survival echoed repeatedly in his heart, playing over ten thousand times, constantly reminding him to lay low and not to be reckless.
Han Li decided that every morning, after waking up and exercising, he would recite the Ten Principles of Survival a hundred times to keep himself in check.
As long as he could lay low, his cultivation would steadily rise and prolong his life, and he would eventually outlive his foes.
Han Li even felt that reaching the True Martial Realm wasn’t secure enough and resolved to continue concealing his strength and laying low, as even True
Martial Realm wasn’t invincible
The Daqian Empire surely had True Martial Realm veterans lurking about; Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm could live for two thousand years, and with the empire being just over three thousand years old, it would have perished long ago without such powerhouses.
He hadn’t understood this before, but now it all made sense to him.
Even the True Martial Realm wasn’t safe; didn’t you see the Daqian Empire stealthily developing? It was being threatened by other top- tier forces.
Even within the Xuan Domain, there were several top-tier forces with foundations surely stronger than the Daqian Empire; the most powerful Ancient Empire might even have Divine YUan Realm old-timers.
A Divine Yuan Realm fighter is revered as an Emperor Wu, with a lifespan of five thousand years, longer than the history of the Daqian Empire itself.
During his return to Tianxuan Mountain, Han Li had also checked some classics and learned many secrets of the Cultivation Realm. The more he knew, the more he wanted to lay low.
He learned that beyond the Xuan Domain lay the Devil Region, Dao Domain, Buddha Domain, and other realms and seas, all within a place named Qianyuan Divine Province.
He even found information on a realm above the Divine Yuan Realm, known as the Tongxuan Realm, the real place of great power, where beings could reincarnate and possessed lifespans of ten thousand years.
As for whether the Qianyuan Divine Province still had Tongxuan Realm powerhouses, Han Li wasn’t sure. That was an absolute secret, and his power hadn’t reached that level yet.
“Even the True Martial Realm is too risky,” he muttered to himself. “Better to be a laid-back Divine Yuan Realm, even better to wait until reaching the Tongxuan Realm before making a move.”
Han Li muttered to himself.
Although resolved to lay low and not be rash, he first had to solve a big problem.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi were like the Sword of Damocles hanging over his head, set to attack the Han Family in half a year; but that time wasn’t enough for his power to surpass the two women.
If he were to move the Han Family, the commotion would be too great and it would definitely attract the attention of Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, possibly prompting them to act ahead of schedule.
Only by dealing with these two women could the Han Family continue to flourish, and he could carry on his peaceful survival indefinitely.
After some deliberation, he saw only five options before him.
The first was to move the Han Family without alarming the two women. If that could be done, he could continue to lay low, but the risk was too high. They couldn’t escape the eyes of Tianji Pavilion, and Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi would find him soon enough.
The second was to get rid of the Body-Cultivating Furnace and spread the news, sparking a conflict and thus avoiding trouble.
Setting aside the importance of the Body-Cultivating Furnace for the moment, if neither of the two women were to acquire it, or if neither did, would they take their anger out on him?
Jiang Baiye might not, but what about Canghai Sect? Yun Miaoyi, this witch who sneaked in from the Yinyang Sect, would definitely not let him off easily if she returned empty-handed.
The third option was to give the Body-Cultivating Furnace directly to the two women, letting them fight for it and displaying his own power in the process to intimidate them. He could make them swear an oath that under no circumstances would they involve him or draw the Han Family into the affair from then on.
This would expose his strength and make him a target of others’ jealousy. The first scenario involved both women agreeing to it for the sake of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, freeing him from this trouble once and for all; the second scenario was that Jiang Baiye might agree, but Yun Miaoyi, that witch, would likely refuse.
In that case, he would have exposed both the Precious Body Nourishing
Furnace and his own power without any gain, which carried no small risk.
The fourth option was to offer the Body-Cultivating Furnace to the Daqian Empire, seeking protection from the empire.
This could also rid him of the trouble from the two women, but it might attract even greater problems.
Canghai Sect, out of caution, might not act against the Han Family, but the same could not be said for the Yinyang Sect. Moreover, presenting the Body-Cultivating Furnace was akin to binding himself with the Daqian Empire in a situation fraught with danger and undercurrents – far too risky.
Should war break out, the Han Family might be casually exterminated.
And this was under the protection of the Daqian Empire; if the empire was either unwilling or unable to help, the Han Family and Han Li would meet their deaths even sooner.
The fifth option was for him to take Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi as his concubines or directly suppress them, temporarily resolving the issue.
This would lead to the same outcome as the second and third options if Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi took their anger out on him or refused his offer.
Regardless of whether Han Li had the capability, the disappearance or death of Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi would surely bring about great trouble.
Would not the Yinyang Sect be aware of Yun Miaoyi’s journey to the Da Qian Empire in search of the Body-Cultivating Furnace? The death of an important Core Disciple would certainly prompt an investigation.
The same would apply to Jiang Baiye; Canghai Sect was likely already aware of Fengyang Manor, Lingjun City, and even his name, Han Li.
A top three Core Disciple coupled with the Body-Cultivating Furnace; the Canghai Sect Leader might very well come to kill him directly.
Han Li furrowed his brows tightly; none of these five options were good, each with its risks and the potential to introduce even greater risks.
This was the greatest crisis he had faced so far, one brought on by his inability to resist the temptation of the Precious Body Nourishing Furnace.
Han Li reminded himself once again to adhere to the sixteen-character mantra, to remember the Ten Principles Practice, so that he could live a long and enduring life, abide by the way until the end of time.
After much contemplation, Han Li was still unable to decide which path to take and decided to wait a little longer. There was at least half a year left; perhaps there would be a turn of events.
He already had a rough plan in mind, but he was not very confident about it. He needed to keep refining the strategy, add more chips to his side, and increase the odds of success. He would not take action unless he was completely certain.
Previously, he erred even with a high level of confidence; Han Li took that as a warning to never allow a second failure.
Once he made a move, it had to be with absolute certainty; he must not act if there were any risks involved.
Additionally, this crisis made Han Li realize the need for multiple contingency plans. It would be best to have five, eight, or even ten bolt-holes to lower the risks, moving immediately if one was exposed.
Otherwise, he would find himself in the predicament he was currently in; all his descendants and concubines were in Lingjun City, and thus Han Li was bound to that place.

chapters.title: Chapter 58 - 58: The Seventh Level of the God Refining Realm_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: The Seventh Level of the God Refining Realm_l
Translator: 549690339
Actually, Han Li had a sixth option deep in his heart, which was to abandon all descendants of the Han Family, abandon most or even all of his concubines, and flee far from the Daqian Empire, or even leave the Xuan Domain to continue struggling elsewhere.
But he was reluctant to part with these concubines and to abandon the descendants of the Han Family; otherwise, he would have to start all over again, wasting a great deal of time, with little to gain and more to lose.
This path also carried risks, as his frequent taking of concubines would still draw attention. Once the Canghai Sect and the Yinyang Sect found out, even if they couldn’t pursue him across domains, news that he possessed the Precious Body Nourishing Furnace would attract even greater crises.
Therefore, the sixth path was stillborn and was quickly vetoed by Han Li.
Soon, four months had passed.
In Lingjun City, Han Mansion.
Han Li lay leisurely on his master’s chair, enjoying the service of one beauty after another, all national beauties, and watching many stunning beauties dance gracefully.
Over the past few months, Han Li had been preparing to resolve the great peril facing the Han Family, step by step, until now he felt ninety percent sure.
But Han Li hadn’t struck yet, for fear of capsizing. No one knew what kind of trump cards Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, the two peerless geniuses, were hiding. To say they had none? Han Li was the first to disbelieve that.
Geniuses, apart from their natural talent, encounter various adventures that allow them to grow. During these adventures, they acquire all kinds of methods to enhance their strength.
He strictly controlled the information. Aside from all his concubines, no one knew he was back, not even the descendants of the Han Family. Naturally, Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi didn’t know either and were still vainly waiting for their chance to come to them.
This was also part of Han Li’s stratagem, to make good use of this period of time. In a situation where the enemy was in the light and he was in the dark, he could make many preparations and enhance his chances of dealing with those two young ladies in one fell swoop.
Han Li had also considered going back to Tianxuan Mountain to ask the Sect Leader to capture Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, but this thought was fleeting.
Whether Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi disappeared or died, it would draw the Canghai Sect and the Yinyang Sect’s attention, with Han Li bearing the brunt of it, potentially leading to the destruction of both the Han Family and Tianxuan Mountain.
Tianxuan Mountain wouldn’t be able to withstand the wrath of the Canghai
Sect unless his nominal master, Gongsun Yun, was a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, who could contend with the Canghai Sect Leader using the Mountain Protection Array.
If Tianxuan Mountain had someone of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, even the
Yinyang Sect would be wary, as Tianxuan Mountain was within the Daqian Empire. If they sent a powerful envoy to destroy Tianxuan Mountain, it would alarm the Daqian Empire, which would not stand by and let a sect with a Myriad Phenomena Realm practitioner be destroyed by the Yinyang Sect.
Is Gongsun Yun of the Myriad Phenomena Realm? Is that possible?
Han Li thought it was unlikely, and even if it were true, he couldn’t involve him. Gongsun Yun must have his own reasons for concealing his cultivation level, and it wouldn’t be right for him to expose it.
Better to resolve everything himself. Han Li was confident of handling it all and not arousing the attention of the Yinyang Sect or the Canghai Sect, but he needed time.
Just then, Han Li heard a prompt sound in his mind, and a smile appeared on his face. The moment he had been waiting for had arrived.
“You have seventy descendants with cultivation talent, you gain twenty years of cultivation, you gain one Seventh Grade Lifespan Extension Pill, you gain thirty years of Formation experience.”
Having checked the System prompt, Han Li’s smile grew wider; this was exactly what he needed.
When he reached the ninth level of the Gangyuan Realm, he had three hundred descendants, with sixty possessing talent.
Now, two years later, the number of his descendants had reached 365, with the talented ones being the first to reach seventy.
The cultivation years Han Li had accumulated had risen to eighty-five, enough to significantly enhance his strength.
Unless urgently needed, Han Li always preferred to save up, and then boost his cultivation to the pinnacle of that realm all at once, but now it was urgent, as being at the first level of the God Refining Realm was not enough to successfully capture the two peerless geniuses.
According to Han Li’s previous estimations, with his Sixth Grade cultivation talent, it would take roughly 120 years to reach the peak of the God Refining Realm through normal cultivation; if he encountered adventures, the cultivation time would continue to decrease.
If his talent increased by one grade, the speed of cultivation would also double, meaning that a Fifth Grade talent would only need sixty years.
Previously, the cultivation years he had saved allowed him to advance to around the fifth level of the God Refining Realm; now, it was enough to advance to the late stages of the God Refining Realm.
With cultivation at the later stages of the God Refining Realm, plus his overwhelming combat ability, suppressing two individuals at the initial stage of the God Refining Realm would not be a problem at all.
In fact, a cultivation level at around the fifth stage of the God Refining Realm would suffice to suppress them, but Han Li felt it wasn’t secure enough and waited. The higher his cultivation, the greater his confidence.
Gathering his thoughts, Han Li returned to his sleeping quarters and directly claimed all the accumulated cultivation, which he absorbed in a few breaths. His cultivation soared, his aura reaching the sky, but it was blocked by the formation he had set up, preventing any from leaking out.
“Finally, the later stages of the God Refining Realm.”
Han Li murmured to himself, with joy evident on his face. He was now at the seventh level of the God Refining Realm.
During these four months, his grasp of the Xuantian Punch, God Slaying Sword
Technique, and Yin and Yang Palm Seal deepened. Together with the perfected Step Booster Technique and the indestructible body-protecting skill, Han Li felt that below the Hollow Void Stage, he would be hard-pressed to find an adversary.
“No hurry, no rush, just wait a bit longer.”
Han Li did not immediately proceed to suppress the two ladies. He felt that it was not yet secure enough; right now, he had only a 98% certainty.
98% certainty = courting death!
With plenty of time on his hands, Han Li decided to prepare even more, to give Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi a huge surprise.
Then, Han Li claimed thirty years’ worth of array cultivation which, after some time absorbing, made his eyes shine even more brightly. He couldn’t help but laugh aloud.
The previous thirty years of array cultivation had allowed him to leap to a seventh-grade formation master. The current thirty years of cultivation, though not enough to elevate him to a sixth-grade formation master, was bringing him close
As a top-tier seventh-grade formation master, he couldn’t deduce his own sixth-grade formations, but if he had array diagrams, he could still set up sixth-grade formations.
But Han Li needed more than that.
In the following month, Han Li secretly traveled to various locations in Leizhou to acquire the necessary formation materials, spending a large amount of spirit stones.
With the Step Booster Technique, Han Li moved without a trace, quickly traversing different areas. Even if someone occasionally noticed he had disguised himself and was wearing a face mask, they couldn’t track him.
After these preparations, Han Li quietly returned to Lingjun City.
After another battle with his consorts and thoroughly enjoying himself, Han Li contentedly left Lingjun City and headed for Fenglei Manor to find a secluded spot.
Out of caution, Han Li did not want to go to Yingyuan Mountain for fear of an ambush. He also did not want to take the fight to Fengyang Manor, to avoid causing trouble.
It was better to be far away, significantly lowering the risks,
There, Han Li made thorough preparations and then went to Fenglei Manor City to show himself intentionally, deliberately revealing traces to lure the two ladies over.
He believed that with the methods Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi possessed, they wouldn’t simply wait and would soon follow the trail.
When that time came, he could give Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi a huge surprise, eliminate a major problem for the Han Family, and then he could peacefully lie low, waiting to emerge undefeated.
As for how he would solve it?
A mysterious smile appeared on Han Li’s face as he thought of his preparations. He was absolutely confident that he could control Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi completely.
