chapters.title: Chapter 59 - 59: Holy Abyss_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: Holy Abyss_1
Translator: 549690339
Fengyang Manor border.
Here lies a mountain range that stretches for hundreds of miles, the main peak rising up to 15,000 feet, known as Yingyuan Mountain.
Legend has it that Yingyuan Mountain was formed from a Flood Dragon in ancient times. This Flood Dragon, with profound cultivation, was hunted down to Qianyuan Divine Province, and died in the region where Fengyang Manor is situated. Its body turned into a mountain range, enriching the area with an extremely dense spiritual energy.
Yun Miaoyi didn’t believe this legend one bit.
Having watched over this place for more than a year, she had scrutinized Yingyuan Mountain thoroughly, finding nothing extraordinary about it, and the spiritual energy was not as rich as claimed.
“Could it be that, with the passage of time, Yingyuan Mountain’s spiritual energy has been completely depleted?”
Yun Miaoyi frowned, feeling that it was highly possible.
Even if that Flood Dragon’s cultivation was above the powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm, reputed to be of the Saint Abyss Realm, possessing unparalleled might, an invincible force within its body, it couldn’t withstand the ravages of time.
The Yinyang Sect’s ancient texts contain some records of this, saying that a Saint from ancient times traveled through the Eight Hundred Divine Regions, slaying the evil Flood Dragons of the world. The one that escaped to Qianyuan Divine Province was the last one left in the world.
That ancient Saint pursued the Flood Dragon for three thousand years, ultimately vanquishing it in Qianyuan Divine Province. Its body transformed into the sprawling Yingyuan Mountain.
Just then, a stunningly beautiful lady with silver hair, clad in white robes, carrying an Immortal Sword on her back, arrived flying and landed not far from Yun Miaoyi.
Jiang Baiye glanced at Yun Miaoyi and knew what she was thinking, saying, “You should stop fantasizing about the Flood Dragon’s treasure and the legacy of the Dragon-Slaying Great Saint. Tens of thousands of years, perhaps even more, have passed. Even if there were treasures and legacies, they would have long been claimed.”
During the times Yun Miaoyi kept watch, she would wander aimlessly around and loved to strike up conversations with her. Jiang Baiye’s ears were almost getting calloused from listening.
Yun Miaoyi gave a charming smile, exuding a multitude of amorous gestures. She didn’t really hold any hope; she was just passing the time. But, what if she indeed stumbled upon it?
“Has Han Li shown up?” Yun Miaoyi asked.
They wouldn’t just wait here aimlessly, nor did they want to worry about Han Li potentially taking a detour back to Fengyang Manor or heading elsewhere. Every month, one of the two women would go to Tianji Pavilion in Fengyang City to purchase intelligence on Han Li’s whereabouts.
“He appeared in Fenglei Manor a day ago, ” Jiang Baiye said indifferently.
Yun Miaoyi’s brows furrowed slightly, “What’s he doing in Fenglei Manor?”
According to the intelligence reports, Han Li was not someone who wandered around aimlessly—other than the occasional visit to Tianxuan Mountain, he mostly stayed in Lingjun City.
After returning from Tianxuan Mountain, instead of heading straight back to Fengyang Manor, Han Li went in another direction, towards Fenglei Manor, which seemed suspicious.
Was it a mission from Tianxuan Mountain? Or had Han Li noticed something? Or perhaps there was some business he needed to handle in Fenglei Manor…
All sorts of guesses emerged in Yun Miaoyi’s mind. She stuck out her little tongue and licked her red lips, asking, “Were Qiu Shuilin, Gongsun Yun, and the others with him?” Jiang Baiye shook her head.
“Let’s go.”
Jiang Baiye nodded, and the two immediately left Yingyuan Mountain, heading to Fenglei Manor City.
This was also the reason for Jiang Baiye’s return. If Han Li had taken a detour back to Lingjun City, she would have gone directly to capture him, not caring about Yun Miaoyi, all for the sake of the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
But now, with Han Li’s movements appearing suspicious, she decided it was safer to bring Yun Miaoyi along. Should any mishap occur, the two of them together could handle it.
Both women were of the God Refining Realm and had cultivated high-level movement and footwork techniques to a profound depth, giving them incredible speed that could match an average Hollow Realm Master.
The trip from Lingjun City to Tianxuan Mountain, which Han Li had taken, had taken him well over ten days, and Fenglei Manor was even farther, yet the two women covered the distance in a very short time.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi hurried to Fenglei Manor City in a flurry. After a brief inquiry, they learned of Han Li’s exact whereabouts.
Han Li had arrived at Fenglei Manor City the previous evening, staying at the Yunling Inn. He left the city early the next morning, heading a thousand miles west of the city to Myriad Sky Mountain. His purpose was unclear.
The two women exchanged a glance and immediately decided to rush to Myriad Sky Mountain.
Although they did not know Han Li’s purpose for going to Myriad Sky Mountain, they were both highly skilled and daring, paying no heed to these trivial details.
If their guess was correct and the seven Loose Cultivators were killed by Han Li, then it was highly likely that Lu Renbin was also killed by Han Li.
From the crime scene investigation, the person who killed the seven Loose Cultivators had, at most, the cultivation level of Gangyuan Realm. If Han Li was in the Gangyuan Realm, given the time it took for his breakthrough into the Pihai Realm, it’s estimated that Han Li would be in the early stages of the Gangyuan Realm.
That was already a high estimate from the two women; in reality, they hardly believed it. An eighth -grade talent cultivating so quickly? What a joke.
They weren’t looking down on Han Li; they even speculated that he might be at the peak of the Gangyuan Realm or even the God Refining Realm, but the higher the cultivation level, the less likely it seemed.
The probability of Han Li being in the God Refining Realm was almost nonexistent; even if Han Li had encountered some miraculous fortune, it wouldn’t be possible for him to cultivate from the first level of the Pihai Realm to the God Refining Realm in a mere twenty years.
Although they felt it was unlikely, what if?
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi didn’t indulge in wishful thinking, which was why they joined forces to come here. They were extremely cautious in their hearts, worried about a possible ambush by Han Li.
Even if Han Li was in the early stages of the God Refining Realm, he wouldn’t be able to defeat their joint efforts.
Atop Myriad Sky Mountain.
Han Li stood at the peak, his green robe billowing, looking at the magnificent view in front of him, he couldn’t help but exclaim,
“Glory breaks through a thousand layers of clouds, the vast mountains and rivers remain unmatched.”
He stood on the mountain peak, as far as his eyes could see, one summit after another stood tall, piercing the heavens; the mountain range lush and verdant, with white clouds chasing and playing.
At the end of his vision, a great sun was setting in the west, releasing a brilliance of ten thousand Zhang, piercing through the myriad layers of cloud sea, illuminating the splendid mountains and rivers.
Gazing upon this beautiful scenery, Han Li’s mind couldn’t help but open up, enjoying the rare sight.
Suddenly, Han Li’s brow furrowed as he sensed two powerful auras entering the range of his Spiritual Sense.
When he had just broken through to the God Refining Realm, his Spiritual Sense could cover a radius of two hundred li. Now that he had broken through to the seventh level of the God Refining Realm, his Spiritual Sense directly expanded to cover a thousand li.
Extending to the limit was hugely draining on his mental strength, and it put a significant burden on his Divine Spirit, not to mention that it was easy to overlook things, so Han Li only covered a radius of two hundred li with his Spiritual Sense.
Within this two hundred li range, even if a strong practitioner in the God
Refining Realm attempted to sneak in, he could detect them with ease. Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi’s Spiritual Senses were far less powerful than Han Li’s; they had already exposed their tracks without realizing it.
“They’ve finally arrived.”
Han Li didn’t turn around, yet a smile appeared on his face.
He had made all the preparations, now he just waited for these two fish to take the bait.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi regarded the Body-Cultivating Furnace with great importance indeed. Han Li had only leaked his whereabouts yesterday evening, and by this afternoon, they had already rushed over, their speed was undeniably swift.
Han Li’s Spiritual Sense kept a close watch on the two women, seeing that they flew unhurriedly, yet their expressions were calm, with a trace of concern in his brows.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi had indeed sensed something. Even if they believed his cultivation was low, they remained cautious, not hastening to Myriad Sky Mountain.
Along the way, their flight seemed leisurely and relaxed, but in their hearts, they were always on guard, wary of a potential ambush by a powerful adversary.
What they feared most was that Han Li had handed over the Body-Cultivating Furnace to Tianxuan Mountain and then set up a trap with the strong practitioners of Tianxuan Mountain.
Of course, both women felt this possibility was extremely unlikely, as improbable as Han Li being in the God Refining Realm—so improbable as to be nearly impossible.
They had gathered information on Han Li; with such a treasure as the Body-Cultivating Furnace, he would never present it to Tianxuan Mountain but would rather keep it within the Han Family.
Who would have thought that Han Li valued the Han Family too dear? With the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the Han Family had a great chance of developing into the new Canghai Sect, or at the very least becoming a power of Tianxuan Mountain’s caliber.

chapters.title: Chapter 60 - 60 Failed Transaction_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Failed Transaction_l
Translator: 549690339
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi let out sighs of relief since they hadn’t been attacked on their way to Myriad Sky Mountain.
The two women didn’t let their guard down, Han Li’s presence here was too abnormal. He was standing conspicuously on the peak, clearly serving as bait to lure them into a trap.
But the women felt they had no choice but to take the bait. What if they didn’t come forward and Han Li disappeared again? The Body-Cultivating Furnace was essential, and they didn’t wish to continue lingering.
This was an open strategy.
Confident in their strength, the two women had it all figured out— the powerhouses from Tianxuan Mountain couldn’t possibly be here.
If Han Li had handed over the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the whole of Tianxuan Mountain would be on alert, with strict control over information, and Han Li wouldn’t be allowed to wander about; if he hadn’t handed it over, it was even less likely for Tianxuan Mountain’s powerhouses to be present.
The women didn’t fly up to the mountain right away but checked the area first.
After confirming there were no ambushes by powerful cultivators on Myriad Sky Mountain and reconfirming that Han Li’s cultivation was indeed at the fifth level of the Pihai Realm, they then flew toward the summit.
As they drew increasingly closer to the mountaintop, both Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi became solemn, immensely vigilant, and cautious of one another.
There was a very high chance that the Body-Cultivating Furnace was on Han Li, and his presence here meant that they could obtain the furnace today.
However, the two women stood on different grounds.
Yun Miaoyi represented the top-ranked devil sect, Yinyang Sect, while Jiang Baiye represented Canghai Sect. Moreover, the Body-Cultivating Furnace was originally a treasured artifact of the Canghai Sect.
Both were determined to have the furnace, and with such a treasure in sight, neither wished to yield. A fierce battle was inevitable later on, one that would decide to whom the Body-Cultivating Furnace would belong.
Although both women intended to contend for the furnace after it appeared, neither knew if the other would launch a surprise attack. They had to remain exceedingly cautious to avoid being capsized in the gutter.
Atop the mountain, Han Li was facing away from the women, seemingly oblivious to the approach of Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi.
In reality, he was fully aware of their every move. Seeing that they didn’t take action early, he felt a tinge of disappointment, for the favored daughters of the great sects were indeed tougher to deal with.
They hadn’t been blinded by the great treasure, resorting to violence before the situation became clear, or attacking the other stealthily.
But Han Li was only slightly disappointed, as all this was within his expectations.
Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye stood to the left and right, about a dozen meters apart. Neither of them made the first move but shared a tacit understanding.
They would vie for the Body-Cultivating Furnace only after it appeared; before then, they didn’t want Han Li to fall into the other’s hands, as he was the key to obtaining the furnace.
“Han Li?”
Yun Miaoyi glanced at Jiang Baiye and called out.
Jiang Baiye immediately prepared to act, mentally communicating with the Divine Sword she carried on her back.
When Han Li turned around and his eyes lit up upon seeing Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, he believed the Tianji Pavilion’s intelligence that both women were peerless beauties.
Jiang Baiye was unrivaled in her cold beauty, like a white-haired female sword immortal from afar; Yun Miaoyi radiated charm in abundance, the very image of an enchanting witch.
Looking at the women, Han Li’s mind remained clear of distractions, and he simply nodded slightly.
Upon seeing Han Li’s features, the hearts of Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye relaxed —it was indeed Han Li. They had long since obtained his portrait and had it etched in their minds.
“You killed Lu Renbin, didn’t you?”
Just as Yun Miaoyi was edging closer to Han Li, trying not to show her intent, Jiang Baiye suddenly spoke.
“Correct.”
Han Li did not deny it. After noticing the women plotting to ambush him, he knew that the past events had come to light.
With both women having pursued him here, denying it would serve no purpose.
“Where is the Body-Cultivating Furnace?”
Yun Miaoyi asked hastily, wanting to move closer to Han Li without giving herself away, but she received a cold look from Jiang Baiye.
After restraining Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye stared intently at Han Li, very eager to know the whereabouts of the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
But she raised her vigilance to the highest level in her heart. The reason she and Yun Miaoyi hadn’t started fighting was precisely because the whereabouts of the Body-Cultivating Furnace were unknown. What if Han Li had hidden the Body-Cultivating Furnace?
Once the location of the Body-Cultivating Furnace was exposed, Yun Miaoyi would definitely make her move immediately, as would she; then it would come down to a contest of strength.
Han Li did not answer Yun Miaoyi’s question, but narrowed his eyes and said in a deep voice, “I want to make a deal with you both.”
“What deal?” Jiang Baiye asked in a cool voice.
Yun Miaoyi looked at Han Li with a playful expression. This Han Li was nothing like the rumors.
The rumors had it that Han Li was a greedy ancestor who indulged in female charms, a coward hiding within Lingjun City, never venturing out to vie for resources, almost never taking action, a mediocre cultivator who had his edges worn down.
But at this moment, Yun Miaoyi felt that those were all just Han Li’s deceptions.
Han Li had realized that they were on the trail of the Body-Cultivating Furnace and were targeting him, and had procured their information in advance. Yet he deliberately lured the two to Myriad Sky Mountain; one had to say his courage and insight were exceptional.
Upon seeing these two remarkable women, there was no trace of frivolous thoughts or desire in Han Li’s eyes. Where was there any hint of greed for female charms?
Being able to kill Lu Renbin meant that Han Li’s cultivation was not limited to the fifth layer of the Pihai Realm; he must be at least a Great Master of the Gangyuan Realm.
Faced with the two true cultivators of the God Refining Realm, he remained unruffled and calm, wanting to negotiate a deal with them.
The Han Li before them was indeed courageous and wise, exceptionally insightful, extremely clear-headed, and also blessed with an attractive appearance.
Yun Miaoyi sneered to herself. No matter how cunning Han Li was, his cultivation was always too weak; he could not escape the palm of her hand.
Han Li’s expression was impassive as he looked at the two women and said, “I can hand over the Body-Cultivating Furnace, but you must promise that whoever obtains the Body-Cultivating Furnace must not trouble me or the Han
Family by any means.”
“I agree.” Yun Miaoyi said with a giggling smile.
Jiang Baiye glanced at her and said nothing, merely nodding in agreement.
“Then swear by your Daoist oaths.” Han Li said indifferently.
“Fine. ”
Frowning slightly, Jiang Baiye still agreed.
Han Li looked towards Yun Miaoyi. Yun Miaoyi sneered and said dismissively, “You’re not qualified to make a deal with me.”
“Hand over the Body-Cultivating Furnace now, or else not only will you die, but all your pretty little concubines and the entire Han Family will be annihilated.”
As a witch, she could go back on something she agreed to at the drop of a hat without any burden.
But if she swore by her Daoist oath, that would be a different matter. If she broke it, her Daoist heart would indeed be harmed, clouded, making her breakthrough to the Hollow Void Stage much more difficult, not to mention hoping to ascend to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
She had taken great risks to infiltrate the Daqian Empire, spending so much effort and time. If she did not acquire the Body-Cultivating Furnace, she would have suffered a great loss.
She would then have to vent her anger on Han Li. If it weren’t for Han Li killing Lu Renbin, she might have found him first and obtained the Body-Cultivating
Furnace.
Han Li sighed inwardly. This approach was indeed a dead end; he had only wanted to try before taking action. If it had worked out, he would have been out of the picture, but unfortunately, Yun Miaoyi, the witch, would not agree.
“Boom!”
Before Yun Miaoyi’s words had fully settled, Han Li made his move, striking with full force and without the slightest hesitation.
Since they couldn’t reach an agreement, he had no interest in further idle talk; he would deal with the two young women after capturing them.

chapters.title: Chapter 61 - 61 Initial Battle_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Initial Battle_l
Translator: 549690339
Han Li threw a punch, and in a flash, a colossal fist imprint coalesced, roaring towards Yun Miaoyi with the momentum of toppling mountains and overturning seas.
Yun Miaoyi reacted swiftly, surprised by Han Li’s decisiveness. Although Han Li was only in the Gang Yuan Realm, she did not hold back at all—her philosophy was to exert full strength even when a lion fights a rabbit.
She struck out with a palm, the Yin and Yang Palm Seal cutting across, with the Yin and Yang energies swirling on it, its might overwhelming the heavens. It was more than ten times stronger than when Cui Pingyu executed the same move.
Inside her, the extremely cold scripture cycled rapidly, with a massive amount of True Yuan gathering in her left hand to unleash the Three Yin Devastating Finger. Even if Han Li blocked the Yin and Yang Palm Seal, he wouldn’t be able to fend off the Three Yin Devastating Finger.
Elsewhere, the moment Han Li made his move, Jiang Baiye sprang into action. The Divine Sword on her back flashed out of its sheath, striking at Han Li with no reservations.
This sword carried the profound weight of the sea, sweeping across the world with an unstoppable force, its sword energy rampaging and sweeping everything aside.
Having an understanding with Yun Miaoyi, if Han Li resisted, they would first severely injure him, reducing him to a non-threat before discussing anything else—it didn’t matter now with the Body-Cultivating Furnace within reach.
After delivering a punch to Yun Miaoyi, Han Li had anticipated that Jiang Baiye would make a move. Facing the sword strike from Jiang Baiye, he did not defend. Instead, his right hand drew the Wenxuan Sword, and brilliant sword energy surged forth.
Burial Style!
All this seems slow when described, but in reality, it all happened in an instant, and the intense battle erupted the next moment.
Han Li’s Xuantian Punch, with the force of toppling mountains and overturning seas, effortlessly shattered the Yin and Yang Palm Seal, then ground away the Three Yin Devastating Finger, persisting in its path towards Yun Miaoyi.
Yun Miaoyi’s face showed shock; realizing from the destruction of the Yin and Yang Palm Seal that Han Li was definitely not in the Gang Yuan Realm, but rather in the seemingly impossible God Refining Realm.
Moreover, Han Li’s cultivation level was even higher than hers!
The ultimate technique of Tianxuan Mountain, the Yinyang Sect’s records, identified the technique executed by Han Li as the Xuantian Punch—the strongest art of Tianxuan Mountain.
The Xuantian Punch and the Yin and Yang Palm Seal were both Earth-Level Extreme Martial Arts. In theory, their powers should be nearly equal, which meant it all came down to who had the higher cultivation and who had mastered their art to a higher level.
Her Yin and Yang Palm Seal had been cultivated to near-perfection. With her second-tier God Refining Realm cultivation, to have her move so easily crushed was a testament to Han Li’s strength.
As the Xuantian Punch obliterated the Three Yin Devastating Finger, Yun
Miaoyi flashed to the side, narrowly avoiding the residual force of the punch.
On the other side, Han Li’s dazzling sword energy eradicated Jiang Baiye’s vast sword energy, continuing towards her, causing a slight furrow in her brow.
Her keen mind quickly assessed the situation, seeing through Han Li’s disguise and recognizing that his cultivation surpassed hers.
Without the luxury of shock, Jiang Baiye did not dodge. Instead, she struck out with two more swords, sweeping forward like the sea, colliding with the brilliant sword energy that seemed intent on burying her, neutralizing it with her relenting power.
Yun Miaoyi joined Jiang Baiye’s side, facing Han Li together. In exchanging just a move or two, Han Li brought immense pressure on both of them.
The once seemingly docile Han Li had, in their eyes, no power to resist. The two were the real competitors for the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
But now, they realized how wrong they had been, egregiously so.
Han Li had concealed his power too deeply, fighting both of them without falling short, his strength absolutely surpassing theirs.
Most likely, Han Li was in the middle phase of the God Refining Realm; coupled with his profound mastery of ultimate techniques, his strength was formidable.
Only by joining forces and setting aside their rivalries could they have a chance to defeat Han Li, or at least protect themselves.
As Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi exchanged glances, they saw a serious look in each other’s eyes, recognizing that the chance to obtain the Body-Cultivating Furnace was slim.
Still, they wanted to give it a try. If there was no sliver of hope, they would simply leave and call for stronger reinforcements, directly attacking the Han Mansion.
Seeing that both women had temporarily ceased their attacks, Han Li too refrained from immediate action, reassessing Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi’s strength in his mind.
Previous intelligence was misinformed; Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi had broken through to the second tier of the God Refining Realm, greatly boosting their strength, and they both had a high level of mastery over their ultimate techniques.
At the same level of cultivation, with his Xuantian Punch and God Slaying Sword Technique yet to reach the minor achievement realm, he was certainly no match for the two women.
Luckily, he had always been cautious. Only after cultivating to the seventh layer of the God Refining Realm did he make a move against the two women. His cultivation was five minor realms higher than theirs, and even if the level of his divine techniques was not as high, he could still overpower them with his strength.
The situation was still under his control.
“Later, you take the lead, and I will look for an opportunity to ambush him.
Hopefully, we can seriously injure him in one fell swoop,”
“Agreed. ”
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi exchanged messages through voice transmission and immediately took action again.
This time they held no contempt, attacking with all their might, solely focused on defeating Han Li.
Jiang Baiye wiped her left hand on the Divine Sword as if unlocking the sword’s bindings. With her movements, the might emanating from the Divine Sword grew increasingly immense.
This Divine Sword was a top-grade Earth Rank Artifact, as well as Jiang Baiye’s greatest reliance. In conjunction with the Heavenly Sword Technique she possessed, it was enough to cause her strength to surge.
Under normal circumstances, the Ice crystal Sword was kept sealed, exhibiting only the strength of a Supreme Grade Profound Rank spiritual artifact to avoid attracting the attention of Hollow Realm Masters or even the Grandmaster Wanxiang.
But at that moment, Jiang Baiye unleashed her full combat ability, brandishing the Ice crystal Sword towards Han Li. Sword qi filled the sky, rampaging unrestrainedly like dancing dragons and snakes, resembling a reversed flow of the Milky Way.
As Jiang Baiye made her move, Yun Miaoyi also acted, a crescent moon blade flying out from her sleeve. Leaping into the air, she grasped it and slashed at
Han Li.
A small tower endures a night of spring rain, Devil Sword listens to the rain Breaking Red Dust!
Although the Yin and Yang Palm Seal and Three Yin Death Finger were both excellent techniques with astonishing power, Yun Miaoyi’s forte lay in the blade, which was her secret, known by very few.
The Devil Sword Spring Rain was also a top-grade Earth Rank Artifact, Yun Miaoyi’s trump card, and naturally, there was a reason she could fight Jiang Baiye to a standstill.
As Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi launched their attacks, Han Li was not idle. In fact, the moment Jiang Baiye began to unseal the Ice crystal Sword, Han Li had already made his move. He would not just watch as Jiang Baiye activated her powerful technique.
The Ice crystal Sword posed a significant threat to him, being too sharp and stronger than the Wenxuan Sword he held in his hand. At the very least, it was an Earth Rank Artifact, possibly even a top-grade one.
The powerful aura of the seventh layer of the God Refining Realm was released without reservation, and his spiritual sense, comparable to that of the ninth layer, also burst forth, fiercely assaulting both women.
Boom!
A terrifying might burst forth at the mountain peak, instantly shattering it, causing Myriad Sky Mountain to drop by several meters.
The bright display of blade and sword danced at that moment, reflecting against the billions of rays of dawn, sketching out an enchanting tapestry.
Bang! Bang!
Han Li’s figure suddenly appeared behind Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, his left hand forming a fist seal, and his right hand executing a sword technique, ferociously attacking the two women from behind.
Han Li was very clear about his strengths and weaknesses. With his mastery of the Xuantian Punch and God Slaying Sword Technique still at a low level, even with his powerful cultivation, he couldn’t easily defeat the two women.
His advantage lay in his movement technique and body-protecting divine skill. The Step Booster Technique and the Invincible Body-Protecting Divine Skill made him unbeatable. If they couldn’t break his defense or hit him, they couldn’t win.
Just now, he feinted an attack, leading the two women to believe he was fighting desperately, but in actuality, he stepped behind them in one move.
Step Booster Technique could cover thousands of miles in one step—its limit. In other words, he could appear anywhere within a thousand miles in one step.
PS: I, riding the void and commanding the wind, have returned. Cackle, cackle, cackle, the update is here on time, hoping for a wave of support..

chapters.title: Chapter 62 - 62 Victory and Defeat Decided 1
chapters.content:
62  Chapter 62 Victory and Defeat Decided_1
```
Boom!
As soon as Han Li launched his attack, both Jiang Baiye's sword and Yun Miaoyi's blade followed suit, leaving no extra opportunity for Han Li.
While engaged in battle, the spiritual senses of the two women were constantly on alert, covering a vast area. Even if Han Li's spiritual sense interfered, they swiftly recovered.
The clash was evenly matched.
Han Li deliberately restrained his strength, not going all out, hoping to lull Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi into a false sense of security and thereby gain an advantage.
An intense fight broke out, with three figures crisscrossing through the air, the engagement was fierce.
Jiang Baiye exerted herself to the fullest to wield the Ice Crystal Sword, while Yun Miaoyi also used her Spring Rain with all her might, launching continuous attacks around Han Li, almost as if the sword and the knife were moving in unison. However, all of them were blocked by Han Li's protective Gang Yuan, unable to break through his defense.
On the other hand, Han Li showed no inclination to defend, using the Xuantian Punch in his left hand and the God Slaying Sword in his right, while stepping with the Step Booster Technique and moving unpredictably according to the Big Dipper formation.
One moment he was behind Jiang Baiye, the next above Yun Miaoyi, or even below Jiang Baiye. With each step, he remained composed, yet his attacks were fierce and ruthless.
It seemed as though Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi were two against one, but in reality, they could only parry as if being besieged by Han Li alone from the heavens, the earth, and all directions.
"Jiang Baiye, do we keep fighting?"
While fighting, Yun Miaoyi sent a telepathic message to Jiang Baiye, already harboring thoughts of retreat.
At this point, it was clear they could not win the Body-Cultivating Furnace; Han Li's strength was too great. Even together, they were no match for him.
If they could not win the Body-Cultivating Furnace, Yun Miaoyi did not want to keep dragging out the conflict. Even if Han Li couldn't defeat them in a short time, remaining here posed too great a risk.
The fight between the three God Refining Realm cultivators was earth-shattering, causing the mountains near Myriad Sky Mountain to shrink by a fraction, destroyed by the aftershocks of battle.
Such commotion would surely draw the attention of the Da Qian Empire. If a Guru in the Void Realm from the official ranks of Leizhou were to arrive, she could very well lose her life.
If it were anyone else, Yun Miaoyi would not have hesitated for a moment and would have run away immediately, but she was teamed up with Jiang Baiye.
If she fled by herself, Jiang Baiye would quickly be captured or slain by Han Li, a result Yun Miaoyi did not want to see.
Boom!
Jiang Baiye unleashed a sword strike, blocking another of Han Li's attacks, but hesitated upon hearing Yun Miaoyi's telepathic message.
The significance of the Body-Cultivating Furnace was beyond question, and it was also related to the chance of entering the Secret Territory. If she could enter the Secret Territory, her chances of becoming a Great Grandmaster in the Myriad Phenomena Realm would significantly increase.
But was there any chance now to take back the Body-Cultivating Furnace?
Using the Ice Crystal Sword, she performed the Heavenly Sword Technique, while Yun Miaoyi used Spring Rain to execute Breaking Red Dust. These were their strongest attacks, meant for fighting together, yet they were being driven into a difficult situation.
Both of them, being women of peerless grace, also cultivated powerful earthly step techniques and movement techniques, but they were only at an early stage of proficiency, and paled in comparison to Han Li's Step Booster Technique, which he controlled rhythmically.
Not only was Han Li's cultivation level higher than theirs, but he had also cultivated an exceedingly formidable protective cultivation technique. The protective Gang Yuan formed by that technique effortlessly blocked their attacks.
Whether it was the Ice Crystal Sword, Spring Rain, or the Sword Intent and blade techniques they displayed, none could get close to Han Li's body and were instead stopped by an invisible protective Gang Yuan three feet away.
Unable to touch or land a hit, Jiang Baiye felt extremely helpless.
"Retreat."
Soon, Jiang Baiye made her decision.
Since the Body-Cultivating Furnace was in Han Li's possession, and since she could not take it back, then her master would have to retrieve it. If the Tianxuan Mountain Sect Leader dared to interfere, then the Canghai Sect Leader would take action.
The two women quickly consulted in secret and decided to launch a fierce counterattack before seizing the opportunity to escape.
Han Li's movement technique had an advantage in short-distance shifting, whereas their cultivated movement techniques and step techniques were better suited for travel, running away. As long as they found the opportunity to escape, Han Li surely couldn't catch up.
```
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Leizhou's silhouette flashed with unpredictable movements, weaving between the two women, executing the Xuantian Punch, the God Slaying Sword Technique, and even the Yin and Yang Palm Seal.
The intense onslaught left Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi secretly groaning in pain, unable to find an opening to escape, forced only to tirelessly defend and counter.
When Yun Miaoyi realized that Leizhou could use the Yin and Yang Palm Seal, she instantly knew he was the murderer of Cui Pingyu. However, she didn't make threats about the Yinyang Sect hunting him down.
She understood that such threats were useless; Leizhou's use of the sect's technique meant he was determined to keep her and Jiang Baiye there.
"There's no chance."
At that moment, Jiang Baiye's cold voice reached her mind, tinged with hints of urgency.
Yun Miaoyi bit her silver teeth and sent a telepathic message, "Then we'll have to create an opportunity."
Leizhou was so slippery that they couldn't attack him proactively, only able to retaliate when he appeared to attack them.
But their counterattacks were weak, utterly failing to break through Leizhou's protective Gang Yuan, not to mention inflicting any injury on him.
On the contrary, both of their dresses were now torn to pieces, exposing large swaths of their fair skin, drawing the eye irresistibly.
Seizing the moment when Yun Miaoyi was distracted, Leizhou appeared behind Jiang Baiye, thrusting his sword imbued with the Sword Intent capable of burying all in its path, a majestic sword aura cascading forward like rivers flowing into the sea.
Jiang Baiye swung her sword, the Ice Crystal Sword slashing in a profound trajectory, carrying a hint of heavenly mandate, clashing against Leizhou's attack.
As they collided, Leizhou vanished, only to reappear behind Yun Miaoyi in an instant, launching another God Slaying strike.
Yun Miaoyi pointed a finger, and a massive surge of Gang Yuan burst forth like a torrent, freezing and then shattering swathes of the surrounding air.
Leizhou disappeared again and the next instant appeared above Yun Miaoyi, a wave of spiritual sense assaulting her, as both of his hands formed fist seals, ruthlessly battering down on her.
Previously, he had intentionally attacked Jiang Baiye once and then Yun Miaoyi once, never alternating, to lull the two women into a false sense of security.
When Leizhou appeared, Yun Miaoyi actually smiled, her smile blooming like a flower, exuding charm, as if she had long predicted Leizhou would do so.
Boom!
Her long-cultivated secret technique erupted in a flash, significantly boosting her aura by a large margin, ascending to the mid-stage of the God Refining Realm, nearing the late stage.
With her strength greatly increased, Leizhou's spiritual sense had little effect on her. The Devil Sword Spring Rain flew from her hands, unleashing the mightiest move of the Breaking Red Dust Technique.
Even if it couldn't break Leizhou's protective Gang Yuan and seriously harm him, it could still send him flying, buying them time to escape.
In the instant of their clash, Jiang Baiye also made her move, brandishing the Ice Crystal Sword and executing the strongest move of the Heavenly Sword Technique, piercing the air with an irresistible heavenly command that locked onto Leizhou.
Faced with the most powerful strikes from the two women, Leizhou too revealed a hint of a smile and voluntarily activated the Indestructible Body-Protection Divine Skill.
In an instant, his body radiated golden light, transforming into a little golden figure, entering the half an hour state of the Indestructible Body.
Yun Miaoyi's mightiest blade shattered his two fist seals and continued barreling towards Leizhou, with Jiang Baiye's mightiest sword strike arriving almost simultaneously.
Boom! Boom!
The blade and sword struck his protective Gang Yuan, and instead of breaking through, the force was equally reflected back upon Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi.
In a flash, both women trembled, uncontrollably flying backward with blood seeping from the corners of their mouths, their eyes flashing with shock.
At that moment, Leizhou's figure appeared above Jiang Baiye and he unleashed a mountain-tumbling, sea-shifting strike. The next instant, he appeared above Yun Miaoyi with the same technique, both attacks occurring nearly simultaneously.
Without surprise, both women spat out blood again, their bodies heavily crashing against the mountainside, their vitality rapidly declining as they sustained serious injuries.

chapters.title: Chapter 63 - 63 Wicked Thoughts_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Wicked Thoughts_1
Translator: 549690339
Stones shattered and dust filled the sky!
Just as Han Li was about to pursue his victory, his pupils shrank suddenly. The figures of Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, who had smashed two large holes in the mountain peak, had disappeared.
Now, his power of the Divine Spirit was exceptionally strong, and his five senses were incredibly acute; even the dust couldn’t obstruct his vision.
In the next instant, his Spiritual Sense provided feedback and reflected the silhouettes of the two women—they had actually fled, and in different directions no less.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi didn’t care to be shocked by Han Li’s strength anymore, they had achieved their goal and took the opportunity to escape.
“Planning to run? Did you ask me first?”
Han Li chuckled and snapped his fingers.
With a “snap,” an invisible barrier suddenly rose around Myriad Sky Mountain within a ten-mile radius, precisely blocking Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi’s paths.
“There’s a Formation?”
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi were slightly taken aback, but their speed didn’t decrease. In their right hands, they wielded the Ice Crystal Sword and Spring Rain, while in their left, a bead exuding a mysterious aura appeared.
This was at least a Sixth Grade Formation. If they couldn’t break through it with one strike, they would immediately activate the Formation Breaking Bead and flee.
Han Li manipulated the Formation; the Five Elements Life and Death Formation immediately counterattacked, and five-colored light bloomed. Two beams of Five Elements Divine Light blasted towards them.
Boom!
The Five Elements Divine Light destroyed their attacks, significantly weakening its power, and the two women easily shattered it with a casual strike.
However, the power of this Formation deeply alarmed Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi. The level of the Formation was higher than they had anticipated, and it was uncertain whether the Formation Breaking Beads in their hands could break through it.
Although shocked, the two women still activated the Formation Breaking Bead at the first opportunity. The mysterious light from the beads enveloped them, and they immediately charged outward while waving their swords to fend off the Five Elements Divine Light.
Bang! Bang!
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi collided with the Formation barrier almost simultaneously, utterly unable to break through. The power of the Formation was too vast and quickly nullified the impact of the Formation Breaking Beads.
The next moment, the two women immediately turned around and rushed toward each other at high speed.
If they couldn’t break through the Formation, they would have to join forces to defend themselves and buy some time while waiting for reinforcements.
But would Han Li give them that time?
As the two women were about to join forces once more, Han Li made his move, stepping behind Yun Miaoyi in an instant and striking her with all his might, relentlessly bombarding her.
Already heavily injured, she had no strength to resist; within two breaths’ time, she was defeated and captured. Han Li’s Gang Yuan surged into Yun Miaoyi’s body, sealing her Dantian in the blink of an eye.
While Yun Miaoyi was engaged with Han Li, Jiang Baiye produced a charm from her hand. A hint of reluctance flashed in her eyes, but without any hesitation, she immediately poured her True Yuan into it, activating the charm.
This was a Small Teleportation Charm, extremely precious. With a market price of 50,000 Mid-grade Spiritual Stones each, they would be immediately snapped up as soon as they became available.
Once used, a Small Teleportation Charm would randomly teleport the user tens of thousands of miles away. As long as one was not trapped in a Fourth Grade or higher Formation, they could teleport out.
But there was a downside to the Small Teleportation Charm: it required five breaths of preparation time. During this period, it couldn’t be interrupted or the teleportation would fail.
Five breaths of time were extremely brief, but to Jiang Baiye’s surprise, Yun Miaoyi couldn’t even hold out for that long—she was defeated in just two breaths’ time.
By the third breath, Han Li had appeared behind Jiang Baiye. His left hand formed the Xuantian Punch, and his right hand cast the Yin and Yang Palm Seal. The might was too strong; Jiang Baiye’s defensive Gang Yuan couldn’t withstand it, and she had no choice but to counterattack.
Boom!
Jiang Baiye was sent flying backward, her teleportation failed, and she sustained even more severe injuries.
Before she could stabilize her form, Han Li was already in front of her, directly striking her chest with a palm. The violent surge of Gang Yuan poured in, sealing Jiang Baiye’s Dantian.
Afterward, Han Li, with one arm wrapped around Jiang Baiye’s slender waist, arrived at the spot where Yun Miaoyi lay. He casually threw Jiang Baiye out, providing her company.
It was not until then, as the dust settled, that Han Li truly let out a sigh of relief.
Everything was within his control. The battle that seemed lengthy was, in fact, over before even half an hour had passed.
All sorts of thoughts emerged in his mind, earlier preparations all being utilized.
According to the plan, he needed to first increase his cultivation to the later stages of the God Refining Realm to make up for his disadvantages in mastery of ultimate techniques, weapons, and various other aspects. Only then could he overpower the Formation and take the initiative.
Then he spent some time improving the Five Elements Life and Death
Formation given by Gongsun Yun. As a top-class Guru in the Void Realm of Formation cultivation, refining a Sixth Grade Formation was within his capabilities.
Han Li temporarily merged the Body-Cultivating Furnace with the Five Elements Life and Death Formation. The Body-Cultivating Furnace was inherently a Heaven Rank, Lower Grade Magical Treasure. As the core of the
Formation, it greatly enhanced the Formation’s power, turning it from a Sixth Grade Formation into a Fifth Grade, one even a Guru in the Void Realm would find troublesome.
After arriving at Myriad Sky Mountain, he buried the Formation flags and hid the Body-Cultivating Furnace deep underground, setting up the improved Five Elements Life and Death Formation before heading to Fenglei Manor City to lure the two women over.
Once the two women arrived, he first tested them. If they handed over the Body-Cultivating Furnace, allowing him to completely disengage, Han Li wouldn’t have proceeded to the next step.
Yun Miaoyi refused to swear an oath of her Daoist heart, so Han Li took action without hesitation. Knowing the advantages and disadvantages, Han Li didn’t strike with full force. Instead, he only applied enough pressure to overwhelm them.
He anticipated that the two women, unable to defeat him, would look for an opportunity to escape. Both sides were waiting for the right moment, but Han Li was a bit craftier.
Initially, his defensive Gang Yuan was forced to protect himself, fending off the women’s attacks. When the two women launched their strongest strike, intending to push him back and escape, Han Li knew his opportunity had arrived.
He immediately proactively activated the Indestructible Vajra Body Protection Divine Technique. The reflection power of his defensive Gang Yuan made its first appearance, giving the two women a huge surprise.
They had never expected Han Li’s defensive Gang Yuan to reflect attacks, and to have it all directly bounced back, resulting in them inflicting severe injuries upon themselves.
With the Vajra Divine Technique activated, Han Li transformed into a little golden figure, his flesh invulnerable for half an hour, and his strength skyrocketed manifold.
Since he hadn’t been fighting at full strength, and now with his power vastly increased, Han Li struck with all his might. Yun Miaoyi, already gravely wounded, couldn’t defend against him and was swiftly captured and sealed, and Jiang Baiye suffered the same fate.
During this process, he also took into account that Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi might possess items like Sixth Grade Formation Breaking Beads and Small Teleportation Charms. The higher the grade of the Formation Breaking Bead, the harder they are to come by. The chances of the two women having Fifth Grade beads were exceedingly slim; indeed, they did not have any.
A Sixth Grade Formation Breaking Bead couldn’t breach the Fifth Grade Five Elements Life and Death Formation, and activating a Small Teleportation Charm required five breaths, time which Han Li would not afford them.
Unless one of them stood out, sacrificing themselves to hold Han Li back to allow the other to escape using the Small Teleportation Charm, but the relationship between Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, though good, was not enough for such a sacrifice.
From the beginning to the end of the battle, everything went according to his calculations.
Gathering his thoughts, Han Li looked forward and saw two peerless beauties with torn clothes lying on the ground, vast areas of snow-white skin exposed, with blood spilling from the corners of their mouths adding an extra lure. Yun Miaoyi glared at him fiercely, while Jiang Baiye remained expressionless.
Suddenly, Han Li felt a wave of movement in his throat, and some wicked thoughts surfaced in his mind.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi were both pride of heaven, with high aptitude, having cultivated to the God Refining Realm early on. They were also stunningly beautiful, with many suitors. Theoretically, they should still be maidens.
Now, both women were heavily injured and their cultivation sealed by him. If he wanted to do something bad, he could truly do whatever he wished..

chapters.title: Chapter 64 - 64 Don ‘t Mess Around_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Don ‘t Mess Around_1
Translator: 549690339
“Don’t you dare.”
Feeling Han Li’s gaze, Yun Miaoyi tightened her clothes, trying to cover her snow-white skin, but there was no way she could hide everything, her charms unwittingly exposed in the brief moment.
In front of Jiang Baiye, she behaved rather boldly, not minding the accidental exposure and even deliberately flaunting it, teasing the cool and distant Jiang Baiye.
But in front of Han Li, her mindset was different. Deep down, she was quite conservative and didn’t want Han Li to see her that way, especially since she loathed him to the core.
In her view, Han Li was a master of concealment through and through.
How could a real person at least at the mid-God Refining Realm, perhaps even later stages, just loaf around in little Lingjun City, playing the role of a womanizing patriarch happy to take concubines? Was that reasonable?
The key was that Han Li outwardly appeared very weak, breaking through to the fifth level of Pihai Realm as if by sheer dumb luck on the brink of his timespan limit, but in reality, he was at least a mid-God Refining Realm practitioner.
Anyone who believed Han Li’s lies and sought trouble with him would die without understanding how.
She, the pampered lady of the Yinyang Sect, and Jiang Baiye, the prodigy of the Canghai Sect, had both stumbled and been calculated by that cunning man.
As for the notion that Han Li had cultivated his way up in the last twenty years, Yun Miaoyi didn’t buy it for a second. Not even she or Jiang Baiye, both with Fourth Grade cultivation talent, could go from the first level of the Pihai Realm to at least the mid-God Refining Realm in twenty years.
One must know that a Fourth Grade cultivation talent was already extremely high in the Daqian Empire, and Third Grade talents were extremely rare. Second and First Grades were practically the stuff of legends.
Jiang Baiye didn’t believe it either. Although captured by Han Li and under his watch, she didn’t panic at all. Her pretty face was frosty as she met Han Li’s gaze with her cool eyes.
“What are your terms?”
A palm strike from Han Li had torn a huge hole in her white dress, exposing large swathes of her pale skin, with glimpses of her peaches barely hidden. Yet Jiang Baiye seemed unconcerned and asked directly.
Since Han Li had captured and sealed them without killing them outright, it indicated that he had reservations in his heart and dared not be reckless, which is why Jiang Baiye wasn’t afraid. Moreover, she had her reliance.
She hailed from the Canghai Sect, one of the Ten Great Sects of Daqian, with a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm at its helm, many times stronger than Tianxuan Mountain.
Her master was privy to part of her mission plan, knowing that she was watching Han Li on Yingyuan Mountain. Should she go missing or die, Han Li would face the wrath of the Canghai Sect.
Han Li ignored the words of Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, hesitating internally about whether to continue with the plan or to lock the two women in a small dark room, for a secluded duel?
The original plan was to capture and seal the two women, then state his terms, using their lives as leverage to ensure they kept silent, and thus extricating himself from the turmoil of the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
He believed that Yun Miaoyi would certainly agree, and Jiang Baiye would likely acquiesce as well. Although the Body-Cultivating Furnace was important, surely it wasn’t as crucial as their lives.
The plan was perfect and was in its final stage, but now there had been a development he hadn’t anticipated; he had underestimated Jiang Baiye’s and Yun Miaoyi’s allure to him.
The current Jiang Baiye was like a Heavenly Immortal cast down to the mortal world, while Yun Miaoyi was a gentle demoness, with her clothes torn and in disarray, not properly covering her body. Their figures, temperament, and beauty were all extraordinary.
Most importantly, both women possessed Fourth Grade talent, which he was in dire need of.
Up to this point, the highest talent amongst his concubines were the sisters Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, one Fifth Grade and the other Sixth Grade.
The offspring produced by the sisters had granted him numerous rewards, causing both his cultivation and power to surge dramatically.
If he took the forceful approach, not only would he have his fill of their charms, but he might also gain two Fourth Grade talented offspring, acquiring decades of cultivation and an Earth Level martial technique superior to the Indestructible Bodv, potentiallv even elevating his talent directlv to Fifth
Grade.
At this moment, two little figures appeared in Han Li’s mind, each whispering opposing advice into his ear, and each piece of advice was tremendously tempting to him.
He was in a state of moral turmoil.
If he followed the original plan, he would be completely free of the Body-Cultivating Furnace trouble, able to live quietly in Lingjun City, quietly growing in power.
But that would mean sacrificing a great deal of tangible benefits. For instance, two peerless beauties, Jiang Baiye, this aloof white-haired sword immortal, and Yun Miaoyi, this enchantress with boundless charm and allure, are rare finds in his life, each with their various buffs and enhancements.
Even when tied together, his concubines Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, this pair of sisters, could barely compare to one of them.
For example, the offspring of these two women would bring him a variety of substantial rewards and allow his power to surge forward significantly.
If he were to change his plan, in the early stages he could obtain a reserved female sword immortal and a fiery enchantress, and he would still have the Body-Cultivating Furnace in his hands.
After enjoying himself for a while and gradually taming the two women until they willingly bore his offspring, he could then receive a multitude of rewards.
The reality, however, is that Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, as favored daughters of heaven, are extremely proud. If he were to forcefully take the two, they might even commit suicide.
Even if he stopped them from committing suicide, it’s likely they’d keep looking for opportunities to do so after they became pregnant; he couldn’t possibly guard them at all times.
Then, with two deaths and four lives gone, it would all be for nothing apart from the brief enjoyment, yet the risks he’d have to face would be enormous indeed.
With Yun Miaoyi’s disappearance into the Daqian Empire, her master from the Yinyang Sect would be enraged and pull strings in the Hehuan Sect to investigate.
This wouldn’t be an issue; the Daqian Empire wouldn’t ignore a Yinyang Sect’s expert coming after him, all he would need to do is be wary of the Hehuan Sect.
But if Jiang Baiye went missing, the Canghai Sect would come to kill. Located in Qingzhou, adjacent to Leizhou, the Daqian Empire had no reason to prevent the Canghai Sect from seeking the traces of their Core Disciple Jiang Baiye.
If a Core Disciple and the Body-Cultivating Furnace went missing, potentially ending up dead, the Canghai Sect would come to Leizhou for Jiang Baiye as well as the furnace.
To Han Li, the Canghai Sect was still a formidable giant; even his nominal Sect Leader Gongsun Yun couldn’t withstand them.
In that case, he would have to constantly avoid the pursuit of the Canghai Sect; the Han Family would be destroyed, and his concubines and offspring would suffer as a result.
“Huff-
After a few breaths, Han Li let out a deep sigh and made a decision.
“Abstinence, oh abstinence!”
Muttering to himself, Han Li walked towards Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi instinctively recoiled, but sevely injured, they were too incapacitated to move, unable to escape.
Seeing Han Li’s hand reach out, Yun Miaoyi panicked and exclaimed, ‘What do you want to do?”
“Think carefully,” she chided. “If you dare lay a finger on us, neither Yinyang Sect nor Canghai Sect will let you off.”
“Not only will you die but the Han Family will be destroyed, and Tianxuan Mountain will be dragged into this as well.”
As Han Li’s hand drew closer, Yun Miaoyi, in her panic, blurted out a string of
threats ana Intimidations.
She had managed to leave the Hehuan Sect with her purity intact, advancing into the Yinyang Sect; her future was bright. So long as she continued to cultivate, her chances of breaking through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm were not low.
But now, in Han Li’s clutches, if she were defiled and lost her virgin yin, her probability of advancing to the Myriad Phenomena Realm would significantly decrease, and she also feared Han Li would silence them to cover his tracks, which would mean everything was over.
Yun Miaoyi was in turmoil, and so was Jiang Baiye. Han Li’s hand was reaching for her too, barely three inches away, almost touching her.
This caused Jiang Baiye’s confidence to waver. Had Han Li truly no fear of offending the Canghai Sect?
“Stop!” Jiang Baiye opened her mouth, resisting with all she had..

chapters.title: Chapter 65 - 65 1 Must Kill You_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: 1 Must Kill You_l
Translator: 549690339
Han Li pinched Yun Miaoyi’s chin with his left hand and Jiang Baiye’s chin with his right, feeling nearly the same sensation from both, incredibly silky.
He looked at the red lips on the left, then at the red lips on the right; under the fiery glare of both women, Han Li gently leaned in and gave each one a kiss.
Having done this, Han Li let go, stepped back a few paces, and with a smile emerging on his face, lightly said:
“That’s what I wanted to do.”
“Han Li, I’m going to kill you, I must kill you.” Yun Miaoyi was about to lose her mind with anger.
Her first kiss was taken away by this man without any preparation on her part.
Jiang Baiye didn’t speak, but her pretty face was ice-cold, as if to drop the temperature of the surrounding air by several degrees. She stared at Han Li intensively; if looks could kill, she would have slain him countless times.
She possessed extraordinary talent, becoming one of the top three core disciples of Canghai Sect within just sixty-four years of cultivation, revered by countless within the sect.
Even in Leizhou, Qingzhou, and Huozhou, she was a highly esteemed Sword Immortal, disregarding any suitor without hesitation, with none able to catch her eye.
Among her peers, only Yun Miaoyi of Hehuan Sect could match her. Once Yun Miaoyi had ascended to the Yinyang Sect, she became the number one fairy of the three states.
Now, her pure and untainted status as a Sword Immortal was easily violated by someone who stole her first kiss, leaving her powerless to resist, and even at the risk of her Yuan Yin being forcefully taken.
Jiang Baiye gnawed her red lip, a determined resolve forming in her heart; if Han Li dared to defile her further, she would rather die by suicide. Even in death, she would not let Han Li off easily; her master and Canghai Sect would seek revenge.
Facing Yun Miaoyi’s fiery gaze, Han Li pressed another kiss on her lips, then with lingering affection, he said:
“Kill me? Come and try.”
“Ahhh-
Yun Miaoyi really wanted to swing her sword, Spring Rain, to cut down this
Han Li, but unfortunately, both she and Jiang Baiye had their cultivation
sealed, unable to move under Han Li’s imposing pressure.
Seeing this, Han Li took immediate action and rewarded her with another kiss.
Yun Miaoyi stopped talking, her eyes almost shooting flames. She very much regretted not learning the art of eye techniques; otherwise, she could have killed this philanderer Han Li with her gaze.
Jiang Baiye, witnessing this scene, felt a sudden relief. Luckily, she hadn’t shouted out, or else she’d have been molested by Han Li twice more.
As she was pondering this, she saw Han Li approach and reward her with two successive kisses.
“You…” Jiang Baiye uttered a word and then swallowed the rest, afraid that Han Li would take further advantage.
She could see that Han Li no longer seemed interested in playing with them nor did he have such thoughts anymore; it appeared he was planning to let them go. Therefore, Jiang Baiye didn’t want to say much more, to avoid provoking Han Li further.
Under the eaves, one has to bow one’s head.
Having already lost her first kiss, she didn’t want to suffer any more losses and only hoped that Han Li would release them soon.
Jiang Baiye turned her head to see Yun Miaoyi actually smiling at her, seemingly delighted that she too was humiliated, having been taken advantage of by Han Li three times.
Looking at the two disheveled beauties, Han Li was about to speak when he suddenly frowned.
His spiritual sense detected several powerful auras rapidly approaching Myriad Sky Mountain, one of which was exceptionally mighty, likely a Guru in the Void Realm.
Without delay, Han Li quickly retrieved the banners of the Five Elements Life and Death Formation and dug up the Body-Cultivating Furnace, then started his escape.
With his left arm around Yun Miaoyi’s slim, curvaceous waist and his right around Jiang Baiye’s slender waist, he ignored the murderous looks from both women and spoke lightly:
“You wouldn’t want others to see you in such a sorry state, would you?”
Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye immediately fell silent, no longer struggling. Han Li chuckled, took a step forward, and disappeared from the spot; soon, he arrived at another location.
There stood a mountain five thousand Zhang tall, situated on the border of Fengyang Manor, known as Yingyuan Mountain—it was also where the two women had been lying in wait for him.
Han Li had just left with the two women in his arms when a figure hurriedly approached, landing on the destroyed peak of Myriad Sky Mountain. His spiritual sense swept the area, and a look of surprise appeared on his face.
Looking in the direction Han Li had gone, he wore a serious expression and murmured, “What incredible speed.”
He himself was quite fast, yet he had only caught a glimpse of that person’s back before they vanished from his spiritual sense coverage.
Keep in mind, he was a Guru in the Void Realm, and judging from the battlefield before him, the site of a clash between three powerful individuals of the God Refining Realm.
The victor, that person, had fled with the other two God Refining Realm figures. The idea that another of the God Refining Realm moved faster than he, a Guru in the Void Realm, was simply preposterous.
Since he couldn’t catch up, the Guru in the Void Realm studied the battlefield carefully, hoping to glean information about the three combatants.
“Canghai Sword Scripture, Heavenly Sword Technique, Triple Slash of the
Raging Seas… And these sword marks, they must belong to Jiang Baiye of the
Canghai Sect, the Sword Immortal.”
“Yin and Yang Palm Seal, Triple Yin Disaster Finger… Such fierce blade marks, carrying a demonic aura—could they be from Jiang Baiye’s nemesis, Yun Miaoyi? But I never heard of her specializing in blade techniques.”
“Xuantian Punch, God Slaying Sword Technique… And this palm technique, could this person really be from Tianxuan Mountain? But since when did Tianxuan Mountain have such a powerful practitioner?”
Ning Haoyuan frowned deeply; as the Sect Leader of the True Sun Sect, he was well informed about Tianxuan Mountain and had a clear understanding of the absolute techniques of Canghai Sect and the Yinyang Sect, as well as their famous powerhouses.
For this reason, he found it inconceivable; the strongest in the God Refining Realm from Tianxuan Mountain was Qiu Shuilin, at the seventh layer of the God Refining Realm.
Yet Qiu Shuilin’s strength could not defeat Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, the famed pride of the heavens, so quickly, and Qiu Shuilin was also not skilled in sword techniques and had never practiced the God Slaying Sword Technique.
“It seems Tianxuan Mountain’s depths are even greater than I imagined,” Ning Haoyuan sighed.
Although he did not know the reason for their fight, the two heaven’s prides, Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, had been defeated by someone who appeared to be a powerful practitioner from Tianxuan Mountain and had been captured and taken away.
Ning Haoyuan took a long look in the direction Han Li had left, then glanced at a few other directions where God Refining Realm figures were approaching.
He smiled, his figure disappearing from the spot as he returned to the True Sun Sect.
True Sun Sect was located right next to Fenglei Manor, and he had rushed over quickly, hoping to enjoy the drama and see if there were any opportunities to take advantage of. Unfortunately, the fight was over before he arrived, and the people involved were nowhere to be seen.
After Ning Haoyuan had departed, several others arrived in succession, all God Refining Realm practitioners from the nearby Leizhou.
These practitioners of the God Refining Realm inspected the battlefield and reached a conclusion similar to that of the Sect Leader of the True Sun Sect, then quickly left to report this information back to their respective powers.
The witch of the Yinyang Sect, Yun Miaoyi, joined forces with Jiang Baiye, the Sword Immortal of the Canghai Sect for battle but were defeated and captured by a powerful practitioner who was suspected to be from Tianxuan Mountain.
Yet this practitioner from Tianxuan Mountain was not documented by their respective powers, indicating hidden depths of Tianxuan Mountain. To be able to defeat the two women in a short time, prevent them from escaping, and capture them alive, such strength was among the top in the God Refining Realm.
But why reveal it now and why battle Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye?
Soon, this news spread, creating quite a stir in Leizhou.
Atop Yingyuan Mountain.
Han Li placed Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi in an embarrassing posture, causing their faces to flush red with shame. Even the typically indifferent Jiang Baiye could not tolerate such a position.
However, under Han Li’s oppressive aura, they were unable to move at all and could only let him arrange them as he pleased..

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - 66 1 Want You to Help Me Cultivate_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: 1 Want You to Help Me Cultivate_1
Translator: 549690339
The two women gazed at Han Li with icy eyes that wished to kill, longing to carve up the man who had taken liberties with them; however, they were trapped in Han Li’s snare and their futures were uncertain.
He kept sizing up Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi.
Without realizing it, their bottom lines were lowered, as they kept conceding, the upper hand was not in their grasp.
In his heart, Han Li quietly sighed; he really had no intention of doing anything more and had made his choice.
Now he only wished to feast his eyes, for he wouldn’t have the chance to see such a sight again for quite some time, so he wanted to look his fill in one go.
His purpose in capturing Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi was to resolve the troubles with the Body-Cultivating Furnace; taking advantage of the two women would only bring greater troubles.
Ensnared in one problem after another, he wouldn’t be able to properly cultivate; he wasn’t like those geniuses who could grow rapidly through trials. What he needed was time to develop steadily and securely.
He silently repeated the Ten Principles Practice several times in his mind, then recited the sixteen-word mantra again, and Han Li approached Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi once more.
As Han Li drew nearer, Yun Miaoyi, who was fixed in an embarrassing position, couldn’t hold back any longer and said in panic, “Han Li, what on earth do you plan to do?”
“Han Li, don’t mess around, let’s talk this out properly,” said someone.
In such a position, even Jiang Baiye couldn’t maintain her frosty demeanor her pretty face flushed with embarrassment.
“Do what?”
Han Li’s eyebrows arched suddenly, a hint of wicked pleasure surfacing as he chuckled heinously, “I want you to aid my cultivation.”
Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye’s expressions changed drastically, their blush dying away to cold sternness as they nearly spoke in unison:
“Don’t even think about it!”
Without saying a word, Han Li watched Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, brazenly scrutinizing them, which greatly infuriated both women.
“So that’s it, this is the secret to your rapid progress in cultivation,” said Yun Miaoyi, a flash of insight in her eyes.
Pretending to have a slight change in expression, Han Li calmly responded, “I have no idea what you’re talking about.”
He wanted to set a trap for Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, making future moves easier, and preferably lead them astray.
“Heh, keep pretending. I was only fifty percent sure before, but now I’m positive, you possess a powerful Dual Cultivation Technique or Collection and Supplement Method. This technique must be at least of Heaven Rank.”
“No wonder you’ve been hiding in little Lingjun City for the past twenty years, taking concubines frequently, yet without the necessary resources, your cultivation has soared, nearly matching the cultivation speed of those Third Grade talent geniuses.”
As Han Li seemed to want to deny it, Yun Miaoyi scoffed coldly, “Don’t forget, I come from the Hehuan Sect.”
It all became clear to Jiang Baiye as well; only that could explain why Han Li took concubines so often without hampering his cultivation, and why his power had increased so dramatically.
Her gaze at Han Li shifted, filled with some trepidation.
Under these circumstances, Jiang Baiye had no confidence that Han Li would let them go.
Watching Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi try to remain composed, Han Li almost wanted to laugh, but he maintained a look of deep furrows on his brow as if Yun Miaoyi had indeed glimpsed his secret.
Without responding to Yun Miaoyi’s guess, Han Li’s expression returned to calmness, continuing to look at the two women without restraint. When he saw them becoming increasingly unnerved, he finally spoke up.
“So you don’t want to engage in Dual Cultivation with me, nor do you want me to release you, is that right?”
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi hastily nodded; Jiang Baiye’s clear voice rang out, “Just tell us your conditions, as long as it’s within our ability.”
They had had enough of their current humiliating pose and just wanted to get away from Han Li as quickly as possible and reclaim their freedom before planning their next move.
The two women didn’t dare threaten or scare him anymore; not only was it useless against Han Li, but it might also provoke him, leaving them at a disadvantage should he act irrationally.
“Of course, there are conditions, and they’re not difficult for you. As long as you agree to all of them, I’ll release you,” Han Li said with a beaming smile.
“Speak,” Jiang Baiye said expressionlessly.
“Stop dilly-dallying,” Yun Miaoyi urged impatiently, her only wish now was to quickly return to the Yinyang Sect.
After giving the two women a deep look, Han Li said, “First, the matter concerning the Body-Cultivating Furnace ends here. You must not investigate further and must exert every effort to prevent your backers from doing so as well.”
“Second, our grievances will be wiped clean, from henceforth, we shall not infringe upon each other’s domains. You must not use any means to continue seeking trouble with me, the Han Family, or Tianxuan Mountain.”
“Third, you must keep the details of this great battle hidden, not revealing any information about me.”
“Fourth, you need to swear an oath with your Dao heart that, should you break these terms, you will be troubled by inner demons for the rest of your life, never advancing to the Hollow Void Stage.”
Having spoken, Han Li quietly watched Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye, waiting for their response.
The two women wanted to quickly rid themselves of him, unaware that he too wished to be free of them as soon as possible, setting clear boundaries so each could go their separate ways, with no one troubling the other.
“I agree,” Yun Miaoyi hesitated only briefly before immediately speaking up.
Although it was a great risk to infiltrate the Daqian Empire and she had wasted time and energy without obtaining the Body-Cultivating Furnace, rendering the venture a loss for her, her circumstances had changed and so had her thoughts.
Now, she wasn’t in a position to negotiate terms. As long as Han Li left her body untouched, she could agree to these trivial matters.
Seeing Jiang Baiye hesitating, Han Li said indifferently, ‘Your agreement alone is useless. Both of you must agree for it to count.”
Yun Miaoyi was furious, but helpless, so she could only look toward Jiang Baiye, hoping she would be rational and prioritize her own safety and purity over the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
“I can’t stop my sect from investigating the whereabouts of the Body-Cultivating Furnace.”
After a silence, Jiang Baiye lowered her head, her cool voice sounding somewhat helpless.
Though she was important within the Canghai Sect and one of the strong contenders for future Sect Leader, she still fell short compared to the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
If it came down to choosing between her and the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the Canghai Sect would undoubtedly opt for the Body-Cultivating Furnace without hesitation.
“Jiang Baiye, you…” Yun Miaoyi panicked. If Jiang Baiye didn’t agree, they both would be doomed.
Han Li nodded, acknowledging Jiang Baiye’s statement, and proposed, “How about this? I will keep the Body-Cultivating Furnace for fifty years. If you come for it after fifty years, I will offer it to you with both hands. How about that?”
Jiang Baiye’s head shot up as she stared intently at Han Li, a flicker of surprise in her eyes, “Agreed.”
No matter what Han Li was planning, as long as there was a chance to retrieve the Body-Cultivating Furnace, she could settle matters with her sect and persuade them to temporarily give up the chase.
Yun Miaoyi breathed a sigh of relief and immediately said, “Jiang Baiye has agreed too. You can let us go now.”
“You haven’t sworn an oath with your Dao heart yet,” Han Li reminded them.
Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye made pledges with their Dao hearts, making all sorts of promises, and Han Li finally felt at ease.
“We’re good now, right?” The two women were somewhat nervous, afraid that Han Li might pull some trick.
“Not so fast.”
After saying this, Han Li took out a Shadow Leaving Stone from his Space Ring.
“What are you doing?!” Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye watched Han Li intently, their voices ice-cold.
“Nothing much, just preparing a little something for my enjoyment,” Han Li said calmly.
Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye, grinding their teeth in hatred, knew this was Han
Li’s safeguard in case they reneged, and in fact, they did harbor such thoughts.
But now that Han Li had leverage over them, they didn’t dare to take the risk of backlash from their Dao hearts and could only pretend not to see it.
“You’re ruthless,” Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye spat out through clenched teeth.

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - 67 Dragon Girl_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: Dragon Girl_l
Translator: 549690339
Han Li scrutinized the two women for a long time, and just when they were about to explode, he finally said, reluctantly,
“How about I take you both as my wives? That way, we could turn hostility into alliance and celebrate a joyous union.”
“Heh.” Yun Miaoyi let out a cold laugh.
Jiang Baiye remained expressionless, outright ignoring him.
Han Li didn’t give up and continued, “I’ve admired you both for a long time, sincerely hoping to take you as wives, not concubines.”
This time, even Yun Miaoyi ignored him. Han Li had already taken advantage of them, and now he had the audacity to push even further—no, to cross line after line.
Both women felt that Han Li was shameless, his skin thicker than city walls, and he clung to life desperately, like an incurable rogue.
In the future, they did not want to see Han Li again for fear of being schemed against by this rogue.
“Alas, you’ve misunderstood the sincerity of my intentions.”
Han Li sighed and with a flick of his right finger, two strands of Gang Yuan shot out, entering the bodies of Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye.
Boom! Boom!
Their seals undone, two powerful auras soared into the sky; Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi immediately took to the air, retreating a hundred zhang.
In the air, Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi exchanged glances, both seeing the color of shame in each other’s eyes; upon having their seals lifted, their first reaction was to flee rather than to settle scores with Han Li.
When the two women looked towards the summit of Yingyuan Mountain, Han
Li’s figure had already vanished. Somehow, both women breathed a sigh of relief, truly afraid that Han Li might pull another stunt.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi didn’t want to say anything and were about to leave when Han Li’s voice simultaneously reached their ears.
“Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, if you change your minds, you’re welcome to find me in Lingjun City anytime. My offer will always stand.”
Bang!
Bang!
Jiang Baiye swung her sword while Yun Miaoyi swung her blade, directly shearing off Yingyuan Mountain. Rocks flew and the earth quaked.
After venting, the two women looked at each other and together turned away. They no longer wished to see this heartbreaking place.
Yingyuan Mountain, which once stood five thousand Zhang high, was now only over three thousand zhang. Countless rocks fell, causing birds and beasts to flee, triggering a minor stampede.
Powerful individuals from three manors near Yingyuan Mountain arrived to investigate and deal with the stampede. Finding nothing, they dispersed.
Daqian Empire, Imperial Capital.
Inside a refined and beautiful boudoir of the Left Chancellor’s mansion, a peerless beauty of unrivaled grace was embroidering. The embroidery depicted a long and magnificent mountain range, vast and beautiful, replete with splendid scenery, yet it remained unfinished.
Suddenly, the peerless beauty glanced at her fingertip. Her brows furrowed slightly as her index finger had been pricked by the needle and was bleeding, but she seemed not to care.
“Who is it?”
An incredibly terrifying presence arose, only to vanish in the blink of an eye, unnoticed by anyone.
The peerless beauty set the embroidery casually on the case table, stood up, and looked towards Leizhou, or more precisely, towards Yingyuan Mountain bordering Fengyang Manor.
Her eyes were profound, etched with mysterious patterns, as if capable of penetrating multiple layers of space to gaze across vast distances at Yingyuan Mountain.
Seeing the collapse of Yingyuan Mountain, the eyes of the peerless beauty turned ice-cold; rage brewed within her.
After a long while, she exhaled heavily. Her belongings were still there, so she decided to head over as soon as she finished the matter at hand.
Fengyang Manor, Lingjun City.
Han Li silently returned to Han Mansion, planning to continue his celestial life.
He would reveal himself officially only after about ten days, letting the people of Lingjun City know he was back.
If not, appearing in Fengyang Manor so soon after having been in Fenglei Manor would lead anyone to suspect his true strength.
Having resolved the trouble with the Body-Cultivating Furnace, he was finally free of worries and could discreetly develop in Lingjun City for a considerable period.
Not only did he temporarily secure the Body-Cultivating Furnace, but he also obtained the first kisses of the two extraordinary women, Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, as well as their images, which he could admire at any time.
Every time Han Li thought of the shameful poses he had the two women assume, a wave of heat surged in his heart. He regretted missing the opportunity but did not regret his actions.
