By the time he would meet them again, his strength would have surely made significant advances, at least reaching the level of Grandmaster Wanxiang. By then, wouldn’t the two women be easily within his grasp?
No matter how fast Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi advanced in their cultivation, they could not possibly surpass him.
Furthermore, it’s broad and vast having stepped back; he didn’t want to
provoke a formidable enemy with insufficient strength. When his power was enough, forcibly marrying Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi—neither Canghai Sect nor Yinyang Sect would dare to object. They might even have to shamelessly deliver the two women to his doorstep.
“Alas.”
Han Li sighed. After all, it was his lack of strength that caused these fears, wasn’t it?
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, such exceptional women, certainly had their own formidable backgrounds. Their masters must be at least Hollow Realm
Masters, perhaps even Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Get the small ones, and the big ones would come after him; capture the big ones, and the old ones would follow. It would never end.
Thus, Han Li would rather give way and let them be for now. He would wait until his strength was substantial. After all, time was what he lacked the least.
For Han Li, using the Body-Cultivating Furnace for fifty years was sufficient; the aptitudes of his concubines would have all improved to their peaks. After that, he was certain to be able to refine the Rebirth Pill, replacing the role of the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
If Jiang Baiye came for it after fifty years, he would let her take it back to the Canghai Sect, but he still wanted the person Jiang Baiye for himself.
If Jiang Baiye did not come, then the Body-Cultivating Furnace would still belong to him, and by that time, it would be too late for Jiang Baiye to leak any information about him.
“Can Canghai Sect survive these fifty years?”
Han Li expressed his doubts.
The Daqian Empire was tumultuous, and no one knew when chaos would erupt —perhaps in a few years, perhaps several decades, maybe even a century.
If the turmoil came early and the Daqian Empire was in disarray, whether Canghai Sect could survive was an unknown factor.
Upon these thoughts, Han Li also started to worry about Tianxuan Mountain, which was weaker than Canghai Sect. He wondered whether his nominal master, Gongsun Yun, could withstand the pressure.
Tianxuan Mountain.
Gongsun Yun stood at the summit of Tianxuan Peak, his brows furrowed in worry as he wondered if he had invested in the wrong person.
News of the battle between Han Li, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi at Myriad Sky Mountain had already spread, involving Tianxuan Mountain, and Gongsun Yun was the first to know.
After dealing with the probes of other powers, Gongsun Yun came here to be lost in thought.
As the Sect Leader of Tianxuan Mountain, he was quite clear about the foundation of his own sect. After much deliberation, capturing Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi could only be the work of Han Li.
In all of Tianxuan Mountain, only he, in such a short time, could have captured the two women—not even Qiu Shuilin, the late stage real person of the God Refining Realm, could do it.
But he and the other real persons of the God Refining Realm were all within Tianxuan Mountain, only the newly accepted disciple Han Li was still in the outside world, also in the God Refining Realm, and just happened to know the Xuantian Punch and the God Slaying Sword technique.
Gongsun Yun was both shocked and pleased that Han Li had advanced to the mid-to-late stages of the God Refining Realm in such a short period of time.
Rapid cultivation was a good thing, as it proved Han Li’s immense potential. However, why had Han Li stirred up such a huge commotion?
Capturing Jiang Baiye, the Sword Immortal of Canghai Sect, and Yun Miaoyi, the witch of Yinyang Sect, and suppressing them was no minor feat and did not match the usual style that Han Li was known for.
“Did this kid take the sixteen-character truth I taught him as wind past his ears?” Gongsun Yun couldn’t help muttering to himself.
Recently, he had been under a lot of pressure with various forces from Leizhou probing Tianxuan Mountain, trying to find out who was responsible, all repelled by him.
Fortunately, Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi soon made another appearance, returning to their respective sects, and the incident was suppressed.
Thinking of Han Li, Gongsun Yun turned his thoughts to another major concern, his expression becoming extremely grave.
Yang Tianxiong and Wan Guiyuan, the two Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, had gone to kill Mother Wusheng again. In the end, they had only killed the Dharma King of the White Lotus Cult, and the gravely injured Mother Wusheng had fled to Leizhou.
PSI: I’ve made revisions to the last chapter, adding a thousand words. This is the best I can do.
PS2: After reading the comments on the previous chapter, I admit I didn’t write it well. It was due to my lack of understanding, and I have deeply reflected on it.
I was considering that the female lead shouldn’t rise too quickly and must match the male lead’s survival character. But I could’ve written it to be more thrilling with more detailed descriptions for heightened excitement, which wouldn’t end anticlimactically.
Raising everyone’s expectations and then not fully satisfying them was partly due to lack of experience (never having written such scenes before), and also due to worries that writing too explicitly might get flagged for review or reported. My concerns led to the current outcome.
I will write the upcoming plot to be more stimulating, with as much detail as possible, and improve my writing in every aspect to make sure it satisfies the readers..

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - 68 King Grade True Elixir_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: King Grade True Elixir_1
Translator: 549690339
A little less than half a month later.
The news of Wusheng Laomu’s escape to Leizhou had spread everywhere, causing a commotion well-known to all, with major powers having received instructions early on. Their disciples had all been mobilized, but most were making an appearance without putting in any real effort.
The impact Han Li had caused was too trivial compared to this matter. The attention of all the major powers was focused on Wusheng Laomu.
This was mainly because Han Li hadn’t done anything to Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, otherwise Leizhou would not have been peaceful. Now, Yun Miaoyi had returned to the Yinyang Sect, while Jiang Baiye had gone back to the Canghai Sect.
Upon hearing that his disciple had been captured by a real person from
Tianxuan Mountain, Jiang Baiye’s master was ready to storm Tianxuan Mountain. However, before he had traveled far, he learned that Jiang Baiye had reappeared and was on her way back, so he simply went to a major city that she must pass through to wait for her.
Jiang Baiye’s master was named Jian Ziyun, one of the few Gurus in the Void Realm in the Canghai Sect. When he was traveling outside the Sect, he noticed Jiang Baiye’s talent and brought her back to the Sect to become his disciple.
Under Jian Ziyun’s careful guidance, Jiang Baiye shone brightly within the Canghai Sect, cultivating all the way to the God Refining Realm, becoming one of the top three Core Disciples.
Jian Ziyun treated Jiang Baiye as if she were his own daughter, striving within the Sect to secure benefits for her. When he heard that she had been captured, he promptly took action.
After meeting with Jian Ziyun, Jiang Baiye spoke of all she could, only withholding information about Han Li.
When Jian Ziyun asked whether the Body-Cultivating Furnace had been obtained by Han Li, Jiang Baiye ultimately did not admit to it and said she would continue the investigation and vowed to retrieve the Body-Cultivating Furnace in the future.
Jian Ziyun did not press further but instead reminded her to pursue the matter diligently as it was related to her chance of obtaining a place in the Secret Territory and her status within the Canghai Sect.
Leizhou, Qingyun Manor.
This manor was located on the southern border of Leizhou, with the territory of the Yinyang Sect further south.
Here existed a major sect named Hehuan Sect, one of the Four Sects of Leizhou. Since the Hehuan Sect was a piece of the Yinyang Sect, the Protector General of Leizhou kept a close watch on the place.
Within a county city of Qingyun Manor, Wusheng Laomu was hiding in a civilian house, striving to heal her injuries.
No one knew that Wusheng Laomu was so bold as to take refuge in Qingyun Manor.
“Damn Wan Guiyuan, damn Yang Tianxiong, damn Prince Wu’an!”
As Wusheng Laomu healed her injuries, she muttered curses under her breath.
Ever since Prince Wu’an had arrived in Sanzhou, she hadn’t had any good days. She was pursued and obstructed by two Great Grandmasters and ultimately fell into a trap.
If it weren’t for the fact that she used her trump card at the last moment, burning away three Faith Halos which greatly increased her combat ability, she wouldn’t have survived at all.
But the cost was too great—she lost the three Faith Halos she had been accumulating for a long time, which significantly weakened her strength, making her the weakest among the Great Grandmasters.
At this moment, still severely injured, her strength had decreased by sixty to seventy percent, and the combat power she could use was at best equivalent to the late stages of the Hollow Void Stage.
“Sigh-
Feeling slightly better from her injuries, Wusheng Laomu released a sigh, her brows knitting together in concern.
The last patriarch of the White Lotus Cult had died, leaving her as a solitary figure. Following the belief that the most dangerous place can be the safest, she had escaped the pursuit and came to Qingyun Manor.
If the Daqian Empire still lurked persistently, she would have no choice but to flee to the territory of the Yinyang Sect. As for the mission delegated by the Sect, it would only be temporarily abandoned.
“I wonder when the Sect will send reinforcements,” sighed Wusheng Laomu.
The force behind her was immensely powerful, much stronger than the Daqian Empire, and harbored the ambition to swallow the Daqian Empire and divide the Xuan Domain. However, due to certain reasons, it had not yet emerged into the open.
Wusheng Laomu stood up and sat in front of a dressing mirror. Gazing at the veiled barefoot girl in the mirror, she decided to keep a low profile, revert to her real name, Lu Tianxiang, and continue to stay undercover by changing her appearance.
Once her injuries had healed and her strength could barely recover to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, she would need to start spreading her faith in secret once again.
Without the Faith Halo, Lu Tianxiang felt a lack of security.
Huozhou, Province City.
In the Royal Manor, Prince Wu’an was still fishing by the pond, and the scholar in blue robes still held a three-character book in his hands, savoring it carefully.
Shortly after, two figures approached, they were Wan Guiyuan, the Commissioner of Sanzhou, and Yang Tianxiong, the Supervisor of the Jingye
Office.
“Prince, why have you suddenly called us back?”
“Prince, just give us a little more time, and we will completely eradicate the Mother of No Life.”
After bowing and paying their respects, Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong spoke with some reluctance.
They had finally cornered the Mother of No Life into a desperate situation, and if they continued their pursuit, the severely weakened enemy would surely be crushed.
However, Prince Wu’an had ordered them to return to Huozhou City to stand by, without giving a reason. Though they were reluctant, they dared not disobey.
Prince Wu’an seemed not to hear them, and the scholar in blue raised his eyelids, saying indifferently, “You have the Prince’s command, and yet the Mother of No Life escaped. Do you not feel ashamed?”
Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong glared at the scholar in blue, with Yang Tianxiong retorting somewhat angrily, “Mr. Lan, do you only Imow how to criticize after the fact? If you had been willing to join forces with us, the
Mother of No Life would have been dead long ago.”
“Heh heh-” Mr. Lan let out a cold laugh, then fell silent.
Wan Guiyuan gave Yang Tianxiong a look, signaling him to calm down, and then said to the back of Prince Wu’an, “Prince, you have summoned us back, may I ask if there is something important?”
“The time is not yet ripe.”
Prince Wu’an only said four words, then fell silent again.
Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong sighed and had no choice but to leave dejectedly. After all, how could they go against Prince Wu’an who governed them?
Once the two had left, Mr. Lan pondered before asking, “Prince, are you certain?”
Prince Wu’an shook his head slightly, sighing, “The Prophet from the Imperial Astronomer sent a message, saying that the fortunes of heaven had briefly cleared a few days ago, but then were obscured again.”
“However, the Prophet estimated that it’s close. It could be as little as three to five days or as long as twenty to thirty years before that opportunity will surely emerge.”
Mr. Lan nodded, asking no further.
As the Prince’s chief strategist and most trusted aide, he was deeply trusted by Prince Wu’an and knew to what the Prince was referring.
It was an opportunity of a lifetime!
The Imperial Astronomer had calculated for over two hundred years before finally deducing the clues and informing Prince Wu’an.
The outside world all thought that Prince Wu’an suppressed his cultivation level in order to condense the Third Grade True Elixir, but very few knew that Prince Wu’an could have condensed the elixir long ago.
Prince Wu’an had reached the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and through cultivation aligned with the forces of nature, his understanding of the true essence of martial arts was exceptionally strong and domineering. At any moment, he could advance to the True Martial Realm and become Emperor Wu, who could suppress the heavens and the earth in one direction.
Otherwise, how could Prince Wu’an have defended the northern border for two hundred years without Da Jing being able to advance?
The Martial True Pill is divided into nine grades, the higher the grade of the pill condensed, the stronger the power after breakthrough and the greater the potential for the future.
But what very few people Imow is that above the First Grade True Elixir, there
is the King Grade Pill. Only by condensing the King Grade Martial True Pill can one truly become Emperor Wu.
Upon learning of the major opportunity foretold by the Prophet, Prince Wu’an deliberately suppressed his cultivation, waiting for the opportunity to emerge. Then, by leveraging that great fortune, he would condense the King Grade Martial True Pill in one fell swoop, advance to the True Martial Realm, and become an unrivaled force in all directions.
After receiving the latest news from the Prophet, Prince Wu’an ordered Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong to return, calmly awaiting the opportunity’s emergence, and then to strive for it with all their might.
What he was most worried about was that the Yinyang Sect and other top-tier factions would learn of the news and come to vie for it; hence, he had to be prepared, always keeping his side in peak condition.
The Mother of No Life was just a small grasshopper, inconsequential compared to that grand opportunity.

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 69: The Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine Again_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: The Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine Again_l
Translator: 549690339
Lingjun City, Han Mansion.
A wedding of exceptional grandeur was being held, with the prominent figure of the Han Family as the groom and a pair of twin sisters as the brides.
This was the third lavish wedding in Lingjun City in a month; each ceremony featured the same groom from the Han Family but a different bride.
Representatives from various factions of Lingjun City and Fengyang Manor had grown weary of attending banquets, accustomed to the Han Family patriarch frequently taking concubines, a congratulatory gift each time sufficed.
They had realized that the Han Family patriarch wasn’t particular about the value of the gifts, seeking merely the liveliness of the event; as long as one didn’t arrive empty-handed, it was acceptable.
The common people of Lingjun City had enjoyed nine days of free-flowing banquets within a month, grateful to the generous Han Family patriarch. Some citizens even took home his portrait to worship, burning incense daily and praying for him to take concubines more often, ideally every three days.
With every concubine the Han Family patriarch took, their quality of life dramatically improved, feasting on meat and fish for three straight days.
If it weren’t for the Han Family patriarch’s high standards, requiring the concubines to be increasingly beautiful and possess cultivation talent, the common people would have been eager to offer their daughters to the Han Mansion, wishing for a new concubine every three days, ensuring an endless supply of meat and fish.
After the splendid wedding concluded, the twin sisters were led to separate bridal chambers to await Han Li’s favor.
In the main hall, amidst toasts and laughter, Han Li entertained the congratulating guests before preparing to enter the bridal chamber.
More than a month had passed since resolving the Body-Cultivating Furnace incident, and Han Li finally enjoyed some peace, relishing once more the joy of quiet development.
The previous two times, he had taken two concubines, each extraordinary in beauty and possessing eligible cultivation talent—one with Ninth Grade and the other with Eighth Grade.
After taking zood care of each concubine for half a month, Han Li then took the
twin sisters, Chu Yutong and Chu Yumeng.
The twin sisters, Chu Yutong and Chu Yumeng, one serene and the other lively, had nearly identical appearances, making it hard for the naked eye to distinguish between them.
They were not only sweet-looking and innocently adorable, but also had fine figures and exceptional demeanors, along with ample bosoms.
At just eighteen years old, Chu Yutong and Chu Yumeng, although possessing Ninth Grade cultivation talent, had not achieved high cultivation levels due to coming from a minor family without plentiful resources.
That minor family lived in a secluded village within Fengyang Manor and had recently encountered serious trouble when they accidentally discovered a mini Spirit Stone Mine, instantly attracting the covetousness of many powers.
The mini Spirit Stone Mine was estimated to yield a few thousand Lower Grade Spirit Stones, which the Chu family, lacking even an Innate Realm cultivator, had no capability to defend, yet they were desperate to keep it.
If they could defend the mine, the Chu family could develop and grow rapidly in the future. It was the family’s hope for rising to prominence, tied to the interests of every member, with none willing to relinquish it.
Since the mine was miniaturized, with only a few thousand stones as reserves and required a significant amount of time and energy to mine, it was beneath the notice of Pihai Realm cultivators.
However, it attracted many forces with Innate Realm cultivators who sought to monopolize or partition this mini Spirit Stone Mine.
The Chu family had also contacted some forces with Pihai Realm cultivators, but those forces were greedy, demanding 80% of the Lower Grade Spirit Stones without lifting a finger.
The Chu family was unwilling to agree, as it felt like a rip-off; putting in all the effort to mine, they would only receive 20% of the Lower Grade Spirit Stones in the end.
Without a solution, the Chu family ultimately decided to offer the twin sisters, Chu Yutong and Chu Yumeng, to the Han Family patriarch as concubines, thereby securing an alliance with the distinguished Han Family.
The Han Family patriarch had an excellent reputation, fond of taking concubines, and provided ample care for the families of his concubines, making him the most approachable Pihai Realm cultivator in Fengyang Manor to seek patronage from.
Moreover, the Han Family patriarch was not a weakling, a fifth-layer “powerhouse” of the Pihai Realm!
The twin sisters were the only two in the younger generation of the Chu family with Ninth Grade cultivation talent, with the potential to reach the Innate Realm in the future. Nevertheless, in the eyes of the Chu family elders, the sisters were far less important than the mini Spirit Stone Mine.
In the end, the Chu family did ask for the sisters’ opinions, worried that if they were forcefully sent to the old Han as concubines, they might speak ill of the Chu family.
Upon learning of the situation, the sisters showed no objection; being concubines to the Han Family patriarch seemed to have no downsides.
Staying with the Chu Family, even if they had Ninth Grade cultivation talent, without a supply of resources, it was difficult for them to break through to the Innate Realm.
But if they became the concubines of the Old Ancestor of the Han Family, reaching the Innate Realm wouldn’t be difficult, and they could even strive to advance to the Pihai Realm. After all, many of the Old Ancestor’s concubines had already reached the Innate Realm.
When Han Li saw Chu Yutong and Chu Yumeng, the twin sisters, he agreed to the Chu Family’s request. He generously waived the twenty percent of spirit stones that the Chu Family was supposed to tribute.
The Chu Family, of course, was overjoyed at having secured a powerful support. After the news spread, the covetous forces, although unwilling, daring not to attempt to lay their hands on the Chu Family’s spirit stone mine anymore.
Shortly after, Han Li arrived in the bridal chamber and saw the stunning bride; Han Li smiled.
Mandarin ducks pair off under the quilt at night; a pear tree in blossom overwhelms the begonias.
After the wedding, Han Li entered another sowing season, working diligently on the undeveloped fertile land like a tireless old farmer.
On normal days, Han Li would just stay in the rear flower garden, admiring flowers, arranging them, watching dances, playing with beautiful jade, watching a group of beautiful concubines dance—his days passed joyfully.
He also heard the news of the Mother of No Birth fleeing to Leizhou, but he didn’t take it seriously. The Daqian Empire would deal with the Mother of No Birth.
Moreover, the Mother of No Birth had been seriously injured, and it was rumored that her power had greatly declined. She probably wouldn’t dare to cause trouble again and would remain low-key and hidden for many years.
Han Li simply followed Tianxuan Mountain’s instructions, letting the Han Mansion go through the motions without actually putting in any effort.
Even if the Mother of No Birth’s strength wasn’t at its peak, she wasn’t someone he could deal with, and he had no interest in provoking this Sect Hierarch.
Lying on a recliner, Han Li enjoyed eating grapes brought by Qiu Yueyao one moment, then savored a peach handed over by Liu Yuexin, followed by a tangerine from Li Mingmeng, a pink grape by Lin Yiwu, and a pomelo from Lin Yiyin…
After tasting a variety of fruits, Han Li felt extremely happy. Not only did he have delicious fruits to eat at any time, but he could also watch overwhelmingly beautiful dances.
At this moment, two figures approached hand in hand, the twin sisters Chu Yumeng and Chu Yutong who had not long been married to him.
“Husband, guess who I am?”
“Heehee- Husband, guess whether I am the elder sister or the younger one?
There’s a reward if you guess right.”
Chu Yutong and Chu Yumeng said giggling.
They wore identical dresses, made up exactly the same, with two identical beautiful faces leaning in from the left and right, even their voices and tones matched.
“Husband, no cheating.”
Lin Yiyin immediately said from the side, knowing that even her husband’s naked eye couldn’t distinguish them.
“Cough cough-
Han Li was about to use his Spiritual Sense to examine them when he heard Lin Yiyin’s words and had to give up.
So Han Li carefully inspected the two sisters and felt them up, still unable to tell who was who.
After thinking, Han Li said, “The one on the left is Yutong, and the one on the right is Yumeng.”
“Hehe, Husband, I’m Yumeng,” the beauty on the left immediately said.
The beauty on the right followed, “Husband, I am Yutong, surely you haven’t mistaken me.”
Chu Yutong clung to Han Li’s arm and shook it playfully, allowing Han Li to feel soft waves.
Han Li hugged both sisters in his arms, rewarding each of them, then laughed and said, “Whoever I say is who..”

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 70 The Pinnacle of the God Refining Realm 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: The Pinnacle of the God Refining Realm 1
Translator: 549690339
One year later.
Han Li was having a great time with the charming concubines in the back garden. A group of stunningly beautiful women surrounded him, each with their own tasks, providing Han Li with the ultimate enjoyment. “My lord, Sister Qin is about to give birth.”
At this moment, Liu Yuexin whispered into Han Li’s ear.
Han Li immediately stood up, said farewell to his many consorts, and strode towards the courtyard where Qin Buhui was.
Qin Buhui was a new concubine that Han Li had taken; she had joined him two months after the Chu family twins, had sixth-grade aptitude, and was at the Innate Realm. She had willingly become his concubine for certain reasons.
Over the course of the year, the Chu family twins and four other new concubines had each given birth to offspring in turn, adding four or five more children under Han Li’s knees.
Han Li’s other concubines also bore some children this year, and some of them were now pregnant, expected to give birth to new offspring next year.
Even the old ancestors of the Han family were working hard to spread their seed; his descendants inherited his diligence and continued to reproduce, increasing the Han family’s population even further.
To this day, Han Li already had 399 descendants. Once Qin Buhui gave birth to this child, he would reach a total of 400 descendants, signaling another huge bounty.
“Wah-”
With the sound of a baby’s cry echoing in the room, Qin Buhui’s child was born —it was a girl, and a notification sounded in Han Li’s mind.
Han Li didn’t go to look; instead, he held tightly to Qin Buhui’s soft and boneless hand, giving her full security, and kissed her forehead repeatedly.
After speaking with Qin Buhui for a while and ensuring she would rest well, Han Li left. A look of joy remained on his face the entire time, which made Qin Buhui very happy.
In his sleeping chamber, Han Li lay leisurely on the bed, beginning to check his gains.
“Your number of descendants has surpassed four hundred; you have gained fifty years of cultivation; you have obtained three Pihai Pills; you have obtained a profound-rank top-grade martial art technique, ‘The Lifetaker Sword
Scripture’.”
Fifty years of cultivation in hand!
Han Li was quite pleased; he had now accrued a total of eighty-five years of cultivation, which was enough to further advance his own level.
Three Pihai Pills was also good. The concubines he had married earlier had all reached the Innate Realm. Among the concubines he took later, Qin Buhui, Qiu Yueyao, and Lin Yiyin were also at the Innate Realm, while Lin Yiwu was at the Pihai Realm.
He had already accumulated quite a few Pihai Pills, enough to allow these Innate Realm concubines to break through to the Pihai Realm one after another.
With the effect of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, all his concubines had varying degrees of improvement in aptitude; those with poorer aptitude improved more and were at least sixth-grade aptitude.
On the contrary, the aptitude of sisters Lin Yiyin and Lin Yiwu improved only slightly, mainly because their aptitude was already better.
The combination of Pihai Pills and the effects of the Body-Cultivating Furnace guaranteed that the Innate Realm concubines could break through to the Pihai Realm with a one hundred percent success rate, without any accidents. Han Li also distributed a large amount of cultivation techniques and martial arts skills for his consorts to practice, most being yellow-ranked supreme grade and profound-ranked mid to low grade. He did not teach them the Step Booster Technique and the Indestructible Vajra Divine Technique yet; he would wait until they were more skilled to avoid complications.
After assimilating the Lifetaker Sword Scripture, Han Li added another powerful offensive martial technique to his arsenal, barely making up for a weakness.
Although the Xuantian Punch and the God Slaying Sword Scripture were higher ranked, they were difficult to cultivate, and he had not yet reached the minor achievement stage. The Lifetaker Sword Scripture was merely a profound-rank top grade, but at the perfected level, its power was strong, nearly touching the threshold of Earth Level Martial Arts.
Afterwards, Han Li took part of the accumulated cultivation and raised his realm to the ninth peak of the God Refining Realm, using forty years’ worth of cultivation, which was five years more than he had initially estimated.
The enhancement of his cultivation caused his Power of the Divine Spirit to surge, nearly doubling, and his Spiritual Sense also increased significantly, covering about two thousand miles; his five senses were also much enhanced.
Having reached this step in cultivation, Han Li’s level had officially reached the pinnacle of the God Refining Realm. He also acquired a perfected level Lifetaker Sword Scripture, greatly enhancing his strength.
After all this, Han Li folded his hands behind his head, deep in thought.
The number of descendants had grown from three hundred to four hundred in less than four years; the speed of branching out had accelerated considerably, and to expand to five hundred would take, at most, another three years.
With an additional hundred descendants, Han Li’s lifespan also increased by a hundred years, and now his lifespan limit had risen to over 850 years.
His current aptitude had improved significantly compared to when he had just advanced to the God Refining Realm. If there were a progress bar, it would be at roughly 55% of the Sixth-grade, still 45% away from advancing to Fifth-grade aptitude.
Upon cultivating to the peak of the God Refining Realm, the power of the Divine Spirit had strengthened to another threshold, temporarily unable to continue rising unless a breakthrough to the Hollow Void Stage was achieved.
For a cultivator at the peak of the God Refining Realm to break through to the Hollow Void Stage, one must comprehend the rudiments of a martial truth. This so-called martial truth is a broad concept, which more specifically could manifest as Sword Intent, Blade Intent, Fist Intent, and so forth.
A true person of the God Refining Realm senses heaven and earth, humanity, and all things with their Divine Spirit. Once they penetrate the illusory and glimpse the profound mysteries, they can condense their own rudimentary form of martial truth.
Every cultivator in the Hollow Void Stage possesses their own martial truth. Even if they have all comprehended Sword Intent, each is unique, following their own martial path, and only thus can one be called a Grandmaster.
The strength of a Dongxu Realm Cultivator who has mastered the rudimentary form of martial truth will skyrocket, and even a newly-advanced Hollow Sect
Master can easily defeat a multitude of peak cultivators from the God Refining Realm.
It’s practically impossible for a cultivator in the God Refining Realm to overturn someone in the Hollow Void Stage. The further one advances in cultivation, the greater the difference between each Big Realm, and not even a genius can challenge across realms.
To be able to cultivate to the Hollow Void Stage and become a Grandmaster of a
sect, who isn’t a genius? Whose aptitude could be considered poor?
“Hiss-
When Han Li saw the cultivation needed to break through to the Hollow Void Stage, he was tempted to start condensing his own martial truth rudiments.
The amount was indeed too much, surpassing his expectations.
He estimated that a breakthrough from the peak of the God Refining Realm to the Hollow Void Stage would require about two hundred years of cultivation, but the System had indicated four hundred years, doubling the amount.
Considering that his Sixth-grade aptitude was quite good, under normal circumstances, it would be hopeful to break through the Hollow Void Stage within a hundred years, finding his own martial path and condensing his martial truth rudiment.
The System explained that with Sixth-grade aptitude, the probability of breaking through the illusions, finding the martial path, and advancing to the Hollow Void Stage was less than twenty percent.
If he were to expend four hundred years of cultivation, not only would he achieve it in one go, saving a great deal of time, but the martial truth rudiment he condensed would also be extraordinarily powerful.
Han Li fiddled with it a bit more and finally understood.
To break through quickly, the cultivation required was double the normal amount; to condense a powerful martial truth rudiment, it needed to be doubled again.
Han Li felt this was a bit of a trap, but it was acceptable. Although four hundred years of cultivation was substantial, it would only take about ten years or so to accumulate it, indeed saving a considerable amount of time.
Without needing to cultivate or comprehend the Dao himself, enjoying the days like an immortal, while also being able to condense a powerful martial truth rudiment, it felt like a good deal when he thought about it.
Furthermore, if his aptitude were to rise to Fifth-grade, the required cultivation would also be halved, for the probability of a Fifth-grade aptitude breaking through to the Hollow Void Stage was at least fifty percent.
Han Li felt that raising his aptitude to Fifth-grade before breaking through to the Hollow Void Stage would be very challenging.
To advance quickly, the only way was to find a concubine with Fourth-grade aptitude and have a few descendants with Fourth-grade aptitude.
But where could he find a beautiful female cultivator with Fourth-grade aptitude?
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi had Fourth-grade aptitude, but these two were now avoiding him, and he didn’t want to cause trouble.
The daughter of the Sect Leader Gongsun Yue? Whether she had Fourth-grade aptitude, Han Li did not know.
Han Li thought it over and still had no idea where to find a beautiful female cultivator with Fourth-grade aptitude in Leizhou.
The ageless mother and the Sect Master of the Hehuan Sect were said to be female cultivators, but Han Li immediately ruled them out.
Both were old maids, and one was a Hollow Realm Master while the other was a Grandmaster Wanxiang, beyond his reach..

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 71 Heavenly Immortal Fairy_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Heavenly Immortal Fairy_l
Translator: 549690339
Upon an immense and boundless ocean, the view stretched to infinity, waves surged tumultuously, and black storms swept across, daunting to all who beheld them.
At that moment, a light boat appeared from the horizon. Wherever it passed, the winds calmed, and the waves stilled, no longer harboring a hint of danger.
At the bow of that light boat stood a figure of peerless elegance. Her beauty was divine and ethereal, her face flawless, with a gentle smile resembling a Heavenly Immortal who had descended to the mortal realm, aloof from the world.
Clad in garments whiter than snow, tall and graceful, her aura was pure and
transcendent, commanding reverence as if she were indeed an exiled fairy.
As the breeze brushed by, lifting light veils, her perfect visage was exposed, against which even the sun and moon paled in comparison.
She raised the long flute to her lips and softly blew. The melodious and gentle sound of the flute resonated over the endless sea, with each divine note transforming into fairies dancing upon the waves, quieting the restlessness and clamor of the North Sea.
The sound of the flute was like a song from the heavens, painting a brilliant tapestry of the great world; the music was like an enchanted dream, inscribing the splendor of an ancient history in a fleeting illusion.
“Bidding farewell to the White Emperor amidst colorful clouds, the vast North Sea returns in a single day.”
“One might suspect the Milky Way had fallen from the sky, as the light boat has already crossed the boundless sea.”
She lowered the translucent jade flute from her lips and began to speak, her ethereal voice echoing over the North Sea.
At this moment, her purple hair fluttered, her eyes and teeth sparkling, her appearance unparalleled in its divine beauty, her skin and bones as if crafted from jade, her figure perfect and statuesque, standing out from the vastness of the North Sea as if she were a true fairy.
Somehow, the light boat had already crossed the wide North Sea, and a vast land mass appeared 3 million miles ahead.
“The Qianyuan Divine Province, I have finally arrived.”
Gazing at the Divine Continent in the distance, the Heavenly Immortal sighed softly.
She had set out from the faraway White Emperor City that morning, when the dawn was filled with rosy clouds, and by the time she crossed Beiming, it was already near midday.
The light boat cleaved through the sea, instantly spanning a million miles, quickly entering the Qianyuan Divine Province, and then headed towards its depths.
The Heavenly Immortal had no intentions to disembark. The light boat was also a powerful treasure, capable of breaking through the sky and traversing the vast ocean at extreme speeds, unnoticeable unless one with great power intentionally spied upon it.
Her purpose for coming was simple; she wouldn’t stay long or, to be more precise, the Qianyuan Divine Province was too insignificant in her eyes to warrant a prolonged visit.
The Heavenly Immortal stood at the bow of the boat, watching the ever-changing scenery flash by as she effortlessly crossed vast distances, indifferent to it all.
Before long, the boat arrived at the heart of the Qianyuan Divine Province. The Heavenly Immortal stepped into the firmament, casually stowed away the boat and looked down.
“Dragons rise from the land.”
She commented placidly towards the empire below.
Afterward, she strode across the void and arrived at another place.
Just beneath where the Heavenly Immortal had been standing was a bustling Imperial Capital. An elder in seclusion suddenly awoke with a start, sensing an overwhelming danger that vanished as quickly as it had appeared.
The elder frowned, made some calculations, but could infer nothing concrete, yet he couldn’t shake off the feeling of unease. After a moment’s thought, he sent out a message and then resumed his seclusion.
Leizhou, Dingyuan Manor.
The Heavenly Immortal descended to a humble mountaintop.
This mountain was not tall, only a hundred meters, but under the Heavenly Immortal’s presence, it took on a majesty as if it was the highest peak, able to look down upon all other mountains.
As the saying goes:
“A mountain needs no height; it’s renowned if immortals are in sight.”
“A river needs no depth; it’s spirited if dragons breathe its breadth.”
Standing atop the mountain, the Heavenly Immortal took out a piece of greyish human skin parchment, felt for a moment, and confirmed her target was here.
She put away the parchment, and the figure of the Heavenly Immortal disappeared from sight.
Deep underground, a hundred thousand feet below, the figure of a Heavenly Immortal suddenly appeared. She found that the place was neither dark nor damp; instead, it felt much like the surface, vast and flat.
After briefly sensing her surroundings, the Heavenly Immortal headed towards the front-left direction. With a casual pace, she quickly arrived at her destination.
About a kilometer in front of her, a nine-colored light barrier emanated a profoundly mystical aura as its restrictions flowed within. Even with her cultivation level, she dared not underestimate it.
The Heavenly Immortal did not advance any further, stopping in her tracks as if some immense horror lay ahead, evoking profound wariness in her.
After a careful observation, the Heavenly Immortal was about to take action when a deep and aged voice suddenly echoed throughout the Underground World.
“Zi Miao Zhen! ”
The Heavenly Immortal’s motions froze momentarily, and she prepared to continue when the deep and aged voice rang out once again.
“Zi Miao Zhen, it’s been five hundred years, and you’ve actually cultivated to the peak of the Tongxuan Realm. Truly remarkable and exceptional.”
The presence in the shadows had seen through the Heavenly Immortal’s level of cultivation, its tone laced with hints of amazement.
Zi Miao Zhen, the Heavenly Immortal, pondered for a moment before replying softly, “Compared to you, what’s my modest cultivation worth?”
“Zi Miao Zhen, aren’t you still under a thousand years old? To have such cultivation at your age, you would be hailed as a celestial maiden even in my era,” the deep and aged voice spoke once more, its tone enigmatic, as if lost in the memories of a distant past.
“You flatter me,” responded Zi Miao Zhen.
She smiled, and with that, the entire Underground World lit up with her dazzling radiance. Her beauty unparalleled, she was a vision of ethereal loveliness.
This was the second time she had come to carry out a mission. When she first came, she had only attained the Divine Yuan Realm and was extremely cautious in the presence of this being.
This time, having reached the peak of the Tongxuan Realm, her confidence was bolstered, yet she remained immensely wary of the entity sealed and suppressed here.
Zi Miao Zhen did not dally. She noticed a minor flaw in the Unprecedented Formation that sealed the entity. Whether it was the entity’s doing or simply due to the passage of time was unclear.
Although the issue was minor, Zi Miao Zhen could not afford to overlook it and promptly began to repair it.
The hidden entity fell silent. After some time, a long sigh resonated, and it continued,
“Zi Miao Zhen, we are old acquaintances by now, aren’t we? Must you be so ruthless?”
Zi Miao Zhen remained silent, her movements steady. With a flick of her finger, magical charms and symbols flew out, integrating into the working of the great Unprecedented Formation.
The entity sighed again and inquired, “Zi Miao Zhen, my promise from five hundred years ago still stands. Have you given it some thought?”
“If you do not repair the Formation and instead help me conceal the truth for a millennium, I will grant you an opportunity of a lifetime to become an emperor.”
Zi Miao Zhen paused, the scenes from her first mission surfacing in her mind.
The sealed entity had tried intensely to lure her with all sorts of seductive persuasion, causing ripples in her moral resolve and nearly leading her astray.
Recalling it now, she still felt a shudder of fear; had she been beguiled back then, she would have wrought a great calamity, plunging the entire Yuankun Domain into chaos…
Dismissing these thoughts, Zi Miao Zhen’s resolve remained unwavering as she continued to repair the Formation. All the while, the obscured entity kept talking, offering various terms.
When Zi Miao Zhen released the last magical charm into the Formation, the nine-colored light barrier brightened slightly. She knew that the minor flaw had been fixed.
With a last glance, Zi Miao Zhen departed without hesitation, and her figure vanished from the Underground World.
“Sigh!”
A heavy sigh echoed as the darkness beyond the nine-colored light barrier receded, revealing a majestic figure.
This majestic figure, looking towards where Zi Miao Zhen had been, felt extreme frustration in his heart. The slight flaw in the Formation, which had taken him five hundred years to produce, had been repaired by that wretched Zi Miao Zhen.
“Just wait, when I get out, you will be the first one I settle scores with,” he said.
As his words faded, darkness enveloped the area once again, concealing the majestic figure..

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 72 Relaxation_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Relaxation_1
Translator: 549690339
Fengyang Manor, Lingjun City.
Han Li lay in the backyard lawn, surrounded by a bevy of stunning beauties, all of whom were looking up at the sky, watching the twilight and the setting sun.
As dusk approached and the evening sky darkened, the sunset glow, entrusted by the night, was suspended in the firmament, captivating the soul.
“Husband, which is more beautiful, twilight or the sunset?” Li Mingmeng’s ethereal voice rose.
Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, Chu Yumeng, and the other concubines also turned to look at Han Li, curious about his response.
Han Li smiled and said, “The sunset is especially gentle, and twilight is always romantic.”
“What a poetic husband,” Liu Yuexin praised.
“If you ask me, ‘The setting sun is infinitely good, but it’s nearing dusk.”‘ Lin Yiyin blinked her sapphire-like eyes.
“To see the weather at dawn and the clouds at dusk, whether walking or sitting, I think of you.”
Li Mingmeng gazed at Han Li, her eyes brimming with deep affection.
Qiu Yueyao, Qin Buhui, and the other concubines also enthusiastically expressed their opinions, receiving nods of agreement from the other ladies.
“Husband, why don’t we play a game?” the lively and active Chu Yumeng came to Han Li’s side, hugging his right hand and shaking it vigorously.
“What game?” Han Li looked at her indulgently.
“Eagle catches the chicks,” Chu Yumeng proposed with a giggle.
Han Li shook his head and said with a wry smile, “That’s too childish, I won’t play.”
“It’s not the kind you’re thinking of,” Chu Yumeng pouted.
“What kind is it then?” Han Li was puzzled. Were there many kinds of eagle catches the chicks?
“You’ll be the eagle, and we’ll be the chicks. You have to catch us with your eyes blindfolded, without cheating, and the whole lawn is your range.”
“Husband, didn’t you always want to play a big one? Today, the more chicks you catch, the more people will play the game with you,” she said excitedly, waving her little fists.
Han Li looked at Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiyin, and all the other concubines who nodded in agreement, obviously having conspired together earlier.
“Alright,” Han Li’s lips curled into a smile.
After all, he was a God Refining Realm expert standing at the peak. His five senses were extraordinary; even without using his Spiritual Sense, he could cover the whole lawn and see every detail. No rustle of grass could escape his notice.
As for whether this was cheating?
Of course not!
He wasn’t going to take off the blindfold, and catching them was all based on his own skill. How could that be called cheating?
The next day,
Within the chess garden, Han Li lay on the reclining chair, feeling a bit of back pain and a lack of energy.
All he could say was, thankfully, his bedroom was large.
A breeze brushed across his face, and Han Li drifted off to sleep unknowingly. When a system alert sounded in his mind, he woke with a start.
He opened the system panel to check, and his face immediately lit up with joy, the fatigue vanishing instantly.
“You have produced eighty offspring with cultivation talent, earning you twenty years of cultivation experience, a Seventh Grade Lifespan Extension Pill, and thirty years of alchemy experience.”
“Very good.”
With an additional twenty years of cultivation experience, his accumulated cultivation exceeded sixty-five years, bringing him closer to a breakthrough to the Hollow Void Stage.
Looking at the thirty years of alchemy experience, Han Li’s eyes glittered with gold, and he chose to receive it immediately, taking some time to absorb it.
After the absorption, Han Li transformed into an elite Seventh Grade Alchemist.
If he acquired another thirty years of alchemy experience, he would advance to a Sixth Grade Alchemist, and then he could finally start refining the long-coveted Rebirth Pill.
The Rebirth Pill is a special Fourth Grade Pill Formula, but one only needs the capabilities of a Sixth Grade Pill Refining Master to concoct it. He was not far from this step now.
Over the years, he had secretly collected most of the ingredients for the Rebirth Pill, but they were mostly auxiliary materials. The main ingredients were three types: Marrow Cleansing Grass, Rebirth Flower, and Vermilion Fruit.
So far, he had only collected the Vermilion Fruit, with no news of the other two main ingredients.
The Vermilion Fruit is a rather precious medicinal material, categorized as either spiritual medicine or treasure medicine based on its age. The older the fruit, the more valuable it is, as it can help one to improve their cultivation.
The Rebirth Pill requires Vermilion Fruit that is fifty years old. Fruit of this age is only considered a middle-grade spiritual medicine and is not very precious.
which is why he was able to buy quite a bit of it.
When Han Li first saw this Pill Formula, he was shocked. None of the medicinal materials could enhance one’s Cultivation Talent; each had its purpose, such as Vermilion Fruit for increasing cultivation, Marrow Cleansing Grass for cleansing the marrow, and Rebirth Flower for undergoing a complete transformation, and so on.
But when mixed together in certain proportions to concoct the pill, it could reverse one’s natural limits and enhance their Cultivation Talent.
One had to admit, the cultivator who created this Pill Formula was truly an Alchemy genius.
After a moment of admiration, Han Li stood up and, after a brief thought, decided not to return to his chambers. He had stayed in Han Mansion for too long and wanted to get some fresh air.
Anyway, he had the Step Booster Technique, which allowed him to cover great distances in one step, so he would be quick both coming and going. Moreover, Han Li did not plan to go far.
Immediately, Han Li stepped out and left Han Mansion, left Lingjun City, and nobody knew he had gone.
The next instant, Han Li appeared four hundred and forty-five miles away. This was the location he had locked onto with his Spiritual Sense in advance, the place he had chosen to relax and unwind.
This was an exceptionally picturesque location, resembling the scenic landscape of Guilin, with endlessly beautiful views, perfect for easing one’s mind.
Dressed in splendid robes, Han Li stood atop a peak, with hands clasped behind his back, quietly gazing at the verdant multitude of mountains, and the rivers flowing through the valleys.
The riverbanks were filled with the calls of animals and insects, sounding melodious and echoing ceaselessly; on the rivers, there were numerous fishing boats, with fishermen rowing their oars, propelling the boats forward while exchanging fishing songs.
As sunlight shone down, the fishing boats cut through the waves, creating a breathtaking scene. The water trailing the boats turned golden, shimmering with a splendid brilliance.
Han Li was amazed and thought of a famous poem from his previous life, and he recited spontaneously,
“Glistening light leaps upon the gold; still shadow sinks to the depths. Fishermen’s songs responding to each other, this joy knows no bounds.”
On the other side,
An ethereal figure, akin to a Heavenly Immortal, appeared atop a low mountain peak.
She glanced down at the summit beneath her feet, disappeared from sight, and the next moment, she was on a light boat in the sky.
After completing her mission, the weight that had been pressing on her had lifted, and Zimiao Zhen felt a sense of relief and comfort.
Thinking for a moment, she spread out her Divine Sense, intending to investigate if the legend was indeed true.
Zimiao Zhen’s Divine Sense effortlessly enveloped the entire Fengyang Manor, saw the fractured Yingyuan Mountain, and also caught sight of Han Li, who was enjoying the scenery and speaking aloud.
The place where Han Li had gone to relax was many thousands of miles away from Yingyuan Mountain, but it could not escape Zimiao Zhen’s Divine Sense.
“Interesting.”
Zimiao Zhen’s mouth curved slightly, making a brief comment, before moving her gaze away; although Han Li, at the peak of the God Refining Realm, was not much in her eyes, his spontaneous recitation and the beautiful scenery captured her attention momentarily.
Zimiao Zhen’s Divine Sense surged crazily into Yingyuan Mountain. After a deep exploration, she discovered its secrets, a look of surprise appearing on her face.
“The legend is actually true.”
Five hundred years ago, when she had explored the area, she found nothing, but after the mountain was fractured, its secrets leaked out a little, no longer able to conceal them from her.
Zimiao Zhen shifted her gaze towards the Imperial Capital of Da Qian where she had previously stood, saw that stunning person inside the Left Chancellor’s mansion, and softly said, “Interesting.”
If this discovery had been made five hundred years ago, she would certainly have taken the concealed treasure of Yingyuan Mountain for herself, but now it was of little use to her; Zimiao Zhen had no interest in it.
Her thoughts moved, and the light boat broke through the sky, leaving Leizhou, leaving Da Qian, even leaving Qianyuan Divine Province.
Zimiao Zhen changed her posture, lying down on the light boat, and a jug of wine appeared in her hand, which she lifted to her lips for a drink.
The light boat sailed out of Qianyuan Divine Province and re-entered Beiming, heading back to whence she came.
By the time she returned to White Emperor City, night had fallen, and the sky was glittering with stars. Zimiao Zhen’s celestial humming resounded just in time.
“Drunk, I knew not the sky was water; the boat full of clear dreams pressed down upon the Milky Way.”
Zimiao Zhen’s travels that day perfectly matched the scene described in her poem..

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 73: The Witch’s Concern_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: The Witch’s Concern_l
Translator: 549690339
Emperor of Da Qian’s Imperial Capital, residence of the Prime Minister.
The peerless beauty suddenly let out a sigh of relief and relaxed completely.
Before, she had felt the vague sense of being spied upon, a great threat that made her feel a sense of horror, as if it had something to do with the item she had left in Yingyuan Mountain.
If she had reacted according to her past life’s temperament, she would have directly slapped to death such a spying fellow, but that was all in the past.
She had already been reborn and become the legitimate daughter of the current Prime Minister of the Da Qian Dynasty, appearing gentle and frail on ordinary days, endearing and loved, chased by the scions of countless nobles.
In secret, she devoted herself to cultivation, and with the experience from her past life’s cultivation, she had already broken through to the True Martial Realm, but even the True Martial Realm was nothing in the eyes of that observer, so she did not dare to act rashly.
Fortunately, that observer held a high opinion of themselves and disdained to snatch her treasures, otherwise she could only watch helplessly.
The peerless beauty let out a light sigh, feeling a sense of powerlessness in her heart.
The Qian Dynasty was a minor place, its strongest being only at the True
Martial Realm. She had been very low-key, okay? Even advancing to the True Martial Realm, she hadn’t caused a stir, yet she had still encountered a great power.
After her trials in her previous life, her temperament had long since changed, radically different, which was why she could lie low and cultivate in the Imperial Capital of the Da Qian.
As long as she continued her cultivation step by step, she would eventually return to her previous life’s realm, and maybe with the fusion of the fruits of both lives’ cultivation, she might even achieve enlightenment in this lifetime.
The peerless beauty glanced towards Leizhou’s Yingyuan Mountain and then shifted her gaze to the neighboring Huozhou, a hint of mockery flashing in her eyes.
Prince Wu’an Chu Hao, as well as the other schemers of the Da Qian Dynasty, she knew all of their intentions, coveting the peerless treasure she had left from her past life.
“The old fellow from the Imperial Astronomer still has some ability, should I kill him?” the peerless beauty murmured to herself.
Somehow that old man had managed to deduce tidbits of information, causing her some trouble. After thinking it over, the peerless beauty suppressed the urge to act.
With her current strength, she could bulldoze through the Da Qian Dynasty without a problem, but that would expose her and attract the attention of the powerhouses from Xuan Domain and Qianyuan Divine Province.
If word got out to her nemeses from her past life, that would really spell big trouble, which was why the peerless beauty was extremely cautious in this life.
“Hmph- Soon, when I take that thing in advance, all you people will inevitably return empty-handed.”
The peerless beauty talked to herself and then picked up her needle and thread, continuing her embroidery, as though she truly was a fragile and genteel young lady of a noble family.
Fengyang Manor, Xiu Mountain.
Han Li stood on the mountain peak with his hands behind his back, his brocade clothes flowing, exuding an air of leisurely sophistication.
Down on the mountain rivers, fishermen rowed at sunset, singing in call and response, their boats pushing out golden ripples one after another; they found joy in it.
Little did they know that to Han Li, they were also part of the scenery, the whole Xiu Mountain area forming a beautiful tableau in his eyes.
Han Li, enjoying the view from the mountain peak, did not notice that someone was watching him from tens of thousands of miles away in the sky.
After achieving the goal of clearing his mind and taking a break, Han Li stepped out and returned to the back courtyard of Han Mansion.
Not long after, Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, the sisters, came over, both sporting little bellies.
Thanks to Han Li’s diligent sowing, both women had finally conceived their second children, and in another half a year, they would give birth to their second offspring.
“My lord, why are you hiding here? The sisters have all been looking for you,” they said.
Lin Yiyin hurried over, wrapped her arms around Han Li’s arm, and nuzzled up to him as she spoke in a sweet voice.
“Husband-” Lin Yiwu approached from the other side and embraced Han Li’s right arm in the same manner.
“What do you need me for?”
Looking at the two stunning faces that were within reach, Han Li kissed each one before standing up, wrapped an arm around each, and left the chess institute.
Before anyone knew it, a year had gone by.
Han Li still led a celestially tranquil life in Lingjun City, with no one disturbing his peace; a small place like Lingjun City did not catch the attention of the major forces.
But there were exceptions. There were three parties that paid considerable attention to Han Mansion in Lingjun City, namely the Sect Leader of Tianxuan
Mountain, Yun Miaoyi of the Yinyang Sect, and Jiang Baiye of the Canghai Sect.
Gongsun Yun designated Han Li as the inheritor of his legacy and protected Han Li’s information well, keeping Han Li’s true cultivation level hidden. Nobody knew that Han Li was the powerful expert concealed within Tianxuan Mountain.
More than two years had passed since the last incident, and seeing that Han Li remained tucked away in Lingjun City, Gongsun Yun finally let down his guard.
Although Han Li still took concubines frequently, living a life of pleasure, as long as it did not hinder his cultivation or lead him to act recklessly, Gongsun Yun was satisfied.
Yun Miaoyi, located far away in the Yinyang Sect, would occasionally purchase information on Han Li. Upon learning that this powerful expert still hid in Lingjun City, indulging in taking numerous concubines, she felt somewhat frustrated and restless.
Following the incident with the Body-Cultivating Furnace, Yun Miaoyi realized that Han Li was, in fact, a “Senior Brother Six,” a real person in at least the mid-stage of the God Refining Realm, hiding away in a small county town, which was exceedingly low-profile.
In places like Leizhou, most God Refining Realm experts were either affiliated with one of the four major sects or congregated in the Province City. Almost none stayed in manor cities.
A God Refining Realm expert needing to improve further could only acquire the necessary cultivation resources at the four major sects or in the Province City.
After escaping Han Li’s devilish grasp and returning to the Yinyang Sect, Yun Miaoyi behaved very appropriately, focusing solely on her cultivation.
However, a shadow remained in her heart, and that shadow was Han Li.
The last time she fell into Han Li’s hands, he had done too many excessive things to her. This “Senior Brother Six” stole her first kiss, toyed with her jade-like feet, made her wet, and even breathed into her ear… finding ways to frivolously tease her. Most importantly, Han Li had even recorded those moments.
Yun Miaoyi was so resentful she itched for revenge, keen on taking back the Shadow Leaving Stone. Yet, she dared not make a move, as she had sworn an oath by her Daoist heart not to trouble Han Li by any means, including exposing his cultivation level.
Otherwise, she would generate a heart devil, significantly decreasing her chances of advancing to the Hollow Void Stage, let alone reaching the Myriad Phenomena Realm. For the sake of her future, Yun Miaoyi endured.
But she always remembered, waiting for the day she would break through to the Hollow Void Stage and even to the Myriad Phenomena Realm. At that time, the oath would shatter on its own, and she could settle the score with Han Li.
Over the past two years, she had come up with ninety-nine ways to humble Han Li. He liked to tease her, didn’t he? Well, he would get his dues!
Jiang Baiye’s mentality was quite similar to Yun Miaoyi’s.
She also paid close attention to information about Han Li, and each time she remembered how Han Li had wantonly toyed with her, the pure and chaste Sword Immortal, her heart felt deeply unsettled. Over time, she developed a peculiar feeling towards Han Li.
Jiang Baiye went to great lengths to keep the news of Han Li possessing the Supreme Body Nourishing Furnace a secret, even prompting the Canghai Sect to stop their investigation.
She had promised her mentor and father figure, Jian Ziyun, that she would definitely bring the Supreme Body Nourishing Furnace back to her sect in fifty years, but she was currently helpless.
After much contemplation, Jian Ziyun chose to trust Jiang Baiye and had no choice but to do so.
It could be said that Jiang Baiye was the most outstanding disciple of the Canghai Sect. Though there were two ahead of her in terms of cultivation, in terms of talent, they fell short of Jiang Baiye.
As the future Sect Leader, it was Jiang Baiye’s inescapable duty to retrieve the sect’s precious Body-Cultivating Furnace.
After a long and private discussion with the Canghai Sect Leader, the Sect Leader ultimately agreed..

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 74 Just One Word – Grudgingly_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Just One Word – Grudgingly_l
Translator: 549690339
In recent times, the Canghai Sect has been under tremendous pressure, as various forces are eager to move, coveting the Sect’s status, resources, and territory… The Sect’s strong are guarding all over, simply unable to spare efforts to investigate, otherwise, would they only let Jiang Baiye and other disciples pursue the matter?
The Canghai Sect announced the recovery of the Body-Cultivating Furnace and unveiled a fabricated artifact to appease the current situation and ease the Sect’s pressure.
As long as they get through these fifty years and the Body-Cultivating Furnace returns, the Canghai Sect will still be among the Ten Great Sects of Daqian.
Other forces, though skeptical, ceased their covert investigations upon seeing that the Canghai Sect had retrieved the Body-Cultivating Furnace, redirecting their energy elsewhere.
If the Canghai Sect is lying, they will eventually be unable to continue the deception and that will be the time when they are collectively attacked.
Under immense pressure, Jiang Baiye cultivated even more diligently, hoping to reach the Hollow Void Stage or even the Myriad Phenomena Realm soon, so he could retrieve the Body-Cultivating Furnace earlier.
Jiang Baiye hoped that Han Li would venture out recklessly, so he would sooner or later die at the hands of other powerful beings, which would serve as revenge for her.
But she also didn’t want Han Li to venture out recklessly; better he just stay put in Lingjun City. If Han Li died, the Body-Cultivating Furnace would fall into the hands of those Hollow Realm Masters or even stronger beings.
Lingjun City, Han Mansion.
Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, the sister duo, Chu Yumeng and Chu Yutong, the pair of twins, as well as Qiu Yueyao and Li Mingmeng, these six stunning beauties were practicing sword dancing.
The six women, dressed in light clothes, danced gracefully; their tall, graceful figures, flat bellies smooth as rivers, and long, straight, fair legs were all put on full display.
This scene would heat up the heart of any man, making them want to touch and play; however, the only spectators were Han Li and his other concubines.
At the end of the dance, the six stunning beauties were drenched in fragrant sweat, accidentally revealing their allure and creating a highly tempting vision.
Even Han Li couldn’t help but gulp, for although he had caressed every inch of the six women’s skin, he still found it difficult to restrain himself at this scene.
“Husband, how was our dance?” Lin Yiyin asked with a twinkle in her sapphire-like eyes and a giggly smile.
Lin Yiwu, Qiu Yueyao, and the other ladies also turned their gaze towards Han Li, awaiting their husband’s feedback.
“Fantastic!”
Overwhelmed with praise, Han Li affectionately stroked her little head and said with a smile, “I hope you can arrange it well, and see to it that everyone can join in.”
In the past year, he had taken in five or six more concubines, now counting over forty in total.
If all the concubines danced together… Hisss- The mere thought was thrilling.
After resting in the back courtyard, Han Li returned to the sleeping chambers with several of the women, stimulating the Body-Cultivating Furnace’s effectiveness, imparting teachings and enhancing their aptitudes, and improving their cultivation.
It had to be said that the efficacy of the Body-Cultivating Furnace was remarkable, especially suitable for stimulation during battle, filling one with boundless energy.
As time passed day by day, Han Li was quite satisfied with his current life, enjoying different pleasures every day.
The key was that no one disturbed his celestial days. Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye both kept their word and stopped troubling him, and even the No-Life Matriarch who fled to Leizhou didn’t stir any trouble.
The mysterious forces behind the White Lotus Cult had yet to make their next move, granting Han Li a rare period of tranquility.
However, Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and Da Jing Empire were constantly watching like tigers, coveting to divide the Qian Dynasty, which also placed considerable pressure on Han Li.
He naturally had no intention of helping the Qian Dynasty, but if the dynasty were to fall into chaos, it was uncertain whether Lingjun City could continue to remain peaceful amidst the turmoil.
He must possess enough strength to protect the growth of the Han Family, safeguard all his consorts from harm, and ensure his own safety.
Thinking of Jiang Baiye, that Sword Immortal, and Yun Miaoyi, the Sorceress,
Han Li’s heart fluttered, and he couldn’t help but take out the Shadow Leaving Stone to admire it once again, having already done so dozens of times over the past two years.
The more he watched, the more he yearned, wanting to claim these two proud daughters of heaven for himself, to completely possess them, not just casually play with them as he had done last time.
But Han Li knew it wasn’t the time yet; his cultivation was not sufficient, and he didn’t need to rush.
Half a month later, an unexpected visitor arrived in Lingjun City.
In the chess garden’s veranda pavilion, Han Li received the guest but was quite surprised internally—why had Jiang Cheng come looking for him?
Han Li still had some impression of Jiang Cheng, a notable figure of Tianxuan Mountain, a cautionary tale of sorts, a man with sixth-grade aptitude who was still trapped in the Pihai Realm. Last time he returned to the Sect, Han Li had collected from him years’ worth of accumulated resources.
Jiang Cheng now looked completely different—not the despondent, white-haired old man he once was, but a handsome and hearty young man.
Moreover, his cultivation had progressed from the ninth level of the Pihai Realm to the third level of the Gangyuan Realm; evidently, he had overcome his emotional tribulation during this period, and Han Li was somewhat curious about how Jiang Cheng had managed it.
He knew that it was Yun Miaoyi, the Sorceress, who had initially harvested Jiang Cheng’s emotional seeds, tossing him about to no end and yet having gained nothing.
Yun Miaoyi had long returned to the Yinyang Sect and was also a true master of the God Refining Realm. There must be another reason for Jiang Cheng’s breakthrough in his emotional tribulation.
Could it be that he visited the brothels?
Putting aside the idle thoughts and looking at the tall youth sitting across from him, after some casual conversation, Han Li smiled and asked, “Brother Jiang, may I know the reason for your visit, why seek out this junior?”
Even though his cultivation was much higher than Jiang Cheng’s, Han Li felt no burden in calling Jiang Cheng “Brother,” realizing that to survive, one must have a thick skin.
“It’s like this, I plan to undertake some training in Huozhou and incidentally witness what the famed Prince Wu’an of Daqian looks like. I was hoping to invite my younger Sect Brother to accompany me, it’d be good to have someone to look out for each other,” Jiang Cheng said earnestly. Breaking through his emotional tribulation had made him much more open-minded, and his Daoist resolve had become incredibly firm.
He had hidden away in Tianxuan Mountain for quite a few dozen years, aware of only a little about the outside world. His master, Qiu Shuilin, had advised him to venture out for experience, as this would allow him to improve his cultivation rapidly.
Qiu Shuilin valued this disciple quite highly; though the emotional tribulation had troubled Jiang Cheng for many years, it was also a blessing in disguise—it solidified his Daoist heart, and after surviving his ordeal, he had even vaguely found a hint of his own martial path’s true meaning.
Just six months ago, Jiang Cheng had broken through to the Gangyuan Realm; post-breakthrough, he rapidly advanced to the third level. Given that he had barely lived past half his lifespan, ascending to the God Refining Realm was not difficult, and advancing to the Hollow Void Stage seemed likely.
Going out for training was very dangerous, especially since Jiang Cheng desired to visit Huozhou—that was even more treacherous. Qiu Shuilin didn’t want his disciple to die foolishly right after overcoming his emotional tribulation.
He had implied that Jiang Cheng should first take a trip to Lingjun City and invite Han Li to join him, to bring the Sect Leader’s favorite disciple on an adventure.
The truth was, Qiu Shuilin knew that Han Li’s cultivation was at least at the peak of the Gangyuan Realm, and he might have even broken through to the God Refining Realm, acting prudently and cautiously in all matters.
If Han Li agreed to accompany Jiang Cheng, he could look out for him, preventing his death in Huozhou, particularly as recent times had not been peaceful.
Due to the Sect Leader Gongsun Yun’s edict, Qiu Shuilin didn’t reveal Han Li’s true level of cultivation, so Jiang Cheng truly believed Qiu Shuilin wanted him to take Han Li with him for training—he had no objections.
Han Li was astonished, wondering why Jiang Cheng would choose him, seemingly only in the fifth level of the Pihai Realm, to accompany him on this expedition, so he said,
“Brother Jiang, inter-state training is too perilous. With my low level of cultivation, I really can’t be at ease leaving my family behind, so I will not join you on this journey.”
Regardless of Jiang Cheng’s reasons, Han Li had no intention of setting out on a training journey—why risk his life when he could comfortably and swiftly improve his cultivation from home?
“Alright.”
Jiang Cheng nodded, not insisting that Han Li accompany him, and in fact felt relieved at having one less responsibility to worry about..

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 75 Diancang Sect_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Diancang Sect_1
Translator: 549690339
Qingyun Manor, Cang Mountain.
The Cang Mountain range stretches for thousands of miles, dotted with numerous peaks, layer upon layer of ridges and ravines, lush and verdant within, ancient trees reaching to the skies. The scenery is not only beautiful, but the spiritual energy is also very rich.
This is the mountain gate of the powerful Diancang Sect in Qingyun Manor.
Qingyun Manor has three major sects, with the Hehuan Sect universally recognized as the first-ranked, while the Diancang Sect is ranked second.
Although the Diancang Sect lacks a Guru in the Void Realm, it has a Diancang Master at the late stage of the God Refining Realm, as well as support from the Leizhou officials, and does not fear the Hehuan Sect in the slightest.
As a major power in Qingyun Manor, the Diancang Sect controls nearly half of the resources in Qingyun Manor, holding significant influence, making it an excellent choice for youths in Qingyun Manor and the surrounding regions who wish to join a sect.
This was also the target chosen by the Eternal Mother.
Half a year ago, the low-profile Lu Tianxiang finally healed her wounds. She planned to find a way to spread her faith in order to recover her strength and quickly advance her cultivation.
She could not use the name of the White Lotus Cult anymore, as the Daqian Empire would not sit by and watch the cult rise from its ashes and create upheaval again, leaving her to flee in a sorry state like a dog that had lost its home.
Thus, Lu Tianxiang decided to change her identity and spread faith under a different guise. However, being on her own with no supporters, she was unable to establish a new sect in a short period of time.
The rapid growth and expansion of the White Lotus Cult were due to the support of mysterious forces in the background, which provided a large number of personnel. With four Hollow Realm Masters and many God Refining Realm masters, they were able to sweep through Huozhou.
After much consideration, Lu Tianxiang decided to ‘borrow a chicken to lay an egg’ by picking out an existing sect to secretly spread her faith for her.
This sect could not be weak in strength; otherwise, it would not be able to get things done. In the vast Qingyun Manor, she only had three choices: the Hehuan Sect, the Diancang Sect, and Heiyuan Mountain.
Amongst the three great sects of Qingyun Manor, Heiyuan Mountain was the weakest in strength, so Lu Tianxiang immediately ruled it out; the Hehuan Sect was the strongest, with a Hollow Realm Master, and she was unsure of the Sect Master’s level within the Hollow Void Stage, which made it difficult to interfere with.
Moreover, with the massive Yinyang Sect behind the Hehuan Sect, Lu
Tianxiang knew she couldn’t afford to provoke it, so she eliminated that option too.
That left her with the second-ranked Diancang Sect.
The Diancang Sect was not weak in strength, nor in influence, and crucially its Sect Master, the Diancang Master, was only at the late stage of the God Refining Realm, making him easier to control.
At present, Lu Tianxiang could barely muster the combat ability of a Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivator, and dared not act rashly. The Diancang Sect was the most suitable choice, and its relations with the Qian Dynasty made it convenient for her manoeuvres.
After selecting her target, Lu Tianxiang disguised herself as a young girl seeking a teacher and successfully infiltrated the Diancang Sect, where she found an opportunity to ambush the Diancang Master, converting him into one of her followers.
With the assistance of the Diancang Master, Lu Tianxiang spent nearly half a year to finally turn the Diancang Sect into her own people.
By the edge of Erhai,
Lu Tianxiang was swimming in the sea, her perfect figure revealed without reserve, captivating curves that bewitched onlookers, paired with a delicate, flawless face and an aloof demeanor that plunged people into deep addiction.
Erhai was not large, only a few miles in circumference, but it was exceptionally clear and pristine with quality waters and even more beautiful scenery. It was a place once often visited by the female disciples of the Diancang Sect.
After taking control of the Diancang Sect, Lu Tianxiang declared Erhai a
forbidden ground and set up a formation, reserving it solely for her own use.
As the Sect Hierarch of the White Lotus Cult, Lu Tianxiang had had no choice but to be high-profile, causing turmoil throughout the Da Qian; however, after seizing control of the Diancang Sect, she kept an extremely low profile, scarcely showing herself, and spending all her days in Erhai.
The Diancang Master would manage the entire sect and, in secret, spread her faith throughout Qingyun Manor, even slowly into the nearby Dingyuan Manor and Dingji Manor.
As the ultimate beneficiary of the faith, all she needed to do was hunker down in Erhai, from where she could also gauge the general state of the faith spread through the halo of belief behind her head.
“Pff-”
Lu Tianxiang emerged from the Erhai, with scant clothing that barely covered the essentials. This place was forbidden to others, she was alone, so Lu Tianxiang wasn’t afraid of being seen.
She stood atop Erhai’s surface, walking step by step toward the shore. Her delicately flawless, stunningly beautiful face; adorable tangerine-like breasts; slender waist with no hint of excess fat; perfect peach-shaped rear; paired with snow-white, straight and long legs, and a pair of tender, crystal-like feet.
All of her was exposed under the sun, her skin white as milk, shining with an icy jade luster.
Behind her head glimmered a halo, faint and incomplete, roughly one-third solidified — the fruition of her half-year’s efforts.
In Lingjun City, Han Mansion.
With nothing else to do, Han Li once again took out the Shadow Leaving Stones of Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, enjoying the recorded scenes of the two women in various shameful poses, as well as the thrilling scenes of him teasing them.
Though nothing too illicit, Han Li still found it immensely entertaining, using it to pass the time.
Watching with appreciative eyes, he pondered that if he ever caught Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye again, he would get serious, not letting them escape once more.
After watching the majority of it, a system notification rang in Han Li’s mind. He didn’t check it immediately, waiting until after he had finished enjoying the exciting scenes of the two women before taking a look.
“You have ninety descendants with cultivation talents, you’ve gained twenty years of cultivation, you’ve received a Seventh Grade Lifespan Extension Pill, and you’ve obtained thirty years of artifact refining experience.”
So this was it.
Han Li suddenly understood; half a month ago he had eighty-nine such descendants, and now, half a month later, his progeny had finally bred an offspring with the cultivation talent.
