Immediately, Han Li absorbed the thirty years of artifact refining experience and, in a transformation, became a top seventh-grade Artifact Refiner.
“Alchemy, artifact refining, and formation abilities are finally at the same level.”
A smile surfaced on Han Li’s face, which meant he could now create various medicines and weapons for the Great Masters in the Gang Yuan Realm, and he could also study and set up killing and defensive formations against the Gang
Yuan Realm.
As his alchemy and artifact refining levels rose, the grade of medicines and weapons Han Family could sell to outsiders would also improve, inevitably bringing in a continuous stream of wealth.
However, he needed to find time to spread the news that his cultivation had reached the Gang Yuan Realm; otherwise, it would invite troublesome speculations.
After some thought, Han Li decided to wait longer. He could start refining the medicines and weapons for the Gang Yuan Realm now and store them away to sell in ten years.
“The Four Arts of Cultivation consist of alchemy, artifact refining, formations, and talisman crafting. Now that I’ve mastered the first three, when will I gain experience in talismans?” he wondered while watching the koi fish swimming in the pond.
Han Li then thought about the issue of talented descendants. The next milestone would be one hundred, and that was a significant threshold. No doubt, the system rewards would increase significantly.
Currently, he only had four hundred and forty-two descendants in total, quite a bit shy of five hundred, which would require nearly two more years of development.
As for cultivation years, he had amassed quite a sum, now surpassing one hundred and twenty years, only a bit more than two-thirds away from breaking through to the Hollow Void Stage and becoming a Grandmaster.
Suddenly, a new thought crossed Han Li’s mind: “Should I let Liu Yuexin, Li
Mingmeng, and the other concubines have another child?”
Indeed, women like Li Mingmeng did have this desire, but Han Li felt that three children were sufficient. He had plenty of time to increase his progeny and expand the Han Family’s lineage.
But now the situation was slightly different. Undercurrents were stirring in the Da Qian, and he wasn’t sure how much peaceful development time was left. Rapidly increasing his offspring was an advantage.
If each of the forty-odd concubines bore a child, that would mean forty more descendants. In a decade or so, they could further expand the family line and easily acquire a hundred more descendants..

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 76 Problematic Girl_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Problematic Girl_l
Translator: 549690339
The venerable ancestor of the Han family had reached the Pihai Realm thirty years ago, during which time he took dozens of concubines, greatly impacting Lingjun City.
Periodically, various powers from Fengyang Manor would send people to participate in the grand concubine-induction ceremony of the Han Family’s elder. When frequent, there could be as many as three to five times a month; when less so, three to five times a year.
This significantly drove the economic development of Lingjun City, and more and more people flooded in, seeking greater prospects for development.
Now, the permanent population of Lingjun City had exceeded four million. Including the transient population, it had surpassed five million, ranking among the top three in numerous counties of Fengyang Manor.
Han Li’s frequent taking of concubines greatly improved the living standards of the people in Lingjun City, but the Mortal World’s ability to resist calamities remained quite low. While natural disasters were rare in Lingjun City, human-induced troubles were quite common.
The Mortal World had its own laws of development and lifestyles. Han Li would not interfere lightly, as it would become too much to manage, and there were too many grievances to be settled.
Staying in Han Mansion for long periods could become suffocating for Han Li; thus, he asked his numerous concubines if they wanted to go out and stroll the streets.
Lin Yiwu, Qiu Yueyao, and other women repeatedly shook their heads. They disliked attracting attention and preferred to cultivate in their own rooms given the time.
Han Li did not insist and took the lively and active Lin Yiyin and Chu Yumeng with him. To avoid minor troubles, Han Li disguised them with the Power of the Divine Spirit, their appearances now seeming mundane to outsiders.
The streets were bustling and lively, clean and well-kept, lined with rows of shops, and there were also ordinary people setting up street stalls.
Han Li, like a wealthy young master, was dressed in brocade clothes, a purple jade hung at his waist, and he held a White Feather Folding Fan in his hand as he swayed it gently.
Chu Yumeng and Lin Yiyin posed as his maids, looking around as they walked and chattering nonstop to Han Li, their excitement apparent.
Lin Yiyin was naturally curious about these things, and Chu Yumeng was also vivacious and energetic. The two held hands, clearly close and without any distance between them.
Feeling the worldly aura washing over him, a smile formed on Han Li’s face, and something deep within him was touched.
They say that the mortal hustle and bustle sooth the human heart, and the same is true for cultivators.
Many powerful cultivators, after reaching a certain level, would enter the secular world to temper their heart and also to strive for progression.
Unknowingly, Han Li had visited many places. He and Lin Yiyin, along with Chu Yumeng, did not feel tired. The two women, instead, were ebullient, their hands full of various snacks purchased by Han Li, and even more delectable treats had been stowed away in their stomachs. “Husband, it’s so lively up ahead.”
“Husband, can we go have a look, please-”
At this moment, Lin Yiyin and Chu Yumeng hugged Han Li’s arm, shaking it while coquettishly pleading, and Han Li was instantly won over by their sugar-coated entreaties.
“Let’s go have a look then.”
Han Li smiled and led the two women to the front left.
Although he had come to experience mortal life, Han Li kept his Spiritual Sense active, covering about ten miles around him to ensure the safety of himself and the two women.
Even though he knew there was no threat to him in Lingjun City, Han Li remained cautious to avoid “capsizing in the gutter.”
He had already noticed the situation to the front left: over a hundred people gathered around, murmuring among themselves, and in the middle stood a little girl dressed in old grey clothes.
A sign stood in front of the little girl bearing four large characters, “Selling Oneself to Bury Father.”
The crowd around was accustomed to such sights; in Lingjun City, such incidents occurred by the hundreds each year, all due to some mishap at home.
Occasionally, someone would step forward to strike up a conversation, but after the little girl quoted her price, they would shake their heads slightly, finding it not worthwhile, and retreat.
Seeing this scene, Chu Yumeng and Lin Yiyin were reminded of their own past misfortunes, and they felt immense sympathy for the little girl, meanwhile looking to Han Li.
Han Li understood their meaning and nodded slightly, agreeing to buy the girl as a maid for the Han Mansion, which was also considered giving her a path to survival.
Just as he was about to speak, Han Li’s brows furrowed slightly, his Spiritual Sense swept back and forth over the little girl a few times, and he indeed discovered something abnormal.
“Not simple.”
This was Han Li’s evaluation of the little girl.
At first glance, the little girl did not have any Cultivation Talent, quite ordinary, just a normal person.
But upon closer inspection, he found something amiss, only after several scans with his Spiritual Sense did he discover the hidden secret.
Upon Han Li’s gesture, the two women immediately stepped forward and spoke a few words to the little girl, who looked up at Han Li with surprise and delight, and Han Li responded with a nod and a smile.
Having bought the little girl, Chu Yumeng and Lin Yiyin no longer had the heart to continue shopping, so Han Li led them back to Han Mansion.
After arranging for a maid to take the little girl to clean up, Han Li called one of his descendants and instructed him to take care of the little girl’s father’s funeral affairs.
Half an hour later, the little girl, now bathed and dressed in neat clothes, was brought to the Fragrance Garden.
Seeing the little girl, Han Li’s eyes lit up; previously, she was dressed in plain gray and had a dirty face, which obscured her beauty, but now it was clear that she was a natural beauty.
The little girl was dressed in a sea-blue gown, with beautiful blue hair, neat bangs in the front and long twin ponytails in the back, each tied with a red bow. Her delicate and cute face ensured she would be a stunning beauty when she grew up, a disaster for the nations.
Han Li had already learned from Lin Yiyin that the girl’s name was Yao Xi and that she was only ten years old, so he spoke to her in a gentle tone: “Yao Xi, from now on, you can live in peace at Han Mansion.”
“Mhm mhm-
Yao Xi had been very nervous being scrutinized by Han Li for so long. At his words, she quickly nodded her head, her little hands clasping the hem of her dress.
After asking Yao Xi a few more questions, Han Li handed her over to Chu Yumeng and Lin Yiyin, who couldn’t wait to introduce her to the other sisters.
They realized that Yao Xi truly was a natural beauty, and seeing that she was likely to become one of their true sisters when she grew up, they had no reservations.
“Blue-haired twin ponytail Ioli, tsk tsk, seems quite suitable for Ioli nurturing.” Looking at Yao Xi’s retreating figure, Han Li muttered softly to himself.
He had played Ioli nurturing games in the past, which were highly customizable with various face-sculpting options, making them very realistic, but he had never played a real -life version of the Ioli nurturing game.
“I’m curious to see if you will bring me a surprise,” Han Li mused, his expression turning strange.
He had inspected Yao Xi carefully earlier and found that this little Ioli did have talent, and not a low one at that, but he was unable to see her true potential.
Yao Xi’s spirit was intact, but with a sense of incompleteness, and there was a seal inside that concealed her true talent. The little spiritual power that was revealed was already much stronger than ordinary people, surpassing even the average Pihai Realm cultivator.
This sufficed to say that Yao Xi had an astonishing background, possibly even a reincarnation of a powerful being from legend.
However, Han Li had already made up his mind to take the problematic girl under his wing once she grew up and to study her in depth to see if she was a reincarnated being of great power.
With a smile, Han Li left the Fragrance Garden and entered another garden. He saw the women gathered around Yao Xi, chatting incessantly, their curiosity piqued, while Yao Xi looked rather nervous and somewhat at a loss.
While Han Li was living an idle life of leisure, a major event occurred in Leizhou..

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 77: Massacre of the City_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: Massacre of the City_1
Translator: 549690339
Leizhou, Dingji Manor.
Yun City, with a population of more than two million, is the heart of Yun County. The stronger families and sects within Yun County mostly congregate here.
When I say stronger, I mean the highest cultivation is only at the Innate Realm, which is not much different from Lingjun City before Han Li’s breakthrough into the Pihai Realm.
Yun City is quite prosperous, its specialty, Cloud Brocade, is famous, and it is one of the few cities in Leizhou capable of producing it, attracting many businessmen.
About a thousand feet above Yun City, a figure stood tall. Dressed in black, he stood there boldly, yet no one noticed him.
Looking down at the bustling Yun City, the man licked his lips and a sinister smile appeared on his face.
“The seventh one.”
As the voice fell, the man in black had already disappeared.
Half an hour later, Yun City was completely transformed, reduced to ruins, and the entire city’s population had vanished, as if it had become a city of specters.
At the same location, the figure in black reappeared, now holding an umbrella in his hand. The surface of the umbrella was as black as ink, emanating an intense aura of hatred.
This black umbrella seemed to have just experienced some great horror, with countless faces appearing on its surface – faces filled with fear, hatred, venom, terror, and anger; they were the true expressions of these myriad faces. “Mere ants, what use is their struggle and hatred?”
The man in black sneered and blew a breath onto the umbrella, instantly suppressing the countless faces that had emerged, and the surface of the umbrella once again became pitch black as ink.
After a final glance at the ruins of Yun City below, the figure in black vanished, aware that he couldn’t stay long, or else he would be met with a terrifying pursuit.
In order to forge this black umbrella, he had gone to great lengths and been pursued several times.
Just two more massacres of county cities, and the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella could be elevated to an Earth-Level Supreme Magical Artifact. Even among the Myriad Phenomena Realm, it would be a top-notch weapon, enough to significantly increase his strength.
Then, he could use the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella to compete for the treasures in those ancient relics, as those treasures could increase the chance of breakthrough into the Hollow Void Stage.
Many in the Yinyang Sect knew this news. When the ancient relics appeared, there was bound to be a bloody struggle, and he dared not compete for it until he was fully prepared, as he could easily be sneak-attacked and killed.
Less than two minutes after the man in black left, a powerful aura suddenly descended upon the ruins of Yun City.
“Damn it!”
Looking at the desolate and empty Yun City, Commander Ji’s face turned livid.
He was a Grandmaster in the Void Realm, a famous leader of the Jingye Office in Leizhou, but at this moment, he found himself in a disheveled state.
The more he thought about that devil escaping again, the more furious Commander Ji became, and he also felt a sense of urgency. If he couldn’t catch that devil soon. he wouldn’t he able to answer to his superiors-
Including the over two million inhabitants of Yun City, this devil had now slaughtered his way through seven cities, massacring over sixteen million people—his crimes were heinous beyond measure.
Ever since the devil began his massacres, Commander Ji had been assigned the task of hunting him down, trapping him twice and leaving him gravely injured.
The devil had the cultivation of an eightfold God Refining Realm. With the black umbrella, he was no match for Ji, but he could fend off an attack or two and then escape using other means.
Every once in a while, after recovering from his injuries or waiting for things to quiet down, the devil would emerge to create chaos and look for opportunities to massacre cities.
When traces of the devil were found in Qingyun Manor, Commander Ji immediately gave chase, only to be fooled. The devil had quietly moved on to Dingji Manor to carry out a massacre.
By the time he arrived, it was too late. The devil had slaughtered Yun City, harvested millions of resentful souls, and fled.
After casting one last glance at the ruins of Yun City, Ji Rufeng’s figure disappeared. He decided to report the matter and request additional personnel from above. This devil cultivator was too slippery; it was very difficult for him to capture alone.
The Da Qian Empire wanted to temporarily conceal the news of the city-slaughter, but it was impossible to keep it hidden.
This was not just one city that had been slaughtered, but seven, with over 16 million people dead. The impact was too significant; it directly caused an uproar in Leizhou and even spread throughout the entire empire.
Han Li, who was living a heavenly life in Lingjun City, also received the news, and was instantly dumbfounded.
He had just settled down for a few years to develop and hadn’t stirred up any trouble; how did he still encounter this kind of problem?
In his opinion, as long as he didn’t roam and cause trouble everywhere, staying in the small place of Lingjun City posed no risk.
The chances of getting caught up in a fight between powerful beings, being targeted by a devil cultivator to slaughter a city for some goal, or suddenly encountering a supreme treasure in Fengyang Manor… were all extremely low.
With the rule of the Da Qian Empire still in place, normally devil cultivators wouldn’t dare to run to Leizhou and slaughter cities. The probabilities of great battles and the emergence of fateful opportunities were even lower.
But there was always someone brazen enough to cause trouble. Had this one cultivated until his mind was addled?
Han Li was somewhat speechless, but he could only prepare in advance for a response. He liked strategic planning rather than reacting on the fly.
According to the intelligence, this devil cultivator had previously been active in Qingyun Manor, pursued by Commander Ji of the Jingye Office, and had been quiet for a long time. But now, he had infiltrated Dingji Manor to slaughter the city, moving deeper into Leizhou.
To Han Li, it seemed as though this devil cultivator might have truly lost his mind, otherwise he wouldn’t make such clueless moves. Wouldn’t it have been better to spend more time in the Yinyang Sect and massacre villages?
The Yinyang Sect also had a large population, although not as populous as the Da Qian Empire, still amounting to about fifty to sixty percent of it. However, the distribution differed from that of the empire.
The territory of the Yinyang Sect mainly consisted of large cities and countless villages scattered throughout the sect.
The population of the large cities was extremely high, comparable to the province cities of Da Qian, and there were even slightly more in number. They were either backed by powerful forces or had Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage or experts from the Myriad Phenomena Realm stationed in them.
The Yinyang Sect, being a sect, was fundamentally different from empires like Da Qian. The rule of the Da Qian Empire could extend down to the county level, resulting in a relatively harmonious internal environment with high governance power.
In contrast, the Yinyang Sect’s territory was ten to a hundred times more brutal. Many devil cultivators, in order to cultivate powerful devil techniques or create powerful weapons, would slaughter cities from time to time, leaving a thousand miles of blood-soaked wilderness.
Only the citizens living in the large cities could avoid the risk of being slaughtered, but the cities had a limit to how many people they could accommodate. More citizens had to live in wilderness villages.
The Yinyang Sect contained countless villages, and the population of each village would never exceed ten thousand. Once surpassed, the excess would be driven out to establish new villages.
This practice was only to reduce the risk of village massacres. The more populous a village, the more likely it was to attract the attention of devil cultivators who could reap lives swiftly to achieve their goals.
To secure a source of disciples, the Yinyang Sect also enacted a ban, dividing territories according to the large cities and setting a limit on the number of villages. Once the number fell below a certain threshold, further slaughter was prohibited to allow for recovery and growth. Violators would be executed on the spot.
If they allowed unrestrained slaughter, the Yinyang Sect worried that all the people in their domain would be exterminated. What then would be the point of ruling over the territory?
With a devil cultivator capable of slaughtering seven cities still at large, Han Li considered him foolish and foolhardy but could not afford to be unprepared. After all, Dingji Manor bordered Fengyang Manor.
Han Li also couldn’t determine whether this devil cultivator would come to Fengyang Manor to carry out a massacre. Given the devil cultivator’s foolhardiness, it was very possible.
If that were to happen, Lingjun City, where he resided, might face a major crisis. Although Han Li was not afraid, he would have to take action if it came to that, which would undoubtedly expose his strength.
Once his strength was revealed, his identity would be impossible to conceal, and it would involve the Body-Cultivating Furnace, attracting the covetous gaze of major forces. Even Tianxuan Mountain wouldn’t be able to protect him..

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 78 Prince Wu l an’s Moves_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Prince Wu l an’s Moves_l
Translator: 549690339
After much contemplation, Han Li came up with several solutions.
First, Han Li could eliminate the demon in secret before the slaughter began, as long as his true identity was not exposed, there wouldn’t be any trouble.
Secondly, return to Tianxuan Mountain and request Gongsun Yun to stay in Lingjun City for a while, until the demon finishes slaughtering the city and either escapes or is killed by the Daqian Court.
Thirdly, rely on luck.
Fourth, move away.
All four solutions had their advantages and disadvantages, leaving Han Li somewhat hesitant.
The first method had three issues, such as Han Li not knowing the exact location of the demon, whether he could quickly suppress the demon with his strength, and whether a higher-up from the Devil Sect was secretly paying attention and following the demon.
The likelihood of the third problem was small, and for the second, Han Li had some doubts. His defense and speed were exceptional, but he had always been somewhat lacking in his attack.
The Sword of Life Scripture was only a Profound Rank Top Grade, and even at the peak level, it still fell short of the power of Earth Level Martial Arts.
He had already cultivated the Yin and Yang Palm Seal to the minor achievement stage, and he could only cultivate the first half to the minor achievement level; he had completed the second form of the God Slaying Sword Technique and the second form of the Xuantian Punch.
In terms of defense, he had reached the mid to late stages of the Hollow Void Stage, his speed had reached the early stage of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but his attack was only just meeting the threshold of the Hollow Void Stage.
The difference between the peak of the God Refining Realm and the Hollow Void Stage was vast, and even a Grandmaster at the Hollow Void Realm Level One had Earth Rank Magical Treasures.
A Grandmaster at the Hollow Void Realm Level One had mastered one or even several Earth Level Martial Arts to a great level of proficiency or even perfection, and they all grasped the embryonic form of the true martial meaning, which could greatly increase the power of martial arts techniques.
Han Li felt that what he currently lacked was an Earth Rank Artifact; his weapon, the Wenxuan Sword, was a Profound Rank Supreme Grade Spiritual Artifact, which was only at the level of the God Refining Realm and could not enhance his strength any further.
If he acquired an Earth Rank Top Grade or even a Supreme Grade weapon, his attack power could completely enter the level of the Hollow Void Stage, but where would he find a weapon at the level of the Myriad Phenomena Realm so easily?
Tianxuan Mountain probably had some, but he estimated that there were very few, perhaps only one, and it was held in the hands of the Sect Leader.
Although Han Li’s Body-Cultivating Furnace was a Heaven Rank Lower Grade
Magical Treasure, its attack power was only equivalent to an Earth-Level Lower Rank, which provided a slight improvement to his strength, and he dared not use it openly unless he reached the Myriad Phenomena Realm or the True Martial Realm.
That demon dared to infiltrate the Qi’an Dynasty and slaughter city after city, even managing to escape from Grandmasters, and although it was only in the God Refining Realm, its combat ability was estimated to be on the verge of reaching the Hollow Void Stage.
Whether he could suppress the demon quickly, Han Li was not sure, but he was clear that he did not know the location of the Devil Cultivator.
The second method also had issues, why would Gongsun Yun, a Grandmaster, come to Lingjun City, a small place, at this critical time?
If Gongsun Yun came to Lingjun City, what would happen if Tianxuan Mountain was attacked?
The third method really just depended on luck, as Leizhou was large, and the Devil Cultivator might not come to Fengyang Manor; with nearly a hundred cities in Fengyang Manor, the probability of the Devil Cultivator choosing Lingjun City to massacre was very small.
But if his luck was bad and it really happened, Han Li would definitely have to take action.
Another aspect of relying on luck was praying that the Qi’an Dynasty would kill the demon sooner rather than later.
The fourth method, although capable of resolving the dilemma, posed the question: where to move to? Moving to another manor would lead to resistance from the local forces, and there was also a risk of being in a city under attack.
Moving to another province could be even worse; at least in Leizhou, he was under the aegis of Tianxuan Mountain, but moving elsewhere would be a disaster.
After much consideration, Han Li decided to follow multiple paths at the same time.
Continue to lay low in Lingjun City to develop, waiting for his own breakthrough to the Hollow Void Stage and for the Qi’an Dynasty’s response to see if they would intensify their efforts to kill the demon.
If Han Li managed to break through to the Hollow Void Stage and the Qi’an Dynasty still hadn’t killed the demon, who was also still a threat to Lingjun
City, then he would have no choice but to secretly take him down.
If, before breaking through to the Hollow Void Stage, his luck was poor and the demon really came to Lingjun City, he would first covertly display his strength, letting the demon know Lingjun City was difficult to deal with and better off choosing another city.
If the demon continues to stubbornly seek to slaughter Lingjun City, then Han Li has no other choice but to find a way to quickly subdue and kill him.
After returning to Leizhou City, Ji Rufeng immediately discussed the matter with the Leizhou Protector General and they unanimously decided to report it. Eventually, the news reached Huozhou City, where both the Protector General of the Sanzhou and Supervisor of Jingye Office, Yang Tianxiong, were informed.
The matter was of great importance, and neither of them could make a decision. They simply reported it to Prince Wu’an and let him decide.
In the Royal Manor,
Prince Wu’an sat on a huge rock by the pond and his brow furrowed slightly upon hearing the news. Was this a deliberate test against him or an accidental occurrence?
Ordinarily, the devils of the Yinyang Sect wouldn’t dare to massacre a city unless it was within the boundaries of the Yinyang Sect; hardly any would come to the Daqian Empire to commit slaughter, as those who came were killed, with none returning successfully to the Yinyang Sect.
But in recent years, the situation in the Xuan Domain had been changing unpredictably, and the long-standing stability could be broken at any moment. The fuse was the focused attention on Leizhou, Qingzhou, and Huozhou.
In preparation for potential explosive conflicts, the Daqian Empire had retracted some of its power, causing the three provinces to maintain only a facade of calm while undercurrents surged beneath the surface.
Not long ago, the troublemaking Mother of Eternal Rest had vanished without a trace for some time, and now another devil from the Yinyang Sect had appeared, really thinking they could be bullied so easily?
The Daqian Empire’s power in Leizhou was not weak, with the Leizhou Protector General, the leader of the Jingye Office, and three Grandmasters of the Demon Suppressing Army among its forces, supported by the Protector General of the Sanzhou and the Supervisor of Jingye Office above them.
Below that, in each province city, there were more than a dozen real people in the God Refining Realm, and each manor city was presided over by a real person in the God Refining Realm. Those in the Gangyuan Realm and Pihai Realm were even more numerous.
In a manor, there were at least seventy to eighty, or as many as a hundred county cities, but the resources in county cities were too scant, so those in the Pihai Realm preferred not to stay, let alone those in the Gangyuan Realm who would converge in the manor cities.
During ordinary times, with the oversight of the Daqian Empire, disciples from the sects were restrained in various cities and rarely fought, let alone committed the inhumane act of slaughtering a city.
If someone committed a crime in a city, the Daqian Empire would directly capture the culprit. If they fled, the empire would act against the sects, maintaining their control.
These were extraordinary times, and the top combat forces of Leizhou and even Sanzhou all had their respective duties, bearing immense pressure.
Prince Wu’an and Grandmaster Lan would not act rashly, anticipating a great opportunity soon to emerge. He even requested that Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong also refrain from taking action, awaiting his orders.
In Leizhou, the Protector General was preoccupied with watching over Hehuan
Sect in Qingyun Manor and was also responsible for tracking down Mother of Eternal Rest. The Demon Suppressing Army was maintaining rule over
Leizhou, leaving only the Jingye Office free to pursue and capture the demon.
The demon didn’t dare target the manor cities, only venturing to attack county cities where the Daqian Empire’s power was significantly weaker. Some of the county rulers were in the Pihai Realm, while others were merely at the peak of the Innate Realm, with hardly any power to resist.
The real people in the God Refining Realm of the manor cities varied in strength, but most were no match for the demon, nor could they match his speed. The only person with both speed and strength far exceeding the demon was the leader of the Jingye Office.
Yet, the demon had already slaughtered seven cities, and the Jingye Office had not captured and subdued him. This was a serious problem that Prince Wu’an had to address.
If he allowed the demon to continue his massacres without the Daqian Empire taking any action, the attention focused on Sanzhou would lead to even larger movements, further forcing him into a passive position.
“Hmph, I want to see who’s causing mischief behind the scenes.”
Prince Wu’an snorted coldly. During this crucial period when the opportunity was about to present itself, he did not wish to create more trouble and preferred to quietly get through this time.
Perhaps the news of the opportunity had already been leaked, which is why these people insisted on testing him, forcing him to make an appearance, to take action. Otherwise, why would they specifically target the Daqian Empire for their massacre?
“Decree: The leaders of the Jingye Office in Qingzhou and Huozhou shall lead all the real people in the God Refining Realm to Leizhou and join forces with Ji Rufeng to capture the demon.”
“Decree: The Four Great Sects of Leizhou, including Tianxuan Mountain, Sword Cleansing Pool, True Sun Sect, and Hehuan Sect, shall provide assistance. They must not shirk their duty.”
“If the demon is not captured and killed within half a month, I will hold them accountable!”
If the Four Great Sects of Leizhou wished to spectate, he would force them to pick a side. Otherwise, he would turn against them directly. Before the opportunity arises, internal stability must be ensured.

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 79: Alluring Beauty_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Alluring Beauty_l
Translator: 549690339
Prince Wu’an’s command quickly spread among the Four Great Sects of Leizhou, eliciting varying reactions.
The Tianxuan Mountain, True Sun Sect and Sword Cleansing Pool, who originally wished to stay out of the matter, were compelled to join forces with the Daqian Empire and suppress the demon cultivator responsible for the city massacres.
“Has this devil cultivator lost his mind?”
Even the mild-tempered Sect Leader Gongsun Yun from Tianxuan Mountain couldn’t help but curse under his breath.
Wasn’t it better to slowly prey on villages in the Yinyang Sect? Instead, he chose to massacre in the Daqian Empire, and now he’s asking for death.
Now great, these bystander sects had also been dragged into the water.
Although the Four Great Sects stood high above in Leizhou, they dared not provoke the Daqian Empire. Normally, they could choose to follow orders without fully committing, but at this critical moment, they really couldn’t dare to take it lightly.
The impact of slaughtering seven cities was too great, over sixteen million lives had already been lost. If he continued his slaughter, they would also be affected.
For instance, there would be fewer disciples joining their sects, as there might be a genius among those being slaughtered who could have joined their ranks.
As the Four Great Sects of Leizhou, they also had a certain obligation to prevent the demon from massacring cities, as this was about protecting their potential disciples. A demon running into their “harvest field” and uprooting a large portion naturally provoked their anger.
Previously, with the Daqian Empire shouldering the burden, they could afford to watch from the sidelines, but now with Prince Wu’an’s decree, they had no choice but to get involved, otherwise being labeled as colluding with the Yinyang Sect would be disastrous.
“This demon won’t cause trouble in Fengyang Manor, will he?”
Gongsun Yun suddenly felt concerned. Beyond Dingji Manor lay Fengyang Manor where his favorite disciple Han Li was holed up in Lingjun City.
No matter how powerful Han Li was, he couldn’t match that demon, and Gongsun Yun knew that the demon possessed a powerful Magical Treasure, at least of the Myriad Phenomena Realm caliber, which had allowed him to escape the Jingye Office’s command multiple times.
This only strengthened Gongsun Yun’s resolve to participate. The sooner they killed that stubborn devil cultivator, the better, lest Han Li got dragged into this—a prospect for Tianxuan Mountain’s future.
The True Sun Sect and Sword Cleansing Pool also took to the field one after another. Their Sect Leaders led a few Elders at the God Refining Realm to join the hunt for the demon, but not with the same intensity as Tianxuan Mountain.
Meanwhile, within the Hehuan Sect of another major faction in Leizhou.
A tall and mature beauty furrowed her brows, making her appear even more enticing, like a fully ripe peach, untarnished by the years.
Her skin was as tender as a young girl’s, yet she harbored a mature and cold charm unique to a married woman, truly an irresistibly mature beauty.
She was Yan Liulong, the Sect Master of the Hehuan Sect.
Yan Liulong wore a tight-fitting jumpsuit that split high up her thigh, revealing her round and slender legs encased in black silk stockings. At this moment, she was sitting with one leg over the other, her hand propping her chin, stunningly beautiful.
“Is Prince Wu’an anxious?” Yan Liulong’s seductive and soul-stirring voice echoed in the hall.
“Perhaps.”
Another voice arose in the hall, belonging to a man wearing a black hood, his face obscured, revealing only his eyes.
At this moment, those eyes were filled with an intense fire, unabashedly gazing at the mature, beautiful temptress as if wanting to bring her to justice on the spot.
“How about a round?”
Yan Liulong extended her little tongue and slowly licked her red lips, her expression the epitome of seduction, her voice filled with an extreme and bewitching allure.
“Forget it, forget it, my old bones can’t handle your torment,” said the hooded man with a sheepish smile, his eyes drooping to suppress his desire.
Although he was also a Grandmaster at the Hollow Void Stage, his strength fell short of Yan Liulong’s. And besides, Yan Liulong was the Sect Master of the
Hehuan Sect.
Yan Liulong licked her tongue again and said in a seductive voice, “Stingy.” The hooded man’s heart quivered, but he dared not promise anything.
“Useless thing, get lost,” Yan Liulong said coldly, her flirtatious allure gone.
After the hooded man left, Yan Liulong returned to her own chamber, stripped off all her clothes, and stepped into a tub full of flower petals, one step at a time.
Prince Wu’an, a Great Grandmaster at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, if she could have him just once, Yan Liulong believed she would definitelv be able to break through the Mvriad Phenomena Realm in one fell swoop.
Unfortunately, she didn’t dare, she didn’t even dare to show herself in front of Prince Wu’an, afraid of being killed with a single slap by that formidable man.
As for the commands of Prince Wu’an, Yan Liulong ignored them outright. Being a high -ranking member of the Yinyang Sect, why would she follow Prince Wu’an’s orders to hunt down her own people?
She defied orders, but would Prince Wu’an really dare to attack Qingyun Manor?
The Yinyang Sect wouldn’t just sit back and watch; if a war were truly ignited in the Xuan Domain, the consequences would be unbearable for Prince Wu’an.
Moreover, the high-ranking members of the Yinyang Sect had even hinted that she should, if necessary, help Lu Xiu and disrupt the Daqian Empire’s pursuit.
Fengyang Manor, Lingjun City.
Because a devil cultivator had been rampaging, slaughtering cities one after another, and the Daqian Empire had failed to suppress him, Lingjun City had experienced a certain degree of unrest.
No one knew if that devil cultivator would sneak into Fengyang Manor; Lingjun City risked the same fate of being sacked if he really came.
In recent days, several of Han Li’s descendants had visited him numerous times, revealing their concerns, and even Han Li’s concubines harbored such worries.
Han Li reassured them with a smile, saying that if the devil cultivator were wise, he would not come to Fengyang Manor to ravage but would return to the Yinyang Sect the same way he came; hence, they had no need to worry.
After soothing his concubines and descendants, Han Li was also making preparations in secret, as he had received a message from his master, Gongsun
Yun.
He was told to be careful recently and, if things got too bad, to retreat to Tianxuan Mountain, where his family could migrate to Xuanyi Manor.
Han Li was indeed considering moving, but not to Xuanyi Manor; he wanted to move to Yuanzhou, far from the whirlpool of the Sanzhou.
He knew that the storm brewing in Sanzhou could erupt at any moment, and if even a small part of it reached Lingjun City, the Han Family would not be able to withstand it.
It was all about timing, though.
Leizhou was at the southernmost part of Da Qian, with Huozhou to the northwest, but separated by a part of Qingzhou; Qingzhou also bordered Leizhou on the north and northeast.
North of Qingzhou were Luzhou and Jizhou, and beyond them lay Yuanzhou, which was already quite close to the heart of the Qian Dynasty, Yuanzhou.
On the surface, the Han Family was just a Pihai Realm family, but they had a large number of people, especially with many beautiful concubines and descendants. Moving to Yuanzhou would require crossing Qingzhou and Jizhou, and the risk was too great.
Small families migrating across states had a hundred percent chance of drawing the attention of bandits and robbers hiding in the lofty mountains and steep hills along the borders of the two states.
In some powerful bandit strongholds, there were even Gurus in the Void Realm, and the leader of the outlaws in Da Qian was even a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Han Li felt that only with cultivation at the Hollow Void Stage could he begin to consider moving his family; otherwise, if he really encountered a Guru in the Void Realm blocking the way, his years of achievements would be undone overnight.
“Sigh, the cultivation realm is truly perilous,” Han Li sighed. Even though he was kind to others and did not vie for cultivation resources, he still couldn’t escape the troubles of the cultivation realm.
This only strengthened Han Li’s resolve to keep a low profile.
Troubles came knocking even when he wasn’t seeking them out; what if he had been out and about causing a stir, would he have been able to grow and thrive?

chapters.title: Chapter 80 - 80 Exorcising Demons 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Exorcising Demons 1
Translator: 549690339
Diancang Sect, Erhai Lake.
A beautiful figure moved through the restrictive enchantments and arrived next to Erhai Lake. She looked at the fiery figure swimming like a mermaid in the lake with admiration, infatuation, and envy…
After only one glance, she lowered her head, not daring to look any longer, and silently waited.
Lu Tianxiang swam joyfully in Erhai Lake. She liked the feeling of being unrestricted, so she swam every day.
After enjoying herself to her heart’s content, Lu Tianxiang walked towards the shore, stepping on the azure waves. Her crystal-perfect jade feet touched the surface of the water without causing a single ripple, yet the surface reflected her perfect figure.
The moment she stepped onto the shore, the moisture on her body automatically dried, and her bare feet were three feet above the ground, as if they would never touch the earth. With the halo behind her head, she appeared like a true celestial maiden.
The beautiful figure then respectfully said, “Sect Hierarch, Prince Wu’an has mobilized the Jingye Office from Sanzhou into Leizhou, and also ordered the Four Sects of Leizhou to assist, proclaiming that they will surely slay the demonic figure who has been massacring cities within half a month.”
“Very good.”
Lu Tianxiang smiled charmingly, making Erhai even more beautiful by a third.
“Convey my command, intensify our propagation of doctrine in Dingyuan Manor and Dingji Manor.”
The beautiful figure was astonished and exclaimed, “Sect Hierarch, shouldn’t we be laying low at this juncture?”
In her view, this was too risky. With Prince Wu’an assembling numerous powerful individuals in Leizhou, their clandestine propagation could very likely be exposed.
Once the demonic figure was suppressed, Daqian Empire was bound to deal with them next. The Daqian Empire certainly wouldn’t allow a new White Lotus Cult to rise.
After looking at the beautiful figure, Lu Tianxiang felt her newly recruited confidant still lacked vision. She thought for a moment and patiently explained,
“Hehuan Sect and the Yinyang Sect behind it will not sit idly by. If that demonic figure is smart, he’ll lie low for a while, and we can take this opportunity to grow our followers.”
The beautiful figure suddenly understood and excitedly left. Lu Tianxiang shook her head slightly at the sight.
Prince Wu’an was ostensibly there to defend Sanzhou and eradicate the remnants of the White Lotus Cult, but he had been inactive since arriving in
Huozhou. Recently, he even called back Yang Tianxiong and Wan Guiyuan, two Great Grandmasters, clearly plotting something.
Two months ago, Lu Tianxiang finally understood why Prince Wu’an had holed up in Huozhou City after word came from her mysterious backers.
Prince Wu’an was waiting for a great opportunity to emerge!
That opportunity was suspected to enhance the quality of the Martial True Pill condensation during the breakthrough to the True Martial Realm. Lu Tianxiang’s heart was also set ablaze with desire to obtain it.
Desperate to participate, LU ‘I’lamaang could no longer care aDout otner matters; she wanted to quickly restore her strength and even push her cultivation a great deal forward.
Otherwise, even as a Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, she would not have the qualifications to be involved. She was well aware that she couldn’t last three moves in Prince Wu’an’s hands.
“I hope that old wench from Hehuan Sect can hold up, buying me some more time,” Lu Tianxiang’s gaze deepened as she murmured to herself.
The eradication campaign that drew the attention of Leizhou and even Sanzhou had grandly commenced.
Six Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage formed teams, and six groups composed of many individuals in the God Refining Realm started a carpet search from twelve directions around Leizhou, converging towards the center of the province.
They extended their Spiritual Sense, covering vast swaths of land in their relentless effort to find the demonic figure, Lu Xiu of the Yinyang Sect, and eliminate him.
Prince Wu’an only gave them half a month; they didn’t have time to wait for the demon to strike first. Therefore, they employed this brute-force method, capable of sweeping Leizhou back and forth hundreds of times in half a month.
If the demonic figure Lu Xiu was still in Leizhou, it would be impossible for him to evade their pursuit; in his hands, the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella gathered tens of millions of resentful souls, its resentment soaring to the heavens, utterly incapable of being completely hidden.
At the foot of a desolate mountain near Fengyang Manor, Lu Xiu clad in black garb was lying in hiding.
At this moment, he felt uneasy, inwardly regretting his own rashness.
After having tricked Ji Rufeng, he pretended to flee toward the territory of the Yinyang Sect, but instead did the opposite, hiding here as he awaited the opportune moment.
His purpose for coming to the Daqian Empire to slaughter was not only to collect souls to enhance the grade of his Soul Extinguishing Umbrella but also to follow the secret orders from the upper echelons of the Yinyang Sect.
Otherwise, Lu Xiu would have preferred to slowly kill off villages within the Yinyang Sect, collecting souls rather than stirring up trouble in the Daqian Empire at such a critical juncture, risking his life greatly.
The high-ranking official was not only powerful but also a Grandmaster Wanxiang; the conditions he offered were impossible for Lu Xiu to refuse, knowing that refusal meant certain death.
The high-ranking official wanted to understand Prince Wu’an’s purpose for hunkering down in Huozhou City, instructing him to slaughter within the Daqian Empire to test Prince Wu’an’s response and see whether all the great grandmasters would continue to hole up in Huozhou City.
For this, the high-ranking official gave Lu Xiu a treasure which was precisely why he could repeatedly escape from the pursuit of Ji Rufeng, the grandmaster.
Without such a treasure, relying on the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella of Earth-Level Top Grade, he could unleash combat power barely at the first-tier of the Hollow Void Stage, but he was no match for Ji Rufeng, let alone escaping.
Beyond the treasure, the high-ranking official also mentioned that a grandmaster would infiltrate the Daqian Empire to secretly protect him, and the Hehuan Sect would provide some assistance as well.
Yesterday, Lu Xiu learned that Prince Wu’an was enraged: though he did not mobilize great grandmasters, he did deploy six grandmasters and a substantial number of God Refining Realm warriors, which made Lu Xiu rather smug.
After his smugness, all that remained was apprehension. With so many grandmasters and true masters after him, he would have no chance of escape if discovered.
“Just wait a bit longer, wait for the storm to pass. Then I’ll slaughter through two more cities before making my escape. By then, with my Earth -Level Supreme Grade Soul Exhingushing Umbrella, the treasures within the ruins will undoubtedly be mine.”
Lu Xiu tried to calm himself down, repeatedly telling himself in his heart, praying not to be discovered and hoping that the Yinyang Sect’s high-ranking officials had not deceived him.
If there was a Guru in the Void Realm to help, along with the famous sect master of the Hehuan Sect, the chances of him returning to the Yinyang Sect alive were still considerable.
Lu Xiu regretted acting too recklessly; had he fled to Qingyun Manor earlier, he would have had the chance to sneak back to the Yinyang Sect, not just waiting here futilely.
Just then, a figure suddenly appeared behind him, causing Lu Xiu to shudder.
“No need to be nervous.”
The raspy voice sounded, and upon seeing the man in the black hood, Lu Xiu breathed a sigh of relief; it appeared this was the Guru in the Void Realm the high official referred to who would secretly protect him.
But the next words from the hooded man sent shivers down Lu Xiu’s spine.
“Ji Rufeng, Gongsun Yun, and others are combing over from twelve directions.
You won’t stay hidden. Now you have two choices: entrust the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella to me for safekeeping while you continue to hide here; or come with me to Qingyun Manor, but I can’t guarantee your safety.”
The raspy voice of the hooded man hit Lu Xiu’s heart like a heavy hammer, his face paling a few shades.
He hadn’t expected Ji Rufeng and the others to search so ruthlessly, sweeping through from twelve directions with their powerful Spiritual Sense, his Soul Extinguishing Umbrella, heavy with resentful souls, indeed couldn’t stay concealed.
But to hand over the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella was something Lu Xiu could not bring himself to do. It was his strongest card, an impending Earth-Level Supreme Grade Magical Treasure, the foundation upon which his survival rested, and he still hoped to vie for the treasures in the ruins with it.
Such a formidable weapon, would this Guru in the Void Realm ever give it back to him once it was in his possession?
Lacking confidence, Lu Xiu opted for the second choice.
The hooded man looked at him deeply, chuckled softly, and without saying more, led Lu Xiu away from the spot.
Lu Xiu prayed in his heart that he would safely reach Qingyun Manor, but his prayers were in vain. The pair had not yet left Dingji Manor when they were discovered by the Sect Leader of Sword Cleansing Pool..

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - 81: One Sword_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: One Sword_l
Translator: 549690339
Dingji Manor was near Dingyuan Manor, and the hooded man stopped there with Lu Xiu.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to leave, but he had been discovered by a powerful Grandmaster with Spiritual Sense and was locked in by their Sword Intent from afar. Any movement would attract a thunderous strike.
Dressed in black, Lu Xiu looked towards the approaching figure in the sky, inwardly groaning, uncertain if he could return to the Yinyang Sect alive.
The figure approached with incredible speed, traversing hundreds of miles in a single step, and in just a few strides, he came within a few miles of the two men.
It was only then that Lu Xiu could see clearly who the newcomer was. It was the Sect Leader of the Sword Cleansing Pool, which filled him with even more despair.
In Tianxuan Mountain, the Sword Cleansing Pool, the True Sun Sect, and the Hehuan Sect, the Sect Leaders of the Four Sects of Leizhou were all Gurus in the Void Realm. However, even among Grandmasters, there were different levels of strength and the leader of the Sword Cleansing Pool was universally acknowledged as the number one Grandmaster of Leizhou.
This number one Grandmaster included all Grandmasters in Leizhou, such as the Protector General of the Daqian Empire, the Supervisor of Jingye Office, as well as Loose Cultivator Grandmasters.
With a great reputation, Lu Xiu recognized the leader of the Sword Cleansing Pool at first glance and couldn’t help but glance at the hooded man beside him. Could he match the leader of the Sword Cleansing Pool?
The hooded man shook his head, his expression solemn as he stared at the figure a few miles away, feeling somewhat dry-mouthed.
The leader of the Sword Cleansing Pool was dressed in green, with three scabbards on his back carrying four swords. A wine gourd hung at his waist, and his face bore a tipsy look.
He took a large gulp from his wine gourd; the liquor poured down his face and wet the front of his clothes, but he didn’t care, just kept walking steadily towards the hooded man and Lu Xiu.
His pace wasn’t fast; each step covered just over a hundred meters, but with each step he took, the Sword Intent he emitted grew fiercer by a fraction.
Sweat beads formed on the hooded man’s forehead, the pressure from the leader of the Sword Cleansing Pool was immense, and he swallowed before he spoke:
“Lin Xiangru, can you pretend not to see us?”
“The fall of the Daqian Empire is imminent; you can still walk away now, and the Sword Cleansing Pool can be spared.”
As the number one Grandmaster of Leizhou, Lin Xiangru’s martial truth was nearing condensation into reality, transforming into true Sword Intent. Once that happened, he could step into the Myriad Phenomena Realm and become a Great Grandmaster.
Yan Liulong of the Hehuan Sect was considerably less skilled than Lin Xiangru, let alone the hooded man?
If he didn’t compare with Yan Liulong, being just at the Fifth Heaven of the Hollow Void Stage, how could he stand a chance against a Guru at the peak of the Hollow Realm, a sword cultivation Grandmaster unparalleled in attack. The hooded man had no confidence in making it out unscathed.
Unlucky enough to encounter Lin Xiangru, the hooded man internally regretted accepting this task. However, at this moment, he could only brace himself and cite the authority of the Yinyang Sect in hopes that Lin Xiangru would show some consideration.
Lin Xiangru continued to advance, step by step, seemingly oblivious to the hooded man’s words. The accumulating Sword Intent grew more immense and weighty, with a world-shaking aura that was immediately detected by other Masters and immortals who were in pursuit from different directions.
Lin Xiangru sighed internally. He had set out in pursuit only because he was under pressure from Prince Wu’an and had meant to just go through the motions. But as fate would have it, he stumbled upon them.
The demon Lu Xiu, who was on the wanted list, and a Grandmaster from the Yinyang Sect. He wanted to let them escape, but how could he? If he let these two go today, Prince Wu’an would destroy the Sword Cleansing Pool tomorrow.
More beads of sweat appeared on the hooded man’s forehead, and he called out loudly, “Lin Xiangru, do you really want to make an enemy of the Yinyang Sect?”
Seeing that Lin Xiangru was unmoved, the hooded man couldn’t be sure whether Lin Xiangru truly intended to kill him. As a Guru in the Hollow Sect, he was a key combatant within the Yinyang Sect and hadn’t committed any offense against the Da Qian Empire. If he died here, the Yinyang Sect would certainly make a big issue out of it.
“Give me the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella.”
The hooded man took out his own weapon, a Bloody Devil Spear, and a three-tiered Stone Tower, and he then said to Lu Xiu.
Both his Devil Spear and Stone Tower were Earth-Level Top Grade Magical Treasures, one for attack and one for defense, greatly enhancing his combat ability. If he had the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella as well, his power would increase even more.
Lu Xiu hesitated only briefly before handing over his strongest trump card, giving the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella, which was close to an Earth-Level Supreme Magical Artifact, to the hooded man.
In the face of Lin Xiangru, the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella was almost useless in his hands; only the hooded man, a Guru in the Hollow Sect, could utilize its maximum potential.
Without handing it over, certain death awaited; with the exchange, there was a glimmer of hope for survival.
The hooded man swiftly erased the branding within the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella, rapidly refined it, sensed its capability, and a look of joy surfaced on his face.
The power of the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella was stronger than his Devil Spear by a third; he had no idea how Lu Xiu had obtained it, but regardless of whether Lu Xiu lived or not, he was not going to return the umbrella.
Facing the ever-approaching Lin Xiangru, the hooded man didn’t delay further; the Stone Tower flew out, hovering above his head, casting down three layers of light screens.
Then, holding the Bloody Devil Spear in one hand and the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella in the other, he moved to attack Lin Xiangru, not daring to allow him to continue to gather strength.
Lin Xiangru’s steps were steady, indifferent to the various preparations of the demonic Grandmaster, knowing that once he made his move, he would surely slay the demonic Grandmaster.
“Clang- Clang-”
The Divine Sword in the scabbard on his left automatically unsheathed, and in an instant, sword qi skyrocketed, shaking the universe.
The Divine Sword landed in Lin Xiangru’s right hand, which he slowly raised, and at once, all the sword intent and boundless sword qi were infused into this one strike.
“Humm!”
Lin Xiangru swung his sword, and the brutally cold sword light glittered across half of Leizhou. The sword qi and sword intent penetrated “Heavenly Space,” as if to cleave through eternity with a single strike.
“All or nothing!”
The hooded man bellowed, using the strongest spear technique with the Devil Spear in his right hand, like a demonic dragon ending the world, destroying all mountains and rivers in its path; his left hand also activated the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella, the pitch-black umbrella surface unfurled, unleashing the terrifying power of resentful spirits, seeking to obliterate Lin Xiangru’s Divine Spirit.
Boom!
A horrific tremor resounded across half of Leizhou. When everything subsided, Lin Xiangru had already walked up close to the hooded man and Lu Xiu, the Divine Sword in his hand, unbeknownst to when, had returned to its scabbard.
“Puh-”
The hooded man spat out a mouthful of blood, his eyes still filled with shock, astonished by Lin Xiangru’s terrifying strength, nearly on par with a Great Grandmaster.
The Bloody Devil Spear was pitched at a distance with three cracks appearing on it; the Soul Extinguishing Umbrella lay on the ground with a hole torn through the fabric.
Merely one sword strike, and he was almost killed; all his attacks were extinguished by a single strike, even the protective Stone Tower had fallen to the ground, now cleaved in two.
His black hooded cloak was torn and tattered, his body was ravaged by sword qi and sword intent, exacerbating his injuries, and he could only barely suppress them. with no strength left to fight.
Lin Xiangru gave the hooded man one glance, recognized the identity of this demonic Grandmaster, and without another word, turned to look at Lu Xiu.
Just as Lu Xiu was about to speak, Lin Xiangru dismissed him with a flick, killing him instantly; a mere eighth level cultivator in the God Refining Realm, had he not held back, a single strike would have sufficed to kill the hooded man.
At this moment, streaks of light descended, and figures suddenly appeared; they were the Grandmasters from Jingye Office, Tianxuan Mountain, and True Sun Sect, and even the Sect Leader of Hehuan Sect had arrived.
In Lingjun City, Han Li watched the battle from afar, his heart pounding unabated, witnessing for the first time how strong the top combat forces of Leizhou were.
“Truly the number one Grandmaster of Leizhou,” Han Li sighed inwardly.
Although he was at the peak of the God Refining Realm, he still fell short compared to the Grandmasters and had never seen a Master-level powerhouse make a move; now, he had witnessed it.
Just as Grandmasters, with a single sword strike, the Sect Leader of Sword Cleansing Pool, Lin Xiangru, had almost slain that demonic Grandmaster, such was the extent of his combat ability.
One sword illuminated half of Leizhou, covering an area of roughly four to five hundred thousand miles. Even as the demonic Grandmaster unleashed all his skills, employing three powerful Earth-Level Top Grade magical treasures, none could withstand a single sword strike.
Ooh ooh, iron brothers, do you still have any monthly tickets? If you do, please cast a few for this book, thank you..

chapters.title: Chapter 82 - 82 Small Goal 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Small Goal 1
Translator: 549690339
“Indeed, lying low was the right decision.”
Having sensed the gap in strength, Han Li felt his decision to remain in Lingjun City was absolutely correct.
He was only at the pinnacle of the God Refining Realm now, without even the combat ability of a Hollow Realm Master. Wandering about recklessly was asking for trouble, for he would have to run if he encountered a Hollow Realm Master, and if he ran into top-class masters like Lin Xiangru, or even Great Masters, he would likely face certain death.
“I’ll continue to lie low until reaching the True Martial Realm,” he decided.
Han Li set a minor goal for himself, to keep developing for decades or even a century, by which time he should be able to dominate the Daqian Empire, right?
He had been worried that devil cultivators would come slaughter Lingjun City, forcing him to expose his strength, but now that the devil cultivator was dead, his crisis was also resolved.
As for what would follow, whether it would lead to higher-level battles, or even the Yinyang Sect going to war with the Daqian Empire, that was no longer Han Li’s concern.
With a sigh of relief, Han Li decided to take a beautiful concubine to reward himself.
Elsewhere, Lin Xiangru sighed as he watched the other Grandmasters arrive late. What a group of slackers.
He had intentionally delayed as long as he could, having walked dozens of steps already, just to wait for the other Grandmasters to arrive, but since they were so late, he had no choice but to make a move.
Even when he acted, he controlled his strength, not killing the hooded man with one stroke. As for the Devil Cultivator who slaughtered the town, killing him off-hand was of no consequence.
At this critical time, Lin Xiangru didn’t want to bring trouble to the Sword Cleansing Pool. If he killed the Grandmaster of the Yinyang Sect with a single stroke, he would definitely be hated by the Yinyang Sect.
Even if the Yinyang Sect would not trouble him or the Sword Cleansing Pool for the time being, they would settle scores when the winds changed. He didn’t want to fully align with the Daqian Empire’s ship, considering it unstable and easy to capsize.
“Brother Lin is indeed the number one Grandmaster of Leizhou, killing a Devil Sect Grandmaster with a single stroke,” praised Gongsun Yun, the Sect Leader of Tianxuan Mountain.
Sun Buhuan, the Sect Leader of the True Sun Sect, also said with a smile, “Brother Lin’s Sword Intent is both pure and integrated, he’s probably ready to step into the Myriad Phenomena Realm, truly envious.”
Gongsun Yun and Sun Buhuan exchanged a knowing glance, both secretly relieved. They didn’t want to get into big trouble, and now that Lin Xiangru had resolved the issue, they didn’t mind flattery.
Both had intentionally arrived late, showing up only after the battle had ended, while the three commanders from the Jingye Office had indeed just arrived.
Gongsun Yun, Sun Buhuan, and Lin Xiangru were responsible for searching from the southern to the northern part of Leizhou, while the three commanders were going from north to south. The three Sect Leaders understood the implication but had to comply.
“Brother Gongsun, Brother Sun, you flatter me. I am not so strong, a full-powered stroke merely inflicted severe injuries on him, and I am still a great distance away from the Myriad Phenomena Realm,” Lin Xiangru quickly said.
He certainly wouldn’t become conceited over a few flattering words. Otherwise, he’d be led astray by these two. He definitely couldn’t bear the responsibility of killing a Yinyang Sect Grandmaster.
“Sect Leader Lin has indeed achieved a great feat this time. Prince Wu’an will surely not shortchange the Sword Cleansing Pool,” said one voice.
“Yes, why be modest, Sect Leader Lin? We have all witnessed your strength, far stronger than any of ours,” said another.
“Once Sect Leader Lin breaks through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, our
Daqian will have another great Great Grandmaster,” chimed in another voice.
At this, Ji Rufeng and the other two commanders in turn relaxed considerably in their tone, glad they hadn’t disappointed Prince Wu’an.
Lin Xiangru, hearing the words of the three commanders, went dark in the face; they were really trying to pull him fully onto the Daqian Empire’s treacherous ship.
Thinking this, Lin Xiangru chuckled and was about to discreetly take a few steps back to show his stance when he noticed Gongsun Yun and Sun Buhuan had already stepped back simultaneously.
Lin Xiangru’s face darkened even more as he raised his wine gourd and took a fierce gulp before retreating behind everyone else.
The three commanders exchanged glances, seeing the helplessness in each other’s eyes. These old foxes, they were really not falling in line.
“Yan Liulong, didn’t you disregard the Prince’s orders? What brings you here?”
At this moment, Ji Rufeng, looking toward the stunning woman not far off wearing a high-slit jumpsuit, called out coldly.
The commanders of Jingye Office from Qingzhou and Huozhou also looked at Yan Liulong with an icy gaze. Regardless of how enchanting this vixen might be, it was not enough to move them in the slightest.
“The demon cultivator who slaughtered the city is dead; you can all return to Prince Wu’an to report. Hand him over to me and I, too, can go back to make my report. ”
Yan Liulong, with her legs casually crossed, reached out with her slender, snow-white hands, caressing upward from her calves as she spoke slowly and deliberately.
“Are you dreaming?” Ji Rufeng sneered coldly.
“How can you call it a dream? If you’re willing to have a round with me, I wouldn’t mind not taking this trash with me.”
Yan Liulong stretched her sultry waist, revealing a perfect S-curve under the sunlight, as she blew a breath at Ji Rufeng, her exhalation as fragrant as orchids.
“Witch!”
The other two Grandmasters shouted, their murderous intent towards Yan Liulong undisguised.
The Hehuan Sect was a malignant tumor that the Yinyang Sect had planted in the Daqian Empire, and they had long wished to eradicate it but had never found the opportunity, fearing that the Yinyang Sect would exploit the situation.
How malicious were Yan Liulong’s intentions?
If one were to sleep with her, even a Grandmaster would be drained dry by this enchantress, their cultivation dissipating into nothingness.
Gongsun Yun, Sun Buhuan, and Lin Xiangru, Sect Leaders of the three great factions, silently watched the scene unfold, showing no intention of intervening, while secretly sneaking in messages like they were watching a spectacle.
They did not fear the Hehuan Sect but knew they were far from capable of contending with the Yinyang Sect and the Daqian Empire. Therefore, before deciding which side to take, they would not favor any particular party.
“Tsk, tsk, Yan Liulong, this old vixen, is truly an unmatched beauty,” Sun Buhuan secretly transmitted.
“Brother Sun, if you get hooked by that old demoness, with your frail body, you’d be wrecked after one night. Only brother Lin could possibly handle such a temptress,” Gongsun Yun transmitted with a chuckle.
“You flatter me too much, brother Gongsun. Yan Liulong practices the Yinyang Sect’s White Bone Seductress Technique—it’s a profound Cultivation Technique of Heaven Rank quality. How could I withstand her harvesting?” Lin Xiangru denied outright, considering Yan Liulong, despite her stunning beauty, to be no more than a painted skeleton—far inferior to a jug of wine or a sword on his back.
Yan Liulong’s gaze swept over the three of them, causing them to immediately cease their secret transmissions, not wishing to offend this old enchantress.
“I must take this person back with me. If you dare, then go ahead and make your move.”
Yan Liulong walked forward with long strides, inching closer to the hooded man while speaking seductively.
The hooded man had been silent all along, but upon hearing this, he finally breathed a sigh of relief. When Lin Xiangru hadn’t killed him, he knew there was hope for survival.
The two Supervisors of the Jingye Office from Qingzhou and Huozhou were filled with a relentless intent to kill and wanted to make a move, but they were stopped by Ji Rufeng.
Supervisor Yang Tianxiong of the Jingye Office had instructed him that their primary mission was to slay the city-slaughtering demon, and they were to avoid escalating the situation as much as possible, so as not to interfere with the Prince’s plans.
For the sake of a devil cultivator Grandmaster, inviting a large-scale invasion from the Yinyang Sect and disturbing the current state of affairs was not worthwhile. It would also affect Prince Wu’an’s grand strategy; a responsibility they could not afford.
Gongsun Yun, Lin Xiangru, and the other Sect Leaders watched Yan Liulong’s departing figure, all of them sighing inwardly and reinforcing a certain resolve.
“We take our leave.”
The three Sect Leaders said before vanishing from sight, as they each returned to their respective Sects.
Ji Rufeng and the other two Supervisors of the Jingye Office felt extremely stifled. They exchanged glances, sighed, and after cleaning up the battlefield, quickly returned to report.
At Dingyuan Manor, atop a hundred-meter hill.
A Gangyuan Realm Grandmaster from the Diancang Sect passed by and stopped to rest, intending to recover his Gang Yuan before secretly spreading his teachings in a county city forty miles ahead.
Before he could catch his breath, a terrifying suction force descended, and the figure of the Great Master vanished, as if he had never been there.

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - 83 The Ancestor Took Another Concubine 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: The Ancestor Took Another Concubine 1
Translator: 549690339
Qingyun Manor, Hehuan Sect.
“My lord.”
Yan Liulong and the hooded man both spoke respectfully and with a tone of awe.
After rescuing the hooded man, Yan Liulong came to the summit of the main peak of the Hehuan Sect. Before them stood a man in yellow robes, with his hands behind his back, watching the clouds roll and unfold.
“Lin Xiangru is not far from breaking through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.”
The man in yellow robes nodded slightly, seemingly having witnessed the previous battle.
Even if a fellow Grandmaster of his sect was to be slain by the sword, he had no intention of intervening, or perhaps he was certain that Lin Xiangru would not dare to kill the hooded man.
“Du Feng.” The man in yellow suddenly called out.
The hooded man, Du Feng, immediately responded respectfully, “Your subordinate is here.”
“What do you think?”
Du Feng trembled, his face bitter, he braved himself to say, “Your subordinate was incompetent, please punish me, Elder.”
His mission within the Daqian Empire was to protect Lu Xiu when necessary, to enable him to continue the massacres and constantly test the limits of Prince Wu’an, but now Lu Xiu was dead.
He didn’t know when the influential Elder had arrived at the Hehuan Sect; probably only Yan Liulong was clear on that.
Indeed, Yan Liulong knew of the Elder’s arrival, or else she wouldn’t have risked her life to snatch a person from the hands of the six Grandmasters.
With the Elder’s backing, her confidence was sufficient. The distance between the two places was less than two thousand miles, and the Elder could arrive in an instant.
“Although Lu Xiu is dead, our goal has been achieved.”
The Elder chuckled lightly, his left hand that had been behind his back forming a claw, and with a slight tug, he extracted a large amount of sword energy and Sword Intent from Du Feng’s body before saying:
“All right, you deserve half the credit for this mission. Go back and tend to your injuries.”
Du Feng, as if granted a great amnesty, relaxed a lot, immediately leaving to return to the Yinyang Sect to dispel the residual Sword Intent within his body. “Master, has Prince Wu’an really come for that legendary great opportunity?” Once Du Feng’s figure had disappeared, Yan Liulong couldn’t help but ask.
The Elder turned around, his face unremarkable. He toyed with a ball of Sword Intent in his hands, pinched it to burst, and then nodded.
“Everything about Prince Wu’an’s move to Huozhou is very suspicious.”
“The massacre this time is no small matter. By right, a Great Grandmaster should have been deployed to strike like thunder, preventing Lu Xiu from wreaking havoc across seven cities. Yet, Prince Wu’an would rather call upon several Grandmasters from Sanzhou to pursue the chase than deploy a Great Grandmaster. It’s truly laughable…”
A cold smile also appeared on Yan Liulong’s face. The Yinyang Sect belonged to the Devil Way, but how different were Prince Wu’an’s actions?
For the sake of his own opportunity, he disregarded the lives of sixteen million people, nothing but a great demon clad in the veil of righteousness.
The Elder’s figure disappeared from sight, leaving only a sentence echoing in Yan Liulong’s ears.
“Disciple, take care.”
ERhai.
Lu Tianxiang lay on a chair, sunbathing, wearing a light and airy outfit.
Her figure was superb, graceful and enchanting, with a waist that could be encircled with a single arm like a willow in the breeze, her perfect S-curve figures alluring, her long and proportionate legs and her crystalline jade feet under the sunlight were mesmerizing.
When half of Leizhou was chilled by a stroke of a sword, Lu Tianxiang was also disturbed, watching the battle from afar, her heart wary of the Sect Leader of the Sword Cleansing Pool.
Although the Sect Leader of the Sword Cleansing Pool had not broken through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, her combat ability had already touched the threshold of this realm. It was only because her strength had recovered considerably during this period that she could possibly contend with this person.
“Who?”
Suddenly, Lu Tianxiang startled and looked towards the main peak of the Diancang Sect, where someone was watching this place, seemingly having seen through her formation and prohibitions.
Simultaneously, garments flew out and swiftly wrapped her up tightly.
With a flash of her silhouette, she prepared to abandon the Diancang Sect’s foundation and flee, as that person brought her immense pressure.
“Mother Wusheng? I bear no hostility, come over and let’s talk,” said the yellow-robed man as he looked towards the somewhat skittish figure by the Erhai, smiling faintly.
Lu Tianxiang did not approach but communicated with the man from afar through voice transmission, recognizing who the yellow-robed man was.
The third Elder of the Yinyang Sect!
A top Great Grandmaster at the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
There were rumors that he had clashed with Prince Wu’an of the Daqian Empire and suffered a slight setback. His strength was unfathomable, and Lu Tianxiang knew she was no match for him.
In Lingjun City, at Han Mansion.
Han Li was still living a heavenly life, his concubinage had expanded, gaining several charming and beautiful new concubines.
Five months had passed since the conclusion of the devil cultivator’s massacre, and the ever-urgent Patriarch Han had taken concubines five times in succession, bringing five beautiful concubines into his fold.
The cultivation level he disclosed to the public had reached the seventh layer of the Pihai Realm, making him an old monster in the late Pihai Realm in the eyes of the cultivators of Fengyang Manor.
Initially, he had thought to reveal that he had just entered the Gangyuan Realm, but after some consideration, he felt it was safer to expose less, to avoid unnecessary trouble.
The late Pihai Realm strength was enough to rank him within the top twenty of Fengyang Manor, at least that was the case outwardly, which facilitated his taking of concubines.
It was difficult to take beautiful female cultivators with aptitude above the seventh grade, but those below the seventh grade were still manageable. Among the five beauties he had taken, two had eighth-grade aptitude and three had ninth-grade aptitude.
After a few months of diligent cultivation efforts, the bellies of the five beautiful concubines had swelled. In a few more months, they would give birth to the first offspring.
Han Li’s gaze shifted, looking at the five beautiful concubines, and then at Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and other beauties, whose bellies were also swelling.
Most of the concubines he had taken in before had already borne three offspring, and the one they were currently carrying was the fourth. Han Li loved to father offspring, and his concubines all knew this; they also wished to contribute to spreading the Han Family’s branches and leaves.
They also knew that the offspring with better aptitude were more beloved by Han Li. However, their own aptitude was mostly not high, and thus the aptitude of the offspring they bore was not high. They could even give birth to offspring with no aptitude at all.
But that was in the past, as their cultivation levels were mostly now in the Pihai Realm and Innate Realm, they were very confident about the aptitude of the fourth child they were carrying, which would definitely possess cultivation talent.
Under normal circumstances, an offspring’s cultivation talent is influenced by the cultivation level and aptitudes of the parents, with only a tiny minority mutating to become even better.
If one of the parents has high aptitude, there’s a great likelihood of giving birth to an offspring with high aptitude. If both parents have high aptitude, then it’s a certainty that they will produce an offspring with high aptitude, and there might even be a mutation.
Cultivation level is also an important factor, with a higher level increasing the probability of giving birth to offspring with high aptitude, and there would never be offspring without cultivation talent.
Han Li was also very confident as he was at the peak of the God Refining Realm and possessed sixth-grade aptitude; plus, he had secretly used the Body-Cultivating Furnace on all his concubines, enhancing their aptitude and cultivation levels.
In just a few more months, he would have dozens more offspring with aptitude. If one included those without aptitude, the number of offspring would increase even more.
After all, his descendants were also procreating, continuously branching out. Those who remained in Han Mansion, though unable to cultivate, were still able to marry spouses with aptitude.
For the offspring of Han Li, there were two choices in marrying a wife or taking a concubine, or accepting a son-in -law: one was high in beauty but without aptitude; the other was above-average in appearance but with aptitude.
To prevent certain problems from arising, Han Li had specifically decreed that direct relatives and collateral relatives within five generations were not to intermarry.
In recent years, Han Li had not neglected the development of his family; in fact, he had devoted much attention to the growth of the clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - 84: Ominous Premonition_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Ominous Premonition_l
Translator: 549690339
Under Han Li’s construction, the Han Family had become a major clan in Fengyang Manor, with hundreds of direct relatives. Including various family servants, custodians, guards, and so on, there were thousands or even tens of thousands of people.
Han Li had refined a large quantity of Eighth Grade Elixirs and Spiritual Artifacts. The Han Mansion had also recruited Alchemists and Artifact Refiners as guest elders who produced many inferior, Ninth Grade elixirs and Spiritual Artifacts, providing the Han Family with a vast fortune and numerous Spirit Stones.
