Now, the Han Mansion’s influence had spread to several surrounding provinces. Many of the Sects nearby counted descendants of the Han Mansion among their disciples, and there were quite a few in Tianxuan Mountain as well.
The secular wealth of the Han Family was primarily allotted to clan members unable to practice cultivation. Besides a fixed monthly allocation of resources, if someone wished to obtain more resources and wealth, they would have to help the family with tasks, with the easiest being to expand the family lineage.
The resources for cultivation, such as Spirit Stones, primarily fell into three categories: one was for the cultivation of Han Li’s concubines, the second was divided into three parts, one for those descendants cultivating in Sects, another part to reward capable descendants, and the last for the family’s guest elders and guards.
The third category was for family reserves, which were required to purchase Pill Formulas, Array Diagrams, Refining Blueprints, or the corresponding materials, and so on.
After advancing his Alchemy, Artifact Refining, and Formation skills to the Seventh Grade, Han Li instructed his descendants to start collecting those items, but the results were not significant. After all, those in charge of the family affairs were capable but lacked the cultivation to access higher-level resources.
However, this was only temporary. Once those descendants who were cultivating in Sects returned with their learnings, the Han Mansion would truly become a cultivating family.
To secure the family’s safety, he had long since arranged the Five Elements Life and Death Formation provided by his master, Gongsun Yun, which, once activated, could withstand attacks from a real person of the God Refining Realm.
Han Li took a long breath out. The thought of facing the naming ceremony in a few months left him feeling somewhat helpless.
After each concubine gave birth to descendants, Han Li would give them names to express his importance. For some juniors he was particularly fond of, he would personally name them.
According to the genealogy Han Li compiled, the naming tradition was as follows: ‘Eternity and Prosperity, Great Rise and Continuation, Upholding the Sacred and Succeeding the Ancestors, Blessed Glory, Wise and Virtuous,
Splendid Transmission…”
“Big brother, what are you worrying about?”
At that moment, a voice as crisp as a silver bell rang out by Han Li’s ear.
Han Li looked over and saw that Yao Xi, the young girl, was dressed in pink today, looking fresh and tender, entirely different from the poorly dressed little girl he first met.
“It’s nothing. Have you remembered anything recently, Xi Xi?” Han Li asked, a trace of concern flashing in his eyes as he looked at the young girl.
Some time ago, Yao Xi had complained of a headache and experienced strange scriptures and memories in her mind.
After asking her to elaborate, Han Li discovered that it was the first layer of a powerful cultivation technique, but he did not know the exact strength of it.
Those inexplicable memories also contained some place names, but upon checking, Han Li found that they did not exist in the Qianyuan Divine Province. “Not at all, lately Xi Xi has been doing well-‘t The girl giggled, her face innocent and carefree.
Han Li nodded, not probing further, instead continuing to ponder other issues.
The turmoil of the Devil Cultivators’ slaughter had long since passed. Neither the Yinyang Sect nor the Daqian Empire persisted in dwelling on the matter.
The Mother of No Life had not caused any more trouble, and although the Da Jing Dynasty seemed to be restless, they had not made a move. Even the vanguard of the Buddha Domain, the Kurong Sect, had quieted down…
All of a sudden, the entire Xuan Domain became peaceful, as if it had returned to the stability of the days before.
Yet, Han Li had an ominous premonition in his heart, causing him some unease and uncertainty about the source of this ominous feeling.
Huozhou City, Royal Manor.
Mr. Lan put down the book in his hands and watched Prince Wu’an fishing, hesitating to speak.
“Why do you hesitate, Mr. Lan?” Prince Wu’an’s voice sounded. Mr. Lan sighed softly and finally spoke, “Prince, your mind is disturbed.”
“Is it?”
Prince Wu’an neither confirmed nor denied.
Mr. Lan did not say anything more.
“Since they wish to play, then this prince will gladly accompany them in their game,” said Prince Wu’an as he stood up, his demeanor vibrant and a hint of murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
He had not wanted to cause further trouble, but those people insisted on provoking him.
Lately, Prince Wu’an had received numerous secret reports; he had everything under his control, and now he was curious to see who else would dare to emerge.
A flicker of light passed through Mr. Lan’s eyes.
He found that, ever since arriving in Huozhou, Prince Wu’an’s behavior seemed somewhat different from before, though he couldn’t quite pinpoint the change just yet.
Leizhou, Dingji Manor.
Atop a hundred-meter-tall hill, a figure suddenly appeared — it was the very Gang Yuan Realm Great Master from the Diancang Sect who had vanished before.
Before his disappearance, he was merely at the second level of the Gang Yuan Realm, but upon his return, he had reached the ninth level. Advancing seven levels in a mere five months was indeed a startling feat.
The Great Master’s face was flushed with excitement as he recalled everything he had experienced in the underground world over the past few months, which only intensified his agitation.
“Huff-
He exhaled several breaths in succession to calm his emotions.
The matter was of great importance; he needed to rush back to the Diancang Sect and inform the Sect Hierarch at once.
Traveling with utmost haste, the Great Master returned to the Er Sea of Cang Mountain in less than half a day and reported the matter to the Diancang Master.
The Diancang Master was shocked to the core and immediately set off to the Erhai to request an audience with Sect Master Tianxiang.
The newly established covert sect founded by Lu Tianxiang was named the Tian Xiang Sect, with her as the Sect Hierarch, while the main body remained the Diancang Sect.
Lu Tianxiang had also just returned to the Erhai not long ago and agreed to meet with the two upon learning of the urgent matter.
Some time ago, three Elders from the Yinyang Sect approached her, negotiated for a while, and made some offers. Lu Tianxiang considered them and agreed to some of the terms.
Thereafter, she temporarily left the Erhai and hurried back to the Chaotic Domain, to the depths of the towering mountain ranges, where she met with a bigwig from the Mysterious Forces.
Lu Tianxiang relayed the agreement she made with the three Elders of the Yinyang Sect to the bigwig, who had already received part of the intelligence. Hearing Lu Tianxiang’s words, he became even more certain.
The two conversed, and the bigwig instructed Lu Tianxiang to return to her hiding place and continue cooperating with the Yinyang Sect, without joining the next operation for the time being.
To further destabilize the Daqian Empire and concurrently test Prince Wu’an, the Mysterious Forces had decided to stage a major event within three years to intimidate those sects aligned with the Daqian Empire.
Lu Tianxiang met with the Diancang Master and the Great Master in a grand hall beside the Erhai.
She sat high upon her throne in the depths of the grand hall, her halo shimmering behind her head, her long, jade-like legs crossed to display a beautiful scene.
Yet, the Diancang Master and the Great Master kept their heads lowered, not daring to overstep in the slightest.
“Speak.”
The authoritative voice of Lu Tianxiang echoed in the grand hall, causing both men to jolt.
The Gang Yuan Realm Master took a deep breath, stepped forward, and, with his head still bowed, reported, “Your Holiness, this subordinate discovered a secret territory within Dingji Manor that holds great opportunities.”
“I was trapped in the secret territory for several months, allowing my cultivation to surge forward dramatically, breaking through seven levels, and I also accidentally uncovered a tremendous secret.”
The more he spoke, the more excited he became, his face flushing with enthusiasm.
Lu Tianxiang’s pupils contracted slightly..

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - 85 Too Bitter 1
chapters.content:
85  Chapter 85 Too Bitter_1
```
Breaking through seven layers in the Gangyuan Realm in just four or five months?
Indeed, this opportunity is not insignificant. The first thing Lu Tianxiang thought of was the great opportunity that Prince Wu'an was waiting for.
The legendary chance to enhance the quality of the Martial True Pill when breaking through to the True Martial Realm is probably unattainable for those in the Gangyuan Realm, but it's still possible to greatly improve one's cultivation by scraping up some residual benefits.
A hint of joy appeared on Lu Tianxiang's lovely face. If that were the case, wouldn't she be able to snatch the great opportunity ahead of time?
Diancang Master and the Great Master both bowed their heads and didn't see this peach-blossom-like moment. Lu Tianxiang said in a grave tone, "Explain in detail, and there must not be the slightest concealment."
She needed to know where this secret territory was, what was inside it, and what he had experienced within... This was crucial to whether she could seize the great opportunity that Prince Wu'an had been eagerly waiting for ahead of time.
"This subordinate dares not." The Great Master replied respectfully, his voice filled with sincerity and reverence.
"That day, as I was about to travel to Tu'an City in Dingyuan Manor to spread the teachings, I passed by a small mountain a hundred meters high. While resting there, a terrifying suction force suddenly appeared and absorbed me. When I appeared again, I had already entered the secret territory."
This Great Master did not realize that it was the Underground World; he still thought he had entered a secret territory.
"The spiritual energy in the secret territory was extremely rich. Having explored it a bit, I found the secret territory to be vast, containing innumerable treasures, Divine Pills, Immortal Elixirs, Immortal Scriptures, and holy techniques, precious relics, great treasures... all you could wish for."
"Before the countless treasures, there was a barrier of nine-colored light. Despite all my efforts, I could not make the slightest crack, and therefore I couldn't procure the treasures. I beg the Sect Hierarch's forgiveness."
"I had intended to report back to you immediately, Sect Hierarch, but I couldn't find an exit. Thus, I cultivated in the secret territory for a while, and my cultivation level improved by leaps and bounds."
Unable to help herself, Lu Tianxiang asked, "Then how did you get out?"
"Eh... Today, a horrific suction force suddenly appeared within the secret territory, and I found myself back on top of that mountain. After coming out, I immediately returned."
Lu Tianxiang nodded slightly and said, "Very well, you have established a great merit this time, and I, as the Sect Hierarch, will reward you handsomely. I grant you..."
"Diancang Master, your contributions are also not insignificant. Therefore, I will bestow upon you an Earth-grade Superior Martial Art for you to diligently cultivate."
"Thank you, Sect Hierarch!" The two exclaimed excitedly in response.
"This matter is absolutely confidential. After you leave, you must not inform anyone. If a single word is leaked, do not blame me for being ruthless."
Diancang Master and the Great Master trembled together and repeatedly said they dared not do so, then they left and departed from Erhai.
Inside the grand hall, Lu Tianxiang paced back and forth, unable to calm her restless heart, feeling an infinite longing.
Her main cultivation technique was incomplete, albeit Heaven Rank Lower Grade, enough for her to break through to the True Martial Realm, but Lu Tianxiang aspired to reach a higher realm. Was there a complete version of the cultivation technique in that secret territory?
Or perhaps there were other powerful techniques more suitable for her cultivation and of a higher grade?
Based on her subordinate's description, there must be higher-grade techniques in that secret territory, even those surpassing Heaven Rank. The sooner she could seize them, the more extraordinary the opportunity would be.
Techniques above Heaven Rank, the unparalleled might of Divine Weapons and Immortal Artifacts, and countless treasures such as Divine Pills and Immortal Elixirs—if she obtained these, she would rise to power and be unstoppable in the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Lu Tianxiang didn't know if this secret territory was the opportunity that Prince Wu'an had been waiting for, nor did she know whether her subordinate's description was true; everything the Great Master saw might be false.
After hesitating for a while, Lu Tianxiang decided to travel to Dingyuan Manor and have a look, preferably to enter the secret territory herself to see if what her subordinate had described was true.
Out of self-interest, Lu Tianxiang did not intend to inform the power behind her for the time being, otherwise, she would gain too little.
If she also couldn't breach the nine-colored light barrier, then she would decide whether to inform the powers behind her.
Da Qian, Capital City.
Jinyue Palace, the back garden.
Here, bamboo formed a sea of purple, peaceful and serene. In the center of the bamboo sea sat a beautiful woman in a yellow palace dress, idly plucking the strings of a guqin. The sound of the guqin, ethereal and lingering, created a beautiful scene.
"Did you eat someone again?"
A voice with a hint of annoyance suddenly arose, accompanied by a mature woman in a purple palace dress.
"Mhm~"
The woman in yellow replied softly, her slender, fair hands continuing to play the guqin, its sound melodious and plaintive, reverberating through the sea of bamboo.
```
"Why?" the woman in the purple dress was somewhat indignant.
The woman in the yellow dress did not respond.
"Do you realize who that man you ate was? He was the second son of the Li principal official from the Ministry of Household Affairs, and this could bring us big trouble," the woman in the purple dress continued to say.
The woman in the yellow dress laughed lightly and said, "A principal official from the Ministry of Household is nothing but a minor sixth-rank officer, what can he do?"
Hearing this, the woman in the purple dress bitterly smiled and sighed, "The Li principal official may not be capable, but don't forget this is the Imperial Capital of Da Qian. Here we have the Imperial Astronomer and those mad dogs from the Jingye Office who would start investigating at the faintest scent."
"If you really want to eat humans, would it not be better to eat those ordinary commoners? There are hundreds of millions of them in the Capital City; no one would notice even if a hundred or two hundred went missing."
"The commoners are too bitter, not tasty," said the woman in the yellow dress nonchalantly.
"Too bitter…" The woman in the purple dress suddenly fell silent.
"Don't worry, I've taken care of everything. The Jingye Office won't be able to trace it back to us."
"I hope so."
The woman in the purple dress looked deeply at the woman in the yellow dress, then her figure disappeared into the bamboo forest.
In Lingjun City, at Han Mansion.
Han Li was naming the offspring recently born to Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin.
He had been staying in Lingjun City for several more months, and all the pregnant concubines began to give birth one after another; this was already Han Li's eighth time naming offspring this month.
When the remaining forty-plus concubines gave birth to their offspring, he would be busy once more, naming all the newborn children.
Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, the strikingly beautiful sisters, had sown their seeds almost at the same time, thus giving birth on the same day, each to a daughter. The daughters did not possess the same talent as their first-born, but they were still of seventh-grade caliber.
"Yiwu's daughter shall be named Han Yongyan, and Yiyin's daughter shall be named Han Yongyan. What do you two think?"
Holding a daughter in each arm, Han Li looked at the two slightly pale yet stunningly beautiful women and announced the charming names he had chosen for their daughters.
"Whatever my husband decides is good."
The two women responded with charming, delightful smiles, quite pleased with the names.
"Yongyan, Yongyan."
Looking at the two daughters in his arms, Han Li's face overflowed with joy. More offspring meant more happiness for him, especially those with talent.
After handing the two daughters over to a maid, Han Li went over to Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, gently caressing their lovely faces and kissing their foreheads.
"Yiwu, Yiyin, you have both worked hard."
He held each woman's hand and spoke warmly.
A blush rose on Lin Yiwu's pretty face, while Lin Yiyin proudly displayed her magnificent figure and said with a smile:
"My lord, my sister and I are both Pihai Realm cultivators, not as fragile as ordinary women."
"Even so, you both need to rest properly," Han Li shook his head gently.
After talking with Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin for a while longer, Han Li instructed the women to rest well in the coming days and to resume cultivation once their vitality had recovered.
Only after both women responded with a nod did Han Li leave with ease.
Arriving alone at Fragrance Garden, Han Li gazed at the picturesque scenery, took a deep breath, and began to check the system prompt.

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - 86: Emperor 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Emperor 1
Translator: 549690339
After the birth of Han Yongyan and Han Yongyan, Han Li’s qualified descendants broke through the one hundred mark, reaching a total of one hundred and one.
The number of talented descendants breaking through the hundred mark is quite the threshold, the rewards would increase significantly. Han Li was very excited, would it greatly enhance his strength?
“You have reached a hundred descendants with cultivation talent; you are awarded one hundred years of cultivation, three Fifth Grade Longevity Pills, one hundred years of alchemy experience, and an Earth-Level Supreme Magical Treasure: the Zhenjun Sword.”
Upon seeing this system notification, Han Li’s pupils dilated suddenly, and he couldn’t help drawing in a sharp breath.
What a massive reward this batch was!
Indeed, the rewards for having ten versus a hundred talented descendants were not on the same level, having increased manifold.
Cultivation years increased from twenty to one hundred, the Lifespan Extension Pills from one to three, alchemy and artifact refining experience from thirty years to one hundred, with an extra reward to boot.
Zhenjun Sword!
This was an Earth-Level Supreme Magical Artifact, belonging to the top tier of weapons in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, possessing tremendous power.
With this Divine Sword in hand, he finally covered his last weak spot.
Combined with his Sword Art of Killing and the God Slaying Sword Technique, his strength skyrocketed, easily reaching the early-stage combat ability of the Hollow Void Stage.
“Huff-I’
After taking out the Zhenjun Sword and branding it for refinement, Han Li fondled it for a while before slowly exhaling.
He was exceedingly fond of the Zhenjun Sword; besides the Body-Cultivating Furnace, it was the highest grade magical treasure he owned, and it was a sword meant for slaughter.
If he were to confront that city-slaughtering Devil Cultivator now, Han Li was confident he could take his life within a few moves. Now, he truly possessed the combat ability of a Guru in the Void Realm.
Taking Lingjun City as an example, a Hollow Realm Master unleashing full power could destroy half a district with a single blow, annihilating the entire city within a few moves, and that’s just the early-stage masters in the Hollow Void Stage.
A late-stage Hollow Void Stage Grandmaster could effortlessly obliterate Lingjun City with a single move, without even having to use full power.
The three Lifespan Extension Pills were also incredibly significant. These were Fifth Grade pills, each capable of extending a Hollow Void Stage Master’s life by fifty years, with a maximum of three pills per person.
The Lifespan Extension Pills he’d previously acquired were only of the Seventh Grade, effective for those below the God Refining Realm, each extending life by ten years, with a maximum of five pills. (PS: All previous mentions have been changed to Seventh Grade Lifespan Extension Pills, otherwise, some might consider this a flaw.)
Though they were all Lifespan Extension Pills, their efficacy was like heaven and earth apart.
While Han Li dared to trade those Seventh Grade Lifespan Extension Pills before, he wouldn’t even dream of trading away these newly acquired Fifth Grade pills.
The Fifth Grade Longevity Pills had the greatest effect on a Hollow Sect Master but also worked wonders on a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, extending life by about twenty years, and they might even be useful to the True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
Han Li solemnly stored away the three Fifth Grade Longevity Pills. He didn’t need them for now, as his lifespan was still very long, and he also had no suitable person to bestow them upon.
His master, Gongsun Yun?
It would be better to wait until Gongsun Yun’s lifespan was about to expire. By then, Han Li’s strength would have far surpassed the Hollow Void Stage, perhaps even the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and he wouldn’t worry about the leak of possessing Fifth Grade Longevity Pills.
After taking a glance at the hundred years of cultivation, Han Li didn’t claim it and continued to accumulate more; by now, it was almost three hundred years, not far from what he needed for his breakthrough to the Hollow Void Stage.
Last, Han Li claimed the one hundred years of alchemy experience, something he urgently needed.
Having spent some time, Han Li completely assimilated the abundant alchemy experience that appeared in his mind, including alchemy techniques, skills, and fundamental blueprints.
“Huff-“
Once again exhaling, Han Li’s alchemy skill had skyrocketed many-fold, progressing directly from a Seventh Grade Alchemist to a mid-level Fifth Grade Pill Refining Master.
A Fifth Grade Pill Refining Master taking action could easily refine a Rebirth Pill with plenty to spare.
Recently, his descendants had collected the Marrow Cleansing Grass, one of the main ingredients for the Rebirth Pill, and they were only waiting to find the final Rebirth Flower before they could start refining the Rebirth Pill.
After dealing with these matters, Han Li studied further and finally understood why the reward this time was so generous.
This was because the next time a reward was given, having two hundred descendants with talents would result in a reward, but having one hundred and ten talented descendants would not.
“This is somewhat tough to endure…”
Han Li’s mouth twitched slightly, but this was also within his expectations; rewards based on the number of descendants were like this.
He had over forty concubines about to give birth to offspring, so when the time came, he would directly gain over forty more descendants with talent, and with a few more descendants born, he would have completed half the required progress.
Han Li discovered that this didn’t seem too hard to bear after all and it would be quite quick, not even taking too many years.
Thinking of the number of descendants, a smile once again appeared on Han Li’s face. The increase in number was faster than he had anticipated, mainly because Han Li had been quite diligent over the past year, time and again tilling the fertile land.
His total number of descendants had already reached 485. In as little as ten days or at most half a month, this number would reach five hundred and he would be able to receive new rewards.
By then, he should have saved enough to break through to the Hollow Void Stage, he thought.
Dingyuan Manor.
On a hundred-meter hill, Lu Tianxiang sat dejectedly, her crystal-like tender feet swinging unconsciously.
She was feeling rather irritated at the moment.
Ever since receiving reports from her subordinates that there was a secret territory here containing a heaven-defying opportunity, she had left Erhai and stealthily arrived at this location.
However, she had been wandering around this hundred-meter hill for several months, inspecting every inch of ground and finding no trace of the secret territory whatsoever.
She hadn’t encountered any terrifying suction either, which could pull her into the secret realm.
Several times, Lu Tianxiang wondered if that Gangyuan Realm Great Master had lied, deliberately deceiving her, but she only entertained the thought.
That Gangyuan Realm Great Master was brainwashed by her cultivation technique, holding a devout faith in her, and thus would never deceive her. Besides, what benefit would he gain from lying to her about this place? It would only anger her.
Furthermore, that Gangyuan Realm Great Master’s cultivation had indeed greatly advanced, which wasn’t a lie, suggesting that there really was a secret territory and opportunity here; she just had bad luck and hadn’t come across it yet.
“Should I continue?”
This thought flashed through Lu Tianxiang’s mind, and she began to waver. Staying here too long would delay many matters.
Such as liaising with the Yinyang Sect, connecting with the mysterious forces behind her, and even missing the chance to fish in troubled waters when the opportunity awaited by Prince Wu’an emerged.
After some thought, Lu Tianxiang decided to wait a few more months to make it a full year. If there was still no discovery, she would have to go back to handle her affairs first. She temporarily didn’t want other forces to discover the secret territory here.
Unknown to Lu Tianxiang, someone beneath her in the underground world was even more anxious than she was.
Deep underground, a peerless great formation sealed everything here.
This was an Emperor Formation, possessing the terrifying power to destroy heaven and earth. If even a trace of its power leaked, it could obliterate the entire Xuan Domain in an instant.
Behind a nine-colored light screen, a majestic figure appeared. He looked upward, his gaze piercing through the formation’s barrier, seeing the peerless beauty on the small hill.
In his eyes swirled countless stars flickering in and out of existence, with worlds rising and falling, and fierce, wild Chaos Qi spreading as if it intended to recreate myriad worlds within his eyes.
“Why is this little one so impatient?”
A sentence tinged with slight anxiety echoed through the entire underground world, yet it could not reach the outside world at all..

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - 87 Consequences 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Consequences 1
Translator: 549690339
For the powerhouse trapped within the unparalleled Emperor Formation, Lu Tianxiang from the Myriad Phenomena Realm was far too weak, a mere breath of air could eradicate countless such as him.
However, at this moment, he did not want Lu Tianxiang to leave, for it was a hard-earned opportunity he had finally brought about.
“Twenty-six hundred thousand years,” he lamented, “when will I be able to escape this bind?”
The towering figure spoke with a voice of aged vicissitudes, imbued with endless desolation, loss, and an unwillingness to accept fate.
After a prolonged silence, the deep and sonorous voice rose once more, “I wonder if it’s luck, or misfortune?”
Before the ancient great calamity, he was already sealed within the Qianyuan Divine Province. After tens of thousands of years, when the ancient great calamity erupted, he narrowly missed it.
Even after a hundred and ten thousand years, the thought still sent shivers down his spine; that calamity was excessively horrifying.
The unparalleled Emperor Formation sealed him, but it also protected him. Within the formation, he had a clear view of parts of the great calamity, which left him, a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, with a profound sense of powerlessness.
The ancient great calamity was not limited to just the Qianyuan Divine Province but spread throughout the entire Yuankun Domain, leaving not one of the Eight Hundred Divine Regions unscathed.
Back then, the Yuankun Domain was frequented by Heavenly Immortals; even a Great Emperor such as himself could occasionally glimpse a True Immortal. Yet during the ancient great calamity, both Heavenly and True Immortals were helpless to resist its onslaught.
He once witnessed with his own eyes the corpse of a Heavenly Immortal falling from the nine heavens, merely pierced by a beam of sword light, a Heavenly Immortal of eons fell powerless and lifeless.
At that moment, a chilling fear took over him. Inside the unparalleled Emperor Formation, he shivered uncontrollably, exerting all his strength to conceal his presence, all to avoid the taint of the calamity.
Fortunately, he did manage to survive within the unparalleled Emperor Formation. The ancient great calamity had not spread to him.
“But why did my nemesis also survive the ancient great calamity?”
In a sudden frenzy, all the grand stars in his eyes shattered, and endless worlds vanished into nothingness.
Fifty thousand years after the ancient great calamity, under his relentless efforts, the unparalleled Emperor Formation finally showed some flaws. But before he could expand on these results, his nemesis sent powerful beings to reinforce the formation.
Since then, every five hundred years, powerful beings would come from White Emperor City, crossing the Beiming, to the Qianyuan Divine Province to reinforce his seal and ensure that the unparalleled Great Formation remained intact, preventing his escape.
After numerous failed escape attempts, he fell into silent waiting, biding his time. After tens of thousands of years, he finally pried open another flaw in the Emperor Formation, releasing but a tiny fraction of his power, not even one-billionth of his full strength.
With this sliver of power, he first threw a Pill Formula outside the colorful light screen and then pulled a small cultivator passing by a hundred meter hill into it.
He remembered that the small cultivator arrived in front of the colorful light screen, dazzled by the countless treasures, desperately attacked the screen. After spending much time with no progress, he dejectedly searched elsewhere and found the Pill Formula before being thrown out again.
It was a Pill Formula that could enhance Cultivation Talent, insignificant to him, but he knew that in the current Qianyuan Divine Province, it was enough to drive all powers mad.
He intended to use the small cultivator to spread the Pill Formula, drawing in more powerful beings to probe, whose frantic attacks on the colorful light screen might afford him a chance to break free.
As for the life and death of that small cultivator, he did not care.
But even the most meticulous plans could go awry; the Pill Formula did not spread from the hands of the small cultivator. Now, not knowing in whose hands it lay, he waited for decades, yet no one else came to the secret territory.
Recently, Zi Miao Zhen came to reinforce the seal again. Fortunately, he had taken precautions in advance, hiding a trace of his power on the outside, which Zi Miao Zhen did not detect.
A year ago, he used that trace of power to bring in another cultivator from the Gangyuan Realm, revealing the myriad treasures within the nine-colored light screen.
He saw that the Gangyuan Realm cultivator’s mind had been tainted, polluted. In order to attract the powerful being who had corrupted the Gangyuan Realm, he transformed that outside trace of power into pure Spiritual Energy to help them elevate their cultivation, then sent them away after the trace of power had been nearly exhausted.
In one year, that trace of power was not enough to recover, incapable of attracting Lu Tianxiang inside. He needed more time, but Lu Tianxiang seemed to be growing impatient.
This made the Great Emperor somewhat anxious.
On the outskirts of Yuanzhou,
Two graceful figures were frantically fleeing, their breathing ragged as if they had been wounded.
“Damn it, the Jingye Office, these mad dogs!” the woman in the purple dress cursed, clutching her chest with indignation.
The girl in the yellow dress said nothing.
“Stop playing dead. Didn’t you say you had taken care of it? How did Jingye
Office still trace this back to us?” the woman in the purple dress said, fuming.
The girl in the yellow dress shook her head slightly, “This must be the work of that old man from the Imperial Astronomer.”
“Two insignificant God Refining Realm cultivators, worth the Prophet’s personal effort in divination?” the woman in the purple dress scoffed disbelievingly.
“What else? What capable people does Jingye Office have? The Head Supervisor of Jingye Office may be a Great Grandmaster at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but he’s merely a martial fighter,” the girl in the yellow dress said with disdain.
The woman in the purple dress fell silent, her mind racing. Could it be that the old man from the Imperial Astronomer did this on purpose?
Could it be that they had been exposed long ago? The Prophet took the opportunity to drive them out of the Capital City, but why would he do that?
They had seen Demon Kings in the True Martial Realm in the Demon Domain, more powerful than the Prophet; yet even those Demon Kings spoke of the Prophet of Da Qian’s Imperial Astronomer with a hint of dread.
While arguing through voice transmission, the two women hastened their escape, not daring to stop for even a moment.
After the incident, a commander from Jingye Office, along with several God Refining Realm cultivators, suddenly struck Jinyue Palace, catching the two women off guard.
If they hadn’t had something to rely on, they would never have been able to escape alive. They would already have been captured by Jingye Office’s commander, and even now they worried about being surrounded and cut off.
Their original escape route was headed towards the Da Jing Empire, but under the pursuit and blockade, they changed their course towards the Da Liang
Empire. To get there, they would have to pass through the territories of either Yinyang Sect or Kurong Sect.
Neither the Yinyang Sect nor the Kurong Sect was a place where the two women dared to linger for long; hiding within the Human Clan’s empire was the most comfortable and peaceful option.
The two women had been fleeing for a long time before they changed their route again. The intercepting cultivators ahead were too strong; they did not dare to confront them and had to find a route with fewer pursuers to make their escape.
In the end, the two women reached Jizhou, where they temporarily rested their feet, treated their injuries, and decided to find an opportunity to move on.
Leizhou, Lingjun City.
Han Li was, yet again, naming his children, experiencing a mix of pain and joy.
Every time he named his children, Han Li racked his brains—it was mainly because he had already named so many, and he needed to avoid repetition while ensuring the names sounded good or had positive meanings.
All of his children provided him with a year of life, a year of cultivation, as well as cultivation techniques and pill formulas. The recently born children also had talents, providing talent feedback that improved Han Li’s cultivation talent.
This was the fourteenth time he was naming a child since naming Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin’s daughters. This time, the subjects were the descendants of twin sisters Chu Yumeng and Chu Yutong.
The twins had each given birth to one boy and one girl, both of whom possessed Ninth Grade talents.
Han Li thought this was quite good. Chu Yumeng and Chu Yutong only had Ninth Grade talents, and generally, only the first descendant would inherit their talent, with subsequent descendants having increasingly weaker talents, or even no cultivation talent at all.
But their partner was Han Li. Not only had Han Li’s cultivation reached the peak of the God Refining Realm, but he also possessed relatively high Sixth Grade talent, which allowed more of the descendants to inherit his talent.
PS: I’ve made changes to the section about the rewards for descendants in Chapter Two.
The earlier setup was that the rewards would halve generation by generation until the fourth generation. Initially, I wrote it this way, but later I got confused, and all descendants were calculated with the rewards of the first generation, so I changed it to all descendants receiving the same rewards as the first generation.
There were also readers who felt that the original setting was not good, that the plot device was too overpowered, and that it suppressed the protagonist too much. Now that I’ve changed it, it should be more logical.
Also, another thing: this novel is a fast-paced leveling-up story. There won’t be deliberate suppression of the protagonist’s realm progression, but there won’t be absolutely no restrictions either. Otherwise, progression would really be too fast and too easy to collapse. I believe no one wants to see this novel
collapse too quickly..

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - 88 Accumulated Enough_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Accumulated Enough_1
Translator: 549690339
“Yumeng’s child is named Han Yongxuan, and Yutong’s daughter is called Han Yongxuan, how about that?”
When naming the offspring of the twin sisters, Han Li always considered homophonic words.
“My husband’s naming skills are truly unmatched,” Chu Yumeng and Chu Yutong exclaimed in admiration at the same time.
Looking at the two nearly identical stunning faces, Han Li felt somewhat ashamed in his heart. In fact, he had many good characters with great meaning reserved for future descendants with excellent talents.
Otherwise, it would be quite embarrassing if any of his children with first-grade aptitudes ended up with a lousy name.
After showering the twins with kisses, Han Li, as usual, instructed the two women to rest well, saying a lot of touching words.
Although the talents of the offspring the two women had just given birth to were only of the eighth grade, Han Li didn’t mind. He had a great idea he wondered if it could be used to exploit a bug.
Once the Rebirth Pills were refined and could be used on a large scale, he would definitely raise the talent of all his descendants with cultivation abilities to the fifth grade, turning them into little geniuses.
Should the talents of his descendants increase manifold, he wondered if it could provide feedback to his own talent.
Even if not, it would still be a win, as these fifth-grade talented descendants could cultivate to the Hollow Void Stage. By that time, Han Li would be very powerful, and if he had enough resources, it might not be impossible for them to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
By then, Han Mansion would not just have hundreds of Hollow Realm Masters and Great Grandmasters; even the Daqian Empire would be small fry before Han Mansion.
The most important thing was that Han Li could obtain a great deal of cultivation feedback from these descendants, enabling his own cultivation to continue to advance rapidly.
After taking care of Chu Yumeng and Chu Yutong, Han Li returned to his sleeping quarters to check the new System prompts.
“Your descendants have exceeded five hundred in number, you have gained fifty years of cultivation, you have obtained five Sea-Opening Pills, two Gang Yuan Pills, and you have acquired the lower-grade martial skill [Dragon
Suppressing Palm].”
Watching this System prompt, Han Li’s face brimmed with a smile, as the rewards had increased significantly from before.
When the number of descendants reached one hundred, three hundred, five hundred, and so on, the rewards would slightly increase, but when it reached a thousand, the rewards would increase vastly.
The Sea-Opening Pills increased from three to five, and he also got two more Gang Yuan Pills. The Sea-Opening Pill was a seventh-grade medicinal pill, while the Gang Yuan Pill was a sixth-grade medicinal pill that could speed up a cultivator’s transformation of True Qi into Gang Yuan by five times when breaking through to the Gangyuan Realm.
Both the Sea-Opening Pill and the Gang Yuan Pill were highly sought after by Sects, families, and other powers, as these magical pills were essential for rapidly nurturing a large number of strong cultivators.
“What a splendid Dragon Suppressing Palm!”
Saving the seven pills, Han Li claimed the martial skill reward. After assimilating it, the Dragon Suppressing Palm naturally reached the perfect level, and he couldn’t help but be impressed.
The Dragon Suppressing Palm was a lower-grade martial skill, two levels higher than the previously obtained Slaughtering Sword Scripture, and its might differed greatly. The ultimate move of the Slaughtering Sword Scripture was barely comparable to the first move of the Dragon Suppressing Palm.
The Dragon Suppressing Palm was both incredibly firm and resolute, consisting of six moves, each brimming with boundless power. The essence was all in the exertion of strength and the delivery of power. With its mighty palm strength, it could unleash the force of toppling mountains and overturning seas.
What pleased him the most was that the Dragon Suppressing Palm, combined with the Vajra Unbreakable Body Technique, was a perfect match. When running the Vajra Unbreakable Body Technique, his strength would surge tenfold; unleashing the Dragon Suppressing Palm would also see an explosive increase in power, and there was no need for defense.
With the Dragon Suppressing Palm, his combat ability had once again risen considerably. At the very least, he would now have the combat ability of the second tier of the Hollow Void Stage.
In the end, Han Li glanced at the reward of cultivation years and stored them away as usual.
Twelve days ago, the number of his talented offspring broke the one hundred mark, which now has reached a total of one hundred sixteen, and the total number of descendants has finally reached five hundred.
Together with the fifty years of cultivation, he had just obtained, his accumulated years of cultivation had reached an astonishing 335 years, only 65 years shy of breaking through to the Hollow Void Stage.
In the following period, Han Li remained dutifully within the Han Mansion, giving names to the progeny of each of his concubines and spending time with his beautiful consorts.
After all the concubines had given birth to their children, the number of Han Li’s offspring reached 538. Among these, eight were a result of further procreation by his descendants, and the number of progeny with talents directly reached 148, almost halfway to obtaining the second reward.
The cultivation years Han Li had accumulated amounted to 373, and he was at most half a year away from breaking through to the Hollow Void Stage. Within that half a year, those descendants who had been pregnant for several months would give birth to many more offspring.
Han Li was pondering over an issue, whether to first improve his aptitude before making a breakthrough, or to breakthrough first and then wait for his aptitude to increase. Both choices had their advantages and disadvantages.
Over the past month or so, he had produced more than fifty descendants with cultivation talents, including those with sixth and seventh-grade aptitudes, which provided him with a significant amount of aptitude feedback.
If calculated by the progress bar, his sixth-grade aptitude was now at 94%. He was only 6% away from raising his aptitude to the fifth grade.
If his aptitude reached the fifth grade, he would only need to expend two hundred years of cultivation to condense a formidable embryonic form of martial dao True Intent and advance to the Hollow Void Stage, saving him over a hundred years of cultivation.
This nearly two hundred years of cultivation would allow him to significantly increase his power, substantially boosting his strength at the Hollow Void Stage.
However, this would mean waiting. Han Li wasn’t certain how long it would take, and time was what he lacked the most at the moment.
Being of sixth-grade aptitude, the birth of a descendant with fifth-grade aptitude increased his own by 30%, sixth-grade by 10%, seventh-grade by 4%, eighth-grade by 2%, and a ninth-grade descendant by 1%…
Now that all his concubines had just given birth, they needed time to recuperate. Even if he took in new concubines, it would be a year at the earliest.
He couldn’t count on his descendants either. Having those descendants occasionally produce a ninth-grade talent was already very good, relying on luck for acquiring six such descendants.
After giving it some thought_ Han Li decided to wait and He would amass
enough cultivation for a breakthrough first. If his aptitude hadn’t improved and there was still time, he would continue to wait until his aptitude increased before attempting the breakthrough.
Time passed, and before he knew it, nearly half a year had gone by.
During this time, many newborns were added to the Han Mansion, and the number of Han Li’s descendants reached 570, with his accumulated cultivation reaching 405 years.
Among the 32 new descendants, only four had aptitudes; two were ninth grade, and two were unremarkable, raising Han Li’s aptitude by 3%. Now, he was just the last 3% away from advancing to the fifth grade.
Han Li then took in concubines three more times, bringing four beautiful and delicate women to his chambers. After his diligent efforts, they were now several months pregnant.
A sense of ill omen always lingered in Han Li’s heart, as if a shadow enshrouded him, urging him to advance to the Hollow Void Stage as soon as possible.
After weighing the pros and cons, Han Li held back. Regardless of whatever turmoil might involve him, at least for the moment, it hadn’t arrived, and he still had time to develop.
As long as he made it through this period, his strength would see an explosive increase, enabling him better to handle any troubles he might face.
On the other hand, at Dingyuan Manor.
Lu Tianxiang had been waiting on this hundred-meter hill for a year already. Not to mention a secret territory, there were very few traces of people.
The place was desolate to begin with, the Spiritual Energy extremely sparse, the hill not tall, and devoid of scenery, making it an unlikely destination for ordinary folks.
Lu Tianxiang felt it was time to leave, having waited here for too long. She would return to handle pressing matters first, and come back to wait for the emergence of the secret territory when she had free time.
If she were to disappear for too long, the Mysterious Forces behind her, unable to contact her, might stir up unnecessary troubles, and tracing it back here would be problematic.
Just as Lu Tianxiang made her decision, in the Emperor Formation deep underground, the Great Emperor had also made a decision..

chapters.title: Chapter 89 - 89 Qualification Upgrade_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Qualification Upgrade_l
Translator: 549690339
Only a year had passed since he last captured a cultivator, and he had not even recovered half of that meager strength. If he were to completely drain this bit of power, he could indeed pull in the Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivator from outside.
If time allowed, he would prefer to wait and conserve that sliver of strength, but time was pressing.
It took him fifty to sixty thousand years to create a slight flaw in the Emperor Formation and barely manage to transmit a sliver of power out. Now that the formation had been repaired by Zi Miao Zhen, he could no longer send power outside, nor did he want to wait another fifty thousand years.
If he missed the opportunity with that Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivator outside, who knows when he would encounter another one? Pulling in a regular cultivator would be futile, as he could not afford to throw out a second pill formula to cause trouble.
Besides, regular cultivators were too unreliable. Thinking back to the first time he pulled in that Pihai Realm minor cultivator, the Great Emperor felt somewhat disheartened.
“Hum-”
Just as Lu Tianxiang was about to leave, she sensed a terrifying suction force. Her expression brightened, and rather than resisting, she merely maintained a basic level of vigilance.
The next instant, Lu Tianxiang found herself in the Underground World.
Lu Tianxiang was somewhat cautious, not releasing her Spiritual Sense, but observing with her eyes alone, being extremely careful in her heart. She did not know if there would be old monsters appearing in this secret territory.
Soon, she spotted the luminous screen ahead. Though it was thousands of meters away, the nine colors revolving and the rosy light illuminated the entire Underground World.
“Gulp-”
Unable to help herself, Lu Tianxiang swallowed nervously, feeling both excited and a bit apprehensive.
Everything she was seeing matched the description from her subordinates, with the only difference being the sparse Spiritual Energy within the secret territory.
Could it be that a Gangyuan Realm cultivator had broken through the seven heavens and nearly exhausted the Spiritual Energy here?
Lu Tianxiang could hardly believe it. She stepped toward the nine-colored screen, only then releasing her Spiritual Sense, covering merely a hundred meters around her and cautiously exploring.
Having reached the Myriad Phenomena Realm through her cultivation, she had entered several secret territories and knew that such places were risky: the greater the opportunity, the greater the risk, as there were no fortunes gained without danger.
The last time she explored a secret territory, she obtained her main cultivation technique of Heaven Rank Lower Grade, but she had almost died in the process, still feeling fear when recalling the experience. She had nearly perished within.
The opportunity within this secret territory appeared greater and more defy-the-heavens, implying greater danger, making Lu Tianxiang all the more cautious. She did not wish to die here.
When she reached within five hundred meters of the nine-colored screen, Lu Tianxiang stopped, her eyes filled with wariness as she saw scenes invisible to ordinary cultivators.
The nine-colored screen was densely covered with patterns of the Great Dao, where countless profound and intricate Dao patterns interwove, sketching fleeting images, each one embodying great terror.
“Is this… an Emperor Formation?”
Lu Tianxiang’s face was somewhat blank as she murmured to herself.
She had seen a description of an Emperor Formation in an ancient book from the last secret territory she visited. It boldly stated that an Emperor Formation possessed supreme power, allowing a mere fraction of its force to destroy heavens and earth, to slay powerful beings.
At that moment, Lu Tianxiang felt an urge to turn and flee. If it really was an Emperor Formation, she dared not pry into it.
No matter what great figure might be suppressed inside or how many treasures lay hidden, she had no interest in them; a mere wisp of the formation’s power could annihilate her countless times over.
“Eh, you actually know about Emperor Formations?”
At that moment, a deep and ancient voice sounded next to Lu Tianxiang’s ear, the tone filled with surprise, as if it was quite astonished.
Whoosh!
As the voice echoed, Lu Tianxiang’s figure flashed, instantly reappearing thousands of meters away, watching the nine-colored screen with extreme apprehension. She wanted to see through the screen, to see what was inside, but she could discern nothing.
“Young one, there’s no need to be nervous.”
The nine-colored screen revealed the silhouette of a towering figure, the voice soft and assuring, like a kindly old grandfather.
Now that Lu Tianxiang had recognized the Emperor Formation, the Great Emperor changed his initial plan, realizing it would be hard to deceive this woman, and he decided to make a trade with her.
Lu Tianxiang bit her red lips, expressionless, and deeply regretted her impulsive action. The opportunity had been so immense that it blinded her, luring her into a perilous situation.
She clearly knew that the person behind the nine-colored light curtain was no philanthropist; otherwise, they wouldn’t be suppressed within the Emperor Formation. To receive such treatment signified that this was one of the legendary ancient Great Emperors.
Seeing that Lu Tianxiang didn’t respond, the Great Emperor chuckled and said, “I know why you have come, and indeed, I possess the opportunities and treasures you seek. If you would do me a favor, I would take you as my personal disciple, impart to you the Emperor’s scriptures and weapons, and even give you a great opportunity to become an emperor. How about it?”
“Heh!”
Lu Tianxiang let out a cold laugh, unmoved by his empty promises and grand talk which she was in no position to enjoy.
Now she felt less nervous; Lu Tianxiang realized that the suspected Great Emperor couldn’t leave the confines of the formation and couldn’t exert any power either. Otherwise, he wouldn’t be wasting his time talking to her.
“Let me first express my sincerity.”
Lu Tianxiang hesitated but eventually nodded her head. Since the Great Emperor couldn’t leave, he posed no threat to her life.
“Over twenty years ago, a Pihai Realm cultivator was captured by me and took away a Rebirth Pill formula from here.”
In Lingjun City, at the Han Mansion.
Han Li was at the Pill Refining Pavilion refining pills. The pill he was making was called the Yuan Enhancing Pill, a seventh-grade elixir that could quicken the cultivation pace of Great Masters in the Gangyuan Realm.
This seventh-grade pill formula was something Han Li had acquired for free after he had killed Cui Pingyu, a Great Master of the Hehuan Sect. Cui’s Space Ring contained many items, which Han Li stored away without thorough inspection.
Previously collecting dust in the Space Ring, upon recently organizing it, he found, to his delight, a seventh-grade pill formula among the items.
Although Han Li had no use for the Yuan Enhancing Pill himself, the Han Mansion did. It could be saved for future Gangyuan Realm Great Masters of the Han Mansion or sold when the time was right, serving as a significant source of Spirit Stones.
After spending some time, Han Li easily made the first batch of pills, yielding ten pills with eight of them being of good quality.
He then refined nine more batches, each producing ten Yuan Enhancing Pills of good quality.
Exhaling, Han Li put away the pill furnace and left the Pill Refining Pavilion.
Upon returning to the rear courtyard and just after taking a sip of Spiritual Tea, Liu Yuexin came over with joy on her face, softly saying:
“Husband, Sister Liu Yue has given birth.”
“That’s great!”
Han Li excitedly kissed Liu Yuexin and strode towards Liu Yue’s courtyard.
Previously, his Cultivation Talent had been very close to the fifth grade, and now, after more than five months and adding 28 offspring, only two had any cultivation potential—one mediocre and one eighth grade. The eighth-grade talent offspring was born to one of Han Li’s concubines.
This brought his Cultivation Talent to 99-5% of the sixth grade, just a tiny bit away from advancing to the fifth grade, and now the moment had finally come.
Another of his beautiful concubines, Liu Yue, had given birth to an offspring, who at least would have a ninth-grade talent, sufficient to raise his Talent to the fifth grade.
After arriving at the courtyard and tending to Liu Yue, Han Li then checked the child’s talent, who was again eighth grade.
Han Li’s face remained full of smiles, which allowed the watchful Liu Yue to breathe a sigh of relief.
After naming the child and chatting with Liu Yue for a while, Han Li left and returned to his bedroom.
Adjusting his mood, Han Li opened the messaging panel to check the system notifications.
“You have fathered an offspring with eighth -grade talent. You gain one year of cultivation, one year of lifespan, one Supreme Grade Heaven Rank Cultivation Technique, one Beauty Preserving Pill, and your Cultivation Talent has been enhanced.”
“Your Cultivation Talent has advanced to the fifth grade..”

chapters.title: Chapter 90: The Strongest Martial Arts, Breaking Through the Hollow Void Stage_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: The Strongest Martial Arts, Breaking Through the Hollow Void Stage_l
Translator: 549690339
“Hahaha-
Seeing this, Han Li burst into laughter. After nearly a year of waiting, the moment had finally arrived.
Fortunately, there had been no disturbances during this time; otherwise, he would have had to make a premature breakthrough.
Han Li’s Spiritual Sense swarmed out, covering thousands of miles to ensure there were no potential enemies. Then he hung a sign outside his door, instructing his concubines not to come looking for him for the time being.
Without further delay, Han Li immediately claimed two hundred years of cultivation and began his breakthrough into the Hollow Void Stage.
He was full of anticipation about which embryonic form of martial truth he would comprehend. He remembered that the System would help him condense a powerful embryonic form of martial truth, and now it was time to witness it.
The System’s account instantly decreased by two hundred years of cultivation. The next moment, Han Li felt his mental strength and senses immensely amplified, able to easily pierce through falsehoods and grasp the essence of the void.
Through the Eye of the Spirit, he saw countless mysterious rules in the world, patterns of Dao interwoven everywhere, with a multitude of rules and patterns converging into various embryonic forms of powerful martial truths, like a sea of stars formed by the convergence of countless Ancient Stars.
Han Li noticed that some of the embryonic forms of martial truth forming the Ancient Stars were particularly immense and bright. He instantly realized that these represented some of the supreme martial truths.
In that vast sea of stars, countless Ancient Stars resonated with him, and a few attracted him the most. With just a slight sensing, he knew what martial truths these particular Ancient Stars corresponded to.
Sword Intent, Palm Intent, Fist Intent, Defense Truth, Space Truth… (For example: Sword Intent is fully referred to as Sword Dao Truth, Defense Truth is temporarily called that for lack of a better term)
“Awesome!”
Han Li finally understood why earlier the System demanded four hundred
years of cultivation for him to break through to the Hollow Void Stage.
When others condense the embryonic form of martial truth, they need to slowly comprehend the heavens and the earth, piercing through the void and deception to find their own path of martial arts, and then step by step, condense an embryonic form of martial truth without choices.
What about Han Li?
He was able to directly see countless martial truths in the world, knowing which ones were powerful and which ones were in harmony with him, allowing him to make the best choice without going astray.
He had spent two hundred years of cultivation, and the effect was naturally more than just that; allowing him to clearly see countless martial truths was only the first step.
The second step was to allow Han Li’s greatest advantage to come into play.
What was his greatest advantage?
He had mastered more than six hundred complete martial arts techniques in various aspects such as attack, defense, and speed, spanning dozens of categories including fist, foot, knife, and sword.
As cultivators embark on the path of cultivation, besides cultivation techniques, they must also practice various martial arts to enhance their own strength, but very few can cultivate a martial art to the level of completeness.
Throughout his journey to the pinnacle of the God Refining Realm, he had changed many martial arts techniques, often replacing one that had achieved great success with a stronger technique.
As his cultivation level advanced to higher realms, he needed to learn higher-grade martial arts, and most cultivators would abandon lower-grade techniques that had reached great accomplishment to fully focus on cultivating higher-grade techniques, as this was far more cost-effective.
Of course, those born into major clans or powerful factions, or who had been taken under the wing of a strong individual from an early age, would start learning profound martial arts from the beginning.
Talented individuals could also quickly cultivate a martial art to a level of completeness, but as their cultivation level rose even faster, they were not willing to spend too much time on low-grade techniques that wouldn’t significantly enhance their strength.
Wouldn’t it be better to spend that time to advance higher-grade martial arts to a greater level or to raise their cultivation by several minor realms?
Even if a Hollow Realm Master or someone of a higher realm were to impart the secrets of cultivating martial arts to completeness—which is greatly beneficial for future condensation of martial truth—how many would choose this path?
Cultivating a martial art to the level of completeness takes considerable time, and the more you cultivate, the longer it takes. Focusing on martial arts training will slow down cultivation progress, and others will simply overpower you with their higher realm.
The more complete martial skills one mastered, the greater the benefits were for condensing the embryonic form of Martial Dao’s true meaning. As long as one could fuse them together, it was possible to condense a powerful true meaning of Martial Dao.
But these complete martial skills pertained to different true meanings of Martial Dao, and how difficult was it to fuse them into one? The more skills there were, the harder the fusion became, increasing geometrically in complexity.
This path was very difficult to follow, but once one managed to do so, one would become extremely powerful, often able to claim supremacy among one’s peers and sweep through invincible opponents.
Han Li did not need to worry about these, for he had spent two hundred years of cultivation, and the system would help him fuse all the true meanings of Martial Dao involved, ultimately forming his own path of Martial Dao, and condensing his unique embryonic form of Martial Dao’s true meaning.
What Han Li looked forward to was the strength of his Martial Dao’s true meaning embryonic form, having mastered hundreds of complete martial skills, including earth-level protective divine techniques like the Indestructible Vajra Body and the Dragon Suppressing Palm. Just how strong would it be?
As Han Li’s thoughts flowed, the integration of the true meaning of Martial Dao had already begun.
Through the Eye of the Spirit, he clearly saw ancient stars extinguishing one after another. Originally, many ancient stars attracted him, allowing him to condense the embryonic form of Martial Dao’s true meaning, but now, they were fewer and fewer.
The first to extinguish were the ancient stars formed from weaker true meanings of Martial Dao. Then came the average ones, followed by the stronger ones, and finally, even the ancient stars with powerful true meanings like Sword Intent, Defense Intent, and Spatial Intent, had also extinguished.
When all the ancient stars of the true meanings of Martial Dao he was involved with had extinguished, the entire sky dimmed in an instant. The next moment, an ancient star radiating Infinite Light emerged, illuminating the vast expanse, brilliant for eternity.
Han Li stared fixedly at that ancient star, feeling an incomparably strong attraction to it. This was the most suitable true meaning of Martial Dao for him; this was the path of Martial Dao he was meant to follow.
He found that this ancient star was even brighter and more dazzling than those supreme true meanings of Martial Dao had been. It seemed eternal and immovable, serenely overlooking the cycles of reincarnation, indifferent to the changes of worlds, it was the greatest, the most powerful, the most supreme true meaning of Martial Dao.
“Hiss-I’
Han Li couldn’t help but take in a breath of Spiritual Energy. Was the embryonic form of the Martial Dao true meaning he was about to condense really so powerful?
The stronger the embryonic form of Martial Dao true meaning, the stronger the completed true meaning of Martial Dao would be. However, this also meant that the path of Martial Dao was even more difficult to follow.
As Han Li reflected, the third step of his breakthrough began.
Han Li established a connection with the magnificent ancient star, and a ray of starlight fell from the ancient star, slicing through countless realms, traversing eternity, and instantly crossing endless time and space to descend upon Han Li.
In an instant, Han Li’s senses were blessed, Hollow Void shattered delusions, and he attained enlightenment of his own Martial Dao path while his Martial Dao true meaning’s embryonic form continuously condensed.
The starlight entered the deepest recesses of his mind, lying dormant there, containing innumerable Dao Intent, endless Dao Patterns, infinite Dao Principles, limitless Dao Laws…
Han Li’s aura soared higher and higher, growing ever stronger as if to reach the heavens. However, with Han Li’s intentional control and the Formation’s barrier in the palace chambers, not a trace leaked out.
“Boom!”
When the embryonic form of the Martial Dao true meaning was completely condensed, Han Li’s realm also broke through to the Hollow Void Stage, becoming a Hollow Realm Master.
As the magnificent ancient star shed its light, in various places unknown to Han Li, terrifying forbidden beings were awakened.
They kept calculating and probing, but in the end, they could only sigh.
An unparalleled demon had touched upon the strongest Martial Dao during their breakthrough to the Hollow Void Stage, but even these forbidden beings could not deduce who the demon was or where they were located.
Otherwise, they would have crossed thousands of worlds in an instant to take this unparalleled demon under their wing, to meticulously guide them, investing early in a being destined to rise, destined to stand at the pinnacle of all worlds and eras.
PS: I revised and revised, decided to discard the previously set true meaning of Martial Dao, deleted some drafts, and still wrote this.

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - 91 Peak of the Hollow Realm_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Peak of the Hollow Realm_l
Translator: 549690339
After his breakthrough, Han Li carefully discerned the changes within himself.
He discovered that the power of his Divine Spirit had grown more than tenfold compared to the peak of the God Refining Realm, his Spiritual Sense now covered an area of forty thousand li in radius, and his five senses had also increased more than ten times.
It should be known that he was only at Level One of the Hollow Void Realm, yet he possessed a Divine Spirit and Spiritual Sense comparable to the mid-stage of the same realm, which multiplied his strength many times over.
Han Li felt that this must be related to the embryonic form of the strongest
Sword Intent that he had cultivated. Normally, a genius at the peak of the God Refining Realm breaking through to the Hollow Void Realm wouldn’t experience even half the growth in strength that he did.
This ultimate martial path, which Han Li called the Omnipotent Martial Path, embraced all martial paths, integrating them into his own and ultimately achieving the strongest martial way.
At present, his Omnipotent Martial Path was only in its embryonic form, touching upon aspects such as Sword Intent, Fist Intent, Palm Intent, Arrow Intent, Defensive Intent, Finger Intent, Speed Intent, Space Intent, and many others.
In the future, he would need to continuously perfect the embryonic form of his martial intent, expanding it to include more martial intents such as the Five Elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, yin and yang, life and death, reincarnation, creation, time and space, destiny, and so on.
As he kept integrating other martial intents, one after another, powerful and supreme martial intents, only then could he walk the path of the Omnipotent Martial Way and achieve the ultimate martial path.
Because his embryonic martial intent was so powerful, whenever he used it, any martial arts technique he executed would receive a significant boost, greatly enhancing its might.
For example, the Earth-Level Extreme Martial Arts technique Step Booster Technique, when perfected, allowed one to traverse a thousand li in a single step and was comparable to the speed of a normal cultivator in the Myriad Phenomena Realm. With the boost from the Omnipotent Martial Path, the speed would increase fivefold, comparable to the peak speed of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
One step of five thousand li, this kind of speed was usually achieved only after perfecting an Earth-Level Lower Rank footwork technique. Such is the power of the Omnipotent Martial Path, which enhances martial techniques by one rank after its boost.
It could be said that with the embryonic form of the Omnipotent Martial Path’s true intent, he had laid the foundation for a remarkable rise, and his future was destined to be extraordinary.
Having just reached the Hollow Void Realm, his strength was already formidable. Once he employed the embryonic form of the Omnipotent Martial
Path’s true intent, his power would surge, enough to rival a Grandmaster in the Fourth Heaven of the Hollow Void Realm.
Keep in mind, this is just the embryonic form of the Omnipotent Martial Path’s true intent.
The martial journey starting from the Hollow Void Realm is a process of simplifying complexity; breaking through to the Hollow Void Realm requires the condensation of a certain martial intent, and breaking through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm requires the perfection of a martial intent.
To ascend to the True Martial Realm, one must turn martial intent into a Martial True Pill… Progressing through the higher realms of cultivation and commanding a particular martial path.
As Han Li’s Omnipotent Martial Path gradually reached perfection and higher levels, the more it would enhance his capabilities.
“Huh ”
Han Li exhaled, his eyes gleaming with anticipation for the future.
Having condensed the embryonic form of the Omnipotent Martial Path’s true intent and ascended to the Hollow Void Realm, Han Li didn’t emerge from seclusion. He had amassed a considerable amount of cultivation, which he planned to use to elevate his realm in one go.
Originally, he had accumulated 1+24 years of cultivation; ascending to the Hollow Void Realm had consumed 200 years, leaving 224 years of cultivation remaining.
As his master, Gongsun Yun, said, once a cultivator reaches the Hollow Void Realm, the speed of cultivation slows down considerably because it requires great effort to perfect the embryonic form of the martial intent.
Generally speaking, it takes a cultivator with fifth-grade talent ten years to break from Level One to Level Two, and the time required increases the higher one goes. To cultivate to the peak of the Hollow Void Realm would take at least
200 years.
This is not fixed, as the speed of cultivation varies with talent—the better the talent, the faster the cultivation; the worse the talent, the slower the cultivation.
This is also influenced by opportunities; once a cultivator encounters a certain opportunity, their cultivation might soar through several heavens in a short time.
“Thrilling! ”
A smile spread across Han Li’s face as he now had 224 years of cultivation left unclaimed, and advancing to the peak of the Hollow Void Realm in one effort should pose no problem.
Intent on his goal, Han Li claimed a large amount of cultivation, and his aura soared instantaneously as his cultivation level climbed steadily.
Hollow Void Realm Level Two!
Hollow Void Realm Level Five!
Hollow Void Realm Level Nine!
When Han Li’s cultivation reached the peak of the Ninth Level of the Hollow Void Realm, the wildly soaring realm finally came to a halt, unable to advance any further.
“It actually took 212 years of cultivation.”
After solidifying his cultivation, Han Li checked and furrowed his brows slightly, but soon they relaxed again.
This was probably because his aptitude had just reached the fifth rank, which was quite poor among those of the fifth rank, so it required more cultivation.
Han Li didn’t care, as he had reached the peak of the Hollow Void Realm anyway, and still had 12 years of cultivation left, which he decided to continue saving.
Closing the system panel, Han Li then checked on how his Omni-Martial True Intent prototype was coming along.
From breaking through from Level One of the Hollow Void Realm to Level Nine in just a short ten breaths’ time, Han Li had a complete 212 years of cultivation experience in his mind.
Throughout those two hundred years, Han Li continuously pondered the mysteries of the laws, comprehended the natural world, and gained various insights into cultivation, constantly perfecting the prototype of his Omni-Martial True Intent until it reached a bottleneck.
To Han Li’s astonishment, his prototype of the Omni-Martial True Intent was far from complete; if it had to be quantified into a level, the progress was only
0 00/n
With a guess in his heart and after further inquiry with the system, Han Li finally confirmed that this was because his Omni-Martial path was too powerful.
Based on the strength of the martial path being cultivated, there were also levels: ordinary, powerful, top-notch, supreme, and ultimate.
Cultivators with the same aptitude but who comprehend an ordinary martial path cultivate faster, but their strength is relatively weaker.
The stronger the martial path comprehended, the more time it takes to perfect, but the stronger the resulting power.
His Omni-Martial path was of the ultimate level, that is, the strongest martial path; more than two hundred years of cultivation would be enough to near-perfect an ordinary or even powerful martial path, but it was still far from enough for the Omni-Martial path.
Although it would take more time, the stronger the martial path, the greater the advantage; not only is one’s strength in the same realm much stronger, but there are also far fewer restrictions when breaking through.
Ordinary and powerful martial paths require a perfection degree of 100% to break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but Han Li’s Omni-Martial path needs to be only 10% perfected to ascend to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
That is to say, his Omni-Martial True Intent prototype at merely 10% could match up to others’ 100% perfected Martial True Intents.
Pulling his thoughts back, Han Li once again contemplated the current might of his Omni-Martial True Intent prototype, which was much more powerful than when it first congealed, and it significantly enhanced his strength as well.
Originally, using the Omni-Martial True Intent prototype would increase his strength by five times, but now it had increased to eight times, boosting his combat ability by a great margin.
Generally speaking, Gurus in the Hollow Void Realm cultivate at least Earth
Rank Practice Methods, Earth Level Martial Arts, and own Earth Rank Artifacts, and the stronger the Guru, the stronger their Practice Methods, Martial Arts, and Magical Treasures.
A Guru who can cultivate to the peak of the Hollow Void Realm has Magical Treasures and Practice Methods of at least the Top Grade of Earth Rank, possesses many Earth Level Martial Arts, including several that are greatly accomplished of the Top Grade of Earth Rank, and might even have Supreme Grade Earth Level Martial Arts.
An even more powerful Guru in the Hollow Void Realm would have Supreme
Grade Earth Rank Magical Treasures, cultivate Heaven Rank Cultivation
Techniques, master many greatly accomplished Supreme Grade Earth Level Martial Arts, and perhaps cultivate Heaven Rank Martial Arts, such a Guru would already have the combat ability of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Now that Han Li’s cultivation had risen to the peak of the Hollow Void Realm, he also possessed a Supreme Grade Earth Rank Zhenjun Sword, but the grade of the Martial Arts he mastered could not keep up, which limited his strength.
The Supreme Grade Earth Rank Xuantian Punch and Top Grade Earth Rank God
Slaying Sword Art were both at the minor accomplishment stage, the Lower
Rank Earth-Level Unbreakable Body Divine Technique and Dragon Suppressing Palm were both at the complete level, along with Profound Rank Martial Arts like the Step Booster Technique and Killing Sword Scripture.
With the core of his Omni-Martial True Intent prototype, these Martial Arts had their grades permanently increased by nearly two ranks, placing Han Li at the very top in the Hollow Void Realm, with his combat ability nearing the threshold of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 92 Family_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Family_l
Translator: 549690339
“It looks like I’ll need to focus on developing quietly for quite some time,” Han Li sighed, feeling the disparity in strength.
The reason his combat ability could reach the threshold of the Myriad Phenomena Realm was firstly due to the Zhenjun Sword and secondly because of the nascent embodiment of the omnidirectional martial truths, with the latter being the most crucial.
Without the nascent embodiment of the omnidirectional martial truths, his strength among those at the peak of the Hollow Void Stage would probably be one of the weakest.
This might be considered a downside of advancing too quickly in cultivation— his martial skills’ grade and depth couldn’t keep up with the speed of his cultivation progress, making him naturally much weaker than other cultivators at the same realm.
Han Li merely sighed about it, but in fact, he wasn’t worried. He had almost always stayed in Lingjun City, only leaving a few times in dozens of years, with an even smaller number of actual battles.
As long as he focused and endured for a while, once the number of his descendants increased and he obtained more complete high-rank cultivation methods, martial skills, and magical treasures, his strength would surge dramatically.
Han Li had ample time to endure and wait for his descendants to multiply and spread their branches.
After breaking through to the Hollow Void Stage, his lifespan had increased greatly once more—while the life expectancy of a typical Guru in the Void Realm was seven hundred years, Han Li’s lifespan far exceeded this number.
His lifespan was now 1,249 years, which was more than even those Great Grandmasters in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, though, of course, it wasn’t nearly as long as Emperor Wu in the True Martial Realm, who could live for two thousand years, not to mention those of the Divine Yuan Realm with legendary lifespans of five thousand years.
After sorting out his thoughts, Han Li left his bedroom with a joyful heart and went to the back garden.
Reclining in a rocking chair, Han Li pondered whether he should move away from Lingjun City quickly, to leave the contentious Leizhou area.
Nowadays, Leizhou, Huozhou, and Qingzhou were all places of strife, and no one knew when a great war might erupt. Once war started, the three regions would be shrouded in darkness, and he always had an ominous premonition that trouble might come knocking at his door.
But where should he move to?
Han Li was inclined to relocate deeper within the Daqian Empire, yet he couldn’t move to Yuanzhou. Yuanzhou, being the central hub of Daqian, brimmed with powerful Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivators, and Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm might even be present, so it wasn’t suitable for him.
