A mental image of the rough map of the Daqian Empire’s eighteen provinces surfaced in Han Li’s mind, and after much deliberation, he made a choice—he thought Yuanzhou would be a good place to go.
Leaving from Leizhou and heading deeper into the territory of Daqian, one would have to pass through Qingzhou and Jizhou before reaching Yuanzhou.
Even if a war broke out in the three states, with Jizhou acting as a buffer, Yuanzhou would be much more stable. Moreover, there was another state between Yuanzhou and the central Yuanzhou, which wouldn’t place him directly under the eyes of a group of Grandmasters in the Daqian Empire.
But how to move?
Han Li’s brow furrowed slightly—traveling across several states was perilous, especially since he had a family to think about. Even if he only took concubines, descendants, and some guards, it would be a group numbering over a thousand people.
This was a huge caravan, very easy to draw attention, especially if this group appeared weak and included a number of attractive women.
“It would be great if I had a treasure that could hold people,” sighed Han Li.
Now, his speed was incredibly fast, covering eight thousand li in a single step, comparable to the top speeds of the pinnacle experts in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, thus making him virtually unrestricted in travel, with hardly anyone in the Daqian Empire who could catch up to him.
After advancing to the peak of the Hollow Void Stage, his power of the Divine Spirit had also exponentially increased. His Spiritual Sense’s range expanded to twenty thousand li.
The typical range of a cultivator’s Spiritual Sense at the Peak of the Hollow
Realm was only around five thousand li, putting Han Li’s strength of Spiritual
Sense on par with a powerful Great GrandMaster in the Myriad Phenomena Realm. It’s worth noting that Leizhou measured only about seventy to eighty thousand li across.
If he had a treasure capable of holding people, in times of danger, he could simply pack up the Han Mansion and take them away, leading with his Spiritual Sense and leaping eight thousand li in a single step to find a safe place to settle down again.
But Han Li didn’t possess such a treasure, so he had no choice but to genuinely make the journey with his whole family in tow. With the strength he had kept hidden, anyone who dared to attack them was simply courting death.
However, before moving, some preparations still needed to be made.
His figure flashed, and he arrived at the main hall, summoning several capable descendants and instructing them on the tasks at hand.
Although Han Yongkang and the others were surprised, no one raised any questions. They immediately left to begin preparations.
Just as Han Li returned to the backyard and was about to pour himself some freshly brewed Spiritual Tea, a system prompt sounded in his mind.
After taking a sip of the tea in his cup, Han Li began to check the notification.
“Your number of descendants has reached six hundred, you have gained fifty years of cultivation, you have received five Sea-Cleaving Pills, two Gang Yuan Pills, and you have obtained the Earth-Level Lower Rank Cultivation
Technique [Five Elements Formula].”
A smile appeared on Han Li’s face as he found the rewards quite satisfactory, with cultivation and the cultivation technique being the most valuable to him.
His main cultivation technique was the strongest technique of Tianxuan
Mountain, the [Tianxuan Scripture], which had reached the level of Supreme Grade of the Earth Rank. He had no use for the Five Elements Formula, but it could be used for his concubines and the family descendants to cultivate, temporarily serving as the family’s defining practice.
An Earth-Level Lower Rank Cultivation Technique, with sufficient aptitude and resources, and without any untimely demise, could cultivate a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage, more than enough to serve as the family’s defining practice at the current stage.
Since he was moving to Yuanzhou, Han Li had already instructed someone to send a message to all the sects, telling all descendants who wished to return to the family to hurry back.
For those who didn’t wish to return, Han Li did not insist; they would be as branches left in Leizhou, and as long as they cultivated diligently or spread their lineage, they would provide support for Han Li.
Now that his cultivation had made some achievements, he was able to systematically cultivate the family’s descendants. Those with talent could now receive better training within the Han Family.
There were several hundred Yellow Rank Extreme Grade cultivation techniques, martial arts, and secret techniques in the Han Mansion, as well as some Profound Rank and Earth Rank martial arts, which were for the moment sufficient.
Once the family descendants advanced their cultivation to the Gang Yuan Realm or above, Han Li would have already acquired more and higher-rank techniques and martial arts, forming a virtuous cycle.
In tne tuture, descendants witn better aptitudes would tirst receive tam11Y training, while those with lesser talents could choose to venture out, join sects, and broaden the influence of the Han Family.
Han Li had long thought about properly cultivating the family’s descendants, intending to turn the Han Family into a true cultivation clan, but a clever woman cannot cook without rice.
In the beginning, Han Li’s cultivation was not high, and resources for cultivation like techniques, martial arts, and Spirit Stones were scarce. With the family descendants having poor aptitudes, Han Li wanted to cultivate them but couldn’t.
The situation has improved a lot now, and he is able to properly organize the family. Han Li plans to take this opportunity of moving to take charge of cultivating the family descendants in Yuanzhou.
The first batch to be cultivated would be the age-appropriate children currently in the Han Family, including some descendants who are six, seven, or even eight years old.
This included Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, the pair of sisters who bore him his first descendants. Han Yonglin had a fifth-grade aptitude, and Han Yongyun had a sixth-grade aptitude; both were already eight years old.
Previously, as Han Li was considering moving, he had not sent Han Yonglin, Han Yongyun, and other eight-year-olds with talents to the sects for cultivation.
He believed that under his guidance, the two brothers’ cultivation would advance quickly, especially since they both had good aptitudes, and Han Li could provide them with an abundance of cultivation resources.
He also wanted to see how much cultivating a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage could contribute to his cultivation.
As for those family descendants currently in the sects, most had unremarkable, ninth-grade cultivation talents, with a few having eighth or seventh grade; their cultivation levels were not high, and since Han Li’s cultivation was very high, the cultivation feedback was not significant.
After securing the Five Elements Formula, Sea-Cleaving Pills, and Gang Yuan Pills, Han Li then considered the cultivation years he had saved up.
Along with the fifty years of cultivation he just gained, he now had a total of sixty-three years of cultivation years saved up, still far from the amount required to break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Han Li was not in a hurry; he had just received a reward for reaching six hundred descendants, but the number of talented descendants had already reached 156, which was very close to two hundred, and soon he would receive a substantial amount of cultivation years..

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 93 Mutual Calculations_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 93 - 93 Mutual Calculations_l
Chapter 93: Mutual Calculations_l
Translator: 549690339
Thinking about breaking through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm gave Han Li a headache, as it required a substantial amount of cultivation.
Logically speaking, his All-Purpose Martial Dao True Meaning had been perfected to 99.9%, just a hair’s breadth from reaching 100% and breaking through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm to become a Grand Grandmaster.
But in reality, it wasn’t so simple. Despite being only 0.1% away, that final step was incredibly difficult, representing a significant threshold. (For more details, refer to Pinduoduo—if we’re brothers, chop it down for me!)
Peak masters at the Hollow Void Stage with a fifth-grade aDtitude often get stuck on this last step, unable to perfect their Martial Dao True Meaning.
Every peak grandmaster would spend a lot of time on this step, with the level of aptitude and fortunes influencing the duration spent.
Under normal circumstances, without any special opportunities, it would typically take a grandmaster with fifth-grade aptitude about one hundred fifty years to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
This refers to grandmasters comprehending ordinary Martial Dao True Meanings. Generally, the stronger the Martial Dao True Meaning they are trying to comprehend, the more time it will take.
Han Li’s All-Purpose Martial Dao was an ultimate martial art. Although it was merely the first stage of perfecting the Martial Dao True Meaning, its difficulty was comparable to the final step of perfecting a strong Martial Dao True Meaning.
Simply put, for Han Li to quickly advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, he needed to expend two hundred twenty years’ worth of cultivation. Only then could he achieve it in one go and break through directly.
So far, he had only accumulated sixty-three years of cultivation and was still about one hundred sixty years short of breaking through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm and becoming a Grand Grandmaster.
“I’ll wait a bit longer,”
Han Li murmured to himself; his speed of cultivation could be described as incredibly fast.
If his economical master, Gongsun Yun, knew about this, he would surely be astounded—as it hadn’t even been ten years since his breakthrough to the God Refining Realm.
In just a few years, he had cultivated from the first tier of the God Refining Realm to the ninth peak tier of the Hollow Void Stage—an alarming rate of progress that would scare anyone.
Thinking of Gongsun Yun, Han Li had a complex expression. The Sect Leader of Tianxuan Mountain indeed provided him with substantial help, bestowing many valuable treasures upon accepting him as a disciple.
Han Li was fully aware of Gongsun Yun’s intentions; whether he could repay that favor depended on whether he had the ability to do so.
Two days later, the last concubine that Han Li had taken in the previous year also gave birth to an heir with eighth-grade aptitude, whom he named Han
Yongfang.
Han Li’s foundation deepened by another notch.
Dingyuan Manor, Underground World.
Lu Tianxiang sat cross-legged a kilometer away from the nine-colored light screen, propping her chin with one hand and looking somewhat listless.
She had been trapped here for half a year, unable to get out, which troubled her a great deal.
“Senior, am I really able to break this formation?” Lu Tianxiang called out weakly.
Half a year ago, she had made an agreement with an entity trapped within the Emperor Formation. That being revealed important information, stating that someone had once obtained an incredible Pill Formula from him.
The Rebirth Pill, if successfully refined, required only one dose to raise a person’s aptitude by one grade. Although the highest it could go was fifth grade, it was truly invaluable.
For Lu Tianxiang, this Pill Formula was indeed very important. It might not be of much use for her personally, but if she offered it to the powers behind her, she would undoubtedly be richly rewarded, fulfilling many of her demands.
However, that entity was somewhat sly and declined to disclose the detailed content of the Pill Formula, only providing the information on the person who had taken the formula and leaving her to pursue it on her own once she got out.
In Lu Tianxiang’s view, this was not sufficiently sincere, but she was powerless to do anything if the entity refused to divulge it. She also knew that the being was guarding against her, and she herself harbored ulterior motives.
If she really knew the content of the Pill Formula, Lu Tianxiang would continue to demand benefits until she could extract no more, after which she would simply leave and never return.
The being sealed within the Emperor Formation was very likely a Great Emperor, with strength far surpassing hers. Lu Tianxiang did not dare to release him, and indeed, she lacked the ability to do so.
If it turned out that a malevolent Great Emperor was sealed inside the Emperor Formation, its release would be no joking matter. The entire Qianyuan Divine Province would be destroyed in an instant, and even she would perish.
Over the past six months, she had been intentionally dragging her feet, refusing to quickly break the formation to get out, and striking daily poses, all because she wanted to gain some extra benefits from this being’s presence.
The existence sealed within the Emperor Formation was of such a high standing that even a casual hint from it was a great opportunity for Lu Tianxiang.
“This formation is merely meant to conceal movements and isn’t connected to the Emperor Formation. It’s just a mere Third Grade auxiliary formation; with your strength, you could have broken it long ago,” a deep and ancient voice sounded, tinged with a trace of dissatisfaction.
“Senior, a Third Grade formation is meant to counter those in the True Martial Realm, and I am only at the early stage of the Myriad Phenomena Realm; how could I break it? Why don’t you send me out directly?” Lu Tianxiang pleaded with feigned grievance and then probed further.
Although it was a Third Grade formation, the years had taken their toll, and it was neither a killing formation nor a trapping formation; she could break it with some tricks up her sleeve.
She wanted more benefits, which was why she was reluctant to leave, and she also wanted to know whether this being’s previous words were true or false.
“Heh-” a cold laugh emanated from the nine-colored light screen.
The towering figure looking at Lu Tianxiang outside the light screen really wished he could slap her to death; one truly cannot trust this person.
He had long detected that Lu Tianxiang was like a cunning little fox, and that was exactly why he hadn’t revealed the contents of the Pill Formula; if he had, the little fox might take an inch and ask for a mile or take the Pill Formula and run away.
He needed Lu Tianxiang to spread the news that there were countless opportunities and treasures here to the forces behind her, luring those in the True Martial Realm and even the Divine Yuan Realm here.
The greater the commotion, the more powerhouses would be attracted, and when they all attacked the formation light screen together, they might not break it but could drain some of its power; then, with his full strength from within, he might be able to break the formation.
But this little fox only cared about receiving benefits and had no intention of doing any work for him; naturally, he could not agree.
After pondering for a moment, the Great Emperor said, “When I led you in, the bit of strength I used was already exhausted, I truly cannot send you out.”
“You’ll see my sincerity once you have the Pill Formula. If you are willing to come back, I will teach you the following parts of the cultivation technique you practice, and give you another significant benefit.”
“Is that true?” Lu Tianxiang’s pupils constricted sharply; she had waited so long, and now she had finally heard of a new benefit.
“True.
Within the nine-colored light screen, in a place Lu Tianxiang couldn’t see, the Great Emperor had an indifferent expression but a hint of a smile in his eyes; the fish had finally taken the bait.
As long as Lu Tianxiang came back, he would continue to tempt her with the prospect of fortune, dulling her vigilance. Once she had a taste of the enormous opportunities available, her greed would continue to grow, eventually being used by him.
Upon receiving an affirmative response, Lu Tianxiang’s expression fluctuated, feeling an intense allure from the promised benefits.
She had no desire to return or to interact with this being any longer, but the rewards offered were too substantial to ignore.
Her incomplete cultivation technique was of the Lower Grade Heaven Rank; the complete version would be at least of the Divine Rank and might even be an Immortal Scripture. If there was a chance, she would definitely want to obtain it.
“Sigh!”
Lu Tianxiang heaved a sigh within her heart and took a deep look at the nine-colored light screen, took out a talisman, and used it immediately.
The talisman unleashed a terrifying power, breaking through the formation, and Lu Tianxiang’s figure disappeared from view.
Whether she would return or not, securing the Pill Formula for the Rebirth Pill first before deciding was not too late.
Lu Tianxiang emerged in the outside world, intending to use her techniques to conceal this place but then thought better of it and returned directly to Qingyun Manor.
She had just returned to the Er Sea of Cang Mountain and hadn’t even had the chance to catch her breath when she suddenly looked towards Jizhou, her expression turning to one of shock.
In Jizhou, a great battle was currently erupting, and it was a battle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm level..

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 94 Two Punches_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 94 - 94 Two Punches_l
Chapter 94: Two Punches_l
Translator: 549690339
This battle attracted the attention of many powerful experts, as well as the focus of various forces.
Centering around Jizhou, the nearby six or seven provinces all felt the impact, with Hollow Void Stage and Myriad Phenomena Realm masters watching from afar.
As the heart of the Daqian Empire, Yuanzhou was home to numerous Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters, all of whom were startled at this moment, casting their gazes over, yet they did not rush over to provide support.
The experts of the Yinyang Sect also paid attention as soon as possible, but they were just watching the show. This wasn’t their doing, and the Yinyang Sect only wanted to know the outcome.
At this moment, outside the Province City of Jizhou, several figures were in a standoff, the atmosphere tense, with the air thick with the smell of gunpowder, ready to burst into a great battle at any moment.
One side had three figures, all Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters, but their complexions were not looking good at this moment, with one of them even exhibiting some signs of weakness.
The other side had only one person, tall and straight, with a heroic face, radiating a terrifying aura that was subtly suppressing the opposition.
This caused many distant onlookers to be shocked. Prince Wu’an’s strength was somewhat astounding; facing three Great Grandmasters alone, he still managed to gain the upper hand.
“No matter who you are, no matter what forces you have behind you, none of you are escaping today.”
Chu Hao’s expression was indifferent, yet his eyes were somewhat gloomy. Did these forces really think the Daqian Empire was an easy target? They all wanted to come and try their hand at it.
His aura grew stronger and stronger, triggering heavenly phenomena, his oppressive True Martial Intent vast like the ocean, bearing down on the opposite side, firmly locking onto the three Great Grandmasters.
He was truly angered. A Commissioner of the Daqian Empire had been brazenly assassinated and had been successfully killed. If these murderers weren’t left behind, the fall of the Daqian Empire wouldn’t be far off.
No matter how powerful the forces behind them were, as long as they didn’t openly show themselves, he was not the least bit afraid. Three Grandmasters were nothing but clowns in his eyes.
“Today, I will use the lives of these three Great Grandmasters to deter potential enemies.”
Chu Hao thought to himself, being targeted by many powerhouses, the Daqian Empire had been forbearing everywhere. Now, he could no longer tolerate it.
Strike with one punch to prevent a hundred! It was also time to show other forces the true strength of the Daqian Empire, to let them weigh whether or not they wanted to clash with the Daqian Empire to the death.
The three Great Grandmasters also released their own True Martial Intent, confronting Prince Wu’an, but even when joining forces, they were suppressed, managing only to withstand the pressure and communicating secretly through voice transmission.
“What do we do? Should we tactically reposition?” asked the Grandmaster on the left.
“What’s there to be afraid of? Chu Hao is also just in the Myriad Phenomena Realm. If the three of us join forces, maybe we can kill him as well, which would be a tremendous achievement,” the Grandmaster in the middle said, itching for action.
The Grandmaster on the right, however, decisively negated the suggestion,
“Retreat. Our mission is already complete. There’s no need to fight with Prince Wu’an. Besides, Prince Wu’an’s strength is much greater than the records suggest.”
They had come from the Chaotic Domain, hidden their tracks all the way to Jizhou, tasked with assassinating the Commissioners of Luzhou, Jizhou, and Yuanzhou, stirring chaos in the Daqian Empire, and incidentally provoking Prince Wu’an.
The death of a Commissioner of Sanzhou would undoubtedly cause major upheaval in the Daqian Empire. If the Daqian Empire couldn’t find the culprit, it would shake the confidence of the Sects within the Daqian territories. They would immediately embark on the next course of action, directly undermining the ruling foundation of the Daqian Empire.
Provoking Prince Wu’an was just incidental. With Prince Wu’an remaining inactive in Huozhou, the Mysterious Forces wondered whether the death of a Great Grandmaster could draw him away.
According to the plan, they were to disappear immediately after successfully assassinating the Commissioners of Sanzhou, and even if Prince Wu’an arrived, it would be to no avail.
The initial part of the plan was very successful, but the actual outcome deviated greatly. Originally, they intended to strike as soon as they found an opportunity, with the combined force of the three Great Grandmasters being able to kill that Commissioner in one blow.
However, that Commissioner had exceedingly sharp senses. He somehow sensed the danger ahead of time and directly conjured a large tortoise shell, blocking this combined attack.
The trio had no choice but to continue attacking, striving to quickly kill the Commissioner, otherwise running away would turn into a complete farce.
All three of them were powerful, all late-stage Grandmasters of the Myriad
Phenomena Realm. The Commissioner was only at the sixth level of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and even with that lower-grade Heaven Rank defensive artifact, he couldn’t withstand their joint attack.
Upon going all out, they soon shattered the giant turtle shell and were about to slay the Commissioner when Prince Wu’an appeared in the skyline, throwing a punch from afar in an attempt to stop their violent deeds.
While the two Grandmasters continued their assault on the Commissioner of Da Qian, he turned to block the punch, believing that, although Prince Wu’an was powerful, there wouldn’t be much difference in strength between them since he too was a late-stage Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
But then he was sent flying by Prince Wu’an’s remote punch, spitting blood, with his internal organs smashed and shifted, suffering severe injuries, and his hands nearly snapping. Fortunately, his two companions promptly finished off the Commissioner of Da Qian and joined him in combat.
Otherwise, if Prince Wu’an had thrown one more punch, he would have met his end there today. Prince Wu’an’s power was too formidable, significantly stronger than what the intelligence had recorded; his combat ability might very well have touched the threshold of the True Martial Realm.
His speed might have also reached the True Martial Realm. From the beginning of their assassination attempt to the breaking of the turtle shell, it took no more than ten breaths for Prince Wu’an to arrive, having traversed over a million miles.
The thoughts of Prince Wu’an, and the telepathic conversations between the three Grandmasters, all occurred in an instant. Their Divine Spirits were incredibly powerful, and countless thoughts flashed through their minds in a moment.
“Chu Hao, you may be strong, but you alone can’t hold us back,”
the leading Grandmaster said with a cold laugh, agreeing to retreat since his two companions also favored it.
As he spoke, one of the Grandmasters took out a talisman and activated it immediately, preparing for Prince Wu’an’s attack while the other Grandmaster and he remained on guard.
The talisman burst into light in an instant, enveloping all three of them and about to transport them away, but to their horror, they didn’t succeed.
“Boom!”
Chu Hao, as he began to speak, simply threw a punch. A huge fist seal swirling with the principles of heaven’s cycle emanated an incomparably domineering aura, blending with the vast and powerful intent of his punch and striking fiercely.
The three Grandmasters tried their best to defend, but they simply couldn’t withstand it; the fist seal was unbeatable, shattering everything, even disrupting their spatial relocation.
“Are you kidding me?”
The three Grandmasters were sent flying back, their bodies battered, leaving wounds all over, bleeding everywhere, their eyes filled with disbelief.
Once the Great Spatial Transfer talisman was activated, they should have been teleported three million miles away in an instant, yet it was forcefully interrupted. The three Grandmasters, even with their combined strength, couldn’t block a single hit from Prince Wu’an and were instead severely wounded.
“Thinking of escaping? Did you ask for my permission?”
Prince Wu’an sneered and swung his fist again, his overpowering killing punch striking once more. No matter how the three Grandmasters resisted, they couldn’t fend it off and were directly obliterated by the punch.
Chu Hao’s gaze swept across the Spiritual Senses lurking in the sky, sending a chilling fear through everyone, deterring further observation.
Lingjun City, Han Mansion.
Han Li was also watching the battle, but he refrained from using his Spiritual Sense, fearing detection.
Now that the battle had ended, he was very eager to learn the outcome, but it was not convenient for him to inquire at the moment.
“Just wait a little longer; the news should spread soon,”
Han Li exhaled and decided to stay calm. This battle could very well be the beginning of a storm, and it was crucial for him not to expose his strength at this time.
He looked somewhat restless, considering his plans to move to Yuanzhou after leaving Jizhou. With the situation unfolding in Jizhou, was it still wise to relocate there?
Han Li pondered, wondering whether he should choose a different location..

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Do Not Waste a Dime_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Do Not Waste a Dime_l
Translator: 549690339
This incident was too significant to be concealed, and the Daqian Empire didn’t even wish to hide it; instead, they widely propagated it.
All parties understood that by doing this, the Daqian Empire was showing off its strength, signaling that it was a tough bone to chew. Anyone who clashed head-on with the Daqian Empire would end up with both sides suffering, to the advantage of a third party.
The Daqian Empire showcased its sharp edge, instantly suppressing the movements of various major forces, nearly dissipating the storm that was on the verge of erupting.
But everyone knew that the storm hadn’t dissipated; it had only shifted from the open to the shadows. On the surface, all seemed calm, but underneath, the undercurrents surged violently, gradually brewing and growing, until their eventual outbreak would be even more fierce.
Qingyun Manor, ERhai.
Lu Tianxiang’s delicate jade feet idly swayed in the sea, her expression somewhat vacant; the incident had given her a great shock.
After returning to the Chaotic Domain, she knew that the forces behind her would launch a second wave of actions against the Daqian Empire, causing further chaos.
Should they succeed, the Commissioners of Daqian as well as other Grandmasters would feel threatened. Even the major Sects would waver in their loyalty. Then, initiating a third wave of action would be enough to completely disrupt the Daqian Empire.
The ideal was plump, but reality was skeletal.
Although they had succeeded in assassinating the Commissioner of Sanzhou, the three Great Grandmasters who had gone to carry out the assassination had all died; the loss was too great.
Two late-stage and one mid-stage Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, in exchange for one mid-stage Commissioner of Daqian, was definitely a bad deal.
The most critical issue was that with Prince Wu’an’s action this time, by killing three Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, he had severely deterred various forces.
With two punches, he had killed three powerful Grandmasters of the Myriad
Phenomena Realm; this was without a doubt the combat ability of the True Martial Realm. The Daqian Empire might have already harbored strength of the True Martial Realm, and now that there was an additional True Martial power, their prowess had greatly increased.
In such a situation, not only would the interior of the Daqian Empire stabilize further, but also the major external forces would become more cautious, not daring to act rashly.
“I really don’t want to go back,” Lu Tianxiang sighed.
If she found the Rebirth Pill, even with the allure of subsequent cultivation techniques, she would still be uncertain, primarily because that existence was too dangerous.
But this great battle made Lu Tianxiang realize that she was still very weak. Even as Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, the gaps among them were as vast as the heavens and the earth.
The three Grandmasters slain by Prince Wu’an had each been much stronger than her. Previously, she thought she could withstand three moves; now, it seemed she would be killed in one.
Hiding in Leizhou was nearly under Prince Wu’an’s very nose, too dangerous. She must enhance her strength.
That existence held the opportunity to rapidly increase her strength in his hands, whether it was subsequent cultivation techniques, powerful martial skills, or other great benefits.
Yinyang Sect.
Black Tortoise City was the mega-city closest to Daqian, with tens of millions of inhabitants and numerous Cultivators, all of whom practiced Devil Cultivation Techniques.
In the master’s mansion, the yellow-robed Third Elder was drinking tea.
Sitting opposite him was another person who faintly possessed the aura of a Grandmaster, with a deep and unshakable presence between the two.
“I didn’t expect him to have come this far,” the Third Elder said with a bit of a
gloomy expression.
He had once fought against Prince Wu’an. At that time, he was in the late stage of the Hollow Void Stage while Prince Wulan was only in the mid-stage. After their fierce battle, Prince Wu’an emerged slightly superior.
This had dealt a great blow to the Third Elder. Back in the day, he was the adored genius of the Yinyang Sect, having condensed a powerful embryonic form of martial intent, possessing few adversaries in the Hollow Void Stage.
Yet, he was defeated by someone of a lower realm. That was when he Imew that Chu Hao’s martial path was stronger than his, one of the top echelons.
Both of their breakthroughs to the Myriad Phenomena Realm occurred around the same time, but Prince Wu’an had reached the pinnacle of the Myriad
Phenomena Realm fifty years earlier than he did. Now he was among the very top of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, yet Prince Wu’an possessed the combat ability of the True Martial Realm.
The disparity in strength between the two was growing wider, and this had struck a blow to Elder Three’s conviction time and again.
The person opposite him was silent, and only after a long while did they sigh and say, “Combat ability in the True Martial Realm is really terrifying, isn’t it? Even we, who are top-tier Great Grandmasters, probably couldn’t withstand more than three moves.”
“Alas,” Elder Three also sighed, as certain thoughts in his mind were extinguished.
If there were no turning point in the situation, he didn’t plan to get involved in the opportunity that Prince Wu’an was waiting for. Going there would be tantamount to courting death.
He knew that the mastermind behind the assassination was the mysterious forces behind Mother Wusheng, and those forces had lost three powerful Great Grandmasters this time. He didn’t know whether a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu would come.
If there were, then there would be a chance to fish in troubled waters. As long as there was an opportunity, he didn’t want to give it up, after all, it was a great opportunity that even Prince Wu’an was keeping an eye on, an opportunity that could enhance the quality of the Martial True Pill.
If he could obtain it, he could jump to the Third Grade True Elixir in one fell swoop and ascend to the True Martial Realm, his strength would catch up with Prince Wu’an, or even surpass him.
Lingjun City, Han Mansion.
“This world is too dangerous, I should just keep lying low.”
Han Li held a jade stone in his hand, which contained intelligence about the recent great battle. After reading it, he couldn’t help but sigh.
Three Great Grandmasters—each one much stronger than him—joined forces to strike and were still blown away by Prince Wu’an with just two punches. That’s damn scary.
He originally thought that with the combat ability of a threshold Myriad Phenomena Realm, he would be considered an influential figure in the Daqian Empire. Now it seemed that his strength was still lacking.
He mustn’t act rashly, for one slip-up could lead to catastrophe.
Prince Wu’an was the Daqian Empire’s openly acknowledged True Martial Realm combat power, but there might be genuine True Martial Realm rulers hidden in the shadows of the empire.
He was not strong enough now and needed to continue to develop discreetly.
When he reached the True Martial Realm, there would be few in the Daqian Empire who could threaten him, and by the time he reached the Divine Yuan Realm, he should be able to dominate the empire.
At that time, the entire Daqian Empire would have to hold Han Li in high esteem. He wouldn’t need to hide his strength, the Han Mansion would be able to develop rapidly, and he could take his pick from the empire’s high-talented and attractive ladies, which would accelerate his power progression even more.
But the most pressing issue was to move house.
This time, Prince Wu’an’s punches had created a brief period of peace, causing a tranquil lull in the Daqian Empire and giving Han Li more time to develop in stability.
However, Han Li knew that this was only temporary. The mysterious forces that had lost three Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters would likely not let things rest and after the brief calm, they would stir up an even greater storm, possibly striking the Daqian Empire with the force of thunder.
Prince Wu’an’s Huozhou would bear the brunt of this. There might be a True
Martial Realm Emperor Wu who would come looking for trouble, and if two True Martial Realm powers fought there, Leizhou could easily be affected. It would be best to move as soon as possible.
Han Li decided that it was still best to move to Yuanzhou, which would be tranquil for many years to come and was an excellent opportunity for relocation.
With the Commissioners of Yuanzhou, Jizhou, and Luzhou assassinated, the Daqian Empire would have to send another Great Grandmaster to replace them, but this would take time.
The Great Grandmasters of the Daqian Empire were few and each had their own duties. With a Commissioner of Sanzhou missing, the empire would need to weigh the pros and cons to transfer someone from a less critical position.
This was advantageous for Han Li, as once he moved to Yuanzhou, he would have more time to develop.
As long as he grew strong enough, any conspiracy or scheming would be futile against him, and he would be able to suppress any storm with just one hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: The Key to the Future_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: The Key to the Future_1
Translator: 549690339
Chaotic Domain, Mysterious Forces.
In a dark golden great hall, several thrones floated, each representing a True Martial Realm martial king.
“We were careless, this loss was significant.”
“Prince Wu’an has kept a low profile, actually possessing the combat ability of the True Martial Realm, I suspect he already had the chance to condense the Third Grade King Grade Pill.”
“Are you saying… Prince Wu’an intends to condense the legendary King Grade True Elixir?”
“Very likely, it seems that divine opportunity is extraordinary, hence Prince Wu’an treats it with such gravity.”
“Daqian Empire has lost one in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and we have lost three, who will go to Daqian Country to kill Prince Wu’an?”
“Impossible, we are not a local force of the Xuan Domain, sending someone from the Myriad Phenomena Realm is still feasible, but if we mobilize someone from the True Martial Realm, the Ancient Empire would not sit idly by.”
“Hmm, the Ancient Empire has always treated the Xuan Domain as their fiefdom, vigorously preventing the incursion of other domains.”
“Heh- The Buddha Domain, Dao Domain, and even the Devil Region have all infiltrated, can the Ancient Empire stop them?”
“Those three domains have been united, the Ancient Empire naturally does not dare to obstruct too much, but can we compare with those three domains?”
“Enough, indeed we need to send a True Martial Realm to take charge of the overall situation, to continue to execute the third step of the plan, as for Prince
Wu’an, we will deal with him when that opportunity emerges.”
As this voice arose, all other voices vanished, quickly unifying the opinion.
Jizhou.
rlWvo demonesses hiding in a small county town were a bit bewildered, even frightened afterwards.
They had long shaken off their pursuers and had been staying here securely for some time, they both wished to stay here forever, but an unexpected change occurred.
A terrifying great war erupted in Jizhou, and four Great Grandmasters fell consecutively, which was frightening.
The two were only God Refining Realm practitioners, such a great war was too horrifying for them, mere aftershocks could easily annihilate them.
“Shall we… leave Jizhou?” the purple-dressed lady trembled as she spoke.
The yellow-dressed beauty nodded, she too felt remnants of fear, so she said, “Prince Wu’an is in Huozhou, and Leizhou is within his jurisdiction, it’s best we do not go there.”
“If we don’t go to Leizhou, how can we travel to the Yinyang Sect and transfer to the Da Liang Empire?” the purple-dressed lady asked.
“Let’s not go to the Da Liang Empire for now, let’s head to Yuanzhou to lay low, far from the Three States under Prince Wu’an’s control,” the yellow-dressed beauty thought for a moment before saying.
The purple-dressed lady pondered for a while and agreed; Yuanzhou was only one state away from the Imperial Capital located in Yuanzhou, so if there was a chance, they could return to the Capital City and complete their unfinished mission.
Imperial Capital of Daqian.
A significant imperial court meeting was convened, with participants all being heavyweights of the Daqian Empire.
Emperor Qian, Left Minister of Daqian, Mentor of Daqian, Daqian National
Teacher, Prophet of the Imperial Astronomer, Head Supervisor of the Jingye
Office, Great General, pillars of the Direct Lineage for state defense, Grand Internal Supervisor – this was a meeting with only nine people, eight participating and one observing.
Nine individuals, representing the highest power and status from nine aspects of Daqian, and their every word and action profoundly affected the operation of the Qian Dynasty.
The theme of the court meeting was none other than the Battle of Jizhou; it kicked off with endless debates, with proponents, opponents, and neutrals regarding Prince Wu’an’s actions.
The supporters argued: Although Daqian had lost one regional commander,
Prince Wu’an thunderously slain three Great Grandmasters, displaying True Martial Realm’s combat ability, sufficient to deter those covetous great forces, consolidate the allegiance of domestic sects, and secure more time for the Qian Dynasty.
The opponents argued: Prince Wu’an should not have killed those three Great Grandmasters; it would have been better to capture them alive, for such actions could exacerbate tensions and possibly provoke the True Martial Realm of that mysterious force to act, leading to greater and more numerous upheavals, ultimately endangering the Qian Dynasty.
The neutrals argued: Prince Wu’an’s show of strength was good, but killing the three Great Grandmasters was indeed thoughtless, likely to trigger larger disturbances; however, since it has already happened, they should make preparations and face it calmly.
Watching these high-powered figures argue until their faces turned red and they nearly came to blows, Emperor Qian couldn’t help but feel torn between laughter and tears.
At last, unable to bear it, Emperor Qian made the final judgment, “When it’s time to strike and kill, one must not be lenient, and when compromise is needed, some concessions can be made. Let it be known far and wide to deter all sides.”
The court assembly dispersed, leaving the building empty except for two people.
Emperor Qian sat alone, with the Grand Internal Supervisor standing by his side, silent from the beginning to the end.
Thinking of Prince Wu’an, Emperor Qian’s eyes deepened with an inexplicable tint, and he ultimately sighed.
As the crown prince, he was inferior to Emperor Wu in every aspect. The outside world believed he ascended the throne through certain means. After his enthronement, he even suppressed Emperor Wu, committing many dishonorable actions.
But what was the reality…
He was forced to ascend, bearing various pressures to allow Prince Wu’an to fade from the limelight and devote himself to cultivation. Once Prince Wu’an achieved the True Martial Realm, Emperor Qian would abdicate in his favor.
How was this different from being a puppet?
Yet, he had no choice but to do so, whether it was because of the pressure from the ancestors or for his own future, he had to temporarily shoulder this responsibility.
In the Imperial Capital, several buildings towered high enough to overlook the entire city, one of which was the Imperial Astronomer.
At this moment, the Prophet stood at the highest point of the Imperial Astronomer, observing the city’s atmosphere, glancing unintentionally towards the residence of the Left Minister.
Afterward, he used the fortune of the entire Daqian Country as a guide to calculate the future of Daqian, which exhausted a great deal of his energy, causing the Prophet to age significantly.
“Leizhou.”
He exhaled, concluding the answer he had discerned from the unknown. “It seems that the opportunity lies in Leizhou…” A glimmer of insight flashed in the Prophet’s eyes.
Prince Wu’an’s fate was tied to the future of Daqian. If he could seize that opportunity, he would surely refine the legendary King Grade Pill, and after advancing to the True Martial Realm, his strength would rapidly soar to the peak, making him an invincible force in all directions.
Not only could he resolve the crisis in Daqian, but he could also elevate the Qian Dynasty to new heights.
In Lingjun City, at Han Mansion.
It had been ten days since the great battle in Jizhou, and Han Li had decided to officially move to Yuanzhou ten days later.
Since deciding to move, more than ten days had passed, with Han Mansion continuously preparing various matters, and now more than half were already prepared.
The descendants of the Han Family cultivating in Fengyang Manor and the surrounding manors and sects had been mostly notified and those willing to return had begun their journey back.
Only Tianxuan Mountain had not been informed yet. There were several of Han Li’s children in Tianxuan Mountain, all with talents of the seventh or eighth grade. Because the distance was too great, Han Li did not send word.
He decided to visit Tianxuan Mountain one more time, to bring back those descendants and also to meet his master, Gongsun Yun.
After moving to Yuanzhou, the distance to Tianxuan Mountain would become even greater, and the glory of Tianxuan Mountain could not cast its light there. Han Li would be even less likely to return often.
This might be his last time returning to Tianxuan Mountain in this life.
After arranging everything and informing his concubines, Han Li set off, vanishing from Lingjun City in a flash.
He no longer deliberately concealed his strength. The move to Yuanzhou, in his concubines’ view, was fraught with risk. The Han Family’s strength was not sufficient to move across states, but since their lord Han Li had made the decision, they could only comply.
Thus, Han Li decided to boost their confidence a little. He would not reveal his true cultivation level; let them guess instead. It might also reduce some troubles.
Many of his concubines had families behind them and occasionally had contact with their maternal homes. It was possible that they might inadvertently reveal something.
If the outside world knew he had grown stronger but did not know the extent of his strength, they certainly could not guess that he was a master at the peak of the Hollow Realm. This could also bring some benefits to the Han Family.
PS: After moving, I will adjust some writing styles. Previously, high-level powerhouses appeared too quickly, such as the Great Emperor, Heavenly Immortals, Dragon Maidens, Prince Wu’an, the Three Elders, etc.
The Great Emperor and the Heavenly Immortals, among others, will not affect the protagonist for a long time, so it’s not a big problem; but Dragon Maidens, Prince Wu’an, the Three Elders, and even Lu Tianxiang’s realms are all higher than the protagonist’s, adding undue pressure.
Although the protagonist’s advancement speed is also fast, there is always a sense of urgency. Later on, I will write more about the protagonist’s realm advantages, involving Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, the two demonesses, and other characters.
The fast-paced nature of this book and the quick progression of the timeline mean that a lot of content is only briefly touched upon, appearing somewhat pale and weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - 97 Take Care, Master_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 97 - 97 Take Care, Master_l
Chapter 97: Take Care, Master_l
Translator: 549690339
It was tens of thousands of miles from Lingjun City to Tianxuan Mountain, but for Han Li, it merely amounted to taking a dozen or so steps.
A figure descended a hundred miles outside of Tianxuan Mountain, a person of elegant and handsome appearance, dressed in blue, with a purple jade pendant hanging at his waist—it was Han Li.
Having observed the area for a while, Han Li sighed inwardly before flying towards Tianxuan Mountain Range at the speed of the Gangyuan Realm.
Before long, he returned to Tianxuan Mountain, and after reporting in, Qiu Shuilin arrived to guide him to meet the Sect Leader.
At the first glance of Han Li, Qiu Shuilin’s heart stirred; he was unable to discern Han Li’s level of cultivation, but Han Li gave him an unfathomably deep impression.
Could it be that Han Li had advanced to the later stages of the God Refining Realm?
Qiu Shuilin felt a surge of surprise, followed shortly by a gloomy thought.
As the two flew together towards the Peak of Tianxuan Mountain, noting Qiu Shuilin’s unusual demeanor, Han Li pondered for a while but ultimately did not ask.
Soon, the pair reached the summit of the main peak, where Gongsun Yun stood with his hands clasped behind his back, seemingly gazing at something.
Han Li noticed that Gongsun Yun seemed to have a particular fondness for this place, as their every encounter took place here.
Qiu Shuilin excused himself, and as Han Li watched his departing figure, he frowned slightly.
“Jiang Cheng is dead.”
Gongsun Yun’s voice rose in Han Li’s ear.
Han Li’s pupils constricted sharply.
Jiang Cheng was actually dead; no wonder Qiu Shuilin’s expression had been so grim. Jiang Cheng was his personal disciple and had been highly valued by Qiu Shuilin, who had invested a great deal of effort into him.
He had met Jiang Cheng only three times, but his impression of the man was significant. Stuck in the tribulation of emotional entanglements for decades, it was with great difficulty that Jiang Cheng had finally broken through, and his future had looked bright. His cultivation to the God Refining Realm would have been easy; even the Hollow Void Stage was within his reach.
Han Li still remembered their last encounter, which took place several years ago, when Jiang Cheng had descended the mountain and came to Lingjun City, asking him to accompany him on his journey.
In reality, it was Qiu Shuilin’s suggestion. If Han Li agreed to journey together, with his level of cultivation, Jiang Cheng’s safety would have been much more assured.
Han Li had not agreed, and fortunately so.
At that time, he was only at the peak of the God Refining Realm, planning to continue laying low, focusing on developing in secret until his realm increased. He had not expected Jiang Cheng’s actual demise.
Had he agreed to Jiang Cheng’s request, they would have trained together, and perhaps Jiang Cheng may not have died— or perhaps both would have perished.
Who knew what dangers Jiang Cheng had encountered? It might have even dragged Han Li down with him, both dying in that journey.
Tianxuan Mountain was merely one of the Four Sects of Leizhou, with little influence in Huozhou. Recently, Huozhou had been home to many Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, making it an extremely perilous place. Han Li certainly did not wish to enter the radar of these powerhouses; that would have been far too insecure.
The death of Jiang Cheng served as another stark reminder to Han Li: if you can lay low, don’t take risks. Jiang Cheng was a case in point; laying low could avoid over ninety-five percent of dangers, and the path of laying low was most suited for his development.
“Huff-”
Han Li let out a long breath, his expression growing even more resolute.
Gongsun Yun had been observing Han Li’s reaction, and seeing his resoluteness, he felt more at ease. The longer Han Li could lay low, the better; only those who could lay low would live long, and only then would Tianxuan Mountain have a future.
“Disciple, do you have some matter upon returning to the mountain?” Gongsun Yun inquired.
“Four Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm have died in Jizhou,” Han Li answered.
Gongsun Yun’s eyebrows rose slightly, probing, “What do you mean by that?”
“Peace is fleeting, the Daqian is about to be plunged into chaos; it is not suitable to linger in a place that breeds trouble. I plan on moving,” Han Li stated bluntly, having already decided to relocate, he could speak openly.
“Sigh-”
Gongsun Yun nodded and sighed, “You’re right, a storm is brewing.
“Prince Wu’an has been in Huozhou for quite some years now, seemingly plotting something. These machinations will likely make Leizhou, Huozhou, and Qingzhou battlegrounds for various powers to contend; once the war breaks out, the repercussions will be widespread, indeed no place to linger.
If possible, Gongsun Yun himself would want to move Tianxuan Mountain far away from Sanzhou, to develop elsewhere.
But the power structure in the other provinces had long been established, and should Tianxuan Mountain attempt to gain a foothold there, it would only face joint resistance and expulsion by various sects.
Tianxuan Mountain’s millennium foundation was in Leizhou; Gongsun Yun did not wish to abandon all that, else he would not be able to face the Founding Masters of past generations.
“Where do you plan to move? Leave Daqian?” Gongsun Yun continued to inquire.
Han Li shook his head slightly and said, “I can’t leave Daqian for the time being, let’s move to Yuanzhou first.”
Gongsun Yun:
It was just a casual remark, but Gongsun Yun hadn’t expected Han Li to seriously consider the idea; however, it did seem to align with Han Li’s character.
Daqian was now the chessboard of various top forces, and great chaos was bound to ensue. If Han Li wanted to live in peace, a change of location was necessary.
The only reason Han Li hadn’t led the Han Family out of the Daqian Empire was that his power was still insufficient.
After a pause, Gongsun Yun said, “Yuanzhou is a good place.”
Although Yuanzhou bordered Jizhou, where four Great Grandmasters had perished, it probably wouldn’t affect Yuanzhou.
Three Great Grandmasters died at the hands of Prince Wu’an, who was in Huozhou. If the mysterious forces sought revenge, it was more likely that Huozhou, Leizhou, and Qingzhou would be affected.
Yuanzhou was only one province away from Yuanzhou and closer to the Capital City of Daqian, which was indeed much safer than Leizhou.
“Having met with my master, it’s also time for me to leave.”
Watching Gongsun Yun’s retreating figure, Han Li knew the immense pressure he was under; however, he couldn’t stay to confront the challenges of Tianxuan Mountain and Gongsun Yun together.
He had his own path to walk, and to him, Tianxuan Mountain was ultimately just a passerby on his journey to immortality.
Even if his power outmatched Gongsun Yun’s, he wouldn’t be able to withstand it once the war began. In the great battles, Masters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm were the main forces, while Hollow Realm Masters could only play a supporting role. Not to mention, even Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm could enter the fray.
If he lacked sufficient strength, then it was better to avoid getting involved; there was no need to compete head-on. Besides, he wasn’t lacking opportunities, and surviving was better than anything else.
“Go, go,” Gongsun Yun wanted to say more but ultimately handed over a Space Ring to him, instructing him to inspect it when the time was right.
“Take care, Master.”
After saying this, Han Li took the Space Ring and turned to leave.
“Han Li, if Tianxuan Mountain is ever in danger of destruction, even if your master dies, you need not return. Always remember the sixteen-character truth I told you, ” Gongsun Yun’s voice reached him. Han Li hesitated briefly before striding away from the peak.
Gongsun Yun did not know when he had turned around to watch Han Li’s disappearing figure, a complex expression in his eyes.
The last time Han Li returned to the mountain, Gongsun Yun could still discern the depth of Han Li’s cultivation. But this time, Han Li’s abilities were thoroughly inscrutable to him.
The breath-concealing technique he taught Han Li was very profound, indecipherable even to those a Big Realm higher; yet if he observed with intent, he could usually detect slight flaws. However, he found no such flaws in Han Li.
This indicated that Han Li’s cultivation had likely reached the Hollow Void Stage, quietly becoming a Grandmaster.
“This child’s future achievements are boundless,” Gongsun Yun remarked.
Han Li’s cultivation was already so advanced, yet the aura he displayed was only that of the early Gangyuan Realm. It had to be said that he was incredibly cautious.
Han Li was also very low-key, not actively seeking trouble. He was focused on taking concubines, and he didn’t even coerce them, which further reduced the chance of attracting trouble.
Turning his gaze away, Gongsun Yun returned to his previous demeanor, looking into the distance, lost in thought.
His gaze was directed towards the Dao Domain. In order to secure the foundation of Tianxuan Mountain, Gongsun Yun had secretly dispatched an Elder to seek help from the Tai Xuan Sect of the Dao Domain.
Tianxuan Mountain was established just a thousand years ago, and under his leadership, it reached the fifth generation of Sect Leaders. Excluding the Founding Master, each Sect Leader served for only two hundred years before going to the Tai Xuan Sect of the Dao Domain to pay homage and return to their roots.
Tianxuan Mountain was too small; it was only within the Tai Xuan Sect that they had more opportunities to cultivate to the level of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and even to the True Martial Realm.
“I hope there’s still time.”
Gongsun Yun sighed inwardly. Despite his great strength, he was but a lone tree against a storm, struggling to withstand the pressures.
Thinking of Gongsun Yue, his headache intensified; his daughter was too stubborn and insisting on staying at Tianxuan Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Before the Migration_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Before the Migration_l
Translator: 549690339
Upon arriving in the Outer Sect Area, Han Li gathered his descendants and spoke of the plans to relocate to Yuanzhou. He also mentioned his intentions to cultivate his offspring before letting them make their choice.
Since Han Yongfan and the others had mediocre aptitudes, merely seventh and eighth grade, Han Li did not force them; staying at Tianxuan Mountain might not necessarily be a bad thing.
For descendants like Han Yonglin and Han Yongyun, who had fifth and sixth-grade aptitudes, Han Li intended to take all of them to Yuanzhou for careful cultivation.
After some consideration, Han Yongfan and the others unanimously agreed, willing to relocate with the family to Yuanzhou.
Previously, Han Li hadn’t managed them directly, only sending them to train at Tianxuan Mountain, where their aptitudes weren’t valued highly and the competition was fierce, leaving them with few resources.
Now, each of them had reached the Third Realm, which was much faster than the pace at which Han Li had cultivated in his younger years, mainly due to the many resources provided by the Han Family.
If they didn’t follow the family, being too far away, the Han Family wouldn’t be able to continue providing cultivation resources, and they would merely be ordinary Foreign Disciples at Tianxuan Mountain with slow cultivation progress.
If they followed the family to Yuanzhou, with their current cultivation levels, they would certainly receive focused training from “old Dad”.
In the Han Family, their aptitudes were among the best, or else they wouldn’t have been sent to Tianxuan Mountain in the first place. Returning to the family would mean concentrated resources on them, which was much better than staying on Tianxuan Mountain.
Han Li naturally understood their thoughts and did not say much; aside from those few with fifth and sixth-grade aptitudes, their talents were the best, and he could provide them with substantial cultivation support.
Afterward, with a wave of his hand, Han Li used Gang Yuan to lift Han Yongfan and the others, disappearing from Tianxuan Mountain.
Traveling rapidly all the while, Han Li led them on the journey. Along the way, he inquired about his children’s recent conditions, understanding their difficulties and any questions they had about cultivation.
When Han Li stopped, they had already returned to Lingjun City, where, with another wave of his hand, he placed Han Yongfan and the others on the plaza of the Han Mansion.
After looking around several times to confirm that this was indeed Lingjun City’s Han Mansion, Han Yongfan and the others were astounded.
Because Han Li had rarely interacted with them previously, his current attentiveness to their well-being and inquiries about their conditions filled them with joy and excitement, to the point that they lost track of time.
Now reflecting on it, they realized that not much time had passed, less than half a day, and they had already returned to their family!
Such incredible speed; just how high was their father’s cultivation?
At least the Great Masters of the Gangyuan Realm did not possess this speed; was their father already at the exalted God Refining Realm?
The God Refining Realm masters were few and far between even on Tianxuan Mountain, holding positions of high prestige as Elders, and Han Yongfan and the others had hardly ever seen one.
Han Yongfan and the others wanted confirmation but did not dare to ask outright, their hearts brimming with joy at their good fortune in returning with their father.
If their father truly was a God Refining Realm master, the Han Family would become a powerful Cultivation Family in the future, and they, as children of a God Refining Realm master, would enjoy access to an abundance of cultivation resources, making their future prospects to reach the Gangyuan Realm highly promising.
“Prepare yourselves. We will relocate in ten days,”
Han Li left this message and then left the central plaza to return to the back courtyard.
Just as he had deliberately revealed his cultivation when he left, he also intentionally displayed it upon returning, aiming to bolster the family’s confidence and reduce external troubles.
As the days went by, Han Mansion staff from the outside gradually returned and preparations for the relocation were steadily completed. The members of the Han Family were both apprehensive and hopeful about the future.
They had lived in Lingjun City for decades, formed emotional attachments, and created many familiar relationships, all of which they were now bidding farewell during this time.
Traveling from Leizhou, crossing Qingzhou and Jizhou to reach Yuanzhou was a long journey with an uncertain future. They felt uneasy, worried about the dangers they might encounter along the way.
They were filled with anticipation for the future, as Han Li had already promised, after migrating to Yuanzhou, all benefits would be significantly increased.
The news of the Han Family’s migration had also spread throughout Lingjun City and even throughout Fengyang Manor. No one knew why the ancestor of the Han Mansion, renowned for taking in concubines, had decided to migrate.
Could it be that Leizhou had too many beauties for taking in as concubines, and he wanted to change his taste by going to Yuanzhou?
The impact of the Han Mansion’s migration was immense, involving all aspects, from the Mortal World to the Cultivation Realm. There had been close attention paid to this matter lately.
Upon learning the news, the ordinary citizens of Lingjun City were dumbstruck. The Han Mansion absolutely couldn’t migrate. What would they do if the Han Mansion left?
The ancestor of the Han Family took several, even a dozen concubines each year. Every time he took a concubine, he would hold a three-day banquet with an endless stream of dishes, allowing them to eat meat and fish for free, and lead a good life.
In the hearts of the citizens of Lingjun City, the ancestor of the Han Family was like a god descended to earth, bringing them good fortune. If the Han Mansion moved away, they would no longer enjoy free banquets.
In recent days, a large number of people had come to the outside of the Han Mansion to plead, requesting that the Han Mansion not move away and beseeching the ancestor of the Han Family to love them once more.
Among them were ordinary citizens, as well as many who had benefited from weddings hosted by the Han Family, and merchants who had business dealings with the Han Family…
The voices were loud, and some even employed moral coercion, but they could not influence the decision of the Han Mansion. Han Li simply didn’t care. Did they really think he was a philanthropist?
For decades, it could be said that at least a million people in Lingjun City had benefitted from the grace of the Han Mansion. Han Li asked for no return, but he absolutely would not allow them to overstep their bounds.
For the forces in Lingjun City, however, this was a great opportunity. With the Han Mansion, the overlord of Lingjun City gone, they could divide up the various benefits left by the Han Mansion and indulge to their heart’s content.
With the Han Mansion no longer there to dominate, they would have more room for development and wouldn’t have to worry about the issue of beautiful female cultivators with qualifications. It was a concern they had harbored previously.
The ancestor of the Han Family continuously took beautiful female cultivators with qualifications as concubines, and his descendants also chose beautiful women when taking wives and concubines. Some beautiful women cultivators with inferior qualifications were willing to marry into the Han Family’s descendants.
Who could blame them? The Han Family was powerful with many strong members, and their descendants had good genes, right?
Now things were looking up. After the Han Mansion moved, Lingjun City would belong to them. One could imagine that for a while in the future, Lingjun City would erupt in strife, filling the power vacuum left by the Han Family’s departure.
The other forces in Fengyang Manor were just watching the drama unfold. The Han Mansion’s decision to move had nothing to do with them, and they couldn’t gain any benefits, so they were just going to sit back and enjoy the show.
Some forces with interests tied to the Han Mansion felt helpless. After the Han Mansion moved away, they naturally could no longer receive spirit pills, weapons, and other cultivation resources, and they were also unable to interfere with the Han Mansion’s decision.
Then there were those related to the Han Mansion through marriage, such as the families of Han Li’s beautiful concubines. They were quite depressed and had sent quite a few people to the Han Mansion recently to contact those concubines.
To have them whisper sweet nothings and persuade the ancestor of the Han Family not to migrate, or if he must migrate, at least to another manor within Leizhou.
These families and forces had offered their daughters as concubines to Han Li in hopes of clinging to his coattails and relying on the strength and influence of the Han Mansion. Now that the Han Mansion was moving to Yuanzhou, their plans had fallen through.
For these marital ally families and forces, Han Li still had arrangements. He hadn’t truly abandoned them, although it was impossible to take them all with him.
Han Li bestowed upon each marital ally family numerous spirit pills and weapons, most of which were ungraded, a small portion were Ninth Grade, and some Eighth Grade spirit pills and weapons, as well as formations.
All these could enhance the strength of the marital ally families and accelerate their development.
For Han Li, these were trivial matters, but they could give his concubines peace of mind and ensure their undivided loyalty.
As for Seventh Grade spirit pills and Spiritual Artifacts, Han Li had also refined quite a few, but he did not bestow them upon these marital ally families. They lacked the strength to protect these treasures, which would only invite endless trouble, and could even lead to their annihilation.

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 99 Hidden Worries_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Hidden Worries_1
Translator: 549690339
Qingyun Manor, Erhai.
Under the sea, an exquisitely perfect body swam gracefully, like a mermaid swaying and posing, forming a beautiful and marvelous seascape painting.
As Lu Tianxiang emerged, shimmering in the light, her whole body covered, her crystal jade feet, snow-white and round long legs, a slender waist that could barely be grasped, fair swan neck, and a face of national beauty bathed in the sunlight.
She walked barefoot on the surface of Erhai, each step she took failing to ripple the water, yet her reflection in the sea revealed a figure that made one’s blood surge with excitement.
It could be seen that there was a halo behind her head, which had become completely solidified after a period of consolidation.
Lu Tianxiang walked to the shore, and articles of clothing automatically flew to her, dressing her perfect figure.
In an instant, the originally alluring figure became holy, noble, and inviolable.
Afterward, the figure of Lu Tianxiang disappeared from Erhai and appeared in the main hall of the Diancang Sect; Diancang Master had been waiting for a long time.
As Lu Tianxiang looked over, Diancang Master quickly bowed his head, not daring to meet her gaze, and she indifferently asked, “Did you find out?”
Upon her return to the Diancang Sect, she had given Diancang Master the task of finding the little cultivator who took the Rebirth Pill, ordering him to mobilize the Sect’s power to track him down.
Of course, she did not tell Diancang Master about the Rebirth Pill, simply stating she was looking for such a person.
Now that considerable time had passed, Lu Tianxiang wanted to know the result.
“Reporting to the Sect Hierarch, after extensive investigation by your subordinate, we have roughly confirmed the identity of the cultivator,” Diancang Master immediately replied respectfully.
“Continue,” Lu Tianxiang felt a surge of joy in her heart but did not show it on her face.
“The person the Sect Hierarch is looking for should be a Pihai Realm cultivator from Fenglei Manor City named Qiu Xuan, only his appearance, strength, and traces match the description you provided,”
“Your subordinate has also bought information about this person from Tianji
Pavilion, confirming his whereabouts. During the time mentioned by the Sect
Hierarch, he was indeed in Yangping County of Dingyuan Manor,” Diancang Master continued to respond, his tone devout and respectful.
Lu Tianxiang nodded slightly and asked, “Was he brought back?”
“Your subordinate is powerless,” Diancang Master said, bowing his body and not standing up, feeling extremely ashamed for not having completed the task Lu Tianxiang had given him.
“What happened?”
Lu Tianxiang’s eyebrows furrowed slightly in confusion. Diancang Master was a cultivator of the God Refining Realm, yet he could not bring back a mere Pihai Realm cultivator.
Could it be that Qiu Xuan handed over the Rebirth Pill to some powerful entity in exchange for protection and various cultivation resources?
If that were the case, then it would truly be difficult to handle. Dealing with Tianxuan Mountain, Sword Cleansing Pool, and the True Sun Sect was just a bit troublesome, as they have no Great Grandmaster to forcefully snatch from.
She could also steal from the Hehuan Sect if she were bold enough, as long as she did not run into one of the Yinyang Sect’s three Elders.
If it were handed over to the Daqian Empire, then no matter how reluctant she was, she could only give up. The Rebirth Pill would definitely end up in the hands of Prince Wu’an for safekeeping.
Even with one hundred times the courage, she would not dare to steal the
Rebirth Pill from Prince Wu’an, as she could very likely be killed by his fist.
“Qiu Xuan died more than a decade ago…” Diancang Master said with a wry smile.
At these words, Lu Tianxiang breathed a sigh of relief and immediately followed up, “Died? How did he die? Who did he interact with before his death? Does he have a wife, concubines, or descendants? If so, where are they now?”
“Upon learning this information, your subordinate immediately came to report to the Sect Hierarch,” Diancang Master replied, bowing deeply and feeling even more ashamed.
Lu Tianxiang scolded softly and said indifferently, “Find out the situation as soon as possible, otherwise you will be held accountable.”
“Yes, your subordinate will take care of it immediately.”
Diancang Master immediately left to continue investigating the relevant intelligence.
“Sigh-”
Looking at the empty main hall, Lu Tianxiang’s feelings were complex.
Qiu Xuan is dead, but whose hands has the Rebirth Pill fallen into now?
Was it left to his wives and descendants? Had Qiu Xuan hidden it away, or had another cultivator intercepted Qiu Xuan and unintentionally obtained the Rebirth Pill Formula?
Each guess was possible, and Lu Tianxiang couldn’t be sure of the situation. She only hoped it wasn’t the worst-case scenario. As long as it wasn’t in the hands of the Daqian Empire, she still had a chance.
With a sigh, Lu Tianxiang’s figure disappeared from the main hall.
Qingzhou, Canghai Sect.
Atop a mountain tens of thousands of feet high, which soared like a heavenly sword piercing the skies, Jiang Baiye stood at the summit, close enough to touch the sea of clouds.
She was still dressed in her palace white gown, with a Divine Sword on her back, her silver hair flowing in the wind. The breeze from the sea of clouds gently caressed her, outlining a figure that could be described as perfection itself.
Her delicate and beautiful features were as lovely as a lotus flower emerging from the water. With arched brows, bright teeth, and picturesque eyes, her fine facial features were strikingly beautiful, truly resembling a Heavenly Immortal, like a Sword Fairy who looked down upon the mortal world.
Her tall figure, with broad shoulders and slender waist, along with her beautiful legs and the astonishing S-curve of her body, was flawless. Every inch of her was mesmerizing.
When it came to her figure, she was impeccable, second to none. The phrase
“graceful as a startled swan, gentle as a gliding dragon” described her perfectly.
At this moment, Jiang Baiye sat on a large white jade boulder, her arms crossed over her chest, her legs swinging in the air. But her mind repeatedly went over certain images, images that brought her extreme shame.
Her delicate snow-white arms hugged around her chest as the cool wind blew on her silver hair and across her perfect frame. It was as if the wind itself was enamored with such beauty, carefully cherishing her.
“Alas-”
After a long while, Jiang Baiye gathered her thoughts and thought back to the recent events within her Sect, letting out a long sigh.
What that man had done to her, Jiang Baiye couldn’t forget. At first, she thought she would hate him intensely and indeed she did, with a gnawing resentment.
But with recurring thoughts of him, an unusual feeling gradually emerged within her. He was the first man to perpetrate such an outrage upon her, defiling her reputation as the celebrated Sword Fairy of Sanzhou.
Jiang Baiye kept wondering if she could really retrieve the Body-Cultivating Furnace in fifty years. Lacking confidence in her own strength, she could only trust that the man would keep his promise.
And the recent happenings within the Sect caused Jiang Baiye great concern — could Canghai Sect endure for another fifty years?
The Canghai Sect had been declaring their retrieval of the Body-Cultivating Furnace for years, but had not used it since; their public statement was that the high-grade spirit liquids inside had been depleted by the thief and needed to be reaccumulated before opening the Furnace again.
Most disciples of the Canghai Sect believed that the Sect’s treasure had indeed been recovered, but there was much skepticism from the outside world believing that Canghai Sect had not regained the Body-Cultivating Furnace and that the current one was a fake. However, they couldn’t provide any evidence.
Therefore, some forces that were already at odds with the Canghai Sect began to stir, among them being Ji Feng Hall from Luzhou.
Ji Feng Hall was also one of the Ten Great Sects of Daqian, ranked just one place above Canghai Sect. Their Sect Leader was a mid-stage Grandmaster from the Myriad Phenomena Realm, whose strength was no less than the Canghai Sect Leader’s.
Ji Feng Hall didn’t personally get involved but incited several other forces in Qingzhou to probe Canghai Sect. If they could prove Canghai Sect hadn’t recovered the Body-Cultivating Furnace, then Ji Feng Hall would intervene.
The other forces in Qingzhou also wanted to know the truth. If it was indeed genuine, they would naturally not dare to act recklessly. But if it turned out to be false, they might well join forces with Ji Feng Hall against Canghai Sect.
If the Canghai Sect fell, the resulting power vacuum would be divided among the other forces — a considerable temptation for them.
Ever since the Body-Cultivating Furnace went missing, Ji Feng Hall and the other Qingzhou forces had been pressuring Canghai Sect, leaving them with no capability to dispatch strong members to pursue the Furnace.
After declaring the return of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, Canghai Sect enjoyed a period of stability, but lately, several major forces have again been showing signs of unrest, with constant small provocations.
