chapters.title: Chapter 108 - 108, Sword Token_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 108 - 108, Sword Token_l
Chapter 108:, Sword Token_l
Translator: 549690339
Han Li wanted to see if he could get a bargain and bring back the Mother of No Life as his concubine.
The Mother of No Life’s strength was formidable, her talents certainly excellent. During the previous battle, he noticed her beauty was exceptional, which is why he harbored this thought.
The Mother of No Life was a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but Han Li thought she looked quite young, and wondered if she possessed the art of maintaining her youth.
It was very likely that the Mother of No Life had a Fourth-Grade talent, or even possibly Third Grade. If he really took her as a concubine, he would make a fortune.
He had a Fifth-Grade talent, and the Mother of No Life had a Fourth-Grade talent; if the two of them combined, the result would likely be a Fourth-Grade talent.
Moreover, both of their cultivations were high, one at the Peak of the Hollow Realm, the other at the early stage of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. The offspring they could produce might have a mutated talent even higher than theirs.
When his first Fifth-Grade talented offspring was born, he gained fifty years of cultivation, the Lower-grade martial skill “Vajra Indestructible Divine Skill,” and his talents improved by one-tenth.
During the fight, this person was like an overbearing tank, with an absurdly high defense and tremendous strength. Every palm strike that landed on her made her cry out in pain.
With the blessing of Omnipotent Martial Arts, a middle-grade Earth-Level was almost comparable to a Supreme Grade Earth-Level, and he could directly master it to perfection, greatly boosting his strength.
However, taking the Mother of No Life as a concubine was very difficult.
Now he would have to snatch food from the mouth of a tiger, and save the Mother of No Life from two Great Grandmasters first.
On the great plains, Lu Tianxiang stood still, seemingly having given up on the idea of running away.
At this moment, she became calm and composed as if she had made peace with life and death, calmly taking out a dress and putting it on over herself, obscuring the alluring spring scenery that had been momentarily exposed.
Even though she was in such straits, Lu Tianxiang’s feet remained off the ground, as if she had a phobia of cleanliness, seemingly worried that even with her shoes on, touching the ground would dirty her jade-like feet.
Swish, swish-
Two sounds of air being torn pierced through, as Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong landed several miles away from Lu Tianxiang, their expressions void of emotion as they looked at her.
For Great Grandmasters like them, a distance of several miles, tens of miles, or even hundreds of miles was all the same, as they could cross it in a blink of an eye.
They didn’t approach too closely, in order to guard against the Mother of No Life choosing to fight to the death. Even a Great Grandmaster going all out in their attacks could cause them quite a bit of suffering, let alone getting caught in a self-destructive blast, which, if not fatal, would leave them severely injured.
“Mother of No Life, you are a Great Grandmaster, and Da Qian also needs strong individuals like you. If you truly pledge allegiance, Prince Wu’an will not mistreat you,” Wan Guiyuan continued to persuade with his offer of clemency.
Yang Tianxiong remained silent, just vigilant and on guard.
Compared to a deceased Great Grandmaster, a living one who is willing to join Da Qian is many times more important. If they could sway the Mother of No Life to their side, it would be a great achievement.
On paper, Da Qian only had twenty-five Great Grandmasters, or rather, now only twenty-four. It could be said that the weight of one Great Grandmaster was very significant.
Generally speaking, if a Great Grandmaster joins the court, Da Qian would bestow upon them the title of a nation’s pillar, granting them immense power and a lofty position. Of course, there were also many obligations. They must fight for Da Qian.
Da Qian also had corresponding methods to prevent these incorporated Great Grandmasters from betraying, ensuring their genuine allegiance.
“Impossible,” Lu Tianxiang rejected without hesitation.
While Da Qian had ways to prevent strong joiners from betraying, her backing forces had them too, and they were even crueller.
All great forces have such means, to bind the strong within their ranks and prevent internal traitors and betrayal.
Generally, only strong individuals of the Hollow Void Stage and above would receive such treatment. If they wanted to achieve a higher status and more cultivation resources within the force, they had to prove their loyalty; otherwise, the sect would not continue to nurture them.
Only those of the Hollow Void Stage and above were considered the upper echelons of a force, able to access more sect secrets, hold detailed intelligence, and the core mysteries. Without total loyalty, they could not even come into contact with these things.
Minor forces didn’t care much, as they lacked such means. Even the Leizhou Sects of Tianxuan Mountain did not have them.
For a force like Tianxuan Mountain, the usual practice was to rely on thorough selection and continuous filtering, fostering the emergence of generations of
Sect Heirs and high-level individuals.
If Lu Tianxiang were to betray the forces behind her, her Divine Spirit would be severely damaged, her path clouded, and it would be impossible for her cultivation to advance any further.
Then, all the relatives and friends of her backing powers would be implicated, with the lighter punishments being imprisonment for hundreds of years, while the more severe penalties ranged from abolishment of one’s cultivation to direct execution.
Lu Tianxiang would rather die than accept such an outcome.
She wasn’t the sort that would let all her friends and relatives pay a hefty price just so she could cling to life.
Perhaps others could do it, holding their own lives as the most important, willing to abandon anyone, but she couldn’t.
“Sigh-
Wan Guiyuan sighed and, at the same time as Yang Tianxiong, made his move.
The two had been maintaining communication through transmitted messages, agreeing that if Lu Tianxiang refused to agree, they would immediately take action to suppress her, and at the very least, they would have to kill her on the spot.
Two fierce and powerful martial intent forces firmly pressed down on Lu Tianxiang, and even though her martial intent was at a higher level, her cultivation was much lower and she was injured, fundamentally unable to withstand the crush of the two Great Grandmasters’ martial intent.
Wan Guiyuan’s fists and Yang Tianxiong’s palms struck Lu Tianxiang simultaneously. Lu Tianxiang struggled to defend herself. Her body uncontrollably flew backwards, blood trickling from the corner of her mouth, her injuries worsening.
The two did not stop their assault, constantly attacking, causing Lu Tianxiang’s injuries to grow more severe and her breathing to rapidly weaken, leaving her almost incapable of moving.
The two exchanged glances before vanishing from their spots, reappearing in the next instant in front of and behind Lu Tianxiang, swinging fists and palms again, aiming to render Lu Tianxiang powerless to resist.
A crafty glint flashed in Lu Tianxiang’s eyes as her figure disappeared from the spot, leaving behind only a sword talisman that burst forth with dazzling light.
“Not good!”
Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong’s pupils contracted sharply, they desperately retreated while simultaneously launching attacks, attempting to weaken the power of the sword talisman.
The sword talisman emitted light, and the dazzling radiance of the sword light blossomed, forming thousands of sword wheels, each wheel releasing terrifying Sword Intent, a magnificent sword light that sliced through heaven and earth, dimming the sun and the moon, peerless sword wheels tearing through space, intending to exterminate all foes.
The first strikes from Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong were instantly ground to nothing by the thousands of sword wheels, and their subsequent attacks were also easily destroyed, but the sword wheels diminished by forty to fifty percent.
The remaining sword wheels split into two waves, attacking both Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, these two Great Grandmasters, shattering their defensive Magical Treasures, penetrating their protective Gang Yuan, and relentlessly striking them.
When all the sword wheels dissipated, the figures of Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong emerged, now thousands of miles apart. They rapidly retreated with their injured bodies, only to find that Lu Tianxiang had long since vanished.
“Damn it!”
“We were careless!”
Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong cursed in anger, their expressions as ugly as they could be.
Their mission had failed again, and they had sustained heavy injuries, their strength not even reaching sixty percent of their peak.
If not for the fact that a lot of the sword wheel’s power had been blocked, they would be close to death or seriously injured, their condition far worse than it currently was.
The two shared a glance and sighed simultaneously. Lu Tianxiang had long since disappeared without a trace, to continue pursuing or not?
But if they did not pursue and returned, how would they explain themselves to Prince Wu’an?
They vanished from that place, having no choice but to continue the relentless pursuit. Fortunately, they had secretly marked the Mother of No Life beforehand and could still barely sense her.
Meanwhile, Lu Tianxiang activated the last of her Gang Yuan and continuously traveled for seventy to eighty thousand miles before she finally stopped, intending to find a place to heal her wounds.
She didn’t know if Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong had caught up, but she had to heal now, or there would be big trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - 109 Azure Dragon Revival Elixir_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 109 - 109 Azure Dragon Revival Elixir_l
Chapter 109: Azure Dragon Revival Elixir_l
Translator: 549690339
Lu Tianxiang’s Spiritual Sense entered the Spatial Bracelet, retrieving various Spirit Pills and rare medicinal concoctions, embarking on a new round of her medicinal journey.
Fortunately, she had the foresight to stockpile a large amount of Spirit Pills in the bracelet. She had consumed many while fleeing for her life, yet there were still quite a few left.
Once the pills were swallowed, Lu Tianxiang’s Cultivation Technique whirred into frantic action within her body, aiming to refine the pills at the fastest speed possible.
As the medicine continued to be refined, her complexion gradually improved, no longer pale and lifeless, and her aura began to steadily rise.
When her strength recovered to about forty percent, she had refined the remaining Spirit Pills. After some hesitation, she took out a beautifully decorated wooden box.
Upon opening the box, the fragrance of the pills wafted out. Looking at the pills inside, Lu Tianxiang’s heart ached; this was her last trump card.
When she came to the Daqian Empire, she had a total of four trump cards. The first was used during a desperate situation when she was repeatedly hunted by two Great Grandmasters.
The second was a talisman paper, with the power of a single strike from the True Martial Realm, used to open the peripheral great array of the Underground World.
The third was a sword talisman, which her uncle had refined at no small cost.
It contained her uncle’s true martial intent and most powerful martial skill. Unprepared, even someone in the later stages of the Myriad Phenomena Realm could be slain in one strike; she had used it just now when she was trapped.
The fourth trump card was the pill in the box, a top-tier Fourth Grade Pill whose efficacy approached that of the Third Grade, known as the Azure Dragon Revival Elixir.
Once the Azure Dragon Revival Elixir was refined. it could restore a Myriad
Phenomena Realm Grandmaster to their peak condition within three breaths. Its effects were incredibly potent.
Lu Tianxiang hesitated, unsure whether to refine the Azure Dragon Revival Elixir. After all, it was her very last trump card.
Once refined, her strength would return to its peak, greatly increasing her chances of escape, making the consumption of the Azure Dragon Revival Elixir worthwhile.
But what if those two sticky plaster-like pursuers had stopped chasing her?
She could slowly recover from her injuries and need not waste the precious Azure Dragon Revival Elixir.
“Hmm?”
Lu Tianxiang’s expression suddenly changed, and she made up her mind at once.
Her condition had been poor, and she had been preoccupied with healing, not realizing that she had been marked by Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong.
Lu Tianxiang immediately erased two deeply hidden tracking marks, then directly swallowed the Azure Dragon Revival Elixir. As her Cultivation Technique activated to refine the pill, it continually supplied potent medicinal effects, rapidly restoring Lu Tianxiang’s injuries and quickly boosting her aura.
While refining the pill, Lu Tianxiang also began to move, fleeing towards another destination.
A moment later, two figures descended just outside where Lu Tianxiang had been hiding. It was Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, who appeared somewhat ragged.
Even though Lu Tianxiang had erased their marks, they had already locked onto the area.
“No one?”
“Chase!”
Their powerful Spiritual Senses combed through the area several times. Failing to find Lu Tianxiang, they detected traces of her escape and continued to pursue her by following the remnants of her aura.
Another moment passed, and Han Li’s figure emerged in the distance. He had arrived here earlier and had witnessed the whole process of Lu Tianxiang’s healing.
Although Lu Tianxiang had erased the tracking marks of the two Grandmasters, her mark on him remained undiscovered. His Spiritual Sense was much stronger than all three of them. Only at her peak would Lu Tianxiang possibly detect it.
Back on the great plains, seeing Lu Tianxiang getting beaten without the strength to fight back, he had considered stepping in.
With his speed, it would have been very easy to rescue her and flee. Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong wouldn’t have been able to catch up, and he could have quickly lost them.
However, this was not a safe bet, the risks were significant. He could no longer use his identity as a mysterious Great Grandmaster, for once his true identity was exposed, he would be severely targeted by the Daqian Empire.
Therefore, Han Li planned to wait a bit longer and look for another opportunity, mainly because he had noticed that Wusheng’s Mother did not seem to have fallen into a real dead end and still had some reliance.
As expected, Wusheng’s Mother feigned weakness to lure Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, who wanted to capture her alive, to come closer. Then, to their surprise, she unleashed a sword talisman and made her escape, while leaving the two Grandmasters with heavy injuries.
Having witnessed this scene, Han Li felt fortunate that he had played it safe; otherwise, if he had saved Wusheng’s Mother and she had turned on him halfway, he wouldn’t have been able to withstand it.
The might of this sword talisman had reached the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. Although it was only the peak of an ordinary Myriad Phenomena Realm, its strength was still far above Han Li’s.
Wusheng’s Mother harbored deep hatred for him and did not want to fall into his hands; she would definitely secretly use the sword talisman against him. If that happened, he might suffer a setback from an unexpected quarter and instead fall into Wusheng’s Mother’s hands.
Compared to powerhouses like Wusheng’s Mother, Han Li had no sword talismans, high-grade elixirs, or any other kind of trump cards. He was aware of his disadvantages and knew the reasons for them.
He had played it too safe.
As someone who pursued a cautious path, he didn’t venture out to gain experience, compete for resources, or explore ruins, and he didn’t have the backing of a major sect… He simply had no means to obtain any trump cards.
Sometimes he felt envious, but he wouldn’t go and do it. Compared with adventuring out, he preferred to play it safe.
There was no other reason; playing it safe was secure.
The system would also reward him with some elixirs and weapons, but since his cultivation was improving too rapidly, they were of no use to him. Han Li could only pray that the system would be more generous in the future and reward him with some powerful treasures so that he might have some trump cards to use.
With the aid of the mark, he quickly caught up with Wusheng’s Mother and saw her healing. She even took out an elixir that made even Han Li a bit envious, and he wanted to suppress Wusheng’s Mother directly and then plunder her.
But he did not make a move, as the higher-grade spirit liquid from the
Body-Cultivating Furnace was more effective for healing than the elixir.
Moreover, Han Li did not want to have a desperate fight with Wusheng’s
Mother. If he attacked her at this moment, Wusheng’s Mother would definitely explode with rage. Without a way out, she would fight him to the death, and by that time, Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong would also catch up.
His goal was to prevent Wusheng’s Mother from leaking information. If there was an opportunity, he would capture her and take her as a concubine to bear his children. If there was no chance, he would simply kill her. His aim was not to help the Daqian Empire capture Wusheng’s Mother.
At this moment, noises from tens of thousands of miles away reached him; Wusheng’s Mother had been caught up by Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong again, and a fierce battle had ensued.
Han Li took a few steps and instantly arrived at the outskirts of the battlefield, hiding as he watched the three of them fighting in the sky. A certain calculation began to form in his heart.
Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong had been weakened by the sword talisman and had consumed quite a few spirit pills. Their strength had been restored to about eighty percent.
Lu Tianxiang had already refined the Azure Dragon Revival Elixir and had recovered to her peak strength, managing to barely fight against the two Grandmasters. However, she was still at a significant disadvantage and would not be able to last long.
If Lu Tianxiang still had a trump card that could once again heavily injure the two Grandmasters, he might be able to strike directly, hitting them hard enough that they would be powerless to fight back.
The advantage of this approach was that he could capture three Grandmasters. Lu Tianxiang could bear his children as his concubine, and the two Grandmasters could also be put to use.
As Grandmasters, they surely had good qualifications. After sealing their cultivation and coupling them with his offspring, it was possible that they could produce descendants with high qualifications, which would rapidly increase Han Li’s own abilities.
However, such an approach would be somewhat evil, turning two Grandmasters into mere breeding machines. If word of this got out, he would undoubtedly face the wrath of all Grandmasters in the world.
Moreover, Han Li needed to consider the feelings of his descendants; he was not the ruthless demon who would do anything to break through to the next realm.
If the two Grandmasters disappeared without a trace, Prince Wu’an would definitely not sit idle. Provoking this fearsome individual with the combat ability of the True Martial Realm was not worth it.
This thought flashed through his mind and then disappeared just as quickly. Han Li discarded it, as he did not know whether Lu Tianxiang had any trump cards left, and he did not want to undertake such high-risk actions.
He would continue to play it safe and steady. As long as he could endure, his strength would keep growing stronger.
PS: Last day of March, asking for monthly tickets, seeking investment!

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - 110 Desperate Situation 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 110 - 110 Desperate Situation 1
Chapter 110: Desperate Situation 1
Translator: 549690339
Boom!
High above, Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong engaged in fierce combat against Lu Tianxiang, who was being thoroughly overpowered.
“Pfft-
After being sent flying a distance, Lu Tianxiang steadied herself, coughing up blood, her posture extremely disheveled.
Her right hand tightly gripped a whip, two meters in length, a magical treasure refined from rare materials and of supreme grade Earth-level quality.
After clashing for a dozen or so moves, Lu Tianxiang was severely injured; despite using all her martial techniques, she still couldn’t withstand the combined efforts of the two Great Grandmasters.
Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, one to the left and one to the right, attacked simultaneously. Their weapons swung with explosive force, while their other hands continued without pause—either striking with palms or swinging fists—each movement infused with their own martial intent, greatly enhancing their combat ability.
Having nearly been surreptitiously killed by the Mother of No Birth, the two Great Grandmasters no longer harbored any thoughts of capturing her alive; they only wished to quickly slay the Mother of No Birth and then return to report.
With no other choice, Lu Tianxiang struggled to defend herself, swinging the long whip with her right hand while her left hand executed the Vacuum Palm Imprint with a horizontal strike.
Thud!
Lu Tianxiang was sent flying again, her breath weakened yet further, her complexion turning three shades paler, a sight that stirred pity.
“It seems you truly have no more tricks up your sleeve, ” Wan Guiyuan said with a cold laugh.
Yang Tianxiong and Wan Guiyuan advanced upon her, shouting, “Die.”
Suppressing her injuries, Lu Tianxiang brought her hands together, forming a complex hand seal in an instant before pushing hard towards the front with her palms apart.
The moment the seal was formed, the sky was filled with star-fire once again, each spark resembling a lotus blooming with radiance, as if purifying all filth in the world and creating a sanctuary.
Simultaneously, a halo emerged behind Lu Tianxiang’s head, igniting in an instant and supplementing the White Lotus Secret Method, making the number of Galaxy Fire Lotuses in the night sky surge to over forty thousand.
Tens of thousands of Galaxy Fire Lotuses surged forward, colliding and erasing the attacks of Yang Tianxiong and Wan Guiyuan before bombarding the two approaching Great Grandmasters.
Yang Tianxiong and Wan Guiyuan seemed to have anticipated this move, retreating just as Lu Tianxiang unleashed the White Lotus Secret Method.
Their evasion meant the attack did not touch them, but rather, it blasted a large mountain to pieces.
“The same move again, do you have any more? Show them all,” Yang Tianxiong said indifferently, his tone mocking.
Previously during their pursuit of the Mother of No Birth, she had used this move, burning three Faith Halos and greatly increasing her strength, repelling them and successfully escaping.
Now the Mother of No Birth had only ignited one Halo, presumably the only one she had left.
The power of the White Lotus Secret Method with three burning Faith Halos was too strong; they would have died resisting it head-on, but with just one burning Halo, the power was greatly reduced, and they could withstand it.
But neither of them wanted to bear it forcibly; why get injured if they could simply avoid it?
Watching the two Great Grandmasters gradually approach, keen on initiating another wave of attacks, Lu Tianxiang felt a sense of despair filling her, her entire body overwhelmed by powerlessness.
She truly had no strength left to resist.
All her trump cards had been used up, even the Faith Halo had been burned, significantly reducing her strength. Combined with her serious injuries, her combat ability had now fallen below the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
After such a prolonged battle, with no one coming to her aid, it was clear that no reinforcements would arrive.
Several fights involving Great Grandmasters had erupted that evening; the first was between her and a mysterious Great Grandmaster, drawing attention from all sides and leading to her being pursued by two Great Grandmasters.
Subsequently, she had clashed with the two Great Grandmasters numerous times, moving across various locations. Given the length of time and still no one had come to help, it was evident that the forces behind her had abandoned her.
Lu Tianxiang was acutely aware that her backing forces had begun implementing the third stage of their plan in the Da Qian, deploying quite a few Great Grandmasters; her own uncle had also arrived.
With her uncle’s cultivation at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, even if he was on the other side of Da Qian, he should have arrived by now.
He didn’t come, meaning he either didn’t want to or couldn’t.
Since my uncle has taken such good care of me and yet still couldn’t make it here, it means that one of those important figures must have arrived in the Daqian Empire and suppressed him.
My uncle is very strong and is just a step away from the True Martial Realm, but a step away is like a chasm, and in the face of Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, he has no power to fight back; he would be killed with a flip of the hand.
Lu Tianxiang knew she had made a grave mistake that would disrupt the plans of the forces behind her, but she didn’t intend for this to happen.
She was merely trying to capture a cultivator from the Gangyuan Realm. Who would have known she’d be intercepted by a mysterious Great Grandmaster, triggering the subsequent events that led her into a desperate situation.
“Huff-”
Lu Tianxiang let out a deep breath, realizing she was in a desperate situation with no one to rescue her. Yet, in her heart, there was still a glimmer of hope that someone would step forward to save her.
This great battle was being watched by all parties, each eager to know whether the Daqian Empire would be able to kill or capture the Mother of the Unborn alive.
The three Elders of the Yinyang Sect were watching too, enjoying the show from the sidelines without any intention of intervening.
Although the Mother of the Unborn had some cooperation with him, she was not a Great Grandmaster of the Yinyang Sect; hence, her death would not compel him to act on her behalf.
If he intervened, things would escalate quickly. Prince Wu’an would surely take action, and he would be unable to escape death. One thing leading to another, the Yinyang Sect would be forced into the limelight too early and become the primary target.
In Tianxuan Mountain, Gongsun Yun was also watching with a calm gaze, not planning to intervene. He dared not get involved even less.
The Mother of the Unborn was neither kin nor kind to him. What reason would he have to stand up for her?
Doing so would offend Prince Wu’an and bring a catastrophe of annihilation upon Tianxuan Mountain.
Mr. Lan had infiltrated the Yinyang Sect to track down Han Li’s whereabouts. Although he guessed that the confusion was a trap laid by Han Li, he still had to investigate it; only if he truly couldn’t find anything could he return to report back.
In Huozhou City, Prince Wu’an was still fishing. His Spiritual Sense was vast, able to cover a radius of five hundred thousand li, comparable to an ordinary cultivator of the True Martial Realm. Once he expanded it, he could easily scan over half the province.
He had been paying attention to the chase the entire time, saw Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong trying to capture the Mother of the Unborn alive, almost getting killed by deception; saw the Mother of the Unborn getting caught up to, pushed by the two into a corner.
Yet, he was also unable to find Han Li’s whereabouts. Although his Spiritual Sense was much stronger than Han Li’s, the distance was too great, beyond his range of coverage, and Han Li seemed to be deliberately concealing his tracks.
Han Li was also watching all this from afar, whether to capture or kill, he needed to wait for the right moment.
If the Mother of the Unborn showed signs of speaking about the Rebirth Pill, he would strike immediately to suppress her.
If not, he would wait until the Mother of the Unborn had no more power to resist before making his move, lest after saving her, she might launch a surprise attack on him.
He was also waiting for Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong to lower their guard, meanwhile scouting the surrounding area to ensure there were no other
Supreme Grade Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm hiding around.
In Hanzhou, to the east of Jingzhou, lay the easternmost large province of the Qian Dynasty.
This was also the location chosen by the Mysterious Forces, where Fengbo Pavilion was established deep in a mountain range spanning tens of thousands of li.
In the depths of the mountain range, in a courtyard, Lu Tianxiang’s uncle, the blue-robed Envoy, was anxiously waiting for news.
The news of Lu Tianxiang being pursued had arrived early, followed by updates. Those two Grandmasters were still after her, and he desperately wanted to know if Lu Tianxiang had managed to escape.
“If Tianxiang is dead, I will make sure you all are buried with her,” the blue-robed Envoy murmured.
Just because he cannot act now does not mean he won’t have the opportunity in the future. The Sect plans to overthrow the Daqian Empire, and sooner or later, he will confront Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong. Then, it will be their time to die.
On the battlefield, Lu Tianxiang regained her composure. She was fully prepared to fight to the death, hoping she could take down one or two Grandmasters with her, or at the very least, severely injure them.
However, Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong showed no signs of approaching, clearly on guard against her, not giving her the chance to bring them down with her.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Shelf Speech_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Shelf Speech_1
Translator: 549690339
[Foreword]
I’ve written quite a journey up to now, experienced a lot, and had many reflections, so I’ll share them here with you all.
[Experiences]
The book was released on February 9th and listed on April 1st, roughly 50 days, totalling 242,000 characters.
I’ve written quite a few books, but never with such a long free period and so many free characters as a new book; this is a first for me.
Along the way, I’ve been through a lot, yet I still managed to endure.
For example, the book was rejected three times upon release, with no publication allowed; readers gave various opinions and suggestions, both good and bad, and there were personal attacks that often irritated me.
After calming down, I accepted many suggestions from readers and revised the earlier chapters multiple times, altering some settings and writing styles, all in the hope of satisfying more readers.
For instance, the new book period has been quite long, almost two months, and many readers hoped it would be listed sooner, but who doesn’t want that more than the author?
When I was at other sites, new books would be listed within ten days. Writing a new book for such a long time was a real test of patience, and many times I was close to giving up, but thankfully you all supported me.
As a newcomer to Qidian, I didn’t have resources, and getting recommendations required battling it out step by step. The book’s performance was neither good nor bad, and it couldn’t jump to recommendations, enduring six rounds plus the ten days before the first round of recommendations.
There are many more experiences, like several bouts of kidney stones while writing the book, but I won’t recount them all here,
[Q&A]
Some readers have been dissatisfied with the recent chapters, thinking that Lu Tianxiang shouldn’t have been saved, and here I need to reiterate the tone of this book:
This is a fast-paced survival story (“Exciting story”?), where the protagonist’s “golden finger” is marrying wives and concubines to increase his strength by expanding his descendants; every female character described in great detail is a target of the protagonist’s.
If these intricately depicted female characters were killed off, then the tone of the book would be ruined, rendering their detailed description useless.
As main heroines, they will have a lot of roles later on, unlike those nameless, nondescript concubines from before; I hope everyone can understand.
In the early stages of the book, the protagonist was weak in strength and influence, and couldn’t be mindful of many aspects, so he could only defer them for later. That’s why I accelerated the timeline to quickly increase the protagonist’s powers, preparing for the middle stage.
After moving, the protagonist enters the middle stage, his personal strength still increases rapidly, but he will also focus on cultivating his descendants and developing the family’s power, plotting for the world.
I will spend narrative on some of the female leads and will also portray some distinguished descendants, trying to write each character’s personality without slipping into stereotyping.
Though the book is about to enter the middle stage, there is still a long way ahead, and the map is huge. Qianyuan Divine Province is just the starting zone, so I hope everyone can be patient and continue supporting as before. Yesterday I discussed listing with my editor, and the editor mentioned that there were a lot of characters, asking if I wanted to do a reverse release—withholding some chapters to create anticipation. I refused.
Even though I could earn a bit more by withholding a few tens of thousands of characters, it’s simply not right. Let’s just do it as it should be done and not earn that “dirty money.”
Also, I had already brainstormed this book before the year’s end, but various things held me up from writing it until I had some free time in February to start. There might be some trend -following, but the ideas from other sites remain original in terms of the story’s plot.
[Acknowledgements]
Firstly, I am extremely grateful to my editor, Penglai, also known as super beauty “Milk Penglai.” That the book could be published and has come this far is in large part thanks to her.
After being rejected three times, it was Penglai who picked me back up, allowing a newcomer like me to write on this grand platform. That the book completed six rounds and got listed on Sanjiang was also something “Milk Penglai” strived hard for.
Throughout the writing process, Penglai also provided plenty of advice, which was a significant help, so here I want to thank “Milk Penglai” for her support of the book.
Secondly, I want to thank all the readers who have supported me along the way, including the leaders “I Have an Eye that Can Ascend to Immortality” and “Star King,” as well as other readers for their rewards, monthly tickets, and recommendation tickets. I am truly grateful; your support has carried this book to today.
I have read every comment you’ve posted, and I’ve replied to many of them. I’ll continue to do so in the future. If there are any shortcomings in the book, please feel free to point them out, but please refrain from personal attacks, which are intolerable for any author.
Last but not least, thanks to the operations officer “Sleep a Little Less” and the readers “Qing MO Shang Fan Chen” and “Xiao Feng, C?n Yué” for providing fan art of the book’s characters.
[Mass Release]
The book will be listed at 00:05 on April 1st.
It’s said that every book on Qidian must have a mass release upon listing, so this one will not be an exception. There couldn’t be any books that don’t, right?
As mentioned before, let’s start with a 50,000-character burst upon listing to satisfy the readers. (You can take a screenshot of this to motivate other authors)
Of course, my stockpile is certainly more than 50,000 characters, and I’ll add more chapters depending on the situation.
About the update schedule after listing, if it optimizes for premium, I’ll update 10,000 characters daily. For every additional 500 premium subscriptions, I’ll update an extra 2,000 characters each day. But if the initial subscriptions don’t reach 3,000, I’ll update 8,000 characters daily.
Performance is the face of a book and the tool an author uses to make a living; I hope my readers can support me in this.
Better results lead to more updates, and I can create better works.
Last of all, let me talk about the book’s plan. According to the outline, it should exceed 2.6 million characters.
As a first-time author, I won’t leave the book unfinished; I certainly won’t stop after just a few hundred thousand or a million characters.
[Promotion]
I’m promoting a friend’s book, “A Journey Through Myriad Worlds Starting from Tokyo Tales of Terror,” which has some decent supernatural content, and interested readers can check it out.
Intro: Transmigrating into a world of tales of terror, he thought he could live a carefree life as a ghost and deity master like Seimei.
But unexpectedly, he gained the power of Fuchi.
Since then, Si Ye was forced to drift between various tales of terror just to stay
alive.
“Ye-kun, you wouldn’t want Kayako to Imow about this, would you?” “Ye-kun, what do you think would happen if she got her hands on this photo?”
“Ye-kun…”
“Ye-kun, you know what you need to do if you don’t want others to know, right?”

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 111 Han Li Takes Action (Seeking First Subscription)_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 111 Han Li Takes Action (Seeking First Subscription)_l
Translator: 549690339
Lu Tianxiang, along with Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, the three Great Grandmasters, were situated on a plain where Lu Tianxiang had already been driven into a dire predicament.
At the edge of the plain, there was a mountain towering six thousand Zhang high, and it was here that Han Li hid himself, only a little over a hundred li from the battlefield.
His Spiritual Sense had long since spread out, thoroughly scanning the area for two hundred thousand li multiple times, confirming that apart from the three Great Grandmasters on the plain, there were no other Great Grandmasters present.
In the distance, many other Great Grandmasters were observing the battle, but Han Li was not worried; they were too far away, and it would take them considerable time to arrive, which was more than enough for him to escape.
Even if Prince Wu’an, who possessed True Martial Realm combat ability, personally hurried over, Han Li did not fear him — if he could not fight, couldn’t he still run away?
Huozhou City was about one million two hundred thousand li away; it would take Prince Wu’an at least eight breaths of time to arrive, and Han Li could have already fled nearly four hundred thousand li by then.
As long as he took Lu Tianxiang and fled swiftly, then concealed their presence, Prince Wu’an would not be able to find them.
Besides, there was no certainty that Prince Wu’an would even make the trip. The last time Prince Wu’an deployed was when a Sanzhou regional commander had died; this time, if he just rescued Lu Tianxiang without doing anything to the two Great Grandmasters, it was highly probable that Prince Wu’an would not take action.
“Kill!
Having waited for a moment and seeing that Lu Tianxiang made no move, Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, the two Great Grandmasters, no longer hesitated and initiated their attack once more.
Wan Guiyuan swung his sword, with sword energy spanning the sky, forming a blanket overhead, merged with the ferocious martial intent, condensing into thousands of gleaming treasure swords, endless in murderous intent and unparalleled in might, illuminating a vast expanse of territory.
The long spear in Yang Tianxiong’s hands danced, striking forward heavily — suddenly, a hundred-zhang silver dragon emerged, its spear momentum masculine and forceful, the dragon’s roar shaking the world, bursting through space to strike at Lu Tianxiang.
The two Great Grandmasters had no intention of holding back, with this strike imbued with the intent to deliver a fatal blow, to thoroughly crush the Mother of Endlessness and deny her any chance of escape.
Even though she knew she was no match and that she couldn’t block this attack, Lu Tianxiang did not wait to die. She cast a secret technique, burning her vital essence; her body visibly withered at a speed discernible by the naked eye, but her energy climbed rung by rung, returning her to the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
This secret technique was extremely dangerous, potentially dealing a thousand blows to the enemy at the cost of eight hundred to oneself. It could only last for a very brief period, and if she did not stop in time, she could fall before her enemy did.
But Lu Tianxiang had no other concerns at this moment, facing a desperate fight. She stirred the remaining Gang Yuan within her body and cast the White Lotus Secret Method, thousands of Galaxy Fire Lotuses slashing toward the silver dragon and the thousand swords.
Afterward, she struck out with the Vacuum Palm Imprint with her left hand, and with her right hand, she pointed out the Life-Extinguishing Finger three consecutive times — this was her final act of defiance.
Having done all these, the Gang Yuan within her body had been completely depleted, not a single drop remained.
Thousands of swords filled the sky, the silver dragon roared, Galaxy Fire Lotuses dazzlingly bright; in the night sky, they collided together, and in an instant, the heavens shattered and the earth cracked open, creating a huge fissure dozens of Zhang wide, ten Zhang deep, and spanning over twenty li on the plain.
After the fierce collision, the Galaxy Fire Lotus was completely extinguished, and only three to four hundred blades of the sword hung in the sky remained, while the roaring silver dragon was left with only half its body.
In the next instant, a Vacuum Palm Imprint, dozens of feet in size, swept across horizontally, with three rays of destructive light piercing through it, obliterating all life in its path.
The remaining swords and the half dragon were directly destroyed; the Vacuum Palm Imprint and the three destructive lights had expended much of their power, but they still charged towards Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong.
Relief showed on the faces of the two men, as they had already realized that the Yinyang Sect’s matriarch was at the end of her strength. Having worn down her best attack, she would no longer have the strength to resist. They wouldn’t even need to lift a finger; she would die on her own.
Just as Wan Guiyuan was about to throw a punch and Yang Tianxiong was about to strike with his palm to shatter the Vacuum Palm Imprint and Finger of Lifelessness aimed at them respectively, alarm bells went off in their minds. Without hesitation, they struck out backvvard, choosing to withstand the remnants of the Yinyang Sect’s matriarch’s attacks, but it was too late.
While the three of them engaged in the final clash, Han Li had already initiated the Vajra Invulnerability Divine Protection. In the moment the other two let down their guard, Han Li made his move.
His powerful Spiritual Sense pressed down on both men at once while his figure instantly appeared behind Wan Guiyuan. He struck with his palms the exceedingly firm and positive Dragon Suppressing Palm, and then appeared behind Yang Tianxiong, delivering two more palms.
In Han Li’s mind, he had rehearsed this series of motions countless times. Carrying out the sequence smoothly like flowing clouds and streaming water, he gave each of the two Great Grandmasters two palms and then once again appeared behind the Yinyang Sect’s matriarch, slapping the back of her head.
The Yinyang Sect’s matriarch hadn’t anticipated Han Li’s appearance at all, and she had no strength to resist. Still in shock, she was knocked unconscious by Han Li’s slap, and the secret technique of blood qi burning automatically ceased.
Glancing at the two Great Grandmasters, Han Li grabbed the back of the Yinyang Sect’s matriarch’s collar and his figure vanished once again.
From the moment Han Li made his appearance to his three strikes and then leaving with the Yinyang Sect’s matriarch, the entire sequence took less than a single breath’s time, leaving the powerhouses who were observing from afar baffled.
Was the death of the Yinyang Sect’s matriarch on the battlefield not already a foregone conclusion? How did another Great Grandmaster suddenly appear, taking action against both sides of the conflict? Was he trying to profit from their quarrel?
Yang Tianxiong and Wan Guiyuan, the two Great Grandmasters who experienced it firsthand, were even more baffled. Where did this sneak attacker come from?
They had already investigated before, and there were no Great Grandmasters hiding within tens of thousands of miles. With Prince Wu’an watching the battle, they didn’t expect anyone would interfere.
Furthermore, their Spiritual Sense continuously covered a thousand miles around them. Having detected no disturbances, they had confidently taken action, yet they were still caught off guard.
The ambusher’s cultivation seemed to be higher than theirs; his overpowering Spiritual Sense surged like the sea, sending shockwaves through their Divine Spirits and causing a momentary halt. Even though it was a brief moment, it was enough to deal them a serious blow.
His Spiritual Sense attack broke their counterattacks, leaving them unable to strike back; they could only withstand the raw power.
He blasted two palms at each of them; every palm was utterly solid and unyielding, indestructible, and possessed tremendous force, easily breaking through their protective Gang Yuan and landing heavily on their backs. Both men spit blood simultaneously.
At that moment, the residual attacks from the Yinyang Sect’s matriarch also bombarded the two Great Grandmasters, adding to their misery. Unable to block the sneak attack, they were also injured by her assault.
At this point, the two had sustained severe injuries. The attack of the Yinyang Sect’s matriarch didn’t cause much damage; it was mainly Han Li’s ruthless surprise attack that nearly shattered their organs. Their vital energies plummeted, and their strength dwindled to merely thirty to forty percent.
They felt somewhat fortunate; had the assailant targeted their heads, they wouldn’t just be gravely injured but dead on the spot.
In fact, Han Li did not dare to act so recklessly, even though a surprise attack could annihilate two Great Grandmasters, he could guarantee Prince Wu’an would pursue him to the ends of the earth.
After circulating their Cultivation Techniques to barely stabilize their injuries, Yang Tianxiong and Wan Guiyuan looked towards Lu Tianxiang’s location, only to find that the figure of the Mother of No Life had vanished without a trace.
Their Spiritual Sense frantically burst forth, reaching the limit of its coverage range, yet they did not detect any trace of the assailant or the Mother of No Life, shock evident on their faces.
The speed of the assailant was too fast, wasn’t it?
Such speed was at least that of the late Myriad Phenomena Realm. The formidable level of that Spiritual Sense seemed to be of the late Myriad Phenomena Realm as well. Could the assailant be a Great Grandmaster of the late Myriad Phenomena Realm?
Did this late Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster not kill them because he was worried about Prince Wu’an’s retaliation and thus spared their lives?
Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong let their imaginations run wild, even less daring to give chase. They were now severely injured, their strength significantly diminished, and the assailant was suspected to be of the late Myriad Phenomena Realm. If they pursued and provoked him, they feared he might decide to kill them.
In Huozhou City, Prince Wu’an suddenly stood up, his face a mix of rage and confusion.
He wanted to rush over several times but forcefully restrained himself; the person had fled into the Yinyang Sect’s territory. It was not appropriate to create more trouble at this time. Since the Mother of No Life had escaped, let her live a little longer.
If he had wanted to make a move, he should have done so earlier. Since he had entrusted this matter to Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, they should be the ones responsible.
Prince Wu’an did not wish to act rashly; after all, Wan Guiyuan and Yang
Tianxiong had not died. If he rushed over and managed to capture the person, it would be good, but if he failed, he would lose face tremendously, and he did not have much confidence in his heart.
He had some guesses about the identity of the assailant. The palm technique used was too similar to that of the mysterious Great Grandmaster; it was likely the same person.
And that was exactly why he was puzzled.
That person’s strength was clearly on par with the Mother of No Life, so how could he have such incredible speed, and how could he possess such a powerful Spiritual Sense to escape his notice?
That person had seriously wounded the Mother of No Life, clearly harboring enmity towards her. Why then did he come to rescue her?
Could it be that he risked offending the Daqian Empire and attacked two Great
Grandmasters just to take the Mother of No Life away? What did he want to do?
Could he perhaps want to kill the Mother of No Life personally or subject her to various cruel tortures?
Prince Wu’an’s mind raced with various speculations. He felt that there must be some connection between that person and the Mother of No Life; otherwise, he would not take such a big risk to do this.
“Sigh!”
Prince Wu’an sighed, feeling a sense of powerlessness.
Despite being at the peak of Myriad Phenomena Realm and possessing True Martial Realm combat ability, with power ranking in the top three of the Daqian Empire, he was also bound by many constraints.
Cultivation was not just about fighting; there were also human relationships and worldliness to consider.
Whether mortals or cultivators, all have various scruples and think carefully about the pros and cons, weighing the risks before taking any action.
It is only the rash who do not care for consequences, but such brash individuals often die the quickest, becoming scapegoats, bearing the brunt, or serving as the vanguard…
Meanwhile, worried about pursuers, Han Li fled at high speed with the Mother of No Life.
After traveling millions of li in one breath, he had long since entered the territory of the Yinyang Sect. After fleeing tens of thousands of li, Han Li used a technique to conceal both his own and the Mother of No Life’s aura. He twisted and turned many times to prevent being tracked.
To Han Li’s relief, Prince Wu’an had not followed, and there were no other pursuers.
He had entered the territory of the Yinyang Sect to make Prince Wu’an hesitate more. The Yinyang Sect and Da Qian were at odds, with both open frictions and covert hostilities.
If Prince Wu’an dared to kill his way into the Yinyang Sect’s territory, the True Martial Realm powerhouses of the sect might take underhanded actions, ensuring Prince Wu’an could not return.
After hiding in the Yinyang Sect for two hours and confirming there were no pursuers, Han Li started to lead Lu Tianxiang back.
He didn’t take the route through Leizhou to enter Da Qian but instead took a long detour into the Chaotic Domain, then from the Chaotic Domain back to the eastern part of the Da Qian, passing through Qingzhou on their way back to Zhending Manor’s migrating caravan.
This caused Han Li to spend more than ten times the usual time, but he deemed it worthwhile. The risk of returning directly from Leizhou was too great; taking a detour greatly reduced the risk.
Originally, Han Li wanted to lie low for a while longer, but even the Yinyang Sect was not safe, and since the Han Family’s migrating caravan was moving states the next day, there were risks if he did not return to provide oversight.
After laying the Mother of No Life on a soft blanket, Han Li silently observed her.
At tne moment, tne N10tner or NO Lite was still unconscious, Dut sne was an extremely alluring sleeping beauty. Her clothes were tattered, revealing large expanses of her fair skin.
Her exquisitely beautiful face was also reflected in Han Li’s eyes, as were her slender and flexible waist, her long and fair legs, and her perfect S-curve…
All of it ignited a fire in Han Li’s heart, making him itch to take the law into his own hands there and then with the Mother of No Life.
Upon his return, Han Li had sealed the Mother of No Life’s cultivation and used the Body-Cultivating Furnace to heal her and replenish her depleted Qi and blood. Otherwise, she would now look like a withered old crone.
Han Li swallowed hard. The Mother of No Life, now devoid of cultivation and akin to an ordinary mortal woman, was also in an unconscious state, leaving him seemingly free to do as he wished.

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 112: Demoness, Please Help Me Gain Immortality_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 113 - 112: Demoness, Please Help Me Gain Immortality_l
Chapter 113: Chapter 112: Demoness, Please Help Me Gain Immortality_l
Translator: 549690339
In the luxurious carriage, there were only Han Li and Lu Tianxiang, a situation that could be described as a lone man and a single woman together in one carriage.
If a seductive beauty, irresistible in the sudden bloom of spring, were lying unconscious before you, at your mercy, what would you do?
Han Li could now provide an answer.
Han Li’s gaze fell upon the body of the lifeless mother, where the tattered clothing revealed large swathes of snow-white skin, though the vital parts were all covered.
The stunning beauty before him was like a ripe peach waiting to be plucked. Her supple, mature physique undulated gracefully, with every curve perfect— any more would be too much, any less would be too little, just right.
Her tall, slender figure stood out elegantly; her charm was captivating. Her battle boots had long vanished, and her tender, pale feet were so alluring that one could hardly resist touching God’s finest creation.
With the allure of spring before him, Han Li merely needed to flick his finger, and all of the lifeless mother’s clothing would shatter to pieces.
Just as Han Li was about to make a move, he suddenly noticed the lifeless mother’s eyelids twitch, instantly realizing that she might have been awake all along.
Han Li’s lips curved into a smile as he deliberately said, “How should I deal with you? Let me think it over.”
“How about turning you into my furnace, reaping the life of a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster until death? That should significantly increase my cultivation level.”
“Or should I sap you first, and then take you to Da Qian to claim a reward once your cultivation is exhausted?”
“Hm, could I perhaps make you into a furnace puppet, useful both for augmenting my cultivation and fighting my battles? Killing two birds with one stone.”
“Tsk tsk, such a figure, such a lovely face, this…”
Lu Tianxiang couldn’t take it any longer and snapped coldly, “Shut up!”
Not long after Han Li placed her on the blanket, Lu Tianxiang had regained consciousness. She didn’t know where she was and didn’t dare to open her eyes abruptly, as she could feel someone eyeing her with an intense gaze.
She remembered being attacked just before fainting; someone had ambushed Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong and then knocked her unconscious. However, who that person was and how she got here was unknown to Lu Tianxiang.
But Lu Tianxiang knew she had been caught.
Barely escaping the wolf’s den, she had fallen into the tiger’s mouth. Her rescuer was no simple character either; a person of profound cultivation, while her own power had been sealed, leaving her at the mercy of others.
Nevertheless, Lu Tianxiang found it strange that her injuries seemed nearly fully healed, and even her depleted vitality appeared to be replenished. What was going on?
When she heard Han Li say those words, Lu Tianxiang’s heart trembled, fully aware that he was deliberate in his provocations, but she couldn’t help but retort to such humiliation, having never been insulted like this before.
“Heh- thief, don’t think your words can agitate the Sect Hierarch. I just prefer a bit of quiet for my ears, ” Lu Tianxiang said with a frozen smile, not bothering to open her eyes.
Oh my, what a tough duck playing dead!
Seeing Lu Tianxiang’s current state, Han Li knew all too well that she was only being stubborn with her words.
Han Li stood tall, while Lu Tianxiang lay on the blanket. From his vantage point, he could see her body trembling violently; her mouth might deny it, but her body was honest.
It seemed she was truly worried about what Han Li might do to her.
“Demoness, if you’re so unmoved, why don’t you dare to open your eyes and look at me?” Han Li chuckled teasingly.
His laughter was grating, and Lu Tianxiang felt a bit uncomfortable. She really wanted to open her eyes to see who this person was.
His tone sounded familiar to her; she had a guess but feared it was the person she least wanted to see, so she hesitated to open her eyes.
If it was indeed that person, then her situation would truly be dire, better to die than to face that reality.
“Heh, what is there to fear? I, the Sect Hierarch, simply do not wish to see your ugly face and spoil my mood,” Lu Tianxiang continued defiantly.
“Since you won’t look at me, then I’ll take a good look at you, examine you from head to toe, inside and out, several times over.”
Han Li’s tone was mocking as he stepped toward Lu Tianxiang, his right hand raised, inching closer to her tempting figure.
He wanted to see if this woman, who was toughest in her words, could continue to be so tough.
Feeling Han Li’s approach, and smelling the masculine scent that assailed her senses, Lu Tianxiang trembled even more violently. Just as Han Li’s right hand was about to touch her delicate face, Lu Tianxiang finally gave in.
“Stop! I’ll look at you, that’s what I’ll do.”
At her words, Han Li did not stop but continued to rub his hand on Lu Tianxiang’s face, caressing her soft skin, enjoying the fine, tender, and silky touch.
“You, you, you… what are you doing? Stop at once, I command you!”
Lu Tianxiang abruptly opened her beautiful eyes, looking at the man close at hand, speaking anxiously.
From a young age, she had never been in such close contact with the opposite sex, let alone having someone so brazenly caress and knead her lovely face.
Having lived for over two hundred years, Lu Tianxiang was usually revered, pure and dignified; untouchable. But at this moment, she was being desecrated, and she could hardly bear the shame.
“You have no say in this,” Han Li said indifferently.
Han Li’s hand roamed all over Lu Tianxiang’s face, caressing it back and forth several times, causing her lovely face to blush, but she was unable to resist.
Not only was her cultivation sealed by Han Li, but at this moment, she was also immobilized by his imposing presence, unable to move at all, with only the ability to speak left.
After a while, Han Li released his hold reluctantly. This woman was a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and also the first female Great Grandmaster he had encountered.
She was his first female Great Grandmaster captive, and soon to become his first Myriad Phenomena Realm concubine.
Han Li changed her position to lie down, looking at Lu Tianxiang quietly. Her eyes were beautiful, like two black gems set within, her long lashes slightly damp.
Her delicate nose, thin red lips tightly pursed, her originally dignified and beautiful hairstyle now a disheveled mess hanging down her back, her abundant and graceful figure showcasing all her curves.
Han Li couldn’t resist anymore and leaned down close to her head, pressing his lips to hers for a long while before pulling away, savoring the lingering sweetness.
Lu Tianxiang was burning with humiliation and anger. She had not only been taken advantage of by this man but also had her first kiss stolen. Detestable.
Rather than being humiliated by this person, it would be better to die at the hands of Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong.
Watching Lu Tianxiang’s ashamed and furious demeanor, Han Li was indifferent, speaking faintly, “Don’t play innocent. If you hadn’t troubled me first, why would I have treated you this way?”
“It really was you!”
Lu Tianxiang said with hatred, her eyes filled with deep resentment. The look of wanting to knife someone is hard to hide.
Previously, she hadn’t managed to glimpse the man’s face and had only heard him speak a few sentences, which left a profound impression on her. She attributed her current misfortunes entirely to him.
Having heard his voice before, Lu Tianxiang had her suspicions, which she now confirmed without a doubt.
Lu Tianxiang had a belly full of grievances, feeling deeply wronged in her heart. What enmity or grudge did she have with this man that he kept targeting her time and again?
When had she ever troubled this person?
She didn’t even know him, let alone hear about him.
Although she was proud, she would never offend a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm for no reason. To make enmities recklessly is a path to death.
Lu Tianxiang could guarantee that she had never offended this man. She hadn’t been in the Daqian Empire for many years, and the only Great Grandmasters she had offended were those of the Daqian Empire; he wasn’t on the list.
But why did he continuously seek trouble with her?
Previously, for no reason at all, he ambushed her, leaving her severely injured before disappearing without a trace, much to her misery.
She had energetically set out to capture Han Li, hoping to obtain the Rebirth Pill, only to be ambushed and then miserably pursued by two Great Grandmasters.
Lu Tianxiang fled all the way, traveling back and forth, a distance enough to circle around Leizhou twice. She was chased to a pathetic state, suffering injuries upon injuries. If it were not for her desperately consuming medicine, she would have died long ago.
During her escape, filled with ups and downs and after several twists and turns, she still didn’t manage to evade capture, falling into a desperate situation, powerless to struggle, with no one coming to her rescue.
Lu Tianxiang had already prepared herself for death, but then someone suddenly appeared and saved her. She should have been overwhelmed with excitement and joy; yet, she felt no positive emotions.
The person who saved her was the very same who had ambushed her before.
If he wanted to save her, then why ambushed her in the first place, leaving her with severe injuries?
Did he want to torment her to death only to catch her again for soul extracting and lamp lighting?
Yet she truly held no grudges or resentments against this man!
“It was me.”
Han Li admitted directly. Once Lu Tianxiang fell into his hands, he had no intention of releasing her.
He would neither kill her nor give her the chance to kill herself, otherwise, what was the point of him going through all this effort to rescue her? Lu Tianxiang was his intended consort, whether or not she agreed, Han Li had already consented.
Times had changed. In the past, when his cultivation level was not high, even if he desired greatly, capturing Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi he did not dare to take them as concubines and could only let them go.
If Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi fell into his hands now, there would be no returning for them.
Now, his combat ability was comparable to that of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and he was about to truly enter this domain, with his combat ability expected to rise dramatically. He wasn’t worried about Canghai Sect causing trouble, nor did the Yinyang Sect dare to come to Yuanzhou to find him.
Although he did not capture Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, he caught someone whose cultivation level was much higher than theirs, the ageless Lu Tianxiang.
The ageless Lu Tianxiang’s beauty was not inferior to the other two ladies, and her figure and temperament each had their own merits, possibly even higher in talent.
Han Li knew that there were Mysterious Forces behind the ageless Lu Tianxiang, and capturing her could lead to trouble, but Han Li would not consider releasing her.
The Rebirth Pill was of utmost importance; the ageless Lu Tianxiang was suspected of knowing about it, and releasing her would only bring endless trouble.
Besides, Han Li had previously ambushed her, causing her severe injuries and leading her to this desperate situation. Lu Tianxiang probably hated him to death by now.
Only by making the ageless Lu Tianxiang his consort first, then gradually influencing her, can he resolve this problem. It’s not impossible to “board the bus first and buy the ticket later,” there is precedent for this, after all.
In less than a year’s time, the ageless Lu Tianxiang could bear him offspring, most likely to be of Fourth Grade talent or above, and his cultivation and strength would skyrocket.
It’s quite strange that in the Cultivation Realm, the higher one’s cultivation, the harder it is to produce offspring; this is an iron law. Yet, it doesn’t seem to apply to him. Could it be that his cultivation is not yet high enough? Or is it because of the System?
Han Li thought it was most likely the latter.
When push came to shove, if he could no longer hedge, then he might as well be decisive and ruthless.
He was hedging, but not weak.
Strength was his greatest confidence, the foundation for his bold actions.
With the ageless Lu Tianxiang missing for a year, the forces behind her shouldn’t be pursuing the matter. Haven’t you seen that no one came to rescue her today?
As long as he gets through this period and receives the reward, with a significant increase in his strength, he’ll be even more confident.
While Han Li was lost in his thoughts, Lu Tianxiang had already forced herself to calm down. She felt there might be some misunderstanding between them which, if resolved, could possibly let her escape.
She firmly believed that she didn’t know this person and had no enmity with him.
“Who are you, really? Why did you ambush me? And why did you rescue me?” Lu Tianxiang asked in a heavy tone.
Now she no longer referred to herself as the Sect Hierarch, as she wanted to ease the tension between them as much as possible.
Han Li spoke indifferently, ‘You’ll find out in due time.”
Lu Tianxiang was frustrated beyond measure. If you don’t answer my questions, how can I resolve the misunderstanding between us?
Taking a deep breath to compose herself, Lu Tianxiang continued, “Then why did you capture me? What do you want?”
“To aid me in my pursuit of longevity,” Han Li considered for a moment before replying in a roundabout manner..

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 113 The Ancestor is Getting Married 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 114 - 113 The Ancestor is Getting Married 1
Chapter 114: Chapter 113 The Ancestor is Getting Married 1
Translator: 549690339
“Help you achieve immortality?” Lu Tianxiang was astonished, finding the reason preposterous.
She didn’t have the ability to help others achieve immortality, she hadn’t even attained eternal life herself; how could she help others?
Han Li nodded solemnly.
Lu Tianxiang examined him closely and noticed that Han Li’s expression didn’t seem feigned, which puzzled her even more. She asked cautiously, “How would you have me help you achieve immortality?”
“Very simple.” A smile appeared on Han Li’s face as he sincerely said, “Marry me and enter my household.”
Han Li’s sincerity came from the heart. Wu Sheng’s mother had good aptitude, a beautiful face, a fine figure, high cultivation level; she was one of his top choices for taking a wife or concubine.
If Wu Sheng’s mother were willing, then Han Li would not need to guard against her. They could live together harmoniously and she could bear him a few children.
If Wu Sheng’s mother were unwilling, Han Li would have to force her. After all, he had to achieve his goal, and for this, he could resort to any means necessary, even if he had to crash head-first and bleed for it.
He wasn’t a good person, and neither was Wu Sheng’s mother. Han Li found they were quite well matched.
Lu Tianxiang’s eyes grew colder, and she stared at Han Li, uttering each word distinctly, “Are you serious? You really want to use me as a cauldron for collection and supplementation?”
He wanted to use her to enhance his cultivation and also expected her to willingly serve as his cauldron, to be played with continuously.
To use a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster as a cauldron for collection and supplementation could, if managed well, provide continuous benefits, given that a Great Grandmaster recovered quickly.
It was possible to hope to advance to the True Martial Realm and achieve immortality through this process, which of course required skillful use of the Collection and Supplement Method and good maintenance of the cauldron, allowing it to recover its cultivation periodically.
After mulling it over, Lu Tianxiang felt she understood his intentions; his heart was truly malicious, utterly sinister.
Han Li shook his head and said indifferently, “You’ve misunderstood; I’m not that kind of person.”
“As Han, I was able to cultivate to my current realm because first, I have good aptitude, second, I’ve diligently cultivated without interruption, and third, I possess uncommon wisdom. I have never resorted to taking advantage of others. ”
Watching Han Li, who spoke with such righteous indignation, Lu Tianxiang wasn’t entirely convinced, but she felt slightly relieved. Since he had said as much, he at least wouldn’t openly take advantage of her.
She’d rather die than become someone’s cauldron for collection and supplementation; such a fate was worse than death.
“Wait a minute!” Suddenly, Lu Tianxiang thought of something and her pupils contracted sharply.
Lu Tianxiang fixed her gaze on Han Li with a complex tone and asked, “Your surname is Han?”
She had just heard him refer to himself as ‘Han someone’, and he had kept saying that she was the one who had troubled him first. Lu Tianxiang thought she might know why he had ambushed her.
Tonight, she had set out to capture a cultivator named Han Li and obtain the Rebirth Pill formula from him.
If this man was indeed Han Li, then everything made sense.
She was out to capture Han Li, which indeed counted as instigating trouble first. Han Li, with his powerful spiritual sense, had detected her presence first and then came to intercept and severely injure her.
She even guessed why Han Li eventually came to rescue her; he probably feared that she would reveal that he had the Rebirth Pill formula, which would draw the attention of the Daqian Empire.
But she still had one doubt in her mind. If this doubt was resolved, then everything would be completely clear.
This man was a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster, whereas Han Li was merely a newly advanced Gangyuan Realm Great Master. They were many realms apart; could they really be the same person?
If they were indeed the same person, then Han Li was terrifyingly cunning for a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster disguised as a Pihai Realm cultivator, hiding in minor Lingjun City, and yet frequently taking concubines to tarnish his own reputation.
Either Han Li truly was indifferent to fame and fortune and tired of the Cultivation Realm, or his schemes were grand.
There was another possibility; this ‘Han someone’ might not be the same person as Han Li, but could be his father, his elder, his ancestor…
Was this man really Han Li?
Lu Tianxiang stared intensely at Han Li, eager to know the answer.
Han Li’s eyebrows lifted slightly, and he said with a chuckle, “So you’ve finally realized who I am?”
He had planned to tell Wu Sheng’s mother later, but since she had guessed, Han Li didn’t intend to deny it. Now she was completely within his grasp.
“Impossible!”
Lu Tianxiang’s pupils narrowed, her tone resolute. Her gaze remained fixed on Han Li’s face, as she sought further confirmation of her conjecture.
“Stop pretending. Your little tricks don’t work on me. I can tell you now that you haven’t guessed wrong,” said Han Li lightly.
Lu Tianxiang had guessed his true identity but couldn’t believe it due to the vast gap in their cultivation. She also suspected Han Li of harboring grand ambitions, all of which he saw through with a glance.
After all, it wasn’t his first time experiencing this.
Now Han Li decided to give Lu Tianxiang a jolt to make her submit meekly, to give up any thoughts of resistance or escape.
“To tell you the truth, the only reason I stay in Lingjun City is that I don’t want to get involved in the turbulent affairs of the Cultivation Realm; I just want to live a normal life, take some wives and concubines, and if I can achieve immortality, all the better,” he confessed.
“I’m not ambitious; I never seek out enemies and hope the world is free of
them.”
“Leizhou, Qingzhou, Huozhou are about to descend into chaos; I just want to take my family to a peaceful place. I had no intention of provoking anyone.
Why then do you insist on provoking me?”
Lu Tianxiang’s face was covered in cold laughter, her expression clearly saying, “As if I’d believe you.”
You, a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster, skulk in a little county town, previously disguised as a Pihai Realm cultivator. Shamelessly so.
Even she, a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster, was capsized in Han Li’s murky waters; over the years, he must have secretly ended countless lives..

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 113 The Ancestor is Going to Get Married 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 115 - 113 The Ancestor is Going to Get Married 2
Chapter 115: Chapter 113 The Ancestor is Going to Get Married 2
Translator: 549690339
Take some concubines? Heading towards a hundred already, how long has it been, won’t there be thousands in the future?
Why do you assassinate me if you’re not trying to make enemies? If even a hint of your energy was exposed, I wouldn’t even think of capturing you!
To hope for a world without enemies, isn’t that lacking ambition? This ambition is overwhelming; without unbeatable strength, one wouldn’t dare to say such words.
If you don’t want to provoke others, then reveal your cultivation level. If you show that you’re in the Gangyuan Realm, who would think you’re easy to bully, and who wouldn’t take a few hits when convenient?
. Lu Tianxiang mentally ranted, but she didn’t voice these thoughts. She didn’t want to argue with this person now; she needed to figure out a way to escape.
According to Han Li’s reasoning, he didn’t want to cause trouble, and capturing her would be big trouble, so Lu Tianxiang felt that there was still a chance to save herself.
“Han Li, Elder Han, you don’t want any trouble, so how about you let me go?”
“Although it was I who troubled you first, I have already fallen to this state, and you’ve had your revenge. If you release me, I assure you I will never trouble you again, nor will I speak a single word against you.”
Lu Tianxiang chose her words carefully, her tone much softer. She even felt like she was demeaning herself, which didn’t match her image of being sanctimonious.
She dared not mention the Rebirth Pill; even though both were well aware, mentioning it made the situation of a different nature.
Han Li’s face showed a gentle smile, as if he was about to let bygones be bygones, which made Lu Tianxiang’s heart flutter with hope.
“Impossible. ”
The next instant, three icy words brutally struck Lu Tianxiang’s heart, leaving her shaken.
Han Li was so resolute. It seemed he had truly made up his mind. However, Lu Tianxiang still wanted to try one last time, so she said:
“You should know, the power behind me is very strong, even stronger than the Daqian Empire. A Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm holds great weight. If you don’t let me go, are you not afraid of being suppressed by the Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm?”
Han Li shrugged, unconcernedly saying, “It doesn’t matter. I’ll just leave.”
Lu Tianxiang was speechless, staring at Han Li. Although they hadn’t known each other for long, she had figured out his character. She stopped speaking, planning to look for an opportunity to seek death.
Han Li’s gaze wandered over Lu Tianxiang’s delicate face. His powerful Divine Spirit captured some of her thoughts and decided to further break her down, so he said with a cold laugh:
“Whether the power behind you is stronger than Da Qian, I do not know, but what I do know is that you have been abandoned. Otherwise, why would no one come to rescue you after such a long time on the run this evening?
“Don’t say they couldn’t make it in time. If you were really important, someone of the True Martial Realm would have intervened to save you.”
“To be frank, you’re just an insignificant character. Otherwise, why would they send you to Da Qian to stir up trouble? That’s a suicidal mission.”
“You should know, had it not been for my rescue, you would have been long dead. So now, your life is mine. You also know that without my permission, you can’t even commit suicide.”
With every sentence Han Li spoke, Lu Tianxiang turned paler, and by the time he finished speaking, her expression had become extremely unsightly.
Lu Tianxiang pursed her lips tightly, not uttering a word, yet her trembling body revealed her intense agitation.
In a desperate situation, she had come to realize all this. After being saved, she had deliberately chosen to forget, but now Han Li tore open her wounds anew.
No matter what, she was a Grandmaster who had done many things wholeheartedly for the Sect and never thought of betrayal until death, yet this was how the Sect treated her.
She wanted to end her life, but her cultivation was sealed, and it was impossible to commit suicide under the watch of a Grandmaster.
When the tension in No-Life Mother had calmed slightly, Han Li asked, “What is the famed No-Life Mother’s esteemed name?”
Lu Tianxiang fell silent, somewhat unwillingly, but eventually spoke, “Lu
Tianxiang.”
“Lu Tianxiang, a name as lovely as the fragrance of the heavens, such a beautiful name!”
“Lu is a beautiful jade, whose magnificence eclipses the towering clouds; wearing the moon-bright treasured Lu as adornment.”
“Tianxiang signifies fragrance, sending scents beneath the osmanthus hall, with celestial music entering the reed pipes.”
Han Li couldn’t stop praising her, feeling that her name was exceptionally well-chosen, and that the person who named Lu Tianxiang had superb taste.
Lu Tianxiang slightly raised her head, a hint of an unusual color flashing in her eyes, but she didn’t speak.
“Very well, let’s continue our earlier discussion.”
“Lu Tianxiang, may I ask you, are you willing to help me achieve eternal life?”
Han Li didn’t wait for her answer before he continued, “I cannot let you go. If you’re unwilling, then I’ll have no choice but to use force. You have no room to resist. ”
“Whether you choose to enjoy this actively or passively is up to you.”
After thinking it over, Han Li decided to entice her further and said, “If you genuinely marry me, I will give you the status of a wife, and within a hundred years, I will help you break through to the True Martial Realm. If I fail, you will be free.”
Lu Tianxiang looked at Han Li in shock, unsure of where his confidence came from to make such a claim, as he himself was still in the Myriad Phenomena Realm and yet he boldly promised to help her reach the True Martial Realm within a century.
Lu Tianxiang was conflicted, tormented by the events of the night. After a long inner struggle, she hesitantly asked in a low voice,
“Are you truly just taking a wife simply, not intending to use me as a Cauldron for cultivation
