Having fallen into Han Li’s hands, unable to escape, and with her Sect having forsaken her, she couldn’t even choose death. On top of that, Han Li painted her a grand picture, offering her a zlimmer of hope to break through to the True Martial Realm—or at the very least regain her freedom after a century.
As long as she wasn’t used as a Cauldron and was treated with the dignity of a wife, not being played with at whim, Lu Tianxiang thought she could accept this.
She knew that if she didn’t accept, she would still not escape the Devil’s Palm, and her situation would be incredibly bleak. So, she chose to gamble.
If she won the bet, she would either ascend to the True Martial Realm or regain her freedom in the future. If she lost, her fate wouldn’t be worse than her present circumstances.
Han Li gazed into Lu Tianxiang’s beautiful eyes, locking eyes with her, and earnestly said, “I truly just want to take you as my wife.”
Having received the answer she wanted, Lu Tianxiang pursed her crimson lips and whispered almost inaudibly, “Give me some time.”
Han Li was overjoyed. Although Lu Tianxiang’s voice was very soft, his senses were so heightened that he heard her clearly.
Lu Tianxiang had finally agreed.
Between a mere childbearing tool and a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm who could both bear children and be an aide, Han Li chose the latter.
That’s why he took so much effort to persuade Lu Tianxiang.
The Han Family’s current foundation was insufficient, with only him as their combat power in the Myriad Phenomena Realm. With Lu Tianxiang’s inclusion, the Han Family’s strength would dramatically increase, greatly enhancing their capacity to handle risks.
Han Li appraised Lu Tianxiang with a heated gaze and said slowly, “We should rest now.”
As he spoke, he moved closer to Lu Tianxiang, about to make a move, when Lu
Tianxiang hurriedly said, “Not now; at least wait until after our marriage ceremony.”
She had just made up her mind and didn’t want to lose her chastity so soon, especially since she had taken so many blows this evening. The cultivator she used to regard with indifference had now gained control over her, and she had no choice but to submit.
Han Li leaned close to her delicate body, his arms wrapped around her slender waist, his large hand resting on her flat belly, he kissed her face, then whispered in her ear,
“Don’t worry, I’ll just hold you to sleep. I won’t do anything inappropriate.”
Feeling the warm breath in her ear, the masculine scent assailing her senses, and the warm body behind her, Lu Tianxiang’s heart was in turmoil.
Han Li had withdrawn his imposing aura, and Lu Tianxiang could move, but she dared not make any sudden movements, fearing she might trigger Han Li’s animalistic instincts.
Lu Tianxiang was well aware of her allure and the strong attraction she held for the opposite sex; she often admired her perfect body herself..

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 114 Are You Not Messing Around? 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 116 - 114 Are You Not Messing Around? 1
Chapter 116: Chapter 114 Are You Not Messing Around? 1
Translator: 549690339
Dawn was breaking.
News spread throughout the Daqian Empire, reaching even the surrounding Da Jing Empire, the Yinyang Sect, and the Kurong Sect.
Last night there had been a series of Great Grandmaster battles within the Daqian Empire, and the outcome was unexpected, astonishing all the bystanders.
A mysterious Great Grandmaster appeared, suspected to be in the later stages of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, who first assassinated the Mother of No Birth, then ambushed two of Daqian’s own Great Grandmasters. What was his purpose?
The timing was sensitive, with the recent battle in Jizhou that had left four Great Grandmasters dead; and soon, Leizhou and the three Sanzhou would have an unparalleled opportunity emerge.
Could this unknown Great Grandmaster be vying for that opportunity? Was he intentionally causing trouble to muddy the waters and fish in troubled streams?
Was the mysterious Great Grandmaster a Loose Cultivator or a pawn sent by a major power?
Opinions were divided.
Those with a broader vision felt it was a prelude to the entry of top forces, with the mysterious Great Grandmaster simply acting as a scout.
Those with a narrower view believed it wasn’t so complex; perhaps the mysterious Great Grandmaster simply had a vendetta against the Mother of No Birth and was determined to kill her himself.
Only a few had a vague intuition about the identity of the mysterious Great Grandmaster, but they dared not believe it, for the difference in strength was too great.
In Hanzhou, Fengbo Pavilion.
The blue-robed envoy sat alone in the courtyard, holding a wine jug in one hand and continuously pouring wine into his mouth.
“Tianxiang, your uncle has wronged you,” he mumbled.
“It’s all my fault, I’m incompetent. I couldn’t protect you and I didn’t even dare to go rescue you.”
“Ah- If you died in Leizhou, how could I face your parents in a thousand years?”
Lu Wenyuan’s expression was gloomy as he whispered to himself, wary that his words might be overheard by that certain True Martial Realm person.
Years ago, Lu Tianxiang’s parents had entrusted her to him. He raised her, supported her cultivation to her current realm. Having no children, he treated Lu Tianxiang as his own daughter.
He loathed his lack of strength, thinking that if only he were of the True Martial Realm, why would he need to consider others, and who would dare harm Lu Tianxiang?
If he were of the True Martial Realm, the one in the Fengbo Pavilion wouldn’t be able to suppress him, but he wasn’t.
He had thought about risking everything to rescue Lu Tianxiang, but in the end, he did not act. The appearance of a Great Grandmaster at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm would have drastically escalated the situation and thrown the Sect’s grand plans into chaos.
Even if the person from Fengbo Pavilion didn’t kill him, Prince Wu’an would have.
Faced with the choice between Lu Tianxiang’s life and his own, Lu Wenyuan ultimately chose the latter, a decision that left him with an uneasy conscience.
Just then, a voice sounded near Lu Wenyuan’s ear. He paused, respectfully uttered “Yes,” and immediately headed towards the Fengbo Pavilion.
On the thirty-sixth floor, Lu Wenyuan saw the old man once more.
This elder was dressed in coarse linen, appearing just like an ordinary old man, playing a flute at his lips.
“Master,” Lu Wenyuan bowed.
The linen-clad elder continued playing the flute for a while before stopping, speaking casually, “Wenyuan, do you hold any resentment in your heart?”
“I dare not,” Lu Wenyuan hastily said.
Not daring to, rather than not having any.
The linen-clad elder wasn’t blind to his thoughts, didn’t mind it, and with a faint smile he said, “Little Tianxiang was rescued by someone, her fate unknown. Once she appears, have her come back; I have important matters to discuss with her.”
“Yes.”
Lu Wenyuan went downstairs, relieved. Although Lu Tianxiang’s fate after being rescued was uncertain, it was still better than being confirmed dead.
Lu Wenyuan then checked the intelligence, learning the full situation. His brow furrowed tightly and he sighed to himself; all he could do was hope that Tianxiang was still alive.
At the Yinyang Sect in Black Tortoise City,
An Elder sipped Spiritual Tea, recalling the events of the previous night, and remarked, “The youngsters these days are really full of vigor, commendable courage indeed.”
The Fourth Elder arrived and sat opposite him, a smile on his face, “Last night Prince Wu’an lost quite some face, didn’t he?”
“Hahaha-” theThird Elder laughed heartily, clearly delighted.
The Mother of No Birth had stirred up trouble again. Chu Hao sent two Great Grandmasters to hunt down the grievously injured Mother of No Birth, cornering her. Unexpectedly, the mysterious Great Grandmaster made a sneak attack and rescued her.
The Mother of No Birth remained unslain, while the two hunters were seriously injured. The Third Elder felt as though he could see Prince Wu’an’s darkened face.
If it were not for the mysterious Great Grandmaster previously inflicting serious injuries on the Mother of No Birth, leading to her pitiful chase, the Third Elder might have thought the two were accomplices.
After their amusement, the Third and Fourth Elders began to discuss who exactly was this mysterious Great Grandmaster, appearing at this critical time and causing trouble, and what reasons were behind it all.
Could it be that some other top force was about to enter the fray?
Elsewhere, Yun Miaoyi was cultivating within the mountain gates of the Yinyang Sect.
Ever since escaping from Demon Hand Han Li, her cultivation had become even more driven. She frequently ventured out to explore various relics and secret territories.
This had led to rapid advancement in her cultivation. Just a month earlier, she had reached the seventh level of the God Refining Realm. Her strength had surged, and she felt that in a few more years, after reaching the Master of the Void, she could rid herself of Han Li’s influence.
Then, she would head to Leizhou, capture Han Li, and properly deal with him. The audacity he had shown towards her was simply too… hateful!
She still blushed and felt utterly ashamed whenever she thought back on it.
But that day, a piece of news reached Yun Miaoyi’s ears, causing her to freeze, feeling a gloom over her future. “How is that possible?”
“It can’t be him!”
“He’s just a God Refining Realm cultivator!”
Yun Miaoyi murmured to herself, her expression vacant as if struck by a tremendous blow.
She had just learned the details of the battle in Leizhou, and she was struck by the account of the mysterious Great Grandmaster..

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 114 This Is Not Messing Around? 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 117 - 114 This Is Not Messing Around? 2
Chapter 117: Chapter 114 This Is Not Messing Around? 2
Translator: 549690339
The intelligence described: The origins of this person are unknown, as is their age. They specialize in a very rigid and masculine style of palm technique and have cultivated a formidable protective body cultivation technique. When they mobilize their power, their entire body turns to gold, indestructible, with a protective aura that can rebound damage.
They once severely injured the Mother of No Birth and stealthily attacked Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, heavily wounding two Great Grandmasters with four palm strikes. Their spiritual sense is powerful, and their speed is extremely fast, suspected to be a late-stage Great Grandmaster of the Myriad
Phenomena Realm.
The intelligence calls this mysterious Great Grandmaster’s palm technique and protective body cultivation technique unrecorded, as no cultivator has been seen using them before. But Yun Miaoyi thought to herself, “You may not know, but I do.”
This mysterious Great Grandmaster’s protective body cultivation technique is simply identical to Han Li’s. A large reason why she and Jiang Baiye were captured was their inability to break through Han Li’s protective body cultivation technique.
“This person must be Han Li’s master, right?” Yun Miaoyi thought to herself, not quite believing her own speculation.
Deep down, she had a nagging feeling that Han Li was this mysterious Great Grandmaster. Even though there was a vast difference in their levels of cultivation, her sixth sense was telling her so.
Thinking about how that straggler Han Li, a cultivator at the God Refining Realm, was hiding in a small county town, it wouldn’t be impossible for him to suddenly make incredible progress if he found some opportunity.
Yun Miaoyi really wanted to expose Han Li, but she dared not. One reason was because of her previous oath, and the other was the worry that Han Li would come looking for trouble.
Now Han Li was a Great Grandmaster, and she was still in the God Refining Realm. The difference in strength was like heaven and earth. If she exposed herself, and Han Li came for retribution at the Yinyang Sect, she would be in a dire situation, as she couldn’t stay behind sect doors forever.
On the surface, she and Han Li had settled their grudges, and although Han Li had become more powerful, he hadn’t sought her out for trouble. Yun Miaoyi felt she shouldn’t willingly walk into a problematic situation.
“Sigh-” Yun Miaoyi sighed. She feared she would never be able to escape the shadow of Old Devil Han in this lifetime.
Qingzhou, Canghai Sect.
Jiang Baiye also received the same intelligence as Yun Miaoyi, and even his thoughts were similar to hers. He too suspected that the mysterious Great Grandmaster was Han Li.
“Sigh-”
Jiang Baiye also sighed, almost in sync with Yun Miaoyi.
If it really was Han Li, could the Body-Cultivating Furnace still be retrieved? Jiang Baiye felt it was doubtful.
Now the Sect was facing a major crisis, with several larger sects eyeing them hungrily, looking for an opportunity to obliterate the Canghai Sect.
The other major factions in Qingzhou had secretly formed an alliance, supported by Ji Feng Hall in the background. The Canghai Sect wanted to strike first, but the Daqian Empire intervened, citing special circumstances and forbidding infighting.
The Daqian Empire was clearly favoring the other factions, leaving the Canghai Sect surrounded by enemies. Otherwise, with the combined force of the factions aligned against them, it wouldn’t be a match for the Canghai Sect. If the Sect Leader took action, he could easily determine the outcome of the battle.
The upper echelons of the Canghai Sect knew why the Daqian Empire was acting this way; it was nothing more than using external pressure from Ji Feng Hall and others to force the Canghai Sect onto the Daqian Empire’s ship.
As long as the Canghai Sect fully sided with the Daqian Empire, Daqian could help them smooth things over with the other sects, then assist the Canghai Sect in suppressing the other sects, leveraging one force against another, thereby bringing the major factions under its control.
“Perhaps I should go find Han Li and see if I can get the Body-Cultivating Furnace back earlier?” Jiang Baiye mulled over this thought in his mind.
Everything started because of the Body-Cultivating Furnace. If it was returned, the other sects would likely stop their advances, and Daqian would no longer have an excuse to apply pressure.
But how could the Body-Cultivating Furnace be retrieved?
Han Li is suspected to be a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, so she absolutely could not take action against him, and now it is too late to tell the Sect Master the truth.
“It seems this is the only option…” Jiang Baiye pursed her red lips, her silver hair fluttering, her elegant hair resembling a misty cloud, as she silently made up her mind.
Tianxuan Mountain,
Ever since watching the battle last night, Gongsun Yun had a sleepless night, continuously pondering one question.
Was that mysterious Great Grandmaster really Han Li or not.
The person did not use the martial techniques of Tianxuan Mountain, nor was there any carelessness in the operation of their cultivation technique, but Gongsun Yun still discovered something amiss, suspecting that the person’s cultivation technique was the strongest in Tianxuan Mountain—the Tianxuan Scripture.
As the Sect Leader of Tianxuan Mountain, he was extremely familiar with his own sect’s cultivation techniques, and no matter how much the person tried to conceal it, it was futile.
The last time Han Li returned to the mountain to bid him farewell, Gongsun Yun had found himself unable to see through Han Li’s cultivation level and suspected that he had reached the Hollow Void Stage.
Now, he felt he had been too conservative in his estimation. Han Li might have cultivated to the Myriad Phenomena Realm and become a Great Grandmaster.
Gongsun Yun thought he was quite adept at hiding his own powers, having ascended to the Myriad Phenomena Realm thirty years ago, revealing only the cultivation level of the Hollow Void Stage to the outside world, with no one aware of the truth. Yet, he didn’t expect this closed-door disciple to be even better at concealing.
A high and mighty Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and yet he constantly disguised himself as a cultivator of the Pihai Realm or the Gangyuan Realm—it was truly shameless.
Huozhou City, Royal Manor.
Prince Wu’an’s face was grim as he stared at Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, really wanting to slap both to death—useless men who did more harm than good in their undertakings.
Wasn’t it better to kill the Mother of No Life right away? But they had to think about capturing her alive, leading to unexpected troubles, causing him embarrassment.
After calming down, Prince Wu’an also began speculating about the origins of the mysterious Great Grandmaster.
It’s very difficult to achieve the Myriad Phenomena Realm. It didn’t make sense for a Great Grandmaster in the late stage of the Myriad Phenomena Realm to suddenly appear. This person likely came from outside the Xuan Domain and might have the backing of a formidable power.
The thought of another top-level power entering the fray made Prince Wu’an somewhat restless. The situation was already unfavorable for the Daqian Empire; the introduction of another top-level power might turn the Qian Dynasty’s planning into nothing.
Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong were on tenterhooks, having repeatedly failed to perform effectively. They were genuinely worried that Prince Wu’an might take harsh measures; their identities as cultivators in the Myriad Phenomena Realm seemed to hold little sway in his eyes.
Fortunately, Prince Wu’an did not lay hands on them but merely said indifferently, “I can overlook your faults for now, but if you perform poorly again, I will slap you to death with one blow.”
It was a critical time to need people, and he had been eagerly waiting for an opportunity to emerge; the two Great Grandmasters still had some usefulness.
“We will certainly redeem ourselves with our contributions,” said Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong respectfully, and then they withdrew.
Prince Wu’an turned to look at Master Lan, who immediately spoke, “Prince, I have not performed well in my duties, failing to track down that person, allowing him to disrupt Wan and Yang’s operation. Please punish me, Prince.”
Prince Wu’an waved his hand dismissively, “Enough, you can’t be blamed for this, the person is too sly.”
“It’s rare for someone to get the better of me. I hope he doesn’t show up again; otherwise, I will definitely give him a punch to remember,” the prince said.
Master Lan secretly sighed in relief. Ever since Prince Wu’an arrived in Huozhou City, he had become increasingly difficult to serve, his temper ever on the rise.
Could it be because of the region?
Huozhou, Huozhou City—are the cultivators living here all so hot- tempered?
Leizhou, Zhending Manor.
Within a carriage at the center of the migrating caravan, a shrill scream was heard, blocked by the surrounding Barrier and failing to reach the outside world.
Inside the carriage, Lu Tianxiang glared at Han Li, indignantly saying, “Han Li, didn’t you say you wouldn’t act rashly?”
“What are you doing?”
Lu Tianxiang trembled with anger; she should never have believed Han Li’s lies.

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 115 Unparalleled Beauty_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 118 - 115 Unparalleled Beauty_l
Chapter 118: Chapter 115 Unparalleled Beauty_l
Translator: 549690339
Last night, Lu Tianxiang felt extremely conflicted. With Han Li hugging her to sleep, she couldn’t resist at all.
Lu Tianxiang didn’t dare move, fearing it would provoke Han Li to take advantage of her. She didn’t sleep a wink, closing her eyes and feigning sleep. If Han Li made a move, she was prepared to struggle.
However, Lu Tianxiang hadn’t anticipated that after her cultivation was sealed, she was nearly indistinguishable from an ordinary person. After enduring numerous hardships and finally relaxing, the long night eroded her will, and she fell asleep in the latter half of the night.
In her sleep, she felt large hands moving over her body and thought she was dreaming, or perhaps she still hadn’t transitioned from the identity of the Mother of No Birth.
When she woke up in the morning, she discovered the shameful scene, screaming out loud as her whole body trembled.
She was actually sleeping in a man’s arms, and that man’s hands were restless, having made some indecent moves, which made her furious.
When had the high and mighty Mother of No Birth ever been treated like this
by a man?
Lu Tianxiang quickly realized what had happened and why she was in Han Li’s arms, yet it didn’t stop her from coldly questioning him.
Feeling the warm, fragrant softness in his embrace, Han Li held her tightly with his large hands and smilingly said, “I didn’t do anything improper, your element of purity is still intact.”
Lu Tianxiang stretched out her hand to slap Han Li’s large hands, her pretty face flushed red, and finally she managed to squeeze out two words,
“Shameless!”
So, he really had left her with this last line of defense?
Oh, her first kiss was still intact.
Suddenly, Lu Tianxiang felt a sense of relief. If she had lost her first kiss too, it would have been too terrible.
While Lu Tianxiang was contemplating, Han Li flipped her over to her shock, buried his head, and gently captured her red lips.
“Mmm-Mmm—”
Lu Tianxiang wanted to say something, but her cherry lips were completely sealed, making it impossible for her to speak.
After a long while, Han Li released her. He licked his lips, seemingly not fully satisfied, and leaned in again.
After repeating the act several times, Han Li finally let go of Lu Tianxiang.
By this time, Lu Tianxiang was on the verge of tears. This demon, Han Li, had even taken her first kiss. Now she was left with only her last line of defence.
Lu Tianxiang resolved to defend it strictly, deciding that even if she had agreed to Han Li, she would only surrender once Han Li formally married her.
But what Lu Tianxiang never expected was that her last defence wouldn’t stand long at all; it was breached that very night.
Han Li stood up, tidying up his clothes, and frowned slightly at Lu Tianxiang’s tattered garments.
He couldn’t possibly let Lu Tianxiang continue wearing that; although it was enticing, if inadvertently seen by another of the opposite sex, Han Li would still be very displeased.
Soon, Lin Yiwu arrived, bringing a set of clothes with her.
Han Li had taken Lu Tianxiang’s measurements the night before. Her appearance and figure were even better than Lin Yiwu’s, but some parts were about the same size and they were nearly the same height, so she could fit into Lin Yiwu’s dress.
“Husband-
Lin Yiwu entered the carriage, sweetly calling out and looking at Han Li with eyes full of affection.
Han Li wrapped his arm around Lin Yiwu’s slender waist, kissed her forehead, whispered a few words in her ear, and then left the carriage.
After leaving the carriage, Han Li gathered all the principal members of the Han Family and announced the journey’s start today, planning to cross the checkpoint into Qingzhou.
In due course, they would traverse vast uninhabited regions, so he instructed them to be cautious and on guard against bandits.
On the road of migration, Han Li would personally take care of any trouble from cultivators with cultivation above the Gang Yuan Realm. The Han Family still lacked individuals capable of carrying major responsibilities and needed time to grow.
The migration was a trial that would filter out the truly capable descendants, and those with both ability and qualifications would receive Han Li’s focused training.
Before long, the migrating caravan set out, stretching ten miles long, heading for the true fixed checkpoint.
Han Li did not return to his own carriage, as he decided to give Lu Tianxiang more time. Lin Yiwu would handle the situation, so Han Li went to find Lin
Yiwu, Qiu Yueyao, and other beautiful concubines. He had recently devised a
new game tnac SIX people coma Play togecner.
In the carriage, after Han Li had left, Lu Tianxiang sat up, gathered her shattered clothes, and put on an expression that said ‘keep out’.
She hadn’t yet figured out how she was going to interact with Han Li’s other concubines, mainly because this had all happened too abruptly. Just last night, she was eagerly attempting to capture Han Li, and today she had become Han Li’s betrothed.
Lin Yiwu watched Lu Tianxiang’s expression and couldn’t help but laugh, causing a slight change in Lu Tianxiang’s complexion.
“Sister Tianxiang, why keep people at arm’s length?”
“We’re going to be good sisters in the future. We should get along well.
Husband does not like to see us in conflict.”
“Plus, I can relate to Sister’s current feelings as we have some shared experiences.”
With a warm smile on her face, Lin Yiwu spoke sincerely.
Han Li had informed her of some details about Lu Tianxiang, instructing her to get along well with Lu Tianxiang and ideally become close to her.
Han Li didn’t mention that Lu Tianxiang was from the Myriad Phenomena Realm, only stating that Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation had been sealed, and she had agreed to marry him.
He wasn’t worried at all about Lu Tianxiang running away or doing anything to Lin Yiwu. Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation was sealed by him, and Lin Yiwu, being at the peak of the Pihai Realm, was more than a match for her.
Looking at the breathtaking beauty before her, Lin Yiwu inwardly admired her husband’s ability; just overnight, he had managed to bring back a new concubine.
And this Lu Tianxiang, with regards to appearance, figure, temperament, cultivation, and so on, was superior to herself and Han Li’s other concubines. Lin Yiwu was curious about their shared experiences but refrained from asking.
Lu Tianxiang calmed herself, pursed her red lips, and pondered for a moment before asking, “How should I address this younger sister?”
“My surname is Lin, given name Yiwu. Sister can call me Lin younger sister, or Yiwu; either is fine,” Lin Yiwu said softly as she sat by the carriage window.
“Then I will call you Lin younger sister,” Lu Tianxiang decided, not wishing to become too familiar with this woman at the moment.
After exchanging a few words with her, Lin Yiwu handed over the clothing, saying with a smile, “Sister Tianxiang, here are your clothes. You should change now; we can talk more later.”
Lu Tianxiang nodded, having long since grown tired of wearing these tattered garments. Her spatial bracelet contained many beautiful dresses, but with her cultivation sealed and unable to use her Spiritual Sense, she couldn’t retrieve them.
Lin Yiwu stepped outside to wait for Lu Tianxiang to change her clothes.
Rustling sounds came from within the carriage. Lu Tianxiang quickly changed into the offered dress—a purple palace skirt—which she found a bit too small, barely able to contain her stateliness.
Having adjusted her clothes, Lu Tianxiang waited a while before calling out,
“Lin younger sister, you may come in now.”
Lin Yiwu entered and, upon seeing Lu Tianxiang in the purple palace skirt, her eyes lit up.
The previously rag-clad Lu Tianxiang had been a tempting peerless beauty, eliciting pity at the sight. But now, she resembled a holy and dignified celestial maiden, aloof and pure.
Lin Yiwu herself was a rare beauty, but in that moment, she felt somewhat ashamed of her own appearance, even she was captivated by Lu Tianxiang’s looks and aura.
“My husband is indeed fortunate this time,” Lin Yiwu sighed to herself.
“Sister Tianxiang is truly beautiful,” she exclaimed in admiration.
Lu Tianxiang’s mood improved slightly, and a smile appeared on her face as she responded, “Lin younger sister is also extremely beautiful. Han Li is quite lucky to have married you; who knows what good deeds he did in past lives to deserve this.”
“Oh, by the way, you mentioned earlier that we share some common experiences. Please, do tell,” Lu Tianxiang encouraged.
Lin Yiwu immediately began talking with a smile, “At the time, I was only at the pinnacle of the Innate Realm and happened to attend a meeting of Loose Cultivators, where I met my husband.”
“My husband is truly secretive; a Gang Yuan Realm cultivator disguising as a Pihai Realm first-layer…”
The two women chatted in the carriage, finding great pleasure in their conversation. After learning about Lin Yiwu’s experiences, Lu Tianxiang felt much closer to her.
So, it wasn’t just her who had been deceived by Han Li’s concealment of his cultivation level!
In another carriage, Han Li was imparting his teachings to Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiyin, and his other beautiful concubines. With his profound cultivation, he had perfected the Five Elements Formula and other martial arts skills.
His Spiritual Sense covered vast territories at all times, paying particular attention to the carriage carrying Lin Yiwu and Lu Tianxiang. After learning about their conversation, Han Li felt at ease.
He needed Lu Tianxiang to become a capable assistant; a Great Master of the Myriad Phenomena Realm could significantly enhance the foundation of the Han Family and also provide great assistance to Han Li.
But mere promises would not suffice. He also had to resolve the knot in Lu Tianxiang’s heart, open up her defenses, and establish deeper bonds with her, such as having offspring together.
Faced with the cultivation-related questions from Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiyin, and the others, Han Li answered them with ease, dispelling their doubts effortlessly.
Before they realized how time passed, two hours of instruction had elapsed.
After this session, the women felt their understanding of the Five Elements Formula had deepened, and they noticed their cultivation had advanced substantially, likely due to the energy infusion.
At the Zhen Ding Pass, a massive migrating caravan slowly passed through. After offering certain resources, the Han Family’s group was permitted to proceed.
Many onlookers gathered, watching this scene and discussing among themselves. After some conversation, they learned the origin of this caravan.
It was from Fengyang Manor, home to the ‘wife-acquiring ancestor’, the Han Family, moving out of Leizhou. All the onlookers believed the Han Family’s prospects were grim.
While the Han Mansion might dominate Lingjun City in Fengyang Manor, Lingjun City was too minor, merely a county town. In comparison to Leizhou, not to mention the entire Daqian Empire, it was insignificant.
The patriarch of the Han Family was only in the early stages of the Gang Yuan Realm; such a level of cultivation would pose great danger even for an individual traveling between states, let alone reaching Qingzhou, especially since the patriarch was bringing along wives, offspring, and a large number of maids and guards.
This was practically an invitation to be plundered!
While no one understood why the ‘wife-acquiring ancestor’ would want to leave the comfortable life in Lingjun City for such a perilous move, every passerby doubted the Han Mansion’s ability to succeed, expecting them to perish on the road between states.
In the eyes of some Pihai Realm cultivators and even Great Gang Yuan Realm Masters, recounting their past experiences, still caused their legs to tremble with fear.
They had been the lucky few to survive the perilous inter-state crossings; originally a group of cultivators had set out together, but very few lived to tell the tale, with most meeting their end.
Watching the caravan cross the state boundary and leave Leizhou, some cultivators exchanged knowing glances, recognizing kindred spirits. They smiled complicitly and followed the caravan out of Leizhou.
The Han Family’s migration to Qingzhou was doomed to fail; they would certainly fall to bandits and be pillaged. With that in mind, these cultivators decided it was better to plunder the Han Family’s caravan themselves than to let unknown bandits benefit.
After all, the Han Family was the overlord of a county town, and its leader was a Great Gang Yuan Realm Master. They surely had some savings, which meant these raiders could get their hands on valuable cultivation resources.
And that Han patriarch had acquired many beautiful concubines, each said to be stunning and also possessing cultivation.
With dozens of beautiful concubines, the patriarch probably couldn’t attend to all of them. So, after killing Han Li, they would take on the hardship of cultivating with the concubines themselves, warming their ‘paths’.
In the midst of the migrating caravan, Han Li sneered coldly in his heart; he knew exactly what these people were plotting.
Having made their decision and acted upon it, they must now pay the price for their actions—and that price, naturally, would be their lives.
Two Great Gang Yuan Realm Masters and seven Pihai Realm cultivators—he could extinguish them all with a flick of his finger.
Han Li planned to handle them lightly this time, so as not to burst their Space Rings—otherwise, all the items within would be destroyed, and that would indeed be a loss.
Even though these cultivators were poor, altogether they had some Spirit Stones, Spiritual Artifacts, and Spirit Pills, enough to enrich the Han Family’s treasury.

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 116 Refining the Supreme Treasure 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Chapter 116 Refining the Supreme Treasure 1
Translator: 549690339
After leaving Leizhou, the migrating caravan continued along their predetermined route.
One carriage after another sped forward, and because they were equipped with shock- absorbing magical artifacts, even at the swift pace of the horses, there was not the slightest discomfort for those within the carriages.
Han Li had returned to his own carriage. Lin Yiwu had left, leaving him and Lu Tianxiang alone together.
He naturally sat beside Lu Tianxiang, wrapping his arm around her slender waist. Lu Tianxiang struggled a few times, but without success, she gave up.
Looking at Lu Tianxiang in her changed attire, Han Li’s gaze held a scorching heat. He was so tempted to take her then and there.
At this moment, Lu Tianxiang was wearing a gorgeous purple palace dress that did nothing to hide her mature and voluptuous tantalizing body. With her cheeks flushed red from being forcibly held by Han Li, she seemed quite unaccustomed to such a posture.
Like distant mountains, her delicately arched eyebrows occasionally furrowed and then relaxed. Below those brows were a pair of beautiful eyes filled with complex expressions.
Because Han Li was leaning over to look at her, his hot breath wafted onto her pretty face, stirring strange feelings in Lu Tianxiang.
“You smell so good,” he said.
Han Li noticed that Lu Tianxiang had a natural body fragrance. It was a subtle scent, with the tranquility of a virgin and the charm of maturity, truly captivating.
Lu Tianxiang pursed her thin red lips, remaining silent.
Suddenly, Lu Tianxiang’s brows slightly furrowed as she felt a devil’s palm glide over her tender skin, coming to rest on her soft and fair shoulder and showing a tendency to explore further down.
Finally, Lu Tianxiang couldn’t bear it any longer and hurriedly whispered, “Stop.”
She was panicking. Although she had some mental preparation, she was still quite flustered, as she had never experienced such advances before.
She had always been noble, mature, holy, and dignified. All the men were always respectful towards her. Who had ever dared to be so presumptuous with her?
No matter what kind of woman, when faced with the advances of a man, they always instinctively feel afraid.
Previously dismissive of such feelings, Lu Tianxiang now felt apprehensive, her heart pounding and her mind in turmoil.
She was no longer the high and mighty Mother of No Birth, nor was she the Myriad Phenomena Realm Grandmaster who suppressed billions of living beings. She was just a fragile woman whose cultivation had been sealed.
“What’s wrong?” Han Li blinked innocently, but his devil’s palm continued to caress Lu Tianxiang’s delicate body.
Lu Tianxiang paused, suppressing her discomfort, and softly said, “Let’s just keep it like this for now.”
People must bow their heads under the eaves. She had already agreed to marry Han Li as his wife, in exchange for a future breakthrough to the True Martial Realm or to regain her freedom. Only now she wasn’t yet prepared.
Seeing that Han Li wasn’t touching her sensitive areas, Lu Tianxiang breathed a sigh of relief and quickly changed the subject, “What exactly is your cultivation level?”
This was a question she had wanted to ask for a while, still somewhat fixated on Han Li’s strength.
The outside world thought Han Li was only at the early stage of the Gangyuan Realm. Lin Yiwu had told her Han Li was a God Refining Realm cultivator. But Lu Tianxiang knew that Han Li must at least be a Grandmaster Wanxiang.
Otherwise, how could Han Li have dealt her a severe injury, inflicted serious injuries on two Great Grandmasters, and rescued her?
As for what Han Li’s actual cultivation realm was, she couldn’t guess. When she first met him, she thought Han Li’s cultivation was less than hers, but later she discovered that Han Li was far stronger than she was.
The two Great Grandmasters who had been chasing her were severely injured by Han Li’s four palms. Although there was the element of surprise, it didn’t negate the fact that Han Li’s strength was formidable.
After hesitating, Han Li still told the truth, “You might not believe it, but I am just at the peak of the Hollow Void Stage.”
He decided to treat her with sincerity, gradually unlocking Lu Tianxiang’s heart, hoping she would fall in love with him, which would solve all troubles.
There was no problem with revealing his true cultivation level in front of Lu Tianxiang. His cultivation level increased rapidly. Given another year or two, he would break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and his strength would rise significantly.
Plus, Lu Tianxiang was under his control and couldn’t escape his grasp. Even if she revealed his secrets to his concubines, those concubines wouldn’t catch even a word if he didn’t wish it.
The Peak of the Hollow Void Stage?
Lu Tianxiang’s pupils contracted sharply, her first thought being disbelief. How could the Peak of the Hollow Realm possibly overpower a Grandmaster Wanxiang?
Leizhou’s top Grandmaster Lin Xiangru was only just strong enough to reach the doorstep of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, with strength among the weakest within it, unable to defeat an ordinary Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivator.
And Han Li? He had severely injured her, a Myriad Phenomena Realm first-layer Grandmaster, and two others at the third and fourth layer, respectively. Which Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivator could do that?
Prince Wu’an couldn’t do it even when he was at the peak of the Hollow Void Stage.
Her second thought was, could it be true that Han Li was just at the Peak of the Hollow Void Stage?
She stared at Han Li’s eyes, finding his words to be quite sincere with not a trace of deceit. This sent a shiver through her.
If the Peak of the Hollow Void Stage could achieve this level, then Han Li must possess a formidable trump card. Either his understanding of martial truth was very profound, or the cultivation techniques and martial arts he practiced were of very high grade, mastered to a profound degree.
She felt that it was likely the latter. Both Han Li’s body-protecting divine skill and palm technique were incredibly powerful. Either he had cultivated an Earth-Level Extreme Martial Art to a high degree of proficiency, or a Heaven Rank martial art to an elementary level.
As for full mastery, Lu Tianxiang thought that was less likely. The higher the grade of martial art, the harder it was to cultivate to completeness, requiring too much time. It would be better to spend that time on other areas, such as increasing cultivation or mastering powerful weapons.
“Are you really at the Peak of the Hollow Void Stage?” Lu Tianxiang couldn’t help asking again.
“Without a doubt,” Han Li released his aura. Without the enhancement of full-ability martial arts, his aura was that of the Peak of the Hollow Realm..

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 116 Refining the Treasure 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Chapter 116 Refining the Treasure 2
Translator: 549690339
“It’s actually true.”
Lu Tianxiang muttered to herself, somewhat dazed. She had been counterattacked by a cultivator at the peak of the Hollow Void Stage, left seriously wounded, captured, and even forced into marriage.
“There’s no need for that; think about Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, didn’t I severely injure them as well?” Han Li said with a smile.
Despite his words, he was not in the least bit arrogant. He was well aware of his own situation. His actual attack power was only at the first layer of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, perhaps even weaker than Lu Tianxiang.
His successive victories over three Great Grandmasters relied entirely on surprise attacks.
After Lu Tianxiang was ambushed by him, her strength diminished, his defensive cultivation technique was formidable and his speed fast—she was no match for him.
Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong were already not at their peak condition and were engaged in battle with Lu Tianxiang, slightly lowering their guard, which allowed him to take advantage of a surprise attack.
Though his offensive power was akin to the first layer of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, his abilities in other aspects were far beyond just the first level of that realm.
His spiritual sense was comparable to the late-stage of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, his speed matched the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and his defense was on par with the later stages of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. In terms of overall strength, he was indeed stronger than the three Great Grandmasters.
Regaining her focus, Lu Tianxiang looked at Han Li with complex emotions and said faintly, ‘Why reveal your true cultivation level to me?”
She was aware that Han Li was a very cautious man, adept at concealing his abilities. Yet now, he had disclosed his real power, wasn’t he afraid that she might leak this information?
“You are my wife,” Han Li stated succinctly with just five words.
“Heh, not yet,” Lu Tianxiang snorted coldly, her heart whispering to herself, “Wife, huh?”
While Han Li’s actions and words did affect her to some extent, it was only a slight disturbance. After all, she was no young girl, and who’s to say Han Li wasn’t just putting on a show?
Suddenly, Han Li’s brow furrowed a little, and he withdrew the hand that had been wandering over her delicate body, saying indifferently, “I’ll be right back.”
As soon as his words fell, without waiting for Lu Tianxiang to respond, Han Li vanished.
The Han Family’s moving convoy had just entered Qingzhou by a little more than two hundred miles when the cultivators with malicious intentions could no longer restrain themselves and began to accelerate towards the Han Family’s convoy.
Han Li wouldn’t allow them to disturb the Han Family’s relocation. He appeared above the nine cultivators in a flash, then snapped his fingers.
Nine invisible sword energies came into existence out of thin air, imbued with an intent to slaughter all beings, cut through space, and directly pierced the foreheads of the nine cultivators, leaving a hole between their brows.
In an instant, all nine cultivators met their demise.
Their divine spirits and bodies extinguished at that moment, dying very peacefully, never knowing the whereabouts of their enemy.
With a flick of his fingers, several sword energies completely destroyed their corpses, and the traces of the battlefield were erased by the sword energies.
With a single thought, nine space rings landed in his hands. Han Li merely glanced at them before casually putting them away.
“Just as expected, dirt poor!”
Two from the Gangyuan Realm, seven from the Pihai Realm—the total of spirit stones, spirit pills, spiritual artifacts, spirit talismans, and so on, inside their space rings didn’t even amount to two hundred thousand spirit stones.
After a moment of complaining to himself, Han Li stepped forward, returning to the carriage in what was barely the time it takes for two breaths.
Crushing a few minor cultivators without a second thought, Han Li didn’t care in the slightest. If they dared harbor ill intentions towards him and had no value, then death was the right outcome for them.
As Lu Tianxiang pondered about what Han Li might be up to, she was taken aback when, after hardly more than a couple of breaths, Han Li returned, appeared beside her, and effortlessly wrapped his arm around her slender waist.
“Huff-” Lu Tianxiang’s breathing quickened. She instantly forgot what she was thinking about and focused on how to make Han Li behave.
Clearly, she hadn’t come up with any countermeasures, and was being wantonly taken advantage of by Han Li, causing her pretty face to be covered with a blush.
As sunrise and sunset came and went, night fell once again. The Han Mansion’s moving caravan had long left the desolate border area between the two states and was now encamped on a plain.
Along the way, Han Li had taken action several times, killing some clueless cultivators of the Gangyuan Realm and even one from the God Refining Realm, amassing a total of six to seven hundred thousand Spirit Stones.
This caused Han Li to feel somewhat emotional, indeed, “without unearned wealth, a man isn’t rich; without night grazing, a horse isn’t fat”.
The Han Family sold so many Spirit Pills and Spiritual Artifacts but didn’t earn as many Spirit Stones as he had with just a few moves.
“Murder and arson for a gold belt” truly lived up to its reputation.
With so many powerful cultivators dead, the border bandits no longer dared to provoke the Han Family’s migrating caravan, knowing that it concealed a highly skilled God Refining master.
Lu Tianxiang leaned against the carriage window, admiring the night sky, greatly missing the days spent by Erhai, free and authoritative, in control of everything. She deeply disliked her current fragile appearance.
The moonlight was pure and hazy, cascading down from the sky like a stream, resembling a silver river falling from the ninth heaven.
Han Li’s figure appeared silently within the carriage, his eyes flickering with a burning desire as he observed Lu Tianxiang.
Lu Tianxiang exuded a mature, noble, and demure temperament, possessing both the innocence of a young girl and the maturity of a young wife.
With her hands propping her chin as she admired the beautiful night, she was still as a virgin, not only naturally beautiful but also exuding a fresh and refined air, radiating a powerful allure all around her.
“The night is beautiful, but the beauty is even more so.”
Startled by the sudden voice, Lu Tianxiang realized Han Li was already seated beside her, not knowing when he had appeared.
Han Li’s right hand directly blocked her slender waist, pulling her over to rest in his arms.
“Don’t move.”
As Lu Tianxiang was about to react, Han Li whispered in her ear, the warm breath sending her into a slight frenzy.
Seizing the moment when Lu Tianxiang was distracted, Han Li’s left hand became restless, causing Lu Tianxiang to grow fearful, worried about what Han Li might do.
“Don’t worry, I won’t do anything rash,” Han Li said, nibbling on her earlobe. “Hmph,” Lu Tianxiang scoffed, ‘That’s what you said last night.’ “I have a secret, do you want to hear it?” Han Li breathed into her ear.
Lu Tianxiang was wary yet asked, “What secret?”
“Actually, I possess a treasure of very high grade, incredibly difficult to refine. It has consumed a great deal of my energy,” Han Li said, lost in his memories.
After obtaining that treasure, in order to refine it and claim it completely, Han Li circulated his cultivation technique, forcibly infusing massive amounts of Gang Yuan into the treasure’s interior.
At first, the treasure reacted violently, struggling fiercely, seeming unwilling to be refined by him and resisting his entry.
Even though Han Li was of high cultivation and profound in his practice, his forceful entry revealed the pathway to the treasure’s core was very narrow, as if no one had ever entered before, indicating he was its first owner.
Han Li was very patient, in no rush, gently drawing out the Gang Yuan and then pushing it back in again, planning a war of attrition to wear down the treasure’s resistance.
After hundreds of repetitions of this process, he finally refined the treasure. His Gang Yuan could effortlessly enter its interior, moving freely and smoothly.
Han Li had finally acquired his life’s first treasure, a treasure of immense power, which would provide him with significant assistance..

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 117: Various Parties Present Women –
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Chapter 117: Various Parties Present Women –
Translator: 549690339
Dawn’s light was faint.
A scream of terror rose within the carriage, breaking the silence, yet it still did not reach the outside world.
“Han Li!”
Lu Tianxiang woke up to a wave of pain in her body, her hands clenched tightly around the quilt, concealing her tempting beauty, and then she shouted angrily.
Her pretty face was covered with frost, her cultivation might have been sealed, but it seemed to also cool down the temperature inside the carriage considerably.
“Is this what you meant by not acting recklessly?” Lu Tianxiang’s icy gaze fixed on Han Li as she spat out each word.
“An accident, all an accident,” Han Li said with a sheepish smile, his eyes brimming with mirth, last night was too thrilling.
Lu Tianxiang, looking at his smiling face, wished she could slap him to death, this was just too shameless.
“You truly are shameless!” Lu Tianxiang said hatefully.
Just yesterday, she had sworn to guard her final line of defense, not letting Han Li break through her virginity, but last night, in a confused blur, she had let him succeed.
This left Lu Tianxiang seething with anger.
Although she had agreed to marry him as his wife, she hadn’t expected to lose her virginity so quickly, at least not until after an official ceremony, when she would have been mentally prepared.
Moreover, she worried that surrendering to Han Li too soon would lead him to think less of her, and that he might not keep his promises in the future.
No matter how one put it, Han Li had obtained her most precious thing, causing Lu Tianxiang’s heart to be in turmoil and her feelings for Han Li to take on a different hue.
Ignoring Lu Tianxiang’s struggles, Han Li reached out and held her in his arms, whispering gently by her ear, “Xiang Xiang, I will treat you well.”
“From now on, you are my wife. Once we migrate to Yuanzhou, I will arrange a grand wedding for you.”
“As long as Han Li lives for one more day, you will not die. This is my promise to you.”
Han Li’s words were heartfelt, he truly felt this way at the moment.
At first, he only wanted Lu Tianxiang to bear his children for rewards; later, he wanted to marry her so she could bear his children, and also gain a Myriad Phenomena Realm ally;
After last night’s warmth, his thoughts changed once again, he now also wanted to win Lu Tianxiang’s heart.
For such a breathtaking beauty as Lu Tianxiang, which man could remain unmoved?
Han Li was admittedly a man of lust, which he acknowledged, his heart stirred from the very first sight of Lu Tianxiang’s true face.
Now that Lu Tianxiang might be carrying his child, Han Li’s feelings for her deepened.
Hearing his sincere words, Lu Tianxiang’s struggle weakened considerably, and her emotions slowly stabilized. She knew it was too late for words now.
After a long silence, Lu Tianxiang finally said with a heavy tone, “Han Li, I hope you will do as you say, otherwise I will certainly find a way to kill you.” Her tone was ice-cold, seemingly expressing an unquestionable resolve.
“Don’t worry, I, Han Li, always keep my word,” Han Li stated decisively, his tone also leaving no room for doubt.
Looking closely at Han Li, Lu Tianxiang sadly said, “Can you remove the seal now?”
Han Li gave a sheepish smile and said, “That’s still not possible for the time
wen 1b.
It was a joke, Lu Tianxiang had yet to calm down. If he released the seal now, wouldn’t that turn the world upside down?
Although Han Li was confident he could suppress Lu Tianxiang again, it would definitely cause a commotion and expose his true cultivation level to outsiders, who would immediately guess that he was that mysterious Great Grandmaster.
That would be asking for trouble.
Moreover, if he beat Lu Tianxiang again, severely injuring her before subduing her, it would only make her more displeased and more resentful towards him.
“Heh, men, what’s the use of sweet-talking?” Lu Tianxiang scoffed coldly but did not press Han Li further; she knew it was useless to push.
Han Li pretended not to hear and just held her tightly in his arms, then lowered his head and gently stamped a kiss on her delicate red lips.
The migrating caravan set off again, heading towards Jizhou.
This journey took a lot of time and experienced many events, which enlightened the migrating team greatly, allowing capable descendants from Han Mansion to emerge.
With Han Li’s protection, only a few guards were lost in the entire caravan; powerful cultivators were dealt with by Han Li personally, and weaker ones were handled by the descendants of Han Mansion and guards.
The news that Han Mansion’s migrant caravan hid a deity of the God Refining Realm spread far and wide. Many cultivators speculated that the old ancestor of the Han Family was indeed that deity, so they no longer dared to cause trouble.
A deity of the God Refining Realm in Qingzhou still had considerable deterrent power. Those who understood the situation wouldn’t seek out trouble, only the young and uninformed would stir up issues, and without exception, they all died.
Upon learning that Han Mansion was migrating to the even further Yuanzhou, the powers of counties and prefectures they passed obviously sighed in relief. As long as the Han Family didn’t lay roots in their territory, they could be seen as a friendly force.
They all instructed their clan members and sect disciples not to provoke the Han Family and to let the Han Family leave Qingzhou quickly.
Three months later,
the migrating team arrived at Qingshu Manor, the fifth prefecture on the Qingzhou route.
Although the protective forces of Han Mansion had suffered some losses, the team had grown stronger.
During their passage through the previous two prefectures, some counties and even prefecture cities wanted to form good relations with the Han Mansion. After all, the old ancestor of the Han Family was a true deity of the God Refining Realm.
Besides the big states with Myriad Phenomena Realm existence, deities of the God Refining Realm already stood at the pinnacle of other big states, with only those of the Hollow Void Stage above them. However, there are very few of them, with ordinary large states having no more than ten.
So how could they ingratiate themselves with a deity of the God Refining Realm?

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 117 Offering Girls from All Sides_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Chapter 117 Offering Girls from All Sides_2
Translator: 549690339
Generally speaking, one must offer rare and precious treasures, profound cultivation techniques, pledge allegiance under a true master, or provide something that the master cherishes.
Once the various powers inquired around, they quickly understood how to curry favor with the Han Family’s old ancestor; it was all too easy.
The Han Family’s old ancestor was also known as the Ancestor of Accepting Concubines, having taken dozens of concubines. As long as one could offer a beautiful female cultivator with potential from their family or sect, the deal would be sealed.
They also found out that the Han Family’s old ancestor took great care of his marital relations’ families, providing them with many resources and attention, especially when moving away from Leizhou.
How to offer a suitable woman became the focus of discussion among the various powers.
After all, the Han Family would not stay in Qingzhou but would move to the distant Yuanzhou, so the various powers were reluctant to send those beautiful female cultivators with good potential away to be concubines.
But would Han Li accept those lower-tier, Ninth Grade beauties as offerings?
After weighing their options, each power made its own decision.
Thus, as the migration caravan passed through the first two manors, various small forces and families competed to present their daughters, and Han Li accepted them all without question.
Being just the first two manors, the various powers had offered up eighteen beautiful female cultivators, causing other powers who heard the news to remark with amazement: the Han Family’s old ancestor was still sharp, taking concubines all along the way.
In reality, among the eighteen beauties, Han Li only chose one with Eighth Grade potential, and he arranged for the rest to marry his descendants.
This move brought back many of his descendants who had been sent to the Sect; many of them were still unwed, and uniting them with these lower-tier, Ninth Grade beauties was beneficial for both parties.
Although taking more wives and concubines and producing offspring could rapidly enhance one’s cultivation, Han Li did not wish to accept too many, mainly because his standards and tastes had become much higher.
Particularly after sampling the delights of Lu Tianxiang, Han Li had even less interest in those beauties of inferior potential; they were not even qualified to be his concubines.
He already had many concubines. If he continued to marry uncontrollably, he would surely be unable to care for them all. At present, he aimed to marry only beautiful female cultivators of high potential, like Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi for instance.
Of course, Han Li was only dismissing those of lower-tier and Ninth Grade potential. He still intended to take those of Eighth or Seventh Grade potential.
The number of female cultivators with both high potential and beauty was not large, and ones like Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Lu Tianxiang were even rarer.
As his cultivation steadily improved, his standards for accepting concubines would rise too—an expectation set by himself, not by the System.
Previously he had no choice, but now he had the opportunity to choose.
Another reason was to leave some resources of beautiful women for his family’s descendants.
While Han Li nabbed rewards for proliferating his lineage, his descendants spreading their branches brought him rewards as well—besides some minor differences in potential, it was largely the same.
His talented descendants would also need to marry and take concubines as they came of age. If Han Li were to take them all for himself, his descendants would struggle to find beautiful wives of their own.
Therefore, Han Li set a benchmark for the future: concubines must now have at least Eighth Grade potential and beauty scores above eighty points, with the expectation to further increase these standards.
As a result, he saved himself effort, had more time to care for his current wives and concubines, and his descendants could find satisfactory spouses while his reward accumulation might even speed up significantly.
After all, the speed at which one person can expand a family is far slower than that of many descendants combined.
Raising the standards meant that his cultivation would advance much faster.
In just two months, seventeen of the beauties married to his descendants had become pregnant, which made Han Li even more approving of his decision.
Apart from these newly-wed women, Han Mansion was home to many pregnant ladies, mostly wives and concubines of male descendants and female descendants; a smaller part was Han Li’s own beautiful concubines.
Travelling from Fengyang Manor to Qingshu Manor had already taken half a year, during which Han Li continued to produce offspring, as did his descendants.
During the day, they migrated, and at night, they rested, without many entertainment activities to distract them—after all, this was not like staying within a city, where various forms of amusement were plentiful.
Han Li had originally thought that he would accumulate enough cultivation to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm by the time they reached Yuanzhou, but now it seemed he might achieve that within Jizhou territory.
As this batch of descendants was born one after another, the number of his offspring, as well as the number of those with exceptional talents, would reach new heights, and he would be able to earn new rewards.
One of Han Li’s newly acquired beautiful concubines was named Zheng Qiurong, with a score of around eighty-five for her looks. She had a great figure and temperament, and a beauty mark on her nose added a touch of charm.
What impressed Han Li the most was her depths which were as profound as a thousand feet of the Peach Blossom Pool, which indeed took him a long time to appreciate.
Zheng Qiurong came from a Gangyuan Realm family, the eldest daughter of the current family head, with cultivation at the Innate Realm. Initially, the head did not want to send his daughter away, but Zheng Qiurong volunteered, and the other elders agreed, leaving the head with no choice but to comply.
After learning of this, Han Li asked her the reason, to which Zheng Qiurong replied that being his concubine held better prospects. Han Li saw that she had some ulterior motives regarding the Zheng family, but he did not inquire further.
Zheng Qiurong too was now pregnant, and breeding offspring was a top priority that could not be delayed. Han Li promised to hold a wedding ceremony for her once they arrived in Yuanzhou.
Although he had taken new beautiful concubines, Han Li’s main focus was still on Lu Tianxiang, and he spent less time with Zheng Qiurong and the other concubines.
Lu Tianxiang was his wife; although not yet married, she had already given herself to him and was carrying his child.
Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation was profound, and she would become a powerful assistant for him in the future. However, Lu Tianxiang’s heart had not yet turned towards him, so Han Li needed to work harder.
Han Li believed that given time, he would eventually win Lu Tianxiang’s heart, as they now had many more ties to each other.
Han Li had been her first in many respects, and during this period, he had succeeded several more times. Plus, now that she was confirmed to be pregnant, each time he could feel Lu Tianxiang changing.
However, Lu Tianxiang still had reservations and couldn’t get over a certain barrier, appearing quite indifferent. She was most resolute verbally, but her body was honest; mainly because she was unable to resist Han Li.
Regarding Han Li’s new concubines, Lu Tianxiang scoffed but didn’t say much. She had long understood that Han Li was a man who loved beauties and had a penchant for taking concubines.
Sometimes she wondered if Han Li possessed some kind of heaven-defying Dual Cultivation Technique; otherwise, how could someone so infatuated with beauty reach the Peak of the Hollow Void Stage?
But she also knew that Han Li did not, after all, he had never used it when fighting her.
Han Li also did not use her as a Body-Cultivating Furnace for refinement. Could it be he simply lusted for her beauty and sincerely intended to marry her?
Lu Tianxiang could feel Han Li’s frequent companionship. Although she never mentioned it, she felt something different in her heart – Han Li treated her differently than his other concubines. Could it be the difference between a wife and a concubine?
Five months later, the migrating caravan of the Han Mansion reached the last manor on the Jizhou route, having traveled six hundred thousand miles across the entire Qingzhou.
News of the Han Mansion’s migration had long since spread throughout Qingzhou, but no forces came to hinder it — there was no need.
What was there to gain from offending a God Refining Realm true person?
Even various forces sent many beautiful female cultivators, knowing well that the Han Family’s ancestor would not take them as concubines, but having one of his descendants marry into their own was not a bad thing either; after all, their aim was merely to establish a goodwill connection.
Under the diligent efforts of Han Li’s descendants, these beautiful female cultivators also became pregnant, bringing Han Li much satisfaction — they were all rewards.
In Qingzhou, Canghai Sect.
Jiang Baiye finally made up her mind.
She had been thinking of retrieving the Body-Cultivating Furnace from Han Li for some time but was delayed by other matters. Knowing that the Han Family would pass through Qingzhou during their migration, she wasn’t in a rush.
But as time passed, her initially firm resolve began to waver. The Han Family’s caravan had arrived in Qingzhou and passed through Gulei Manor, yet she still had not gone to see them.
She worried that Han Li would make excessive demands, demands she could not fulfill.
Lately, she had been closely following the news about Han Li, aware that various minor powers were sending daughters to the Han Family in hopes they would become Han Li’s concubine.
Han Li had played with her ruthlessly last time, and Jiang Baiye still vividly remembered her fear. She was reluctant to present herself to him, wary of his lecherous ways.
Yet if she did not seek out Han Li, there was no way to retrieve the
Body-Cultivating Furnace, and the Sect would not be able to settle down.
After much internal struggle, Jiang Baiye finally compromised and decided first to attempt a trade with other things in exchange for the Body-Cultivating
Furnace..

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 118 Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 118 Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture_l
Translator: 549690339
Qingzhou, Gulei Manor.
A few hundred miles away from the border, the migrating caravan of the Han Family was encamped here for a rest.
All the horse-drawn carts formed circular rings, and on the outermost perimeter, Han Li had set up a Formation to guard against potential enemies.
His master Gongsun Yun had once bestowed upon him the Five Elements Life and Death Formation, which he had always set up at Han Mansion in Lingjun City. When moving out, Han Li had dismantled it directly.
The outside world had already learned of his cultivation in the God Refining Realm, so Han Li boldly deployed this Sixth Grade Formation as well, to deter those harboring ill intentions.
A Sixth Grade Formation was already capable of posing a significant threat to True Persons of the God Refining Realm; its power could double if controlled by one such cultivator.
Inside the camp, the descendants and maids of Han Mansion bustled about, organizing small entertainment events to enrich the dull life on the road.
Many of Han Li’s female descendants, and the wives and concubines of his descendants, had swollen bellies. In a few months, they would give birth to a new generation, proliferating the branches of the Han Family tree.
Han Li’s Spiritual Sense took in everything; he also noticed among the inner circle of carts that his beautiful concubines were gathering in groups, chatting happily, many of their bellies noticeably larger — the results of Han Li’s efforts.
At that moment, Han Li was in a luxurious horse-drawn cart, spending time with Lu Tianxiang, the two alone together in the carriage.
Today, Lu Tianxiang wore a sumptuous red fairy robe, which perfectly accentuated her pure and noble charisma, extremely alluring.
This was one of the dresses from Lu Tianxiang’s Spatial Bracelet. Han Li had inspected it after he captured her and found nothing particularly noteworthy inside.
Many valuable items had been consumed by Lu Tianxiang in her flight, so Han Li did not take anything from within the Spatial Bracelet. Instead, he simply took out some of her dresses and personal belongings and then put the bracelet back on her.
“Are you still looking?”
Feeling the intensity of Han Li’s gaze, Lu Tianxiang felt an unusual sensation in her heart, but she spoke coldly.
She could never fully submit, even though sometimes her body was honest; she remained defiant, never admitting to it.
Perhaps she would only truly face reality and accept Han Li if his cultivation surpassed hers.
During their months together, Lu Tianxiang had felt the emotions Han Li had for her, and as her belly gradually grew, her inner resistance slowly diminished.
No matter what, Han Li was always her lifesaver, rescuing her when she was in a desperate situation.
From what she had observed during this time, although Han Li was amorous, coveting her beauty and body, he hadn’t treated her cruelly or used her as a cauldron for cultivation.
Perhaps it wouldn’t be so bad to be Han Li’s wife?
The thought suddenly surfaced in Lu Tianxiang’s mind as her hands unconsciously caressed her enlarged belly.
Their enmity wasn’t deep; everything had started over the Rebirth Pill
Formula. If she hadn’t pursued Han Li, he wouldn’t have ambushed her.
She was relentlessly pursued by the Da Qian, with no escape to heaven nor entrance to earth, stuck in a hopeless situation, wishing for someone to rescue her — and it was Han Li who came to her aid, while her own Sect had given up on her.
Whatever Han Li’s motives were, the fact that he saved her remained, and he did not torture her or drain her for cultivation; he truly treated her as a wife.
Han Li even promised to help her break through to the True Martial Realm within a hundred years, with genuine sincerity, not seeming deceptive, and said that if he failed, he would grant her freedom.
Wasn’t her goal in obtaining the Rebirth Pill to break through to a higher realm?
The Rebirth Pill was useless to her, but offering it to her Sect would bring substantial rewards and a confidential grand opportunity, or assist her to attain it, thus advancing to the True Martial Realm.
Now that the Sect had abandoned her, it seemed her only reliance was on Han Li. If he truly had the capabilities, her breakthrough to the True Martial Realm could be feasible.
“If only Han Li weren’t so obsessed with beauty,” Lu Tianxiang sighed internally.
She felt that Han Li’s only flaw was being too licentious, taking too many concubines, and seemingly likely to take even more in the future.
If Han Li only had her, Lu Tianxiang felt she could accept it more easily.
But there were too many women around Han Li, which irked her, making only Lin Yiwu seem somewhat pleasant to her eyes; she preferred not to go out, staying inside this horse-drawn cart.
“Xianger, you’re wearing this dress for your husband to see, aren’t you?”
Han Li wore a mischievous smile on his face, his hand also not behaving, wrapping around her slender waist and getting to work.
“Slap-
Lu Tianxiang slapped his Devil’s Palm away, and Han Li was unfazed, leaving her no choice but to give up.
After all she had been through, her resistance to such things had grown strong; after all, she had already become Han Li’s woman in form.
“Xianger, are you truly of Third Grade aptitude?”
Holding Lu Tianxiang in his arms, Han Li whispered softly in her ear.
“Otherwise? I, the Sect Hierarch, am certainly not a mediocre talent like you,” Lu Tianxiang pouted, unable to resist making a biting comment.
She had seen Han Li’s information and knew that he had started with only Eighth Grade aptitude. To reach his current state, he must have encountered an extraordinary opportunity, probably enhancing his aptitude by a few grades.
But could it be higher than hers?
In Lu Tianxiang’s view, Han Li attaining Fourth Grade aptitude would already be incredible; she had never even heard of someone increasing their aptitude by four grades.
And she, Lu Tianxiang, the aloof Mother Without Life, the formidable Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm that shook the Ancient Empire, the stunningly talented Heaven’s Daughter of the Divine Province, was indeed a genuine Third Grade talent.
Third Grade aptitude held a fair chance of advancing to the True Martial
Realm, which was already at the pinnacle of the Xuan Domain. None of the
Eight Great Forces of the Mysterious Region were said to possess Divine Yuan Realm emperors, though perhaps the oldest and most powerful Ancient Empire might have some hidden..

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 118 Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 118 Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture_2
Translator: 549690339
Lu Tianxiang felt that with her talents. self-proclaiming as a breathtaking
heavenly maiden who dazzles the Divine Province was not an overstatement, right?
Could the Da Qian Empire boast even a handful of Third Grade talents like her? Perhaps only Prince Wu’an was one.
In the whole Xuan Domain, talented individuals with Third Grade aptitude were pitifully scarce—countable on the fingers of three hands, and even if there were some hidden, their total number wouldn’t exceed twenty.
“Xiangxiang, your unmatched talent makes you the foremost under the heavens, and your dazzling brilliance astonishes both the ancient and modern world.”
Han Li said with a smile, his large hand caressing her belly, feeling the little life inside.
“Heh, smooth talker.” Lu Tianxiang coldly chuckled, yet the corners of her mouth involuntarily curved into a crescent moon.
After thinking for a while, Han Li couldn’t help but ask, “Xiangxiang, with your talent, even if you made a big mistake, that sect behind you wouldn’t give up on you, right?”
A talented individual with Third Grade aptitude, if heavily supported with various resources, had a great chance of ascending to the True Martial Realm.
With the birth of an Emperor Wu, a top-notch power’s foundation could be greatly strengthened—what mysterious force would be so shortsighted?
Lu Tianxiang fell silent for a moment, then slightly shook her head, “They only knew I had Fourth Grade aptitude.”
“No wonder,” Han Li suddenly realized.
The probability of ascending to the True Martial Realm with Fourth Grade aptitude was much smaller than with Third Grade aptitude, but it was still hopeful. Yet, its significance was far less than that of Third Grade aptitude.
“It’s a good thing they didn’t know,” Han Li thought to himself, feeling relieved.
If that mysterious force knew of Lu Tianxiang’s true aptitude, they probably would have rushed to support her immediately… No, if they had known, Lu Tianxiang probably wouldn’t have been dispatched to cause trouble in Da Qian in the first place.
Without Lu Tianxiang’s arrival, how would he have had the chance to capture her, marry her, and have her bear his offspring?
Lu Tianxiang was of Third Grade aptitude, and he was of Fifth Grade; with both their cultivation levels, their first child had a good chance to be Third Grade, possibly Fourth Grade, while the likelihood of Fifth Grade or lower was actually quite small.
Whether it was an offspring of Third or Fourth Grade aptitude, both would significantly enhance his own aptitude; and since this would be the first offspring of that grade, he would receive a substantial reward, and his strength would surge.
After hesitating for a moment, Lu Tianxiang continued, “Actually, I was initially of Fourth Grade aptitude, but then I encountered a great opportunity, and my talent improved by one grade.”
Han Li’s pupils contracted, thinking of something, and he asked, “Does this have something to do with the main cultivation technique you practice?”
When Han Li inspected Lu Tianxiang’s spatial bracelet, he had discovered that technique, which piqued his interest, so he took a closer look, but ultimately he didn’t take it.
That cultivation technique was called “Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture,” which sounded very majestic, as if it was a legendary Immortal Scripture. However, Han Li found that the scripture was incomplete.
The incomplete “Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture” had only ten levels and was a lower-grade Heaven Rank cultivation technique; it could be cultivated to the True Martial Realm, suggesting how strong the complete version must be.
If the name of this technique was not arbitrarily chosen, it very well might be a true Immortal Scripture, a genuine technique for becoming an immortal.
Although he had only briefly perused some of it, Han Li was still deeply shocked. If the scripture were complete, it indeed might enable one to become an immortal. He finally understood how Lu Tianxiang managed to rapidly sweep through half of Huozhou with the White Lotus Cult.
It was a scripture that bestowed immortality through faith, with oneself as a deity, spreading one’s true name to gain the belief of all living beings.
The more people who believed in Lu Tianxiang, the faster her cultivation would rise, breaking through realms swiftly, emerging as a formidable force.
When belief was abundant, a Faith Halo would coalesce behind the practitioner’s head, from ethereal to tangible, and with each successive halo, more and more belief would be required.
For each additional Faith Halo, the practitioner’s strength would greatly increase, and with every gesture, they could receive augmentation; one could even burn through the Faith Halos for a one-time burst of formidable strength.
The Immortal Scripture recorded that the Faith Halos would continuously bolster the practitioner’s strength—a single halo by thirty percent, three halos doubling the strength, and nine halos tripling it.
It could be said to be incredibly terrifying; indeed worthy of an Immortal Scripture. Without resorting to bursting techniques, to triple one’s strength is impressive, but when burning the Faith Halos, strength could exponentially skyrocket.
Every Cultivator who practices the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture could claim supremacy within the same realm, and overcoming those of higher levels was effortless, provided that they condensed enough Faith Halos.
According to the scripture, Cultivators of the Myriad Phenomena Realm needed to condense nine Faith Halos, and upon merging them into one, they could refine the Martial True Pill and advance to the True Martial Realm.
During his fight with Lu Tianxiang, he discovered that she had invoked the Faith Halo at the back of her head to augment her strength, which was only one, showcasing her cultivation level.
“That’s right,” Lu Tianxiang admitted frankly.
When she first entered that ruin, there was a corpse inside that, despite having been dead for countless years, still emitted an immensely powerful aura that made Lu Tianxiang extremely wary.
Lu Tianxiang explored the ruin for a long time, nearly dying in the process, but ultimately she obtained the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture and some of the faith essence remnants from that corpse.
It seemed that the faith essence was specifically left for the inheritors, and a voice had echoed in her mind when she accepted the inheritance, followed by the emergence of a Secret Technique.
This secret technique could be operated to refine the remaining faith essence, enhancing the aptitude of the inheritor. The lower the aptitude, the greater the enhancement.
Without hesitation, Lu Tianxiang operated the secret technique and refined the remaining faith essence, raising her aptitude from Fourth Grade to Third Grade, nearly touching Second Grade.
This was her greatest opportunity and also her biggest secret, which Lu Tianxiang told no one and dared not reveal the slightest bit.
Both the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture and the secret technique were crucial – they were the support for her rise; she also wanted to try and see if she could further elevate her aptitude.
