But the amount of faith required was far beyond her expectations.
At first, the amount of faith essence seemed small, but Lu Tianxiang later realized it was incredibly vast; she would have to cultivate to the Divine Yuan Realm or even the Tongxuan Realm to condense that kind of faith essence, and it would also take a significant amount of time and consume countless faith.
In her eagerness to rapidly ascend to the Myriad Phenomena Realm and not die in the Daqian Empire, she was somewhat too hasty in spreading her faith and the three Faith Halos she condensed were strong on the outside but dry inside, flashy without substance.
According to the cultivation technique, three Faith Halos correspond to the third heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, yet she only had one heaven’s worth.
Only after burning the Faith Halos to rebuild did her Faith Halo start to become genuine. Even though it was only one, it was equivalent to the previous false three halos and corresponded to the first heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Now without even one Faith Halo, her combat ability plummeted, making her one of the weakest in the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Han Li did not press further, sighing deeply, he said with concern, “This cultivation technique must have pitfalls, not everyone can bear the burden of faith and incense offering.”
“Moreover, this Immortal Scripture is incomplete, lacking the subsequent techniques; practicing it may ultimately play into someone else’s strategy.” Lu Tianxiang fell silent.
She had her suspicions for some time, but as of yet, she had not seen any signs nor come up with a solution.
Giving up the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture was out of the question for her. She could only continue to practice it, hoping to become stronger and find solutions to potential problems later.
Perhaps the reason why the Immortal Scripture was incomplete was deliberate, aiming to entice inheritors to cultivate to the True Martial Realm and then search for the subsequent techniques, which could likely be a trap.
Suddenly, Lu Tianxiang felt the embrace of a broad and solid chest. Han Li wrapped his arms around her, lifting her chin, and kissed her red lips before saying solemnly,
“Don’t worry, I will take care of everything.”
No matter what perils lay behind the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture, Han Li would try to resolve them. Lu Tianxiang was his wife, and it was his duty to protect her.
Even if he was not strong enough now, he would certainly be powerful enough in the future.
The Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture might be profound, but it could hardly compare with his System. By the time Lu Tianxiang cultivated to the True Martial Realm, Han Li would have reached the Divine Yuan Realm, or even the Tongxuan Realm, and perhaps even higher realms.
If the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture really was a trap, and the person who set it dared to show themselves, Han Li would dare to slap him dead with one blow.
Hearing this, Lu Tianxiang stared blankly at Han Li, looking into his earnest eyes, and somehow, she no longer kept a cold face towards him, but instead gently “Hmm”ed, and rested her head on Han Li’s shoulder

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 119 Sword Immortal Takes the Initiative to Show Up_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 119 Sword Immortal Takes the Initiative to Show Up_1
Translator: 549690339
The moon shone brightly, stars sparse.
Clad in her palace gown and white skirt, her back bearing the Divine Sword, the breathtakingly beautiful female cultivator was hurrying along her way, her destination shockingly being Gulei Manor.
Throughout the journey, Jiang Baiye kept a cold expression on her face, still uncertain about how to face the devil Han Li.
If Han Li truly was the mysterious Great Grandmaster, with his lustful nature, could she really escape from Han Li’s Devil’s Palm this time?
Jiang Baiye didn’t know, but she knew she had to go.
The evening breeze caressed her, silver hair danced in the air, her hair misty like clouds, fully revealing the Sword Immortal’s graceful beauty.
Her eyes were as clear as autumn water, her figure second to none, her looks surpassing this world; the cold moonlight lit up her bright phoenix eyes, as if igniting two stars.
When she arrived above Gulei Manor, Jiang Baiye stopped proceeding any further, standing tall in the ninth heaven, the gentle moonlight draping her with a robe of moonlight, making her seem even more ethereal and enlightened at this moment, serene like a fairy.
She Imew she couldn’t go any further, this was her limit.
If Han Li was indeed the mysterious Great Grandmaster, he naturally had the strength to discover her and know her intentions, and would come to meet her.
Since Han Li did not wish to reveal his identity or the strength of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, if she were to go to Han Mansion’s campsite, her identity would surely cause a significant stir.
The outside world was unaware of her relationship with Han Li; meeting him suddenly would bring a lot of trouble to Han Li, and although she would like to see that happen, she didn’t want to offend Han Li.
She came here to exchange for the Body-Cultivating Furnace, not to trouble Han Li.
As time passed, Jiang Baiye’s mood suddenly became anxious; why hadn’t Han Li come yet?
Did Han Li not want to see her? Or was Han Li not the mysterious Great Grandmaster and thus couldn’t detect her presence?
She was quite confident in herself, being Sanzhou’s number one Sword Immortal, and with Han Li being a lecher, having committed many shameful acts towards her last time, he couldn’t possibly not want to see her.
Could it really not be him…
If Han Li wasn’t the Great Grandmaster, then she would have to find another way to get the Body-Cultivating Furnace back, without risking herself.
Even if she would face backlash and have no hope of reaching the Hollow Void Stage in this life, for the safety of her Sect, Jiang Baiye had no choice but to proceed this way.
She decided to wait a little longer; if Han Li still didn’t appear, she would return to Canghai Sect and ask the Sect Leader to come and help take back the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
Why not ask her master to intervene?
Jiang Baiye felt it might not be very safe for the Hollow Sect Master to take action.
As Jiang Baiye’s thoughts were in turmoil, three hundred li behind her in the sky, a figure in black stood still, quietly observing the Sword Immortal in front.
“What exactly does Little Ye want to do?”
Jian Ziyun mused to himself. He hadn’t made much effort to hide, yet Jiang Baiye hadn’t noticed him, which Jian Ziyun found quite unsettling.
With Jiang Baiye being in the late God Refining Realm, he wasn’t deliberately concealing himself; at such a distance, she should have noticed something amiss.
In recent times, Jian Ziyun had noticed that Jiang Baiye seemed off, often appearing absent-minded within the Sect, seemingly harboring something extremely important in her heart.
When he asked her, Jiang Baiye didn’t say anything.
So during this time, he paid special attention to Jiang Baiye, trying to see what exactly she intended, hoping she wouldn’t do anything foolish. After Jiang Baiye left the Sect tonight, Jian Ziyun discreetly followed her.
“Why isn’t Little Ye moving? Is she waiting for someone here?” Jian Ziyun frowned.
He knew his disciple well and hadn’t heard of her having like-minded friends
in Gulei Manor. There was a God Refining Realm Master in Gulei Manor, but he was an old chap, definitely not someone Jiang Baiye would bother with.
“Could it be that Gulei Manor has some Secret Territory that’s about to emerge?” Jian Ziyun speculated, feeling this might be more likely.
Otherwise, why would Jiang Baiye be in the sky above Gulei Manor in the middle of the night instead of cultivating at the Sect? She surely hadn’t come here just to admire the moon.
Jian Ziyun was filled with doubts when suddenly his expression drastically changed. Without any time to defend or retaliate, he passed out.
Han Li’s figure appeared there, grabbing Jian Ziyun with one hand before disappearing again. As he arrived, the Gang Yuan expanded, forming a barrier that concealed the sounds of the scuffle, while Jiang Baiye was still lost in thought hundreds of li away.
Beforehand, Han Li had been staying inside the carriage, enjoying an intimate and tender time with Lu Tianxiang, feeling quite heartened as if he was not far from winning over Lu Tianxiang’s heart.
Then he sensed two figures intruding into the range covered by his Spiritual Sense, one after the other; the former at the God Refining Realm and the latter, Guru in the Void Realm, seemed to be tracking the former, carefully concealing their trail.
Han Li wasn’t in a rush to act as they still needed quite some time to draw near.
As he continued to be loving with Lu Tianxiang, he noticed that the former stopped at the edge of Gulei Manor, not moving forward as if waiting for someone; meanwhile, the latter hid hundreds of li away from the former, also motionless.
Upon carefully scrutinizing with his Spiritual Sense, Han Li recognized the one in front to be Jiang Baiye, who had been missing for a while, and he did not recognize the Void Realm Grandmaster behind her.
With a bit of guesswork, Han Li figured out her purpose for being here. He had been longing to see Jiang Baiye for a while and naturally could not refuse to meet her.
Picking up Lu Tianxiang’s delicate face, Han Li gently pecked it, whispering softly, “Xiangxiang, I’ll be back in a bit.”
“Just go already,” Lu Tianxiang said coldly, fully aware of what Han Li was about to do. On their relocation trip, Han Li would occasionally leave to handle troubles.
Her tone wasn’t due to Han Li’s absence, but rather she felt somewhat ashamed of her recent behavior, how she could have acted like a young girl, leaning in her lover’s arms.
Lu Tianxiang felt her dignity was at stake, choosing to resume the aloof demeanor of the high and mighty Mother of No Life..

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 119 Sword Immortal Takes the Initiative to Show Up_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Chapter 119 Sword Immortal Takes the Initiative to Show Up_2
Translator: 549690339
Han Li smiled without much concern and vanished from the sight.
Instead of meeting Jiang Baiye right away, Han Li appeared behind the Hollow Realm Master and, raising his hand, slapped him on the back of his head.
For a mid-stage Hollow Void Stage grandmaster, the gap in combat ability compared to Han Li was too vast. Han Li had already initiated his move, and only then did the grandmaster barely begin to react.
The Hollow Realm Master had no chance to retaliate before Han Li’s Gang Yuan surged into his body in an instant, forcing all his Gang Yuan back into his Dantlan ancl spiritual sea, sealing It ort.
With his powers sealed, the Hollow Realm Master was no different from an ordinary man, and Han Li knocked him out with a slap.
With a flash, Han Li appeared behind Jiang Baiye and suddenly spoke.
“Jiang Baiye, how dare you come to see me?”
Startled by the voice and feeling the presence behind her, Jiang Baiye’s divine sword immediately resonated, ready to unsheathe itself for battle.
Han Li slapped the divine sword with his palm, and the sword immediately calmed down, ceasing its humming.
Feeling like a thorn was in her back, Jiang Baiye knew it was Han Li who had arrived. Her guess was confirmed, and after taking a deep breath, Jiang Baiye turned around, attempting to lock gazes with Han Li.
She was shocked to find that Han Li was much closer than she thought, almost leaning on her back. As she turned, her red lips touched two warm, moist lips.
“Shameless!”
Jiang Baiye immediately tried to retreat, but found her cultivation sealed in the blink of an eye, her body unable to move, and then she was pulled into Han Li’s embrace.
From a distance, under the dome of the sky and the moonlight, a handsome man and a beautiful woman leaned on each other tenderly, their affection deep and long, like a pair of fairy lovers.
But in reality, the usually cold and fairy-like Jiang Baiye was swearing up a storm, although she kept repeating the same few words.
“Shameless!”
“Bastard!”
“You lecher!”
“Let me go this instant!”
“I’m going to scream…”
Han Li held Jiang Baiye tightly in his arms and suddenly let out an evil chuckle, speaking like a great devil, “Go ahead, scream. Even if you scream your throat raw, no one will come.”
In the area covered by his spiritual sense, no one else had noticed this place, and Han Li had even concentrated on creating a Gang Yuan barrier to block out the noise, making it even less likely for the outside world to hear.
“I…” Jiang Baiye trembled all over, biting her red lip, but she didn’t continue cursing.
She realized that the more she cursed, the more excited Han Li became, and she couldn’t find any particularly nasty words to say anyway.
So, Jiang Baiye simply gave in.
Now that her cultivation was sealed, she had no means of acting, and even though she had anticipated this possibility, when it actually happened, it still left Jiang Baiye feeling powerless.
“Jiang Baiye, I let you go last time out of sheer kindness, and here you are presenting yourself to me again. Could it be that you’ve fallen for this old ancestor and wish to be my wife?”
Holding Jiang Baiye’s slender waist with one hand, Han Li’s other hand was not behaving. He whispered softly into the ear of the cool beauty.
Feeling the bursts of warm breath on her ear and the heat coming from Han Li’s body, Jiang Baiye’s face turned red with embarrassment, but she still tried to maintain a cold tone as she said:
“Shameless, I would never fall for a lecher like you.”
“I’m here today to take back the Supreme Body Nourishing Furnace of our sect, not to be your wife or concubine. Get rid of your wishful thinking.”
“Is that so?”
Han Li chuckled softly, bent down, and captured Jiang Baiye’s red lips. Jiang Baiye struggled, but it was of no use.
After a long while, Han Li finally let her go, laughing as he said, “Still quite unfamiliar, eh? It seems you’re still reserved for me.”
“You really are a bastard!” Jiang Baiye was frantic, knowing what he meant.
After her previous mistake led to her capture by Han Li, not only had he used a Shadow Leaving Stone to record her in various shameful poses, but he also stole her first kiss.
As the Sword Immortal, the number one beauty of Sanzhou, with such high standards, how could she casually choose a partner for cultivation?
So all this time, she remained the aloof Sword Immortal, chased after by countless people—wasn’t it normal for her to be unfamiliar?
She hadn’t kissed anyone else, so how had she become reserved for him?
Feeling extremely uncomfortable under Han Li’s lewd touches, Jiang Baiye tried hard to resist, but there was an unusual sensation in her heart, reminding her of what happened the time Han Li sealed her cultivation.
After teasing Jiang Baiye thoroughly, Han Li then whispered in her ear, “Jiang Baiye, it’s not impossible for you to take back the Body-Cultivating Furnace, as long as you marry me. Then we can talk.”
“And I won’t treat you poorly, I’ll marry you as my wife, not take you as a concubine. What do you think?”
“I don’t think much of it at all!” Jiang Baiye’s voice was cold as she emphatically refused.
Pausing for a moment, ignoring Han Li’s wandering hand, Jiang Baiye continued, “I can exchange other things for the Body-Cultivating Furnace.”
Han Li stopped his movements, sneering as he said, “The Body-Cultivating Furnace is a Lower-Grade Heaven Rank magical treasure, immensely useful; surely you are well aware of its powers. What could you possibly offer in exchange?
“Moreover, the Body-Cultivating Furnace is a replica of the ancient Supreme
Life Nurturing Furnace, just currently sealed. If unsealed, it would at least be a Supreme Grade Heaven Rank magical treasure, perhaps even a Divine Weapon. Can you afford such an exchange?”
Truth be told, Han Li himself doubted that the Body-Cultivating Furnace was merely a replica of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, but that didn’t stop him from saying so, as long as it served to intimidate Jiang Baiye.
Just like with Lu Tianxiang, he genuinely wished to claim Jiang Baiye’s heart and body completely, to have her devote herself to him wholeheartedly, and not merely play with her.
With Jiang Baiye’s loyalty, Han Li would gain a powerful ally. Given her aptitude, with substantial cultivation on his part, she could one day become a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Playing forcefully would only let him possess Jiang Baiye’s body, but she would not heed his commands, nor would she be able to assist him.
Since advancing to the Myriad Phenomena Realm in terms of combat ability, Han Li’s mindset had changed. Rather than settling for easily obtained, eager concubines, he preferred conquering women of exceptional talent, beauty, cultivation, and renown.
Han Li found this to be more challenging. The matter of producing offspring could be left to the beautiful concubines; his descendants were already actively spreading their branches.
In simple terms, the Elder Ancestor Han’s taste had changed from quantity to quality.
Taking concubines was an easy task for the current Elder Ancestor Han. Those women, once married to him, quickly devoted their hearts to him.
But women like Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye, the favored daughters of heaven, were rare gems that required effort to pursue.
Though he could easily seize Jiang Baiye’s body, forcing her to produce offspring, what would be the point? Couldn’t any of the lesser concubines serve that purpose?
If he were to force himself on every favored daughter of heaven, he would undoubtedly attract trouble. Thus, Elder Ancestor Han sought both Jiang Baiye’s body and her heart.
This way, not only would he avoid trouble, but he would also gain a valuable ally. Jiang Baiye could bear his offspring as well, killing several birds with one
stone.
Upon hearing this, Jiang Baiye fell silent for a time before weakly saying, “The Body-Cultivating Furnace is just that, not some replica of the ancient Supreme
Life Nurturing Furnace.”
It was already difficult enough for her to retrieve a Lower Grade Heaven Rank Body-Cultivating Furnace; should it carry the label of a replica of an ancient treasure, its value would skyrocket manifold, well beyond her means of exchange..

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 120 Fairy Descends into Hell_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 120 Fairy Descends into Hell_l
Translator: 549690339
“All signs indicate that the Body-Cultivating Furnace is a replica of the ancient Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace, without a doubt. You don’t need to argue with me about it,”
“If you want to exchange for the Body-Cultivating Furnace, fine. I won’t make it difficult for you. Just bring me a Heaven Rank Supreme Grade magical treasure in exchange,”
Embracing Jiang Baiye, Han Li spoke into her ear. His tone was indifferent yet extremely domineering.
Jiang Baiye shivered all over upon hearing this. This bastard was too shameless.
She could never exchange a Heaven Rank Supreme Grade magical treasure for the Body-Cultivating Furnace. Setting aside whether the Body-Cultivating Furnace was truly a replica of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, a Heaven Rank Supreme Grade magical treasure was not something she could possess.
Those were weapons used by warriors of the Divine Yuan Realm. She feared that not a single one could be found in the entire Daqian Empire, let alone by the Canghai Sect.
If the Canghai Sect had a Heaven Rank Supreme Grade magical treasure, they would have become the foremost sect in the Daqian Empire, ruling over half the empire’s territories.
Jiang Baiye remained silent, but Han Li continued, “Can’t bring it forth, huh? Then exchange with yourself. Those are your only two choices.”
Jiang Baiye’s heart quivered.
“I’ve heard that the Canghai Sect hasn’t been doing well lately, what with Ji Feng Hall and the other major factions in Qingzhou targeting you, and even the
Qian Dynasty putting pressure on you. Tsk tsk.”
“Don’t you take your sect very seriously? And yet you took the risk to seek me out. What now, can’t let it go? Are you unwilling to sacrifice yourself or does the Canghai Sect not weigh enough in your heart?”
Han Li’s words were sharp, like a series of keen heavenly blades piercing relentlessly into Jiang Baiye’s heart.
Jiang Baiye took a deep breath. She had anticipated this before she came, but she still came anyway, hoping to exchange other treasures, but it was a failure.
This bastard Han Li was clearly intent on having her exchange herself for the Body-Cultivating Furnace and what was even more shameless, he wanted not just her body but also her heart.
But now, Jiang Baiye found herself seemingly without the luxury of choice.
Her cultivation was sealed, and she was in Han Li’s hands. Whatever Han Li wanted to do, she couldn’t resist, like how this bastard was now brazenly holding her in his embrace.
If she agreed to Han Li, she could exchange for the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
If she didn’t agree, she wouldn’t get the Body-Cultivating Furnace back, and she herself would fall into Han Li’s hands.
What should I do?
Jiang Baiye murmured in her heart, struggling ceaselessly, torn apart by indecision.
The Canghai Sect indeed held great significance in her heart, but didn’t she matter to herself?
If she agreed, she would lose her freedom for life, body and soul bound to that bastard Han Li, and she probably couldn’t return to the Canghai Sect either.
Suddenly, a flash of inspiration struck Jiang Baiye, and she said with a stern voice, “Han Li, don’t go too far. You should remember that this is Qingzhou, and our Canghai Sect is the foremost major faction here.”
“If I disappear, my master will definitely notice. Once it’s traced back to you and reported to the Sect Leader, he will surely come looking for trouble.”
“Let alone whether you could match our Sect Leader in strength, if you two were to fight, your identity would be exposed. Don’t forget what you’ve done under other identities. Once that’s out, the Qian Dynasty, and even the forces behind the Mother of Non-Life, will come after you. Can you withstand that?”
Jiang Baiye said quite a lot, her words filled with threats. She breathed a sigh of relief internally, almost fooled by Han Li.
Her cultivation had been instantly sealed, followed by Han Li’s improper advances and a series of conditions that completely controlled the pace and threw her off, sending Jiang Baiye into chaos, almost resigning to her fate.
Once she recovered her wits and thought it over carefully, Jiang Baiye immediately spotted a loophole, a loophole that was crucial to Han Li, concerning his other identities.
Han Li liked to conceal his competence, hiding his true strength deeply, cunningly living on, unknown what disguises he may have employed, but if one were exposed, others might follow suit.
She was confident that Han Li did not want his identity exposed, or it would bring him immense trouble. Neither the Qian Dynasty nor the Mysterious Forces were entities Han Li could contend with.
Though Han Li was a Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, he was far from matching the Qian Dynasty and the Mysterious Forces.
Jiang Baiye didn’t know whether her master was aware of her seeking out Han Li, but it didn’t prevent her from saying so, bolstering her chips, deterring Han Li.
Han Li’s face showed a peculiar expression at her words, yet Jiang Baiye, held in his arms, could not see his expression at that moment.
Han Li did not respond, and Jiang Baiye thought she had intimidated him. She decided to persist, adding, “Now you have only one choice, let me go, and hand over the Body-Cultivating Furnace to me.”
“If I can safely return with the Body-Cultivating Furnace, I assure you that your identity will not be exposed, and you can continue enjoying your carefree and pleasurable life, otherwise…”
“Wait,” Han Li interrupted her.
“Han Li, this is the best choice for you. Don’t think about a fight to the death; it’s not good for either of us.”
“Without the Body-Cultivating Furnace, my Canghai Sect won’t collapse immediately, but without you, could the Han Family still exist?”
“Han Li, you don’t want your identity exposed, do you?”
Jiang Baiye kept sneering, an expression of certainty in her victory on her face. “Jiang Baiye, oh Jiang Baiye, you’re rejoicing too soon.”
Han Li waved his hand, and a body was forcefully pulled over from afar, placed strikingly before Jiang Baiye’s eyes.
Jiang Baiye was confused as to why Han Li would say such a thing, but when she saw the unconscious figure in front of her, she felt as if she had been struck by lightning, her face instantly paling a few shades.
“I might not recognize this person, but I’m sure you do,”
“Tsk tsk, a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage following you, evidently to protect
you.. Could this be your revered master?”

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 120 Fairy Descends into Hell_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 120 Fairy Descends into Hell_2
Translator: 549690339
Feeling the tremble of the delicate body in his embrace, Han Li continued speaking, each sentence driving Jiang Baiye deeper into despair.
After a moment of thought, Jiang Baiye understood why her master, Jian
Ziyun, had followed her. Her master meant well, but it had spoiled everything.
She hadn’t told her master about her plan to seek out Han Li, but she had expected that, should she go missing, her master would investigate and the trail would lead to Han Li. This was her trump card, intended to threaten Han Li.
But now her trump card was gone, even her master had been captured by Han Li, and her earlier threats seemed laughably feeble.
Thinking back to her previous threats and how Han Li had remained silent, Jiang Baiye felt a wave of embarrassment and shame. Was Han Li, that bastard, just watching her make a fool of herself just now?
Now that both she and her master were in Han Li’s hands, he had no risk of his identity being exposed. Her confidence was completely drained and she didn’t know how to face his coercion any longer.
Feeling the abnormality in the beauty within his arms, Han Li knew he had guessed correctly; this Guru in the Void Realm was indeed Jiang Baiye’s master.
What a pity, Jiang Baiye’s master wasn’t a beautiful female cultivator, otherwise, he would have considered keeping both master and disciple.
“Jiang Baiye, you wouldn’t want your master to die right before your eyes, would you?”
“Jiang Baiye, you wouldn’t want to be dishonored in front of your master, would you?”
“Jiang Baiye, your master is right here, and if I were to do something to you…”
Recalling the scene of Jiang Baiye threatening him, Han Li used her own tone of voice to turn her words against her.
Jiang Baiye pursed her red lips, wanting to scold this bastard loudly, but seeing her master lying unconscious before her, she found herself unable to speak the words.
Although this bastard was shameless, he was indeed cruel and perfectly capable of doing such things.
“Surely the Sect Leader was notified by the master before he left. If we go missing or die, the Sect Leader will definitely trouble you, and your identity will still be exposed.”
Jiang Baiye struggled to speak, but even she lacked confidence in her own words.
She Imew that it was nearly impossible for her master to notify the Sect Leader before leaving the sect; there was no need. If Han Li had killed her master and captured her, it might take some time before the Sect Leader realized. By then it would be too late for the Sect Leader to investigate, as Han Li would have fled to Yuanzhou.
And with the Canghai Sect lacking a Sect Heir and a Guru in the Void Realm, it would have a very negative impact. Other forces would take advantage of the vulnerability, making the Canghai Sect even more endangered.
Her purpose in coming was to retrieve the Body-Cultivating Furnace to help stabilize the Canghai Sect, not to hasten its downfall.
“Do you believe that?” Han Li sneered.
“You seem to have overlooked the most crucial point, which is that strength is all that matters.”
“Before the Canghai Sect Leader discovers anything, I could ally with the Ji Feng Hall, eliminate him, and without a Sect Leader, could your Canghai Sect still stand? Your master will also die here.’
Considering the situation described by Han Li, Jiang Baiye felt completely hopeless.
She knew such a thing was very likely to happen; Han Li would surely do so to eliminate any uncertainties.
Having intimidated Jiang Baiye, Han Li decided to take a dual approach, so he sweetened his tone and dangled a carrot before her.
“Baiye, if you follow me wholeheartedly, I will marry you properly and give you the status of a wife. You will not be treated unfairly in the least.”
“Your aptitude is excellent, but the Canghai Sect is too small to nurture you to the Myriad Phenomena Realm. However, if you follow me, reaching the Myriad Phenomena Realm would be effortless, and even breaking through to the True
Martial Realm is possible in the future.”
“The Body-Cultivating Furnace can be taken back, your master won’t die, the Canghai Sect Leader won’t die, the Canghai Sect won’t be destroyed, and you’ll be able to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm and the True Martial Realm. Don’t you think that’s wonderful?”
“When you’ve reached the True Martial Realm in the future, you can also give back to the Canghai Sect, helping your master ascend to the Myriad Phenomena Realm. Even Da Qian wouldn’t dare to touch the Canghai Sect, and becoming the First Sect of Da Qian is just around the corner…”
“All of this requires just a slight nod from you, and everything can be yours. All of it lies within a single thought of yours.”
Gently holding Jiang Baiye, Han Li didn’t move further but spoke tenderly into her ear.
Feeling Jiang Baiye’s body tremble, Han Li sighed inwardly. He did not wish to coerce a beauty into submission with threats and bribes, but how else would a woman of such exceptional caliber agree to marry him?
With the strength he’d shown to the outside world, he could easily take numerous beauties of lesser talent as concubines, but high-quality female cultivators were much harder to acquire.
Previously, he had no choice but to be a diligent farmer toiling away at enriching his land. Now that his power had grown, he had options.
Let the descendents be the diligent farmers. Han Li began to pursue high-quality female cultivators, focusing on quality over quantity.
He wanted everything in one go—not only to take high -quality female cultivators as wives but also to win their hearts. Otherwise, what difference would there be between them, with their sealed cultivation, and those concubines who threw themselves at his door?
If they couldn’t assist Han Li in other ways and only served as tools for producing offspring, why would Han Li go to great lengths to capture these high-quality female cultivators?
“Alas, when will high -quality female cultivators actively pursue him and throw themselves at him?”
Han Li sighed again but knew such a thing was highly unlikely to happen, at least not in the coming decades.
The level of cultivation he had shown was not enough to make these high-quality female cultivators willingly come to him as wives or concubines.
Female cultivators with great talent, high beauty, reputation, and cultivation levels were all proud and haughty. They wouldn’t resort to this unless absolutely necessary unless Han Li had way too much to offer.
Jiang Baiye remained silent the entire time, her delicate body trembling. Looking at her unconscious master lying before her, and thinking of the potential destruction of the Canghai Sect because of her, she was very tempted to agree.
Perhaps agreeing was indeed a good choice.
Just as Han Li described, everything would become beautiful if she just agreed.
It was just that doing so would cost her freedom, tying her spirit and body to Han Li. Therefore, Jiang Baiye was torn, with two voices in her head relentlessly debating the pros and cons.
“Now, speak your choice!”
Not giving Jiang Baiye too much time to think, Han Li knew that such matters had to be struck while the iron was hot. He turned her around to face him and said calmly as he gazed into her eyes.
Jiang Baiye looked into Han Li’s eyes, pursed her red lips, and eventually lowered her head, whispering four words in an almost inaudible voice.
A smile instantly appeared on Han Li’s face.
The Sword Immortal, Jiang Baiye, once let go by him, had now fallen into his hands again. After some maneuvers, he ultimately compelled Jiang Baiye to agree.
Although she didn’t have feelings for him at the moment, after they were intimate and she carried his child, he believed her mindset would gradually change.
Given some time, Han Li was confident he could fully capture Jiang Baiye’s heart.
After all, once Jiang Baiye agreed, she understood that it was inevitable, and she had no room for regret..

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 121 Hearing of the Imperial Secret_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Chapter 121 Hearing of the Imperial Secret_l
Translator: 549690339
“Can I have the Body-Cultivating Furnace back now?” Jiang Baiye bit her lip, speaking with a hint of subdued grievance.
“Not yet,” Han Li flatly refused.
“You…” Jiang Baiye glared at him, visibly frustrated. Was that bastard Han Li going back on his word?
With an indifferent expression, Han Li spoke directly, “Before that, there are some matters to attend to, and I will still need the Body-Cultivating Furnace for a while.”
It wasn’t that all troubles would be resolved just because Jiang Baiye had agreed; there were still issues that needed his intervention to wrap up.
“What matters? How much longer will you need it?” Jiang Baiye had no choice; given her current predicament, she had little room to maneuver. She only hoped that Han Li wouldn’t go back on his promise.
“First, bring him back to the Sect without revealing anything about me. Pacify your master, then find an excuse to go out for experience and reunite with me later.”
“Although I’m not afraid of trouble, I also don’t want unnecessary complications. You’d better handle it properly so he doesn’t come looking for me again, or else I’ll kill him with a slap.”
“I will need the Body-Cultivating Furnace for a bit longer, ten years at most.
Then it will also benefit you, and once I’m done, it will be returned to the
Canghai Sect.”
“The Canghai Sect is, after all, one of the Ten Great Sects of Daqian. It shouldn’t crumble in the span of ten years, right?”
Han Li laid out the plan he had devised in advance, explaining it in detail.
By doing so, the troubles of the Canghai Sect would be thoroughly resolved, and he would gain a lady favored by the heavens.
Just as he couldn’t unseal Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation now, Han Li couldn’t return the Body-Cultivating Furnace to Jiang Baiye yet. He, his wives, and some of his descendants needed it after moving, and Han Li was also worried that Jiang Baiye might take the furnace and renege on her word, leaving him to regret it deeply.
Jiang Baiye was silent for a while but ultimately agreed, as she once again had little choice.
Seeing her concession, a satisfied look appeared on Han Li’s face as he continued, “I’m only giving you one year. You must reunite with me within that time.”
“You need to swear an oath on your Dao heart not to reveal anything concerning me. If you violate it, you will never advance to the Hollow Void Stage in your life, and both your master and your Sect will be destroyed because of it.”
“Okay,” Jiang Baiye immediately agreed. It wasn’t her first time swearing an oath; last time she didn’t say anything, and this time she wouldn’t either.
Times had changed. Before, she didn’t want to break her oath and affect her own path; now, she didn’t dare. Han Li’s strength was too great, and she dared not harbor any ill intentions, or the Canghai Sect would truly face annihilation.
“I will also need to plant a spiritual seed in your mind. If you show the slightest intention to reveal anything or fail to reunite with me within a year, it will kill you immediately. Then, I will finish off the Canghai Sect.”
Han Li continued to lay out his demands. He saw no need for pleasantries when possessing strength allowed him to speak bluntly.
“No way!” Jiang Baiye’s expression changed, and she rejected the idea.
If someone were to plant a spiritual seed in her mind and there was a significant power disparity, that person could monitor all her thoughts. With just a will, they could control her Divine Spirit or instantly unleash a force capable of eradicating it.
Han Li was a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, while she was only in the God Refining Realm. The gap in the Power of the Divine Spirit was far too vast; even a single spiritual seed would be too much for her to resist.
It wasn’t that she wanted to leak information or break her oath; she just didn’t want Han Li to pry into her thoughts, especially those concerning him. She didn’t want to give him the impression that she had feelings for that bastard.
Looking down at the stunning Fairy in his arms, Han Li said coldly, “You have no room to refuse.”
This was a necessary step, and the most crucial one.
Back in the God Refining Realm, he lacked this method, but now with his Divine Spirit on par with the late stages of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, he naturally mastered this skill.
Previously, he could only trust oaths sworn on the Dao heart, but now he preferred to trust himself. After all, given enough sacrifice, even promises sworn on the Dao heart can be broken.
Once he planted the spiritual seed, with his power, not even the Canghai Sect Leader would notice, let alone resolve it.
If Jiang Baiye ever harbored rebellious thoughts, he would be forced to take action. In the face of risk to his own exposure, he could even forsake a lady favored by the heavens.
Jiang Baiye’s expression fluctuated, and after a deep sigh, she ultimately agreed.
Since she indeed had no such intentions and had already made an agreement with Han Li, she would not break it, as that was her principle and belief.
She just didn’t want Han Li prying into her privacy. At worst, she would spend the next year recalling her last experience.
“Good,” Han Li’s face showed pleasure.
He leaned in close and touched Jiang Baiye’s red lips. Struggling in vain, she had no choice but to let him have his way.
Not until after a long while did Han Li reluctantly part from her.
“We’re not even married yet. Isn’t this a bit too much?” Jiang Baiye gritted her teeth, furious at the constant liberties this bastard was taking.
“You’re now my fiancée, so a kiss is nothing excessive,” Han Li chuckled. “Shameless!”
Jiang Baiye felt that Han Li’s skin was thicker than the walls of the Imperial Capital of the Emperor of Da Qian.
“Can we go now?” Jiang Baiye held back, not saying what she initially intended, and instead asked.
“Yes.”
Han Li released the seal within Jiang Baiye’s body.
“Don’t forget the promises you made to me.”
As he finished speaking, Jiang Baiye disappeared with her master, Jian Ziyun, no longer able to face staying there.
She had risked coming to Han Li, only to have the worst happen; Han Li took liberties with her and sucked her into his orbit..

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 121: First Hearing the Emperor’s Secret 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Chapter 121: First Hearing the Emperor’s Secret 2
Translator: 549690339
Since things had already taken shape, she didn’t intend to go back on her word; Jiang Baiye wanted to see whether Han Li’s promise could be fulfilled and if he could truly help her advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm and the True Martial Realm.
Watching Jiang Baiye’s departing figure, Han Li’s Spiritual Sense followed her until she neared the Canghai Sect, and only then did he withdraw it.
Jiang Baiye was now his person, and Han Li did not want any accidents to befall her on her way back.
Seeing that Jiang Baiye had returned safely, Han Li’s figure also disappeared from the spot, and the next moment he was back inside the carriage.
Upon seeing Han Li’s figure, Lu Tianxiang’s eyes brightened, but then her brows furrowed slightly; she smelled a fragrance coming from Han Li.
There was no scent on Han Li’s body before, which meant that he had met with a woman in the short time he was away.
Lu Tianxiang felt she shouldn’t be angry, she didn’t like Han Li, after all; her presence in the carriage was due to being seized by him, she was there against her will, yet she couldn’t help feeling somewhat upset.
After all, Han Li had just left her alone to meet with another woman; did that mean she lacked appeal?
“What’s the matter, Tianxiang? Are you jealous?”
Han Li, with his keen senses, instantly noticed Lu Tianxiang’s unusual demeanor, and he wrapped his large hand around her tender waist, chuckling in her ear.
“Let go of me, who’s jealous of you, dream on.”
Lu Tianxiang extended her jade hand to swat Han Li’s hand away, but Han Li didn’t feel much force behind her push, and his smile grew even brighter.
Han Li lifted Lu Tianxiang up and placed her on his lap, then leaned down to kiss her.
Lu Tianxiang’s jade hand blocked her red lips, preventing Han Li from moving closer, and she turned her head aside, scoffing, “If you want to kiss, go find that little vixen from just now, or one of your beautiful concubines.”
Han Li felt a surge of delight in his heart. Lu Tianxiang might not realize what her behavior implied, but Han Li understood clearly that their relationship had just grown closer.
“What are you smiling about? Aren’t you quite capable? Why didn’t you bring back that little vixen from vour secret meeting to be a concubine? Surelv vou didn’t lose to her,” Lu Tianxiang humphed, her willowy brows slightly furrowing, her displeasure written all over her face.
“Tianxiang, you’ve misunderstood me, I was indeed dealing with some business just now; a Hollow Realm Master and a God Refining Realm real person had barged in,” Han Li explained patiently, though his big hand was not behaving.
“Stop moving—”
Lu Tianxiang struggled briefly, then coldly demanded, “Then how do you explain the fragrance on you?”
Without hesitation, Han Li responded, “The God Refining Realm real person was a female cultivator, she tried to sneak attack me, and I caught her and sealed her cultivation to teach her a lesson.” “Where is she?” Lu Tianxiang suddenly asked.
Han Li: “Who?”
“That God Refining Realm female cultivator. Given your lustful nature, you should have taken her back as a concubine, unless she was too ugly?” Lu Tianxiang wondered aloud, it wouldn’t make sense for him to have let her go; this didn’t align with her understanding of Han Li.
“She is beautiful, just not as much as Tianxiang,” he said.
Even though Han Li thought the two women were similar in appearance, in front of Lu Tianxiang, he didn’t mind saying she was more beautiful.
Sure enough, hearing Han Li say that, the corners of Lu Tianxiang’s mouth curled up slightly, her eyes and brows seeming all the more attractive.
“It’s a bit of trouble to bring her back now, so I let her go, but she should come looking for me within a year, and then you’ll be sisters,” Han Li continued.
Lu Tianxiang was immediately displeased, “So it’s not troublesome to take me back, is that it?”
“No, Tianxiang, listen to me explain…” Han Li spent some time and finally managed to appease Lu Tianxiang.
He could feel that Lu Tianxiang’s attitude towards him was improving every day; surely, the strategy of gradual influence was the right one.
After sharing a tender moment with Lu Tianxiang and feeling the baby inside her belly for a while, Han Li smiled and said, “Our child’s future is certainly that of an extraordinary prodigy.”
“That must be because of my talents. If the child inherits yours, then he or she will be just an ordinary person,” Lu Tianxiang said with her haughty air, unable to resist taking a hit at him.
“Yes, yes, yes, Tianxiang, the Sect Hierarch, is a peerless genius, unrivaled under the heavens,” Han Li immediately agreed.
After a while, Han Li suddenly thought of something and asked, “Tianxiang, no one should know about your chase after me, right?”
Things had been going a bit too smoothly lately. Mainly because the taste of Lu Tianxiang was too enticing, and he had tasted the marrow of bliss; his energy was all spent on how to win Lu Tianxiang’s heart sooner, and he had grown somewhat negligent.
“Heh, only now you think to deal with these issues,” Lu Tianxiang gave him a sidelong glance, scoffing coldly.
Embracing Lu Tianxiang’s soft body, Han Li kissed her forehead, then nipped her earlobe and said, “Come on, Tianxiang, just tell me.”
After hesitating for a moment, Lu Tianxiang still decided to reveal the truth, as she didn’t want to cause any trouble for Han Li now.
“After escaping to Leizhou, I hid myself in Qingyun Manor and took over the Diancang Sect—it was with the Diancang Sect’s power that I was able to track you down,” she said.
“No one else knows I came to capture you, only the Diancang Master does. However, he doesn’t know about the Rebirth Pill or that I’ve fallen into your hands.”
“After all, you ambushed me halfway through with a different identity, and then I was pursued by Da Qian; in the end, you saved me with that identity.” “Not just the Diancang Master, the outside world is probably guessing who that mysterious Great Grandmaster is; unfortunately, no one can trace it back to you. You have hidden yourself very well,” Lu Tianxiang said slowly, and then she seemed to be somewhat inexplicably emotional.
Han Li nodded, feeling relieved. He had also been getting updates about the outside world recently; various forces were reacting, but no one knew it was him..

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 121: First Hearing the Emperor’s Secret—3
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Chapter 121: First Hearing the Emperor’s Secret—3
Translator: 549690339
He also visited Tianji Pavilion to check on intelligence, wanting to see if Tianji Pavilion knew that the alias was him, but Tianji Pavilion was also unaware.
However, Han Li knew that there would still be people who guessed the alias was his, such as Jiang Baiye who had guessed it; if Jiang Baiye knew, then Yun Miaoyi probably knew as well.
Now that Jiang Baiye was dealt with by him, and Yun Miaoyi was far away at Yinyang Sect, he was temporarily unable to deal with her.
Based on Han Li’s understanding of Yun Miaoyi, that witch was almost guaranteed not to leak the information, as it would not benefit her; nonetheless, Han Li still decided to find an opportunity to patch things up. “Later, I’ll accompany you back to the Diancang Sect for a bit, to handle some things.”
Han Li still planned to deal with the Diancang Sect; at the very least, he needed to make Lu Tianxiang show herself, to keep the Diancang Sect functioning and stop them from investigating Lu Tianxiang’s whereabouts.
Moreover, with Lu Tianxiang’s strength heavily damaged, and her Faith Halo that burned still needing to be reformed, it required Diancang Sect to spread the word; even if her cultivation was sealed, it wouldn’t affect the accumulation of faith.
Lu Tianxiang did not refuse.
“What is the name of the force behind you? Will there be someone who would want to come and save you?” Han Li continued to ask.
He had long been curious about those Mysterious Forces, and also wanted to know Lu Tianxiang’s situation within them.
Although Lu Tianxiang had been abandoned, but then rescued by him, it was uncertain whether her friends, family, or mentors would come to investigate and attempt to rescue her from his alias.
Lu Tianxiang fell silent, Han Li could see she was struggling and hesitating, he did not continue to press her.
After a while, Lu Tianxiang sighed and said, “For certain reasons, the name of the Sect cannot be revealed, but I can answer your other questions.”
Han Li nodded; it seemed this Mysterious Force possessed some unfathomable method of preventing internal members from exposing the Force, suggesting it lurked in the shadows, unwilling to be known by the outside world. Seeing that Han Li did not force her, Lu Tianxiang felt relieved, a somewhat inexplicable feeling in her heart, which she shook off and continued:
“I have an uncle in the Sect with whom I have a good relationship. He didn’t come to support me this time, likely being suppressed by others, too fearful to come. ”
“He should have other important matters to attend to in the Da Qian, and I’m not clear if he will come to investigate, but even if he does, it will be of no use, as no one Imows I am in your hands.”
Han Li’s pupils contracted slightly.
As a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, Lu Tianxiang’s uncle should be a late or peak powerhouse of the Myriad Phenomena Realm to be able to support her.
The “other person” who could suppress her uncle and frighten him from coming to her aid must at least be at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, most likely an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm.
A secret arrival of an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm belonging to a Mysterious Force within the Da Qian province undoubtedly revealed their intentions; it looked like the Daqian Empire was not far from chaos.
Han Li didn’t know how long this calm could last; he only hoped the longer, the better. Fortunately, he was also close to breaking through to the Myriad
Phenomena Realm.
Once the child in Lu Tianxiang’s belly and other offspring were born, he would definitely be able to break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, this time at most half a year away.
“Right, how did you know that I had the Rebirth Pill in my possession?” Although Han Li had already guessed, he still wanted to hear what Lu Tianxiang would say.
“A Great Emperor said so, ” Lu Tianxiang replied indifferently.
“A Great Emperor?! ”
Han Li gasped, taken aback. What realm was a Great Emperor?
He knew that beyond the True Martial Realm were the Divine Yuan Realm, Tongxuan Realm, and Saint Abyss Realm, but none of these realms’ honorific titles were Great Emperor; could the Great Emperor be a realm beyond the Saint Abyss Realm?
Seeing Han Li’s shocked demeanor, Lu Tianxiang felt a slight thrill of joy. Han Li always appeared so confident and in control, which annoyed her quite a bit.
“Above the Holy Abyss Realm lies the Heaven Imperial Realm, only by mastering the Heavenly Sovereign Path can one be called a Great Emperor,” Lu Tianxiang said proudly, her graceful swan neck on display as she lifted her head high.
“Hiss-”
Watching Lu Tianxiang’s proud and adorable demeanor, Han Li purposely drew a sharp breath to go along with her act.
“With your strength, you shouldn’t have been able to come into contact with a
Great Emperor, and moreover, in the Xuan Domain and even within the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, mighty beings at the Tongxuan Realm are nearly extinct. How could there be a Great Emperor existing?” Han Li was very puzzled.
Lu Tianxiang’s eyes flickered as she answered, “This is an ancient emperor who was sealed in ancient times, an invincible being who survived the great calamities of antiquity.”
“He was sealed within our Xuan Domain, and as it happens, the location of this emperor’s seal is right within the Qian Dynasty’s Leizhou.”
“This emperor informed me of some news, which I found related to Qiu Xuan, and then deduced that the Rebirth Pill formula is on you.”
“Han Li, do you want to know the exact location of this emperor’s seal?”
Han Li appeared enlightened, then unhesitatingly refused, “I don’t want to know. ”
Lu Tianxiang frowned in confusion and asked, “You don’t want to meet a legendary emperor who mastered the Heavenly Sovereign Path? This emperor possesses countless high-level cultivation techniques, sacred arts, pill formulas, and blueprints. If you were to go, the emperor might even bestow upon you a scroll of imperial scriptures.”
“I don’t want to, and I don’t need to. I feel that life is quite good as it is now,” Han Li tightened his grip around Lu Tianxiang’s hand, drawing her even closer to him.
“Why?”
“I’m the kind who dislikes fighting and killing, preferring a peaceful life, the best life is one without any enemies.”
“The trouble with the Rebirth Pill formula was enough, and if I were to obtain the imperial scriptures, I would be entangled in even greater trouble,” Han Li said indifferently.
What of an emperor at the Heaven Imperial Realm?
Given time, it was inevitable that he would become a Great Emperor in the future, as well as attaining immortality.
Currently lacking in cultivation, he did not wish to be involved with beings far more powerful than himself at higher realms, as that would make him concerned for the security of his life.
In the future, once he had reached the Heaven Imperial Realm, becoming a Great Emperor or even immortal, then it would be fine to visit this sealed Great Emperor.
At that time, although the sealed Great Emperor might not provide him with fortunes, the knowledge and skills which the emperor possessed could vastly enhance the foundation of the Han Mansion.
Han Li might not need them, but his descendants would.
The location of the Great Emperor’s seal will certainly be visited by Han Li once his cultivation reaches the necessary realm.
Lu Tianxiang nodded slightly, asking no further, her estimation of Han Li had risen considerably.
A living Great Emperor, and one who is sealed at that, represented countless grand fortunes and was enough to drive people mad.
Even Lu Tianxiang herself was not exempt, otherwise, she wouldn’t have ended up in Han Li’s hands.
She had deliberately revealed this information as a test for Han Li, to see if he could resist the temptation of that heaven-defying opportunity.
Han Li had passed the test, and her approval of him had increased significantly; she felt that someone like Han Li might actually live a longer life.
He was adept at concealing his edge and intelligence and knew how to abstain and save himself. Such a person was destined for great achievements in the future.
If that were the case, her marrying such a man wouldn’t diminish her status, and she wouldn’t be dragged into some nonsensical vortex and die as a result..

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 122 Xiang Xiang gives birth to a child 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Chapter 122 Xiang Xiang gives birth to a child 1
Translator: 549690339
That evening, Han Li quietly returned to Qingyun Manor in Leizhou with Lu Tianxiang.
Once Lu Tianxiang had arranged everything and dealt with any potential troubles, Han Li returned to the carriage with her.
Now that all kinds of troubles had been solved, Han Mansion’s relocation convoy should continue its journey, and they could enter Jizhou territory tomorrow.
Han Li decided to keep a lower profile and try not to make any move.
Having revealed his cultivation at the God Refining Realm, it was unlikely that any fool would trouble the Han Mansion’s relocation team.
Han Li decided to accelerate certain matters during this time, such as enhancing the aptitude of his many concubines, which naturally required extensive transfer of teachings and fluids.
He had already promised to return the Body-Cultivating Furnace to the
Canghai Sect after ten years, which was ample time for beauties such as Qiu Yueyao and Li Mingmeng to greatly improve their aptitudes.
The production of the Rebirth Pill was imminent, and the Body-Cultivating Furnace would no longer be of much use to him, as the Rebirth Pill could enhance a person’s aptitude to the highest of Fifth Grade with just a few pills.
Although the effects of the Body-Cultivating Furnace were better, capable of enhancing aptitude up to Fourth Grade, it required a great deal of time and would consume a vast amount of high-level spiritual fluid accumulated each time a cultivator’s aptitude was enhanced.
Even if he kept the Body-Cultivating Furnace indefinitely, it was nearly impossible to raise all of his concubines to Fourth Grade aptitude—it would take upwards of a thousand years for the many concubines.
After all, the Body-Cultivating Furnace was only a Heaven Rank Lower Grade magical treasure; its ability to produce such effects was already miraculous, and it was a treasure passed down through generations by the Canghai Sect.
If there were an heir with Fourth Grade aptitude in the current generation, they would use the Body-Cultivating Furnace to elevate their aptitude even further, and the remaining efforts would focus on cultivating a new heir with Fourth Grade aptitude.
If there was no heir with Fourth Grade aptitude in the current generation, they would strive to cultivate a disciple with Fifth Grade aptitude and elevate them to Fourth Grade.
After beauties like Qiu Yueyao and Li Mingmeng took the Rebirth Pill, their aptitudes would increase to Fifth Grade, and their chances of advancing to the Hollow Void Stage would greatly increase, making the Body-Cultivating Furnace unnecessary.
Once Han Li’s cultivation level increased in the future, he could then seek treasures for enhancing aptitudes without rush.
The next day, the relocation convoy set off, crossing the provincial border, and officially entered Jizhou territory.
In the following period, Han Li became busy dividing his time during the day between accompanying Lu Tianxiang and other concubines; at night, he would provide them with personal instruction, transferring the grand Dao to them, enhancing their aptitudes and improving their cultivation. Although it was a bit busy, Han Li found pleasure in it.
In the blink of an eye, several months had passed.
Since Han Li had led the Han Family on their relocation journey from Leizhou, it had been more than a year since they reached the current region.
As the relocation caravan passed through the prefectures of Jizhou, they received the same treatment as they did in Qingzhou.
Facing an Immortal Refining Clan, those small families and minor forces all wished to form good relationships, considering the Han Family would not be settling in Jizhou and wouldn’t encroach upon their resources and spheres of influence.
Han Li, of course, turned away none who came to him.
As for the beautiful female cultivators who were sent and had aptitudes lower than Eighth Grade, he let his descendants of lesser aptitudes take them to marry or make concubines, helping the Han Family in their grand plan of expanding their population.
Consequently, the Han Family gained several dozen pregnant women, and the total population of the Han Family further swelled, much to Han Li’s delight.
With these children born, they would bring him decades of cultivation and lifespan… When they grew up and took wives and concubines of their own, they would continue to proliferate offspring, and in this way, the Han Family gradually grew stronger.
In Jizhou, Han Li took two more concubines, one with Eighth Grade aptitude and the other with Seventh Grade. Both women were from the same sect, and they were master and disciple.
Zhang Yuyan was the sect master with Seventh Grade aptitude and Pihai Realm cultivation, and her disciple was named Zhang Lan, an Eighth Grade aptitude with only True Qi Realm cultivation.
According to them, their sect could not continue due to a lack of resources and inability to recruit disciples, which was further exacerbated by suppression from other forces.
Hearing that the Han Family was passing through Jizhou and that there was a famous ancestor within who took concubines, the master and disciple figured they might as well become the concubines of Han ancestor.
An Immortal Refining Clan with sufficient resources could support their continuation of cultivation and advancement to higher realms, without worrying about the future of their sect, and they would have a God Refining Realm ancestor as their support.
Han Li found this reason somewhat amusing yet he still accepted them, for it wouldn’t be right to turn away such potential concubines whose aptitudes surpassed his standard for taking new ones.
Although Zhang Yuyan was quite aged, being in her seventies, she maintained herself well and appeared to be only about thirty, a mature beauty. She claimed that she still retained her virginity.
Age was not an issue for Han Li; after giving Zhang Yuyan a Beauty Preserving Pill, her appearance reverted to look ten years younger, standing beside Zhang Lan, they looked like sisters.
Furthermore, it was an added bonus that Zhang Yuyan and Zhang Lan were master and disciple.
That very night, Han Li personally tested them and was very satisfied; Zhang Yuyan indeed had not lied, she was quite luscious.
Zhang Lan was not bad either, though not as luscious as Zhang Yuyan, she had youthful vigor and was extraordinarily tender.
The master and disciple pair, under Han Li’s diligent efforts, were now three months pregnant.
During these months, it was also a time of gain for Han Li, as his concubines successively gave birth to offspring, and the next generation of his descendants was also born, causing the amount of cultivation he accumulated to skyrocket.
As Han Li was reflecting, a system notification sound reached his ears, and he broke into a smile, giving Lu Tianxiang a kiss.
“Your offspring count has surpassed seven hundred, you’ve gained fifty years of cultivation, you’ve obtained six Sea-Calming Pills, three
Strength-Condensing Pills, and you’ve earned the Intermediate Earth-Level Martial Arts Technique [Divine Desolate Prison Finger]..”

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 122 Xiang Xiang gives birth to a child 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Chapter 122 Xiang Xiang gives birth to a child 2
Translator: 549690339
“Awesome!” Han Li was thrilled in his heart; the rewards were much more generous this time.
Although the reward of cultivation years was still fifty, the quantities of the Pihai Pills and the Gathering Pills had increased, especially the martial arts technique he had been looking forward to for so long, and its grade had once again improved.
Last time it was an Earth-Level Lower-Rank martial art, the Dragon Suppressing Palm, but this time it was an Intermediate Earth-Level Martial Arts Technique, the Divine Desolate Prison Finger, which sounded very powerful.
With the addition of his All-Powerful Martial Dao True Intent Embryo, the
Divine Desolate Prison Finger nearly equaled an Earth-Level Extreme Martial
Art. Han Li was about to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and his True Intent Embryo would further improve. Once it enhanced his martial arts, the might would vastly increase
Having mastered a new, fully developed martial technique, he could show off a new facade. Should he encounter a major trouble and must act, he could use this new identity to strike and slay the enemy—who would know it was Han Li’s doing?
Plus this fifty years worth of cultivation, the total amount of cultivation he had saved up had reached 213 years, making it possible to advance to the Myriad
Phenomena Realm.
After all, the cultivation needed to ascend to the Myriad Phenomena Realm was around 220 years, possibly more or less.
However, Han Li planned to wait a little longer; there was no rush. Currently, there were no external enemies, and the number of his qualified descendants had already reached 196. In a little while, it was going to hit two hundred, at which time another substantial amount of cultivation would come in.
Moreover, the child in Lu Tianxiang’s belly was about to be born; this was at least a Fourth-Grade talent offspring, and possibly even a Third-Grade. If more ferocious, an anomaly might occur, possibly bumping it directly to Second or First Grade.
Han Li could only fantasize about it, as attaining a Second or First-Grade talent was extremely difficult.
“What’s making you so happy?
Leaning against Han Li’s chest, Lu Tianxiang could feel his joyous emotions and couldn’t help but ask.
“Our child is going to be born, and just thinking about it fills me with joy,” Han Li murmured softly as he lightly nibbled on her earlobe.
Lu Tianxiang’s face blossomed into a charming smile, radiating maternal glory, adding threefold charm and seductiveness.
Although Lu Tianxiang knew Han Li was thinking of other things, she was still pleased with his words. She didn’t want to pry too much; if Han Li wanted to tell her, he naturally would.
After her cultivation was sealed, Lu Tianxiang had become much calmer over this period and her mindset had significantly improved. As her due date approached, her affection for Han Li deepened, and she gradually enjoyed the feeling of having Han Li by her side.
Han Li wrapped his arms around her, his large hand resting on Lu Tianxiang’s belly, gently caressing. He wore an ever-present smile, one that came from deep within his heart.
This child was his and Lu Tianxiang’s first, the link between the two of them, and also would be his first offspring with either Fourth or Third-Grade cultivation talent, bringing him a substantial reward.
With Han Li’s cultivation, he could sense clearly that the child would be born in seven days, very healthy and brimming with spiritual energy.
Inside Han Mansion, pregnant women would receive various nourishing items to ensure they were well-fed.
Those in better conditions could even buy or exchange additional nourishing items. Even knowing this wouldn’t affect the child’s talent, they were still eager to do it, if only to ensure the mothers were well-nourished and the babies healthy.
As for the concubines pregnant with Han Li’s children, they were treated even better. Han Li personally regulated their bodies, and in secret, he would use high-grade spiritual fluids from the Body-Cultivating Furnace to nourish them, employing various means to ensure their condition so that the children in their bellies would be very spiritual and healthy.
Han Li paid the most attention to the child in Lu Tianxiang’s belly, personally caring for it dozens of times, each time very carefully, ensuring a good foundation for the child even in the womb.
Seven days passed in a blink of an eye, and the Han Mansion’s convoy arrived at Dongshan Manor, which was the penultimate manor on the Jizhou route.
Once past this manor and through another, they would leave Jizhou and enter the Yuanzhou region, at which point Yonchang Manor wasn’t far off.
At this moment, the entire migrating convoy came to a temporary halt because Lu Tianxianz was about to zive birth.
Han Li was very nervous and had Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, and the other women arrange for proper care, while he set up the Five Elements Life and Death Formation. Then he took his place at the central hub, his spiritual sense fully unfurled, covering an area of two hundred thousand li to prevent any accidents from occurring.
After all these preparations, Han Li waited outside, anticipating the birth of his and Lu Tianxiang’s first child.
Soon after, a baby’s cry rang out, and a smile instantly appeared on Han Li’s face. At the same time, a system prompt echoed in his mind.
He did not immediately pay attention to the system prompt, maintaining his spiritual sense to continue scanning the surroundings while he went inside.
Looking at Lu Tianxiang lying on the bed, somewhat pale, Han Li sat beside her and took her soft and boneless hand, transmitting refined and gentle high-grade spiritual fluid into her to help her recover.
With the help of Han Li, Lu Tianxiang’s complexion quickly turned rosy and returned to its state before pregnancy.
After some thought, Han Li opened a seal on Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation level, allowing her to recover to the Pihai Realm, then he reinforced several seals in her Spiritual Sea in the Dantian to prevent any accidents.
Lu Tianxiang immediately felt the strength within her body and looked at Han Li in surprise. She had thought Han Li would unseal her cultivation at least ten years later, but he had done it just after the child was born.
Although only a tiny fraction (less than one ten-thousandth) of her full strength had been unsealed, she was no longer a frail woman, powerless as a chicken bound at hands.
Han Li didn’t speak, but simply nodded at her. Lu Tianxiang hesitated slightly before nodding back.
All was understood without words.
Having done this, Han Li finally turned his attention to the child in Liu Yuexin’s arms, a boy. After a moment of contemplation, he said:
“Let’s call him Han Yongzhen, hoping this child will always remain naive, keep the heart of a child, be bold and diligent on the path of cultivation, and finding the True Martial Realm easily achievable in the future.”
Han Yongzhen did not disappoint, possessing a cultivation talent of Third Grade, the first of Han Li’s descendants to surpass the Third Grade threshold. Such talent was rare across the entire Xuan Domain.
Therefore, Han Li held high expectations for Han Yongzhen, intending to train him wholeheartedly once he reached the appropriate age. It was predictable that the future of Xuan Domain would witness a new prodigy, another Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm.
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, and the maids assisting with the birth only heard the first half, but as soon as Lu Tianxiang heard the last sentence, her eyes lit up.
“Congratulations, sister.”
“Congratulations, Madam.”
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, and the maids immediately offered their sincere congratulations with smiles on their faces.
“Mm.” Lu Tianxiang also wore a smile on her face, satisfied with Han Li’s attitude and the chosen name.
“Thank you for your hard work today, sisters.”
Lu Tianxiang then said to Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, and the other women in a gentle tone.
Han Yongzhen was taken away by Liu Yuexin and the other women for temporary care while Han Li tended to Lu Tianxiang, sharing a tender moment full of affection.
He also took a moment to glance at the system notification and was immediately overjoyed. Lu Tianxiang did not notice anything unusual, thinking Han Li was just happy for the birth of their child.
“You have had your first Third Grade talent descendant, your own talent has increased bv one hundred Dercent. vou have gained seventv vears of cultivation, you have obtained an Earth -grade Superior Martial Art [Five Elements Grand Hand Seal], and you have obtained a Lower Heaven Rank cultivation technique [Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture].” “Your cultivation talent has been elevated to Fourth Grade!”
The rewards were indeed sumptuous!
Han Li was over the moon, finding this reward much more generous than the one for having seven hundred descendants, and perhaps only the reward for a thousand descendants could match it.
A third grade talent descendant had bumped up his own talent by a grade, from Fifth Grade to Fourth Grade, which was a great help to him.
The seventy years of cultivation were also fantastic; with this newly gained cultivation, he had amassed nearly 290 years in total.
It took about 220 years of cultivation for a Fifth Grade talent to perfect 10% of the True Intent of All-Around Martial Path, but now upgraded to Fourth Grade, it would take half the time, around 110 years.
With nearly 180 years left in cultivation, he could continue to perfect the True Intent of All-Around Martial Path and quickly break through in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, reaching a very high stage.
Apart from cultivation and talent, the remaining rewards also pleasantly surprised Han Li.
From the first low-grade talent descendant to the first Fifth Grade talent descendant, he was only rewarded with a martial skill each time, but this time, for the first Third Grade talent descendant, he received both a cultivation technique and a martial skill.
Earth-grade Superior Martial Art [Five Elements Grand Hand Seal]!
Lower Heaven Rank Cultivation Technique [Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture]!

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 123 Breakthrough! True Martial Realm Combat Ability_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: Chapter 123 Breakthrough! True Martial Realm Combat Ability_l
Translator: 549690339
But upon seeing the “Five Elements Grand Palm Seal” and “Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture,” Han Li’s breath quickened.
Together with the Intermediate Earth-Level Martial Arts Technique “Divine Desolate Prison Finger” he had obtained a few days earlier, his strength could be said to have skyrocketed, completely reaching a new stage.
Neither the accumulated cultivation nor the martial arts and cultivation techniques he had obtained had Han Li claimed.
Han Li decided to wait until his offspring with cultivation talent reached two hundred, and he was at 198 now, with many women in the final stages of pregnancy.
Once he obtained the other rewards, he would choose a time to absorb and refine them all at once. He didn’t want to make several trips, mainly because there were no external threats; otherwise, he wouldn’t have waited.
Calming his thoughts, Han Li continued to accompany Lu Tianxiang, embracing her and talking for a long time, telling her some stories from his past life, which mesmerized Lu Tianxiang.
This was a method Han Li had discovered to enhance his relationship with Lu Tianxiang, for she showed great interest in these stories, and Han Li happened to have countless such tales.
After spending a considerable amount of time with Lu Tianxiang, Han Li eventually left. He had to check on Lin Yiwu, Chu Yutong, Zhang Yuyan, and the other beauties.
“Sigh-”
Watching Han Li’s disappearing figure, Lu Tianxiang’s face showed a mix of emotions, and after a long while, she let out a deep sigh.
It seemed she was beginning to become infatuated with this life.
Lu Tianxiang knew that if things continued this way, it wouldn’t be long before she truly fell in love with Han Li.
But Lu Tianxiang didn’t want to stop it; she would rather watch herself fall helplessly.
Elsewhere, Han Li arrived at the carriage of Lin Yiyin and Lin Yiwu, explaining to the two women the profound mysteries of the Five Elements Formula, enlightening and resolving their doubts to enhance their cultivation.
Afterward, Han Li visited the carriage of Chu Yumeng and Chu Yutong. The twin sisters claimed to have developed a new trick and wanted to share it with him.
After pointing out that the twins lacked battle experience, noticing many mistakes and insufficiently swift techniques in combat, Han Li left satisfied.
Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, Liu Yuexin… Han Li successively looked after each of his concubines.
After tending to them, the busy Elder Han fell into contemplation; indeed, he was somewhat overwhelmed, with everyone needing to take turns, few days making a full cycle.
Luckily, Elder Han had already begun to pursue a path of quality over quantity. Both the number of wives and the standard for concubines had increased; otherwise, he would have been even busier.
Three days later,
Han Li was teaching martial arts to Zhang Yuyan and her apprentice Zhang Lan. They had just joined the Han Family not long ago and had been Han Li’s concubines for only a few months, unfamiliar with the family’s cultivation techniques and martial arts.
Naturally, Elder Han felt obliged to impart the techniques and martial arts to them, diligently guiding their cultivation, enhancing their strength, hoping they could become stronger in combat.
Meanwhile, a system notification sounded in Han Li’s mind, but he ignored it, continuing his instruction until both Zhang Yuyan and Zhang Lan were covered in fragrant sweat, had their great epiphanies, and grasped the true essence of the Five Elements Formula. Only then did Han Li stop the session.
Then, Elder Han left the apprentices’ carriage and checked the system notification while walking.
“You have reached two hundred offspring with cultivation talent. You have gained one hundred years of cultivation experience, three Fifth Grade
Longevity Pills, one hundred years of talisman-making experience, and an
Earth-Level Supreme Martial Arts Technique [Sealed Heaven Sword Manual]!”
Han Li paused his steps, then continued walking, his expression unchanged but his heart filled with unexpected joy.
With this additional one hundred years of cultivation, his accumulated cultivation had reached 377 years, a terrifying amount that would allow him to advance through many realms at once.
The three Fifth Grade Longevity Pills were a standard reward, but the one hundred years of talisman-making experience pleasantly surprised Han Li. As one of the Four Arts of Cultivation—Alchemy, Artifact Refining, Formation, and Talisman Making—he had long mastered the first three; now, he could finally master talisman making.
And the final reward, the Earth-Level Supreme Martial Arts Technique “Sealed Heaven Sword Manual,” thrilled Han Li the most.
When he reached one hundred talented offspring, the reward had been the Earth-Level Supreme Magical Artifact “Zhenjun Sword,” which in theory was about as valuable as the Sealed Heaven Sword Manual.
But for Han Li, the value of the Sealed Heaven Sword Manual eclipsed that of the Zhenjun Sword by tenfold, if not a hundredfold, since his nascent True Martial Dao Intent couldn’t yet enhance weapons.
Once he advanced to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, with the support of his nascent True Martial Dao Intent, the might of the Sealed Heaven Sword Manual could rival that of an intermediate Heaven-Rank martial arts technique.
Many mighty peak Myriad Phenomena Realm practitioners possessed only lower Heaven-Rank martial arts techniques, with intermediate ones typically wielded by True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, who hadn’t yet perfected their practice.
Not only did Han Li have the Sealed Heaven Sword Manual, which could rival an intermediate Heaven-Rank martial arts technique, but he had also perfected it, making his strength imaginable.
The time had come; Han Li decided to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm today.
He conveyed his intentions to all his wives and concubines through spiritual sense, informing them he would be gone for a while and if they needed him, they should wait. Then Han Li’s figure disappeared from the convoy.
The commotion of breaking through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm was significant, and Han Li didn’t want to proceed within the migrating group to avoid revealing his cultivation.
Han Li kept walking, each step spanning eight thousand miles, crossing nearly fifty thousand miles in a single breath. Eventually, he arrived at a secluded place seventy thousand miles away.
He agitated his Gang Yuan, forming an invisible barrier covering a hundred yards to prevent the noise of his breakthrough from spreading, before Han Li began his formal breakthrough.
Between talisman-making experience, cultivation techniques, martial arts, and advancing his cultivation, Han Li chose to convert his cultivation techniques first.
With a single thought, the lower Heaven- Rank cultivation technique “Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture” was claimed by Han Li. Countless scriptures appeared in his mind, digested and comprehended by Han Li’s mighty divine spirit..

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 123 Breakthrough! True Martial Realm Combat Ability_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Chapter 123 Breakthrough! True Martial Realm Combat Ability_2
Translator: 549690339
In a short span of time, Han Li grasped all the cultivation essentials of the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture and mastered all the cultivation experiences.
The next moment, he circulated the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, and began to convert his cultivation techniques. The Gang Yuan cultivated from the Tianxuan Scripture within his body ceaselessly transformed into the new Gang Yuan, which was endowed with the attributes of Yin and Yang and the Five Elements.
After several breaths, all the Gang Yuan inside Han Li were converted, now entirely consisting of the Gang Yuan from the Yin and Yang Five Elements
