Scripture. The overall quantity reduced by seventy to eighty percent, but Han Li’s aura strengthened several fold.
“This is indeed a cultivation technique of Heaven Rank’s lower grade!” Han Li opened his eyes, his expression filled with surprise, feeling the power of the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture.
The Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture was a cultivation technique of the True Martial Realm level, several times more powerful than the Tianxuan Scripture.
If two cultivators had the same realm and martial skills, a cultivator who practiced the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture could easily defeat a cultivator who practiced the Tianxuan Scripture—this was the disparity between cultivation techniques.
Even without advancing to the Myriad Phenomena Realm or absorbing other higher-level martial skills, at this moment, his attack power had increased a lot, and he could take on three or four of his former selves before converting his cultivation technique.
Generally speaking, it is only after a cultivator condensed a Martial True Pill and advanced to the True Martial Realm, that the Gang Yuan inside the body would transform into True Yuan.
A Grandmaster Wanxiang who cultivated this technique, whose Gang Yuan naturally carried the attributes of Yin and Yang, and the Five Elements, rivaled the strength of True Yuan, was equivalent to possessing True Yuan ahead of time, greatly enhancing their strength.
The Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture also had the characteristic of continuously integrating other cultivation techniques, absorbing their essence. If the number of assimilated techniques reached a certain amount, it was possible to elevate the grade of the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture.
With just these two characteristics, Han Li decided in an instant to make the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture the new cornerstone cultivation technique for his clan, of course, for now, it would only be taught to his beloved wives and concubines, as well as offspring with exceptional talent.
Those descendants with mediocre talent should start by cultivating the Five Elements Formula first, as the grade of the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture was too high, and they would find it difficult to grasp even the basics.
After completing the conversion of his cultivation technique, Han Li did not delay any longer. He immediately claimed a portion of his accumulated cultivation base and began to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
A vast amount of cultivation was consumed, and Han Li once again entered a state of unity with heaven and man, his comprehension exploding countless times, as if he could understand anything at a glance. This was also commonly known as entering an Enlightenment State.
Han Li seemed to have experienced a century, during which he continually perfected the embryonic form of his All-Encompassing Martial Intent, gaining various cultivation experiences, insights into cultivation…
But in reality, it was just a moment, and all the cultivation insights and experiences appeared in Han Li’s mind, absorbed and digested by him.
A moment like a century!
Han Li’s aura continued to climb, faster and stronger, until the completion of his All-Encompassing Martial Intent embryonic form reached 10%, and his aura finally broke through its shackles, surging upward in an instant.
His aura continued to rise, though not as rapidly as before, and soon stabilized without further increase.
It was only then that Han Li opened his eyes and discovered that even his cultivation had consolidated after the breakthrough, firmly reaching the first layer of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
“Is this what it’s like to be a Grandmaster Wanxiang? It’s truly too strong!”
Han Li took a moment to feel the combat ability he now possessed and exclaimed in amazement; his strength had increased many times over compared to when he was at the peak of the Hollow Void Stage.
Others needed to perfect their Martial Intent to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, yet he only needed to perfect it to 10%, but his strength was much, much stronger than that of a Grandmaster of the same realm.
If Han Li were to describe it, at this moment his combat ability was comparable to the Fifth Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and that was without claiming those higher-level martial skills; otherwise, his combat ability would have increased by a large margin.
The more perfected the All-Encompassing Martial Intent, the greater the improvement to his strength, meeting his expectations; he was now able to elevate martial skills by two grades.
The Myriad Phenomena Realm is about perceiving the myriad phenomena of heaven and earth, understanding everything, and integrating it into one’s own Martial Intent. One’s Divine Spirit is immensely powerful, connecting heaven and earth with a mere thought—capable of commanding wind and rain, creating ice and fire at a wave of a hand, summoning the power of thunder and lightning, and leveraging a trace of the Power of Heaven and Earth with one’s own Martial Intent.
The reason why one could be called a Great Grandmaster in the Myriad Phenomena Realm lies in three signs: an exceptionally strong Divine Spirit, more than ten times stronger than an ordinary Hollow Void Stage; a thoroughly perfected Martial Intent; and the ability to leverage a trace of the Power of Heaven and Earth, wielding the might of the world.
Upon advancing to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, all aspects of Han Li’s capabilities skyrocketed enormously. His Divine Spirit was comparable to the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, his Spiritual Sense greatly strengthened to cover an area of three hundred thousand miles, and his senses exploded in strength, almost touching upon a new domain.
After understanding his current strength, Han Li finally looked at his System panel to see how many years of cultivation had been consumed in advancing to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
“112 years, huh? Not bad.”
Although it was a bit more than he expected, it was of no consequence; he still had 265 years of cultivation remaining, enough to be quite generous.
Han Li’s own Gang Yuan surged forth, forming a new invisible barrier to ensure that there were no problems, before he continued to break through.
A vast amount of cultivation was consumed. Countless training experiences appeared in Han Li’s mind, which he rapidly absorbed and refined. His aura exploded and climbed, increment by increment.
Han Li once again entered the Enlightenment State and experienced the marvel of perceiving a hundred years in a moment. Numerous insights into cultivation flooded his mind, continuously refining the embryonic form of his Universal Martial Dao Intent.
Myriad Phenomena Realm Second Heaven!
Myriad Phenomena Realm Fourth Heaven!
Myriad Phenomena Realm Sixth Heaven!
When all his cultivation was exhausted, Han Li’s cultivation level settled at the complete Seventh Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, just one step away from the Eighth Heaven.
This made Han Li’s brows furrow slightly. Did cultivating the Myriad Phenomena Realm require so much cultivation to be consumed?
But it made sense; his Martial Dao was the ultimate Martial Dao, and naturally, the difficulty of cultivation was higher. Moreover, he was only of Fourth Grade aptitude.
It wasn’t difficult for someone with Fourth Grade aptitude to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but the difficulty to ascend to the True Martial Realm was more than tenfold, a vast difference indeed.
Upon reaching the Myriad Phenomena Realm, it is necessary to continuously polish the Martial Dao Intent until it is complete, so as to condense the Martial True Pill, which is extremely time-consuming.
Generally speaking, a Grandmaster Wanxiang with Fourth Grade aptitude would take twenty years to break through a minor stage, and the further they progressed, the more time it took.
“The Seventh Heaven is the Seventh Heaven, at least I’ve stepped into the later stages of the Myriad Phenomena Realm,” Han Li smacked his lips, accepting the result.
Afterward, Han Li made some inquiries and learned that to cultivate to the complete Ninth Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, the peak of the realm, another hundred years of cultivation were needed.
“Pah, what a rip-off,” Han Li commented and started to check his own strength.
The completion level of the embryonic form of his Universal Martial Dao Intent soared from 10% to 36%, reaching the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm at 49% completion, and at 50%, he could ascend to become an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm.
The amplification of the embryonic form of the Universal Martial Dao Intent on the power of martial skills had also increased a lot, boosting at least by two and a half ranks.
For instance, the Earth-Level Lower Rank Dragon Suppressing Palm, once enhanced by the Universal Martial Dao, could rival the top Earth-grade Superior Martial Arts in power.
His Divine Spirit grew many times stronger, comparable to an ordinary Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm. His Spiritual Sense was also comparable to the True Martial Realm and could cover an area of five hundred thousand miles. His five senses were once again enhanced, as if he had stepped into a new domain.
Han Li planned to ponder this new domain in detail later, as it seemed quite profound.
In terms of combat ability, before his consecutive breakthroughs, he was already on par with those at the Fifth Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. Now, after climbing to the complete Seventh Heaven, his combat power had surged, surpassing that of an average peak Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivator.
He should be on par with those who mastered powerful levels of Martial Dao at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, almost touching the threshold of True Martial Realm’s combat power.
On one hand, the disparity in strength within the Myriad Phenomena Realm widens as one goes deeper. On the other hand, it is also due to insufficient power of the martial skills he mastered.
Although all his martial skills rose by two and a half ranks with the enhancement of the embryonic form of the Universal Martial Dao Intent, compared to those truly powerful peak Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivators, there was still a gap.
Having evaluated his own strength, Han Li then consecutively acquired three Lower-grade martial skills: Divine Desolate Prison Finger, Five Elements Great Hand Seal, and Sealing Heaven Sword Scripture.
After spending some more time absorbing and digesting these, Han Li’s aura suddenly grew much stronger, and his combat ability once again multiplied, truly crossing that threshold.
Now, Han Li had mastered many Earth-grade secret techniques, no worse than those Great Grandmasters who had stayed at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm for a long time.
Although he was still in the later period of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, his actual combat power had stepped into the realm of True Martial Realm, and within this realm, he was not weak, far surpassing many ordinary Emperors wu.

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 124 Divine Sense! Five New Aliases! 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 124 Divine Sense! Five New Aliases! 1
Translator: 549690339
The True Martial Realm was much, much stronger than the Myriad
Phenomena Realm.
Practitioners of the True Martial Realm had the Martial True Pill, and each move could mobilize more than ten to a hundred times the True Yuan of the Myriad Phenomena Realm; the essence of True Yuan was also several times stronger than Gang Yuan.
With the Martial True Pill inside their body, warriors of the True Martial Realm could leverage more than a hundred times the power of Heaven and Earth compared to the Myriad Phenomena Realm. If manifested, they could create a nascent domain, wherein every gesture was endowed with great power, and only then could they be called Emperor Wu.
A True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, at the most basic level, had cultivated
Heaven Rank Lower Grade Cultivation Techniques, mastered several Earth-Level Supreme Grade Martial Arts to at least a high level of proficiency; they had also mastered at least two Heaven Rank Lower or Middle Grade Martial Techniques, with cultivation to minor or major success; they possessed at least one Heaven Rank Artifact, or several Earth-Level Supreme Magical Artifacts whose combined power could rival a Heaven Rank Artifact.
They had mastered many secret techniques, their Divine Spirits were immensely powerful, their Spiritual Sense shone in all directions, their speed was of the True Martial Realm level, and their physical bodies were extraordinarily robust, with nearly no weaknesses.
Even an ordinary True Martial Realm Emperor Wu could easily crush more than a dozen Great Grandmasters with a flick of their hand, and it would take several peak Myriad Phenomena Realm practitioners working together just to barely withstand their casual strikes.
Only those especially powerful peak warriors of the Myriad Phenomena Realm could possess the combat ability of the True Martial Realm, but this so-called
True Martial Realm combat ability was only equivalent to the basic level of the True Martial Realm.
Prince Wu’an, Chu Hao, was at this level; his combat ability was equivalent to that of an ordinary True Martial Realm practitioner, which was why he was dreaded by everyone. The True Martial Realm already stood at the pinnacle of the Xuan Domain.
When Prince Wu’an massacred three Great Grandmasters in Jizhou, he used only two punches, because he deliberately hid his strength. Even so, others could see that he killed Grandmasters too easily, and his speed had also reached the level of the True Martial Realm.
Gathering his thoughts, Han Li began to contemplate what level his current combat ability had reached.
His Divine Spirit and Spiritual Sense had only just reached the level of the True Martial Realm, but his offensive power had overtaken them, advancing to a higher level.
Xuantian Punch, Seal Heaven Manual, Five Elements Palm Seal, God Slaying
Sword Technique, Yin and Yang Palm Seal, Divine Barren Prison Pointing, Diamond Indestructible Body Protection Technique, Dragon Suppressing Palm…
Unknowingly, he had mastered eight types of Earth Level Martial Arts, two of Supreme Grade, two of Top Grade, one of Mid Grade, and three of Lower Grade, compensating for his shortcomings in this area.
With the enhancement of All-Powerful Martial Path, all his martial techniques could improve by two and a half grades, drastically increasing their might.
Xuantian Punch and God Slaying Sword Technique, both of which he had cultivated and were now nearly at major success, had combat ability of the first tier of the True Martial Realm, with the latter also able to unleash the threshold combat ability of the True Martial Realm.
The might of the Dragon Suppressing Palm could be enhanced to a top Earth-Grade Superior Martial Art. When perfected, it would possess substantial power, easily comparable to the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, although it was somewhat lagging behind the speed of his cultivation progress.
The Diamond Indestructible Body Protection Technique was roughly the same; it was invulnerable to peak Myriad Phenomena Realm attacks but couldn’t withstand strikes from a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
The might of the Divine Barren Prison Pointing could be raised to that of top
Earth-Level Supreme Martial Arts. When perfected, it rivaled a Heaven Rank Lower Grade Martial Technique and could unleash the combat strength of the first tier of the True Martial Realm.
The might of the Five Elements Palm Seal could be raised to that of top Heaven Rank Lower Grade Martial Techniques. When perfected, it rivaled a Heaven Rank Middle Grade Martial Technique and could unleash the combat strength of the second tier of the True Martial Realm.
The might of the Seal Heaven Manual could be elevated to that of top Heaven rank intermediate Martial Techniques. When perfected, it rivaled a Heaven Rank High Grade Martial Technique. Using the Zhenjun Sword, he could explode with the combat strength of the third tier of the True Martial Realm, and with a Heaven Rank Lower Grade Divine Sword, the power was estimated to be comparable to the fourth tier of the True Martial Realm.
After sorting out his thoughts, Han Li finally had a clear understanding of his own combat strength.
At the moment, he could burst forth the combat strength of the third tier of the True Martial Realm, and with a suitable weapon, his combat ability could increase significantly.
Prince Wu’an was at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but Han Li, who was at the complete seventh tier of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, had combat strength that far surpassed his.
Comparing himself to Prince Wu’an, Han Li found that he seemed to be able to slap him to death with a single palm, or at the very least, he could inflict heavy damage on Prince Wu’an.
The ninth tier of the True Martial Realm differed by many times in strength between each tier, and Prince Wu’an’s strength was only comparable to the combat ability of the first tier of the True Martial Realm, just slightly higher than those at the threshold combat ability of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
“It’s a pity.”
Looking at the other martial techniques he possessed, especially in terms of speed, Han Li felt a bit of a headache; he still had weaknesses.
Previously, his speed and defense, Divine Spirit, and Spiritual Sense were the strongest, and his offensive power lagged behind. Now his offensive power was the strongest, with Divine Spirit and Spiritual Sense following, and his defense and speed the weakest.
The Step Booster Technique was just a Profound Rank Supreme Martial Technique; even with the support of the All-Powerful Martial Path, it was only comparable to a top Earth Rank Mid Grade Martial Technique, with its perfected state allowing about sixteen thousand miles in a single step, and a distance of nearly one hundred thousand miles in the span of a breath.
This speed was only somewhat faster than the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm but fell short of the True Martial Realm, where a practitioner could cross at least one hundred and fifty thousand miles in a breath.
“However, I seem to be able to go faster, stronger…” Han Li frowned slightly, recalling the sensation from before.
After consecutive breakthroughs in cultivation, his senses had drastically sharpened, seemingly entering a new domain he had never heard of before.
Thinking it over, Han Li decided to explore this mysterious domain. If it could genuinely enhance his strength, that would be more than welcome.
Although his current strength allowed him to be honored in the Daqian Empire and ranked him among the strongest in the Xuan Domain, he still fell short of those veteran True Martial Realm practitioners.
In an instant, Han Li elevated his senses to their utmost limit and stood within a mysterious domain, with the road ahead shrouded in fog, obscuring everything..

chapters.title: Chapter 137 - 124 Divine Sense! Five New Aliases! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 124 Divine Sense! Five New Aliases! 2
Translator: 549690339
But he could clearly sense that each aspect of his bodily functions was skyrocketing, his abilities increasing fivefold in an instant.
Standing within this mysterious realm, Han Li looked outward, observing a bird flying past, but its speed seemed to be five times slower than usual.
He frowned slightly, then a look of pleasure appeared on his face. It wasn’t that the bird’s speed had decreased by five times, but rather, standing in this mysterious realm, his own speed had increased.
This mysterious realm seemed to involve time; in his eyes, every motion in the outside world automatically slowed down by a factor of five, giving him ample time to react, dodge, or counterattack.
Beyond that, in this state, his overall strength had soared, his speed had increased fivefold, his attack power had gone up by five times, and his defense had strenghtened by fivefold…
Merely three seconds later, Han Li automatically exited the mysterious realm, feeling a bit mentally fatigued.
Han Li tried to enter the mysterious realm again and succeeded, but the duration was even shorter, lasting only a brief two seconds.
After that, Han Li did not continue to try. He knew he had to hurry back, not Imowing how long the tests would take.
If too much time passed, his beautiful wife and concubines, and his family descendents would start worrying about his safety, and conducting experiments within the migrating group wouldn’t be affected.
Han Li took steps, crossing a distance of sixteen thousand miles in just five steps, less than a single breath’s time, returning to the carriage much faster than when he had left.
After sharing an affectionate moment with Lu Tianxiang, Han Li went to find Lin Yiyin, Li Mingmeng, and the other ladies to chat for a bit before returning to Lu Tianxiang’s side.
Embracing Lu Tianxiang’s soft body, Han Li chatted with her while devoting a part of his mind to continue experimenting.
The dawn light was faint; the sky gradually brightened.
The Han Mansion’s migrating caravan set off from Dongshan Manor of Jizhou towards Dongchuan Manor of Jizhou, one of the two gateways from Jizhou to
Yuanzhou.
After several days of continuous study, Han Li finally finished his experimentation, understanding a part of this mysterious realm.
He named the realm “Divine Sense,” a state he could only enter after enhancing his five senses to a certain level and breaking through a certain shackle.
In the state of Divine Sense, his combat abilities were enhanced fivefold, but the state could only be maintained for a maximum of six seconds.
The first entry lasted three seconds, the second lasted two seconds, and the third one second; after three times, he needed three hours to recover.
If he didn’t enter Divine Sense continuously, he only needed a quarter of an hour’s rest for his divine spirit to recover, allowing him to enter again, but only up to six times. After six times, he still required three hours to recover.
There were pros and cons to each method of using Divine Sense. The first method was like a true man of six seconds, during which Han Li’s strength soared fivefold for six seconds, possessing mid-stage True Martial Realm combat ability, with six hours of “sage time.”
The second method was more suitable for sustained combat, where he could burst with strength six times within five quarters of an hour, each burst lasting three seconds, retaining mid-stage True Martial Realm combat power, and still six hours of sage time.
Understanding all this bolstered Han Li’s confidence. He finally had a significant card up his sleeve for self-preservation.
Moreover, he had just begun to explore the realm of Divine Sense. He believed that as his cultivation further increased, he could delve deeper and perhaps even further amplify his combat ability.
The outside world mostly knew him as a Guru in the God Refining Realm, some of his beautiful concubines knew he was a Grandmaster of the Hollow Void
Stage, and Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye knew he had the combat ability of the
Myriad Phenomena Realm.
But no one knew his strength had surged by dozens or even hundreds of times in a short period, and his ultimate combat power could reach the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm.
Han Li was now feeling an impulse to head to Huozhou City and give Prince Wu’an a slap in the face, to vent his frustrations; Prince Wu’an had suffocated him with pressure before.
Currently, his strength was one of the top in the Daqian Empire and Prince Wu’an was no match for him, but it was unknown what level the true power of the hidden True Martial Realm ancestor of the Daqian Empire was.
The thought of acting on impulse vanished as quickly as it came, and Han Li mentally urged himself to stay steady and avoid recklessness—it wasn’t the time to reveal himself.
Leveraging his past experiences, Han Li planned to prepare several more disguises to facilitate his actions, as his identity as the old patriarch of the Han Family restricted him from doing many things.
After careful consideration, Han Li decided to set up five more significant pseudonyms.
One pseudonym would use the Diamond Indestructible Body Protection
Technique and the Dragon Suppressing Palm; another would use the God Wasteland Imprisoning Finger; another would wield the Xuantian Punch and the God Slaying Sword Art; another would use the Five Elements Grand
Handprint; and the last one would employ the Heaven Sealing Sword Canon.
The Step Booster Technique would be universal, as long as he was careful, it would be hard for others to detect any clues.
In this way, Han Li would have six identities, including his own, which could also use the Xuantian Punch and the God Slaying Sword Art but to a lesser extent, sufficient for the God Refining Realm level.
“Huff-”
Han Li let out a breath, took Lu Tianxiang’s pretty face in his hands and gave her a kiss, which made her feel somewhat helpless as Han Li would take liberties with her whenever he pleased.
Although she was starting to like this feeling, could she admit it?
To admit it would mean admitting she had fallen for Han Li, which would make this shameless rogue look down on her.
“What are you doing?” Lu Tianxiang glared at him, her tone dissatisfied.
“Just happy about something, hehe,” said Han Li with a laugh, though he had no plans to elaborate.
After creating a few new pseudonyms, his future actions would be much more convenient, and each of these five personas had strong combat abilities.
One at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, two at the first level of the True Martial Realm, one at the second level of the True Martial Realm, and the last one even at the fourth or fifth level of the True Martial Realm.
Han Li had already decided to give both the Zhenjun Sword and the Divine Sense to the pseudonym that used the Heaven Sealing Sword Canon, to cultivate the strongest pseudonym in terms of combat ability.
“Should I go and patch things up with that Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi at the
Yinyang Sect right now?”
This idea suddenly popped up in Han Li’s mind.
As long as he did not use the pseudonym that employed the Dragon Suppressing Palm and the Diamond Indestructible Body Protection Technique, even Yun Miaoyi would not be able to recognize that it was Han Li.
Nobody else would have a clue, either; they would only feel that a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu had suddenly appeared and speculate that it must be the entry of some top-tier power into the shadows.
After all, a mysterious Great Grandmaster had already appeared before. “Forget it, I’ll let her off this time,” Han Li reconsidered and abandoned the idea.
“Forget it, I’ll let her off this time,” Han Li reconsidered and abandoned the idea.
Yun Miaoyi was hidden somewhere, and if she was staying within the Yinyang Sect’s gates, he wouldn’t dare to force his way in – it wasn’t worth the stand-off.
“But in the future, could I potentially become a major power all on my own?” Another thought emerged in Han Li’s mind.
After pondering for a while, he felt this idea was viable.
If he shaped all five pseudonyms to appear from the same power, wouldn’t the outside world get scared upon seeing a power with four True Martial Realm Emperor Wus? They would definitely be extremely wary, not daring to offend disciples of this power. If the four True Martial Realm level practitioners joined forces, who in the Xuan Domain could withstand them?
“Ah, if only I could split myself,” Han Li sighed.
The five pseudonyms he had created couldn’t appear simultaneously; this was a loophole. If he had a way to split himself, he would completely patch this weakness.

chapters.title: Chapter 138 - 125: Yao Xi and the Empress 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Chapter 125: Yao Xi and the Empress 1
Translator: 549690339
The migration caravan stopped for a month at Dongchuan Manor for reasons other than travel; they were receiving those forces wishing to forge good relations.
For these forces, Han Li handled them with the same old rules, and these forces were well aware of the practices of the Han Family’s patriarch and did not mind.
After all, they only wanted to establish a good connection. It would be best for them to marry into the Han Family as concubines to the patriarch, but becoming concubines to the distinguished descendants of the Han Family would also be quite satisfactory.
In Dongchuan Manor, Han Li did not take any more concubines, mainly because there were no suitable candidates. He did not even look at those below his standards, leaving his descendants to handle the situation by themselves.
Once everything was settled, the Han Mansion migration team set out again, passing through Dongchuan Pass to enter Yuanzhou, and then followed the predetermined route towards Yonchang Manor.
Upon entering Yuanzhou, they found the treatment far inferior to that in Qingzhou and Jizhou, but Han Li understood the reasons behind this.
The Han Family did not take root in Qingzhou and Jizhou, meaning their influence did not extend to the interests of each force in those territories, but news of the Han Family’s migration to Yuanzhou had spread early on. They were now competing for territory in Yuanzhou and seizing resources from the existing forces there.
The Han Mansion as an Immortal Refining Clan could rank within the top three simply by settling in any manor, and they would be within the top hundred in the whole of Yuanzhou.
For those clans and forces at the Gangyuan Realm and the Pihai Realm or below, the Han Mansion would take a lot of resources that belonged to them, which these forces were not happy about.
The Immortal Refining Clan forces were just a bit wary but realized after some analysis that the Han Family patriarch was good at dealing with people and probably wouldn’t affect their interests.
Some forces in Yuanzhou had already collected information about the Han Family and its patriarch. They hadn’t cared much before because the strength that the Han Familys patriarch had shown was very weak, but now they began to pay more attention to it.
It was just a slight increase in attention, though. When in Leizhou, the Han Family’s patriarch had always resided in a small county town, and for decades, neither he nor his family had actively competed for cultivation resources. It has only been in the past two or three decades that they began selling Spirit Pills and Spiritual Artifacts.
Immortal Refining Clan forces generally do not wage war against each other, as each of such forces is part of the upper layer in a large state. Unless one force is confident that it can quickly annihilate another, a mutually detrimental war would simply benefit other forces.
The Dongxu Stage Forces, being essentially the top echelon of a state, essentially have the Immortal Refining Clan forces under them, nominally within their jurisdiction.
The Dongxu Stage Forces don’t care much, Immortal Refining Clan forces pay some attention, and those at the Gangyuan Realm, Pihai Realm, and below are somewhat in disarray.
After the Han Mansion’s migration team entered Yuanzhou, various small forces became active, constantly keeping an eye on the Han Mansion’s movements, eager to learn exactly which manor the Han Mansion would settle in.
They all knew that the Han Mansion planned to move into Yonchang Manor, but they were unsure if this was a feint, so most small forces would not be at ease until they saw the Han Mansion firmly established in a specific manor.
Although the Immortal Refining Clan forces counted among the upper layer of the state, they could only influence one or two manors. There are twenty or thirty manors within a state, but these are usually occupied by major forces, whether they are Dongxu Stage Forces, Immortal Refining Clans, or occasionally one of the Ten Major Sects.
Once the Han Mansion settles in a manor, it would only be able to influence that manor; the surrounding manors remain under the control of other Immortal Refining Clan forces.
Two months later, the Han Family migration team entered Xuanshi Manor.
Inside a luxurious carriage sat four people: Han Li, Lu Tianxiang, and the sisters Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin.
Ever since guiding Lu Tianxiang through an issue, Lin Yiwu became quite close with her, and her sister Lin Yiyin often joined them, leading to Lu Tianxiang becoming familiar with Lin Yiyin as well.
The two sisters maintained appropriate boundaries. Lu Tianxiang was Han Li’s wife, and they were simply his concubines. It was always right to be on good terms with Lu Tianxiang.
Han Li was dressed in blue clothing, Lu Tianxiang wore a red dress, Lin Yiwu was in a white gown, and Lin Yiyin was clad in a blue skirt.
“Husband, come and have some grapes-”
Lin Yiyin was seated to the left of Han Li, holding onto his arm with one hand while offering grapes to his mouth with the other.
Han Li took a grape into his mouth and after chewing a few times, found it quite tasty.
Lin Yiwu sat across from Han Li; after peeling an orange, she stood up and brought it to his mouth, tenderly helping him eat it.
Lu Tianxiang, seated in the innermost section, watched this affectionate display between master and concubines with some distaste in her heart.
That bastard Han Li deliberately brought Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin to wait on him, putting on a show to provoke her into compliance.
Yesterday Han Li wanted Lu Tianxiang to feed him a Spirit Energy-filled sweet pomelo, but Lu Tianxiang was reluctant. Today, Han Li brought the two sisters to demonstrate to Lu Tianxiang.
“Hmph- I, the Sect Hierarch, would never stoop to such acts,” Lu Tianxiang thought indignantly feeling the need to reaffirm her status.
After all, she was Han Li’s only wife, though not yet married, so how could she demean herself by serving him like the other concubines?
Wouldn’t the Sect Hierarch lose face?
Lu Tianxiang turned her pretty face away to look out of the window, deciding on an ‘out of sight, out of mind’ approach to avoid swallowing this dose of ‘dog food.’
She suddenly exclaimed, as Han Li pulled her over, but she did not struggle. Han Li placed her on his lap, took the fruits from Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, and fed them to her personally. Lu Tianxiang’s heart bloomed with happiness, yet she haughtily turned her face away.
Han Li chuckled, whispering in her ear with warm breath, “Xiangxiang, being disobedient might lead to a whipping.”
Lu Tianxiang was momentarily stunned before realizing what he meant; her cheeks immediately flushed a deep red like dawn’s first light, exceptionally charming.
After dealing with Lu Tianxiang, Han Li gestured for Lin Yiwu to sit to his right, enjoying the embrace of a beauty on each side, and yet another stunning woman on his lap.

chapters.title: Chapter 139 - 125: Yao Xi and the Empress_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Chapter 125: Yao Xi and the Empress_2
Translator: 549690339
Han Li was quite tempted, but he didn’t act rashly. The sisters could accept holding a meeting, but Lu Tianxiang clearly couldn’t, and she would even be unwilling to have private discussions.
“Husband-” Lin Yiwu called out softly.
“Yiwu, do you have something you want to tell your husband?” Han Li turned his face to look at Lin Yiwu.
As the saying goes, to look charming in every way, Lin Yiwu was already incredibly beautiful, and at this moment, dressed in white, she was a truly stunning and lovely woman.
“Something seems off with Xi Xi recently, should husband go take a look?” Worriedness filled Lin Yiwu’s eyes.
Lin Yiyin joined in and said, “Husband, Yin’er has noticed too. Sometimes Xi Xi talks to herself in the carriage, and her tone is different, as if she’s become a different person. ”
“I’ve asked her, but she said there’s nothing like that, and she has no such memory.”
Han Li’s eyebrows slightly wrinkled as the image of the young cutie Yao Xi and her voice and smile came to his mind. Could it be that the seal within her soul had come loose?
Before moving, Yao Xi had complained about headaches and often had inexplicable characters flashing through her mind. After understanding the situation, Han Li deduced it was part of a powerful cultivation technique.
Yao Xi also mentioned some place names, but none of those places existed in Qianyuan Divine Province.
However, they moved soon after, and many things happened during the relocation. He got occupied with conquering Lu Tianxiang, handling the matter of Jiang Baiye, and then focusing on his own combat ability, indeed, he had not checked on the little Ioli for quite a while.
Yao Xi was only about thirteen or fourteen years old now, and Han Li didn’t dare to pluck this tender flower. He simply decided to raise her first and would talk about it when she grew up.
“What are your thoughts, Tianxiang?” Han Li turned to look at Lu Tianxiang in his arms.
Lu Tianxiang shook her head and said, “I don’t know what this condition is.”
In fact, she had a guess in her heart. This condition seemed to align with the predicament of great beings on the verge of breaking the mystery from within the womb, after being reincarnated.
Powerful experts who cultivated to the Tongxuan Realm had the chance to be reborn. If guided by other strong beings, they could quickly break the mystery and remember everything from their past life, advancing swiftly in cultivation with the experience from their former life.
If there was no strong being to guide them, then they had to rely on themselves to break the mystery, which was difficult. History recorded many such powerful experts who disappeared without a trace after reincarnation, living and dying as one of the masses.
However, Lu Tianxiang didn’t believe that someone as powerful as a reincarnated great being would appear beside Han Li; that would be too fortuitous. It would mean that Han Li had such good luck that he could casually pick up a reincarnated great being to bring home.
With her delicate and charming features, Yao Xi was the epitome of a beautiful woman in the making. Even at thirteen or fourteen, she was already stunning, and she would be a breathtaking beauty when she grew up. Even if she wouldn’t quite match up to herself, she wouldn’t be far behind.
Lu Tianxiang was well aware of Han Li’s plan to raise Ioli’s, and with his lecherous nature, once Yao Xi grew up, he would definitely take her into his fold as a concubine.
Han Li nodded. He was just asking casually since Lu Tianxiang didn’t know he didn’t press on.
“Then you two chat, I’m going to check on Yao Xi.”
As his voice faded, Han Li’s figure vanished, reappearing inside another carriage.
This carriage was set up in a cutesy and tender style, brimming with a young girl’s heart. Yao Xi was sitting by the window, supporting her chin with both hands as she looked outside.
When Han Li appeared beside her, Yao Xi didn’t notice at all.
“Xi Xi, what are you looking at?” Han Li stretched out his hand to ruffle her little head.
“Ah? Brother, you came.”
At the sound of his voice, Yao Xi immediately turned around, a surprised and joyful smile spreading across her little face.
“Brother hasn’t come to see Xi Xi for a long time, Xi Xi missed you very much.”
Yao Xi reached out to grasp Han Li’s big hand, as if this gave her some sense of security.
“Then, should brother come to see you more often?”
“Yes, yes.” Yao Xi nodded vigorously, her small hand still clutching tightly to Han Li’s big hand.
Han Li’s brows furrowed slightly. Yao Xi’s reaction was a bit off. Thinking it over, he directly asked, “Xi Xi, have there been any strange memories appearing in your mind recently?”
He suspected that the seal within Yao Xi’s soul had loosened, causing some memories to leak out. These were likely the memories from her past life.
But Yao Xi had not yet broken the riddle of the womb, and seeing these memories might lead to some unwanted effects, such as speeding up the process of unraveling the womb riddle and completely recovering past-life memories.
Generally speaking, once past-life memories are recovered, a person’s disposition is greatly altered, given that the current life is short while the previous one could have spanned thousands or tens of thousands of years.
Those capable of reincarnation and rebirth are at least great powers of the Tongxuan Realm, living for ten thousand years, but Tongxuan Realm great powers only meet the standard for reincarnation and rebirth, with a low success rate; Saints of the Shengyuan Realm are the mainstream.
Saints live exceedingly long lives, up to one hundred thousand years, and it is not an exaggeration to say they have achieved immortal life.
After Han Li broke through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, his lifespan significantly increased, and together with the lifespan rewards from his descendants, it reached a little more than one thousand six hundred years, similar to the years many in the True Martial Realm had lived through.
The lifespan of the Myriad Phenomena Realm is only one percent of that in the Shengyuan Realm, but their strength doesn’t even amount to one-millionth of a Saint’s.
If Yao Xi showed signs of unraveling the riddle of the womb, then he would have to intervene. Han Li didn’t want her to awaken her past-life memories too soon.
A Yao Xi awakened to her past-life memories wouldn’t be easy to control, as she was a being whose strength once far exceeded his; who knew what methods she had?
He preferred to control the current Yao Xi, to wait until Yao Xi grew up, until she became dependent on him, fell in love with him, to take her in—then it wouldn’t be too late to help her awaken her past-life memories.
The older Yao Xi got, and the more she experienced, even if she awoke to her past-life memories, there would be room for struggle, and she would not immediately become dominated by those memories.
“Hmm-” Yao Xi responded softly, a trace of worry appearing on her little face.
Han Li’s large hand rested on her head, rubbing gently, and he spoke softly,
“Don’t be afraid, brother is here.”
“I’ll help you check later, don’t be scared.”
“With brother here, Xi Xi isn’t scared,” Yao Xi said, lifting her head to look at Han Li’s face.
Han Li nodded, and sent a thread of his Spiritual Sense into Yao Xi’s mind to probe the secrets of her soul.
Previously, he hadn’t dared to do so due to insufficient strength, but now that his Divine Spirit was comparable to the True Martial Realm, he was capable of doing some things.
After checking, Han Li furrowed his brow; the seal at the deepest part of Yao Xi’s soul had indeed loosened.
This loosening of the seal caused some past-life memories to surface, confusing Yao Xi’s memories; no wonder Yao Xi would occasionally change temperaments and talk to herself.
At the same time, the loosening of the seal also made Yao Xi’s soul more complete, significantly strengthening her mental power, revealing some of her hidden talents, which astonishingly reached Third Grade, surprising Han Li.
This further solidified Han Li’s resolve. Then, the thread of Spiritual Sense took on Han Li’s form, and he formed several seals with his hands and stamped them onto the loosened part of the seal, creating a new barrier to isolate it.
“No matter what abilities you had in your past life, in this life you’re destined to be under my control.”
Han Li snorted coldly in his heart; Yao Xi was a golden seedling he was nurturing by his side, waiting to reap in the future.
When he first discovered the seal in Yao Xi’s soul, he had already harbored such intentions. A strong reincarnated being is easiest to control in their weaker years.
Once Yao Xi’s seal was wholly removed, her talents would return to her past-life levels, which would be at least First Grade—a wife or concubine that Han Li could only dream of taking.
When Third Grade Han Yongzhen was born, it brought Han Li exceedingly generous rewards, but should a First Grade descendant appear, then the rewards might be ten or even a hundred times more bountiful.
First Grade talent is rare in both the Xuan Domain and the Qianyuan Divine Province, a once-in-a-lifetime encounter; since it appeared by his side, he definitely would not let it slip away.
As Han Li was reinforcing Yao Xi’s seal, within the vast and endless Yuankun Domain, in a brilliant and prosperous Imperial Court.
An entity clad in Golden Divine Armor, exuding layers of golden ripples from her delicate body, commanding boundless prestige, suddenly looked up, her eyes flashing with anger.
“Who dares to seal the fragment of my Divine Spirit!”
A tremendous voice rose in the majestic hall, a terrifying aura quaking the universe, alarming countless ancient beings.
The Golden Armor Empress stepped majestically toward the outside of the palace, her graceful curves rippling intensely.
Recently, she had sensed that the seal on a fragment of her spirit was loosening and that she would be able to pinpoint its location after a little while longer, but suddenly that faint connection had disappeared.
Clearly, someone with nefarious intentions had tampered with her spirit fragment.

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 126 Arrival at Yonchang Manor (Subscription Request)_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 126 Arrival at Yonchang Manor (Subscription Request)_l
Translator: 549690339
Xuanshi City.
It was still that mansion with tall gates and a large courtyard.
At this moment, a lady in a purple dress was brewing tea, while a beauty in a yellow dress played the zither. Both were at ease, thoroughly enjoying themselves.
“What a comfortable life,” said the lady in purple, lifting her cup to savor a sip of the freshly brewed Spiritual Tea, relishing the moment.
They had been living in the manor for nearly two years, hidden away in the mortal world without any contact with Xuanshi City’s Cultivation Realm.
The saying ‘the greatest hiddenness is to seem ordinary’ held true here. Hidden in this place, even the mad dogs of the Jingye Office hadn’t pursued them here, allowing the two women to gradually lower their guard.
The lady in purple quite liked their current life—no need to fight and kill, no need to struggle for cultivation resources, and no need to lurk cautiously and walk on thin ice in the capital city of the Daqian Empire.
They were from the God Refining Realm, but their lifespans were not just limited to five hundred years—they nearly had two thousand years because they were from the Demon Clan.
Within the same realm, members of the Demon Clan had lifespans three or four times longer than the Human Clan, a unique advantage of their race. However, the Demon Clan’s disadvantage was also clear: their cultivation speed was six to seven times slower than the humans’, and sometimes even more than ten times slower.
For the lady in purple and the beauty in yellow, with more than a thousand years of life remaining, they had plenty of time to enjoy life leisurely for a very long time.
Setting her teacup down, the lady in purple looked to the beauty playing the zither, and thinking of a recent rumor, she spoke up,
“I heard that an Immortal Refining Clan has just moved to Yuanzhou and will soon pass through our Xuanshi City. Their patriarch is extremely lecherous, frequently taking concubines. Would you like to go and trouble him?”
“That Han Family patriarch has moved from Leizhou to Qingzhou, to Jizhou, then Yuanzhou, taking concubines every step of the way during his migration. He truly deserves the title of ‘Concubine-taking Elder,”‘ she added.
The music from the zither ceased abruptly.
“Are you talking about that Concubine-taking Elder who forcefully abducts women as his concubines, treats them as cauldrons for cultivation, and exploits them daily?” the beauty in yellow asked in a deep voice.
She detested two kinds of people the most in her life: faithless men and demonic cultivators who prey on female cultivators. If she encountered such individuals, she vowed to eliminate them.
Back in the capital of the Daqian Empire, the official’s son she devoured was the former type. The beauty in yellow had witnessed how he abandoned his true love and treated her as nothing more than an object, abusing his power to commit wrongdoing.
“It doesn’t seem so. The concubines he took along the way were all willingly offered by various factions, and reportedly, they all live quite comfortably,” the lady in purple said with an uncertain tone.
“Then there’s no rush,” the beauty in yellow replied, shaking her head. Such matters required thorough investigation, and she didn’t want to accidentally harm the innocent.
If that Concubine-taking Elder was indeed relocating his clan to Yuanzhou, they could pay more attention to him in the future. If he turned out to be one of those demonic cultivators who exploit others, she would show no mercy.
“Didn’t a great battle occur recently in Leizhou? Four great Grandmasters participated, and ultimately, the Mother of Non-Existence fell into the hands of a mysterious Grandmaster. It’s unclear what the situation is now,” continued the lady in purple.
The beauty in yellow shook her head, “Such matters don’t require our concern.” The Myriad Phenomena Realm was far from them, and the issue was unrelated to them.
“Boring, ” the lady in purple pouted, but resigned herself to quell her curiosity.
On the other side, within the convoy of Han Mansion in the midst of relocation, Han Li witnessed this scene.
“Interesting, ” he thought.
To think that there were members of the Demon Clan in Yuanzhou, and just hundreds of miles ahead in Xuanshi City, were two late-stage God Refining Realm cultivators.
Glancing at Lu Tianxiang in his arms, Han Li thought to himself, “These are indeed demonesses.”
Lu Tianxiang was once called a ‘demoness’ as well, but that was just a term, a pejorative title. However, the two women in Xuanshi City were genuine demonesses, female cultivators from the Demon Clan.
Yet, these two demonesses had quite the nerve to venture into the heartland of the Human Clan, a move that could only be described as brash and outrageous.
Situated to the southeast of Xuan Domain, which is located in the central region of Qianyuan Divine Province, the Divine Province is divided into eight regions and two seas. Apart from the Barbarian Region to the north and the Demon Domain to the south, the other six regions and most of the seas are dominated by the Human Clan.
Referring to Daqian as the heart of the Human Clan would not be an exaggeration.
Due to its favorable location, Xuan Domain attracted the attention of various parties wanting a piece of it, preventing a unified power from emerging since the ancient calamities.
“I wonder what those two God Refining Realm demonesses taste like, how succulent they might be. Should I capture and sample them?” pondered Han Li.
His Spiritual Sense spread in all directions, observing everything within its range, penetrating through the veil around the lady in purple and the beauty in yellow.
After advancing to the seventh layer of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, his Spiritual Sense matched that of the True Martial Realm, capable of covering an area as large as five hundred thousand miles. However, this consumed a great deal of mental energy.
Han Li maintained a coverage area of only one hundred thousand miles during the migration, within which, given his strength, no one in the Daqian Empire could hide from his scrutiny.
The two demonesses couldn’t have imagined that despite their utmost caution, they had fallen into the eyes of a certain elder.
They had set up a concealment formation to prevent detection by Spiritual Sense. Even close scrutiny from the Myriad Phenomena Realm would likely miss it, which should have been sufficient.
Normally, Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm wouldn’t visit a manor city, nor would they scan broadly and closely with their Spiritual Sense without good reason, let alone Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm.
But Elder Han was different. He carefully maintained a one hundred thousand mile coverage of his Spiritual Sense during the migration to preemptively deal with any potential crises.
Upon detecting the concealment formation, Han Li, concerned about an ambush, penetrated it with his Spiritual Sense. The two demonesses never realized that someone had opened a gap in their concealment formation, allowing their entire conversation to reach Han Li’s ears.
“Practice abstinence, practice abstinence, do not stir up trouble for now,” Han Li quickly abandoned the thought, but still couldn’t resist marking the two demonic females.
The two demonic females, having cultivated to the late stages of the God Refining Realm with hopes of reaching the Hollow Void Stage, possessed decent aptitudes and high attractiveness. He could consider them as potential concubines and decided to capture them if the opportunity arose.
Mostly because the two demonic females seemed not inherently evil and had not sought him out for trouble, Han Li couldn’t find an excuse to take them as concubines.
Old Ancestor Han had already passed the early stages of craving and now had higher standards, setting his sights on high-quality female cultivators like Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye.
Capturing two with fourth-grade talents wouldn’t be of much use; he already had descendants of fourth-grade aptitude. Besides the novelty of their true demonic identities, which was a bonus, the two demonic females weren’t much different from his other beautiful concubines.
“It’s all because your talents aren’t good enough, you don’t have that fortune,” Han Li sighed secretly. If the two demonic females had fourth-grade talents, he wouldn’t care so much and would capture them first and deal with the rest later.
The two demonic females in Xuanshi City were blissfully unaware they had narrowly escaped a predicament; they continued to enjoy the pleasures of life, luxuries they couldn’t have in the Demon Domain.
When the Han Mansion’s migration caravan passed through Xuanshi City, the watching powers heaved a sigh of relief, grateful that the caravan did not take root in Xuanshi City.
According to the route, after passing through Xuanshi City and two more manors, they would reach their destination, Yonchang Manor.
As the migration caravan entered the next manor, Han Li was in the luxurious carriage, playing with Han Yongzhen and talking to the little fellow.
Don’t be fooled by Han Yongzhen’s few months of age; he was already as tall as a normal child of two or three, exceptionally intelligent and brimming with spiritual energy, and he could already speak.
After handing Han Yongzhen over to Lu Tianxiang to care for, Han Li watched the interaction between mother and son, yet his mind was pondering another matter.
Would Sword Immortal Jiang Baiye keep her promise and arrive as agreed?
It had been more than half a year since he last met Jiang Baiye, captured her, and made her swear an oath.
According to the agreement, Jiang Baiye was to join him within a year, leaving roughly two months now.
If Jiang Baiye failed to show up, Han Li would not be lenient; he would simply don another disguise and annihilate the Canghai Sect, capturing Jiang Baiye himself.
Last time, aside from making Jiang Baiye vow a spiritual oath, he had also implanted a mental seed in her mind to prevent any leaks of information.
For the past half-year, Han Li hadn’t been paying much attention, nor did he deliberately pry into Jiang Baiye’s privacy. However, this didn’t mean he wouldn’t notice; he would be immediately aware if Jiang Baiye considered revealing anything.
The mental seed would also self-destruct immediately, destroying Jiang Baiye’s divine spirit.
From the beginning to end, Han Li had not sensed any inclination from Jiang Baiye to divulge any information, so he was not in a hurry. No matter what, Jiang Baiye couldn’t escape his grasp.
Although Han Li had some reservations at first, now that he possessed True Martial Realm combat ability and could easily kill Prince Wu’an, why worry about the exposure of the Body-Cultivating Furnace?
Even if his possession of the Mother of No Birth and the mysterious Great Grandmaster being Han Li were revealed, he wasn’t concerned, for strength was the best confidence.
That said, unless necessary, Han Li still preferred to keep it under wraps, not flaunting it deliberately, but he wouldn’t fear it when push came to shove.
From beginning to end, Han Li understood a key point: he was just lying low, not being cowardly.
If, when trouble loomed, he still thought of avoiding it despite having the strength to deal with it, then that would indeed be cowardly.
Qingzhou, Canghai Sect.
Jiang Baiye stood atop a mountain peak, which was her cultivation ground.
As one of the Sect Heirs, Jiang Baiye had her own mountain peak in the Sect early on, where she could establish her cultivation ground.
After returning to the Sect last time, she kept her oath and revealed no information about Han Li to her master or the Sect.
Jian Ziyun, who had much he wanted to say, hesitated repeatedly. He was a Hollow Realm Master, and yet he was humiliated by being knocked unconscious in a sneak attack and couldn’t understand why.
He also wanted to know who Jiang Baiye had met that night, what happened afterward, and how he safely returned to the Sect.
Jiang Baiye didn’t go into details, only advising her master not to dig deeper as it could bring disaster upon the Sect.
Chilled by the thought, Jian Ziyun realized anyone capable of knocking him out instantly and threatening the Sect’s existence must be at least a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Since Jiang Baiye was reluctant to speak, Jian Ziyun didn’t press her. With the issue involving a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and the Canghai Sect already under great pressure, it was indeed inadvisable to provoke other formidable enemies.
Jiang Baiye did not mention anything about the Body-Cultivating Furnace from beginning to end. She didn’t want her master to know too much, reasoning that she would recover it herself.
She had already dealt with all matters within the Sect and could go to meet Han Li, but she hesitated to leave.
Jiang Baiye knew that once she left to meet Han Li, it would be difficult to return to the Canghai Sect. She wanted to take one last long look at the Sect where she had spent decades, filled with her memories.
She also knew that after joining Han Li, that shameless lecher would not let her off easily, and she wouldn’t be able to resist a Grandmaster; she would likely lose her virtue to him.
Thus, Jiang Baiye wanted to delay as long as possible. After all, there was a year’s time; she would prolong it as much as she could.
Jiang Baiye remained on the mountain, quietly overlooking the Sect until the date of the agreement approached. Only then did she rise, bid farewell to her master, claiming she needed to undergo a period of cultivation outside.
As Jiang Baiye descended the mountain, Han Li, on the other hand, arrived at his destination, Yonchang Manor, while sitting in the carriage.

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 127 Chengsheng Mountain_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 127 Chengsheng Mountain_1
Translator: 549690339
The Han Family’s migration caravan arrived at Yonchang Manor.
At this moment, it was undoubtedly the center of attention, with countless spies observing from all around.
Most of these spies came from the forces within Yonchang Manor, as well as forces from neighboring manors, all wanting to know whether the Han Mansion was going to take root in Yonchang Manor.
“Please don’t settle in Yonchang Manor!”
Many cultivators prayed frantically in their hearts, especially those from the Gangyuan Realm, whose expressions were particularly ugly.
Despite its agreeable name, Yonchang Manor had average cultivation resources and lacked significant Spirit Stone Mines, Spiritual Materials Mines, or even high-grade medicinal fields.
Since ancient times, the level of spiritual energy in Yonchang Manor had always been low, with no gathering spots for spiritual energy, resembling a valley of low spiritual energy.
Great Grandmasters from the Myriad Phenomena Realm had come to investigate, but found no clue, considering it possible that the Spirit Veins of Yonchang Manor were completely shattered during the great catastrophe of ancient times.
Therefore, forces of the Immortal Refining Realm looked down on Yonchang
Manor, taking root in other manors instead. Not to mention the powers of the Hollow Void Stage and the Myriad Phenomena Realm, who chose locations with rich spiritual energy for their sects.
Although no forces of the Immortal Refining Realm and above were in Yonchang Manor, it had attracted quite a few forces of the Gangyuan Realm, as well as those below the Pihai Realm.
A manor without a powerful force dominating it was an eldorado for smaller forces, free from oppression and restrictions by larger ones, allowing them to develop freely.
There were many reasons why Han Li chose Yonchang Manor, including this factor.
Yonchang Manor was very suitable for the development of the Han Family; without encroaching on the interests of other major forces, they wouldn’t face resistance. Otherwise, other major forces would cause constant trouble for the Han Mansion with various schemes.
Though Han Li was unafraid, he didn’t want to be entangled in troubles that would affect his mood, nor did he want to show too much of his strength too soon.
Besides himself and Lu Tianxiang, the Han Mansion currently had only Lin Yiwu as a Great Master of the Gangyuan Realm, with a fair number of cultivators in the Pihai and Innate Realms, not yet affected by the shortage of spiritual energy.
As for when the family grew stronger and the number of powerful members increased, there was no need to worry. By then, Han Li would have arranged everything to ensure the smooth development of the family.
Soon, the various forces and families of Yonchang Manor despaired and became anxious as the news that the Han Mansion had taken root in Yonchang Manor was confirmed.
An Immortal Refining Clan, although only one elder of the Han Family was notable (outsiders were unaware of the cultivation level of Han Li’s concubine), still overshadowed all the other forces.
The power structure in Yonchang Manor had long been established, with a relatively stable distribution of resources and interests, which would not be easily altered.
But all the leaders of these forces knew that the skies of Yonchang Manor had changed at this moment; a colossal entity like the Han Family had relocated here.
The elder of the Han Family had a high cultivation level and was destined to live a long life, yet his family was weak and in need of substantial development.
What does developing a family require?
It requires all sorts of cultivation resources, talents, territories, and more…
Prior to this, everything was in the hands of the various forces of Yonchang Manor, but now they had to relinquish them, handing over many resources to the Han Mansion. How could these forces accept or be happy about this?
Some Gangyuan Realm forces with backgrounds were slightly more composed, actively shuttling about, trying to implore True Immortals of the God Refining Realm to intervene and drive away the Han Family.
But no True Immortals of the God Refining Realm were willing to take action.
This was completely thankless; setting aside whether they could defeat the elder of the Han Family, they certainly wouldn’t offend a True Immortal of the God Refining Realm without good reason, and the benefits and favors offered by those Great Masters of the Gangyuan Realm were far from sufficient to persuade them.
Moreover, moving to Yuanzhou had long been a settled matter for the Han Family. Staying in Yonchang Manor, a place where even birds wouldn’t relieve themselves, was ideal. Driving the Han Family out of Yonchang Manor would only force them to compete for territories and resources with the others, wouldn’t it?
This outcome caused great frustration to the actively hustling forces, but what could they do with their lack of strength?
Unable to entice True Immortals of the God Refining Realm to act, nor to drive away the Han Family, the future landscape was already set. Thus, many forces instantly switched their attitude.
Since the Han Family had become the strongest force in Yonchang Manor, wouldn’t it be good for them to cling to the Han Family’s might?
The elder of the Han Family liked to take concubines, and so did his descendants; bonding with the Han Family was all too easy, only requiring the sacrifice of one or two beautiful female cultivators.
By then, they would become kinship forces of the Han Mansion. Surely the Han Family wouldn’t continue to encroach on their interests, would they?
Even if encroachment did occur, the extent would be much lesser, shifting the cost to other forces. As they weakened, the other forces would become weaker, and hence, they would comparatively become stronger.
For example, if the Han Family wanted to claim one-third of Yonchang Manor’s territories and cultivation resources, these would have to be taken from other forces. With the total amount unchanged, if several forces handed over less, the others would have to hand over more.
According to intelligence reports, the elder of the Han Family had a good reputation. When leaving Leizhou, he even took care of those kinship families.
By forming marital ties with the Han Family, they might even gain various benefits from the Han Family, continuously grow stronger, and those beautiful female cultivators who married into the Han Family might live even better lives than before.
Within a very short period, many forces in Yonchang Manor had already shifted their mindset, determined to send daughters to the Han Family.
As for what kind of beautiful female cultivators should be sent, that had to be carefully considered as it concerned the relationship with the Han Family.
After all, the Han Family was taking root in Yonchang Manor, not just passing through. They couldn’t simply think about forming a good bond by casually choosing someone with poor aptitude to suffice.
If other forces of the same caliber were sending beautiful female cultivators with Eighth Grade aptitude, and you sent one with Ninth Grade aptitude, this would certainly be remembered by the elder of the Han Family..

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 127 Chengsheng Mountain_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 127 Chengsheng Mountain_2
Translator: 549690339
The forces that didn’t send their daughters for marriage may not necessarily be remembered by Han Li, the ancestral patriarch, but he will surely remember those who did not.
Meanwhile, the Han Mansion convoy continued its journey.
Unlike the previous tense atmosphere, the entire migration team was now filled with excitement and a relaxed mood.
Migrating from Leizhou to Yuanzhou was an extremely long journey, almost 2.6 million li, a distance many cultivators of the Gangyuan Realm and even the God Refining Realm had never traveled.
Cultivators of the Gangyuan and God Refining Realms generally settled in a major province and would not easily cross into another; simply crossing one province was about seven to eight hundred thousand li.
The risk of crossing provinces for those in the God Refining Realm was small, but it increased significantly for those in the Gangyuan Realm and below, and even more so for crossing multiple provinces consecutively.
During the relocation, whether it was the descendants of the Han Mansion, the guards, maids, or Han Li’s concubines, all feared the unpredictable future, the high mountains and long roads, and whether they would be able to reach Yuanzhou alive was a major concern.
For various reasons, these people had all chosen to relocate together, but feelings of tension and fear were inevitable, and they were very worried about encountering dangers that could lead to the destruction of the convoy.
A Great Master in the early stages of the Gangyuan Realm provided little reassurance to the people of Han Mansion; luckily, Ancestor Han had soared to the realm of a God Refining Real Master, slaying many incoming enemies, boosting their confidence and greatly enhancing their sense of security.
Indeed, in the following journey, the migrating team faced fewer troubles, and many within the Han Mansion even gained considerable benefits.
Only after reaching Yuanzhou and arriving at Yonchang Manor did everyone finally breathe a sigh of relief, no longer living in fear, instead brimming with excitement.
They had long known that there were no God Refining Realm forces in Yonchang Manor; the Han Family, by arriving, had become the strongest force. Their future development was sure to be infinitely better than remaining in Lingjun City.
All of this had been worth it!
Zhang Xuan, riding a magnificent horse and with a great saber hanging at his waist, exuded a sharp aura as he patrolled back and forth, safeguarding the safety of the migrating team.
Sensing the atmosphere of the migrating team, a smile emerged on Zhang Xuan’s face, making him feel much more at ease.
He had originally been Qiu Xuan’s first disciple but later decided to follow Ancestor Han to Lingjun City and became a guardian of Han Mansion. Although his cultivation was slightly insufficient, he was also the chief of the guards.
Han Li had once taken care of him, and Qiu Yueyao had been particularly supportive; she was her father’s only remaining disciple, as the others had long since scattered.
Through years of cultivation, Zhang Xuan had reached the Innate Realm. He thought he was qualified to be one of the chief guards of Han Mansion, but Ancestor Han’s strength had grown too rapidly, ascending to the exalted God Refining Real Master.
Once the Han Family established roots in Yonchang Manor, they would no doubt attract cultivators of the Pihai and Gangyuan Realms. The position of chief guard would at least require the cultivation of the Pihai Realm.
Relying on his relationship, Zhang Xuan felt he could still hold the position of chief guard, but his inadequate strength would inevitably lead to criticism.
At that moment, Zhang Xuan silently resolved to make more contributions to Han Mansion and to earn Pihai Pills. Even with his limited talent, there was a good chance for him to break through to the Pihai Realm.
Touching the scar on his face, Zhang Xuan felt optimistic about the future. Having survived the arduous 2.6 million li journey, where many guards had died, he was fortunate to be alive.
The Han Family was destined to grow and prosper in Yonchang Manor, and he would have more opportunities to contribute and gain cultivation resources to climb higher.
“Master, I will definitely cultivate to the Gangyuan Realm and see the scenery of that domain for you,” Zhang Xuan silently vowed in his heart.
In the luxurious carriage, many people gathered.
Han Li, Lu Tianxiang, Lin Yiwu, Lin Yiyin, Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, Liu Yuexin, and several other wives and concubines were all there.
Han Li and Lu Tianxiang were already in the carriage, and the other beauties had come over to inquire about a matter.
Where was the Han Family ultimately going to relocate in Yonchang Manor?
To the manor city? Or, like before, settle in a county town?
Li Mingmeng, Lin Yiwu, and the other women were very curious, even Lu Tianxiang was somewhat curious. Han Li had only mentioned moving to Yonchang Manor in Yuanzhou, without specifying the exact location.
Yonchang Manor is a large manor in Yuanzhou, with a territory spanning over a thousand miles. Besides the manor city, there are three or five county towns that are quite prosperous.
“Husband, isn’t it time you told us exactly where we’re going to settle?” Lin Yiyin asked, hugging Han Li’s arm and shaking it coquettishly.
Feeling the soft elasticity, Han Li caressed her head affectionately and smiled,
“Since you all want to know, I’ll tell you.”
“The Han Mansion will not move to any county town or manor city; we’re moving to Chengsheng Mountain.”
“Chengsheng Mountain?”
Lu Tianxiang, Qiu Yueyao, and the other wives and concubines all showed puzzled expressions on their pretty faces.
They had quite a bit of knowledge about Yonchang Manor, knew the names of the manor city and several prosperous county towns, as well as the names of the mountain ranges and peaks within the manor, yet they had never heard of any Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li blinked, realizing he had not told them, so he explained, “This is a mountain I named; it should be originally called Jingqing Mountain.”
The several beautiful wives and concubines suddenly understood, yet felt somewhat speechless. Their husband hadn’t even arrived yet but had already renamed a peak in Yonchang Manor in advance; it seemed he had long had his eye on that mountain.
“Chengsheng, to become a saint, that contains my aspirations for the family,” Han Li said softly.
Li Mingmeng, Lin Yiwu, and the other women did not understand the meaning, and they also did not know about the Saint Realm of the Saint Yuan. However, Lu Tianxiang understood.
Lu Tianxiang looked at Han Li in amazement, her eyes sparkling with astonishment. Her man had great ambitions, daring to contemplate sainthood while only at the peak of the Hollow Void Stage.
After the Hollow Void Stage, there is the Myriad Phenomena Realm, the True Martial Realm, the Divine Yuan Realm, the Tongxuan Realm, and then finally the Saint Yuan Realm.
The Daqian Empire only has one or two in the True Martial Realm, and the sect she belonged to did not seem to have anyone in the Divine Yuan Realm; whether there is anyone in the entire Qianyuan Divine Province in the Tongxuan Realm is hard to say, not to mention saints of the Saint Yuan Realm, who have long been extinct and only exist in legends.
“Perhaps, his promise to me is true,” Lu Tianxiang thought suddenly.
If Han Li dares to think about becoming a saint, helping her achieve the True Martial Realm probably isn’t much to ask.
Once the women received the definite news, they told the other beautiful concubines, who then relayed the information to their children, and the news swiftly spread.
The spies from various powers who were gathering intelligence in the vicinity also learned of this, and they breathed a sigh of relief, immediately reporting the intel back to their respective forces.
The leaders of these forces also heaved a great sigh of relief. Although Jingqing Mountain was high, its spiritual energy was not exceptional, and there were no high-value cultivation resources nearby. It was perfect for the Han Mansion to take root there. As long as they did not move to the manor city or county towns, or take over their sect’s mountain gate, it was alright.
The forces immediately began to gather and select beautiful female cultivators to send to the Han Mansion, planning to find a good opportunity to deliver them to Jingqing Mountain, and secure a strong alliance with the Han Family.
At this time, the Han Family’s relocation convoy had also arrived at Chengsheng Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - 128: All Forces Gather, Just to Hug the Big Thigh_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 128: All Forces Gather, Just to Hug the Big Thigh_l
Translator: 549690339
Jingqing Mountain.
This mountain rose abruptly from the ground, grand and imposing, stretching for hundreds of miles. The main peak was especially majestic, reaching 3,000 meters into the clouds, surrounded by over a dozen subsidiary peaks of three to five kilometers. It resembled a congregation of stars circling the moon.
Gazing at this great mountain, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face. His spiritual sense took in the entirety of Jingqing Mountain, leaving no stone unturned, and found that this place was truly remarkable.
The mountain range stretched from east to west for more than 700 miles, and was over 200 miles wide from north to south. Within a hundred miles, three large rivers meandered and converged here, creating a tapestry of rivers and mountains of striking beauty.
Jingqing Mountain, with its splendid scenery and perilous terrain, was famous in the Mortal World. Many scholars and literati had discussed the landscape here, leaving behind numerous steles and stone inscriptions that became widely known.
Typically, such famous mountains and rivers are most suitable for establishing Sect grounds due to the spirit veins beneath them and the very rich spiritual energy. However, Jingqing Mountain’s spiritual energy was exceptionally sparse.
If the concentration of spiritual energy in the various manors of Yuanzhou were to be quantified, an average manor would have a concentration of 100 points, suitable for God Refining Realm and below for cultivation; the better ones would be between 150-200, where Dongxu Stage Forces would settle; and if a manor had over 300 points, the Ten Major Sects would all take interest in it.
Yonchang Manor was one of those places with thin spiritual energy, having a concentration between 50-70 points. For a real person in the God Refining Realm, staying here would be uncomfortable, as drawing a breath here brought little spiritual energy, greatly affecting their cultivation speed.
Even more sparse was the spiritual energy in Jingqing Mountain, with a concentration of about 20 points. No cultivator wanted to stay here—why not cultivate in places where the spiritual energy was rich?
In a place rich with spiritual energy, the chances of giving birth to a cultivator increased, and the speed of cultivation would be much faster. All forces enjoyed territories with abundant spiritual energy, but only those with strength could occupy such places.
The average force had a Spirit Gathering Array, which could increase the concentration of spiritual energy in their Sect grounds. The stronger the force, the higher the grade of Spirit Gathering Array they could use, allowing them to elevate the spiritual energy concentration to even higher levels.
With no force having claimed Jingqing Mountain, setting up a Spirit Gathering Array here would be a waste, as the effects of setting one up elsewhere could be several times greater.
Spirit Gathering Arrays were very expensive, okay? Even a Ninth Grade Spirit Gathering Array would cost five hundred Lower Grade Spirit Stones.
Han Li didn’t mind at all. He was a top-tier Seventh Grade Formation master himself, able to set up a Seventh Grade Spirit Gathering Array, which was sufficient for the Han Family’s use for now. As his mastery in formations improved, he could set up even higher-grade arrays, or even go out and purchase a higher-grade Spirit Gathering Array if needed.
He was quite fond of the landscape of Jingqing Mountain, and after setting up a Spirit Gathering Array, it would be more than sufficient for the Han Family’s use. The Han Family occupying this place would be welcomed by all parties, and they would not face incessant troubles in the future. Han Li also wanted to develop quietly for some time.
Although his combat ability in the True Martial Realm was very strong, he wanted to become stronger. He also needed time to develop his family, to nurture the next generation. In a few decades, the Han Family would become an immense power.
Calling over his capable descendants, Han Li gave a few instructions, ordering them to start establishing the family at Jingqing Mountain immediately and to construct various buildings. These tasks must be done well.
Looking at the dozens of wives and concubines around him, Han Li smiled and said, “Come, let me take you to enjoy the view.”
Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and the other women were immediately intrigued. This would be their future home, and they truly wanted to take a good look at it, having long heard of the unique scenery of Jingqing Mountain.
With their husband leading them, they could fly to the heavens and look down upon Jingqing Mountain, taking in all its beauty.
