Han Li waved his sleeve, and Gang Yuan surged forth, lifting all his wives and concubines into the sky above Jingqing Mountain.
“Wow-I’
“It’s so beautiful!”
“It’s truly magnificent-
“Eight words to describe it: Majestic and bold, serene and graceful.”
Li Mingmeng, Liu Yuexin, Zhang Yuyan, and other beautiful consorts stood in the sky, overlooking Jingqing Mountain, all stunned by the scenic splendor, each expressing their amazement.
From their perspective, they could overlook the entire Jingqing Mountain. They were Innate Realm and Pihai Realm cultivators, after all, and their senses far surpassed those of ordinary people.
“The beauty of sights like the stone coves with the sound of pines and the sea of clouds like jade plates is truly enchanting,” Lu Tianxiang couldn’t help but comment.
She had originally thought the scenery at Er Sea of Cang Mountain, which she occupied, was very good, but in comparison, it still fell short by quite a lot. The only real downside was the extremely sparse spiritual energy.
Such magnificent mountains and rivers could only attract the literati of the Mortal World, and had no appeal to cultivators.
“Is that the Triple Pool Mirroring the Moon? It’s so beautiful. I’ve heard that in winter, you can witness the spectacle of ‘ice halos’ and frosty mist.” Chu Yumeng exclaimed in amazement.
Han Li nodded with a smile, especially satisfied with the domain he had chosen. He wouldn’t grow tired of it, even if he spent every day here.
It was clear that Jingqing Mountain had the main peak as a watershed, with a multitude of rivers and streams to the south and north, flowing into the surrounding three raging rivers.
The terrain of Jingqing Mountain was steep, with short and swift rivers eroding many faults, forming numerous cascades and waterfalls. The valley’s bedrock was often pockmarked by the flowing water, creating pools and alternating with waterfalls.
From the mountain top to the foothills, springs and streams were abundant, with long and high mountains and hundreds of miles of mountains dotted with gurgling springs, quiet and serene.
The mountain boasted majestic, magnificent, rugged, and perilous natural landscapes, leaving Han Li in awe.
“With such beautiful scenery, why is the spiritual energy so sparse here?” Lin Yiwu asked with a slight frown, puzzled.
Qiu Yueyao, Zhang Lan, Li Mingmeng, and the other women all shared their opinions, contributing to a multitude of different views.
Han Li just smiled and remained silent. One of the reasons he chose this place was precisely because of its sparse spiritual energy..

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 128: All Forces Gather, Just to Hug the Big Thigh_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 128: All Forces Gather, Just to Hug the Big Thigh_2
Translator: 549690339
Theoretically, a peak with such beautiful scenery should be brimming with
spiritual energy, but Oddly enough, this mountain is devoid of it, suggesting there is a hidden story behind it.
He had looked through relevant intelligence reports, many cultivators had explored this place, and even that Great Grandmaster from the Myriad Phenomena Realm had paid a visit, finding no reasons for the lack; they all came to the conclusion that it was natural.
Before relocating, Han Li had quietly flown to Yuanzhou to have a look, inspecting each manor, but somehow he was led by an indistinct guide to Yonchang Manor.
As he hovered above Jingqing Mountain, Han Li distinctly felt the
Body-Cultivating Furnace stiir for a moment as if it had sensed something.
He took out the Body-Cultivating Furnace and activated it, yet the sensation disappeared.
Han Li suspected the scarcity of spiritual energy in this mountain was related to the Body-Cultivating Furnace. There might be an actual Body-Cultivating Furnace hidden here, or the one he held was the genuine one and what lay beneath could be the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, or even the Life-Prolonging Furnace, because otherwise, there would be no reaction.
But even after flying several circles around the mountain with the Body-Cultivating Furnace and continuously probing with his spiritual sense, he found nothing.
The spiritual energy in Yonchang Manor couldn’t possibly be so much thinner than the others without reason; there certainly had to be a cause, and it might originate from Jingqing Mountain, the place with the sparsest spiritual energy in Yonchang Manor.
At that moment, Han Li decided to relocate his home to Yonchang Manor and settle down at Jingqing Mountain.
The name Yonchang Manor sounded auspicious, which Han Li found very fitting for the Han Mansion to take root; although the name Jingqing Mountain didn’t sound impressive, the place wasn’t bad—good scenery, less trouble, and a potential treasure could be hiding.
After some thought, Han Li reached out and took a sizable, hard stone from Jingqing Mountain, suspending it mid-air, which caught the attention of his beloved wives and concubines, all of whom looked over, eager to know what their husband was doing.
With a flick of his fingers, streams of sword energy bombarded the stone, chipping away pieces until finally a giant stone tablet appeared, standing five fathoms high, about a fathom long, and three feet wide.
He stretched out his right hand, with middle and index fingers together like a sword, he wrote through the air. The characters for “Chengsheng Mountain” surfaced on the front face.
Then the stone tablet flipped, and Han Li continued to inscribe, the characters “Han Mansion” appeared on the back.
After that, he lightly pressed with his hand, and the massive tablet immediately plummeted down, thudding, to stand at the foot of the mountain, as Han Li’s voice followed.
“From this day on, Jingqing Mountain shall be renamed Chengsheng Mountain, the sacred grounds of my Han Mansion.”
The voice resonated grandly, spreading across hundreds of miles.
All members of the Han Mansion heard it, as did the cultivators lurking around the perimeter, and every mortal within this area.
People of the Han Mansion showed smiles, leaping for joy; cultivators from other forces were shocked, admiring the Han Family’s boldness, just arrived and already renaming a mountain, making the announcement to all corners—an announcement to all forces in Yonchang Manor, the Han Mansion has arrived.
As for the mortals in the secular world, they were somewhat bewildered—why had the well-regarded Jingqing Mountain been renamed and taken over by cultivators? Could they still visit the picturesque scenes and carve into the cliffside steles in the future?
Some astute mortals decided to take their chances with Chengsheng Mountain and see if perhaps the immortals atop it would accept them as disciples and impart them with immortal laws.
To women like Li Mingmeng and Qiu Yueyao, it appeared that Han Li had simply carved a monumental tablet at the mountain gate, but Lu Tianxiang saw more to it.
As a former Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, even though her powers were sealed, her insight remained intact.
“You’re really willing to go that far, huh? Not afraid of attracting trouble?” Lu Tianxiang scoffed.
“What is it, Sister Tianxiang? What did husband do?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Yiwu and Zhang Yuyan, among other lovely concubines, asked curiously, wondering if their husband had done something to the stone tablet.
“Nothing much, just placed a few small things inside.”
“You can tell your children,” Han Li smiled, “those who are interested should study the tablet more closely.” He did not elaborate further.
Lin Yiyin, Qiu Yueyao, and other beautiful concubines nodded, deciding to share this news with their children once back home; the husband had put effort into this deed, which must hold significance.
And indeed, it held great significance; Han Li had hidden quite a few treasures within it.
The three characters “Chengsheng Mountain” were inscribed with the full comprehension of the Seal Heaven Sword Art, while the two characters “Han
Mansion” were done with the complete insights into the Five Elements Grand Handprint.
The final pat was imbued with the understandings of various martial arts like
Xuantian Punch, God Slaying Sword Technique, Shenhuang Imprisoning Finger, Dragon Suppressing Palm, and even a trace of the ultimate essence of martial arts.
Now all these martial insights and the true essence of martial arts have been internalized, deeply hidden within the stone tablet. Given time, this tablet could perhaps become an invaluable treasure.
The descendants of the Han Family, as well as those guards, maids, and others, if they were to study and observe the stone tablet more, might gain some enlightenment from it, which would be of immense benefit to them.
Those with sufficient talent can see more when they observe the stone tablet, while those with lesser talent, as long as they have patience and perseverance, can also gain insights if they dedicate enough time.
All of this would depend on one’s individual fate, but in any case, Han Li had left the opportunity there.
This was especially designed as a benefit for the descendants of the Han Family, as well as other members of the Han Family. Those with good talent or background among Han Li’s descendants would definitely get more cultivation resources, while others would naturally have fewer. However, if they could gain some understanding from the stone tablet, rising to prominence was still a hopeful prospect.
This was also a contingency plan left by Han Li, as the martial techniques sealed within could be unleashed when necessary, slaying incoming enemies.
The main material of the stone tablet was that trace of his all-encompassing true martial essence, with hard stone merely serving as a secondary material, otherwise it wouldn’t be able to withstand those powerful martial techniques.
With the true martial essence as support, these martial techniques could still receive a boost, bursting out with the combat ability from the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm or even the True Martial Realm.
The entire mountain gate stone tablet could be regarded as a huge stone talisman.
After absorbing a hundred years of talisman-making experience, Han Li’s talisman-making expertise reached the level of a Sixth Grade Mark Master, which gave him this idea.
A typical Sixth Grade Mark Master could only refine talismans and paper charms at the level of the God Refining Realm, but Han Li was different.
Possessing the combat ability of the True Martial Realm, he viewed things
trom a higher perspective. With his expertise in talisman making, it was easy for him to contain his own martial techniques and refine many extremely powerful talismans.
In just a few short days, the new Han Mansion was built, many times larger than Lingjun City, and far more magnificent and grand.
The entire Chengsheng Mountain now belonged to the Han Mansion. Han Li redeployed the Five Elements Life and Death Formation here, using the Body-Cultivating Furnace as the formation’s nexus.
It was partly to strengthen the formation’s might, and partly to see if it could once again trigger a response. Should there be any reaction, Han Li would be able to detect it immediately.
Chengsheng Mountain had a total of eighteen peaks, with the main peak named by Han Li himself: Chengdao Peak!
Just like Chengsheng Mountain, this, too, embodied his ambitions.
The Han Mansion was rooted in Yonchang Manor, where it would remain for a long period of time in the future. He had enough strength to protect the development of the Han Family.
Chengdao Peak was the residence for Han Li and his beautiful wife and concubines, serving as the core of the Han Mansion, with a large number of palace complexes constructed there.
Of the other seventeen lesser peaks, Han Li temporarily activated only three. Together with the foothills and mid-mountain areas, it was sufficient for the current Han Family’s use. The remaining peaks would be planned after the Han Family’s population increased significantly.
When the Han Mansion was completed, many forces from Yonchang Manor seemed to have made a pact, hurriedly coming to visit the Han Mansion one after another.
Those who came were either the head of the power or its upper echelons, and they all had one thing in common: a beautiful female cultivator accompanied them.
Mature, sexy, innocent, charming, pure, fragile…
All sorts of styles were represented among these beautiful female cultivators. On this day, the Han Mansion seemed like a venue for a beauty selection.
“Elder Chen, I have heard that your sect has some complaints about our ancestor Han, with the Lake Mountain Sect backing you up. What brings you to Chengsheng Mountain?”
“Zhang Family head, didn’t you say you wouldn’t come? Why have you brought even the most outstanding descendant of your Zhang Family?”
“Sect Master Qi, are you out of your mind? Your sect’s Fairy Hua has a Seventh
Grade aptitude, how can you bear to part with her? Send her back quickly!”
“Sect Master Lu…”
At the foot of the mountain, forces from all over Yonchang Manor gathered, and every Gangyuan Realm cultivator and Pihai Realm cultivator watching the others felt as if they had swallowed a fly.
When we asked you, everyone said they wouldn’t come, yet here you are, each arriving faster than the last!
PS: Today is the second chapter, with three more to follow. I continue to write and continue to ask for monthly tickets and rewards.
These two or three chapters serve as a bridge between the previous and the next, and might seem mundane. Don’t hurry, everyone; this is setting the stage for what’s coming next. Ancestor Han is about to start marrying and taking concubines again, then nurturing his offspring..

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - 129: The Ancestor Takes a Wife, the
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Chapter 129: The Ancestor Takes a Wife, the
Ancestor Takes Another Concubine Again (Large Chapter)_l
Translator: 549690339
Chengdao Peak.
Han Li and Lu Tianxiang stood shoulder to shoulder at the peak, overlooking the entirety of Chengsheng Mountain, taking in the magnificent scenery and also observing the cultivators gathered at the foot of the mountain.
“Ancestor Han, you can take another concubine, congratulations, congratulations,” Lu Tianxiang said coldly, her displeasure evident on her face.
Han Li held Lu Tianxiang close, rubbing his cheek against hers, nibbling her earlobe as he whispered, ‘Xiangxiang, I didn’t ask them to come, you can’t blame me for this.”
“Heh- Are you saying you don’t want to?” Lu Tianxiang chuckled coldly.
She thought Han Li was a shameless bastard, deeply ingrained with lechery. Despite already having so many concubines, he kept taking more.
If she hadn’t fallen into Han Li’s hands and lost her virginity to him, and if their child Han Yongzhen wasn’t already several months old, Lu Tianxiang felt she would never have liked a person like him.
But now, she was deep in the mire and unable to extricate herself, primarily because her cultivation had been sealed, leaving her with no choice.
Having spent over a year with Han Li, she had come to deeply understand him. Han Li seemed obsessed with taking concubines and having children, and he made his descendants do the same.
She couldn’t fathom his reasons.
However, she knew she really had no other choice.
Despite her cultivation, talents, beauty, and temperament being superior to all of Han Li’s other concubines, and she was treated as a wife, it was a role she had agreed to.
If she hadn’t agreed, she would not only have lost everything, but she would have been reduced to a tool for bearing Han Li’s children, an outcome she believed Han Li would definitely enforce, and her fate would be truly miserable.
Han Li wasn’t angry. He was never angry about things like this and was very patient. He knew that conquering Lu Tianxiang’s heart would take time, as would her complete acceptance of everything.
“Xiangxiang, if you admit you’re jealous, I’ll send all these people back. How about that?” Han Li’s eyes twinkled with mirth as he spoke softly.
“Hmph-” Lu Tianxiang snorted, unwilling to admit it. How could the Sect Hierarch, Xiangxiang, be jealous?
Although she didn’t admit it, Lu Tianxiang felt somewhat relieved. She knew Han Li was serious—if she admitted it, he wouldn’t accept the beautiful female cultivators sent by these powers.
“Don’t move!”
Lu Tianxiang slapped Han Li’s wandering hand.
Han Li behaved a bit better and continued, “Xiangxiang, do you want to screen them for me?
“In what capacity should I screen them for you?” Lu Tianxiang said with irritation.
When she had agreed to Han Li’s proposal, she had made it clear that he must marry her before touching her. But the next evening, Han Li had taken her, which infuriated Lu Tianxiang to no end.
Now their child Han Yongzhen had been born for several months, and Han Li still hadn’t married her.
Although everyone knew she was Han Li’s wife, they had not wed in an official ceremony. Could that be the same?
This mattered greatly to Lu Tianxiang, who refused to be associated with Han Li without proper acknowledgment. Han Li had to make things official and extravagant, or else she wouldn’t let him touch her.
Even though Han Li had yet to formally marry her, he had already taken three concubines—out of necessity during their travels, which Lu Tianxiang had tolerated.
Now that Han Mansion had established its roots in Chengsheng Mountain and had everything in place, if Han Li still didn’t marry her and continued to take a bunch of concubines, Lu Tianxiang wouldn’t be able to tolerate it anymore.
Having spent over a year living closely with Han Li and being well cared for, with many ties deepening their relationship, Lu Tianxiang had already developed a fondness for him and even begun to like him.
But if Han Li dared to continue taking concubines before marrying her, then heh… all those feelings, all that fondness, the Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang would let it all go to hell.
Sensing the emotions of the beautiful woman in his arms, Han Li hugged her tightly, then turned her around to face him, looking earnestly into her eyes as he said:
“Xiangxiang, don’t worry. I will choose an auspicious day to marry you, and it will be done beautifully.”
“As for the female cultivators sent by these powers, I will only select a few, and they will marry me a month after you, in a joint ceremony.”
Upon hearing this, Lu Tianxiang immediately felt happy. Although Han Li was shameless, he hadn’t disappointed her.
As Han Li’s wife, her place was unique. No matter how many concubines there were, they couldn’t compare to her treatment.
While Han Li might be lecherous and shameless, he still had principles. He wouldn’t accept just anyone who was offered up and would only select a few. This reassured Lu Tianxiang greatly.
She truly feared that Han Li would indiscriminately accept all these dozens of beautiful female cultivators, effectively doubling the number of his concubines.
“Mm- I’ Lu Tianxiang responded, her tone a bit more buoyant.
Han Li lowered his head, touching Lu Tianxiang’s red lips as she instantly closed her eyes, her heart pounding wildly.
Despite having been intimate many times before, Lu Tianxiang experienced a different sensation each time, and as her relationship with Han Li deepened, her perspective on intimacy had changed as well.
Yundao Peak, one of the three tallest mountains surrounding Chengdao Peak, stood 5,600 meters tall and was named by Han Li himself.
A multitude of buildings had also been constructed on Yundao Peak, and Han Li received the multiple powers from Yonchang Manor in one of the grand halls.
The hall was filled with dozens of powers, including seven from the Gangyuan Realm and the rest from Pihai Realm and lower realms.
Behind the high-ranking officials of these powers stood beautiful female cultivators, each with their own charm—whether icy, seductive, regal, or aloof.
The leaders of these powers had long stopped conversing and didn’t dare to secretly transmit messages. They merely observed the young-looking patriarch of the Han Family seated in the place of honor.
Shock colored their eyes. The patriarch of the Han Family seemed too young.. Was it a technique for preserving youth or exceptional talent?

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - 129: The Ancestor Takes a Wife, the
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 129: The Ancestor Takes a Wife, the
Ancestor Takes Another Concubine Again (Large Chapter)_2
Translator: 549690339
The intelligence they had on the Han Family patriarch indicated that, after leaving Tianxuan Mountain in his early years, he had encountered some great fortune which had improved his aptitude. Within just a few short decades, his cultivation had soared dramatically, propelling him to become a true person of the God Refining Realm.
This patriarch of the Han Family was also a direct disciple of the Sect Leader of the major Leizhou Sect, Tianxuan Mountain, adept at concealing his true strength. Had it not been for the relocation to Yuanzhou, it’s likely he wouldn’t have revealed his cultivation in the God Refining Realm.
Every power was wary of such cultivators, for no one knew what realm they truly resided in. The power they displayed might very well be just a ruse, and anyone who dared to make a move against them risked a crushing counter-strike, falling into the trap of the old sixth.
“We have seen Patriarch Han!”
The cultivators bowed respectfully, their tones filled with great reverence.
They were merely practitioners of the Gang Yuan Realm, the Pihai Realm, and some even from the Innate Realm, while Patriarch Han was a true person of the God Refining Realm, his strength far surpassing theirs.
Patriarch Han was only over two hundred years old and had more than two hundred years of lifespan remaining; there was hope for him to break through to the Hollow Void Stage and achieve the status of Grandmaster in the future, which they dared not offend.
They were also filled with envy. Patriarch Han used to be just an Innate Realm cultivator, but with a great opportunity, he had soared to the heavens. When could they ever encounter such luck, and when would they become the next Patriarch Han?
Dozens of beautiful female cultivators standing behind them also bowed and addressed Patriarch Han, while their sidelong glances continually surveyed the figure above.
Was this the man they were to marry in the future?
Not only was his cultivation profound, but he was also truly handsome.
“The clan head (father, Sect Master, master) did not deceive me,” the same thought arose in the many beautiful female cultivators.
Since marriage was inevitable, they naturally hoped their future husband would be a handsome man rather than an old geezer.
Being a concubine of a true person from the God Refining Realm wasn’t so bad; they could gain access to many cultivation resources and have more hope of advancing to higher realms.
But was the competition not a bit too fierce?
The numerous beautiful female cultivators glanced at the others and felt somewhat anxious. Would they be chosen?
In their respective clans and sects, they were all renowned female cultivators with not only good aptitude but also top-notch looks and temperament.
Besides these lesser powers, there was another presence in the hall, not small by any means—a delegate from Yonchang Manor, the City Envoy.
Since the spiritual energy in Yonchang Manor was too sparse and there were no God Refining Realm powers present, the Lord of Yonchang Manor was merely a Great Master of the Gang Yuan Realm.
But no one dared to underestimate the Lord of Yonchang Manor, for he was backed by the entire Daqian Empire.
An Immortal Refining Clan moving into Yonchang Manor had long caught the attention of its lord, who highly valued it and specifically waited until Han Mansion was constructed before sending someone to convey greetings.
The City Envoy glanced at the other powers in the main hall and felt somewhat out of place, his discomfort showing.
All those powers had brought beautiful female cultivators, while he came alone. But what could he do? The Lord of Yonchang Manor couldn’t possibly offer a daughter to Patriarch Han—what would that make the Daqian Empire? To earn such treatment, Patriarch Han would have to possess at least True Martial Realm strength, which the Qian Dynasty would tacitly accept.
“Paying respects to Patriarch Han, the Lord has asked me to extend his congratulations,” said the City Envoy respectfully, though with a touch of self-possession.
By coming here, he represented the Lord of Yonchang Manor on a smaller scale, and the Da Qian Empire on a larger one. He naturally could not lose his stature, as he would face unpleasant consequences upon his return. “No need for such courtesy from everyone.”
“I, Han Li, have recently arrived with the Han Family and will now settle at Chengsheng Mountain within Yonchang Manor. I hope to receive your kind care in the future.”
Han Li wore a mild smile on his face, uttering the polite niceties.
Since these powers had shown him such deference, he would not turn them away. It was nice for everyone to be cordial and no one to seek trouble.
The high-ranking figures of the various powers immediately responded, lavishing praise on Han Li before saying:
“Patriarch Han has high cultivation and outstanding strength, unmatched and heroic. The young ladies from our homes (sect) have long admired the Patriarch and, upon hearing of his arrival in Yonchang Manor, earnestly requested to meet him, wishing to sweeten his life with their presence. We hope that the Patriarch won’t disappoint their sincere sentiments.”
Following this, the beautiful female cultivators stepped out from behind their leaders and stood in the middle of the great hall, like a blooming array of flowers, each possessing their own grace and charm.
Han Li’s eyes sparkled as he said with a smile, “Since they possess such heartfelt devotion, I cannot let them down.”
“Here is what we’ll do: Those with qualifications of Seventh Grade and above can stay and become concubines to me, Patriarch Han. Those who don’t meet the criteria need not feel discouraged, as there are many outstanding descendants in the Han Family who you can become the wives or concubines
of.”
“Of course, if you are unwilling, I, Patriarch Han, will not force you,” Han Li added, purposely glancing at the leaders of the various powers.
There were precisely sixty-three beautiful female cultivators present, among them twenty-two of Ninth Grade, thirty-four of Eighth Grade, and only seven of Seventh Grade—pitifully few.
Initially, Han Li’s standard for taking concubines was Eighth Grade, but now he had no choice but to raise it to Seventh Grade, given the excessive number of candidates. He certainly didn’t want to accept more than forty concubines all at once.
Otherwise, if the number of concubines suddenly exceeded a hundred, he would be hard-pressed to equally attend to them all; it would take many days to complete a cycle, leading to the neglect of other beauties.
After all, whether for his descendants or himself, the rewards in terms of aptitude enhancement, cultivation progress, and lifespan would be just as substantial. This way, Han Li could also free himself to attend to other matters.
The cultivators in the hall were suddenly taken aback, with only a few brimming with excitement. Accepting only Seventh Grade was perfect, creating a closer connection to them.. Even if other powers became in-laws with the Han Mansion, there would be a significant difference in closeness—a concubine to Patriarch Han or a wife or concubine to his descendants—are
these the same?

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 129: The Ancestor Takes a Wife, the
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 129: The Ancestor Takes a Wife, the
Ancestor Takes Another Concubine Again (Large Chapter)—3
Translator: 549690339
Many high-ranking figures among the powers cursed inwardly, wishing they had simply not brought their daughters; marrying into the Han Family’s lineage wasn’t of much significance after all, given the Han Family’s multitude of descendants, while there was only one Han Family Patriarch.
But now, it was too late for them to take it back; the words had been spoken, and Patriarch Han had given them a look that they all understood.
Their daughters had been delivered, so it was best not to take them back.
If any power insisted on taking their daughters back, they would bear the consequences themselves.
Of course, none dared to offend the Han Family Patriarch. The choice of Patriarch Han to make the Chengsheng Mountain his Daoist practice ground had already shown them favor. If this True Person of the God Refining Realm got angry, no one knew how many small powers would be wiped out.
They glanced at the beautiful female cultivators behind them, saw the disappointment in their eyes, and could only sigh inwardly, resigned to leaving them behind.
Otherwise, they would truly offend Patriarch Han. If the Patriarch became enraged, it was possible they wouldn’t be able to leave Chengsheng Mountain, and the powers behind them would suffer.
“But we are at Patriarch Han’s command.”
The leaders of the various powers begrudgingly accepted the situation.
Afterward, Han Li proclaimed that from now on the Han Mansion would root itself in Chengsheng Mountain and would not expand outward easily. Their territories would remain unaffected, and the Han Family would not seize them.
The Han Mansion only needed Chengsheng Mountain and the surrounding twenty li as their territory. They would also not randomly seize various cultivation resources. However, when Han Mansion disciples were out training, other powers should make things convenient for them and provide assistance when necessary…
Hearing this, the leaders of the various powers finally breathed a sigh of relief. Although sending their daughters wasn’t quite successful, they at least secured these promises from the Han Family Patriarch.
Wasn’t this the result they were hoping to achieve by sending their daughters?
This news quickly spread throughout Yonchang Manor, and even reached the surrounding manors, refreshing many cultivators’ impression of the Han Family Patriarch.
While known to be licentious and fond of beauty, becoming a concubine of the Han Family Patriarch was not easy. At least those female cultivators with less than seventh-grade aptitude were not qualified.
At the same time, they also noticed the Han Family Patriarch’s greed and domineering nature, for he had kept all the beautiful female cultivators, which certainly made the powers that sent the girls extremely uncomfortable.
Beauty in female cultivators was also a cultivation resource; combining with them made it easier to produce offspring with good aptitudes and even better allow the transmission of one’s own qualities. Plus, if the female cultivators were beautiful, it also pleased the eyes and improved one’s mood.
The powers of other manors instantly felt lucky; it was a good thing that it was Yonchang Manor where the Han Family had rooted itself, otherwise, it would have been their turn to suffer.
After this event of the powers sending their daughters, Chengsheng Mountain remained bustling for several months.
First, the Han Family Patriarch officially took a wife, holding a grand wedding with great fanfare and widespread influence.
Han Li officially married Lu Tianxiang, making her his first wife.
That day, all the significant powers of Yonchang Manor came, and all were the heads of their powers. Even though many were internally upset with Han Li’s previous domineering actions, they dared not abstain.
The Lord of Yonchang Manor arrived, and high -ranking figures from surrounding manors also attended this grand wedding.
Many God Refining Realm powers from Yuanzhou sent representatives to participate, and even the great sect of Wendao Pavilion from Yuanzhou came to congratulate Patriarch Han on his marriage.
In name, all the manors in Yuanzhou were ruled by the Da Qian Empire, but in reality, the great sects in Yuanzhou had their territories where they would recruit disciples, barely qualifying them as actual rulers, a situation tacitly accepted by the Daqian Empire.
These great sects were nominally under the rule of the Daqian Empire, which would not interfere as long as they did not cause trouble.
Han Li, having said he would give Lu Tianxiang a beautiful wedding, did not go back on his word. Without further exposing his cultivation level, he had indeed achieved the utmost.
Those God Refining Realm powers and Wendao Pavilion guests were personally invited by Han Li; they gave face by attending and brought blessings along with various precious congratulatory gifts.
After all, this was the first time the God Refining Realm Patriarch Han was taking a wife. While they could disregard his taking of concubines, they had to pay respect for his marriage.
The Cultivation Realm wasn’t just about fighting; it was also about interpersonal connections and the ways of the world.
Today they gave face to Patriarch Han, and in the future, he would do the same for them; it was reciprocal.
This was the most splendid wedding Han Li had ever hosted, far surpassing those he held in Lingjun City by dozens or hundreds of times.
Simultaneously, Han Li used the occasion of this wedding to declare the arrival of the Han Family to Yonchang Manor and to Yuanzhou formally.
He showcased his God Refining Realm cultivation level; sometimes, maintaining a low profile wasn’t a matter of personal preference, as various powers would consistently monitor his movements.
Han Li reiterated his previous statements: the Han Family would not expand actively nor would they easily seize other powers’ cultivation resources, but if anyone sought trouble with the Han Mansion, he would retaliate thunderously.
Han Li knew that when it was time to be firm, he had to be firm, to let these powers know the Han Family was not to be provoked, decreasing the odds of them seeking trouble.
Although the wedding had a significant impact, it would cool down after a while. When the various powers realized the Han Family had upheld their promises, they naturally wouldn’t pay much attention.
As long as Han Li kept a low profile consistently, remaining in Chengsheng Mountain, other powers would be very pleased.
Then, the Han Family could continue to develop stably, and when the Han Family’s descendants went out to train, there would be few who dared to openly harm them.
Han Li did not want his descendants to perish while training; how would they then continue the family line and contribute to him?
A month after marrying Lu Tianxiang, Han Li held another wedding, taking those seven female cultivators with seventh-grade aptitudes as concubines.
This time, the wedding was much quieter. Han Li followed the standards of Lingjun City; the great powers did not attend, with only the smaller ones sending representatives.
These powers knew well that the Han Family Patriarch had come to be known as the ‘Concubine-taking Patriarch’ with incessantly adding concubines. They considered taking a wite seriously but tor taking concubines, a pertunctory acknowledgment sufficed.
For both taking a wife and accepting concubines, Han Li held mass feasts in the Mortal World by the side of three major rivers, offering free food and drink to ordinary people so they would remember the good deeds of Patriarch Han, and keep his favor in mind. It was best if families with beautiful descendants could marry them into the Han Mansion.
After Han Li completed his marriage and concubinage ceremonies, only then did the Han Family descendants begin to hold their smaller weddings and concubinage celebrations, which were less influential..

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - 130 Family Planning, The Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Chapter 130 Family Planning, The Sword
Immortal Arrives! 1
Translator: 549690339
After taking in seven beautiful concubines, Han Li was far from idle, embarking on an arduous journey of cultivation, forging new paths every day, and breaking through obstacles with a battered and bloodied determination.
It must be said that Han Li, possessing the combat ability of the True Martial Realm, was extremely powerful. In battle, he wielded various martial techniques with ease, forcing his opponents to retreat in defeat, step by step.
Even when faced with encirclement, Han Li showed no fear, scrutinizing each of his opponents with a sigh, “The advantage is mine.”
Indeed, how could a few Innate Realm Cultivators ever compete with the venerable Ancestor Han?
Ancestor Han was a fierce figure standing at the pinnacle of the Daqian Empire. His True Martial Realm combat ability was not just for show – each strike carried tremendous force and weight, and even after fighting for hours on end, Ancestor Han’s brow would not furrow in the slightest.
Subsequently, those cultivators who rashly besieged Ancestor Han all ended up kneeling before him begging for mercy, calling him “father” and pleading for his leniency.
Although Ancestor Han was formidable, he wasn’t unreasonable and thus spared these cultivators for the time being.
In the end, Ancestor Han exclaimed with a sigh, “Ancestor’s Shadowless Whip Technique is truly invincible under the heavens!”
After several busy days, Han Li finally rested only after confirming that all his newly taken beautiful concubines were with child.
It had been several months since he had advanced to the complete seventh layer of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
During this time, the Han Mansion saw the addition of several dozen newborns, further bolstering the population of the Han Family.
Naturally, Ancestor Han was beaming with joy, and his cultivation and lifespan increased significantly, with his aptitude also slightly improved.
He calculated that in a few months, the second batch of wives and concubines taken by his descendants in Jizhou would also give birth to their first offspring.
The number of descendants should reach eight hundred, though the number with aptitude would still be lacking.
After about ten more months, the wives and concubines taken by the descendants of the Han Mansion will also give birth to their children, amounting to dozens. Adding the offspring of other descendants, the total number of descendants should reach nine hundred, with three hundred of them having aptitude.
Then, after one to one and a half more years, the number of his descendants will reach one thousand, and by then he would be able to claim a grand prize.
All told, it would take about two and a half to three more years.
Han Li felt this was already incredibly fast. In the past, it would take years to have one child, then ten in a few years, and a hundred in a few more years.
Now, it took only one year for a hundred descendants to appear in this world.
At the previous pace, to add a hundred descendants would have taken at least two years, and to add three hundred would likely take seven or eight years.
Han Li was well aware of why the growth was so rapid – mainly because of the recent move, his descendants took a very large number of wives and concubines in Qingzhou, Jizhou, and Yuanzhou.
For instance, this time Yonchang Manor took in fifty-six, with a total of over one hundred and eighty in Sanzhou alone , and Yuanzhou’s batch had the best aptitude.
Before moving, Han Li had those descendants who had entered the Sect return, to migrate to Yuanzhou. Initially, they had some complaints — what was the point of moving, after all?
Now, those descendants were overwhelmed with excitement, battling with their lovely wives at home every day, nearly neglecting their cultivation.
Originally without wives or concubines, as Cultivators they disdained mortals, desiring spouses with aptitude and beauty.
However, those women both beautiful and talented disdained them in return, for their aptitude was not high, and they lacked background and connections.
But now? Each one of these descendants had one wife and two concubines, some even three or four concubines, each one a beautiful female cultivator of talent.
It was these new women married into the Han Family who made a great contribution to the increase in the number of Han Li’s descendants. Over the next decade, they would add four to five hundred, or even more, to the Han Mansion’s population.
Besides the descendants with aptitude growing their lineage, those without aptitude were also busy procreating on the move. Although they had not taken any new wives or concubines, they already had a considerable number.
“In ten years, the rate of population growth in the Han Mansion will probably have multiplied several times over,” Han Li mused with a sigh.
Ten years later, the descendants born in the previous ten years would have grown up, and those with good aptitude need not marry or take concubines too early, while those with average or no aptitude would need to marry and take concubines earlier.
Because those with good aptitude were given priority in cultivation, with ample resources to aid their practice, the other descendants naturally could not compare with these talented individuals. Those wanting more cultivation resources had to contribute to the Han Family, and procreation was their greatest contribution.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li stood tall, overlooking the whole of Chengsheng Mountain, beholding the thriving scene of the Han Mansion.
Before officially marrying Lu Tianxiang and before taking in the seven beautiful concubines, there was a month’s gap during which Han Li was also not idle.
He was first busy with setting up the Spirit Gathering Array for the Han Mansion. The mansion had already stored a large amount of materials for the array, and then he purchased more from outside. Finally, he set up the Spirit Gathering Array for the Han Mansion.
Nine seventh-grade Spirit Gathering Arrays were placed throughout Chengsheng Mountain, one large array covering the entire mountain, and eight smaller ones distributed in various locations.
Three arrays were allocated to Chengdao Peak, and one array each to Yundao Peak and the other two peaks that were in use, with one more placed at the mountainside and another at the foot of the mountain.
These Spirit Gathering Arrays significantly increased the concentration of spiritual energy within the Han Mansion; if quantified, the change was as follows:
Originally the spiritual energy concentration of Chengsheng Mountain was 20 points, quite sparse. After the use of seventh-grade Spirit Gathering Arrays, the concentration of spiritual energy doubled. The spiritual energy concentration of Chengsheng Mountain became 60 points, now comparable to other regions of Yonchang Manor..

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - 130 Family Planning, The Sword Immortal Arrives! 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Chapter 130 Family Planning, The Sword Immortal Arrives! 2
Translator: 549690339
At Yundao Peak and other locations where a small-scale Spirit Gathering
Formation was set up, it would absorb the spiritual energy from other parts of Chengsheng Mountain, increasing the concentration of spiritual energy in the area of the formation to 180 points.
The concentration of spiritual energy at Chengdao Peak was even higher, reaching 420 points. Such a level of spiritual energy concentration could only be found in the dwellings occupied by the Ten Major Sects.
Of course, after those major sects used high-grade Spirit Gathering
Formations, the concentration of spiritual energy would be even higher.
Just setting up eleven Spirit Gathering Formations had cost Han Mansion half of the Spirit Stones it had accumulated over many years, and that was the result of Han Li, who was a Seventh Grade Array Master, setting up the formations himself.
Otherwise, if they had hired someone to set up the formations, the cost would be many times higher, with just the material expenses amounting to an astronomical figure.
In the Cultivation Realm, a Ninth Grade Spirit Gathering Formation could only increase the concentration of spiritual energy by 50%, selling for 500 Lower Grade Spirit Stones; an Eighth Grade Spirit Gathering Formation could double the concentration, selling for 10,000 Lower Grade Spirit Stones; while a Seventh Grade could triple it, selling for 2,000 Mid-grade Spirit Stones, which is equivalent to 200,000 Lower Grade Spirit Stones.
The prices of Spirit Gathering Formations were extremely expensive, but they were very practical and a necessary item for every power.
The Spirit Gathering Formations sold on the market did not cover a large area, at most 5 miles around, which was considered the standard range for a Spirit Gathering Formation.
To purchase a larger Spirit Gathering Formation, one would have to pay a lot more money. The larger the area, the more materials would be consumed in setting up the formation, and the price could increase manyfold.
Even Tianxuan Mountain, which had set up a large-scale Spirit Gathering Formation, only had an Eighth Grade one that covered the entire mountain. If it were Seventh Grade, it would have bankrupted Tianxuan Mountain, mainly because Tianxuan Mountain is much larger than Chengsheng Mountain by several orders of magnitude.
Some important places on Tianxuan Mountain would have separate Spirit Gathering Formations set up, the more important the location, the higher the grade of the formation set up. However, the highest was only Sixth Grade, as anything higher was unaffordable.
A standard Sixth Grade Spirit Gathering Formation required five million Lower Grade Spirit Stones, and a standard Fifth Grade Spirit Gathering Formation required one hundred million Lower Grade Spirit Stones, which is equivalent to 10,000 Top Quality Spirit Stones.
Only the powers of the Myriad Phenomena Realm had the foundation and were willing to purchase a Fifth Grade Spirit Gathering Formation. As for higher-grade formations, none were sold on the market.
The aforementioned spiritual energy densities are only theoretical values. In reality, the richness of spiritual energy at locations such as Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak, and Yundao Peak was much lower.
Han Li conducted an investigation and found that the spiritual energy had vanished without a trace, and he didn’t know where it had gathered.
This made Han Li even more certain that there was something wrong with Chengsheng Mountain; there was a major entity absorbing spiritual energy, hidden very deeply, at least beyond the current detection capabilities of Han Li.
He suspected that Chengsheng Mountain truly concealed a Soul-Cultivating Furnace or a Life -Prolonging Furnace, most likely the latter. The
Soul-Cultivating Furnace was only an imitation and not as extraordinary.
The reason for the scarce spiritual energy in Yonchang Manor dated back to ancient times; over 110,000 years since then, only a treasure from ancient times like the Life-Prolonging Furnace could have the capacity to absorb spiritual energy for so many thousands of years.
As to why it absorbed spiritual energy, Han Li guessed that the Life -Prolonging Furnace was damaged in the great calamity of ancient times and was now autonomously repairing the damaged areas, which required a continuous supply of spiritual energy.
Alternatively, a supreme Spirit Pill or a powerful Divine Weapon might be in the process of being refined inside the Life-Prolonging Furnace, requiring the absorption of spiritual energy for 110,000 years, and still not having reached its limit.
In that month, apart from setting up Spirit Gathering Formations, Han Li also refined many pills, weapons, and made numerous talismans for Han Mansion.
Because Han Mansion had recruited many Ninth Grade and Eighth Grade
Artifact Refiners, Alchemists, and Mark Masters, Han Li only needed to refine Seventh Grade Spiritual Artifacts, as well as Seventh Grade, Sixth Grade, and Fifth Grade Spirit Pills, and talismans above Seventh Grade.
In the Four Arts of Cultivation, Han Li was a Fifth Grade Pill Refining Master, Sixth Grade Mark Master, Seventh Grade Artifact Refiner, and Array Master.
Items below Sixth Grade would be sold in large quantities to earn Spirit Stones, while Sixth Grade, Fifth Grade, and top Fifth Grade items would be stored first for various uses, such as rewards, exchange options, or future sales, among others.
Besides recruiting cultivators who studied the Four Arts of Cultivation, Han Mansion also recruited many cultivators at the Innate Realm and Pihai Realm to serve as family guards, and even two cultivators at the Gangyuan Realm Grand Master level were willing to become Guest Elders, as long as Han Li mentored them twice a year.
Han Li marveled that they were fortunate to have made the most correct decision in their lives. Han Li was an extremely strong cultivator with True Martial Realm combat ability, meeting with them twice a year was a tremendous opportunity for them.
Therefore, Han Li had them sign a long-term contract; they couldn’t just leave after improving their cultivation level, no way!
They had to work for him honestly.
During this period, Han Li also began formally training the younger generation of his family. Before the move, there were already quite a few eight-year-old children, and after nearly two years spent moving, dozens more eight-year-olds had joined.
Among them were many with high aptitude, such as Han Yongzhen with Third Grade aptitude, Han Yonglin with Fifth Grade aptitude, and Han Yongyun with Sixth Grade aptitude, among others.
There were also some who had cultivated to the Innate Realm, such as Han Yongfan, Han Yongchun, and Han Yongli; they had been taught by Han Li en route, and their cultivation had progressed rapidly, nearing a breakthrough to the Pihai Realm.
Han Li had already thought of a fairly systematic and complete system for training his family’s younger generations, and he had prepared various challenges and benefits. As long as they met his requirements and passed his tests, they could earn a wealth of benefits.
The benefits were manifold, such as higher-level Cultivation Techniques, martial skills, personal mentoring opportunities from Han Li, Cultivation resources like Spirit Stones, Spirit Pills, and Spiritual Artifacts, and even chances to obtain sword talismans and other talismans made by Han Li himself.
Han Li also knew well that aptitude did not determine everything, nor did aptitude equate to comprehension.A cultivator’s advancement to profound realms was influenced by various factors..

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 130 Family Planning, The Sword Immortal Arrives!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: Chapter 130 Family Planning, The Sword Immortal Arrives!_3
Translator: 549690339
One can only say that innate talent provides cultivators with incredible assistance, offering them a high starting point. Cultivators with good talent, if they receive proper cultivation and do not meet untimely ends, have a high probability of reaching lofty realms.
For cultivators with lesser talent, the chance to cultivate to profound realms is significantly smaller; after all, poor talent means slower cultivation speed. However, with enough cultivation resources, or a great opportunity, they too can reach the Myriad Phenomena Realm or even the True Martial Realm.
Generally speaking, cultivators with high talent also possess keen insight, but there are also many with poor talent but keen insight, and even some whose insight defies the heavens.
Even if their talent is lacking, such cultivators with high insight have a similarly great chance of cultivating to profound realms.
Therefore, he specially crafted an Enlightenment Stone.
This Enlightenment Stone contained all the omni-directional martial Dao true meanings and rudimentary insights that Han Li had up to this point, which he placed on Enlightenment Peak, allowing any member of the Han Family to come and observe.
As long as they could comprehend something, even those with mediocre talent could be specially cultivated by Han Li. If their talent was already good, then they would receive even more intense cultivation.
This was the opportunity that Han Li offered to all descendants of the Han Mansion, like a stone tablet at the gate of a sect, impartial to all, available for anyone to comprehend the Dao.
In Han Li’s heart, there are roughly three types of descendants: the first type has both talent and insight and can cultivate to high realms in the future; the second type has strong abilities, capable of helping Han Li manage the various affairs of the family;
The third type are those either lacking in both talent and insight or completely devoid of talent. These descendants can expand the family tree, producing more offspring.
The first type will receive key cultivation, the second type he will also cultivate vigorously, providing a large amount of cultivation resources to those with poor talent, and helping those without talent to extend their lifespan or to cultivate talented offspring.
The third type will only receive basic cultivation resources and worldly wealth; if they desire more, they must make contributions to the Han Family.
Apart from the above, Han Li had also opened up patches of Spirit Fields in various places on Chengsheng Mountain to grow Spiritual Medicines.
The higher the grade of the Spiritual Medicine, the more luscious the spiritual energy of the place where it is planted.
Once the Spiritual Medicines mature, they can be used for alchemy, as rewards for descendants, exchanged by members of the Han Mansion, or sold to increase the Spirit Stone income of the Han Mansion. Either way, there are many benefits.
Han Li set up formations in every Spirit Field, appointing dedicated individuals to manage and guard them, strictly prohibiting any leakage of information about the fields, and providing a certain number of Contribution Values every year.
“Huff-I’
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li let out a long breath, feeling a lot of pressure lift from him.
He had been incredibly busy lately; at last, he had set the Han Family on the right track, and life would be much easier from then on.
He only needed to take care of his cherished wife and concubines, cultivate his descendants, and craft Spirit Pills, Spiritual Artifacts, Spirit Talismans, and so on.
Suddenly, Han Li’s spirits lifted. His Spiritual Sense, reaching five thousand miles away, detected a figure—it was the figure he had been waiting for a long time.
The Sword Immortal, Jiang Baiye, was finally arriving, albeit belatedly.
Had it not been for the last time he used his Spirit Seed to peek into her thoughts, the Old Ancestor would have thought Jiang Baiye would not come.
“Coming at such a late hour, how interesting,” Han Li said with a grin.
It was already nighttime, and it seemed Jiang Baiye had deliberately chosen this moment to avoid most prying eyes.
After all, she was the foremost Sword Fairy of Sanzhou, and many were paying close attention to her movements. Jiang Baiye did not wish others to know she was going to become Han Li’s wife.
This piece of news wouldn’t be good for anyone if it got out.
PS: No chapter five today; only eighteen thousand words across four chapters, not the twenty thousand. I’m exhausted, wuwu.
Continuing to ask for monthly tickets, tomorrow I’ll work hard to explode with a twenty thousand word update!

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - 1311 Won ‘t Act Rashly, The Dragon Maiden I s Journey_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: Chapter 1311 Won ‘t Act Rashly, The Dragon Maiden I s Journey_l
Translator: 549690339
The silver moon hung high, its light bright and pure.
Jiang Baiye, clad in white, otherworldly as if dust-free, carried the Divine Sword on her back. The cool, tender moonlight adorned her, ethereal as if untouched by the mundane world, resembling a Fairy descending from her moon palace, dreamlike and illusory—a breathtakingly beautiful scene. “Why did that bastard Han Li move to Yonchang Manor?”
In the distance, Chengsheng Mountain came into view, and Jiang Baiye’s expression grew complex as she lightly bit her red lips.
During her time at Canghai Sect, she had kept tabs on the Han Mansion’s relocation, eventually learning it had settled at Chengsheng Mountain within Yonchang Manor.
The spiritual energy at Yonchang Manor was thin, the poorest among the twenty-eight provinces of Yuanzhou, and Chengsheng Mountain was the place where the energy was most sparse in the manor.
Han Li liked to take advantage, so why would he choose Chengsheng Mountain as the Han Mansion’s cultivation site? Was it really because there was less trouble?
Or was there another hidden reason?
Mind flashing with thoughts, Jiang Baiye let out a sigh in her heart, knowing that pondering these matters was futile. Once she arrived at Chengsheng Mountain, some things would not be able to be concealed from her.
Soon, Jiang Baiye flew into Yonchang Manor, her exquisite brows immediately furrowing slightly.
“The spiritual energy is even worse than I expected.”
Jiang Baiye sighed, but she did not stop moving and continued toward
Chengsheng Mountain, eventually descending at the foot of the mountain.
She knew that bastard Han Li had surely noticed her presence but had yet to show himself. She wondered what kind of trickery he was planning.
“This guy really is willing to invest heavily.”
The figure, cold and peerless, stood at the foot of the mountain, gazing up at Chengsheng Mountain with a flicker of shock in her eyes.
Her Spiritual Sense swarmed forth, taking in the entire Chengsheng Mountain, and she noticed that a large Spirit Gathering Array had been set up over it, apparently of the seventh grade.
The spiritual energy outside Chengsheng Mountain was much thinner than reported, but within the mountain, it was much denser, reaching the standard of a normal manor.
Chengsheng Mountain was not small at all, stretching over seven hundred li in length and more than two hundred li in width. To cover such a range with a
Spirit Gathering Array would require an astronomical number of Spirit Stones.
A normal seventh-grade Spirit Gathering Array could only cover an area five li in radius and would need two hundred thousand lower-grade Spirit Stones. To cover Chengsheng Mountain, it would take possibly tens of millions of Spirit Stones. Where did that bastard Han Li get so many?
Her Canghai Sect belonged to the Myriad Phenomena Realm forces, one of the
Ten Major Sects; their mountain gate was much larger than Chengsheng Mountain, yet they only set up an Eighth Grade Spirit Gathering Array, with higher grade arrays arranged only in certain key areas.
Jiang Baiye was somewhat familiar with Chengsheng Mountain’s Mountain Protection Array—it seemed to be the same Formation Han Li used the first time he captured her, and it was quite powerful.
“He knew I was coming,” Jiang Baiye huffed coldly, somewhat displeased that Han Li had not shown himself yet.
Her cultivation might be strong, but she still couldn’t peek inside Chengsheng Mountain; evidently, that bastard deliberately allowed her to see that much.
The enhanced version of the Five Elements Life and Death Formation on Chengsheng Mountain operated continuously, obscuring the interior from the outside world. One could only see the formerly magnificent scenery of the mountain but not the state of the Han Mansion within, nor the richness of the spiritual energy.
Before moving, the Han Family was just a small clan, surviving in a minor county without the need to constantly operate formations, as no Cultivator above the Gangyuan Realm really cared about them.
After moving, everyone knew the Han Family was an Immortal Refining Clan, and many were secretly scanning with their Spiritual Sense, seeking to understand the situation inside Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li certainly did not want the details of the Han Family to be fully exposed. He had created numerous Spirit Fields, some of immense value, and did not wish places like Chengdao Peak to be spied upon.
Operating the Mountain Protection Array constantly would consume a large amount of Spirit Stones, but the Han Mansion could afford that expense—the necessary protective measures could not be neglected.
Atop Chengdao Peak, Han Li kept a close watch on Jiang Baiye.
He had even employed his Spiritual Sense to shield her from others, preventing anyone from seeing her.
Just as Jiang Baiye thought, Han Li did not want others to know she was visiting his place, at least not for now, else it would cause quite a bit of trouble.
Even though he was to marry Jiang Baiye, the conditions of her reception would be the same as Lu Tianxiang; he did not need to go out to meet her, just a banquet to entertain was sufficient.
He would conceal Jiang Baiye’s looks; her appearing just once would be enough. With no Cultivators of God Refining Realm present, who would dare to peer intentionally?
That would be courting death!
The outside world only knew that the Han Family’s ancestor had taken a wife, but not who the bride was. Even if they were curious, they would not deliberately seek the truth.
“Jiang Baiye, you’ve really made me wait.”
Han Li’s figure flashed, appearing beside Jiang Baiye, wrapping around her delicate waist, then returning to the peak of Chengdao.
“You…”
Just as Jiang Baiye reacted, she found herself on the main peak. After thinking for a moment and not taking action, she let Han Li hold her.
“I haven’t broken my oath,” Jiang Baiye huffed coldly.
Han Li nodded slightly, and with a thought, he retracted the psychic seed from Jiang Baiye’s mind.
Jiang Baiye immediately sensed it, breathed a sigh of relief; without the psychic seed, she could finally recall certain things.
“So direct? This isn’t like you,” Jiang Baiye said with a blink, curiously asking.
She Imew quite a lot about Han Li. According to his usual way of doing things, he shouldn’t have retracted the psychic seed this early.
“There’s no need,” Han Li said indifferently.
Jiang Baiye had proven through her actions that she was trustworthy, adhering faithfully to her oath, and Han Li was not one to be overly rigid.
Moreover, with his True Martial Realm combat ability, capable of blasting
Prince Wu’an, what waves could Jiang Baiye, in the late stage of God Refining Realm, possibly create? After all, Han Li’s Spiritual Sense constantly covered Han Mansion, to prevent any powerful individuals from secretly infiltrating.
“Hmm-” Jiang Baiye hummed lightly, a faint sense of fondness arising in her heart for Han Li’s approach..

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 1311 Won ‘t Act Rashly, The Dragon Maiden ‘s Journey_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Chapter 1311 Won ‘t Act Rashly, The Dragon Maiden ‘s Journey_2
Translator: 549690339
She definitely did not want to be surveilled at all times, a feeling akin to a thorn in her side, prickly and deeply uncomfortable.
Han Li released Jiang Baiye and stood beside her, hands clasped behind his back, gazes down at Chengsheng Mountain and suddenly asked, “Are you ready?”
Jiang Baiye was slightly startled, and then her pretty face blushed slightly as she shook her head and whispered softly, “Not yet.”
Han Li turned to look at Jiang Baiye and found that the Sword Immortal tonight was exceptionally enchanting.
Jiang Baiye was inherently aloof and otherworldly, ethereal and detached. Now, standing at the summit, her white dress danced with the wind and her silver hair fluttered, together with the Divine Sword on her back, she resembled a moon fairy descended to the world, a silver-haired female sword immortal.
Jiang Baiye possessed a graceful silhouette with smooth curves, her legs long and straight, her waist slender and flexible, and her skin delicate and fair as jade stone, flawlessly perfect, truly a vision of elegance.
Her arched brows, cherry lips, and dainty nose coupled with eyes that sparkled with vivacious light, carried a chilling distance that seemed to keep others at bay. Her lips were stunningly beautiful, her body exuded a light fragrance, she was truly a peerlessly beautiful woman.
Her fairy-like grace and radiant charm were fully displayed in this moment.
Under Han Li’s intense gaze, Jiang Baiye bit her red lips, her expression slightly nervous, revealing an air of distinctive allure.
Jiang Baiye could hardly bear Han Li’s unabashed stare and hurriedly changed the subject, “You have good taste. Chengsheng Mountain and Chengdao Peak not only offer stunning scenery, but also are abundant in spiritual energy, rivaling many great sects.”
After arriving here, Jiang Baiye realized that the spiritual energy on Chengdao Peak was several times denser than anywhere else on Chengsheng Mountain, clearly because Han Li had set up a Spirit Gathering Array here.
“My taste has always been impeccable,” Han Li said with implied meaning.
Jiang Baiye understood the hint and chose not to respond.
“Come here,” Han Li suddenly pointed to a spot next to him, noticing that Jiang Baiye was a bit too far from him,
Jiang Baiye bit her red lips, hesitated slightly, but still moved closer. The next moment she felt a large hand block her soft waist.
After struggling in vain, Jiang Baiye gave up.
When she came to Chengsheng Mountain, Jiang Baiye was mentally prepared; according to their agreement, she was to marry Han Li and, in exchange, obtain the Body-Cultivating Furnace and other promises Han Li had made. If she had a choice, Jiang Baiye definitely would not want to come, but she had no say in the matter.
Having made an oath back then, Jiang Baiye had never thought about reneging. Although Han Li was lustful and shameless, he was in other respects indeed a match for her.
While Jiang Baiye was still contemplating, she felt her lips suddenly blocked, struggled for a while, then relented awkwardly, responding in kind.
After a long time, Han Li let her go, looking at the beautiful woman whose face was flushed with rosy tinges. Han Li drew her into his arms, immediately feeling the warmth and softness envelop him, and inhaled a breath of her refreshing scent uncontrollably.
Feeling the warmth of Han Li’s body, Jiang Baiye’s heart fluttered, an experience she felt for the first time.
Although Han Li had teased her like this before, her mindset and feelings were not the same as they are now.
Nibbling on Jiang Baiye’s earlobe, Han Li’s hand became restless. Jiang Baiye struggled, but not too fiercely, as if her heart was not fully opposed to Han Li’s actions.
“Baiye, are you ready?” Suddenly, Han Li’s voice entered Jiang Baiye’s mind.
Jiang Baiye, somewhat flustered, immediately snapped back to attention, vigorously shaking her head and said in a cold voice, “You must marry me first.”
She Imew she couldn’t escape this situation, but she didn’t want it to happen so soon. She had only just arrived at Chengsheng Mountain, was she really going to lose her innocence?
“I promise,” Han Li replied without the slightest hesitation, since Jiang Baiye was bound to be his eventually, a few days did not matter.
Previously, Han Li had been eager to deflower Lu Tianxiang because of her immense allure, as she was the first high-quality female cultivator he had obtained. On the other hand, the move to Yonchang Manor was more than a year away, and Han Li could not wait that long.
As it turned out, his approach was correct.
Now that they had arrived at Yonchang Manor and the Han Mansion was on the right track, there was naturally no need to rush to possess Jiang Baiye.
Han Li also wanted to leave Jiang Baiye with beautiful memories.
Jiang Baiye responded softly, her fondness for Han Li growing. Although he was shameless and lecherous, he was very respectful towards her.
She knew that if Han Li wanted to force her, she would not be able to resist, and she would’ve lost herself the last time.
“Baiye, then let me hold you to sleep tonight,” Han Li whispered into her ear, his breath sending tremors through Jiang Baiye’s heart.
Even though they couldn’t take the final step, there were other lines of defense that could be breached.
“No!” Jiang Baiye flatly refused.
Han Li was up to some trick, and she understood it crystal clear.
“Don’t worry, I won’t do anything rash; I simply want to hold you while we sleep,” said Han Li earnestly, seemingly just as he said.
“Heh,” a cold smirk appeared on Jiang Baiye’s face, though she didn’t outright refuse.
Sensing an opportunity, Han Li continued to sweet-talk Jiang Baiye, trying to cheer her up.
As it turned out, even high-caliber beauties like Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye enjoyed being showered with compliments, especially when said by a member of the opposite sex with whom they had a special relationship.
Yuanzhou, Capital City.
The Prime Minister’s residence.
A peerless beauty put down her embroidery, looking at her finished work with an exquisite smile on her face.
“Finally finished. ”
The beauty sighed; the embroidery was done, and some matters should also come to an end.
In the end, the peerless beauty glanced at the Prime Minister’s bedchamber, a hint of something unusual flashed in her eyes, she sighed softly, and her figure vanished.
“It’s come to this step at last, alas.”
Inside the bedchamber, with the lights burning bright, the Prime Minister looked blankly at his daughter’s empty boudoir, his expression struggling with an incredibly complex mood.
He was both the father of Yu’er and the Prime Minister of the Daqian Empire, torn between familial love and loyalty to the nation.
The Daqian Empire had been incredibly gracious to him; the late Emperor and the current Emperor Qian both valued him highly; otherwise, he would neither have attained nor kept his position as Prime Minister.
His status in the Daqian Empire was very high, among the top five. He managed to cultivate his way to the Myriad Phenomena Realm and become a Great Grandmaster, with significant help from the Daqian Empire.
On the other side was his own daughter, whom he watched grow up, bound to him by flesh and blood and familial ties.
Yet his daughter was about to come into major conflict with the Daqian Empire, leaving the Prime Minister caught in the middle, extremely troubled.
After a long silence, the Prime Minister stood up and went to the palace.
He knew that the moment his daughter left, she had already made the decision for him.
Hanzhou, Fengbo Pavilion.
Dressed in blue, Lu Wenyuan entered Fengbo Pavilion and made his way up to the thirty-sixth floor, once again meeting the old man in hemp clothing.
“Wenyuan, is everything ready?”
The old man in hemp seemed to have anticipated his arrival and immediately went straight to the point.
“Lord, all is almost ready,” Lu Wenyuan promptly responded with respect.
Fengbo Pavilion had only been established for two or three years in the Daqian Empire, but it had secretly done many things, always preparing for the third step of a grand plan, and now the preparations were quite adequate.
“What I want is not ‘almost’; it must be thoroughly prepared; we cannot afford any more mistakes,” the old man in hemp huffed, discontent with the reply.
“My apologies, Lord!”
Lu Wenyuan immediately apologized, knowing full well that this was not the time for explanations; when superiors are angry, they don’t listen to your reasoning; they want to see you admit your fault and apologize.
“You must be thoroughly prepared within a year,” the old man in hemp nodded slightly, pleased with his attitude, and commanded.
“Yes!”
Lu Wenyuan promptly agreed, then exited Fengbo Pavilion.
After returning to his own courtyard, Lu Wenyuan sighed. Doing these things truly wore him out.
Externally, he had to navigate among the various sects, promising various rewards to win them over, while internally, he also had to deal with Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm.
He still had feelings for Lu Tianxiang and wondered how she was doing at the moment; he couldn’t leave to investigate just yet, only knowing that she was rescued by a mysterious Great Grandmaster.
“Once Canghai Sect is dealt with, I’ll have time to look into Tianxiang,” Lu Wenyuan silently vowed.
He had dealt with and won over all other targeted sects, but Canghai Sect remained a tough nut to crack, presently mired in pressures from all sides, a prime opportunity to secure their allegiance.
Yet the Sect Leader of Canghai Sect was unbending and inscrutable.

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 132: The Storm Approaches! Jiao Saint! Dragon Soul and Dragon Ball!_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Chapter 132: The Storm Approaches! Jiao Saint! Dragon Soul and Dragon Ball!_l
Translator: 549690339
Dingyuan Manor, within the unparalleled Emperor Formation.
The towering figure revealed its outline, his eyes gazing outwards as if he could see through the obstacles of the Emperor Formation. Stars were born and died in his eyes; ages rose and fell.
“How many years has it been?”
The sonorous and ancient voice suddenly sounded, and the towering figure’s brows furrowed, his complexion somewhat grim.
It seemed he had miscalculated again.
Four or five years had passed, and the Cultivator woman from the Myriad Phenomena Realm who had appeared last time had not returned yet, which made the Great Emperor somewhat anxious.
To pull that woman from the Myriad Phenomena Realm in, he had exhausted all his external forces, it could be said to be an all-in gamble. Has she still not tracked down that little Cultivator?
All kinds of conjectures flashed through the Great Emperor’s mind, eventually turning into a sigh; he had underestimated that woman from the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Even the Immortal Law Emperor Scripture and the opportunity to become an emperor couldn’t tempt that Cultivator woman—her dao heart was far too steadfast, just at the Myriad Phenomena Realm, yet her dao heart matched that of the peak of the Tongxuan Realm’s Zimei Zhen.
“Seems I can only endure for a few more tens of thousands of years.” Within the nine-colored light barrier, darkness swept over, concealing the towering figure, and there was no more sound in the Underground World.
In the Capital City of Da Qian, the Imperial Palace.
Inside the Chao Tian Hall, Emperor Qian sat high on the Dragon Chair, thinking back to what the Prime Minister had said, his expression solemn as he asked again:
“Prime Minister, are you sure what you said is true?”
Emperor Qian couldn’t help but be solemn; the matter was too significant, so serious that even a master of a top power had to treat it with great care.
“I swear on my loyalty, every word is true,” the Prime Minister said with a bow, his tone sincere.
Emperor Qian felt a great headache, looking at the Prime Minister who seemed hesitant to speak, ultimately said nothing.
“Summon the Grand Preceptor, State Preceptor, Prophet, Head Supervisor, and
Great General. ”
Emperor Qian instructed the Grand Internal Supervisor standing beside him and then said to the Prime Minister:
“Please wait here for a moment, my dear subject.”
The Prime Minister watched as Emperor Qian’s figure receded, saying nothing, just thinking of his daughter far away, his heart stirring with waves.
In the deepest part of the Imperial Palace, the core forbidden area.
Emperor Qian arrived there, took out a metal Token inscribed with the character “Qian,” infused it with Gang Yuan, and the Token immediately radiated divine light, opening a passage that Emperor Qian stepped into with long strides.
Walking inside, Emperor Qian’s heart was somewhat uneasy; this was the most important place in the Qian Dynasty, which could only be opened with the Qian Token.
To activate the Qian Token, one needed to practice the Da Qian Royalty’s exclusive Heaven Rank Cultivation Technique at the Myriad Phenomena Realm of a Great Grandmaster, for their Gang Yuan had a specific property, comparable to the strength of True Yuan. Missing the slightest amount meant it could not be opened from the outside.
If someone tried to attack forcefully, the three-grade Emperor Formation that protected the forbidden area would kill the intruder outright.
He walked along the passage, the path ahead suddenly opened up, and he entered an ancient hall.
In the center of the hall, there was a stove, its design ancient and covered in patterns, emanating an aura that was refreshing to the soul.
On either side of the stove, there were two cushioned mats, upon which sat two figures, both facing the stove.
The figure on the left wore coarse gray clothes, hair white as a crane’s and skin wrinkled like a chicken’s, his eyes tightly closed, not even a breath could be felt.
The figure on the right was dressed in Silver Battle Armor, his features rugged and handsome, also with eyes shut, but his aura was robust and dominant.
Emperor Qian didn’t go forward, merely stopping at the entrance of the hall, glancing at the stove before bowing his head to report: “Ancestor, Father, I have an urgent matter to report.”
“Ancestor, Father, I have an urgent matter to report.”
There was no reaction from the two figures in the hall, but Emperor Qian waited patiently. After the time it takes to burn an incense stick, the rugged figure on the right finally opened his eyes. Two beams of divine light shone on the stove, but the stove remained unresponsive.
“Speak,” said the rugged middle- aged man in a commanding tone that unconsciously inspired submission.
Another incense stick’s time later, Emperor Qian left the hall, walked the passage, and appeared outside the forbidden area.
He looked back at the forbidden area one last time, his figure vanishing. When he reappeared, he was already back in the Chao Tian Hall.
In the hall, the Grand Preceptor, State Preceptor, Prophet, and the others had all arrived, each wearing a grave expression. Grand Internal Manager Cao had already relayed some news, which made them feel extremely troubled.
They knew where Emperor Qian had been, and they also knew that such matters were not for Emperor Qian to decide alone, so they waited patiently.
When Emperor Qian appeared, they all looked at him eagerly, wanting to know what decision he had received.
“My lords, there is no need to worry, the sky of Da Qian won’t fall,” Emperor Qian said with a smile, his tone relaxed.
The Grand Preceptor, State Preceptor, and the others breathed a sigh of relief, and a secret council immediately began, discussing how to handle the impact of this affair, and how to counter that person.
After the secret council ended, the Prophet returned to the Imperial Astronomer to observe the national fate of Da Qian once more.
“Pu—”
The Prophet spat out a mouthful of blood from his core, his face aged by threefold, his overall presence greatly diminished. He hurriedly took out several medicinal pills and swallowed them to ease his condition, but his face was still marked with shock.
“How could this be?” the Prophet muttered to himself restlessly.
He noticed that Da Qian’s national fate was extremely volatile, with dragons and snakes preparing to emerge from the earth as if a world-changing event was imminent.
The opportunity indicated for Prince Wu’an was still in Leizhou, but the critical point concerning Da Qian’s future faintly pointed toward another province.
After steadying his heart, the Prophet hurriedly left to convey this matter to the concerned parties.
In Leizhou, at the Hehuan Sect.
Yan Liulong lounged on a throne, revealing a large area of snow-white skin from her slender legs. She propped her chin with one hand, appearing to be deep in thought.
From her, one could see the delicacy and charm of a mature woman, as well as the tenderness and purity of a young girl, all aspects of femininity embodied in one person. Especially with the white stockings on her legs, she added even more seductiveness..

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 132: The Storm Approaches! Jiao Saint! Dragon Soul and Dragon Ball!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: Chapter 132: The Storm Approaches! Jiao Saint! Dragon Soul and Dragon Ball!_2
Translator: 549690339
This is a Femme Fatale!
“How annoying, should I seek revenge or not?”
