The seductive and soul-stirring voice resonated in the grand hall, a frown creasing the Femme Fatale’s brow, which would make anyone who saw it feel heartache, not willing to let her frown.
The death of Cui Pingyu finally had a lead; everything pointed to Tianxuan Mountain’s core disciple, Han Li.
Cui Pingyu was a core disciple of the Hehuan Sect, dispatched to Zhenyi Manor on an assignment, responsible for infiltrating Qingzhou, a matter significant to the grand plans of the Yinyang Sect.
However, Cui Pingyu had died in previous years, killed by someone who forced their way into the manor, and the evidence at the scene pointed to the White Lotus Cult, but Yan Liulong was no fool to believe that.
She ordered an investigation, as the death of a core disciple was no small matter, but after years with no results, the Hehuan Sect had given up on the probe.
Recently, there had been a turnaround, as someone conveyed information to the Hehuan Sect, claiming the culprit behind the deed was Tianxuan Mountain’s Han Li.
Han Li had a concubine, named Lin Yiyin, who looked exactly like the female cultivator that Cui Pingyu had attempted to capture. Han Li had attacked Cui Pingyu for this woman, and had then pinned the deed on the White Lotus Cult.
Yan Liulong had the intelligence gathered, confirming the information about Lin Yiyin was correct—many at the Cui Manor in Zhenyi City had seen Lin Yiyin, indeed confirming she was the same person as Han Li’s concubine.
Yan Liulong also looked into Han Li’s background and discovered he was a cultivator in the God Refining Realm. Although he had reached the realm only within the last two years, it was possible he had hidden his cultivation level in earlier years, otherwise, why would Gongsun Yun, that old fox, accept him as a direct disciple?
Han Li had the strength to kill Cui Pingyu, and with Lin Yiyin in Han Mansion, the murderer could be confirmed without a doubt.
Under normal circumstances, with the discovery of the murderer, she would launch an attack and directly obliterate him, to uphold the name of the Hehuan Sect.
Only, that Han Li was quite cunning, having preemptively moved to Yuanzhou, which left Yan Liulong feeling somewhat at a loss for how to proceed.
Her identity prevented her from easily entering other provinces of the Daqian Empire, and with the undercurrents growing treacherous, she did not want to die without clarity. She desired to retire after achieving success and ascend to a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Since Han Li had fled, her next course would be to make trouble for Han Li’s Sect, which indeed seemed to be what the force secretly passing intel wanted to see.
Yan Liulong’s mind was delicate and crystal clear, piercing through the secrecy of the situation; however, this was an open plot, enticing those willing to be ensnared.
Tianxuan Mountain and the Hehuan Sect were both among the Four Sects of Leizhou with nearly equal power, and Hehuan Sect represented the Yinyang Sect.
If she were to commence hostilities with Tianxuan Mountain, triggering a conflict, she would fall into the trap of other forces. That force clearly intended to prematurely drag the Yinyang Sect into the turmoil, muddying the waters, and prevent them from profiting as bystanders.
To coerce Tianxuan Mountain into paying a price, the Hehuan Sect would need the Yinyang Sect’s power. Tianxuan Mountain had not aligned with Da Qian, but the Daqian Empire wouldn’t just stand by either.
Yan Liulong did not want to proceed in such a manner, for it would disrupt the Yinyang Sect’s grand plans, with extremely severe consequences.
Yet she did not wish to let Han Li get away scot-free; she wanted to capture him, teach him a good lesson, and “harvest” him to vent her spleen.
She was very interested in Han Li; a man who frequently took concubines and did not compete outside, yet whose cultivation advanced by leaps and bounds perhaps he possessed some high-level Dual Cultivation Technique or Collection and Supplement Method.
She was eager to compare her Collection and Supplement Method prowess with Han Li’s to see whose was more formidable.
Huozhou City, Royal Manor.
Master Lan stepped forward, informing Prince Wu’an of two significant pieces of news that had arrived from the Capital City.
“It’s actually her! ”
A rare look of astonishment appeared on Prince Wu’an’s face, who normally carried an expression of settled composure with everything seemingly within his grasp.
“Left Chancellor, oh Left Chancellor, why the suffering. Alas.”
Following that, Prince Wu’an sighed again, thinking of the Left Chancellor and ultimately deciding not to pursue accountability.
The Left Chancellor was not only immensely powerful but also had rendered great service to the Daqian Empire, assisting two Emperors Qian. He would continue to serve when it was his turn to ascend the throne.
Regardless, the Left Chancellor still favored Da Qian, his heart loyal to the Empire. Otherwise, he would not have made the decision to reveal such confidential and vital news.
“The last Jiao Dragon in the world, an ancient sage, the legend of Yingyuan Mountain is actually true; it’s really unexpected,” Prince Wu’an said with a multitude of emotions.
Now, he finally knew what the grand opportunity he had been waiting for was. Everything became clear, and it was all related to the last Jiao Dragon in the world.
According to the legends, the ancient sage traversed the Eight Hundred Divine Regions, slaying the malevolent Jiao Dragons, and the very last one fled to Qianyuan Divine Province but still couldn’t escape its fate.
Now it seems, after the death of that Jiao Dragon, the ancient sage had other plans and only took the immensely valuable treasures such as dragon tendons, blood, hide, bones, and more.
But the dragon’s most important attributes, the Dragon Soul and Dragon Ball, were left behind. It is said that this particular Jiao Dragon had just ascended to the Holy Abyss Realm, and its power was extremely terrifying.
From the news that came from Da Qian, it could be confirmed that Yingyuan Mountain was the transformed body of that Jiao Saint. However, all the valuable treasures were taken away, leaving only a rich spiritual energy, which formed a large dragon vein.
But that dragon vein was taken by powerful beings over a hundred thousand years ago, leaving Yingyuan Mountain rather ordinary and the source of a legend.
The Dragon Soul reincarnated and was reborn as the daughter of the Prime Minister, who noticed abnormalities early on, investigated, but did not inform Da Qian, choosing to keep it a secret.
Now, as the Prime Minister’s daughter and Da Qian are on the brink of opposition, the Prime Minister has made his choice to stand with Da Qian and revealed the news.
And the grand opportunity he needed was the Jiao Dragon’s Dragon Ball. With that Dragon Ball, he could refine a King Grade Pill, and he could even rapidly advance to the Divine Yuan Realm and improve his talent further—a heavenly fortune indeed.
No wonder when Yingyuan Mountain was severed, the Prophet sensed that the secrets of heaven had become clear in an instant, pinpointing the rough range where the opportunity for fortune appeared.
“It seems she is my greatest opponent,” Prince Wu’an said with a complex tone. He had seen the Prime Minister’s daughter before, a delicate beauty without any cultivation.
Now, it seemed he had been deceived, which might have to do with the fact that his combat ability hadn’t reached the True Martial Realm at that time. Prince Wu’an put down his fishinq rod, stood up, and looked in the direction of Yingyuan Mountain with a grave expression. The Dragon Lady had put significant pressure on him.
According to the Prime Minister, the Dragon Lady had reached the True Martial Realm a few years ago, but no one knew exactly which level of the True Martial Realm she had achieved.
He needed the Dragon Ball, but the Dragon Lady would certainly not give it up, for it was a critical item for her reincarnated life and central to whether she could climb to that domain in this life.
It was inevitable that the Dragon Lady and Da Qian would stand in opposition.
Yuanzhou, Chengsheng Mountain.
The morning light was faint, and the sky gradually brightened.
On the vast and soft bed, Han Li woke up, looking at the breathtaking Sword Immortal in his arms, his lips curving into a smile.
Last night, he had successfully penetrated the Sword Immortal’s several lines of defense, leaving only the last one.
The Sword Immortal first resisted and then relented in a half-hearted manner, but she defended the final line with all her might, making Han Li give up. Even so, he was very satisfied.
Looking at the warm and fragrant jade in his arms, Han Li felt a sense of pride; the Sword Immortal had finally fallen into his hands, something unimaginable in the past.
The Sword Immortal, while asleep, seemed even more enchanting, with a face as beautiful as a heavenly fairy, shy and timid. Her autumn water-like eyes were half-open, brimming with tender, water-like affection, as if she were in a beautiful dream.
Her silver hair, smooth and soft, scattered on the bed, half-covering that cold and peerless face; her neck was long and white, pristine without a single flaw, moving down to the white dress she wore last night.
The white dress concealed her delicate and compelling curves, her boneless, fairy-like figure. The dress rose and fell with her perfect body, complementing it as if she were a fairy waiting to be plucked from the Moon Palace.
Her straight and slender jade legs were extremely tempting, coyly held together, and blended with her slender shoulders and waist, forming a dreamlike image of a sleeping fairy.
“Truly beautiful,” Han Li couldn’t help but praise aloud.
Jiang Baiye’s eyelashes fluttered, as if she were about to wake up, or perhaps she was already awake.
Han Li gently held her in his arms, carefully, feeling the warm and fragrant jade, inhaling the fresh scent of the Sword Immortal’s body..

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - 133: The Ancestor Marries Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 155: Chapter 133: The Ancestor Marries Again!
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing (Large Chapter, Please
Subscribe)_l
Translator: 549690339
Dawn broke, and a streak of morning glow awakened the earth from eternal night, infusing all living things with vitality.
The scenery of Chengsheng Mountain was already breathtaking, but now with the rise of the morning glow, it gained an additional touch of ethereal beauty.
Atop Chengdao Peak, clad in white, the Sword Immortal stood tall, overlooking the vast mountains and rivers, gazing at the beautiful sunrise, her red lips slightly parting:
“Feasting on the six energies and drinking the misty vapors, I rinse my mouth with pure yang and embrace the morning glow.”
Upon awakening, thinking about the things Han Li did to her last night, and the dreams she had, the Sword Immortal felt she needed some time to stay calm, so she ran here.
She gazed absently at the morning glow, reflecting on all that had transpired with Han Li, sighing inwardly, never having imagined herself being so intimate with a man.
It seemed that her subconscious had already accepted the fact, but her rationality kept her alert. The broken barriers were hard to restore, and she needed to be cautious.
At that moment, Jiang Baiye sensed someone approaching. She didn’t turn around, continuing to admire the morning glow as if it could calm her spirit.
“Jiang Baiye?”
Lu Tianxiang walked over, looking at the fairy with the Divine Sword on her back, her tone tinged with uncertainty.
Last night, Han Li had informed her that one of his sisters had arrived, and he wouldn’t be able to keep her company temporarily. Lu Tianxiang felt complicated but said nothing.
She knew this would happen sooner or later, that Han Li wouldn’t have only her as a wife, but she hadn’t expected it to be so soon.
Lu Tianxiang thought it was nice of Han Li to have told her in advance; it meant he had her in his heart and respected her, not abandoning her for a new love. This eased some of the knots in Lu Tianxiang’s heart.
Earlier when she saw someone flying to the summit, and it wasn’t one of Han Li’s concubines, Lu Tianxiang guessed it might be Han Li’s new wife and decided to see who it was.
Currently, Han Li had only her as his wife, the others were concubines. This woman, being given the status of a wife by Han Li, clearly was extraordinary.
Otherwise, if Han Li were to marry a beauty fit only to be a concubine as his wife, not only would Lu Tianxiang be displeased, but the other concubines wouldn’t be happy either. Why should they?
Lu Tianxiang felt she might know her.
Though the Daqian Empire was vast, there weren’t many female cultivators who had both beauty and talent, and they were all quite famous. Lu Tianxiang had looked into this long ago.
Upon seeing the person, Lu Tianxiang was somewhat surprised. Could this really be the Sword Immortal, whose beauty is renowned throughout the three states of Leizhou, Qingzhou, and Huozhou, acclaimed as the supreme beauty of the three states?
But when had Han Li ever intersected paths with Jiang Baiye?
Han Li used to be the type of person who lived a “secluded life in a small tower, indifferent to the changes of spring, summer, autumn, and winter,” keeping his cultivation deeply concealed, rarely venturing out for trials, and seldom interacting with other cultivators.
Jiang Baiye, on the other hand, was the favored daughter of the Canghai Sect, the likely next sect leader, who had reached the God Refining Realm early on, her name known far and wide across the entire Qian Dynasty.
Jiang Baiye was indifferent to suitors, devoted to cultivation, rumored to be a woman who preferred the company of her own gender, entangled in an unclear relationship with Yun Miaoyi of the Yinyang Sect.
Normally, Han Li and Jiang Baiye would not have known each other, but here Jiang Baiye stood before her, so Lu Tianxiang was sure she hadn’t mistaken her identity.
Suddenly, a thought flashed through her mind, and she realized the connection between Han Li and Jiang Baiye.
The Body-Cultivating Furnace!
She had seen Han Li use the Body-Cultivating Furnace, which now served as the core of Chengsheng Mountain’s Formation, and Han Li had even used this treasure to heal her wounds before.
After learning about the power of this artifact, Lu Tianxiang understood why the Canghai Sect valued it so much as a legacy treasure; its various powers were indeed very suitable for sect inheritance.
With the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the Canghai Sect was unshakable. Even if the Daqian Empire coveted it, they wouldn’t dare to seize it by force. What would the other sects think?
After the Loss of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, Jiang Baiye was responsible for its retrieval. She had been to Leizhou before, and Lu Tianxiang guessed that the intersection between Jiang Baiye and Han Li must have started there.
Han Li was known for his lustful nature; the beauty of Jiang Baiye, the supreme beauty of the three states, was not something Han Li would easily let go of.
Seeing it was Jiang Baiye, Lu Tianxiang felt much more balanced inside. Jiang Baiye surely wasn’t with Han Li of her own free will, becoming his wife; she had to be like Lu Tianxiang, making a reluctant choice out of helplessness.
Although Jiang Baiye’s cultivation and talent were somewhat inferior to her own, her appearance, aura, and figure were on par with Lu Tianxiang, and much higher than Han Li’s other concubines. Indeed, she had the qualifications to be Han Li’s wife, and women like Qiu Yueyao and Li Mingmeng would not be discontent.
“Wusheng Old Mother, you’re really here,”
Jiang Baiye turned around, her eyes lighting up at the stunningly beautiful woman behind her and quickly recognizing her identity.
The true face of Wusheng Old Mother was a secret to ordinary cultivators, but Jiang Baiye was no ordinary cultivator; she had long since seen a portrait of Wusheng Old Mother.
She also knew that the mysterious Great Grandmaster was Han Li, and that Wusheng Old Mother had been rescued by Han Li; her appearance here was not strange.
Like Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye also believed Han Li would not let go of a woman with peerless beauty, just as she herself had fallen into Han Li’s Devil’s Palm.
It was no wonder that bastard Han Li took a wife recently; it seemed that it was indeed Wusheng Old Mother, and surely, she was qualified to be Han Li’s wife.
Lu Tianxiang’s pupils narrowed slightly; upon their first meeting, it seemed she was slightly at a disadvantage.
Previously, she did not know Han Li’s new wife was Jiang Baiye, but Jiang Baiye seemed to have known long ago that she had fallen into Han Li’s hands.
And while her own cultivation was still only unsealed to the Pihai Realm, Jiang
Baiye’s cultivation had not been sealed and remained at the God Refining Realm. The situation seemed different from what she had expected.. Could it be that Jiang Baiye wasn’t captured by Han Li?

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - 133: The Ancestor Marries Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 156: Chapter 133: The Ancestor Marries Again!
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_2
Translator: 549690339
Jiang Baiye spread a smile across her face, as if she knew what the ageless matriarch was thinking, and then said, “I came here on my own.”
Lu Tianxiang gave a slight nod without changing her expression, but inside, her surprise deepened. Jiang Baiye had actually taken the initiative to come and become Han Li’s wife—could it be that the two really shared mutual affection?
After a moment’s thought, Lu Tianxiang said, “It’s our first meeting, so let’s properly introduce ourselves—I’m Lu Tianxiang.”
She felt there was no need to compare herself with Jiang Baiye; they were inherently different. She was Han Li’s first wife and even had his child; her cultivation level was higher than Jiang Baiye’s, so she naturally had a great advantage.
No matter what, Jiang Baiye was just a younger sister in front of her.
No matter what, Jiang Baiye was just a younger sister in front of her.
Jiang Baiye was momentarily taken aback by Lu Tianxiang’s reaction, which was slightly unexpected. She had not thought Lu Tianxiang would accept her so quickly, so with a smile, she said:
“Jiang Baiye. ”
Inside the bedchamber, Han Li watched the scene unfold, and seeing Lu Tianxiang getting along harmoniously with Jiang Baiye, he breathed a sigh of relief.
He had truly worried that the two women might not get along. Jiang Baiye was a darling of the righteous path, while Lu Tianxiang used to be the enchantress of a heretic sect; their identities were naturally at odds.
However, considering that Jiang Baiye could even get along well with the demoness Yun Miaoyi, it seemed normal for her to mesh with the enchantress.
In the following days, Han Li introduced Jiang Baiye to Li Mingmeng, Liu Yuexin, Lin Yiwu, and his other beautiful concubines so they could get to know each other.
Lin Yiyin, Zhang Lan, Chu Yutong, and the other beautiful concubines were surprised by Jiang Baiye’s identity but accepted her. They were convinced by Jiang Baiye’s position as their husband’s wife.
After all, they were not her match in many respects, and in some aspects, they fell far behind.
A few days later, Han Li’s chosen auspicious day arrived, and he once again held a grand marriage ceremony, inviting forces from all quarters to participate.
Many forces were somewhat speechless—indeed, as a habitual taker of concubines, he had now begun to frequently marry. It hadn’t even been two months since the elder of the Han Family had married his first wife, and now he was marrying a second one, and crucially, they still didn’t know the identities of these two wives.
If not for the fact that the elder of the Han Family was taking it very seriously, which was unlike his usual manner of taking concubines, they would have doubted that the elder of the Han Family was doing this on purpose.
As the elder of the Han Family took a wife, the secular populace near Chengsheng Mountain could eat and drink for free at the banquet for seven days, enjoying plenty of meat and fish.
However, it was different for these forces; participating in the marriage ceremony meant giving gifts, and the congratulatory gifts they had to give were much more valuable than those given on occasions of taking concubines.
Despite their grumbles, various forces from Yonchang Manor, surrounding manors, and forces with vested interests all attended. Even those from the God Refining Realm and Wendao Pavilion sent representatives and brought gifts.
However, they were determined that if the elder of the Han Family continued to take concubines frequently, they could accept it and would merely express goodwill. But if he were to marry frequently, they wouldn’t send expensive gifts anymore.
Otherwise, this marriage business would become a tool for the elder of the Han Family to amass wealth, shamelessly scraping their cultivation resources. If this continued, he could marry six or seven times a year, and within a few years, they would be bankrupt.
The grand wedding took place on Chengsheng Mountain. Aside from those participating, other cultivators did not pay much attention. They were used to it—if the elder of the Han Family did not frequently marry or take concubines, that would be truly strange. This was not something worth noting.
After the wedding, Han Li entered the prepared bridal chamber.
The Sword Immortal, Jiang Baiye—with whom he had been infatuated—was sitting on the edge of the bed, her head covered in a red veil, wearing a gorgeous wedding dress. Compared to the usual white-dressed Jiang Baiye, she seemed three parts more tender and three parts less aloof.
Now, they were legitimately husband and wife.
Sensing Han Li’s entrance, Jiang Baiye’s delicate body trembled slightly, her breaths deep as she tried to calm her inner turmoil.
What was meant to come had finally arrived.
Yinyang Sect.
This was a vast mountain range spanning tens of thousands of miles, with many powerful cultivators coming and going—it was where the gates of the Yinyang Sect were situated.
Atop one of the peaks sat a figure of stunning beauty—it was Yun Miaoyi.
“Han Li, that demon, has actually moved to Yuanzhou’s Yonchang Manor; he sure ran off quickly. A true to his type, always the first to run at any sign of trouble,” said Yun Miaoyi.
She thought Han Li was overly cautious, given his immense strength, and yet he chose to stay far away.
Now, with the situation in Sanzhou growing more tense, even without inside information, Yun Miaoyi could tell that a conflict was imminent.
When that time came, Sanzhou would become a land of chaos. The Daqian
Empire, despite its strength, would struggle to contain it, because the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, Da Jing Dynasty, and the Mysterious Forces would all exert pressure and would not let the Daqian Empire suppress the unrest swiftly.
Meanwhile, that demon Han Li was already skulking around in Yuanzhou, having taken seven beautiful concubines in one breath, leading a carefree and joyous life.
“I wonder how that girl, Jiang Baiye, is doing now. Is she still with the Canghai Sect?” Yun Miaoyi then reflected on Jiang Baiye, who was similarly afflicted.
When Han Li’s migration procession passed through Qingzhou, she wondered whether he might have troubled Jiang Baiye. As a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, if Han Li went to capture Jiang Baiye, she might really fall into his trap.
“Poor Jiang Baiye,” sighed Yun Miaoyi.
With Han Li being a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, it would be even more difficult for Jiang Baiye to retrieve the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
Yun Miaoyi stood up, her gaze shifting toward the direction of the Canghai Sect, her mind filled with hesitation: should she ask Jiang Baiye for help with that matter?
There was a relic within the Yinyang Sect that was soon to emerge. She had received news of it early on and had been preparing. However, she still felt somewhat uncertain.
If Jiang Baiye were to join her, her confidence would greatly increase, bolstering her faith in seizing the most important of the treasures..

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 133: The Ancestor Marries Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: Chapter 133: The Ancestor Marries Again!
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_3
Translator: 549690339
That treasure could help God Refining Realm cultivators ascend to become Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage, and it was said to be usable three times, enough for both her and Jiang Baiye.
But Yun Miaoyi wasn’t sure if she could invite Jiang Baiye, for the relic was within the Yinyang Sect’s domain, and this righteous fairy entering would take a great risk.
Moreover, the current situation was not favorable, and Yun Miaoyi was also not keen on going to the Daqian Empire’s territory, fearing she might encounter trouble.
“Forget it, I’ll prepare some more,” Yun Miaoyi sighed after a long hesitation.
There were still two years until the emergence of the relic; if a year and a half later she still felt uncertain, it wouldn’t be too late to invite Jiang Baiye then.
Demon Domain.
The Demon Domain was vast, close to half as large as the combined size of the Devil Region, Xuan Domain, and Dao Domain. Nearly all the Demon Clan lived here.
Going further south, there was the South Sea, where many demons also dwelled.
In the center of the Demon Domain stood a Divine Mountain towering over a million Zhang tall, known as Myriad Demon Mountain.
Myriad Demon Mountain was the heart of the Demon Clan, as well as their most critical location. Here, a great number of demons with profound cultivation resided.
It was said that during the Ancient Era, this place was home to over ten thousand True Martial Realm Demon Kings, Divine Yuan Realm Demon Emperors, Tongxuan Realm great demons, and even Holy Abyss Realm saintly demons. It could be described as a time of splendid glory.
But the Ancient Era had long passed, and the glory of Myriad Demon Mountain was no more. Whether there were still thirty True Martial Realm Demon Kings was uncertain, and there were very few Demon Emperors of the Divine Yuan
Realm left. No one knew if there were still any Tongxuan Realm great demons.
At this moment, atop Myriad Demon Mountain, within a grand hall emanating a dense demonic aura, there were eleven figures.
One of the figures was seated at the top, while the other ten sat on either side, most of them in human form.
“Gentlemen, the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel has moved, sending out a message: The legendary Flood Dragon Ball is about to appear, right in Leizhou of the Daqian Empire,” said Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing with an excited tone.
Gazing at the ten Demon Kings below, the Demon Emperor’s voice carried a hint of excitement.
“What? The Flood Dragon Ball truly exists?”
“What are we waiting for? Let’s head to Leizhou immediately and seize the Flood Dragon Ball.”
“Indeed, the ancient Flood Dragon Saint is also one of our demon lineage, and her Dragon Ball should rightfully be inherited by our Demon Clan.”
“That is true, but if we truly advance into the Qian Dynasty, the warriors of the Human Clan will not sit idly by; it may trigger the fourth great war between humans and demons.”
“Yes, we are not yet prepared. The Demon Clan suffered a severe blow in the war ten thousand years ago and has not yet recovered, while the Human Clan has been flourishing. If we initiate the battle, they might exterminate us without mercy.”
The ten Demon Kings debated loudly, the argument becoming incessant, dividing into three factions each holding firm to their views, unable to persuade one another.
“Enough!”
With a cold snort from Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, the ten Demon Kings immediately fell silent and looked toward the Demon Emperor.
“Although the Flood Dragon Ball is important, our clan can’t wage war with the
Human Clan just yet. Not only have we not yet recovered, but the Barbarian Clan hasn’t either. Even if both clans joined forces, we are still no match for the
Human Clan.”
“After discussing with the other three Demon Emperors, a decision has been made: to dispatch an early-stage True Martial Realm Demon King to lead two Myriad Phenomena Realm to contend for the Flood Dragon Ball.”
“The infighting within the Human Clan is severe; as long as we don’t mobilize on a large scale, the other human forces won’t interfere.”
“Yes!”
While the opinions of the Demon Kings were important, the final decision still lay with the Demon Emperors. Once the Demon Emperors had discussed and agreed, the Demon Kings could only execute the orders, without any objection.
As the ten Demon Kings departed, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing let out a sigh, feeling a bit weary.
Although the Demon Clan had long lifespans, their cultivation speed was much slower than that of the Human Clan. In the last great war, the Demon and Barbarian Clans were defeated, but the Human Clan didn’t fare well either, losing a large number of strong warriors, just not as many as the defeated Demon and Barbarian Clans.
Yet, human warriors emerged quickly, continuously coming to the fore, and rose rapidly. In just five thousand years, they had returned to their pre-war levels, and in the following five thousand years, their strength only grew stronger.
The Demon and Barbarian Clans, however, were far behind, their vital energy yet to recover and only at about sixty percent of their pre-war level.
After the Ancient Era, the Human, Demon, and Barbarian Clans vied for supremacy in the Divine Continent, each seeking to establish their legitimate status.
Seventy thousand years ago, the Human Clan ultimately prevailed, occupying the essence of the Divine Continent. The Demon Clan was driven to the furthest south, and the Barbarian Clan to the furthest north.
Both the southern and northern lands were poor in cultivation resources compared to other domains, with thinner Spiritual Energy and harsher environments. Separated, the two clans also found it difficult to join forces.
Naturally, the Demon and Barbarian Clans were unsatisfied, silently preparing for twenty thousand years before initiating the second great war between the three clans, this time the Demon and Barbarian Clans jointly attacking the Human Clan.
The war raged for a thousand years, and in the end, the Human Clan emerged victorious, with the Demon and Barbarian Clans suffering another defeat. Yet all three clans were left greatly weakened again.
Forty thousand years later, the Demon and Barbarian Clans made a comeback. This time, they did not aim to defeat the Human Clan but rather sought to expand their territories as much as possible, for instance, to each occupy a domain of the Human Clan.
Then the Demon and Barbarian Clans failed again and until now are still licking their wounds.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing stepped out of the grand hall, looking toward the land of the Human Clan in the north, her heart filled with mixed feelings.
The infighting among the Human Clan never ceased; strong individuals rose quickly, but deaths were also rampant. Nevertheless, they were still far stronger than the more united Demon and Barbarian Clans.
“Sigh, I hope we can obtain the Flood Dragon Ball this time,” sighed Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
Thinking of the Demon King and the two Demon Clan Grandmasters she had dispatched, her heart felt somewhat relieved, believing this lineup should be sufficient.
The Demon Clan was known for its discipline, and with only two Grandmasters and one Demon King sent out, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was sure that the other forces of the Human Clan would not interfere, as the most top-tier forces of humanity had always behaved in this manner.
Although Prince Wu’an was strong, he was only at the first tier of combat ability in the True Martial Realm. As long as that hidden True Martial Realm figure from the Daqian Empire didn’t take action, the Demon Clan had a good chance of seizing the Flood Dragon Ball.
Even if other human forces’ Emperor Wu wanted to intervene, as long as they were only at the early stage of the True Martial Realm, there was still a chance; they would rely on their skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - 134: Refining Treasures Diary, Embraced from Both Sides 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: Chapter 134: Refining Treasures Diary, Embraced from Both Sides 1
Translator: 549690339
“The Artifact Refining Diaries”!
Day One of Refining the Treasure: The ancient era possessed supreme treasures, which have persisted after the age, yet do the abilities of these ancient treasures surpass even those of today?
After acquiring the supreme treasure, in order to enhance his own strength, Ancestor Han steel his resolve to refine it. He aimed to imprint his core mark deep inside the treasure, to completely claim this artifact for himself.
The treasure possessed a divine spirit that resisted fiercely, not wanting to be easily refined by him. It unleashed the full force of its abilities, proving to be immensely powerful. It battled against Ancestor Han for a full day and night, leaving Han battered and bloody. Relying on his profound cultivation and extraordinary strength, he only just managed to prevail.
Summary: Only by narrow margins can one break through.
Day Two of Refining the Treasure: The treasure’s grade was too high, its power too formidable; Ancestor Han’s cultivation was slightly inadequate, not enough to easily subdue and refine the spirit within the treasure.
But could Ancestor Han possibly be considered a brute? He was exceedingly patient, in no rush at all. He planned to slowly confront the artifact, believing that one day he would refine it. By then, having tamed the spirit within, this treasure would be fully at his disposal.
This was, after all, a supreme treasure—a relic of ancient battles against the heavens and the earth, having slain countless mighty saints. It was rather temperamental, seemingly unwilling to acknowledge Han Li as its master. It struggled fiercely, eroding the Gang Yuan that Han Li imbued it with.
For the sake of having a means to establish a foothold in the future and a powerful safeguard for preserving his life, Ancestor Han was truly patient this time.
He engaged the treasure’s spirit in a tug-of-war. Whenever the spirit was off guard, he would quickly infuse a great deal of Gang Yuan. When the spirit caught on and began to struggle, Ancestor Han would slowly withdraw most of the Gang Yuan, leaving only a part behind. This way, the spirit would not resist too sharply.
This was the experience Ancestor Han had gathered from his last attempt.
Summary: The treasure’s resistance is weakening.
Day Three of Refining the Treasure: Ancestor Han made a significant breakthrough. After repeating the operations of the second day thousands of times, the spirit of the treasure slowly began to accept his might. It seemed to have realized that resisting Han Li was futile and only detrimental to itself.
Hence, when Han Li once again infused Gang Yuan and imprinted his core mark during the refining process, the resistance he faced upon entry decreased drastically and felt notably smoother.
Summary: A phase of victory.
Day Four of Refining the Treasure: Ancestor Han successfully refined the treasure. No matter the manner in which he infused Gang Yuan, it entered effortlessly into the heart of the treasure. The treasure’s spirit was tamed and acknowledged him as its master.
Summary: The treasure has now become an extension of Ancestor Han.
“Sigh.”
Having finished his Artifact Refining Diaries, Ancestor Han let out a long sigh. These past few days, the fierce battle with the artifact’s spirit had truly drained him.
Fortunately, the result was gratifying; the treasure had taken on his imprint, he could wield it as if it was a part of him, no longer fearing that it might be taken by others.
At this moment, Ancestor Han felt the urge to proclaim to the heavens: “I,
Ancestor Han, have finally obtained my second supreme treasure!”
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li stood tall, gazing at the beautiful sunset, feeling an unusual sense of comfort.
Just then, a cool figure descended, her voice as cold as ice:
“Are you pleased?”
Jiang Baiye looked at Han Li’s excited demeanor, feeling a maddening itch — that scoundrel had utterly ruined her.
She had only been married to Han Li for a few days, and he had already come up with all sorts of new experiences, making Jiang Baiye feel as though she had entered a new world.
While her body was honest, Jiang Baiye was the foremost Sword Immortal of Sanzhou, with a delicate reputation, and she firmly refused to admit to anything.
Han Li embraced her, fondly entwining and murmuring endearments to her, then said affectionately, “Jiang Jiang, of course I’m happy. We’ve formed a bond that goes beyond life and death.”
“Pah- Shameless!”
Jiang Baiye blushed instantly, the typically icy Sword Immortal losing herself to the mortal realm, a hint of charming beauty emerging.
Her soft, boneless hand involuntarily stroked her flat abdomen, whispering, “It can’t be so soon.”
Although Jiang Baiye said this, when her hand wandered there, she indeed felt a faint sign of life.
Her God Refining Realm late-stage cultivation hadn’t been sealed by Han Li, and even though less than a week had passed, the inception of new life couldn’t escape her perception.
Touching her stomach, an involuntary maternal glow appeared on Jiang Baiye’s stunning face, as she fantasized about her belly growing day by day and the eventual birth of a new life; a smile crept onto her beautiful face.
The vision caused Han Li to stare in awe, leading him to capture her enticing lips with his own.
Only after a long while did Han Li release her, Jiang Baiye, in frustration, gave him several hits, although without much force. Her daydreaming of a beautiful future had been rudely interrupted by this shameless lecher.
“Jiang Jiang, do you feel an improvement in aptitude?” Han Li nibbled on her earlobe and whispered softly in the ear of Sword Immortal Jiang Baiye.
Warm breath tickled her, causing Jiang Baiye to feel a bit flustered, but she reported truthfully, “No.”
Han Li frowned slightly, “That’s strange, shouldn’t the Body-Cultivating
Furnace raise aptitude?”
“I’m already Fourth Grade in aptitude, having already used the Body-Cultivating Furnace to enhance it; it’s not possible to rise to Third Grade,” Jiang Baiye said softly, a hint of disappointment in her eyes.
For Fourth Grade individuals, advancing to the Myriad Phenomena Realm wasn’t a big problem, but to ascend to the True Martial Realm and become an Emperor Wu, the difficulty was immense — it required a tremendous stroke of luck.
“Jiang Jiang, don’t worry. With me here, your advancement to the True Martial Realm is assured,” Han Li proclaimed with sincerity and heartfelt earnestness.

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - 134: Refining Treasures Diary, Embraced from Both Sides 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 159: Chapter 134: Refining Treasures Diary, Embraced from Both Sides 2
Translator: 549690339
“You bastard, are you capable of anything other than bullying me and talking big?” Jiang Baiye said unpleasantly, recalling the memories of the past few days that were both unsatisfactory and seemingly wonderful.
She found that Han Li was slick with his words, sweet talk came naturally to him, charming her around in circles even though she admittedly loved hearing it.
When she fell into Han Li’s hands for the second time, Han Li had promised to help her break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but now there was still no sign of it, and he was already talking about helping her break through to the True Martial Realm.
Han Li himself was still a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, how could he help her advance to the True Martial Realm?
This must be an addiction to promising pies in the sky.
Although I love to eat, you can’t keep drawing them every day, and making them bigger each time.
Seeing Jiang Baiye’s expression of “if you don’t explain yourself tonight, you’re in for it”, Han Li held her tightly in his arms and remained silent for the moment.
Feeling the warm and fragrant tenderness, smelling Jiang Baiye’s scent, Han
Li’s mind began to wander, he couldn’t help saying, “Jiang Jiang, you say the Body-Cultivating Furnace can’t improve your aptitude? I don’t believe it, if we do it a few more times, I’m sure I can enhance your aptitude to Third Grade.”
“Shameless!” Jiang Baiye almost laughed out of exasperation. How thick-skinned must one be to say such self-righteous words?
Are you really trying to help me improve my aptitude?
Jiang Baiye didn’t feel like bursting his bubble, nor did she feel like joining Han Li to enhance her aptitude. Right now, all she wanted was some quiet time to herself, mainly because her body hadn’t yet recovered.
She began to doubt, could the body of a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm be so vigorous?
After all, she was in the late stage of the God Refining Realm!
As the two of them were in their tender moment, another person flew up, also an extraordinarily beautiful woman.
Lu Tianxiang’s eyes nearly shot fire as she looked at Han Li holding Jiang Baiye.
It was not that she envied Jiang Baiye for stealing away Han Li’s affection for her, but she was unhappy with Han Li, that bastard. Couldn’t he unseal more of her cultivation for her?
Pihai Realm cultivators could only just start to fly; the True Qi they could harness was so limited, let alone traveling through the skies and escaping into the earth.
Han Li had only unsealed her cultivation to the Pihai Realm, and Chengdao Peak was wickedly high, a full three thousand zhang. The higher one flew, the greater the consumption.
Every time Lu Tianxiang flew to the summit of Chengdao Peak, she felt as if she was about to be squeezed dry, her spiritual sea’s True Qi nearly exhausted. This was truly torturous.
Sect Hierarch, I’ve already become yours and even bore you a child. Is this how you treat me?
Even if you had unsealed me to the Gangyuan Realm, it’d have been good. With Gang Yuan, flying to the summit of Chengdao Peak would be at least ten times easier, without such toil.
The quality of the Gang Yuan in the Gangyuan Realm is several times better than that of True Qi, and its quantity is more than ten times that of the True Qi in the Pihai Realm.
Lu Tianxiang was somewhat indignant, panting and saying coldly, “Han Li, you shameless bastard.”
Han Li is indeed a bastard!
She was aware that Han Li’s Spiritual Sense covered Chengsheng Mountain at all times, how could he not notice her flying up?
He deliberately waited for her to fly slowly so he could play the loving suitor with Jiang Baiye at the mountain summit.
Jiang Baiye immediately struggled out of Han Li’s embrace, her cheeks flushed, but she quickly regained her cool Sword Immortal demeanor.
When alone with Han Li, she could allow him to hold her and let him make intimate gestures, but with someone else present, Jiang Baiye couldn’t let loose.
Especially since the newcomer was Lu Tianxiang, Han Li’s first wife, essentially her sister-in-law.
Seeing Lu Tianxiang in such a state, Jiang Baiye felt even more embarrassed to be romantic with Han Li.
“Sister Tianxiang,” Jiang Baiye softly called.
Asking her to directly call Lu Tianxiang “sister” was something Jiang Baiye couldn’t do yet, but calling her “Sister Tianxiang” was just bearable.
They were originally people with no connections, and they might not have any in the future either, but Han Li appeared and tangled their fates together.
Looking at Lu Tianxiang, Han Li looked slightly embarrassed and chuckled awkwardly, “Tianxiang, why have you come?
In spending the past few days in intimacy with Jiang Baiye, he had indeed somewhat neglected Lu Tianxiang, and his other beautiful concubines too, making Han Li feel a bit remorseful.
He planned to take good care of them from now on, and since Jiang Baiye was also pregnant, Han Li would be able to spend a lot of time with other people.
Without waiting for Lu Tianxiang to respond, Han Li flicked a finger, infusing her body with the Gang Yuan of the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, once again unsealing some of her power.
It was also time to unseal more of Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation. Han Li had noticed her attitude towards him—they were getting closer every day, and now she was quite fond of him.
Moreover, he couldn’t always let Lu Tianxiang stay at the Pihai Realm cultivation level, even flying up to Chengdao Peak was strenuous for her. This was not good at all.
“You…” Just as Lu Tianxiang was about to say something, she felt the power inside her body surge, and her aura climbed higher and higher.
After sensing the power within her body, she found that part of her cultivation had been unsealed again, and she had recovered to the late stages of the God Refining Realm.
Lu Tianxiang, with her clever mind, knew that Han Li was doing this on purpose. Jiang Baiye was in the late stages of the God Refining Realm, and he didn’t want her to feel less imposing in front of Jiang Baiye.
Having her cultivation restored to the God Refining Realm and feeling Han Li’s intention, Lu Tianxiang instantly felt much better, and her previously unhappy face now wore a smile.
“Huff-
Lu Tianxiang exhaled a breath, ignored Han Li, and turned to Jiang Baiye with a charming smile, “Little sister, let me accompany you to enjoy the evening glow. ”
“Sure, I’m new here and I don’t know much about the stunning landscapes of Chengsheng Mountain. I hope you, Sister Tianxiang, can introduce me to many of them,” replied Jiang Baiye after thinking for a moment. A beautiful smile appeared on her cool face as she no longer paid attention to Han Li.
The two women seemed to have a tacit understanding and deliberately chose to ignore the bastard Han Li, wanting to teach him a lesson.
Don’t think that just because they both took on your form, you could do whatever you wanted.
Han Li immediately understood what they intended to do. Without saying a word, once Lu Tianxiang stepped forward to stand shoulder to shoulder with Jiang Baiye, he voluntarily stepped back a few paces to admire the stunning figures of the two women from behind.
Lu Tianxiang was dressed in a red gown today. Since she wore it in the carriage that day and noticed that Han Li liked it, she would often dress in red gowns.
Each was a different style, but all were incredibly gorgeous and accentuated Lu Tianxiang’s breathtaking beauty.
The red gown concealed Lu Tianxiang’s ripe and alluring figure. At this moment, Lu Tianxiang was a sanctified and dignified aloof celestial maiden.
Jiang Baiye was still in a white gown today. She seemed to have a strong preference for white gowns, wearing slightly different shades and styles every time. Each and every one complemented her, revealing her delicate and graceful curves without restraint.
The white gown concealed Jiang Baiye’s tender and exquisite figure. However, at this moment, Jiang Baiye was a cool and stunningly gorgeous sword fairy.
Both Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye had top-notch looks. Their figures and faces were flawless and natural. Their temperaments were distinct from one another, but both were incredibly attractive.
Looking at the two peerless beauties ahead of him, Han Li felt waves of satisfaction. Such beauties were rare in the world, and he had two of them. “If only the Witch Yun Miaoyi could be here as well.”
“Mm, Senior Sister Gongsun Yue wouldn’t be bad either. Why doesn’t Master entrust her to me? I can take care of her.”
Han Li’s mind wandered with these thoughts, and then they spiraled out of control.
At that moment, he truly wanted to run to the Yinyang Sect to capture the Witch Yun Miaoyi and then go to Tianxuan Mountain to invite his Senior Sister Gongsun Yue over, thereby gathering the four great celestial maidens.
Gongsun Yue and Yun Miaoyi’s temperaments differed from those of Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye, but their appearances were similar—all of them were outstanding beauties.
Han Li suddenly felt it was a pity; it seemed that he only had one encounter with Senior Sister Gongsun Yue and the Witch Yun Miaoyi, and then they never interacted again.
Witch Yun Miaoyi’s voluptuous figure and enchanting charm left a deep impression on Han Li, and Senior Sister Gongsun Yue, who didn’t mind being either gentle or tough, truly was a heroine among women.
Watching Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang conversing softly ahead of him, Han Li didn’t deliberately listen in. Instead, he stepped forward, positioned himself between the two women, and stretched out both hands to simultaneously hold onto the slender waists of Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye.
Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye both blushed and struggled, but Han Li did not let go. Unable to break free, they eventually gave up.
At this moment, the Old Ancestor Han achieved the feat of holding one in each arm.

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - 135: The Old Taoist of the East Sea, Bai Yujing, The Female Bodhisattva, The Dragon Maiden Reappears!_l
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Chapter 135: The Old Taoist of the East Sea, Bai Yujing, The Female Bodhisattva, The Dragon Maiden Reappears!_l
Translator: 549690339
East Sea.
Traveling east from the Xuan Domain, through the Dao Domain or the Chaotic Domain, one can enter the East Sea.
One hundred and eighty million miles east of the Divine Continent, deep within the East Sea, there lies an island named Penglai, commonly known as the Immortal Island of Penglai.
The Immortal Island of Penglai is massive, nearly thirty million miles in circumference, inhabited by countless beings of the Human Clan, numbering in the trillions.
The island is also home to countless cultivators, with numerous sects and plentiful clans, together forming a vast Cultivation Realm.
In the center of the Immortal Island of Penglai, there stands a Divine Mountain, piercing the clouds, towering hundreds of thousands of feet high, radiating an aura of primeval, simple immensity.
This mountain is named Penglai, the central Divine Mountain of the Immortal Island of Penglai.
Atop the Penglai Divine Mountain, there is a sect, also named “Penglai.” Known as the Penglai Immortal Sect, it is said that in ancient times it produced an Immortal that shook the Eight Hundred Divine Regions. The lineage has been passed down to this day, existing for over a million years.
The Penglai Immortal Sect is the most powerful force on the Immortal Island of Penglai, and the sect everyone on the island aspires to join. There is a saying in the Mortal World, “To be inducted into the Penglai Immortal Sect is to become an Immortal.”
At this moment, atop a floating Immortal Mountain within the Penglai Immortal Sect.
An old Taoist sits in mediation on a cliff, facing the direction of the Divine Continent, beholding the vast East Sea. Although unblemished by a speck of dust, he exudes an air of antiquity as if he had sat here for thousands of years.
Next to him, there is a tattered water jar, only three feet in diameter, containing a loach that barely moves, listless as if long dead.
Upon closer observation, one can find that the loach only stirs once in a great while, seemingly exerting great effort with each movement, taking a long time to recover.
This seven-colored loach is shaped like a dragon, a rare and seldom-seen Seven-colored Dragon Loach, valued far higher than a ten-thousand-year-old Divine Medicine.
In one moment, the meditating old Taoist’s eyelids twitch, and he opens his eyes. Instantaneously, the undulating millions of miles of sea calm down, and the wind and waves quiet.
“Dreaming through a thousand autumns, what year is it tonight?”
The emaciated Taoist sighs, looking at the tattered water jar, and with a swipe of his hand, a series of visions appear.
They depict vast landscapes and rivers, bustling dynasties with crowds like woven textiles, and spirited blessed lands with thriving energies, with the final scene settling on a range of connected mountains.
The mountain range is long and serpentine like a dragon, majestic, emanating an immeasurable and profound glow of creation, seemingly unnoticed by all.
The main peak of this mountain range has been sheared off, revealing the latent grandeur of this thousand-mile dragon landscape that had previously remained concealed.
The emaciated Taoist calculates with his fingers, and after a long while, finally says, “The timing is about right. If this succeeds, from Jiao to dragon, it won’t be long.”
He seems to be muttering to himself, yet also as if speaking to someone else.
The whiskers of the Seven-colored Dragon Loach in the tattered water jar flutter slightly.
The emaciated Taoist swipes his hand and the visions disappear. He sits back down, still facing the Divine Continent, as if he intends to continue his sea-gazing.
“A dragon can enlarge or shrink, rise or conceal. When large, it conjures clouds and mists; when small, it stays hidden and changes form. When it rises, it soars between the universe; when concealed, it lurks within the waves. Now that spring is deep, the dragon rides the changes of time.” As his words fall, the emaciated Taoist once again closes his eyes.
Dao Domain.
This region can be said to be the best within the Qianyuan Divine Province for cultivating the Dao, relatively peaceful and harmonious with few conflicts, where cultivators often engage in profound discussions of the Dao.
Within the Qianyuan Divine Province, there is a widely circulated poem: “Atop the heavens lies Bai Yujing, with its twelve towers and five cities. Immortals touch our crowns, bestowing upon us the secrets of eternal life.”
All these legends of Bai Yujing, the twelve towers, the five cities, and the Immortals, originate from the Dao Domain.
The Dao Domain has eight major powers, led by Bai Yujing, the ancestral court of the Dao Sect. The others—Heaven, Earth, Man, Taixuan, Dragon Tiger, True Martial, and Pure Yang—all originate from Bai Yujing, each pursuing their own path of cultivation.
Bai Yujing is in the heavens, a celestial city suspended high above, invisible, untraceable, unfathomable.
The five cities and twelve towers are on the ground, corresponding to the Five Elements and the twelve branches, acting as the focal points for the grand Dao Sect array, collectively supporting Bai Yujing and concealing it.
The twelve towers are distributed among the five cities, all towering into the clouds. It is said that they can directly reach Bai Yujing, possessing the power to connect heaven and earth.
Legends say that in ancient times, Bai Yujing housed constant presences of Heavenly Immortals, and once an Immortal descended from the ninth heaven to touch the crown of a mortal, bestowing upon them the seeds of the eternal Dao and taking them back to Bai Yujing.
Fifty thousand years later, another Heavenly Immortal from Bai Yujing appeared, whose Sword Dao was extraordinary and saintly. Fond of drinking and composing poetry, he came to be known as the “Poetic Sword Immortal,” leaving behind countless legends in the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Just like the Penglai Immortal Sect, Bai Yujing, although the ancestral court of the Dao Sect, is no longer as splendid as before, the celestial city suspended high above having not appeared in the world for tens of thousands of years.
Yet, the depth of its foundations are such that very few in the Qianyuan Divine Province can compare, perhaps none at all.
At this moment, inside the Breeze Pavilion, two Daoists are exchanging insights. One appears refined and amiable, making others feel as if bathed in a spring breeze, like a piece of jade returning to its natural state. The other looks ordinary, but every move he makes is sharp and unmistakable, like an unsheathed Immortal Sword.
These two individuals are the Second Grandmaster of Bai Yujing and the Third Grandmaster of Bai Yujing.
“The Jiao’s Dragon Ball has appeared, and the Demon Clan dares to reach for it.
Shall I take my sword and make a trip to the Demon Domain!” the ordinary-looking Third Grandmaster says with an overwhelming aura of slaughter in his words.
“No need. It’s just an early-stage Demon King; the forces in the Xuan Domain will handle it,” the Second Grandmaster shakes his head and says softly, somewhat helplessly towards the Third Grandmaster.
His younger fellow disciple has always loved to fight and kill, which is completely at odds with the tranquil and peaceful nature of the Dao Sect. He wonders why their master took him in in the first place.
However, this younger disciple indeed possesses remarkable talent, and his combat ability is astounding, proclaiming himself “undefeated in three thousand years..”

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - 135: The Old Taoist of the East Sea,
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 135: The Old Taoist of the East Sea,
Bai Yujing, The Female Bodhisattva, The Dragon Maiden Reappears! 2
Translator: 549690339
“You, when will you cultivate your heart? When you do, you will be able to break through that threshold.” The Second Grandmaster spoke earnestly, holding great expectations for his junior brother.
The Third Grandmaster neither agreed nor disagreed but also did not mention the matter of descending with a sword to the Demon Domain.
The Second Grandmaster walked to the window, his hands clasped behind his back, and looked toward the west with a hint of worry. “The Demon and Barbarian tribes are currently not a threat, but what we must consider is the pressure coming from the west.”
“Those bald donkeys!” The Third Grandmaster’s tone changed instantly upon hearing this, obviously finding them disagreeable.
The Second Grandmaster continued, “For ten thousand years, the Buddhist Sect has become increasingly prosperous, and now their power is vast. They wish to spread Buddhism from the west to the east and have been scheming in secret.”
“The Sword Domain and Devil Region may block the spread of Buddhism to the east, but the Xuan Domain can’t. The Kurong Sect was established early in the
Xuan Domain by the Buddhist Sect, and they even extended their reach to the Daqian Empire. Although their influence was cut off, now that Daqian is in grave danger, the Buddhist Sect will inevitably try to take advantage of the situation.”
“We need to prepare early; otherwise, there will emerge a trend where Dao diminishes and Buddhism rises. When our master blames us for this, it will be hard to explain.”
“Humph-”
The Third Grandmaster snorted coldly, his palm stroking the Immortal Sword at his waist, unfazed.
“I want to see whether those bald donkeys’ golden bodies are harder or my Immortal Sword is sharper,” he said defiantly.
The Second Grandmaster was at a loss for words; it seemed that his lengthy explanations fell on deaf ears.
The Buddha Domain is vast, known as the Million Buddha Kingdom, where monks are everywhere, whether mortal or immortal.
In the far west, there is a mountain that reaches to the heavens, where thunderous sounds are constant. This place is known as Xumi Mountain, upon which resides the Great Leiyin Temple.
Xumi Mountain is the ancestral home of the Buddhist Sect, and the Great
Leiyin Temple, also known as the Ten Thousand Buddha Temple, presides over the Buddhist Sect.
Atop Xumi Mountain, a Bodhisattva was seated cross-legged in the air, expounding on the sutras and imparting profound Buddhist teachings.
Around her, Arhats, Kong, Protectors, and others listened intently, each in a different pose, with solemn expressions, and varying degrees of understanding.
After this sermon ended, the gathered monks dispersed, leaving only the Bodhisattva and a Kong.
“Tuoshan Kong, go to Daqian and assist Kurong Kong in retrieving the Dragon Ball of the Jiao Saint,” she instructed.
“Yes.”
The Kong bowed with hands clapped together in respect and immediately set off on his journey.
“The spread of Buddhism from the west to the east is an inevitable trend. None of the Dao, Devil, or Sword traditions can stop it,” the Bodhisattva said with a smile, murmuring to herself.
Ten thousand years ago, Buddhism was meant to spread eastward, but it encountered three great wars and had to join forces with other traditions to fend off the invasion of the Demon Barbarians.
In those wars, all sides suffered heavy losses and were greatly weakened, including the Buddhist Sect, and the great trend of spreading eastward was forcefully interrupted.
Now, the Buddhist Sect has risen again, returning to its peak. Without the Demon and Barbarian tribes causing trouble, the eastward spread is inevitable, and no one can stop it.
In the Daqian, Yuanzhou.
Above the nine heavens, the Dragon Maiden rode the wind, her feet atop a Seven-Colored Auspicious Cloud.
Since leaving the Capital City of Daqian a few days ago, she first went to a certain place to retrieve something, and then she began her journey to Leizhou.
She did not fly at extreme speeds but rather leisurely, enjoying the scenic landscapes along the way, her Spiritual Sense covering a vast area. “Oh? This humble Yuanzhou actually hides dragons and harbors tigers.”
As she passed by Yonchang Manor, her Spiritual Sense swept through Chengsheng Mountain and upon seeing three figures standing on Chengdao Peak, she was somewhat surprised.
The grand formation of Chengsheng Mountain couldn’t block her Spiritual Sense, which easily saw through everything inside. She wasn’t interested in anything else, but the two women and one man caught her attention.
The man was handsome and imposing, at the Peak of the Hollow Realm. The two women were both in the late stage of the God Refining Realm, with unparalleled beauty, not inferior to her in the slightest.
The three stood there, as if they were perfectly matched.
These three seemed young, clearly possessing high potential, at the very least of Fourth Grade talent.
Yuanzhou had no foothold from the Ten Major Sects, and on the surface, not a single Master from the Myriad Phenomena Realm; yet this Sect harbored three talented geniuses with the potential of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, which was truly remarkable.
However, the Dragon Maiden was only mildly interested and did not linger, as her Spiritual Sense quickly moved elsewhere.
If these three were all of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, she would have bestowed them with opportunities and taken them under her wing to serve her, but at present, they were not qualified.
Being at the late stage of the God Refining Realm or the Peak of the Hollow Realm might be impressive in the Daqian Empire, but how lofty were the Dragon Maiden’s standards?
In her previous life, she was a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm, a powerful Jiao
Saint, whose might shook the Eight Hundred Divine Regions; countless beings of the True Martial Realm and Divine Yuan Realm fought to become her disciples, yet she dismissed them all with disdain.
After passing Yonchang Manor, the Dragon Maiden swiftly arrived at Xuanshi Manor. In the city, her Spiritual Sense detected a woman in a purple dress and another in a yellow dress.
A faint smile appeared on the Dragon Maiden’s face, not wishing to disturb the two as they enjoyed their peaceful life, and she headed directly towards Leizhou.
The talents of the woman in the purple dress and the woman in the yellow dress were inferior to the three individuals she had seen earlier. When she had helped them to escape the Capital City of Daqian, it was only due to their roughly shared bloodline.
The Dragon Maiden flew over Yuanzhou, believing she had concealed herself well, hidden from any detection.
After all, she was an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, and in Yuanzhou where not a single Myriad Phenomena Realm individual existed, who could detect her if she wished to remain hidden?
But someone did take notice.
In Chengsheng Mountain, on Chengdao Peak.
Han Li was in a state of bliss, feeling he had reached the pinnacle of life with two unparalleled beauties in his embrace. Each one of them was a rare beauty in the world.
And now, he possessed two of them, both of whom had taken on his form—one had gifted him a child, and the other was already carrying his child.
Han Li was about to say something to Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye, when he suddenly frowned, sensing a strong presence coming from outside Yuanzhou. The presence was not overly concealed; it seemed to assume that no one could detect it..

chapters.title: Chapter 162 - 135: The Old Taoist of the East Sea, Bai Yujing, The Female Bodhisattva, The Dragon Maiden Reappears!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: Chapter 135: The Old Taoist of the East Sea, Bai Yujing, The Female Bodhisattva, The Dragon Maiden Reappears!_3
Translator: 549690339
“`
It turned out to be a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu!
Han Li immediately retracted his Spiritual Sense, his aura swiftly weakened, leaving only the power indicative of the Peak of the Hollow Realm. He also shielded Lu Tianxiang a bit, to prevent the passing Emperor Wu from discovering that her cultivation was sealed.
Soon, that Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm passed by Yonchang Manor and headed towards Leizhou.
Han Li could clearly feel a fierce Spiritual Sense sweeping towards them, lingering over him, Lu Tianxiang, and Jiang Baiye for an instant before moving on without detecting anything unusual.
Only after this passing Emperor Wu left Yuanzhou did Han Li breathe a sigh of relief. That was truly a close call.
This Emperor Wu’s combat ability might not necessarily be stronger than his, but their Spiritual Sense indeed far surpassed Han Li’s, definitely not just at the first level of the True Martial Realm.
“How did the Daqian Empire suddenly have an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm?” Han Li mused within his heart, pondering internally.
According to his understanding, the Daqian Empire should have at most two Emperor Wu’s in the True Martial Realm, and that included Prince Wu’an who possessed the combat ability of the realm.
In the past, Han Li had always believed Da Qian had no one in the True Martial Realm; it was not until he advanced in his cultivation and his contacts became higher-leveled that he realized this was not the case.
The Daqian Empire had always hidden an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm who was said to have lived for over a thousand years, with profound and unfathomable cultivation, making other powers covetous of the Daqian Empire quite wary.
With Prince Wu’an still in Huozhou, could it be the hidden Emperor Wu of Da Qian who was on the move?
No, that’s not right. Han Li had caught a brief glimpse earlier and found that the Emperor Wu seemed to be a woman, not quite like the ancient ancestor hidden by Da Qian.
“It’s really a time of great turmoil, thankfully I strategically retreated quickly,” Han Li thought to himself.
Regardless of the identity of the passing Emperor Wu, it was very likely that they were heading for Leizhou, and Han Li didn’t know what earth-shattering opportunity Leizhou had to offer to garner the attention of such important figures.
Prince Wu’an had been waiting in Huozhou early on, never stepping into Leizhou, and his agenda was too obvious, trying too hard to cover it up. Han Li had guessed his goal was Leizhou, which was part of the reason he moved out of there.
The opportunity that had Prince Wu’an waiting for so many years must be substantial, and perhaps other True Martial Realm powers would come to contend for it. When a battle among those in the True Martial Realm breaks out in Leizhou, regardless of how much he tries to lay low, he could easily be affected.
Now, it seemed his decision was wise, with the mystery of True Martial Realm rushing over, it indicated that the opportunity Prince Wu’an had been waiting for was about to appear.
Han Li even felt that when the time came, multiple True Martial Realm powers might get involved, with top forces like the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and Da Jing Dynasty likely having already received the news and unwilling to simply watch as Prince Wu’an obtained a great fortune.
“Should I take the chance to fish in troubled waters?” Han Li suddenly had this thought.
He indeed had many undeutilized disguises with the combat ability of the True Martial Realm, so the plan to fish in troubled waters was feasible.
Yet upon reflection, Han Li discarded the idea. The nature of the opportunity was unknown, and it was not worth the risk.
He would do well to stay put at Chengsheng Mountain. In a little while, once he had eight hundred descendants, his cultivation would be able to soar to the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
At that time, his combat ability would also increase, so why should he take great risks to fight for treasures and opportunities?
Leizhou would evidently face a grand melee of True Martial Realm powers, and it’s possible one of the Emperor Wu’s might even perish. It’s far too dangerous.
Doe Han Li, the great ancestor, really need to engage in such slaughter?
