chapters.title: Chapter 163 - 136: Playing Games, Cultivation Feedback Arrives, Turmoil in Leizhou!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Chapter 136: Playing Games, Cultivation Feedback Arrives, Turmoil in Leizhou!_1
Translator: 549690339
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
During these days, Han Li had been staying in Chengsheng Mountain without ever going out.
The fanfare from Han Li’s recent marriage to Jiang Baiye had long since faded, and the various powers of Yonchang Manor no longer paid much attention to Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
Most of these powers had become in-laws with Han Mansion, and moreover, Han Mansion had kept its promise not to expand outward, not to vie for cultivation resources, nor to occupy their territories.
The various powers realized that with Han Mansion in Yonchang Manor, albeit a God Refining Realm power, there appeared to be no significant impact, and the power structure remained much the same as before.
Once they noticed that Han Mansion was as low-profile as always, they ceased to pay attention, hoping that this “cross-river dragon” would continue to slumber.
Life within Chengsheng Mountain remained quite lively, finally taking on the appearance of a cultivating clan.
The population of Han Mansion was continuously growing, with increases every day, including new babies, as well as Guest Elders, guards, maids, and even live-in sons-in-law brought in from outside.
Han Li had divided the part of Chengsheng Mountain in use, creating over ten different areas each with its own purpose, which brought much coordination to the whole of Han Mansion.
In recent days, Han Li also set up Formations in many key places, such as Chengdao Peak and Yundao Peak, to prevent anyone from intruding recklessly.
Especially Chengdao Peak, the residence of Han Li and his beloved wives and concubines, where Han Li had reinforced it multiple times. From the outside, one could only see a mountain standing tall, completely unable to see the scenery inside.
Chengdao Peak was mainly divided into five areas, the first of which allowed his descendants to enter, where they could receive guidance from Han Li and accept his training.
This area was quite large; apart from where Han Li trained his offspring, these descendants could also meet and interact with their mothers in other places.
The four areas above were off-limits to them, serving as the private areas for Han Li and his wives and concubines.
Although the number of his wives and concubines had not yet reached one hundred, there was no need for such a large space, but the old ancestor Han had always been one for advance planning. After all, he intended to live for hundreds of millions of years, and by then, the number of his wives and concubines would surely be much, much larger.
When Han Li convened his descendants or met with some people, it was on Yundao Peak.
Atop Chengdao Peak, Han Li was playing a game with a group of beautiful concubines—the very game that his second senior brother loved to play.
“Husband~”
“Husband~”
“Husband~”
Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and other beautiful concubines called out “husband,” one after the other, which made Han Li’s heart soften.
To better integrate into the game, Han Li sealed the cultivation levels of all his beautiful concubines, as well as his own, making them like ordinary people.
Of course, this was only temporary. He could unseal their cultivation levels with a single thought, instantly restoring his True Martial Realm Combat Ability.
Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang, his two delicate wives, watched from the side. They were not yet ready to lower their pride and join in such chaotic games that they considered quite disorderly.
Moreover, neither woman could bring herself to call out “husband,” not in private, let alone in front of a crowd.
Han Li knew that the time was not yet ripe; after some more time, when the two women fully accepted the situation, they too would obediently call out “husband.”
Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye hadn’t wanted to watch the game initially, feeling a bit jealous when they saw Han Li’s affectionate moments with numerous beautiful concubines.
However, once they heard that Han Li would seal his own cultivation level, they became intrigued. Sure enough, seeing Han Li at a disadvantage brought smiles to their pretty faces.
It was the first time they had seen Han Li at a disadvantage; before, it was always they who had suffered at his hands, with him taking all the advantages.
By the end of the game, Han Li couldn’t resist any longer and quietly unsealed his cultivation level. The blindfold that covered his eyes no longer impeded him. Even without using his Spiritual Sense, his five senses, which could enter the domain of Divine Sense, made it no different from seeing with open eyes.
He accurately caught each one; Lin Yiyin, Zhang Lan, Chu Yumeng, and other beautiful concubines were initially teasing Han Li, but not a single one escaped.
“Cheater!”
“Husband, you’re cheating!”
“Husband, you must have unsealed your cultivation!”
Zhang Yuyan, Wu Ziyue, and other beautiful concubines all shouted indignantly, their faces full of dissatisfaction.
Before Han Li had unsealed his cultivation, they had played circles around him, and after half an hour, he hadn’t caught a single one.
Now suddenly he could catch them accurately, and so much faster too—how was this not cheating?
“Hahaha~”
Han Li laughed heartily a few times, kissing the women he had caught in his arms, his face full of smiles, as if he hadn’t heard the beautiful concubines accuse him of cheating.
Truthfully, Han Li didn’t want to cheat, but without cheating, the game was too hard to play—they were too difficult to catch.
The area they played in was vast, with dozens of beautiful concubines spread out in various directions, now one calling “husband,” then another drawing Han Li to try and catch them.
With his cultivation temporarily sealed, Han Li’s senses were greatly weakened, just like an ordinary person’s. In such a situation and blindfolded, how could he possibly catch anyone?
Though he couldn’t catch anyone, Han Li still found joy in the game, until he felt he had played enough—that’s when he unsealed his cultivation.
Of course, to avoid being attacked, Han Li had already left a part of his Spiritual Sense as an alarm in the grand Formation of Chengsheng Mountain. If anyone tried to peep or break in forcefully, his cultivation would automatically unseal.
He even guarded against Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang, having prepared an invisible Gang Yuan Barrier around them without their knowledge.
The old ancestor Han would not let his guard down during a game and become the most vulnerable without his cultivation.
Seeing that Han Li, the husband, showed no embarrassment, the many beautiful concubines did not say much. It wasn’t their first time playing such games, and they were now accustomed to their husband’s thick-skinned nature.

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 136: Playing Games, Cultivation Feedback Arrives, Turmoil in Leizhou!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 136: Playing Games, Cultivation Feedback Arrives, Turmoil in Leizhou!_2
Translator: 549690339
After the game ended, they obediently lined up, and Han Li rewarded each of them before finally unsealing their cultivation.
As Han Li walked toward Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang, with a thought, all his sweat and stains disappeared, returning him to an immaculate state, even his clothes as clean as new.
As Han Li approached, the invisible barrier of Gang Yuan dissipated automatically. He first caressed Jiang Baiye’s belly, feeling the new life within, then he turned to Lu Tianxiang and asked gently,
“Tianxiang, would you like to go see Yongzhen?”
All of Han Li’s children did not reside on Chengdao Peak. They each had their own mountain peaks to live on, with splendid environments, ample spiritual energy, and maids dedicated to taking care of their daily needs.
Normally, they could come to the first area of Chengdao Peak, and Han Li’s cherished wives and concubines could also visit the mountain peaks where they lived.
After hesitating for a moment, Lu Tianxiang shook her head, “Let’s leave it; I’ll visit him in a few days.”
Han Li nodded slightly, did not ask further, and turned his head toward Jiang Baiye, smiling as he said, “Jiang Jiang, have you made your decision?”
A few days ago, he had asked Jiang Baiye if she wanted to change her main cultivation technique. Jiang Baiye said she would think it over and give him an answer after a few days.
Jiang Baiye was cultivating a Heaven Rank technique of Canghai Sect, which was also of Lower Heaven Rank. Han Li wanted her to switch to the Han Family’s Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture.
“Let’s talk about it later.”
Jiang Baiye declined; she was not yet ready to change her main cultivation technique, as she had some reservations.
Even though she had married Han Li and was carrying their child, she had not spent much time with Han Li and could not speak of liking him. She was reluctant to accept the techniques of the Han Family.
The Han Family’s cultivation technique was also just of Lower Heaven Rank, currently only slightly better than the one she was practicing. Changing it would not have much of an effect on her strength.
The main reason Jiang Baiye felt this way was that it seemed like a betrayal.
She was, nominally, still a core disciple of the Canghai Sect, and to cast aside the sect’s techniques for another just one or two months after her marriage seemed disloyal to her.
She thought that it would not be too late to change her methods once she fully accepted Han Li.
Han Li nodded his head and did not press her; he understood Jiang Baiye’s concerns.
As for Lu Tianxiang, Han Li had asked her long ago, and she did not wish to either.
Lu Tianxiang said she wanted to continue cultivating the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture and did not want to give up this Immortal Scripture. Han Li knew this technique was very powerful and agreed.
He would also help Lu Tianxiang find the subsequent parts of this Immortal Scripture and deal with any potential traps so that she could cultivate it with peace of mind.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li stood tall with his hands clasped behind his back, admiring the magnificent scenery of Chengsheng Mountain.
Pine waves in the rocky cove, jade plate of the sea of clouds, triple reflection of the moon over the pools, alternating pool cascades…
Simultaneously, his Spiritual Sense was monitoring the situation within Han Mansion, paying close attention to which descendants were diligently cultivating.
After arriving at Chengsheng Mountain, those descendants with cultivation talent had already begun their cultivation journey, and their progress was good.
The spiritual energy of Chengsheng Mountain was far better than that of Lingjun City, with a supply of Spirit Pills, Spirit Stones, Spiritual Medicines, and others vital for cultivation, not to mention the teachings from the Pihai Realm and Gangyuan Realm Guest Elders.
The Han Family’s Scripture Pavilion also housed thousands of cultivation techniques and martial arts, including not a few of Profound and Earth Ranks, which they could choose to cultivate.
Han Li would occasionally provide them guidance, transmitting his knowledge and solving their doubts, especially taking care of those on the cultivation roster such as Han Yonglin, Han Yongyun, Han Yongwen, Han Yongfan, and the like.
The Han Mansion also had Enlightenment Peak and the mountain gate stele for them to contemplate, and understanding even a tiny bit could lead to great gains. Han Li would also increase the efforts to cultivate them.
“More time is needed,” Han Li sighed.
These talented descendants of his were generally of low cultivation, primarily because they had been practicing for too short a time. The highest were only recently at the Pihai Realm, and there were only three of them; the rest were mostly at the True Qi Realm and Innate Realm.
Although these descendants had low cultivation levels, and his own was very high, Han Li still felt their cultivation feedback.
The feeling was not obvious, but Han Li had the system display a feedback panel, and everything became clear at a glance.
This feedback panel listed the names of all his qualified descendants, divided mainly into two parts: one part was those who had not yet begun cultivation, with their cultivation feedback all at zero, and the other part was those who had started cultivating, showing feedback of their cultivation behind their names.
Han Li analyzed it and discovered that this cultivation feedback was related to their stage. For instance, Han Yongfan—who was at the Pihai Realm—contributed 1.8 years of cultivation to Han Li.
The 1.8 years of cultivation progress were composed as follows: a total of 0.3 years for the first three stages, 0.5 years for the Innate Realm, and 1 year for the Pihai Realm.
If Han Yongfan were to break through to the Gangyuan Realm, he would provide feedback of 2 years, 4 years for the God Refining Realm, and 8 years for the Hollow Void Stage, and so on, with higher realms giving more feedback of cultivation progress.
Before, he had very little cultivation talent, with all his cultivative progress lying within the first three stages, amounting to only a few years, so Han Li hardly felt anything.
Now, there are more descendants practicing cultivation, and their cultivative progress has also improved quite a bit, making the effect much more significant.
Han Li checked and found that those descendants who started down the path of cultivation had collectively given him feedback of almost twenty years’ worth of cultivation progress.
Han Li thought it was pretty good. He was still in the accumulation phase, and, once there were more descendants practicing cultivation and after their realms increased, the feedback he received each year would become a substantial figure.
“Your cultivation speed is still too slow; can’t you put in more effort? If talent is insufficient, make up for it with effort,” Han Li thought to himself.
If the cultivation speed of his descendants was all very fast, he could just lie back and slack off, receiving large amounts of cultivative progress every year, and his own realm breakthroughs would still surge ahead rapidly.
“No, I need to give them some help.”
Ever since Han Mansion was relocated to Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li had sent out people to inquire about the Rebirth Flower, and there had been some recent developments.
Han Li decided to urge them to focus on the task, which would surely make those investigating the Rebirth Flower work harder and obtain it sooner.
When the time comes, Han Li planned to first cultivate the Rebirth Flower and see if he could plant this spiritual medicine on a large scale. He had already planted Marrow Cleansing Grass and Zhu fruits in the newly opened medicinal fields.
In the early stages, it would certainly be necessary to purchase various medicinal materials from outside. Then, as the cultivated medicines matured, he would be able to refine more Rebirth Pills.
“It’s a pity that it can’t be applied on a large scale in the early stages,” Han Li thought with a frown.
The Rebirth Pill formula’s records state that refining a furnace of Rebirth Pills yields about two successful pills, and the cost is extremely high, but it’s absolutely worth it.
Excluding the Rebirth Flowers, Han Mansion currently has enough Rebirth Pill medicinal materials stored to refine about sixty furnaces, which is tantamount to one hundred and twenty Rebirth Pills.
This seems like a lot, but when it comes to allocation, it’s actually very little.
For example, he has as many as sixty-three concubines. Even if their talents have been improved using the Body-Cultivating Furnace to reach at least Seventh Grade, each person would need to consume one or two Rebirth Pills to enhance to Fourth Grade talent, and Rebirth Pills can only enhance up to Fourth Grade.
If one wants to enhance to Fourth Grade talent, for the time being, one can only rely on the Body-Cultivating Furnace to do so through continuous use, as there is still hope.
Han Li estimated that in order to enhance the talent of all his concubines to Fourth Grade, at least one hundred Rebirth Pills would be needed.
Han Li wishes to cultivate many descendants, and he wants to raise the talents of all those who can cultivate to Fourth Grade, to practice cultivation on behalf of Han Li.
“Well, well, let’s wait until the Rebirth Flower is in hand and the Rebirth Pills are refined before allocating,” Han Li said with a wry smile. It was useless to think about these things now.
If there weren’t enough Rebirth Flowers, not even 120 Rebirth Pills could be refined, and when the time comes, they would have to forego allocation to the concubines and continue using the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
First, he would take them to some descendants worth cultivating, enhancing their talent to Fourth Grade, which would significantly increase their cultivation speed.
This would not only foster more core forces for the Han Family, but also provide more feedback of cultivation progress for him.
Sighing, Han Li resumed a routine task, exploring the hidden treasures within Chengsheng Mountain, a task he performed daily.
Sometime earlier, he had once again sensed an unusual movement from the Body-Cultivating Furnace, which resonated with a certain location on Chengsheng Mountain. Although Han Li discovered it, he could never find exactly where it was.
He had searched inside and out, top to bottom of Chengsheng Mountain countless times, without a trace to be found.
Han Li suspected that the Soul-Cultivating Furnace or the Life-Prolonging Furnace was concealed by a powerful formation, possibly creating its own space, and even he, a powerhouse comparable to the True Martial Realm, could not detect it.
This made Han Li even more certain that the treasure hidden in Chengsheng Mountain was likely the Life-Prolonging Furnace, as the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, merely a Heaven Rank Supreme Grade magical treasure, probably wouldn’t match a Second Grade or even First Grade formation used for hiding it.
Suddenly, a terrifying roar came from afar, and Han Li instantly reacted, looking towards the source of the sound.
“It’s actually Leizhou…” Han Li’s eyebrows furrowed, then relaxed again.
Yuanzhou’s Yonchang Manor is at least two million miles away from Leizhou; being so far away and still able to hear it could only mean two possibilities.
Either that the earth-shattering opportunity in Leizhou had emerged, or a battle at the level of the True Martial Realm was taking place in Leizhou.

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - 137: Suppressing Prince Wu’an, The Demoness King_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Chapter 137: Suppressing Prince Wu’an, The Demoness King_1
Translator: 549690339
Leizhou.
Above the vault of heaven, two figures were in confrontation, with numerous powerful beings watching the battle around them.
One of the figures was the Dragon Maiden, coming from Yuanzhou. She stood atop the Seven-Colored Auspicious Cloud, dressed in a colorful light skirt, with brows like ink, skin fairer than snow, a waist that could be encompassed with a grip, and three thousand strands of smooth black hair blowing in the wind like mist and clouds.
A thin veil covered her face, yet it could not hide her stunning contours. Beneath the gauze, her beautiful eyes shimmered, dimming the sun and the moon, with a limpidity like crystals, exuding an indifference that seemed to keep others millions of miles away.
The other figure was Prince Wu’an, Chu Hao, who had come from Huozhou. He possessed a divine and extraordinary martial prowess, with a tributary of meteor-like charisma, and an aura that pierced the sky. His dominance and fierceness were known throughout the land.
But at this moment, Prince Wu’an’s expression was grim, somewhat gloomy, as he stared fixedly at the figure hundreds of miles away, yet he did not make another move.
When the Dragon Maiden arrived, although she did not do so flamboyantly, she did not conceal herself either. Prince Wu’an detected her presence immediately. He issued a warning to the Dragon Maiden, but she ignored it.
Prince Wu’an was known for his direct and domineering ways, often choosing to strike first. Issuing a warning was already a courtesy, yet the Dragon Maiden did not reciprocate.
Faced with such provocation, Prince Wu’an could not tolerate it.
He too wanted to test the extent of the Dragon Maiden’s cultivation level, and to which layer of the True Martial Realm she had practiced.
Since learning the precise information about the fortune, Prince Wu’an knew that a battle between them was inevitable.
The Dragon Ball was prepared by the Dragon Maiden for her own reincarnated self, and she couldn’t possibly share it with anyone, as it pertained to her current life’s path.
Prince Wu’an felt the same way. He had delayed for so many years in order to refine the King Grade Pill, with the Dragon Ball relating to his own path. He would absolutely not give it up.
Thus, Prince Wu’an made his move, directly throwing a punch at the Dragon Maiden.
However, the Dragon Maiden’s combat ability was beyond his expectations. With an effortless wave of her bare hand, she pressed down with a palm that obliterated his fist mark and continued to suppress Prince Wu’an.
The palm imprint grew larger, possessing the momentum to conceal the sky, as if desiring to suppress Prince Wu’an with a single palm. Prince Wu’an unleashed a series of over a dozen punches before he managed to shatter the Sky Concealing Palm imprint.
“Chu Hao, you’re not up to par, get lost,” said the Dragon Maiden, her voice light yet filled with an innate pride, a haughtiness that was part of her very bones.
She was the Dragon Maiden who commanded respect across the Eight Hundred Divine Regions, the overwhelming Jiao Saint. In her eyes, Chu Hao was merely an insignificant junior.
It didn’t matter that Prince Wu’an was only at the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. Even if Chu Hao advanced to the True Martial Realm, or even cultivated to the same level as hers, he could not possibly be her match.
Before her reincarnation, she was the Jiao Saint, wielding a plethora of Divine Rank martial techniques, which were countless times more powerful than Heaven Rank techniques, of which she possessed no small number.
Even though she could not utilize many of the Divine Rank martial techniques at the moment, she only needed to use one casually to defeat Prince Wu’an as if it were child’s play.
She had ascended to the True Martial Realm and had done so using a King Grade True Elixir. Her combat experience wasn’t something Prince Wu’an could compare with.
“Li Yue, don’t be too arrogant, this is the Da Qian, not a place where you can be so arrogant,” said Prince Wu’an, his fists clenched, feeling deeply frustrated in his heart. When had he, Prince Wu’an, ever been threatened like this?
For those who disobeyed him, he would usually respond with a punch. If they didn’t submit, he’d give them another punch.
But now, his fists were of no use. This woman’s combat ability was terrifying. Prince Wu’an had to admit that he was no match for her.
Li Yue’s casual strike, which Prince Wu’an could only counteract with great effort and many punches, made the disparity between them obvious to him.
Li Yue might have cultivated to the fourth layer of the True Martial Realm, making her a mid-tier powerhouse within that realm, whereas he was merely at the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
“Wait until I ascend to the True Martial Realm with the King Grade Pill; what of the fourth layer? I’ll still smash you,” Prince Wu’an roared in his heart, his yearning for the Dragon Ball growing fiercer.
What Prince Wu’an didn’t realize was that Li Yue had only reached the third layer of the True Martial Realm and had not even used a tenth of her strength in that casual palm.
If he knew, he would probably sink into deep despair.
“Heh~”
Long Yue let out a cold laugh, filled with disdain.
It was unclear whether her disdain was directed at the Qian Dynasty, at the name Li Yue, or perhaps at both.
She had given the Prime Minister a chance to choose, but he did not seize it, still siding with Da Qian, so Long Yue reverted to her former name the moment she left.
Prince Wu’an frowned, deeply annoyed by Long Yue’s attitude, but he did not make another move.
Knowing he was no match for Long Yue, he would only bring shame upon himself by continuing the fight. If he were to be injured by Long Yue, it would be disadvantageous for the subsequent struggle for the Dragon Ball.
“Li Yue, you are audacious and proud, looking down upon the cultivators of the Qianyuan Divine Province, aren’t you? Don’t forget that this will be your grave,” Prince Wu’an regaining his composure, stood with his hands behind his back, his tone nonchalant as he revealed Long Yue’s secret.
Though the two had only exchanged a single move, the commotion was immense, noticeable within millions of miles.
Lesser cultivators couldn’t watch the battle, unable to see that far, and even those cultivators in Leizhou didn’t dare. They activated various formations at the first sign of trouble, and some even hid underground to avoid it.
When Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm went into battle, a mere stroke of his hand could destroy a thousand miles of land, shatter mountain ranges that stretched for a thousand miles, and if the battle was fierce enough, the whole of Leizhou would be obliterated, killing countless mortals and cultivators.
Only those with the strength and courage to watch from afar, such as some Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters and some hidden True Martial Realm Emperor Wu’s.

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 137: Suppressing Prince Wu’an, The Demoness King_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Chapter 137: Suppressing Prince Wu’an, The Demoness King_2
Translator: 549690339
The Dragon Girl and Prince Wu’an briefly exchanged blows, and all the spectators could see Prince Wu’an’s disadvantage; his strength was far inferior to that of the woman in the colorful light skirt.
Many powerful figures felt extremely gratified, thinking that the invincible and overbearing Prince Wu’an finally met his match today—it was karma indeed.
When Prince Wu’an’s bottom line was exposed, a few strong individuals suddenly had an epiphany, discerning the identity of the woman in the colorful light skirt—the reincarnated form of the ancient Jiao Saint: Dragon Girl Li Yue.
These True Martial Realm Emperors and Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters had originally come for the Jiao Saint’s Dragon Ball. Although they were unaware of the Jiao Saint’s reincarnated form, they guessed it right away after Prince Wu’an revealed it.
“The reincarnated form of the Jiao Saint is only at the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm?”
For a time, all the forces felt greatly relieved, believing their chances of success in this mission were significant.
If the Dragon Girl was at the late stage, peak, or even at the Divine Yuan Realm of the True Martial Realm, they would have turned tail and fled, hopeless in seizing it, but now there still lay hope.
After all, there were not a few from the True Martial Realm who had come this time. Although the Dragon Girl was powerful, the collective might of their True Martial Realm was not weak either.
“Hmph!”
The many prying eyes did not escape the Dragon Girl. She let out a cold snort, and her overwhelming Spiritual Sense swarmed out, crushing the probing Spiritual Senses.
Although she appeared supremely proud on the surface, she felt a hint of pressure in her heart. There were indeed not a few forces out to seize her Dragon Ball this time.
Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, the Daqian Empire, the Demon Clan, and even the Da Jing Dynasty had True Martial Realm Emperors lurking at the borders, ready to muddy the waters at any moment.
At least five True Martial Realm Emperors…
“The ancient Qianyuan Divine Province was once brilliant and prosperous, its radiance shining across the Yuankun Domain, leading the Thirty-three Divine Provinces, but what remained after the great catastrophe?” Long Yue shook her head slightly, her tone indifferent as if recalling a distant past.
The Qianyuan Divine Province was indeed powerful in the past, with several Heavenly Immortals residing constantly and numerous Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors and even more Saints.
When she was being pursued, she fled to the Qianyuan Divine Province seeking refuge, but for some reason, that power did not offer her protection.
“There are many places in the Qianyuan Divine Province that I respect in both my past life and this one, such as Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall… but this does not include your Daqian Empire.”
“Your Daqian Empire, with merely three thousand years of history, harbors wild ambitions, attempting to seize my treasures. I have already shown great mercy by not killing you,”
“If you do not leave now, then stay!”
After Long Yue finished her last sentence, her hand raised, ready to deliver another blow to Prince Wu’an.
This time she would not hold back the slightest bit, and if Prince Wu’an could withstand it, she might consider sparing him a way out.
“You…”
Prince Wu’an’s eyes widened with his aura surging, feeling immensely humiliated, but ultimately he did not make a move.
If he did, he suspected he would likely be blown away by the Dragon Girl’s palm. Outclassed, he had no choice but to bow his head for the moment.
“I’ll settle the score with you later. I hope you’ll still be this strong when the time comes.”
Prince Wu’an took one deep look at the Dragon Girl, muttered to himself, and then withdrew, retreating back to Huozhou City.
Right now, those hidden True Martial Realm Emperors showed no intention of coming to his aid; Prince Wu’an dared not face the Dragon Girl alone—it would be suicide.
Seeing Prince Wu’an withdraw, Long Yue’s eyes beneath the light veil swept all around; no strong figures continued to pry, and she let out a cold laugh before her figure vanished from sight.
Yuanzhou, Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li’s complexion flashed with a trace of pallor but soon returned to lustrous health.
“She’s the reincarnated form of the ancient Jiao Saint? Truly proud, powerful, and overbearing,” Han Li sighed softly.
Han Li now knew who the mysterious True Martial Realm figure he had previously encountered was—none other than the Dragon Girl who caused such commotion in Leizhou.
It had to be said that the Dragon Girl’s strength was indeed formidable; with a casual palm, she managed to thwart Prince Wu’an, leaving him with no will to confront her further.
“I wonder how the Dragon Girl’s strength compares to mine, who is stronger?” Han Li pondered silently.
If he used the Sealing Heaven Sword Scripture, he, too, could make Prince Wu’an scurry away with his tail between his legs, a vast gap in strength between them.
With the Zhenjun Sword employing the Sealing Heaven Sword Scripture, he would only possess the combat ability of the third layer of the True Martial Realm. If he had a Heaven Rank Divine Sword, the power would increase tremendously, comparable to the fourth layer of the True Martial Realm.
If he further pushed his limits, entering the Divine Sense realm, his combat ability could briefly soar to the fifth level of the True Martial Realm.
But whether such power would defeat the Dragon Girl, Han Li had no certainty.
The Dragon Maiden’s foundation is too profound!
Unless his cultivation advanced further, reaching the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, Han Li felt that only then could he truly stand a chance in battle.
Han Li suddenly blinked, realizing he had fallen into a misconception, and he wouldn’t run to seize that great opportunity; he and the Dragon Maiden were not enemies.
Even if the Dragon Maiden were arrogant and domineering, she couldn’t possibly make a move against him without reason, right?
If he just stayed put on Chengsheng Mountain and minded his own business, he wouldn’t have to worry about pressure from the Dragon Maiden affecting him, and he could focus on his development in peace.
Let those in the True Martial Realm who want to vie for the great opportunity fight amongst themselves, it would be best if they fought until their brains turned to mush and all died—then there would be fewer strong adversaries to threaten him.
“Huff~”
Exhaling a breath, Han Li’s figure disappeared from the summit of Chengdao Peak, reappearing inside Lu Tianxiang’s sleeping chambers.
Ever since Lu Tianxiang’s belly grew larger, he had not shared a bed with her, and afterwards, with her giving birth and recuperating her body, Han Li did not press the matter.
Later on, Jiang Baiye arrived, and Han Li had been focusing his efforts on her, not pursuing Lu Tianxiang for the time being.
Now, Han Li felt that the time was right. The fertile soil of Lu Tianxiang also deserved to be cultivated; how could it be good for Lu Tianxiang to remain in an empty room by herself?
In Qingzhou, within a deep mountain.
Three figures stood tall, retracting their gaze that had been looking off towards Leizhou.
Two of them turned towards the leading figure, respectfully inquiring, “When shall we head to Leizhou, my lord?”
Though the two were Great Grandmasters at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, they dared not be disrespectful in front of the leader and spoke with cautious reverence.
“Wait.”
The person at the forefront casually glanced at them and uttered a single word; she was not one to waste words needlessly.
“Yes!”
The two peak Great Grandmasters immediately bowed their heads, not daring to look directly at the Demon King, as if afraid of encountering great terror.
“Sslluurrp~”
The Demon Queen stuck out her tongue and licked her enticing red lips, causing the two Great Grandmasters to further lower their heads, wishing to distance themselves from the Demon Queen but not daring to leave of their own volition.
“Dismissed,” the Demon Queen said indifferently, feeling bored.
“Yes.”
The two peak Great Grandmasters, as if receiving a pardon, quickly retreated and found a place to stay.
The gaze of the Demon Queen turned toward Leizhou, toward Yingyuan Mountain, her brows slightly furrowed. This mission was truly dangerous.
There were many from the True Martial Realm and Emperor Wu vying for the Jiao Saint Dragon Ball, and her own strength was not very formidable; it would be quite difficult to obtain it.
The Demon Queen decided that her own life was more important. If the situation were unwinnable, she would retreat directly.
If one dared to look directly at the Demon Queen, they would find that this Demon Queen had an incredibly beautiful appearance, bewitchingly captivating.
She had a pair of slender pale blue eyes and every movement was enchanting by nature. With the sly glances of her phoenix eyes, she could attract the gaze of all the opposite sex.
Dressed in an exquisite pale blue gown, beneath which was a plump and mature graceful figure, her skin was as flawless as white jade, exuding a seductive aura.
Her pale blue hair was casually draped down, nearly perpendicular to her slender waist like a willow, while further down was a pair of closely knit, long, and fair beautiful legs, creating a breathtaking and graceful silhouette.
She always exuded a bewitching wildness about her that drew the eye, making anyone who noticed her feel inexplicably feverish.
“Speaking of those two little demonesses, are they still in the Capital City of Da Qian?”
The Demon Queen withdrew her gaze, suddenly remembering the purple-gowned matron and the yellow-gowned beauty; these two demonesses had infiltrated the Capital City of Da Qian on a mission from Myriad Demon Mountain.
“They should still be there. When I return, I’ll have a chance to check on them. I hope they haven’t been exposed, or they could be facing death,” the Demon Queen murmured to herself in a soft and charming voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 138: The Ancestor Has Taken Yet Another Concubine_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Chapter 138: The Ancestor Has Taken Yet Another Concubine_1
Translator: 549690339
Tianxuan Mountain, Tianxuan Peak.
“This is very bad.”
Sect Leader Gongsun Yun’s heart trembled, feeling that his entire being was in disarray.
Although he had long known that Sanzhou would become a place of turbulent conflicts, he hadn’t expected it to arrive so soon, nor had he imagined that it would start in Leizhou.
A True Martial Realm battle, no less.
Sect Leader Gongsun Yun activated the Mountain Protection Array at once and took out a palm-sized copper bell, ready to stimulate it at any moment.
Even though the battlefield was tens of thousands of miles away from Tianxuan Mountain, Gongsun Yun dared not be negligent. Should the battle fully erupt, hundreds of thousands of miles of land could be flattened or even turned into a colossal pit in minutes.
Luckily, the distance was not too short; with his cultivation, he could drive the copper bell, coupled with the Mountain Protection Array, to fend off the aftermath.
“It’s bad, Prince Wu’an can’t hold on; the gap in strength is too vast.”
Gongsun Yun’s complexion changed, and he couldn’t help but cry out in alarm.
Although Tianxuan Mountain had not sided with the Daqian Empire, he was somewhat partial to Prince Wu’an, hoping that Prince Wu’an would be strong enough to suppress these disturbances, seize the opportunity and return to the Capital City soon so that Sanzhou could continue to remain peaceful.
But Prince Wu’an had disappointed him, or perhaps it was the woman clad in a colorful skirt, stepping on colorful clouds, who was too strong.
With just a single slap, she had forced Prince Wu’an into a sorry state; he had to strike with full force dozens of times to barely hold her off, which clearly showed that although Prince Wu’an’s strength was preposterous within the Myriad Phenomena Realm, it paled within the True Martial Realm.
Any True Martial Realm Emperor Wu could crush Prince Wu’an.
Seeing the standoff between the two and then Prince Wu’an’s retreat, Gongsun Yun finally breathed a slight sigh of relief.
“It’s actually the Dragon Lady, the reincarnation of the Dragon Saint.”
Gongsun Yun’s mind was still heavy with worry. Who in Leizhou from the major forces didn’t know the legends of Yingyuan Mountain? They had all explored it countless times, finding nothing.
He finally understood why Prince Wu’an had waited so many years in Huozhou—it was all for the treasures left by the Dragon Saint. Now that the Dragon Lady had returned, quite a few True Martial Realm Emperor Wus were likely watching, wanting to intervene.
If it came to that, there might very well be a massive brawl in the True Martial Realm, and it all depended on whether the Dragon Lady’s strength could suppress the entire scene. If she was too strong, she would face joint attacks from all True Martial Realm opponents.
“Alas, Tianxuan Mountain just wants to develop peacefully, why is it so difficult?” Gongsun Yun sighed in resignation.
In such circumstances, even if the Tai Xuan Sect offered support, unless a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu took action, they couldn’t fend off the pressures from all sides for Tianxuan Mountain.
“Second, third, fourth generation Grandmasters, have you reached the True Martial Realm?” Gongsun Yun muttered in his mind.
Immediately afterward, Gongsun Yun thought of his direct disciple, Han Li, admiring his skill in laying low, considering himself far inferior compared to his disciple.
Han Li seemed to have cultivated to the master level of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and now still pretended to be a God Refining Realm real person, having run off to Yuanzhou early, avoiding all these disturbances without any pressure.
He also knew that Han Li was now frantically marrying and taking concubines in Yonchang Manor, taking two wives and seven or eight concubines in just three months, living a carefree and happy life.
As Han Li’s master, he was enduring hardships in Tianxuan Mountain, treading on thin ice, facing great pressure every day, and finding no joy in anything.
“Truly laying low.” Gongsun Yun lamented, feeling a trace of sourness in his heart.
Not only Tianxuan Mountain, but also Leizhou’s Sword Cleansing Pool, True Sun Sect, and even the major factions of Huozhou and Qingzhou had all begun to prepare, thinking of how to protect their Sects in this impending storm.
Since Prince Wu’an retreated to Huozhou and the Dragon Lady disappeared, the situation in Sanzhou once again calmed down a bit, seemingly returning to its prior tranquility.
But everyone knew it was only temporary; when the storm struck again, it would be even more fierce and vast.
At that time, the True Martial Realm Emperor Wus would all take to the stage one after another, vying for that great opportunity—it was a stage for the True Martial Realm.
Those below the True Martial Realm, even masters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, wouldn’t dare compete for it; the fallout from a True Martial Realm battle could grievously injure them or even kill them outright.
Only those peak figures of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, confident in their own strength, would dare to muddy the waters and attempt to snatch victory from the jaws of peril.
Above the Leizhou sky, the Dragon Lady stood tall, her figure and aura concealed as she overlooked the mountains and rivers below.
After disappearing, she did not head straight for Yingyuan Mountain, which would have been too obvious, as several True Martial Realm Emperor Wus were secretly watching.
The Dragon Ball was actually not on Yingyuan Mountain but within an independent secret territory, created by a large array, highly concealed, and undetectable even to True Martial Realm Emperor Wus and Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors.
According to her original plan, she had intended to wait until she had cultivated to the Divine Yuan Realm before coming back to retrieve the Dragon Ball, but unfortunately, plans went awry.
The main peak of Yingyuan Mountain had been leveled, resulting in a minor flaw in the array, affecting the secret territory and causing a leakage of the Dragon Ball’s aura. Although the array quickly repaired it, this still attracted the attention of some powerhouses.
Long Yue had no choice but to change her plans and prepare to retrieve the Dragon Ball ahead of schedule, for if the array continued to operate for a while, it would malfunction, and the secret territory would be exposed, potentially snatched away by that brat Prince Wu’an.
This was something she absolutely could not accept.
Although these powerhouses couldn’t locate the entrance to the secret territory, they were certain there was a great opportunity here, each preparing and keeping a close watch.
As soon as the secret territory emerged, or someone opened it, they would reveal themselves, rushing into the secret territory to compete for the loot.
Long Yue was well aware of their intentions. She also knew that her reincarnation couldn’t be kept a secret; perhaps powers like the Da Qian weren’t aware, but those truly at the pinnacle of Qianyuan Divine Province, like Bai Yujing, Myriad Demon Mountain, Xumi Mountain, and even Penglai and other Sacred Lands, definitely knew.
These Sacred Lands, with their deep roots, each had produced Heavenly Immortals in ancient times; those with larger schemes would not covet her Dragon Ball, while those with lesser schemes would send people to fight for it, though they would not go too far, sending only True Martial Realm forces at most, as they still had reputations to maintain.

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - 138: The Ancestor Has Taken Yet Another Concubine_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Chapter 138: The Ancestor Has Taken Yet Another Concubine_2
Translator: 549690339
As far as she knew, no unusual movements came from the Dao Domain or the Devil Region, represented by Bai Yujing and the Heavenly Demon Hall, respectively. The Sword Domain, Demon Domain, and Barbarian Region also hadn’t sent anyone.
Even so, she had no shortage of enemies.
The Buddhist Sect was always shameless, and the Kurong Sect, being near the Da Qian Empire, would definitely intervene, perhaps even visitors from Xumi Mountain; the True Martial Realm masters from Yinyang Sect were highly likely to act, and practitioners from the demon path wouldn’t miss this opportunity.
The Demon Clan had been in distress lately, and since the Dragon Ball was of great help to the Demon Clan, the True Martial Realm masters from the Demon Domain would also come.
Then there were the surrounding powers like Da Qian, Da Jing, Da Liang, Emperor Wu’s City, and even the Ancient Empire that might take action, as well as the Mysterious Forces secretly meddling within Da Qian.
She had already exposed quite a few enemies, not to mention those potential powerhouses who hadn’t yet shown themselves.
While she was powerful, her realm was still far from its peak, and with her combat ability, she could sweep through most in the True Martial Realm.
But if the number of True Martial Realm warriors was too high, it could still affect her, and no one knew whether these True Martial Realm warriors under Emperor Wu would use some powerful moves.
Some of these moves, if used in a sneak attack, could possibly injure her, and once injured, it would create an opportunity for others.
Therefore, when Long Yue arrived in Leizhou, she was anything but courteous, directly challenging Prince Wu’an to establish her dominance and to flaunt her strength, hoping to scare away some of the powerhouses.
Under the huge disparity in strength, no matter how enticing the opportunity was, it wasn’t as important as one’s life. Many powerhouses, after weighing the pros and cons, would stay away if they deemed the risks too high.
“I hope there’s no Divine Yuan Realm warrior under Emperor Wu. Otherwise, that would be utterly shameless,” she thought.
Overlooking the mountains and rivers, Long Yue’s Spiritual Sense swept over the vast territories time and again, attempting to locate all the hidden True Martial Realm experts, while also checking for the presence of any Divine Yuan Realm warriors.
While her strength was formidable, she was no match for a Divine Yuan Realm warrior unless her cultivation reached the peak of the True Martial Realm.
Divine Yuan Realm warriors, who mostly used King Grade Pills during their time in the True Martial Realm, had celestial strength that pierced through heaven and earth. In this age, they were among Qianyuan Divine Province’s peak powerhouses.
Such strong figures rarely make moves, each wary of the other, balancing each other out to maintain a stable power structure.
Within the Xuan Domain, it was certain that forces such as Da Qian, Da Jing, and Emperor Wu’s City did not harbor any Divine Yuan Realm warriors; however, there were doubts concerning the Ancient Empire.
The Ancient Empire is ancient and profound, always seated comfortably as the number one power in the Xuan Domain, with territories that exceed the combined size of the Da Qian, Da Jing, and Da Liang empires.
Although other domains like the Devil Region, Buddha Domain, and Dao Domain extended their reach into the Xuan Domain, they only had up to True Martial Realm masters, which were kept in check by the Ancient Empire.
With such influence, it was highly likely that the Ancient Empire was concealing a Divine Yuan Realm warrior, which made the other paths somewhat cautious, but just somewhat.
After all, compared to Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and the Heavenly Demon Hall, the Ancient Empire pales significantly; they also maintained checks and balances amongst themselves.
Long Yue’s greatest fear was that a Divine Yuan Realm warrior from the Ancient Empire would make a move. As long as such a warrior didn’t act, the present True Martial Realm warriors, although somewhat pressuring, were not a big problem for her.
With two or three years remaining until the Secret Territory emerges, Long Yue didn’t want to gamble, even if the likelihood of a Divine Yuan Realm warrior appearing was small. She had to first ensure that no Divine Yuan Realm warrior was present before daring to open the Secret Territory.
Otherwise, it would be like making the bridal gown for someone else.
If there really were any shameless Divine Yuan Realm warriors lurking in the shadows, she would have to make other plans, perhaps venturing to Penglai.
Huozhou City, Royal Manor.
The Royal Manor’s grand array had already been activated, partly as a defense against any potential strong attacker, and partly to keep a secret.
At this moment, two figures were present in the Royal Manor, one being Prince Wu’an, Chu Hao, and the other not Mr. Lan, but rather a middle-aged man in silver battle armor, exuding a majestic and commanding presence.
“Your Imperial Majesty,” Prince Wu’an greeted.
Such words, if they were to spread, would surely create a huge commotion. The abdicating Emperor Qian had come to Huozhou City so quietly. What could he be planning?
Decades ago, Emperor Qian had suddenly given up the throne, rumored to have sustained serious injuries with only a short time to live.
But this robust middle-aged man showed no sign of serious injury; on the contrary, he had reached the True Martial Realm, becoming an Emperor Wu.
“Hao’er, you’ve been reckless,” the former Emperor Qian, Chu Wuji, said flatly.
Prince Wu’an nodded slightly without making any excuses.
News had come from the Capital City that Emperor Chu Wuji would secretly rush over to preside over the situation, but before Chu Wuji could arrive, Prince Wu’an had rashly made his move, becoming the target of the Dragon Maiden’s show of force.
Not only did it affect his own reputation, but it also affected the plans of the Da Qian Empire.
“What’s done is done, it’s useless to say more.”
Chu Wuji didn’t continue to reproach Chu Hao, but turned and said, “Just wait patiently, Li Yue will definitely open the Secret Territory, and even if she doesn’t, the Secret Territory will emerge before long.”
He knew many secrets and understood the gravity of the situation. When Prince Wu’an couldn’t control the situation, and Emperor Qian was informed, he decided to come and provide support.
At any cost, they must fight for the Dragon Ball, even if it means a great sacrifice.
The Dragon Ball was of utmost importance to the Qian Dynasty. With it, Prince Wu’an could Craft King Grade Pills to aim for the Divine Yuan Realm. Both he and the old ancestor could use it to rebuild their foundations, and in the future, they could possibly reach the Divine Yuan Realm.
By then, all the turmoil within Da Qian could be quelled, and they could even take advantage of the situation to become the number one power in the Xuan Domain. Even if they could not compare to Sacred Lands such as Bai Yujing or Xumi Mountain, the current unstable situation would no longer occur.
Time flowed idly by, and five months passed in the blink of an eye.
Yuanzhou, Chengsheng Mountain.
The Artifact Refining Ancestor was refining an artifact, certainly not a supreme treasure, but it could at least be considered a significant treasure.
As a top-tier Seventh Grade Artifact Refiner, Han Ancestor was adept at this, with outstanding skill, he steadily controlled everything.
After a series of intricate manipulations, hammering the significant treasure into various shapes, he finally polished it to a silky smoothness, shaping it as he desired.
“Refreshing!”
Looking at his accomplishment, excitement adorned Han Li’s face. This time, he had refined three treasures at once, successfully crafting three identical significant treasures.
“Sigh~”
Han Ancestor glanced at the three treasures, exhaled deeply, and vanished.
The next instant, Han Ancestor appeared at the summit of Chengdao Peak, feeling completely refreshed and clear-headed.
During these five months, Han Ancestor had taken another concubine, just one time, and the concubines were triplets.
The triplets were named Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhirou, and Zhou Zhixuan, each with a semblance score around eighty-six, and their talents were merely eighth grade.
They came from a family in Yonchang Manor within the Gangyuan Realm, a family that recently faced a great crisis and could not find a solution. In the end, they approached Han Ancestor for aid.
Wishing to offer their daughters to Han Ancestor, they sought to leverage his influence to resolve their troubles.
Han Ancestor heard that the beautiful female cultivators sent as potential concubines were initially unwilling; he had raised his standard for taking concubines to seventh grade talents.
However, after seeing the three beautiful cultivators sent by the family, Han Ancestor felt his standards could be somewhat lowered—standards are rigid, but people are flexible, after all.
Zhou Zhirou, Zhou Zhiruo, and Zhou Zhixuan were identical triplets, all exuding a type of pure innocence—which brightened Han Ancestor’s eyes at first sight.
The three women had low cultivation and poor talents, likely facing an unpromising future, so Han Ancestor felt it his duty to assist them, to teach and enhance their cultivation, ensuring they led good lives.
This was not because Han Ancestor wanted to taste something new, even though he hadn’t had this type in his collection of concubines before.
Enough said, it was truly delightful.
Although not particularly enchanting, Han Ancestor expressed a liking for this kind of feeling.
Therefore, Han Ancestor gladly accepted, and after a few days, he threw a grand feast, marrying the Zhou sisters, allowing them a happy life on Chengdao Peak.
Han Ancestor considered himself a very good man, constantly toiling, always diligently tilling the land, solely to cultivate a fertile ground. He had to sow as well because only then could one reap a harvest. If this wasn’t the archetype of an old farmer, then what was?

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - 139 Breakthrough, Pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Chapter 139 Breakthrough, Pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm!_1
Translator: 549690339
“Triplets are already so refreshing, what about quadruplets or quintuplets?”
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, with the cool breeze on his face, the thoughts of Elder Han silently wandered.
Although Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhirou, and Zhou Zhixuan, the three sisters, were far behind Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and others in terms of talent, appearance, and cultivation level, their identity as triplets was a significant boon.
Even Elder Han, who had long been battle-hardened and had killed countless enemies, could not resist such a temptation.
Han Li found that he was not unwilling to accept female cultivators with lower talents as concubines; it was just that the others were quite ordinary and had nothing particularly appealing.
If there were bonus points, such as a special identity, or a special cultivation technique, or exceptionally beautiful looks, scoring above ninety-five, far surpassing the baseline, these could be grounds for a relaxed criterion.
Under such circumstances, which officer could withstand this test?
After much diligent effort, Elder Han finally did not disappoint the high expectations of a billion descendants, succeeding in planting seeds in the three sisters.
“Judging by the time, it should be about right now,” Han Li muttered to himself.
It wasn’t long before a system prompt sounded in Han Li’s mind, and the joy on his face deepened.
This was roughly in line with his previous predictions.
“You have reached the number of eight hundred descendants, you gain fifty years of cultivation, you obtain seven Sea-Splitting Pills, and four Gang Yuan Pills, you acquire the Earth-grade Superior Martial Art ‘Nine Heavenly Divine Actions’.”
Han Li checked the system prompt and found that the reward this time had improved quite a bit over the last one.
The cultivation was still fifty years, with one additional Sea-Splitting Pill and Gang Yuan Pill, but the last reward was upgraded.
The last martial technique awarded was the mid-tier Earth-grade ‘Divine Desolate Prison Finger,’ but this time it was the top-tier Earth-grade ‘Nine Heavenly Divine Actions,’ and the key point was that this Earth-grade Superior Martial Technique specialized in speed.
Han Li had already thoroughly analyzed his combat ability and found his weaknesses quite evident, mainly in speed and defense, as both were still at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Now, with ‘Nine Heavenly Divine Actions,’ his speed would inevitably surge, once again patching up a weakness and substantially increasing his overall strength.
Han Li sent a message to Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Qiu Yueyao, and other beloved wives and beautiful concubines, telling them not to come up to the peak for the time being, after which he set up an invisible Barrier.
After preparing these, Han Li finally claimed the ‘Nine Heavenly Divine Actions;’ he couldn’t wait to comprehend the speed of this powerful martial technique.
In an instant, a vast amount of scripture appeared in Han Li’s mind, followed by endless insights associated with these scriptures, a wealth of cultivation experience, various application scenarios…
Han Li’s Divine Spirit was already comparable to that of the True Martial Realm; he quickly absorbed and digested ‘Nine Heavenly Divine Actions,’ mastering this martial technique to the peak.
“Hahaha~ the old Ancestor has put in the effort and mastered another powerful martial technique to perfection.”
Opening his eyes, Han Li couldn’t help but laugh out loud three times, a bit dissolute, but the sound was masked by the Barrier and was not heard by anyone.
The speed of ‘Nine Heavenly Divine Actions’ was too fast!
‘Step Booster Technique’ was merely a Supreme Grade Profound Rank martial technique. With the addition of the nascent form of the All-Powerful Martial Dao True Intent, it was comparable to top-tier mid-tier Earth-grade martial techniques, and when mastered to perfection, it could cover ninety-six thousand miles in a single breath.
‘Nine Heavenly Divine Actions’ was a top-tier Earth-grade Superior Martial Technique. When mastered to perfection, it allowed crossing of one hundred and forty thousand miles in a single breath, approaching the speed of the True Martial Realm.
With the nascent form of the All-Powerful Martial Dao True Intent, ‘Nine Heavenly Divine Actions’ was nearly comparable to a mid-tier Heaven Rank martial technique, with the speed directly soaring to cover three hundred and sixty thousand miles in a single breath.
The length of Yuanzhou from east to west was just eight hundred and twenty thousand miles, and Han Li could traverse it in just two and a half breaths, a speed beyond the imagination of ordinary people and even many cultivators.
The speed of an Emperor Wu in the True Martial Realm was extremely fast, at least one hundred and fifty thousand miles in a single breath. The speed of three hundred and sixty thousand miles in a single breath was very fast even within the True Martial Realm, comparable to around the Fifth Heaven.
His speed, which had originally been the lowest of his attributes, had now leaped to the strongest, and even without a Heaven Rank Divine Sword to execute the Seal the Heavens Sword Canon, he would only have the combat ability of the Fourth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
Han Li originally wanted to go out for a stroll and experience the extreme speed of ‘Nine Heavenly Divine Actions,’ but he restrained himself firmly, deciding that it was more urgent to increase his cultivation first; it wouldn’t be too late to go out after he became stronger.
His realm was at the perfect Seventh Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and to elevate to the perfect Ninth Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, he still needed about a hundred years’ worth of cultivation. Now, Elder Han had already saved up enough.
Adding one hundred descendants equaled one hundred years of cultivation; reaching eight hundred descendants awarded fifty years of cultivation, and the cultivation feedback from descendants was another twenty years, totaling to one hundred and seventy years.
Without hesitation, Han Li immediately began his breakthrough.
Watching the numbers on the panel decrease rapidly, Elder Han did not even frown as his aura rapidly increased, growing stronger and soaring to the sky.
Myriad Phenomena Realm Eight Heavens!
Myriad Phenomena Realm Nine Heavens!
Myriad Phenomena Realm Peak!
When Han Li’s realm reached the perfect Ninth Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, the surging aura finally halted and could not advance any further.
As his realm improved, over a century of cultivation experience emerged in Elder Han’s mind, ushering him once more into an Enlightenment State of a hundred years in an instant.
In these hundred years, he constantly refined the nascent form of the All-Powerful Martial Dao True Intent, observed the profound to comprehend the way, and understood the laws through worldly experiences, all of which eventually converged upon Han Li, propelling his Martial Dao True Intent forward by a significant step.
“Phew~”
After the realm elevation ended, Han Li exhaled deeply, feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.
He quickly checked his state, comprehending the strength following the continuous breakthroughs, and discovered that his overall strength had greatly increased.

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 139 Breakthrough, Pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 139 Breakthrough, Pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm!_2
Translator: 549690339
First, the completion degree of the embryonic form of the All-Powerful Martial Dao’s true intent reached 49%, which significantly enhanced his overall strength, allowing him to improve martial skills by nearly three grades.
A normal Earth-Level Lower Rank martial skill could be enhanced to nearly an Earth-Level Extreme Martial Arts level, and the top-tier Earth-Level Lower Rank martial skills could be directly promoted to Earth-Level Extreme Martial Arts; it was quite practical.
Having advanced by two minor realms, his Divine Spirit and Spiritual Sense also significantly increased, now comparable to the Second Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
His five senses were further heightened, allowing him to remain in the Divine Sense realm for one additional second every time, which was a significant overall increase.
In a short burst, the duration of Divine Sense extended to 9 seconds, and in sustained bursts, it stretched to 24 seconds.
After his cultivation had improved, Han Li’s Gang Yuan strength was further enhanced and became indistinguishable from True Yuan; it could also be referred to as True Yuan.
When the Myriad Phenomena Realm Seventh Heaven was perfected, his total amount of True Yuan touched the threshold of the True Martial Realm. Now, with further improvement, it was about the same as an ordinary Second Heaven in the True Martial Realm.
Additionally, the further refinement of the embryonic form of the All-Powerful Martial Dao’s true intent meant that the might of the various martial skills he mastered also increased significantly, with a comprehensive enhancement in power.
Using the Zhenjun Sword to perform the Sealing Heaven Sword Canon, he had the combat ability of the Fifth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, using the Five Elements Seal, he had the power of the Fourth Heaven, and using the God Wasteland Imprisoning Finger and Xuantian Punch, he had the power of the Third Heaven, and with the God Slaying Sword Technique, the Second Heaven.
Even when using his weakest move, the Dragon Suppressing Palm, he still had the combat ability of the First Heaven of the True Martial Realm; the main issue was that this martial skill was of too low a grade, and even with augmentation, it only approached the level of Earth-Level Extreme Martial Arts.
Han Li was very satisfied with his own strength. Now, in all his hidden identities, the weakest was also at the First Heaven of the True Martial Realm, a bit stronger than Prince Wu’an.
If he entered the Divine Sense realm, the combat ability of all his hidden identities would further rise, reaching a new level.
Even with defense being his shortcoming, Han Li felt that his comprehensive strength was at least at the middle stages of the True Martial Realm.
Next, Han Li’s goal was to elevate this last shortcoming as well, so that even without a breakthrough to the True Martial Realm, each of his indicators would be at the level of the True Martial Realm.
Gathering all his thoughts, Han Li looked toward the direction of Leizhou, feeling much more relaxed.
A grand melee at the True Martial Realm was about to take place in Leizhou, which had put considerable pressure on Han Li; he was just worried that these True Martial Realm fighters would start fighting and end up in Yuanzhou.
This was not impossible as the speed of the True Martial Realm was extremely fast, and the situation in battle changed in the blink of an eye. It was unlikely for them to stay in one place and fight continuously.
Previously, his strength had been slightly inadequate to dominate the entire scene, but now Han Li felt it was sufficient.
To deal with that substandard Prince Wu’an, Han Li felt that just using the Dragon Suppressing Palm, throwing a few more strikes, was enough to blast him away.
Even for that strong and haughty Dragon Maiden, Han Li felt he could now personally assess her and perhaps really defeat her.
These thoughts were fleeting, and Han Li had no intention of intervening; he planned to continue lying low on Chengsheng Mountain.
Of course, if there was an easy opportunity, Han Li thought it was worth considering.
For instance, if some female martial artist in the True Martial Realm, or even the Dragon Maiden, were to be wounded and flee from a great battle, with her strength severely diminished, Han Li would consider whether to reveal one of his hidden identities to intercept her, capture her, and have her bear his children.
Afterward, Han Li took a step and his figure disappeared from Chengsheng Mountain.
A few moments later, Han Li reappeared, a trace of astonishment on his face.
Although he knew his speed was extremely fast, it was only after truly experiencing it that he understood just how preposterously fast it was.
It was only because his physical condition had improved to be comparable to a Second Heaven of the True Martial Realm; if it had been another peak warrior of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, he would not have been able to handle such speed.
The faster the speed, the higher the demands on one’s physical conditioning. Forcing an increase in speed without sufficient physical condition could only harm oneself; one might even end up dead.
Upon returning to Chengdao Peak, Han Li sent word to Jiang Baiye, Li Mingmeng, Liu Yuexin, and his other lovely wives and beautiful concubines that he was finished with his duties.
After withdrawing the True Yuan barrier, Han Li’s figure disappeared from the summit of Chengdao Peak and he appeared in the sleeping quarters.
He found that the three treasures he had recently acquired and refined were still there, so Han Li directly began to stimulate them, experiencing the silky pleasure once again.
After passing teachings and the essence to the Zhou sisters, and then sharing a tender moment with them, Han Li instructed them to rest well before leaving the sleeping quarters.
The next moment, he was behind Lu Tianxiang, looking at her in her red dress. Han Li couldn’t help but lick his lips, feeling the heat rising in his chest again.
“Husband… Han Li, what are you doing here?”
Lu Tianxiang was somewhat surprised to see this figure and almost blurted out the name in her heart. She quickly corrected herself.
Although Lu Tianxiang corrected herself quickly, she couldn’t hide it from Han Li. His face immediately lit up with joy. He stepped forward, wrapped his arms around Lu Tianxiang’s slender waist, and nibbled on her delicate earlobe before speaking softly,
“Xiangxiang, were you just about to call me ‘husband’? Why didn’t you finish? I’ve been looking forward to it for quite some years now.”
“Nonsense, how could I, the esteemed Sect Hierarch, use such a cheesy term? You must’ve heard wrong,” Xiangxiang, the Sect Hierarch, declared in denial, except her pretty face was flushed with a rosy hue, making her already stunning features even more beautiful.
Looking at Lu Tianxiang, who was saying one thing but meaning another, Han Li just smiled, not pressing the subject any further.
His progression with Lu Tianxiang was going smoothly, and he’d already achieved more than half of his goal. It wouldn’t be long before she’d fall completely.
“Why don’t you go keep those three concubines company? They all look identical; they must be quite the treat, right?” Lu Tianxiang’s tone carried a hint of grievance.
Ever since Han Li took Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhixuan, and Zhou Zhirou as his concubines, he’d been energetically occupied with them for several days, and Lu Tianxiang felt somewhat put out by it.
“They are indeed lovely, but when compared to Xiangxiang, they’re worlds apart—it’s like heaven and earth,” Han Li said with a sly chuckle, his hand beginning to wander.
Lu Tianxiang felt secretly pleased inside, yet she still slapped away his hand and sneered, “Smooth talker.”
“Xiangxiang, look how big Yongzhen has grown; don’t you think about finding him a companion?” Han Li said with a smiling face.
Lu Tianxiang frowned in displeasure, “Find a companion? He’s only a year old. Don’t mess around, or there will be consequences.”
“Besides, he has so many brothers, sisters, and other young relatives to play with.”
“Ahem~” Han Li coughed a few times and continued, “Xiangxiang, what I meant was, do you want to give Yongzhen a little brother or sister…?”
“Don’t even think about it!”
Lu Tianxiang glared fiercely at Han Li, rejecting the idea outright.
So that scoundrel Han Li had come to her with this in mind.
Lu Tianxiang thought having one child with Han Li was enough; this shameless rogue actually wanted a second one, when Han Yongzhen was not even a year old yet—despicable!
“Xiangxiang, I’m just worried about Yongzhen being lonely. Look at Yueyao, Mingmeng, they all have several children. Only Yongzhen is all by himself,” Han Li explained.
Almost a year had passed since Lu Tianxiang gave birth to Han Yongzhen, and her cultivation had unfurled to the late stage of the God Refining Realm. Her body had recovered quickly, ready for more childbearing.
Among all his wives and concubines, Lu Tianxiang was the only one with Third Grade talent, even higher than Han Li’s own, so naturally, Han Li didn’t want her to have just one child.
At least she should meet the average standard of having four.
Han Li wasn’t demanding another child with Third Grade talent from Lu Tianxiang. He would be quite satisfied with Fourth Grade or even Fifth Grade talent.
Lu Tianxiang scoffed with a look that said, “As if I would fall for that.”
It took some effort and sweet talk from Han Li before he finally appeased Lu Tianxiang, and then they joyfully went to play.
PS: Regarding the update schedule, don’t be fooled by the author’s daily updates; they take up a lot of time.
The truth is, the author writes quite slowly. Writing one chapter takes at least two hours, and when it’s slow, it can take up to three hours, as plotting takes time.
For instance, this morning, I started writing around nine o’clock, and it wasn’t until twelve o’ five that I finished, sometimes with a lot of deleting and editing.
I’ve said before that I aim for ten thousand characters a day, and I’ve always exceeded that. Barring any surprises, I’ll keep this up daily.
As for updates, now there are three chapters some days, four chapters on others, each chapter being over four thousand characters.
On days with three chapters, that’s because I take a nap in the afternoon; otherwise, I really couldn’t sustain the intensity of continuous writing.
The update times are: around noon for the first chapter, approximately eight o’clock for the second chapter, about eleven-thirty for the third chapter, and if there is a fourth chapter, it’ll be updated around five or six in the afternoon

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 140 Jiang Jiang’s Worries, the Aged Monk Kurong, the Stable Da Jing Dynasty_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 140 Jiang Jiang’s Worries, the Aged Monk Kurong, the Stable Da Jing Dynasty_1
Translator: 549690339
The second day dawned, its light faint and tender.
Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang had chased Han Li out, but his face was filled with smiles.
“It should have worked, right?”
Han Li murmured softly to himself.
As long as Lu Tianxiang didn’t actively disperse it with her cultivation, given his mutated constitution, it was almost certain to take effect.
“Get out!”
Lu Tianxiang’s voice came out, filled with embarrassed anger, evidently having overheard Han Li’s murmurs.
“Xiangxiang, you rest up, I’ll come to see you again in the afternoon.”
Han Li smiled and then disappeared from sight; he had intentionally murmured loud enough for Lu Tianxiang to hear.
Within Lu Tianxiang’s bedchamber, she lay on the soft big bed, a quilt concealing most of the enticing view of spring.
There was no anger on her face, just a certain complexity, as she reached out and touched her abdomen, feeling somewhat hesitant in her heart.
She had originally not wanted to continue having children, but if there really was one, she didn’t know whether she should get rid of it.
“Sigh~”
Lu Tianxiang sighed, her jade hand stroking back and forth over her flat belly dozens of times, but in the end, she did nothing.
After leaving Lu Tianxiang’s place, Han Li made his way to Jiang Baiye’s bedchamber.
His delicate wives and beautiful concubines each had their own independent chambers on Chengdao Peak, decorated according to their wishes.
“She’s actually not here.”
Han Li walked around inside and then stepped out, his Spiritual Sense sweeping around, he found Jiang Baiye standing atop the mountain, enjoying the view.
With a single step, Han Li appeared beside Jiang Baiye, his large hand naturally encircling her slender waist.
Jiang Baiye glanced at him, then continued to admire the beautiful morning glow.
“Jiang Jiang, are you troubled by something?” After a moment’s thought, Han Li asked directly.
During this period, he had noticed Jiang Baiye’s worries, pondering over what was troubling her. Han Li had been waiting for her to speak up, but Jiang Baiye remained silent.
After a slight hesitation, Jiang Baiye nodded.
Han Li sighed. Jiang Baiye still kept her distance from him and hadn’t fully accepted him yet, otherwise, she would have spoken up about her concerns much earlier.
He tightened his hold, pulling Jiang Baiye’s head to rest upon his shoulder, then lowered his head to kiss her forehead before saying:
“Tell me about it.”
“I… I’m worried about the Sect,” Jiang Baiye let out a long breath, revealing her concern.
A few months ago, a battle of the True Martial Realm erupted in Leizhou. Although it was extremely brief, its impact was profound, and Jiang Baiye obviously knew about it.
Han Li had even mentioned to them that a battle royale of True Martial Realm might occur later on, with those Emperor Wu’s vying for a great opportunity.
That was when Jiang Baiye started to worry.
Though the battle would assuredly break out in Leizhou, Canghai Sect was in Qingzhou, but still, there was an undeniable risk of being affected by the ripples of the grand battle.
If the True Martial Realm powerhouses fought their way through Canghai Sect, could really the Sect’s protective formations withstand such an onslaught?
Jiang Baiye had no confidence in that.
Even if the Canghai Sect wasn’t directly affected by the grand battle, the ensuing aftermath would surely reach them.
Once the battle of the True Martial Realm commenced, the long-brewing storm within the Daqian Empire would fully erupt, placing Sanzhou at the forefront, and Canghai Sect would not be spared.
Faced with the larger trends, Canghai Sect would inevitably have to make a choice; otherwise, they were very likely to be destroyed.
Whether it was the Da Qian Dynasty, the Mysterious Forces stirring trouble within, or the covetous Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, Da Jing Dynasty, and so on, Canghai Sect didn’t have the ability to oppose them.
During these times, one must take sides, taking refuge with one to continue surviving.
The dilemma of which faction to join had become a major issue, as allying with a faction that ends up defeated would also spell doom for Canghai Sect.
She herself was only at the latter stages of the God Refining Realm and couldn’t influence much, whereas Han Li, with his strength of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, could influence the situation to some degree.
Should Han Li offer his help, the chances of Canghai Sect surviving would greatly increase.
But Jiang Baiye also knew that she couldn’t ask for Han Li’s help. His distance from Leizhou was precisely to avoid the brewing storm. He hadn’t even looked after his own Sect, Tianxuan Mountain, so how could he aid Canghai Sect?
Besides, while the power of a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm could normally intimidate the Qian Dynasty, during the battle of the True Martial Realm, or the subsequent factional confrontations, they would hardly influence the overall situation and would even face mortal danger.
Jiang Baiye didn’t want Han Li to risk his life for these matters, as she didn’t want their child to grow up fatherless.
Sensing the heartfelt emotions of the exquisite beauty in his arms, Han Li held her tightly, offering comfort. After a while, he said:
“Don’t worry, I’m here.”
He didn’t speak of relocating Canghai Sect. Tianxuan Mountain hadn’t moved, and neither would Canghai Sect; if they were going to move, they would have done so already.
When the storm hits, powers like Tianxuan Mountain and Canghai Sect must take sides unless they leave the Da Qian Dynasty entirely.
But is it really stable outside the Da Qian Dynasty?
That’s hard to say.
Jiang Baiye bit her red lips, her gorgeous lips parting several times before she finally let out a soft “Mhm.”
She didn’t ask Han Li what to do, she trusted that he would handle it well, and she knew Han Li would prioritize their safety.
Even if Han Li ultimately did nothing, Jiang Baiye wouldn’t be disappointed, because at least he had tried.
Han Li bent down again, capturing her exquisite red lips with his own, holding her for a long moment before letting go. He continued to hold Jiang Baiye without speaking, just quietly enjoying the sunrise together.
There were some things he couldn’t reveal, not even to Jiang Baiye, Lu Tianxiang, Qiu Yueyao, and his other delicate wives and beautiful concubines.
This world was too full of mystique—once spoken aloud, there was a chance outsiders would come to know of it.
Even some thoughts held in the heart, if pondered upon, might be known by others.
Han Li had already planned that, should Tianxuan Mountain or Canghai Sect face the danger of destruction, he would have no other choice but to operate under an alias to lend assistance.

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 140 Jiang Jiang’s Worries, the Aged Monk Kurong, the Stable Da Jing Dynasty_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Chapter 140 Jiang Jiang’s Worries, the Aged Monk Kurong, the Stable Da Jing Dynasty_2
Translator: 549690339
By then, even with multiple factions in opposition, the weight of a True Martial Realm cultivator would be extremely heavy, causing all sides to give face, seeking to woo them, thereby preserving Tianxuan Mountain and Canghai Sect.
