In Han Li’s heart, Tianxuan Mountain was more important than Canghai Sect. When the time came, he would use an alias with higher combat ability to stand up for Tianxuan Mountain.
Of course, all this was based on the assumption that there was no significant threat to his life. If the other powers insisted on taking action and Han Li was unable to defeat them, then a strategic retreat would be necessary.
Although Tianxuan Mountain was important, it paled in comparison to his own life.
Ancestral revenge could wait a thousand years.
All he needed to do was bide his time, and he could easily avenge Tianxuan Mountain.
Hanzhou, Fengbo Pavilion.
Above the thirty-sixth floor, an elder in hemp garb stood by the window, his hands clasped behind his back, quietly gazing in the direction of Leizhou.
“Wenyuan, you will be in charge of this plan. I hope you will not disappoint me,” the hemp-clothed old man finally spoke after a long silence.
Standing not far behind the hemp-clothed elder, Lu Wenyuan’s face showed hesitation as he cautiously said, “My lord, this might not be wise.”
According to the plan, the operation was to be led by the hemp-clothed elder, a True Martial Realm cultivator, as its importance was too great, involving too wide a scope, and the weight of a Myriad Phenomena Realm pinnacle couldn’t compare.
The hemp-clothed old man chuckled lightly and said, “Don’t worry, it’s just right for you to lead it.”
After a pause, the elder continued, “The Sacred Dragon Dragon Ball in Leizhou is still out of Prince Wu’an’s reach; a True Martial Realm cultivator from Da Qian is bound to take action.”
“At that time, Da Qian’s True Martial Realm combat ability will all be tied up in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm. It’s the best time to implement the plan; no Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm will be there to stop you.”
“I will find an opportunity to strike, severely injuring or even killing Prince Wu’an and another of Da Qian’s True Martial Realm cultivators. The rest is up to you.”
“You may leave now.”
Without waiting for Lu Wenyuan’s agreement, the hemp-clothed elder said dismissively.
Lu Wenyuan could only laugh bitterly and take his leave with a salute; there was nothing he could do when the elder had made a decision.
The hemp-clothed elder continued to look towards Leizhou but was feeling quite fervent inside.
When they first discussed the plan, he had volunteered for this responsibility, risking his life to enter Da Qian for today.
Back then, he didn’t know what opportunity Prince Wu’an was waiting for, but he knew it had to be extremely precious. If there was a chance, he would steal it himself.
Now that the opportunity had arrived, he also knew what it was—the Sacred Dragon Dragon Ball!
This was a significant fortune for both the Myriad Phenomena Realm and the True Martial Realm, and even of great use to those in the Divine Yuan Realm.
However, Divine Yuan Realm cultivators were very rare in the Qianyuan Divine Province, and those capable of cultivating to that realm almost always had the backing of a Sacred Land, whose reserves were immensely deep, so they didn’t need to compete for the Dragon Ball.
Knowing there would be no Divine Yuan Emperor Wu’s participating, the hemp-clothed elder dared to contend for it; being an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm’s third layer, albeit only a Third Grade True Elixir, he could certainly suppress those of the True Martial Realm with lower cultivation levels.
If he could obtain the Sacred Dragon Dragon Ball, he would be able to reconstruct his foundation, defy fate, and greatly increase his chances of advancing to the Divine Yuan Realm as Emperor Wu.
Continuing his cultivation, whether he could break through to the later stages of the True Martial Realm during his lifetime was uncertain.
Faced with such a temptation, the hemp-clothed elder couldn’t resist; anyone wishing to break through to higher realms and live longer would find it hard to withstand the allure of such a great opportunity.
With only a lifespan of two thousand years in the True Martial Realm, the elixirs and treasures that could extend a True Martial Realm cultivator’s life were extremely rare, and even if obtained at great cost, would at most add another two to three hundred years.
Once one broke through to the Divine Yuan Realm, that was a lifespan of five thousand years.
Whether it be for strength or longevity, the hemp-clothed elder was willing to risk it all.
Moreover, he did indeed have the idea of taking the opportunity to severely injure or kill Prince Wu’an and another of Da Qian’s True Martial Realm cultivators; should he succeed with any of it, the other Emperor Wus within his sect would have nothing to say.
“The Sacred Dragon Dragon Ball, I must obtain it,” the hemp-clothed elder thought to himself.
There were quite a few with the same thoughts as the hemp-clothed elder; Prince Wu’an, Chu Wuji, the Diamond Monks of Kurong Sect, and others all had similar notions.
Long Yue’s deterrence indeed had some effect; some Emperor Wus who had originally planned to compete directly were now waiting to see if an opportunity would present itself.
These Emperor Wus were either young or felt they had ample chances to advance to the Divine Yuan Realm, making it unnecessary to risk their lives competing for the prize.
West of the Qian Dynasty lay Kurong Sect.
The domains of Kurong Sect also contained many large and small cities and villages, which were home to many Human Clan commoners and Human Cultivators.
Unlike Da Qian and the Yinyang Sect, the central area of every town within Kurong Sect was always a temple.
These temples often had flourishing incense offerings. Commoners living in the towns had to visit them regularly to offer incense and even had to chant sutras and worship Buddha at home.
Within the regions controlled by Kurong Sect, like many families and Sects, reliant on the Sect, they all practiced Buddhist Cultivation Techniques and martial skills.
Compared to the Qian Dynasty, the governance of Kurong Sect over its territories, bonded by faith, was considerably stronger. However, the human heart is unpredictable and prone to change; there were many evil beings within the domains of Kurong Sect as well.
While the Buddhist Sect might have high proficiency in matters of faith, not all monks would forever believe in Buddha, some whose beliefs wavered eventually abandoned the Buddhist path, becoming Devil Buddhas, Evil Buddhas, Demon Monks, and the like, specially opposing the Buddhist Sect.
In the center of the Kurong Sect’s domain stood a massive temple, within which was a towering tree that reached to the heavens.
This towering tree exhibited a curious phenomenon: at times it was lush and brimming with vitality, at other times it withered, its leaves faded, exuding an air of death.

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - 140 Jiang Jiang’s Worries, the Aged Monk Kurong, the Stable Da Jing Dynasty_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Chapter 140 Jiang Jiang’s Worries, the Aged Monk Kurong, the Stable Da Jing Dynasty_3
Translator: 549690339
Under this towering sky-reaching tree, a old monk sat cross-legged with his eyes closed, wearing only a coarse monk’s robe, his face full and round, with a broad square forehead and an expansive jaw, his kindly eyes exuding the aura of a high monk who had attained the Dao.
“Kurong elder brother, has your Kurong True Intent improved further?”
At that moment, another monk appeared beneath the sky-reaching tree, his back slightly hunched as if carrying a divine mountain.
“Still a bit lacking.”
Without opening his eyes, the Kurong old monk spoke in a calm tone, seemingly seeing through everything in the world.
“Congratulations, elder brother, on your soon-to-be advancement to the fourth level of the True Martial Realm,” joy appeared on Tuoshan Kong’s face.
“Younger brother, your congratulations have come too early,” the Kurong old monk sighed.
“It’s just a matter of time.”
“It seems that even if I didn’t come, with elder brother’s strength, securing the Jiaolong Dragon Ball would be almost certain,” Tuoshan Kong said with a smile.
Kurong old monk shook his head and said, “The Dragon Maiden is too powerful, even if you and I join forces, we might not be her match.”
Tuoshan Kong’s pupils shrunk slightly, then he said, “No matter, there are more than just us making a move this time.”
To the north of the Daqian Empire is the Da Jing Empire.
For centuries, the two great empires had constant friction and fought many large wars, with victories and defeats on both sides.
The Da Jing Empire always stationed troops in the south to threaten the Daqian Empire, but in the last several decades there had been no major movements, even though Prince Wu’an was called back to Capital City, they did not seize the opportunity to invade and conquer.
Da Jing Empire’s territories also operated under a system of states, prefectures, and counties, with the Capital City located in Wen Province.
At this moment, an urgent meeting was being convened within the imperial palace of the Da Jing Empire.
The meeting didn’t last long, but all those involved knew it was of great importance; they appeared somewhat excited and left to prepare right after it concluded.
Emperor Jing sat upon the Dragon Chair, his gaze deep as he mulled over the upcoming plan to ensure there were no oversights.
The Da Jing Empire had always been waiting for the right opportunity, unwilling to invade Daqian first, because going to war with Daqian would only benefit the Yinyang Sect and the Kurong Sect.
The Yinyang Sect and Kurong Sect thought the same, thus leading to a stalemate, which instead allowed the Daqian Empire a chance to breathe.
Fortunately, the stalemate didn’t last many years, as a Mysterious Forces emerged within Da Qian, stirring up trouble: White Lotus Cult attacked prefectures, there were assassinations of the military governors of Sanzhou, and now they were plotting something big.
The Da Jing Empire, Yinyang Sect, and Kurong Sect were pleased to see this development, preferring other forces to act as the vanguard; if they could whittle down the essence of the Daqian Empire, they could then swoop in for the profits.
Now the timing was almost right; with the emergence of the Leizhou Secret Territory, Emperor Jing knew that the Mysterious Forces would make a major move and would not miss this opportunity. Da Jing Empire thought the same.
Emperor Jing believed that Kurong Sect and Yinyang Sect would also not miss this chance to take advantage of the situation, delivering a fatal blow to the Daqian Empire, and then they would divide the spoils of victory together.
With the emergence of the Leizhou Secret Territory, Da Qian’s True Martial Realm Combat Ability would be drawn there, making it an excellent opportunity to annihilate them in one fell swoop.
Thus, many Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm from the Da Jing Empire moved to the southern border, ready to strike at the opportune moment.
A True Martial Realm elder from the Da Jing Empire also moved out secretly, speeding towards the location to find a chance to strike.
Da Jing Empire had no intention of competing for the Jiaolong Dragon Ball; their primary goal was to eliminate the True Martial Realm Combat Ability of the Daqian Empire, to mitigate the threat. Once Daqian lacked the True Martial Realm Combat Ability, it could only be carved up at their mercy.
Though the Jiaolong Dragon Ball was valuable, it was also a live target that could bring Da Jing a lot of trouble.
Emperor Jing and the two elders had discussed it and decided to develop steadily. They would not vie for the Jiaolong Dragon Ball—instead prioritize swallowing up the Daqian Empire first, agreeing that steady development was more important.
PS: Third update, asking for monthly votes, and also a question.
The big plotline has started, do you think the main character should reveal his True Martial Realm strength?
There are three options now: first, the main character could join the battle under his real name, which doesn’t quite fit with being cautious, but since he levels up quickly, it wouldn’t have much impact. This could lead to plotlines like Da Qian offering a princess…
Second, the main character could enter the battle undercover, not affecting his cautious identity.
Third, the main character doesn’t actively join the battle but waits at home until he can take the opportunity to capture the Dragon Maiden or the female Demon King undercover

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - 141: The Requirements for Advancing to the True Martial Realm! The Sacred Dragon Secret Realm Opens!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 141: The Requirements for Advancing to the True Martial Realm! The Sacred Dragon Secret Realm Opens!_1
Translator: 549690339
Chengsheng Mountain, atop Chengdao Peak.
It was now the break of dawn, and Elder Han’s thoughts were somewhat fluctuating, as if sensing in the obscurity that something momentous was about to occur.
After completing his treasure refining, Elder Han came to this place alone, intending to enjoy the scenery to calm his mind, while casually waiting to see what would happen.
Sunrise, hailed as one of the most majestic and splendid scenes in nature, its beauty is indescribable, beyond words.
One of the most spectacular sights of Chengsheng Mountain is precisely the sun rising in the east.
A thread of dawn breaks through the eternal night, and the eastern sky transitions from dark to pale, to red, and finally to a dazzling golden yellow.
Around rises the sun from the horizon, in an instant, myriad rays of light flooding the sky, casting the firmament in a hue of red, filling onlookers with a sense of boundless vitality and formidable presence.
From Han Li’s perspective, beneath the glow of dawn, the mountains stretched in succession, layer upon layer, a myriad of peaks and seas, resembling an ink wash painting.
As the crimson sun slowly ascends, the morning light illuminates every inch of the majestic rivers and mountains, revealing the full beauty of Chengsheng Mountain.
The sea of clouds turns red with the light of dawn, waterfalls cascade downwards like silver dragons, and the reflection of the sun dances in various ponds, their brilliance mingled with the light of the sky.
“The radiant light slowly departs from the blue, the mirror-like disk gradually reaching the vast palace above.”
“I wish to ride the wind up to the jade capital, gazing far into the distance from Fusang, endless and unfathomable.”
Unable to resist, Han Li began to recite these lines. The sea of his heart, once disturbed, was now smoothed over by the glow of dawn, portraying him in a state of tranquillity and serenity.
Standing at the peak, his white robes fluttering, Elder Han at this moment seemed like a hermit with a celestial aura, giving off the impression of one who is ‘ethereally detached from the world, transcending mortality to ascend to immortality.’
“Huff~”
Han Li exhaled a long breath, resembling an immortal sword cleaving through the air, only to be disintegrated by the elder’s flick of a finger.
Turning his gaze away, Han Li then looked towards Leizhou, sensing that the Dragon Maiden was about to make her move, a storm was coming.
In fact, he felt that the Dragon Maiden should have entered the Secret Territory over five months ago to retrieve the Dragon Ball, yet she had not, seemingly wary of something.
The emergence of the Secret Territory was bound to happen sooner or later; the Dragon Maiden couldn’t possibly wait for the Secret Territory to appear naturally, as her advantage would mostly vanish by then.
“I wonder when I will be able to ascend to the True Martial Realm,” Han Li mused to himself.
If he were to ascend to the True Martial Realm, his combat ability would at least reach the late phase of the True Martial Realm. Then, with few rivals in the Xuan Domain, he would have a great advantage in the fight for power.
As for now, better not, Han Li planned to continue laying low, just observing for the time being.
His strongest combat ability was around the fifth or sixth level of the True Martial Realm, but Han Li still felt this was too risky. Mainly because those True Martial Realm Emperor Wus had all lived for a very long time, most of them over a thousand years old, certainly concealing many contingencies.
Anyone who cultivated to the True Martial Realm had special trump cards, didn’t they? Who lacked secret techniques to burst forth with their true strength?
Han Li felt his defense was too weak; the Diamond Indestructible Body Technique couldn’t handle this level of conflict.
As his realm advanced, the embryonic form of the All-Encompassing Martial Intent continued to improve, and the protective body technique’s defense also elevated from the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm to the first layer of the True Martial Realm.
However, defense at the first level of the True Martial Realm was considered among the weakest in the realm. In the grand melee of the True Martial Realm, it could easily be breached, leading to grievous injuries.
Of course, Elder Han was fast, capable of crossing 390,000 miles in a single breath, nearly reaching the speed of the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm. During a battle, it would be quite difficult for others to hit him, but Elder Han didn’t want to expose his speed so easily.
Besides, the Nine Heavens Divine Travel technique excelled in traversing great distances, and its effectiveness was lessened in combat.
Opening the system panel, Han Li’s strengths were laid bare. His eyes moved to the very bottom, where a line of text was displayed.
[Ascension Requirement: 600 years of cultivation]
“Sigh~”
Elder Han sighed, having checked this more than once, each time sighing. The required cultivation was just too much.
To break through from the complete seventh heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm to its pinnacle, he had used a total of 102 years of cultivation, leaving only 68 years remaining, merely a tenth of the ascension requirement.
But Han Li had no other choice, the system required this much to help him ascend to the True Martial Realm; otherwise, he could only cultivate on his own, slowly.
To decrease the necessary cultivation for ascension, there was another way, which was to improve his talent. If he improved his talent to Third Grade, the required cultivation would be halved, needing only 300 years.
Currently, being of Fourth Grade talent, it was already challenging to cultivate to the True Martial Realm. Typically, one might struggle for over two hundred years just to have a chance to condense a Martial True Pill, and the success rate did not exceed ten percent.
Typically, among twelve or thirteen Fourth Grade talents of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, only one Great Grandmaster would succeed in ascending to the True Martial Realm, and the grade of the condensed Martial True Pill wouldn’t be high.
Han Li possessed the All-Encompassing Martial Intent, which further increased the difficulty. He needed help in condensing a fake pill during his ascension to cover the excessive level of the Martial Intent, which would require two hundred years of cultivation.
The condensed fake pill would be comparable to a King Grade Martial True Pill, and also needed to compress several hundred years of hard cultivation into a few breaths, which demanded another two hundred years of cultivation.
Although the required cultivation for ascension was extensive, Elder Han decided to take a shortcut.
Lying flat could outcompete all cultivators; if Elder Han seriously cultivated, what would become of it? He had to leave a way out for other cultivators.
“Sigh, it’s truly a laborious life for me, Elder Han, to toil day after day.”
The Treasure Refining Elder was filled with emotions, as though he foresaw the scene of himself “unmatched in battlefields and validating the great way with countless treasures refined.”
Closing his own panel, Han Li then checked another panel, which displayed three progress bars.
[Offspring Count: 803↑]
[Talented Offspring: 264↑]
[Current Talent: Fourth Grade 11%↑]

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 141: The Requirements for Advancing to the True Martial Realm! The Sacred Dragon Secret Realm Opens!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 141: The Requirements for Advancing to the True Martial Realm! The Sacred Dragon Secret Realm Opens!_2
Translator: 549690339
Having glanced at the ancestral elder Han Li, he closed the view, now having a rough idea in mind.
Among the last batch of one hundred new descendants, the majority had aptitudes because most of their parents possessed aptitudes as well.
From eight hundred to nine hundred, there would be far fewer descendants with aptitudes in this batch of one hundred, but it should be enough to bring the total number of descendants with aptitude to three hundred.
The current progress was about what he had anticipated; in about another year, he should have nine hundred descendants and three hundred of them with aptitudes.
Han Li noticed that the ratio of total descendants to those with aptitudes had increased, which was likely related to himself and the talents of the wives and concubines his descendants had married in recent years.
When two individuals without aptitudes have a child, the likelihood of that offspring having an aptitude is very small, such is the state of endless mortals. However, due to their large base, they still provided a substantial number of cultivators to the Cultivation Realm.
If one of the parents has an aptitude, the likelihood of their offspring having an aptitude increases, though the exact increase is hard to say, as it varies from person to person. Maybe the first offspring would mutate into a Third Grade aptitude.
However, such cases are generally reincarnations of the mighty or those born with a vast destiny, also known as “children of fortune”?
The probability of two descendants with aptitudes having a child with aptitudes is very high, and the higher the aptitude and cultivation level, the greater the probability. Yet, it is still possible to have offspring without any aptitudes, and the Cultivation Realm has many such examples.
A Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm and a God Refining Realm female cultivator had a third child who lacked any aptitude.
“One year later, nine hundred descendants, three hundred with aptitudes, two years later, a thousand descendants…”
Han Li felt that in at most three or four years, he would have accumulated enough cultivation to break through to the True Martial Realm, and by then, his power would improve in all aspects.
Moreover, during this process, he might also gain some high-level martial techniques and powerful weapons… steadily increasing his strength.
“Your ancestor me, I’m on the path to greatness,” he mused.
The thought of such rapid growth in the number of his descendants brought a smile to Han Li’s face.
Suddenly, his pupils contracted sharply as he witnessed a myriad of phenomena toward Leizhou, with a divine light piercing the sky. With his vision, standing atop a ten-thousand-meter peak, he could just make it out despite being more than two million miles away.
“It’s finally here!” Han Li caught his breath, then quickly let it go.
He blinked, feeling slightly embarrassed, “It’s not my opportunity, nor do I intend to compete for it. What am I looking forward to?”
Han Li wondered if he was getting carried away. After capturing Lu Tianxiang and abducting Jiang Baiye, he had a considerable longing for such events.
Upon seeing the dragon girl, Han Li’s first thought was not “how high is her cultivation, or how powerful was she in her past life,” but “how great would it be to have the dragon girl as my Dao companion at home. A reincarnation of a Saint, her aptitude must be at least First Grade, right?”
This was also a shortcut; as long as these females with high aptitudes and cultivation bore him offspring, there was a high probability they would inherit their original talents.
The higher the child’s aptitude, not only could he receive new grade rewards, but also a large amount of aptitude feedback.
Now, his Fourth Grade aptitude was only at 11%, and typically, it would be nearly impossible to advance to Third Grade in a short period.
An offspring of Fourth Grade aptitude could only increase his own aptitude by one-tenth, while an offspring with Third Grade aptitude could increase it by one-third.
If it was below Fourth Grade, the increase would be even less, requiring accumulation in quantity, and there were very few cherished wives and beautiful concubines capable of producing offspring above Fifth Grade, such as Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin, among others.
He and Jiang Baiye both had Fourth Grade aptitude, and four to five months later when Jiang Baiye’s child would be born, it was highly likely to also be Fourth Grade, enhancing the aptitude by one-tenth.
However, if he could capture a True Martial Realm female cultivator, or the dragon girl, so long as they bore Han Li offspring, the aptitude would generally be high, with Third Grade, Second Grade, or even First Grade being possible.
If he could capture the dragon girl and she bore a child, he would immediately advance to Third Grade with a Second Grade aptitude, and if it was a First Grade aptitude, he might even leap straight to Second Grade. It would be exhilarating.
Reaching Third Grade or Second Grade aptitude would significantly reduce the cultivation needed to advance to True Martial Realm, and then he’d truly soar to new heights.
Of course, Han Li was only musing. He felt the chances of capturing the dragon girl to be his Dao companion were slim, given her formidable strength.
Leizhou’s combat ability was such that he only dared to weigh his chances, and in a direct confrontation, he felt somewhat outmatched: his defense was too weak, while the Dragon Girl’s attacks were too powerful, and her speed was not necessarily slower than his.
As a reincarnation of a Saint, the Dragon Girl had a profound foundation and undoubtedly held numerous trump cards; at her peak state, Leizhou could only “watch from a safe distance without defiling”.
If, unluckily, the Dragon Girl were injured, and the injuries were quite severe, leading to a significant decrease in her strength, only then would Leizhou consider taking action.
Leizhou felt that the current priority was to see if there were any female cultivators among those fighting for the Sacred Dragon Dragon Ball in the True Martial Realm. His first target was to take advantage of the situation and capture a True Martial Realm female cultivator; as for the Dragon Girl, he would play it by ear, and if there was no opportunity, he absolutely must not be reckless.
Leizhou, above the ninth heaven.
After meticulously investigating for several months, the Dragon Girl finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Within a radius of millions of miles, all the hidden True Martial Realm cultivators had been discovered by the Dragon Girl; they were basically all in the early stages of the True Martial Realm, with no old monsters among them.
The number of True Martial Realm cultivators in the Xuan Domain was already few, and those who had cultivated to the late stages or the peak of the True Martial Realm were even rarer—only two or three individuals, and Long Yue was aware of all of them, without having noticed their presence.
As for those from outside domains, as long as they weren’t from a Sacred Land, even if they were at the late stages or peak of the True Martial Realm, it was very difficult for them to know about the emergence of her Dragon Ball.
Those True Martial Realm early stage Emperors Wu were not fools; they would not spread the news recklessly. Otherwise, once the late-stage or peak True Martial Realm Emperors Wu came, they would have no chance to compete, the gap in strength was too big, not even a chance to muddy the waters.
Long Yue had also confirmed that no Divine Yuan Realm War Emperors were lurking around; there are so few in the Qianyuan Divine Province, and Long Yue specifically paid attention to their whereabouts, none having come to the Xuan Domain.
That suspiciously Divine Yuan Realm-level ancestor of the Ancient Empire had not emerged from seclusion and was unlikely to intervene rashly anymore.
During this time, Long Yue had also been pondering why that Great Saint had disposed of her in such a way; without the Great Saint sparing her life, she would have had no chance for reincarnation and rebirth.
The Great Saint is a term of respect for cultivators at the peak of the Saint Abyss Realm; their power reaches the heavens and penetrates the earth, infinite in their might.
Long Yue, at that time, had only recently advanced to the Saint Abyss Realm and had yet to fully grasp the mysteries of this realm, still cultivating some powerful Saint Abyss Realm martial techniques.
In the Cultivation Realm, cultivation techniques, martial techniques, and weapons are classified into Yellow Rank, Profound Rank, Earth Rank, and Heaven Rank, and each rank is further divided into Lower Grade, Mid-Grade, Top Grade, and Supreme Grade.
Earth-Level Lower Rank and Mid-Grade correspond to the Hollow Void Stage, Earth-Level Top Grade and Supreme Grade correspond to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, Heaven Rank Lower Grade and Mid-Grade correspond to the True Martial Realm, and Heaven Rank Top Grade and Supreme Grade correspond to the Divine Yuan Realm.
After the ancient times, very few cultivators knew that above the Heaven Rank there was the Divine Rank. Cultivation techniques that could be called divine arts, martial techniques known as divine techniques, weapons referred to as Divine Weapons, as well as Divine Medicine, Divine Pills, and so on.
Divine Rank is also divided into Lower Grade, Mid-Grade, Top Grade, and Supreme Grade, with Divine Rank Lower Grade and Mid-Grade corresponding to the Tongxuan Realm, and Divine Rank Top Grade and Supreme Grade corresponding to the Saint Abyss Realm.
Long Yue had mastered quite a few Divine Rank Mid- and Lower Grade martial techniques, and she had also cultivated two or three Divine Rank Top Grade techniques, though her mastery was not deep.
Now, only at the third layer of the True Martial Realm, she couldn’t even use the Divine Rank Top Grade techniques, let alone many of the Divine Rank Mid- and Lower Grade ones.
Divine Rank martial techniques consumed a vast amount of energy, and though the True Martial Realm’s True Yuan was as vast as the sea, it could only sustain a few moves.
However, Long Yue felt that it was enough; even if she could only utilize the Divine Rank Lower Grade martial techniques, they could elevate her combat ability to an extremely high level.
After reincarnation, she had the cultivation experience from her previous life, and she progressed rapidly in re-cultivating some Divine Rank martial techniques to perfection, to keep as trump cards.
“Huff~”
After one final sweep of the area, Long Yue exhaled, her figure flashed, and she instantly appeared above Yingyuan Mountain. With delicate fingers forming seals, she executed several intricate and mysterious incantations, opening the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
PS: I suddenly discovered that a dark fantasy god I really liked, ‘Nì Cāng Tiān’, has returned. His Killing Gods was a classic, which I used to stay up late to read.
Although Nì Dà does not know me, I still want to promote his book for him; his new book “Purgatory Tribulation” is approaching a hundred thousand words. Brothers who like Killing Gods, enjoy the Spirit Realm, and like Nì Dà, can go and support him.
Lastly, I hope Nì Dà’s new book explodes in popularity, returning him to his godly status, and reaching the pinnacle of platinum certification.

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 142: The Majesty of the Dragon Girl, Suppressing Seven Great Emperor Wus with One Hand!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 142: The Majesty of the Dragon Girl, Suppressing Seven Great Emperor Wus with One Hand!_1
Translator: 549690339
Whoosh~
Whoosh~
When Long Yue appeared, some formidable warriors who had been closely watching Yingyuan Mountain immediately made their move, converging from all directions at extreme speeds toward Yingyuan Mountain.
One second they were millions of miles away, the next they were just tens of thousands of miles away, arriving at Yingyuan Mountain in just a few seconds.
At that moment, the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm opened, and Long Yue’s figure darted in. At the same time, with a gentle sweep of her bare hand, she lightly slapped toward the space behind her.
A giant palm print instantly materialized, growing larger and larger, with earth, water, wind, and fire evolving beneath it, darkening the sky and covering a vast expanse of the heavens, permeated by a terrifying mighty presence.
“Not good!”
The many True Martial Realm Emperors who wanted to follow into the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm behind her had a sudden change of expression. They all struck out simultaneously, whether with fists or palms, weapons or… putting all their strength into their attacks, they struck at the gigantic palm print that blocked out the sky.
Boom, boom, boom!
Cataclysmic booms spread across millions of miles nearby. The giant palm was torn apart, the earth, water, wind, and fire were obliterated, and the entrance to the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm was exposed, as it began to close rapidly.
Prince Wu’an, Kurong Kong, and other True Martial Realm Emperors rushed in fiercely. Half a breath later, the entrance to the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm closed.
At this moment, two or three strong waves of Spiritual Sense swept through the area, silently observing. There were actually True Martial Realm Emperors lurking about, not entering the Secret Territory but seemingly intending to ambush.
These two or three True Martial Realm Emperors became aware of each other, but none made a sound. With a tacit understanding, they prepared to lie in wait, ready to harshly strike the first strong warriors to emerge from the Secret Territory.
Inside the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
The Secret Territory was vast, spanning millions of miles. It contained mountains, rivers, vegetation—all sorts; even light and rain were present, resembling a real world, yet devoid of any living beings.
A great battle, brief but intense, shattered landscapes for tens of thousands of miles. Everywhere were huge pits and fissures, several towering mountains were blasted apart, rocks scattered, and the atmosphere was dense with tension to the extreme.
In the center of the Secret Territory,
There was a fist-sized bead, neither gold nor jade, displaying a prismatic array of colors, shining like a sun hanging in the sky, with myriad rays of light and thousands of auspicious patterns, emitting a serene and auspicious aura.
A flood dragon twirled and danced around it. It was covered in scales, with whiskered horns on its head, and five claws. This dragon seemed to be both illusionary and shadowy, likely a phantom.
Beneath the Dragon Ball and the flood dragon stood a figure in a colorful light skirt, looking up at the sky, a faint smile emerging on her pretty face.
Surrounded by many True Martial Realm Emperors, she remained utterly calm and composed, treating these Emperors as nothing, her delicate hand reaching out as if to touch the Dragon Ball.
“Stop!”
Seven shouts rang out in unison, glaring furiously at Long Yue, their auras surging to the sky, firmly locking onto that figure.
From left to right, they were:
Kurong Kong from Kurong Sect, holding a string of Buddha Beads in his hand, continuously rotating them, with the Buddha’s light shining upon all;
An old man in hempen robes from the Mysterious Forces of Chaotic Domain, his face concealed, identity hidden, with a Heaven Rank saber suspended above his head, its light cleaving the sky;
Prince Wu’an of Da Qian, with blood at the corner of his mouth, holding a polearm in his hand, pointing diagonally at the Dragon Maiden, his wild and domineering true intent sweeping the heavens;
The Hierarch of Yinyang Sect, in a billowing red dress, below his feet a red lotus phantom emerged, a Longsword hanging at his waist, exuding a sinister and unruly aura;
The Demon Queen from Demon Domain, wearing a light blue dress, enchanting and wild, with the phantom of a light blue giant serpent emerging behind her, the serpent hissing while staring at the Dragon Ball;
An old True Martial Realm ancestor from Da Jing Dynasty, clad in a purple robe, with white hair and beard, his face imposing, hands clasped behind his back, unarmed;
The last one was cloaked in black, face masked, also concealing his identity, carrying a large spear, drawing the attention of the other Emperors.
The seven True Martial Realm Emperors were overwhelmingly powerful, their martial intent converging and pressing down on Long Yue, with a momentum akin to toppling mountains and overturning seas, puissant and enveloping.
They were slightly later than the Dragon Maiden in entering. Upon entering, they saw that the Dragon Maiden was already approaching the central Dragon Ball and immediately employed various methods, attacking the Dragon Maiden to stop her from advancing further.
An intense battle unfolded, but the Dragon Maiden’s strength took them by surprise. The seven True Martial Realm Emperors combined were no match for her. She was able to hold them off with just one hand.
The weakest of them, Prince Wu’an, was directly struck to the point of coughing up blood. The Demon Queen and two or three other True Martial Realm rank one combatants also sustained minor injuries, while the rest of the True Martial Realm Emperors were relatively unscathed.
They couldn’t stop the Dragon Maiden at all; she flew directly beneath the Dragon Ball, and the seven True Martial Realm Emperors temporarily ceased their attacks, confronting the Dragon Maiden.
Several shouts rang out, but the Dragon Maiden turned a deaf ear, her jade hand beckoning gently. The Dragon Ball in the sky trembled at once, emitting a dragon’s roar, and then began falling toward the Dragon Maiden.
As the Dragon Ball fell, the circling flood dragon also shrank in size and finally flew into the Dragon Ball, leaving behind a dragon’s engraving upon it.
“Kill!”
Witnessing this scene, some True Martial Realm Emperors could no longer restrain themselves and once again made their move. Different martial arts techniques bombarded towards her, intending to disrupt the Dragon Ball’s descent.
Prince Wu’an took the lead, his polearm swinging several times in the blink of an eye. Chains of wind and fire dragons swept across, possessing the might to annihilate mountains and rivers.
The Hierarch of Yinyang Sect drew his sword from his waist and slashed from afar. A red lotus tore through space, the Sword Intent split the heavens, the sword light dazzled the world, and with a bittersweet longing, it was unexpectedly the first to arrive.
Kurong Kong raised his Buddha Beads, and a beam of Buddha’s light shone forth, life and death alternating within its radiance. Its might was surprisingly even stronger than that of Prince Wu’an and the Hierarch of Yinyang Sect.
The Demon Queen, the old True Martial Realm ancestor from Da Jing, the black-clad Emperor, and the old man in hempen robes all made their moves, showing off a variety of Heaven Rank martial arts techniques, powerful beyond compare.
The Dragon Maiden did not even glance their way, her right hand still raised, waiting for the Dragon Ball to descend. Her left hand, however, formed a fist seal that glowed bright, with lightning flashing and thunder rumbling, and thousands of paths of lightning illuminated the area.

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 142: The Majesty of the Dragon Girl, Suppressing Seven Great Emperor Wus with One Hand!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 142: The Majesty of the Dragon Girl, Suppressing Seven Great Emperor Wus with One Hand!_2
Translator: 549690339
Sword Intent Red Lotus, streaks of wind and fire dragons, dual phase of decay and prosperity’s Buddha light… Various attacks collided with the lightning fists, causing great explosions between heaven and earth. The ripples of destruction radiated in all directions, slicing all the mountains evenly in half.
To the horror of the kings, the lightning fists were unmatched, erasing all their attacks and continuing to pummel toward them with immense might.
The kings did not take the hits head-on, quickly dodging out of the way and then launching more attacks. They were determined to prevent the Dragon Maiden from obtaining the Dragon Ball and rushed her from every direction, palms thrusting, swords swinging, blades drawing, fists flying… an endless barrage of attacks.
Following the fists, Long Yue brought her left index and middle fingers together, and with horizontal slashes, trails of sword light ripped through the air. Her Sword Intent was resplendent, creating and destroying the heavens and earth, shattering all the kings’ attacks and keeping them at bay, not allowing them to approach within a hundred thousand miles.
The kings charged again and again, each time to no avail. The Dragon Maiden blocked them single-handedly, consecutively using several overpowering martial techniques. Each technique possessed peerless power, sending tremors of fear through their souls.
Under the watchful eyes of the kings, the Dragon Ball finally descended, landing in the Dragon Maiden’s soft, boneless jade hand, once again letting out a heaven-shaking dragon’s roar.
“This is bad.”
Prince Wu’an, Sect Hierarch of the Yinyang Sect, the elder in hemp clothes, Kurong Kong, and several other True Martial Realm monarchs’ expressions changed.
The Demon King furrowed her brows, the expression of the black-clothed Emperor Wu was indecipherable, and the old ancestor from Da Jing in the True Martial Realm was expressionless.
Although the seven monarchs had joined forces due to the overwhelming strength of the Dragon Maiden, they each harbored their own thoughts and had different goals. Some appeared to be attacking the Dragon Maiden but in fact were not putting in their full effort.
Yet, it was also evident how fearsome the Dragon Maiden was. With just one hand, she blocked the seven True Martial Realm monarchs and even injured several, with Prince Wu’an sustaining the heaviest wounds.
“You can get lost now.”
After examining the Dragon Ball carefully, a smile finally appeared on the proud and peerless face of Long Yue. Nonchalantly pocketing the Dragon Ball, she then turned and spoke, her tone indifferent but extremely domineering.
“Li Yue, hand over the Dragon Ball, or else…”
Prince Wu’an bellowed, his eyes nearly bursting with rage. That was the Dragon Ball he was determined to have, a matter concerning his cultivation path.
“Or else kill me? With just you few pieces of trash? You can’t even block one of my hands, yet you have the audacity to bark at me.” Long Yue spoke with a dismissive tone, her gaze icy cold, not considering the seven True Martial Realm monarchs worth a glance.
Although there were seven True Martial Realm monarchs here, they were all early-stage, two at the third level, two at the second level, and three at the first level of the True Martial Realm.
It was only the attack of the old monk and the black-clothed Emperor Wu that posed a threat to her. The rest, in Long Yue’s eyes, were as insignificant as chickens and dogs, utterly worthless.
Besides, this group was discordant in heart and mind. With such a situation and their hidden agendas, how could they contend with her?
If they had truly united and exerted their full strength, although they would not be able to defeat her, they could at least add a bit of pressure to her.
“Boom!”
Upon hearing her words, Prince Wu’an’s face turned crimson with rage. He swung his great halberd as the essence of martial truth swarmed toward it, forming a thousand-foot dragon that tore through the sky, pulverizing everything in its path.
This strike, which drained two-tenths of his True Yuan, was one of his strongest moves. Prince Wu’an retaliated against the Dragon Maiden with action.
To be called trash and accused of yapping like a dog was something Prince Wu’an could not tolerate. Elevated to high status, who dared to speak to him this way?
“Cricket.”
Long Yue flicked her finger, and a divine light burst forth, annihilating the thousand-foot dragon and striking Prince Wu’an with stupendous force, catapulting him tens of thousands of miles away into the ground, creating a massive crater.
Within the crater, Prince Wu’an’s battle armor was in tatters, his aura diminished. He circulated his cultivation technique to heal, struggling to rise, and then flew back to join the other six monarchs in forming an encirclement.
The Demon King and the Sect Hierarch of the Yinyang Sect both showed shock on their faces upon seeing this but did not come to his aid. It was a fact that they could not defeat the Dragon Maiden even by joining forces. This was something they could accept, after all, the Dragon Maiden was the reincarnation of an ancient saint.
Prince Wu’an brought this upon himself with his bluster and reckless behavior, deserving the heavy blow dealt by the Dragon Maiden.
When they saw Prince Wu’an seriously injured, the old ancestor from Da Jing and the elder in hemp clothes almost couldn’t resist the urge to deliver a finishing blow but ultimately held back.
They knew it was not yet the time. Another True Martial Realm old ancestor of Da Qian was still hidden. They couldn’t kill Prince Wu’an just yet without prematurely exposing their intentions.
“Do I need to repeat myself?”
Watching the seven True Martial Realm monarchs still refusing to retreat, Long Yue frowned.
In her previous life, with her personality, she wouldn’t have wasted a word. Anyone who coveted her treasures would be directly met with force, utterly annihilated.
And now, she only wanted to take the Dragon Ball and leave, not wishing to get entangled with these Emperors Wu from the True Martial Realm. Although she was powerful, killing these martial kings wouldn’t be easy.
Once they were driven into a corner, this group of martial kings wouldn’t hold back any longer and would join forces to counter her, deploying all kinds of trump cards.
In doing so, she might get injured.
Long Yue knew the matter was far from over; the Emperors Wu of the True Martial Realm she had detected were not the only ones, and there were several mid-stage True Martial Realm martial kings lurking outside the Secret Territory for sure.
She had to conserve her strength to cope with various contingencies.
“Li Yue, I don’t care who you were in your previous life, today you must leave behind the Dragon Ball,” the Sect Hierarch of Yinyang Sect said coldly.
“Do you all think the same?”
Long Yue’s tone was indifferent, laced with a hint of murderous intent. She had intended to give these people a way out, but if they insisted on courting death, she would not be polite.
“Leave the Dragon Ball, go.”
Prince Wu’an had just consumed and refined several precious elixirs, and his complexion had finally improved significantly, his expression one of wariness, devoid of his former arrogance.
“Benefactor Li, this Dragon Ball is fated with our Buddhist Sect. If you offer up the Dragon Ball, the Bodhisattva is willing to guide you to become a protector heavenly king in our Buddhist Sect,” Kurong Kong said with one hand erect in front of his chest, his tone sincere.
The Demon Queen, the old ancestor of Da Jing’s True Martial Realm, the hemp-robed elder, and the black-robed martial king didn’t speak, but their faces twitched simultaneously, deeply feeling the shamelessness of the bald Kurong.
Bullshit about being fated with the Buddhist Sect!
They didn’t just want the Dragon Girl to voluntarily offer up the Dragon Ball, but they also wanted to convert the Dragon Girl into a protector heavenly king for the Buddhist Sect—it seemed they had no shame at all.
“As shameless as ever, bald donkey!”
A flicker of anger crossed Long Yue’s eyes. With a single hand pushing forward, a giant hand large enough to obscure the sky materialized, with the earth, water, wind, and fire evolving, ready to crush Kurong Kong.
The Demon Queen, the hemp-robed elder, and other martial kings hastily scrambled aside. The Sect Hierarch of Yinyang Sect hesitated before he, too, refrained from offering aid, and even Prince Wu’an had made himself scarce early on.
A resigned look flitted across Kurong Kong’s eyes. He let out a sigh, quickly formed several seals with his hands, and then slammed his right hand forward with force.
The Colorless Handprint!
This was a secret technique of the Buddhist Sect, created by an Arhat of the Divine Yuan Realm, imbued with the true essence of “form is emptiness, and emptiness is form.”
The giant handprint struck against the hand large enough to obscure the sky; beneath the handprint, all was void, and within the palm, creation and destruction converged, evolving into a myriad of forms, unleashing boundless attacks.
The Colorless Handprint collided with the hand that obscured the sky, and the Secret Territory was suddenly engulfed in a white expanse, then plunged into darkness, alternating between light and dark several times in the span of an instant.
The next moment, Kurong Kong’s expression shifted slightly. The True Elixir within him erupted, causing his aura to surge dramatically. With his right hand clenched into a fist and his left finger pointing out, he resorted to two distinct Buddhist secret techniques to just barely disintegrate the hand obscuring the sky.
“Such strength, bald donkey.”
The Demon Queen, the black-robed martial king, and the other True Martial Realm martial kings harbored the same thought, growing warier of Kurong Kong.
Just as Long Yue was about to continue her assault, a resounding voice filled the air.
“Fellow daoists, we have all come for the Dragon Ball. I ask that no one holds back. United, we should be able to seize the Dragon Ball and then rely on our own abilities to compete for it,” said Emperor Chu Wuji, clad in Silver Battle Armor, who appeared beside Prince Wu’an.
Prince Wu’an carried a treasured artifact with him that could briefly encompass living beings and conceal their auras. Chu Wuji had witnessed everything from within, knowing they could no longer hide.
The Dragon Girl was too formidable. Given their disunity and lack of strength, they could very well be scared off by her directly.
“Words of wisdom, Daoist Chu,”
Kurong Kong immediately agreed, and a slightly hunchbacked figure appeared beside him—it was Tuoshan Kong.
The Demon Queen’s expression subtly changed, the black-robed martial king, the hemp-robed elder, the Sect Hierarch of Yinyang Sect, and even the True Martial Realm old ancestor from Da Jing wore impassive faces as if they had anticipated this.
PS: The writing is a bit slow today, with only three chapters. The third update will be around 11:30 PM.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 143: A Turn of Events! Da Qian Encircled on All Sides! The Ancestor Opens Another Vestige_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 143: A Turn of Events! Da Qian Encircled on All Sides! The Ancestor Opens Another Vestige_1
Translator: 549690339
At this moment, the Daqian Empire was amidst a shocking and massive upheaval.
After multiple cultivators from the True Martial Realm, led by Emperor Wu, stormed into the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, the long-brewing storm officially began.
Within Fengbo Pavilion, with a single command from Lu Wenyuan, many secret forces that had pledged allegiance to Fengbo Pavilion openly rebelled. They raised the banner of revolt, declaring that Da Qian was unjust, cruel, and inhumane, causing the people within the empire to live in hardship and dire straits…
These forces heaped accusations upon the Daqian Empire, then swept across various provinces, attacking the provincial capitals, causing shock and alarm throughout the realm as the Daqian Empire was plunged into turmoil.
On another front, the Taiping Empire, which had been amassing troops for years, upon receiving the news, also marched southward. In a very short amount of time, they breached the frontier passes, threatening Sanzhou to the north of Da Qian. Some powers, believing that Da Qian was beyond salvation, began to defect to the Taiping Empire.
On the western front, the Buddhist soldiers from Kurong Sect poured out from ten major cities, splitting into three forces to attack the three western provinces of Da Qian. The military governors of the three provinces hurriedly coordinated the provincial and prefectural armies to respond to the battle.
In the south, a vast army of demons, led by the three Elders of the Yinyang Sect, stormed through the defenses of Leizhou at lightning speed, bursting into the province of Leizhou with the intention of seizing the three southern provinces.
In a short time, the Daqian Empire was beset on all sides, with formidable enemies invading from the east, south, west, and north. Da Qian was suddenly caught in the midst of turbulence and chaos.
Yuanzhou, Capital City.
Emperor Qian convened an emergency meeting, attended by the backbone of the nation, including himself and the State Preceptor, each with a grim expression.
In Chao Tian Hall, the State Preceptor, Mentor, Prime Minister, Champion Duke, Great General, Prophet, Head Supervisor, and others had all arrived. Emperor Qian glanced at them and said in a grave voice,
“My dear ministers, what is the situation now? Can someone give me a detailed report?”
A cloud of gloom hung over Emperor Qian’s face, and his voice was chillingly cold.
He was completely baffled by this series of developments.
Just half an hour ago, Da Qian was a peaceful empire, with singing and dancing, prosperity and glory, and far-reaching influence.
Half an hour later, Da Qian had become chaotic and unstable, with enemies encroaching from all sides and various powers invading; rebels rose within, aiming to overthrow Da Qian’s rule.
In just half an hour, Da Qian’s internal and external troubles had completely erupted, placing the rule of the Daqian Empire in grave danger.
If not dealt with promptly and effectively, the Daqian Empire would not be far from collapse.
Emperor Qian was very angry and tremendously raged, feeling that these senior ministers were utterly incompetent.
They had anticipated the threats from the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and Taiping Empire, and had made preparations, but they were caught off guard by the sudden rebellion in several eastern provinces and the revolt of the major powers.
Emperor Qian could see at a glance that this was undoubtedly the handiwork of the previous Mysterious Forces.
The Daqian Empire also had defenses against that Mysterious Forces, but so far, they had no clues at all; it was extremely well-hidden.
This Mysterious Forces, able to persuade so many powers, must have been plotting for a long time. Yet, the Daqian Empire received no intelligence whatsoever. Wasn’t this sheer incompetence?
If they had known earlier, Da Qian would have been prepared and not so passive.
Faced with the covetous stares of the three major powers—Kurong Sect, Yinyang Sect, and Taiping Empire—Da Qian’s strength was already insufficient. The plans they had made were mainly about how to resist the invasions from the three major powers.
But the rebellion of several eastern provinces, with the support and incitement of the Mysterious Forces behind them, meant Da Qian had no excess strength to suppress them.
If they dispatched troops to forcibly quell the rebellion in the east, their forces in the other directions would be further weakened and utterly incapable of resistance.
After a low discussion among the senior ministers, the Mentor took a step forward and said in a deep voice, “Your Majesty, although the situation is dire, we, Da Qian, still have the strength to fight.”
“Oh? I would like to hear the details,” said Emperor Qian, expressionless.
“Now, Da Qian appears to be in grave danger, but it is only superficial. We had already anticipated the potential invasions from Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and Taiping Empire and are prepared for them. We can hold them off for the time being.”
“The urgent task at hand is to quell the rebellions in Hanzhou, Jingzhou, and Jinzhou. Once the rebellious forces are suppressed, the internal threat will naturally be removed, allowing us to fully confront the invasions from the three major powers,” narrated the Mentor of Daqian at a moderate pace.
Emperor Qian nodded slightly, as if he agreed with the Mentor’s opinion.
The Daqian Empire consisted of eighteen provinces, with three provinces in each of the four cardinal directions. Every three provinces were overseen by a governor of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, while the remaining six provinces made up the core of Da Qian.
These six provinces were Jizhou, Luzhou, Yuanzhou; Changzhou, Yuanzhou, and Tangzhou, with Yuanzhou being the heart of the Daqian Empire.
All of the core forces of the Daqian Empire were concentrated in Yuanzhou. The Yinyang Sect, the Taiping Empire, and the Kurong Sect would take time to attack, but the rebellion in the three eastern provinces was of the utmost importance.
Only Tangzhou was between Yuanzhou and the three eastern provinces. If the rebellion was not suppressed in time and the Mysterious Forces manipulated the rebels to kill their way into Tangzhou, then Yuanzhou would be in danger.
“The Mentor may continue,” Emperor Qian said.
“The forces in the three eastern provinces have been bewitched by the Mysterious Forces, rebelling against our great Da Qian, and attempting to attack the provincial capitals. Their crimes deserve death.”
“At present, we need to ascertain which powers have rebelled in the three provinces and which are still observing. We must stabilize the observing powers, and enlist the ones on our side to suppress the rebellious forces.”
“Among the rebellious powers, those willing to realign themselves with our great Da Qian can be temporarily accepted; we can settle accounts after the autumn harvest. However, those steadfast in the Mysterious Forces’ camp must be struck with thunderous force and be swiftly eradicated.”
“Only then can we reassure the people, stabilize all families, sects, and cultivators in the three provinces, give them confidence, and let them know that our Daqian Empire will not fall. This will also stabilize the imperial situation and boost the morale of Da Qian, allowing the Twelve Provinces to resist vigorously, buying us more time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 143: A Turn of Events! Da Qian Encircled on All Sides! The Ancestor Opens Another Vestige_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 143: A Turn of Events! Da Qian Encircled on All Sides! The Ancestor Opens Another Vestige_2
Translator: 549690339
“The four major powers dared to brazenly provoke a fight and launch an invasion because the combat ability of the Daqian Empire’s True Martial Realm experts had all entered the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, leaving no one to suppress the situation,”
“These powers also have True Martial Realm experts among them, and I fear they’re not just trying to fight over the Dragon Ball but also aim to… completely eliminate Prince Wu’an and the retired Emperor, cutting off Daqian’s strongest combat force. Then, Daqian will truly have no power to resist.”
“If there were an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm from our Daqian to take charge of the overall situation, I believe it would cause all parties to hesitate greatly, buying us more time until the retired Emperor and Prince Wu’an emerge from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.”
“By then, with the Daqian Empire having three True Martial Realm combat abilities, Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and the Ancient Empire would not dare to make any rash moves, and we could quickly counter-attack.”
After the Grand Preceptor finished speaking, he looked toward Emperor Qian, seemingly hoping to discern something from his face.
The State Preceptor, the Left Chancellor, the Prophet, and other high-ranking officials did the same, for they all knew where the crux of the problem lay.
The Daqian Empire now lacked True Martial Realm combat ability and urgently needed an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm to take control of the overall situation, otherwise, any plan would be useless.
Without the combat ability of the True Martial Realm to preside, who would dare go to the Eastern Three Provinces to suppress the rebellion?
The mysterious forces behind those rebellious powers have an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm. If these Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm go, it would be tantamount to seeking death.
As long as there is still True Martial Realm combat ability in Daqian, Daqian still has a chance. The Eastern Three Provinces could be subdued, and even if the struggle becomes prolonged, the hearts of people in the other fourteen provinces could be stabilized.
The powers in other provinces would not dare to defect easily and would most likely choose to watch and wait, and the preparations they’ve made would be able to resist the three major powers for a while.
As the backbone of the Daqian Empire, the State Preceptor, the Grand Preceptor, the Left Chancellor, and other high-ranking officials were also uncertain whether Daqian still had any True Martial Realm combat abilities hidden.
Apart from Prince Wu’an Chu Hao and the retired Emperor Chu Wuji, they were aware that Daqian still had one elder ancestor in the True Martial Realm.
However, rumor had it that the elder ancestor was over nineteen hundred years old, and whether he was still alive was a mystery to everyone; there had been no news of him for hundreds of years.
Deep down, they all faintly believed that the elder ancestor of Daqian was still alive, otherwise, the retired Emperor and Prince Wu’an would not have entered the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm together, knowing that doing so would leave Daqian in jeopardy.
It was also possible that the elder ancestor had already died, and facing the current situation, the retired Emperor and Prince Wu’an chose to gamble, confident in their chances of seizing the Dragon Ball.
Should they successfully refine the Dragon Ball, their strength would greatly increase in a short time, and in the future, they might even reach the Divine Yuan Realm. At that point, the crisis of the Daqian Empire could be resolved.
The Prophet, the Head Supervisor, the Great General, and others all turned their gaze to Emperor Qian. Only Emperor Qian was privy to such core secrets, and they urgently wanted to know the answer in order to plan their next move.
After pondering for a moment, Emperor Qian finally spoke, “The elder ancestor is indeed still alive.”
Upon hearing this, the State Preceptor, the Grand Preceptor, the Prophet, and others showed joy on their faces, relieved at heart. If the elder ancestor of Daqian was still alive, then there was hope for Daqian.
This elder ancestor had likely reached the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm. Just by standing up, he could stabilize the situation, causing those restless forces within the empire to temporarily halt their ambitions and choose to observe.
“Champion Duke, State Preceptor, head to the Eastern Three Provinces to suppress the rebellion; the Left Chancellor, the Grand Preceptor, the Great General, and others, proceed to situate yourselves in the predetermined locations in the other three regions. You must block the advance of the three major powers and buy time for the retired Emperor and Prince Wu’an,”
“I will immediately go to report to the elder ancestor and ask him to come out of hiding,” Emperor Qian declared solemnly.
“Yes.”
The State Preceptor, the Left Chancellor, and others promptly departed, each feeling much less pressure.
After everyone left, Emperor Qian, facing Grand Internal Manager Cao, said, “The Capital City lacks strength now, and the task of defending it falls on you.”
“Your Majesty, rest assured,” Grand Internal Manager Cao responded respectfully.
Emperor Qian nodded, his figure vanished, and he soon reappeared at the entrance to the core forbidden area of Daqian.
He took out the golden ‘Qian’ metal token, injected Gang Yuan into it, activated the Formation, and quickly entered the passageway.
Walking through the passageway, Emperor Qian felt somewhat apprehensive; in fact, he didn’t know whether the elder ancestor was still alive.
Since his ascension to the throne, he had only been to the forbidden area a few times, and on each visit, he was received by the retired Emperor. The elder ancestor had never opened his eyes or spoken, and the retired Emperor had not informed him of the truth.
But Emperor Qian knew he had to say the elder ancestor was still alive, otherwise those Daqian officials would also lose confidence and have no grounds for assurance.
After all, whether the retired Emperor and Prince Wu’an would emerge alive from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm remained an unknown.
Soon, Emperor Qian exited the passageway and arrived at the entrance of the great hall. Hesitating for a moment, he still entered and stopped three meters away from the elderly man wearing coarse gray linen, with hair as white as a crane’s and skin like chicken skin.
After observing for a while, Emperor Qian cautiously began, “Great Ancestor Zhenxiong, the retired Emperor and my brother have both entered the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm together, their lives and deaths uncertain. Now with the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and the Ancient Empire all launching an invasion, alongside mysterious forces inciting rebellion in the Eastern Three States, Daqian is on the brink of peril.”
“I implore the elder ancestor to make an appearance, to suppress heaven and earth, to stabilize the world, and to fight for the everlasting foundation of our Daqian Empire.”
Having spoken, Emperor Qian bowed deeply and did not rise.
Time ticked by second by second, and Emperor Qian grew increasingly anxious, even a fine sweat appearing on his forehead. As a Great Grandmaster, he should not be exhibiting such a state, but it uncharacteristically occurred.
One breath, three breaths, five breaths, ten breaths…
Emperor Qian’s expression shifted from hopeful to disappointed, and then slowly to despair.
After nearly half a moment, the Elder of Zhenxiong had not responded. Could it be that he had truly passed away?
What was the Daqian Empire to do then?
Five more breaths passed, and just as Emperor Qian was about to succumb to utter despair and turn to leave, the eyelids of the man in grey twitched. Emperor Qian immediately noticed.
“Elder of Zhenxiong, Elder of Zhenxiong…” Emperor Qian called out anxiously, his demeanor becoming agitated. The Elder of Zhenxiong was still alive.
Two more breaths later, the man in grey opened his eyes, divine light shooting forth, and his aura climbed steadily, quickly restoring him to the True Martial Realm.
Emperor Qian felt quite uncomfortable suppressed by that aura, but his face showed an undeniable joy.
“Ah.”
The man in grey sighed, a trace of resignation that was hard to detect flickered in his eyes.
“I heard everything you just said. You go first; I will appear soon,” the man in grey said calmly.
“This will be my last battle for Daqian. I hope Daqian can survive this crisis.”
The man in grey paused and added those words.
Emperor Qian nodded solemnly, his heart heavy, yet he quickly left.
Although the Elder of Zhenxiong was still alive, he was clearly not in good condition. Having been in a closed deathlike state, if he were to engage in a major battle this time, the Elder probably couldn’t withstand it much longer.
Thinking that the Daqian Empire would be short of a True Martial Realm warrior king to suppress heaven and earth, Emperor Qian felt heartache, yet the thought of the empire overcoming this crisis brought him some happiness.
Once Emperor Qian left the core forbidden land, the man in grey became indifferent, but soon his face twisted with rage.
“Damn it, how could that dragon woman be so powerful?”
The thought of his plans being thwarted filled the man in grey with immense irritation, desperately wishing he could tear the dragon woman to pieces.
Emperor Wu’s City, Xuan Domain.
Emperor Wu’s City was an immeasurably large city, even bigger than the Capital of Daqian, gathering countless people of the Human Clan.
At that moment, on top of the walls of Emperor Wu’s City stood a middle-aged man dressed in mysterious yellow battle clothes, tall and majestic, with a commanding presence.
The middle-aged man stood with his hands behind his back looking towards the direction of the Qian Dynasty, murmuring to himself, “The show is starting.”
He showed no intention of intervening, as if he only wished to watch the drama unfold.
The Ancient Empire, Capital City.
Deep within the forbidden grounds of the Imperial Palace, a dignified elder opened his eyes and looked towards Leizhou of the Qian Dynasty, a cryptic expression crossing his features.
“Interesting.”
His eyes seemed capable of piercing through the void, spying the scenes in Leizhou.
After uttering those words, the dignified elder glanced westward and then closed his eyes again.
Daqian, Qingzhou.
Atop a high mountain range, Han Li, dressed in blue, was intently observing the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm in Leizhou, watching Tianxuan Mountain.
Originally, he had planned to wait at Chengsheng Mountain to see if he could pick up a true martial realm female cultivator to take home, but the situation changed in an instant, and the Daqian Empire was now in grave danger.
The Yinyang Sect had invaded Leizhou, steamrolling everything in its path, and Wan Guiyuan, the Commissioner of the Three Provinces, along with Yang Tianxiong, the Supervisor of Jingye Office, were organizing a large army to confront them.
In such circumstances, Tianxuan Mountain could not remain uninvolved; it had to choose a side, or it would face destruction.
Thus, Han Li made a quiet appearance in Qingzhou, of course, after changing his appearance, completely concealing his own aura, ready to act under an alias.
Considering there were still several shrewd old beings guarding Leizhou, Han Li had no desire to join the fray. So, he decided to watch from Qingzhou and be close enough to rush over if necessary.
Han Li planned to act as the situation dictated, both looking to see if there was a chance to rescue Tianxuan Mountain and seeing if he could seize the opportunity to capture a true martial realm female cultivator to become his Dao companion.

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 144: Elder Han is Going to Capture the Female Demon King_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 144: Elder Han is Going to Capture the Female Demon King_1
Translator: 549690339
“Should I sneak an attack on the Yinyang Sect?”
Han Li’s gaze drifted beyond Leizhou, looking toward the territory of the Yinyang Sect.
He knew that the Yinyang Sect’s Sect Hierarch had ventured into the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, leaving the Yinyang Sect’s forces somewhat depleted, making it a prime opportunity for a surprise attack.
He had been eyeing the Devil Princess, Yun Miaoyi, for quite some time now, and this seemed like a good chance to catch her and bring her home.
But after some thought, Han Li decided not to go.
The Daqian Empire had two combatants of the True Martial Realm, and the Yinyang Sect most certainly had the same, who knows what level that other True Martial Realm Emperor Wu was. If it was the late stage of the True Martial Realm, he would just be throwing himself into trouble.
Han Li also didn’t know Yun Miaoyi’s exact location, which could potentially be a wasted trip, and he didn’t have the time to lay in wait at the Yinyang Sect.
With the current turmoil, tension was high, and there was a chance that Tianxuan Mountain could be in real trouble soon, and Han Li didn’t know when the group of True Martial Realm Emperor Wus would emerge from the Secret Territory.
If he missed this opportunity, it would be a classic case of missing the forest for the trees. There would always be a chance to catch Yun Miaoyi, but seizing a female cultivator of the True Martial Realm wasn’t as easy, and this was an excellent opportunity.
He had taken a glance earlier and saw a female cultivator of the True Martial Realm entering the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm; he just hoped that the dragoness in there was powerful enough to seriously injure her, and that this cultivator could last without getting killed by the dragoness.
Han Li glanced at the battlefield in Leizhou and then turned his gaze back to the Capital City of Daqian, curious to see whether the Daqian Empire would be able to withstand this crisis and what measures they had in place.
If they didn’t handle it well, the Daqian Empire would be doomed.
He now greatly appreciated his foresight in relocating to Yuanzhou, which was a very wise decision. With the Daqian Empire under siege on all sides, only the Mid Six Province faced less pressure and was relatively stable.
Leizhou.
As the Yinyang Sect’s army entered Qingyun Manor, the Hehuan Sect immediately emerged as a leader, providing extensive intelligence on the Daqian Empire’s presence in Leizhou.
The Yinyang Sect’s army split into four divisions, starting from Qingyun Manor and marching in four different directions, conquering cities and fortresses effortlessly and causing county and manor cities to surrender at the sight of them, eventually convening at Fengyang Manor.
In a short time, they swept through half of Leizhou, proving to be unstoppable.
If not for Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong leading a large army to set up defenses at Fengyang Manor to block the Yinyang Sect’s forces, they could have taken over the entire Leizhou within a day.
The area had turned into a meat grinder; countless cultivators died every day, with the Daqian Empire suffering the highest casualties but successfully holding back the Yinyang Sect’s forces.
Compared to the Yinyang Sect, the Daqian Empire had a more advantageous military formation, allowing it to maximize the army’s strength.
A military formation of a hundred thousand cultivators led by a Guru in the Void Realm would make even a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm cautious. A single misstep could lead to death.
But if support from Daqian didn’t arrive in time, Wan Guiyuan, Yang Tianxiong, and the others couldn’t hold out for long. Furthermore, besieged on all sides, how much force could Daqian spare to fight against the Yinyang Sect?
All sides were watching and waiting to see if the Daqian Empire could hold out because failure to do so meant annihilation.
The Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and the Da Jing Empire struck like thunder, aiming to occupy as much territory as possible in the shortest time, hoping to annihilate the Daqian Empire outright.
Even if the two True Martial Realm combatants of Daqian returned, they would not be able to turn the tide, as the territories taken by the four great forces would not be easily relinquished.
The Daqian Empire, on the other hand, aimed to sustain with minimal losses until the two True Martial Realm combatants returned. If they successfully acquired the Dragon Ball, all its losses would have been worth it.
Tianxuan Mountain.
Atop Tianxuan Peak, Gongsun Yun continuously gazed in the direction of the battlefield in Leizhou, his expression filled with worry.
The Daqian Empire issued a final ultimatum, decreeing that a decision had to be made within a day. Siding with the Daqian Empire would bring many benefits; choosing neutrality or siding with the enemy, however, would lead to Daqian wiping out Tianxuan Mountain first.
Not just Tianxuan Mountain, but also the Sects and families within Leizhou faced the same pressure; the Daqian Empire wanted to stabilize internally first and concentrate its strength to oppose the Yinyang Sect. The forces in Qingzhou and Huozhou were given a bit more leeway, with two days to decide.
“There is no escaping it in the end,” sighed Gongsun Yun.
After such an undercurrent had been building up for so long, the outbreak was torrential and sweeping, with the forces of the front-line Twelve Province unable to stay out of it.
As a branch of the Dao Sect, Tianxuan Mountain couldn’t possibly side with the Yinyang Sect. They had maintained neutrality in ordinary times, but now they had no choice but to side with the Daqian Empire due to their insufficient strength.
Even if Gongsun Yun revealed his strength as a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, he couldn’t protect Tianxuan Mountain, unless a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu appeared there.
Gongsun Yun had already decided to side with the Daqian Empire and reveal his strength as a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, ensuring he could protect the disciples of his Sect as much as possible on the battlefield.
“Little Cloud.”
At that moment, a voice penetrated Tianxuan Mountain’s grand formation and reached Gongsun Yun’s ears.
Gongsun Yun’s pupils contracted sharply as he immediately looked in the direction of the voice, overjoyed. Before he could speak, three figures landed on Tianxuan Peak.
“Hahaha~ I have returned.”
“We’ve made it back just in time.”
“Little Cloud, were you getting anxious?”
Three figures stood beside Gongsun Yun, one middle-aged and two elderly, all seeming quite excited.
“Ancestor.”
Gongsun Yun immediately bowed respectfully, recognizing the three individuals. They were the second, third, and fourth generation Sect Leaders of Tianxuan Mountain.
“Little Cloud, you’ve done very well to cultivate to the Myriad Phenomena Realm. Your cultivation level is close to mine; I indeed made the right choice,” the middle-aged man said as he scrutinized Gongsun Yun closely, clicking his tongue in admiration.

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 144: Elder Han is Going to Capture the Female Demon King_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 144: Elder Han is Going to Capture the Female Demon King_2
Translator: 549690339
These successive Sect Leaders, although only of fifth-grade talent, went to the Tai Xuan Sect and, with the help of the Sect’s resources and better inheritances, they successively broke through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
It is easy to cultivate to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but reaching the True Martial Realm is much more difficult. Although the Tai Xuan Sect also has treasures that can aid in this process, they were not yet qualified to use them.
“Very well,” the second-generation Ancestral Master said.
“Not bad, little Yunzi. With this, our Tianxuan Mountain now has four Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, barely with enough qualification to stay out of the fray,” the third-generation Ancestral Master said in a deliberately casual tone.
“Alas, Master, Elders, you shouldn’t have come back.”
Gongsun Yun sighed. What he wanted were reinforcements at the True Martial Realm, as those at the Myriad Phenomena Realm wouldn’t hold.
He was at the early stage of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, so was the fourth-generation Sect Leader, the third-generation Sect Leader was at the middle stage, and the second-generation Ancestral Master was at the highest level, already at the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. However, he was also over nine hundred years old, so his hopes of breaking through to the True Martial Realm were very slim.
Indeed, four Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm could allow Tianxuan Mountain to stay out of the affairs, and neither the Daqian Empire nor the armies of the Yinyang Sect would dare to do anything to them.
