But as soon as other True Martial Realm combatants from the Yinyang Sect made a move to try to break the stalemate, Tianxuan Mountain would not be able to hold out. Even if the four of them joined forces, they would not be able to withstand a single True Martial Realm Warrior King.
“If we had not come back, Tianxuan Mountain would truly be gone, and the foundation left by our master would have been destroyed,” the second-generation Ancestral Master said indifferently.
The third and fourth generations also nodded in agreement. They had infinite love for Tianxuan Mountain; it was only for the pursuit of higher realms that they went to the Tai Xuan Sect. If Tianxuan Mountain was in trouble, they would definitely come forward.
They also knew that returning was more likely to bring disaster than good fortune, but they still resolutely returned. Who made it so that the higher-ups of the Tai Xuan Sect did not want to intervene?
If a True Martial Realm Warrior King came to take charge, both the Yinyang Sect and the Daqian Empire would have to give face.
They also understood the stance of the Tai Xuan Sect. With many branches of the Sect, it was impossible to send a True Martial Realm Warrior King to every branch in need of support.
The Tai Xuan Sect itself did not possess that many True Martial Realm powerhouses; each one was in deep cultivation, seeking to break through to the Divine Yuan Realm.
Gongsun Yun knew this too; he had not held much hope in his heart from the start. Now the question was whether to continue standing with the Daqian Empire or not?
Gongsun Yun looked towards the three Ancestral Masters. The three of them smiled, and the second-generation Ancestral Master said indifferently, “Little Yunzi, you are now the Sect Leader of Tianxuan Mountain. You should make these decisions yourself.”
The third- and fourth-generation Sect Leaders nodded slightly as whatever decision Gongsun Yun made, they would support him.
The arrival of the three Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm to Tianxuan Mountain was quickly learned by the Daqian Empire and the Yinyang Sect and they had different reactions.
The third Elder of the Yinyang Sect, after a little investigation, found out that these were the successive Sect Leaders of Tianxuan Mountain. He didn’t feel any pressure; Tianxuan Mountain siding with the Daqian Empire couldn’t reverse the overall situation.
He was actually curious about what choice Tianxuan Mountain would make at this moment.
Wan Guiyuan and Yang Tianxiong, on the other hand, were extremely pleased. At this moment, support from the Capital City had not yet arrived. If there were three more Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, their pressure would be significantly reduced, and they could hold out much longer.
Thus, the two immediately sent envoys to Tianxuan Mountain, promising more benefits, hoping to persuade Tianxuan Mountain to stand with the Daqian Empire.
Now that the Daqian Empire was lacking True Martial Realm combat ability, Tianxuan Mountain, with three Great Grandmasters, held considerable weight. The Daqian Empire also didn’t dare to mess with Tianxuan Mountain; they could only seek to entice, not to threaten.
The two or three True Martial Realm Warrior Kings who were waiting outside the Sacred Dragon Secret Territory also noticed the arrival of the three Great Grandmasters in Leizhou but paid them no mind, as their target was the Dragon Ball. They didn’t wish to assist either the Daqian Empire or the Yinyang Sect.
In Qingzhou, Han Li also saw the return of the three Ancestral Masters to Tianxuan Mountain from afar, a look of joy appearing on his face.
With three Great Grandmasters holding fort, Tianxuan Mountain was temporarily secure. If he could find an opportunity to show up under an alias and deter all parties, Tianxuan Mountain could be saved.
“Huh?”
Han Li suddenly detected two unfamiliar and powerful auras within the range of his Spiritual Sense, and in a flash, he teleported over there.
“To think they are two Great Grandmasters at the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.”
Observing the two hidden in the mountain range, Han Li was surprised. Since when did Qingzhou have so many Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm?
After careful investigation, Han Li learned of their origins and received crucial intelligence.
These two were Grandmasters of the Demon Clan, sent by the Demon Emperor and the female Demon King to compete for the Sacred Dragon Ball. However, they did not anticipate that the Dragon Ball would be concealed within a Secret Territory, contended for entirely by True Martial Realm powerhouses, rendering them useless in the struggle.
The Demon Queen instructed them not to show themselves for the time being as this place was protected by a concealing formation, one that even martial arts experts at the early stage of the True Martial Realm could not detect.
However, since the Demon Queen had entered the Secret Territory for quite a while, and considering that the Daqian Empire no longer possessed combat ability at the True Martial Realm, the two demons thought they were strong enough to dominate across Daqian, so they decided to come out and gather some information.
“That True Martial Realm female cultivator is actually the Demon Queen of the Demon Clan,”
Han Li murmured to himself, his expression becoming even more excited.
Capturing a True Martial Realm female Demon Queen was a thrilling prospect; he hadn’t even tasted a demoness before and wondered if this Demon Queen was as succulent as imagined.
After glancing at the two demons, Han Li’s figure vanished without ever being detected from start to finish.
He wasn’t an opponent for the two Demon Clan Grandmasters and didn’t wish to provoke trouble without cause; they had the backing of the entire Demon Clan, an overwhelming force for Han Li.
That Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing might very well be a martial emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm.
Within the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm,
after the former Emperor Qian, Chu Wuji, and the Buddhist Sect’s Tuoshan Kong made their appearance, Long Yue faced two more enemies.
The Yinyang Sect Hierarch, Black-clothed Emperor Wu, and the Demon Queen all showed signs of joy. If the nine True Martial Realm warriors truly cooperated, they might be able to snatch the Dragon Ball from the dragon maiden.
Da Jing’s True Martial Realm elder frowned, though he had anticipated it, the difficulty of his ambush had now increased.
The elderly man in hemp garments had a complex expression. The addition of two more True Martial Realm martial kings greatly increased their chances of obtaining the Dragon Ball, but it also made his attempt to assassinate Chu Hao and Chu Wuji that much more difficult.
Seeing that the crowd seemed ready to act, Chu Wuji continued, “This opportunity is rare. If we nine at the True Martial Realm join forces, even the dragon maiden will not be able to withstand our attacks.”
“Only by injuring the dragon maiden and forcing her to give up the Dragon Ball do we stand a chance. Otherwise, not only will we leave empty-handed, we’ll also incur the dragon maiden’s enmity, even if we don’t manage to seize the Dragon Ball.”
“This dragon maiden’s temper is fierce, and she has a long memory for grudges. Once she takes the Dragon Ball and cultivates to the Divine Yuan Realm, she will definitely seek retribution against all of us here.”
The expressions of the True Martial Realm martial kings shifted slightly as what Chu Wuji said made sense.
Seeing this, Long Yue realized that a safe retreat was impossible, so she took action directly. She launched her Left Hand Lightning Fist and Right Hand Sky-obscuring Seal, striking towards the nine True Martial Realm martial kings.
“Since you seek death, then let this deity grant you your wish,” she declared.
If she could kill one or two True Martial Realm martial kings, their alliance would shatter, allowing her to leave with the Dragon Ball.
Boom!
The nine True Martial Realm experts immediately countered and launched a new attack, engaging in a fierce battle with the dragon maiden in the Secret Territory.
The Demon Queen inwardly lamented; she had only come here to seize an opportunity, but now she had to fight fiercely. Otherwise, she might easily be killed by the dragon maiden.
The elderly man in hemp garments and Da Jing’s True Martial Realm elder both furrowed their brows, having their own plans to assassinate Chu Hao and Chu Wuji but finding no opportunity at the moment, they could only stand against the dragon maiden.
When Chu Hao and Chu Wuji were injured or an opportunity for an ambush arose, they would be ready to strike.
Rumble~
Terrifying power swept in every direction; the Secret Territory’s heavens crumbled, earth reversed, mountains and rivers turned upside down, cosmos inverted, and sun and moon lost their light.
In a one-versus-nine battle against True Martial Realm martial kings, even when surrounded, Long Yue remained composed and at ease, calmly weaving through the battlefield and effortlessly blocking a multitude of attacks.
Thump!
With a gentle slap of Long Yue’s hand, from back to front, she pierced through Tuoshan Kong; then with a punch, she broke the Yinyang Sect Hierarch’s left hand; her palm slice flashed, and Prince Wu’an’s legs were severed; with a single finger, she punctured a blood hole through the Demon Queen’s abdomen, clear from front to back…
Once Long Yue went all out, she absolutely crushed the nine True Martial Realm martial kings. In just a few exchanges, all nine were injured, to varying degrees.
And Long Yue remained unharmed, her attacks either exploding on contact or blocked by her protective aura.
Some weaker True Martial Realm martial kings grew fearful. For example, the Demon Queen thought of retreating; the disparity in strength was just too huge, despite being at the same realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 145: The Great Battle Concludes, Elder Han Takes Action_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 145: The Great Battle Concludes, Elder Han Takes Action_1
Translator: 549690339
Within the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
The nine True Martial Realm warriors that had originally split up to besiege Long Yue had no choice but to gather together, combining their strength to fend off Long Yue’s attacks.
Once Long Yue unleashed her full power, they realized the gap between them was simply too great. Even though their numbers had increased by two True Martial Realm warriors, they were still thoroughly overpowered.
Now each of them was injured, with severed limbs and numerous through-and-through wounds on their abdomens and backs. Even after refining high-grade Healing Pills that regenerated their limbs and healed the pierced areas, their combat abilities had significantly decreased.
In the sky above, Long Yue walked towards the nine True Martial Realm warriors, her target being the exit of the secret territory.
Her overwhelming aura pressed down on them, causing the nine True Martial Realm powerhouses to retreat involuntarily. As far as Long Yue advanced, they retreated just as much, their faces filled with dread.
Long Yue strolled leisurely across the sky, her colorful clothes fluttering, her proud and beautiful face covered in frost. She raised her right hand and threw a punch forward.
Roar!
The sound of a dragon’s roar filled the entire Sacred Dragon Secret Realm. Nine silver dragons, each a thousand zhang in size and radiating a terrifying presence, suddenly appeared out of nowhere, causing Chu Wuji, the Sect Hierarch of Yinyang Sect, the Demon King, and others to change color in fear.
“Kill!”
Chu Wuji, Kurong Kong, and others bellowed as they employed their respective techniques to counter the attack.
Kurong Kong offered up a bowl, which, upon being infused with True Yuan, swelled to an enormous size, radiating Buddha’s light and carrying the idea of withering and flourishing, heading towards the silver dragons as if to capture them.
Chu Wuji took a deep breath, deployed a secret technique, and his aura surged. He also brought out a Bronze Cauldron, which glowed with divine light that illuminated heaven and earth and unleashed immense power, attempting to suppress the silver dragons.
The Yinyang Sect Hierarch also employed a secret technique, drastically increasing his combat ability, and then formed seals with his hands, creating a huge red lotus from thin air. Wisps of flame leapt out, carrying the might to burn the heavens and devour the earth—this was Karmic Fire, capable of incinerating everything.
Tuoshan Kong used the Great Sun Replacement technique, cheating heaven and earth, capturing the essence of the world to merge into his own body and stimulate his potential to the extreme. With a bright heart, he pushed his hands upward, and the phantom of a divine mountain appeared, ten thousand zhang high—it was none other than the legendary Xumi Mountain.
Tuoshan Kong fiercely lifted Xumi Mountain and slammed it forward. The mountain burst forth with boundless Buddha’s light, suppressing everything, colliding with the ten-thousand-zhang silver dragons.
The Demon King, the warrior in black, and Prince Wu’an also deployed their trump cards, wielding powerful Heaven Rank Artifacts, along with exceptionally potent Heaven Rank martial techniques.
They focused completely on resisting Long Yue’s punch, continuously unleashing various martial techniques, their expressions extremely solemn. One misstep could lead to them being killed by this single punch.
Just then, the elder in hemp clothing and the True Martial Realm elder, Da Jing, suddenly made their move without blocking the silver dragons that were targeting them. They disappeared in a flash, seemingly trying to escape, leaving the others to hold off the enemy.
The expressions of the other True Martial Realm powerhouses changed, but before they could react, the elder in hemp clothing and Da Jing, the True Martial Realm elder, simultaneously appeared behind the former Emperor Qian, Chu Wuji, launching a fierce attack.
The two coordinated their assault on Chu Wuji first, given that he was a third-level True Martial Realm warrior with greater strength and needed to be taken out or severely wounded first. Prince Wu’an, only a first-level True Martial Realm in combat ability, was not to be feared.
Da Jing, the True Martial Realm elder, had always been looking for an opportunity, and the elder in hemp clothing was no different. Now that the Dragon Ball was clearly out of reach, they resorted to attacking Chu Wuji. Of the two targets, they had to accomplish at least one.
The elder in hemp clothing was a second-level True Martial Realm warrior, while Da Jing, the True Martial Realm elder, was even a third-level. Both of them launched a sudden, vicious assault at full strength, wielding their respective Heaven Rank Artifacts.
Chu Wuji was busy operating the Bronze Cauldron, fighting with all his might. He and Prince Wu’an were the most eager to seize the Dragon Ball and had been resisting with full force. They had not expected two True Martial Realm warriors to suddenly launch an attack on them.
He couldn’t defend in time; his protective aura was pierced, and two magical treasures struck him hard. Chu Wuji’s Silver Battle Armor shattered, and he was sent flying, his body torn and bloody.
But that was not the end of it. Without his True Yuan to support it, the Bronze Cauldron couldn’t counter the silver dragons, and with a roar, it was sent flying by the dragons, which then surged through the air toward Chu Wuji.
Chu Wuji had no choice but to forcibly suppress his injuries. His Martial True Pill flew out from within him, shining brilliantly and erupting with terrifying power to protect him.
The silver dragon collided with the Martial True Pill, which gave a piteous cry and shattered on the spot. The silver dragon then struck Chu Wuji hard,
Chu Wuji screamed, his body exploding in mid-air, dead beyond any doubt.
Everything happened so fast that several warriors were unable to lend a hand. After blocking Long Yue’s punch, they scattered, not daring to stay grouped together for fear of being ambushed by others.
The Yinyang Sect Hierarch, the Demon King, Kurong Kong, Tuoshan Kong, and the warrior in black all looked simultaneously at the elder in hemp clothing and Da Jing, the True Martial Realm elder, with unfavorable expressions.
They were already having an extremely hard time warding off Long Yue’s assault and had sustained no light injuries. These two suddenly turned traitor and attacked “one of their own,” which enraged them exceedingly. Had they been the ones attacked, it would have been one of them who just died.
The five warriors’ eyes flashed with killing intent, yet they did not make a move. After all, the elder in hemp clothing and Da Jing, the True Martial Realm elder, had not attacked them.
Now that Chu Wuji was dead and they were all wounded, their strength had decreased considerably. The prospects of competing for the Dragon Ball were now hopeless, so they simply did not act and watched coldly from the sidelines.
With Chu Wuji dead, what would Prince Wu’an do? Would he follow in his footsteps?
“Ah, ah, ah~”
Prince Wu’an was furious, wanting to go to Chu Wuji’s aid, but his strength was insufficient. Unable to block the silver dragons, he was struck and sent flying tens of thousands of li.

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 145: The Great Battle Concludes, Elder Han Takes Action_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Chapter 145: The Great Battle Concludes, Elder Han Takes Action_2
Translator: 549690339
Prince Wu’an was already severely injured, but after taking a punch from Long Yue, a large hole appeared in his body, and all his internal organs were gone; he fell directly into a dying state.
Long Yue took everything in with cold eyes, merely sneering without commenting, and continued to step forward.
The Sect Hierarch of the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Kong, the female Demon King, and others of the True Martial Realm watched her warily, not daring to make another move. Being overwhelmed by nine True Martial Realm could only mean death for the five of them if they acted.
As she passed by Prince Wu’an, Long Yue did not strike either; she knew that Prince Wu’an’s fate was sealed. Even if the cloaked elder and the True Martial Realm ancestors from Da Jing spared him, he would not be able to leave the Secret Territory alive.
After a few more steps, Long Yue made a hand gesture, causing the entrance to the Secret Territory to appear again, and she disappeared with a flash.
The Sect Hierarch of the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Kong, the female Demon King, and the others were about to follow her out, but just as they arrived at the entrance to the Secret Territory, a tremendous roaring sound could be heard. There were powerful beings fighting outside, and the aftershocks had reached inside the Secret Territory.
They saw four people fighting outside, where three powerhouses were besieging Long Yue. Their strength was immense, at least at the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm.
Their faces grew even uglier, as it became clear that those three outside were waiting to ambush anyone who obtained the Dragon Ball and emerged first.
If any of them were to be ambushed by three mid-stage True Martial Realm attackers upon exiting, they would be killed on the spot; only someone as strong as Emperor Wu, like the Dragon Maiden, could hold them off.
The five immediately halted, not daring to exit at once. The attacks from the three mid-stage True Martial Realm were targeting the entrance to the Secret Territory, intending to kill the Dragon Maiden. If they went out, they would bear the brunt of the attack, resulting in death or at least severe injury.
The five True Martial Realm figures, although helpless, could only watch helplessly as the entrance to the Secret Territory disappeared. Fortunately, the Secret Territory would not last much longer and would open automatically in at most two years, so they could leave then.
On the other side, as soon as Long Yue had left the Secret Territory, the five True Martial Realm Emperors also left the battlefield, prompting the cloaked elder and the True Martial Realm ancestor from Da Jing to take action.
Whoosh whoosh~
Two figures appeared not far from Prince Wu’an, both looking at him with cold eyes.
“Cough cough~”
Prince Wu’an coughed up blood, wiped it away, and struggled to stand, looking up at the two True Martial Realm Emperors in midair to his left and right, and let out a bitter laugh.
“If I’m not mistaken, the one on the left is Jiang Zhengyang, the former emperor of the Da Jing Dynasty; and the one on the right, although I don’t recognize your martial skills, you must be from the Mysterious Forces behind the White Lotus Cult.”
Chu Wuji was dead, but Prince Wu’an was not very saddened; his eyes showed more of his fury than grief, having guessed the identities of the two men.
Jiang Zhengyang remained expressionless. Although he had concealed his identity, his martial skills and Magical Treasures could not be hidden. It was normal to be recognized.
The cloaked elder sneered. So what if they were recognized? Chu Wuji was dead, and Prince Wu’an would die too. With both True Martial Realm figures dead, the Daqian Dynasty could only be butchered by them.
Moreover, they had been inside for so long, and the situation outside had long changed. By the time they emerged, they would be able to settle the power struggle.
The two did not intend to speak further with Prince Wu’an and moved to attack, assaulting him with killing intent.
“I’ll remember you.”
Prince Wu’an let out a thunderous shout and self-detonated.
Jiang Zhengyang and the cloaked elder wiped away the remnants of Prince Wu’an’s self-explosion, their brows knitted tightly, exchanging a glance, both feeling puzzled.
With Prince Wu’an dead, what was the use of remembering them?
Could it be that Prince Wu’an was not yet dead?
That seemed impossible. Prince Wu’an had just died before their eyes, not even a trace left behind.
The cloaked elder put aside his doubts, looking at Jiang Zhengyang and greeted, “Fellow Daoist Jiang.”
“How may I address this Fellow Daoist?” Jiang Zhengyang inquired.
The downfall of the Qian Dynasty was already inevitable, and he wanted to gather information about this Mysterious Forces, as Da Jing and the Mysterious Forces were about to become competitors.
It was a race to see who could swallow more of the Qian Dynasty’s territory.
The cloaked elder smiled but did not respond. Instead, he turned to look at the five True Martial Realm Emperors standing firm at the entrance to the Secret Territory and said abruptly, “It seems we’ll have to stay in the Secret Territory for a while.”
Jiang Zhengyang’s brows furrowed slightly as he looked over and noticed that the entrance to the Secret Territory had disappeared, with the Sect Hierarch of the Yinyang Sect, the female Demon King, and the others still inside.
A moment ago, they had also faintly heard noises from the outside world, but killing Prince Wu’an had been more important, and they had not paid it any mind.
Whoosh whoosh~
Before Jiang Zhengyang could speak, Kurong Kong, the female Demon King, and the other five True Martial Realm figures approached, eyeing the two men with hostility. Tuoshan Kong spoke with a cold voice:
“Two fellow Daoists, please give us an explanation.”
The mission entrusted by the Bodhisattva had failed, and Tuoshan Kong was in a very foul mood. If the two men did not have a reasonable explanation, he would not mind making a move against them. Now that the dragon maiden had left, nothing could threaten those in the True Martial Realm anymore.
No matter how strong those two were, they would not be able to withstand the joint assault of the five True Martial Realm warriors.
“I came here solely to eradicate Chu Wuji and Chu Hao,” Jiang Zhengyang said indifferently, his tone firm. He too had little regard for the Buddhist monks.
The elder in hemp-robed sneered and said, “The same goes for me.”
Tuoshan Kong’s face showed anger, but in the end, he did not make a move. Their explanations were passable, after all.
Their goal was not to fight for the Dragon Ball. It was normal for them to look for an opportunity to assassinate Chu Hao and Chu Wuji, but their actions were disgusting and disrupted their plans.
The Yinyang Sect Hierarch, the female Demon King, and Emperor Wu clad in black watched Jiang Zhengyang and the elder coldly but said nothing and showed no intention to act.
Even if the two had not attacked Chu Hao and Chu Wuji, they would not have had a chance to snatch the Dragon Ball. On the contrary, the two had given them an opportunity to cease fire. Otherwise, if they had continued fighting, the dragon maiden might have killed them all off.
Yet, they felt no gratitude in their hearts; the conduct of the two was too despicable. What they feared most when joining forces to fight the enemy was a teammate suddenly turning against them, which could easily lead to their demise.
The atmosphere turned icy as the seven True Martial Realm warriors exchanged glances and left to find places to stake out, waiting for the Secret Territory to emerge so they could depart.
Outside the Secret Territory,
Long Yue was in a fierce battle with three mid-stage True Martial Realm warriors. Her pretty face was frosty, utterly cold, and her eyes filled with fury.
She only wanted to retrieve her Dragon Ball. First, she was obstructed by nine True Martial Realm warriors inside the Secret Territory, and then, upon coming out, she was ambushed by another three True Martial Realm warriors.
Luckily, she was prepared and the assassination attempt had failed. Long Yue immediately counterattacked, employing different martial arts techniques with both her hands, battling the three True Martial Realm warriors.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
After a heated fight, Long Yue inflicted severe injuries on a fourth-stage True Martial Realm warrior and light wounds on two fifth-stage warriors.
Just as she was about to press her advantage and annihilate the three on the spot, she suddenly felt a chill in her heart and sensed that powerful beings were spying on the area, at least warriors in the later stages of the True Martial Realm.
Long Yue gave the three warriors a cold look and then vanished. She planned to lay low for a while and wait until she broke through to the Divine Yuan Realm before settling the score.
“Phew~”
The three True Martial Realm warriors exchanged glances, all heaving a sigh of relief as if a heavy burden had been lifted. The pressure the dragon maiden exerted on them was too great; her strength was even more formidable than they had anticipated.
Fortunately, the dragon maiden did not continue to attack and suddenly left. Otherwise, they could indeed have been eradicated today.
Even though they recognized each other’s identities, the three warriors did not communicate further and vanished in a flash, deciding to leave the battlefield far behind.
In Qingzhou, Han Li’s brows were deeply furrowed.
He had been keeping a watchful eye on Yingyuan Mountain, and he noticed the dragon maiden’s appearance immediately. Knowing where the ambush was, he had no thought of alerting her.
Han Li had hoped that the three mid-stage True Martial Realm warriors would seriously injure the dragon maiden, so that he might have a chance, but to his disappointment, his hopes were dashed.
The dragon maiden was incredibly strong, slaughtering her way out of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm apparently unscathed.
After emerging, she was ambushed by three warriors of the True Martial Realm and yet was not injured. Instead, she wounded the three ambushers and left with impunity.
“Such a pity.”
Han Li sighed, his tone filled with regret.
The dragon maiden’s strength was even greater than he had estimated, terrifyingly on par with the later stages of the True Martial Realm. Even if he transformed into the ‘Nine-Second True Man,’ he still wouldn’t be a match for the dragon maiden.
Without the dragon maiden being seriously injured, he had no chance of ambushing and capturing her. He could only watch helplessly as the dragon maiden left.
Fortunately, he had not held much hope. His primary target was not the dragon maiden, after all.
Although only the dragon maiden had left the Secret Territory, Han Li had just seen that there were still five figures at the exit of the Secret Territory, one of them being the female Demon King.
He had ascertained that the female Demon King was only in the first stage of the True Martial Realm. Even if she was unharmed, once she appeared, Han Li dared to attempt capturing her.
“Unable to catch the dragon maiden, I’ll have to make do with capturing the female Demon King first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 146: The Shocking and Outrageous Demonic Fetus Technique! Yun Miaoyi Comes Knocking!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Chapter 146: The Shocking and Outrageous Demonic Fetus Technique! Yun Miaoyi Comes Knocking!_1
Translator: 549690339
Seeing the Dragon Girl flee, Han Li immediately gave up the idea of capturing her; the timing wasn’t right, making it completely impossible to catch her.
He shifted his focus to the Demon Queen, reasoning that he had to capture at least one of them and could not return empty-handed.
With his strength, suppressing a monster queen of the first tier of the True Martial Realm was more than manageable. Once captured, he would be able to refine a new top-tier treasure—something Han Li’s ancestor was famously capable of.
After a final glance at Leizhou, Han Li’s figure disappeared, yet a faint regret lingered in his heart—he truly yearned to ride a dragon.
Now that the Demon Queen and the others of the True Martial Realm were trapped in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm and wouldn’t emerge for another two years, Han Li planned to return to Chengsheng Mountain first and come back to wait for them later.
Rather than waiting here for two years, it would be better to return and take in more concubines, to ‘cultivate’ further with his beloved wives and beautiful concubines.
For the time being, Tianxuan Mountain had no troubles. With the addition of three Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, Gongsun Yun had new plans and did not join the forces of the Daqian Empire, maintaining neutrality instead.
Gongsun Yun was actively motivating the entire sect, planning to relocate Tianxuan Mountain far from Leizhou and even farther from the Daqian Empire.
Gongsun Yun had not entertained this idea before mainly because his strength was not sufficient. Relocating Tianxuan Mountain out of the Daqian Empire without losing many disciples would be difficult.
Now with the return of three forefathers, combined with him, that made four Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and one of the forefathers even revealed an artifact capable of transporting people.
This grand artifact was named the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship, a middle-grade treasure of the Heaven Rank, exchanged from the Tai Xuan Sect at a tremendous cost before the forefathers’ return.
The speed of the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship was extremely fast, comparable to an Emperor Wu at the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm. It had a spatial formation inside, creating a small space, encompassing a hundred miles in radius.
With such a vast space, it was sufficient to relocate all disciples of Tianxuan Mountain, along with key buildings, resources, treasures, and so on.
After returning to Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li called upon Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhirou, Zhou Zhixuan, Chu Yumeng, and Chu Yutong, finding the cultivation of these five concubines too weak, which made him feel a pang of guilt.
So he worked overtime to impart knowledge to them, striving hard to help improve their cultivation, without fearing the hard work or exhaustion.
After the diligent teachings of ancestor Han, the five beautiful concubines were deeply moved. Exhausted from listening to the teachings, drenched in fragrant sweat, they still reciprocated with immense gratitude.
After the teachings, ancestor Han felt refreshed and invigorated, as if he had the sensation of refining a top-tier treasure—five magical treasures combined almost matched that feeling.
Regrettably, there was a minor flaw; the five magical treasures were not a matched set. If they had been part of a series, they could have rivaled a single top-tier treasure.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li stood, contemplating his next move.
He noted that there were still five True Martial Realm practitioners in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, but Prince Wu’an was not among them. As the weakest in power, there was a strong possibility that he had been suppressed by the Dragon Girl.
The Daqian Empire had hidden a True Martial Realm ancestor; it was uncertain whether he went to aid Prince Wu’an in the struggle for the Dragon Ball or if he was one of the five remaining in the realm.
Or had that True Martial Realm ancestor also perished within?
If only Prince Wu’an had died, there would still be one True Martial Realm elder left who might prolong the lifespan of the Daqian Empire for a while, although its territory would undoubtedly need to be considerably reduced.
If that elder perished as well, then the Daqian Empire was indeed finished. Without a True Martial Realm practitioner to fortify it, the Daqian Empire would collapse in a very short time.
With the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, the Da Jing Empire, and Mysterious Forces all invading the Daqian Empire, Han Li was uncertain which power would ultimately take Yuanzhou.
He hoped it would be the Da Jing Empire since the rule of an empire tended to be more stable, which would benefit his well-being and the development of the Han Mansion.
The Kurong Sect was too extreme for Han Li’s liking; he had no interest in worshiping any Buddha. The Yinyang Sect had poor public security, with the possibility of Cultivators of the demon path causing trouble at any moment. The Mysterious Forces were also not an option; he had captured Lu Tianxiang to be his Dao companion, and exposure would mean big trouble.
In Yuanzhou, Capital City.
Within a large hall of the Imperial Palace, a gray-robed elder was seated cross-legged on a cushion.
His presence brought immense confidence to State Preceptors, the Left Chancellor, and other high-ranking officials of the Da Qian Empire. With three True Martial Realm practitioners, they were formidable, even among the Eight Great Forces of Mysterious Region.
“Pu~”
Suddenly, the gray-robed elder spat out a mouthful of blood, his complexion turned pale, and his expression was extremely unpleasant.
His brow furrowed deeply, the dreadful aura seemingly shaking the hall to its foundations, as his icy voice rang out in the chamber.
“Damnable Jiang Zhengyang, that damned beggarly elder!”
“Detestable Dragon Girl!”
Exhaling deeply as if to vent the frustration within, the gray-robed elder’s voice once again filled the room after a long while, murmuring to himself, “What to do now?”
All his plans were thrown into disarray, and now even the Great Qian Dynasty he had founded with his own hands was on the verge of collapse; he was far from resigned to this fate.
Almost no one in the world knew that he was the founding Great Emperor of Da Qian, Chu Dingqian!
Three thousand years ago, Chu Dingqian achieved the True Martial Realm. During the battle between the Da Jing Empire and Kurong Sect, he took advantage of the chaos to cleave away a third of the Da Jing Empire’s territory. This caused the Da Jing Empire to hold a longstanding grudge against Da Qian, viewing it as an arch-enemy and constantly seeking to destroy the Da Qian Empire and reclaim the lost lands.
He single-handedly established the glorious Da Qian Dynasty and over the subsequent centuries, annexed some other forces, setting the borders of the Da Qian Dynasty and becoming a figure of epic proportions.
Five hundred years after founding the Da Qian Dynasty, Chu Dingqian’s life neared its end. Unwilling to succumb to mortality, not yet satiated with life, he yearned to break through to the Divine Yuan Realm, to become an Emperor Wu, and live another three thousand years.

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 146: The Shocking and Outrageous Demonic Fetus Technique! Yun Miaoyi Comes Knocking!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Chapter 146: The Shocking and Outrageous Demonic Fetus Technique! Yun Miaoyi Comes Knocking!_2
Translator: 549690339
But he was merely at the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm, far from reaching the peak, let alone breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm.
Thus, Chu Dingqian entertained other ideas.
Few knew that Chu Dingqian hailed from the Devil Region and was once a Cultivator of the demon path who had slain countless lives.
In the Hollow Void Stage, he had chanced upon a heritage site, where he acquired a great opportunity that allowed him to raise his aptitude from Fourth Grade to Third Grade, rapidly rising to prominence and breaking through to the True Martial Realm.
Within that heritage, Chu Dingqian also acquired an incomplete Devil Cultivation Technique, known as the “Demonic Fetus Technique.”
The grade of the Demonic Fetus Technique was high; even incomplete, it reached the lower rank of the Divine Rank, and Chu Dingqian treasured it as a prized possession.
However, upon deeper research, it left Chu Dingqian vexed and deeply cautious, daring not to practice it and relegated it to the shelves.
Upon cultivating the Demonic Fetus Technique, one could transform a thread of their Divine Spirit essence into a Devil Fetus, hide it in the deepest part of another’s spirit to sleep soundlessly, and continuously consume the host’s essence of the spirit.
Once a certain stage was reached, one could transfer their core spirit into the Devil Fetus, directly supplanting the host to be reborn and live another life.
But this Divine Rank Practice was incomplete, and cultivating it came with great risks, which was why Chu Dingqian dared not practice it.
Implanting the Devil Fetus into the deepest part of another’s spirit was risky; if the host’s spirit was too powerful, the Devil Fetus would be destroyed, the practitioner would suffer backlash, and their Power of the Divine Spirit would be greatly damaged.
The Devil Fetus would nourish the host; if the host grew too quickly before the transfer of the spirit core, like advancing to the True Martial Realm, it would detect the Devil Fetus and still suffer backlash.
The most crucial point was that after the parasite Devil Fetus settled, the practitioner needed to remain dormant and could not easily take action, or else severe consequences would ensue.
Chu Dingqian hesitated for a long time before practicing it, but faced with dwindling lifespan, he decided to risk it.
He implanted the Devil Fetus deep within the spirit of a descendant with decent aptitude. In the final year of his life, this descendant cultivated to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, the Devil Fetus matured, and Chu Dingqian took control.
His Divine Spirit was exceptionally strong and the descendant’s Myriad Phenomena Realm spirit couldn’t resist at all, and he was replaced by Chu Dingqian.
As the descendant, Chu Dingqian inherited everything and even struggled for the throne, eventually becoming the new Emperor Qian of the Daqian. After a period of time, he once again cultivated to the True Martial Realm.
When he reached the age of 1700 in this body, Chu Dingqian once again used the Demonic Fetus Technique, this time choosing Chu Hao and nesting within the depths of his spirit.
With the nourishment of his Devil Fetus, Chu Hao rose rapidly, becoming the famed Prince Wu’an, and he even had the capital to break through the True Martial Realm.
Chu Dingqian naturally did not wish for Chu Hao to advance swiftly. He had planned to directly replace him but later discovered a great opportunity. He made Chu Hao wait in Leizhou, insisting he must obtain the King Grade Pill.
In reality, Chu Dingqian planned to replace Chu Hao right after he obtained the Dragon Ball, so he could refine the Dragon Ball in Chu Hao’s identity and live out a third life.
Chu Wuji knew about this plan; he didn’t say anything, as Chu Dingqian couldn’t implant a Devil Fetus within him, and even passed on the Demonic Fetus Technique to him. The two agreed to refine the Dragon Ball together.
But now, both Chu Wuji and Chu Hao were dead.
The Daqian had lost a True Martial Realm cultivator, and he no longer had a prepared new body; Chu Hao’s body was much better than his current one.
Chu Dingqian was full of hatred but powerless to do anything about it.
Now, he had less than fifty years of life left; it was already too late. The Devil Fetus needed time to mature, at least fifty years or as much as two hundred years, unless he chose those cultivators with very low cultivation.
But once he died, the Qian Dynasty would be doomed; even if he successfully took over a minor cultivator’s body, such a weak cultivator would have great difficulty surviving in these chaotic times.
Chu Dingqian utterly detested Jiang Zhengyang and the Hemp-Robed Elder, for had they not attacked Chu Hao and Chu Wuji, even without seizing the Dragon Ball, he could have replaced Chu Hao and lived out a third life, still as a True Martial Realm ancestor.
With himself and Chu Wuji, the Qian Dynasty could still retain a vast territory despite some sacrifices.
But now, everything was gone.
“If only Daqian had one more True Martial Realm,” Chu Dingqian muttered to himself.
With two True Martial Realms in the Qian Dynasty, especially since he was close to death, the other True Martial Realm experts would be wary, afraid that he would go mad and drag others down with him.
As long as Daqian still stood, he could replace a minor cultivator and grow steadily.
But he knew this was impossible.
“Sigh.”
Chu Dingqian sighed, stood up, and walked out of the main hall. His terrifying aura was released without restraint, spreading throughout half of the Qian Dynasty. He wanted the world to know he was still alive.
At the same time, Chu Dingqian issued a series of commands, ordering those high officials of Daqian to quickly retreat to the Mid Six Province, and to take everything that could be taken from the Twelve Province.
Chu Dingqian was determined to give up most of the territory, only keeping the Mid Six Province. With his power, he could still temporarily stabilize the situation, striving for time to cultivate the Devil Fetus.
When Chu Dingqian released his aura, Han Li in Yuanzhou sensed it immediately.
“This is… the aura of the True Martial Realm. The Qian Dynasty still has Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm; their foundation is just too deep,” Han Li marveled.
With such depth in their three-thousand-year foundation, Han Li wondered how many True Martial Realm experts the Ancient Empire might have.
However, Han Li was actually pleased with this development. It was good that the Qian Dynasty still had a True Martial Realm—enough to stabilize the situation somewhat, and at the very least, able to protect the territory of the Mid Six Province.
For the sake of Han Mansion’s secure development and his continued survival, Han Li even considered creating an alias to support the Qian Dynasty and help stabilize the situation.
Two True Martial Realms were more than enough to defend the Mid Six Province. The four major forces each occupying parts of the Sanzhou would likely not continue to fight to the death against Daqian.
The more Han Li thought about it, the more he felt this approach was reliable.
The newly emerged True Martial Realm of Daqian would definitely want to win over his alias as one of Daqian’s strongest combatants and would surely be willing to pay a price. Some of his more wicked ideas might just be realized this way.
Later on, as a True Martial Realm ancestor of Daqian, his alias could also take many concubines, further spreading the risk.
For the time being, the ancestor Han had not yet decided how to proceed, so he decided to wait and see, pondering carefully whether this plan was feasible.
Several days later,
The ancestor Han stealthily made his way to Qingzhou again.
He had already decided to come and check every week to monitor the situation at Tianxuan Mountain, and to see if the Secret Territory might emerge ahead of time.
After carefully verifying the situation, ancestor Han found everything to be fine. The Sacred Dragon Secret Realm above Yingyuan Mountain showed no signs of emergence, and the Dragon Princess had also disappeared without a trace.
The Mountain Protection Array of Tianxuan Mountain was always activated. Han Li couldn’t see through to the inside from a great distance, but it was good that Tianxuan Mountain was not destroyed.
As Han Li was about to return to Chengsheng Mountain, he suddenly made a new discovery, his face lighting up with joy.
He spotted a fiery figure flying cautiously through Qingzhou, heading in the direction of the Canghai Sect.
Han Li recognized that figure at a glance—it was Yun Miaoyi, the Devil Princess he had been thinking about for a long time.
Although Han Li didn’t know what the Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi was sneaking into Qingzhou for, he knew that her timing was just right.
Han Li had previously thought about sneaking into the Yinyang Sect to steal away from home, wanting to quietly capture Yun Miaoyi to become his consort. But because he did not know her exact location and feared the other True Martial Realm experts of the Yinyang Sect, he had not acted.
Now that the Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi had come to Qingzhou by herself, it was as if she was delivered to his doorstep. Han Li felt that even the heavens were helping him.
He dared not capture the Dragon Princess, and the Demon King was trapped in the Secret Territory and couldn’t be captured at the moment, so capturing the little Devil Princess for now was also fine.

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - 147: Successful Operation, The Enchanting Devil Princess_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Chapter 147: Successful Operation, The Enchanting Devil Princess_1
Translator: 549690339
Several days ago, after Chu Dingqian was born, the outside world immediately learned that the Daqian Empire still had an elderly ancestor in the True Martial Realm, suspected to be the same old monster who had been in the True Martial Realm eight hundred years ago, during Emperor Wu’s time.
The forces of the outside world were shocked. The True Martial Realm ancestor hidden by the Daqian Empire hadn’t entered the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm to assist Prince Wu’an in the struggle for the Dragon Ball?
Before they could react, they received intelligence that the defense lines of the Daqian were starting to comprehensively shrink, planning to abandon the Outer Twelve States and were busily preparing for a retreat.
The various forces were puzzled. Didn’t the Daqian Empire still have a True Martial Realm ancestor? Was there really a need to do this?
Soon, two more pieces of intelligence spread out. Prince Wu’an was suspected to have died in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, and the True Martial Realm ancestor who had recently emerged was nearing his end, not long for this world.
The powers of all sides had a sudden realization, understanding why the Daqian would adopt such a course of action. The situation was truly precarious, and collapse was not far off, supported only by a dying True Martial Realm ancestor.
As the towering tree of the Daqian Dynasty was about to fall, the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and Da Jing Empire accelerated their invasion. Fengbo Pavilion also made constant moves in the Eastern Three Provinces, intending to swiftly swallow up the provinces before reaching out to other major states.
Within the Daqian Dynasty, everyone was in a state of panic, with all the forces looking for a new allegiance, or temporarily relocating to the Mid Six Province.
In these past few days, several high officials of the Daqian, upon receiving messages from the Capital City, had been preparing to withdraw back to the Mid Six Province. Before that, they needed to scavenge what they could in the Twelve Province.
They planned to take away all the cultivational resources from the Twelve Province that could be taken, as well as any willing smaller forces wanting to follow them in the retreat.
Previously, when executing their plans, high officials like the State Preceptor, the Left Chancellor, the Prophet, and several others of the Daqian were dispatched to four war zones to oversee operations. The high official in charge of Leizhou, Qingzhou, and Huozhou was the Mentor of Daqian, who also brought a Great General and a nation-supporting pillar with him, both Great Grandmasters in the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
After the arrival of the Mentor and others, the deteriorating situation was alleviated, and the Leizhou battlefield, which previously had Wan Guiyuan, Yang Tianxiong, and Master Lan, now had six Great Grandmasters.
With the six Great Grandmasters and the army, they held back the invasion of the Yinyang Sect forces, and both parties were preparing for a major battle in Fengyang Manor. But instructions from the Capital City suddenly came, directing the Mentor and others to retreat back to the Mid Six Province.
This left the Mentor and his colleagues feeling extremely helpless. They had a sensation of “While we are ready to fight to the death, why does His Majesty order a retreat first?”
But the Mentor and his people complied anyway, immediately starting preparations. They also knew that the situation of the Daqian had deteriorated to an extreme point, and a retreat was necessary.
Prince Wu’an and Chu Wuji, the reclusive emperor that the outside world was unaware of, were dead. With only one dying True Martial Realm ancestor left barely holding on, the Daqian simply couldn’t defend such a vast territory.
The retreat, however, could not be completed in a single day. It had to be gradual, taking with them everything that could be taken from the three provinces to avoid leaving anything for the Yinyang Sect.
By now, the Mentor had already led the armies of the Daqian out of Leizhou, organizing defenses to block the relentless pursuit of the Yinyang Sect while simultaneously coordinating teams to scavenge the resources of Huozhou and Qingzhou.
All the sects and forces in the provinces unwilling to accept the rule of the Yinyang Sect and planning to withdraw to the Mid Six Province were also organized for a retreat.
While withdrawing from Leizhou, the Mentor had visited Tianxuan Mountain in hopes of convincing them to also retreat, as they had three or four Great Grandmasters in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, which would undoubtedly be of immeasurable help to the current state of the Daqian.
However, Gongsun Yun did not agree. He was already preparing to move Tianxuan Mountain. The rule of the Yinyang Sect in Leizhou was of no concern to him; they would be able to swiftly escape the Daqian Dynasty on the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship in due time.
With the Grandmasters of the True Martial Realm from the Yinyang Sect trapped within the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, no one could stop the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship, which was comparably as fast as a mid-stage practitioner in the True Martial Realm.
Tianxuan Mountain refused to advance or retreat together with the Daqian, and while the Mentor felt helpless, he didn’t say much more and returned to lead the army out of Leizhou.
Not just in the southern provinces, but also in the east, west, and north, each high official conceded one province, allowing the three great powers to digest them, buying more time for their retreat.
Just as the Daqian had retreated to Huozhou and Qingzhou, and the Yinyang Sect had just swallowed Leizhou, a figure quietly arrived in Qingzhou.
It was another night when the moon shone brightly and the stars were sparse.
The Devil Princess, Yun Miaoyi, was flying towards the direction of the Canghai Sect, being extremely cautious on the way, for fear of being discovered.
When the Yinyang Sect invaded Leizhou, Yun Miaoyi had come along and picked up some cheap gains, establishing some merits.
Now that Qingzhou housed numerous Great Grandmasters in the Myriad Phenomena Realm and Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage, who harbored deep hatred for the Yinyang Sect, if her whereabouts were uncovered, her end would certainly be dire.
Yet, for Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi still took the risk to come. She didn’t wait until the Daqian withdrew from Qingzhou because she was worried that the Canghai Sect would follow the retreat to the Mid Six Province.
“Jiang Baiye, Jiang Baiye, how good I’ve been to you,” she mused to herself while flying.
The general situation was now set. After the Daqian retreated, they would fortify the Mid Six Province and wait for an opportunity. The Yinyang Sect would directly swallow up Leizhou, Qingzhou, and Huozhou, and then seek chances to encroach upon the Mid Six Province.
The Canghai Sect had significant conflicts with the Yinyang Sect and was unlikely to accept their rule, more likely to retreat to the Mid Six Province. Jiang Baiye would also be in the Mid Six Province.
By then, the Mid Six Province would gather a large number of powerful individuals from the Daqian, each bearing a profound hatred for the Yinyang Sect. Dare not Yun Miaoyi invade again to find Jiang Baiye.
Now was the best chance. As long as she found Jiang Baiye, she was confident she could coax him away, convincing Jiang Baiye to return with her to the Yinyang Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 147: Successful Operation, The Enchanting Devil Princess_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Chapter 147: Successful Operation, The Enchanting Devil Princess_2
Translator: 549690339
Besides personal feelings, Yun Miaoyi also wanted Jiang Baiye to explore the soon-to-emerge ruins with her, compete for treasures, and help her break through to the Hollow Void Stage.
It would be even better if Jiang Baiye converted to practicing Devil Cultivation Techniques, then they would both be Devil Princesses, able to do some more thrilling things together.
As Yun Miaoyi was flying, she was completely unaware of a figure that had appeared behind her. Right behind her, almost pressing against Yun Miaoyi, warm breath brushed against her neck, yet Yun Miaoyi still did not notice.
“Where is Jiang Baiye now? Inside the Canghai Sect’s mountain gate?” Yun Miaoyi muttered to herself.
Ancestor Han’s heart stirred, and suddenly he spoke, “He’s at Chengsheng Mountain with me, little Devil Princess, do you want to come along?”
After spotting Yun Miaoyi, Han Li had instantly arrived. His Spiritual Sense covered the area, concealing himself and blocking Yun Miaoyi’s four senses except for her sight.
In this manner, even though he was nearly pressed against Yun Miaoyi and continuously teased her, the little Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi remained completely unaware.
As he spoke, Han Li lifted the block on Yun Miaoyi’s sense of hearing. The voice that rang out by her ear was that familiar devilish voice; Yun Miaoyi exploded.
Without looking back, she fully channeled her cultivation technique and escaped instantly, fleeing tens of thousands of miles before Yun Miaoyi dared to stop for a breath.
She looked back, her Spiritual Sense surged out, continuously scanning the area, but she did not find Han Li’s figure, nor any traces of other cultivators.
“Is it because I’ve been too tense lately that I’m having hallucinations?” Yun Miaoyi murmured.
Just for a moment, she had almost thought that the big Devil, Han Li, had come. She had completely put Jiang Baiye out of her mind and ran as fast as she could.
Thinking back now, it really seemed like she was hallucinating.
Han Li may be strong, but he was just a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and he hadn’t broken through for long. The key point was that Han Li was in Yuanzhou, with Jizhou still between them; it was impossible for him to have found out about her coming to Qingzhou.
Unless Han Li was just staying in Qingzhou, knew that she was coming to find Jiang Baiye, and deliberately searched for and tracked her down.
But how could that be?
She and Han Li had only crossed paths once, and she had kept her oath afterwards, never disclosing any information about Han Li. It was improbable that Han Li would still be keeping her in mind, right?
Yet Yun Miaoyi felt uneasy, Han Li might indeed be continuously thinking of her.
That bastard had wanted to harm her in the first place, but had some reservations. Given that devil’s lecherous nature, now that his strength far surpassed hers, he might just want to capture her and make her his wife or concubine.
In a flash, various thoughts sped through Yun Miaoyi’s mind, then she turned around, prepared to continue her escape.
Whether it was a hallucination or not, it was better to return to Leizhou. She’d find another chance to elope with Jiang Baiye later.
“Little Devil Princess, why aren’t you running anymore?”
Suddenly, Han Li’s teasing voice was heard in her ear.
Yun Miaoyi verified without a doubt, it was Han Li speaking. Her beautiful red lips were tightly pursed; she said nothing and once again began to flee.
While Han Li wanted to play with her, which ended up giving her a chance to escape, another hundred thousand miles and she would reach Leizhou. Yun Miaoyi felt that Han Li would not dare to set foot in Leizhou.
Now, Leizhou was crowded with a multitude of strong figures from the Yinyang Sect. If Han Li dared to pursue her in Leizhou, those Devil Grandmasters would not turn a blind eye, and Han Li would be biting off more than he could chew.
Watching Yun Miaoyi flee, Han Li chuckled lightly. His Spiritual Sense had long since covered a radius of six hundred thousand miles, finding no traces of True Martial Realm hiding. As long as he wished, not only would Yun Miaoyi fail to escape, but she wouldn’t even make a sound to the outside world.
After Yun Miaoyi escaped fifty thousand miles, Han Li flashed and appeared a hundred miles ahead of her on a mountain peak.
When Yun Miaoyi flew closer, Han Li stretched out his right hand forward, making a claw gesture. A massive True Yuan Devil’s Palm formed, becoming bigger and pressing down towards Yun Miaoyi.
“Little Devil Princess, can you escape from the Ancestor’s Five Finger Mountain?” Han Li laughed lightly.
Yun Miaoyi still didn’t speak, she merely drew out her Devil Sword, Spring Rain, and struck with all her might towards the gigantic palm made of True Yuan.
It was to no avail; the palm’s descent was not slowed in the slightest.
Reluctant to accept defeat, Yun Miaoyi gripped Spring Rain tightly, swinging it repeatedly for more than a dozen times, still to no effect.
The little Devil Princess smiled bitterly, ceasing her resistance; she knew it was futile.
She had seen it clearly, that bastard Han Li was determined to capture her. With her speed far slower than his and the overwhelming difference in strength, there was no chance of escape.
Yun Miaoyi even suspected that Han Li’s strength had improved again, but she had no evidence and felt it was unlikely, as a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm would progress very slowly.
The imprint of the True Yuan giant claw fell down but did not harm Yun Miaoyi, it only sealed all her cultivation.
With a slight summons of his right hand, Han Li made Yun Miaoyi fly uncontrollably into his arms.
Feeling the warm and tender beauty in his arms, Han Li did not hold back and directly lowered his head, capturing Yun Miaoyi’s delicate red lips.
Yun Miaoyi clenched her teeth tightly, refusing to let Han Li, this Devil Grandmaster, go any further.
She was known as the Devil Princess, but in Yun Miaoyi’s view, Han Li was the true Devil Grandmaster.
After a long while, Han Li finally let her go, not forgetting to comment, “Still the same taste, really good.”
“What exactly do you want?” Yun Miaoyi bit her red lips, unable to hold back her words.
Although she knew that once in Han Li’s hands, he would never let her go, there was still a glimmer of hope in Yun Miaoyi’s heart.
“Aren’t you looking for Jiang Baiye? I’ll send you to keep her company, how’s that? Am I not a good person?”
Han Li’s face beamed with smiles. Now that Yun Miaoyi had come to him, he would not let her leave again. The Old Ancestor Han had been thinking about the Devil Princess for a long time, and he had even imagined the scene of refining treasures.
Yun Miaoyi’s delicate body shivered, looking at Han Li in shock. She stammered, “Jiang… Baiye… was captured by you too?”
Yun Miaoyi deeply regretted her actions, knowing that Jiang Baiye had been captured by this devil Han Li, she would have never come to Qingzhou.
This bastard might have guessed her intentions and specifically waited for her in Qingzhou; otherwise, how could he coincidentally discover her trail?
Han Li nodded with a smile.
“Is Jiang Baiye your wife or concubine?” After a silence, Yun Miaoyi suddenly asked.
Han Li was startled. The Devil Princess was so direct?
“Answer me,” said Yun Miaoyi, her pretty face frosty as she glared at Han Li.
Since she couldn’t escape, she might as well fight for some favorable conditions for herself. After all, Han Li wasn’t going to let her go.
“Jiang Jiang is of course my wife,” Han Li naturally replied.
Yun Miaoyi sighed with relief. It was good that Jiang Baiye was the wife, so if she married Han Li, she should also be the wife.
She was aware of Han Li’s situation. He had two wives at present, one of whom should be Jiang Baiye. Han Li had sixty or seventy concubines, and she didn’t want to be one.
Having made up her mind, Yun Miaoyi became much more composed and scoffed, “Tsck tsck, ‘Jiang Jiang’, how nauseatingly sweet. It seems Jiang Baiye fell into your Devil’s Palm long ago.”
“Hahaha~”
Han Li laughed. He liked Yun Miaoyi’s response, which showed she had made her decision.
Unlike Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi had climbed up from the bottom step by step to become a Core Disciple of the Yinyang Sect. Her thoughts were more intricate, and she knew well how to make choices.
Han Li really appreciated this trait in Yun Miaoyi; it would save him a lot of trouble.
“Yun Yun, once you cross my threshold, I will give you the status of a wife too,” Han Li said earnestly, looking into Yun Miaoyi’s eyes—this had been his intention all along.
“Okay.”
Yun Miaoyi agreed straightforwardly, being a wife is always better than a concubine.
Han Li let her go. It was only then that he took the opportunity to observe Yun Miaoyi properly, realizing that whatever she wore, her voluptuous body was always in full display.
Her black, smooth hair reached her waist, occasionally stirring with the breeze. Her face was stunningly beautiful with not a single flaw. Beneath her long lashes were round, bright eyes, clear and sparkling, her brows and eyes exuding a soft, enchanting charm; her sensual and bewitching demeanor was mesmerizing.
Her hot and curvy body, her slender waist like a willow, was perfectly accentuated by the tight black dress she wore, showcasing the seductive S-curve of her figure. Her bare arms were exposed to the air, her skin white as snow glistening in the moonlight, especially tender. The hem of her black dress revealed her long, fair legs, with clear battle boots on her feet displaying her tender, crystal clear toes, shining with an enticing luster.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 148: The Patriarch Gets Married, A Joyous Event for All!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 148: The Patriarch Gets Married, A Joyous Event for All!_1
Translator: 549690339
“So beautiful.”
While saying so, Han Li reached out his hand.
The Devil Princess, Yun Miaoyi, slapped away his large hand and coldly said, “Speak if you want, but keep your hands to yourself.”
Han Li laughed, but his hand did not stop, continuing to wander.
Yun Miaoyi really was interesting—he changed very quickly and naturally. She could be soft or firm, yielding or unyielding, but she never gives you a hint whether she can accept or reject.
If she could also do that, she would indeed be a little treasure.
Han Li adored his beautiful wives and concubines. If they could please him, he would cherish them immensely.
Han Li once again pulled her into his embrace and nibbled on her beautiful face several times before biting her earlobe and whispering,
“Yunyun, rest assured, whatever Jiang Jiang has, you won’t be shorted a single dime.”
However, what Han Li was thinking about in his heart was how to refine these two treasures at the same time; once the sword and sabre were united, their power would surge, an exhilarating thought for Han Li.
Yun Miaoyi’s heart flickered lightly, and she said with a half-smile, “Oh? Let me hear what sweet words you’ve whispered to Jiang Baiye?”
“We’ll talk upon returning.”
With a final glance at Tianxuan Mountain, Han Li disappeared with Yun Miaoyi in his arms and quickly returned to Chengsheng Mountain.
Atop Chengdao Peak, Han Li and Yun Miaoyi stood firm. After a moment of thought, he unsealed Yun Miaoyi’s cultivation level.
Yun Miaoyi was a clever person, adaptable to all situations, and she wouldn’t act foolishly. Moreover, with his mid-stage True Martial Realm combat ability, as long as he wished, there was nothing Yun Miaoyi could do to him.
“It seems you have great confidence in your own strength.”
Feeling the Gang Yuan resuming its flow inside her body and regaining control of her formidable power, Yun Miaoyi looked at Han Li in surprise.
She had gathered a lot of information about Han Li. Even though the man was shameless, lustful, a bastard, and a rogue, he was also exceedingly cautious and extremely surviving.
For Han Li to unseal her cultivation meant that whether she had cultivation or not didn’t make any difference to him. How high must one’s cultivation be to have such strong confidence?
Han Li shook his head slightly and whispered affectionately in the little devil woman’s ear, “Yunyun, I have admired you for a long time. Now that you have agreed to marry me, I naturally can’t let you suffer the slightest grievance.”
“Not only you, but Jiang Jiang’s cultivation also isn’t sealed by me.” After a moment, Han Li added.
He was planning to unseal all of Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation as well. Lu Tianxiang had almost completely turned her loyalties, and the child of the Sect Hierarch, Xiao Xiang, was also on her way.
It would not be good to continue suppressing the Hierarch’s seal. Not only did he plan to unseal Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation, but he also intended to help her quickly elevate it. As for how, they’d have to start with the Qian Dynasty.
As long as he appeared incognito, the current True Martial Realm ancestor from the Qian would beg him to stand with the Qian, offering countless rich terms.
Aside from obtaining some resources he needed, Han Li could also seek benefits for the Sect Hierarch and easily establish a new sect in Lu Tianxiang’s name with the official help of the Qian Dynasty. Even if the Qian only had the Mid Six Province left, it would be enough for Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation to surge rapidly, possibly even reaching the True Martial Realm.
Upon hearing this, Yun Miaoyi’s heart throbbed fiercely, but she did not show it.
Ever since she stepped onto the path of cultivation, Yun Miaoyi had longed to be protected and shielded by someone. However, she had no backing and no background, relying solely on herself.
She used many means to protect herself and cultivated all the way to the God Refining Realm, becoming a Core Disciple of the Yinyang Sect.
In the deepest parts of her heart, she longed to be protected. But within the Hehuan Sect and the Yinyang Sect, she dared not show it, fully aware of how cruel and cold Cultivators of the demon path could be.
Cases of killing one’s wife to prove their Dao were not rare; in their eyes, wives and concubines were mere playthings. Truly affectionate demon path Cultivators were extremely rare; at least, she had never encountered one.
In the eyes of others, she was a cold-hearted demoness, and only when she was with Jiang Baiye, fighting and competing, could she relax a bit more.
Although Han Li was flirtatious and lustful, as far as Yun Miaoyi knew, he was good to his wives and concubines. At least, she had never heard of him using them as cauldrons for cultivation.
Yun Miaoyi felt that she needed to understand Han Li more deeply; she would not be fooled by his sweet words.
She believed that Han Li also needed to comprehend her more deeply to see if he would still like the real her when the time came.
“Hu hu~”
Seeing Yun Miaoyi silent, Han Li wrapped his hand around her soft waist and gently blew into her ear.
Yun Miaoyi’s breathing suddenly became more rapid. As Han Li drew near, the rich male scent enveloped her, intruding upon her senses and causing her blood to boil like hot waves, sending an inexplicable burning flow throughout her body.
Yun Miaoyi struggled; she wanted to escape Han Li’s embrace, afraid that she would become flustered if it continued.
In the Devil Princess’s mind, the scene when Han Li first captured her emerged unbidden—how he cruelly toyed with her and Jiang Baiye, forcing them into various shameful poses. The memory was still vivid for Yun Miaoyi.
After struggling in vain, Yun Miaoyi couldn’t break free and, trying to suppress her panic, she quickly changed the subject:
“Tell me, what sweet nothings did you use to deceive Jiang Baiye?”
“Jiang Baiye is as pure as a white lotus, so it’s normal for her to be deceived by you, but if you think you can do that to me, you’re bound to be disappointed.”
A smile appeared on Yun Miaoyi’s beautiful face, seemingly proud. With her vast experience, she believed nothing could deceive her.

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 148: The Patriarch Gets Married, A Joyous Event for All!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 148: The Patriarch Gets Married, A Joyous Event for All!_2
Translator: 549690339
Han Li lowered his head and gently pressed his lips to her soft, warm red ones.
“How could you think of me like that? I’m not that kind of person.”
“Jiang Jiang volunteered, as did my other wives and concubines. The world is too chaotic; all I wanted was to give them a secure home. Is that so wrong?”
Han Li sighed, his handsome face brimming with sincerity.
“Han Li, I have to say, your skin is really thick.” Yun Miaoyi was speechless. Can you not be so shameless?
Do you really think I don’t know what kind of person you are? A shameless lecher!
Pah!
“Thanks for the compliment.” Han Li smiled, unaffected.
His slender, jade-like fingers caressed Yun Miaoyi’s flat and smooth abdomen, feeling incredibly silky and soft. He bit down on Yun Miaoyi’s earlobe once again, his warm lips lightly grazing her delicate and beautiful ear.
Yun Miaoyi suddenly felt a jolt as if she were electrocuted, her body shaking. She quickly stopped him, saying in a cold voice, “Enough, if you don’t speak frankly I’ll take it as you’re deceiving me.”
Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi was also quite curious; what exactly had that bastard Han Li said to Jiang Baiye, and what promises had he made.
In her view, although Han Li was crafty and cunning, he was still quite credible. He might actually make it happen.
Since Jiang Baiye had certain things from Han Li, she would as well; she wouldn’t be shortchanged at all. She wanted to see exactly what Jiang Baiye had gained.
Han Li paused, noticing that Yun Miaoyi’s expression had become even more enticing. It should be said that this Devil Princess, no matter what her expression, always fascinated him.
Han Li liked her coquettishness, her shyness, her unpretentiousness, her enchanting charm… Yun Miaoyi had too many appealing qualities for him.
Especially in some indescribable areas.
Han Li held Yun Miaoyi’s warm and soft body tightly, whispering in her ear, “I told Jiang Jiang that as long as she wholeheartedly marries me, I would help her break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, even the True Martial Realm.”
Yun Miaoyi’s pupils shrank, her pretty face betraying her shock; she too was startled by Han Li’s promise.
Han Li himself was still in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, far from the True Martial Realm. Whether he could break through to the True Martial Realm in his lifetime was uncertain, so what made him bold enough to help Jiang Baiye ascend to the True Martial Realm?
Now he had to add her to the list; if Han Li married more wives in the future, would he also help them reach the True Martial Realm?
The True Martial Realm was no mere trifle; it represented the mightiest in the Xuan Domain. Even the Hehuan Sect, where she came from, did not have a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, let alone a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster.
After advancing to the Yinyang Sect, she made many inquiries and learned that the Yinyang Sect had only two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus.
Of course, backed by the Devil Region, with the entire Demon Clan as its support, the Yinyang Sect could instantly have many more True Martial Realm Emperor Wus if the Demon Clan was willing.
On what basis did Han Li make such assertions?
Swallowing, Yun Miaoyi lifted her head to look at Han Li, fixing her gaze on his eyes, studying his expression, and suddenly said, “You couldn’t possibly be at the True Martial Realm, could you?”
Han Li’s brow lifted. Was this Devil Princess really so perceptive? Neither Lu Tianxiang nor Jiang Baiye had guessed his True Martial Realm status, thinking he was just a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster.
“Why would you say that, Yunyun?” Han Li countered.
Yun Miaoyi replied, “I feel that you can only make such promises if you have reached the True Martial Realm.”
“You’re just over two hundred years old, right? If you were a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, you might even achieve the Divine Yuan Realm Great Emperor in the future. Then you would indeed have the capability to help me and Jiang Baiye break through to the True Martial Realm.”
“That makes sense.” Han Li nodded slightly.
Yun Miaoyi felt somewhat disappointed; she couldn’t read anything from Han Li’s face or eyes. It seemed Han Li was very skilled at controlling his expressions.
“So, are you a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster or a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu?” Yun Miaoyi continued to press for an answer, unwilling to give up until she was certain.
If Han Li was only in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, she would be a little disappointed; his promises would seem like castles in the air, highly unrealistic.
But if Han Li was at the True Martial Realm, his promises would carry significant weight, and being the wife of a young True Martial Realm Emperor Wu would satisfy Yun Miaoyi.
In these turbulent times in the Xuan Domain, having a husband with stronger powers meant surviving longer and better protection for her.
Looking at the expectant Yun Miaoyi, Han Li hesitated only slightly before saying directly, “Just assume I’m at the True Martial Realm.”
Telling Yun Miaoyi was just the beginning; he planned to disclose his cultivation level to his beloved wives and beauties, but of course, he needed to address this separately.
For example, telling Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye that he was at the True Martial Realm would instill more confidence in them, secure their loyalty, and they wouldn’t feel wronged about being wives to a young True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
For his concubines like Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, and Lin Yiwu, who knew Han Li was a God Refining Realm Real Person, he intended to reveal his cultivation as a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster.
And for those loyal, capable, and specially trained descendants, Han Li could consider disclosing his status as a Guru in the Void Realm.
Though each knew a different piece of information, they generally wouldn’t ask others, assuming everyone knew the same. After all, Han Li hadn’t shown any overtly powerful traits.
With Da Qian now retreating and steadily pulling back to the Mid Six Province, the world was in turmoil, and each province faced a certain degree of chaos.
The Outer Twelve States were the most chaotic, and although Yuanzhou was part of the Mid Six Province, it too was quite disordered, even with a province like Jizhou standing between it and the Yinyang Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - 148: The Patriarch Gets Married, A Joyous Event for All!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: Chapter 148: The Patriarch Gets Married, A Joyous Event for All!_3
Translator: 549690339
Because the news of the impending death of the True Martial Realm ancestor of the Daqian Empire was deliberately spread out, the many forces of the Mid Six Province were seeking ways out, with less than fifty years to make their move.
When the Daqian Empire withdrew, although the great war was still raging, the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, Da Jing Dynasty, and the Mysterious Forces did not intervene with their True Martial Realm combatants.
On one hand, some members of the True Martial Realm from these four major forces were trapped in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, and on the other hand, they were wary of Chu Dingqian.
Chu Dingqian was close to death, and other True Martial Realm Emperors did not want to provoke his ire, especially since Chu Dingqian was suspected to be in the middle stage of the True Martial Realm, with formidable strength. If he fought to the death, it would be easy for him to drag several True Martial Realm early stage Emperors to die with him.
They preferred to continue waiting, first to swallow up the Outer Twelve States ceded by the Daqian Empire and then slowly scheme for the Mid Six Province.
Chu Dingqian could live for a few more decades at most. Once he died, the Daqian Empire would be left without any True Martial Realm combat ability. Then, the partition of the Mid Six Province would follow suit all the same; a few decades wouldn’t make a difference.
This was the situation that, even though the Daqian Empire still had True Martial Realm combatants, internally the people were panicked and in disarray.
Han Mansion was also aware of these intelligence reports, and in recent days Han Li had noticed concern on the faces of his concubines and descendants, worried whether Han Mansion would be affected and could continue to develop peacefully.
After all, Han Family ancestor Han Li was just a God Refining Realm cultivator. In such a situation, he was practically useless, unable to provide them with sufficient security.
In the past few days, several Great Grandmasters at the Myriad Phenomena Realm had already died, and even Prince Wu’an, who had True Martial Realm combat ability, died in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm. If the Yinyang Sect invaded, their Immortal Refining Clan would likely be annihilated instantly.
Yun Miaoyi’s small mouth opened slightly, but she couldn’t find the words to speak. Her face was filled with shock; although she had some speculations, she found it unbelievable when she actually learned the truth.
Yun Miaoyi clearly remembered that more than a decade ago, Han Li was just a God Refining Realm cultivator who had exerted a lot of effort to capture her and Jiang Baiye.
Over a decade had passed, and Han Li had improbably advanced from the God Refining Realm, crossing the Hollow Void Stage and Myriad Phenomena Realm to reach the True Martial Realm. This was simply too exaggerated.
What kind of great opportunity had Han Li encountered?
Although her mind was filled with myriad guesses, Yun Miaoyi knew better than to keep asking. Han Li was willing to share this with her, which touched her deeply.
It meant that he truly considered her as his own, as his wife. Otherwise, such confidential information would never be revealed to her.
“Now that you are my wife, you don’t feel wronged, do you?” Han Li chuckled softly in Yun Miaoyi’s ear.
“Hmm,” Yun Miaoyi nodded, accepting Han Li in her heart.
