After sharing a tender moment atop the mountain, Han Li brought Yun Miaoyi to the palace area and gathered all his beloved wives and concubines to introduce Yun Miaoyi to them.
Li Mingmeng, Lin Yiyin, Qiu Yueyao, and other beauties were, of course, indifferent; their husband taking another wife was nothing new to them, and they had grown accustomed to it.
Knowing that Yun Miaoyi was still a God Refining Realm cultivator made them even more enthusiastic, affectionately calling her “sister.”
Lu Tianxiang felt a twinge of sourness in her heart, feeling that Han Li, that scoundrel, was marrying at a frighteningly fast pace—it had only been two or three years, and he had taken her and Jiang Baiye, and now he was about to marry Yun Miaoyi.
However, Lu Tianxiang quickly came to terms with it, as Han Li had completely unsealed her powers and informed her that she had reached the True Martial Realm.
Lu Tianxiang was shocked, yet she felt it was somewhat normal. She touched her slightly enlarged belly, and looking at Han Li’s handsome face, she felt that she had really fallen for Han Li.
Compared to when she was first captured by Han Li, her attitude towards him had changed dramatically. Lu Tianxiang sighed inwardly and fully accepted it.
As for Yun Miaoyi’s arrival, Jiang Baiye naturally welcomed her. She felt quite lonely in the Han Mansion, but with Yun Miaoyi there, it would be different.
Jiang Baiye had thought that Yun Miaoyi would be quite reluctant, knowing all too well that she must have been captured by Han Li. Yun Miaoyi would not have willingly offered herself to become Han Li’s wife.
But to her surprise, Yun Miaoyi seemed quite willing. The way she looked at Han Li even carried a hint of affection, a stark contrast to the Devil Princess Jiang Baiye knew.
Jiang Baiye really wanted to know what kind of love potion Han Li had given Yun Miaoyi to make her, the Devil Princess, so devoted to him.
After all, she had been married to Han Li for quite a while now, with a child several months along, and only now was she developing an attitude similar to Yun Miaoyi’s.
“Yun Miaoyi, congratulations,” said Jiang Baiye, a smile gracing her cool face.
“Tch, Han Li really didn’t lie. You’re already pregnant, and by the looks of it, you’ll give birth in another three or four months,” noted Yun Miaoyi.
Upon seeing Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi acted somewhat arrogantly, perhaps out of habit from their previous rivalry.
“You won’t be far behind,” Jiang Baiye retorted coldly, Yun Miaoyi was indeed the same as before.
“Who knows, maybe my child will have better innate talent than yours,” said Yun Miaoyi, sticking out her tongue and licking her red lips provocatively.
Jiang Baiye was at a loss for words, the Devil Princess was speaking such wild, bold words.
You haven’t even married yet, and you’re already thinking about bearing children for that bastard Han Li. What kind of love potion has Han Li fed you?
Two days later, the Han Family patriarch held a grand wedding on an auspicious day, officially marrying Yun Miaoyi.
Although Han Li had arranged a lavish ceremony, not many powers attended; only kinship forces sent representatives. Other forces did not participate.
Han Li naturally knew why. Normally, everyone would show his Immortal Refining Clan patriarch respect, but now with the political situation in turmoil and the Daqian Empire on the brink of collapse, every power was busy preparing for their future. Who had the time to attend the old patriarch’s wedding?
While the patriarch understood, he still took note of the absence of those powers in his little book.
This was his grand wedding to Yun Miaoyi. Despite the same grandeur, it was far less lively than the previous two times. Han Li worried that Yun Miaoyi would be unhappy about it.
Luckily, Yun Miaoyi was very understanding and rational, saying they should not care about those things as long as Han Li treated her well in the future.
After the grand wedding concluded, the Han Family patriarch entered the bridal chamber meticulously prepared for the Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi, his mood a mix of excitement. He was finally about to taste the flavor of the Devil Princess.

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - 149: Refining Treasure Diary Page 3, The Reluctant Han Yongchun_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: Chapter 149: Refining Treasure Diary Page 3, The Reluctant Han Yongchun_1
Translator: 549690339
“Artifact Refining Journal,” page three.
In a magnificent and splendid bedroom, the ancestor of artifact refining, Han Li, was flipping through his journal, vigorously writing new entries in his artifact refining diary.
Preface: There were many ancient treasures of great fame, but only a few were well-known, among which three were extremely renowned: first the Demon Girl Whip, second the Fairy Sword, and third the Devil Sword.
Day one of refining the ultimate treasure: With the situation as perilous as a stack of eggs, Han Li felt a deep inadequacy in his strength, so he went out seeking aid, hoping to encounter great fortune.
One day, Han Li burst into an ancient ruin and saw a Devil Sword hanging high in the firmament, its blade piercing through the Nine Heavens, dividing yin and yang, spanning across ancient and modern times.
Delighted by the find, he immediately approached, intending to take down the Devil Sword and refine it to enhance his own strength.
But ultimate treasures all have spirits, and the Devil Sword was no exception. Within it dwelled a demon spirit controlling the artifact, and as Han Li drew near, it awakened the dormant Devil Sword, whose blade’s intent could annihilate limitless universes, with a formidable might.
Han Li had no choice, for the sake of increasing his strength, he had to act resolutely. He condensed his True Yuan into beams and gradually approached the ultimate treasure, the Devil Sword, attempting to penetrate its core and imprint it with his mark, thereby gaining control over it.
The demon spirit was furious, a mere cultivator, skilled in artifact refining though he may be, the Devil Sword was not his to control. Thus, the sword put up a fierce resistance, its light overflowing, causing all worlds to tremble.
Seeing that the Devil Sword, full of demonic nature, refused to be dominated, Han Li became angry as well. He directly clashed with the Devil Sword using his physical body, for he was an ancestor skilled in body refining, having refined countless magical treasures, and all of them had to submit to him. He did not believe that he could not tame this Devil Sword.
The battle between the ancestor and the spirit of the Devil Sword was fierce, lasting a day and a night. Han Li suffered some minor losses, getting beaten until he was bloody and his head wounded.
But the ancestor laughed; no matter how much the Devil Sword resisted, relying on his powerful physical body, he subdued the sword. He forcefully injected his True Yuan into the treasure’s core. Even though it was erased by the demon spirit, it was at least a good start.
Summary: The Devil Sword is an extremely ferocious object, and the ancestor has a slight advantage, having gained preliminary control over the fierce object.
Day two of refining the ultimate treasure: Yesterday, Han Li was expelled from the ruins by the spirit of the Devil Sword. Today, having recovered to his peak, he re-entered the ruins in a renewed state to fight against the Devil Sword.
Although the Devil Sword is an ancient and notorious evil object with extreme might, who is Han Li? Known as the “Ancestor of Artifact Refining,” any ultimate treasure that catches his eye ends up being refined by him without exception.
Though the Devil Sword is fierce, Han Li gave no quarter; with a powerful body capable of suppressing the heavens, subduing a mere demon spirit was a simple task, wasn’t it?
However, Han Li was kind-hearted and did not plan to overpower it forcefully. He had ample patience to slowly confront the Devil Sword, knowing that one day he would subdue it. When the spirit of the Devil Sword submitted to him, that would be the day he gained control over it.
Time and again, Han Li gathered his True Yuan into beams, repeatedly sending them deep into the core of the Devil Sword, touching its deepest reaches, the very place to leave his mark. Success in imprinting his mark would make the ultimate treasure his.
Unconsciously, the Ancestor of Artifact Refining battled the Devil Sword for yet another day and night; the sword was too fierce, even making Han Li feel tired physically.
Luckily, he achieved good results; through his relentless efforts and fierce battles with the demon spirit, while momentarily suppressing it, he poured his True Yuan unrestrainedly, purifying the Devil Sword, attempting to leave his imprint in its core.
Unfortunately, the Devil Sword was too evil, its might too strong; with a shift of its blade light, it almost caused infinite worlds to crumble. Frightened, Han Li almost withdrew most of his True Yuan. A destruction of that scale would be a great loss, and it would take a long time to recover.
Undeterred, Han Li went in and out several times, eventually refining a part of the Devil Sword, but the demon spirit still refused to acknowledge him as master, expelling Han Li once again.
Summary: The great path is about to be achieved.
Day three of refining the ultimate treasure: After recovering to his peak, Han Li charged into the ruins once more, engaging in yet another intense battle with the Devil Sword.
Having already made good progress the day before, Han Li planned to strike while the iron was hot, to subdue the Devil Sword and thus avoid nightly troubles. Battling the Devil Sword day after day was taxing, even for an invincible body like his.
That day, perhaps thanks to the partial mark left the previous day, the resistance of the demon spirit had weakened a lot. Han Li unleashed his divine might, suppressing the Devil Sword over ten thousand times, infusing it with countless True Yuan.
The Devil Sword was nearly burst by Han Li’s True Yuan, and it cried out for Han Li to stop, to hold off, to spare its life, claiming it was dying…
The ancestor, with eyes as sharp as a burning torch, saw through the demon spirit’s ruse right away. It was attempting to make Han Li relax his guard in order to reassert itself and subdue him in return. But Han Li wouldn’t fall for it, and with great force, he continued the beating until the demon spirit lost its spirit.
After prolonged combat, the shouts of the demon spirit grew weaker; whether it was about to be extinguished or had become accustomed to the ancestor’s power and no longer dared to resist fiercely, it knew it had nothing to gain from a direct confrontation with him.
After battling for a day, when Han Li began to feel a bit of fatigue, he went all out, pouring all of his remaining True Yuan into it, filling the core of the ultimate treasure and successfully leaving a great number of his marks.
The demon spirit had been subdued by Han Li, lacking the strength to resist Han Li’s refinement of its Devil Sword body. This allowed Han Li to triumph again, effortlessly infusing True Yuan from various angles and positions into the Devil Sword, feeling considerably smooth.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 149 Refining Treasure Diary Page 3, The Unwilling Han Yongchun_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 149 Refining Treasure Diary Page 3, The Unwilling Han Yongchun_2
Translator: 549690339
Summary: The ancestor unleashed his divine might, and the demon spirit knelt to beg for mercy.
On the fourth day of refining the treasure: Ancestor Han visited this ruin for the last time. He planned to completely refine the treasure today, take it with him, and from now on, it would join him in his battles across the heavens.
This time, while refining the treasure, Ancestor Han found that the spirit of the Devil Sword wasn’t resisting at all. It let him do as he pleased. No matter how Ancestor Han operated or provoked, the demon spirit bowed its head in submission, not daring to compete with Ancestor Han.
Ultimately, Ancestor Han showed mercy and spared the demon spirit. He didn’t destroy it, allowing it to continue controlling the Devil Sword.
After leaving the ruins, Ancestor Han decided to test the might of the Devil Sword. He infused it with a large amount of True Yuan and felt a smoothness as if it were new, without any resistance. He could say the handfeel was very good.
Summary: The demon spirit submitted, willingly becoming the Ancestor’s weapon.
After successfully refining the ancient supreme treasure, the Witch’s Devil Sword, Ancestor Han carried the Devil Sword back to his sleeping chamber and wrote this artifact-refining journal.
It recorded the process of Ancestor Han refining the Devil Sword, displayed his invincible demeanor in the battle of wits and courage with the sword, and even included illustrations of various positions in which he mastered it.
“Huh~”
Ancestor Han exhaled deeply, closing the artifact-refining journal, with a great sense of accomplishment on his face.
He looked back and saw the Devil Sword lying there obediently, as if its might had been drained by Ancestor Han, no longer able to be utilized.
However, Ancestor Han knew this was temporary. Once the Devil Sword absorbed the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, it would return to its peak state, and then it could be used to wage wars across myriad realms.
Putting away the refining journal, Ancestor Han vanished from the sleeping chamber and appeared on the peak of Chengdao Peak.
Looking at the beautiful sunset, Ancestor Han felt refreshed and said aloud, “The great task is completed, Ancestor Han has finally refined the third supreme treasure.”
Of course, the matter of the supreme treasures couldn’t be leaked. Ancestor Han had already set up a True Yuan barrier in advance to ensure that no sound could escape.
While watching the sunset, Han Li thought about how to find other supreme treasures. He knew the whereabouts of several more, one of which was a dragon-shaped treasure whose might far surpassed that of the Devil Sword. Ancestor Han didn’t dare to confront it for the time being.
As the saying goes: To serve well, you must first pave the way.
Ancestor Han was indeed a great benefactor, renowned throughout Da Qian, either cultivating fertile lands or building bridges, with a resounding reputation.
Thinking of this, Ancestor Han thought of his three beloved wives. Each one of them possessed high talent, and most importantly, they each had powerful weapons.
The demoness Lu Tianxiang had the Heavenly Fragrance Whip, the Sword Immortal Jiang Baiye had the Ice Crystal Sword, and the witch Yun Miaoyi had the Devil Sword Spring Rain.
“When will I ever have a Heaven Rank Divine Sword?” Han Li wondered silently.
The Zhenjun Sword was only an Earth-Level Supreme Magical Artifact and couldn’t unleash his full power. If he had a Heaven Rank Divine Sword, his combat ability would rise to the next level.
After a sigh, Ancestor Han disappeared from the peak of Chengdao Peak, planning to go and play with Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang, to see how the children in their bellies were doing.
Yuanzhou, Leiyuan Manor.
The spiritual energy of Leiyuan Manor was much stronger than that of Yonchang Manor, ranking in the middle in Yuanzhou. The manor attracted many forces, including several of the Gangyuan Realm.
The Zhou Family was one of these Gangyuan Realm forces. They ran into big trouble last time and offered triplets Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhirou, and Zhou Zhixuan to Ancestor Han of the Han Family. With the influence of Ancestor Han, they managed to resolve the situation.
In the manor city, the Zhou Family had a great reputation and deep foundations, recruiting many Guest Elders. After establishing relations with the Han Family, the Zhou Family’s influence further expanded, with the potential to become the first force outside the city lord’s manor.
At this moment, at the entrance of the Zhou Family residence, there came a handsome young man dressed in green clothes with a long sword hanging from his waist.
This young man was named Han Yongchun, the first concubine that Han Li took after his breakthrough to the Pihai Realm, and was the son of Li Mingmeng.
Li Mingmeng was known as the most beautiful woman in Lingjun City, with an outstanding appearance. Han Li was also handsome and graceful. Han Yongchun inherited the excellent genes of both parents and was extraordinarily handsome.
His talent, however, was somewhat lacking, as he was born during times when Han Li’s cultivation level and talents were both on the lower side, featuring a mere Eighth Grade aptitude.
In the early days, the Han Mansion lacked comprehensive conditions for nurturing its descendants, so Han Li sent him to cultivate at Tianxuan Mountain. With the aid of Han Li’s connections and the resources of the Han Family, Han Yongchun managed a decent life.
When Han Li summoned his descendants to return, Han Yongchun followed suit. En route to moving, he listened to Han Li’s lectures and gained enlightenment on many cultivation issues, which further enhanced his abilities.
By the time they reached Yonchang Manor at Chengsheng Mountain, he had taken a wife and two concubines, both the wife and the concubines possessing Eighth and Ninth Grade aptitude respectively, with quite high levels of attractiveness.
For a while, Han Yongchun became immersed in the tenderness of his beautiful wives and concubines until he saw that his father had given him several more siblings with very high aptitude, which jolted him awake.
He realized that if he continued his decline, his life would just be this way, and his father wouldn’t give him much more resources for cultivation; he’d be trapped in the Innate Realm forever, passing away after two hundred years.
As for those siblings born in recent years, with their exceptionally high aptitude, they would surely make rapid progress as soon as they began to cultivate. In the future, they could become real beings of the God Refining Realm, Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage, or even Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, living for hundreds or even thousands of years.
Han Yongchun was not content with this prospect.
At times, he would also blame his mother Li Mingmeng, because of her poor aptitude, which contributed to his own shortcomings. If his mother had been Lin Yiwu or Lu Tianxiang, his talent would certainly have been much higher.
Yet, Han Yongchun also knew this was unchangeable. He felt more gratitude towards his mother, Li Mingmeng, because she had fought for many benefits on his behalf from his father, providing him with ample cultivation resources, allowing him to smoothly reach the Innate Realm.
Jolted into awareness, Han Yongchun contemplated his future path. With poor aptitude, he could not enter into the Han Family’s key cultivation program. His indulgence in the pleasures of women had lasted for quite some time, and in his father’s eyes, he probably lacked any real talent.
Nevertheless, Han Yongchun refused to be merely a tool for the Han Family to propagate its lineage, unwilling to die discontent after two hundred years. Thus, he sought out his mother, Li Mingmeng, requesting her guidance.
Li Mingmeng could not directly help him either. She had four children, and Han Yongchun was just one of them, while Han Li had nearly two hundred. With Han Yongchun’s poor aptitude and his indulgence in women, she couldn’t give him a lot of cultivation resources, or how would the other children see it?
Therefore, Li Mingmeng suggested that Han Yongchun try to comprehend the sect’s stone steles and go to Enlightenment Peak to contemplate the Enlightenment Stone; if he managed to understand something, he would be placed on the priority list for cultivation.
Han Yongchun first went to comprehend the stone steles at the mountain gate, then to Enlightenments Stone. After two straight months, whether through good fortune or exceptional insight, he actually managed to grasp something.
Sitting in meditation below the Enlightenment Stone, he entered an Enlightenment State and saw an extremely powerful figure practicing myriad techniques with ease, grasping the true essence of martial arts, catching stars and seizing the moon, terrifying to the extreme.
When he awoke from this realization, he found that he had broken through to the peak of the Innate Realm and swiftly understood that he had grasped the forming of an unwavering blade intent.
Overjoyed, Han Yongchun rushed to Chengdao Peak to share the news with his mother, Li Mingmeng, who also had good news for him. His father, Han Li, had taken note of his efforts and, recognizing his insight, had granted him a Pihai Pill to aid his breakthrough to the Pihai Realm.
Upon receiving the Pihai Pill and returning home, Han Yongchun immediately consumed and refined it, successfully breaking into the Pihai Realm.
After his cultivation breakthrough, he once again went to the mountain gate steles and Enlightenment Peak to seek understanding but found no progress over three continuous months.
Taking the opportunity during one of Han Li’s teachings, Han Yongchun cautiously asked for insights, and Han Li solved his dilemma on the spot, explaining that what he lacked was experience and that he needed to undergo trials.
Previously, Han Yongchun’s heart was filled with a profound sense of dissatisfaction and unwavering resolve, which allowed him to comprehend the nascent form of unwavering blade intent. However, upon advancing to the Pihai Realm, his unfaltering spirit was no longer sufficient, naturally preventing further comprehension.
Han Li informed him that if he wished to achieve great success in the future, he must venture out to gain experience and could not stay sheltered in the comfort of the Han Family. If he decided to go out, Han Li would provide him with some life-saving items.
After much deliberation, Han Yongchun resolved himself three days later. He was determined to cultivate to higher realms, to witness the higher vistas, to live longer.
He also wished for his wives and concubines to live longer and to create better cultivation conditions for his children. He had to venture out alone; otherwise his father’s cultivation support would end there.
Now over thirty years old, Han Yongchun’s achievement of reaching the Pihai Realm with just Eighth Grade aptitude was extremely rapid. But he knew this was due to the excellent cultivation conditions of the Han Family. Without them, he feared he might not have reached the Pihai Realm even at the age of one hundred on Tianxuan Mountain.
Having made his decision, Han Yongchun bid farewell to Han Li and Li Mingmeng, to his wives, concubines, and children, and left the Han Family. He arrived at Leiyuan Manor City.
His aunt, Zhou Zhiruo, told him that if he wasn’t sure where to go for his journey of experience, he could start with the Zhou Family of Leiyuan Manor, where he would be offered some help.

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 150 Han Yongchun’s Choice, Han Laozu’s Scheme, Something Big Has Happened_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 150 Han Yongchun’s Choice, Han Laozu’s Scheme, Something Big Has Happened_1
Translator: 549690339
When Han Yongchun announced his family name, he was promptly welcomed into Zhou Manor.
A maid escorted him to the main hall of the Zhou family and brought fine Spiritual Tea for his tasting, with a plate of Spirit Fruits placed nearby.
Han Yongchun casually picked up a fruit and took a bite, finding that it wasn’t as good as those in Han Mansion; the content of Spiritual Energy was only about a third, and he shook his head silently.
Indeed, the Zhou family’s Gangyuan Realm influence was far inferior to his own, the Zhou family’s patriarch was only in the mid-stage of the Gangyuan Realm, and his life span was less than thirty years remaining.
His own father’s strength far surpassed that of the Zhou family’s patriarch. Before he left home, his mother Li Mingmeng had let slip some news that his father was about to break through to the Hollow Void Stage and become a Grandmaster.
Knowing that Han Yongchun was heading out to gain experience, Li Mingmeng was somewhat worried and decided to give him some assurance, yet she did not dare to reveal Han Li’s Hollow Void Stage cultivation outright.
At that moment, a lavishly dressed middle-aged man strode into the main hall, his eyes lighting up upon seeing Han Yongchun, and he immediately called out,
“Young Master Han.”
Han Yongchun recognized his identity and responded with a courtesy, “Chief Zhou.”
“Young Master’s visit to our Zhou Manor is an honor, bringing glory to our manor,” said Chief Zhou, holding Han Yongchun’s hand with great warmth.
Han Yongchun was slightly taken aback by the honored treatment; he wasn’t paid much attention to within the Han Family, and he hadn’t expected to be treated so highly outside. Was the Han Mansion’s reputation really that impressive?
With his thoughts racing, Han Yongchun withdrew his hand and said, “You flatter me, Manor Lord.”
After some casual conversation with Han Yongchun to close the distance, Chief Zhou then said, “I’m already aware of the purpose of your visit, Young Master, and indeed, the Zhou family can provide some assistance.”
Han Yongchun was overjoyed and asked eagerly, “What can Zhou Manor do for me?”
Although he had left home to gain experience, he felt quite at a loss, not knowing where to go or what to do to achieve the desired effect of his journey.
Chief Zhou’s eyebrows rose, realizing that it was normal for Han Yongchun, who was just starting out, to be unversed in worldly affairs, and did not mind his tone as he said directly,
“There are three options: first, Young Master could help escort a batch of precious spiritual materials to neighboring Tian Yong Mansion. There might be trouble along the way, which the Young Master could resolve with ease.”
“Second, one of my Zhou Manor’s exploration teams has discovered a small-scale ruin deep within Mangyang Mountain, which seems to contain a Lower Grade Spirit Stone Mine. Young Master can go and help explore the ruin and assist our Zhou Manor in securing the Spirit Stone Mine.”
“Third, Young Master can temporarily join the Zhou family as a Guest Elder, helping to deal with some troubles within the Manor City.”
Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhirou, and Zhou Zhixuan are his daughters, and before Han Yongchun’s arrival, Zhou Zhiruo had already sent back the news, asking her father to lend a hand.
After discussing with the elder patriarch, Chief Zhou agreed.
The current situation is chaotic, but Yonchang Manor still respects Han Mansion. Zhou Manor’s ability to withstand pressure is still too weak. If Han Mansion could offer more support, it would be far easier to navigate the upcoming turmoil.
He was aware that his three daughters were quite favored by Elder Han, but Elder Han’s speed in taking wives and concubines was too rapid, and having just married another, his three precious daughters, being merely concubines, would likely not be favored for long.
Therefore, Chief Zhou also wanted to further strengthen the relationship with Han Mansion, and this was a good opportunity. He wasn’t quite sure about Young Master Han Yongchun’s capacity for risk, so he presented three options with varying degrees of risk.
Han Yongchun was in the Pihai Realm and, although he had just made his breakthrough not long ago, his strength was not weak in Yonchang Manor.
Faced with the three choices given by Chief Zhou, Han Yongchun hesitated. The third option had the least risk, followed by the first, and the second had the greatest risk; the potential for cultivation experience was similarly scaled.
He initially wanted to choose the third option, to have an easy transition, but considering his poor talent and seemingly low aptitude, he knew he had to work hard or he might really not have a chance to distinguish himself in the future.
Before setting out for his journey, his father Han Li had given him three trump cards to use in case he encountered danger, which could save his life three times—this was Han Yongchun’s greatest assurance.
Therefore, he chose the second option to explore the small ruin and compete for the Spirit Stone Mine.
Compared to cultivators of the same realm, Han Yongchun was somewhat confident in his strength. His family’s Han Mansion was the strongest force in Yonchang Manor, his Cultivation Techniques and martial prowess were also far superior to those of other forces within the manor, and he had sufficient Spirit Pills and powerful Spiritual Artifacts.
Although he was only at the first level of the Pihai Realm, Han Yongchun felt that his strength should be equivalent to an ordinary Pihai Realm third-level and could reach even higher levels if he used secret techniques.
Chief Zhou looked at Han Yongchun in surprise; he had thought Han Yongchun would choose either the first or the third option, not the second, which was the riskiest.
After some thought, he warned, “Young Master Han, several Gangyuan Realm forces in Yonchang Manor are aware of the ruin in Mangyang Mountain. While there are no Great Masters from the Gangyuan Realm going there, there will definitely be cultivators in the late stages of the Pihai Realm…”
“Chief Zhou, rest assured. Even if I can’t defeat them, I am confident in preserving my life,” interjected Han Yongchun, understanding his concern.
“Very well, Young Master. Please wait here for two days, and then you will proceed to Mangyang Mountain with our Zhou Manor’s team.”
Since Han Yongchun was insistent on participating, Chief Zhou didn’t try to persuade him further. After all, Han Yongchun was born into the Han Family, the son of Elder Han. Even if not much regarded, he would surely have some trump cards for his first journey, which could also bring considerable assistance to Zhou Manor.
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi were soaking in a hot spring, surrounded by various floating flower petals.

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 150 Han Yongchun’s Choice, Old Ancestor Han’s Plot, Big Trouble Arises_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 150 Han Yongchun’s Choice, Old Ancestor Han’s Plot, Big Trouble Arises_2
Translator: 549690339
It was evident that Jiang Baiye’s belly was quite distended, and while Lu Tianxiang was pregnant as well, it was early days, and her lower abdomen hardly showed.
Yun Miaoyi’s lower abdomen was still as flat as a plain; she had only been married into the Han Mansion for a few days. Although she had been thoroughly conquered by Han Li, and he had successfully sown his seed, it would still be a long while before her lower abdomen would show any apparent signs.
Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye had become Han Li’s wives one after another, yet their relationship wasn’t very close. With Yun Miaoyi’s arrival, she acted as the lubricant among them, and the three women quickly became good friends.
Otherwise, for old ancestor Han to enjoy a hot spring bath with his three ladies, it would be a long and arduous road ahead, with no telling how many years it would take to achieve.
While Han Li was contemplating his future strategies and mulling over his plans, he took pleasure in admiring the exceptional beauty of the three women. During their hot spring bath, they only covered the vital parts, leaving large expanses of their skin, flawless like white jade, bathing in the sunlight and the warmth of the spring.
“My lord, elder sister Mingmeng’s elder son has gone out to gain experience, and she is quite worried. Aren’t you going to comfort her?”
Yun Miaoyi shifted her position, her tone lazy.
After agreeing to become Han Li’s wife and going through all the procedures, Yun Miaoyi had wholeheartedly accepted her new identity, constantly addressing him as ‘my lord’.
Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang frowned slightly; they found this form of address too cloying and could never bring themselves to say it, wondering how the sorceress Yun Miaoyi could do it.
“No need,”
Han Li shook his head slightly, his tone indifferent, not particularly concerned about Han Yongchun’s situation.
This was the path chosen by Han Yongchun himself, not willing to produce many offspring in the Han Mansion, aspiring to stand out; then he had to fight and make his own way.
Han Li wouldn’t bestow vast resources on any descendant without cause; unless they demonstrated their worth, whether it be talent, insight, ability, or…
The resources of the Han Mansion were limited; it was impossible to cater to all descendants. Some had to be prioritized for cultivation, and the others who were not content had to fight for recognition, to show Han Li their effort and achievements.
It was like this now and would be so in the future. As his progeny would increase, the competition would intensify. As long as the intensity remained reasonable, Han Li wouldn’t intervene.
He had given Han Yongchun three treasures, capable of protecting his life thrice. If he still couldn’t extract a good training outcome from that, Han Yongchun ought to return and focus on continuing the lineage, in the hopes of raising a child who would achieve greatness.
When Han Li first arrived in this world, he started with nothing and had to strive for everything on his own. Even the opportunity to join Tianxuan Mountain was hard-earned through great hardship.
The old ancestor had fought for his success and founded the vast Han Mansion; his descendants were beneficiaries who had a far higher starting point than he had had.
Yun Miaoyi smiled without saying much, and Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang also nodded slightly, endorsing Han Li’s approach.
They were not worried that their children would lack priority in cultivation; they were wives of Han Li, possessing high cultivation levels and qualities, capable of securing excellent accommodations for their offspring.
Their children would not lack in talent and, with their support, they would be the pillars of the Han Mansion in the future. As per the rules of the Han Family, their descendants were listed for priority cultivation from birth.
This was a given from the start. For instance, Han Yongzhen, the first child of Lu Tianxiang, possessed Third Grade talent. With proper cultivation, he could very much hope to ascend to the True Martial Realm in the future. How could Han Li not cultivate him well?
“Now, the situation in the Daqian Empire grows increasingly chaotic, nearing collapse. Even with Chu Zhenxiong (the name of Chu Dingqian’s second form) straining to maintain it, it won’t last much longer. What’s your plan?”
Gazing at Han Li, Lu Tianxiang spoke up, wanting to know Han Li’s plans for the future.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi also looked at Han Li; they too were concerned about the precarious current state of affairs.
Once Chu Zhenxiong couldn’t hold on any longer, Yuanzhou was very likely to be annexed by the Yinyang Sect or Mysterious Forces. Under the rule of these two powers, it would be much more difficult for the Han Mansion to develop peacefully.
Among the three women, one was from the Yinyang Sect, another from Mysterious Forces. As long as their true identities remained concealed, the Han Family risked attracting serious trouble.
Although Han Li was at the True Martial Realm, he had just made the breakthrough and his strength within the realm wasn’t strong. How could he possibly stand against the True Martial Realm Emperor Wu of the Yinyang Sect and Mysterious Forces?
Though the Yinyang Sect merely has two warriors of the True Martial Realm, behind them the Demon Clan possesses a large number of warriors not only in the True Martial Realm but even in the Divine Yuan Realm. There are even legends of powers in the Tongxuan Realm.
Lu Tianxiang, who comes from a Mysterious Forces, also has quite a few warriors in the True Martial Realm, and it’s suspected that there exist Divine Yuan Realm warriors. She understands just how strong the Mysterious Forces are—a colossus that secretly rules over one-third of the Chaotic Domain is most likely to have Divine Yuan Realm warriors.
After a slight hesitation, Han Li shared some of his thoughts, “I plan to change my identity to help the Daqian Empire.”
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi all had their pupils contract slightly. Was this the Han Li they knew?
In their minds, Han Li was cautious, cunning, and deceitful, but also very bold—daring enough to take them one by one to be his companions.
Han Li smiled and explained, “I’m highly confident that my identity won’t be exposed.”
“Daqian cannot rely solely on Chu Zhenxiong, whose life is not much longer; can he even live another fifty years? Such a warrior of the True Martial Realm cannot stabilize the situation of Daqian.”
“The powers from the Outer Twelve States that have withdrawn back to the Mid Six Province, as well as the local forces of the Mid Six Province, are all seeking a way out. They are still watching the situation and looking for new affiliations. If any of the four major forces can offer a good price, they definitely would not mind selling out the Daqian Empire.”
“The four major forces currently dare not touch the Mid Six Province, worrying that after Daqian’s collapse, Chu Zhenxiong might go mad. An unfettered mid-stage warrior of the True Martial Realm can be extremely terrifying.”
“But once Chu Zhenxiong dies, Daqian will be completely finished, and our Han Mansion won’t be able to continue to develop peacefully. Therefore, a warrior of the True Martial Realm must come forward to support the Daqian Empire.”
“If I were to change my identity and step forward, although I won’t be able to recapture the Outer Twelve States for Daqian, stabilizing the situation of Daqian should be no problem.”
“Then Daqian would have two warriors of the True Martial Realm as kings—one whose life is nearly over, but the other with a long life ahead, which would bring confidence to the internal forces of Daqian, and they wouldn’t act rashly.”
“After digesting the Outer Twelve States, the four major forces will also need time to assimilate, as it is a very large territory, and some of their True Martial Realm warriors are still trapped in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm and won’t further threaten Daqian.”
“For the next several decades, Daqian will just have me and Chu Zhenxiong in the highest positions. Once Chu Zhenxiong is dead, I will be the highest authority in Daqian. Whether it’s now or in the future, I can acquire vast benefits for us, for the Han Family.”
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi all nodded in agreement; they shared this opinion, but how could Han Li ensure his identity remained concealed?
Even if Han Li changed his identity, his martial skills wouldn’t change, and if he used them in his true form in the future, he would be exposed.
Yun Miaoyi voiced the doubts in her heart.
Han Li said, “I have my ways.”
These were too specific, and Han Li didn’t intend to inform them just yet. Perhaps another time.
All three women sneered. Han Li was still hiding something—just how many secrets was he keeping?
Compared to this, they were actually more curious about how Han Li had improved his cultivation so rapidly. Yun Miaoyi hadn’t been around long, but Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang had been with Han Li for quite some time, almost constantly.
The two women knew that the scoundrel had never actually cultivated, nor had they seen him use the Dual Cultivation Technique or the Collection and Supplement Method in battle. Yet, Han Li’s cultivation had soared rapidly, advancing his realm at lightning speed.
Before, they didn’t know the truth, but after Han Li informed them of his True Martial Realm cultivation, they realized that his cultivation level had skyrocketed in a very short period.
Although they were very curious, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi did not pry further. This was Han Li’s secret. If he didn’t want to share it with them, all the questioning in the world would be useless and might even damage the relationship between them.
Truth be told, they found this to be a good thing; Han Li’s rapid progress in cultivation was beneficial. It meant he could better protect them and safeguard the things they cared about in times of chaos.
For instance, Jiang Baiye was very pleased at heart. With Han Li in the True Martial Realm, if the Canghai Sect encountered an existential crisis, he could secretly help without causing trouble for Han Li, since warriors of the True Martial Realm were extremely powerful.
As Han Li was about to say something, his expression suddenly changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 151 Elder Han Displays Divine Might, Slashing a Mid-True Martial Realm with His Sword_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 151 Elder Han Displays Divine Might, Slashing a Mid-True Martial Realm with His Sword_1
Translator: 549690339
Leizhou, Tianxuan Mountain.
A gigantic Heavenly Cloud Boat spanned across the mountain range, with numerous Tianxuan Mountain Disciples transferring various cultivation resources into it, their expressions somewhat excited, as they were finally able to leave Leizhou.
Gongsun Yun, along with the three Ancestors, watched the bustling scene, their faces also showing signs of relief. In half an hour, everything would be ready, and the Heavenly Cloud Boat could commence its escape.
Before this, Tianxuan Mountain had been gathering disciples and all resources— they planned to take everything with them to make a faster comeback in a new place.
In recent days, the Da Qian Empire had already retreated a considerable distance. Huozhou and Qingzhou were nearly half evacuated, and in a few more days, they would be completely withdrawn to the Mid Six Province.
Leizhou had been under the Yinyang Sect’s rule for several days now, and the forces that did not follow or could not follow the Da Qian Imperial Army’s retreat could only accept the rule of the Yinyang Sect— this included Tianxuan Mountain as the most prominent among them.
The Four Sects of Leizhou: the Hehuan Sect was a branch of the Yinyang Sect and had acted as the vanguard during the invasion of Da Qian; both the True Sun Sect and the Sword Cleansing Pool had retreated with the Da Qian Empire, leaving only Tianxuan Mountain which had not retreated, but neither had it allied with the Yinyang Sect.
The forces in the Sanzhou region all knew that Tianxuan Mountain had three Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm return, which was Tianxuan Mountain’s backbone. However, not aligning with the Yinyang Sect, even several Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm couldn’t hold back the invasion of the Yinyang Sect.
Previously, the Yinyang Sect was occupied with taking over Leizhou and pursuing the Da Qian Imperial Army in Qingzhou and Huozhou, so they did not bother with Tianxuan Mountain, as it would stretch their power thin and reduce their achievements in the pursuit of Da Qian.
After all, Tianxuan Mountain had three to four Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, as well as the Mountain Protection Array. Without Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm taking action, it would take at least six or more Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm for the Yinyang Sect to breach Tianxuan Mountain.
The Third Elder, the Fourth Elder, and other leading commanders of the Yinyang Sect’s army thought it was not cost-effective. Tianxuan Mountain wasn’t going anywhere anyway. They preferred to wait until they had completely swallowed up Leizhou, Qingzhou, and Huozhou, and then turn back to pressure Tianxuan Mountain— that was the optimal choice.
It was a good plan, but a piece of intelligence forced the Third Elder to make changes. Tianxuan Mountain actually had a space-faring ship, which could enable the entire mountain to retreat. How could this be allowed?
The intention of the Third Elder and others was to coerce Tianxuan Mountain into submitting to the Yinyang Sect and to convert to following the Demon Path. If they refused, they would annihilate Tianxuan Mountain.
Now that Tianxuan Mountain entertained the notion of completely relocating, they naturally wouldn’t permit it. They not only wanted to keep Tianxuan Mountain but also to seize that space ship.
Capable of carrying the entire Tianxuan Mountain to retreat, its speed was at least comparable to that of the True Martial Realm— it was truly a treasured artifact. The Yinyang Sect did not possess such a ship; only the Demon Clan did.
Thus, after a discussion, the Fourth Elder immediately returned to the Yinyang Sect and called forth another Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm stationed at the Yinyang Sect’s Sect. The Third Elder continued leading the army to battle the Da Qian Empire, doing their utmost to eliminate Da Qian’s living forces.
“One more quarter-hour.”
Gongsun Yun and the three Ancestors’ expressions became increasingly relaxed; they would be able to retreat safely very soon.
Once the Heavenly Cloud Boat launched, even common strong practitioners in the middle stage of the True Martial Realm wouldn’t be able to catch up; they could only watch as they left.
“Yue, you should go up too,” Gongsun Yun said to Gongsun Yue behind him, his tone leaving no room for disagreement.
Gongsun Yue nodded slightly but did not insist any further. Since everyone would soon be leaving together, Gongsun Yun wouldn’t stay behind either.
She flew towards the Heavenly Cloud Boat, her purple dress billowing, her purple hair dancing in the wind, her figure radiating light, her charm natural and unrestrained— she instantly became the center of attention, drawing the gaze of all the disciples.
Qiu Shuilin snorted coldly, and the disciples came to their senses, no longer indulging in the beauty of Gongsun Yue, and continued with their tasks at hand.
“Half a quarter-hour more.”
Gongsun Yun exhaled a breath and turned to the three Ancestors, saying with a smile, “Sect Leader, and fellow Ancestors, let’s go up as well.”
The three Ancestors nodded their heads. The time was almost due, and everything that needed to be prepared was ready. The disciples of Tianxuan Mountain had mostly already boarded.
With a flash, they appeared at the bow of the Heavenly Cloud Boat, looking down at Tianxuan Mountain below, emotions running deep on their faces.
“The foundation laid down by the Sect Leader has ultimately not been preserved,” the Second Ancestor said with a hint of sorrow.
“There’s no need to be so downcast, Sect Founder. It’s only the gate of Tianxuan Mountain that we have lost. At least all else that belongs to Tianxuan Mountain remains intact. Once we leave the Da Qian Empire, it will be easy for our strength to re-establish itself in a new territory,” the Head of the Fourth Generation said with a chuckle, envisioning the future.
“Indeed, wait just a little longer, and we will be able to embark on our journey, freeing ourselves from the constraints of the Da Qian Empire— the sky will be high for the birds to soar, the sea vast for the fish to leap,” the Head of the Third Generation added.
Gongsun Yun’s face was filled with a smile, and just as he was about to speak, his expression abruptly changed. It wasn’t just him, the expressions of the three Ancestors changed at that moment as well.
“Leave? I don’t agree. No one from Tianxuan Mountain will get away today.”
A cold voice, full of murderous intent, pierced through the Array, echoing throughout Tianxuan Mountain, causing turmoil among all the Disciples on the Heavenly Cloud Boat.
“Hurry, go!”
“Ignore everything, start it immediately!”
Gongsun Yun and the others shouted as they activated the Heavenly Cloud Boat. They saw a figure in the distance of the sky, wrapped in dense demonic energy, with an overwhelming presence, steadily approaching Tianxuan Mountain.
That was undoubtedly an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm.
With every step he took, he closed a great distance to Tianxuan Mountain, and in just a few strides, he arrived at its perimeter. His overwhelming presence bore down on Tianxuan Mountain, causing the light of the Mountain Protection Array to flicker, on the verge of shattering.
At that moment, the Heavenly Cloud Boat had just launched, its arrays activated, ready to break away into the void, but in the next instant, the figure struck out with a palm. A blood-red giant palm shattered the Mountain Protection Array and slammed into the Heavenly Cloud Boat.

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - 151 Elder Han Displays Divine Might, Slashing a Mid-True Martial Realm with His Sword_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 151 Elder Han Displays Divine Might, Slashing a Mid-True Martial Realm with His Sword_2
Translator: 549690339
The protective shield of the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship started to show cracks one after another, and though it hadn’t shattered, the momentum of its escape had been disrupted.
“Not good.”
Gongsun Yun and the other three Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters’ expressions changed as they shouted, their energy bursting forth, striking with all their might.
“I and the three Honored Ancestors will block his attack; you all quickly activate the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship.”
Before the Tianxuan Mountain disciples like Qiu Shuilin could marvel at the fact that Sect Leader Gongsun Yun was a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, they immediately poured all their Gang Yuan and replenished Spirit Stones to power the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship, restoring its protective shield and restarting it to prepare for their escape.
The Devil Powerhouse did not stop after striking with a palm, and with another palm strike he intended to hold back everyone from Tianxuan Mountain.
Gongsun Yun and the three Honored Ancestors continuously took action, each bringing out their weapons, the Xuantian Punch, the God Slaying Sword Technique, the Great Mysterious Palm… one after another, powerful martial arts techniques were unleashed by them.
Boom boom boom!
Yet this was to no avail, as the Bloody Demon Palm blot out the sky and covered a vast expanse of the heavens, with boundless devilish Qi surging tumultuously. The attacks from Gongsun Yun and others were erased upon contact, and even their weapons fell, each showing minute cracks.
“A Devil Powerhouse at the mid True Martial Realm!”
Gongsun Yun and the others were horrified. The attacker was definitely an Emperor Wu from the Yinyang Sect at the mid True Martial Realm, otherwise there was no way their attacks would be so easily obliterated.
In their horror, Gongsun Yun and the other four Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm struck again, even employing Secret Techniques to make their auras climb higher and higher, continuously unleashing powerful martial arts, all to block this one Bloody Demon Palm.
Boom!
Gongsun Yun and the other four Great Grandmasters simultaneously spat out blood, flying backward and smashing into the Tianxuan Mountain Range, creating a large crater.
“Father!”
“Sect Leader!”
“Honored Ancestor!”
On the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship, Gongsun Yue, Qiu Shuilin, and other Tianxuan Mountain Elders and disciples cried out in shock, their expressions filled with sorrow.
The power of the Bloody Demon Palm weakened considerably, continuing to strike at the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship and part of the Tianxuan Mountain Range. The mountain range was directly shattered, a large area collapsing to form a chasm.
The light screen of the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship flickered incessantly, dense cracks quickly appeared, causing the people of Tianxuan Mountain inside the ship to be utterly panic-stricken.
They fought desperately to activate the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship, straining to maintain the light screen, daring not let it shatter, otherwise almost all of the people from Tianxuan Mountain within the ship would be annihilated.
Fortunately, they truly managed to block it, and as their True Qi and Gang Yuan were nearly depleted, the might of the Bloody Demon Palm finally ran out.
Before they could even breathe a sigh of relief, the towering figure in the devilish sky flipped his hand for another palm strike, his expression extremely cold, showing absolutely no regard for their lives.
“No!”
“Yue’er!”
Gongsun Yun and the three Honored Ancestors saw this scene, their eyes nearly splitting with rage, but having just been severely injured by that palm strike, their strength greatly diminished, they were already unable to support the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship.
“Alas, fellow Daoist, why must you be so ruthless.”
At this moment, a voice full of compassion for the world rose between heaven and earth, accompanied by a glorious sword light. That sword light sealed the heavens and the earth, eliminating everything, and directly exploded the Bloody Demon Palm.
A rare emotion finally appeared on the cold and merciless face of Dugu Bing, as he slightly frowned, somewhat surprised looking toward the figure approaching from afar.
The man was dressed in black, a refined middle-aged person with a Divine Sword on his back – the radiant sword light just now had been wielded by him.
Dugu Bing’s eyes flashed with a hint of blood as he tried to see through the man’s true face, but discovered it obscured by the mighty power of the Divine Spirit, completely impenetrable.
“You who hide your face while showing your tail, reveal your name. I do not strike down the nameless under my spear.”
A Devil Spear appeared in the hands of Dugu Bing, blood-red throughout, engraved with a series of mysterious patterns. The Devil Spear pointed from afar at the refined middle-aged man.
“Fellow Daoist, peace is precious. Fighting and killing isn’t good,” said the refined middle-aged man as he appeared above the Tianxuan Mountain, speaking with a smile to Dugu Bing, without giving his name. He was, in fact, Han Li.
He had just been enjoying a hot spring at Chengdao Peak when he sensed the great booming from the direction of Leizhou, a sure sign of an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm in action. Only the disturbance from a True Martial Realm fight could travel so far.
Without hesitation, Han Li disappeared from Chengsheng Mountain, and upon reaching the border of Jizhou and Qingzhou, he could see from afar the Devil Powerhouse dealing a heavy blow to Gongsun Yun and the other four, suppressing the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship.
He stepped directly into the realm of Divine Sense, which drastically increased his speed, and in an extremely short period of time, he crossed a million miles and immediately released a slash. His sword strike exploded the Bloody Demon Palm, saving the people of Tianxuan Mountain.
“Since you are courting death, I shall oblige you,” Dugu Bing shouted angrily, the Bloody Devil Spear piercing out heavily.
The blood-colored spear light mingled with the spear intent to form a blood-red dragon thousands of zhang long. The dragon roared, with a dragon’s cry shaking heaven and earth, attacking Han Li.
Han Li sighed, the Zhenjun Sword on his back flying out, and with a slash at the blood-colored dragon, the sword light was magnificent, creating a storm of Sword Intent sweeping across heaven and earth, suppressing everything.
Boom boom boom~
The storm of Sword Intent devoured the blood-colored dragon, continuing its assault towards Dugu Bing, who with a mere flip of his hand, quelled it.
“You have some skill, but if you think you can stop me from killing, you’re far from capable,” said Dugu Bing indifferently.
Han Li raised an eyebrow; this Emperor Wu from the Yinyang Sect really liked to put on airs, exuding an air of condescension, looking down upon everything.
Yet, upon close observation, Han Li realized that this person was only at the fourth level of the True Martial Realm. Although he was an Emperor Wu in the mid True Martial Realm, compared to himself, he was still lacking.

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - 151 Elder Han Displays Divine Might, Slashing a Mid-True Martial Realm with His Sword_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 151 Elder Han Displays Divine Might, Slashing a Mid-True Martial Realm with His Sword_3
Translator: 549690339
He had been holding back, hoping to give the Martial Emperor of the Yinyang Sect face and spare Tianxuan Mountain.
Han Li did not want to kill him here, as that would complicate matters enormously. The death of a mid-True Martial Realm Martial Emperor would definitely invite relentless investigation by the Demon Clan.
Even if he could escape detection, Tianxuan Mountain would not be able to, and would certainly be annihilated by the Demon Clan. Then his intervention today would be meaningless.
Down below, the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship hovered above the shattered Tianxuan Mountain Range, with everyone on board watching the scene in trepidation, unsure if the refined middle-aged man would continue to make a move.
If this True Martial Realm Martial Emperor were to retreat, their death today would be certain.
“Who is he? Why has he come to save us?”
Qiu Shuilin, Gongsun Yun, and the others were surprised and suddenly wondered about this issue. Tianxuan Mountain had no True Martial Realm Martial Emperors, with the strongest being the three Ancestral Masters who had returned.
Could this person be the Founding Ancestral Master of Tianxuan Mountain?
In the large pit, Gongsun Yun and the three Ancestral Masters were also guessing the identity of the refined middle-aged man. They knew he was definitely not the founding ancestor, as the first-generation master had long since died.
But with no ties to them, why would he extend his help? Was it simply because he could not stand by and watch injustice or was it to vanquish demons and protect the Tao?
“I had originally intended to spare your life, but why do you persist in uttering provocative words before me?”
Before his words had even faded, Han Li had already made his move. His right hand grasped the Zhenjun Sword, unleashing a powerful sword technique recorded in the Sealing Heaven Sword Canon.
From above the nine heavens, a long river of Sword Intent surged downward. With towering waves of Sword Intent and resplendent sword light spanning millions of miles, it carried the terrifying might capable of sealing all laws as it bore down upon Dugu Bing.
Seal the heavens! Seal the gods! Seal the demons! Seal the Buddhas! Seal the immortals!
Dugu Bing’s pupils constricted sharply as he sensed a formidable threat. With no time for idle talk, he immediately executed the Magic Blood Technique, causing his vital blood to burn wildly while significantly boosting his aura.
The Bloody Devil Spear in his hands spun, and one after another blood-colored wheels appeared, growing larger and more numerous, clashing with the river of Sword Intent.
Boom!
The river of Sword Intent surged furiously, and endless sword light burst forth, shattering all the blood-colored wheels and slamming heavily against Dugu Bing.
Dugu Bing spat out a mouthful of blood as the impact hurled him backward, crashing into the Tianxuan Mountain Range and causing large swaths of mountains to explode.
Hum!
Two brilliant sword lights shone forth again, slashing towards the severely wounded Dugu Bing, who, despite his injuries, coerced his Blood Demon Undying Body to function, and, wielding the bloody spear, tried to fend off the two sword attacks.
Spurt, spurt~
The Devil Spear was sent flying, Dugu Bing’s left arm was severed, and he was left with a gaping wound that was visible from both the front and the back. The Sealing Heaven Sword Intent rampaged within his body, frantically sealing his True Yuan.
Seeing another two sword strikes coming, Dugu Bing did not dare to resist and instantly executed the Blood Demon Escape Technique, escaping over a million miles in the blink of an eye, vanishing into the distance.
After using the Blood Demon Technique twice in succession, he entered deeper into the territory of the Yinyang Sect before finally stopping.
He looked back and realized the refined middle-aged man had not pursued him, feeling extremely frustrated. This time, he had suffered a severe setback.
Not only did he fail to seize Tianxuan Mountain and capture the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship, but he also sustained serious injuries, losing an arm, and particularly after using the Blood Demon Technique twice.
Although the Blood Demon Technique was a divine skill for escaping, it came with significant side effects. Employing it twice in a row had caused his cultivation to regress to the third layer of the True Martial Realm.
“If only I had given him face and not spoken so many provocative words,” Dugu Bing was filled with regret. He took one last glance and turned, not looking back as he returned to the Yinyang Sect’s gates.

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - 152: Tremors in the Xuan Domain, The Thoughts of Senior Sister Gongsun Yue_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 152: Tremors in the Xuan Domain, The Thoughts of Senior Sister Gongsun Yue_1
Translator: 549690339
In the sky above Tianxuan Mountain.
Han Li quietly watched the escaping Devil Powerhouse, with no intention to pursue.
If that person hadn’t insisted on showing off in front of him, he really wouldn’t have wanted to fight. It would have been better to stay hidden and possibly reset this disguise.
Now that he had used the Seal Heaven Scripture several times, those watching from the Myriad Phenomena Realm and the True Martial Realm had taken note, and if he used the Seal Heaven Scripture again under this guise, it would be immediately recognized.
“Ah, wouldn’t it be better to be peaceful?” Han Li sighed.
His strongest disguise had been exposed, and the Devil Powerhouse had also paid a heavy price, not to mention being struck by his sword multiple times. That last blood escape was definitely going to have serious repercussions.
Otherwise, how could a mid-stage True Martial Realm powerhouse suddenly burst forth with a speed that matched that of an Emperor Wu from the Divine Yuan Realm?
It must be said, Old Ancestor Han also felt a bit envious. Although the technique had serious side effects, it was indeed a life-saving divine skill, comparable to his speed when he entered Divine Sense.
“Cough cough~”
“Thank you, senior, for your righteous assistance.”
Gongsun Yun and the others coughed up blood, forcefully suppressing their injuries, flew into the sky, and were about to respectfully salute Han Li.
With a gentle flick of his sleeve, Han Li interrupted their salutes, and they could only look at Han Li helplessly as he said indifferently:
“I have quite a connection with the Founding Ancestral Master of your Tianxuan Mountain. In the past, he took great care of me. Today, with Tianxuan Mountain in crisis, I naturally would not stand by and watch without helping. There is no need for such formalities.”
Gongsun Yun was his mentor, and the other three were all Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, each with higher cultivation levels than the last, seeming like successive heads of Tianxuan Mountain. Naturally, Han Li could not accept their salutations.
He also provided the backstory he had thought of for his disguise and deliberately connected it to the Ancestral Master of Tianxuan Mountain.
In this way, the outside world would believe that Tianxuan Mountain had gained the support of a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, and typical top-tier forces would not easily make a move against Tianxuan Mountain.
After all, there was a powerful True Martial Realm expert behind Tianxuan Mountain who almost killed a mid-stage True Martial Realm Devil Powerhouse in a disagreement.
Gongsun Yun and the others exchanged glances, puzzled about when the long-deceased Founding Ancestral Master had befriended a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, but they could only let it go and not continue the formalities.
“Senior’s kindness will never be forgotten by all within Tianxuan Mountain, throughout the ages.”
Gongsun Yun and the three Ancestral Masters said in a deep voice, their tone extremely sincere, coming straight from the heart.
Just then, they had nearly lost all hope. A mid-stage True Martial Realm Devil Powerhouse was terrifyingly potent; they had been defeated effortlessly. Had not the senior taken action, everyone in Tianxuan Mountain would have died right there.
Han Li nodded slightly, about to say something, when he saw a strikingly beautiful woman with purple hair and a purple gown flying over, stopping beside Gongsun Yun.
“Father, are you alright?”
While asking, Gongsun Yue also began healing Gongsun Yun with Gang Yuan.
“Yue girl, you only care for your father. What about us?” the three Ancestral Masters said with a sour tone; they had been seriously injured as well.
“Three Ancestral Masters, I wish I could help too, but I really can’t,” Gongsun Yue said, sticking out her tongue slightly, looking somewhat embarrassed. She wanted to heal the three Ancestral Masters, but her abilities were not enough.
Just healing her father Gongsun Yun was already stretching her Gang Yuan to its limits; after all, Gongsun Yun was a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, while she was only at the Peak of Gangyuan Realm.
Seeing his beautiful senior sister appear, Han Li suddenly discovered that Gongsun Yue had such a playful side. He thought about taking out a few Spirit Pills, but he realized that the highest-quality pills he had only reached the sixth-grade level of the God Refining Realm.
A sixth-grade Spirit Pill was something he really couldn’t present; it wouldn’t fit his current status and would greatly reduce his prestige, so Han Li silently abandoned the idea.
The three Ancestral Masters were just griping; now that they were safe, they immediately took out Healing Pills to consume, all of which were Fourth Grade Spiritual Pills brought back from the Tai Xuan Sect.
Gongsun Yun stopped Gongsun Yue’s healing, also taking out two Fourth Grade Spiritual Pills to consume and refine. In no time, their auras recovered considerably, and their complexions looked much rosier.
Gongsun Yue looked towards the refined middle-aged man not far away, biting her red lips, a bold idea flashing through her mind, but she hesitated to speak it out.
Han Li glanced at his senior sister Gongsun Yue briefly before returning his gaze. Now he had to maintain the image of a lofty figure, not a lecherous ancestor, and so must maintain his prestige.
He had intentions towards Gongsun Yue, wishing his senior sister would also become his Dao companion, but he couldn’t express such desires in his current guise.
Looking at the huge flying ship below, Han Li’s Spiritual Sense conducted a sweep and a hint of surprise flickered in his eyes. That was actually a spatial magical treasure. He finally understood why Tianxuan Mountain hadn’t evacuated with the Daqian Empire.
It turned out they had planned to use the Heavenly Sky Vessel to escape, bringing along everything from Tianxuan Mountain. Unfortunately, things had not gone as hoped, and they had been just a bit short of success.
“What are your plans for the future?” Han Li asked.
The three Ancestral Masters looked at Gongsun Yun, who gave a helpless smile and said, “We originally planned to leave the Qian Dynasty aboard the Heavenly Sky Vessel and settle elsewhere, but we were intercepted by that Emperor Wu from the Yinyang Sect just as we were about to leave.”
“Had it not been for the senior’s help, we would all be dead now,” Gongsun Yun said, his expression somber.
He had been a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm for quite some time, keeping it a secret and only displaying the capabilities of a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage. But even against a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, he couldn’t last for a single move, unable to protect the people of Tianxuan Mountain.
“Let’s go, I will escort you for a distance and guard your path for a hundred years,” Han Li said after hesitating for a moment.
Escorting them a distance was true, but guarding for a hundred years was false. In time, he would pretend to enter seclusion in the new Tianxuan Mountain and quietly leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - 152: Tremors in the Xuan Domain, The Thoughts of Senior Sister Gongsun Yue_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 152: Tremors in the Xuan Domain, The Thoughts of Senior Sister Gongsun Yue_2
Translator: 549690339
The outside world still believed he was staying at the new Tianxuan Mountain, so they naturally didn’t dare to provoke a True Martial Realm power lightly. Tianxuan Mountain also had ample time to develop and settle.
Wait a few decades or a hundred years, and his strength probably would have advanced to the Divine Yuan Realm. At that time, he could just make an appearance at Tianxuan Mountain.
“Many thanks, senior.”
“We at Tianxuan Mountain will never forget the great kindness and great virtue of the senior.”
Gongsun Yun and the three founding ancestral masters were overjoyed. They immediately spoke, their faces full of excitement.
With the escort of this powerful True Martial Realm figure, they would be able to safely reach their destination, and they would have enough time to develop. A middle-phase True Martial Realm personally vowing to protect them for a century was like a golden signboard, Tianxuan Mountain’s lifesaver.
Soon, Tianxuan Mountain made some brief arrangements and, under the protection of Han Li, set out anew towards their destination.
In recent days, Gongsun Yun and the others had already chosen a new place for Tianxuan Mountain; they intended to go to the territory of the Qitian Teaching.
To the north of the Daqian Empire was the Da Jing Empire, and to the northwest of the Da Jing Empire was the Ancient Empire, while to the northeast was the Qitian Teaching.
The Qitian Teaching’s ruling area was a quarter larger than the Daqian Empire’s. Like the Yinyang Sect, which was adjacent to the Devil Region, the Qitian Teaching was next to the Dao Domain, a chess piece of the Dao Sect in the Xuan Domain.
Tianxuan Mountain is considered a branch of the Taixuan Clan Dao Sect, so moving into the scope of the Qitian Teaching to develop is most appropriate. It would also distance them from the conflicts of the Daqian Empire, allowing for better growth. Additionally, it brought them much closer to the Dao Domain, which might even enable them to establish contact with the Tai Xuan Sect.
The three founding ancestral masters had no intention of returning to the Tai Xuan Sect. They couldn’t cultivate to the True Martial Realm there, so they planned to spend the rest of their days at Tianxuan Mountain, strengthening it.
Tianxuan Mountain, boasting four Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters, would be able to have a good development within the Qitian Teaching’s territory, essentially being equivalent to the first power under the Qitian Teaching.
Since the Qitian Teaching was a branch of the Dao Sect, it showed the least rejection towards Tianxuan Mountain. Tianxuan Mountain was also no threat to the Qitian Teaching’s status, after all, Han Li would not stay on Tianxuan Mountain forever.
The Heavenly Sky Plural Ship was incredibly fast, on par with the middle-phase True Martial Realm, and continued on its way towards the Qitian Teaching. As it passed through Yuanzhou, Han Li vanished for a moment to communicate with Lu Tianxiang and the other lovely wives and concubines at Chengsheng Mountain, then he returned to the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship.
Leizhou was located at the southernmost part of the Daqian Empire; the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship needed to traverse the entire Daqian Empire, then the Da Jing Empire before entering the Qitian Teaching territory—an incredibly distant journey, exceeding twenty million miles.
And to reach the destination chosen by Gongsun Yun, they still had to advance another six million miles after entering the Qitian Teaching territory, a total distance of twenty-six million miles.
The Heavenly Sky Plural Ship’s extreme speed was on par with the fifth heaven of the True Martial Realm, reaching three hundred and fifty thousand miles in a single breath. However, this required consuming a vast amount of Spirit Stones, burning one million lower-grade Spirit Stones in a breath’s time.
At this rate, the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship would need at most seventy-five breaths, requiring seventy-five million lower-grade Spirit Stones. Tianxuan Mountain naturally didn’t have so many Spirit Stones.
Over the years, Tianxuan Mountain had accumulated less than thirty million lower-grade Spirit Stones, which was not enough to support the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship for seventy-five breaths of flight, and Han Li didn’t need so long either.
According to the initial plan of Gongsun Yun and the others, it would suffice to maintain a speed equivalent to the regular Myriad Phenomena Realm. If they encountered an attack by the True Martial Realm, they would accelerate.
Moreover, they could also use their own Gang Yuan to substitute for the consumption of Spirit Stones, thereby significantly reducing the need for Spirit Stones.
Han Li naturally didn’t want to waste too much time, so he took action himself, channeling his own True Yuan into it, propelling the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship forward.
His True Yuan reserves were equivalent to the second heaven of the True Martial Realm. He only maintained the speed of the first heaven of the True Martial Realm for the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship’s flight, partly to avoid detection, and partly to conserve True Yuan for any possible attacks.
However, the journey was smooth. They encountered no attacks within the Daqian Empire, the Da Jing Empire, or upon entering the territory of the Qitian Teaching, as nobody wished to provoke a powerful True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
After Han Li and the others from Tianxuan Mountain left Leizhou on the Heavenly Sky Plural Ship, the strong onlookers disseminated the information of the battle at Leizhou, which quickly became known to all major powers.
Daqian Empire, Capital City.
Chu Dingqian sat cross-legged in a large hall of the Imperial Palace, feeling somewhat mentally and physically exhausted. He wanted to quit and find another place to plant the Devil Fetus, to possess and be reborn.
But, in doing so, his true body had to be well concealed after implanting the Devil Fetus; if it were accidentally discovered, all his efforts would be in vain.
And yet, he couldn’t bear to part with the Daqian Empire, an empire he had founded, which had flourished for three thousand years, and to which he had devoted so much of his hard work.
Chu Dingqian was waiting. Once the armies of Da Qian from all four directions retreated back to the Mid Six Province, he secretly sought help from some True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, willing to pay a great price if they were willing to station themselves in Da Qian.
If there were no results within two years, Chu Dingqian would give up, even if he couldn’t bear to leave the Qian Dynasty behind, he would have to go, find a safe place, and seek a Cultivator with potential to implant the Devil Fetus Possession.
The battle in the True Martial Realm in Leizhou made quite a stir, and with Chu Dingqian’s strength, even from far away in Yuanzhou, he could barely sense it, but he didn’t dare to go for fear of being ambushed.
When the great battle ended and specific intelligence arrived, Chu Dingqian immediate regretted his inaction, sighing and lamenting that he should have rushed over.
Against all odds, a powerful True Martial Realm fighter had emerged in Da Qian, who, with a few strikes, had severely injured Dugu Bing of the Yinyang Sect. This strength was at least equivalent to the Fifth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, not inferior to his own.
If he had rushed over, perhaps together they could have killed Dugu Bing, or at the very least cultivated a relationship with that refined True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
Just when Da Qian needed the combat ability of the True Martial Realm, that Emperor Wu appeared. It was simply too perfect, but regretfully, he had missed the opportunity.
“Next time, if there is a next time, I will definitely rush over to see it as soon as possible,” Chu Dingqian said softly to himself.
He felt extremely regretful in his heart; that powerful True Martial Realm Emperor Wu was escorting Tianxuan Mountain to the Qitian Teaching territory, reportedly to protect the sect for a hundred years.
Chu Dingqian was envious. How could little Tianxuan Mountain be so lucky? It would have been wonderful if that True Martial Realm Emperor Wu were willing to protect Da Qian for a hundred years.
But all those opportunities were missed.
In the Da Jing Imperial Palace, Capital City.
When Emperor Da Jing and another True Martial Realm ancestor received the intelligence, they immediately thought of the True Martial Realm who had passed through the Da Jing Empire before.
They marveled at the formidable combat ability of this True Martial Realm and lamented the missed opportunity.
The background of this True Martial Realm was unknown, but he seemed to highly value loyalty and honor. The Founding Ancestral Master of Tianxuan Mountain had shown him kindness a thousand years ago, and even after a millennium, he came back to repay it, saving Tianxuan Mountain from peril.
Such a True Martial Realm was most suitable for alliance. If they could have won him over to the Da Jing Empire, the empire’s foundation would have immediately surged, bolstering their confidence to claim more territory from the central areas of the Qian Dynasty’s domain.
Atop Emperor Wu’s City,
Donning black and yellow battle garb, the tall and upright middle-aged man frowned slightly upon receiving this intelligence.
How had a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu of such great strength suddenly appeared in the Xuan Domain?
The strength of this True Martial Realm Emperor Wu was not much less than his own. Who was he, after all?
After pondering for a while, the middle-aged man could not guess the identity of the True Martial Realm. Though there were many in the Qianyuan Divine Province, he was familiar with almost all the renowned and named ones, but none of them used such sword techniques.
The Da Liang Empire, Kurong Sect, Qitian Teaching, Ancient Empire, and even the Yinyang Sect and other powers all received this intelligence. After learning the details of the battle in Leizhou, they all furrowed their brows, unable to deduce the origin of this person.
Elsewhere, within the Qitian Teaching territory, at the new gate of Tianxuan Mountain.
After speaking to Gongsun Yun and the others, Han Li was ready to take his leave; he had no intention of truly staying there for a hundred years.
Gongsun Yun and the others were astonished. It turned out that the powerful True Martial Realm’s promise to stay for a hundred years was just talk. But then again, they thought, how could their senior truly stay at Tianxuan Mountain for a hundred years?
This senior had shown great kindness to Tianxuan Mountain. As for his claims of being indebted to the Founding Ancestral Master, that was just what the senior had said, and whether it was true or not, they themselves did not know.
Besides, the outside world was unaware that this senior had quietly left. As long as no one came probing, it was as if Tianxuan Mountain had a True Martial Realm powerhouse stationed there.
Gongsun Yun and the others naturally wouldn’t say anything; they were more than grateful.
Just then, Gongsun Yue spoke up: “Senior, I wish to become your disciple and follow you in cultivation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - 153: You you you… are Han Li, Junior Brother Han?_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 153: You you you… are Han Li, Junior Brother Han?_1
Translator: 549690339
Become your disciple?
Gongsun Yun opened his mouth but didn’t say anything.
His daughter was highly gifted, among the best of Fourth Grade talents, and it was true that cultivating on Tianxuan Mountain had buried her potential.
