Gongsun Yun had previously thought about sending Gongsun Yue to further her cultivation at Tai Xuan Sect. Tianxuan Mountain was a branch of Tai Xuan Sect, and with three ancestors there, plus Gongsun Yue’s talent, there was a chance she could eventually reach the True Martial Realm if she received good training.
Unfortunately, Gongsun Yue was unwilling to leave and had always been stubborn. Even when Tianxuan Mountain faced great crisis, Gongsun Yue chose to stay. She had said, “Mother has long passed, and if father were gone too, what purpose would my life serve all alone in this world?”
After hearing this, Gongsun Yun didn’t try to persuade her further. He knew it was futile, but now that his daughter had finally considered this idea, he couldn’t be more pleased.
This senior had dealt a heavy blow to that mid-stage True Martial Realm Devil Powerhouse with just a few sword strikes. He was already a force to be reckoned with in the True Martial Realm. If his daughter became his disciple and received his dedicated guidance, the prospect of her advancing to the True Martial Realm was hopeful.
Moreover, it would also bring Tianxuan Mountain closer to this senior. Should Tianxuan Mountain face difficulties in the future, this senior surely couldn’t ignore them.
Though he thought this, Gongsun Yun still felt somewhat reluctant deep down; his daughter, the apple of his eye who had been by his side for decades, was about to be taken away. His emotions were complex.
The three ancestors exchanged glances but remained silent. It was a matter between Gongsun Yun and Gongsun Yue, and it wasn’t appropriate for them to interfere. However, they too hoped the senior would accept Gongsun Yue as his disciple, as it would provide a powerful assurance for Tianxuan Mountain.
“Become my disciple?” Han Li’s eyes flashed with surprise. This senior sister was indeed decisive.
With the strength he had shown, it would be a great opportunity for anyone at Tianxuan Mountain to become his disciple.
Although Gongsun Yue had high potential, even with proper guidance, her advance to the True Martial Realm was uncertain, and she might perish along the way.
The cultivation level Han Li had demonstrated, which was at least of a mid-stage True Martial Realm, and his unfathomable strength, placed him at the pinnacle throughout the entire Xuan Domain.
Gongsun Yue had the courage to seize the opportunity and declare her wish. Her determination was indeed extraordinary. Their relationship was currently amicable, making it the perfect time for her to ask to become his disciple.
Once Han Li left, it would become incredibly difficult for Gongsun Yue to request discipleship again, especially since advancing within the Tai Xuan Sect, it would be hard for her to be taken as a direct disciple by a True Martial Realm powerhouse, given her mere Fourth Grade talent.
Gongsun Yue nodded earnestly and spoke again, “Please, senior, accept me as your disciple.”
She knew this was an excellent chance. Though Tianxuan Mountain was now far from the major conflicts of Da Qian, having just arrived in the region controlled by Qitian Teaching, the stability was not yet solid.
If she became the disciple of this person, Tianxuan Mountain would be further connected to him, and they could ask for his help when needed.
Gongsun Yue also truly wanted to venture out. She had spent most of her life on Tianxuan Mountain and longed to see the outside world, hoping to travel Qianyuan Divine Province with this senior.
Although Qianyuan Divine Province was vast and boundless, it would take only a few months for a True Martial Realm powerhouse to cross it, and protecting her, a minor Gangyuan Realm cultivator, would be effortless.
Looking at the stunning beauty before him with purple hair and a purple dress, Han Li sighed inwardly. If not for the fact that he was Gongsun Yun’s disciple, he really would have wanted to take Gongsun Yue as his disciple—and to attempt a romance between master and disciple…
But alas, Gongsun Yue was his senior sister, and his true identity would surely be exposed eventually.
Han Li shook his head, sighing, “Five hundred years ago, I stopped taking on disciples.”
Gongsun Yue pursed her lips with a disappointed look on her pretty face, while Gongsun Yun and the three ancestors let out a silent sigh, sensing that this senior had no intention of further involvement with Tianxuan Mountain.
“However…” Han Li paused.
Gongsun Yue’s bright eyes shone with anticipation, and Gongsun Yun, along with the three ancestors, held their breath in hope. Could there be a twist in this tale?
Han Li continued, “I am in need of a maid. If you are willing, then follow me.”
In truth, what Han Li wanted to say was that he needed someone to warm his bed, but such a statement wouldn’t fit his current dignified demeanor, and would tarnish his esteemed image in the eyes of others.
Gongsun Yun shook his head slightly at Gongsun Yue, signaling her not to agree. Although this senior was a powerful Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, Gongsun Yun did not want his precious daughter to be wronged.
Gongsun Yue hesitated only slightly before accepting, “I am willing.”
The man seemed noble and upright; the chances that she would find herself in an unpleasant situation as a maid seemed unlikely.
Had the man harbored covetous thoughts about her, with his power, he could have taken her by force right then, and Tianxuan Mountain would be powerless to resist. Thus, Gongsun Yue saw no need for concern.
Gongsun Yun sighed inwardly, harboring an uneasy feeling as if his daughter might encounter some trouble on this path—a feeling he could not quite explain.
He, like Gongsun Yue, believed that since this senior had come to repay a debt after a thousand years, he must value loyalty and gratitude highly. If he had any untoward intentions, with his strength, Tianxuan Mountain could not resist.
Gongsun Yun thought he was probably overprotecting his daughter and suspecting the senior without cause.
Little did he know, this was exactly Han Li’s real intention.
If he were to take Gongsun Yue as his disciple and then marry her, he would ultimately face difficulty explaining himself to Gongsun Yun.
However, not taking her as his disciple while proceeding with that offer wouldn’t pose any issue, and Gongsun Yun would likely be very pleased, since he was regarded as Gongsun Yun’s final disciple, the heir.
Only, it was not a good time for him to reveal his identity. It would be better to wait until his power further increased before informing Gongsun Yun

chapters.title: Chapter 201 - 153: You you you… are Han Li, Junior Brother Han?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Chapter 153: You you you… are Han Li, Junior Brother Han?_2
Translator: 549690339
As for his senior apprentice sister, he had no choice but to take care in advance.
“All right then.”
Han Li glanced at Gongsun Yun, his eyes hinting at an unfathomable smile.
After another forty minutes, Han Li patiently waited for Gongsun Yue and Gongsun Yun to finish speaking. Gongsun Yun, as a father, kept giving instructions, which made Han Li want to say:
“Father-in-law, please be assured, your son-in-law will take good care of the senior apprentice sister.”
When their conversation ended, Han Li flicked his sleeve, enveloping Gongsun Yue and vanishing from sight.
Almost two hours had passed since they left Chengsheng Mountain. Han Li was feeling homesick for his loving wives and beautiful concubines at home. It had been a long time since he had been away from Han Mansion for so long.
Traveling at lightning speed, Han Li flew at his fastest pace. He could now traverse 390,000 miles in the blink of an eye, incredibly swift.
Gongsun Yue was only at the peak of Gangyuan Realm, her body too delicate to withstand such vigorous fast travel. Han Li continuously protected her with his Divine Yuan, lest she accidentally die en route.
Gongsun Yue had wanted to communicate with this senior, to inquire about his name, background, and other details, asking where they were heading, and how to address him… But the senior never gave her a chance to speak.
All she could feel was the scenery outside changing at breakneck speed, covering vast distances in the blink of an eye. Without the protection of a Divine Yuan barrier, Gongsun Yue felt she would have been torn apart by the Gang wind instantly.
Gongsun Yue could tell that this senior seemed eager to return, fully focused on the journey and not in the mood to speak with her. Thus, she patiently waited, planning to ask her questions once they arrived at their destination.
She also wanted to know the background of this senior. Perhaps upon reaching the destination, everything would become clear.
Soon, the two descended on a majestic and uniquely scenic mountain peak. Gongsun Yue looked at the landscape and the bustling crowd within these mountains with a hint of bewilderment in her eyes.
Where was this place, after all?
Gongsun Yue sneaked a peek at the senior with his back to her, and carefully released her Spiritual Sense, attempting to listen to the conversations of the people below to figure out their location.
As she listened for a while, her expression suddenly became odd, and then more and more astonished. Her bright eyes filled with disbelief, and in her heart, a very bold speculation took shape.
Could this senior in front of her be Han Li?
Her Spiritual Sense had seen the stone stele of Han Mansion and heard the conversations of Han Mansion’s people. They mentioned that the most powerful person in Han Mansion was Old Ancestor Han, though no one mentioned his full name.
Furthermore, she overheard some familiar names while in a certain region of Chengdao Peak, only some of them, like Yueyao, Mingmeng, Yuexin, and so on.
She had seen those names before when she collected information on Han Li. She knew that Han Li had many concubines, including names like Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, and others.
Moreover, the title “Old Ancestor Han” seemed to have been recorded in the intelligence as well, a term of reverence used for Han Li by those from Lingjun City.
Gulu~
Gongsun Yue swallowed nervously. She felt her speculation might very well be true.
It couldn’t be a coincidence that this senior held the same surname as Han, was revered as Old Ancestor Han, and shared the same names of some concubines, could it?
Such coincidences did not exist in this world.
Although this senior did not look the same as Han Li and appeared to be of a different age, Gongsun Yue knew these things could be disguised.
If it were Han Li, it would also explain why he came to assist Tianxuan Mountain, escorted Tianxuan Mountain to Qitian Teaching, and was reluctant to accept her as his disciple.
However, if he was Han Li, why would he take her as a maid and bring her back to Han Mansion?
Gongsun Yue felt a flurry of anxiety. With various conjectures flooding her mind, she took several deep breaths to compose herself before cautiously asking:
“Are you… Han Li, Junior Brother Han?”
Gongsun Yue fixed her gaze on the figure ahead, her heart pounding. She didn’t know what she was hoping for.
“Senior apprentice sister, you’re well, I see.”
Just as Gongsun Yue’s heart was in her throat, Han Li spoke with a smile and turned to face her, looking at this strikingly beautiful senior sister with purple hair and a purple dress.
Gongsun Yue’s pupils shrank abruptly, her stunningly beautiful face filled with shock, her bright eyes brimming with disbelief as she fell into a daze.
Although she had already speculated, Han Li’s confession of identity still gave Gongsun Yue an immense shock, indeed a great surprise to her.
She couldn’t help but recall the only time she had met Han Li, after she had visited him several times, and Han Li had met her only out of impatience.
She also thought of the words her father, Gongsun Yun, had said to her. Indeed, Gongsun Yun had an excellent eye, considering Han Li was indeed the best choice to inherit Tianxuan Mountain.
In just a short decade or so, Han Li had cultivated from the Peak of Gangyuan Realm to the True Martial Realm, crossing over numerous Big Realms such as the God Refining Realm, Hollow Void Stage, and Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Han Li’s strength within the True Martial Realm was also extremely strong; otherwise, he could not have heavily injured that Yinyang Sect’s True Martial Realm Emperor Wu with just a few sword strikes, forcing him to flee in a sorry state.
In just over a decade, he had reached the pinnacle of Xuan Domain, becoming one of the top ten superpowers; what exactly was Han Li’s method of cultivation?
Wasn’t he the old ancestor known for taking concubines frequently, wasting his cultivation? Yet, Han Li’s cultivation speed was terrifying, and if he had cultivated seriously, wouldn’t he have broken through to the Divine Yuan Realm or even higher realms by now?
Gongsun Yue took a deep breath and then exhaled, her red lips opening and closing several times, yet she didn’t know what to say.
Remembering how she had once thought Han Li had too low a cultivation and was not suitable to inherit Tianxuan Mountain, and did not qualify to be taken as her father’s personal disciple, Gongsun Yue felt embarrassed, her beautiful face blushing with shame.
Thinking of her past evaluations and opinions of Han Li, she wished she could find a hole to crawl into.
Han Li was no mediocre individual; he was a prodigy whose talent shone brightly in Xuan Domain, whose speed of realm advancement broke the record in both Xuan Domain and Qianyuan Divine Province, by many multiples.
After a long while, Gongsun Yue’s emotions finally calmed somewhat, and she asked, “Han… Junior Brother, why didn’t you tell father the truth?”
With Han Li’s current strength, there was no need to hide any longer; he could have acted under his real identity, but Han Li had always hidden it, not revealing a thing to Gongsun Yun.
Looking at this somewhat naive senior sister, Han Li shook his head slightly and said, “It’s not that I didn’t want to, but that I couldn’t.”
He had many enemies, both overt and potential, and with his current strength, he was still unable to contend with them, naturally, he could not expose his identity.
Otherwise, it would bring great disaster to Han Mansion and Tianxuan Mountain and would become a vulnerability for him.
As long as the enemy did not know his true identity, they wouldn’t know his vulnerabilities, hence couldn’t exploit them against him.
Han Li still preferred to remain low-key, using alts to act out was fine, but his identity must never be exposed.
“Then why did you tell me?”
After hesitating, Gongsun Yue still asked the question, with a hint of expectation in her eyes. Why did Han Li tell her all this? Could it really be what she thought?
Her innocent senior sister’s thoughts were clearly written on her face, and seeing this, Han Li said earnestly, “It’s just as you imagined.”
Gongsun Yue’s beautiful face flushed with two blossoms of red, as she lowered her head, appearing somewhat at a loss.
She had previously guessed why Han Li had made her disguise as a maid to follow him, and she hadn’t expected her guess to be correct.
In the past, she naturally looked down upon Han Li; she disliked his womanizing ways, especially since her father took him as a personal disciple and had great expectations for him, yet he did not strive for progress, and indulged in pleasures of the flesh, which made Gongsun Yue frustrated.
But now Han Li’s strength and his actions had caused Gongsun Yue’s heart to flutter.
Han Li, now a highly skilled and top-ranking Emperor Wu within the True Martial Realm, had saved everyone on Tianxuan Mountain, and it seemed he also had feelings for her…
Additionally, Han Li was handsome and to her preference, giving her one more reason to favor him.
As the famous old ancestor known for taking numerous concubines, Han Li knew this was the perfect opportunity to capture her heart. The naive and pure senior sister had undergone such upheavals, and her heart was now open to him.
“Senior Sister, do you remember the words I once said to you?”
PS: I’m speechless; I was just writing when a friend messaged me that my book had been plagiarized on another site, with identical chapter titles and content, directly copied and pasted.
This is just too damn infuriating!

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - 154 Gongsun Yue: I like to eat soft food, the transformation of Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 154 Gongsun Yue: I like to eat soft food, the transformation of Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye_1
Translator: 549690339
“What…what did you say?”
As Han Li approached, Gongsun Yue could distinctly feel the heat emanating from his body, which threw her into even greater disarray.
“The first time we met, I asked if senior sister preferred gentle or tough approaches, and senior sister said she liked both. What about now?” Han Li said with a smile.
Gongsun Yue became even more flustered upon hearing this.
She remembered these words. At the time, she hadn’t thought much about them, but after pondering them carefully afterward, she realized that Han Li had been taking advantage of her.
Wait, did junior brother Han have feelings for me back then?
Gongsun Yue thought it was possible. At that time, out of a mix of frustration and disappointment, she had treated Han Li poorly, so even if he had any feelings, he wouldn’t dare show them.
Now, looking back, junior brother Han might have hidden his cultivation level. He certainly wasn’t just a Pihai Realm cultivator, he must have been at least at the God Refining Realm. Otherwise, why would father take him as a close disciple?
Thinking of this, Gongsun Yue felt both annoyed and amused. This master and disciple pair certainly shared a trait.
She had always thought her father, Gongsun Yun, was a Guru in the Void Realm. Only when the Sect faced danger did she discover that Gongsun Yun was actually a Great Grandmaster in the Myriad Phenomena Realm. It had to be said that he kept his power deeply hidden, so much so that even she, his own daughter, had no clue.
Han Li was even more of a dark horse, surpassing his predecessors. He had previously displayed the cultivation of the Pihai Realm while concealing his God Refining Realm capabilities. Now that he’s attained the True Martial Realm, he only displayed the God Refining Realm to outsiders. He was getting better and better at hiding.
She also finally understood why Gongsun Yun had said Han Li would live a long time, and why he said she was too young.
Compared to Gongsun Yun and Han Li, she was indeed naive. If she were to practice in the outside world, she might suffer a great loss.
Fortunately, when on Tianxuan Mountain, her father protected her, and upon arriving at Chengsheng Mountain, she had junior brother Han Li to guard her. She didn’t need to worry or be troubled about anything from the outside world.
Suddenly, Gongsun Yue felt the warmth of a large hand taking hold of her jade hand. She immediately snapped back to reality, and after a light struggle which proved futile, she couldn’t help but glare at Han Li.
“What is senior sister thinking about? Have you even thought of a name for our children?” Han Li teased.
“Hehe~”
Gongsun Yue let out a cold laugh, yet she didn’t pull her hand away. Her heart was in turmoil, holding hands with a man other than her close kin for the first time—especially this junior brother Han, whom she quite fancied.
“Senior sister hasn’t answered my question yet,” Han Li whispered in her ear, his breath sending waves of warmth over her.
He had discovered that his senior sister Gongsun Yue was indeed easy to win over, hence he became more audacious. He wondered if it was because he was too handsome or too dashing.
The warmth that flowed into her delicate and exquisite ear caused a tingling and burning sensation in Gongsun Yue. She pursed her red lips and responded in a barely audible voice, “I like it gentle.”
As she spoke, she lowered her head again to hide her panic and her blush.
She knew that after telling her this, Han Li wouldn’t let her go or allow her to reveal the truth to Gongsun Yun. For a long time to come, she would have to live at Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li liked her, and she realized she had feelings for Han Li too, but she didn’t want things to progress too quickly. She didn’t want Han Li to be forceful; she wanted him to be gentle.
To put it simply, the nave and pure senior sister wanted Han Li to pursue her.
Han Li raised an eyebrow. The answer from the senior sister was indeed unexpected—he thought Gongsun Yue wouldn’t reply.
Han Li easily saw through Gongsun Yue’s thoughts, mainly because she was too obvious. He decided to grant her this small wish. After that, it would be time for his senior sister to grant his wishes.
Afterward, Han Li kept feeding Gongsun Yue with enchanting words, showering her with all sorts of sweet nothings that made her delighted, and their relationship grew ever closer.
Compared to Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi, senior sister Gongsun Yue was purer in mind, innocent and vivacious, untouched by the harshness of the Cultivation Realm.
While Han Li and Gongsun Yue were being affectionate at the mountain peak, in the palace district of Chengdao Peak, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi were also discussing the two of them.
“Tsk tsk, the husband goes out and brings back another sister. It looks like he intends to marry her,” said Lu Tianxiang.
Yun Miaoyi stretched languidly, her fair skin basking in the sunlight, her voluptuous figure boldly on display.
Previously, Gongsun Yue had probed Han Mansion with her Spiritual Sense, which immediately alarmed them. Their cultivation levels were higher than Gongsun Yue’s, and they had in turn scrutinized her, discovering that she and Han Li were enjoying their world atop the mountain.
Yun Miaoyi was indifferent to the arrival of Gongsun Yue. She was well aware of her own place, and she also knew exactly what to do to make Han Li dote on her more.
“The husband refrains from competing, and therefore no one in the world can compete with him.”
Hence, after accepting Han Li’s proposal and marrying him, Yun Miaoyi swiftly adjusted her mindset. If she did not resist deep down, her heart would quickly be occupied by Han Li.
After all, apart from being a womanizer, Han Li had nothing but good qualities, and he was very attractive to her.
“Hmph, womanizer.”
Jiang Baiye snorted coldly. Although she had accepted Han Li and was even carrying his child, Han Li’s speed in taking wives was excessively fast, wasn’t it?
Yun Miaoyi had just joined their household a few days ago, and this scoundrel Han Li had brought back another one, making Jiang Baiye feel sour inside.
In the past, she was celebrated as the most beautiful woman of Sanzhou, the unmatched and aloof Sword Immortal.
But after becoming Han Li’s wife, she realized there were indeed many women whose beauty could rival hers. Yun Miaoyi for one, Lu Tianxiang, and this new woman—their looks were no less striking than hers, each with their own unique charm.

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 154 Gongsun Yue: I like to eat soft food, the transformation of Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 154 Gongsun Yue: I like to eat soft food, the transformation of Lu Tianxiang and Jiang Baiye_2
Translator: 549690339
Lu Tianxiang was Han Li’s first wife, her cultivation and talent both superior to Jiang Baiye’s; although Yun Miaoyi became Han Li’s wife later, her talent and cultivation were similar to Jiang’s, but Yun Miaoyi was more open-hearted. She sweetly called him ‘husband’ at every turn and backed Han Li in everything.
This made Jiang Baiye feel a sense of crisis, worried that Han Li would neglect her; the Sword Immortal felt inferior to Lu Tianxiang and Yun Miaoyi in certain aspects.
Now, Han Li had brought back another woman, and it seemed she wasn’t captured; they got along very happily, which deepened the Sword Immortal Jiang Baiye’s sense of crisis.
Strictly speaking, she, Lu Tianxiang, and Yun Miaoyi were all taken by Han Li, becoming his wives out of helplessness, but this new stunning beauty was not.
She really wanted to hear what they were talking about, but that bastard Han Li had blocked the sound; her spiritual sense could only see the images. Even so, she could tell their relationship was rapidly closing—a lot of intimate talking and cooing.
“She is Gongsun Yue, the daughter of Gongsun Yun, Han Li’s master at Tianxuan Mountain; she’s considered Han Li’s senior martial sister,”
Lu Tianxiang glanced at Yun Miaoyi and then at Jiang Baiye, sighing inwardly before she spoke.
Having been Han Li’s wife for several years now, she had completely let go; she had fallen for Han Li, even considering calling Han Li “husband.”
Han Li treated her well; his cultivation, status, and all were entirely sufficient. Han Li was actively making preparations for her, helping her to advance to the True Martial Realm, and she had already borne Han Li one child, with the second now on the way.
Although she didn’t like Han Li frequently taking wives and concubines, Lu Tianxiang knew she couldn’t stop it, so she had come to terms with it. Being Han Li’s wife was quite nice, and life at Chengsheng Mountain was infinitely more relaxed and pleasant than in the Chaotic Domain.
But considering Jiang Baiye had not yet let go, Lu Tianxiang decided to wait. She felt she was naturally the chief wife as Han Li’s first wife and that Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye, with their inferior talents and cultivation, were only secondary wives.
As the undisputed main wife of the Han Family, she needed to maintain harmony in Han Li’s harem. If she too called Han Li “husband,” and only Jiang Baiye continued to “stand apart,” it might make Jiang Baiye feel isolated.
Gongsun Yue had always stayed at Tianxuan Mountain, hardly ever going out; the outside world only knew of her existence, very few knew what she actually looked like.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi had learned about Han Li being a Tianxuan Mountain disciple when they investigated him before; they knew of Gongsun Yue’s name and status but nothing else.
Lu Tianxiang knew her; while hiding in Leizhou, she had collected detailed information about the four factions of Leizhou, including Gongsun Yue’s name, status, cultivation, and appearance.
Lu Tianxiang spoke forthrightly to clear up Jiang Baiye’s confusion; the witch Yun Miaoyi didn’t care, but she could see that Jiang Baiye had some knots in her heart.
Lu Tianxiang, with her noble character and tender heart, had noticed in her interactions with Jiang Baiye that the latter seemed to harbor a trace of inferiority.
Inferiority was not something that should be afflicting a woman as proud as Jiang Baiye, but it surely did. After analyzing, Lu Tianxiang found the reason but said nothing; this needed to be addressed by Han Li.
Han Li had many wives and concubines; naturally, there would be neglect in his care for each. Furthermore, Jiang Baiye, in her interactions with Han Li, consciously concealed this aspect, so he had yet to discover it.
“So, it’s her,” realized Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye.
Compared to them, Gongsun Yue and Han Li seemed to be childhood sweethearts?
No wonder Gongsun Yue got along so well with Han Li after arriving at Chengdao Peak; Jiang Baiye was somewhat relieved but also felt the pressure.
She wondered if she should make some changes.
After some thought, Jiang Baiye said, “It is said that Gongsun Yue is a Fourth Grade talent; although her cultivation is somewhat low right now, her beauty, figure, temperament, as well as her identity, truly qualify her to be Han Li’s wife.”
Jiang Baiye had made her position clear, acknowledging Gongsun Yue; if Han Li were to marry Gongsun Yue, she would have no objections.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, after chatting with Gongsun Yue for a while, Han Li arranged a sleeping palace for her but did not introduce her to his beloved wife and concubines right away.
Given Gongsun Yue’s current identity was not appropriate, though both he and Gongsun Yue knew what the eventual outcome would be, Han Li had promised to give her a courtship process and naturally could not introduce her as a wife.
If he introduced her as his senior sister, and Gongsun Yue lived in a palace area where only Han Li’s beloved wife and concubines would reside, it would not be fitting, so Han Li planned to wait a bit longer. He was confident he could conquer his innocent and pure senior sister Gongsun Yue in just a few days.
After bidding farewell to Gongsun Yue, Han Li appeared where Lu Tianxiang and the other two women were. Judging by their expressions, Han Li knew they were already aware of the situation. He smiled, sharing some details with them.
When they learned that Han Li had slain the True Martial Realm Emperor Wu of the Yinyang Sect, all three women were shocked; Han Li’s strength was not what they had imagined.
Han Li was not just a newly advanced True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, his cultivation must also be at least at the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm, otherwise how could he have slain another mid-stage True Martial Realm opponent?
Who among those who had cultivated to the True Martial Realm was not a genius? Yet they had never heard of someone in the True Martial Realm being able to challenge beyond their level.
As for the varying levels of martial intent, they did not fully understand, only knowing some were ordinary and others powerful, but the specifics were unclear.
Han Li knew these details because the System had informed him; otherwise, he would not have had access, as such knowledge simply did not exist in the Xuan Domain.
In the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, perhaps only a few Sacred Lands like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Myriad Demon Mountain might have a clear understanding of the detailed classifications of martial intent levels.
“Based on my husband’s description, if I’m not mistaken, that person should be Dugu Bing of the Yinyang Sect,” Yun Miaoyi spoke up.
“Although my status wasn’t high when I was with the Yinyang Sect, I still had access to some secrets. I knew the Yinyang Sect had two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus, one was the Sect Hierarch Chen An, and the other was Dugu Bing. It’s said his cultivation is even higher than that of the Yinyang Sect Hierarch.”
“So it’s him.” Lu Tianxiang suddenly realized, knowing who Dugu Bing was.
On her journey to the Daqian Empire, she had familiarized herself within the Sect with the True Martial Realm Emperor Wus of the major powers in the Xuan Domain and some powerful Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and Dugu Bing was one of them.
The Sect intelligence reported: The Yinyang Sect always maintained two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus, one was the Sect Hierarch, and the other would rotate every three hundred years to serve as a guardian. It just so happened that it was Dugu Bing’s turn this time.
Dugu Bing, with his arrogant nature, was a disciple of the Sect Master of the Blood Devil Sect of the Demon Domain. After joining the Yinyang Sect, he always stayed within the sect to guard it. He had quite a discordant relationship with the Sect Hierarch Chen An because Dugu Bing, relying on his profound cultivation and higher status, wanted to meddle in Yinyang Sect affairs to seize more benefits.
Dugu Bing also liked to posture sanctimoniously in front of others, looking down on his enemies with an arrogant attitude, and was incessantly annoying with his swagger. He had been very displeasing to people even when he was in the Demon Domain.
Jiang Baiye looked at Han Li and realized she still did not understand him well. Han Li’s cultivation was too high, and although she had some words she wanted to say to Han Li, her red lips parted slightly, yet she remained silent.
In the end, Jiang Baiye simply said, “Dugu Bing was injured by you under another identity. If you come forward with that identity, Chu Zhenxiong will surely seek you out, and the plan you spoke of earlier can be implemented very well.”
Han Li’s eyebrows twitched as he noticed the subtle changes in Jiang Baiye, but now wasn’t the appropriate time to speak. He planned to find time to understand Jiang Baiye more deeply and solve her troubles.
“Jiang Jiang is correct, that is exactly what I had in mind,” Han Li nodded slightly.
“I have investigated Chu Zhenxiong under another identity. The intelligence suggests that he is very likely a mid-stage True Martial Realm strongman. My interaction with him as an elegant middle-aged man should be most fitting and could possibly leverage more benefits,” he said.
Upon hearing this, a smile appeared on the faces of Yun Miaoyi and Lu Tianxiang, as they too thought of this key point. If handled well, Han Mansion would embrace an opportunity for soaring development.
By then, Han Li’s status within the Daqian Empire would be one of the highest, enabling him to extract much from Chu Zhenxiong, including the foundations of the national treasury, while they would also obtain countless precious cultivation resources to enhance their overall strength.
PS: Continuing to write, there will be another chapter before twelve o’clock.

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 155 Emperor Mingtian of the East Sea, the Four Great Sacred Lands, the Great Ancestor is getting married again!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 155 Emperor Mingtian of the East Sea, the Four Great Sacred Lands, the Great Ancestor is getting married again!_1
Translator: 549690339
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, five days had passed.
During these days, the Da Qian Empire underwent another massive change.
The Da Qian Empire withdrew all its forces from the Outer Twelve States, ceding them entirely to the four invading powers.
The Da Jing Empire’s southern armies engulfed the three northern provinces of the Da Qian Empire. While assimilating the territories of the three provinces, they stationed troops on the borders, waiting for the next opportunity to set their sights on the Mid Six Province.
The Buddhist soldiers of the Kurong Sect occupied the three western provinces of the Da Qian Empire. In just half a month, many temples had been constructed in these three provinces to worship the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas of the Buddhist Sect.
The Kurong Sect normally had two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus stationed there. Being granted the title of Kong when in the True Martial Realm, after Kurong Kong and the supporting Tuoshan Kong were trapped in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, the Kurong Sect was left with only one Kong.
This Kong, being only in the early stages of the True Martial Realm, was quite wary of Chu Dingqian and did not dare to pressure the Da Qian Empire too much. For the time being, he stopped advancing his troops, intending to stabilize the occupied territories until the Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong emerged.
In the Eastern Three Provinces, the troops of the Da Qian Empire also retreated, taking away everything they could. Fengbo Pavilion stepped forward to control the territories, beginning the process of absorption.
Although the mysterious forces behind Fengbo Pavilion were eager to swallow more territories of the Da Qian Empire, their lack of strength hindered them. The cloaked elder who presided over the overall situation was trapped in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
For the time being, the mysterious forces did not dare to send another True Martial Realm Emperor Wu there. They had been warned that the territories held by Fengbo Pavilion in the Xuan Domain could only be governed by one True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
The mysterious forces from the Chaotic Domain, known as Emperor Mingtian, were originally a power from the East Sea. However, Emperor Mingtian had long been scheming in the Chaotic Domain, slowly eroding and ultimately swallowing up numerous forces in the domain, seizing control of one-third of its territories. This was their limit.
Although what Emperor Mingtian did was covert, it didn’t escape the eyes of the major sacred lands, who were manipulating the overall structure of the Qianyuan Divine Province.
The Chaotic Domain was inherently chaotic, with forces from various domains settling in. The major sacred lands allowed Emperor Mingtian to enter the arena because they wanted to ease the relationship with the East Sea. After all, the East Sea was a part of the Qianyuan Divine Province, and there was the Penglai Immortal Sect deep within the East Sea, which was not much weaker than the major sacred lands.
The Chaotic Domain could not be unified; this was the consensus of the major sacred lands. One-third of the Chaotic Domain was to be controlled by Emperor Mingtian, and that was their bottom line.
Within Emperor Mingtian, there was one Divine Yuan Realm Emperor, and several True Martial Realm Emperor Wus. Although they were dissatisfied with the decision of the major sacred lands, they did not dare to cross the red line. Otherwise, Emperor Mingtian would be doomed, and all their efforts would be ruined overnight.
The major sacred lands might lack the glory of ancient times, but they still had powerhouses in the Tongxuan Realm to uphold them, and they also possessed Emperor-grade Immortal Artifacts. If Emperor Mingtian dared to defy their resolutions, the consequences would be unbearable for them.
Emperor Mingtian’s entry into the Xuan Domain was the same. The major sacred lands were watching and gave their tacit approval, but they also set clear boundaries. Emperor Mingtian must tread carefully.
After the Da Qian Empire withdrew from Leizhou, Qingzhou, and Huozhou in the south, the Yinyang Sect assimilated them and also temporarily ceased expansions, silently digesting the three provinces.
Their Sect Hierarch, Chen An, was trapped in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, and another powerful True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, Dugu Bing, was severely injured and had yet to recover, not daring to provoke the Da Qian Empire further.
Now the Da Qian Empire held firm to the Mid Six Province, and most of the troops that had withdrawn from the Outer Twelve States were stationed on the borders of Tangzhou, Jizhou, Liangzhou, and Guzhou. The rest were withdrawn to Yuanzhou. Yuanzhou, due to its unique geographical location, was not defended.
Chu Dingqian had been striving to stabilize the situation these days, seeking to prevent the collapse of the vast empire he had founded. He still harbored hope and didn’t want to witness the empire he had built with his own hands perish.
Although he knew that the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and Fengbo Pavilion either lacked or had only one weaker True Martial Realm force, he still didn’t dare to provoke them.
Firstly, he wanted to settle down and find a True Martial Realm to preside over the Da Qian Empire while he focused on nurturing the Devil Fetus Possession, as his life was not much longer.
Additionally, both the Yinyang Sect and Kurong Sect had the Demon Clan and Buddhist Sect behind them. Among the Four Sacred Lands of the Human Clan, the Demon Clan and Buddhist Sect accounted for two, and they were the ones who set the rules.
If Chu Dingqian schemed to disrupt the Yinyang Sect and Kurong Sect, by launching destructive attacks and assassinating True Martial Realm warriors, and slaughtering a large number of people from the Myriad Phenomena Realm and Hollow Void Stage, these two forces would instantly violate the consensus and directly annihilate the Da Qian Empire.
Generally speaking, the Four Great Sacred Lands care a lot about face, and they will abide by the rules they have set, honoring the consensus and giving other forces a chance. However, if their interests are seriously compromised, they can put aside their dignity.
Chu Dingqian dreaded the Buddhist Sect and Demon Clan and did not dare to cause destruction. He wanted to live to see a third life and then continue to contend with forces like the Yinyang Sect and Kurong Sect.
If handled well, for instance, if the Daqian Empire were to have several individuals reach the True Martial Realm or the warriors in the Divine Yuan Realm, they could counterattack the Yinyang Sect and Kurong Sect, the Da Jing Dynasty, etc., and seize more territories, which the rules permit.
This is also an opportunity for development given by the Four Great Powers to other forces in the Qianyuan Divine Province. They wish to maintain their status as sacred lands, preserve the big picture of the Qianyuan Divine Province, and also desire that the affairs within the Human Clan are not stagnant like dead water.
Yuanzhou, Chengsheng Mountain.
As the Daqian Empire retreated to the Mid Six Provinces, and after the Four Great Forces swallowed the Twelve Provinces and then rested their banners, the situation suddenly eased, and the people of Han Mansion breathed a sigh of relief.
Although many major forces had moved into Yuanzhou, from those at the God Refining Realm to the Hollow Void Stage, and even the Myriad Phenomena Realm, Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain remained, quietly existing in its corner, becoming low-key.
These past few days, Han Li spent half his time with his senior sister Gongsun Yue, and the progress was satisfying. He had finally captured Gongsun Yue’s heart completely, and she agreed to marry him.
However, Gongsun Yue wanted to inform Gongsun Yun and invite him to participate in such a significant event. Han Li refused, feeling that now was not the right time to inform Gongsun Yun.
On one hand, he did not want to expose his identity just yet; on the other hand, he had stolen Gongsun Yun’s beloved little cotton-padded jacket, and it had been only five or six days since Han Li took Gongsun Yue away.
Gongsun Yun treasured Han Li, but with his precious daughter’s heart conquered by Han Li within just a few days and ready to marry him, he surely wouldn’t be pleased.
In preparation for the grand wedding to be held at Chengsheng Mountain two days later, Han Li only invited the forces from Yonchang Manor; he did not invite the major forces from other manors in Yuanzhou.
With these forces just having moved in, and the situation being chaotic and prone to troubles, it could cause endless problems. If you fight the small ones, the big ones come; if you fight the big ones, the elders come. It never ends and doesn’t fit with his wish to lie low and develop safely.
Although many major forces had relocated to Yuanzhou, none in Yonchang Manor had reached above the God Refining Realm. Why? Because the spiritual energy in Yonchang Manor was too sparse.
They preferred to settle in other manors, seizing the mountain gates of smaller forces, and after setting up Spirit Gathering Arrays, the effect was certainly much better than in Yonchang Manor.
This also led to small forces from several nearby manors flocking to Yonchang Manor. In order to establish a foundation, they needed to seize the territories and interests of other forces, plunging Yonchang Manor into a comparatively chaotic situation.
But no one dared to provoke Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain. The spiritual energy on Chengsheng Mountain was the sparsest, with hardly any cultivation resources nearby, and Han Mansion was still the only God Refining Realm force in Yonchang Manor.
The grand wedding took place as scheduled. The newly arrived forces all sent representatives, showing great respect for the old ancestor of the Han Family. They had just relocated and encountered the old ancestor of the Han Family getting married.
It was only after the Han Family’s old ancestor’s wedding that the various forces of Yonchang Manor came to a realization—there was still a God Refining Realm old ancestor in Yonchang Manor.
This God Refining Realm old ancestor was very low-key. Apart from taking wives and concubines, he was almost unnoticeable in both Yonchang Manor and Yuanzhou.
When the festivity concluded, and the wedding ended, all the forces withdrew, returning to their own sects. Only the banks of the three large rivers remained bustling and lively.
Every time Old Ancestor Han took a wife, he would set up a banquet along the riversides, serving lavish food for the common people near Chengsheng Mountain in the Mortal World to eat and drink for free for seven days.
Because of Lu Tianxiang, Han Li specifically took this opportunity to spread her beliefs in secret, earning him heaps of gratitude and move from the Sect Hierarch Lu Tianxiang. Han Li clearly always kept me in his thoughts.
As the golden crow set and the bright moon hung high, Han Li once again entered one of the four happiest moments in life: the wedding night in the bridal chamber.
This time, his companion for the wedding night in the bridal chamber was his long-pined-for innocent and pure senior sister, Gongsun Yue.
Old Ancestor Han entered the bridal chamber and saw the stunning beauty sitting on the edge of the bed. He did not rush but slowly savored the sight before him.
Tonight, Gongsun Yue wore a long red dress that trailed across the wooden floor. Her delicate, plump jade feet peeked out, bound in red embroidered shoes with thin red silk ribbons, outlining an exquisite and tempting sexiness.
With just a fleeting glance under the red bridal veil, Han Li caught sight of the flawless, beautiful face, and his heartbeat inadvertently quickened.
Even though he had admired many peerless beauties like Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi, he was still moved by the beauty of his senior sister Gongsun Yue.

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - 156 The Changes of the Delicate Wife and Beautiful Concubines, Elder Han Went to Da Qian Capital City_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 156 The Changes of the Delicate Wife and Beautiful Concubines, Elder Han Went to Da Qian Capital City_1
Translator: 549690339
Last night, uncombed hair hung over her shoulders.
Resting on her lover’s lap, she was pitiable everywhere.
Han Li, the elder ancestor, had been tirelessly toiling for several days, driving his pure and innocent senior sister to her limits, until she finally sent him away.
When the first light of dawn painted the skies, in an instant, myriad rays of morning glow lit up the entire world, bringing all life to its vibrant state. The imposing mountains and seas surged with energy, and countless silver rivers appeared to cascade from the heavens.
With Elder Ancestor Han Li’s morning exercises no longer taking place, Gongsun Yue finally had time to ascend to the peak of Chengdao to watch the sunrise. At this moment, she was reveling in the breathtaking morning glow and the magnificent beauty of Chengsheng Mountain.
A cool breeze came, stirring the skirt of this stunning beauty, her purple dress billowing in the wind, her hair dancing like clouds around her temples.
Today, Gongsun Yue had donned her purple gown again, with a white silk ribbon tied around her waist. Her slender waist was pressed down by her hip-length purple hair, perfectly accentuating her exquisitely curvaceous figure, evoking a sense of tenderness.
With a gentle gust lifting her skirt, Gongsun Yue’s proportional, slender, and porcelain-like legs were revealed, adding a touch of grace to the morning at Chengdao Peak.
Her hands were as soft as tender shoots, her skin as smooth as congealed fat, her neck as graceful as a silkworm, and her teeth as bright as rhinoceros ivory. With her well-shaped forehead and arched eyebrows, she smiled enchantingly, revealing captivating eyes that glimmered with life.
Han Li appeared silently behind Gongsun Yue, embracing that much-desired waist, and with a slight turn of his head, he could see her flawless side profile, the soft ridge of her nose, and her tender luscious lips casting a charming luminescence, her long curving lashes fluttering gently.
Feeling the warmth of his large hand on her waist and the hot breath brushing her cheek, Gongsun Yue’s heart fluttered. Biting her lip, she whispered softly,
“Junior brother, you can’t come again today.”
She had deeply experienced Han Li’s strength and truly couldn’t withstand it anymore.
Fortunately, Han Li had many other delicate wives and beautiful concubines to relieve her burdens; otherwise, Gongsun Yue would have been worried about the future.
“Still calling me junior brother?” Han Li nibbled on her soft earlobe and murmured.
A tingling sensation arose from within her, making Gongsun Yue almost melt. She bit her lip, hesitated slightly, but still tenderly called out, “My lord~”
Han Li laughed, a look of blissful joy on his face. He felt an immense sense of accomplishment – his senior sister, Gongsun Yue, had finally given him her whole heart.
Gongsun Yue struggled to turn and embrace Han Li; with one hand she held him and with the other, she reached for his warm jade-like cheek. Her tender, onion-like fingers gently caressed his face, gazing at him dazedly, her eyes filled with deep affection.
Han Li looked down at her too. The beautiful senior sister in his arms once radiated innocence and purity, but now she bore a touch of tenderness, even more endearing.
Unable to help himself, Han Li kissed those soft, pink lips. Gongsun Yue closed her eyes without any resistance, savoring the moment.
After a long kiss, Gongsun Yue nestled her head into Han Li’s broad chest. He held her quietly, savoring the warmth and softness of her in his arms.
“Yue’er, let’s go down.” Han Li said warmly.
Gongsun Yue nodded gently.
With his arm around her waist, the two vanished from the mountain peak and appeared on a spacious white jade platform.
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and other delicate wives and beautiful concubines were enjoying the scenery, chatting and laughing merrily.
In the distance, upon one of the subsidiary peaks of Chengsheng Mountain, a faint purple mist rose in the sunlight, making the waterfall appear like a white silk cloth hanging in front of the mountain.
The waterfall, cascading from the high cliffs, was thousands of feet tall, evoking a beautiful sensation of the Milky Way pouring down from the heavens to earth.
“Fragrant Sister, Jiang Jiang Sister, Yun Yun Sister, Yueyao Sister, Mingmeng Sister…”
Gongsun Yue’s arrival captured the attention of all her co-wives, as she greeted them with grace and poise.
Jiang Baiye, Liu Yuexin, Zheng Qiurong, and the other wives returned the gesture graciously. They had all met Gongsun Yue when Han Li officially married her.
These past few days, they had tactfully not sought Han Li, understanding that he would be accompanying and caring for the newlywed Gongsun Yue. They had received the same treatment when they first joined.
Right from the first day, wives like Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi accepted Gongsun Yue. Even concubines like Lin Yiyin, Zhang Yuyan, and Zhou Zhiruo became content once they learned more about Gongsun Yue.
Gongsun Yue was indeed worthy to be their husband’s wife.
“My lord~” Yun Miaoyi, Zhou Zhirou, Chu Yutong, and other co-wives sweetly called out.
Lu Tianxiang glanced at Jiang Baiye, neither of whom used such an endearment. Lu Tianxiang refrained out of consideration for Jiang Baiye’s feelings, while Jiang Baiye was bound by her inner conflict.
With his keen senses, Han Li instantly noticed the expressions of Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang. He could tell Lu Tianxiang was already leaning that way, but Jiang Baiye was still holding back a bit.
After enjoying the magnificent views with everyone, Han Li took Jiang Baiye back to the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Gently embracing Jiang Baiye in his arms, she quivered. Han Li raised an eyebrow, as it had been a long time since Jiang Baiye had reacted that way since the beginning; clearly, there was something on her mind.
Embracing his love in silence, Han Li then turned her to face him and kissed her lips, effectively ending the silence before he looked at Jiang Baiye and spoke earnestly,
“Jiang Jiang, you must remember that you are my wife, Han Li. If you have any grievances in your heart or anything else you want to tell me, husband will solve them for you.”
Jiang Baiye held her lips tightly, hesitant to voice her thoughts.

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - 156 The Changes of the Delicate Wife and Beautiful Concubines, Elder Han Went to Da Qian Capital City_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 156 The Changes of the Delicate Wife and Beautiful Concubines, Elder Han Went to Da Qian Capital City_2
Translator: 549690339
“Is it the Canghai Sect?”
Without waiting for the Sword Immortal to speak, Han Li directly asked.
When Da Qian withdrew from Qingzhou, Canghai Sect also relocated, moving to Jizhou in the Mid Six Province.
However, in the midst of their relocation, Canghai Sect was pursued and attacked by the Yinyang Sect, suffering significant losses, even the Sect Leader was injured, causing their foundation in Jizhou to become somewhat unstable.
If other powers wished to target Canghai Sect, now would be the best opportunity.
The Sword Immortal, Jiang Baiye, shook her head slightly.
She was well aware of Canghai Sect’s situation, but Canghai Sect wasn’t in trouble for now; if there were any problems, Han Li would handle them. With Han Li’s strength, it would be easy for him to assist Canghai Sect by assuming a different identity.
“What is it then?”
Han Li frowned. Apart from Canghai Sect, Jiang Baiye didn’t seem to have any other people or things she cared about; her master within Canghai Sect was also living well.
Jiang Baiye remained silent for a long time before finally looking up at Han Li’s gentle face, gazing into his eyes, and said softly, “Am I being unappreciative?”
Han Li was somewhat stunned. What was Jiang Baiye rambling about?
Jiang Baiye continued, “Sister Lu Tianxiang has completely accepted you, even intending to change what she calls you, but she has held back from calling you ‘husband’ out of consideration for my feelings.”
“In truth, I feel the same way. I’ve been deeply attracted to you and have fallen in love with you, but I’m just extremely shy when it comes to matters of love, I really want to call you ‘husband’, yet I’ve never been able to say it out loud.”
“Sister Lu Tianxiang went through the wedding ritual with you before me and her cultivation level and aptitude are higher, giving her a natural advantage; Yun Miaoyi, though similarly matched with me in terms of circumstances, is more open-hearted and has hence gained your favor;
Now your senior sister Gongsun Yue has arrived too, having been childhood sweethearts with you, she is in no way inferior to me except in cultivation level, and now she calls you ‘husband’ as well.”
“In the future, you will welcome more wives who are not inferior to me, even those whose conditions may be better, and if they too meekly and affectionately call you ‘husband’, gaining your love, then I, who am shy and lack any particularly outstanding advantages, will gradually be neglected by you.”
Having spoken her mind, Jiang Baiye stopped dwelling on her hesitation and poured out her thoughts all at once.
Unnoticed, a couple of tears traced down Jiang Baiye’s exquisitely flawless face. Her emotions were somewhat out of control, and Jiang Baiye knew it, but she didn’t want to keep it bottled up inside any longer. Since Han Li had asked, she decided to lay it all out.
Now she had also fallen for Han Li and was even carrying his child. Han Li was such a flirt, and if she did nothing, the future might turn out exactly as she feared.
Especially since Han Li’s cultivation level was rising too swiftly, this added to the immense pressure on Jiang Baiye.
And Jiang Baiye didn’t want it to be this way; why couldn’t she gain more of Han Li’s affection? She didn’t want her child, once born, to be inferior to the children of Han Li’s other wives.
She wasn’t trying to vie for his favor, but rather she didn’t want to be overlooked by Han Li; she wanted Han Li to keep his promise and treat them all equally and impartially.
Jiang Baiye knew that she was partly to blame for the current situation. She was shy, and feeling inferior compared to Yun Miaoyi and Lu Tianxiang, she fell into a sense of self-doubt.
Han Li’s other cherished wives and concubines were proactive, and unconsciously, Han Li would dote on them more, investing more time and effort in them, and less on her.
Han Li listened quietly to Jiang Baiye’s outpouring, his large hand tightly embracing her, offering comfort.
Seeing Jiang Baiye shedding tears, Han Li suddenly felt a heart-wrenching pain. He stretched out his hand to wipe away her tears, looking at the tearful Sword Immortal, Han Li sighed.
Some of the future scenarios that Jiang Baiye spoke of had already been considered by Han Li, which is why he kept raising the standards for taking concubines; but he hadn’t anticipated that it would still lead to Jiang Baiye feeling this way.
Actually, his affection for Jiang Baiye was no less than that for Yun Miaoyi or Lu Tianxiang; it was only because of some inexplicable self-doubt in Jiang Baiye’s heart that led her to worry about the future.
Han Li decided to administer a strong reassurance to Jiang Baiye, to settle her spirit and put her mind at ease.
Moving his hands from around Jiang Baiye’s slender waist, he placed them on her silky and tender shoulders, looked into her eyes, and said with sincerity and earnestness:
“Jiang Jiang, remember this – you are the unique and incomparable Sword Immortal in my heart.”
“Xiangxiang, Yunyun, and Yue’er may be wonderful, but you are not a whit behind them. You don’t need to compare yourself to them; just be yourself.”
“Whether or not you call me husband, you will always have a place in my heart that is unshakable.”
Jiang Baiye was touched by Han Li’s sincere gaze and the words he spoke resonated deeply within her.
“Mhm~”
She responded softly, a radiant smile blossoming on her beautiful face. All the knots in her heart unraveled, and she believed Han Li would keep his word.
With that, she no longer dwelled on those concerns but focused on being herself.
After hesitating a few times, Jiang Baiye’s lips parted and came together several times, until finally in an almost inaudible voice, she said, “Husband~”
Having spoken, Jiang Baiye lowered her head, seeming quite embarrassed despite having rehearsed this countless times in her mind.
Han Li’s eyes sparkled, and a smile crossed his face. He was relieved that Jiang Baiye was no longer struggling with the issue.
“Jiang Jiang, I didn’t hear you clearly just now, could you say it again?” Han Li embraced her once more, whispering into her ear.
“Hmph~” Jiang Baiye huffed lightly, giving him a sideways glance. Han Li, as the True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, could surely hear her no matter how softly she spoke, especially with them being so close.
“Husband~”
Jiang Baiye repeated it nonetheless. A sweet feeling arose in her heart, finding the address not as cheesy as she had imagined.
“Hahaha~”
Han Li laughed heartily, making no attempt to conceal it this time, allowing Yun Miaoyi, Lu Tianxiang, Gongsun Yue, and the other women on Chengdao Peak to hear clearly.
Yun Miaoyi’s face showed a charming smile. She was happy as well. Having seen Jiang Baiye’s mood, she knew she could not resolve it—only Han Li himself could, as her interventions might only increase Jiang Baiye’s stress.
Lu Tianxiang breathed a sigh of relief, guessing that Han Li had sorted things out with Jiang Baiye. Seeing that Jiang Baiye’s troubles were gone, Han Li’s joy signified that she could also change how she addressed him.
Gongsun Yue also smiled, not knowing exactly what had transpired between Han Li and Jiang Baiye, but it looked like good news. As long as her junior brother was happy, so was she.
After a loving exchange with Jiang Baiye, Han Li and she joined Lu Tianxiang and the others, where Han Li showed his affection for them as well.
Han Li had intended to visit Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, Zhou Zhixuan, and his other wives, but seeing them engrossed in their cultivation, he chose not to disturb them.
Ever since their husband began taking wives, in just a few short years acquiring several, Liu Yuexin, Lin Yiwu, Chu Yumeng, and the other wives also felt the pressure.
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and the others were highly cultivated, with the least among them at the God Refining Realm. In comparison, their own realms fell short, with only Lin Yiwu at the Gangyuan Realm, many like Lin Yiyin and Qiu Yueyao in the Pihai Realm, and the Zhou triplets remaining in the Innate Realm.
They felt their cultivation speed increasing substantially and surmised their aptitude had improved. Although they did not know what method their husband had used, they did not ask, as it was certainly good news.
This meant they could ascend to higher realms. With Han Li’s guidance and the various cultivation resources from Han Mansion, their cultivation speed was now many times faster than those of comparable aptitude following their increase in talent.
Their diligent cultivation aimed at breaking through to the Gangyuan Realm, and even the God Refining Realm. This way, they would have more life to spend alongside their husband.
Even the later additions, the Zhou sisters Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhirou, and Zhou Zhixuan, had their aptitudes increased to seventh-grade under Han Li’s efforts, quickly approaching sixth-grade aptitude.
Han Li was pleased with this progress. He still possessed many Pihai Pills and Gangyuan Pills that could help them reach the Pihai and Gangyuan Realms, respectively. He had also refined many pills that accelerate cultivation speed for these two realms.
Han Li sent a message to his beloved wives and concubines, informing them he was stepping out for a brief errand and would be back soon.
After settling these matters, Han Li’s figure vanished from Chengsheng Mountain. When he reappeared, he was already in the Da Qian Capital City, transformed into a refined middle-aged man.
PS: There’s an Easter egg about Gongsun Yue later on.

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - 157: I am Li Feiyu, Han Li’s Conditions! (Please Subscribe)_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 157: I am Li Feiyu, Han Li’s Conditions! (Please Subscribe)_1
Translator: 549690339
Yuanzhou, Capital City.
Han Li was currently disguised as a refined middle-aged man, dressed in blue, with a piece of green jade hanging from his waist and a folding fan in his hand, appearing like a suave scholar.
He was sitting in a private room on the ninth floor of the renowned Drunken Immortal Pavilion in the Capital City, drinking wine, listening to music, and watching the dance.
In front of him, there were two young beauties, one playing the zither with her delicate hands strumming the strings, producing a melodious and lively sound that seemed to echo through a thousand fleeting years; the other danced gracefully, her skirts billowing as if she were a fluttering butterfly, as supple as a willow, a delight to the eyes.
Both women were attractive, but they lacked talent, so Han Li didn’t even consider taking them as concubines.
“Well done, worthy of reward!”
Han Li clapped his hands and threw out a bag of Spirit Stones, containing several dozen Lower Grade Spirit Stones.
“Thank you, sir, for your generous reward.”
The two women accepted the reward and expressed their thanks before they retreated.
Han Li picked up a cup of wine from the green jade table, took a sip of the Drunken Immortal Pavilion’s signature fine liquor, and found it indeed had an excellent taste.
Originally, he had wanted to visit some of the Capital City’s infamous pleasure houses, but realizing that the courtesans inside had long ago lost their primordial yin, he instantly lost interest.
This time, with his identity and if he were to ally with Chu Zhenxiong, he could have any princesses, empresses, duchesses, and ladies of nobility from the Da Qian if he so wished.
Han Li walked to the window and gazed toward the Imperial Palace. Before his arrival, he had already planned everything, even considering the offer he would make. As for whether Chu Zhenxiong would agree?
Chu Zhenxiong could only agree.
Within the Imperial Palace, in a grand hall, Emperor Qian was reporting the current situation to an old man in grey, Chu Dingqian.
“Ancestor, the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, Da Jing Dynasty, and Fengbo Pavilion have all temporarily subdued their banners, and the situation has somewhat stabilized. As long as we secure our internal affairs, our Da Qian still has a chance,” said Emperor Qian.
“The State Preceptor, the Grand Preceptor, and others have already led the armies to withdraw to the Mid Six Province to set up defenses, and a large number of sects and families from the Outer Twelve States have also migrated here. Although we lost most of our territories, the foundation of Da Qian has been preserved,” he continued.
“The Yinyang Sect, the Kurong Sect…”
Emperor Qian relayed the important parts of the information provided by the court officials to him, his heart filled with mixed emotions.
The death of Prince Wu’an was good news. He no longer had to be a puppet Emperor Qian and could continue to hold great power.
However, the simultaneous deaths of both Prince Wu’an and the Retired Emperor were terrible news, causing the empire to collapse, with two-thirds of the Qian Dynasty’s lands swallowed by the four major powers, leaving only the Mid Six Province.
Even though he could continue to serve as Emperor Qian, his power had diminished greatly. Moreover, the Da Qian faced numerous crises. With the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm emerging in two years, would the True Martial Realm powerhouses from the four major powers continue to invade Da Qian?
Even if they did not lay their hands on Da Qian for the time being, could Elder Chu defend Da Qian for another fifty years given his limited lifespan?
In such a situation, Emperor Qian would rather step down and let someone else take the throne; the pressure of the position was too great for him to bear.
The grey-clothed elder remained silent, and Emperor Qian dared not speak either, silently waiting as he had grown accustomed to the sluggishness of Elder Chu.
After a long while, Chu Dingqian’s eyelids lifted, and he said slowly, “How many Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivators and powers does Da Qian still possess?”
Emperor Qian immediately answered, “There are still quite a few.”
“During this crisis, all of Da Qian’s high-end combat abilities were mobilized, some perished, but most are still alive.”
“One chief of the Imperial Astronomer, two chiefs of the Jingye Office, three military governors, one Great General, the Champion Duke, three pillars of the state, along with two hidden Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivators perished, totaling thirteen,” he reported.
“The powers of the State Preceptor, the Grand Preceptor, the Left Chancellor, and others of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, including me and Chief Cao, as well as two hidden ones, come to seventeen,” he added.
Emperor Qian paused before continuing, “Out of the Ten Major Sects, only two have relocated to the Mid Six Province. Including the two native ones, there are only four Myriad Phenomena Realm powers left.”
Emperor Qian’s heart was filled with bitterness. In its prime, the Qian Dynasty had a profound foundation, owning eighteen provinces with three True Martial Realm powerhouses commanding over forty Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters.
Now, the Qian Dynasty’s territory was reduced to the Mid Six Province, with only Elder Chu left in the True Martial Realm, a mere seventeen official Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivators, and merely four or five from the people, a significant loss of vitality.
“Ah~”
Chu Dingqian sighed, as he had also thought of everything Emperor Qian had.
He, who had personally founded the Qian Dynasty, could now only struggle to survive, even though he might forcefully endure with just about forty to fifty years of life left.
If he couldn’t find a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu to oversee things, he would flee Da Qian before the emergence of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, and the Qian Dynasty could fall overnight.
Chu Dingqian had no other options. When the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm emerged, the True Martial Realm powerhouses trapped within would appear. If they launched an attack, he could kill two or three with his strength but would ultimately die himself.
However, Chu Dingqian did not want to die; he wanted to live through a third, a fourth, or even more lives. He wanted to reach the Divine Yuan Realm or even the Tongxuan Realm.
As long as he succeeded in cultivating to the Divine Yuan Realm in one life and become Emperor Wu, he would have five thousand years of life, truly standing at the pinnacle of Qianyuan Divine Province with ample time to cultivate the next Devil Fetus.
In this way, life after life, he would eventually reach a higher realm and might even be capable of challenging the Four Great Sacred Lands.
With a True Martial Realm helper, the situation would be different; the deterrent power of the Qian Dynasty would increase significantly, the four major powers would have more reservations, and he could focus on nurturing the Devil Fetus, buying himself more time to re-cultivate to the True Martial Realm.
Unfortunately, during this period, he had contacted two old friends, but they were unwilling to stand up for the Qian Dynasty, not daring to offend the four major powers.

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - 157: I am Li Feiyu, Han Li’s Conditions! (Please Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 157: I am Li Feiyu, Han Li’s Conditions! (Please Subscribe)_2
Translator: 549690339
Chu Dingqian planned to wait for one more stable month in the Daqian Empire before setting out to seek assistance elsewhere, even considering moving to Tianxuan Mountain within the scope of the Qitian Teaching.
Though Tianxuan Mountain was weak, it had the support of a powerful True Martial Realm Emperor Wu behind it. If he could win them over, then the Daqian Empire would be secure.
All of a sudden, Chu Dingqian’s brow furrowed slightly, and a surge of emotion rose in his heart. He said to Emperor Qian, “You go and make the arrangements first. We must stabilize the interior of Da Qian as quickly as possible.”
Emperor Qian received the order and left the grand hall.
As soon as he left, Chu Dingqian’s figure also disappeared. Then, he appeared above the sky, his Spiritual Sense sweeping towards the Drunken Immortal Pavilion. After detecting no ambush, the next instant he appeared in the private room on the ninth floor of the Drunken Immortal Pavilion.
Upon clearly seeing the face of the other party, Chu Dingqian was overjoyed, but he forcefully suppressed it, not showing his emotions and asked with feigned composure,
“I wonder why the esteemed friend has summoned me here? I don’t believe we are acquainted.”
Chu Dingqian stood with his hands behind his back, his right hand clutching a small furnace densely inscribed with runes, yet it emitted no aura, appearing to be just an ordinary incense burner.
He did not employ his Spiritual Sense, but instead fortified his sight with the Power of the Divine Spirit, attempting to see through this person’s true identity, though he did not succeed.
While guessing the purpose of this person’s visit to the Capital City to find him, he also contemplated the person’s origins.
“Chu friend, you sure are fast. Your profound strength truly lives up to your reputation,” said Han Li without rising, his body and the green jade desk both floating in the air, level with Chu Dingqian.
Han Li had chosen the Drunken Immortal Pavilion specifically to meet here with this True Martial Realm elder of Da Qian.
Though he was very confident in his own strength and knew that Chu Zhenxiong would not choose to battle him at this time, Han Li still did not want to take risks. The Daqian Palace was surely protected by True Martial Realm Formations, much more powerful than those in the Capital City.
The defensive grand Formation of the Capital City could not stop him, but the Imperial Palace’s might be a different story. Meeting here served the same purpose, as his Divine Sense enveloped the space, preventing the outside world from hearing or seeing anything.
At the same time, Han Li mentally heightened his alertness to the utmost, quickly preparing to stimulate his Divine Sense and activate the Zhenjun Sword atop the green jade desk to slay Chu Zhenxiong.
“Oh, where can I compare? My strength is still lacking compared to esteemed friend, who has slain the Yin Yang Sect’s fiend Dugu Bing with his sword. Now, your name shakes the world, earning the admiration of countless beings,” praised Chu Zhenxiong.
This refined middle-aged man, seemingly amiable, possessed a terrifying combat record. Chu Zhenxiong dared not underestimate him at all, not even speaking in a condescending tone but choosing a more equal approach.
Having read the detailed reports of the battle at Leizhou, he knew this person was amiable at first, consistently advocating peace to the Yin Yang Sect’s Dugu Bing. Dugu Bing did not listen and even looked down on him, speaking arrogantly and incessantly, until he finally enraged the man. A few sword strikes later, Dugu Bing was severely injured, and if not for his escape using a Blood Evading Technique, he would likely have perished in Leizhou.
“What I did is hardly a notable achievement. Chu friend is the one who…” As Chu Zhenxiong had given face, Han Li also exchanged compliments with him.
The two exchanged flattery while remaining on guard against each other, cautious of a sudden attack.
After a while, Chu Dingqian inquired, “May I ask how to address esteemed friend?”
He had already guessed the purpose of the other’s visit. This person must be aware of the predicament of Da Qian. Coming at this time and maintaining goodwill throughout, the purpose was clear.
Still, he harbored many doubts. What were the origins of this person? Why did they want to help Da Qian? And what conditions might they propose?
Chu Dingqian contemplated the price he was willing to pay, as well as how big the other’s appetite might be.
“I am Li Feiyu,” Han Li said indifferently, a pseudonym he had prepared long ago.
“So, it’s friend Li,” nodded Chu Dingqian slightly. He knew this was surely a false name, but it did not matter. As long as the other’s cultivation was real and the intent to help Da Qian genuine, that was enough.
After thinking, Chu Dingqian said, “What brings esteemed friend Li here?”
“My purpose is simple, to help Da Qian escape its plight,” Han Li stated plainly.
Han Li no longer cared to engage in much conversation with Chu Zhenxiong, preferring to get straight to the point. If they could reach an agreement, so be it; if not, they would part ways.
Chu Dingqian’s pupils contracted slightly, and his heart leaped with joy, though he did not show it. He quietly asked, “What are esteemed friend Li’s conditions?”
“That would depend on what kind of help you specifically need from me,” Han Li said nonchalantly.
“With your formidable strength, could you assassinate the old ancestor Yuwen Hua of the Da Jing Empire for me?” Chu Dingqian ventured.
The royal family of the Da Jing Empire is the Yuwen family, and Yuwen Hua is another True Martial Realm ancestor of the Empire. Yuwen Hua is at the Fifth Heaven of the True Martial Realm and currently presides over the Capital City of Da Jing.
Behind the Yinyang Sect stands the Demon Clan, and the Kurong Sect is supported by the Buddhist Sect. Even Fengbo Pavilion is backed by a major power, at least at the level of the Divine Yuan Realm. Chu Dingqian could not afford to provoke any of them.
Among the four forces invading the Daqian Empire, only the Da Jing Empire can be provoked and is also the easiest to grasp because it has no background.
If Li Feiyu indeed killed Yuwen Hua of the Da Jing Empire, then the Daqian Empire would be saved.
The Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and Fengbo Pavilion would certainly take the opportunity to destroy the Da Jing Empire, allowing the Daqian Empire to catch its breath and even take the opportunity to retake Sanzhou in the north and invade Da Jing, biting off a large chunk of territory.
“Possibly.”
“And the conditions?”
“Three Heaven Rank Top Grade Cultivation Techniques or Martial Arts, ten Heaven Rank middle to lower grade Cultivation Techniques and Martial Arts, the number and grade of Heaven Rank Artifacts to match, plus five million Top Quality Spirit Stones, ten bottles of Third Grade Spirit Pills…” Han Li stated indifferently.
“Hiss~”
Hearing Han Li’s conditions, even Chu Dingqian inhaled sharply and said with a wry smile, “Friend Han, you are really asking for the lion’s share. The Daqian Empire simply can’t bring out that many rare treasures.”
Heaven Rank Top Grade Cultivation Techniques, Martial Arts, and Artifacts are all at the level of the Divine Yuan Realm. Although the Daqian Empire possesses some, it does not have so many.
Chu Dingqian could grit his teeth and produce ten Heaven Rank middle to lower grade Cultivation Techniques and Martial Arts, ten Heaven Rank middle to lower grade Magical Treasures, and ten bottles of Third Grade Spirit Pills.
But five million Top Quality Spirit Stones was an astronomical figure, which Chu Dingqian could not produce.
One Top Quality Spirit Stone is worth ten thousand Lower Grade Spirit Stones; five million Top Quality Spirit Stones amount to five hundred billion Lower Grade Spirit Stones. Chu Dingqian could not produce such a sum, and even if he could, he would not do so as it would deplete the entire Daqian Empire.
Tianxuan Mountain had been accumulating for over a thousand years and, besides the Spirit Stones consumed, had less than thirty million Lower Grade Spirit Stones, twice as much as a typical Dongxu Stage Force.
Myriad Phenomena Realm Forces typically have a reserve of one to five billion Lower Grade Spirit Stones. The Daqian Empire, being a True Martial Realm-level force, despite constantly accruing a massive amount of Spirit Stones, also has tremendous expenditures. The reserves are thus only around three to four million Top Quality Spirit Stones.
“Yuwen Hua is a Fifth Heaven True Martial Realm Martial Emperor, always stationed in the Capital City of Da Jing, with the Imperial Palace heavily fortified by Formations. Isn’t he quite hard to kill?”
“My attack on him may cost me my life, so these conditions are not high,” Han Li said lightly, persuading him earnestly.
He knew Chu Zhenxiong was testing him, so Han Li deliberately made a huge demand, knowing full well that Chu Zhenxiong would not agree. Even if he did, what then?
If worse comes to worst, he could wait a few years to break through to the True Martial Realm before attacking Yuwen Hua. By then, would Chu Zhenxiong dare to default on the deal?
If he dared to go back on his word, Han Li would simply kill him too.
Of course, this was limited to the Da Jing Empire. If Chu Zhenxiong asked him to attack forces such as the Yinyang Sect, the Kurong Sect, or Fengbo Pavilion in the True Martial Realm, Han Li would not make such demands, not daring to provoke these powerful entities before gaining sufficient strength.
Although he was wearing Li Feiyu’s “mail,” Han Li could not guarantee that the two Sacred Lands behind the Yinyang Sect and the Kurong Sect could absolutely not trace the deeds back to him.
It wouldn’t be as easy as saying, “This was done by Li Feiyu, what does it have to do with me, Han Li? Go find Li Feiyu.”
Chu Dingqian nodded slightly, acknowledging Li Feiyu’s words. Killing a True Martial Realm Martial Emperor was difficult enough, let alone one in the middle phase of the True Martial Realm, ensconced in his own lair.
“If I need the help of friend Han to guard the Daqian for five hundred years, what would your conditions be?”
