chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 158: Six Conditions, Jian’an Spirit, I Want the Empress and Princesses All!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 158: Six Conditions, Jian’an Spirit, I Want the Empress and Princesses All!_1
Translator: 549690339
Gazing at the refined middle-aged man seated cross-legged in midair, Chu Dingqian voiced his ultimate request.
This was his longstanding goal, to find a True Martial Realm martial king who would station themselves in the Daqian Empire for five hundred years, ensuring five centuries of peace for the Qian Dynasty.
Chu Dingqian had less than fifty years left to live, and even if he wished to cultivate a Devil Fetus, it would require over fifty years. He no longer had enough time and was forced to choose among lesser cultivators.
Should he survive into his third life, he would need to consider security issues, how to keep living. If nothing unexpected occurred, he was confident he could reach the True Martial Realm within three hundred years.
During this period, Chu Dingqian hoped that the Daqian Empire would continue to prosper in peace, maintaining its six provinces would suffice. That way, he would have a safe environment to grow in.
However, finding a True Martial Realm martial king to help the Daqian was extremely difficult, let alone one willing to commit five hundred years. After all, such kings only lived for two thousand years.
Although he knew it was difficult, Chu Dingqian didn’t want to give up, for if he did, his hard-built Qian Dynasty would fall apart, and his own reincarnation would lack any guarantee of safety.
Even if a great price must be paid, Chu Dingqian thought it worthwhile. As long as he could live into his third life and cultivate to the True Martial Realm, all of this would be trivial. He could reclaim everything and own it all once again.
“Stationed for five hundred years?” Han Li spoke in surprise.
Chu Dingqian dared to make such a bold request. Five hundred years would consume a quarter of a True Martial Realm’s lifespan—who would be willing to commit so much time to the Qian Dynasty?
Normally, it takes about six hundred years for a cultivator with Third Grade talent to progress to the True Martial Realm and between six hundred to under a thousand years for those with Fourth Grade or lesser talent. Cultivators from the Myriad Phenomena Realm can only live for a thousand years.
If one comes across various fortunes along the path of cultivation, this time frame could be significantly reduced, with specifics varying from person to person.
Considering a lifespan of six hundred years, a cultivator who breaks through to the True Martial Realm has another one thousand four hundred years to live—who would be willing to bind five hundred of those to the Qian Dynasty?
This entails a significant risk. During this time, one must cope with forces like the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, Fengbo Pavilion, and the Da Jing Empire. Over five centuries, it’s very likely that other troubles would arise, all requiring resolution to assure the Qian Dynasty’s survival.
Chu Dingqian nodded firmly and said, “Yes, exactly five hundred years.”
“Are you trying to secure growth time for a future True Martial Realm ruler of the Daqian Empire?” Han Li frowned and inquired.
Chu Dingqian feigned hesitation before nodding. “That is my intention. The Daqian Empire was founded through the arduous efforts of my ancestors to build what we have today—I can’t let it be destroyed on my watch.”
While it was Chu Dingqian seeking time for himself, he certainly couldn’t say that. Li Feiyu, with his unclear origins, could not be fully trusted. Chu Dingqian dared not even mention a specific time frame—after all, the longer the better.
This was also a smokescreen for the outside world. When he returned from body snatching, the world would only believe a new True Martial Realm king had emerged in the Qian Dynasty, none wiser to Chu Dingqian’s third life.
Han Li narrowed his eyes, choosing to remain silent for the moment.
The conditions set by Chu Zhenxiong were difficult for others, mainly due to the five hundred-year commitment. But to Han Li, it was not much. He was, after all, from the Qian Dynasty and needed its stability, allowing Han Mansion and himself to continue developing discreetly.
For him, five hundred years were unnecessary; with only a hundred or even fifty years, he could ascend to the Divine Yuan Realm. Five hundred years would be enough to cultivate to the Tongxuan Realm.
He only needed to create a front to safeguard the Qian Dynasty. Once Chu Zhenxiong died, the empire would be his to manipulate at will, free from anyone within the empire who could check his power.
By then, he would need to ensure the Qian Dynasty’s stable existence even more, functioning as a protective umbrella for Han Mansion, allowing it to prosper quickly under the empire’s protection.
Before Chu Zhenxiong’s death, external pressures on the Qian would be handled by them both. Once Chu Zhenxiong perished, all such pressures would fall upon Li Feiyu, the alias Han Li would be using.
However, Han Li had confidence in himself. Before Chu Zhenxiong’s death, he would reach the Divine Yuan Realm; at the very least, he would possess Divine Yuan combat potential. By that time, unless those Sacred Lands and Divine Yuan Realm Powers personally intervened, safeguarding the Daqian Empire would be more than manageable.
For the Qian Dynasty’s six state borders, other powers would certainly weigh whether it was worth offending a powerful True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
Seeing Li Feiyu holding back, Chu Dingqian grew anxious. A strong True Martial Realm cultivator had appeared, and he could not let this opportunity slip by.
“Friend Li, you are free to make any demands. As long as Chu can fulfill them, I will do my utmost to satisfy your needs,” Chu Dingqian immediately said.
He knew that securing a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu to oversee the Daqian for five hundred years was incredibly difficult, but Chu Dingqian refused to give up. He was prepared to pay any price to secure Li Feiyu.
Speaking of the immediate concern, it was about whether he could safely grow into the True Martial Realm in his third life. Looking at the bigger picture, it was about whether he could cultivate to the Tongxuan Realm in the future and challenge the Four Great Sacred Lands.
Han Li’s right hand rhythmically tapped on the jade desk, yet he did not voice any terms. He wanted to wear down Chu Zhenxiong’s resolve.
If he set forth those conditions now, Chu Zhenxiong might refuse. But if he were to wear the man down, Chu Zhenxiong’s mindset and lower limits would gradually diminish. It would then be ideal to offer the conditions later.
As time ticked by, Chu Dingqian’s heart grew increasingly anxious. He did not know whether Li Feiyu was truly contemplating or deliberately leaving him hanging, yet Chu Dingqian had little recourse.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 158: Six Conditions, Jian’an Spirit, I Want the Empress and Princesses All!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 158: Six Conditions, Jian’an Spirit, I Want the Empress and Princesses All!_2
Translator: 549690339
After leaving Chu Zhenxiong hanging for half an hour, Han Li spoke leisurely, “Chu Daoist, since you have made this request, have you considered what price you are willing to pay?”
Chu Dingqian immediately replied, “Of course I have considered it. Please, Han Daoist, just state your terms.”
Han Li nodded slightly and continued, “First of all, by coming forward and standing with the Da Qian Empire, I will become an enemy of the Yinyang Sect, the Kurong Sect, Fengbo Pavilion, and the Da Jing Empire, which will bring me great risk. What do you think, Chu Daoist?”
Chu Dingqian gave a bitter smile and inwardly sighed. This Li Feiyu was indeed cunning and shrewd, having been stringing him along earlier.
He wants to elaborate on how difficult and dangerous his request is, continually lowering his psychological baseline, to obtain more benefits for Li Feiyu.
Although Chu Dingqian understood this, he had no choice since he was the one asking for help; there was no room for bargaining, and he had to bear the overt scheme.
Chu Dingqian nodded and said, “What Han Daoist said is extremely true.”
A hint of satisfaction flashed in Han Li’s eyes. This Chu Zhenxiong was indeed sensible, not nitpicking or dragging his feet, rather clear cut. It seemed he was in dire need of his help.
“Secondly, in two years’ time, the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm will emerge. The True Martial Realm practitioners from the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and other four major forces will break free from their bindings. By then, if they choose to continue targeting the Da Qian Empire, I alone will not be able to hold them back. My life will be in great danger,” Han Li continued.
Chu Dingqian opened his mouth, wanting to say that it was unlikely for those four major forces to act after the True Martial Realm practitioners were freed since the Da Qian Empire only had territories of six states, plus there were two Emperor Wus in the True Martial Realm.
However, Chu Dingqian ultimately did not speak these words. Knowing that Li Feiyu was intentionally exaggerating the dangers, he went along with his words and said, “What Han Daoist said is extremely true.”
“Your lifespan isn’t much longer, Chu Daoist, can you live another fifty years? Once you ascend to the heavens, it will be up to me to support the Da Qian Empire. The external pressure is immense. Although I would like to withstand it, a single person can hardly prop up the sky, and the spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak,” Han Li said.
This time, Chu Dingqian did not hesitate and directly replied, “What Han Daoist said is extremely true.”
“Lastly, five hundred years is too long; no one can say what changes may occur. If True Martial Realm Emperor Wus continually set their sights on the Da Qian Empire, I will have to engage them in battle, repelling each attempt. The risk inherent, you must be well aware of,” Han Li said.
Chu Dingqian feigned hesitation, exhaled a deep breath, and then slowly said, “If Han Daoist feels five hundred years is too long, four hundred years is not out of the question.”
Chu Dingqian knew that five hundred years was impossible since, after living through three lifetimes, he would be able to ascend to the True Martial Realm in about three hundred years. Having Li Feiyu holding the fort for four hundred years would be sufficient for his growth.
“So, Han Daoist, you can state your conditions now, right?”
Chu Dingqian knew he was at a disadvantage, but he resignedly accepted it. All could be discussed after cultivating to the True Martial Realm in three hundred years.
At that time, he could take back everything he had lost from Li Feiyu.
The atmosphere having built to this point, Han Li no longer delayed intentionally and finally stated his conditions, “I have six conditions. If Chu Daoist can meet them, I will guard the Da Qian Empire for four hundred years.”
“Huh~”
A twitch surfaced on Chu Dingqian’s lips when he heard six conditions, knowing that each one would be extortionate. After exhaling a long breath, Chu Dingqian said:
“Please, Han Daoist, speak.”
Immediately, Han Li listed the six conditions he had thought up, “First, Da Qian must pay me ten thousand Supreme Grade Spirit Stones.”
Theoretically, one Supreme Grade Spirit Stone is equivalent to a hundred Top Grade Spirit Stones, but it is very difficult to exchange a hundred Top Grade Spirit Stones for one Supreme Grade one, and a premium price is necessary.
Supreme Grade Spirit Stones contain a hundred times more Spiritual Energy than Top Grade Spirit Stones, and are also more pure and easier to absorb and refine, essential for high-level cultivators.
Although Han Li did not need them for his own use, his wife Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and others could all use them. As for his concubines, they should first cultivate to the Gang Yuan Realm.
Before Han Li could continue, Chu Dingqian’s face twitched as he said with a bitter smile, “Han Daoist may not be aware, but Da Qian does not have so many Supreme Grade Spirit Stones.”
Han Li’s eyebrows raised slightly.
Chu Dingqian immediately explained, “Top-grade Spirit Stones are generally produced in top-grade Spirit Stone Mines. There are also a small amount of top-grade Spirit Stones found at the core of top-quality Spirit Stone Mines. However, Daqian does not have any top-grade Spirit Stone Mines, only some top-quality ones.”
“In the past three thousand years, aside from the top-grade Spirit Stones that have been used, Daqian has stored only about a thousand top-grade Spirit Stones.”
After some thought, Han Li said, “Then one thousand top-grade Spirit Stones, plus nine hundred and fifty thousand top-quality Spirit Stones.”
“Agreed.” Chu Dingqian immediately consented.
Although this meant paying an extra fifty thousand top-quality Spirit Stones, Chu Dingqian did not want to prolong the negotiation. The Daqian Empire still had three to four million top-quality Spirit Stones, so it could afford the extra fifty thousand.
“The second condition: two Heaven Rank high-grade cultivation techniques and martial skills, four Heaven Rank mid- to lower-grade cultivation techniques and martial skills, half each; thirty Earth Level cultivation martial skills.”
When Han Li stated the second condition, he voluntarily lowered his demands. He didn’t want to haggle too much with Chu Zhenxiong. After all, once Chu Zhenxiong died, everything in the Daqian would be under his control, and he could take whatever he wanted.
Seeing that Chu Zhenxiong remained silent, Han Li continued to propose terms, “The third condition: ten bottles of Third-Grade Spiritual Pills, fifty bottles of Fourth-Grade Spiritual Pills, and two hundred bottles of Fifth-Grade Spiritual Pills.”
Chu Dingqian’s eyelids twitched, yet he stayed silent.
“The fourth condition: one Heaven Rank high-grade Divine Sword, three Heaven Rank mid-grade Magical Treasures, five Heaven Rank lower-grade Magical Treasures, twenty each of Supreme Grade and Top Grade Earth Rank Magical Treasures.”
“Fellow Daoist Li, isn’t this too much?” Chu Dingqian couldn’t help but speak up.
If they really agreed to Li Feiyu’s condition, Daqian’s collection of Heaven Rank Artifacts would be depleted by more than half, and their Earth Rank Artifacts would be reduced by half as well.
“Not at all, this is what I’m trading my life and four hundred years for,” Han Li said indifferently.
Chu Dingqian sighed bitterly and had no choice but to say, “Please continue, Fellow Daoist Li.”
“This fifth condition will not be difficult for you, Chu. Due to my cultivation technique, I will need to marry some female cultivators in time, and I hope you will not interfere,” Han Li said with a smile.
Han Li did not specify which female cultivators he wanted, but he already had some targets in mind, such as the well-known princesses of Daqian, duchesses, and so on.
He had also heard that the current empress was a stunningly beautiful and mature woman, gentle as water. Additionally, those high-cultivated and attractive noblewomen were also worth considering.
Han Li had long admired the legacy of Weiwu Yifeng and had not had the opportunity to act on it; all the wives and concubines he had taken were intact. Now, he was considering a change of taste.
Of course, Han Li was clear in his mind—those empresses and princesses could at most be his concubines, becoming his wives was out of the question.
As long as their cultivation was high, their appearance attractive, and their demeanor and figure were good, Han Li was willing to consider them for his harem. He planned to establish another Li Manor in the Daqian Capital City. Regardless of whether his descendants bore the Han or Li name, they were all his progeny and could provide him with rewards like cultivation, talent, and lifespan.
One Han Mansion, one Li Manor. In the future, he could consider establishing some other clans. After all, he was the source, and this would significantly reduce the risk of losing everything should Han Mansion ever fall.
“Agreed,” Chu Dingqian readily answered, finding this to be the easiest and least distressing of the five conditions.
What Chu Dingqian could never have imagined was that Han Li’s targets included the empress and princesses, which meant he would have to swallow his suffering silently in the future, with no way to express it.
“What is the sixth condition, Fellow Daoist Li?” Chu Dingqian inquired, figuring it might be as simple as the fifth.
“The sixth condition is also quite simple; all you have to do is give me that little furnace you’re holding,” Han Li said calmly.
“What?”
Chu Dingqian was startled, almost thinking he had misheard.
Warned by this, Han Li prepared to take action at any moment, and then he enunciated clearly, “I said, I want the little furnace in your hands.”
“As long as you agree, Fellow Daoist Chu, our alliance will be established, and I will protect Daqian for four hundred years, shielding it from the storm and ensuring the stable development of the Qian Dynasty.”

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 159: The Soul-Cultivating Furnace! Xiao Chu, you’re heading down a dangerous path! Han Li’s murderous intent_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 159: The Soul-Cultivating Furnace! Xiao Chu, you’re heading down a dangerous path! Han Li’s murderous intent_1
Translator: 549690339
You want the furnace in my hand?
Chu Dingqian’s heart skipped a beat.
He did not know how Li Feiyu had seen it, and Chu Dingqian’s first thought was to take action and kill this Li Feiyu.
This furnace was a treasure, something Chu Dingqian had obtained in a relic when he was young in his first lifetime, and it played a significant role in his rapid cultivation to the True Martial Realm.
In ancient times, there was the Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace, a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon of unparalleled might. The heavens and the earth trembled for it, and the stars shattered, reversing the universe and eclipsing the sun and moon when it was activated, shattering mountains and rivers within billions of miles.
There were two replicas of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, made by powerful beings from ancient times. They were failed products, only of Heaven Rank Supreme Grade Magical Treasures, one was the Body-Cultivating Furnace and the other was the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
The furnace Chu Dingqian held was the Soul-Cultivating Furnace. Although it was just a replica of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, its might and efficacy were indeed immense for Chu Dingqian, and it could still be used even after he advanced to the Divine Yuan Realm and became Emperor Wu.
For three thousand years, Chu Dingqian had been collecting information about the Body-Cultivating Furnace, hoping to acquire the other replica of the Life-Prolonging Furnace. It was said that the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and the Body-Cultivating Furnace would greatly resonate within a certain range, sensing each other’s exact location.
Chu Dingqian also knew another legend about the Life-Prolonging Furnace: the powerful ancient being only made one replica of the Life-Prolonging Furnace that reached the Lower Grade Divine Weapon level, but he seemed dissatisfied, so he split the Lower Grade Divine Weapon into two, creating the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
Should a cultivator obtain both the Body-Cultivating Furnace and the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and use the correct method, it was possible to recombine the two furnaces into a Lower Grade Divine Weapon.
The lone Soul-Cultivating Furnace, being of the Heaven Rank and Supreme Grade, had such great power and efficacy. If combined into one to become a Lower Grade Divine Weapon, its might would undoubtedly increase manyfold, and it might even help one cultivate to the Divine Yuan Realm.
Chu Dingqian knew that the Canghai Sect possessed the Body-Cultivating Furnace, which was only of Heaven Rank Lower Grade. He had once brought the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and sneaked into the Canghai Sect to investigate. Although there was a slight resonance between the two, they could not merge into one.
He speculated that it might have been sealed. He tried various methods to unseal it, but to no effect.
In the end, Chu Dingqian disappointingly discovered that the Body-Cultivating Furnace of the Canghai Sect was merely an imitation of the true Body-Cultivating Furnace, which was why there was only a slight resonance.
Considering certain reasons, Chu Dingqian did not seize the Canghai Sect’s Body-Cultivating Furnace at that time.
The Soul-Cultivating Furnace was the only Heaven Rank Supreme Grade Magical Treasure owned by the Daqian Empire and Chu Dingqian himself. Li Feiyu called him out for a meeting, and Chu Dingqian directly brought along the Soul-Cultivating Furnace. In the event of a great battle, the Soul-Cultivating Furnace could definitely kill enemies.
With his cultivation, even an Emperor Wu in the later stages of True Martial Realm couldn’t withstand the power of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace. This was Chu Dingqian’s biggest trump card.
With the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, he could traverse the Xuan Domain, of which there weren’t even three Emperors Wu in the later stages of the True Martial Realm.
“Bang~ Bang~”
The sound of Han Li knocking on the table came through, awakening Chu Dingqian, who immediately gathered his myriad thoughts.
Looking at the smiling, yet not smiling, Li Feiyu, Chu Dingqian forcefully suppressed the killing intent in his heart, deciding to test the waters. If Li Feiyu didn’t know the origin of the furnace and just felt it was a powerful Magical Treasure, then he could replace it with other Magical Treasures.
Chu Dingqian quickly organized his words and said, “Fellow Daoist Li, this is but a trifle, a favorite plaything of mine, rather dear to me, truly difficult to part with.”
Chu Dingqian did not want to take action; he had come to seek Li Feiyu’s help, hoping he would defend the Daqian Empire and protect it for hundreds of years, so he himself could safely grow stronger.
If he killed Li Feiyu, where would he find another Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm to guard the Qian Dynasty?
Moreover, Li Feiyu appeared very confident and complacent. Chu Dingqian also wasn’t entirely sure that he could kill him.
If Li Feiyu escaped, that would truly be a deadly feud. Even if he found another Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm to guard the dynasty later, once he seized a new body and was reborn, that Li Feiyu would certainly seek vengeance.
“What a coincidence, Fellow Li also enjoys playing with furnaces on a usual basis, so upon seeing it, I instantly took a liking to it. I hope Fellow Chu can bear the pain of parting with it.”
Han Li smiled broadly, while reiterating, “As long as Fellow Chu is willing to part with this furnace and gift it to me, I will immediately form an alliance with Fellow Chu and protect the Qian Dynasty for four hundred years.”
Han Li naturally noticed that Chu Zhenxiong was reluctant to part with it. Even though Chu Zhenxiong’s murderous intent was deeply hidden, Han Li sensed it. He remained vigilant, ready to act first and flee, should Chu Zhenxiong decide to take action; there was no need to fight to the death.
When Chu Zhenxiong arrived, Han Li’s senses kept frantically warning him that Chu Zhenxiong had something capable of threatening him in his hand.
Han Li quietly activated his Divine Sense and eventually detected the source of the threat. It turned out to be the right hand Chu Zhenxiong kept behind his back, holding a small furnace inscribed with runes, in a state of activation but without exposing a breath of it.
If not for his extremely keen senses, he wouldn’t have noticed at all. He was Han Li, “Han Laozu”, who had the Divine Sense.
Han Li had once collected information on Divine Sense and found only a few records of it, even rarer in ancient times.
The small furnace in Chu Zhenxiong’s hand looked familiar to Han Li. A flash of insight made him realize that it was most likely the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, its runes closely resembling those of the Body-Cultivating Furnace, but its might was countless times greater.
Possibly, the Body-Cultivating Furnace he placed in Chengsheng Mountain was a second-rate imitation, while the Soul-Cultivating Furnace in Chu Zhenxiong’s hands was a first-rate imitation.
The Soul-Cultivating Furnace was a Heaven Rank Supreme Grade Magical Treasure, and Han Li was naturally extremely tempted to acquire this treasure from Chu Zhenxiong’s hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 159: Soul-Cultivating Furnace! Xiao Chu, you’re walking a narrow path! Han Li’s murderous intent_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 159: Soul-Cultivating Furnace! Xiao Chu, you’re walking a narrow path! Han Li’s murderous intent_2
Translator: 549690339
Meanwhile, Han Li had also realized something: if Chu Zhenxiong had the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, then what was hidden within Chengsheng Mountain could possibly be the true Body-Cultivating Furnace or even the Ancient Supreme Life-Prolonging Furnace.
Only by obtaining the Soul-Cultivating Furnace could he further investigate Chengsheng Mountain, discern whether it was the Body-Cultivating Furnace or the Life-Prolonging Furnace that was hidden, and get it into his hands.
Chu Dingqian remained silent, looking at Li Feiyu opposite him, his heart caught in a tumultuous struggle.
The Soul-Cultivating Furnace was crucial for his rapid rise after rebirth through possession. Chu Dingqian did not want to hand it over to Li Feiyu, otherwise, he had no confidence in cultivating to the True Martial Realm within three hundred years after his rebirth.
It might take four hundred years, five hundred years… The longer the time, the more variables, and the greater the risk. Chu Dingqian did not dare to take this risk.
Yet, Li Feiyu was very eager to have the Soul-Cultivating Furnace. It seemed that if he did not give it to him, even if the previous five conditions were very generous, Li Feiyu would not agree to the alliance, nor protect the Da Qian for four hundred years.
On one hand was the risk of extending the time to break through to the True Martial Realm in his third life; on the other hand was facing great risks right now. This indecision tormented Chu Dingqian.
Sometimes he thought of rising in rebellion and killing Li Feiyu, yet he also worried about not being able to kill him and that he might not find another True Martial Realm cultivator afterwards.
If Li Feiyu came to help him but ended up being attacked, who among the cultivators at the True Martial Realm would dare to come forward after such news spread?
At other times, he considered giving up the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, straightforwardly handing it over to Li Feiyu. After recultivating back to the True Martial Realm in his third life, he could settle accounts with Li Feiyu and take back the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
“Sigh~”
Suddenly, Han Li sighed, a look of dissatisfaction on his face as he said, “Well, well, since Brother Chu is not willing to part with it, then I shall not insist.”
Han Li decided to tactically give up. He had sensed Chu Zhenxiong’s hidden murderous intent, which at certain moments was especially intense, indicating that Chu Zhenxiong was very reluctant to part with it and definitely knew the origins of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
No ancestor builds a wall under a crumbling ruin.
Grand Ancestor Han was not fully confident he could withstand a strike from the Soul-Cultivating Furnace. If he suffered severe injuries, it would be quite unfavorable.
With that in mind, he decided to not go after the Soul-Cultivating Furnace for now. In order to gain greater benefits, Han Li decided to propose a different condition, meanwhile confusing Chu Zhenxiong, making him believe that Han Li was unaware that it was the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
But Grand Ancestor Han had no intention of giving up on the Soul-Cultivating Furnace. He already noted Chu Zhenxiong in his ledger; daring to harbor murderous intentions towards an ancestor, Chu, your path has narrowed.
Grand Ancestor Han had already decided to kill Chu Zhenxiong.
In about two more years, he would be able to advance to the True Martial Realm, his combat ability most likely soaring to the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm. At that time, he could seek an opportunity to assassinate Chu Zhenxiong and take the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
Of course, this was somewhat risky, as it might let the outside world know that two True Martial Realm powerhouses within the Daqian Empire were in conflict, plunging the empire once again into turmoil.
Thus, Grand Ancestor Han was considering whether to wait until he possessed the combat ability of a Divine Yuan Realm warrior before going to suppress Chu Zhenxiong. By then, no news would leak to the outside world, and everyone would simply think Chu Zhenxiong was still in seclusion.
Chu Zhenxiong dying earlier, Han Li felt, would be advantageous for him, as he could take control of the Daqian Empire sooner, with no one left to impede him.
“Chu, you’re forcing an ancestor’s hand,” Han Li thought silently to himself.
As Han Li’s words fell, he could clearly sense Chu Zhenxiong’s murderous intent dissipating.
“How can you say that, Brother Li? I am ashamed, it’s just that I’ve been fond of this little furnace for over a thousand years, and have grown attached to it. Otherwise, I would have gifted it to Brother Li right away. I hope you understand,” replied Chu Zhenxiong.
“How about this? Since Brother Li also fancies such trinkets, I can offer some of my other treasured collections. Brother Li can also put forward another condition,” Chu Zhenxiong proposed.
Hearing this, Chu Dingqian felt a great relief and was refreshed. Li Feiyu was indeed sensible, not driving him to a dead end.
Seeing that Li Feiyu no longer insisted on the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, Chu Dingqian’s wrinkled old face beamed with joy, and he immediately said some pleasantries.
Han Li nodded slightly and, after a moment of contemplation, proposed a new condition.
“Then, Han Li would like to have some Pill Formulae, Array Diagrams as well as blueprints for Artifact Refining and Talisman Making,” Han Li said. “I need them from the tenth to the third grade, and if there are any second or top-grade Pill Formulae, that would be even better.”
Waiting for the Han Mansion to slowly gather these four major categories was too troublesome and far too slow. The Han Mansion was merely a deformed power within the God Refining Realm, making it incredibly difficult to collect Pill Formulae and Array Diagrams of the fifth grade or higher, and they simply couldn’t afford them.
The Daqian Empire had thrived for over three thousand years and must have amassed a large collection of Pill Formulae, Array Diagrams, and other such items. Taking them directly would instantly enhance the foundation of the Han Mansion.
“Alright!”
Chu Dingqian readily agreed and said generously, “I will copy and give Han Li a copy of all the Pill Formulae, Array Diagrams, as well as blueprints for Artifact Refining and Talisman Making that Da Qian possesses.”
This condition didn’t mean much to Chu Dingqian—it was a cost-free business deal. Although these were extremely valuable and priceless in the outside world, they paled in comparison to the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
A smile appeared on Han Li’s face. Although he didn’t get the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, these six conditions would still bring him and the Han Mansion countless benefits.
And in a few more years, after he had killed Chu Dingqian, everything from the Qian Dynasty would be his—he would be the secret mastermind behind Da Qian. For now, he would just take some advance benefit.
After uttering a few more polite words, Chu Dingqian then took out a stone that was neither gold nor jade, and placed it in mid-air, saying with a solemn expression:
“Since Han Li has no objections to our covenant, let’s swear an oath using this Oath Stone.”
The Oath Stone?
Han Li’s pupils shrank suddenly—he knew what this was. This object was extremely precious, creating significant constraints on those who swore upon it. To break an oath made on it would result in a tremendous price, so great that it made violating the oath not worth the consequences.
“Han Li must recognize this thing, right? If not, it’s no problem; I can explain it to you,” Chu Dingqian said, noting the surprised look on Li Feiyu’s face, a smile emerging on his own.
Li Feiyu had laid out six conditions, and aside from the fifth, the other five had taken a great toll on the Qian Dynasty. Naturally, Chu Dingqian had a way to keep Li Feiyu bound to the covenant.
Otherwise, if Li Feiyu were to take what he was given and run, not fulfill the covenant, not protect Da Qian for four hundred years, Chu Dingqian would undoubtedly be furious to the point of spitting blood.
Although Chu Dingqian didn’t know Li Feiyu’s true background, he didn’t care. As long as Li Feiyu swore on the Oath Stone, he would be bound to the covenant.
“Chu Dingqian is quite wealthy with treasures,” Han Li remarked.
Han Li had only read about the Oath Stone in ancient records; it was prevalent during the Ancient Era. From Saints in the Saintly Abyss Realm and Great Emperors in the Heaven Imperial Realm to Heavenly Immortal and True Immortals, down to those in the Gangyuan Realm, Pihai Realm, and even the Innate Realm—any cultivator who embarks on the cultivation path would use this object to bind others.
Its widespread use amongst beings as mighty as Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals showed just how powerful the Oath Stone’s effects were; not even they dared to break an oath made on it.
However, after the great calamity of the Ancient Era, Qianyuan Divine Province was in turmoil for a hundred thousand years, and the Oath Stone became a thing of the past. In the more recent eras spanning ten thousand years, it had become extremely rare.
Han Li had never seen one before and was surprised that Chu Zhenxiong possessed such a rare treasure.
Swearing on the Oath Stone had dire consequences if broken—clouding the Dao Heart and spawning inner demons were just minor effects. The oath-taker could suffer divine retribution, breaking their cultivation path, stripping away everything related to the martial path, such as the Martial True Intent, Martial True Pills, and so on.
Swearing on the Oath Stone was an oath to a great existence beyond comprehension in the vast unknown, a being far more powerful than any Heavenly Immortal or True Immortal. Han Li didn’t know what realm that might be, but he knew it was not to be offended.
Chu Dingqian laughed, swore on the Oath Stone first, and then gestured with his hand, “Please, Han Li.”
“Alright,” Han Li nodded. Swearing an oath was no big deal.
Soon, Han Li held the Oath Stone in his hand, and in the name of Li Feiyu, he repeated the covenant he and Chu Zhenxiong had established, asking the great existence to bear witness.
The covenant did not contain any clause about mutual slaughter—this was intentional on Chu Dingqian’s part. He still planned to seek out Li Feiyu for a reckoning after his rebirth by seizing another body, naturally not wanting to restrict himself.
This was exactly what Han Li wanted. Without this clause, he would be able to kill Chu Dingqian when the time came.
After all, Han Li had no intention of breaking the covenant. To protect Da Qian was to protect Han Mansion, and the benefits to Han Li far outweighed any disadvantage.

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 160 New Plan! Han Yonglin’s Enlightenment! Refining the Rebirth Pill! Fleecing the Great Emperor (Subscribe for this big chapter)_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 160 New Plan! Han Yonglin’s Enlightenment! Refining the Rebirth Pill! Fleecing the Great Emperor (Subscribe for this big chapter)_1
Translator: 549690339
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
After exchanging a few words with Chu Zhenxiong, Han Li returned to Han Mansion.
Seven days later, Han Li, in the guise of Li Feiyu, would openly stand on the side of the Da Qian Royalty, announcing his allegiance to the Qian Dynasty, who in turn would arrange an identity for his alias.
These seven days were also the time for Chu Dingqian to collect resources. Among Han Li’s six conditions, aside from the fifth, the rest required preparation, as dispensing so many resources and treasures all at once would strain the resources of the Qian Dynasty.
For Han Li, the fourth and fifth conditions were the most important as they would be very useful to him.
The fourth condition included a Heaven Rank High Grade Sword, which upon acquisition could replace the Zhenjun Sword, a Supreme Grade Earth Rank sword whose use of the Sealing Heaven Sword Codex only allowed for combat ability equal to the True Martial Realm’s Fifth Heaven.
A Lower Grade Heaven Rank Divine Sword would enhance his combat ability further, reaching the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm; whereas a Heaven Rank High Grade Sword would allow for even more improvement, and even if it did not reach the later stages of the True Martial Realm, it would not be far off.
A Heaven Rank High Grade Sword was normally a weapon of Divine Yuan Realm level, usually wielded by Emperor Wu, and a common Myriad Phenomena Realm practitioner could only activate a small part of its power, but Han Li could unleash its full potential.
The fourth condition was about boosting short-term combat ability, while the fifth condition was for long-term planning. The Da Qian Royalty, being one of the Eight Great Forces of Mysterious Region, had many high-quality and beautiful female cultivators under its banner, with a significant portion belonging to the Da Qian Royalty itself.
Currently, this was Han Li’s plan:
For his identity as Han Li, except for the destined female Demon King, he would not marry again for the time being. However, he could occasionally take concubines; otherwise, it would seem too out of character and inconsistent with his previous style.
As for his identity as Li Feiyu, he could openly take many wives and concubines, expanding his harem.
This identity’s cultivation was very high, being a powerful martial king of the True Martial Realm, enough to make many proud daughters of heaven willingly become his wives and concubines.
Da Qian being so vast, naturally, there were more than Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue as peerless beauties; they were just from the southern three provinces of Da Qian.
In the remaining fifteen provinces of Da Qian, there were many more high-quality female cultivators that did not pale in comparison to the three women, all of which were potential wives and concubines for Han Li.
Though now Da Qian had only six provinces left, many high-quality female cultivators from the Outer Twelve States had also relocated to the Mid Six Province, so overall, the decrease in high-quality female cultivators was only partial.
In this chaotic era, internal forces within Da Qian would think of clinging to Li Feiyu’s powerful support. Knowing Li Feiyu’s preferences, they would offer women actively, and a portion of those proud daughters would take the initiative to come forth due to various considerations.
Chu Zhenxiong might just let it be; the old man is nearly at death’s door, clinging to powerful support would be useless, in the end, they would have to rely on Li Feiyu.
For those part not coming forth on their own, Han Li could use means to intimidate or force marriages. Thus, The Li Manor could increase its population rapidly, and Han Li’s number of descendants and those with naturally high talents would quickly grow.
It might take less than two years for him to advance to the True Martial Realm and become a true martial king.
As for the negative impact of such actions?
Han Li did not consider this; he wasn’t a good person to begin with. His priority was to ensure his own interests, and after all, being one of his wives or concubines came with many benefits.
Of course, Han Li still hoped that these proud daughters would take the initiative, so he wouldn’t have to shoulder some unfavorable reputation.
Apart from high-quality female cultivators from families and sects within Da Qian, Han Li’s targets also included the Da Qian Royalty.
Having flourished for many generations, the Da Qian Royalty had numerous members, among whom countless beautiful female cultivators with excellent talents.
Han Li’s main targets were the princesses, county princesses, and female cultivators from other noble families—generally, these women were of beautiful appearance, with talents no less than Seventh Grade, mostly concentrated around the Fifth or Sixth Grade, rarely Fourth Grade, and probably none at Third Grade.
Han Li would only marry beautiful virgins from these ranks, and although he would play the role of a conqueror, he had high standards and would select only a few high-quality ones as concubines.
While this could lead to associations with Han Li, it wasn’t a big issue—the gap in cultivation and status between the two identities was too significant.
Moreover, it wasn’t only Han Li who coveted beauty in this world and enjoyed marrying and taking concubines; not to mention the Mysterious Region and Qianyuan Divine Province, even in the former Qian Dynasty, there were many such individuals.
Now, there’s just one more powerful ancestor with a penchant for taking concubines.
As for the other conditions, such as Supreme Grade Spirit Stones, Heaven Rank Cultivation Techniques and martial arts, Heaven Rank Magical Treasures, and Third Grade Spirit Pills, they weren’t of much use to Han Li himself; these were meant for his cherished wives, concubines, and the Han Mansion.
“Tianxiang, Jiang Jiang… Yueyao, Yiwu… I’m back.”
Han Li’s voice reached the ears of Lu Tianxiang, Qiu Yueyao, and other beloved wives and concubines, each reacting differently, some continuing to cultivate, some carrying on with their activities, and others flying towards the direction of Han Li…
The one who flew to the summit of Chengdao Peak was Senior Sister Gongsun Yue, which slightly surprised Han Li; the innocent senior sister had been avoiding him these past few days. Could it be that she had changed her mind?
“Yue’er, are you missing your husband?”
Han Li wrapped his arms around Gongsun Yue’s slender waist, gently blowing into her delicate ear, a flirtatious whisper passing between them.
“I… I did not.”
Gongsun Yue gave him a glare; why was her junior brother always thinking about such things? Continuous fighting over the past few days had exhausted her.
“Then why did Yue’er come so quickly? Look, Tianxiang, Jiang Jiang, none of them came to greet their husband.” Han Li said with a smile on his face, gently nibbling on her earlobe.

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - 160 New Plan! Han Yonglin’s Enlightenment! Refining the Rebirth Pill! Fleecing the Great Emperor (Subscribe for this big chapter)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 160 New Plan! Han Yonglin’s Enlightenment! Refining the Rebirth Pill! Fleecing the Great Emperor (Subscribe for this big chapter)_2
Translator: 549690339
Gongsun Yue immediately blushed, looking extremely attractive. Indeed, she found the intimacy rather addictive, but how could she ever admit to such things.
Han Li, the rascal, was so formidable that she worried she might be worn out again when the time came.
Bowing her head, Han Li captured her tender, delicate lips, and it was a long while before they parted. Han Li did not tease her further; instead, he asked seriously,
“Is Yue’er here to tell her husband some good news?”
Gongsun Yue quickly nodded, like a pecking chick. Indeed, she had come to tell her husband the good news.
Han Li looked at her stunning face, waiting for her to speak, even though he had already guessed.
Gongsun Yue pursed her lips, her face flushed with a shy red, and she softly said, “Husband, I think I am with child.”
“Is that so? Let your husband take a good look.” Han Li took the trouble to check with her, leaving Gongsun Yue deeply touched.
In truth, she knew that with Han Li’s strength, he could easily sense whether she was pregnant, but Gongsun Yue still wanted to tell him herself, and Han Li’s reaction satisfied her greatly.
“Yue’er, our child will surely achieve great things in the future.”
Once again encircling Gongsun Yue in his arms, Han Li’s hand gently caressed her smooth and flat abdomen as he spoke softly.
Gongsun Yue nodded vigorously.
A light filled her eyes, and she began to imagine the future, envisioning the accomplishments her child would one day achieve.
“Wait… can husband let Yue’er rest for a few more days, is that okay?”
Suddenly, Gongsun Yue noticed that the scene had shifted, and somehow, they had arrived in her bedroom. She exclaimed in shock.
“That’s unacceptable.” How could Han Li agree to that.
Enlightenment Peak.
Han Yonglin flew up, ready to study the Enlightenment Stone and comprehend the profound Dao within.
He was Lin Yiwu’s eldest son, now eleven years old, and much valued by Han Li. He possessed the best talent among Han Li’s descendants, apart from Han Yongzhen.
Han Li had provided him with an abundance of cultivation resources, teaching him the Heaven Rank cultivation technique, the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture. He occasionally received guidance from Han Li, and had already reached the mid-stage of the True Qi Realm. It could be said his cultivation progressed rapidly.
Next year, he would be able to break through to the Innate Realm, and in another two or three years, advance to the Pihai Realm, making breakthroughs one after another.
Ever since moving to Chengsheng Mountain, Han Yonglin often visited Enlightenment Peak to observe. He remembered his father mentioning the benefits of visiting this place, and his mother also frequently told him to go to Enlightenment Peak, so Han Yonglin did as he was told.
Each visit to Enlightenment Peak, Han Yonglin would always grasp something new, which even surprised Han Li. His son’s comprehension seemed to be even better than his talent.
Today, following his usual practice, Han Yonglin sat down on a familiar Jade Stone facing the Enlightenment Stone, closed his eyes and earnestly attempted to grasp its essence.
Not long after closing his eyes, Han Yonglin noticed that the world had quieted down around him. His siblings and juniors had disappeared, leaving him alone on Enlightenment Peak with a giant rock radiating divine light and filled with Daoist charm.
Han Yonglin was captivated by the light and charm, moving closer unconsciously, his eyes brimming with fascination. He contemplated the profound mysteries with a smile on his face.
This rock seemed like a Thousand Magic Stone, depicting the myriad arts of the world, all mysterious and unpredictable; it seemed like a Thousand Path Stone, the source of all paths in all worlds, where all paths were born and spread eternally.
Of course, this was neither a Thousand Magic Stone nor a Thousand Path Stone. It was simply that Han Li had imbued it with his own omnipotent martial true intent, which created this effect.
Also, Han Yonglin’s cultivation was too low; he was only at the True Qi Realm and had not even formally stepped onto the path of cultivation. The omnipotent martial true intent that Han Li had imparted was of the True Martial Realm level, which to him seemed profoundly mysterious.
In this Wudao World, only Han Yonglin existed. Suddenly, his pupils constricted and shock swept across his face; he saw his father Han Li for the first time.
His father’s figure stepped out from the Enlightenment Stone, approaching him, radiating divine brilliance, majestic and holy, speaking to him, transmitting his teachings.
Han Yonglin couldn’t help but follow his father’s motions, practicing a certain profound technique over and over. His father would also provide guidance, pointing out his errors.
And so, as days went by, Han Yonglin felt as though half a year had passed before he reluctantly came back to himself.
Opening his eyes, various sounds filled his ears. Han Yonglin exhaled deeply, his face filled with boundless joy.
He looked up at the sky and realized that only three hours had passed. He felt a bit hungry, even though he had eaten well before coming to Enlightenment Peak.
Han Yonglin guessed it might have been the effect of his enlightenment experience. He hastily took out some spiritual beast meat, swallowing it down to refine and restore his body to peak condition.
Afterward, Han Yonglin contemplated the results of his previous enlightenment. He remembered mastering a powerful technique.
“Such a powerful technique.”
After contemplating for a while, Han Yonglin couldn’t help but demonstrate the technique, and realized its execution was mysterious and its power formidable.
“This child’s comprehension is truly remarkable.”
Atop Chengdao Peak, Han Li had long since noticed Han Yonglin’s enlightenment. He called over Lin Yiwu, and they watched together.
Hearing her husband praise their child, pride swelled on Lin Yiwu’s face. She was proud of Han Yonglin.
“Yonglin has always been hardworking and visits Enlightenment Peak every few days,” Lin Yiwu said softly.
Watching Han Yonglin’s diligent cultivation, sometimes she felt like advising him not to push so hard; he was still young and the cultivation journey could be taken slowly, but Lin Yiwu never uttered these words.

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - 160 New Plan! Han Yonglin’s Enlightenment! Refining the Rebirth Pill! Fleecing the Great Emperor (Subscribe for this big chapter)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 160 New Plan! Han Yonglin’s Enlightenment! Refining the Rebirth Pill! Fleecing the Great Emperor (Subscribe for this big chapter)_3
Translator: 549690339
Living within the Han Family, as his child, Han Yonglin was destined to diligently cultivate. Although his starting point was higher than most descendants of Han Li, Lin Yiwu knew this counted for little.
After all, her husband was continuously taking on new wives, each one possessing profound cultivation levels and talents that surpassed her, and there would only be more wives in the future.
When the time came, the talents of those wives’ offspring would exceed that of her child Han Yonglin. If Han Yonglin did not cherish his current advantage, it would dwindle over time, the attention he received would gradually weaken, and the competition would only become fiercer.
For instance, the firstborn of Lu Tianxiang, Han Yongzhen, Lu Tianxiang’s second child she was currently pregnant with, the firstborns that Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue were expecting—all these children, once born and grown to the age of eight, would become Han Yonglin’s rivals.
As wives and concubines of Han Li, they wouldn’t compete and deliberately engage in favoritism battles against one another, but their descendants would need to compete—it was inevitable since the resources of the Han Mansion were not endless.
Those with good talents naturally had higher starting points, while those with lesser talents had to work harder and diligently to catch up, to show their value and receive attention.
Han Li nodded slightly and said, “I have seen all of this.”
Han Yonglin indeed worked very hard. Although among Han Li’s offspring his talent ranked within the top three, he still spent a great deal of time cultivating every day.
Leaning into Han Li’s embrace, Lin Yiwu’s body suddenly felt a bit feverish as she mustered the courage to say, “Husband, come to my place tonight.”
Han Li looked at her in surprise. He knew that Lin Yiwu was usually quite modest, similar to Jiang Baiye, and felt very ashamed regarding such matters, seldom initiating an invitation for Han Li to “battle.”
“Okay.”
Han Li naturally wouldn’t refuse Lin Yiwu’s request.
That night when Han Li arrived at Lin Yiwu’s chamber, he found Lin Yiyin there as well, the two sisters apparently chatting about something.
Leiyuan Manor, Mangyang Mountain.
In the depths of this mountain range lay a small ruin, where several factions were engaged in fierce combat, battling over a vein of Lower Grade Spirit Stones.
One of the factions was none other than the Zhou Family from Leiyuan Manor, with Han Yongchun also amongst them.
“Bang~”
Han Yongchun sent a Pihai Realm early stage cultivator flying with a palm strike and charged with a Spiritual Artifact longsword towards another cultivator in the middle stage of the Pihai Realm.
After a period of tempering, Han Yongchun had fully mastered his own strength, applying all of the martial techniques he had learned and comprehended at the Han Mansion in actual combat, deepening his mastery over them.
His cultivation had also progressed further, finally advancing to the second layer of the Pihai Realm, enabling him to unleash the combat ability of the Pihai Realm’s middle stage, ranking within the top three in combat ability in the Zhou Manor’s competing team.
After an intense battle, all parties ceased fighting and retreated to their respective positions to prepare for the next engagement.
Exhausted, Han Yongchun returned as well with several wounds on his body. He applied the Han Mansion’s healing liquid and consumed a healing pill, finally recovering from his injuries.
“Phew~”
Han Yongchun let out a heavy breath, finding himself growing fond of the sensation of battle. Although dangerous, it was greatly beneficial to him.
The leader of their team, Zhou Huaijun, approached and clapped Han Yongchun on the shoulder, laughing as he said, “Brother Han truly displayed divine might today.”
Zhou Huaijun had a good impression of Han Yongchun. Among the members of the team, only he knew Han Yongchun’s background. Han Yongchun had requested him not to disclose it when he joined.
The other forces competing for the Spirit Stone Mine were unaware of Han Yongchun’s origins. The battles were fierce and deadly, and Han Yongchun proved to be tenacious, enduring without complaints, fear, or retreat, impressing Zhou Huaijun.
“Don’t tease me, Big Brother Zhou. My abilities are still far behind yours,” Han Yongchun said with a wry smile.
Zhou Huaijun shook his head and replied, “You can’t say that. I’ve been cultivating for many times the years you have, yet my strength is not much higher than yours. I should be the one feeling ashamed.”
Zhou Huaijun’s eyes flashed with envy. He had been cultivating for two hundred and seven years and had only reached the eighth layer of the Pihai Realm.
Han Yongchun, only in his thirties, had already reached the second layer of the Pihai Realm, a truly frustrating comparison. Their talents were nearly the same, but Han Yongchun hailed from a God Refining Realm power, with his father being an ancestor of the Han Family.
Han Yongchun simply smiled without responding.
In Zhou Huaijun’s eyes, he was a genius, but in the Han Mansion, he was just average and didn’t garner much attention; there were many stronger than him.
“Brother Han, the contest for the Spirit Stone Mine will soon come to a close. Do you have any plans for afterwards?” Zhou Huaijun asked.
After this period of struggle, only three forces remained in the small ruin, with the Zhou Family holding a clear advantage—an achievement that Han Yongchun had contributed to.
Han Yongchun thought for a moment and answered, “Once this is over, I plan to take a look around other areas of Leiyuan Manor.”
His current cultivation was too low; he didn’t desire to visit other manors until he reached the later stages of the Pihai Realm. If he could advance to the Gangyuan Realm sooner, he intended to return to the Han Mansion.
Zhou Huaijun nodded, harboring a thought in his mind, but he left it unspoken.
After Zhou Huaijun left, Han Yongchun casually set up an Eighth Grade Formation, hiding within it to cultivate and avoid disturbances.
An hour later, a tremor woke Han Yongchun from his meditative state. He hurriedly emerged to investigate and found that the entire ruin was shaking, its cause unknown.
Zhou Huaijun rushed over, bringing Han Yongchun an important piece of news.
This small ruin concealed a hidden paradise; the outer Gang Yuan Sect ruins were merely a front. Someone had triggered a hidden mechanism or Formation, revealing a complex of palaces that lay concealed within, at the heart of the ruin.

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 160 New Plan! Han Yonglin’s Enlightenment! Refining the Rebirth Pill! Fleecing the Great Emperor (Subscribe for this big chapter)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 160 New Plan! Han Yonglin’s Enlightenment! Refining the Rebirth Pill! Fleecing the Great Emperor (Subscribe for this big chapter)_4
Translator: 549690339
The three factions had just finished scouting, and the formations protecting this palace complex were dissipating; they estimated that in about half an hour, they would be able to enter.
Clearly, there were fortunes to be found within the palace complex, and the three factions were eagerly rubbing their hands together, itching to go in and explore. If they managed to secure this opportunity, they could potentially soar to great heights.
Zhou Huaijun shared all the intelligence with Han Yongchun and then invited him to join in the exploration of the palace ruins in search of these fortunes together.
Everyone knew that opportunity and risk often coexisted, and more often than not, one had to overcome danger to seize an opportunity. This palace complex looked perilous, but Zhou Huaijun was not blinded by the prospect of fortunes.
The head of the Zhou Family had told him that Han Yongchun had some trump cards given by the Han Family ancestor. If Han Yongchun agreed to go together, their chances of making it out alive would be much greater.
After thinking it over, Han Yongchun agreed. He was aware of Zhou Huaijun’s intentions, but he truly wanted to explore. His purpose for leaving home and gaining experience was precisely to search for such opportunities.
Half an hour later, the Zhou Manor and the other two factions entered the central palace complex from different directions.
Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li received an important piece of news and, exhilarated, he promptly arrived at the main hall of Yundao Peak to meet with Han Yongjin, the one who reported the news.
Seeing his father appear, Han Yongjin’s face lit up with excitement. He immediately said respectfully, “Father, we have found the Rebirth Flowers, and in no small quantity, please have a look.”
Han Yongjin brought out a Space Ring, and, with a thought from Han Li, the Space Ring appeared in his hands. He sent his Spiritual Sense into it and confirmed that there were indeed Rebirth Flowers, enough to refine about one hundred and fifty furnaces’ worth of Rebirth Pills, although they didn’t have as many of the other necessary herbs.
“Yongjin, you’ve done very well with this task, and I am very satisfied. All rewards will be doubled,” Han Li casually put away the Space Ring, looking down at the child dressed in fine clothes, a slight smile on his face.
“Thank you, Father.”
Overjoyed, Han Yongjin immediately expressed his thanks.
As he left the main hall, Han Yongjin’s face was still beaming with happiness, and he clenched his fists tightly, finally having earned his father’s praise.
His mother was one of Han Li’s concubines, taken in Lingjun City. Although Han Yongjin’s aptitude was only Ninth Grade, he was very diligent in his cultivation and proficient at handling tasks. He actively took on the responsibility to find various medicinal herbs and carried out his duties with great dedication.
With the resources of the Han Mansion, he barely managed to cultivate to the Innate Realm, which was already quite satisfying for Han Yongjin. Normally, a cultivator of Ninth-grade aptitude would need to be at least eighty years old to reach the Innate Realm, but he was only in his thirties.
Now that he had completed the task set by his father, he would be rewarded with an abundance of cultivation resources—doubled, in fact—which included pills that aided cultivation in the Innate Realm, some of which could even boost him a minor realm with a single dose. There were also Pihai Pills that could help break through to the Pihai Realm.
With so many resources, it was enough for him to reach the Pihai Realm before the age of fifty, at which point he would have a three hundred year lifespan.
Han Yongjin had grand ambitions. Although his aptitude wasn’t great, he firmly believed that as long as he persisted, his father would see his worth, and effort would yield rewards.
He knew that the Han Mansion was still a fledgling power, not yet a century old. With his father overlooking it, even someone with poor aptitude like himself had a chance to show value and be cultivated.
Since the Han Mansion was not yet populous but was rich in resources, he had the opportunity to acquire many resources for cultivation, allowing him to reach even higher realms.
Watching the retreating figure of Han Yongjin, Han Li smiled. He believed that Han Yongjin was promising, and with further training and evaluation, if he made the cut, he would be rewarded with a Rebirth Pill that could catapult him to new heights.
“I hope you don’t disappoint me.”
As his words fell, Han Li’s figure disappeared from the main hall and reappeared in a field that had been prepared a long time ago.
Han Li activated a cultivation technique suitable for nurturing Spiritual Medicines, the “Spring Rain Transformation Scripture,” and went over the field once more. He then threw in several thousand Low-grade Spirit Stones before planting some Rebirth Flowers into it.
After observing for a quarter of an hour, Han Li keenly sensed that the Rebirth Flowers could be cultivated in this field and proceeded to plant a large number of them.
The Han Mansion had collected many auxiliary materials for refining Rebirth Pills, but the main ingredients, Marrow Cleansing Grass and Fifty Years Fairy Fruit, were only enough to refine sixty furnaces of pills, and the remaining Rebirth Flowers would suffice for roughly a hundred furnaces.
After completing these tasks, Han Li headed to the Pill Refining Pavilion to begin pill refinement.
Since recruiting a Seventh Grade Pill Refining Master some time ago, Han Li’s workload had diminished. He only needed to refine Fourth Grade Spirit Pills himself.
Although he was a Fifth Grade Pill Refining Master, the Han Mansion didn’t have any Fifth Grade pill formulas. It’s hard to cook a meal without rice. However, in just a few more days, the Han Mansion would possess a large number of pill formulas.
The Rebirth Pill was a Fourth Grade pill that could at most raise a cultivator’s aptitude to the Fifth Grade, but only required the skills of a Sixth Grade Pill Refining Master to produce. Since Han Li was already a Fifth Grade Pill Refining Master, he naturally could refine it.
This time, Han Li spent a full two hours refining, producing five furnaces of Rebirth Pills, totaling ten successfully refined pills.
“The instructions on the pill formula were actually true,” Han Li felt somewhat helpless.
He had thought that with his higher alchemy skills, he could produce more Rebirth Pills. Yet, it turned out to be just two pills per furnace.
Thinking about the effects of the Rebirth Pill, a smile reappeared on Han Li’s face.
The cost of the Rebirth Pill wasn’t high; refining a batch only required about two thousand Lower Grade Spirit Stones, with the main expenses going to Rebirth Flowers, Marrow Cleansing Grass, and Fairy Fruit.
A batch yielding two Rebirth Pills meant that the value of each pill was extremely high, and it could vary depending on the person. One Rebirth Pill for a Ninth-grade aptitude cultivator compared to a Sixth-grade aptitude cultivator was completely different in value.
If he were to sell them, Han Li felt that one Rebirth Pill should be priced at a minimum of five million Lower Grade Spirit Stones, which is fifty thousand Top Quality Spirit Stones.
Tianxuan Mountain couldn’t afford many even if they emptied their coffers, and a power like the Canghai Sect couldn’t buy too many either. He must carefully consider, only administering them to those Sixth-grade aptitude disciples worth cultivating.
As for those cultivators with lower aptitudes who couldn’t afford Rebirth Pills?
These pills were never meant for them in the first place; pills capable of enhancing aptitude were a great opportunity, not something easily obtained.
“Such exorbitant profits,” Han Li sighed. It was truly worthy of being from the hand of a Great Emperor.
A cost of two thousand Lower Grade Spirit Stones could sell for tens of millions, and the great powers would still clamor to buy them.
The Rebirth Pill was just a small opportunity that leaked from the hands of that Great Emperor who was suppressed beneath Leizhou. To a Great Emperor or forces of his level, such a pill formula was trivial.
But to Han Li, it was incredibly important. The Han Mansion greatly needed such opportunities to cultivate a large number of Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage.
“If it weren’t so dangerous, I’d really like to go shearing the Great Emperor’s ‘wool,’” Han Li sighed.
Before he had sufficient strength, Han Li didn’t want to appear before such an overwhelmingly powerful being. Who knew what kind of unforeseen danger it could bring?
Although the innumerable great opportunities controlled by the Great Emperor were indeed very tempting.
What Han Li didn’t know was that while he dared not shear the wool, someone else was already planning to do so.
That person was Lu Tianxiang.
Lately, she had been wondering how to cultivate her eldest son, Han Yongzhen. Although Han Yongzhen was still young and several years away from cultivating, Lu Tianxiang was already considering his future.
Although her husband Han Li would strongly support Han Yongzhen’s cultivation, Lu Tianxiang wanted to contribute as well. After much consideration, she realized she only had two things of value to offer.
One was the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture, but since this cultivation technique was incomplete and flawed, Lu Tianxiang didn’t want Han Yongzhen to practice it, as it might pose hidden dangers. Another reason was that it could lead to a struggle for faith.
The other was her knowledge of a sealed Great Emperor.
Lu Tianxiang herself didn’t dare to appear before that Great Emperor again, but her descendants could. If handled well, it might be possible for Han Yongzhen to obtain some opportunities from that Great Emperor.
This was a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm who had survived from ancient times. Even a little opportunity leaked from him would be an immense fortune for Han Yongzhen.
If Han Yongzhen succeeded, Lu Tianxiang even planned to send her second child to continue the effort—shearing time and time again.
The Great Emperor might want to come out, even if he knew it would be like throwing a meat bun to a dog. But he would still need to pay a price to entice them.
ps: This time it’s long enough, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 161: Distribution of the Rebirth Pill, Two Docile and Obedient Demonesses, Elder Han Falls in Love_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 161: Distribution of the Rebirth Pill, Two Docile and Obedient Demonesses, Elder Han Falls in Love_1
Translator: 549690339
Pill Refining Pavilion.
Han Li gathered all the Rebirth Pills and left the place.
He did not plan to refine all the Rebirth Pills today, as it would be too time-consuming. It took two hours to refine just five furnaces of Rebirth Pills; even without sleep, food, or drink, it would take a full day and night to finish refining sixty furnaces.
Han Li had already planned it out, he would just refine five furnaces of Rebirth Pills per day, and he could finish in twelve days—he wasn’t short on time.
The pressing matter was how to allocate these one hundred and twenty Rebirth Pills; this was only the first batch. Once the spiritual medicine required for the Rebirth Pills matured, the second batch could be refined.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li stood tall with his hands behind his back, clad in white robes as pure as snow and his coat hem fluttering in the cool breeze.
He had been here for quite a while, feeling a headache over the distribution of the Rebirth Pills.
“Husband, what troubles you so?”
Lu Tianxiang’s figure drifted over. Today, she wore a purple dress that highlighted her noble grace and pure elegance.
Han Li forced a smile and said, “I’ve gathered all the materials for the Rebirth Pills. I’ve just refined five furnaces, a total of ten pills. Once all the medicinal materials are processed, there should be a total of one hundred and twenty, I guess.”
“I’m having a headache over how to distribute them. Xiangxiang, you’ve come just in time; give me some advice.”
Rebirth Pills?
Lu Tianxiang’s phoenix eyebrows raised slightly, and an odd look appeared on her stunning face.
Originally, she had been deceived by the Great Emperor to capture Han Li but ended up being captured by him instead. Through a series of accidents, she became Han Li’s first wife.
“I remember a Rebirth Pill can improve a cultivator’s aptitude by one grade, and it can only raise it to Ninth Grade at most, right?” Lu Tianxiang asked in a quiet voice.
Han Li nodded.
“In that case, the Rebirth Pills are useless for me, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue, as well as the children we four have,” she said.
“Among those in Han Mansion who need Rebirth Pills, the main ones are those beautiful concubines of yours and their descendants, along with the Guest Elders and guards who are affiliated with us.”
“Outsiders can be put aside for now. In your circle of concubines, sisters Lin Yiyin and Lin Yiwu also don’t need them. Among the descendants, only the eldest son of little sister Yiwu, Han Yonglin, does not need a Rebirth Pill; the others all need them to improve their aptitudes. It really isn’t easy to allocate.”
“With not many Rebirth Pills and an ever-growing number of concubines and descendants, the allocation all comes down to what you think, Husband.”
“If you wish to focus on cultivating our descendants to create a backbone for Han Mansion, then prioritize giving Rebirth Pills to them; if you feel the sisters’ aptitudes are too low and their lifespans too short to accompany you for long, then you can prioritize giving them to your concubines,” Lu Tianxiang pondered before sharing her thoughts.
“Xiangxiang’s words make perfect sense.” Han Li thought so too but was somewhat conflicted over the specifics of the allocation.
There weren’t few in Han Mansion with aptitudes above Ninth Grade who did not need the Rebirth Pills. The guards and Guest Elders could also be disregarded for the time being. He’d wait until he ascended to the Divine Yuan Realm or Tongxuan Realm, when the Rebirth Pills have satisfied the needs of concubines and descendants before considering them.
He currently had seventy-two concubines, like Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao… Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhixuan, and so on. Among these concubines, only Lin Yiyin and Lin Yiwu did not need Rebirth Pills.
That still left seventy who did. The aptitudes of the concubines were concentrated between Sixth Grade and Seventh Grade, with only a few who had joined later and had not undergone significant qualitative improvement in their aptitude due to their recent initiation.
Han Li made a preliminary calculation: if he focused on allocating to the concubines, he would need approximately one hundred Rebirth Pills, leaving only twenty for cultivating descendants, which was clearly insufficient.
He had over eight hundred descendants, nearly three hundred of whom had potential. Among these, only Han Yongzhen and Han Yonglin did not need Rebirth Pills.
If he disregarded those with poor comprehension, no abilities, or who were simply waiting for death, there were about eighty left. These were the ones Han Li focused on cultivating or had included on his list of candidates.
These eighty descendants had aptitudes ranging from Ninth Grade to Sixth Grade. To raise them all to Fifth Grade would require about two hundred Rebirth Pills.
That is to say, Han Mansion’s current need was three hundred Rebirth Pills, but Han Li had only one hundred and twenty in hand. Thus, how to allocate them became a technical matter—if done poorly, it could discourage certain concubines and descendants.
With Han Li’s presence, they naturally would not voice any complaints, but surely they would harbor thoughts in their minds, which was what Han Li wanted to avoid.
Holding Lu Tianxiang gently in his arms, Han Li softly blew in her ear and lightly bit her earlobe before whispering, “Xiangxiang, if your husband is a bit greedy and wants both, what should we do?”
He wanted to cultivate a portion of his descendants as well as raise the aptitude of all his beautiful concubines to Fifth Grade.
Lu Tianxiang gave Han Li a look and after a moment’s thought, she said, “Why not do it according to seniority?”
“Oh? How so?” Han Li had an idea forming in his mind.
“Your concubines could be ordered by the time they married into Han Mansion, while those descendants worthy of cultivation could be ordered by their birthdates. When more Rebirth Pills are refined later on, continue allocating them using this method,” she said.
“However, Husband, it would be best if you split the Rebirth Pills in half to manage both ends,” Lu Tianxiang spoke deliberately.
Han Li’s eyes brightened. Embracing Lu Tianxiang’s pretty face, he kissed her passionately and said excitedly, “Let’s do as Xiangxiang suggests.”
He thought the method was good. Going by seniority could leave no room for objection, and splitting the Rebirth Pills evenly between concubines and descendants would silence any discontent—as each concubine also had descendants who were being prioritized for cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - 161: Distribution of the Rebirth Pill, Two Docile and Obedient Demonesses, Elder Han Falls in Love_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 161: Distribution of the Rebirth Pill, Two Docile and Obedient Demonesses, Elder Han Falls in Love_2
Translator: 549690339
“If my husband is pleased, so am I,” Lu Tianxiang said, with a smile on her face.
“This matter owes much to Xiangxiang. Your husband must properly reward you.”
As Han Li spoke, he embraced Lu Tianxiang and disappeared from the summit of Chengdao Peak, arriving at Lu Tianxiang’s sleeping quarters.
“Husband, no~ I am already with child. Let’s wait until later,” Lu Tianxiang attempted to refuse.
“Xiangxiang, I know what you’re saying. When you say no, you mean yes~”
With those words, Han Li undressed the Sect Hierarch’s Luo skirt.
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
In these three days, Han Li wasn’t in a hurry to distribute the Rebirth Pills, opting to wait until all were refined. He had spent most of his time doting on his tender wife and beautiful concubines, accompanying them by day and night, inseparable as if glued together, drenching in sweat, their days blissful as those of immortals.
Today, Han Li felt it was time to take concubines. It had been quite some time since he last did so, with the previous occasion being when Zhou Manor sent over triplet sisters.
If he didn’t take another concubine soon, Ancestor Han felt he would be letting down the title of “Ancestor of Taking Concubines.”
However, upon contemplation, Ancestor Han realized there were no suitable candidates for concubinage. To be his concubine, a woman needed exceptional beauty, and at the very least, a talent of the seventh rank, which excluded many beautiful female cultivators.
There were indeed some beautiful female cultivators in Yonchang Manor that met the criteria, some even with bonus points, but since they weren’t forthcoming, Ancestor Han found it inappropriate to force them.
Given his status, he couldn’t act without any restraint, otherwise he would run into trouble with cultivators intent on vanquishing demons and defending the way. Li Feiyu might have been more suitable for such actions.
In three or four days, it would be time for Chu Zhenxiong to fulfill his promise. Only when Li Feiyu’s identity was officially revealed could he use that identity to boldly take wives and concubines.
After some thought, Han Li’s eyes brightened with a new idea for taking concubines, not only meeting the standards but also bringing bonus points.
“It will be you two,” Ancestor Han murmured to himself with a smile on his face.
Those were two true demoness beauties. Ancestor Han had long wanted to taste the flavor of genuine demonesses, but he did not know if they had assumed human form.
When Han Mansion was relocating, they had passed by Xuanshi City, and it was then that Han Li had spotted the woman in the purple dress and the beauty in yellow. At that time, Han Li had spared them, not capturing them to become his concubines.
Now Han Li wanted to do just that, to taste something of the two little demoness beauties. In a couple of years, he could also sample the flavor of the Demon Queen, which would serve nicely to satisfy his craving.
Speaking of the Demon Queen reminded Han Li of the Dragon Lady. It had been several months since the Dragon Lady took the Dragon Ball from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, and Han Li had no idea where she had gone.
Han Li quite fancied the idea of becoming a Dragon Knight. That way, he might earn himself a new title: Dragon-Subduing Ancestor!
But since the Dragon Lady had disappeared a long time ago and was also extremely powerful, Han Li was temporarily unable to do anything about her.
“Dragon Lady, oh Dragon Lady, whether I can become a Dragon Knight depends on you,” Han Li murmured to himself, then vanished from Chengsheng Mountain. In the next instant, he was high above Xuanshi City, standing aloft in the firmament, surveying the mountaintops and lands below.
In a grand house within Xuanshi City, the woman in the purple dress and the beauty in yellow were leisurely enjoying their tea, though their expressions were more somber than before.
“Sister, things haven’t been peaceful in Da Qian lately. We must be more vigilant and cannot afford to be discovered by human cultivators,” the woman in the purple dress said softly.
The beauty in yellow frowned slightly and sighed, “Indeed, it’s been turbulent.”
“I recall when we first came to Da Qian, it was one of the Eight Great Forces of Mysterious Region, ranking fifth or sixth. Decades have passed, and the Qian Dynasty has come to this—a matter of both time and fate,”
The woman in the purple dress’s face was tinged with nostalgia as she said, “That’s true. Back then, the Qian Dynasty was truly glorious and imposing. Otherwise, our clan wouldn’t have sent us to infiltrate the Capital City. Such a pity.”
“Now, Da Qian is severely weakened. The True Martial Realm forces have lost two members, and only one aging True Martial Realm ancestor is left to barely hold things together. The territory has shrunk to a third of its original size, and a considerable number of forces within have defected to the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and other major powers.”
“Da Qian is still fraught with crisis, beset by internal strife and external threats. With only a few decades of life left, it is close to being struck off the list of top forces in the Xuan Domain.”
“As the saying goes, ‘When the tides of time flow, all are swept along; when fortune fades, even heroes are powerless.’ It is so for cultivators, and it is so for dynasties. Initially, Emperor Chu Dingqian of Da Qian was blessed with great fortune and established the Qian Dynasty from the remnants of the Da Jing Empire. Now, the last Emperor Qian, Chu Xuanhai, has lost his luck, and it may be time for the dynasty’s demise,” the beauty in yellow said calmly.
