“Chu Zhenxiong is trying his best to merely prolong the Qian Dynasty’s lifespan by another forty or fifty years at most. Perhaps the emergence of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm will mark the dynasty’s absolute end.”
“In the last twenty thousand years, the Eight Great Forces of Mysterious Region have constantly changed. Only the Ancient Empire has stood unyielding, having been established over sixteen thousand years ago. The other seven forces have all shifted several times; the Qian Dynasty is merely following the footsteps of previous powers.”
The woman in the purple dress nodded in agreement with her sister’s words, saying, “The Ancient Empire is indeed formidable. The records in Myriad Demon Mountain state that the Ancient Empire is bolstered by a Divine Yuan Realm martial emperor, allowing it to stand unyielding.”
Pausing, she suddenly asked:
“Shall we go to the Da Liang Empire?”
Seeing the beauty in yellow turning to her, the woman in the purple dress immediately said, “Currently, the Qian Dynasty only has between two to fifty years of life remaining. Then, Yuanzhou will descend into chaos, affecting us as well.”
“Moreover, Xuanshi Manor has brought in many God Refining Realm and Hollow Void Stage forces. Although it is still stable, there will be inevitable struggles as they vie for cultivation resources, and the Manor City will be affected by the turmoil.”

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - 161: Distribution of the Rebirth Pill, Two Docile and Obedient Demonesses, Elder Han Falls in Love_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 161: Distribution of the Rebirth Pill, Two Docile and Obedient Demonesses, Elder Han Falls in Love_3
Translator: 549690339
“Indeed, there have been many strange cultivators in the mansion city recently, some nearly broke into our estate. It’s time for a change of location,” the woman in the yellow dress pondered and agreed.
“Moving to the Da Liang Empire might be a good idea. Though not as powerful as the Ancient Empire, the Da Liang Empire has a history of over six thousand years and ranks among the top three forces in the Xuan Domain. There are no undercurrents to speak of, making it suitable for us to go into hiding.”
“It’s good that you agree, sister. Let’s pack up and depart tomorrow. I can’t stand to stay in this wretched place for another day.”
The woman in the purple dress sighed with relief; she was worried that the woman in the yellow dress wouldn’t want to move, and it wouldn’t be good for her to head to the Da Liang Empire alone without anyone to rely on.
“The Da Liang Empire is too far. Just come to my Chengsheng Mountain, and no one will disturb you there.”
A gentle voice arose in the backyard, shocking both the woman in the purple dress and the woman in the yellow dress. They immediately activated their cultivation techniques, and their spiritual sense swarmed out, repeatedly scanning the area, yet they detected no one in the backyard.
“Could it be from the outside?” the woman in the purple dress whispered, her expression turning grim—they had been exposed.
The woman in the yellow dress felt hot breath on her ear and said with a wry smile, “No, right beside us.”
The stranger’s cultivation was unfathomably deep, far surpassing their own—surely at least a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. He had shielded their perception so effectively that they could neither detect him with their spiritual sense nor see him with their naked eyes.
But the woman in the yellow dress knew the stranger was right by her side.
Han Li had been in the vicinity for a while now, quietly listening in, hoping to glean some information from their conversation. He didn’t expect these two demon women to actually consider fleeing—truly cunning.
Han Li silently breathed a sigh of relief, fortunate that he, on a whim, wanted to take on concubines and thought of these two demon women. Otherwise, if they fled to the Da Liang Empire, Han Li truly wouldn’t bother chasing them there to bring them back.
After teasing the two demon women for a while, Han Li finally lifted the concealment, and the woman in the purple and yellow dresses suddenly spotted a handsome young man in white sitting beside the table.
The two demon women exchanged glances, wanting to get up but found themselves unable to do so, as if they didn’t even have the courage to struggle.
To silently pass through their defensive array, to easily shield their five senses, and to remain undetected even by their spiritual sense, the handsome young man’s strength was terrifying indeed.
After a moment of silence, the woman in the yellow dress spoke first, “Do you want us to go to Chengsheng Mountain that you mentioned?”
Her brow furrowed; the name Chengsheng Mountain seemed vaguly familiar, as if she had heard it somewhere before, but the memory wasn’t clear, and she couldn’t recall it at the moment.
“That’s right, Chengsheng Mountain can satisfy your needs. You just need to pay a small price, and you will see that the rewards far outweigh what you give,” Han Li said with a faint smile on his face.
The woman in the yellow dress’s throat bobbed as she ventured, “And if we don’t wish to? Will you kill us?”
Han Li shook his head and said lightly, “I will capture you and take you back.”
The woman in the yellow dress instantly breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed the powerful individual bore them no great malice. Despite discovering their identities, he showed no intent to kill, which was somewhat different from the Human Cultivators they were familiar with.
There was a deep-seated blood feud between the Human Clan and the Demon Clan. After several clan wars, many Human Cultivators would outright attack any Demon Clan members they found, declaring a need to subdue demons and eliminate evil.
“Chengsheng Mountain? The Chengsheng Mountain you mentioned, is it in Yonchang Manor of Yuanzhou?” the woman in the purple dress suddenly asked.
Han Li looked at her in surprise, “Oh? You know of it? That makes things easier.”
The woman in the purple dress nodded, her face mixed with complex emotions, and sighed, “I think I might know your identity. You must be that old ancestor who was looking for concubines, right?”
She loved gossiping on regular days, often inquiring about various interesting events in Da Qian to entertain herself. The tale of the old ancestor from Han Mansion relocating to Yonchang Manor and seeking concubines was one such piece of gossip she enjoyed.
She remembered when the old ancestor from Han Mansion passed through Xuanshi Manor on the way to Yonchang Manor; at the time, she had even egged the woman in the yellow dress into causing trouble for him, not expecting to be approached by that very old ancestor now.
What exactly is the cultivation level of this person?
The woman in the purple dress screamed internally, finding the whole situation absurd. The cultivation level of the old ancestor was incredibly high; wasn’t it said that he was only at the early stage of the God Refining Realm?
Why, then, did she and the other woman—both at the later stage of the God Refining Realm—have no ability to resist in the presence of this man?
“Is it you?” the woman in the yellow dress’s pupils contracted sharply as she suddenly remembered. The woman in the purple dress often gossiped with her about such matters.
For example, the old ancestor who took in concubines at Yonchang Manor got married again, and not long after, he got married yet again, the old ancestor took in another concubine…
Han Li chuckled and nodded his head.
“You want us to be your concubines?” the woman in the purple dress asked cautiously.
“Exactly.”
“Can we be wives instead?”
“No.”
“Is there any room for negotiation?”
“No, there isn’t.”
“But we are real people from the God Refining Realm.”
“To me, it’s all the same.”
“We could be of great help to you.”
“Just the two of you salty fish demons?”
“Alright then.”
The woman in the purple dress’s face fell immediately. She too felt that she and the woman in the yellow dress were as useless as salty fish. They were greedy for comfort, didn’t want to endure the hardships of cultivation, didn’t want to risk their lives, and most certainly didn’t want to die.
They still had over a thousand years of life left. If they died, it would all be for nothing.
“Since you have decided, we can only obey,” the beauty in the yellow dress sighed.
It was of no use for them to disagree; the concubine-collecting ancestor wouldn’t let them off anyway, and would still capture them and take them back.
If that happened, they might not even become concubines. Turning into a pill furnace or a female servant for the old concubine collector would be truly miserable.
Just the thought made the two demonesses shudder. Being a concubine for Old Ancestor Han wasn’t too bad, at least Old Ancestor Han was elegant and handsome, with profound cultivation, gentle as jade, and reputed to be good to every wife and concubine…
The woman in the purple dress and the beauty in the yellow dress comforted themselves in their minds, came up with a bunch of good points about Han Li, and had actually convinced themselves, successfully brainwashing themselves.
Seeing how sensible the two demonesses were, Old Ancestor Han was very pleased and decided to work them harder later on to show his appreciation.
“Now, tell me your stories,” said Old Ancestor Han authoritatively, sitting back in his seat and pulling the two women onto his lap for a cuddle.
Initially, the woman in the purple dress and the beauty in the yellow dress felt a bit awkward, but they quickly relaxed, their self-brainwashing incredibly effective.
After a chat, Old Ancestor Han learned of their origins.
The woman in the purple dress was named Fang Yousi, a Flower Demon. The beauty in the yellow dress was named Bi Xinlei, a Fox Demon. According to them, they both still retained their virginity.
Old Ancestor Han was skeptical and decided he would have to thoroughly check them out later to see just how smooth they were.
Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei came from the Demon Domain. Supposedly they were on a mission, and now that they had failed, they escaped from the Capital City of Da Qian and found their way here.
Han Li wanted to ask the specifics of their mission and more details about the Demon Domain, but the two demonesses said they couldn’t answer, as there were restrictions in their minds that would kill them if they spoke out.
Given this situation, Old Ancestor Han didn’t press further, but did ask about other things Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei could answer, to which they responded one by one.
Old Ancestor Han was quite pleased with their compliance. He almost thought the two demonesses had willingly offered themselves as his concubines, so meek and docile they were.
Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei even started to serve him proactively, massaging, squeezing his shoulders, and pounding his back. Realizing they couldn’t resist, the two salty fish demons simply gave up and accepted their lot as concubines. After all, it still promised a good life.
After further exchange, Old Ancestor Han took Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei back to Chengdao Peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 162: The Elder Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine! The Dragon Abyss Sword! Within Da Qian, True Martial Prohibition!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 162: The Elder Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine! The Dragon Abyss Sword! Within Da Qian, True Martial Prohibition!_1
Translator: 549690339
At Chengdao Peak, the Viewing Platform.
Han Li, accompanied by Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei, appeared here. At this moment, his cherished wives and beautiful concubines were relaxing and enjoying the scenery. The picturesque view of Chengsheng Mountain was exquisitely beautiful and served well to soothe the fatigue of the soul.
Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei only felt a slight sway before they were transported to this place in the blink of an eye. Realizing they had reached Chengsheng Mountain, they were secretly astounded.
Just how high was Han Li’s cultivation level?
Wasn’t this speed too fast? Could a Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm truly possess such astonishing velocity?
The two demonesses did not have a firm grasp on the situation, but they also did not believe that Han Li was a martial king of the True Martial Realm.
The Demon Domain was so vast that even the Xuan Domain could not compare, and whether there were even thirty demon kings remained uncertain.
Every demon king in the Demon Domain had an enormous reputation, dominating the domain for thousands of years. The most recent one to reach the True Martial Realm and become a demon king was six hundred years ago.
Han Li was so young – he did not even possess a third of their age. How could he possibly be a martial king of the True Martial Realm?
The True Martial Realm in the Xuan Domain had only about a dozen individuals, and each one was famed and influential. Even they, hailing from the Demon Domain, were aware of them.
The two demonesses snapped out of their thoughts only to hear Han Li introducing them.
“Xiangxiang, Jiang Jiang… Mingmeng, Yi Dance… These two are the concubines I plan to take soon; get to know each other,” Han Li said to his cherished wives and beautiful concubines with a smile.
“The one in the purple dress is Fang Yousi, a late-stage Fox Demon of the God Refining Realm. The one in the yellow dress is Bi Xinlei, a late-stage Flower Demon of the God Refining Realm.”
As Han Li spoke, he also introduced his cherished wives and beautiful concubines to Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei.
“Demon Clan – and in the late stages of the God Refining Realm, no less.”
Qiu Yueyao, Zhang Yuyan, Zhou Zhiruo, and other concubines looked at the purple-dressed young woman and the yellow-dressed beauty, their faces showing shock.
Had their lord’s standard for taking concubines become so high? He had even brought into the harem a true person of the late God Refining Realm. Truly befitting of our lord.
Although they did not understand how two God Refining Realm demons had emerged in the Daqian Empire, they knew that from then on, they would be sisters. No matter how advanced Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei’s cultivation was, they were still younger sisters in their eyes.
Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei responded with smiles, getting to know Li Mingmeng, Chu Yutong, Lin Yiyin, and others. In their hearts, though, they wondered inwardly about the cultivation levels of Han Li’s concubines, which were quite low, with the highest being only at the Peak of Gangyuan Realm.
Han Li noted the expressions of the two demonesses and shook his head slightly before introducing Gongsun Yue, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Lu Tianxiang to them.
“Peak of Gangyuan Realm and she can be a wife? Does she possess outstanding aptitude?”
“Late stage of God Refining Realm, her strength seems a bit stronger than ours, not bad.”
“Another late stage of God Refining Realm, Han Li’s wives are indeed of high caliber, seemingly stronger than us too.”
“Myriad Phenomena Realm?! No way, no way, how could Han Li have a Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm for a wife, what a joke?”
Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei continued their inward barrage of complaints, their expressions gradually becoming more astonished, and they almost cried out in surprise.
Especially Fang Yousi, her expression currently shifting unpredictably, feeling as if she had been out of the loop all along.
Since Elder Han moved to Yonchang Manor’s Chengsheng Mountain, Fang Yousi always followed news of his marriage and concubinage. She would relate the gossip to Bi Xinlei each time.
But she never expected that the first wife Han Li had married since relocating was actually a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and she had heard nothing of this news.
Lu Tianxiang looked at the two women with a smile that was not quite a smile, making Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei involuntarily lower their heads. In front of Lu Tianxiang, their cultivation seemed insignificant; they decided they would be well-behaved concubines in Han Mansion from now on, biding their time and keeping a low profile.
“The two younger sisters are new here and still unfamiliar with the surroundings. We, as your elder sisters, should introduce you around,” Lu Tianxiang said, taking on the demeanor of the lady of the house.
Unconsciously, Lu Tianxiang had come to regard herself as the principal woman of Han Li’s harem, feeling this was only natural, as did the other cherished wives and beautiful concubines.
Lu Tianxiang was the first wife Han Li married after moving here, and in terms of both cultivation and age, she was the highest ranking, making her the most qualified.
Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei were thrilled yet apprehensive, worrying secretly. Could Han Mansion be like the harems described in novels and biographies, where the master’s multitude of wives and concubines engaged in cruel struggles for his favor?
The two demonesses feared Lu Tianxiang and Han Li’s other wives and concubines might put them in their place, but they had prepared themselves to take the loss. Enduring would be the key, but soon they realized they had been concerned over nothing.
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, and Han Li’s other cherished wives and beautiful concubines had no intention of making life difficult for them. They genuinely introduced them to the various scenic spots of Chengsheng Mountain, the many matters to consider in Han Mansion, and places they could visit for leisure and sightseeing during their free time.
Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei felt their tension ebb away; they quickly integrated, stepping into their roles as though they had already become Han Li’s concubines.
This impressed Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi. They could tell that the two demonesses had been brought by their lord, but they didn’t expect them to be so well-behaved and submissive, appearing to enjoy this life so much that they were soon lost in their joy, forgetting their own kind.
Elder Han, watching this scene unfold, felt gratified. It seemed that the principles he had been instilling in them over the years were very effective.
One day later, Elder Han took yet another concubine. This time, the concubines he took were Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei, the two demonesses.
News of Elder Han of the Han Family taking another concubine spread throughout Yonchang Manor and even reached the surrounding manors, causing countless cultivators to sigh and marvel.

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 162: The Elder Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine Again! The Dragon Abyss Sword! Within Da Qian, True Martial Prohibition!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 162: The Elder Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine Again! The Dragon Abyss Sword! Within Da Qian, True Martial Prohibition!_2
Translator: 549690339
In this world, perhaps the Han Family patriarch was the most unflappable, possessing a heart clear as ice and undisturbed even as the sky falls.
The Daqian Empire was in such chaos, with external forces eager to move and numerous factions within vying for resources and territory. Only the Han Family patriarch had the best mentality, not competing for anything.
They remember that the Han Family patriarch had only recently taken a wife and now he had already taken concubines, two at once no less.
“No wonder the Han Family patriarch possesses such cultivation, his mental state is incomparable to us cultivators.”
“The Han Family patriarch truly is a role model for our generation, deserving to be dubbed ‘the Ancestor of Taking Concubines.’”
“It seems as though the Han Family patriarch is uncompetitive, but in reality, he is also vying. We compete over tangible cultivation resources, while the Han Family patriarch competes for intangible resources.”
“Indeed, the path of cultivation requires wealth, companions, methods, and territory, with companions coming second. The Han Family patriarch keeps marrying and taking concubines, leaving us struggling even to find a dao companion.”
Cultivators from all over discussed the matter of the Han Family patriarch taking concubines as casual gossip during their leisure time.
This time, the situation in Yonchang Manor had stabilized somewhat, and representatives from various factions came to participate in the patriarch’s concubine-acceptance ceremony. Some cultivators also wanted to see just how beautiful the female cultivators being taken as concubines by the Han Family patriarch were.
Yonchang Manor’s various factions knew well that the patriarch had high standards. He would not even consider beautiful female cultivators of the eighth rank, yet this time he took two concubines at once.
To their disappointment, they only saw two brides covered with red veils, unable to discern anything specific. No one dared to probe with their spiritual sense, as that could be lethal.
There had been an ignorant individual who did just that and was slapped to death on the spot by the Han Family patriarch.
During the wedding feast, the powers of Yonchang Manor clinked cups and exchanged information about the current situation, using the opportunity to actively network and see if they could support each other and advance or retreat together.
Chief Zhou also approached Han Li, reporting that Han Yongchun had entered the Mangyang Mountain ruins and claiming that Zhou Huaijun, together with his kinsman, had entered the central palace complex. Zhou Huaijun would protect Han’s son, vowing not to let him come to harm before his own death and so on…
Han Li was already aware of this. News of new discoveries in the Mangyang Mountain ruins had spread long ago, and he was not overly concerned about Han Yongchun’s safety. He knew that Chief Zhou’s words were mere pleasantries.
Zhou Huaijun, only at the eighth layer of the Pihai Realm, couldn’t even protect himself, let alone Han Yongchun.
After the wedding feast concluded, the various powers dispersed, and the Han Family patriarch made his way to the lavishly decorated bridal chamber. Gazing upon the beauties who were national treasures, he slowly approached, lifted their red veils, and removed their red dresses.
When the patriarch was all settled and made his way to the Capital City, he was still savoring the memory of those two days and nights of pleasure. That was the taste of real demonesses.
The two demonesses indeed had not deceived him; their primordial yin remained intact.
“How brazen, demonesses! I saw through you at a glance, not even human. Reveal your true forms this instant!”
“Hmph! Petty tricks. You dare flaunt your meager skills in front of the patriarch? Witness my great mighty heavenly dragon!”
In his excitement, the patriarch blurted out several lines he had prepared for the Demon Queen.
“Truly worthy of being demonesses from the God Refining Realm, such magnificent vitality, still brimming with life and vigor.”
Once in the Capital City, reminiscing on the taste of the two demonesses, the patriarch couldn’t help muttering to himself.
If demonesses of the God Refining Realm were already so formidable, how fierce must that Demon Queen of the True Martial Realm be?
The patriarch felt that perhaps it would take hundreds of billions of elite soldiers to fill the gap, grinding away the Demon Queen’s fighting spirit.
As thoughts flitted through his mind, Han Li’s figure appeared in the ninth-floor private room of Drunken Immortal Pavilion; he still had not chosen to go to the Daqian Palace.
Although both sides had the intention to form an alliance, taking what they needed from it, Han Li did not want to risk it. After all, when swearing by the Oath Stone, he had not mentioned refraining from making moves against the other party.
Who knew if Chu Zhenxiong, that old fox, would do such a thing?
Under normal circumstances, Chu Zhenxiong would not, and he would not dare, but what if Chu Zhenxiong lost his mind? Han Li was not willing to risk his own safety.
Later on, after sipping some fine wine, Han Li sent a sound transmission to Chu Zhenxiong to notify him that it was time for their transaction.
Before long, Chu Dingqian’s figure appeared on the ninth floor of Drunken Immortal Pavilion.
Seeing Chu Zhenxiong arrive, Han Li asked with a smile, “How has Chu Daoist brother been lately?”
“Thanks to Daoist Brother Li’s blessings, all is well,” Chu Dingqian laughed heartily.
Since reaching an agreement with Li Feiyu and taking an oath by the Oath Stone, Chu Dingqian felt at ease.
These days as he oversaw the Daqian Empire, his mood had greatly improved. He had revealed some information in advance to Emperor Qian and the key officials of Daqian, settling their hearts.
Although Emperor Qian and the others did not know exactly how Zhenxiong could achieve this, if a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu truly came to Daqian in a few days, all would be well.
Hence, they became more diligent in their work, swiftly quelling the internal strife and stabilizing the various powers within Daqian.
The external powers also received this news through various channels, shocking the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, Fengbo Pavilion, and the Da Jing Dynasty. How could an empire in such a state still find generous aid? Weren’t they afraid of offending the four major forces?
Wouldn’t partitioning the Daqian Empire and adding glory to the four powers be good?
The decision-makers within the four major forces had different thoughts, but they were still observing. They suspected the news might be false, intended to stabilize the hearts of the people of Daqian.
The four major forces silently waited to see if a new True Martial Realm figure would indeed emerge in a few days to take charge of the Daqian Empire.
“Seeing Chu Daoist brother fairing well, I can rest assured,” Han Li said with a beaming smile, all the while pondering another matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 222 -
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 162: The Elder Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine! The Dragon Abyss Sword! Within Da Qian, True Martial Prohibition!_3
Translator: 549690339
His recently taken two beautiful consorts, Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei, had told him a piece of information of utmost importance concerning Chu Zhenxiong. Han Li was deeply shocked after hearing it and couldn’t discern its truth.
The two demonesses told him that they had accidentally heard a rumor in Myriad Demon Mountain: Da Qian’s founding ancestor, Chu Dingqian, was still alive, having lived a second life through reincarnation.
Han Li didn’t believe it. According to ancient histories, Da Qian’s founding ancestor Chu Dingqian only possessed the abilities of the True Martial Realm, so how could he have reincarnated?
It was well known that only when Cultivators reached the Tongxuan Realm and became great powers could they reincarnate, and even then, success wasn’t guaranteed.
How could Chu Dingqian, a True Martial Realm cultivator, have successfully reincarnated?
Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei didn’t know the answer either; they had merely come across this rumor by chance, and Han Li didn’t pursue it any further.
However, upon seeing Chu Zhenxiong, Han Li’s thoughts grew active, and he pondered over the rumor again.
If Da Qian’s founding ancestor Chu Dingqian was truly still alive, then he must have used some method unknown to him to reincarnate.
According to the rumor heard by the two women, Chu Dingqian was currently living his second life, and theoretically, he should have cultivated to the True Martial Realm by now.
In Da Qian, there were only two True Martial Realm powerhouses: one was Emperor Wu Chu Wuji, and the other was the ancestor Chu Zhenxiong. Exactly who was Chu Dingqian in his second life?
Han Li believed that if Chu Dingqian truly lived a second life, it was more likely to be Chu Zhenxiong than Chu Wuji, who died so swiftly.
With Chu Dingqian’s strategies and depth, it was unlikely he would take risks to fight for the Dragon Ball; more likely, he’d be seated at the helm, waiting for the outcome.
Is Chu Dingqian’s second life Chu Zhenxiong?
Han Li felt there was another possibility: that Chu Zhenxiong was not Chu Dingqian’s second life, and Chu Dingqian’s second life was another True Martial Realm powerhouse, currently hidden deep within the Daqian Palace.
Yet this possibility seemed slim; with just three thousand years of the nation’s history, it was unlikely that there would be three True Martial Realm existences at the same time, with one more possessing True Martial Realm combat ability.
Moreover, if Chu Dingqian’s second life were another True Martial Realm person, he could stabilize Da Qian’s situation just by coming forward now, with the world unaware of his true identity.
Chu Zhenxiong wouldn’t have been so anxious, and Han Li seriously considered the conditions he agreed to with gritted teeth.
Is it you, young Qianzi?
Han Li wanted to ask Chu Zhenxiong this question, but he restrained himself; it would be too risky, practically courting death.
If Chu Dingqian’s second life truly was Chu Zhenxiong, it would be a stunning revelation, a True Martial Realm existence capable of reincarnation – who would dare to believe it? It would unquestionably cause an uproar in the Xuan Domain and even the Qianyuan Divine Province.
The True Martial Realm Emperor Wus and even those in the Divine Yuan Realm would probably flock here, eager to seize Chu Dingqian’s extraordinary method of reincarnation.
Chu Zhenxiong would certainly not allow such news to spread; the best method would be to kill the witness, to eliminate Li Feiyu, who had guessed his identity.
“I thought I wore a disguise, but perhaps you have worn one too,” Han Li muttered to himself.
In Chu Zhenxiong’s eyes, Han Li was Li Feiyu, while in Han Li’s eyes, Chu Zhenxiong might be Chu Dingqian, although this had yet to be confirmed.
Then Han Li thought of something else: assuming Chu Zhenxiong was indeed Chu Dingqian’s second life, with Chu Zhenxiong’s end drawing near, was he considering going against fate and living a third life?
Han Li suppressed the shock in his heart and conversed with Chu Zhenxiong without revealing anything on the surface, while internally calculating the likelihood of his theory.
Based on previous conjecture, if Chu Dingqian truly lived a second life and became Chu Zhenxiong, it was possible that he might reincarnate again, preparing to live a third life.
When Chu Dingqian returned reborn, nobody would know that a certain True Martial Realm powerhouse was Chu Dingqian; in the eyes of the outside world, Chu Dingqian would be a brand-new True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
The more Han Li thought about it, the likelier it seemed. Chu Zhenxiong’s agreement to his outrageous conditions, requesting he defend Da Qian for four hundred years, was very likely due to this reason.
Previously Han Li had guessed that Chu Zhenxiong wanted to buy time for the talent of the Da Qian Royalty to grow and reach the True Martial Realm. Now, it seemed that Chu Zhenxiong was likely buying time for himself.
“Chu Zhenxiong is actually confident he can cultivate to the True Martial Realm within four hundred years!” Han Li was quite astonished. If all his previous speculations were true, Chu Zhenxiong was indeed formidable.
A Third Grade genius would need about six hundred years to cultivate to the True Martial Realm. Chu Zhenxiong had cut it down by two hundred years, and that was a conservative estimate; it might only be three hundred years.
Han Li didn’t believe that with Chu Dingqian’s cunning, he would just happen to leave a window of four hundred years.
Could it be because of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace?
A thought struck Han Li, and he suddenly remembered the Soul-Cultivating Furnace. The Body-Cultivating Furnace he possessed might be a secondary replica, capable of accelerating cultivation speed, and the Soul-Cultivating Furnace was of a much higher grade than his Body-Cultivating Furnace; it might significantly increase the speed of cultivation.
Chu Dingqian continued conversing with Li Feiyu, oblivious to the fact that Han Li was close to seeing through him.
“Cultivator Li, this is what you need. Please verify it.”
With that, Chu Dingqian handed over a Spatial Bracelet to Li Feiyu.
With a slight bend of his finger, the Spatial Bracelet flew into his hand. Han Li’s Spiritual Sense swept through it and found the space inside to be vast.
Laid within the Spatial Ring were numerous treasures, with one corner piled high with Spirit Stones, divided into two heaps.
The smaller pile contained a thousand Top-grade Spirit Stones, and the larger held nine hundred and fifty thousand Top Quality Spirit Stones, making Han Li’s eyes nearly pop out.
This was well over a hundred billion Lower Grade Spirit Stones. Han Li had never seen so many Spirit Stones before, making him feel like he had become instantly wealthy.

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 162: The Elder Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine! The Dragon Abyss Sword! Within Da Qian, True Martial Prohibition!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 162: The Elder Ancestor Has Taken Another Concubine! The Dragon Abyss Sword! Within Da Qian, True Martial Prohibition!_4
Translator: 549690339
With his mind focused, he continued to inspect the other treasures, finding one Heaven Rank High Grade, one Middle Grade, and one Lower Grade Cultivation Martial Skill, as well as fifteen Earth Level Cultivation Martial Skills.
There were ten bottles of Third Grade Spiritual Pills, fifty bottles of Fourth Grade Spiritual Pills, and two hundred bottles of Fifth Grade Spiritual Pills, each serving a different purpose, such as power enhancement, healing, detoxification, and more.
Among them was also a Heaven Rank High Grade Divine Sword, as well as eight Heaven Rank Middle and Lower Grade Magical Treasures, and twenty Earth Rank Supreme and Top Grade Magical Treasures.
Additionally, inside the Spatial Bracelet were various Pill Formulas, Array Diagrams, Artifact Refining, and Talisman Making Blueprints from the Da Qian, ranging from Tenth Grade to Third Grade, with the higher the grade, the fewer the number, and only two or three of each of the Four Arts of Cultivation at the Third Grade level.
“Hoo~”
Han Li let out a long sigh, feeling very satisfied at last having obtained them.
He immediately took out the Heaven Rank High Grade Divine Sword to examine it closely, becoming more and more pleased with it as he looked. After all, this was a weapon of the Divine Yuan Realm.
“Friend Li, this Divine Sword is named Dragon Abyss, said to be forged from the dragon bone of a Divine Yuan Realm Jiao dragon by a powerful being in ancient times, unrivaled in sharpness, and indestructible,” Chu Dingqian said with a sense of loss in his heart, but still introduced the sword to Li Feiyu through gritted teeth.
Throughout three thousand years, the Daqian Empire only gathered three weapons of the Divine Yuan Realm level; one is the Heaven Rank Supreme Grade Divine Furnace, the other is the Heaven Rank High Grade Dragon Abyss Sword, and the last is also a Heaven Rank High Grade.
If it were not for the fact that there were two Heaven Rank High Grade Magical Treasures, Chu Dingqian would not have been willing to part with them to Li Feiyu; they were extremely precious, and all the other treasures and Spirit Stones in the Spatial Bracelet were barely equivalent to the value of the Dragon Abyss Sword.
He had agreed to give up the Dragon Abyss Sword because he considered that Li Feiyu was a swordsman, a powerful practitioner of the Sword Dao, and that the sword would enhance Li Feiyu’s strength, allowing him to better protect the Daqian Empire.
“Dragon Abyss Sword, I ask you to endure for a while, I will take you back in four hundred years,” Chu Dingqian murmured in his heart.
About three hundred years after his rebirth through body possession, he should be able to cultivate to the True Martial Realm, and in another hundred years he should be able to reach his current level. By then, with the help of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, even if Li Feiyu had the Dragon Abyss Sword, he would not be able to escape death.
He had actually considered waiting until he reached the later stages of the True Martial Realm before killing Han Li, but he found it difficult to reach that stage—it was a shackle to him.
In his first and second lives, he only reached the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm, and originally, with Prince Wu’an as his third life, he should have been able to break these shackles and even advance to the Divine Yuan Realm, but regrettably, the host of the Devil Foetus, Prince Wu’an, had died.
“Good name,”
Han Li complimented. A large amount of True Yuan surged into the sword’s body, quickly refining it and leaving his own mark on it.
Chu Dingqian watched with envy as his Divine Sword, which used to be his, had now taken the form of Li Feiyu, causing him a strange feeling.
Han Li was eager to test his own strength to see if he could reach the late stage of the True Martial Realm by wielding the Dragon Abyss Sword to perform the Sealing Heaven Sword Manual; even if he couldn’t, he should at least meet the standard of half-step to the Seventh Layer of Heaven.
If he transformed into his true manly form, his combat ability would definitely reach the Seventh Layer of the True Martial Realm, although the duration would be too short.
Chu Dingqian hastily cut off these distracting thoughts, looking at Li Feiyu, he said, “Friend Li, now that you have what you came for, shouldn’t you make your appearance?”
As soon as Li Feiyu made his appearance, Chu Dingqian planned to observe for a few more days, and if everything went as he expected, he would begin his closed-door cultivation.
The third life’s Devil Fetus Host, Chu Dingqian, had already selected his candidate, now he was all set, simply awaiting the opportune moment.
“Of course.”
Han Li put away the Zhenjun Sword into the Spatial Bracelet, inserted the Dragon Abyss Sword into its scabbard, and said impassively.
Before long, Han Li appeared in the skies above the Capital City of the Da Qian as Li Feiyu, not far from him was Chu Dingqian.
“Friend Li, please,” said Chu Dingqian, making a gesture.
Han Li did not hesitate. With a single thought, the Dragon Abyss Sword was unsheathed half an inch, its cold light illuminating hundreds of millions of miles around, with him at the center, an immense sword intent and bright sword qi spreading in all directions.
At the same time, Han Li’s voice also followed the sword light to the surrounding millions of miles, “From now on, I, Li Feiyu, shall be seated in the Da Qian Capital City, protecting the Daqian Empire for four hundred years.”
“Starting from today, within four hundred years, the practice of True Martial Realm is banned within the territory of Daqian!”
Han Li’s voice, vast and stern, spread throughout the area covered by the sword light, like a thunderclap on a clear day, resounding between heaven and earth, and like a spring thunder, rekindling a light of hope in the hearts of countless beings of Daqian.
In an instant, the six provinces of the Daqian Empire’s territory, the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, Fengbo Pavilion, and part of the territory of the Da Jing Empire heard Han Li’s voice; countless cultivators suddenly woke up, their faces shocked as they looked towards the direction of the Da Qian Capital City.
“It’s actually him!”
“So your name is Li Feiyu. This seat will find you for revenge.”
“The fate of Daqian is truly good. At this time, they were able to invite such a powerful Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm to sit in town. I wonder what price Chu Zhenxiong paid.”
“Tsk tsk, does Li Feiyu want to forcibly extend the life of the Daqian Empire for four hundred years? But does he have the strength for it?”
“A ban on the practice of True Martial within Daqian? Haha~ Do you really think you are invincible in the True Martial Realm? When the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm emerges, it will be the time for Daqian’s downfall.”
At this moment, the spiritual senses of many from the Myriad Phenomena Realm and True Martial Realm spread toward the Da Qian Capital City, probing and seeing that upright and elegant middle-aged man in the sky.
These powerhouses came from various forces, each with different thoughts at this moment: some recognized Li Feiyu’s strength, others looked down on him, and still others were waiting to see how things would unfold…
No matter what they thought, none dared to provoke that Emperor Wu in the sky; that was something that could really result in death.
The Yinyang Sect’s Dugu Bing, of the fourth level of True Martial Realm, was severely injured by just a few strokes of Li Feiyu’s sword. Had Dugu Bing not fled quickly, he would have died in Leizhou by now.
“Dang~”
Han Li flicked the Dragon Abyss Sword gently with his finger, a resounding sword cry echoing forth, eliminating all the spying spiritual senses.
The great Emperor Wu, Li Feiyu, who had once severely injured Dugu Bing of the Yinyang Sect, resurfaced, with the ancient patriarch of Daqian, Chu Zhenxiong, inviting him to sit in town for the Daqian Empire, and Li Feiyu agreeing to protect the empire for four hundred years.
This news stirred up huge waves and quickly spread throughout the Xuan Domain, attracting the attention of many forces, which had not expected the seemingly dying Daqian Empire to rally so convincingly.
Whether or not it could truly last would depend on whether the powerhouses of the True Martial Realm from the Four Great Sacred Lands would continue to take action after the emergence of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
If those Emperor Wu’s of the True Martial Realm acted and Li Feiyu could withstand, Daqian could live for another four hundred years; if Li Feiyu could not withstand, not only would Daqian fall, but Li Feiyu would also very likely die.
“Chu friend, the mansion you prepared for Li is ready, isn’t it?”
Han Li did not care about those waves, he looked towards Chu Dingqian with a smile and asked.
In two years, his strength would probably be at the peak of the True Martial Realm, and as long as no one from the Divine Yuan Realm interfered, he feared no one.
The combat power of Emperor Wu from the Divine Yuan Realm was indeed strong, but there were constraints. On one hand, they had reputation to uphold and would not bully the less powerful; on the other hand, the influence of the Four Great Sacred Lands had set the rules, dictating that they should not intervene unless necessary, and at most, act only within the True Martial Realm.
The warriors of the Divine Yuan Realm already stood at the highest level of the Xuan Domain, with the Tongxuan Realm having very few individuals, all in secluded cultivation, hoping to take another step forward.
The combat ability of the Divine Yuan Realm was too strong, its destructive power terribly fearsome, an action causing deep impact, capable of significantly damaging the living environment of the Human Clan.
“Li friend, you are truly domineering.”
Chu Dingqian praised, then replied, “The mansion for Li friend has been ready for a long time, just waiting for you to move in.”

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 163: Die Yi, the Concubine, Sending Several Princesses to Li Feiyu_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 163: Die Yi, the Concubine, Sending Several Princesses to Li Feiyu_1
Translator: 549690339
“Then I really must thank you, Daoist Chu,” Han Li said with a slight bow, his manner polite.
Chu Dingqian informed Li Feiyu of the location of The Li Manor, then he disappeared; he needed to go back to the Imperial Palace’s forbidden area to enter seclusion and properly cultivate the Devil Fetus. What happened next would depend on Li Feiyu.
Han Li gazed deeply at the Imperial Palace, a mysterious light shimmering in the depths of his eyes. Was Chu Dingqian’s second life truly Chu Zhenxiong?
If it were all true, then Chu Dingqian’s hasty departure was to prepare for his reincarnation, wasn’t it?
Han Li really wanted to investigate and spy on Chu Zhenxiong’s secrets, but he restrained himself. He knew he shouldn’t harbor such curiosity.
Curiosity could kill not just the cat, but also a man.
No matter what Chu Zhenxiong had in mind, if there indeed were a third life looking to trouble him, then he could easily crush it when the time came.
Three to four hundred years would be more than enough for Han Li to elevate his cultivation to an exceedingly high level. Squeezing an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm to death would be as easy as pie, wouldn’t it?
Withdrawing his gaze, Han Li’s figure disappeared from the sky above, and in the next instant, he appeared over The Li Manor.
The Capital City of the Daqian Empire was split into southern and northern cities by an east-west avenue. The southern city was for commoners, while the northern city was the noble district. In the center of the northern city was the Imperial Palace, with the manors of nobility to the east.
The Li Manor was located in the northeast of the Capital City, occupying the best location in this district, centered within the district. It was originally Prince Wu’an’s residence, but now it had become Han Li’s.
This manor was extremely grand and imposing, exuding sheer magnificence. It spanned a vast area and was roughly divided into the front, middle, and rear routes. Within it were numerous palaces and pavilions, with resting hills and turning corners, multiple eaves and columns, painted ceilings, relief sculptures on the steps, red doors, and windows – all forming this splendid residence.
“This manor is really not small,” Han Li remarked, his tone one of surprise. On this matter, Chu Zhenxiong had truly put in a great deal of effort.
This Li Manor alone took up one-twentieth of the northeastern district. It’s worth noting that the Capital City was a massive city that housed over a hundred million people.
“It’s just a bit too deserted.” Han Li sighed softly. It seemed he needed to hasten using this identity to take a wife and concubines, otherwise living here would be too lonely.
In The Li Mansion were numerous servants, including all sorts of maids and guards. The maids were responsible for food, drink, and taking care of the master’s daily life, while the guards were responsible for the security of The Li Manor.
Although he knew Li Feiyu did not need them, Chu Zhenxiong had still arranged for a large number of cultivators with decent cultivation levels to act as guards. The guard leader was at the Initial Stage of the Hollow Void Realm, and there were quite a few cultivators in the God Refining and Gangyuan Realms a well.
Han Li planned to use them for the time being, as he, alone, would not be able to handle many tasks – for instance, organizing a grand wedding banquet would require many hands.
Upon entering The Li Mansion, Han Li’s Spiritual Sense fluctuated slightly, summoning the mansion’s butlers, managers, guard leaders, and so on to come for an audience.
He took a seat at the head of the main hall in The Li Mansion, and after waiting quietly for a while, the butler, managers, leaders, and others arrived, all submissive and respectful.
Seeing them hesitate in silence, Han Li spoke indifferently, “From now on, you may address me as ‘Old Ancestor’.”
“We pay our respects to the Old Ancestor!”
In the main hall, a large group of people bowed in unison, their tone extremely respectful, not daring to be the slightest bit careless.
Before coming here, they had been instructed that The Li Manor was prepared for an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, who would be arriving in a few days, and they would serve the master of The Li Manor from then onwards.
Previously, Han Li’s imposing figure had been deeply etched into their minds, and his command had been thunderous. They all knew that he was a true Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm.
The future of the Daqian Empire for the next four hundred years would rely on the protection of the master of The Li Manor. They could offend the Daqian ancestors, but they absolutely could not offend the master of The Li Manor.
If they could win the favor of the master of The Li Manor, receive wonderful cultivation techniques, be bestowed with resources, or even be taken on as disciples, it would truly be an ascension to the heavens.
Everyone knew that Chu Zhenxiong, the old ancestor of the Qian Dynasty, would not live much longer. The real support for the Qian Dynasty was the master of The Li Manor.
With a slight lift of his right hand, everyone instinctively straightened their bodies but still kept their heads lowered, listening to the words of the Old Ancestor of The Li Manor.
“Introduce yourselves,” Han Li commanded.
“Yes,” they responded.
Quickly, the group in the main hall introduced themselves one by one, but Han Li only remembered three.
The butler of The Li Manor was named Zhong Shan, at the pinnacle of the God Refining Realm, 368 years old, seeming honest and simple, a man who kept to himself; the leader of the guards was Feng Busui, at the Initial Stage of the Hollow Void Realm, 485 years old, a rugged man, but with careful attention to detail hidden under his rough exterior.
However, it was the Head Maid named Die Yi who caught Han Li’s attention, necessitating a few extra glances. She was at the initial stage of the God Refining Realm, with Fourth Grade aptitude, and was only 154 years old. There was hope for her to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm in the future.
Han Li was interested in her, not because of her cultivation, talent, or potential, but mainly because the woman was exceedingly beautiful, with bright eyes and white teeth, autumn water-like pupils, and a gentle disposition, still a virgin, which moved the heart of the Old Ancestor Han Li.
“Chu Zhenxiong really is considerate,” Han Li mused to himself.
When he set conditions for Chu Zhenxiong, the fifth was that due to his cultivation technique, he would occasionally take in some beautiful female cultivators. Chu Zhenxiong agreed readily.
Han Li had not yet taken action, but Chu Zhenxiong had already arranged for a beautiful female cultivator to be sent over. This was really considerate, and of course, it would be even better if she had Fourth Grade aptitude.
“Die Yi, stay behind,” Han Li commanded as he waved his hand. Zhong Shan, Feng Busui, and the others filed out, leaving only Die Yi in the room.
Being scrutinized by a powerful Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, she felt somewhat uneasy. Although she had been informed of some situations when she was arranged to join The Li Manor, Die Yi was still nervous.

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 163: Die Yi, the Concubine, Sending Several Princesses to Li Feiyu_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 163: Die Yi, the Concubine, Sending Several Princesses to Li Feiyu_2
Translator: 549690339
Han Li approached her and hooked her chin with one hand, instructing lightly, “Lift your head up.”
Die Yi couldn’t help but raise her head, her bright eyes looking towards the refined middle-aged man before her, growing even more nervous.
Suddenly, two divine lights shot out from Han Li’s eyes, entering hers and quickly reaching the sea of her consciousness.
After searching for a moment, the divine lights transformed into the Divine Sword, cutting towards the restrictions deep within Die Yi’s Divine Spirit with two “putt” sounds, and Han Li had erased the spiritual restriction.
“Just as I expected,” Han Li said, shaking his head slightly.
Chu Zhenxiong had arranged for Die Yi to enter, with the intention of monitoring him as well, wanting to grasp his movements at all times. But how could Han Li, the old ancestor, not know of these petty tricks?
Han Li had no intention of causing trouble for Chu Zhenxiong; it was normal for Chu Zhenxiong to be wary of him. Han Li didn’t care about others, but Die Yi he had to deal with.
Otherwise, if he took Die Yi as his concubine, and had to always guard against the person beside his pillow, that would be too exhausting.
Die Yi’s eyes were tightly closed, her forehead glistening with fine beads of sweat, extremely frightened. Would this Old Ancestor Li kill her?
She was naturally aware of the spiritual restriction within her, but Die Yi was powerless to resist; she had to obey, or else suffer a fate worse than death. Now that her identity was exposed, she feared she might also be facing death.
Die Yi had no thought of resisting. In the presence of a martial king from the True Martial Realm, she, who was only in the early stages of the God Refining Realm, was too weak. Even if she stood still and let herself be attacked, she could not break through the defense.
“Open your eyes,” Han Li said indifferently, his fingers on the delicate and smooth chin of Die Yi.
Die Yi slowly opened her eyes, carefully looking at the Li Manor lord close at hand, and heard his calm words:
“From now on, you will be a good Head of Maid at The Li Manor, and my concubine. Do you understand?”
Die Yi breathed a sigh of relief and promptly replied, “I understand.”
She didn’t mind being the concubine of The Li Manor lord. Freed from the spiritual restriction, she was also inclined towards the Manor Lord, intending to be honest and obedient.
The Da Qian Royalty had sent her into The Li Manor, originally intending for her to become the concubine, and she knew this, but had no choice.
Now, she no longer needed to work for Da Qian. All she had to do was to be the concubine of The Li Manor lord, and with him around, nobody from the Qian Dynasty could do anything to her.
For Die Yi, this outcome was the best possible scenario. Otherwise, if things were to come to light in the future, she feared that The Li Manor lord would slap her to death.
“I like your gentle and obedient nature,” Han Li said, a faint smile appearing on his face.
He received Chu Zhenxiong’s well-meaning gesture, and just erased the other intentions; there was no need to do anything to Die Yi, as long as she wasn’t foolish, she would know how to choose.
“My… husband, as long as you’re happy,” Die Yi promptly corrected herself.
Han Li embraced her, feeling the soft and tender body in his arms, and as he saw the slight panic and the deeply hidden tenderness in her eyes, he couldn’t help but lower his head and capture her soft and tender lips.
Die Yi’s pretty face instantly flushed a deep red, and her hands unconsciously wrapped around Han Li’s waist. The fragrance surrounding Han Li, together with her delicate and extremely beautiful face, left him somewhat entranced.
After a while, Han Li finally released her and said, “Get ready, accompany me to bed tonight.”
As his voice fell, Han Li’s figure disappeared in The Li Mansion, leaving only Die Yi standing there quietly.
She lightly bit the lip Han Li had just tasted, a hint of coy charm appearing on her face, extremely alluring, but there was no one to see it.
Thinking of Han Li’s recent words, a blush returned to Die Yi’s face, and she muttered to herself softly, “My lord~”
Sighing softly, she decided to dress up nicely, to serve Han Li well tonight. After all, her future life was now tied with The Li Manor lord.
When Die Yi’s spiritual restriction was erased, the grey-clothed old man in the palace’s forbidden area sensed it immediately, sighed, and closed his eyes again.
It was just one of his small tricks; if it could deceive Li Feiyu, great. If not, he wouldn’t be disappointed, as Li Feiyu was not so easily fooled.
Chu Dingqian was currently focusing on cultivating a new Devil Fetus. The Daqian Empire would be handed over to Li Feiyu. If even that didn’t work out, there was nothing he could do but plan an early escape.
“I hope you won’t disappoint me,” he murmured to himself, thinking about the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm that was due to appear in less than two years.
If Li Feiyu couldn’t withstand those martial kings from the True Martial Realm, he would have to leave the Daqian Empire and implement his final plan.
Of course, before doing so, he would need to launch a sneak attack to kill Li Feiyu and take back everything he had given him.
Elsewhere, in the Daqian Palace, Emperor Qian was discussing matters with a group of Da Qian officials.
After Li Feiyu had appeared, Emperor Qian urgently summoned the officials to discuss how to please this practitioner of the True Martial Realm.
Within fifty years, Chu Zhenxiong would still be alive, but afterward, the Daqian Empire would have to rely on Li Feiyu alone.
If they did not manage the relationship well, when the time came, they would suffer, and the Daqian Empire would be unable to counterbalance Li Feiyu.
“Chu Zhenxiong has revealed some information. This Li Feiyu seems to practice the Collection and Supplement Method, and he will take many wives and concubines from now on. We should start with this and see how we can stabilize him,” Emperor Qian said, glancing at the State Preceptor, the Grand Tutor, the Left Chancellor, and other officials in the great hall.
He initially wanted to say that this would please Li Feiyu, but remembering his position as Emperor Qian, he modified his words.
The dignitaries in Chao Tian Hall immediately looked surprised. If Li Feiyu practiced Collection and Supplement Method, he might belong to the demons’ path.

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - 163: Die Yi, the Concubine, Sending Several Princesses to Li Feiyu_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 163: Die Yi, the Concubine, Sending Several Princesses to Li Feiyu_3
Translator: 549690339
The true identity and exact origins of Li Feiyu were unknown to anyone, but they speculated that Li Feiyu was most likely a powerful Practitioner of the True Martial Realm from the Devil Region, or less likely from some other domain.
The Collection and Supplement Method was deeply hated by the righteous path, but there were still many Practitioners who secretly cultivated it and captured female Practitioners in secret to use as cauldrons.
If Li Feiyu was the latter, then he was a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu pretending to be virtuous. In other domains, it was not good to harvest widely, so he came to the Daqian Empire to do these things, changing his identity so that no one could track him down.
“Since he has this particular inclination, it’s going to be much easier to deal with. There are countless beautiful female Practitioners in Daqian. Sending three or five to him each year to be his wives or concubines should be enough to stabilize this practitioner of the True Martial Realm,” the Daqian National Teacher said indifferently.
The Mentor of Daqian nodded and said, “Indeed, the Old Ancestor of Zhenxiong has already negotiated the terms with him, and they have all been granted to Li Feiyu. Meeting this request of Li Feiyu should be an additional condition.”
“No, this is a part of the alliance,” Emperor Qian said with a bitter smile and a shake of his head.
The Old Ancestor of Zhenxiong had revealed the terms of the alliance to Emperor Qian, who fell silent after hearing them. He had paid a steep price, but it was indeed worth it, as it could extend the life of the Daqian Empire by four hundred years.
With a Practitioner of the True Martial Realm in place, the Daqian Empire still had hope.
Although the emperor was somewhat displeased with the fifth condition of the alliance, fearing that certain unfavorable situations might arise, Emperor Qian had no choice as the Old Ancestor of Zhenxiong had agreed to it.
The Prophet, Head Supervisor, the Left Prime Minister, and others fell silent upon hearing this. They had also thought of some of the worst-case scenarios, either having beautiful Practitioner wives or concubines, or their daughters being such Practitioners.
“The worst-case scenario shouldn’t occur. The Old Ancestor of Zhenxiong is still here, and the alliance should keep Li Feiyu from causing trouble,” the State Preceptor pondered aloud.
Everyone nodded in agreement with the State Preceptor’s words, but no one could guarantee what Li Feiyu might do after the Old Ancestor of Zhenxiong passed away. They could only wait and see.
“Your Majesty, I believe we can send a princess to Li Feiyu first, preferably to become his principal wife. This would show the importance the Daqian Empire places on the master of the Li Manor and also help to bridge the relationship between the two sides,” suggested the last pillar of the nation cautiously.
“Hmm?” Emperor Qian’s pupils contracted slightly, somewhat displeased.
Is this a joke? On the very first day, you want me to send my daughter to be a mere cauldron?
In a few days, will you set your sights on my consorts, and years later, will you even consider sending off my empress?
Emperor Qian wanted to suggest sending their own wives, daughters, or female disciples first, and only consider the royal family at last. However, seeing that the State Preceptor, the Mentor, and other senior officials all nodded in agreement, he ultimately refrained from saying it.
Emperor Qian sighed and remained silent.
“How about Your Majesty finds a palace maid to bestow the title of princess and then send her over?” the Left Prime Minister suggested after some thought.
Without a real princess, it would be impossible to convey the level of esteem, but it was clear that Emperor Qian was reluctant to casually send his own daughter, so the Left Prime Minister had to make a suggestion.
However, the Left Prime Minister also knew that it was unlikely to succeed and that the master of the Li Manor would easily detect such deception, potentially worsening their relationship.
“That’s not possible!”
The State Preceptor, Mentor, Prophet, and others spoke out in unison to prevent it, as doing so would undoubtedly offend the master of the Li Manor, and they would all suffer the consequences.
Yet, upon hearing this, Emperor Qian had a flash of inspiration. He needed to send a princess but did not want to send his own daughter, and he couldn’t choose someone fake or inferior. It seemed like there could be a viable option after all.
He actually had thousands of brothers and sisters, and among them, there were hundreds of beautiful sisters. Some were married off, but a significant number remained in the boudoir.
They were the daughters of the former emperor, Emperor Chu Wuji, and could be considered princesses, or rather, elder princesses. Emperor Qian thought this would suffice. After all, they were all princesses.
“What do you all think of sending a few Imperial Highnesses?”
Emperor Qian spoke of sending several sisters at once, they were not his daughters, but his own sisters. Between daughters and sisters, Emperor Qian chose to send the latter.
Of course, Emperor Qian thought he could start by sending those with whom he had a mediocre relationship, and if the master of The Li Manor needed more later on, he would consider sending those closer to him.
“It’s feasible.”
“Your Majesty’s plan is ingenious.”
“Your Majesty is wise and sagacious.”
The senior officials were momentarily stunned, then immediately began singing his praises.
With the former emperor deceased, his daughters were now without support; only those close to Emperor Qian still held power. Sending some would be no harm; it was all for the sake of Da Qian.
“Let it be so.”
“Draw up a list, select three or four princesses from it; we’ll have a grand wedding in a few days and marry them all into The Li Manor.”
Emperor Qian nodded. This was good for everyone.
These princesses, powerless and without influence, might be used by the master of The Li Manor for Collection and Supplement Method, or they might not. By then, they would have found a suitable husband for themselves and could look forward to a bright future.
Emperor Qian sighed inwardly and left Chao Tian Hall.
The State Preceptor, the Mentor of Daqian, the Left Chancellor, and others exchanged looks, leaving with heavy hearts.
They only hoped that Li Feiyu’s cultivation of the Collection and Supplement Method was of a higher order so that he wouldn’t need to collect from a large number of female cultivators. If he could endure the four hundred years, they might avoid paying a price. Otherwise, they too might have to contribute.
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li’s figure appeared at the summit, inhaling a breath of spiritual energy, feeling refreshed and clear-headed.
From today, his strength would enter the fast lane. It would suffice for The Li Manor to simply take in many wives and concubines to expand the lineage.
When compared to Han Mansion, The Li Manor had one significant advantage—that was, there was no need to be as inconspicuous as Han Mansion, nor was there worry about a shortage of cultivation resources. If there was a shortage, one could simply ask the Daqian Empire for more.
Han Mansion was in Yonchang Manor of Yuanzhou, while The Li Manor was in the Capital City of Yuanzhou. There was an entire province between them, a distance of about one and a half million miles, which meant nothing to Han Li.
His speed was now extremely fast, covering three hundred and ninety thousand miles in a single breath. He could travel back and forth in the time of four breaths, which was incredibly quick.
Once he advanced to the True Martial Realm, his speed would increase dramatically, and it might take only two breaths to travel between the two manors.
It was precisely because of this speed that Han Li dared to establish The Li Manor in the capital. With his strength, he could travel back and forth swiftly, making it virtually impossible for the outside world to discover that Li Feiyu was in fact Han Li.
Whether The Li Manor or Han Mansion faced difficulties, he could provide fast support and arrive quickly.
He planned to set up True Martial Realm formations for both Han Mansion and The Li Manor. Though he didn’t possess them himself, the Daqian Empire did, and he could procure a few Third-Grade formations to enhance the security of both manors.
Though Han Mansion and The Li Manor would both have many wives and concubines in the future, Han Li would not be overwhelmed. He could be with other wives and concubines in the other manor in a very short span of time.
In the future, when his strength increased, Han Li planned on merging the two manors, though he could also choose not to. He would decide based on the circumstances then.

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - 164: The Ancestor Took Another Concubine Again!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 164: The Ancestor Took Another Concubine Again!_1
Translator: 549690339
“Huff~”
Watching the sunset dyeing the sky, Han Li let out a long sigh and vanished from sight.
In Chengdao Peak, there was a hot spring that remained at a comfortable temperature throughout all four seasons and exuded a faint fragrant scent, hence it was named Xianghai Hot Spring. Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue were soaking in it.
The four ladies were idly chatting, wondering when their husband Han Li would return from the Capital City of the Da Qian to Chengsheng Mountain. Only the four wives knew that Li Feiyu was in fact Han Li, and they were also aware of Han Li’s plans, though they said nothing of it.
“That scoundrel is likely taking concubines in The Li Manor. He’s probably so pleased with himself that he’ll forget all about us and take a long time to return,” Lu Tianxiang said with a sigh.
“Didn’t junior brother say he’d be back soon?” Gongsun Yue asked innocently.
Heh~” Jiang Baiye let out a cold laugh, shook her head dismissively, and said, “You’re too naive.”
Gongsun Yue tilted her head, looking towards Yun Miaoyi, and asked, “Yun Yun, do you think so too?”
Yun Miaoyi shook her head then nodded, smiling as she said, “Being innocent and pure is a good thing. Actually, I agree with you. Our husband might have even come back by now and is watching us from the mountain peak.”
“Tsk tsk, using ‘husband’ so affectionately. When did you, little devil witch, become so clingy?” Jiang Baiye teased.
“As if you haven’t called him ‘husband’ just the same.”
Yun Miaoyi stretched out her delicate, fair fingers, pinched Jiang Baiye’s tender fair skin, and then drew her into an embrace, playfully teasing her.
“Husband~”
Just then, Han Li’s figure appeared at the Xianghai Hot Spring, sitting between Lu Tianxiang and Gongsun Yue. Gongsun Yue was thrilled to find Han Li had returned and sweetly called out.
Han Li swept Gongsun Yue into his arms, lowered his head, and rubbed his cheek against her delicate face, gingerly moving aside the purple hair by her ear, and then he whispered softly by her slightly flushed ear:
“Yue’er is so good.”
A wide smile immediately spread across Gongsun Yue’s pretty face, her bright eyes filled with tender affection for Han Li. She could see the genuine concern in Han Li’s heart.
She liked this side of Han Li.
After being affectionate with Gongsun Yue for a while, Han Li turned to look at the other three. Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi stopped their playful banter, joining Lu Tianxiang as they called out:
“Husband~”
“Xiang Xiang, Jiang Jiang, you two were just badmouthing me, I heard it,” Han Li said with a smile.
“Hmph~” Lu Tianxiang snorted softly, “So what if you heard? Isn’t what I said the truth?”
“Sister Xiang is right,” Jiang Baiye chimed in, quickly moving next to Lu Tianxiang.
Looking at Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang in the hot spring, Han Li felt a warmth in his heart. He moved closer, but he didn’t do anything too over-the-top.
Eventually, Han Li shared the events that had transpired in the Capital City of Da Qian as well as his plans with the four ladies, and their faces immediately lit up with joy.
Their husband had actually garnered so many benefits from Da Qian: Heaven Rank cultivation techniques, martial techniques, magical treasures, top-grade spirit stones, third-grade spirit pills…
Seeing the Spatial Bracelet that Han Li produced, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue used their spiritual sense to inspect its contents, leaving them stunned.
Although they were not without their own impressive experiences, they couldn’t help but be overwhelmed by the assets equivalent to a quarter of a top-tier power’s foundation, their hearts thumping wildly as they cried out in astonishment.
“Heaven Rank artifacts, cultivation techniques and martial skills, spirit pills and spirit stones, and so on; you can choose whatever you like. I will send some to Yaoyue and Mingmeng later as well. The remaining items we’ll store in the treasure vault to develop Han Mansion,” Han Li said.
Lu Tianxiang and Yun Miaoyi didn’t hesitate to choose, while Jiang Baiye and Gongsun Yue briefly hesitated before also agreeing.
Afterward, Han Li left the Xianghai Hot Springs and gathered all his beauties, informing them of several pieces of good news and shared with them some arrangements.
However, Han Li did not disclose the matter about the Spatial Bracelet. Beauties like Liu Yuexin and Lin Yiwu were unaware of his true power, not knowing his other identity was Li Feiyu. For the time being, Han Li didn’t plan to enlighten them.
Having done this, Han Li allowed the beauties who wanted to cultivate to leave and then played multiplayer games with the others.
Leaving Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li felt refreshed, and it didn’t take long for him to return to Li Mansion.
The Manor Lord Han clearly remembered that there was a beauty in Li Mansion waiting for his favor.
Within the bedchamber, Han Li’s figure appeared, and he found someone bathing behind the gauze curtain, the air filled with a fragrant, subtle scent.
From his position, Han Li could see Die Yi behind the gauze, occasionally lifting her delicate arms in the bath, offering limitless temptation.
Licking his lips, Han Li noticed Die Yi was indeed very considerate, bathing in fragrance, waiting for his arrival.
“Die Yi, I’m back,” he said.
With those words, he walked in, and behind the curtain, the water splashed sporadically, accompanied by some peculiar sounds.
The next day, Han Li instructed the butler, Zhong Shan, to make preparations for a concubine-acceptance wedding banquet to be held in three days.
Zhong Shan naturally agreed without hesitation, vowing to ensure the Manor Lord would be satisfied, and started bustling about that very day, spreading the news.
In the following days, Han Li spent half of each day at Li Mansion, keeping company with Die Yi, diligently tilling the fertile soil, and spent the rest of his time in Han Mansion, enjoying life.
Sometimes he’d seek out Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue; other times, he would be with the enchantresses Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei, and sometimes he played with both the Zhou and Chu triplets…
During this time, Han Li also received another piece of news: Emperor Qian intended to send four princesses to become his concubines, and Han Li gladly agreed.
Three days flew by, and a grand wedding banquet was held in the Capital City of the Daqian Empire. Various factions from the Capital City, as well as nobles and even Emperor Qian himself, attended, along with representatives from Yuanzhou and forces from the Hollow Void Stage and Myriad Phenomena Realm of the entire Daqian Empire.
It was an event of tremendous scale, and those unaware might have thought a major event was taking place.
Those in the know understood that this was Li Feiyu’s, the Manor Lord of the Li Mansion, first time taking concubines. He was the True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, the stabilizing presence for Daqian in the next four centuries, the cornerstone of the entire Qian Dynasty.
Therefore, powers from all sides and various mighty individuals showed great face, eagerly participating in this grand concubine-acceptance ceremony.
The protagonists of this ceremony were six individuals: the male lead was the Manor Lord Han, and the female leads were the four princesses and Die Yi, the Head of Maids at Li Mansion.
Many cultivators in attendance secretly marveled at how the Qian Dynasty, in order to strengthen relations with the Manor Lord Han, had no qualms about pride, sending forth four princesses directly.
While these princesses were not daughters of Emperor Qian, they were his sisters and daughters of the previous emperor, each one exceptionally beautiful and with excellent talent.
Han Li had viewed the information of the four princesses in advance; they all possessed Third Grade talent, with similar cultivation levels, still in the Gangyuan Realm, and were later descendants of Emperor Chu Wuji. They were quite young and had only ordinary relations with Emperor Qian.
It must be said that the Da Qian Royalty had excellent genes, as all four princesses were extremely beautiful, each with a near-ninety rating. Although they were not quadruplets, they bore a semblance of resemblance to one another.
The character and temperament of the four princesses varied: one was innocent and lovable, another cold and majestic, the third mature and charming, and the fourth naive and cute, all of which greatly pleased Han Li.
After the grand wedding banquet concluded, Han Li entered the first bridal chamber, savoring the presence of the innocent and lovable princess. After tilling the fields for half an hour, he proceeded to the other matrimonial rooms, tasting each in turn, with Die Yi being the last.

Encountered a bit of a writing block and not feeling well, very tired. Will write more tomorrow, definitely an update by noon.
It’s been almost half a month since the book was launched, with a total update of 225,500 words. Time to adjust the pace a bit.
Also, a quick heads up, there will be a big update on the 18th, at least twenty thousand words.

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - 165: Taking a Concubine for the 9th Time, Jiang Jiang Has a Baby!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 165: Taking a Concubine for the 9th Time, Jiang Jiang Has a Baby!_1
Translator: 549690339
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, three months had passed.
At the top of Chong Xiao Pavilion, Han Li stood tall, overlooking the entire Capital City of the Daqian Empire.
Chong Xiao Pavilion, located in the western part of The Li Manor, was an extremely tall building and the tallest in the Daqian Empire’s Capital City, even slightly higher than the Imperial Palace.
Wherever one was in the Capital City of Daqian, just by looking up, they could see the tower rising into the sky, symbolizing the owner of The Li Manor.
Since his alliance with Chu Zhenxiong over three months ago, the various forces within the Da Qian had stabilized completely. No longer panic-stricken, they believed that two mid-True Martial Realm martial kings were enough to protect the Daqian Empire.
After all, the Daqian Empire only had territories spanning six provinces. Was it worth it to fight desperately against two mid-True Martial Realm kings for the sake of protecting these lands?
The external forces of the Daqian Empire, such as the Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, Fengbo Pavilion and Da Jing Dynasty, had all ceased their activities. Even minor border skirmishes came to a halt, as no one wished to provoke the Daqian Empire.
The four major powers were also waiting; they bided their time for the several True Martial Realm warriors who were trapped in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm to escape before discussing whether to continue targeting the Daqian Empire.
At present, the top combat abilities of the four major powers were relatively depleted. The Da Jing Dynasty, without any significant backing, had only one old ancestor in the True Martial Realm, while the better-connected Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, and Fengbo Pavilion fared even worse.
With Divine Yuan Realm Power and two Great Saints behind them, they kept each other in check and followed the rules, not daring to send more powerful fighters to the branches in the Xuan Domain easily.
As a result, Fengbo Pavilion currently had no True Martial Realm forces stationed. The Yinyang Sect and Kurong Sect each had one True Martial Realm martial king left, and Dugu Bing of the Yinyang Sect had suffered heavy injuries not long ago and dropped to the early stages of the True Martial Realm.
In actuality, the four major powers collectively had only three True Martial Realm warriors left – one at mid-stage and two at early-stage – so naturally, they did not dare act rashly and were also worried about the Daqian Empire acting arbitrarily.
Fortunately, the old ancestor of Daqian, Chu Zhenxiong, was close to death and focused on preserving the Da Qian Empire, while the newly arrived Li Feiyu did not concern himself with these matters, taking concubines frequently within the Capital City. It seemed as long as these True Martial Realm warriors did not set foot in the Daqian Empire, Li Feiyu would not intervene.
“Huff~”
Han Li exhaled, licking the corner of his mouth; he had been diligently plowing the fields lately, traveling between two manors every day, engaging in battles with one delicate wife after another.
Han Li couldn’t be bothered with the external forces of the Da Qian; as long as they didn’t bring True Martial Realm forces, that was fine. He adhered to the principle, “Within the Daqian territory, True Martial Realm is prohibited.” Should a True Martial Realm martial artist enter, he would take action.
As for those at the Myriad Phenomena Realm, Hollow Void Stage, and others, Han Li wouldn’t interfere. The Daqian Empire could deal with them on its own; Han Li didn’t have that much spare time.
In the past three months, Han Mansion remained unassuming. Since he last took Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei, Han Li had temporarily ceased taking in any more concubines.
Part of the reason was that Jiang Baiye was about to give birth. Han Li did not want to take in any concubines at this time and decided to wait until after Jiang Baiye’s child was born.
On the other hand, The Li Manor had seen Han Li take many more concubines, causing tremors of fear throughout the upper and lower ranks of the Da Qian.
