Three months earlier, Han Li, under the guise of Li Feiyu, took five concubines in one go, four of whom were princesses. They were all now pregnant, about two to three months along.
Over these three months, Han Li gradually took nine more concubine-taking ceremonies, averaging three per month, with varying numbers each time – starting with one and reaching as high as four at most.
Of these nine concubine-taking ceremonies, two still involved marrying princesses – all daughters of the late Emperor Chu Wuji, the younger ones; the older ones were generally already wedded.
Four of the instances involved taking concubines from various powers within the Capital City, who sought to please the Lord of The Li Manor. Finding they all met his standards, Han Li took them all in.
The remaining three times were from other forces outside the Capital City, with the simple aim of clinging to the coattails of a True Martial Realm powerhouse.
These powers were very considerate, not attempting to deceive the old Han ancestor; the beautiful female cultivators they offered were all of decent quality, mostly with fifth and sixth-grade aptitudes.
Since then, the number of concubines in The Li Manor had grown rapidly, reaching twenty-four, and in terms of quality, they were somewhat superior to those in the Han Mansion, mainly in cultivation and aptitude; in looks and temperament, they were not much different.
The old Han ancestor often marveled that the Capital City of Da Qian was indeed exceptional; it boasted female cultivators of far greater quality than those in Leizhou or Yuanzhou.
Hence, the old Han ancestor silently raised the standards for taking in concubines as Li Feiyu: starting with sixth-grade aptitude, a minimum of eighty-five points in looks, and even then, there were many beautiful female cultivators available.
No wonder they say that a nation’s capital concentrates the essence of the entire country.
Han Li murmured to himself and withdrew his gaze, looking towards The Li Manor. Despite its vastness, it was far from desolate. Numerous maids bustled about, and squads of guards patrolled back and forth, stationed at key locations.
The Li Manor was divided into front, middle, and rear sections. According to Han Li’s planning, the front housed the maids and guards, on each side respectively; the middle was dense with palaces, used mainly for discussions, hosting banquets, etc., and in the future, it would also be where his descendants lived, on both sides of the middle section;
The rear was where Han Li and his delicate wives and beautiful concubines resided, a vast area with good layout and unique scenery, accessible only to the personal maids of his wives and concubines.
During this period, he had acquired two sets of True Martial Realm formations from the hands of the Da Qian Empire, one set at Han Mansion and another at The Li Manor, greatly enhancing the security of both manors.
Powered by Top Quality Spirit Stones as the consumable energy for formations of third grade and above, they could withstand an assault from a True Martial Realm martial king for more than twenty breaths – such a long time was enough for Han Li to rush over and assist.
Although Han Mansion was quietly developing, its foundations had recently exploded exponentially. Most of the treasures obtained from Chu Zhenxiong were left in Han Mansion; only one-fifth of the spirit stones, Spirit Pills, and the like were taken to The Li Manor.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - 165: Taking a Concubine for the 9th Time, Jiang Jiang Has a Baby!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 165: Taking a Concubine for the 9th Time, Jiang Jiang Has a Baby!_2
Translator: 549690339
Besides, Li Manor also had all Heaven Rank cultivation techniques, martial arts, as well as a complete set of the Four Arts of Cultivation, ranging from Tenth Grade to Third Grade.
Han Li had already refined all the Rebirth Pills and distributed them according to his earlier plan, creating dozens of Fifth-Grade talents for the Han Mansion.
Each person who received a Rebirth Pill, whether they were Han Li’s descendants or his concubines, were all subjected to a Divine Spirit restriction by Han Li to prevent any leaks.
Even if all of Han Li’s strength were to be exposed, those who coveted the Rebirth Pill Formula would still fall short; one would need to be at least in the Divine Yuan Realm to contend.
Upon reaching the Divine Yuan Realm, Han Li didn’t plan to reveal himself immediately, for owning strength and revealing strength were two different matters. The world only thought he was someone from the God Refining Realm or Hollow Void Stage who acquired the Rebirth Pill Formula, which would bring endless troubles to his door.
The beautiful concubines and descendants who received the Rebirth Pills were overjoyed, never having imagined their husband, father, or grandfather possessed such a heaven-defying treasure, and they instantly became filled with anticipation for the future.
After being promoted to Fifth-Grade aptitude and with the support of Han Mansion’s resources, their future ascension to the Hollow Void Stage wouldn’t be difficult, and they might even glimpse the Myriad Phenomena Realm, attaining a lifespan of a thousand years.
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, and other beautiful concubines thought of cultivating to higher levels, to accompany their husband, Han Li, for longer.
Han Yongfan, Han Yongli, Han Yongjin, and other descendants, originally lacking in aptitude but possessing either ability or insight, now had their aptitudes enhanced. Looking forward to the future, their confidence soared, believing they would make significant achievements and would then return the family’s nurturing in full.
In the inner quarters, Han Li’s concubines were gathered together, casually chatting and dreaming about the future.
Before being sent to The Li Manor as concubines, they had an inkling that the Manor Lord seemed to have practiced the Collection and Supplement Method, taking in many concubines to find suitable cauldrons.
Ling Xuejing, Li Qingqing, and other beautiful concubines felt quite hopeless, yet they were powerless to resist and were forced into The Li Manor due to various factors.
But after marrying into The Li Manor, they discovered that it was not the dark and hopeless place they had imagined. The Manor Lord, Li Feiyu, had never practiced collection and supplement on them and treated them well; it seemed he harbored no ill intentions and was simply indulging in his love for beauty.
This greatly relieved the hearts of Ling Xuejing, Li Qingqing, and the other beautiful concubines. Being the concubine of a strong individual from the True Martial Realm was quite pleasant and a fortune many yearned for but could not obtain.
After observing for several months and confirming that the Manor Lord truly had no intention of practicing collection and supplement, they fully accepted Li Feiyu in their hearts as their husband and pillar of strength.
Having a husband in the True Martial Realm, they could access cultivation resources in The Li Manor they previously couldn’t, such as Heaven Rank cultivation techniques, martial arts, and plenty of Top Quality Spirit Stones, enabling them to cultivate to higher realms.
With their status as concubines of The Li Manor, their influence in Capital City Da Qian greatly increased, their standing within their own families rose quickly, and they possessed significant sway, much to the delightful surprise of Ling Xuejing, Li Qingqing, and the other beautiful concubines.
They felt that the only downside of their husband, Li Feiyu, was his keen desire to spread his lineage, having taken twenty-four concubines, all of whom were now with child.
Could it be that their husband was once a Loose Cultivator who has now set his heart on establishing a grand family, which is why he’s been taking in concubines so frequently?
The numerous concubines felt this was the truth, as it seemed the only explanation for their husband’s behavior. Although being pregnant affected their cultivation, they all felt it was manageable, and having children would surely make their husband treat them even better.
Han Li observed all this and muttered to himself, “The children they give birth to should mostly be of Fifth-Grade, which would save a considerable amount of Rebirth Pills.”
He himself was of Fourth-Grade aptitude, and these concubines were of Fifth or Sixth Grade. Theoretically speaking, their children’s aptitudes could be Fourth, Fifth, or Sixth Grade, with the likelihood of Fourth and Sixth Grades being smaller, and Fifth Grade being more probable. The chances for an aptitude above Third Grade or below Sixth Grade were even lower.
“When will I be able to take in a beautiful cultivator with Fourth-Grade aptitude?” Han Li murmured to himself.
In Capital City Da Qian, there were indeed many high-quality female cultivators with Fourth-Grade aptitude, concentrated in the royal family and the homes of dukes and nobles, with a good number throughout the six provinces as well, just that none had come to become Han Li’s concubines as of now.
They were all watching and waiting, aware of the rumors, and worried about becoming cauldrons if they married into the Han Mansion, they harbored many concerns.
However, the reputation of The Li Manor’s Lord had been improving lately. Although he took in many concubines, the first batch of five concubines, who had been in The Li Manor for three months, were still living well, flourishing and even improving significantly in their cultivation.
The beautiful female cultivators who married into The Li Manor later and became concubines to the Manor’s Lord were also doing fine and had all conceived as well.
Han Li didn’t prevent his concubines from contacting the outside world, as he wanted to spread some information through the concubines and the servants of The Li Manor, to reverse the negative influences.
Han Li had not yet planned to actively capture high-quality female cultivators to become his concubines nor had he made moves toward the renowned beauties in Capital City. That would come later.
He had taken many concubines now, engaging in battles daily, not eager to do those things, and Han Li preferred those who were willing to take the bait. It was like a trade.
For various reasons, they wanted to obtain certain things but couldn’t satisfy them through themselves, their families, or their Sects. However, the master of Li Mansion could fulfil their wishes, so they would consider trading with Li Feiyu. The price was to marry into Li Mansion and become one of Li Feiyu’s concubines.
According to Han Li’s estimate, in some time, it was likely that women cultivators with fourth-grade aptitude would present themselves, whether of their own accord or under the influence of their backing forces; Han Li didn’t care and would accept them all without exception.
After casting a final, deep glance at the Imperial Palace, Han Li’s figure disappeared from Li Mansion and then shortly appeared in Han Mansion.
With a sweep of his Spiritual Sense, he immediately knew Jiang Baiye’s location and appeared by her side at once.
“Jiang Jiang.”
Han Li wrapped his arms around her from behind, his large hand resting on Jiang Baiye’s swollen belly, caressing.
He could clearly sense the small life inside, a boy, which made the old ancestor Han exceedingly pleased.
He preferred boys somewhat more because boys could take many wives and concubines to produce numerous descendants for Han Mansion; girls couldn’t do that. He did not wish for his daughters, granddaughters, and so on to have too many children—similar to how he purposefully controlled the number of children his beautiful concubines had.
“My husband~”
Jiang Baiye called out softly, her cool voice tinged with tender warmth, visibly delighted at the sight of Han Li.
Han Li had previously said he would come to keep her company, staying with her until the birth of the child, so Jiang Baiye had gone to the summit of Chengdao Peak to wait, hoping Han Li would return from Li Mansion soon.
Indeed, Han Li didn’t stay long at Li Mansion before returning to her side. Now that it was just the two of them again, Jiang Baiye was overjoyed.
The cool breeze lifted the hem of the Sword Immortal’s moon-white dress, revealing her slender and beautiful feet in white ankle socks. The wind itself seemed to marvel at her beauty; in this moment, the Sword Immortal was exceptionally enticing.
“Jiang Jiang…”
Han Li whispered sweet nothings into Jiang Baiye’s ear, causing her to shiver delightedly, her smile growing even brighter.
The Sword Immortal’s body was soft as she leaned quietly in Han Li’s embrace. Being pregnant had changed her aura significantly, with the added shyness of a young girl and the gentle charm of a young wife, she was stunningly gorgeous, constantly radiating an irresistible allure.
Jiang Baiye looked at Han Li, and he gazed back at her, their eyes gradually becoming hazy. Han Li couldn’t help but lean down and capture her delicate, blushing lips.
After, Han Li patiently accompanied Jiang Baiye, giving her his full care, making her feel deeply moved. She knew that Han Li had taken many concubines, but he still treated her as before and was willing to spend a lot of time with her.
The next day, Sword Immortal Jiang Baiye’s child was born, just as Han Li had seen—a boy.
“Jiang Jiang, I would like to name the child Han Yongjiang, what do you think?”
Han Li looked at the infant in his arms and then towards Jiang Baiye, who was a little pale and weak, as he softly spoke.
He hadn’t named Lu Tianxiang’s children Han Yonglu or Han Yongxiang, as those were girls’ names. The Sect Hierarch had borne him a boy; he could consider such names if they had a daughter in the future.
Jiang Baiye quickly nodded, her eyes filled with surprise; this was the first time she saw her husband give such a meaningful name to a descendant.
She was the first person to receive this kind of treatment.
Thinking of this, Jiang Baiye looked at Han Li next to her and, uncharacteristically, took the initiative to say, “My husband, kiss me~”
Han Li naturally wouldn’t refuse Jiang Baiye’s request. He handed Han Yongjiang to someone else to hold and, with one arm around Jiang Baiye, lowered his head to press his lips to her soft ones.
His other hand supported Jiang Baiye’s back, transferring a copious amount of refined True Yuan to help her recover her vitality, causing her complexion to quickly regain its rosy hue.
PS: This a makeup for yesterday’s.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - 166: Han Li Cuts the Grass and Removes the Roots! The Daqian Empire Trembles!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 166: Han Li Cuts the Grass and Removes the Roots! The Daqian Empire Trembles!_1
Translator: 549690339
After spending a considerable time with Jiang Baiye, Han Li finally left, heading towards Cultivation Peak while checking the system notifications.
“You have produced an offspring with the first Fourth Grade talent, your talent has increased by ten percent, you’ve gained sixty years of cultivation, and you’ve obtained the Earth Rank Mid-Grade martial technique [Xuanming Seven Sword].”
Han Li nodded slightly, having anticipated this reward, yet he couldn’t help but feel a bit disappointed.
“It seems that only offspring with at least Third Grade talent would yield greater rewards,” Han Li mused to himself.
The reward for the first offspring with Third Grade talent had included an additional Heaven Rank Low-Grade cultivation technique, the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, directly raising his talent from Fifth to Fourth Grade. Now, the reward for the first offspring with Fourth Grade talent was significantly less impressive.
The ten percent increase in talent had brought his current talent to 31% at Fourth Grade, and sixty years of cultivation was quite substantial, reducing the cultivation needed to advance to the True Martial Realm by one-tenth.
The Xuanming Seven Sword was decent as well; with the augmentation of the nascent Omni-Martial True Intent, it could unleash the combat strength of the Third Heaven of the True Martial Realm, comparable to the Divine Desolate Imprisoning Finger. Both techniques could be used in conjunction on one ‘persona.’
Nowadays, he possessed numerous Earth Rank Top-Grade and Supreme-Grade martial techniques. He had learned the complete version of the Yin and Yang Palm Seal from Yun Miaoyi and had already cultivated it to perfection. Tianxuan Mountain’s Xuantian Punch was also perfected, both capable of unleashing the combat power of the Fifth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
The God Slaying Sword Scripture from Tianxuan Mountain had also reached perfection some time ago, able to unleash the combat power of the Third Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
Collecting his thoughts, Han Li arrived at Cultivation Peak, where all of the Han Mansion’s Artifact Refiners, Alchemists, Talisman Makers, and Formation Masters resided. The Guest Elders skilled in the Four Arts of Cultivation stayed here, refining various Spirit Pills, Spiritual Artifacts, Spirit Talismans, and Spiritual Formations for the Han Family.
Han Li also visited occasionally to refine higher grade Spirit Pills, Spiritual Artifacts, and other cultivation resources.
In the eyes of the outside world, Han Mansion was merely a God Refining Realm power, only capable of recruiting Seventh Grade Artifact Refiners and Alchemists from the Gangyuan Realm and the like.
Now, Cultivation Peak was home to numerous Guest Elders skilled in the Four Arts of Cultivation, with at least one Seventh Grade expert in each field, painstakingly recruited by the Han Mansion with significant effort.
Although Han Li was not impressed by their creations, he still found them satisfactory, at the very least useful for the descendants of the Han Mansion, who could also sell them.
In a few decades, there would be a group of Han Mansion descendants skilled in the Four Arts of Cultivation with decent grades, and by then, the Han Mansion would be able to compensate for its past weaknesses in this area.
Qingzhou, the former site of the Canghai Sect.
Ever since the Daqian Empire withdrew, the Yinyang Sect had occupied Qingzhou. The Hehuan Sect had also moved to the former site of the Canghai Sect.
This place possessed the richest concentration of Spiritual Energy in the entire Qingzhou, and even in Sanzhou, which is why the Canghai Sect, one of the Ten Great Sects of Daqian, had claimed it.
In the newly established Hehuan Sect’s grand hall, Yan Liulong was once again contemplating whether to capture Han Li.
She wore a form-fitting black dress with a slit running up to her thigh, revealing enticing black silk stockings. Resting her chin in one hand, she lounged on the throne, legs elegantly crossed.
Her tall, mature body undulated with grace—her beauty beyond description. Her posture was incredibly seductive, from her peach-like charms above to below, she was a fully ripened water peach.
Time failed to leave its mark on her; she retained the delicate skin of a young girl yet possessed the mature allure of a married woman, sometimes taking on the persona of a cool and noble lady, akin to a queen sitting above all others.
“It should be fine, right?” Yan Liulong’s sultry, soul-stirring voice echoed in the grand hall as she spoke to herself.
The thought of capturing and marrying an ancestor brought a profoundly enchanting and sultry expression to the face of this tempting creature, intoxicating and ensnaring to anyone who beheld it.
Yan Liulong had accomplished her task of infiltrating the Daqian Empire for the Yinyang Sect, and as she desired, she had broken through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, becoming a Great Grandmaster.
She felt it was time to settle accounts with that marrying ancestor.
Now that the situation had stabilized and the various powers were maintaining their current statuses, with no new major confrontations expected in the short term, Yan Liulong believed this to be an opportune moment.
Her current location in Qingzhou was not far from Yuanzhou, where Han Li resided, with only Jizhou lying in between. With her speed, the round trip would not take long.
Yan Liulong had previously wanted to settle the score with Han Li but had been wary of the Qian Dynasty’s old war ancestor, leading her to hold back. Furthermore, with the arrival of an old ancestor from the Li Manor in the Qian Dynasty, she dared not take any action.
However, after observing for a while, Yan Liulong noticed that both True Martial Realm Emperor Wu stayed in the Capital City of the Qian Dynasty, seemingly with no intention to interfere.
The old war ancestor appeared to have little lifespan left and was likely in seclusion, not wishing to act recklessly; the lord of Li Manor, however, seemed to be of a larger vision, proclaiming, “Within the boundaries of Da Qian, True Martial is forbidden,” specifically targeted at True Martial Realm powerhouses.
When other powers’ Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters entered Da Qian’s six states, it was the Great Grandmasters of the Qian Dynasty itself who dealt with them. The old ancestor from Li Manor made no moves at all, truly adhering to what he had declared.
“I’ll wait a few more days, and if there’s still no issue, I’ll go capture Han Li to bolster my strength,” Yan Liulong’s tempting tongue flicked across her red lips.
Suddenly, Yan Liulong sighed, “Compared to Li Feiyu, Han Li still falls far short.”
In fact, Han Li had been gradually losing his title of marrying ancestor, mainly because his strength was too low. Being only over two hundred years old, he no longer suited the moniker, even though he had many wives and concubines.
Now, the new “marrying ancestor” from the Li Manor was Li Feiyu, with True Martial Realm cultivation and having lived for over a thousand years. In three months, he had taken twenty-four concubines, each with significant renown, all of great beauty and starting from the Gangyuan Realm in cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - 166: Han Li Cuts the Grass and Removes the Roots! The Daqian Empire Trembles!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 166: Han Li Cuts the Grass and Removes the Roots! The Daqian Empire Trembles!_2
Translator: 549690339
Leizhou’s title of “Ancestor of Concubine Acquisition” only spread within a small scope, such as a few manors, while Li Feiyu’s similar title became known throughout the entirety of Daqian, and even in the Xuan Domain.
Someone at the True Martial Realm engaging in such activities would always attract more and greater attention. The outside world buzzed with speculation about how many wives and concubines the master of the Li Manor, Li Feiyu, would take in a year, and whether Daqian Empire could really withstand this for four hundred years?
If Li Feiyu were to engage in some forceful abductions, especially targeting the Daqian Royalty, would the mighty ancestors of the empire intervene? Would the two sides come to a rupture?
“If I could ‘harvest’ that master of the Li Manor, Li Feiyu, could I rise to the True Martial Realm?” Yan Liulong thought to herself, her heart filled with longing.
Yet she knew this was merely a thought, one she could not act upon; she was a newly-advanced Grandmaster from the Myriad Phenomena Realm. Making such a move would simply be courting death.
Her sect, the Yinyang Sect, bore a deep grudge against Li Feiyu, as Emperor Wu Dugu Bing from the True Martial Realm had been severely injured by Li Feiyu, even falling in cultivation level. Although his wounds had since healed, it would still take a considerable time to regain his former realm.
Li Feiyu was also suspected of being a great demon, practicing the Collection and Supplement Method. Should Yan Liulong fall into his hands, she would effectively be delivering herself for him to ‘harvest,’ an outcome she dearly wished to avoid.
She enjoyed ‘harvesting’ others; she did not want to be ‘harvested.’ She pictured each of her targets carefully and selectively.
In the Capital City of Daqian, within the Li Manor.
Han Li stood atop the highest floor of Chong Xiao Pavilion, overlooking Daqian, contemplating a question.
Should he slay Yu Chengkong and his mentor, the Daqian National Teacher?
In years past, the Lin Family had been a moderately influential power in Yuanzhou, having once produced a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage, dominating in other manors within Yuanzhou.
When Yu Chengkong, the third disciple of the Daqian National Teacher, passed through the manor city where the Lin Family resided, he laid eyes on the beautiful, mature wife of the family head and, indulging his preferences, he outright demanded that the head gift his wife to him.
The head of the Lin Family refused, thus sowing the seeds of disaster. Bearing a grudge, Yu Chengkong conducted extensive inquiries, expending hefty resources to discover that the Lin Family possessed two Longevity Pills, capable of extending the life of a Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Yu Chengkong immediately informed the Daqian National Teacher of this information. Knowing his disciple wanted to use him as a cat’s-paw, the National Teacher still agreed, provided Yu Chengkong bring back the two miracle drugs.
Subsequently, Yu Chengkong led a raid on the Lin Family, wiping them out, and seizing the Longevity Pills, leaving the Lin Family’s head and his wives and concubines dead. Only two daughters were saved by their guards who fought desperately to help them escape to Leizhou.
These two daughters were Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, who, since early years, became concubines of Han Li, each giving birth to three or four children.
After joining Han Mansion, the two sisters buried the incident deep in their hearts, never speaking of it, not wanting to place pressure on their husband, Han Li, or bring major troubles to Han Mansion.
But Han Li had not forgotten, just that previously the timing was not right and his identity did not permit action; now, the identity of Li Feiyu posed no issues.
Li Feiyu was a formidable Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, the pillar that would support Daqian for the next four hundred years—Daqian Empire’s greatest bulwark.
Killing a disciple of the State Preceptor was a trivial matter, and even if he were to kill the Daqian National Teacher himself, who would dare to object?
After pondering for a while, Han Li decided it was time to act, to kill Yu Chengkong and even the Daqian National Teacher together, to prevent future calamities.
He had refrained from acting before due to insufficient strength and the potential for trouble; now, his strength was adequate, and with this identity, there was no need for so much caution. If he still hesitated, too afraid to even avenge a wrong, he felt he would be unworthy of the identity of one who followed the way of survival.
The enemies of his concubines were also his enemies. Now that he, Han Li, had survived until he was sufficiently powerful, he need not be so cautious anymore. What use was his combat ability in the True Martial Realm if he still feared this and that?
Han Li’s Spiritual Sense surged forth, enveloping the entire Qian Dynasty, locating the residence of the Daqian National Teacher, and identified that the Teacher had even set up a Third Grade Formation around his manor.
Han Li’s Spiritual Sense did not try to forcefully break through, as disturbing the formation might alert Yu Chengkong and the Daqian National Teacher, causing them to hide, which would lead to complications.
His figure vanished from the Li Manor, and when he reappeared, he had changed his attire and proceeded to the Tianji Pavilion to check on Yu Chengkong’s whereabouts, discovering that he had recently been staying at Mentor’s Manor.
In the secret chamber of Mentor’s Manor.
The Daqian National Teacher sat at the head, with his disciples seated below; Yu Chengkong was also there, his mouth opening and closing as he spoke incessantly, “Master, are we really leaving the Daqian Empire?”
“Indeed, Master, if we leave the Daqian Empire, where can we go?” the second disciple asked, his head drooping.
“Hmph, would your master harm you?” the First Disciple snorted coldly, unsatisfied with the tone.
“That Li Feiyu is too arrogant, shamelessly taking on concubines, and at this rate, he might eventually set his sights on our wives and daughters.”
“If we don’t leave now, do you wish to present your wives and daughters to the Li Manor as concubines?”
“Eldest brother is absolutely right. I don’t dare to show my face anymore for fear that one day I’ll be snatched away by the lord of the Li Manor to become a concubine,” said the fourth disciple with a bitter smile.
She was the fourth disciple of the State Preceptor, known as Li Na, with a Fourth Grade Cultivation Talent. She was the State Preceptor’s last disciple with the lowest talent and had reached the pinnacle of the God Refining Realm. Additionally, she was an absolute beauty with a voluptuous figure, curvaceous in all the right places, and a cold but stunning demeanor.
“Enough, your master has made a decision; there is no need for further discussion,” the Daqian National Teacher said blandly.
In truth, he had long harbored thoughts of breaking away from the Qian Dynasty, although he had been hesitant, opting to wait and see if there was yet something to gain from the empire.

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - 166: Han Li Cuts the Grass and Removes the Roots! The Daqian Empire Trembles!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 166: Han Li Cuts the Grass and Removes the Roots! The Daqian Empire Trembles!_3
Translator: 549690339
Originally, he had planned to leave once the Daqian Empire collapsed or when Zhenxiong’s elder ancestor died. The chaos within the collapsing Daqian Empire would facilitate his actions, allowing him to seize the empire’s thousands of years of accumulated essence. By seizing even just a portion, his chances of cultivating to the True Martial Realm would greatly increase.
After the arrival of Li Feiyu, a True Martial Realm powerhouse, the Daqian State Preceptor’s resolve hardened even further.
Having an additional True Martial Realm presence to ensure the peace of the Daqian Empire for four hundred years was indeed a blessing. However, the issue lay with the fact that this True Martial Realm Emperor Wu had a fondness for the company of women and took concubines too frequently.
For now, Li Feiyu’s attention was still focused on the maidens with untouched beauty, but in a few years, those in the capital with decent aptitude and maidenhood intact would be taken as his servant concubines.
At that point, it was likely that Li Feiyu would set his eyes on the wives and beautiful matrons, targeting them first among the imperial nobility and even within the Daqian Empire.
Because of their high cultivation and status, the quality of the wives they took and the concubines they accepted was also very high.
Take the State Preceptor for example—he had two wives and five beautiful concubines, with aptitudes between fifth and sixth grade, and cultivations ranging from late Gangyuan Realm to the initial stage of the Hollow Void Realm.
The standards by which the Master of the Li Manor took concubines happened to be quite similar to this, and just the thought was enough to distress the State Preceptor.
The arrival of Li Feiyu not only spoiled his plans but might also bring him a vast stretch of green grassland. After some consideration, the State Preceptor decided to sever ties with the Daqian Empire sooner rather than later.
He only shared this decision with his two wives and four disciples. He could forsake five beautiful concubines, but not his wives, with whom he shared deep affection; the four disciples were his capable assistants, one at the peak of the God Refining Realm and three Gurus in the Void Realm.
“Sigh~”
Yu Chengkong and the second disciple sighed. They were reluctant to leave the prosperity of the capital city, but with the master’s decision made, they could only agree.
“Boom!”
A loud explosion sounded, causing the State Preceptor and his four disciples to change color simultaneously as they sensed that the protective formation of their manor was under attack.
This was the capital city of the Daqian Empire, where two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus were stationed, not far from the Mentor’s Manor. Who would be bold enough to do this?
Swish, swish~
The state preceptor and Yu Chengkong vanished from the secret chamber, their expressions somber as they looked outside. When they clearly saw who was approaching, their faces drastically changed.
“Grand Ancestor Li, what are you doing? Stop immediately!” the State Preceptor cried out in shock and horror. While activating the great formation to defend, he shouted loudly.
A bright sword light slashed across, shattering the protective formation. The State Preceptor and his four disciples didn’t dare resist and scattered in all directions, fleeing for their lives.
Though unsure why Li Feiyu sought to attack the Mentor’s Manor, they knew that fighting a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu was a suicidal path and decided to escape first, discuss later.
Han Li, indifferent to the pleas, pointed his finger as if it were a sword. The sword light dove like a dragon, directly shattering the Daqian State Preceptor. With another palm strike, he obliterated Yu Chengkong, who died instantly.
Following that, he flicked his fingers twice, killing the State Preceptor’s First Disciple and second disciple. Reaching out, he captured Li Na, the fourth disciple of the State Preceptor who had fled into the distance, and sealed all of her cultivation.
He had intended to exterminate the entire line of the State Preceptor, but upon discovering a beautiful woman among them, he spared her life.
After finishing these acts, Han Li glanced at the Imperial Palace, holding onto Li Na as he disappeared from the Mentor’s Manor and returned to Li Mansion.
Casually tossing Li Na to a maid to take away with several instructions, Han Li appeared atop the Chong Xiao Pavilion and looked towards the Imperial Palace, deep in thought.
Chu Zhenxiong had not made a move!
The reason Han Li boldly went to slaughter the State Preceptor’s line was also to test Chu Zhenxiong’s intentions and to discover how Chu Zhenxiong was plotting his reincarnation and whether he was indeed Chu Dingqian or not.
Now, Han Li felt that the grey-clothed elder was very likely Chu Dingqian.
His attack on the Mentor’s Manor had utilized True Martial Realm combat ability, alarming the entire six states of Daqian. It took him only a breath or two to kill the State Preceptor and others, yet Chu Dingqian had not appeared despite the close proximity of the Mentor’s Manor to the Imperial Palace.
This indicated that Chu Dingqian was preoccupied within the palace and unable to intervene in time. Han Li wanted to know more about Chu Dingqian’s current state—could he appear again, or had he already been reincarnated?
Meanwhile, the capital city was in turmoil due to the sudden battle, with many important Daqian officials rushing to the Imperial Palace to seek an audience.
The Grand Preceptor, the Left Chancellor, the Prophet, and others stood in Chao Tian Hall, still feeling the aftereffects of danger. They were not sure why Li Feiyu, the old ancestor, had suddenly gone mad, attacking and killing the lineage of the State Preceptor. They were very concerned that they might follow in the footsteps of the State Preceptor.
“Devil incarnate!”
“The State Preceptor didn’t provoke him, did he? For no reason at all, he slew the Preceptor’s lineage. He must give us an explanation.”
“How detestable. My manor is not far from the State Preceptor’s, and it was almost affected by the aftermath.”
“This is too terrifying—the State Preceptor was at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, yet without even drawing his sword, Li Feiyu killed him with a mere flick of his fingers.”
Several important ministers of Da Qian vented their dissatisfaction, not worried about Li Feiyu discovering them, as the grand formation of the Imperial Palace had been activated, making it impossible for Li Feiyu to glimpse inside.
Emperor Qian was also in Chao Tian Hall, listening quietly. He knew these people needed to vent, and after a while, he said, “My lords, do not worry. I have already reported to the old ancestor, and he will seek out Li Feiyu to obtain an explanation.”
Emperor Qian silently sighed in his heart, feeling extremely powerless, for he had already detected Li Feiyu’s actions at the time they occurred.
He did not dare to intervene, and immediately went to the core forbidden area to inform Chu Zhenxiong, the old ancestor, who had now gone to find Li Feiyu.
“I hope for a good outcome,” Emperor Qian thought silently to himself.
At the ninth floor of the Drunken Immortal Pavilion, the figures of Han Li and Chu Dingqian appeared; neither of them wanted to go back to their respective strongholds and thus chose this place.
However, their expressions were completely different—Han Li was all smiles, clearheaded and in high spirits, whereas Chu Dingqian’s face was gloomy, filled with anger.
“What business does Chu have with Han?”
Seeing the furious Chu Dingqian, Han Li spoke indifferently.
“Doesn’t Han plan on giving Chu an explanation?” Chu Dingqian said coldly, his anger unabated.
He had been in suspended animation in the forbidden area of the Imperial Palace, waiting for the Devil Fetus to mature, leaving Li Feiyu in charge of guarding Da Qian. Yet, in such a short time, Li Feiyu had given him quite the shock.
An action from the True Martial Realm is quite noticeable, and even within the forbidden grounds of the Imperial Palace, Chu Dingqian was awakened. His Spiritual Sense surged out, and he instantly discovered that it was Li Feiyu who was taking action, killing the State Preceptor and his Disciples and abducting a beautiful female cultivator.
However, it took time for him to recover from his special state; by the time his strength returned to its peak, Li Feiyu had already left, and Emperor Qian came running in.
“An explanation? The State Preceptor and his Disciples offended me; what’s wrong with killing them?” Han Li said blandly.
“Is that truly so?” Chu Dingqian continued to inquire, clearly disbelieving.
He was very suspicious of Li Feiyu’s intent—if that was the case, why didn’t he kill everyone? And why take a beautiful female cultivator with him?
Han Li replied, “That’s right.”
“You wouldn’t think I did this for that female cultivator, would you? If Han wanted her, he would’ve simply commanded the State Preceptor to offer her up; there would be no need for such a commotion.”
“Heh,” Chu Dingqian let out a cold laugh, “Let’s not have a repeat, Han.”
With those words, Chu Dingqian’s figure vanished. Li Feiyu had given his explanation, and there was no use in pressing further. Li Feiyu obviously felt secure in his position.
He didn’t want to fall out with Li Feiyu over a State Preceptor, but hoped that Li Feiyu would not continue such actions. Otherwise, he would have to bear the pain of having Li Feiyu killed.
Otherwise, before he could take over and be reborn, Da Qian would be thrown into disarray by Li Feiyu’s actions.
Han Li chuckled, his figure also disappearing from the Drunken Immortal Pavilion. Chu Zhenxiong was indeed Chu Dingqian; how interesting.
Indeed, he would not do so again. This time was to avenge Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin and incidentally to test Chu Dingqian. Taking the beautiful female cultivator was just by the way.
There were still many lovely ladies in the Mentor’s Manor, seemingly the wives and concubines of the State Preceptor. Although Han Li had noticed them, he was not interested in them; they did not catch his eye, so naturally, he did not take them.
That beautiful female cultivator was a virgin, which is why Han Li conveniently took her back. Moreover, he would not bestow upon her the status of a principal wife; she would be a servant concubine, the kind that satisfies physical desires without involving the heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - 167: Fairy, Witch, All Are Ancestors_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 167: Fairy, Witch, All Are Ancestors_1
Translator: 549690339
In the Li Manor, within a secluded palace hall.
Li Na stood there, bewildered, looking around aimlessly, not knowing what to do.
Just two quarters of an hour earlier, she had been within the Mentor’s Manor, deeply conversing with her fellow disciples and their master, preparing to leave the Daqian Empire to live a carefree life elsewhere.
With one peak Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster, four to five Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage, and a number of masters in the God Refining Realm, their group was already quite powerful.
After breaking away from the Daqian Empire, whether establishing their own sect, starting a new school, or joining one of the top forces, they would all hold high status and position.
As the most favored disciple of the State Preceptor, having cultivated to the peak of the God Refining Realm and with great hope of advancing to the Myriad Phenomena Realm under her master’s guidance, she naturally expected to attain a lofty status as well.
But now, everything was gone.
Her master and several of her fellow disciples had perished, casually slain by the master of Li Manor in the blink of an eye. She herself had been captured and brought to the Li Manor; she knew full well what her fate would be, she just didn’t want to face it.
Although it was widely said that the manor’s lord was very Benevolent, never practicing any Collection and Supplement Method, and that the beautiful female cultivators who had married into the Li Manor were all living well, Li Na felt this was just a facade. Perhaps Li Feiyu, this great demon, had bigger schemes in mind.
Li Na had considered suicide, but her cultivation had been sealed; now, she was no different from a common person, and with several maids with intact cultivation watching her, she found she had no opportunity to end her own life.
Deep down, she still clung to a thread of hope; what if the rumors she had heard from the outside world were true?
If so, marrying into the Li Manor and becoming one of its master’s concubines might not be so bad. At the very least, she wouldn’t have to die or become a mere cultivation vessel.
Li Na didn’t want to die; she still yearned to reach the Myriad Phenomena Realm. She had so much life left to live, so much pleasure to experience; her earlier years had been consumed by nothing but cultivation.
She knew about the concubines in the Li Manor. Although their looks were comparable to hers, their aptitudes and cultivation levels were inferior. Li Na felt that if she took the initiative, she might become Li Feiyu’s favored consort.
First, using Li Feiyu’s resources to cultivate to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, then, if an opportunity presented itself in the future, she would consider whether to seek revenge for her master.
Her master had treated her extremely well, so well that at times, she wondered if he saw her as nothing but a cultivation vessel, waiting to harvest her once she became a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster.
But since her master had never indicated such intentions, Li Na thought she might be overthinking it. Besides, her master was now dead, so such thoughts were pointless.
Looking at her thin, black silk dress, Li Na bit her red lips, suspecting that very soon, she would be ravaged by that old demon, Li Feiyu.
After Li Feiyu brought her back, he handed her over to the maids. They took her to bathe and changed her into this dress, then brought her here.
Li Na had been waiting, waiting for Li Feiyu to appear. But Li Feiyu had yet to show himself, and she couldn’t help but let her mind run wild.
What will be the outcome of her waiting?
Another half a quarter later, as Li Na grew increasingly listless, Han Li’s figure finally arrived, albeit belatedly.
“What… what do you want to do?” Seeing Li Feiyu appear, Li Na’s eyes lit up. Hesitating briefly, she asked.
In that half a quarter, Li Na had thought through a lot. She felt she had to seize the opportunity; she couldn’t die or become Li Feiyu’s cultivation vessel.
She hoped to become Li Feiyu’s favored concubine, even his wife. For this, she had pondered many methods, unsure which might succeed.
“Li Na, is it? You have two choices, first, become a servant concubine to this seat,” said Han Li indifferently.
Given Li Na’s identity, Han Li thought offering her the status of a servant concubine was the limit. It was a relationship that benefited the flesh but not the heart; having children would be the extent of it, to produce more offspring for him.
As the fourth disciple of the State Preceptor, albeit incidental, Han Li had no intention of letting her go, nor did he wish to show any mercy. An enemy was an enemy, who knows whether she might harbor resentment and seek revenge when the chance arose.
Han Li had checked Li Na’s background—Sixth-grade aptitude, peak of the God Refining Realm, and face value around ninety points—qualifying her as a high-quality female cultivator.
If it were not for his identity, and if there were no such enmity between them, Han Li might have considered taking her as his wife.
But as Li Feiyu, with deep enmity between them, Han Li was unsure whether Li Na could forget the past, and he didn’t care to find out. Considering Li Na’s aptitude and attractiveness, she could avoid death by becoming a servant concubine.
Regardless, Li Na’s cultivation level was not to be restored. If she was unwilling, she would be treated merely as a tool, which made little difference to Han Li.
Servant concubine?!
Upon hearing this, Li Na’s complexion turned several shades paler, she trembled, and stepped back involuntarily, her face a mask of disbelief.
Those Sixth-grade aptitude female cultivators of the Gang Yuan realm, inferior to her in both looks and temperament, could become Li Feiyu’s minor concubines, yet she was relegated to being a servant concubine?
What a joke!
Li Na doubted her ears, but after scrutinizing Li Feiyu multiple times, she confirmed his intention.
In the Capital City of Da Qian, she was the famously known Fairy Li Na, counted among the five fairy-like beauties of Da Qian. Was she only suited to be a servant concubine?
She felt as if she had been knocked down from heaven into hell.
A servant concubine was an even lower existence compared to a minor concubine. Even being a “concubine” conferred some semblance of status, but a “servant concubine” was merely one to be summoned and dismissed on a whim, considered even more abjectly low.
Servant concubines could be directly purchased, came as part of a dowry, were given as gifts, and more…
A servant concubine had no status; they were not officially married. If she were to become one, it would be tragically low—slightly above servants and guards in the manor but ranked below managers, butlers, and overseers.

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - 167: Fairy, Witch, All Are Ancestors_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 167: Fairy, Witch, All Are Ancestors_2
Translator: 549690339
This was far beyond Li Na’s expectations; it was a world away from what she had imagined. A wife, a favored concubine, and a servant concubine were as different as heaven and earth.
Li Na bowed her head and asked tentatively with a weak voice, “What about the second choice?”
Even though she knew the second choice would generally be worse, Li Na couldn’t help but harbor a sliver of hope. What if the outcome was better?
“The second option is to become my female slave,” Han Li said indifferently.
The “female slave” he spoke of—she’d satisfy certain needs. Han Li would be responsible for the tilling, the female slave for bearing children. He just needed to ensure that Li Na didn’t die.
Upon hearing this, Li Na’s delicate body trembled, and she immediately said, “I choose the first one.”
Being a female slave was worse than a servant concubine. To be a female slave was to be entirely at Li Feiyu’s mercy, without freedom, obtaining nothing, living a life worse than death.
At least a servant concubine retained some freedom.
Tears had unknowingly begun to stream down her cheeks as she felt utter humiliation. Was this the fate of one of the Capital City’s five great fairies, to end up as a mere servant concubine to an old demon?
With a wave of his hand, Han Li and she disappeared from the side hall and arrived at a small courtyard, which Han Li had prepared for Li Na. Of course, it was much inferior to the lodgings of beauties such as Die Yi and Li Qingqing.
Han Li lay in a Taishi Chair, looking at Li Na who stood there numbly, and said indifferently, “What are you standing there dumbfounded for? Come and attend to me.”
Li Na sobbed piteously. She very much wanted to disobey the command but she didn’t want to die either, and she knew that even if she wanted to die, she couldn’t. The consequences for not obeying would be even worse.
“Yes… Master… Master,” she said.
Her head bowed, feeling immensely humiliated, she still slowly walked towards Han Li, and with stiff jade hands, she began to massage Li Feiyu’s shoulders.
Seeing her like this, something in Han Li’s heart stirred, a sensation of excitement different from what he felt when in the company of Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Qiu Yueyao, and the other graceful wives and beautiful concubines.
After continuously disciplining her for half an hour, Han Li attempted to mold this fairy of the Capital City into his shape, but it wasn’t entirely successful yet.
Watching the fairy he had disciplined, now kneeling on the ground serving him, Han Li felt a sudden sense of achievement swelling in his heart. So this was all there was to a fairy famed throughout Da Qian.
“If only I had a sorceress to come along next,” he thought.
The idea of disciplining a sorceress, after having disciplined a fairy, crossed Han Li’s mind, and he found the notion somewhat enticing.
Disciplining both a fairy and a sorceress together seemed like it might provide an even more gratifying sense of achievement.
With a silent sigh, Han Li felt himself growing more wicked by the day, and silently made a decision.
Procreation was the true path; he needn’t be overly strict with himself. Besides wives and concubines, there were servant concubines and female slaves, after all—as long as they could bear him offspring, it was sufficient.
Of course, under normal circumstances, Han Li would take them as wives or concubines, like Li Na’s abnormal case which resulted in her being made a servant concubine or a female slave.
If the offspring she bore could greatly contribute to the Li Manor in the future, such as reaching a high realm in cultivation, offering precious treasures to the elder, or multiplying numerous descendants, it wasn’t impossible to consider leniency and promote her status.
Killing Li Na would be a waste of resources, and Han Li felt this approach was in his favor.
With that thought, Han Li ended the discipline training and began the night’s main event.
The next day, an invigorated Han Li returned to Chengsheng Mountain early in the morning.
There was certainly a unique satisfaction to be had from dealing with a fairy in an entirely different way.
This sensation was completely unlike the feeling during battle with the Sword Immortal, Jiang Baiye; it seemed even more free-spirited, thoroughly enjoyable.
After returning to Han Mansion, apart from dealing with some important matters and crafting some items, Han Li spent the rest of his time keeping company with his graceful wives and beautiful concubines.
Jiang Baiye had just given birth and was currently resting, but Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue were several months pregnant, their bellies now prominently visible.
Apart from those three, there were also several other beauties who were heavily pregnant, some close to giving birth, some still months away, such as the Zhou sisters and two true demonesses.
While attending to his graceful wives and beautiful concubines, Han Li also spared some attention to check on his descendants, his Spiritual Sense sweeping through silently; the entire Han Mansion was within his perception.
After doing all this, Han Li opened his System panel to check and found that the number of talented descendants had reached nearly two hundred and ninety. It wouldn’t take long, at most another month, to reach three hundred.
Upon reaching one hundred and two hundred talented descendants, Han Li had received a century of cultivation experience, a Fifth Grade Longevity Pill, a hundred years of experience in one of the Four Arts of Cultivation, and a supreme grade earth-level Cultivation Technique, martial skill, or weapon.
According to the pattern of rewards based on the number of descendants, reaching three hundred would lead to improved rewards, and Han Li was somewhat expectant.
With the talented descendants nearly reaching the target, and the total number of descendants close as well, less than twenty to go, Han Li estimated it wouldn’t be long after reaching three hundred talented descendants.
At that time, receiving two types of substantial rewards in quick succession, he could gain a significant amount of cultivation experience. Adding a hundred years of cultivation experience for every hundred descendants, along with the cultivation experience he had accrued himself, Han Li felt he was getting close to breaking through to the True Martial Realm.
Even if it were still not enough, it would at most take another half a year, which was about six months ahead of his initial estimate.
Mainly, with the Li Manor’s Han Li prolifically taking concubines, there would be at least twenty-five talented descendants born in seven to ten months.
In the coming period, Han Li would continue to take more concubines under the guise of Li Feiyu, to broaden his sources and strive diligently.
“Sigh, in truth, the elder isn’t just laying back; every day is spent either in battle or on the way to battle,” Han Li sighed inwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 167: Fairy, Witch, All Are Ancestors_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 167: Fairy, Witch, All Are Ancestors_3
Translator: 549690339
A few days later, at the Hehuan Sect.
A mature and plump figure left silently, heading for the Daqian Empire, with the destination being Yonchang Manor in Yuanzhou, Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
Previously, Yan Liulong had thought to wait and observe further, but she hadn’t expected the opportunity to come so swiftly.
There seemed to be signs of internal strife in the Daqian Empire!
The new patriarch Li Feiyu, in a fit of insanity, had actually slain the Daqian National Teacher and killed his three disciples as well, capturing one of the female disciples.
This event had a massive impact and had already spread throughout the Daqian Empire and beyond.
Various powers believed that the Lord of the Li Manor had done so in order to take Fairy Li as a concubine, otherwise why would he act with no apparent cause or grudge?
This caused a great deal of fear among the powers with high-quality female cultivators, worried that the Lord of the Li Manor might suddenly descend upon their forces and annihilate their families and sects.
Thus, many factions took a nearly identical approach, persuading the lofty ladies within their sects or families to become concubines to the Lord of the Li Manor, perhaps even wives.
The Daqian officials made a statement the same day to clarify, dispelling rumors that the National Teacher had a grudge with the Lord of the Li Manor—that his actions were not baseless, nor were they because of Fairy Li.
The Daqian officials also cited the widow of the National Teacher as an example, asserting that the Lord of the Li Manor was not as they imagined; otherwise, how could he have spared the widow of the National Teacher?
When it came to the true Martial Realm Emperor Wu, the Lord of the Li Manor, the Daqian officials couldn’t be very explicit, but believed that all factions could understand the implication.
Was the National Teacher’s widow lacking in talent, or low in cultivation? Was she not beautiful in face, figure, and demeanor? The Lord of the Li Manor had spared them, so what else were you worried about?
After this clarification from the Daqian officials, the various powers were somewhat reassured, ready to wait and see again. If things didn’t improve, for the continuation of their sects and families, they were prepared to send their most exceptional women to the Li Manor to become wives or concubines.
The Daqian officials hadn’t expected that an event occurring a month later would harshly slap their faces, causing all the factions to panic again and hastily prepare to send women.
Currently, Yan Liulong did not know of the future events; she only knew that the two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus of the Daqian were no longer in accord, not as close as before.
Yan Liulong also didn’t believe the various parties’ dispelling of rumors, scoffing at the notion. Would the venerable Zhengxiong ancestor believe them?
With the two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus in an unseen standoff in the Capital City, they barely had the time or energy to care about other places. The Daqian Empire’s Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters likely had no mind to pay attention at the moment either.
This was the perfect opportunity for Yan Liulong to sneak into Jizhou, capture Han Li, and bring him back to the Hehuan Sect. Otherwise, she could not reconcile herself.
She had already planned how to deal with Han Li, starting with administering one hundred and eight types of whipping as a greeting, then slowly harvesting his essence to let him experience the prowess of the Hehuan Sect, so in his next life he wouldn’t dare to offend the Hehuan Sect again.
Unnoticed, Yan Liulong arrived in Yuanzhou. After confirming her direction, she continued towards Yonchang Manor on Chengsheng Mountain.
“Huh?”
In the midst of Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li was leisurely strolling with Yun Miaoyi when he suddenly became aware of a powerful presence entering the range of his Spiritual Sense.
It was an unfamiliar Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster, merely at the first tier. Han Li initially did not want to bother with her, but unexpectedly, this person was heading straight for Chengsheng Mountain.
His Spiritual Sense instantly investigated more carefully and discovered that this was a female cultivator, exuding a captivating and seductive aura, unmistakably a cultivator of the demon path.
Old Patriarch Han’s eyes brightened with the thought, ‘Isn’t this delivering comfort right when one is drowsing?’
Just a few days ago, while subduing Fairy Li, he had thought how nice it would be to train a demoness, and now one had come knocking at his door.
However, Han Li did not act immediately, deciding to let Yun Miaoyi see who this was first.
If it was a self-respecting female demon path cultivator who was still a virgin till now, Han Li would consider taking her as his wife, as she had the qualifications in terms of appearance, talent, and cultivation.
If it was a female demon path cultivator who did not value purity, she could become a servant concubine or female slave, satisfying his desire to train a demoness.
“Yun Yun, I’ll take you to meet someone. Do you recognize her?”
Han Li whispered this into Yun Miaoyi’s ear while nibbling on her earlobe.
Yun Miaoyi looked somewhat puzzled but still nodded gently.
In the next instant, Han Li, with Yun Miaoyi in his arms, disappeared from Chengsheng Mountain and appeared above Yan Liulong, concealing his own aura as they followed her.
“Yun Yun, do you know her?”
Han Li felt that Yun Miaoyi might recognize her.
This female demon path cultivator came from the Yinyang Sect, where Yun Miaoyi was originally a member. Given that there were only so many Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters in the Yinyang Sect, all with known names and reputations, it stood to reason that Yun Miaoyi should know her.
Yun Miaoyi looked and her pupils shrank, surprise appearing on her pretty face, “It’s actually her.”
Seeing Yun Miaoyi’s expression, Han Li knew that she recognized the demon path female cultivator and asked with a smile, “Yun Yun, who is she? Why is she heading for our Chengsheng Mountain? She seems to bear ill will.”
“She couldn’t possibly be coming to save you, could she?” Han Li said teasingly.
“Hmph, she would never come to save me, and she certainly doesn’t know I’m on Chengsheng Mountain,” retorted Yun Miaoyi with a glance at Han Li.
Continuing, Yun Miaoyi said, “Husband, this person is Yan Liulong, the Sect Master of the Hehuan Sect. I suspect she’s here for you.”
“I see, so it’s her. But why would she come to target me?”
His eyes shining upon hearing this, Han Li immediately tagged Yan Liulong as to-be-tamed; this woman had quite the reputation and could only be a servant concubine or female slave. But why would she target him without any apparent reason?

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 167: Fairy, Witch, All Are Ancestors_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 167: Fairy, Witch, All Are Ancestors_4
Translator: 549690339
Yun Miaoyi chuckled bitterly, “Husband, have you forgotten about Cui Pingyu? You killed him for Yiyin sister back then, secretly, and blamed it on the White Lotus Cult, framing Sister Xiangxiang. Yan Liulong is a man who holds grudges; he must have learned about this and seized the opportunity to capture you.”
“I guess she wants to take you back to the Hehuan Sect to properly ‘nourish’ herself,” she continued.
Having come from the Hehuan Sect herself, she naturally recognized the Sect Master Yan Liulong. The two had some connections and originally, Yan Liulong had looked after her quite a bit. Otherwise, she might have lost her innocence at the Hehuan Sect long ago.
After thinking it over, Yun Miaoyi looked at Han Li and said, “Husband, if possible, please treat her a little better.”
She knew that once Yan Liulong arrived, there was no going back; Han Li would not let her go. However, Yan Liulong was different from her, Jiang Baiye, and Lu Tianxiang. The three of them were all virgins, while Yan Liulong had harvested vitality from numerous cultivators.
The wives and concubines that Husband Han Li took were all virgins. Someone like Yan Liulong, who fell into the husband’s hands, would probably not be treated very well.
“Fine,” Han Li agreed directly, erasing the lowest tier.
He also thought that Yun Miaoyi must have owed Yan Liulong a favor; after all, Yun Miaoyi was once the enchantress of the Hehuan Sect, likely fostered and taken care of by Yan Liulong.
Yun Miaoyi was his wife, whom Han Li also loved deeply. Since Yun Miaoyi had requested it, Han Li naturally agreed. It was also the first time Yun Miaoyi had made such a request to him.
It wasn’t a big deal anyway, just not making Yan Liulong a female slave. Being a servant concubine would be okay, just like that Fairy Li.
Now, Fairy Li had been well trained by him, completely taking on his old ancestor’s demeanor, obedient to every word. Next would be the witch Yan Liulong.
Yan Liulong was none other than the Sect Master of the Hehuan Sect, and a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. Taming such a witch should be even more gratifying, he thought.
With that in mind, Han Li instantly appeared above Yan Liulong with Yun Miaoyi, covering a radius of ten thousand miles with his Spiritual Sense to prevent any noise from leaking out. Then his enormous hand pressed down, and a Yin and Yang Palm Seal descended upon Yan Liulong.
In mid-flight, Yan Liulong’s face turned white with shock. Why was she suddenly under attack? Moreover, the attacker was using a Yin and Yang Palm Seal. Could it be that there was a powerful figure in the Sect wanting to eliminate her in secret within Da Qian?
With no time to think further, Yan Liulong circulated her cultivation technique, summoning all the Gang Yuan in her body, and slapped out with her palm, sending a Yin and Yang Palm Seal shooting forth.
She had practiced the Yin and Yang Palm Seal for many years and had already perfected it. With the assailant’s Palm Seal merely reaching significant completion, she should have been able to block it, right?
Thinking this, Yan Liulong unleashed several more martial arts techniques and even summoned her weapon, preparing to activate it.
What she didn’t expect was for the unremarkable Yin and Yang Palm Seal from the opponent to utterly shatter her own Seal, instantly erasing the several subsequent attacks she had released.
Yan Liulong’s face turned deathly pale in an instant, realizing that this was the power of an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm. Otherwise, the disparity between them could not have been so vast.
“Which honored one…”
Before Yan Liulong could finish her sentence, the Yin and Yang Palm Seal struck her, inflicting severe injuries and sealing her cultivation.
Without her cultivation, the powerless Yan Liulong plummeted toward the ground. Her face was extremely unsightly, filled with immense regret. If only she had known, she never would have come.
Han Li waved his hand gently, and Yan Liulong immediately flew towards him, caught in his left arm around her lush and delicate waist.
“Han Li?”
When she saw the face of the person who had captured her, Yan Liulong was shocked and could hardly believe it.
Wasn’t Han Li a God Refining Realm cultivator? How had he become an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm?
Her expression darkened further, filled with regret. Why had she been so foolish as to trouble Han Li?

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 168: How to Play High-Level Matches Without a Smurf Account? The Patriarch Takes Another Concubine_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 168: How to Play High-Level Matches Without a Smurf Account? The Patriarch Takes Another Concubine_1
Translator: 549690339
Yan Liulong’s mature and charming face was full of shock and bewilderment. She was at a loss, seriously suspecting that she had mistaken the person before her.
Leizhou had not seen a warrior of the True Martial Realm for three thousand years, so how had she happened to encounter one?
As her thoughts whirled, Yan Liulong considered two possibilities. The first was that Han Li had always been at the True Martial Realm, pretending to be at the God Refining Realm, deliberately baiting a trap—he was too cunning and deceitful.
The second was that this person was not Han Li but someone else impersonating him.
Suddenly, a thought flashed through Yan Liulong’s mind, and she blurted out, “Are you Li Feiyu?”
She felt certain she was right—that Han Li was just a false identity used by Li Feiyu. The True Martial Realm couldn’t just pop up out of nowhere; it was usually old monsters.
In the Xuan Domain, there were only so many at the True Martial Realm; within the Daqian Empire, there were currently only two, Da Qian’s ancestral master Chu Zhenxiong and the manor lord of The Li Manor, Li Feiyu.
Han Li was greedy for feminine beauty, madly taking in concubines. Li Feiyu was the same, and the first time he appeared, it was to save Tianxuan Mountain.
The outside world thought Li Feiyu was truly grateful, that the founding ancestral master of Tianxuan Mountain had once helped him. Now it seemed this was not the case at all. The false identity of Han Li was a disciple of Tianxuan Mountain. Li Feiyu was strong enough to help on a whim.
“It looks like the old concubine-collecting ancestor hasn’t changed after all,” Yan Liulong muttered to herself.
Han Li was the former concubine-collecting ancestor, and Li Feiyu the current one, but no one knew they were the same person.
At most, people might think the two were related, perhaps Han Li was a descendant of Li Feiyu. They would not consider them to be the same person—the gap in their cultivation was too vast.
Information about Han Li was easy to obtain. He was only a little over two hundred years old, having reached the Innate Realm just decades ago. It was impossible for him to cultivate to the True Martial Realm so quickly.
Advancing to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, the True Martial Realm, was exceedingly difficult. Those who were gurus in the Void Realm and grandmasters in the Myriad Phenomena Realm knew all too well, as if there was an insurmountable gulf blocking them, preventing this crucial step forward.
Yan Liulong was also acutely aware of this. With her Fourth Grade talent, she had been at the peak of the Hollow Realm for many years. If not for her recent significant achievements and the rewards she received, she wouldn’t know how much longer it would have taken to break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Had she not come looking for trouble with Han Li, only to be attacked and subdued by this man, she wouldn’t have had this speculation.
Yet, deep down she had another guess—that Li Feiyu was Han Li’s false identity. Though both were the same person, the implications were utterly different.
One was pretending to be an old monster while the other a minor cultivator, each bringing a completely different shock to people.
Yan Liulong didn’t believe it. She’d rather believe that Li Feiyu was the true entity.
“You’re quite clever,” Han Li laughed but offered no explanation.
Li Feiyu was him, and Han Li was him as well—the names were just code. He could also be called Ye Fan, Shi Hao, Zhong Yue, or Jiang Nan.
These days, who doesn’t have several aliases?
How do you play high-end games without an alternate account?
Yan Liulong’s expression turned bitter. What did guessing right amount to when she could not escape from Li Feiyu’s grasp?
She thought capturing Han Li would be easy upon entering the Qian Dynasty, that it would be effortless. She left without making much preparation.
Yan Liulong then thought that even if she had reserved some tricks, it would have been useless. If her master came to rescue her, it would only endanger the master as well.
Though the Yinyang Sect still had another True Martial Realm warrior, Dugu Bing, they stood no chance against Li Feiyu. Dugu Bing had already been gravely injured by Li Feiyu’s few sword strikes, and with her cultivation now declined, it was likely a one-way trip.
“Sect Master.”
At that moment, the voice of Yun Miaoyi brought Yan Liulong back to reality. She then noticed someone beside Li Feiyu, who had been so captivating and shocking that she had completely missed the other presence.
“Miaoyi? How come you are here?”
Yan Liulong mumbled dully, looking back and forth between Li Feiyu and Yun Miaoyi, who was in his embrace.
“Have you been captured by Li Feiyu too?”
Yan Liulong felt certain this must be the case. No wonder there had been no news from Yun Miaoyi for half a year; she had fallen into the hands of Li Feiyu. She saw her own fate in Yun Miaoyi.
As a fellow enchantress, she feared she would be the next Yun Miaoyi.
“Sort of,” said Yun Miaoyi with a sigh, looking at the shocked Yan Liulong. “My husband will not be too harsh on you.”
“Husband?” Yan Liulong’s pupils constricted, but just as she was about to speak, she found herself unable to open her mouth.
Han Li was no longer interested in listening to her talk. He took Yun Miaoyi and Yan Liulong back to Chengdao Peak, entrusted Yan Liulong to a maid, and then continued spending time with Yun Miaoyi.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Yun Miaoyi hesitated before asking, “Husband, what do you intend to do with her?”
“Let’s make her a servant concubine,” said Han Li nonchalantly.
“But Yan Liulong is a great grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and she’s so seductive and mature. Can you really bear it?” Yun Miaoyi tried to persuade him.
She had thought that even if her husband didn’t give Yan Liulong the status of a wife, he would at least give her the status of a concubine. She hadn’t expected her to become just a servant concubine.
Being a servant concubine meant having no title, no status—a noble sect master and grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, reduced to just a servant concubine. That was too sorrowful.
“She is different from you,” Han Li shook his head.
While Yan Liulong was indeed a mature and stunning beauty, she was a practitioner of the Collection and Supplement Method, infamous for her allure. Han Li had no desire to be her successor.
Had it not been for Yun Miaoyi’s plea, acting on the principle of not wasting resources, Han Li would merely have intended to make Yan Liulong a female servant, useful enough for procreation, to breed in abundance.
Female servants did not require much attention; the more they bred, the better. With Yan Liulong’s high talent, she could produce a large number of offspring with decent potential.
Yun Miaoyi pursed her lips and sighed without further persuasion.
She understood Han Li’s point. Yan Liulong’s past reputation had ruined her prospects. If she were just a mature and beautiful woman, with Yan Liulong’s talent and cultivation, she believed her husband would have accepted her.

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - 168: How to Play High-Level Matches Without a Smurf Account? The Patriarch Takes Another Concubine_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 168: How to Play High-Level Matches Without a Smurf Account? The Patriarch Takes Another Concubine_2
Translator: 549690339
Even if he couldn’t marry a wife, he could still take her as a concubine.
Although Yan Liulong could only be a servant concubine, Yun Miaoyi felt relieved in her heart, partly because she had repaid a kindness, and partly because she realized that her husband was very selective.
Only virgins like her, Jiang Baiye, Gongsun Yue, and Lu Tianxiang could become wives, while women like Li Mingmeng and Lin Yiwu, who were inferior in terms of talents, appearance, and cultivation, could only be concubines.
For someone like Yan Liulong, it was already good to be a servant concubine, but one still needed high cultivation, talents, and beauty; otherwise, the husband might kill her outright.
The husband, although lustful, seemed to select carefully, and the standards for taking concubines had risen in recent years. Those with Eighth or Ninth Grade talents and good looks were no longer taken as concubines.
After nibbling on Yun Miaoyi for a while, Han Li returned to the Li Manor, dealt with some matters, spent time with many concubines, and then returned to Han Mansion.
After having pleasant fun with beautiful wives and concubines like Jiang Baiye, Lu Tianxiang, Lin Yiyin, and Liu Yuexin, it was already the time when the golden crow sank in the west and the jade rabbit hung high in the sky.
Only then did Han Li leisurely go to meet the Devil Princess, Yan Liulong.
In a small courtyard on Chengdao Peak, Yan Liulong, washed clean and fragrant by the maids, had already changed into a specially made cool dress.
Yan Liulong paced back and forth in the bedroom, feeling somewhat restless and helpless. She took a deep breath, trying to calm herself, but she couldn’t.
She had thought a lot during that time.
Yun Miaoyi called Li Feiyu “husband,” which indicated that she was Li Feiyu’s wife or concubine. Seeing Li Feiyu come out with Yun Miaoyi, looking very affectionate, it was very likely that Yun Miaoyi was Li Feiyu’s wife.
She felt that with Yun Miaoyi’s talents, beauty, cultivation, and means, it was very possible for her to become Li Feiyu’s formal wife.
What about herself? What identity would she live under?
After all, she was a Great Grandmaster of Myriad Phenomena Realm. Her talents and beauty were not inferior to Yun Miaoyi’s. The positions she knew, and the various means of serving others, were not something a young girl like Yun Miaoyi could compare with. At the very least, she should also be a concubine.
Yan Liulong knew she had little chance of becoming Li Feiyu’s wife, given her insufficient innate qualities. If it were her second venture, there might have been a possibility, but she was far from that now.
Yan Liulong’s psychological expectation was to be a concubine, aspire to be a wife, and at the very least, be a servant concubine.
If she could become a concubine of Han Li, that would be quite good. Her cultivation might be unsealed, and she could use Han Li’s resources to cultivate to a higher realm.
She certainly did not want to be someone’s cauldron or female slave; that would be worse than death.
As the Sect Master of the Hehuan Sect, she had many cauldrons before and knew how miserable the fate of a cauldron could be. She just never thought that she would face such a day.
It had always been her who harvested others; now, she might be harvested by someone stronger.
Thinking of this, Yan Liulong felt a wave of misery. If she had swallowed her pride in the past and not thought of capturing Han Li to harvest, she wouldn’t have ended up like this.
Although it was still harvesting, it wasn’t her harvesting Han Li, but Han Li harvesting her.
As for a swift death? Yan Liulong hadn’t considered that. She had just advanced to Myriad Phenomena Realm and still had six or seven hundred years of life left. She couldn’t bear to die.
Looking down at the cool dress she was wearing, Yan Liulong stuck out her little fragrant tongue and licked her lips, deciding to serve Han Li well later in hopes of better treatment.
There was no chance of escape, and she did not want to die; since she was going to live, she had to live well.
When Han Li appeared, he found that Yan Liulong approached him with great initiative and enthusiasm, beginning to serve him on her own accord.
“Oh ho, are Devil Princesses so self-aware? Is this tamed successfully before we even start?” Han Li mused in his heart.
The Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi had also changed very quickly, pleasing Han Li immensely and holding a high place in his heart.
Although the Devil Princess Yan Liulong was very proactive, Han Li still issued various commands. Compared to a mature Devil Princess, he preferred those who were tamed to become his people.
Yan Liulong followed the orders completely, and even though Han Li had made up his mind, she was confident that with her means, she could definitely make Han Li change his mind and give her better treatment.
With the active cooperation of Yan Liulong, Han Li felt very satisfied in just half an hour. Yan Liulong perfectly obeyed every command, satisfying Han Li’s sense of achievement.
He decided that when he had the chance, he must let the Fairy and the Devil Princess compete with each other, making the taming process seem more enjoyable.
Various thoughts flashing through his mind, Han Li showed an expression of satisfaction. Truth be told, the services of the Devil Princess Yan Liulong were really spot on, and she often took initiative in ways that matched his desires.
After a while, Han Li could no longer resist and picked up the Devil Princess, Yan Liulong, to spend a wonderful night.
The next day, Yan Liulong woke up and, seeing that there was no one beside her, harbored considerable resentment towards Han Li. He really didn’t know how to cherish and appreciate the delicacy and beauty of women.
“Sigh~”
After a long relaxation, Yan Liulong suddenly sighed with a complex expression.
She had been so proactive last night, serving Han Li well, and it was evident from Han Li’s expression.
But still, the bastard Han Li only gave her the status of a servant concubine. He had a heart of stone, with no consideration for her feelings.
“Next time, I’ll definitely show you,” Yan Liulong muttered.
Although she only received the worst outcome she had anticipated, Yan Liulong did not give up. She intended to make more efforts later and continually strive for better; she simply didn’t believe that that bastard Han Li wouldn’t give in.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - 168: How to Play High-Level Matches Without a Smurf Account? The Patriarch Takes Another Concubine_3
chapters.content:
