Chapter 239: Chapter 168: How to Play High-Level Matches Without a Smurf Account? The Patriarch Takes Another Concubine_3
Translator: 549690339
After tidying up, Yan Liulong, bearing the soreness, walked out of the courtyard. The beautiful scenery of Chengsheng Mountain lifted her spirits a bit, but upon seeing those stunning beauties admiring the scenery, her mood soured again, and she even felt somewhat dejected and inferior.
Judging from the attire of those beauties, they must be Han Li’s wives and concubines. A look of envy appeared in Yan Liulong’s eyes.
She had previously read some reports about Han Li, and had also seen information about his concubines; only his wives’ information was not available and was strictly protected.
These concubines all had low aptitudes and even lower cultivations. In terms of beauty, temperament, and even their postures, none of them compared to her. Yet, they were concubines, and she was merely a servant concubine, with no status whatsoever in their presence.
“Sigh~”
Yan Liulong sighed again and silently walked back to her courtyard, giving up on the idea of looking for Yun Miaoyi.
Chengdao Peak was so large, and without any cultivation, coupled with her sore body, how could it be easy to find Yun Miaoyi?
Besides, even if she found Yun Miaoyi, it would be of no use. Yun Miaoyi couldn’t change Han Li’s mind, otherwise she wouldn’t just be a servant concubine.
“Everything depends on myself.”
On the other side, in the Da Qian Li Manor.
After leaving Yan Liulong that morning, Han Li went to find Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Zhang Yuyan, Zhou Zhiruo, and the other tender wives and beautiful concubines.
Currently, only four wives in Han Mansion, including Yun Miaoyi and Gongsun Yue, knew that he was Li Feiyu. The other beauties were unaware and hadn’t noticed.
The concubines thought that if Han Li wasn’t with them, he was with other concubines, or attending to his four wives. They never imagined their lord was hiding beauties in golden houses in the capital city of Da Qian and opening another manor to take in concubines.
The concubines in the Li Manor felt the same way. Beauties such as Li Qingqing and Die Yi didn’t dare to inquire about Li Feiyu’s whereabouts, only hoping that their lord would spend more time with them. When he didn’t come, they cultivated on their own or gathered in groups.
Han Li stood atop the Chong Xiao Pavilion, looking down at the capital city of Da Qian, calculating the time in his mind.
It had been several months since the Dragon Maiden opened the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm and took the Dragon Ball, trapping several True Martial Realm cultivators inside. There was less than a year and a half before they would emerge.
When the time came, he would be able to act and recapture the Demon Queen. Han Li had been longing for the Demon Queen for quite a while.
Although he had already tasted two true demon women, Fang Yousi and Bi Xinlei, these two demon women couldn’t compare to the Demon Queen.
Despite it being just a fleeting glimpse, the Demon Queen had left a deep impression on Han Li. Her enchanting wildness was something none of his tender wives and beautiful concubines possessed.
What’s more, the Demon Queen was also of the True Martial Realm, and most likely of Third-Grade aptitude, all of which made Han Li even more eager for her.
He couldn’t wait to capture the Demon Queen and show her the strength of Elder Han.
Han Li’s spiritual sense surged out, covering the Da Qian capital city while deliberately avoiding the Imperial Palace; he didn’t want to provoke Chu Dingqian, that old geezer.
Ever since confirming that Chu Zhenxiong was Chu Dingqian’s second incarnation, Han Li’s killing intent towards Chu Dingqian had deepened. Chu Dingqian had lived for thousands of years after splintering Da Jing to create Da Qian, and was extremely cunning.
But even after he proposed so many conditions and squeezed a quarter of the Qian Dynasty’s essence in one breath, Chu Dingqian actually agreed without much hesitation.
There’s definitely a problem. That old thing might be thinking of reincarnating and, after cultivating to the True Martial Realm, coming back to settle the score with me. By then I might not know Chu Dingqian’s third life’s identity and could very well be taken by surprise.
Moreover, Han Li coveted the Soul-Cultivating Furnace in Chu Dingqian’s possession, which made his murderous intent toward Chu Dingqian even stronger.
Last time, when he tested Chu Dingqian by killing off the State Preceptor’s lineage, he could clearly sense the deeply hidden murderous intent within Chu Dingqian. Han Li knew that if he tried to provoke and test him again, Chu Dingqian might not be able to hold back.
Han Li didn’t want to disrupt the current situation, as he didn’t have the strength to fully control everything yet. So, he was waiting, waiting for his own breakthrough to the True Martial Realm.
Chu Dingqian was waiting too, but the time Chu Dingqian needed was far more than what Han Li needed—hundreds of years more.
Han Li had no intention of letting Chu Dingqian successfully reincarnate. When the breakthrough to the True Martial Realm was achieved, when the timing was right, and the preparations were complete, he could assassinate Chu Dingqian and seize the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
Otherwise, if he waited for Chu Dingqian to reincarnate, the Soul-Cultivating Furnace would no longer be obtainable. At that time, if Chu Dingqian saw his strength was too formidable, he would definitely flee far away to avoid Han Li’s edge, and the chance to get the Soul-Cultivating Furnace would really be gone.
Without the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, the Life-Prolonging Furnace hidden in Chengsheng Mountain wouldn’t be attainable either—and that is a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon.
Han Li was almost certain that it was indeed the Life-Prolonging Furnace. Only such top-tier Sacred Weapons and Great Saintly Weapons could continuously absorb spiritual energy for more than a hundred thousand years. A mere Heaven Rank Supreme Grade Body-Cultivating Furnace was still not capable of doing that.
Once his Spiritual Sense covered the Capital City of the Daqian, Han Li continued to expand outward. His Spiritual Sense was strong, comparable to the second level of the True Martial Realm, with a maximum coverage range of six hundred thousand miles.
Yuanzhou was the biggest province of the Daqian Empire, spanning a million miles. Han Li’s Spiritual Sense could cover more than half of it, allowing him to uncover the information he sought.
After a while, Han Li withdrew his Spiritual Sense, a smile emerging on his face.
He had scoured the Capital City of Daqian and most of Yuanzhou several times, thoroughly investigating all high-quality female cultivators and those of medium quality.
Even if these exceptional women or princesses hid within Formations, the mere Fourth Grade Formations couldn’t block Han Li’s probing, and they didn’t even notice it.
He also heard many rumors. These forces were intimidated by his annihilation of the State Preceptor’s lineage and his boldness in seizing Fairy Li. Initially, they had thought to send their exceptional daughters within their power to be his wives and concubines.
However, the officials of the Daqian forcefully debunked the rumors and conveyed Han Li’s previous explanation to Chu Dingqian, causing all parties to cease their actions and choose to wait and see.
This left Han Li somewhat disappointed. Although he had not intended for this, he would have been quite happy to see this situation unfold.
A few days later, the Master of The Li Manor announced that he would take in concubines again—this time three beauties, all of whom were well-known noble ladies in the Capital City.
These three concubines had different temperaments; some were pure and aloof, others dignified and noble, and still others playful and cute. Their appearances were quite pleasing, all scoring over eighty-seven in terms of beauty.
Zhou Xuan had a Fifth-grade aptitude, her cultivation reaching the late stage of the Gangyuan Realm. Guo Le and Du Feifei had Sixth-grade aptitudes, their cultivation only at the early stage of the Gangyuan Realm.
The three women were all quite young, not even fifty, which is unheard of for their aptitudes, but they came from powerful families.
Thus, Han Li directly took them as his concubines.

chapters.title: Chapter 240 - 169: The Six Harmonies and Eight Desolations Fist, Eighth Level Combat Ability of True Martial Realm, Undying Golden Body!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 169: The Six Harmonies and Eight Desolations Fist, Eighth Level Combat Ability of True Martial Realm, Undying Golden Body!_1
Translator: 549690339
In the blink of an eye, another month had passed.
After being busy at Han Mansion, Han Li arrived at Li Manor.
This month, Patriarch Han took in three more concubines, six in a month, making the outside world click their tongues in secret admiration. The owner of Li Manor was truly fierce.
All six concubines were exceptionally beautiful and of different temperaments, like Spring orchids and Autumn chrysanthemums, each with their own allure. Once they had married over, Patriarch Han diligently cultivated his fertile soil.
Through Patriarch Han’s relentless efforts, all six beauties were pregnant with offspring, which made Han Li extraordinarily delighted.
He had quite a few pregnant concubines recently, even Yan Liulong and Li Na, these two servant concubines, were expecting, and in just over half a year, he would be blessed with numerous progeny.
One day, Patriarch Han was standing atop Chong Xiao Pavilion, seated on a stool while the servant concubine Fairy Li served him with reverence on her knees in front.
As Patriarch Han savored the service, he checked the system panel, where two days ago the number of talented offspring had reached 299. He estimated it would reach three hundred in the next few days.
Although his beloved wives and beautiful concubines were not birthing children these days, Patriarch Han had many offspring, and new babies were being born over these days.
After Han Li had thoroughly enjoyed himself, he noticed the number on the panel jump, changing to 300, and at the same time, a system notification rang in his mind.
“The number of your progeny with cultivation talents has reached three hundred, you’ve gained a hundred years of cultivation, you’ve obtained five Fifth Grade Longevity Pills, you’ve gained a hundred years of artifact refining experience, and you’ve obtained a Heaven Rank Lower Grade Martial Art, ‘Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Fist’.”
Han Li glanced at the notification, his face suddenly showing elation. Fairy Li thought it was due to her and redoubled her efforts.
Han Li paid no attention to her, his thoughts entirely on the rewards he’d just received, a sense of joy overwhelming him.
In terms of cultivation, he was still rewarded with a hundred years, which meant his accumulated cultivation had increased significantly, bringing him closer to advancing to the True Martial Realm.
The amount of Fifth Grade Longevity Pill increased from three to five. These pills were extremely useful, as one could extend the life of a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage by fifty years, up to a maximum of three, and extend the life of a Great Grandmaster in the Myriad Phenomena Realm by twenty years, even an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm could extend their lifespan by ten years.
Indeed, the value of the Fifth Grade Longevity Pill was extraordinarily high, but Han Li didn’t need them. Instead, they could be bestowed upon his cherished wives and powerful offspring, and with his current strength, no one dared covet the Fifth Grade Longevity Pills in his hands.
The first time he obtained a hundred years of alchemy experience, the second time was a hundred years of talisman making experience, but this time it was a hundred years of artifact refining experience. Han Li suspected the next reward would be a hundred years of formation experience, although he had no evidence to back this up.
Originally, he was a top Seventh Grade Artifact Refining Master in the field of artifact refining, but with this hundred years of artifact refining experience, he could reach the same level as he achieved in alchemy, that of an ordinary Fifth Grade Artifact Refining Master.
A Fifth Grade Artifact Refining Master could forge weapons suitable for the Hollow Void Stage, namely Earth Rank Lower and Middle Grade Treasures. Han Li, being an ordinary Fifth Grade Artifact Refining Master, was unable to forge Middle Grade Earth Rank Treasures, but he was capable of producing Lower Grade Earth Rank Treasures.
Han Li felt this was very satisfactory. Once he crafted a large number of Earth Rank Lower Grade Magical Treasures, the offspring at Han Mansion wouldn’t lack weapons to wield.
Weapons were, after all, one of the crucial components of combat ability. The stronger the weapon, the more it could enhance a cultivator’s combat ability.
Han Li closed his eyes, and while basking in the pleasure, he claimed the hundred years of artifact refining experience and spent some time absorbing and digesting it.
“Huff~”
Han Li exhaled a breath, assimilating the numerous artifact refining knowledge and experiences into his mind quickly, thanks to the strength of his Divine Spirit.
He reached out and patted Fairy Li’s head, who obediently looked up at him. Patriarch Han motioned for her to continue before Han Li began to examine the final reward.
Heaven Rank Lower Grade Martial Art: Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Fist!
This reward was the most surprising for Han Li, as it was the first time he had obtained a Heaven Rank martial technique that would greatly enhance his strength.
Although he had acquired some Heaven Rank martial techniques from Chu Dingqian, which were very powerful, Han Li had not practiced them.
To train a Heaven Rank martial art to a great success or perfect level required decades or even a century, a length of time that was beyond Han Li’s patience.
With the rate at which his offspring advanced, he would soon acquire Heaven Rank martial techniques directly at the perfect level. For instance, the Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Fist he had just received.
It hadn’t even been a year since he had gained Heaven Rank martial techniques from Chu Dingqian, and at most, he could have trained them to a beginner level. Yet what use was a beginner level Heaven Rank martial art? It couldn’t compare to the Earth-Level Extreme Martial Arts he had mastered to the perfect level.
The Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Fist was just the beginning. As the number of talented offspring reached four hundred, five hundred, or even more, he would receive more Heaven Rank martial techniques, and their grades would gradually increase.
This was only one of the channels to acquire perfect-level Heaven Rank martial arts. Another channel was the total number of offspring rewards.
When the offspring count reached eight hundred, Han Li obtained the Earth-grade Superior Martial Art ‘Divine Movement Nine Heavens’. He estimated that when the offspring count reached nine hundred, he would obtain a Supreme Grade Earth-Level martial technique.
Once the number of offspring surpassed one thousand, he would definitely obtain a Heaven Rank martial technique, and possibly other generous rewards. After all, the offspring count would have advanced by a significant tier, moving from tens to hundreds, and from hundreds to thousands.
With the current number of offspring at 897, Han Li estimated that in another ten days to half a month, the count would officially hit nine hundred, by which time he could verify his conjecture.
All thoughts processed, Han Li directly claimed the Heaven Rank Lower Grade martial technique, Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Fist.
In an instant, a scroll of golden scriptures appeared in Han Li’s mind, then burst forth like a cosmic big bang, revealing myriad profound martial insights, secrets of martial arts, and the complete training experiences of the Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Fist, along with numerous demonstration images of the technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - 169: The Six Harmonies and Eight Desolations Fist, Eighth Level Combat Ability of True Martial Realm, Undying Golden Body!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 169: The Six Harmonies and Eight Desolations Fist, Eighth Level Combat Ability of True Martial Realm, Undying Golden Body!_2
Translator: 549690339
Even though Han Li’s Divine Spirit was incredibly strong, comparable to the second level of the True Martial Realm, it still took him a full five breaths of time to receive and integrate a martial art of the Heaven Rank Lower Grade at the perfection level.
Only after he had fully mastered the Six Harmonies and Eight Extremes Fist did Han Li realize how powerful this martial art was. There were only three moves in total: Fist Dominates Six Harmonies, Horizontal Push of Eight Extremes, and Shattering of Heaven and Earth.
Each move was grand and majestic, requiring one to have the audacity to sweep across the Six Harmonies, horizontally push the Eight Extremes, and suppress everything under the heavens. With one punch, it was irresistible, as if facing an entire world, squarely crushing the opponent.
Han Li was very fond of the Six Harmonies and Eight Extremes Fist. Although he was a practitioner of the way of survival, he also aspired to one day fear nothing and be able to push across the nine heavens and ten lands, suppress the Six Harmonies and Eight Extremes, and shatter everything.
Even if his true self was not suitable for using it at the moment, he could use this technique to create a new persona, which would be incredibly powerful, becoming the strongest among many personas in terms of combat ability.
The Six Harmonies and Eight Extremes Fist was originally a martial technique of Heaven Rank Lower Grade, but under the augmentation of Han Li’s nascent true meaning of all-around martial arts, it was almost elevated by three grades, infinitely close to a martial technique of Heaven Rank Supreme Grade.
Moreover, what Han Li had mastered was a martial technique at the perfection level, and it was infinitely close to the martial art of Heaven Rank Supreme Grade. How strong would it be when he threw a punch?
Han Li made a preliminary estimate. The might of it was far stronger than wielding the Dragon Abyss Sword and executing the Heaven-Sealing Sword Canon. He could unleash the combat ability of the seventh level of the True Martial Realm, which was already the late stage of the True Martial Realm.
Previously, when he stimulated his Divine Sense and held the Dragon Abyss Sword to execute the Heaven-Sealing Sword Canon, he also possessed the combat ability of the seventh level of the True Martial Realm, but it lasted very shortly, only nine seconds, and even with intermittent use, only a maximum of 24 seconds.
But now, with the Six Harmonies and Eight Extremes Fist, his combat ability steadily stepped into the seventh level of the True Martial Realm. Should he stimulate his Divine Sense again, that combat ability could enter the eighth level of the True Martial Realm.
Han Li was exceedingly pleased with this. There were only two or three kings in the Xuan Domain who were in the late stages of the True Martial Realm, and whether there were even three was questionable.
His strength now likely ranked him among the top three in the Xuan Domain, and even when considered within the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, he would still rank very highly.
The only ones before him were those powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm, the Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm, and the prodigies of the late True Martial Realm, all of whom were exceedingly rare.
Han Li doubted if there were even five powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm in the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, and were there twenty Emperor Wu in the Divine Yuan Realm?
“Fantastic!”
Han Li double-entendred and petted the chestnut Fairy’s head again; she had already been thoroughly tamed by him.
After the surge in strength, Han Li wanted to go out and revel, but in the end, he restrained himself and continued to keep a low profile; his current strength still wasn’t sufficient.
Han Li stayed in The Li Manor a while longer before returning to Han Mansion.
This time, he headed straight for the Artifact Refining Peak.
Having obtained a hundred years of artifact refining experience, Han Li had transformed into a Fifth Grade Artifact Refining Master; he was not there to refine Earth Rank Lower Grade Magical Treasures for Han Mansion despite having the blueprints.
Previously, Han Li had an idea to create several masks for his personas to better conceal his identity.
Although he could change his appearance and shield his face with the Power of the Divine Spirit, if he encountered someone far stronger than himself, he would still be seen through.
But if he used masks with unique properties, then his ability to hide his face would be greatly enhanced. Although he could only refine Earth-Level Lower Rank concealment masks, paired with his mental strength, it would be very difficult for those in the late True Martial Realm to see through.
Once his realm advanced to the True Martial Realm and his Power of the Divine Spirit surged, along with the masks, no one below the Divine Yuan Realm would be able to see through him, unless he encountered a freak with a Divine Spirit on par with an Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Thinking it over, he did it. Han Li took out a large amount of precious refining material that could be used to refine weapons of the Myriad Phenomena Realm level, even materials of the True Martial Realm level, specifically to forge a few masks that would enhance his concealment ability.
The masks didn’t require blueprints. Han Li was a Fifth Grade Artifact Refining Master, so he sketched several mask designs in his mind and began refining.
After being busy for more than an hour, Han Li finally refined the masks; there were five in total, all of which were Earth Rank Lower Grade Magical Treasures. However, because of the materials used, they had an effect close to Earth Rank Top Grade in terms of concealment.
Although he could have created seven or eight personas, the elder Han Li found that he probably wouldn’t need that many, so for now he crafted five masks, which should be enough; if not, he could always refine more.
Having sorted these out, Han Li then spent his time with a large group of beloved wives and concubines, occasionally playing some fun games. With the participation of many stunningly beautiful women, Han Li’s joy was heightened.
While Elder Han was living a life of bliss, one by one, his offspring were being born.
Twelve days later, while Han Li was watching the sunset on Chengdao Peak, by his side were Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye, both embraced in his arms, one on each side.
Yun Miaoyi was on the left, dressed in a black robe, while Jiang Baiye was on the right, in a white robe, both matching their respective temperaments.
Yun Miaoyi, because she was still pregnant, had not been practicing cultivation, while Jiang Baiye, having given birth to Han Yongjiang, had recovered and started practicing cultivation a few days before.
Since Han Li had obtained several Heaven Rank cultivation techniques and martial skills from Chu Dingqian, Jiang Baiye had finally decided to switch her primary cultivation technique and changed from Canghai Sect’s dominant cultivation technique to the Han Family’s clan-defining cultivation technique, the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture.
One notable aspect was that the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture had an integration feature. Using it as the primary cultivation technique, one could practice other techniques and then integrate them into the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, which would enhance its grade.

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - 169: The Six Harmonies and Eight Desolations Fist, Eighth Level Combat Ability of True Martial Realm, Undying Golden Body!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 169: The Six Harmonies and Eight Desolations Fist, Eighth Level Combat Ability of True Martial Realm, Undying Golden Body!_3
Translator: 549690339
The grade of the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture varies from person to person and depends on how many powerful cultivation techniques a cultivator integrates into it.
Besides the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, Han Mansion also possesses three Heaven Rank cultivation techniques, including one Top Grade Heaven Rank, one Middle Grade Heaven Rank, and one Lower Grade Heaven Rank.
Jiang Baiye decided to cultivate all three other Heaven Rank cultivation techniques of Han Mansion in addition to her original technique, and then gradually integrate them into the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, including her previously primary cultivation technique.
In doing so, the grade of her Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture would greatly increase, and she estimated it would approach that of a Supreme Grade Heaven Rank cultivation technique.
With the higher grade of the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, her cultivation speed would also improve. Coupled with the top-grade spirit stones given by Han Li, Jiang Baiye was confident she could advance to the Hollow Void Stage within three years and become a Master-level powerhouse.
It wasn’t just Jiang Baiye with this plan. Yun Miaoyi and Gongsun Yue had similar intentions, but since they were currently pregnant, they had to postpone their cultivation, which could only be delayed.
Han Li also wanted to do this. He planned to start cultivating other Heaven Rank cultivation techniques once he advanced to the True Martial Realm.
In terms of comprehension, he was not as good as Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, or even Gongsun Yue. His understanding of the omnipotent way of martial arts relied on the assistance of the system.
Han Li once tried to cultivate a Heaven Rank martial technique alongside his four wives, and they all grasped the basics ahead of him while he struggled, taking an extra month to get started.
Once he advanced to the True Martial Realm, cultivating Heaven Rank techniques would become much simpler. Then it wouldn’t be too late to cultivate additional techniques and integrate them into his Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture.
“So annoying, Jiang Baiye, you’ve actually advanced to the eightfold heaven of the God Refining Realm.” Yun Miaoyi pouted her red lips discontently.
She and Jiang Baiye had been rivals for decades, competing in everything, which led to their friendship. Even now, as wives of Han Li, Yun Miaoyi still wanted to compete with Jiang Baiye.
Although it was frowned upon to compete for favoritism, Yun Miaoyi wanted to surpass Jiang Baiye in strength to prove she was stronger.
But now, with Jiang Baiye at the eightfold heaven of the God Refining Realm and herself still in the latter stages of the sevenfold heaven, she was a few months away from giving birth and needed time to replenish her vitality and recover.
This gap would only widen, and Yun Miaoyi was reluctant to accept falling further behind.
“You, still competing with me now?” Jiang Baiye pointed a pale jade finger at Yun Miaoyi’s forehead and shook her head helplessly.
She too had a competitive spirit in the past, vying with Yun Miaoyi, but after marrying Han Li and giving birth to Han Yongjiang, Jiang Baiye’s interest in such competition had faded.
The reason she still strived in her cultivation wasn’t to outdo Yun Miaoyi, but to catch up with her husband, Han Li.
Her husband was already in the True Martial Realm, while she was still in the late stages of the God Refining Realm—how could that be acceptable?
She reminisced about their first encounter, which was not exactly pleasant, but their cultivation levels were similar, both in the God Refining Realm.
Yet, in just a few years, when she saw Han Li again, he was already in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and not long after marrying him, he progressed to the True Martial Realm, becoming Emperor Wu, whose fame shook the Daqian Empire.
In a few years, if her husband told her he had reached the Divine Yuan Realm, Jiang Baiye felt she wouldn’t even be surprised.
Ignoring her, Yun Miaoyi clung to Han Li’s hand and shook it vigorously, coquettishly saying, “Husband, look, she’s bullying me. You better take Jiang Baiye down a notch and try to get her to carry another one.”
“Pfft,” Jiang Baiye laughed, saying resignedly, “Yun Miaoyi, I never realized you could be so wicked before. That’s like sacrificing a thousand of your own troops to kill a thousand enemies.”
“If I have another one, then after you give birth, the husband will certainly want you to have another one too.”
Han Li found this amusing, “Haha, Jiang Jiang is right. I treat you all equally and will not show preference to one over the other,”
“I will work harder to have you all bear more children.”
“This… this…”
Yun Miaoyi fell silent at his words, her expression falling. She had shot herself in the foot.
She hadn’t even given birth to one yet, and her husband was already thinking of having her have several more. How could that be possible?
“No way, husband, you can’t do this,” Yun Miaoyi continued to act spoiled, signalling to Jiang Baiye with her eyes.
Jiang Baiye laughed and followed up, saying, “Husband, I don’t want to have another one for now. Let’s wait until I break through to the Hollow Void Stage.”
Han Li readily agreed, though internally he doubted. Once they were pregnant, he didn’t believe Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi would really want to abort the child.
Although he loved Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, it didn’t stop him from wanting them to bear children, as offspring from the two would have good potential and help improve Han Mansion’s bloodline.
After having a few, Han Li would no longer force them to continue, only if they actively wished for it or special circumstances arose would he consider providing his seed again.
This was the same situation for Lin Yiyin, Li Mingmeng, and Qiu Yueyao, among his beautiful concubines. After reaching four children, he did not pressure them further and focused on their cultivation efforts.
Han Li estimated that after some time, they themselves would request to have more children, as their previous progeny’s talents were too low.
Now, their talents would gradually reach Fourth Grade, and their cultivation levels would rise quickly; then, giving birth again, they could have offspring with Fourth Grade talent, or even Supreme Grade.
Although they didn’t say it, they were all quite envious of Jiang Baiye, Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue, whose talents were great, and with their husband’s talent increasing, they could produce highly talented children.
As for the servant concubines, Yan Liulong and Li Na, Han Li didn’t concern himself as much—let them give birth to their hearts’ content; after all, he would not be emotionally invested.

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 169: The Six Harmonies and Eight Desolations Fist, Eighth Level Combat Ability of True Martial Realm, Undying Golden Body!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 169: The Six Harmonies and Eight Desolations Fist, Eighth Level Combat Ability of True Martial Realm, Undying Golden Body!_4
Translator: 549690339
First, let’s set a small goal, for each of the two servant concubines to bear ten children.
Both of them possess Fourth Grade aptitude, and even though their cultivation has been sealed, their origins are far beyond that of ordinary people—any offspring they have won’t lack in talent.
“Husband~”
Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye called out at the same time, moved in their hearts. The more Han Li respected them, the more they adored him.
Han Li cradled their pretty faces, kissing each of them once, and continued to hold them as they admired the beautiful dusk.
Suddenly, a system notification sounded in Han Li’s mind.
“Your progeny have reached a total of nine hundred, you’ve gained fifty years of cultivation, nine Pihai Pills, five Gang Yuan Pills, and you’ve gained the Earth-Level Extreme Martial Technique [Undying Golden Body].”
Han Li took a brief look and his pupils constricted slightly, a smile involuntarily appearing on his face.
At last, at last a defensive martial technique had appeared! He had been anticipating this moment for a very long time.
This latest fifty-year increase added to his cultivation meant that Han Li now had more than three hundred and fifty years’ worth saved up—he felt that in at most another year, the number of his progeny would break a thousand.
Then, every one hundred offspring adding a hundred years of cultivation, he was only one hundred and fifty years away from advancing to the True Martial Realm. He wondered how many years of cultivation would be rewarded for a thousand offspring—A hundred years? Two hundred years?
As he had expected, once the number of offspring reached nine hundred, the reward had increased significantly. Two more Pihai Pills and an additional Gang Yuan Pill meant he could cultivate two more at the Pihai Realm and one more at the Gangyuan Realm.
The grade of the rewarded martial techniques had also risen from Heaven Rank Top Grade to Earth-Level Supreme Grade, and the defensive type was something Han Li very much needed. He believed that the grand prize for a thousand offspring would surely include Heaven Rank cultivation techniques and martial skills.
Once the number of offspring broke a thousand, the rate of increase thereafter would also climb. Han Li had a vague feeling that this could be a very lavish reward.
According to the system’s reward pattern, at the ten-stage, rewards were given at ten, twenty, thirty numbers and so on; at the hundred-stage, the rewards were at one hundred, two hundred, three hundred increments.
When it reached the thousand-stage, it probably required reaching two thousand, three thousand, four thousand thresholds to receive rewards. If the prizes weren’t rich enough, it would be too pitiful.
After spending more time with Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, the three of them departed from Chengdao Peak separately.
Han Li returned to his sleeping chamber and sat cross-legged, starting to claim the powerful Earth-Level Extreme Martial Technique, Undying Golden Body.
In roughly the span of a single breath, Han Li completely absorbed and digested the Undying Golden Body, mastering it to the complete level.
At this time, Han Li fully understood just how formidable the Undying Golden Body was.
It was a martial skill emphasizing defense while also incorporating bodily refinement as a secondary effect. Once cultivated to the complete level and activated, it would produce a golden body law form ten times larger than Han Li, capable of blocking all attacks—impervious to blades and spears, untouched by myriad laws.
Only those realms far surpassing Han Li could break his defense—extremely overpowered.
The body refining effect attached to the Undying Golden Body multiplied Han Li’s physical strength many times over, his power surged so much that he felt he could destroy the heavens, the earth, and the air with a single punch.
Of course, Han Li knew this was an illusion.
After the enhancement of Han Li’s embryonic form of the Omnipotent Martial Dao’s True Intent, the Undying Golden Body came infinitely close to the Heaven Rank High Grade Martial Technique, elevating Han Li’s defense to the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, impenetrable to anyone without late-stage True Martial Realm power.
His body was now equivalent to a body refining cultivator of the First Heaven in the True Martial Realm—extremely formidable, capable of suppressing everything with his physical body alone, even without utilizing True Yuan.
This is true domination!
The Muscular Immortal Sect is invincible!
Han Li was very pleased with his current strength; all of his weaknesses had been addressed.
Although he had not yet broken through to the True Martial Realm, his strength in various aspects was of the True Martial Realm level—some early stage, some mid-stage, and his strongest attack power had even reached late-stage True Martial Realm.
Han Li himself felt too overpowered. In his realm, he had long been invincible, with no one to match, at least within the Qianyuan Divine Province, Han Li had not yet found anyone who could rival him.
His current combat targets were Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, but ordinary Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm couldn’t even withstand a single strike from him—the gap was too large.
Han Li was already looking forward to his breakthrough to the True Martial Realm; there would be an overall improvement, and his Omnipotent Martial Dao’s True Intent would be further perfected, augmenting even more strength.
PS: Writing to this point, actually I have an idea for the next book, most likely it will be about extreme path flowing. It feels really cool, and the author is a fan of rolling out books too, wanting to write one in homage.
Deep Blue, add points!

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 170: The Widow of the State Preceptor Offers Herself to Feed the Demon, The Fragrant Sect Hierarch Reappears!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 170: The Widow of the State Preceptor Offers Herself to Feed the Demon, The Fragrant Sect Hierarch Reappears!_1
Translator: 549690339
Da Qian, The Li Manor.
After spending some time in Han Mansion, Han Li had returned to this place.
Looking at the bustling Capital City of Da Qian, Han Li felt time had passed quite quickly. It had almost been a year since The Li Manor was established, and Han Mansion had moved to Yonchang Manor in Yuanzhou several years ago.
When he left Leizhou, he was at the peak of the Hollow Realm, and now he was at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, on the verge of advancing to the True Martial Realm, with his combat ability even touching the eighth layer of the True Martial Realm.
Sometimes, Han Li found it somewhat unreal; the speed at which his cultivation improved was simply too fast, probably even surpassing those with First Grade talent.
But the powerful body and overwhelming strength told Han Li that all of this was real.
“Above First Grade talent, there should be even higher levels, right?” Han Li murmured to himself.
Theoretically, those with Third Grade talent are likely to cultivate to the True Martial Realm, Second Grade talents are likely to reach the God Refining Realm, and First Grade talents, if they don’t fall prematurely, can easily advance to the True Martial Realm and God Refining Realm, and have a great chance of reaching the Tongxuan Realm.
Above the Tongxuan Realm lie the Mortal Realm stages like the Sacred Abyss Realm, Heaven Imperial Realm, and beyond that is ascension, with realms like Heavenly Immortal and True Immortal in the Immortal Domain.
What level of talent is needed to have a great chance of cultivating to these realms?
It’s extremely difficult for someone with ordinary talent to advance, unless they are constantly blessed with opportunities, have auspicious destiny, and possess other special characteristics.
“Sigh~”
Han Li sighed. These pieces of information were all secret, and he had no access to them for the time being, but the Sacred Lands probably had records of this.
After all, in ancient times, Great Emperors and Heavenly Immortals had emerged from the Four Sacred Lands of Mortal World, so they must know these secrets. Han Li wanted to learn about them to set goals for himself.
What would be his own path after marrying a wife with First Grade talent, or if his talent reached First Grade?
From atop the Chong Xiao Pavilion, Han Li, with hands clasped behind his back, wearing a set of green clothes, took in the entire scenery of The Li Manor.
The inner manor already had over thirty concubines, and all of them were pregnant. Yet, Han Li was still not satisfied and wanted to marry more wives and concubines.
Only by continuously taking in concubines could he sire more offspring. Although his descendants were also rapidly expanding the family, Han Li was somewhat dissatisfied with the rate of propagation.
Moreover, the talents of the wives and concubines married into his family by his descendants were rather low, resulting in descendants with varying levels of talent, many without talent, or, even if they had talent, it wasn’t high.
Han Li needed more descendants with talent. This would give him talent feedback to improve his own talent, as well as rewards, which would strengthen the foundation of his two manors—it was a matter of killing several birds with one stone.
“Eh~”
Han Li’s Spiritual Sense swept over an area, showing an interested expression on his face.
Mentor’s Manor was currently facing unwelcome visitors.
A Late stage Void Realm Grandmaster, accompanied by several God Refining Realm true ones, was blocking the gate of Mentor’s Manor, speaking arrogantly and frivolously, which infuriated the widow of the State Preceptor.
The leading Hollow Realm Master looked at the mature and dignified beauty and said indifferently, “Madam, please come with us; let’s not make things difficult for each other.”
“If it comes to blows, it won’t be good for anyone, and it’ll affect your reputation as well. You wouldn’t want others knowing about this, would you?”
Lu Renyi’s gaze roamed unscrupulously over the mature beauty and occasionally glanced at a few charming beauties beside her, sighing inwardly.
The State Preceptor was really lucky to be able to possess these seven beauties, Lu Renyi envied him greatly. Each one was full of charm and grace, their allure left him drooling.
But he could only look; he was merely a scout. The one truly coveting the State Preceptor’s widows was not him but a significant figure behind him.
With good talent, cultivation, beauty, and figure, the State Preceptor’s widow was tempting to Lu Renyi, but he knew he wasn’t fortunate enough for her.
In the Capital City of Da Qian, there were many beautiful female cultivators with excellent talent and beauty that the figure behind him didn’t care for. Lu Renyi surmised that the figure probably wanted a change of pace, and the State Preceptor’s widow was an ideal choice.
Especially the State Preceptor’s chief wife, who was a Hollow Realm Master; such mature, cultivated beauties with her status were few in the entire Capital City.
After the State Preceptor and his three disciples died, the widows attracted the covetousness of many powerful figures, but these powerhouses hadn’t dared to act.
They were wary of the Lord of The Li Manor, fearing if he took an interest in the widows of the State Preceptor, their actions would equate to competing with a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, which could bring them lethal troubles.
However, after nearly two months with no action from The Li Manor’s master, it seemed he had forgotten about the State Preceptor’s widows or genuinely wasn’t interested in them, contrary to what they had assumed.
Therefore, someone couldn’t resist and sent subordinates to probe the situation. If they succeeded, well and good; if not, and anything went south, they were prepared to make an apology bearing thorns.
“How dare you!”
Another wife of the State Preceptor scolded angrily, her face showing outrage. Were these people finally reaching out their Devil’s Palms toward them?
The several mature beauties behind her also looked furious, indignation bursting forth. Their husband the State Preceptor had only died not long ago, and yet, there were already people eyeing them so quickly.
Yu Wanying, the chief wife of the State Preceptor, took a deep breath, gestured her sisters to stop, and then turned to Lu Renyi and others, saying calmly,
“I’m aware of who’s behind you. That’s all the skill he has, able to only bully some weak women like us.”
“I advise you not to be too pleased with yourselves. The Lord of The Li Manor is still watching. You’re now reaching out to Mentor’s Manor, aren’t you afraid of being slapped to death by The Li Manor’s master?”
“Can the Guru in the Void Realm behind you withstand a strike from The Li Manor’s master? You people are just cannon fodder sent to die. When taking actions, be mindful, and don’t bring disaster upon yourselves.”

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 170: The Widow of the State Preceptor Offers Herself to Feed the Demon, The Fragrant Sect Hierarch Reappears!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 170: The Widow of the State Preceptor Offers Herself to Feed the Demon, The Fragrant Sect Hierarch Reappears!_2
Translator: 549690339
Yu Wanying’s expression remained calm, as if she truly had an affair with the Li Manor Lord, much to the surprise of the other Mentor’s widows. How could her sister say such a thing?
The Manor Lord of the Li Manor was their enemy, the one who had killed their husbands and caused them to fall into such a state.
If the State Preceptor were still alive, would these upstarts dare to make a scene? Who would have the audacity to block the gate of Mentor’s Manor?
Several Mentor’s widows were indignant, but they didn’t voice their displeasure; this was not the time to argue with Yu Wanying. They needed to drive away these unwelcome guests first.
Yu Wanying caught their expressions and sighed inwardly. She didn’t want to speak this way either, but she really had no choice.
“My husband, Wanying has wronged you~”
Yu Wanying felt a deep sense of guilt; she actually said such words in front of so many people.
She genuinely hated the Manor Lord of the Li Manor, who, without any reason, killed her husband, the State Preceptor, leading them to their current miserable situation.
After the death of the State Preceptor, Yu Wanying was also worried that the Manor Lord of the Li Manor would extend his Devil’s Palm toward them. At that time, they would have no means to resist and might be taken back to the Li Manor to be played with at will.
But nearly two months had passed, and the Manor Lord of the Li Manor had made no move. While Yu Wanying heaved a sigh of relief, she also worried about pressure from others.
Previously, the presence of the Manor Lord of the Li Manor was a protective charm for the widows of the Mentor, with no one daring to covet them. But now, with their protection fading, faced with the covetous Grandmasters of Myriad Phenomena Realm, Yu Wanying knew she could not resist.
After much deliberation, Yu Wanying decided to use her enemy, the Manor Lord of the Li Manor, to her advantage, pretending to have an affair with him. Only by doing this could she preserve Mentor’s Manor, the other widows of the Mentor, and her daughter.
Though there were reasons for her actions, Yu Wanying still felt an unbearable pain. She struggled for a long time but finally decided to go through with it, only to betray her deceased husband.
Sure enough, upon hearing Yu Wanying’s words, Lu Renyi felt wary. Even though he knew Yu Wanying was bluffing, he didn’t dare to stay any longer. His purpose today had only been to probe; failure wasn’t important.
If Yu Wanying truly had secretly formed a relationship with the Manor Lord of the Li Manor, then he would become cannon fodder.
“Madam Yu, a lie will eventually be exposed,” he said. “You better watch yourself.”
After giving Yu Wanying a long look, Lu Renyi hurried away with his people.
“Let’s go back and talk about it.”
After glancing at the younger sisters beside her, Yu Wanying sighed and left first.
The other widows exchanged glances and followed her. They wanted to know what Yu Wanying was really thinking. Had she really had a secret affair with the Manor Lord of the Li Manor?
They were all too aware of the current predicament of Mentor’s Manor, including their own peril. They could not defend the Mentor’s Manor by themselves; they couldn’t even get past the official barrier of Da Qian. Perhaps the only way was to seek the shelter of a powerful figure. With differing thoughts, the other widows followed Yu Wanying closely.
Back in the main hall, Yu Wanying talked with her younger sisters, then dragged her weary body back to her sleeping chamber. As she was about to bathe and rest, her daughter Mu Wanyan burst in.
“Mother, do you really have that kind of relationship with Li Feiyu?” Mu Wanyan’s expression was ugly as she looked at the mature beauty before her, sadness in her eyes.
She couldn’t believe it was true; Li Feiyu was the man who had killed her father. Why would her mother do such a thing?
Li Feiyu was the one who had killed her father!
Yu Wanying looked at her daughter, her heart aching tremendously. She had wanted to keep the secret, but seeing her daughter’s grief-stricken eyes, she ended up telling the truth.
“Wanyan, it’s not what you think…”
As Mu Wanyan listened, tears streamed down her face. She threw herself into Yu Wanying’s arms and sobbed, “Mother~”
Her mother had made such a great sacrifice for her, for Mentor’s Manor—willing to feed herself to the demon to secure her daughter’s safety—yet she had thought so lowly of her own mother. Mu Wanyan felt inconsolable.
Mother and daughter embraced, each agonizing over their uncertain futures. Without the State Preceptor, where were they to go?
With them, the Mentor’s widows, being targeted by Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, how could they extricate themselves and maintain their purity?
After a long while, Mu Wanyan dried her tears and pursed her lips, resolvedly saying, “Mother, let me do it. If I become Li Feiyu’s concubine, those evil men won’t dare covet you all anymore.”
As Mu Wanyan spoke, her heart felt exceedingly heavy. Li Feiyu had killed her father, yet she was considering offering to become his concubine; how humiliating was that?
“No way!” Yu Wanying felt as if her heart was being cut out, rejecting the idea immediately.
She could feed herself to the demon, but she would never allow her daughter to do the same. Her daughter hadn’t even experienced love yet; she couldn’t let her fall prey to that old devil Li Feiyu.
Seeing Yu Wanying disagree, Mu Wanyan sighed and said painfully, “But you know, Mother, Li Feiyu doesn’t fancy any of you; only by offering myself is there a chance.”
Yu Wanying trembled. She knew it all too well.
If Li Feiyu had desired them, he would have taken them, the widows of the State Preceptor, long ago, rather than just taking Li Na.
Li Feiyu’s inaction for so long had made his stance clear; otherwise, those coveting them would not have dared to make a move.
Yet Yu Wanying could not bear the thought of her daughter jumping into that fiery pit. Her daughter was at the peak of her beauty; if she became Li Feiyu’s concubine, she would never escape his clutches.
Once again, tears ran down Mu Wanyan’s face, as her decision caused her great distress. How could she bear the thought of becoming the concubine to the man who had murdered her father?
But if she didn’t, both her mother and the others in Mentor’s Manor would fall into the hands of powerful men, and her own fate wouldn’t be much better.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: 170
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: 170
Translator: 549690339
When Li Feiyu had killed the State Preceptor, Mu Wanyan was not in Daqian Capital City; she was still traveling abroad. Upon hearing the news, she immediately rushed back and even thought of going to Li Mansion to seek revenge, but she was stopped by Yu Wanying.
Mu Wanyan held an immense hatred for Li Feiyu, hating him for killing her father without reason. However, for the sake of her mother and the other people at Mentor’s Manor, she had to voluntarily become Li Feiyu’s concubine. Otherwise, her mother would have to be the one to do so, and she didn’t want her mother to bear this alone.
Mu Wanyan was very confident in herself; if she offered herself as a concubine to Li Feiyu, he would definitely accept. Then, with Li Feiyu’s influence, no one would dare covet the widows of Mentor’s Manor.
With her talents and Li Feiyu’s resources, there was a hope for her to cultivate to the True Martial Realm, and thus there was a chance she could avenge her father in the future.
Seeing the clear tears on her daughter’s face, Yu Wanying also had tears streaming down her pretty face, mustering the courage to say, “I’ll accompany you…”
Although her daughter was beautiful, as attractive as Li Na, she might suffer mistreatment from Li Feiyu; Yu Wanying couldn’t bear it and would rather be with her daughter through it all.
She knew those people of high status liked this sort of thing, and if they were together, perhaps Li Feiyu would treat them well.
Mu Wanyan looked at Yu Wanying in disbelief. How could her mother speak such words?
Then Mu Wanyan felt even more distressed. All of this was for her sake, so she vigorously shook her head and said, “No, it’s enough for me to go alone; I must not tarnish mother’s purity.”
“If both of us mother and daughter fall into the hands of that demon Li Feiyu, how could we face father under the nine springs?”
“But…” Yu Wanying opened her mouth to speak.
Mu Wanyan placed her hand over her mother’s mouth, not letting her continue to speak.
In Li Mansion, Han Li noticed the entire scene at the gates of Mentor’s Manor with a mocking expression and shook his head slightly.
He indeed wasn’t interested in the widows of the State Preceptor; otherwise, he would have captured them long ago. While Yu Wanying was indeed a very attractive, mature beauty, she still wasn’t outstanding enough.
The current plight of the State Preceptor’s widows was caused by Han Li, yet he felt not even the slightest guilt.
The Daqian National Teacher was not a good person either, having directly and indirectly committed countless evil deeds, with the ruined Lin Family being just one of them. Now that Han Li had the power, he took revenge for his concubines.
Han Li wasn’t concerned about the future fate of the State Preceptor’s widows. Even if Yu Wanying personally offered herself to join his bedchamber, it would be futile; he simply wasn’t interested, as her talents only reached the Fifth Grade.
He wasn’t temporarily interested in cultivating relationships with the wives and concubines of his enemies, not even considering taking them as servant concubines. Why not accept more beautiful virgins instead?
Han Li withdrew his gaze, knowing that Mentor’s Manor probably couldn’t last much longer. Even having a Third Grade grand formation for protection was useless.
A Third Grade grand formation constantly operating required the consumption of a large amount of Top Quality Spirit Stones. How long could the Spirit Stones accumulated by Mentor’s Manor last? Moreover, it could be easily breached from within.
Han Li’s figure disappeared from Chong Xiao Pavilion, as he went to the back of the mansion to accompany concubines like Li Qingqing and Die Yi.
They had been pregnant for quite some time, ranging from one to four or five months, and by now, they had completely settled in Li Mansion, wholeheartedly devoted to their husband Li Feiyu.
They were not treated very well in their respective powers; otherwise, they wouldn’t have been sent to Li Mansion to be concubines in the first place. Initially, they were apprehensive, worried about being used as cauldrons for cultivation.
But after some time, they realized that was not the case at all. Not only did Li Feiyu not use them for cultivation, but he also treated them extremely well, providing ample cultivation resources and teaching them various advanced cultivation techniques and martial arts.
If Li Feiyu hadn’t casually exterminated the National Teacher’s lineage, they might have thought he was a really good person.
But the death of the National Teacher was a matter of the past. As long as their husband Li Feiyu treated them well, life in Li Mansion was far happier than in their original factions.
After spending time with these beautiful concubines, Han Li left and returned to Han Mansion. Li Qingqing, Die Yi, and the others had no idea and merely thought their husband had gone into seclusion or to other places in Capital City.
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
Han Li stood on the summit of Chengdao Peak, his Spiritual Sense flooding out, observing the entire situation in Li Mansion, the state of Yonchang Manor, and a vast expanse of Yuanzhou.
Han Mansion was thriving. His wives and concubines were either leisurely enjoying nature, diligently cultivating, or interacting with their children.
His offspring were also busy with their own affairs, either earnestly cultivating, comprehending martial arts, sparring, indulging in romance, or producing the next generation…
He saw the Han Mansion’s descendants who had gone out to gain experience, like Han Yongchun, who had emerged alive from the relics of Mangyang Mountain, becoming even more composed. His cultivation had improved once more, and clearly, he had encountered significant opportunities within the relics of Mangyang Mountain.
Han Li felt very gratified by this, and when Han Yongchun returned, the Rebirth Pills that were being refined would also be ready. He could gift him one, considering him a talent worth cultivating, with a promising future ahead.
“Husband~”
Lu Tianxiang’s figure appeared beside Han Li, leaning on his shoulder as she called out softly.
“Xiangxiang.”
Han Li extended his hand to embrace Lu Tianxiang in his arms, caressing her belly, feeling the little life inside.
Lu Tianxiang was several months pregnant with their second child, who would be born in a few more months. Although they couldn’t receive the reward for a firstborn, Han Li was still very happy.
“Husband, do you think our child will have Third Grade aptitude?” a trace of worry appeared on Lu Tianxiang’s pretty face.
Her and Han Li’s first child, Han Yongzhen, had Third Grade aptitude. She hoped the second child would also have Third Grade aptitude, but that was likely difficult.
“They will, and even if they don’t initially, they can still improve in the future,” Han Li said softly.
He knew their second child was likely to have Fourth Grade or Fifth Grade aptitude, and Third Grade was quite difficult, but there was still hope.
Han Li was quite confident about improving aptitude. When his own cultivation reached greater heights, he believed he could find methods to enhance aptitude, like the Great Emperor beneath Leizhou might know some.
Han Li also looked forward to the System rewarding him with pills or treasures that could enhance aptitude. It wasn’t impossible since the System awarded improvements in cultivation and longevity; why not aptitude?
“Mhm~”
Lu Tianxiang nodded lightly, full of trust in her husband Han Li. Unconsciously, she had become very confident in him.
Han Li lowered his head to kiss her forehead, then said, “Xiangxiang, I’ve been planning to spread your faith recently. Have you decided on an identity?”
Now that Chu Dingqian was in seclusion and not interfering with the outside world, as long as Han Li didn’t do anything too outrageous, Chu Dingqian would definitely not come out to intervene.
The emperor and senior officials of Da Qian dared not meddle in his affairs; this was a perfect opportunity to enhance Lu Tianxiang’s strength. As long as the faith was spread across the six states, Lu Tianxiang might very well ascend to the True Martial Realm because of it.
Lu Tianxiang was very touched upon hearing this; she thought Han Li had forgotten about it as he took concubines in the Capital City, but her husband had been considering her matter all along.
After pondering for a while, Lu Tianxiang said, “Let’s call it the Wenxiang Sect, and I’ll be the Sect Hierarch.”
She had originally thought about bringing out the Tian Xiang Sect she started in Leizhou, but then dismissed the idea, considering it might cause trouble for her husband.
Her uncle from Fengbo Pavilion, upon hearing of the Tian Xiang Sect, would likely associate it with her and come to investigate.
Now, Lu Tianxiang wanted to avoid any further entanglements with Fengbo Pavilion; she wished to be with Han Li wholeheartedly and stay within the Han Family.
“Okay,” Han Li nodded.
Soon after, the two of them left the place and went to a lower area where Han Li spent time with his other beloved wives and concubines. They chatted leisurely, played some games, enjoyed the scenery together, or handled jade…
After being occupied with these activities, Han Li finally returned to Li Mansion.
No sooner had he returned to Li Mansion than he went up to Chong Xiao Pavilion. As usual, he spread out his Spiritual Sense, and soon discovered something new.
A charming and delightful figure had appeared in Mentor’s Manor, someone he hadn’t seen before, and this stunning figure was heading towards Li Mansion.
Before long, Mu Wanyan arrived at the entrance to Li Mansion

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 171: Special Achievement Accomplished, Li Feiyu’s First Wife_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 171: Special Achievement Accomplished, Li Feiyu’s First Wife_1
Translator: 549690339
In the great hall of The Li Manor.
Mu Wanyan was waiting, waiting for the arrival of her father’s unseen murderer.
She desperately tried to stabilize her emotions, admonishing herself not to speak carelessly. She was shouldering a heavy responsibility this time. Whether her mother Yu Wanying, her other aunts, and Mentor’s Manor could continue to exist depended entirely on her.
Yu Wanying had wanted to come with her, but Mu Wanyan had strongly refused. She didn’t want her mother to suffer such humiliation, especially the notion of sharing one husband, which Mu Wanyan found unacceptable.
She would truly have no face to meet her father in the netherworld, although she already felt that way.
“Huff~”
Mu Wanyan took a deep breath and waited silently, hoping that Li Feiyu, the great demon, would appear sooner.
She felt that staying here was a torment, sometimes she strongly wanted to escape. There was no one guarding her, and with her cultivation, she could escape from The Li Manor and fly far away.
But if she left, what would become of her mother?
The bigwigs of the Myriad Phenomena Realm were already watching them closely and would not give her mother and the others a chance to escape. They could barely survive for a while depending on the formation in Mentor’s Manor, but leaving the Capital City would be like walking into a trap.
“Father, please forgive your daughter,” she pleaded in her heart.
“If I ever get the chance, I will avenge you,” she silently vowed, though no hint of hatred showed on her face. After the continuous blows of recent times, she had matured.
From Chong Xiao Pavilion, Han Li had been watching Mu Wanyan. After she arrived, he had his maid lead Mu Wanyan into the hall.
He had also found out about Mu Wanyan’s background: the only daughter of the Daqian National Teacher, possessing Fourth Grade talent and God Refining Realm cultivation, still a virgin.
“Why do I feel like a villain?” Han Li mumbled to himself.
He laughed. Han Li didn’t really care, this was the way of the Jianghu: grudges and grievances, intricate and intertwined, fate dragged everyone in, and no one could escape.
The families of Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin were destroyed because of the Daqian National Teacher, and the grudge was enormous. If he could survive until he had the power to avenge the two sisters, it was only right.
In Mu Wanyan’s eyes, he was the murderer who killed her father; and wasn’t the State Preceptor seen the same in the eyes of Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin?
If not for the indulgence of the Daqian National Teacher, Yu Chengkong wouldn’t have dared to annihilate the Lin Family so openly, and the longevity pill possessed by the Lin Family eventually ended up in the hands of the Daqian National Teacher.
“To be honest, this Daqian National Teacher isn’t that impressive, but his daughter is indeed very beautiful,” he thought, gazing at the stunning beauty in the hall.
Mu Wanyan had a delicate, fair oval face, stunningly beautiful, with rosy, thin lips, a high nose bridge, curving eyelashes and brows like ink; her features were so exquisite and vivid, her dark hair cascaded like a waterfall, tied with a purple ribbon, giving her a gentle and tranquil appearance, like a fragile woman.
She wore a light yellow palace dress, her figure graceful and curvy, with an elegant demeanor that made people desire to get closer.
If Han Li were to rate her, Mu Wanyan would score ninety-two points, almost on par with Fairy Li.
Mu Wanyan, as the daughter of the State Preceptor, kept a low profile, and the outside world didn’t dare disturb her or place her on any list.
“It’s about time.”
Han Li murmured to himself, his figure vanished, and in an instant, he appeared in the great hall where Mu Wanyan was.
Han Li didn’t hide his aura deliberately. Mu Wanyan detected it immediately, turned around, and saw the “much longed for” Li Feiyu.
“Mu Wanyan, do you realize that once you stepped into The Li Manor, your fate was already sealed?” Han Li said with a smile at the corner of his mouth, eyeing the stunning beauty before him, curious about her reaction.
Mu Wanyan had come to him of her own accord, and whether or not he accepted her request, Han Li had no intention of letting her go.
A pure virgin, moreover, a Fourth Grade talented and beautiful cultivator coming to him, Han Li would damage his reputation if he let her go.
“I know,” Mu Wanyan responded, her tone somewhat cold.
Thud!
With a gentle wave of his sleeve, Han Li sent Mu Wanyan flying backward, crashing into a pillar, blood spilling from the corner of her mouth, adding an alluring appeal.
“To beg, one must look the part. Who are you putting on this act for?” Han Li said indifferently.
He knew why Mu Wanyan had come to The Li Manor, to become his concubine and thus help Mentor’s Manor overcome its peril.
But whether he would agree depended on Han the Ancestor’s mood. If Mu Wanyan didn’t serve him well, he could either directly destroy Mentor’s Manor or simply watch coldly from the sidelines.
Mu Wanyan felt a pang of misery in her heart, opened her mouth, but did not dare to say anything. She suppressed any malice, and then she smiled.
Although he was the murderer of her father, he was now their lifeline. Li Feiyu didn’t even need to take action; just giving her a status would solve the crisis at Mentor’s Manor.
“I’m… sorry.” Mu Wanyan got up, walked to Han Li’s side, and apologized with a lowered head.
In just a short time, she had reined in her emotions, burying all her hatred deep in her heart. All she needed to do now was to accomplish one thing: to become Li Feiyu’s wife or concubine.
“Can you serve well?”
Han Li nodded slightly and then asked suddenly.
“I can learn,” Mu Wanyan almost said no, but ultimately changed her response.
Han Li snapped his fingers, sealing Mu Wanyan’s cultivation, and then said, “Then you may begin.”
Mu Wanyan was a little stunned, sighing inwardly at how cautious this Li Feiyu was, knowing full well she couldn’t hurt him but still choosing to seal her cultivation.
Without hesitating, she stepped forward, recalling how maids served her, and began to attend to Li Feiyu, imitating what she had seen.

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 171: Special Achievement Accomplished, Li Feiyu’s First Wife_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 171: Special Achievement Accomplished, Li Feiyu’s First Wife_2
Translator: 549690339
Han Li and Mu Wanyan spent an hour together, during which Han Li issued various commands, all of which Mu Wanyan obeyed.
This pleased the old patriarch Han immensely.
Although she was still some way off from being tamed like fairy Cheng Li, it was acceptable, so Han Li said indifferently, “Since you’re so keen on marrying into the Li Manor to serve this old man as a concubine, then you shall be a servant concubine.”
Mu Wanyan’s figure trembled, and she asked weakly, “May I become an official concubine?”
Her purpose in coming to the Li Manor on her own was not to be a servant concubine but to become Li Feiyu’s wife or official concubine, to gain a status that could help her mother.
If she were to be a servant concubine, without a title or status, it would be practically giving herself away for nothing, and she would not be able to help her mother at all.
Having been subdued by Han Li for an hour, Mu Wanyan’s confidence had greatly diminished. Understanding her outcome, she only wished to strive for better treatment.
“It’s not out of the question…” Han Li thought of the figure he had seen earlier, thought for a moment, and then said.
“What are your conditions?”
Mu Wanyan looked up hopefully at Li Feiyu.
“Unless…” Han Li smiled and stated his condition.
“No, absolutely not.”
Mu Wanyan’s head shook like a rattle-drum in vehement refusal; she could not accept such a situation.
“Hmm?” Han Li’s expression turned cold.
“Not… acceptable.” Mu Wanyan lowered her head, her tone weakened, feeling utterly powerless in her heart.
Han Li spoke with Mu Wanyan for a while longer before taking the final step.
Mu Wanyan sighed silently to herself but eventually accepted the outcome.
The next day,
The old patriarch Han stood on the Chong Xiao Pavilion feeling refreshed and happy, watching Mu Wanyan hurry away. He cracked a smile.
You’re still too green to battle with the old patriarch Han.
As expected, Mu Wanyan ultimately succumbed to him.
With this thought, Han Li’s mood improved greatly. Something he had been longing for was finally about to be fulfilled.
A message quickly spread throughout the Capital City of the Daqian Empire, the Master of the Li Manor was to take another concubine, and that concubine was Mentor’s daughter, Mu Wanyan.
This caused some forces with ill intentions to immediately cease their scheming, daring not to harbor any malevolent thoughts towards the widows of Mentor’s Manor any longer. Moreover, on the day the Master of the Li Manor held the wedding ceremony, they sent extremely precious congratulatory gifts.
Han Li, of course, knew their intentions, accepted them all without charging any crime—as these people had merely made an attempt and had inadvertently provided him with an assist.
It was unseemly for him to act in certain matters personally, and now, due to a twist of fate, it had worked out. This made the old patriarch Han laugh heartily with delight.
The widows of Mentor’s Manor and others breathed a sigh of relief. They did not know what Mu Wanyan had paid, but they knew they were safe now.
Only Yu Wanying let out a sorrowful sigh, knowing her daughter had ultimately been unable to avoid the worst outcome. Although she had anticipated this possibility, Yu Wanying still found it hard to accept when it actually happened. How sorry she was to her husband resting below.
But with things having come this far, and her daughter having already made the sacrifice, there was no going back, even if she couldn’t accept it.
The concubine welcoming ceremony ended quickly, and the old patriarch Han once again enjoyed the pleasure of tilling fertile ground, tirelessly.
What Han Li had not anticipated was that this act of taking another concubine would have an even broader impact.
Those forces within the Capital City, still observing, sighed when they learned that the Master of the Li Manor had once again taken in a concubine and had now taken in the daughter of the State Preceptor. They made a certain decision.
To continue persuading the favored daughters of their own forces to marry into the Li Manor to become wives or concubines of the Master of the Li Manor.
From the affair with Mentor’s Manor, they also observed something else—that the influence of the True Martial Realm’s Emperor Wu was incredibly vast.
The widows of Mentor’s Manor initially faced a grave crisis, but once the daughter of the State Preceptor married into the Li Manor and became a minor concubine, their fates were reversed.
Without uttering a word, without doing anything, the Master of the Li Manor simply took another concubine as usual, forcing other forces to back down and even offer reparations.
In the future, the Daqian Empire would surely be ruled by the Master of the Li Manor. The Master of the Li Manor would be the stabilizing force of the Qian Dynasty for the next four hundred years, the greatest pillar of support.
If they could cling to the coattails of the Li Manor, as long as the Daqian Empire did not fall, their power would never be destroyed. Perhaps they could even advance further.
The Hollow Void Stage Forces hoped to become Myriad Phenomena Realm Forces, and the Myriad Phenomena Realm Forces hoped to have more Great Grandmasters in the realm or even advance to the True Martial Realm Forces. They couldn’t achieve this on their own, but if the Master of the Li Manor helped, then it was very likely.
The Master of the Li Manor could assist. Guidance from a powerful Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm was extremely useful, and the Master of the Li Manor also controlled many Heaven Rank Cultivation Techniques.
To get help from the Master of the Li Manor, they must first cling to his powerful support. The easiest way was to have the favored daughters of their own forces marry into the Li Manor.
The various forces calculated it all and realized becoming a lesser concubine was not particularly beneficial—they had to become the Master of the Li Manor’s wife. Only then would they have the ear of the Master of the Li Manor.
The Master of the Li Manor had over thirty lesser concubines. Even if they sent more, it would scarcely matter. The Master had no wife, and that was the opening they could exploit.
But how could they ensure that the beautiful female cultivators their forces provided would become the Master of the Li Manor’s wife?
The various forces analyzed and concluded that their own favored daughters would have to take the initiative, or why would they be any different from the dozens of minor concubines? Why would they become a wife?
Almost every force in the Myriad Phenomena Realm had favored daughters with Fourth Grade talents, stunningly beautiful and with an otherworldly demeanor, each with varying cultivation. Even some Hollow Void Stage Forces had such favored daughters.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 171: Special Achievement Accomplished, Li Feiyu’s First Wife_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 171: Special Achievement Accomplished, Li Feiyu’s First Wife_3
Translator: 549690339
Although possessing fourth-grade aptitude, it’s uncertain whether one can cultivate to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, as some fall midway, while others suffer setbacks and never recover their morale, and still others face accidents, such as having their cultivation destroyed…
The concubines of the Lord of the Li Manor are mostly of sixth-grade and fifth-grade aptitude, though there are also exceptional women of fourth-grade aptitude like Fairy Li and Mu Wanyan. Their status, however, precludes them from becoming the Lord’s wives.
The favored daughters of these powers differ, with impeccable backgrounds, outstanding aptitudes, unrivalled beauty, and a unique charm, making them potential wives for the Lord of the Li Manor.
Compared to the future of their Sect or family, the loss of one favored daughter seems trivial, but persuading them is another matter.
These powers dare not use force, for fear of turning friends into foes, which, even if they succeeded in sending someone over, would not help but could instead bring disaster.
Meanwhile, some beautiful female cultivators with third-grade aptitude also started considering whether to go to the Li Manor. They were confident that with their aptitude and beauty, they were more than qualified to become the Lord’s wife.
These beautiful cultivators include both Loose Cultivators and disciples of major powers; they concealed their true aptitude on a daily basis, only revealing fourth-grade aptitude to avoid accidents on their path to power.
They have third-grade aptitude and naturally aspire to the True Martial Realm, but on their own or with their current backing, they lack the support needed for such cultivation.
With various cultivation resources limited, only a major stroke of luck would allow them to successfully reach the True Martial Realm. But how easy is it to come by such a fortunate opportunity?
Becoming the wife of the Lord of the Li Manor is a shortcut.
Looking at the current situation, Li Feiyu doesn’t seem to be some devil cultivator, nor does he practice any Collection and Supplement Method. His frequent taking of concubines might indicate that his cultivation has reached its peak with little room for improvement.
Hence, he begins to enjoy life without pursuing the great Dao, aiming to establish a vast family. Otherwise, why would he confine himself to guarding the Qian Dynasty for four hundred years?
The pregnancies of the Lord’s concubines are the best proof.
Logically, at the Lord’s level of cultivation, it is quite difficult to produce offspring, but who knows if the Lord has some secret fertility technique?
Such techniques do indeed exist, even wielded by the Da Qian Royalty; each Emperor Qian sires many children to select the best successor, of course at a certain price.
The outside world speculates that this is the case with the Lord, therefore becoming his wife is viewed as the best option.
A powerful True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, whose future seems bleak and begins focusing on family propagation, can be highly attractive to those third-grade aptitude beauties who seek the True Martial Realm but lack opportunities.
This implies that Li Feiyu might invest substantial cultivation resources in his wife, aiding her advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and work tirelessly to facilitate her entrance into the True Martial Realm.
In the following period, Han Li kept a low profile, other than taking concubines, he stirred no further trouble.
As a result, the outside world breathed a sigh of relief, as they had grown accustomed to the Lord taking concubines. If a day passed where the Lord didn’t take another, they would find it odd.
Time flew like a shuttle, and in the blink of an eye, three months had passed.
During this period, the Han Mansion saw the birth of many progenies; some were born to Han Li’s concubines, but even more were from the wives and concubines of his offspring.
This growth in population inflated the numbers in the Han Mansion, bringing the total number of descendants and the number of aptitude-bearing descendants closer to the targets of one thousand and four hundred, respectively.
As for Han Li himself, he took concubines on two occasions, only one each time. One was named Zhou Yunya, with sixth-grade aptitude, and the other was Xia Sihan, with seventh-grade aptitude.
Zhou Yunya and Xia Sihan were from outside Yonchang Manor; Zhou Yunya came of her own volition, while Xia Sihan was sent over.
Through the efforts of the old ancestor Han Li, both Zhou Yunya and Xia Sihan soon became pregnant, joining the childbearing ranks of the Han Mansion.
However, Li Feiyu married or took concubines six times. Four times, it was with a single beautiful cultivator, and twice, with two.
The four beautiful cultivators came from various powers; only one had fourth-grade aptitude and the most exquisite beauty—her name was Xue Qingyi, and she was at the God Refining Realm.
The other three beautiful cultivators were of fifth-grade aptitude, one even a Princess, the daughter of the former Emperor Chu Wuji.
The special ones among the remaining four beautiful cultivators included a set of twins, and two were…
Although they had only sixth-grade aptitude, their beauty was nonetheless outstanding, with additional flattering qualities, which old ancestor Han Li gladly accepted.
Out of these ten beautiful cultivators, only Xue Qingyi became Han Li’s wife, marking the first time he, as Li Feiyu, took a wife. The other nine beauties became his concubines.
