Xue Qingyi hailed from the Kunqian Sect, one of the Ten Major Sects of Da Qian, and was the Sect Leader’s daughter. Known across Tangzhou as Fairy Xue, she had countless suitors.
Upon hearing of Xue Qingyi’s marriage into the Li Manor, numerous young talents beat their chests in anguish, cursing Li Feiyu in secret for taking away their goddess.
Han Li also inquired why Xue Qingyi had actively chosen to marry into the Li Manor, to which she candidly responded that she wished to use Han Li’s aid to reach the Myriad Phenomena Realm sooner, and then have more time to strive for the True Martial Realm.
She also expressed her hope for Han Li’s assistance; with her future advancement to the True Martial Realm, the Li Manor would house two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus, making it effortless for the Li Manor to usurp the throne and take over the Qian Royalty.

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 171: Special Achievement Accomplished, Li Feiyu’s First Wife_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Chapter 171: Special Achievement Accomplished, Li Feiyu’s First Wife_4
Translator: 549690339
Han Li smiled, showing some admiration for Xue Qingyi, and even though he wasn’t tempted by the promises she painted, he still agreed to take her as his wife.
Although Xue Qingyi had made clever calculations, after marrying into The Li Manor, she still needed to bear several offspring first. Without making contributions, it was difficult for the great ancestor Han to lend her a helping hand.
As it was the Manor Lord’s first marriage, the wedding ceremony was naturally grand beyond compare, easily surpassing the magnitude of any previous concubine inductions by more than tenfold.
All the powers within the territory of the Daqian Empire, be they Sect Leaders or Sect Masters, either personally attended or sent high-ranking representatives. Each delivered precious treasures, their intentions expressed through their gifts.
It was the same with the official Da Qian stance. Even though they harbored some misgivings about Li Feiyu, the Manor Lord of The Li Manor, entering matrimony for the first time, they had to maintain a good public facade; otherwise, they would offend the Manor Lord.
Offending the Manor Lord meant that once the old ancestor Chu Zhenxiong passed away, they would not fare well.
This marriage ceremony also sent out an important signal to all powers: a woman of Fourth Grade talent could indeed become the wife of the Manor Lord.
It made sense, after all, since the Manor Lord was only at the True Martial Realm himself. Should he wish to find a wife of Third Grade talent and beauty, it would have been difficult, as nobody knew if such a woman even existed within the great Da Qian.
With the assistance of Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm, it was relatively easy for those with Fourth Grade talent to cultivate to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, thereby becoming competent aides to Emperor Wu himself.
Under the tireless efforts of the great ancestor Han, Xue Qingyi, Wen Yun’er, and their other ten delicately beautiful wives and concubines soon conceived, although the lengths of their pregnancies varied. Basically, they became pregnant not long after marrying into Han Mansion.
Atop Chong Xiao Pavilion, Xue Qingyi stood looking out over the back residence at Li Feiyu’s beautiful concubines and gently touched her lower abdomen with a sigh.
She hadn’t wanted to become pregnant so soon, preferring to cultivate to the Hollow Void Stage first. But unable to defy her husband Li Feiyu, she conceived anyway, and now the child had been growing for over a month.
Under the moonlight, Xue Qingyi looked breathtakingly graceful. Her pale moon-colored palace dress fluttered, revealing her fairy-like skin and bones beneath. Her three thousand strands of black hair fell like a waterfall, each strand glistening, smoothly cascading over her snow-white neck, reaching her slender, delicate waist, which seemed too fragile for even a gentle grasp.
Her arched eyebrows complemented her clear, distinct eyes, bright whites and dark pupils, and her red lips were stunningly beautiful. Her body was slender, her demeanor elegant and graceful, towering and captivating. With every move, her spiritual energy was overwhelming, her presence radiant.
At that moment, Xue Qingyi felt a pair of large hands embrace her delicate waist. She leaned back, resting against the solid and powerful chest behind her.
“My Lord~” Xue Qingyi’s voice rang out like the clear chime of a bell.
“What is Qingyi contemplating?” Han Li kissed her tender skin and then captured her gorgeous red lips.
After being released by her husband, Xue Qingyi said, “My Lord, I was wondering when I could resume my cultivation.”
Han Li smiled and replied, “Don’t worry, you’ll be able to cultivate soon after the birth of our child. I will ensure Qingyi recovers her vitality as quickly as possible.”
“Mm~” Xue Qingyi murmured softly, unsure if it was true, but choosing to believe it nonetheless.
“My Lord, when do you think the old ancestor Chu Zhenxiong of the Qian Dynasty will pass away?” Xue Qingyi suddenly asked.
Han Li paused and then responded, “Why does that concern you? According to my estimate, Chu Zhenxiong should have over forty years of life left.”
“Alright~” Xue Qingyi’s tone held a touch of resignation.
“Do you truly wish for The Li Manor to take its place?” Han Li inquired.
“I do ponder on it,” Xue Qingyi admitted openly. “If we become the imperial family of Daqian, then the cultivation of my Lord’s descendants would be even better supported.”
“The alliance between my Lord and the old ancestor didn’t specify that the imperial family of the Qian Dynasty must bear the surname Chu, did it?” Xue Qingyi looked up at her handsome husband with hopeful eyes.
If The Li Manor were to succeed, as the wife of Li Feiyu, the Lady of The Li Manor, she too would reap countless benefits. Cultivating to the Myriad Phenomena Realm would be effortless, and there would even be hope for her to advance to the True Martial Realm in the future.
“There is such a stipulation,” Han Li shook his head.
After a pause, Han Li added, “Moreover, I myself cannot turn the imperial family into puppets.”
The old fox Chu Dingqian had long considered this issue, leaving no such loopholes. He certainly did not wish for The Li Manor to benefit from the Qian Dynasty he worked so hard to establish.
Otherwise, what would have been the point of all his careful plotting?
Besides, Chu Dingqian had plans to seize another’s body for rebirth and use the vast cultivation resources of the imperial family to rapidly break through.
Xue Qingyi sighed quietly to herself, saying nothing more, and simply lay quietly in her husband’s arms.
“Qingyi, let’s try a new game,” Han Li suggested.
After whispering sweet nothings into Xue Qingyi’s ear and nibbling on her earlobe, Han Li whispered the details of the game to her.
Upon hearing what the game involved, a beautiful blush spread across Xue Qingyi’s pretty face, but she still softly consented with a murmur.
Excited, Han Li immediately set his plans for the evening into motion

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 172: Bullying the Weak? That’s Called Upholding Justice! The Ancestor Han Who Cries ‘Stop Thief’!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 172: Bullying the Weak? That’s Called Upholding Justice! The Ancestor Han Who Cries ‘Stop Thief’!_1
Translator: 549690339
Half a month later, at Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li was anxiously waiting in a bedroom, his face showing both worry and joy.
Today was the day the Sect Hierarch of Wenxiang Sect was to give birth to her second child, and Han Li had been waiting all along, staying by Lu Tianxiang’s side, which pleased her greatly.
On such an important day, if Han Li had been at The Li Manor taking concubines or spending time with other wives and concubines, she would have surely felt heartbroken.
With the cry of a newborn, the Sect Hierarch of Wenxiang Sect’s second child was finally born.
Han Li quickly went over, took a glance at the child, then sat by the bed, tightly holding her bonelessly soft hand and transferring a great amount of his refined Gentle True Yuan.
“Xiang Xiang, I’m here.”
Han Li looked affectionately at the slightly pale-faced Xiang Xiang, and spoke tenderly.
Though Lu Tianxiang had some grievances with him in the past, she had long fallen for him, and had been busy working for the development of Han Mansion. Now she had even given birth to their second child, filling Han Li’s heart with endless love.
The Sect Hierarch was after all a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. If she didn’t want to, she could easily refine the essence.
Giving birth to a child weakens one’s vitality significantly, creates a deficit in one’s origin, and is highly detrimental to one’s cultivation, but Lu Tianxiang chose not to do so, and kept the child instead.
“Husband~”
Feeling the warmth of Han Li’s hand, Lu Tianxiang looked at her beloved husband by her side, a weak smile appeared on her face.
After a tender exchange with the Sect Hierarch, Han Li then said, “Let’s name the child Han Yongxiang.”
He had already checked; Xiang Xiang’s second child only had Fourth Grade aptitude, which was already very good, and being a girl, she was his first female descendant with a high aptitude.
“Mm~” Lu Tianxiang quickly nodded in agreement.
Jiang Baiye’s eldest son was named Han Yongjiang, and she had truly envied that for a while, but she also knew that the eldest son indeed wasn’t suitable for the names Han Yonglu or Han Yongxiang. As for the name Han Yongtian, Lu Tianxiang knew the eldest son couldn’t bear it yet.
Now that her daughter was named Han Yongxiang, it held the same significance as Han Yongjiang, and Lu Tianxiang instantly felt satisfied.
“Xiang Xiang, I’ve already made arrangements for the matters concerning the Wenxiang Sect.”
Han Li stretched out his hand, gently touched Lu Tianxiang’s lovely face, smoothed her somewhat disheveled hair, and spoke softly.
“Husband, I have already felt it…”
Speaking of this, Lu Tianxiang’s face lit up with joy, as with the spread of the Wenxiang Sect, her long-stagnant strength had also begun to grow.
Since the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture was a very special Cultivation Technique, she did not need to cultivate arduously to improve her cultivation. If the faith continued to spread, having a child wouldn’t affect her much, and her cultivation level would still rapidly increase.
“That’s good.” Han Li nodded slightly; he was very pleased to see the Sect Hierarch’s breakthrough to the True Martial Realm.
After spending some time with Lu Tianxiang, Han Li reluctantly left. He originally wanted to take Lu Tianxiang out for a walk, but she wanted to see her daughter and didn’t wish to go out for the time being.
On the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li sighed softly.
Indeed, there were no special rewards for having a second descendant with Fourth Grade aptitude; only the birth of the first descendant of each grade would yield rewards.
Han Li had still harbored a sliver of hope, thinking that since Fourth Grade aptitude was already so high, maybe the conditions could be loosened, but it was not to be.
Although somewhat disappointed, he was still very happy about the birth of Han Yongxiang, as she was the fruit of his and Lu Tianxiang’s union, and had brought Han Li quite a few rewards.
“You have a descendant with Fourth Grade aptitude born, you gain one year of lifespan, you gain one year of cultivation, you gain a section of…”
Lifespan and cultivation gains, as well as Cultivation Techniques, were minor benefits. What Han Li valued was the aptitude feedback brought by Han Yongxiang, which had increased his own aptitude by a full ten percent.
In high spirits, the elder Han Li opened his personal panel to take a glance and discovered that his aptitude had indeed improved rapidly, already exceeding 50% of the Fourth Grade.
After Lu Tianxiang, the Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi and his Shijie Gongsun Yue would also be giving birth to offspring in succession, within two months of each other.
They all had Fourth Grade aptitude, and so did Han Li. Usually, the first descendant would inherit the excellent bloodlines from both parents, resulting in the best aptitude.
The first descendants of Yun Miaoyi and Gongsun Yue were likely to have Fourth Grade aptitude. If favored by destiny, they could even have Third or Second Grade aptitude.
At that moment, Jiang Baiye flew up hand in hand with Yao Xi and came to Han Li’s side.
“Husband~”
“Brother~”
Jiang Baiye and Yao Xi both called out, smiles in the corners of their eyes.
“Jiang Jiang.” Han Li first acknowledged Jiang Baiye, then turned to Yao Xi and asked, “Xi Xi, what made you think to come up to the peak?”
“Because I’ve never been here before, it’s so high up! But the view from here is truly awesome…”
The little girl in the pink dress started babbling, as if she had a multitude of things to say, stealing glances at Han Li from time to time.
Han Li wrapped one arm around Jiang Baiye, and with the other hand, he ruffled Yao Xi’s head.
“Oh my, brother, I’ve grown up already, don’t just ruffle a girl’s head like that.” The little girl in the pink dress complained sweetly.
Han Li laughed and said, “To me, Xi Xi will always be a little girl.”
While speaking, Han Li examined Yao Xi closely; she was already a stunning beauty, and in a few more years when she reached adulthood, she might truly possess peerless grace.
Considering that she was the reincarnation of a powerful being trapped by the mystery within the womb, Han Li’s smile grew even wider.
He didn’t want Yao Xi’s past life memories to be unlocked yet. On one hand, he was worried about losing control; a reincarnation of a powerful being would recover their cultivation very quickly, and with The Han Mansion having abundant resources, especially since Yao Xi might not just be a Grandmaster of the Tongxuan Realm, but possibly a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 172: Bullying the Weak? That’s Called Upholding Justice! The Ancestor Han Who Cries ‘Stop Thief’!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 172: Bullying the Weak? That’s Called Upholding Justice! The Ancestor Han Who Cries ‘Stop Thief’!_2
Translator: 549690339
Han Li actually wanted to take her under his wing as soon as possible, but the omnipresent Mystical Beast was keeping a tight watch on him. Ancestor Han didn’t dare make the slightest reckless move, for he might incur heavenly wrath and instantly meet his demise.
On the other hand, Yao Xi’s memories of this life were too fleeting. If her past life memories were to be revived, there was a great likelihood that they would take precedence, and by then, she would become a stranger to him—a prospect Han Li didn’t want to face.
“Sigh, nurturing a young girl is indeed a long and arduous task.”
Thinking of the fact that it would take another three or four years for Yao Xi to come of age, Han Li silently sighed.
“Xi Xi, have you been having headaches lately?”
“Nope, and those weird memories aren’t showing up either,” Yao Xi said, her delicate, tender face breaking into a smile.
Jiang Baiye quietly nestled in her husband’s embrace, watching as Han Li and Yao Xi chatted, a smile also appearing on her face.
She knew all too well what her husband was scheming, as did Yun Miaoyi, Lu Tianxiang, and others, yet no one said a word—they found it only natural.
Even Yao Xi herself probably understood, but she was willing and enjoyed the feeling.
After some thought, Jiang Baiye spoke up, “Husband, does Xi Xi really not need to cultivate?”
Although she was aware of Yao Xi’s situation, Jiang Baiye was still a bit worried. Yao Xi was nearly fifteen years old and had not yet started to cultivate. Wouldn’t it be too late for her to start cultivating in the future?
“Sister, Xi Xi doesn’t want to cultivate,” Yao Xi said, her expression falling and her face filled with distress.
She had seen the people of the Han Mansion cultivating, and even just watching them made her feel that it was extremely difficult. Yao Xi felt that her current life was quite good—why bother with arduous cultivation?
Han Li shook his head slightly and said, “Not for now.”
Indeed, it was not necessary. Even if Yao Xi started cultivating at the age of twenty, it wouldn’t take her many years to reach the Myriad Phenomena Realm or the True Martial Realm.
With a safe environment and an abundant supply of cultivation resources, the advantage of a powerfully reincarnated individual was simply too great.
“Yay~”
Yao Xi stuck her tongue out at Jiang Baiye and coyly clung to Han Li’s hand, acting coquettishly, “Brother is the best.”
Han Li smiled and said nothing.
In the following days, Han Li enjoyed a blissful immortal life, with lovely wives and beautiful concubines in both households needing his company, and they could play all kinds of games with him, which made Ancestor Han feel refreshed and energized.
If ever he felt downcast, he could visit Li Feiyu, the fairy, and two other servant concubines to lift his spirits. With them, Han Li could enjoy various pleasures; as long as he didn’t restrict his physical strength, the two women were very durable.
Just as Han Li, as Li Feiyu, was preparing to take in another concubine, a little trouble arose—unexpected, yet reasonable.
One day, Jiang Baiye sought out Han Li and, after a slight hesitation, still spoke up, “Husband, could you please assist the Canghai Sect?”
Han Li nodded and asked directly, “What happened?”
It had been over a year since the turmoil in the Daqian Empire, and the Canghai Sect had remained unscathed. Han Li had prepared an alias that he hadn’t used yet, but now an opportunity seemed to have presented itself.
Han Li wouldn’t refuse such a request from his beloved wife Jiang Baiye. It was a trivial matter for him to handle.
Besides, having gained a lot of strength recently, he was also eager to try on an alias and make an appearance. There was no need to seek trouble with an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, competing in the Myriad Phenomena Realm would suffice.
It was still quite amusing to take advantage of one’s superior strength.
With his formidable power, Han Li had been laying low and not using it, which made Ancestor Han rather itch for some action—he was somewhat inclined to show off.
Without the right opportunity, Han Li was unwilling to court trouble needlessly. Now, with the Canghai Sect in distress, it was as though a sleeper was being delivered a pillow.
The Canghai Sect was a Myriad Phenomena Realm force. They might have lost the Body-Cultivating Furnace, but their Myriad Phenomena Realm Sect Leader was still standing firm.
If some power was oppressing the Canghai Sect and it hadn’t fallen yet, it was unlikely to be a force from the True Martial Realm. It must be a rival of the same level.
Han Li’s thoughts flickered countless times in a moment, and he surmised that it was probably the same force targeting the Canghai Sect before—Jifeng Hall.
The strongest member of Jifeng Hall was only a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, without any True Martial Realm expert or significant backing, so dealing with Jifeng Hall wouldn’t pose any hidden dangers.
“Jifeng Hall has joined forces with other powers, blockading the entrance to the Canghai Sect with a menacing front, and the Sect has almost reached its breaking point,” Jiang Baiye said with a touch of sadness in her tone.
Even though she had married into the Han Mansion and become Han Li’s wife, with no way of returning to the Canghai Sect, Jiang Baiye constantly kept an eye on her own Sect.
Inside the Canghai Sect were her master and junior and senior sect brothers and sisters, as well as some friends. Jiang Baiye didn’t want to see the Sect destroyed.
Especially after learning that her husband Han Li was an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm, she was able to put her mind at ease; if her husband could adopt an alias to help Tianxuan Mountain and preside over the Daqian Empire, he could also take up an alias to aid the Canghai Sect.
With her husband’s strength, helping the Canghai Sect wouldn’t be dangerous, and if it ever became dangerous, Jiang Baiye wouldn’t want Han Li to get involved.
Every half month, Jiang Baiye would collect news from the Canghai Sect, with the most recent update being not long ago. After hearing the news, she rushed to find her husband Han Li.
She was also relieved that fortunately, her husband wasn’t in the Li Manor; otherwise, she could only have waited for his return to seek help.
“The Master of Jifeng Hall’s strength is about the same as the Canghai Sect Leader’s, right? At most, he’s only slightly better. Did he perhaps break through to the middle phase of the Myriad Phenomena Realm?” Han Li wondered.
He had been paying attention to this intelligence previously and had some understanding of the strength of both sects.
The power difference between the two sects was slim; even if Jifeng Hall had the support of some Hollow Void Stage Forces, they shouldn’t be able to reach the entrance of the Canghai Sect, especially since the entrance was protected by the Mountain Protection Array.
Normally, one wouldn’t act so blatantly without absolute certainty, as this would lead to an open and relentless fight until one of the conflicting forces was destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 172: Bullying the Weak? That’s Called Upholding Justice! The Ancestor Han Who Cries ‘Stop Thief’!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Chapter 172: Bullying the Weak? That’s Called Upholding Justice! The Ancestor Han Who Cries ‘Stop Thief’!_3
Translator: 549690339
“Alas,” Jiang Baiye sighed and recounted the matter in detail.
After listening, Han Li raised an eyebrow, finally understanding how the Canghai Sect had fallen into such dire straits—the Canghai Sect Leader was critically injured.
Previously, the Canghai Sect in Qingzhou and Ji Feng Hall in Luzhou were both among the Ten Great Sects of Daqian, with comparable strength; however, the Canghai Sect, with its Body-Cultivating Furnace, ranked one place higher.
There had always been enmity between the two sects, but they had not openly broken into conflict. Once the Body-Cultivating Furnace was lost, Ji Feng Hall began coveting the Canghai Sect, constantly fanning the flames in hopes of an opportunity to obliterate the Canghai Sect.
This was not simply a matter of old grudges; Ji Feng Hall also coveted the cultivation resources that the Canghai Sect had accumulated over the years, which could significantly strengthen their sect.
When the Daqian Empire retracted its influence, both Ji Feng Hall and the Canghai Sect retreated, coincidentally relocating to Jizhou, along with some other Dongxu Stage forces.
With several Hollow Void Stage forces present in Jizhou even before, and now the addition of two Myriad Phenomena Realm forces and five Hollow Void Stage forces, the competition for cultivation resources and territory instantly intensified.
Ji Feng Hall aligned with other forces to ostracize the Canghai Sect, suppressing them in all respects, making life difficult for the Canghai Sect.
A few days earlier, while the Canghai Sect Leader was outside, the Master of Jifeng Hall and a mysterious Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm launched a surprise attack. Although the Canghai Sect Leader managed to escape, he was severely wounded.
Afterward, Ji Feng Hall abandoned its usual tactics and directly led several Hollow Void Stage forces to attack the Canghai Sect with the intention of completely eradicating it.
Reliant on their Mountain Protection Array, the beleaguered Canghai Sect held on desperately, and the Sect Leader occasionally mustered his severely wounded body to mount a defense. The situation was now perilous, and without external aid, the Canghai Sect would soon be destroyed.
In this battle, not only was the Master of Jifeng Hall involved, but also several Dongxu Stage Grandmasters, as well as the enigmatic Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster—it was only a matter of time before the Canghai Sect would merely be clinging to survival.
“Jiang Jiang, don’t worry, I’ll be right back.”
Han Li gently cradled her beautiful face and planted a kiss on it, saying with a smile.
Jiang Baiye nodded her head. With her husband stepping in, the Canghai Sect would be saved. A glint of murderous intent flashed in her eyes as she said, “Husband, kill them all.”
Jiang Baiye seldom harbored murderous intent towards anyone, not even when Han Li once treated her as he did; however, this time she was truly enraged.
If Ji Feng Hall and the other forces weren’t annihilated, the Canghai Sect would continue to face severe trouble in the future. She didn’t want her husband to be constantly burdened with the affairs of the Canghai Sect—an end to the troubles once and for all would be best.
“Alright,” Han Li nodded.
Jiang Baiye paused for a moment, then asked, “This won’t affect the overall situation, will it?”
Understanding her concern, Han Li replied with a smile, “Don’t worry, I have a plan.”
His intervention on behalf of the Canghai Sect would be under the guise of the True Martial Realm’s Emperor Wu, and this should fall under Li Feiyu’s jurisdiction, as Li Feiyu had declared martial law within the borders of Daqian and forbade any action from the True Martial Realm in territories like Jizhou, which was part of the Daqian Empire.
Since Han Li had decided to take action, he naturally had a plan in place.
Jiang Baiye breathed a sigh of relief, watching her husband Han Li’s figure fade into the distance before turning her attention back to the beautiful scenery of Chengsheng Mountain, her heart becoming calm once again.
She knew that with her husband’s involvement, the Canghai Sect’s crisis would soon be resolved.
In the skies above Canghai Sect in Jizhou—
Han Li’s figure emerged, concealing his presence so well that, despite it being day, none of the cultivators below could detect him.
Looking down, Han Li saw that the Canghai Sect was indeed in a crisis. Several formidable figures were bombarding the sect’s Mountain Protection Array midair; one was the Master of Jifeng Hall, and shockingly, another was a Cultivator of the demon path, with the remaining assailants being Hollow Void Stage Grandmasters.
Han Li raised an eyebrow; Ji Feng Hall was indeed bold, joining forces with cultivators of the demon path, explaining how they were able to launch a successful sneak attack that seriously injured the Canghai Sect Leader.
It was uncertain whether Ji Feng Hall had already been in cahoots with the Yinyang Sect in the past or only recently formed an alliance, but either was possible, as Jizhou was now in close proximity to the territory of the Yinyang Sect.
Under the onslaught of the two Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters and several Hollow Void Stage Grandmasters, the Canghai Sect’s Mountain Protection Array began showing cracks, ready to collapse at any moment.
The remaining forces surrounded the Canghai Sect tightly, also attacking to deplete the array’s energy.
Within the Canghai Sect, the Sect Leader Chen Qiuyun’s complexion was deathly pale as he stared helplessly at the attacking figures outside, a wave of despair washing over him.
Glancing at the disciples within the sect who all wore looks of despair, Chen Qiuyun felt his heart clench with guilt; it was his negligence that led to the sneak attack and his severe injury, which in turn brought the sect to this moment of crisis.
“Huff~”
After exhaling deeply, Chen Qiuyun prepared to fight once more—he had to relieve some of the pressure on the Mountain Protection Array, or it would soon be shattered.
“Sect Leader, you mustn’t!”
Jian Ziyun forcefully held him back, vigorously shaking his head and saying, “Even after taking the Spirit Pill, your strength has only recovered to forty percent. If you go to fight now, you will die.”
Looking at Jian Ziyun, who was also injured and gasping for breath, Chen Qiuyun managed a bitter smile and replied, “Junior brother, you know our situation. There are not many Spirit Stones left in the sect, and the Mountain Protection Array can only hold out for another two hours at most. If I go, at least it can last a few hours longer.”
Jian Ziyun fell silent, then let go and sighed, hesitating before suggesting, “Sect Leader, why don’t you escape?”
With Chen Qiuyun’s strength, even in his wounded state, there was a good chance of escaping, but he was reluctant to abandon the sect and continued to be dragged into this predicament.
“If one is to die, we will all die together,” Chen Qiuyun flatly refused, then stepped forward, ready to unleash his power.
The next moment, however, Chen Qiuyun was stunned.
He saw a series of dazzling sword lights descend from the heavens, extending for millions of miles, carrying an unstoppable force and brimming with an endless icy intention, slashing towards the Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters and Hollow Void Stage Grandmasters attacking the Canghai Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 172: Bullying the Weak? That’s Called Upholding Justice! The Ancestor Han Who Cries ‘Stop Thief’!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 172: Bullying the Weak? That’s Called Upholding Justice! The Ancestor Han Who Cries ‘Stop Thief’!_4
Translator: 549690339
“Not good!”
“It’s Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm!”
“Run for it!”
Seeing the Xuanming Sword Light slashing down from the heavens, Master of Ji Feng Hall and others’ complexions drastically changed. They bellowed loudly while launching attacks to defend themselves and frantically tried to escape.
But where could they fend it off, and where could they run to?
The Xuanming Sword Light annihilated everything, shattering their attacks and exploding their bodies, causing them all to lose their lives.
Han Li didn’t even draw his sword. With merely an inch of the blade revealed from its sheath, the unrivaled sword light had already slain two early-stage Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm and several Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage.
Casting a glance at the fleeing elders and disciples of Ji Feng Hall and other powers, he didn’t make another move, his figure disappearing from sight.
Chen Qiuyun’s face was full of astonishment. Did happiness come too suddenly? Jian Ziyun was also dumbfounded. What was this maneuver…
Could it be that an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm just happened to pass by and lent them a hand?
Before the two of them could catch their breath, their expressions quickly turned grave again as they looked up at the refined figure appearing in the sky and immediately recognized him.
The Manor Lord of the Li Manor, governing Capital City of the Da Qian Empire, Li Feiyu!
They instantly understood why Li Feiyu had come; it must have been the intervention of Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm that alerted him. Both remembered Li Feiyu’s overbearing declaration from over a year ago.
The two of them breathed a sigh of relief. Thankfully, that righteous Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm had already left; otherwise, they would have faced great trouble. And had two Emperors Wu clashed here, the aftershocks alone could have obliterated the Canghai Sect.
“Who’s there?”
“Fellow Daoist, please come out for a talk.”
High above in the heavens, Li Feiyu spoke, his voice spreading across all of Jizhou, even reaching the ears of the distant powerhouses spectating.
Various powers sighed with relief. The Manor Lord of Li Manor was still reliable. Although he frequently took concubines, when it came to moments like this, he truly showed up.
Whenever an Emperor Wu acted within the territory of the Da Qian Empire, the Manor Lord of Li Manor would hurry over. Although he didn’t encounter the intruder, it wasn’t his fault. The Emperor Wu who acted was too vigilant and had departed early.
“Cultivator of the demon path?”
Han Li reached out to snatch the belongings of that demon path cultivator, his expression immediately darkening.
“Dugu Bing, come out! Did you orchestrate this from behind the scenes?”
Han Li’s momentum soared to the skies as the terrifying presence pressed towards the Yinyang Sect, his voice sharp, directly throwing blame onto Dugu Bing’s head.
The spectating powers had an epiphany. That mysterious Great Grandmaster from the Myriad Phenomena Realm was actually a cultivator of the demon path. If Ji Feng Hall colluded with the Yinyang Sect, then their deaths were indeed deserved.
They felt it was indeed possible that Dugu Bing orchestrated it, since everyone knew about his feud with Li Feiyu. After being beaten and having his cultivation level dropped, it wouldn’t be surprising if he secretly sent people to cause trouble in the Qian Dynasty.
Han Li arrived above Leizhou, territory of the Yinyang Sect, putting on a bit of an act before leaving contentedly.
After slaying the Master of Ji Feng Hall and other cultivators with his new disguise, Han Li instantly fled far away, then changed back into Li Feiyu’s attire before reappearing, directly playing the thief shouting “catch the thief.”
This news quickly spread throughout the Xuan Domain, attracting the attention of various powers.
It was suspected that Emperor Wu Dugu Bing of the Yinyang Sect wanted to secretly stir trouble, colluding with Ji Feng Hall to annihilate the Canghai Sect and covertly gain control of the entirety of Jizhou.
As a result, an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm happened to pass by the Qian Dynasty and, disapproving of the situation, cut down those Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm and Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage with a single slash.
No one knew who this Emperor Wu was, only that he wore silver armor, carried a mask, and was a master of the sword. The image of his sword qi spanning a million miles was deeply etched into the minds of those who witnessed the battle.
At the same time, various powers also noticed that Li Feiyu was truly intent on taking action. Had that mysterious Emperor Wu lingered a bit longer, he would have certainly been cornered by Li Feiyu, possibly leading to a battle between Emperors Wu.
PS: I mentioned I would do a big update today, and I have not forgotten. This is the first update; there will be two or three more today.

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 173: Devil Princess and Senior Sister Have Children, Married Twice, Took Concubines Five Times_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 173: Devil Princess and Senior Sister Have Children, Married Twice, Took Concubines Five Times_1
Translator: 549690339
Yinyang Sect, the entrance to the sect.
Dugu Bing had healed his wounds and was bitterly cultivating, with the aim to return to the fourth layer of the True Martial Realm.
When he received the news, he was immediately dumbfounded and felt his head clang loudly.
What the hell?
When had he ever ordered someone to cause trouble in the Daqian Empire?
Dugu Bing felt incredibly wronged, as if, despite sitting at home, trouble had come from the sky.
While he silently cultivated, a huge black pot had been pinned on him, which made Dugu Bing very unhappy, as he hated being made a scapegoat for others.
Thus, Dugu Bing left his seclusion to investigate but found no useful information.
The person who died was indeed a Cultivator of the demon path from the Yinyang Sect, with a not insignificant status; however, his relationship with Dugu Bing was just average. The real power within Yinyang Sect lay in the hands of the Sect Hierarch.
As for who the True Martial Realm Emperor Wu was that made the move, Dugu Bing couldn’t find out from Tianji Pavilion. He only knew that the person was skilled in the Dao of the Saber and wore a bronze mask, which left him speechless.
What exactly was the Daqian Empire? Wasn’t it just a small and insignificant empire?
Why were there so many unknown True Martial Realm Emperor Wus continuously emerging, each more troublesome than the last?
First, it was the reincarnated Dragon Girl of the Sacred Dragon, then Li Feiyu, and now a bronze-masked saber wielder. Would there be another mysterious True Martial Realm Emperor Wu next time?
Dugu Bing frowned, feeling that Li Feiyu was truly a bastard. Was it because he didn’t give him face last time that he had to bear such a grudge?
Last time, Li Feiyu had severely injured him and his cultivation fell. Now Li Feiyu couldn’t find the real culprit and directly framed him instead, which really annoyed Dugu Bing.
However annoyed he was, he could only hold it in; Dugu Bing didn’t dare to go and cause trouble in the Daqian Empire. If he presented himself on Li Feiyu’s doorstep now, he would likely end up being killed by him.
“If I find out who did this, I’ll flay and bone you,” Dugu Bing declared menacingly before retreating into seclusion. The Sacred Dragon Secret Realm would emerge in half a year, and he had to strive to recover to the fourth layer of the True Martial Realm.
If various forces were to move against the Daqian Empire by then, he could take the opportunity to seek revenge on Li Feiyu and kill him. Dugu Bing had always held grudges in his heart.
Daqian Empire, Capital City.
After receiving the report, Emperor Qian hurriedly entered the core forbidden area to report to the venerable ancestor of the empire, Zhènxióng.
Once Emperor Qian had left, Chu Dingqian’s expression relaxed considerably. He had granted Li Feiyu so many benefits; although Li Feiyu was arrogant and lecherous, he was reliable when needed.
Chu Dingqian silently gauged Li Feiyu’s speed. It would indeed take some time to travel from the Capital City of Daqian to the Canghai Sect, and it made sense that the bronze-masked saber wielder had left immediately after the attack, making it plausible for Li Feiyu to miss him.
Chu Dingqian was pleased with Li Feiyu’s attitude. He was afraid that Li Feiyu would take the benefits without doing the work, and just idling would have complicated matters.
“However, who could this bronze-masked saber wielder be?” Chu Dingqian pondered in secret.
There were only two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus who used sabers in the Xuan Domain, and judging by the martial skills used by the bronze-masked saber wielder, it was unrelated to either of them. Besides, those two had no connection with the Canghai Sect and were unlikely to act on its behalf without good reason.
Suddenly, Chu Dingqian’s pupils constricted as he considered a possibility: Could the bronze-masked saber wielder be Li Feiyu?
If it were Li Feiyu, then all his actions would be an attempt to cover up his tracks. The first time Li Feiyu appeared was at Tianxuan Mountain, facing a crisis and claiming to repay a debt of gratitude.
Now, a crisis was threatening to destroy the Canghai Sect, and yet again a mysterious True Martial Realm Emperor Wu showed up to solve the problem, with another unknown origin.
“How is that possible?”
Chu Dingqian sighed, feeling he was being overly suspicious. The bronze-masked saber wielder couldn’t be Li Feiyu.
Li Feiyu was skilled with the sword, while the bronze-masked wielder excelled with the saber, and their martial intentions were different; it was unlikely they were the same person.
Furthermore, there were no connections between the Canghai Sect and Tianxuan Mountain, nor between Li Feiyu and either, and Chu Dingqian was well aware of the details of the Canghai Sect—there were no True Martial Realm Emperor Wus behind it. Why would Li Feiyu bother to save the Canghai Sect?
At least Tianxuan Mountain was a branch of the Tai Xuan Sect in the Dao Domain, so it was feasible that Li Feiyu could have been requested by a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu of Tai Xuan Sect to come to the rescue.
“It seems they must come from the Sword Domain, a True Martial Realm indeed, but their intentions are unknown,” Chu Dingqian murmured to himself.
The Four Sacred Lands of the Human Clan include White Jade Capital from the Dao Domain, Xumi Mountain from the Buddha Domain, Heavenly Demon Hall from the Devil Region, and the House of Divine Armies from the Sword Domain.
The sword is considered the king of all weapons and is the most commonly used in the Sword Domain, which boasts the highest number of strong practitioners. Consequently, the domain housing the House of Divine Armies is known as the Sword Domain.
The second most prevalent and powerful group in the Sword Domain are the saber wielders. In addition to swords and sabers, the domain contains cultivators who specialize in spears, halberds, axes, maces, hooks, forks, whips, clubs, hammers, and more, although their numbers are significantly fewer than those who wield swords and sabers.
As one of the Four Great Sacred Lands of the Human Clan, the House of Divine Armies is not only powerful and profound, but it is also skilled in crafting magical treasures, having forged numerous Spiritual Artifacts, Magical Treasures, Divine Weapons, and Emperor Weapons. It is rumored that the House has even created several Immortal Artifacts.
At least one-third of the weapons in Qianyuan Divine Province are produced by the House of Divine Armies, and countless cultivators hold it in high regard, for it provides the opportunity to acquire powerful Heaven Rank Artifacts, Divine Weapons, and even Emperor Weapons at a relatively low cost.
The House of Divine Armies has a place called Thousand Soldiers Alley. For a fee of one hundred Top Quality Spirit Stones, one can stay there for half a day, where countless weapons are available, ranging from Heaven Rank Lower Grade Magical Treasures to Emperor Weapons.
As long as one receives the acknowledgment of a weapon, it can be drawn and taken away. Even if unsuccessful, one parting gift of an Earth-Level Lower Rank Magical Treasure awaits upon leaving.
The admission fee of one hundred Top Quality Spirit Stones is quite steep, equating to one million Lower Grade Spirit Stones. However, it is significantly less than the value of the Divine Weapons in Thousand Soldiers Alley.

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - 173: Devil Princess and Senior Sister Have Children, Married Twice, Took Five Concubines_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 173: Devil Princess and Senior Sister Have Children, Married Twice, Took Five Concubines_2
Translator: 549690339
Just a single Heaven Rank Lower Grade magical treasure would require at least two thousand top quality spirit stones on the market, not to mention divine weapons and imperial weapons, whose values are immeasurable.
Even Earth-Level Lower Rank magical treasures are not cheap, with market prices requiring three hundred thousand lower grade spirit stones, of course the cost for House of Divine Armies is much lesser, offering magical treasures to the losers as consolation, encouraging them to come again.
For tens of thousands of years, innumerable cultivators have tried their luck at the Thousand Soldiers Alley of the House of Divine Armies; most set out with high hopes only to return disappointed, but a few have succeeded, and that depended on fate.
Some were able to obtain Heaven Rank artifacts, some divine weapons, and even rarer were those favored by imperial weapons, who from then on were invincible and rose meteorically, standing tall above the nine heavens.
“Sigh~”
Chu Dingqian sighed at the thought of Thousand Soldiers Alley, as he had spent over a thousand top quality spirit stones there and had not succeeded once.
Glancing at the Soul-Cultivating Furnace in front of him, Chu Dingqian closed his eyes and continued nourishing the Devil Fetus.
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
Han Li and Jiang Baiye stood atop Chengdao Peak, looking like a pair of celestial lovers, stunning to behold.
“Husband, thank you.” Jiang Baiye’s words were gentle, her face filled with gratitude.
“We don’t need to say such things.” Han Li held Jiang Baiye in his embrace, sealing her exquisite red lips with his.
After some time, Jiang Baiye responded softly with a “Mm.”
Her face was filled with happiness; her husband’s unwavering sincere heart towards her had never changed, he did not neglect her even when the number of wives and concubines increased.
Jiang Baiye looked at her husband’s profile and silently agreed to a certain request Han Li had made.
This time, by solving a crisis for the Canghai Sect, Han Li indeed rendered a great service.
The leaders of Ji Feng Hall and several other Dongxu Stage Forces died at the gates of Canghai Sect, allowing the Canghai Sect to absorb their foundations, instantly increasing their own substantially.
Moreover, after that, there were no longer any powers in Jizhou to compete with the Canghai Sect. It became the strongest force in Jizhou and would continue to develop and grow stronger.
All these were thanks to her husband’s help, and Jiang Baiye remembered them all in her heart.
After the couple had their sweet time on the mountain peak, Jiang Baiye left. She needed to continue her cultivation, aiming to advance to the Hollow Void Stage as soon as possible.
Once Jiang Baiye had left, Han Li prepared to return to The Li Manor to check on things but suddenly paused in his tracks as his spiritual sense picked up something odd about Gongsun Yue.
Without hesitation, Han Li went to Gongsun Yue’s side and took her delicate, boneless hand, asking softly, “Yue’er, what are you thinking about?”
“Ah~ Nothing…” Gongsun Yue snapped back to reality and, seeing it was her husband Han Li, a flicker of panic crossed her eyes.
Han Li pulled her into his arms and gently nibbled on her delicate earlobe while continuously blowing warm breaths, “What’s wrong? You can tell your husband anything.”
Feeling the warm breath, Gongsun Yue became tingling and softly trembled; her tender, pink lips parted as she said, “Husband, I’ve been missing my father.”
Having been on Chengsheng Mountain for nearly a year now, Gongsun Yue indeed missed her home. It was the first time she had been away from home for so long since she had lived on Tianxuan Mountain and spent every day with her father.
“Silly Yue’er, if you miss home just tell your husband. I will take you to visit,” Han Li said with a smile, caressing her purple hair.
“But husband, you’re very busy…” Gongsun Yue said, her head bowed and her cheeks flushed with shyness.
Han Li lifted her head to look into her eyes and spoke sincerely, “Yue’er, you are my beloved wife; no matter how busy I am, I will make time for you.”
“You must know, in my eyes, you are the best, first among the world, the very highest of them all.”
Gongsun Yue’s eyes reddened slightly, and she replied earnestly, “Mm~”
“Husband, then let’s go back next month,” Gongsun Yue said after moistening her red lips.
Han Li immediately understood her meaning; his senior sister’s belly was quite large now, and she was due in half a month.
She also remembered what her husband had meant by wanting to keep things quiet for now, so Gongsun Yue decided to wait until the child was born before returning home. That way, her father Gongsun Yun wouldn’t be able to tell.
Han Li was moved in his heart and held her tightly in his embrace, whispering softly, “Yue’er, it’s actually okay to go back now if we want.”
Gongsun Yue lightly shook her head.
Han Li nodded, unable to resist and captured her soft lips once more.
After spending some time together alone with his senior sister Gongsun Yue, Han Li leisurely left and returned to The Li Manor, to the Chong Xiao Pavilion.
Han Li found that his wife in The Li Manor, Xue Qingyi, was actually standing there as if waiting for his return.
When Han Li appeared, Xue Qingyi immediately smelled the fragrances on him, more than one, her eyebrows knitting slightly as she speculated in her heart, but she did not voice it out.
“Husband~” Xue Qingyi’s voice rang out like silver bells, her face adorned with a smile.
“Yi’er.”
Han Li raised an eyebrow, having detected her previous frown, he sighed inwardly but did not explain as he did not wish to tell Xue Qingyi yet.
Might as well wait for some time; it wouldn’t be too late to tell Xue Qingyi after their child was born, and during this period, it could help Xue Qingyi settle her feelings.
Xue Qingyi was the one who took the initiative to marry into The Li Manor and become his wife, but it wasn’t out of overwhelming love or adoration for him. Han Li knew her goals and did not reject them.
With Xue Qingyi herself being incomparably stunning and having given herself to him as a maiden, now also carrying his child.
After some more time, once Xue Qingyi’s heart was settled, Han Li would then share some of his own secrets with her; otherwise, he could not tell her.
“Husband, I’d like to see the ocean.”
Snuggled in Han Li’s embrace, Xue Qingyi’s emotions were complex as she suddenly spoke out.
Han Li gave her a look and nodded without asking the reason.

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - 173: Devil Princess and Senior Sister Have Children, Married Twice, Took Five Concubines_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 173: Devil Princess and Senior Sister Have Children, Married Twice, Took Five Concubines_3
Translator: 549690339
Han Li held Xue Qingyi in his arms as the two of them disappeared from the Chong Xiao Pavilion, heading towards the East Sea.
The Daqian Empire was located in the eastern part of the Xuan Domain. Starting from the Daqian Empire, one could reach the East Sea by passing through either the Chaotic Domain or the Dao Domain.
For safety reasons, Han Li chose to travel to the East Sea through the Dao Domain.
With his speed, he could traverse nearly four hundred thousand li in a single breath, a speed that could be termed extreme. Although the Daqian Empire was a great distance from the East Sea, spanning hundreds of millions of li, distance was not an issue for an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm.
When the couple arrived at the edge of the East Sea and stood atop a sea cliff, Xue Qingyi couldn’t help feeling amazed and exclaimed, “That was really fast;”
Han Li nodded slightly. Indeed, the speed was incredibly fast; it had taken him just over half an hour to travel from the Capital City of Da Qian to the shore of the East Sea.
“The True Martial Realm is truly powerful to the extreme, not only in strength but also in speed, far beyond my imagination,”
Xue Qingyi said softly, her eyes filled with ambition, now even more eager to cultivate to the True Martial Realm.
For her, a cultivator in the God Refining Realm, traveling from the Capital City of Da Qian to the shore of the East Sea would take a very long time. Her speed allowed her to traverse only a few hundred li in a single breath, and even with unlimited Gang Yuan and ceaseless flight without rest, it would take her over a hundred days.
Just by making a brief comparison, Xue Qingyi realized how vast the gap between her and her husband was, with speed being just one aspect of strength.
The gap between the God Refining Realm and the True Martial Realm may seem to be only two Big Realms apart—Hollow Void Stage and Myriad Phenomena Realm—but how many times greater was the disparity in strength?
“With Yi’er’s qualifications, there is hope for you to advance to the True Martial Realm in the future,” Han Li remarked, his big hand mischievously wandering.
Xue Qingyi nodded, not stopping his movements. She felt it was only natural, being his wife; she had given everything to her husband, and a little touch was nothing, as she was not the kind of female cultivator with a thin skin.
“The East Sea is indeed vast and magnificent,” Xue Qingyi observed, turning toward the sea, her eyes shining with wonder.
She had lived for decades, and this was her first time seeing the East Sea. Although she had always wanted to see the ocean, she had never had the chance before.
The East Sea was too far from the Daqian Empire, with endless dangers along the way. With a low level of cultivation, not only would one have to spend a considerable amount of time, but one might also perish on the journey.
Han Li nodded slightly. It was also his first time seeing the East Sea, vast and limitless, and suddenly, he felt inspired to recite a poem.
After searching in his mind for a while, Han Li found a poem by a chancellor and began to recite:
“I face the stone cliffs of the East, to behold the vastness of the blue sea. The waters run deep and still, islands stand tall and sheer.
Trees and vegetation thrive, the grass is lush and green. The autumn wind harsh and cold, great waves surge in response.
The sun and the moon traverse the sky, as if emerging from within; the stars glitter brightly, as if they come forth from below.
So very fortunate am I, to express my aspirations through this song;”
As Han Li recited this poem, looking out over the turbulent vastness of the East Sea, his thoughts were on immortality and eternal life, standing tall through an endless age, looking down upon the cycle of reincarnation.
Xue Qingyi watched her husband in surprise, nodding slightly, as if finding it to be expected.
With her husband’s refined and scholarly appearance, it was not strange that he had such talent.
Pondering over her husband’s poem, Xue Qingyi felt secretly astonished; the vision expressed was indeed lofty, full of even more ambition than hers.
Perhaps her husband wasn’t as the outer world and she herself had thought, someone who chose to settle in the Da Qian, establishing The Li Manor and producing offspring after believing he could no longer advance in cultivation.
There must be deeper meanings behind it, but Xue Qingyi couldn’t guess what they were.
In the past, she might have thought it had to do with gathering vitality, but as Li Feiyu’s wife, she had a significant say, and indeed, her husband had never done such a thing.
After observing the East Sea for a long time, the two returned to the Capital City of Da Qian, safely and without incident.
In the following days, Han Li spent his time shuttling between The Li Manor and Han Mansion, accompanying his beloved wives and consorts, living an easy and carefree divine existence.
Seven days later, at Han Mansion.
Han Li was pacing back and forth in Yun Miaoyi’s bedroom, awaiting joyful news.
Yun Miaoyi was finally giving birth. This Devil Princess had married him and been his wife for ten months, and the fruit of their union was about to be born.
When a clear and bright cry was heard, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face; he approached Yun Miaoyi’s side.
Having just given birth, Yun Miaoyi was greatly depleted in vital energy, looking quite pale, yet her face was full of joy.
“Yunyun,”
Han Li sat by the bedside, tightly holding her hand, channeling an abundance of gentle True Yuan to regulate her body. He personally fed her the nourishing holy items he had prepared.
Only after Yun Miaoyi’s complexion had turned rosy did Han Li look at the child in the maid’s arms and suggest, “A boy; how about calling him Han Yongyun?”
“Whatever the husband decides is good,”
Yun Miaoyi nodded, a flicker of satisfaction crossing her eyes upon hearing the name.
Yun, signifying clouds, following her husband’s recent naming convention; if the child was a boy, he would be named Han Yongyun, and if a girl, Han Yongyun, which Yun Miaoyi thought very fitting.
Han Li held Han Yongyun and noticed how his appearance was pleasantly plump and smooth, not wrinkled and old-looking like that of an ordinary mortal baby.
He looked the baby over and found that some features resembled him, while some resembled Yun Miaoyi. The child would grow into a handsome man.
As for the genes of Han Mansion, Han Li was extremely satisfied, his own appearance being handsome and imposing, and his wives and consorts all stunning beauties, resulting in offspring who were also handsome boys and pretty girls.
“Husband, let me hold him,” Yun Miaoyi requested softly, and then carefully took Han Yongyun, her eyes full of maternal affection.
Han Li watched this scene quietly, simultaneously checking his personal panel.
His attribute in the qualifications section had increased, and although he had not yet advanced, he was not far from reaching the Third Grade.

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 173: Devil Princess and Senior Sister Have Children, Married Twice, Took Five Concubines_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 173: Devil Princess and Senior Sister Have Children, Married Twice, Took Five Concubines_4
Translator: 549690339
Han Yongyun had a Fourth Grade aptitude, and by imparting one tenth of that aptitude to him, Han Li’s aptitude increased to about 65% of the Fourth Grade.
In about ten days, Gongsun Yue’s child would also be born, which would most likely increase his aptitude by another 10%. By then, he would only need one more quarter to reach the Third Grade aptitude.
In the blink of an eye, ten days passed.
During these days, Han Li did not take any more concubines under his two identities; he wanted to wait until his beloved wife Gongsun Yue gave birth before considering the matter of taking concubines.
On the day when Gongsun Yue was due to give birth, Han Li accompanied her early in the morning and waited in her bedchamber.
Before long, Gongsun Yue gave birth to her first child, who was also a boy.
Han Li, as usual, came to Gongsun Yue’s side, caring for her attentively, showering her with meticulous care and concern, and tending to her physical recovery.
When all was done, Han Li spoke to Gongsun Yue, “Yue’er, let’s name this child Han Yongyang. What do you think?”
Gongsun Yue said, “I’ll listen to my husband~”
Gongsun Yue had anticipated this name, and her heart filled with joy; her husband indeed did not favor one over the other.
Her son was named Han Yongyang, and if they had a daughter in the future, she would be named Han Yongyue. Both names carried the love her husband had for her.
“As long as Yue’er is happy, that’s good.”
Han Li bent down and kissed Gongsun Yue’s forehead; she promptly closed her eyes.
Seven days after Gongsun Yue gave birth to Han Yongyang, Han Li took Gongsun Yue back to Tianxuan Mountain Gate, now part of the Qitian Teaching territory.
Gongsun Yue and Gongsun Yun had endless conversations. The old father Gongsun Yun kept asking if his daughter had been well, where she had been, and what she had experienced…
Gongsun Yue answered all his questions, but she kept the secrets about Han Li to herself and temporarily concealed their marital status.
Gongsun Yun did not know that Han Li was indeed Li Feiyu, and he was eternally grateful to Li Feiyu for looking after his daughter’s safety while she was away.
Gongsun Yun had long been aware of Li Feiyu’s role in stabilizing Da Qian. Although he found it somewhat unexpected, he was not surprised; Li Feiyu was indeed the best candidate to save the Daqian Empire.
After the father and daughter had finished catching up, Han Li took Gongsun Yue to leave. Old father Gongsun Yun was very reluctant, feeling that there was something different about his daughter’s return, but he couldn’t pinpoint exactly what it was.
Several months passed since they returned from Tianxuan Mountain, leaving less than three months until the emergence of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
During these months, both Han Li’s true identity and his alias, Li Feiyu, married and took concubines repeatedly.
Han Li took in three beautiful concubines at once; the three beautiful women were a master and disciple trio, one with Sixth-grade aptitude, and two with Seventh-grade aptitude, all stunningly beautiful in appearance and figure, meeting Han Li’s requirements for taking concubines.
The trio, a master and her disciples, had fled from Yonchang Manor and only had cultivation in the Pihai Realm. They were being pursued by enemies and eventually fled to Chengsheng Mountain, where Han Li discovered them, casually resolved their troubles, and then took them in as beautiful concubines.
Now the trio, all pregnant with Han Li’s children, were already two months along.
Elsewhere, in Li Mansion, Han Li wedded and took concubines five times, marrying two wives and taking five beautiful concubines.
The second wife of the Li Manor was named Chu Xianlin with Fourth Grade aptitude and cultivation at the Hollow Void Stage. She was a sect leader. However, her sect was suppressed by a Myriad Phenomena Realm force that had relocated and taken over its resources and territory, causing many disciples to defect.
Chu Xianlin, in a fit of anger, led her favorite female disciple, a Fifth-grade aptitude beauty in the Gang Yuan Realm, to the Capital City and voluntarily entered the Li Manor.
Chu Xianlin became Han Li’s second wife, and her disciple became one of his concubines.
The third wife of the Li Manor was named Song Zhixuan, also with Fourth Grade aptitude and even more beautiful than Chu Xianlin and Xue Qingyi, but with lower cultivation, only at the Gang Yuan Realm.
Song Zhixuan came from a God Refining Realm force outside the Capital City; her marriage into the Li Manor was partly voluntary, influenced by her sect, and in part her desire.
For such an unparalleled beauty with high aptitude, Han Li generously gave Song Zhixuan the status of a wife, which made both her and her backing force very happy.
The other four concubines came from various forces within and outside the Capital City, three with Sixth-grade aptitude and one with Fifth-grade aptitude. Because all had beauty scores of eighty-five or higher, Han Li accepted them all.
For these beautiful female cultivators who were still virgins, as long as they met the standards, Han Li would take as many as were available.
A body comparable to the True Martial Realm was so formidable; he was not the slightest bit concerned about any frailty.
Through the relentless efforts of the old ancestor Han, Chu Xianlin, Song Zhixuan, and the rest of the delicate wives and beautiful concubines also successively became pregnant.
PS: The second update; today I’ve written 12,000 words, continuing to write. At the very least, today I will update 20,000 words.

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - 174: System Upgrade! All-new Benefits! Breakthrough to the True Martial Realm! (Long Chapter, Please Subscribe)_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 174: System Upgrade! All-new Benefits! Breakthrough to the True Martial Realm! (Long Chapter, Please Subscribe)_1
Translator: 549690339
On this day, Han Li was playing a game of eagle catching chicks at Chengdao Peak.
This time he changed the way he played; Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Qiu Yueyao, Chu Yutong, and other charming wives and concubines blindfolded their eyes while Han Li did the catching.
To ensure fairness, Han Li sealed his own cultivation level. Of course, he did not seal his physical body, and some of his wives and concubines had their cultivation levels sealed as well, retaining only the power of the Pihai Realm.
Although the physical strength of Ancestor Han could be compared to a cultivator of the True Martial Realm, he held back his power, using only the strength and speed of the Gangyuan Realm, which made the game more fun.
Otherwise, with his level of cultivation, it wouldn’t have mattered if his wives and concubines were all blindfolded or not; he could still catch a bunch of them easily.
After about half an hour of this playful activity, Ancestor Han captured all his wives and concubines, and although women such as Lu Tianxiang and Yun Miaoyi were somewhat unwilling, they obediently accepted the punishment.
The punishment was for them to take out the fruits they had prepared, such as grapes and peaches, and line up to feed them to Ancestor Han.
Feeling immensely happy, Ancestor Han basked in his joy as his wives and concubines were also pleased, the occasional gathering serving to relieve the fatigue from cultivation.
When the punishment session ended, and the wives and concubines dispersed, Han Li was about to head to the Li Manor when a series of prompt tones echoed in his mind, instantly stopping him in his tracks, his face showing excitement.
“Your progeny count has reached one thousand; you receive four hundred years of cultivation, fifty Pihai Pills, twenty Gather Gang Pills, and five Immortal Conservation Pills, you also gain three hundred years of formation experience, and you acquire a Heaven Rank Lower Grade martial skill ‘Buddha Dominance over Hell Seal.’”
“Ding~ Due to the master’s progeny successfully reaching one thousand, the Longevity Family System will be upgraded, upgrading in progress… Please wait!”
“Upgrade Progress 1%… 10%… 50%… 95%…”
“Ding~ System upgrade successful, Longevity Family System upgraded to version 2.0, for detailed contents please check by yourself.”
“Hoo~”
With a flash step, Han Li arrived at the peak of Chengdao Peak and had to exhale several breaths before he could barely calm his excited mood.
Even though he was already a super expert with late-stage True Martial Realm combat ability, he was still extremely excited in the face of these system prompts.
Mainly because the rewards and system updates this time were incredibly empowering, a leap like never before.
Han Li opened the system message panel and clicked on the first system prompt, savoring the details.
Seeing the rewards displayed, although Han Li already had some expectations, he was still overcome with excitement, as the rewards were many times more generous than he had anticipated.
When the number of offspring reached one hundred in previous stages, he was only awarded fifty years of cultivation, but this time, with a thousand, he was given a full four hundred years!
That was four hundred years of cultivation!
Previously, it took Han Li a long time to accumulate almost four hundred years of cultivation, and he only needed six hundred years to advance to the True Martial Realm.
Originally, he had accumulated 458 years of cultivation, plus the one hundred years from the new hundred descendants, together with the reward of four hundred years of cultivation, Han Li’s accumulation reached an astonishing…
958 years!
Nearly a thousand years of cultivation; an unimaginable feat as he would normally be doing very well to accumulate two or three hundred years. This time, he was close to a millennium.
Even if he spent six hundred years of cultivation to advance to the True Martial Realm, becoming Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, he would still have over three hundred years left, which he believed could be used to advance a few minor realms.
As for the awarded medicine pills, the quantity had also greatly increased. Before, there were just a few Pihai Pills and Gather Gang Pills, but now there were directly fifty Pihai Pills, twenty Gather Gang Pills, plus an addition of five Immortal Conservation Pills.
Han Li could only say it was worthy of the Longevity Family System; these pills were clearly meant to cultivate the family. Seventy-five pills could create five God Refining Realm true people, twenty Peak of Gangyuan Realm great masters, and fifty Pihai Realm cultivators.
The Han Mansion already had many pills that increased cultivation, such as the Open Sea Pill for the Pihai Realm, the Condense Gang Pill for the Gangyuan Realm, the Mental Cultivating Pill for the God Refining Realm, and several others for each realm.
Han Li had originally gathered some, and he obtained even more from the Daqian Empire, which greatly enhanced the foundation of the Han Mansion.
With such a bounty of pills now, building a complete family talent cultivation mechanism was entirely possible.
For instance, a heavily invested descendant, upon reaching the peak of the Innate Realm, can be aided with a Pihai Pill to breakthrough to the Pihai Realm. Then provide him with Open Sea Pills and other cultivation improving pills to cultivate all the way to the peak of the Pihai Realm… Once he reaches the Peak of Gangyuan Realm, grant him the Immortal Conservation Pill, and once he breaks through to the God Refining Realm, give him the Mental Cultivating Pill.
Following this process, a cultivator with a sixth-grade aptitude could advance to the peak of the God Refining Realm in just ten years, with the cultivation time being even shorter for those with better aptitudes.
“Those Divine Yuan Realm powers and even the Sacred Lands are terrifying,” Han Li couldn’t help exclaiming.
The Qian Dynasty also had pills that helped people break through the Pihai, Gangyuan, and even God Refining Realms. For the Qian Dynasty, only the Hollow Void Stage and Myriad Phenomena Realm were considered the backbone of their strength; they couldn’t cultivate them with pills.
As for powers like the Ancient Empire, which had the Divine Yuan Realm status, they likely had Spirit Pills to help one break through to the Hollow Void Stage. These kinds of pills would definitely be exceedingly costly, and ordinary God Refining Realm cultivators could bankrupt themselves and still not afford one.
And the Four Great Sacred Lands with the deepest foundations had many Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. This must be because they possess pills that help Hollow Realm Masters break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and possibly even pills that assist in ascending to the True Martial Realm.
The ingredients required for the pills that assist in ascending to the True Martial Realm would be of extremely high quality, and the cost of production is unimaginable. Although the Sacred Land’s foundations are profound, they likely cannot produce too many, after all, this is not the Ancient Times.

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - 174: System Upgrade! All-new Benefits! Breakthrough to the True Martial Realm! (Long Chapter, Please Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 174: System Upgrade! All-new Benefits! Breakthrough to the True Martial Realm! (Long Chapter, Please Subscribe)_2
Translator: 549690339
The Spiritual Energy in the Qianyuan Divine Province has declined significantly, and various spiritual medicines, treasures, and heavenly medicines are in short supply due to reduced production.
“The responsibility is significant, and the journey is long,” Han Li murmured as he shook his head slightly.
Han Mansion’s current foundation barely compares with the Daqian Empire, yet the gap is still too vast compared to Shenyuan Realm Powers and Sacred Lands.
However, Han Li knew better than to rush. His family might not compare now, but what about in a hundred years, or even a thousand?
Sacred Lands would one day bow before Han Mansion!
Now that he possessed elixirs of three Big Realms and the Rebirth Pill, he had enough to clear the path for the descendants of Han Mansion to break through to the Hollow Void Stage.
Provided they focused on development for a few centuries, when Han Mansion finally bared its fangs, even the Four Great Sacred Lands would tremble. By then, they would realize that a power comparable to their own, perhaps even greater, had risen quietly.
Collecting his thoughts and regaining some composure, Han Li continued examining the rewards.
The last phase’s reward was only three items, but this time there were indeed four, including the experience in the Four Arts of Cultivation.
Three hundred years of formation experience!
Even Han Li was taken aback; when the talent of his descendants reached levels of one or two hundred, the reward was merely a hundred years of experience.
Already a top Seventh Grade Formation Master, a hundred years of formation experience was sufficient for him to advance to an average Fifth Grade Formation Master. What about three hundred years of experience?
Could it elevate him to a Fourth Grade or a Third Grade Formation Master?
Han Li’s breathing accelerated slightly. If he could become a Third Grade Formation Master directly, the boost to his combat ability would be enormous.
A Third Grade Formation Master could set up formations at the True Martial Realm level. With skillful use, they could easily annihilate a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, and with a sufficiently powerful killing formation, even a late-stage True Martial Realm Emperor Wu could not escape death.
“As I expected,” he murmured with a smile when he looked at the last reward.
He had guessed that a Heavenly Immortal Grade Martial Skill would appear when the total number of descendants exceeded a thousand, and now it had indeed appeared.
Heaven Rank Lower Grade Martial Skill: Buddha Subduing Prison Seal!
This martial skill had only three moves: Buddha Seal, Prison Seal, and Buddha Subduing Prison—each one more powerful and ferocious than the last.
After some thought, Han Li decided not to look at the subsequent enhancements. Instead, he planned to first claim the reward for reaching a thousand descendants.
He took out seventy-five pills and placed them into his Spatial Bracelet, preparing them for the cultivation of those members of his family listed for key training.
Next, Han Li claimed the three hundred years of formation experience. In an instant, a wealth of formation knowledge, deployment techniques, and blueprints surfaced in his mind. His powerful Divine Spirit absorbed, assimilated, and digested them.
It took him ten full breaths to fully absorb three hundred years of formation experience. His demeanor had grown more profound and steady.
“Sigh, as expected, I didn’t ascend to a Third Grade Formation Master,” he sighed. Three hundred years of formation experience was still not enough.
He underestimated the difficulty in advancing the grades of formation mastery. Three hundred years of experience had only allowed him to ascend to a mid-level Fourth Grade Formation Master.
To advance to a Third Grade Formation Master, he would need at least another two hundred years of experience.
Even though he hadn’t met his ultimate expectations, Han Li felt satisfied. At least, he was now a Fourth Grade Formation Master, which meant he could create his own Fourth Grade formations.
If he had the blueprint and materials, he could also set up Third Grade formations, but it would require much more time than it would for a Third Grade Formation Master.
Exhaling, Han Li didn’t linger and claimed the Heaven Rank Lower Grade Martial Skill, Buddha Subduing Prison Seal.
At that moment, golden scriptures appeared in Han Li’s mind. They exploded into a vast array of cultivation experiences, application insights, and combat images…
With his Divine Spirit, equivalent to the Second Layer of the True Martial Realm, operating at full capacity, Han Li rapidly absorbed and digested the Buddha Subduing Prison Seal.
“Excellent!”
With the martial skill fully mastered, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face as his overall strength took another leap forward.
Previously, he only matched the late-stage True Martial Realm combat ability when executing the Six Harmonies Eight Wastes Fist, but now he could also match it using the Buddha Subduing Prison Seal. This provided greater security and more techniques at his disposal.
The Buddha Subduing Prison Seal was only a Heaven Rank Lower Grade Martial Skill, yet with the enhancement of his all-encompassing martial dao embryo, it nearly rivaled a Heaven Rank Supreme Grade Martial Skill.
Han Li knew it was due to his exceptionally high-grade martial dao, a legendary ultimate martial dao that reigned above all others. It included time, fate, causality, reincarnation, and other martial daos, making lower-grade martial skills elevate many grades and exhibit might far beyond their own.
Perhaps only those martial skills from the Immortal Domain, which belonged to immortals, would see diminished enhancement from his all-encompassing martial dao. Han Li wasn’t sure since he was at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Immortal Scriptures and Immortal Grade Martial Skills were still far too out of reach for him—so distant he didn’t know how many years it would take before he could encounter them.
Glancing at his cultivation panel showing 958 years, Han Li hesitated about whether to break through and ascend to the True Martial Realm immediately.
His talent had already improved to 79% at the Fourth Grade. He was only 21% away from ascending to Third Grade talent. If he waited until he reached Third Grade talent, the amount of cultivation needed to ascend to the True Martial Realm would be significantly reduced.
To be honest, Han Li was tempted—very much so.

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - 174: System Upgrade! All-new Benefits! Breakthrough to the True Martial Realm! (Long Chapter, Please Subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 174: System Upgrade! All-new Benefits! Breakthrough to the True Martial Realm! (Long Chapter, Please Subscribe)_3
Translator: 549690339
All three of Han Li’s wives at the Li Manor could bear offspring with Fourth Grade aptitude, among whom Xue Qingyi was less than half a year away from giving birth, while Chu Xianlin and Song Zhixuan had just recently become pregnant, needing approximately eight and nine months, respectively.
However, Han Li also had many other concubines at the Li Manor, whose offspring would be born in four or five months.
They all had Fifth or Sixth Grade aptitudes, and Han Li himself possessed Fourth Grade aptitude. The greatest possibility for their first child was to have Fifth Grade aptitude, although it was also possible to have Fourth or Sixth Grade aptitude.
Han Li believed that the birth of these descendants would be enough to elevate his aptitude to Third Grade.
But Han Li didn’t want to wait any longer.
There were just over two months left until the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm’s emergence, and it was highly unlikely he would reach Third Grade aptitude by then. Han Li also planned to capture a female Demon King and bring her back.
Rather than breaking through to the True Martial Realm when the time came, he’d prefer to break through now. Being stronger was always a good thing.
His combat ability was at the later stages of the True Martial Realm, so theoretically, it should be easy to capture the female Demon King, who was only at the early stages of the True Martial Realm. However, since the female Demon King came from the Demon Clan and was tasked with fighting for the Dragon Ball, who knew whether those Demon Emperors or even greater beings had given her powerful treasures?
He had to capture the female Demon King quickly, accurately, and ruthlessly, and then relocate her swiftly, lest the Demon Clan trace her whereabouts, which would be truly troublesome.
If a Demon Emperor were to take action because of this, Han Li felt that he wouldn’t be in for anything good.
Therefore, Han Li thought it would be safer to break through to the True Martial Realm. After advancing, his strength would see a significant increase, and he could at least reach the peak combat ability of the True Martial Realm.
By then, even if the female Demon King had any powerful treasures, Han Li would be able to easily suppress her. Should the Demon Emperor come to kill, he would also have the capability to resist for a while.
After making the decision, Han Li planned to check the rest of the System updates and then begin his breakthrough.
Hence, Han Li continued examining the System notifications. These were several upgrade prompts for the System. The Longevity Family System had evolved to version 2.0, seemingly with some added functions. Han Li immediately began to understand them.
The more Han Li browsed through the System update content, the more astonished he became, and his face soon revealed joy and excitement.
After some understanding, Han Li found that the System upgrade had added the following contents:
First, the System Space was unlocked. The System Space’s length, width, and height each measured ten thousand li. It could be used for storage, to harbor life, and also to block prying eyes.
If a life form wished to enter the System Space, it had to be voluntary; one could not force another into the System Space;
