Life forms could only stay in the System Space for one day, after which, if they did not leave, they would automatically die, unless the being had become immortal. Otherwise, they could not resist the related rules.
Second, mutual cultivation benefits. Wives and concubines who dual cultivate with the master will enjoy the effects of dual cultivation, but only the cultivation of the wives and concubines will improve. This effect is ineffective for the master.
The prerequisite for enjoying the benefits of dual cultivation is to become the master’s wife or concubine through an official wedding ceremony; otherwise, it is invalid.
The effect of dual cultivation depends on the master’s realm. For example, if Han Li is in the True Martial Realm, then his wives and concubines are considered to be dual cultivating with someone at the True Martial Realm, and they will receive a corresponding increase in their dual cultivation cultivation level.
Third, the System has unlocked the Treasure Box function. It automatically refreshes once a year, and the treasure box will contain one treasure, the grade of which will depend on the master’s realm, plus or minus four grades.
There are three chances for active refresh every month: the first one requiring five years of cultivation, the second fifty years, and the third five hundred years.
Seeing the new functions added to the System, Han Li was so delighted he almost cheered. The System was indeed powerful.
With the System Space, he could retire his Spatial Bracelet. With its length, width, and height each measuring ten thousand li, its size was immense, capable of containing countless items.
From now on, storing his items in the System Space meant he no longer had to worry about his Spatial Bracelet being destroyed in battle and the treasures inside being shattered by the chaotic spatial flows.
He also didn’t need to worry about others stealing his Spatial Bracelet, and another feature of the System Space was its ability to block prying eyes.
This meant that if he could get his hands on someone else’s refined treasures and place them in the System Space, the original owners would not be able to track them down, having no idea where the treasures had gone.
What made Han Li most delighted was that the System Space could carry life; this was extremely domineering.
Although there was only one day’s time, Han Li felt it was completely sufficient.
With his current speed, he could travel at least two hundred million li in a quarter of an hour; in one day, he could cover the entire Qianyuan Divine Province.
The System Space was so vast that, in times of crisis, he could directly take all his beloved wives and beautiful concubines from the Han Mansion and the Li Manor, as well as their offspring and family members, all in one go.
As long as he released them within a day, there would be no problem at all.
This greatly increased Han Li’s ability to mitigate risks; he wouldn’t have to worry about his years of hard work being destroyed in an instant during an encounter with a major enemy, requiring him to start all over again, which would be truly lamentable.
The System Space might not compare to the small worlds that Han Li so desperately yearned for, but for the current Han Li, it was already enough.
Used properly, he could go anywhere beneath the heavens and earth, and his restrictions would be even fewer.
With the System Space, Han Li made a silent decision: once he cultivated to the Divine Yuan Realm, he would combine the Han Mansion and the Li Manor. This way, in times of emergency, he could directly take everyone with him; otherwise, mistakes might occur, potentially leading to the destruction of one of the families by the enemy.
The second function after the System upgrade also made Han Li very happy; he had been looking forward to this function, and now it was finally available.
The 1.0 version of the Longevity Family System could only allow him to rapidly increase his own cultivation, while the offspring were only being nurtured incidentally, relying on the medicinal pills rewarded by the System.

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - 174: System Upgrade! All-new Benefits! Breakthrough to the True Martial Realm! (Long Chapter, Please Subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 174: System Upgrade! All-new Benefits! Breakthrough to the True Martial Realm! (Long Chapter, Please Subscribe)_4
Translator: 549690339
But his delicate wives and beautiful concubines did not have such considerations; for them to improve their cultivation, they had to embark on arduous self-practice, which was incredibly difficult.
After all, many of the concubines had low aptitude, especially those who were married to him in the beginning, only having Eighth Grade or Ninth Grade talent. Fortunately, the Rebirth Pills had raised them to Fifth Grade.
Now, after the system upgrade, his wives could also enjoy the benefits of his golden touch—all they needed to do was dual cultivate with him more, and their cultivation would rapidly improve.
Although there were many restrictions and it was ineffective for him, Han Li was still very pleased. As long as his wives could rapidly improve their cultivation, that was enough; he didn’t need the effects of dual cultivation for himself to advance quickly—it was just icing on the cake.
He was about to reach the True Martial Realm, and by then, cultivating with his delicate wives would undoubtedly bring them a tremendous dual cultivation effect, causing their cultivation levels to surge dramatically.
After all, the lower the cultivation of these wives and concubines, the greater the effect of dual cultivation, in theory. Ideally, the cultivation levels of both parties should be similar for the benefits to be mutual. If the discrepancy in cultivation is too large, then it will have a low effect on the person with higher cultivation, but the effect will be substantial for the person with lower cultivation.
Han Li even suspected that if those wives in the Innate Realm or Pihai Realm dual cultivated with him just once, they might directly advance several minor realms or even break through a Big Realm.
Who told him to have such high cultivation?
Previously, Han Li had always been thinking about how to enhance the cultivation of his delicate wives and beautiful concubines. Relying on the System’s bestowed Spirit Pills was an unknown wait. Now, it would simply require dual cultivation.
Dual cultivation could improve the cultivation of his wives and concubines, procreate to extend his lineage, and also provide pleasure of body and mind; it was indeed killing several birds with one stone.
After sighing with emotion, Han Li continued to explore the third feature of the upgraded System.
Open treasure chests!
Han Li was not unfamiliar with this, but he didn’t expect his System to have this feature too; it was too reliant on luck, and without good fortune, one might not extract anything worthwhile.
According to the introduction, there is only one treasure chest per year given for free by the System.
If one wishes to open more treasure chests, one would have to consume cultivation, with only three opportunities each month, meaning that, at most, one could open thirty-seven treasure chests a year, provided Han Li had that much cultivation to spend.
“This is way too expensive…” Han Li couldn’t help but complain. It was a rip-off.
The first time each month costs five years of cultivation, and then it increases ten-fold— who can bear that?
If all thirty-six additional treasure chests were opened, it would cost a total of 6660 years of cultivation per year! Han Li could only describe this as: outrageous!
If he had 6660 years of cultivation per year, wouldn’t he prefer to directly enhance his cultivation to the Tongxuan Realm, the Saintly Abyss Realm, or even the Heaven Imperial Realm?
After thinking it over, Han Li felt that the only feasible approach was to open just one treasure chest every month. Spending five years of cultivation for the first chest each month was still acceptable to him.
This would result in him being able to open 13 treasure chests a year, costing just 60 years of cultivation, which was worth it as the gains outweighed the costs.
As for the second monthly treasure chest opening, it could be reserved for emergencies, to see if he could extract anything favorable to avert crises.
But the third time?
Is there even a third time for opening treasure chests?
Han Li felt there was not, estimating that he would not need it for a long time to come, until perhaps his cultivation was high and his family had many descendants. Then it might be playable.
Han Li thought it might only be possible after becoming a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, or even after ascending to immortality.
After finishing his grumbling, Han Li pondered the last rule a bit more: the treasure chest contains only one item, and its grade depends on his current realm plus or minus four grades.
For instance, Han Li was still in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, which corresponds to Earth-Level Top Grade and Earth-Level Supreme Grade treasure. Four grades down would include Profound Rank Top Grade and Profound Rank Supreme Grade, and four grades up would involve Heaven Rank Top Grade and Heaven Rank Supreme Grade.
Once Han Li’s cultivation advances to True Martial Realm, the treasure chest might yield anything from Earth-Level Lower Grade to Divine Rank Supreme Grade.
Han Li felt that this rule was still commendable. If he were lucky enough, he might get a Divine Weapon of the highest grade with just one free treasure chest opening.
You should know that even a complete Life-Prolonging Furnace is just a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon.
It’s just that Han Li was somewhat uncertain about his own luck, having never yet opened a treasure chest; he didn’t know if he was a jinx or a lucky emperor.
Han Li hoped that he was extremely lucky, preferably favored by Lady Luck herself. Otherwise, being a jinx would be too miserable.
Closing the System panel, Han Li took several deep breaths to calm his excitement.
Afterwards, his silhouette disappeared from the peak of Chengdao Peak.
In the next instant, Han Li appeared in his sleeping palace; he didn’t immediately begin his breakthrough but instead took out a variety of materials to start setting up a Formation.
The Han Mansion had a Third Grade Formation for family protection. The Formation Han Li was setting up was to conceal any commotion so that his breakthrough efforts wouldn’t be detected by others.
After a series of operations, Han Li had set up the Formation, then he sat cross-legged and began his breakthrough to the True Martial Realm.
Without hesitation, with a single thought, the breakthrough began.
While the cultivation value on his System account plummeted rapidly, Han Li’s aura skyrocketed, climbing higher and higher, ascending dramatically and causing a great commotion—all of which was concealed by the Formation.
At this moment, Han Li entered the Enlightenment State, experiencing several bursts of a hundred years in an instant; or to put it differently, this Enlightenment State lasted six times longer than before.
Within the Enlightenment State, Han Li spent six hundred years in that state, during which time he delved into mysteries, created laws, absorbed the essence of various martial arts techniques, contemplated the nature of the universe, and integrated everything into the true essence of his Universal Martial Path, continuously perfecting its embryonic form.

chapters.title: Chapter 263: 174
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: 174
Translator: 549690339
When six hundred years had passed, Han Li awoke from his Enlightenment State, yet in reality, only a very short amount of time had gone by.
The next instant, everything that Han Li had comprehended during those six hundred years flooded into his mind, where his Divine Spirit absorbed it frantically, continuously digesting the information.
Finally, the embryonic form of the omnipotent martial intent broke through its shackles, reaching a completion rate of 50%!
In that moment, Han Li’s cultivation level began soaring, his Divine Spirit also grew, his Spiritual Sense surged dramatically, his five senses were enhanced, and his physical strength was carried along, climbing towards a higher realm…
A spherical phantom gradually appeared above Han Li’s head, forged from the martial intent he refined, a combination of his Cultivation Techniques, martial skills, physical body, and all other transformations.
As Han Li’s cultivation level surged, the sphere also grew larger, gradually becoming rounder and more substantial.
This was the Martial True Pill!
Glowing threads appeared above the Martial True Pill, entwined with true intent, possessing immense might, capable of unleashing a horrific force.
At a certain moment, Han Li’s aura broke through some shackles, with the Martial True Pill completely solidifying, and his realm also passed through its limits, ascending from the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm to the first layer of the True Martial Realm.
The terrifying aura continuously bombarded the walls of the grand hall, all of which were masked by the previously arranged Formation. Not a single whiff of aura leaked out, so nobody knew that Han Li had successfully advanced to the True Martial Realm at that moment.
“Huff~”
Han Li exhaled, instantly forming an air sword that shot out, striking the Formation with ripples after ripples, revealing its formidable power.
Han Li glanced at the Martial True Pill above his head, which was now nearly tangible, although it was ultimately a false pill.
His Martial Intent was of such a high tier that merely perfecting it to 50% allowed him to break through to the True Martial Realm, whereas others needed 100% perfection just to break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, reflecting the vast disparity.
To avoid exposing his martial insights, the System helped him condense a Martial Fake Pill, comparable to a King Grade Pill, such that even the Divine Spirit Realm’s Emperor Wu or a mighty one from the Tongxuan Realm could not peer into his true strength.
Taking the Martial Fake Pill back into his body, Han Li immediately sensed his own state. He was now a genuine True Martial Realm fighter, though his realm was only at the first layer of the True Martial Realm.
But Han Li felt that, even if he were to fight with an Emperor Wu from the seventh layer of the True Martial Realm, he would be able to slap the opponent to death with one palm.
He discovered that the strength of his True Yuan had become stronger, and the reserves had significantly soared. Before the breakthrough, he was equivalent to the second layer of the True Martial Realm, and now his True Yuan reserves were enough to rival those of an Emperor Wu from the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
His Divine Spirit had surged, extremely potent, now roughly comparable to the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, and his Spiritual Sense was similarly nearly on par with the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, capable of covering a range of a full million miles.
This meant that Han Li could now expand his Spiritual Sense to its limits and cover any state within the Da Qian Empire, including those that had been lost.
His physical body also got strengthened during this breakthrough in cultivation, though the enhancement wasn’t substantial, it was still comparable to the second layer of the True Martial Realm now.
Han Li then attempted to stimulate his Divine Sense, his five senses having been greatly enhanced during this cultivation breakthrough, and he wanted to know what changes had occurred in the field of Divine Sense.
After some experimentation, Han Li understood the changes in his Divine Sense. The breakthrough into the True Martial Realm had taken him deeper into this mysterious field.
Previously, when stimulating his Divine Sense to enter this mystic field, all aspects of his abilities would increase fivefold, but now they could be enhanced tenfold.
Han Li thought this was not bad, as in the Nine Heavens of the True Martial Realm, there was a huge disparity in combat ability between each layer, and the higher one went, the more pronounced it was. If his Divine Sense could only increase his combat ability by five times, it would be of minor help to him, but now it still allowed his combat ability to advance by a small realm.
Besides that, the duration of the Divine Sense had also extended. Stimulating the Divine Sense once could now last for ten seconds, and continuously stimulating it three times could last for 27 seconds.
The interval between uses had also shortened again. Originally, it required fifteen minutes, now it only needed ten, and it could be used in succession for eight times, which means a total of eighty seconds of Divine Sense activation.
Han Li was very satisfied with this evolution, as the advancement of his Divine Sense was of much greater help to him.
After checking all his strength indicators, Han Li began testing his combat ability with the use of martial skills. Martial skills greatly enhance a cultivator’s combat ability, and depending on the grade of the martial skill, the unleashed might differs. If the grade of a martial skill is too low, it’s sometimes worse than fighting unarmed.
Han Li, however, was not worried about this. Although his martial skills weren’t of a very high grade, he possessed the embryonic form of the Omnipotent Martial Intent.
After the Omnipotent Martial Intent Embryo reached a 50% completion rate, it could finally enhance the might of martial skills by three grades.
Within the grand hall, Han Li practiced various martial skills, experiencing their newfound might, and indeed found them to be completely transformed, much improved from before.
For instance, the Earth-Level Lower Rank Dragon Suppressing Palm, with the support of the Omnipotent Martial Intent Embryo, was on par with a Supreme Grade Earth-Level martial skill, but such techniques could no longer keep up with Han Li’s strength.
Even after enhancement, the might was too low, only able to unleash the combat ability of the fifth heaven of the True Martial Realm. Although this was a significant improvement from the first heaven before, it was still inadequate.
Without utilizing martial skills, merely with True Yuan alone, Han Li could unleash the might of the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
PS: This mega-sized, over eight thousand words, incredibly powerful.
Today’s update exceeds twenty thousand words, asking for a wave of monthly ticket support!
With the System upgrade and the protagonist ascending to the True Martial Realm, the stage is set, and it’s time to commence a new storyline.

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - 175 Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Quasi Emperor Domain! Treasure Chest Explosion!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 175 Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Quasi Emperor Domain! Treasure Chest Explosion!_1
Translator: 549690339
Ordinary True Martial Realm beginners utilize Heaven Rank Lower and Middle Grade martial techniques; Earth Level Martial Arts no longer enhance their strength.
Although Han Li’s realm is only the first level of the True Martial Realm, his Divine Spirit, Spiritual Sense, and True Yuan reserves are equivalent to an ordinary True Martial Realm Sixth Heaven Emperor Wu.
Let alone Earth Level Martial Arts, even Heaven Rank Lower Grade martial techniques can no longer enhance his combat ability. Fortunately, with the embryonic form of his Omniscient Martial True Intent boosting him, most of the martial techniques he has mastered are between Heaven Rank Middle and High Grade, and even Supreme Grade, which can still elevate his combat power.
After the previous trials, Han Li had a clear understanding of his own strength after his breakthrough.
With the boost from the embryonic form of his Omniscient Martial True Intent, all the martial techniques he now wielded had risen by three grades, bursting forth with much more formidable might.
The Divine Desolation Prison Finger and the Seven Kills Blade were Earth-grade Middle Grade Martial Arts; after the boost, they were comparable to Heaven Rank Lower Grade martial techniques. Having cultivated them to perfection, Han Li could unleash combat power equivalent to half a step into the True Martial Realm Seventh Heaven.
The God Slaying Sword Technique was an Earth-grade Superior Martial Art; bolstered, it rivaled Heaven Rank Middle Grade martial techniques. Han Li had reached major accomplishment in it, able to release the combat power of the True Martial Realm’s Seventh Heaven.
The Five Elements Giant Palm Print, also an Earth-grade Superior Martial Art, when boosted, rivaled Heaven Rank Middle Grade martial techniques. Han Li had perfected its practice and could release power akin to half a step into the True Martial Realm Eighth Heaven.
The Xuantian Punch and the Yin and Yang Palm Seal were Earth-Level Extreme Martial Arts, and post-boost, they matched Heaven Rank High Grade Martial Techniques. With major accomplishment in these, Han Li could unleash the combat power of the True Martial Realm Eighth Heaven.
The Sealing Heaven Sword Scripture was an Earth-Level Extreme Martial Art; after the boost, it matched Heaven Rank High Grade Martial Techniques. Perfected by Han Li, it could unleash power akin to half a step into the True Martial Realm Ninth Heaven.
When deploying the Sealing Heaven Sword Scripture with the Heaven Rank High Grade Sword, Dragon Abyss Sword, its might could be further elevated to rival the combat power of the True Martial Realm Ninth Heaven.
The Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Fist and the Buddha’s Prison Seal were Heaven Rank Lower Grade martial techniques; post-boost, they matched Heaven Rank Supreme Grade martial techniques. With them perfected, Han Li could explode with the pinnacle combat abilities of the True Martial Realm.
The peak of the True Martial Realm, the fully realized True Martial Realm Ninth Heaven, represents a unique state.
Each realm is divided into Nine Heavens, and further categorized into the early, middle, late, and peak stages—first to third heaven as the early stage, fourth to sixth heaven as middle, and seventh to ninth heaven as late.
Those who perfect the Ninth Heaven stand at the peak, a half-step from the next Big Realm, and also bear another moniker.
For instance, the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm is called “half-step True Martial Realm,” the peak of the True Martial Realm is referred to as “half-step Divine Yuan Realm,”…; the peak of the Saint Abyss Realm isn’t called “half-step Heaven Imperial Realm” or “half-step Great Emperor,” but “Great Saint.”
Though the Great Saint and the Heaven Imperial Realm seem only a half-step apart, in reality, the difference is quite substantial. Cultivators who reach the Great Saint must ascend to another domain and then elevate once more to step into the Heaven Imperial Realm.
The intermediate domain is known as the Quasi Emperor Realm. To become an Emperor, one must first become a Quasi Emperor, a challenge that has vexed countless Great Saints, not to mention the arduous transition from Quasi Emperor to Great Emperor.
Originally, there was no Quasi Emperor Realm between the Great Saint and the Great Emperor, but forebearers discovered a vast gap between these two realms, blocking numerous Great Saints, leading to the creation of the Quasi Emperor Realm.
First stepping into the Quasi Emperor, and then into the Great Emperor, is relatively much easier.
Directly transitioning from Great Saint to Great Emperor is extremely difficult, but if one first steps into the Quasi Emperor, then attempting to enter the Great Emperor becomes more than ten times easier.
“Half-step Emperor Wu, how strong I truly am,” Han Li mused to himself as he stood up and looked at his hands, never before feeling them as powerful as they were at that moment.
He was, after all, only at the first heaven of the True Martial Realm but already possessed the peak combat power of the realm. Although it was just ordinary peak True Martial Realm strength, who would believe this if it spread? It would certainly cause an uproar.
Han Li found it quite normal, for he possessed the ultimate Martial Way and a King Grade Pill. His True Yuan, Divine Spirit, Spiritual Sense, and others were comparable to those of the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, not to mention his mastery of many Heaven Rank High and Supreme Grade martial techniques.
Heaven Rank High and Supreme Grade martial techniques are of the caliber of the Divine Yuan Realm. With Han Li having cultivated them to major accomplishment and perfection, the boost to his strength was immense.
“I wonder, if I stimulate my Divine Sense, could my strength climb to the level of the Divine Yuan Realm and compete with those Emperor Wu?” Han Li stood with his hands clasped behind his back, pondering this question.
Han Li didn’t hold much hope.
He had never seen an Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm, but he had recently accessed information on them, documenting the combat ability of Emperor Wu from the Divine Yuan Realm.
For one at the Myriad Phenomena Realm peak to step into the True Martial Realm, they must condense their Martial Way True Intent into a Martial True Pill, and then they qualify as an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm.
If an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm wished to elevate their cultivation, they must continually refine their Martial True Pill until it reaches primal unity, signifying the True Martial Realm peak.
The peak True Martial Realm cultivators aspiring to step into the Divine Yuan Realm and achieve Emperor Wu must base their efforts on the Martial True Pill, nourished by Martial Way True Yuan and unified with the Divine Spirit. All three aspects must cultivate together to foster the Martial Primordial Spirit.
Once the Martial Primordial Spirit has formed, strength soars tremendously. With a wave of a hand, one can harness the Power of Heaven and Earth, converting it into their own mighty force, capable of plucking stars and shattering large planets with a single strike.
Upon reaching the Divine Yuan Realm, Spiritual Sense evolves into Divine Sense, undergoing a qualitative transformation. Divine Sense can attack and kill foes, even materialize into weapons, and if merged with weapons that have been personally refined, their might significantly increases.
To attain the Divine Yuan Realm…
Even a newly promoted Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm is far beyond the realm of an Emperor Wu at the True Martial Realm peak in terms of strength—a casual palm strike could kill multiple ordinary True Martial Realm peak cultivators.
Han Li estimated that the gap in combat abilities between the True Martial Realm peak and an Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm was likely much more significant than just tenfold; perhaps dozens or even a hundredfold.

chapters.title: Chapter 265: 175
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: 175
Translator: 549690339
After some assessment, Han Li felt that a tenfold increase in combat ability after activating his Divine Sense should be considered among the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm.
Even at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm, the gap in strength could be vast, ranging from the grade of the cultivation techniques one practiced, the level of martial skills mastered, whether one possessed a Divine Weapon, whether one had secret techniques to unleash bursting power, the quality of the Martial True Pills condensed, and so on. These were all factors that could affect one’s combat ability.
Han Li smiled to himself, no longer dwelling on this issue, and turned his attention to his defense and speed.
The Nine Heavens Stride was an Earth-grade Superior Martial Art that, when augmented, could compare to a mid Heaven Rank technique. Han Li had perfected it to the completion level, giving him a speed that rivaled the fifth Heaven of the True Martial Realm before his breakthrough. Now, further enhanced, it was comparable to the eighth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
A speed of the eighth Heaven in the True Martial Realm was incredibly fast, one capable of crossing five hundred thousand li in a single breath and spanning the entire Yuanzhou in just two breaths.
In terms of defense, Han Li possessed the Undying Golden Body, which was an Earth-Level Extreme Martial Art that could match a Heaven Rank High Grade Martial Technique after enhancement. He had practiced it to the completion level, which raised his defense to that of a half-step from the ninth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
If he were to use his trump card and summon the shroud of the Undying Golden Body over himself, he could, for a short duration, possess defense equivalent to that of the ninth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
Having sorted out his own strength, Han Li was in high spirits and then opened the system panel to check how many years of cultivation he had left.
358 years!
Seeing this number, Han Li contemplated whether or not to use it all to break through to a higher realm in one fell swoop.
After reaching the True Martial Realm, advancing even a minor realm required an incredible amount of time; a cultivator with Third Grade aptitude, under normal circumstances, would need fifty years of arduous training to ascend to the second Heaven of the True Martial Realm, with increasing time needed the further one advanced.
Aptitude, elixirs, and opportunities were three crucial factors that influenced the duration of cultivation, enabling a cultivator to break through realms in less time.
Han Li inquired with the system and discovered that the accumulated cultivation couldn’t advance him to the mid-phase of the True Martial Realm; he was still quite a bit short.
With Fourth Grade aptitude, going from the first to the second Heaven of the True Martial Realm required one hundred years of cultivation, reaching the third Heaven needed one hundred and fifty years, and ascending to the fourth Heaven took two hundred years.
With only 358 years of cultivation, advancing to the third Heaven of the True Martial Realm would leave him with 108 years remaining. To reach the fourth Heaven, he would need an additional 92 years.
“This is too difficult,” Han Li said with a wry smile as his face darkened.
However, he thought it made sense; even advancing to the True Martial Realm was less likely for those with Fourth Grade aptitude, and the time required to further progress within the realm would undoubtedly be even longer.
Han Li then checked how many years of cultivation were needed to reach the ninth Heaven and the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm, and it nearly sent him into seclusion.
For a cultivator with Fourth Grade aptitude to reach the ninth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, it would take 2800 years, and to reach the peak, it would take 3000 years, but one could only live up to two thousand years in the True Martial Realm.
Generally speaking, for Fourth Grade aptitude, ascending to the True Martial Realm was practically the limit, and most would end their journey at the initial phase of the realm.
Unless they encountered further opportunities that could rapidly increase their cultivation and shorten the time to break through realms, reaching the ninth Heaven of the True Martial Realm would be impossible.
Even for Third Grade aptitude within the True Martial Realm, reaching the ninth Heaven would still require 1400 years, while reaching the peak would need 1500 years.
Most cultivators with Third Grade aptitude in the True Martial Realm also found it difficult to reach the pinnacle of the realm. It required fortunate opportunities to shorten the cultivation time before considering ascending to the Divine Yuan Realm.
“Sigh~”
Han Li sighed. He knew this was somewhat one-sided.
The cultivation times provided by the system were calculated based on the standard of a cultivator’s arduous training—assuming a True Martial Realm cultivator in secluded cultivation, not taking spirit pills to boost their cultivation, nor seeking opportunities outside.
Normally, cultivators would search the world for elixirs to enhance their cultivation and continually undergo trials and tribulations, exploring relics and secret territories, all for the chance to rapidly increase their cultivation.
Han Li, on the other hand, simply lay flat, not even cultivating, aiming to rapidly increase his realm by accumulating the necessary cultivation. Each year of cultivation was equivalent to a year of arduous training by a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
After some contemplation, Han Li sighed again and abandoned the idea of further increasing his realm.
The cultivation required for a Fourth Grade aptitude to advance realms was immense. It wasn’t too late to wait until his aptitude improved to Third Grade, which was just a few months away anyway.
With his current combat ability, he could be considered nearly invincible in the Xuan Domain, with only the Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu of the Ancient Empire able to overpower him.
As long as he kept a low profile, the few months would pass without incident, at which point his ascension to Third Grade aptitude would allow him to advance his realm.
By then, he would have accumulated more cultivation and could surge to the fifth or sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm in one attempt. At that point, his combat ability would surely reach the level of the Divine Yuan Realm, rivaling Emperor Wu.
Previously, he had been eager to advance his realm and break through to the True Martial Realm to more securely capture the female Demon King. Now that he had the combat ability of the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm, it was completely sufficient, and no accidents were likely to occur.
Han Li didn’t think the Demon Emperor of the Demon Clan would go to great lengths to come to the Xuan Domain to fetch the female Demon King; it wasn’t worth the effort, and the Demon Emperors surely wouldn’t dare enter the heartland of the Human Clan, would they?
“Don’t rush, don’t rush. This ancestor can be patient,” Han Li murmured.
After breaking through to the True Martial Realm, his lifespan had increased by a thousand years, and now he had a lifespan of over 2750 years. If he were to obtain more life-extending elixirs, living over three thousand years would not pose a problem.
He still had three thousand years, and with the current trajectory of development at Han Mansion, not only ascending to the Divine Yuan Realm, but also to the Tongxuan Realm, would be entirely feasible.

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - 175 Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Quasi Emperor Domain! Treasure Chest Explosion!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 175 Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Quasi Emperor Domain! Treasure Chest Explosion!_3
Translator: 549690339
Gathering all his thoughts, Han Li dismantled the formation and then left the bedroom, coming to the summit of Chengdao Peak.
He decided to go to the Li Manor later, for now, there was another matter he needed to attend to. To accomplish it, he required the fortune and luck bestowed by Chengsheng Mountain and Chengdao Peak, that was—
Open the treasure box!
After the system upgraded to version 2.0, the treasure box function appeared, and a free treasure box was refreshed once a year.
Taking a deep breath, Han Li prepared to open the treasure box, silently chanting various phrases to increase his luck and praying to pull something good.
He was now in the True Martial Realm, capable of pulling items ranging from Earth-Level Lower Rank to Divine Rank Supreme Grade. Han Li wouldn’t spare a second glance at anything below Mid-Grade Heaven Rank, he would barely consider Top-Grade Heaven Rank, and only Supreme Grade Heaven Rank would catch his serious attention.
If he could pull out a Divine Weapon, even a Lower Grade Divine Weapon, Han Li would be extremely thrilled. The higher the grade of the Divine Weapon, the happier he would be.
Once ready, Han Li opened the treasure box page, and a virtual screen appeared before him, visible only to himself.
At the center of the screen was a treasure box shrouded in a halo of rainbow light, flashy and very enticing.
“Open!”
Han Li silently commanded in his heart, and the treasure box immediately burst into golden light, slowly opening up. It took a full ten seconds to completely open.
“Ding~ Congratulations, Master, for procuring a treasure from the treasure box: [Chongming Palace]!”
Hearing the system notification, Han Li’s eyebrows raised in surprise. Chongming Palace? What level of treasure was that?
With a thought from Han Li, a magnificent, exquisitely crafted palace appeared small enough to fit in the palm of his hand. He picked it up and examined it, noticing that the inside and outside of the palace were intricately engraved with numerous formation patterns and runes—he could tell it was something extraordinary at a glance.
He opened the system panel to check the attributes of Chongming Palace; his lips gradually curling into a smile, he murmured, “I really am a Son of Fortune; even Lady Luck is willing to bend over backwards for me.”
Chongming Palace: Lower Grade Divine Weapon, a magical treasure with flying, defense, and attack capabilities, prioritized for flying, followed by defense, and then attack.
Once the full potential of Chongming Palace is unleashed, its flying speed could rival a peak Divine Yuan Realm, its defense comparable to the Sixth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, and its attack power similar to the Fourth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm.
“What a pity, with my current strength, I cannot even unleash ten percent of Chongming Palace’s potential,” Han Li sighed inwardly.
As a Lower Grade Divine Weapon, Chongming Palace’s power was indeed immensely strong, but it also required a tremendous amount of energy to utilize. It would take at least the mid-stage of the Divine Yuan Realm to fully unleash its power.
Han Li’s True Yuan was equivalent to the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, and he could not employ even ten percent of its potential. Even so, Chongming Palace could still unleash formidable power.
After trying it out, Han Li discovered that with his current True Yuan, if he operated Chongming Palace normally, its speed could reach the Third Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, almost approaching the Fourth Heaven.
As for defense, it was comparable to the Second Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, but the attack was much less powerful, merely at the peak of the top True Martial Realm.
Although it was a bit disappointing that he couldn’t fully exploit the Divine Weapon he had obtained, Han Li was still very happy. Chongming Palace had multiplied his ability to withstand risks many times over.
If he encountered a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor, as long as they were not mid-stage or above in the Divine Yuan Realm, even if he couldn’t defeat them, he could escape by hiding inside Chongming Palace.
“Should I open another one?”
Looking at the empty treasure box page, Han Li was somewhat tempted.
Having pulled a Lower Grade Divine Weapon, Chongming Palace, on his first attempt, showed that his luck was extremely favorable, at least of Son of Fortune caliber.
Not taking advantage of such good fortune to open a few more treasure boxes would be too wasteful; opening several more Divine Weapons could drastically enhance his strength.
But after hesitating for a moment, Han Li decided to try his luck with another treasure box.
“Refresh~”
With a thought, Han Li spent five years of cultivation, and another treasure box with rainbow light and halos appeared on the treasure box page, still looking flashy and particularly appealing.
“Open.”
Han Li silently chanted, and the treasure chest burst into golden light as it slowly opened.
“Ding~ Congratulations to the master for acquiring the treasure: [Extreme Cold Scripture]!”
Hearing the system’s notification, Han Li blinked, feeling something was amiss.
Extreme Cold Scripture?
It didn’t sound very powerful…
Han Li quietly accessed the system panel to check, his expression growing darker by the second, with the urge to curse welling up within him.
The Extreme Cold Scripture was indeed trash, merely an Earth-Level Top Grade cultivation technique which was of no use to his strength whatsoever.
Its only purpose might be to throw it into the family’s treasure vault for exchange by descendants, Guest Elders, protectors, and the like.
Staring at the empty treasure box page before him, Ancestor Han fell silent, his heart caught in a struggle: should he take another gamble?
It was probably just an accident earlier…
Han Li couldn’t believe his luck was that bad; perhaps this was paving the way for a second treasure chest opening?
“Huff~”
Exhaling deeply, Ancestor Han’s thought flickered, and fifty years of cultivation were gone, refreshing to reveal another treasure chest.
“Open~”
Without hesitation, Han Li directly opened the chest, ignoring the fancy visuals of the opening.
“Ding~ Congratulations to the master for acquiring the treasure: [Void Pill]!”
Han Li’s expression turned utterly dark as he casually closed the treasure box page, looking at the Void Pill in his hand with immense heartache.
Damn gambler’s fate!
He shouldn’t have been tempted by luck, hoping to take a gamble, only to end up with such an item.
The Void Pill, a Fourth Grade Pill, was extremely difficult to refine. It could help those in the God Refining Realm to break through to the Hollow Void Stage; it was very useful.
But for Han Li, it was truly trash. The value of the Void Pill was about the same as an Earth-Level Supreme Magical Artifact, but what he spent was a full fifty years of cultivation.
“As expected, treasure chests are just money pits,” Han Li couldn’t help complaining.
Learning from his setback, Han Li decided he wouldn’t easily open a second paid treasure chest again; once a month was more than enough.
Heaving a sigh, Ancestor Han’s figure vanished from the summit of Chengdao Peak. After placing the Extreme Cold Scripture in the family treasure vault, he left and returned to the Li Manor.
With only one Void Pill, Han Li hadn’t decided who to give it to yet. Several of his wives were real people in the God Refining Realm who needed the Void Pill.
Atop the Chong Xiao Pavilion, Han Li overlooked the Capital City of Da Qian, his mind slowly settling down.
“Well, a single Void Pill can create a Guru in the Hollow Void Realm. Although it cost fifty years of cultivation, I suppose it’s barely not a loss,” Han Li said in a calm tone, muttering to himself.
In reality, he was bleeding inside; once his aptitude reached Third Grade, fifty years of cultivation might have allowed him to ascend to the second heaven of the True Martial Realm.
But with the outcome set in stone, Ancestor Han could only console himself with a wave of forced contentment.
Having opened the treasure box thrice, he exhausted fifty-five years of cultivation; now he had only 303 years of cultivation saved up.

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 176 The Ancestor Takes Another Wife and Concubine! The Dragon Maiden Reappears, the Secret Territory Emerges!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Chapter 176 The Ancestor Takes Another Wife and Concubine! The Dragon Maiden Reappears, the Secret Territory Emerges!_1
Time flowed gently by, and in the blink of an eye, two months had passed.
During this period, the Xuan Domain remained peaceful with no significant incidents, and the same could be said for the Daqian Empire.
Inhabitants of the Capital City of Da Qian, however, felt far from tranquil, owing to the fact that the Manor Lord of the Li Manor had taken new wives and concubines again during these two months.
The Li Manor’s lord had taken a wife and accepted concubines three times in quick succession, marrying one wife and bringing in three concubines, sparking heated discussions. Still, the talks did not last long as everyone had grown used to it.
Above the Chong Xiao Pavilion, Han Li was gazing at the Daqian Imperial Palace, showing no intent to act.
Two months prior, he had broken through to the first layer of the True Martial Realm. His combat ability had reached the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm, a shocking and awe-inspiring level, making him one of the top two paramount experts in the Xuan Domain.
With his current strength, he could easily infiltrate the Daqian Imperial Palace, kill Chu Dingqian, and seize the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
But Han Li held back, deciding not to take action for the time being. He thought he might as well let Chu Dingqian live a little longer as a way to repay him for the resources he had traded.
Now, his primary goal was to capture the Demon King.
As two months passed, the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm was about to emerge—it was a matter of days. Han Li did not wish to involve himself in extraneous matters before this.
Of course, this did not interfere with his marrying and taking in concubines. In the span of those two months, he married a wife and accepted three concubines, and successfully impregnated all of them.
All three concubines were Fifth Grade in terms of cultivation aptitude. One was a princess of the Daqian Empire, a daughter of Emperor Qian. Han Li did not understand why he had an epiphany—the daughters of Chu Wuji were still many and single.
The other two were twins from the Mentor of Daqian’s household, the Mentor’s younger daughters.
Because they met all of Han Li’s standards in aptitude and beauty, he did not decline. He was aware of the intentions of Emperor Qian and the Mentor, though he said little about it.
The fourth wife was named Feng Ziyue, a woman of exceptional beauty who rivaled Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, also possessing Fourth Grade aptitude and God Refining Realm cultivation, hailing from the Feng Family of Liangzhou.
The Feng Family was a Myriad Phenomena Realm family of Da Qian, with an ancestor who was a Great Grandmaster of the same Realm. The current family head was a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage, and Feng Ziyue was his daughter.
Feng Ziyue proactively married into the Li Manor, seeking protection and hoping to obtain a Lifespan Extension Pill for the Feng Family’s ancestor.
The lifespan of the Feng Family’s ancestor was nearing its end, with only a decade or so remaining. Without a new Great Grandmaster in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, the family would face inevitable destruction at the hands of their envious enemies.
Thus, Feng Ziyue came with this in mind, and even if the Manor Lord of the Li Manor could not provide a Lifespan Extension Pill, just by becoming one of the manor’s ladies, the Feng Family’s enemies would not dare to act against them.
She had learned about the three main wives of the Li Manor; their beauty was comparable to hers, and none had a temperament like hers. Their aptitudes and cultivation levels were similar, and they had all become main wives. Feng Ziyue was confident that she could be too.
Han Li did not disappoint her, presenting the Feng Family with a great number of precious betrothal gifts, including a Fifth Grade Longevity Pill.
A Fifth Grade Longevity Pill was primarily intended for masters of the Hollow Void Stage, adding fifty years to their lifespan, but it was also beneficial to a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, providing an additional twenty years.
Han Li had a purpose for offering the Lifespan Extension Pills; he wanted to fish, not to have others come and plot for them. With his True Martial the strength, who would dare to attempt to seize a Fifth Grade Longevity Pill beneficial to individuals of the Hollow Void and Myriad Phenomena Stages?
He aimed to entice those families and sects with powerful members nearing the end of their lives. Learning that Han Li had Lifespan Extension Pills and was using them as dowries would certainly set their hearts ablaze, and they would actively offer beautiful women with high cultivation quality to Lord Han.
Sure enough, when the news spread, it caused great unrest among the upper echelons of various powers; the Fifth Grade Longevity Pill was precisely what they needed in the Myriad Phenomena and Hollow Void Stages.
Feng Ziyue was the first wife Han Li had taken in these two months. The princess of Emperor Qian and the daughters of the Mentor were accepted later, and they came with the same intention.
Sending Fifth Grade qualified daughters into the Li Manor was merely a probe. If they could obtain a Fifth Grade Longevity Pill, they wouldn’t need to make any greater sacrifices—an alternative would be considered if they didn’t acquire one.
Naturally, Han Li did not grant their wish. He did not have many Fifth Grade Longevity Pills on hand, and he would only consider them as dowries for Fourth Grade beauties.
Once his descendants with qualifications reached a hundred or two hundred, he gained three Fifth Grade Longevity Pills. When the number hit three hundred, Han Li acquired five more, totaling eleven pills.
After giving one as a dowry to Feng Ziyue, he was left with ten.
For a long time, his offspring and their consorts would not require Fifth Grade Longevity Pills. Besides, he would continuously receive more from the system. Therefore, when Feng Ziyue made her request, Han Li gave it some thought and agreed.
At that time, he had already entertained the idea of using the Fifth Grade Longevity Pill as an implicit condition to exchange for beauties with Fourth Grade qualifications. With ten pills left, acquiring ten Fourth Grade beautiful wives would be an excellent deal.
Indeed, a beauty with Fourth Grade aptitude could not be gained with just a Fifth Grade Longevity Pill; it served primarily as a bait. Powers sending their beautiful women to marry into the Li Manor would also receive an abundance of cultivation resources as a betrothal gift.
They could additionally benefit from the influence of the Li Manor and the protection of its lord, a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu. They might even seek his tutoring among other advantages.
Han Li withdrew his gaze, smiling to himself as his figure disappeared from above the Chong Xiao Pavilion, returning to Han Mansion.
Over the last two months, forty-two descendants were born in Han Mansion. Some were from Han Li’s beautiful concubines, others from the consorts of his offspring, granting him numerous rewards.

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 176 The Ancestor Takes Another Wife and Concubine! The Dragon Maiden Reappears, the Secret Territory Emerges!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 176 The Ancestor Takes Another Wife and Concubine! The Dragon Maiden Reappears, the Secret Territory Emerges!_2
At the peak of Chengdao Peak, Han Li opened his personal panel to check.
His accumulated cultivation had reached 345 years, the total number of his offspring had reached 1042, and among these, 377 had aptitude; he was not far from receiving his next reward.
The additional nineteen offspring with aptitude had further improved Han Li’s own aptitude, reaching 87% at Fourth Grade and very close to advancing to Third Grade.
No offspring with Fourth Grade aptitude or higher would be born in Han Mansion for the next half year, but there were quite a few in The Li Manor. In the coming year, the four wives of The Li Manor: Xue Qingyi, Chu Xianlin, Song Zhixuan, and Feng Ziyue, would all give birth to offspring.
In the next one to three months, most of the concubines in The Li Manor would also give birth to offspring, and their aptitudes were not low, so the aptitudes of the children born would not be bad either.
By then, Han Li’s aptitude would directly advance to Third Grade; however, further improvement would become difficult, as the birth of offspring with Fifth or Sixth Grade aptitude brought too little feedback to aptitude.
Even offspring with Fourth Grade aptitude could only increase it by 5%, while the birth of Third Grade aptitude offspring could contribute 10% to the progress of Han Li’s aptitude.
“Luckily, the female Demon King is about to be captured,” Han Li thought, a smile appearing on his face.
The female Demon King had at least Third Grade aptitude, and possibly even Second Grade; the specific aptitude could only be checked after her capture.
Although they shared the same aptitude, members of the Demon Clan cultivated more slowly than those of the Human Clan, but their lifespans were three to four times longer.
To be able to cultivate to the True Martial Realm, the female Demon King was probably at least a thousand years old, and might even be three thousand.
A demon of the Myriad Phenomena Realm had a lifespan of three to four thousand years, while those in the True Martial Realm had lifespans that exceeded ten thousand years, longer than even the great experts of the Human Clan in the Tongxuan Realm.
“I hope not,” Han Li sighed.
Otherwise, it really would be, ‘the older the woman, the closer to ascent among immortals.’
The vast East Sea roared with surging waves, towering crests rising and falling, home to countless creatures.
A mighty whale, stretching ten thousand meters long, swam past, emitting a powerful aura that caused the complexions of cultivators passing through this part of the sea to change dramatically, hastening away at once.
At the bottom of a certain part of the East Sea, there was an ocean trench exceeding fifty thousand miles in depth. The whale, with its ten thousand-meter-long body, seemed like a tiny shrimp within the trench.
When it reached the deepest part of the trench, the whale’s body shone with divine light, transforming into a middle-aged man dressed in a whale battle suit, exuding the aura of a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Here lay a Crystal Palace, sprawling and luxurious, with a signboard bearing two large characters: Dragon Palace!
The middle-aged man glanced at the signboard, sighed in his heart, entered the palace, and upon reaching the inner depths, he made a courteous bow and said:
“My lord, I have brought back what you requested.”
With that, the middle-aged man took out some items from his Spatial Bracelet and placed them in midair.
In the depths of the Dragon Palace, there was a magnificent throne upon which sat a woman in a light-colored dress, the absolute beauty, Long Yue.
At his words, Long Yue’s bright eyes opened; after one glance to confirm everything was correct, the items automatically flew towards her and were collected.
“You’ve done well,” said Long Yue in an indifferent tone.
“My lord, about my…” began the middle-aged man, speaking cautiously.
“Away with you, the prohibition will lift automatically in three months,” Long Yue said indifferently.
The middle-aged man hesitated then decided not to press the Dragon Lady for immediate removal of the Divine Spirit prohibition, fearing that his impatience might earn him her deadly ire.
It was only a long while after the middle-aged man had left that Long Yue stood up, her gaze turning towards the Divine Continent, a glint flashing in her eyes.
“Is the Secret Territory about to emerge?” Long Yue murmured to herself.
Two years earlier, she’d opened the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, suppressed a multitude of True Martial Realm Emperors, and retrieved her Dragon Ball.
Upon exiting the Secret Territory, she was ambushed by three mid-stage True Martial Realm Emperors, but Long Yue unleashed her divine might, injuring them too before escaping because she sensed a late-stage True Martial Realm expert watching. She did not continue the slaughter, choosing to leave directly instead.
As she left the Xuan Domain and was planning to pass through the Chaotic Domain to the East Sea, she was attacked yet again.
This time, her assailant was a late-stage True Martial Realm Emperor, extremely powerful, but he underestimated the Dragon Lady’s strength and was killed by her.
Although Long Yue was only in the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm at the time and did not possess a Divine Weapon, her past life as the Sacred Dragon meant that even under numerous restrictions, her combat ability was extraordinary, capable of contending with an Eighth Heaven Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm.
The Emperor Wu who attacked her was also of the Eighth Heaven, wielding a Supreme Grade Heaven Rank Divine Weapon, but was still destroyed by Long Yue. The Secret Techniques she wielded could not be compared with mere True Martial Realm methods.
After eliminating her assailant, Long Yue did not delay, concerned that a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor might take action. She immediately fled at top speed, diving into the East Sea.
Once inside the East Sea, Long Yue found a Daoist sacred ground left by a powerful being of the ancient Jiao Clan, now occupied by a Myriad Phenomena Realm mighty whale.
She overpowered it with a direct attack, established a Divine Spirit prohibition, and coerced it into doing her bidding, threatening to kill it otherwise.
After the Myriad Phenomena Realm mighty whale had gone, Long Yue renamed the Daoist sacred ground the Dragon Palace and laid several layers of Second Grade grand formations. Even if a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor were to attack, it could not be breached.
Having cultivated in the Dragon Palace for two years, with the aid of her past life’s Dragon Ball, Long Yue’s strength had advanced by leaps and bounds. She had now reached the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, and was rapidly approaching the later stages.
As her realm increased, her combat ability also improved. Today, she possessed the combat ability of a top-tier pinnacle True Martial Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 176 The Ancestor Takes Another Wife and Concubine! The Dragon Maiden Reappears, the Secret Territory Emerges!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 176 The Ancestor Takes Another Wife and Concubine! The Dragon Maiden Reappears, the Secret Territory Emerges!_3
“Huff~”
Exhaling a breath, Long Yue once again sat cross-legged and continued her cultivation, intending not to emerge until she reached the seventh heaven of the True Martial Realm.
By then, she would possess the combat ability of a Martial Emperor in the Divine Yuan Realm, and in these latter days, she would be considered to have the power to protect herself.
At that time, she could conclude her previous strategies in the Xuan Domain and obtain the things she desired.
Demon Domain, Myriad Demon Mountain.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing arrived at a forbidden land, which was protected by numerous powerful formations, capable of executing even Divine Yuan Realm powerhouses should they attempt to force their way in.
At the center of the forbidden land, there was an immensely large wheel radiating divine light, inscribed with countless runes. The indistinct aura of power made Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing’s heart tremble incessantly.
This was the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel, a godly artifact of imperial significance, possessing the might to destroy heaven and earth.
After the great catastrophe of ancient times, when the spiritual energy of Qianyuan Divine Province severely waned, there were no longer any Saints, Great Emperors, or even Heavenly Immortals above the Tongxuan Realm. Each Sacred Land was heavily damaged.
The Myriad Demon Mountain, a Sacred Land of the Demon Clan, was no different; despite possessing divine weapons, they were unable to utilize them. Even a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse couldn’t unleash a trace of the divine weapons’ might; their True Yuan would be entirely drained in an instant.
Thus, they sought an alternative, sealing the divine weapons and centering several Emperor Weapons to guard the Demon Domain and deter the Human Clan.
The might of Emperor Weapons was also immensely powerful, yet a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse could activate them, unleashing a thread of their power. If the situation were dire, the Emperor Weapons could even autonomously revive, attacking heaven and earth, shattering the cosmos, and annihilating everything.
Gazing at the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel, Xue Yueqing sighed in her heart. Even with the Emperor Weapon before her, she was incapable of attaining it.
With her strength, she couldn’t even excite a sliver of the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel’s power; only with its recognition and assistance could she unleash the Emperor Weapon’s might.
Regrettably, the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel did not acknowledge her, and so Xue Yueqing could only look on at the Emperor Weapon within her reach, yearning yet unattainable.
While Xue Yueqing was deep in thought, a thread of dao light emerged from the core of the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel and entered her sea of consciousness.
Xue Yueqing received the urgent message and immediately altered her expression, hastily departing from the forbidden land.
Her initial reason for coming here was to seek the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel’s assistance in divining fate to see if Bai Keqing would encounter troubles upon her return to the Demon Domain after escaping from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, in order to strategize accordingly.
But now, she had received another piece of intelligence from the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel, one that held far greater importance than the matter of Bai Keqing, the female Demon King. It was of utmost urgency, and she needed to discuss it with the other Demon Emperors.
Dao Sect, Bai Yujing, Breeze Pavilion.
The refined and amiable Second Grandmaster, carrying the weight of mountains and rivers, overlooked the peaceful and harmonious Dao Domain. A faint smile always adorned his face, as if nothing could disturb his composure.
At that moment, the plain-looking Third Grandmaster barged in and said to the Second Grandmaster, “Old Second, something big is about to happen in the Xuan Domain. Shouldn’t we take care of it?”
The Second Grandmaster turned around, regarding the agitated Third Grandmaster with helplessness, “Old Third, why are you still so impetuous?”
“I’m just itching for some action, wanting to go out for a bit,” the Third Grandmaster chuckled.
Peace had reigned over Qianyuan Divine Province for far too long. The previous affairs of the Daqian Empire were mere trifles, whereas the emergence of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm bore significant karmic consequences which the Third Grandmaster had no wish to entangle with.
However, the forthcoming event in the Xuan Domain was indeed within the purview of their Dao Sect’s interference, as it would attract the attention of the entire Qianyuan Divine Province. Naturally, the Third Grandmaster did not want to miss it.
“Did you ask our eldest brother?” sighed the Second Grandmaster and asked.
Their third junior brother possessed awe-inspiring combat ability, renowned for being unbeaten in three thousand years, and indeed that was the truth.
Since his debut, he had been involved in endless slaughter, challenging the heroes of Divine Province and causing numerous tumults, accruing much bloodshed.
It was only in the past millennium or so that the Third Grandmaster had turned to cultivating his nature, staying in Breeze Pavilion to focus on cultivation, not causing trouble in the outside world.
“Senior Brother is still in seclusion, I dare not disturb him,” Third Grandmaster said with a smile.
Second Grandmaster nodded slightly and paused before saying, “There are still a few years left, will you go then?”
Third Grandmaster shook his head and replied, “I plan to leave now. It’s been a long time since I walked in the outside world. I will first go to the East Sea to discuss the Dao with that old Daoist, and then return to Divine Province to deal with the matters of the Xuan Domain.”
“That’s fine,” Second Grandmaster agreed.
It was good for Third Junior Brother to go out and walk around. He had been stuck at his current realm for many years, unable to break through. Perhaps this trip could bring him an opportunity.
“Remember, if you cannot decide on something, you can consult Breeze; if Breeze is silent, then follow your own heart,”
Second Grandmaster cautioned once again before Third Grandmaster’s departure.
“Old Second, you’ve already said this 10,896 times. I’ve memorized it so well that it’s ingrained in my mind; you don’t need to repeat it every time.”
Third Grandmaster made a quip and then disappeared from Breeze Pavilion.
Second Grandmaster shook his head gently, glanced at the Xuan Domain once, and closed his eyes again to comprehend the boundless universe.
In the Xuan Domain, the Daqian Empire, on Chengsheng Mountain,
Han Li stood at the summit of Chengdao Peak, next to him was Lu Tianxiang in her fluttering red dress. The two stood there like a couple of Heavenly Immortals, eliciting envy from others.
“Husband, is the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm about to emerge?” Lu Tianxiang snuggled into Han Li’s embrace and asked softly.
“Don’t worry, with me here, they wouldn’t dare to cause any trouble,” Han Li said with a smile.
He knew what Lu Tianxiang was worried about. Once the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm emerged, those trapped True Martial Realm Emperor Wu within the secret territory would be freed, and they might cause trouble for the Daqian Empire.
As the public figurehead of the Daqian Empire, all of this was up to him to shoulder, and the Sect Hierarch was concerned for his safety.
But his power was unlike before, having skyrocketed manyfold. If those True Martial Realm Emperor Wu truly dared to cause chaos, they wouldn’t be enough for him to kill with one hand.
Lu Tianxiang nodded lightly. Since her husband said so, she believed he must be very confident. She understood Han Li and trusted him as well.
“Wait for me at home, my dear, I’ll capture a True Martial Realm sister for you,” Han Li said, as he gently captured Lu Tianxiang’s beautiful red lips with a tranquil smile on his face.
“Capture a True Martial Realm?” Lu Tianxiang’s pupils constricted as she felt anew the might of her husband’s strength.
Without immense confidence, Han Li would surely not dare to speak so boldly.
“Then I’ll be looking forward to it,” Lu Tianxiang said with a smile that shone like the stars.
After kissing Lu Tianxiang’s forehead again, Han Li’s figure vanished. Watching this scene, Lu Tianxiang was pondering who the female True Martial Realm cultivator Han Li intended to capture could be.
To her knowledge, there seemed to be only one True Martial Realm female cultivator in the Xuan Domain, and what’s more, she had a husband who was also at the True Martial Realm.
Elsewhere, Han Li’s figure appeared in Qingzhou.
He did not go directly to Yingyuan Mountain in Leizhou as that would be too conspicuous. Instead, Qingzhou was just right.
The two Demon Clan Grandmasters from Qingzhou had not left yet and were waiting for the Demon King to come out. Han Li was high in the sky, concealing his presence, quietly waiting.
An hour later, a huge noise erupted from the sky above Yingyuan Mountain, and rich spiritual energy gushed forth.
The Sacred Dragon Secret Realm had emerged!

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: Chapter 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_1
In the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, before it emerged into the world.
More than two years ago, nine True Martial Realm martial kings followed the dragon maiden into this place, eager to snatch the Dragon Ball from her hands. Unexpectedly, the dragon maiden easily suppressed them and pushed them aside with a single hand.
The nine True Martial Realm martial kings were disunited and harbored ulterior motives. When faced with unfavorable circumstances, the hemp-robed martial king from Fengbo Pavilion and the purple-robed martial king from Da Jing Empire seized the opportunity to jointly kill Chu Wuji, the incumbent Emperor Qian of the Daqian Empire.
Afterward, they also killed Prince Wu’an, the Devil Foetus Host of Chu Dingqian, fulfilling their respective goals.
Chen Jingyun, the Sect Hierarch of the Yinyang Sect, the black-robed martial king, the demon queen Bai Keqing, and the Buddhist monks Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong did not intervene. They attempted to leave the secret territory but were frightened back by the great battle outside.
In the end, they watched helplessly as the exit of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm closed and decided to wait two and a half years for the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm to naturally emerge into the world before leaving.
Ten True Martial Realm martial kings entered the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, but only one left; two died, and the remaining seven were all trapped.
The seven trapped True Martial Realm martial kings came from different clans, camps, and forces, but they were wary of each other and maintained a balance of power, with none making a move against the others.
To avoid being assassinated by others, the seven True Martial Realm martial kings each lay in hiding within the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, setting up formations to conceal themselves while waiting for the realm to emerge.
After two years of analysis and reflection, the seven True Martial Realm kings had figured out the identities of the other True Martial Realm martial kings.
The flamboyant man draped in red, enigmatic and wildly uninhibited, was Chen Jingyun, the Sect Hierarch of the Yinyang Sect. The old man in coarse hemp robes was a True Martial Realm martial king from the mysterious forces causing upheavals within Daqian. Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong were from the Buddhist Sect.
The elder in purple robes had also concealed his identity; he was Jiang Zhengyang, the second True Martial Realm martial king of the Da Jing Empire, much weaker than the one guarding the Da Jing Empire.
The black-robed martial king had hidden his identity, but during his battle with the dragon maiden, the martial techniques he displayed had revealed his identity as one of the three True Martial Realm martial kings from the Da Liang Empire.
The demon queen Bai Keqing had previously disguised herself as a True Martial Realm martial king from the Human Clan, but she eventually exposed herself. She had used some sort of secret technique, revealing the shadow of her true form behind her, which allowed the other True Martial Realm martial kings to discover that she was a Demon King from the Demon Clan.
As the emergence of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm drew near, some of the True Martial Realm martial kings within began to stir. The Buddhist monks Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong roamed everywhere erratically as if searching for the traces of other True Martial Realm martial kings.
Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong stood erect in the firmament, both quite relaxed – a result of their strength.
In the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, only these two True Martial Realm martial kings were from the same camp. The two from the Daqian Empire had died long ago.
Kurong Kong was at the third level of the True Martial Realm, nearing the fourth, and Tuoshan Kong was at the first level. Together, they were powerful enough to dominate the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
Of the remaining five True Martial Realm martial kings, only the purple-robed martial king from Da Jing was at the third level, while the black-robed martial king and the hemp-robed martial king were at the second, and the demon queen Bai Keqing, along with the Yinyang Sect’s Sect Hierarch, were only at the first level of the True Martial Realm.
Initially, the two Buddhist Arhats did not dare to be so arrogant, fearing it would provoke the other True Martial Realm martial kings to join forces against them. Although the possibility was slim, now that the secret territory was about to open, they no longer had such concerns.
“Kurong elder brother, where do you think that demon queen is hiding?”
Tuoshan Kong’s Spiritual Sense swept back and forth across the secret territory, ceaselessly probing, but he was unable to find any trace of the demon queen Bai Keqing.
“I haven’t found her either,” said Kurong Kong as he shook his head slightly.
The Sacred Dragon Secret Realm was vast, encompassing millions of square miles. Even the Spiritual Sense of these True Martial Realm martial kings could not cover it all but only a small portion.
They had scoured the secret territory back and forth many times in the past two days. They had found traces of the purple-robed martial king from Da Jing, the black-robed martial king from Da Liang, and even the hemp-robed martial king from Emperor Mingtian’s domain, but they could not find the Yinyang Sect’s Sect Hierarch or the demon queen from the Demon Clan.
And those two were precisely their targets.
The Buddhist Sect and the Demon Clan were natural life-and-death enemies, as were the Human and Demon Clans. When Buddhist Cultivators encountered Devil Cultivators or Demon Cultivators, they would engage in fierce battle, attempting to subdue, convert or seal, and extinguish them.
Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong prioritized the demon queen from the Demon Clan, intending to eliminate her before exiting, not wishing to let her return to the Demon Domain.
Secondly was Chen Jingyun, the Sect Hierarch of the Yinyang Sect. The Demon Clan and the Buddhist Sect were inherently at odds, with the Devil Region blocking the path eastward for the Buddhist Sect to spread its teachings, making it one of the greatest obstacles to the Buddhist Sect’s eastward expansion. Subduing or defeating a True Martial Realm martial king of the Demon Clan would certainly be a great achievement.
However, both the demon queen and the Yinyang Sect Sect Hierarch hailed from Great Holy Land Schools that were no less formidable than the Demon Clan. They possessed rare treasures that completely concealed their whereabouts, making them unfindable by the two Arhats of the Buddhist Sect.
The Yinyang Sect Sect Hierarch Chen Jingyun worried that the two Buddhist Arhats would take the opportunity to slay him, while the demon queen Bai Keqing was even more concerned that the six Human Clan True Martial Realm martial kings would join forces to kill her. Over these two years, she had always stayed within a grand formation and had never ventured out.
“Elder brother, we cannot let her escape,” said Tuoshan Kong, pausing before continuing, “The demon king being a female cultivator, it would be best to subdue and convert her and bring her back to Xumi Mountain. Presenting her to the Joyous Arhat would be an immensely great merit.”
Kurong Kong nodded slightly and sighed, “I understand, junior brother.”
The Joyous Arhat was one of the few Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors of this era, holding a high position and influence within the Buddhist Sect. His cultivation technique was unique within the Buddhist Sect.
While Buddhist Cultivators typically refrain from carnal relations, the Joyous Arhat did the opposite. Having obtained great fortune early in his life, the exceptionally talented Arhat integrated the Dual Cultivation Technique into the Buddhist Cultivation Technique, forging his path in martial arts.

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_2
The Buddhist Sect initially did not acknowledge the Delighted Arhat and even suppressed him multiple times, but it was only after the Delighted Arhat sang and forged ahead, cultivating all the way to the True Martial Realm and Divine Yuan Realm, that he finally gained a foothold in the Buddhist Sect and received recognition.
A female cultivator at the True Martial Realm was a rare treasure to encounter and was usually someone with a powerful background; the Delighted Arhat had long been craving for one but had never acquired until then.
If they could capture the Demon Clan’s female Demon King and bring her back, the Delighted Arhat would surely be ecstatic, showering them with a wealth of cherished cultivation resources, such as Heaven Rank Supreme Grade martial skills, pills that enhance Emperor Wu’s cultivation at the True Martial Realm, Heaven Rank Supreme Grade magical treasures, and the like.
Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong both aspired to advance further in the True Martial Realm, and even breakthrough to the Divine Yuan Realm. Gaining the favor of a Divine Yuan Realm martial emperor was extremely necessary as it meant they could receive his guidance.
“There’s also that Chen Jingyun of the Yinyang Sect who has been obstructing my brother and hindering the expansion of our Kurong Sect. This would be an excellent opportunity to convert him as well,” said Tuoshan Kong with a smile.
A gleam flashed in Kurong Kong’s eyes as he nodded in agreement.
Both Chen Jingyun, the sect hierarch of the Yinyang Sect, and the Demon Clan’s female Demon King were at the first heaven of the True Martial Realm. With his combat ability, he could suppress either of them alone, not to mention with the assistance of his junior brother Tuoshan Kong. Neither could escape.
“Since we cannot find them, there’s no need to continue searching. We will simply guard the exit of the Secret Territory. If they wish to leave, they will inevitably have to pass through this exit,” spoke Kurong Kong indifferently.
“Brother, your plan is brilliant.”
A smile emerged on Tuoshan Kong’s face. Together with Kurong Kong, they headed to guard the exit of the Secret Territory, lying in wait like a hunter waits for rabbits.
In a certain area of the Secret Territory, a top-tier Third Grade formation concealed everything, creating its own space within, which even Emperor Wu at the latter stages of the True Martial Realm could not detect without a thorough investigation.
This was the hiding place of the Demon Clan’s female Demon King, Bai Keqing.
Bai Keqing was dressed in a light blue gown, perfectly accentuating her exquisite and curvaceous figure, her seductive and wild temperament invoking a massive desire to conquer.
She silently calculated the time, waiting for the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm to reveal itself spontaneously before searching for an opportunity to escape. She was tired of hiding in this place.
Since the death of Prince Wu’an of Da Qian, she was one of the two weakest among the seven martial emperors in the True Martial Realm within the Secret Territory. This made Bai Keqing feel very insecure.
Surrounded by martial emperors from the Human Clan’s True Martial Realm, her status as a Demon Clan True Martial Realm martial emperor would lead to certain death if her identity were exposed.
Unable to leave the Secret Territory, Bai Keqing quickly escaped and sought out a hidden location to set up her grand formation and concealed herself within it.
Power couldn’t give her a sense of security, but the formation could.
This was one of the few trump cards given to her by the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing before she left, to ensure her life could be preserved.
“I hope those two bald monks from the Buddhist Sect aren’t guarding the exit of the Secret Territory,” Bai Keqing muttered to herself, though with little confidence.
Within the formation, she could see the outside world. The Secret Territory had been relatively calm in the past, but over the last two days, she occasionally saw the two Kong figures of the Buddhist Sect flying high in the sky, obviously searching for her traces.
Unable to find her, Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong would likely guard the exit of the Secret Territory, which soured Bai Keqing’s mood significantly.
Initially, when the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing found her and tasked her with this mission, promising her numerous lavish rewards, Bai Keqing was significantly tempted.
