Bringing back the Dragon Ball was the best outcome, but even in failure, she would still receive abundant cultivation resources as a reward.
This enticed Bai Keqing greatly.
Having cultivated in the True Martial Realm for merely twenty or thirty years, she felt her cultivation was incredibly slow. Her talent was among the top in the Third Grade, yet felt she would need hundreds of years of arduous cultivation to break through to the second heaven of the True Martial Realm.
As for reaching the middle period or even the latter period of the True Martial Realm, it seemed like an eternity away, which made her anxious. When this issue arose, she hesitated before agreeing to the mission.
Even if the mission failed, the rewards provided by the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing would help her rapidly increase her cultivation, with the possibility of ascending to the second heaven of the True Martial Realm within fifty years and reaching the middle period in three hundred years.
Bai Keqing also wanted to visit the Mortal Territory of the Human Clan to seek opportunities. Before, her insufficient cultivation level made her daring not venture there, and it was not until she reached the True Martial Realm that she felt confident enough to do so.
Although the Human Clan was stronger than the Demon Clan and had more martial emperors at the True Martial Realm, the Mortal Territory of the Human Clan was much larger. If spread thin, there weren’t many martial emperors in one region, and, with her strength, encountering danger was not easy.
Now, Bai Keqing naturally regretted her decision—not for taking the mission, but for her greed, underestimating the Dragon Girl’s power, hoping to catch fish in troubled waters, which resulted in her being trapped in the Secret Territory.
If she had simply left without entering the Secret Territory, none of this would have happened. Now, her life was in danger.
“Alas, opportunity can spell trouble for demons,” Bai Keqing said with a wry smile.
The rewards for bringing back the Dragon Ball were too generous; they were enough to support her rapid cultivation to the latter period of the True Martial Realm. Bai Keqing had been blinded by opportunity and had overlooked the danger.
She thought that even if she failed to seize the Dragon Ball, retreating wouldn’t be a problem. She did not anticipate an ambush outside, and the battle was so terrifying that martial emperors at the early stage of the True Martial Realm dared not venture out—they could be easily severely injured by the aftershocks.
Suddenly, a vibration emanated from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, and Bai Keqing’s spirit was jolted. She knew the time for the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm to emerge had come.
She immediately appeared, standing tall in the sky, making every effort to conceal her presence as she made her way to the exit of the Secret Territory. There she saw Tuoshan Kong and Kurong Kong casually guarding the exit.
“Damn bald donkeys,” Bai Keqing halted in her tracks and cursed under her breath. This was going to be difficult.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_3
Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong also saw Bai Keqing, but they didn’t immediately make a move, still guarding the exit. As long as Bai Keqing wanted to leave, she wouldn’t be able to escape their grasp.
Above the firmament, figures appeared one after another. Emperor Wu of Da Jing in a purple robe, Emperor Wu of Daliang in black clothes, Emperor Wu in a hemp robe of Emperor Mingtian, and Sect Hierarch Chen Jingyun of Yinyang Sect all appeared, stopping in their tracks.
Upon seeing this scene, Kurong Kong immediately said, “Our three friends from Da Jing, Daliang, and Emperor Mingtian are free to leave. We brothers will absolutely not intervene.”
“Our targets are Chen Jingyun and that female Demon King. The three friends are all from the righteous cultivators. I believe you won’t help a Devil Cultivator or the Demon Clan,” Tuoshan Kong added.
Their words echoed between heaven and earth, instantly causing the five True Martial Realm Emperor Wus to frown in unison.
The Emperor Wu of Da Jing in a purple robe, the Emperor Wu of Daliang in black clothes, and the Emperor Wu in a hemp robe of Emperor Mingtian exchanged glances, all feeling rather displeased. The baldies of the Buddhist sect were too domineering, blocking the door outright.
Although they weren’t the targets, such behavior also filled them with anger. But who could challenge the power of the Buddhist Sect?
The forces they belonged to had no background, and in fact, they themselves were the backbone of their forces. They couldn’t provoke the Buddhist Sect, and now Tuoshan Kong had given them a difficult choice. Should they assist Chen Jingyun and the female Demon King, they would undoubtedly face trouble from the Buddhist Sect after leaving.
Chen Jingyun and the female Demon King had no relationship with them and were indeed on opposing sides. The three True Martial Realm Emperor Wus had no intention of intervening in the first place.
The three did not speak out, communicating secretly with sound transmission. They all moved towards the exit of the Secret Territory.
With their strength, if Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong dared to mess around, they would hit back directly, killing them on the spot. They believed Chen Jingyun and the female Demon King would also take action.
Sect Hierarch Chen Jingyun of Yinyang Sect and the female Demon King Bai Keqing were also closing in. Through secret communication, they prepared to join forces to break out, setting aside the opposition of their factions for the sake of survival.
The atmosphere at the exit of the Secret Territory grew tense, ready to ignite a True Martial Realm battle at any moment.
Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong were very cautious, their thoughts mainly on guarding against Chen Jingyun and Bai Keqing to prevent them seizing their chance to escape; a smaller part of their concern was aimed at the three True Martial Realm Emperor Wus, in case they would cause trouble.
The approach of the two Kongs prompted the three True Martial Realm Emperor Wus to also be on guard. Although they knew the Kongs’ targets were Chen Jingyun and the female Demon King, they were still wary of underhanded tactics.
The three exchanged glances, maintaining their secret communication. They drew closer to the exit, staying within five hundred meters of each other, and continued towards the exit of the Secret Territory.
Several hundred miles behind them, Chen Jingyun and Bai Keqing were closing in as well. They dared not get too close, nor too far—several hundred miles was just right. With their speed, they could escape in an instant if they timed it right.
Watching the three True Martial Realm Emperor Wus approach, Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong remained vigilant but did not take action, allowing the three True Martial Realm Emperor Wus to burst out of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
When they looked back, they saw that an earth-shattering great battle had erupted within the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, with four True Martial Realm Emperor Wus clashing fiercely.
Inside the Secret Territory, Chen Jingyun and Bai Keqing, seeing the instant the three True Martial Realm Emperor Wus escaped, activated their secret techniques, boosting their speed to the extreme, ready to force their way out. But they didn’t succeed.
Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong had anticipated their move. Kurong Kong formed the Kurong Print while Tuoshan Kong summoned the illusion of Xumi Mountain, firmly blocking the exit of the Secret Territory.
Chen Jingyun and Bai Keqing didn’t hesitate at all, immediately taking action and erupting with full force.
Chen Jingyun struck with a palm, delivering the Karma Fire Red Lotus Print, and with his other hand, he unsheathed his sword to slash. Bai Keqing manifested the silhouette of a pale blue giant serpent behind her, which spit out divine light, and with both her fists, she hurled a punch forward, sending two massive fist prints crashing out.
Boom~
The illusion of Xumi Mountain crumbled, but the attack from Chen Jingyun and Bai Keqing was worn away by the Kurong Print. The remaining force forced the two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus to keep retreating.
“Baldies, do you really want to fight to the death with me?” Chen Jingyun said with an ugly expression.
Bai Keqing licked her lips seductively, spoke with a heavy tone, “Gentlemen, we have no grudges and no grievances, why give this weak woman a hard time?”
“Amitabha, if the two benefactors are willing to convert to our Buddhist Sect, naturally, all will be well,” Kurong Kong said with hands clasped together.
“Brother, there’s no need for nonsense with them.”
Tuoshan Kong, looking toward Chen Jingyun and Bai Keqing in the distant sky, said blandly, “You only have two choices. One is to be converted to the Buddhist Sect, and the other is to die within this Secret Territory.”
The faces of Bai Keqing and Chen Jingyun immediately became extremely unsightly. These two baldies were too difficult to deal with, guarding the exit of the Secret Territory and giving them no chance to escape.
If Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong came after them, the exit would be unguarded, and they could look for an opportunity to escape.
“The moment of life and death is upon us, friend of the Demon Clan. Let’s not hold anything back and reveal our trump cards,” Chen Jingyun said to Bai Keqing.
Tuoshan Kong had given two options, and he chose neither. He wanted a third option, to escape and survive.
If that proved impossible, then he would have to find a place to hide within the Secret Territory. There was another mid-phase True Martial Realm Emperor Wu in Yinyang Sect, Dugu Bing. Although he did not get along with Chen Jingyun, he wouldn’t dare not come to his rescue.
“Alright.”
Bai Keqing agreed directly, as the current situation was most disadvantageous to her.
The Sacred Dragon Secret Realm was not far from the Yinyang Sect. Dugu Bing of the Yinyang Sect would come to rescue Chen Jingyun, but as this was the heartland of the Human Clan, no Demon King of the Demon Clan would come to save her.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_4
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing couldn’t be relied upon either. Not even the Demon King could easily step foot into the Mortal Territory, let alone the Demon Emperor. The Four Sacred Lands of the Mortal World were keeping a vigilant eye on both the military kings and emperors of the Demon and Barbarian Clans, restraining them from acting rashly. To infiltrate the Mortal Territory was exceedingly difficult.
“Kill!”
Both of them roared in unison, each pulling out their trump cards, and charged once more towards the exit of the Secret Territory.
“Junior brother, be careful.”
Kurong Kong’s expression shifted slightly as he gave a warning. Then, he swiped forward with his palm, unleashing the Colorless Handprint, while his other hand threw out a begging bowl that burst forth with Buddha’s light, seeking to deliver salvation to all beings.
Under the Colorless Handprint, all was void. Within the palm print, creation and annihilation converged, evolving into a myriad of forms and displaying innumerable offensive techniques.
Tuoshan Kong did not dare to be careless, and immediately brought out a string of Buddha Beads, gifted to him by a female Bodhisattva before his departure. He had not used them in his struggle against the Dragon Maiden, thinking that revealing his trump card was pointless if he couldn’t defeat her anyway.
The Buddha Beads enlarged as they met the incoming attack, quickly growing to over ten thousand feet. The twenty-four beads seemed like twenty-four Titans seated in meditation within the void, the sound of Buddha’s chants twining around them as they all struck forward with a palm at the same time.
“Boom!”
Chen Jingyun and Bai Keqing were blocked once again. Without any hesitation, they continued their assault, using their full strength, exhausting all kinds of trump cards as they engaged in fierce battle with Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong.
The expressions of Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong were exceedingly grave too, not daring to underestimate the two True Martial Realm military kings fighting with their lives on the line. Although Chen Jingyun and Bai Keqing were of lower realms, the trump cards they produced were one more powerful than the next.
If it weren’t for their own trump cards, they would have already been breached by now. Even so, they still felt immense pressure and could be broken through by Chen Jingyun and the female Demon King at any moment.
Outside the Secret Territory, Qingzhou.
The moment the Secret Territory emerged, Han Li was the first to detect it.
He had initially planned to wait for the female Demon King to return and walk into his trap but didn’t expect that his calculations would be off.
After the opening of the Secret Territory, three True Martial Realm military kings burst out and fled in different directions. However, Han Li discovered that there were still four True Martial Realm individuals engaged in a fierce battle inside.
Though the number of True Martial Realm military kings exceeded his expectations, Han Li was somewhat irritated. The female Demon King, his capture target, was being blocked inside the Secret Territory.
“Damn these bald-headed monks!” Han Li cursed silently.
These two bald-headed monks from the Buddhist Sect were causing trouble, letting go three True Martial Realm military kings while blocking the weakest Yinyang Sect Hierarch and his female Demon King. It seemed they either wanted to suppress and convert them or to kill them outright.
Han Li didn’t care if the Yinyang Sect Hierarch lived or died, but his female Demon King could not die there, nor could she be captured and taken back to the Buddhist Sect.
He had heard about the Buddhist Sect’s Joyful Arhat; should the female Demon King fall into his hands, Han Li would truly be furious.
“Daring to hijack this old ancestor’s female Demon King, it’s like they’re forcing me to make a move,” Han Li muttered to himself in a low voice, then altered his appearance and made his way towards the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm atop Yingyuan Mountain.
He didn’t want to get involved, preferring to capture the female Demon King discreetly, but now he had no choice. If he didn’t take action, it was highly likely that the female Demon King would be intercepted.
Since he had already put on a disguise, Han Li decided not to hold back any longer. He would use this disguise to take away the female Demon King and, incidentally, teach those two bald monks a lesson.
Inside the Secret Territory,
The expressions on the faces of Yinyang Sect Hierarch Chen Jingyun and the female Demon King grew increasingly ugly, turning more and more grim, under tremendous pressure within their hearts.
Their trump cards were being rapidly depleted, yet they still hadn’t broken through. If they exhausted all their trump cards, they would truly be finished.
“What to do? What to do?”
The female Demon King Bai Keqing was exceedingly anxious inside. She only had one or two trump cards left. Could it be that they really couldn’t break out?
Thinking of the grim fate that awaited them at the hands of the Buddhist Sect, the female Demon King shuddered. Being converted by the Buddhist Sect would alter her temperament greatly, wholeheartedly devoting herself to the Buddha and losing her original personality.
Moreover, there was that Joyful Arhat in the Buddhist Sect, which made her tremble even more. She would rather die than be captured and brought back to the Buddhist Sect.
“Where on earth is Dugu Bing?” Chen Jingyun inwardly cursed non-stop. He suspected that Dugu Bing might be toying with him.
Dugu Bing was a mid-True Martial Realm practitioner by all accounts, so he should have reached the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm by now. However, he had yet to appear.
In fact, right after the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm had opened, Dugu Bing had noticed it. Later, when he discovered that three True Martial Realm individuals had come out and that Chen Jingyun was still inside, where a great battle had erupted, he knew Chen Jingyun had run into misfortune.
Dugu Bing did not want to rescue him but still immediately set off toward the direction of the misfortune. If a True Martial Realm military king from the Demon Clan died due to his inaction, the higher-ups would surely blame him, a responsibility he could not bear.
However, having fallen from the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm, his speed had greatly decreased, and he was still millions of miles away from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
As Dugu Bing entered Leizhou, his figure abruptly halted. He had spotted a silhouette bursting into the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, moving even faster than him, likely a mid-True Martial Realm powerhouse.
After considering for a moment, Dugu Bing continued to approach, but he stayed outside the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm to observe. He would only enter to rescue him if Chen Jingyun’s life was in danger.
The last encounter with Li Feiyu had left him with a psychological shadow, and Dugu Bing couldn’t be sure who this sudden True Martial Realm powerhouse was. He feared another beating.
He had two suspects in mind: one was Li Feiyu and the other was a True Martial Realm swordsman who had previously been seen in Jizhou.
Li Feiyu was far away in Capital City, and even if he arrived a bit sooner than Dugu Bing, he had no reason to get involved; he would probably be pleased to see Chen Jingyun die inside.
The likely candidate was that True Martial Realm swordsman, as Jizhou was not far from Leizhou. It was possible that the swordsman had come specifically for this purpose, and had been waiting in Leizhou already.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_5
It only took Han Li two breaths’ time to arrive at the entrance of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm. His Spiritual Sense swept out and detected the presence of Dugu Bing.
However, Han Li paid no heed to him; his arrival was not unexpected. Han Li flashed into the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm without hesitation.
The scene of Kurong Kong, Tuoshan Kong, and the Yinyang Sect Sect Hierarch Chen Jingyun, along with the Demon Clan’s Demon King, fiercely battling one another, appeared before Han Li’s eyes. He did not hesitate and directly threw a punch.
This punch carried the momentum of sweeping across the universe, possessing the tyrannical power to push through Qianyuan Divine Province, suppress the heavens and earth, proclaiming an unrivaled dominance.
The fist imprint was peerless, the fist light covered the world, and even the void trembled, with countless ripples appearing as if it was about to shatter.
“Not good!”
Tuoshan Kong and Kurong Kong shouted in unison, immediately abandoning Bai Keqing and Chen Jingyun to confront the punch. They employed every tactic they could muster; such a terrifying punch, if not blocked, would spell certain death.
Previously, while they were battling the Yinyang Sect Sect Hierarch and the Demon Clan’s Demon King, they also extended their Spiritual Sense to monitor the surroundings, wary of someone coming to disrupt their scheme.
But they had never imagined that the attacker would be so powerful, at least a late True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, not someone they could contend with.
This sudden upheaval shocked both Chen Jingyun and Bai Keqing, but they quickly reacted, unleashing their attacks with full strength, not to take advantage of Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong, but to bombard the incoming punch.
The new arrival was overwhelmingly domineering, aiming a punch at all four of them. Did they intend to annihilate them all within the Secret Territory?
The four True Martial Realm Emperor Wus, who had been locked in a life-and-death struggle, united instantaneously, each exerting their full power in a desperate attempt to resist the punch.
To their despair, the new arrival was too strong. With just one punch, all their attacks were obliterated, even their various weapons were sent flying, and the weaker ones shattered.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!
All four True Martial Realm Emperor Wus were sent flying, each creating a huge crater upon landing, all severely injured, their vital energy severely drained.
Kurong Kong, Tuoshan Kong, the Yinyang Sect Sect Hierarch, and the Demon King Bai Keqing felt intense dread, filled with a thick sense of despair. They faced a powerful being they could not hope to challenge together.
The punch had obliterated all their attacks, the fist light heavily striking their bodies, the intent within the fist entered their bodies, disrupting the flow of their Cultivation Techniques, continuously draining their True Yuan, and worsening their injuries.
At that moment, they were reminded of their encounter with the Dragon Maiden more than two years prior, even feeling that the powerhouse before them was much stronger than the Dragon Maiden back then.
The Dragon Maiden was just as formidable, single-handedly pushing through the Secret Territory, one palm suppressing nine Emperor Wus.
The aura of this new powerhouse was even more overwhelming than the Dragon Maiden’s, more tyrannical, possessing a might that suggested dominance over the world, sweeping through the universe and subjugating the heavens and earth.
They tried to discern who it was, but all attempts failed. The newcomer stood aloft amidst the heavens, hands clasped behind his back, his whole body encased in divine light, likened to a round of brilliant sun, its rays illuminating all realms.
With just one glance, they felt a tremble deep within their Divine Spirits, blood spilling from the corners of their mouths, their hearts filled with utter shock.
This led them to a bold speculation: this was an invincible powerhouse at the peak of the True Martial Realm!
Only a peak True Martial Realm powerhouse could exert such enormous pressure on them, possess such an overwhelming Combat Ability, comparable to their aura, a single punch sweeping invincibly, subduing all four of them in the True Martial Realm.
Keep in mind, they had utilized every trick at their disposal, the Combat Ability they unleashed at that moment equivalent to several mid-phase True Martial Realm warriors striking with their full force, yet not even one punch could be withstood.
They suspected the peerless warrior had held back, otherwise, they would have been pulverized under the might of the fist, reduced to ashes.
When had the Xuan Domain given rise to such an unmatched and invincible warrior?
In this era, the Tongxuan Realm powerhouses remained withdrawn from the world, indifferent to the world’s power dynamics, while the Divine Yuan Realm Emperor maintained order in Qianyuan Divine Province, not moving lightly.
In such a scenario, a peak True Martial Realm powerhouse was indeed an invincible existence, sweeping invincibly was no empty boast.
“Cough cough~”
Kurong Kong looked up, enduring the pain as he gazed towards the godlike figure shining like the sun, and asked in a deep voice,
“Who might you be?”
“Ye Fan.”
Han Li stood with his hands clasped behind his back, shrouded in divine light, and responded indifferently.
He had indeed held back. The Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Fist could unleash the combat strength of a peak True Martial Realm warrior, but he had only used a small portion of his strength, or else the four True Martial Realm Emperor Wus would have been annihilated with one punch.
He had not come here to kill, but to take away his Demon King. He did not wish to slay Kurong Kong, Tuoshan Kong, or the Yinyang Sect Sect Hierarch Chen Jingyun.
Behind these three were the Demon Clan and the Buddhist Sect, which Han Li felt were beyond his capacity to provoke for the time being, sparing them for now. If he had killed these three True Martial Realm warriors, he would surely have incited major trouble.
The Divine Yuan Realm Emperor of the Demon Clan and Buddhist Sect might take action, dominating the Xuan Domain, and stirring up great turmoil, not conducive to maintaining a stable situation.
Besides, Han Li was not certain whether these two Sacred Lands could divine his identity, seeing it as a possibility, depending on whether the Sacred Lands were willing to pay the price.
Having inherited from ancient times, these two Sacred Lands possessed not a few Emperor-grade weapons, and even Immortal Artifacts; Han Li dared not underestimate the foundations of the two Sacred Lands.
However, Han Li noted this in his heart. With more strength in the future, he would eventually confront these two Sacred Lands, as he needed higher quality beautiful female cultivators.
Second Grade, First Grade, and even higher qualifications were mostly concentrated within the various Sacred Lands. If Han Li wanted to take wives home, he would need to pluck them from these Sacred Lands.

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Chapter 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_6
Temporary forbearance served as the prelude to amassing greater power, to unleash a mightier blow.
Once he ascended to the Tongxuan Realm, he could very well become unparalleled across Qianyuan Divine Province, and by then, he might possess Emperor’s weapons and Immortal Artifacts, fearless of all Sacred Lands.
Ye Fan?
Kurong Kong, Tuoshan Kong, the Yinyang Sect Hierarch, and Demon Queen Bai Keqing exchanged looks. Many bore the name Ye Fan, but none who cultivated in the True Martial Realm, let alone a supreme powerhouse seemingly at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm.
In just an instant, they realized it was a pseudonym. Obviously, this paramount figure had reservations and dared not reveal his true identity, with backing from three major Sacred Lands: Xumi Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, and Myriad Demon Mountain.
“Benefactor Ye, what brings you here? Do you intend to ambush and slay the True Martial Realm Emperors of our three great Sacred Lands? Can you shoulder the responsibility if we perish here?”
Tuoshan Kong’s eyes glowed red, his face etched with displeasure, as he thundered angrily.
As an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm from the Sacred Land of Xumi Mountain, he was accustomed to high esteem. Whenever he ventured into the outside world, which True Martial Realm Emperor Wu dared not show Xumi Mountain respect?
Kurong Kong’s face remained expressionless. He didn’t believe that this Ye Fan would dare kill them, as this would mean offending all three major Sacred Lands, leaving no place for Ye Fan in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Yinyang Sect Hierarch Chen Jingyun remained silent. Although he also harbored similar thoughts, recognizing the reality of the situation, he decided it was better not to provoke this paramount figure with hard words.
As a Cultivator of the demon path, he was far more tactful than the two Buddhist Kongs; he knew when to submit. If he truly died here, it would be unjust, as he had no desire to die yet.
Even if the Demon Clan sought vengeance for him after his death by slaying this so-called supreme figure named Ye Fan, it would be meaningless. He would already be deceased, unable to see it.
Demon Queen Bai Keqing looked up at the domineering, invincible figure above, deeply shaken inside. The Human Clan actually had such a world-shaking powerhouse.
She knew there were Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors and Tongxuan Realm immortals in Qianyuan Divine Province, but those strong figures had long ceased to take actions. Bai Keqing had never seen them and was unaware of their true strength.
Now, witnessing this world-shaking figure named Ye Fan, who could suppress four True Martial Realm Emperor Wus with merely a punch—even effortlessly crushing them—she grasped the extent of his power.
If the peak of the True Martial Realm was already so formidable, breaking apart the void, what unspeakable horror would Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors and Tongxuan Realm immortals represent?
She inwardly sighed, a smile with hints of sorrow and enchantment crossing her face, feeling the situation was not so bad after all.
She had been likely to die in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm or be captured and taken back to Xumi Mountain for conversion, living a fate worse than death. But now those two bald donkeys found themselves in the same plight as her, grievously wounded by this world-shaking powerhouse.
If they were to die, they would die together; she was no longer fearful, considering the current circumstances no worse than before.
The four True Martial Realm Emperor Wus had varied thoughts but all maintained the same posture, looking up at the sky at the figure as radiant as a divine sun, but none dared peep at Han Li’s true face again.
“Even if I killed your three major Sacred Lands, what could you do to me?” Han Li spoke indifferently.
Han Li reached out and slapped Tuoshan Kong. Tuoshan Kong was sent flying, crashing heavily against a great mountain, burying deep within it.
Tuoshan Kong felt as if every bone in his body was shattered by that slap, his injuries worsening. Before he could catch his breath, he was caught by an immensely strong suction force.
Slap!
Slap!
Han Li gave him several more resounding slaps, smashing Tuoshan Kong’s golden body, leaving his face as swollen as a pig’s head.
Thud!
Tuoshan Kong fell powerlessly to the ground, nearly shattering his battered innards completely. His body was covered in wounds, and his limbs’ bones broken, rendering him immobile.
“Stop!” Kurong Kong bellowed, his face colored with compassion.
Han Li ignored Kurong Kong’s shout and, dissatisfied, summoned a thousand-zhang-high mountain with a gesture. He pressed down, and the mountain crashed onto Tuoshan Kong’s body.
“Aren’t you Tuoshan Kong? Let’s see if you really have the fortitude to bear a mountain,” Han Li’s emotionless voice reverberated throughout the Secret Territory.
Chen Jingyun of the Yinyang Sect and Demon Queen Bai Keqing felt a chill in their hearts, not daring to speak lest this strong figure treat them similarly.
“Benefactor Ye, this is too much!” Kurong Kong bellowed again like an enraged guardian deity.
“Too much? ‘Twas but a minor punishment. The words you spoke to me just now, not killing him with one slap was already giving your Buddhist Sect face,” Han Li’s grand voice thundered, leaving Kurong Kong feeling like he was struck by lightning, realizing Ye Fan’s audacity.
Kurong Kong took a deep breath and suppressed his rage, not daring to further provoke Han Li, fearing that a fit of anger might lead to their deaths.
“Benefactor Ye, Buddhism is not something you can provoke, retreat swiftly and this monk might let this matter go,” he proclaimed.
“You’ll let this matter go?”
Han Li chuckled coldly, looking down at Kurong Kong from high above, “You’re not yet qualified to say such words. Have your Buddhist Sect’s goddess come and say them, and it might be more fitting.”
“How dare you!”
Kurong Kong roared in anger, struggling to contain his fury, continuing, “Great powers should not be insulted; you are inviting disaster upon yourself.”
Thud!
Han Li slapped him once more, leaving Kurong Kong feeble and barely clinging to life.
“Great powers cannot be insulted, but I, Ye Fan, can be lightly insulted?”
Han Li’s domineering words echoed between heaven and earth, leaving the four True Martial Realm Emperor Wus breathless. Ye Fan was indeed overpowering.

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_7
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 177: A Single Punch Suppresses the Four Great Emperor Wus! You Don’t Have the Right to Say This, Let the Female Bodhisattva Come (Please Subscribe)_7
The two Vajra of the Buddhist Sect were dealt with by Han Li in a flurry, and although they were burning with rage, they dared not say anything more. This man was truly willing to strike hard, and to provoke him further would simply be asking for trouble.
Han Li turned his gaze towards Chen Jingyun and Bai Keqing of the Yinyang Sect. He sent a palm straight towards Chen Jingyun, hitting him and sending him flying away, with a loud booming sound in the distance.
Feeling wronged, Chen Jingyun, who had snuck into the mountains, hadn’t said a word, hadn’t done a thing; why then, did he have to be hit?
It really hurt!
Watching Han Li extend his hand, Bai Keqing closed her eyes, mentally prepared for what was to come.
To her surprise, instead of being hit with a palm, her body flew towards the peerless powerhouse, who pulled her into his arms. Her snake-like waist was encircled by a man for the first time, causing two blushes to appear on her face.
By now, she finally realized the peerless powerhouse wreaking havoc had come for her, to rescue her from the secret territory, although Bai Keqing didn’t know anyone named Ye Fan.
She felt speechless in her heart. You came to rescue me, so why punch me?
She didn’t believe such a peak True Martial Realm powerhouse couldn’t control his own strength; it was clear he hadn’t spared her.
“Shut up!”
Just as Bai Keqing was about to say something, she heard Han Li’s authoritative words and immediately shut her mouth, her heart filled with an itch of hatred.
She simply gave up resistance; falling into the hands of a peak True Martial Realm powerhouse left her unsure of whether she would live or die, but she knew she couldn’t fight back.
After one last look at Kurong Kong, Tuoshan Kong, and Chen Jingyun of the Yinyang Sect, Han Li, holding the Demon Queen, disappeared from the secret territory.
All this seemed to take a long time, but in reality, from the moment he appeared in the secret territory, suppressed four True Martial Realm Emperor Wus with a single punch, and then hit them a few more times, it all happened in less than five breaths of time.
Once out of the secret territory, Han Li glanced in a certain direction, slapped his hand down, and then his figure vanished from sight.
Bang!
Dugu Bing had noticed Han Li’s emergence and had no time to flee when he saw the man slap him. Dugu Bing resisted, but to no avail, and was sent flying backward, crashing heavily onto the ground, feeling as though his bones had shattered and his tendons tore.
“Can’t be, just passing by and I get slapped too?”
Dugu Bing felt like he had walked into calamity. Had he known, he would not have come to rescue Chen Jingyun. This slap was taken for Chen Jingyun’s sake.
Luckily, the peerless powerhouse had shown restraint, not slapping him to death. Otherwise, Dugu Bing felt his fate would truly be too miserable.
Struggling to his feet, he glanced in the direction of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, turned his head, and headed straight back to the mountain gate of the Yinyang Sect.
Such a ferocious peerless powerhouse, even someone merely passing by like him had to endure a slap, and those few True Martial Realm experts inside probably had little chance of good fortune.
Half an hour later, Chen Jingyun, Kurong Kong, and Tuoshan Kong, the grandmasters of the Buddhist and Yinyang Sects, left the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm one after the other, looking nearly dead, shocking all forces observing the secret realm.
They had all thought these three True Martial Realm experts died within the secret realm, especially considering how fierce the peerless powerhouse was just now. Dugu Bing was merely observing from afar, but he too got a slap, suffering severe injuries.
After the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm had been open for half an hour, it closed once again. The news quickly spread everywhere in the Xuan Domain, and even made it into the hands of the top echelons of other major powers in the Qianyuan Divine Province.
In the Daqian Empire, Capital City.
Upon receiving the news, Emperor Qian immediately went to the forbidden land to inform the Old Ancestor Zhenxiong of it, as it was something the ancestor had ordered—that they should inform him once the secret territory emerged.
Upon learning the news, Chu Dingqian fell into a long silence.
How did another True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, a peak peerless powerhouse, appear within the Daqian Empire’s territory?
“Ye Fan?”
Chu Dingqian went over it in his mind, confirmed he had never heard of him, and then asked, “Did Li Feiyu go?”
“No,” replied Emperor Qian.
“Go ahead,” said Chu Dingqian.
Emperor Qian exited.
Chu Dingqian sighed leisurely, but wasn’t surprised by the outcome.
The opening of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm was perilous in itself. If Li Feiyu had gone there, it was likely to have provoked an attack from those True Martial Realm Emperor Wus.
Fortunately, Li Feiyu hadn’t gone or else he would have ended up like Dugu Bing, receiving an unwarranted slap and suffering serious injuries.
Chu Dingqian didn’t wish for Li Feiyu to be gravely injured. At least not for the next four hundred years; otherwise, he wouldn’t be able to protect the Daqian Empire.
He was very satisfied with the situation this time; the illustrious strong martial artist named Ye Fan had really given him a great help.
Although the three True Martial Realm warriors from the Da Qian Empire, Da Liang Empire, and Fengbo Pavilion had successfully escaped, Chen Jingyun from the Yinyang Sect and Tuoshan Kong and Kurong Kong from the Buddhist Sect had suffered extremely serious injuries. It would be many years before they could cause trouble for the Da Qian Empire again.
This crisis of the Da Qian Empire was directly resolved, and he could now properly cultivate the Devil Fetus.
“Li Feiyu is really lucky,”
Chu Dingqian exclaimed. It was supposed to be Li Feiyu’s problem to deal with, but an illustrious strong martial artist had appeared and crippled three True Martial Realm Emperor Wus for him.
Ancient Empire.
Deep in the Imperial Palace, a dignified old man clad in dark battle attire withdrew his gaze; his expression was inscrutable.
The distance was too vast; even with the use of secret techniques, he could only barely glimpse a blurry scene and could not see the specifics.
After receiving detailed reports, the dignified old man also pondered to himself, just who was this Ye Fan at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm?
There were no such illustrious strong martial artists at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm in the Xuan Domain, and the other Emperor Wus of the True Martial Realm did not possess such dominant and overbearing strength; he surmised that this individual must be a strong martial artist from another domain.
“How interesting, to disregard the Buddhist Sect and even declare that a female Bodhisattva should come in person to be qualified to discuss matters with him—these are words even I would not dare to utter,”
“I really don’t know if you are young and audacious, or if you truly have the confidence,”
The dignified old man said, then sighed again. He felt great pressure as something significant was about to happen in the Xuan Domain soon. The emergence of Ye Fan was likely just an appetizer.
That True Martial Realm swordsman, Li Feiyu, and Ye Fan were all mysterious strong martial artists of untraceable origins, and it was very possible they had all come for this reason.
Buddha Domain, Xumi Mountain.
Seated high above the nine heavens, a female Bodhisattva teaching the Dharma slightly furrowed her brows; her sermon surrounded by Buddhist chants and bathed in the light of Buddha, the sight of a Buddha land spread across the myriad worlds momentarily vanished.
“Bodhisattva, Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong have emerged from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, but they were severely injured by a strong martial artist at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm named Ye Fan. Their injuries are grave; they cannot heal themselves,”
“That Ye Fan did not take our Buddhist Sect into account, even saying that only if the Bodhisattva herself comes would she be worthy to argue with him,”
Atop Xumi Mountain, a Kong in dignified appearance flew in, speaking carefully and respectfully.
“Oh~”
The female Bodhisattva continued her sermon as if unconcerned, her face as calm and serene as an ancient well’s depths.
Yet in her heart, a slight ripple had emerged. It had been so many years since anyone had dared to speak to her like that; perhaps more than sixteen hundred years had passed.
The last one to speak such words was the Third Grandmaster of the Dao Sect, Bai Yujing.
That person, exuding a murderous aura so vast it seemed he placed heaven first and himself second, had almost provoked the female Bodhisattva to strike him with her palm.
While continuing to preach, the female Bodhisattva formed several hand seals with her other hand, only to find no revelations, so she set the matter aside for the moment.
Ye Fan’s appearance at this time must be due to the matter unfolding in the Xuan Domain; it would not be too late to settle the score with him later.
Dao Domain, Bai Yujing, Breeze Pavilion.
The Second Grandmaster, who was genteel and easygoing, looked over the Dao Domain. Every move of his brought a sensation of a spring breeze. He was also stunned upon receiving the report.
“The junior brother has a successor,” the Second Grandmaster murmured after a while.
When the third junior brother said something similar before, he truly offended the female Bodhisattva from the Buddhist Sect. If it were not for the Sect Leader interceding, the third junior brother would have surely received a slap from the Bodhisattva.
Now, with Ye Fan suddenly emerging and speaking in the same manner, what would his fate be?
The Second Grandmaster smiled, feeling a sense of anticipation.
But just who was this Ye Fan?
Qianyuan Divine Province is vast, but there were not many at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm who were illustrious strong martial artists, and each had a great reputation.
There were a few dominant and overbearing individuals at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm. Perhaps one of them had made their way to the Xuan Domain, but why would he severely injure two Kongs of the Buddhist Sect and one True Martial Realm Emperor Wu of the Demon Clan?
The most crucial point was, this Ye Fan had also abducted the Demon Clan’s Lady Demon King, Bai Keqing.

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_1
Demon Domain, Myriad Demon Mountain.
The intelligence report regarding the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm finally made its way back and came to the knowledge of Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
“These bald donkeys from the Buddhist Sect are still as nauseating as ever,” Xue Yueqing said.
A trace of anger appeared on the delicate, flawless, and exquisite face of Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
Seven martial kings of the True Martial Realm were trapped in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm. None of the martial kings from the Demon Clan, Da Jing Empire, Da Liang Empire, and Emperor Mingtian’s forces had attacked Bai Keqing; only the Buddhist Sect had been so shameless.
They dared to use their numbers to bully and attempt to suppress and slay Bai Keqing. It was truly detestable.
Xue Yueqing had sent Bai Keqing to the Xuan Domain mainly for her to gain experience and see if she could incidentally find an opportunity. As for retrieving the Dragon Ball, she had no expectations at all.
Bai Keqing was her confidant, and Xue Yueqing had granted her many trump cards. Even if she returned in failure, there were excuses to reward her with an abundance of cultivation resources.
According to Xue Yueqing’s initial estimate, each force would at most send one martial king from the True Martial Realm to vie for the prize. The neighboring powers of the Da Qian Empire would not come out in full force, as the risks were too great.
The Kurong Sect indeed sent only Kurong Kong, a True Martial Realm martial king, but unexpectedly, the female Bodhisattva from Xumi Mountain had also sent Tuoshan Kong as support, which was extremely shameless.
If only Kurong Kong alone was there, although his combat ability was greater than that of Bai Keqing and Chen Jingyun, he could not keep both of them trapped in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
As the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm was about to emerge, Xue Yueqing had considered this and prepared to have the Heavenly Demon Hall predict the situation, to see if the expected scenario would unfold.
However, the prediction from the Heavenly Demon Hall revealed another piece of information, which somewhat disturbed Xue Yueqing, causing her to hastily consult with several Demon Emperors, temporarily setting aside Bai Keqing’s matter.
Fortunately, a strong figure arrived in time to injure both Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong, and rescued Bai Keqing. Otherwise, Bai Keqing could have possibly died, and if she didn’t die, she would have been taken back to Xumi Mountain for conversion. Either outcome was unacceptable to Xue Yueqing.
Although she didn’t know who Ye Fan was, Xue Yueqing felt some goodwill toward this person. Judging from his actions, he disliked both the Buddhist and Demon Sects; otherwise, Ye Fan would not have severely injured four martial kings from the two major paths.
Bai Keqing being saved by Ye Fan was much better than dying in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm or being captured and converted back at Xumi Mountain.
However, this Ye Fan was quite presumptuous and domineering, disrespecting the Bodhisattva and slapping any True Martial Realm martial kings that he passed by. With such strength and confidence, and such a style at the peak of the True Martial Realm, who could he possibly be?
Xue Yueqing wanted to have the Heavenly Demon Hall calculate more about this individual, but after some consideration, decided against it. Calculating for a peak True Martial Realm martial king would require too much energy, and the costs would multiply if Ye Fan had treasures to conceal his fate.
The Demon Clan is currently weak, and it’s best to preserve its foundation to deal with possible turmoils in the future. After all, Bai Keqing was not dead.
Within Myriad Demon Mountain, there was the life lamp of Bai Keqing, which had not been extinguished. Perhaps Bai Keqing would return to the Demon Domain to recover from her injuries. If she could not come back, then Xue Yueqing would have to make a trip to the Xuan Domain herself.
Gazing down upon the lands of the Demon Domain, Xue Yueqing sighed silently, contemplating, “Is the Qianyuan Divine Province about to fall into chaos too?”
According to her investigations, the major Sacred Lands have been actively preparing due to this incident—the Arhat who subdued the dragon from Xumi Mountain, the three Sect Leaders from Bai Yujing, the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea from the Heavenly Demon Hall, and so on—either have emerged or are about to emerge, all for this matter.
The magnitude of this incident was monumental, originating from the Xuan Domain and pulling in the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, causing the Four Great Sacred Lands of the Human Clan, the Myriad Demon Mountain of the Demon Clan, the Summit of Stars of the Barbarian Clan, and even the Penglai Immortal Sect to have Divine Yuan Realm martial kings intervening.
From the side of Myriad Demon Mountain, it had already been decided that she would go to the Xuan Domain to participate in the matter happening in nine years.
If Bai Keqing returned to the Demon Domain by then, there would be nothing to worry about. If not, Xue Yueqing would set out earlier, using special methods to find Bai Keqing’s whereabouts, take her away, and then go to participate in the matter.
East Sea, Dragon Palace.
“Is it over?”
Long Yue, who was deep in closed-door cultivation, suddenly opened her eyes, a mysterious glint flickered within them.
She had a special connection with the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, aware of when it opened and closed, but since Long Yue had been in closed-door cultivation, she was not aware of the specifics.
Murmuring to herself, Long Yue closed her eyes again to continue her cultivation.
Right now, her top priority was to break through to the 7th level of the True Martial Realm, and afterward head to the Xuan Domain to complete her final plan.
After that, she could then retire at ease, returning to the East Sea Dragon Palace to continue her cultivation and pursue the Divine Yuan Realm.
In the depths of the East Sea, Penglai Immortal Island.
Atop Penglai Divine Mountain, a gaunt old Taoist was sitting cross-legged on a cliff, facing the Divine Continent. The sea breeze hit his face, seemingly unnoticed by him.
Not far from him, there was a worn-out water jar in which a seven-colored dragon loach, no longer half-dead, displayed spirit in its eyes as it swam around.
At this moment, a young Taoist with an average appearance, dressed in a green Taoist robe and carrying an empty sword sheath on his back, appeared on the cliff.
Clasping his hands in his sleeves, the young Taoist walked up to the water jar, squatted down, and closely observed the seven-colored dragon loach, a thoughtful expression on his face.
Godly light flashed in the eyes of the young Taoist as he clucked in amazement several times before asking, “Old Taoist Guanhai, do you think she’ll succeed?”
The old Taoist, who had been sitting in meditation watching the sea, opened his eyes, a hint of helplessness flashing in them. This plague had run off to his Penglai again.
“Whether she succeeds or not, there is a fate and law unto itself,” the Old Taoist Guanhai said with a tone that was profound and unfathomable.
The young Taoist man pursed his lips and said, “It’s no fun when you pretend to be confused with such clear understanding.”

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_2
The old Taoist Guanhai smiled without saying a word, showing little interest in bothering with him.
Seeing that the young Taoist was still looking incessantly, obviously intent on unveiling the truth, Guanhai finally asked, “Lu Zhen, instead of being the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, what brings you to Penglai?”
Sitting down beside him with a casual posture and hands tucked into his sleeves, the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, Lu Zhen, bitterly smiled and said, “Baiyujing is just too boring. I’ve been cooped up there for over a thousand years, can’t I come out for a breath of fresh air?”
“The moment I left, I ran over to Penglai to see you. How’s that, pretty considerate of me, right?” Lu Zhen winked at Guanhai.
“You might as well stop there. Penglai doesn’t have any treasures for you to snatch away,” Guanhai directly punctured his intentions.
Undeterred, Lu Zhen continued, “That Immortal Flying Map of Penglai looks quite nice, could you bestow it upon this junior?”
The corners of Guanhai’s mouth twitched slightly. Although he knew all too well that Lu Zhen had thick skin, meeting him again after a thousand years still left him speechless.
“That Immortal Flying Map is a weapon for immortals, old Taoist can hardly use it, how could I possibly bestow it on you?” Guanhai shook his head.
“If not the Immortal Flying Map, then giving me an Emperor’s weapon should be alright, no?” Lu Zhen blinked, having seen the Immortal Flying Map before and not set much store by it.
Guanhai still shook his head, saying, “The Baiyujing house has great business and profound heritage, with countless immortal artifacts and emperor weapons. You, as the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, coming to Penglai to grab some loot, that’s quite unscrupulous.”
“Stingy.” Lu Zhen looked disappointed and then added, “Baiyujing and Penglai have been one family since ancient times, I…”
Guanhai arched his brow, and Lu Zhen stopped in mid-sentence, sighing inwardly without saying more.
The task his master had entrusted to him was too difficult; although Guanhai had a good relationship with him, accomplishing it was impossible.
“Lu Zhen, remember this: Penglai is Penglai, Baiyujing is Baiyujing, do not confuse the two,” Guanhai said coolly.
“Alas, old Taoist, why bother?”
Lu Zhen sighed and didn’t continue, changing the subject, “Who in Penglai is in charge of matters in the Xuan Domain?”
Guanhai glanced at him and said, “You don’t need to worry about that.”
Lu Zhen blinked and asked, “Could it be Sister Qingshuang?”
“It’s not.” Guanhai scoffed coldly.
Lu Zhen probed around the subject but found Guanhai impervious to persuasion and ultimately left disappointed.
He came to Penglai not only bearing his master’s instructions but also wishing to see which Divine Yuan Realm War Emperor Penglai Immortal Sect had dispatched this time.
If it were Sister Qingshuang, he would have been able to travel the Qianyuan Divine Province together with her.
Watching the spot where Lu Zhen had been seated before, Guanhai sighed deeply and closed his eyes once more.
Let’s turn back the clock slightly, to the Xuan Domain.
After fleeing from Leizhou’s Dingyuan Manor, Han Li swept up the Demon King and entered the Da Liang Empire, worrying about possible pursuers.
Bai Keqing had been silent from beginning to end. As soon as she saw this man who claimed to be Ye Fan stop, she was about to say something when Han Li abruptly struck her.
Han Li slapped the back of her neck, sealing her cultivation and then knocking her unconscious.
After doing this, Han Li threw her into the System Space and set aside an area to confine her before he finally heaved a sigh of relief.
Putting the Demon King into the System Space required her consent; Han Li didn’t have the patience to persuade her, and he didn’t want the Demon King to know about it—knocking her out was the simplest solution.
After strolling around the Da Liang Empire, Han Li quietly returned to the Qian Dynasty, back to Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
When the Demon King Bai Keqing woke up again, she found herself lying on a bed. Her expression changed slightly as she quickly checked herself and finally relaxed a bit.
She was unharmed.
“Where is this?”
Wondering internally, Bai Keqing got out of bed, finding herself in a regally decorated chamber. She walked out, opened the palace doors, only to be met by a handsome and imposing face.
Bai Keqing’s pupils constricted and her heart shook as she halted in place, feeling apprehensive.
This Ye Fan, who had saved her from two of the Buddhist Sect’s great Vajras, seemed to be no easy mark either. He had dealt her a heavy blow, just like any other True Martial Realm being, and eventually both sealed her cultivation and knocked her out.
She didn’t know why Ye Fan had saved her; Bai Keqing knew she didn’t know this person, a Human Clan’s peak True Martial Realm being, with whom she had no connection.
She also wasn’t sure how to escape, sensing an ominous premonition that once in his clutches, she might never get away.
If Ye Fan had been sent by the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing to rescue her, he wouldn’t have inflicted such injuries on her and sealed her cultivation.
Before she could think further, she found Ye Fan closing in on her. Bai Keqing quickly retreated until she could retreat no more, finding herself cornered against the wall by Han Li.
As Han Li continued to move closer, breathing in the masculine scent coming from him, Bai Keqing furrowed her brows and couldn’t help but rebuke, “Ye Fan, what are you trying to do?”
“What am I doing? Of course it’s…” Han Li paused, then continued, “I want to see what kind of demon you hail from.”
With a cold laugh, Bai Keqing provocatively leaned forward, moving close to Han Li’s ear and said, “Can you tell? I…mm…”
Bai Keqing’s warm breath caressed Han Li’s face. He raised an eyebrow, wrapped his arms around her tightly, lowered his head, and captured her lush, ripe lips.
After a long while, Han Li let her go, speaking calmly, “The taste of a Snake Demon is not bad indeed, especially since you are a True Martial Realm Demon King.”
Outraged, Bai Keqing realized that his rescue had not been out of good intentions, as he had just stolen her first kiss.

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Chapter 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_3
“Damn it~”
Bai Keqing cursed inwardly; her powers had been sealed, leaving her no room to resist. Otherwise, she would have slapped the man daring to treat her so frivolously long ago.
In the Demon Domain, she was a True Martial Realm Demon King, ruling over vast territories, a lofty queen whose fame spread throughout the entire domain.
Even a Great Grandmaster at the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm would have to bow respectfully in her presence—not daring the slightest disrespect.
Now, severely injured and stripped of her strength, even the powerful body of her demon race was sealed. She couldn’t even struggle.
Facing a peerless powerhouse at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm, it was not just about her powers being sealed; even at her peak, she would still be at his mercy.
She only hoped he would not treat her as a mere furnace for cultivation; she would rather die in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm than see her cultivation harvested by others.
“You’re not called Ye Fan, are you?” After some thought, Bai Keqing inquired.
Han Li nodded. At this point, he saw no need to conceal his identity and said, “Han Li. And you?”
She hesitated but eventually revealed her real name.
In her heart, she wondered whether there was a True Martial Realm powerhouse by the name of Han Li in the Xuan Domain or even within the Human Clan.
Could this man be seriously spewing nonsense?
“There’s no need to doubt; I am who I am, and you’ll know in a couple of days.”
Han Li smiled, waved his sleeve, and took Bai Keqing to the summit of Chengdao Peak. Lu Tianxiang had already left, having seen Bai Keqing during her unconsciousness.
Placing Bai Keqing to one side, Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, admiring the billowing sea of clouds over Chengsheng Mountain, with a faint smile on his face.
Successfully capturing the female Demon King Bai Keqing, he had finally fulfilled his wish—indeed, consistent effort was rewarded.
Bai Keqing moved closer to him, looked at the scenery of Chengsheng Mountain, and praised, “The scenery here indeed is majestic, no less than that of my own grounds.”
“So, what exactly is your purpose?”
Bai Keqing turned around to face Han Li and asked directly.
She could tell; Han Li had no intention of killing her. He saved her for another reason, and this was precisely what intrigued Bai Keqing.
What did Han Li want to do?
Use her as a cultivation furnace?
Subdue her as a subordinate?
Or did he wish for her to become his partner?
Bai Keqing’s thoughts shifted, unable to guess at Han Li’s purpose. She had no plans to bring up the protection of the great Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, as this man was brazen and would not be swayed by such tactics.
After all, Han Li had grievously wounded two True Martial Realm Emperors from the Buddhist Sect and two from the Demon Sect, capturing her, a Demon Clan True Martial Realm Emperor, and had even dared to say, “Let the female Bodhisattva come for her.”
This was sufficient to see just how dominant and arrogant he was, full of confidence, not fearing her threats.
Hearing this, Han Li also directed his gaze at Bai Keqing, his eyes warming up slightly.
Bai Keqing had a stunningly enchanting beauty, with a pair of slender, seductive pale blue eyes that brimmed with allure, perpetually sparking with electricity.
Her slender curves were concealed beneath a pale blue dress, her mature and ample body almost bursting forth, her skin as white as snow and flawless, exuding a wild yet bewitching and sultry air.
Her long pale blue hair was casually draped over her waist, hanging down to her enticingly slender waist.
Below that, the slit in her pale blue dress revealed her long, fair legs and delicate pink feet.
“My purpose is simple. Marry into the Han Mansion and become my partner,” Han Li said with a smile.
Bai Keqing’s eyebrows rose, and a smile surfaced on her enchantingly beautiful face as she spoke softly, “Partner or cultivation furnace?”
“Partner.”
Han Li’s tone was firm, and after a pause, he added, “The ninth partner.”
“The ninth?” The smile disappeared from Bai Keqing’s face, and she turned cold.
“Han Li, what kind of joke is this?”
“I, a True Martial Realm Demon King, become your partner and rank ninth. Do you mean to tell me that your previous eight partners are all True Martial Realm masters?”
Bai Keqing laughed scornfully, her face clearly expressing dissatisfaction.
If she were to be Han Li’s sole partner, Bai Keqing could begrudgingly accept it. His cultivation level was profound, a peak True Martial Realm powerhouse, just half a step from the Divine Yuan Realm Emperor.
Yet, being one among several partners was unacceptable to Bai Keqing. She didn’t believe Han Li’s previous eight partners could all be of the True Martial Realm; that just seemed impossible, with even one being quite remarkable.
She had never heard of any True Martial Realm Emperor with eight True Martial Realm partners. Not even the Divine Yuan Realm Emperors had that, so it was unlikely Han Li did, otherwise, he would not be so obscure.
Back when she reached the True Martial Realm, a Demon Emperor had invited her to become his second partner, and even then, Bai Keqing had declined.
With the protection of the great Xue Yueqing, that Demon Emperor dared not forcefully make her his partner, so Bai Keqing had escaped that fate.
“They are not True Martial Realm Emperors.”
Han Li nodded nonchalantly and explained, “However, in my eyes, none of that is important. You have to accept it whether you like it or not, or I don’t mind having an extra demon king as my female slave.”
“You…” Bai Keqing was so angry she couldn’t find the words to speak.
Was it truly alright for him to treat her, a True Martial Realm Demon King, with such contempt?
To even consider making her a female slave was outrageous!
After some thought, Bai Keqing decided to relent. Stepping back was the better option, as she gritted her teeth and said, “Then I will be the lead partner.”
Compared to being a female slave, being a partner was still preferable. Now that she had fallen into Han Li’s hands without the protection of Xue Yueqing, she had little choice.

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Chapter 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_4
“You don’t have a choice,” Han Li said.
“That’s too much,” Bai Keqing bit her silver teeth, a look of anger appearing on her stunningly enchanting face.
She had accepted being one of the nine Dao companions, and yet he still wanted her to be the ninth?
She was of the True Martial Realm, she was the lofty queen of the Demon Clan, when had she ever been so humble?
Not even regarding the second Dao companion of the Demon Emperor with any significance, and now, to be one of your nine Dao companions, you should be thankful, and yet you still demean me?
Seeing Bai Keqing’s angry face, Han Li explained, “In my eyes, all of you have the same status, there’s no distinction between junior and senior.”
“I know that cultivation for the Demon Clan progresses slowly, with your talents, to reach the second level of the True Martial Realm would probably take over two hundred years, right?”
Bai Keqing felt somewhat better upon hearing this and retorted with a pout, “What are you trying to say?”
“You have a great deal of elixirs that can enhance True Martial Realm cultivation, and you must give them all to me, to help improve my cultivation?”
Han Li shook his head, and just as Bai Keqing felt disappointed, she heard Han Li say, “I don’t have any pills that can enhance the True Martial Realm cultivation for now, but I do have a Pill Formula.”
“What I mean to say is, I have an Immortal Scripture level Dual Cultivation Technique, and if you become my Dao companion, our dual cultivation could bring you great benefits, significantly shortening the time it takes for you to reach the peak of the True Martial Realm.”
Naturally, he did not have an Immortal Scripture level Dual Cultivation Technique, but he had the System, and the new version of the System had this function; Han Li thought it was no less than an Immortal Scripture.
He had already tested it on his beloved wives like Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, as well as beautiful concubines like Qiu Yueyao, Liu Yuexin, and Li Mingmeng, with excellent results, making their cultivation soar.
In just a little over two months, the cultivation levels of his beloved wives and concubines had improved significantly, on average by one or two Big Realms, and now the one with the lowest cultivation was in the Gangyuan Realm.
Gongsun Yue, Song Zhixuan, and Lin Yiwu, who were originally in the Gangyuan Realm, had directly advanced to the mid to late stages of God Refining Realm.
Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Xue Qingyi, and Feng Ziyue, who were in the late stage of the God Refining Realm, had improved to the Initial Stage of the Void Realm.
Chu Xianlin, who was at the mid-stages of the Void Realm, had advanced to the late stage of the Void Realm, and Lu Tianxiang, who was at the first layer of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, had also advanced to the Third Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
The effects of the dual cultivation function were extremely noticeable, but Han Li also knew that the later it got, the smaller the effects would be; naturally, as his wives and concubines’ levels of cultivation rose, the cultivation gains from each dual cultivation session would diminish.
Unless his own cultivation experienced a rapid breakthrough, ascending to a higher realm, could he continue to help his wives and concubines increase their realms as before.
An Immortal Scripture level Dual Cultivation Technique, significantly reducing the time needed to cultivate to the peak of the True Martial Realm…
Upon hearing these two statements, Bai Keqing suddenly looked up at Han Li and inquired, “Are you telling the truth?”
Bai Keqing felt somewhat tempted, if that was the case, then becoming Han Li’s ninth Dao companion was somewhat acceptable; after all, with no distinction in status, she wouldn’t be aggrieved.
Bai Keqing desired to cultivate to the peak of the True Martial Realm, even breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm, which is something every Emperor Wu at the True Martial Realm immensely yearned for.
Just that she knew, without fortuitous opportunities, it was unlikely for her to cultivate to the peak of the True Martial Realm or even the Divine Yuan Realm, as it would take too much time.
At the initial stages of the True Martial Realm, it took her hundreds of years to breakthrough each realm, and at the intermediate stages, based on the experience of other Demon Kings, it took a thousand years for a single minor realm.
The gap from the sixth to the seventh heaven of the True Martial Realm was a major hurdle, stopping seventy to eighty percent of True Martial Realm Emperors from advancing any further, from breaking through to the later stages of the True Martial Realm.
If she continued like this, in the future, she might be old and still find it difficult to advance to the later stages of the True Martial Realm, let alone reaching the peak of the True Martial Realm or advancing to become an Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm.
If it was possible to significantly reduce her cultivation time, assisting her in rapidly cultivating to the peak of the True Martial Realm, then the Divine Yuan Realm was indeed within reach.
A person from the human Clan could only live for five thousand years in the Divine Yuan Realm, while she could live nearly twenty thousand years, becoming a Demon Emperor like the great Xue Yueqing, standing at the pinnacle of the entire Qianyuan Divine Province.
“Whether it’s true or not, you’ll need to verify it yourself,” Han Li said with a smile.
He knew that if Bai Keqing didn’t believe him, no amount of talking would be useful. Once Bai Keqing tried it, she would naturally know if what he said was true.
“Would you dare to undo the seal on my cultivation?”
An enchanting smile flashed across Bai Keqing’s face; she had already made her decision.
“I cannot,” Han Li said, shaking his head.
Bai Keqing was an unstable factor at the moment; he dared not unseal her cultivation. If Bai Keqing did something foolish, it would be too late for regrets. Moreover, the array at the Han Mansion would not be able to stop her if he went to The Li Manor.
“Then what’s the point of all this talk?” Bai Keqing stretched her slender waist and gave a cold laugh.
With her cultivation sealed, even if dual cultivation truly had a substantial effect, she couldn’t improve her cultivation — so, what use was it to her to cultivate together?
She would be completely under Han Li’s control, and through dual cultivation, he could improve his own cultivation, with all the benefits falling into Han Li’s hands, while she would end up completely at a loss.
“I can let you experience it once first, and then unseal your cultivation in a year. How about that?” after thinking it over, Han Li said.
He planned to hook Bai Keqing with the effects of dual cultivation first, and in a year, after Bai Keqing would have had children, his own cultivation would also advance further, truly possessing the combat ability of the Divine Yuan Realm.
After hesitating for a while, Bai Keqing nodded her head, and with a seductive smile towards Han Li, she said, “Then come, let me properly feel it for myself, and I hope you’re not all bark and no bite.”
The Demon Queen really is different; so bold in her speech, being so open after agreement, and even actively seeking pleasure.

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Chapter 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_5
“Then let’s begin.”
Han Li’s large hand pulled Bai Keqing into his embrace, and their shadows vanished from the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Originally, he had intended to wait until after officially marrying Bai Keqing to dual cultivate with her, but since Bai Keqing was eager to experience the effects of dual cultivation, Han Li naturally would not hold back.
After returning to his own sleeping quarters, Han Li laid down a formation and then unsealed Bai Keqing’s cultivation. He even kindly healed her wounds, as a demon queen weakened from serious injuries might have impaired combat ability.
Once these tasks were completed, Patriarch Han began his journey to subdue the demon queen.
Three days later, Patriarch Han formally took a wife, and the grand wedding ceremony caught the attention of the entire Yonchang Manor.
“The Han Family Patriarch is welcoming his fifth wife.”
This news spread throughout Yonchang Manor and even reached several neighboring manors, making countless cultivators click their tongues in wonder.
As cultivators discussed Patriarch Han’s valor, they were also very curious about the origins of Patriarch Han’s beautiful and gentle wives.
Ever since the Han Mansion had moved to Chengsheng Mountain in Yonchang Manor, they had held five wedding ceremonies, but the background and identity of each wife had never been disclosed.
Nor had any power in Yuanzhou or even Yonchang Manor claimed that the Patriarch’s wives came from their influence.
This made countless cultivators even more curious. With Patriarch Han marrying repeatedly, no one outside knew exactly who he had married.
Powers only became aware of the identities and origins of Patriarch Han’s concubines when he took them, and could see their true forms, but they were completely in the dark about the identities of Patriarch Han’s wives.
Han Li, of course, offered no explanations. The identities of his five wives varied, each with their background, and with his current status, he could not reveal them yet, or else it would bring great trouble.
The wedding ceremony took place as scheduled, with the various powers of Yonchang Manor very graciously attending. With the situation in the Daqian Empire now stable, they certainly did not want to offend Han Mansion.
Han Mansion was willing to keep a low profile, staying in the spiritually impoverished corner of Chengsheng Mountain without competing over territory or cultivation resources with them; it was a true relief.
In the past two to three years, the forces of Yonchang Manor had more than once been thankful for Han Mansion’s discretion. Looking at the other manors and states, the newly moved-in forces were locked in fierce battles with the local powers over territory and resources.
After the wedding ceremony ended, Han Li entered the bridal chamber and saw Bai Keqing who was now different from before.
Bai Keqing had changed from her light blue dress into bridal attire, adding a touch of grace and tenderness to her originally seductive and untamed, sexy charm.
Especially these past few days, through Patriarch Han’s diligent efforts, Bai Keqing had evolved and developed another kind of temperament.
That beautiful night, sleep was impossible.
Following their first dual cultivation, Bai Keqing’s cultivation had increased significantly. Confident in the truth of Han Li’s words, she transformed from demon queen to Goddess of War, clamoring daily to battle Patriarch Han.
Due to certain considerations, Han Li did not use a seal on Bai Keqing’s physical body, so she still possessed formidable combat strength.
After spending several days and nights together with Bai Keqing, Han Li finally slipped away from her, hiding back in the Li Manor. He suspected that if this continued, Bai Keqing would literally drain him dry.
Bai Keqing was now aware that another of Han Li’s identities was Li Feiyu, and she was quite surprised, her opinion of Han Li changing considerably.
This man was cunning and deceitful, a true survivor.
Han Li, with a cultivation at the peak of the True Martial Realm, was a powerful being, nearly invincible in the Xuan Domain, yet he remained so low-key, so focused on survival, revealing only the cultivation of the God Refining Realm.
She also realized that Han Li was indeed a man of great desire, taking wives and concubines under another identity, and doing so at an alarmingly rapid pace. Was he planning on gathering all the beautiful female cultivators of Da Qian into the Han Mansion and the Li Manor?
During one battle, Han Li learned of the existence of the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing from Bai Keqing and realized that he had set his sights on the esteemed Xue Yueqing. This left her astounded by Han Li’s audacious lust.
The Li Manor in the Capital City of the Qian Dynasty.
Han Li stood atop Chong Xiao Pavilion, hands clasped behind his back, gazing in the direction of the Imperial Palace.
He wondered if he should sneak into the Imperial Palace now, eliminate Chu Dingqian, and then seize the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
As soon as the thought occurred, he acted. Han Li, with the powerful Power of the Divine Spirit, concealed his aura and slipped into the Imperial Palace undetected.
Out of caution, Han Li did not use his Spiritual Sense but relied on his Divine Spirit to sense his surroundings, wandering the Imperial Palace unperceived as he passed by maids and guards without anyone noticing him.
After exploring for a while, upon reaching the harem, he discovered the Empress engaged in her toilette, and his eyes lit up.
He observed the Empress from behind for a while. Despite her being at the Hollow Void Stage, she was wholly focused on her grooming and failed to notice Han Li’s presence.
With a silent sigh, Han Li’s figure disappeared from the Empress’s chamber, continuing his search.
Before long, Han Li finally located Chu Dingqian’s place of seclusion—a forbidden area of the Imperial Palace, enveloped in the formidable presence of a formation.
Even though the formation was concealed, Han Li still sensed it. Its strength was undeniably Third Grade, and even among the top Third Grade formations, a late True Martial Realm cultivator might fall victim to it if not vigilant.
Han Li was almost certain that Chu Dingqian was inside. He had been everywhere else in the palace, and only this place had a top-tier Third Grade formation laid out.
If Chu Dingqian was planning a reincarnation, he would need a location free from disturbance, the safest place to be, and this was the ideal choice.
“What a pity,” Han Li muttered to himself inwardly as his figure vanished, choosing not to storm in and eradicate Chu Dingqian.

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: Chapter 178: Marrying Bai Keqing! Female Demon King? Goddess of War! Breakthrough! Breakthrough!_6
Although he had the strength to do so, there was no need, as it would trigger the Formation and cause a great disturbance, which was not his intention.
Hence, Han Li decided to wait until his realm further advanced, his combat ability stepped into the Divine Yuan Realm, and he possessed the battle prowess of an Emperor Wu level, before making his move to assassinate Chu Dingqian.
He was not in a hurry, after all, Chu Dingqian wouldn’t be able to reincarnate anytime soon, and Han Li still had time to wait.
After Han Li left, in the Great Hall of the Forbidden Grounds of the Imperial Palace, Chu Dingqian suddenly awoke.
He had just sensed a faint malice aimed at him, which put Chu Dingqian on high alert.
His powerful Spiritual Sense surged out, scrutinizing the area outside the Forbidden Grounds, the entire Imperial Palace, and even scanning the Capital City several times, paying particular attention to the Li Manor.
Chu Dingqian suspected that the malice might come from Li Feiyu, but found no evidence. After relaxing, he felt that he might have been overly suspicious.
How could Li Feiyu know about his situation and sneak into the Imperial Palace to assassinate him?
Besides, he possessed the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, making him stronger than Li Feiyu. If it really were Li Feiyu, it would be simple to just kill him directly.
