If it were another powerhouse, such as Ye Fan, who suddenly appeared and injured four True Martial Realm experts of two great Sacred Lands, he would be facing a peak True Martial Realm ultimate powerhouse whom he couldn’t withstand even with the Soul-Cultivating Furnace in hand.
“Hopefully, I’m just overthinking it,” Chu Dingqian muttered to himself before returning to sit cross-legged in front of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
He had thought about moving from this place, yet after hesitating he chose not to do so, reasoning that if the Daqian Imperial Palace wasn’t safe, the outside world would be even more dangerous.
Cultivating the Devil Fetus required a long time, and he would occasionally awaken to deal with affairs of the Da Qian Empire. Moreover, if other powerhouses targeted him, the Capital City would be the safest place. At least Li Feiyu was there to lend him aid.
In Li Mansion, at the Chong Xiao Pavilion.
Han Li continued to look towards the Imperial Palace, but not in Chu Dingqian’s direction, as his mind occasionally conjured an image of a beautiful silhouette.
“What a pity,” Han Li sighed.
Such a fine woman, how did she end up as the Empress of the Daqian Empire?
She was Emperor Qian’s Empress, which made Han Li somewhat cautious, as acting rashly could easily cause a backlash from the Daqian Empire.
If the Daqian Empire descended into chaos again, it would not be conducive to the development of Han Mansion or the Li Manor, and would not align with his original intentions.
As the sigh fell, Han Li’s figure disappeared from the Chong Xiao Pavilion, appearing beside Chu Xianlin, engaging with her affectionately.
Then Chu Xianlin directly expressed her desire for dual cultivation with her ancient ancestor, a sign of her insatiable craving. After a period of dual cultivation with her husband, her cultivation had soared, breaking through to the late stage of the Hollow Void Realm, which delighted Chu Xianlin immensely.
Chu Xianlin wished her husband could dual cultivate with her every day, so that she could quickly ascend to the Myriad Phenomena Realm and become a Great Grandmaster. In the future, advancing to the True Martial Realm would also be within her reach.
Unfortunately, her husband didn’t have just one wife. Not only did he have four wives, but also over forty concubines, so even if she wanted to engage in frequent dual cultivation, it was impossible as her husband believed in showering attention evenly.
Three months later.
Han Li stood atop Chengdao Peak with a beaming smile, feeling refreshed even in his breaths.
In these three months, his nights were filled with music and unceasing battles, sometimes even reversing day and night, but the result was gratifying.
The beloved wives and beautiful concubines of Han Mansion and the Li Manor had their cultivation levels significantly increased, those with higher cultivation levels improved by one or two minor realms, while those with lower cultivation levels improved by several minor realms, their cultivation progress had indeed skyrocketed.
In these three months, Han Li had unlocked three treasure chests, spending a total of fifteen years of cultivation effort, but his luck was not too bad.
The first chest yielded a Heaven Rank top-grade Magical Treasure, the second a Heaven Rank mid-grade Cultivation Technique, and the third a Second Grade Spirit Pill, a “True Martial Pill”.
Second-grade elixirs correspond to the Divine Yuan Realm, but the True Martial Pill is not meant for the martial emperors of the Divine Yuan Realm, nor even for the martial kings of the True Martial Realm, it is prepared for those grandmasters at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Taking a True Martial Pill, the probability of advancing to the True Martial Realm increases directly by over fifty percent, and it also aids in enhancing the quality of the condensed Martial True Pill, potentially improving it by one to three grades.
It could be said that the effects of the True Martial Pill are truly heaven-defying, directly creating a martial king in the True Martial Realm.
When Han Li obtained the True Martial Pill, he had already considered to whom he would give it.
Beyond these, what pleased Han Li the most was that his cultivation talent had ascended from fourth-grade to third-grade.
In these three months, many offspring were born within Han Mansion and in Li Mansion too, with nearly the same increase in population numbers for both, but the quality of Li Mansion’s offspring was countless times higher.
On Han Mansion’s side, twenty-nine were born, but only nine possessed cultivation talents, and none were high, somewhat raising Han Li’s talent;
In Li Mansion, the first batch of beautiful concubines he accepted all gave birth, totaling twenty-seven, all endowed with aptitudes, and as he predicted, the talents were around fifth or sixth-grade.
This provided Han Li with a massive amount of talent feedback, directly elevating his talent to third-grade.
With a smile, Han Li opened the system panel to take a glance.
Talent: Third-grade 4%
After ascending to third-grade talent, the resistance he received from the progeny with fifth or sixth-grade talents greatly lessened, otherwise, it would have been even more.
However, Han Li was not in a hurry, as his four beautiful wives in Li Mansion—Xue Qingyi, Chu Xianlin, Song Zhixuan, and Feng Ziyue—were all going to give birth in the next half-year, which would bring him quite a substantial amount of talent.
Han Mansion’s Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue, these four beautiful wives, were also pregnant again, and in eight months, they would give birth,
Upon seeing that dual cultivation greatly increased their cultivation levels quickly, they also no longer resisted the prospect of having children.
Bai Keqing, the female Demon King he married three months ago, had also been pregnant for a long time and would give birth in seven months; this child would likely be of third-grade aptitude, bringing a large amount of talent feedback to Han Li.
The number of his talented descendants had already reached 377, and with the addition of 36 in these three months, it directly reached the standard for a new round of rewards.
Han Li glanced at the message panel, and the last system notification appeared before his eyes.
“With the number of your descendants possessing cultivation talents reaching four hundred, you have gained a hundred years of cultivation, you have received five Fifth Grade Longevity Pills, you have received a hundred years of talisman-making experience, and you have obtained the Heaven Rank lower-grade martial technique [Meteor Sword Scripture].”
After absorbing the hundred years of talisman-making experience, Han Li’s attainments in talisman-making rose to fourth-grade, and even within fourth-grade, he ranked among the middle level.
Under the bolstering of the embryonic form of the all-encompassing Martial True Intent, the Meteor Sword Scripture could rival supreme grade martial techniques of Heaven Rank. Han Li, using this technique, could unleash combat power at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm, just as he could with the Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Fist and the Bulwark Imprisoning Stamp.
With this additional hundred years of cultivation, the reserves of Han Li’s cultivation had made a significant breakthrough, reaching 542 years, enough to allow him to break through many minor realms of strength.
After all, he was now of third-grade talent, which meant the amount of cultivation he needed was halved, although each minor realm still required a lot, compared to before.
“Hoo~”
Finally, after one last look at the majestic expanse of cloud waves, Han Li exhaled a breath, his figure disappearing from the summit of Chengdao Peak.
He arrived at his own sleeping chamber, then quickly arranged a formation and sat down cross-legged at the center of the formation.
A smile appeared on Han Li’s face, as he was about to begin his breakthrough.
As his mind moved, his aura instantly began to surge.

chapters.title: Chapter 283: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_1
In this moment, an extremely formidable aura emanated from the sleeping chamber, shooting straight into the clouds as if it wanted to shake the Nine Heavens. Fortunately, it was concealed by the great formation; otherwise, a large part of the Daqian Empire would have witnessed the marvel of a breakthrough.
Nobody knew that Han Li, famed across the Xuan Domain, was in seclusion, attempting a breakthrough, still only at the First Heaven of the True Martial Realm. Everyone outside believed he was a peak-level powerhouse of the True Martial Realm.
As soon as Han Li’s thoughts moved, the massive amount of cultivation he had accumulated on the panel began to be consumed at a rapid pace, with many years’ worth of cultivation being used up every second to enhance Han Li’s strength.
In the blink of an eye, Han Li entered the Enlightenment State, began practicing martial techniques, probing mysteries, and creating laws. This state lasted for a very long time, with every instant being equivalent to a hundred years, continuously perfecting the embryonic form of his omnipotent martial true intent.
In reality, a moment passed, but in the Enlightenment State, it equated to one hundred years. This caused the degree of perfection of Han Li’s embryonic form of omnipotent martial true intent to surge tremendously, pushing toward deeper levels as though he was about to step into an extremely profound domain.
51%…60%…70%…
With every passing century, Han Li’s understanding of the embryonic form of omnipotent martial true intent deepened substantially. He grasped endless martial profundities and was inundated with the infinite truths of the Dao. Han Li was devouring and wildly comprehending them, absorbing and digesting.
When Han Li awoke from the Enlightenment State, all of the mysteries he had comprehended converted into his cultivation, causing it to soar steadily. His aura surged, growing stronger and stronger to the extent that it seemed to suppress the Nine Heavens. Even the void started to warp under the influence of his aura as though it would shatter.
True Martial Realm Second Heaven!
True Martial Realm Third Heaven!
True Martial Realm Fourth Heaven!
True Martial Realm Fifth Heaven!
Han Li’s aura continued to rise frantically, reaching an extreme intensity. His cultivation was still growing, advancing by leaps and bounds, heading straight for the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
Soon, Han Li’s aura broke through a critical point, stepping into a new domain. His cultivation reached the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, and his aura surged by many times, disturbing the stability of the void.
“Huh~”
After a good while, Han Li exhaled deeply, opened his eyes, and divine light flickered within, like two great stars circulating, terrifying in their majesty.
“What a supremely powerful force, is this the combat ability of the Divine Yuan Realm level?”
Han Li murmured to himself, extremely satisfied with this breakthrough. In one go, he had shot from the First Heaven of the True Martial Realm to the Sixth Heaven, progress that could be described as meteoric.
In just under half a quarter of an hour, he broke through five minor realms, all while still in the True Martial Realm. This news, if it spread to the outside world, would be sure to cause a huge stir and shake the entire Qianyuan Divine Province.
Even the Great Emperors of ancient times had not achieved such a swift series of breakthroughs in the True Martial Realm; breaking through five minor realms in half a quarter of an hour was truly shocking and defied all norms.
After stabilizing his aura, Han Li finally turned to the panel to check the cultivation consumed by this breakthrough.
[System Notification: Congratulations to the master for advancing to the Second Heaven of the True Martial Realm, consuming 50 years of cultivation.]
[System Notification: Congratulations to the master for advancing to the Third Heaven of the True Martial Realm, consuming 75 years of cultivation.]
[System Notification: Congratulations to the master for advancing to the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, consuming 150 years of cultivation.]
“Hiss~”
Even though he had expected it, Han Li still took in a sharp breath of spiritual energy.
Just breaking through five minor realms, he had used up 500 years of cultivation, which was an immense amount.
Consider that his advancement from the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm to the First Heaven of the True Martial Realm had only used up six hundred years of cultivation, and it becomes clear how difficult it is for the Emperors of the True Martial Realm to break through.
Han Li clicked his tongue in wonder.
Even after his talent had improved to Third Grade, the breakthrough had still consumed 500 years of cultivation. Had he still been at Fourth Grade, it would have required a thousand years to advance to the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
Glancing at the remaining cultivation on the panel, Han Li sighed. This advancement had nearly drained all his resources.
Before the breakthrough, he had accumulated a full 542 years of cultivation, and in just under half a quarter of an hour, five hundred years had evaporated, earning him the realm of the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, as well as the combat ability of a Divine Yuan Emperor.
Closing his personal panel, Han Li inquired about the cultivation needed for subsequent breakthroughs, and his expression gradually soured.
“Damn!”
Master Han could not help but curse.
Now at the realm of the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, to break through to the Seventh Heaven, he needed a full two hundred years of cultivation, for the Eighth Heaven three hundred years, and for the Ninth Heaven four hundred years.
For these next three minor realms, he would need a total of nine hundred years of cultivation, so Han Li couldn’t help but exhale deeply to calm his emotions.
Nine hundred years of cultivation was what it would take to break through to the Ninth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, and to cultivate to the perfected state of the Ninth Heaven, the peak of the True Martial Realm, would need yet another hundred years of cultivation.
“How many years will I need to accumulate to save up a thousand years of cultivation?” Master Han sighed.
If his talent were to improve to Second Grade, the needed cultivation would be halved. But since he had just improved to Third Grade with only 4% progress, the leap to Second Grade talent was still so far off as to be almost out of reach.
The total number of his descendants had now reached 1098, with 413 of them being of talent pedigree; the ratio had further narrowed, but it would still be a long time before the next reward could be anticipated.
A total of two thousand descendants was required for a new reward, which was very substantial, but still far off. However, reaching 500 talented descendants could be something to look forward to, as the reward would probably be significantly higher than at four hundred.
“I hope that by the time the total number of descendants reaches 2000, the number of talented descendants will have truly broken through the thousand mark,” Han Li said with a hint of expectation on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 284: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_2
The rewards for attaining the “hundred” stage in terms of talented descendants are already so generous; if one were to reach the “thousand” stage, the rewards would undoubtedly soar dramatically, as can be seen from the rich rewards gained upon reaching a total of a thousand descendants.
A heavy burden and a long road ahead!
This was Han Li’s feeling, but fortunately, his strength was now sufficient. Even if it took ten, twenty years, or even longer, his combat ability would ensure his own safety and that of Han Mansion.
Now, his combat ability was genuinely that of a Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu.
As for who is the strongest in the Xuan Domain now, that would really require a match to find out.
The higher the cultivation level, the higher the level of contact, and the more intelligence and secrets one can understand. The Ancient Empire has been a towering Divine Mountain over the Xuan Domain, standing unyielding for more than sixteen thousand years.
Only when one’s cultivation level reaches a certain stage, at least a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage, can one understand how powerful the foundation of the Ancient Empire truly is. This is the only top-tier power in the Xuan Domain with a Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu for generations without interruption.
If it weren’t for the intervention of the Four Great Sacred Lands, the Ancient Empire would have long since swept across the Six Harmonies, suppressed the Eight Desolations, and unified the vast and boundless Xuan Domain.
Just how strong the Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu of the Ancient Empire is, not even the True Martial Realm Emperor Wu from within the Ancient Empire knows, let alone the True Martial Realm Emperor Wu from the outside world. Probably only the higher-ups of the Four Great Sacred Lands are clear about this.
The Ancient Empire itself is aware that occupying one-third of the Xuan Domain is their limit and they cannot expand further unless a powerful being from the Tongxuan Realm emerges to change the situation.
“How do my combat abilities compare with those of the old monster from the Ancient Empire, who is stronger and who is weaker?” Han Li pondered silently.
When he was at the first heaven of the True Martial Realm, his True Yuan reserves were comparable to those of the sixth heaven, and now that he had reached the sixth heaven of the True Martial Realm, his True Yuan reserves barely matched those of the ninth heaven.
Han Li had anticipated this situation; every minor realm within the True Martial Realm had a great disparity, especially in the later stages. Having True Yuan comparable to the ninth heaven of the True Martial Realm, Han Li was quite content.
With the breakthrough across five minor realms in succession, Han Li’s overall strength also increased. His physique was comparable to a body cultivator’s at the third heaven of the True Martial Realm, and both his Divine Spirit and Spiritual Sense had vastly improved, on par with the ninth heaven of the True Martial Realm.
His five senses were also significantly enhanced, leading to a deeper understanding of Divine Sense and allowing him to stay in this realm for longer periods.
The first time he activated Divine Sense, Han Li could maintain it for 30 seconds, the second time for 25 seconds, and the third time for 20 seconds—able to sustain it for a continuous 75 seconds, roughly 25 breaths.
If the activation was intermittent, the time he could step into the realm of Divine Sense was even longer, roughly 80 breaths, close to half the duration of a cup of tea. (In the book, the duration of a cup of tea is set as 10 minutes; do not dispute this.)
With this improvement, Han Li was very satisfied. He could now activate Divine Sense for an extended period, no longer just the six-second man he once was.
The perfection level of his all-around Martial Dao true meaning prototype had soared by half, from 50% to 75%, which meant Han Li’s overall strength received an even stronger enhancement.
Before, he could only enhance the might of martial techniques by three grades, but now he could enhance them by three and a half.
Upon introspection, Han Li discovered that the Martial Fake Pill within him had become even more real, imbued with many Primordial Yuan meanings.
He knew that when Martial Dao and Primordial Yuan became one, it signified that his realm had reached the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm, and he could then prepare to break through to the Divine Yuan Realm.
After reflecting for a while, Han Li opened his personal attribute panel to check his combat ability after consecutive realm breakthroughs.
His speed had already been equivalent to the eighth heaven of the True Martial Realm, and now he had progressed further, rivaling the peak of the top True Martial Realm; his defense had also thoroughly entered the Divine Yuan Realm level, comparable to the first heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Han Li discovered that using those Earth-grade mid-level martial techniques, he could now exert the combat ability of the ninth heaven of the True Martial Realm. If he used the Xuantian Punch and Yin and Yang Palm Seal, which were only cultivated to the major proficiency, he could barely unleash the threshold combat ability of the Divine Yuan Realm.
The so-called threshold combat ability of the Divine Yuan Realm is the lowest within the Divine Yuan Realm, but it could be considered invincible in the True Martial Realm.
The Meteor Sword Scripture could unleash the normal combat ability of the first heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, and using the Dragon Abyss Sword would enhance his strength significantly, but it would not reach the second heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Without activating Divine Sense, the strongest combat ability Han Li could unleash was the second heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, enabling the use of the Meteor Sword Scripture, Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Punch, and the Stupa Suppressing Hell Seal.
These three martial techniques, with the enhancement of the all-around Martial Dao true meaning prototype, were very close to the martial techniques of the Divine Rank Lower Grade; he had cultivated all of them to the complete level, no less than some Divine Rank Lower Grade martial techniques.
If Divine Sense was to be activated, his overall strength would increase tenfold, reaching the third heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, whether he could reach the fourth heaven, Han Li was not sure.
All these combat abilities were estimated based on records of the strength of some Divine Yuan Realm powerhouses and were compared to ordinary Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu.
If they were those who mastered high-level martial arts, possessed high-grade Martial Dao Primordial Spirits, controlled powerful Divine Weapons, had cultivated many Divine Rank martial techniques, and had a high mastery of those, their combat ability could be higher than their realm; such cases were not what Han Li was comparing himself against.
The further one cultivates, the more important one’s foundation becomes. The foundation includes many aspects; what has been mentioned is only part of it.
Just mastering one or two aspects can make one’s combat ability surpass one’s realm. The more aspects mastered, the higher the combat ability becomes. Such individuals are indeed peerless prodigies amongst their peers.

chapters.title: Chapter 285: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_3
All those who have cultivated to the Divine Yuan Realm possess extraordinary talents. They either have great fortune and destiny or high qualifications, and are seen as heavenly prodigies in the eyes of the outside world.
Some prodigies come to a halt in the Divine Yuan Realm, unable to advance even an inch further, and become quite mediocre compared to those who continue to soar and are able to cultivate to the Tongxuan Realm or the Saint Abyss Realm.
If the former are considered ordinary, then the latter are the geniuses and prodigies; if the former are prodigies, then the latter are peerless prodigies.
The heights they stand on are different, and so are the objects they are compared with. Even the most common of Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors are considered absolute prodigies to cultivators of lower realms, beings they can only look up to.
“Eh~ why has she come?”
Suddenly, Patriarch Han noticed that someone had arrived outside his sleeping chamber, and it was none other than the newly wedded Demon Queen Bai Keqing.
After a brief thought, Han knew exactly why Bai Keqing had come here. She was surely checking if he was in the sleeping chamber, looking to dual cultivate with him.
Ever since experiencing the effects of dual cultivation for the first time, Bai Keqing couldn’t stop thinking about it. She cast aside everything regarding the Demon Clan and the Demon Domain, wholeheartedly desiring to dual cultivate with Patriarch Han, hoping to reach the peak of the True Martial Realm as soon as possible.
Though Han had said that he would unseal her cultivation in a year and then they could officially dual cultivate to increase her strength, how could Bai Keqing be willing to wait?
Therefore, Bai Keqing would come to Han’s sleeping chamber every few days to see if he was there, or she would fly to the summit of Chengdao Peak to wait for his return. Her physical body wasn’t sealed, and even without her True Yuan, she was still incredibly powerful.
Through Bai Keqing’s persistent efforts, Han couldn’t help but give in. From time to time, he would unseal Bai Keqing’s cultivation and indulge in exuberant dual cultivation with her.
“Oh well, today the old ancestor shall display his godly prowess once more.”
Watching the approaching Bai Keqing, Han dispelled the formation and waited for her to enter.
Now that his strength had skyrocketed and he officially had the combat ability of a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor, Bai Keqing no longer posed any threat in his eyes.
He also wanted to test his much stronger body and completely exhaust Bai Keqing, the Demon Queen, letting her know his strength so she wouldn’t keep bothering him all the time.
Bai Keqing arrived outside the great hall, and her eyes lit up, sensing Han’s presence. She quickly entered the bedroom, as the previous formation had concealed any certainty of someone’s presence.
Today, Bai Keqing was still dressed in a light blue gown, relatively cool and provocative, with a slightly protruding belly, still that seductive and sexy Demon Queen, bold and untamed in such matters.
Looking at the entering Bai Keqing, Han smiled faintly. Her beauty was exquisite, dimples faintly appearing on her cute face, phoenix eyes brimming with allure, and her charm surpassing others. Her skin, revealed by the gown, was white and delicate, like the finest white jade, full and smooth, shining with a satin-like luster, flawless.
Her red lips were sensual and plump, and she exuded brilliance as she walked, full of allure and unrivaled charm, complemented by her perfect, curvaceous figure—truly a peerless beauty.
“You choose the position, just don’t go overboard, I’m only here for the dual cultivation,” Bai Keqing said, her first words as she walked in, looking down at Han who was sitting cross-legged with the attitude of a queen.
“No problem.”
With the atmosphere set, Patriarch Han naturally wouldn’t refuse, and thus a heaven-shaking battle to subdue the demon erupted.
The next morning, Han returned to the Li Manor satisfied.
After visiting his various beautiful wives and concubines, Han went up to the Chong Xiao Pavilion and once again looked in the direction of the Imperial Palace.
This time, a smile graced his face.
After waiting a few more months, the time for the harvest had finally arrived.
Apart from wanting to obtain the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, he was also interested in knowing the truth behind Chu Dingqian’s ability to reincarnate.
Even if he didn’t need it at the moment, who could say about the future? Perhaps he might need it one day.
In the next instant, Han’s figure vanished from the Chong Xiao Pavilion in the Li Manor, heading for the forbidden area of the Imperial Palace.
“Tsk tsk, what a formidable Yin and Yang Demon Slaying Formation. It’s truly extraordinary; even late-stage True Martial Realm powerhouses would be severely injured or even subdued if they forced their way through. But unfortunately, it’s not enough to stop me,” Han remarked upon recognizing this top-grade Third Grade formation.
Chu Dingqian, that old fellow, had indeed held back. Initially, he agreed to copy the blueprints and Pill Formulas involving alchemy, artifact refining, formation, and talisman making from the Daqian Empire to Han.
But when Han received them, there was only one copy of each Third Grade Pill Formula and blueprint. This Yin and Yang Demon Slaying Formation was not among them.
Han had known at the time that Chu Dingqian would keep something in reserve. He didn’t mind it since everything would eventually be his. After subduing Chu Dingqian, all of it would fall into his hands.
A hint of sword energy appeared at Han’s fingertips, and with a light flick in the air, a crack appeared in the void. The Yin and Yang Demon Slaying Formation was instantly broken by Han.
Simultaneously, his Spiritual Sense, comparable to the ninth level of the True Martial Realm, covered the entire area in an instant, concealing any disturbances.
After fulfilling these tasks, Han walked with his hands behind his back towards the interior along the corridor.
Inside the great hall,
The moment the Yin and Yang Demon Slaying Formation was breached, Chu Dingqian was jolted awake. The formation was connected to his mind, alerting him instantly upon being attacked.
Chu Dingqian’s expression drastically changed. Without hesitation, he gathered the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, ready to flee, but to his despair, he found himself unable to leave the great hall. A powerful being had sealed the area with an immensely forceful Spiritual Sense, turning it into a Spirit Realm.
“Damn it!”
Chu Dingqian retreated, stopping only when he reached the corner of the great hall wall, cautiously watching the corridor entrance. The Soul-Cultivating Furnace in his hand was fully activated, ready to unleash a full-powered strike at any moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 286: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_4
He had already tried to send a message outside, but every attempt had sunk like a stone into the sea, all failing without exception, which weighed heavily on Chu Dingqian’s mind.
The other party came prepared.
“Tap Tap”
Listening to the rhythmic footsteps echoing in the corridor, Chu Dingqian’s spirit shook with each step, as if they trod directly upon his heart, bringing immense pressure upon him.
He knew that the enemy had instantly broken through the Yin and Yang Demon Slaying Formation, concealed all movement, cut off internal and external communication, and now approached with slow, confident steps, indicating that this adversary was extremely confident in their own strength.
Chu Dingqian speculated that this person must be a peerless powerhouse at the peak of the True Martial Realm, and most likely, a warrior at the level of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Chu Dingqian held his breath and concentrated, his right hand grasping the Soul-Cultivating Furnace tightly, his nerves stretched to their utmost.
As a king at the pinnacle of the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, if he were to fully activate the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, he could still unleash unmatched might.
After all, the Soul-Cultivating Furnace was a Supreme Grade Heaven Rank magical treasure, a top-tier weapon of the Divine Yuan Realm. Although he couldn’t fully activate it, it was still possible for him to unleash combat ability worthy of the Nine Heavens of the True Martial Realm.
Even though his raw strength was inferior to that of the enemy who had come to attack him, the assailant’s overconfidence gave him a chance. If only he could seize the opportunity to strike with the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, even an unwary Divine Yuan Realm Emperor would suffer a grievous injury.
What kept Chu Dingqian’s mind taut was the fact that the corridor was clearly very short, only about a dozen meters, yet the footsteps kept resounding. More than ten breaths had passed, and by all logic, the attacking enemy should have already entered the grand hall.
“Not good!”
A flash of insight crossed his mind, and realizing his own perception had been affected, Chu Dingqian didn’t hesitate to fully activate the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and unleashed a blast beside him.
As Chu Dingqian attempted a counterattack, Han Li’s fist had already thundered forward, its brilliance overpowering the world, commanding the Eight Wastes and Nine Heavens, with an overwhelming might, it struck the Soul-Cultivating Furnace heavily.
Boom!
The Soul-Cultivating Furnace and Chu Dingqian were sent flying together, the furnace crashing heavily onto Chu Dingqian, exacerbating his injuries.
“You’ve realized too late.” Han Li’s voice resounded at that moment.
That punch carried the combat ability of the Third Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, and for the sake of caution, Patriarch Han had also triggered his Divine Sense, not wanting to take any chances.
What could Chu Dingqian use to defend?
He couldn’t defend at all!
“Puh~”
Chu Dingqian spat out a mouthful of blood, his body falling from the wall to the ground, his expression wilted, looking at Han Li in utter shock.
This man was too strong, undoubtedly an Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm!
Just one punch not only shattered the attack from the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and cracked it open, but also severely injured him, a powerhouse in the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm.
Now his body was falling apart, with a huge fist imprint on his chest. The powerful and domineering intent behind the punch was eroding his physical body, wearing away his True Yuan, continuously weakening his strength.
After taking that punch, his strength plummeted to less than a tenth of what it was, and it continued to decline. His life was hanging by a thread.
“You! Who! Are! You?”
Chu Dingqian articulated each word, his face heavy with reluctance. He had planned everything carefully, and the situation had evolved as he had expected, so why had he suffered this sudden attack?
If he had another forty years, he could succeed in seizing a new body and be reborn, and after another two or three hundred years of cultivation, he could return to the True Martial Realm. Why wouldn’t the heavens allow him to live a third life?
Chu Dingqian was filled with hatred!
Knowing that his death was inevitable, his tone was filled with bitter resentment, and his murderous intent was icy cold, not concealed in the slightest.
“Even for great beings and Saints, being reborn and living a second life is incredibly difficult. You, a mere True Martial Realm warrior, had the audacious desire to defy the natural order and live a third life. Did you think you wouldn’t encounter calamity?”
Han Li’s tone was indifferent, his face revealing an unfathomable expression.
At this moment, he was using Han Li’s appearance, not Li Feiyu’s, so Chu Dingqian did not recognize him.
“I just wanted to live a third life. Why block my path? I! Am! Not! Willing!”
A look of grief and indignation appeared on Chu Dingqian’s face. He had already succeeded in being reborn once and his plans for a third life had been successful, but this sudden disaster was too hard to accept. How could he be willing?
Han Li shook his head slightly, seized Chu Dingqian, and with a surge of True Yuan, sealed the remnant of his strength.
Ignoring Chu Dingqian’s resentful and hateful gaze, Han Li directly probed his soul. After the soul-search was complete, Han Li swiftly ended his life with a palm strike.
He did not want to waste words with Chu Dingqian. What was done was done; killing him was the simplest solution.
Since his growth up to this point, he was no longer the Han Li of the past. Decades ago, he might have been reluctant in his heart to give Li Deshun a chance at life, but not anymore.
Now, his actions were decisive, exterminating any potential threat without wanting to bear the consequences. If he inadvertently brought upon serious trouble, it would be disastrous.
“Sigh” Han Li heaved a sigh, feeling that he had indeed changed a lot.
Although he remained cautious and low-profile, his actions had become more resolute—kill when necessary, remove the roots completely, never showing leniency.
If Chu Dingqian had been willing to give up the Soul-Cultivating Furnace during their transaction, not only would Han Li have spared his life, but he would have also offered him tremendous benefits, sincerely supporting his rebirth and re-cultivation.
But Chu Dingqian had chosen another path, one that stood in Han Li’s way. Well, he couldn’t blame Han Li then. The Cultivation Realm was indeed so cruel.
If he were in Chu Dingqian’s shoes, Han Li knew that he would never hand over the Soul-Cultivating Furnace to a True Martial Realm king of unknown origins, even if it meant the protection of the Daqian Empire for hundreds of years.
After reflecting, Han Li’s Daoist heart returned to peace. He casually stowed Chu Dingqian’s corpse and the Soul-Cultivating Furnace into the System Space and then cleared all traces.

chapters.title: Chapter 287: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_5
Having done all this, Han Li changed his appearance, height, attire, and temperament, and disguised himself as Chu Dingqian. He then found the control token for the Yin and Yang Demon Slaying Formation from Chu Dingqian’s spatial bracelet and refined it.
After gaining control of the Yin and Yang Demon Slaying Formation, Han Li withdrew his Spiritual Sense, opened the formation, and appeared in the Imperial Palace.
After some investigation, Han Li arrived at a grand hall where Chu Dingqian occasionally spent time. The hall was filled with a substantial amount of Chu Dingqian’s residual aura. He then used his Spiritual Sense to send a message to Emperor Qian, requesting his presence.
Emperor Qian received the message and was somewhat astonished, feeling that the voice of the ancestor from the Town of Xiong sounded slightly odd, but he didn’t think too much about it and went to the grand hall.
Bowing his head, Emperor Qian said respectfully, “Greetings, Ancestor. May I ask why you have summoned this junior?”
“Now that the Da Qian has calmed down, I will enter a reclusive cultivation in the forbidden lands, attempting to practice some life-prolonging cultivation techniques. Unless I summon you, you must not intrude,” said Han Li in the tone of Chu Dingqian, then looking towards Emperor Qian.
Emperor Qian was startled and quickly replied, “What if this junior has an urgent matter?”
Emperor Qian had no suspicions. Chu Dingqian had said similar things before. Now that the last crisis of Da Qian had been unexpectedly resolved, it was only natural for the ancestor from the Town of Xiong to go into reclusive cultivation.
He also hoped that the ancestor’s cultivation of the longevity techniques would be successful, so that he could live longer, ensuring that the Daqian Empire wouldn’t be oppressed by Li Feiyu in the future.
“I will leave a treasure outside the forbidden lands. You just need to strike it, and I will know and summon you,” Han Li said indifferently. “But remember, unless it is a matter of life and death for Da Qian, you must not disturb me.”
“Yes!” Emperor Qian nodded and felt relieved.
After handing over a pass token for the Yin and Yang Demon Slaying Formation, Han Li let Emperor Qian leave.
Looking at the ‘Qian’ token in his hand, Han Li smiled and casually tossed it into the System Space.
Immediately afterwards, his figure vanished.
On the other side, Emperor Qian returned to his own sleeping palace, feeling a vague unease, but he couldn’t pinpoint the reason.
The idea that the ancestor’s behavior today was somewhat strange popped into Emperor Qian’s mind; his heart suddenly harbored a bold guess.
Could it be that the ancestor had encountered trouble? Otherwise, why would he summon him in that great hall?
In the past, he was always summoned within the forbidden lands, with the exception of the time Prince Wu’an and the previous emperor fell in battle.
Emperor Qian’s heart pounded as he took several deep breaths to barely maintain his composure.
Shaking his head, Emperor Qian thought he was overthinking things. How could the ancestor possibly have encountered trouble?
After all, the ancestor was none other than Emperor Wu, a mid-stage True Martial Realm expert, within the Yin and Yang Demon Slaying Formation. Who could kill him?
Li Feiyu certainly couldn’t do it, and the number of True Martial Realm experts in the Xuan Domain capable of killing the ancestor could be counted on one hand. Moreover, there would have been a great commotion, but he hadn’t detected anything at all.
“Huff”
Exhaling deeply, Emperor Qian decided to stop thinking about it; he knew it was not a matter to be pondered deeply.
Regardless of whether the ancestor had encountered trouble, he couldn’t probe further, or real disaster would indeed strike.
At The Li Manor, atop the Chong Xiao Pavilion.
Han Li withdrew his attention from the Imperial Palace, a look of satisfaction spreading across his face.
If Emperor Qian hadn’t been understanding and had insisted on digging deeper, Han Li would have had no choice but to kill him as well.
The present outcome was for the best; otherwise, he would have had to find someone to impersonate Emperor Qian, which would have been too troublesome.
With his gaze now removed, Han Li began to check his spoils of war.
He now held a spatial bracelet in his hands, which was precisely Chu Dingqian’s; Han Li had deliberately protected the spatial bracelet previously.
With a smile, Han Li’s Spiritual Sense surged into it, easily refining the ownerless spatial bracelet.
After inspecting the treasures within the spatial bracelet, Han Li’s smile grew even broader; this time, he had truly struck it rich.
The various cultivation resources and treasures that Chu Dingqian had traded to him were plentiful, but they only amounted to half of what was inside this spatial bracelet.
With this spatial bracelet, it was as if he had obtained half of the foundation of the Daqian Empire. Combined with the quarter he had previously acquired, he now held more than half of the entire empire’s foundation in his hands.
Within this spatial bracelet, there were many Heaven Rank Artifacts, including one Top Grade Heaven Rank Divine Blade that was extraordinarily sharp.
All sorts of Heaven Rank cultivation techniques, martial skills, Spirit Stones, Spirit Pills, Spirit Talismans, and more were present, as well as countless spiritual medicines, various Artifact Refining materials, and materials for setting up formations, and so on.
What Han Li valued the most were the Supreme Grade Heaven Rank cultivation technique ‘Qiankun Technique’ as well as two Supreme Grade Heaven Rank martial skills. These were priceless.
He also unexpectedly discovered two thousand Top-grade Spirit Stones and couldn’t help but admit that Chu Dingqian was a very convincing actor, having almost fooled him into believing his ruse.
Chu Dingqian had previously claimed that the Daqian Empire had only one thousand Top-grade Spirit Stones, which was clearly a bluff.
The Third Grade blueprint Pill Formulas of the Four Arts of Cultivation such as Alchemy and Artifact Refining numbered close to twenty pieces, including the blueprint for the Yin and Yang Demon Slaying Formation.
Han Li found many desirable items in the spatial bracelet; the quality surpassed that of the items Chu Dingqian had traded to him, and the quantity was greater.
“It’s truly the case of wealth coming to those who eliminate obstacles, while those who do good deeds often remain unrewarded,” Han Li mused. It was true that without windfall profits, one would not get rich; with this spatial bracelet, the foundation of Han Mansion and The Li Manor skyrocketed in an instant.
He could now lavish attention on cultivating his descendants, providing them with abundant cultivation resources to help the specially trained ones grow rapidly.
With these cultivation resources, even the welfare of his less talented descendants could be increased severalfold, allowing him to provide them with better treatment.

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 179: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Chapter 179: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_6
Han Li decided to improve the clan’s welfare as soon as he returned, and once again encourage childbirth. He wanted the descendants to branch out and flourish so that he could quickly reach two thousand, three thousand descendants. Currently, the pace was far too slow.
Han Li put away his Spatial Bracelet and thought back to the memories he saw when he searched Chu Dingqian’s soul. He sighed.
Chu Dingqian, too, had great fortune. His adventures never ceased, and he rose from a seventh-grade slave to finally cultivate to the True Martial Realm, splitting the Da Jing dynasty and shaking the Xuan Domain.
Using the Demonic Fetus Technique, Chu Dingqian had even managed to live a second life, truly an astounding genius. If given time, he might have even lived a third, a fourth… like this, the chances of cultivating to the Divine Yuan Realm and the Tongxuan Realm would have grown higher and higher.
It was a pity Chu Dingqian met him and was ended by him, with most of his three thousand years’ accumulation falling into Han Li’s hands.
“What a Demonic Fetus Technique, it’s a pity it’s incomplete,” Han Li marveled as he pondered over the content of the technique, his face showing a look of admiration.
The cultivator who created this technique was a remarkable genius with extraordinary comprehension abilities. To think that he could invent such an against-the-heavens technique, Han Li couldn’t help but admire him.
Even an incomplete version of the Demonic Fetus Technique was of a Divine Rank Lower Grade. How strong would the complete version be?
Han Li felt it would be at least an Immortal Scripture, likely even more powerful than the complete version of the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture that Lu Tianxiang had, which was only Heaven Rank Lower Grade.
This was the first Divine Rank Practice Han Li had acquired, and he decided to take the opportunity to study it, to try planting a Devil Foetus as a precaution for the future.
The Devil Foetus Host must be meticulously selected, with the best aptitude, comprehension, and so on, so as to have a high starting point.
If an accident were to happen to him in the future, he could then reincarnate through devil fetus possession.
Han Li didn’t think he was invincible. The world was too dangerous, with the area beyond Qianyuan Divine Province vast, and countless stronger individuals around. Even a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor would not suffice.
It was always good to have backup plans.
After contemplating for a while, Han Li couldn’t think of a suitable host. Should he raise a descendant like Chu Dingqian did to be the Devil Foetus Host?
After thinking it over, he decided against it. He felt some things weren’t right, and his biggest concern was the destruction of Han Mansion along with him, with all his beloved wives, concubines, and descendants unable to escape.
Thus, it was best to secretly cultivate an exceptional genius as the Devil Foetus Host, someone seemingly unrelated to him on the surface, so in case of an emergency, he could directly transmigrate and let enemies believe he was truly dead.
Then he could reclaim his legacy in a new identity, instead of letting all his efforts turn to ashes.
He sighed, putting the thought aside for now, deciding to mull it over later. There was still plenty of time.
With a flip of his hand, a small furnace appeared in Han Li’s right hand, palm-sized with runes inscribed both inside and out, emanating a powerful presence.
True Yuan surged in, and he quickly refined the Soul-Cultivating Furnace.
“As expected of a Heaven Rank Supreme Grade magical treasure, its power is indeed outstanding.”
After sensing the formidable power of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, Han Li’s face lit up with surprise. It was the first Heaven Rank Supreme Grade treasure he had acquired. Although it could not compare to the Lower Grade Divine Weapon of the Chongming Palace, it was still powerfully impressive.
A Heaven Rank Supreme Grade treasure is a pinnacle Divine Yuan Realm weapon. With his current True Yuan reserves, he could activate seventy to eighty percent of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace’s power, unleashing the might comparable to the third level of Divine Yuan Realm, which was a vast improvement over Chu Dingqian’s usage.
Similar to the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the offensive power of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace was just an added feature, and even so, it was very strong. If fully activated, it could certainly have mid Divine Yuan Realm combat ability.
After a thorough exploration, Han Li claimed the Soul-Cultivating Furnace as his treasure. As the name suggests, the Body-Cultivating Furnace targeted the physical body, while the Soul-Cultivating Furnace was meant for the Divine Spirit. The functionalities of the Heaven Rank Supreme Grade Soul-Cultivating Furnace were many times stronger than those of the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
“It’s time.”
He murmured to himself, then Han Li’s figure vanished from The Li Manor, returning to Chengsheng Mountain.
He materialized at Chengdao Peak, before a massive furnace—the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
Ever since The Han Mansion upgraded the Mountain Protection Array, Han Li had placed the Body-Cultivating Furnace here. This treasure was to be exchanged with the Canghai Sect, and not many years remained of the ten-year agreement.
Now that he had acquired the better Soul-Cultivating Furnace, and he was about to receive the legendary Life-Prolonging Furnace, the Body-Cultivating Furnace was of little use to him.
As soon as Han Li took out the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, the two furnaces started roaring and resonating with one another.
But to Han Li’s disappointment, the Body-Cultivating Furnace and the Soul-Cultivating Furnace did not merge. This Body-Cultivating Furnace was indeed a second-rate imitation.
He had anticipated this, but still sighed.
After searching Chu Dingqian’s soul, he learned much intelligence, including detailed information about the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, Body-Cultivating Furnace, and the Life-Prolonging Furnace. He knew that Chu Dingqian had once taken the Soul-Cultivating Furnace to the Canghai Sect to merge it with the Body-Cultivating Furnace, but without success.
“Can it be successful?” Han Li frowned slightly.
With the imitation Body-Cultivating Furnace in his left hand and the Soul-Cultivating Furnace in his right, his expression varied uncertainly, now unsure of the outcome.
Only three treasures could cause a response in the imitation Body-Cultivating Furnace: the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, and the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
With the Soul-Cultivating Furnace in his possession, that could be ruled out. Since the Body-Cultivating Furnace and the Soul-Cultivating Furnace were of comparable ranks and unable to persistently absorb spiritual energy for tens of thousands of years, the object hidden on Chengsheng Mountain must be the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
He had already explored Chengsheng Mountain countless times and found no trace of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, which led to only one possibility: like the Dragon Ball, the Life-Prolonging Furnace was hidden within a secret territory.

chapters.title: Chapter 289: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_7
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: 179 Chapter: Divine Yuan Realm Combat Ability! Killing Chu Dingqian! The Life-Prolonging Furnace Emerges! Five Great Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!_7
Han Li was anxious, wondering if the imitation Body-Cultivating Furnace and Soul-Cultivating Furnace could open the secret territory where the Life-Prolonging Furnace was located?
From Chu Dingqian’s memories, he knew that only the merging of the true Body-Cultivating Furnace and Soul-Cultivating Furnace into a lower-grade Divine Weapon would produce the true imitation of the Life-Prolonging Furnace and sense its presence.
“Regardless, I must try,” Han Li didn’t hesitate too much, for indecision could lead to chaos.
At this point, he had to find the Life-Prolonging Furnace; it couldn’t remain hidden any longer.
If the effects of the imitated Body-Cultivating Furnace and Soul-Cultivating Furnace were so powerful already, how strong could the ancient supreme Life-Prolonging Furnace be?
As a supreme-grade Divine Weapon, it was a top-notch Shengyuan Realm Weapon, perhaps even a Grand Saint Soldier, with infinite might. Even if it wasn’t primarily for offense, it could still significantly enhance his combat ability.
The other effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace could also allow Han Mansion to develop rapidly, greatly accelerating the pace at which he could train his descendants.
Holding the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and the imitated Body-Cultivating Furnace, Han Li’s figure appeared throughout various locations on Chengsheng Mountain. However, he concealed his presence rendering himself undetectable.
“Not here.”
“Neither is this place.”
“Also not here. Where could it be?”
With the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and the imitated Body-Cultivating Furnace in hand, his sensing of the Life-Prolonging Furnace indeed grew stronger, though intermittent. Even with his Divine Spirit powerful enough to rival the ninth level of the True Martial Realm, he couldn’t pinpoint its location.
Despite this, Han Li didn’t give up. This was already much better than before when he could only sense it vaguely and that too, only appearing once after a long time.
Inside Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li constantly appeared in various places, even ascending to the heavens and delving underground, traversing every part of the mountain in search of the secret territory containing the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
Without the true Body-Cultivating Furnace and Soul-Cultivating Furnace, unable to form the key to enter directly, he could only find a special point and then break through with his formidable strength.
With his Divine Yuan Realm combat ability, he believed he could forcibly break into the secret territory.
An hour passed.
Two hours went by.
Four hours later, and Han Li was still searching patiently, without a trace of slackening.
His Spiritual Sense covered the entire Chengsheng Mountain, even extending for thousands of miles around. His divine spirit’s perception was fully active, and he kept stimulating his Divine Sense, all to sense that special node.
After over three hours, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face as he quickly popped up at a certain spot on Chengsheng Mountain.
“I’ve finally found it.”
Standing here, with the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and the imitated Body-Cultivating Furnace in hand, he could sense the Life-Prolonging Furnace distinctly, without any intermittent breaks.
He was sure that the real Life-Prolonging Furnace was indeed within the secret territory linked to this node, a place extremely hidden.
If it weren’t for having the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, the imitation Body-Cultivating Furnace, and the patience to search for nearly four hours, it would have been impossible to locate this place.
After calming his emotions, Han Li prepared to break into the secret territory where the Life-Prolonging Furnace was located. But before doing so, he had another task to complete.
Swish swish swish
One after another, the array materials were flung out by Han Li, pre-embedded at each array node as he began to set up a Third Grade grand array.
Forcibly entering the secret territory might cause a huge disturbance, something Han Li didn’t want others to be aware of. Should someone deduce that the Life-Prolonging Furnace had appeared in Chengsheng Mountain, that would indeed spell big trouble.
After expending considerable effort to set up the grand array and verifying its effectiveness, this Third Grade grand array with a vast range could conceal fate and block noise, preventing the outside world from knowing.
Then, Han Li’s Spiritual Sense surged out, notifying Lu Tianxiang, Bai Keqing, Lin Yiwu, Fang Yousi, and other cherished concubines that he was preoccupied with an important matter, asking them not to disturb him.
Once all this was done, Han Li took a deep breath and solemnly drew the Dragon Abyss Sword, then stimulated his Divine Sense and executed the strongest form of the Meteor Sword Technique.
He thrust his sword out fiercely, striking that special node. A thunderous roar echoed as a rift in the void opened up.
The aura of the Life-Prolonging Furnace leaked from the rift in the void. Han Li’s expression lit up with joy; seeing the crack rapidly closing, he hesitated no longer and darted through.
Swish
Having passed through the crack in the void, Han Li entered a sunny world filled with birds twittering and flowers fragrant, a tranquil and harmonious scene.
This place was overgrown with vegetation, ancient trees reaching the sky, with the spiritual energy being so rich that it was ten thousand times denser than the outer world’s Chengsheng Mountain. It was like comparing heaven to earth; the concentration of spiritual energy here was at least a thousand times greater.
Han Li’s spiritual sense surged forth, instantly enveloping the entire secret territory, which took him by surprise. The secret territory was actually not that vast, far smaller than the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm.
Now, his spiritual sense rivaled the mighty of the True Martial Realm’s Nine Heavens, capable of covering an area of thirteen million miles. Even Yuanzhou, the largest region in Da Qian, was insignificant in comparison.
The secret territory had a size of merely forty to fifty thousand miles, which was very small indeed; it didn’t even compare to his System Space.
At the center of this secret territory’s firmament, there stood a broad-mouthed, narrow-rimmed tripod furnace with two handles, and its lid was suspended a foot above it.
Above this tripod furnace, divine sun and divine moon shone upon each other, illuminating the territory, with countless stars scattered across the firmament, twinkling brightly. Below this tripod furnace, myriad spirits roamed the land, each one exuding extraordinary presence, as if evolving a world of their own.
“In the cauldron of heaven and earth, the sun and moon are refined.”
Upon viewing this scene, Han Li couldn’t help but exclaim, “Indeed, it’s the ancient Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace!”
He looked at the imitations of the Body-Cultivating Furnace and Soul-Cultivating Furnace he held in his hands. In comparison to the ancient Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace, they seemed embarrassingly inferior.
Without hesitation, Han Li headed towards the Life-Prolonging Furnace, intending to claim and refine it.
“Buzz”
Just at that moment, the lid of the Body-Cultivating Furnace slammed shut, and a ripple of divine light swept forward. Han Li threw a punch that swept across the six directions, suppressing the eight desolates, and forcibly ground the ripple of divine light into nothingness.
However, Han Li also halted in his steps. He frowned slightly, looking at the Life-Prolonging Furnace without moving any closer.
It seemed that the Life-Prolonging Furnace had already developed an Artifact Spirit, which was far from vague like those of the Chongming Palace, and not something he could refine easily.
He tried to take another step forward, and another swipe of divine light came his way. Han Li punched again, forcefully extinguishing the divine light.
“Life-Prolonging Furnace, you’ve hidden in this secret territory nursing your wounds for over a hundred thousand years; don’t you wish to go out and see the world?”
“If you were to follow me, ascending to the rank of a divine weapon would be within reach. I could even take you along as I ascend to immortality,” Han Li proclaimed.
His voice, boundless and majestic, echoed throughout the secret territory.
He directly deployed the Hu You Dafa technique, painting a grand picture for the Life-Prolonging Furnace first; whether it was achievable was not within his concerns.
“Young man, leave this place. We can talk when you reach the Divine Yuan Realm.”
Han Li waited, and finally, a voice of ancient and profound depth emanated from the Life-Prolonging Furnace, imbued with the breath of endless ages.
Han Li’s eyebrows lifted slightly. The Life-Prolonging Furnace indeed possessed an Artifact Spirit and was not recognizing him at the moment.
“You’ve hidden in this secret territory for over a hundred thousand years, wishing to repair your body, right? If you follow me, I can help you restore it.”
Han Li did not retreat, and his reverberating voice rose once more.
His eyes blazed with divine light, revealing the injuries to the Life-Prolonging Furnace. The body of the furnace was rather worn, with even a fist-sized hole that appeared to have been punched through it. While it seemed intact, it was merely cloaked in divine light.
The Life-Prolonging Furnace did not respond to him.
After some thought, Han Li continued to advance, taking one step after another, remaining vigilant and keeping his eyes fixed on the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
As Han Li moved again, the lid of the Life-Prolonging Furnace completely fell, merging with the body of the furnace. In a flash, the divine sun and moon, the encircling stars, and the myriad spirits on the ground all turned into runes, returning to the furnace to etch one picture after another upon it.
The secret territory dimmed in an instant, only to brighten again shortly after.
It was the Life-Prolonging Furnace exuding divine light. Centered on the Life-Prolonging Furnace, vast beams of divine light shot out in succession, transforming into the five great mystical beasts: the Azure Dragon, the White Tiger, the Vermilion Bird, the Black Tortoise, and the Kylin.
The five great mystical beasts stood firm in the five directions of the firmament. Although they were condensed from divine light, they were fused with the might of the Life-Prolonging Furnace and took on solid forms, each exuding a fearsome authority.
“Five Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors!”
Han Li’s expression changed. The Life-Prolonging Furnace was excessively formidable, casually creating five Martial Emperors of the Divine Yuan Realm, each with the strength of the Second Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm.
This posed an extreme challenge for Han Li.
A self-reviving Grand Saint Soldier was indeed formidable, serving him five Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors as a mere appetizer. How was he to proceed?
PS: Thank you to the alliance leader [Looking Back with Regret] for your support. I will find time to add more chapters as a token of gratitude!

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Chapter 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_1
Secret Realm Sky Dome,
Five directions, five aspects, five Mystical Beasts, five elements, the reversal of yin and yang, the unpredictable cycle of life and death.
Witnessing this scene, Han Li’s pupils constricted slightly. The five Mystical Beasts had actually formed the Five Elements Great Array, reversing yin and yang, with the light of creation and destruction distorting the void to the point of shattering.
The Azure Dragon formed an array in the east, corresponding to wood; the White Tiger in the west, corresponding to metal; the Vermilion Bird in the south, corresponding to fire; the Black Tortoise in the north, corresponding to water; the Kylin in the center, corresponding to earth.
The Five Elements generated and restrained one another. Five Divine Yuan Realm second-layer Mystical Beasts composed the Five Elements Great Array, endlessly circulating, their might growing stronger, breaking through a limit and stepping into a new level of combat ability.
“Divine Yuan Realm third-layer combat ability!”
Han Li instantly felt immense pressure. This Life-Prolonging Furnace was truly extraordinary, this was possible.
“Young man, I’ll give you one more chance, withdraw.”
The ancient and vicissitudinous voice of the Health Preservation Furnace Spirit once again echoed in the Secret Territory.
Accompanying its words, the five Mystical Beasts gazed unanimously at Han Li, their overwhelming auras converging on Han Li, the cycle of creation and destruction, the fusion of the Five Elements, faintly exuding the fearsome aura of the mid- Divine Yuan Realm.
“Buzz”
Han Li’s own aura burst forth as well, with the Dragon Abyss Sword suspended high above, its sword glow flashing across thousands of worlds, its Sword Intent sharp and irresistible, fiercely contending with this momentum.
“Thump thump thump~”
Han Li retreated three steps in quick succession, each step a hundred zhang across, leaving behind three giant pits dozens of zhang deep on the ground.
In this clash of auras, he was undoubtedly at a disadvantage.
Han Li steadied his stance and looked forward towards the Life-Prolonging Furnace, stretching out his right hand upward, as the Dragon Abyss Sword gently descended into his grasp.
In an instant, sword qi crisscrossed heaven and earth; sword light streaked across the void; Sword Intent filled the sky dome. Sword qi, sword light, and Sword Intent merged into a Divine Sword that was identical to the Dragon Abyss Sword in Han Li’s hand, only a thousand times larger.
“Opportunities are seized, not granted by others.”
The instant Han Li’s voice rang out, he made his move, directly stimulating his Divine Sense, his aura soaring in an instant. He brandished the Dragon Abyss Sword in his hand with a powerful slash forward.
The Divine Sword above followed in tandem with Han Li, with a heavy slash forward.
At that moment, the two swords, one large and one small, slashed through the heavens and shattered the earth, the space fractured, the universe inverted. Within the Secret Territory, all else paled in comparison to the splendor of this blade, its sword qi rampaging, its sword light sweeping across, its Sword Intent swirling…
“You’ve got spirit.”
As the words of the Health Preservation Furnace Spirit rose, the five Mystical Beasts also moved, making a horizontal swipe towards Han Li.
With just one joint strike, the tumultuous sword qi and sword light, the sword intent that stretched for tens of thousands of miles, were all worn away. The shattered void was smoothed over, both the large and the small swords simultaneously broke apart, followed by the massive figures of the five horizontal strikes.
Han Li soared into the sky, his fighting spirit soaring, his aura at full bore as he engaged in an earth-shattering fierce battle with the five Mystical Beasts.
The Secret Territory where the Life-Prolonging Furnace resided was isolated from the world, and the commotion of a Divine Yuan Realm battle could not spread outside. Han Li did not worry about attracting any trouble. He also yearned for a grand battle to see the limit of his own combat ability.
For decades, he had been cautious and low-profile, fearing to cause any significant trouble. His true body seldom took action, and even when he did act under a different identity, he had never gone all out.
Today, presented with the rare opportunity, he wanted to fight a liberating and satisfying battle. Even if he couldn’t gain recognition from the Life-Prolonging Furnace, he could still vent the frustration accumulated in his heart.
The Azure Dragon unleashed its claws, the claw prints covering the sky and the sun, the power boundless, shattering the void; the White Tiger roared, its countless sword qi of solidified metal rushed to attack, demolishing everything in its path; the Vermilion Bird spat fire, its southern true flame burning the sky and boiling the sea, turning the void within ten thousand miles into a sea of fire.
The Black Tortoise came walking on the sea from the north, the void beneath its feet spontaneously giving rise to endless waves, with turtle and snake intertwined, its step exploding the void; the Kylin towered in the nine heavens, with each step it took down, as if a primeval Divine Mountain was bearing down.
Facing the onslaught of the five Mystical Beasts, Han Li was fearless, his expression composed, launching one strike after another in resistance to the five Divine Spirits.
His Divine Spirit controlled the Dragon Abyss Sword above his head to execute the Meteor Sword Scripture, one star after another appeared, then burst apart, radiating cataclysmic sword light, contending with the heaven-stepping Kylin.
His right hand formed a fist seal, sending a punch forward, and another to the right, possessing the imposing might that swept across universes, repressed the desolate wilderness and heavens, and ruled over the eras and all realms.
His left hand formed a palm seal, first pushing left and then striking another palm backwards, two nine-layered divine pagoda towers condensed, oppressing the void and annihilating everything.
The next instant, the attacks of both sides collided, setting off earth-shattering roars, the light of destruction blossoming, obliterating the towering ancient trees and majestic mountains within the Secret Territory in an instant.
The light of great cataclysm from the exploding stars destroyed layers of primeval Divine Mountains; his fist seals shattered the sky-obscuring dragon claws, vaporized boundless waves, and sent the Black Tortoise flying backward;
One divine pagoda tower descended, all the metal sword qi disintegrating, and as another divine pagoda tower suppressed downwards, the vast sea of fire was all absorbed into the nine-layered divine tower.
“Boom boom~”
After the first strike erupted, the five Mystical Beasts and Han Li engaged again in fierce combat, the void collapsing from their battle, the worlds quaking.
Despite being besieged, Han Li remained composed and calm, whether forming fists, wielding a sword, or striking palms, his potent martial skills came effortlessly, even barely gaining the upper hand, suppressing the five Mystical Beasts.
Divine Pagoda Seal, Prison Suppression Seal, Divine Pagoda Prison Suppression!
Sweep Across Universes Fist, Suppressing Wilderness and Heavens Fist, Shattering Cosmos Fist!
Star Shatter, World Break, Realm Destroy!
With the Divine Pagoda Prison Suppression Seal, the Sweep Across Universes Fist, and the Meteor Sword Scripture, Han Li used them to transcendence, wielding them as if he were one with his limbs, repeatedly demolishing the Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, Black Tortoise, and Kylin—these five Mystical Beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Chapter 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_2
“Boom”
The Azure Dragon lunged to attack, but Han Li countered with the back of his hand. The Buddha Suppressing Prison Seal burst the Azure Dragon apart, and another punch was hurled, shattering the void and slaughtering the Vermilion Bird.
Han Li grew stronger as the battle went on, his fighting spirit increasing by the moment. He was so thrilled, having never experienced such an intense confrontation before.
After attaining combat ability at the Divine Yuan Realm, the Life-Prolonging Furnace sent him five early-stage Divine Yuan Realm sparring partners to test his own strength. What a magnificent Divine Weapon indeed.
The Dragon Abyss Sword slashed out thrice in succession, each slash possessing the might to destroy worlds, capable of annihilating a starry domain. The splendid sword light cleaved through, and the Black Tortoise, White Tiger, and Kylin crumbled one after another.
Han Li stood above the ninth heaven, clear-headed and exhilarated, a smile on his face as he watched the five Mystical Beasts recover.
“Is that all you’ve got?”
Han Li’s taunting voice echoed in the Secret Territory. In the next instant, the Life-Prolonging Furnace fired five beams of divine light once more, instantly restoring the five Mystical Beasts.
This time, the five great Mystical Beasts didn’t gang up. They stood firm at the five cardinal points of the heavens and earth, and a massive Five Elements Formation Map appeared beneath them, obfuscating the sky and enveloping half of the Secret Territory.
Han Li didn’t hesitate and threw a direct punch, the force ripping through the void, bearing a might that could suppress all under heaven and intent on destroying the Five Elements Formation Map. He never had the habit of waiting for his enemies to be ready.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh~
From each of the five great Mystical Beasts, a different colored divine light surged out, instantly forming the Five-Coloured Divine Light that hurtled towards his fist imprint.
As the Five Elements Divine Light swept past, the fist imprint was directly annihilated, and its formidable power charged towards Han Li unabated.
Han Li’s brows raised slightly, his expression becoming serious. The might of this Five Elements Divine Light was already close to the power of the fourth layer of the Divine Yuan Realm.
He wielded the Dragon Abyss Sword, slashing out three times in succession—the stars shattered, the world collapsed, the realms were extinguished. Each slash was stronger and more terrifying than the last, striking the Five Elements Divine Light and significantly reducing its power, before he finally burst it with a punch.
Suddenly, Han Li’s brows furrowed slightly. The duration of his Divine Sense was about to end, so he promptly triggered it for the second time without any hesitation.
Then, Han Li took the initiative, wielding the Dragon Abyss Sword and charging forward. The sword glowed brilliantly, executing world-annihilating slashes, as sword intent storms swept through all creation. His palms and fists alternated, employing one martial technique after another in a fierce confrontation with the five cardinal Mystical Beasts, the Five Elements Formation Map, and the Five-Coloured Divine Light.
Bang!
After a dozen or so breaths, the Five Elements Formation Map was shattered, and the five Mystical Beasts also fragmented, leaving only Han Li standing between the heavens and the earth.
A myriad of miles in front of him, the Life-Prolonging Furnace radiated divine light, the two began a standoff.
“Got any more? Bring five more; I want to fight ten!” Han Li said with a laugh.
But in his heart, he remained extremely vigilant. These words were just probing the limits of the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
He wanted to see to what extent the Life-Prolonging Furnace had recovered and if he could forcibly take and refine it. He had not utilized the Chongming Palace from the beginning; with his current strength, using the Chongming Palace could unleash even greater combat ability.
“You really are arrogant, young man.”
The tone of the Health Preservation Furnace Spirit became much livelier, with a hint of amusement, seemingly appreciative of Han Li’s strength.
“I know what you’re after. Since you’re so persistent, this old one will give you a chance. Whether you seize it or not is up to you.”
As the words fell, without waiting for Han Li’s response, the lid of the Life-Prolonging Furnace flew up, a divine light shot into the sky, and an overwhelmingly powerful aura spread out, making Han Li frown tightly.
Within that divine light, a new figure emerged, the Azure Dragon!
But at this moment, the Azure Dragon was a hundred times larger than before, and its aura was many times heavier. It gazed from afar at Han Li, instantly giving him a sense of mortal peril.
Swoosh!
Han Li’s figure vanished, disappearing from the Secret Territory, leaving behind only a voice echoing throughout.
“I’m someone who takes advice well. You told me to return after reaching the Divine Yuan Realm, so that’s exactly what I’ll do.”
Inside the Life-Prolonging Furnace, a cluster of divine light contained a tiny, delicate figure, not the old man Han Li had imagined, but instead a silver-haired, silver-dressed little loli with a porcelain-like complexion.
“This guy is really interesting.”
The Artifact Spirit loli Yin Ling’s mouth twitched, finding Han Li’s quick grasp surprising as she had wanted to play a bit longer.
Having been in this Secret Territory for over a hundred thousand years, she was utterly bored and longed for the day when the Furnace’s body would be repaired so she could roam the world freely again.
Suddenly, a person came with the intent to subdue her. Naturally, Yin Ling was not willing; she was an ancient treasure, a Great Saintly Weapon, not some cheap enchantress that would follow just anyone.
Yin Ling intended to scare him away, but Han Li was stubborn and insisted on pursuing her. So, Yin Ling planned to tease him a bit to assess Han Li’s strength.
After observing for a while, Yin Ling set aside her initial playful attitude and began to acknowledge Han Li.
The man was indeed formidable, with unparalleled talent and stunning martial skills, possessing the combat ability of a martial emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm while still in the True Martial Realm. He mastered several Divine Rank martial arts. The five Mystical Beasts that she had created were all at the third layer of the Divine Yuan Realm, and their formation was nearing the strength of the mid Divine Yuan Realm. Nonetheless, Han Li had managed to destroy them.
Thus, Yin Ling spoke those words, willing to recognize Han Li as her master and accompany him in his battles across the Yuankun Domain, providing that he passed the test.
But Han Li was too fearful of death. Before she could even mention the test, he had already fled, leaving the Secret Territory.
The Azure Dragon she created had the combat ability of the Later Stage of God Yuan Realm, and Yin Ling knew well that Han Li was not strong enough to kill it. If Han Li could withstand three breaths of time, he would pass the test.

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
