Chapter 292: Chapter 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_3
Though the Azure Dragon possessed the combat ability of a seventh-layer Divine Yuan Realm warrior, its spiritual nature was not sufficient, and its battle techniques and experience were far inferior to those of a normal warrior at the same level. Yin Ling believed that Han Li still had a chance to pass the test.
After all, this person was likely hiding some trump cards.
“I hope you won’t disappoint me,” Yin Ling murmured softly, expectancy gleaming in her eyes.
She looked forward to the day the man would cultivate to the level of a Divine Yuan Realm warrior and re-enter the secret territory, although she had no idea how many years that might take.
A hundred years? Three hundred years? Five hundred years?
Meanwhile, on Chengsheng Mountain,
Han Li appeared, casting a wary glance at the secret territory’s node.
The Azure Dragon that showed up afterwards was too powerful, definitely possessing the combat ability of the later stages of the Divine Yuan Realm. Even with Chongming Palace and the Soul-Cultivating Furnace, he was no match for it; the gap was enormous.
Therefore, Han Li decisively fled, planning to return to the secret territory after cultivating to the Divine Yuan Realm when he believed he could subdue the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
He could feel that the Life-Prolonging Furnace bore him no malice. Otherwise, if this supreme-grade divine weapon unleashed its full power, even a great being at the Hollow Void Stage would be suppressed, let alone him; his defense was far weaker than his attack.
After a moment of thought, Han Li contracted the formation here, concealing the special node to prevent certain accidents.
After completing these tasks, Han Li returned to Chengdao Peak and greeted his beloved wives and concubines such as Lu Tianxiang, Bai Keqing, Lin Yiwu, and Qiu Yueyao.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li fidgeted with the replica Body-Cultivating Furnace and Soul-Cultivating Furnace, making a decision.
When the agreed time came, he would return the replica Body-Cultivating Furnace to Canghai Sect, fulfilling Jiang Baiye’s wish.
The replica Body-Cultivating Furnace had many effects, but it was no longer useful to him. After using it for a few more years, the talent of his concubines would be raised to the sixth grade, and then using the Rebirth Pill, they would reach the fifth grade.
With the effects of dual cultivation, his wives and concubines were making rapid progress in their cultivation. In a few decades they would reach the Hollow Void Stage, and by then, Han Li would be even stronger, breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm and obtaining the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
The effects that the replica Body-Cultivating Furnace had, the Life-Prolonging Furnace surely possessed too, and many times stronger at that. Moreover, the Life-Prolonging Furnace also had effects the replica did not have.
For Han Li, having one Life-Prolonging Furnace was enough; the replica Body-Cultivating Furnace was useless to hold on to.
In the meantime, he still had the Soul-Cultivating Furnace to use.
Similar to the Body-Cultivating Furnace, the Soul-Cultivating Furnace also had four effects, but it focused on the divine spirit and was many times more powerful.
First, the Soul-Cultivating Furnace could absorb higher level spiritual energy from the unseen world to accelerate cultivation, increasing cultivation speed within its covered range by dozens of times.
Second, it strengthened the divine spirit. The Soul-Cultivating Furnace harnessed half of the higher level spiritual energy to condense into higher level spiritual liquid. Absorbing this kind of liquid could enhance the divine spirit, making it grow rapidly.
This effect was useful to cultivators in the Gangyuan Realm, God Refining Realm, Hollow Void Stage, Myriad Phenomena Realm, and the True Martial Realm, nurturing their divine spirits.
Third, it healed injuries. The Soul-Cultivating Furnace could help cultivators quickly recover from divine spirit injuries and stabilize the divine spirit, blocking many divine spirit attacks.
Fourth, it enhanced comprehension. Long-term residence within the range of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and undergoing its baptism could enhance one’s own comprehension.
Han Li compared the Soul-Cultivating Furnace with the replica Body-Cultivating Furnace and roughly speculated on the effects of the ancient supreme treasure Life-Prolonging Furnace.
Han Li’s heart burned with eagerness. With the Life-Prolonging Furnace, the Han Mansion could develop and grow even better. It was a treasure for assisting the development of a family or sect, helping an influence amass a strong foundation in a short period of time.
“No wonder the Soul-Cultivating Furnace is called an ancient supreme treasure even though it’s just a supreme-grade divine weapon,” Han Li murmured softly to himself.
He had been somewhat puzzled before. Although a supreme-grade divine weapon was strong, enough to be a Great Saint’s weapon of choice, it didn’t fit his idea of a true treasure.
In his mind, a treasure should at least be a Divine Weapon of the imperial rank, belonging to the strongest category of weaponry just beneath Immortal Artifacts.
Now he understood that the Life-Prolonging Furnace did have the qualifications to be called a treasure. Although its offensive and defensive powers were far less than those of Divine Weapons, the auxiliary effects it possessed were superior to them.
After inspecting the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and the replica Body-Cultivating Furnace, Han Li decided to put them to use that evening, letting his wives and concubines experience the benefits of enhanced comprehension.
Latter, Han Li’s figure disappeared from Chengdao Peak and arrived at the main hall on Yundao Peak, where he summoned various leading descendants of the Han Mansion and announced his decision.
The benefits for the Han Mansion were significantly improved. The welfare for those on the priority training list increased fivefold, for those of adequate talent, it doubled, and even those without talent saw their benefits increase by one fold.
Han Li reiterated the importance of encouraging childbirth, once more raising the rewards for procreation. Those who spread the Han lineage could now receive three times the previous awards.
This shocked people like Han Yongfan, Han Yongjin, and Han Shigao, who were perplexed as to why the patriarch suddenly made such a decision, but they were very excited and hurried off to carry it out.
It was a great boon for them; even if they were not on the priority list, they could still obtain three times the previous resources, which would greatly aid their path of cultivation.
As time flies, seasons change, and in the blink of an eye, six years had passed.
In these six years, the event that caught the attention of all the Sacred Lands in the Xuan Domain began to show signs of emergence, stirring up waves of disturbance. Cultivators in the Hollow Void Stage and above across the Qianyuan Divine Province became aware of it, and some well-informed cultivators at the Gangyuan Realm and God Refining Realm also heard the news and were quite worried.
In the Xuan Domain, within the Da Jing Dynasty,
A plain-looking young Daoist stood proudly against the sky, a sheath void of a sword on his back, with sleeves gathered in his hands, he faced a stunningly cold and beautiful woman before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Chapter 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_4
“Lingshuang, Sister Lingshuang, why are you in such a hurry? Isn’t it better if we travel this wonderful world together?” Lu Zhen grumbled.
Since leaving the Penglai Immortal Sect, Lu Zhen had been traveling around Qianyuan Divine Province, and there was still several years before the matter in the Xuan Domain needed attention, so he was not in a rush.
In these years, he had visited the Sword Domain, Devil Region, Chaotic Domain, and even toured the Barbarian Region and Demon Domain. He left his mark in the East Sea and South Sea, but he specifically avoided the Buddha Domain.
He had a psychological shadow about the female bodhisattva on Xumi Mountain, concerned that she might play dirty tricks on him, so he thought it best not to wander under her nose.
After returning from the South Sea, Lu Zhen hung around in the areas of the Qitian Teaching and Da Jing Dynasty within the Xuan Domain. After waiting for over half a year, he finally encountered Sister Lingshuang from the Penglai Immortal Sect.
However, much to Lu Zhen’s disappointment, Ling Lingshuang hardly paid him any attention. She only greeted him with a “Junior Brother Lu” when they first met and then did not speak to him again, truly as cold as frost.
Ling Lingshuang ignored him completely as if he did not exist. Having known Lu Zhen for thousands of years, she was well aware of his feelings for her, but she had no such feelings for him.
She had rejected Lu Zhen many times before, but Lu Zhen, the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, seemed to have no shame, always coming to pester her now and then.
Fortunately, Lu Zhen had offended a female bodhisattva over a thousand years ago and was confined by a powerful figure in Baiyujing to cultivate in seclusion, which gave her peace for over a thousand years.
About six or seven years ago, when Lu Zhen came to Penglai Island, Ling Lingshuang didn’t even show her face, letting her master Guanhai Daoren send Lu Zhen away.
She had no desire to come to the Xuan Domain to deal with the big issue that could affect the entire Qianyuan Divine Province. However, since her brothers and sisters were all in critical stages of their closed-door cultivation, her master had no choice but to send her.
After taking on the task, Ling Lingshuang deliberately waited for six or seven years before leaving the Penglai Immortal Sect to avoid Lu Zhen, but to her surprise, Lu Zhen had intentionally been waiting for her in the Da Jing Dynasty.
This left Ling Lingshuang with no choice but to acknowledge him with a call of “Junior Brother Lu” and then decided not to engage with him any further.
Ling Lingshuang understood Lu Zhen very well; if she exchanged a few words with him, he would become overbearing, always pushing the boundaries. Ling Lingshuang had no intention of giving this nuisance any opportunities.
Ling Lingshuang strolled through the sky, crossing vast distances with each step. She was pondering how to shake off Lu Zhen, who was like a persistent shadow.
With over two years remaining before that matter erupted, she still wanted to explore the Divine Continent and definitely did not want to be entangled by Lu Zhen.
“Sister Lingshuang, wait for me!”
Lu Zhen quickly followed, but he did not get too close, maintaining a distance of several hundred meters. Otherwise, Ling Lingshuang would indeed dare to take action against him.
Demon Domain, Myriad Demon Mountain.
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing arrived at a cliff’s edge and looked at the sea of clouds within arm’s reach. She extended her delicate jade hand to caress it and even caught a colorful cloud in her hand to admire.
After a while, she released the colorful cloud and looked towards the Xuan Domain with a sigh.
Six or seven years had passed, and the situation in the Xuan Domain had escalated, growing bigger and more intense. She too was nearly ready.
Bai Keqing had not yet returned, which caused Xue Yueqing some worry. However, Bai Keqing’s life lamp was not extinguished. In fact, it had grown brighter, piquing Xue Yueqing’s curiosity about where exactly she was.
Withdrawing her gaze, Xue Yueqing turned and continued back to her closed-door cultivation.
Through years of exploration, she had made considerable progress and, if all went smoothly, she could break through to the next realm in a year’s time.
Even if she did not succeed in breaking through, she would still leave her retreat and head to the Xuan Domain to contribute to resolving the issue. It was a calamity that affected the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, and the Demon Clan could not keep themselves safe by standing alone.
When the time came, she would also look for Bai Keqing to see where the female Demon King had run off to, pondering if Ye Fan had abducted her, for she had not returned to the Demon Domain for many years.
Buddha Domain, Xumi Mountain.
Xumi Mountain is the king of all mountains, the center of the Buddha Domain, towering a million zhang high, surrounded by floating Buddha mountains that protect Xumi Mountain on all sides.
There are also nine mountains, eight seas, and four continents centered around Xumi Mountain, collectively transforming the Buddha Domain into a pure land of Buddhism. Xumi Mountain shines like a bright and eternal divine sun, its Buddha light illuminating billions of miles of the territory within the Buddha Domain.
At this moment, high above Xumi Mountain, a female bodhisattva hung suspended in the sky, seated on a lotus platform, her mouth emanating lotus flowers as she preached to the monks of Xumi Mountain. Her Buddha’s words resonated through the vast world, her radiance shining upon the Nine Heavens.
After her sermon, the monks and Vajras dispersed. The female bodhisattva looked in the direction of the Xuan Domain, her eyes flashing an indescribable hue.
“With this Xuan Domain incident, saints from all the Sacred Lands are sending Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors to handle it. Which of the Arhats are willing to go?” her melodious voice asked, filled with Buddhist teachings.
This Xuan Domain incident was a risk but also an opportunity. A mishandling might affect the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, yet a successful resolution might yield great fortune.
For those in the Divine Yuan Realm, it was a significant opportunity, hence the magnitude of the chance could be imagined.
The Arhats furrowed their brows, pondering whether to participate in the Xuan Domain incident, when suddenly the Joyous Arhat spoke up, “Bodhisattva, let this poor monk go this time.”
“Good,” the female bodhisattva replied with a glance, knowing the intentions of the Joyous Arhat but not minding. As long as the matter was taken care of well and did not damage the reputation of the Buddhist Sect, it was acceptable.
The bodhisattva’s figure disappeared. A few Arhats looked at the Joyous Arhat, hesitant to speak, but in the end, they left without saying anything.
“Amitabha” the Joyous Arhat murmured softly, looking at the place where the bodhisattva had been seated, a hint of longing flashing deep within his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Chapter 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_5
If he could embark on a joyous journey with the Bodhisattva, his scripture of great joy would undoubtedly reach completion. His cultivation would advance by leaps and bounds, and without needing three hundred years, he could potentially break through to the Tongxuan Realm and become a mighty figure pressuring the entire Qianyuan Divine Province.
Unfortunately, the Bodhisattva’s cultivation was too high, and her strength too formidable. The Joyous Arhat dared not reveal any disrespectful thoughts, lest the consequence be more than he could bear.
“Where on earth has Bai Keqing gone?”
The figure of the Joyous Arhat vanished from this place, pondering the same question.
After Tuoshan Kong returned and reported the matter to him, the Joyous Arhat took an interest in this female Demon King. Over the years, he had investigated and discovered that Bai Keqing had not returned to the Demon Domain.
The disappearance of a Demon King without causing an uproar among the Demon Clan implied that Bai Keqing was not in mortal danger.
It was very likely that Bai Keqing was still with that Ye Fan; however, after years of searching, the Joyous Arhat had found no trace of them.
This time, his journey to the Xuan Domain was to further investigate Bai Keqing’s whereabouts, with the hope of capturing her and bringing her back to Xumi Mountain for transformation.
Although Bai Keqing was just at the True Martial Realm and far from matching the Bodhisattva, she still held great significance for him, capable of aiding in his cultivation progress and making a breakthrough in a minor realm feasible.
Returning to his Buddha hall, the Joyous Arhat began to make preparations, planning to set off in half a year. With over two years remaining before the Xuan Domain incident would officially erupt, he had ample time to track down Bai Keqing’s whereabouts.
Sword Domain, House of Divine Armies.
A few cultivators with powerful presences were discussing affairs, each emanating different auras, vaguely taking the shapes of various weapons such as swords, sabers, and spears.
These three were the Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors in charge of all affairs of the House of Divine Armies.
“Brother Liu, who shall deal with this matter? Has the master spoken?” asked a martial emperor with a square face and the aura of a Silver Spear.
The “Brother Liu” he referred to was a middle-aged man with the air of a gentleman, whose martial aura was that of a Divine Sword, known as the Sword Emperor.
Lu Zhen of Bai Yujing had long coveted the title of Sword Emperor. He had repeatedly come to the Sword Domain to challenge Brother Liu to a duel, each time ending in defeat. It was only after being confined in Bai Yujing that he finally calmed down.
“Not yet,” the Sword Emperor Liu Yunzhi said, shaking his head slightly.
“Do either of the brothers have any thoughts?” Liu Yunzhi looked at his two junior brothers and inquired.
The martial emperor who pursued the path of the saber shook his head and said, “Count me out.”
After some thought, the square-faced Jiang Taijing spoke up, “Then let me do it. It’s not quite appropriate for Brother Liu to go.”
“I have just reached a new understanding and developed a new spear technique; it would be good to test it out,” said Jiang Taijing with a smile.
The Sword Emperor Liu Yunzhi nodded and said, “Then we’ll leave this matter to Junior Brother Jiang.”
Barbarian Region, Peak of the Multitude of Stars.
The Peak of the Multitude of Stars was the highest Divine Mountain in the Qianyuan Divine Province. The ancient Immortals of the Barbarian Clan plucked stars and moons, refining and fusing them one after another to construct this Divine Mountain.
This was not only a Divine Mountain but also a powerful Immortal weapon, with boundless might capable of shattering entire worlds.
The Peak of the Multitude of Stars resonated with the celestial stars, continuously attracting the Power of the Starlight. Star rivers hung inverted from beyond the nine heavens, cascading onto the peak to aid the cultivators of the Barbarian Clan.
The barbarians of the Qianyuan Divine Province, also known as the Star Barbarians, excelled in using the power of the stars to temper their bodies. Each cultivator of the clan was a body cultivator, and the higher their cultivation, the stronger their physical bodies became.
Powerful members of the Barbarian Clan could traverse the void with their physical bodies, shatter suns, moons, and stars with a punch, and breach ancient Divine Mountains with a single finger, their might formidable and unrivaled.
At this moment, several Barbarian Emperors were gathered on the Peak of the Multitude of Stars.
There was some dispute among the Barbarian Emperors over the matter. One of them believed there was no need to intervene, since the Four Sacred Lands of Mortal World would handle it. If that thing really emerged, the Mortal Territory would be the first to be affected.
With deep-seated enmity between the Barbarian Clan and the Human Clan, this Barbarian Emperor would rather see the ruin of the Human Clan, devastated by that thing in its entirety.
As for whether it would affect the Barbarian Clan, he assured there was no need to worry. They had the Peak of the Multitude of Stars; should that thing dare to approach, it would be directly suppressed.
The other Barbarian Emperors disagreed with this perspective, seeing it as a matter concerning the entire Qianyuan Divine Province. If only the Human Clan and Demon Clan were to act while they abstained, it would make the Barbarian Clan appear inferior, failing to match the initiative of those clans.
Moreover, although the Xuan Domain situation posed significant risks, it also presented great opportunities. If managed well, it could be an immense stroke of fortune, which they couldn’t simply let the Human Clan seize.
From their viewpoint, the Four Great Sacred Lands sending Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors to handle the affair implied there wouldn’t be any accidents. The primary goal was to compete for the great fortune.
After some deliberation, the Barbarian Clan decided to send the Force Barbarian Emperor to the Xuan Domain to deal with the incident there.
East Sea, Dragon Palace.
Long Yue walked out of the Dragon Palace, her expression indifferent. With a flash, she disappeared from the place, heading towards the Divine Continent.
In recent years, her cultivation had further progressed, stepping into the seventh layer of the True Martial Realm.
Her combat ability had increased accordingly, breaking through her limits and stepping into the realm of the Divine Yuan, and not merely at the threshold of Divine Yuan Realm but nearing the second layer.
As her realm improved, she could employ more techniques, lifting many previous constraints, which in turn caused her combat ability to grow exponentially.
“It’s time.”
As Long Yue teleported, she pondered her final strategy.
Her visit to the Xuan Domain was to claim something she had planned for before, which would greatly aid her cultivation, allowing her to quickly ascend to the Divine Yuan Realm and perfect the path of her current lifetime.
As for the imminent major event in the Xuan Domain that would impact the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, Long Yue was unconcerned. She held no affection for the Qianyuan Divine Province, for it was not her homeland.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Chapter 180: Blowing up the Five Major Mystical Beasts! A population explosion 6 years later! (Long chapter, please subscribe)_6
She had only stayed in the Qianyuan Divine Province for a little more than a hundred years, merely a passerby.
“I hope that Li Feiyu has the sense to stay out of my way, otherwise I will have no choice but to kill him,” Long Yue thought silently.
What she needed was of utmost importance to the Da Qian Dynasty, and any action she took would surely cause a great commotion. But Long Yue didn’t care; she already possessed the combat ability of a warrior at the Divine Yuan Realm.
It was just the Da Qian Dynasty after all; the Four Sacred Lands of the Mortal World wouldn’t necessarily give her trouble, only Chu Zhenxiong and Li Feiyu within the dynasty might be a bit bothersome.
But it was only a minor nuisance; if they dared to obstruct her, Long Yue wouldn’t mind crushing them with the flick of her finger.
Thinking of the Da Qian Dynasty, Long Yue’s thoughts unintentionally turned to the father of this body she inhabited, and she sighed.
“Enough, enough, when I leave, I will grant you a fortunate opportunity,” she conceded.
Long Yue’s expression was one of desolation. Although the Prime Minister had chosen the Da Qian Dynasty in the past, he had taken care of her for over a hundred years, and his blood-related affection for her was genuine.
Xuan Domain, Da Qian Dynasty.
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
Han Li stood at the summit of Chengdao Peak, admiring the beautiful scenery of the Nine Tarns Reflecting the Moon, his expression very relaxed.
Six years had passed, and both the Han Mansion and the Li Manor had grown significantly.
Compared to the Li Manor, the Han Mansion had become completely low-profile. Han Li’s frequency of taking concubines had drastically reduced, now maintaining a rate of only one every six months. In six years, he had taken only twelve new concubines.
The talents and beauty of these twelve concubines were superior to those of before, carefully chosen by Han Li. Some were gifted by other forces, while others were actively discovered by Han Li in the Mortal World.
Now, the cultivation levels of these twelve concubines had all risen above the Gangyuan Realm, and their talents improved to the Fourth Grade, making their life in the Han Mansion extremely satisfactory.
Of course, they couldn’t escape the fate of bearing children, and collectively, they provided Han Li with nearly forty offspring, contributing to the expansion of the Han Mansion.
Besides these twelve newly taken concubines, Han Li’s other beauties had also given birth to two or three more children each, breaking the standard he had previously set. This was the joint desire of Han Li and his beauties.
Not only concubines such as Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, and Qiu Yueyao, but also his five beautiful wives Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and Bai Keqing had each borne three four children.
Whether it was due to Han Li’s talent having improved to Third Grade or not, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue later each had a child with Third Grade talent.
Over the six years, Bai Keqing became pregnant three times, each time laying only two snake eggs. She was reluctant to have more, as it greatly consumed her primordial energy. The first litter of two children were of Third Grade talent, whom Han Li named Han Yongbai and Han Yongqing.
Although the offspring from Bai Keqing’s second litter were only of Fourth Grade, the third litter consisted of two children with Third Grade talent again. It has to be said that the female Demon King was very exceptional, perhaps because she loved to engage in dual cultivation with Han Li so much.
In these six years, the population of the Han Mansion had exploded massively, growing very quickly.
Six years ago, Han Li increased the welfare benefits for propagating offspring by threefold, which caused a surge in the desire of his descendants to procreate.
They worked diligently to impregnate their beloved wives and beautiful concubines and took in quite a few more as well, encouraging these newly wedded wives and concubines to bear many children, successfully driving up the population growth of Han Mansion.
According to Han Li’s statistics, over these six years, Han Mansion had added a total of 1,642 descendants, among which 529 possessed talents.
Over the past six years, Han Li had poured his heart into advancing the cultivation levels of his beloved wives and beautiful concubines.
In comparison to Han Mansion’s population growth, The Li Manor was far less impressive; after all, Han Li was the only one sowing seeds, diligently cultivating each fertile land.
The children of The Li Manor were still young, with the eldest being only seven and thus unable to undertake the responsibility of spreading The Li Manor’s branches and producing offspring, leaving everything up to Han Li himself.
Over these six years, a large number of beautiful female cultivators from the Capital City and the six states married into The Li Manor, becoming wives and concubines to the lord of The Li Manor, infusing The Li Manor with endless vitality.
While Han Li took a new wife or concubine in Han Mansion only once every six months, in The Li Manor, it was much more frequent, usually marrying once a month, sometimes one at a time, sometimes two.
Over the course of six years, Han Li, on average, married two wives and took thirteen beautiful concubines for The Li Manor, resulting in twelve new principal wives and seventy-eight concubines for The Li Manor in total.
Now, Han Li has seventeen wives and more than one hundred and forty concubines in The Li Manor, both in terms of quality and quantity, generally surpassing those of Han Mansion.
In order to increase the number of offspring, Han Li spared no effort. The Fourth Grade beauties of the Capital City of Da Qian, as long as they were virgins, many married into The Li Manor, including several of Emperor Qian’s princesses, among which only four wives were discovered by Han Li from the Mortal World.
The sources of these concubines were diverse; about one-sixth of them were actively sought out by Han Li, who scouted the Mortal World for these beauties of high appearance and talent who were otherwise hidden away.
The wives and concubines of The Li Manor numbered about one hundred sixty, and each, on average, gave birth to three children, including the several wives and concubines married six years ago.
In just six years, The Li Manor had added four hundred eighty descendants, and although it did not compare with the growth rate of Han Mansion’s descendants, the advantage was that these descendants all possessed talent; their talents varied from Sixth Grade, Fifth Grade, to Fourth Grade, with the largest number being of Fifth Grade talent.
Counting the descendants born earlier, Han Li had a total of more than five hundred descendants in The Li Manor.
Six years of dedicated development brought Han Li countless benefits in all respects, significantly increasing his foundations.
In these six years, Han Mansion and The Li Manor together had added a total of 2,122 descendants, with 1,009 talented descendants, granting Han Li innumerable rewards.
Just from the births of these two thousand-plus descendants, Han Li had gained over two thousand years of cultivation and life span, as well as a great deal of Cultivation Techniques and medicinal pills.
Not counting the rewards for having 500 to 1,000 talented descendants and the rewards for having a total of 2,000 to 3,000 descendants, the accumulated cultivation was enough for Han Li to break through to the perfect state of the Nine Heavens in the True Martial Realm.
PS: Hahaha, as I was writing, I realized I got a bit too carried away, adding over three hundred wives and concubines to The Li Manor, so I deleted the majority of them.
Now, we are signing up for wives, one per person, first-come, first-served.
Oh, and don’t start with the combat ability collapsing; this is a timeline jump to accelerate the pace and deal with the plot setup.

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Chapter 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_1
“So satisfying”
Han Li couldn’t help but sigh with emotion.
After six years of devoted development, all the cultivation he had accumulated had not been spent. Including various rewards, the amount was astronomical.
Han Li was looking forward to seeing just how far his realm could improve.
With over two thousand new descendants, the quantity of descendants with good innate talent and the total number of descendants both experienced a tremendous breakthrough. Advancing to the complete Nine Heavens of the True Martial Realm was inevitable.
He still didn’t know how much cultivation was needed to ascend from the peak of the True Martial Realm to the Divine Yuan Realm. However, Han Li estimated that he probably had enough, and perhaps even some surplus, allowing him to advance even further within the Divine Yuan Realm, improving several minor realms to become a powerful Emperor Wu with exceptional combat ability.
“After enduring six years, today marks the day my cultivation comes to fruition,” Han Li said with a joyful laugh.
These six years were tough. Do you know how he spent them?
Even without foreign invasions and with the external environment being peaceful and harmonious, Han Li lived every day as if he were an immortal, but still found it to be a struggle.
Luckily, his strength was formidable. With a physical body as powerful as a cultivator in the third layer of the True Martial Realm, anyone else in his position would have been ground down to a nub.
Though taking new consorts frequently was extremely pleasurable, the days to come would be even more so.
Once his wives and concubines discovered that dual cultivation with their husband Han Li had profound effects, they were each full of zeal, pestering Elder Han every day for dual cultivation sessions.
For beauties with high cultivation talents like Lu Tianxiang, Bai Keqing, and Jiang Baiye, dual cultivation with their husband greatly accelerated their own practice, even seemingly enhancing their comprehension abilities. Every once in a while they found it significantly easier to understand and practice cultivation techniques and martial skills.
For beauties like Zhou Zhiruo, Chu Yutong, and Chen Qiurong, dual cultivation with their husband resulted in leaps and bounds in their cultivation, often breaking through a minor realm in a short time and improving a major realm in just a few years.
They also discovered that frequent dual cultivation with their husband was gradually improving their talents, divine spirits, and comprehension. This made all the beauties ecstatic.
They didn’t know how Han Li achieved this, but they never asked. Such questions were not for concubines to ask. They were content as long as they saw tangible, significant benefits.
In the past, they never dared to hope for advancing to the Hollow Void Stage or the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but now even the thought of breaking through to the True Martial Realm and becoming an Emperor Wu seemed within reach.
As all the wives and concubines improved in cultivation, their physical bodies also strengthened, becoming many times more supple and robust than before, allowing them to experience countless new positions.
Two years ago, Han Li concocted the second batch of Rebirth Pills, which was three times larger than the first batch, about four hundred pills in total.
These four hundred Rebirth Pills were distributed according to Han Li’s previous plan. Immediately, it significantly enhanced the talents of a large number of his beautiful consorts and promising descendants, greatly enriching the foundation of Han Mansion.
Especially after killing Chu Dingqian and acquiring his legacy, the foundation of Han Mansion skyrocketed, providing Han Li the leverage to cultivate the descendants of the mansion wholeheartedly.
If the descendants of The Li Manor had been of age, Han Li would have already started their cultivation. Even so, he had made appropriate plans for when the time came, ready to implement them when needed.
He didn’t intend to favor one over the other. They were all his descendants after all. If he had the ability, he would treat both mansions equally. Besides, Han Mansion and The Li Manor were meant to merge, and the day for that was not far off.
After all, his cultivation was about to make a huge leap, potentially reaching the combat ability of a Tongxuan Realm great power. By then, he would truly stand at the peak amongst the mightiest in Qianyuan Divine Province.
In just six years, with the accumulation of various cultivation resources provided by Han Li, a large number of cultivators emerged among the descendants of Han Mansion. Some had naturally high talents or were enhanced by the Rebirth Pills, rapidly advancing in cultivation. The highest had already reached the Peak of the Gang Yuan Realm.
From below the Innate Realm to the Gang Yuan Realm, each realm was filled with numerous descendants of Han Mansion. Born into a good family, a strong family, they had access to ample cultivation resources to help them rapidly progress in their practice.
Every talented descendant was full of passion for cultivation, unwilling to let this opportunity slip by.
For those without cultivation talent, they hoped for their sons to become dragons and their daughters to become phoenixes, encouraging them to produce more offspring. After all, the children were raised by Han Mansion; all they had to do was bring them into the world.
If a descendant with higher talent, strong comprehension, or capabilities emerged, they would be placed on the list for focused cultivation. In no time they could soar to great heights, and their parents would see their own status within Han Mansion rise.
The cultivation progress of the descendants of Han Mansion was swift, but the cultivation of Han Li’s wives and consorts improved even faster.
The resources available to the wives and concubines for cultivation were even better and more plentiful than those for the descendants, especially since they also had the incredibly powerful Han Li as their partner for dual cultivation.
Sometimes they even wondered whether their husband was truly at the Hollow Void Stage or the True Martial Realm.
In response to their skepticism, Han Li told his consorts he had advanced to the Myriad Phenomena Realm and his wives that his cultivation had reached the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm, asking them to keep it a secret.
Indeed, everyone in the Han Mansion had their doubts about the level of Elder Han’s cultivation. Could a cultivator at the God Refining Stage really provide so many resources? Anyone unaware might think that the Han Mansion was related to the royal family of the Daqian Empire.
But the descendants didn’t speak of it outside; they even proactively informed all the maids, guards, guest elders, and others that whatever they saw within Han Mansion must not be disclosed, or else they would face death.

chapters.title: Chapter 297: 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_2
chapters.content:
Now, Han Li’s wives and concubines have all significantly improved their cultivation levels. Those with high cultivation advanced several minor realms, while those with low cultivation jumped multiple major realms.
Many of the newly accepted wives and concubines did not possess high cultivation levels, but they have now all advanced to the Gangyuan Realm. The cultivation levels of those previously married have generally increased to the God Refining Realm.
Those beauties who were already in the God Refining Realm, like Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Xue Qingyi, and the rest, have elevated their cultivation to the peak of the Hollow Void Stage.
Chu Xianlin was at the late stage of the Void Realm before, but now she has advanced to the third layer of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. She is extremely satisfied with this speed of advancement; it’s too fast, beyond imagination.
From time to time, Chu Xianlin feels fortunate and grateful towards those forces that once forced her sect, otherwise, how would she have brought her disciples to join The Li Manor?
Of course, most of those forces have now been eradicated by Chu Xianlin herself, without the need for Han Li to take action; she led her disciples from the Void Realm to seek revenge.
Lu Tianxiang is Han Li’s first wife, ranking second in cultivation among all his beauties. Her advancement in cultivation has been incredibly quick, and she has now reached the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, soon to break through to the True Martial Realm.
This includes the merits of dual cultivation with her husband Han Li, but more so due to her own cultivation technique. In just six years, the Wenxiang Sect spread throughout the Daqian Empire, worshipped by countless citizens. Many cultivators of lower realms have become followers of the fragrant Sect Hierarch.
The official powers of the Daqian Empire and various other forces observed Wenxiang Sect without taking any action. They were well aware that the Wenxiang Sect had the support of a significant figure behind it, the very sky of the Daqian Empire, The Lord of The Li Manor!
The once-dominant Ancient Ancestor of Da Qian had been silent for six years. Many forces speculated that Chu Zhenxiong might have died as they noticed that Emperor Qian was increasingly respectful towards The Lord of The Li Manor, seemingly responding to every request.
Han Li had previously obtained a True Martial Pill from a treasure box, which could aid someone in advancing their Martial True Pill grade and cultivation to the True Martial Realm. He had already given it to Lu Tianxiang.
Lu Tianxiang hasn’t used it yet, as she wants to wait a while longer, to refine and consolidate a Third Grade Martial True Pill, and then with the aid of the True Martial Pill upgrade it to a King Grade Pill.
Above Lu Tianxiang is the Demon King Bai Keqing. She became Han Li’s wife six years ago, the latest addition and the highest in cultivation among his wives, already at the first layer of the True Martial Realm.
During these six years, Bai Keqing has been the most enthusiastic about dual cultivation. With her powerful body, she has the most formidable endurance, capable of prolonged dual cultivation and quick recovery.
In the first year, after giving birth to the twins Han Yongbai and Han Yongqing, Han Li immediately unwrapped the seal on Bai Keqing’s cultivation. She had no thoughts of leaving whatsoever.
Isn’t life in Han Mansion wonderful?
Here, she doesn’t have to worry about anything. Her cultivation is progressing by leaps and bounds, far better than in the Demon Domain. This made Bai Keqing reluctant to contact the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, for fear that she might come and ruin her good fortune.
Moreover, she also worries that Xue Yueqing might get captured by her husband.
Although her husband always claimed to be at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm, Bai Keqing didn’t believe it. Six years have gone by and there’s been no advancement? Impossible!
Even she progressed from the first layer of the True Martial Realm to the fourth layer, all thanks to her husband’s powerful cultivation.
Bai Keqing suspects her husband Han Li has long since covertly advanced to the Divine Yuan Realm and become a high-and-mighty Martial Emperor.
This is highly possible, as over the years she has been influenced by listening to her sister-wives, understanding her husband very well. Her husband is adept at concealing his cultivation, which is evident from the varying degrees of awareness about Han Li’s cultivation within The Li Manor.
The maids, guards, and guest elders of The Li Manor know Han Family’s ancestor as a real person of the God Refining Realm, and the outside world thinks the same.
Descendants of Han Li know their father, grandfather, or great ancestor as a Grandmaster of the Hollow Void Stage.
Han Li’s concubines are aware that their husband Han Li is a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, while his wives like her, Yun Miaoyi, Lu Tianxiang, and others know him to be at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm.
But according to his habits, he would certainly not disclose his real cultivation to them, so it is only natural for them to think he might have advanced by one more realm.
If her husband is indeed a Martial Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm, Bai Keqing fears that if the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing comes, she might not be able to defeat Han Li and would end up in his hands; she knows her husband has had his sights on Xue Yueqing for a long time now.
Besides, she’s also concerned Xue Yueqing might come and steal her status. She currently holds the highest cultivation among Han Li’s wives, naturally attaining a high status and more opportunities for dual cultivation with him.
If Xue Yueqing were to arrive, and once she tastes the benefits, wanting to rely on dual cultivation with Han Li to quickly advance her cultivation, she would occupy much of her husband’s time, which currently belongs to Bai Keqing.
“Ah, the joy of the ancestors is so simple,” Han Li exclaimed as he stood on the peak of Chengdao Peak, looking out over the vast sea of clouds.
Thereafter, Han Li opened the message panel, looking at the series of system notifications with a smile on his face.
The first thing he checked were the rewards for his descendants surpassing totals of two thousand and three thousand. Now the total number of his descendants had reached 3220.
“For your descendants reaching two thousand, you receive four hundred years of cultivation, fifty Sea-Cleaving Pills, twenty Gang Yuan Pills, five Immortal Conservation Pills, three hundred years of alchemy experience, and a Heaven Rank mid-grade martial technique the ‘Sky Concealing Palm’.”
“For your descendants reaching three thousand, you receive four hundred years of cultivation, seventy Sea-Cleaving Pills, thirty Gang Yuan Pills, ten Immortal Conservation Pills, three hundred years of artifact refining experience, and a Heaven Rank top-grade martial technique the ‘Four Phases World Suppressing Punch’.”

chapters.title: Chapter 298: 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_3
chapters.content:
Just one glance was all it took for Han Li’s eyes to shine with undisguised mirth—it was truly exhilarating. His cultivation base alone had increased by 800 years, not to mention an additional 300 years’ worth of experience in both alchemy and artifact refining.
The reward for reaching a progeny count of two thousand was similar to that of one thousand, differing only in the martial art grade rising by one level, earning him the Heaven Rank mid-grade martial technique “Sky Concealing Palm.”
Upon reaching a progeny count of three thousand, the rewards significantly increased overall. There were twenty more Ocean-Parting Pills, ten more Gathered Vitality Pills, five more Immortal Conservation Pills, and another increase in martial technique grade, now obtaining the Heaven Rank high-grade “Four Phases World Suppressing Punch.”
With just these two rewards, Han Li was overjoyed. What he valued most were the 800 years of cultivation base and the two martial arts techniques Sky Concealing Palm and Four Phases World Suppressing Punch. In his hands, they were on par with top-notch Divine Rank lower and middle-grade techniques at their maximum level.
Han Li chose not to receive the rewards yet. His gaze traveled further down to the rewards for attracting 500 to 1000 talented disciples, noting that his current count had reached 1422.
“You have attained 500 disciples with cultivation talent. You receive one hundred years of cultivation base, seven Fifth Grade Longevity Pills, one hundred years of Formation experience, and the Heaven Rank mid-grade martial art technique ‘Calming Chaos Sword Manual.’
“You have attained 700 disciples with cultivation talent. You receive one hundred years of cultivation base, nine Fifth Grade Longevity Pills, one hundred years of Talisman Making experience, and the Heaven Rank high-grade martial art technique ‘Sky Balancing Blade Manual.’
“You have attained 900 disciples with cultivation talent. You receive one hundred years of cultivation base, eleven Fifth Grade Longevity Pills, one hundred years of Alchemy experience, and the Heaven Rank supreme-grade martial art technique ‘Demon Slaying Great Hand Imprint.’
Han Li checked five system prompts in a row, which corresponded to the rewards for reaching 500, 600, 700, 800, and 900 talented disciples, respectively.
He discovered that whenever the count of talented disciples reached a mere hundred, the rewards would escalate one level. At 600 and 800 talented disciples, he had obtained one hundred years of experience in artifact refining, one hundred years of Alchemy experience, and the Heaven Rank mid-grade martial technique “Void Walking,” as well as the Heaven Rank high-grade technique “Xuanhuang Tyrant Body.”
These five system prompts granted Han Li five hundred years of cultivation base, forty-three Fifth Grade Longevity Pills, one hundred years’ experience each in Formation, Artifact Refining, and Talisman Making, two hundred years of Alchemy experience, two Heaven Rank mid-grade martial techniques, two Heaven Rank high-grade martial techniques, and one Heaven Rank supreme-grade martial technique.
Compared to the other rewards, Han Li yearned most for the five Heaven Rank martial techniques, which could drastically bolster his strength. In his possession, they were all Divine Rank techniques of boundless might.
After calming his excitement, Han Li turned to the last system prompt, which showed the rewards for reaching one thousand talented disciples.
With such generous rewards already for reaching a total of one thousand descendants, the prizes for talented descendants at the same stage were several times more substantial.
Expectant, Han Li opened this final system prompt.
“You have attained 1000 disciples with cultivation talent. You receive eight hundred years of cultivation base, three Third Grade Longevity Pills, thirty Fifth Grade Longevity Pills, five hundred years of Formation experience, and the Divine Rank lower-grade martial technique ‘Three Mysteries Body.’
“Hiss~”
At this point, Han Li couldn’t help but inwardly gasp, taking in the Spiritual Energy from the summit of Chengdao Peak.
The improvements were much more dramatic than the previous rewards for a total of one thousand progeny, nothing short of incredibly lavish.
In terms of cultivation base, the rewards jumped from one hundred to eight hundred years. As for elixirs, the Third Grade Longevity Pill appeared, numbering three, while the amount of Fifth Grade Longevity Pills surged to thirty.
A single Third Grade Longevity Pill could extend the lifespan of an Emperor Wu in the True Martial Realm by a hundred years, with a maximum of three pills taken, adding up to three hundred years of extended life.
Even when consumed by a warrior emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm, one Third Grade Longevity Pill could extend life by thirty years.
The Third Grade Longevity Pill was truly a treasure beyond price, far more valuable than the former Seventh Grade and Fifth Grade Longevity Pills.
The experience in the Four Arts of Cultivation also went from one hundred to five hundred years, but most importantly, the level of martial technique moved from Heaven Rank supreme-grade to Divine Rank, and he finally possessed a Divine Rank technique.
Although just a lower-grade Divine Rank, in Han Li’s hands, its power could dramatically surge by several grades.
“Phew~”
With a long exhale, Han Li began to sort through his immense harvest. This was an unprecedented bounty.
In terms of cultivation base alone, he had gained 2100 years, along with 2122 years from newly added progeny, plus the remaining years before that, and the amplification of his progeny’s cultivation base increase, his accumulated cultivation base had reached 4659 years.
4659 years!
When Han Li saw this number, he checked it several times, finally confirming he hadn’t misread—that was indeed an astronomical figure.
Considering he only needed 1000 years of cultivation to break through to the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm consecutively, with the remaining 3659 years of cultivation, Han Li was confident it would be entirely sufficient to break through to the Divine Yuan Realm and become a true Emperor Wu.
He reflected on six years ago, lamenting that breaking through from the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm to its pinnacle required a thousand years, a considerable sum. Now, it seemed he had grossly underestimated his own potential.
On the front of elixirs, he had received several hundred Ocean-Parting Pills, Gathered Vitality Pills, Immortal Conservation Pills, and dozens of Longevity Pills, including three Third Grade Longevity Pills.
In the four Cultivation Arts, Han Li had amassed five hundred years of Alchemy experience, four hundred years of Artifact Refining experience, six hundred years of Formation experience, and one hundred years of Talisman Making experience, enough to cause his proficiency in these areas to skyrocket.

chapters.title: Chapter 299: 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_4
chapters.content:
In terms of martial skills, that was a grand harvest. In total, he had obtained eight martial skills, each one immensely powerful, and he could easily cultivate each to the complete stage.
Heaven Rank Mid-Grade Martial Skills: Sky Concealing Palm, Calming Chaos Sword Manual, Void Walking
Heaven Rank High-Grade Martial Skills: Four Phases World Suppressing Punch, Sky Balancing Manual, Xuanhuang Tyrant Body
Heaven Rank Supreme Grade Martial Skill: Demon Slaying Great Hand Imprint
Divine Rank Lower Grade Martial Skill: Tri-Mystic Dao Body
Looking at these powerful martial skills, Han Li found that the martial skills he mastered had been completely renewed, and the previous Earth Level Martial Arts were not even worth mentioning anymore.
He now possessed the combat ability of the Divine Yuan Realm, and ordinary Earth Level Martial Arts could hardly enhance his combat ability anymore.
Soon, his realm would also advance to the Divine Yuan Realm. By then, Xuantian Punch, the Sealing Heaven Sword Manual, and other Earth Level Martial Arts like the Desolate Divine Prison Finger would provide an almost negligible boost to his combat ability.
After reflecting, Han Li began to claim his awards one by one, starting with various elixirs. Once claimed, he stored them in his unique System Space, never worried about losing them again.
Then, Han Li proceeded to claim alchemy, artifact refining, formation, and other various experiences.
A hundred years of talisman making experience greatly improved Han Li’s talent in talisman making, advancing him from a Fifth Grade Talisman Master to a Fourth Grade Talisman Master, with a quite remarkable effect.
Four hundred years of artifact refining experience dramatically increased Han Li’s proficiency in artifact refining. He went straight from an ordinary Fifth Grade Artifact Refiner to a top Fourth Grade Artifact Refiner, nearly reaching Third Grade.
Five hundred years of alchemy experience significantly enhanced Han Li’s alchemy skills, promoting him directly from an ordinary Fifth Grade Pill Refining Master to an ordinary Third Grade Pill Refining Master, jumping two grades at once, with a particularly powerful effect.
Six hundred years’ worth of formation experience multiplied Han Li’s proficiency in formations many times over, elevating him straight from an average Fourth Grade Formation Master to a top Third Grade Formation Master. He could now create some top True Martial Realm level formations.
“Huff”
Having absorbed over a thousand years of experiences in the Four Arts of Cultivation, Han Li took a long breath, his powerful Divine Spirit, comparable to the Divine Spirit of the Nine Heavens within the True Martial Realm, needed time to digest everything properly.
As his proficiency in alchemy, artifact refining, formations, and talisman making deepened, all reaching Fourth and Third Grade, Han Li found his comprehension also growing. This seemed to be a side effect of delving into the Four Arts of Cultivation.
Previously it wasn’t clear, but now he could distinctly feel his comprehension had increased significantly, resolving many doubts that had once puzzled him.
After a pause, Han Li’s gaze turned to the eight martial skills, ready to claim and assimilate each of them.
Sky Concealing Palm, Calming Chaos Sword Manual, Sky Balancing Manual, Four Phases World Suppressing Punch, and Demon Slaying Great Hand Imprint – these five martial skills were all for attack, capable of greatly enhancing his combat prowess.
Han Li believed that even if he didn’t advance in realm, once he mastered these five Heaven Rank martial skills to completion, his combat ability would soar to the mid-stage of Divine Yuan Realm, although he was uncertain if he could reach the later stage of the Divine Yuan Realm.
The Heaven Rank Mid-Grade Martial Skill Void Walking was a speed-based martial skill that could replace the Earth Rank Top Grade Nine Heavens Movement; the Heaven Rank High-Grade Martial Skill Xuanhuang Tyrant Body was a body-refining skill, which could confer immense strength and defense, more than suitable to replace the Earth Rank Supreme Grade Undying Golden Body.
This time, Han Li didn’t continue to stay at the summit of Chengdao Peak. Instead, he returned to his chambers, casually arranging a formidable formation to conceal his aura.
Having done this, Han Li no longer hesitated and began to claim each of the Heaven Rank martial skills.
First was the Heaven Rank Mid-Grade Martial Skill Sky Concealing Palm. It took Han Li three breaths’ time to fully digest the golden scriptures in his mind and cultivate this Heaven Rank martial skill to the complete stage.
Then came Calming Chaos Sword Manual and Void Walking, each taking three breaths’ time to absorb and digest; afterwards, he claimed Four Phases World Suppressing Punch, Sky Balancing Manual, and Xuanhuang Tyrant Body, each taking seven breaths’ time to absorb and digest.
Next was the Demon Slaying Great Hand Imprint. For this Heaven Rank Supreme Grade martial skill, Han Li spent a full fifteen breaths’ time before he had totally absorbed everything, successfully cultivating it to the complete stage.
Last, Han Li’s gaze settled on the Tri-Mystic Dao Body, a Divine Rank Lower Grade martial skill. His breath grew a bit hurried.
Previously, he had obtained a Divine Rank Lower Grade practice, the Demonic Fetus Technique, which Han Li had studied for many years. Tri-Mystic Dao Body was the first Divine Rank Lower Grade martial skill he obtained, and he could directly master it to the complete stage.
With a thought, Tri-Mystic Dao Body was claimed by Han Li. In an instant, golden runes appeared one after another in his mind, forming a powerful Divine Rank martial skill.
There were a total of 10,800 golden runes, each containing a vast amount of information, numerous cultivation experiences, cultivation images, and combat scenes.
Han Li’s Divine Spirit generated a suction force, drawing one after another of the golden runes into his Divine Spirit, where his powerful Divine Spirit absorbed each one, deepening his mastery over this Divine Rank lower grade martial skill.
One breath, three breaths, ten breaths, fifty breaths…
After a full hundred breaths’ time, Han Li had finally absorbed the Tri-Mystic Dao Body in its entirety and cultivated it to the complete stage.
“So powerful!”
Opening his eyes, shock appeared on Han Li’s face, astounded by the Divine Rank martial skill.
This shock was something even the Heaven Rank Supreme Grade martial skill Demon Slaying Great Hand Imprint couldn’t give him, truly surprising Han Li.
Tri-Mystic Dao Body: Divine Rank Lower Grade, divided into three layers. Cultivating the first layer allows the evolution of one Dao body, the second layer grants two Dao bodies, and the third layer bestows three Dao bodies.

chapters.title: Chapter 300: 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_5
chapters.content:
The Dao form could not leave the range of ten thousand miles from the main body, and each could exist for no more than half an hour.
Initially, the Dao form only had thirty percent of his combat ability, but as Han Li perfected each layer of the Sanxuan Dao Form, the combat ability of the Dao form would also enhance, ultimately possessing up to seventy percent of the main body’s combat strength.
Now Han Li had cultivated this Divine Rank, Lower Grade martial technique to the third layer’s grand perfection, enabling him to evolve three Dao forms, each possessing seventy percent of his combat strength.
With a mere thought from Han Li, three silhouettes appeared beside him, constructed from his martial Dao intent and True Yuan, surrounding Han Li in the middle.
Han Li closely observed the three Dao forms; each one was a replica of himself, identical in every way, even their Divine Spirit’s aura was his, and despite having only seventy percent of his battle strength, they still possessed the power of the first level of the Divine Yuan Realm.
After experimenting, Han Li discovered that the physical bodies, Divine Spirits, and True Yuan of the Dao forms were all only seventy percent of his own, and there was one major limitation—they could not initiate Divine Sense.
“What a pity,” Han Li lamented with a sigh.
If they could initiate Divine Sense, the battle strength of these three Dao forms could reach the second level of the Divine Yuan Realm.
But in the end, the Sanxuan Dao Form was still of the Divine Rank, Lower Grade, with many limitations, and was not truly existent, depending on his main body.
If they were to exist for more than half an hour or leave the range of ten thousand miles from the main body, they would directly disappear.
According to the records within the Sanxuan Dao Form, if a Dao form is destroyed in battle or exceeds half an hour, it can be condensed again, albeit with great consumption; if it leaves the range of ten thousand miles, once the Dao form dissipates, Han Li can reform it with a single thought without any significant consumption.
To evolve a single Dao form, it required twenty percent of his own True Yuan, while evolving three Dao forms in battle would consume sixty percent of his True Yuan.
Although the consumption was significant, the aid it provided was immense, and the main body could also prepare pills in the mouth; when evolving the Dao form, he could refine the pills to replenish the expended True Yuan.
If not in battle, then on regular days, evolving a Dao form could be used to accomplish many tasks, such as acting as a disguise, filling in for the last weakness.
Previously, Han Li and Li Feiyu could not appear in two places at once, but now they could.
Han Li’s main body could stay at home while using his Dao form to venture out, seeking highly talented and stunning beauties with high aesthetic values, as well as undertaking tasks that he himself could not do.
“This Sanxuan Dao Form is just too suitable for me,” Han Li chuckled with delight.
The embryonic form of his all-encompassing martial Dao intent could now boost the power of a martial technique by three and half grades, and Divine Rank techniques were no exception. The Sanxuan Dao Form, although a Divine Rank Lower Grade, in his hands, could manifest the power of top Divine Rank, Supreme Grade martial techniques.
After experimenting, Han Li found that with the boost from his all-encompassing martial Dao, the Sanxuan Dao Form was greatly optimized, and many of its limitations were significantly reduced.
The Sanxuan Dao Form now had ten layers, with which he could have ten Dao forms, each possessing one hundred percent of his own combat strength.
The consumption of evolving a single Dao form had greatly decreased, only needing three percent of True Yuan. Even for evolving ten Dao forms simultaneously, that would only be thirty percent of True Yuan.
How powerful could eleven Han Lis burst forth?
Now, even if a warrior of the seventh level of the Divine Yuan Realm were to appear before him, Han Li could force them into a pitiably frenzied retreat.
Han Li felt that the Sanxuan Dao Form might as well be renamed the Shi Xuan Dao Form, for in his hands, it could unleash power close to that of Emperor Level martial techniques.
Suddenly, a spark of inspiration flashed in Han Li’s mind. He thought of the Life-Prolonging Furnace that created the Five Directional Mystical Beasts, which could be arranged into a Five Directional Five Elements Formation to boost strength. Could he do something similar?
Even though he lacked the corresponding Formation, Han Li believed he could focus on collecting or creating his own since he was now a top Third Grade Formation Master.
If he could develop a formation where the more people involved, the greater the increase in battle strength, then his combat ability could skyrocket even further.
With that, he would have three layers of trump cards—Divine Sense, the Sanxuan Dao Form, and a Formation tailored to it.
The more Han Li thought about it, the more excited and anticipative he became. Once he advanced to the warrior emperor level of the Divine Yuan Realm, his all-encompassing martial Dao intent would be perfected, and the enhancement to his martial techniques’ power would increase even further.
Would the Sanxuan Dao Form leap from a Divine Rank, Lower Grade martial technique to an Emperor Level technique?
It was quite possible.
Emperor Level techniques are also divided into Lower, Middle, Top, and Supreme Grades, with Lower and Middle representing the Quasi Emperor domain, while Top and Supreme correspond to the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
“Hoo”
Exhaling, Han Li steadied his mind, ready to embark on his breakthrough journey. This time, he was determined to ascend to the Divine Yuan Realm level and become a true warrior emperor.
By then, how far his combat ability could reach was unknown even to Han Li, but for now, he was already invincible among his peers.
Over the past six years, his main Cultivation Technique had also advanced to Divine Rank, Lower Grade. Throughout this period, he had fused it with all the Earth Rank and Heaven Rank Cultivation Techniques he had obtained from the Daqian Empire, and he had also acquired many powerful Cultivation Techniques from various forces within the Qian Dynasty, all of which he integrated into the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture.
Additionally, he obtained many powerful Heaven Rank Practices from treasure chests, all of which were also merged into it, allowing the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture to advance to Divine Rank, Lower Grade a month ago.
It could no longer be called the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture. After merging various features of different Cultivation Techniques, its power had multiplied countless times, and Han Li had renamed it the Chaos Scripture.
He decided that this would be its name from now on, and he would continue to integrate countless Divine, Emperor, and even Immortal Rank Practices into it, perpetually evolving and breaking through the Chaos Scripture to bring him a substantial aid.

chapters.title: Chapter 301: 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_6
chapters.content:
This was the cultivation technique that best suited him, complementing his all-encompassing martial arts perfectly, like a tiger growing wings or a fish taking to water.
After the Chaos Scripture advanced to the Divine Rank Lower Grade Practice, it brought Han Li a significant increase in power. His True Yuan now possessed various attributes, its strength tens to hundreds of times greater than before.
Especially his True Yuan reserves, which originally were only equivalent to the ninth layer of the True Martial Realm, were now comparable to a Martial Emperor of the first layer of the Divine Yuan Realm. The increase was immensely substantial.
Many of his beloved wives and concubines also practiced the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, a Heaven Rank Lower Grade Practice, but they had not, like Han Li, integrated all their cultivation techniques into it, as this would require an inordinate amount of time, and they needed to manage their cultivation as well.
Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Bai Keqing, and other women chose cultivation techniques that suited them and then integrated them into the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, creating unique practices tailored to themselves, each giving new names to their techniques.
Their personal cultivation technique ranks were Heaven Rank Top Grade and Heaven Rank Supreme Grade, providing a considerable boost to their strengths.
Gathering his thoughts, Han Li’s Dao heart returned once again to a state as still as an ancient well. Afterward, he began his journey of breakthrough.
In an instant, his accumulated cultivation began to surge wildly, with each moment equating to a century of training, rapidly diminishing.
At the same time, Han Li’s aura also grew furiously strong, becoming stronger and more vigorous, as if to break through the Nine Heavens and reign supreme over all ages.
At this moment, Han Li once again entered the Enlightenment State. This time, the state lasted longer than any before; he spent five hundred years in this state.
In these five hundred years, Han Li expended endless energy and innumerable efforts to comprehend the natural laws of heaven and earth, to understand the Great Dao, constantly perfecting his all-encompassing martial way.
When the Enlightenment State ended, all insights gained within those five hundred years flooded into Han Li’s mind, absorbed and digested by his overwhelming Divine Spirit.
In this process, his Divine Spirit grew stronger, his Spiritual Sense became increasingly potent, his physical body was tempered by True Yuan and became fortified, his five senses once again enhanced, becoming sharper, and his Martial Fake Pill also became more homogenously mixed, exuding even more formidable power…
The nascent form of his all-encompassing martial intent saw its completion progress skyrocket at this moment, 80%… 90%… 99%… 100%!
Finally, the true intent of his all-encompassing martial way was completely perfected!
In an instance, Han Li entered a new state, akin to when he first comprehended the all-encompassing martial way and again saw the myriad stars evolved from the infinite martial paths.
Among these Ancient Stars, in the deepest reaches of that ancient starry sky, a colossal, boundless… supreme, most powerful star revealed itself.
With just one glance, Han Li felt it was the greatest celestial body across all worlds, all ages, and an infinite number of epochs – the ultimate manifestation of the martial path.
In a blink, this greatest star emitted a beam of starlight, piercing through the eons of time and space, crossing myriad worlds, descending into Han Li’s mind, merging into his Divine Spirit.
Then, the greatest star once again concealed itself, causing ages past and present to tremble once more, awakening countless ancient powerhouses, each one standing at the pinnacle of myriad worlds, looking down upon all ages as the most powerful beings.
Han Li was unaware of these events. He withdrew from this special state and inwardly examined his Divine Spirit, searching for that beam of starlight, but found nothing, as if everything before had been an illusion.
“The second time,” Han Li muttered softly.
It was his second encounter with this greatest, most supreme Ancient Star, and the second time a starlight had descended into his Divine Spirit. He did not feel anything unusual, as if it were merely an ordinary beam of light.
Han Li speculated that the effects of this descending starlight might only manifest later, perhaps due to his current lower realm.
Shaking his head and discarding these stray thoughts, Han Li focused wholeheartedly on continuing his breakthrough. As the true intent of his all-encompassing martial way was completely perfected, his realm began to break through continuously.
True Martial Realm Seventh Heaven!
True Martial Realm Eighth Heaven!
True Martial Realm Ninth Heaven!
Eventually, Han Li’s cultivation stabilized at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm. He felt a mighty power coursing through his body, capable of shattering stars with a mere gesture.
He knew it was not an illusion but the actual power he now possessed.
His combat ability was already extremely high before his breakthrough, but after breaking through, it rose to new heights, stepping into a new realm where he could rival the Martial Emperors of even higher realms.
Yet Han Li was still not satisfied. He cast his gaze towards the Martial Emperors of the Divine Yuan Realm, not accustomed to hoarding his cultivation; he preferred using it all.
Originally, it would have taken Han Li a thousand years of cultivation to break through from the sixth heaven of the True Martial Realm to its peak, but Han Li had not broken through. Six years passed, and over a thousand descendants with talents were born, among them not lacking in Fourth Grade and Third Grade prodigies.
This caused Han Li’s own talent to surge tremendously as well, continuously rising. Two years ago, Han Li’s talent had already advanced to the Second Grade.
Now, his talent had increased even more compared to two years ago, reaching 52% of the Second Grade, progressing very rapidly.
This was all thanks to Han Li’s six years of devoted cultivation, waiting until he transformed all his accumulated cultivation into strength, believing he would be invincible upon emerging, capable of effortlessly overpowering all in all directions.
In the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, perhaps only the great powers of the Tongxuan Realm within the Sacred Lands could pose a threat to him.
Because he was a Second Grade talent, the cultivation consumed by his continuous breakthroughs was halved, costing him merely five hundred years of cultivation, leaving him with a grand total of 4159 years!

chapters.title: Chapter 302: 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_7
chapters.content:
Han Li knew that it would take a huge amount of cultivation to break through from the peak of the True Martial Realm to the Divine Yuan Realm, a staggering figure, even more difficult than cultivating from the first level of the True Martial Realm to its peak, but he was not the slightest bit worried about his cultivation not being high enough.
After all, didn’t he still have over four thousand years of cultivation?
Calming his heart, Han Li began to check the requirements for ascending to the Divine Yuan Realm.
After Han Li finished reading, he was completely staggered, taking a sharp intake of breath—the requirements were too extensive.
To ascend from Fourth Grade qualification to the Divine Yuan Realm, one needed eight thousand years of cultivation; for Third Grade qualifications, this was halved to four thousand years; and for Second Grade qualifications, it was halved again, requiring only two thousand years.
From this, Han Li could see just how great an impact qualification had on cultivation; cultivators with low qualifications, without enough luck and opportunity, were unable to cultivate all the way up.
Many cultivators had enough luck in the early stages to cultivate rapidly to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, the True Martial Realm, but once their fortunes were exhausted, and they couldn’t gain new great opportunities, they would be stuck in that realm for life, unable to continue climbing higher.
Han Li felt fortunate that his qualification had been raised to Second Grade; if he were still at Third Grade, he would just barely have enough to ascend to the Divine Yuan Realm.
Now, if he were to ascend to Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm, he would still have more than two thousand years of cultivation left to continue elevating his realm.
“Cultivation really is a struggle against the heavens, a path against the natural order, and reaching the Divine Yuan Realm is too difficult,” Han Li’s face was full of emotion.
It was impossible for a True Martial Realm cultivator with Third Grade qualification to ascend to the Divine Yuan Realm through sheer hard work; cultivating from the first level of the True Martial Realm to its peak required one thousand five hundred years, and breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm required four thousand years, while the lifespan in the True Martial Realm was only two thousand years.
It’s not just True Martial Realm cultivators with Third Grade qualifications that find it difficult; even those with Second Grade qualifications struggle, for although they cultivate quickly in the early stages, going from the first level of the True Martial Realm to the peak through hard work takes seven hundred and fifty years, but breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm still takes two thousand years.
To cultivate to the Divine Yuan Realm through sheer hard work, one must have at least First Grade qualification; only such peerless geniuses, without relying on cultivation resources or competing for opportunities, could cultivate all the way to the Divine Yuan Realm and become the supreme Emperor Wu.
Those with qualifications lower than First Grade who wish to cultivate to Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm can’t make it just through hard work; they need to struggle, snatch, experience hardships, and seize opportunities.
This path, littered with countless failures, becomes a pile of dry bones, while the successful ones march higher step by step, acquiring great opportunities, significantly shortening their cultivation time, and advancing to the Divine Yuan Realm and even higher realms.
But this path is extremely perilous, one wrong step and all is lost, becoming one of the countless dry bones themselves, forming the stepping stones for other cultivators to reach the summit.
Han Li was very clear that to cultivate to a higher realm, one needed to compete; the path of emperors is strewn with bones, and isn’t it the same with other realms?
High-level cultivators have a glimmering exterior, but behind that are uncountable hardships, climbing out of mountains of corpses and seas of blood, snatching opportunities from countless other cultivators, and enduring trials to reach higher grounds.
This is a typical survivorship bias.
Those cultivators with low cultivation only see the halo of glory behind the strong, easily ignoring the hardships they have gone through, taking this path lightly, and most end up as piles of white bones.
Han Li was very grateful that he didn’t have to struggle in the outside world, endure hardships, or fight for opportunities… He just needed to honestly keep a low profile, focus on developing his family, and his cultivation could soar, allowing him to cultivate to his current state.
Keeping a low profile might also encounter risks, but the chances are very slim; unlike going out to gain experience and compete for opportunities where the risk of encountering danger is one hundred percent, and the chance of death exceeds 95%.
Normally, out of a hundred cultivators at Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, perhaps only one can cultivate to Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm, or even none at all.
Cultivators who can ascend to Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm are those with great fortunes and opportunities, perhaps with unparalleled qualifications or insight against the norm; in any case, they have something that makes them stronger than most cultivators to advance to higher levels.
Since ancient times, the Qianyuan Divine Province has produced countless True Martial Realm cultivators, but how many have managed to cultivate to Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm?
A great part of them are from Bai Yujing, Heavenly Demon Hall, Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, and other major sacred lands; these sacred lands have profound heritages, and entering one is a huge opportunity in itself.
