In each era, these sacred lands have several Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wus, with many Tongxuan Realm powerhouses at the peak, and at least one Tongxuan Realm powerhouse at the lowest, showcasing their heritage and lineage.
Cultivators from sacred lands have countless times the advantage over ordinary cultivators; of course, being able to enter a sacred land means the cultivator’s qualifications, insight, fortunes, or other aspects are extraordinarily high.
“Two thousand years of cultivation, what a painful loss,” Han Li muttered, feeling helpless.
He had thought his accumulated cultivation of over four thousand years was an astronomical figure, but now it seemed far from enough.
The cultivation consumed for ascending a minor realm in the Divine Yuan Realm would definitely be more than the consumption for ascending a minor realm in the True Martial Realm; it could even double or more.
With his remaining two thousand one hundred plus years of cultivation, could he raise his realm to the Seventh Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm?
Han Li expressed his concern.
“Huff~”
Letting out a breath, Han Li calmed his thoughts and suddenly felt it wasn’t such a big deal after all.
While the cultivation needed to elevate his realm was indeed substantial, for Han Li, it was countless times better than bitter cultivation or searching for opportunities; in just six years, he had accumulated over four thousand years of cultivation.
This not only allowed him to elevate his realm from the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm to its peak but also to ascend to the Divine Yuan Realm and continue climbing higher.

chapters.title: Chapter 303: 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_8
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: Chapter 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_8
What more could one ask for?
In another six years, his accumulated cultivation wouldn’t just exceed four thousand years, it could be five thousand, six thousand, or even more.
His descendants were gradually growing up, more and more of them were reaching adulthood, able to spread their branches and leaves, taking on the heavy responsibility of furthering the Han Family’s prosperity and continuing the lineage.
Collecting his thoughts, Han Li continued to read on, the System provided an explanation for why two thousand years of cultivation were needed.
Two thousand years of cultivation, based on his second-grade talent calculation, could lay the most solid foundation for him, paving the path for ascending to higher realms. Otherwise, the journey ahead would be very difficult, requiring even more cultivation.
At the peak of the True Martial Realm, after the Martial True Pill has merged with both True Yuan and Divine Spirit in harmony, it can foster the Martial Primordial Spirit.
Martial True Pill is graded from ninth to the first grade, and above the first grade, there’s the King Grade. The Martial Primordial Spirit also has a similar grading system, with the King Grade being the next step above the first grade, followed by the even higher Imperial Grade Martial Primordial Spirit.
Generally speaking, a cultivator at the peak of the True Martial Realm with a King Grade Martial True Pill, when advancing to the Divine Yuan Realm, will at least possess a top third-grade Martial Primordial Spirit, and there’s a decent chance of cultivating a King Grade Martial Primordial Spirit.
However, cultivating an Imperial Grade Martial Primordial Spirit is extremely difficult, more than ten times harder than condensing a King Grade Martial True Pill at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
The King Grade Martial True Pill is the strongest foundation for the True Martial Realm, but the King Grade Martial Primordial Spirit isn’t the strongest foundation for the Divine Yuan Realm. Only by cultivating an Imperial Grade Primordial Spirit can the strongest foundation for the Divine Yuan Realm be established.
The stronger the foundation you lay at each realm, the higher the realm you can cultivate to. Possessing an Imperial Grade Martial Primordial Spirit means having the potential for sainthood.
A cultivator with an Imperial Grade Martial Primordial Spirit, as long as they do not fall midway, can smoothly cultivate to the Tongxuan Realm, and the odds of reaching the Saint Abyss Realm are significant, over fifty percent.
Only by forging the strongest foundation in every realm can one better and more quickly cultivate to higher realms, and there is a decent chance to vie for the highest, to step into the Ultimate Realm.
Han Li had just fully perfected the Martial True Intent and had not yet started to condense the Martial True Pill. In theory, he should not be able to cultivate to the True Martial Realm, let alone the Divine Yuan Realm.
The higher level of Comprehension True Intent achieved, the slower the cultivation speed becomes, but such cultivators are invincible within their own realm and can even combat those from higher realms.
With the help of the System, Han Li needed only to provide sufficient cultivation, and it could help him advance, assisting him in condensing the Martial Fake Pill when breaking through the True Martial Realm and in cultivating the Martial Primordial Spirit when breaking through the Divine Yuan Realm.
And it would be an Imperial Grade Martial Primordial Spirit at that, possessing might no less than any other Emperor’s Imperial Grade Martial Primordial Spirit.
It’s just that his would be illusory, but capable of deceiving the real, undetectable to others, even if a Tongxuan Realm expert were to face him and witness the Martial Primordial Spirit he summoned, they would not perceive the slightest difference.
Han Li was very satisfied with this, and with a thought, he began his journey towards ascending as a Divine Yuan Realm Emperor.
In an instant, Han Li’s aura began to surge, climbing higher and higher, becoming stronger and more vigorous, causing ripples to form in the Formation.
Above his head, the Martial True Pill flew out, hanging high in the sky, emitting streaks of radiant light, as if to illuminate all worlds, making Han Li appear extremely divine.
Following that, Han Li’s Divine Spirit left his body, entering the Martial True Pill, sitting cross-legged within as if an innate deity.
The tremendous True Yuan within him, comparable to the Divine Yuan Realm First Layer, burst forth from his body, flowing upwards into the Martial True Pill, causing its brilliance to shine even brighter, its aura becoming ever more formidable.
This was merely the first step. A normal cultivator at the peak of the True Martial Realm would have performed this step much earlier and would slowly nurture, taking a lengthy time to cultivate the Martial Primordial Spirit, unless they managed to refine many miraculous substances midway to speed up the process.
Upon entering the True Martial Realm, it was “With one True Elixir swallowed, my fate is my own, not dictated by heaven.”
At the peak of the True Martial Realm, once the Martial True Pill was refined into harmonious chaos, it translated to “I possess a True Elixir, long confined by worldly troubles. Today, as the dust clears and light emerges, it pierces through mountains and rivers endlessly.”
When the Martial Primordial Spirit is successfully cultivated, receiving the mighty power of heaven and earth, it is then “Spewing forth the heroic spirit within one’s chest, transforming into celestial rainbows and rosy clouds of dawn.”
With one breath, they could shatter countless miles of mountains and rivers, with one hand they could break apart stars, and with a single step, they could crush the void and teleport to their destination.
After completing the first step, Han Li’s accumulated cultivation began to rapidly deplete, diminishing by a full two thousand years in an instant, transforming into Creation Power, descending upon his Martial True Pill.
With an unceasing flow of Creation Power blessing, merging into the Martial True Pill, it prompted the rapid integration of the Martial True Pill, Divine Spirit, and True Yuan, accelerating the process of unification.
After three breaths, Han Li’s Divine Spirit had returned to the primal state, reverting to its embryonic form, the Martial True Pill becoming the innate matrix nurturing the embryo, with ceaseless True Yuan and Creation Power as the nourishment, enabling the embryo to gradually take shape and then grow stronger.
Ten breaths later, the embryo transformed into a baby, identical to Han Li, but more exquisite and tiny, only palm-sized. However, it emanated divine light all over, the light of the Primordial Spirit.
At this stage, the Primordial Spirit was considered successfully cultivated, but the breakthrough to the Divine Yuan Realm was not yet complete.
Next came the third step, which was to enhance the grade of the Martial Primordial Spirit. Now was the time to contend with one’s accumulated essence.
The stronger the foundation built in the earlier stages, such as having condensed a King Grade Elixir, the higher the grade of Martial Primordial Spirit that could be nurtured, starting off much higher than most cultivators.

chapters.title: Chapter 304: 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_9
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: Chapter 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_9
The Creation Power continued to pour into the Martial True Pill, unceasingly and in ever-increasing amounts, causing the Martial True Pill to shine brilliantly, as if it were on the verge of a splendor that dazzled all the heavens.
Within the Martial True Pill, the newly cultivated Martial Yuan Spirit grew larger and taller, and soon, it was on the brink of bursting the Martial True Pill apart.
After the Martial True Pill shattered, everything was absorbed by the gaping maw of the Martial Yuan Spirit, refining it into its foundation and thereby enlarging the Martial Yuan Spirit once more.
One Zhang!
Ten Zhang!
A hundred Zhang!
Han Li’s Martial Yuan Spirit continued to grow, with its speed of growth increasing by the moment. The rich light of the Primordial Spirit burst forth, and a terrifying presence began to rise, seemingly suppressing the nine heavens and ten earths.
Suddenly, the Martial Yuan Spirit reached a thousand Zhang in height and instantly broke through this major boundary, continuing to grow wildly toward the ten-thousand-Zhang mark.
The stature of the Martial Yuan Spirit determined its grade, with the Ninth Grade being the lowest at just around one Zhang. Eighth Grade was ten Zhang, Seventh Grade fifty Zhang, Sixth Grade a hundred Zhang, and Fifth Grade five hundred Zhang.
Only by condensing a King Grade Martial Yuan Spirit or higher could one initially break through the ten-thousand-Zhang threshold, while an Imperial Grade Martial Yuan Spirit required a height of over one hundred thousand Zhang.
In the span of a single breath, Han Li’s Primordial Spirit broke through the thousand-Zhang threshold, reached five thousand Zhang in three breaths, and passed ten thousand Zhang in five breaths.
Thirty thousand Zhang!
Fifty thousand Zhang!
Eighty thousand Zhang!
In just twenty breaths, Han Li’s Primordial Spirit broke through the one hundred thousand Zhang threshold and continued to surge upwards without any apparent limit.
Han Li watched patiently, waiting for everything to unfold, his own curiosity piqued about what his limits might be.
A hundred breaths later, Han Li’s Primordial Spirit finally ceased its expansion, reaching a height so astonishing it could shake the world and leave it in awe.
Nine hundred ninety-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine Zhang!
Upon reaching this height, it could ascend no further, the Martial Yuan Spirit stabilizing and standing tall behind Han Li.
Fortunately, his Formation constituted a small space of its own, otherwise there would be no room to accommodate such an immense Martial Yuan Spirit.
“Awesome!”
Upon seeing the towering and mighty Primordial Spirit rising high above, Han Li couldn’t help exclaiming.
The two thousand years spent on cultivation were well worth it, more valuable than he could have ever imagined.
An Imperial Grade Martial Yuan Spirit starts at a hundred thousand Zhang, but even its limit does not reach a million Zhang. It is a shackle that Han Li had never heard of anyone breaking.
But he felt that he might have a chance to break it in the future.
His false Martial Yuan Spirit had already reached the limit of an Imperial Grade Martial Yuan Spirit, so when he truly condenses his Martial Yuan Spirit, it’s very likely he will break this shackle.
What changes would occur after breaking this shackle and what new realms he would step into, Han Li was completely unaware at this moment.
After feeling a burst of emotion, Han Li didn’t linger and began the fourth step of breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm.
With a single thought, the nearly million-Zhang tall Martial Yuan Spirit began to shrink until it was the same height as him.
At that moment, the light from the Yuan Spirit was so dense it was nearly tangible, shining across all worlds with an unparalleled power, possessing an invincible combat ability to overwhelm all foes.
Then, the Martial Yuan Spirit took a step and merged with Han Li’s physical body, causing his aura to swell countless times in an instant, breaking through all barriers and advancing to the Divine Yuan Realm, making him a true Martial Emperor.
Only after the Martial Yuan Spirit entered his body did Han Li begin to inquire about the system and the situations pertaining to the Divine Yuan Realm, and how to measure the strength of his realm.
His Martial Yuan Spirit was excessively strong, reaching the limit of an Imperial Grade Martial Yuan Spirit, close to a million Zhang. Could it continue to improve from here?
Subsequently, the system provided Han Li with an answer.
In the Divine Yuan Realm, martial emperors seek to elevate their cultivation realms through the growth of their Yuan Spirits—the taller the Yuan Spirit, the higher the realm.
Generally, the height of the Yuan Spirit on the first layer of the Divine Yuan Realm is the initial height of every Cultivator, based on grade.
The second layer is a hundred Zhang, third layer five hundred Zhang, fourth layer one thousand Zhang…, eighth layer one hundred thousand Zhang, and ninth layer five hundred thousand Zhang.
The pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm will see a Martial Emperor’s Yuan Spirit nearly reaching a million Zhang in height, only by advancing to the Tongxuan Realm would one’s Yuan Spirit be able to grow beyond a million Zhang.
In other words, Han Li’s current Primordial Spirit was on par with that of a pinnacle Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor, and one of the most formidable at that.
According to the system, he was currently at the first tier of the Divine Yuan Realm. As his realm advanced to the middle stages of the Divine Yuan Realm, he would be able to break through the shackles and grow his Martial Yuan Spirit beyond a million Zhang, matching the power of those great beings in the Tongxuan Realm.
After receiving this answer, Han Li was overjoyed. He had genuinely been concerned that his Yuan Spirit would not be able to grow further.
Otherwise, if he continued to elevate his realm while his Yuan Spirit could not grow, and remained just under a million Zhang, it would be an enormous loss, unable to bring him huge improvements in strength.
You see, the Martial Yuan Spirit is the greatest foundation of a Martial Emperor in the Divine Yuan Realm. The taller the Martial Yuan Spirit, the stronger they are, and the more strength it can provide to a Martial Emperor.
“I wonder what realm my physical body has reached?”
Han Li suddenly thought of a question—what realm was his physical body in, exactly?
His Martial Yuan Spirit, comparable to the most supreme pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor, was easily housed within his physical body without a hint of discomfort, which spoke volumes.
He knew that if a Yuan Spirit were too powerful, it would exert immense pressure on the physical body. If the disparity was too vast, the body could not endure the Yuan Spirit.
But Han Li didn’t feel that pressure. He found that his physical body effortlessly accommodated his nearly million-Zhang tall Yuan Spirit, indicating an extraordinary strength to his physique.
Before breaking through, his physical body was already on par with a third-tier True Martial Realm body cultivator. After he had mastered the Heaven Rank High Grade Martial Technique “Xuanhuang Tyrant Body”, the strength of his physical body surged even further.

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_10
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Chapter 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_10
With the current blessing of the Omnivalent Martial True Intent, it’s possible to ascend by four grades, that is, a whole major phase, equivalent to a Divine Rank Top Grade martial skill.
Divine Rank Top Grade martial skills are already at the level of the Sacred Abyss Realm. Having mastered a consummate level Sacred Abyss Realm martial skill, his physical body became unimaginably powerful.
Moreover, after ascending to the Divine Yuan Realm, his physical body would receive nourishment from the light of the Primordial Spirit when it entered the body, further strengthening it, yet Han Li felt little difference, as though his physical body had only improved slightly.
All of these signs indicated that his physical body was peerlessly powerful. Han Li guessed that it had likely reached the level of the Tongxuan Realm, enabling him to strike mightily with his body alone, and to boldly confront Lower Grade and Middle Grade Divine Weapons with his bare hands.
Thus, Han Li once again inquired of the System and received a definitive answer that his physical body had indeed reached the level of the Tongxuan Realm.
“Terrifying indeed,” Han Li murmured.
In just six years, he had become this strong without realizing it, possessing the combat ability of a mighty being from the Tongxuan Realm.
Merely relying on his physical body, he could strike mightily against such a being, which was an aberration beyond what Han Li could have ever imagined.
“It seems I may have underestimated my own strength,” he mused.
Han Li muttered to himself, realizing that his previous perspective had been too narrow and old-fashioned.
The Xuanhuang Tyrant Body had raised his physical body to the level of the Tongxuan Realm, so what about the Four Phases World Suppressing Punch and the Sky Balancing Manual of the same level?
If he used these two martial skills, could he unleash the combat ability of the Tongxuan Realm?
Han Li was uncertain. The combat ability from the physical body and the True Yuan were different; unleashing martial skills required True Yuan, and the potency of the martial skills was greatly tied to the strength and reserves of the True Yuan.
His current True Yuan reserves were nowhere near the level of the Tongxuan Realm, still far from that of a true might.
Before breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm, Han Li’s True Yuan reserves and potency were comparable to a first layer Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor. After the breakthrough, thanks to the limiting Prime Martial Primordial Spirit, his True Yuan reserves had also skyrocketed, reaching the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm.
However, the True Yuan reserves at the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm were ten times less than those of a Tongxuan Realm mighty being, and the strength of a strand of True Yuan was also ten times weaker, not at all on the same level.
“Forget it, let’s not think about these for now.”
Shaking his head, Han Li temporarily put those thoughts aside.
The matter at hand was to continue to raise his realm, to consume all the accumulated cultivation, and to aspire to increase his realm as much as possible, thus maximizing his combat ability.
His aptitude was only at 52% of the Second Grade, and although he had already made progress through a segment, Han Li didn’t plan to wait for his aptitude to advance to First Grade before improving his cultivation.
That would take too long. If no offspring with Second or First Grade aptitudes were born, and another three years went by, he would still not be able to advance to a First Grade aptitude.
Moreover, the situation in the Xuan Domain was becoming tense again due to that incident, attracting the attention of the various Sacred Lands, with Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors emerging one after another, entering the Xuan Domain.
Han Li didn’t want to wait any longer; he would raise his realm first, then in another six years, he could accumulate five thousand or even more years of cultivation. He had no fear of consumption.
The Han Mansion had developed, with a sufficient number of descendants; this was Han Li’s greatest source of confidence.
He initially had 4659 years of cultivation, and it took 500 years to ascend from the sixth layer of the True Martial Realm to the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm. Advancing from the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm to the first layer of the Divine Yuan Realm took an additional 2000 years of cultivation, leaving him with only 2159 years.
How many years of cultivation were needed for a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor to advance in realm?
Han Li quickly inquired and received the desired answer.
The answer made Han Li’s tongue click in amazement; indeed, the consumption of cultivation to advance one layer in the Divine Yuan Realm was much higher compared to the True Martial Realm.
To ascend from the first layer of the Divine Yuan Realm to the second layer required a full two hundred years of cultivation, which in the early stages, would have been enough to breakthrough two major realms.
It would take three hundred years of cultivation to break through from the second layer of the Divine Yuan Realm to the third layer, and five hundred years of cultivation from the third layer to the fourth layer. Currently, Han Li’s accumulated cultivation was barely enough to allow him to break through to the fifth layer of the Divine Yuan Realm.
If he wished to advance directly from the first layer of the Divine Yuan Realm to the Ninth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, it would require a grand total of 5900 years of cultivation, and to ascend to the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm, he would need an additional 500 years of cultivation, totaling 6400 years of cultivation.
Although that was a lot, it was still more than the lifespan of a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor. But Han Li was used to it, as he knew that he could achieve this through arduous cultivation.
Whether other cultivators could achieve this through grueling cultivation was not his concern.
With this in mind, Han Li did not hesitate to embark on his next breakthrough journey.
Today, he was determined to break through to his heart’s content.
With a thought, Han Li once again entered the Enlightenment State, and in an instant, 100 years of cultivation were consumed, and Han Li didn’t blink an eye.
At this moment, in the Enlightenment State, he experienced century after century, enduring daily arduous cultivation, diligently without pause, making his Martial Primordial Spirit purer and purer.
Although he had not yet broken through the barrier of a million Zhang, Han Li knew it was only a matter of time. As long as his realm ascended to the mid-stage of the Divine Yuan Realm, it was inevitable his Primordial Spirit would break free of its shackles and step into a new level, comparable to a Tongxuan Realm mighty being.
Simultaneously, Han Li’s aura began to surge rapidly, growing stronger and faster, bursting through the clouds, as if to overshadow the ancient azure sky.
His Martial True Intent was also refined in the state of martial cultivation, advancing towards a new phase.
Shortly after, Han Li opened his eyes, retreating from the Enlightenment State, his gaze flickering with the brilliant radiance of the laws of the Dao.
The next moment, Han Li’s cultivation began to rise sharply, breaking the shackles of his realm and swiftly advancing to a higher realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_11
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Chapter 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_11
Divine Yuan Realm Second Heaven!
Divine Yuan Realm Third Heaven!
Divine Yuan Realm Fourth Heaven!
Finally, Han Li’s cultivation settled at the Fifth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, which was close to his estimation.
Breaking through four minor realms in succession, Han Li’s physical body, Divine Spirit, Divine Sense, five senses, and other aspects all experienced a substantial increase, surging forward and entering a new stage.
“Did it consume 1600 years of cultivation?”
After glancing at the cultivation consumed by the increase in realm, Han Li sighed, now having only 559 years of cultivation left.
However, to advance from the Fifth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm to the Sixth Heaven, 700 years of cultivation were required, and his remaining cultivation was insufficient.
“Well, let it be, let it be, for the time being.”
Since the accumulated cultivation was not enough, Han Li didn’t insist on pushing it, given that his strength had already increased manyfold and reached an unprecedented domain.
Just 4800 years short of cultivation would take him to the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm. Han Li planned to amass more and then advance in one go.
Now, Han Li was certain that his combat ability was absolutely on the level of the Tongxuan Realm, having improved too much compared to before his breakthrough.
He was very satisfied with today’s achievement. Six years of accumulation exploded in an instant, which was a case of accumulating slowly and bursting forth swiftly, allowing him truly to soar to the heavens and stand at the apex of the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Advancing from the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm to the Fifth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, nearly breaking through nine minor realms, was definitely rare throughout history.
Han Li had never heard of such a remarkable cultivator, and even the ancient history of the Qianyuan Divine Province had no record of such achievement.
In ancient times, those from the Heaven Imperial Realm who became Great Emperors or even Heavenly Immortals, even though they were countless times stronger than he currently was, did not achieve what Han Li had accomplished today in their records.
In other words, Han Li’s achievement today was on par with the Great Emperors and Heavenly Immortals of ancient times, and he had even surpassed them all.
“It’s time to check out my combat ability.”
Murmuring to himself, Han Li opened his personal panel, which contained records of his post-breakthrough capabilities.
[Name: Han Li]
[Realm: Fifth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm]
[Age: 244 years old]
[True Yuan Reserve: First Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm]
[Physical Body: Fourth Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm]
[Primordial Spirit: First Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm]
[Divine Sense: First Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm]
[Defense: Third Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm]
After carefully perusing, the smile on Han Li’s face grew wider, and he couldn’t help laughing out loud.
“Hahaha~”
Seeing these data, Han Li felt a tremendous sense of achievement, it was simply too thrilling.
At only 244 years old, he had cultivated to the Fifth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, and his physical body, Primordial Spirit, Spiritual Sense, True Yuan reserve, and so on were all comparable to the powers of the Tongxuan Realm.
Han Li felt himself exceedingly abnormal; his current strength was invincible in the Xuan Domain. Even that old guy from the Ancient Empire, the War Emperor at the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm, couldn’t withstand a single hand of his.
With just his physical body, he could sweep through the Qianyuan Divine Province. Only those powerful beings hidden within the Sacred Lands were qualified to be his opponents, while other cultivators were not worth mentioning in his presence.
This time, breaking through so many realms, including the major realm of the Divine Yuan Realm, resulted in a multitude of times increase in his five senses, taking him deeper into the field of Divine Sense.
After careful study, Han Li finally understood the changes in the field of Divine Sense.
Now, whenever he triggered Divine Sense and entered this special field, his combat ability would increase fifteenfold, significantly enhancing his strength and potentially raising him one or two minor realms in combat ability.
The interval between triggering Divine Sense had further shortened from ten minutes to five minutes, which pleased Han Li greatly.
The duration of each Divine Sense activation had also increased significantly. Before the breakthrough, the first Divine Sense activation lasted for ten breaths, and now it lasted for sixty breaths, the second for fifty breaths, the third for forty breaths, and he could even trigger Divine Sense a fourth time, albeit only lasting thirty breaths.
This meant that Han Li could consecutively trigger Divine Sense in battle for a total of one hundred and eighty breaths, or nine minutes, which was close to the time it takes to drink a cup of tea.
If he spaced out the activations of Divine Sense, the number of times he could use it increased from eight to ten, equating to a spaced usage time of six hundred breaths, or half an hour.
As for the evolution of Divine Sense, Han Li was very content. He even wondered what it would be like to be constantly in the Divine Sense field, perpetually unleashing fifteen times his combat power, which would greatly elevate his ultimate fighting capability.
Han Li looked again, besides his physical body, Primordial Spirit, Divine Sense, and so on, his speed and strength had also improved a lot, all recorded on his personal panel.
Beyond that, there was his combat strength, all displayed according to Han Li’s request, benchmarked against those typical powers of the Tongxuan Realm.
Listed there were the various martial techniques Han Li had mastered, with their maximum potential under the enhancement of the true meaning of the Omniscience Martial Path.
Now that Han Li’s realm had advanced to the Fifth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, his understanding of the true meaning of the Omniscience Martial Path had reached the minor accomplishment stage, which could enhance a martial technique’s might by four grades.
Sometimes Han Li would marvel at how powerful the Omniscience Martial Path was, a true ultimate martial path, which could enhance even Divine Rank Techniques by four grades in might, leaving him to wonder when he might reach the pinnacle of the true meaning of the Omniscience Martial Path.
Suddenly, Han Li blinked, noticing something amiss.
Logically, his realm having reached the mid-stage of the Divine Yuan Realm and the Omniscience Martial Path true meaning having a minor accomplishment, should allow him to enhance a technique’s might by four and a half grades, but the panel showed only four grades, differing from before.

chapters.title: Chapter 307: 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_12
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: Chapter 181 Divine Rank Cultivation Technique Martial Skill! Breakthrough! Breakthrough! Imperial Martial Dao Primordial Spirit! Tongxuan Realm Combat Ability?_12
Han Li deliberated for a moment, feeling that it wasn’t the true essence of the all-powerful martial arts that had reached its limit, but rather his own understanding of it was too shallow, having only achieved a minor accomplishment, which limited the display of the true essence of the all-powerful martial arts.
If he had truly mastered the all-powerful martial arts, instead of just reaching minor accomplishment in its true essence, then the enhancement to the divine martial techniques’ power could probably be by hundreds of millions or even trillions of times.
“What a pity,” Han Li sighed inwardly. This was his own fault, and he couldn’t blame it on the true essence of the all-powerful martial arts.
“Huh~”
Exhaling a breath, Han Li began to check his combat ability panel to see to what extent his attack power had reached.
[Tao-mysterious Realm First Heaven: Seal Heaven Scripture, Xuantian Punch, Yin and Yang Palm Seal]
[Tao-mysterious Realm Second Heaven: Six Harmonies Eight Desolation Punch, Meteor Sword Scripture, Buddha Suppressing Prison Seal]
[Tao-mysterious Realm Third Heaven: Sky Concealing Palm, Calming Chaos Sword Manual]
[Tao-mysterious Realm Fourth Heaven: Four Phases World Suppressing Punch, Sky Balancing Blade Scripture]
[Tao-mysterious Realm Fifth Heaven: Demon Slaying Great Hand Imprint]
[Tao-mysterious Realm Sixth Heaven: Three Mysteries Dao Body]
Seeing the data displayed on the panel, Han Li’s pupils contracted, and he was somewhat shocked. Had his attack power really become this strong?
But thinking about it, it made sense. From the Six Harmonies Eight Desolation Punch to the Demon Slaying Great Hand Imprint, after being enhanced by the true essence of the all-powerful martial arts, their power was like divine techniques. And after enhancement, the Three Mysteries Dao Body, originally a lower-grade divine martial skill, was now comparable to a lower-grade Emperor Level martial skill.
The previous Three Mysteries Dao Body was only close to a lower-grade Emperor Level martial skill, but now it genuinely matched one, having been optimized again.
It could evolve fifteen Dao bodies, each possessing 1.2 times the combat ability of the main body, still unable to elicit Divine Sense, with the duration extended to half a day, and the range of activity expanded to three million miles.
Han Li understood why it was said that the Three Mysteries Dao Body, once displayed, possessed the combat ability of the Tao-mysterious Realm Sixth Heaven. With fifteen Dao bodies, each stronger than himself appearing, plus his own strength, they would be invincible within the Tao-mysterious Realm Fifth Heaven and have combat abilities comparable to most in the Tao-mysterious Realm Sixth Heaven.
“I truly am invincible,” Han Li mused.
He began to wonder, were there any late-stage Tao-mysterious Realm experts in Qianyuan Divine Province?
If not, with his hidden power, couldn’t he be considered the number one in Qianyuan Divine Province?
As long as those rulers of the sacred lands, the Tao-mysterious Realm experts, didn’t use Emperor Level weapons or Immortal Artifacts, Han Li felt he had nothing to fear.
Who would win and who would lose could only be known after the battle, and maybe he really was the first in Divine Province, truly invincible, able to horizontally push through all enemies.
Closing the combat ability panel, Han Li opened another page, which introduced the combat abilities of Tao-mysterious Realm experts, mainly divided into four categories.
The standard for a Tao-mysterious Realm expert involved divine martial skills, Divine Weapons, and Divine Rank Practices, with everything at least being of divine rank.
The first type of Tao-mysterious Realm expert only mastered a few lower grade divine martial skills and one middle grade divine martial skill, which they cultivated to a high degree of proficiency or perfection. They also own several Divine Weapons, ranging from lower to middle divine rank.
The second type of Tao-mysterious Realm expert controlled several middle grade divine martial skills, cultivated primarily middle divine rank practices, and possessed several middle divine rank Divine Weapons, or one top divine rank Divine Weapon.
The third type of Tao-mysterious Realm expert held several top divine rank martial skills, cultivated practices that were top divine rank or supreme divine rank, and owned several top divine rank Divine Weapons, or one supreme divine rank Divine Weapon.
The fourth type of Tao-mysterious Realm expert was often at the peak of the Tao-mysterious Realm, controlling several supreme divine rank martial skills, and even mastering Emperor Level martial skills. They cultivated practices that were supreme divine rank or Emperor Level, and had several supreme divine rank Divine Weapons or quasi-Emperor weapons.
Depending on different opportunities and backgrounds, Tao-mysterious Realm experts might possess different Divine Rank practices, martial skills, and Divine Weapons, but the system nevertheless listed an approximate combat ability for them.
Han Li compared his combat ability in the Tao-mysterious Realm by measuring against the first and second type of powers within the Tao-mysterious Realm. If he were to compare himself with the third and fourth type of Tao-mysterious Realm powers, the attack strength of all his martial techniques would have to be significantly reduced.
“I have been careless.”
After reviewing, Han Li was silent for a long time before suddenly uttering a sentence.
He had previously become a bit complacent, as his strength had grown too fast, making Han Li forget himself. Now, after seeing these comparisons of combat ability, he instantly came to his senses.
He felt that sweeping through the Qianyuan Divine Province still posed quite a difficulty, at least until he had cultivated to the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm and gained control of not only the Life-Prolonging Furnace but possibly even a Divine Weapon.
After all, there seem to be no powers of the first or second type in the Tao-mysterious Realm within the Qianyuan Divine Province; he had not heard of any Loose Cultivators who had managed to cultivate to the Tao-mysterious Realm since ancient times. There should be some outside the Qianyuan Divine Province, but none within it.
The powerful beings of the Tao-mysterious Realm within the Qianyuan Divine Province all hail from sacred lands such as Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and the myriad Stars Peak. These powerful beings are the rulers of their respective sacred lands.
As rulers, they could draw upon the heritage of these sacred lands, allowing them to comprehend Imperial Immortal Skills. If they could not cultivate those, they should be able to succeed with Godlike Martial Arts of Supreme Grade. They also mastered many Godlike Martial Arts of Supreme Grade and possibly even Emperor-Level techniques, depending on whether their comprehension was sufficient.
Even if they could not master Emperor-Level techniques, these rulers of the sacred lands were in possession of many Supreme Grade Divine Weapons and could wield Quasi-Emperor Weapons.
All these elements could cause the combat ability of the Tao-mysterious Realm’s powers in sacred lands to skyrocket, representing a strong foundation that Han Li currently lacked.
“Huh~”
Exhaling deeply, Han Li immediately engaged in self-reflection, chanting the sixteen-character mantra to remind himself not to get carried away.
His current combat ability was still insufficient; without the combat ability of a Saint in the Sacred Abyss Realm, how could he possibly dream of sweeping across the Qianyuan Divine Province?
“I hope you guys don’t come to disturb the old ancestor.”
Han Li gazed in the direction of a certain place in the Xuan Domain and said silently.
As long as no troubles came knocking, Han Li planned to stay in seclusion indefinitely, until the end of time or until he became invincible before he would emerge.
By the time he became invincible, he would naturally be able to crush all opponents. At that point, Great Emperors and Heavenly Immortals would all be inconsequential in Han Li’s eyes.
Moreover, Han Li had so much time to develop. After breaking through to the Martial Emperor in the Divine Yuan Realm, Han Li’s lifespan increased by 3,000 years.
In six years, the addition of over two thousand descendants brought him more than two thousand years of lifespan. Combined with his nearly 3,000 years of previous lifespan, Han Li’s lifespan had now reached 7,970 years.
Nearly 8,000 years of lifespan, far exceeding the normal Martial Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm, was approaching that of Tao-mysterious Realm powers.
In just six years, he had accumulated such a powerful foundation; what if he were given sixty years?
What kind of formidable foundation could Han Li amass after six hundred years, or six thousand years?
By then, he might have already surpassed the Heavenly Immortals, the True Immortals, and reached those legendary realms.
After reflecting, the Old Ancestor Han decided to continue focusing on his development, refraining from stirring up trouble unless necessary.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: 182: Dragon Princess, Can You Escape from the Ancestor’s Five Finger Mountain?_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Chapter 182: Dragon Princess, Can You Escape from the Ancestor’s Five Finger Mountain?_1
“How did she manage to escape?”
Han Li’s Divine Sense stretched out for millions of miles and caught sight of the stunning beauty in a light-colored dress, sparking a flash of curiosity in his eyes.
At this point, the beauty in the colorful dress was very far from Chengsheng Mountain, a distance of four or five million miles, but to Han Li’s Divine Sense, this was not an issue.
Before his breakthrough, his Spiritual Sense was comparable to the True Martial Realm’s Nine Heavens, with a limit covering a radius of 1.3 million miles. Now his Spiritual Sense had evolved into Divine Sense, which was incredibly powerful and comparable to the Tongxuan Realm’s First Heaven, increasing the area he could cover by many times.
The Divine Sense of someone in the Divine Yuan Realm’s First Heaven could cover an area with a radius of two million miles, whereas Han Li’s Divine Sense could cover an area with a radius of twenty million miles. If he wished, even the mighty Daqian Empire at its peak wouldn’t be significant before him.
“Dragon Princess, oh Dragon Princess, this is you coming right to my door.”
The thought flashed through Han Li’s mind as he activated his Three Mystery Body, from where a divine light shot out of his head, landing next to him and transforming into another Han Li.
“Go.”
With a soft chant from Han Li, his Dao Body directly tore through the space, heading towards the Dragon Princess.
It seemed that the Dragon Princess had come from the East Sea and had not yet entered the territory of the Daqian Empire, currently at the border between the Xuan Domain and the Chaotic Domain, about to enter the territory of Fengbo Pavilion.
A distance of five million miles was not much for Han Li now.
Previously it took him seven breaths to fly, but now that time was drastically reduced, not even requiring a single breath.
After perfecting the Skywalk Void technique, his potency was comparable to mid-grade Divine Rank martial skills, which boosted Han Li’s speed by many folds, giving him a speed equivalent to the Tongxuan Realm’s Third Heaven.
Upon reaching the First Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, his speed had greatly increased from that of the True Martial Realm. A martial emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm could traverse space, covering a million miles in just a breath.
Reaching the Tongxuan Realm and becoming a powerful entity, even at the First Heaven, meant an overwhelming change in speed.
The powerful beings could tear open space with a mere thought, instantly teleporting to distant locations—if one were to calculate speed, a single breath could move them ten million miles.
Han Li’s speed matched that of a mighty being from the Tongxuan Realm’s Third Heaven, allowing him to cover thirty million miles in a breath, piercing through space and arriving at a location thirty million miles away in one breath.
If the speed of light is characterized as 300,000 kilometers per second, then Han Li’s speed would be 16.67 times the speed of light.
The Xuan Domain was vast, stretching over an area of five hundred million miles, and the Qianyuan Divine Province was even more immense, with the Divine Continent alone exceeding fifty billion miles in area.
But to a formidable Tongxuan Realm entity, the Qianyuan Divine Province was considered quite small, as an average entity from the Tongxuan Realm’s First Heaven could cross or traverse the entire Qianyuan Divine Province in less than half an hour.
It was only five million miles, and in an instant, Han Li’s Dao Body arrived above the Dragon Princess, who noticed nothing at all, for Han Li’s Dao Body possessed combat strength comparable to the Tongxuan Realm’s Fifth Heaven.
“Let’s see what you’re up to.” Dao Body Han Li chuckled softly, his figure remaining concealed.
He had a feeling that the Dragon Princess’s return to the Xuan Domain probably involved some scheming—otherwise, it would be quite unlikely for her to come back.
Below, the Dragon Princess was speeding through the skies, reaching the airspace above the Capital City of Daqian in just a few breaths. She was also hiding her presence, not wanting to be discovered, unaware that she was being observed.
Gazing down at the bustling expanse of the Capital City of Daqian, Long Yue’s expressionless face scanned the Left Chancellor’s residence, Imperial Palace, and other places, finally resting on The Li Manor.
Her gaze penetrated The Li Manor’s protective formation, observing the scene inside and furrowing her brows slightly.
“This Li Feiyu sure knows how to enjoy life. In just seven or eight years, he has taken in over a hundred wives and concubines. Is it because of his love for beauty, or does he plan to create a huge clan?”
Long Yue pondered, feeling that something was amiss.
If it were out of lust, that would be for Li Feiyu’s personal pleasure, and if it were for starting a large family, then it would be for strengthening the clan. Either way, there should not be a high standard for taking wives and concubines.
Based on external speculations about Li Feiyu, the standard for his taking of wives and concubines should not be high. That would allow him to enjoy more beauties or marry more concubines to expand The Li Manor.
Yet Li Feiyu’s standards for taking wives and concubines were, in fact, remarkably high.
According to the intelligence she gathered, the lowest quality of the concubines that Li Feiyu took was Sixth Grade, and their looks and figures were all exceptional; as for the wives he married, the standards were even higher—the lowest quality had to be Fourth Grade, with looks and figures surpassing those of the concubines by a margin.
Having high standards for taking wives and concubines meant filtering out a large number of attractive female cultivators, which effectively meant those beauties were excellent cauldrons.
However, to everyone’s astonishment, those beautiful female cultivators who married into The Li Manor were all living well, with lives of utmost comfort and rapidly advancing cultivations, showing no signs of being drained.
“If he’s not marrying a large number of high-quality beauties for energy harvesting, could it really be that Li Feiyu’s tastes are that exquisite?” Long Yue found this perspective hard to believe inside her heart.
This Li Feiyu had aroused her curiosity a bit, but Long Yue had no intention to delve deeper, thinking that if Li Feiyu were to hinder her plans, she wouldn’t mind teaching him a lesson he’d never forget.
Then she looked ahead, a divine glow flashing in her eyes as if she were observing something.
It was a golden dragon soaring and coiling in the sea of clouds thousands of feet above the Capital City of Daqian, occasionally letting out a dragon’s roar, unheard by anyone in the city below.
This was the Qi Luck Golden Dragon formed by the condensation of the Daqian Country’s national fortune, a thousand feet in size, looking majestic and mighty and subtly exuding an aura that would startle many martial emperors of the True Martial Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 309: 182: Dragon Princess, Can You Escape from the Ancestor’s Five Finger Mountain?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Chapter 182: Dragon Princess, Can You Escape from the Ancestor’s Five Finger Mountain?_2
“Alas~”
Gazing at the fated golden dragon, Long Yue murmured to herself, a look of regret filling her pretty face.
The Daqian Empire’s fated golden dragon was exceedingly well-hidden, undetectable even by Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm without specific secret techniques. However, having witnessed it before, Long Yue set her sights on this fated golden dragon.
Before the opening of the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, the fated golden dragon of the Daqian Empire was at its zenith, stretching over ten thousand zhang, rivalling even ordinary warriors of the Divine Yuan Realm.
However, the Daqian Empire did not understand the laws of fate and could not utilize the fated golden dragon, or else the empire would not have fallen to its current sorry state.
Being of the dragon lineage herself, a true Jiao dragon, and having cultivated to the Saint Yuan Stage in her previous life, the empire’s fated golden dragon was of great use to her.
After reincarnating, Long Yue wished to take a new path—feasting on the fated golden dragon to assist her ascent to the Divine Yuan Realm and forge a king-grade Martial Primordial Spirit.
In her previous life, upon reaching the True Martial Realm, she had condensed a king-grade Martial True Pill, and within the Divine Yuan Realm, she had nurtured a king-grade Martial Primordial Spirit. But she had failed to take the final step in advancing to the Tongxuan Realm, resulting in a less than perfect foundation, which weighed heavily on her mind.
Although she eventually cultivated to become a saint of the Saint Yuan Realm, the hardships she faced during the journey were known only to her. For the sake of acquiring great fortunes, she braved many dangerous places in the Yuankun Domain and narrowly survived multiple brushes with death before finally ascending to the Saint Yuan Realm.
Not even a century after her ascent, she was pursued by that Great Saint and ultimately perished in the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Since her return from reincarnation, Long Yue has been pondering why the Great Saint would do such a thing, realizing there was a deeper meaning behind it.
If the other party had truly wanted her dead, she would not have had the chance to reincarnate. How then could her Dragon Soul and Dragon Ball have been left in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, allowing her the opportunity to reincarnate a hundred years ago?
Recently, Long Yue had gradually clarified the intricate details and began to understand the Great Saint’s intentions.
“Sigh~”
Thinking of her previous speculation, Long Yue heaved a sigh.
She then dismissed these distractions from her mind and continued to watch the fated golden dragon.
In this life, she did not follow the path of her past life but embarked on a brand new one. Leveraging the foundation from her past life, she successfully condensed a king-grade Martial True Pill.
But even with her past life’s foundation, Long Yue wasn’t very confident about nurturing a king-grade Martial Primordial Spirit, estimating at most a thirty percent chance of success.
This probability was extremely high for others at the peak of the True Martial Realm, but Long Yue was unsatisfied. She did not want to take risks unless there was over an eighty percent chance, if not absolute certainty.
As a result, she began to strategize and deduced a secret technique that could absorb fate to help her nurture a king-grade Martial Primordial Spirit.
The fates of forces at the Hollow Void Stage or Myriad Phenomena Realm were useless to Long Yue because their fates were not in the form of golden dragons but merely Jiao dragons.
Only the forces of the True Martial Realm had fate that could transform into dragons, breaking through the thousand zhang threshold. The stronger a force’s foundation, the larger its fated golden dragon would be.
For a top-tier force like the Daqian Empire, with its flourishing fate, two True Martial Realm powerhouses in residence, and numerous rising geniuses, it spanned an area near ten million li. Its fated golden dragon exceeded ten thousand zhang, which made it the target Long Yue had chosen.
It just so happened that the Daqian Empire had started on a downward spiral, coveted by many top-level forces, which provided Long Yue with an opportunity.
If she could seize the Daqian Empire’s fated golden dragon, upon her breakthrough to the Divine Yuan Realm and infusing it into the Martial True Pill, she could enhance the quality of the resulting Martial Primordial Spirit.
With this, the sky would be the limit for her future, allowing her to completely refine her past life’s Dao fruit Dragon Ball once she re-cultivated to the Saint Yuan Realm.
At that point, with the Dao fruits of two lives merged, she would transform from a Jiao to a dragon, drastically increasing her cultivation and breaking into the Quasi Emperor domain, with the future potential to become a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Though saints lived for a hundred thousand years, it was merely one-tenth of the lifespan of a Great Emperor from the Heaven Imperial Realm.
As a Jiao dragon, her lifespan was already many times that of a human from the Saint Yuan Realm, yet still shy of five hundred thousand years.
Should she succeed in reaching the Heaven Imperial Realm and becoming a Great Emperor, her lifespan would surpass five million years, far exceeding that of ordinary Demon Clan members and even that of Jiao dragons and True Dragons of the same realm.
“Whoever tries to obstruct my path will be my mortal enemy.”
Her eyes cold and unyielding as she beheld the fated golden dragon before her, Long Yue knew it was of paramount importance; it was also the best she could hope to attain.
Several Sacred Lands controlled the Qianyuan Divine Province, and she dared not act rashly. Even if she regained her past life’s cultivation level, causing disorder in the Qianyuan Divine Province would lead to suppression by those Sacred Lands.
The Imperial Weapons and Immortal Artifacts within those Sacred Lands were not just for show. They could awaken spontaneously, unleashing tremendous power. They could also be actively used by cultivators, although at the cost of massive amounts of energy.
Only the fated golden dragon of the Daqian Empire was within easy reach.
With the decline of the Daqian Empire, its downfall was inevitable. Her taking away the fated golden dragon would only hasten the process, and the masters of those Sacred Lands would not blame her for it.
After all, the collapse of the Daqian Empire was already being orchestrated behind the scenes by the Sacred Lands.
What Long Yue lamented was that the once ten thousand zhang fated golden dragon had dwindled to just one-tenth of its size. A ten thousand zhang fated golden dragon would have undoubtedly enabled her to nurture a king-grade Martial Primordial Spirit, possibly even surpassing thirty thousand zhang in height.
Now, the Daqian Empire’s fated golden dragon had shrunk to a mere thousand zhang. Although greatly reduced, consuming it would still aid her in nurturing a king-grade Martial Primordial Spirit.
Long Yue had thought about seizing the ten thousand zhang fated golden dragon years ago but ultimately did not act, opting instead to carefully plan her move.
It wasn’t that she didn’t want to take the fated golden dragon years ago; she simply couldn’t.

chapters.title: Chapter 310: 182: Dragon Princess, Can You Escape from the Ancestor’s Five Finger Mountain?_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Chapter 182: Dragon Princess, Can You Escape from the Ancestor’s Five Finger Mountain?_3
At that time, the Da Qian Empire’s qi luck golden dragon exceeded ten thousand zhang, possessing the combat ability akin to the threshold of the Divine Yuan Realm. Without a method to wield it, the dragon wouldn’t actively fight for Da Qian, and it only had a hazy consciousness.
Should Long Yue attempt to forcibly seize it, the qi luck golden dragon would resist. Given her strength at that time, even if she revealed some of her trump cards, she would likely fail.
That would cause a great commotion and draw the attention of all parties, possibly even the gaze of Sacred Lands. The probability of her successfully seizing Da Qian’s qi luck golden dragon would be even lower.
Some great taboos lay in devouring the qi luck of top powers to enhance oneself; the several Sacred Lands would be dissatisfied.
Therefore, Long Yue chose to wait. After making various plans, she headed to Leizhou, entered the Secret Territory, and retrieved the Dragon Ball.
Now, with the Daqian Empire so weakened, there was only an aging and dying Mid True Martial Realm Emperor Wu and another Emperor Wu from outside presiding over it, unable to hinder her actions.
Most crucially, the attention of all the Sacred Lands had been drawn to the incident in the Xuan Domain. A minor Daqian Empire wouldn’t garner attention, making her actions go smoothly.
Once she had successfully seized the qi luck golden dragon of Da Qian, she would immediately escape the Divine Continent and even leave the Qianyuan Divine Province to travel to other states in the Yuankun Domain.
“Something’s wrong!”
Suddenly, Long Yue looked closely at the qi luck golden dragon and frowned slightly.
Why was the Daqian Empire’s qi luck golden dragon barely a thousand zhang tall?
Logically, since the Daqian Empire had a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu from the direct lineage, it should have at least a thousand zhang of qi luck, and with an external figure like Li Feiyu, it should add several hundred more zhang of qi luck to the empire.
Could it be that someone from the Qian Dynasty like Chu Zhenxiong had already died?
This conjecture arose in Long Yue’s mind. Her gaze fell upon the Imperial Palace, where she didn’t find Chu Zhenxiong’s figure; instead, that Li Feiyu was still at The Li Manor.
“Forget it, forget it.”
Long Yue sighed. This was barely acceptable to her.
The qi luck golden dragon might have been diminished by several hundred zhang, and its effect was significantly reduced, but it could still enable her to cultivate an imperial-grade Primordial Spirit of martial arts.
If Chu Zhenxiong was dead, then nobody would desperately fight with her for the Daqian Empire’s qi luck golden dragon. As for Li Feiyu? Long Yue did not take him seriously.
Pushing aside her stray thoughts, she looked at the qi luck golden dragon before her and stretched out her right hand, ready to capture it.
The qi luck golden dragon seemed to sense impending doom, and suddenly let out dragon roars, circling and dancing restlessly as if seeking help.
“It’s futile; no one will come to save you,” Long Yue scoffed.
Just as she was about to make a move, she heard a voice beside her ear that made her body tremble.
“Who says no one will?”
Han Li’s dharma body became visible, and he did not conceal his face.
Long Yue, seeing Han Li appear, her eyes flashed with surprise. How could it be him?
Years ago, when she went to Leizhou, she had seen Han Li. Beside him stood two peerless beauties, but she remembered that he was only at the God Refining Realm at the time.
Now, it seemed he was a hidden old monster; otherwise, it was impossible for him to approach her so silently, without her noticing.
Keep in mind, she was once the Jiao Saint of the Sacred Abyss Realm in her past life. Although she was only at the Seventh Heaven of True Martial Realm in this life, her combat ability had already reached the Martial King level of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Long Yue felt this man might very well be a Martial King in the Later Stage of the Divine Yuan Realm. As for being a mighty being of the Tao-mysterious Realm, that was unlikely.
Thoughts flashed through her mind in an instant; Long Yue did not hesitate and prepared to flee in the blink of an eye.
This person had malevolent intentions, intending to protect the qi luck golden dragon of the Daqian Empire. With this old monster guarding it, she had no chance of seizing it.
If she did not leave now, she might even be captured.
Long Yue did not understand why there was such an old monster guarding the declining Daqian Empire, who did not intervene until today.
She gritted her teeth with hatred for this person, who was obstructing her path. However, she truly could not defeat him, and she would not use her past life’s fruits of cultivation, as doing so would not be worth it and could have significant ramifications on her future path.
“I’ll have to scheme in other Divine Provinces instead, seizing the qi luck of a weakened True Martial Realm power.”
While traversing through the void, this thought came to Long Yue’s mind as she headed straight for the East Sea.
“Thinking of leaving? Have you asked for the old ancestor’s permission?”
Han Li watched Long Yue attempt to flee. He didn’t chase immediately but instead let out a cold chuckle.
His words, however, clearly reached Long Yue’s ears, causing her body to tremble while she crossed the void. The old monster’s cultivation seemed even higher than she had imagined.
Han Li stretched out his right hand towards Long Yue. His movements were slow, his momentum did not seem imposing, yet he caused Long Yue to shudder.
She found that, despite having traversed tens of millions of li and entering the Chaotic Domain, she had yet to escape.
Below her, a giant palm that obscured the sky was opened with its palm facing up and fingers standing tall, growing larger and larger, about to engulf her within it.
“Hmph~”
Long Yue snorted coldly, didn’t hesitate, and immediately employed a Secret Technique. Her aura surged as she aimed to deliver a world-shaking strike, to break through the barrier formed by the giant palm and escape from the Qianyuan Divine Province.
But in the next instant, she encountered a disaster; her Secret Technique was interrupted. With a muffled sound, her delicate body plummeted, the sky-covering giant palm closed, capturing Long Yue within its grasp.
Retracting his right hand, Han Li looked at the Dragon Princess in his palm and smiled faintly before stepping through the void to depart, returning to Chengsheng Mountain.
The Dragon Princess’s combat ability was only comparable to the first level of the Divine Yuan Realm. Even though she had used a Secret Technique and her strength greatly increased, she was still far inferior compared to him.
His intervention just now may have seemed casual, but he did not take her lightly at all and directly employed the Demon Slaying Great Hand Imprint, a force comparable to the combat ability of the Fifth Heaven of the Tao-mysterious Realm, easily handling a small Dragon Princess.
To avoid unnecessary trouble, he also covered tens of millions of li of territory with his overwhelmingly powerful Divine Sense, concealing the magnitude of his intervention, preventing the outside world from discovering anything.
Who in the Divine Province would know that the Dragon Princess had once come to the Daqian Empire and was captured by him?
PS: That’s all for today; not feeling quite well, and I’ve got some matters to deal with. We’ll continue with 10,000 words tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 311: 183: Bai Keqing’s Shock, The Imperial Weapon Void Bell! The Dragon Lady’s Doom!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Chapter 183: Bai Keqing’s Shock, The Imperial Weapon Void Bell! The Dragon Lady’s Doom!_1
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
Han Li was at the summit of Chengdao Peak, seemingly admiring the scenery, but in reality, most of his mind was focused on his Dao body.
The female Demon King, Bai Keqing, with her blue dress billowing, flew up and said concisely, “Husband, shall we dual cultivate?”
After five or six years of dual cultivation, her realm had progressed from the first layer of True Martial Realm to the fourth layer, with her strength increasing manyfold. This experience had made Bai Keqing very keen on the process.
She felt that her days in the Han Mansion were very happy, either indulging in the joy of battle or enjoying life.
In the Han Mansion, she also learned many Heaven Rank top-grade and Heaven Rank supreme-grade martial arts. She even changed her main cultivation technique, which was derived from the fusion of the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, and had been elevated to be nearly a Heaven Rank supreme-grade technique.
Here, she did not need to compete for resources, as Han Li would provide her with a plethora of cultivation resources. Bai Keqing rarely cultivated her techniques anymore, focusing solely on honing her martial arts, since dual cultivation with her husband Han Li would quickly enhance her cultivation level.
Han Li shook his head slightly and said, “Not today, Keqing.”
Today, he was to become a Dragon Knight, ascending from the status of Subjugating Demon Ancestor to Taming Dragon Ancestor; he could not afford to be distracted by Bai Keqing, the female Demon King.
Bai Keqing looked disappointed; she liked to dual cultivate not only because it helped her to increase her cultivation level rapidly but also because she enjoyed the process immensely. Han Li was powerful and brave, capable of satisfying and conquering her.
“Did you flip over Sister Xiangxiang or Sister Jiang Jiang’s plates today? I don’t mind joining them,” Bai Keqing persisted.
When she was captured by Han Li, she was still acting dignified, but now she had long realized her situation and resigned herself to being secondary—as long as it meant advancing her cultivation level.
Han Li continued to shake his head, saying, “I did not.”
“Then, did you flip the plates of Sister Mingmeng and Sister YiWu?”
“No, not them either.”
“Are you going to The Li Manor?”
“No.”
After the conversation, a look of surprise appeared on Bai Keqing’s face; this did not seem like her husband’s usual behavior.
Han Li was known to flip the plates every day, sometimes flipping many in a single night, yet today he behaved like a Saint, seemingly unattracted by hundreds of stunning women.
Suddenly, a thought flashed through Bai Keqing’s mind, and she blurted out, “Do you have a new love?”
Only when taking a new wife or concubine did Han Li act this way. However, it had been a long time since he last married, and he only took a concubine every six months—it was not yet time for that.
Han Li smiled and nodded.
Having her guess confirmed, Bai Keqing continued to ask, “Is it a wife or a concubine that you’re taking, husband?”
Before Han Li could respond, Bai Keqing sighed and said, “If it weren’t for the fact that I temporarily cannot return to the Demon Domain, I’d bring some beautiful Demon Clan female cultivators over for you.”
Indeed, she had such intentions. Among the Demon Clan were many beautiful female cultivators who met Han Li’s standards for taking wives and concubines.
She wouldn’t dare to speak of others, but within her own tribe, she could. At her command, the beautiful female cultivators with sixth-grade aptitude and above in her clan would be eager to volunteer, one after another marrying into the Han Mansion.
But since she temporarily could not return to the Demon Clan and her husband was so low-key, unable to openly do such things, and the Xuan Domain was far from the Demon Domain, various reasons prevented Bai Keqing from executing her plan.
“A wife, and you know her,” Han Li said with a mysterious smile.
“I know her?” Bai Keqing was astonished.
In the Xuan Domain, she hardly knew any members of the Human Clan, let alone beautiful female Human Clan cultivators. Could it be someone from the Demon Clan?
“Did you capture Xue Yueqing?” Bai Keqing asked tentatively.
Among the Demon Clan in the True Martial Realm, there were only three or four female Demon Kings besides her, and the rest were already married off; it seemed that her husband was not particularly fond of that.
There were quite a few virgin beauties of the Demon Clan in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but given her husband’s character, it was unlikely that he would go to the trouble of entering the Demon Domain to capture them, which could lead to a lot of trouble.
Therefore, it could very well be Xue Yueqing.
As someone very close to Xue Yueqing, Bai Keqing had not returned to the Myriad Demon Mountain in the Demon Domain to report back after being rescued by her husband from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, and since her life lamp had not gone out, it was possible that Xue Yueqing would come looking for her.
Especially in recent years, with the turmoil in the Xuan Domain, all the Sacred Lands were watching closely. Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors began descending the mountains, rushing to the Xuan Domain, and Xue Yueqing could very likely be among them.
To be honest, whether for the public good or out of self-interest, Bai Keqing did not wish for her husband to capture Xue Yueqing.
“I would have liked to capture Xue Yueqing, but she has yet to come here, and it is not advisable for me to go to the Demon Domain,” Han Li said with a smile tinged with helplessness.
Bai Keqing breathed a sigh of relief but also sighed inwardly; her husband indeed harbored such thoughts, and although she wished otherwise, she did not voice it.
“Then who is your new wife?”
“You will find out soon,” Han Li said with a smile.
Bai Keqing rolled her eyes at him. Was there a need for him to be so secretive?
Leaning against Han Li, Bai Keqing was very curious about who his new wife would be.
After a while, Han Li suddenly said, “Here she comes.”
Bai Keqing looked around, wondering what he meant—there were still only the two of them at the peak of Chengdao.
As she was thinking this, Bai Keqing turned her head and her pupils constricted in shock.
Behind them, a figure emerged from the void, and that figure looked exactly like her husband, Han Li.
She looked at Han Li, who was holding her, and then at the figure behind them, her eyes filled with undisguised astonishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: 183: Bai Keqing’s Shock, the Imperial Weapon Void Bell! The Dragon Lady’s End!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 183: Bai Keqing’s Shock, the Imperial Weapon Void Bell! The Dragon Lady’s End!_2
When did my lord learn such powerful martial arts?
Wait, translocating through the void with great transference, can even Emperor Wu at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm do this?
My lord is indeed a martial emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm!
After her shock subsided, Bai Keqing regained her senses, looking around with bewilderment painting her gorgeously enchanting face.
Where is my lord’s new wife?
Han Li said she was coming, yet Bai Keqing only saw another Han Li appear and didn’t notice anyone else.
Many thoughts flashed through her mind in an instant. Bai Keqing looked up at Han Li, waiting for him to explain. If he was joking, she would surely punish elder Han severely tonight.
“Keqing, look.”
Han Li gently encircled her waist with one arm and nibbled on her earlobe, then turned around.
Behold, Han Li’s incarnate extended his right hand and then opened it, revealing a miniature Dragon Princess in the palm of his incarnate, looking utterly disoriented and in a foul mood.
She was caught while attempting to steal the qi-fortune golden dragon of the Daqian Empire, and ended up encountering an old monster from the Tongxuan Realm, who suppressed her with a single palm.
Initially, she thought Han Li was a later-stage Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm, but upon truly clashing with him, she realized she had severely underestimated this fellow’s strength.
She had once set eyes upon this old monster. That insignificant cultivator who didn’t even enter her sight back then, the contrast now made the Dragon Princess extremely miserable.
In her lofty status as the Sacred Dragon, revered across the Eight Hundred Divine Regions, she now found herself held in someone’s palm, akin to a small loach, completely powerless to resist.
“Dragon Princess?!”
Bai Keqing exclaimed upon seeing the petite beauty in the palm of Han Li’s incarnate.
How did my lord capture this reincarnated Sacred Dragon?
Upon closer inspection, she was certain she was not mistaken. She had fought against the Dragon Princess before and remembered her figure, temperament, and attire exceptionally well.
Looking back and forth between the Dragon Princess and her own lord, Bai Keqing suddenly had a bold guess—could her lord have secretly cultivated to the Tongxuan Realm?
Years ago, during the great battle in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, the Dragon Princess was already unmatched in strength. After reclaiming her Dragon Ball, her cultivation speed would only increase faster, and even if she hadn’t reached the Divine Yuan Realm, she possessed combat ability comparable to it.
Yet this Dragon Princess, who appeared to be a martial emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm, was now minuscule in her lord’s palm, her cultivation completely sealed. This great divine power seemed much like the legendary abilities of Tongxuan Realm powerhouses.
Reflecting upon it, Bai Keqing thought that the other Han Li stepping out from the void earlier seemed too effortless. Even Lord Xue Yueqing, who traversed the void, couldn’t achieve such a feat, not even close.
“Keqing, go back first.”
Although Bai Keqing was filled with doubts, she didn’t ask further questions. Obediently and gently, she agreed and took a deep look at the Dragon Princess before disappearing from the peak of Chengdao.
Since her lord had captured the Dragon Princess, it was likely difficult for her to have dual cultivation with him today and possibly for some time in the future. She would have to think of another way.
After Bai Keqing left, Han Li’s incarnate waved his right hand gently, and the Dragon Princess landed on the ground, regaining her original size.
He withdrew his incarnate with a single thought, smiling at the Dragon Princess without a word.
The Dragon Princess looked extremely young, as if in her teenage years, dressed in a colorful light skirt that perfectly outlined her delicate figure, enhancing her stunning beauty.
Her brows were like ink, her eyes as clear as crystals; her skin was whiter than snow, with a waist slender enough to hold, and her three thousand strands of soft hair fluttered in the wind.
A thin veil covered her face, yet it couldn’t hide her exquisite features. Underneath the veil, her eyes circled with a beauty that made the sun and moon pale in comparison.
The Dragon Princess, with her cultivation sealed, lacked her usual aloofness that kept others miles away. She appeared very vulnerable.
Han Li remained silent, as did Long Yue, who was observing him carefully, with countless thoughts running through her mind.
She contemplated how to escape her current predicament, which was very unfavorable to her.
Having not yet returned to her previous life’s cultivation, and not even reached the Tongxuan Realm, she was captured by a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse—an extremely bad piece of news for her.
Her identity was known to all; she was the reincarnated Sacred Dragon, and the Dragon Ball from her previous life’s Dao fruit was in her possession. If this old monster coveted her Dragon Ball and plotted against her, her future was worrisome.
The Dao fruit of a Saint from the Saint Abyss Realm had great allure for a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse. Long Yue wasn’t sure if this person had already discovered her plans and was lying in wait or had simply chanced upon her.
If it was the former, she might truly perish. If it was the latter, there was still hope for her to escape.
“Little Dragon Princess, now that you’re in the hands of the elder, just accept your fate,” Han Li said with a chuckle, seeming to know what Long Yue was thinking.
Before capturing Long Yue, he had evolved into five incarnates and stationed them in the five cardinal directions of the world. Five Tongxuan Realm powerhouses formed a large array to isolate the inside from the outside.
Even if Long Yue had a way to reach the heavens, with her mere seventh layer of the True Martial Realm, she couldn’t possibly break through, especially since Han Li had sealed her cultivation.
Long Yue’s eyebrows raised slightly, and she said coldly, “Little Dragon Princess? Do you know how old I truly am?”
“I lived for tens of thousands of years in my former life, and you, a Tongxuan Realm cultivator, have only lived a mere few thousand years, not even a fraction of my age. In my eyes, you’re like a little brat, yet you dare to call yourself an elder in front of me. Who gave you the courage?”
Long Yue found it laughable; her true age was nearly forty thousand years. This man was merely at the Tongxuan Realm; no matter what, he couldn’t be over ten thousand years old.
At this moment, Long Yue felt as if she was “a dragon playing in shallow waters, being teased by shrimps.”

chapters.title: Chapter 313: 183: Bai Keqing’s Shock, The Imperial Weapon Void Bell! The Dragon Lady’s Demise!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Chapter 183: Bai Keqing’s Shock, The Imperial Weapon Void Bell! The Dragon Lady’s Demise!_3
Although she fell into the hands of this person, the Dragon Princess’s pride did not permit her to bow her head; in her previous life, she roamed freely and only ever suffered humiliation in the presence of a Great Saint.
“My previous life was nothing but a fig leaf. All I strive for is this life, to achieve longevity in this life, to be eternal, to stand tall across the endless heavens for all eternity.”
Han Li stood with his hands clasped behind his back, his back facing Long Yue, speaking in a calm tone, sharing his own ambition for the first time with someone.
“In this life, you are barely over a hundred years old, yet you’ve cultivated to the seventh level of the True Martial Realm. Although your foundation from the previous life assisted you, you’re still considered a rare genius, a peerless talent of this era. But compared to me, you’re still far behind.”
“In the eyes of the old ancestor here, you will always be nothing but the Dragon Princess.”
“Heh heh~” Long Yue let out a cold laugh, no longer arguing with him on this matter. Walking up to his side, she spoke indifferently, “Your ambition is too great, too heavy for you to bear.”
“I have seen many peerless geniuses and unparalleled prodigies, whose accomplishments shine brighter and outdazzle yours. Some are Quasi Emperors who have shaken the Eight Hundred Divine Regions, some are even invincible Great Emperors. Yet they all have fallen on the path to longevity, turned to piles of dry bones.”
“These geniuses, who astounded both past and present, couldn’t transcend the Emperor Tribulation, the Immortal Tribulation; what makes you think you can? Even a Heavenly Immortal lives only for one epoch, and yet you wish for eternity? To stand tall across the endless heavens forever? Do you think you’re an unrivaled Immortal Emperor? Ridiculous!”
“You haven’t experienced that splendid and magnificent Ancient Era, that is your sorrow; yet being born in this era is also your fortune. Without countless wunderkinds and geniuses to compete with, you could luckily cultivate to the Tongxuan Realm.
