This does not mean that you are more dazzling than those heroes who shone brightly in the Ancient Era.”
“A cultivator like you can dominate and call yourself a ruler in this era, but in the Ancient Era, you’d be one among many, too common, nothing worth mentioning.”
“I once traversed the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of the Yuankun Domain in search of immortality; I sought guidance from a Great Emperor and was fortunate enough to receive some pointers; I have debated the Dao with saints and have even battled with a Great Saint… you are not even my equal, let alone eligible to reach the level of those peerless geniuses who astound both past and present.”
The more Long Yue talked, the more stirred up she became, as if she was returning once again to that glorious and prosperous great era.
Han Li sneered, “You don’t even have the faith to match or surpass those peerless geniuses, no wonder you perished not long after becoming a saint.”
“If I had lived in the Ancient Era, the ultimate splendor of that age would have been created by me. Those peerless geniuses, those unparalleled prodigies, in the end, are just handfuls of dry bones.”
“I don’t need to compete with those geniuses who startled past and present ages. As long as I live long enough, endure long enough, the universe will eventually allow me to roam freely at will.”
At this point, Han Li paused, not continuing any further, his own secrets would never be revealed to anyone.
“You’re too presumptuous,” Long Yue disagreed with Han Li’s philosophy.
She had thought the same as Han Li did at the beginning, her ambition higher than heavens, but after being severely beaten countless times by the Cultivation Realm, she still bowed her head in the end.
Moreover, fighting for the Dao is inevitable, simply surviving is useless!
Surviving gets you no cultivation resources, no opportunities, no fortuitous encounters, without… If you rely solely on painstaking cultivation, no one could have an unimpeded and rapid progress; they would be firmly blocked by their realms.
Without breaking through to the next realm, there wouldn’t be enough lifespan to continue cultivating. How could one outlast those peerless geniuses?
Only someone like Han Li, who lived in the later ages, could hold such a thought.
Han Li did not explain further, closing off the topic, “Dragon Princess, don’t think about swaying the old ancestor’s Dao heart to find a chance to escape. With the old ancestor’s methods, there’s no one in the Qianyuan Divine Province who can oppose me.”
“Is that so?”
Long Yue’s expression remained unchanged, but she was somewhat disappointed inside. She said so much just to make this person expose a loophole.
Unsealing her cultivation wasn’t very difficult for her; as long as Han Li showed a weakness, she could pay a certain price to unseal her cultivation, then directly use a portion of the mighty power from her previous life’s Dao fruits to break free and flee the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Unsealing her cultivation and borrowing the power of her past life’s Dao fruits required time. Han Li had shown no weakness and could perceive her actions in an instant, causing her plan to fail.
Sighing softly to herself, Long Yue decided to look for another opportunity. She had only one chance to unseal her cultivation and shouldn’t act rashly without certainty. If Han Li became aware, it would be even more difficult to escape.
Thinking it over, Long Yue continued, “No one in the Qianyuan Divine Province can match you? You dare say that? You really don’t regard the powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm from Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, and other Sacred Lands highly at all.”
“Let alone you, a Tongxuan Realm cultivator, even I, if I were to regain my previous life’s Saint Abyss Realm cultivation, wouldn’t dare make such a claim in the Qianyuan Divine Province. Sacred Land’s imperial weapons and Immortal Artifacts are not just decorations; a casual strike from them could obliterate you.”
Han Li smiled, offering no explanation. His trump cards were not to be revealed, not even to his beloved wives and concubines, let alone Long Yue, this new wife who hadn’t yet entered his household.
In these past six years, although he had not gone to the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain to secure the ancient Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace, he had still acquired many good things.
The System’s treasure box function allowed a free treasure opening once a year; in six years, he had opened it six times without cost.
Besides, there were three paid treasure box openings every month. Han Li wasn’t greedy, he only spent five years of cultivation each month to open one treasure box.

chapters.title: Chapter 314: 183: Bai Keqing’s Shock, The Imperial Weapon Void Bell! The Dragon Lady’s Fate!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Chapter 183: Bai Keqing’s Shock, The Imperial Weapon Void Bell! The Dragon Lady’s Fate!_4
Over the past six years, he had opened a total of seventy-two paid treasure chests, which in total drained three hundred and sixty years of his cultivation (this wasn’t mentioned previously, but I’ve accounted for it while writing).
Of the seventy-eight treasure chests, each one could contain treasures ranging from Heaven Rank Lower Grade to Emperor Level Supreme Grade, which brought Han Li a plethora of valuable items.
He acquired sixty-four Heaven Rank artifacts, including cultivation techniques, martial skills, medicinal pills, pill formulas, charms, array diagrams, and more, significantly bolstering the foundation of the Han Mansion manyfold.
Han Li also obtained thirteen Divine Rank treasures, which included Divine Rank Top Grade Divine Blades, Divine Rank Supreme Grade Divine Swords, and Tongxuan Realm and Sacred Abyss Realm level medicinal pills, array plates, divine medicines, among others.
But the treasure that Han Li valued the most was a single item, a true Emperor’s Artifact, positioned at Emperor Level Supreme Grade, named “Void Bell”.
At the time, Han Li couldn’t help but laugh. It was his luckiest moment.
It was precisely because of the Void Bell, the Emperor’s Artifact, that Han Li had the confidence to make such bold declarations.
An Emperor’s Artifact of the finest quality, whose Artifact Spirit acknowledged him as its master and was utterly loyal to him, proved to be infinitely more useful than those Emperor’s Artifacts and Immortal Artifacts in the Sacred Lands that usually served as decorations.
“Stop!”
“What do you think you’re doing?”
A trace of panic flashed across Long Yue’s face as she realized Han Li had drawn closer, wrapping his arms around her soft, slender waist.
The strong scent of his masculinity was overwhelming, leaving Long Yue extremely uncomfortable, and for a moment, she wanted to erupt in fury, but she restrained herself, waiting for the right moment.
“What am I doing?”
Han Li leaned in, whispering into her ear, “Ancestor here wants to play ‘dragon soars through the seams’.”
Long Yue’s face paled in shock, unable to believe that this old monster was lusting after her body. It was despicable!
She was about to trigger the Dragon Ball, heedless of the consequences, to slay this villain, even if it jeopardized her path in this life.
She could tolerate Han Li holding her in his arms, but his lustful desires toward her body were utterly intolerable.
However, the next instant, her expression froze, and she was visibly stunned; she felt a thread of Emperor’s Might targeting her, causing her Divine Spirit to tremble in fear.
Indeed, it was Emperor’s Might!
Although Long Yue didn’t know where Han Li had acquired an Emperor’s Artifact, she was certain she wasn’t mistaken; in her past life, she had seen true Emperor’s Artifacts, and she even possessed a Quasi Emperor Artifact.
She finally understood where that shameless old monster got the audacity to speak so boldly.
It wasn’t that he was merely being arrogant; he truly possessed a formidable and invincible foundation.
He possessed an Emperor’s Artifact and could even activate it, which unsettled Long Yue’s mind for a long time, making her abandon the thought of a desperate struggle.
Being locked on by an Emperor’s Artifact, even if she had borrowed all her cultivation from her previous life, she wouldn’t stand a chance and would be easily annihilated.
With a silent sigh in her heart, Long Yue decided to endure the humiliation, bearing the burden in silence; there would be other opportunities, and time was on her side.
Han Li’s large hand wandered on her flat belly, causing Long Yue’s delicate body to quiver incessantly, and he nibbled on her earlobe, gently blowing air:
“Continue, please.”
“Let Ancestor see what other cards you have up your sleeve.”
Just now, he had sensed the hidden murderous intent in Long Yue and immediately connected his mind to the Void Bell concealed in the void, emitting Emperor’s Might to warn her.
The Void Bell, being Supreme Grade Emperor’s Artifact, was theoretically impossible for him to refine, and with his True Yuan, very difficult to activate, requiring a massive amount of True Yuan to unleash even a wisp of its power.
However, the Void Bell was a product of the System, which allowed Han Li to fully refine it directly, significantly reducing the consumption of his activation, and the Void Bell could also rejuvenate autonomously, using its accumulated energy reserves for combat.
This was something the Emperor’s Artifacts and Immortal Artifacts in the Sacred Lands struggled to do; they rarely revived on their own, conserving energy instead, and to unleash their powers, the Sacred Lands needed to provide a vast amount of high-grade energy sources.
Long Yue fell silent.
Finding herself in such a predicament was unexpected.
When she arrived, she was a lofty Dragon Girl, but it didn’t take long before she was toppled from her throne, captured by an old monster from the Tongxuan Realm, who was particularly lewd and scheming, and most crucially, possessed an Emperor’s Artifact.
“If you don’t take action, Ancestor will,” Han Li said as he licked her face with his tongue.
Long Yue’s delicate body went completely rigid.

chapters.title: Chapter 315: 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Chapter 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_1
“Stop, stop, stop~ We can talk this over, no need for this,”
Long Yue forcibly suppressed the revulsion in her heart, speaking feebly.
Feeling the warm and firm chest behind her, the large hands caressing her abdomen, the face that was almost pressed against her pretty face… Long Yue was in a panic, yet she forced herself to appear calm.
In her previous life, she was a Jiao Saint of the Saintly Abyss Realm, overlooking the Eight Hundred Divine Regions. In this life, however, she had fallen to such a state, the intense contrast piercing Long Yue’s cultivation heart.
She, the former Jiao Saint, was now like meat on a chopping board, to be sliced at will, manipulated casually by this person.
“There’s nothing to discuss.”
Old Ancestor Han Li had weathered great ups and downs; he could strive for towering peaks, but also linger in secluded valleys, his vision vast.
“Stop!”
“You must not bully the dragon too far…”
Long Yue’s delicate body trembled, waves of intense, strange sensations coming over her, filling her with shame, her face cold as frost, her killing intent sharp.
“If you want my Dragon Ball, I’ll give it to you,” Long Yue suddenly sighed, her tone filled with resignation.
Suppressing the discomfort in her body, Long Yue hurriedly began to prepare. As soon as the Dragon Ball was removed, she would pretend to give it to Han Li, but in reality, she would activate it, surely dealing a heavy blow to this man.
“Hah~ What’s the Dragon Ball to me?” Han Li scoffed with disdain; the bauble had never been in his thoughts from the beginning.
“What! Are! You! Saying!” Long Yue’s tone was icy cold as she spoke word by word.
The Dragon Ball was the fruit of her cultivation in her previous life, her most important possession, and an ultimate treasure in the eyes of countless cultivators outside, a great fortune and opportunity. Yet this man treated it as worthless, greatly angering Long Yue.
“You, a frog at the bottom of a well! If you could refine my Dragon Ball, perhaps you’d develop a powerful physique, and it may even be possible for you to ascend to the Saintly Abyss Realm in the future.”
“That’s all,” Han Li commented indifferently.
Looking at Han Li’s indifferent face, Long Yue felt like slapping him; her cultivation fruit, the Dragon Ball, just ‘that’s all’? It was a ridiculous notion!
Seeing Little Dragon Princess’s frosty face and her eyes filled with wrath, Han Li nonchalantly produced a Mutton Fat Jade Vial.
“The Dragon Ball may be good, but does it compare to Old Ancestor’s Divine Pills?” Han Li said calmly.
“It’s merely a pill; how can it compare with my Dragon Ball—Immortal Cultivating Pill?!!”
Long Yue hadn’t finished her sentence when she saw the Divine Pill Han Li poured from the Mutton Fat Jade Vial, exclaiming in surprise, her face showing a mix of shock and doubt.
She felt that the Divine Pill must be fake.
Such pills were extremely rare even in ancient times and very hard to come by. She had scoured the Eight Hundred Divine Regions for ten thousand years without success; how could Han Li possess it?
This was the Qianyuan Divine Province after the great catastrophe of ancient times, no longer the glorious past, and even the great Sacred Lands couldn’t produce such a high-grade Divine Pill.
“How about it? Can your Dragon Ball compare to Old Ancestor’s Divine Pill?” Han Li said coolly.
The Immortal Cultivating Pill was a Supreme Grade Divine Pill that Han Li had obtained from the treasure chest, ranking at the top among Saintly Abyss Realm Divine Pills. A single Immortal Cultivating Pill could create a Saint of the Saintly Abyss Realm, its effect enormously against the heavens.
This Immortal Cultivating Pill was just one of many items Han Li had gained over the past six years.
Putting aside the dozens of Heaven Rank treasures and not discussing the Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon Void Bell, each of the other thirteen Divine Rank treasures was incredibly powerful, able to bring endless assistance to Han Mansion and also to enhance Han Li’s own power.
The Dragon Ball, though valuable, was the fruit of another’s cultivation; once refined, it could easily affect one’s own path and require tremendous effort to deal with.
But the Immortal Cultivating Pill was different; a cultivator from the Tongxuan Realm could use it without worrying about any influence, and just refining it could increase their chances of breakthrough by more than fifty percent, its value immeasurable.
Even during the peak of Qianyuan Divine Province’s ancient times, it was very difficult for the great Sacred Lands to produce such a Divine Rank Supreme Grade Divine Pill, let alone the now-declined Sacred Lands.
Long Yue fell silent, gazing at the Supreme Grade Divine Pill, the Immortal Cultivating Pill, so close at hand. She was desperate to snatch it from Han Li. With that pill, her path in this life would truly be clear.
Thinking thus, Long Yue was about to erupt, ready to grab the Immortal Cultivating Pill at any cost, even if it meant sacrificing the Dragon Ball, the fruit of her previous life’s cultivation.
“Snap~”
With a flick of his fingers, Han Li released a beam of light from the Void Bell, which penetrated Long Yue’s body and completely sealed her Dragon Ball.
Long Yue panicked immediately—her Dragon Ball was sealed by the seal of an imperial weapon, and despite her numerous methods, she couldn’t break it.
She regretted it a great deal; had she known, she would have fought to the death decisively. Now she didn’t even have a chance for a final struggle.
Her Dragon Ball and that Supreme Grade Divine Pill, the Immortal Cultivating Pill, soon to be beyond her reach.
“Little Dragon Princess, you’re still too green to compete with the Old Ancestor,”
Han Li’s smile curled at the corner of his mouth as he gripped Long Yue’s delicate and flawless chin, leaning in gently.
Long Yue did not resist at all, letting Han Li do as he pleased.
To Han Li, Long Yue’s compliance only excited him more, as he thoroughly savored the Dragon Princess’s taste.
After a long while, Han Li finally let go of the Little Dragon Princess, satisfied. Just as he was about to take action, he saw that her face had turned ashen, and his brow furrowed.
“Keep going; why have you stopped? Don’t you covet my body?” Long Yue said coldly.
It was impossible for her to kill herself, and collaborating with this debauchee was even more impossible. Long Yue simply gave up, letting Han Li do as he wished. As long as she lived, she would have her day of vengeance against him.
Since she couldn’t resist, Long Yue simply didn’t. She steadied her heart and reverted to the demeanor of the Jiao Saint, her brows coldly met; the body was but a vessel, a skeleton of flesh and blood. Let this scoundrel defile it if he must.

chapters.title: Chapter 316: 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Chapter 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_2
Long Yue’s posture made Han Li feel somewhat uninterested.
Over the years, he had captured many high-quality beautiful female cultivators like Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Bai Keqing, and so forth, each with her own distinctiveness. Yet none of them could act like Long Yue, as if the body Han Li was toying with did not belong to her at all.
“Hehe~ I asked you to move, and now you dare not?”
Long Yue let out a cold laugh, her face as cold as ice, utterly indifferent, as if she couldn’t care less about her situation.
The way Han Li was acting solidified her belief even more; if she chose to resist, the man would probably get more excited, full of lustful thoughts. Now that she was confrontational, he lost interest and probably wouldn’t do anything too outrageous to her anymore.
“Ah”
As she thought this, Long Yue suddenly cried out in surprise. She found that the scene had changed, and her delicate body was flying towards a large bed.
“Any trick is useless against the ancestor.”
Han Li chuckled lightly and pounced.
That night was one of triumph and complete enjoyment.
The next day, Han Li left the sleeping quarters and went to a sub-peak of Chengsheng Mountain.
He named this peak Zaidao Peak, which also bore his ambitions, comparable to the likes of Chengdao Peak, Yundao Peak, and Enlightenment Peak.
There was no one in the sky above Zaidao Peak, but on the top of the peak, there was a pond only about thirty feet wide and long and bottomless in depth. In the center of the pond was a lotus flower.
Not far from the pond, a green ox was lying down, seemingly asleep, with a tempest raging just above its head.
The green ox was completely emerald green without horns and had only three hooves. It radiated light like that from the sun and moon, and its roar was as thunderous as thunder itself.
As soon as Han Li’s figure appeared at the top of Zaidao Peak, the ox opened its eyes and rushed over to nuzzle against Han Li. Han Li reached out to pet it, smiling as he said:
“Kui Yi, how do you like it here?”
Kui Yi was a Mythical Beast Kui Bull, born in response to the Great Dao of Thunder, naturally mastering thunder, with extraordinary power, and the cultivation of the peak of the Tongxuan Realm.
The ox, though similar in shape to its bovine brethren, was highly temperamental. It allowed no one to approach wherever it went, and should anyone unfortunate enough enter its territory, the Kui Bull would mercilessly annihilate them with thunder.
During a lucky moment opening a treasure chest, Han Li obtained the Mythical Beast Kui Bull and appointed it as the Guardian Beast of the Clan, protecting the Han Mansion and The Li Manor.
Normally hidden in Chengsheng Mountain, Kui Yi’s existence was unknown to others. However, should any enemy come to attack The Li Manor or the Han Mansion, they would first have to contend with Kui Yi.
Later, Han Li obtained another supreme treasure from a chest, which he planted on Zaidao Peak, and he stationed Kui Yi there to guard the treasures upon the peak.
The distance between The Li Manor and Han Mansion was less than three million miles, and Kui Yi could guard both. Its Divine Sense and speed were many times stronger than Han Li’s. It could instantly tear through space and appear anywhere within the range of its Divine Sense.
With the Guardian Beast Kui Bull, Han Li’s sense of security greatly increased.
He already had the combat ability of the Tongxuan Realm and held in his possession a Divine Weapon, the Void Bell. In the Qianyuan Divine Province, he was almost invincible. His only vulnerability was his family and descendants.
But with Kui Yi, a peak Tongxuan Realm Mystical Beast Kui Bull at his side, who would dare to act recklessly at the Han Mansion or The Li Manor?
Han Li had placed a Supreme Grade Sacred Soldier at Chengsheng Mountain, known as the Time-Sky Tower, located on Enlightenment Peak. In a critical moment, Kui Yi could activate this top-tier Sacred Soldier, and even a Saint at the Saint Abyss Realm would have to yield upon its challenge.
The Time-Sky Tower was a treasure Han Li obtained from a chest a year and a half ago, a formidable Supreme Grade Divine Weapon. Han Li believed its offensive power was not inferior to some Quasi Emperor Weapons.
This Divine Weapon was related to time. Should it unleash its full power, even a Saint in the Saint Abyss Realm would retreat rather than confront it.
Han Li placed it on Enlightenment Peak because the Time-Sky Tower had another function, its internal space flowed at a different pace than the outside world.
The Time-Sky Tower had five floors. The higher the floor, the fewer cultivators it could accommodate. The first floor could hold a thousand people, who would stay for two days inside, and only one day would pass on the outside.
The second floor could only hold two hundred people, five days inside, and only one day would pass on the outside; the third floor could hold fifty people, with ten days inside to every outside day.
The fourth floor could only hold ten people, a month inside for every day outside; the fifth floor could only accommodate three cultivators, where one year inside equated to one day outside.
Not everyone could enter the Time-Sky Tower; one needed proper authorization, with multiple levels of access currently divided by Han Li into five levels.
The first level was Han Li himself, the second level was all of his beautiful wives, the third level was all of his concubines, the fourth level was reserved for his descendants on the list for key training, and the fifth level was for Guest Elders and protectors who had made significant contributions to the Han Mansion. This level also required a review of loyalty, background, and other qualifications.
Each level represented the amount of time that could be spent cultivating within the Time-Sky Tower, as calculated by the time outside. For instance, the first level, Han Li, could stay in the Time-Sky Tower indefinitely, although he didn’t really need it.
The fifth level was a temporary authorization, only permitting a three-month stay inside, after which the corresponding privileges were automatically revoked by the Time-Sky Tower. The fourth level could stay for one year, the third level for three years, and the second level for five years.
The second, third, and fourth level permissions were permanent and would not be revoked under normal circumstances. Each entry required a certain interval before re-entering.

chapters.title: Chapter 317: 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: Chapter 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_3
Han Li took out the Time-Sky Tower, partly because with the Void Bell, the Time-Sky Tower was not of much use to him anymore, and on the other hand, he wanted to quickly develop the Han Mansion, allowing his beloved wife and concubines, as well as his descendants, to make rapid progress in their cultivation. The Li Manor would soon be merged into the Han Mansion.
With the supreme grade Divine Weapon, the Time-Sky Tower, the development speed of Han Mansion would surge by many folds.
However, the Time-Sky Tower, as good as it was, also had other restrictions. The level permissions were set by Han Li, and the Time-Sky Tower itself came with limitations.
Time spent inside the Time-Sky Tower was time consumed from one’s lifespan; those with a lack of longevity entering the Time-Sky Tower were courting death.
Moreover, the five floors of the Time-Sky Tower required corresponding cultivation levels to enter. Those not meeting the cultivation requirements would not be able to withstand the effects of the accelerated time on their physical bodies. Of course, if the physical body was strong enough, even those with insufficient cultivation could enter a higher level.
The first floor required the True Qi Realm, the second required the Gangyuan Realm, the third the Hollow Void Stage, the fourth the True Martial Realm, and the fifth the Divine Yuan Realm.
In Han Mansion, aside from Han Li himself, no one could step into the fifth floor of the Time-Sky Tower, their cultivations being insufficient. Long Yue was temporarily not in Han Li’s considerations, to be reconsidered when her heart returned to him.
All these thoughts flashed by, and Han Li then heard Kui Yi’s muffled, stifled voice, booming like thunder.
“Master, I’m quite content here, very serene. No one comes to disturb me,” said Kui Yi.
“If you’re happy, that’s good,” replied Han Li.
Han Li nodded slightly and looked towards the pond, his gaze mostly focused on the lotus flower at the center of the water.
This was a greenish-blue sacred lotus with twenty-seven blossoms and nine leaves, three sections of white lotus root emitting radiant light, vaguely circulating with various laws of the Tao, captivating to behold.
This was a supreme grade Divine Medicine, known as the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus—all parts valuable: the lotus flower, leaves, and root were all rare divine medicines—but the most important were the seeds of the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus.
When the seed pod of the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus appeared, it would bear nine seeds in black, white, red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, and purple—each one a top-grade divine medicine.
Top-grade divine medicine is something even the saints of the Saint Abyss Realm would fight fiercely over. Whether consumed directly or refined into elixirs, it constituted a significant fortuity.
A single seed could increase a saint’s cultivation by three thousand years within the Saint Abyss Realm. While those with lesser talent might not ascend a realm, for the extraordinary geniuses, one seed of the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus was enough to raise their cultivation by a minor realm.
If one could obtain the entire Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus and cultivate its seeds, their cultivation would skyrocket dramatically.
Most importantly, the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus was a sustainable supreme grade Divine Medicine. Every five thousand years, it would bear nine seeds, an invaluable treasure.
When Han Li opened the treasure box, the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus was already in this state, with lotus root, leaves, and flower all present, and the seed pod just beginning to manifest.
According to the system, this Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus would mature in another thousand years, and its nine seeds would be ready for harvest.
If Han Li did not wish to wait so long, he could use various heavenly materials, supreme grade spirit stones, or spirit crystals and spirit sources, etc., to expedite the maturation, accelerating the growth of the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus.
Glancing at those heavenly materials, Han Li was struck speechless; he simply had no way to find all kinds of divine waters, which were unsuitable for him.
Spirit crystals were the main currency of exchange between Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors and Tongxuan Realm powerhouses, more advanced than top-grade spirit stones, while spirit sources were the main currency among Saint Abyss Realm saints and Heaven Imperial Realm emperors, with the spiritual energy concentration and quality in the spirit sources being even higher than that of spirit crystals.
Yet, Han Li had neither spirit crystals nor spirit sources. He only had a little over two thousand top-grade spirit stones in his possession. Originally, he had three thousand, but he had given some to his beloved wife and concubines to aid in advancing their cultivation.
In the Qianyuan Divine Province during the Ancient Era, there were many spirit source mines, but they were all controlled by several Sacred Lands. There were many spirit crystal mines, held by various Tongxuan Realm powers and Saint Abyss Realm powers.
But the spiritual energy of today’s Qianyuan Divine Province was far less than before, much lesser compared to the Ancient Era. Not a single new saint from the Saint Abyss Realm had been born since, and the spirit source mines had long since vanished. Though spirit crystal mines still existed, they remained in the hands of the various Sacred Lands.
Without heavenly materials or spirit crystals and sources, Han Li had no choice but to reluctantly use two thousand top-grade spirit stones to cultivate the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus.
This pond, measuring about thirty feet in both length and width, was transformed from top-grade spirit stones. The water inside contained an abundance of spiritual energy. Han Li even set up a Fifth Grade Spirit Gathering Formation for the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus to provide it with pure spiritual energy.
“This won’t do,” he muttered.
Looking at the pond and then at the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus, Han Li’s eyebrows furrowed deeply.
The Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus he had obtained a year ago was already halfway through the energy of the two thousand spirit stones converted into pond water, and it was still about nine hundred eighty years from maturation.
In other words, a thousand top-grade spirit stones and the large amount of pure spiritual energy from the Fifth Grade Spirit Gathering Formation had only accelerated the growth of the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus by twenty years.
Once the pond water was exhausted, it would accelerate growth by only forty years, still leaving nine hundred sixty years until maturity—a very long time.
Initially, he had thought of cultivating it within the fifth floor of the Time-Sky Tower, but that had not been successful. The Time-Sky Tower couldn’t speed up the growth of the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus, and he wondered if it was due to the tower’s insufficient grade.
“If only I had a time acceleration formation,” sighed Han Li.
With a Time Formation set up around the Nine Revolutions Sacred Lotus, it could greatly hasten the growth of the sacred lotus, leading to its swift maturation.

chapters.title: Chapter 318: 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Chapter 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_4
But he did not.
Sometimes, Han Li would think about robbing them, snatching the Top-grade Spirit Stones, Spirit Crystals, and Spirit Sources, but ultimately, he gave up the idea.
Though Top-grade Spirit Stones were not as good as Spirit Crystals or Spirit Sources, their possessors were at least in the True Martial Realm. Moreover, there weren’t many forces in the True Martial Realm, and the Daqian Empire had only three to four thousand Top-grade Spirit Stones.
With his strength, Han Li certainly could have stolen them, but that would draw too much attention. If he robbed many True Martial Realm forces, let alone those of the Divine Yuan Realm, the major Sacred Lands would definitely take notice, and that would bring him a great deal of trouble.
Then, he might as well directly rob the Sacred Lands. Surely, there were a vast number of Spirit Crystals in the Sacred Lands, and perhaps there were even Spirit Sources left from the Ancient Era, along with various divine waters.
But that was just a thought. Although he possessed a Top-grade Emperor Weapon, making him almost invincible in the Qianyuan Divine Province, it was only “almost”, assuming that no Immortal Artifacts were involved.
If he were to raid the Sacred Lands, their Immortal Artifacts would definitely awaken autonomously. At that point, he wouldn’t be able to withstand them. If he were a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor wielding the Void Bell, a Top-grade Emperor Weapon, then he might have a chance.
Without full confidence, Han Li preferred not to offend the various Sacred Lands for no good reason. It was one thing to capture a few cultivators from the Sacred Lands, but to forcefully invade and attempt to steal their foundations would be to make mortal enemies of them.
After all, Han Mansion didn’t need the Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus for the time being, so they could wait for it to mature naturally. When his beloved wives, concubines, and descendants reached the Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm, if the Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus hadn’t matured by then, they would simply hasten its growth.
Han Li could take or leave the Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus for himself, as he preferred to reserve it for his beloved wives, concubines, and descendants, not needing it for his own rapid advancement.
Of course, if an exceptional situation arose, like a powerful enemy attacking and his cultivation not being sufficient, Han Li would not hesitate to use it directly.
After sighing, Han Li looked at Kui Yi, the Mythical Beast Kui Ox, and instructed, “Kui Yi, you must guard the Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus well. Once it matures, I will reward you with one of its Nine Tribulations seeds.”
“Master, rest assured. Kui Yi vows to defend the Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus to the death. Apart from the master, if any other being approaches with ill intentions and without master’s permission, Kui Yi will immediately eliminate them,” Kui Yi excitedly declared.
Han Li nodded and then vanished from Zaidao Peak.
Kui Yi was a product of the System and was absolutely loyal to him, but Han Li knew it was still necessary to offer it some incentives to prevent it from becoming complacent and allowing the Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus to be stolen.
However, Han Li believed such an event was highly unlikely. Chengsheng Mountain was protected by a super Formation, which was Han Mansion’s new Guardian Formation.
The new Guardian Formation, named the Nine Exterminations Abyss Formation, was of Divine Rank Top Grade, at the level of the Saint Abyss Realm. With this Divine Grade Formation guarding the place, ordinary Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm could not break through.
The Heaven Rank Formation acquired from the Da Qian Empire was still in place, continuously protecting Chengsheng Mountain. The Nine Exterminations Abyss Formation, however, was kept inactive and would only be triggered at critical moments.
Han Li wished he could keep it active at all times, but the foundation was simply insufficient. A Formation at the level of the Saint Abyss Realm consumed too much energy, primarily relying on Spirit Crystals or even Spirit Sources, which Han Li did not have.
The spiritual energy density in Chengsheng Mountain, Yonchang Manor, and even Yuanzhou was not high, relying solely on the self-sustaining absorption of spiritual energy by the Nine Exterminations Abyss Formation would not work.
While Han Mansion possessed the Nine Exterminations Abyss Formation, The Li Manor also had a Divine Grade Formation, of the same grade, called the Four Phases World Suppressing Formation. Its operational mechanism was the same as Han Mansion’s, not to be activated unless it was a critical moment.
After leaving Zaidao Peak, Han Li’s silhouette appeared in the sleeping chamber at Chengdao Peak.
To his surprise, Long Yue, the Dragon Princess, was not there. A sweep of his Divine Sense revealed that Long Yue had, at some point, gone up to the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Han Li had sealed her cultivation, but for the sake of combat, he had not sealed her physical body. Only with an unsealed body could she engage in unfettered combat. Otherwise, how could the fragile Dragon Princess withstand his body comparable to that of a powerful being from the Tongxuan Realm?
This morning, when departing, Han Li had not sealed the Dragon Princess’s body either. With Kui Yi constantly monitoring the two manors, if Long Yue had any thoughts of mischief, Kui Yi would suppress her in an instant.
The next moment, Han Li appeared beside Long Yue. Seeing Han Li, Long Yue couldn’t help but shudder.
This bastard was not as she had thought. Yesterday, she assumed Han Li would give up or wait a while before coupling with her. She didn’t expect him to swiftly take action.
Remembering last night’s events, Long Yue felt such hatred she gritted her teeth, yet her expression remained indifferent, deliberately putting on this facade.
“Dragon Princess, didn’t this old ancestor please you greatly last night?”
Looking at her ice-cold, beautiful face, Han Li let out a sneer, initially thinking Long Yue was seriously indifferent, but her body was too honest.
A mouth can lie, but the body does not!
Long Yue’s pupils contracted slightly, then immediately returned to her calm, indifferent expression, and coldly said, “Not that great.”
“Is that so?”
A sly smile appeared on Han Li’s face as he exerted his powerful aura to control Long Yue, carrying her back to the sleeping chamber.
The Old Ancestor Han Li embarked on another dragon-subduing journey, ultimately becoming a Dragon Knight.
Two hours later, Han Li and Long Yue returned to the summit of Chengdao Peak.
“How about it?”
Han Li looked at Long Yue with an air suggesting he was ready for another round.
Long Yue’s mouth twitched slightly, resigning herself to say, “It was alright.”
She knew that if she spoke sarcastically again, this bastard would surely want one more time.
Old Ancestor Han Li raised an eyebrow and once again unleashed his aura, carrying Long Yue back to the sleeping chamber for a third dragon-subduing journey.

chapters.title: Chapter 319: 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Chapter 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_5
Another two hours passed, and the figures of the two appeared again at the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Long Yue’s pretty face was red as the twilight sky, and without saying a word, she thought, “How can this bastard have so much energy!”
Moreover, she had already admitted that Han Li was incredible, so why did he take her back to battle again?
“How was it?” Han Li, the ancestor, inquired of the Dragon Princess Long Yue once more.
“You’re very strong, okay?” Long Yue said helplessly, her face no longer as cold as frost.
She really feared that Han Li would take her down for a fourth battle; the physical body at Tongxuan Realm was too strong, and her current body was still far behind, nearly at its limit.
Although Han Li did not harvest her energy or treat her as a cauldron for cultivation, such combat ability was also not good for her; she simply couldn’t withstand it unless she returned to her previous life’s form as the Dragon Saint.
She finally understood why that bastard Han Li had so many delicate wives and lovely concubines; a single wife or even a few would not be able to withstand Han Li’s conquests.
She had secretly seen Han Li’s delicate wives and lovely concubines when she arrived at Chengdao Peak in the morning, including the two peerless beauties she had seen standing beside Han Li before.
These wives and concubines had cultivation levels far less than hers, only winning by numbers, the highest among them being at the fourth level of True Martial Realm; it was Bai Keqing, the female Demon King she had met, who was probably captured by Han Li.
But now she understood why Bai Keqing was enjoying her time, completely opposite to the anger and sadness she had expected.
“As long as you’re willing to speak the truth, that’s fine.” Han Li coiled his arms around Long Yue, licked her earlobe, and whispered.
Although he still had desires, he made no further moves. He knew Long Yue’s combat ability was far inferior to his and that she was nearly at her limit. There was no rush; there would be more time in the future.
When her earlobe was licked, Long Yue’s delicate body suddenly trembled, a tingling sensation of electricity spreading throughout her body, making her uncomfortable although she had experienced it many times that day.
Taking a deep breath, Long Yue coldly asked, “Han Li, what exactly do you want?”
She truly couldn’t understand Han Li’s purpose. Was he merely lustful, craving her body, and that’s why he had captured her?
She would rather hope Han Li wanted her for her identity; after all, she was the reincarnation of the Dragon Saint from the Sacred Abyss Realm, or perhaps because of her past life’s Dragon Ball, which would be a tremendous opportunity for any cultivator below the Sacred Abyss Realm.
If Han Li had captured her simply because he coveted her body, she would find it very displeasing. Was a mere body really more attractive than her identity or her Dragon Ball?
Until yesterday, she hadn’t even heard of Han Li, having only seen him once by chance years ago, and had not taken him seriously. Little did she know, he was the most hidden figure in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Long Yue felt Han Li was too good at concealing himself, living under the radar.
A great being of Tongxuan Realm, he had disguised himself as a cultivator of God Refining Realm and with this identity, he wildly took many wives and concubines, seemingly throwing all shame aside.
Moreover, this great being of Tongxuan Realm was an invincible powerhouse with an Emperor Level weapon; with the ability to activate an Emperor Level weapon, Han Li was nearly invincible in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Such an invincible powerhouse, not belonging to Bai Yujing, Myriad Demon Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, or any other Sacred Lands, astonished Long Yue greatly.
In this era, it was simply unheard of for a cultivator not belonging to the major Sacred Lands of Qianyuan Divine Province to reach the Tongxuan Realm, yet, here it was, a reality.
Long Yue was extremely curious about how Han Li had earned the recognition of that Emperor Level weapon. She, herself, had struggled greatly and only managed to obtain a Quasi-Emperor Level weapon of lower grade, which paled in comparison to Han Li’s weapon.
Although curious, Long Yue did not ask. She knew Han Li wouldn’t tell her; it was his core secret, undoubtedly his greatest fortune.
Long Yue suspected that Han Li’s ability to cultivate to his current level was very likely due to inheriting from a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Otherwise, with Han Li’s lowly status and not belonging to the major Sacred Lands, it was impossible to gain applicable cultivation resources to reach the Tongxuan Realm. And these resources were not limited to Divine Pills and Spirit Stones, but included Cultivation Techniques and combat skills as well.
With Cultivation Techniques not high enough in grade, there is no way to achieve profound realms; without high-enough-grade combat skills, combat ability can’t be effectively improved.
“That bastard also has an Immortal Cultivating Pill!” Long Yue thought of the Immortal Cultivating Pill, her heart burning with envy and longing; why could that bastard Han Li obtain it when she had searched for ten thousand years without a trace?
“What do I want?” Han Li turned Long Yue within his arms to face him, looked at her beautiful face, and said indifferently, “I want to take you as my wife.”
“I believe with my status and strength, taking you as my wife wouldn’t be a disgrace to you, right?”
Long Yue was stunned by his words, and although she didn’t want to admit it, she nodded because it was the truth.
In terms of both identity and strength, Han Li was indeed higher than her, and by quite a bit. Even when she was at her peak in her previous life as the Dragon Saint of Sacred Abyss Realm, Han Li would have been more than sufficient as a suitor.
After all, Han Li had the Immortal Cultivating Pill, making it inevitable for him to become a Saint of the Sacred Abyss Realm, and with an Emperor Level weapon at his disposal, plus the ability to wield it, his combat ability dwarfed hers by far.
With the inheritance of a Great Emperor, it was highly probable that Han Li would reach the Quasi-Emperor Realm in the future—even if he couldn’t cultivate to the Heaven Imperial Realm or become a Great Emperor. A Quasi-Emperor wielding an Emperor Level weapon would be nearly invincible within that realm and would stand amongst the highest echelons across the whole Eight Hundred Province of Yuankun Domain, considering that, vast as it may be, there were few Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and even fewer Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals.

chapters.title: Chapter 320: 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: Chapter 184: Dragon Knight! Guardian Beast of the Clan! The Nine Tribulations Holy Lotus and Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue’s Homeward Heart_6
“You have reincarnated, and in this life, you are only at the True Martial Realm. Even if you retrieve the Dragon Ball, it will be extremely difficult to cultivate back to the Saint Abyss Realm, not to mention you have chosen a different path from your previous life, which makes it even more difficult.”
As Han Li’s words fell, Long Yue’s face darkened. This was also the truth. Although she had always hoped for the best, how could reality always conform to her wishes?
For instance, this time, she wanted to steal the Da Qian Dynasty’s Qi Luck Golden Dragon to nurture a royal-grade Martial Dao Primordial Spirit. The dream was full, but the reality was skeletal; she hadn’t even started when this bastard Han Li caught her and brought her back.
“If you are willing to be my wife, sincerely marry me, I can protect your cultivation path and help you re-cultivate back to the Saint Abyss Realm. That Immortal Cultivating Pill can also be used by you.”
Han Li gazed into Long Yue’s eyes and solemnly declared.
With his assistance, Long Yue’s re-cultivation to the Saint Abyss Realm would not be difficult. By then, he would have also reached the Saint Abyss Realm, and the foundation of Han Mansion would greatly increase. They could compete with the several Sacred Lands to see who really holds sway over the Qianyuan Divine Province.
If he managed to overthrow the several Sacred Lands, then Han Mansion would become the covert dominator of Qianyuan Divine Province. Han Mansion would welcome an era of explosive development, and his growth rate would undergo an earth-shaking transformation.
“Are you serious?”
Long Yue stared intently into Han Li’s eyes, her breathing becoming rapid, trying to ascertain if Han Li was deceiving her.
She knew the extent of Han Li’s power—and he even had an Emperor’s weapon. With his protection, she could basically walk sideways in Qianyuan Divine Province, and re-cultivation to the Saint Abyss Realm would be countless times easier.
Han Li was, after all, an invincible powerhouse in Qianyuan Divine Province, practically unmatched.
Moreover, Han Li had also offered to let her refine the Immortal Cultivating Pill, which was a divine, supreme-grade pill of immeasurable value. With the Immortal Cultivating Pill, her ascension to the Saint Abyss Realm and becoming a Saint was guaranteed. Merging the fruits of her two lives, advancing to the Quasi Emperor realm would also become much easier.
“You’re deceiving me, aren’t you? You yourself are only at the Tongxuan Realm. If you had the Immortal Cultivating Pill, you would definitely have used it yourself. Why would you give it to me?”
As she spoke, Long Yue’s pretty face grew even colder; she felt she had guessed the truth—Han Li was deceiving her.
After all, who would believe that a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse would give an Immortal Cultivating Pill to another cultivator they had just met simply to take her as his wife?
Han Li held Long Yue tightly in his arms and shook his head, “I can swear on the Oath Stone.”
At these words, a shock coursed through Long Yue’s heart. She looked at Han Li, incredulous and full of surprise, not knowing why Han Li would do such a thing.
“Why?” Long Yue’s tone softened.
Since Han Li was willing to swear on the Oath Stone, she believed him a lot more, and her mood suddenly improved.
So her allure was that great, huh.
A Tongxuan Realm powerhouse with an Emperor’s weapon, willing to forsake his own sanctification to protect her cultivation path and assist her in becoming a Saint, all to have her as his wife.
“Because you’re worth it,” Han Li said with a smile.
Long Yue’s brow furrowed slightly, she continued, “And what about you? Don’t you want to break through to the Saint Abyss Realm anymore?”
“Even if we become husband and wife, by the time I cultivate to the Saint Abyss Realm with a lifespan of a hundred thousand years, how many years will you have left? How long will you be able to accompany me?”
Long Yue sighed. This was still an understatement of the situation.
If she merged the achievements of her two lives, transformed from Jiao to dragon, her lifespan would explode, exceeding five hundred thousand years. If she then advanced to the Quasi Emperor realm, her lifespan could compete with that of a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
Han Li was already a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse. How many thousands of years would it take for her to cultivate to the Saint Abyss Realm? Would Han Li still be around then?
If possible, Long Yue too wished to find a partner who could achieve eternal life together, to support each other, but that was too difficult.
The Dao companion she was seeking had to grow together with her and achieve immortality together. Thus, aptitude, cultivation, and other aspects had to be roughly equal; otherwise, if one party died halfway, it would be an enormous blow to the other, and could even lead to the collapse of their path.
“Do you think I have only one Immortal Cultivating Pill?” Han Li said with a smile.
Although he really had only one Immortal Cultivating Pill, he could not reveal this to Long Yue—it was a core secret concerning himself, allow Long Yue to misunderstand it.
He could see that Long Yue was already moved. After all, Han Li had offered a very significant bargaining chip.
Having an almost invincible great power from Qianyuan Divine Province as a Dao protector and even gifting such a priceless Supreme Grade Divine Pill as the Immortal Cultivating Pill—Long Yue could not remain unmoved.
After looking deeply at Han Li, Long Yue sighed after a moment of hesitation and said, “Han Li, you truly have profound fortune.”
She was almost certain that Han Li had obtained the Great Emperor’s inheritance; otherwise, how could he possess two Immortal Cultivating Pills and an Emperor’s weapon?
“Thank you for the praise,” Han Li said.
After thinking for a moment, Long Yue said, “Since you want to protect my cultivation and help me recover to the Sacred Abyss Realm, then can you give me the destiny golden dragon of the Daqian Empire?
Han Li’s brows furrowed slightly. “What do you want that for?” he asked.
“I have a secret technique. If I devour the destiny golden dragon, it can help me conceive a royal-grade Martial Dao Primordial Spirit,” Long Yue explained without concealing anything.
Han Li suddenly understood.
“Is that possible?” Long Yue continued to ask.
“No,” Han Li flatly refused.
Long Yue’s expression turned cold, and she scoffed, “Is this your sincerity? Just a destiny golden dragon from the insignificant Daqian Empire, and you are unwilling to give it to me. You say you are willing to give me the Immortal Cultivating Pill to marry me, how can I believe you?”
Given that the Daqian Empire had no significant relationship with him, Han Li’s reluctance suggested to her that he might not even be willing to give her the Immortal Cultivating Pill.
Hearing this, Han Li gave a wry smile. “It’s not that I don’t want to give it to you, but the Daqian Empire still has great use to me. I need it to hide behind. The Daqian Empire’s ability to stabilize is also due to my manipulation from behind the scenes.”
Han Li continued, “It’s just about conceiving a royal-grade Martial Dao Primordial Spirit. I can help you achieve that without the need for the destiny golden dragon of the Daqian Empire.”
“Really?” Long Yue’s eyes lit up.
If Han Li could truly do this, then she was willing to become his wife, to support and help each other on the path of cultivation, and to pursue immortality together.
“Really. I can even swear an oath on the Oath Stone,” Han Li affirmed.
Although he currently had only the Tongxuan Pill and the Immortal Cultivating Pill, and no pill to assist in conceiving a royal-grade Martial Dao Primordial Spirit, Han Li was not worried. He was confident that it could be produced eventually.
All these were merely a matter of time.
“Very well, I agree, I, Long Yue, will from now on be your wife, Han Li,” she said without hesitation.
