chapters.title: Chapter 321: 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large for subscription)_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: Chapter 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large chapter for subscription)_1
“From this day forward, I, Long Yue, am your wife, Han Li.”
Upon hearing these words, Han Li’s smile deepened, and he couldn’t help but think of lowering his head to capture Long Yue’s soft pink lips.
But he didn’t succeed, as he was blocked by Long Yue’s jade hand.
With a smile that was not quite a smile, Long Yue looked at Han Li and said lightly, “Wait a moment.”
“I was too impatient,” Han Li said with a smile and then took out the Oath Stone.
Next, Han Li swore an oath with the Oath Stone, encompassing all the promises he had previously made and adding some details.
After the oath was completed, Han Li put away the Oath Stone, and Long Yue was stunned for a moment, feeling an unusual sensation in her heart. She withdrew her hand that was in mid-air and asked,
“You don’t need me to swear an oath?”
Although Han Li’s words were sweet, she didn’t really believe them. Without swearing an oath on the Oath Stone, everything was just an empty promise that could be retracted at any time, leaving her with no security whatsoever.
Having lived for tens of thousands of years in her previous life, growing from weakness to strength, transforming from a snake to a dragon, Long Yue faced tough challenges and countless life-and-death situations, and she had seen too much deceit and treachery.
Despite the sweetness of Han Li’s previous words, whether they could be fulfilled was a question, and Long Yue dared not take that gamble. She had seen and known too many female cultivators who had failed in such gambles and ended up in wretched circumstances.
Now that Han Li had taken an oath with the Oath Stone and even added many details, Long Yue felt very satisfied; her future was secured, and Han Li would not bear such a great cost just to deceive her.
Long Yue had been ready to swear an oath herself, and since Han Li kept his word, she wouldn’t go back on hers. A proud Dragon Saint would not do such a thing, but she hadn’t expected Han Li not even to give her the chance to swear.
Did Han Li trust her so much? Was he not afraid that she might have some tricks up her sleeve in the future?
Long Yue was touched by Han Li’s action. It felt like trust. Han Li indeed had sincere intentions in taking her as his wife.
“There’s no need,” Han Li replied, shaking his head slightly.
After a pause, Han Li lowered his head again, and this time Long Yue did not stop him, letting him claim her soft pink lips.
After a long while, when two blushes appeared on Long Yue’s exquisite face, Han Li finally released her and said softly, “I trust you.”
Han Li believed that Long Yue would not do anything to upset him and also believed in his ability to win her over completely. Seeing his practical actions, she would naturally gradually fall in love with him and fill her heart with him, just like Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and other women before.
Han Li never indulged in hollow talk. He always did as he said. He didn’t need to deceive to gain their affection and bodies; that was too petty.
“Perhaps I understand now why Bai Keqing followed you so devotedly.”
Looking up at Han Li’s handsome face, Long Yue sighed softly.
When she was captured the day before, she had seen Bai Keqing, the female Demon King, and had learned her name in the morning. She had been wondering why the female Demon King was so submissive to Han Li.
Judging by Han Li’s actions, even the beautiful female cultivators like Bai Keqing would eventually be moved by him, no matter how unwilling they were at first—who could resist when Han Li was so generous?
Even she herself had changed her attitude under his relentless pursuit, agreeing to become his Dao companion. Han Li’s attention to detail had touched her heart, filling it with subtle emotions.
If it continued like this, and Han Li truly fulfilled all his promises, she knew that she, the Dragon Saint, would be ensnared, her heart firmly tied to Han Li.
“You will too,” Han Li said, his lips curving into a slight smile.
“I’m not as easily fooled as they are. If you want to conquer me, mere physical bravery won’t be enough,” Long Yue said with pride on her beautiful face.
Although Han Li’s prowess in battle was exhilarating for her body, Long Yue would not easily submit; she had the pride of a Dragon Saint.
Han Li laughed softly, said nothing, and embraced Long Yue, then spread out her tender arms and placed the Mutton Fat Jade Vial into her smooth and bonelessly soft hands.
Long Yue’s delicate body trembled once more, waves of shock rippled through her heart, and she lifted her head to look back at Han Li’s face, her hands tightly clutching the Mutton Fat Jade Vial, at a loss for words.
She had to admit, she was moved again, with much of her heart conquered by Han Li.
Which beautiful female cultivator could withstand such a test?
In her previous life, no matter how formidable she was, she was now but an Emperor Wu in the True Martial Realm. Yet, Han Li had directly handed her a Divine Rank Supreme Grade Immortal Cultivating Pill.
For any beautiful female cultivator from the Tongxuan Realm who came forward, they would probably also fall, willingly becoming Han Li’s Dao companion.
The allure of the Immortal Cultivating Pill was too strong, increasing the chance of breaking through to the Saint Abyss Realm by more than fifty percent. As long as one wasn’t incredibly unlucky, they could almost certainly advance to become a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm.
For a beautiful Tongxuan Realm cultivator, this was the best gift. Being someone else’s Dao companion wasn’t a problem; if they were willing to give you an Immortal Cultivating Pill to help you become a Saint, their sincerity and true heart were evident.
In her past life, if a Saint from the Saint Abyss Realm had been willing to give her an Immortal Cultivating Pill, Long Yue would have been tempted, having searched in vain for one for ten thousand years.
But in the Ancient Era, Immortal Cultivating Pills were extremely rare, mostly out of reach for Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm and mainly in the hands of those in the Heaven Imperial Realm and Heavenly Immortals.
“Take it, and keep it,” Han Li whispered in her ear, and he unsealed some of her cultivation, allowing Long Yue to recover to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
To Han Li, exchanging a mere Immortal Cultivating Pill for the true heart of a Dragon girl was a very worthwhile deal. He would be able to obtain more in the future; one pill was not a big deal to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 322: 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large for subscription)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: Chapter 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large chapter for subscription)_2
In every aspect, the Dragon Princess was considered more important than the Immortal Cultivating Pill; this was Han Li’s belief.
Taking a deep breath, Long Yue forced herself to calm her emotions and with a complex expression replied, “Mm~”
Storing the Immortal Cultivating Pill in her Spatial Bracelet, Long Yue quietly nestled against Han Li’s broad and sturdy chest, her thoughts drifting away.
If only she had met Han Li in her previous life…
Long Yue silently contemplated in her heart. She started her cultivation journey as a tiny Snake Demon, practicing for thousands of years until she broke through to the Divine Yuan Realm and became a martial emperor, successfully transforming into a Jiao.
The first thousand years of her transformation from a snake to a Jiao were the most difficult moments of her life. At that time, she naively longed for a hero to descend from the sky, to rescue her and live doubly cherished with her.
But she had long since given up on such thoughts. Along the way, it had always been just her. If Han Li had also been born in the Ancient Era and become her Dao companion, perhaps she wouldn’t have been chased to despair and death by that Great Saint.
If only…
As Long Yue snuggled in Han Li’s embrace, lost in her thoughts, Han Li cradled the warm and fragrant beauty in his arms, his own mind wandering. The two of them stood atop the mountain peak, admiring the surging sea of clouds.
He now possessed Second Grade aptitude, and among his beloved wives and concubines, the highest aptitude was only Third Grade, possessed by only Lu Tianxiang and Bai Keqing.
The offspring he had sired with them in the past, those with the highest aptitude, reached only Third Grade, while some were even Fourth Grade.
Since his aptitude had advanced to Second Grade, Lu Tianxiang and Bai Keqing had expressed that they didn’t wish to have children for the time being. They wanted to make a breakthrough in their cultivation first, and Han Li didn’t force them.
He planned to wait until Sect Hierarch Xiang’s advancement to the True Martial Realm before asking for a child with her, to see if they could produce an offspring with Second Grade aptitude.
As for the wild and beautiful Demon Queen Bai Keqing, who had given birth to three litters with six children—four with Third Grade aptitude and two with Fourth Grade aptitude—she said she wanted to wait until advancing to the Divine Yuan Realm before having more children.
Having children would drain her vitality, and she wanted to advance to the Divine Yuan Realm as soon as possible, to achieve a breakthrough in her life’s transformation from a snake into a Jiao. At that time, if she had children again, she should be able to give birth to offspring with even better aptitudes.
Due to Han Li’s extremely high aptitude, the gap between him and his new offspring was vast, resulting in a very low benefit to his own aptitude. To advance to First Grade aptitude, even three years might not be enough.
He would need to find another solution, creating offspring with Second Grade or even First Grade aptitude. A single Second Grade offspring could enhance his aptitude by one-tenth, and a First Grade offspring could increase it by one-third.
Producing high-aptitude offspring would be difficult relying solely on himself; he needed to find a beautiful female cultivator with both high aptitude and cultivation.
Han Li had already set his sights on someone—Dragon Princess and Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
However, before he could take any action, Dragon Princess Long Yue presented herself at his doorstep, leaving Han Li no choice but to reluctantly accept her. Now, he was considering when to capture Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
“I wonder which Demon Emperor from the Demon Clan of Myriad Demon Mountain has been sent to deal with the affairs of the Xuan Domain? If it’s Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, that would be ideal,” Han Li silently pondered.
If it was Xue Yueqing, Han Li wouldn’t be polite. He would find an opportunity to capture her and discuss having children with her afterwards.
Myriad Demon Mountain was a sacred land of the Demon Clan. Although it stood at the summit of the Qianyuan Divine Province, Han Li was no longer as wary of it as before.
Six years had accrued a vast foundation for him. Not only had he cultivated to the Fifth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, but his combat ability had also reached the Sixth Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm.
In his possession were the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, the Dao Decapitating Sword, and the Top Grade Divine Weapon, the Nine Mysterious Heavenly Knife, which, combined with the Calming Chaos Sword Manual and the Sky Balancing Manual, could unleash tremendous power.
He also had the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, the Time-Sky Tower, the Top Grade Divine Weapon, the Sky God War Chariot, and a Divine Rank Supreme Grade Array Plate of the Celestial Extinguishing Formation, which he could deploy in a very short time to unleash unstoppable killing power, against which most Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm would not be able to withstand.
Once he got the Life-Prolonging Furnace out, combined with the Time-Sky Tower, the development speed of Han Mansion would enter a new level and witness a burst of growth.
He also had the Guardian Beast of the Clan, the Mythical Beast Kui Bull—a peak Tongxuan Realm powerhouse—protecting both Han Mansion and the Li Manor.
But most importantly, Han Li had in his possession a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, his strongest trump card.
With his current strength and foundation, as long as he did not forcefully enter the Sacred Land’s Dao grounds, what was capturing a Demon Emperor to him?
He was not at all afraid of the revival of the Divine Province’s Divine Weapons. Would the Sacred Land really pay a huge price to revive an Immortal Artifact for the sake of a Demon Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm?
That was impossible, for the consumption of an Immortal Artifact was far too great.
After the great catastrophe of the Ancient Era, Myriad Demon Mountain, in alliance with the summit of all stars, engaged in three major wars with the Human Clan, which depleted countless foundations. Divine and Immortal Artifacts were utilized many times, and by now, their foundation was no longer as it once was.
Immediately following the end of the Ancient Era, if the foundation of the Sacred Land was 100, and employing an Immortal Artifact required 1, the foundation of the Sacred Land had been greatly depleted over the eleven thousand years. It was now between 3 and 5, and they could no longer use Immortal Artifacts casually.
Unless it came to a life or death situation, or a heaven-defying opportunity arose, the Tongxuan Realm powerhouses of the Sacred Land would not use Immortal Artifacts, only Divine Weapons at most.
A Tongxuan Realm powerhouse equipped with a Divine Weapon could sweep across the Divine Province, only matched by other Sacred Lands. But the Sacred Lands restrained and checked each other, reluctant to engage in conflict lightly.
Gathering his thoughts and looking at the peerless beauty in his embrace, a satisfied smile appeared on Han Li’s face.
He might not have the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing yet, but Han Li had acquired a better Dragon Princess Long Yue.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was just at the Divine Yuan Realm, and her aptitude was likely only Second Grade or possibly First Grade. But Long Yue was different—her aptitude was very likely beyond First Grade.

chapters.title: Chapter 323: 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large for subscription)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 323: Chapter 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large chapter for subscription)_3
Cultivators of the Tongxuan Realm and above, as long as they are reincarnated and managed to unravel the mystery of their prenatal state and awaken their Dormant Wisdom, their talents from the previous life would revive, merging with this life. Generally speaking, their talents would become somewhat better than in their previous life.
If their talents in this life were even better, then after the merging, their talents would get another boost from the foundation of this life.
Those with First Grade talents have a relatively high chance of reaching the Tongxuan Realm and becoming mighty beings, but it’s very difficult for them to reach the Sacred Abyss Realm and become Saints. Based on what Long Yue revealed earlier, it’s very possible that her talents surpass even First Grade.
What lies beyond First Grade talents?
If he were to unite with Long Yue, would their offspring possess Second Grade, First Grade, or even higher talents?
Han Li was very expectant.
Up till now, he had no descendants with talents of Second Grade or higher; if such descendants were born, he would receive very generous rewards.
Dispelling distracting thoughts, Han Li noticed Long Yue stealthily glancing at him. Seizing the moment, he bowed his head and kissed her soft, tender forehead, laughing as he said,
“Yue’er, are you stealing looks at me because I’m considered a peerless beauty in this world?”
“Vain,” Long Yue said, slightly unable to stand this kind of address but still nodded her head.
Han Li laughed, very satisfied with Long Yue’s attitude. With his abundant experience, if the strategy were to be divided into five steps, he had already taken the second and perhaps even the third step.
Hearing laughter by her ear, the proud Master Jiaosheng lowered her noble head, her cheeks blushing, not daring to look at Han Li anymore, feeling somewhat flustered and disconcerted by his gaze.
“Yue’er, do you know what lies beyond First Grade talents?” Han Li pondered for a second and then directly asked.
Long Yue gave Han Li a sideways look, her mind stirring as she knew what he was thinking, but she still said, “This Saint certainly knows.”
“Then I implore my esteemed Master Jiaosheng to enlighten me,” Han Li replied.
He gently blew warm breath in Long Yue’s ear, then stretched out his tongue to lick her pretty face.
Long Yue trembled, the same place, the same scene, the same treatment, but her feelings at this moment were completely different from yesterday.
Taking a deep breath, Long Yue let go of some of the burdens in her heart and expressed her true feelings, saying, “Hmph~ Then this Saint will thoroughly explain it to you, little cultivator.”
Han Li pretended to listen attentively while Long Yue, with a smile on her pretty face, began to explain, “The classification of talents was common knowledge during the Ancient Era, and the methods to detect talents were also passed down from that time.”
“In this era, the vast majority of cultivators in Qianyuan Divine Province only know about the talent grades from Unclassified to Ninth Grade and do not have access to higher-level information.”
“This knowledge is intentionally sealed by the Sacred Lands; ordinary people cannot understand it, and only the forces with Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu at the helm may have some understanding.”
“However, I’ve heard that outside of Qianyuan Divine Province, in the other Divine Provinces of the Yuankun Domain, there are still those who have knowledge of such things, and in some Divine Provinces, there still exist Saints of the Sacred Abyss Realm, and even Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm.”
“It’s just that Qianyuan Divine Province is isolated from the outside world, and even Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm finds it difficult to traverse to the other Divine Provinces, as there is great unpredictability and risk, only Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm can do it relatively easily. Information from other places in the Yuankun Domain seldom reaches Qianyuan Divine Province.”
Han Li nodded slightly; this was almost the same as his guess. The Daqian Empire, a top force in its own right, knew nothing, and it must have been the Sacred Lands that sealed the knowledge.
But why could there be Saints of the Sacred Abyss Realm and Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm in other Divine Provinces when the highest cultivation in Qianyuan Divine Province in this era was only mighty beings of the Tongxuan Realm?
Han Li frowned and asked, “Are there really Saints of the Sacred Abyss Realm and Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm in the other Divine Provinces?”
He had thought that his strength was almost invincible in this world, but to learn that there were even stronger beings outside was somewhat frustrating for Han Li. His strength was still not strong enough; after cultivating for so many years, he still could not dominate nine heavens and ten earths.
In just a short time, Han Li had made up his mind that once his strength increased, he would secretly control Qianyuan Divine Province and not wander to the other Divine Provinces; life was far too unsafe out there.
With the Supreme Grade Emperor’s weapon, the Void Bell, in his possession, ordinary Saints were no match for him, but if he faced a Saint of the Sacred Abyss Realm who also wielded an Emperor’s weapon, he would be outmatched, let alone those Great Emperors high above in the Heaven Imperial Realm.
There was also a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm suppressed beneath Leizhou, which Han Li had not yet planned to investigate, fearing the possibility of an accident; he would wait until his strength further increased before doing so.
Long Yue nodded her head, then shook it, saying, “I’m not very sure myself, it’s just hearsay.”
“I perished over a hundred and forty thousand years ago, before the Ancient Cataclysm occurred. After that, my Dragon Soul and Dragon Ball were sealed within a Secret Territory, preventing me from knowing anything about the outside world.”
“Over a hundred years ago, when the seal of the Secret Territory loosened, I was able to escape and reincarnate into the womb of the Left Minister of Daqian’s wife.”
After pausing for a moment, Long Yue relayed an incident she experienced previously: “However, I suspect that outside Qianyuan Divine Province, there truly are Saints of the Sacred Abyss Realm and Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm.”
“More than a decade ago, before I left Capital City to head to Leizhou, I sensed a profoundly inscrutable presence spying on me, which gave me the chills. That being was stronger even than you,” she said.
“There is no such being in Qianyuan Divine Province, so it’s highly likely that it’s someone from the outside who later left Qianyuan Divine Province.”
Glancing at Han Li, Long Yue added, “Of course, that being could also be like you, a hidden great power of Qianyuan Divine Province.”

chapters.title: Chapter 324: 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large for subscription)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Chapter 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large chapter for subscription)_4
Before, she thought that aside from a few Sacred Lands, other factions couldn’t possibly give rise to a powerful being of the Tongxuan Realm, but after Han Li appeared, her thinking began to waver.
Han Li raised an eyebrow, he actually felt the first possibility was greater.
There was a vague guess in his heart, that the powerful individual Long Yue encountered was very likely looking for the Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm sealed beneath Leizhou, but he did not know whether that individual found him, nor the specifics of their objective.
Han Li knew his own situation and was also aware of the larger context of Qianyuan Divine Province, he was an exception and should not be generalized, Qianyuan Divine Province probably wouldn’t find a second Tongxuan Realm loose cultivator.
“Perhaps the Great Emperor suppressed beneath Leizhou knows everything about this,” Han Li silently thought to himself.
Even though he thought this way, Han Li still had no intention to seek out that Great Emperor to understand the situation, knowing that to survive, one must not possess an overwhelming curiosity.
“Let’s not talk about this now, Yue’er, continue talking about talent,” Han Li said with a smile.
Long Yue nodded slightly and continued, “The classification of talent has existed since ancient times, it was not established in the Ancient Era; it goes back to the Prehistoric Ages, the Primordial Ages, and even more distant times.”
“According to the legends passed down from antiquity, the higher the talent, the faster the cultivation speed, the greater the chance of cultivating to higher profound realms; if the talent is not enough, then one must make up for it with cultivation resources and opportunities, in the Ancient Era there were also some whose talents were lower but who ultimately became Saints and Emperors, and even ascended to immortality as supreme beings.”
“Generally speaking, those with Third Grade talent have a pretty high probability of cultivating to the True Martial Realm, those with Second Grade talent and First Grade talent also have relatively high probabilities of cultivating to the Divine Yuan Realm, Tongxuan Realm.”
“It’s very difficult for talents above Third Grade to break through to the Saintly Abyss Realm, the success rate for First Grade talents doesn’t even reach ten percent, the Saintly Abyss Realm is a major threshold, with vast improvements in strength, lifespan, status, and so on.”
“Above First Grade talent is the Immortal Grade talent, cultivators with Immortal Grade talent represent the potential to become immortals, the hope of transcending tribulations to achieve true immortality, with lifespans reaching a single epoch.”
Han Li thoughtfully nodded.
The classification of talent really did not come from the Ancient Era, but from even more ancient times, though the statistical data on talent and realm must have been collected by the Great Holy Land Schools of the Ancient Era, then spread throughout the world.
The gap in lifespan between the Saintly Abyss Realm and the Tongxuan Realm was ninety million years, indeed a significant realm constraint, no wonder the current Qianyuan Divine Province has no one cultivating to the Saintly Abyss Realm, as for the strength gap between the two big realms, Han Li was not very clear either.
When he heard the last sentence, Han Li’s pupils constricted slightly, between First Grade talent and Immortal Grade talent there actually seemed to be something amiss.
Cultivators with Immortal Grade talent have the potential to become immortals, whereas those with First Grade talent have great difficulty even cultivating to the Saintly Abyss Realm like Saints, there’s still a Heaven Imperial Realm in between, could something be missing?
With this in mind, Han Li directly asked, “Above First Grade talent, and below Immortal Grade talent, there should be others, right?”
“Can only becoming immortal grant longevity and not eternal life? And how many years are in a single epoch?”
Hearing Han Li’s questions, Long Yue sighed and said, “Becoming immortal can grant eternal life, but becoming a Heavenly Immortal only grants longevity.”
“As I understand, after cultivating to become a Heavenly Immortal, life expectancy reaches twelve billion nine hundred sixty million years, which is a single epoch.”
“To obtain eternal life, one must continue to cultivate, surpassing a True Immortal, advancing to the Golden Immortal above True Immortal. Only in the Golden Immortal Realm can one achieve great freedom, greatness, and eternal existence.”
A surge of desire for the Dao rose sharply in Han Li’s heart, his own lifespan was still too brief, not even eight thousand years, far from even a fraction of that of a Heavenly Immortal.
A Heavenly Immortal could live for twelve billion nine hundred sixty million years!
A Golden Immortal was eternal!
Only by cultivating to the Golden Immortal Realm, would he not need to worry about lifespan anymore, by then he could overlook the cycles of epochs, calmly watching the turns of the great world.
Seeing the expression on Han Li’s face, Long Yue smiled but did not disrupt his reverie, she too had longed for it when she learned of these things.
But in reality, she couldn’t achieve it, let alone cultivating to become immortal or becoming a Golden Immortal, she couldn’t even become a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm; she was just a pitiable flood dragon who had just stepped into the Saintly Abyss Realm and met an untimely death.
Only when Han Li was brought back to his senses did Long Yue continue, “As for your first question, whether there are other qualities between First Grade talent and Immortal Grade talent, indeed there are none.”
Long Yue was certain of her tone; in her past life, she sought to break through the Saintly Abyss Realm and become a Saint, and looked into the relevant information. According to the records of the various Sacred Lands, above First Grade talent was Immortal Grade talent.
Long Yue blinked, sensing something amiss; Han Li, after hearing this, not only lacked even the slightest disappointment or shock, but his breathing instead quickened.
“Cough cough~”
Seeing Long Yue watching him thoughtfully, Han Li coughed twice and asked, “Is Yue’er an Immortal Grade talent?”
According to what Long Yue had said, the probability for First Grade talent to cultivate to the Saintly Abyss Realm was less than ten percent; Long Yue in her previous life was a Saintly Abyss Realm flood dragon Saint, possibly First Grade talent, or possibly Immortal Grade talent.
Although Immortal Grade talent has the potential to become immortal, Long Yue had perished midway through, her potential had not had the chance to transform into strength.
At these words, Long Yue shook her head slightly, giving a wry smile, “How could I possibly be an Immortal Grade talent, even my First Grade talent was enhanced through opportunities.”
Han Li suddenly understood, feeling a slight disappointment inside, but it was also within his expectations.

chapters.title: Chapter 325: 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large for subscription)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Chapter 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large chapter for subscription)_5
Long Yue was able to cultivate to the Saint Abyss Realm at a young age and become a Jiao Saint, certainly having attained many fortuitous opportunities. In this regard, indeed, she vastly outperformed cultivators who had endured bitter cultivation without sufficient resources—without them, there was no way forward.
Han Li was about to speak words of consolation when he heard Long Yue say, “However, with just first-grade aptitude, I indeed had no hope of cultivating to the Saint Abyss Realm.”
Han Li’s pupils contracted as he looked at Long Yue, motioning her to continue.
“I reached the Tongxuan Realm before I was six thousand years old. This speed of cultivation was very fast among both the Demon Clan and the Human Clan. After becoming a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, I continued to venture out, seizing one opportunity after another, and it took me a mere nine thousand years to barely reach the peak of the Tongxuan Realm.”
Long Yue continued to speak, her face full of reminiscence.
“At that time, I knew that without fortuitous opportunities, I couldn’t break through to the Saint Abyss Realm by relying solely on myself. So, I traveled throughout the Eight Hundred Provinces of the Yuankun Domain to find just one Immortal Cultivating Pill. Unfortunately, even after ten thousand years, I did not obtain the Immortal Cultivating Pill.”
“Afterward, I gave up on that wish and prepared to venture into a perilous land. The land was extremely dangerous—a hundred Tongxuan Realm powerhouses might enter, yet not even one would be certain to exit alive.”
“For this, I prepared for ten thousand years. Feeling that I was mostly ready, I dared to venture into that perilous land. Trapped inside for thousands of years, I indeed had the good fortune to come across a great opportunity and condensed the Xuan Yin King Body, finally ascending to the Saint Abyss Realm and becoming a Jiao Saint.”
“Regrettably, I had just escaped from that perilous land when, without having had the chance to spread my fame, I was pursued and killed by the Great Saint who slayed dragons for three thousand years, dying within the Qianyuan Divine Province.”
At the end, Long Yue’s pretty face was filled with bitterness. She had survived the perilous land and obtained a great opportunity, only to meet her demise after ascending to the Saint Abyss Realm.
Sensing Long Yue’s emotion, Han Li embraced her tightly, wanting to offer her more comfort.
With the warmth of her soft body in his arms, Han Li couldn’t help but sigh deeply. Long Yue’s fate was indeed tragic.
Her cultivation to the Tongxuan Realm before six thousand years of age was equivalent to a member of the Human Clan cultivating to the Tongxuan Realm before one thousand five hundred years of age. Her speed of cultivation was indeed extremely fast, enough to be considered a prodigy even in the Ancient Era, let alone the current era where she would certainly be considered a top genius.
It only took her nine thousand years to advance from the first level to the peak of the Tongxuan Realm, but she spent more than twenty thousand years to promote to the Tongxuan Realm. During that period, she entered perilous lands where death was almost certain.
The most tragic part was that Long Yue, after much hardship and tribulation, had ascended to the Saint Abyss Realm as a Jiao Saint with a lifespan of hundreds of thousands of years, only to be chased to her death mere decades later by a Great Saint who slayed dragons.
After Long Yue’s emotions had stabilized, Han Li then inquired, “Yue’er, what is this Xuan Yin King Body you mentioned?”
Long Yue hadn’t been able to ascend to the Saint Abyss Realm for tens of thousands of years, but once she condensed the Xuan Yin King Body, she ascended immediately, which surely contained a huge secret.
However, Han Li had never heard of such a physique, and there was no record of it in the Daqian Empire. It seemed that even in the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, no one was known to possess that physique.
“The Xuan Yin King Body is a powerful physique,”
Long Yue said with a smile, a hint of pride appearing on her beautiful face before fading into sadness. That was all from a past life—now she had only a first-grade aptitude.
Han Li held her soft, boneless jade hand and then said, “Tell me about it.”
“Living beings have aptitude and comprehension, and naturally, they also have physiques,” Long Yue collected her thoughts and continued.
“Just like how most people lack aptitude and are just ordinary humans, the vast majority of people lack a special physique and are merely ordinary mortals.”
“Physiques are categorized as King Bodies, Emperor Bodies, and Immortal Bodies, and there are many types, such as the Innate Spirit Body, Supreme Bone, Thunder God Body, Star River King Body, Nine Calamities Immortal Body, Mortal Emperor Body, Taiyin Immortal Body, and so on.”
“Even with the same aptitude, those with a special physique have faster cultivation speeds and can dominate within the same rank in combat ability. The stronger the physique, the greater the enhancement. There are legends that some powerful Emperor Bodies and Immortal Bodies inherently come with Divine Skills.”
“A physique is a unique existence that may be innate or nurtured. Beings with special physiques often have both high aptitude and high comprehension.”
“With a King Body, it is much easier to cultivate to the Saint Abyss Realm. With an Emperor Body, one can aspire to cultivate to the Heaven Imperial Realm. The Heaven Imperial Realm is also known as the Great Emperor or Emperor Realm.”
“If one has an Immortal Body, even with first-grade aptitude, they have the potential to become immortal. And if they have both an Immortal Body and Immortal-Grade aptitude, the chances of becoming immortal through tribulation are much higher. An Immortal Body, that is the body of immortals.”
As Long Yue spoke slowly, Han Li’s eyes grew brighter, his doubts finally resolved, and he knew where to direct his development in the future.
Once he cultivated to the Saint Abyss Realm or his combat ability reached the Saint Abyss Realm, rivalling a Saint, then he should consider marrying a fairy with a special physique.
By joining with those fairies who had a special physique, there was a possibility of having offspring with a special physique. His own aptitude would rapidly improve, approaching Immortal-Grade aptitude.
At the same time, Han Li also pondered in secret how to acquire a physique. His current combat ability seemed very high, but if he faced a peak Divine Yuan Realm disciple from a Sacred Land with a special physique, he might not be able to win.
Born in a Sacred Land, such a rival’s cultivation techniques, martial skills, and weapons would not be inferior to his own, perhaps even better, and with a special physique, their combat ability would greatly increase.
“Yue’er, you’ve really opened my eyes today,” Han Li exclaimed.

chapters.title: Chapter 326: 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large for subscription)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: Chapter 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large chapter for subscription)_6
He had never known that there were such things as special constitutions in the world, thinking everyone was ordinary and only after becoming an immortal would one have an Immortal Body. It seemed he had been quite ignorant.
Constitutions were likely devised by the great divine beings of ancient or primeval times, as a means to enhance combat ability, strengthen one’s foundation, and increase one’s potential.
Otherwise, cultivators with the lowest aptitude would struggle to reach the Saint Abyss Realm, not to mention the Quasi Emperor domain or the Great Emperor in the Heaven Imperial Realm. While those with Immortal Grade aptitude could cultivate to these realms, creatures with such aptitude were scarce, a rarity among countless billions.
Han Li speculated that initially, constitutions must have been cultivated artificially, for the sake of advancing to the Saint Abyss Realm and the Heaven Imperial Realm. Over time, these artificially cultivated traits were inherited by descendants and thus became innate.
Of course, there might have been those who were born with them, as he was not very familiar with special constitutions. His speculations were all based on what Long Yue had told him that day.
“So, how are you planning to thank this saint?” Long Yue tilted her head and looked at Han Li with a proud demeanor.
Han Li blinked, feeling that something was amiss. This was not the Dragon Saint he remembered.
The Long Yue he knew was proud, aloof, indifferent to everything in the world. When had she ever shown such haughtiness?
This clearly indicated the success of his strategy, combined with his Dragon Knight Buff. Long Yue’s heart was gradually opening up to him, unwittingly revealing her true nature. Perhaps the personality she had shown before was just a facade.
Han Li lowered his head, captured Long Yue’s gorgeous, alluring red lips, then said with lingering affection, “Then your husband will help you quickly cultivate to the Saint Abyss Realm.”
“Rest assured, your constitution in this life is under your husband’s care. I guarantee to forge for you a powerful special constitution.”
“Pah, who’s your husband? Stop saying such nauseating things.”
“You yourself are but an ordinary mortal; and now you want to help me forge a powerful special constitution? Where do you get such courage?”
Disdain flashed across Long Yue’s face, yet her heart felt warm, and she found his sweet nothings rather delicious.
“Of course, it’s the courage Yue’er gives me,” Han Li replied as he gently stroked Long Yue’s smooth hair, smiling.
If he didn’t possess it himself, then he would rely on the system. He guessed that the system might offer such rewards in the future, probably requiring either a certain number of descendants or exceptionally talented descendants. He couldn’t wait that long.
Han Li had another method to obtain a special constitution sooner—opening treasure chests.
The Emperor Level bodies such as Wang Body and Huang Body were likely within this rank, and it was within the scope of what he could obtain from the treasure chests.
Once all doubts were cleared, Han Li spent time with Long Yue at the summit of Chengdao Peak, gradually conquering her heart step by step.
The two of them stayed for another two hours before leaving. When they descended, Han Li gathered his beloved wives and concubines, including Lu Tianxiang, Bai Keqing, Lin Yiwu, and Qiu Yueyao, and formally introduced Long Yue to them, without mentioning that Long Yue was a reincarnation of the Dragon Saint.
When the wives and concubines heard that Long Yue was a martial artist in the seventh heaven of the True Martial Realm, their reactions were mixed.
Bai Keqing smiled; she had met Long Yue the day before and was not surprised by her cultivation level.
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue showed some surprise. They weren’t surprised by Long Yue’s cultivation, but rather that their husband had so quickly taken another beauty of the True Martial Realm to be his wife.
True Martial Realm martial artists were rare enough, and beautiful female cultivators who remained virgins upon reaching that realm were even rarer—the last one was Bai Keqing six years ago.
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and the others didn’t believe Long Yue had joined them willingly. Among these wives, only Gongsun Yue was truly voluntary.
Their husband had only displayed the strength of the God Refining Realm. Beautiful female cultivators of the True Martial Realm, still virgins no less, would hardly take the initiative to give themselves to a husband and become his wife.
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, and the other beautiful concubines were extremely shocked; their husband was actually marrying a beautiful martial artist of the True Martial Realm. What then was his true cultivation level?
The husband was definitely a martial artist of the True Martial Realm, a powerful one at that, otherwise he could not have married a beautiful woman in the later stages of the True Martial Realm!
With this thought, Lin Yiwu, Zhang Yuyan, Fang Yousi, and the other concubines all began to breathe rapidly, their eyes hot as they watched their husband, Han Li.
No wonder the effects of dual cultivation with their husband felt so profound; they had believed it to be due to a powerful Dual Cultivation Technique, but now it seemed it was because of Han Li’s high cultivation.
Even though Han Li kept it from them, the beauties held no grudge; it was quite normal for they understood their husband’s nature very well—he was always low-key.
The higher their husband’s cultivation, the more secure they felt, and the better their offspring would be raised.
Han Li nodded slightly to these beauties. When he had wed Bai Keqing, he had introduced her similarly, albeit concealing some facts, openly declaring Bai Keqing’s cultivation to be at the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Now that his power had grown extraordinary, it was good for the concubines to know of his True Martial Realm cultivation. As for his publicly known cultivation level, he had no plans to reveal it yet.
He intended to find an opportunity to let the outside world know he had reached the True Martial Realm, only then could he seek wives and concubines throughout the Xuan Domain. The Daqian Empire was no longer sufficient for him.
His standards for taking wives and concubines would continue to rise. Those female cultivators who did not meet the criteria would be passed to his descendants. This way his descendants could marry more and quicker, further expanding Han Mansion and proliferating his lineage.
However, this required the right opportunity. He had to find himself a backdrop, like creating an alter ego for support, to deter other forces from provoking him.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large chapter for subscription)_7
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: Chapter 185: The Proud and Arrogant Jiao Saint! Immortal Grade Aptitude and Eternal Golden Immortal! Xuan Yin King Body! (Large chapter for subscription)_7
Otherwise, having advanced to the True Martial Realm so quickly, everyone would know that he had obtained a great fortune; they might then begin to have crooked thoughts about it.
If there were people behind him, other powers would be deterred from making careless moves against him, and he could use the influence of his backers to better take wives and concubines.
“Greetings, elder sister.”
Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiyin, Chu Yumeng, Zhou Zhiruo, and other beautiful concubines bowed slightly, their tones sincere.
They didn’t really engage in any serious scheming. Aside from dual cultivation with their husband, they would gather with close sisters or immerse themselves in cultivation.
“Welcome, sister Long Yue.”
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and the other lovely wives said in unison, smiles on their faces.
Even though Long Yue was of the True Martial Realm, she had married into the family after them, so she was their younger sister, and this had nothing to do with cultivation levels.
Bai Keqing was a True Martial Realm Demon King, and when she married into the Han Mansion, she also called them elder sisters. They had all been through this process.
Looking at so many stunning beauties, Long Yue felt somewhat speechless; Han Li was indeed quite amorous, on par with Li Feiyu from the Da Qian Capital.
Although she was somewhat flustered inside, Long Yue still said, “Greetings to all elder sisters.”
She remembered all the kindness Han Li had shown her, and since she had agreed to become his Dao companion, she would not hold back. It was just that this was her first time integrating into such a group, which was a bit socially frightening for someone who used to be quite solitary and always kept to herself.
“Yue’er, Xiang’er, Jiang Jiang, …, as well as Yueyao, Yiyin… from now on, you are all good sisters, you must get along well,” Han Li said with a smile, looking at his beautiful wives and concubines. Every time he took a wife or concubine, he would repeat this, never tiring of saying it.
This was to show his own attitude; Han Li did not want anyone to disrupt everything, causing trouble in his backyard, as that would be very irritating to him.
“Mhm~”
“We understand, husband~”
“Don’t worry, husband~”
Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, and other lovely wives and beautiful concubines responded in turn, none dissenting.
After introducing Long Yue to them, Han Li stayed a bit longer and then returned to the Li Manor.
Long Yue wanted to spend more time with Han Li but saw that he had left, feeling somewhat regretful, and couldn’t help but look at Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, Bai Keqing, and the other beautiful wives of Han Li.
“Elder Sisters, where is Han Li going?”
Despite the awkwardness in her heart, Long Yue still asked the question. It was her first time calling someone “elder sister,” and there were so many of them.
Bai Keqing came over, wanting to take Long Yue’s hand but then gave up on the idea, feeling somewhat apprehensive because she had been badly beaten by her before.
After a moment of thought, Long Yue took the initiative to grasp Bai Keqing’s hand. She smiled and said, “Elder sister Bai, I hope you don’t mind that I injured you before.”
Bai Keqing replied with a smile, “Where’s that coming from, sister Long? I should be thanking you.”
Bai Keqing had her apprehensions, but she bore no grudge against Long Yue. In the past, she had tried to steal Long Yue’s Dragon Ball and being defeated due to her own lack of strength was only to be expected.
She even felt somewhat grateful to Long Yue. Had Long Yue not shown mercy, she would have died in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm. She knew that Long Yue had the power to suppress all nine of them—True Martial Realm warriors of Emperor Wu’s caliber.
Bai Keqing was very pleased that Long Yue was taking the initiative to mend their relationship. She wanted to form a united front with Long Yue to withstand Han Li’s conquests together.
“Husband went to the Li Manor,” Bai Keqing explained.
“The Li Manor?”
Long Yue raised an eyebrow, quickly coming to a realization. So the elderly concubine collector from the Da Qian Capital was one of Han Li’s identities.
Long Yue felt somewhat helpless inside. How many identities did this scoundrel have? He truly was flagrantly shameless.
Thinking about Han Li having a whole host of lovely wives and beautiful concubines in the Li Manor gave Long Yue a bit of a headache.
With a sigh, Long Yue stopped dwelling on these matters, as it was unnecessary.
Han Li’s beloved wives and numerous concubines might abound, but with their limited talents and lower realms, they will not be able to accompany Han Li for long; ultimately, it will still be her at Han Li’s side.
In the Da Qian Capital City, within The Li Manor.
Han Li made a round inside and then gathered Xue Qingyi, Chu Xianlin, Song Zhixuan, and other beautiful wives to share a decision with them.
“Yier, Chuchu, Xuaner… in about three years, I’m going to merge The Li Manor into the Han Mansion; you all should start preparing early.”
Han Li had been considering for a while when to unite the two manors, and finally, he decided on three years later.
By that time, the total number of his descendants, as well as those with talents, should break through three thousand and two thousand, respectively. His power would have grown tremendously, and the merging of the two manors would no longer be a concern.
After merging the manors, Han Li was ready to send his descendants to various places in the Xuan Domain to establish branches of the Han Family, marrying and bringing in many wives and concubines.
Before that, he would fabricate a vestige background to support his descendants in traveling throughout the Xuan Domain, to act as a pillar for them, making it less likely for cultivators and powers to cause them trouble.
If need be, by then, he would make an example out of some to deter those cultivators and powers with ulterior motives.
“So soon?”
“Husband, isn’t this too early…”
“Husband, why wait three more years? I can hardly wait.”
One by one, the beautiful wives expressed their views, some wanting to move to the Han Mansion sooner, some preferring later, and others indifferent.
Two years ago, Han Li had already informed all his beautiful wives about the situation of Han Mansion. They were somewhat surprised to learn about Han Li’s other identity, but they said nothing.
After all, they were already bound to Han Li. Whatever their husband desired would be fine with them, whether it was the Han Mansion or The Li Manor; to them, it was much the same. What mattered was the person Han Li.
When they married into the Han Family, they did so with various intentions, but now, they all shared the same goal: to stay forever by their husband’s side.
Over the years, through dual cultivation with their husband, they truly gained immense benefits. Those with lower realms progressed by several Big Realms, and those with higher realms even ascended successively to the Hollow Void Stage and the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
“Prepare yourselves,” said Han Li with a nod.
Xue Qingyi, Song Zhixuan, and Chu Xianlin, among other beautiful wives, nodded in response; no matter what they thought, they would comply with their husband’s decision.
Three days later, Han Li held a grand wedding ceremony at Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion, inviting forces from all sides to attend.
This time, the various powers from Yonchang Manor came to show their support, with high-ranking members from every power present, bringing precious gifts as congratulations.
Although they were curious about the identity of the Han Family patriarch’s new wife, they tactfully refrained from asking and had no intention to probe, which suited everyone just fine.
The patriarch of the Han Family hadn’t taken a wife in six years and had only taken twelve concubines over the past six years. This brought relief to the various powers.
The Han Mansion had always kept its promises, allowing the various forces to develop well within Yonchang Manor. Looking at the rest of Yuanzhou and even other areas, one could see the powers beating their brains out in strife.
After the wedding with the Dragon Princess, Long Yue, she officially became Han Li’s wife.
On their wedding night, Han Li and Long Yue were relentless in their encounter, which was fiercely intense.
That night, Long Yue tasted the benefits of dual cultivation. She found its advantages so significant that she clung to Han Li, demanding to dual cultivate for several days on end.
On the fifth day after the wedding, Han Li, along with a still-keen Long Yue and Bai Keqing, opened the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain and entered it.
