chapters.content:
Chapter 328: Chapter 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, Let’s Have Another Child! (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_1
Outside the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li, Long Yue, and Bai Keqing stood there.
“Is there really a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon inside?”
Bai Keqing’s eyes burned with fervor. She had never seen a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon before, which was the pinnacle of Shengyuan Realm Weapons. Even the Demon Kings in Myriad Demon Mountain didn’t possess one, only behemoths of the Tongxuan Realm could truly command such weapons.
Had not her husband told her, she could never have imagined that Chengsheng Mountain actually concealed a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon.
“Over a hundred thousand years ago, the ancient Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace was owned by the Nine Solar Heavens, the foremost sacred land in the Crimson Divine State. It’s said that it was shattered during the catastrophe of ancient times, and I never thought it would end up in the Qianyuan Divine Province.”
Long Yue looked at Han Li, her tone equally astonished. Her dao companion’s luck seemed too great.
Having received the Great Emperor’s inheritance and recognized by an Emperor Level Divine Weapon, possessing two Immortal Cultivating Pills and treasures beyond her knowledge, he even managed to locate the Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace, lost for over a hundred thousand years – truly a person of great fortune.
No wonder Han Li had chosen to settle Han Mansion on the spiritually sparse Chengsheng Mountain in Yuanzhou, where the spiritual energy was much lower than in other provinces. It must have been because of the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
“Of course there is. I entered it a few years ago and saw that the Life-Prolonging Furnace was still under repair, so I backed out. Now that I think about it, the furnace must be almost fully repaired by now.”
Han Li said with a smile. He swiped his hand at a special node, splitting open space, and a large gate appeared.
Six years ago, he had needed his strongest attacks just to open a crack to the secret territory. Now, he casually constructed a portal to the realm.
“Let’s go.”
Han Li, with his left arm wrapped around Long Yue and his right around Bai Keqing, entered the Secret Territory with poised grace. His Divine Yuan surged forth, protecting the two women from the chaotic flow of the void.
With a single step, the world changed, and the three of them entered the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li looked toward the center of the realm, where the Life-Prolonging Furnace still stood, its body still bearing a fist-sized hole.
“It really is the Life-Prolonging Furnace,” muttered Long Yue, gazing at the furnace suspended in the central firmament.
She had seen illustrations of the furnace before and recognized its appearance. Although the furnace was now damaged, its overall shape and spiritual essence remained unchanged.
“Is this the ancient Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace?” Bai Keqing’s eyes twinkled, her enchantingly beautiful face filled with curiosity.
She too had heard many legends about the Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace and did not expect that today she would actually see this ancient treasure.
“Do you want to try it? You might even gain the furnace’s recognition,” Han Li suggested with a sly smile.
Before, when he was not strong enough, the furnace had scared him off, but now he feared nothing. His entire demeanor was different, exuding a calm confidence.
He already possessed numerous Divine Rank Supreme treasures, including Divine Medicine, Divine Formations, Divine Weapons, Divine Pills, and so on, with two Supreme Grade Divine Weapons in his hands.
One was the Dao Decapitating Sword, and the other was the Time-Sky Tower.
Moreover, he also had a Supreme Grade Emperor Level weapon, the Void Bell. Even at its peak, the Life-Prolonging Furnace would only be subdued by him.
Although the Life-Prolonging Furnace was an ancient treasure, it was of little use to him. Han Li’s visit was also for the sake of his family; his beloved wives and concubines, along with his thousands of descendents, all needed the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
“Try it?”
Long Yue and Bai Keqing seemed eager at the suggestion – after all, this was the ancient Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace, and it would be false to claim they weren’t moved.
“Forget it, I’m not powerful enough. It’s unlikely that the furnace will recognize me. I don’t want to get beaten up. Long Yue, your strength is greater, you should give it a try,” Bai Keqing sighed and said to her husband Han Li and Long Yue.
Her husband had already been a Divine Yuan Realm powerhouse six years ago and couldn’t gain the furnace’s recognition. She, a mid-stage warrior of the True Martial Realm, would just be delivering herself to be thrashed. It would be embarrassing to be beaten into a sorry state,
As for what her husband had said earlier, Bai Keqing simply ignored it. She knew him well; there was no such thing as seeing the furnace still repairing and retreating on his own accord – most likely, he couldn’t beat it, unable to gain the furnace’s recognition.
Otherwise, her husband would have taken it long ago, why wait until now?
“Then I’ll go,” said Long Yue, looking at Han Li, who gave a slight nod. With him present, there would be no accidents.
After getting Han Li’s signal, Long Yue promptly approached the Life-Prolonging Furnace, her expression gradually turning solemn. She knew it would be difficult to gain the recognition of such a Grand Saint Soldier, especially with her insufficient cultivation level.
At the center of the secret territory, within the Life-Prolonging Furnace, divine light shone brilliantly.
The silver-haired and silver-gowned little girl, Yin Ling, who looked sculpted from jade, was observing Han Li, Long Yue, and Bai Keqing.
The moment the three appeared, Yin Ling noticed them. The secret territory was small, spanning only tens of thousands of miles, easily enveloped by the power of the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
She could see through the cultivation levels of the two beautiful female cultivators, but the handsome male cultivator leading them was enshrouded in a veil of mist to her eyes.
She recognized him; he had come in once years before, but she had frightened him into a hasty retreat.
It had only been six years, was it possible that he had advanced to the Shengyuan Realm, becoming a Saint that dwelt above the world?
Yin Ling thought it impossible; just six years ago, he was only at the late stage of the True Martial Realm. How could he have broken through the Divine Yuan Realm, the Tongxuan Realm, the Shengyuan Realm – the three Big Realms – in such short order?
Even those with Immortal Grade talent and Immortal Bodies couldn’t achieve this feat.
That meant he must have obtained some treasure that concealed his cultivation, preventing her from probing it.
But she was the ancient Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace, even if damaged, her essence remained unchanged. What rank of treasure could possibly elude her perception?

chapters.title: Chapter 329: 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, let’s have another child! (Large , please subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: Chapter 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, let’s have another child! (Large chapter, please subscribe)_2
“It must be at least a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, and generally, one would need a Quasi Emperor weapon to qualify, but can one acquire a Quasi Emperor weapon in six years?”
“Something’s not right,” Yin Ling muttered.
Watching the stunning female cultivator in a light-colored, dancing dress approaching, rays of divine light surged from within the Life-Prolonging Furnace, as she created mystical beasts like the Azure Dragon and White Tiger from the five directions.
“She’s also at the late stage of the True Martial Realm, I’d like to see just how far her combat ability can go,” Yin Ling snorted coldly, feeling somewhat annoyed.
Without even the cultivation of the Shenyuan Realm, how dare she covet her master? She couldn’t even stimulate one-tenth of her original power.
The colorful dress fluttered as Long Yue’s fighting spirit soared. Unafraid, she faced the five attacking mystical beasts and soared into the sky, engaging in a fierce battle with them.
Her Dao companion, Han Li, watched on; he would never let any accident befall her, so Long Yue could fight with peace of mind—something she had never experienced in her past life when she was like walking on thin ice.
“It feels so good to have someone to rely on.”
A thought flashed across her mind, and Long Yue moved with various gestures—sometimes sweeping her palm, sometimes striking with her fist, sometimes joining her fingers together as a sword, or using her palm as a blade—her divine light condensed and shattered the heavens, her momentum growing ever more powerful.
Facing five mystical beasts with the Combat Ability of the second layer of the Shenyuan Realm, Long Yue fought with grand moves, striding across the nine heavens. Supreme martial arts techniques came effortlessly to her hands, shattering the incoming attacks without ever being at a disadvantage.
Once she had reached the late stage of the True Martial Realm, her combat ability was already comparable to that of the first heaven of the Shenyuan Realm, and if she used some powerful divine secret techniques, her combat ability would rise even further.
Ordinarily, Long Yue would not easily use them, as they consumed too much energy, and she risked being attacked while weakened, but now she had no such worries and could fight to her heart’s content.
“Little sister Long is too strong,” Bai Keqing exclaimed, her eyes filled with admiration.
If it weren’t for her husband’s protection, the aftermath of the battle between six Shenyuan Realm cultivators could have severely injured or even killed her. Her strength was far inferior to Long Yue’s.
In the past, she couldn’t even challenge those above her level, but ever since she married into Han Mansion and was nourished by her husband, her cultivation advanced by leaps and bounds. She had also trained in powerful cultivation techniques and martial arts, and her husband had given her formidable magical treasures, raising her combat ability significantly.
Although she was only at the fourth layer of the True Martial Realm, her combat ability was comparable to that of a Martial Emperor in the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
If her husband hadn’t given her so much and been so kind to her, she wouldn’t have followed Han Li so devotedly.
“Keqing, you will break through to the Shenyuan Realm in the future too; just focus on doing your best,” Han Li said with a smile, pulling her into his arms.
“Mm-hmm,” Bai Keqing nodded, feeling confident in this regard.
Members of the Demon Clan naturally had long lifespans, and she still had seven to eight thousand years ahead of her. Cultivating together with her husband would lead to rapid progress, more than enough for her to break through to the Shenyuan Realm and become a Demon Empress.
“Not good, little sister Long is in danger,” Bai Keqing awoke from her sweet nothings with a look of urgency on her face.
In the sky, the mystical beasts Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, Black Tortoise, and Kylin formed the Five Elements and Five Directions Great Formation, and their combat ability rose sharply, reaching the third layer of the Shenyuan Realm. Joining forces, they made a collective strike that was close to the power of the fourth heaven of the Shenyuan Realm.
Even if Long Yue used a secret technique to boost her combat ability and continued to throw punches and palm strikes, she couldn’t block this attack.
But she remained calm and composed regardless.
“What’s giving her such confidence?”
Inside the Life-Prolonging Furnace, Yin Ling watched this scene and murmured to herself, suddenly turning her gaze towards Han Li’s direction. She wondered if the stunning female cultivator’s confidence stemmed from that man.
The three of them had entered the Secret Territory with great intimacy and were likely Dao companions. The stunning female cultivator couldn’t win, yet she remained cool and composed; was it because she felt that man would ensure she remained unharmed?
“Let’s see if your strength has improved,” Yin Ling said under her breath.
The Life-Prolonging Furnace once again burst into five rays of divine light, descending upon the mystical beasts surrounding Long Yue, causing them to surge in aura as their combat ability entered the fourth heaven of the Shenyuan Realm.
Then, the mystical beasts roared in unison, joining forces to make another strike—obliterating the aura rushing towards Long Yue, and shattering the very space they traversed.
Long Yue chuckled, standing with her hands behind her back in the heavens. Her dress fluttered, and her spirit soared, treating the incoming strike as if it were nothing.
Bai Keqing’s expression was anxious, concerned about the situation for Long Yue. The strike was clearly beyond what Long Yue could bear, yet why wasn’t she resisting?
She looked towards her husband, Han Li. Why was he also so calm and composed?
Bai Keqing knew her husband was an Emperor in the Shenyuan Realm, but she wasn’t sure of his exact level. She guessed that it might be the early stages of the Shenyuan Realm because he was at the peak of the True Martial Realm when he captured her.
But if her husband was only at the early stages of the Shenyuan Realm, how could he withstand this strike?
“Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, Black Tortoise, huh? I have them too. Let’s see which of ours is more formidable,” Han Li said with a light chuckle. He clenched his right hand into a fist, punching forward. His fist radiated a brilliant light, dominating the heavens and the earth, shattering the void wherever it passed.
The Azure Dragon struck across, the White Tiger roared, the Vermilion Bird danced, and the Black Tortoise trod the seas. With one punch, the Four Symbols Mystical Beast manifested, their imposing presence overwhelming heaven and earth with peerless pressure. In the blink of an eye, they passed over where Long Yue stood and obliterated the attack in front of them.
With a casual swipe, the Azure Dragon effortlessly crushed the five mystical beasts that were attacking with their fierce claws.
Afterward, the Four Symbols Mystical Beasts carried the momentum of subduing a great era, moving to suppress everything, charging toward the Life-Prolonging Furnace as if to press it down.
A few strands of Long Yue’s hair danced in the air as she sighed, “What a freak.”
Han Li had informed her of his real cultivation level, which was only the Fifth Heaven of the Shenyuan Realm, yet his combat ability was comparable to the great abilities of the Tongxuan Realm, and not just any but those of the mid-stage of the Tongxuan Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 330: 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, let’s have another child! (Large , please subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Chapter 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, let’s have another child! (Large chapter, please subscribe)_3
Compared to Han Li, her reincarnation as a Jiao Saint indeed fell short by a considerable margin.
“To not cultivate for past or future lives, but to seek invincibility in this life, to wander eternally without care? You truly have some capital now.”
Long Yue turned her head, looking towards Han Li who was embracing a peerless beauty, and admiration flickered across her stunningly beautiful face.
Han Li gave Long Yue a slight nod, then said to the gorgeous female Demon King in his arms, “My love, am I not very strong?”
“Mhm~” Bai Keqing hurriedly nodded, like a chick pecking rice, her beautiful face full of shock.
At that moment, she was no longer the seductive and bewitchingly charming female Demon King, but rather a tame and clingy little kitten.
Long Yue had just a bit of admiration for Han Li, but Bai Keqing’s admiration was boundless. The image of her husband in her heart suddenly grew incredibly grand and invincible.
The husband was much stronger than she had expected. Although she had never seen a cultivator from the Tongxuan Realm take action, she was aware of the records, and that punch was definitely at the combat ability of a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse. It even seemed stronger than the average Tongxuan Realm powerhouse.
Her husband was actually a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse!
Bai Keqing’s heart was hit by stormy waves, which took a long time to calm down. No wonder her husband was so calm and composed, no wonder he easily captured the Dragon Princess Long Yue, who was comparable to a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor, and Long Yue was willing to become her husband’s wife; no wonder the dual cultivation with her husband was increasingly effective, no wonder…
A Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, that was the ruler of a Sacred Land, standing at the very top of Qianyuan Divine Province. Bai Keqing was not very clear about other Sacred Lands, but she knew that Myriad Demon Mountain had only one Tongxuan Realm powerhouse.
Now her husband was also an ultimate powerhouse of this level.
The emotionally stirred Bai Keqing thought of many things in an instant, and a certain idea in her heart became resolute.
Since her husband was a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, she no longer had to worry about not returning to the Demon Clan and causing trouble. She even wanted to relocate her clan to Yonchang Manor, with all the high-quality and peerless female cultivators from her clan marrying her husband, and others could establish marital ties with the descendants of Han Mansion.
After all, her husband liked to procreate, and their race could reproduce very rapidly.
The Blue Serpent clan was matriarchal, with the majority of the clan being female serpents. Not only were there more females, but powerful individuals also emerged in abundance, and the high-ranking individuals were mostly female serpents.
Taking a deep breath to quell the excitement in her heart, Bai Keqing secretly thought, “It seems Xue Yueqing won’t be able to escape my husband’s Devil’s Palm.”
Thinking that the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing would also have to call her ‘Sister Bai,’ she suddenly became excited, a tingling current spreading throughout her body, flushing her cheeks.
“How is that possible?”
In the Life-Prolonging Furnace, the silver-dressed loli Yin Ling exclaimed in shock; that punch had completely altered her impression of Han Li.
Was this the same cultivator from the True Martial Realm who would run when he couldn’t win, so cowardly?
That punch was almost at the level of the fourth layer of the Tongxuan Realm!
It was too outrageous that, in six years, he had gone from the early stages of the Divine Yuan Realm combat ability to the middle stages of the Tongxuan Realm. Even those with Immortal Grade talents and Immortal Bodies, those peerless geniuses, couldn’t be much better than this, right?
Not having time to be more shocked, the silver-haired, silver-dressed loli Yin Ling turned serious and activated the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
Whoosh!
A divine light shot out from the hole in the Life-Prolonging Furnace, brightening the entire Secret Territory, illuminating the eternal night, colliding with Han Li’s fist light.
Boom!
The Vermilion Bird and Black Tortoise, the Azure Dragon and White Tiger, exerted their full power in this moment of fierce battle, but they couldn’t match that divine light, which grounded their fist intent to dust and evaporated it between heaven and earth.
“Interesting.”
“Little broken furnace, so you still refuse to submit, huh?” Han Li laughed as he threw another punch, shattering the remaining divine light, and spoke.
“Who are you calling a little broken furnace?!” Yin Ling was enraged, enunciating every word, her tone filled with dissatisfaction. The Life-Prolonging Furnace vibrated, threatening to fully awaken, its terrifying might instantly enveloping the entire Secret Territory.
Pushing the furnace too far!
So what if she’d taken some damage? How did that make her a little broken furnace?
She was the renowned Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace from ancient times!
When she was in the number one Sacred Land of the Crimson Divine State, the Nine Solar Heavens, her status was not a bit inferior to those Divine Weapons!
This person merely had a combat ability that reached the middle stages of the Tongxuan Realm; how dare he insult her so? If she were to submit to him, wouldn’t she be humiliated daily?
The furious silver-haired loli decided to teach Han Li a harsh lesson, to teach him a thing or two, to let him know how powerful she was.
Even if she followed him, it wouldn’t be out of submission, but choosing a wielder for herself. Han Li would have to revere her properly, offering her all sorts of heavenly and earthly treasures, to restore her to her peak condition as soon as possible.
Han Li furrowed his brows slightly and shielded Bai Keqing and Long Yue behind him, blocking the might of the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
With a thought, the Dao Decapitating Sword flew out, soaring high into the Nine Heavens, radiating dazzling sword light. The brilliant light subdued the Nine Heavens, causing the entire Secret Territory to shake and roar, ready to collapse at any moment.
It was the spirit of the Dao Decapitating Sword exerting its power autonomously. A fully awakened Supreme Grade Divine Weapon might not be as powerful as a Great Saint, but it could unleash the might of the late stages of the Saintly Abyss Realm, which was extremely terrifying.
“Another Supreme Grade Divine Weapon!”
Both Long Yue and Bai Keqing were shaken to the core, staring dumbfounded at the figure before them. They were moved, and at the same time, they wondered just how many trump cards their husband had hidden away?
Long Yue was more at ease; she knew Han Li had a true Emperor Level weapon. It seemed only natural for him to bring out a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon now.
Bai Keqing was the most shocked; such a weapon could dominate a Sacred Land and would be wielded only by a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse. Her husband was not only a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse but also possessed a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, equal to any ruler of a Sacred Land.

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, let’s have another child! (Large chapter, please subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: Chapter 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, let’s have another child! (Large chapter, please subscribe)_4
Moreover, my husband will soon obtain another Supreme Grade Divine Weapon.
Although the Life-Prolonging Furnace is an ancient treasure, it is ultimately damaged, its might only six or seven tenths of its peak power; it couldn’t possibly be a match for my husband’s Divine Sword.
“Did this guy dig up a Quasi Emperor’s big tomb?”
The Health Preservation Furnace Spirit, Yin Ling, was also stunned, now caught between a rock and a hard place, uncertain of what choice to make.
When Han Li displayed combat ability of the Tongxuan Realm, she had acknowledged him; growing so much in six years, in the future he would at least be a Quasi Emperor level powerhouse, maybe even proving his way to Emperor status and mastering the Heavenly Sovereign Path.
It was only because Han Li was too arrogant and assertive that she wanted to teach him a lesson and elevate her own status, to prevent him from underestimating her.
Yin Ling had not expected that this guy would still have a card up his sleeve, even bringing out a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, one that was willing to fully revitalize itself to serve Han Li voluntarily; no wonder he was so arrogant, calling her “little broken furnace” all the time.
Yin Ling wanted to submit, that Divine Sword was too sharp; its light cutting through heaven and earth, its aura filling the world, even piercing her protective divine light, burrowing into her body, filling her with rage and disbelief, and giving rise to a strange feeling – he didn’t do that on purpose, did he?
But after submission, her status would inevitably be lower; she hadn’t followed him from the beginning, and now that this guy had a complete Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, how was she, the broken one, supposed to mix in?
“Damn bootlicker~” the silver-haired little lolita in a dress fumed, pounding on the furnace wall.
If it weren’t for that Divine Sword being such a bootlicker, reviving itself to confront her, she wouldn’t have fallen into such a passive situation.
We are Supreme Grade Divine Weapons, Grand Saint Soldiers; can’t you act with a bit of dignity and not be a bootlicker?
The Dao Decapitating Sword stood in opposition to the Life-Prolonging Furnace, and the furnace was clearly at a disadvantage.
Bai Keqing and Long Yue exchanged a glance, both curious as to what choice the ancient treasure, the Life-Prolonging Furnace, would make.
“Still not submitting? Believe it or not, this elder can erase you,” Han Li frowned, a hint of displeasure in his heart now.
The Artifact Spirit of the Life-Prolonging Furnace was an old thing; was it choosing to be obstinately unenlightened, to resist to the end?
If that were really the case, he’d have no choice but to take harsh measures and annihilate the Artifact Spirit of the Life-Prolonging Furnace. Although it would result in a significant decrease in the furnace’s power, he could always cultivate another obedient one, like creating a little lolita Artifact Spirit.
He wondered whether the System was doing this deliberately; all the Artifact Spirits of his Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, the Void Bell, as well as the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, the Dao Decapitating Sword, and the Time-Sky Tower were in the form of little lolitas—each one delicately and exquisitely crafted; what a test for this elder!
Which elder could withstand such a test?
“Hmph~, think you can erase me? Do you believe you can?” Yin Ling haughtily snorted, believing herself not so easily bullied.
Even if she couldn’t defeat this Divine Sword, escaping was still no issue; with the vastness of the heavens and earth, finding her again would become difficult.
The silver-haired and silver-dressed little lolita’s face was full of anger. This guy really was domineering, calling her a “little broken furnace” and even threatening to erase her existence—it was bullying the furnace too much.
Yin Ling’s voice echoed throughout the Secret Territory; Bai Keqing and Long Yue didn’t think much of it, but Han Li raised an eyebrow.
What a find, wasn’t the Artifact Spirit of the Life-Prolonging Furnace an old thing? How did it change so quickly within a few years?
This voice, as clear as a silver bell and with a touch of arrogance, was likely a little lolita’s—similar to the Artifact Spirits of his other Emperor Weapons and Divine Weapons.
Thinking it over, Han Li’s Primordial Spirit Communicated with the Void Bell, letting it cast a strand of the Emperor’s Might to pressurize the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
“Alright, Master~”
The Emperor Weapon, Void Bell, was hidden outside the Secret Territory in the heavens, but a territory like this couldn’t stop an Emperor Weapon, which was frail before it.
High above the ninth heaven, deep in the void, an ancient bell floated, with Dao patterns inscribed both inside and out, each one harboring an unfathomable might.
Within the Void Bell, its own little world had formed, where a purple-dressed, purple-haired little lolita was playing happily with the Time-Sky Tower Artifact Spirit. When she heard Han Li’s communication, she immediately responded.
The Emperor’s Light from the Void Bell shone down, revealing the silver-haired and silver-dressed little lolita hiding within the Life-Prolonging Furnace, and she was seen by the purple-haired little lolita.
“Hmph, daring to disrespect my master, let me teach you a lesson.”
The Void Bell vibrated slightly, a strand of Emperor’s Might was unleashed, penetrating the Secret Territory, through the Life-Prolonging Furnace, directly onto the silver-haired little lolita, Yin Ling, feeling as though a great mountain was pressing down on her.
The visibly fuming face of the silver-haired little lolita suddenly stiffened, and her body trembled, powerless as she slumped to the ground. Her eyes flashed with disbelief: “Did this guy raid a Great Emperor’s tomb?”
With a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, a combat ability that skyrocketed within six years to the Tongxuan Realm, and now even an Emperor Weapon emerging – what Quasi Emperor big tomb? This is clearly a Great Emperor’s tomb!
Someone who received the legacy of a Great Emperor!
“Just knows how to bully others ~ wee~”
Yin Ling’s cute face changed from anger to tears as the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s aura dissipated and stopped resisting the confrontation with the Dao Decapitating Sword.
“Husband, what did you do to the Artifact Spirit of the Life-Prolonging Furnace?” Bai Keqing asked curiously.
Long Yue also looked over, guessing in her heart that it must have been Han Li’s Emperor Weapon that had taken action. The Life-Prolonging Furnace couldn’t resist and had been reduced to tears.
“I am just standing here, what can I do to her?” Han Li smiled helplessly.
He only had the Void Bell Spirit, Zi Yi, release a strand of Emperor’s Might. The Life-Prolonging Furnace Spirit naturally knew how to choose, but he hadn’t expected Zi Yi of the Void Bell to give the Life-Prolonging Furnace Spirit quite a shock.
Taking advantage of the power of the Void Bell, he had also seen the inside of the Life-Prolonging Furnace. Its Artifact Spirit really was a little lolita with silver hair and a silver dress—delicate and refined, not much different from Zi Yi of the Void Bell.

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, let’s have another child! (Large chapter, please subscribe)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Chapter 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, let’s have another child! (Large chapter, please subscribe)_5
He certainly wouldn’t blame Zi Yi, and in fact, Zi Yi didn’t actually harm the Health Preservation Furnace Spirit; she had simply caused it to fall over.
Long Yue and Bai Keqing looked incredulous. Just a moment ago, the Health Preservation Furnace Spirit was huffing with anger, and now it was crying. If it wasn’t you, then who was responsible?
Han Li smiled but didn’t explain, leading Long Yue and Bai Keqing to the front of the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
The Artifact Spirit of the furnace, Yin Ling, flew out, looking at Han Li with a pitiful gaze that made him feel somewhat embarrassed, as though he had bullied a little girl.
“So cute~”
The stunning and wild Demon Queen Bai Keqing’s eyes lit up. She reached out to touch Yin Ling’s head but retracted her hand sheepishly when Yin Ling gave her a stern look.
“You’ve won. From now on, I’ll follow you. Come and brand your mark inside me,” said Yin Ling, the silver-clad little girl, weakly to Han Li.
That fellow even brought out a Divine Weapon, what could she do? She had no choice!
If she didn’t submit, she feared this man might truly erase her existence. The might of a Divine Weapon was no laughing matter.
Although she had a status in the Nine Solar Heavens that was comparable to that of a Divine Weapon, her actual strength was far less, not even comparable to a Quasi Emperor Weapon.
Han Li smiled and gently rubbed her little head, messing up Yin Ling’s purple hair and making her look even more aggrieved. She couldn’t resist.
“Alright, stop with the theatrics. I’ll have that hole fixed within five years,” he said.
“Really?”
Yin Ling exclaimed with delight, her face devoid of any trace of grievance, not even minding her disheveled hair anymore.
During the ancient calamity, the Nine Solar Heavens were destroyed, and the Celestial Weapons there shattered. Even the Divine Weapons broke for the most part. She had merely been affected by the residual waves of the residual waves, and a large part of her body had shattered.
Afterward, she hid in this place in the Qianyuan Divine Province and exhausted her efforts to create a small secret territory, using the Life-Prolonging Furnace as support, absorbing Spiritual Energy to heal her wounds.
As she gradually recovered, she also slowly expanded the secret territory, increasing the speed at which she absorbed Spiritual Energy.
But the repair of her wounds solely through Spiritual Energy was too slow. After a hundred and ten thousand years, she had only managed to repair most of her wounds, with one large hole left unrepaired.
At her own rate of absorbing Spiritual Energy, it might take tens of thousands of years to complete the repair, and she didn’t want to wait that long. She had longed to venture out and see the world, but she didn’t dare to take the risk.
“Of course it’s true,” Han Li said.
While speaking, he channeled his True Yuan into the Supreme Life Nurturing Furnace, branding his own mark in its core area and truly taking control of the furnace.
After doing so, he noticed that this little silver-haired girl was also affected by the branding, with his mark appearing within her as well.
Old Ancestor Han couldn’t help but exclaim, what had he done to this silver-haired little girl?
The Artifact Spirits of the previous Void Bell, Dao Decapitating Sword, and Time-Sky Tower had all been refined as a reward, and he hadn’t felt this sensation, but now it felt rather peculiar.
He seemed to have become a true Artifact Refining Ancestor!
“Master is so kind,” Yin Ling sweetly called out, her attitude turning a sharp corner.
Seeing Long Yue and Bai Keqing, his two beautiful wives, eyeing him with strange looks, Han Li quickly said, “Let’s go.”
“Master, wait~” Seeing that Han Li was about to put away the Life-Prolonging Furnace, Yin Ling hurriedly called out.
“What is it, Yin Ling?” After refining the Life-Prolonging Furnace, Han Li learned the name of the little silver-haired girl and asked in confusion.
“Don’t you want this secret territory?” asked Yin Ling.
Han Li’s eyebrows raised, realizing what she meant.
This secret territory existed only by relying on the Life-Prolonging Furnace; if the furnace was taken away by him, the territory would likely collapse soon.
The secret territory formed by the Life-Prolonging Furnace was not small, spanning tens of thousands of miles, with abundant Spiritual Energy – much higher than that of Chengsheng Mountain. Here, one’s cultivation speed would improve by many times.
Naturally, Han Li was reluctant to let it collapse and planned to leave it for the Han Mansion; a powerful family without a secret territory was unthinkable, for it was part of the family’s heritage.
“Luckily you reminded me,” Han Li said, patting the little silver-haired girl’s head. Then he turned to Bai Keqing and Long Yue, “Yue’er, Keqing, please wait a moment.”
He tried to separate the Life-Prolonging Furnace while still maintaining the existence of the secret territory. If unsuccessful, he would have to consider placing either the Nine Mysterious Heavenly Knife or the Sky God War Chariot here instead.
Oh right, he should use the Chongming Palace; that Lower Grade Divine Weapon was somewhat insignificant now. Its speed was much inferior compared to the Sky God War Chariot, and it didn’t have the impressive aura of the war chariot either.
After maneuvering for a while, Han Li successfully separated the Life-Prolonging Furnace, and the secret territory remained fairly stable, quickly settling down.
With his strength, added to his proficiency in Formation and Talisman Making, such tasks were relatively easy and enjoyable.
After giving it some thought, Han Li still left the Chongming Palace there, using it to serve as the core of a Fourth Grade Spirit Converging Formation. With a Lower Grade Divine Weapon as the formation’s center, the power of the Spirit Gathering Array could be enhanced.
Then, Han Li connected the Nine Extermination Abyssal Formation with the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain. From then on, the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain would supply energy to the Nine Extermination Abyssal Formation, and in turn, the formation would protect the secret realm, preventing it from being attacked and collapsing.
“All done.” He let out a breath, a smile appearing on Han Li’s face.
Bai Keqing, Long Yue, and Yin Ling all showed surprised expressions; they hadn’t expected their husband, their master, to know so much, to have such high attainments in Formation and Talisman Making, and to have even higher cultivation and combat ability. How did he manage to cultivate like this?
Han Li smiled and with a thought, the Dao Decapitating Sword and the Life-Prolonging Furnace were stored within him. He then left the secret territory, affectionately embracing Bai Keqing and Long Yue on either side.

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, let's have another child! (Large chapter, please subscribe)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 333  - 186: Subduing the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Emperor Rank Pills! Husband, let's have another child! (Large chapter, please subscribe)_6
After leaving, Han Li stabilized the entrance to the Secret Territory by setting up arrays to reinforce it, ensuring stable access from then on, eliminating the need to open a rift in the void at that specific node to break through.
In the following two months, Han Li once again lived a leisurely life of an immortal, spending each day either dual cultivating or on his way to dual cultivate, shuttling back and forth between Han Mansion and The Li Manor.
Only with his current formidable strength could he instantly travel between Han Mansion and The Li Manor; otherwise, he would have been too busy to manage everything.
After two months of battle, Patriarch Han still hadn't felt the slightest fatigue. It had to be said that the physique at the Tongxuan Realm was incredibly powerful and his combat ability was impressive, which had been proven through countless battles.
Among all his cherished wives and concubines, Long Yue had the highest combat ability, capable of battling with Patriarch Han for an extended time, and Han Li always felt a sense of novelty with her.
Every time he turned over Long Yue's tablet, it was time to play "See the Dragon Shed Its Armor."
Long Yue felt somewhat helpless, yet there was a sense of excitement and thrill growing inside her, and she gradually came to enjoy it.
Over these two months, Han Li opened two treasure chests, limiting himself to one five-year cultivation treasure chest per month and firmly refusing to touch the second or third chests.
The first treasure chest brought Han Li average luck; he didn't get anything particularly great, just a Divine Rank middle-grade Cultivation Technique called "Wind and Cloud Mirage Art."
Now in the Divine Yuan Realm as a Martial Emperor, the lowest he could open was a treasure of Heaven Rank lower grade, and the highest could be an item of Emperor Level supreme grade. Therefore, opening a Divine Rank practice could only be considered average luck.
When he opened the second treasure chest, Han Li had a sudden inspiration to do so while dual cultivating with the Dragon Princess, which resulted in an explosion of good fortune that delighted him beyond expectation, prompting him to decide to rub off some good luck more often in the future.
The effect of this Emperor Rank top-grade Emperor Pill was straightforward, increasing by fifty percent the chance for a Great Saint at the peak of the Saint Abyss Realm to step into the Quasi Emperor domain, an incredibly heaven-defying feat.
From this treasure chest, Han Li obtained an Emperor Rank top-grade treasure, an Emperor Rank Pill named "Taoism Pill."
The effect of this Emperor Rank top-grade Emperor Pill was straightforward, increasing by fifty percent the chance for a Great Saint at the peak of the Saint Abyss Realm to step into the Quasi Emperor domain, an incredibly heaven-defying feat.
When Han Li first opened the Taoism Pill, he was ecstatic, becoming even more valiant in battle and grateful for his beloved wife Long Yue's support.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li stood with his hands clasped behind his back, admiring the magnificent view of Chengsheng Mountain while calculating the time in his heart.
Thanks to Long Yue's unremitting efforts, she had been pregnant for over a month. Although Long Yue didn't want children, she agreed to have the child after continuous persuasion from Han Li.
In just over eight months, his and Long Yue's child would be born—an occasion of great joy indeed.
Han Li was looking forward to finding out whether the child would have a Second Grade talent or First Grade, or might even possess a special constitution.
If the child had a special constitution, could it bring any feedback to him?
Apart from calculating the time until Long Yue's child was born, Han Li was also counting down to when the free treasure chests would become available.
In half a month, a new year would arrive, and that would be the time when the free treasure chests would refresh.
Although he could spend cultivation to open one treasure chest after another, Patriarch Han simply wouldn't, for he liked freebies; free things were eternally divine.
Free victories brought miracles!
When the time came, it would be euphorically satisfying.
Even though it wasn't time to open the free treasure chests yet, Han Li had already begun to fantasize about the thrill of the moment.
Two days later, Han Li arrived at Jiang Baiye's chamber, but this time it wasn't to dual cultivate with his beloved wife Jiang Jiang.
"Husband~"
When Han Li arrived, Jiang Baiye was surprised and delighted, having thought that her husband wouldn't come.
After all, she was merely breaking through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, not a matter of great significance, but Han Li's arrival made her very happy. It showed her husband's regard for her.
She had already been given the Body-Cultivating Furnace by her husband. Jiang Baiye planned to find an opportunity to return the Body-Cultivating Furnace to the Canghai Sect, as, even though Han Li told her it was just a replica, she didn't mind and just wanted to return it to the Canghai Sect.
Jiang Baiye knew her husband had obtained the truly ancient and supreme treasure, the Life-Prolonging Furnace, and she herself had experienced its renewal.
Originally, her cultivation was stuck at the Peak of the Hollow Realm. The true essence of her martial path was incomplete, and she struggled to refine it for a long time. However, after the baptism of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, her aptitude and comprehension significantly improved, allowing her to quickly grasp the key elements and completely refine the true essence of her martial path.
"Jiang Jiang, I'll protect you as you make your breakthrough."
Han Li cradled Jiang Baiye in his embrace, pressing his lips gently against her exquisitely beautiful red lips, and whispered.
"Mmm~"
Jiang Baiye gently nodded her head, entwined intimately with her husband for a while before reluctantly starting her breakthrough.
Han Li watched over everything with his Divine Sense covering an extremely wide area, primarily concentrated inside Jiang Baiye's chamber. If there were any accidents during her breakthrough, he would immediately correct them and help Jiang Baiye break through in one go.
Jiang Baiye's momentum climbed steadily and she smoothly shattered her constraints, advancing from a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage to a Great Grandmaster in the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
After the breakthrough, joy was painted all over Jiang Baiye's face. Her first reaction was to inform Han Li, "Husband, I've reached the Myriad Phenomena Realm."
"You're truly amazing, Jiang Jiang."
Han Li kissed her smooth and tender forehead, pulling her back into his embrace. He then explained the mysteries of the Myriad Phenomena Realm to her, what she needed to pay attention to during cultivation in the realm, and went into all the details eloquently.
Jiang Baiye leaned in Han Li's arms, listening quietly. She loved this feeling very much, occasionally stealing glances at Han Li, her eyes filled with admiration.
Even though her husband's strength had already reached the Tongxuan Realm and he now possessed several Supreme Grade Divine Weapons, he remained unchanging toward her, never fickle and fancy-free.
Jiang Baiye's heart had long been entrusted to Han Li, filled only with him.
In the depth of their love, Jiang Baiye couldn't help but say, "Husband, let's have another child."
"Okay~"
Han Li nodded slightly, "But we should wait until Jiang Jiang's cultivation has stabilized before we have another child."
Jiang Baiye nodded, her heart even more moved by her husband's consistent thoughtfulness.
Just four days after Jiang Baiye's breakthrough to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, another of Han Li's beautiful wives, Yun Miaoyi, was also about to advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Han Li put aside all other matters and came to Yun Miaoyi's chamber to protect her as she advanced.
After Yun Miaoyi successfully became a Great Grandmaster in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, Han Li also carefully explained all the intricacies of the realm to her. She listened with rapt attention as he expounded with great care.
Just like Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, the little "Devil Princess", had also deeply fallen in love with Han Li, her eyes filled only with him.
The actions of Han Li deeply touched Yun Miaoyi. By now, her husband's cultivation and combat power had become unfathomable, reaching the Tongxuan Realm, and he also had two wives at the True Martial Realm.
Yet, he had never changed his heart towards her and had become even better over time, never depriving them, his earlier wives, of any good things.
She felt increasingly fortunate about her decision back then to go to Qingzhou to find Jiang Baiye. Otherwise, how would she have met her husband and been brought back by him to Chengsheng Mountain?
From a little "Devil Princess" of Yinyang Sect, she was carefully nurtured and well cared for by her husband, and her cultivation had progressed from the late God Refining Realm to become a Great Grandmaster in the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
"Husband, let's have another child," Yun Miaoyi initiated, biting Han Li's lips, her breath as sweet as orchids.
Han Li repeated the same words to Yun Miaoyi that he had said to Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi's heart was filled with even more sentiment. She decided to bear her husband several more children this time.
