chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue's Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 334  - 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue's Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_1
Da Qian, The Li Manor.
Han Li walked out of his beloved Chu Xianlin's bedroom.
After two months of dual cultivation, along with last night's fervent battle, Chu Xianlin's cultivation had finally advanced another step, breaking through from the third level of the Myriad Phenomena Realm to the fourth level.
After her realm breakthrough, Chu Xianlin rewarded her husband handsomely, allowing him to engage in all kinds of battles with her, and she herself also reveled in it.
Arriving at the top floor of Chong Xiao Pavilion, Han Li overlooked the entire Li Manor, which now had much more life and vitality, having seen a significant increase in population compared to before.
Originally, The Li Manor had a few thousand people, consisting of all sorts of maids, guards, and the like. Now, there were over five hundred of his descendants, ranging from newborns to five years old, ready for cultivation training when the two manors merged.
Beyond his descendants, the harem area contained a multitude of palaces, of which more than one hundred and forty were inhabited; each residence belonged to one of Han Li's beautiful wives and concubines. They also had a large number of maids, all of whom were quite pretty and well-formed.
With a sweep of his Divine Sense, all his wives and concubines appeared in his mind: where they were, what they were doing, what they said... it was all crystal clear.
"This is all the fruit of the patriarch's efforts," Han Li sighed.
During these two months, he had not taken any more wives or concubines in Han Mansion, but he had taken on two more concubines in The Li Manor, each with Fifth Grade talents and looks scoring over eighty-five points.
Han Li was no longer planning to take any more beautiful but lower than Fifth Grade talented female cultivators, unless something particularly special and attractive about them caught his interest, such as... (fill in the blank).
According to his plans, the standards for taking wives and concubines in both Han Mansion and The Li Manor were to be unified and greatly elevated.
From now on, only exquisitely beautiful female cultivators with a talent of Fifth Grade, Fourth Grade and looks scoring above eighty-five points could become his concubines, and those with looks scoring above ninety points and Third Grade talent and above could become his wives.
Han Li was deliberately controlling the number of his wives and concubines.
With his current strength, it was somewhat beneath his status to take exquisite female cultivators with Sixth or Seventh Grade talents as concubines and Fourth Grade talented beauties as wives.
The outside world was unaware of his true combat ability, but Han Li was well aware of it. Moreover, those beautiful female cultivators with insufficient talent also had low cultivations and could not withstand his conquests.
There are not many exquisitely beautiful female cultivators with Fifth or Fourth Grade talent in the Daqian Empire, and many of them have already been taken into Han Mansion and The Li Manor. As for Third Grade talented beauties, Han Li had yet to encounter one.
Lu Tianxiang, Bai Keqing, and Long Yue, although all have talents of Third Grade and above, are not native female cultivators of the Daqian Empire; Long Yue is barely considered a half-native.
His gaze was now set across the entire Xuan Domain, thus, the number of potential wives and concubines he could take in instantly skyrocketed, leaving the beautiful female cultivators below Fifth Grade talent in the Daqian Empire for his descendants.
The Daqian Empire once held a nearly ten-million-li territory. Since the situation collapsed, huge swathes of land were lost, leaving it with merely three to four million li of territory now.
The Xuan Domain is vast, spanning over five hundred million li. The current territory of the Daqian Empire doesn't even make up one percent of the Xuan Domain, and its strength ranks as the weakest among the nine major powers in the Xuan Domain.
Despite Fengbo Pavilion having even less territory than the Daqian Empire and only guarded by Emperor Wu at the early stage of the True Martial Realm, no one believes the Daqian Empire to be stronger than Fengbo Pavilion.
The mysterious forces behind Fengbo Pavilion have now been revealed, known to be the strongest force in the Chaotic Domain, Emperor Mingtian.
Backed by Emperor Mingtian, Fengbo Pavilion may not compare to Qitian Teaching, Kurong Sect, Yinyang Sect, or the Ancient Empire, but their foundation is stronger than the Da Liang Empire, Da Jing Empire, Emperor Wu's City, and the Daqian Empire.
Several years ago, when Emperor Mingtian came to the forefront, it shocked the entire Chaotic Domain and Qianyuan Divine Province, causing a great uproar, with reactions varying among the different powers.
Emperor Mingtian, a force from the East Sea within the Divine Yuan Realm, had somehow infiltrated the Chaotic Domain, controlling a third of its territory and subduing countless powers, becoming the preeminent force in the Chaotic Domain. Even the gates of Emperor Mingtian moved from the East Sea to the Chaotic Domain.
Various powers speculated that Emperor Mingtian's decision to reveal itself might have been at the behest of the Four Great Sacred Lands. Since that revelation, Emperor Mingtian ceased its expansion, and the powers understood why Emperor Mingtian would intervene in the Daqian Empire's affairs.
Under the constraints of the Four Great Sacred Lands, Emperor Mingtian could no longer expand in the Chaotic Domain. The territories ruled by Emperor Mingtian quieted down over the years, no longer in disarray. Other parts of the Chaotic Domain remained as before, but many powers felt an urgency, worried about the emergence of another top-tier force like Emperor Mingtian.
At the same time, the Heaven Lord of Emperor Mingtian announced that they would head to the Xuan Domain to jointly face its crisis. Powers speculated this might also be a demand of the Four Great Sacred Lands, as part of a deal allowing Emperor Mingtian to move its base to the Chaotic Domain and officially step onto the stage of the Divine Continent.
Han Li had long been aware of these developments, but he paid them no mind. To the countless powers, Emperor Mingtian might be a leviathan, immovable, but to the Sacred Lands, it was insignificant.
To Han Li, it was the same. If they chose not to obey, Han Li wouldn't hesitate to annihilate Emperor Mingtian entirely.
His stature now matched that of Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, and other Sacred Lands. He harbored only a slight wariness, and once his power further increased, the structures of power within the Qianyuan Divine Province would be redrawn.
By then, he would be the foremost power, and the Great Sacred Lands would only occupy the second tier.

chapters.title: Chapter 335: 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue’s Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Chapter 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue’s Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_2
At that time, he would be able to marry and take concubines throughout the Qianyuan Divine Province, and who among the various forces would dare not comply? The Sacred Land would obediently send their daughters to the ancestor!
At that time, his standards for taking wives and concubines would rise again, at least by one level.
Then, Han Li would lie low and focus on his development. He hadn’t thought about getting involved outside the Qianyuan Divine Province, at least not for the time being.
Unless the Qianyuan Divine Province could no longer satisfy him, only then would he turn his gaze to other parts of the Yuankun Domain. By that time, his cultivation level would probably have ascended to the Sanction Abyss and Heaven Imperial Realm, making him fearless of everything.
During this period, he had learned many things beyond the Qianyuan Divine Province from the Health Preservation Furnace Spirit, Yin Ling, giving him a rough overview of the power structure of the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of Yuankun Domain.
Han Li knew this was a very rough overview. The ancient catastrophe had wreaked great havoc on the Yuankun Domain. Many powerful Sacred Lands had perished, such as the Nine Solar Heavens, the foremost Sacred Land of the Crimson Divine State. It was likely that the power structure of the Yuankun Domain had undergone significant changes.
“Take it slow, I, the old ancestor, can wait.”
Releasing a breath, a refreshing look appeared on Han Li’s face.
Once he had dealt with the matter in the Xuan Domain, his influence would surge, and at that time, he would be able to marry and take concubines across the entire Xuan Domain.
Extremely beautiful female cultivators with qualifications of fifth rank or above are rare in Da Qian, but when expanded to the entire Xuan Domain, there are many more, at least a hundred times more.
Just the Ancient Empire alone had an unknown number, the foremost force in the Xuan Domain, occupying one third of its territory. Within it, there are not a few Emperor Wus of the True Martial Realm, far surpassing the other three major empires.
After staying in the Li Manor for a while, Han Li’s thought brought him back to Han Mansion.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, there awaited a stunningly gorgeous woman, unsurpassed in grace and beauty, and she was not any of Han Li’s cherished wives or concubines.
Dressed in a gorgeous pink dress, her sleeves fluttered; her hair shone sleek and smooth; her forehead was rounded and lustrous; her nose was exquisitely perched; her eyes were like autumn waters, sparkling and with pearly teeth; her lips were beautifully shaped; her skin was creamy; she shone with stunning enchantment yet carried an air of pure charm—an embodiment of both a temptress and a fairy.
She stood there, with a graceful figure, an alluring back, and a slender, enticing posture. Her captivating curves ebbed and flowed, her demeanor was unmatched in this world, exuding beauty that seemed unearthly, all of her enveloped in a divine brilliance, like a fairy descended to the mortal plane.
Her beauty was unmatched, unquestionable. Her pink hair cascaded down to her waist, dancing with the wind now and then. Standing there quietly, she seemed as if the stars themselves held her in reverence, making even the natural spirit and unparalleled beauty of heaven and earth pale in comparison.
The scenery of Chengsheng Mountain was unparalleled in beauty, yet it was not even a hundredth as beautiful as she was.
“Brother~”
Seeing Han Li’s figure appear, Yao Xi spoke up, her voice sweet and melodious like music to the ears, filled with deep affection as her beautiful eyes shimmered.
Han Li stood by her side, gazing at this extraordinarily beautiful pink-haired girl. He naturally pulled her into his embrace and kissed her smooth, white forehead.
“Xi Xi, why are you here?”
“Waiting for Brother to come back and marry me.”
Nestling against her brother’s broad and sturdy chest, Yao Xi looked up at her beloved, her gem-like eyes glimmering with anticipation, her face brimming with eager expectation.
She had been waiting for this day for nine years.
At the age of ten, Yao Xi was brought back to Han Mansion by Han Li and has lived in the inner palace ever since; now she was nineteen.
Over the years, Yao Xi had fallen deeply in love with Han Li, with a heart filled only with him, always waiting for Han Li to voice those words she had longed to hear for many years.
But Han Li seemed to have some reservations and had not spoken them yet. Yao Xi did not rush him, patiently waiting instead.
She knew that Brother also liked her, and their relationship had long been determined; otherwise, he would not have allowed her to live together with those sisters.
When she was younger, Yao Xi did not understand the meaning of this, but by the age of thirteen or fourteen, she understood. Since then, she had been looking forward to the day when she could live here under another status.
In those nine years, Brother always treated her well, and compared to her previous life, it was a world of difference. She was extremely grateful that she met Brother in Lingjun City that year; any later, she would have missed him forever.
Over the years, Brother amassed more and more wives and concubines, marrying one beautiful sister after another, causing some uneasiness and a sense of urgency and expectation in Yao Xi’s heart.
Brother had married so many wives and concubines; when would he marry her?
As she grew older, she became even more exquisitely beautiful, and few among Brother’s charming wives and beautiful concubines could compare to her.
She grew to like him more and more, looked forward to it more and more, and missed him more and more… but Brother had never spoken, and even in the past two years, the time he spent with her had been decreasing.
After much thought and many restless nights, Yao Xi decided she could not wait any longer and determined to speak for herself. She knew her own heart, as well as Brother’s, and wanted to actively break the reservations in his heart.
When she finally spoke those words, the emotions Yao Xi had accumulated over many years came pouring out. She spun around, wrapped her arms around Han Li’s waist, and on tiptoe, she leaned in and took the initiative, biting Han Li’s lips.
Han Li did not refuse and also began to respond.
After a while, as their lips parted, Han Li said with a smile, “It seems Xi Xi can’t wait any longer.”
Looking at the exceptionally beautiful girl in his arms, Han Li was also filled with emotion. He too had waited for Yao Xi for nine years, and it took nine years to raise this little girl into her current self.
He still remembered the little girl that nobody wanted nine years ago, who transformed into a little princess the moment she donned grand attire after he brought her home.
Now, the little girl had grown up. She still liked to wear pink dresses, perhaps because the first dress she wore was pink. Her hair also had changed from black to pink, which seemed to be an unconscious choice by Yao Xi.

chapters.title: Chapter 336: 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue’s Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: Chapter 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue’s Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_3
Since the last time Han Li reinforced the seal on Yao Xi’s Divine Spirit, she had not suffered from headaches, nor had she been bombarded with inexplicable memories flooding her mind. However, her Divine Spirit continued to grow stronger by the day, with rapid increase in her mental strength.
Even without cultivating, Yao Xi’s Divine Spirit was now comparable to many Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage, and Han Li took careful notice.
Now, it was finally time to reap the benefits.
“Mhm~” Yao Xi nodded vigorously, gazing into the eyes of her beloved.
Her radiant, pale face blushed beautifully, catching Han Li completely off guard and rendering him speechless.
With hundreds of beautiful wives and concubines, he had seen women of all sorts of beauty, but facing this version of Yao Xi, he was still defenseless.
“Then brother shall marry you now,” he said.
As the words fell, Han Li leaned in, this time taking the initiative, and his hand could not help but move.
The two, on Chengdao Peak’s summit, were utterly absorbed in each other, whispering sweet nothings and enjoying their own little world.
Yao Xi was unaware that many people on Chengdao Peak had witnessed this scene, such as Long Yue, Bai Keqing, Lu Tianxiang, and others. Han Li knew, but he didn’t care.
“Yao Xi has finally achieved true fruition,” remarked Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and the other beautiful wives of Han Li, smiles blooming on their faces.
They had long since treated Yao Xi as a younger sister and were relieved to see her success, having looked forward to this moment for a long time. They would even discuss when their husband would finally take little sister Yao Xi as his bride.
Three days later, the Patriarch of the Han Family took another wife!
This news spread through Yonchang Manor at lightning speed, sending a ripple of shock through all the major powers, with wry smiles appearing on the faces of their leaders.
Was the old Han Patriarch back to his old ways?
It had been six full years since the Han Family Patriarch last took a wife, and they all thought that he had changed his ways.
So when the Han Family Patriarch took a wife two months ago, various powers enthusiastically participated, offering various precious gifts to congratulate him.
Everyone thought the Han Family Patriarch would wait another six years to marry his next wife, but to their bewilderment and chagrin, it had been only two months before he took another. This left them laughing and crying at the same time.
If things continued this way, would the Han Family Patriarch end up marrying a new wife every two months?
The leaders of the powers were inwardly tormented; it was acceptable to offer ordinary gifts for the Han Patriarch’s concubinage, but marriage required precious gifts. Frequent marriages could drain their treasuries.
Yet they could not simply refrain; failing to offer gifts, or offering meager ones, would certainly provoke the resentment of the Han Family Patriarch.
Despite their internal grievances, the leaders of these powers dutifully brought their gifts to Chengsheng Mountain to partake in the grand wedding celebration of the Han Family Patriarch.
They would rather appease the Han Mansion with some resources than anger it, lest the Han Mansion emerge from its comfort zone to contest with them over cultivation resources and territories in Yonchang Manor—with which they could not compete.
The grand wedding took place as scheduled, a lively and bustling affair.
On the wedding night, an elated Han Li entered the bridal chamber to find a stunning beauty seated on the bed, his breathing turning rapid.
Suddenly, the sound of thunder came from outside the window, “rumbling” incessantly, as if rain was imminent.
Dark clouds filled the sky, concealing the heavens and earth like the broad, heavy body of a man, as though a black cloud was about to crush the city—a foreboding feeling.
On the earth below, plants thrived, ancient trees towered, and tender leaves drifted in the wind, like the alluring hands of a beautiful girl waving erratically.
The tender leaves, battered by the violent storm, swayed uncertainly, a will to resist the oppressive dark clouds overhead and restore light to the world—yet they failed.
Finally, with a series of urgent peals of thunder, the dark clouds had fully gathered, and suddenly heavy rain poured down, drenching everything.
Bathed in the nourishing rain, the vegetation seemed even more delicate, and the tender leaves swayed once more, as if echoing the roaring thunder.
Rain fell on Chengsheng Mountain, and far away in Qianyuan Divine Province, beyond the reach of time and space, rain also began to fall—a rain that seemed to transcend time itself.
In the Yuankun Domain, Kunji Divine Province.
The vast Yuankun Domain, with endless lands, once had a history of such splendor and dominance that it overshadowed the heavens, gazing down upon myriad worlds, making legions of species and spirits bow in homage.
Qianyuan Divine Province was located southwest of the Yuankun Domain, while Kunji Divine Province was directly east of the Qianyuan Divine Province. Unlike the declining Qianyuan Divine Province, Kunji Divine Province remained powerful.
In Kunji Divine Province there lay an imperial empire, called Huangyue Imperial Empire. It once governed the Nine Great Divine Provinces in ancient times. Legend has it that the empire was founded by a female phoenix emperor who eventually transcended tribulations to become a Heavenly Immortal, overseeing the mortal realm.
The ancient catastrophe came, and the Endless Yuankun Domain plunged into turmoil. Saints and Great Holy Land Schools, Imperial Empires, and the Eternal Clan’s True Immortals, Heavenly Immortals, and Great Emperors all perished, including those of the Huangyue Imperial Empire.
After the ancient catastrophe, the Eight Hundred Divine Regions fell into great chaos. Saints and Great Holy Land Schools, Imperial Empires, and the Eternal Clan’s emperors and greater combatants all died, and even divine weapons and immortal weapons were shattered in large numbers, providing the Saint Abyss Realm Power an opportunity to ignite endless killings and warfare.
Heaven’s murderous intent moved the stars; Earth’s murderous intent incited dragons and serpents to rise; Human’s murderous intent overturned heaven and earth.
In the ensuing unrest and chaos, powers of the Yuankun Domain fell one by one, be they Divine Yuan Realm War Emperors, Tongxuan Realm experts, or even the Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm.
In this fierce struggle, some Great Holy Land Schools, Imperial Empires, and Eternal Clans were destroyed, while some Tongxuan Realm powers and Saint Abyss Realm powers rose and took their place.

chapters.title: Chapter 337 Chapter 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue's Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_4
chapters.content:
337  Chapter 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue's Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_4
```
The Huangyue Imperial Empire may have lost its Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals, but it still had Great Emperors who lived on in this world, ruling over the Nine Great Divine Provinces and with their Emperor's Might suppressing the Eight Hundred Divine Regions.
The current female emperor of Huangyue was unparalleled in elegance, possessing extraordinary talent and was incredibly striking; she rose amidst turmoil, step by step ascending to the throne of Empress.
She swept across the six directions, subdued the eight desolations, and faced no rivals under the heavens and on earth. Her might as an Empress spread throughout the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of Yuankun Domain.
After the Great Emperors and Heavenly Immortals of the Huangyue Imperial Empire had fallen, the empire plunged into severe chaos. Some factions within the empire from the Tongxuan Realm and the Saint Abyss Realm rebelled, and the Nine Great Divine Provinces that were vassals of the Huangyue Empire began to cut ties, no longer recognizing the empire's sovereignty. Numerous Saint Abyss Realm factions ceaselessly battled, each wanting to dominate a Divine Province.
A female figure emerged from nowhere—rumored to be a daughter of a Heavenly Immortal who originally founded the Huangyue Empire. She had a heavenly countenance and was born with an Immortal Body, also possessing Immortal Grade talent.
The female emperor of Huangyue rose swiftly; at birth, she was already in the True Martial Realm. In just ten years, she reached the Divine Yuan Realm, in forty years, the Tongxuan Realm, and in a century, she became a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm.
After reaching sainthood, the female emperor of Huangyue ascended to the highest position, becoming Empress, and began to eradicate domestic troubles and foreign threats.
She personally led a campaign against a Saint Abyss Realm power possessing imperial armaments. With an unmatched domineering stance, she utterly annihilated them. That battle shook the world and made various powers come to the realization that the Huangyue Imperial Empire was reviving and a successor had risen.
Subsequently, the female emperor of Huangyue campaigned in all directions, pacifying one Saint Abyss Realm power after another, quelled internal threats to the empire, and launched expeditions to the Nine Great Divine Provinces. After a century, she finally brought the Nine Great Divine Provinces back under the banner of the Huangyue Imperial Empire.
When the female emperor of Huangyue was four hundred years old, she achieved enlightenment to become a Great Emperor and broke through to the Heaven Imperial Realm, controlling the Heavenly Sovereign Path with her imperial might that shocked the Eight Hundred Divine Provinces.
When a formidable foe struck, seeking to seize the Great Emperorly Dao fruits from the newly enlightened female emperor of Huangyue, they were slain on the spot by her, causing a sensation throughout the boundless Yuankun Domain.
This battle securely stabilized the Huangyue Imperial Empire, as no one dared to have a second thought, and no other power dared to cast a covetous eye.
As ten thousand years passed, the majesty of the Huangyue Imperial Empire deeply ingrained itself in the hearts of the people. The Empress continued her southern and northern campaigns, her conquests in the east and west, constantly expanding the realm of the Huangyue Imperial Empire.
In the ancient era, the peak of the Huangyue Empire only led ten Divine Provinces, including Kunji Divine Province and the associated Nine Great Divine Provinces. But now, the Huangyue Empire ruled over forty-eight Divine Provinces, making it one of the strongest forces in the entire Yuankun Domain.
The imperial capital of the Huangyue Empire was a city in the sky, floating above the nine heavens of Kunji Divine Province. It radiated a profound might at all times, covering the entirety of Kunji Divine Province and also overseeing the affiliated Forty-eight Divine Provinces.
The imperial city of Huangyue was magnificent, brilliant, thriving, and bustling. It was worthy of countless praises, and indeed could hold its own, looking like a phoenix soaring the skies, so vast that a hundred Imperial Capitals of Da Qian could not compare.
Within the radiant and flourishing imperial palace of the capital,
At the majestic entrance of a great palace, the female emperor of Huangyue in her Golden Battle Armor stood with hands crossed behind her back, gazing east toward that towering and majestic Divine Mountain.
Underneath her Golden Battle Armor was her exquisitely curving, surging figure, and outside the armor, layers of golden ripples continuously blossomed, concealing her peerlessly graceful body.
After a long gaze, the female emperor of Huangyue murmured softly, "I really want to shatter that Divine Mountain."
The borders of the Yuankun Domain were endless and vast, yet at its far eastern end stood a towering and majestic Divine Mountain, the premier Divine Mountain of the Yuankun Domain, the tallest and the strongest.
This Divine Mountain was named the Xuanshen Sword Mountain!
According to the ancient records of the Yuankun Domain, beyond its borders lies an even more vast and boundless universe, with the Yuankun Domain being just a corner of this unlimited universe.
And the Xuanshen Sword Mountain was the only exit from the Yuankun Domain to the outside world. The Xuanshen Sword Mountain separated the Yuankun Domain from the outside, resulting in the Yuankun Domain having little exchange with the outside world for countless eons.
To leave the Yuankun Domain and venture to the more expansive Boundless Universe, one must climb the Xuanshen Sword Mountain and traverse one of its three ancient paths, enduring the supreme Sword Intent, to successfully exit.
The female emperor of Huangyue's desire to shatter the Xuanshen Sword Mountain was not because it separated the Yuankun Domain from the outside world, but rather because it was the culprit behind the great calamities of olden times.
Or to say, every great calamity that had risen within the Yuankun Domain was due to the Xuanshen Sword Mountain. Each time the Xuanshen Sword Mountain reawakened, a great calamity ensued in the Yuankun Domain, costing the lives of countless Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, and True Immortals.
"Sigh~"
The female emperor of Huangyue sighed. She knew her strength was among the strongest in the Yuankun Domain, but it was still far from enough to destroy the Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
She was the founder of the Huangyue Empire, that daughter of a Heavenly Immortal, aware of numerous secrets, and knowledgeable about all the intelligence that the empire had collected over countless years.
It was precisely because she was so knowledgeable that she felt powerless, even deeply hopeless.
From ancient histories, she learned that every eon in the Yuankun Domain would be marked by six great calamities, occurring every two billion one hundred and sixty million years with absolute punctuality, without exception.
It was these recurring calamities that divided the history of the Yuankun Domain into several eras, with each eon beginning with the Desolate old ages, followed by the Divine Ages, then the Primordial Ages, after which came the Prehistoric Ages, and then the Ancient Era.
The current era she lived in was the sixth era of this eon, and once buried, the Yuankun Domain would begin the next eon, repeating the cycle of eras endlessly.
`

chapters.title: Chapter 338 Chapter 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue's Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_5
chapters.content:
338  Chapter 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue's Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_5
Upon her first encounter with these top-secret records from ancient history, Empress Huangyue did not believe them. Who could overlook each epoch and control the countless epochs within the Yuankun Domain?
It was said that even Eternal Golden Immortals could not achieve this!
Yet, after extensive inquiries and learning more detailed ancient histories, Empress Huangyue came to believe in them because the records of the Great Holy Land Schools, Eternal Clans, and Imperial Empires all told the same cruel truth.
In every epoch, in every era, countless sages struggled against it, seeking to break the chains of their fate, but all failed.
Xuanshen Sword Mountain, this was the dark origin of the Yuankun Domain, the birthplace of the catastrophe, the harvester of countless Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, and True Immortals.
Every creature that knew of these top-secret records, from the True Immortals above to the Saintly beings in the Sacred Abyss Realm and even the powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm, knew that their fate was sealed.
Though the powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm, the Saints of the Sacred Abyss Realm, and the Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm could not live for more than two hundred million years, cultivating was in defiance of the heavens, and they all aspired to become immortals, to rise to the status of Heavenly Immortal, True Immortal, or even an Eternal Golden Immortal.
If they achieved immortality, they would face the great challenge of Xuanshen Sword Mountain, and when the time came, they would be reaped by it.
Even if they did not become immortals, if they happened to exist during the time of a catastrophe, they were likely to die, and their Sects and families could be destroyed as well. There were too many such records in ancient history.
"What level of weapon is this Immortal Sword after all?"
After a long silence, Empress Huangyue whispered to herself, a question she had pondered countless times, but for which she never had an answer.
Because after the revival of Xuanshen Sword Mountain, it became too strong, so strong that it plunged the entire Yuankun Domain into despair.
Every time a great tribulation descended, and Xuanshen Sword Mountain revived, this Immortal Sword did not even move; its mere radiance was enough to freeze the Endless Yuankun Domain with light, slaughtering all Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, and True Immortals.
Wherever the sword light passed, heaven and earth trembled, space and time shattered, and the sword light obliterated all causality and fate. From Great Emperors to True Immortals, no one could withstand a single ray of sword light and would be slain in an instant.
Even True Immortals hiding in minor worlds were no exception; they and their minor worlds would be annihilated together.
This is the top-secret information recorded in the historical annals of each epoch and era in the Yuankun Domain, revealing the terror of Xuanshen Sword Mountain and a profound sense of despair.
The limits of this Immortal Sword are unknown, unsuspected even by Heavenly and True Immortals, for they too cannot withstand even a single ray of its sword light.
"This is most certainly not an Immortal Sword of a Golden Immortal rank!" Empress Huangyue stated with unwavering certainty.
In this epoch, the Yuankun Domain had not seen the birth of any Golden Immortals, or perhaps for many epochs, since those True Immortals were culled by the revival of Xuanshen Sword Mountain before they could reach the Golden Immortal Realm.
However, the ancient history of the Yuankun Domain did record Golden Immortals; Heavenly Immortals lived for one epoch, True Immortals for one hundred, while Golden Immortals could live forever.
Records in ancient history chronicled the lifespan of Golden Immortals, their combat ability, and even some rough descriptions of the Golden Immortal Realm. All these hinted that an Immortal Sword at the level of a Golden Immortal could not achieve all of this.
What lies above the Golden Immortal?
No one in the entire Yuankun Domain had the answer, and neither did Empress Huangyue, who speculated that this Immortal Sword was a weapon above the Golden Immortal, giving it such endless power.
"This era has just begun, and I still have a chance," Empress Huangyue whispered again to herself.
An era spans two hundred and sixteen million years, and the Ancient Era had just passed eleven thousand years; the new era had only just begun. She had already cultivated to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, making her an extreme dao Great Emperor.
Ten thousand years ago, she had already reached this level but purposely suppressed her realm from breaking through, as she wanted to become stronger within the heaven Imperial Realm.
With her Huangyue Immortal Body and Immortal-grade talent, advancing to Heavenly Immortal was not difficult, and the so-called heavenly tribulations could not stop her.
Empress Huangyue was acutely aware that becoming a Heavenly Immortal was pointless, as she would live for at most two hundred million years before dying in a great tribulation triggered by Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
Only by becoming stronger, possessing the combat ability of a Heavenly Immortal while in the Heaven Imperial Realm, could she have a chance to sever the chains of fate.
For Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, and True Immortals in the Yuankun Domain, the revived Xuanshen Sword Mountain was an insurmountable foe. The only way to survive was to leave the Yuankun Domain and head for the vast outside world.
Although there were three ancient pathways atop Xuanshen Sword Mountain leading to the outside world, very few beings were capable of walking them through. At the very least, they needed to possess the True Immortal Realm to have the qualification to attempt it.
Empress Huangyue guessed that perhaps only with a True Immortal Realm and Golden Immortal Battle Power would one be able to break through Xuanshen Sword Mountain and successfully reach the vast external world.
But how difficult would that be?
On the path of cultivation, the further one progresses, the greater the disparity in combat ability. Not to mention a Big Realm, even within a minor realm, the difference in combat ability could be immense.
Being able to possess combat ability equivalent to a Heavenly Immortal in the Heaven Imperial Realm was already an incredible feat, with very few achieving it since antiquity. And to have True Immortal combat ability in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, or Golden Immortal combat ability in the True Immortal Realm, was even rarer, with probably no more than a handful over countless epochs.
Whether she could succeed in the future, Empress Huangyue did not know. First, she needed to ensure she possessed the combat ability of a Heavenly Immortal while in the Heaven Imperial Realm, and she had been trying to achieve that since a hundred thousand years ago.
Empress Huangyue deduced a supreme Immortal Law, dividing a wisp of her Primordial Spirit to undergo reincarnation, sealing part of her memories and copious cultivation experiences, as well as numerous Imperial Immortal Skills, within the split soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 339 Chapter 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue's Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_6
chapters.content:
339  Chapter 187: Marrying Yao Xi, Empress Huanyue's Fury! The Origin of the Catastrophe! Empress Yuanchu Enjoys the Drama!_6
```
With that approach, the split soul could successfully train and progress rapidly. Once it reached the Saint Abyss Realm, Huangyue Empress would retrieve the split soul, then assist it in breaking through to a Quasi Emperor, and attaining the Dao as an Emperor.
One hundred thousand years passed, and Huangyue Empress had split off thousands of souls, but very few grew to reach the Saint Abyss Realm—only eight, in fact. She brought them all back to the Huangyue Imperial Empire and cultivated them with great care, with some even having successfully broken through to the Heaven Imperial Realm as Great Emperors.
Huangyue Empress was waiting for the ninth Saint Abyss Realm split soul to emerge. She had placed high hopes on the split soul she had parted with decades before, sealing more within it to ensure its growth.
Should this split soul successfully cultivate to the Saint Abyss Realm and she can cultivate it after retrieving it, once all nine split souls reached the Heaven Imperial Realm as Great Emperors, she would then be able to activate a supreme Immortal Law, uniting the nine great split souls with her own.
Huangyue Empress was confident that once the nine great split souls united with her, her combat ability would increase countless times over, breaking all shackles and surging into the Heavenly Immortal domain, truly possessing a combat prowess comparable to that of a Heavenly Immortal.
That would be the time when she overcomes the heavenly tribulation and achieves the Heavenly Immortal state.
However, this split soul that she had high hopes for seemed to have encountered a problem. Someone had tampered with it, sealing it to the extent that even she could not sense its presence.
Huangyue Empress had several suspects, all of whom were her adversaries. Her primary suspect was the Empress from Yuanchu Mountain.
The Empress had often clashed with her, and there were continuous frictions between Yuanchu Mountain and the Huangyue Imperial Empire. Both Empresses shared the same goal, and it was very likely that the Yuanchu Mountain Empress had found her split soul and interfered with it.
This wasn't the first time she had encountered such an incident. Many of her split souls had fallen due to irresistible forces. If it weren't for reincarnation being beyond her control, Huangyue Empress would wish for all her split souls to reincarnate within the Huangyue Imperial Empire.
"I hope it's not you causing mischief; otherwise, I will make you pay the price," there was a flash of ruthlessness in Huangyue Empress's eyes.
All of a sudden, Huangyue Empress's delicate body shuddered, her pupils dilated, and her eyes flashed with disbelief as her fair, jade-like cheeks became expressionless.
"Why is my body reacting?"
Huangyue Empress spoke in a dazed tone, feeling a tingling, electrifying pleasure coursing through her body, involuntarily making her moan aloud.
Immediately after, Huangyue Empress forcibly suppressed the sensation, her pretty face frosty as a terrifying aura was released, her Emperor's Might shaking the Three Thousand Realms, drawing the attention of countless powers.
"Who is it!?!"
With a flash, Huangyue Empress returned to her sleeping chambers and lay on the soft and comfortable bed, cultivating to calm the discomfort in her body as she shouted angrily.
At that moment, Huangyue Empress was certain her split soul had not fallen into the hands of the Yuanchu Mountain Empress.
Although the Empress opposed her, she would never stoop to such laughable actions. The Yuanchu Mountain Empress also knew that committing such an act would incense her greatly, resulting in more loss than gain.
This was the first time in ten thousand years that Huangyue Empress had encountered such a circumstance. Before, if a split soul died, it just died, and Huangyue Empress didn't care—she would simply split another to reincarnate.
But today's situation had caught Huangyue Empress off guard. Someone was messing with her split soul, the effects of which, across the endless bounds of space and time, transmitted to her main body, igniting the rage of Huangyue Empress.
Huangyue Empress was furious!
Someone had dared to defile the purity of her split soul!
Even though it was the purity of a split soul that was lost, it was felt by her, causing a reaction within her body; even her majestic Primordial Spirit was at risk of contamination, which left Huangyue Empress immensely angry.
She felt as if her own purity had been lost!
The split soul was her, and the main soul was also her; the loss of purity in the split soul also affected the main soul.
"Don't let me find out who you are!"
After cultivating several times, Huangyue Empress finally suppressed the strange sensation and her Divine Sense spread out.
Shortly after, an ethereally beautiful figure in green, with a refined and incomparable elegance, appeared in Huangyue Empress's sleeping chambers. She was like a Heavenly Immortal descending to the mundane realm, transcendent and of indescribable beauty.
```
"Your Majesty~"
The Heavenly Immortal clad in purple robes bowed deeply and greeted respectfully.
"Ji Mingyue, proceed to Qianyuan Divine Province and the thirty-six provinces, and bring back my soul fragment."
"This Emperor must know into whose hands the soul fragment has fallen; bring that person back as well."
The Huangyue Empress spoke in a cold tone, concealing endless rage.
"As you command!"
Ji Mingyue accepted the order and left immediately.
She did not know why the Huangyue Empress was so enraged, but assumed it was related to the mission. A sense of urgency grew within her0 to retrieve the Huangyue Empress's soul fragment as soon as possible.
Otherwise, she would be in for a world of trouble.
"Hmph~"
Within the bedchamber, the Huangyue Empress snorted coldly, her voice filled with boundless fury, as if to incinerate the Nine Heavens.
Just now, when her soul fragment was marred, the seal within the soul body loosened for a moment. Although that thief quickly reinforced it, the Huangyue Empress still sensed a vague location.
She pinpointed the location of the soul fragment to the southwest of the Yuankun Domain, which is where Qianyuan Divine Province and the thirty-six provinces it once ruled are located.
But Qianyuan Divine Province had long since declined. Now, it did not even have a Saint from the Saintly Abyss Realm, and was not even considered by the Huangyue Empress.
No matter who had defiled her soul fragment, she would make them pay the price; even the Sacred Lands of Qianyuan Divine Province could not withstand her wrath.
If the Huangyue Empress were to lose her temper, the entire Endless Yuankun Domain and the Eight Hundred Divine Regions would be plunged into chaos. Mere Sacred Lands without even a Saint from the Saintly Abyss Realm, she could obliterate countless such places with a flick of her wrist.
In the Yuankun Domain, there is the Yuanchu Province.
Home to another mighty power of the Endless Yuankun Domain: Yuanchu Mountain!
Yuanchu Mountain encompasses Yuanchu Province and also rules over forty-six Divine Provinces, making it one of the formidable powers comparable to the Huangyue Imperial Empire.
The strongest within Yuanchu Mountain is Empress Yuanchu.
"The Huangyue Empress is enraged again? This is the second time in the last ten or twenty years. What exactly is happening to her? Could it be that there is a problem with her soul fragment?"
Empress Yuanchu perceived the overwhelming Emperor's Might and pondered.
She had repeatedly sabotaged the Huangyue Empress's soul fragment before it could grow into the Saintly Abyss Realm, aiming to delay the progress of the Huangyue Empress.
Empress Yuanchu was quite aware of what the Huangyue Empress was doing. The two of them were the most dazzling women in the Endless Yuankun Domain, two great empresses, destined to compete all the way.
Before she succeeded herself, she would not allow the Huangyue Empress to succeed.
Empress Yuanchu also knew that the Huangyue Empress had constantly sabotaged her as well, causing her progress to be delayed for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 340: 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 340: Chapter 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_1
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
Han Li was admiring the scenery at the summit of Chengdao Peak with Yao Xi, their closeness as newlyweds evident in their loving exchanges and tender affection.
Han Li was unaware that marrying Yao Xi and obtaining her prime Yin essence had enraged the Great Empress Fengyue, who ruled lands billions of miles away. The empress had even dispatched a female saint from the Saint Abyss Realm to capture him.
At the moment, he was contemplating Yao Xi’s situation. When she lost her virginity, the seal loosened momentarily before Han Li instantly reinforced it again.
This, however, triggered a significant incident, including the flood of many memories containing a wealth of cultivation techniques, martial skills, secret methods, and cultivation experiences, and so on.
As a result, Yao Xi’s divine spirit became even more powerful, and her mental strength was incredibly formidable, comparable to a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Han Li was pondering whether to continue suppressing Yao Xi’s realm or to let her formally embark on the path of cultivation.
As a reborn powerhouse, Yao Xi would have an astonishingly fast cultivation progress. For instance, Long Yue, a reborn strong entity, reached the seventh level of the True Martial Realm in just over a hundred years and was estimated to break through to the Divine Yuan Realm by the age of two hundred.
If Yao Xi was a formidable entity from the Tongxuan Realm in her previous life, then her cultivation speed would be markedly slower than Long Yue’s but still many times faster than that of those genius cultivators.
Should Yao Xi’s past life have been that of a saint from the Saint Abyss Realm, her speed would probably be similar to Long Yue’s. If she had been a Great Emperor from the Heaven Imperial Realm, or even a Heavenly Immortal, her cultivation speed would be even faster.
If Yao Xi’s former life was that of the Tongxuan Realm or the Saint Abyss Realm, Han Li would not fear. However, if she had been from the Heaven Imperial Realm or even a Heavenly Immortal, that could pose some problems.
“Wait a second… Why do I feel that the cultivation speed of reborn strong beings is faster than mine?”
Han Li suddenly froze, realizing that he seemed to be obsessing needlessly over this issue; there was no need for him to worry about it.
Even if Yao Xi’s cultivation speed was fast, could it be faster than his, who was like one with a cheat?
Even if a Great Emperor or Heavenly Immortal were to cultivate anew, it would take at least a thousand years to regain their peak strength.
If a thousand years seems too long, then perhaps five hundred—achieving the status of Great Emperor or Heavenly Immortal in five hundred years would be incredibly against the heavens.
Han Li felt his own cultivation to become a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm or a Heavenly Immortal would be even faster, whether three hundred, two hundred, or even one hundred years.
As the realms get higher, more cultivation is required, but his descendants would increase in multitude, causing the rate of cultivation growth to accelerate and possibly counter the obstacles presented by the higher realms.
Having thought it through, Han Li decided to let Yao Xi make her own decision. If she wanted to cultivate, he would assist her; if she preferred not to, he would just let things be.
“Xi Xi, do you want to cultivate?”
Holding the peerless beauty in his arms, Han Li stroked her pink hair and whispered in her ear.
“I’ll do as my husband wishes, teehee~”
Yao Xi chuckled lightheartedly, finally fulfilling her long-held wish these past few days.
After formally marrying Han Li, Yao Xi switched from calling him “brother” to “husband,” something she had longed to do.
The corners of Han Li’s mouth twitched slightly.
He had left the choice to Yao Xi, yet she deferred to his decision, effectively still leaving him to choose.
“Maybe I should cultivate…”
Seeing her husband remain silent, Yao Xi gave it some thought and suggested.
“Xi Xi, how did you come to this decision?”
Han Li was curious. Yao Xi had always been averse to cultivation, even though her abilities would soar upon unlocking her potential.
“Because… because…”
Yao Xi bowed her head, her fair, delicate face instantly blushing red as she stammered, unable to get the words out.
Han Li blinked, guessing her thoughts, and said with a smile, “Is it because your husband’s combat power is too strong and you can’t withstand it?”
He suspected this was the case.
Without cultivation, Yao Xi’s divine spirit was strong, but physically, she could at best match a Great Master of the Gangyuan Realm.
Han Li’s physical strength was comparable to the fourth level of the Tongxuan Realm. Compared to him, Yao Xi was too fragile, delicate, and vulnerable. During combat, Han Li dared not exert too much force and was extremely gentle and considerate in his slow-paced battles with her.
For this reason, Han Li even limited his physical cultivation to the level of the God Refining Realm, just to make the experiences more comfortable for both of them.
Despite this, Yao Xi, new to the experiences of the flesh, couldn’t handle it. Only after a long period of adaptation did she come to accept him.
“It’s not that, I… I… I just think that a higher cultivation level means a longer life, so I could stay by my husband’s side forever.”
Yao Xi retorted with a red face, embarrassed to admit her little scheme had been guessed by her husband.
“Alright, alright.”
Han Li leaned down and captured those tender, blushing lips, and Yao Xi awkwardly responded.
After quite some time, Han Li released her and then closely observed the changes in Yao Xi. He noted that compared to a few days ago, she had become even more enchanting.
Her pink hair shone translucently, naturally falling to her waist, her eyes like gemstone-covered stars—pure, bright, and full of spiritual energy. Her figure was slender and graceful with beauty that could topple states and shame flowers, exuding an otherworldly elegance.
She had fair, crystal-clear skin like mutton-fat jade, with perfectly curving contours, a tranquil and serene demeanor that was angelic, yet also vibrant with youthful vivacity. Just turning around stirred Han Li’s heart.
“Husband~”
Yao Xi sweetly called out, her eyes brimming with bliss as she noticed the affection with which her husband looked at her.
Han Li responded and talked with her about cultivation matters, explaining experiences, even though he knew that her restored memories would contain this knowledge.
The couple cooed for a long time at the mountain summit before Han Li left reluctantly, heading to The Li Manor.
In Jizhou, at Taikang Manor.
Atop a thousand-foot mountain, two young men were drinking, seemingly waiting for something.

chapters.title: Chapter 341: 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: Chapter 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_2
One of them wore brocade robes, it was Han Yongjin from the Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion, and the other donned blue clothes; he was his brother, Han Yongchun.
Initially, both had low aptitude, but due to their exceptional performances, they were included in Han Li’s list for key cultivation training and were given Rebirth Pills, which transformed their aptitude to fifth-grade.
Now, both had become Great Masters in the Gangyuan Realm, with Han Yongjin in the Sixth Heaven and Han Yongchun in the Seventh Heaven of the Gangyuan Realm.
Although their cultivation was not high, their combat abilities were astonishing, comparable to Great Masters at the Peak of Gangyuan Realm, and each had their own hidden strengths, such that even those lesser in strength from the God Refining Realm could hardly trouble them.
“Big bro Chun, when will they arrive?”
Putting down the wine pot, Han Yongjin asked with a frown.
Since his breakthrough into the Gangyuan Realm, he had ventured out, and not just him; other disciples from Han Mansion did the same, heading out for experiences upon reaching the Gangyuan Realm.
Han Yongjin had been tempering himself outside for a year when he encountered Han Yongchun, and the two clicked right away, deciding to venture together.
Both were sons of Han Li, and although not from the same mother, they were blood brothers, with frequent contacts and close relations. With their father’s constraints, they would not commit fratricide.
After the two joined forces, they ventured together, leaving Yuanzhou and arriving at Jizhou. In Yuanzhou, apart from their clan, the strongest were also of the Gangyuan Realm, offering no significant challenge for training.
Now, they were waiting for two cultivators from the Gangyuan Realm to arrive, core disciples of the Mincang Sect from Jizhou, which was a force within the Hollow Void Stage.
“Should be soon.” Han Yongchun also frowned slightly, feeling somewhat impatient.
The Mincang Sect was merely a Hollow Void Stage force, and yet their two core disciples were dragging their feet. Did they look down on them?
Their Han Mansion outwardly appeared as an Immortal Refining Clan, but he and Han Yongjin, who were prioritized descendants, knew some secrets; their father was far from as simple as he seemed.
After all, their father preached by example, teaching them to be humble, take caution when outside, keep their cultivation hidden, and not act rashly before planning diligently…
Han Yongjin and Han Yongchun both knew their father was definitely not just a cultivator in the God Refining Realm, but very likely a Grandmaster in the Hollow Void Realm, as their father was accustomed to concealing his real cultivation level.
During their expeditions, their mothers had also revealed some secrets to them, including that their father Han Li was a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
The descendants of Han Mansion who knew this information were both shocked and felt it was within their expectations, having grown used to their father’s ways. Even if they were told their father was Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, they would dare to believe it.
With a powerful father, Han Yongjin, Han Yongchun, Han Yongfan, Han Yongyan, and others ventured outside with full confidence, not worried about offending anyone.
In the Daqian Empire, apart from the owner of The Li Manor in the Capital City, their father was among the strongest.
In Jizhou, the strongest force, the Canghai Sect, had a Sect Leader who was also just a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and his combat ability might not even be stronger than their father’s.
After all, Han Mansion had many Heaven Rank cultivation martial skills, and even more Earth Rank ones. Descendants such as them, who were prioritized for training, all chose some they could practice to enhance their combat abilities.
If they had learned these techniques, then their father certainly knew them too, and his combat ability was probably extremely formidable, not something the Canghai Sect Leader could match. How many Heaven Rank martial skills could the Canghai Sect possess?
“Big bro Chun, let’s wait for another half hour, if they still don’t show up, we’ll find someone else.” Han Yongjin’s face showed his impatience.
They had come to Jizhou to participate in a talent competition organized by the Canghai Sect, with bountiful rewards for the victors.
Neither Han Yongjin nor Han Yongchun were concerned about the rewards; what they desired was renown, hoping to accomplish something to impress their father and receive better cultivation support.
The talent competition consisted of three trials, one of which involved entering a barrier to hunt demonic beasts and compete for points, a task designed for teams ranging from two to five people.
Han Yongjin and Han Yongchun’s abilities were certainly sufficient, but out of caution, they wanted to find two teammates to serve as cannon fodder to scout ahead or to take the fall if danger arose.
This strategy had been systematically taught in Han Mansion’s training curriculum, and they both kept it in mind during their ventures, leading to smooth and triumphant experiences.
“Alright.” Han Yongchun nodded.
They were merely looking for two cannon fodder teammates to take the hits; the two from the Mincang Sect would do, but other cultivators could serve as well. Although there would be some risk following them, they would reap considerable benefits, especially entering the third trial.
Picking up his cup, Han Yongchun took another sip of wine while his thoughts dwelled on the upcoming talent competition.
Years ago, he had come across an opportunity at the Mangyang Mountain ruins within the Leiyuan Manor in Yuanzhou, and after emerging, his cultivation progressed rapidly. Having experienced much, upon returning to Han Mansion, he was rewarded by his father with a Rebirth Pill and the identity of a core disciple, hence gaining access to abundant cultivation resources.
He was originally quite pleased with himself, having improved his aptitude to fifth-grade and becoming a prioritized descendant with a promising future, but a casual conversation he overheard between Han Yonglin and Han Yongyun jolted him awake.
A few years down the line, there could be a reshuffling among the prioritized disciples, with fiercer competition awaiting. Han Yongchun didn’t know the reasons, but he knew he had to work harder.
He aimed to take the lead in this talent contest and, at the very least, finish in the top three. Only then, upon his return to Han Mansion, would he have reason to expect his father’s praise.
Han Yongjin’s thoughts were similar to Han Yongchun’s. He had obtained the Rebirth Pill through his abilities. Now that there were no more simple but strenuous tasks like searching for Rebirth Flowers, he could only strive to show his mettle.

chapters.title: Chapter 342: 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: Chapter 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_3
Fortunately, his aptitude and cultivation had improved, providing him with the capital to compete against his brothers and sisters. Although their talents were high, most were only one grade above him.
The two brothers were pondering over matters when, a quarter hour later, two core disciples of the Mincang Sect finally arrived, albeit belatedly.
“Jin, Chun, we’ve kept you waiting,”
The two disciples of the Mincang Sect hastily apologized, seemingly sincere, yet Han Yongchun and Han Yongjin saw through their disguises.
The siblings had ventured out for experience, using false identities, and did not expect to be so belittled by the core disciples of the Mincang Sect.
“No need for formalities.”
“Oh please, Brother Chun and I have just arrived as well.”
Although inwardly they had listed these two as mere cannon fodder, Han Yongjin and Han Yongchun remained exceedingly polite, showing no sign of taking offense.
The two core disciples of the Mincang Sect sneered inwardly—they were truly loose cultivators, so easily deceived. They would not dare to truly offend the disciples of a major sect.
They had planned from the beginning to use these early-stage Gangyuan Realm loose cultivators as cannon fodder; otherwise, they would never have teamed up with them.
“Since both of you have arrived, let’s set off. The Genius Battle starts in just one day,” suggested Han Yongchun.
Thereafter, the four set off towards the Canghai Sect.
…
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
Han Li had come to Lu Tianxiang’s sleeping chamber.
This time, he was not there to dual cultivate with Lu Tianxiang. The Sect Hierarch, at last, was on the verge of a breakthrough to the True Martial Realm, and Han Li was there to protect and guide her.
“Xiang Xiang, are you ready?”
Gazing at the peerless beauty sitting cross-legged, Han Li approached her and asked softly.
He had many beautiful wives and concubines, but only Long Yue and Bai Keqing were True Martial Realm beauties. Once Lu Tianxiang made her breakthrough, there would be three of them.
Han Li had previously obtained a True Martial Pill from a treasure chest and had long since given it to Sect Hierarch Xiang Xiang. Her cultivation had reached the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, but she had not yet made her breakthrough.
The martial intent she had condensed was only of a powerful level, stronger than average but not top-notch—something she herself did not know until Han Li told her.
Thus, Lu Tianxiang decided to refine her foundation during her ascension to the True Martial Realm, strengthening her base. If she could condense a Third Grade Martial True Pill on her own, then with the aid of the True Martial Pill, she might well condense a King Grade Martial True Pill.
After solidifying her foundation, she would be able to break through to higher realms. Lu Tianxiang’s aspirations had changed; she no longer aimed for just the True Martial or Divine Yuan Realms. She wanted to break through to the Tongxuan Realm.
She thought this was very possible—after all, she had an excellent husband.
Her husband was a Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu, already possessing Tongxuan Realm combat ability at just over two hundred years old. It would only be a matter of time before he ascended to the status of a Tongxuan Realm great being or a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm.
With her husband’s support, she, along with Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, Long Yue, Bai Keqing, and others, might well hope to break through to the Tongxuan Realm in the future.
Therefore, Lu Tianxiang wanted to build a solid foundation. After all, her husband had said that it was only the beginning to condense a King Grade True Elixir in the True Martial Realm. To break through the Divine Yuan Realm, one also needed to condense an Emperor Grade Martial Primordial Spirit so one could reach even higher realms.
“My husband, I am ready,” Lu Tianxiang nodded, her expression a bit tense.
“Xiang Xiang, relax, there’s no need to worry, just go ahead with the breakthrough,”
“Even if you don’t manage to condense a King Grade Martial True Pill, you will still have a chance to solidify your foundation and cultivate an Emperor Grade Martial Primordial Spirit when breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm.”
Han Li embraced Sect Hierarch Xiang Xiang, biting her exquisitely beautiful red lips, calming her nerves.
“Mmm~”
Comforted by Han Li, Lu Tianxiang indeed became less tense.
After a brief period of regulating her breath, Lu Tianxiang began her journey of breakthrough.
Her martial intent surged out and gathered above her head, slowly condensing into a pill.
It began rather illusory, but as it was continuously refined by the unceasing flow of martial intent, the Martial True Pill gradually solidified, emanating a formidable aura.
A dozen breaths later, Lu Tianxiang’s forehead was covered with a great deal of sweat, but she persisted, wanting to do even better.
“Xiang Xiang, refine the True Martial Pill,” Han Li urged urgently.
Lu Tianxiang’s Martial True Pill had already reached Second Grade, but she still wanted to push it to the First Grade. Clearly, she had reached her limit.
Lu Tianxiang gritted her teeth but obeyed her husband’s command, swallowing the True Martial Pill in her mouth and began refining it with her powers.
As the True Martial Pill was assimilated, a powerful force entered her body, boosting her martial intent and causing the force refining the Martial True Pill to surge instantly.
Three breaths later, the Martial True Pill ascended to the First Grade.
Nine breaths later, the Martial True Pill neared the King Grade.
Han Li’s brow raised; he discovered that the True Martial Pill was somewhat lacking in strength and could not help Lu Tianxiang condense a King Grade True Pill.
Without hesitation, Han Li took out another True Martial Pill and had Lu Tianxiang refine it.
The True Martial Pill was a Second Grade Spirit Pill, equivalent to a Heaven Rank treasure. Han Li had opened quite a few from treasure chests, and aside from this one, he still had seven in reserve.
Surprise flickered in Lu Tianxiang’s eyes, but she did not refuse and obediently followed the command, refining the second True Martial Pill.
With the assistance of the new True Martial Pill, Lu Tianxiang successfully condensed a King Grade Martial True Pill.
Subsequently, with a single thought, her realm broke through, and after some time, she successfully advanced to the True Martial Realm, becoming a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
“My husband, thank you,”
After the breakthrough, Lu Tianxiang immediately threw herself into Han Li’s arms, her face filled with gratitude.
She knew her husband likely had more True Martial Pills, but Lu Tianxiang never considered asking for more. After all, her sisters also needed to break through to the True Martial Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: Chapter 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_4
She hadn’t expected her husband to also present her with a True Martial Pill without any hesitation, which showed just how much he cared for her.
When her husband had captured her previously, he had promised to help her ascend to the True Martial Realm. Less than a decade had passed, and she had already advanced. The prospects of breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm and the Tongxuan Realm in the future were highly promising.
She was extremely grateful to be his wife.
“Xiangxiang, is this how you thank your husband?”
Han Li, with a mischievous smile on his face, scooped up Xiangxiang, the Sect Hierarch, as she bowed her head, and carried her deep into the sleeping chambers.
The Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang had broken through to the True Martial Realm and become Emperor Wu, which likely meant her combat strength had soared.
Elder Han sought to exchange insights with the Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang to see who was stronger. As the two discussed the profound mysteries and Elder Han explained the principles, he did so in a way that was both deep and simple, captivating the Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang, leaving her utterly defeated.
In the blink of an eye, five months had gone by.
During these months, Han Li hadn’t taken any concubines in Han Mansion mainly because he couldn’t find an appropriate target.
But he continued to take concubines in The Li Manor; over five months, he had taken seven beautiful concubines, each according to the new standards.
With dual cultivation during this time, all the wives and concubines in both mansions had their cultivation levels surge, with many advancing by one or several minor realms.
During this period, Han Li often taught his descendants, imparting various experiences and vigorously training those on the key cultivation list, enabling them to continue breaking through.
With the Life-Prolonging Furnace and the Time-Sky Tower complementing each other, Han Mansion had entered an explosive period of growth, with its foundation rapidly increasing. The more time passed, the stronger the foundation became.
The efficacy of the Life-Prolonging Furnace was incredibly strong, incomparable to that of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and the imitation Body-Cultivating Furnace, offering six major auxiliary effects.
First, Mysterious Creation. The Life-Prolonging Furnace could absorb higher level spiritual energy from the unknown and condense it into a Spirit Source. It could also attract external spiritual energy to refine into Spirit Source, albeit at a lower efficiency.
This higher level spiritual energy was almost like Immortal Qi, far superior to the higher level spiritual energy from the Soul-Cultivating and Body-Cultivating Furnaces.
As long as there was an ample supply of this high-level Spirit Source, the Life-Prolonging Furnace could create powerful combatants, such as the Five-Directional Mystical Beasts. At its strongest, it could create beings at the beginning of the Sacred Abyss Realm, necessitating a considerable amount of Spirit Source to maintain just two of them.
Second, after undergoing the purification of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, the aptitude of the purified individual would increase by one grade, reaching up to the highest, first grade, and their comprehension would also greatly improve.
It’s possible to undergo this purification three times a month, each time consuming quite a bit of Spirit Source. One could also provide Spirit Source to empower the Life-Prolonging Furnace, thus increasing the number of purifications up to a maximum of six times a month.
Third, entering the Life-Prolonging Furnace for tempering, which takes a day. One could also only be tempered three times a month, each session consuming a considerable amount of Spirit Source.
The tempering subject’s physical cultivation and Divine Spirit would surge, varying with individual cultivation, the increase from a single tempering could be up to tenfold.
Fourth, cultivating within the range of the Life-Prolonging Furnace would enhance cultivation speed by over a hundred times, accommodating a maximum of ten people. The increase in cultivation would diminish as the number of people increased.
Fifth, the Spirit Source of the Life-Prolonging Furnace could rapidly heal injuries to the body and Divine Spirit, allowing cultivators to return to their peak condition. Even without injuries, while within the range of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, one’s body and Divine Spirit would always be in peak condition, aiding in cultivation, understanding of the Dao, and spellcasting.
Sixth, the Life-Prolonging Furnace could assist cultivators in their breakthrough, increasing the likelihood of success.
Below the Hollow Void Stage, the chance of breakthrough was one hundred percent. For the Hollow Void Stage, it increased the chance by eighty percent, Myriad Phenomena Realm by sixty percent, True Martial Realm by forty percent, Divine Yuan Realm by twenty percent, Tongxuan Realm by ten percent, Sacred Abyss Realm by five percent, and by two percent for advancing to Quasi Emperor.
The highest it could help was to Quasi Emperor, for after all, the Life-Prolonging Furnace was only a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon and couldn’t help cultivators ascend to the Heaven Imperial Realm and become a Great Emperor.
Even so, it didn’t affect the status of the Life-Prolonging Furnace as an ancient treasure.
Because of these six effects, even though the Life-Prolonging Furnace was only a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, its status in the Nine Solar Heavens, the number one sacred land in the Crimson Divine State, was no less than that of emperor-level weapons.
Having learned of the efficacy of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, Han Li was delighted, heaping praise upon Yin Ling and was also eager to repair the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s injuries.
Currently, the Life-Prolonging Furnace was only at seventy percent of its peak power, and its six faculties were all considerably discounted to only seventy percent of their usual potency.
Han Li knew that this process couldn’t be rushed—fixing the Life-Prolonging Furnace would take time. As soon as suitable Immortal Gold or Divine Iron appeared from the treasure chest, he could feed it to Yin Ling.
Now, Yin Ling had completely integrated into Han Mansion, spending its days in the small space within the Void Bell, happily playing with the Void Bell’s Artifact Spirit Zi Yi, the Dao Decapitating Sword’s Artifact Spirit JianJi, and the Time-Sky Tower’s Artifact Spirit Ling Shiqi. The four little Artefact Spirit girls were joyful every day.
In the past five months, Han Li had opened five treasure chests, each costing five years of cultivation—a total of twenty-five years of cultivation.
This expenditure wasn’t significant, and occasionally they yielded excellent items. Han Li felt it was very worthwhile. As for opening a second or third treasure chest each month, that wasn’t as valuable, as there was no guarantee of good results.
With each opening of the treasure chest, Han Li would either “shed dragon scales” or “support the demon ascension”, and sometimes he would “cherish fragrance and pity jade”, borrowing a bit of their luck in the process.
Overall, the gains were quite good. Out of the five treasure chests, three contained excellent items, with only two being fairly average. Still, there were no instances of particularly bad luck.
The first “shedding dragon scales” yielded a Divine Rank Supreme Grade Cultivation Technique, the “Life and Death Sacred Scripture”.
The second “shedding dragon scales” revealed a Lower Grade Divine Medicine, the “Three Netherworld Grass”.
The first “supporting the demon ascension” revealed an Emperor Level mid-grade weapon, the “Combat Tower”.

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: Chapter 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_5
The second time I supported the Demon Clan and rose up, I unlocked the Heaven Rank Supreme martial skill “Metallic Sword Secret”.
The first time I took pity on a woman because of her beauty, I produced a Lower Grade Divine Pill “Primordial Spirit Pill”.
Han Li was quite satisfied with this achievement and decided to engage more in seeing the dragon shed its armor, supporting the Demon Clan’s rise or taking pity on a woman because of her beauty in the future and to also sample new delights.
The Three Netherworld Grass is a main ingredient in refining a Divine Yuan Realm elixir which helps the growth of the Primordial Spirit; its effects are quite impressive. Once obtained, he cultivated it immediately.
With the nourishment of the Spirit Source from the Life-Prolonging Furnace, the Three Netherworld Grass survived the transplant; but to transform a single Divine Medicine into ten, a hundred, or even more is still a long and arduous task.
The Primordial Spirit Pill is similar to the True Martial Pill and Tongxuan Pill in that it helps cultivators break through major realms. It can increase the likelihood of breaking through from the peak of the True Martial Realm to the Divine Yuan Realm by fifty percent, and can also enhance the grade of a martial Primordial Spirit by one to three grades.
This kind of breakthrough elixir, when used in conjunction with the Life-Prolonging Furnace, yields the best effects. The breakthrough probability will be further increased and is nearly a sure bet, and it can also increase the quality of the Martial True Pill and martial Primordial Spirit.
The Metallic Sword Secret turned out to be the lowest-grade item from the five treasures, merely being at Heaven Rank Supreme level. Fortunately, with the blessing of his versatile true martial intent, it rivals even those of Divine Rank Supreme.
With this martial skill, Han Li has added another technique to his arsenal in the Fifth Heaven of the Tao-mysterious Realm. When combined with the Supreme Divine Weapon said the Dao Decapitating Sword, its power will increase significantly.
The Fighting Tower is of Emperor Level medium grade, which Han Li finds slightly regrettable. It is not a true Emperor Weapon; weaponry ranging from Emperor Level lower grade to medium grade is considered quasi-Emperor, while only those from upper grade to supreme grade are true Emperor Weapons.
Despite the small grade difference between Emperor Level medium grade and upper grade, the gap between them is huge—it’s the difference between a Quasi Emperor and a Great Emperor.
The Combat Tower is a top quasi-Emperor weapon with extremely powerful offensive abilities, but what Han Li values most about it is its auxiliary function.
The Combat Tower can be used to train and test the progeny of the family.
Inside the Combat Tower, there are forty levels, each forming a space that spans from the Innate Realm to the Saint Abyss Realm. Each realm has four levels of spatial tests.
The Combat Tower will automatically generate layers of living beings, encompassing the Human Clan, Demon Clan, Barbarian Clan, Feather Clan, Stone Clan, Spirit Tribe, and various other clans and beings.
The first three levels of each realm represent the regular combat ability of that realm. If one manages to pass through and skip the fourth level, they can proceed to a new realm level to face challenges; the fourth level, however, is a cross-realm combat level. For example, the Innate Realm’s tower level is guarded by the Pihai Realm, while the True Martial Realm’s level is guarded by the Divine Yuan Realm.
Through the Combat Tower, the family’s younger generation can gain much-needed combat experience, have a battlefield to practice their martial skills, and receive rewards given by Han Li for passing through certain levels.
Especially for those descendants who pass through the fourth level of each realm, they will be included in Han Li’s list for core progeny cultivation.
This is a new initiative that he plans to fully implement once the Han Mansion and The Li Manor merge. The descendants from The Li Manor all have aptitude and are of at least sixth grade, which theoretically makes most of them meet the criteria for key cultivation.
Hence, Han Li has devised a core progeny cultivation list to specifically train extremely talented individuals who can fight across a Big Realm. By focusing more on these descendants, providing them with better treatment, he can help them reach farther and higher.
