The Life and Death Sacred Scripture is a top-tier cultivation technique of the Saint Abyss Realm level. Han Li placed it in the library, available for anyone interested to cultivate, though certain privileges are required for access.
Currently, there are two types of cultivation techniques practiced in Han Mansion: one is to primarily cultivate the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture, with the secondary cultivation of other techniques, which can then be integrated into the former, potentially deriving the most suitable technique for oneself, which can also see an increase in quality.
The second type is to not cultivate the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture at all but to directly concentrate on other powerful techniques, such as the Life and Death Sacred Scripture. This method is simple and direct, and one can cultivate it much faster, but it’s difficult to forge one’s own path.
Han Li and his many beautiful wives have chosen the first path, while among the concubines and descendants, only a small portion choose the first path, with the majority taking the second.
Last time, the Wind and Cloud Illusion Scripture was obtained. Han Li integrated it into his Chaos Scripture, which noticeably increased its grade, but not quite reaching the Divine Rank medium grade. Probably another three or four Divine Rank medium grade techniques are needed to achieve it.
This time, having obtained the Divine Rank Supreme Life and Death Sacred Scripture, Han Li, after cultivating it, integrated it into the Chaos Scripture, directly raising it to a Divine Rank upper grade technique.
Now, the Chaos Scripture Han Li cultivates is also of the Saint level, which has greatly amplified his strength, but not to the extent he imagined.
His True Yuan reserve increased from comparing favorably with the Tao-mysterious Realm First Heaven to the Fourth Heaven, but his combat ability has not jumped another Big Realm.
The main reason is that the gap in combat ability between various levels is enormous. Even between the mid-phase and latter stage of the Tao-mysterious Realm, there’s a significant threshold. Pushing one’s combat ability past it is rather challenging.
Han Li estimates there are three ways to boost his ultimate combat ability. The first is to raise his realm, to enter the Later Stage of the Divine Yuan Realm. The second is to develop Divine Sense and explore further in that field.
The third way is to obtain an Emperor Level martial technique, mastering a lower or medium grade attack-oriented Emperor Level technique to perfection.
“Hoo~”
Exhaling a long breath, Han Li decided to focus on all three, ensuring a comprehensive enhancement of his own strength.
Just then, Lu Tianxiang flew up, landing next to Han Li and leaned on his shoulder, softly calling out, “Husband~”
“What’s wrong, Xiangxiang?”
Han Li sensed that the Sect Hierarch called Xiangxiang had something on her mind, it was almost written on her face, hard to miss.

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: Chapter 188: Xiangxiang Advances to the True Martial Realm! The Effects of the Life-Prolonging Furnace! Traps in the Immortal Scripture Begin to Emerge! Xue Yueqing Sets Out_6
“Husband, ever since I’ve broken through to the True Martial Realm, I’ve felt a mysterious call growing stronger as time passes.”
“I’ve thought it over, and it must be because of the cultivation technique I am practicing, the ‘Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture.’ This unseen calling seems to be guiding me to seek out the remaining parts of the scripture.”
Lu Tianxiang’s expression was one of worry as she sighed.
Had it been earlier, she would have certainly rushed off in search of it excitedly, but now she no longer wanted to. She had a good husband, and she was not in need of powerful cultivation techniques, being able to practice even Shengyuan Realm techniques at will.
The ‘Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture’ may be an Immortal Scripture, but it only consisted of the first half and was likely missing the latter or middle parts.
Previously, she didn’t want to switch because she wanted to cultivate a complete Immortal Scripture, but now it seemed pointless. Instead of chasing after an elusive Immortal Scripture, it was more practical to practice saint-level cultivation techniques.
Moreover, the continuation of the ‘Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture’ could very well be hidden with hazards and traps, waiting for her to fall into them.
Otherwise, why would this mysterious call come forth just after she made a breakthrough to the True Martial Realm and perfected the initial part of the ‘Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture’? It couldn’t be such a coincidence.
Han Li raised his eyebrows, aware of Lu Tianxiang’s situation. He had previously urged her to switch to a different cultivation technique, but now his thoughts had changed as well.
He wanted Lu Tianxiang to continue her practice.
Even with the help of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, Lu Tianxiang’s potential could only be raised to a first-grade level at most, allowing her to practice up to the Tongxuan Realm, but reaching the Shengyuan Realm would be difficult. However, with the ‘Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture,’ it was different.
This Immortal Scripture might contain the means to help cultivators break through to the Shengyuan Realm and even the Heaven Imperial Realm or become immortal by transcending tribulations.
It’s just that Lu Tianxiang only knew too little of the ‘Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture,’ only the parts up to the True Martial Realm. The latter parts were the most critical.
The first half only recorded some trivial information and didn’t even include the breakthrough from the Myriad Phenomena Realm peak to the True Martial Realm or the method to condense King Grade Pills, let alone the method for condensing them.
Han Li had long determined that this Immortal Scripture was a trap, waiting for someone to cultivate it up to the True Martial Realm, then when they tried to retrieve the subsequent parts, the trap would spring—or perhaps, the schemer would continue fishing, not in a hurry to reap the harvest.
Now that he had grown much stronger and possessed the Void Bell, a top-tier Emperor-grade weapon, Han Li was confident he could take out this old monster scheming in the dark and claim the complete ‘Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture.’
Once Lu Tianxiang successfully cultivated the complete ‘Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture,’ he believed her achievement would be tremendous. Han Li did not want her to become indistinguishable from the masses. As his first wife, he held special affection for her.
Not just for Lu Tianxiang, but for Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and others as well, Han Li intended to pave the way for them, striving to enable them to cultivate to higher realms.
As for those beautiful concubines, Han Li had also come to terms. If they felt that immortality was meaningless and wished to die and reincarnate, he would not compel them any longer. However, if they wanted to live longer, he would provide the necessary assistance.
Embracing Sect Hierarch Lu Tianxiang, Han Li contemplated for a moment before saying, “Let’s do this, Tianxiang, take your time. In two or three years, your husband will assist you in retrieving the subsequent cultivation techniques of the ‘Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture.’
Although he was quite confident about going now, Han Li preferred to wait until he was absolutely certain. Otherwise, if the fisherman turned out to be a Prehistoric Giant Crocodile, he might find himself in deep trouble.”
“I’ll listen to my husband~”
Lu Tianxiang nodded, her alabaster, jade-like face shedding all worries and blossoming into a smile. Her enchantress charm emerged as she took the initiative to bite Han Li’s lips.
“How does Tianxiang want to repay her husband?” Lu Tianxiang asked shyly and timidly.
“Hahaha~ Of course, by allowing your husband to tenderly cherish his jewel.”
Laughing, Han Li scooped up Lu Tianxiang, and the two figures vanished from the peak of Chengdao Peak.
“Boom, boom, boom~”
Atop Chengdao Peak, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Bai Keqing, Long Yue, and others were startled awake, looking up at the sky, thinking it was going to rain, but found the sky clear and cloudless.
Yet, this urgent sound, resonating like thunder, echoed throughout Chengdao Peak, making the peak itself seem to shake.
The women exchanged glances, their Spiritual Sense surging forth to inspect the outside world, and saw that everything was as usual with the residents of Han Mansion, hearing nothing out of the ordinary. Then they understood.
Feeling somewhat helpless, they thought that the commotion caused by their husband this time was rather loud. Next time, we should do the same.
After a brief search, they learned that their husband was ‘battling’ with Lu Tianxiang, as she hadn’t come out and all of them were present there.
Demon Domain, Myriad Demon Mountain.
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, who had been in seclusion for a long time, finally emerged.
Although she concealed her aura, there was a faint instability to it, a sign of a recent breakthrough in her realm.
“Sigh~ I’ve still made the breakthrough.”
A smile appeared on Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing’s face, for she had devoted much effort for this trip to the Xuan Domain.
She had used some precious treasures she had been reluctant to utilize before, refining them one by one, all to raise her realm.
She succeeded, breaking through from the third layer of the Divine Yuan Realm to the fourth.
It was just a minor increase in her level, but it was a significant jump from the early stage to the middle stage of the Divine Yuan Realm, and her combat ability had greatly improved.
Previously, she was not very sure about her journey to the Xuan Domain, but now she felt much more confident. With her current combat ability, she surely could achieve excellent results.
Leaving her place of seclusion, Xue Yueqing’s figure appeared at the peak of Myriad Demon Mountain, where she bowed and said, “Ancestor, Xue Yueqing wishes to borrow the Heavenly Moon Wheel.”
“Granted!”
A mighty voice rang out, followed by the appearance of a moon wheel, radiating divine light and potent force.
“Thank you, Ancestor!”
Xue Yueqing expressed her gratitude respectfully, picked up the Heavenly Moon Wheel, and vanished from the summit of Myriad Demon Mountain.
She only possessed a Top Grade Divine Weapon, which was a Shengyuan Realm Weapon, but compared to the Heavenly Moon Wheel, there was a significant difference. The Heavenly Moon Wheel was a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon with a complete Artifact Spirit and capable of unleashing terrifying power.
Moreover, the Heavenly Moon Wheel was quite compatible with her, and she had long coveted this Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, only her status was not yet sufficient.
According to the Ancestor, she needed to cultivate to the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm before she could wield this Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, at which point she would be able to unleash the combat ability of a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse.
“Finally, it’s complete.”
With high spirits, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing departed, her figure leaving Myriad Demon Mountain and heading toward the Xuan Domain.
With the Heavenly Moon Wheel in her possession, her venture was almost certain to be successful.
However, before that, she needed to search the Xuan Domain to find her trusted subordinate, the female Demon King Bai Keqing.
Bai Keqing had been missing for seven or eight years, and although the life lamp showed no danger to her life and even appeared more vigorous, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was still somewhat worried.
She also wanted to see what exactly Bai Keqing was up to that allowed her cultivation to advance so rapidly in such a short time, seemingly reaching the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm.
Who exactly was Ye Fan, the one who rescued Bai Keqing? Xue Yueqing had investigated for years without a single clue.
Now that she had the chance, she decided to go in person. She shared a special bond with Bai Keqing that even Bai Keqing herself was unaware of.
With this fallback in place, she could trace Bai Keqing’s whereabouts.
When Xue Yueqing had created this fallback, it was to avoid accidents. Should something happen to Bai Keqing, she wanted to be able to rescue her.
As Bai Keqing had cultivated all the way to the True Martial Realm, Xue Yueqing thought she would not need this fallback, but as it turned out, it was still necessary.
Bai Keqing had great potential. If she could receive the support of Myriad Demon Mountain, there was hope for her to break through to the Divine Yuan Realm and become a new Demon Emperor.
That way, Xue Yueqing would have an additional helper, and the Demon Clan’s combat ability would be strengthened.
Despite the pressure from the Human Clan, the internal unity of the Demon Clan was quite strong, though there was competition, just not as intense as that within the Human Clan.
As the Demon Emperor, in order to gain more cultivation resources and a higher status, she too needed to achieve accomplishments worthy enough for the Ancestor to grant her.
PS: I got up at half-past eight to use the restroom, then started writing without even having breakfast. Finally finished, I’ll post earlier since it’s done ahead of schedule.

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - 189: Marry the Bodhisattva first, then seek the scriptures; let down neither the Buddha nor your beloved! The uncertain Red-haired monster? (Long chapter, please subscribe)_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: Chapter 189: Marry the Bodhisattva first, then seek the scriptures; let down neither the Buddha nor your beloved! The uncertain Red-haired monster? (Long chapter, please subscribe)_1
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
Han Li stood atop Chengdao Peak, overlooking the entire Chengsheng Mountain, taking in the full view of Han Mansion.
All the mountains planned before now served a purpose, and Han Li once again allocated several peaks, expanding the activity area for the Han Mansion’s disciples.
On Yandao Peak stood the fighting tower. On Yangdao Peak was the Life-Prolonging Furnace. On Enlightenment Peak were the Enlightenment Stone and the Time-Sky Tower. Zaidao Peak housed the Nine Tribulations Sacred Lotus, Three Netherworld Grass, and the Mystical Beast Kui Bull, which might later become an area for cultivating precious medicinal fields.
Chengdao Peak was the living area for Han Li and his cherished wives and concubines. Yundao Peak held the main hall where all sorts of assemblies were convened. Xiu Dao Peak had various pavilions, designated for Alchemy, Artifact Refining, Talisman Making, and Formation areas, with Guest Elders skilled in the Four Arts of Cultivation concentrated there.
In addition, there were Hudao Peak and Dengdao Peak.
Han Li planned Hudao Peak to be the area for the Han Mansion’s protectors. Currently, it was only inhabited by Hollow Void Stage, God Refining Realm, and Gangyuan Realm protectors; as he revealed more of his power, Han Li would continue to recruit stronger protectors.
Currently, those Hollow Void Stage and God Refining Realm protectors were secretly recruited by Han Li. The protectors also had different ranks, based on their cultivation level and their contributions.
Dengdao Peak was designated as the residential area for those Han Mansion descendants earmarked for key cultivation. In the future, once The Li Manor merged, many descendants from The Li Manor would also move to Dengdao Peak, which symbolized their status.
As for the other descendants and all servants and maids, they lived in the vast foothills and mid-mountain areas, etc., where a large number of buildings had been constructed.
Only certain personal maids could live on each main peak and sub-peak, holding a higher status within Han Mansion.
In the future, Han Li also intended to plan out Cangdao Peak to house Han Mansion’s scriptoreum, which was currently placed on Yundao Peak.
Han Li was waiting—for the emergence of new space-related Divine Weapons or Emperor Weapons. Then, he would be able to categorize all of Han Mansion’s cultivation techniques, martial arts, secret techniques, and various historical records and observations into different classes.
Supreme Grade Divine Weapons and above all have complete Artifact Spirits to manage the scriptoreum, so there wouldn’t be a need for Han Li to worry too much. There would be no issues of loss or theft, as everything was under the supervision of the Artifact Spirit.
The Artifact Spirit could also check the entrant’s authority, deciding whether to allow them access to higher floors, monitoring their activities within, exchanging their contributions for learning more cultivation techniques and martial arts.
Han Li saw a large gathering of Han Mansion’s people on Yandao Peak, including his descendants and the Han Mansion’s Guest Elders and protectors. They were engaged in lively discussions, all eyes on the imposing forty-story Emperor Tower.
Inside the fighting tower, a descendant of the Han Mansion was attempting to break through the levels, while those outside were discussing how far the person inside could go.
On the other side of the fighting tower stood a giant stele, smooth as jade and a hundred zhang high, bearing the names recorded on it. This was a ranking list created by Han Li, kept up-to-date in real-time by the fighting tower’s Artifact Spirit.
The stele had two leaderboards. The first was visible to everyone and recorded the performances of Han Mansion’s descendants, protectors, Guest Elders, and so on.
The second leaderboard recorded the performances of Han Li’s cherished wives and concubines; it was hidden on regular days and required special permission to be accessed.
Those who made it onto the first leaderboard and showed immense potential, such as clearing the fourth level of each realm, would have their names prominently marked, catching everyone’s attention.
Han Li was trying various methods to motivate the Han Mansion’s descendants to diligently cultivate. Only when the descendants grew stronger could they provide more cultivation energy to him and become talents capable of standing on their own.
At present, the descendant’s growth time was too short, or rather, Han Li’s growth was too rapid, so much so that his descendants couldn’t keep up and seemed rather insignificant.
Han Li was aware of these circumstances and was making great efforts to improve the situation. The Life-Prolonging Furnace, Time-Sky Tower, and the fighting tower, alongside the prioritized cultivation lists and core cultivation lists, were all created for this purpose.
Once the Xuan Domain incident was over, his power would advance further. Then he would reveal his True Martial Realm combat ability to the public and start to settle and develop further.
After a decade or two, or perhaps even longer, these descendants of Han Mansion should be able to grow up. After all, he had provided such excellent cultivation conditions, Han Li felt it was not inferior to those Sacred Lands.
There were too many disciples in the Sacred Lands with fierce competition—how could their privileges be better than those given to the Han Mansion descendants?
Thinking of the Xuan Domain incident, Han Li suddenly sighed. Even he had to participate in this matter, of course by going incognito. When the time came, he would use this alias to support his true self.
The Xuan Domain incident had significant implications; if mishandled, it could affect the entire Qianyuan Divine Province and trigger a major catastrophe, disrupting his peaceful life.
This was something Han Li didn’t wish to see; he preferred a life where everyone was amicable. The atmosphere in the Dao Domain was what Han Li liked.
However, Han Mansion couldn’t just move to the Dao Domain. Developing under the watchful eyes of Bai Yujing wasn’t very favorable, and his frequent marrying and taking of concubines would draw too much attention in the Dao Domain.
The cultivators of the Dao Domain might criticize and cause an uproar, with some self-righteous cultivators even coming to his doorstep to cause trouble.
Defeating a small one would bring a bigger one, defeating a big one would bring an elder, and defeating an elder would bring an even older one. Continuing this way would inevitably involve Bai Yujing, after all, Bai Yujing is the ancestral home of the Dao Sect, and many cultivators in the Dao Domain had connections to Bai Yujing.
The Human Clan had four great Sacred Lands: Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, and the House of Divine Armies, among which Bai Yujing was the strongest, with Xumi Mountain and Heavenly Demon Hall being somewhat similar.

chapters.title: Chapter 347: 189: Marrying the Bodhisattva Before Obtaining the Sutras, Not Letting Down the Buddha or You! The Vague Red-Haired Monster? (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Chapter 189: Marrying the Bodhisattva Before Obtaining the Sutras, Not Letting Down the Buddha or You! The Vague Red-Haired Monster? (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_2
The House of Divine Armies is the weakest and the most amiable, lacking any ideological disputes with the Dao Sect, Demon Clan, and Buddhist Sect; however, the Dao Sect, Buddhist Sect, and Demon Clan are fiercely competitive with each other.
Therefore, Han Li simply abandoned this thought.
“Can they really handle it well?” Han Li sighed softly.
He always felt that the major Sacred Lands had somewhat underestimated the incident in the Xuan Domain, sending only some Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors to handle it. Were they looking down on that existence too much?
Over the years, affected by the incident in the Xuan Domain, Han Li had not spared any effort in gathering intelligence to understand what exactly the Xuan Domain incident was about, and had roughly figured out which Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors the various powers had dispatched to deal with it.
All four Sacred Lands of the Human Clan had Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors emerging from seclusion: Bai Yujing’s third Sect Leader Lu Zhen, Xumi Mountain’s Joyful Arhat, Heavenly Demon Hall’s Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, and the House of Divine Armies’ Prison Spear Emperor Jiang Taijing.
The Demon and Barbarian Clans also had Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors in action, with the Barbarian Emperor Lí Mán descending from the Pinnacle of Stars, and it was said that the Demon Clan was overseen by the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing in recent years.
It was rumored that Lu Zhen was a Sixth Heaven Martial Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm, and some speculated he had broken through to the Later Stage of the Divine Yuan Realm. The other Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors were not easy to provoke either.
The Heaven Lord of Emperor Mingtian, which had moved from the East Sea to the Chaotic Domain and controlled a third of its territory, also spread word that he would go to the Xuan Domain. It was said that this was a Fourth Heaven Martial Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Then there was the Ancient Empire, the only Divine Yuan Realm power native to the Xuan Domain. The incident was right in Xuan Domain, and the Ancient Empire was the first to bear the brunt. That old ancestor of the Ancient Empire would also emerge, his cultivation level unclear.
Some speculated he was still in the Early Stage of the Divine Yuan Realm, while others guessed that the old ancestor of the Ancient Empire had advanced to the Middle Stage of the Divine Yuan Realm, possessing formidable strength.
The Ancient Empire had been able to stand in the Xuan Domain for over sixteen thousand years, controlling a third of the Xuan Domain’s territory. According to legend, the Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor who founded the Ancient Empire had inherited the legacy of some Saint Abyss Realm Power, likely commanded a Sacred Soldier, but had never used it.
Others also spotted the trace of Fairy Qing Shuang from the Penglai Immortal Sect. The Penglai Immortal Sect, located deep in the East Sea on Penglai Fairy Island, was a place Han Li had only read about in various biographies; he didn’t expect they would send someone as well.
These Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors should mostly be arriving with Sacred Soldiers in tow. Theoretically, they should be able to handle the situation well, but deep down, he had an ominous premonition, so he had to go check it out himself, albeit incognito.
Out of the nine Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors, Han Li was most concerned with only two, with another two garnering slight attention.
The first two were Fairy Qing Shuang from the Penglai Immortal Sect and the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing from Myriad Demon Mountain—both were Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors. Xue Yueqing had long been a target for Han Li, and now Fairy Qing Shuang had also entered his list of targets.
He considered whether to seize this opportunity to capture both Female Martial Emperors at once; both Fairy Qing Shuang and Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing were young and powerful Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors, with at least Second Grade talent.
Among his wives, he lacked those with Second Grade talent and beautiful female cultivators, as well as a Divine Yuan Realm Female Martial Emperor; Han Li was very curious to experience what that would be like.
Han Li was plotting in his mind how to get his hands on Fairy Qing Shuang and Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was an important member of the Sacred Land, Myriad Demon Mountain, and currently in charge of it, while Fairy Qing Shuang’s Penglai Immortal Sect might not be a Sacred Land, but was not far off, housing Tongxuan Realm experts and Immortal Weapons that ensured its destiny.
Han Li was worried that capturing both Fairy Qing Shuang and Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing in a short period would create a tremendous shockwave, enough to rock the entire Qianyuan Divine Province. It was unlikely that Myriad Demon Mountain and Penglai Immortal Sect would overlook it.
This would cause a backlash.
Although Han Li was not particularly wary, he still didn’t want to take too many risks. He couldn’t stand against Immortal Weapons, and the completely revived Void Bell wouldn’t hold up either.
Capturing two Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors from Penglai Immortal Sect and Myriad Demon Mountain might alarm Sacred Lands like Bai Yujing and Xumi Mountain. To protect the True Martial Realm and Divine Yuan Realm female cultivators within their Sacred Lands, they might very well join forces to trouble him.
“Should I just capture one?” Han Li sighed.
If he only captured one, it would be hard for him to let go. If Fairy Qing Shuang returned to Penglai Immortal Sect or Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing returned to Myriad Demon Mountain, another opportunity to capture them would be scarce, and he would have to wait for a very long time.
“It would be nice if they appeared one by one.”
Han Li muttered to himself, but he also knew it was quite unlikely.
These Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors would basically all be in action two years later, arriving directly in the Xuan Domain to handle the incident. How could they come one by one?
He also couldn’t track the whereabouts of Fairy Qing Shuang and Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing; his only chance would be in two years, when both Fairy Qing Shuang and Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing would appear.
Han Li felt a headache coming on. He decided to stop thinking about it for now and play it by ear when the time came. Whichever of Fairy Qing Shuang and Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was easier to capture, he would take her back as his partner.
The other two Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors he was slightly interested in were Bai Keqing from Bai Yujing, a legend throughout the Qianyuan Divine Province with a great fate upon him. Once young and ambitious, he self-proclaimed to be unbeaten “in three thousand years.”
But Bai Keqing was just over three thousand years old, and there was a good deal of exaggeration to his claims. Allegedly, he later offended a female Bodhisattva from Xumi Mountain and nearly got smacked to death by her, only saved by the intervention of a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse from Bai Yujing, resulting in him being confined.
The other was the Joyful Arhat from Xumi Mountain, whose proactive arrival in the Xuan Domain likely carried a motive of revenge against him.
Initially, Kurong Kong and Tuoshan Kong had cornered Bai Keqing in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, intending to capture her and take her back to Xumi Mountain for conversion. In the end, she surely ended up in the hands of Joyful Arhat.

chapters.title: Chapter 348: 189: Marrying the Bodhisattva Before Obtaining the Sutras, Not Letting Down the Buddha or You! The Vague Red-Haired Monster? (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Chapter 189: Marrying the Bodhisattva Before Obtaining the Sutras, Not Letting Down the Buddha or You! The Vague Red-Haired Monster? (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_3
But Demon Queen Bai Keqing was snatched away by his backup identity Ye Fan, and now she has borne him six children, becoming one of his beloved wives.
Even though the Joyous Arhat didn’t know Ye Fan was Han Li, he could definitely find out that Demon Queen Bai Keqing wasn’t dead. Coming to the Xuan Domain to deal with that matter, he could also take the opportunity to locate both Ye Fan and Bai Keqing.
If a warrior of the Divine Yuan Realm truly wants to search for someone, he has many methods at his disposal, making it very difficult for warriors of the True Martial Realm to defend against. But Grand Elder Han wasn’t just any warrior of the True Martial Realm.
Han Li could overlook previous incidents, but if the Joyous Arhat really had such intentions, then he shouldn’t blame Han Li for being discourteous. If he found the chance, he would kill the Joyous Arhat.
As for whether the death of the Joyous Arhat would lead to retaliation from Xumi Mountain, that was a certainty.
The female Bodhisattva from Xumi Mountain was not to be trifled with. She had been in charge of Xumi Mountain for thousands of years, and her strength was unfathomable. Nobody knew to what extent she had cultivated in the Tongxuan Realm.
If a warrior of the Divine Yuan Realm died, the female Bodhisattva would be furious, definitely ready to wage war to hunt him down. In such a case, Han Li could possibly implement another plan.
To capture the female Bodhisattva!
As the saying goes: First marry the Bodhisattva, then seek the scriptures.
To not let down the Buddha nor the dame!
Coveting the Bodhisattva was not a sin; it would just help her relieve her loneliness.
Even if the female Bodhisattva were to hunt down a warrior of the Divine Yuan Realm, she wouldn’t likely directly revive the Immortal Soldiers, as that would be overkill. That she would bring an Emperor Level weapon to hunt him down was already a great honor to him.
After all, being a Tongxuan Realm master and one of the Sacred Land Masters, the female Bodhisattva possessed profound and unpredictable abilities, controlling many Divine Rank and Emperor Level martial techniques. To deal with a warrior of the Divine Yuan Realm, she wouldn’t even need to draw her weapon—it would be as simple as a slap in the face.
As long as he was well-prepared and chose the right battlefield, he could then activate the Array Plate of the Heavenly Punishing Divine Saint Great Array, a Supreme Grade Divine Rank large formation, and with the support of the Void Bell, catch the female Bodhisattva off guard and likely capture her.
Han Li and the Artifact Spirit Zi Yi of the Void Bell could maintain communication at all times, allowing Zi Yi to fully revive whenever necessary. However, the female Bodhisattva might not have that ability, which could be his opportunity.
If the female Bodhisattva acted similarly, the attempt to capture her might fail, invoking her extreme fury. She might return to retrieve her Immortal Soldiers to deal with him, and he would have no choice but to feign retreat.
He would make the female Bodhisattva believe he had left the Qianyuan Divine Province, then secretly return and revert to being his true self, Han Li, to discreetly develop his power, leaving the future to take care of itself.
“The female Bodhisattva is truly tempting,” Han Li couldn’t help but lick his lips and muttered to himself.
Bodhisattva, Sacred Land Master, Tongxuan Realm powerhouse… Each of these titles was a bonus point, extremely attractive to Han Li and feeding his high conquest desire.
Sighing, Han Li cut off his distractions and put aside thoughts of the female Bodhisattva for now. Capturing either the Frost Fairy or Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was his real goal, and he’d focus on that first.
The situation in the Xuan Domain was becoming increasingly intense, with unending turbulence and undercurrents. If anyone were to interfere, it would become even less likely to resolve.
According to the information Han Li had gathered, the source of the Xuan Domain incident was at Dangyang Mountain, a Divine Mountain not within the territory of the Daqian Empire, located quite a distance away.
Dangyang Mountain was one of the Five Great Divine Mountains of the Xuan Domain, towering at one hundred and eighty thousand zhang in the western part of the Xuan Domain, which was within the sphere of influence of Emperor Wu’s City.
Emperor Wu’s City was a neutral force in the Xuan Domain, not involving itself in factional struggles. The city lord’s cultivation was not high—it was said to have not yet reached the late stage of the True Martial Realm—and he spent every day at the city gates, having sat idly atop Emperor Wu’s City for eight hundred years.
Speculation was rife in the outside world, but the city lord of Emperor Wu’s City did not come forward to explain and continued in his independent ways.
Emperor Wu’s City was not very far from Dangyang Mountain, just six or seven hundred thousand li away. Standing atop Emperor Wu’s City, those of higher cultivation could see Dangyang Mountain’s imposing and majestic presence, soaring into the clouds.
Below Dangyang Mountain, a powerful being with unfathomable strength was sealed. There were rumors that someone caught a fleeting glimpse and saw that this being was covered in red hair.
Han Li secretly gathered information from various sources and confirmed the truth of these rumors. That being was indeed a red-haired monster.
Eight thousand years ago, Qianyuan Divine Province had just recovered from the third great war between humans and Demon Barbarians. The unrest had calmed down, maintaining the larger pattern unchanged.
That year, a star from outside the sky fell, descending into the Chaotic Domain near the East Sea. The Sacred Land Masters paid no attention to it, but various forces battled fiercely for it.
That year, in the Chaotic Domain, there was a family known as the Lingnan Chen Family. Their patriarch was skilled in swordplay, possessed True Martial Realm cultivation, and was known as “Heavenly Blade” Chen Xilai.
As the forces contended for the fallen star, reaching a peak of heated conflict, Heavenly Blade made his move. With a slash, Chen Xilai entered the fray powerfully, slaying a True Martial Realm warrior in battle and earning tremendous acclaim.
Afterward, Heavenly Blade Chen Xilai struck with dominance, sweeping across all opponents, revealing the power of the late True Martial Realm, overshadowing the heroes, decimating heads, routing kings, and securing the fallen star.
Chen Xilai attempted to move the star back to the Lingnan Chen Family but failed as his strength was insufficient to transport even a part of the large celestial body.
It was seen that Chen Xilai unleashed a hundred and eight slashes, cleaving open the fallen star to enter its core, where he discovered a red glow with a pearl inside.
When Chen Xilai emerged, two True Martial Realm warriors ambushed him. One was slain by several slashes from Chen Xilai, while the other was gravely wounded and fled.
Carrying such a treasure, Chen Xilai dared not pursue. After issuing a stern warning, he left and didn’t return to the Lingnan Chen Family, disappearing from the world, never to be seen again.

chapters.title: Chapter 349: 189: Marrying the Bodhisattva Before Obtaining the Sutras, Not Letting Down the Buddha or You! The Vague Red-Haired Monster? (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: Chapter 189: Marrying the Bodhisattva Before Obtaining the Sutras, Not Letting Down the Buddha or You! The Vague Red-Haired Monster? (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_4
A thousand years later, a strong warrior emerged, brandishing his blade and sweeping through the Qianyuan Divine Province. Even Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors mobilized to face him fell to his sword. Blood-red sword light shone across half the Divine Province, sending tremors through all the sacred lands.
The Divine Yuan Realm martial emperor who was slain was an Arhat from the Buddha Domain’s Xumi Mountain, who had descended to enlighten this scourge. Unexpectedly, he was cut down with a single strike.
At that time, the ruler of Xumi Mountain was not the female Bodhisattva, but another Bodhisattva of the Tongxuan Realm. His cultivation and power touched fate, approaching the threshold of the Sacred Abyss Realm, with one foot almost stepping into it. People called him “Great Bodhisattva.”
What took everyone by surprise was that before the Great Bodhisattva could move to subdue the demon, the formidable emergent warrior turned his blade towards Xumi Mountain. Along the route, the Buddha nation bled, and countless monks were slaughtered.
The Great Bodhisattva was enraged and stepped out from Xumi Mountain for a showdown with this emergent demon.
It was only during that battle that the major forces of the Qianyuan Divine Province realized that the powerful demon that had emerged was Chen Xilai, who a thousand years before, had received the legacy of a meteorite from beyond the heavens.
After disappearing for a thousand years, Chen Xilai’s cultivation had skyrocketed, advancing from the late stages of the True Martial Realm through the Divine Yuan Realm and into the late stages of the Tongxuan Realm, thus becoming an unparalleled strong warrior.
But Chen Xilai, having reappeared, was no longer the same. He had gone mad, killing anyone he saw, with a bloodthirst unmatched, and he seemed to particular enjoy the fresh blood of the strong.
After slaying the Arhat of Xumi Mountain, he stood with his blade in the ninth heaven, laughing while thirstily drinking the Arhat’s blood, instilling fear in the hearts of countless cultivators.
Later, the crazed Chen Xilai continued his bloody path towards Xumi Mountain, slaying from the Devil Region to the Buddha Domain, annihilating cities and spirits alike, eventually confronting the Great Bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain directly.
At that moment, everyone knew Chen Xilai had gone mad and had lost all sense of reason; otherwise, why would he assault Xumi Mountain?
The majesty of the sacred Xumi Mountain was not to be challenged lightly. Even the most powerful beings at the later stages of the Tongxuan Realm, let alone the pinnacle Sacred Abyss Realm Great Saints, would be slain on the spot. A single flicker of sacred power could suppress a Great Saint.
Great Bodhisattva, in a fierce battle with the deranged Chen Xilai, fought heaven-shaking, earth-shattering battles on the southeastern skies of the Buddha Domain, and the void shattered, leaving the sun and moon dark, clashing for hundreds of rounds.
This sight stunned the countless strong who watched. Chen Xilai had become too strong after his madness, clearly just at the seventh layer of the Tongxuan Realm; yet, he was able to withstand the Great Bodhisattva’s might. Though disadvantaged, he was yet to be defeated.
The Great Bodhisattva was an unrivaled strong one, with half a foot in the threshold of the Sacred Abyss Realm. At the time, only the old Taoist of Bai Yujing was a match for him.
The mighty all wondered what Chen Xilai had gained from the meteorite from beyond the heavens to have ascended to this level in just a thousand years, becoming a peerless powerhouse and even turning his Heavenly Blade into a Sacred Soldier, wielding martial skills of the Sacred Abyss Realm.
Many Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors regretted not vying for it back then. Had they obtained the meteorite’s legacy, they might be the ones who had advanced to the later stages of the Tongxuan Realm today.
Even with their cultivation, they could have potentially stepped into the Sacred Abyss Realm in a thousand years. Losing sanity?
These Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors believed that they had the fortitude to resist. They were Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors, after all, and their determination was surely not something for which Chen Xilai could account.
After clashing for hundreds of rounds, the Great Bodhisattva sighed softly, retracting his intent to kill. He aimed to convert the mad Chen Xilai, to take him back to Xumi Mountain to serve as a protector, compensating for the losses the mountain had suffered.
The Great Bodhisattva executed the Buddha’s Palm intent on suppressing Chen Xilai, but what left both himself and the countless strong watching dumbfounded was his failure.
The Buddha’s Palm was an Emperor-level top-notch martial skill, created by an ancient Buddhist Sect Great Emperor. The Great Bodhisattva had cultivated it to the Great Completion Stage, capable of clashing with Saints of the Sacred Abyss Realm.
Latterly, the Great Bodhisattva discovered the source of Chen Xilai’s resistance against suppression to be a red bead inside him. With every fluctuation of this red bead, Chen Xilai grew madder, fine red hairs appeared all over his body, but his aura ballooned, nearly reaching the threshold combat ability of the Sacred Abyss Realm.
The Great Bodhisattva grew even more determined. He had to bring Chen Xilai back to Xumi Mountain. That red bead had to come under the control of the Buddhist Sect and become one of their basis, potentially allowing him to advance to the Sacred Abyss Realm.
Chen Xilai, having been injured by the Great Bodhisattva’s several Buddha’s Palm strikes, regained his sanity briefly and attempted to leave without looking back, seeking to escape from the battlefield.
But would the Great Bodhisattva let Chen Xilai get away?
To avoid complications and potential mishaps, the Great Bodhisattva made a full effort to capture him quickly. Chen Xilai had no choice but to continue stimulating the red bead, not wanting to fall into the hands of the Buddhist Sect.
After another fierce battle for a short while, the Tongxuan Realm powers of the Heavenly Demon Hall finally decided to intervene. Their Devil’s Palm obscured the sky, aiming to suppress Chen Xilai in the chaos and bring him back to the Heavenly Demon Hall.
The Great Bodhisattva shattered his Devil’s Palm with a single strike, only to see several other Tongxuan Realm powers appear, all acting together to seize Chen Xilai, each wanting to possess the red bead within him.
With many Tongxuan Realm powers present, including the two strongest of the time—the Great Bodhisattva of the Buddhist Sect and the old Taoist of Bai Yujing—Chen Xilai was no longer a match and was suppressed on the spot.
However, the Tongxuan Realm powers were at odds regarding Chen Xilai’s fate. The Great Bodhisattva claimed that Chen Xilai should belong to Xumi Mountain. The reason was that Chen Xilai had cut down an Arhat and numerous monks of Xumi Mountain and needed to repay the debt.
But the other mighty scoffed at this claim and didn’t agree. Rather than allowing the Great Bodhisattva to take Chen Xilai back to Xumi Mountain, they would prefer him slain on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 350: 189: Marrying the Bodhisattva Before Obtaining the Sutras, Not Letting Down the Buddha or You! The Vague Red-Haired Monster? (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: Chapter 189: Marrying the Bodhisattva Before Obtaining the Sutras, Not Letting Down the Buddha or You! The Vague Red-Haired Monster? (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_5
“`
The Great Bodhisattva had no choice but to agree to suppress Chen Xilai, and the site of suppression was located in one of the Dangyang Mountains in the Xuan Domain. The other powerful entities were not willing to suppress Chen Xilai in the Buddha Domain; suppressing him in the Xuan Domain was the most appropriate.
They all had their own thoughts and plans. After returning, they slowly schemed to find an opportunity to “steal the chicken” and bring Chen Xilai back to their respective Sacred Lands. Once done, other Sacred Lands, even if incensed, could do nothing about it.
Thus, the great powers left their seals on Dangyang Mountain and set up their own grand formations to prevent others from “stealing the chicken.” If there was any disturbance, they would be able to detect it immediately and rush to the scene.
Another purpose was to extract the fortune from Chen Xilai’s body. The grand formations suppressed Chen Xilai, siphoning the cultivation level of this late-stage Tongxuan Realm powerhouse. Over time, this would condense into a great opportunity. Although not useful to them, it was very useful to the Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors within the Sacred Lands.
No sooner had they laid down the seal than a red bead broke through the many grand formations and fled. The great powers immediately gave chase, casting Chen Xilai aside.
In the end, whether the red bead was obtained by any Sacred Land or genuinely disappeared without a trace remains a matter of debate, becoming an unsolved mystery.
This incident in the Xuan Domain was suspected to herald the resurgence of Chen Xilai, suppressed beneath Dangyang Mountain.
Originally, in another twenty or thirty years, Chen Xilai’s lifespan would have reached its limit, and he would have naturally died, but the formations and restrictions in Dangyang Mountain had unexpected failures. It was uncertain whether it was due to natural deterioration over time or if it was deliberately damaged.
Chen Xilai, without the red bead, was of no value to those Sacred Land Masters, and they were too lazy to go and repair the seal or slay Chen Xilai.
His cultivation was stolen by several formations, and he no longer had his former power. His cultivation fell to the Divine Yuan Realm, perhaps even to the True Martial Realm, and even his Saint Abyss Realm level Heavenly Blade had been broken.
Therefore, the various Sacred Lands dispatched their Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors to deal with the deranged Chen Xilai, to suppress him and reclaim the opportunities left by their ancestors. If possible, they naturally wanted to take more for themselves.
“I hope that red-haired monster doesn’t manage to escape.”
Gazing down at the magnificent scenery of Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li sighed to himself.
Normally, with his cultivation greatly reduced and without the Sacred Soldier or red bead, Heavenly Blade Chen Xilai would be doing well to have the combat ability of a Divine Yuan Realm martial emperor.
With the Sacred Lands’ Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors mobilized, and carrying Sacred Soldiers, suppressing Chen Xilai would be easy.
Or rather, they took Sacred Soldiers not to guard against Chen Xilai but against other Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors to seize as much fortune as possible.
The opportunity condensed from the late-stage Tongxuan Realm powerhouse’s cultivation was immensely attractive even if divided into several portions. A single share could potentially elevate a Divine Yuan Realm martial emperor by one or even two minor realms.
Han Li was worried the red-haired monster might play some tricks, which would be no fun if it escaped. His Fairy of Clear Frost, his Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, might suffer greatly, even die, creating another upheaval in the entire Qianyuan Divine Province.
Whether for his Fairy of Clear Frost, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, or the stability of the larger Qianyuan Divine Province, he had to go in disguise to take a look and act according to the situation.
While Han Li pondered these things, an incredibly beautiful figure in green clothes, peerless in elegance and grace, arrived from the eastern part of the Yuankun Domain, crossing hundreds of Divine Provinces and finally stopping above the nine heavens of a Divine Province.
Standing above the nine heavens, she was like a Heavenly Immortal descending to earth, exuding a pure and elegant aura. Her face covered with a light veil, her delicate fingers like jade were forming incantations.
She was Saint Ji Mingyue from the Huangyue Imperial Empire in the Kunji Divine Province, sent by the Huangyue Empress to search for the empress’s split soul in these thirty-seven Divine Provinces and bring back the culprit who had enraged the empress.
“Let’s start the search from here.”
Ji Mingyue looked down upon the vast Divine Continent below, her lips curling slightly upward in curiosity about who was bold enough to enrage the Huangyue Empress. She suspected that someone had desecrated the Empress’s split soul.
This Divine Province was called Yuanming Divine State, one of the thirty-six Divine Provinces governed by the ancient Qianyuan Divine Province. It did not have ancient Sacred Lands, but it housed several Saint Abyss Realm Powers.
In ancient times, the Sacred Lands of these thirty-seven Divine Provinces were concentrated in the Qianyuan Divine Province. The highest-tiered forces in other Divine Provinces were at the Heaven Imperial Realm; during the cataclysm, all Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors perished.
The now-declining Qianyuan Divine Province can no longer govern the thirty-six Divine Provinces, which have long become independent. Many Divine Provinces now have Saint Abyss Realm Powers with Saints at the helm.
These forces coveted the heritage of the Qianyuan Divine Province but dared not offend it. The heritage of the Sacred Lands was unfathomable, and as Saints, they were no match for it.
To guard against a resurgence of the Qianyuan Divine Province and its reassertion over the thirty-six Divine Provinces, the neighboring Divine Provinces had long since reached a consensus, prohibiting Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors and Tongxuan Realm powerhouses from the Qianyuan Divine Province from leaving and stepping into other Divine Provinces.
After suffering a severe blow in ancient times, the spiritual energy in the Qianyuan Divine Province was only about a tenth of that in other Divine Provinces, unable to nurture even a Saint Abyss Realm Saint.
Tongxuan Realm powerhouses from Sacred Lands like Bai Yujing and Xumi Mountain who wanted to become Saints could not leave the Qianyuan Divine Province. If they went to other Divine Provinces, they would be annihilated by Saint Abyss Realm Saints.
They also could not take away immortal weapons; immortal weapons were the foundation of the Sacred Lands and would not obey them. Artifact Spirits of immortal weapons would only defend the Sacred Lands and protect the Dao sanctuaries. Unless they were recognized by an Artifact Spirit and became the master of an immortal weapon, it would be many times harder than becoming a Saint.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 351: 189: Marrying the Bodhisattva Before Obtaining the Sutras, Not Letting Down the Buddha or You! The Vague Red-Haired Monster? (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Chapter 189: Marrying the Bodhisattva Before Obtaining the Sutras, Not Letting Down the Buddha or You! The Vague Red-Haired Monster? (Large Chapter, Please Subscribe)_6
The Tongxuan Realm powerhouses from the Sacred Lands could indeed take Emperor’s weapons to other Divine Provinces, but those Saints also had Emperor’s weapons. When Saints spurred Emperor’s weapons, their strength was far superior to theirs.
In despair, the Tongxuan Realm powerhouses of the various Sacred Lands were all trapped in the Qianyuan Divine Province, unable to leave, and the Saints from other Divine Provinces did not wish to enter.
Looking down at the Yuanming Divine State under her feet, Saint Ji Mingyue let out a soft sigh.
How glorious was the Qianyuan Divine Province in ancient times?
If it wasn’t for the plotting of grand schemes that led to the downfall of the Qianyuan Divine Province—where the Saints, Great Emperors, and Heavenly Immortals of various Sacred Lands all perished under the light of the Immortal Sword—it wouldn’t have declined to such a state.
Even the subsidiary Divine Provinces like Yuanming Divine State had been reduced to such dire straits.
Ji Mingyue could empathize somewhat, as the Huangyue Imperial Empire had also nearly fallen amidst the chaos. Fortunately, the Empress of Huangyue emerged, leading the empire to revival and its now revered status in the Endless Yuankun Domain as one of the strongest forces among the Eight Hundred Divine Regions.
Then, Saint Ji Mingyue began to take action, searching for the split soul of the Empress of Huangyue within the vast and boundless Yuanming Divine State.
The Empress of Huangyue had given her an item which, if it came within ten thousand miles of the Empress’s split soul, would produce a slight response; the closer it got, the clearer the response.
It was with this item that Saint Ji Mingyue felt confident in finding the split soul of the Empress of Huangyue.
As she moved through the Yuanming Divine State, she did not conceal her tracks. Naturally, the various powers in Yuanming Divine State noticed the figure of Saint Ji Mingyue but were extremely wary and dared not say anything.
Even the Saints within the Saint Abyss Realm Power were the same.
Saint Ji Mingyue represented the Empress of Huangyue, and she might even carry an Emperor’s weapon. If they were to obstruct her, they would offend the Empress of Huangyue.
Were the Empress of Huangyue to become enraged, the Yuanming Divine State would be razed, and all Saint Abyss Realm Powers would perish.
As Saints, they were acutely aware of the Empress of Huangyue’s domineering strength, being one of the mightiest in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
After searching for a month, Saint Ji Mingyue sighed. Yuanming Divine State had none.
In that month, she had explored Yuanming Divine State dozens, even hundreds of times, but failed to find the split soul of the Empress of Huangyue.
In the next instant, the figure of Saint Ji Mingyue disappeared from Yuanming Divine State and went toward the next Divine Province.
She could investigate each Divine Province in at most a month and in just over three years she would have explored all thirty-seven Divine Provinces thoroughly.
If she was lucky, she might complete the task assigned by the Empress of Huangyue after only searching a few Divine Provinces.
Failure to complete the task would lead to punishment upon her return, but success meant she would be richly rewarded by the Empress of Huangyue.
One month prior.
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing left from the Myriad Demon Mountain of the Demon Clan, carrying the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, Heavenly Moon Wheel, and arrived in the Xuan Domain.
She did not conceal her form as her visit was to deal with a matter in the Xuan Domain and resolve the issue with Chen Xilai of the Heavenly Blade. The Four Great Sacred Lands of the Human Clan would not openly target her.
After arriving in the Xuan Domain, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing immediately employed a Secret Technique to sense the contingency she left on the Female Demon King Bai Keqing.
However, Xue Yueqing failed.
“What’s going on?”
In the heavens, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing’s brows furrowed slightly, her eyes flashing with a trace of suspicion.
She could not sense the contingency she left with the Female Demon King Bai Keqing, yet Xue Yueqing knew it was still intact, which surprised her.
There was only one possibility, Bai Keqing was in the midst of a grand formation, and the level of that formation was very high, at least at the peak of the Tongxuan Realm, so as to isolate her senses.
But how could that be possible?
Ye Fan, who had rescued Bai Keqing from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm seven years ago, was merely at the peak of the True Martial Realm, and perhaps only had the combat ability of the peak of the True Martial Realm. How could he set up a grand formation that was at least of a supreme Divine Rank quality?
Even she, the Demon Emperor of Myriad Demon Mountain, could not set up such a formation, as the materials required were too costly, and she was not willing to part with them unless she utilized the resources of Myriad Demon Mountain.
Yet, Bai Keqing had disappeared.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was certain that Bai Keqing was within the Xuan Domain, but at this moment she could not find her.
“Could there be deceit involved?” A trace of unrest flickered in Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing’s heart.
But very quickly, she dismissed this trace of unrest. A Wu Emperor at the peak of the True Martial Realm, even if he had broken through to the Divine Yuan Realm in these past few years, could not possibly be her opponent.
Not to mention, Xue Yueqing was carrying the supreme-grade Divine Weapon, the Heavenly Moon Wheel.
The Heavenly Moon Wheel resonated well with her, and they had already established a connection. With a mere thought from her, the Heavenly Moon Wheel would fully awaken and unleash the combat ability of the Saint Abyss Realm.
“Forget it, there is still time, I will search slowly.”
Giving Dangyang Mountain a glance, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing sighed and decided to start searching.
With more than a year left, if she truly could not find her, then she had no choice but to temporarily give up. She could not afford to let the search for Bai Keqing delay the eradication of demons at Dangyang Mountain.
Now, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing did not know if she could find Bai Keqing. Although the Xuan Domain was about half the size of the Demon Domain, it still spanned over five hundred million li.
The grand formation had blocked her senses, she would need to be within a thousand li, or even a hundred li from Bai Keqing to sense her location.
Casting aside distracting thoughts, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing vanished on the spot and commenced her journey to find the female Demon King, Bai Keqing.
In another place, Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li was standing on Chengdao Peak, thinking about the matter of Dangyang Mountain and how he planned to take advantage of the chaos to capture either Fairy Qingshuang or Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
Suddenly, he turned his gaze in a certain direction of the Xuan Domain, his eyes filled with surprise and joy.
It really was like speaking of Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing and having her show up on his doorstep.
Now, his Divine Sense was always covering the entire Daqian Empire, and he had no reason to deliberately extend it any further. It wasn’t needed.
But unexpectedly, there was a pleasant surprise.
His Divine Sense had just detected a powerful aura passing by the edge of the Daqian Empire. Swiftly, it left the borders of the Daqian Empire and entered the territory of the Da Jing Imperial Empire.
Han Li immediately expanded his Divine Sense, instantaneously covering a radius of twenty million li, locating the passing figure.
After just one observation, Han Li confirmed that the Divine Yuan Realm Wu Emperor was Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing from Myriad Demon Mountain.
It’s just that Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing did not conceal her figure and didn’t make too much effort to hide her aura either, her demonic energy was too strong, making it difficult for Han Li not to recognize her.
“Truly heaven helps the old ancestor!” Han Li’s face showed joy as he disappeared from Chengdao Peak.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had delivered herself to him ahead of time, now he could capture her. When the incident at Dangyang Mountain erupted, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing might have already borne him several children.
By then, capturing Fairy Qingshuang of Penglai Immortal Sect wouldn’t be so conspicuous.

chapters.title: Chapter 352: 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Chapter 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_1
Ancient Empire.
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had only just arrived when, after exploring an area of merely two or three million miles, she felt a surge of malice descending and fixing on her.
At the same time, the Heavenly Moon Wheel, which was connected to Xue Yueqing’s mind and spirit, issued a warning, immediately putting her on alert.
With a thought, the Heavenly Moon Wheel radiated a glorious lunar brilliance, covering tens of millions of miles and causing a significant commotion.
Although she didn’t know who was targeting her, as the Demon Emperor, she was not someone to be trifled with. She decided to activate the Heavenly Moon Wheel first.
“I want to see who dares to make a move against me,” she said.
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing’s expression was icy cold, her face showing ill favor.
Originally, on her visit to the Xuan Domain, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was wandering around and had attracted considerable attention. Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm from the Ancient Empire kept an eye on her traces, and other True Martial Realm martial sovereigns and Divine Yuan Realm martial sovereigns were also silently observing.
Suddenly, as Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing erupted, a full moon appeared between heaven and earth, its moonlight shining so brightly that it made the sun pale in comparison. Its incredibly fierce power swept across all directions.
The many observing powerhouses felt a sense of palpitation. This full moon was definitely an artifact of the Sacred Abyss Realm grade. Some well-informed Divine Yuan Realm martial sovereigns recognized it immediately, identifying it as the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, the Heavenly Moon Wheel of Myriad Demon Mountain.
To the surprise of these powerhouses, nothing happened. No enemies appeared, and it seemed as if Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was simply going mad on her own.
On the peak of a massive mountain millions of miles away from Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, Han Li stood tall. He had changed his garments, now clad in fluttering green clothes, and his face was covered with a newly refined bronze mask.
To be on the safe side, to capture Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing this time, he did not reveal his true face, instead resorting to a disguise.
The last time he captured Dragon Princess Long Yue, he went in person because he was overwhelmingly more powerful than her. Moreover, Long Yue had sneaked in inconspicuously and did not attract much attention.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was different. Her visit to the Xuan Domain was done openly and attracted the attention of many. If Han Li wanted to capture her, he could not act in person.
Moreover, he needed to find the right moment when attention was at its lowest, to capture the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing in one fell swoop and take her back to Chengsheng Mountain to have children.
Otherwise, if the matter became widely known, the Four Sacred Lands of the Mortal World might not intervene, but the Demon Clan of Myriad Demon Mountain certainly would. Causing unrest in the Qianyuan Divine Province was not conducive to his later plans to capture his Fairy Clear Frost.
To his surprise, although he was a million miles away from Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, she could still sense his malice.
Indeed, a Divine Yuan Realm martial sovereign was not easy to deal with—too sensitive to hostility. This put Han Li at a disadvantage.
Especially since Xue Yueqing had the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, the Heavenly Moon Wheel of the Demon Clan, a top-tier artifact of the Sacred Abyss Realm. As soon as Xue Yueqing became agitated, she activated the Heavenly Moon Wheel, making it even harder for Han Li to take action.
As Xue Yueqing activated the Heavenly Moon Wheel, Han Li immediately used the Void Bell to envelop himself, isolating his presence in this world and entering the deep void. He also suppressed his malice and stopped thinking about capturing the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
“The old ancestor has plenty of patience. I’ll slowly wear you down, and the moment you slip up, that’s when the old ancestor will strike,” Han Li muttered to himself.
With Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing so vigilant, Han Li internally switched strategies, no longer acting openly under his true identity.
He decided to motivate his Three Mysterious Dao Bodies to evolve three identities, each donning a bronze mask. Thus, the risks were minimized.
Now, his Three Mysterious Dao Bodies rivaled Emperor Level Lower Grade martial arts, able to evolve fifteen identities. Each had 120% of his own combat ability and knew all of his techniques, martial arts, and secret techniques.
The Dao Bodies appeared to possess 120% of the original’s combat ability, but in fact, they were not as strong as the original. This was because Han Li could stimulate Divine Sense, instantly boosting his combat ability by many times, and the duration of the Divine Sense had now become very long.
As long as his original body and Dao Bodies were within three million miles of each other, the Dao Bodies could last for half a day, which was very practical.
This time, Han Li planned to arm each of his three Dao Bodies with a formidable weapon, the Life-Prolonging Furnace, the Time-Sky Tower, and the Dao Decapitating Sword. When necessary, the Life-Prolonging Furnace and the Time-Sky Tower within Han Mansion would only leave behind an illusion. Since the battle wouldn’t last long, there would be no significant effects, and nobody would notice.
The Combat Tower, a Middle Grade Emperor Weapon, would stand in Chengsheng Mountain as a deterrent, while the original Han Li carried the Void Bell. When the right moment came, he would launch a surprise attack. Just two or three million miles were nothing for the power of the Void Bell to arrive in an instant.
“Xue Yueqing, I have got you now,” Han Li said, a smirk on his face.
In the deep void, Zi Yi, Yin Ling, JianJi, and Shi Qi—the four young Artifact Spirits in the Void Bell—watched as their master Han Li’s expression turned crafty, immediately bursting into discussion. They speculated when their master would capture the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing and then ‘devour’ her.
“Oh dear, the master is so naughty,” they said.
“Hehe, another female cultivator is about to fall into the master’s hands,” they giggled.
“Wow, last time it was a flood dragon, this time a female demon. I wonder what form Xue Yueqing’s true body takes,” they wondered.
“Our little team is going to have a new member soon too. As soon as Xue Yueqing is captured by the master, the Artifact Spirit of the Heavenly Moon Wheel will also be refined by the master,” they chattered excitedly.
All four young Artifact Spirits were incredibly cute, looking carved from jade, and unanimously believed that Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had no chance of escaping from their master’s Devil’s Palm.
Above the skies of the Ancient Empire.
Xue Yueqing’s moon-white robe fluttered and whistled in the wind, her flowing hair glinting with the sheen of moonlight. Her delicate and shapely body poised gracefully, exuding an imposing presence as she stood tall in the heavens.
She had a celestial complexion and skin as white and polished as alabaster. Her body emitted a divine glow, her figure was slender, tall, and captivating. Under her thin shawl, around her snowy neck, was a face whose stunning beauty surpassed all others in this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Chapter 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_2
All people could only see her beautiful eyes behind the gauzy veil, a pair of clear and pure as autumn water, captivating.
Above her head hung a full moon, wherever she passed, the void trembled, and the sun lost its light. She possessed an unparalleled elegance that could swallow mountains and rivers, as well as a transcendent beauty likened to a true fairy in an empty valley.
At this moment, the peerless countenance beneath the veil of Xue Yueqing was somewhat indignant, her eyebrows slightly furrowed. Her divine sense covered vast territories, sweeping back and forth, constantly communicating with the Heavenly Moon Wheel’s artifact spirit.
“Why is there nothing?”
Under the bright moonlight, she was extraordinarily lovely and graceful, her beautiful eyes lit with spirit, murmuring softly to herself.
Earlier, she had clearly sensed malice, and the Heavenly Moon Wheel had warned her too, which is why she had made such a spectacle. But after the Heavenly Moon Wheel revived, sweeping across all directions, with moonlight illuminating the world, she found nothing at all.
There were only two possibilities.
Firstly, the person knowing defeat was inevitable, gave up on their scheming attack and retreated far beyond the coverage area of the Heavenly Moon Wheel.
Secondly, that person possessed a treasure capable of concealing their aura and even their malevolence, making it impossible for her to sense and for the Heavenly Moon Wheel to detect.
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing faintly felt it was the second possibility.
Before she departed from Myriad Demon Mountain, a hint of unease had arisen in her heart, but at that time she paid it no mind, dismissing it, and now it seemed to be coming true.
If it were the second case, it meant that the cultivator harboring ill intentions towards her was still covertly spying. Now the enemy was hidden while she was exposed, a situation highly unfavorable to her.
The adversary knew her cultivation level, her background, her cultivation techniques, and martial skills, and also knew she carried the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, the Heavenly Moon Wheel, while she knew nothing about the enemy in the shadows.
After taking a deep look at Dangyang Mountain, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing turned around and left, traveling back from the Da Jing Dynasty, traversing the void toward the Demon Clan’s territories.
She could no longer care about searching for Bai Keqing. Drawing this much attention, she had attracted a prying enemy. It was best to return to Myriad Demon Mountain first, otherwise, she might suffer a significant setback.
Although they did not know what had happened, all the great powers saw the Divine Yuan Realm powerhouse, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, leaving the Xuan Domain and heading south back to Myriad Demon Mountain in the Demon Domain, and they all breathed a sigh of relief.
If a battle between Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors were to break out in the Xuan Domain, with Sacred Soldiers clashing, these powers and cultivators of Xuan Domain would be in big trouble, caught in undeserved calamity.
As Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing crossed the void towards Myriad Demon Mountain in the Demon Domain, Han Li also moved, closely following behind at a distance of a million miles, concealed in the deeper layers of the void, silently waiting for an opportunity.
The return of Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing to the Demon Domain was exactly what he wanted; this path would lead her through the Devil Region, and there was no better place to make a move.
If Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing were to disappear in the Devil Region, then let the Demon Domain and Devil Region fight it out. Myriad Demon Mountain could pressure the Heavenly Demon Hall, but they wouldn’t be able to trace it back to him, Han Li.
Elsewhere, Emperor Wu’s City.
On top of the city wall, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City, who had been sitting in meditation for eight hundred years, opened his eyes for the first time in many years, looking towards the direction of Da Jing Dynasty, his gaze as calm as an ancient well.
“Why has Xue Yueqing also come early?”
The middle-aged lord of Emperor Wu’s City, dressed in Xuanhuang Battle Armor, wondered to himself, his expression unchanged, but a sense of urgency growing within him.
He had already gathered detailed intelligence that Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors from Dangyang Mountain were coming.
Many Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors had yet not set out, after all, it was almost two years until the Dangyang Mountain incident was set to erupt. Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors were extremely fast and would not take long to reach Dangyang Mountain in the Xuan Domain.
Lu Zhen, the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, and the fairy of Penglai Immortal Sect had already revealed their presence in the Xuan Domain and then disappeared again.
The fairy’s early arrival was understandable due to the distance; her Penglai Immortal Island was located deep in the East Sea, billions of miles from the Xuan Domain.
The Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, Lu Zhen, had been in Baiyujing for over a thousand years. Now that he had left his seclusion, first visiting Penglai Immortal Sect and wandering around Qianyuan Divine Province, following behind the fairy was also within reason.
But what business did Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing have in the Xuan Domain so early?
Both the Demon Domain and the Xuan Domain were on the Divine Continent, so Xue Yueqing had no reason to come early, did she?
Or was Xue Yueqing searching for something?
Watching Xue Yueqing’s movements from afar, Emperor Wu’s City lord’s pupils suddenly narrowed as Xue Yueqing activated the power of the Heavenly Moon Wheel. Not long after, she carried the Heavenly Moon Wheel across the void, heading south, seemingly wanting to return to Myriad Demon Mountain in the Demon Domain.
Although he was somewhat puzzled by Xue Yueqing’s actions, Emperor Wu’s City lord finally breathed easier; it was better for Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing to leave the Xuan Domain.
Withdrawing his gaze, he stared at Dangyang Mountain tens of thousands of miles away, his heart like tumultuous waves.
“After planning for hundreds of years, it’s finally time to reap the rewards.”
Emperor Wu’s City lord muttered to himself, a smug look flashing in the depths of his eyes. This Qianyuan Divine Province was vast, but no one knew that the breaking of the seal on Dangyang Mountain was his doing.
Eight thousand years ago, he had fallen into Qianyuan Divine Province along with a meteor from beyond the heavens. His Primordial Spirit, severely damaged and extremely weak, fled, leaving all behind within the star, most of which was destroyed, save for his most important treasure.
That red bead, named Heavenly Evil Orb, was an unparalleled treasure from his previous life, a remnant from the Ancient Era. Although not an Emperor Level weapon, it was an artifact of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
The Heavenly Evil Orb was an Emperor Level treasure that aided in cultivation, significantly boosting a cultivator’s speed, but it was extremely malevolent.
With that Heavenly Evil Orb, he had overcome numerous challenges, advancing rapidly in his cultivation to the Quasi Emperor realm, his fame shaking the Endless Yuankun Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 354: Chapter 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_3
When he reached the peak of the Quasi-Emperor level, he was trapped for tens of thousands of years. In order to step into the Heaven Imperial Realm and become an emperor through the Heavenly Sovereign Path, he had a bold and wicked idea.
He had once heard that the two lofty empresses of the Endless Yuankun Domain had reincarnated parts of their souls for a significant purpose, and the lord of Emperor Wu’s City set his sights on the reincarnated souls of the two empresses.
After thousands of years of searching, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City finally took action against the reincarnated soul of the Empress Yuanchu of Yuanchu Mountain. This soul had cultivated to the level of the Sacred Abyss, and the Empress Yuanchu had not yet recalled it.
The lord of Emperor Wu’s City secretly captured the Sacred Abyss-level reincarnated soul of Empress Yuanchu, intending to use the Heavenly Evil Orb to extract the emperor-level essence of Empress Yuanchu, and to gain insights into the Way of the Emperor from this Sacred Abyss-level soul, as well as various cultivation experiences, cultivation techniques, martial skills, and so on.
If successful, his chances of ascending to the Heaven Imperial Realm, mastering the Heavenly Sovereign Path, and becoming a Great Emperor would greatly increase.
However, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City failed. When he attempted to extract the emperor-level essence of Empress Yuanchu with the Heavenly Evil Orb, Empress Yuanchu located his position, directly ripped open space, traversed three hundred Divine Provinces to arrive, and with a single slap, she shattered the emperor-level grand array he had set up.
The lord of Emperor Wu’s City was greatly alarmed and immediately abandoned everything, taking the Heavenly Evil Orb and driving his life-bound treasure to flee, leaving behind even the Sacred Abyss-level soul of Empress Yuanchu.
His life-bound treasure was that war star, which he had refined to the peak of the Quasi-Emperor weapon level. Should he become an emperor, his life-bound treasure would undergo the baptism of heavenly tribulation and also advance to a true emperor-level weapon.
Though his escape was fast, breaking through the void and instantly reaching well beyond over a dozen Divine Provinces, and despite desperately fleeing and employing various secret techniques of escape, it was still of no use.
Empress Yuanchu stood unmoved, her every gesture seemingly capable of collapsing the heavens and earth, displaying an unparalleled aura of a generation. Stars emerged in every strand of her hair, as if she stood amidst a vast universe, the sole sovereign ruler.
No matter how desperately the lord of Emperor Wu’s City fled, Empress Yuanchu just watched coldly, her gaze overlooking the past, present, and future, and she gazed down upon the long river of time. She had already locked on to the lord of Emperor Wu’s City.
Just when the lord of Emperor Wu’s City thought he had escaped, Empress Yuanchu struck across the void with a palm. Immeasurable divine light surged forth, the heavens and earth lost their color, the sun and moon went dark, and even the edges of the universe were shattered, countless galaxies crumbling under this punch.
The Emperor’s Might was boundless, and the Emperor’s Palm was unrivaled, pressing down upon the primordial chaos of the universe, crossing endless time and space, shattering that Peak Quasi-Emperor weapon, and annihilating the lord of Emperor Wu’s City’s Primordial Spirit and physical body.
Empress Yuanchu didn’t expect that the lord of Emperor Wu’s City wouldn’t die completely; a wisp of the core light of his Primordial Spirit was protected by the Heavenly Evil Orb, albeit it was also on the verge of extinguishing, extremely weak.
The last wisp of the lord of Emperor Wu’s City’s Primordial Spirit light hid within the Heavenly Evil Orb, crashing down to the border between the Chaotic Domain and the East Sea of the Qianyuan Divine Province along with the shattered war star.
