When Chen Xilai of Martial Emperor City acquired the meteorite from beyond the heavens and split it open with one hundred and eight slashes, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City abandoned the Heavenly Evil Orb and fled.
If his life-bound treasure, the peak Quasi-Emperor weapon, had not been shattered by Empress Yuanchu’s palm, greatly diminishing its power, how could a mere late-stage True Martial Realm cultivator break it open? Approaching it would have resulted in being suppressed to death by the Quasi-Emperor’s might!
His Primordial Spirit light was too shattered, weak to the extreme, necessitating reincarnation to be reborn. Otherwise, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City would never have abandoned the Heavenly Evil Orb, that emperor-level supreme treasure.
Three thousand years later, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City successfully reincarnated, but since only a wisp of his Primordial Spirit light remained before reincarnation and it was extremely weak, he never broke the mystery of the womb in this lifetime until death.
After dozens of reincarnations, the Primordial Spirit light of the lord of Emperor Wu’s City finally recovered somewhat, and in this life, seven thousand one hundred years later, he broke the mystery of the womb and officially embarked on the path of cultivation.
Because he had been a Peak Quasi-Emperor before, his foundation was incredibly profound. Even though he had lost most of his memories from being struck by Empress Yuanchu’s palm, the last wisp of his Primordial Spirit light retained his core foundation.
In this lifetime, he only cultivated for nine hundred years before he returned to the Tongxuan Realm, becoming a great power within the Tongxuan Realm, and every level built a strong foundation.
In this life, he intended to challenge the Heaven Imperial Realm with an even stronger stance, to become an emperor through the Heavenly Sovereign Path, and in the future, to avenge his past humiliation and seek revenge against Empress Yuanchu.
More than eight hundred years ago, he reached the True Martial Realm and learned of the Heavenly Evil Orb, so he began to plot.
The lord of Emperor Wu’s City came to Martial Emperor City, secretly killed the previous lord, and then took over his identity.
Through soul searching, he learned some of the former lord’s cultivation techniques and martial skills and gained some of his memories, understanding his style of conduct. However, to survive and retain this identity, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City did not act for the next eight hundred years.
He sat withering on the head of Emperor Wu’s City for eight hundred years!
During these eight hundred years, his true self remained stationed there, using his avatar to act, traveling more than six or seven hundred thousand miles to Dangyang Mountain to begin his operation.
After inspecting the seals, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City felt very helpless. His power was insufficient to break the seals or even penetrate the numerous grand arrays around Dangyang Mountain.
He was no longer the Peak Quasi-Emperor he had once been, no longer possessing a life-bound treasure of Quasi-Emperor weapon level. He didn’t even have Sacred Soldiers of the Sacred Abyss level, all had been destroyed by a palm crossing time and space by Empress Yuanchu.
Thus, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City decided to plot slowly.
As his cultivation gradually recovered, he began to secretly meddle with the seals on Dangyang Mountain, but very covertly and subtly. He also refrained from being too reckless, for making a fuss would easily attract the attention of the Sacred Lands, against whom he was no match at present.
Even in his peak period, he wouldn’t dare to act recklessly in the Qianyuan Divine Province. In ancient times, it was one of the most powerful Divine Provinces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, with incredibly profound foundations.

chapters.title: Chapter 355: 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: Chapter 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_4
Ten years ago, his cultivation had restored to the Tongxuan Realm. He finally destroyed some of the seals, allowing a bit of Chen Xilai’s suppressed aura from Dangyang Mountain to leak out, attracting the attention of various Sacred Lands.
The lord of Emperor Wu’s City did this intentionally. If he were to sneak in, any major disturbance would be too great. After all, this sealing was conducted by the rulers of the previous generation of the Sacred Lands, and multiple Sacred Soldiers were used.
If the various Sacred Lands came to break the seal, to deal with Chen Xilai and take the opportunities, he could take advantage of the chaos.
As he had expected, with Chen Xilai deprived of the Heavenly Evil Orb, the Sacred Lands did not place much importance on him, only sending a Divine Yuan Realm martial emperor to handle the matter and collect the opportunities.
This suited him. With his Tongxuan Realm cultivation, he could dominate the scene at that time. Of course, unless necessary, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City would not reveal his Tongxuan Realm cultivation level.
What he needed was Chen Xilai’s physical body, dead or alive, while the Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors of the various Sacred Lands were after the opportunities stolen from Chen Xilai, which he did not care for, hence the likelihood of conflict between them was very small.
Chen Xilai’s body, having been tempered by the Heavenly Evil Orb for a thousand years, would be a great asset if he could obtain it. Moreover, with his secret technique, he was very confident of finding the Heavenly Evil Orb again, as it had, after all, followed him for tens of thousands of years.
“Once I retrieve the Heavenly Evil Orb, I will have the confidence to attempt ascending to the Heaven Imperial Realm again. This life, I am determined to succeed,” murmured the lord of Emperor Wu’s City, his eyes cast down.
In Emperor Wu’s City, he had sat idly for eight hundred years under this identity; on the surface, his cultivation level had not advanced an inch, remaining forever at the True Martial Realm’s Sixth Heaven. No one would suspect him concerning the affairs of Dangyang Mountain.
After all, how could a mere mid-True Martial Realm possibly break the Formation restrictions laid down by several Tongxuan Realm experts wielding Sacred Soldiers?
Demon Region.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing traversed from the void to this place in a very short time.
This time, she did not make a grand entrance as she had in the Xuan Domain but concealed her presence. This was partly to avoid the enemy lurking in the shadows watching her, and partly to avoid being ambushed by the Demon Emperors of the Demon Region.
Some Divine Yuan Realm Demon Emperors who practiced demonic ways but retained their sanity naturally would not act rashly against her, lest it provoke a war between the two great Sacred Lands.
But within the Demon Region, there was a fellow whose sanity was nearly gone, acting insane and fearlessly on a regular basis. If not for the overlord of the Heavenly Demon Hall keeping him in check, he would have wreak havoc upon the entire Demon Region by now.
If she were to boldly transit through the Demon Region, she would likely be attacked by that demented Demon Emperor, putting her at a disadvantage. After all, she was being covertly observed by a powerful enemy. Xue Yueqing did not know if this shadowy foe had left, but she was not willing to take the risk.
With the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, the Heavenly Moon Wheel, she concealed her aura and form and, with its help, moved rapidly towards Myriad Demon Mountain.
Crossing billions of miles within the Demon Region with the assistance of the Heavenly Moon Wheel, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing took a much shorter time than on the outward journey by manyfold.
When she arrived at the border between the Demon Region and the Demon Domain, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed the enemy lurking in the shadows had likely departed, daring not to pursue her any further.
Yet Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing dared not let her guard down and was about to continue moving rapidly, aiming to return to Myriad Demon Mountain as soon as possible, where she would be absolutely safe.
She was about to move, but suddenly her expression drastically changed. Her movement was interrupted, and her figure stopped in place. One must know that this was teleportation assisted by a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, not even a Tongxuan Realm power could interrupt it.
Before Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had time to ponder, she found the environment around her change in an instant, entering a strange new world. This unexpected transition caused a surge of malice within her, making her, a Divine Yuan Realm demon emperor, feel a chill down her spine.
“Yue Ji, do you notice anything?”
Taking a deep breath, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, who had not detected any trace of the enemy and trying to remain calm, maintained her vigilance while inquiring the Artifact Spirit of the Heavenly Moon Wheel.
By now, the full prowess of the Artifact Spirit of the Heavenly Moon Wheel had recovered. Still, it could not shake the great Formation, and no disturbances could be communicated to the outside world.
“This is bad, Xue Yueqing, we might have encountered an Emperor Rank Weapon.”
The figure of a stunningly beautiful girl wearing a moon-white palace dress appeared within the round moon formed by the Heavenly Moon Wheel, looking like a young girl speaking anxiously to Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
Though powerful was the Formation, she was no pushover. Her true form was incredibly strong; at worst, they were of the same level. Any clash would usually create noise detectable from outside, but Yue Ji felt nothing.
This indicated that a more potent weapon enveloped this place, concealing all disturbances. It was not an Emperor Rank Weapon; it was a Quasi Emperor Weapon, many times mightier than her true form.
Upon hearing this, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing’s heart skipped a beat, and her beautiful features hidden behind light gauze became extremely grim.
Despite all her precautions, she had been outmaneuvered. She did not expect the opponent to possess an Emperor Rank Weapon and lie in ambush at the border of the Demon and Devil Regions.
Such meticulous preparation by the other party meant that, even though she had not been the slightest bit negligent, she would still be unable to escape, inevitably trapped within this huge Formation.
“Yue Ji, please keep to your fully recovered state, stay on guard for any surprise attacks. If we make it back to Myriad Demon Mountain, I will replenish your energy,” Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing said with a grave voice, her own guard up to the highest level.
“Alright,” Yue Ji instantly agreed.
At this moment, she and Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing were in the same boat. She needed to give her all to possibly escape this dire situation.
Fully recovering for battle would deplete the energy she had accumulated, something she normally wouldn’t utilise, requiring Xue Yueqing to supply her with energy. Although she favoured Xue Yueqing, she was not about to make a losing deal.
After all, she belonged to Myriad Demon Mountain, not to Xue Yueqing. It was only once Xue Yueqing obtained her from the ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain that she would be able to serve Xue Yueqing wholeheartedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 356: 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: Chapter 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_5
Of course, given the extraordinary circumstances, it would be excellent if Xue Yueqing could replenish her energy afterwards, otherwise she would require an extended period to recover. Who could blame her when the spiritual energy of Qianyuan Divine Province was so thin?
Above the firmament outside the grand formation, Han Li was smilingly sizing up his Demon Emperor trapped within the pot. At this point, the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had essentially fallen into his hands.
He used the Emperor Rank Void Bell to conceal his form, making it impossible for anyone to detect his presence, and even the secrets of heaven here were obscured by the Void Bell.
Unless the Tongxuan Realm powerhouse from Myriad Demon Mountain utilized a divine weapon or an Emperor Rank weapon skilled in divining the secrets of heaven, they wouldn’t dream of finding even a trace of him.
When the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing withdrew from the Great Da Jing Dynasty of the Xuan Domain, Han Li had been closely following her, maintaining a distance of a million miles and patiently waiting.
He originally intended to make his move in the Devil Region, but after some thought, he decided against it. He noticed that the old fellow from the Heavenly Demon Hall was secretly spying on Xue Yueqing with divine sense. Should he make a move, the old fellow from the Heavenly Demon Hall would surely intervene.
Otherwise, the Heavenly Demon Hall would have to take the blame for what Han Li did.
Only when the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was about to transfer out of the Devil Region did the Tongxuan Realm powerhouse from the Heavenly Demon Hall stop spying, at which point Han Li immediately prepared to take action.
His three Daoist clones, each wielding three Supreme Grade divine weapons, instantaneously moved in front of the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing and conjured the Supreme Heaven Exterminating Saint Formation, ensnaring the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing within it.
In such a situation, the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had become a turtle in a jar, with no chance of escape.
The formation created a small world of its own, isolating inside from outside and obscuring the secrets of heaven, with only Xue Yueqing remaining alert all around.
The silver moon hung high, and its bright light softly bathed every corner of the small world, casting a thin veil of mist across the formation, picturesque and poetic.
Under the silver moon, was a stunningly beautiful girl with a gracefully curving body, her eyes like bluestone, shining with the light of the moon, her dress fluttering as if she were a sprite of the moon.
Beneath the silver moon, a peerless beauty dressed in a moon-white battle dress and a light veil over her face, her delicate figure as pure and gleaming as white jade, bathed in the moon’s glow, was an unparalleled stunning sight.
Seeing this breathtakingly beautiful scene, Patriarch Han couldn’t help but swallow his saliva, his gaze wandering up and down. At this moment, a wicked thought flashed through his mind.
“Can an Artifact Spirit have children?”
This was a blind spot in his knowledge, as he had never heard of a cultivator forming a union with an Artifact Spirit.
The more he thought about it, the more restless Han Li felt. It seemed he could become the founding ancestor of a great new era.
Patriarch Han had quite a number of Artifact Spirits, but Zi Yi, Yin Ling, JianJi, and Shi Qi all manifested as little lolita-like figures carved from jade and rosy red cheeks. Although Han Li had some thoughts, he hadn’t put them into practice.
However, the Artifact Spirit of the Heavenly Moon Wheel was different, actually manifesting as a stunningly beautiful girl with a graceful figure, which seemed as if it could verify his idea.
To see if an Artifact Spirit could have children, what kind of talent those children would possess, would they be born with special physiques?
“Audacious demon! With one glance, this patriarch sees you are not human. Reveal your true form at once!”
All thoughts flashed through his mind in an instant. Han Li knew now was not the time to entertain these ideas, so he spoke.
His grand voice echoed within the formation, unceasingly resounding, accompanied by an intense oppressive force focusing on the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
“Out with you, before your emperor!” shouted the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, her eyes flashing with anger.
Even under the full pressure of the entire formation, with all of this world seeming against her, the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was uncontrollably furious.
How many years had it been?
Perhaps thousands of years, since she had cultivated to the True Martial Realm and no one had dared to call her a demon, let alone now that she was a Demon Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm, overseeing the affairs of Myriad Demon Mountain, wielding great power, and holding an exceedingly high status.
The moonlight of the Heavenly Moon Wheel surged again and again, attempting to wash over the entire small world and break through the formation, yet it never succeeded.
A towering Sword Qi, a devastating Divine Light, and a Blade of Time, all struck from three directions towards the Heavenly Moon Wheel hanging in the firmament.
Boom~
Yue Ji hurriedly urged the Heavenly Moon Wheel to defend, unleashing its full power to counter the three attacks, but she was knocked towards the ground, struggling fiercely to stabilize her form.
This alarmed Yue Ji immensely. The three weapons attacking her were too powerful, matching her without loss, and one even seemed slightly stronger.
Three Supreme Grade divine weapons!
Yue Ji felt desolate.
Even if she operated the Heavenly Moon Wheel with all her might, she could not defeat three Supreme Grade divine weapons of the same class, let alone the hidden Emperor Rank Weapon.
“How is this possible?”
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, protected by the Heavenly Moon Wheel, trembled and also took several steps back, her face unbelieving.
Who was attacking her?
When had she offended such a powerful being?
To assault her, someone had used a Divine Rank Supreme Formation, three Supreme Grade divine weapons, and there was even an Emperor Rank Weapon lurking in the shadows.
This super luxurious lineup was more than enough to take on a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm, yet to target her, a Demon Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm, it was like using Emperor Level Weapons to kill a chicken.
Above her, the Heavenly Moon Wheel trembled, but did not burst out again, staying on guard. Yue Ji knew the trend was over and that her escape today was doomed.
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing and Yue Ji felt a heavy weight in their hearts as they watched three figures appear from three different directions within the small world.
The three figures each held a Divine Sword, a Sacred Tower, and a Divine Furnace in their hands, all wearing bronze masks, their aura locked on her.
“Three Tongxuan Realm powerhouses!”
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing’s heart skipped a beat, her face filled with shock; this was more startling to her than the sight of an Emperor Rank Weapon.

chapters.title: Chapter 357: 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: Chapter 190: Monster, I Recognized at a Glance You Aren’t Human! Quasi Emperor Reincarnated? Successfully Captured a Demon Emperor!_6
“Qianyuan Divine Province is going to turn upside down…” Xue Yueqing muttered to herself, as her heart stirred up huge waves.
After the ancient catastrophe, it was rare for anyone with the power of the Tongxuan Realm to be born outside of the Sacred Lands—with exceptions like the insanely talented swordsman, Chen Xilai, happening only once in tens of thousands of years.
But at this moment, there were three, maybe four Tongxuan Realm experts, and one of them was even concealing a Divine Weapon.
Four Tongxuan Realm masters, wielding one Divine Weapon and three Supreme Grade Divine Weapons, were capable of challenging the Sacred Lands themselves. Without the resurgence of divine soldiers, even the Sacred Lands would be suppressed.
“Who are you…?”
Xue Yueqing’s delicate body trembled as she asked in a quivering voice.
Han Li’s three Dao bodies did not speak, but instead summoned the Dao Decapitating Sword, the Time-Sky Tower, and the Life-Prolonging Furnace, allowing JianJi, ShiQi, and Yin Ling to take action on their own.
The three Supreme Grade Divine Weapons whistled through the air, striking towards the Heavenly Moon Wheel.
At the same time, the three Dao bodies approached the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, descending from the ninth heaven, one step at a time, each step weighing heavily on Xue Yueqing’s heart, escalating the pressure she felt.
“I’ll fight to the end!”
Xue Yueqing gritted her teeth; as the Demon Emperor, she would definitely not surrender without a fight.
In an instant, she erupted with a fierce aura, using the strongest martial skill of her life in a counterattack, but she was easily suppressed by the three Dao bodies and soon the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was subdued and sealed.
In the heavens, the Heavenly Moon Wheel was still struggling. Seeing Xue Yueqing being sealed, Yue Ji felt immensely burdened, but she couldn’t worry about that now.
The pressure from the three Supreme Grade Divine Weapons was too great for her. She was too busy defending herself to care about the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
“Still struggling?”
One of the Dao bodies raised an eyebrow and activated the Du Tian Zhu Sheng Great Array.
This top-tier Sacred Grade Array burst forth with unparalleled might, working in tandem with the Life-Prolonging Furnace, Dao Decapitating Sword, and Time-Sky Tower to suppress the Heavenly Moon Wheel.
After a few struggles, the Heavenly Moon Wheel grew still, having been sealed.
The entire ordeal, from start to finish, took merely a moment or two. The outside world still believed that the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had returned to Myriad Demon Mountain.
With a wave of his hand, Han Li brought both the Heavenly Moon Wheel and Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing into the System Space, a smile emerging on his face as his mission was accomplished.
The next instant, the smile on his face disappeared, and he frowned slightly as he glanced in the direction of Myriad Demon Mountain.
Then, he immediately retracted the Du Tian Zhu Sheng Great Array, recalled the three Dao bodies and the three Supreme Grade Divine Weapons, and vanished from the scene, eliminating all traces with the Void Bell.
A breath after Han Li left, a figure arrived—an imposing old man with the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel suspended above his head.
His expression was extremely ugly. The Demon Emperor of Myriad Demon Mountain was attacked right at the entrance of the Demon Domain and then taken away.
How could he, how could Myriad Demon Mountain, save face?
The moment the Heavenly Moon Wheel was sealed, the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel sensed it and immediately warned him. The ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain came with the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel, but found no trace of the enemy.
“Search.”
The ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain said in a deep voice.
The Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel turned, and Emperor’s Light streamed out, covering tens of millions of miles, trying to trace the cause and whereabouts of the enemy.
“There was interference from a Divine Weapon, eliminating all traces, at the very least a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon.”
After a while, a voice came from the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel, sounding somewhat surprised.
“Damn it!”
The terrifying aura of the ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain was unleashed, overwhelming heaven and earth, as he carried the Heavenly Demon Dao Wheel and charged towards Heavenly Demon Hall.
“Old devil, you owe me an explanation for this!”
The grand voice of the ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain echoed across vast territories of the Devil Region, his tone extremely unfriendly.

chapters.title: Chapter 358: 191: The Demon Lord Battles the Demon Lord! The War of Imperial Arms, the Shattering of the Galaxy! The Resigned Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: Chapter 191: The Demon Lord Battles the Demon Lord! The War of Imperial Arms, the Shattering of the Galaxy! The Resigned Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing!_1
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li and Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing stood there, silent.
Gazing at Han Li’s back, Xue Yueqing wanted to say something but hesitated; she then followed Han Li’s line of sight towards the Devil Region, but since her cultivation was sealed, she could no longer sense anything.
Han Li held one hand behind his back, idly twirling a lunar disc in the other, watching the Heavenly Demon Hall in the Devil Region, quietly observing the unfolding events.
With the help of the Emperor-class Void Bell, he spied on the Devil Region from billions of miles away without any sound, wondering what the old demon of Myriad Demon Mountain would do.
The Tongxuan Realm powerhouse from Myriad Demon Mountain, wielding the Emperor-grade Heavenly Demon Moon Wheel, pressured the Heavenly Demon Hall with an unfriendly tone. In response, a dark demonic light burst forth from within the hall, fracturing the void where it passed, inverting heaven and earth, obliterating mountains and rivers.
The Heavenly Demon Moon Wheel emitted a hazy blue light, clashing against the demonic light, demonstrating earth-shattering might that shook the entire Qianyuan Divine Province. Many Divine Yuan Realm powers and Sacred Lands cast their watchful gazes.
“What madness has possessed the old demon of Myriad Demon Mountain?”
“A grand battle of demons? How fascinating!”
“If the Myriad Demon Mountain and Heavenly Demon Hall go to war, the hall likely won’t be able to withstand it, as it lacks the same depth of heritage.”
“Shall we stand by and watch the situation unfold, or shall we provide support to the Heavenly Demon Hall?”
“Yet another grand battle between the Human Clan and the Demon Clan, let them fight. I’ve long wanted to kill those devils from the Devil Region.”
The strong from various factions discussed among themselves, all enjoying the spectacle. For the time being, there was no one offering support, preferring to clarify the situation before taking action.
Whether it was the Dao Sect, Buddhist Sect, or Sword Domain, none had much affection for the Demon Clan, with whom they were usually at odds. They only united during racial wars; otherwise, the strife was intense.
Although they opposed the Demon Clan, they were all part of the Human Clan. If Myriad Demon Mountain sought to annihilate the Heavenly Demon Hall, Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and the House of Divine Armies would certainly not stand idly by; they all understood the principle of “a loss to one is a loss to all.”
The Heavenly Demon Hall might be a Sacred Land, but when compared to Myriad Demon Mountain, it fell short, the latter boasting the entire heritage of the Demon Clan, while the hall possessed less than a quarter of the Human Clan’s.
Among the Human Clan, only the top Sacred Land, Bai Yujing, could compete with the Barbarian Clan’s and the Demon Clan’s powers such as Myriad Demon Mountain on its own. The other three Great Sacred Lands lagged somewhat behind.
If the Four Sacred Lands of the Mortal World joined forces, neither the Barbarian Clan’s pinnacle of might nor Myriad Demon Mountain would be a match, or they would not have been defeated time and again.
“Get lost!”
A voice full of demonic nature echoed from within the Heavenly Demon Hall, shaking the entire Devil Region and reaching out to the Qianyuan Divine Province.
In the practice ground of the Heavenly Demon Hall, a figure dressed in a purple demonic robe, with a looming presence like a majestic mountain, sat cross-legged in the void, rising higher and higher. Soon he reached the same height as the ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain. This was the lord of the Heavenly Demon Hall, a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse.
Above the purple-robed middle-aged man, a pitch-black Devil Sword spun, its overwhelming demonic aura oppressing the world around it. The sword seemed eager to strike at the Heavenly Demon Moon Wheel.
“Dugu Weizun, you old demon still wield such power. However, without an explanation today, I’ll flatten the Heavenly Demon Hall,” the lord of Myriad Demon Mountain stated coolly under the misty green light, his placid tone belying a tumultuous rage.
The entire Demon Clan had a mere ten Demon Emperors in the Divine Yuan Realm, a testament to their profound heritage. Each Emperor took turns overseeing Myriad Demon Mountain for three hundred years, allowing him, the sovereign of the mountain, and the other Emperors to meditate and cultivate peacefully.
Now, with Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, who was in charge of Demon Clan affairs, having disappeared at the border of the Devil and Demon Domains under a concealing Emperor weapon, the ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain could hardly avoid suspecting Dugu Weizun.
Across the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, only six Great Sacred Lands, including Bai Yujing, Myriad Demon Mountain, and Heavenly Demon Hall, possessed Emperor weapons. Other Divine Yuan Realm powers hardly even had Sacred Soldiers.
Xue Yueqing had merely passed through the Devil Region and had not yet entered the Demon Domain when she vanished into thin air. There must be an explanation for this event.
There were many Demon Kings in the True Martial Realm; counting those in hiding, there were nearly fifty. Yet, there were only ten Divine Yuan Realm Demon Emperors, each crucial to the Demon Clan.
The disappearance of a Demon Emperor demanded action from him, the Myriad Demon Mountain’s ruler, or the prestige of the mountain would suffer immensely. The remaining nine Demon Emperors would lose heart, fearing for their own safety.
He went straight to the Heavenly Demon Hall, seeking to shift the blame onto it. He didn’t know if the Heavenly Demon Hall was behind Xue Yueqing’s disappearance, but he was sure they were involved.
Xue Yueqing’s passage through the Devil Region could not have escaped Dugu Weizun’s notice, even under the concealment of the Heavenly Moon Wheel. To disappear under his watch, without Dugu Weizun lifting a finger.
It was either Dugu Weizun’s doing or he simply turned a blind eye. Without a clear culprit, he would vent his anger on the Heavenly Demon Hall. After all, he had to uphold the dignity of Myriad Demon Mountain and assure the other Emperors to avoid chaos.
“Dongfang Qingcang, do you really think you can destroy my Heavenly Demon Hall? Hahahaha… What a grand joke!”
Amidst Dugu Weizun’s laughter, the floating pitch-black Devil Sword began to unleash its power, awakening step by step, ready for full resurgence.
This was a majestic and splendid Devil Sword, its hilt and blade both shrouded in darkness as if forged from the deepest demonic auras. The thick demonic energy it emitted constantly seemed like a single strand could collapse the ages.
The many True Martial Realm and Divine Yuan Realm powerhouses within the Devil Region, as well as the powerhouses from other realms, all held their breath at that moment, speechless before the mighty sword.
The Devil Sword Breaking Red Dust!
This was one of the two great Emperor-class weapons of the Heavenly Demon Hall, surviving since the primordial catastrophe, and it bore a nefarious reputation fortified by the blood of countless lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 359: 191: The Demon Lord Battles the Demon Lord! The War of Imperial Arms, the Shattering of the Galaxy! The Resigned Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 359: Chapter 191: The Demon Lord Battles the Demon Lord! The War of Imperial Arms, the Shattering of the Galaxy! The Resigned Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing!_2
The Devil Sword Breaking Red Dust had once slurped up the imperial blood of the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors in the Ancient Era. The Great Emperor from the Heavenly Demon Hall once wielded this Devil Sword to slay two Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors; countless Quasi Emperors and Saints fell beneath the Devil Sword Breaking Red Dust.
Even after the Ancient Era, the Devil Sword Breaking Red Dust shone brightly again and again, its demonic might terrorizing the Qianyuan Divine Province. Whether it was the civil war within the Human Clan or the great battles with the Demon Clan, the Devil Sword Breaking Red Dust claimed the lives of one after another famed Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors and powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm.
“Since you, Demon Lord Dugu Weizun, don’t wish to give this old man an explanation, then this matter falls on the head of your Heavenly Demon Hall.”
Dongfang Qingcang, the ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain, bellowed furiously. His Demon Dao Wheel began to revive, instantly bursting forth with azure light that inundated the sky, eclipsing the sun, as if rebuilding the Nine Heavens.
“Why would I, Dugu Weizun, need to explain my actions to others in my life?”
Dugu Weizun rose to his feet, emitting a fearsome aura that soared into the sky, shaking the Nine Heavens, resonating with the Devil Sword Breaking Red Dust. Demonic and sword energies interwove, tearing through the void, causing the azure-constructed Nine Heavens to tremble and bulge upward.
“If you refuse to be convinced, then let us battle!”
Demon Lord Dugu Weizun’s purple robe fluttered in the wind, his hands folded behind his back, his face a mask of cold indifference. He had no intention of explaining himself.
With Dongfang Qingcang from Myriad Demon Mountain knocking at the door, it was inevitable that the blame would fall on Heavenly Demon Hall. No matter how he explained, it would be useless; he truly had not witnessed it, but Dongfang Qingcang would not believe it.
Besides, why should he explain?
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing wasn’t the Demon Emperor of the Devil Region; whether she disappeared or died, it had nothing to do with the Devil Region.
Dongfang Qingcang’s arrival to threaten was tantamount to pushing the Devil Region too far. As the ruler of Heavenly Demon Hall, whether due to his nature or for the sake of Heavenly Demon Hall’s dignity, he would not explain, he would not bow down.
Indeed, Dugu Weizun was also quite interested in assessing the strength of Dongfang Qingcang, the old demon, to see how far he had cultivated over the past few thousand years, and whether he had made further progress.
With the Devil Region right next to the Demon Domain, if Dongfang Qingcang’s strength had greatly increased, it was possible that he might initiate the fourth great war between the Human Clan and Demon Barbarians. When that time came, the Devil Region would be the first to bear the brunt, facing the pressure of the Demon Clan.
“The Demon Lord is still as domineering as ever.”
Inside the Heavenly Demon Hall, a Divine Yuan Realm Demon Emperor clad in a black demonic robe saw this scene, his face flickering with reminiscence, and he murmured excitedly.
When he had abandoned the Buddhist Sect for the path of demons, pursued by several Divine Yuan Realm Arhats from Xumi Mountain, it was Demon Lord Dugu Weizun who saved him.
Even when the Bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain appeared, Dugu Weizun remained undaunted, with only a simple phrase.
“This person, I, Dugu Weizun, will protect. Those who disagree, fight!”
The Bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain and Dugu Weizun fought a great battle, with no one knowing the outcome. Yet, in the end, Dugu Weizun successfully took him back to the Heavenly Demon Hall.
“Come, fight!”
Dongfang Qingcang gave Dugu Weizun a deep look, then soared skyward with his Demon Dao Wheel, entering the space beyond.
“Heh~”
Dugu Weizun sneered as he reached out his hand, and the Devil Sword Breaking Red Dust landed in his grasp. He lightly made a slash.
In that instant, time and space seemed to freeze beneath this stroke of the sword. The Nine Heavens, like a mirror, were shattered by a single slash, the vast azure light vanishing without a trace.
Dugu Weizun ascended into the void, entering the space beyond to engage in fierce battle with Dongfang Qingcang.
As the two powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm spurred on their respective imperial weapons, a portion of their might was awakened. The starry sky crumbled, countless stars turned to dust, and one galaxy after another fell silent under the might of the emperor’s weapons.
About a dozen breaths later, demonic and azure lights descended from beyond the sky. The demonic light directly fell upon the Heavenly Demon Hall, while the azure light returned to Myriad Demon Mountain in the Demon Domain.
Countless cultivators were very interested in the outcome of this battle, wondering whether the Demon Lord Dugu Weizun of the Heavenly Demon Hall was stronger, or if the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang from Myriad Demon Mountain had the upper hand.
Perhaps only the rulers of these Sacred Lands, themselves powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm, knew the victor of this battle.
Bai Yujing.
Within the hidden Bai Yujing in the void, an elderly man with white hair and beard emanating an air of immortal grace stroked his beard, withdrew his gaze, and sighed:
“Dongfang Qingcang, that old demon, actually took that step, and little Dugu Weizun has also grown to this extent. Time really spares no one.”
If these words were to spread outside, they would certainly cause a huge stir. The leader of Myriad Demon Mountain was suspected of making a new breakthrough, and yet, someone had referred to the Demon Lord Dugu Weizun as a “little guy.”
However, since it was the old Daoist of Bai Yujing who said it, it seemed rather normal.
The old Daoist of Bai Yujing had once defeated the ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain, Dongfang Qingcang, head-on. Dugu Weizun was the emerging talent of a later era who had dramatically risen in the demonic path and became the new Demon Lord after the old Demon Lord passed away.
Xumi Mountain.
“The female Demon King Bai Keqing from the Demon Clan has not returned to the Demon Domain since she was rescued by Ye Fan, and the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing is suspected to have gone to the Xuan Domain to look for her. On her return to the Demon Domain, she was attacked and vanished without a trace.”
“Even the old demon of Myriad Demon Mountain couldn’t trace any clues; it must have been an imperial weapon that erased all traces. Who exactly is targeting the Demon Clan?”
The Bodhisattva, dignified and serene, sat cross-legged in the void, pondering in her heart. An immeasurable sense of Zen pervaded the void. The sound of Buddhism twirled around Xumi Mountain, while the Buddha’s light shone across billions of miles within the Buddha Domain.
She did not take action, the old Daoist of Bai Yujing would not be the first to make a move, and neither the House of Divine Armies nor the Summits of the Stars would do so. No wonder Dongfang Qingcang headed to Heavenly Demon Hall.
In the Qianyuan Divine Province, only a few of these Sacred Lands had the capability. Among them, the Demon Lord Dugu Weizun of the Heavenly Demon Hall was the most suspicious.
“This little demon has grown so fast in strength,” she thought of Dugu Weizun. The Bodhisattva recalled how Dugu Weizun, within less than a hundred years of taking the position as the Demon Lord of the Heavenly Demon Hall, boldly came to her Buddha Domain to protect someone, evidently full of youthful vigor.

chapters.title: Chapter 360: 191: The Demon Lord Battles the Demon Lord! The War of Imperial Arms, the Shattering of the Galaxy! The Resigned Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: Chapter 191: The Demon Lord Battles the Demon Lord! The War of Imperial Arms, the Shattering of the Galaxy! The Resigned Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing!_3
Initially, her cultivation level was much higher than Dugu Weizun’s, but after employing the imperial weapon, their strengths were almost equal, so in the end, she stepped back and allowed Dugu Weizun to take away the Arhat who had turned to the demonic path.
She had no choice but to retreat. The young were too impetuous. Dugu Weizun would fully unleash the imperial weapon at the slightest disagreement and even considered reviving a divine weapon.
The female bodhisattva didn’t want to play such a game with Dugu Weizun. It was too depleting, and if they both ended up injured, it would delay the grand plan of the Buddhist Sect’s eastward propagation and simply hand Dao Sect an advantage on a silver platter.
House of Divine Armies.
Inside a cave heaven, a rather portly elder waved his hand and erased the images in the void, sitting down with a chuckle.
Behind him were nine types of weapons including the Divine Sword, a wild blade, a square sky halberd, a Silver Spear, and a phoenix-winged golden lancer, each a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon resonating faintly with the portly elder.
“Dugu Weizun is not up to par. He is far less powerful than Dongfang Qingcang,” the portly elder said, shaking his head slightly.
In this battle, Dugu Weizun appeared to be on the losing side, relying solely on the Devil Sword Breaking Red Dust for support. Dugu Weizun’s willingness to make a sacrificial play, extremely ruthless, increased the might of Devil Sword Breaking Red Dust, causing Myriad Demon Mountain’s Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang to step back.
If the fight continued, Dugu Weizun would have to fully unleash the imperial weapon, and in the end, even divine weapons might be revived, resulting in a fight to the death with him.
Dongfang Qingcang went to demand an explanation and stabilize the wavering hearts within the Demon Clan. He wasn’t truly intending to engage in a decisive battle with Heavenly Demon Hall. Even if he won, the victory would come at a great cost to his vitality, not worth it for Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, and would be a classic case of winning the battle but losing the war.
Summit of All Stars.
The northern part of Qianyuan Divine Province was entirely the territory of the Barbarian Clan. The environment here was notably harsher than those of the Human Clan and Demon Clan, but it was suitable for the Barbarian Clan.
The Barbarian Clan had naturally strong physiques and the Barbarians from Qianyuan Divine Province were Star Barbarians, skilled in using the power of the stars to temper their bodies, unafraid of the perilous environment.
Atop the Summit of All Stars, constructed from countless fallen stars, a middle-aged man of about ten feet tall with bulging muscles sat cross-legged. Starlight from beyond the heavens streamed down like a reversed galaxy, constantly tempering his physical body and simultaneously nurturing his Primordial Spirit.
“The Galaxy Body Cleansing Scripture is indeed difficult to cultivate,”
the middle-aged man sighed. He was practicing a top-tier Barbarian imperial scripture, which was among the strongest body tempering cultivation techniques in Qianyuan Divine Province.
While cultivating, he also observed the grand battle happening in the sky from afar but showed no intention of assisting his allies from the Demon Clan.
This was a personal grudge. Even as allies, he would not interfere unless the Four Sacred Lands of Mortal World threatened to annihilate Myriad Demon Mountain.
“Dongfang Qingcang, this Demon Lord, lacks determination. It’s time for him to step down,”
said the middle-aged man as the battle concluded, returning to his starlight tempering.
He had long seen that Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang, fearful and overly cautious, lacked the strategic ability. Relying on the Demon Clan wouldn’t work; focusing on strengthening the Barbarian Clan internally was the correct move.
He also knew the reason. Three thousand years ago, in a battle with that old Daoist from Bai Yujing, Dongfang Qingcang was almost beaten to death, severely damaging his Dao heart.
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
“Tsk, just as I, the old ancestor, expected,”
Han Li retracted his gaze, looking at Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing with a smile.
“What are you trying to say?”
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing felt a jolt in her heart but feigned calmness, speaking coldly.
Her cultivation was sealed, and she didn’t know what had happened, but she had some guesses in mind.
She and the Heavenly Moon Wheel were captured by this man. Surely the Demon Lord of Myriad Demon Mountain, Dongfang Qingcang, would react.
This man’s composure indicated that Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang had not discovered the truth of their capture and had taken the matter to the head of Magic Domain Devil Temple.
Heavenly Demon Hall’s Demon Lord was extremely powerful. In less than a hundred years after succeeding the position, he dared to snatch someone from the hands of the Buddhist Sect’s female bodhisattva. With Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang knocking on his door, given Demon Lord Dugu Weizun’s temperament, it was highly likely that he would not offer any explanation.
What this man was watching must have been the great battle between Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang and Demon Lord Dugu Weizun.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was astute, handling the Demon Clan’s affairs very competently during her stewardship, earning high regard from Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang.
Although she hadn’t seen any scenes, she deduced quite a lot of what occurred in the Devil Region from Han Li’s tone and actions.
Seeing him take pleasure in the misfortune of others, it was highly probable that Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang returned without accomplishing anything and could not do anything to Demon Lord Dugu Weizun.
Since Myriad Demon Mountain’s Demon Lord would not be able to find this man and could not vent his anger on Heavenly Demon Hall, upon his return, although he would rage, it was unlikely he would search for her publicly. Instead, he would likely do so in secret.
Based on her understanding of Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang, Xue Yueqing felt that she was probably being abandoned.
Xue Yueqing wasn’t disappointed; when she fell into this man’s hands, she already had this realization.
An organization that appeared suddenly, possessing four Tongxuan Realm powerhouses and one top-tier imperial weapon, as well as three Supreme Grade Divine Weapons, was sufficient to shake a Sacred Land.
If they had one more divine weapon as their pillar, this organization could become a new Sacred Land in Qianyuan Divine Province, even the foremost Sacred Land.
After all, Sacred Lands like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Myriad Demon Mountain only had one Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, with at most one more hidden away, far inferior to this organization.
It was normal for Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang to return without success and ultimately give up on her. His traces were eradicated by the imperial weapon, and unless Myriad Demon Mountain revived a divine weapon, it was unlikely to detect any clues.
But the cost of reviving a divine weapon is immense, isn’t it?
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing didn’t feel she was worth that price. The resources consumed in reviving a divine weapon could produce at least four or five Divine Yuan Realm Demon Emperors.

chapters.title: Chapter 361: 191: The Demon Lord Battles the Demon Lord! The War of Imperial Arms, the Shattering of the Galaxy! The Resigned Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: Chapter 191: The Demon Lord Battles the Demon Lord! The War of Imperial Arms, the Shattering of the Galaxy! The Resigned Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing!_4
Ever since the Human Clan’s great defeat in the third major battle with the Demon and Barbarian Clans ten thousand years ago, the Demon Clan had never again used immortal weapons. That battle had depleted the Demon Clan of too much of its foundation, and they ultimately failed to achieve their goal.
Han Li turned around, his left hand still fiddling with the Heavenly Moon Wheel while his right hand pinched Xue Yueqing’s delicate and flawless chin. He brought his face close to her stunningly beautiful red lips and said indifferently,
“You should think it over carefully. If you are willing to become my Dao companion, then all will be well, and we can look forward to a bright future. But if you’re unwilling, heh heh…”
As his words fell, Han Li drew closer and captured the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing’s exquisite and beautiful lips, savoring them to the fullest.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was greatly shocked inside, struggling intensely, but it was utterly futile. Now that she was without any cultivation, just like an ordinary person, how could she resist the invasion of a powerful Cultivator from the Tongxuan Realm?
After savoring the kiss, Han Li glanced at Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing once more before his figure disappeared from Chengdao Peak.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing clutched the Heavenly Moon Wheel tightly in her hand, her face extremely unsightly. She had never imagined that one day she would be treated in such a way, her first kiss taken forcefully and arrogantly.
Worse yet, she couldn’t resist at all and could only let this person take and take from her.
Xue Yueqing felt an immense humiliation. She was a Divine Yuan Realm Demon Emperor, yet she was treated in such a manner. The contrast cut her like a knife.
As one of the ten great Demon Emperors of the Demon Clan, during her tenure overseeing the affairs of the Demon Clan, the other nine Demon Emperors were all beneath her in rank. Her status was akin to the second in command of the Myriad Demon Mountain and even in the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, she was among the top fifteen influential figures.
“Sigh~”
Xue Yueqing extended her soft, snow-white hand to touch her tender lips, feeling an indescribable bitterness.
At that moment, the Heavenly Moon Wheel glowed, and a figure emerged beside Xue Yueqing. It was a beautiful young girl in a moon dress, stunning in appearance.
Xue Yueqing’s pupils contracted as she quickly asked in a low voice, “Yue Ji, have you recovered?”
If Yue Ji had recovered and could control the Heavenly Moon Wheel, then there was a chance for them. They could wait for the right moment to escape and return to the Demon Domain.
Yue Ji gave a wry smile and shook her head, saying, “Not yet. That man unsealed some of my restraints, so I can come out, but I can’t activate the full might of the Heavenly Moon Wheel.”
After a pause, Yue Ji continued, “Even if I were fully recovered, we wouldn’t have any hope of escaping alive.”
“The mountain range is covered by a Shengyuan Realm-level Formation. Even if I try to break out, it would require considerable effort. In that time, the Supreme Grade Divine Armies within the mountain range, or even the Emperor-level ones, would instantly suppress us.”
“I can sense that there are many powerful presences hidden in this mountain range, some are Sacred Soldiers, Emperor-level weapons, and some are Cultivators.”
Upon hearing these words, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing fell into silence.
Yue Ji’s original form was a top-tier Shengyuan Realm Weapon. If even Yue Ji couldn’t escape, Xue Yueqing had no chance.
After hesitating for a moment, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing asked in a low voice, “Yue Ji, can you find out the scale of this organization’s foundation?”
Xue Yueqing was very curious about just how powerful the organization that captured her was and whether their foundation could compare to the other Great Sacred Lands.
“I’ll try,” Yue Ji hesitated for a moment but then agreed, as she was very curious as well.
Yue Ji mobilized the power of the Heavenly Moon Wheel, and moonlight scattered down to the mortal realm, covering the entire Chengsheng Mountain, causing the beings within the Han Mansion to be somewhat astonished. How was there moonlight in broad daylight, and only within the bounds of Chengsheng Mountain at that?
Although it was puzzling, no one went to investigate. Those living in the Han Mansion—whether they were Han Li’s descendants or the Guest Elders, protectors, servants and maids—all knew that the Han Mansion hid many secrets. They must never inquire, and if they happened to see something, they were to keep it to themselves.
“I’ve found something.”
Suddenly, the moonlight dissolved, the Heavenly Moon Wheel ceased to spin, and Yue Ji sounded a bit surprised.
Her actions were quite obvious, but the organization did not make a move, seemingly indifferent to her small schemes. How confident they must be!
“How substantial is the foundation of this power?” Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing asked eagerly.
After thinking for a moment, Yue Ji said, “I could only uncover part of it. I can’t detect Emperor-level weapons, and if this power has immortal weapons, I can’t detect them either.”
“In the mountains surrounding our peak, many hide powerful presences. According to my findings, I detected one Quasi Emperor weapon, three Supreme Grade Divine Weapons, two Top Grade Divine Weapons…”
“In one of the mountains, there’s also the presence of Supreme Grade Divine Medicine, guarded by a Mystical Beast Kui Bull at the pinnacle of the Tongxuan Realm.”
Yue Ji pointed at Zaidao Peak and continued, “As for those three powerful cultivators from the Tongxuan Realm who attacked us, as well as the man from earlier, I didn’t detect them.”
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was shocked. The foundation of this power was truly unfathomable. Even if it didn’t rival Myriad Demon Mountain, it likely wasn’t far behind the House of Divine Armies, or even Sacred Lands like Xumi Mountain and Heavenly Demon Hall.
One top-tier Emperor weapon, one Quasi Emperor weapon, five Sacred Soldiers, at least five powerful Tongxuan Realm beings, the suspected presence of Shengyuan Realm Saints, and the probable existence of immortal weapons.
Since when did such a superpower with an unfathomable foundation emerge in the Qianyuan Divine Province?
She had never heard of it before—what was the purpose of this superpower hiding in the Divine Province?
Could it be that they intended to overthrow the rule of the Six Great Sacred Lands?
Suddenly, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing’s heart skipped a beat, and a wildly bold speculation emerged in her mind. Could this superpower be from another Divine Province, infiltrating and secretly plotting against the entire Qianyuan Divine Province?
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing felt this was very likely. Otherwise, how could such an unfathomably powerful superpower appear in the Qianyuan Divine Province?

chapters.title: Chapter 362: 191: The Demon Lord Battles the Demon Lord! The War of Imperial Arms, the Shattering of the Galaxy! The Resigned Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: Chapter 191: The Demon Lord Battles the Demon Lord! The War of Imperial Arms, the Shattering of the Galaxy! The Resigned Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing!_5
Under the rule of the Six Great Sacred Lands, Qianyuan Divine Province maintained its power structure and would never allow a new Sacred Land to rise. Such an emergence would significantly impact the power dynamics of Qianyuan Divine Province, profoundly affecting the interests of the Six Great Sacred Lands.
“Xue Yueqing, do you really want to be his Dao companion?”
As Demon Empress Xue Yueqing’s mind wandered with wild thoughts, Yue Ji suddenly asked.
Just now, she had been inside the Heavenly Moon Wheel, which Han Li had been toying with in his hands, and Yue Ji clearly heard what Han Li had said to Xue Yueqing.
Behind the thin veil, Xue Yueqing’s stunningly alluring face showed a struggle.
The man who had just summoned the power of three Tongxuan Realm experts and three top-tier Sacred Soldiers, and even imperial weapons, was very likely the sovereign of this superpower, suspected to be a Saint of the Sacred Abyss Realm.
As the sovereign of a Sacred Land, an invincible being suspected to be a Saint, she was somewhat flattered to think that he had captured her just to make her his Dao companion.
She thought that if the man had plainly proposed to her, she might have very likely accepted, considering he was the master of a superpower and possibly a Saint of the Sacred Abyss Realm.
However, she had ultimately been captured, which left a knot in the heart of Demon Empress Xue Yueqing, as they had never met before and she had never even heard of him, with no foundation of feelings whatsoever.
“Well, let’s see how it goes,”
Xue Yueqing sighed heavily and spoke helplessly.
She wanted to refuse but knew she had no room to do so; rejection could mean facing an abyssal downfall.
Now, the master of this superpower still spoke to her kindly and had not forced anything. If she rejected him, she would leave herself no room at all.
Xue Yueqing knew that he would not let them go; otherwise, he wouldn’t have allowed them to blatantly see his power base.
“Oh~”
Yue Ji opened her mouth, seeming to have something to say but then hesitating.
Frowning slightly, Xue Yueqing candidly asked, “Yue Ji, is there something you want to say?”
“Xue Yueqing, why do I feel that this man also has a bit of interest in me? It must be my imagination, probably just a misperception,”
Yue Ji’s small hands nervously clutched at the hem of her dress, her face instantly blushing as she felt extremely shy.
Uttering such thoughts made her feel ashamed—after all, she was an Artifact Spirit, how could he possibly be interested in her…
And yet, she seemed to have genuinely felt this before, as he endlessly toyed with her true form, shifting through countless positions.
Blinking, Xue Yueqing was startled by Yue Ji’s words and cautiously asked, “Yue Ji, are you sure you’re not sensing it wrong?”
In her heart, she believed Yue Ji was mistaken; how could a master of a superpower, suspected to be a Saint of the Sacred Abyss Realm, harbor such thoughts for an Artifact Spirit?
“It must be my misperception.”
Yue Ji lowered her head in shame, regretting having mentioned it to Xue Yueqing.
“I…”
Just as Xue Yueqing was about to say something, a familiar voice echoed in her ear.
“Lady Xue Yueqing.”
Xue Yueqing abruptly turned around and looked at the figure that had suddenly appeared behind her, a mix of shock and bewilderment crossing her eyes before turning into realization; she seemed to understand something.
She understood why Bai Keqing had not returned to Myriad Demon Mountain in the Demon Domain for so long, why her life lamp was not only undiminished but had grown stronger; she understood why Bai Keqing could be here, and why she herself had been captured and brought to this place; she understood…
“Keqing, why are you here?”
Though Xue Yueqing had guessed the answer, she still asked, seeking confirmation from Bai Keqing herself.
“My lord came as I did,” Bai Keqing said with a bitter smile.
When her husband had arrived at her chamber just now, she thought he was there to seek dual cultivation with her. But then he informed her that he had captured Demon Empress Xue Yueqing.
Though Bai Keqing had anticipated it, she was still shocked by how quick her husband’s actions had been.
Soon, she realized the purpose of her husband’s visit to her chamber—to have her go to the summit of Chengdao Peak later and persuade Xue Yueqing to accept her fate and peacefully become her husband’s Dao companion.
Naturally, Bai Keqing had no objections. With Empress Xue Yueqing present, they would simply have one more sister. It was someone she already knew, and in the future, they could stand together against her husband’s conquests.
“As expected.”
Demon Empress Xue Yueqing exhaled, instantly understanding the purpose of Bai Keqing’s presence.
The Ye Fan who had rescued Bai Keqing from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm years ago was a member of this superpower, and after bringing back Bai Keqing, she likely became his Dao companion as well.
At the time, she had been puzzled: how had a peak True Martial Realm expert suddenly appeared in Qianyuan Divine Province with no traceable origin?
Previously, when she came to the Xuan Domain to trace Bai Keqing’s whereabouts without success—her senses blocked—it seemed logical now that Bai Keqing had been in this mountain range all along, protected by a grand array at the level of the Sacred Abyss Realm and numerous Sacred Soldiers and imperial weapons. It was only normal for her to be undetectable.
If Bai Keqing had become that man’s Dao companion, and he also wished for her to do the same, Bai Keqing’s arrival must have this purpose.
“Are you well here?”
“Has he promised you anything? Has it been fulfilled?”
Demon Empress Xue Yueqing sighed asking these questions.
Although she had reached a decision in her heart, she still wanted to learn more.

chapters.title: Chapter 363: 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: Chapter 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_1
“I’m doing very well here.”
As she spoke of this, a genuine smile of happiness appeared on Bai Keqing’s face without any pretense.
Life on Chengsheng Mountain was countless times more relaxed than on Myriad Demon Mountain. There was no such great pressure; she didn’t have to worry about the welfare of her clan or ponder over its future, much less fret about her own future.
Here, Bai Keqing felt that life in Han Mansion was truly blissful.
She could discuss the strengths of cultivation techniques with her husband and quickly improve her own power through dual cultivation. Even when her husband wasn’t dual cultivating with her, she had access to an abundance of precious cultivation resources, without the need to fight bitterly for them.
When not cultivating, she could accompany the other pampered wives and beautiful concubines of Han Li on leisurely excursions, admiring the magnificent scenery of Chengsheng Mountain. Having been here for six or seven years, she had made quite a few good friends among her ‘sisters’, and they didn’t have to engage in vicious competition for favor.
Besides, she frequently visited her children—all six of them lived on Dengdao Peak, with numerous maids taking care of their daily needs, so she could watch them grow up gradually.
Her children were all highly talented, with two being Fourth Grade and four being Third Grade—standing out even within Han Mansion. Among Lu Tianxiang’s four children, only two could match them.
Among Han Li’s other pampered wives and beautiful concubines, apart from Long Yue, who had married into the family recently and had not yet had children, none of their offspring could match the talents of hers.
Once the six children grew to the age of eight, they would receive the best training from their father. With a smooth path ahead, they were bound to achieve great things.
All this brought immense satisfaction to Bai Keqing.
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing and Yue Ji both watched Bai Keqing intently and realized that she showed no sign of lying. Moreover, it would be meaningless to lie about such a thing; she was certain to become Han Li’s Dao Companion and would soon learn the truth.
A feeling of absurdity arose in their hearts. Bai Keqing, a proud Demon King of the Demon Clan, had only been with this supreme power for a few years, yet what exactly had Han Li given her that made her so utterly devoted?
Bai Keqing still had her clan in the Demon Domain; wasn’t she worried about them due to her prolonged absence?
As these thoughts flashed through their minds, Xue Yueqing and Yue Ji continued to observe Bai Keqing, curious to hear what she would say next.
“My husband didn’t promise me much, only that he would help me rapidly increase my cultivation level and assist me in reaching the Divine Yuan Realm in the future.”
Bai Keqing smiled happily.
Han Li had indeed not deceived her; her cultivation had already risen to the Fourth Heaven of the True Martial Realm and was now charging towards the Fifth Heaven, all within just six or seven years.
If she continued to cultivate at this pace, it would take less than a hundred years to break through to the Divine Yuan Realm and become a Demon Emperor. What’s more, she even had hopes of reaching the Tongxuan Realm. What could there possibly be to complain about?
At that time, Han Li had only been at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm. His cultivation was nowhere near as high as it was now. Although he could have easily dominated her, he had sincerely married her and kept all his promises, fulfilling them exceptionally well.
Bai Keqing was also curious about how her husband’s cultivation had advanced so quickly. She knew the other sisters were equally curious—people like Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi had past dealings with Han Li when his cultivation was still low.
But none of his pampered wives or beautiful concubines ever asked, knowing this was not their place to inquire. If Han Li wished to tell them, he would do so of his own accord. Asking might not only leave them without answers but could also annoy their husband and lower their standing in his heart.
As long as Han Li continued to treat them well, they couldn’t care less about these matters. The higher his cultivation, the better for them, as they could ascend to greater heights through his achievements, just as they had been experiencing rapid advancement in their cultivation.
“Is that all?”
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing and Yue Ji were both surprised. They had thought Han Li had promised Bai Keqing many benefits, yet it turned out to be just this.
It sounded too vague, almost as if he was leading Bai Keqing on. Yet, Bai Keqing believed it.
However, considering Bai Keqing’s cultivation level, Xue Yueqing and Yue Ji had to dismiss their initial thoughts.
This didn’t seem like a deception!
Bai Keqing’s cultivation had indeed improved. She was only at the First Heaven of the True Martial Realm when she left Myriad Demon Mountain, and when she departed from the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, she was still at the First Heaven.
But now, her cultivation had reached the Fourth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
In just six or seven years, her cultivation had soared by three minor realms—a remarkable feat in the True Martial Realm, especially for members of the Demon Clan, since each minor realm could take hundreds of years to surmount.
It was as if Bai Keqing had saved herself over a thousand years of cultivation time…
Continuing at this rate, Bai Keqing’s advancement to the Divine Yuan Realm as a Demon Emperor was indeed just a matter of time.
A faint pang of envy emerged in Xue Yueqing’s heart. Her talent was even higher than Bai Keqing’s, being a Second Grade talent, but it had also taken her hundreds of years to cultivate from the First to the Fourth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
And Bai Keqing had managed it in just a few years.
After a lengthy silence, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing couldn’t help but ask, “Has he made any promises to me?”
Even if he hadn’t made any promises, she would have no choice but to yield in the end. However, if Han Li had made promises, the more substantial they were, the more they would signify his regard for her.
The more Han Li valued her, the more she could let go of her pride, for, as a Demon Emperor, she deserved such esteem.
Yue Ji also listened intently, curious about the terms the powerful man would offer Xue Yueqing.
And what about herself?
What could she expect to receive?
Engrossed in her thoughts, Yue Ji lowered her head, embarrassed by such improper considerations…
“Sister, you are a Demon Emperor, so naturally my husband will extend the highest regard to you,” said Bai Keqing suddenly, with a laugh, her beautiful and wild face flashing with a hint of envy.

chapters.title: Chapter 364: 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 364: Chapter 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_2
Her husband truly had spoken these words to her, and she was shocked upon hearing them. Her husband was really willing to invest heavily for the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
Currently among her husband’s beloved wives and beautiful concubines, Long Yue had the highest cultivation level, she ranked second, and Lu Tianxiang third; all were at the True Martial Realm.
Her husband had offered certain terms to Long Yue, and Bai Keqing vaguely knew what they were, yet she did not feel jealous or mind, since Long Yue was the reincarnation of the Jiao Saint and was destined to once again become a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm.
Although she was shocked by the terms her husband offered to Xue Yueqing, she didn’t get jealous. Xue Yueqing had treated her well in the past, protected her for a long time, and in terms of cultivation, status, appearance, and figure, Xue Yueqing was top-notch. It was natural for her to receive such terms.
With Xue Yueqing’s cultivation level, upon marrying into the Han Mansion, she would automatically become the one with the highest cultivation among her husband’s beloved wives and beautiful concubines.
Bai Keqing did not think the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing would refuse her husband’s terms. She knew very well that Xue Yueqing wouldn’t refuse, nor did she have any room to refuse.
Just like herself back then, and Long Yue not too long ago.
Although they were all moved by her husband’s sincerity, initially it was a choice made reluctantly under the weight of her husband’s strength.
After marrying her husband, Bai Keqing realized that she had indeed made the right choice.
Bai Keqing believed that Xue Yueqing would make this right choice as well.
“Keqing, can you tell sister about it?”
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was moved and voluntarily lowered her stature to accept the earlier address from Bai Keqing.
Before, Bai Keqing had always referred to her as Miss Xue Yueqing, and Xue Yueqing also felt this was natural as her cultivation and status were higher than Bai Keqing’s, and Bai Keqing was a trusted subordinate she had personally nurtured.
Even though Xue Yueqing felt somewhat awkward when Bai Keqing first called her sister, she didn’t say anything, and now she had actively acknowledged it.
Marrying that man as a Dao companion was the best choice, and her only choice. As a Dao companion of the same man, she and Bai Keqing would naturally become sisters in no time.
Even though she joined later, she couldn’t bring herself to call Bai Keqing sister, as she herself couldn’t overcome that hurdle in her heart. To call the other Dao companions sisters was barely acceptable.
“I am here exactly to talk to sister about this.”
Glancing at Yue Ji, Bai Keqing stuck out her little tongue and licked her lips, her seductive charm inviting pity.
She also knew the one beside Xue Yueqing; her husband had mentioned her before. The Artifact Spirit of the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon Heavenly Moon Wheel, called Yue Ji.
Had Yue Ji not been an Artifact Spirit, Bai Keqing might have suspected her husband would want to marry Yue Ji as well, since Yue Ji’s beauty and figure were not a whit inferior to Xue Yueqing’s, yet their temperaments were completely different.
Casting aside distracting thoughts, Bai Keqing slowly began to speak, “Husband made four promises to sister, hoping sister would consider them carefully.”
“The first promise, to elevate sister’s talents to First Grade within ten years.”
“The second promise, to assist sister in cultivating to the peak of Divine Yuan Realm within a hundred years.”
“The third promise, to give sister a Tongxuan Pill to aid her cultivation to the Tongxuan Realm, and husband also said the Tongxuan Pill can be given first.”
“The fourth promise, to hand over the Heavenly Moon Wheel to sister to manage from now on.”
Looking at Xue Yueqing and Yue Ji, Bai Keqing’s face was full of smiles. She knew that the Demon Emperor would soon become an intimate sister to her.
Even if her husband hadn’t made these promises, Miss Xue Yueqing would have certainly chosen to be his Dao companion. Otherwise, she would have been made into a servant concubine or a female slave by her husband, and the treatment between the two was worlds apart.
Moreover, the promises made by her husband were too attractive. She was heart-thrilled upon hearing them and marveled at how much her husband was willing to spend.
Although Bai Keqing felt a twinge of envy, she wasn’t jealous. Xue Yueqing was the Demon Emperor; she deserved this.
Even though her husband didn’t make these promises to her, she would definitely have them in the future. Her current goal was to cultivate to the Divine Yuan Realm. The Tongxuan Realm was a matter for later, and her husband would surely help.
Having lived together for so many years, Bai Keqing knew Han Li very well. They had discussed the Dao countless times. Her husband was not heartless and, despite his amorous nature, took care of every beloved wife and beautiful concubine, otherwise, he would not have thought of improving the talents of the less endowed concubines.
Now with the Life-Prolonging Furnace, even her, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and other beloved wives of her husband could continue to improve their talents, which were bound to reach First Grade in the future.
With talents reaching First Grade and her husband’s assistance, it was very promising for them to cultivate to the Tongxuan Realm and become powerful beings, perhaps even glimpse into the Saint Abyss Realm.
The background of their Chengsheng Mountain was no lesser than that of the Sacred Lands, with top-notch Sacred Soldiers and Supreme Grade Quasi Emperor weapons like the Life-Prolonging Furnace, Time-Sky Tower, and Battle Tower, all offering formidable supplementary effects to cultivation.
Although Myriad Demon Mountain also had two similar treasures, they paled in comparison to those of Chengsheng Mountain, and not everyone could use Myriad Demon Mountain’s two great treasures.
Even as a True Martial Realm Demon King, she had only used them once, at a great personal cost. The benefits, however, were astonishing and greatly increased her chances of ascending to the True Martial Realm, subsequently condensing a Second Grade Martial True Pill.
Xue Yueqing and Yue Ji had their pupils constrict sharply at the first promise, and with each promise heard, their faces showed increasing levels of shock. By the time Bai Keqing finished speaking, both women looked stunned.
Xue Yueqing’s heart thumped wildly. She admitted she was attracted and her heart was racing.
Each of the four promises from that man was a huge lure for her. Just any one of them would have sufficed for her to agree, and now that man had given four, the sincerity was overwhelming. Xue Yueqing couldn’t help but feel a few strands of warmth in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 365: 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 365: Chapter 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_3
She was merely a prisoner at the moment, and even if that person did not offer any promises, she had no choice but to submit, for she did not wish to die. She still had tens of thousands of years of lifespan, still aspired to cultivate to the Tongxuan Realm, and longed to be the next ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain.
Now, as long as she agreed to that person, it seemed all her dreams could come true.
With her aptitude raised to Supreme Grade, her cultivation speed would greatly accelerate. Even without the resources of the Divine Yuan Realm to refine, the time it took her to break through minor boundaries would dramatically decrease.
Based on her own estimate, if no external forces aided her, such as a great opportunity to rapidly advance in realm, it would take her at least six thousand years to reach the pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm.
By then, she would only have about five thousand years of life left, which certainly wasn’t enough to break through to the Tongxuan Realm, unless she obtained a heaven-defying opportunity.
There were no shortage of peak Divine Yuan Realm powerhouses in Myriad Demon Mountain and other Sacred Lands, several of whom had been stuck at this threshold for thousands of years. None of them had an aptitude lower than hers; if they couldn’t break through, she had no hope either.
However, if her aptitude were raised to Supreme Grade, she could reach the pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm within three thousand years, and the likelihood of breaking through to the Tongxuan Realm would be much greater.
This was just the first promise, and that person also promised to help her reach the pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm within a hundred years and bestow upon her the Tongxuan Pill to help her advance to the Tongxuan Realm.
This effectively shortened the tens of thousands of years of cultivation she needed into a single century and assured her successful advance to the Tongxuan Realm. What was there to be dissatisfied about?
The Heavenly Moon Wheel— a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon she had long coveted—was also unconditionally given to her, which could enhance her combat ability and life-preserving capability by many times.
In Myriad Demon Mountain, she could also obtain it, but she had to first cultivate to the pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm and complete accomplishments that satisfied the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang.
Observing Xue Yueqing’s excited demeanor and ever-changing expression, Bai Keqing stayed silent, simply watching quietly.
She sighed inwardly, as Xue Yueqing’s reaction seemed to mirror her own past self. The Demon Emperor had still fallen into her husband’s Devil’s Palm.
After being tempted for a long while, Xue Yueqing finally calmed her mind and said gravely, “How can you prove it?”
Xue Yueqing knew she had no right to demand proof from that person, but she still needed to ask, or else she wouldn’t feel at ease.
“Sister, you’re overthinking it,”
Bai Keqing smiled and replied, “My husband is willing to swear by the Oath Stone and doesn’t require a vow from sister. The Tongxuan Pill can also be given to sister first.”
“In that case, I agree.”
Upon hearing this, Xue Yueqing no longer hesitated and readily agreed.
If she didn’t agree, she might receive even better treatment, but it was more likely that she would lose even these promises and fall into an abyss.
What could she do if she didn’t appreciate the face given to her?
Xue Yueqing had no doubt that person could deliver, as that was a superpower on par with a Sacred Land, and the person was suspected to be a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm.
The only doubt was about the Tongxuan Pill. Currently, neither Myriad Demon Mountain nor Bai Yujing and other Sacred Lands had it, but that person’s promise to give it to her first dispelled the last bit of doubt in her heart.
“It’s good that sister agreed; from now on, we’ll truly be sisters,”
Hearing Xue Yueqing’s commitment, Bai Keqing also breathed a sigh of relief, saying with a smile, “In the years at Chengsheng Mountain, I really missed sister. If it weren’t for sister sending me to the Xuan Domain, how could I have met my husband?”
“I’ve always remembered sister’s kindness; I was worried sister’s defiance would bring hardship upon her.”
Xue Yueqing fell silent for a moment then chuckled lightly, probing, “Is sister blaming me?”
Bai Keqing shook her head and earnestly said, “I am truly grateful to sister. Everything I said earlier was heartfelt. I really had a good time at Chengsheng Mountain.”
“Even though I’ve only been Dao companions with my husband for seven years, I fell in love with him long ago. My heart is full of him, without room for anything else.”
Smiling, Bai Keqing continued, “Sister will know of my husband’s charisma in due time.”
Xue Yueqing relaxed a bit, glad that Bai Keqing bore no grudge, then nodded slightly and said, “I’ll see for myself.”
Her tone was full of anticipation; she couldn’t wait to learn more about that person. It was astonishing how he had made her rebellious, seductive wild demoness so submissive, so obedient, so consumed with thoughts of him.
Now, she was already feeling some of that generosity, that full sincerity which exceeded her expectations, involuntarily causing her to develop a fondness for him.
“Sister, we’ve talked so much, yet I still don’t know his name…”
Xue Yueqing extended her snow-white jade hand, taking Bai Keqing’s soft hand, and asked softly.
