“It’s my fault, I forgot to say it. My husband’s name is Han Li.”
Feeling the warmth of Xue Yueqing’s hand, Bai Keqing quickly responded.
“Han Li~”
Xue Yueqing quietly repeated the name several times, confirming she had never heard it before.
So, this was the name of her future Dao companion.
Xue Yueqing had no doubt that Bai Keqing was telling the truth; there was no point in lying. She would soon become Han Li’s Dao companion; there was no need to conceal it.
Behind the two women, Yue Ji hesitated, giving Xue Yueqing a glance and sighing silently before asking timidly, “What about me?”
Was she merely a background player?
Her true form was the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, the Heavenly Moon Wheel. Having followed Xue Yueqing to the Xuan Domain, not only did she get nothing, she was also suppressed and brought back. In the end, she was given to Xue Yueqing as a reward by that man. How did that make sense?
Xue Yueqing and Bai Keqing both turned their heads to look at Yue Ji, their faces revealing meaningful expressions.

chapters.title: Chapter 366: 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 366: Chapter 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_4
“`
“Cough, cough~ Yue Ji, don’t tell me you also fancy becoming Han Li’s Dao companion? But you are an Artifact Spirit…” Xue Yueqing blinked, feeling that there was something off about Yue Ji.
Bai Keqing felt the same way.
How could an Artifact Spirit dual cultivate with her husband?
Yue Ji lacked a physical body, and her current form was merely condensed from moonlight, an illusion; even if her husband wanted to cultivate with her, it wasn’t possible.
Yue Ji pursed her red lips and said weakly, “If he truly wished to, with his means, it wouldn’t be hard for him to create a physical body for me, right?”
“Or he could marry me first, then help me upgrade the Heavenly Moon Wheel to a Quasi Emperor weapon, or even an Emperor weapon, I should then be able to create a real body for myself.”
After much deliberation, Yue Ji sensed that her previous intuition wasn’t wrong—Han Li certainly had intentions toward her; it must be due to her identity as an Artifact Spirit that he had not expressed it.
Yue Ji thought that she could still salvage the situation for herself.
Why should she, with such favorable treatment, only fall to being a weapon, and moreover, one used by Xue Yueqing? Why didn’t Han Li use her himself?
Xue Yueqing had no words for that.
“You do have a cunning plan,” Bai Keqing sighed, “but what to do specifically still depends on my husband’s decision.”
Yue Ji’s ambitions weren’t small at all, actually hoping for her husband to help her upgrade the Heavenly Moon Wheel to a Quasi Emperor weapon, or even an Emperor weapon.
The resources required for an elevation to Quasi Emperor weapon far exceeded one Tongxuan Pill, not to mention the legendary Immortal Cultivating Pill.
Yue Ji stuck her little tongue out and stopped talking, feeling that her request was a bit too much.
Bai Keqing chatted some more with Xue Yueqing, then led her to the palace area on Chengdao Peak, where her husband had already assigned a sleeping palace for Xue Yueqing.
After completing these tasks, Bai Keqing approached Han Li, who was at the edge of a cliff, watching a waterfall in the distance, where some descendants of Han Mansion were tempering their bodies.
“This waterfall, in combination with Han Mansion’s cultivation technique, indeed greatly accelerates the pace of body tempering,” Bai Keqing observed thoughtfully.
Before the path of cultivation, there are three realms: body tempering, blood exchange, and True Qi. These three realms don’t count as cultivators; in the Mortal World, they are considered martial arts experts.
These three realms serve as the foundation before cultivation. Once completed, one can formally step onto the path of cultivation and embark on the journey of seeking the Dao.
The path of cultivation begins with the Innate stage, followed by the realms of Sea Opening, Gang Yuan, Spirit Refinement, Hollow Void, and up to Myriad Phenomena; these six Big Realms constitute the first step of cultivation.
For cultivators in the first step, their combat ability gradually climbs, but the increase in lifespan isn’t significant. For those of the Human Clan, those at the first realm, the Innate, live up to two hundred years, and those at the sixth realm, Myriad Phenomena, live only up to a thousand years.
Breaking through from the Myriad Phenomena Realm to the True Martial Realm and condensing the Martial True Pill marks the entrance to the second step of cultivation, which also encompasses six Big Realms: True Martial Realm, Divine Yuan Realm, Tongxuan Realm, Holy Abyss Realm, Quasi Emperor Domain, and Heaven Imperial Realm.
Those stepping into the second tier of cultivation see their combat ability grow increasingly faster—it’s a period of rapid surge. At the Heaven Imperial Realm of the Great Emperor, one can destroy galaxies with a wave of the hand, shatter boundless star systems with a flick of a finger.
In the second tier of cultivation, a cultivator’s lifespan also explodes, matching their combat ability, as they step progressively into longevity and live freely among mortals.
Two thousand years for True Martial Realm, five thousand for Divine Yuan Realm, ten thousand for Tongxuan Realm, a hundred thousand for Holy Abyss Realm, three hundred thousand for Quasi Emperor Domain, and a million for Heaven Imperial Realm.
Once one becomes immortal, it’s the third step of the path of cultivation, which, according to ancient records, is divided into seven Big Realms. Bai Keqing only knows that the first three Big Realms are Heavenly Immortal, True Immortal, and Golden Immortal, while the latter three are lost to history.
As for the final Big Realm of the third step, Bai Keqing does know it—it’s called the Immortal Emperor Realm and represents the supreme among the Immortal Domain.
Legends of the Immortal Emperor circulate in the Endless Yuankun Domain, revered as supreme and unparalleled, but no one in the Endless Yuankun Domain has ever seen an Immortal Emperor.
If it were not for the Great Calamity that occurs every two hundred million years, claiming even True Immortals with ease, the pinnacle forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain would start to doubt the existence of Golden Immortals.
Stepping into the third phase of cultivation grants true longevity. Lifespan and combat ability increase by hundreds to thousands of times—just being a Heavenly Immortal allows one to live for one hundred and twenty-nine million six hundred thousand years, which equates to one epoch.
Legend has it that the True Immortal Realm can grant a lifespan of one hundred epochs, while attaining the Golden Immortal Realm is said to offer eternal life, but Bai Keqing has not seen corresponding records in ancient history; it seems no cultivator has truly reached the Golden Immortal Realm within the Endless Yuankun Domain.
In a crumbling ancient record, Bai Keqing once came across this remark: “Immortal Emperor is not the end; there is a fourth step on the path of cultivation. To transcend and attain great eternal freedom, one must set foot on the fourth step of cultivation.”
“If these children can reach the second step of cultivation in the future, that would already be quite an accomplishment,” Han Li sighed.
About the divisions of the path of cultivation, Han Li had already learned from Bai Keqing and Long Yue, and his ambition naturally grew within him.
Although the Yuankun Domain’s great calamity was dreadful, Han Li wasn’t too concerned; it had been only eleven thousand years since the last ancient calamity, and it would be over two hundred million years before the next great calamity of the Yuankun Domain.
With such an immensely long period, Han Li believed he would have long since become immortal, perhaps even reaching the Golden Immortal Realm or higher.
If Han Mansion maintained this trajectory, how many descendants would there be after more than two hundred million years?
Not to mention spreading throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain, but certainly to be counted in the trillions. How strong would he be at that time?
Although the fourth step of cultivation is but a legend among legends, Han Li set it as his own goal; the Immortal Emperor Realm was merely a landmark on his path of cultivation, his aim was transcendence, eternity, the ineffable, indescribable, unthinkable… realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 367: Chapter 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_5
Withdrawing his gaze, Han Li pulled Bai Keqing into his embrace, took in her delicate fragrance with a sniff, and said with a smile, “Has Xue Yueqing agreed?”
“Agreed.”
“With such terms, any Divine Yuan Realm Emperor of War would agree.”
Bai Keqing nodded, a smile also spreading across her face, and then she took the initiative to bite Han Li’s lips, launching an assault.
“Are you satisfied now, my dear?” Caressing Bai Keqing’s seductively wild face, Han Li spoke softly.
Lying in her husband’s arms, Bai Keqing turned from a little wildcat into a little kitten, pouting her lips and said, “It’s the husband who is satisfied.”
Xue Yueqing would be coming, which would take some pressure off her and handle her husband’s advances, but isn’t the real beneficiary the husband himself?
“Hahaha~”
Han Li burst into laughter, feeling refreshed and invigorated, for he already knew what kind of demon Xue Yueqing was.
The true exemplar of a vixen!
Of course, Xue Yueqing was not just any vixen; she hailed from the Sky Fox Clan and had become an Eight-Tailed Celestial Fox. If she were to sprout a ninth tail, Xue Yueqing would be promoted to the Tongxuan Realm and become a great powerhouse.
Han Li currently had three demon clan beauties and concubines; his beloved wife Bai Keqing was a Snake Demon, his concubine Fang Yousi a Flower Demon, and his concubine Bi Xinlei a Fox Demon.
As for Long Yue, she did not really count as a demon clan, instead barely classified under the Dragon Clan.
Even though Bi Xinlei was a Fox Demon, she did not belong to the Sky Fox Clan, but she had already provided Han Li with a rather satisfying experience.
Now, Han Li was curious to taste what an Eight-Tailed Celestial Fox was like. He only sealed Xue Yueqing’s cultivation base, her physical strength remained, ready to accommodate his “cultivation” well when the time came.
Three days later, Han Li formally welcomed Xue Yueqing into his home as a bride.
This news spread throughout Yonchang Manor, causing the leaders of various powers in Yonchang Manor to frown and sigh.
It was exactly what they were afraid of.
They were still praying that the old ancestor of the Han Mansion would not take wives so frequently, yet the old ancestor had taken another and another and another wife.
This was already the third marriage within a year, and each time they had to prepare precious gifts; this kind of expense would eventually empty their coffers.
Regarding the old ancestor of the Han Mansion marrying frequently, the great powers already had their complaints, and if this continued, grievances would be loud and numerous.
Although they were displeased in their hearts, the various powers still actively took part in the old ancestor Han’s grand wedding ceremony. It would be too costly if the old ancestor harbored resentment against them.
The wedding ceremony of the old ancestor Han was a grand affair, with various powers attending in full to show their respect. Seats were filled to the brim, and for a time, Chengsheng Mountain bubbled with voices and became the focus of Yonchang Manor once again.
And along shores of the three great rivers within a hundred miles of Chengsheng Mountain, bountiful banquets were laid out for the secular commoners nearby to feast to their hearts’ content.
The cultivator powers of Yonchang Manor might have grievances, but the secular commoners around Chengsheng Mountain were ecstatic. The old ancestor Han was finally getting married again, something they had long hoped for.
Every time the old ancestor Han took a concubine, they could enjoy lavish meals for free for three days. Every time he married, they could do the same for seven days, which truly felt like the days of the gods to them.
These commoners had long since revered the old ancestor of the Han Mansion as a celestial being, offering daily incense and prayers, hoping that he would take more wives and concubines.
With Han Li’s strength, for these secular commoners, there was no doubt he was as a deity.
Thanks to this strategy, the population of secular commoners within a two-hundred-mile radius of Chengsheng Mountain surged, and daily, large numbers of people moved there from other parts of Yonchang Manor, resulting in several new mortal cities springing up within this area.
Han Li was fully aware of these developments and made no intervention, allowing things to evolve naturally.
A small number of secular commoners were of little use to the Han Mansion, but when there are many – like tens of millions or even hundreds of millions – they become significant.
If the population base grows, each year there will be quite a few with the talent for cultivation. With some luck, they might even find some seedlings with higher cultivation talent.
This was Han Li’s “vegetable patch,” where those with talent would be nurtured and could replenish some of the Han Mansion’s servants. If they were talented and beautiful, they could marry directly into the Han Mansion.
Based on their talent and beauty, they would be taken by Han Li or his descendants.
Han Li always hoped that his vegetable patch would produce someone like Yao Xi, a reborn powerhouse, or even a person of great fate. Even if their parents were mortal, their talent could reach Third Grade or even Immortal Grade.
Unfortunately, the golden seedling he had been awaiting had yet to emerge, possibly because not enough time had passed.
After the grand wedding, Han Li flashed to the outer chamber of Xue Yueqing’s bedroom, their bridal chamber.
Standing outside the chamber, Han Li was in high spirits; the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had officially become his wife, and she was his first Divine Yuan Realm peerless female cultivator to marry.
Although Xue Yueqing was only of Second Grade talent, she was perfect for Han Li, who had just been lacking a wife of such calibre.
Once Xue Yueqing bore his child, typically, he would have a Second Grade talented descendant. Since it would be his first descendant of this grade, he would receive a reward.
His other wife, the Dragon Princess Long Yue, had Immortal Grade talent and a special constitution known as the Mystical Yin Monarch Body. Their first child might likely inherit Immortal Grade talent. Whether they will inherit the Mystical Yin Monarch Body, Han Li was not certain, but he anticipated another reward regardless.
Similarly married this year, Yao Xi was someone Han Li could not quite fathom.
Yao Xi had been married after Long Yue and was already a few months pregnant; Han Li did not know what kind of talent the offspring would possess.
He had always suspected Yao Xi to be reborn, but he could not discern if her previous life had been that of a strong individual from the Tongxuan Realm, a Saint from the Saint Abyss Realm, a Great Emperor from the Heaven Imperial Realm, or even a real goddess.

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 368: Chapter 192 Step Four of Cultivation: The Path to Transcendence, Pursuing Eternity_6
“`
Past life cultivation levels have a significant impact on Yao Xi in this life.
Another reason is that Yao Xi has yet not decoded the mystery of the womb, failing to completely merge her past life memories with her current life, resulting in her past life’s aptitude remaining unmerged. Currently, Yao Xi only possesses the aptitude of this life.
Yao Xi’s aptitude in this life is not high, only at the fifth rank, which, at that time, was still the top rank in Lingjun City. Back then, the best aptitude in Lingjun City was only around the seventh or eighth rank.
Now, Yao Xi has embarked on the path of cultivation, with the help of Han Li’s dual cultivation and some experience from her past life, her cultivation level has broken through rapidly. In just a few months, she has already reached the Pihai Realm.
This is despite the fact that Yao Xi is pregnant, and the child in her womb is absorbing her vitality. Otherwise, Yao Xi’s cultivation speed would be even faster.
Sighing inwardly, Han Li cut off his distracting thoughts and strode into Xue Yueqing’s bedchamber. Approaching Xue Yueqing, he gently lifted her red bridal veil.
In an instant, Xue Yueqing, dressed in a vivid red bridal costume, appeared perfectly before Han Li’s eyes, stunning him to silence.
It must be said that the higher one’s cultivation, the higher their beauty tends to be. Xue Yueqing is a case in point, her looks, figure, and charm rank easily in the top three among all of Han Li’s beautiful wives and concubines.
If Han Li were to rate them, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and Bai Keqing, along with the women from The Li Manor like Xue Qingyi, Chu Xianlin, Song Zhixuan, and others, would all be in the same category, with their beauty scores around ninety-five or so.
Long Yue, Yao Xi, and Xue Yueqing’s beauty, however, is even more exceptional, making them the three most beautiful among Han Li’s wives.
“Husband~ what are you waiting for?”
Xue Yueqing, seeing Han Li’s stunned state, felt a flash of pride in her heart for her own beauty, and then softly opened her mouth to speak.
In these few days, Han Li had already sworn an oath, given her the Tongxuan Pill, and introduced her to his other wives and concubines, earning their recognition.
Although Xue Yueqing has the pride of a Demon Emperor, she is a woman of her word. Since she agreed to it and married Han Li, she has recognized him as her chosen one.
Han Li is her partner in the cultivation path, and she would not hesitate to call him husband when appropriate.
“Qing’er, your husband is coming right now.”
Han Li instantly snapped back to his senses and moved closer, spending a blissful night with the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
Atop Chengdao Peak, Long Yue, Yao Xi, and Bai Keqing were enjoying the scenery together when suddenly they felt the peak shake, accompanied by the comfortable cries of a fox.
Yao Xi blinked, unsure of what had happened, while Long Yue and Bai Keqing exchanged a look, both wearing smiles on their faces.
Their physical bodies were strong, and when they battled with their husband, it was the same. But compared to the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, they were somewhat inferior; the commotion was even louder than that made by them.
Yao Xi, seeing the smiles on Bai Keqing and Long Yue’s faces, suddenly understood and blushed with embarrassment, giving a coy spit.
“The husband really has no shame, making such a big commotion,” Yao Xi murmured softly.
“When has our husband ever been concerned with shame?” Bai Keqing said with a laugh.
“Xi Xi, don’t worry. We have set up a special formation around Chengdao Peak, so no matter how loud the noise, it won’t spread outside,”
Long Yue reassured softly. The last time was the same when she initially married their husband; they had been in continuous combat for seven days.
“`
Xue Yueqing was the Demon Emperor, her physical body was stronger, and it probably would last for ten days.
However strong she was, she would still be subdued by the husband. Their physical bodies were far inferior to the husband’s, whose physique was comparable to a great power of the Tongxuan Realm.
Such a commotion wasn’t only noticed by Long Yue, Bai Keqing, and Yao Xi, but also by the beloved wives like Jiang Baiye, Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue, as well as the beautiful concubines like Zhang Yuyan, Zhang Lan, Chu Yutong, and Zhou Zhirou, who were cultivating in their own palace halls, or elsewhere on Chengdao Peak.
To such disturbances, they had long since grown accustomed. Those with thicker skins merely paused for a moment before continuing with their tasks, while those with thinner skins huffed lightly, their pretty faces flushing red.
In their hearts, they were actually very envious. Their cultivation was too low, their physical bodies not strong enough; they couldn’t possibly create such a ruckus even if they wanted to.
Every time the husband dual cultivated with them, he would seal a major part of his physical body; otherwise, they simply couldn’t withstand his rigor. Even so, Han Li was always very gentle and never dared to be too hasty.
As Long Yue had predicted, Han Li debated with Xue Yueqing for ten consecutive days, not letting her go until she pleaded multiple times and he had subdued her to his satisfaction.
Of course, during this period Han Li spent only a third of the time in combat with Xue Yueqing, discussing the strengths and weaknesses of their Dao, while the rest of the time he spent accompanying his other cherished wives and concubines, moving between The Li Manor and Han Mansion.
He would also occasionally check on the cultivation progress of their descendants or offer them guidance, expounding the Dao and teaching.
After ten days, Han Li and Xue Yueqing stood together at the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Han Li naturally embraced the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, feeling the soft and fragrant body within his arms, and couldn’t help but lower his head and capture those exquisite red lips.
Xue Yueqing nestled against her husband Han Li’s broad and powerful chest. Faced with Han Li’s advances, Xue Yueqing didn’t refuse but instead took the initiative to raise her head and engage with Han Li.
During these ten days, she had grown accustomed to such closeness with Han Li. The two of them intimately rubbing temples and ears, sticking together like glue here, seemed like a pair of immortal lovers.
“Husband, dual cultivation with you is truly too delightful,” Xue Yueqing said softly.
During dual cultivation, she felt extreme pleasure, and her cultivation level rapidly increased; merely ten days of dual cultivation were equivalent to ten years for her.
This took Xue Yueqing by surprise, and she fully understood why Bai Keqing’s cultivation had progressed by leaps and bounds—it was all from dual cultivating with the husband.
Now, Xue Yueqing was somewhat addicted to this sensation.
Being able to enjoy a pleasant life while rapidly increasing cultivation—who wouldn’t love that?
Unfortunately, Xue Yueqing also knew she couldn’t monopolize Han Li; she was only one of his Dao companions.
The husband, besides them as Dao companions, had a plethora of beautiful concubines. Those concubines, with weaker physical bodies, didn’t occupy much of his time, but it was different with his other Dao companions.
“If Qing’er likes it, that’s good.”
Han Li’s large hand caressed Xue Yueqing’s smooth and flat belly, inhaling her body’s fragrance while feeling the small life inside of her.
After ten days of cultivation, Xue Yueqing had successfully conceived his child, and Han Li could feel the aura of the new life emerging.

chapters.title: Chapter 369: 193: Another Imperial Weapon Emerges! The Dragon Girl and the Rainbow Dragon Loach!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 369: Chapter 193: Another Imperial Weapon Emerges! The Dragon Girl and the Rainbow Dragon Loach!_1
Before they knew it, half a month had passed.
On this day, Han Li strolled through a mortal city near Chengsheng Mountain with Yao Xi.
With Han Li deliberately concealing his presence, the mortals did not notice anything unusual. In their eyes, Han Li and Yao Xi were just an ordinary husband and wife.
Yao Xi, holding Han Li’s hand, walked cheerfully down the street, sometimes stopping to look at this, sometimes stopping to look at that. In no time, she had bought a large pile of tasty treats: sugar figurines, candied haw sticks, meat buns, beggar’s chicken…
Han Li tucked these away in his sleeve and continued to accompany Yao Xi as they shopped. A smile remained on his face, showing no sign of impatience.
Aside from Yao Xi wanting to experience the hustle and bustle of the human world, Han Li also wanted to take a walk to see if he could find a promising chive seedling.
“Husband, I want to eat a fresh flower cake.”
“Husband, I want to eat Dragon’s Beard Candy.”
“Husband, I want to eat mung bean cake.”
Yao Xi, holding Han Li’s hand, acted coquettishly with hopeful eyes.
These snacks were nothing to her; she had eaten countless delicacies in the Han Mansion. But now, in her and Han Li’s little world, Yao Xi wanted Han Li to buy them for her; somehow, the snacks seemed tastier at this moment.
“Alright, alright, I’ll buy everything for Xi Xi.”
Han Li chuckled, pulled out some silver, and at each stand he threw down a large ingot, magnanimously telling the vendors to keep the change.
“Husband is the best~”
Yao Xi tiptoed to give Han Li a kiss, her face radiating happiness.
The couple continued to stroll for a while until Yao Xi suddenly pulled Han Li toward a crowd of people. With a slight lift of his eyelid, Han Li knew what was happening and did not refuse.
They walked briskly closer and joined the crowd of onlookers.
At the center of the onlookers were two figures, a father and daughter. The father appeared to be in his thirties, and the daughter about seven or eight, both dressed in coarse old clothes patched up quite a bit.
The father and daughter were performing, putting on a brilliant show that elicited praise from the crowd.
But when the little girl held up a bowl to collect the reward money, only a few people tipped, which made her look more and more disheartened.
The middle-aged man, seeing this scene, clenched his fist behind his back, his heart sinking with regret for his inability.
When the little girl approached Han Li and Yao Xi with her bowl, Yao Xi squeezed her husband’s palm. Han Li smiled and immediately called out,
“Good show, a reward is due!”
His robust voice erupted like thunder, bringing surprised joy to the disheartened father and daughter. The middle-aged man quickly looked over upon hearing the voice, and the surrounding people also turned their gaze in that direction.
Excitedly lifting her head, the little girl’s clear eyes looked at the plain-looking couple in front of her, her face brimming with joy.
It wasn’t about how much she was tipped; just getting by was enough. She simply didn’t want her hard work and her father’s performance to go unrecognized.
Han Li extended his right hand, placed his sleeve over the bowl the little girl was holding up, and gave it a shake. Ingots of silver instantly fell down, filling the bowl to the brim.
“Sir, that’s enough, that’s enough, please don’t give any more,” the little girl said excitedly, but hurriedly added.
Han Li nodded slightly and stopped giving silver.
The surrounding locals watched in awe, seeing so much gleaming silver for the first time. It was dazzling.
Although tempted, no one spoke; the couple looked ordinary, but anyone who could give so much in tips was certainly not common. Offending someone of high status would be troublesome.
Looking at the silver in her bowl, the little girl hesitated for just a moment before saying, “Sir, we do not need so much silver, not even a single ingot. A little small change will do.”
With that, the little girl held up the bowl again, signaling for Han Li to take back the previously given tips and leave her with a little small change.
At this moment, the girl’s father also came over and solemnly said, “Esteemed sir, we thank you for your compassionate deed, but we cannot accept a reward we have not earned. Our performance is not worth so much silver; please, sir, take it back.”
The middle-aged man bowed deeply and did not straighten up.
Surprise appeared on the faces of the onlookers, even greater than when Han Li had given so much in tips. There was at least several dozen taels of silver there, enough to sustain an ordinary man for ten years, yet this father and daughter were resisting the temptation. If it had been any of the onlookers, surely they would have accepted.
A hint of admiration flashed in Han Li’s eyes. After a moment’s thought, he flicked two streams of True Yuan into the bodies of the father and daughter, transforming them into True Yuan seeds that would continuously improve their constitutions.
Although the father and daughter had no innate talent, with the help of the True Yuan seeds, within a year they would be able to reach the peak of the True Qi Realm, their combat ability surpassing many Innate Realm Cultivators.
The True Yuan seeds could also extend the lives of the father and daughter, allowing them to live an extra thirty to fifty years without issue, and achieve success in the future.
Afterward, Han Li took back most of the silver, leaving only one ingot behind as he left with Yao Xi.
In the past, he had searched everywhere for opportunities; now, he himself was the opportunity for countless cultivators. With his strength, even the slightest leak of it would be a vast opportunity for others.
“Thank you, sir, for the reward!”
Feeling a warm sensation in their bodies, the father and daughter once again bowed and called out.
Yao Xi looked back, waving her hand, as she left with her husband.
“Husband, thank you,” she suddenly said as they walked down the street.
Seeing the little girl reminded her of herself in the past, also living only with her father. After her father’s death, she had reluctantly tried to sell herself to afford his burial, but nobody wanted to buy, until she met her husband Han Li.
Because she had experienced darkness, she wanted to bring light to the little girl.

chapters.title: Chapter 370: 193: Another Imperial Weapon Emerges! The Dragon Girl and the Rainbow Dragon Loach!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 370: Chapter 193: Another Imperial Weapon Emerges! The Dragon Girl and the Rainbow Dragon Loach!_2
“Foolish girl,” Han Li sighed and gently stroked her head.
Han Li didn’t consider himself a good person, but when faced with such matters, he would help if he could. However, he would not go around helping everyone he came across, everything depended on fate. If he encountered someone in need, he would consider lending assistance.
As the two chatted on their way, Yao Xi returned to her carefree self as a young girl, a pure smile appearing on her face as she tirelessly asked Han Li to buy her tasty snacks, enjoying herself immensely.
After wandering around the mortal city for over an hour, Han Li took Yao Xi back to Chengsheng Mountain.
Since the treasure chest had refreshed for the month, Han Li didn’t hesitate. This time, he had Yao Xi do her hair in a double ponytail; then, while holding the double ponytails, he expended five years of his cultivation to open the chest.
On a screen visible only to Han Li, a dazzling flash of golden light appeared, followed by the system’s notification sound in Han Li’s mind.
“Ding~ Congratulations to the master for obtaining from the treasure chest a lower grade Emperor Level weapon[Cangdao Hall]!”
Han Li’s pupils contracted slightly with excitement, and he firmly gripped the steering wheel as a way to properly repay Yao Xi’s efforts.
His Divine Sense scanned the information about the Cangdao Hall, and he instantly understood the function of this Quasi Emperor weapon.
Although the Cangdao Hall was a lower grade Emperor weapon, its offensive capabilities weren’t strong, but it contained a vast space within itself. It could divide layer upon layer of space according to the master’s requirements. Within this space, living beings could survive for up to a year.
If Cultivation Techniques, martial skills, and Secret Techniques were placed inside, the Cangdao Hall would autonomously read all the scriptures and then deduce new Cultivation Practices and martial skills, continuously expanding the number of scriptures.
Of course, this was limited to Divine Rank Practices and martial skills and below. For Divine Rank, Emperor Level, or even Immortal Level Cultivation Techniques and martial skills, the Cangdao Hall was not capable of deducing entirely new versions.
Han Li made his decision immediately. He would use the Cangdao Hall to place all the scriptures and miscellaneous books of Han Mansion, organizing them categorically and managing them with the Cangdao Hall’s Artifact Spirit, just as he had envisioned before.
Previously, he had wanted to establish a Cangdao Peak to house the scripture library for ease of management, but he had lacked the necessary Divine or Emperor weapons.
Now that he had the Cangdao Hall, he could establish Cangdao Peak, and thus another peak would be added to Han Mansion.
Chengsheng Mountain stretched over seven hundred miles with a main peak that soared three thousand feet high, known as Chengdao Peak, along with sixteen subsidiary peaks ranging from three to five thousand meters in height.
By now, Han Li had already put to use many of the subsidiary peaks. Counting the soon-to-be-established Cangdao Peak, there were nine in total. Including Chengdao Peak, that made ten peaks of Chengsheng Mountain in use.
After dual cultivating with Yao Xi and spending some more time with her, Han Li eventually left her chamber then headed to Yundao Peak, where he gathered the main stewards of Han Mansion and announced the establishment of Cangdao Peak.
He briefly explained his plans and then left the details for these descendants to fill in, instructing them to refine the plan and submit it to him for review.
A month later.
Han Li asked the Divine Beast Kuiyi, along with the Artifact Spirits of the Combat Tower and Cangdao Hall, to look after the home. After informing his beloved wives and concubines, such as Xue Yueqing, Lu Tianxiang, Qiu Yueyao, and Liu Yuexin, he left Da Qian with Long Yue and headed towards the East Sea.
Long Yue had been married to him for several months, and in another two or three months, she was due to give birth. Long Yue found this to be strange.
Initially, Long Yue hadn’t wanted the child; she directly assimilated the essence left by Han Li. Later, unable to withstand Han Li’s repeated requests and his explanation that it wouldn’t affect her cultivation progress, Long Yue relented.
What Long Yue found strange was the fact that she was a Jiaolong, yet she also experienced a ten-month pregnancy? Typically, a ten-month pregnancy was only common among Human Clan mortals and first-step Cultivators. Human Clan’s second-step and higher Cultivators, the Demon Clan, Barbarian Clan, and other races usually had longer pregnancy periods.
As a Jiaolong, she should have had a pregnancy lasting at least thirty years; a hundred-year pregnancy was also considered normal. Yet Long Yue felt the child in her womb was already nearly fully developed and at most would be born in two or three months.
Looking at her husband who smiled without speaking, Long Yue suspected it was due to him. Among his other beloved wives and concubines, there were those from the Demon Clan, like Bai Keqing, who also had ten-month pregnancies.
“No wonder my husband said it wouldn’t much hinder cultivation,” Long Yue thought to herself silently.
A year was not a long time, and she could accept having a child. Although it would deplete her vital energy, her husband had already considered these things and prepared many heavenly materials and earthly treasures to nourish her and replenish her vital energy.
“Yue’er, we’ve arrived,”
While Long Yue was lost in her thoughts, Han Li, with his arms around her waist, brought her to the East Sea Dragon Palace.
“Husband, wait for me just a moment,”
Long Yue leaned in and kissed Han Li on the cheek, speaking softly.
Han Li nodded, watching Long Yue enter the Dragon Palace without trying to pry unnecessarily.
With the birth of the child imminent, Long Yue had told him she needed to retrieve two items from the East Sea, one of which was within the East Sea Dragon Palace.
Only after obtaining both items could the child possibly inherit her special physique from a previous life, as she no longer possessed the Profound Yin King Body in her current life.
To this end, Han Li naturally would not refuse her request and gladly accompanied Long Yue.
Of course, before their arrival, Han Li had Zi Yi check everything within tens of millions of miles to ensure there were no ambushes or threats. Even at that moment, Zi Yi was on standby, ready to activate the Void Bell at the slightest sign of trouble.
While Han Li trusted Long Yue, it was necessary to be cautious in unfamiliar places. He needed to make preparations; otherwise, it would be all too easy for things to go wrong unexpectedly.
Soon, Long Yue came back out and extended her right hand to Han Li, smiling, “Husband, look—”

chapters.title: Chapter 371: 193: Another Imperial Weapon Emerges! The Dragon Girl and the Rainbow Dragon Loach!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 371: Chapter 193: Another Imperial Weapon Emerges! The Dragon Girl and the Rainbow Dragon Loach!_3
Han Li glanced over and his pupils constricted slightly. Long Yue had actually placed such an important treasure within the East Sea Dragon Palace.
“Husband, let’s go,” Long Yue said with a smile.
Han Li nodded slightly and, wrapping his arms around Long Yue’s soft slender waist, vanished from the East Sea Dragon Palace to the next destination.
According to Long Yue, the item at the next location was over ten times more important than that of the East Sea Dragon Palace. She must obtain it, as it was related to her future path.
On hearing this, Han Li was astonished. It was actually related to the Penglai Immortal Sect. Although he did not know how Long Yue had become entangled with the Penglai Immortal Sect, Han Li would try his best to fulfill her requests.
If their first child possessed a special constitution, it would be a boon for Han Li as well. He might gain great benefits from it.
However, the Penglai Immortal Sect was not to be trifled with. Its ruler was also a Great Master of the Tongxuan Realm, and within the sect, there were Immortal Soldiers that suppressed and stabilized fate. Unless necessary, Han Li would not force the issue.
During spatial movement, Han Li’s clothing, facial features, temperament, and even the aura of his Primordial Spirit all changed, and a bronze mask now adorned his face.
He did not wish to reveal his true identity just yet, especially not to superpowers like the Penglai Immortal Sect which were not inferior to Sacred Lands.
Under the full force of Han Li’s space shifting, they soon arrived at Penglai Immortal Island.
Looking at the massive and towering Immortal Mountain in the center of Penglai Immortal Island, piercing the clouds, Han Li couldn’t help but praise, “What a magnificent Penglai Divine Mountain.”
The grandeur of this Penglai Divine Mountain was probably slightly superior to both Xumi Mountain and Myriad Demon Mountain, only slightly inferior to the Barbarian Clan’s Peak of the Stars.
“It’s alright,” Long Yue responded noncommittally.
In her previous life as a Jiao Saint, she had a vast experience and had seen too many Divine Mountains and Immortal Mountains. The highest, largest, strongest, most majestic, and most revered among them was the Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
It was a Divine Mountain that despaired all second step Cultivators and third step Cultivators of the Endless Yuankun Domain. Neither Heavenly Immortals nor True Immortals could withstand a strand of sword energy from the revived Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
“You’ve finally arrived.”
As Han Li and Long Yue were reflecting, an ancient voice resounded in their ears.
Long Yue’s expression remained unchanged. It was only to be expected for the Penglai Immortal Sect’s Tongxuan Realm Great Master to discover her arrival.
The Immortal Soldier of the Penglai Immortal Sect might have fallen silent, but a strand of the Emperor Soldier’s might was constantly active, covering the entire Penglai Immortal Island and the nearby tens of thousands of miles, guarding against any accidents.
Han Li raised his eyebrows but said nothing. He had now hidden the Void Bell and was not deliberately covering himself with it. Zi Yi was linked to his mind and would autonomously choose to act depending on the situation.
What surprised him a bit was that the Tongxuan Realm Great Master of the Penglai Immortal Sect seemed to have anticipated Long Yue’s visit and appeared to have been waiting for quite a long time.
“Would you care to come over for a talk?”
On the cliffs of Penglai Immortal Mountain, the seagazing old Daoist opened his eyes and looked in the direction of Han Li and Long Yue, speaking again.
Long Yue cast a side glance at Han Li, and Han Li shook his head slightly.
“I would ask the senior Daoist to come out for a meeting,” Long Yue said. Her voice reached the Penglai Immortal Sect but was not heard by others, as the old Daoist hid it.
The seagazing old Daoist stood by the water tank, staring intently at Han Li’s figure in the reflected image within, his thoughts profound.
Afterward, he waved his hand, scattering the image, and a vibrant, seven-colored dragon loach appeared.
“Very well, I shall come out to meet you,” he said.
Watching the colorful dragon loach swim, the Daoist master Guanhai sighed, waved his sleeve, and took away the colorful dragon loach.
Afterward, he stretched out his hand and beckoned, and a chaotic-looking great bell hanging from the cliff flew towards him, shrinking as it came, before landing in his hand.
Upon consideration, Daoist master Guanhai beckoned again, and from the depths of Penglai Immortal Mountain, a purple rope flew towards him, wrapping around his waist.
“This should be safe now.”
Having done these things, a smile emerged on old Daoist master Guanhai’s face as he vanished from the cliff edge and appeared an instant later not far from Han Li and Long Yue.
Upon closer inspection of the man wearing a bronze mask, Daoist master Guanhai felt a sense of threat emanating from him; this was undoubtedly a powerful being from the Tongxuan Realm.
He didn’t know how the dragon girl managed to find a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse to help her, but he wouldn’t skimp on his precautions, not even for Long Yue, this person with a significant karmic connection to Penglai Immortal Sect.
“Fellow Daoist, it seems I’ve met you before,” said Daoist master Guanhai with a chuckle, his mind racing as he tried to guess the identity of the man.
In the great Qianyuan Divine Province, there were only so many Tongxuan Realm powerhouses, definitely no more than the number of fingers on both hands, each hailing from the major sacred lands. The man before him was no exception.
However, this person wore a bronze mask and had altered his appearance and temperament, even changing his Primordial Spirit’s aura, so Daoist master Guanhai couldn’t guess which old friend it might be for the time being.
“You’ve mistaken me for someone else, Elder Daoist. I am but a minor cultivator, here only to broaden my horizons,” Han Li said with a sincere tone, as if his purpose was indeed just that.
“You are not being honest, fellow Daoist. If a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse is a minor cultivator, then this vast Qianyuan Divine Province would have no Great Masters at all.”
Daoist master Guanhai shook his head and sighed, but he did not continue the conversation with Han Li.
“Dragon girl, you’re here for this, aren’t you?”
Daoist master Guanhai looked towards the dragon girl at his side, waving his sleeve robe, and the colorful dragon loach flew out, its life force growing stronger as it flew towards Long Yue, but no matter how it tried, it couldn’t get close, only circling in the air.
Long Yue’s eyes lit up, and she immediately said, “Exactly, I hope Elder Daoist can fulfill this wish.”
Han Li’s gaze also fell on the colorful dragon loach, understanding the relationship between it and his beloved wife Long Yue, which was indeed crucial for Long Yue’s Daoist path.
This colorful dragon loach seemed to resonate faintly with Long Yue, as if it was inherently a part of her.
Long Yue was the reincarnation of the Dragon Soul of the Jiao Saint, with the Dragon Ball also in her possession. However, her previous life’s dragon body, including the dragon bones, tendons, bone marrow, blood, skin, and marrow, all ended up in the hands of the dragon-slaying Great Saint.
Han Li didn’t know the relationship between this dragon-slaying Great Saint and Penglai Immortal Sect, but it seemed the colorful dragon loach was nurtured from Long Yue’s previous life’s dragon body and was related to her very fate.
If Long Yue was at the True Martial Realm, then the dragon loach was colorful; if Long Yue reached the Divine Yuan Realm, the dragon loach would likely evolve into eight colors, and a Tongxuan Realm Long Yue would correspond to a nine-colored dragon loach, just as the Nine-tailed Celestial Fox was of the Tongxuan Realm.
If this colorful dragon loach were to merge with Long Yue, it would undoubtedly significantly increase her core essence, and she might even regain her previous life’s special constitution: the King’s Dark Yang Body!
But would Daoist master Guanhai from Penglai Immortal Sect give this colorful dragon loach back to Long Yue?
“Dragon girl, there must be a reason why it is with my Penglai Immortal Sect. Presumably, you know something about this. It’s not impossible for me to return it, you just need to agree to one condition,” Daoist master Guanhai said with a smile.
PS: That’s all for this chapter; I’ll try to make up for it tomorrow.
The last chapter was posted at 8:10, and it was blocked as soon as it went up. After modifying and reposting four times, it still got blocked until the editor unblocked it later.
I’m already annoyed to death by the system’s sensitive words, plus some other issues. I managed to write this much, so goodnight everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 372: 194: The Heavenly Immortal’s Backup Plan, The Hidden Danger of the Dragon Eel, A Massive Treasure Chest Explosion!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 372: Chapter 194: The Heavenly Immortal’s Backup Plan, The Hidden Danger of the Dragon Eel, A Massive Treasure Chest Explosion!_1
Conditions?
Han Li’s brows furrowed slightly as he faced the Eight Colorful Loaches directly, while his peripheral vision was sizing up Guanhai Daoren.
He was wondering whether to attack directly and snatch it. The Eight Colorful Loaches were within arm’s reach, and if he were to take action, there was a considerable chance of seizing it.
Guanhai Daoren was about to state his conditions, which if excessive, would complicate matters.
“Fellow Daoist, let’s not resort to chaos,” Guanhai Daoren suddenly looked towards Han Li, said with a smile, his left hand casually unfolding to reveal a chaos-colored large clock.
A chill ran through Han Li’s heart; this Guanhai Daoren was highly sensitive, almost touching upon Divine Sense— he was even aware of the malice hidden deep in Han Li’s heart.
“Fellow Daoist jests. What are your conditions? Please explain them,” said Han Li, keeping his composure and smiling in response.
He temporarily abandoned the idea of taking action; Guanhai Daoren’s chaos-colored large clock, undoubtedly an imperial weapon, was operational and ready for use. He had come prepared, anticipating Han Li’s moves.
Long Yue nodded, also extinguishing a certain thought.
If even her husband spoke like this, it meant they had little confidence; otherwise, following the plan, they would have taken the Eight Colorful Loaches and fled before Guanhai Daoren could find them.
“This condition might be somewhat difficult for the Dragon Girl, but with the fellow Daoist here, it shouldn’t be an issue,” Guanhai Daoren transmitted his primordial spirit’s voice, stating the condition, before slowly speaking out loud.
Han Li and Long Yue exchanged a glance, their brows both slightly creased.
“Husband, shall we agree?” Long Yue’s Divine Spirit silently communicated to Han Li.
“Let’s just go with it. Making more issues is worse than making fewer. With my ability, I can just barely achieve it, so let’s agree,” Han Li replied after a moment’s contemplation.
“But…”
“Yue’er, this old Daoist is guarding against us. It’s not just the large clock in his hand; even his waistband is an imperial weapon. For us to forcefully take it would be very difficult.”
“That old bull-nosed geezer!”
“Let’s simply create a good bond with Penglai Immortal Sect.”
Han Li said to Long Yue, feeling displeased deep inside. He decided to capture the Fairy Qingfrost earlier to see how anxious Guanhai Daoren would get.
He had considered forcibly taking it earlier, but Zi Yi informed him that Guanhai Daoren had another imperial weapon on him, leaving Han Li with no choice but to relent.
“How have the two of you decided?”
Guanhai Daoren had been watching them, quietly waiting for their silent discussion, and asked when it seemed they had finished.
“The old Daoist’s move was masterful. We agree,” Han Li said indifferently.
A smile crept across the wrinkled face of Guanhai Daoren, “It’s good that the fellow Daoist agrees.”
The three of them continued to converse, discussing the details, before Long Yue gathered the Eight Colorful Loaches and Han Li, embracing her, instantly left Penglai Fairy Island.
“Is Qianyuan Divine Province about to change?”
After Han Li and Long Yue left, Guanhai Daoren’s expression immediately turned somber and serious.
He had maintained a mental connection with two imperial weapons the entire time, the Binding Dragon Cord and the Primordial Clock. Their Artifact Spirits informed him that Han Li was not a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse from sacred places like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, and the likes.
The investigation by the two imperial weapons was something Guanhai Daoren trusted. However, they were also unable to peek at Han Li’s true identity. Their perception was blocked by the power of an imperial weapon; when they tried to gaze upon Han Li’s true identity, they saw only endless void.
A mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse possessing an imperial weapon was an unpredictable factor for Qianyuan Divine Province. Perhaps the disappearance of the Demon Emperor from Myriad Demon Mountain a few months ago had something to do with this person.
“Sigh~”
With a sigh, Guanhai Daoren’s figure disappeared from the location, returning to the cliff.
He sat down cross-legged again, facing Divine Continent, closed his eyes, but his thoughts were still on the Dragon Girl.
Almost no one knew that the Great Saint who slayed dragons in ancient times originated from Penglai Immortal Sect and that the Great Saint was just a separate incarnation of a Heavenly Immortal from the Sect, using this identity for certain schemes.
The Heavenly Immortal ancestor, aware that he could not survive the ancient calamity, made many plans for the Penglai Immortal Sect to flourish and rise triumphantly after the crisis, and slaying all the worldly dragon descendants was one of them.
According to the sect’s internal records, the Heavenly Immortal ancestor, using the identity of the Great Saint, deliberately hunted the Sacred Dragon for three thousand years, forcing it into Qianyuan Divine Province. After slaying the Sacred Dragon and taking everything except the Dragon Ball and Dragon Soul, he established a Secret Territory, allowing the Sacred Dragon to reincarnate after the great calamity.
As planned, once the Dragon Girl returned to the Divine Yuan Realm, Guanhai Daoren could take action. Using the Eight Colorful Loaches as a lure, he would find the Dragon Girl and merge it with her, securing a brand-new Dragon Girl for the Penglai Immortal Sect.
The Eight Colorful Loaches was not just Long Yue’s previous dragon form, but also incorporated dragon forms, Dragon Balls, and Dragon Souls of all dragon descendants vanquished by the Great Saint, carefully nurtured for a hundred thousand years until it was successful.
If the Dragon Girl were to merge with the Eight Colorful Loaches, her essence would far surpass her former life, becoming almost that of a pure-blooded True Dragon. It would be easy for her to become a Quasi Emperor then, and even hoping to become an emperor was very likely.
The Eight Colorful Loaches, having been nurtured by the Penglai Immortal Sect for a hundred thousand years, naturally bore the deep imprint of the Sect, along with measures left by the Heavenly Immortal ancestor.
Once the Eight Colorful Loaches merged with the Dragon Girl, she would be bound to the Penglai Immortal Sect, considering herself as part of the Sect. Penglai Immortal Sect would then rise smoothly under the Dragon Girl’s lead, becoming one of the most prominent Sacred Lands and Imperial Empires in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Even if the Dragon Girl realized the trap, he could forcefully capture her and make the Eight Colorful Loaches blend with her, the outcome would be the same.
Alas, an error occurred. After the Sacred Dragon reincarnated and left the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, it’s unknown what transpired, but it came to be accompanied by a mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, in possession of top-notch imperial weapons.

chapters.title: Chapter 373: 194: The Heavenly Immortal’s Backup Plan, The Hidden Danger of the Dragon Eel, A Massive Treasure Chest Explosion!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 373: Chapter 194: The Heavenly Immortal’s Backup Plan, The Hidden Danger of the Dragon Eel, A Massive Treasure Chest Explosion!_2
“`
This made Guanhai Taoist dare not act rashly, even with two Emperor Level weapons in his possession, it was very difficult to capture Long Yue and the mysterious great power from the Tongxuan Realm unless he used the Immortal weapon of the Penglai Immortal Sect.
The Immortal weapon of the Penglai Immortal Sect was named the Heavenly Fixing Element Stake, which not only bolstered the sect’s fortunes but also suppressed the objects beneath the Penglai Island. It could not be used lightly; activating the Heavenly Fixing Element Stake was also problematic.
Every time the Heavenly Fixing Element Stake was used, it required the consumption of endless resources, and with the current foundation of the Penglai Immortal Sect, they could only fully revive the Heavenly Fixing Element Stake twice. Each use also required resources to be prepared in advance.
Upon seeing Long Yue and Han Li appear, Guanhai Taoist knew the plan had changed. To be safe, he brought the two Emperor Level weapons that the Penglai Immortal Sect had, but still, they were inadequate.
The two Emperor Level weapons of the Penglai Immortal Sect, the Primordial Clock was a Supreme Emperor Level weapon, and the Dragon Binding Rope was a Top Grade Emperor Level weapon, both possessing tremendous power. Another person would have long been suppressed by Guanhai Taoist.
But he encountered Han Li, this mysteriously powerful being from the Tongxuan Realm who gave Guanhai Taoist a great amount of trouble.
The opponent possessed a Supreme Emperor Level weapon related to the void, which was also in a continuous state of full revival, ready to spring into action. Even if he fully revived the Primordial Clock and the Dragon Binding Rope, it was very difficult to detain Han Li and Long Yue.
In the end, Guanhai Taoist compromised and changed the plan; otherwise, if he acted, the loss would be greater.
Being unable to suppress Han Li and Long Yue meant that it would be extremely difficult to have the Dragon Maiden merge with the Rainbow Dragon Minnow in the future, and they would become deadly enemies with this mysterious power from the Tongxuan Realm with a Supreme Emperor Level weapon, not to mention the countless resources the Penglai Immortal Sect would spend.
Allowing two Emperor Level weapons to fully revive was a process that consumed endless resources. Guanhai Taoist was not the master of the Emperor Level weapons; the spirits of the Emperor Level weapons would not fight for him on their own initiative.
However, Guanhai Taoist astutely discovered that the mysterious great power from the Tongxuan Realm seemed to be the owner of that Supreme Emperor Level weapon, which allowed the weapon to actively fully revive.
When Emperor Level weapons self-revive, they consume their own accumulated energy. In the current state of Qianyuan Divine Province where Spiritual Energy is sparse, for Emperor Level weapons to replenish energy by absorbing the spiritual Qi of heaven and earth would take a very long time. Thus, the spirits of the Emperor Level weapons at each Sacred Land were unwilling to revive by themselves, preferring the Sacred Lands to offer more energy in sacrifice instead.
Emperor Level weapons can draw their energy from many sources, such as Spirit Stones, Spirit Crystals, Spirit Sources, higher-level spiritual energy, Immortal Qi, and other naturally occurring treasures containing immense power.
“I hope they haven’t noticed,” Guanhai Taoist thought silently.
If they hadn’t noticed, the Dragon Maiden would merge with the Rainbow Dragon Minnow and would still have the Penglai Immortal Sect in her heart, automatically returning to the Penglai Immortal Sect. The old Heavenly Immortal’s scheming wouldn’t have failed.
If they had noticed, then it would be considered as giving the Dragon Maiden a great opportunity and forming a good relationship; moreover, he also proposed that condition as a form of indirect compensation.
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li and Long Yue stood there, with Long Yue wearing a smile, everything on this trip had gone fairly smoothly.
Ever since her reincarnation, she had sensed something drawing her from the direction of the East Sea. Over the years, Long Yue had already investigated clearly, though she didn’t know it was the Rainbow Dragon Minnow, she knew it was at the Penglai Immortal Sect.
She had originally planned to wait until she cultivated to the Tongxuan Realm, became powerful, and retrieved her past life’s Quasi Emperor weapon before considering retrieving that thing from the Penglai Immortal Sect.
Now that she had her husband, she moved her plan forward, as her husband was a great power from the Tongxuan Realm with an Emperor Level weapon, which gave her great confidence in retrieving that item.
Although they were tricked by the Penglai Immortal Sect’s Guanhai Taoist, they finally got the Rainbow Dragon Minnow back. She would rise again in this life, and with her husband’s assistance, she would enter an unprecedented realm.
“Husband, once I merge with this Rainbow Dragon Minnow, my origin will increase manyfold. In a short period, I will break into the Divine Yuan Realm.”
“When our child is born, it’s very likely they will inherit my physique, and they will achieve greatness in the future.”
Snuggled in her husband’s arms, Long Yue looked at the Rainbow Dragon Minnow swimming in her jade hand, her eyes shining with excitement and her expression animated.
After carefully examining the Rainbow Dragon Minnow, Han Li frowned and said gravely, “Yue’er, don’t be too hasty to merge with it.”
“Hmm?” Long Yue’s voice halted, and she looked up at her husband.
“There seems to be something wrong with this Rainbow Dragon Minnow,” Han Li explained.
Long Yue suddenly employed a secret technique, her eyes emitting divine light to shine upon the Rainbow Dragon Minnow, scanning it several times.
“Husband, I haven’t identified any problems,” Long Yue said with a frown.
She knew that her husband would never speak without reason; if he said so, there must be a cause. Could it be that the Rainbow Dragon Minnow concealed a threat too deeply hidden?
“Let me have a closer look.”
Han Li nodded slightly, and a torrent of Primordial Spirit light poured into his eyes as he looked at the Rainbow Dragon Minnow, but he didn’t discover anything obvious.
Han Li’s brow furrowed slightly. With a thought, he activated his Divine Sense and looked again at the Rainbow Dragon Minnow, whereupon he immediately spotted a few clues.
“`
“As expected.”
Han Li snorted coldly and waved his hand, causing the Void Bell to appear, with Zi Yi materializing by his side.
“Zi Yi, take a look at this seven-colored dragon fish.”
Han Li patted the little loli Zi Yi’s head, instructing her.
“Okay, Master~”
Zi Yi harnessed the power of the Void Bell, and a ray of Emperor’s Light shone upon the seven-colored dragon fish.
Long Yue’s pupils contracted at this sight; she knew her husband possessed an Emperor Level weapon, but she had never seen it until now.
She also felt a great sense of relief in her heart. Her husband even let her see this, showing his sincere affection for her. All that had happened during this time had allowed Long Yue to feel the sincerity of Han Li’s feelings.
After checking several times, Zi Yi reported, “Master, there is indeed a problem with this seven-colored dragon fish.”
Following that, Zi Yi listed out the hidden dangers one by one, causing both Han Li and Long Yue to frown deeply.
“Alright, Zi Yi, you can go back to playing now.”
Having finished speaking, Han Li reached out and touched his beloved wife Long Yue’s jade-white and lovely face, sighing, “We nearly fell for that old Taoist’s scheme.”
Long Yue wholeheartedly nodded, her face reflecting her fear.
The hidden dangers were too great, with even Heavenly Immortal traps laid down that Zi Yi could only vaguely sense.
After some thought, Han Li said, “Yue’er, don’t rush to refine the seven-colored dragon fish. Wait a few more years.”
In a few years, he might obtain an Immortal weapon. By then, if he let the Artifact Spirit of the Immortal weapon take action, it could possibly eliminate all the hidden dangers within the seven-colored dragon fish. The Heavenly Immortal ancestor of the Penglai Immortal Sect had long passed away, so any attempt at a counterattack would be futile.
“Okay.”
Long Yue nodded, suppressing her desire for the seven-colored dragon fish. After hesitating for a while, she handed the seven-colored dragon fish to Han Li.
“Husband, please keep the seven-colored dragon fish with you for the time being.”
The allure of the seven-colored dragon fish was too great for her, and she truly feared that one day she might not be able to resist. If she were to then refine and merge with the seven-colored dragon fish, the trouble would be considerable; she did not wish to serve the Penglai Immortal Sect as a dog.
After all, the Penglai Immortal Sect was her enemy, as the Great Saint who had slain her in the past might very well have come from the Penglai Immortal Sect.
“Then husband shall keep it safe for Yue’er for a few years.”
Han Li casually stored the seven-colored dragon fish into the System Space, dropping it into a pond he created with a mere thought.
He planned to find time to deal with the seven-colored dragon fish, whether to place it in the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain or on Zaidao Peak, he would decide later.
After being affectionate on Chengdao Peak, Long Yue left; she still had to undergo closed-door cultivation to refine the items she had retrieved from the East Sea Dragon Palace.
Han Li had intended to open this month’s treasure chest when witnessing the dragon shedding its armor, but with Long Yue going into seclusion, he would have to find someone else.
After some consideration, Han Li decided to try a new trick.
Soon, after reluctantly bidding farewell, Han Li enjoyed the starry night with tender, loving care. Then, expending five years of his cultivation, he opened this month’s treasure chest.
On the panel that only he could see, a flash of golden light passed by, followed by a system notification sound in Han Li’s mind.
“Ding~ Congratulations, Master, for obtaining a treasure from the chest: Emperor Level Lower Grade[Dragon Vein]!”
Upon hearing this, Han Li’s pupils contracted, and his face was unable to hide the sheer joy, which stirred him to greater passion.
This time, he had actually obtained a Dragon Vein!
And it was an Emperor Level Lower Grade one at that!
PS: As mentioned previously, chapters will be split after hitting ten thousand words. Let’s try splitting it today, and there will be a second chapter tonight.

chapters.title: Chapter 374: 195: True Dragon, Foundation, Combat Ability Increase, Repairing the Life-Prolonging Furnace_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 374: Chapter 195: True Dragon, Foundation, Combat Ability Increase, Repairing the Life-Prolonging Furnace_1
“With this Emperor Level Lower Grade Dragon Vein, the development speed of Han Mansion will once again leap forward by a large margin.”
Han Li worked hard, constantly switching his targets, yet his mind was occupied with silent contemplation.
According to the classification in the Cultivation Realm, Spirit Veins are divided from Twelfth Grade to First Grade, with every three grades forming a level, the higher the grade, the rarer they are.
For example, from Third Grade to First Grade are all Top-grade Spirit Veins, containing a large amount of top-grade Spirit Stones; due to different grades, the quantity of stored top-grade Spirit Stones also varies, and at the core of a First Grade Spirit Vein, a Spirit Crystal will be nurtured.
Above Top-grade Spirit Veins are Divine Rank Immortal Veins and Emperor Level Dragon Veins, which are divided into four divisions: Lower, Middle, Upper, and Supreme Grade. Divine Rank Immortal Veins produce a large amount of Spirit Crystals, and their grade is determined by the size of the Divine Rank Immortal Vein.
A Divine Rank Supreme Grade Immortal Vein is nearly turning into a dragon, with a Spirit Source hidden at its core. If it takes one more step, it could evolve into a Dragon Vein.
The grade of Dragon Veins is also judged by size; the larger the Dragon Vein, the higher the grade and the more Spirit Sources it contains.
Once a Spirit Vein turns into a dragon, the Dragon Vein acquires its own consciousness and possesses formidable combat ability. Although it is not as strong as an Emperor Weapon of the same level, it is much stronger than a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm.
At that time, capturing a Dragon Vein becomes very difficult; one must possess great strength, or else the Dragon Vein will escape using the earth’s veins.
A Dragon Vein with consciousness will no longer allow itself to be harvested at will; they are considered exceptional beings, also wishing to transform into True Dragons and roam the universe, but without the appropriate cultivation methods, it’s very difficult for a Dragon Vein to turn into a True Dragon.
When a Dragon Vein evolves into a True Dragon, it will condense a real dragon body, possessing dragon blood, Dragon Balls, and everything else a True Dragon has. Then, after experiencing the trial of heavenly tribulation, if successful, it becomes a True Dragon; if not, its consciousness is erased.
There are many in the world who wish to evolve into True Dragons, all from different origins, including snakes, flood dragons, carps, Dragon Veins, turtles, horses, pigs, pheasants, and so on.
Carps are born ordinary, extremely weak, but favored by fate, and as long as they leap over the Dragon Gate, they can become True Dragons, one of the top creatures in the world.
However, it is incredibly difficult for a carp to transform into a dragon and leap over the Dragon Gate. Through thousands of trials and hardships, it’s very fortunate if even one among tens of thousands of accomplished carp can turn into a True Dragon.
If a snake wants to become a dragon, it must undergo a long period of time, embark on the path of cultivation, awaken its intelligence, and transcend tribulation to become a flood dragon, then enter the sea to have a chance to transform into a True Dragon.
Entering the sea as a flood dragon is extremely difficult; it is akin to a deadlock. Without a Protector, one would almost certainly perish.
A flood dragon, swimming from rivers and lakes toward the sea, becomes irresistible prey at this phase, attracting countless greedy creatures seeking to seize its fortune. It cannot escape or hide; if successful, it becomes a supreme True Dragon, but if it fails, it perishes along with its path.
If one is born as a flood dragon, aside from entering the sea, there is also the option to slowly purify the bloodline, which, over a long period, may also offer the chance to transcend tribulation and become a True Dragon.
As for a turtle becoming a dragon, it cannot shed its shell; even with a dragon’s head, it remains a dragon-headed turtle like Ba Xia, the sixth son of the Dragon Ancestor.
…
Whatever the being, if it wishes to evolve into a True Dragon, it must pass through tribulations; there are both man-made and heavenly tribulations. Survive, and one becomes a Nine Heavens True Dragon; fail, and it means death.
Currently, in the Endless Yuankun Domain, there are no True Dragons, not even one, but there are records of True Dragons from ancient eras where they once existed in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
True Dragons are one of the most powerful species among all races in the skies. A newborn True Dragon is a Quasi Emperor, growing a little makes it a Heavenly Immortal of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and an adult True Dragon is at least a Heavenly Immortal.
For example, the Emperor Level Lower Grade Dragon Vein that Han Li obtained, if nurtured properly and with Han Li acting as its Protector, could have the potential to transform into a True Dragon in the future.
However, Han Li did not entertain this idea. To raise it into a True Dragon, he would first need to nurture it into an Emperor Level Supreme Grade Dragon Vein, which would require an abundance of resources, not cost-effective, and not as good as directly nurturing an Emperor Level Supreme Grade Dragon Vein.
Since this Dragon Vein was obtained from opening a treasure box, its spiritual intelligence is quite docile and obeys Han Li’s commands. He plans to integrate it into the earth’s veins of Chengsheng Mountain, which would boost the Spiritual Energy of Chengsheng Mountain a thousandfold, ten thousandfold, or even more.
One Emperor Level Lower Grade Dragon Vein, if fully mined, can yield at least five hundred thousand pieces of Spirit Source, and no more than eight hundred thousand pieces at most.
Of course, unless there are special circumstances, nobody would exhaustively mine it. Although Spirit Sources are precious, they pale in comparison to Dragon Veins.
If mined slowly, a Dragon Vein can produce ten thousand pieces of Spirit Source a year, only a fiftieth of its storage or even less, which will not affect the Dragon Vein’s growth.
In this manner, the Dragon Vein can absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth for recovery, and slowly evolve and grow over time, eventually having the potential to evolve into an Emperor Level Middle Grade Dragon Vein or even higher.
Han Li was not inclined to exhaustively mine it either. After this Emperor Level Lower Grade Dragon Vein was integrated into Chengsheng Mountain, he would mine it slowly. It would not only provide a massive amount of pure Spiritual Energy for Han Mansion, but also yield ten thousand pieces of Spirit Source annually.
According to the standard market price in the Cultivation Realm, one top-grade Spirit Stone can be exchanged for one million Lower Grade Spirit Stones, but it takes one million two hundred thousand to exchange for one top-grade Spirit Stone.
One Spirit Crystal is equal to a thousand top-grade Spirit Stones, and one piece of Spirit Source is equivalent to ten thousand Spirit Crystals, which is the same as ten million top-grade Spirit Stones.
Spirit Source is mainly produced by Dragon Veins, containing extremely pure Spiritual Energy, which can be called Higher Level Spiritual Energy. Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm own it in small quantities. It is frequently used by Quasi Emperors and Great Emperors, and only Spirit Source can quickly replenish their Mana.
With this Emperor Level Lower Grade Dragon Vein, Han Mansion now has security, and it also eliminates a major concern for Han Li.

chapters.title: Chapter 375: 195: True Dragon, Foundation, Combat Ability Increase, Repairing the Life-Prolonging Furnace_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 375: Chapter 195: True Dragon, Foundation, Combat Ability Increase, Repairing the Life-Prolonging Furnace_2
The previous outbursts of power from the Void Bell were autonomous revivals, consuming the energy accumulated by Zi Yi. Although it never fully revived each time, the frequent partial revivals still depleted much of its energy without any replenishment.
Now, with the Lower Grade Imperial Dragon Vein, the Void Bell can absorb some Dragon Vein Energy to replenish itself, as well as draw from the Spirit Source.
After communicating with Zi Yi, Han Li understood how much Spirit Source was needed to revive an imperial weapon.
For example, a Lower Grade Imperial weapon partially revives with at least five pieces of Spirit Source and fully revives with at least twenty pieces; for a Middle Grade Imperial weapon, this base consumption increases by five to seven times.
Top Grade Imperial weapons, corresponding to a Heavenly Imperial Realm Great Emperor, require at least five hundred pieces of Spirit Source for partial revival and at least two thousand for full revival.
The consumption for a Supreme Grade Imperial weapon is five to ten times that of a Top Grade one, requiring at least two thousand five hundred pieces for a partial revival, and for a full revival, it would consume at least ten thousand pieces in one go.
In other words, the output of Spirit Source from the Lower Grade Imperial Dragon Vein of Chengsheng Mountain is only enough for the Void Bell to fully revive and fight once a year.
However, Han Li felt it was worth it; at least he now had a safeguard. With an energy supply for the Void Bell, it can absorb more Dragon Vein Energy in special circumstances.
If it were an Immortal weapon, the base consumption needed on top of a Supreme Grade Imperial weapon would increase by more than fifty times – using Spirit Source to revive Immortal weapons is far too costly.
The reserves of Spirit Source among the Great Holy Land Schools are quite limited nowadays, and they usually only employ imperial weapons. Immortal weapons are reserved for urgent crises, such as the impending doom of a Sacred Land or when a race war intensifies to the point where an outcome must be decided.
Even when a Sacred Land does use an Immortal weapon, they don’t consume Spirit Source first; they consume Immortal Stones, crystals used by Immortals containing Immortal Qi.
Reviving Immortal weapons with Immortal Stones overall consumes far less than using Spirit Source.
Days later, Han Li stood at the summit of Chengsheng Mountain, with the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing by his side.
“Qing’er, how does the spiritual energy of Chengsheng Mountain now compare to that of Myriad Demon Mountain?” Han Li asked with a smile, a trace of pride flashing in his eyes.
After incorporating the Lower Grade Imperial Dragon Vein, the concentration of spiritual energy throughout Chengsheng Mountain soared by more than ten thousand times, with high-grade Spirit Gathering Arrays set up additionally at the nine great sub-peaks and other areas like the foothills and the mountainside, enhancing the energy to even higher levels.
The pinnacle of spiritual energy concentration on Chengsheng Mountain was at Chengdao Peak. Han Li had set up a Third Grade Spirit Gathering Array there, with the concentration of spiritual energy exceeding that of the nine great sub-peaks by more than ten times.
He could only set up this one Third Grade Spirit Gathering Array; a Second Grade was out of the question. Establishing the Third Grade Array already expended a great deal of the Han Mansion’s base resources, secretly purchasing countless precious materials for the formation.
“Myriad Demon Mountain does not compare to our Chengsheng Mountain, and I fear that even Bai Yujing, the number one Sacred Land in Qianyuan Divine Province, cannot match us,” said Xue Yueqing, her face filled with shock as she felt the extremely rich spiritual energy at Chengdao Peak. She did not understand where her husband had acquired a Lower Grade Imperial Dragon Vein from.
Now Myriad Demon Mountain no longer had an imperial dragon vein, and as far as she knew, none of the six Great Sacred Lands, plus the Penglai Immortal Sect, possessed imperial dragon veins in Qianyuan Divine Province, not even lower-grade ones.
The highest vein held by these seven Great Holy Land Schools in Qianyuan Divine Province was at most a Divine Rank Supreme Grade Spirit Vein. Following the Ancient Cataclysm, Qianyuan Divine Province could no longer nurture Emperor Rank Dragon Veins.
With this Lower Grade Imperial Dragon Vein, along with the Combat Tower, Cnagdao Hall, Life-Prolonging Furnace, Time-Sky Tower, and other imperial and sacred weapons, the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain had, in some ways, surpassed the Great Holy Land Schools.
With an energy supply for the Supreme Grade Imperial weapon Void Bell of Chengsheng Mountain, it can truly rest easy, commanding even more deterrence than the Great Holy Land Schools.
Of course, the existence of the Lower Grade Imperial Dragon Vein must not be revealed; otherwise, Chengsheng Mountain would be doomed. The seven Great Holy Land Schools would definitely fight over it, even if it meant destroying Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li was well aware of this and had made preparations. He had arranged for the Artifact Spirit Zi Yi to secretly brand all the beings of Chengsheng Mountain, monitoring their Divine Spirits and Primordial Spirits.
If anyone harbored the thought of disclosing the secret, they would be detected by Zi Yi immediately, and the Void Bell would annihilate the person attempting to leak the information in an instant.
Xue Yueqing really wanted to know how her husband, Han Li, managed to obtain the Lower Grade Imperial Dragon Vein, which even the Great Holy Land Schools could not achieve. It was an extraordinary feat.
But she sensibly refrained from asking. She now knew that Chengsheng Mountain was not just any superpower and that her husband was not a Saint of the Heavenly Abyss Realm. Even reaching this stage had taken less than a hundred years.
Xue Yueqing was aware that her husband had many secrets and excelled at creating miracles. As his Dao companion, her future was set to soar, and her vision was no longer limited to the Tongxuan Realm.
She set her sights on the Heavenly Abyss Realm, aspiring to become a Quasi Emperor and even a Heavenly Imperial Realm Great Emperor herself. She wanted to be the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
If her husband could continue to break through at this pace, the hope for him to become a Heavenly Imperial Realm Great Emperor in the future was very high. With his help, she too had a chance to prove her way to the Emperor level, to master the Heavenly Sovereign Path and reign over the Endless Yuankun Domain.
“Actually, Bai Yujing might still possess a Lower Grade Imperial Dragon Vein,” Han Li shook his head and looked towards the Dao Domain.
As the foremost Sacred Land in Qianyuan Divine Province since Ancient Times, Bai Yujing was the only Sacred Land possessing a True Immortal, a foundation unmatched by other Great Holy Land Schools.
For a True Immortal, it is simple to create a blessed land. Transplanting a dragon vein into it, even after over a hundred thousand years, it’s not likely that not even a single Lower Grade Imperial Dragon Vein remains.
