chapters.title: Chapter 376: 195: True Dragon, Foundation, Combat Ability Increase, Repairing the Life-Prolonging Furnace_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 376: Chapter 195: True Dragon, Foundation, Combat Ability Increase, Repairing the Life-Prolonging Furnace_3
In ancient times, Emperor Rank Dragon Veins in the Qianyuan Divine Province and the surrounding thirty-three Divine Provinces were all controlled by seven Great Holy Land Schools such as Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Penglai Immortal Sect, among which Bai Yujing held the most.
Those Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals, fully aware that they could not survive the great calamity of ancient times, were bound to make preparations for their Sects to ensure the Sacred Lands continued their legacy and maintained their exalted status.
Although during the great calamity of ancient times, the Qianyuan Divine Province seemed to have undergone a major disaster and suffered more damage than the other Divine Provinces in the Yuankun Domain, the Emperor Rank Dragon Veins were likely depleted significantly as well.
But Han Li felt that while other Great Holy Land Schools no longer had Emperor Rank Lower Grade Dragon Veins, Bai Yujing might still have them.
Xue Yueqing was startled but nodded her head, acknowledging this statement.
During the time she presided over the affairs of the Demon Clan at Myriad Demon Mountain, she had come across many secrets and knew the terrifying extent of Bai Yujing’s profound background, which was much stronger than that of Myriad Demon Mountain.
After the great calamity of ancient times, although Bai Yujing also suffered heavy losses and even lost Heavenly Immortal Artifacts, they still possessed two Heavenly Immortal Artifacts, while other Sacred Lands, such as Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, and Heavenly Demon Hall, only had one Heavenly Immortal Artifact each.
In terms of open strength, Myriad Demon Mountain only had one Tongxuan Realm powerhouse and ten Divine Yuan Realm Demon Emperors; the Summit of Stars, Xumi Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, House of Divine Armies, and Penglai Immortal Sect each had one Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, and the number of Divine Yuan Realm individuals were nine, eight, six, five, and four, respectively.
Even with some hidden assets, there would be at most one or two Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors.
As for Bai Yujing, as the premier Sacred Land in the Qianyuan Divine Province, its background was much more profound. In the Dao Domain’s eight top forces, aside from Bai Yujing, the remaining seven factions each had at least one Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor. Including Bai Yujing’s visible forces, there were fourteen Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors in total.
Bai Yujing openly had one Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, and the other Sacred Lands speculated that Bai Yujing still concealed another Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, with corresponding evidence to support this.
From this, it is evident that Bai Yujing’s foundation far exceeds that of other Great Holy Land Schools.
“Qinger, there’s no need to worry. We won’t be clashing with Bai Yujing for a long time, and they won’t trouble us for no reason,” Han Li said with a smile.
Xue Yueqing blinked but worry flickered in her eyes.
Normally, as her husband said, Chengsheng Mountain kept such a low profile that it hadn’t attracted the attention of Bai Yujing, so there shouldn’t be any trouble.
But her husband wasn’t normal.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have dared to snatch away even her, the Demon Empress of Myriad Demon Mountain, to be his Dao companion. He was incredibly bold, though, she was now quite happy to be Han Li’s Dao companion.
According to Xue Yueqing’s knowledge, the Dao Sect had two Divine Yuan Realm Female Martial Emperors, not even counting Penglai Immortal Sect’s Fairy Clear Frost.
Each of these two Female Martial Emperors was peerlessly elegant, not inferior to herself. Given her husband’s lascivious nature, if given a chance, he might very well snatch those two Female Martial Emperors to be his Dao companions.
At that point, it would be difficult not to draw Bai Yujing’s attention.
Myriad Demon Mountain already exhibited some restraint, not daring to search extensively within the Mortal Territory after her disappearance; however, Bai Yujing, as the top Sacred Land of both the Qianyuan Divine Province and the Human Clan, would not harbor such concerns.
“I hope those two Divine Yuan Realm Female Martial Emperors don’t encounter my husband,” she muttered to herself. Otherwise, Chengsheng Mountain would face serious trouble, and her husband’s current strength wouldn’t be enough to handle Bai Yujing, even together with the Void Bell and the Emperor Rank Lower Grade Dragon Vein.
“Qinger, do you think our child will have Demon Clan blood after they are born?” Han Li embraced Xue Yueqing and asked softly.
The gentle wives and beautiful concubines from the Demon Clan, such as Bai Keqing, Bi Xinlei, and Fang Yousi, bore him children who only had Human Clan bloodline, because his strength was too overpowering and their own Demon Clan bloodline could not be inherited by their offspring.
“I don’t know.”
Quietly nestled in her husband’s arms, Xue Yueqing shook her head.
With her strength, her offspring with Han Li should inherit some of the Sky Fox Clan’s bloodline, but who could say for sure?
Time flew by, and before they knew it, two months had passed.
During these two months, Han Li had stayed put in both Han Mansion and The Li Manor without going anywhere, keeping a low profile.
On regular days, aside from playing games with his charming wives and concubines, he either cultivated together with them, instructed his descendants, or accompanied his charming wives and concubines to enjoy the scenery…
In this period, Han Li had opened two more mystical chests. One was rather ordinary, containing the Divine Rank mid-grade martial arts technique “Thousand Sword Scripture”.
Under the blessing of Han Li’s omnipotent martial dao true intent, its power could rival that of an Emperor Level mid-grade martial arts technique. Having mastered the Thousand Sword Scripture to the perfection, Han Li’s combat ability increased to the Sixth Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm.
If he stimulated his Divine Sense, he was matched only by the common powers of the Seventh Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm; and when utilizing the Three Mysterious Dao Bodies, if fifteen dao bodies executed the Thousand Sword Scripture simultaneously, their combined power could even rival that of the top powers of the Seventh Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm.
Han Li was quite satisfied with this. The deeper one ventured into the Tongxuan Realm, the greater the difference between each level, and even for him, climbing a minor realm in combat ability was extremely challenging.
He had long accumulated enough cultivation to break through to the Sixth or even Seventh Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, but Han Li never made the breakthrough, mainly because there was no pressing need.
After a breakthrough, his True Yuan reserves, Primordial Spirit, Divine Sense, and senses would all improve significantly, but without advancing a minor realm, his combat ability would barely increase—unless he broke through to the Eighth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, when his combat ability would leap across a minor realm.
Now that his combat ability had increased once again, he would need to reach the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm in one go to potentially bring his extreme combat ability up to the Eighth Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm.
Han Li still believed that mastering stronger martial arts techniques was a more feasible way to boost his combat ability.
The second chest, however, unveiled a treasure—a piece of Emperor Level mid-grade Divine Gold, suitable as the main material for a Quasi Emperor weapon or as auxiliary material in crafting an Emperor weapon.
Lacking the refinement skills and cultivation to create a Quasi Emperor weapon, Han Li handed this piece of Emperor Level mid-grade Divine Gold over to Yin Ling, fulfilling his promise to her.
Once Yin Ling’s Body Preservation Furnace finished absorbing the Divine Gold, the furnace would completely recover, and might even improve further, enhancing all its functions.
At the moment, Han Li was in the Dragon Princess Long Yue’s chamber; he was keeping her company.
Long Yue was about to give birth in about three days, and during this period, Han Li had refrained from cultivating with her, deciding it was better to wait until after the childbirth.
“Yue’er, there’s no need to be nervous,”
he said, holding Long Yue close and soothing her as he sensed her emotions.
As the moment of delivery drew closer, Long Yue became increasingly anxious, wondering whether her first descendant would inherit her talents and physique.
“Huff~”
Taking a deep breath, Long Yue bit Han Li’s lips actively, and after a spirited entanglement, her emotions finally stabilized.
“Yue’er, stop worrying yourself sick. Just focus on taking care of the baby,”
Han Li said softly, his hand gently stroking her belly.
“Mhm~” Long Yue nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 377: 196: The Dragon’s Daughter Gives Birth, I Will Repay You Well_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 377: Chapter 196: The Dragon’s Daughter Gives Birth, I Will Repay You Well_1
Three days later.
Han Li anxiously awaited, and although he was already the father of hundreds of children, he felt anticipatory with every birth.
This time, it was Dragon Princess Long Yue who was delivering the child.
Han Li did not have to wait long, as a loud cry soon filled the entire bedroom, and he immediately entered.
Upon seeing a handsome and graceful maid holding his offspring, a boy, Han Li walked over to Long Yue and sat on the bed’s edge.
Grasping Long Yue’s soft, boneless hand, Han Li infused a generous amount of submissive True Yuan to nourish her body and replenish her vitality, while he looked lovingly at his wife lying in the bed, saying,
“Yue’er, do you feel better now?”
“Mm~”
Long Yue hummed softly, her previously pale and beautiful face quickly returning to a healthy flush, feeling absolutely content.
Han Li whispered softly to her, and after Long Yue had recovered a bit, he lifted her into his arms and cuddled her closely, their temples rubbing affectionately.
After sweetly whispering many words of affection, Han Li turned to look at the child and said softly, “Yue’er, we shall name our child Han Yonglong, what do you think?”
“Really?”
Long Yue suddenly raised her head, looking at Han Li with surprise and delight in her eyes.
Having been married into the Han Mansion for nearly a year, Long Yue knew, even if her husband did not say it outright, from the names of his other offspring that he rarely chose names with profound meanings.
Lu Tianxiang, Bai Keqing, Chu Xianlin, and other beloved wives and concubines understood that this was because the husband was preparing for the future. Although they felt a bit disappointed in their hearts, they couldn’t demand more, and they understood his approach.
The character for “dragon” carried heavy significance, and although Long Yue had hoped for it, she didn’t harbor much expectation.
Hearing that her husband was willing to name their first child Han Yonglong, Long Yue was deeply touched.
“Of course, Yonglong is our child, and he is worthy of this name.”
Han Li spoke tenderly and sincerely, his words reflecting his genuine feelings.
Now was the time to bestow names with significant meanings on those offspring with high cultivation talent.
“Husband~”
Long Yue’s eyes reddened with emotion, her heart brimming with joy as she lightly bit her red lips.
After hesitating for a moment, driven by an impulse in her heart, Long Yue bit her stunningly beautiful red lips and leaned close to Han Li’s ear, whispering in a very low voice,
“Husband, I will repay you properly in a few days.”
Han Li blinked, looking at the allure and charm personified by the gorgeous woman in his arms, probing, “Yue’er, how do you intend to repay your husband?”
“Isn’t husband looking to… tread an uncommon path?” Long Yue lowered her proud head, rare blushes of shyness adorning her face.
“Hahaha~ very good, excellent.”
Han Li’s pupils constricted slightly, but then he laughed heartily.
He was fond of those who were grateful and sought to repay kindness.
It’s just like the saying goes: to attain extraordinary might, one must not take the conventional path!
Han Li favored the shaded paths, but sometimes he liked to switch things up, forging new paths, like experiencing chrysanthemum picking beyond the eastern fence.
Liu Yuexin, Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, Zhang Yuyan, and all of his other beauties, Han Li had already been intimate with them in every imaginable way.
But with his beloved wives like Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Xue Qingyi, and others, Han Li could only manage one approach, always taking the shaded path.
He had proposed trying new positions, such as ***** and ****, **** and others, but his beautiful wives had declined his reasonable requests, though Han Li had always fancied trying something different.
Each time he was with his wives, Han Li was restricted to a one-way street, unable to change lanes, which left him somewhat frustrated in his desire for backdoor adventures.
Following that, Han Li stayed by Long Yue’s side, watching her hold the child with maternal brilliance on her face, a smile spreading across his own as well.
While talking with Long Yue, Han Li also divided his attention to check the System panel, not forgetting the rewards for the birth of Han Yonglong.
“You have the first offspring with First Grade cultivation talent, your talent increases by thirty percent, you gain three hundred years of cultivation, you receive the Heaven Rank Supreme Martial Art ‘Duan Yu Spear Technique,’ you receive the Divine Rank Lower Grade Practice ‘Immortal Sea Scripture.’”
“Your cultivation talent has advanced to First Grade!”
Seeing the rewards, Han Li was a bit stunned; they were much more abundant than he had expected.
For his first Third Grade talented offspring, he had received seventy years of cultivation, one Earth-grade Superior Martial Art, and one Heaven Rank Lower Grade Cultivation Technique, which paled in comparison to this time’s rewards.
Han Li figured that the difference between each cultivation talent grade was substantial, with a Second Grade talent award in between, which likely contributed to such a significant boost.
His talent had recently been elevated to seventy percent of Second Grade, and now the birth of a First Grade talented offspring had directly advanced it to First Grade. This was a great boon for Han Li,
meaning that his future breakthroughs in realm could significantly reduce the consumption of his cultivation energy, saving a vast amount of it and allowing him to reach even higher realms in one go.
He was now at the Fifth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm. The previous breakthrough required seven hundred years of cultivation, now only three hundred and fifty. Attaining the Seventh Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm used to require a thousand years; now, it would only take five hundred.
The thought alone exhilarated Han Li, realizing how much cultivation he would save, a result of his own hard-earned labor.
As for the newly acquired Heaven Rank Supreme Martial Art and Divine Rank Lower Grade Practice, Han Li could only sigh, his appetites having grown, these two items held less significance for him now.
The Divine Rank Lower Grade Practice “Immortal Sea Scripture” could be integrated into the Chaos Scripture. Although far from advancing the Chaos Scripture, it could be placed in the Cangdao Hall for his beloved wives, concubines, and Han family offspring to study.

chapters.title: Chapter 378: 196: The Dragon’s Daughter Gives Birth, I Will Repay You Well_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 378: Chapter 196: The Dragon’s Daughter Gives Birth, I Will Repay You Well_2
The Spear of Imperial Command isn’t too bad—though merely a heaven-rank supreme martial technique, it could, with the full-fledged martial dao’s true meaning Han Li bestowed upon it, rival a godlike martial art. It enabled Han Li to unleash the combat power of the Tao-mysterious Realm Five Heavens.
In the days that followed, Han Li spent most of his time with Long Yue and their child, also finding time to master the Spear of Imperial Command and fully assimilate it.
On this day, with the weather fine and sunny, Han Li and Long Yue, with their child in her arms, were enjoying the scenery, exchanging laughter and conversation—mostly, Han Li was whispering sweet nothings to make Long Yue happy.
Glancing at the baby’s food supply in front of Long Yue, Han Li could smell the faint scent of milk wafting from his delicate wife, which instantly gave him the impulse to compete with his child for food.
He had no other intention but to stimulate the child’s appetite; after all, food tastes best when contested for.
He absolutely did not want to taste Long Yue’s baby’s pantry.
It must be said that though Long Yue looked fragile, her figure had recently become quite impressive, shockingly going from a B to a D, much to Han Li’s surprise.
He wasn’t sure whether this was due to Long Yue’s pregnancy and childbirth, or because she had previously refined that treasure brought back from the East Sea Dragon Palace.
However, to be honest, the venerable Han Li did have a preference for the larger size, quite like himself.
A man’s hobbies are just that simple.
Han Li remembered a widely circulated saying from his previous life:
Men might get dizzy with electronic 3D.
But men will never feel dizzy with a natural 36D!
Wanting to act on his thoughts, Han Li picked up his beloved wife Long Yue and returned to their sleeping quarters; the child was left in the care of a maid for the time being.
Here, the old master Han spent a day that could not be casually sought after.
(Let’s not pad out the word count here.)
Time passed, and another half a month went by.
On this day, Gongsun Yue, the tough and tender senior sister, had a breakthrough in her cultivation and was promoted to Grandmaster Wanxiang.
As one of the ten best husbands in the Cultivation Realm, Han Li naturally protected Gongsun Yue as she broke through, to avoid any accidents, and tended to the shaded path, also planning to forge a new way.
Ever since his unconventional path with Long Yue, old master Han had been actively taking steps, wanting to offer all his beautiful wives a chance to gather chrysanthemums beneath the eastern fence.
Once Gongsun Yue had stabilized her cultivation and stood up, Han Li approached her and naturally wrapped her in his arms, nibbling on her earlobe and said,
“Yue’er, you’re now a great grandmaster as well.”
“Thanks to my husband’s help,” Gongsun Yue said, her pretty face blushing.
She had only been married to Han Li for about ten years and had advanced from the Gangyuan Realm to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, a pace of cultivation that was incredibly fast.
If her father Gongsun Yun knew this, he would surely be dumbfounded and his jaw would drop.
“If Yue’er thinks so, then shouldn’t you repay kindness with a spring that gushes forth?” Han Li said with a wink.
“Hmm~”
Gongsun Yue replied softly, looking down; she was someone who knew how to return a favor.
Seeing this, Han Li blew in her ear, then continued to speak, “Then tonight, your husband wants to take an unusual path, is that alright?”
Seeing Gongsun Yue break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm and become a great grandmaster filled Han Li with joy.
Indeed, behind every rise of a stunning beauty, there was a man silently stepping up.
“All my husband ever thinks about are these embarrassing things,” Gongsun Yue spat.
“Then are you willing, Yue’er?”
Gongsun Yue buried her head in Han Li’s chest, her stunningly beautiful face blushing like a ripe apple, her snow-white neck and ears tinged with a faint pink, and after a long while, she murmured in a delicate mosquito-like voice,
“Mhm~”
Old master Han was overjoyed; his Yue’er was indeed someone who knew how to return a favor with the spring of generosity.
“Husband~ put out the divine fire lamp…”
The lifted Gongsun Yue hastily said.
Han Li said with a smile, “Yue’er, if the lamp is out, you can’t see the way clearly.”
Gongsun Yue rolled her eyes; her husband was a Divine Yuan realm martial emperor, with senses so sharp that even in the dark, he could see as if it were broad daylight.
That evening, Han Li and Gongsun Yue sat and discussed the Dao, debating the strengths of various methods. With his profound cultivation, Han Li articulated the principles of the Great Dao, sometimes quickly, sometimes slowly, sometimes deeply, sometimes superficially, leaving Gongsun Yue feeling both confused and impressed.
But women are all actors, especially at certain times. Even though Gongsun Yue didn’t understand, she also played along, pandering to him with pleasing words and even occasionally bursting into song to cheer the venerable ancestor.
…….
The next morning, the early sunlight streamed into the bedroom.
There were places the sunlight couldn’t reach, but the venerable ancestor could.
Having returned to the Li Manor, Han Li lectured his beloved wives and beautiful concubines, such as Chu Xianlin, Xue Qingyi, Song Zhixuan, and Die Yi, and then basked in the sun in the backyard, enjoying grapes offered by them.
Gazing at the empty swing in the garden, Han Li suddenly sighed inwardly, thinking it would have been nice if Pan Jinlian were there, so he could have enjoyed hanging upside down like a golden lotus while eating grapes.
After spending some time in the Li Manor, dealing with some affairs, Han Li instantly returned to Han Mansion.
His boundless Divine Sense in motion, he frowned slightly and saw that the twin sisters Chu Yutong and Chu Yumeng were battling against the triplet sisters Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhirou, and Zhou Zhixuan, exchanging blows back and forth.
The venerable ancestor saw that Chu Yutong and Chu Yumeng were gradually losing ground. It was normal considering it was two against three and that each person’s strength was about the same.
Seeing this, Han Li didn’t hesitate and stepped forward to intervene.
As time passed day by day, Han Li stayed low-key in both Han Mansion and the Li Manor, enjoying endless pleasure each day, a life so enviable that even gods would be jealous.
After a fierce battle with the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, Han Li, clutching his back, arrived at the peak of Chengdao Peak and sighed lightly at the magnificent and beautiful scenery.
The days were good, but his back was suffering.
This thought flashed through Han Li’s mind, but then, cycling through his cultivation technique, he instantly replenished his depleted vital energy, feeling immediately refreshed and invigorated.
Ever since Xue Yueqing, the Demon Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm, became his companion, Han Li’s ambitions reached a higher level, and he recently started contemplating the female bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain again.
The female bodhisattva was extremely dangerous, the ruler of Xumi Mountain, capable of wielding imperial weapons and even reviving celestial weapons, posing a great threat to the old ancestor.
But how can one seize the tiger’s cub without entering the tiger’s den?
Although the old ancestor plays it safe, he certainly isn’t a coward. Given the chance, he still longed to taste the flavor of the female bodhisattva, which must be incredibly unique!
“Husband~”
Just then, Lu Tianxiang flew up and stood beside Han Li, softly calling out.
“Xiangxiang.”
Han Li wrapped his arms gently around Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang, feeling the warm and soft fragrance within his embrace, smelling her body and milk scent, the old patriarch suddenly desired to taste Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang’s treasury of provisions.
However, it had been two or three years since Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang last gave birth, and he wondered if the treasury of provisions still had any stock…
“Husband, the seal at Dangyang Mountain is loosening badly, shouldn’t we make preparations?” Anxiousness appeared on Lu Tianxiang’s fair and jade-like face.
Husband Han Li had told her about the seal on Dangyang Mountain, with the red-haired, sky-reaching Chen Xilai imprisoned within, a formidable figure who was already a late-stage expert of the Tao-mysterious Realm thousands of years ago.
If anything went wrong, allowing him to break free, then the entire Qianyuan Divine Province would suffer a catastrophe, with the Xuan Domain bearing the brunt.
“Xiangxiang, don’t worry, when the time comes, I’ll visit in a different identity,” Han Li said with a smile, aware of her concerns and offering reassurance.
The event at Dangyang Mountain would kick off in just over a year, and Han Li had been keeping an eye on it, still considering the possibilities with the Fairy Clear Frost of Penglai Immortal Sect and even the female bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain.
Now that he had captured the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, who had done everything and was carrying his child, the next target was Fairy Clear Frost.
Taking advantage of this opportunity to capture Fairy Clear Frost would be a small revenge against the Guanhai Daoist of Penglai Immortal Sect, repaying a little interest for daring to plot against him. Did they really think the old ancestor could be so easily schemed against?
The revenge of the old ancestor could afford to wait ten thousand years!
If the opportunity arose, Han Li wouldn’t mind taking his revenge sooner.
As for the female bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain, Han Li purely coveted her. Once he slew the Arhat of Great Joy, he’d see if the female bodhisattva would fall into his trap.
If the female bodhisattva fell for it, Han Li would proceed as planned; as long as nothing unexpected happened, he was quite likely to capture her successfully.
The female bodhisattva had many buffs that were very attractive to the old ancestor.
Of course, if the chance didn’t present itself, Han Li wouldn’t force one, as that would be too risky. He didn’t like taking such risks.
Han Li preferred to wait for the right moment — if not in one year, then ten; if not in ten, then a hundred; if not in a hundred, then a thousand…
If the right moment never came, once his strength was sufficient, he’d just force his way into Xumi Mountain and capture the female bodhisattva.

Chapter 379: Chapter 197: The Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster Who Offers an Embrace_1
As time trickled by, more than half a month had passed in the blink of an eye.
In the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li along with Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi walked across the mountainous terrain, measuring the expanse of this secret territory with their steps.
When they felt a bit weary, the trio rested atop a mountain summit, and then Elder Han would immerse himself in the breathtaking landscape.
First was Jiang Baiye performing a sword dance in the sky, akin to a fairy swordsman descending from the moon palace, followed by Yun Miaoyi’s dance—a Demon Dance that earned Elder Han’s immediate salute.
Gazing at the Devil Princess, Yun Miaoyi, absorbed in her Demon Dance, Han Li moved closer to Jiang Baiye’s ear and, nibbling on her delicate and exquisite earlobe, whispered a sentence.
Jiang Baiye’s strikingly beautiful face flushed crimson in an instant. She stole a glance at Yun Miaoyi, displaying a coy and inviting demeanor that made Elder Han’s mouth water.
Without hesitation, Elder Han took the opportunity to deliver a sermon right there, expounding on deep philosophical truths with great simplicity. For a moment, it was as if mountains echoed and dragons and phoenixes danced in harmony.
After the discourse with Jiang Baiye concluded, she found that Yun Miaoyi had already finished her dance and was watching with great interest. Jiang Baiye then fled in disarray.
Yun Miaoyi arched her brow at Han Li, feeling a bit helpless at her husband’s antics, yet she found it thrilling.
So, at the next mountaintop, while Jiang Baiye transformed into the stunning fairy swordsman in the air, the Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi also sat and discussed philosophy with Elder Han.
Han Li, ever generous to those who thirsted for knowledge, did not hold back. He instructed her, opening her path to enlightenment, overwhelming the Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi with hundreds of billions of pieces of knowledge.
After their leisurely mountain outing, Han Li and his companions Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi departed the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain and returned to The Li Manor.
Atop the Chong Xiao Pavilion, Han Li stood on the highest structure in the Daqian Capital City, surveying the bustling city below.
On this floor, besides Han Li, there were two women—one was his beautiful concubine, Mu Wanyan; the other was his servant concubine, Fairy Li Na.
The two women shared a special relationship: one was the daughter of the Daqian National Teacher, the other his disciple, and both had fallen into Elder Han’s clutches.
“What a pity that the Daqian National Teacher won’t witness this scene,” Han Li mused with a soft sigh as he looked down at the prosperous Daqian Capital City.
A pause in the movements of the kneeling Li Na and Mu Wanyan signified a deeply buried shame had been uncovered, leaving the women feeling a mix of embarrassment and an inexplicable thrill.
They indeed had a special connection with the Daqian National Teacher, yet now they were concubines and servant concubines of Han Li. Before, they had both been virgins without a single dao companion.
Then there was one, and although Han Li was not their dao companion, he was their master and consummated the relationships successfully.
“Speak no ill of the absent,” Han Li frowned slightly.
Li Na and Mu Wanyan ignored his admonition, seemingly fueled by their emotions and perhaps finding the situation even more stimulating.
Especially Li Na, who as one of the five renowned fairies of the Capital City, had been well-known for her eloquence. After becoming Han Li’s servant concubine, she was completely tamed by him, lavishing him with praise and affection unrestrainedly in everyday conversation.
When emotions reached their peak, the two women couldn’t help but wail to Han Li, “Husband, we want…”
With a grand wave of his hand, Elder Han granted their request, giving Li Na and Mu Wanyan a sense of immense relief that their earnest flattery had not been in vain.
After spending some time at The Li Manor, Han Li was considering departure when his eyes suddenly sparkled.
Was someone delivering themselves into his hands?
His Divine Sense enveloped the Daqian Capital City and he saw a breathtakingly beautiful figure glide into the city, making her way towards The Li Manor.
The exquisite being possessed a formidable aura, actually revealing the power of a Great Grandmaster from the Myriad Phenomena Realm, which surprised Han Li even more.
But it came at a good time. Recently, he was somewhat troubled as Li Feiyu, one of his aliases, had difficulty in finding a wife. It was primarily because in the Capital City and even across the six regions of the Qian Dynasty, women with good qualifications and stunning appearances had mostly been married to Han Li already.
Another reason was Han Li’s raised standards for taking wives and concubines. Many who could have been wives were now only eligible as concubines, and many who might have become his concubines now fell short of his criteria.
The entrance of a Great Grandmaster from the Myriad Phenomena Realm, making no effort to conceal her aura into the Capital City, naturally drew the attention of the various forces within the city.
When they tried to investigate further or suppress her, they discovered that this Great Grandmaster was heading straight for The Li Manor. Subsequently, they reined in their intent, opting to watch and wait.
They had a premonition that the master of The Li Manor was likely to take another wife.
After all, this enigmatic Great Grandmaster who had suddenly appeared was a stunning beauty of unparalleled charm and grace.
Qiu Shuhui flew all the way to The Li Manor, pausing briefly before continuing forward, encountering no resistance from any great formations.
“Come up and chat~”
A voice reached Qiu Shuhui’s ears and she looked up at the Chong Xiao Pavilion. In a blink, her figure appeared on the top floor of the pavilion.
“Qiu Shuhui pays respects to the master of The Li Manor.”
Qiu Shuhui curtsied, her movements lithe and graceful, a beguiling smile playing upon her lips.
Han Li remained silent, simply observing the Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm who had delivered herself to him. Qiu Shuhui smiled charmingly, undisturbed and confident—she had been ready before coming to The Li Manor.
Dressed in a pristine white gown, Qiu Shuhui’s mature and alluring figure, with curves too bountiful to ignore, swayed with the delicate fabric. The flowing dress accentuated her exquisite figure with perfection.
She was unmatched in elegance, like a luminescent pearl shedding its glow, ethereal and otherworldly, with a celestial visage and bone structure, and a face near perfection without a single flaw—one of the most beautiful cultivators Han Li had ever encountered.

chapters.title: Chapter 380: 197: The Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster Who Offers an Embrace_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 380: Chapter 197: The Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster Who Offers an Embrace_2
Qiu Shuhui was beautifully breathtaking, appearing to be only around twenty-five or twenty-six years old. Her entire being exuded an enchanting aura, naturally charming, yet she had a cold and delicate pretty face.
Her skin was as fair as snow, and her body exuded a divine light, as if covered with frost, with a delicate and graceful figure sculpted like the Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade.
Her three thousand strands of hair cascaded down to her waist, her white dress purer than snow. Merely standing there, she gave Han Li a feeling as if she was untainted by the mortal world, even more holy than a heavenly maiden, truly a peerless beauty.
After admiring Qiu Shuhui’s stunning appearance, Han Li exclaimed, “Truly a world class beauty.”
Qiu Shuhui had a charm that was unparalleled, and although she had an innate seductive quality, her eyes carried bewitchment without a hint of vulgarity. She was brilliantly beautiful and immaculately pure, with a natural sense of contrast.
“Have you thought it through?” Han Li asked with a smile after making his remark.
As for Qiu Shuhui, who eagerly threw herself at him, willingly and proactively seeking to marry into The Li Manor, Han Li naturally wouldn’t refuse. His question was merely a casual inquiry.
Even if Qiu Shuhui regretted her decision now and wanted to leave, that was impossible. The elder of the Li family did not have the habit of letting the prey at his lips fly away.
“I wish to break through to the True Martial Realm, does the master of The Li Manor have a way?”
Her gaze fell on Han Li’s handsome face, and Qiu Shuhui spoke directly and unabashedly.
As a Loose Cultivator with Third Grade aptitude, it was already incredibly difficult for her to cultivate to the Sixth Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, let alone advance further to the Seventh Heaven or even consider ascending to the True Martial Realm in the future.
Qiu Shuhui had long since taken notice of the master of The Li Manor. She had been watching, waiting, and over the many years, not a single one of his wives or concubines had come to harm. Instead, their cultivation levels increased significantly, which finally gave Qiu Shuhui the resolve to make her move.
She came to try her luck with the master of The Li Manor and of course, she came fully prepared.
Should the master of The Li Manor be able to help her break through to the True Martial Realm, to become an Emperor Wu, she would willingly be his cultivation partner, one of his cherished wives.
If the master of The Li Manor couldn’t do it, yet still wanted to forcefully keep her, intending to take her against her will, then she would not agree and would immediately activate a great displacement charm, teleporting instantly to another place in the Xuan Domain, across tens of millions of miles.
For the master of The Li Manor to find her in the vast Xuan Domain would be like a fool’s dream.
This was one of Qiu Shuhui’s biggest trump cards. She originally had two great displacement charms, but had used one in the past when she was pursued by an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm, from which she successfully escaped. Therefore, she was full of confidence.
As a Loose Cultivator, Qiu Shuhui knew all too well the pain of lacking cultivation resources. Her odds of breaking through to the True Martial Realm through sheer effort were not high, even with Third Grade aptitude she needed a substantial amount of cultivation resources.
If she wanted to shorten the time spent cultivating, she would have to brave dangers and seek fortune, but this was extremely risky, and she could easily die in the process.
The reason Qiu Shuhui had resolved to take this step was because she had recently gone out to seek fortune and compete for an opportunity, a venture which ended in failure. She nearly got caught by an Emperor Wu from the demonic path of the True Martial Realm, which would have been a dire fate.
After narrowly escaping, Qiu Shuhui decided to give it a try with the master of The Li Manor, as it might be a shortcut.
To take advantage of the shortcut offered by the master of The Li Manor, she naturally had to let him take her shortcut first.
Otherwise, why would the master of The Li Manor help her ascend to the True Martial Realm?
Having roamed the Cultivation Realm for hundreds of years, Qiu Shuhui understood this principle well.
“There are many ways, and for me, none of it is difficult,” Han Li said with a smile, equally frank.
Qiu Shuhui’s eyes brightened, and she sighed in relief. Having a method was good.
“Is the master of The Li Manor willing to elaborate?” Qiu Shuhui asked again.
“Seeing that you have thrown yourself into my arms, it wouldn’t be a problem for this elder,” Han Li replied.
As he spoke, Han Li flipped his palm, and a jade vial appeared in his hand.
With a casual toss, Han Li threw it at Qiu Shuhui, and said indifferently, “Take a look.”
Qiu Shuhui was momentarily stunned, but she quickly caught it and opened the jade vial to look inside. She was immediately shocked; her beautiful face frozen in disbelief, her eyes full of confusion.
She blinked at Han Li, wanting to ask if this was really the pill she knew. But the fragrance of the pill and its shape all matched the divine pill she had longed for in her dreams.
True Martial Pill!
This was the heaven-defying pill that could help a Great Grandmaster from the Myriad Phenomena Realm break through to the True Martial Realm and even had the chance to improve their Martial True Pill by one to three grades.
The Divine Pill she had dreamed of was just tossed to her by the master of The Li Manor like it was trash!
This turn of events greatly shook Qiu Shuhui’s Dao heart, At this moment, she realized that the owner of The Li Manor seemed to be quite different from the rumors outside.
Qiu Shuhui even had the urge to immediately activate a great teleportation talisman and flee, As long as she successfully escaped, and once she cultivated to the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, she could rely on this True Martial Pill to ascend to the True Martial Realm with her talent, becoming a Martial Emperor assuredly.
But Qiu Shuhui forcefully suppressed this thought, On one hand, she feared the strength of The Li Manor’s lord, It was possible that the True Martial Pill he had given her was fake, or that his strength was far greater than she had imagined and he wasn’t afraid of her running away with the pill.
On the other hand, it was because Qiu Shuhui kept her promises; she had her own bottom line, The Li Manor’s lord treated her with a sincere heart, and she wouldn’t just run away; she’d become his Dao companion.
The owner of The Li Manor wasn’t a demon nor an old man; he was handsome, powerful, held high status, and was the best choice for her.
“Very good.”
All of Qiu Shuhui’s reactions, even her thoughts, were known to Han Li; nothing was secret before him.
“If you attempt to use the great teleportation talisman to escape, not only will you not receive the True Martial Pill, you’ll only become the female slave of your ancestor Han Li,” Han Li said indifferently.
Qiu Shuhui’s expression subtly changed, but she quickly regained her composure.
The strength of The Li Manor’s lord was indeed greater than she had imagined, He was even able to detect the deeply hidden great teleportation talisman she had, Luckily she hadn’t planned to run away, otherwise it would have been truly miserable for her.
After hesitating for a while, Qiu Shuhui called out directly, “Husband~”
She was very understanding and her purpose for coming here was simple, She wanted to find an opportunity to make a breakthrough to the True Martial Realm, Since The Li Manor’s lord had given her that chance, she was now his Dao companion.
“You’re very good,” Han Li praised.
He beckoned, and with only a slight hesitation, Qiu Shuhui walked over and sat on Han Li’s thigh.
Han Li wanted to climb high mountains and fish in troubled waters, and Qiu Shuhui didn’t stop him, but her delicate body was trembling slightly.
Holding Qiu Shuhui in his arms, Han Li captured her cold and glamorous red lips, savored them, and found her inexperienced response slightly surprising.
“Before me, how many Dao companions have you had?” Han Li asked indifferently.
He could tell that Qiu Shuhui was a Loose Cultivator, For a Loose Cultivator, reaching the Great Grandmaster level of the Myriad Phenomena Realm was extremely difficult, He had thought she might have had quite a few Dao companions already, but her inexperienced demeanor suggested otherwise.
“None,” Qiu Shuhui shook her head.
She had not always been a cultivator of the Da Qian Empire; she had stayed in the Da Liang Empire, and later traveled to the Da Qian Empire seeking to break through to the True Martial Realm.
For hundreds of years, indeed many had pursued her, but Qiu Shuhui disdained them all; she was realistic, looking for a powerful Dao companion who could definitely provide substantial help to her.
Qiu Shuhui didn’t believe in love, Over the years she’d seen plenty, In both the Mortal World and the Cultivation Realm, love was worthless and betrayal came easily.
Seemingly worried that The Li Manor’s lord would not believe her, Qiu Shuhui paused before adding, “My Yuan Yin is still intact, You are definitely the first to possess my body and will be the first and last at the end.”
Han Li nodded slightly, a smile appeared on his face, whether it was true would be known tonight.
Having gained such a stunning beauty, Han Li naturally wasn’t in a rush to return to Han Mansion; he simply extended his Divine Sense to Chengsheng Mountain to inform the delicate wives and beautiful concubines at Han Mansion, then disappeared from Chong Xiao Pavilion with Qiu Shuhui in his arms.
Since Qiu Shuhui, a peerlessly beautiful woman, took the initiative to throw herself into his arms, ancestor Han Li naturally wouldn’t refuse and accepted her with great enthusiasm.
That night, ancestor Han Li discovered what it felt like to savor a natural-born enchantress of peerless beauty.
Needless to say, it was very good.
Qiu Shuhui gave Han Li a great experience, This woman was not only a first-timer but also did not refuse any of Han Li’s requests, allowing for any position to be freely taken.
In high spirits, ancestor Han Li vigorously battled until dawn, successfully reached the ‘Fifth Heaven,’ and had all of Qiu Shuhui’s firsts as she always welcomed him with open arms.
The next day, Han Li held a grand wedding ceremony at The Li Manor and formally took Qiu Shuhui as his wife.
The various powers of the Capital City of the Da Qian had already anticipated this, and had prepared gifts in advance, As soon as the wedding preparations began, they sent their gifts.
Needless to say, they were very good at flattering.
Ancestor Han Li liked such discerning people very much and happily sent them a bit of return gifts, indeed only a bit.

Han Li didn’t speak but quietly appraised the Great Grandmaster from the Myriad Phenomena Realm who had thrown herself at him. Qiu Shuhui smiled enchantingly, without any signs of nervousness, remaining calm and composed. She had come prepared to The Li Manor.
Qiu Shuhui wore a snow-white dress that outlined her mature allure and abundant charm. With the breeze lifting her dress, her exquisite curves were perfectly sketched out.
She was like an unparalleled beauty, shimmering like a pearl with elegance and an ethereal presence, possessing skin as smooth as jade, divine beauty in her bones, with a countenance so nearly perfect and without a single flaw—she was one of the most beautiful women Han Li had ever seen.

chapters.title: Chapter 382: Chapter 197: The Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster Who Offers an Embrace_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Chapter 197: The Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster Who Offers an Embrace_2
Qiu Shuhui was exquisitely beautiful, appearing to be only twenty-five or twenty-six years old, yet she emitted a captivating aura, naturally alluring, with a cold and exquisite pretty face.
Her skin was as white as snow, radiating divine light, as though covered with frost, her figure slender and graceful like Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade meticulously carved and polished.
Her three thousand strands of black hair cascaded down to her waist, her white dress purer than snow. Merely standing there, she gave Han Li a sense that she was beyond the earthly dust, holier than even a goddess—truly an unparalleled beauty.
After admiring Qiu Shuhui’s incomparable beauty, Han Li praised, “She truly is a beauty of the ages.”
Qiu Shuhui’s charm was peerless. Although she was born with enticing bones, and there was a hint of seduction in her eyes, there was not the slightest trace of worldly dust on her. She was bright and absolutely pure, possessing an inherent contrast.
“Have you made up your mind?” After offering his commentary, Han Li asked with a smile.
Han Li naturally would not refuse Qiu Shuhui’s initiative to throw herself into his arms and willingly marry into The Li Manor. It was just a casual question.
Even if Qiu Shuhui now regretted it and wanted to leave, that would no longer be possible, as the old ancestor of the Li family certainly didn’t have the habit of letting the prey at hand fly away.
“I want to break through to the True Martial Realm; does the Lord of The Li Manor have a way?”
Her gaze settled on Han Li’s handsome face, Qiu Shuhui stated bluntly.
As a Loose Cultivator with Third Grade qualifications, it had already been difficult enough for her to cultivate to the Sixth Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. Advancing further, even reaching the Seventh Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, was hard, let alone aspiring to rise to the True Martial Realm in the future.
Qiu Shuhui had long since noticed the Lord of The Li Manor, observing and waiting. After so many years, none of the Lord’s cherished wives and concubines had come to any harm; instead, their cultivation had greatly increased, which finally gave Qiu Shuhui the determination to try.
She had come to try her luck with the Lord of The Li Manor, naturally with full preparation.
If the Lord of The Li Manor had a way to help her break through to the True Martial Realm, making her an Emperor Wu powerhouse, she was willing to become his partner, one of his cherished wives.
If the Lord of The Li Manor couldn’t do that but still wanted to keep her by force, to take her without consent, then naturally she wouldn’t allow it and would immediately activate a great teleportation talisman to be instantly transported to some other place in the Xuan Domain, millions of miles away.
For the Lord of The Li Manor to find her in the vast Xuan Domain would simply be a fool’s dream.
This was one of Qiu Shuhui’s biggest trump cards. She originally had two great teleportation talismans, but had used one in the past while being chased by a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, succeeding in her escape, so she was full of confidence.
As a Loose Cultivator, Qiu Shuhui knew all too well the pain of lacking resources for cultivation. Her chances of breaking through to the True Martial Realm were not high, even with her Third Grade qualifications, unless she had a large number of resources to support her cultivation.
If she wanted to shorten the cultivation time, she would need to go on adventures and seek great opportunities, but that was incredibly risky, and it was easy to die during such endeavors.
Qiu Shuhui had made her determination this time because she had gone on an adventure not long ago to compete for an opportunity, and having failed, she barely escaped capture by a True Martial Realm cultivator from the demonic path—a fate that would have surely been dire.
After her narrow escape, Qiu Shuhui decided to try her luck with the Lord of The Li Manor, seeing it as a shortcut.
If she wanted to take the shortcut offered by the Lord of The Li Manor, she naturally had to let him take her shortcut first.
Otherwise, why would the Lord of The Li Manor help her ascend to the True Martial Realm?
Having wandered the Cultivation Realm for hundreds of years, Qiu Shuhui understood this principle well.
“There are many ways, and for me, it isn’t difficult,” Han Li said with a smile, speaking as straightforwardly as she had.
Qiu Shuhui’s eyes brightened, and she breathed a sigh of relief. Having a way was good.
“Would the Lord of The Li Manor care to elaborate?” Qiu Shuhui asked once more.
“Given that you’ve offered yourself to me, the old ancestor naturally would not refuse,” Han Li replied.
After speaking, Han Li flipped his palm, and a Jade Vial appeared in his hand.
With a casual toss, Han Li threw it to Qiu Shuhui and said indifferently, “Take a look.”
Qiu Shuhui was momentarily stunned but still caught the vial promptly. Upon opening it and seeing the contents, she was shocked, her pretty face frozen and her eyes filled with disbelief.
She blinked at Han Li, wanting to ask if this was really the pill she knew of. But the fragrance of the pill and its shape all matched the Divine Pill she had dreamt of obtaining.
True Martial Pill!
This was a heaven-defying pill that could help a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm break through to the True Martial Realm and potentially even increase the grade of their Martial True Pill by one to three grades.
The Divine Pill she had longed for—was the Lord of The Li Manor simply tossing it to her like throwing away trash?
The dramatic shift in atmosphere greatly shook Qiu Shuhui’s Daoist heart, and at that moment, she found that The Li Manor Lord seemed quite different from the rumors outside.
Qiu Shuhui even entertained the thought of immediately activating the great movement talisman to escape, knowing that if she could successfully flee, and once she reached the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, she was sure to advance to the True Martial Realm with the aid of this True Martial Pill—using her talents, she was bound to ascend to a generation’s Emperor Wu.
But Qiu Shuhui forcefully suppressed this idea. On one hand, she feared the Manor Lord’s strength; he had given her the pill so effortlessly that it could either be a fake True Martial Pill, or his power might be much greater than she had imagined, not fearing her taking the pill and running away.
On the other hand, Qiu Shuhui valued keeping promises. She had her principles; if the Li Manor Lord treated her with a sincere heart, she would not walk away, but instead become his Dao companion.
The Manor Lord of the Li Manor was not a demon nor an old man. He was good-looking, powerful, and held a high status and identity—the best choice for her.
“Very good.”
All of Qiu Shuhui’s reactions, even her thoughts, were known to Han Li; there were no secrets before him.
“If you attempt to escape using the great movement talisman, not only will you lose the True Martial Pill, but you’ll also become a mere slave to this old ancestor,” Han Li said indifferently.
Qiu Shuhui’s expression briefly changed, then she regained her composure.
Indeed, The Li Manor Lord was even more powerful than she had imagined; he was able to detect her deeply hidden great movement talisman. Fortunately, she had no intention of running away, or it really would have been a disaster.
After a moment of hesitation, Qiu Shuhui called out, “Husband~”
She was very sensible. Her purpose here was simple: to seek an opportunity to break through to the True Martial Realm. Since the Manor Lord had provided that opportunity, then she was his Dao companion.
“You’re not bad,” Han Li praised.
He beckoned, and after only a slight hesitation, Qiu Shuhui walked over and sat on Han Li’s thigh.
Han Li wanted to climb steep mountains and wade through muddy waters, and Qiu Shuhui did not stop him, though her delicate body trembled slightly.
Holding Qiu Shuhui in his arms, Han Li captured her cold yet exquisite lips, tasting them. He was slightly taken aback by her naive response.
“Before me, how many Dao companions did you have?” Han Li asked lightly.
He could see that Qiu Shuhui was a Loose Cultivator, and it was extremely difficult for such a person to reach the grandmaster level of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. He had thought she must have had numerous companions, but her naive demeanor suggested otherwise.
“None,” Qiu Shuhui shook her head.
She was not originally a Cultivator from the Da Qian Empire; she always stayed in the Da Liang Empire. Later, in search of a breakthrough to the True Martial Realm, she traveled all the way to the Da Qian Empire.
Over hundreds of years, indeed many had pursued her, but Qiu Shuhui did not take any of them seriously. She was very pragmatic, wanting to find a powerful Dao companion, definitely someone who could offer her immense help.
Qiu Shuhui never believed in love. Over the years, she had seen plenty, both in the Mortal World and the Cultivation Realm. Love was worthless and easily betrayed.
Worried that The Li Manor Lord might not believe her, Qiu Shuhui paused before adding, “My Yuan Yin is still intact; you are absolutely the first to possess my body, and you will also be the first and the last in the end.”
Han Li nodded slightly, a smile emerging on his face—he would find out whether it was true that night.
Having acquired such an exceptionally enchanting woman, naturally, Han Li was in no hurry to return to the Han Mansion. He simply extended his Divine Sense over to Chengsheng Mountain to inform the wives and concubines at the Han Mansion, and then disappeared with Qiu Shuhui from the Chong Xiao Pavilion.
Since Qiu Shuhui, the extraordinary beauty, had willingly thrown herself into his arms, the old ancestor warmly accepted her, quite passionately.
That night, the old ancestor savored the taste of a naturally seductive beauty.
It must be said, it was extremely good.
Qiu Shuhui provided Han Li with an excellent experience; not only was it her first time, but she also did not refuse any of Han Li’s requests, allowing for free change of positions.
The greatly invigorated old ancestor energetically battled until dawn, succeeded in five rounds, and experienced various ‘first times’ with Qiu Shuhui, who always welcomed him with open arms.
The next day, Han Li held a grand wedding ceremony at The Li Manor, formally taking Qiu Shuhui as his wife.
The various powers of the Capital City of the Qian Dynasty had long anticipated this and had prepared gifts in advance. As soon as the old ancestor’s wedding preparations began, they delivered their gifts.
It must be said, they were very good at flattering.
The old ancestor appreciated such perceptive people and was very pleased to give them a bit of a return gift, indeed, just a bit.

chapters.content:
Chapter 383: Chapter 197: The Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster Who Offers an Embrace_1
Time flowed leisurely, and in the blink of an eye, more than half a month had passed.
In the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li, along with Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, walked across the landscapes, measuring this secret realm with their steps.
When they felt a bit weary, the trio would rest atop a mountain peak, after which the old ancestor Han would enjoy the scenery.
First was Jiang Baiye dancing in the sky with her sword, like a fairy swordswoman descended from the moon palace, followed by Yun Miaoyi’s dance, a “Demon Dance” that made the old ancestor Han express his admiration outright.
Watching Yun Miaoyi, the little Devil Princess performing the “Demon Dance”, Han Li leaned close to Jiang Baiye’s ear, bit her delicate and exquisite earlobe, and whispered a sentence.
Jiang Baiye’s beautiful face blushed instantly; she stealthily glanced at Yun Miaoyi, showing an attitude that was inviting yet dismissive, which stirred old ancestor Han’s heart immensely.
Thus, old ancestor Han made no hesitation, revealing his divine presence there to preach, explaining the profound Dao in simple terms and conjuring up beautiful scenes of high mountains and flowing rivers with dragons and phoenixes.
After Han Li and Jiang Baiye finished their discussion of the Dao, Jiang Baiye realized that Yun Miaoyi had long stopped dancing and was observing with interest; Jiang promptly fled in a panic.
Yun Miaoyi raised an eyebrow at Han Li, feeling helpless about her husband’s behavior, yet found it quite thrilling in her heart.
So, on the next mountaintop, while Jiang Baiye transformed into a stunning fairy swordswoman and danced in the sky, the little Devil Princess Yun Miaoyi also sat and discussed the Dao with old ancestor Han.
To the knowledge-thirsty little Devil Princess, Han Li certainly wasn’t stingy, sharing all he had learned, enlightening and guiding her, and through countless army formations, utterly bested Yun Miaoyi.
Once their leisurely tour ended, Han Li departed the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain with Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, heading back to The Li Manor.
Atop Chong Xiao Pavilion, Han Li stood on the highest structure of the Daqian Empire, gazing down at the Capital City of Da Qian.
On this floor, besides Han Li, there were two others, one of whom was his beautiful concubine Mu Wanyan, and the other, his servant concubine and Fairy Li Na.
Both women shared a special relationship: one was the daughter of the Daqian National Teacher, and the other was his disciple. Yet, both had fallen into the clutches of old ancestor Han.
“It’s a pity, the Daqian National Teacher won’t be able to witness this scene.” Looking at the bustling Capital City of Da Qian, Han Li sighed softly.
Li Na and Mu Wanyan, kneeling on the ground, paused their movements; it was as if the deepest shroud of shame within them was suddenly unveiled, bringing a flush of embarrassment, yet also a strange sense of excitement.
After all, they both had special connections with the Daqian National Teacher, but now they were Han Li’s concubines and servant concubines, having been virgins before, without even a dao companion.
They got one later on and although Han Li was not their dao companion, he was ultimately their husband, and a successful one at that.
“Hold your tongue.” Han Li frowned slightly.
Li Na and Mu Wanyan paid him no heed, possibly carried away by their emotions, seemingly finding the thrill even more exciting this way.
Especially Li Na, who once ranked among the top five fairies of the Capital City of Da Qian, was famously eloquent. Having become Han Li’s servant concubine, she had long been tamed by Han Li, offering him unabashed praise, unable to let go, and never skimping on flattering words on any given day.
When their emotions had built up to a certain extent, they finally couldn’t help it and sobbed to Han Li, “Husband, we wish…”
Old ancestor Han waved his hand generously in approval, which relieved Li Na and Mu Wanyan greatly, making their fervent praises not in vain.
After spending some time at The Li Manor, Han Li was thinking of leaving when suddenly his eyes lit up.
It seemed someone was coming on their own to offer a gift?
His Divine Sense enveloped the whole Capital City of Da Qian, spotting a stunning figure flying into the city and heading towards The Li Manor.
This breathtaking figure possessed a formidable aura, actually being a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, which surprised Han Li even more.
But it was just as well, as he had recently been somewhat vexed that the alias Li Feiyu found it difficult to take a wife, mainly because most of the women in the Capital City and across the six states of the Qian Dynasty, those with talent and stunning beauty, had nearly all been married off by Han Li.
Another reason was that Han Li had raised the standards for taking wives and concubines; those who previously could have become his wives were now only fit to be concubines, and many who could have been considered for concubinage now didn’t even meet Han Li’s criteria.
The bold arrival of a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm into the Capital City of Da Qian naturally attracted the attention of the various powers within the city.
When they tried to probe further or consider suppressing her, they realized that this Great Grandmaster was heading straight to The Li Manor, causing them to hold their thoughts and decide to wait and see how things would unfold.
They had a premonition that the Lord of The Li Manor would possibly take another wife soon.
After all, this mysterious Great Grandmaster who had suddenly appeared was a uniquely enchanting and stunningly beautiful peerless beauty.
Qiu Shuhui flew all the way to The Li Manor, pausing briefly before continuing forward, indeed encountering no obstructions from any grand formations.
“Come over for a chat~”
A voice reached Qiu Shuhui’s ears, and she looked up at the Chong Xiao Pavilion. In the next instant, she appeared at the topmost floor of the pavilion.
“Qiu Shuhui pays respects to the Lord of The Li Manor.”
Qiu Shuhui offered a graceful curtsy, with a beguiling smile and hopeful eyes.
Han Li didn’t speak, simply sizing up the Great Grandmaster who had come to offer herself willingly. Qiu Shuhui smiled alluringly, exhibiting no anxiety, poised and collected, having come prepared to The Li Manor.
Qiu Shuhui was dressed in snow-white garments, her mature body sensuously full, with curves that were highlighted as the white dress fluttered with her movements, perfectly outlining her exquisite figure.

"It's a pity that the Daqian National Teacher won't see this scene," Han Li sighed lightly as he gazed upon the bustling Capital City.
Li Na and Mu Wanyan, kneeling on the ground, paused in their movements, and the deepest shrouds of shame in their hearts were suddenly lifted, bringing a wave of embarrassment yet an inexplicably thrilling sensation.
After all, they both had a special relationship with the Daqian National Teacher, but now they were Han Li's concubines and servant concubine, who once were virgins without even a Dao Companion.
Later on, they acquired one, and although Han Li wasn't their Dao Companion, he was their husband indeed, and successfully so.
"Watch your words," Han Li frowned slightly.
Li Na and Mu Wanyan paid him no heed, as if they were caught up in their emotions, seemingly finding this even more stimulating.
Especially Li Na, who as one of the five famed Fairies of the Capital City, was known for her clever speech. After becoming Han Li's servant concubine and being tamed by him, she spoke very highly of him, lovingly adoring him, and she was always full of praise for him on a daily basis.
When their emotions accumulated to a certain extent, the two women could no longer hold back and cried out to Han Li, "Husband, we wish..."
Elder Han waved his hand in approval, allowing Li Na and Mu Wanyan to feel a great sense of relief, their fervent praises finally not in vain.
After having stayed in The Li Manor for some time, Han Li was just thinking about leaving when his eyes suddenly brightened.
It seemed someone had taken the initiative to come to him?
His Divine Sense covered the Capital City, spotting an extremely beautiful figure flying into the Capital City and heading toward The Li Manor.
This breathtaking figure was powerfully imposing, surprisingly a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, which astonished Han Li even more.
But it was just as well, for lately he had been somewhat troubled; his alias Li Feiyu found it difficult to take a wife, mainly because almost all the talented and stunning female cultivators in the Capital City and even the six states of the Qian Dynasty had been married off by Han Li.
Another reason was Han Li's elevated standards for taking wives and concubines; many who could have been wives now could only be concubines, and many who could have been his concubines now didn't even meet Han Li's criteria.
A Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm entering the Capital City without concealing her presence naturally drew the attention of various powers within the city.
When they tried to probe further or contain her, they found that this Great Grandmaster was heading straight for The Li Manor, causing them to withdraw their thoughts and decide to watch and wait.
They had a premonition that the Manor Lord was likely to take another wife.
After all, this mysteriously arriving Great Grandmaster was an enchanting woman of supreme beauty and allure.
Qiu Shuhui flew straight to The Li Manor, pausing briefly before continuing forward, encountering no hindrance from any great formations.
"Come over for a chat~"
A voice reached Qiu Shuhui's ears, and she looked up at the Chong Xiao Pavilion, her figure appearing atop the tower in the next instant.
"Qiu Shuhui pays respect to the master of The Li Manor."
Qiu Shuhui curtseyed gracefully, her smile enchanting and her eyes swimming with anticipation.
Han Li remained silent, simply observing this Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm who had brought herself to him. Qiu Shuhui smiled beguilingly, not the least bit nervous, poised and composed, having prepared herself well before coming to The Li Manor.
Qiu Shuhui was clad in a snow-white dress, her mature figure exquisitely curvaceous and full of grace, with her white gown billowing, perfectly outlining her voluptuous form.

chapters.title: Chapter 387: 197: The Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster Who Offers an Embrace_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 387: Chapter 197: The Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster Who Offers an Embrace_2
“`
She was unmatched in beauty, like a shimmering pearl bathed in the light of dawn, otherworldly and pure, with skin like immortal jade and natural elegance. Her face was nearly flawless, void of any blemish—one of the most beautiful female cultivators Han Li had ever seen.
Qiu Shuhui was incredibly beautiful, appearing to be only around twenty-five or twenty-six years old, yet her whole being radiated a captivating quality. With a natural charm and a delicately gorgeous yet cold face, she stood out prominently.
Her skin was whiter than snow, and her body emitted a divine glow, as if enveloped in frost. Her figure was slender and graceful, carved like the Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade.
Her hair, black as a raven’s feathers, cascaded down to her waist, and her white dress was purer than snow. Merely standing there, she gave Han Li the impression of a being untouched by mundane concerns, more saintly than a goddess, truly a rare beauty of her generation.
After admiring Qiu Shuhui’s stunning appearance, Han Li exclaimed in admiration, “Truly, a peerless beauty.”
Qiu Shuhui, with her world-class elegance, naturally possessed an alluring charm. Despite her enchanting eyes, she bore no trace of vulgarity; her beauty was remarkable and holy, with a compelling contrast of qualities.
“Have you decided?” After the comment, Han Li asked with a smile.
As for Qiu Shuhui, who was voluntarily throwing herself into his arms and willing to marry into the Li Manor, Han Li naturally wouldn’t refuse, and his question was asked merely in passing.
Even if Qiu Shuhui regretted her decision now and wanted to leave, it was no longer possible. The old ancestor, Han Li, did not have the habit of letting the prey that came to him escape.
“I wish to break through to the True Martial Realm. Does the Manor Lord have a way?”
Her gaze resting upon Han Li’s handsome face, Qiu Shuhui spoke frankly.
As a Loose Cultivator with Third Grade aptitude, it was already incredibly difficult for her to have cultivated to the Sixth Heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. She found it very challenging to advance further to the Seventh Heaven, not to mention aspiring to the True Martial Realm in the future.
Qiu Shuhui had long been observing the Manor Lord of the Li Manor, biding her time. After so many years, none of the beautiful wives and concubines of the Manor Lord had met with any misfortune; instead, their cultivation had greatly improved, which finally convinced her to take action.
Seeking out the Manor Lord for an attempt, she came fully prepared.
If he could help her break through to the True Martial Realm and become a powerhouse like Emperor Wu, she was more than willing to be his consort and become one of his beloved wives.
If the Manor Lord couldn’t do it but still wanted to keep her against her will, trying to overpower her, then she would definitely not allow it and would activate a Movable Talisman to instantly teleport herself to another location in the Xuan Domain, thousands of miles away.
For the Manor Lord to find her within the vast Xuan Domain would be a fool’s dream.
This was one of Qiu Shuhui’s biggest trump cards. She originally had two Movable Talismans, but had used one when she was being pursued by a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, which helped her escape successfully, so she was quite confident.
As a Loose Cultivator, Qiu Shuhui knew all too well how painful it was to lack cultivation resources. The chances of her breaking through to the True Martial Realm on sheer hard work were slim, even with her Third Grade aptitude, without substantial cultivation resources to support her.
If she wanted to shorten the cultivation time, she would need to take on challenges and seek great fortunes, but this was fraught with peril, and she could easily die during such trials.
The reason Qiu Shuhui had resolved to take this step was because she had recently sought a fortuitous opportunity and failed, narrowly escaping capture by a demonic cultivator of the True Martial Realm. She would have met a terrible fate had she been taken.
After her fortunate escape, Qiu Shuhui decided to give it a try at the Manor Lord’s, seeing it as a shortcut.
If she wanted to take the Manor Lord’s shortcut, she had to let the Manor Lord take her shortcut first.
Otherwise, why would the Manor Lord help her advance to the True Martial Realm?
Qiu Shuhui, with hundreds of years of experience in the Cultivation Realm, understood this principle well.
“There are many methods, and for me, they are not difficult,” Han Li said with a smile, being as candid as she was.
Qiu Shuhui’s eyes brightened, and she breathed a sigh of relief—having a method was good news.
“Would the Manor Lord be willing to elaborate?” Qiu Shuhui asked again.
“Given that you’ve thrown yourself at me, I see no reason not to,” Han Li replied.
With a flip of his palm, a Jade Vial appeared in his hand.
Without much ceremony, Han Li tossed the Jade Vial to Qiu Shuhui, saying indifferently, “Take a look.”
Qiu Shuhui was momentarily stunned but caught the vial and swiftly opened it to check. The sight left her shocked, her pretty face frozen, her eyes filled with disbelief.
She looked at Han Li, blinking and wanting to ask if this was indeed the pill she knew, but the fragrance and shape of the pill matched the Divine Pill she had longed for.
The True Martial Pill!
This was a heaven-defying elixir that could help a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm break through to the True Martial Realm, and potentially even increase the grade of the Martial True Pill by one to three grades.
The Divine Pill she had dreamt of, and the Manor Lord had just tossed it to her as if it was trash!
This turn of events shocked Qiu Shuhui to her core. In that moment, she realized the Manor Lord might be quite different from what the rumors suggested.
Qiu Shuhui even felt the urge to activate the Movable Talisman and flee right there and then. If she succeeded, once reaching the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm and with the aid of the True Martial Pill, her chances of advancing to the True Martial Realm and becoming an Emperor Wu were certain.
But Qiu Shuhui suppressed that impulse, partly because she feared the Manor Lord’s strength. He had so casually given her the pill, which could either be a fake True Martial Pill or a sign that he was far stronger than she had imagined, unconcerned about her potentially running away with it.
Another reason was Qiu Shuhui’s commitment to her promises; she had her own principles. If the Manor Lord treated her with genuine sincerity, she wouldn’t just walk away. She was ready to become his consort.
After all, the Manor Lord was neither a demon nor an old man. He was handsome, powerful, and held high status. He was the best choice for her.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - 197: The Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster Who Offers an Embrace 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 388 - 197: The Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster Who Offers an Embrace_3
"Very well."
All of Qiu Shuhui's reactions, even her thoughts, were known to Han Li; there were no secrets before him.
"If you attempt to use the Great Spatial Shift Talisman to escape, not only will you not get the True Martial Pill, but you will also become my, the ancestor's, female slave," Han Li said indifferently.
Qiu Shuhui's expression changed slightly, then regained her composure instantly.
The power of the Lord of The Li Manor was indeed stronger than she had imagined, as he even detected the deeply hidden Great Spatial Shift Talisman. Fortunately, she hadn't planned on running away, otherwise, she would have truly been in a dire situation.
After hesitating for a moment, Qiu Shuhui called out directly, "Husband~"
She was very sensible. Her purpose for coming here was simple: to seek an opportunity to break through to the True Martial Realm. Since the Lord of The Li Manor had given her this opportunity, she was now his Dao Companion.
"You're quite good," praised Han Li.
He beckoned with his hand, and Qiu Shuhui, with only a slight hesitation, walked over and sat on Han Li's lap.
Han Li wanted to appreciate the lofty mountains and also to fish in troubled waters, and surprisingly, Qiu Shuhui did not stop him, though her delicate body trembled slightly.
Holding Qiu Shuhui in his arms, Han Li captured her cool and exquisite red lips, probing gently. He discovered Qiu Shuhui's inexperienced response, which made Han Li, the ancestor, slightly astonished.
"Before me, how many Dao Companions have you had?" Han Li asked indifferently.
He could see that Qiu Shuhui was a Loose Cultivator, and for Loose Cultivators to cultivate up to the Great Grandmaster level of the Myriad Phenomena Realm was extremely difficult. He had thought she would have had quite a number of Dao Companions by now, but this inexperienced demeanor did not seem to match up.
"None," Qiu Shuhui shook her head.
She had not previously been a Cultivator from the Daqian Empire, but had always stayed in the Da Liang Empire. Later, seeking a breakthrough in the True Martial Realm, she traveled all the way to the Daqian Empire.
For hundreds of years, indeed, many had pursued her, but Qiu Shuhui did not fancy any of them. She was very pragmatic and wanted to find a strong Dao Companion, particularly one who could certainly provide her with substantial help.
Qiu Shuhui did not believe in love. Over the years, she had seen much. Whether in the Mortal World or the Cultivation Realm, love was worthless and easily led to betrayal.
As if worried that the Lord of The Li Manor wouldn't believe her, Qiu Shuhui paused, then added, "My Yuan Yin is still intact, you are definitely the first to possess my body, and also the first and the last in the end."
Han Li nodded slightly, a smile appearing on his face. He would know by night whether it was true or not.
Having acquired such an exquisitely beautiful woman, Han Li naturally wasn't in a hurry to return to Han Mansion. He simply extended his Divine Sense to Chengsheng Mountain, informed the charming wives and beautiful concubines at Han Mansion with a word, and then disappeared with Qiu Shuhui from Chong Xiao Pavilion.
As the stunningly beautiful Qiu Shuhui took the initiative to warmly throw herself into his arms, Han Li, the ancestor, naturally did not refuse and accepted her with great enthusiasm.
That night, Han Li experienced firsthand what it was like to possess a naturally alluring and peerless beauty.
It must be said, it was very good.
Qiu Shuhui gave Han Li an extremely good experience; not only was it her first time, but she also did not reject any of Han Li's requests, allowing for a variety of positions at will.
The elated Han Li spent the entire night discussing the Dao with her, successfully passing through five stages, seizing all of Qiu Shuhui's first times, and Qiu Shuhui was always welcoming in her responses.
The next day, Han Li held a grand wedding at The Li Manor, officially taking Qiu Shuhui as his wife.
The various powers of the Capital City of the Daqian Empire had long anticipated this and had prepared gifts in advance. As soon as Han Li, the ancestor's wedding began, they sent over their gifts.
It must be said, they were very adept at being personable.
Han Li, the ancestor, liked such sensible people and happily sent them a bit of return gifts, indeed only a bit.

chapters.title: Chapter 389: 198: The Evolution of Time-Sky Tower, Supreme Grade Imperial Arms! White Emperor City’s Zimiao Zhen! The Empress has given birth to a child?_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 389: Chapter 198: The Evolution of Time-Sky Tower, Supreme Grade Imperial Arms! White Emperor City’s Zimiao Zhen! The Empress has given birth to a child?_1
Having just married a charming wife, Han Li discussed the Dao with Qiu Shuhui for several days in a row.
During this period, Han Li directly expended five years of his cultivation to open this month’s treasure chest, and it turned out to be a massive hit.
This enabled Han Li to unexpectedly get a new move for opening treasure chests.
“Ding~ Congratulations to the master for obtaining from the treasure chest: Emperor Level Supreme Grade Artifact ‘Creation Stone’!”
When Han Li saw the Emperor Level Supreme Grade Artifact, his heart was filled with joy. This was the second Emperor Level Supreme Grade Artifact he had acquired, the first being the Void Bell. He immediately examined it.
Creation Stone: Can enhance the target weapon by four grades, up to the maximum of Emperor Level Supreme Grade.
After just one glance, Han Li understood—the effect of the enhancement stone was simple, crude, and defied the heavens.
Used well, Han Li would gain another Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, significantly boosting Han Mansion’s foundation.
Arriving at the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li took a deep breath, opened his personal panel to take a look, and all of his weapons appeared.
[Weapons]
Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon: Void Bell
Mid Grade Emperor Weapon: Battle Tower
Lower Grade Emperor Weapon: Cangdao Hall
