Supreme Grade Divine Weapon: Time-Sky Tower, Dao Decapitating Sword, Life-Prolonging Furnace
Top Grade Divine Weapon: Nine Mysterious Heavenly Knife, Sky God War Chariot
…
After some consideration, Han Li excluded the Battle Tower and Cangdao Hall, two Quasi Emperor Weapons, as making use of the Creation Stone on them seemed like a loss. (PS: Let me explain again, so no more questions about this later. Top Grade Divine Weapons and Supreme Grade Divine Weapons correspond to the Saint Yuan Realm, also known as Sacred Soldiers; Lower Grade Emperor Weapons and Mid Grade Emperor Weapons correspond to Quasi Emperors, also called Quasi Emperor Weapons.)
Han Li also ruled out the two Top Grade Divine Weapons, the Nine Mysterious Heavenly Knife and the Sky God War Chariot, leaving him with three Supreme Grade Divine Weapons, which could be upgraded to Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons with the help of the Creation Stone.
Hence, Han Li found himself in a dilemma.
The Time-Sky Tower, Dao Decapitating Sword, and Life-Prolonging Furnace each had their unique effects; evolving any of them into a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon would strengthen Han Mansion’s foundation immensely.
The Time-Sky Tower had both offensive capabilities and supportive functions, whereas the Life-Prolonging Furnace was a supportive weapon, lacking in offensive power—both were suitable for Han Mansion’s development; the Dao Decapitating Sword was a weapon of attack, with no auxiliary powers, suitable for Han Li’s personal use.
The sword techniques Han Li mastered were the most numerous and currently the strongest. He had the Divine Rank Mid Grade Thousand Sword Scripture, Heaven Rank Supreme Grade ‘Geng Jin’ Sword Scripture, Heaven Rank Mid Grade Calming Chaos Sword Manual, and so on.
After hesitating for a while, Han Li ruled out the Life-Prolonging Furnace, which was absorbing a Piece of Emperor Level Mid Grade Divine Gold and would need several more years to digest it.
Once the Life-Prolonging Furnace successfully digested the Divine Gold, its injuries would heal and it might even further advance, possibly evolving into a Lower Grade Emperor Weapon.
After careful consideration, Han Li ultimately gave up on the Dao Decapitating Sword and chose the Time-Sky Tower.
His own cultivation was advancing rapidly, but his charming wife, concubines, and the progeny of Han Mansion were far behind, not even close to one percent of his cultivation speed, which was unacceptable.
First, he already had the Void Bell, a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon also designed for offense, so acquiring another one like the Dao Decapitating Sword didn’t seem very useful, making it more cost-effective to enhance the Time-Sky Tower.
Second, the Time-Sky Tower was well-rounded, with capabilities in both offense and support; its offensive power was not inferior to the Dao Decapitating Sword, a top-tier Sacred Soldier involving time.
Enhancing the Time-Sky Tower to a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon would grant him not only an attacking Emperor Weapon but also a supporting one, giving Han Li a feeling of striking it rich.
The only drawback was that the Time-Sky Tower had to be placed on Enlightenment Peak and couldn’t be carried around; otherwise, it would affect the Cultivators of Han Mansion using the Time-Sky Tower’s supportive functions.
He wasn’t sure whether evolving it into a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon would dilute or even solve this drawback.
Once he decided, Han Li didn’t hesitate and immediately summoned Shi Qi, Zi Yi, Yin Ling, JianJi, Yue Ji, and other little Artifact Spirit girls.
For a moment, Han Li was surrounded by little girls in various colored dresses, with only Yue Ji being a young woman.
After looking around, Han Li voiced his decision.
“Shi Qi, I’ve decided to upgrade your grade and evolve your body into a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon.”
“Really? Master is so good to Shi Qi, wuwu, Shi Qi is so touched~”
Shi Qi was a bit stunned at first, but quickly reacted, immediately hugging Han Li’s arm and shaking it, her face full of surprise and emotion.
The master had so many Artifact Spirits, but he chose her to evolve into a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, which meant he cherished her the most.
Every Supreme Grade Divine Weapon’s Artifact Spirit desired for their body to be promoted to an Emperor Weapon, but only one in a hundred could achieve it.
Now she had this opportunity, and to directly evolve into a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon was blissful indeed.
Zi Yi, JianJi, Yin Ling, and other little Artifact Spirit girls were also momentarily stunned, with Zi Yi recovering her composure the fastest, as her body was already a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon.
JianJi, Yin Ling, and other little girls stared at Han Li eagerly; they too wished to become Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons.
While Yue Ji and Yin Ling still harbored doubts, JianJi and the other little girls were already pushing Shi Qi aside, either hugging Han Li’s thigh, his arm, or pulling at his clothes, desperately acting spoiled and adorable.
Yue Ji and Yin Ling, having been subdued by Han Li, didn’t entirely believe he could accomplish this feat since it was no longer Ancient Times, and even the major Sacred Lands could no longer refine Emperor Weapons, let alone Supreme Grade ones.
Han Li only had Divine Yuan Realm cultivation, and even with Tongxuan Realm combat ability, the idea of elevating a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon to a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon seemed like an impossible dream.
Yet, when the two little girls saw that Zi Yi, Shi Qi, JianJi, and their friends were utterly convinced, they could only half-believe and wait to witness it with their own eyes.
“Alright, alright, when there’s a chance in the future, I’ll let you all evolve into Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons.”

chapters.title: Chapter 390: 198: The Evolution of Time-Sky Tower, Supreme Grade Imperial Arms! White Emperor City’s Zimiao Zhen! The Empress has given birth to a child?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 390: Chapter 198: The Evolution of Time-Sky Tower, Supreme Grade Imperial Arms! White Emperor City’s Zimiao Zhen! The Empress has given birth to a child?_2
The sight of JianJi and the other two exquisitely carved little lasses cooing and acting cutely melted Han Li’s heart to mush, and he quickly spoke.
“Hehe~ I knew our master still loves us.”
JianJi and the other little lasses immediately beamed with joy.
“Of course it’s true.”
Han Li first answered Shi Qi’s question, and then turned to Zi Yi, saying, “Zi Yi, you’ll be the protector when the time comes, concealing any possible disturbances that might arise.”
“Don’t worry, master,” Zi Yi sweetly smiled.
After making preparations, Han Li’s Divine Sense entered the Time-Sky Tower and, finding no one at critical junctures such as breakthroughs, he beckoned, and the Time-Sky Tower over Enlightenment Peak flew over and landed in his hand.
All the cultivators from Han Mansion who were cultivating inside the Time-Sky Tower got shaken out, landing on Enlightenment Peak in a daze, unsure of what had happened.
Then Han Li’s voice came, calming all those restless and bewildered people, who silently waited.
Husband, father, ancestors had said they would be compensated. The time they spent cultivating in the Time-Sky Tower would be recalculated and doubled.
This brought immense joy to everyone, though they were unaware of what would happen to the Time-Sky Tower, it was a great benefit for them.
Atop Chengdao Peak, seeing the Time-Sky Tower fly over, Shi Qi, JianJi, Yue Ji, Yin Ling, and other little lasses all grew tense, silently standing behind their master, waiting.
Han Li looked at Zi Yi, who thought for a moment, and the might of the Void Bell burst forth, hiding Chengdao Peak, isolating it from the world, entering deep space where no little bit of noise could be transmitted outside.
Han Li took out the Creation Stone with a flip of his hand, about to begin, when he noticed Xue Yueqing, Long Yue, Bai Keqing, and Lu Tianxiang, his beautiful wives, flying up.
His Divine Sense moved, instantly informing his many partners about the situation. Xue Yueqing, Long Yue, and the other women were instantly shocked, wanted to speak but held back, silently watching.
The husband held too many secrets, and now he was only revealing one of them.
Glancing back at the countless peerless beauties and delicately charming little lasses, Han Li smiled, bringing his left and right hands together and slowly bringing the Creation Stone and Time-Sky Tower close.
Shi Qi had already returned to her original body, and seeing this, she didn’t hesitate to swiftly activate the Time-Sky Tower to absorb the Creation Stone and then began to refine it.
Han Li gently tossed it, and the Time-Sky Tower landed at the highest point of Chengdao Peak. Instantly, divine lights burst forth in grandeur, the aura growing ever stronger, a trace of Emperor’s Might germinating and then increasing, twisting the void, changing the color of the heavens and earth, with the air of the epochs beginning to emerge.
Lu Tianxiang, Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, Jiang Baiye, and other beautiful wives had shocked expressions, as their husband seemed to truly be evolving a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon by hand.
Yue Ji and Yin Ling exchanged glances, equally astounded, and at the same time, they felt an endless longing, wishing they too could be favored by their master and evolve into a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon.
“Master is so amazing~”
JianJi and the other two little lasses had stars in their eyes, looking up to Han Li with faces full of admiration, envy, and blessings.
As time passed, the Emperor’s Might atop Chengdao Peak grew increasingly dense, the Emperor’s Light illuminated the nine heavens, the Emperor’s Might was eternal, and myriad wondrous phenomena appeared in the heavens, each one auspicious, as if celebrating the birth of an Emperor Weapon.
Han Li, Lu Tianxiang, Xue Yueqing, and the others grew solemn, even with the Void Bell concealing the commotion and blocking the spreading Emperor’s Might of the Time-Sky Tower, they could feel a daunting aura rushing towards them.
To avoid any accidents, Han Li had Zi Yi completely isolate the area, so aside from those present, none of the many beautiful concubines on Chengdao Peak could perceive the slightest bit.
Streams of Emperor’s Might burst forth, the Time-Sky Tower continuously refined, evolving, its aura growing stronger and stronger, already evolving into a Lower Grade Emperor Weapon.
Mid Grade Emperor Weapon!
Top Grade Emperor Weapon!
When the Time-Sky Tower evolved into a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, the fearsome Emperor’s Might shattered the void, inverted the cosmos, dimmed the stars, and fearsome Emperor’s Light illuminated the eternal azure heavens.
If not for Shi Qi also making great efforts to control the Time-Sky Tower, Zi Yi alone managing the Void Bell wouldn’t have been enough to conceal it, unless it was fully awoken.
That was when something that shocked even Han Li happened.
In the heavens above, a river emerged faintly, filled with the aura of epochs, and the Time-Sky Tower violently surged into the river of time, accepting the baptism of the river of time, completing its final ascent and transformation.
During this period, the Time-Sky Tower emitted increasingly terrifying Emperor’s Might, putting great pressure on Zi Yi, who couldn’t help but transmit a message to Han Li.
“Master, the power of the Time-Sky Tower is too strong, I must fully awaken, otherwise the Emperor’s Might will leak out.”
Han Li’s lips twitched, not expecting that the evolution of a single Emperor Weapon would require such a grand affair, that even the river of time would appear.
Fully awakening the Void Bell once required at least ten thousand Spirit Sources, the yearly output of the Dragon Vein from Chengsheng Mountain.
Though it pained him, Han Li didn’t hesitate, comparing the concealment of the Emperor’s Might from the Time-Sky Tower to the ten thousand Spirit Sources, it was undoubtedly more crucial.
Otherwise, Chengsheng Mountain would be exposed to the eyes of all the Sacred Lands in Qianyuan Divine Province, then it would become a target of everyone, all his previous efforts would be exposed, and he could hide no more.
Just as Han Li was about to agree, Shi Qi’s voice rang out, “Master, wait.”
Hearing this, Han Li remained silent, just watching, knowing that Shi Qi’s evolution was complete, or she wouldn’t have said so.
The Time-Sky Tower burst from the river of time, completely changed in appearance, with boundless Emperor’s Light shining upon the nine heavens and ten earths, the river of time then disappeared without a trace.

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - 198: The Evolution of Time-Sky Tower, Supreme Grade Imperial Arms! White Emperor City’s Zimiao Zhen! The Empress has given birth to a child?_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 391: Chapter 198: The Evolution of Time-Sky Tower, Supreme Grade Imperial Arms! White Emperor City’s Zimiao Zhen! The Empress has given birth to a child?_3
The next instant, Shi Qi reined in the Time-Sky Tower, retracting all Emperor’s Might and Emperor’s Light, causing the tower to fall into Han Li’s hand.
Zi Yi breathed a sigh of relief and continued to have the Void Bell cover everything, but the rate of recovery had significantly lowered. Although a substantial amount of stored energy had been used up, the absorption of Dragon Vein Energy would replenish it soon.
“Ding! Time-Sky Tower has successfully evolved into a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon!”
Examining the small tower in his hand, Han Li heard a system notification in his mind, which he promptly ignored.
The Time-Sky Tower had evolved from a five-layered tower to a nine-layered one, ascending from a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon to a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, with four extra layers added to the tower’s body.
The Time-Sky Tower was enveloped in an aura of time, with fragments of time subtly flowing around it, exuding an ancient and primitive air. It was a time-related Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, while the Void Bell was a space-related one.
Divine Sense poured into the Time-Sky Tower, and after communicating with Shi Qi, Han Li instantly knew the situation after the tower’s evolution.
After evolving into a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, the Time-Sky Tower’s offensive and auxiliary effects skyrocketed countless times, delighting Han Li.
Now, the first layer of the Time-Sky Tower could accommodate a hundred thousand people; stay inside for four days, and only one day would pass on the outside.
The second layer could hold twenty thousand people; ten days inside equaled one day outside. The third layer could hold five thousand; twenty days inside for one outside.
The fourth layer could hold one thousand for two months; the fifth, two hundred for half a year; the sixth, fifty for a year; the seventh, ten for two years; the eighth, five for five years; and the ninth, one person for ten years.
“Hiss~”
Han Li couldn’t help but take a sharp breath; the auxiliary effect of the Time-Sky Tower, now a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, was simply too tyrannical.
So worth it!
With the new Time-Sky Tower, the Han Mansion’s development speed could increase by tens to hundreds of times, or even faster, enabling the rapid cultivation of a substantial number of powerhouses in a very short time.
Of course, if there was an ample supply of cultivation resources, this speed could be further increased, transitioning from arduous cultivation to a constant stream of opportunities.
Han Li decided to redesign a set of rules for the cultivators of Han Mansion to use the Time-Sky Tower, updating the corresponding level privileges and required contributions. He communicated with Shi Qi, letting her operate and control all these.
Using the Time-Sky Tower must be done with caution, as the lifespan consumed inside is real. If not careful, it could lead to a rapid depletion of one’s life.
The sixth layer of the Time-Sky Tower was only accessible by those in the Tongxuan Realm, as only with a Tongxuan Realm physique could one withstand the speed of time on that layer; one year of cultivation inside equates to just one day outside.
The seventh layer required a Saint from the Saint Abyss Realm, the eighth needed a Quasi Emperor, and only a Great Emperor in the Heaven Imperial Realm could enter the ninth level.
The Time-Sky Tower was also extremely useful for a Great Emperor in the Heaven Imperial Realm. When it came to the Emperor’s domain, advancing a minor realm was measured in ten-thousands of years. Some less fortunate Great Emperors might spend hundreds of thousands of years to ascend a minor realm, spending their entire lives stuck in the early stages of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
If one had a temporal treasure like the Time-Sky Tower, things would be different. With one year passing outside, one could undergo arduous cultivation for 3650 years on the inside. A decade or two outside might suffice for an advancement of one minor realm.
Though a great deal of lifespan is consumed, it truly is a heaven-defying opportunity, gaining strength that would have taken tens of thousands of years to obtain, and significantly increasing the odds of seizing chances.
Shi Qi also told him that the corporal body of the Time-Sky Tower didn’t need to be placed on Enlightenment Peak anymore; it could summon a shadow from the river of time to sit in its stead. The auxiliary power would not be weakened, and it would go unnoticed by others.
The corporal body of the Time-Sky Tower could then reside in the Nine Heavens, frolicking with the Void Bell. In this case, however, the auxiliary effect of the Time-Sky Tower’s corporal body would be temporarily stripped away, as it had been transferred to the shadow of the tower.
The shadow of the Time-Sky Tower could only last for one year; a new one must be summoned every year and only one can exist at a time, otherwise, it would disappear.
This was incredibly good news for Han Li.
With this development, the Time-Sky Tower wouldn’t be restricted to Chengsheng Mountain anymore. If necessary, it could be carried along, greatly enhancing his safety.
The Time-Sky Tower dealt with time, and the Void Bell with space. Time and space were among the most powerful paths, which made the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell terrifyingly potent, stronger than the typical Supreme Grade Divine Weapons.
Han Li was curious if the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell could fully recover their strength and work together, would they be able to withstand a celestial weapon?
Contemplating this, Han Li couldn’t help but inquire. After a discussion between Zi Yi and Shi Qi, they provided an answer.
If they combined their powers, the outbreak of might would increase by at least tenfold, but there was still a considerable gap from the might of a celestial weapon. They could fend off celestial weapons that hadn’t fully recovered but not against those that had. Unless they advanced further and their corporal bodies evolved into demi-celestial weapons.
Though slightly disappointed, Han Li was still satisfied. Being able to withstand partially recovered celestial weapons was already very powerful.
“It’s truly a success!”
The young girls like JianJi had eyes full of envy, while Lu Tianxiang, Bai Keqing, Yue Ji, Yin Ling, and others were completely shocked.
They witnessed the birth of a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, their feelings incredibly complex.
“Congratulations, husband~”
“Congratulations, Master~”
“Congratulations, Sister Shi Qi~”
After the astonishment, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, JianJi, Zi Yi, and others spoke up to congratulate.
From now on, Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain possessed an additional Supreme Grade Divine Weapon – a joyous occasion indeed that surged the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain’s strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - 198: The Evolution of Time-Sky Tower, Supreme Grade Imperial Arms! White Emperor City’s Zimiao Zhen! The Empress has given birth to a child?_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 392: Chapter 198: The Evolution of Time-Sky Tower, Supreme Grade Imperial Arms! White Emperor City’s Zimiao Zhen! The Empress has given birth to a child?_4
With the Void Bell and the Time-Sky Tower as its foundation, the Han Mansion was as stable as Mount Tai, not even a Sacred Land could easily shake it; from then on, it would enter a grand era of soaring heights.
They were participants, firsthand experiencers, witnesses, and the greatest beneficiaries.
Xue Yueqing, Long Yue, Bai Keqing, Lu Tianxiang, and other beautiful wives had already listened to their husband Han Li describe the evolved effects of the Time-Sky Tower, and they were greatly surprised.
On one hand, the capacity of each level of the Time-Sky Tower had increased dramatically, and on the other, its upper limit had risen countlessly, which was a significant opportunity even for Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
The last was that the privileges their husband granted them had increased; they could now stay in the Time-Sky Tower for many times longer, which meant reaching the Heavenly Abyss Realm or even becoming a Quasi Emperor was no longer wishful thinking.
As for their husband?
He was certain to cultivate to the Heaven Imperial Realm, master the Heavenly Sovereign Path, and become a Great Emperor suppressing the current era!
Not one of his beautiful wives, including Xue Yueqing and Long Yue, doubted this; Han Li had too many secrets and had created too many miracles. They just needed to closely follow their husband’s footsteps.
With the new Time-Sky Tower, when their husband wasn’t dual cultivating with them, they could practice there, thus doubling their cultivation efficiency, increasing their cultivation progress faster, and preventing them from being left too far behind by their husband.
…….
On this day, Han Li was soaking in the Xianghai Hot Spring with Long Yue, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Bai Keqing, while his other cherished wives and concubines busied themselves with their own affairs.
Han Li leaned against the edge, holding the alluring body of Long Yue in his arms, while Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Bai Keqing reclined gracefully nearby.
“Husband, is Sister Yao Xi about to give birth soon?” Long Yue asked with her beautiful eyes closed, reveling in the hot spring.
“Mmm, about another week,” Han Li replied absently because in the hot spring, there were two pairs of crystal clear, flawless jade feet flexibly acting first come, first served.
Yun Miaoyi was to Han Li’s right, and Bai Keqing was to his left; both women propped their heads with one hand, alluring and charming as they smiled at Han Li.
Across from Han Li was the Sword Immortal Jiang Baiye, whose pretty face blushed slightly, looking eager to join in, but there seemed to be no room left.
Holding Long Yue, Han Li massaged her, a look of contentment on his face, but in his heart, he was secretly thinking.
The Devil Princess and the Demon Queen are indeed mischievous.
The patriarch must subdue the demons and give them a stick-based education.
While Patriarch Han enjoyed his contentment in the Xianghai Hot Spring, a major event was unfolding outside of the Qianyuan Divine Province.
In the Endless Yuankun Domain, the Taibai Divine Province.
The Taibai Divine Province was situated in the northern part of the Endless Yuankun Domain, ruled by White Emperor City, and its supreme ruler was the White Emperor.
White Emperor City was one of the most powerful forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, just like the Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain.
The Huangyue Imperial Empire had forty-eight subsidiary Divine Provinces, Yuanchu Mountain had forty-seven, and White Emperor City had even more—fifty-two in total.
Although the Endless Yuankun Domain was vast, more than half of the Eight Hundred Divine Regions were split among the Supreme Territories, supreme sects, Imperial Empires, and Eternal Clans within their realms of power.
Elevated above the Taibai Divine Province in the heavens was White Emperor City; a city even more grandiose and colossal than the Huangyue Imperial City, also an immortal weapon left from the ancient great calamities.
In the massive western expanse of White Emperor City stood a sky-piercing colossal tree, said to be a branch cut from an ancient tree from primeval times and regrown anew.
Built upon this colossal tree were numerous resplendent and majestic palaces and various cave dwellings, where some of the city’s most exalted cultivators resided.
At two-thirds the height of the colossal tree, where there were fewer palaces and cave dwellings, there lay a palace engraved with the words “Zimiao Palace.”
Clad in snow-white garments, the ethereal Fairy Zimiao sat cross-legged within.
“At last, success!” Zimiao opened her eyes with an expression of boundless joy.
Decades ago, after her second visit to the Qianyuan Divine Province to reinforce the Emperor Formation sealing a Great Emperor, and having completed her task, she had finally accumulated enough contributions.
Thus, Fairy Zimiao traded for a treasure that could enhance the quality of the Heavenly Abyss she had opened, and for this, she stayed at the peak of the Tongxuan Realm for a hundred years.
Now, all her efforts had paid off; she opened the ideal Heavenly Abyss and successfully promoted herself to the rank of Saint in the Heavenly Abyss Realm.
Because her Heavenly Abyss was of high grade, her combat ability within her realm was very strong, and she held enormous potential for the future. Breaking through to the Quasi Emperor realm was only a matter of time, and she even had hopes of stepping into the Heaven Imperial Realm, despite the slim odds.
Soon after, the news of Fairy Zimiao becoming a Saint spread throughout White Emperor City, causing quite a stir and earning her countless praises.
Fairy Zimiao was one of the three fairies of White Emperor City. The other two fairies had reached the Heavenly Abyss Realm decades and even a century ahead of her, overshadowing Zimiao.
With her breakthrough, Zimiao once again reversed her downturn, garnering the adoration of countless young prodigies.
White Emperor Palace.
Having been summoned, Fairy Zimiao saw the White Emperor’s avatar in this place.
With his hands behind his back and facing away from Zimiao, the White Emperor spoke indifferently, “Zimiao, congratulations on stepping into the Heavenly Abyss Realm.”
“I owe it to the treasure bestowed upon me by Your Majesty, otherwise, it would have been nearly impossible for Zimiao to cultivate such a quality Heavenly Abyss,” she replied, respectfully bowing her head.
“These are the fruits of your efforts. Without corresponding contributions, I wouldn’t have been able to reward you,” said the White Emperor with a smile.
As the supreme ruler of White Emperor City, he commanded several Heavenly Immortals and a host of Saints as well as Quasi Emperor powerhouses. He had to be mindful of the impact on them, taking care of other people’s feelings, and not acting recklessly since that could dishearten his subordinates.

chapters.title: Chapter 393: 198: The Evolution of Time-Sky Tower, Supreme Grade Imperial Arms! White Emperor City’s Zimiao Zhen! The Empress has given birth to a child?_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 393: Chapter 198: The Evolution of Time-Sky Tower, Supreme Grade Imperial Arms! White Emperor City’s Zimiao Zhen! The Empress has given birth to a child?_5
“If not for Your Majesty’s favor, this treasure would not have come to Miaozhen.” Zimiao Miaozhen shook her head.
White Emperor nodded slightly, for that was indeed the truth.
In White Emperor City, there were countless Tongxuan Realm powerhouses, many of whom coveted this treasure, all lining up for it. Although Zimiao Miaozhen had contributed enough, in terms of seniority, she only ranked fifth.
At this moment, if White Emperor took a fancy to Zimiao Miaozhen, he could bestow the treasure upon her. Those ranked before her might feel discontent, but they would not say much, for after all, Zimiao Miaozhen was also qualified to receive it.
This was an unwritten rule known to all, it all depended on who garnered more of White Emperor’s attention.
If White Emperor did not have someone he particularly favored, then the distribution of the treasure would follow the order of seniority.
“Miaozhen, I have asked you to come because I need you to make another trip to Qianyuan Divine Province and handle a matter for me,” said White Emperor with a gentle tone.
Zimiao Miaozhen instinctively responded, “Is there a problem with that Great Emperor’s seal again? Impossible, I clearly reinforced it well…”
White Emperor shook his head slightly and said, “It is not his issue. A soul fragment from Empress Huangyue has fallen into Qianyuan Divine Province, and it seems there has been an incident. Empress Huangyue is quite upset.”
“She has already sent Ji Mingyue over. I was originally thinking of sending someone else, but since you’ve broken through to the Saint Abyss Realm, it would be better for you to go.”
Zimiao Miaozhen suddenly realized.
In the past decade, Empress Huangyue had been furiously upset twice—could it have been because her soul fragments ran into trouble?
“As Your Majesty commands, Miaozhen shall certainly not refuse,” Zimiao Miaozhen immediately promised.
This was good news for her. A trip to Qianyuan Divine Province would earn her a great deal of merit, whether she succeeded or not. If she were to succeed and White Emperor was pleased, he would value her more highly, bestowing upon her even more treasures.
“Ji Mingyue must have taken an Emperor Level weapon with her, so you should take one as well. If possible, bring back Huangyue’s soul fragment. If not, then just ascertain the reason for Empress Huangyue’s fury,” White Emperor instructed as he extended his hand and beckoned, summoning an Emperor Level weapon that flew toward Zimiao Miaozhen.
“Miaozhen will do her utmost not to disappoint Your Majesty’s trust,” Zimiao Miaozhen replied as she received the Emperor Level weapon, then left White Emperor Palace and returned to Zimiao Palace to get ready before heading out to Qianyuan Divine Province on her light boat.
Zimiao Miaozhen had been to Qianyuan Divine Province twice and was fairly familiar with it by now. She felt at ease, primarily because this mission was not difficult. If White Emperor had not favored her, he would not have entrusted her with this task.
Qianyuan Divine Province had long since declined, no longer as glorious and prosperous as before. The strongest there were only at Tongxuan Realm, and she could walk unhindered with an Emperor Level weapon.
Although the Sacred Lands had Immortal Grade weapons, they did not dare to awaken them rashly or act against her in the shadows; otherwise, White Emperor’s wrath would reduce the Sacred Lands of Qianyuan Divine Province to ashes.
Back in White Emperor Palace, White Emperor’s avatar turned around and looked toward Kunji Divine Province, his gaze seemingly crossing boundless time and space, reaching Empress Huangyue.
Empress Huangyue disrupted his gaze with a wave of her hand, prompting White Emperor to sigh softly.
“You’re still the same.”
Empress Huangyue, no, Empress Yuanchu, was plotting something—White Emperor was fully aware. He was engaged in the same endeavors, only taking different paths.
In the face of the imminent great calamity of Yuankun Domain and Xuanshen Sword Mountain, no Great Emperor dared to take it lightly. Anyone with a hope of becoming immortal was desperately amassing foundational strength and not rushing to make breakthroughs.
Huangyue must now be at a critical juncture, suppressing those separated souls; otherwise, with Huangyue’s disposition, she would have personally gone to Qianyuan Divine Province by now.
Among those separated souls of Huangyue, there are not a few who have achieved enlightenment and control over the Heavenly Sovereign Path; the Huangyue Empress desires to have all these souls completely submit to her, but naturally, those souls are unwilling as they have long been independent entities.
To confine and suppress these separated souls, the Huangyue Empress has been significantly distracted, and she doesn’t dare to act recklessly or step out of Huangyue Imperial City at will, worried that enemies might take advantage of her vulnerability. If these souls were to break free, the hope of recapturing them would become exceedingly dim.
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
Han Li was in Yao Xi’s chamber, waiting for his beloved wife Yao Xi to give birth to their child.
Old Ancestor Han prayed quietly in his heart, hoping that his and Yao Xi’s first child would have a potential no lower than Fourth Grade.
His luck hadn’t been too good recently; he wondered if it was because he had obtained an Emperor Level Supreme Grade treasure from a treasure chest several months ago, that the subsequent chests had yielded no substantial rewards.
Although he now possessed First Grade potential, he had only been Second Grade when Yao Xi conceived. This child could not inherit his current potential.
Yao Xi might be the reincarnation of a powerful being, but she had not yet solved the mystery of her prenatal state, and her previous life’s potential had not returned. Currently, she possessed only Fifth Grade potential, and what the potential of the child she and Han Li would bring into the world was something Han Li was uncertain about.
It might be Fifth Grade, possibly Fourth Grade, and maybe even Third or Second Grade.
As for First Grade potential or a special constitution, Han Li felt there was little chance.
The likelihood of such events was extremely small; among his many descendants, only a rare few exhibited an unusual change in potential at birth, exceeding expectations, yet even the highest did not surpass Fourth Grade. It was far too difficult for a variation to result in First Grade or Immortal Grade potential.
As a wail broke the silence, Han Li collected his thoughts and strode into the room. After glancing at the child, he instantly probed its potential and his pupils shrank involuntarily.
Right as Yao Xi delivered the child, the Huangyue Empress in Huangyue Imperial City of Kunji Divine Province suddenly furrowed her brows, feeling unsettled.
It seemed as though something unfavorable had occurred.
The Huangyue Empress hastened to make an astrological calculation, but she failed to determine what had happened, which caused her to frown deeply.
Nowadays, Chengsheng Mountain is obscured by the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell, concealing the temporal and spatial landscape, blocking all probing attempts, so much so that not even a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor or a Supreme Grade Imperial weapon could detect it.
Even wielding an Immortal Grade weapon would require significant karmic entanglement to barely conjecture anything.
After some thought, the Huangyue Empress still decided to use an Immortal Grade weapon, as this related to her own safety, and she dared not be the slightest bit negligent.
When the results became available, the Huangyue Empress was infuriated again. Had she not been preoccupied, she truly wished to go to Qianyuan Divine Province to capture that thief and subject him to severe punishment for a hundred thousand years.
He had actually impregnated one of her separated souls, and a descendant had just been born—this was an extreme violation of her dignity!
What angered her was that this thief possessed treasures capable of concealing fate and confounding time and space; otherwise, even if he were hundreds of Divine Provinces away, she could leverage this karmic connection to calculate his precise location.
But now, she could only discern a vague outline of the situation.
“I hope Ji Mingyue doesn’t disappoint me,” she murmured to herself, then closed her eyes, choosing not to dwell on the matter any further to avoid growing angrier.
The separated soul was connected to her, in essence, part of herself; was she, the noble Huangyue Empress, indirectly giving birth to someone else’s child?

chapters.title: Chapter 394: 199: Descendants with the Supreme Bone! An Unprecedented Feat, Discussing the Dao with Shi Qi!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 394: Chapter 199: Descendants with the Supreme Bone! An Unprecedented Feat, Discussing the Dao with Shi Qi!_1
Chengsheng Mountain, Yao Xi’s bedroom.
Han Li’s gaze moved away from the newborn infant and settled on Yao Xi as he quickly walked over to her.
“Xi Xi, you’ve worked hard.”
Holding his beloved wife in his arms, Han Li grasped her delicate, boneless hand and continuously infused it with gentle True Yuan, regulating her body and replenishing her damaged vitality.
Snuggled in her lover’s embrace, Yao Xi shook her head gently and a blissful smile spread across her face as she said sweetly, “I’ve finally given birth to a child for my husband.”
She had been waiting for this day for a long time.
Just as she had longed to marry Han Li, after becoming pregnant, she would think about when the child would be born, whether it would be a boy or a girl, what its talents would be like, if it would resemble her husband more, or herself…
Yao Xi’s complexion quickly regained its rosy flush, and her delicate, flawless face lifted slightly as she looked up at her husband Han Li, her eyes brimming with love.
Han Li, too, looked affectionately at the beauty in his arms, speaking sweet nothings to her, which kept Yao Xi’s face full of sweet smiles.
After a tender exchange, whispering sweetly to each other, Yao Xi finally spoke in a gentle voice, “My husband hasn’t yet named our child…”
“I have already thought of a good name,” Han Li replied with a smile.
Expectantly, Yao Xi looked at her husband, feeling suddenly nervous.
She knew that Long Yue, her sister, and her husband’s first child was named Han Yonglong, and she wanted her husband to choose a good name for their own first child as well.
However, she was aware of her own modest talents, which could not compare to those of her sisters Long Yue, Bai Keqing, Lu Tianxiang, and Xue Yueqing; she estimated that her child’s talents would be at most Third Grade.
According to her husband’s customary naming, descendants with Third Grade talents were not sufficient to carry such connotations—Long Yue’s child had Supreme Grade talents, thus becoming the first.
“Xi Xi, he is our first child, how about the name Han Yongqian?” Han Li suggested softly as he looked at the infant.
To reach the heights is to be called Qian. Among the things that ascend, none surpasses qi; qi accumulates in the sky, thus Qian is the sky.
The Qian represents utmost robustness under heaven, its virtuous conduct is consistent and easy, knowing the perils.
Han Li had not intended to choose this name initially, but upon seeing the child for the first time, he changed his mind.
The significance of the character Qian was already profound, and when combined with Yong for everlasting, the meaning expanded even further.
Only this child could bear it, for he possessed a special constitution.
Now, Han Li was curious about Yao Xi’s true origins, which might not be as simple as the reincarnation of a powerful being as he had speculated.
Long Yue was also reborn, her previous life being that of the Jiao Saint from the Saint Abyss Realm, with a Mysterious Yin King physique. After rebirth, she lost her special constitution, and even though Long Yue still possessed the Dragon Ball and treasures from the Dragon Palace, her first child only had Supreme Grade talent.
But the child born to Yao Xi not only had Supreme Grade talent but also a special constitution, as Han Li noticed a piece of bone on Han Yongqian’s chest, full of Taoist charm.
The seal within Yao Xi’s Divine Spirit was still intact, the mystery of the womb yet to be unraveled, and even if she was a Saint from the Saint Abyss Realm in her past life, she could not have given birth to a child with both Supreme Grade talent and a special constitution under these circumstances.
Han Li speculated there were two possibilities:
The first was that Yao Xi was a Great Emperor from the Heaven Imperial Realm in her previous life, possessing an Imperial physique. Even without unraveling the mystery of the womb, if she were to have a child, it could inherit her previous life’s talents and constitution.
The second was that Yao Xi was not a reincarnated powerful being, but this was her first life; she might be the avatar or a split soul of a current Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, or something similar.
Han Li was unfamiliar with the Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm. He was not clear on whether they truly had such power after reincarnation, and he felt this was unlikely.
He considered the second possibility more likely. If her true self were a female Great Emperor from the Endless Yuankun Domain of the Heaven Imperial Realm with a special connection, then the child Yao Xi bore could have inherited some of the female Great Emperor’s talents and constitution.
“Sigh~”
Han Li silently sighed and frowned slightly. If it were the second possibility, he might have gotten himself into serious trouble.
He had involved himself with a split soul or an avatar of a Heaven Imperial Realm female Great Emperor and even had a child with her. What would that female Great Emperor think?
If the female Great Emperor created a split soul or avatar, she likely had big plans. His actions could have inadvertently disrupted them, and she would surely bear a grudge against him for this.
His current strength was still insufficient, far less than that of a female Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm. Although Han Li possessed two Supreme Grade Imperial weapons, he knew he could not be careless; the outside world was very different from the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Beyond the Qianyuan Divine Province, the world was vast and endless. The Eight Hundred Divine Regions were home to many Supreme Territories, Supreme Sects, Imperial Empires, and so on, each ruled by a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
These Great Emperors not only had their own Lifespan Imperial weapons but could also mobilize many Imperial weapons and even Immortal weapons. Their depth was unfathomable, far beyond the comparability of the declining Sacred Lands of the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Contemplating this, Ancestor Han became extremely excited at the thought—could it mean that, unintentionally, a Heaven Imperial Realm female Great Emperor had borne him a child?
Had he become, in a way, the husband of a Heaven Imperial Realm female Great Emperor?
The more Ancestor Han thought about it, the more thrilling it became, and he quickly dismissed the thought. This was not something to dwell on extensively.
His current strength was not yet formidable, nor had he secured the allegiance of the Buddhas in the Tongxuan Realm, so coveting a Heaven Imperial Realm female Great Emperor was courting death.
If that female Great Emperor were to meet him, she might squash him on the spot.
Meanwhile, Han Li also became alert, aware that he needed to be very cautious in the next few decades. It was possible that the female Great Emperor had some means to discover this matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 395: 199: Descendants with the Supreme Bone! An Unprecedented Feat, Discussing the Dao with Shi Qi!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 395: Chapter 199: Descendants with the Supreme Bone! An Unprecedented Feat, Discussing the Dao with Shi Qi!_2
Even if they don’t send the actual body to personally hunt him down, they will probably dispatch a Saint from the Holy Abyss Realm, or even a Quasi Emperor to capture and kill him. He must be wary, for getting caught would spell his own doom.
All thoughts scattered in the blink of an eye as Han Li looked at the peerless beauty in his arms, noticing her shocked face, he asked with a smile,
“Xi Xi, are you not satisfied with the name I chose for you?”
Of course, he knew Yao Xi was very satisfied.
“No, husband, Xi Xi is very satisfied, I just didn’t expect you to bestow this name on Qian’er.”
Yao Xi came back to her senses, her face full of emotion, as she wrapped her arms around Han Li, biting his lips, they intertwined for a while.
Yao Xi naturally knew the name Han Yongqian was laden with profound significance, even more so than her sister Long Yue’s child, Han Yonglong.
She had hoped her husband would choose a good name for their child, but she hadn’t quite expected this name, which made Yao Xi’s heart flutter.
After hesitating for a moment, Yao Xi weakly asked, “Husband, can Qian’er live up to this name?”
Yao Xi’s tone was worried.
A name with deep significance often comes with a great destiny. If one can bear it, they will rise, but if not, they may perish young.
The name Han Yongqian given by her husband highlighted how much he valued Han Yongqian, but with only a Third Grade aptitude at most, it seemed difficult for Han Yongqian to fulfill his father’s expectations.
If Han Yongqian failed to meet her husband’s expectations in the future, he would inevitably be disappointed—a prospect Yao Xi did not want to see.
“Xi Xi, don’t worry, since I have named Qian’er this, I naturally have my considerations,” Han Li said, taking Yao Xi’s delicate hand and biting her earlobe.
As things stand, Han Yongqian possesses the best aptitude among all his descendants, with both a First Grade aptitude and a special physique. His descendants, including Long Yue and her child Han Yonglong, pale in comparison; Han Yonglong only has a First Grade aptitude.
These descendants will receive his focused cultivation and are among the top three in his core descendants cultivation list.
As they begin their cultivation, with their aptitudes combined with treasures like the Time-Sky Tower, the Life-Prolonging Furnace, the Combat Tower, the Enlightenment Stone, the Cnagdao Hall, and others, their cultivation speed will be frighteningly fast.
For Han Yonglong and Han Yongqian, Han Li can provide even better treatment, such as longer stays in the Time-Sky Tower or early access to higher floors.
Although each floor of the Time-Sky Tower has its requirements, exceptions can be made, like when Si Qi assists Han Yonglong and Han Yongqian, minimizing the physical strain the tower places on them.
“That’s good.”
Yao Xi breathed a sigh of relief, then took Han Yongqian into her arms, carefully examining him for a while before smiling and saying,
“Husband, Qian’er looks more like you, look at this nose, these eyes, they’re almost identical to yours.”
“Hahaha~”
Han Li laughed, having noticed long ago that all his offspring were handsome or beautiful, all thanks to his excellent genes.
After spending a long time with Yao Xi, Han Li left and headed to the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Gazing at the magnificent sea of clouds in the distance, Han Li took a deep breath and opened the message notification panel.
When Han Yongqian was born, he had received several notifications, but he hadn’t looked at them at that time.
He knew Han Yongqian had a special physique, but whether it was a King’s or an Emperor’s body, or even a higher Immortal Body, Han Li wasn’t sure.
“Ding~ Your descendant has been born, you gain one year of cultivation, you gain one year of life, you obtain an Earth-Level Lower Rank Cultivation Technique, you obtain a Beauty Preserving Pill, and you obtain a Profound Rank Top Grade Martial Skill [Qingfeng Punch].”
“Ding~ Since this descendant has a First Grade aptitude, you receive an aptitude feedback, increasing your aptitude by one-tenth.”
“Ding~ Since this descendant possesses an Emperor’s body [Supreme Bones], you activate the hidden panel [Physique], you receive physique feedback, you gain 100 Physique Points.”
After reading these three system notifications, Han Li’s pupils contracted sharply and emotions surged in his heart. His descendant Han Yongqian was incredibly impressive.
Good boy, Daddy really didn’t choose the wrong name for you!
The first system notification is a reward for the birth of every descendant; it wasn’t so generous before, but after the system upgraded, the reward was enhanced.
This reward has brought Han Mansion a vast collection of Earth-Level Lower Rank Cultivation Techniques and Profound Rank Top Grade Martial Skills, enriching Han Mansion’s depth of cultivation techniques and supplementing Han Li’s understanding of the ultimate martial truth.
Since Han Yongqian is not the first descendant with a First Grade aptitude, he didn’t receive additional rewards, but the ten percent aptitude feedback satisfied Han Li.
After reaching First Grade aptitude, further improvement is very difficult. Ascending to an Immortal Grade aptitude is a distant dream, mainly because the aptitude of the descendants now born in Han Mansion is too far from his, bringing too little feedback.
With the additional ten percent, Han Li’s aptitude has now increased to 13% at the First Grade level, leaving an 87% gap to advance to the Immortal Grade aptitude.
Han Li wasn’t currently concerned about his own aptitude; he could improve it slowly over time. Right now, his mind was filled with thoughts about his physique.
His son Han Yongqian had the Emperor’s body [Supreme Bones], exceeding his expectations and being a legendary physique. This only reinforced Han Li’s secondary conjecture.
Yao Xi’s true form is very likely a powerful female emperor from the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Such a powerful female emperor would definitely have an Immortal Grade aptitude and Immortal Body; otherwise, how could a split soul or clone produce a child with a First Grade aptitude and an Emperor’s body?

chapters.title: Chapter 396: 199: Descendants with the Supreme Bone! An Unprecedented Feat, Discussing the Dao with Shi Qi!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 396: Chapter 199: Descendants with the Supreme Bone! An Unprecedented Feat, Discussing the Dao with Shi Qi!_3
In the Endless Yuankun Domain, only two formidable Heaven Imperial Realm empresses with Immortal Grade talent and Immortal Body are known to Han Li—an empress from the Huangyue Imperial Empire, and the other is Empress Yuanchu from Yuanchu Mountain.
Neither of these empresses is someone easily trifled with!
It is said that they cultivated to the Heaven Imperial Realm tens of thousands, or even a hundred thousand years ago, mastering the Heavenly Sovereign Path, achieving enlightenment, and becoming emperors. By now, they are likely to be at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, Great Emperors.
Both Yuanchu Mountain and the Huangyue Imperial Empire are among the most powerful forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, each commanding dozens of Divine Provinces, their might shaking the entire realm.
With a sigh, discarding these distracting thoughts, Han Li decided not to think about it for the time being. He would address it later, when his strength was sufficient—both the Huangyue Empress and Empress Yuanchu would have to become his ancestors’ companions.
His gaze then fell on the third system notification. With a thought, the golden characters for Supreme Bone lit up, revealing new information.
Supreme Bone: Emperor Body, every being born with a Supreme Bone is a natural supreme, unrivalled in combat ability, respected among their peers, and with extraordinarily fast cultivation speeds. If they do not perish prematurely, they can smoothly cultivate to the Heaven Imperial Realm and become emperors.
As the cultivator grows, the Supreme Bone will be nourished and will gradually give birth to divine skills unique to that cultivator, each possessing formidable might, at the very least comparable to the might of Emperor Level Top martial arts.
Depending on the cultivator’s experiences, the number of unique divine skills that the Supreme Bone can give birth to varies, with a minimum of one and a maximum of three.
“Hiss~”
After reading through the information, Han Li couldn’t help but take a deep breath of the higher level spiritual energy from the mountain peak. “This is the Emperor Body? Too domineering!” he thought.
“My son Yongqian possesses the stature of a Great Emperor!” Han Li couldn’t help but mutter to himself.
A descendant born with the Emperor Body Supreme Bones is undoubtedly a peerless genius, and he must cultivate him at all costs. He would be the future Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, the pillar of the Han Mansion.
After some reflection, Han Li opened a new panel: the Physique Panel.
This was a hidden panel activated after the birth of Han Yongqian. Perhaps it was already available after the system upgrade, but it required his own discovery.
[Physique Panel]
Physique: None
Physique Points: 100 points
Physiques Pending Activation: [King Body], [Emperor Body], [Immortal Body]…
Physique Available for Gifting: None
Physique Evolution: [Currently Inactive]
Physique Molding: [Available for Use]
…
Seeing this new system panel, Han Li pondered over it carefully, becoming increasingly excited as he understood it.
The Physique Panel was incredibly heaven-defying!
It’s just too expensive to use the Physique Points!
The hundred Physique Points he had just acquired were only enough to activate a single King Body.
There were many categories on the Physique Panel; the first showed the physiques he owned, and the second showed his Physique Points.
Opening the second category, there was detailed explanation about Physique Points. When he had a common body, for every King Body born among his descendants, he would earn 10 Physique Points; for every Emperor Body, he would earn 100 Physique Points; for every Immortal Body, he would earn 1000 Physique Points…
If he possessed a King Body, then for every King Body appearing among his descendants, he would only earn 1 Physique Point. The rewards for Emperor Body and Immortal Body and other physiques would also be reduced to one-tenth.
The third category displayed the physiques that Han Li could activate, which included countless King Bodies, Emperor Bodies, Immortal Bodies… He could click to view the specific details of each physique such as:
[King Body]: Galaxy King Body, Mysterious Yin King Body, Gemini King Body, Universal King Body…
[Emperor Body]: Supreme Bone, Cangtian Overbearing Body, Seven Calamities Immortal Body, Xuanhuang War Body…
[Immortal Body]: Nine Calamities Immortal Body, Taiyin Immortal Body, Taiyang Immortal Body, Taiqing Immortal Body…
….
To activate a King Body, the first one requires 100 points, the second 200 points, the third 300 points, and so forth.
To activate an Emperor Body, the first one needs 1000 points, the second one 2000 points… To activate an Immortal Body, the first one requires 10000 Physique Points.
After activating multiple King Bodies, Emperor Bodies, or Immortal Bodies, it’s not that one would simultaneously possess so many physiques. Instead, they would merge with each other and be gradually refined into an even stronger physique.
The fourth category showed the physiques that Han Li could gift to others. After activating a physique, he could choose not to merge it with himself and keep it stored in the fourth category, ready to gift to others when needed, to allow others to possess special physiques.
However, doing so would require an additional fee: gifting a King Body would consume an extra 30 Physique Points, an Emperor Body 300 Physique Points, and an Immortal Body 3000 Physique Points, without any increase.
Upon seeing this, Han Li felt a bit helpless.
After obtaining a physique for himself, he would have to save up Physique Points to arrange special physiques for his beloved wives and concubines. Only by doing so, could the offspring of his beloved wives and concubines have a greater chance of possessing special physiques.
The more descendants with special physiques he had, the more Physique Points he could earn, thus creating a positive feedback loop.
It’s just that this initial stage would be quite difficult, likely requiring a long time to save up, since the Physique Panel had just been activated and everything was just beginning.
Another way was to diversify more, marrying more beauties with special physiques. In this way, the number of descendants with special physiques could increase, providing him with Physique Points in return.
The fifth category displayed the physiques that Han Li could evolve. It required possessing a physique to activate.
For example, if Han Li had the Galaxy King Body, and he didn’t want to activate other Emperor Bodies but wished to continue down the Galaxy physique route, he could choose to evolve the Galaxy King Body, turning it into the Emperor Body, Immortal Body… of that physique’s lineage.
For physique evolution, compared to the consumption of Physique Points for activating Emperor Bodies or Immortal Bodies, it required even more: evolving a King Body to an Emperor Body needed 3000 Physique Points, and an Emperor Body to an Immortal Body required 30000 Physique Points—no price increase!

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - 199: Descendants with the Supreme Bone! An Unprecedented Feat, Discussing the Dao with Shi Qi!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 397: Chapter 199: Descendants with the Supreme Bone! An Unprecedented Feat, Discussing the Dao with Shi Qi!_4
The sixth option allows Han Li to sculpt his own physique, to hand-mold an exclusive constitution most suitable for himself, but this service consumes even more Physique Points.
To create an exclusive King Body requires 600 Physique Points, an exclusive Emperor Body 6000, an exclusive Immortal Body 60000…
This made Han Li shake his head; it was just too damn expensive.
To mold an exclusive constitution, one could activate three same-level physiques, which meant this option consumed twice as much compared to physique evolution, making the old ancestor Han exclaim he could not afford such expenses.
Of course, Han Li also knew the great benefits of these two functions, especially sculpting a constitution, which was tailor-made, perfectly matching one’s own Cultivation Technique, martial skills, Primordial Spirit, and flesh. It could allow one to fully unleash their strength and even bring out stronger combat ability.
Gazing deeply at the physique panel, Han Li felt hesitant. Should he activate a King Body first or save up the points to sculpt an exclusive physique?
The former would allow him to keep activating King Bodies until he could directly activate an Emperor Body or choose to evolve his physique, while the latter was considering the long-term.
Activating a physique could enhance his current combat ability, but there was also a particularly key issue: it would greatly reduce the Physique Points he obtained in the future.
After an intense internal struggle, Han Li ultimately decided not to activate any physique for the time being and to save up some points first.
By not activating a physique right away, he could quickly gain Physique Points. When the time came, he would have the flexibility to choose whether to directly exchange them for an Emperor Body or to mold an exclusive King or Emperor Body.
It’s still too early to talk about these things now; let’s wait until there’s a certain amount of Physique Points saved up.
“Hu~”
Taking a deep breath, Han Li calmed his mind and took pleasure in admiring the scenery of Chengsheng Mountain.
Although he had seen it many times over the years, the scenery of Chengsheng Mountain was always invigorating, revealing new insights with each view and soothing Han Li’s mood.
After watching the scenery for a while, Han Li suddenly thought of Ling Shiqi, the Artifact Spirit of the Time-Sky Tower, and lightly called out.
“Shiqi.”
The next instant, Ling Shiqi’s figure appeared at the summit of Chengdao Peak, standing beside Han Li.
After the Time-Sky Tower evolved from a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon to a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, Ling Shiqi’s appearance also transformed from a young girl into a ravishing woman of peerless beauty in her prime, in every aspect from her figure to her facial features.
Gazing at Ling Shiqi, a bright light flashed in Han Li’s eyes, and a certain devilish thought arose in his heart. Without speaking, he simply sized her up.
Ling Shiqi was dressed in a fiery red gown, tall and striking with a supple, undulating figure, her physique the epitome of perfection, peerless in beauty.
She possessed a full, fair forehead, an oval face, brows curved like distant mountains, and large eyes that shone bright like stars with divine luster.
Her fiery red hair cascaded down to her waist, her skin flawless, as if carved from pure white jade; her willowy waist was soft and slender, her abdomen as flat as a plain, and her legs were long and straight, swaying gracefully with each movement, captivating and enchanting.
“True to being the Artifact Spirit of a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, her figure and appearance are without flaw, even more outstanding than Yao Xi, Xue Yueqing, Long Yue, and others.”
Han Li thought to himself. He then recalled Zi Yi, the Artifact Spirit of the Void Bell. Zi Yi was still in the form of a young girl; did she need to evolve into an Immortal Artifact to mature? (She can’t grow up without maturing, and I can’t even describe it—three chapters in the front were edited, and I was warned again…)
“Master~ Did you call for Shiqi for some matter?”
Feeling the burning gaze of her master, Han Li, Ling Shiqi bashfully lowered her head and asked, nervously fiddling with the hem of her dress, her heart recalling previous conversations with Zi Yi, Yin Ling, Yue Ji, JianJi, and others.
Although Yue Ji was just the Artifact Spirit of a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, after taking human form, she appeared as a young woman in her prime. During their private chats, Yue Ji shared some of the thoughts she had felt before, which left Zi Yi, Yin Ling, JianJi, and others both shocked and somewhat expectant.
It seemed that wouldn’t be such a bad thing.
Shiqi thought the same. After her true form evolved into a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, her appearance changed drastically, turning into the stunning beauty she was now.
She often wondered if her master harboured the same thoughts as Yue Ji mentioned; would he come looking for her? When would he do so?
Given that a significant amount of time had passed since she evolved into a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon and her master still had not sought her out, she gradually discarded the thought, assuming it was a misunderstanding by Yue Ji.
After all, at that time, Yue Ji had made a certain request, but the master did not respond; otherwise, given her master’s tendencies, he would have taken Yue Ji down long ago, and she would have experienced the same.
But now, called out by her master and feeling his heated gaze, Shiqi began to believe what Yue Ji had said.
As the Artifact Spirit of a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, she could clearly sense her master’s devilish thoughts, very clearly—the kind of things he was pondering were all too known to her.
This caused Shiqi’s fair and jade-like face to gradually blush, her head hanging ever lower, yet she still occasionally stole glances at her master.
It was one thing for the master to have thoughts, but whether he would act on them was another.
She found herself hoping that he would voice it, fulfilling her wish to be the first among her group of sisters. Yet she was too shy to initiate the subject and also worried that her master might restrain his demonical thoughts.
“Shiqi, is your body real?” Han Li asked after some thought.
Looking at Ling Shiqi, shy and irresistibly enchanting, how could Han Li not understand her intentions?
But he wasn’t sure just how real Shiqi’s physical form could be.

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - 199: Descendants with the Supreme Bone! An Unprecedented Feat, Discussing the Dao with Shi Qi!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 398: Chapter 199: Descendants with the Supreme Bone! An Unprecedented Feat, Discussing the Dao with Shi Qi!_5
Made purely of energy and assuming form, it could only be observed; while an Artifact Spirit’s physical body, which had been shaped, could fulfill some of his more wicked desires.
“Master~ Shi Qi’s physical body is real, it’s just… just…”
Clinging to her skirt, Shi Qi said weakly, her voice getting lower and her cheeks redder.
When the master asked this question, it meant he really entertained this idea and was going to act on it. Shi Qi felt very happy, but…
Her physical body was built from the energy of the Time-Sky Tower, indistinguishable from the body of a real creature, capable of converting between an energy state and a real state. Whatever his beloved wives and concubines had, she had too.
If the master wished to discuss and compare the depth of mystical arts with her, she was also capable.
But she couldn’t bear children for her master.
After all, she was still an Artifact Spirit; even with a physical body, she wasn’t a real creature—she couldn’t truly be considered to have taken shape.
Only after surviving celestial tribulation would she be considered a real creature, becoming a special form of life in this world.
Having followed her master for so long, Shi Qi was naturally aware of his keen interest in having children; however, she could not bear children, and Shi Qi worried this might displease him.
After hearing Shi Qi’s explanation, Han Li immediately laughed heartily, embracing her in his arms.
“Shi Qi, are you thinking about your master wanting to do something to you?”
As he finished speaking, Han Li captured Shi Qi’s delicate red lips, tasting an Artifact Spirit for the first time.
Han Li felt he was venturing further into the realms of debauchery, no longer satisfied by fairies or Dragon Princesses. He carefully counted and realized he had inadvertently achieved many accomplishments (fill in the blank).
Soon, Han Li was about to accomplish yet another feat.
Shi Qi’s inability to bear children was of no consequence to Han Li; he never expected his Artifact Spirits to give him children. With so many beloved wives and concubines and thousands of progeny diligently spreading their branches and multiplying, he wasn’t lacking in this area.
Though Artifact Spirits couldn’t bear children, they had many other advantages, always accompanying him to discuss and contemplate mystical arts wherever he went.
Shi Qi also revealed she could enter Han Li’s Divine Sense sea and have a spiritual union with his Primordial Spirit, which would undoubtedly offer another flavor.
Thus far, Han Li had not experienced spiritual union with his wives and concubines. His Primordial Spirit was too powerful and involved some secrets; among them, only Xue Yueqing had a Primordial Spirit, but it was far too weak compared to his.
Han Li had planned to discuss the topic of spiritual union with his wives and concubines in a few years, but Shi Qi’s offer came as a surprise.
It seemed that his first spiritual union might well be with Shi Qi…
Embraced by her master, Shi Qi felt both excited and a little flustered. So this was what it felt like to be held by her master.
What would be her master’s next step?
While Shi Qi was pondering this, she heard Han Li’s words, and the next moment, found her beautiful red lips covered by her master.
In her mind, everything was in turmoil. She could only respond naively, trying to repay her master with what she had stealthily learned from watching him with his wives and concubines.
“Master can do whatever he wants to Shi Qi…”
Burying her small head deep in Han Li’s embrace, a faint blush spread from her pale neck to her ears.
At this moment, Shi Qi was extremely shy.
But to Han Li, she was like a tempting ripe apple luring him to take a bite.
“Then, Master will fulfill Shi Qi’s wish.”
With that, Han Li disappeared from the summit of Chengdao Peak, holding Shi Qi in his arms, and appeared inside the physical structure of the Time-Sky Tower.
This expansive space was free from disturbances and the perfect spot for a grand battle with Shi Qi.
It has to be said, Shi Qi, as the Artifact Spirit of a Supreme Grade imperial weapon, had a flexibility and strength far surpassing that of the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing or Dragon Princess Long Yue.
The physical body that Shi Qi manifested was even stronger than Han Li’s, at least at the level of a Quasi Emperor. To accommodate her master, Shi Qi willingly adjusted the strength of her body, degrading it to the level of the Tongxuan Realm.
The two ardently debated mystical arts inside the Time-Sky Tower. Han Li would assert himself from time to time, while Shi Qi was completely overpowered by her master’s extensive and profound knowledge of the arts, willingly accommodating and often bursting into song to praise the master.
To repay Shi Qi for guarding Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li lectured her on mystical arts until dawn, imparting countless essences of mystical arts in the process, which left Shi Qi intoxicated and unable to extricate herself.
The next morning,
The first rays of morning sunlight shone upon the world,
and Han Li’s brilliance also shone upon the Time-Sky Tower and Shi Qi.
Afterward, Han Li appeared at the summit of Chengdao Peak, supporting his back.
“So comfortable~”
Unable to help himself, Han Li muttered to himself.
This was his first truly satisfying battle, where he didn’t have to hold back. Han Li let loose to his heart’s content, sometimes even rousing his Divine Sense.
Even so, Han Li found that Shi Qi could still withstand it with ease.
Eventually, Han Li had no choice but to let Shi Qi set her body’s strength fixedly, not allowing it to increase along with his.
Glancing at the Time-Sky Tower concealed in the ninth heaven, Han Li murmured to himself, “Has the old ancestor just achieved an unprecedented feat?”
Han Li thought so. He had never heard of such a thing before, nor had he come across any records of it.
He was the founding ancestor!
He was the pioneer of the path!
“Hu~”
Exhaling, Han Li decided he could discuss mystical arts more often with Shi Qi in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 399: 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 399: Chapter 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_1
Two months later.
Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li leisurely wandered through the majestic mountains, strolling along forested paths, admiring the mountain springs, crossing countless ravines, and finally sitting cross-legged atop a towering peak.
Here, Han Li would drink the morning dew and swallow the evening spring water, watching the clouds of various shapes and forms while a serene and contented expression emerged on his face.
Atop Chengdao Peak, muffled moans echoed from time to time, like fairies in high song, or like heavenly maidens playing symphonies. The sound would resonate loudly on this quiet mountain.
“Boom~”
Han Li’s combat ability was fully unleashed; at times, he would meditate quietly, at times he would engage in a fierce battle with his enemies, driving them into caverns, or swiftly traversing the void between peaks to silently watch the mountains and listen to the spring water.
“Husband~”
When Han Li was lying on the summit of Chengdao Peak watching the sunrise, a breathtakingly beautiful figure appeared, her belly large with child.
It was none other than Xue Yueqing, the Demon Emperor.
“Why are you here, Qing’er? These past few days you shouldn’t move recklessly.”
Han Li steadied her, pulling her into his embrace and gently caressed her belly, feeling the child inside Xue Yueqing.
Xue Yueqing was about to give birth, in the next few days, and Han Li was pondering what to name their first child.
A girl could be named Han Yongxue or Han Yongqing, but what about a boy?
When Xue Yueqing was pregnant, Han Li had only a Second Grade aptitude, and she, too, was of Second Grade aptitude. Their child was likely to be Second Grade, potentially First Grade, but Third Grade aptitude and special constitutions were much less likely.
Lying in Han Li’s arms, a smile broke across Xue Yueqing’s face as she spoke softly, “My husband need not worry, Qing’er knows.”
Her cultivation seal had already been lifted, and after nearly a year of dual cultivation, her cultivation had stabilized in the fourth layer of the Divine Yuan Realm. If it were not for the great amount of vital energy consumed by her pregnancy, Xue Yueqing felt she could have advanced further.
As a Demon Emperor, her movements, no matter how vigorous, would not affect the fetus inside her, unless she encountered a life-and-death battle, suffered an injury from a higher realm enemy, or…
Xue Yueqing extended a fair and delicate hand, also caressing her abdomen gently, a soft and happy smile spreading across her face.
Although she had been on Chengsheng Mountain for less than a year, Xue Yueqing felt it was far better than Myriad Demon Mountain—whether it was the atmosphere, the cultivation environment, or anything else.
Here on Chengsheng Mountain, she had no pressure to cultivate, and she didn’t have to worry about resources or opportunities because her husband would take care of preparing everything for her.
Here, when not cultivating, she could perform dual cultivation with her husband, admire the scenery with her sisters on Chengsheng Mountain, or chat about anything and everything with Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Lu Tianxiang, and discuss past and present without any constraints.
She didn’t have to act as the aloof and arrogant Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing; she could share her feelings with others, and seek Han Li’s guidance with any doubts. Her husband would patiently unravel her confusions.
Now, her child was about to be born.
As the birth of her child approached, Xue Yueqing’s heart grew steadier and more settled, allowing her to fully enjoy her current situation.
Even though she had been captured by her husband, he treated her exceedingly well. Even she, the Demon Emperor, could find no fault in him, which was why her sisters with similar experiences were so devoted to him.
In contrast, the Myriad Demon Mountain, represented by Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang, aside from an initial uproar with the Heavenly Demon Hall’s Demon Lord Dugu Weizun, had become quiet, almost as if they had forgotten about her and Yue Ji.
Regarding this, Xue Yueqing did not want to pass any judgment—it was what it was.
Han Li nodded slightly, quietly holding Xue Yueqing, the two of them enjoying this moment of tranquility on the mountain peak, occasionally whispering sweet nothings to each other, sharing tales and laughs, without any pretense of being high and cold.
Two days later, Xue Yueqing and Han Li’s first child was born.
When Han Li went to look, surprise flashed in his eyes—this child also possessed a special physique. Although it was clearly not as extraordinary as Han Yongqian, Han Li was still satisfied; it was an unexpected joy.
While caring for and staying with Xue Yueqing, Han Li was also distractedly checking the System notifications.
“You have sired your first Second Grade aptitude offspring. Your aptitude increases by five percent. You gain one hundred and fifty years of cultivation, the Heaven Rank medium-grade martial technique ‘Soul Crushing Hand,’ and the Heaven Rank supreme-grade Cultivation Technique ‘Shocking Xuan Heart Sutra.’”
“Ding~ As your offspring possesses the royal body ‘Tianhu King’s Body,’ you gain an aptitude feedback of 10 Physique Points.”
Seeing these two System notifications, Han Li hugged Xue Yueqing tightly and kissed her twice, making her mood skyrocket.
The husband’s joy was obviously due to the birth of their first child. His emphasis made Xue Yueqing’s initially anxious heart calm down instantly.
Han Li did not explain, continuing to talk with Xue Yueqing while pondering over the two System notifications.
The birth of this child only gave Han Li a five percent aptitude feedback, which he considered not too bad. Little by little, his aptitude had now increased to First Grade eighteen percent.
For his first Second Grade aptitude offspring, he was only rewarded with one hundred and fifty years of cultivation, the Heaven Rank medium-grade martial technique ‘Soul Crushing Hand,’ and the Heaven Rank supreme-grade Cultivation Technique ‘Shocking Xuan Heart Sutra,’ all of which Han Li had anticipated and was not disappointed by.
What excited him was that Xue Yueqing had borne him an offspring with a special physique, his second one possessing such a trait, increasing his Physique Points by 10 all at once.
Han Li felt fortunate that he hadn’t activated a royal body two months before, otherwise he would have only gained 1 Physique Point now. At that rate, accumulating five hundred or a thousand points would take aeons.

chapters.title: Chapter 400: 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 400: Chapter 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_2
“My lord~”
As Han Li was secretly excited, Xue Yueqing softly called out to him, looking at him expectantly.
Han Li understood what she wanted to know, and after pondering for a while, he said, “Qing’er, I’ve decided to name him Han Yongkun. What do you think?”
Kun means compliant.
The earth’s terrain is compliant; the superior man carries the world with his virtue.
Han Li held great expectations for Han Yongkun, hoping that he would have a smooth future, keep his feet on the ground, and rise to greatness against the wind.
Xue Yueqing was slightly stunned, feeling even more touched in her heart.
Yao Xi’s first child was named Han Yongqian, a name with profound and broad implications. Naturally, Xue Yueqing also hoped her own first child would have a good name.
But Han Yongqian possessed first-grade talents, including the legendary Emperor’s Body with “Supreme Bones,” which the other members of Han Mansion might not be aware of, but their lord’s cherished wives and beautiful concubines certainly were.
Long Yue’s child was named Han Yonglong, and he also had first-grade talents. Her own child only had second-grade talents, yet her lord had named him Han Yongkun, showing her how dearly he loved her.
“Qing’er, you might not know yet, but our child has a special constitution,” he said.
“It seems he has inherited the bloodline of your Sky Fox Clan, or perhaps there is ancestral return. He possesses a powerful King’s Body, and he is bound to achieve great things in the future.”
Holding Xue Yueqing in his arms, scenting the fragrance and mother’s smell coming from his wife, Han Li felt somewhat restless.
“Really?”
Xue Yueqing’s face was full of surprise, and she was extremely excited.
She took Han Yongkun into her arms and carefully checked him to confirm what her husband had said was true.
Their Sky Fox Clan all carried the blood of the Sky Fox. The Sky Fox can rival a Heavenly Immortal in strength. When the Sky Fox blood is sufficiently concentrated, it can give rise to special constitutions like the Tianhu King’s Body and the Tianhu Emperor’s Body, with the strongest being the Immortal Body.
An Immortal Body requires incredibly rich bloodline purity, an ancestral return of at least ninety-five percent, very close to that of the Sky Fox progenitor.
However, since the ancient catastrophe, no member of the Sky Fox Clan with a particularly rich bloodline had been born in this era; there were no Sky Foxes with special constitutions.
Although Xue Yueqing had second-grade talents and had cultivated to the Divine Yuan Realm, becoming a Demon Emperor, her Sky Fox blood was not rich enough to reach the Tianhu King’s Body standard.
