Xue Yueqing originally planned to cultivate to the Tongxuan Realm, take control of Myriad Demon Mountain, and become the new Demon Lord. Then, using the resources of Myriad Demon Mountain, she hoped to purify her Sky Fox blood, which could give her a chance to develop the Tianhu King’s Body.
By then, she would have a chance to cultivate to the Shengyuan Realm, become a Saint, and be the strongest figure in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Her plan was sound, but Xue Yueqing knew that it was extremely difficult to achieve. First of all, becoming a Tongxuan Realm cultivator was already very hard, not to mention reaching the peak of Tongxuan Realm, then developing the Tianhu King’s Body, which would give her a significant chance of advancing to the Shengyuan Realm.
After the excitement, Xue Yueqing looked at her husband and hesitantly said, “My lord, when Kun’er cultivates to the Hollow Void Stage, may he go to the Demon Domain for a trial?”
Han Yongkun possessed rich Sky Fox blood. If he went to the ancestral lands of the Sky Fox Clan in the Demon Domain and received the baptism, it might not evolve him into a Tianhu Emperor’s Body, but it could certainly enhance him a lot.
“Of course, he can,”
Han Li said with a smile. Although Han Mansion could provide a superior cultivation environment, in the end, that was just a greenhouse flower. He needed much experience to grow.
Otherwise, with a serious setback, it’s easy to collapse and never recover, turning from a prodigy into a waste.
By the time Han Yongkun cultivated to the Hollow Void Stage, Han Li estimated that it would be at least ten years later. Eight years would be a polishing period; although he couldn’t cultivate, he could still slowly increase his foundation. Once he officially started cultivating at eight years old, he would experience explosive growth and improve rapidly.
To cultivate from an ordinary person to the Hollow Void Stage in two years, Han Li thought it would be somewhat challenging. However, Han Yongkun indeed had the potential to reach this goal because he had both second-grade talents and the Tianhu King’s Body.
With the assistance of treasures like the Life-Prolonging Furnace and the Time-Sky Tower, the actual cultivation time would certainly be more than two years.
…..
Chengdao Peak, Qiandao Hall.
This is Han Li’s bedroom, and he really liked such a name, as it showcased his ambition.
Han Li was admiring two treasures, one was a furnace and the other was a vial.
Both treasures were retrieved from a treasure chest. The loot of these two months had been exceptional, each item better than the last.
The furnace was called the Yuan Refining Furnace, the first treasure he got, of Divine Rank Top Grade, classed as a Shengyuan Realm Weapon. However, it was only an auxiliary weapon.
The Yuan Refining Furnace was suitable for alchemy and artifact refining with miraculous effects. Anything below the Tongxuan Realm had a one hundred percent success rate in pill or artifact crafting, with quantities of finalized pills and artifacts doubling.
Lower Grade Divine Rank pills and artifacts could improve the success rate by sixty percent, Middle Grade by forty percent, Top Grade by twenty percent, and Supreme Grade by ten percent. Emperor Level Lower Grade pills and artifacts could improve by three percent, which was the maximum achievable with Emperor Level Lower Grade.
Besides increasing success rates, the Yuan Refining Furnace could also upgrade the grade of pills and artifacts. The lower the original grade, the more significant the increase, with a maximum upgrade of three major grades and a minimum of one minor grade.
For example, a Middle Grade Divine Rank pill, when refined with the Yuan Refining Furnace, could reach Top Grade Divine Rank in efficacy, which is the highest possible.
After acquiring the Yuan Refining Furnace, Han Li used this Divine Rank Top Grade furnace as his exclusive alchemy and artifact refining furnace. He had always wanted to find a good furnace but had not found one suitable, as neither the Life-Prolonging Furnace nor the Soul-Cultivating Furnace was appropriate.
Han Ancestor is a Third Grade Pill Refining Master and a Fourth Grade Artifact Refining Master. Over the years, he had crafted countless pills and weapons for Han Mansion, creating many talismans and array plates as well. Some were for the mansion’s use, and others were sold through secret channels, becoming one of Han Mansion’s important sources of wealth.

chapters.title: Chapter 401: 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 401: Chapter 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_3
Aside from himself, Cultivation Peak was also home to a substantial number of Guest Elders skilled in the Four Arts of Cultivation, including many of Fourth and Fifth Grade, all of whom Han Li had quietly recruited.
The vial was called the Chengdao Vial, the second treasure offered by Han Li, of Emperor Level Top Grade, and it also served as an auxiliary Emperor Armament.
Although the Chengdao Vial didn’t possess much in the way of offensive or defensive power, its usefulness was indeed immense. Once one grasped it, they could mass-produce most of the pills in the world.
Simply by placing a pill inside the Chengdao Vial, the Creation Formation etched within would automatically activate, absorbing higher level spiritual energy from the depths of the void, and then produce a certain number of pills inside.
The quantity of pills the Chengdao Vial produced depended on the grade of the pill—the lower the grade, the more produced, and the higher the grade, the fewer produced.
From Ninth Grade Pills to First Grade Pills, and then Divine Rank Pills and Emperor Rank Pills, the daily output varied.
Emperor Level Middle Grade Pills were produced at one per month; Emperor Level Lower Grade Pills at one every ten days; Divine Rank Supreme Grade Pills at one per day; Divine Rank Top Grade Pills at three per day; Divine Rank Middle Grade Pills at thirty per day; Divine Rank Lower Grade Pills at sixty per day…
The maximum capacity of the Chengdao Vial was to mass-produce Emperor Level Middle Grade Pills, which Han Li found rather regrettable, as this was still within the Quasi Emperor range, while Emperor Level Top Grade reached the domain of the Great Emperor.
Nevertheless, Han Li greatly appreciated the efficacy of the Chengdao Vial. With it, Han Mansion wouldn’t have to worry about pills in the future.
For instance, various Realm Breaking Pills such as the True Martial Pill, Yuanshen Pill, Tongxuan Pill, and Immortal Cultivating Pill could be truly mass-produced by simply placing them inside the Chengdao Vial, saving the effort, materials, etc., even bypassing the need for a pill formula.
In the past, Han Li had worried about his beloved wives and concubines; with so many wives, he now had thousands of offspring, and in the future there would be even more, all of which required countless Realm Breaking Pills. The higher the grade of the Realm Breaking Pills, the more difficult they were to refine and obtain.
Han Li didn’t have many pills in his possession; currently, he only had from one to several hundred of Taoism Pills, Immortal Cultivating Pills, Tongxuan Pills, Yuanshen Pills, True Martial Pills, Void Pills, Sea Parting Pills, and so on.
Now with the Chengdao Vial, he wouldn’t have to worry about this anymore; if he ran out, he could just place a Realm Breaking Pill inside the Chengdao Vial and, after some time, he would have many.
The Taoism Pill was an Emperor Rank Top Grade Pill, which helped Great Saints break through to Quasi Emperor. It could not be mass-produced, and Han Li only had one.
However, Han Li could now start mass-producing pills like the Immortal Cultivating Pill, Tongxuan Pill, True Martial Pill, and Void Pill. It was better to be prepared, otherwise, if he ran out of stock, he would feel anxious.
Apart from the Myriad Phenomena Pill, Han Li only lacked the Realm Breaking Pills for each stage. And yet, in the near future, a large number of his beloved wives and concubines would be advancing towards the Myriad Phenomena Realm, giving Han Li a sense of urgency.
Beyond the Realm Breaking Pill, Han Li could also use the Chengdao Vial to mass-produce pills for enhancing cultivation level, extending lifespan, and improving aptitude, among others.
After obtaining the Chengdao Vial, Han Li had put a Rebirth Pill into it. As a Fourth Grade Pill, the Chengdao Vial could produce a thousand of them every day, which was countless times faster than slowly cultivating spiritual medicine and then refining it.
The daily output of Rebirth Pills from the Chengdao Vial could satisfy the entire needs of Han Mansion, which was quite astounding.
Han Li knew why this was the case.
Previously, the Rebirth Pill was very precious to Han Mansion, as it could help cultivators elevate their aptitude to Fifth Grade. A Fifth Grade aptitude offered a not insignificant chance of advancing to Guru in the Hollow Void Stage.
But now, the Hollow Void Stage meant almost nothing to Han Mansion, as the Mansion had grown too quickly. Its foundation now rivaled the great Sacred Lands, and the Chengdao Vial was a true Emperor Armament.
For Sacred Lands, Rebirth Pills, and Hollow Realm Masters weren’t a big deal, but for Han Mansion, they were still quite important, as the middle-level foundation of the Mansion was lacking.
“Huh~”
Exhaling deeply, Han Li stowed away the Chengdao Vial and Yuan Refining Furnace, then, after a moment’s thought, he summoned Yue Ji.
“Master~ May I ask why the master has summoned Yue Ji?”
Yue Ji was enchantingly charming, like a lotus flower rising out of water, akin to a spirit of the moon, shyly and timidly asking.
She lowered her gaze, stealing glances at Han Li with her peripheral vision, her heart fluttering with excitement. She hoped the master had summoned her for that particular matter.
Her sister Shi Qi had been favored by the master two months ago, and she hadn’t received her own answer yet. It was frustrating for Yue Ji, especially since the master had first entertained these thoughts about her.
Today, had the master called her over to do what Shi Qi had done?
Yue Ji had asked both Xue Yueqing and Shi Qi, but neither of them would share their experience with her, telling her to discover it for herself.
Looking at Yue Ji, who stood gracefully like a fairy of the moon within the Qiandao Hall, Han Li smiled and said, “Yue Ji, didn’t you want to learn from Qing’er? I’ve agreed.”
“Ah?”
Yue Ji suddenly lifted her head and swiftly lowered it again, her cheeks blushing instantly.
The master was being too direct.
But inside, Yue Ji was overjoyed. It was finally her turn. She was the second artifact spirit among the master’s many to be so intimately favored.
Han Li reached out with his large hand, drawing Yue Ji into his embrace, and said with a light smile, “Yue Ji, your physical body is real, right?”
As he spoke, Han Li already felt the answer. It was similar to the feeling of embracing his other beloved wives and concubines; indeed it was real, suitable for discussing the Dao.
“Mhm~”
Yue Ji buried her head into Han Li’s chest, responding with a voice as faint as a mosquito.
Surprised by the sudden happiness, and the master’s straightforwardness, Yue Ji was somewhat at a loss, bewildered.
Just as Yue Ji felt bewildered, she discovered her head being lifted, and then a pair of heavy lips pressed against hers. She was startled for a moment and then naively responded.

chapters.title: Chapter 402: 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 402: Chapter 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_4
“`
“Is this what kissing Master feels like? It’s so comfortable~” Yue Ji thought silently to herself.
But before Yue Ji had time to ponder further, she found herself scooped up around the waist by her Master, and their figure disappeared from Qiandao Hall.
The next moment, the two arrived inside the Time-Sky Tower and began discussing the Dao, as melodious singing resounded within the Time-Sky Tower, the jubilant music of the great Dao.
Shi Qi merely glanced once before she frantically ran away, escaping to the small world inside the Void Bell, whispering secretly with JianJi, Zi Yi, Yin Ling, and other Artifact Spirits.
Several days later,
Han Li arrived at The Li Manor, overlooking the Da Qian Capital City from atop the Chong Xiao Pavilion with Qiu Shuhui.
Cozying up affectionately and rubbing ears and temples together, Han Li lay back in the chair while Qiu Shuhui massaged him.
“Husband~ should I press harder?”
“Husband~ do you want it faster?”
“Husband~ shall we change the spot?”
As Qiu Shuhui massaged Han Li, her words flowed like a stream of lotus flowers, her eloquent tongue making Han Li feel blissful.
Han Li looked down at Qiu Shuhui, kneeling before him, his hand caressing her pretty face, very satisfied with her demeanor.
Unlike many delicate wives and beautiful concubines in The Li Manor, Qiu Shuhui knew how to put aside her pride and please her Dao partner without shame.
After Qiu Shuhui’s efforts, seeing her husband relaxed, a smile also appeared on her face.
Living in The Li Manor was truly joyful. Having a backer really made a difference; she faced no pressure whatsoever, and dual cultivating with her husband even rapidly improved her cultivation.
On her very first day with him, Han Li had given her a True Martial Pill, and now her cultivation had progressed further, breaking through a minor boundary. In a few more years, at most within a decade, she would be able to break through to the True Martial Realm.
If her husband decided to merge Han Mansion with The Li Manor earlier, she felt that her breakthrough time to the True Martial Realm would be shortened once again. She had overheard her husband mention that Han Mansion had far more resources than The Li Manor.
A few months after marrying into The Li Manor, her belly had also grown larger. In a few more months, she would be able to bear a child for her husband, which would secure her status even more.
Her husband had many delicate wives and beautiful concubines in The Li Manor, and although they were generally united without much strife, their statuses were different.
The status of her husband’s wives and concubines came from two aspects: one was their own talent and cultivation, and the other was the aptitude of their offspring.
She had just arrived at The Li Manor and did not yet have offspring. Her husband’s other delicate wives had already had several children, securing their status. Although her cultivation was higher, she still had to address them as sisters when she saw them.
After staying in The Li Manor for some time, Han Li returned to Han Mansion.
Having spent time with Xue Yueqing, Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Lu Tianxiang, among other delicate wives and beautiful concubines, Han Li sought out Yao Xi.
When he arrived at Yao Xi’s bedroom, he was surprised to find his beloved wife still cultivating. When had Yao Xi become so diligent?
“Xi Xi.”
“Husband~”
Seeing her husband arrive, Yao Xi stopped her cultivation, her pale and stunningly beautiful face blushing faintly, her secret effort in cultivation unexpectedly uncovered by her husband.
“Why has Xi Xi become so diligent?” Han Li asked with a smile, embracing Yao Xi.
Biting her beautiful red lips, Yao Xi earnestly replied, “I want to become stronger.”
If her realm increased, she would enjoy discussing the Dao even more happily with her husband. With great strength, she could accompany her husband for longer.
She wanted to be like Shi Qi, who could be with her husband at any time. If her cultivation were high enough, her husband would certainly take her with him when he went out.
“Then Xi Xi will have to continue to work hard.”
Stroking Yao Xi’s smooth hair, Han Li smiled and encouraged her.
At the first glance, he saw through Yao Xi’s cultivation progress, which was impressively swift. She had reached the Hollow Void Stage already.
Before giving birth, Yao Xi was merely at the Gang Yuan Realm. In just two or three months, she had broken through to the Hollow Void Stage, truly befitting a piece of the powerful Heaven Imperial Realm empress from the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Han Li had also provided a lot of support. For instance, Yao Xi had undergone several purifications through the Life-Prolonging Furnace, improving her aptitude to Second Grade. To reach Top Grade, there was still some time needed.
In these two to three months, Yao Xi also frequented the Time-Sky Tower for cultivation. After its evolution, Han Li had redefined the access levels. As someone like Yao Xi, who was Han Li’s Dao companion, had very high permissions, she was able to stay in the Time-Sky Tower for long periods and enter higher levels with the protection of the tower.
However, his delicate wives and beautiful concubines rarely stayed in the Time-Sky Tower for extended periods. Han Li had noticed that they wouldn’t stay for more than ten days at most before coming out, either to dual cultivate with him, play with other sisters, or guide their offspring.
“Mhm~”
Yao Xi nodded vigorously, her eyes filled with anticipation.
Upon seeing this, Han Li sighed inwardly, still unsure how to deal with the Divine Spirit seal of Yao Xi.
Lately, he had felt some inexplicable pressure, which, upon analysis, Han Li found might come from Yao Xi, more precisely, from her identity.
Ever since he had captured the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing to become his Dao partner, Han Li had inquired about various matters. Xue Yueqing, as the Demon Emperor of the Demon Clan, and former handler of affairs for Myriad Demon Mountain, knew many secrets.
Han Li particularly sought to understand the situation outside Qianyuan Divine Province, to learn about the Endless Yuankun Domain. He had basically grasped the situations within the Sacred Lands of Qianyuan Divine Province.
Xue Yueqing shared many things that could be told, allowing Han Li to finally have a basic understanding of the Endless Yuankun Domain and the awkward predicament of Qianyuan Divine Province.
Fortunately, the strongest forces of the Endless Yuankun Domain like Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, White Emperor City, Heavenly Cult, and so on, disdained the Qianyuan Divine Province, which was too far away and engaged in mutual checks and balances.

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 403: Chapter 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_5
“`
The thirty-six states surrounding Qianyuan Divine Province had not seen the emergence of a Heaven Imperial Realm power; the highest were merely Quasi Emperor rank powers, and most of the forces that could hold their own on the stage were those of the Saint Abyss Realm.
Although these Saint Abyss Realm and Quasi Emperor rank powers coveted the heritage of Qianyuan Divine Province, they did not dare to set foot in it, for any who did were courting death, no matter their number.
Each Sacred Land in Qianyuan Divine Province possessed heavenly weapons, and even if they could only be revived once, that was not something other powers could covet, as a single revival could annihilate all invaders, be they Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm or Quasi Emperors.
Of course, unless there were special circumstances, the Sacred Lands of Qianyuan Divine Province also dared not casually revive heavenly weapons to slaughter the Saints and Quasi Emperors of the surrounding Thirty-six Divine Provinces, for this would invite great trouble.
Although the Thirty-six Divine Provinces are currently coveting Qianyuan Divine Province, they also act as a natural barrier for it, deterring other powers with ulterior motives.
It was then that Han Li learned that there were nine supremely powerful forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, such as the Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, White Emperor City, and so on.
The supreme rulers of these powerful forces were peak Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors with unmatched combat abilities, ranking on the Supreme Honor List of the Endless Yuankun Domain.
The Supreme Honor List was a ranking list released by the Tianji Pavilion, which held high authority. The Tianji Pavilion itself was also one of the nine supremely powerful forces, with unfathomable depth.
The Tianji Pavilion is a neutral power, and its branches are spread across the Eight Hundred Divine Regions. Strong Divine Provinces have Saint Abyss Realm Saints in charge, while ordinary Divine Provinces like Qianyuan Divine Province, according to Xue Yueqing, only have a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse managing the Tianji Pavilion.
There are a total of ten places on the Supreme Honor List, and individuals like Empress Yuanchu, Empress Huangyue, and the White Emperor are among them. They are Great Emperors and the supreme beings of the Endless Yuankun Domain, pressuring the Eight Hundred Divine Provinces.
Beyond the nine supremely powerful forces, there are thirty-three Emperor Level forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, and the leader of each force is a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, though their strength pales in comparison to that of Empress Huangyue, Empress Yuanchu, and the like.
Forces as powerful as the Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain not only have a peak Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor as the head of the power, but also have other Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors within the force, making their strength far greater than ordinary Emperor Level forces.
Among the thirty-three Emperor Level forces, there are only seven female Emperors in the Heaven Imperial Realm, and Han Li did not believe that Yao Xi was an avatar or reincarnation of these seven female Emperors. Given their strength, they should not be able to create avatars or reincarnations that also possess an imperial body.
Therefore, Han Li had previously deduced that Yao Xi’s true form was likely one of the two strongest female Emperors in the Endless Yuankun Domain: Empress Huangyue or Empress Yuanchu!
Therefore, Han Li felt a headache coming on.
Whether Yao Xi’s true form was one of the seven ordinary female Emperors or Empress Huangyue or Empress Yuanchu, none were entities he could contend with at the moment.
Even if it were one of the seven ordinary female Emperors, they still wielded heavenly weapons, and with their strength, they could easily revive part of the weapons’ divine power, paying a small price to fully restore them.
Although he possessed the Time-Sky Tower and Void Bell, he was still far from being a match for them, even if he acquired heavenly weapons, it would not change the situation.
Unless he obtained an Immortal Dragon Vein that could supply the energy needed for the revival of heavenly weapons, otherwise the heavenly weapons could only be fully awakened once and not be used lightly.
Han Li felt that his sense of pressure lately might be due to the female Emperors sending people this way, searching for Yao Xi, or perhaps even looking for him.
An envoy of the female Emperor, at least a Saint Abyss Realm Saint or possibly a Quasi Emperor, possibly carrying divine weapons, posed a significant threat to Han Li.
Although he could contest them, how exactly to do so was a big issue.
If he wasn’t careful and caused too much commotion, he might not be able to hide in Qianyuan Divine Province any longer, and those female Emperors themselves might come seeking retribution.
“Sigh, when can this old ancestor ever possess a heavenly weapon?” Han Li sighed.
With a heavenly weapon, although he couldn’t contend with those female Emperors, there was a good chance that he could quietly deal with the envoys of the female Emperors, and continue to buy time for him to grow and develop further.
But obtaining a heavenly weapon was too difficult, even with the system, he felt it was a challenge.
At present, to obtain a heavenly weapon, relying on rewards from having offspring was insufficient, far from enough; it would probably take tens of thousands of descendants to achieve.
Only by opening treasure boxes could he possibly obtain heavenly weapons.
But to open a treasure box containing heavenly weapons, he first needed to raise his cultivation to the Tongxuan Realm; otherwise, the best he could open were Supreme Grade imperial weapons.
Han Li was currently at the Fifth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, and to make a leap to the Tongxuan Realm and become a powerhouse, he still needed 4,800 years of cultivation.
This was a staggeringly large number, giving Han Li a particular headache.
His current accumulated years of cultivation were far from enough, so he could only continue to wait, wait for the number of offspring to reach four thousand, wait for two thousand talented offspring, wait for the cultivation feedback from his descendants…
“Hoo~”
Letting out a breath, Han Li opened the offspring panel and took a glance at the number of descendants, his eyes suddenly lighting up.
It had been a long time since he last checked, and the number of offspring had increased beyond his expectations, nearing four thousand.
Even the number of offspring with high aptitude had surged by several hundred, and it wasn’t far from reaching two thousand.
PS: A bit short, will make up for it tomorrow, and also cover the previously owed three thousand words.

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 404: Chapter 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_1
Two months later.
Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li walked slowly among the lofty mountain ranges, observing the shady pathways, admiring the mountain springs, crossing thousands of ravines, and finally arrived at the towering peak where he sat down cross-legged.
Here, he drank the morning dew and the evening spring, enjoying the clouds in various shapes, a contented expression appearing on his face.
Atop Chengdao Peak, groans echoed from time to time, like a heavenly maiden singing or a fairy playing music, resounding clear and loud on this quiet mountain.
“Boom~”
Han Li’s combat ability was fully unleashed; at times he quietly stroked, at times he fought to the death with his foes, beating them into mountain caves, and sometimes he crossed the void, moving swiftly between peaks, calmly observing the high mountains and listening to the clear springs.
“Husband~”
When Han Li lay on the summit of Chengdao Peak watching the sunrise, a stunning figure appeared, with a large belly.
It was none other than the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
“Why have you come here, Qing’er? You should not move about carelessly these past few days.”
Han Li supported her, drawing her into his arms and gently stroking her belly, feeling the child inside Xue Yueqing.
Xue Yueqing was about to give birth to her child, within these few days, and Han Li was pondering what to name their first child.
If it was a girl, the name could be Han Yongxue or Han Yongqing. But what if it was a boy?
When Xue Yueqing was pregnant, Han Li still had only Second Grade aptitude, and Xue Yueqing also had Second Grade aptitude, so the child was very likely to be of Second Grade as well, or possibly First Grade. As for Third Grade and a special physique, the chances were significantly lower.
Snuggling in Han Li’s embrace, Xue Yueqing showed a smile on her face and spoke gently, “Do not worry, husband. I am aware of it.”
Her cultivation had been unsealed long ago. After nearly a year of dual cultivation, her cultivation had stabilized at the fourth layer of the Divine Yuan Realm. If not for the pregnancy consuming a great deal of her vital energy, she felt she could have made a small advance.
Even as a Demon Emperor, her movements wouldn’t affect the fetus inside her, unless she encountered a life-and-death battle, was injured by a higher realm enemy, or unless…
Xue Yueqing extended a snow-white, delicate hand, too gently stroking her belly, a faintly content smile on her face.
Although she had been on Chengsheng Mountain for less than a year, Xue Yueqing felt it was much better than Myriad Demon Mountain, whether in terms of atmosphere, the environment for cultivation, or other aspects.
On Chengsheng Mountain, she was free from the pressure of cultivation and did not need to worry about resources and opportunities; her husband would arrange everything for her.
Here, when not cultivating, she could dual cultivate with her husband, admire the scenery of Chengsheng Mountain with some sisters, or have heart-to-heart talks with Bai Keqing, Long Yue, and Lu Tianxiang, discussing the past and present without any constraints.
She didn’t need to maintain the solitary and aloof demeanor of the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing and could confide in others; for any doubts, she could seek answers from Han Li, who would patiently clarify them.
Now, her child was about to be born.
As the birth of the child approached, Xue Yueqing’s heart became steadier, completely at peace, enjoying the current situation.
Even though she had been captured by her husband, he treated her extremely well. Even she, the Demon Emperor, couldn’t find any faults, which is why her sisters with similar experiences remained utterly loyal to their husband.
In contrast, on Myriad Demon Mountain, the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang, after initially creating havoc with the Demon Lord Dugu Weizun from Heavenly Demon Hall, made no further moves and seemed to have forgotten her and Yue Ji.
As for this, Xue Yueqing didn’t want to judge any further. Let it be.
Han Li nodded slightly, quietly holding Xue Yueqing in his arms, both enjoying this serene moment on the mountain peak, occasionally exchanging affectionate caresses and whispers; Han Li would tell some amusing stories, and Xue Yueqing didn’t pretend to be aloof, often covering her mouth with a light laugh.
Two days later, the first child of Xue Yueqing and Han Li was born.
When Han Li went inside to see the child, surprise flashed in his eyes—the child actually had a special physique, and while not quite as outstanding as Han Yongqian, Han Li was still satisfied, as this was an unexpected delight.
While taking care of and accompanying Xue Yueqing, Han Li was also distractedly checking the System prompts.
“You have a descendant with Second Grade aptitude, your aptitude is increased by five percent, you gain one hundred and fifty years of cultivation, you receive a Heaven Rank mid-grade martial skill [Soul Crush Hand], you receive a Heaven Rank Supreme cultivation technique [Shocking Profound Heart Sutra].”
“Ding~ Since the descendant possesses a royal body [Tianhu King’s Body], you receive aptitude feedback, gaining 10 Physique Points.”
Seeing these two System prompts, Han Li hugged Xue Yueqing tightly and kissed her fiercely twice, leaving her in an elated mood.
Surely her husband was so happy because their first child was born. His importance to the child instantly calmed Xue Yueqing’s previously anxious heart.
Han Li did not explain; he conversed with Xue Yueqing while looking at the two System prompts.
The birth of this child had granted Han Li a 5% aptitude feedback, and he deemed it not bad at all. Little by little, his current aptitude had improved to First Grade 18%.
The first Second Grade aptitude descendant only awarded him an additional 150 years of cultivation, and both the Heaven Rank mid-grade martial skill [Soul Crush Hand] and the Heaven Rank Supreme cultivation technique [Shocking Profound Heart Sutra] were within his expectations, not disappointing.
But what truly excited him was that Xue Yueqing had given birth to a descendant with a special physique. This was his second descendant with such a trait, boosting his Physique Points by 10 all at once.
Han Li was secretly relieved that two months prior, he hadn’t activated a royal body, for otherwise he would have only gained 1 Physique Point. At that accumulation rate, reaching five hundred or a thousand would take an eternity.

chapters.title: Chapter 405: 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 405: Chapter 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_2
“Husband~”
While Han Li was internally excited, Xue Yueqing softly called out, looking at him with anticipation.
Han Li understood what she wanted to know. After pondering for a moment, he said, “Qinger, I have decided to name him Han Yongkun, what do you think?”
Kun, meaning compliance.
The earth’s attribute is Kun, and a gentleman carries great virtue.
Han Li held great hopes for Han Yongkun, wishing his future would be smooth sailing, down-to-earth, and soaring against the wind.
Xue Yueqing was slightly stunned and felt even more touched inside.
Yao Xi’s first child was named Han Yongqian, which held profound and broad meaning; naturally, Xue Yueqing also hoped for a good name for her own first child.
But Han Yongqian possessed First Grade aptitude, and was the legendary emperor’s body with “Supreme Bones.” The others at Han Mansion didn’t know, but their husbands’ cherished wives and beautiful concubines were aware.
Long Yue’s child was named Han Yonglong, who also had First Grade aptitude. Her child only had Second Grade aptitude, yet her husband named him Han Yongkun—how dearly loved she must be.
“Qinger, you might not know yet, our child possesses a special physique.”
“It should be an inheritance of the bloodline from your Sky Fox Clan. It might even be a regression to an ancient form. He has a powerful king’s body, and he will surely achieve great things in the future.”
Holding Xue Yueqing close, sniffing the faint scent and milk fragrance coming from his beloved wife, Han Li felt somewhat restless.
“Really?”
Xue Yueqing’s face lit up with surprise, and she was extremely excited.
She took Han Yongkun in her arms and carefully examined him, confirming that what her husband said was true.
Members of the Sky Fox Clan all carry the bloodline of the Sky Fox, a being comparable to Heavenly Immortals, strong and mighty. When the Sky Fox bloodline is rich enough, it can give birth to special physiques, such as the Tianhu King’s Body and the Tianhu Emperor’s Body, with the strongest being the Immortal Body of the Sky Fox.
To acquire the Immortal Body of the Sky Fox requires an incredibly rich bloodline, with at least a 95% regression to the ancient form, extremely close to the Sky Fox progenitors.
However, after the great catastrophe of ancient times, in this era, no member of the Sky Fox Clan with a particularly rich bloodline had been born yet, and none have possessed a special physique.
Although Xue Yueqing had Second Grade aptitude and had cultivated to the Divine Yuan Realm, becoming a Demon Emperor, her Sky Fox bloodline was not strong enough to reach the standard of the Tianhu King’s Body.
Xue Yueqing originally planned to cultivate to the Tongxuan Realm, take control of Myriad Demon Mountain to become the new Demon Lord, and use the resources of Myriad Demon Mountain to purify her Sky Fox bloodline. That way, there was a chance to refine the Tianhu King’s Body.
At that time, she would hope to cultivate to the Shengyuan Realm, become a Saint, and be the strongest being in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Her plan was well thought out, but Xue Yueqing knew it would be extremely difficult to achieve. Firstly, reaching the Tongxuan Realm was tough enough, let alone cultivating to the peak of Tongxuan Realm and then refining the Tianhu King’s Body, which would give her a fair chance to advance to the Shengyuan Realm.
After the excitement had subsided, Xue Yueqing looked at her husband and hesitated before saying, “Husband, when Kun’er cultivates to the Hollow Void Stage, could he go to the Demon Domain for some experience?”
Han Yongkun carried a strong bloodline of the Sky Fox, and if he went to the ancestral land of the Sky Fox Clan in the Demon Domain to receive the baptism, it would not turn him into the Tianhu Emperor’s Body, but it would greatly enhance him.
“Of course he can.”
Han Li said with a smile; although Han Mansion could provide a superior cultivation environment, in the end, it was like flowers in a greenhouse—they needed to be tempered in order to grow.
Otherwise, when they faced a major setback, they could easily become discouraged and transform from a genius to a failure.
By the time Han Yongkun cultivated to the Hollow Void Stage, Han Li estimated it would be at least ten years later. Eight years were a polishing period where, although he could not cultivate, he could still slowly strengthen his foundation. When he began formal cultivation at the age of eight, he would break out and rapidly progress.
Two years for a mortal to cultivate to the Hollow Void Stage was difficult, Han Li felt, but Han Yongkun indeed had the potential to reach this goal, given that he had Second Grade aptitude and Tianhu King’s Body.
With the aid of treasures like the Life-Prolonging Furnace and the Time-Sky Tower, the actual cultivation time was bound to be more than two years.
…..
Chengdao Peak, Qiandao Hall.
This was Han Li’s sleeping chamber, and he quite liked this naming convention, showcasing his ambition.
Han Li was admiring two treasures; one was a furnace, and the other was a vial.
Both of these treasures were opened from the treasure chest, and the items from the past two months have been impressive, each one better than the last.
The furnace was called the Yuan Refining Furnace, the first treasure opened, of Divine Rank Top Grade, belonging to Shengyuan Realm Weaponry. However, it was also just an auxiliary weapon.
The Yuan Refining Furnace was suitable for both alchemy and artifact refining, with incredibly miraculous effects. Under the Tongxuan Realm, the success rate of pill and artifact creation was 100%, and the yield of pills and artifacts would double.
For Divine Rank Lower Grade pills and artifacts, it could increase the success rate by 60%, 40% for Divine Rank Mid Grade, 20% for Divine Rank Top Grade, 10% for Divine Rank Supreme Grade, and 3% for Emperor Level Lower Grade pills and artifacts, up to Emperor Level Lower Grade pills and artifacts at most.
Besides increasing the success rate, the Yuan Refining Furnace could also enhance the grade of pills and artifacts. The lower the grade, the more significant the enhancement, with a maximum improvement of three major grades and a minimum of one minor grade.
For example, a Divine Rank Mid Grade pill produced using the Yuan Refining Furnace could achieve effects of Divine Rank Top Grade, which was the highest possible.
After acquiring the Yuan Refining Furnace, Han Li made this Divine Rank Top Grade furnace his exclusive alchemy and artifact refining furnace. He had always wanted a good furnace, but hadn’t found one; the Life-Prolonging Furnace and Soul-Cultivating Furnace were not suitable.
Grand Elder Han was both a Third Grade Pill Refining Master and a Fourth Grade Artifact Refining Master. Over the years, he had crafted countless pills and weapons for Han Mansion, as well as many talismans and array plates. Some were used by Han Mansion itself, while others were sold through secret channels, becoming an important source of wealth for the Han Mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 406: 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 406: Chapter 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_3
Apart from himself, there were a large number of Guest Elders proficient in the Four Arts of Cultivation on Cultivation Peak, many of whom were Fourth and Fifth Grade, all secretly recruited by Han Li.
The bottle was named Chengdao Vial, the second treasured artifact offered by Han Li, an Emperor Level Top Grade, and it was also an auxiliary Emperor Weapon.
Although the Chengdao Vial didn’t possess much offensive or defensive might, its utility was indeed immense. If one mastered it, they could mass-produce most of the pills in the world.
As long as a pill was placed inside the Chengdao Vial, the Creation Formation etched within would automatically activate, absorbing higher-level spiritual energy from the deep void, and then produce a certain number of pills inside.
The number of pills produced by the Chengdao Vial depended on the grade of the pill, the lower the grade, the more produced, and the higher the grade, the less produced.
From Ninth Grade Pills to First Grade Pills, then Divine Rank Pills and Emperor Rank Pills, the daily output varied.
For Emperor Rank mid-grade pills, one was produced every month; for Emperor Rank Lower Grade pills, one every ten days; for Divine Rank Supreme Grade pills, one each day; for Divine Rank Top Grade pills, three each day; for Divine Rank mid-grade pills, thirty each day; for Divine Rank Lower Grade pills, sixty each day…
The Chengdao Vial could only mass-produce up to Emperor Rank mid-grade pills, which was a matter of regret for Han Li. Emperor Rank mid-grade was still within the Quasi Emperor range, while only the Emperor Rank Top Grade reached the Great Emperor realm.
However, Han Li greatly admired the effect of the Chengdao Vial; with it, the Han Mansion wouldn’t have to worry about pills in the future.
For various Realm Breaking Pills, such as the True Martial Pill, Yuanshen Pill, Tongxuan Pill, Immortal Cultivating Pill, and so on, one simply had to put them into the Chengdao Vial to achieve true mass production, without expending energy, materials, etc., even sparing the need for a Pill Formula.
In the past, Han Li worried about his beloved wives and concubines; with numerous descendants now totaling in the thousands, and more to come in the future, they would require countless Realm Breaking Pills. The higher the grade of Realm Breaking Pills, the harder they were to refine and to obtain.
Han Li didn’t have many on hand. At present, he only had Taoism Pills, Immortal Cultivating Pills, Tongxuan Pills, Yuanshen Pills, True Martial Pills, Void Pills, Sea Splitting Pills, and so on, ranging from one to a few hundred.
Now that he had the Chengdao Vial, he no longer had to worry about this aspect. If they were short, he just needed to place a Realm Breaking Pill into the Chengdao Vial, and after a while, he would have plenty.
The Taoism Pill was an Emperor Rank Top Grade Pill, used to help Great Saints break through to Quasi Emperor, and couldn’t be mass-produced. Han Li only had one.
But the Immortal Cultivating Pill, Tongxuan Pill, True Martial Pill, Void Pill and such, he could start mass-producing as a precaution. Otherwise, without stock on hand, his mind would be uneasy.
Of all the Realm Breaking Pills for various stages, Han Li only lacked the Myriad Phenomena Pill, and unfortunately, in the near future, his beloved wives and concubines would be advancing towards the Myriad Phenomena Realm in large numbers, giving Han Li a sense of urgency.
Apart from Realm Breaking Pills, Han Li could also use the Chengdao Vial to mass-produce pills for enhancing cultivation, extending life, improving aptitude, and more.
After obtaining the Chengdao Vial, Han Li put a Rebirth Pill into it. The Rebirth Pill was a Fourth Grade Pill, which the Chengdao Vial could produce a thousand of a day, incomparably faster than slowly cultivating Spiritual Medicine and then refining it himself.
The output of Rebirth Pills from the Chengdao Vial for just a few days could meet the entire Han Mansion’s needs, which was extremely impressive.
Han Li knew why it was so.
The Rebirth Pill used to be very precious for the Han Mansion, capable of helping a Cultivator elevate their aptitude to Fifth Grade. With Fifth Grade aptitude, there was a good chance of cultivating to the level of a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage.
But the Hollow Void Stage was nothing in today’s Han Mansion. The Han Mansion had grown too quickly, its foundation now on par with the Sacred Lands, and the Chengdao Vial was indeed an Emperor Weapon.
For the Sacred Lands, the Rebirth Pill and Hollow Realm Masters were nothing, but they were still quite important to the Han Mansion, which lacked middle management.
“Huh,”
Exhaling a breath, Han Li put away the Chengdao Vial and the Yuan Refining Furnace and called over Yue Ji after some thought.
“Master~ What matter brings Yue Ji to your presence?”
Yue Ji appeared with a loveliness that put the blossoming lotus to shame and looked like a sprite from the moon, timidly asking with bashfulness.
She bowed her head slightly, sneakily sizing up Han Li with her peripheral vision, her heart racing. She hoped that the master had summoned her for that reason.
Her sister Shi Qi had been favored by the master two months before, and she had yet to receive an answer. It was the master who first had that kind of interest in her, which caused Yue Ji some distress.
Did the master summon her today to do the kind of thing he did with Shi Qi?
Yue Ji had asked both Xue Yueqing and Shi Qi, but neither woman told her the taste of it, letting her have the opportunity to experience it for herself.
Looking at Yue Ji standing gracefully like a fairy from within the moon in the Qiandao Hall, Han Li smiled and said, “Yue Ji, didn’t you want to learn from Qing’er? I’ve agreed.”
“Ah?”
Yue Ji quickly looked up, then swiftly lowered her head, her cheeks turning instantly crimson.
The master was too direct.
But Yue Ji’s heart was filled with joy, her turn had finally come; she was the second Artifact Spirit among all the master’s to be graced with favor.
Han Li extended his hand and pulled Yue Ji into his embrace, smiling lightly, “Yue Ji, your physical body is real as well, isn’t it?”
As he spoke, Han Li had already felt the answer, similar to embracing any of his other beloved wives and concubines. Indeed, it was real, suitable for discussing the Dao.
“Hmm~”
Yue Ji buried her head into Han Li’s chest, responding in a whisper.
Happiness arrived so unexpectedly, and the master was so forthright, leaving Yue Ji somewhat at a loss, a bit bewildered.
Just as Yue Ji felt bewildered, she found her head being raised, followed by the master’s lips pressing against hers. Yue Ji was startled, then responded with green tenderness.

chapters.title: Chapter 407: 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 407: Chapter 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_4
“Is this what it feels like to be intimate with Master? So comfortable~” Yue Ji thought silently to herself.
Before Yue Ji had more time to think, she found herself lifted by the waist as Master’s figure disappeared from Qiandao Hall.
In the next moment, the two of them were inside the Time-Sky Tower, beginning their discussion on the Dao. Chants of high songs filled the tower, a melody of the Dao’s joyful sound.
Shi Qi merely glanced once before frantically running away, escaping into the small universe inside the Void Bell, whispering secrets with JianJi, Zi Yi, Yin Ling, and other Artifact Spirits.
Several days later,
Han Li arrived at The Li Manor and looked over Da Qian Capital City with Qiu Shuhui from the Chong Xiao Pavilion.
The couple were intimate and affectionate, and after some tender whispers, Han Li lay back in his chair as Qiu Shuhui massaged him.
“Husband~ do you need more strength?”
“Husband~ would you like me to go faster?”
“Husband~ would you like to change the place?”
As Qiu Shuhui massaged Han Li, her words were as delicate as a blooming lotus, eloquent and pleasing, making Han Li feel like his heart was blooming with flowers.
Han Li looked at Qiu Shuhui kneeling before him, his large hand caressing her pretty face, very satisfied with her attitude.
Qiu Shuhui was different from the many charming wives and beautiful concubines in The Li Manor, she knew to drop her reserve and to please her Dao companion without shame.
After her actions brought comfort to her husband, a smile graced Qiu Shuhui’s face.
Life in The Li Manor was truly blissful. Having strong support was indeed different; she had no pressures and could quickly improve her cultivation with dual cultivation with her husband.
On the first day she arrived, her husband gave her a True Martial Pill, and now her cultivation had advanced further, breaking through a minor realm. In a few more years, at most within ten years, she would be able to break through to the True Martial Realm.
If her husband decided to merge Han Mansion and The Li Manor sooner, she felt her break through to the True Martial Realm could come even earlier. After all, she heard her husband say on occasion that the resources of Han Mansion were far greater than those of The Li Manor.
Several months after joining The Li Manor, her belly had also grown. In a few months, she would bear offspring for her husband, which would solidify her status even more.
The husband had many charming wives and beautiful concubines in The Li Manor. Although they were quite united and there was no struggle, their statuses were different.
The status of these charming wives and beautiful concubines of their husband came from two aspects: one was their own aptitude and cultivation, and the second was the aptitude of their offspring.
She had not been in The Li Manor for long and had no offspring yet, while those wives of her husband had borne several offspring, with a solid status; although her cultivation was higher, she still had to call them sisters upon meeting them.
After spending some time in The Li Manor, Han Li returned to Han Mansion.
After spending time with Xue Yueqing, Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, Lu Tianxiang, and other charming wives and beautiful concubines, Han Li found Yao Xi.
When he arrived at Yao Xi’s bedroom, he was surprised to find his beloved wife still cultivating; since when did Yao Xi become so diligent?
“Xi Xi.”
“Husband~”
Seeing her husband arrive, Yao Xi stopped her cultivation. A touch of shyness flashed over her fair and stunning face, her secret efforts at cultivation unexpectedly discovered by her husband.
“Why has Xi Xi become so diligent?” asked Han Li, as he embraced Yao Xi in his arms and asked with a smile.
Biting her beautiful red lips, Yao Xi earnestly replied, “I want to become stronger.”
With a higher realm, she could discuss the Dao with her husband more joyously, and with greater strength, she could stay by her husband’s side for even longer.
She also wanted to be like Shi Qi, to be with her husband at all times. If her cultivation were high enough, her husband would surely take her with him on his travels.
“Then Xi Xi must continue to work hard,”
Touching Yao Xi’s smooth hair, Han Li smiled and encouraged her.
At first glance, he saw through Yao Xi’s cultivation – it had improved remarkably fast. She was now at the Hollow Void Stage.
Before giving birth, Yao Xi was only at the Gangyuan Realm, but in just two to three months, she had broken through to the Hollow Void Stage, fitting for a certain powerful female emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm from the Endless Yuankun Domain.
However, Han Li had also provided a lot of help. For example, Yao Xi had been baptized several times in the Life-Prolonging Furnace, her aptitude raised to Second Grade. To reach Top Grade, more time was needed.
Yao Xi had also frequently entered the Time-Sky Tower to cultivate in the past two to three months. After its evolution, Han Li had redefined its access levels. For a dao companion like Yao Xi, her permissions were very high, allowing her to stay in the tower for extended periods and, with the tower’s protection, access even higher floors.
Still, his charming wives and beautiful concubines rarely stayed within the Time-Sky Tower for long. Han Li had noticed that at most they would not stay beyond ten days before coming out, either to dual cultivate with him, to play with other sisters, or to instruct their offspring.
“Mm~”
Yao Xi nodded firmly, her eyes filled with anticipation.
Seeing this, Han Li sighed internally. He still didn’t know how to deal with the seal on Yao Xi’s Divine Spirit.
Lately, he felt an inexplicable pressure within him, which after analysis, he realized might be coming from Yao Xi – more precisely, from her identity.
Ever since he had captured the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing to be his Dao companion, Han Li had asked her about many things. As a Demon Emperor of the Demon Clan and the former handler of affairs at Myriad Demon Mountain, Xue Yueqing knew many secrets.
Han Li focused on learning about what lay beyond the Qianyuan Divine Province, wanting to understand the state of the Endless Yuankun Domain. He was already fairly clear on the Sacred Lands within the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Xue Yueqing told Han Li many things she could share, and Han Li finally had a basic understanding of the Endless Yuankun Domain, realizing that the Qianyuan Divine Province was in an awkward predicament.
Fortunately, the strongest forces of the Endless Yuankun Domain like the Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, White Emperor City, Heavenly Cult, and others looked down on this side of the Qianyuan Divine Province. Too far to bother with, they kept each other in check.

chapters.title: Chapter 408: 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 408: Chapter 200: Tianhu King’s Body, Nine Great Supreme Forces, Top Grade Imperial Soldier Chengdao Vial, Seven Female Emperors_5
“`
The thirty-six Divine Provinces surrounding the Qianyuan Divine Province did not have any forces at the Heaven Imperial Realm level. The highest were only at the Quasi Emperor Rank, and most of the prominent forces were of the Saint Abyss Realm Power.
Although these Saint Abyss Realm Powers and Quasi Emperor Rank forces coveted the heritage of the Qianyuan Divine Province, they did not dare to step foot inside; otherwise, no matter how many came, it would be death.
The Sacred Lands of the Qianyuan Divine Province possessed Celestial soldiers. Even if they could only be revived once, that was not something other forces could covet. A single revival could annihilate all the invading Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm and Quasi Emperors.
Of course, unless there were special circumstances, the Sacred Lands of the Qianyuan Divine Province would also not dare revive the Celestial soldiers at will to subjugate the Saints and Quasi Emperors from the surrounding Thirty-Six Divine Provinces, as that would invite great trouble.
Although the Thirty-Six Divine Provinces were currently coveting Qianyuan Divine Province, they also acted as a natural barrier for it, warding off other ambitious forces.
It was then that Han Li came to know that the Endless Yuankun Domain contained nine supreme powers, including the Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, White Emperor City, and others.
The highest rulers of these supreme powers were all pinnacle Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm with unparalleled combat abilities, listed on the Endless Yuankun Domain’s supreme ranking list.
The supreme ranking list was produced by the Tianji Pavilion, which was highly authoritative, and the Tianji Pavilion itself was also one of the nine supreme powers, with immeasurable heritage.
The Tianji Pavilion was a neutral power, and its branches were spread throughout the Eight Hundred Divine Regions. Powerful Divine Provinces would have a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm Power in charge, whereas for a general Divine Province like the Qianyuan Divine Province, according to Xue Yueqing, the person responsible for the local Tianji Pavilion was only a powerful being of the Tongxuan Realm.
There were a total of ten spots on the supreme ranking list. Empress Yuanchu, the Empress of Huangyue, the White Emperor, and others were among them; they were Great Emperors and also the supremes of the Endless Yuankun Domain, exerting pressure over the Eight Hundred Divine Regions.
Besides the nine supreme powers, there were also thirty-three Emperor Level forces within the Endless Yuankun Domain, each led by a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, though their powers were much weaker compared to the Empress of Huangyue, Empress Yuanchu and others.
For supreme powers like the Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain, besides the leader who was a pinnacle Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, there were other Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm within the power, making their strength far greater than that of ordinary Emperor Level powers.
Among the thirty-three Emperor Level forces, there were only seven female Emperors in the Heaven Imperial Realm. Han Li didn’t believe that Yao Xi was an incarnation or split soul of these seven female Emperors; with their strength, they likely could not allow an incarnation or split soul to also possess an emperor’s body.
Therefore, Han Li had previously concluded that Yao Xi’s true body was most likely one of the two strongest female Emperors in the Endless Yuankun Domain: the Empress of Huangyue or Empress Yuanchu!
Thus, Han Li felt a headache.
No matter whether Yao Xi’s true body was one of the seven common female Emperors or the Empress of Huangyue/Empress Yuanchu, none were within his current capacity to handle.
Even the seven common female Emperors held Celestial soldiers in their hands, and with their strength, they could easily revive part of the Celestial soldiers’ might. With a small price, they could fully revive the Celestial soldiers.
Though he had the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell, he was still far from being able to compete, and even obtaining Celestial soldiers would not change the situation.
Unless he acquired an Immortal Dragon Vein that could supply the energy needed for the Celestial soldiers’ revival, the Celestial soldiers could only be fully revived once and not be used lightly.
Han Li felt that the intangible pressure he had sensed recently might be because those female Emperors had dispatched people, who were looking for both Yao Xi and him.
The Special Envoy of the female Emperor was at least a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm Power and might be a Quasi Emperor, possibly wielding imperial weapons. This posed a significant threat to Han Li.
While he could confront it, how to do so was a big question.
If he didn’t handle the situation well and caused a commotion, he might no longer be able to hide in the Qianyuan Divine Province. The female Emperors themselves would likely come to settle scores with him.
“Alas, when can I ever possess Celestial soldiers,” Han Li sighed.
With Celestial soldiers, although he could not confront those female Emperors, there was a great chance to silently deal with the female Emperors’ Special Envoys, to continue buying time for further growth and development.
However, owning Celestial soldiers was extremely difficult, even with the System, it seemed hard to achieve.
At present, if he wanted to obtain Celestial soldiers, relying on the rewards from having offspring was insufficient, far from it, probably needing tens of thousands of descendants to do so.
Only by opening treasure chests would there be a chance to acquire Celestial soldiers.
But to get Celestial soldiers from a treasure chest, he needed to first increase his cultivation level to the Tongxuan Realm. Otherwise, he could at best only obtain Supreme Grade imperial weapons.
Han Li was currently at the fifth heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm and needed an additional 4,800 years of cultivation to breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm and become a powerful being.
This was an astronomical figure, which made Han Li particularly troubled.
His current accumulated cultivation was still far from sufficient. He could only continue to wait, for his descendants to reach four thousand, for two thousand of them to have high qualifications, waiting for cultivation feedback from his descendants…
“Huff~”
Letting out a sigh, Han Li opened the descendants’ panel, glanced at the number of his descendants, and his eyes suddenly brightened.
It had been a long time since he last checked, and the speed of increase in the number of his descendants surpassed his expectations, quickly approaching four thousand.
Even the number of descendants with high qualifications had surged by several hundreds, not far from reaching two thousand high-qualified descendants.
PS: If I have time tomorrow, I will make up the three thousand words I owe from before.

chapters.title: Chapter 409: 201 If the public does not abandon, Kui wishes to acknowledge as foster father_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 409: Chapter 201 If the public does not abandon, Kui wishes to acknowledge as foster father_1
Descendant Panel
Total number of offspring: 3998
Number of talented offspring: 1745
Seeing this, a smile involuntarily surfaced on Han Li’s face.
Almost two years ago, the total number of his offspring was 3220, and the number of talented offspring was 1422. Now they had increased by 778 and 323, respectively.
It had been less than two years, and the number of offspring that had increased somewhat exceeded his expectations, but it also seemed normal. With hundreds of beloved wives and concubines and thousands of offspring, it was not much to have less than eight hundred more offspring in nearly two years.
The Han Mansion had already passed its early stages; what used to take dozens of years to accumulate a hundred offspring now only took a few months.
Just two more offspring and his total would reach four thousand, at which time he would receive a hefty reward. This would only take a few days, or even by the end of today, he would achieve his target.
Continuing at this rate, once the total number of offspring reached around 4600, the number of talented offspring would reach two thousand, and another hefty reward would be due then.
Han Li closed the Descendant Panel and opened his personal panel to glance at it, discovering that the amount of cultivation years he had accumulated had reached 1787.
To break through to the ninth layer of the Divine Yuan Realm in one go, he needed 4300 years, and to further break through to the pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm, he would need another 500 years, for a total of 4800 years of cultivation.
He was still short by three thousand years of cultivation, a significant gap, but Han Li was not too worried about it.
Reaching four thousand offspring would yield at least four hundred years of cultivation, and reaching two thousand talented offspring would yield another eight hundred years, amounting to twelve hundred years of cultivation.
If he waited a bit longer, until the number of offspring reached five thousand, that would add at least another fourteen hundred years to his cultivation, reducing the gap to just four hundred years.
Those four hundred years could be fully covered by the cultivation feedback from his offspring.
The panel for offspring cultivation feedback was calculated separately; the previously mentioned 1787 years of cultivation did not include this portion.
Han Li glanced at this panel, where the accumulated cultivation feedback now stood at 261 years.
With the help of the Time-Sky Tower, in another year or two, a large number of the Han Mansion’s offspring would break through to the Gangyuan Realm and God Refining Realm, significantly increasing the cultivation feedback.
While pondering, Han Li noticed that the total number of offspring jumped to 3999, indicating a high probability that his total number of offspring would surpass the four thousand mark today.
Gathering his thoughts, Han Li looked at the warm and soft jade in his embrace, leaned down to kiss Yao Xi’s smooth forehead, and smilingly said, “Then, Xi Xi, continue your cultivation. I won’t disturb you anymore; your husband will come to speak with you about the Dao in a few days.”
“Mm~” Yao Xi responded shyly and timidly.
After Han Li’s figure disappeared, Yao Xi’s shy countenance faded, replaced by a grave expression. After a long silence, she heaved a sigh.
“I hope it’s not too late,” she murmured to herself.
The reason she had become diligent and was desperately seeking to improve her cultivation was that Yao Xi had sensed a crisis.
Even though the seal in her Divine Spirit had been reinforced, the birth of Han Yongqian inevitably had an effect, causing her to assimilate numerous memories.
These were the memories of the Huangyue Empress!
After assimilating all emerging memories, Yao Xi felt like an ancient divine mountain weighed down upon her, making it difficult to breathe.
It turned out she was not the reincarnation of a great power as her husband and sisters had said; she was the reincarnated fragment of the Huangyue Empress’s soul, with an inherent mission to return to the Huangyue Imperial City in the Kunji Divine Province once she broke through to the Saintly Abyss Realm.
According to the memories, she was not supposed to lose her virginity, let alone have a child for her husband. This could make the main body, the Huangyue Empress, sense it, leading to tremendous trouble.
The Huangyue Empress was a daughter of a Heavenly Immortal, pure and untouched for over a hundred thousand years. Her main body had not yet sought a partner, yet this fragment of her had found a partner, lost her virginity, and even given birth to a child.
Since the fragment and the main soul had a special connection, her dual cultivation with her husband might blur the lines of perception for the main body, arousing even greater fury.
The main body had not yet arrived in the Qianyuan Divine Province, indicating some delay, but she would not ignore the situation and would definitely send someone to investigate.
The Huangyue Imperial Empire was teeming with powerful beings, including Saints, Quasi Emperors, and Great Emperors, far surpassing what the Qianyuan Divine Province could compare to. Even a single Saint wielding an imperial weapon could pose a threat, would her husband be able to withstand it?
If he could not, her husband might be wrathfully killed, and she would be captured and taken back to the Huangyue Imperial Empire. Even if he could hold them off, it would only buy a little time, and the main body would definitely send a Quasi Emperor or Great Emperor directly, ending tragically for both her and her husband.
Yao Xi did not want her husband to know about this for now, as it would put tremendous pressure on him; she planned to advance her cultivation during this time.
If she could reach the Saintly Abyss Realm, that would be ideal. If not, when the envoys from her main body arrived and it was no longer possible to act, she would reveal herself and go with them voluntarily.
Regardless of the outcome, Yao Xi did not want this matter to affect her husband; under no circumstances should he be harmed.
After leaving Yao Xi’s chamber, Han Li became “busy” again.
After spending time with Liu Yuexin, Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, Lin Yiwu, Zhou Zhiruo, Chu Yutong, and other beautiful consorts, Han Li went to instruct his offspring one by one.
As Rebirth Pills could be supplied without limit, Han Li decided to elevate all talented offspring to fifth-grade talent, even those of insignificant talent could receive a Rebirth Pill.
The Rebirth Pill would become a new family benefit of the Han Mansion; anyone with talent lower than fifth-grade could improve their talent through the Rebirth Pill.
Exchanging a hundred contribution points could redeem a Rebirth Pill to be consumed by children, oneself, a spouse, or a concubine.

chapters.title: Chapter 410: 201 If the public does not abandon, Kui wishes to acknowledge as foster father_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 410: Chapter 201 If the public does not abandon, Kui wishes to acknowledge as foster father_2
Han Li placed no restrictions on this matter, as long as they belonged to the direct lineage of the Han Mansion, whether they were beautiful women who had married into the Han Mansion, or handsome men who had joined by marriage, all could exchange contribution points for a Rebirth Pill.
Of course, Han Li set a limit, for instance, if one of his descendants was of Seventh Grade talent with a wife of Eighth Grade talent, two concubines of Ninth Grade talent, and six descendants of Eighth Grade talent.
Then, this family of nine could exchange for thirty-one Rebirth Pills, and the talents of this family of nine would be elevated to the Fifth Grade, with their future offspring also highly likely to be of the Fifth Grade, or even if they were of the Sixth Grade, they could be improved with the Rebirth Pill.
When this policy was extended to the entire Han Mansion, the genetics of the Han Mansion would be continuously purified, with each generation of descendants born having increasingly higher talents, with the lowest being of the Fifth or Sixth Grade.
Not to mention the Life-Prolonging Furnace, which could further enhance these people’s talents, as long as they delivered results and then exchanged their contribution points for chances of purification by the Life-Prolonging Furnace, their talents could continue to be raised.
Over time, the foundation of the Han Mansion would become stronger and deeper, and Han Li would also gain endless benefits.
For example, if a large number of descendants with talents of the Fifth Grade and above were born, then he would receive massive feedback of talent, allowing his talent to reach Immortal Grade, elevating to an even higher level.
To advance from First Grade talent to Immortal Grade talent was already extremely difficult, not to mention the further enhancement from Immortal Grade talent; if the base foundation of the Han Mansion were not elevated, Han Li’s own talent improvement would consume a long period.
As the Rebirth Pills were manufactured for unlimited supply, Han Li once again adjusted the rules for the list of core descendants’ cultivation and the list of key descendants’ cultivation.
To become a key cultivated descendant, one needed to have a talent of Third Grade, or reach a certain level of comprehension, or have extremely strong capabilities, such as achieving something outstanding.
To become a core cultivated descendant, the talent needed to reach First Grade, or one needed to have a special physique, or meet standards in comprehension, capability, and so on.
As a result, the number on the list of key cultivated descendants drastically decreased, and even fewer were on the list of core cultivated descendants, currently only three – Han Yonglong, Han Yongqian, and Han Yongkun, all born within the same year.
Although the three were still far from the age of cultivation, they could still enjoy the benefits of the core cultivation list, solidifying their foundation and enhancing their heritage.
Han Li set the bar so high to increase the competitive vitality of the Han Mansion, otherwise, it would stagnate.
One hundred contribution points were very few; it was very simple for these descendants to rise to the talent of the Fifth Grade. Therefore, better incentives were needed to motivate them.
Outsiders of the Han Mansion, such as Guest Elders, protectors, servants and maids, among others, could also exchange for Rebirth Pills, but it required a substantial amount of contribution points, with one pill costing ten thousand contribution points, and still, there was a limited supply.
So far, Han Li had not announced this arrangement, but once he did, it was believed that it would cause a huge stir within the Han Mansion, and the members of the core cultivation list would significantly increase.
For instance, the descendants of Lu Tianxiang like Han Yongzhen, Han Yonglu, Han Yongxiang, and others, the descendants of Jiang Baiye such as Han Yongjiang, Han Yongye, Han Yongqiang, and so on, as well as the descendants of Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, Bai Keqing, and the wives from The Li Manor like Xue Qingyi, Chu Xianlin, Song Zhixuan, among others.
Although their descendants had not yet met the standards, they would undoubtedly reach them in the future, since they were wives of Han Li with high privileges, such as having the opportunity to be purified by the Life-Prolonging Furnace once a year.
With each purification by the Life-Prolonging Furnace, their talent would rise by one grade, reaching up to First Grade at most, with a maximum of three times per month. If there was a sufficient supply of Spirit Source, they could undergo purification six times a month.
Nowadays, with a Lower Grade imperial dragon vein on Chengsheng Mountain, the Life-Prolonging Furnace had ample energy to perform purification six times a month, which equaled seventy-two times a year.
This number may seem large, but actually, it’s quite limited, given that Han Li has dozens of wives, and their annual purification alone nearly accounts for half of the available opportunities, with the other half designated for descendants.
However, once these wives gradually elevate their talents to First Grade, this portion of opportunities will be freed up and become available for others to be purified.
If he were to announce the new cultivation system, many wives would likely choose to give their purification chances to their descendants to elevate them to First Grade talent and thereby enter the core list for descendant cultivation.
Unfortunately, resources are finite, and even his wives must wait their turn.
Han Li could not distribute them arbitrarily, favoring some over others, or it would dishearten his other wives and concubines. Having everyone adhere to the rules was better for all involved, and no one would have grounds for complaint.
For the sake of harmony in his harem, Han Li had always strived to treat everyone equally and fairly.
If his wives had the chance for purification by the Life-Prolonging Furnace, naturally his concubines did too, but due to their sheer number, Han Li, after some consideration, decided it would occur once every three years.
The concubines were quite satisfied with this arrangement; it was a good outcome for them. Their talents were at least of the Fifth Grade, some were originally higher, while others had been improved through the Rebirth Pills.
As long as they had the chance for purification from the Life-Prolonging Furnace, every three years they could advance one grade in talent, and within at most twelve years, they could reach First Grade. What was there to be dissatisfied with?
Once Han Li announced the new rules for cultivation, wives would compete for their children to be on the core cultivation list, and the concubines would do the same for the key cultivation list.
However, the children of these concubines were numerous; they themselves bore at least five, and each of their children had many more.
With too many descendants and purification chances coming only once every three years, they could only focus on cultivating one descendant first.

chapters.title: Chapter 411: 201 If the public does not abandon, Kui wishes to acknowledge as foster father_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 411: Chapter 201 If the public does not abandon, Kui wishes to acknowledge as foster father_3
Han Li conducted his affairs strictly according to the rules. How his beloved wives and concubines chose to use the baptism quota, whether for themselves or their descendants, was their business, and he would not interfere.
He believed this to be the fairest approach.
If he had any favoritism, he could have given his favorite wife or concubines, and their descendants, several more baptisms. Although the other beloved wives and concubines would be dissatisfied, what could they do?
In terms of cultivating his descendants, Han Li currently had two concerns. The first was that the grade of the Life-Prolonging Furnace was too low, only at the level of a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, and it was uncertain whether it could advance further after assimilating the Divine Gold.
Even a lower-grade Emperor Level Life-Prolonging Furnace did not meet his standards, and Han Li hoped to obtain another Creation Stone so he could elevate the furnace to the level of a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon.
After the Time-Sky Tower had been enhanced to a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, its auxiliary effects had exploded by countless times, and he believed the Life-Prolonging Furnace would do likewise.
By then, the number of baptism quotas from the Life-Prolonging Furnace would undoubtedly increase dramatically; for instance, performing fifty to a hundred baptisms a month, which would allow all those in Han Mansion to reach first-rank aptitude within a mere ten years.
Of course, this was just what Han Li hoped for. He doubted it was likely, but he would be very content if the number of monthly baptisms from the Life-Prolonging Furnace could increase to thirty or even twenty.
The second was his desire to acquire a treasure that could bestow aptitude to those without it.
Currently, he had almost four thousand descendants, but less than two thousand of them had aptitudes, with over two thousand more lacking any aptitude.
Should such a treasure exist, even if it only turned those two thousand-plus descendants from having no aptitude to possessing mediocre ones, Han Li would be exceedingly excited.
As long as they had aptitude, the arrangements for the Rebirth Pills would elevate all of them to fifth-rank, and then they could shine for Han Mansion, contribute, vie for the baptism quotas of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, and continue to improve their aptitudes.
If this step were achieved, the genes of Han Mansion would be thoroughly optimized, and the descendants born in the future would have a minimum of fifth-rank aptitude, laying a solid foundation for Han Mansion’s glorious prosperity.
Whether it is the Creation Stone or the treasure that could bestow aptitude, Han Li currently had neither; he hoped to unbox them, but the process of opening treasure boxes was too mysterious.
The Creation Stone was an Emperor Level Supreme Grade treasure; a treasure that could bestow aptitude probably had to be at least of the Emperor Level Supreme Grade as well, making it exceedingly difficult to unbox.
So many years had passed since the System upgrade, and after opening dozens to hundreds of treasure boxes, he had only acquired two Emperor Level Supreme Grade treasures.
After giving instructions to his descendants, Han Li found his beloved wife, Long Yue, and made a request.
“My lord, you want to take back the Immortal Cultivating Pill from my possession?” Long Yue frowned slightly after listening.
Initially, when she agreed to become Han Li’s Dao companion, the Immortal Cultivating Pill played a significant role, and she was touched by it for a long time.
If her lord wished to take it back, despite feeling some displeasure, she would still hand over the Immortal Cultivating Pill.
Seeing Long Yue’s demeanor, Han Li knew she had misunderstood. He immediately held her in his embrace, and after a tender moment, explained:
“Yue’er, it’s like this. I’ve recently obtained a divine treasure called the Chengdao Vial, the effects of which are incredibly heaven-defying….”
