After listening to Han Li’s explanation, Long Yue was utterly shocked, overwhelmed by astonishment.
Her lord had acquired another Top Grade Emperor Weapon!
Although the Chengdao Vial was an auxiliary Emperor Weapon, it was still a weapon of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and the Chengdao Vial had such heaven-defying effects.
In her previous life, she had also heard of such types of treasures, but their effects were far inferior to her lord’s Chengdao Vial. Where on earth did her lord find so many Emperor Weapons?
Long Yue hesitated to speak and ultimately held back, refraining from asking; she knew she should not ask, as it would not yield an answer.
She was open-minded, just like the lord’s other beloved wives, without any concerns about it. If the lord wanted to keep it a secret, let him. After all, they all enjoyed the benefits of the items he brought out and gained endless advantages.
“My lord, can the Chengdao Vial really produce one Supreme Grade Divine Pill every day?” Long Yue couldn’t help but ask, still finding it unbelievable.
The Immortal Cultivating Pill was a Supreme Grade Divine Pill, a transcendental Divine Pill that could help peak practitioners in the Tongxuan Realm break through to the Saint Yuan Realm. It’s astounding to have one produced every day without any cost.
Wouldn’t this allow the mass production of Saints of the Saint Yuan Realm?!
Han Li nodded slightly and said, “That’s why I want Yue’er to give me the Immortal Cultivating Pill first, and I’ll put it inside the Chengdao Vial. Tomorrow, I’ll return that same pill to Yue’er.”
“Alright~”
Without hesitation, Long Yue took out the Immortal Cultivating Pill and handed it back to Han Li.
She did not ask her lord to show her the Chengdao Vial; she trusted that he would not deceive her in this matter, for there was no need.
“Thank you for understanding, Yue’er.”
Han Li breathed a sigh of relief, rewarded her with a kiss, and then, in front of her, took out the Chengdao Vial and placed the Immortal Cultivating Pill inside it.
Afterward, he casually tossed it, and the Chengdao Vial flew up to the nine heavens, keeping company with the Void Bell and the Time-Sky Tower, where it could better absorb Higher level spiritual energy.
Witnessing this scene, Long Yue’s eyes sparkled brightly, confirming that what her lord had said was indeed true.
“Yue’er, it’s time for us to rest.”
Suddenly, Long Yue felt a tickling sensation by her ear accompanied by warm breath, as she heard her lord’s words.
Long Yue nodded, without any trace of shyness, and actively engaged in discussing the Dao with Han Li.
Two hours later, the session of dual cultivation ended, and an invigorated Han Li arrived at the summit of Chengdao Peak. Before he could even catch his breath, a System notification echoed in his mind.
“Your descendant count has reached four thousand. You’ve gained six hundred years of cultivation, a hundred Sea-Splitting Pills, fifty Pillars of Gang Energy Pills, twenty Immortal Conservation Pills, four hundred years of alchemy experience, and a Divine Rank lower-grade martial technique, the Five Elements Divine Punch.”

chapters.title: Chapter 412: 201 If the Public Does Not Abandon, Kui Wishes to Become Your Adoptive Son_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 412: Chapter 201 If the Public Does Not Abandon, Kui Wishes to Become Your Adoptive Son_4
Han Li glanced at the system prompt with a look of surprise on his face, as the reward was significantly greater than he had anticipated.
After investigating, Han Li discovered that it was a normal reward increase; future generations reaching five thousand or six thousand would receive rewards of this magnitude. If the number reached seven thousand, there would be a small increase, and if it topped ten thousand, there would be a significant surge.
To this, Patriarch Han was very pleased.
The rewards for four thousand descendants were considerable: two hundred years more in cultivation, an additional thirty Pihai Pills, twenty more Gangyuan Pills, ten more Immortal Conservation Pills, an extra one hundred years of experience in the Four Arts of Cultivation, and martial arts skills upgraded from Heaven Rank Upper Grade to Divine Rank Lower Grade.
Han Li didn’t care much about the Pihai Pills, Gangyuan Pills, and Immortal Conservation Pills, since with the Chengdao Vial in hand, he could have as many as he desired.
However, the advancements in cultivation, cultivation arts experience, and Divine Rank martial arts skills thrilled Patriarch Han, for these were areas he lacked.
At the thought, Han Li sat down cross-legged as a beam of Emperor’s Light from the Void Bell isolated him, and he began to claim his rewards.
First, he received four hundred years of alchemy experience, elevating him from an ordinary Third Grade Alchemist to an intermediate Second Grade Alchemist, a status akin to that of a master alchemist.
Next, Han Li received the Divine Rank Lower Grade martial technique, “Five Elements Divine Punch,” the second Divine Rank Lower Grade martial technique he had obtained, the previous one being the Triple Xuan Body Art.
In Han Li’s hands, the Five Elements Divine Punch could unleash power comparable to that of an Emperor Level Lower Grade martial technique. As a mid-stage warrior in the Divine Yuan Realm, executing a perfected Quasi Emperor level technique, he could unleash combat ability tantamount to the Sixth Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm.
Theoretically, a perfected Quasi Emperor level technique shouldn’t have such limited combat power, but Han Li’s lower cultivation level greatly reduced the Five Elements Divine Punch’s potential.
Han Li estimated that if he were to fully execute the Triple Xuan Body Art, creating fifteen bodies, and then simultaneously execute the Five Elements Divine Punch, he might not reach the combat ability of late-stage Tongxuan Realm, but it should be close.
The next day,
Han Li took out an Immortal Cultivating Pill from the Chengdao Vial and returned it to Long Yue.
On the third day, Han Li took another Immortal Cultivating Pill from the Chengdao Vial and then headed to Zaidao Peak.
Atop Zaidao Peak, there were Lower Grade Divine Medicines like Three Netherworld Grass and Supreme Grade Divine Medicines like the Nine Tribulations Sacred Lotus, as well as Kui Yi, the Tongxuan Realm peak-level Mythical Beast Kui Ox.
First, he checked the growth of the Nine Tribulations Sacred Lotus and found it flourishing, far quicker than when he had hastened its maturity with Top-grade Spirit Stones; truly, Emperor Level Lower Grade Dragon Veins were extraordinary.
Then, Han Li looked at Kui Yi, who was nudging at his leg, fondly stroked its head, and asked with a smile, “Kui Yi, would you like to ascend to the Heavenly Abyss Realm?”
“Yes, of course I would. Master, will you help Kui Yi breakthrough to the Heavenly Abyss Realm?”
Kui Yi paused, then its face lit up with excitement as it began to adorably pander.
As a Mystical Beast, Kui Yi possessed high intelligence. Since its master had posed the question, it must mean there was intent to assist in its breakthrough.
Naturally, Kui Yi desperately wished for the chance to break through to the Heavenly Abyss Realm and become a Saint.
“Then I shall give you the opportunity. I hope you won’t disappoint me,”
said Han Li solemnly.
Thinking of helping Kui Yi break through to the Heavenly Abyss Realm was a plan Han Li had formed after acquiring the Chengdao Vial, to reproduce an Immortal Cultivating Pill and then give it to Kui Yi to consume.
Once Kui Yi advanced to the Heavenly Abyss Realm and became a Mystical Beast with increased strength, it would provide even better protection for Han Mansion.
Additionally, Han Li was also preparing for any envoys sent by Empress Fengyue or Empress Yuanchu. Having a Saint-level Mystical Beast at home would give Han Li more confidence.
When the time came, Kui Yi would prove immensely valuable.
“Kui Yi will not disappoint master,”
Kui Yi promised with utmost earnestness.
If it weren’t inappropriate to say so, Kui Yi would have expressed, “Kui has drifted through life, lamenting not meeting a wise master sooner. If my master will have me, Kui wishes to become his adopted son…”
Han Li nodded slightly, then took out the Immortal Cultivating Pill, saying, “Within this Jade Vial lies an Immortal Cultivating Pill. Take it, and when you are ready, call for Zi Yi and let her take you to the deep void for your breakthrough.”
Cultivation by its very nature defies the heavens, and the journey is fraught with calamities; only the true darlings of the heavens sail smoothly.
Cultivators attempting to break through to the Innate Realm are the first to transcend the mundane and venture onto the path of cultivation. From there, they proceed through realms like the Pihai Realm, Gangyuan Realm, … up to the Tongxuan Realm, with no celestial tribulations in between.
However, when a cultivator at the pinnacle of the Tongxuan Realm attempts to break through to the Heavenly Abyss Realm, celestial tribulations will descend to hinder their enlightenment. If the cultivator’s Heavenly Abyss can withstand the test, they will successfully overcome the celestial tribulation and become a Saint.
During tribulation, the cultivator must often be wary of human calamities as well. Cultivators are most vulnerable right after passing their tribulation, easily falling prey to jeopardy and perishing.
Han Li’s request for Zi Yi to protect Kui Yi wasn’t due to human calamity concerns. He simply did not want to create a stir or have the residents of Han Mansion and the outside world become aware of Kui Yi, whose existence was currently known only to him.
“Yes, master,”
Kui Yi replied excitedly, cherishing the Jade Vial as it observed it carefully. Han Li smiled and vanished from Zaidao Peak.
Ten days later, Han Li received good news from Zi Yi: Kui Yi had successfully navigated its tribulation and officially ascended to the ranks of the Heavenly Abyss Realm as a Mystical Beast.
Han Li was quite delighted and generously rewarded himself that day. As for the method of reward, it naturally involved profound discussions with his beloved wife and concubines.
In the blink of an eye, another half month passed. Han Li had not taken any wives or concubines in Han Mansion but had indeed taken a beautiful concubine in The Li Manor, and of course, there was no shortage of sowing his seeds.

chapters.title: Chapter 413: 201 If the Public Does Not Abandon, Kui Wishes to Become Your Adoptive Son_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 413: Chapter 201 If the Public Does Not Abandon, Kui Wishes to Become Your Adoptive Son_5
That day, Han Li found Long Yue, engaged in a discussion of the Dao, and during the “Unarmed Dragon”, opened this month’s paid treasure box.
When five years of cultivation were consumed, a bright flash of golden light passed, and an item of treasure appeared on the virtual panel in front of Han Li.
“Ding~ Treasure box successfully opened, congratulations to the master for obtaining the Emperor Rank High Grade Treasure [Immortal Sky Concealing Formation Array Diagrams]!”
Han Li’s eyes lit up, his movements quickened involuntarily, as he imparted numerous profound principles to Long Yue.
He had obtained another Emperor Rank High Grade Treasure!
Although it was not the Creation Stone he desired, a treasure of birth talent, this set of Array Diagrams was also urgently needed, and one might even argue that it was more necessary than the former two.
Emperor Rank High Grade, that was on the level of the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor. With the Immortal Sky Concealing Formation’s Array Diagrams, it seemed he would no longer have to worry about envoys sent from Empress Huanyue or Empress Yuanchu.
As long as he threw out the Array Diagrams, the Immortal Sky Concealing Formation would instantly be laid out, and a peerless Emperor Formation of the Heaven Imperial Realm level would be completed in an extremely short time.
Once the formation was complete, it could conceal the secrets of heaven, confuse time and space, disrupt fate, and shield causality. Whatever happened inside would remain unknown to the outside world, and even if a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor personally divined it, no useful information could be gleaned.
This Grand Formation could also manifest twelve Immortal Demons, each at the peak of Quasi Emperor, who, in combination with the formation, could unleash the combat prowess of the early stages of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
After understanding the might of the Immortal Sky Concealing Formation, Han Li was thoroughly satisfied; it was to be one of his most powerful trump cards.
The advantage of Array Diagrams is that they can bypass the complicated process of setting up the formation, allowing it to be completed in just one step and in a very short time, and they can be used many times over.
However, the cost of producing Array Diagrams is very high. For example, the various materials consumed in setting up an Emperor Rank High Grade Great Formation amount to ten thousand units of Spirit Source, then to create such an Emperor Rank Great Formation into an Array Diagram, at least a hundred thousand units of Spirit Source would be required.
Three days later, at the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Han Li sat cross-legged, sipped the morning dew, and swallowed the first strand of purple qi between heaven and earth.
After that, Han Li contemplated deeply and decided to take a tour of the outside world.
In his weaker years, he often said that without even reaching the True Martial Realm, one mustn’t venture out recklessly; not to leave the mountain until reaching the Divine Yuan Realm…
Now that he had become a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor, with combat capability surpassing most of the Tongxuan Realm powerhouses, and in possession of two Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons and an Array Diagram of a Top Grade Emperor Formation, he was more than ready to traverse Qianyuan Divine Province with ease.
Han Li felt that it was time for him to venture out as well.
The Xuan Domain was so vast, and he had not properly explored it, it was definitely not because the ancestors were going out to select high-quality female cultivators!!!
Han Li waved his hand, and the Void Bell and Time-Sky Tower flew over, each shrinking in size, one hanging from his left wrist, the other from his right.
The Array Diagrams of the Immortal Sky Concealing Formation morphed into a Daoist robe, draping over Han Li, protecting him from any unforeseen events.
In the next moment, Han Li’s figure disappeared from Chengdao Peak.
Leizhou.
Han Li stood atop Tianxuan Mountain, looking down at the place with a hint of nostalgia in his eyes.
Many years ago, Tianxuan Mountain had already moved into the domain of the Qitian Teaching, and the current Tianxuan Mountain Range had been taken over by a new force, a Demon Sect of the Yinyang Sect.
Han Li merely watched silently, without taking any action.
Images flashed before his eyes, each one etching a deep memory in Han Li.
More than two hundred years ago, a young man, unwilling to remain mediocre, came here from Fengyang Manor in Lingjun City, and after overcoming numerous challenges, arrived at the Tianxuan Mountain Range.
After making great efforts, the young man finally passed the entry test of Tianxuan Mountain and was successfully accepted into the Sect.
Even if it was just as the lowest Registered disciple, the young man was overjoyed.
Tianxuan Mountain was one of the Four Great Sects of Leizhou. By being accepted, the young man had a future.
Three years to complete physical tempering, nine years to achieve great success in blood exchange, twenty years at the peak of True Qi, and three more to break through to the Innate Realm. He labored for decades to reach the peak of the Innate Realm but, due to carelessness and inattention, failed to ascend to the Pihai Realm, harming his foundations…
After wasting thirty more years, the once-young man had aged, and at the age of one hundred and fifty, he descended the mountain in frustration, took consorts, had children, and from then on embarked on a new cultivation path that spiraled uncontrollably.
“Huff~”
Exhaling deeply, Han Li repressed all memories deep within his heart and looked towards Dingyuan Manor.
He remembered that there was a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor pinned down beneath the earth by a peerless Emperor Formation, something he was told by his first wife, Lu Tianxiang.
In his weaker days, Han Li never considered seeking out this Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor or gleaning opportunity from him, as that felt too dangerous.
After all, this was a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor—who knew if he still had the power to break free, or if he still possessed lingering forces elsewhere?
Now, his strength had increased countless folds, with two Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons and an Emperor Formation Diagram draped over him, making it very unlikely for a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor to succeed in a sneak attack to kill him.
That Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor had been suppressed for hundreds of thousands of years. His strength had likely deteriorated far from what it once was, and he probably posed little threat anymore.
Yet, after some thought, Han Li still chose not to seek out the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor. The timing wasn’t right, and he worried about unexpected developments.
Generally speaking, a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor pinned by a peerless Emperor Formation couldn’t have too high cultivation, certainly not at the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, otherwise the Emperor Formation wouldn’t be able to hold him down.
This Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor couldn’t possess any immortal weapons either; otherwise, by activating them, he could have shattered the peerless Emperor Formation and would have already freed himself.
But that’s all theoretical. Han Li believed that it was the peerless Emperor Formation suppressing the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, which Lu Tianxiang had told him, and she had learned it from the Great Emperor himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 414: 201 If the Public Does Not Abandon, Kui Wishes to Become Your Adoptive Son_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 414: Chapter 201 If the Public Does Not Abandon, Kui Wishes to Become Your Adoptive Son_6
What if this Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor lied?
Han Li did not want to take any risk, for the ancestor avoided standing below wobbly walls.
Once he acquired the immortal weapon, then it would not be too late to seek out the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
Before that, he would follow the plan suggested by his beloved wife, Lu Tianxiang.
Lu Tianxiang had told him, she wished for her descendants to seek out the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor to see if they could obtain some opportunities from him, maybe pluck some wool, and Han Li naturally agreed.
This was also a kind of trial.
Lu Tianxiang had four children, two boys and two girls, respectively named Han Yongzhen, Han Yongxiang, Han Yonglu, and Han Yonglu. Their aptitudes ranged from Fourth Grade to Second Grade. The fourth child, Han Yonglu, was born to Lu Tianxiang when Han Li himself had a Second Grade aptitude.
Currently, Han Yongzhen had already begun cultivation, while Han Yongxiang and Han Yonglu were younger and would need to wait another year or two.
According to Lu Tianxiang’s wishes, she wanted to wait until Han Yongzhen reached the God Refining Realm or Hollow Void Stage before letting him venture out for trials, and then he could go and seek that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor for opportunities.
Lu Tianxiang did not just want to pluck wool once; she also hoped for Han Yongxiang, Han Yonglu, and Han Yonglu to all go and grab opportunities, taking as much as they could.
Han Li had not discussed this with any of his other beloved wives and concubines. This was an opportunity for Lu Tianxiang’s descendants, and since Lu Tianxiang did not wish to share it, he would not interfere.
The descendants of his other wives and concubines each had their paths, and Han Li had forged the stage for them and provided the best cultivation environment. As for how far they could go, that would be up to them.
With a smile, Han Li’s figure disappeared as he left Tianxuan Mountain to continue his roaming journey.
Meanwhile, at Dingyuan Manor, beneath a hundred-meter hillock,
Nangong Guang’s brows were tightly knitted together, a faint sense of foreboding rising in his heart.
Previously, he sensed someone spying on him, but as a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, when he tried to divine it, he got no results, which left Nangong Guang utterly baffled.
To his knowledge, Qianyuan Divine Province had long since declined, and now the strongest were only masters in the Tongxuan Realm, which were typically rulers of a Sacred Land, and rarely made public appearances.
The other strong beings, even if they were Divine Yuan Realm War Emperors, even if he was separated by this supreme Emperor Formation, he should have been able to deduce something.
“Who exactly is scheming against me?”
A chilling light flashed through Nangong Guang’s eyes.
On the other side, Han Li entered the hustle and bustle of the Mortal World. He constantly switched identities, experiencing various aspects of life, sometimes appearing in the Da Jing Empire, sometimes in the Kurong Sect, sometimes in the Qitian Teaching, sometimes in the Da Liang Empire…
In the Ancient Empire, within a Province City.
Han Li came here, disguised as a white-garbed scholar, walking amidst the secular world of the Province City.
After wandering for a long time, just as Han Li was about to leave and change locations, he suddenly stopped in his tracks, looking up slightly towards a spot thousands of miles away from the Province City.
There, a chase was unfolding.
The one being pursued was an extraordinary beauty in a blue dress with a light veil over her face, possessing only a cultivation of the God Refining Realm.
There were two pursuers, both Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage, a man and a woman, who seemed to have been chasing the lady in the blue dress for quite some time without success.
Han Li’s Divine Sense swept over the three people silently, a smile appearing on his face.
“How interesting.”
Han Li now understood why the lady in the blue dress, a real person in the mid-stage of the God Refining Realm, had been able to repeatedly escape from two Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage.
This roaming trip that he began in placid reflection urged him on, and it seemed he had netted a big fish this time.
The veiled lady in the blue dress was no ordinary individual; she harbored a great secret, which piqued Han Li’s intense interest.
The next instant, Han Li’s figure vanished from the Province City, appearing at the scene of the chase.

chapters.title: Chapter 415: 202 Murong Ying_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: Chapter 202 Murong Ying_1
Ancient Empire, Tuo State, Lishun Mountain Range.
Adorned in a fluttering blue dress and a light veil over her face, the woman stood atop the mountain, her eyebrows slightly knitted and her lips gently parting in a slightly annoyed tone:
“Do not delude yourselves.”
“Murong Ying, surrender and come back with us. Otherwise, this will be your place of burial.”
The man in green clothes, hundreds of meters in front of Murong Ying, spoke with a heavy voice, bursting with momentum, firmly locking onto the woman in the blue dress.
“Delude? I think you’re the deluded one, Murong Ying. You have no choice now,” said a yellow-dressed young matron with a graceful and mature figure, toying with a small knife in her hand, smiling behind Murong Ying, hundreds of meters away.
A hint of murderous intent flashed in Murong Ying’s eyes as she responded coldly, “You are seeking death.”
“Murong Ying, do you really think you, a mere God Refining Realm cultivator, have the audacity to say such things? What gives you such confidence?” sneered the young matron in yellow.
“Killing Young Master Qi has sealed your fate,” stated the man in green, his voice deep and somber.
Murong Ying replied indifferently, “He deserved to die.”
Young Master Qi was at the Gangyuan Realm, and with his two followers of the God Refining Realm, he tyrannized one side, bullying everyone in Suizhou, and even wanted to capture her as a slave. Murong Ying had simply executed him on the spot, along with his two God Refining Realm followers.
After leaving Suizhou, Murong Ying entered Yunzhou. Unexpectedly, that man was the grandson of Wanshui Palace’s Second Elder. Wanshui Palace was a major Sect of the Ancient Empire, with several Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm commanding respect across more than a dozen states.
Upon learning of his grandson’s murder, the Second Elder of Wanshui Palace dispatched two Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage to capture her.
Murong Ying fled all the way to Tuo State but was still cornered.
She truly didn’t want any trouble, and though these two men were Gurus in the Void Realm, she hadn’t regarded them as a threat. If she really had to make a move, it would take no more than a few strokes to suppress them.
But killing these two would only make things more complicated. There were only about twenty to thirty Gurus in the Void Realm at Wanshui Palace, and the death of two Gurus was a significant event. The Myriad Phenomena Realm’s Second Elder would definitely take action, and she was currently no match for a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Murong Ying also didn’t want to mindlessly slaughter people. If she could escape the pursuit, that would be best. Otherwise, she would have to kill her pursuers and then leave the territory of Wanshui Palace to continue her solitary cultivation.
“Young Master Qi deserved to die, but you weren’t qualified to kill him,” the man in green communicated to the young matron in yellow, as they slowly closed in on Murong Ying.
Young Master Qi’s actions had outraged both heaven and humans, but with a grandfather who was a late-stage Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster, the man in green, although displeased, had no choice but to obey orders.
“Murong Ying, don’t make foolish moves in your next life. It’s terrible to be impulsive in this world.”
As soon as the young matron in yellow finished speaking, her figure suddenly appeared behind Murong Ying, raising her hand to strike towards the back of Murong Ying’s head.
Simultaneously, the man in green ambushed her, his long spear thrusting with the force of a dragon, sweeping heavily towards Murong Ying’s abdomen.
“Hmph~”
Murong Ying coldly snorted, unfazed, a flash of blue light covering her body, blocking the attack from both sides. Then, with a flick of her left fingers, sword lights shot towards the man in green, while her right hand formed a fist seal, blasting towards the young matron in yellow.
“How is this possible?”
Both the man in green and the young matron in yellow were sent flying, injured and shocked, disbelief flashing in their eyes.
Murong Ying was just a God Refining Realm cultivator; they had never suspected that she could possess such formidable strength. Otherwise, how could they have chased her for so long and so far?
Now, they realized their assumptions were too naïve; they had kicked an iron plate. Murong Ying wasn’t just talking big; she truly had the ability.
While the two of them were lost in their thoughts, Murong Ying continued her assault, determined to quickly end the fight now that she had engaged.
She flashed above the man in green, pressing down from above with a crushing force. The man in green swung his spear to resist, but he was no match and was killed after just a few exchanges.
As the young matron in yellow managed to steady herself, preparing to aid the man in green, she saw him grievously wounded in just two moves. Without hesitation, she turned and fled.
But she couldn’t escape; after killing the man in green, Murong Ying activated a secret technique and appeared in front of the young matron in yellow. Within three exchanges, the young matron in yellow was dead.
Having killed two Gurus in the Void Realm, Murong Ying sighed, collected their Space Rings, destroyed the bodies, and was about to leave when she suddenly froze in place.
A look of alarm crossed Murong Ying’s face, not because she didn’t want to move, but because she had been suppressed by a powerful being.
“Clap clap clap~”
“A mid-stage God Refining Realm cultivator cutting down two mid-to-late stage Hollow Void Stage Grandmasters, impressive indeed.”
A series of clapping echoed, followed by a voice of admiration. However, the sound made Murong Ying feel rather uneasy.
This person had witnessed the entire event, yet she had not noticed them at all. At the very least, they must be an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, but what was their purpose?
“Who are you?” Murong Ying demanded, her voice cold as she scanned the area, trying to locate the person.
Even before an Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, Murong Ying was not afraid. Worst comes to worst, she could use some forbidden techniques at a price and still manage to escape.
“You’re quite composed. It seems you have some cards up your sleeve. Let me test your depth.”
As soon as the voice ceased, Murong Ying saw a delicate and fair hand reaching out from the sky above, grabbing at her. Her body flew uncontrollably towards that hand.
“Don’t even think about it!”
Without hesitation, Murong Ying resorted to a forbidden secret technique, attempting to escape.
To her horror, she still found herself flying towards the fair hand; the forbidden secret technique had not transported her millions of miles away as it should have.

chapters.title: Chapter 416: 202 Murong Ying_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 416: Chapter 202 Murong Ying_2
Grinding her teeth, Murong Ying used several forbidden techniques in a row, but all failed, leaving her somewhat at a loss.
Theoretically, once these forbidden techniques were deployed, even powerhouses at the Tongxuan Realm could not block them, let alone trace them, and could only watch helplessly as she fled.
For her to have paid such a tremendous price in vain, the being stopping her must be at least a saint of the Saint Abyss Realm, but when was there ever a saint at the Saint Abyss Realm in Qianyuan Divine Province?
Moreover, within the Ancient Empire—a place of little significance—the highest one could find was a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor. One would rarely even encounter someone from the True Martial Realm, so how did she come across a saint from the Saint Abyss Realm?
Unable to understand, Murong Ying regained her calm and ceased to resist. She wanted to see who the person was and what their intentions were to dare take such a great risk to capture her.
Image after image flashed through Murong Ying’s mind, with many potential suspects—all with significant backgrounds—who might be capable of such an act.
Up in the Nine Heavens,
Han Li smiled, looking at Murong Ying in her blue gauze garment within his palm, and thought to himself:
“Zi Yi, Shiqi, obfuscate time and space, conceal cause and effect, then send forth a ray of the Emperor’s Light to probe into her sea of consciousness, and see if she is indeed a reincarnated split soul of those empresses from the Endless Yuankun Domain.”
He initially thought about investigating with his Divine Sense, but he held back. Murong Ying was different from Yao Xi, who had not awakened when he found her, and this Murong Ying had used many techniques that he found mysterious; her background was definitely significant.
Had he not empowered the Void Bell with a strand of might, he might not have been able to capture Murong Ying.
Murong Ying’s Divine Spirit seal must have been unlocked. If he rashly probed, he might have suffered a great loss, and the chances were high that she was a split soul of a Heaven Imperial Realm empress.
“Understood, Master~”
The voices of Zi Yi and Shiqi echoed in Han Li’s heart simultaneously, after which two invisible rays of Emperor’s Light descended from the Nine Heavens into Murong Ying’s sea of consciousness.
“What are you doing?”
Murong Ying instantly detected the anomaly in her sea of consciousness. Standing in the palm of Han Li’s hand, her tone was cold beyond measure.
Han Li paid her no attention, quietly awaiting the outcome, and before long, Zi Yi and Shiqi voiced their findings to him.
Indeed, it was a split soul of a Heaven Imperial Realm empress!
Han Li’s brows furrowed slightly, then smoothed out, and he vanished from the spot, soon returning to Chengsheng Mountain.
Now that he had caught a big fish, there was no need to continue his travels; it would not do for complications to arise.
Back on Chengdao Peak, Han Li shook his hand, and Murong Ying landed on the mountain summit, standing not far from him.
Looking at the man standing with his hands behind his back, facing away from her, Murong Ying’s expression was as cold as ice, her words measured and decisive:
“You are making a grave mistake!”
As the reincarnation of a split soul of Empress Yuanchu, Murong Ying’s Divine Spirit seal had finally been broken at fourteen. That was when she embarked on the path of cultivation, progressing rapidly and reaching the mid-stage of the God Refining Realm in no time.
Murong Ying had many of Empress Yuanchu’s memories, mainly her cultivation techniques, martial skills, cultivational experiences, and combat experiences. As for Empress Yuanchu’s personal experiences, there were only vague memories, thus she had a distinct personality.
Nevertheless, her original being, Empress Yuanchu, was one of the strongest Great Emperors in the Endless Yuankun Domain, and being a split soul of hers, her status was naturally lofty.
With memories from Empress Yuanchu, Murong Ying had great vision and a broad perspective. She did not take Qianyuan Divine Province seriously. If things went smoothly, she would be able to reach the Tongxuan Realm within a hundred years, and the Saint Abyss Realm in another hundred years.
But now she was captured, her cultivation sealed, even the hidden reserves in her Divine Spirit were locked away, which infuriated Murong Ying.
This person was likely sent by one of her adversaries!
In the hundred thousand years, there had been thousands of reincarnated split souls, but only a few had successfully cultivated to the Saint Abyss Realm; most had perished prematurely.
Most of these prematurely perished split souls died before their Divine Spirit seals could be unlocked. The rest fell to hidden adversaries, with very few dying at the hands of other cultivators.
“The old ancestor is not easily frightened,” Han Li said in a light voice.
Murong Ying stared intently at Han Li’s back, her brows furrowed tightly and she questioned, “Who sent you? Empress Fengyue? Emperor Bai? Butian Sect Master? Or the Western Sky Palace Master?”
“No one sent me, they can’t instruct me,” Han Li stated indifferently.
“Is that so?”
Murong Ying’s eyes flickered slightly, and she began to believe him somewhat; those people’s underlings would typically just kill a split soul like hers and would not go to great lengths to take her away.
Moreover, this person did not seem to revere those she had mentioned in her questions, so it was quite likely that another cultivator with ulterior motives had set his sights on her.
This person’s cultivation was indeed formidable, but she felt that he was boasting. Empress Fengyue and the Lord of the Western Sky Palace were among the most powerful, on the same level as her original self. And yet this mere Saint Abyss Realm cultivator dared to speak so boldly?
However, Murong Ying did not question further. As long as they weren’t the underlings of those supremely powerful individuals, there was still hope; otherwise, she truly faced a dead end. If possible, Murong Ying did not wish to die.
“What is your intent?”
Murong Ying inquired, preparing to give him the runaround, to buy herself time.
Knowing that deploying forbidden techniques was futile, she had secretly communicated across boundless time and space to her original being using a special method. Once her original being learned of her plight, she would surely send for her rescue, all she needed was to delay for a while.
Han Li turned around, looking at this peerless beauty in her blue gown and veiled face, he said lightly, “You will have no reinforcements.”

chapters.title: Chapter 417: 202 Murong Ying_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 417: Chapter 202 Murong Ying_3
Before he made his move, he had the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell conceal the causality of time and space. Even the Heaven Imperial Realm empress was unaware that her divided soul had been captured. Murong Ying found that any means she tried to send a message would be intercepted.
Shi Qi and Zi Yi had already given him feedback, having intercepted the secret calls for help sent out by Murong Ying.
Murong Ying’s expression faltered for a moment before she turned back into an iceberg goddess, her pretty face utterly indifferent.
She didn’t know if this person had truly intercepted the messages, or if he was just bluffing her. Murong Ying believed it was the latter, as a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm could not accomplish this yet.
As for the outcome, she only needed to feign ignorance and stall for time until it became clear.
Seeing Murong Ying’s expression, Han Li smiled and said, “You ask me what my purpose is, I might as well tell you.”
“The ancestor has taken a liking to you and wants you to become my Dao companion.”
Ever since he found out Murong Ying was a divided soul of Empress Yuanchu, Han Li understood that Yao Xi was most likely a divided soul of the Empress Huanyue.
He already had a divided soul of Empress Huanyue as a Dao companion, to take a divided soul of Empress Yuanchu as another Dao companion would be sheer bliss.
Old Ancestor Han thought this was a good omen and decided to warm up to the idea in advance.
When he became stronger in the future, and could bring Empress Yuanchu and Empress Huanyue as his Dao companions, then his satisfaction would be complete.
Hmm, they seem to like splitting their souls, could there be many more divided souls…
At that moment, Old Ancestor Han felt he too had started to like the idea of divided souls.
As for marrying Murong Ying and cultivating together, and after she gave birth to a child, whether Empress Yuanchu would send someone over or not, Old Ancestor Han expressed that he didn’t care.
After all, he had already provoked Empress Huanyue, so having Empress Yuanchu against him as well wouldn’t make much difference.
If he could quietly deal with the Envoy of Empress Huanyue, then he could continue to stall for time. If not, he’d just throw the people of Han Mansion and The Li Manor into the System Space and take them away.
If he couldn’t win, he would just hide. When things settled down, they could continue to grow and prosper.
“You! What! Did! You! Say!”
Murong Ying was stunned for a moment, her tone icy cold to the extreme. If looks could kill, she would have slain this man countless times over by now.
This seemingly Saint Abyss Realm Saint turned out to be a lascivious person!
To actually lust after her body, how despicable!
This caused Murong Ying’s plans to feign ignorance to be shattered. She could consider other conditions, but this condition wasn’t even worthy of consideration.
Seeing that he was unmoved, Murong Ying spoke solemnly, “Do you know what you’re saying?”
“You should be aware of my identity. What you’re doing is tantamount to courting death. Even if I agreed, you would still be held to account by her afterward.”
Han Li had wanted to say that she needn’t worry about that, but after a thought, he changed his words, “To die under a peony, one becomes a ghost with charm.”
“Once we become Dao companions, and since I am a divided soul of Empress Yuanchu, doesn’t that make you equivalent to Empress Yuanchu’s Dao companion as well?”
“If she seeks to kill me, that would be akin to murdering her own husband.”
Murong Ying looked at him with a dumbfounded face. This man was not only lecherous and shameless, but also incredibly thick-faced and audacious to say such a thing.
“Whether you agree or not, this matter is settled,” Han Li stated with an indisputable tone.
After a pause, Han Li added, “This is Chengsheng Mountain, constantly monitored by Supreme Grade imperial soldiers, you won’t even have a chance to kill yourself. Prepare yourself well, the wedding is in three days.”
As Han Li’s words fell, his figure disappeared from the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Murong Ying felt weak and almost collapsed to the ground. The light veil on her face was lifted by the cool breeze, revealing a face of peerless beauty, radiant and otherworldly.
She had a very bad feeling in her heart. This person might have really intercepted her secret communication to her main body, otherwise he wouldn’t be so arrogantly forceful.
This person possesses a Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon, and it’s very possible that they could intercept a distress signal, preventing any reinforcements from arriving.
Even though her true form is Empress Yuanchu, Empress Yuanchu does not know that she has been captured and is still craving for her body.
Does she really have to become this person’s partner?
After struggling for a while, Murong Ying sighed. Her cultivation was sealed, and even her physical body and Divine Spirit were sealed, rendering her no different from an ordinary mortal woman.
Murong Ying looked around at the magnificent and majestic scenery, her face expressionless as she walked forward. Just a few steps ahead of her was a cliff. If she fell now, she would die, but Murong Ying no longer cared.
Although this person intercepted her call for help, he still coveted her body. If her Yuan Yin were lost, Empress Yuanchu’s true form would surely sense it and might directly come to Qianyuan Divine Province.
At that time, she would have no face to continue living. It would be better to die now.
As she took the fifth step, Murong Ying stumbled into emptiness, her entire body falling from the summit of Chengdao Peak. From a height of ten thousand meters, her mortal flesh was certain to perish.
Murong Ying closed her eyes, waiting for death.
“I said, Chengsheng Mountain has an Imperial Weapon monitoring it. You can’t commit suicide,” said Han Li’s voice beside Murong Ying’s ear. Murong Ying opened her eyes and found herself back on top of Chengdao Peak.
Murong Ying didn’t speak and simply jumped from the summit of Chengdao Peak again. Mid-fall, she realized she was back at the top of the peak, as if time had been reversed.
After attempting suicide several times, Murong Ying was certain this person truly possessed a Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon, a Time Emperor Soldier, making her own suicide impossible.
If activated, the Time Emperor Soldier could easily reverse time in a specific region.
“In fact, you don’t want to die, but you have no other choice, right?” Han Li’s figure reappeared at the summit of Chengdao Peak. He looked at Murong Ying, her beauty causing nations to fall, and said indifferently.
Murong Ying raised her eyebrows slightly but said nothing.
“Actually, you don’t have to worry. Even if you become my partner, Empress Yuanchu won’t know,” Han Li continued.
“You won’t touch me?” Murong Ying coldly sneered.
“Of course, I will,” Han Li said without hesitation.
“Then it’s impossible to keep it a secret,” Murong Ying said coldly.
The Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon may be strong, but so is Empress Yuanchu—she is not someone to be trifled with. She has left special measures with each of her split spirits, which would activate once the Divine Soul is unsealed.
If she were to lose her virginity, Empress Yuanchu would know instantly. Even if her true form doesn’t know who is responsible, she would undoubtedly be furious.
Her true form had long been aware of her presence in the Qianyuan Divine Province. If she came personally and used an Immortal Soldier to search for cause and effect, even the Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon wouldn’t be able to hide her traces.
“I have my ways,” Han Li smiled.
If all else fails, he could just hide Murong Ying in the System Space. Even Empress Yuanchu, in all her strength, would not be able to detect the System Space. With two Supreme Grade Imperial Weapons for protection and the Top Grade Emperor Formation Diagrams, he could leave quietly.
“Heh heh~” Murong Ying coldly chuckled, her expression clearly saying, “Keep fooling yourself.”
“Never mind, think it over,” said Han Li.
Han Li sighed. Yao Xi was so much better in comparison. He decided to let her think it over herself; after all, he would be holding the wedding ceremony in three days.
Han Li’s figure disappeared, leaving only his words echoing in Murong Ying’s ears.
“Don’t you want to become completely independent?”
PS: Not in good form today, will make up for it tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 418: 203: Don’t worry, I’ve got this!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 418: Chapter 203: Don’t worry, I’ve got this!_1
Three days later.
Han Li, the old ancestor of the Han Family, has taken a wife again!
After hearing the news, various powers of Yonchang Manor sighed and honestly brought gifts to participate in the grand wedding ceremony.
In this broken place of Yonchang Manor, where the spiritual energy ranks among the bottom three in the entire Daqian Empire, no Cultivators above the God Refining Realm are willing to settle here, making Han Mansion the strongest force.
Han Mansion does not expand its influence either, keeping a low profile. Had it not been for the fact that the Han Family liked taking wives and concubines, the outside world would have forgotten about this God Refining Realm force long ago.
Up to this day, the majority of powers in Yonchang Manor are related to Han Mansion by marriage, each entangled with Han Mansion to some extent—some marry into the mansion to become concubines of the old ancestor, some to become wives or concubines of the Han descendants, and some simply marry into the Han Family.
These people naturally understand how powerful Han Mansion is, far beyond what the outsiders perceive. They also know just how dense the spiritual energy on Chengsheng Mountain is. However, they dare not speak carelessly, as this is expressly forbidden.
These cultivators who have married into or joined Han Mansion know full well, like looking into a mirror, that Han Mansion is a slumbering dragon. By marrying into it through chance, they’ve already gained immense benefits, and in the future, there will be endless good fortunes to come.
Bound by various kinds of ties, they can only remind their natal families not to provoke Han Mansion and to deepen their ties with it instead, giving some subtle hints.
Atop Chengdao Peak, Han Li watched the bustling Han Mansion with a smile constantly on his face.
After withdrawing his gaze, Han Li set off toward Murong Ying’s bridal chamber. There laid the nuptial room for the two of them. Han Li would spend the night here tonight and for many nights to come.
Murong Ying had finally compromised, agreeing to his terms. For this reason, Han Li naturally painted a lot of big pies for her—the big and round kind.
Inside the bridal chamber,
Murong Ying sat on the edge of the bed, covered by a red bridal veil, dressed in bright red wedding attire. She was waiting for the audacious Han Li to come in.
Her heart was in turmoil, not knowing if Han Li could truly shield against the fates decreed by heaven. If any slightest bit leaked, only a path of death awaited her and Han Li.
As a soul fragment, although she didn’t inherit all the memories of the original being, Murong Ying was acutely aware of how ruthless Empress Yuanchu was. If her original being were to find out about what she had done, she would be enraged beyond measure, and even the slightest carelessness could result in failure.
Over these three days, Murong Ying pondered a great deal. Han Li’s last words before he left ensnared her like a curse, endlessly enticing her to agree.
Having been accidentally caught by Han Li and brought to Chengsheng Mountain, unable to call for help, Murong Ying’s numerous attempts at suicide had all failed, and she had become desperate.
However, upon hearing Han Li’s words, another thought took root in Murong Ying’s heart. Why couldn’t she live for herself?
Being a soul fragment, she had a strong sense of mission and knew what her destiny was. This was ingrained in her memory when the Divine Spirit was unsealed, and without any hesitation, Murong Ying strived toward that goal.
Empress Yuanchu had calculated all of this from the start. When the soul fragment grew to the Heaven Imperial Realm, it wouldn’t develop its own will and would remain utterly loyal, serving only the original being. Everything was in service to the original being.
Only when the soul fragment broke through to the Quasi Emperor realm would it gradually develop its own thoughts. If it remained the same as before, it wouldn’t be possible to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Therefore, like Empress Fengyue, Empress Yuanchu would reclaim her soul fragment once it reached the Heaven Imperial Realm, to prevent it from becoming unmanageable and to avoid impacting their plans.
It was because of an accident that Murong Ying, who had not yet fully matured, encountered Han Li and started to have such thoughts.
As a soul fragment, if she were to cultivate smoothly up to the realm of Heaven Imperial, she would be taken back to Yuanchu Mountain by the original being to continue training and assist in reaching the Heaven Imperial Realm.
In the future, she would merge back with the original being, helping the original make a crucial step in the Heaven Imperial Realm with combat ability on par with a Heavenly Immortal.
If that were the case, her life would come to an end, having fulfilled her purpose.
But now, Murong Ying wished to become independent, to live for herself.
Murong Ying wanted to take a gamble, to completely break away from Empress Yuanchu with the help of Han Li’s power, no longer continuing that so-called mission, not wanting her life to end upon completion of her mission.
She wanted to live more brilliantly, to complete her own independent life, rather than being bound by Empress Yuanchu her entire life.
The person who pushed Murong Ying to make a decision was Yao Xi.
Yesterday, when Murong Ying met Yao Xi and learned of her identity from Han Li, that was when Murong Ying truly made up her mind.
Yao Xi was a soul fragment of Empress Fengyue, a being as powerful as Empress Yuanchu. Even the soul fragment of Empress Fengyue was living on Chengsheng Mountain as Han Li’s Dao companion and had borne him a child.
This proved that Han Li had the capability to conceal all of this. Otherwise, Empress Fengyue would have discovered it long ago, not waiting until Yao Xi had given birth to the child.
After conversing with Yao Xi, Murong Ying gave Han Li her answer. Han Li naturally welcomed it, agreeing to all of Murong Ying’s demands and voluntarily adding quite a few more, to Murong Ying’s great satisfaction.
But now, as the moment approached, Murong Ying’s previously firm heart began to waver again. Hearing Han Li’s footsteps, Murong Ying’s breathing grew increasingly rapid.
She, the soul fragment of Empress Yuanchu, was actually about to marry and become Han Li’s Dao companion.
Tonight she would surely lose her virginity, and at that moment, the original being—Empress Yuanchu—would sense it. It all depended on whether those two imperial weapons of Han Li’s would work.
If they concealed all the heavenly secrets and fates, then the original being—Empress Yuanchu—wouldn’t be able to detect her exact whereabouts, only knowing that she was in Qianyuan Divine Province. This would allow Han Li to proceed with the next step. Following the plan, she would finally sever her ties completely with Empress Yuanchu and become independent.

chapters.title: Chapter 419: 203: Don’t worry, I’ve got this!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 419: Chapter 203: Don’t worry, I’ve got this!_2
“Ying’er, are you ready?”
Approaching Murong Ying, Han Li extended his right hand to grasp the red bridal veil without haste to lift it, instead asking.
“Han Li, I’m asking you one last time, is it reliable?”
Murong Ying was somewhat nervous, partly because she was about to lose her virginity and partly because of the pressure from her original body, Empress Yuanchu.
“Rest assured, I’ve got everything under control.”
Han Li spoke with a calm tone, composed and confident, as if everything was under his control, easing Murong Ying’s emotions.
As soon as Han Li entered the bedchamber, he had already communicated with Shi Qi and Zi Yi. The Void Bell and Time-Sky Tower, these two Supreme Grade Imperial Arms, had started operating, partially recovering their might, to veil the heaven’s secrets, blur time and space, and disrupt the causal threads.
If Empress Yuanchu were to exert her full might in deducing and investigating, Shi Qi and Zi Yi would fully recover to ensure the plan proceeded smoothly.
At the same moment Han Li was to obtain Murong Ying’s pure Yin, the Void Bell and the Time-Sky Tower would unleash their might, enter Murong Ying’s sea of consciousness in that instant, and seize the opportunity to seal the hidden maneuvers left in her Divine Spirit by Empress Yuanchu, preventing the latter from deducing and locating her through them.
Before this moment, Han Li had not dared to act thus, for it would alert the Empress prematurely to these matters.
Choosing this moment for action held no such concerns, for Empress Yuanchu would feel the connection the moment Murong Ying lost her virginity, like giving her a taste of sweetness first.
Taking a deep breath, Murong Ying calmed her mood, softly saying, “If that’s the case, then let’s begin.”
The next moment, her red bridal veil was lifted by Han Li, revealing a face of stunning beauty.
Naturally gorgeous, she had delicate, well-defined eyebrows, expressive eyes, shoulders carved like fine jade, a waist as slender as if bound by a cord, jet-black hair cascading down to her waist, beneath the bridal makeup, her delicate figure undulated, the curves graceful and perfect, truly a vision of national grace and heavenly fragrance, dazzling and peerless.
Even Han Li, who had hundreds of delicate wives and beautiful concubines, was captivated at this moment, his gaze searing as he watched Murong Ying, silently sighing in admiration.
Murong Ying’s beauty could rank within the top five among all his wives and concubines, on a par with Yao Xi, Long Yue, and Xue Yueqing, greatly alluring to Han Li.
“Husband~ It’s time to rest,” said Murong Ying with a smile blossoming on her fine, jade-like cheeks, her rosy lips gently parting as she softly called out.
Her smile was like blossoming spring peaches; her hair piled up like gathering clouds, her lips parting like cherry blossoms; her teeth like pomegranate seeds, exuding fragrance.
Han Li was stimulated by that single address of “husband” from Murong Ying. He really hadn’t expected her to call him that tonight, thinking it would take some time.
“Ying’er, I will now impart to you the profound ways and the essence. It’s okay if you don’t understand the deep doctrines; I will infuse them all into you,” Han Li declared.
When Han Li set about to discuss the profound doctrines officially with Murong Ying, the Void Bell and Time-Sky Tower vibrated simultaneously. Two rays of Emperor’s Light fell into Murong Ying’s sea of consciousness. In an instant, they formed a temporal-spatial seal, encasing the hidden maneuvers at the core of her Divine Spirit.
Meanwhile, far away in the Yuanchu Province.
Terrifying Emperor’s Might burst forth from Yuanchu Mountain, enveloping everything under the sky, instantly covering the nine heavens and ten earths, spreading across numerous Divine Provinces, shaking the entire Endless Yuankun Domain.
“Audacity!”
Along with it came the thunderous fury of Empress Yuanchu.
Such commotion had immediately alarmed numerous mighty beings who turned their attention toward Yuanchu Mountain, with Saints, Quasi Emperors, and Great Emperors all somewhat dazed.
What’s wrong with Empress Yuanchu?
In the past twenty years, Empress Fengyue had raged three times, each time shaking the Endless Yuankun Domain, causing a great stir within the Eight Hundred Divine Regions.
Yet, to the surprise of many mighty beings, Empress Fengyue seemed not to have taken any action, leaving them wondering what had happened.
Now another peerless Empress of the Endless Yuankun Domain, Empress Yuanchu, was also furious. What exactly was happening?
What could have provoked Empress Yuanchu to such fury, causing such a great disturbance? Was it related to Empress Fengyue’s rage? Would Empress Yuanchu continue to be enraged in the coming time?
Suddenly, the many forces within the Endless Yuankun Domain felt rather vexed. It had been only 110,000 years since the ancient great calamity ended, and it seemed undercurrents were stirring again, with great unrest brewing. If it were to affect the entire Endless Yuankun Domain, these forces would be the first in the line of fire, most likely to be annihilated as a result.
In the center of the Yuanchu Province, there stood a vast and majestic Immortal Mountain, towering a billion feet tall, one of the tallest Immortal Mountains in the Endless Yuankun Domain, aside from the Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
Penglai Divine Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, Xumi Mountain—these Divine Mountains were as nothing before Yuanchu Mountain, akin to glowworms against the bright moon.
Yuanchu Mountain, ethereal and otherworldly, spanned endlessly with its undulating terrain dancing like silver snakes, which were actually Dragon Veins, this place being a convergence of countless such veins, a land of creation.
The Founding Master of Yuanchu Mountain was an incredibly powerful Heavenly Immortal. It is said that to create this Sacred Land, this Heavenly Immortal refined thirty-three vast Star Domains, condensing them into the scenic wonders of Yuanchu Mountain.
At the peak of Yuanchu Mountain, within an Immortal Palace,
Empress Yuanchu’s face was marked with fury as she continued her deductions, yet nothing could be gleaned from them.
Her body occasionally reacted in ways that made her expression extremely unsightly. She forcibly suppressed these sensations, her expression turning cold, causing the temperature in the Immortal Palace to plummet drastically.
“Don’t let me find out who you are?” Empress Yuanchu said hatefully, clad in Silver War Armor, wielding a Silver Long Spear in her hand.
To have Heavenly Immortal Combat Ability in the Heaven Imperial Realm, to eventually step out of the Xuanshen Sword Mountain, she had planned for a hundred thousand years.
Such scheming was no secret even to those who stood at the pinnacle of the Endless Yuankun Domain, Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm. It was known since the Ancient Era, the Prehistoric Ages, and even earlier times, in even earlier epochs.

chapters.title: Chapter 420: 203: Don’t worry, I’ve got this!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 420: Chapter 203: Don’t worry, I’ve got this!_3
Many unparalleled Great Emperors succeeded in having Heavenly Immortal Combat Ability in the Heaven Imperial Realm, but that was just the beginning. They still needed to have True Immortal Combat Ability in the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and finally attain Golden Immortal Combat Ability in the True Immortal Realm.
The further they went, the more difficult it became, with the success rate being very slim.
Through so many generations, the corresponding Secret Techniques became more and more refined, and the hope gradually increased. Although the Secret Techniques controlled by various forces were different, they all led to the same goal.
The Supreme Secret Technique cultivated by Empress Yuanchu was similar to that of the Empress of the Moon, except hers was extrapolated from her predecessors, while the Empress of the Moon had created a new Secret Technique on her own.
Just a moment ago, she was still in a responsive connection with her soul division, knowing it was in Qianyuan Divine Province, and aware that her soul division had reached the God Refining Realm.
However, in the next instant, Empress Yuanchu felt a reaction within her body, detecting a change in her soul division—it had actually been shattered.
Before Empress Yuanchu could investigate, she discovered the connection to her soul division was cut off, deliberately concealed, which infuriated Empress Yuanchu even more.
She exerted all her effort to deduce what had happened, yet found nothing, only knowing that the last place her soul division disappeared was in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Empress Yuanchu paid a certain price to have a certain Divine Weapon of Yuanchu Mountain fully revived, aiding her deduction, but in the end, she still couldn’t deduce anything.
This hurt Empress Yuanchu deeply, feeling annoyed for the first time that her own Divine Weapons were not good at deduction.
Once calm, Empress Yuanchu locked onto her targets. Only a few of the Great Holy Land Schools in Qianyuan Divine Province possessed the means to conceal fate, obstruct her deductive investigation, and seal the countermeasures she had left within her soul division.
Empress Yuanchu suspected that her soul division had fallen into the hands of Great Holy Land Schools such as Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Penglai Immortal Sect, who had Divine Weapons capable of this feat.
Her prime suspects were Heavenly Demon Hall, Xumi Mountain, and Myriad Demon Mountain. Their motives were the strongest, whereas Bai Yujing, Penglai Immortal Sect, House of Divine Armies, and the Summit of the Stars, had much less reason.
In ancient times, Qianyuan Divine Province was very powerful. Although it has declined thoroughly, the various forces of the Endless Yuankun Domain still often paid attention, having a clear understanding of the power structure of Qianyuan Divine Province.
After a moment of silence, Empress Yuanchu’s Divine Sense moved towards a certain place in Yuanchu Mountain, “Youwei, come here.”
Just like the Empress of the Moon, even in her immense fury, Empress Yuanchu would not personally address the issue. On one hand, it was due to the influence, as she did not want this matter to leak out and damage her reputation.
On the other hand, her true body could not move and had to guard Yuanchu Mountain, overseeing the Thirty-three Heavens.
Her soul divisions, found within Heaven Imperial Realm, Quasi Emperor, and Holy Abyss Realm, were all within the Thirty-three Heavens. If she were to leave, her hundred thousand years of effort would be lost, as many soul divisions developed a rebellious streak, not wanting to merge back into one with her.
Soon, a female ruler in a purple gown arrived at the immortal palace, bowing to Empress Yuanchu and respectfully said, “Greetings, Your Majesty.”
Empress Yuan Youwei quickly pondered, guessing Empress Yuanchu summoned her due to the earlier incident. Curiosity filled her heart about what had happened, yet she asked nothing.
“Youwei, I need you to go to Qianyuan Divine Province and bring back my soul division and the related parties,” Empress Yuanchu said.
“Your will be done,” Yuan Youwei respectfully answered.
Empress Yuanchu took out a Token and handed it to her, adding, “With this Token, as long as my soul division is within ten thousand miles, it will trigger a response.”
“You may temporarily have this Divine Weapon. Should you succeed, it will belong to you.”
Yuan Youwei received the Divine Weapon and the Token, accepted the order, and left without asking further questions.
Her heart aflame with excitement, for such a simple task, the Empress actually bestowed a Divine Weapon. Was she intent on cultivating her intensively?
As Yuan Youwei vanished, Empress Yuanchu sighed inwardly. This matter was not suitable for public announcement, so she had to entrust it to a confidant.
Yuan Youwei was a Quasi Emperor, and although she had just broken through, with a Divine Weapon of the Heaven Imperial Realm level, she was more than capable of moving unbridled in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Although she suspected those Great Holy Land Schools in Qianyuan Divine Province of foul play, without evidence, she decided to let Yuan Youwei do some probing. If even Yuan Youwei failed, she wouldn’t hold back.
Then, she would send a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm with a Divine Weapon to blood-wash the relevant Sacred Lands in Qianyuan Divine Province. They had dared to shatter her soul division, a price not even the Sacred Lands of Qianyuan Divine Province could afford.
Empress Yuanchu turned to look towards Kunji Divine Province, her face showing a trace of complexity.
Years ago, she enjoyed watching others face setbacks, like her old rival, the Empress of the Moon, who frequently became enraged. Now it was her turn, and Empress Yuanchu was quite displeased.
She felt that she might be encountering a situation similar to that of the Empress of the Moon. Such matters weren’t easy to publicize, which could explain why the Empress of the Moon had refrained from taking significant action.
Now, the Empress of the Moon was probably enjoying the spectacle of her situation!
Indeed, as Empress Yuanchu had predicted, at this moment, the Empress of the Moon was in her imperial palace, watching the spectacle unfold, even letting out a laugh.
She didn’t know exactly what Empress Yuanchu was experiencing, but as her rival, the Empress of the Moon was very happy to see her furious.
In the past, when she repeatedly became furious, Empress Yuanchu had never missed an opportunity to provoke her. Although the Empress of the Moon was angry, she hadn’t said much as such things were not suitable for spreading.
If Empress Yuanchu found out, who knew how she would mock her? Therefore, the Empress of the Moon didn’t want this embarrassing information revealed.
Looking in the direction of Yuanchu Mountain, the Empress of the Moon’s gaze clashed with that of Empress Yuanchu’s, and upon seeing her complex expression, she felt a twinge in her heart.
Could it be that her archenemy, Empress Yuanchu, was also enraged by the same thing?

chapters.title: Chapter 421: 203: Don’t worry, I’ve got this!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 421: Chapter 203: Don’t worry, I’ve got this!_4
Empress Phoenix Moon seemed contemplative, but she didn’t take it to heart, still focusing on her own affairs first.
The Heavenly Cult, Western Sky Palace, Tianji Pavilion, and other supreme forces of the Endless Yuankun Domain were all stirred up, buzzing with discussions, yet they didn’t know the reason why.
Time passed day by day.
On Chengdao Peak of Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li was discussing Taoism with his newly wedded wife, Murong Ying, while casually opening this month’s treasure chest.
“Ding, treasure chest successfully opened, congratulations Master for obtaining an Emperor Level Supreme Grade treasure [Creation Stone]!”
Hearing the system prompt and seeing the treasure that appeared on the chest panel, Han Li was utterly excited, galloping with joy on the path.
Murong Ying, being a soul fragment of Empress Yuanchu with great fortune upon her, was whom Han Li wanted to rub some luck off of by choosing this moment to open the chest. With his vast experience, he hadn’t expected such a huge windfall.
With the second Creation Stone in hand, the problem that had troubled him was solved. Without hesitation, Han Li had already decided to assign it to the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
Once the Life-Prolonging Furnace evolved into an Emperor Level Divine Weapon, all aspects of its auxiliary effects would skyrocket. Han Li was already looking forward to it.
“Why is my husband suddenly so excited?”
Receiving the Taoist teachings from Han Li, Murong Ying suddenly asked. She clearly sensed the change in Han Li’s emotions since they were already like one.
“I’m just excited at the thought of Ying’er carrying my child,” Han Li said sincerely.
It had been several days since he had married Murong Ying, and after his continuous cultivation, she was already pregnant.
Murong Ying smiled helplessly, without doubt, but sighed softly, silently accepting the Taoist teachings.
She really didn’t want to have children, but her husband, Han Li, persuaded her earnestly and offered her many promises. Ultimately, Murong Ying accepted.
Two hours later,
Han Li finished imparting his teachings, and after being affectionate with Murong Ying, he said deeply, “Ying’er, rest well.”
After arriving at Chengdao Peak, Han Li summoned Zi Yi, Shi Qi, and Yin Ling, and then said, “Yin Ling, do you want to evolve into an Emperor Level Divine Weapon?”
The three women were taken aback. Zi Yi and Shi Qi showed smiles on their faces, while Yin Ling’s face showed excitement as she stuttered, “Master… Master, can I… really… do it?”
Yin Ling said, looking at Han Li with anticipation, her face flushed with nervousness.
As a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, her next step was to evolve to the level of Emperor’s Weapon, but this was extremely difficult. Even after she absorbed the Divine Gold, it was uncertain whether the Life-Prolonging Furnace could evolve to a Lower Grade Emperor’s Weapon.
She had previously witnessed her Master evolve Shi Qi, truly turning the Time-Sky Tower into an Emperor Level Divine Weapon. She had seen it with her own eyes, leaving no room for doubt.
Since then, Yin Ling, Yue Ji, JianJi, and other Artifact Spirits had been looking forward to whose turn it would be next for the Master to evolve.
Yin Ling had not expected it to be herself, knowing her advantages were not significant despite her Body Preservation Furnace’s formidable auxiliary effects.
Still, she was an outsider like Yue Ji, having been refined by their Master later on, while Zi Yi, Shi Qi, JianJi, and other Artifact Spirits seemed to have always been with the Master.
If it came down to seniority, she felt she wouldn’t even rank in the top three. Yet to her surprise, the Master was now choosing to evolve her.
With only Zi Yi, Shi Qi, the Master, and herself present, the decision was almost certain, which made Yin Ling very excited and nervous.
“Of course, you can,” Han Li nodded.
“Then please favor me, Master,” said Yin Ling, inhaling deeply, finally voicing the request she had been harboring for a long time.
Shi Qi and Yue Ji had already been with the Master, and she, along with JianJi and others, knew their turn would come eventually. They were prepared, waiting for the Master to act.
Now that Yue Ji had not yet evolved into an Emperor Level Divine Weapon, it was her turn to evolve first. Once she finished evolving, the Master would probably favor her.
Han Li smiled and said, “Yin Ling, there’s no rush for that, let’s wait a bit longer.”
Yin Ling lowered her head, her cheeks blushing, and softly acknowledged with a hum.
“Shi Qi, Zi Yi, later on it will be up to you to cover up any noise,” Han Li turned to Zi Yi and Shi Qi.
“Please rest assured, Master.”
“Don’t worry, Master~”
Shi Qi and Zi Yi quickly promised.
Following that, Han Li took out the Creation Stone and summoned the Life-Prolonging Furnace into his hands with a gesture.
Han Li’s Divine Sense also resonated across Yangdao Peak, ensuring the Han Mansion descendants cultivating within the range of the Life-Prolonging Furnace not to panic; it would be over soon.
Having completed these tasks, Han Li wasted no time and fused the Creation Stone with the Life-Prolonging Furnace, initiating its evolutionary journey.
Under Han Li’s watch, the Life-Prolonging Furnace underwent a massive transformation, evolving wildly, with its might soaring, Emperor’s Might permeating the heavens and the earth, and shaking the ages.
Lower Grade Emperor’s Weapon!
Middle Grade Emperor’s Weapon!
Top Grade Emperor’s Weapon!
Fina

chapters.title: Chapter 422: 203: Don’t worry, I’ve got this!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 422: Chapter 203: Don’t worry, I’ve got this!_5
“`
The higher level spiritual energy here is close to Immortal Qi, superior to that of the Soul-Cultivating Furnace and the Body-Cultivating Furnace.
According to Yin Ling, it would take only three hundred years to breed a lower grade imperial dragon vein, and a thousand years to breed a middle grade imperial dragon vein, with the highest being just a middle grade imperial dragon vein.
Additionally, as long as there is sufficient higher level Spirit Source, the Life-Prolonging Furnace can create powerful followers, like the Five Directions Mystical Beasts, the strongest of which can be at the peak of Quasi Emperor; this requires consuming a vast amount of Spirit Source and can be maintained for five.
Second, after undergoing the baptism of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, the recipient’s cultivation talent can be enhanced by one grade, with the maximum enhancement being up to first grade, and their comprehension abilities will also improve significantly.
The baptism of the Life-Prolonging Furnace no longer requires charging; it is self-sufficient, and it can baptize twenty-five times each month, each time consuming a considerable amount of Spirit Source.
Receiving the baptism of the Life-Prolonging Furnace has an extremely low chance of resulting in special physiques, with the lowest being the King physique and the highest the Emperor physique. If one undergoes multiple baptisms, the probability of giving birth to a special physique will continuously increase.
Third, entering the Life-Prolonging Furnace for tempering, which takes a day’s time, is also limited to twenty-five times a month, each time consuming quite an accumulation of Spirit Source.
The physical and Divine Spirit cultivation levels of those who are tempered will soar dramatically. Depending on the level of cultivation, the increase can vary, with one tempering session able to increase up to a hundredfold at most.
Fourth, cultivating within the range covered by the Life-Prolonging Furnace will boost the speed of cultivation by thousands of times, accommodating up to ten people; increasing the number will reduce the enhanced cultivation speed.
Fifth, the Spirit Source of the Life-Prolonging Furnace can rapidly repair physical and Divine Spirit injuries, enabling cultivators to return to their peak condition. Even without any injuries, within the range of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, the body and Divine Spirit will always be at their peak, which is beneficial for cultivation, enlightenment, and spellcasting.
Sixth, the Life-Prolonging Furnace can assist cultivators in breaking through, increasing their odds of success.
Below the True Martial Realm, the chance of breaking through is one hundred percent; the Divine Yuan Realm by eighty percent, the Tongxuan Realm by sixty percent, the Holy Abyss Realm by forty percent, the chance of advancing to Quasi Emperor by twenty percent, and the chance of becoming Great Emperor by ten percent.
The highest possible attainment is the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor. After all, the Life-Prolonging Furnace is a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon and cannot help cultivators ascend to be Heavenly Immortals or achieve Immortality.
Han Li was very satisfied with the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s new effects after its evolution; the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s aid in the development of Han Mansion was tremendous.
Being able to breed a lower grade imperial dragon vein in three hundred years, and a middle grade imperial dragon vein in a thousand years, was truly superb; henceforth, Chengsheng Mountain wouldn’t need to worry about dragon veins anymore.
As he had expected, the number of monthly baptisms provided by the Life-Prolonging Furnace had greatly increased, offering twenty-five baptism opportunities a month, without needing Han Li to supply energy.
Twenty-five times a month, that’s three hundred times a year, almost meeting the needs of the Han Mansion.
His beloved wife has one Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism opportunity per year, while his concubines get one every three years, and then both the core and key descendants to be cultivated have the chance for baptism after a certain period.
In less than ten years, his wives and concubines would all have first grade talents, and many of his descendants would also develop first grade talents.
After that, the chances are that his newly born children will likely have first-grade talents, and perhaps even Immortal Grade talents. Should they have Second or Third Grade talents, they can simply use the Life-Prolonging Furnace for enhancement.
Besides the significant increase in the number of baptism times, what Han Li valued most was that the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s baptisms could actually create special physiques, although the chances were very slim.
But after all, there was a chance, wasn’t there?
According to what Yin Ling estimated, if the same being undergoes more than five baptisms, they would likely have a thirty percent chance of obtaining a special physique. If they undergo more than ten baptisms, the chances exceed fifty percent.
This was extraordinary, but Han Li sighed. It wasn’t easy to manage.
Concentrating the monthly baptism opportunities on one to three individuals would almost certainly lead to the emergence of special physiques among them.
The best choice would be to focus the resources on one person. Even if their luck was extremely poor, receiving twenty-five baptisms a month would definitely result in a special physique.
If they were lucky, maybe it would take only around a dozen, ten, or even two or three times to be successful; then, resources could be allocated to the next person.
But this is not easy to distribute.
Having so many beloved wives, beautiful concubines, and thousands of descendants, how to determine the order?
If he followed such an order, giving one month to one person, those at the end might have to wait for tens or hundreds of years, even several centuries, before their turn came.
Not to mention his descendants still multiplying, with many more being born every day, while he continued to marry and accept more concubines.
With a sigh, Han Li decided to stick to the original plan.
“`
The new scheme could swiftly create individuals with special constitutions, but the original scheme might not be much worse, as with good luck, a special constitution could emerge in a single attempt.
Most importantly, this scheme was the fairest.
A few days later, Han Li announced the news that the number of monthly baptisms of the Life-Prolonging Furnace had increased, causing widespread excitement throughout the Han Mansion.
Countless descendants of the Han family looked forward with great anticipation, rubbing their hands with eagerness and motivation, almost wishing to hover around Han Li day after day.
Previously, the Life-Prolonging Furnace could only conduct three baptisms a month, and many didn’t even qualify for a baptism. Those who did had to wait in a long line, as there were simply too many who wished for this opportunity.
Now, the Life-Prolonging Furnace could perform twenty-five baptisms a month, adding up to three hundred a year, which was incredibly exhilarating.
After all, each baptism could raise their cultivation talent by one grade. Where else in the world could one find such a great opportunity? Only they, the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, had this privilege.
Many descendants of the Han family did not understand how the number of baptisms of the Life-Prolonging Furnace increased so drastically, but Han Li’s cherished wives, like Lu Tianxiang, Xue Yueqing, Jiang Baiye and the others, guessed the reason.
The husband had silently evolved the Life-Prolonging Furnace into a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon!
