How long had it been since the Time-Sky Tower was upgraded to a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon? Not more than a year, at most.
Even though they knew their husband had created countless miracles, at this moment, their hearts quivered in excitement—it was too thrilling.
In another year, would their husband possibly upgrade another Supreme Grade Divine Spirit to a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon?
Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, Bai Keqing, and Long Yue, his beautiful wives, knew well that Chengsheng Mountain had many Supreme Grade Divine Weapons.
Although curious about how their husband achieved this, none of them asked, instead quietly enjoying the benefits he brought.
As the wives of Han Li, they had the chance for one baptism a year. Before, it was for their own use, but after their husband announced the new cultivation scheme, they considered using it for their children instead.
Whoever used it, they faced a long wait, as in the past there were at most seventy-two opportunities a year. Now, however, the pace was almost five times faster at three hundred chances a year.
This scope could satisfy everyone in the Han Mansion with a quota. They could consider using their opportunity for themselves this year, and for their descendants next year. No need to wait long anymore; any method would work.
Three months later.
In Capital City, Da Qian, The Li Manor.
Han Li was waiting for the birth of Qiu Shuhui’s child.
Before long, a baby’s cry sounded, and Qiu Shuhui’s child was born.
Han Li stepped inside, glanced at the child, noticed that it had only Second Grade talent, and was not disappointed. After all, Qiu Shuhui herself had only Third Grade talent; the child’s Second Grade was already quite good.
After helping Qiu Shuhui recover her strength, they shared a tender moment before Han Li revealed the name he had chosen for their child.
Han Yongyu!
Qiu Shuhui was quite satisfied with this name; the meaning behind the character for “Yongyu” was indeed very good.
After leaving Qiu Shuhui’s chamber, Han Li glanced at the descendant panel and a smile appeared on his face.
In the months that had passed, the number of his descendants had significantly increased; now the total number of descendants had reached 4,599, with 1,998 of them having registered talent. It was about to reach two thousand.
According to Han Li’s estimate, it would take at most ten days for the number of talented descendants to break through two thousand. After three to four more months, the total number of descendants would reach five thousand.
Indeed, Han Li’s prediction was not wrong.
On the third day after Qiu Shuhui gave birth to Han Yongyu, the Han Mansion welcomed another descendant with registered talent, and on the fourth day, yet another was born.
The System notification arrived on time, as it never failed to do.
“You have reached two thousand descendants with cultivation talent; you gain eight hundred years of cultivation experience, three Third Grade Lifespan Extension Pills, thirty Fifth Grade Lifespan Extension Pills, five hundred years of artifact refining experience, and a Lower Grade Divine Rank martial technique ‘Heaven-Shaking Fist’.”

chapters.title: Chapter 423: 204: Breakthrough, I, The Ancestor, Am Invincible in My Realm!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 423: Chapter 204: Breakthrough, I, The Ancestor, Am Invincible in My Realm!_1
Looking at the system prompt, Han Li’s face broke into a smile.
The rewards for talented descendants and the total number of descendants reaching the same stage differ significantly, with the former’s rewards being much higher but also harder to achieve.
Now, even though the total number of his descendants has exceeded 4,600, there were just over 2,000 talented descendants, a ratio of 2.3 to 1, and this ratio was shrinking.
Han Li believed that in another ten years, this ratio would shrink further to within the range of 1.8 to 1, or even 1.5 to 1.
The Life-Prolonging Furnace could perform its rite three hundred times a year; in ten years, that would be three thousand times, and the Han Mansion’s eligible descendants would have long completed their rites, with their talents reaching First Grade.
Afterward, the standards could be adjusted to allow more people from the Han Mansion to benefit, improving many people’s talents by one or even several grades.
Before then, the Rebirth Pill would enhance all the talented descendants in the Han Mansion to Fourth Grade, including Han Li’s children, their consorts, descendants, and sons-in-law who married into the family.
When the least talented of the descendants all have Fourth Grade talents, it becomes very difficult to produce descendants without talent, thereby purifying the Han Mansion’s gene pool.
If within these ten years a treasure that could bestow talents were acquired, thus granting talents to those descendants currently without, then the ratio would reach 1 to 1. From then on, the Han Mansion would have no descendants without talent.
Exhaling deeply, Han Li claimed the five hundred years of Artifact Refining expertise, and countless Artifact Refining experiences flooded into his sea of consciousness, all absorbed and digested by his grand Primordial Spirit.
In just a few moments, Han Li’s achievements in Artifact Refining surged dramatically, transforming from a top Fourth Grade Artifact Refiner to a Second Grade Artifact Refiner, even ranking high within this grade.
“It’s truly troublesome how fast strength can increase,” Han Li couldn’t help but quip.
Now, his Four Arts of Cultivation were lagging far behind his strength, incapable of refining items that could be useful to himself—the highest for Alchemy and Artifact Refining were Second Grade, Formation was approaching Second Grade, and Talisman Making was only at an ordinary Fourth Grade level.
Luckily, he had a vast family; the pills he refined, weapons, Array Plates, and talismans were crucial treasures for the descendants of the Han Mansion and most of his favored consorts and concubines, enhancing the Han Mansion’s foundation.
Next, Han Li claimed the “Heavenly Shaking Fist,” a Divine Rank Lower Grade martial art, spending eight breaths of time absorbing and digesting it.
Following the absorption, even Han Li’s aura shifted subtly, and his martial intent gained additional depth.
The “Heavenly Shaking Fist” required unwavering resolve and courage to master, embodying the determination to shake the heavens with a single punch, daring to strike even in the face of gods and Heavenly Immortals.
“Now I have one more method to counter enemies.”
A smile appeared on Han Li’s face, his strength steadily growing; he now had several techniques capable of unleashing the combat power of the Tongxuan Realm’s Sixth Heaven.
After stretching his limbs, Han Li finally looked towards his personal panel.
With the number of talented descendants reaching two thousand, he obtained another eight hundred years of cultivation, further increasing his accumulated cultivation, which now reached 3,792 years.
He was only about a thousand years away from the cultivation needed to reach the peak of the Tongxuan Realm.
Han Li glanced at the descendant panel and saw the feedback of his cultivation had increased again, from 261 years to 278 years.
With this, his total accumulated cultivation reached a staggering 4,070 years, and he still needed… wait a minute!
Han Li suddenly froze as he realized he might have forgotten something. Looking back and forth at his personal panel, he finally remembered what it was.
He had forgotten that he had ascended to First Grade talent!
Before, his calculation of needing 4,800 years to advance from the Divine Yuan Realm’s Fifth Heaven to its peak was based on him having Second Grade talent.
Because the personal panel didn’t display how many years of cultivation were needed to advance levels, only showing how many years he had, Han Li momentarily forgot.
“The patriarch has been too diligent, too capable, forgetting such a crucial matter,” Han Li said reproachfully, yet his tone was filled with excitement.
Upon remembering this, Han Li realized that all the crises were no longer concerns!
Lately, he had been worried about the Special Envoy from Empress Huang Yue finding him; then, there was also the issue with Empress Yuanchu. With his current level of cultivation, he might not be able to deal with them.
Moreover, the Sacred Lands of the Qianyuan Divine Province all had Immortal Weapons. Although Han Li had three Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons, he was still inferior when facing Immortal Weapons.
To truly dominate the Qianyuan Divine Province and effortlessly take down people sent by Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu, he must possess an Immortal Weapon.
To acquire an Immortal Weapon, there was only one way he knew of, and that was opening treasure chests.
Han Li needed to ascend to the Tongxuan Realm to have a chance of obtaining Immortal Weapons from treasure chests.
Han Li had always thought this would take a long time, as ascending to the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm alone would require 4,800 years of cultivation, and to ascend from there to the Tongxuan Realm would require many more years, neither of which he had yet accumulated enough for.
But now, the patriarch realized that everything was possible.
He had ascended to First Grade talent several months earlier when his first child with Long Yue, Han Yonglong, was born—a child of First Grade talent, who contributed a tenth of this talent back to him.
With First Grade talent, advancing to the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm only required around 2,400 years, a full 2,400 years less in cultivation.
Now possessing 4,070 years of cultivation, even after ascending to the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm, he would still have 1,670 years of cultivation left. Han Li felt that should be enough to advance to the Tongxuan Realm, and if not, it wouldn’t be far off.
After all, the difficulty of ascending to the Tongxuan Realm as a First Grade talent is much lower than as a Second Grade talent, and the system’s cultivation consumption would be halved.

chapters.title: Chapter 424: 204: Breakthrough, I, The Ancestor, Am Invincible in My Realm!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 424: Chapter 204: Breakthrough, I, The Ancestor, Am Invincible in My Realm!_2
After putting his thoughts in order, Han Li did not delay and immediately began preparing for his breakthrough.
He communed with Zi Yi and Shi Qi through his mind, asking the two women to help conceal any commotion, after which Han Li embarked on his journey to break through.
Han Li seemed to be sitting cross-legged at the peak of Chengdao Peak, but in reality, he was deep in the time-space continuum. Behind him, his Martial Primordial Spirit appeared, its rich light illuminating all heavens, dazzling myriad realms.
Han Li’s Martial Primordial Spirit had reached the Imperial Grade; it had grown nearly a million zhang in height at the moment of breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm. With his ascension to the Fourth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, he finally shattered his shackles, with his Primordial Spirit breaking through one million zhang.
As his cultivation progressed further to the Fifth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, his Primordial Spirit also grew considerably. Currently, his Primordial Spirit stood at one million six hundred thousand zhang, rivaling the powers of a great being from the First Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm.
The Primordial Spirit of Tongxuan Realm powerhouses also continues to grow, one million zhang in the First Heaven, two million zhang in the Second Heaven, and nine million zhang in the Nine Heavens. Only when breaking through to the Heavenly Abyss Realm will the Primordial Spirit break through to ten million zhang.
As can be seen, the Primordial Spirit exceeding a million zhang is incomparably radiant. In certain areas of the Primordial Spirit where the color has changed from silver to gold, those regions have become Pure Yang.
Warriors in the Divine Yuan Realm increase their strength by growing their Primordial Spirit. In contrast, great beings in the Tongxuan Realm must continue to cultivate their Primordial Spirits, transforming them step by step into Pure Yang. Only a Pure Yang Primordial Spirit can withstand the Heavenly Abyss that has been opened; otherwise, even a Primordial Spirit of ten million zhang would be crushed, leading to death and the dispersal of one’s cultivation path.
Han Li focused with a calm mind, contemplating deeply. Others might not know, but Han Li was very clear that his Imperial Grade Martial Primordial Spirit was ultimately false.
His understanding of the Martial Way had only recently approached great accomplishment; he had yet to condense the Martial True Pill, let alone the Martial Primordial Spirit—one received assistance from the system for these achievements.
This time, if he could break through to the Tongxuan Realm in one go, his general mastery of the Martial Way would evolve from the Martial True Intent to the Martial True Pill stage. At that time, his strength would see a tremendous enhancement.
Afterward, Han Li closed his eyes and recited a mantra silently in his heart.
The next instant, Han Li’s aura began to skyrocket, and he entered an Enlightenment State. Behind him, his Primordial Spirit also began to grow rapidly, towering into the skies, piercing through heaven and earth.
On Han Li’s personal panel, the stored cultivation began to deplete insanely, pouring out like a flood.
500 years!
1000 years!
2000 years!
Han Li fully entered the Enlightenment State; every instant was a hundred years of enlightenment. He continued for 24 instants, expending 2400 years of cultivation.
After 2400 years of enlightenment, Han Li comprehended countless principles, understood various mystical laws, and polished his Martial True Intent to perfection.
The next instant, Han Li awoke from the Enlightenment State. The enlightenment of 2400 years’ worth of principles and mysterious laws rushed to him all at once, elevating Han Li’s Martial True Intent rapidly from minor accomplishment to great accomplishment, and then to complete perfection.
The moment his Martial True Intent reached perfection, Han Li’s cultivation surged, breaking through several minor realms. His aura climbed higher and higher, charging into the heavens, his terrifying might sweeping in all directions, stirring time and space.
Divine Yuan Realm Sixth Heaven!
Divine Yuan Realm Eighth Heaven!
Divine Yuan Realm Ninth Heaven!
As his realm reached the perfect pinnacle of the Ninth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, Han Li exhaled gently. He had reached the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm, exhausting all his insights.
By using up 2400 years of cultivation at once, his cultivation skyrocketed to the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm, his strength increasing manyfold. Han Li merely exhaled, and he saw the void in front of him shattering.
After a moment of reflection, Han Li began to assess his current state.
This time, his Primordial Spirit also underwent frenzied growth, reaping great benefits. When breaking through to the Sixth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, his Primordial Spirit had only grown to one million nine hundred thousand zhang.
But when he broke through to the Seventh Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm, his Primordial Spirit surged by five hundred thousand zhang at once. Afterwards, every ascent to the Eighth Heaven, Ninth Heaven, and the pinnacle of the Ninth Heaven increased it by another five hundred thousand zhang each. And when the realm reached the pinnacle of the Ninth Heaven, the Primordial Spirit’s growth was even greater—increasing by six hundred thousand zhang.
Now, Han Li’s Martial Primordial Spirit had grown to four million zhang, with forty percent of it becoming Pure Yang, just on par with an average powerhouse from the Fourth Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm.
Han Li was very satisfied with this; at the same peak of the Divine Yuan Realm, his Primordial Spirit was four million zhang tall while other peak Martial Emperors only approached one million zhang. It seemed only four times greater, but the difference in strength was at least a hundredfold.
After retracting his Martial Primordial Spirit, Han Li began to inspect other aspects of his strength, and discovered enormous improvements.
The capacity of his True Yuan increased from rivaling the Fourth Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm to matching the Sixth Heaven. This was still because he cultivated the Chaotic Decision, a Divine Rank Top Grade cultivation technique; otherwise, an advancement of four and a half minor realms would probably only increase by one minor realm’s worth of True Yuan capacity.
The gap between the minor realms of the Divine Yuan Realm and those of the Tongxuan Realm was just too vast.
His Divine Sense advanced by two minor realms, matching the Sixth Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm. Aspects such as strength, physique, defense, speed, and more, only rose by one minor realm. Part of this increase was due to the boost in cultivation, and part was due to the breakthrough of the all-capable Martial Way.
Because the Martial True Intent from the all-capable Martial Way had reached the perfection stage, it further enhanced the might of martial skills, leading to a slight increase in the power of techniques such as Han Li’s Xuanhuang Tyrant Body and Void Walking.
Beyond these, Han Li’s five senses had further improved, reaching a new stage in Divine Sense exploration.
There were no changes in other aspects of Divine Sense, but the changes it brought to strength were significant. Formerly activating Divine Sense multiplied the current strength by 15 times.
For example, when Han Li used the Six Harmonies Eight Desolations Fist, he could wield the Combat Ability of a power from the Third Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm. When activating Divine Sense, his strength increased 15 times, bursting forth with the Combat Ability of the Fifth Heaven.

chapters.title: Chapter 425: 204: Breakthrough, I, The Ancestor, Am Invincible in My Realm!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 425: Chapter 204: Breakthrough, I, The Ancestor, Am Invincible in My Realm!_3
“`
Han Li employed the Five Elements Divine Punch, which allowed him to exhibit the combat ability of the seventh layer of the Tongxuan Realm. After triggering his Divine Sense, even if his strength increased by 15 times, he could only manifest the combat ability of the eighth layer of the Tongxuan Realm—a mere increase of one minor realm.
This was because the higher the realm, the greater the difference; there was a substantial disparity in combat power between the seventh and eighth layers of the Tongxuan Realm.
Now, his Divine Sense no longer increased strength by a multiple of his current power; instead, it directly elevated him by two minor realms.
Using the Five Elements Divine Punch again and triggering his Divine Sense, he could now directly burst forth with the combat ability of the eighth layer of the Tongxuan Realm.
Han Li felt quite pleased as it was much more useful than before. In the past, his Divine Sense had been rather unstable and the power boost weakened as his own realm increased.
After contemplating for a while, Han Li turned his attention to breaking through the Tongxuan Realm, directly inquiring the System for the information he wanted and received the answer he was seeking.
“So pricey!”
Han Li exhaled a breath and couldn’t help but utter.
When he had advanced to the Divine Yuan Realm, he had a Second Grade aptitude and spent two thousand years. According to the System, a Second Grade aptitude would require five thousand years of cultivation to advance to the Tongxuan Realm.
He now had a First Grade aptitude, which would consume two thousand five hundred years of cultivation.
However, Han Li currently had only one thousand six hundred and seventy years of cultivation, lacking eight hundred and thirty years. He felt that he needed to accumulate it for a while yet.
He did a rough calculation and found that it would take at most three to four months for him to advance to the Tongxuan Realm.
The total number of his descendants was 4,603—fewer than four hundred shy of reaching five thousand. Upon reaching that number, he would gain six hundred years of cultivation, and with the additional four hundred years from four hundred more descendants, that would be one thousand years.
At that time, his cultivation would exceed two thousand six hundred years, more than meeting the requirement to break through to the Tongxuan Realm.
To reduce the amount of cultivation consumed by the breakthrough, there were two methods. One was obtaining a special physique. An Imperial Body would halve the cultivation needed, a Royal Body would halve it again, and an Immortal Body would halve it yet again.
This meant, with a King’s Body, Han Li would only need one thousand two hundred and fifty years to reach the Tongxuan Realm. With an Imperial Body, he would need just six hundred and twenty-five years, and with an Immortal Body, merely three hundred and thirteen years.
The second method was to improve one’s aptitude to an Immortal Grade, which would reduce the required cultivation by one-fifth, to five hundred years—a bit more than what an Immortal Body would need.
This was because within the Cultivation Realm, an Immortal Body was rarer and more cherished than Immortal Grade aptitude.
Han Li’s aptitude had only reached 23% of the First Grade, making an upgrade to Immortal Grade a distant prospect.
Though for every addition of a First Grade aptitude descendant, Han Li could gain a tenth of that aptitude in return, it seemed that just eight more First Grade aptitude descendants were needed. He could create them in a few years, especially with a number of First Grade aptitude beauties like Murong Ying, Yao Xi, Xue Yueqing, and Long Yue for wives.
But raising a First Grade aptitude to an Immortal Grade was not so simple. Han Li had previously asked the System, which said there was a huge threshold to cross.
The gap between a First Grade aptitude and an Immortal Grade aptitude was immense. A cultivator with First Grade aptitude had a fair chance of reaching the Tongxuan Realm, while those with Immortal Grade aptitude had a good chance of becoming a Heavenly Immortal. Between the two grades, there were two to three Big Realms, including the Sacred Abyss Realm, the Quasi Emperor, and the Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
To bridge this gap, the Sages, through relentless research, had finally created special physiques which could gradually narrow the gap between the First Grade and Immortal Grade aptitudes.
Even if Han Li’s aptitude reached 99.99% of the First Grade, additional First Grade aptitude descendants would not enable his aptitude to rise to an Immortal Grade.
To truly ascend, certain conditions had to be met.
Han Li knew it would be a while before he could meet those conditions, so he dismissed the option of enhancing his aptitude. As for acquiring a physique, he could certainly activate a King’s Body, but it wasn’t really necessary.
Conserving one thousand two hundred and fifty years of cultivation wouldn’t allow him to advance straight to the fourth layer of the Tongxuan Realm, nor would it greatly enhance his combat ability. Moreover, his own combat ability had little impact on the upcoming matters; what he needed were Immortal weapons.
With a sigh, Han Li learned more details about the breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm and obtained some secret knowledge from the System.
The path of cultivation was one of defying the heavens, requiring one to continuously seize the natural fortunes of heaven and earth in order to climb step by step to higher realms.
Starting from the Hollow Void Stage, advancing from the God Refining Realm to the Hollow Void Stage necessitated the comprehension of the nascent form of Martial True Intent. This was a critical juncture; comprehending a high level of martial arts would present limitless possibilities in the future, much like Han Li’s ultimate Martial Dao.
But such knowledge was exceedingly secretive, not widespread even in Qianyuan Divine Province or the Endless Yuankun Domain. Perhaps, only those Great Holy Land Schools that had produced Great Emperors and Immortals might be somewhat aware of it.
If one failed to comprehend a high-level Martial Dao during the Hollow Void Stage, there were still opportunities for rectification in the future, such as obtaining some defying fate, starting over with cultivation, building the strongest foundation at every realm, and so forth…
To advance to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, one needed to perfect the Martial True Intent nascent form into their personal Martial True Intent. To advance to the True Martial Realm, it was essential to polish the Martial True Intent and condense a Martial True Pill.
To progress to the Divine Yuan Realm, one had to refine the Martial True Pill to integrate it holistically, and finally, make the Martial True Pill, Divine Spirit, and True Yuan coalesce into a Martial Primordial Spirit.
And to ascend to the Tongxuan Realm, it was necessary to unite the Primordial Spirit, physical body, True Yuan, and one’s own Martial Dao, to foster the True Spirit.
The True Spirit was the hallmark of the mighty beings of the Tongxuan Realm. Only by giving birth to the True Spirit did they have the chance to reincarnate and be reborn.

chapters.title: Chapter 426: 204: Breakthrough, I, The Ancestor, Am Invincible in My Realm!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 426: Chapter 204: Breakthrough, I, The Ancestor, Am Invincible in My Realm!_4
Great beings of the Tongxuan Realm, even if their physical bodies perish and their Primordial Spirits are annihilated, as long as their most core, most vital True Spirit remains, can reincarnate anew.
During reincarnation, the True Spirit absorbs some energies from the unknown, and then re-cultivates a soul. In this process, the True Spirit gradually becomes veiled with mortal dust.
Therefore, after great beings of the Tongxuan Realm are reincarnated, they need to unravel the mystery within the womb, so that the veiled True Spirit may regain its glory. Only then can they recall everything from their past lives.
The True Spirit is the most essential and crucial entity for those above the Tongxuan Realm, with all memories within the Primordial Spirit backed up within it, including one’s innate talent; upon breaking the mystery within the womb after reincarnation, all that is stored within the True Spirit will be restored.
Emerging from the deep void, Han Li once again appeared at Chengdao Peak. His gaze swept over the lands of Myriad Demon Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, Xumi Mountain, and Bai Yujing—the dominions of the Great Holy Land Schools. Were there any now who possessed combat abilities surpassing his own?
His current realm was the pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm, and with the Thousand Sword Scripture, he could unleash combat power of the eighth layer of the Tongxuan Realm. If he were to further employ the Three Mystery Dao Body, with fifteen Dao Bodies alongside his own casting the Thousand Sword Scripture, it would be hard to find an adversary within the eighth layer of the Tongxuan Realm.
If his original body triggered Divine Sense, he could directly enhance his strength by two minor realms, and then his combat ability would match that of a peak power of the Tongxuan Realm.
Of course, that refers to an ordinary power of the Tongxuan Realm.
Those wondrous geniuses and peerless talents who have mastered means beyond the peak of the Tongxuan Realm have abilities that surpass Han Li’s.
In reality, Han Li had a stronger foundation than those peerless talents; he possessed the ultimate martial path, several Heaven Imperial Realm-grade Imperial Weapons, Divine Sense, and mastery over several martial skills comparable to the Quasi Emperor level, all at consummate mastery.
It’s just that the Cultivation Technique he practiced was slightly lacking—the Chaos Scripture was merely close to a Supreme Grade Divine Rank, a standard Cultivation Technique of the Saint Abyss Realm yet a perfect fit for Han Li himself.
Han Li believed that, beyond the Qianyuan Divine Province, amongst those peerless talents in the Endless Yuankun Domain, if they were at the same realm as him, they would be no more than targets for his thrashing.
He, unbeatable within his realm!
These peerless talents could only compete with him if their realms were higher than his.
The Cultivation Techniques practiced by these peerless talents were likely better than his, possibly Quasi Emperor level, Great Emperor level, or even Immortal Scriptures. They might also practice martial skills of these levels, but the higher the grade of the martial skill, the harder it is to master.
Even if a peerless talent were in the Tongxuan Realm, it would be very difficult for them to cultivate a Saint Abyss Realm martial skill to consummate mastery, let alone Quasi Emperor or Great Emperor level martial skills, which they would grasp to an even lesser degree.
Regarding Divine Sense, Han Li did not know if those peerless talents had mastered it, but he was certain they were not his equals in terms of martial path.
Even less so in the aspect of weapons; it’s unlikely that peerless talents of the Tongxuan Realm from the nine mightiest forces within the Yuankun Domain would carry a Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon with them—it would be frightening if they had even a Top Grade one.
Han Li, however, possessed three Supreme Grade Imperial Weapons, all of which recognized him as their master and could be fully revived at any moment—not to mention his Heaven Imperial Realm-level Emperor Formation Array Diagrams for both offense and defense.
Should actual combat arise, not to mention the Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm, he was capable of killing even a Quasi Emperor.
Of course, Han Li would not act that way; doing so would inevitably turn him into a target of all. A martial sovereign of the Divine Yuan Realm, no matter how talented, charming, or defiant of the heavens, ultimately held too low a cultivation; revealing so many Imperial Weapons and Emperor Formation Array Diagrams would be a death sentence.
Meanwhile, in the Huangting Divine Province.
This place was once one of the thirty-six Divine Provinces under the rule of Qianyuan Divine Province in ancient times, only to become independent after the great catastrophe of the ancient era.
Within the Huangting Divine Province, numerous forces existed, including those of the Tongxuan and Saint Abyss Realms. The strongest force was known as Huangting Palace, a Quasi Emperor-level power.
The master of Huangting Palace was a Quasi Emperor, with unfathomably deep strength and recognized as the strongest in Huangting Divine Province.
Although Huangting Palace possessed a Quasi Emperor and aspired to unify the whole of Huangting Divine Province, and even extend its influence to other Divine Provinces, it lacked the strength to do so.
In Huangting Divine Province, there were two Saint Abyss Realm Powers that now also considered themselves Sacred Lands, with Heaven Imperial Realm Imperial Weapons to shore up their fortunes and were thus not fearful of Huangting Palace.
After all, although Huangting Palace had a Quasi Emperor, it only possessed one Top Grade Imperial Weapon, and the combined efforts of the Saints of the other two Sacred Lands, with their Imperial Weapons, were enough to confront them on equal footing.
At this moment, within Huangting Palace, the Quasi Emperor ancestor was receiving a guest.
“My esteemed guest has arrived, and apologize for not having met you from afar; I hope my esteemed guest will forgive me,” the Quasi Emperor ancestor said with a faint smile to the guest sitting opposite.
There sat a visage of breathtaking beauty, in robes whiter than snow, with a light veil concealing her face, ethereal and immaculate, as if a Heavenly Immortal had graced the mortal world, her elegance unmatched by both the ancient and the present.
Zi Miao Zhen sipped a cup of Moonlight Tea, shook her head gently, and said, “There’s no need for such courtesy, Daoist Lan Shan. My visit to Huangting Divine Province is merely in passing.”
She had come from Taibai Divine Province, following the orders of the White Emperor, to perform a task on his behalf—to find the lost soul fragment of Empress Phoenix Moon.
Within the Endless Yuankun Domain, who didn’t know of the White Emperor’s interest in Empress Phoenix Moon?
The White Emperor was a suitor of Empress Phoenix Moon, but she was dedicated to the Dao, seeking to escape the great calamity and leave the Endless Yuankun Domain, without such desires.
The intentions of the White Emperor were clear to Zi Miao Zhen; Empress Phoenix Moon was angered three times over her lost soul fragment. If the White Emperor could locate it and return it to Kunji Divine Province, he would undoubtedly earn a significant place in Empress Phoenix Moon’s good graces.
The White Emperor’s entrusted task was taken seriously by Zi Miao Zhen, however, the White Emperor knew only that the soul fragment of Empress Phoenix Moon was lost within the area of Qianyuan Divine Province, without knowing its exact location.

chapters.title: Chapter 427: 204: Breakthrough, I, The Ancestor, Am Invincible in My Realm!_
chapters.content:
Chapter 427: Chapter 204: Breakthrough, I, The Ancestor, Am Invincible in My Realm!_
The region known as Qianyuan Divine Province is delineated based on the territorial divisions of Ancient Times, encompassing both Qianyuan Divine Province and the thirty-six Divine Provinces it once governed.
There are thirty-seven Divine Provinces in this vast, boundless area; searching for Empress Phoenix Moon’s soul fragment is not something that can be done overnight. Zi Miao Zhen had already prepared herself for a prolonged struggle.
After all, she had just advanced to the Saint Abyss Realm, possessing a lifespan of a hundred thousand years. Spending a hundred or a thousand years here wouldn’t be a problem, and if she succeeded, she would certainly receive rewards from the White Emperor upon her return.
Huangting Divine Province was the eighth Divine Province Zi Miao Zhen investigated, having fully explored it, she concluded that Empress Phoenix Moon’s soul fragment was not there, and she planned to leave.
Unexpectedly, the Quasi-Emperor ancestor of Huangting Dao Palace invited her over. Zi Miao Zhen was clear about the intentions of this Quasi-Emperor ancestor but couldn’t make any decisions or promises on her own.
Hearing Zi Miao Zhen address him as a fellow Daoist, the Quasi-Emperor ancestor didn’t mind and smiled broadly. The other party was from White Emperor City, naturally having a status one level higher, and it was fitting for them to interact as equals.
“Zi Daoist friend, we can be considered old acquaintances. I recall that a thousand years ago, you were still a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor, and now you’ve become a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm in a blink of an eye, truly a dazzling prodigy.”
“In Lan’s opinion, Zi Daoist friend should be ranked in the top ten on the Heavenly Immortal List, and even the top five would not be unreasonable.”
Blue Mountain Quasi-Emperor first reminisced about the past, then lavishly flattered her. As a Quasi-Emperor flattering a newly advanced Saint, he felt no shame.
“Blue Mountain Daoist friend flatters me too much,” Zi Miao Zhen replied with a slight smile and shake of her head.
The Heavenly Immortal List is a ranking released by Tianji Pavilion, targeting the Heavenly Immortals of the entire Endless Yuankun Domain, each person on the list possessing unsurpassed beauty in the Yuankun Domain.
With only fifty spots available, the lowest cultivation required to be on the list is Divine Yuan Realm. The rankings are based on the Heavenly Immortal’s cultivation, potential, beauty, and talent, among other factors.
Zi Miao Zhen was initially ranked around thirty-third, but after her recent breakthrough to the Saint Abyss Realm, she climbed five ranks to twenty-eighth, even higher than some of the Heavenly Immortals at the peak of the Saint Abyss Realm.
While Zi Miao Zhen wished to rank higher, she knew it was unrealistic unless her cultivation progressed dramatically, reaching the peak of the Saint Abyss Realm or even breaking through to the Quasi-Emperor domain, or by obtaining a great opportunity that would significantly boost her potential.
Twenty-nine Heavenly Immortals stood before her, the first being Empress Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu, two peerless empresses sharing the top spot, with Tianji Pavilion not daring to rank one above the other.
From second to eighth were the other seven Heaven Imperial Realm Empresses of the Yuankun Domain. From ninth to twenty-seventh were either Great Saints or Quasi-Emperors; Zi Miao Zhen could not compete with them.
Blue Mountain Quasi-Emperor also smiled, knowing full well it was impossible, but compliments were welcomed by everyone.
After some casual conversation, Blue Mountain Quasi-Emperor finally revealed his intent. “Zi Daoist friend, Lan has an impolite request and hopes for your assistance.”
If it’s such an impolite request, then it’s better left unsaid.
Zi Miao Zhen muttered to herself internally, her expression unchanged, she said, “Please speak, Blue Mountain Daoist friend.”
“Zi Daoist friend is a trusted confidante under the White Emperor and greatly valued by him. I wonder if you could pass a message for Lan…”
Blue Mountain Quasi-Emperor paused, then continued, “Lan wishes to request a White Emperor’s Edict.”
Zi Miao Zhen’s pupils constricted sharply, then relaxed almost instantly, and she shook her head saying, “Blue Mountain Daoist friend, I regret that I cannot accommodate this request.”
A Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor can issue edicts, each one imbued with tremendous power, easily capable of slaying Quasi-Emperors, not to mention those from a peak Heaven Imperial Realm sovereign like the White Emperor.
Once a White Emperor’s Edict is issued, even ordinary Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors must treat it with all seriousness; a slight mishap could easily result in severe injury.
Considering the immense power of an edict, it naturally cannot be easily written. It contains the Great Emperor’s Dao principles, which once inscribed, strips the respective Dao principle from themselves, requiring them to re-cultivate it.
The might of a Great Emperor’s edict is proportional to how much the writing emperor is willing to sacrifice.
This time, Zimei really ran to the Qianyuan Divine Province to find the splinter soul of Empress Huangyue and brought only one top-grade imperial armament. The White Emperor’s Edict would not be given out easily.
“Is there really no way at all? Lan is willing to give everything,” said Blue Mountain Quasi-Emperor, his face bearing a bitter expression.
He had requested a White Emperor’s Edict, naturally not to unify the Huangting Divine Province; that would be an excessive use of minimal talent.
Blue Mountain Quasi-Emperor wanted to use the White Emperor’s Edict to take a gamble in some forbidden land of the Yuankun Domain, to seize a heaven-defying opportunity and increase his chances of ascending to the status of a Great Emperor in the Heaven Imperial Realm.
At the very least, he needed to snatch the Immortal Emperor Pill from the forbidden land. With the Immortal Emperor Pill, he could extend his life by a hundred thousand years, giving himself a chance to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm.
“Blue Mountain friend, you know yourself that even if you give up everything, it won’t equal the value of a White Emperor’s Edict,” said Zimei really and then drifted away.
Blue Mountain Quasi-Emperor fell into silent speechlessness; he just wanted to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm. Why was it so hard?
…….
Qianyuan Divine Province, Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li was admiring the scenery on Chengdao Peak with Lu Tianxiang.
He wrapped his arms around Lu Tianxiang’s soft, slender waist, his chin resting on her shoulder as they whispered sweet nothings to each other.
After a tender moment between the two, Han Li said affectionately, “Xiangxiang, the time is almost ripe.”
“Ah?”
Lu Tianxiang was briefly stunned before a flash of realization crossed her mind and she blurted out, “Husband, are you referring to the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture?”
“Mhm.”
Han Li nodded slightly.
Years ago, he had promised Lu Tianxiang that they would search together for the continuation of the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture.
Due to the significant risks involved, Han Li did not want Lu Tianxiang to go alone, even though she had now advanced to the third level of the True Martial Realm.
“Xiangxiang, can you still sense that guidance in the dark? Let’s set off now,” said Han Li gently.
Han Li didn’t want to delay any longer; in about three months, the incident at Dangyang Mountain would erupt. Once the Dangyang Mountain issue was addressed, he would be caught up in busyness again.
It was better to take advantage of this brief moment of respite to deal with the issues of Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation technique, allowing her to advance rapidly.
Years before, he had felt there were risks, but now he believed there were none, especially since Han Li already possessed four imperial arms of Heaven Imperial Realm caliber, even if two of them were auxiliary imperial arms.
He also had the Emperor Formation Array Diagrams, enough to ensure their safety.
“Of course, I can,” nodded Lu Tianxiang emphatically.
The next instant, Han Li, with Lu Tianxiang in his arms, vanished from Chengdao Peak.
PS: Sigh, what can I say, definitely tomorrow!

chapters.title: Chapter 428: 205: The Emperor Sword is Very Good, It Belongs to the Ancestor Now! We’ll Talk in the Next Life!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 428: Chapter 205: The Emperor Sword is Very Good, It Belongs to the Ancestor Now! We’ll Talk in the Next Life!_1
High above the firmament,
a war chariot crossed the heavens, its body shimmering in purple and gold, bursting with divine light, dazzling and majestic, commanding and awe-inspiring, like a sky god surveying his domain.
Engraved upon the chariot were numerous Sacred Rank Runes, and it featured four Golden Crow engravings, lifelike to the slightest detail. As the chariot soared, one could see four Golden Crows materializing, circling around in flight, their presence lending ever greater speed to the chariot.
Pulling the chariot forward were five exotic beasts, each possessing the early cultivation of the Tongxuan Realm. When the chariot came to a halt, they turned into statues; and when the chariot set off, they revived, leading the chariot onwards.
Within the Sky God War Chariot, the interior was lavishly decorated, arranged exquisitely, forming a small space on its own, over a hundred times larger than it appeared from the outside.
At that moment, Han Li lay on a soft cushion, relishing the ministrations of Sect Hierarch Yun Miaoyi, who fed him grapes.
This journey was to resolve the hidden dangers within the “Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture” and to acquire the subsequent cultivation techniques of this immortal scripture. Following Lu Tianxiang’s description, the distance was likely great, and obviously, Han Li wouldn’t foolishly take to the skies embracing Lu Tianxiang.
He naturally took out a mode of transportation: the Sky God War Chariot, which was a Top Grade Divine Weapon of the Sacred Abyss tier—a treasure Han Li had obtained from opening a treasure box and saw a chance to utilize.
Steering the Sky God War Chariot, Han Li could bask in affectionate moments with Lu Tianxiang inside the chariot, all while journeying to his destination—an utterly carefree and enjoyable experience.
“My lord, is it really okay to be so conspicuous?”
As she put away the unfinished grapes, Lu Tianxiang asked with a hint of worry.
Although surprised by the sight of a Sacred Soldier chariot for travel, Lu Tianxiang was not curious; she had grown used to it, her lord husband already owning several Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons.
Yet, with Han Li’s power clearly insufficient to stand invincible in Qianyuan Divine Province, according to his character, he should be traveling incognito, cultivating in secret rather than revealing himself.
The Sky God War Chariot was too domineering, and driving it across Qianyuan Divine Province was sure to alert the attention of those from Great Holy Land Schools, potentially exposing their home at Chengsheng Mountain.
Without realizing, Lu Tianxiang had also grown accustomed to this discreet growth and quiet breakthroughs, finding the stealthy approach best. As long as there were enough cultivation resources, it was infinitely better to keep a low profile than to engage in battles and killings.
“Don’t worry, sweetheart, they won’t find out,”
Han Li said with a smile, full of confidence.
For safety on the journey, he brought along with him two Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons—the Void Bell and the Time-Sky Tower—while the Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, the Life-Prolonging Furnace, and the Top Grade Emperor Weapon, the Chengdao Vial, were left behind at Chengsheng Mountain to anchor its luck and destiny.
Though these two Emperor Weapons were auxiliary in nature, they were still of the Heaven Imperial Realm tier. Should a true conflict arise, none in Qianyuan Divine Province would stand a chance against them.
However, Han Li did not task Zi Yi or Yao Xi with concealing their tracks; that task fell to the Emperor Formation diagrams he carried with him. With the Emperor Formation masking their fates, even the rulers of the Sacred Lands wouldn’t sense them unless they deliberately activated Immortal Weapons.
The Emperor Formation, known as the “Twelve Heavens Divine Demon Great Formation Diagram,” had become a battle garment ever since Han Li obtained this Heaven Imperial Realm level diagram, ensuring he wore it at all times to prevent mishaps.
Han Li considered the Emperor Formation exceedingly useful—not only could it shield their destiny from prying eyes, but it also served as defense, and in crucial moments, it could launch a deadly offensive.
Hearing this, Lu Tianxiang nodded slightly, then asked, “My lord, is there truly a trap within the ‘Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture’?”
Lu Tianxiang had sensed the call of the scripture when she reached the True Martial Realm, leading her to seek the subsequent cultivation techniques of the “Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture.” She had refrained from doing so, suspecting it to be a trap, only because her lord husband held doubts about it.
Before that, Lu Tianxiang had considered switching her cultivation technique. At the Han Mansion, there were arts of the Sacred Abyss realm available, and there was no need to cling to the Lower Grade Heaven-ranked scripture, especially since the first half of the “Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture” was merely of an ordinary True Martial Realm level.
But seeing her lord husband’s confidence in resolving the problem, Lu Tianxiang repressed her other thoughts. Acquiring the complete immortal scripture would undoubtedly be a great fortune for her.
Lu Tianxiang held a significant sense of crisis within her heart. She was now eager to improve her strength, longing to swiftly progress to the Divine Yuan Realm and even the Tongxuan Realm. An intact “Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture” would be a shortcut to achieving this goal.
Her worry did not stem from external threats, but rather from internal ones. Her lord husband had married too many wives, causing Lu Tianxiang considerable anxiety.
In the past, as her lord husband’s first wife, she had always positioned herself as the foremost among his consorts—after all, she was the earliest to join him and the highest in terms of cultivation.
Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and even Yao Xi, as well as the wives in The Li Manor, had all been of lesser cultivation levels compared to her, cementing her position securely. Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and her other sisters showed her great respect.
But in the recent years, her lord husband’s cultivation had soared, and he had taken on many new wives. Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, and others had higher cultivation levels than her and were no less appealing in appearance, and some were even more so.
She also learned from her lord husband some secrets: Yao Xi and the newly arrived Murong Ying were suspected to be the reincarnated soul shards of female emperors from the Heaven Imperial Realm, with astonishingly prominent backgrounds.
Lu Tianxiang felt she could no longer hold the fort. Long Yue was close to breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm. Xue Yueqing was already a Demon Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm, advancing towards the Tongxuan Realm. With Yao Xi and Murong Ying as the female emperors’ soul shards, their cultivation speed was startlingly fast.
Lu Tianxiang realized that while they were cordial towards her, they would not show her the same deference as Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, Gongsun Yue, and others did. After all, they had known her for less time, and their status and cultivation levels far surpassed her own.

chapters.title: Chapter 429: 205: The Emperor Sword is Very Good, It Belongs to the Ancestor Now! We'll Talk in the Next Life!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: Chapter 205: The Emperor Sword is Very Good, It Belongs to the Ancestor Now! We’ll Talk in the Next Life!_2
“`
If I continue to take wives like this, in the future I will have partners from the Tongxuan Realm and even the Sacred Abyss Realm, so Lu Tianxiang is eager to enhance her cultivation level, partly to secure her own position and partly to secure her child’s position.
Her talent had already risen to Second Grade, and in two more months, she would undergo the second Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism, by which time her talent would reach First Grade.
With First Grade talent, she could stand on the same starting line as Xue Yueqing, Long Yue, and the others, but to narrow the gap, or even to surpass them in cultivation, she would have to rely on the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture.
Many things in Han Mansion could assist in cultivation, such as dual cultivation with her husband, going to Enlightenment Peak to comprehend the Enlightenment Stones, entering the Time-Sky Tower to cultivate, going to Yangdao Peak to cultivate within the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s range, going to Cangdao Peak, entering Cnagdao Hall to comprehend profound laws, and even going to Yandao Peak’s Battle Tower for trials…
But these couldn’t help Lu Tianxiang take a shortcut to overtake the others; what she could use, Xue Yueqing, Long Yue, Bai Keqing, and others could as well, as the wives of the husband all received the same treatment.
Only a complete Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture was Lu Tianxiang’s biggest trump card, with her husband’s help, she could quickly and secretly spread faith, enhancing her strength.
When her husband’s power further improved and he no longer feared the great Sacred Lands of the Qianyuan Divine Province, she could openly preach, much like Buddhism collecting faith, and then her cultivation level would rise even more swiftly.
“There should be one.”
Han Li wrapped his arms around Lu Tianxiang’s soft waist, his big hand restlessly moving as he thoughtfully said.
He couldn’t be certain there really was one, he just felt there probably was one, and based on his own understanding, Han Li believed the person opposite was most likely a fisherman.
But with him accompanying Lu Tianxiang, the fisherman was doomed to come up empty-handed, and would even be counter-fished by them, and everything would be taken from him to fulfill Lu Tianxiang.
Lu Tianxiang was his first wife, and their relationship had always been good, even improving over time. Han Li also knew that Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation was too low, True Martial Realm Triple Heaven did not suit her status, and he was thinking of ways to help her.
Han Mansion had many elixirs to enhance True Martial Realm cultivation levels, which Lu Tianxiang had at her disposal. This could only make her cultivation progress by leaps and bounds, but overtaking by a shortcut was impossible.
Han Li had no other great opportunities to give to Lu Tianxiang, even if there were any, it would not be good to give them, because he always adhered to the principle of equal treatment and making sure blessings fell on everyone, so that all the charming wives and beautiful concubines could live in harmony, at least there were no overt conflicts on the surface.
He always dealt with affairs fairly and justly, with little personal bias, whether it was Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Xue Yueqing, or the other women, they were all his beautiful wives and had given birth to his children.
And beauties like Liu Yuexin, Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, and Zhou Zhiruo, despite having a somewhat lower status than his wives, received the same treatment as other beauties.
In reality, for the wives and concubines who entered his life early, Han Li intentionally or unintentionally skewed resources in their favor, after all, those who came first were bound to lose out more, having married him when he was weak, and thus, comparatively, they had given more.
The Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture was one of the ways Han Li helped Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang, securing for her this grand opportunity, so Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang could take off.
Han Li himself also had a need for the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture; if he could integrate this immortal scripture into his Chaos Scripture, the grade of the Chaos Scripture would definitely increase significantly. Although it might not reach the level of an Immortal Scripture, it could potentially reach the level of an Emperor Scripture, or at least be of Quasi Emperor Rank.
After a significant increase in the grade of the Chaos Scripture, it would greatly enhance his strength. There are many factors affecting a cultivator’s combat ability, and the grade of the cultivation technique is one of the most fundamental determinants.
In the Sky God War Chariot, Han Li and Lu Tianxiang were endearingly intimate, whispering sweet nothings and showing affection.
“We’ve arrived.”
After some time, Han Li suddenly spoke, and the Sky God War Chariot came to a stop, hovering above the ninth heaven.
Han Li stepped out with Lu Tianxiang, casually storing the Sky God War Chariot, and looking down, he asked casually, “Xiangxiang, sense the exact location.”
Below was a vast, boundless ocean. Han Li’s divine sense surged out to probe the area, confirming their location was still within the bounds of the Qianyuan Divine Province.
This place was not the East Sea but the South Sea.
The South Sea was far from the Xuan Domain. To reach it from the Xuan Domain, one must first pass through the Devil Region, then could either head east from the Chaotic Domain to the northern part of the South Sea or traverse the Demon Domain from the southeast to enter the South Sea.
The South Sea was no less vast and misty than the East Sea, equally boundless in its expanse. The South Sea, however, was dotted with islands, somewhat more scattered than places like the Penglai Immortal Island, which had massive land masses.
The largest islands in the South Sea were only about five million miles in circumference, and there were about a dozen such islands, all occupied by True Martial Realm forces.
Compared with the massive land masses of Penglai Immortal Island, which span thirty million miles, these were small. Yet, compared to the Earth from Han Li’s previous life, the scale was many times larger.
In terms of size, Earth was about 45,000 miles in circumference, similar in size to those ordinary small islands in the South Sea; the largest island in the South Sea was equivalent to over 100 Earths.
Lu Tianxiang nodded her head. Coming to this place, the indistinct call was no longer faint; it was extremely clear, and she could sense the exact direction.
After carefully sensing for a while, Lu Tianxiang said, “Husband, it’s on that large island about sixty miles ahead.”
Han Li raised his eyebrows and looked forward, the large island ahead being one of the largest in the South Sea. He had just probed and found that it was occupied by a True Martial Realm force known as the Mincang Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 430: 205: The Emperor Sword is Very Good, It Belongs to the Ancestor Now! We'll Talk in the Next Life!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Chapter 205: The Emperor Sword is Very Good, It Belongs to the Ancestor Now! We’ll Talk in the Next Life!_3
“Let us go.”
Han Li smiled lightly, wrapping his arm around Lu Tianxiang’s waist, and their figures vanished on the spot.
In the next instant, the pair appeared on this sizable island land, alighting in a certain southeastern area.
Lu Tianxiang looked towards the valley ahead and said, “Husband, I sense that the source of the calling is within this valley.”
Han Li nodded slightly, but he didn’t immediately proceed.
The valley was serene, with a stream flowing out from within, and towering mountains on either side, each precisely three thousand three hundred and thirty feet tall.
Han Li felt something was odd, as it seemed to be a gateway of sorts.
His gaze shifted upwards to the skies between the mountains, his eyes flickering with divine light and interwoven runes, trying to peer into the secret, yet he found nothing.
“Husband, what is it?”
Lu Tianxiang followed Han Li’s gaze but noticed nothing amiss and asked puzzledly.
The obscure call within grew stronger and stronger, persistently urging her to enter quickly, promising great fortune. Had Han Li not been by her side, Lu Tianxiang suspected she might have been beguiled by the calling.
“There’s a problem.”
Han Li conveyed through telepathy. Although he could not discern anything, the Emperor Formation Diagrams on him were issuing a warning.
After some thought, Han Li took off the bracelet on his right hand, from which hung a small tower, and placed it on Lu Tianxiang’s smooth and fair wrist, saying, “Zi Yi, protect Tianxiang in a moment.”
“Of course, Master~”
Zi Yi’s voice echoed in the telepathic channel between Han Li and Lu Tianxiang.
Following that, with a thought from Han Li, he drew upon a thread of the Emperor Formation’s power into his eyes. When he looked again at the skies between the two mountains, his brows furrowed instantly.
Indeed, it was a gateway!
With the bolstering power of the Emperor Formations, Han Li saw everything clearly. The doorframe in the sky between the mountains was made from an ethereal, pale silvery glow, beneath which hung an ancient bronze sword.
The bronze sword was no more than three feet in length, covered in patina, its might hidden and dormant, yet Han Li discerned it to be a genuine Emperor Weapon.
“Quite the fisherman,” Han Li snorted coldly.
If they had entered without noticing, their path of retreat would have been cut by the ancient bronze sword. Should its might erupt, it would catch them off guard.
However, Han Li believed this bronze sword was probably not meant for them. After all, those who came here seeking the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture were destined to not be of high cultivation, generally only at the True Martial Realm.
The fisherman who hung the bronze sword here likely meant it for other powerful beings; Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm was not worthy of having the Emperor Sword unleash its power.
“The Emperor Sword is fine, but now it’s mine,” Han Li said with a light chuckle, proceeding to issue instructions to Zi Yi and Artifact Spirit.
Knowing full well there was an ambush within the valley, Han Li naturally wouldn’t blunder in carelessly. He decided to take the bronze sword first.
If the fisherman within was too strong, they would simply retreat. It wasn’t as if the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture could only be found here. Lu Tianxiang had said that another Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, suppressed beneath Leizhou, had it as well.
After weighing his options, Han Li felt that this fisherman was easier to handle, which is why he had hurried here with Lu Tianxiang.
Receiving Han Li’s instructions, Zi Yi and Artifact Spirit promptly activated the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell, their fearsome might bearing down on the ancient bronze sword.
Simultaneously, Han Li flicked his Emperor Formation Diagrams, which vanished in an instant only to cover tens of thousands of miles in the next, engulfing the entire valley within it.
“Hum~”
The bronze sword lit up, shedding all the rust in a flash, from which beams of brilliant sword light burst forth, resisting the suppression of the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell.
At this moment, the spirit of the bronze sword was astonished, wondering how such formidable foes had appeared suddenly. It sensed attacks on its main body from two Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons, along with an array of the Heaven Imperial Realm’s caliber expanding and striking it as well.
Previously, when Han Li cloaked himself with the Emperor Formation Diagrams, he concealed the celestial mechanisms, and with the Time-Sky Tower and Void Bell blurring time and causality, the spirit of the bronze sword hadn’t noticed anything special about Han Li.
Or rather, it hadn’t paid any attention at all. It had seen too many True Martial Realm cultivators come here and never needed to lift a finger themselves.
But now, it had miscalculated. It realized it had ensnared a prehistoric giant crocodile that would instead be the end of them.
“You shall not succeed!”
Facing the onslaught of the Emperor Formation Diagrams, Time-Sky Tower, and Void Bell, and feeling the terrifying suppressive force, the spirit of the bronze sword bellowed, as infinite sword lights spread out, illuminating the heavens and the earth, timeless, wanting to carve out existence anew.
Yet, what left the bronze sword spirit in despair was that despite its full-force eruption, none of its might was transmitted to the outside world. It was all shielded by the spectacular Emperor Formation evolved from the Emperor Formation Diagrams, with the two Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons relentlessly besieging it.
“Detestable!”
Under the assault of the peerless Emperor Formation, Void Bell, and Time-Sky Tower, even the fully revived bronze sword was of no avail, quickly subdued.
Although both Top Grade Emperor Weapons and Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons were of the Heaven Imperial Realm’s level, the gulf between them was immense. With two Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons plus a Top Grade Emperor Formation besieging the bronze sword, it could not hold its ground.
Han Li beckoned, and the subdued bronze sword flew to him, held in his hand, all its might sealed, now like a simple bronze sword.
Lu Tianxiang witnessed everything, her beautiful eyes filled with wonder. Even knowing her husband’s cards, she was still shocked to see them played.
This was the power on the tier of the Heaven Imperial Realm!
If not for the Emperor Formation concealed by heaven’s secrets, the Time-Sky Tower and Void Bell confusing time and causality, and it being three against one, the commotion would certainly have reached the outside, causing this large island land of five million miles to shatter instantly, with countless lives within ceasing to exist in a flash.

chapters.title: Chapter 431: 205: The Emperor Sword is Very Good, It Belongs to the Ancestor Now! We'll Talk in the Next Life!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 431: Chapter 205: The Emperor Sword is Very Good, It Belongs to the Ancestor Now! We’ll Talk in the Next Life!_4
But now, the situation was easily resolved, and the outside world had no idea, all those mortals and cultivators remained unaware of the Divine Weapons Battle that had just taken place here.
“Behave, or I’ll erase your artifact spirit,” Han Li said indifferently, addressing the struggling ancient bronze sword in his hand.
Threatened and intimidated, the artifact spirit of the ancient bronze sword instantaneously became compliant. The bronze sword ceased its struggles and allowed Han Li to play with it as he wished.
He casually stowed the ancient bronze sword into the System Space to prevent any accidents and then took Lu Tianxiang’s hand, heading into the valley.
He knew that the Fishing Elder within the valley must be aware of his arrival, considering the speedy conclusion of the Divine Weapons Battle, and although he’d taken measures to conceal the commotion, the Fishing Elder would definitely be in the know.
In fact, Han Li had guessed correctly.
The moment the Divine Weapons Battle erupted, the Fishing Elder in the valley was aware of it.
Feeling the might of the two Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons, he knew the ancient bronze sword was in dire straits. His first thought was to flee, to abandon this place, and even the sole Emperor Weapon he possessed.
But he found he couldn’t escape at all. An unparalleled Emperor Formation had covered a radius of a hundred thousand miles, preventing him from leaving.
This realization left the Fishing Elder in despair. Having fished for tens of thousands of years, eating countless small fish, he had now caught a Prehistoric Giant Crocodile and found himself about to be devoured instead.
Within the Emperor Formation, twelve deities manifested, closing in from twelve directions, herding the Fishing Elder back into the valley. Then they stood around the valley, watching silently, imposing immense psychological pressure on the Fishing Elder.
He was merely a Saint of the Heavenly Abyss Realm, but these twelve deities were all at the pinnacle of the Quasi Emperor level. Even if he wielded the Quasi Emperor Weapon, he was utterly unable to cope.
It was not long before the Fishing Elder realized that the Divine Weapons Battle had ended. With a sigh in his heart, he sat cross-legged deep in the valley, calmly awaiting the arrival of the Prehistoric Giant Crocodile.
Soon, the Fishing Elder of the Heavenly Abyss Realm saw two figures approaching together, a man, and a woman. The man was handsome and striking, the woman was as beautiful as a goddess, they looked like a couple descended from heaven.
“Fellow Daoist, this all has been a misunderstanding, please let me explain,” the Fishing Elder hastily started to speak before Han Li and Lu Tianxiang could utter a word.
“A misunderstanding? Then explain it to this elder,” Han Li said calmly.
He discovered that the Fishing Elder was actually a Saint of the Heavenly Abyss Realm, truly cunning and deceitful. A Saint hiding and fishing in the islands of the South Sea was a rarity, as the great Sacred Lands across the Qianyuan Divine Province did not have Saints of the Heavenly Abyss Realm.
Lu Tianxiang pursed her red lips, remaining silent, but her expression looked rather poor. The Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture did indeed contain traps.
If she hadn’t been accompanied by her husband, the consequences would have been unthinkable, as she was no match for a Saint of the Heavenly Abyss Realm.
“Fellow Daoist, you are here for the subsequent part of the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture, I presume. I have been waiting here for years for this, in hopes of finding a suitable successor, and at last, it seems my wait is over…”
The Fishing Elder rattled on, attempting to portray himself as a positive figure.
According to the Fishing Elder, he had been injured back in the day and had ended up in the South Sea of Qianyuan Divine Province by accident. Believing his end was near, he passed on the first part of the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture, hoping that someone in the Qianyuan Divine Province could cultivate to the True Martial Realm and then find this place to inherit his legacy.
However, as his injuries gradually healed and he eventually recovered, he continued waiting here, hoping to take a disciple to pass on the mantle before leaving the Qianyuan Divine Province to seek revenge on his enemies.
Han Li remained impassive, unmoved by the story.
If the Fishing Elder was really as he claimed, he would not have hung the Emperor Sword at the entrance. Besides, Han Li sensed many grievances in the valley, unaware of how many cultivators of the True Martial Realm had perished here.
Seeing Han Li’s silence, the Fishing Elder’s heart sank.
He could sense that the female cultivator had practiced the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture, and while she might have enjoyed some benefits, she had brought a Prehistoric Giant Crocodile with her, which gave the Fishing Elder unspeakable difficulties.
The male cultivator, although merely at the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm, had too many methods; he possessed two Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons and a set of Array Diagrams, pushing the Fishing Elder into a corner.
“Fellow Daoist, I still have things to discuss…” Desperate thoughts racing, the Fishing Elder hurriedly began to speak, hoping to stabilize this Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor.
“Let’s talk in your next life,” Han Li said indifferently, as one of the deities manifested by the Array Diagrams took action – a Three-legged Golden Crow. Although not a pureblooded one, it possessed the combat ability of a Quasi Emperor at its peak.
The Three-legged Golden Crow opened its beak, and rolling waves of True Solar Fire erupted, burning the void itself, about to annihilate the Fishing Elder of the Heavenly Abyss Realm in a single strike.
The Fishing Elder let out an angry shout, and a vast Primordial Spirit appeared behind him, imbued with Pure Yang, towering at thirty million zhang high. Its aura shone across the heavens, illuminating everything.
Above the mighty Pure Yang Primordial Spirit, a Heavenly Abyss spread across the sky, bursting forth with majestic and boundless Sacred Light. Countless runes exploded, overwhelming the skies, merging with the Pure Yang Primordial Spirit.
Fortified by the Heavenly Abyss, the Primordial Spirit wielded a Silver Sky Spear, a mid-grade Emperor Weapon, unleashing unparalleled force that even chopped through the True Solar Fire.
“Hmph!”
Han Li snorted coldly, and in an instant, all twelve deities acted in unison. The power of the Immortal Sky Concealing Formation exploded, empowering the twelve deities, as they combined their strength for a collective strike.
Boom!
The Silver Sky Spear fell straight down, embedding itself into the earth, yet it did not unleash its power again, as its Artifact Spirit recognized the situation.
The Fishing Elder was directly obliterated by this strike from the Heaven Imperial Realm, his body and Primordial Spirit shattered, resulting in an instant death.
His True Spirit tried to flee, to reincarnate anew, but Han Li would not let it escape so easily. With a sweep of the Array Diagrams, the True Spirit was suppressed.

chapters.title: Chapter 432: 205: The Emperor Sword is Very Good, It Belongs to the Ancestor Now! We'll Talk in the Next Life!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 432: Chapter 205: The Emperor Sword is Very Good, It Belongs to the Ancestor Now! We’ll Talk in the Next Life!_5
“It’s done.”
Han Li looked at Lu Tianxiang and embraced her with a kiss.
A look of excitement emerged on Lu Tianxiang’s face as well. They had been watching the entire battle, and with the protection of the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell, they hadn’t suffered any harm.
“Zi Yi, retrieve all the memories from the True Spirit,” Han Li instructed.
After all, this was the True Spirit of a Saint from the Saint Abyss Realm; Han Li didn’t dare to act personally, worrying about any accidents, so it was safest to let the divine weapon do it.
“Okay, Master~”
Zi Yi complied, and a strand of the Emperor’s Light from the Void Bell fell onto the True Spirit within the Emperor Formation Diagrams.
This fisherman’s True Spirit still wanted to resist, having hidden techniques and intending an assassination on Han Li. He hadn’t anticipated Han Li to be so cautious, not falling for it.
Soon, Zi Yi had extracted all the memories stored within the True Spirit, and she also casually extinguished it.
After Zi Yi transferred the memories to him, Han Li absorbed and digested them, then sighed.
This fisherman really was someone on the same path. The truth was completely different from what the fisherman had said.
The fisherman had lived for over five thousand years. In his youth, he underwent some melodramatic events. His childhood sweetheart conspired with an outsider to push him off a cliff, leading to an unexpected adventure for him.
In the middle of that cliff was an Ancient Secret Realm. Anyone who fell off the cliff would get sucked into it, and only those who passed its trials could leave alive.
The fisherman passed the tests and obtained the inheritance of the Secret Realm. The master of this Ancient Secret Realm was a Great Emperor from the Heaven Imperial Realm. The Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture was his Cultivation Technique, indeed an Immortal Scripture, but not one he had created himself.
The bronze ancient sword was his personal Emperor Weapon, and the Silver Sky Spear was also one of his Emperor Weapons.
Before the outbreak of the Ancient Cataclysm, this Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor rejected the Sacred Land’s invitation, hid in this Secret Territory, hoping to survive, but ultimately, he did not succeed.
After receiving the Emperor’s legacy, the fisherman also took the Emperor Weapons with him, though they did not recognize him as their master. Nevertheless, he left with them, triumphantly returning home to experience another melodramatic tale.
Later, the fisherman quickly cultivated to the Divine Yuan Realm using the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture. Due to some matters, he clashed with the Sacred Land. At that time, he thought with the bronze ancient sword, the Sacred Land couldn’t do anything to him.
Then, the fisherman got a lesson, suffered a beating, and barely escaped Qianyuan Divine Province, coming here to South Sea to hide on this island.
After that incident, the fisherman didn’t dare cause trouble again, became more cautious, deciding to become a fisherman. Apart from occasionally sneaking back to Qianyuan Divine Province to set up ruins and Secret Territories, leaving behind the first half of the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture, he stayed here most of the time.
For thousands of years, many True Martial Realm Emperors Wu came here and were all eaten by the fisherman. He refined their gathered faith to use for himself, enhancing his cultivation.
He also quietly spread teachings in the South Sea, becoming a deity in the hearts of countless common folk, gaining enormous faith that allowed his cultivation to soar, advancing to the Saint Abyss Realm.
The fisherman had originally wanted to continue laying low for tens of thousands of years until he could cultivate to the Quasi Emperor, even the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, and then take his revenge. However, he met Han Li and prematurely met his end.
“A precedent for others to learn from,” Han Li remarked sentimentally. In the end, he took the Silver Sky Spear and the fisherman’s spatial belt, boarded the Sky God War Chariot with Lu Tianxiang, and began the journey back.
On the return trip, Han Li inspected the fisherman’s spatial belt and was quite satisfied with the spoils. After all, the man had inherited part of the legacy of the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor; it was rich enough to significantly bolster the foundation of Han Mansion.
Han Li carefully examined the complete version of the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture and discovered that this cultivation technique actually had significant flaws, making it very difficult to become immortal.
While accepting the incense offerings of all beings could make one’s cultivation progress by leaps and bounds, in the end, it would trap the practitioner in the incense offerings, making it impossible to become immortal.
Immortality required transcending tribulation and cleansing karma, but the karma associated with the incense offerings of all beings was too immense, making it even more challenging to break free than the regular path to immortality, more than ten times harder.
Of course, once the path to immortality was clear, such an immortal would be much stronger than an ordinary Heavenly Immortal. Generally speaking, the more powerful the heavenly tribulation, the stronger the Heavenly Immortal that emerged from it.
After some thought, Han Li said to Lu Tianxiang, “Xiangxiang, you must cultivate this Immortal Scripture with caution. It is best to integrate it with the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture and then use this scripture as the core to deduce a cultivation technique that suits you well.”
Lu Tianxiang nodded and said, “Don’t worry, husband; I understand.”
She had read the complete version of the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture and was aware of its risks. Lacking the confidence to transcend the Immortal Tribulation, she had no choice but to seek another method.
By integrating it with the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture and transforming it into another cultivation technique suitable for her, she might be able to extract the essence of the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture and ultimately perhaps find a way through.
“As long as you understand,” he replied.
Han Li breathed a sigh of relief, his mind at ease, and then turned his thoughts to another matter.
It concerned the decline of the Qianyuan Divine Province.
He had learned of this from the memories of the fisherman, who in turn knew it from the inheritance of the Great Emperor.
“So the Qianyuan Divine Province of ancient times actually had such a background,” Han Li silently sighed.
In ancient times, the Qianyuan Divine Province was home to a True Immortal and several Heavenly Immortals, one of the most dominant forces in the whole Endless Yuankun Domain, pressing down on the domain and ruling over the Thirty-three Divine Provinces in all their glory.
To surmount the great ancient catastrophe, the True Immortal of the Qianyuan Divine Province led the way, and together with several Heavenly Immortals, they devised a shocking and outrageous plan.
This plan involved all aspects of the Qianyuan Divine Province and even included the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors and Quasi Emperors of the Thirty-three Divine Provinces, with even the pinnacle of the Saintly Abyss Realm joining in.
If successful, they would reap enormous benefits, and they would not have to worry about the catastrophe in the future, able to live freely and enjoy longevity.
The Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor who lay hidden in the Secret Territory was pessimistic about this, declining the invitation. As he expected, the Qianyuan Divine Province failed, suffered heavy losses, and fell into decline, never recovering. The Great Emperor also did not survive the catastrophe.
“Fortunately, the old ancestor still has more than two billion years,” Han Li muttered to himself. He still had plenty of time to grow, more than two billion years to become strong enough to survive the great catastrophe, and to protect the Han Mansion.
Not long after, the Sky God War Chariot silently returned to the Han Mansion at Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li and Lu Tianxiang both began cultivating the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture, one as a secondary practice and the other as a primary one.
In the blink of an eye, three months passed.
In the Xuan Domain, Dangyang Mountain,
The seal here completely shattered, a terrifying aura surged to the skies and affected a vast stretch of the Xuan Domain, causing a major upheaval.
