All eyes in the Qianyuan Divine Province turned towards this event.

chapters.title: Chapter 433: 206: The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, with Grandpa Han at the very end!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 433: Chapter 206: The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind, with Grandpa Han at the very end!_1
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
After the Life-Prolonging Furnace evolved into a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, an internal small space was also created.
At this moment, Patriarch Han was testing the strength of Yin Ling’s techniques, and the two were engaged in an intense close-quarters battle here, exchanging blows back and forth until they were both exhausted.
Only after Patriarch Han transmitted countless profound principles to Yin Ling did he leave, contented.
Arriving at Chengdao Peak, Han Li overlooked the entire Chengsheng Mountain, feeling a sense of pleasure in his heart.
Although only three months had passed, the development speed of the Han Mansion was accelerating, entering a rapid and vigorous phase of growth, with good news heard every day.
Three months ago, Han Li took Lu Tianxiang to the South Sea to slay the Fisherman, obtaining the subsequent Cultivation Technique of the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture, which Lu Tianxiang, having cultivated the complete Immortal Scripture, broke through to the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm in just three months.
Han Li also successfully integrated this technique into the Chaos Scripture, greatly elevating its grade to the Emperor Level Top Grade, which belongs to the top Quasi Emperor rank Cultivation Techniques.
If not for the many aspects of the Immortal Scripture that were unsuitable for him, after absorbing this scripture, his Chaos Scripture would have advanced to a true Emperor Scripture.
Due to the significant upgrade in Cultivation Technique grade, Han Li’s own strength also increased markedly, the most noticeable change being the transformation of his True Yuan into Mana within his body.
Mana is of a higher order than True Yuan, and Cultivators generally need to reach the Saint Abyss Realm to condense Mana; Han Li, due to practicing an Emperor Level Top Grade technique, also saw a considerable enhancement in his Mana reserves, matching the power of eighth-level Tongxuan Realm, boosting him up by two small realms.
From the Fisherman, he also obtained many Sacred Soldiers and Emperor Weapons, such as the Top Grade Emperor Weapon Ancient Bronze Sword, the Mid Grade Emperor Weapon Silver Sky Spear, and the Lower Grade Emperor Weapon Haotian Hammer, and another seven or eight Sacred Soldiers.
Now, these Emperor Weapons and Sacred Soldiers were all loyal and acknowledged their master; Han Li planted the Ancient Bronze Sword on Chengdao Peak to guard Chengsheng Mountain, and the Silver Sky Spear was placed in The Li Manor’s Chong Xiao Pavilion.
The Haotian Hammer and the other Sacred Soldiers were left for his wives and concubines to choose from; those they liked they used, those they did not were cast into the Han Mansion’s treasure vault to reward descendants or for exchange in the future.
In the three months, Han Li opened three treasure chests and obtained three treasures, but regrettably, none were particularly impressive, making him doubt whether his luck was exhausted after obtaining the Creation Stone last time.
However, he thought it wasn’t too bad, considering them as groundwork for the future; perhaps after advancing to the Tongxuan Realm, he might strike it big and obtain an Immortal Weapon.
He placed all three treasures into the Han Mansion’s treasure vault, leaving them for his descendants to exchange. They were of no use to him, but they would be valuable to his descendants.
Thinking of his offspring, Han Li sighed.
In three months, the number of descendants in the Han Mansion had increased by several hundred, but it fell short of reaching 5,000, lacking just a bit; there were now only 4,983, and a few more days were needed to qualify for the reward.
The total number of descendants increased by 380, and the number of talents among them went up by 185, almost a 2:1 ratio, which Han Li found quite satisfactory as the gap was further narrowing.
Although Patriarch Han’s realm had not yet reached the Tongxuan Realm, his lifespan was nearly comparable, as his natural lifespan reached 9,733 years, which is close to the ten thousand years that a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse would live.
Breaking through from the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm to the Tongxuan Realm required 2,500 years of cultivation base; Han Li had so far accumulated 2,050 years, still short of 450 years.
Han Li’s sigh was because he would not be able to advance to the Tongxuan Realm before the outbreak of the Dangyang Mountain incident, which could erupt at any time, and he still needed a few more days to accumulate enough cultivation base.
Once the number of descendants reached 5,000, Han Li would gain an additional 600 years of cultivation base, by then he would have sufficient cultivation base to break through to the Tongxuan Realm, but it was too late.
Nevertheless, Han Li felt the issue was not significant, as with his Combat Ability, dealing with these matters should be quite simple, as long as nothing unexpected occurred.
After withdrawing his gaze, Han Li then looked towards Capital City, extending his Divine Sense in that direction, encompassing the entire Capital City.
His Divine Sense was now rivaling the fourth level of the Tongxuan Realm, and if pushed to its limit, could cover an area of fifty million li in radius; Capital City was only two million li away from Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li saw that The Li Manor in the Capital City was bustling with preparations; his wives and concubines there were no longer in closed cultivation, every one of them with an expectant look in their eyes.
At first, only The Li Manor’s beautiful wives, such as Chu Xianlin, Xue Qingyi, Song Zhixuan, and others, knew his true identity, but now all his wives and concubines were aware.
After all, The Li Manor was soon to be integrated into the Han Mansion, and it was time to inform them, allowing them to prepare in advance and not be caught off guard.
Not only were the wives and concubines of The Li Manor informed, but Han Li’s offspring there also learned the truth, even changing their names back, all adopting the Han surname.
For example, the children of Xue Qingyi included Han Yonghuo and Han Yongyi, the children of Chu Xianlin included Han Yonglin and Han Yonglin, the children of Song Zhixuan included Han Yongzhi and Han Yongxuan, and the children of Feng Ziyue included Han Yongfeng and Han Yongyue.
Qiu Shuhui was the last wife Han Li took at The Li Manor, currently with only one offspring, named Han Yongyu.
In these three months, Han Li took on few concubines, only adding one concubine named Chen Duling from a prominent family in the Capital City.
Outsiders speculated whether the master of The Li Manor had changed his ways, but in reality, Han Li was preparing for the future; after the Dangyang Mountain incident concludes and the two mansions merge, Han Li would implement new standards for marrying and taking concubines throughout the Xuan Domain.
Henceforth, only women Cultivators with a beauty score above eighty-five and a talent of Fifth or Fourth Grade could become his concubines, and only those with a beauty score above ninety and a talent of Third Grade or higher could become his wives.

chapters.title: Chapter 434: 206 The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind; Grand Elder Han at the very end!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 434: Chapter 206 The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind; Grand Elder Han at the very end!_2
“`
This would greatly reduce the number of wives and concubines, improve quality, and also leave some surplus for the descendants of Han Mansion.
After the Dangyang Mountain event concludes, Han Li plans to completely retreat behind the scenes, manipulating the entire Qianyuan Divine Province from the shadows. By then, the descendants of Han Mansion will traverse the Qianyuan Divine Province.
When these descendants venture out for their trials, their cultivation will already be high, with the God Refining Realm being the bare minimum and Gurus in the Void Realm being quite common. If some more years pass, many outstanding descendants of Han Mansion may reach the Myriad Phenomena Realm and even the True Martial Realm.
Han Li withdrew his Divine Sense, intending to find a charming wife or beautiful concubine for dual cultivation when he noticed Gongsun Yue approaching him.
Under Han Li’s nurturing, Gongsun Yue’s cultivation improved by leaps and bounds. Less than a year away from breaking through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, she had already reached its late stages. Others like Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi were cultivating in the ninth heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, on the verge of breaking through to the True Martial Realm.
Not just these three, but charming wives like Xue Yueqing, Long Yue, Bai Keqing, Yao Xi, Murong Ying, and beautiful consorts like Liu Yuexin, Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, Zhou Zhiruo, and Chu Yumeng were all advancing rapidly in their cultivation.
The reasons for this could be attributed to six factors.
First was the improvement in Han Li’s own cultivation, which enhanced the effects of dual cultivation. Second, their innate talent improved to Second Grade, naturally increasing their cultivation speed by many times.
Third, Chengsheng Mountain now had an Emperor Level Lower Grade Dragon Vein, with immensely dense Spiritual Energy, even richer on Chengdao Peak. Fourth, there was a continuous supply of pills that promoted the cultivation for the Myriad Phenomena Realm. With the Chengdao Vial, Han Mansion was no longer short on pills below the Emperor Level.
Fifth was the quality of cultivation techniques; the high-grade cultivation techniques at Han Mansion were increasing. From the True Martial Realm to the Holy Abyss Realm, they had access to study powerful techniques, which could also be integrated into the Yin and Yang Five Elements Scripture to deduce a perfect technique suited to oneself.
With the improvement in the quality of cultivation techniques, the speed of cultivation increased significantly.
Sixth was the influence of the Time-Sky Tower. Han Li’s charming wives and beautiful concubines rarely visited Enlightenment Peak, not competing with their descendants for the cultivation areas within range of the Life-Prolonging Furnace. Instead, they entered the Time-Sky Tower for cultivation.
Since evolving into a Supreme Grade imperial weapon, the auxiliary effects of the Time-Sky Tower had soared dramatically, allowing many more people to cultivate inside. Even if all of Han Li’s wives and concubines cultivated there, there would still be more than enough space.
The first three levels of the Time-Sky Tower can accommodate a total of one hundred and twenty-five thousand Cultivators. Currently, including Guest Elders, protectors, maids, and so on, Han Mansion didn’t have more than fifty thousand people.
In Ancient Times, an imperial weapon like the Time-Sky Tower could only be owned by the most powerful Supreme Territories and Great Holy Land Schools, which had tens of millions or even billions of disciples. The spots in treasures like the Time-Sky Tower were simply not enough for them.
As of now, Han Mansion still falls short of becoming a Great Holy Land School, and the population isn’t large, resulting in many vacancies in the Time-Sky Tower.
Therefore, Han Li relaxed the standards, opening it up to guards, protectors, Guest Elders, and even maids, granting them partial access. They could use their Contribution Value to exchange for cultivation time in the Time-Sky Tower, encouraging them to serve Han Mansion wholeheartedly.
As for whether this would lead to the leakage of secrets?
Han Li’s answer is: Definitely not!
Han Mansion possesses several imperial weapons and is very strict with surveillance. As long as one is within the range of the imperial weapons, if there’s a tendency to leak secrets, they would be warned the first time, and executed immediately upon a second offense.
As for escaping outside the range of the imperial weapons?
That scenario doesn’t exist either, as imperial weapons, even when only partially restored, can monitor the entire Xuan Domain. And those people lack the ability to flee so far.
Starting from the fourth level, the Time-Sky Tower can accommodate far fewer people, but the acceleration of time inside increases dramatically.
The fourth level can hold one thousand people—two months inside is equivalent to just one day outside; the fifth level holds two hundred people for half a year; the sixth level fifty people for a year; the seventh level ten people for two years; the eighth level five people for five years; and the ninth level only one person, yet ten years pass for them.
According to the second version of the Time-Sky Tower’s usage and ranking plan established by Han Li, Han Mansion’s descendants would typically cultivate between levels three to five. The third level is for ordinary descendants of Han Mansion, the fourth for those on the key cultivation list, and the fifth for those on the core cultivation list.
The third level requires the Myriad Phenomena Realm, the fourth the True Martial Realm, and the fifth the Divine Yuan Realm. These descendants naturally fall short in cultivation level but possess high enough authority to benefit from the Time-Sky Tower’s blessings and cultivate in these levels ahead of time.
Han Li’s beautiful concubines mainly cultivate between the fourth and fifth levels, Han Li’s charming wives primarily between the fifth and sixth levels, and only Xue Yueqing and Long Yue cultivate on the seventh level.
The sixth level of the Time-Sky Tower requires the Tongxuan Realm, and the seventh the Divine Yuan Realm. The cultivation levels of charming wives like Gongsun Yue, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi are far too low. Even if they forcefully entered under the protection of the Time-Sky Tower, they wouldn’t last long.
Currently, the Time-Sky Tower is only being used by those from Han Mansion. The Li Manor hasn’t merged yet, so they are not using it. However, Han Li has proposed a compensation plan, allowing the wives, concubines, and descendants from the Li Manor to cultivate for an extended period in the Time-Sky Tower after merging.
“Husband, this release of Dangyang Mountain’s seal won’t affect the entire Xuan Domain, will it?”
Gongsun Yue snuggled into Han Li’s embrace, gazing at the clouds and surging aura nearby and asked softly.
As the seal on Dangyang Mountain was gradually destroyed, the leaked aura was growing stronger, already drawing attention from the entire Xuan Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 435: 206: The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind; Grand Elder Han at the very end!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: Chapter 206: The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind; Grand Elder Han at the very end!_3
As Han Li’s wife, Gongsun Yue naturally knew the details, and she also knew that the Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and the peaks of the Myriad Stars and other major Sacred Lands had all sent Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors to handle the situation.
“My dear, don’t worry, with your husband here, even if an accident occurs, Chengsheng Mountain won’t be affected, and the same goes for Tianxuan Mountain.”
Han Li understood what Gongsun Yue was worried about and said with a smile.
A month ago, he and Gongsun Yue had gone back to Tianxuan Mountain once more. This time, Han Li didn’t deliberately conceal his identity, and Gongsun Yue told Gongsun Yun everything she could.
Gongsun Yun was naturally extremely shocked and astounded. When he later found out that his precious daughter had been married off to Han Li, his face turned dark.
After knowing that Gongsun Yue had become Han Li’s wife, his expression eased quite a bit, but he still felt displeased with Han Li and almost regretted taking him as his closed-door disciple.
One misstep and his precious daughter had been snatched by this disciple. The key issue was that this disciple was too flirtatious, with hundreds of wives and concubines. Gongsun Yue, being just one of them after marrying him, was a reason Gongsun Yun’s face was anything but pleased.
Later, Han Li took out four True Martial Pills and gave them to his master Gongsun Yun, one for his own use and the other three for those three ancestors. The look on Gongsun Yun’s face was complicated indeed.
Now, with the help of the True Martial Pill, the second-generation ancestor has successfully broken through to the True Martial Realm, and the cultivations of Gongsun Yun and the other two had also improved significantly. Before leaving, Han Li also left behind many pills that would help increase their Myriad Phenomena Realm cultivations.
“Mm~”
Gongsun Yue nodded slightly, then turned around, looped her arms around Han Li’s neck, stood on her tiptoes, and offered a kiss.
The old ancestor Han naturally would not be courteous, and the two engaged in a small skirmish, then changed venues and began to discuss the Dao.
…….
Xuan Domain, Kurong Sect.
Atop the giant tree of the Kurong Sect was a monk with his chest and arms bare, sitting cross-legged, hands clasped in prayer, with Buddhist sounds swirling around and Buddha’s light shining over vast territories.
Kurong Kong and another kong sat at the foot of the giant tree, listening to the wonderful Buddhist sounds, intoxicated.
Suddenly, the Happy Arhat opened his eyes, and two beams of Buddha’s light shot out as he looked towards Dangyang Mountain, saying, “It’s about time. Kurong, Wenfa, if there’s any news, report it to me immediately.”
As his voice fell, the Happy Arhat’s figure disappeared from Kurong Sect, traversed through the void, and headed towards Dangyang Mountain.
He had been in the Xuan Domain for over a year, originally intent on finding Ye Fan, who had outwitted the Demon Queen Bai Keqing, and execute him, while also trying to recapture Bai Keqing. However, after searching for a whole year and scouring the Xuan Domain several times, he found no trace of him.
Out of helplessness, the Happy Arhat temporarily gave up and came to sit in the Kurong Sect to wait for the seal of Dangyang Mountain to break, and then he could meet with those Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors.
While traversing the void, the Happy Arhat also pondered where Ye Fan and Bai Keqing could possibly have gone.
To his knowledge, the Demon Queen Bai Keqing had not returned to the Demon Clan and she was very likely still in the Xuan Domain, just hidden too deep.
The Dangyang Mountain incident this time was a great crisis as well as a great opportunity. Ye Fan, who was at the peak of the True Martial Realm back then, might come to stir up trouble.
If he could gain a share of the opportunity, anyone at the peak of the True Martial Realm could smoothly advance to the Divine Yuan Realm—such an allure was still very significant.
The Happy Arhat was secretly looking forward to it, thinking that if Ye Fan showed up, he would take action directly, first executing him since he had grown impatient after searching for a year.
The Ancient Empire.
Within a grand hall in the deepest part of the Imperial Palace’s forbidden grounds.
An imposing elder dressed in black battle armor rose to his feet, looked towards the direction of Dangyang Mountain with a sigh, and then disappeared from view.
“Sigh, under my very nose, I can’t just ignore it.”
As the ancestor of the Ancient Empire, Xuanyi Elder had not shown himself for thousands of years, focusing solely on cultivation, with the sole desire to break through to the Tongxuan Realm and become a powerhouse.
Only by becoming a Tongxuan Realm adept could he have more say in Qianyuan Divine Province, and could the Ancient Empire claim more terrains in the Xuan Domain. Otherwise, it was all empty talk.
Shenyuan Realm Powers could only occupy one-third of a region’s territory at most; crossing that line would provoke punitive actions from the Four Great Sacred Lands.
If the incident were occurring in another domain, Xuanyi Elder wouldn’t need to make a move, but Dangyang Mountain was within the range of Emperor Wu’s City in the Xuan Domain and adjacent to the Ancient Empire.
Xuanyi Elder knew that once he took action, his cultivation level would be exposed, and it would be unrealistic to hide it after that.
But he had to go, otherwise Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, and the House of Divine Armies would teach him a lesson with a good thrashing.
Emperor Wu’s City.
The Lord of Emperor Wu’s City, who had been sitting in silence for eight hundred years, rose for the first time. His aura as a Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm was unabashedly displayed, and he looked gravely towards Dangyang Mountain, tens of thousands of miles away.
In fact, the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City was overjoyed; he had planned for hundreds of years, and today the seal of Dangyang Mountain would finally shatter completely, and it was time for him to reap the rewards.
On the surface, he appeared to be at the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, but in reality, he had long cultivated back to the Tongxuan Realm, and he was now a Tongxuan Realm Fourth Heaven powerhouse.
Though he lacked handy Sacred Soldiers or Quasi Emperor weapons, the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City’s combat abilities were far higher than his cultivation level suggested. After all, in his previous life, he had been a Peak Quasi Emperor, cultivated Emperor-level techniques of the Heaven Imperial Realm, mastered numerous Quasi Emperor martial skills, and knew even two or three Emperor-level martial skills.
“As long as I get Chen Xi’s body, this life I shall continue the path and once again strive for the Heaven Imperial Realm.”
The Lord of Emperor Wu’s City muttered to himself. Now everything was ready; he just needed the east wind. Once the Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors from various Great Sacred Lands went to deal with the situation, he could take advantage to interfere.

chapters.title: Chapter 436: 206: The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind; Grand Elder Han at the very end!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: Chapter 206: The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind; Grand Elder Han at the very end!_4
“`
Once he had Chen Xilai’s physical body, he would be able to use a secret technique to locate the Heavenly Evil Orb. Only with the Heavenly Evil Orb would he have the hope of becoming a Great Emperor, otherwise, even returning to the status of a Quasi Emperor would be difficult in this life.
“For the control of the Heavenly Sovereign Path, anyone who obstructs me will die!”
Tens of thousands of miles away, Dangyang Mountain.
Many powerful figures had already risen on Dangyang Mountain, and the moment the seal on the mountain was completely shattered, they all awoke.
From the Penglai Immortal Sect, Fairy Ling Lingshuang, the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, Lu Zhen, the Barbarian Emperor from the Summit of Stars, the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea from the Heavenly Demon Hall, and Jiang Taijing, the holder of the House of Divine Armies’ Prison Spear.
Five Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors were positioned at the five points of the heavens, their expressions differing as they looked towards Dangyang Mountain.
“Fellow Daoists, at present, Chen Xilai of the Heavenly Blade is weak and barely matches the Divine Yuan Realm in terms of aura. The few of us can completely handle him, there’s no need to wait for others, right?”
The Devil Emperor of Blood Sea from the Heavenly Demon Hall was the first to speak, standing on a blood-red lotus dais with a sinister expression.
After the Heavenly Blade Chen Xilai was sealed in his mad demon state, all the Great Holy Land Schools had a part in it and left means to steal his cultivation for their descendants, providing an opportunity for the future generations.
But there were at most seven portions of this opportunity.
The forces that came to deal with the Dangyang Mountain incident included not only the Great Holy Land Schools such as Baiyujing, Xumi Mountain, and Myriad Demon Mountain but also the two Shenyuan Realm Powers, Emperor Mingtian and the Ancient Empire.
Even though the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing of the Myriad Demon Mountain had gone missing and forfeited the chance at Dangyang Mountain, that still left eight Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors.
Eight Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors vying for seven portions of opportunity could result in casualties, and no one was certain of victory.
It would be better to take advantage of the few people now and deal with Chen Xilai immediately, each securing a portion of opportunity first. Then it would be easier to contest the remaining two portions later on.
“Agreed.”
“No opposition.”
The Barbarian Emperor from the Summit of Stars and Jiang Taijing of the House of Divine Armies expressed their opinions.
The Devil Emperor of Blood Sea turned to Fairy Ling Lingshuang of the Penglai Immortal Sect and Lu Zhen of Baiyujing, asking in a deep voice, “What do the two of you think?”
Lu Zhen glanced at Ling Lingshuang and said indifferently, “I don’t care much about opportunity, but I must take Chen Xilai’s physical body with me.”
With an immensely profound background, Baiyujing didn’t place much value on the opportunity from Dangyang Mountain. For Lu Zhen, the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, another motive for coming was Chen Xilai’s physical body.
His master once hinted to him that Chen Xilai’s physical body was of great importance. If brought back to Baiyujing, it might be possible to use an Imperial Soldier to deduce the whereabouts of that red bead from the past.
The Dao Sovereign of Baiyujing’s previous generation had pursued that red bead but ultimately failed to obtain it.
The former Dao Sovereign had left some information stating that once the seal of Dangyang Mountain broke, they must seize Chen Xilai’s physical body as soon as possible.
Upon hearing this, the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea narrowed his eyes, the Barbarian Emperor’s eyebrows slightly furrowed, and Jiang Taijing remained expressionless; they all had plans for Chen Xilai’s physical body.
Initially, they wanted to act in secret, but Lu Zhen from Baiyujing was so direct that it seemed they would have to rely on their own abilities when the time came.
“I have no objections.”
Fairy Ling Lingshuang of the Penglai Immortal Sect said with a hint of light flashing in her eyes.
“Since all fellow Daoists agree to take action early, let’s begin then. As for Chen Xilai’s physical body, we will rely on our own abilities when the time comes, how about that?” the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea said in a deep voice.
“Agreeable.”
Lu Zhen, Jiang Taijing, Ling Lingshuang, and the Barbarian Emperor all nodded slightly.
Instantly, the five Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors brought out their respective Sacred Soldiers they had brought with them, placing them above their heads. They shone with holy light, protecting themselves and ensuring safety before they were ready to take action.
“Wait a moment!”
Just then, two voices rose simultaneously between heaven and earth.
Lu Zhen, Ling Lingshuang, the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, the Barbarian Emperor, and Jiang Taijing frowned and turned towards the source of the voices, only to see two figures crossing the void from different directions and approaching.
In the next instant, the joyful Arhat clad in Buddhist robes appeared, and from another direction, the Heaven Lord of Emperor Mingtian arrived, an elegant middle-aged man in green clothes, holding a White Feather Folding Fan in his hand.
“You fellow Daoists really are inconsiderate. The group isn’t complete yet, how could you start without everyone?”
The joyful Arhat said with a laugh, his tone a bit dissatisfied.
The Heaven Lord of Emperor Mingtian glanced at Chen Xilai below Dangyang Mountain and smiled, saying nothing more.
The Devil Emperor of Blood Sea narrowed his eyes, about to speak, when ripples appeared in the void, and another Divine Yuan Realm martial emperor arrived, the tardy Xuanyi Elder from the Ancient Empire.
“Ancient War Spirit, you really took your time. You might as well have not shown up,” the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea said coldly, venting his dissatisfaction on Xuanyi Elder, Ancient War Spirit.
If Ancient War Spirit had not come, the seven of them would have been perfectly matched for the seven portions of opportunity.
“Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, I didn’t want to come, but I had no choice,” Xuanyi Elder, Ancient War Spirit, sighed, ignoring his discontent.
The Barbarian Emperor said indifferently, “Then you might as well just watch.”
“That won’t do. Since I’ve come, I deserve a share of the opportunity,” the Xuanyi Elder said in a somewhat assertive tone.
They wanted him to contribute without getting benefits in return? That was unacceptable.
Since they had to unveil their powers anyway, it was better to secure an opportunity first.
Many thousands of miles from Dangyang Mountain, there was a small mountain a thousand feet high. The figure of Emperor Wu’s City’s master appeared, using a secret technique to conceal his aura and spying on Dangyang Mountain expressionlessly.
Even from tens of thousands of miles away, he could clearly hear and see everything happening on Dangyang Mountain. At this moment, the former Peak Quasi-Emperor was very displeased.

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - 206: The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind; Grand Elder Han at the very end!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 437: Chapter 206: The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind; Grand Elder Han at the very end!_5
The scenario he least wanted to see had emerged.
He’d assumed that the Holy Lands of the Qianyuan Divine Province didn’t place much importance on the flesh of Chen Xilai, the red-haired monster, especially since the Heavenly Evil Orb had escaped thousands of years ago. He hadn’t expected miscalculation.
These people actually shared his intention, all wanting to use the body of Chen Xilai to search for the Heavenly Evil Orb, a treasure of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
“You’re forcing my hand,” he said.
A flash of shocking murderous intent crossed the eyes of Emperor Wu’s City Master, and at all costs, he had to obtain the body of Chen Xilai. Only in this way could he find the Heavenly Evil Orb and achieve enlightenment in this life to take revenge on Empress Yuanchu.
The murderous intent vanished in an instant, deftly concealed by Emperor Wu’s City Master, so as not to alarm the eight Divine Yuan Realm warlords standing sentinel on Dangyang Mountain.
Looking at the Sacred Soldiers above the heads of those Divine Yuan Realm warlords, Emperor Wu’s City Master felt a headache coming on. Although his realm and combat ability far surpassed those of the Divine Yuan Realm warlords, without a Sacred Soldier in hand, they were difficult to deal with.
Lu Zhen, Ling Lingshuang, the Barbarian Emperor, the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, the Joyous Arhat, and Jiang Taijing, these five Divine Yuan Realm warlords came from the Great Holy Land Schools and each carried a Sacred Land with them.
The ancient martial spirit of the Ancient Empire and the Heaven Lord of Emperor Mingtian, although both were leaders of the Divine Yuan Realm power, seemingly had command over Sacred Soldiers, capable of easily triggering a portion of their might. If willing to pay the price, they could also fully revive the Sacred Soldiers.
“Dammit …” Emperor Wu’s City Master cursed in his heart, yet he dared not mention the name of Empress Yuanchu, for fear of being sensed by her through some mysterious connection.
The said Empress Yuanchu’s skills were profound and natural, her realm having long reached the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and her strength was unfathomable. Emperor Wu’s City Master risked not gambling on it.
Alas, his Quasi Emperor weapon and those Sacred Soldiers were a pity. They were blown apart by Empress Yuanchu in a punch across time and space, leaving his True Spirit barely alive, taking refuge in a mere strand of Primordial Spirit light.
“It seems I must take the long view on this matter,” he sighed and thought dejectedly.
Originally, he wanted to disguise himself as a mysterious Divine Yuan Realm warlord and join in the action, taking the opportunity to take Chen Xilai’s body amidst the chaos.
But under these circumstances, he didn’t feel like showing himself just yet. All six Great Holy Land Schools’ Divine Yuan Realm warlords had their sights set on Chen Xilai’s body, and even if he wanted to stir the waters, he wouldn’t be able to.
Even if he demonstrated all his combat ability and paid a heavy price to use forbidden secret techniques that would allow him to barely unleash the might of the Holy Abyss Realm, it would be futile. If attacked by the eight Sacred Soldiers, he would be unable to withstand them and would be killed alive.
Emperor Wu’s City Master watched the eight disputatious Divine Yuan Realm warlords, waiting silently, ready to act like a mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.
For the chance and the body of Chen Xilai, these Divine Yuan Realm warlords were bound to fight bitterly; he just needed to find the right opportunity to act, and he might still have hope of success.
But what Emperor Wu’s City Master didn’t know was that there was a pair of eyes above him, watching him intently, capturing his every expression.
While Emperor Wu’s City Master thought to be the oriole waiting behind the mantis, Han Li had precisely the same idea.
Only, while Emperor Wu’s City Master aspired to be the oriole, Han Li was the one who would catch the oriole.
After the seal of Dangyang Mountain officially shattered, it caused a stir in the Xuan Domain, setting off a storm of controversy. Naturally, Han Li was the first to arrive at the scene.
With an Emperor Formation diagram for cover, the Void Bell and Time-Sky Tower hanging on his left and right wrists obscured fate and confused space-time, ensuring that nobody noticed him, not even those Tongxuan Realm experts spying from their Holy Land portals.
Han Li walked around and made an unexpected discovery: tens of thousands of miles away from Dangyang Mountain, someone was lurking, attempting to gain profit from the strife. To his surprise, it was the Master of Emperor Wu’s City, the conventionally neutral Emperor Wu.
The outside world rumored that the Master of Emperor Wu’s City was merely at the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, but Han Li discovered that he was a master of deep concealment, in fact, a hidden power of the Tongxuan Realm.
A Tongxuan Realm powerhouse lurking here certainly wasn’t after the opportunities of Dangyang Mountain, after all, those opportunities were only of great use to those in the Divine Yuan Realm or True Martial Realm. So what was the purpose of Emperor Wu’s City Lord coming here?
After observing for a while, Han Li discovered that this City Lord of Emperor Wu’s City seemed to be without a Sacred Soldier; otherwise if he had used a Sacred Soldier to conceal himself, he would have not been discovered so easily by him.
After some thought, Han Li had a bold idea: the City Lord of Emperor Wu’s City was very likely a transmigrated reincarnation of a powerhouse above the Tongxuan Realm.
Otherwise, given the current cultivation environment in Qianyuan Divine Province, it would be almost impossible for a Loose Cultivator at the Tongxuan Realm to emerge.
A few thousand years ago, there was Chen Xilai of the Heavenly Blade, and a few thousand years later, another City Lord of Emperor Wu’s City appears, and this lord just happened to be lurking not far from Chen Xilai’s sealed grounds.
“How interesting,” Han Li chuckled lightly, retracting his gaze that was observing the City Lord and turned towards Dangyang Mountain.
His gaze briefly lingered on the Xuanyi Elder of Ancient Empire, the Heaven Lord of Emperor Mingtian, the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea from the Heavenly Demon Hall, Jiang Taijing of House of Divine Armies, and the Barbarian Emperor of Summit of Stars, before finally settling on the last three individuals.
“Well done, Lu Zhen,” Han Li couldn’t help but praise when he saw Lu Zhen, the Third Patriarch of Bai Yujing; this Lu Zhen was truly not to be underestimated, with a special constitution to boot.
However, the source of Lu Zhen’s special constitution appeared damaged, and it was unclear what he had gone through; otherwise if his source were intact, and given that he was in Bai Yujing—the premier Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province—he should have cultivated to the Tongxuan Realm long ago.
With a flicker in his eyes, Han Li pondered whether he could lure Lu Zhen away to serve as a Guest Elder at his Chengsheng Mountain; he had a way to restore Lu Zhen’s source.
If Lu Zhen could be married into his family, that would be even better; perhaps in time, he could have a descendant with a special constitution born to Han Mansion.
As for Lu Zhen’s pursuit of Ling Lingshuang?
Was there such a thing?
Wasn’t Fairy Lingshuang his, Han the Ancestor’s, destined partner?
Even if she wasn’t now, she would be very soon.
Han Li’s gaze moved from Lu Zhen to Fairy Ling Lingshuang of the Penglai Immortal Sect, a smile appearing on his face—this was his predetermined partner.
That Old Daoist Guanhai from Penglai Immortal Sect had once tricked him, and Han Li had always kept it in mind. Snatching Fairy Lingshuang to Chengsheng Mountain to become his partner and have children was only the first step.
At last, Han Li’s gaze settled on the Arhat of Joy; a sliver of killing intent flashed by.
In the past year, the Arhat of Joy hadn’t refrained from wandering around the Xuan Domain. The purpose of the Arhat of Joy was crystal clear to Han Li, and he had long wanted to kill him; it was just that he had been restraining himself.
After all, the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had gone missing not long ago, and if an Arhat from Xumi Mountain were to die following that, it would definitely cause a huge shakeup, and at that point, it might not be possible to keep it hidden anymore.
Xumi Mountain was not like Myriad Demon Mountain; they would not shy away from confrontation in the Mortal Territory, and that Female Bodhisattva was especially protective.
So, Han Li had been waiting, waiting until now for the right moment to take down this Arhat of Joy.
Beyond that, Han Li was also playing a long game, to see if he could use the Arhat of Joy to lure out the Female Bodhisattva.
Now he had the Emperor Formation Diagrams on him, carrying both the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell, all ready to be fully revived at any moment; if the Female Bodhisattva were careless, it was very possible that she could be captured directly by Han Li.
Then, he could truly “marry the Bodhisattva then seek the sutra, not failing the merciful Buddha nor thee.”
As Han Li was contemplating, a grand battle erupted atop Dangyang Mountain among the eight Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors.

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - 207: Punching the Ecstatic Arhat to Pieces, Slapping the Master of Emperor Wu’s City, the Female Bodhisattva is in Pursuit!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 438: Chapter 207: Punching the Ecstatic Arhat to Pieces, Slapping the Master of Emperor Wu’s City, the Female Bodhisattva is in Pursuit!_1
Atop Dangyang Mountain, several Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors couldn’t settle their differences with words, and began to fight on the spot.
Sacred Soldiers radiated holy light, releasing terrifying power in a sweeping assault, clashing with each other.
Boom~
The majestic sacred power illuminated the heavens, suppressing the universe, leaving the world engulfed in a white expanse.
Dangyang Mountain, one of the Five Great Divine Mountains of Xuan Domain, stood 180,000 zhang tall, but under this terrifying power, it was instantly sheared off by two-thirds, most of it disappearing into the void, reduced to nothingness.
The eight Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors each made their move to test the waters, then calmed down. The air was thick with the smell of gunpowder, threatening to erupt into a major battle at any moment.
At this moment, the eight Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors dominated their respective territories, towering like deep, immovable peaks.
Lu Zhen clasped his hands within his sleeves, a sword sheath without a sword strapped to his back. His ordinary appearance gave off a mundane, gentle vibe, yet no one in the realm of Divine Yuan powerhouses dared to underestimate him.
As the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, Lu Zhen proclaimed himself as “undefeated for three thousand years.” His combat ability was astonishing, as were his military achievements.
Hovering above his head was a Jade Ruyi, exuding an aura of Dao, its divine light brilliant, seemingly purifying all malice in the world.
Although Ling Lingshuang detested Lu Zhen, who was like a clingy plaster, she tacitly sided with him at this moment. Penglai Immortal Sect and Baiyujing both came from the Dao Sect; despite their differences, she was clear about where to stand on such matters.
Fairy Lingshuang’s three thousand strands of black hair cascaded down, billowing with the wind. Among them, a Jade Hairpin shone, shielding her within its holy protection.
The Joyous Arhat from Xumi Mountain stood firm in the southeast sky, not adhering to any fixed form, his brow slightly furrowed, resonating with the Bodhi Buddha Beads above his head.
The Devil Emperor of Blood Sea from Heavenly Demon Hall stood on a blood-red lotus platform, surrounded by a string of blood-red rivers, exuding sheer ferocity, with a large cauldron above his head emitting demonic light that shone across the heavens.
The Barbarian Emperor from the Peak of Stars stood in the north; although it was daytime, he summoned down cascading moonlight, like a silver galaxy falling from the ninth heaven, revolving around a platinum hammer.
Jiang Taijing of the House of Divine Armies had a gentle expression, holding a spear in one hand, its tip slanting towards the earth, with a golden spear above his head gleaming, its spear light emerging and rending the void.
Atop the head of the Ancient Warrior Spirit from the Ancient Empire was a Sacred Soldier—a black crescent blade, exceedingly sharp, its blade qi overflowing, slicing through layers of the void.
The Heaven Lord from Emperor Mingtian also had a Sacred Soldier, which was a large banner, exuding a ferocious iron-blooded aura, with endless roars faintly emerging from it, intimidating the devine, subduing the Buddha, capturing the demons, defeating evil, cutting down the holy.
Lu Zhen and Ling Lingshuang were implicitly on one side, the Joyous Arhat, the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, Jiang Taijing, and the Barbarian Emperor each stood alone, while the Ancient Warrior Spirit and the Lord of Emperor Mingtian seemed inclined to join forces.
The other six Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors all hailed from the Great Holy Land Schools of Qianyuan Divine Province. Having weaker backgrounds, they didn’t dare to be complacent, ready to join forces if the situation turned against them.
“Since everyone is vying for it, this humble Daoist will step back and not compete for the opportunity. I only need to take away Chen Xilai,” Lu Zhen said.
“So, who agrees, and who opposes?” Lu Zhen looked around, taking the lead to speak up, breaking the standoff.
Instantly, the murderous aura filled the heavens. Lu Zhen, who was previously a sheath with concealed sharpness, was now a Divine Sword with exposed edge.
Behind him, within the sheath, a Longsword silently appeared, unsheathing itself by a half inch.
“Hum~”
Sword light dazzling, sword qi filling the fields, chilling radiance for eight million miles, causing all the Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors present to frown involuntarily.
“Agreed.”
A flicker of a strange color passed through the depths of Ling Lingshuang’s eyes as she took the lead in responding.
She had two goals for coming here; the first was to take away her portion of the opportunity, and the second was to see if there was a chance to take away Chen Xilai’s physical body. If not, she would help Lu Zhen.
The Heaven Lord and the Ancient Ancestor from the Ancient Empire exchanged glances and spoke simultaneously, “We have no objections.”
Their purpose for being here was simple: to see if there was a chance to secure an opportunity. Knowing before they set out that the chance was slim, they came to show their faces.
After all, there were only seven opportunities, and the seven Great Holy Land Schools of Qianyuan Divine Province had sent Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors; it was not their turn.
Now, with the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing of Myriad Demon Mountain gone missing, an opportunity had opened up, leaving one less competitor. With Lu Zhen, the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, voluntarily stepping back, there was now one less rival.
This meant the seven Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors could each obtain one opportunity. Naturally, the Heaven Lord and the Ancient Ancestor from the Ancient Empire were willing.
Grabbing an opportunity on the side and gaining a major boon that could lead to a breakthrough of one or two minor realms was a tremendous fortune.
As for Chen Xilai’s physical body, both Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors knew there were complications. Otherwise, these Holy Land Schools would not value it so highly, but it was none of their concern.
They were well aware that they couldn’t touch the red bead. Apart from not having the necessary secret techniques, attempting to lay claim to Chen Xilai’s body would result in a catastrophic attack from the Holy Lands, bringing instant ruin.
Seeing this, Lu Zhen nodded slightly. These two were sensible. His gaze then turned to Jiang Taijing with his Zhen Prison Spear from the House of Divine Armies, the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, the Joyous Arhat from Xumi Mountain, and the Barbarian Emperor from the Peak of Stars.
“How about the four of you?” Lu Zhen asked again.
“I can agree, but Sect Leader Lu must promise Jiang one condition,” Jiang Taijing said after some thought.
“Speak.”
“After this is over, Jiang will go to Baiyujing to pay respects and challenge Sect Leader Lu to a battle. I hope Sect Leader Lu won’t take advantage of the weaker.”
Lu Zhen’s pupils contracted slightly, then he burst into laughter, “Lu is invincible in the same realm, I can allow Spear Emperor a one-realm advantage.”

chapters.title: Chapter 439: 207: Punching the Ecstatic Arhat to Pieces, Slapping the Master of Emperor Wu's City, the Female Bodhisattva is in Pursuit!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 439: Chapter 207: Punching the Ecstatic Arhat to Pieces, Slapping the Master of Emperor Wu’s City, the Female Bodhisattva is in Pursuit!_2
His cultivation had reached the peak of the Divine Yuan Realm, surpassing the Second Grandmaster of Bai Yujing by half a minor realm, and Jiang Taijing by four or five minor realms.
It was precisely because his cultivation was too high that Lu Zhen looked down upon the opportunity at Dangyang Mountain; it was of little use to him, unable to take him a step further unless he seized all seven opportunities.
However, committing such a reckless act against the world was something even the brash Lu Zhen dared not do. Facing the siege of seven Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors wielding seven Sacred Soldiers, he couldn’t withstand their attacks.
“Hahaha.”
Jiang Taijing, the Spear Emperor of Heavenly Prison, also burst into laughter, saying, “Alright, that’s settled then.”
Since Lu Zhen was arrogantly overestimating himself, Jiang Taijing would not be polite. In fact, in a fight of the same realm, he was indeed less confident; the foundation of the House of Divine Armies was ultimately a few notches below Bai Yujing.
Lu Zhen’s smile froze, he had been modest, and yet Jiang Taijing took it seriously. He shook his head and said nothing.
“Lu Zhen, there’s no way Chen Xilai will be given to you Bai Yujing.”
At this moment, the Joyful Arhat from Xumi Mountain spoke indifferently.
“Years ago, Chen Xilai killed an Arhat of my Xumi Mountain and slaughtered countless in the Buddha’s land; this is a debt of blood. Chen Xilai must come to Xumi Mountain to be converted.”
“Besides, it was our great Bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain who suppressed Chen Xilai. You insist on meddling, leading to today’s situation.”
The Devil Emperor of Blood Sea from Heavenly Demon Hall chuckled with a bold and sinister tone, “The Demon Lord has spoken, we can do without the opportunity, but Chen Xilai’s physical body must belong to our Heavenly Demon Hall, otherwise, the Demon Lord doesn’t mind making a personal visit.”
Just as the Barbarian Emperor of Myriad Demon Mountain was about to speak, the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea continued, “Barbarian, you can forget about Chen Xilai’s body. You should be satisfied if you can take away one opportunity, or you won’t leave the Xuan Domain alive today.”
“You!”
Being threatened and intimidated by the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea like this, the Barbarian Emperor was infuriated. His aura surged to the sky, ready to fight at a word, but then he calmed down quickly.
The Barbarian Emperor saw figures like Lu Zhen, the Joyful Arhat, and the Heaven Lord of Emperor Mingtian from the Human Clan—all Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors—casting indifferent and hostile glances at him.
Although the Barbarian Emperor was very upset, he eventually fell silent, genuinely so.
The Barbarian Clan had a deep-seated hatred with the Human Clan, but at their level, both sides were relatively restrained and wouldn’t fight to the death on sight.
With the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing of Myriad Demon Mountain absent today, he didn’t even have a single ally to call upon. If he were too domineering, these fellows might very well take a dark shot at him.
In such a case, even if Myriad Demon Mountain were outraged, they could do nothing against the Four Sacred Lands of the Mortal World. The Ancient Empire and Emperor Mingtian were too far away from the Barbarian Region to intervene, and ultimately, they could only swallow their anger.
“Lu Zhen, if you want to take away Chen Xilai’s body, you’ll have to get past us first.”
The Devil Emperor of Blood Sea stamped his right foot lightly, a lotus pedestal blossomed with surging blood light in response, and the river of blood encircling him mirrored this energy, manifesting his colossal Primordial Spirit hundreds of thousands of feet tall, its presence growing ever more formidable.
The cauldron above his head bobbed, emitting demonic light that subdued the world, with mirages evolving around it, worlds being birthed and perishing, gods and demons multiplying, his demonic form reaching the heavens and piercing the earth, all casting their gaze upon Lu Zhen.
“Bai Yujing is strong, but my Xumi Mountain is not inferior,” the Joyful Arhat said lightly.
As he spoke, his colorful kasaya shone brilliantly with Buddha light, and behind him appeared a Primordial Spirit that reached through the heavens, the flow of yin and yang, surrounded by the seven emotions and six sensory pleasures, akin to the descent of a Buddha.
The Bodhi Buddha Beads rotated, the twenty-four beads each representing a heavenly realm, with each rotation doubling the radiance of the Buddha’s light and the grandeur of the Buddha’s sound.
“If you’re not convinced, then let’s fight it out, the consequences be on our own heads.”
Lu Zhen’s expression was as tranquil as an ancient well, and with one step forward, he manifested a Primordial Spirit ninety-five thousand feet tall behind him, dwarfing those of the Joyful Arhat and the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea.
The next instant, Lu Zhen raised his right hand above his shoulder, gripping the hilt of his sword, and he drew it slowly. The sword’s light grew sharper, the sword’s energy fuller, and the Sword Intent more majestic, Lu Zhen seemed like the sovereign of the Sword Dao in the world.
Simultaneously, his towering Primordial Spirit made the same motion, drawing a Divine Sword constructed from his martial Dao true intent and True Yuan, its light cleansing the six directions, its energy overwhelming the heavens and the earth.
Above Lu Zhen’s head, the Jade Ruyi shone with harmonious Dao light, layer upon layer, creating the circumpolar stars. In an instant, the sky appeared as a sea of stars, with Ancient Stars rising and falling, their life and death uncertain, fending off the myriad gods and demons and the twenty-four heavenly realms.
Ling Lingshuang, Jiang Taijing, the Barbarian Emperor, along with the Heaven Lord of Emperor Mingtian, and the Ancient Ancestor of the Ancient Empire each stepped back, their Sacred Soldiers radiating vast holy might, protecting themselves, and observing the impending battle.
They too wanted to know if the Third Patriarch of Bai Yujing, Lu Zhen, had finally crossed that threshold, and how far the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea and the Joyful Arhat had progressed.
Bai Yujing was the foremost Sacred Land of the Human Clan, with Xumi Mountain and Heavenly Demon Hall ranking second and third; they were also the main forces contending for the heavenly blade, Chen Xilai. Whoever emerged victorious would be able to take Chen Xilai away.
“Kill!”
“Cut!”
The Devil Emperor of Blood Sea and the Joyful Arhat exchanged glances before simultaneously launching their attacks without any probing, going all out from the start. Lu Zhen’s reputation was formidable enough to warrant such respect from them.
Everyone possessed Sacred Soldiers, and now, with three Sacred Soldiers counterbalancing each other, the outcome would depend on their individual strength.
The Devil Emperor of Blood Sea and the Joyful Arhat were both at the later stages of the Divine Yuan Realm. Although Buddha and demon are inherently at odds, at this moment, the Joyful Arhat and the Devil Emperor of Blood Sea had no such concerns. Their priority was to join forces against Lu Zhen before anything else.
Lu Zhen’s cultivation was higher than theirs, significantly so. In a one-on-one fight, they were not confident of coming out on top.

chapters.title: Chapter 440: 207: Punching the Ecstatic Arhat to Pieces, Slapping the Master of Emperor Wu's City, the Female Bodhisattva is in Pursuit!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 440: Chapter 207: Punching the Ecstatic Arhat to Pieces, Slapping the Master of Emperor Wu’s City, the Female Bodhisattva is in Pursuit!_3
Lu Zhen’s expression remained indifferent as he stepped forward, casually swinging the Divine Sword in his hand. The brilliant sword qi shattered the void, stirring in all directions, colliding with the overwhelming might that was coming to kill.
In an instant, a terrifying battle in the Divine Yuan Realm had erupted.
All three participants were fighting with full force, deploying a variety of divine rank martial skills from Bai Yujing, Heavenly Demon Hall, and Xumi Mountain—these three Sacred Lands. Each technique belonged to the level of the Holy Abyss Realm.
However, the three still exercised some restraint, not allowing their Sacred Soldiers to fully awaken. They knew their limits, and it was enough for them to settle the score among themselves.
Ling Lingshuang the Fairy, Lord of Emperor Mingtian, and old ancestors from the Ancient Empire—five Divine Yuan Realm warriors—watched the battle from afar, their attention drawn to the fierce fight involving Lu Zhen, Devil Emperor of the Blood Sea, and the jubilant Arhat.
They did not notice that beneath Dangyang Mountain, suppressed by the power of several Sacred Soldiers, the eyelids of Chen Xilai of the Heavenly Blade twitched.
Thousands of miles away, the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City did see this scene, and a smile suddenly appeared on his face.
The current situation wasn’t chaotic enough. If things continued this way, it was highly likely that Lu Zhen would come out on top. By then, Chen Xilai would be taken back to Bai Yujing, and he would lose his chance.
But an unexpected opportunity had arisen, although it was beyond his expectations, it was a welcome development.
The Lord of Emperor Wu’s City noticed that the red hairs on Chen Xilai’s body were retracting as if he was about to regain consciousness. Although his aura was still weak, once Chen Xilai came to, he would surely reclaim his stolen cultivation and recover his strength.
One must remember that Chen Xilai was a formidable warrior at the late stages of the Tongxuan Realm before being suppressed. If he were to cause a commotion, even without a Sacred Soldier, he could still throw the situation into disarray, providing the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City with an opportunity.
Above the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City, Han Li was also watching everything. He too was waiting for the right moment.
He could sense that the masters of the Great Holy Land Schools were all watching from afar, each plotting their schemes. He couldn’t make a move yet and needed to find an opportunity.
Beneath Dangyang Mountain, Chen Xilai finally came to his senses, his past memories flooding back, causing him immense pain and turning his eyes blood-red.
He had been suppressed here for seven thousand years, vegetating till now, with not much life left. His cultivation was stolen, causing him to lose a significant amount of it and to suffer a great loss in vitality. How could Chen Xilai not be filled with hatred?
All this was the doing of the Sacred Lands of Qianyuan Divine Province!
If it weren’t for his seven thousand years under suppression, with his talent, he would have cultivated to the Holy Abyss Realm. Even if he couldn’t dominate the Qianyuan Divine Province, he would have lived for a hundred thousand years, not end up in this plight.
These thieves were still coveting his physical body, seeking the Heavenly Evil Orb through it. It was utterly detestable!
Chen Xilai looked up at the three Divine Yuan Realm warriors battling in the sky, as well as the five Divine Yuan Realm warriors observing. His heart brimmed with intense killing intent.
Nevertheless, Chen Xilai concealed his murderous intent. He knew he couldn’t reveal himself now. The priority was to absorb the seven halos of light—they represented the cultivation that had been stolen from him.
As long as he successfully reclaimed his cultivation and spent a little time, he could return to his peak combat ability. Even with his foundation severely damaged, he would still have the chance to seek revenge.
In the sky above, the battle raged on, growing even fiercer.
But to the discerning observer, it was apparent that Lu Zhen, the Third Patriarch of Bai Yujing, had seized an absolute advantage, single-handedly suppressing two Divine Yuan Realm warriors at the late stage.
Lu Zhen wielded his sword with a might that reached the heavens, the sword light dazzling as he forced the Devil Emperor of the Blood Sea and the jubilant Arhat into a desperate position, and both had suffered minor injuries.
As for Lu Zhen, he was strolling leisurely, calm and composed, as if he was not fighting two late-stage Divine Yuan Realm warriors but rather enjoying the scenery.
The Barbarian Emperor, Jiang Taijing, and Lord of Emperor Mingtian, as well as the ancient warrior spirit of the Ancient Empire, watched this scene with grave expressions. Their cultivation was not weak; some were even not much inferior to the Devil Emperor of the Blood Sea and the jubilant Arhat, but under Lu Zhen’s sword, they seemed somewhat dimmed.
“It seems Lu Zhen is likely to inherit the position of Monarch of Bai Yujing in the future,” remarked Ling Lingshuang the Fairy, sighing to herself as she watched the scene.
The master of Xumi Mountain is called a Bodhisattva, the master of Heavenly Demon Hall as Demon Lord, the master of Myriad Demon Mountain as Demon Lord, and the master of Bai Yujing as Monarch.
Monarch, the lord of the Dao!
In the Dao Domain, there are openly fourteen Divine Yuan Realm warriors, in addition to the Sect Masters of the seven great sects like Tai Xuan Sect, True Martial Sect, Chun Yang Palace, who are Divine Yuan Realm warriors; the rest of the Divine Yuan Realm are concentrated in Bai Yujing.
There are three Sect Leaders in Bai Yujing. The Sect Leader is the strongest, having reached the pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm two thousand years ago. No one knows whether he has taken that step.
The Second Grandmaster revealed his cultivation level hundreds of years ago, which was at the pinnacle of the eighth layer of the Divine Yuan Realm. He may now have reached the ninth layer of the Divine Yuan Realm.
As for the Third Patriarch Lu Zhen, more than a thousand years ago, he had just entered the Divine Yuan Realm. Later, because he offended the female Bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain with his words, he was confined by the Monarch of Bai Yujing. Unexpectedly, upon exiting confinement, his cultivation had grown to such an extent, reaching the pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm.
“A prodigy indeed, what a pity,” said Ling Lingshuang softly, shaking her head with an inexplicable lamentation in her tone, her thoughts unknown.
Suddenly, Ling Lingshuang’s expression changed as she looked towards the base of Dangyang Mountain. The Lord of Emperor Mingtian, the Barbarian Emperor, and the other four Divine Yuan Realm warriors, as well as Lu Zhen, who was fiercely battling the Devil Emperor of the Blood Sea and the jubilant Arhat, all looked over in shock, their pupils constricting slightly.
Beneath Dangyang Mountain, the previously listless Chen Xilai, who had only the threshold combat ability of the Divine Yuan Realm, now stood up, his complexion rosy and his breath soaring, exuding the terrifying might of the Tongxuan Realm.
“Have I been discovered? Then, please, go to your deaths!”

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - 207: Punching the Ecstatic Arhat to Pieces, Slapping the Master of Emperor Wu’s City, the Female Bodhisattva is in Pursuit!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: Chapter 207: Punching the Ecstatic Arhat to Pieces, Slapping the Master of Emperor Wu’s City, the Female Bodhisattva is in Pursuit!_4
The exposure came earlier than expected, but Chen Xilai was not surprised, nor had he intended to keep it a secret forever.
His martial arts true intent condensed into a heavenly blade, and his figure vanished from below Dangyang Mountain. In the next instant, he appeared behind the jubilant Arhat, and the heavenly blade in his hand gently swept across, creating a huge fissure in the void.
The jubilant Arhat was greatly alarmed, his brocaded kasaya emanating Buddha light trembled violently, but failed to block the attack. He was sent flying backward, a deep, bone-exposing gash visible on his back, the terrifying blade intent spreading and causing him unbearable pain.
At this moment, the Bodhi Buddha beads ended their entanglement with the Jade Ruyi, flew above the jubilant Arhat’s head, bloomed with Buddha light, dispelled the blade intent, helped the jubilant Arhat to recover, and protected him.
After slashing the jubilant Arhat with his blade, Chen Xilai didn’t linger to fight; his figure disappeared as he continued his assault on other Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors.
But Lu Zhen, Ling Lingshuang, Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, and other Divine Yuan Realm powerhouses were not to be trifled with. With the jubilant Arhat blocking one strike, they had all reacted, activating their sacred weapons and engaging in a fierce battle with the heavenly blade-wielding Chen Xilai.
While they were still hesitating whether to pay the price to fully activate their sacred weapons, Chen Xilai charged fearlessly, striking in broad, powerful sweeps, his blade qi crisscrossing the heavens and the earth, shining for tens of millions of miles, shaking the universe.
He knew his end was near, and even with restored sanity, he could not escape fate, so he might as well take the opportunity to kill a few Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors for some relief.
“Go to hell!”
The jubilant Arhat’s expression was filled with livid rage; he paid a significant price to fully awaken the Bodhi Buddha beads. In an instant, light radiated brilliantly, and twenty-four heavenly realms truly manifested, sealing the skies and locking the earth, pressing down on Chen Xilai.
Chen Xilai, knowing he had no escape and with no desire to flee, wielded the heavenly blade and employed his strongest secret technique, slashing at the twenty-four heavens eighty-one times in rapid succession.
“Boom~”
One after another, the heavenly worlds crumbled, their powerful might spilling out, causing the other Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors to change their expressions drastically and hastily shield themselves.
“To shatter the twenty-four heavens, you are not worthy, die!” the jubilant Arhat shouted angrily, continuously attacking Chen Xilai.
The twenty-four heavenly realms, derived from the Bodhi Buddha beads, were both offensive and defensive, circulating endlessly. If all the heavens were not destroyed in one go, they would swiftly recover, after all, they were manifestations of a sacred soldier.
“Gentlemen, if you do not take action now, when will you?”
The jubilant Arhat, unable to bring down Chen Xilai, called out to the other Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors.
Lu Zhen, Emperor Mingtian, Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, and other Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors exchanged glances and each spurred their sacred soldiers to attack the trapped Chen Xilai.
However, they did not fully revive their sacred soldiers, deeming it unnecessary.
Rumble!
The heavens and earth erupted with tremendous might, sweeping all around, shattering the cosmos, blotting out the sun and the moon and reducing the towering Dangyang Mountain to a plain.
Chen Xilai, struck by a combined blow from eight Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors, suffered severe injuries and his energy plummeted. He had already been gravely weakened, with his combat ability temporarily restored to its peak, but after this battle, he could hold on no longer.
“I hate this, the way of heaven is unjust!”
Chen Xilai roared, his body falling rapidly, and with a “thud”, he crashed onto the ground, lifeless, his physical body and primordial spirit all falling into stillness.
At this moment, Lu Zhen, Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, and the jubilant Arhat all took action, attempting to seize Chen Xilai’s physical body.
But all three were unsuccessful and instead were blown away, each suffering varying degrees of injuries.
The Lord of Emperor Wu’s City appeared quietly, repelled the three Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors with a single strike, took Chen Xilai’s physical body into his hand, and attempted to flee.
“Hmph!”
Ling Lingshuang, Jiang Taijing, Emperor Mingtian, and other Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors simultaneously let out a cold snort, with their sacred soldiers summoned and striking at the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City.
The Lord of Emperor Wu’s City’s brow furrowed as the surrounding void was sealed, preventing his escape. Heaving a sigh, he braced himself for battle.
Boom!
A new round of battle erupted, with the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City withstanding the assault from eight Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors and blocking the power of the eight sacred soldiers, invincibly strong.
He used a taboo secret technique to boost his strength to that of the Sacred Abyss realm for a limited time, otherwise, he wouldn’t have dared to come and steal Chen Xilai’s physical body.
The Lord of Emperor Wu’s City revealed himself, and his identity was immediately exposed, or rather he never bothered to disguise it, for after obtaining Chen Xilai’s body, this identity was no longer useful.
Han Li stood in the ninth heaven, witnessing this great battle.
“Zi Yi, Shi Qi, you handle the distortion of time and space, fend off others who try to peer in.”
Immediately, he flicked his sleeve, and the Emperor Formation Diagram unfolded in an instant, laying down a peerless Emperor Formation engulfing a hundred thousand miles.
Emperor’s Might like a prison!
The vast Emperor’s Might swept across the battlefield, causing everyone’s bodies to stiffen, unable to move.
Their sacred soldiers autonomously and fully revived, attempting to protect their respective Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors and break through the void to flee, but all failed.
Under this supreme Emperor’s Might, the eight sacred soldiers teetered on the brink of collapse, their power completely dissipated, struggling to fend for themselves.
Lu Zhen, Ling Lingshuang, Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, the jubilant Arhat, and other Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors were terrified, knowing immediately that they had fallen into the Emperor Formation, under the influence of the Emperor’s Might.
The Lord of Emperor Wu’s City included, everyone’s faces paled, and foreheads beaded with cold sweat.
All this for the sake of capturing Chen Xilai’s body—it seemed like an overreaction to deploy the Emperor Formation.
Although the Great Holy Land Schools placed great value on the Heavenly Evil Orb, they had only sent their disciples with sacred weapons to deal with it, not deeming it worthy enough to dispatch their Emperor Weapons.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - 207: Punching the Ecstatic Arhat to Pieces, Slapping the Master of Emperor Wu’s City, the Female Bodhisattva is in Pursuit!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: Chapter 207: Punching the Ecstatic Arhat to Pieces, Slapping the Master of Emperor Wu’s City, the Female Bodhisattva is in Pursuit!_5
Han Li didn’t care what they were thinking; time was of the essence, and he had no time to play games with them.
With a thought, one of his avatar manifested and instantly appeared in the midst of the battlefield.
Han Li’s avatar threw a punch, directly exploding the jubilant Arhat and erasing his dazzling Primordial Spirit, leaving only a wisp of the spirit’s light to be suppressed.
Then, his figure appeared behind the lord of Emperor Wu’s City. He raised his hand and pressed it against the back of the city lord’s head. The city lord tried to resist but was suppressed by the Emperor’s Might and couldn’t struggle, only able to watch helplessly as his soul was searched.
After obtaining the memory he wanted, Han Li casually slapped him away. He then slapped Lu Zhen, Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, Jiang Taijing, ancestors of the Ancient Empire, Heaven Lord of Emperor Mingtian, and the Barbarian Emperor, with varying intensities.
Ling Lingshuang closed her eyes; she knew she was next. But instead of the anticipated slap, a strong hand encircled her soft waist.
Ling Lingshuang was about to resist when she found her cultivation sealed and herself unable to speak, bewilderingly taken away by this suddenly appearing powerhouse.
From the moment Han Li entered the scene to him taking away Ling Lingshuang, it was but a single breath’s time before he disappeared without a trace, as if he had never been there.
The chaotic battlefield, however, proved that Ancestor Han had been there, but no one knew who this person was. They only knew that the visitor wore a ghastly face mask and was clad in a blue robe.
Lu Zhen’s Divine Sense surged out, noticing Ling Lingshuang’s disappearance, his expression changed, and after a moment’s hesitation, he stopped and rushed towards Chen Xilai’s body.
The mysterious powerhouse from before was too strong, definitely possessing Tongxuan Realm cultivation, and he had also activated the Emperor Formation. Lu Zhen was unable to catch up and didn’t know where Ling Lingshuang was taken.
This was something to be dealt with by the rulers of the Sacred Land. The urgent matter at hand was to seize Chen Xilai’s body.
The Heaven Lord of Emperor Mingtian, ancestors of the Ancient Empire, Barbarian Emperor, and Jiang Taijing from the House of Divine Armies silently retreated, having no intention to contest further.
Today really was a bout of extreme misfortune; the grand opportunity that was within their grasp was lost, and they were inexplicably slapped by a mysterious powerhouse, causing them to cough up blood.
However, thinking of the miserably killed jubilant Arhat, they realized how fortunate they were to have survived the encounter with the mysterious powerhouse.
The jubilant Arhat was truly pitiable. As soon as Chen Xilai, the Sky Saber, appeared, he targeted and grievously wounded the Arhat. Previously, when the lord of Emperor Wu’s City showed up, he too seized the opportunity to violently attack the Arhat, aiming to break through at that point.
Then the mysterious powerhouse appeared, directly punching and killing the jubilant Arhat.
But why did the mysterious powerhouse not harm Ling Lingshuang and instead took her away?
Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, clutching his chest, watched Lu Zhen contend for Chen Xilai’s body. His face went through a series of changes but ultimately, he did not make a move.
Having been caught in an unwarranted disaster, it was pointless to join the fray, especially since he couldn’t defeat Lu Zhen, not to mention the lord of Emperor Wu’s City was also vying for the body.
“Don’t even think about it!”
The lord of Emperor Wu’s City yelled in rage, raising his hand for a palm strike in an attempt to suppress Lu Zhen.
Previously, he had been suppressed by the Emperor Formation and forcibly had his soul searched, causing some confusion in his memory. But after all, he was a Peak Quasi-Emperor in his former life and was also in the later stages of the Tongxuan Realm in this life; he quickly stabilized himself.
However, he was once again struck by the powerhouse, causing the body of Chen Xilai he had almost captured to fly away.
The Jade Ruyi shone brightly, waves of Dao rippling out, blocking the oppressive punch and allowing Lu Zhen to successfully secure Chen Xilai’s body.
The lord of Emperor Wu’s City wanted to strike again, but his face suddenly changed as he activated a Secret Technique and vanished on the spot.
The next moment, terrifying Emperor’s Might unfolded, nearly causing several Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors present to fall from the sky, as they looked toward the heavens in shock.
They saw figures emerge from bundles of Emperor’s Light: the Demon Lord, the female Bodhisattva, the Daoist from Bai Yujing, the Old Daoist looking over the sea, and other powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm. Above each of their heads hung a supreme weapon, an Imperial Weapon.
“Where do you think you’re going!”
The Daoist from Bai Yujing looked in the direction where the lord of Emperor Wu’s City fled. With a thought, the Imperial Weapon above his head struck out, shattering space-time, traversing tens of millions of miles, gravely wounding the city lord before apprehending him and bringing him back.
The Demon Lord, Demon Lord, and several other Tongxuan Realm powerhouses glanced below, then at the lord of Emperor Wu’s City, and finally, their gazes converged on the female Bodhisattva and the Old Daoist looking over the sea.
Previously, they had been observing the battle using Secret Techniques or with the help of Imperial Weapons, but suddenly the scene disappeared. They realized that something unexpected had occurred at Dangyang Mountain. They tried to divine information using the Imperial Weapons, but found that the heavenly secrets were obscured, space-time disturbed, with no information to be deduced.
They made a decisive move, communicated with their Imperial Weapons, which immediately revived some of their power, carrying them across billions of miles of space-time, aiming to directly descend upon Dangyang Mountain.
But yet another unexpected event occurred, preventing their descent to Dangyang Mountain, as layer upon layer of space-time blocked their path.
Once the resistance vanished, the several Tongxuan Realm powerhouses, led by the Imperial Weapons, descended in an instant, but by then the mysterious powerhouse had already vanished without a trace.
The Demon Lord, Demon Lord, Daoist, and others heaved a sigh of relief; the Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors of their Sacred Land had not suffered losses, only some injuries at most.
In contrast, Xumi Mountain and Penglai Immortal Sect suffered the most severe losses. The jubilant Arhat of Xumi Mountain had been directly killed, and Fairy Lingshuang of the Penglai Immortal Sect had been kidnapped.
“Who is it?”
The Old Daoist looking over the sea was furious, the chaos-colored bell above his head spinning ceaselessly, emitting supreme Emperor’s Light as he tried to find some trace. However, he found nothing, not even able to trace back through time.
The female Bodhisattva’s expression was also unpleasant, about to say something when she suddenly felt moved, sensing the faint breath of the jubilant Arhat, very far from this place.
The female Bodhisattva humphed coldly, gestured to Xumi Mountain, and another Imperial Weapon descended immediately. Then she disappeared with the two Imperial Weapons.
The Daoist, Demon Lord, Barbarian Lord, and Demon Lord, four Tongxuan Realm powerhouses, exchanged looks, contemplative. The female Bodhisattva had left in a hurry, had she discovered something?
Should they follow her?

chapters.title: Chapter 443: 208: I heard the female Bodhisattva is very graceful, I want to have a taste_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: Chapter 208: I heard the female Bodhisattva is very graceful, I want to have a taste_1
Xuan Domain, Dangyang Mountain.
The rulers of the great holy land schools from the Qianyuan Divine Province descended with imperial arms, their mighty pressure overwhelming all creatures, looking down upon the world with awe-inspiring presence that shook the heavens and the earth.
Besides the Pusa of Xumi Mountain who had left, still in the Nine Heavens were the Monarch of Bai Yujing, the Demon Lord of the Heavenly Demon Hall, the Demon Lord of Myriad Demon Mountain, the Barbarian Lord from the Summit of the Stars, the old Taoist from the Penglai Immortal Sect who observes the sea, and the progenitor of weapons from the House of Divine Armies.
Six powerful beings from the Tongxuan Realm stood proud in the Nine Heavens, each upholding an imperial weapon, their Emperor’s Light shining across the heavens, Emperor’s Might suppressing ages, causing such a great commotion that it even drew the attention of many powerhouses within the surrounding divine provinces.
The Monarch of Bai Yujing wore a gentle expression, the Demon Lord remained calm and composed, the progenitor of weapons was contemplative, the Demon Lord had a look of amusement, the Barbarian Lord showed no emotion, while the old Taoist from Penglai was frowning deeply, clearly very displeased.
“Dongfang Qingcang, this matter has nothing to do with Myriad Demon Mountain, so what are you doing here? Just here to enjoy the show?”
After a glance around, the old Taoist from Penglai’s gaze finally settled on Dongfang Qingcang, the Demon Lord of Myriad Demon Mountain, and he spoke with a very confrontational tone.
A few years ago, when the Dragon Saint reincarnated and brought a mysterious elder from the Tongxuan Realm with an imperial weapon to the Penglai Immortal Sect, it caused a change in the meticulous plans of the Heavenly Immortal ancestor from Penglai, forcing the old Taoist to alter his strategy.
Although he managed to trick Long Yue and that mysterious elder from the Tongxuan Realm a little, the old Taoist was still annoyed, as the vital multicolored Qilin Loach was gone, and his plans of tens of thousands of years were close to failure.
Years had passed, and Long Yue still hadn’t refined that multicolored Qilin Loach, meaning he had discovered the fallback of the Penglai Immortal Sect, and the plan was essentially a failure.
