Had it not been for the Heavenly Immortal ancestor’s numerous contingencies, not limited to orchestrating the Dragon Saint’s line, the old Taoist wouldn’t have let go so easily.
Even so, the old Taoist’s mood hadn’t been great for these past few years, and now it was even worse.
His beloved disciple Ling Lingshuang was kidnapped, and the old Taoist was nearly driven mad with rage, furiously indignant, but since the gathering was full of significant figures, he didn’t want to show it too openly in case it became fodder for gossip.
Although the Penglai Immortal Sect was one of the great holy land schools of the Qianyuan Divine Province, its foundations were relatively shallow, even less so than the House of Divine Armies. There were only four Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors in their generation, and now one had been kidnapped and gone missing.
Ling Lingshuang’s talent was remarkable, although not quite on par with Lu Zhen of Bai Yujing; among the four Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors of the Penglai Immortal Sect, she was the most promising. Under his guidance, she had the potential to break through to the Tongxuan Realm and replace him as the guardian of the Penglai Immortal Sect in the future.
Ling Lingshuang had been stuck at the Sixth Heaven of the Divine Yuan Realm for decades, unable to advance to the later stages. That was why the old Taoist sent her to handle the Dangyang Mountain incident and secure the opportunity belonging to the Penglai Immortal Sect, with the hope of breaking through to the later stage of the Divine Yuan Realm.
The potential successor of the Penglai Immortal Sect was taken away—how could the old Taoist not be furious? The other Tongxuan Realm powerhouses maintained their restraint, but seeing the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang with a look of amusement, the old Taoist grew even angrier.
“Guanghai, what are you talking about? Didn’t Myriad Demon Mountain send any Shenyuan Realm cultivators here? Or are you saying that no Martial Emperors from Myriad Demon Mountain went missing?”
Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang didn’t indulge the old Taoist’s irritations and responded firmly.
He was also extremely annoyed these past two years. The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had mysteriously disappeared, obviously having been kidnapped, and while there were traces of an imperial weapon at the scene, no leads were found.
He wanted to shift the blame to the Heavenly Demon Hall and let off some steam, but the Demon Lord Dugu Weizun was not a man of martial integrity, threatening full on revival of divine weapons at a moment’s notice, even wanting to bring back celestial weapons to confront him to the death, in a maniacal frenzy.
Eventually, Dongfang Qingcang reluctantly stepped back, holding back his anger, leading to a cessation of hostilities. But this pent-up frustration had been gnawing at him, and he had held a grudge these two years.
Now, seeing that one of the Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors from the Penglai Immortal Sect was also kidnapped and missing without a trace, the frustration in his heart suddenly eased.
Myriad Demon Mountain has lost one Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor, and your Penglai Immortal Sect has also lost one; now we are even.
“Haha~ Your Myriad Demon Mountain has deep foundations; losing one Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor is nothing to worry about,” the old Taoist replied with a cold laugh, pushing back just as hard.
There were six Tongxuan Realm powerhouses present, four of which belonged to the Human Clan. Even though they were constantly fighting amongst themselves, they presented a united front against outsiders, and the old Taoist was not intimidated.
He indeed felt the same way. The Penglai Immortal Sect had only four Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors, and losing one was a blow to his heart, especially since this person was the successor he was grooming.
On the surface, Myriad Demon Mountain had ten Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors; losing one, Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, was not a big deal, and besides, Xue Yueqing was not the future successor of Myriad Demon Mountain.
In the mind of the old Taoist, Xue Yueqing’s importance couldn’t even be compared to Ling Lingshuang’s.
Upon hearing this, Dongfang Qingcang’s forehead creased, his face instantly turning cold, and he said displeasedly, “Guanghai, are you looking for a fight with me?”
“Based on what you said, your Human Clan has dozens of Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors, several times more than my Demon Clan. Losing Ling Lingshuang really is no big deal.”
The Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang stood with his hands behind his back, his voice firm and forceful, unleashing a terrifying presence that overshadowed everything, exerting enormous pressure on the Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors below.
“If you want to fight, I am ready to give you one,” the old Taoist replied without hesitation, his own aura burgeoning, not conceding an inch.
The atmosphere on the scene suddenly tensed up, hinting at a potential outbreak of combat between the two. The Monarch of Bai Yujing, the Demon Lord of the Heavenly Demon Hall, the progenitor of weapons from the House of Divine Armies, and the Barbarian Lord from the Summit of the Stars all reacted differently.
The Demon Lord of the Heavenly Demon Hall and the progenitor of weapons from the House of Divine Armies stepped back, making their stance clear: they did not want to interfere with the fight between the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang and the old Taoist.

chapters.title: Chapter 444: 208: I heard the female Bodhisattva is very graceful, I want to have a taste_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: Chapter 208: I heard the female Bodhisattva is very graceful, I want to have a taste_2
“Unless it’s a major racial war, they won’t intervene too much, for there are grievances among them.”
The Barbarian Lord from the Summit of the Stars slightly furrowed his brows and spoke, “Both of you, let’s calm down. The urgent matter at hand is to find that mysterious powerhouse.”
With the Human Clan’s power being great, although the Barbarian Lord did not like the actions of the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang, he could only stand on the same side with him, otherwise, both the Demon and Barbarian clans would be suppressed by the Human Clan to the point where they’d have no strength to resist.”
Only by uniting could the Demon and Barbarian clans have the strength to make the Human Clan wary, preventing them from acting recklessly against both clans.”
If the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang and the old Daoist Guanhai fought, he wasn’t sure whether he should help. Not helping would fail to maintain the united front, but helping might escalate the conflict.”
In doing so, things would become much bigger, and if things escalated to a serious level, he feared it might directly lead to the fourth great war between the Human Clan and the Demon Barbarians. Starting such a war now would only lead to defeat for the Demon Barbarians.”
The only solution was to prevent the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang and the old Daoist Guanhai from fighting, which would require shifting the conflict and having both of them focus their efforts on finding the mysterious powerhouse.”
“What the Barbarian Lord said is not wrong.”
The Daoist from Bai Yujing laughed and nodded his head. He was an old man with the demeanor of a transcendent being and kind eyes, wearing a Tai Ji Daoist robe and a lotus crown on his head.”
“For ten thousand years, Tongxuan Realm Loose Cultivators have kept emerging one after another in Qianyuan Divine Province, suggesting that something beyond our control might have happened.”
The Daoist with transcendent demeanor looked at Emperor Wu’s City’s Lord who had been brought in, furrowing his brows slightly.
Seven thousand years ago, Chen Xilai of the Heavenly Dao, a late-stage Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, actually could erupt with combat ability close to the Saint Yuan Realm, bolstered by that red pearl.”
The Lord of Emperor Wu’s City seven thousand years later, a late-stage Tongxuan Realm powerhouse as well, was able to withstand multiple Sacred Soldiers and could also unleash the ordinary fighting power of the Saint Yuan Realm.”
There is also the most mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, who possesses Emperor Weapons that can muddle time and space and Emperor Formations that can conceal fates. He launched a surprise attack on Dangyang Mountain, killed Xumi Mountain’s Joyful Arhat, and captured the Fairy of Penglai Immortal Sect, Ling Lingshuang.”
All other Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors bore injuries, as if this mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse had slapped each one, including the suppressed Lord of Emperor Wu’s City.”
As the Barbarian Lord from the Summit of the Stars and the Daoist from Bai Yujing consecutively spoke up, old Daoist Guanhai and Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang both calmed down. They might dismiss the Barbarian Lord, but the words of the Daoist demanded their attention.”
Plus, what the two said made sense.”
After this incident, both old Daoist Guanhai and Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang suspected that the one who abducted the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing and Fairy Ling Lingshuang was the same mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse.”
With so many Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors on Dangyang Mountain, why did they specifically abduct Fairy Ling Lingshuang?
Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was also a female Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor, and the site where Xue Yueqing disappeared also bore traces of Emperor Weapons, making it hard for them not to put two and two together.”
All six present were among the most prominent figures in Qianyuan Divine Province, well aware that under their control, it was impossible for two mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouses with Emperor Weapons to emerge within a short period.”
All signs pointed towards this conclusion.”
So, who exactly was this mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse?
Where were they hiding?
What was their unspeakable motive for capturing two female Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors consecutively?
To act so openly and within such a short span of two years—it was as if they were not taking these seven Great Holy Land Schools seriously at all.”
At this moment, the hearts of the Demon Lord, the Daoist, the Barbarian Lord, and the other six Tongxuan Realm powerhouses were feeling rather displeased.”
The mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse could capture Ling Lingshuang from the Penglai Immortal Sect and abduct Xue Yueqing from Myriad Demon Mountain, even slaying Xumi Mountain’s Joyful Arhat, acting too brazenly—this had crossed the bottom line of the Great Holy Land Schools.”
If today this person dared to abduct and suppress Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors from Penglai Immortal Sect and Xumi Mountain, would they tomorrow abduct and suppress Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors from Heavenly Demon Hall, Bai Yujing, and House of Divine Armies among other Sacred Lands?
And would they then aim to lay their hands on these masters of the Sacred Lands, the Tongxuan Realm powerhouses?
Did they truly believe that possessing Emperor Weapons and cultivating to the Tongxuan Realm meant they could challenge these Great Holy Land Schools?
Ridiculous!
As Sacred Lands and Great Schools, even if they had fallen into decline, there would be at least one Immortal Weapon and two Top Grade Emperor Weapons within their power circles, accumulated over countless years.”
How could they be overthrown by mere thousands of years of effort from other Cultivators?
“So, if any of you have suspicions about who it might be, feel free to share them. I refuse to believe that person didn’t leave any clues,” said Demon Lord Dugu Weizun indifferently.”
The Ancestor of House of Divine Armies and the Barbarian Lord from the Summit of the Stars both shook their heads slightly; they hadn’t paid much attention to this matter before.”
Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang sighed and said, “I have tried to deduce their tracks before, but failed. There have been no discoveries.”
The Sacred Land Masters looked towards the Daoist from Bai Yujing, who also shook his head and added, “The poor Daoist hasn’t found anything yet.”
Thinking for a moment, the Daoist looked in a certain direction and suddenly said, “Fellow Daoist Yu Fengzi, could you come out to meet us?”
The Demon Lord, the Demon Lord, the Ancestor of Arms, the Barbarian Lord, and other Sacred Land Masters also looked in the same direction, their eyes filled with anticipation.”
Yu Fengzi was a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse and the person in charge of Tianji Pavilion in Qianyuan Divine Province. He was extremely low-profile and almost never appeared in public, such that the world hardly knew of such a powerful figure in Divine Province.”
They had long noticed Yu Fengzi was watching, but hadn’t said anything, or rather, they didn’t care much.”
After all, Tianji Pavilion was one of the nine most powerful forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, always adhering to neutrality with excellent credibility. The branch of Tianji Pavilion in Divine Province had existed since ancient times.”

chapters.title: Chapter 445: 208: I heard the female Bodhisattva is very graceful, I want to have a taste_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 445: Chapter 208: I heard the female Bodhisattva is very graceful, I want to have a taste_3
Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, and other Great Holy Land Schools didn’t want to offend Tianji Pavilion, for Tianji Pavilion also abided by the rules they had set. In Qianyuan Divine Province, it was extremely low-key and never caused trouble.
Tianji Pavilion’s branch in Qianyuan Divine Province only possessed a Quasi Emperor weapon to secure its fate, which didn’t pose a threat to the Great Holy Land Schools. On the contrary, they could obtain a lot of important information from outside Qianyuan Divine Province through Tianji Pavilion.
For example, now was the time for Tianji Pavilion to play its role.
Qianyuan Divine Province, Tianji Pavilion branch.
Yu Fengzi stood with his hands behind his back at the highest level of Tianji Pavilion, looking in the direction of Dangyang Mountain in the Xuan Domain, with a White Jade Ruler radiating divine light behind him.
When the rulers of the sacred lands triggered the descent of divine weapons into Xuan Domain, Yu Fengzi sensed it immediately. He then activated the divine weapons to observe and prepare to make some records.
Dao Jun, Demon Lord, Demon Lord, and others didn’t intentionally conceal their discussion from him. Yu Fengzi knew they would sooner or later come to Tianji Pavilion, and he couldn’t help but sigh,
“My fellow Daoists, Tianji Pavilion doesn’t have the answers you seek.”
Yu Fengzi had no intention of descending there himself, as he genuinely didn’t have the relevant intelligence. Going there would be a waste of time and accomplish nothing.
The branch in Qianyuan Divine Province only had one Quasi Emperor weapon to supervise other forces. Predicting the destiny was not a problem, but once it involved a Quasi Emperor weapon or higher, Yu Fengzi was at a loss.
However, the purpose of Tianji Pavilion establishing a branch here was not to supervise the various Great Holy Land Schools, but to engage in the business of selling intelligence. They wouldn’t sell critical intelligence regarding the sacred lands.
In addition to this, the branch of Tianji Pavilion could also use the Quasi Emperor weapon to receive various secret intelligence reports from the headquarters and sell them to the various Great Holy Land Schools in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Yu Fengzi was also curious as to how Qianyuan Divine Province suddenly had a mighty figure in the Tongxuan Realm with divine weapons and an Emperor Formation.
Could it be that person from five thousand years ago?
Five thousand years ago, a Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor with a bronze ancient sword as his divine weapon had challenged the sacred lands, only to be chased and cornered in a sorry state before escaping from the Divine Continent.
According to Tianji Pavilion’s calculations and investigation surveys, that Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor was suspected to have obtained the legacy of a Great Emperor.
Yu Fengzi was aware of this intelligence, but he had no intention to act on it. As the person in charge of Qianyuan Divine Province, he knew his duties, and it was enough to do his part.
“Sigh~”
The Daoist with the bearing of an immortal sighed but did not ask further.
Demon Lord, the Ancestor of Armaments, Demon Lord, and Barbarian Lord also sighed inwardly, their slim hope vanishing; they understood Yu Fengzi was not lying.
If they, with divine weapons in hand, could not deduce anything, how could Tianji Pavilion’s branch, with only one Quasi Emperor weapon, figure out the intelligence?
Just as everyone was exchanging glances, Guanhai, the old Daoist, broke the silence and suddenly said, “The old Daoist does have one target.”
The gaze of every mighty figure in the Tongxuan Realm instantly turned toward Guanhai, the old Daoist.
“You all must be aware that the reincarnated body of the Sacred Dragon is none other than the daughter of the Left Minister of the Daqian Empire.” Guanhai, the old Daoist, stated solemnly.
“Get to the point.”
Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang snorted coldly in dissatisfaction.
Guanhai, the old Daoist, gave him a cool glance before continuing, “A few years ago, Long Yue visited my Penglai Immortal Sect, though she didn’t come onto the island. At that time, she was accompanied by a mysterious figure in the Tongxuan Realm, carrying a divine weapon.”
Dao Jun, Barbarian Lord, Demon Lord, Demon Lord, and Ancestor of Armaments, among other mighty and strong figures, pupils constricted—another Tongxuan Realm powerhouse with a divine weapon?
“Do you think it’s the same person? Since you’ve seen him before, have you left any countermeasures?” asked Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang.
Guanhai, the old Daoist, nodded and then shook his head, sighing.
He had just made the connection and felt it was indeed possible that it was the same person, and that person certainly had the strength and motive to do it.
After all, he had tricked that person slightly in the past. If that person held a grudge, it was very possible for him to seek revenge. Since he couldn’t take revenge on him directly, he probably turned the target of his revenge to the disciples of Penglai Immortal Sect who were outside.
Otherwise, why would he specifically capture Ling Lingshuang?
The Daoist with the bearing of an immortal looked at Guanhai, the old Daoist, and said, “Since we can’t find that person, let’s track down Long Yue. The man has only one divine weapon and is now being pursued by the Bodhisattva; he has no chance to obscure Long Yue’s fate.”
As Dao Jun spoke, he connected with the Supreme Divine Weapon floating above his head. It was a painting that depicted the mountains, rivers, and seas of the entire Qianyuan Divine Province.
In an instant, the divine weapon radiated beams of light, began to predict the destiny, and the depiction of Qianyuan Divine Province vanished from the painting, turning blank. Then, it displayed multiple scenes.
Those were the many experiences of Long Yue, but some crucial parts were missing.
After the fruitless prediction, Dao Jun said in a deep voice, “It seems the man’s background is deeper than we have imagined.”
The painting depicted by the Mountain and River Diagram did not show scenes of Long Yue after she left the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, nor any scene with her current location. This indicated that the person had obscured Long Yue’s destiny, preventing it from being spied upon.
However, it did reveal some discoveries: Long Yue and the mysterious figure in the Tongxuan Realm had only come into contact more than a decade ago.
The other Tongxuan Realm powerhouses nodded slightly, knowing that if the Daoist from Bai Yujing couldn’t figure it out, neither could they.
“Shall we use the Immortal Weapon?” Guanhai, the old Daoist, couldn’t help but ask.
Dao Jun, Demon Lord, Barbarian Lord, and other Tongxuan realm powerhouses raised their eyebrows but didn’t respond. The cost of using an Immortal Weapon was too great; if it were to be used, it would be Penglai Immortal Sect and Myriad Demon Mountain that would do so.
Sensing the atmosphere turning somewhat awkward, Ancestor of Armaments switched the topic with a chuckle, “I wonder how the situation is on the Bodhisattva’s end, whether she has caught up to that mysterious figure in the Tongxuan Realm?”

chapters.title: Chapter 446: 208: I heard the female Bodhisattva is very graceful, I want to have a taste_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 446: Chapter 208: I heard the female Bodhisattva is very graceful, I want to have a taste_4
…….
On the other side.
Above the vast and boundless Beiming, two figures stood against the sky, a man and a woman.
The man was handsome and impressive, as elegant as a jade tree in the breeze, currently full of smiles, with one arm around a stunning female cultivator; the female cultivator had a cold expression, like a glacier of a billion years, her eyes filled with indignant anger, struggling continuously, yet unable to break free from the man’s embrace.
This man and woman were none other than Han Li and Ling Lingshuang.
After killing the Joyful Arhat at Dangyang Mountain and abducting Ling Lingshuang, Han Li followed his plan, controlling the emperor’s weapon to swiftly descend upon the vast Beiming, concealing his actions from heaven’s secrets, befuddling time and space.
Han Li was quite satisfied with his trip to Dangyang Mountain, gaining multiple benefits in one fell swoop.
If he hadn’t gone to Dangyang Mountain to preside over it himself, it might indeed have led to a major spectacle that would eventually affect the Xuan Domain and the development of the Han Mansion.
This time, he was the biggest beneficiary.
As expected, an unexpected incident occurred with the Dangyang Mountain affair.
First, Chen Xilai woke up, regained his rationality, refined and reclaimed seven parts of his cultivation, and fought desperately against eight Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors with his late-stage Tongxuan Realm cultivation.
Then, an Emperor Wu’s City master emerged, exploding with Sacred Abyss Realm combat ability in the late stage of the Tongxuan Realm, attempting to snatch Chen Xilai’s body. It was quite miserable for him, as he had not a single Sacred Soldier, only a weapon of the divine rank.
After Han Li intervened, he suppressed Emperor Wu’s City master and had Zi Yi search the master’s memories to understand the full story.
Thus, when he killed the Joyful Arhat and abducted Ling Lingshuang, he left behind Chen Xilai’s body and Emperor Wu’s City master to attract the attention of the Sacred Land Masters.
Chen Xilai and Emperor Wu’s City master were both related to the Heavenly Evil Orb. Han Li had no particular interest in the orb, preferring to leave it to those Sacred Lands to fight over, so as to avoid trouble.
In dealing with Divine Yuan martial emperors like Lu Zhen, Devil Emperor of Blood Sea, and the Barbarian Emperor, Han Li merely slapped them casually, holding back his strength to avoid killing them.
Han Li had no intention of offending all the Great Holy Land Schools at the moment, which was why he showed mercy; otherwise, if those Divine Yuan martial emperors were killed, the commotion would be too great, and the seven Great Holy Land Schools would definitely join forces to hunt him down.
If they couldn’t find his trace, they would likely pay a price to employ sacred weapons to deduce his whereabouts. Even with the aid of the Void Bell, Time-Sky Tower, and Sky Concealing Formation Map, his exposure was a possibility.
Once exposed, what awaited him would be the devastating strikes from Sacred Land Schools such as Bai Yujing, Penglai Immortal Sect, Myriad Demon Mountain, Xumi Mountain, who would not let him go, whether it was to avenge those Divine Yuan martial emperors or to uphold the rule of the Great Holy Land Schools.
Now, he had only offended Xumi Mountain, Penglai Immortal Sect, and possibly Myriad Demon Mountain, which made things much easier to manage.
Myriad Demon Mountain might not know that it was he who abducted the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing. Even if Penglai Immortal Sect knew that it was he who abducted Fairy Ling Lingshuang, not knowing his location wouldn’t help them.
Han Li aimed to lure the female bodhisattva; when he killed the Joyful Arhat, he deliberately left a wisp of Primordial Spirit light to tempt the female bodhisattva.
If only the female bodhisattva came after him, Han Li planned to meet her and see who was tougher. If she was careless and rushed over with only one emperor’s weapon, then Han Li would gladly capture her.
If the female bodhisattva called for help, and the Demon Lord, Daojun, or another powerful Tongxuan Realm being came with an emperor’s weapon, Han Li wouldn’t show himself, but would directly annihilate the last wisp of the Joyful Arhat’s Primordial Spirit light and then make his escape.
All these thoughts flashed through his mind in an instant. Han Li looked at the fragrant soft jade within his arms, an unparalleled beauty, and couldn’t help but extend his tongue and lick Ling Lingshuang’s exquisitely flawless earlobe.
The sudden move made Ling Lingshuang shudder, chilling her heart and shattering her composure.
“Who exactly are you?” Ling Lingshuang asked coldly.
This mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse was bullying the weak and showing no shame, but to be so depraved, so frivolously defiling her, filled Ling Lingshuang with shock and fury. Yet, she couldn’t resist.
Having lived for over two thousand years, this was the first time she had been held in the arms of the opposite sex, the first time she had such close contact with a man, and this man was an old monster, forcing her.
“You’ll find out later.”
Han Li smiled but didn’t reveal his identity right away, preferring to keep a sense of mystery.
Then, under Ling Lingshuang’s shocked and angry gaze, he turned her around, bent down to capture those crystal-clear, dripping lips, and tasted them.
“Ahh ahh ahh~ Damn it, my first kiss is gone…” This was the last thought Ling Lingshuang had before she passed out.
Then, to Ling Lingshuang’s astonished look, Han Li knocked her unconscious with a palm strike and tossed her into the System Space; he might have to battle the female bodhisattva next, and Ling Lingshuang would be in the way here.
Having done all this, Han Li finally released the sealed wisp of the Joyful Arhat’s Primordial Spirit light and threw it onto an island below.
Afterward, Han Li fled at extreme speed, distancing himself by tens of millions of miles from the island, watching from afar, using the Void Bell, Time-Sky Tower, and Sky Concealing Formation Map to conceal his actions from heaven’s secrets and muddle time and space.
“I hope the female bodhisattva won’t disappoint me,” Han Li murmured to himself.
Now, Old Han was fishing; it was up to the female bodhisattva whether she would take the bait or not.
In less than half a breath’s time, Han Li saw a divine light descending from the sky, landing on the spot where he had just been.
Amidst the dispersing auspicious mist, divine light shielding the body, from the splendid heavens emerged the female bodhisattva.
The female bodhisattva had her hair coiled up in a dragon bun, wore a plain silk robe, her waist girdled in a brocaded skirt, her eyebrows and eyes like stars and moons, her lips red and moist, carrying a crystal-clear jade cleansing bottle, her feet bare.

chapters.title: Chapter 447: 208: I heard the female Bodhisattva is very graceful, I want to have a taste_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 447: Chapter 208: I heard the female Bodhisattva is very graceful, I want to have a taste_5
The Bodhisattva had a frosty expression and did not descend near the island or on it, keeping her distance which clearly suggested she feared an ambush.
She was well aware that the thief who had killed the Joyful Arhat had an Emperor Formation at his disposal. If she carelessly became trapped in it, even with the help of two Divine Soldiers, she would face considerable trouble.
Above the Bodhisattva’s head hovered the Seven Treasures Pagoda, with its five thousand balustrades and ten thousand niches, adorned with countless banners and streamers, and draped with strings of pearls and tinkling bells; each banner was composed of gold, silver, crystal, conch shells, agate, pearls, and rose gemstones, creating the seven treasures. Moreover, from all four sides of the pagoda, the fragrance of sandalwood wafted through the air.
At this moment, the Seven Treasures Pagoda’s Buddha’s light shone brilliantly, the Infinite Light covering heaven and earth as it spread over the vast Beiming in search of Han Li’s whereabouts.
The seven treasures, like seven sitting Buddhas, emitted sonorous chants that harmonized with the Infinite Light, almost transforming the vast Beiming into a Buddhist kingdom at sea.
However, after searching for some time, the Bodhisattva frowned slightly; she hadn’t detected the thief’s trail.
Had the enigmatic Tongxuan Realm powerhouse left, or was he hiding in the shadows, spying on her?
Why kill the Joyful Arhat and why lure her here?
The Bodhisattva found it puzzling, but out of caution, she summoned another Divine Soldier. With two Divine Soldiers accompanying her, she descended, just in case.
If the target was her and she arrived carelessly, she would suffer a great loss.
With a mere thought, the Bodhisattva made the Seven Treasures Pagoda continue to shine its Buddha’s light, scouring the heavens and the earth, yet still finding nothing.
After some contemplation, she beckoned towards the island, and the strand of the Joyful Arhat’s Primordial Spirit light that Han Li had left there immediately appeared in her hand.
Boom!
Just as the Bodhisattva intended to investigate it, the strand of Primordial Spirit light exploded instantly, emitting Five Elements Divine Light. Punch rays lit up the nine heavens and the ten earths, striking the Bodhisattva forcefully.
The Bodhisattva recoiled thousands of miles, yet her composure remained unshaken, suffering no injuries. She looked at the figure before her and said calmly, “So it was indeed me you were after.”
Han Li’s Dao body smiled wryly, feeling somewhat helpless. He used the Demonic Fetus Technique to conceal a Dao body within the Joyful Arhat’s Primordial Spirit light, hidden so well that even the Bodhisattva hadn’t noticed—but alas, the sneak attack failed.
The Bodhisattva possessed too many treasures. The plain silk gown she wore was Quasi Emperor-level armor, and she was adorned with various other accessories—the least among them being Sacred Soldiers.
Han Li’s Dao body attacked using the Five Elements Divine Punch, but it was blocked by her Quasi Emperor armor. Now, with the Seven Treasures Pagoda reacting, he no longer had a chance for a surprise attack.
“I’ve heard the Bodhisattva is quite succulent. I would quite like to have a taste,” Han Li said, even going so far as to stick out his tongue and lick his lips.
In the face of Han Li’s provocation, the Bodhisattva was expressionless, but the Seven Treasures Pagoda above her head unleashed a ray of Buddha’s light, which blasted onto Han Li.
In an instant, Han Li was annihilated, that part of the void extinguished. A vast area of the sea evaporated, and countless sea creatures perished as a result.
The Bodhisattva raised an eyebrow. Was it really that easy?
Soon after, she let out a cold laugh, realizing that this was merely a clone, not the thief’s true body. Otherwise, even a casual strike from the Seven Treasures Pagoda wouldn’t have the power to kill the opponent.
After all, he possessed Divine Soldiers and an Emperor Formation; his death wouldn’t come so easily.
Having eliminated Han Li’s Dao body, the Bodhisattva communicated with the Artifact Spirit of the Seven Treasures Pagoda. The Pagoda’s Buddha’s light blossomed, Infinite radiance enveloped the vast Beiming, erecting a supreme Buddhist realm.
Although she appeared indifferent, she had internally condemned that man to severe punishment. To have treated her with such frivolity, once captured, she would suppress him beneath Xumi Mountain for a hundred thousand years, converting him into a Buddhist Sect protector, worshiping her devoutly.
Thousands of miles away, Han Li quietly watched all this unfold. With three Divine Soldiers and Array Diagrams concealing him, the Seven Treasures Pagoda still couldn’t detect him.
“Zi Yi, Ji Mingyue, are you confident?” Han Li communicated with the Artifact Spirits of the Void Bell and the Time-Sky Tower, considering whether he could suppress the Bodhisattva in one fell swoop.
“Master, our chances of subduing the Bodhisattva are very low,” Ji Mingyue spoke.
Han Li’s eyebrows raised.
“Master, we’ve detected another Top Grade Divine Soldier on the Bodhisattva. If a battle ensues, it won’t be easy to overcome her quickly,” Zi Yi explained.
Han Li sighed.
It seemed that for today, he would have to let the Bodhisattva go. However, he was in no hurry; there would be other days.
The Bodhisattva was too cautious, bringing two Divine Soldiers with her. Even though he had two Supreme Grade Divine Soldiers and one Top Grade Array Diagram, it would be difficult to defeat her swiftly.
Battles at the Heaven Imperial Realm level were enormously disruptive. The Sacred Land Masters of Qianyuan Divine Province would soon notice and descend upon them.
If he were to be attacked by multiple Divine Soldiers, he would not be able to escape. Seeing his foundation, those Sacred Land Masters might employ Immortal Soldiers to prevent his flight.
As his thoughts turned, Han Li immediately departed, not lingering, as today’s gains had already been substantial.
Less than half a breath after Han Li left, figures started to arrive in Beiming—one by one, Dao Lords, Demon Lords, and Lords of Demons, all Tongxuan Realm powerhouses.
PS: With this segment of the plot complete, including the stories of Ji Mingyue, Zi Yi, and Yuan Youwei, we’re going to jump forward in the timeline, by at least thirty years. I’m thinking of trying a different narrative style, something like a family saga. Ancestor Han will still marry and take concubines, fathering children, but those parts of the story will be much shorter. Mainly, it will focus on some exceptional descendants of the family, as well as the stories of the original wives and concubines.
Through different facets, we’ll portray the power of the Han Mansion and Han Li, and this time, there won’t be the kind of monodrama that occurred with the previous time skip that you didn’t enjoy and that also wore me out writing.

chapters.title: Chapter 448: 209: Ling Lingshuang's Shock and Despair! The Naturally Gifted Ancestor Han!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 448: Chapter 209: Ling Lingshuang’s Shock and Despair! The Naturally Gifted Ancestor Han!_1
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
Han Li stood erect on Chengdao Peak, his hands clasped behind his back, his face expressionless as he looked toward the direction of Beiming.
With his current strength, he naturally couldn’t see Beiming. His Divine Sense was now on par with a fourth-layer Tongxuan Realm cultivator, only covering a radius of fifty million li, and Beiming was extremely far from Chengsheng Mountain.
The East Sea and South Sea were considered inner seas of Qianyuan Divine Province, whereas Beiming did not belong to Qianyuan Divine Province. Its vastness was boundless, linking multiple Divine Provinces, and was even larger than the area of Qianyuan Divine Province.
“Those old sly foxes,” Han Li muttered softly.
Although he couldn’t see them, the Void Bell and Time-Sky Tower could sense them; Zi Yi and Shi Qi saw several powerful beings from the Tongxuan Realm, wielding Emperor Weapons, descending just moments after his departure.
If he had truly fought a grand battle with the female bodhisattva, he would have definitely been cornered by these individuals, making it difficult to flee when the time came.
“I think you’re the real old sly fox.”
Ling Lingshuang, standing beside Han Li, retorted coldly and unceremoniously upon hearing his words.
She held the Tongxuan Realm mighties, like her master Monk Guanhailao, Monarch of Bai Yujing, and the Female Bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain, in high esteem. At least, they would not do something as despicable as bullying the weak by virtue of their power.
The key issue was that this person had no sense of martial morality. Despite being a powerful Tongxuan Realm being with Emperor Weapons and Emperor Formations, he deviously ambushed them, the Divine Yuan martial emperors. It was shameless.
Ling Lingshuang still remembered that right before she was knocked unconscious, this person had forcefully kissed her, taking liberties with the Fairy of Qianyuan Divine Province and defiling her, the esteemed Fairy Lingshuang.
If only she was a match for this person, she would have dearly wished to return the favor and make him realize that she, Ling Lingshuang, was not to be trifled with.
Han Li raised his eyebrows, his tone somewhere between mocking and serious, “My dear Fairy Lingshuang, have you ever considered the possibility that I might actually be younger than you, perhaps not even amounting to a fraction of your age?”
Ling Lingshuang had been brought to Chengdao Peak, her fate sealed to become his Dao companion. At this point, Han Li didn’t mind revealing the truth to her.
After all, Ling Lingshuang had no means of escape.
For now, he would just give the Penglai Immortal Sect’s esteemed Fairy Lingshuang a small shock.
“Are you joking?”
Ling Lingshuang’s heart skipped a beat, only to sneer in response, not believing him for a second.
With her first-grade talent, she was considered to possess peerless potential across the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, and as an exalted Fairy, she had been enveloped in various divine auras since her debut. Her fame shook Qianyuan Divine Province, and even so, it took her over two thousand years to reach her current level of cultivation.
On her cultivation journey to the sixth layer of the Divine Yuan Realm, Ling Lingshuang encountered numerous fortuitous opportunities. She felt her destiny was auspicious, and now, at barely more than 2400 years of age, she had great hopes of breaking through to the Tongxuan Realm.
But what was this person saying?
His cultivation level was much higher than hers, he was definitely a mighty Tongxuan Realm cultivator. The idea that his cultivation period was shorter than hers was acceptable to Ling Lingshuang. After all, she was aware of many secrets, knowing that even first-grade talents had their own levels.
Barely qualifying for first-grade talent and being close to Immortal-grade talent, although both were first-grade, the speed of cultivation was different. Not to mention special physiques; if this person possessed a King’s Body or even an Emperor’s Body and had major destiny favoring him, reaching the Tongxuan Realm at an early age was plausible.
Yet, this person was claiming that his cultivation years were just a fraction of hers, implying he had reached the level of a powerful being in the Tongxuan Realm—seemingly in the latter stages—in under four hundred years; this was utterly impossible.
Even if he did possess first-grade talent and an Emperor’s Body, she still found it unbelievable, for good talent and strong physiques were one thing, but adequate cultivation resources were necessary too. This man was obviously a Loose Cultivator; where could he possibly get enough resources to rapidly advance in cultivation?
“Do I have any reason to deceive you?” Han Li said indifferently.
Ling Lingshuang’s mind was jolted, her gaze upon the figure standing with his hands clasped behind him wavered, and though still disbelieving, her certainty began to fade.
“Before long, you will marry into the Han Mansion and become my Dao companion. Then you will realize that there is not a single falsehood in my words,” Han Li continued, his tone still nonchalant.
Ling Lingshuang pursed her luminous lips tightly and remained silent. This man was too confident, almost convincing her against her will. If what he said was true, it was too terrifying to imagine.
To reach the later stages of the Tongxuan Realm in less than four hundred years was enough to dominate the current era of Qianyuan Divine Province. Even her master and other Sacred Land Masters were far from matching him.
This led Ling Lingshuang to speculate that this person either possessed an Immortal-grade talent or an Emperor’s Body, or maybe first-grade talent plus an Immortal Body. As for having both Immortal-grade talent and an Immortal Body simultaneously, the odds were far too slim. She didn’t believe Han Li had such fortune.
Outside of Qianyuan Divine Province, within the Endless Yuankun Domain, those with both Immortal-grade talent and Immortal Bodies were considered once-in-an eternity geniuses. In the current era, only a few individuals, such as Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu, perhaps no more than a handful.
Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu were figures whom Ling Lingshuang revered as role models, following their examples as guiding lights in the darkness. She had learned a great deal about their legendary deeds, real once-in-an eternity geniuses. For instance, Empress Huang Yue, legitimate daughter of a Heavenly Immortal, born with both an Immortal Body and Immortal-grade talent and emerging during a chaotic era.
She reached the Tongxuan Realm in just forty years, ascended to the Saint Abyss Realm in a century, and, by the age of four hundred, had achieved enlightenment in the Heaven Imperial Realm, grasped the Heavenly Sovereign Path, and stood at the pinnacle of the Endless Yuankun Domain.
With her extraordinary grace, she was one of the brilliant empresses of her era, sweeping through all lands, flattening the heavens and the earth, and suppressing an epoch.
If this person had an Immortal Body or Immortal-grade talents, although not as unparalleled as Empress Huang Yue or the other exceptional Great Emperors, so long as they didn’t die young, they could potentially become a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 449: 209: Ling Lingshuang's Shock and Despair! The Naturally Gifted Ancestor Han!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 449: Chapter 209: Ling Lingshuang’s Shock and Despair! The Naturally Gifted Ancestor Han!_2
When did such a heaven-defying genius appear in Qianyuan Divine Province?
The key point was that this person was unknown; she had never heard of him.
As Ling Lingshuang pondered, a heaviness settled in her heart. The rise of a heaven-defying genius signified the future Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, which was very unfavorable for the Penglai Immortal Sect and other Great Holy Land Schools.
Since ancient times, the Qianyuan Divine Province had been controlled by the Six Great Sacred Land, the grand scheme was always stable, and no upheaval had ever occurred. Even when Penglai Immortal Sect split from Bai Yujing, it could not establish a foothold in the Divine Continent and could only take root deep in the East Sea.
This person possessed divine weapons and Emperor Formations and was also able to cultivate to the Tongxuan Realm in just a few hundred years; it was very likely that he had received the inheritance of an ancient Great Emperor.
From his actions, it was apparent that he was not content to stay put, had great ambition, and did not take the Great Holy Land Schools seriously. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have attacked Dangyang Mountain, killed the Jubilant Arhat of Xumi Mountain, and kidnapped her.
If this person truly rose to power and certified his path as an emperor, then Qianyuan Divine Province would experience another great upheaval, and perhaps several of the Great Holy Land Schools might be destroyed as a result.
Her own Penglai Immortal Sect would likely be the first to be obliterated.
With the weakest foundation of Penglai Immortal Sect, seeking revenge for her by constantly troubling this person would only lead to a bad end once he ascended and controlled the Heavenly Sovereign Path.
“Wait a minute, when did I agree to marry you as a Dao companion?”
As Ling Lingshuang was weighed down by her thoughts, she suddenly realized the situation and looked at the man before her in astonishment.
The two of them had never met before; you shamelessly kidnapped me using your seniority to bully the younger, and even made decisions for me, insisting that I marry you as your Dao companion.
That’s just too shameless!
Ling Lingshuang knew her charm was enormous; she was known as Fairy Lingshuang, her name known throughout Qianyuan Divine Province with countless admirers, including Lu Zhen, the Third Patriarch of Bai Yujing.
However, Ling Lingshuang was solely devoted to her cultivation, taking the unparalleled Empresses Yuanchu and Fengyue as her role models, and never thought about marrying anyone or becoming any Dao companion.
She aimed to break through to the Tongxuan Realm as soon as possible and then, with the aid of Penglai Immortal Sect’s various rare resources, there was still hope to make a push for the Shengyuan Realm.
Men were just obstacles to her cultivation speed!
No men in her heart, her cultivation was naturally divine!
She had never thought that someone would decide her life’s big event with a single word, and this person was the very same man, who upon their first meeting, had kidnapped her and stolen her first kiss.
Too overbearing!
“I say you agreed, which means you’ve agreed. You have no choice,” Han Li said indifferently.
Hearing this, Ling Lingshuang’s brows furrowed tightly, as she coldly stared at him and suddenly said, “Xue Yueqing was also abducted by you, wasn’t she?”
Xue Yueqing was the Demon Emperor of the Demon Clan, the current ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain, with unparalleled beauty and elegance, her fame widespread.
If there were anyone in the Qianyuan Divine Province who could rival her, the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing was definitely one of them.
Due to Xue Yueqing being from the Demon Clan, Ling Lingshuang’s relationship with her was average, but she occasionally paid attention to this Demon Emperor who could compare with her.
After Xue Yueqing went missing, Ling Lingshuang had also investigated and gathered some information.
The Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing disappeared at the border between the Devil Region and the Demon Domain, carrying a top Shengyuan Realm Weapon, yet she was abducted in an extremely short time.
The Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang from Myriad Demon Mountain triggered a divine weapon and arrived instantly but failed to intercept and couldn’t find any clues—all traces had been erased and concealed.
Since then, the upper echelons of the Great Holy Land Schools in the Qianyuan Divine Province knew that there was a mysterious powerhouse hidden among them, possessing divine weapons and formidable strength.
But this mysterious powerhouse was too well-concealed, leaving no clues, so the Great Holy Land Schools could only wait patiently, waiting for him to show a flaw.
This time, it was she who had been abducted, and the modus operandi was all too similar.
Ling Lingshuang was almost certain that the mysterious powerhouse who had abducted Xue Yueqing was the man before her.
“That’s right,” Han Li admitted frankly.
Ling Lingshuang’s heart jolted, her suspicions confirmed, and this man really was confident. He didn’t conceal a thing; she thought for a moment and asked, “Is she still alive?”
“Qing’er is my Dao companion, and you will soon be as well,”
“So, do you want to meet her?” Han Li asked indifferently.
“Hehe~ You really know how to discard the old for the new,”
Ling Lingshuang scoffed, feeling like she had seen through Han Li.
How long had Xue Yueqing been captured by this man?
The time she became his Dao companion was even shorter. Putting herself in Xue Yueqing’s shoes, Ling Lingshuang felt that the Demon Emperor had probably just surrendered not long ago.
Xue Yueqing had become his Dao companion for a mere few months before he grew tired of her and promptly kidnapped Ling Lingshuang, intending to forcibly make her his new Dao companion.
“You are mistaken. I, Han Li, never grow tired of the new and weary of the old; I treat each and every cherished wife and concubine sincerely, including Xue Yueqing. They are all living very well right now,”
Han Li paused, then continued, “I just want to give each of them a home. Is that wrong?”
Ling Lingshuang’s sneer deepened. Han Li really was shameless, actually able to utter such a shameless statement. It was truly an eye-opening statement for her.
Men, indeed, are all smooth talkers; none are any good.
Seeing Ling Lingshuang’s expression, Han Li did not bother to explain further, merely saying, “More words are of no use, you will understand in time.”
The two fell into silence, Han Li admiring the scenery, while Ling Lingshuang watched his back.
A cool breeze blew over, lingering at the peak of Chengdao Peak, helping Ling Lingshuang to calm down, and she said thoughtfully, “Can you let me go?”
She still had great dreams yet to achieve and did not wish to be tied down as someone’s Dao companion so soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 450: 209: Ling Lingshuang's Shock and Despair! The Naturally Gifted Ancestor Han!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 450: Chapter 209: Ling Lingshuang’s Shock and Despair! The Naturally Gifted Ancestor Han!_3
Having become his Dao partner, she no longer had a chance to dominate the Penglai Immortal Sect. Without the cultivation resources of the Penglai Immortal Sect, even reaching the Tongxuan Realm would be difficult, let alone attacking the Heaven Imperial Realm.
“Do you think that’s possible?” Han Li said with a smile that was not quite a smile.
The peerless beauties who fell into his hands had all become his wives and concubines; Han Li had never entertained the idea of releasing them.
Otherwise, wouldn’t kidnapping Ling Lingshuang have been a thankless task for him?
Ling Lingshuang pursed her lips and sighed silently.
Indeed, Han Li would never let her go.
In front of her, Han Li revealed many secrets, not concealing anything, clearly having no intention of letting her go.
After a long silence, Ling Lingshuang spoke again, “I am of prime aptitude, the future successor of the Penglai Immortal Sect. Your act of kidnapping me will not be settled easily by my master. When the time comes, you will have endless trouble.”
“Is prime aptitude that great? We have a lot of it in Chengsheng Mountain,” said Han Li indifferently.
Ling Lingshuang scoffed, with an expression that read ‘you think I believe that.’
Prime aptitude individuals were few and far between in Qianyuan Divine Province, not exceeding twenty, and maybe not even ten. Yet, Han Li claimed he had many in Chengsheng Mountain.
What a joke!?
Great talents with prime aptitude weren’t cabbages.
Han Li couldn’t be bothered to explain and continued, “As for the trouble you mentioned? You don’t think I care about that, do you?”
Han Li laughed, a laugh unrestrained and uninhibited.
Ling Lingshuang was startled, her expression gradually turning ugly. The identity and backing she relied upon was utterly useless in Han Li’s eyes.
This was a heavy blow to Ling Lingshuang.
She had never experienced such a situation before. As the Fairy Lingshuang of the Penglai Immortal Sect, her status was noble, admired by countless beings. She was always held in high esteem wherever she went, but to Han Li, she was worthless.
“Let me tell you the truth, I kidnapped you because your master, the old Guanhai Daoist, offended me.”
“The old Guanhai Daoist dared to trick me, so I’ll take you as a Dao partner first, to recoup some interest,” Han Li said lightly.
Ling Lingshuang was shocked, her eyes filled with uncertainty. Had her master met with Han Li and offended him?
Ling Lingshuang thought it was very likely; otherwise, why would Han Li dare to commit such an outrage against the world, brazenly kidnapping her under the watchful eyes of Sacred Land Masters?
“You first captured Xue Yueqing, then killed the Joyful Arhat, and now you’ve kidnapped me, offending three Great Holy Land Schools at once. Do you really think you can escape the law?”
After calming herself, Ling Lingshuang opened her mouth to speak.
Each Great Holy Land School had a Sacred Soldier to stabilize their destiny, their greatest trump card, and one that could be revived. Even Quasi Emperors, the Saints from other Divine Provinces, wouldn’t dare to act recklessly in Qianyuan Divine Province.
There were only seven Great Holy Land Schools in Qianyuan Divine Province in total, and Han Li, in one go, had offended Myriad Demon Mountain, Xumi Mountain, and the Penglai Immortal Sect, and Penglai Immortal Sect had intricate connections with Bai Yujing.
Whether it was because of the Penglai Immortal Sect or as the foremost Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province, Bai Yujing would have a hand in it. After all, a mysterious Tongxuan Realm power with an emperor’s soldier was already threatening to the Sacred Land.
“So what?” said Han Li indifferently.
Han Li reached out and forcefully pulled Ling Lingshuang into his embrace, leaned in beside her delicate jade neck, and spoke softly,
“You don’t think the Penglai Immortal Sect would use their Sacred Soldier for you, do you? How many more times can your sect’s Sacred Soldier even be revived? No more than three times at most.”
“Furthermore, the heritage of my Chengsheng Mountain is not as superficial as you imagine.”
As he spoke, Han Li gently waved his hand, revealing the normally hidden aura of Chengsheng Mountain before Ling Lingshuang’s eyes.
Gazing at the heritage revealed by Chengsheng Mountain, Ling Lingshuang forgot to struggle, her expression shock, she murmured to herself, “How is this possible?”
The depth of Chengsheng Mountain’s heritage surpassed her imagination by far.
What she saw alone included nine Emperor Weapons, among which at least five were Heaven Imperial Realm level Emperor Weapons.
Ling Lingshuang also saw a sacred might emanating from the distant peak. It was not the might of Sacred Soldiers, but the might of a Saint from the Sacred Abyss Realm.
It should be known that not even the greatest Sacred Lands of Qianyuan Divine Province, including the foremost Bai Yujing, possessed a Saint of the Sacred Abyss Realm, yet Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain did.
Apart from lacking Immortal Soldiers, the heritage of Chengsheng Mountain had already surpassed that of most Great Holy Land Schools, and even Bai Yujing might not necessarily match it.
And this was only what Han Li allowed her to see; she did not know whether Chengsheng Mountain had any hidden Immortal Soldiers.
If there were Immortal Soldiers, then even if Chengsheng Mountain could not become the foremost Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province in a single leap, it could certainly rival Bai Yujing.
“Sigh~”
Ling Lingshuang let out a soft sigh, wondering how her master had managed to offend Han Li. It was like drawing disaster upon the Penglai Immortal Sect.
Straightaway, Ling Lingshuang closed her eyes, not wanting Han Li to see her despair.
Just as Han Li had said, Penglai Immortal Sect would not employ Immortal Soldiers for her, even though she was the future successor of Penglai Immortal Sect and even though they knew that using Immortal Soldiers could potentially trace her whereabouts.
After all, the heritage of Penglai Immortal Sect was insufficient, and the stored Spirit Source was very scarce; the Immortal Soldier that suppressed the sect’s fate could only fully revive at most two more times.
Even if one counted the Immortal Soldier’s autonomous full revival, it could only fully fight thrice at most—far too few.
This was fundamental in maintaining the status of Penglai Immortal Sect, and they would not employ it for her sake.
Without her, Penglai Immortal Sect would still cultivate other peerless geniuses as successors. Though her several senior brothers were somewhat inferior to her, with vigorous training, they also had the hope of reaching the Tongxuan Realm, not to mention the outstanding younger generations below them.
But once the revival count of the Immortal Soldiers was exhausted, the Immortal Soldier would become a mere decoration, unable to be stimulated, unable to be revived, and thus it would pose no threat. The status of Penglai Immortal Sect would plummet, and all their schemes would be affected.
“Ling Lingshuang, think carefully, and tell me your answer in three days,” said Han Li softly.
Feeling the warm breath on her ears, Ling Lingshuang’s delicate body trembled, and she said coldly, “What if I refuse?”
“I will still take you as my Dao companion. I told you, you have no choice,” he replied.
He paused, then added, “However, that will greatly reduce your status in my eyes, and many of the privileges you could have enjoyed will be gone.”
Ling Lingshuang’s pupils narrowed. She was silent, not knowing what to think.
Han Li released her, choosing not to defile her at this moment. His figure vanished from the summit of Chengdao Peak, leaving only Ling Lingshuang behind.
The next moment, Han Li arrived at the sleeping chamber of Xue Yueqing and informed her of his intentions.
“Qing’er, I have returned, and I have captured Ling Lingshuang as well—go and persuade her on my behalf,” he said.
Upon hearing this, Xue Yueqing breathed a sigh of relief, glad that her lord had returned safely. Then she shot Han Li a glare and her figure appeared atop Chengdao Peak.
PS: I’m not in good shape, didn’t write much, my body is getting worse day by day. It seems I really need to discipline myself and exercise.

chapters.title: Chapter 451: 210 The Stunning Empress and the Cold Royal Sister! Elder Han gets married again!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 451: Chapter 210 The Stunning Empress and the Cold Royal Sister! Elder Han gets married again!_1
At the summit of Chengdao Peak,
two peerless beauties of stunning elegance stood firm, both causing a sensation with their extraordinary grace, seemingly like heavenly immortals.
Xue Yueqing and Ling Lingshuang stood side by side, gazing at the splendid and wondrous scene before them, little did they know that they themselves were the most dazzling part of the landscape, both renowned nymphs of Qianyuan Divine Province.
One, the future successor of the major Penglai Immortal Sect, possessed incomparable beauty and was widely celebrated throughout Qianyuan Divine Province.
One demoness, the current steward and a strong contender for future leadership of Myriad Demon Mountain, also possessed grand beauty, and her fame spread far and wide across Qianyuan Divine Province as well.
Throughout the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, there were but a few who could match these two women in terms of talent, status, position, cultivation, and beauty, not exceeding the number of one hand.
As a member of the Sky Fox Clan, Xue Yueqing was naturally charming but cold on the outside and warm on the inside. She was also the leader of the Sky Fox Clan, the current steward of Myriad Demon Mountain, carrying profound dignity and seen as a supremely beautiful empress aloof from worldly affairs.
Ling Lingshuang’s talents were even superior to those of Xue Yueqing, being the future successor of Penglai Immortal Sect and a warrior of the Divine Yuan Realm, her demeanor coldly detached and proud. In terms of appearance, figure, and temperament, she was not a fraction less than Xue Yueqing, the epitome of an aloof and glamorous elder beauty.
Xue Yueqing was clad in a light purple moon dress that concealed her delicate curvaceous figure, whereas Ling Lingshuang wore a blue-green gown that accentuated her perfect form to its fullest.
“Ling Lingshuang, I never imagined our third encounter would be at Chengsheng Mountain,” said Xue Yueqing, her expression complex.
Although the two knew each other, their interactions were limited to only twice due to factional differences, each time engaging in a silent competition, each wanting to outshine the other.
In the blink of an eye, they both ended up in Han Li’s grasp, and she had even married him as his Dao companion and bore him a child, Han Yongkun.
With her husband’s skills, no matter how proud Ling Lingshuang was, she couldn’t escape his Devil’s Palm and would soon be subdued, becoming submissive to her husband, just like the original her.
“You really disappoint me, Xue Yueqing.”
Ling Lingshuang glanced at Xue Yueqing expressionlessly, disappointment in her eyes.
As nymphs of Qianyuan Divine Province, Xue Yueqing had easily submitted, becoming Han Li’s Dao companion, a fact that made Ling Lingshuang feel somewhat humiliated, believing Xue Yueqing no longer worthy to be named alongside her.
“One chooses their own path, and scales their own Dao. I am very content on Chengsheng Mountain, becoming his Dao companion was an exceedingly right choice,” Xue Yueqing said lightly, her demeanor becoming cool again.
In less than two years since her arrival at Chengsheng Mountain, she had advanced to the late phase of the sixth layer of the Divine Yuan Realm, rapidly catching up to Ling Lingshuang in cultivation.
Keep in mind, when she left Myriad Demon Mountain, she had just broken through to the fourth layer of the Divine Yuan Realm. To break through two minor realms in the middle phase of the Divine Yuan Realm in just two years was nothing short of astounding.
Xue Yueqing naturally knew why this was.
As Han Li’s Dao companion, she indeed received many benefits, each one a tremendous opportunity. Thus, Xue Yueqing quickly devoted herself, becoming earnestly one of her husband’s wives.
As a member of the Demon Clan, her lifespan was three to four times longer than that of the Human Clan at the same realm, but her cultivation speed was also much slower. Xue Yueqing used to feel this way, but after coming to Chengsheng Mountain, she discarded this notion.
On Chengsheng Mountain, dual cultivating with her husband allowed her cultivation to skyrocket; one session was equivalent to twenty years of her hard cultivation, how could Xue Yueqing not be obsessed?
Even though her husband had many pampered wives and concubines, she could still cultivate with Han Li once or even twice a month, her cultivation increasing at a visible rate.
When not dual cultivating with Han Li, she would pursue her own endeavors, such as enduring training at the Time-Sky Tower. She could enter the seventh layer of the tower, where one day of cultivation was equivalent to two years.
Though it couldn’t compare to dual cultivating with her husband, it was hundreds of times faster than her arduous cultivation at Myriad Demon Mountain; comprehensively, her cultivation speed had increased by thousands of times.
Her talent had also risen to King Grade, greatly speeding up her cultivation on its own; Han Li had also given her a plethora of elixirs to enhance her cultivation, how could her cultivation speed not be fast?
If things continued this way, she would be able to reach the peak of Divine Yuan Realm within ten years, and then she could start preparing to nurture her True Spirit.
Han Li had already given her the Tongxuan Pill; she wasn’t worried about breaking through the barriers of the Tongxuan Realm, rather, she sought to polish her foundation, to fortify her roots and address the shortcomings of the Divine Yuan Realm.
When she broke through to the True Martial Realm, she had forged a King Grade Martial True Pill, but during her advancement to the Divine Yuan Realm, she hadn’t birthed an imperial-grade Martial Yuan Primordial Spirit, still only King Grade.
If she wanted to ascend higher, she had to solidify her foundation; when nurturing her True Spirit, she would aim for an imperial-grade True Spirit, and as for the higher god-grade True Spirit, Xue Yueqing could only wish for it, knowing it was unrealistic.
When Han Li abducted her to Chengsheng Mountain, Bai Keqing came to persuade her, and Xue Yueqing couldn’t comprehend why Bai Keqing was so devoted to Han Li.
But a few months after marrying Han Li, Xue Yueqing understood.
Myriad Demon Mountain was the sacred land of the Demon Clan and a sacred land of Qianyuan Divine Province as well, but compared to Chengsheng Mountain, there was a significant difference, as if Myriad Demon Mountain was a minor sect and Chengsheng Mountain was a cultivation sacred land.
Chengsheng Mountain’s cultivation techniques, martial skills, and secret techniques might fall short when compared with Myriad Demon Mountain, but they were sufficient for Xue Yueqing to cultivate. Myriad Demon Mountain might have stronger techniques, but she didn’t have the access to cultivate them.
In terms of spiritual energy, elixirs, weapons, and the like, Chengsheng Mountain ranked superior, especially with the Life-Prolonging Furnace, Time-Sky Tower, Combat Tower, Cnagdao Hall, Enlightenment Stone, and other such auxiliary treasures, Chengsheng Mountain had more and better ones than Myriad Demon Mountain.
The foundation of Penglai Immortal Sect, where Ling Lingshuang hailed from, wasn’t even a match for Myriad Demon Mountain, let alone compared with Chengsheng Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 452: 210 The Stunning Empress and the Cold Royal Sister! Elder Han gets married again!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Chapter 210 The Stunning Empress and the Cold Royal Sister! Elder Han gets married again!_2
Xue Yueqing knew that Ling Lingshuang would definitely agree, just like she had back then.
It was just that it had been Bai Keqing who had persuaded her in the past, and now she was the one persuading others.
“Hehe~”
Facing Xue Yueqing’s words, Ling Lingshuang responded with a cold laugh. Life at Chengsheng Mountain was good? Becoming Han Li’s Dao companion was the absolutely right choice?
Who are you trying to fool!
She did not deny that Chengsheng Mountain had deep foundations in certain aspects, such as Emperor-Level weapons and powerful experts, but these things couldn’t help Xue Yueqing.
Even though Han Li possessed the inheritance of a Great Emperor, compared to the foundation of Myriad Demon Mountain, he still fell far short, and Xue Yueqing’s treatment at Myriad Demon Mountain was clearly many times better than that at Chengsheng Mountain.
After all, Xue Yueqing was a powerful contender for the future ruler of Myriad Demon Mountain.
Ling Lingshuang didn’t believe it, and Xue Yueqing didn’t continue to explain. Their relationship was just ordinary, and the main reason she came this time was that her husband had promised to dual cultivate with her a few more times next month, and there were other benefits as well.
With a smile, Xue Yueqing spoke of the conditions her husband had offered. As she spoke, she watched Ling Lingshuang’s expression change drastically.
Doubt, skepticism, astonishment, shock, stunning, dazed…
Xue Yueqing clearly saw the swift changes in Ling Lingshuang’s expression. Her own face also looked somewhat absent-minded, as if she saw her past self.
After finishing, Xue Yueqing threw out a Jade Vial, leaving behind a sentence, her figure vanished from the pinnacle of Chengdao Peak.
“Inside is the Tongxuan Pill he has given you. Think it over carefully.”
Ling Lingshuang clenched the Jade Vial tightly in her hand, staring at the spot where Xue Yueqing had stood, silent for a long time.
After a moment of silence, Ling Lingshuang opened the vial, and the fragrance of the pills wafted out immediately. She took one out and examined it closely, her breathing gradually becoming rapid.
This was a real Tongxuan Pill!
She had seen records of the Tongxuan Pill in the Penglai Immortal Sect, and it looked just like this: the fragrance of the pill, the patterns on it, everything.
The Penglai Immortal Sect had long since run out of Tongxuan Pills; they only existed in the glorious ancient times. She hadn’t expected Han Li to have one, and to give it so generously to her.
If he could give it to her, then he must have also given it to Xue Yueqing before; his resources were even deeper than she had imagined.
As Xue Yueqing mentioned, Chengsheng Mountain did have a Lower Grade Emperor-Level Dragon Vein; the Spiritual Energy there was much richer compared to the Penglai Immortal Sect, but her cultivation was sealed, so she didn’t feel much.
“I…”
Looking at the fragrant Tongxuan Pill in her hand, Ling Lingshuang’s luscious red lips were tightly pursed, her heart caught in a fierce inner struggle.
As Han Li’s Dao companion, she would be able to break through to the Tongxuan Realm in a short time. In the future, he would let her use the Life-Prolonging Furnace to create a special physique for her, give her the Immortal Cultivating Pill, help her achieve sainthood, and give her…
Initially, Ling Lingshuang did not believe it, however Xue Yueqing had shown her the true depth of the Chengsheng Mountain’s foundations.
Originally, Ling Lingshuang was unwilling, but Han Li, that cunning man, offered far too much.
To choose a bright and rising path, to follow in the steps of Empress Fengyue and Empress Yuanchu and advance steadily, or to remain stagnant, becoming a marginalized person in Han Mansion—Ling Lingshuang realized she had no choice at all.
Even if she wanted to rather die than submit, she couldn’t do it. In Chengsheng Mountain, she couldn’t even die if she wanted to, had no strength to resist, and in the end, Han Li would still have his way.
“Master, I’m sorry.”
Ling Lingshuang sat down dejectedly on the Jade Stone, muttering to herself.
She had made her decision.
In this situation, she really had no choice, even if her Master had grievances with Han Li, even if her Master was very good to her, she could only temporarily abandon her Master.
In the future, once she had a say in Han Li’s heart, she would whisper sweet nothings to dissuade Han Li from troubling the Penglai Immortal Sect, thus repaying her Master.
Ling Lingshuang excused herself with various justifications in her mind.
Agreeing to become Han Li’s Dao companion was against her proud Dao heart, but she couldn’t disagree. Without agreement, there would be no future, a life worse than death.
In another location, within Qiandao Hall.
Han Li was going over the gains from his trip to Dangyang Mountain.
Apart from capturing Ling Lingshuang, he also obtained a set of memories from the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City; the memories had been copied from his True Spirit.
From those memories, Han Li found out that the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City was a Peak Quasi-Emperor in his previous life, and in this life, he was only in the late stages of the Tongxuan Realm. Under the suppression of the Sky Concealing Formation Map, he simply couldn’t withstand the Artifact Spirit Zi Yi’s soul search, even though she was of Supreme Grade Emperor Level.
“The power of Empress Yuanchu really is terrifyingly immense.”
Han Li thought with a grave expression, as the memory of the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City contained scenes of Empress Yuanchu striking across boundless space and time to subdue him with a punch.
Han Li felt a chill watching it; a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor was incredibly strong, and Empress Yuanchu, who had reached the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, was even more powerful.
Empress Yuanchu and Empress Fengyue, those peerless powerhouses who aspired to become Warrior Immortals, wielded incomparable might, dominating an era, suppressing countless geniuses and prodigies, sweeping aside all enemies.
And he had offended two such figures at once; one was Empress Yuanchu, who had killed the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City, and the other was Empress Fengyue, who stood at the same pinnacle. Han Li felt somewhat overwhelmed.
Previously, these two peerless female emperors stood so high and were so far from him that Han Li didn’t feel very concerned, but now he didn’t think the same way. If those peerless female emperors really took action, even space and time were trivial matters to them.
The Lord of Emperor Wu’s City captured a divided soul of Empress Yuanchu at the Saint Abyss Realm, attempting to gain insights into the path of Empress Yuanchu’s True Spirit and even extract the Great Emperor’s origin from her. He was instantly sensed by Empress Yuanchu.
Empress Yuanchu was able to break through space and time to arrive from beyond three hundred Divine Provinces, shattering the Emperor-Level grand formation set by the Lord of Emperor Wu’s City. Even if the Lord had instantly escaped to somewhere tens of Divine Provinces away, he was obliterated by one punch, even causing a Peak Quasi-Emperor war star to explode.

chapters.title: Chapter 453: 210 The Stunning Empress and the Cold Royal Sister! Elder Han gets married again!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 453: Chapter 210 The Stunning Empress and the Cold Royal Sister! Elder Han gets married again!_3
At last, the True Spirit of Emperor Wu’s City’s lord hid within a strand of his Primordial Spirit’s core light, concealed within the remnants of a broken war star, and drifted outside the realm for many years before it finally crashed into Qianyuan Divine Province.
Han Li suspected that Empress Yuanchu and Empress Huang Yue, such peerless Great Emperors, could probably break through space-time and descend upon Qianyuan Divine Province in an extremely short period of time.
Fortunately, these two peerless empresses seemed to be held back by something and did not have the intention to personally visit Qianyuan Divine Province; otherwise, Han Li would have thought about running away directly.
Among his wives, Yao Xi was a split soul of Empress Huang Yue, and Murong Ying was a split soul of Empress Yuanchu, one voluntarily and the other half-forced by him, but it was all the same to the two peerless empresses.
Han Li had defiled their split souls’ bodies, and for that, he deserved to die, an unforgivable sin.
“Low profile, I must keep a low profile,” Han Li muttered to himself.
He decided to implement an Empress Cultivation Plan, aiming to cultivate Yao Xi and Murong Ying into peerless empresses, then go and challenge Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu in a competition—it would certainly be interesting.
With a smile, Han Li severed these distracting thoughts and refocused his attention on the memories of Emperor Wu’s City’s lord.
The lord of Emperor Wu’s City in his previous life was a Peak Quasi-Emperor, and in this life, he was also in the later stages of the Tongxuan Realm. His memories were a fine foundation that could compensate for some deficiencies in Han Mansion and strengthen the foundation of the Han Family.
For example, the main cultivation technique practiced by the lord of Emperor Wu’s City was an Emperor Rank Supreme Grade Practice of the Heaven Imperial Realm level, known as Supreme Longevity Practice.
In addition to this Heaven Imperial Realm level Emperor Scripture, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City also had three Quasi Emperor Rank cultivation techniques and over twenty Tongxuan and Saint Abyss Realm level cultivation techniques.
With these techniques, Han Mansion could make up for much of its lack in high-level cultivation techniques, and Han Li also planned to cultivate these techniques himself, integrating them all into his Chaos Scripture.
Currently, his Chaos Scripture was an Emperor Level mid-grade cultivation technique, belonging to the top-notch Quasi Emperor level. If he could integrate all of the powerful techniques contributed by the lord of Emperor Wu’s City, it was very likely that it would advance to an Emperor Level Supreme Grade Practice, and at that time, his strength would further increase significantly.
Beyond the cultivation techniques, the lord of Emperor Wu’s City also contributed two Emperor Level Top martial arts, as well as many Emperor Level mid and lower grade and Divine Rank martial arts. Han Li did not plan to cultivate them himself but instead placed them all into the Cnagdao Hall, enriching the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain, letting his beloved wives, concubines, and descendants practice them.
After organizing the loot, Han Li extracted part of the lord of Emperor Wu’s City’s memories and processed them into Memory Crystals so that the descendants of the Han Mansion could directly absorb them when learning cultivation techniques, martial skills, or honing their abilities in the combat tower.
These Memory Crystals were roughly divided into four categories, each containing many corresponding memories.
The first category consisted of the cultivation experiences of cultivation techniques, including all sorts of cultivation insights from the lord of Emperor Wu’s City; the second category comprised the cultivation experiences of martial skills, cultivation insights.
The third category contained the lord of Emperor Wu’s City’s combat experiences, techniques, and countless combat scenes, which were tantamount to a Peak Quasi-Emperor’s exhaustive and unreserved teaching of everything, of immeasurable value.
The fourth category was about the lord of Emperor Wu’s City’s accomplishments in Alchemy, Artifact Refining, Formation, and Talisman Making, as well as all the Pill Formulas and Blueprints he mastered.
Knowing the boundless benefits of a Peak Quasi-Emperor’s memories, Han Li initially refined tens of thousands of Memory Crystals and would refine more should they ever be insufficient.
After assimilating the Four Arts of Cultivation expertise from the lord of Emperor Wu’s City, Han Li made breakthroughs in many of his uncertainties, significantly improving his proficiency in Alchemy, Artifact Refining, Formation, and Talisman Making.
Now, Han Li’s highest proficiency was in the art of Formation, reaching Divine Rank Top Grade. Next were Alchemy and Artifact Refining, where he had Divine Rank mid-grade proficiency, and the worst was Talisman Making, with merely Divine Rank Lower Grade proficiency.
Even so, compared to his previous status as an ordinary Fourth Grade Talisman Master, Han Li’s Talisman Making proficiency had improved boundlessly, enabling him to craft Talismans at the Tongxuan Realm level.
From now on, the descendants of Han Mansion, as well as his beloved wives and concubines, were in for good fortune.
“I am so considerate,” Han Li silently exclaimed.
He wished his descendants to become dragons and phoenixes, to become emperors and immortals, but those descendants were not living up to expectations, and for the moment, he could not count on them.
To enhance the power of his descendants and improve their cultivation, Han Li spared no effort and prepared countless opportunities for them.
The ultimate goal of all this, apart from strengthening Han Mansion, was to enable them to produce more, higher talent descendants, and also to provide more cultivation for Han Patriarch’s support.
As a generation of immortals, Han Patriarch felt very tired.
He could not count on anyone but himself; if he did not strive, his descendants would have no prospects. In the future, they would still be ordinary people, common cultivators, remaining at the lower levels.
After reflecting for a while, Han Li sent the cultivation techniques, martial skills, Secret Techniques, and Memory Crystals to the Cnagdao Hall and the treasure vault of the Han Mansion.
Subsequently, Han Li returned to the Qiandao Hall and started the cultivation journey of his cultivation technique. He would like to skip this process, but unfortunately, the system didn’t have this function yet; it couldn’t let him attain mastery over a cultivation technique the moment he acquired it.
To elevate the grade of his Chaos Scripture, the Patriarch also had to diligently practice. When his Chaos Scripture advanced to a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Scripture, he too would be a man who cultivated Emperor Scriptures.
