Three days flashed by.
A major piece of good news spread throughout Yonchang Manor, instantly causing an uproar across the entire place.
The Han Family Patriarch has taken another wife yet again!
The upper echelons of various powers in Yonchang Manor all let out a collective sigh. Could the Han Family Patriarch’s back really handle it?
In just three years, this was already the fifth wife the old Patriarch of Han Mansion had married.

chapters.title: Chapter 454: 210 The Stunning Empress and the Cold Royal Sister! Elder Han gets married again!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 454: Chapter 210 The Stunning Empress and the Cold Royal Sister! Elder Han gets married again!_4
Long Yue!
Yao Xi!
Xue Yueqing!
Murong Ying!
Ling Lingshuang!
Of course, because Han Li concealed their identities when taking them as his wives, the outside world did not know their true identities, only aware that the Old Ancestor Han kept on taking wives.
In the past, they thought the Old Ancestor Han was merely taking concubines frequently, but now it had changed to frequently taking wives. With so many cherished wives and beautiful concubines already, why couldn’t he settle down?
Countless cultivators looked on with envy, jealousy, and hatred. They also wanted to lie back and welcome a large number of cherished wives and beautiful concubines like the Old Ancestor of the Han Mansion, but sadly they did not have the strength and had to honestly prepare gifts to send to Chengsheng Mountain.
Otherwise, the Old Ancestor of the Han Mansion would indeed assign blame.
The grand wedding ceremony was held as scheduled at the foot of Chengsheng Mountain, where the foothills of Chengsheng Mountain once again bustled with life, gathering a large number of cultivators from Yonchang Manor.
Along the banks of the three major rivers within a hundred miles around Chengsheng Mountain, there were endless banquet tables set with plenty of fish and meat, and the common people from the surrounding mortal cities flocked out, having long awaited this event.
Over the years, the Old Ancestor Han had refrained from taking concubines, leading countless common people to miss those times deeply. Before, they could eat two or three times a month, and sometimes they could even eat continuously for a month, which was truly satisfying.
Atop Chengdao Peak,
Han Li came to Ling Lingshuang’s chamber in his wedding attire; this was their bridal chamber for the wedding night.
Dressed in bridal red, Ling Lingshuang sat quietly on the edge of the bed. Under her red veil, she was irresistibly alluring, yet at this moment, she was somewhat nervous.
Three days ago, having spoken to Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang had already made her decision.
But Ling Lingshuang did not say that she had dragged it out for two days, only telling Han Li of her agreement yesterday. She did not want to agree too quickly, lest Han Li think lightly of her.
Hearing the footsteps entering the chamber, Ling Lingshuang’s breathing became rapid. Thinking about what was to come, a numb sensation involuntarily tingled through her delicate body, growing a bit hotter.
Would it really be comfortable to do that thing?
During these three days, Ling Lingshuang had gotten to know the other cherished wives and beautiful concubines of Han Li, such as Long Yue, Murong Ying, Yao Xi, and others. They had shared their experiences with her.
A flush bloomed upon the exquisite beauty of Ling Lingshuang’s face, and she secretly spat, quickly gathering her thoughts; this was not the time to think about such things.
In the next instant, Han Li lifted Ling Lingshuang’s red veil and as he beheld the stunning beauty before him, inches away, he couldn’t help but swallow.
Ling Lingshuang was undoubtedly beautiful, no less charming than any of his other cherished wives and beautiful concubines. She possessed her own unique character and grace, which made Han Li particularly fond of her.
“Lingshuang.”
Han Li directly addressed her in such a manner, feeling not the slightest bit awkward—as he always had.
Upon hearing this, Ling Lingshuang’s body suddenly got goosebumps. She seldom heard such mushy nicknames, especially under these circumstances.
Ling Lingshuang’s heart throbbed uncontrollably. She tried to calm it, but she could not; she hadn’t yet undone her cultivation seal.
Ling Lingshuang glared at him and said with feigned displeasure, “Don’t call me that. I’m not used to it.”
“Of course, Lingshuang,” Han Li replied with a smile, nodding his head.
Ling Lingshuang rolled her eyes at him. What thick skin he had—it was utterly shameless.
Han Li snapped his fingers, removing the seal on Ling Lingshuang’s physical body, as the cultivation discussion to follow would require considerable energy. Without a strong body, Ling Lingshuang would not be able to withstand it.
“Hmph~”
Feeling her body restored to peak condition, Ling Lingshuang haughtily snorted, instantly understanding Han Li’s intention.
“Lingshuang, let’s begin.”
Han Li wrapped one arm around Ling Lingshuang to bring her into his embrace while his other hand rested on her fair and slender thigh. He spoke softly.
Ling Lingshuang’s delicate body involuntarily struggled a bit, then replied in a tiny, mosquito-like voice, “Mhm~”
Huge partings bring sorrow as the white sun tilts, I flick the whip eastward, pointing to the end of the sky.
Fallen petals aren’t heartless things, turn to spring mud to guard the flowers more.
—Gong Zizhen
PS: One more chapter.

chapters.title: Chapter 455: 211 The Plan to Replace the Sacred Land! The Merger of Han Mansion and The Li Manor, The Daqian Empire Is Shaken!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: Chapter 211 The Plan to Replace the Sacred Land! The Merger of Han Mansion and The Li Manor, The Daqian Empire Is Shaken!_1
Ten days later,
Elder Han, supporting his back, stood proud at the peak of Chengdao Peak.
During these ten days, he enjoyed his honeymoon with Ling Lingshuang, inseparable like glue, as Han Li passed on profound teachings to her, and she eagerly welcomed them.
It must be said that the flesh of someone in the Divine Yuan Realm is indeed strong enough to withstand Han Li’s unrestrained conquest. Even though Ling Lingshuang was somewhat reserved, Han Li inwardly lamented the pity, deciding to take it slow.
During this period, Han Li naturally didn’t just spend all his time on Ling Lingshuang. He also took care of Lu Tianxiang and his other beloved wives, such as Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, and Bai Keqing, and even found time to instruct his beautiful concubines Qiu Yueyao, Die Yi, and Fang Yousi.
“Hmph, you’re still too green to compete with the Elder, Ling Lingshuang.”
Thinking of Ling Lingshuang’s reluctant pregnancy, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face.
To have this child, Han Li had quite the battle of wits with Ling Lingshuang, ultimately subduing the proud beauty and barely gaining her consent to conceive.
Han Li verbally agreed to only let Ling Lingshuang have one child, but who can be certain of such matters? After the first one comes the second, the third…
Children are unexpected; we are the true love.
Regathering his thoughts, Han Li began to contemplate the unification of Han Mansion and the Li Manor.
According to his previous arrangement and the explanations given to the wives and concubines of both houses, the merger would happen after the Dangyang Mountain incident.
After the Dangyang Mountain incident, Han Li did not unite the two houses but instead married Ling Lingshuang at Han Mansion. Now, another ten days had passed.
It wasn’t that Han Li didn’t want to merge the houses, but the Dangyang Mountain incident took an unexpected turn.
Originally, Han Li thought he would craft a Dao-clone to participate in the Dangyang Mountain incident secretly, build some reputation and set a record at the various Sacred Lands. Later, he would reveal that Han Li’s true identity was that of a clone’s disciple.
By doing so, even if Han Mansion and the Li Manor were to merge and the relationship between Li Feiyu and Han Li became known, the impact would be minimized.
At that time, Han Li would be known to outsiders as a mid-stage True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, with a Divine Yuan Realm master backing him up. Thus, Han Mansion would be able to develop discreetly.
A mere True Martial Realm; major Sacred Lands would glance at him and not care further, especially since Han Li appeared uninterested in cultivation, only keen on marrying wives and concubines and quietly growing his family. They would be even less concerned.
But plans can’t keep up with changes.
In the Dangyang Mountain incident, the Red-haired monster Chen Xilai awoke and, regaining his sanity, sought to wreak havoc. Then, the shrewd master of Emperor Wu’s City appeared, making it impossible for Han Li to send a Divine Yuan Realm clone there to participate.
A Divine Yuan Realm clone going there would have simply been sending a lamb to slaughter. Even if Han Li later intervened powerfully according to the new plan, that Divine Yuan Realm clone would become a significant vulnerability.
If Han Li took away the Divine Yuan Realm clone, its participation would become meaningless. If he didn’t take it away, the arriving Sacred Land Masters would likely probe into the clone’s background.
After all, a succession of Tongxuan Realm Loose Cultivators appearing one after another would put the Sacred Land Masters on high alert.
The outside world is currently far from peaceful, with some disturbance happening in Qianyuan Divine Province due to Han Li.
The Penglai Immortal Sect’s Fairy Lingshuang was kidnapped, and the old Master View Sea is outraged, investigating various leads to find the mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse who tricked him before, suspecting it to be an act of revenge from the same person.
Although Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang of Myriad Demon Mountain doesn’t get along with Master View Sea, he is also making considerable efforts, as the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing from his mountain was also abducted. They suspect it to be the work of the same Tongxuan Realm powerhouse.
The female Bodhisattva from Xumi Mountain is still fuming with anger. That day, not only did Han Li kill Xumi Mountain’s Arhat of Joy, but he also dared to tease her in Beiming and attempted an ambush. This had made her bear a grudge.
She mobilized resources from Xumi Mountain to investigate, starting with the Arhat of Joy to identify any major enemies he had and if there was any chance that someone had covertly reached the Tongxuan Realm.
That mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse did not severely harm any other Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors that day, only going out of his way to kill the Arhat of Joy. There had to be an underlying reason.
Upon inquiry, the female Bodhisattva learned that the Arhat of Joy had not said anything amiss; there were no conflicts with that mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse. It was more likely an old grudge.
However, after investigating, the female Bodhisattva found no suspects. All enemies of the Arhat of Joy were ruled out, without any case against them.
Most of the Arhat of Joy’s enemies were dead, and the highest level among the living cultivators was at the early stages of the Divine Yuan Realm, from different Sacred Lands and without opportunity for wrongdoing.
Analyzing over and over, the female Bodhisattva had a flash of insight. Coupling that with her embarrassing experience in Beiming, she felt that the mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse was likely targeting her.
He intentionally killed the Arhat of Joy, used a strand of Primordial Spirit light to lure her into Beiming, and set a trap, only withdrawing when he saw the timing was off.
She had carried two imperial weapons with her at the time and covertly communicated with Dao Jun, the Demon Lord, the Barbarian Lord, among other Sacred Land Masters, asking them to arrive later.
Otherwise, the likes of Dao Jun, Demon Lord, Barbarian Lord, and Master View Sea, all Tongxuan Realm powerhouses, would not be calmly chatting in Dangyang Mountain. It was all merely a tactic, foiled only because Han Li sensed something was wrong and retreated in time.
After eliminating other possibilities, the female Bodhisattva was convinced of her conclusion; the likelihood was too great.
First, the abductor kidnapped the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing from Myriad Demon Mountain and then kidnapped Fairy Lingshuang from Penglai Immortal Sect, both Divine Yuan Realm female cultivators. It was only natural to target her next.
The female Bodhisattva held a uniquely high status in Qianyuan Divine Province, being the only Tongxuan Realm female cultivator, with extraordinary grace and stunning appearance.

chapters.title: Chapter 456: 211 The Plan to Replace the Sacred Land! The Merger of Han Mansion and The Li Manor, The Daqian Empire Is Shaken!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: Chapter 211 The Plan to Replace the Sacred Land! The Merger of Han Mansion and The Li Manor, The Daqian Empire Is Shaken!_2
Aside from the Penglai Immortal Sect, Myriad Demon Mountain, and Xumi Mountain, even Bai Yujing had taken action, collaborating with the three great holy land schools to conduct a grand search within the Qianyuan Divine Province. However, while the three great holy land schools acted openly, Bai Yujing operated in the shadows.
The entire Divine Province’s attention was drawn to the incident at Dangyang Mountain.
The anticipated storm did not occur; instead, another, greater turmoil arose that involved three or four of the great holy land schools.
For a time, the many forces in the Divine Province and countless cultivators were in uproar, with various speculations flying high.
A gigantic force, possessing Divine Weapons and Tongxuan Realm powers, was lurking in the shadows of the Divine Province, its foundation only slightly inferior to that of the Sacred Lands.
This intelligence caused continuous tremors in the hearts and minds of influences in the True Martial Realm and Divine Yuan Realm, who speculated incessantly but could never quite pinpoint which force it was.
However, the powers in both the True Martial Realm and Divine Yuan Realm felt that it was a good thing for this massive, hidden force to gradually emerge.
The appearance of this mysterious, vast power would attract the attention of entities like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Heavenly Demon Hall, among other holy land schools. It was preferable for the Divine Province to descend into chaos as the mysterious forces contended with the schools.
Only with chaos in the Divine Province could there be a chance to break the rigid structure of power, allowing these influences in the True Martial and Divine Yuan Realms to rise.
Atop Chengdao Peak,
Han Li’s immense Divine Sense, comparable to a fourth tier of the Divine Yuan Realm, retracted after gathering countless pieces of intelligence.
“Sigh~”
Han Li felt somewhat troubled by the annoyance of being too powerful.
His strength and influence made the great holy land schools extremely wary; he couldn’t reveal his power easily, lest he attract a devastating attack before he could defend against it.
In order not to expose himself, merging Han Mansion and The Li Manor now could be problematic.
His background was impeccably clean, which was exactly why his sudden progress, from an Innate Realm cultivator with eighth-grade cultivation talent to the True Martial Realm within a mere few decades, was so hard to justify.
Had he received the inheritance of a Saint, a Quasi Emperor, or even a Great Emperor?
In such a sensitive period, any significant anomaly would draw attention.
After much deliberation, Han Li realized there were only two ways to continue merging Han Mansion and The Li Manor.
The first was to go ahead with the merger, while still displaying mid-stage True Martial Realm cultivation.
The outside world might suspect that Han Li had come upon a great opportunity, but there was another possibility they might consider: that Han Li was the reincarnation of a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, or even higher.
Han Li had been mediocre before the age of two hundred but rose to prominence in just fifty years, reaching the True Martial Realm. This could be explained by the breaking of an enigmatic prenatal puzzle and awakening dormant wisdom.
There were historical precedents for this; many strong figures only broke through the prenatal puzzle as death approached. Some of them died without advancing to the next realm, while others made the breakthrough, defying fate to rise again.
Han Li could pass himself off as one of these reborn powers.
However, doing so would undoubtedly draw the attention of the Four Sacred Lands of the Mortal World, each considering taking him under their wing. He could only pledge allegiance to one.
Otherwise, Han Li still faced a grim fate.
A reincarnated being of great power who chose not to join these holy lands, preferring to remain a loose cultivator—was that not a sign of grand ambitions, perhaps even to overthrow their dominion once restored to full strength?
If he pursued this path, Han Li would only consider joining the House of Divine Armies or Bai Yujing.
The Heavenly Demon Hall was in decline, and allying with them while frequently taking new wives and concubines could easily make him a target for those upholding righteousness.
Xumi Mountain was even less suitable as it was facing a joint boycott from other human Sacred Lands, their relations with the Demon Barbarians were also mediocre at best, and most importantly, he would no longer be able to take wives or concubines.
Although it would be thrilling to act under the watchful eyes of a female Bodhisattva, Ancestor Han preferred the Bodhisattva beneath him.
The House of Divine Armies was more harmonious, with fewer restrictions upon joining, but its influence wasn’t strong, and aligning with them, effectively including the Qian Dynasty, could invite trouble.
As for Bai Yujing, that was an attractive prospect. Ranked as the number one Sacred Land in the Divine Province, with an incomparably profound foundation, he would certainly be valued even as a disguised reincarnated power.
With the Qitian Teaching in the Xuan Domain offering mutual support to prevent any foul play, and the Dao Sect’s rules being lax with an amicable atmosphere, they wouldn’t restrict his marital options.
Han Li thought joining Bai Yujing was quite favorable. If you can’t beat them, join them.
Having originated from Tianxuan Mountain, which in turn came from the Tai Xuan Sect of the Dao Domain, and Tai Xuan Sect having branched out from the ancestral Bai Yujing, his association would be clear and his lineage impeccable.
By being part of Bai Yujing, he would have a strong backing, deterring other powers, even Sacred Lands from meddling without just cause.
Thus, Han Mansion could continue its low-profile development, enjoying the shade under a large tree.
Han Li could also take this opportunity to send descendants into Bai Yujing and the other seven major sects of the Dao Domain, for them to become disciples.
The cultivation talents of Han Li’s descendants ranged from fifth-grade to highest-grade; by selectively sending some to these sects, they would surely be noticed as prodigies.
Those descendants tasked with carrying on Han Li’s missions, and with his support, could one day become high-ranking officials within these sects. Eventually, it might even be possible to orchestrate replacements.
In hundreds of years, all important positions within the Tai Xuan Sect, True Martial Sect, and the other seven major sects, up to and including Bai Yujing, could belong to people from Han Mansion. Thus, without having to lift a finger, Han Li might control the Dao Domain from the shadows.

chapters.title: Chapter 457: 211 The Plan to Replace the Sacred Land! The Merger of Han Mansion and The Li Manor, The Daqian Empire Is Shaken!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Chapter 211 The Plan to Replace the Sacred Land! The Merger of Han Mansion and The Li Manor, The Daqian Empire Is Shaken!_3
“`
Beyond that, Han Li could also rely on Bai Yujing to ward off disasters.
When the envoys of Empress Yuanchu and Emperor Wu arrive, and discover that Han Li is an important disciple of Bai Yujing, they might not resort to force. Bai Yujing might even protect him, or if they don’t, Han Li would have to deal with it himself.
Secondly, he decided to delay the merger of Han Mansion and The Li Manor, and instead create a new alias to use until the time was right for the merger.
If he chose this path, Han Li’s new alias would be that of a Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu from a large island in the South Sea, preparing to expand into the Xuan Domain. Thus, he would take Han Li as his disciple, using the Daqian Empire as his foundation and establishing a firm foothold in the Xuan Domain.
Before, he had slain a Saint Abyss Realm fisherman on a large island deep in the South Sea. This fisherman had more than one identity, one of which was that of a True Martial Realm power, the Emperor Wu of that large island.
Han Li could replace him with his alias, then pretend to have broken through to the Divine Yuan Realm, and following the example set by Emperor Mingtian, develop towards the Divine Continent.
The first path had many advantages and could take effect in a short time, but it came with some risk. He must convince the outside world that he was a reincarnated great being rather than someone who had come across some heaven-defying opportunity.
The second path also had quite a few advantages, but it required a long time and was risk-free.
After some consideration, Han Li still decided to choose the first path; he only needed to refine the plan further to minimize the risks.
Having settled on a strategy, Han Li’s Divine Sense surged, informing his beloved wives and concubines to get ready, as Han Mansion and The Li Manor would merge in the next few days.
After that, Han Li’s figure disappeared from the summit of Chengdao Peak and reappeared in The Li Manor.
In the backyard of The Li Manor, Han Li’s group of beloved wives and concubines were admiring flowers — the season when hundreds of flowers bloomed.
Xue Qingyi, Chu Xianlin, Song Zhixuan, Feng Ziyue, Qiu Shuhui, Die Yi, and other stunning beauties were gathered in small groups, chatting and laughing joyously.
Even without using Divine Sense, Han Li could hear the conversations of his wives and concubines clearly, as his senses had long been heightened to an extreme degree.
At the moment, the topic of their conversation was when The Li Manor would merge with Han Mansion. After moving to Han Mansion, they would be able to enjoy the abundant cultivation resources there, as well as access various auxiliary treasures.
Han Li had previously mentioned these benefits to them, giving a rough outline of the treatment for the wives and concubines so that they had an idea of what to expect.
When Han Li appeared in the backyard, bright eyes of Chu Xianlin, Qiu Shuhui, Song Zhixuan, and the other wives and concubines instantly lit up. They gathered around him, chirping and asking questions.
“Husband, when will The Li Manor merge with Han Mansion?”
“Husband, when will we move to Chengsheng Mountain?”
“Husband, your concubine misses the sisters from Han Mansion.”
“Husband, …”
Looking at the faces full of anticipation before him, Han Li’s heart melted. Fortunately, he had already made up his mind; otherwise, it would have been difficult to give these beloved wives and concubines an explanation.
Moreover, the first batch of children from The Li Manor were already eight years old and ready to begin their cultivation. Indeed, it was time to move to Chengsheng Mountain.
“Everyone, get ready. We’ll be moving in three days,” Han Li said thoughtfully, setting the specific date for the merger.
“That’s wonderful~”
All the wives and concubines showed excited smiles upon hearing this. They had been looking forward to moving to Chengsheng Mountain, well aware that it was the true stronghold with far better conditions for cultivation, resources, and auxiliary treasures than The Li Manor.
At Chengsheng Mountain, they would also be freer, as the mountain was vast, covering hundreds of miles, giving them plenty of space to roam and play.
Now it was time for Han Li, the patriarch, to enjoy his blessings. To express gratitude to their husband and to thank him for deciding so swiftly to merge the two mansions, all the wives and concubines took turns serving him fruit.
Grapes, honey peaches, honey pomelo, orange, white peach, white strawberries, white pear…
After tasting each fruit in turn, Han Li felt extremely happy, as it had been a long time since he had eaten so much fruit all at once. The last time was, well, the previous occasion.
“So fragrant, so white, so…”
Han Li looked at the variety of fruits before him, giving his evaluation, occasionally reaching out to measure their size. Each one was not small, brimming with bountiful harvests.
In the two days that followed, the news spread rapidly to the Capital City, throughout the entire Daqian Empire, causing a great stir.
Han Li had not asked his wives and concubines to deliberately hide the move; it would become apparent during the moving process anyway, so he let them be. After all, his wives and concubines came from various forces of the Daqian Empire.
The news that The Li Manor’s lord was planning to move out of the Capital City to Yonchang Manor in Yuanzhou, on Chengsheng Mountain, was a sensational one.
Initially, including the Daqian Court and various other forces, everyone thought that The Li Manor’s lord was dissatisfied with the Daqian Court, which was why he intended to move, making a statement through his actions.
Different factions within the Daqian Empire started to calculate their next moves. Some were worried whether the empire would descend into turmoil, ending its stability of over a decade; others wanted to pledge loyalty directly to The Li Manor’s lord and take the place of the Da Qian Royalty; some had other thoughts…
The Daqian Court itself was also full of doubts and apprehensions. Emperor Qian, in particular, was thoroughly bewildered. For years, they had been behaving themselves, never provoking The Li Manor’s lord, and continuously sending wives and concubines to him without cease.
What move was The Li Manor’s lord playing at?
Emperor Qian, the Prophet, the Left Chancellor, and other high-ranking members of the Daqian Empire racked their brains but could not fathom the reason. They were certain they had not offended The Li Manor’s lord; they wouldn’t dare to and had been trying to please him all along.

chapters.title: Chapter 458: 211 The Plan to Replace the Sacred Land! The Merger of Han Mansion and The Li Manor, The Daqian Empire Is Shaken!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: Chapter 211 The Plan to Replace the Sacred Land! The Merger of Han Mansion and The Li Manor, The Daqian Empire Is Shaken!_4
The situation in the Daqian Empire was quite clear. Ever since the battle in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, the Daqian Empire had lost its foundation. Now, the venerable ancestor of Tianxuan Mountain had been in closed-door cultivation for more than a decade without any activity, and Emperor Qian, heeding the advice, had not sought him out.
What the Daqian Empire could rely on was the Lord of the Li Manor, a warrior of the True Martial Realm. They also knew well that the existence of the Daqian Empire was due to the role played by the Lord of the Li Manor.
But what they never expected was that the Lord of the Li Manor suddenly decided to move the Li Manor from the Capital City of Daqian to Yonchang Manor in Yuanzhou. Was this a sign of his dissatisfaction with them?
Emperor Qian and the others were at a loss for words. Clearly, they had done nothing wrong, yet the powerful support they had finally secured was about to abandon them. How could they let this happen?
However, as the news spread, the Daqian Court and various factions within the empire discovered that things were not as they had imagined, in fact, they were vastly different.
The Yonchang Manor in Yuanzhou where the Li Manor was to move, and Chengsheng Mountain, harbored another power of the God Refining Realm, the Han Mansion. Surprisingly, this force was actually one with the Li Manor.
According to the latest information, the Lord of the Li Manor was none other than the Venerable Ancestor of the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li. The Li Manor was a branch established by the Venerable Ancestor in the Capital City of Daqian.
The reason the Li Manor was to move to Chengsheng Mountain was to merge with the Han Mansion, not because the Lord of the Li Manor was dissatisfied with the Daqian Court as various factions had speculated.
This truth was even more sensational than the first guess!
The venerable ancestor of the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain turned out to be not a God Refining Realm practitioner, but an extremely powerful warrior of the True Martial Realm, even a mid-stage one.
Including the Daqian Empire, the upper echelons of various factions combined the information on Han Li, the Venerable Ancestor of the Han Mansion, with that of the Lord of the Li Manor and indeed found it to be consistent.
The Venerable Ancestor of the Han Mansion hailed from Leizhou’s Tianxuan Mountain. Later, concerned about the turbulence in Leizhou, he moved his entire clan to Yonchang Manor in Yuanzhou, occupied Chengsheng Mountain, and developed modestly.
The first time the Lord of the Li Manor appeared was in Leizhou when Tianxuan Mountain faced a great disaster. Dugu Bing from the Yinyang Sect attacked and almost annihilated Tianxuan Mountain. Fortunately, the Lord of the Li Manor appeared and severely injured Dugu Bing with several sword strikes, forcing him to flee in embarrassment and causing his cultivation to plummet.
As the Venerable Ancestor of the Han Mansion was the Lord of the Li Manor, it was no wonder he appeared to help Tianxuan Mountain through the crisis, at the risk of offending the Yinyang Sect.
Intelligence showed that the Venerable Ancestor of the Han Mansion constantly took wives and concubines, from Leizhou to Yuanzhou, and so did the Lord of the Li Manor.
Previously, various factions could not guess why the Lord of the Li Manor frequently married and took concubines, unlike other warriors of the True Martial Realm. Now it made sense.
When the Venerable Ancestor of the Han Mansion moved to Yonchang Manor in Yuanzhou, he likely had all this planned. Otherwise, why would he move to Chengsheng Mountain in the spiritually barren Yonchang Manor?
The Han Mansion had been incredibly low-key on Chengsheng Mountain, but the Li Manor was exceptionally high-profile, obtaining countless cultivation resources from the hands of the Daqian Empire. This was probably the reason the Han Mansion could remain low-key, and it also diluted the relationship between the Han and Li Mansions, leading others to deny their connection.
Given the Han Mansion’s consistent low profile and to avoid the Leizhou turmoil, they moved directly to Yuanzhou. When the Daqian Empire faced unavoidable defeat, the Venerable Ancestor of the Han Mansion appeared as the Lord of the Li Manor to maintain the continued low-profile and stable development of the Han Mansion, thus sustaining the existence of the Daqian Empire.
In an instant, the truth was revealed to the world.
The Lord of the Li Manor was the Venerable Ancestor of the Han Mansion!
The people of the six provinces of the Daqian Empire discussed eagerly upon learning this, speculating on how many wives and concubines the Venerable Ancestor of the Han Mansion had, showing no concern for other matters.
As long as the Daqian Empire still had a powerhouse of the True Martial Realm to rely on, there would be no chaos, and it would not affect them, the ordinary people and cultivators.
However, the upper echelons of the various factions were greatly shocked when they learned the truth and made all sorts of conjectures about Han Li.
They easily obtained information about Han Li, who, decades ago, was just an ordinary Innate Realm Cultivator. How could he rise in just a few decades to become a mighty warrior of the True Martial Realm, commanding respect in the region?
Did he acquire some heaven-defying opportunity?
Was Han Li the reincarnation of some powerful being, only awakening dormant wisdom a few decades ago?

chapters.title: Chapter 459: 212: The Reaction of the Various Sacred Lands, Descendants Reach Five Thousand, Breaking Through to the Tongxuan Realm! _1
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: Chapter 212: The Reaction of the Various Sacred Lands, Descendants Reach Five Thousand, Breaking Through to the Tongxuan Realm! _1
Da Qian, Imperial Palace.
Emperor Qian summoned numerous high officials of Da Qian for a discussion, which included the Mentor of Daqian, Left Minister of Daqian, the Prophet of the Imperial Astronomers, the Head Supervisor of the Jingye Office, the Great General, and others.
At this moment, this group of Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters was engaged in a heated debate, holding different views, and the shocking topic was that the ancestral figure of Han Mansion and the master of The Li Manor were the same person.
After discussing for half a day, the group of high officials finally turned their gaze to the silent Emperor Qian, waiting for him to speak.
“Let’s keep everything as is,” Emperor Qian sighed, saying weakly.
After pondering, Emperor Qian added, “Also, prepare a congratulatory gift of sufficient value and send it to Chengsheng Mountain.”
Before summoning his ministers, Emperor Qian had gone to the forbidden area of the Imperial Palace. He had called out for a long while but did not receive a response from the old ancestorial figure, Zhen Xiong.
The token that allowed passage had been taken by Han Li, and even if Emperor Qian wished to enter, he could not, for it was a top-tier True Martial Realm formation in operation, capable of easily killing him.
The lack of response from the old ancestorial figure, Zhen Xiong, very likely meant his time had come, dying silently within the forbidden grounds. Given this, Emperor Qian did not wish to disturb him; maintaining the false impression that Zhen Xiong was still alive was quite beneficial.
At the very depths of his heart, Emperor Qian also harbored a suspicion that the old ancestorial figure, Zhen Xiong, had died long ago, perhaps over a decade before.
That was the last time he saw the old ancestorial figure, Zhen Xiong, and even then, Emperor Qian felt something was amiss. However, he did not dare to confirm it, for it might bring about his own demise.
If the old ancestorial figure had died back then, then the person who killed him might have been the master of The Li Manor, Li Feiyu, who is now the ancestral figure of Han Mansion, Han Li.
However, these issues were no longer of his concern. After all, the old ancestorial figure, Zhen Xiong, had not much life left, and in the future, the Qian Dynasty still needed to rally closely around the ancestral figure of Han Mansion.
The merging of Han Mansion and The Li Manor by the ancestral figure was quite favorable, having moved away from Da Qian’s Capital City. This also allowed him to breathe a sigh of relief. Otherwise, Emperor Qian would always feel tremendous pressure.
After all, the ancestral figure of Han Mansion was an outsider, and the Qian Dynasty could only maintain its stability by continuously supplying Han Mansion. Now that the only True Martial Realm of the Qian Dynasty might be gone, if the ancestral figure of Han Mansion were to act recklessly, his position as Emperor Qian might be in jeopardy.
The merger of The Li Manor and Han Mansion in Yuanzhou’s Chengsheng Mountain, while not moving away from the Qian Dynasty, could still be the stabilizing force for the empire, but not necessarily for Da Qian Royalty.
With Han Mansion far away in Yuanzhou, if not diligently maintained, the relationship with the Qian Dynasty might gradually weaken, leading to unpredictability.
The ancestral figure of Han Mansion might protect the Qian Dynasty for another three hundred years, but Emperor Qian did not have confidence in cultivating a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu during this period. However, if they continued to maintain a close relationship with the ancestral figure of Han Mansion and if Han Mansion took root in the Qian Dynasty, then the Qian Dynasty would continue to stabilize until a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu emerged.
By doing so, he could continue to be Emperor Qian.
Previously, he was pushed forward as a puppet Emperor Qian, but now he truly held real power. Without the old ancestorial figure, Zhen Xiong, he could leverage more of the Qian Dynasty’s resources.
Perhaps, he also had a chance to attempt advancing to the True Martial Realm and to better cultivate his offspring to see if there was hope of them reaching the True Martial Realm.
Although he had a semi-retired emperor above him, the ancestral figure of Han Mansion was always low-profile and never interfered in affairs. As long as he maintained a good relationship, he could continue being Emperor Qian, and Da Qian Royalty would still belong to the Chu family.
“As you command,” replied the Mentor, Left Minister, the Prophet, and others, their eyes flashing, each harboring different thoughts, but still replying with respect.
After the imperial assembly disbanded, Emperor Qian sat on the Dragon Chair, his expression tangled with conflict.
After a long while, Emperor Qian sighed, “Grand Internal Supervisor, what do you think about me doing that?”
Grand Internal Supervisor Cao, standing by his side, pupils contracted slightly, thought for a moment, and then said, “Your Majesty, this old servant does not know.”
Emperor Qian had once vaguely revealed his intention about this matter to him, but it was far too taboo, and he dared not express an opinion for fear of being made the scapegoat by Emperor Qian in the end.
“Sigh~”
Emperor Qian sighed again and then vanished from the grand hall.
Imperial Harem, Fengyi Palace.
The figure of Emperor Qian silently appeared there, simply standing outside, silently gazing at Fengyi Palace.
His Empress was a mature and alluring beauty of unparalleled grace and gentleness, and her appearance and figure were top-notch in the Qian Dynasty.
Ever since his last encounter with the old ancestorial figure, Zhen Xiong, Emperor Qian had not touched her, undoubtedly harboring other thoughts in his heart, but he had never truly made up his mind.
After staring at Fengyi Palace for a long while, Emperor Qian started walking slowly towards it.
Yinyang Sect, mountain gate.
Two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus stood silently facing each other, exchanging looks, the atmosphere heavy.
One was the Yinyang Sect Hierarch in red and the other was Dugu Bing clad in black. At that moment, Dugu Bing’s aura was growing increasingly stronger.
“You’re not really planning to seek revenge against Han Li, are you?” asked the Sect Hierarch as he watched Dugu Bing’s demeanor.
Although he and Dugu Bing often clashed, the latter was still one of the faces of the Yinyang Sect. If he really went to seek revenge on Han Li, it was likely a one-way journey.
If Dugu Bing died at Han Li’s hands, the Demon Clan might blame him for it, and he would have difficulty absolving himself. After all, he would be seen as having watched Dugu Bing march towards his death.
On hearing this, Dugu Bing’s aura stumbled, then slowly dissipated to nothing.
“Sigh, it seems I won’t be able to avenge myself for the time being,” said Dugu Bing dejectedly as he sat down, his face full of unwillingness.
The news that Li Feiyu was Han Li had spread throughout the Xuan Domain over several days. Although the Xuan Domain was vast, there were very few True Martial Realm Emperor Wus. They were the most elite individuals, and every move they made was closely watched.

chapters.title: Chapter 460: 212: The Reaction of the Various Sacred Lands, Descendants Reach Five Thousand, Breaking Through to the Tongxuan Realm! _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Chapter 212: The Reaction of the Various Sacred Lands, Descendants Reach Five Thousand, Breaking Through to the Tongxuan Realm! _2
After more than a decade of secluded cultivation, Dugu Bing had finally restored his cultivation and returned to the fourth layer of the True Martial Realm. He always remembered the grudge from the past and wanted to seek revenge.
However, Dugu Bing didn’t dare to act recklessly. The current situation was stable, and the Demon Clan had no further intentions of letting the Yinyang Sect advance.
In such a situation, he didn’t dare to foolishly run to the Daqian Empire to seek revenge on Han Li; that wouldn’t be seeking revenge, it would be seeking death.
“Don’t panic, the hard days are still to come,” the Sect Hierarch Chen said with a smile.
“Hmph!”
Dugu Bing snorted coldly, his face full of dissatisfaction. You really know how to comfort someone, kid.
But he also knew that what Sect Hierarch Chen had said was the truth. Li Feiyu was not frightening, but Li Feiyu being Han Li was terrifying.
After all, Li Feiyu was already over a thousand years old, with only a few hundred years left to live, and the hope of breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm was slim. Han Li, on the other hand, was only in his two hundreds, already in the mid-phase of the True Martial Realm. Without any accidents, he was destined to become a Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu in the future.
Whether Han Li had risen so quickly because he found a great opportunity or because a powerful being was reborn in him, either way, he was going to have a brilliant future.
The brighter Han Li’s future was, the more difficult it would be for his enemy, to the point of living in constant fear and worry, concerned that Han Li might target him ruthlessly.
“Han Li has a big secret on him. Doesn’t the Heavenly Demon Hall really plan to probe it? To take Han Li in…”
Dugu Bing said, cutting himself off midway. That wasn’t something one should talk about.
If Han Li were to join the Heavenly Demon Hall and receive key training, it would be easier to target him. If Han Li became a Divine Yuan Realm Demon Emperor in the future, then his life would be even more miserable, and he might even be secretly killed.
Sect Hierarch Chen shook his head and said, “According to the news from the Heavenly Demon Hall, the undercurrents in the Qianyuan Divine Province are surging, showing a trend towards major upheaval. It’s not suitable to create complications.”
Both, being Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, knew why there was an emergence of a powerful and mysterious force in the Qianyuan Divine Province that could even threaten Sacred Lands. All the major Sacred Lands wanted to eradicate it first.
According to the intelligence on Han Li, this person was low-key, liked stability, and was incredibly cautious. It was unlikely that he would join their Heavenly Demon Hall, just as it was with Xumi Mountain. The most likely possibility was Bai Yujing.
Now was not the right time to provoke Bai Yujing. Otherwise, a conflict could inadvertently benefit the mysterious forces in the dark, perhaps even encouraging them.
“You don’t need to think too much; just focus on cultivating. It’s possible that Han Li doesn’t even take you seriously. He could very likely be a reincarnation of a powerful Saint,” Sect Hierarch Chen said after a moment’s thought.
Dugu Bing gave a muffled snort.
If you can’t say anything helpful, then don’t say anything at all.
“In over thirty years, I will return to the Heavenly Demon Hall. You just wait and see,” he said.
After finishing his words, Dugu Bing’s figure disappeared from sight.
Sect Hierarch Chen got up and looked in the direction of the Daqian Empire, feeling a headache coming on.
The Daqian Empire, now with Han Li, a suspected reincarnation of a powerful Saint, would be troublesome to deal with in the future and would put a lot of pressure on him.
He hoped that Han Li would continue to keep a low profile and not cause any trouble. That would be good for everyone.
The Kurong Sect, the Ancient Empire, the Da Liang Empire, the Qitian Teaching, and several other top forces in the Xuan Domain all received the same intelligence and agreed with Sect Hierarch Chen’s assessment.
As long as Han Li didn’t cause trouble, that would be good.
As long as Han Li didn’t think about sticking his neck out for the Daqian Empire, then everyone could live in peace. After all, there was no enmity between them.
The Ancient Empire, the Imperial City.
Within the depths of the Imperial Palace, the ancient ancestor of the Ancient Empire, Gu Wuling, tasted the freshly received intelligence, his face revealing a pensive expression.
The reincarnation of Jiaosheng was in the Daqian Empire, and Han Li was also suspected of being a reincarnation of a powerful Saint. Was the feng shui of the Daqian Empire that good? Were there other powerful beings reincarnated in the Daqian Empire?
“Heh, what’s the use of good feng shui if one can’t handle it oneself?” Gu Wuling suddenly sighed.
The Daqian Empire had good feng shui but was in a miserable state, and it seemed closely related to the two reincarnated powerful beings.
Had it not been for the reincarnation of Jiaosheng who killed Prince Wu’an and the former Emperor Qian in the Secret Territory, the Daqian Empire would not have lost so much territory to the Yinyang Sect, the Kurong Sect, the Da Jing Empire, and Fengbo Pavilion.
Although Han Li had stabilized the situation of the Daqian Empire, he had gained many benefits from the empire. With the death of Chu Zhenxiong, the future owner of the Daqian Empire was still uncertain.
His Ancient Empire was different. He himself was a Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu, and with Sacred Soldiers supporting their fate, several members of the direct lineage were in the True Martial Realm, and the other Emperor Wus of the True Martial Realm within the empire and in various forces of the Xuan Domain were all very compliant.
“If only my Ancient Empire had an imperial soldier,” he sighed. With an imperial soldier, the Ancient Empire could advance further, becoming the number one force just below the Sacred Lands.
Gu Wuling’s gaze was profound as he looked in the direction of the Daqian Empire, towards Chengsheng Mountain, but ultimately, he cut off his wicked thoughts.
The chances of Han Li being a reincarnation of a powerful Saint were higher. Even if he had obtained a great opportunity or was the inheritance of a Great Emperor, it wasn’t worth the risk.
He preferred stability.
Fengbo Pavilion.
Lu Wenyuan came to the highest tower and met with the hemp-robed elder in charge, respectfully saying, “My lord, I have important matters to report.”
The hemp-robed elder waved his hand and said indifferently, “I already know.”
“Don’t worry; Han Li won’t act rashly, and he doesn’t dare to act rashly.”
“Even if Han Li is the reincarnation of a powerful Saint, he’s currently only in the True Martial Realm. We have a few in our Emperor Mingtian who are stronger than him, not to mention we have the Heaven Lord.”
“According to that Han Li’s character, it’s likely that he has developed a gap with the Daqian Empire. After merging The Li Manor into the Han Mansion, he’ll probably continue to keep a low profile. There’s no need to worry,” the elder concluded.

chapters.title: Chapter 461: 212: The Reaction of the Various Sacred Lands, Descendants Reach Five Thousand, Breaking Through to the Tongxuan Realm! _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 461: Chapter 212: The Reaction of the Various Sacred Lands, Descendants Reach Five Thousand, Breaking Through to the Tongxuan Realm! _3
Lu Wenyuan opened his mouth as if to speak, then hesitated and eventually remained silent, simply responding, “Your subordinate will pass on the message right away.”
Fengbo Pavilion had acted as the vanguard for Emperor Mingtian’s invasion of the Xuan Domain, and last time, after they occupied three provinces of the Daqian Empire, many Sects and families within the three provinces had stayed behind, all worried about this matter.
If Han Li indeed reincarnated as a powerful Saint, and still intended to help the Daqian Empire recover its lost territory, then there would be no good ending for these traitors.
Having left Fengbo Pavilion, Lu Wenyuan paused in his step and sighed inwardly, still not voicing his thoughts.
What he had wanted to mention was about his niece, Lu Tianxiang. Over these years, he had been secretly investigating Lu Tianxiang’s whereabouts and had long since found clues about her.
Lu Wenyuan suspected that the wide-spread religious sect across the Daqian Empire originated from Lu Tianxiang. Her ability to spread the teachings extensively in Daqian might be intricately linked to the Li Manor’s Master.
Now that the Li Manor’s Master was confirmed to be Han Li, the former ancestor of the Han Mansion, and Lu Tianxiang had been intercepted and captured by a mysterious Great Grandmaster in Leizhou, Lu Wenyuan suspected that person was Han Li.
If Han Li truly was a reincarnation of a powerful Saint who had awakened his Dormant Wisdom decades ago with his strength improving by leaps and bounds, capturing Lu Tianxiang when he was a Supreme Grade Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and fighting Dugu Bing several years later as Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm, it was very likely.
Both Li Feiyu and Han Li were the sort of people known for their flamboyant dalliances, taking countless wives and concubines, and Lu Tianxiang, Lu Wenyuan feared, had become one of Han Li’s consorts.
Lu Wenyuan had originally wanted to bring up this matter, but Emperor Mingtian had long stopped caring about Lu Tianxiang, not searching for her in these years. Ultimately, Lu Wenyuan decided to keep this to himself.
Seeing as his niece Lu Tianxiang seemed to be living well in Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, he thought it was better not to disturb her. This way, he could finally find peace, as he had always been haunted by his failure to dare attempt her rescue.
Atop Fengbo Pavilion, the old man in hemp clothing watched Lu Wenyuan’s departing figure with a slight sigh.
He faintly guessed Lu Wenyuan’s hidden thoughts and had also received reports about Lu Tianxiang, but the old man had put them aside.
Lu Tianxiang was involved with the Li Manor’s Master, now Han Li; if exposed, the old man knew it was impossible to make Lu Tianxiang return, as Han Li, though unassuming, was not someone to be easily dealt with.
Emperor Mingtian could not spare sending another Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm to the Xuan Domain, and so the old man had neglected the matter, assuming Lu Tianxiang had died.
“Hu~”
Exhaling, the old man in hemp clothing vanished from Fengbo Pavilion, hurrying towards the Chaotic Domain of Emperor Mingtian.
Although he had spoken so to Lu Wenyuan, it was merely to maintain stability. The actual decision would depend on the thoughts of Emperor Mingtian’s side.
However, the old man felt that the matter would probably remain as is, since the current situation was peculiar. Emperor Mingtian would not want complications arising now, waiting instead for chaos to erupt before seizing the opportunity.
Apart from the major powers in the Xuan Domain, places like Xumi Mountain, Bai Yujing, Penglai Immortal Sect, House of Divine Armies, Heavenly Demon Hall, and other Great Holy Land Schools had also received news of Han Li, all reacting differently.
Xumi Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, Penglai Immortal Sect, and the likes ignored it, knowing that there was little chance Han Li would join them, and they also lacked the competitiveness of Bai Yujing.
On hearing the news, both Bai Yujing and House of Divine Armies, two major Sacred Lands, actually sent people to the Xuan Domain Great Qian Dynasty to get a sense of Han Li’s attitude and see if he was willing to join their Sacred Land.
Whether Han Li was a reincarnation of a powerful Saint or had encountered a great opportunity, they were willing to take him under their wing. Han Li was known to be discreet and well-behaved, which fit well with both Sacred Lands.
If Han Li was unwilling to join a Sacred Land, they would not insist, and only then other Sacred Lands or some Divine Yuan Realm Powers would take action.
….
At Chengsheng Mountain, within the Han Mansion.
Han Li was keeping his beautiful wife company, admiring the scenery. To be honest, he was somewhat tired of it, seeing it every day, but what choice did he have, being such a good man?
Ling Lingshuang had not long since married into the Han Mansion and was still very fond of the scenery on Chengsheng Mountain, often dragging him out to enjoy it, and comparing it to the scenery of Penglai Immortal Sect.
During such times, Han Li would compare and contrast for Ling Lingshuang, giving her instruction and nourishment, letting her know Chengsheng Mountain was indeed superior.
Ling Lingshuang touched her belly and sighed softly as she looked at the handsome man beside her.
It had been over half a month since she had come to Chengsheng Mountain, and she had gotten to know the place quite well. What Han Li and Xue Yueqing had previously told her was true and still left her shocked to this day.
The heritage of Chengsheng Mountain was even deeper than she had imagined.
And all of this was built by this man in just a few short decades.
So many Emperor Weapons, among them Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons, as well as numerous auxiliary treasures, made Ling Lingshuang think Han Li might be the reincarnation of a Heavenly Immortal.
Even the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors from ancient times did not possess such a substantial foundation. Only those Heavenly Immortals, exalted high above the ninth heaven, whose radiance shined through the ages, could have such a foundation.
As for why there were no Divine Weapons on Chengsheng Mountain?
Ling Lingshuang felt there were two possibilities: either they were hidden away, known only to Han Li himself; or Han Li’s divine weapon from his previous life had been destroyed in the great calamities of ancient times.
Regardless of the possibility, Ling Lingshuang did not ask. She knew the answer would not come, for even Lu Tianxiang, Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, and other women did not know, so how could she, a newcomer, be privy to it?
Her Divine Sense scanned over the entire Chengsheng Mountain, taking in the thriving Han Mansion, and said, “You sure have taken many wives and concubines at the Li Manor, and have so many children too.”

chapters.title: Chapter 462: 212: The Reaction of the Various Sacred Lands, Descendants Reach Five Thousand, Breaking Through to the Tongxuan Realm! _4
chapters.content:
Chapter 462: Chapter 212: The Reaction of the Various Sacred Lands, Descendants Reach Five Thousand, Breaking Through to the Tongxuan Realm! _4
The Li Manor relocated to Chengsheng Mountain and merged with Han Mansion two days ago. Han Li’s cherished wives and beautiful concubines from the Li Manor, along with his progeny, were fully integrated. These days, they were exploring everywhere, filled with curiosity, getting to know the various buildings, benefits, and systems of Chengsheng Mountain.
The guards and maids of the Li Manor were partly brought over by Han Li’s faithful entourage, while the rest were left at Han Mansion in the Capital City. The plaque of the Li Manor had already been replaced with that of Han Mansion.
Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yun, Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, and other cherished wives and beautiful concubines gladly welcomed Xue Qingyi, Song Zhixuan, Chu Xianlin, and other ladies. They had each been aware of one another for some time.
After the merger of the two households, the master had instructed them to live harmoniously, just like before, and to avoid any discord. All the cherished wives and beautiful concubines abided by this.
Whether for themselves or for their progeny, none of them wanted to be involved in such thankless trouble.
Xue Qingyi, Song Zhixuan, Chu Xianlin, and other beautiful wives and concubines from the Li Manor who were now integrated were even less likely to cause trouble since Han Li’s wives and concubines at Chengsheng Mountain, although fewer in number, had been with him longer and generally possessed higher cultivation levels.
They simply wanted to assimilate quickly and then enjoy the benefits of Chengsheng Mountain, striving for more advantages for themselves and their progeny.
For Ling Lingshuang, it was different; she was somewhat annoyed in her heart. When she agreed to Han Li, she really had not anticipated that Han Li would have so many wives and concubines.
Since she was inherently proud and held a status second to none, she had reluctantly convinced herself to accept becoming Han Li’s Dao companion, only to end up being one among many.
Now that the Li Manor had integrated, the number of Han Li’s cherished wives and beautiful concubines suddenly multiplied several times over, which made Ling Lingshuang even more displeased.
In her mind, even if she were to take on the role of someone’s Dao companion, it would be as the sole one, or at least one of very few. She could accept Xue Yueqing, given that Xue Yueqing was as renowned as she was.
Han Li reached out to embrace her in his arms, and Ling Lingshuang struggled symbolically for a moment before giving in; she knew struggling was futile, and the adulterer even seemed to enjoy it more.
“Lingshuang, are you jealous?”
Han Li bit her exquisitely flawless earlobe, speaking softly in her ear.
Feeling the warm breath blowing in her ear, Ling Lingshuang raised an eyebrow and scoffed, “Heh~ even if I jump from here, I, Ling Lingshuang, will absolutely not be jealous.”
I knew she would be stubborn about it.
Han Li smiled, quite enjoying it, and whispered into her ear, “Lingshuang, with your silver tongue, why don’t you shower me with some praise?”
Ling Lingshuang was stunned; what was Han Li talking about? It took her a moment to catch on.
A beautiful blush appeared on Ling Lingshuang’s face and she lightly stepped on Han Li’s foot, rejecting him with a frosty tone, “Don’t even think about it.”
A smile appeared on Han Li’s face as his hands began to make mischievous movements, traversing peaks and valleys, causing Ling Lingshuang’s delicate body to stiffen slightly.
Afterward, Han Li picked up Ling Lingshuang and vanished from the peak of Chengdao Peak in a flash.
Two hours later, Patriarch Han returned to the peak of Chengdao Peak alone, satisfied, and began to attend to other matters.
He was preparing to break through to the Tongxuan Realm.
As early as the day after the Dangyang Mountain incident concluded, the number of his progeny had reached five thousand. Han Li glanced and noted there were now 5,072 of them, with 2,208 being progeny of outstanding talent.
When the number of his progeny reached five thousand, Han Li received a reward of six hundred years of cultivation, bringing his accumulated cultivation to 2,446 years.
He also obtained a great number of elixirs, such as Sea Parting Pill, Gathering Gangrene Pill, Immortal Conservation Pill, and so on, along with four hundred years of Talisman Making experience, barely elevating his Talisman Making proficiency to the mid-range of Divine Rank.
In addition, Han Li acquired a Lower Grade Divine Rank martial technique, the Golden Crow Escape Technique.
The Golden Crow Escape Technique was a speed-based martial skill, which delighted Han Li considerably as he had long been looking forward to a powerful speed-based martial skill.
His previously mastered skill was the Heaven Rank mid-grade Void Step, which, even with the enhancement of the All-Powerful Martial Path, equated merely to the mid-range of Divine Rank.
The Golden Crow Escape Technique, being inherently a Lower Grade Divine Rank martial skill, with the enhancement of the All-Powerful Martial Path, rivaled Emperor Level Lower Grade martial skills and was a Quasi Emperor Rank technique.
Upon claiming the skill, Han Li immediately absorbed and mastered it to the perfection stage. Although he could not exhibit Quasi Emperor Rank speed due to his cultivation limitations, it significantly boosted his own speed.
Now, Han Li’s speed leapt from being comparable to the Tongxuan Realm’s fourth layer of the Nine Heavens to the ninth layer perfection, making his speed second only to that of the Saints of the Sacred Land below the Saintly Abyss Realm.
With Han Li’s current speed, he could traverse nearly a hundred million li in a single breath. Once he broke through to the Tongxuan Realm, his speed would further increase, enough to rival the Saints of the Saintly Abyss Realm.
A breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm required 2,500 years of cultivation, and now, his cultivation was ample.
Including the 296 years of cultivation reflected from his progeny, Han Li had accumulated 2,742 years of cultivation, more than enough to ascend perfectly to the status of a powerful Tongxuan Realm expert.
Without hesitation, Han Li activated his thought, connecting with Zi Yi and Shi Qi, and the two women promptly activated the Void Bell and Time-Sky Tower. Two beams of Emperor’s Light descended, instantly isolating Han Li atop Chengdao Peak.
Entering a peculiar temporal space, Han Li immediately felt at ease. Guarded by two Supreme Grade Emperor artifacts, he did not have to worry about being disturbed, which might cause a mishap during his breakthrough. The commotion from his breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm could now be perfectly concealed.
After a moment’s thought, Han Li gave his body a shake, and the Sky Concealing Formation Map draped over him flew out, growing larger and transforming into an incomparable Emperor Formation, like so–divine providence.
Finally satisfied, Han Li nodded, sat cross-legged, and embarked on his journey of breakthrough.

chapters.title: Chapter 463: 212: The Reaction of the Various Sacred Lands, Descendants Reach Five Thousand, Breaking Through to the Tongxuan Realm! _5
chapters.content:
Chapter 463: Chapter 212: The Reaction of the Various Sacred Lands, Descendants Reach Five Thousand, Breaking Through to the Tongxuan Realm! _5
The next instant, a majestic Primordial Spirit towering to four million feet materialized behind Han Li, parts of which had already undergone Pure Yang transformation, radiating a purely masculine aura.
With a mere thought from Han Li, the accumulated cultivation surged out like a torrential river, burning through a thousand years worth in a flash.
Han Li also entered an Enlightenment State, comprehending wondrous techniques, delving into the mysteries of the Martial Dao, and further evolving the omniscient essence of the Martial Dao.
Two thousand five hundred years of enlightenment led Han Li to comprehend countless truths, a look of astonishment appearing on his face.
When the enlightenment ended, all insights came flooding in, absorbed and digested by Han Li’s towering Primordial Spirit, causing his aura to skyrocket, climbing higher with each step, shaking the heavens and the earth.
At the same time, Han Li’s all-encompassing essence of the Martial Dao also experienced a new breakthrough, condensing into a Martial True Pill—a Martial True Pill with the color of chaos, seemingly influenced by his cultivation technique.
This Martial True Pill, though freshly condensed, was integrated and reached the pinnacle of this realm.
To Han Li’s surprise, this was not a King Grade Martial True Pill but one that had broken through this ultimate boundary, stronger than the King Grade Martial True Pill.
While Han Li was in a daze, a ray of Ancient Immortal Light suddenly flew out from the depths of his Primordial Spirit and merged into the integrated Martial True Pill.
The next instant, Han Li’s Martial True Pill shattered, giving birth to a Martial Primordial Spirit that was identical to Han Li. It was his true Primordial Spirit; the one before was a false one conjured by the system.
No sooner had the Martial Primordial Spirit been born at a hundred thousand feet than it burgeoned, breaking past the million-foot limit, and growing ever taller. Han Li’s false Primordial Spirit also merged into the true Primordial Spirit, propelling the newly born Martial Primordial Spirit to further heights.
Watching this scene unfold, Han Li’s heart stirred with waves of emotion. His Martial Primordial Spirit was not of Emperor Grade—it had broken through the extreme limit, entering an unknown realm.
When Han Li’s Martial Primordial Spirit reached its limit, which was nine hundred ninety-nine million nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine feet, it was comparable to the most powerful beings in the Tongxuan Realm, infinitely close to the Primordial Spirit of a Saint of the Sacred Land Realm.
Han Li thought it was over, but then a ray of Ancient Immortal Light shot out from within his body once more, merging into the nearly ten million feet tall magnificent Primordial Spirit.
Han Li suddenly realized that this was the two rays of starlight he had gained during a previous breakthrough, originating from the most magnificent Ancient Star that corresponded to the ultimate Martial Dao.
He had not known what these represented before, but now he understood.
These two rays of Ancient Immortal Light could significantly enhance Han Li’s foundation. Once his Martial Dao essence was complete, condensing a Martial True Pill again could bypass two steps and directly start nurturing a True Spirit.
After all, Han Li’s cultivation level was sufficient, making it the best opportunity to nurture the True Spirit.
Nurturing the True Spirit requires the union of Martial Dao, Primordial Spirit, physical body, and Mana—a crucial step that cannot be faked and must be done in one go.
After realizing this, Han Li did not hesitate to release his all-encompassing Martial Dao in full, resonating with his physical body and Primordial Spirit. His entire body’s Mana boiled as he embarked on the journey of nurturing the True Spirit.
Immediately, a tremendous disturbance echoed through heaven and earth, yet it was all concealed by the Sky Concealing Formation Map, the Time-Sky Tower, and the Void Bell, preventing it from reaching the outside world.
Han Li’s boundless Mana and unmatched all-encompassing Martial Dao poured into the nearly ten million feet tall Primordial Spirit. The next instant, the magnificent Primordial Spirit resonated with the physical body, gradually shrinking.
After one breath, the Primordial Spirit shrank to nine million feet.
After three breaths, the Primordial Spirit shrank to five million feet.
After five breaths, the Primordial Spirit shrank to one million feet.
….
The Primordial Spirit’s shrinking rate accelerated, and though it became smaller, the aura it emitted grew stronger and more vigorous.
At a certain moment, when the Primordial Spirit shrank to the same size as Han Li’s physical body, two other shadowy figures of Han Li appeared out of thin air.
However, these two figures of Han Li were ethereal—one was a phantom of the all-encompassing Martial Dao while the other was condensed from Han Li’s Mana.
Han Li’s physical body, Primordial Spirit, Martial Dao figure, and Mana figure looked at each other. Then, the other three figures simultaneously flew into Han Li’s physical body.
Boom!
A sound as if the world was being created resounded, not in the outside world, but through Han Li’s sea of consciousness.
At this moment, within Han Li’s sea of consciousness, creation was taking place; his Niwan Palace opened up, and a vast ancestral ground unfolded, spanning billions of miles of heaven and earth.
In the deepest part of the ancestral ground, a figure enveloped in Daoist light gradually became solid, identical to Han Li. This was Han Li’s True Spirit.
The moment the True Spirit was born, Han Li’s aura surged instantaneously, breaking the shackles of his realm and tearing through the barrier, stepping into a new level.
At this moment, Han Li’s physical body, Primordial Spirit, senses, Divine Sense, Mana… and so on, all surged dramatically.
At this moment, Han Li’s strength improved in all aspects, as if his combat abilities had entered a new domain. Divine light shone pervasive and radiant, illuminating all corners of the cosmos.
“Huff~”
After an indeterminate amount of time, Han Li’s skyrocketing aura suddenly stabilized, and he finally opened his eyes, exhaling a breath.
Instantly, two divine lights and a Divine Sword tore through heaven and earth, shattering the cosmos and creating three huge spatial rifts, which were quickly smoothed over by the might of two imperial weapons.
“I’ve finally reached the Tongxuan Realm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 464: 213: Power Surge! Lu Zhen and Han Li_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 464: Chapter 213: Power Surge! Lu Zhen and Han Li_1
In a mysterious space-time,
Han Li stood tall, emanating a terrifying aura that spread billions of miles around. With every move, his divine might overshadowed the world, and the laws of the universe pervaded the air as if he were an invincible being reigning over the nine heavens and ten lands.
“So strong!”
As Han Li savored the strength following his breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm, he couldn’t help but exclaim.
Now he was hundreds, if not more, times stronger than before the breakthrough; he could annihilate his former self with a snap of his fingers.
This breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm marked a colossal advancement in his all-encompassing martial path, as he leaped from the Martial True Pill and Martial Primordial Spirit directly to the True Spirit stage.
Owing to the fusion of two strands of Ancient Immortal Light, Han Li’s Martial True Pill and Martial Primordial Spirit both shattered their limits and ventured into uncharted territories, laying a solid foundation for these realms, which allowed him to reach the True Spirit stage in one fell swoop—breaking through the extreme limit and also stepping into the unknown.
Typically, the highest rank for a Martial True Pill is King Grade, for a Martial Primordial Spirit it is Emperor Grade, and for True Spirit, it is Divine Grade—insurmountable limits representing the strongest foundations.
At least, that was the belief throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain.
In the ancient records of the countless epochs of the Endless Yuankun Domain, there had never been a mighty one capable of breaking these extreme limits, let alone all three at once.
What benefits breaking the extreme limits brought, Han Li couldn’t quite articulate at the moment. He only knew that his origin had grown manyfold stronger, and his combat ability had greatly increased.
Now, every aspect of Han Li’s strength had surged dramatically, encompassing his Primordial Spirit, mana, Divine Sense, physical body, and many more areas.
Though only in the first Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm, Han Li’s mana was already comparable to that of a Saint in the Saint Abyss Realm. According to the data on his personal panel, his mana reserve was akin to the third Heaven of the Saint Abyss Realm.
This surprised Han Li; he had broken through a Big Realm and his all-encompassing martial path had advanced by several stages, yet it only matched the third Heaven of the Saint Abyss Realm.
Upon further understanding, Han Li realized that the gaps within the Saint Abyss Realm were even vaster than those of the Tongxuan Realm. The higher one climbed, the larger the disparity became, even between minor sub-realms.
In the Saint Abyss Realm, Saints had to open up the Heavenly Abyss, one function of which was to bear the mana of the Saints. During a breakthrough, True Yuan is transformed into mana, not only increasing in quality but also potentially surging tenfold in quantity, varying from person to person.
Thereafter, with each minor sub-realm, the mana doubles, making for an amplification compared to previous realms. The key is the increasing base, which widens the disparity further.
Han Li’s Primordial Spirit, during his breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm, had shattered countless shackles and surged to 50 million zhang in height, rivaling the Fifth Heaven of the Saint Abyss Realm.
Such a tremendous increase in his Primordial Spirit also lead to an enhancement of his Divine Sense, on par with the Fifth Heaven of the Saint Abyss Realm, with a maximum coverage area reaching five hundred million miles.
Considering the vast and boundless expanse of the Xuan Domain, also measured at about five hundred million miles in its entirety, this meant Han Li could cover the entire Xuan Domain with his Divine Sense if he wished.
In comparison, Han Li’s physical body, strength, and defense improved modestly. The all-encompassing martial path had progressed through several stages and, coupled with the breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm, reached the peak of the Tongxuan Realm.
After all, the body-refining martial technique he practiced was only of Top Grade Heaven Rank—the Xuanhuang Tyrant Body. Once he obtained a Divine Rank body-refining martial technique, or acquired a special physique, he could advance to the domain of the Saint Abyss Realm.
Prior to the breakthrough, Han Li’s speed was already the fastest in the lower Saint Abyss Realm; now, it had increased exponentially, comparable to the Fourth Heaven of the Saint Abyss Realm, allowing him to traverse four billion miles of the void in a single breath.
Besides that, Han Li’s combat ability had also received a tremendous boost. On one hand, there was a significant increase in mana, strength, and speed, enabling the same martial techniques to unleash even greater power. On the other hand, there was the all-encompassing martial path.
Han Li had initially thought the all-encompassing martial path reaching the True Spirit stage would enhance the power of martial techniques by seven grades. Unexpectedly, it was only six.
Upon investigation, he discovered that True Spirit doesn’t fall within the sphere of martial arts. True Spirit is a unique existence, born from the fusion of martial path, physical body, Primordial Spirit, and True Yuan.
Starting from the Hollow Void Stage, the essence of martial arts begins to be understood, and through the Shenyuan Realm, the Martial Primordial Spirit is cultivated. Once in the Tongxuan Realm, the focus is still on cultivating the Martial Primordial Spirit, not the True Spirit.
The stage of Martial Primordial Spirit encompasses the Shenyuan Realm, Tongxuan Realm, Saint Abyss Realm, and even up to the Quasi Emperor territory and Heaven Imperial Realm. The Martial Primordial Spirit becomes increasingly powerful, serving as one of the fundamental sources of a cultivator’s strength.
However, Han Li was quite content. The ultimate martial path was indeed potent, and there still was no limit reached, capable of enhancing the power of martial techniques by six grades. The question remained whether he could continue to improve before becoming an immortal.
With a thought, Han Li opened his Martial Skill Panel, which contained all the martial techniques he had mastered. It also quantified his combat ability, comparing it to the average cultivator of each realm, showing where he currently stood.
[Martial Skill Panel]
Divine Rank Mid Grade: Thousand Sword Scripture (Saint Abyss Realm Sixth Heaven)
Divine Rank Lower Grade: Five Elements Divine Punch, Earth-shattering Fist (Saint Abyss Realm Fifth Heaven)
Emperor Rank Extreme Grade: Demon Slaying Great Hand Imprint, Geng Metal Sword Scripture, Breaking Cosmos Spear Decree (Saint Abyss Realm Fourth Heaven)
Heaven Rank Top Grade: Four Phases World Suppressing Punch, Sky Balancing Manual (Saint Abyss Realm Third Heaven)
…
Seeing the information on the panel, Han Li’s pupils contracted abruptly. How could he be this strong?
Then, Han Li came to his senses. This was normal, after all. The power of these martial techniques had been elevated by six grades, reaching the pinnacle of the Emperor Level martial techniques.
If his mana and physical body were not limiting him, perhaps they could be elevated even further.
“It seems there won’t be much increase in combat ability for a long time to come.” Closing the Martial Skill Panel, Han Li sighed softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 465: 213: Power Surge! Lu Zhen and Han Li_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 465: Chapter 213: Power Surge! Lu Zhen and Han Li_2
The disparity within the Myriad Phenomena Realm is vast; he had to elevate several minor realms within the Tongxuan Realm just to increase his mana reserve by one minor realm, thereby enhancing his combat ability.
Now, Han Li’s primordial spirit stands fifty million Zhang tall, completely transformed into Pure Yang, rivaling a Saint in the fifth heaven of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. No longer bound by realm restrictions, with sufficient cultivation, he could ascend to the pinnacle of the Tongxuan Realm in one go.
Han Li estimated that the cultivation needed during this period should be much less. After all, without the realm’s strictures, it was much easier to break through.
Having done all of this, Han Li retracted his aura, took back the Sky Concealing Formation Map, and then had Zi Yi and Shi Qi withdraw their power before he returned to the summit of Chengdao Peak once again.
Disappearing for only a short amount of time, no one knew that he had broken through to the Tongxuan Realm and that his combat ability matched a Saint of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
“This gives me even more confidence.”
Thinking of the potential arrival of Empress Yuanchu and envoys of Empress Yuanchu, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face, even showing signs of anticipation.
With his current combat ability, plus several Emperor Level weapons, he should be able to win, right?
“Huff~”
Han Li exhaled a breath, feeling refreshed; his strength had grown, and even his mindset had improved.
Along with his breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm, his lifespan also soared dramatically. Before the breakthrough, Han Li had a lifespan of 9822 years, and after, it skyrocketed to 14822 years.
After some thought, Han Li queried the system, wanting to know how many years of cultivation it would take for him to break through the Tongxuan Realm. The system quickly provided an answer.
As Han Li had anticipated, the Tongxuan Realm is essentially about cultivating the primordial spirit and transforming it into Pure Yang. His primordial spirit is so strong, and already fully Pure Yang, there are no bottlenecks due to realms.
He is now of first-grade aptitude, with a progress reaching 28%, still far from ascending to Immortal Grade aptitude and without any special physique, so the cultivation consumption is not small.
Originally, it would take countless years of cultivation for him to break from the first heaven of the Tongxuan Realm to the peak, but now the consumption has been reduced by roughly half, which made the old ancestor Han Li extremely happy.
This way, he could save a great deal of effort and ascend in realms much faster.
……
Several days later,
A young Taoist priest arrived at the outskirts of Chengsheng Mountain. With an ordinary appearance, hands folded into his sleeves, and a sword sheath on his back without a sword within.
This young Taoist priest was none other than Lu Zhen, who had come from the Dao Domain of Bai Yujing.
“Is this Chengsheng Mountain? It doesn’t seem as sparse in spiritual energy as the rumors say.”
Lu Zhen stood nonchalantly high in the sky, making no attempt to conceal himself, as his overwhelming divine sense covered Chengsheng Mountain for a thorough investigation.
Using divine sense to probe Chengsheng Mountain was likely to be noticed, but Lu Zhen didn’t mind being concealed; he did so deliberately as a form of probing.
