He would soon learn whether Han Li had rapidly risen by chance fortune or, as the rumors suggested, was a reincarnated Saint or Great Power.
At the same time, Lu Zhen remained vigilant, constantly in communication with the Artifact Spirit of the Quasi Emperor weapon, ready to be activated in case of any emergencies.
Lu Zhen was acting on the Monarch of Bai Yujing’s command to recruit Han Li into Bai Yujing, while also determining the roots of this man, which would shape Bai Yujing’s attitude towards Han Li.
Previously in Dangyang Mountain, he had been careless and suppressed by an enigmatic Tongxuan Realm Power with an Emperor Formation Map, even slapped gratuitously.
This time leaving the mountain, Lu Zhen had learned from his mistakes and secured a Quasi Emperor weapon from his master, and not just any, but a top-tier one.
With this Quasi Emperor weapon by his side, he could traverse the entire Qianyuan Divine Province with ease. Even if that mysterious Tongxuan Realm Power reemerged, the full awakening of the Quasi Emperor weapon could withstand the Emperor Formation Map for a while, buying enough time for the Monarch of Bai Yujing to provide support.
“But that’s about it, it still falls short compared to the old lairs of the Divine Yuan Realm Powers,” Lu Zhen assessed.
The spiritual energy of Chengsheng Mountain was many times denser than reported, which was normal, after all, considering it is the lair of an Emperor Wu from the True Martial Realm.
He found that Chengsheng Mountain was equipped with several high-grade Spirit Gathering Arrays, greatly enhancing the spiritual energy of the mountain. Moreover, Han Li had obtained a massive amount of cultivation resources from the Daqian Empire, including Spirit Veins, all of which could enhance the spiritual energy of Chengsheng Mountain.
Lu Zhen shook his head slightly, then turned his gaze to the bustling Han Mansion and noticed that the cultivators inside were not of a high realm. Apart from Han Li, the strongest were only at the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
The number of God Refining Realm true beings was substantial, while Grandmasters in the Hollow Void Stage and Great Grandmasters in the Myriad Phenomena Realm were few, all documented in the intelligence as Han Li’s wives.
Looking at a certain peak of Chengsheng Mountain, Lu Zhen sighed, “He really has quite the progeny.”
According to reports, not only does Han Li have hundreds of wives and concubines, but his number of descendants is even larger, totaling several thousand.
His Divine Sense swept over the area briefly and found that most were indeed on Chengsheng Mountain, but their cultivation levels were generally not high.
After another investigation, Lu Zhen communicated with the Artifact Spirit of the Quasi Emperor weapon and had it activate the Quasi Emperor weapon to probe Chengsheng Mountain once again.
In the past, Lu Zhen wouldn’t have been so cautious, but having suffered a setback last time and with the undercurrents flowing within the Qianyuan Divine Province recently, it was better to be safe than sorry.
“There’s nothing amiss.” Soon, the voice of the Artifact Spirit entered Lu Zhen’s sea of consciousness.
Lu Zhen’s eyebrows raised slightly. “Nothing amiss” meant no major problems, but did that indicate there were minor problems?
Lu Zhen soon came to terms with it. Minor problems weren’t much of an issue, they couldn’t tarnish the bigger picture. If Han Li truly were the reincarnation of a powerful saint, it would be strange if there weren’t any minor issues.
“Tsk, he’s finally here.”
As Lu Zhen’s thoughts turned, he saw a figure flying out from Chengsheng Mountain, it was Han Li, coming towards him in the firmament.
Han Li maintained the peak of the True Martial Realm’s Sixth Heaven cultivation, flying towards Lu Zhen with a deliberately solemn expression on his face, not revealing any flaws to anyone.
The arrival of Lu Zhen was quite sudden; he had concealed his aura with a Quasi Emperor weapon when he entered the Xuan Domain, intending to catch Han Li unprepared for the best effect.
However, what Lu Zhen didn’t know was that the moment he entered the Xuan Domain, he had been completely exposed in Han Li’s sight, even the Quasi Emperor weapon’s concealment was futile.
Since deciding on this plan, Han Li had been prepared by allowing Zi Yi to revive a portion of the Void Bell’s power, constantly covering the entire Xuan Domain, deliberately probing to see which forces would come and who would be the people coming.
For this, Han Li also revived many Emperor weapons and even the Sky Concealing Formation Map on Chengsheng Mountain to conceal the secrets of heaven, meanwhile hiding the climate of Chengsheng Mountain.
Sensitive identities or high cultivation wives like Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang were temporarily placed in the Time-Sky Tower, cultivating inside to avoid any mishaps.
The Emperor-level Lower Grade Dragon Vein of Chengsheng Mountain, as well as all important Divine Medicines, Divine Weapons, Divine Formations, and everything else including his wives, concubines, and descendants’ cultivation levels and aptitudes were covered and temporarily sealed by the power of several Emperor weapons.
If an envoy from the Sacred Land were to come and inspect, they wouldn’t be able to discover much unless they used an Immortal Grade weapon, which was completely impossible. In public, he was just at the True Martial Realm. Even for the reincarnation of a powerful saint, it was not worth it.
The envoy sent by Bai Yujing turned out to be Sect Leader Lu Zhen, which was quite a surprise to Han Li and a sign of great respect.
The Quasi Emperor weapon on Lu Zhen had already been probed by Han Li’s Emperor weapons, yet he was none the wiser; what he saw was only the most ordinary side of Chengsheng Mountain.
“Sect Leader Lu, this isn’t quite proper, is it?”
Upon reaching the firmament, Han Li’s tone was already not very good, containing dissatisfaction.
He was now portraying himself as the reincarnation of a powerful figure. Lu Zhen’s willful probing of his lair would warrant some temper, or else it would be easier to give himself away.
“I think it’s quite good.”
Lu Zhen’s eyes narrowed slightly as he released the aura of the Divine Yuan Realm, pressing down on Han Li.
“Hmph!”
Han Li snorted coldly, the aura of the peak of the True Martial Realm’s Sixth Heaven was released without reservation. He even activated a secret technique that temporarily elevated his combat ability to the later stages of the True Martial Realm, resisting Lu Zhen’s aura.
After that, Han Li pretended to be unable to bear it, retreating several steps in succession before forcefully stabilizing himself. He frowned deeply and stared at Lu Zhen, demanding, “What is Sect Leader Lu’s intention?”
“Don’t get excited, Dao Friend Han.”
Lu Zhen smiled, withdrew his aura, and said, “I heard that Dao Friend comes from an extraordinary background. Lu was overjoyed at the hunt and wished to have an exchange with Dao Friend.”
“It’s a pity that Dao Friend has not yet recovered his former life’s strength, otherwise, Lu would have the chance to witness the extraordinary elegance of a saint.”
Han Li’s eyebrows raised as he said with a deep voice, “Sect Leader Lu seems to have some misunderstandings about Han, I am not the reincarnation of any saint.”
“Is that so?” Lu Zhen smiled and did not continue to question further.
Han Li was quite interesting. His words implied that he might be a reincarnation from the Tongxuan Realm, yet Han Li had not explicitly said so.
“Sect Leader Lu’s intentions for coming here are clear to Han, but Han would like to ask, where are the people from the House of Divine Armies?” Han Li let out a breath and said.
“Before coming to Chengsheng Mountain, Lu took a trip to the Sword Domain and had a friendly exchange with the envoy from the House of Divine Armies. He said that something came up at the last minute and decided not to come,” said Lu Zhen indifferently.
PS: Something came up today, and I’m not in a good state, plus I hit a block in the writing… I was stuck on combat ability for quite a while…
In short, I’ll make up for it tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 466: 214: Dominate All Paths of the World! Ancestor's Mana is Boundless! The Encounter of the Two Great Female Saints!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 466: Chapter 214: Dominate All Paths of the World! Ancestor’s Mana is Boundless! The Encounter of the Two Great Female Saints!_1
Han Li’s pupils shrank slightly.
This Lu Zhen was truly domineering.
The House of Divine Armies had intended to send an envoy to invite him to join, but Lu Zhen had preempted them.
This was cutting off Han Li’s retreat.
However, it also suited his purposes, since Han Li had no intention of joining the House of Divine Armies anyway. Their involvement was just for show; he was definitely going to join Bai Yujing in the end.
Han Li had originally wanted to play hard to get, to take some advantage from Bai Yujing, but now it seemed impossible.
He would have to wait for later to rejuvenate his power base.
“Fellow Daoist Han, would you like to enter Bai Yujing?” Lu Zhen asked with a smiling gaze.
At this moment, his face was gentle, and his tone was calm, not betraying any hint that he was the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, with an aura of overwhelming murderous intent.
Han Li feigned a sigh and answered with a complicated expression, “Does Han have any other choice?”
Lu Zhen snorted with laughter and indifferently said, “Is this not exactly what Fellow Daoist Han has been expecting? Why put on such an act?”
They were all intelligent people; how could Lu Zhen not see through the little schemes of Han Li? If this man did not want to join Bai Yujing, he would not have merged Han Mansion and The Li Manor, revealing his identity to the world.
Han Li smiled and dropped the pretense, as he now had Lu Zhen wrapped around his finger.
Seeing Han Li not deny it, Lu Zhen said in a heavy tone, “Han Li, we both know why you are doing this. I’ll speak bluntly, if you’re just looking to use Bai Yujing to restore your cultivation, then you are gravely mistaken. Do not delude yourself.”
“Otherwise, no matter who you were in your previous life, regardless of your realm, on the territory of Qianyuan Divine Province, you cannot escape from the palm of Bai Yujing.”
Prior to coming to the Xuan Domain’s Chengsheng Mountain, Lu Zhen had discussed with the Second Grandmaster Qi Chunfeng about Han Li’s identity, purpose, power, and even the treatment after joining Bai Yujing.
After analyzing Han Li’s information, considering his personality and style, they concluded that Han Li was most likely a reincarnation of a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse or a Saint from the Saint Abyss Realm.
Decades ago, Han Li had broken the mystery of the fetus within, awakened his Dormant Wisdom, and since then, his cultivation had soared uncontrollably, eventually reaching the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm as Emperor Wu.
Han Li kept a low profile, solely focusing on the development of his family. He rarely went out, did not vie for cultivation resources, nor did he seek opportunities to enhance his skills. Yet, he was skilled in many powerful Heaven Rank martial techniques to the point of mastery, and that was only what he had revealed.
The cultivation resources of Han Mansion were predominantly obtained through trade with the outside world, with goods including elixirs, weapons, and so on, indicating that Han Li possessed considerable expertise in the Four Arts of Cultivation.
This was consistent with the characteristics of reincarnated powerhouses.
If Han Li had risen to prominence by luck and became an unparalleled genius, this would not fit with those characteristics, as even a peerless genius could not advance rapidly through closed-door cultivation alone.
Even geniuses need to go out and fight, compete for resources and opportunities, and cultivate martial techniques in a step-by-step manner. They could not master them to perfection in an extremely short period, especially when also studying the Four Arts of Cultivation…
As for reincarnated powerhouses, the attitude of the major Sacred Lands of the Qianyuan Divine Province was ambiguous. Those willing to join them faced no issue; those unwilling to join without strong backing were to be eliminated, their memories acquired to add to the heritage of the Sacred Land.
If they had strong backing, like a major force outside Qianyuan Divine Province, they would be expelled from the province and sent back where they came from.
Bai Yujing was willing to accept Han Li for several reasons.
Firstly, Han Li hailed from Tianxuan Mountain, and if traced back, he was somewhat connected to Bai Yujing.
Secondly, Han Li was a reincarnated powerhouse who had quickly cultivated to the True Martial Realm. Now in his early two hundreds, he held potential for cultivation.
If he passed through Bai Yujing’s layers of selection, they would invest more resources to help him rapidly cultivate to the Divine Yuan Realm and even the Tongxuan Realm, bolstering Bai Yujing’s strength.
Thirdly, Han Li was low-key and possessed a big-picture perspective. He was not prone to stirring up trouble and aligned well with the Dao Sect’s values, making Bai Yujing a suitable choice for him.
Fourthly, this was for the sake of the situation in the Xuan Domain. By absorbing Han Li into Bai Yujing, they could leverage the Daqian Empire to create a barrier against the Qitian Teaching.
The Daqian Empire could be used to fend off the Demon Clan from moving north and block the Buddhist Sect from expanding east. With the backing of Bai Yujing, Han Li only needed to keep Kurong Sect and the Yinyang Sect in check.
For this, Bai Yujing could overlook Han Li’s preferences, not caring about his frequent taking of wives and concubines, even offering him certain support to continue leading the Qian Dynasty.
From Han Li’s behavior and dealings, it was clear that he was someone who distinguished between gratitude and grudges, repaying debts of kindness. He took care of trivial matters like handling the aftermath for his junior brother Qiu Xuan, and on a larger scale, shielded Tianxuan Mountain from calamity, driving off Dugu Bing and escorting Tianxuan Mountain to settle within Qitian Teaching’s domain.
This was what Bai Yujing needed.
They did not want to welcome an ingrate into Bai Yujing; although one would not cause major trouble, it would still be displeasing. Someone with Han Li’s character was much more preferable.
Although Han Li was quite suitable in many aspects, his intention to join Bai Yujing was also utilitarian, seeking to leverage its resources to restore his past life’s cultivation.
Han Li had struck a deal with Chu Dingqian from the Qian Dynasty to help defend the empire for four hundred years, in exchange for a vast amount of resources.
Only a decade had passed when Han Li felt the time was ripe and voluntarily revealed Li Feiyu’s identity, attracting Bai Yujing. Although this did not violate his covenant with Chu Dingqian, it showed that Han Li was not particularly content to stay in one place.
So when Lu Zhen spoke, he aimed to admonish Han Li, advising him to rein in his clever plans and behave honestly.

chapters.title: Chapter 467: 214: Dominate All Paths of the World! Ancestor's Mana is Boundless! The Encounter of the Two Great Female Saints!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 467: Chapter 214: Dominate All Paths of the World! Ancestor’s Mana is Boundless! The Encounter of the Two Great Female Saints!_2
Looking at Lu Zhen, Han Li said solemnly, “Sect Leader Lu can rest assured, what kind of person Han Li is, I believe you all know very well.”
Lu Zhen nodded slightly.
The two conversed further, then Lu Zhen took out an Oath Stone and spoke at length to Han Li, who did as instructed, completing the initiation ritual.
Although he had taken an oath, Bai Yujing did not place too many constraints on Han Li, only a few fundamental principles like not injuring fellow sect members, not betraying the master and ancestors, not deliberately harming the interests of Bai Yujing, and so on.
Seeing Han Li complete these actions, a smile appeared on Lu Zhen’s face, now Han Li was one of their own.
Disciples of Bai Yujing weren’t initially bound by an Oath Stone either, it was only at a certain stage that this would happen, otherwise they would not qualify for Bai Yujing’s focus on cultivation.
As an individual of the True Martial Realm and Emperor Wu, Han Li was considered upper middle class within Bai Yujing, which naturally required such a show of loyalty, otherwise Bai Yujing would not be at ease.
“These are some resources for your initiation into Bai Yujing, if there are no objections, Lu will take his leave now.”
Lu Zhen tossed a Space Ring to Han Li, which contained a large amount of resources including pills, weapons, talismans, formations, some cultivation techniques of Bai Yujing, martial skills, and so forth.
Han Li caught the Space Ring and swept his Divine Sense over it, his face revealing a trace of surprise—Bai Yujing was quite generous.
If he truly were in the middle-stage of the True Martial Realm, these resources would be of great use to him and the Han Mansion; for now, they could certainly add some benefits to the Han Mansion.
“Han naturally has no objections, thank you, Sect Leader Lu, for making the trip,” Han Li said with a cupped fist salute and a smile.
Lu Zhen nodded, headed north, and quickly disappeared from sight, leaving only his voice echoing in Han Li’s ears.
“Junior Brother Han, last time on Dangyang Mountain, Dao Jun captured the lord of Emperor Wu’s City, who in his previous life was a Peak Quasi-Emperor. If you’re interested, you might consider visiting Bai Yujing.”
Han Li’s figure stalled for a moment, then he sighed. His expression soon relaxed and he descended towards Chengsheng Mountain.
Two million miles away, Lu Zhen stood high in the sky with hands behind his back, his expression serene as he gazed in the direction of Chengsheng Mountain.
The final expression of Han Li had been detected by his Divine Sense. Satisfied, he nodded. Lu Zhen had spoken so deliberately as a final test for Han Li.
Bai Yujing had taken Han Li into the sect and provided resources with an intention in mind. Lu Zhen was worried about Han Li’s disloyalty, hence the final warning.
If Han Li stayed compliant, then upon his visit to Bai Yujing, Lu truly could allow him to gain some benefits from the lord of Emperor Wu’s City; however, if Han Li was disloyal, then the fate of the city lord would be Han Li’s as well.
What use is the reincarnation of a powerful being? Before Bai Yujing, even tigers must kneel, and dragons coil.
Withdrawing his gaze, Lu Zhen found his visit to Chengsheng Mountain quite satisfactory. He communicated with the Artifact Spirit of a Quasi Emperor weapon and received a final answer.
Han Li had no connection with the mysterious being of the Tongxuan Realm who appeared on Dangyang Mountain.
Lu Zhen trusted the words of the Quasi Emperor’s Artifact Spirit; with Han Li’s strength, it was not enough to deceive the Quasi Emperor’s weapon, unless Han Li possessed a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s weapon.
But how could that be possible?
Heaven Imperial Realm-level Emperor’s weapons are not cabbages!
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li stood on the peak with a smile tugging at his mouth; Lu Zhen’s distant spying had not escaped his notice. From Lu’s expression, he had perfectly passed the test.
The first step of his plan was complete; from now on, he, Elder Ancestor Han, also had a backing.
With Bai Yujing’s influence, whether it be for himself or for the descendants of the Han Mansion, finding a wife or concubine within the Xuan Domain would be much easier.
Now as a disciple of Bai Yujing, his status was much improved, and other powers would not easily move against him, which was more conducive to the development of the Han Mansion.
As for the plan to replace the Sacred Land, that would have to be taken slowly. Perhaps after a decade or two, or even twenty or thirty years, when Bai Yujing became less vigilant, he could send more descendants to Bai Yujing.
Considering that the cultivation conditions at the Han Mansion were many times better than those of Bai Yujing, not to mention those of Tai Xuan Sect, Chun Yang Palace, and the other seven major sects, there probably wouldn’t be many from the Han Mansion willing to go there.
However, Elder Ancestor Han had his ways, and there was no rush. He would take his time.
As a member of Bai Yujing, with his strength in the True Martial Realm, he could claim a certain share of cultivation resources each year. This was just a basic guarantee and wouldn’t enhance his cultivation by much.
Disciples of Bai Yujing who wished to obtain more cultivation resources also had to make continuous contributions to Bai Yujing, such as completing various sect missions.
Han Li had missions too; Lu Zhen had mentioned them earlier. He needed to maintain the stability of the Daqian Empire and prevent it from being engulfed by the Yinyang Sect or the Kurong Sect. Bai Yujing would provide support for this.
This mission had no deadline; as long as the Daqian Empire existed and prevented the Yinyang Sect and Kurong Sect from engulfing it, Han Li could obtain a large amount of cultivation resources from Bai Yujing each year.
These cultivation resources were of no use to Han Li, but they were quite decent for the Han Mansion and could serve as one source of the mansion’s resources.
After all, these were just incidental matters. Even without Bai Yujing’s requirement, Han Li would still maintain the stability and existence of the Daqian Empire.
In this maneuver, Elder Ancestor Han felt he had struck it big!
He had perfectly accomplished his previous plan, without any mishaps in any aspect. Once he dealt with the possible envoys sent by Empress Fengyue and Empress Yuanchu, the Han Mansion would continue its low-profile development.
Seeing that Lu Zhen had left the Xuan Domain, Han Li finally relaxed and got to work restoring Chengsheng Mountain to its original state.

chapters.title: Chapter 468: 214: Dominate All Paths of the World! Ancestor's Mana is Boundless! The Encounter of the Two Great Female Saints!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 468: Chapter 214: Dominate All Paths of the World! Ancestor’s Mana is Boundless! The Encounter of the Two Great Female Saints!_3
Soon, the prosperous and vibrant Chengsheng Mountain returned, and all hidden things emerged, with the sealed martial abilities and talents of the descendants of Han Mansion completely unsealed.
Long Yue, Ling Lingshuang, Xue Yueqing, Yao Xi, Murong Ying, and many other beautiful wives and concubines of Han Li, whose identities could not be revealed, also stepped out from the Time-Sky Tower.
Time, just like certain readers, came and went in a hurry.
Half a month later,
Han Li was in Ling Lingshuang’s chamber, discussing Daoist principles with her and imparting his knowledge.
Facing Ling Lingshuang’s thirst for profound Daoist knowledge, Han Li agreed without hesitation; he was a man unable to say no, generously sharing all he had with Ling Lingshuang.
Amid the intense imparting of knowledge, watching Ling Lingshuang’s contented expression, Han Li still managed to divert a sliver of his attention to embark on a great venture.
Opening the treasure chest!
Finally, the much-anticipated moment to open the treasure chest had arrived.
Since breaking through to the Tongxuan Realm, Han Li hadn’t opened a treasure chest, although he now had the potential to unlock immortal weapons.
The main reason was that he had already used last month’s opportunity to open treasure chests in exchange for five years of cultivation, and opening it a second time would require fifty years of cultivation, which Han Li felt was too painful to consider.
Having almost depleted his accumulated years of cultivation for his breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm, leaving only a little over two hundred years, Han Li planned to conserve what was left.
Acquiring immortal weapons was too difficult; the fifty years of cultivation might just go to waste, so it was better to wait for this month’s opportunity to open the chest using five years of cultivation.
Now, the time had finally come.
To open this chest and strike gold in one go, Han Li had even specially sought out Ling Lingshuang, to fight with this proud and cold beauty, and to rub off some of her luck on himself.
With a thought from Han Li, the interface of the treasure chest appeared before him, right on top of Ling Lingshuang’s peak, exciting Han Ancestor even more.
He continued to discuss Daoist techniques with Ling Lingshuang and clapped for her as she sang, while simultaneously opening the treasure chest.
Looking at the treasure chest, enveloped in a halo of auspicious light, Han Li had a thought and silently uttered, “Open~”
In an instant, the chest burst into a dazzling golden light, radiating infinite light that only Han Li could see, and he became ecstatic.
This was a sign of a massive haul! Could it be that his first attempt to open a treasure chest since reaching the Tongxuan Realm would strike gold and yield the immortal weapon he so dearly desired?
When the boundless golden light faded, a treasure appeared on Han Li’s virtual panel, followed by a system notification sound.
“Ding~ Treasure chest successfully opened, congratulations Master on obtaining the Emperor Level Supreme Grade treasure [Emperor Flag]!”
Looking at the flag suspended above the chest, Han Li was slightly stunned and then sighed quietly, realizing that he hadn’t obtained an immortal weapon after all.
The Emperor Flag was only a Supreme Grade Emperor weapon!
Han Li glanced at Ling Lingshuang beneath him, continued to impart Daoist teachings, and muttered to himself, could it be that the luck wasn’t rubbed off enough?
Afterward, Han Li devoted himself entirely to exchanging Daoist principles with Ling Lingshuang. Though he hadn’t obtained an immortal weapon, acquiring a Supreme Grade Emperor weapon was still quite good.
Once he had taught all the profound Daoist techniques to Ling Lingshuang, Han Li left contentedly and headed for the summit of Chengdao Peak.
He took out the recently obtained Emperor Flag and examined it carefully, his face gradually revealing a look of wonder.
By now, Han Li had already obtained six Emperor weapons of Heaven Imperial Realm caliber: the Top Grade Emperor weapon Chengdao Vial and the ancient bronze sword, the Supreme Grade Emperor weapons Void Bell, the Time-Sky Tower, the Life-Prolonging Furnace, and the newly acquired Emperor Flag.
Among them, the Chengdao Vial and Life-Prolonging Furnace were auxiliary Emperor weapons, not powerful in offense or defense. The ancient bronze sword, which Han Li had obtained from a fisherman in the South Sea, had already submitted to him and was renamed by Han Li to Chengdao Sword.
Each Emperor weapon contained one or more Daoist principles. Generally, the more principles they contained, the more powerful the Emperor weapon would be. However, if the principle corresponded to a very high level of Dao, then even a single principle could make an Emperor weapon incredibly powerful.
For instance, the space principle of the Void Bell and the time principle of the Time-Sky Tower, these two weapons contained only one principle each but ranked as powerful items among the Supreme Grade Emperor weapons.
The Chengdao Sword was somewhat inferior, being only a Top Grade Emperor weapon containing two principles: the metal principle and the thunder principle.
The Chengdao Sword, endowed with the principles of metal and thunder, had formidable offensive capabilities, able to shatter anything indestructible and was absolutely yang and inflexible.
This Emperor weapon was always implanted on Chengdao Peak by Han Li, guarding the peak, and the whole of Chengsheng Mountain, to prevent any accidents.
The Emperor Flag, on the other hand, contained many principles within it; a total of nine principles to be exact: metal, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, thunder, light, and darkness. The Emperor Flag, bearing these nine principles, was incredibly powerful, not the least bit inferior to the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell.
Generally, possessing four principles would elevate an item to the status of a Supreme Grade Emperor weapon, which can have at most nine principles.
The power of the Emperor Flag had reached the pinnacle of Emperor weapons, its surface dense with Dao patterns. On close inspection, Han Li discovered there indeed were nine types, on both the flag’s fabric and the staff.
“To control Dao, to master all the Dao of the world.”
Looking at the Emperor Flag in his hand, Han Li’s eyes gleamed as he remarked.
Although the Emperor Flag contained only nine principles, if they were combined and derived from one another, they actually encompassed many types of principles. For instance, any of the Five Elements principles were actually composed of many smaller principles.
The Artifact Spirit of the Emperor Flag was a young girl in a colorful dress with whom Han Li communicated at length, fully understanding the power of the Emperor Flag.
The Emperor Flag, with unparalleled offensive capabilities, also excelled in defense, concealing fate, and more, greatly delighting Han Li.

chapters.title: Chapter 469: 214: Dominate All Paths of the World! Ancestor's Mana is Boundless! The Encounter of the Two Great Female Saints!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 469: Chapter 214: Dominate All Paths of the World! Ancestor’s Mana is Boundless! The Encounter of the Two Great Female Saints!_4
After toying with the Emperor Flag, Han Li casually threw it, sending it flying into the heavens where it kept company with the Time-Sky Tower and the Void Bell.
With hands clasped behind his back, Han Li stood on the mountain’s summit, admiring the stunning and magnificent scenery of Chengsheng Mountain, and he noticed a curious thing: he had obtained many Sacred and Emperor Level weapons, and most of their Artifact Spirits were female.
Only a very few Emperor weapons were not, such as the Chengdao Sword, the Haotian Hammer, and the Fangtian Halberd, to name a few.
He thought this was quite nice, after all, Ancestor Han was a cultivator of exquisite taste, and there was a saying, what was it?
When there’s work, the Emperor weapons toil; when idle… (fill in the blank)!
With a faint smile, Han Li’s figure disappeared from the peak of Chengdao, returning to his own sleeping chamber to grab a few items, then in a flash, he appeared on the eighth level of the Time-Sky Tower.
Now that Han Mansion and The Li Manor had merged, Han Li no longer needed to travel between the two, although for him it was but a thought away.
Sitting cross-legged, Han Li continued to cultivate his techniques.
Having obtained many high-quality and powerful cultivation techniques from the lord of Emperor Wu’s City, Han Li had always been cultivating them, and he was close to integrating them all into the Chaos Scripture.
Han Li could clearly feel that his cultivation technique, the Chaos Scripture, was steadily becoming stronger, improving in every aspect, and he estimated that once he integrated all the techniques, it should be able to reach the Emperor Level Top Grade.
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, half a month had passed.
The eighth level of the Time-Sky Tower required Quasi Emperor cultivation, and as the master of the tower, with its protection, Han Li successfully entered this place, even though his physical body was only comparable to the peak of the Tongxuan Realm.
Han Li did indeed want to go to the ninth level of the Time-Sky Tower to experience its effects, but for now, he couldn’t enter; the flow of time was too swift there, and even with the protection of the Time-Sky Tower, he couldn’t stay long and it was quite uncomfortable.
So when Han Li wanted to cultivate, he would enter the eighth level of the Time-Sky Tower to do so. This level was also good, with one day on the outside equating to five years inside. After further advancing his cultivation level, going to the ninth level wouldn’t be too late.
Although Han Li had to leave from time to time to engage in the transmission of teachings and guide his descendants in cultivation, spending time with his loving wife and beautiful consorts, which took up a lot of time, he also succeeded today in integrating all the techniques into the Chaos Scripture.
As expected, the Chaos Scripture underwent a tremendous enhancement, rocketing from Quasi Emperor Rank cultivation technique to a legitimate Emperor-level technique of the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor Rank.
Because of the upgrade to Emperor Level of the Chaos Scripture, the vast mana within Han Li also improved, becoming further refined, and the quality increased by much.
Although the overall amount of mana temporarily dropped to one-tenth of its original amount, Han Li would soon replenish it, and additionally, his mana storage limit increased, now comparable to the fourth layer of the Saint Abyss Realm.
“The Ancestor’s mana is boundless.”
After sensing the limitless mana within, Han Li grinned with a smile.
With the increase in mana storage, the combat ability he could exert also improved, stronger than before.
Elsewhere, in Guanghan Divine Province.
Guanghan Divine Province was vast and boundless, not much smaller than Qianyuan Divine Province, once one of the Thirty-three Divine Provinces under the jurisdiction of Qianyuan Divine Province.
As one of the ancient Thirty-three Divine Provinces under the jurisdiction of Qianyuan Divine Province, compared to Huangting Divine Province, Yuanming Divine State, and the like, Guanghan Divine Province was relatively more chaotic.
While Huangting Divine Province and Yuanming Divine State and thirteen other Divine Provinces all had Quasi Emperor Rank powers, Guanghan Divine Province did not, the strongest there being Saint Abyss Realm powers, with a total of five.
The five Saint Abyss Realm Powers were constantly vying for territories and cultivation resources, leading to endless strife and wars in Guanghan Divine Province.
Cultivators living in Guanghan Divine Province were generally bellicose, and although the spiritual energy was much richer compared to Qianyuan Divine Province, the cultivation environment was inferior, since the Great Holy Land Schools of Qianyuan Divine Province were more restrained, sustaining stability in the Divine Province.
At this moment, high above the sky of Guanghan Divine Province, two exceptionally beautiful and unparalleled female saints stood in confrontation.
All five great Saint Abyss Realm Powers of Guanghan Divine Province had noticed this situation and became anxious; they did not wish for the two peerless female saints to clash in Guanghan Divine Province, as it would cause significant destruction.
However, the six Saint Abyss Realm Saints of the five great powers dared not to intervene. Both peerless female saints had extraordinary backgrounds, not to be trifled with by them.
One was the Purple Mystical True Saint from White Emperor City in Taibai Divine Province, and the other was Ji Mingyue, the female Saint from Huangyue Imperial Empire in Kunji Divine Province, but it was unclear why they had come to a standoff.
As fellow Saint Abyss Realm Saints, both Purple Mystical True and Ji Mingyue hailed from the nine mightiest forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, their identities and status naturally supreme, on par with Quasi Emperor powerhouses.
“When immortals fight, it is the fish in the pond that suffer,” a seasoned Saint Abyss Realm Saint couldn’t help lamenting as he looked up at the two peerless female saints locked in a standoff above.
He dared not mediate the conflict, and if the two peerless female saints were to truly start fighting, they could only activate their respective powers’ Sacred and Emperor Soldiers, striving to protect Guanghan Divine Province.
High above, separated by thousands of miles, the two peerless female saints’ gazes met.
Ji Mingyue, in flowing green robes, stood unsurpassed in beauty, with phoenix eyes and starry pupils, a delicate figure undulating in its grace and elegance, as if a Heavenly Immortal had descended, uniquely aloof from the world;
Purple Mystical True, in white clothes purer than snow, with fluttering purple hair, bright eyes, and white teeth, presented a beauty unparalleled in this world, with a fairy-like complexion and a perfectly slender figure, exuding a noble and pure aura.
Ji Mingyue looked distastefully at Purple Mystical True not far away, speaking faintly, “Purple Mystical True, what are you doing in this region of Qianyuan Divine Province?”
Deployed by the Huangyue Empress to the thirty-seven Divine Provinces of this region in Qianyuan to investigate, carrying the task of returning with the Empress’s split-soul and that person, Ji Mingyue had always been diligently carrying out this task.
Her first stop was in Yuanming Divine State, taking a month to finish the investigation without finding a trace of the Empress’s split-soul, so she moved on to other Divine Provinces, reaching Guanghan Divine Province after surveying most of the region.
What Ji Mingyue hadn’t expected was for Purple Mystical True from White Emperor City to also show up here, which instigated a sense of crisis within her heart. She wanted to understand Purple Mystical True’s motives, whether they were personal or under the Great Emperor’s orders.
In the previous Divine Provinces, Ji Mingyue had sensed someone spying, but as soon as she attempted to investigate, the shadow vanished; even calling upon the Emperor Artifact Spirit was of no use, as the other party had an Emperor-level artifact as well.
It wasn’t until Guanghan Divine Province that Ji Mingyue used a trick to force Purple Mystical True out.
Purple Mystical True, like her, was listed on the Heavenly Immortal Ranking. In the past, Purple Mystical True’s rank was much lower, but she had recently broken through to the Saint Abyss Realm and was now almost on par with her, only one rank lower.
“Ji Mingyue, it’s been a long time. I didn’t expect to encounter you in Guanghan Divine Province,” Purple Mystical True said with an indifferent smile, not showing a hint of embarrassment, as if she was not the one who had been tracking Ji Mingyue before.
She came under the Great Emperor’s orders, already aware that Ji Mingyue was investigating the Huangyue Empress’s split-soul. After checking several Divine Provinces, Purple Mystical True unexpectedly came across Ji Mingyue and chose to hide early on, following her movements.
The White Emperor had tasked her to try bringing back the Huangyue Empress’s split-soul, or at least to ascertain the cause of the Empress’s fury should the former prove impossible.
With Ji Mingyue operating under the Huangyue Empress’s orders, she undoubtedly possessed items that could trace the Empress’s split-soul, greatly increasing the likelihood of discovery.
Purple Mystical True felt it would be easier to find the Huangyue Empress’s split-soul by following Ji Mingyue, thus she dropped the notion of searching aimlessly on her own.
PS: Plans can’t keep up with changes; I owe another thousand words today, which I promise to make up for tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 470: 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang's Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 470: Chapter 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_1
“Zi Miao Zhen, no matter what your motives are, you’d best keep your distance from me,”
Ji Mingyue, her aura burgeoning, took a few steps towards Zi Miao Zhen, her graceful poise commanding as her towering presence bore down on Zi Miao Zhen.
Adorned in flowing celestial garb with wide sleeves, her peerless beauty stunned the world; her lips were lustrous red, and now, with her sleeves fluttering and divine light cascading around her, she appeared as an ethereal Heavenly Immortal descending to the mortal realm, transcendent and detached.
Confronted with Ji Mingyue’s aura, Zi Miao Zhen stood tall and unyielding, though her delicate brows furrowed slightly, revealing a hint of surprise on her flawless, exquisite face beneath the light veil.
Ji Mingyue’s cultivation was far stronger than hers; she had only recently broken through to the Saint Abyss Realm, while Ji Mingyue was already a mid-stage female saint of that realm, signifying a substantial gap in their strengths.
But Zi Miao Zhen was undaunted; her methods were formidable, her Divine Skills peerless. Should Ji Mingyue truly seek a confrontation, Zi Miao Zhen was confident she could hold her own in battle.
Each bore the divine weapons of the Heaven Imperial Realm; if need be, reviving those imperial weapons for a fight, who could prevail over whom?
“Ji Mingyue, you don’t need to try to intimidate me with your words. I won’t fall for that. If you really want to fight, then bring it on,”
Zi Miao Zhen’s gaze sparkled, her dynamic eyes as radiant as two stars. A light smile graced her flawless face, shadowed by her charming body’s sinuous curves. Towering and slender, her figure exuded divine radiance and holy elegance.
Her white robe danced like ripples on water, reminiscent of a celestial fairy of unparalleled elegance. When she smiled, she was stunningly radiant, making even the bright sun in the heavens seem dim in comparison.
“Hmm~”
Ji Mingyue let out a cold laugh, continuing her approach without hesitation, and extended her radiant right hand forward with a gentle pat.
“Then I shall have to experience it for myself.”
As Ji Mingyue’s jade hand moved, she formed the Heavenly Phoenix Seal; her crystalline fingers bent as if a phoenix spreading its wings, causing the heavens and earth to invert, the Yuankun Domain to shatter.
The Heavenly Phoenix shakes the nine heavens!
“Afraid? Not in the slightest,”
Zi Miao Zhen chuckled softly, her slender, fair arm extending as her hand emanated light, releasing an immortal glow that illuminated all corners of existence. Layers of palm prints surged towards Ji Mingyue, immediately corroding all laws and destroying all things, ripping the void asunder.
The two peerless female saints clashed, their momentum scornful of all creation, standing defiant above all, their terrifying power sweeping across billions of miles of the Divine Province.
Below, the five Saint Abyss Realm powers of the Guanghan Divine Province cursed inwardly, forced to act to shield against the aftershocks of the superior female saints’ clash, preventing the strikes from reaching the Guanghan Divine Province itself.
Fortunately, Ji Mingyue and Zi Miao Zhen, the two peerless female saints, still retained some measure of restraint. This was but a simple exchange—it wasn’t that they had used their Sacred Soldiers, let alone their imperial weapons.
Billions of miles away from where Ji Mingyue and Zi Miao Zhen were clashing, a figure in a purple palace dress, her beauty without parallel and face flawless, stood atop a Divine Mountain tens of thousands of feet high.
Suddenly, her expression shifted slightly, and then she stepped off the Divine Mountain and disappeared.
The Artifact Spirit of the imperial weapon informed her that two powerful female saints were battling some billions of miles away, and both were acquaintances of hers. Naturally, Yuan Youwei could not miss this.
Soon, Yuan Youwei emerged from the void, descending outside the Guanghan Divine Province. She did not approach too closely and concealed her form.
Standing high in the heavens, Yuan Youwei’s proud figure undulated perfectly, her purple dress floating gracefully, her beauty as astonishing as ever, outshining even Zi Miao Zhen and Ji Mingyue by a narrow margin.
“Huangyue Imperial Empire’s Ji Mingyue, White Emperor City’s Zi Miao Zhen—how did these two end up fighting?”
Divine light diffused from Yuan Youwei’s body, and her beautiful eyes looked puzzledly toward the battlefield, taking in the spectacle of the two supreme female saints’ struggle.
Being a Heavenly Immortal herself, listed on the Heavenly Immortal Ranking, she was already a Quasi Emperor powerhouse, ranked much higher than Zi Miao Zhen and Ji Mingyue.
Below the Empress Yuanchu, the Huangyue Empress, and the other seven empresses, there were few who could compare to her. Her unparalleled elegance and renowned beauty were widely acknowledged across the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Despite her high ranking, Yuan Youwei did not underestimate those other fairies below her. They might not be as highly ranked due to less cultivation time, but their potential could very well match or even exceed her own.
Take Ji Mingyue and Zi Miao Zhen, for instance; with their exceptional talent and astonishing potential, advancing to the Quasi Emperor tier was merely a matter of time. In the future, they might even become formidable opponents on the path to becoming empresses.
Yuan Youwei’s eyes flickered; she thought of the recent events in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Being a confidante of the Huangyue Empress, Ji Mingyue likely had a purpose for coming to the Qianyuan Divine Province similar to her own. She was searching for fragments of Empress Yuanchu’s Primordial Spirit, while Ji Mingyue sought the fragments of the Huangyue Empress.
“Enemies indeed often cross paths,” murmured Yuan Youwei in her flowing purple robe, standing proudly.
The enmity between the Empress Yuanchu and the Huangyue Empress ran deep, and being on opposing sides with Ji Mingyue and both being figures of the Heavenly Immortal Ranking, they were inevitably compared against each other, almost like sworn enemies.
But why had Zi Miao Zhen come here?
Gazing at Zi Miao Zhen, who battled fiercely against Ji Mingyue and commanded the winds in the heavens, an unusual shade crossed Yuan Youwei’s perfect complexion.
The path walked by the Huangyue Empress and Empress Yuanchu was similar in their unique ingenuity, yet the White Emperor followed a different path entirely. Zi Miao Zhen was of White Emperor City, and by all logic, she had no reason to be here.
Could it be that the White Emperor wished to interfere in the strife between Empress Yuanchu and the Huangyue Empress?
Yuan Youwei felt it could be possible; everyone at the upper echelons of the Endless Yuankun Domain knew of the White Emperor’s interest in the Huangyue Empress.
However, if that were the case, what caused Zi Miao Zhen and Ji Mingyue to come to blows…
“Their methods are quite astonishing indeed,”
Putting aside her distracting thoughts, Yuan Youwei chose not to ponder any further and focused on the battle between the two supreme female saints, appraising their prowess.

chapters.title: Chapter 471: 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang's Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 471: Chapter 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_2
Ji Mingyue and Zimiao Zhen both possessed combat abilities that exceeded their realms, mastering numerous emperor-level martial skills with unmatched might. Their clash was fierce, attracting the attention of powerful figures from the surrounding Divine Provinces.
Yuan Youwei watched for a while before her figure faded away; she had a mission to continue, striving to find Empress Yuanchu’s soul fragment sooner so that she could return to Yuanchu Mountain earlier.
It was mainly because Ji Mingyue and Zimiao Zhen were holding back, restraining themselves and testing each other, preventing a fierce battle from erupting. Thus, Yuan Youwei lost interest in watching.
As expected, after clashing for a while, Ji Mingyue and Zimiao Zhen each retreated and vanished from the skies above Guanghan Divine Province.
They both had their own missions, and it wasn’t the time to engage in battle. Creating too much of a disturbance and attracting attention wouldn’t be good, and besides, they did not relish the thought of so many powerful figures scrutinizing them, as it could easily reveal their strengths.
Although they were both probing, it was obvious to the discerning eye that Zimiao Zhen was at a disadvantage, being suppressed by Ji Mingyue. After all, it was normal for Zimiao Zhen to be inferior to Ji Mingyue since she had only recently broken through to the Sacred Abyss Realm.
….
In Qianyuan Divine Province, on Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li was planning a significant event related to his future path.
What event?
Of course, it was a matter of personal significance.
Han Li was preparing to take a wife and concubines across the entire Xuan Domain.
By now, the information available about him had undergone a major update; he had become a mid-phase True Martial Realm powerhouse, standing at the apex of the whole Xuan Domain.
There were few practitioners in the True Martial Realm within the Xuan Domain to begin with, and even fewer were late-phase powerhouses. To the public, Han Li was Emperor Wu of the Sixth Heaven in the True Martial Realm.
In terms of strength, there were hardly any True Martial Realm Emperors in the entire Xuan Domain who could match the power Han Li displayed, no more than three.
In terms of status, Han Li was a disciple of Bai Yujing, the number one Sacred Land in Qianyuan Divine Province. Even other True Martial Realm Emperors from different forces in the Xuan Domain had to defer to him slightly.
In terms of potential, Han Li was a powerful reincarnated being, certified by Bai Yujing.
Han Li, not yet two hundred fifty years old, had already reached the mid-phase of the True Martial Realm and would easily break through to the Divine Yuan Realm in the future. External speculation suggested that if Han Li relied closely on Bai Yujing, he might become one of Bai Yujing’s core figures in the future, returning to the Tongxuan Realm.
Even if Han Li wouldn’t take charge of Bai Yujing, the number one Sacred Land in Qianyuan Divine Province, as a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, he would still be able to shake Qianyuan Divine Province.
To the outside world, Han Li was a rising superstar, destined for a boundless future that was beyond reach.
And now was the best time to form a connection with Han Li.
Securing the support of a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse early meant certain substantial rewards in the future; the investment was far too lucrative.
Especially since Han Li held a fondness for beautiful women and enjoyed taking wives and concubines. Simply by presenting a highly talented and attractive female cultivator to be one of the old ancestor of Han Mansion’s wives or concubines, one could easily board this mighty ship braving the winds and waves.
However, it had been over half a month since Han Li joined Bai Yujing, and he had yet to make any moves, seemingly content with only taking brides from the territory of the Daqian Empire.
This caused some urgency among the higher-ups of other forces in the Xuan Domain. These matters were sensitive, and they could not be too proactive.
Han Li was fully aware of these intentions from the other forces. During this period, many cultivators had come to visit, and their words and deeds conveyed this very message.
Ancestor Han, we beg you to continue marrying and taking concubines. We simply can’t wait any longer.
Han Li had been holding off, not wanting to draw too much attention and also considering the standards for taking wives and concubines, whether to maintain the previous ones or to establish new criteria.
To control the number of his consorts, Han Li had previously set a standard.
Only beauties with looks scoring above eighty-five and talents reaching Fourth or Fifth Grade could become his concubines; beauties with looks scoring above ninety and talents reaching Third Grade or above could become his wives.
Of course, special circumstances allowed for exceptions.
After some thought, Han Li decided not to raise the standards anymore. If he set the requirement that only Fourth Grade talent could be concubines and Second or First Grade talent could be wives, he probably wouldn’t be able to marry or take concubines.
Even as a reborn Saint, it was an issue because the Xuan Domain was too small.
The higher the talent of the cultivator, the fewer in number—this was a constant in the Xuan Domain, in Qianyuan Divine Province, and even in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Female cultivators of high talent were even scarcer, not even half the number of the entire high-talent cultivator population, approximately a six-to-four ratio.
Besides talent, there were also requirements for looks, which would eliminate many beautiful female cultivators. This was not conducive to the endeavors of Ancestor Han.
Han Li was skeptical whether there remained any other Second or First Grade talented beauties in the Xuan Domain.
Though he had married many beautiful wives, the ones who were Second or First Grade talents and belonged to the Xuan Domain were only Long Yue, Murong Ying, and Yao Xi. They weren’t of First Grade talent initially; their talent had only been enhanced after awakening Dormant Wisdom or following the release of their Divine Spirit seals.
Xue Yueqing and Ling Lingshuang, despite being of Second and First Grade talent, were not from the Xuan Domain; Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, Bai Keqing, and others had initially only been of Fourth or Third Grade talent and had recently improved to Second or First Grade talent through the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
Currently, Han Li had not heard of any beautiful female cultivators in the Xuan Domain with Second or First Grade talent. Such talent held immense potential and once revealed, Sacred Lands would actively come to recruit them. Even True Martial Realm forces couldn’t hold on to them if they tried.

chapters.title: Chapter 472: 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang's Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 472: Chapter 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_3
“`
In the Xuan Domain, there may indeed be maidens of Second Grade or even First Grade talent, who are either yet undiscovered, still lingering in the Mortal World, or have not yet unraveled the mysteries of their prenatal essence, and so on.
Therefore, Han Li did not want to set the standards too high, as doing so would dampen the enthusiasm of other forces to offer their daughters. Regardless of whether they possessed such high-talented beauties, it was improbable that these forces would send them to the Han Mansion.
Offering a beauty with Second Grade or First Grade talent to Han Li as a wife would simply be too great a loss; they could either cultivate her themselves or send her to a Sacred Land and reap even greater benefits.
With standards set too high, Han Li felt that he might go a long time without taking a new wife, and even the number of concubines he could accept would drastically decrease.
After all, only beauties with Fourth Grade or Third Grade talent were suitable as concubines. Fourth Grade talent was manageable, but the entire Xuan Domain had very few beauties who met the criteria for Third Grade talent.
Only being eligible to become a concubine with Third Grade talent, it was unlikely that any force would do so. Han Li was just a reincarnated formidable being, not a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse yet; he was not quite there yet.
“Alas, for the happiness of my descendants, I must take on more wives and concubines,” sighed Han Li.
He needed to improve the quality of his wives and concubines and control the quantity, yet he also had to keep broadening his sources to ensure that the number of Han Mansion’s descendants grew faster and faster.
The more rapidly the number of descendants in the Han Mansion increased, the faster his cultivation would improve. The stronger he became, the more benefits his progeny could enjoy.
Han Li knew that even if he maintained the current standards, the number of wives he could marry would still be very limited. After all, Third Grade talent was already quite high, possessing the potential for the True Martial Realm. Few forces would be willing to give a Third Grade talent to be his wife.
In this regard, Han Li felt he needed to take action himself and capture some beauties with Third Grade talent or higher to bring back.
However, doing so meant he would need to take certain measures. Third Grade talent was manageable, but beauties with Second Grade or First Grade talent were generally very well-known. He could no longer just capture and marry them like before.
Now that he was too much in the spotlight, the standards for his marrying and taking concubines could easily be deduced by the outside world. If he were to marry frequently and if, coincidentally, a celestial woman of First Grade or Second Grade talent went missing, it would be all too apparent.
Still, the number of his concubines was estimated to increase rapidly. In the Daqian Empire alone, he had taken many wives and concubines of Fifth Grade and Fourth Grade talent. Looking across the entire Xuan Domain, there would only be more.
Han Li felt this was acceptable; after all, he possessed the Life-Prolonging Furnace and with enough time, he could upgrade those concubines to First Grade talent.
Once he had made a decision, Han Li informed the relevant parties within the Han Mansion, and had his descendants convey his stance to the outside world.
This news spread rapidly outside the Daqian Empire, eventually reaching the entire Xuan Domain, and all forces above the God Refining Realm received the message.
The attention was mainly due to the numerous forces focused on the Han Mansion, who sought to curry favor with Han Li by offering daughters. Once they knew that Han Li was intent on taking wives and concubines across the Xuan Domain, interested forces quickly became aware.
When they learned of Han Li’s standards for taking wives and concubines, many forces sighed with relief, while many others heaved a sigh of regret.
The forces that sighed were the medium-sized ones, such as those at the God Refining Realm or Hollow Void Stage. The heads of these forces were only of the God Refining Stage or Hollow Void Stage, with talents mostly at the Sixth Grade or Fifth Grade, and very few at Fourth Grade.
These medium-sized forces realized they weren’t even qualified to cling to the coattails of Han Li, a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu and the future Tongxuan Realm mighty being.
The forces within had few if any cultivators with Fifth Grade talent, let alone being able to find a beautiful female cultivator of that talent to offer.
Even if by some chance they did find one, sending her to the Han Mansion in the Daqian Empire would only allow her to become a lowly ranked concubine.
The pleased forces were those of Myriad Phenomena Realm status and even True Martial Realm status, as some True Martial Realm forces in Xuan Domain sought to offer daughters to Han Li.
For instance, the Da Jing Dynasty wanted to send some beautiful cultivators to Han Li to mend their relationship and avoid Han Li siding with the Qian Dynasty.
Now, the Qian Dynasty was not what it used to be, with Han Li, a reincarnated powerhouse with boundless prospects, at its helm, so they no longer needed to worry about their downfall.
If the Da Jing Dynasty didn’t want to give up the Sanzhou territory already in its grasp, it knew it had to be strategic. As long as they could get on Han Li’s good side, they wouldn’t have to worry about this issue.
These Myriad Phenomena Realm andTrue Martial Realm forces breathed a sigh of relief because Han Li’s standards for marrying and taking concubines weren’t set too high. If the standards were too lofty, even if they wanted to support him, they would have had to give up.
Now, the standards were just right. Among the Myriad Phenomena Realm forces, there were beauties with Fourth Grade talent, and a rare few with Third Grade. Whether to send them as concubines or as wives, they still had a choice.
If only Third Grade talent could become a concubine, they wouldn’t have had a choice at all, and most Myriad Phenomena Realm forces wouldn’t qualify. Those that did would probably refrain from sending one.
But in the True Martial Realm forces, there were many beautiful cultivators of Fourth Grade talent and even quite a few of Third Grade. Sending one to Han Li would not be a bad move, for the rewards of winning his favor could be incredibly high.
Third Grade talent alone merely indicated potential for the True Martial Realm. It still required sufficient cultivation resources to have a fair chance of reaching that realm, which could take at least a few hundred years. Could anything be faster than offering a daughter to become a wife in the Han Mansion?
In a few hundred years, Han Li would have already cultivated to the Divine Yuan Realm, becoming an exalted Emperor Wu.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 473: Chapter 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_4
Daqian Empire, Capital City.
Inside the Chao Tian Hall, Emperor Qian sat alone on the Dragon Chair, silent and unspoken.
He had also heard the news that Han Li, the ancestor of the Han Mansion, intended to take a wife and concubines in the Xuan Domain. This time, he had not summoned his ministers to discuss the matter; instead, he sought a moment of solitude—he had yet to make up his mind.
The ancestor of the Han Mansion was the stabilizing pin of the Daqian Empire, stationed in the empire, safeguarding its existence from demise. Now, the importance of Han Mansion’s ancestor had been multiplied; not only was he an Elder of Bai Yujing, but also a reincarnated powerhouse, with his status skyrocketing.
According to the covenant between the Sect’s Elder and Han Mansion’s ancestor, the latter would protect the Daqian Empire for four hundred years. However, if the relationship between them were not maintained, it would last only those four hundred years.
Now that Han Li’s status had changed, Emperor Qian wanted to take their relationship further; otherwise, it would gradually become more distant.
Who would let there be so many forces out there wanting to undermine them?
Although the Daqian Empire had sent many beautiful female cultivators to Han Li, the highest aptitude among them was only Fourth Grade, all of whom were concubines.
To advance the relationship with Han Mansion’s ancestor further, they needed to present him with a Third Grade aptitude beauty to become Han Li’s wife.
Otherwise, not to mention using Han Li’s help to reclaim the territories swallowed up by the four great powers, even the remaining territories would be precarious and could be lost at any time.
There were indeed some beautiful female cultivators of Third Grade aptitude in the Daqian Empire, but only a handful belonged to both the Daqian Court and the Da Qian Royalty.
Meeting these criteria, Emperor Qian could only think of three.
The first was the Princess of the former emperor, his elder sister. Although she was three or four hundred years old and had cultivated up to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, she remained unmarried and a virgin, and her beauty was outstanding.
The second was the queen of his brother, Prince Wu’an, who also possessed Third Grade aptitude. Although she was only at the Hollow Void Stage, in terms of beauty and figure, she was no less than the Princess.
The third was his own… Empress, also of Third Grade aptitude and cultivator at the Hollow Void Stage.
Emperor Qian wanted to make the relationship between the Daqian Empire and the Han Mansion even closer, so he could only offer a woman from their ranks to become Han Mansion’s ancestor’s wife. However, given the extraordinary statuses of these three, should he do so, he would certainly bear an overwhelming infamy.
Especially regarding his Empress, which was why Emperor Qian had been unable to make up his mind, also uncertain if Han Mansion’s ancestor would marry the latter two women. If they could only become concubines, it would be a severe loss.
Emperor Qian was sure that the Princess could marry into the Chengsheng Mountain and become the wife of Han Mansion’s ancestor, but his elder sister was also a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster, whose cultivation was even more profound than his, leaving Emperor Qian no room to compel her.
He had mentioned it to the Princess once and was blasted out by her. Emperor Qian still remembered her icy demeanor and the words she spoke.
“Li Feiyu is unreliable. If I were to marry over there, even if I eventually cultivated to the True Martial Realm, by then my heart would be with Li Feiyu, and I wouldn’t be much help to the Da Qian.”
“You needn’t worry about these matters. There’s plenty of time. Once I’ve cultivated to the True Martial Realm, I can become the guardian deity of the Daqian Empire,” she asserted.
Emperor Qian sighed.
How easy it was to talk about cultivating to the True Martial Realm?
He was at the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and the State Preceptor, Grand Tutor, Left Chancellor, Prophet, Head Supervisor, and many other Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters also had Third Grade aptitude. The Daqian Empire was not short of Third Grade aptitude cultivators, not to mention those from the Myriad Phenomena Realm Sects and families.
But perhaps none of them would truly advance to the True Martial Realm!
In the three thousand years since the founding of the Daqian Empire, only the Da Qian Royalty could reliably produce True Martial Realm Emperors Wu, and each generation had at most two, usually only one.
Third Grade aptitude represented only potential, and those cultivators who could transform potential into realm were rare, perhaps one in ten or even one in tens of Third Grade aptitude cultivators might break through to the True Martial Realm.
He was Emperor Qian, able to utilize all of the empire’s resources, yet he had no confidence in advancing to the True Martial Realm, so how could the Princess possibly make the breakthrough?
Yet the Princess was very proud and stubborn, unswayable even by him.
“Let it be.”
Emperor Qian sighed lightly, vanishing from the Chao Tian Hall, and once again appeared in the Royal Manor of Prince Wu’an.
He wanted to continue persuading that queen.
Using force was out of the question; it would only result in loss without gain.
Da Jing Empire, Capital City.
Inside the forbidden grounds of the Imperial Palace, two True Martial Realm Emperors Wu of the Da Jing Empire were engaged in a secret conversation.
One was Jiang Zhengyang, the former, former, former Emperor of the Da Jing Empire who had appeared in the Sacred Dragon Secret Realm, just at the initial stage of the True Martial Realm. The other, wearing a black robe, was an even older Emperor of the Da Jing Empire named Jiang Yuanchuan, who had cultivated to the middle stage of the True Martial Realm.
“Ancestor, what should we do?” Jiang Zhengyang asked in a heavy voice.
Ever since confirming that Han Li was a reincarnated powerhouse and had become an Elder of Bai Yujing, the Da Jing Empire had been contemplating how to establish a connection with Han Li. The simplest method was to offer him a woman.
There were precedents for this; whether under the identity of Han Li or Li Feiyu, he had accepted many women from various powers as wives and concubines, securing a strong alliance with the Han Mansion.
The Da Jing Empire also wanted to offer a woman, but remained uncertain about the appropriate level to send, given Han Li’s different status now, which might lead him to raise the requirements for marriage and concubinage.
According to the latest intelligence, Han Li had not raised the standards. Jiang Zhengyang believed it was fine to follow the original plan, but he still sought the opinion of Jiang Yuanchuan, the strongest in the Da Jing Empire.
Jiang Yuanchuan meditated silently and after a long while let out a sigh, saying, “Zhengyang, now is a good opportunity we must seize.”
“What does the ancestor mean?” Jiang Zhengyang’s brow furrowed slightly.
Jiang Yuanchuan shook his head and replied, “Your vision is still too narrow, unable to see farther.”

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 474: Chapter 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_5
Jiang Zhengyang fell silent, his heart unwilling, but he didn’t voice it.
Jiang Yuanchuan saw through it and hinted, “You’re thinking of establishing good relations with Han Li, protecting the annexation of the three states of Da Qian, and then, once Han Li breaks through to the Divine Yuan Realm in the future, investing further, right?”
“That’s right,” Jiang Zhengyang nodded, indeed that was what he thought.
Although Han Li was a transmigrated strong being and now an elder of the Bai Yujing, who could predict the future?
Currently, the undercurrents in Qianyuan Divine Province were turbulent, and Bai Yujing might not necessarily be secure; as for the depth of that mysterious forces’ foundation, no one knew.
Jiang Yuanchuan smiled and said, “Since you know he is the reincarnation of a strong being, why don’t you consider profiting from this directly? It would be simpler and swifter.”
Jiang Zhengyang’s pupils suddenly shrank; he understood, the old indeed were craftier, thinking on a grander scale.
Since Han Li was the reincarnation of a strong being, a mighty figure from the Tongxuan Realm or even a Saint from the Sacred Abyss Realm in his past life, he surely possessed many divine cultivation techniques and martial skills, even possibly at the Quasi Emperor level.
Besides, Han Li might also possess a great number of high-grade Pill Formulas and Refining Blueprints; all of which are a great opportunity for fortune.
If they could obtain some from Han Li’s hands, both of their strengths would greatly improve, and the foundation of the Da Jing Empire would also enhance significantly.
In this way, they could ensure both the short-term benefits and long-term prospects; grasping onto both ends, both ends firm.
However, if that was the plan, then both the quality and quantity of the women sent would have to be further increased.
“What are the elder’s plans?” Jiang Zhengyang directly asked.
Since Jiang Yuanchuan had put it this way, he likely had already made a decision, and Jiang Zhengyang had no objections; this way, he could also obtain a great deal of benefit.
“Send three perfect Third Grade aptitude beauties with exceptional looks to Han Li,” said Jiang Yuanchuan.
The Da Jing Empire, being stronger than the Daqian Empire, had some beautiful female cultivators with Third Grade aptitude, but their number was not large.
Jiang Zhengyang raised his eyebrows and asked, “Is there no need to send some with Fourth Grade and Fifth Grade aptitude?”
“In front of three beauties with Third Grade aptitude, others are just icing on the cake,” said Jiang Yuanchuan with a smile.
Pausing briefly, Jiang Yuanchuan continued, “Ask Snow’s opinion; if she is willing, send her along to Chengsheng Mountain; if not, then forget it.”
Jiang Zhengyang fell silent, sighed, and could only agree with a word: “Alright.”
The Snow mentioned by Jiang Yuanchuan, named Nangong Xue, was his disciple, currently a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage. She came from humble origins and was discovered by chance by him, raised like a precious daughter.
Nangong Xue possessed Second Grade aptitude, which held the potential for the Divine Yuan Realm. Even if she stayed in the Da Jing Empire, her future would be that of a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, and if she encountered a great opportunity, she might even become a Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu.
A cultivator with Second Grade aptitude, if born in a Sacred Land and grandly nurtured, with a great opportunity, could even hope to break through to the Tongxuan Realm.
Since Han Li was an elder of Bai Yujing and a transmigrated powerful being, if Nangong Xue was willing to marry over, her status would certainly be high.
According to the intelligence they gathered, among Han Li’s wives, the one with the highest aptitude was merely Third Grade, whereas Nangong Xue was of Second Grade aptitude.
With one Second Grade and three Third Grade aptitude beautiful female cultivators, the Da Jing Empire would be giving such a generous gift that, based on Han Li’s character, he would surely reciprocate generously.
They could then obtain some cultivation techniques and martial skills of the Tongxuan Realm or even Sacred Abyss Realm level from Han Li’s hands, enabling him and Jiang Yuanchuan as well as other cultivators in the official ranks of the Da Jing Empire to strive higher.
Currently, they were only cultivating Divine Yuan Realm level techniques, and those Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm loyally serving the Da Jing Empire were only cultivating True Martial Realm level techniques.
A powerful cultivation technique had a significant impact; even with lesser aptitude and limited potential, as long as one had good techniques, they could still rise to prominence.
Scenarios like those of the Daqian Empire and the Da Jing Empire were happening all over the Xuan Domain; most forces were willing to cling to Han Li’s coattails, even some of the True Martial Realm powers.
Like the Da Liang Empire and Emperor Wu’s City, whose master had died.
Emperor Wu’s City was in a dire situation; the city only had the ruler of Emperor Wu’s City, a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, who never intended to nurture the city’s cultivators. Regardless of whether his schemes succeeded, he could no longer stay there.
Without the protection of the True Martial Realm, the vast territories of Emperor Wu’s City would be indefensible and on the brink of collapse.
Emperor Wu’s City had vast territories, larger than the original eighteen states of the Qian Dynasty, roughly equivalent to one and a half times the Qian Dynasty.
Within this vast territory, aside from Emperor Wu’s City as the dominant power, there were many Myriad Phenomena Realm families and sects underneath that were now harboring other intentions, although they were still observing for the moment.
If the True Martial Realm and Divine Yuan Realm powers of the Xuan Domain didn’t interfere, they planned to declare their independence and establish their own territory.
Under such circumstances, the high ranks of Emperor Wu’s City were urgently looking for external support, seeking protection, and the elder of Han Mansion was the best choice.
The Da Liang Empire, the Da Jing Empire, the Kurong Sect, and others might take the opportunity to annex the territories of Emperor Wu’s City. Although the Ancient Empire couldn’t, being too close, Emperor Wu’s City might become a puppet.
But the elder of Han Mansion was a favorable option. Based on the situation in the Daqian Empire, this elder from Han Mansion seemed to hold no ambition and wouldn’t come to rule over Emperor Wu’s City.
Han Li’s strength, identity, status, potential, and so on, were all sufficient to deter other powers.
The high ranks of Emperor Wu’s City didn’t plan to keep the entire territory intact but hoped to maintain half or a third of it, just as with the Qian Dynasty.

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 475: Chapter 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_6
Now that the ancestor of Han Mansion had expressed his desire to take a wife and concubines within the Xuan Domain, their opportunity had arrived. There were quite a few beautiful female cultivators with Third Grade talent in Emperor Wu’s City; their only worry was being intercepted and unable to send them to Chengsheng Mountain.
Not everyone in the Xuan Domain was eager to curry favor with Han Li; there were many who did not wish to. Powers ranging from Myriad Phenomena Realm to Divine Yuan Realm Power were present.
The Ancient Empire was still observing, waiting to see what Han Li would offer in return. The Kurong Sect, Yinyang Sect, and Qitian Teaching did not need to do so, as they were backed by three Great Holy Land Schools and did not need such measures.
Fengbo Pavilion was also holding its forces back. They were backed by Emperor Mingtian and were still discussing what to do, whether to follow the current or to outright ignore it.
Within the territories of these five major powers, the forces of the Myriad Phenomena Realm would not send women to Han Li; they did not dare to.
The news of Han Mansion’s ancestor taking a wife and concubines within the Xuan Domain spread far and wide. Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, Myriad Demon Mountain, and other Great Holy Land Schools all received the news and chose to directly ignore it.
Han Li was an Elder of Bai Yujing; if the issue needed to be handled, it should come from Bai Yujing. Bai Yujing was clearly sitting by, even planning to use Han Li to restrain the Yinyang Sect and Kurong Sect, so not only did it not intervene, but it might also even present congratulatory gifts.
It must be said, the other Sacred Lands knew Bai Yujing well, and indeed, this was what the senior leaders of Bai Yujing were thinking.
In their view, Han Li taking a wife and consorts was a good thing. In time, his network would spread across the Xuan Domain, deeply intertwined, better equipped to resist invasions from the Yinyang Sect and Kurong Sect.
As for this allowing the Han Mansion to grow and become a colossal entity?
Bai Yujing was not worried about this; how strong could the Han Mansion be, no matter how powerful it became?
In front of Bai Yujing, none of it was worth mentioning; Bai Yujing possessed Immortal Soldiers to suppress its fate and had extraordinarily deep roots.
Furthermore, Han Li was also an Elder of Bai Yujing, a member of theirs.
……
Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion.
Since the announcement of his decision, Han Li had been busy making some preparations.
Although he had many predictions, whether those forces would act according to his expectations was another question.
During this time, Han Li was also presiding over the integration of Han Mansion and The Li Manor, and under his pressure, the two households finally merged smoothly.
Although there were some frictions, they all occurred among the younger generations of both houses, which Han Li thought was a good thing. Competition was beneficial, driving them to cultivate more diligently.
