The delicate wives and beautiful consorts, along with their descendants from the Li Manor, had adapted to life on Chengsheng Mountain during this period, got used to the various benefits owned by Han Mansion, learned about the treasures that assisted in cultivation at Han Mansion, and began to use them actively.
To this end, Han Li opened up all the sub-peaks of Chengsheng Mountain and developed the entire mountain area; a portion was for those from the Li Manor, while the majority remained for the future.
Chengsheng Mountain now had over five thousand descendants of Han Mansion, and if one included Han Li’s delicate wives and beautiful consorts, the descendants’ wives and concubines, and the freeloading sons-in-law, then the number reached several tens of thousands.
Chengsheng Mountain was home to several hundred thousand beings, most of whom were maids, protectors, Guest Elders, and such, all serving Han Mansion.
On Chengdao Peak,
Han Li stood side by side with Lu Tianxiang, the pair resembling a celestial couple, made for each other by heaven.
“Husband~”
Lu Tianxiang turned her head to look at Han Li beside her and softly called out.
“Xiangxiang, have you decided?” Han Li confirmed.
Lu Tianxiang hesitated, then nodded.
After cultivating together with her husband for a while and practicing diligently within the Time-Sky Tower, Lu Tianxiang had reached the Sixth Heaven of the True Martial Realm.
This rate of cultivation could be considered extremely rapid, only a year since her breakthrough to the True Martial Realm.
Her talent had been enhanced to Second Grade, her main cultivation technique shifted from Lower Grade Heaven Rank to the Immortal Scripture. Coupled with the benefits of dual cultivation as well as the temporal acceleration of the Time-Sky Tower, and a steady supply of True Martial Realm pills for cultivation growth…
All these factors led to Lu Tianxiang’s rapid improvement.
Not just her, the cultivation of Han Li’s other delicate wives and concubines had also greatly improved; for instance, Bai Keqing had reached the Ninth Heaven of the True Martial Realm, and Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and other wives had reached the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, while Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Liu Yuexin, and other consorts had mostly reached the God Refining Realm, Hollow Void Stage.
Lu Tianxiang was in discussion with Han Li about her desire to use the Life-Prolonging Furnace consecutively three times, willing to exchange her future four opportunities for this.
After evolving into a Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon, the Life-Prolonging Furnace offered twenty-five opportunities for cleansing each month, amounting to three hundred per year.
A single cleansing from the Life-Prolonging Furnace could elevate a person’s talent by one grade and had a certain chance of birthing a special physique.
After more than five cleansings, there was a thirty percent chance; after more than ten cleansings, there was a fifty percent chance.
As Han Li’s wife, Lu Tianxiang was entitled to one cleansing opportunity each year. She had undergone one cleansing before, when the Life-Prolonging Furnace had not yet evolved, raising her talent to Second Grade.
Because of practicing the Immortal Cultivation Scripture, her physical body was already gradually improving. Lu Tianxiang had asked Yin Ling how many more cleansings would be necessary for her to develop a special physique.
Yin Ling used the Life-Prolonging Furnace to examine her and concluded she needed at least three more cleansings.
This matter had troubled Lu Tianxiang for a long time, but in the end, she decided to go through with it, wanting to develop a special physique sooner rather than later.
With a special physique, her cultivation speed would surge enormously, and even if she couldn’t keep up with Han Li, she could catch up to Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang, and other women.
Once she developed a special physique, her chances of birthing a Divine Yuan-level Primordial Spirit when she ascended to the Divine Yuan Realm would be much greater, at least around fifty percent likely.

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_7
chapters.content:
Chapter 476: Chapter 215: The Celestial Phoenix Moves the Nine Heavens! Xiang Xiang’s Birth Constitution! New Descendant of the Imperial Body! The Ancestor Takes a Wife and Concubines in Xuan Domain_7
“`
If she followed the normal procedure and accepted the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s cleansing, she would only have hope of developing a special constitution three years later, which was too slow. With the Time-Sky Tower in existence, three years outside meant she could cultivate for hundreds of years inside the tower.
Before obtaining the Immortal Scripture, Lu Tianxiang had no such intention, intending to cultivate her four children first. However, she changed her mind later because if she were to develop a special constitution, she could obtain more benefits for her progeny.
Her eldest son, Han Yongzhen, and her second daughter, Han Yongxiang, both had Third Grade talents, while her third daughter, Han Yonglu, and youngest son, Han Yonglu, had Second Grade talents; the latter two were born after Han Li’s talent had risen to Second Grade.
All four of Lu Tianxiang’s children were on Han Mansion’s priority training list, which meant they could already enjoy a great amount of resources, much more so than the vast majority of Han Mansion’s descendants.
According to Han Li’s rules, descendants on the priority training list received a cleansing every three years, while those on the core cultivation list received a cleansing annually.
After the consolidation of The Li Manor, the number of people competing for a chance at the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s cleansing soared. Just Han Li’s cherished wives and beautiful concubines numbered in the hundreds, not to mention the large number of priority and core cultivation descendants.
All these people were to be cleansed once every three years, but the Life-Prolonging Furnace could only cleanse three hundred people a year, so even those qualified had to queue and take turns.
All of Lu Tianxiang’s children were still young and only Han Yongzhen and Han Yongxiang were cultivating; their realms weren’t high. In fact, Lu Tianxiang didn’t need to let them have their turn at the cleansing since all four children could just follow the normal process and be promoted to First Grade talents in at most six years.
That was exactly why Lu Tianxiang was determined to proceed.
For this reason, Lu Tianxiang had already cleared the way with Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and even Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, and many of Han Li’s other cherished wives and beautiful concubines.
They were also willing to let Lu Tianxiang jump the queue. She was originally entitled to only one cleansing, but now she was to receive three, which would cause a delay of two slots for others in the lineup.
Lu Tianxiang had a good relationship with them and as Han Li’s first wife, everyone was willing to extend her this courtesy.
Looking at Lu Tianxiang, Han Li sighed.
Han Li was hesitant whether to directly allow Lu Tianxiang to use three cleansings, letting her enjoy the privilege without having to pay a price for it.
But how would the others see this?
Lu Tianxiang was his first wife, and he could give her special treatment, but what about Liu Yuexin, his first concubine who had been of great help to him? Should she also receive special treatment?
Long Yue was the reincarnation of a dragon saint and had given birth to a First Grade talent, Han Yonglong – did she also deserve special treatment?
There were also Yao Xi and Murong Ying, who were avatars of the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu, with unique identities, and whose progeny were or might be of a special constitution.
Xue Yueqing and Ling Lingshuang were also Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors, who also had reasons to receive special treatment.
Both the palm and back of the hand are flesh; Lu Tianxiang was his beloved wife, but so were the others, along with his offspring. He had to follow the rules he had set, or no one would be satisfied, and that would result in chaos.
Even if they didn’t say it, they would surely think it. Who wouldn’t want to be specially treated?
This was Han Li’s hesitation.
Once he opened this door, and other cherished wives and beautiful concubines came forward, it would be difficult for him to refuse.
“My lord, you needn’t worry so much.”
Feeling Han Li’s emotions, Lu Tianxiang took the initiative to embrace him and said softly.
She was aware of Han Li’s dilemma and voluntarily showed understanding. Although she wished to be treated specially, she knew more importantly that her lord couldn’t open this door, or it would disrupt the rules, which would be bad for everyone.
If he dealt fairly and justly, both she and the other cherished wives and beautiful concubines would be convinced, at least it would be the same for everyone.
Embracing Lu Tianxiang in his arms, Han Li lowered his head and captured her delicate, stunning red lips.
After a long while, they separated, and Han Li nodded and then shook his head, saying, “Xiangxiang, you don’t have to give up an extra cleansing opportunity.”
Han Li had made his decision: he would not grant Lu Tianxiang special favors, but he would also not let her suffer a loss.
Lu Tianxiang looked up at Han Li’s handsome face, her countenance filled with smiles.
Her lord still favored her, which touched Lu Tianxiang deeply.
It seemed that he had not directly given her two additional cleansing opportunities, but it was already quite good, allowing her to move next year’s and the year after’s cleansing opportunities to this year, without having to pay any other price.
This was very important.
Although she had persuaded some sisters, there were still many more she hadn’t, or rather, Lu Tianxiang hadn’t approached them.
Han Li extended his curved forefinger to gently scrape her nose, smiling as he spoke, “Let’s go, my Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang.”
“`
Lu Tianxiang nodded, her face adorned with a blissful smile.
The two arrived at Yangdao Peak, where the Life-Prolonging Furnace was situated.
“Xiangxiang, go ahead,” Han Li indicated.
Lu Tianxiang glanced at him, took a deep breath, and proceeded. A ray of Emperor’s Light appeared from within the Life-Prolonging Furnace and guided her inside.
As soon as Lu Tianxiang entered to receive the ritual, Han Li’s voice echoed around Chengsheng Mountain, heard only by those qualified for the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s ritual.
He announced the matter of Lu Tianxiang cutting in line, stating that the two opportunities she would have had the next and year after next were gone, all focused on this single occasion.
This naturally caused some ripples, but no one made a fuss. After all, Lu Tianxiang was the husband and father’s first wife, and she had paid a corresponding price. It was just a slight favoritism.
As long as Lu Tianxiang was not directly given two chances to undergo the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s ritual, everyone could accept it.
Han Li noted the reactions of his wives and descendants, a satisfied smile surfacing on his face. This was quite good.
Afterward, Han Li waited there, expecting Lu Tianxiang to complete the Life-Prolonging Furnace ritual.
He was not the only one; before long, many people had accumulated on Yangdao Peak, mostly Han Li’s wives and concubines. They easily guessed Lu Tianxiang’s purpose and wanted to see if she would succeed.
So far, no one who had undergone the Life-Prolonging Furnace ritual had given birth to a child with a special constitution. Would Lu Tianxiang be the first?
Each session of the Life-Prolonging Furnace ritual took half an hour, with a period required between uses before one could receive another session.
After Lu Tianxiang’s third ritual, the Life-Prolonging Furnace suddenly burst with rays of Emperor’s Light. A thousand auspicious colors twined around Yangdao Peak and countless glows of rosy light bloomed, along with various miraculous phenomena.
Such commotion immediately caught everyone’s attention. It was clear that Lu Tianxiang had likely given birth to a child with a special constitution, as none who had undergone the ritual before had caused such an uproar.
Would Lu Tianxiang give birth to a King’s Body or an Emperor’s Body?
When Lu Tianxiang came out of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, seeing so many people slightly stunned and then offering a beaming smile.
“My lord, I have given birth to a King’s Body, which I call the ‘Heavenly Fragrance Body.'”
Lu Tianxiang conveyed to Han Li through a message.
Han Li nodded slightly and then said, “Everyone, disperse.”
All eyes turned towards Lu Tianxiang, envy glinting within, as she truly had given birth to a child with a special constitution.
Although it was unknown whether Lu Tianxiang had a King’s Body or an Emperor’s Body, or what special constitution it was, there was certainly something extraordinary, which reassured the others that they too might have a chance to produce a child with a special constitution in the future.
Returning to her chambers with Lu Tianxiang, Han Li joined her in a grand battle, with the Sect Hierarch showing exceptional initiative tonight.
As Han Li’s first wife and the first to possess a special constitution, she remained distinct from the rest.
Even if Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang, Yao Xi, Murong Ying, and other women had higher status or cultivation than her, Lu Tianxiang did not feel inferior to them.
Seven days later,
Han Li stood inside Murong Ying’s chamber, his face showing a hint of anticipation.
Murong Ying was in the midst of childbirth, and Han Li felt anxious, uncertain whether she could bear him a descendant with a special constitution, particularly an Emperor’s Body.
Like Yao Xi, Murong Ying was also an empress’s split soul, but the nature of her offspring was still unknown.
As a baby’s cry rang out, Han Li immediately walked in, directing his Divine Sense towards the newborn child while looking at Murong Ying.
The next instant, a smile spread across Han Li’s face, filled with surprise and delight.
Murong Ying had not disappointed him.
Worthy of being a split soul of the Empress Yuanchu, her child indeed had a special constitution. And just like Han Yongqian, it was an Emperor’s Body.
When Murong Ying gave birth, far in Divine Province, atop Yuanchu Mountain.
The Empress Yuanchu was once again enraged.
This time, she experienced what the Phoenix Moon Empress had gone through, which drove her to the brink of madness with boundless fury.

chapters.title: Chapter 477: 216: An unexpected change? The birth of the Divine Emperor's Body! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu's City! Long Yue advances to the Martial Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 477: Chapter 216: An unexpected change? The birth of the Divine Emperor’s Body! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City! Long Yue advances to the Martial Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm_1
Yuanchu Province, Yuanchu Mountain.
Empress Yuanchu was on the brink of madness, as the worst scenario she had anticipated still came to pass.
In less than a year, she had first been passively subjected to applause, and now, she was forced to endure the pains of childbirth.
Even though she had promptly blocked this extremely unique sensation, her flawlessly beautiful face was still filled with rage.
Who was it that was desecrating her divided soul?
If she were to find out, she would definitely skin them alive and pull out their tendons, then burn their soul with the Nine Nether Ghost Flame for a hundred thousand years, ensuring that person would wish for death yet be unable to attain it—only this could quench the hatred in her heart.
Empress Yuanchu withdrew her formidable aura, her gaze traversing endless time and space to focus on the region of Qianyuan Divine Province, her expression fluctuating unpredictably.
It had been almost a year since Yuan Youwei went there, and it was unclear how much progress she had made or how much territory she had explored.
As far as she knew, the divided soul of her arch-nemesis, Empress Huang Yue, was also in that region of Qianyuan Divine Province, and Huang Yue had even sent the saintess Ji Mingyue there, seemingly to no avail.
Suddenly, Empress Yuanchu had a surge of inspiration, a bold thought: “That audacious, lascivious person wouldn’t have captured both hers and Empress Huang Yue’s divided souls, would he?”
Once this thought arose, it could no longer be dismissed.
Empress Yuanchu felt that this was very likely.
Both were in the Qianyuan Divine Province region, both were so daring and lascivious—it was very likely that their divided souls had fallen into the same person’s evil hands.
Empress Yuanchu took one last look at Kunji Divine Province, her body radiating resplendent runes, her path paved by the laws of order as she stepped into the Thirty-Three Heavens Secret Territory.
Since Murong Ying had been violated and had given birth to a child, there was then no need for her to exist anymore.
Once Murong Ying was dead, she would be able to split off another divided soul to reincarnate and continue with her final goal.
Empress Yuanchu had this idea, and Empress Huang Yue was thinking the same.
If the divided soul had been subjected to such indecency, then it was best to annihilate it; once Ji Mingyue captured and brought back the divided soul and the culprit, she would kill the divided soul and then split off a new one to reincarnate, slowly dealing with that audacious scoundrel.
Taibai Divine Province, White Emperor City.
The White Emperor glanced at Yuanchu Province, then at Kunji Divine Province, his expression contemplative, as it seemed that the region of Qianyuan Divine Province might yet hold some surprises.
After pondering for a while, the White Emperor waved his sleeve, creating a temporal-spatial portal. He stepped into it and soon arrived at the headquarters of Tianji Pavilion.
Concealing his aura, the White Emperor was welcomed in by the supreme being of Tianji Pavilion, Emperor Tianji, with whom he had a conversation. The White Emperor then directly stated his purpose for coming.
Emperor Tianji nodded without changing expression, but inside, he was quite pleased; the big sucker he had been waiting for a long time had finally arrived.
In recent years, the Endless Yuankun Domain had faced some disturbances related to Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu, the two peerless empresses. According to his calculations, the divided souls of both peerless empresses had ended up in the Qianyuan Divine Province region and seemed to have encountered some mishaps, which infuriated both empresses.
Emperor Tianji had intended to calculate the source and then sell the information at a high price, but he found it quite challenging and the required resources were substantial. The cost made him wince, so he refrained from proceeding.
Then, Emperor Tianji silently waited, for his calculations showed that someone would come to pay the price, and now the White Emperor had come.
Working for the White Emperor, the massive resources required would definitely be funded by the White Emperor himself, and he would also have to pay a service fee to him. In this way, Emperor Tianji knew how to look at the cause and effect—it was simply too cost-effective.
“White Emperor, you and I are old friends, so I won’t hide it from you. I don’t have the information you want,” said Emperor Tianji honestly.
Just wait for you to invest in assisting with my calculations.
The White Emperor glanced at him helplessly and sighed, “Tianji, I thought we could talk about friendship, but it turns out you still want to talk about money with me.”
He knew Emperor Tianji very well. For him to speak like this meant he had already set a trap and was just waiting for someone to fall into it; this time, that person was him.
“Stop!”
Emperor Tianji frowned slightly, “Friendship is friendship, and business is business. It’s a small-scale business, and there’s no bargaining.”
Since when did you, a bold-faced fellow, learn to play the emotional card?
The White Emperor sighed. This guy was truly impervious to persuasion. He hadn’t even started to bargain and Emperor Tianji had already flatly refused.
Tianji Pavilion’s branches are spread throughout the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of the Endless Yuankun Domain, every Divine Province having countless sub-branches, with vast resources flowing into Tianji Pavilion every moment. And you tell me it’s a small-scale business?
“Name your price,” said the White Emperor indifferently.
He was the ruler of White Emperor City, which governed Taibai Divine Province and fifty-three other Divine Provinces. The White Emperor could access all resources and was ranked among the top three wealthiest in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Of course, he still couldn’t compare to the man before him. The wealth of Tianji Pavilion could be considered the first in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Calculating the whereabouts of Empress Yuanchu’s divided soul would not cost that many resources, at most the price of one Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapon, which he could still afford.
Emperor Tianji chuckled, flashing his right hand in front of the White Emperor.
“Have you lost your mind?”
The White Emperor frowned deeply, speaking disgruntledly, “Tianji, aren’t you trying to blatantly rip me off? Five Top Grade Emperor’s Weapons, why don’t you just rob me?”
His heart had anticipated the price to be one Top Grade Emperor’s Weapon, but Emperor Tianji was demanding five. Did he think he was a fool with limitless money to be swindled?
“White Emperor, you misunderstand. With our friendship, how could I cheat you? Of course, it’s not five Top Grade Emperor’s Weapons…” Emperor Tianji shook his head, clarifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 478: 216: An unexpected change? The birth of the Divine Emperor's Body! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu's City! Long Yue advances to the Martial Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 478: Chapter 216: An unexpected change? The birth of the Divine Emperor’s Body! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City! Long Yue advances to the Martial Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm_2
White Emperor breathed a sigh of relief and felt somewhat ashamed, he had almost misunderstood an old friend.
“We’re all good friends, Tianji still values relationships and wouldn’t trick me,” he thought.
“What I mean is five Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons,” Emperor Tianji said with a sly smile, glancing at him.
“Boom!”
White Emperor suddenly stood up, his terrifying Emperor’s Might erupted, shaking the heavens and the earth, sweeping through the universe, eclipsing the brilliance of the sun and moon, causing time and space themselves to seem inverted.
White Emperor looked at Emperor Tianji expressionlessly and said coldly, “Are you doing this on purpose?”
He felt that Emperor Tianji didn’t really want to divine for him, thus quoting an astronomical price, expecting him to give up due to the difficulty, could it be that the soul fragments of Empress Yuanchu and Phoenix Moon Empress’s tribulations involved Tianji Pavilion, involving the Emperor Tianji before him?
Even Top Grade Emperor Weapons seemed outrageous enough, to demand five Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons was simply astronomical; even as the master of White Emperor City, it was impossible for him to produce five Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons for such a minor divination.
It wasn’t that he couldn’t afford it, but that it simply wasn’t worth it!
The value of a single Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon was roughly equivalent to three to four Top Grade Emperor Weapons; five Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons would then equal fifteen to twenty Top Grade Emperor Weapons, and if converted to the main material for Emperor Weapons, the number would have to be multiplied several times over.
If White Emperor were to bring out so many Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons, White Emperor City itself would be crippled, taking countless years to recover.
With a light stamp of his foot, Emperor Tianji neutralized White Emperor’s Emperor’s Might and said with a smile, “White Emperor, stay calm and listen to my explanation.”
“I’m curious how you’ll explain this,” White Emperor said with a mocking smile, still expressionless.
“As you know, the region of Qianyuan Divine Province is peculiar to begin with, its heavenly secrets are heavily obscured, particularly Qianyuan Divine Province, divination is not easily done there. Sacred lands like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain are not to be trifled with; they are constantly protected by Immortal Weapons which fortify their destiny, preventing external prying into Qianyuan Divine Province’s affairs,” Emperor Tianji explained gravely.
White Emperor nodded slightly. Qianyuan Divine Province had reached the peak of glory in ancient times, and even though it had declined now, a lean camel is still bigger than a horse, and the nine strongest forces would not provoke it lightly. Who could blame them? Qianyuan Divine Province had too many Immortal Weapons.
In the present age, the nine strongest forces were only on par with the sacred territories like Myriad Demon Mountain, Xumi Mountain, and Heavenly Demon Hall during the ancient times. They still fell short of Bai Yujing, but each of them owned a Divine Province and controlled multiple Divine Provinces.
However, Qianyuan Divine Province was home to six of the Six Great Sacred Lands and the Great Holy Land School like Penglai Immortal Sect. It boasted one True Immortal and nearly ten Heavenly Immortals, its might echoing through the Endless Yuankun Domain, one of the ancient overlords.
Nowadays, each Heavenly Governing Force had a Great Emperor at its helm, as well as an Immortal Artifact to secure their fortunes, whereas the nine strongest forces each had a Supreme (at the pinnacle of Heaven Imperial Realm) in charge. Within these forces, two or three Immortal Artifacts could be found, and some even possessed true Immortal Artifacts.
In terms of heritage, Qianyuan Divine Province was still deeper than that of the nine strongest forces. It’s just that now there were no Saints of the Saintly Realms, Quasi Emperors, or Great Emperors left, with even the powers of the Tongxuan Realm being pitifully few.
“And then?”
“You want to divine the whereabouts of Phoenix Moon and Yuanchu’s soul fragments, which is already difficult. They both left measures when severing their soul fragments, obscuring the heavenly secrets and fate of the fragments, making it extremely difficult to divine.” Emperor Tianji continued.
“Is that all? That is far from worth five Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons,” White Emperor said, sneering. If the soul fragments of the two Empresses were outside Qianyuan Divine Province, in the other Thirty-Three Divine Provinces, it might cost at most one Top Grade Emperor Weapon. Even within Qianyuan Divine Province, only one Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon would suffice.
Yet Emperor Tianji was asking for five Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons from him!
Emperor Tianji appeared unconcerned, chuckling, “Of course, that alone would not be worth it, but the person who caused the trouble is.”
“What do you mean?”
“That person is no simple character. They definitely have a treasure that can obscure heavenly fate and confound time and space, at the very least an Immortal Weapon. Even I cannot easily divine it,” Emperor Tianji said with a sigh. He had tried a quick divination but to truly divine it with his abilities, while certainly possible, the cost would be too great.
If he were to make such a grand effort to divine it, neither Phoenix Moon Empress nor Empress Yuanchu would buy this information, it wouldn’t be worth it. It was just one soul fragment after all; even if it encountered mishap, just sending subordinates to search slowly would suffice.
In fact, Han Li did not have an Immortal Weapon, but he did have many Top Grade and Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons, notably the Void Bell, the Time-Sky Tower, and the Emperor Flag, which combined could rival a true Immortal Weapon in their effect of concealment.
White Emperor’s eyebrows raised, his face showing interest, and then without looking back, he left.
Let those who want to be duped, be duped.
After all, he was not willing to part with five Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons!
This trip was still worth it, for he had baited out some very valuable intelligence from Emperor Tianji’s mouth, such as the information that the troublemaker possessed an Immortal Weapon.
In the region of Qianyuan Divine Province, only seven of the Great Holy Land Schools had Immortal Weapons, which implied that the soul fragments of the two Empresses likely ended up in the hands of the Sacred Land Masters.
Of course, there was another possibility, that something completely unexpected had occurred; a person of extraordinary destiny and fortune had obtained an Immortal Weapon and dared to commit such a bold and audacious act.
This information was very valuable and made the trip to Tianji Pavilion worthwhile.
“White Emperor, wait a moment, won’t you reconsider? Actually, four Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons could also suffice,” Emperor Tianji said, suddenly anxious as he watched White Emperor turn and leave. With such a fool passing up the offer, who would fund his divination of heavenly secrets?
He too wished to know the causes and consequences, to satisfy his curiosity.
White Emperor paused, covered in the principles of order, walking upon high ridges of rules, crossing through time and space, returning to White Emperor City.

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - 216: An unexpected change? The birth of the Divine Emperor’s Body! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City! Long Yue advances to the Martial Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 479: Chapter 216: An unexpected change? The birth of the Divine Emperor’s Body! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City! Long Yue advances to the Martial Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm_3
Emperor Tianji truly knows how to keep one in suspense!
He really did plan to trap him!
Since all four Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons are acceptable, then the cost of Tianji’s deductions would be at most the value of three Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons.
…….
In Qianyuan Divine Province, Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li sat at the edge of the bed, holding Murong Ying in his arms, clasping her supple, boneless hand, while he replenished her vitality and exchanged sweet nothings with her.
Once Murong Ying had almost fully recovered, she took the child and looked at the infant with a beaming smile of happiness. It was only after a good while that she remembered the child didn’t have a name yet, and she quickly spoke up,
“Husband, what shall we name our child?”
Expectation filled Murong Ying’s eyes, wondering what good name her husband would come up with for their child…
She had just checked, and her and Han Li’s first child was extraordinary, not only possessing first-grade talent but also a special constitution, though she wasn’t sure if it was a King’s Body or an Emperor’s Body.
“Han Yongmu.”
Han Li’s gaze flickered as he announced the name he had chosen. Originally, he had thought of another one, but after seeing the child’s constitution, he changed his mind.
A gentle and modest gentleman lowers himself to shepherd the people.
Ancient enlightened kings heeded these six principles to shepherd their people, and the people flourished without fail.
Han Li chose the character ‘Mu’ for Han Yongmu’s name because he wanted his son to grow up cultivated, like a modest gentleman, and also to raise him into a peerless strongman of unmatched strength.
The act of shepherding people and livestock bears a similarity to a sovereign’s rule over his subjects, and Han Li desired that Han Yongmu could shepherd gods, saints, and immortals in the future.
“Han Yongmu?” Murong Ying was slightly disappointed.
Once Han Li explained the reasoning, Murong Ying’s face lit up with a smile again. Since her husband had put it that way, it indeed carried his great expectations for their son.
Looking at the infant in her arms, Murong Ying softly asked, “Husband, what is our child’s constitution?”
Han Li gestured for the maids to leave before smiling and saying, “Divine Emperor’s Body.”
Divine Emperor’s Body!
Murong Ying’s pupils contracted with surprise coloring her lovely features; her descendant had been born with such a formidable Emperor’s Body. No wonder her husband had named the child Han Yongmu.
Murong Ying also understood why Han Yongmu had such a constitution; it likely had something to do with Empress Yuanchu herself.
Empress Yuanchu possessed Immortal Grade talent and an Immortal Body, and as her soul fragment, Murong Ying inherently carried some of Empress Yuanchu’s own essence. It was not surprising that she could give birth to an Emperor’s Body.
The Divine Emperor’s Body held great prestige in the ancient and even Primordial Ages, producing several unparalleled Great Emperors, and there was even one peerless being who became immortal with the Divine Emperor’s Body.
Every bearer of the Divine Emperor’s Body, once grown up, had the might to sweep all enemies, suppress the nine heavens and ten lands, plow through the thirty-three heavens, and be virtually invincible in their era.
The Divine Emperor’s Body possesses many innate divine skills such as “Sovereign’s Arrival over Nine Heavens,” “Divine Emperor’s Rebirth,” “Primordial Tribulation Light,” and so on; each one extremely powerful.
Most beings with the Divine Emperor’s Body originated from Yuanchu Province, hence it was also called the Primordial Divine Body.
Murong Ying felt thrilled that her child had the Divine Emperor’s Body. She knew that Chengsheng Mountain was not the only place with an Empress’ soul fragment; Yao Xi was Empress Huang Yue’s soul fragment, and Empress Huang Yue was an adversary to Empress Yuanchu.
As wives of the same husband, they obviously couldn’t compete openly, but comparisons were inevitable; Yao Xi’s first child possessed Supreme Bone, while her first child had the Divine Emperor’s Body.
The Divine Emperor’s Body was no less remarkable than the Supreme Bone, and she was not inferior to Yao Xi.
Seeing Murong Ying’s expression, Han Li easily guessed what she was thinking, but he didn’t point it out.
Han Li spent some time in Murong Ying’s chamber, then took his leave, reappearing at the peak of Chengdao Peak.
After marveling at the splendid scenery, Han Li took a deep breath of Spiritual Energy, then opened the message panel, and two system notifications jumped to his sight.
“Ding~ Congratulations, Master, on gaining a descendant with first-grade talent. You receive a talent feedback, increasing your talent by one-tenth.”
“Ding~ Since Master’s descendant possesses a special constitution [Divine Emperor’s Body], Master receives a physique feedback, earning you 100 Physique Points.”
Seeing these two system notifications, Han Li’s face immediately beamed with a radiant smile.
A descendant with first-grade talent and an Emperor’s Body indeed brought him great benefits.
After the one-tenth talent increase, Han Li’s talent reached around 40%, and his Physique Points accumulated to 210.
With another 390 Physique Points, he could mold an exclusive King’s Body that perfectly fits his physical body, Primordial Spirit, Cultivation Technique, martial path, and so on, greatly enhancing his Combat Ability.
“It looks like it’s time to schedule for Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang to conceive another child,” Han Li muttered to himself.
After three purifications through the Life-Prolonging Furnace, Lu Tianxiang not only upgraded her talent to first-grade but also acquired a special constitution, a King’s Body level Tianxiang Physique, which could be called the Tianxiang King’s Body.
This special constitution was somewhat similar to an exclusive constitution, but it still fell short; it perfectly suited Lu Tianxiang’s martial path, and the overall compatibility was very high.
Lu Tianxiang was his first wife with a constitution; other wives with special status or cultivation such as Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang, Yao Xi, and Murong Ying had not acquired one yet.
Before marrying other wives with constitutions, or before his other beloved wives bore children with special constitutions, he would have to rely on Lu Tianxiang to share the burden.
Yao Xi was also ready to have a second child. Even if it wasn’t an Emperor’s Body, a King’s Body would be good too.
As for Murong Ying, she should rest more; they could discuss it again in half a year.

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - 216: An unexpected change? The birth of the Divine Emperor’s Body! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City! Long Yue advances to the Martial Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 480: Chapter 216: An unexpected change? The birth of the Divine Emperor’s Body! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City! Long Yue advances to the Martial Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm_4
……..
Xuan Domain, Qingxuan Mountain.
This place was the obligatory path from Emperor Wu’s City to the Daqian Empire.
Stretching over hundreds of thousands of miles, the main peak of Qingxuan Mountain rose a hundred thousand feet high. It originally lay at the junction of four major powers: Emperor Wu’s City, Kurong Sect, Daqian Empire, and the Da Jing Empire.
However, after the weakening of the Daqian Empire, the Outer Twelve States were annexed, and now Qingxuan Mountain bordered only three powers: Emperor Wu’s City, Kurong Sect, and the Da Jing Empire.
To pass through Qingxuan Mountain and enter the Daqian Empire, one had to traverse the territories of either Kurong Sect or the Da Jing Empire.
At this moment, on a subsidiary peak of Qingxuan Mountain half way up the mountain, stood a group of more than a dozen figures, all exuding powerful auras – thirteen men and five women in total.
These eighteen individuals were all coming from Emperor Wu’s City, wishing to go to the Daqian Empire, or to be precise, to Chengsheng Mountain of the Daqian Empire.
The five female cultivators all wore veils, their figures graceful, and their demeanor gentle. Even though their faces were not visible, it was clear they were beauties of stunning appearance.
The leading beauty among them looked toward the direction of the Daqian Empire and said softly, “Ladies and gentlemen, have you made your decision? Which path shall we take?”
Among the five peerless beauties, three possessed Fourth Grade talent with cultivation levels ranging between the Gangyuan Realm and the God Refining Realm; two were of Third Grade talent, one a Guru in the Void Realm, and the other an early-stage Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
The leader among the peerless beauties was the Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Ever since the lord of Emperor Wu’s City fell into the hands of Elder Bai Yujing and his life or death remained unknown, the upper echelons of the city had been strategizing their next move, planning to seek support from the ancestor of the Han Mansion, Han Li.
Following the announcement that Han Li would be taking a wife and concubines in the Xuan Domain, the higher-ups of Emperor Wu’s City made a swift decision, selecting the five best candidates from those previously chosen, and dispatched strong protectors to escort them to Chengsheng Mountain in the Daqian Empire.
The five peerless female cultivators all belonged to the direct lineage of Emperor Wu’s City. With the city facing the danger of obliteration and possible destruction at any moment, they stepped forward, prepared to sacrifice everything for righteousness.
Their families, their friends, their masters, and so on, were all in Emperor Wu’s City. Without the protection of a powerful figure, should the city fall, everything they cared about would be destroyed as well.
Without a nest, there can be no eggs!
Thus, after the upper echelons of Emperor Wu’s City offered numerous generous conditions, they all agreed, including the Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
To be the wife or concubine of the Ancestor of the Han Mansion wasn’t shameful!
Han Li was a War King of the True Martial Realm, an Elder of Bai Yujing, a reincarnated powerful being with boundless prospects; in the future, at the very least, he was destined to become an Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Once they became Han Li’s wives or concubines, not only could they protect Emperor Wu’s City and bring blessings to their families and friends, they themselves would also reap tremendous benefits, possibly cultivating up to the Hollow Void Stage or the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
For example, the leading beauty wanted to use Han Li’s resources to cultivate up to the status of a War King of the True Martial Realm, which is why she was willing to make the arduous journey of tens of millions of miles to Chengsheng Mountain.
However, they now faced a dilemma; there were two paths ahead. One led through the Da Jing Empire into the Daqian Empire, and the other through Kurong Sect into the Daqian Empire. They had to make a choice.
Taking the Da Jing Empire’s path would take more time but was safer. The Da Jing Empire wouldn’t dare to act against them after learning of their intentions; taking the Kurong Sect’s path would save time, less than half of the former, but was more dangerous.
The Kurong Sect was backed by Xumi Mountain, and traditionally, the Buddhist Sect and Dao Sect did not get along. Kurong Sect wouldn’t care about Han Li’s face and might take action against them.
After all, if not for Han Li’s sabotage, the Daqian Empire would have been destroyed, granting Kurong Sect a chance to take over more territory.
Even if Kurong Sect chose not to act against them, other forces might. Inside Emperor Wu’s City’s domain, there were numerous Myriad Phenomena Realm forces with ambitions of independence or the desire to find a strong backer.
These forces also entertained the idea of presenting females to Han Li in the hope of gaining his support, either to lead or replace Emperor Wu’s City, but their offerings could never be as rich as those of Emperor Wu’s City.
Though they lacked rich offerings, Emperor Wu’s City had them, and if they could intercept Emperor Wu’s City’s marriage procession and successfully take the women, they could then send them over to Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
Would that not bring upon them calamities?
In fact, these forces were not worried. Their own forces would also be presenting brides to Chengsheng Mountain, becoming kinship forces related to the Han Mansion. Even if the beautiful women from Emperor Wu’s City they seized spoke ill of them, it wouldn’t matter.
After all, these beauties would be sent by them, making them related to the Han Mansion through marriage, and thereby able to obtain even more benefits.
Among the thirteen male cultivators, four were Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, while the remaining nine were Gurus in the Hollow Void Realm, also capable of forming a Formation that could match one or two Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Along with the female Great Grandmaster, this bridal procession boasted the combat ability of at least six Great Grandmasters – an incredibly powerful force.
The Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm in Emperor Wu’s City were not limited to these; there were about thirty in total. Some were stationed in Emperor Wu’s City, while others went to intercept other Myriad Phenomena Realm forces.
The strongest among the four Great Grandmasters was a square-faced middle-aged man named Fang Yun, dressed in green, possessing peak strength of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, his power and status ranking within the top five of Emperor Wu’s City.
Hearing Zhao Wanling’s question, Fang Yun pondered and said, “Take the path through Kurong Sect into the Daqian Empire.”
Zhao Wanling’s delicate brows furrowed slightly, and she said displeasedly, “That’s very dangerous.”
“We don’t have that much time left. Do you all want to just watch as Emperor Wu’s City is destroyed?” Fang Yun said coldly.
The fall of Emperor Wu’s City might not extend to them, but their families, friends, disciples, and entire networks within Emperor Wu’s City would all vanish into nothing.

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - 216: An unexpected change? The birth of the Divine Emperor’s Body! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City! Long Yue advances to the Martial Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 481: Chapter 216: An unexpected change? The birth of the Divine Emperor’s Body! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City! Long Yue advances to the Martial Emperor at the Divine Yuan Realm_5
In Emperor Wu’s City, they possessed overwhelming power. However, if they accepted the protection of Chengsheng Mountain and joined Han Mansion, they would be under someone else’s roof, and their power and status would be incomparable to before.
Zhao Wanling looked back at the other four exceptionally beautiful female cultivators, communicated with them through transmitted thoughts for a while, and then turned back and said,
“We can do that, but we have to be careful. We absolutely can’t afford any mistakes on this last stretch.”
“Don’t worry, if there’s any mistake, and you are fine, we will be the ones in trouble,” Fang Yun sighed.
After Fang Yun, Zhao Wanling, and the others had discussed and started to move, they hadn’t flown for long before they all stopped again, looking troubled.
In front of them, dozens of figures were already standing, with the eight in the front all being Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. Some were originally under Emperor Wu’s City, while others seemed to belong to the Kurong Sect.
The two sides had a heated exchange of words and then came to blows. The team from Emperor Wu’s City was clearly no match and quickly fell into a disadvantage.
Meanwhile, on the main peak of Qingxuan Mountain, there were also figures watching the battle. Among them, there were actually two Great Grandmasters from the Myriad Phenomena Realm, several Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage, and many cultivators from the God Refining Realm as well as other realms.
“Boss, should we really lend a hand?”
The Second Master spoke with a deep voice. He was a Great Grandmaster at the early stage of Myriad Phenomena Realm who had just broken through a few years ago and was somewhat concerned.
“This is a great opportunity. If we assist the men and horses of Emperor Wu’s City to successfully reach Chengsheng Mountain, we could also seize the opportunity to submit to Chengsheng Mountain and serve the patriarch of Han Mansion.”
“The patriarch of Han Mansion is a strong reincarnated soul and also Elder Bai Yujing. Joining Han Mansion is a great opportunity for us. With this merit, we can gain more attention.”
“Don’t you want to cultivate to the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm and get a glimpse of the True Martial Realm? Don’t our brothers want to break through to the Hollow Void Stage or ascend to the Myriad Phenomena Realm?”
The Boss looked around at the cultivators, speaking enthusiastically, his eyes filled with anticipation.
He had been stuck at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm for a long time but had never been able to break through to the True Martial Realm. Even if he joined other powers in the True Martial Realm or Divine Yuan Realm, it would be difficult to get noticed. He was not from a direct lineage and it was even harder to make use of resources for advancement.
But it was different with Han Mansion of Chengsheng Mountain. To his knowledge, there were no protectors at the Myriad Phenomena Realm serving as Guest Elders for Han Mansion. If he was the first to join, he’d more likely receive importance, especially if there was a welcome gift.
The patriarch of Han Mansion was a reincarnated strong soul who, in his previous life, was a powerhouse of the Tongxuan Realm and even possibly a saint of the Heavenly Abyss Stage. Helping him, at the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, to break through to the True Martial Realm was very likely.
The Second Master and the other cultivators looked at each other and were persuaded. It was indeed a great opportunity. As long as they took action, the odds of the wedding party from Emperor Wu’s City breaking through were very high.
“Fortune favors the bold, let’s do it!”
The Second Master and the others said excitedly.
Immediately after, the Boss and Second Master took out their weapons, carefully concealed their aura, left the formation, and crept towards the battlefield.
……..
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, standing tall at the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Next to him, Long Yue was wearing a light-colored dress, her body astonishingly radiating the aura of the True Martial Realm peak.
“Yue’er, are you ready?” Han Li said with a smile.
“I’m ready,” Long Yue replied with a smile on her perfect and flawless face.
In just a few short years since her marriage to Chengsheng Mountain, her cultivation had already reached the peak of the True Martial Realm, and she was on the verge of ascending to the Divine Yuan Realm.
If it weren’t for her desire to take a surer approach and nurture a higher-quality Martial Primordial Spirit, she could have broken through to the Divine Yuan Realm over a year ago.
Now, she was almost ready. Her King Grade Martial True Pill had been refined to the point of perfect harmony. When she broke through to the Divine Yuan Realm, she would at least have a King Grade Martial Primordial Spirit, and there was a 20-30% chance of developing an Emperor Grade Martial Primordial Spirit.
If she was willing to use the Dragon Ball from her past life’s Dao fruits, nurturing an Emperor Grade Martial Primordial Spirit wouldn’t be difficult. In the past, she would have done so, but not anymore.
Doing so would deplete her potential. The ideal opportunity would be to wait until she broke through to the Heavenly Abyss Stage and then absorb and refine it, combining the Dao fruits of both lives to carve out a higher grade Heavenly Abyss.
Now that she was Han Li’s wife, protected by her husband and given many precious resources, she had a great chance of nurturing an Emperor Grade Martial Primordial Spirit without using the Dragon Ball.
For instance, the Yuanshen Pill given by her husband.
The Yuanshen Pill could increase the likelihood of a True Martial Realm peak cultivator breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm by 50% and raise the Martial Primordial Spirit by one to three grades.
With a very high probability of nurturing a King Grade Martial Primordial Spirit on her own, the Yuanshen Pill would also greatly increase her chances of developing an Emperor Grade Martial Primordial Spirit.
“Then let’s start,”
Han Li enveloped her in his arms, gently kissed her stunningly beautiful lips, and said softly.
“Mm~”
Long Yue responded softly.
With a mere thought from Han Li, the area was sealed off, impervious to any external disturbance.
Long Yue immediately began her breakthrough; her Martial True Pill flew out, infused with Martial Dao true intent, as a powerful ceaseless stream of True Yuan poured in.
Her journey to breakthrough progressed incredibly smoothly, just as they both had expected.
Long Yue herself nurtured a King Grade Martial Primordial Spirit, which towered tens of thousands of feet behind her. Then, after taking the Yuanshen Pill and assimilating it,
With the assistance of the Yuanshen Pill, the height of Long Yue’s Martial Primordial Spirit surged, quickly breaking through the hundred-thousand-feet mark to attain the status of an Emperor Grade Martial Primordial Spirit.
Ultimately, Long Yue nurtured a Martial Primordial Spirit standing three hundred thousand feet tall. She was extremely satisfied as her aura surged. She had officially stepped into the Divine Yuan Realm.
At that moment, she became the third Female Martial Emperor among Han Li’s wives.

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - 217: Lunar God Battle Armor! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City arrives; the old ancestor is taking yet another wife and concubine!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 482: Chapter 217: Lunar God Battle Armor! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City arrives; the old ancestor is taking yet another wife and concubine!_1
“My lord~”
Long Yue’s delicate voice called out, her steps as light as a lotus moving, her body radiating brilliance, her grace captivating, and her charm radiating in all directions.
“Xiang Xiang, has your cultivation improved so much that you wish to discuss the profound ways with your husband earnestly?”
Han Li embraced her in his arms, feeling the warmth and tenderness of the beauty in his embrace. He smiled and said.
“That’s right.”
Long Yue responded frankly, her face full of fighting spirit, like a goddess of war about to step onto the battlefield.
Times had changed. Now Long Yue was very different from when Han Li had first captured her. She was quite frank about such things and looked forward to them.
Even though she was the reincarnation of a Dragon Saint, she couldn’t benefit much from it. On the one hand, her cultivation level was not high, and once satiated, she could last a long time. On the other, it was because her lord had too many delicate wives and beautiful concubines.
Now that she had broken through to the Divine Yuan Realm and become a Female Martial Emperor, it was the perfect time to test her combat strength at this realm.
“Then let us, husband and wife, delve deeply into discussing the profound ways,” Han Li said with a smile on his face.
Who wouldn’t love a beauty who takes the initiative?
“My lord, please enlighten me,” Long Yue took a deep breath and said, already imagining the tempest that was to come.
……
Two hours later, Han Li and Long Yue reappeared at the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Han Li looked refreshed and spirited, whereas Long Yue was a bit gimpy, no longer as aglow with fighting spirit as before, but her flawless face was flushed with redness.
“My lord, I’ll go down first,”
After saying this, Long Yue did not wait for Han Li to reply before her figure disappeared.
Han Li’s divine sense expanded, covering all of Chengsheng Mountain, observing the situation of the entire mountain with a gradual smile of satisfaction on his face.
The Han Mansion was thriving, growing stronger by the day, and becoming deeper in its foundation.
This was not only because of the rapid progress and breakout of his delicate wives and concubines and his offsprings’ cultivation levels but also due to other aspects.
For example, the number of protectors and Guest Elders was increasing every day, with many cultivators coming to join the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain daily. Among them were not a few Fourth Grade Alchemists and Artifact Refiners, as well as two to three Great Grandmasters from the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
The purpose of these people joining Chengsheng Mountain was simple: they worked for the Han Mansion, gained returns from it, improved their cultivation, or broke through to a Big Realm, or they wanted to learn higher-level Cultivation Techniques, Pill Formulas, Refining Blueprints, and so on.
As long as they had the strength and capability, Han Li welcomed all comers.
They were also not afraid of harboring ill intentions, for any bad thoughts on Chengsheng Mountain were useless; they had to contribute sincerely to the Han Mansion or face instant extermination if they dared to be reckless.
Sure enough, these new protectors and Guest Elders who had joined the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain were shocked, intimidated, and deeply impressed upon witnessing its terrifying foundation.
They realized right away that the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain was the mysterious force causing trouble in Qianyuan Divine Province, one that even the Great Holy Land Schools had to headache over.
These cultivators not only weren’t frightened, but they were also overjoyed, extremely excited, and this was just what they wanted.
The stronger the foundation of the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, the more benefits they could reap, and the higher realms they could break through to.
After retracting his divine sense, Han Li took out a scripture and began to contemplate it.
This was a Cultivation Technique given by Bai Yujing after he had become his disciple, found inside the Space Ring that Lu Zhen had given him.
It must be said, Bai Yujing was quite generous in this respect; the grade of this Cultivation Technique was not low, being a mid-grade Divine Rank Cultivation Technique at the peak of the Tongxuan Realm.
Bai Yujing was uncertain whether Han Li was a reincarnation of a great being of the Tongxuan Realm or a Saint from the Saintly Abyss Realm. They also knew that Han Li had his own primary Cultivation Technique, but still, they gifted him with a top-notch Tongxuan Realm Technique.
Tongxuan Realm Techniques were extremely rare in the outside world, but for Bai Yujing, they were nothing special. They possessed countless Tongxuan Realm-level Techniques, along with a great number of Saintly Abyss Realm-level Techniques. Only Emperor Level and Quasi Emperor Level Techniques were highly valued by them.
Immortal Scriptures, however, were their closely guarded secrets, only available for the Monarch of Bai Yujing of each generation to cultivate.
Days passed in the blink of an eye.
On this day, Han Li was imparting the Dao to Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi were Han Li’s second and third wives, who at that time had only reached the God Refining Realm. Now they had cultivated to the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, ready to advance to the True Martial Realm.
During this time, they concentrated on studying the Cultivation Technique given by Bai Yujing but found it quite abstruse and difficult. So, they turned to Han Li for guidance.
As their venerable elder, Han Li was naturally obliged to instruct patiently. He explained the deep and complex Technique in a simple and easy-to-understand manner.
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi occasionally showed thrilled expressions, singing praises for their lord Han Li when they gained insights into the mystical aspects of the Technique, rewarding him for diligently and tirelessly imparting the Dao.
While imparting the Dao, Han Li also took the time to open treasure chests.
He had waited patiently for half a month and with the arrival of a new month, the count for opening treasure chests had reset, allowing him to open one again at the cost of five years of cultivation.
Han Li eagerly wished for an Immortal-grade weapon, but he didn’t want to gamble on opening treasure chests. He had vowed never to resort to such a gamble.
Mainly because he did not have much accumulated cultivation. After his last breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm, he had almost depleted it all, and up to now, he had only about four hundred years of cultivation, which included the leftover two hundred plus years from cultivation feedback.
With such a small amount of cultivation, even if Han Li wanted to gamble, he could not afford it. Opening the second treasure chest each month cost fifty years of cultivation, while opening the third one required five hundred years of cultivation.
Even though Han Li longed for a windfall, getting an Immortal-grade weapon on his second try, Elder Han was not willing to take the gamble.

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - 217: Lunar God Battle Armor! The bridal procession from Emperor Wu’s City arrives, the Patriarch marries and takes another concubine again!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 483: Chapter 217: Lunar God Battle Armor! The bridal procession from Emperor Wu’s City arrives, the Patriarch marries and takes another concubine again!_2
When Han Li’s thought moved, the treasure chest’s panel immediately burst into brilliant light, with streaks of golden radiance flashing before his eyes.
“Ding~ Treasure chest opened successfully, congratulations to the master for obtaining 10 pieces of Divine Rank Top Grade treasures [Lunar God Battle Armor]!”
Looking at the ten pieces of battle armor floating above the treasure chest, each with a different design but all equally magnificent, Han Li secretly sighed.
He had been so diligent in spreading his teachings, yet he couldn’t catch a break with luck; could it be that Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi were simply not destined for great fortune?
The more Han Li thought about it, the more he felt this was the case; it certainly wasn’t because he was unlucky.
To be honest, the items that came out of the treasure chest this time weren’t very valuable.
Now when he opened treasure chests, the lowest rank of treasures he could expect were of the Divine Rank Low Grade, while the highest could even be of the Immortal Rank; the Lunar God Battle Armor was merely of the Divine Rank Top Grade.
Divine Rank Top Grade, that is, typically the treasures suitable for the Holy Abyss Realm, 10 pieces of which were roughly equivalent to the value of two or three pieces of Divine Rank Supreme Grade treasures, about the same as half an Emperor Rank Low Grade treasure.
However, battle armor type treasures are always more valuable, so 10 pieces of Divine Rank Top Grade battle armor could be considered equivalent to an Emperor Rank Low Grade treasure.
“Consider it a cushion for the next time I open a treasure chest that yields divine weapons,” Han Li muttered to himself.
Last month, his fortune might have temporarily run out after opening a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon Emperor Flag, otherwise his luck wouldn’t be so terrible; he did stack buffs after all.
“Jiang Jiang, Yun Yun, I have a gift for you two,” he said.
After completing his teachings for Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, Han Li took out two pieces of Lunar God Battle Armor for the two women, these were specially selected by Han Li to suit the temperament of Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi.
A gift?
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi were stunned upon hearing this, and when they saw the two magnificent Lunar God Battle Armors appear out of thin air, they immediately showed surprise and delight on their exquisite faces.
“Husband, are these for us?” they asked.
“Husband, is it just the two of us who have them?” they inquired almost simultaneously, both looking at their husband Han Li with anticipation.
Han Li replied without hesitation, “Of course, they are for you.”
After a pause, Han Li added, “These are battle armors of Holy Abyss Realm grade, and there are only ten of them. Wearing them will provide good protection for your bodies.”
Wearing a Sacred Soldier grade battle armor in the Qianyuan Divine Province basically meant encountering no danger at all, and in critical moments, one could even stimulate the battle armor to revive and unleash powerful capabilities.
Hearing that these were battle armors of Holy Abyss Realm grade, Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi were both shocked, unable to hide the excitement on their faces.
Though these battle armors weren’t unique to them, there were only ten, and Han Li’s wives and concubines numbered in the hundreds. Han Li giving it to them undoubtedly showed he valued them more.
“Thank you, husband~”
Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi cheerfully caught the two pieces of battle armor and after a brief refinement, they wore them on the spot, displaying their perfect figures for Han Li to admire.
Seeing his two beautiful wives in the Lunar God Battle Armors, Han Li’s eyes lit up. Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi became even more enchanting with their gorgeous attire, exuding grace and peerless elegance.
Jiang Baiye’s battle armor was moon-white in color, while Yun Miaoyi’s was purple-red. Witnessing this stirred Han Li’s appetite, prompting him to act on a wicked thought that arose within him.
The following day, Han Li gave away the remaining eight pieces of Lunar God Battle Armor.
One went to Gongsun Yue, one to Lu Tianxiang, and others like Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Ling Lingshuang, and Xue Yueqing also received one.
For those who did not receive a piece of Lunar God Battle Armor, Han Li compensated them in other ways and promised that the next time he acquired such battle armors, they would be the first to receive them.
On the day after Han Li finished with these arrangements, he received some good news.
The first batch of bridal parties from Xuan Domain has arrived!
Some time had passed since Han Li announced his intention to take wives and concubines within the confines of the Xuan Domain, and he had been collecting information, learning that many forces were willing to offer their daughters to him, including True Martial Realm powers, and others who were disdainful or observing.
Han Li stood atop Chengdao Peak, watching as a procession flew in from the horizon, arriving from Emperor Wu’s City and Qingxuan Mountain.
The bridal party from Emperor Wu’s City had encountered an ambush, and the situation became perilous almost to the point of scattering the procession. The faces of the attackers revealed triumphant smiles.
But then, a hidden force from Qingxuan Mountain took the initiative. The First Master and Second Master, along with the elite of their stronghold, suddenly struck out, launching a pincer attack that thundered with might, catching the attackers off guard.
Emperor Wu’s City and Qingxuan Mountain took advantage of the situation and killed two Great Grandmasters in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, injuring three others. The attacking force scattered, no longer daring to continue the battle.
Fang Yun, Zhao Wanling, the First Master, and others did not pursue their advantage, instead, they quickly reorganized the procession and swiftly fled.
This time, they chose to take a detour through the Da Jing Empire and then enter the Daqian Empire, preferring a longer but safer route.
If they had continued on the path through the Kurong Sect territory, the risks would have been great. Although the Kurong Sect did not make a move, some Myriad Phenomena Realm powers under its command did interfere.
After detouring through the Da Jing Empire, unsurprisingly, they encountered no more dangers. The combined strength of both parties increased significantly, safely entering the territory of the Daqian Empire and arriving at Chengsheng Mountain.
When they flew to the foot of Chengsheng Mountain, they immediately waited respectfully. A few people from within Chengsheng Mountain walked out from the Mountain Protection Array, leading them inside.
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, his white robe fluttering, silently observing everything.
“Two of Third Grade aptitude, one Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, one Guru in the Void Realm, and three of Fourth Grade aptitude, tsk tsk, Emperor Wu’s City is truly generous.”

chapters.title: Chapter 484: 217: Lunar God Battle Armor! The bridal procession from Emperor Wu's City has arrived, and the old ancestor takes yet another wife and concubine!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 484: Chapter 217: Lunar God Battle Armor! The bridal procession from Emperor Wu’s City has arrived, and the old ancestor takes yet another wife and concubine!_3
Han Li murmured to himself in a soft voice, his face showing satisfaction.
He was, of course, clear about the purpose behind Emperor Wu’s City’s actions. Now, with Emperor Wu’s City on the brink of disaster and without the city lord to maintain order, there were many top-tier forces covying Emperor Wu’s City’s territory, including those from the Myriad Phenomena Realm within its borders who were watching or harboring ulterior motives.
It was a pity for that city lord of Emperor Wu’s City, who was actually a Peak Quasi-Emperor in his previous life. Just unlucky, he dabbled in crooked practices to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm and ran afoul of Empress Yuanchu, who slapped him to death.
After reincarnating, it took great effort for the city lord of Emperor Wu’s City to cultivate to the later stages of the Tongxuan Realm. He planned for hundreds of years to unseal Dangyang Mountain and obtain Chen Xilai’s physical body, but alas, man proposes and heaven disposes; the city lord failed.
Even if he did not lift a finger, not delivering a slap to the city lord of Emperor Wu’s City, the city lord would still not be able to escape. The Sacred Land Masters were watching, and for the city lord to attempt snatching victory from the jaws of a tiger without the support of a strong foundation was tantamount to seeking death.
Emperor Wu’s City faced a crisis of annihilation, but the higher-ups of the city were tactful, offering him five beautiful wives and concubines as a gesture, which Han Li naturally accepted.
“Fate plays tricks on people,” he said.
Gazing upon the five stunning beauties, Han Li’s expression was filled with emotion.
In the past, to marry a wife of Fourth Grade aptitude, he had exerted much effort and had captured Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, always fearful of discovery and ensuing trouble.
Now, without lifting a finger, merely hinting his desire was enough for other forces to bring him groups of stunning female cultivators with aptitude of the Fourth Grade or even Third Grade.
Power and status are truly intoxicating!
After his moment of reflection, Han Li vanished from the summit of Chengdao Peak and arrived at Yundao Peak, where he took his seat at the main hall, waiting for the delegation from Emperor Wu’s City to present themselves.
It wasn’t long before Han Yongjin, Han Yongfan, and others led the marriage procession into Yundao Hall to meet with the patriarch of Han Mansion.
The number of people was not large; most waited outside the hall. Besides the four Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm from Emperor Wu’s City and two Grandmasters from Qingxuan Mountain, the five stunning beauties also entered.
“We pay our respects to Patriarch Han,” they said.
Fang Yun, Second Master Yun Bufan, and other figures of the Myriad Phenomena Realm bowed deeply, their heads lowered, not daring to look directly at Han Li.
Zhao Wanling, Zhuo Yanran, and the other beauties also lowered their heads, not even revealing the tips of their toes, while occasionally stealing glances at the handsome Han Mansion male sitting at the head of the hall.
Indeed, he was a strikingly handsome man with an aura as exquisite as jade!
Han Li too was observing everyone in the hall, his gaze mainly on Zhao Wanling, Zhuo Yanran, and the other beauties. Although they wore light veils over their faces, they could not block Patriarch Han’s Divine Sense.
The elegance and poise of Zhao Wanling, Zhuo Yanran, and the rest could not be obscured by clothing. Their curvaceous figures, each with a unique demeanor, were like orchids in spring and chrysanthemums in autumn, each with their own charm.
“You’ve done well, and this patriarch is very pleased,” said Han Li.
Fang Yun, Yun Bufan, and others showed joy, for Patriarch Han had accepted their goodwill.
Han Li casually conversed with these Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, making them beam with pride and excitement.
Seeing that Patriarch Han had no further interest in continuing the conversation, Yun Bufan immediately spoke on behalf of Qingxuan Mountain, pledging loyalty with respect, “The men of Qingxuan Mountain have long admired the patriarch’s esteemed name. If the patriarch is willing, we wish….”
Listening to Yun Bufan’s endless flow of loyalty and flattering words, Han Li found it very satisfying and agreed, allowing them to join Han Mansion.
As they had established considerable merit, Han Li generously rewarded them with plenty of resources and benefits.
Upon receiving the response they hoped for, the faces of the lead figures of Qingxuan Mountain, including the First and Second Masters, showed an excitement they could not hide, and they immediately bowed deeply in gratitude.
Han Li waved his hand, indicating they should stand aside, and then turned to Fang Yun, Zhao Wanling, Zhuo Yanran, and the rest, speaking thoughtfully,
“I will release a message stating that Emperor Wu’s City is now under this patriarch’s protection, and you may keep only one-fourth of your territory.”
“Thank you, patriarch,” they responded immediately in gratitude.
Fang Yun and the others bowed in thanks, and smiles appeared on the faces of Zhao Wanling, Zhuo Yanran, and the other women. One of their reasons for marrying into Chengsheng Mountain was to help protect the families and friends of Emperor Wu’s City.
With Han Li’s promise, Fang Yun, a high-ranking official of Emperor Wu’s City, was ecstatic; this trip was well worth it.
With a word from Patriarch Han of Han Mansion, Emperor Wu’s City no longer faced the threat of destruction. Although they could only retain one-fourth of the territory, it was still a significant portion.
Even just one-fourth of Emperor Wu’s City’s territory was larger than that of the current Daqian Empire, allowing its high-ranking officials to retain considerable power and prestige.
Other major forces in Xuan Domain would not deliberately trouble Emperor Wu’s City. By yielding most of its territory, Emperor Wu’s City provided enough to satisfy their appetites. If they still were greedy, it would be an insult to Patriarch Han, and Han Li would intervene to settle the matter.
Now, no one wanted to offend Han Li, the Elder of Bai Yujing, a reincarnated mighty figure with limitless prospects, as it would bring calamity upon their own forces.
After spending some time in Yundao Hall, Han Li returned to Chengdao Peak.
The date to welcome the five stunning beauties of Emperor Wu’s City as brides was set for seven days later, an auspicious day.
Once the date was set, the entire Han Mansion sprung into action, preparing for the patriarch’s upcoming marriage and concubinage.
Back at Chengdao Peak, Han Li also called together Lu Tianxiang, Long Yue, Ling Lingshuang, Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, and other beloved wives and concubines to share the news with them.
Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Xue Yueqing, Liu Yuexin, Chu Yutong, and the rest of the wives and concubines expressed no objections, as they had already been informed and were prepared for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - 217: Lunar God Battle Armor! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City arrives, the old ancestor marries and takes another concubine again!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 485: Chapter 217: Lunar God Battle Armor! The wedding procession from Emperor Wu’s City arrives, the old ancestor marries and takes another concubine again!_4
They knew that their husband had already exercised great restraint, for the husband was a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, and Han Mansion possessed a vast foundation, inferior to the Great Holy Land Schools by only one divine weapon.
Should the husband decide to marry and take concubines freely, then all the high-quality beauties among the female cultivators in Qianyuan Divine Province would be targets, and who knows how many stunning women would willingly throw themselves at him.
After all, the husband gave too much!
Seven days later,
Chengsheng Mountain hosted a grand wedding ceremony.
This marriage ceremony was unparalleled in the past, with immense grandeur, causing a huge sensation.
On one hand, Han Li was marrying two wives and taking three beauties as concubines at the same time, all five ravishing ladies hailing from another top force in the Xuan Domain, Emperor Wu’s City, which, despite its overnight decline, still retained its reputation.
On the other hand, Han Li’s cultivation had significantly surpassed that of the past.
Previously, he had only revealed cultivation at the God Refining Realm, overlooked by all forces outside Yonchang Manor, as he was but a true person of the God Refining Realm.
Now, Han Li was a mid-stage True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, also an Elder of Bai Yujing, a reborn powerhouse, the future Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperor, a Tongxuan Realm great power.
The first time Elder Han of Han Mansion displayed his power and took wives and concubines, truly a host of applicants gathered, with countless powers coming to pay homage.
The Daqian Court, various forces within the Daqian Empire, the Da Liang Empire, Da Jing Empire, Emperor Wu’s City, Ancient Empire, Qitian Teaching, and other respectable forces within the territories of the five great powers.
Even the Kurong Sect, Yinyang Sect, and Fengbo Pavilion—three top forces with direct or indirect grievances with Han Li—showed their respect by coming to the event and presenting precious congratulatory gifts.
The first Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province, Bai Yujing, also sent a congratulatory gift to this newly appointed Elder Han Li.
This was Han Li’s first marriage and concubine-taking ceremony since joining Bai Yujing, and Bai Yujing still showed respect; as for the future, there would be none, since even Bai Yujing knew too well how quickly Han Li took wives and concubines.
Now, facing the entire Xuan Domain to marry and take concubines, who knew how many stunning women he would wed; just sending congratulatory gifts would be quite painful for them—the first Sacred Land could not afford to be too stingy.
On this day, Chengsheng Mountain was packed with people, gathering a large number of Hollow Void Stage Gurus, Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters, and some True Martial Realm Emperor Wus.
Before this, Han Li had already instructed the Emperor Flag, Time-Sky Tower, and Void Bell to conceal the wondrous sights of Chengsheng Mountain, and had also forbidden all of Han Mansion from leaking any information.
Atop Yundao Peak, Han Li stood surrounded by Zhao Wanling, Zhuo Yanran, and the other five brides, wearing a full-faced smile. On one hand, he was marrying five stunning women; on the other hand, it was about the congratulatory gifts from various powers.
These waves of gifts were truly exceedingly generous, what Han Li received in his past two personas when marrying and taking concubines was not even one percent, or even one thousandth of what he received this time.
With these gifts, Han Mansion’s foundation could be replenished substantially, making up for the missing parts of Han Mansion.
Han Li knew that the reason why the gifts were so rich this time was mainly because it was his first marriage and concubine-taking since revealing his cultivation, and various powers really respected him for sending precious gifts.
In the future, when he continues to marry and take concubines, many powers will no longer participate, and even if they do, the gifts they send will not be as precious as this time.
“It’s such a pity,”
Han Li sighed. His dream of getting rich through this method had burst.
After the wedding had ended, Zhao Wanling, Zhuo Yanran, and the other brides were sent to the bridal chamber, but Elder Han did not rush into the bridal chamber this time.
He stayed behind to converse with envoys from Bai Yujing and with several True Martial Realm Emperor Wus from the Xuan Domain. After seeing these people off, Han Li entered the bridal chamber leisurely.
Here’s a poem to prove:
A square pond half an acre wide, unveiled as a mirror’s expanse; Heaven’s light and cloud shadows wander together.
When asked how it could remain so clear, it’s because there is a source of living water coming in.
—Southern Song Dynasty · Zhu Xi.
In the following days, Master Han was extremely busy, diligently and painstakingly imparting teachings and transferring essence to the brides every day, relentlessly tilling, all to ensure they wouldn’t be lonely in Han Mansion.
PS: I was delayed by some matters today, and there’s a part of the plot I didn’t write. I’ll make it up tomorrow.
