chapters.title: Chapter 486: 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 486: Chapter 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_1
The venerable ancestor Han Li, busy for half a month, looked upon the fertile land he had cultivated, his face revealing a contented smile. Plant the seeds in spring, and harvest the fruits in winter.
Though the circumstances at Tianxuan Mountain had been less than ideal for the venerable ancestor Han Li, life had been perfect since settling at Chengsheng Mountain.
After successfully imparting his teachings to his charming new wives, including Zhao Wanling and Zhuo Yanran, Han Li leisurely played with his beautiful spouses. His days as an immortal were growing happier by the day.
Every day, he would taste a variety of fruits, plant some flowers in his garden, play with his collection of Jade Stones, and occasionally indulge in some joyful games…
In the blink of an eye, another dozen days passed by.
One day, Han Li was invited by Jiang Baiye for a discussion on profound doctrines. After imparting high-level knowledge to her, Jiang Baiye suddenly realized that her cultivation had reached its peak, and her foundation had become extremely solid.
Continuing to stay in the Myriad Phenomena Realm was only a waste of time, so Jiang Baiye decided to break through to the True Martial Realm, becoming Han Li’s third True Martial Realm wife.
Ling Lingshuang and Xue Yueqing were Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wus, and even Long Yue had already broken through to the Divine Yuan Realm. Up until now, there were only two in the True Martial Realm at Han Mansion, one was Bai Keqing, and the other was Lu Tianxiang.
Nevertheless, Jiang Baiye knew that in a while, several more True Martial Realm Emperor Wus would emerge from Han Mansion.
Following her breakthrough, Yun Miaoyi and Gongsun Yue were also close to doing so, and Murong Ying along with Yao Xi had already cultivated to the Hollow Void Stage. They could reach the peak of Myriad Phenomena Realm within two or three years, aided swiftly by the Time-Sky Tower.
There were also new arrivals at Han Mansion over the past few months, such as Chu Xianlin and Qiu Shuhui. They had already cultivated to the late Myriad Phenomena Realm during their time at The Li Manor.
After coming to Han Mansion, with the help of the Time-Sky Tower, they made rapid progress, reaching the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and were now polishing their foundation, striving to condense a King Grade Pill in one fell swoop.
“Husband, should we break through here, or…?”
Jiang Baiye looked at Han Li with affection, her voice soft. Her whole body was nestled in Han Li’s arms, forehead beaded with fine sweat which she did not evaporate through cultivation.
Han Li, with one arm around Jiang Baiye and leaning back against the headboard, his other hand casually wandering, said without a second thought:
“Jiang Jiang, just break through here. With me watching over you, there won’t be any problems.”
Jiang Baiye smiled and nodded, then left Han Li’s embrace to sit cross-legged, the aura around her body gradually ascending, revealing her Sword Dao
Jiang Baiye’s Sword Intent was, of course, a type of Sword Dao, which she called the Illusory Sword Intent. Compared to common Sword Dao Intents, like the Rain Sword Intent or the Fiery Sword Intent, hers was much stronger, belonging to the elite level of Sword Dao.
It had to be said that as the once number one Sword Immortal of Sanzhou, Jiang Baiye possessed high comprehension, with an elite Sword Dao, increasing the chances of condensing a King Grade Martial True Pill.
Moreover, having spent many years at Chengsheng Mountain, whether it was cultivation techniques, martial skills, physical body, or divine spirit, her foundation in all aspects was deep, further increasing her chances of condensing a King Grade Martial Pill.
To prevent mishaps, Han Li had already given Jiang Baiye a True Martial Pill in advance, so even if something went wrong, she could rely on it to successfully condense a King Grade Pill.
Han Li stood with his hands behind him, quietly watching Jiang Baiye break through her limit, his face wearing a gratified smile.
Before long, Jiang Baiye successfully condensed her King Grade Martial True Pill out of her Illusory Sword Intent, breaking through the shackles to step into the True Martial Realm, becoming a female Emperor Wu.
Jiang Baiye silently cultivated to stabilize her breath and after ingesting a few pills, her cultivation was immediately secured.
Upon opening her beautiful eyes, Jiang Baiye found that her husband Han Li had come closer at some point, his large hands busily moving about.
Jiang Baiye smiled helplessly and said softly, “Husband, what are you up to now?”
“You,” Han Li said succinctly.
Jiang Baiye’s flawless face blushed deeply, and she boldly said, “Then what is husband waiting for?”
Having been with Han Li for so many years, she had dual-cultivated with him countless times, her cheek no longer as thin as before. She felt no shyness when it came to exchanging profound doctrines.
Han Li laughed and then lay on the luxurious and elaborate bed.
Jiang Baiye gave him a look but still took the initiative to become the Female Knight.
….
In the next few days, just as Jiang Baiye anticipated, several more True Martial Realm Emperor Wus appeared in Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
They were Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and Chu Xianlin.
Han Li personally oversaw their breakthroughs and took the opportunity to exchange doctrines with his three lovely wives, helping them solidify their cultivation.
While assisting Chu Xianlin in her breakthrough to the True Martial Realm, she even called over her Disciple, showing how much she cared for her—she had brought her along when first married into The Li Manor.
These days, Han Li also did not idle away. He started to consider how to better nurture the offspring of Han Mansion.
The cultivation environment and resources at Han Mansion were considered top tier in the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, ensuring that all descendants of Han Mansion were lacking for nothing.
But because of the abundant resources, many had become lazy, realizing they could enjoy a wealth of benefits without making an effort to break through in their cultivation, merely going with the flow.
Han Li felt this attitude was detrimental. How could he, as the venerable ancestor, be at ease if his descendants were not striving to excel?
After pondering for a few days, Han Li came up with some new strategies.
Han Mansion maintained two lists, one for the core offspring and their cultivation, which currently had few names, and another for key offspring growth, with names more than tenfold the former.

chapters.title: Chapter 487: 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 487: Chapter 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_2
The rules Han Li had previously established were that once someone made it onto either of these two cultivation lists, they would enjoy every kind of benefit from the Han Mansion, with each nurturing scheme being more significant than the last.
These two cultivation lists were not competitive; meeting certain criteria, such as aptitude and comprehension, was sufficient for selection, and there was no elimination.
This led to some descendants with excellent talents and understanding developing a tendency to slack off, wanting to be a lazy Second Gen Immortal, leaving their brothers and sisters to strive in cultivation.
Han Li decided to reform both the core descendants’ cultivation list and the priority descendants’ list, adopting a bottom-elimination system, with the fixed annual expulsion of the bottom ten percent.
He believed that with this change, those descendants with outstanding talent and understanding would be spurred into action, working hard in cultivation and engaging in intense internal competition.
Without diligent cultivation, they would be eliminated within a year, subsequently losing their corresponding status, privileges, positions, and so on, with substantial reductions in resource supply and nurturing intensity, regardless of their mother’s high status within Han Li’s favor.
Old Ancestor Han wants to create an internally competitive family, not a family of indolents.
He desires a family where everyone shines like dragons, all pushing to excel, each producing a succession of powerful individuals, replenishing Han Li in return.
The alternative would be Han Li playing the lifelong nanny for the Han Mansion, supplying everything and worrying about all matters, which would be far too exhausting.
Now that the Han Mansion had crossed the early stages of development, it was time for its outstanding descendants to venture out, rise and shine.
Beyond the descendants on both major cultivation lists, Han Li also established a promotion system for other descendants, setting aside factors such as aptitude and comprehension, thus giving them the opportunity to enter the two major lists as well.
The first is the Combat Tower, comprising forty floors, corresponding to ten Big Realms, designed for the training and honing of the Han Mansion descendants, and Han Li created numerous leaderboards as well.
According to the new rules, any descendant who conquers the fourth floor of their respective Realm would automatically be placed on the priority cultivation list, demonstrating that they possess the basic ability to fight beyond their own level.
If they could surpass their current Realm by one level and conquer the second floor of the next, they would automatically enter the core cultivation list.
To prevent cheating, Han Li set rules, such as a ban on the use of single-use talismans and the regulation that the weapons used should not exceed two Big Realms above their own, among others.
Han Li knew that these were all parts of strength, but internal family selection and external experience were different. Many descendants could get a hold of over-leveled talismans and weapons, which would lead to too many passing, rendering the lists meaningless.
When it comes to nurturing descendants, it is about special treatment, focusing on the outstanding ones, but also giving others a chance.
Secondly, Han Li planned to hold an annual martial competition and discussion of the Dao within the family; the top three from these contests would automatically join the core nurturing list each year, and the top ten would join the priority nurturing list.
This represents an opportunity. If those descendants can seize it, they could rise to prominence. Once heavily nurtured and if they avoid elimination at the end of each year, they could continue to grow and become the backbone of the Han Mansion in the future.
The third is about the external genius battles, martial contests, and Dao discussion gatherings. Those who place within the top three automatically become priority nurturing descendants of the Han Mansion, and the one who claims the first place would become a core nurturing descendant.
For now, Han Li plans to implement these reforms, observe the effects, make continuous improvements if results are unsatisfactory, and reinforce areas that prove effective.
Soon, Han Li gathered some important figures in the main hall of Yundao Peak. They were either his beloved wives and concubines or capable descendants, and he announced this significant decision.
A single stone caused a thousand ripples!
Han Li’s words caused a huge stir in the hearts of these people. A small portion remained indifferent, as either they, or their descendants, practiced cultivation diligently.
The majority looked up at their husband/father/grandfather seated high on the throne, opened their mouths, but didn’t know what to say.
Han Li held profound and stern authority on Chengsheng Mountain; no one ever dared to refute his decisions, and this time was no different.
“You all may spare the unnecessary words; this decision is for your own good. The Han Mansion’s resources cannot sustain unlimited provision to everyone.”
“If you wish to reap without sowing, then kindly step down and leave the resources and benefits to others, allowing them to take your place and continue contributing to the Han Mansion.”
Han Li’s voice echoed in Yundao Hall, resounding and thunderous, prompting a solemn expression from everyone present, all nodding in agreement.
They had witnessed themselves or seen brothers, sisters, or descendants grow lazy, lax in their cultivation, and often indulgent. This was indeed not beneficial.
They knew well that the Old Ancestor’s decisions would not be altered; their only duty was to execute them.
Capturing the expressions of everyone in the hall, Han Li showed a look of satisfaction and continued, “Today I’ve assembled you here for another matter.”
“Our Han Mansion’s Direct Lineage population is too sparse; continue to encourage fertility. Yong Jin, Yonglin, Yong Kang… You three, work out a new standard, and then submit it for my review.”
“You must also lead by example, set a paradigm for your own progeny, expanding our lineage and proliferating our descendants.”
“….…”
That day, Han Li’s decision spread throughout the entirety of Chengsheng Mountain. The Guest Elders and protectors of the Han Mansion were merely bystanders to the excitement, as this matter did not concern them and they maintained a separate system.
The Han Mansion descendants, however, were thoroughly shaken. Judging from this series of changes, the Old Ancestor was dissatisfied with their recent attitudes towards cultivation, imposing this method to coerce them into change. Without adjustment, they faced elimination.

chapters.title: Chapter 488: 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 488: Chapter 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_3
A minority of the descendants of those who already benefited felt somewhat dissatisfied, but given the trend of the times, they couldn’t change the old ancestor of the Han Mansion, so they could only change themselves. Otherwise, if they were eliminated, they would have nothing left.
Most descendants, however, were excited beyond measure. It had been very difficult for them to get on either the key or core training lists, but with this reform, they now had many avenues for promotion.
On the other hand, most descendants were still watching the policy that encouraged reproduction, waiting to see what the new incentive policies were before deciding whether or not to continue having children.
Although the offspring of the Han Mansion’s descendants didn’t require their attention, with everything being managed by the Han Mansion, eliminating worries for them, having more descendants still meant receiving a substantial reward.
But the more offspring they had, the less concerned they were, after all, they still had to secure a bright future for their descendants and compete for various resources and benefits, which were not managed by the Han Mansion.
Another reason was that the development of the Han Mansion was too rapid; the resources and benefits they could receive were many times better than before, and the incentives for encouraging reproduction hadn’t changed, making them seem less attractive.
All this was noticed by Han Li, who observed in silence, noticing the reactions of his descendants, thereby gauging the effectiveness of these systems.
So far, the response had been quite positive; his descendants were willing to actively cooperate, and even those who were once lacklusturous now rediscovered their motivation to cultivate.
Even if they were unwilling, their mothers, Han Li’s beloved wives and beautiful concubines, would influence their thinking.
Three days later,
Han Li received some good news: a marriage delegation from the Da Jing Empire had entered Yuanzhou.
Standing atop Chengdao Peak, Han Li with his hands behind his back, unleashed his vast, majestic Divine Sense, instantly covering the entirety of Yuanzhou and saw the marriage delegation from the Da Jing Empire.
After observing carefully, Han Li discovered an unexpected surprise.
“Tsk tsk, the Da Jing Empire is really willing to spend.”
This marriage delegation from the Da Jing Empire consisted of more than eight hundred people, fully equipped and arriving in chariots—an entire solemn marriage procession.
In total, there were twelve chariots. The four in the center were even more luxurious and exquisite, decorated with big red flowers, brimming with joy. Inside them were four exceptionally beautiful women: one with Second Grade potential and three with Third Grade potential.
Leading the entourage in the foremost chariot was a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, none other than Jiang Zhengyang, the former emperor of Da Jing. In the remaining seven chariots were seven Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. This setup could be said to be extremely lavish, underscoring the great importance that the Da Jing Empire placed on Han Li.
In terms of the strength and background of the marriage delegation, as well as the beauty of the women sent, the Da Jing Empire had outperformed Emperor Wu’s City.
Emperor Wu’s City had only sent two beauties with Third Grade potential, the rest were Fourth Grade, whereas the Da Jing Empire not only sent three beauties with Third Grade potential but even included one with Second Grade potential.
It could be said that they had really invested heavily.
One must know that Second Grade potential had the capacity for the Divine Yuan Realm. With careful cultivation, advancing to the True Martial Realm would be easy, and with sufficient resources, coupled with some opportunities, they might even have a hope of breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm.
The Da Jing Empire itself only had two True Martial Realm Emperors Wu and didn’t possess anyone in the Divine Yuan Realm, yet they were willing to send a beauty with assured True Martial potential and the possibility of reaching the Divine Yuan Realm.
This truly caused Han Li to view them with new respect.
But this was exactly what the old ancestor Han had hoped for; he wanted as many of these arrangements as possible, for they would bring him even greater fortune.
Han Li also knew why the Da Jing Empire was so generous: he had successfully ‘fished’ for them.
Han Li was well aware of the principle that spending a fortune may bring forth a steed of great value. After successfully arranging a marriage with Emperor Wu’s City, he not only came forward to solve the crisis of Emperor Wu’s City, allowing it to retain a quarter of its territory, but he also offered a grand dowry.
This included high-level cultivation techniques, martial skills, pills, weapons, and various other resources, even a considerable number of Spirit Stones, giving Emperor Wu’s City plenty of face.
Han Li had even intentionally publicized this, to let other powers know that sending a woman to him would yield a very substantial return.
The old ancestor will not treat you poorly!
As expected, this news caused quite a stir throughout the Xuan Domain. The Da Jing Empire’s willingness to send a beauty with Second Grade potential and even have a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu lead the team was aimed at the lavish gifts from Han Li.
When the Da Jing Empire’s marriage delegation reached the outside of Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li briefly concealed the mountain before personally going out to receive them, affording Jiang Zhengyang full courtesy.
Inside the Yundao Hall.
“It is a joy to have friends come from afar.”
Han Li said with a smile, “It is my honor that Daoist Jiang has come personally.”
“Where do you speak, Han Daoist friend? From now on, we will be in-laws, so naturally, I should visit personally, lest the outside world misinterprets.” Jiang Zhengyang said seriously.
Han Li nodded slightly, then turned his gaze to the other people in the hall, his attention mainly on the four gorgeous women beside Jiang Zhengyang.
Feeling the gaze of Han Li, Jiang Zhengyang secretly smiled to himself, thinking that Han Li was exactly as rumored, overly fond of beauty.
They had only chatted for a moment and Han Li could hardly wait to cast his gaze towards Nangong Xue and the other women, showcasing his lustfulness.
Yet, this made Jiang Zhengyang pleased; the more Han Li acted this way, the more generous his return for the great gift they brought would be.
Initially, he hadn’t wanted to send Nangong Xue. She was his personal disciple, whom he had raised as his own daughter and regarded as a future pillar of the Da Jing Empire.
But how could he resist when Han Li’s offerings were so plentiful?
According to the news that had spread, the dowry Han Li provided to Emperor Wu’s City was so generous that it moved both him and Jiang Yuanchuan, the two True Martial Realm Emperor Wus.

chapters.title: Chapter 489: 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 489: Chapter 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_4
Emperor Wu’s City had sent just two beauties with Third Grade aptitude, and to think they received such a generous return. If the Ancient Empire was to send a beauty with Second Grade aptitude, the rewards they would obtain would likely be many times more bountiful than that of Emperor Wu’s City.
Jiang Zhengyang and Jiang Yuanchuan both longed for a great opportunity to glimpse the Divine Yuan Realm, but they had never found one. Now, Han Li was their chance, their hope for breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm.
As long as they could get what they desired from Han Li, the reincarnated powerhouse, their short-term strength would increase significantly, and their future would be full of even greater hope.
Once he had made up his mind, Jiang Zhengyang went to persuade Nangong Xue, getting her to agree.
“Brother Han, this is my direct disciple, Nangong Xue, who has Second Grade aptitude and has already cultivated to the late stage of the Hollow Void Realm.”
“This is….”
Jiang Zhengyang turned towards Nangong Xue and the other three stunning female cultivators, introducing each one by one. Each of them was extraordinary in their own right, but Nangong Xue stood out the most, whether in terms of appearance, temperament, cultivation, or aptitude.
As Jiang Zhengyang made the introductions, Nangong Xue and the other women lifted their heads to look at Han Li, each with their own thoughts – Nangong Xue’s feelings being the most complex of all.
Nangong Xue observed the handsome man seated at the head of the table and sighed inwardly. From today onwards, she would be his wife.
When her master, Jiang Zhengyang, had initially approached her, Nangong Xue was reluctant. She was confident that she could easily cultivate to the True Martial Realm. After that, she would venture out, seize some great opportunities, and break through to the Divine Yuan Realm, leading the Ancient Empire to new heights, on par with the Ancient Empire.
Yet, things were contrary to her wishes. Previously, when Jiang Zhengyang heard her goals, he would praise her, but now it was different.
Her master earnestly persuaded her to marry into Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion, saying that with Han Li’s help, she would break through to the True Martial Realm faster, and her hopes of advancing to the Divine Yuan Realm in the future would greatly increase.
Nangong Xue felt uncomfortable. She was clever and naturally knew her master’s purpose, but after weighing her options, she still agreed.
Her master and the old ancestor of the Ancient Empire both wished for her to marry into Chengsheng Mountain, then obtain numerous benefits from the old ancestor of Han Mansion, Han Li, to satisfy their own ambitions. It was as if they were selling her off.
However, thinking of her master’s kindness, Nangong Xue couldn’t refuse. If she didn’t agree, her master would certainly use obligations to persuade her, and it wouldn’t be good to cause an ungainly scene.
After agreeing, Nangong Xue felt much lighter. She collected a lot of information about Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion and Han Li and began to envision the future.
Perhaps, as her master had said, only on Chengsheng Mountain could she achieve greater heights and advance to the Divine Yuan Realm.
After all, the old ancestor of Han Mansion had been, at the very least, a power of the Tongxuan Realm in his past life.
Nangong Xue’s eyes crossed with Han Li’s in the air, and her pretty face suddenly turned red as she quietly looked down.
At that moment, she had even thought up the names of their future children.
Han Li withdrew his gaze from Nangong Xue, smiled, and said, “Jiang, you are most righteous.”
Others commit fratricide for righteousness, but Jiang Zhengyang sends off relatives in the name of righteousness.
Jiang Zhengyang shook his head and said solemnly, “Brother Han, I hope you will treat my disciple and these three others well….”
“Rest assured, friend. What I’m best at is taking care of others,” Han Li said with a smile.
Han Li talked with Jiang Zhengyang for a long time in Yundao Hall, covering all sorts of topics. It wasn’t until Jiang Zhengyang became restless with anticipation that Han Li finally revealed his offer.
Two Tongxuan Realm level cultivation techniques, three Tongxuan Realm level martial skills, even more Divine Yuan Realm and True Martial Realm level cultivation techniques and martial skills, along with precious Pill Formulas, Refining Blueprints, talismans, and so on. Han Li also gifted Jiang Zhengyang a large quantity of pills to enhance True Martial Realm cultivation…
With each reward mentioned by Han Li, the smile on Jiang Zhengyang’s face widened, and by the end, he was beaming with joy, which was clearly written all over his face.
Han Li was truly generous!
Jiang Zhengyang felt a surge of emotions and decided to stay in touch with Han Li from time to time, perhaps sending him a few more lovely wives and concubines.
By his side, Nangong Xue noticed the expression on Jiang Zhengyang’s face and sighed to herself.
This time, she didn’t resent her master Jiang Zhengyang anymore. Han Li had given too much, far too generously, and genuinely spared no expense for the sake of the four of them.
With such a splendid dowry, Nangong Xue too found her heart racing. If she were in Jiang Zhengyang’s shoes, she likely would have made the same decision.
Soon, Nangong Xue’s face was adorned with a radiant smile.
With her master Jiang Zhengyang gaining so much, it could be considered a repayment of his kindness toward her.
If Han Li could give Jiang Zhengyang such a substantial reward, he surely wouldn’t treat her, his consort, unfairly, would he?
After conversing with Jiang Zhengyang a while longer, Han Li set a date for the wedding on an auspicious day.
Six days later,
The entire Xuan Domain was once again stirred up.
The old ancestor of Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion had taken yet another wife!
Various forces throughout the Xuan Domain were moved upon receiving the news; the old ancestor Han truly lived up to his reputation.
Just about a month had passed, and the old ancestor of Han Mansion, Han Li, had again taken a wife — this time, four at once.
He truly was the Great Love Ancestor!
Great Love Ancestor became the unspoken title bestowed upon Han Li by the various powers of the Xuan Domain, a name they all found apt. It highlighted Han Li’s romantic nature without offending him.
Han Li, a powerful being reincarnated, was indeed worthy of the title of old ancestor, likely having lived even longer than the Dao Lord of Bai Yujing.
This time, many forces from the Xuan Domain still came to show their support, although there were far fewer than last time, and the gifts they brought were not as lavish as before.

chapters.title: Chapter 490: 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: Chapter 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_5
The various forces also had their grievances, unable to voice their frustration. The rate at which the great Elder Consort Han Li took wives and concubines was simply too fast. If this trend continued, it would amount to taking a wife or concubine once a month, and if they kept giving gifts as they did the first time, it wouldn’t be long before their powers would suffer significant losses.
Now, the various forces were still willing to present gifts, partly wanting to further their relationship with the great Elder Consort Han Li, and partly because Han Li had not been completely reckless.
Last time, Han Li took in two wives and three concubines; this time, he was welcoming four wives. If Han Li acted recklessly, he could have split this into nine separate ceremonies to take in his new brides, leaving hardly any forces willing to pay their respects.
Chengsheng Mountain was once again immersed in a buzz of activity, a place where literati laughed and common folk did not tread, with all those entering having some measure of status or identity.
When the festivity faded, the noise dissipated, and the various forces left the place empty, Han Li officially entered the bridal room. He set out to earnestly pamper his brides of the night, especially Nangong Xue.
Beneath is the recitation segment of ancient poetry:
To ascend the chilly mountain, the stone path slants, and within the deep clouds, someone’s home awaits.
Pausing the cart to cherish the maple woods at dusk, where frost leaves appear redder than the blooms of February.
——Tang Dynasty·Du Mu
…..
For ten days straight, Master Han Li toiled in the fertile fields tirelessly, all for the benefit of future generations.
Only after Han Li, the great elder, had successful sown his seeds with Nangong Xue and the other three newly-wedded brides did he breathe a sigh of relief. Life, despite its beauty, was somewhat taxing on the back and kidneys.
Fortunately, the great elder Han Li was a capable being of the Tongxuan Realm, with a physical body nearly comparable to a Sage from the Sacred Abyss Realm, otherwise he truly wouldn’t have been able to withstand it.
After all, Elder Han Li discussed philosophical doctrines many times a day, never resting a single one of the three hundred and sixty-five days of the year, a true model of cultivation.
During this period, the news of the Ancient Empire forming a marriage alliance with Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion spread far and wide across the vast Xuan Domain, causing no small sensation.
The Yinyang Sect, Kurong Sect, Fengbo Pavilion, and Ancient Empire among others were shocked by the determination of the Ancient Empire. The fact that they were willing to send even Second Grade talented beauties to Chengsheng Mountain meant they were rolling too hard.
Since when did offering women become something to compete over?
This is making things difficult for us.
The various forces were also shocked by the generous rewards given by Han Li. Such grand gestures showed how magnanimous the great Elder Consort was, making countless powers eager, wishing they could immediately send beautiful female cultivators from their forces to Chengsheng Mountain.
…….
Daqian Empire, Capital City.
Emperor Qian paced back and forth in the Imperial Palace, restless and agitated, occasionally muttering under his breath, “Damn it, this is too much competition!”
They, the Daqian Empire, were supposed to be Han Li’s rightful partner!
Yet now, Emperor Qian felt as if he had been cuckolded.
First, Emperor Wu’s City sent Han Li two wives and three concubines, then the Ancient Empire sent four wives, among whom was even a second-grade talent.
This left Emperor Qian deeply regretful for being too late to act.
Emperor Wu’s City was one thing; it was already in decline and bore no enmity or grievance with the Daqian Empire. But it was different with the Ancient Empire, still at its peak and powerful, furthermore, it had a deadly feud with the Daqian Empire, having even annexed three provinces of their territory.
Emperor Qian, however, couldn’t say anything against this, and could only watch as he was being cuckolded. He was acutely aware that it was the Daqian Empire relying on Han Li, not Han Li relying on the Daqian Empire; they had no say in the matter.
He wanted to send women to the great Elder Consort Han Li, but now it was too late.
The beautiful female cultivators sent by Emperor Wu’s City and the Ancient Empire not only possessed high talents and stunning beauty, but they were also virgins.
But what about the Daqian Empire?
The only one they could present proudly was the eldest princess, who was also a virgin, with a Third Grade talent, and cultivation at the level of a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
But the problem was, the eldest princess was unwilling to marry into Chengsheng Mountain and become a wife to Han Li.
Emperor Qian had no choice but to heave sighs and worry daily, trying to come up with other solutions.
After pacing around for a while, Emperor Qian’s figure vanished, determined to continue persuading the eldest princess. If she remained unwilling, then he had no choice but to collaborate with the Grand Preceptor and others to forcibly suppress her and deliver her to Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion.
If things continued as such, the relationship between the Daqian Empire and Chengsheng Mountain would grow more and more distant. They needed their own people in Chengsheng Mountain and to have some influence in front of Han Li.
…..
Bai Yujing, Breeze Pavilion.
Sect Leader Lu Zhen stood silent and sullen atop the high pavilion, his face full of worry as he drank sullenly.
Elder Consort Han Li’s latest round of taking wives and concubines had extended an invitation to Bai Yujing, but they had chosen not to send anyone. Lu Zhen had known of this news early on.
To be honest, Lu Zhen felt envious of the great Elder Consort Han Li.
To think that Han Li could take as many beautiful wives and concubines without hindering his cultivation progress. Was reincarnation of the strong always this monstrous?
He had cultivated arduously to reach the Divine Yuan Realm, experiencing hardships along the way, nowhere as easygoing and untroubled as Han Li.
It was a provocation to Lu Zhen, mainly because the Fairy Ling Lingshuang from the Penglai Immortal Sect, whom he admired, had been missing for a long time, leaving no useful clues as to her whereabouts.
Lu Zhen used to swing by the Penglai Immortal Sect now and then, to scout for news, but now he dared not go anymore.
Every visit, the Observing Sea Daoist treated him like a punching bag, furiously venting at his master, disparaging Bai Yujing with comments like ‘Even the so-called number one Sacred Land of the Qianyuan Divine Province couldn’t discern a Mysterious Force, allowing them to make fools of them and remain free from justice…’
Lu Zhen could only endure in silence, aware that the Observing Sea Daoist was more enraged and frustrated than he was, angry about not finding Ling Lingshuang and hence vented at him.
The Observing Sea Daoist wished for Bai Yujing to put in more effort, to identify the Mysterious Forces sooner, and rescue Ling Lingshuang.

chapters.title: Chapter 491: 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: Chapter 218: Creating an Intense Competitive Family! The Whole World Honors the Great Ancestor of Love! Mortal King Body! The First Immortal Weapon is Born_6
Lu Zhen also desired it, yet although he was the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, he had no authority to wield immortal weapons, and without the Sect Leader’s approval, no one could.
He did not know what the Sect Leader was thinking, Lu Zhen had sought him out several times, yet never received an answer.
The very thought of Han Li marrying nine incomparably beautiful women in just over a month filled Lu Zhen with immense frustration, wondering when he could find Ling Lingshuang, the Fairy, and become dao companions with her.
…..
At Chengsheng Mountain, in the Han Mansion.
Unaware of Lu Zhen’s constant thoughts about Ling Lingshuang, Han Li was indeed spending time with her.
His beautiful wife was also nearing the end of her pregnancy, with the birth due in a few days, and Han Li made sure to spend as much time as possible with Ling Lingshuang.
“Qing’er, eat a grape.”
Han Li offered a Crystal Grape brimming with Spiritual Energy to the tender and lustrous lips of Ling Lingshuang.
Ling Lingshuang’s lips parted slightly, consuming the Crystal Grape. It was sweet, but Han Li’s gesture was sweeter, bringing an involuntary smile of happiness to her face.
After being brought to Chengsheng Mountain by Han Li ten months ago, Ling Lingshuang had unconsciously fallen for him, accepting Han Li in her heart and no longer thinking of escape.
The cultivation environment on Chengsheng Mountain was indeed many times better than that of Penglai Immortal Sect.
Though pregnant these ten months, her cultivation level had actually risen significantly, far outpacing the progress she could have made with solo cultivation.
Once the child was born, she would be able to cultivate in the Time-Sky Tower, and with her status, could enter directly to the seventh floor, where her cultivation would advance by leaps and bounds.
“Husband, do you think our child will have a special constitution?”
Ling Lingshuang snuggled in Han Li’s embrace, pondered for a bit, then asked softly, her voice tinged with nervousness.
She was aware that many children with special constitutions had been born in the Han Mansion over the past one or two years, Yao Xi’s son Han Yongqian possessed the Supreme Bone, Murong Ying’s son Han Yongmu had the divine Mortal Emperor Body, and even Xue Yueqing’s son Han Yongkun had the Tianhu King’s Body.
Having a child with a special constitution could significantly raise one’s status in the Han Mansion.
She knew that Long Yue’s first offspring, Han Yonglong, did not have a special constitution. Even the reincarnation of the Jiao Saint, Long Yue’s child lacked it—would hers have one?
If her own child did not possess a special constitution, its potential would inherently be much lower than others, and even she could be outshone by Xue Yueqing.
“Qing’er, rest assured, our child will have a special constitution,” Han Li’s large hand gently caressed her belly, soothing her.
He and Xue Yueqing both had first-class aptitudes, so the child would likely also be of a first-class aptitude, with a chance of being born with a special constitution.
Even if not manifested at birth, they would certainly develop one in the future.
After all, he had the Life-Prolonging Furnace!
“Mm.” Ling Lingshuang relaxed, her expression filled with anticipation.
So they remained at the summit of Chengdao Peak, intimately doting on each other, whispering sweet nothings, occasionally nibbling on lips with heartfelt affection, like a pair of divinely-matched immortals deeply in love.
Several days later,
Han Li arrived at Ling Lingshuang’s chamber, waiting in silence; today was the day she would give birth.
No long wait was demanded of Han Li, as soon a resounding cry pierced the air.
Han Li walked in, moving to the bedside, he helped Ling Lingshuang into his embrace, channeling mana into her to restore her vitality, while his Divine Sense explored the newborn child.
His Divine Sense conducted a check and a look of surprise appeared in his eyes, which then changed to one of joy.
“Husband, our child seems to have a special constitution…”
Ling Lingshuang too used her Divine Sense to examine and excitedly said, yet she wasn’t certain if it really was a special constitution.
Thus, Ling Lingshuang looked up at her husband Han Li, waiting for him to provide an answer.
Han Li smiled and nodded, saying, “Qing’er is not mistaken, he indeed has a constitution, a royal one, the Mortal King Body.”
The Mortal King Body is a special constitution that only emerges at a certain stage after the Human Clan bloodline becomes concentrated and returns to its ancestors, and it is a very powerful constitution.
If one continues to delve into the Mortal King Body and evolves it, it has the potential to eventually reach the level of an Emperor Body—the Mortal Emperor Body, which is extraordinarily promising.
However, special constitutions like the Mortal King Body or Mortal Emperor Body are extremely difficult for ordinary members of the Human Clan to activate, and even among the descendants of Mortal Emperors and Mortal Kings, most do not possess them.
He had been prepared for the possibility that this child might not have a special constitution, but unexpectedly, he was presented with a pleasant surprise.
It seems that Ling Lingshuang is a descendant of a Mortal King or Mortal Emperor, with special blood flowing in her veins, of which Ling Lingshuang herself was unaware—probably because the bloodline had become very dilute.
Unexpectedly, after combining with him, this extremely dilute bloodline was inadvertently activated, resulting in the birth of their first child with the Mortal King Body.
Han Li had a suspicion deep in his heart that perhaps the System played a role in this, just as his cultivation level increased but did not affect the offspring he produced.
There were Supreme Bone, Tianhu King’s Body, God Emperor Body, among other royal and emperor constitutions—how could such things be born so easily? The System must play a part, possibly as a hidden effect.
Casting aside distracting thoughts and seeing Ling Lingshuang eagerly looking at him, Han Li immediately said, “My son has the appearance of a Mortal King, and his future will certainly be extraordinary. Let’s call him Han Yonghao.”
Hao, associated with the sun and the sky, immense and boundless.
Hao signifies vast and grand primordial energy.
By naming their child Han Yonghao, Han Li naturally carried great expectations for him. Under his guidance, Han Yonghao was sure to evolve into a Mortal Emperor Body, achieving incredible greatness.
“Thank you, my husband~”
Upon hearing this name, Ling Lingshuang’s face lit up with a brilliant smile and she took the initiative to offer a kiss.
This name was no ordinary one!
After taking care of Ling Lingshuang and Han Yonghao, Han Li then departed.
Han Yonghao had a first-rate aptitude and the Mortal King Body, which fed back 10 percent of the aptitude to Han Li, along with 10 Physique Points, deepening his cultivation foundation.
Three days later.
Han Li felt his luck was particularly good today, and it was a good day to open treasure chests.
After some thought, Han Li approached Nangong Xue for a profound exchange of cultivation insights, engaging deeply in a discussion of the Dao.
While conveying teachings and imparting knowledge, Han Li silently spent five years of cultivation to open this month’s treasure chest.
In an instant, the treasure chest radiated dazzling light, and the radiant immortal light that was released almost blinded Han Li.
When he saw the treasures that emerged from the chest, Han Li was shocked, excited, and overjoyed; he couldn’t help but speed up the pace of his discussion.
This time, with a successful stroke, he opened the first Immortal Weapon!

chapters.title: Chapter 492: 219 Sword Spirit Xi Yue! Immortal Realm? Prison Land? Reporting to the Ancestor, someone is hijacking the wedding!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: Chapter 219 Sword Spirit Xi Yue! Immortal Realm? Prison Land? Reporting to the Ancestor, someone is hijacking the wedding!_1
“`
“Ding, the treasure chest has been successfully opened. Congratulations, Master, for obtaining the Heaven Immortal Rank Treasure, Sword of Humanity!”
As Han Li gazed at the Immortal Sword on the treasure chest, surrounded by immortal light extending for billions of miles and sword energy in countless strands, he listened to the System’s prompt and his expression grew increasingly excited, unable to help but quicken his pace.
The Heaven Immortal Weapon, Sword of Humanity!
Han Li felt that his luck today would be extraordinary, which is why he utilized his chance to open the treasure chest this month.
Han Li had not expected that this time he would actually strike it big in one go, unboxing his first Immortal Weapon in his life.
How mystical!
Who says fortune doesn’t favor the bold?
Full of excitement, Han Li continued to exchange Daoist teachings with Nangong Xue, and as he observed her transformed into a Female Knight, he decided to properly reward her.
This time, he certainly had latched onto Nangong Xue’s luck.
He was a bit worried, wondering if Nangong Xue would turn into the unluckiest person from now on, transformed from a person of great fortune to a deity of decline.
He would take it one step at a time; after all, with him around, even if Nangong Xue became a deity of decline, he had ways to turn it around.
The discussion at the meeting of the Dao lasted for two hours before Han Li left, satisfied.
Then it was the turn of Han Li’s other beloved wives and concubines to be surprised. What happened today that their husband actually dual cultivated with Nangong Xue for two hours?
Generally speaking, their husband dual cultivated with them for one hour, and only when Han Li was very pleased would there be exceptions.
Arriving at the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li took a deep breath, calmed the excitement in his heart, and then took out the Heaven Immortal Weapon, Sword of Humanity, that he had obtained this time.
Looking at the Sword of Humanity in front of him, Han Li fondly played with it, carefully observed it, and also communicated with the System to understand more about the Sword of Humanity. His breathing gradually became more rapid.
The Sword of Humanity, three feet and two inches long, was forged from the four types of Immortal Gold: Dao Tribulation Immortal Gold, Feathered Immortal Gold, Indestructible Immortal Gold, and Void Immortal Gold.
On one side of the sword were engraved the characters for “humanity,” surrounded by a myriad of worldly phenomena, and on the other side the character for “Dao,” covered with traces of the great Dao. It contained boundless power and had a faint resonance with the Dao.
The hilt of the sword was adorned with Dao patterns and was decorated with thirteen colored beads and Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade; the blade was as frosty as snow, emitting a cold light that intimidated the ninth heaven. When the sword light flowed, the heavens trembled, and where the sword energy swept across, the realms would collapse.
An Immortal Weapon must be forged from Immortal Gold, as only Immortal Gold can bear the Immortal Dao. The strength of an Immortal Weapon depends firstly on the material and secondly on the Immortal Dao it carries.
Immortal Gold is also categorized into many levels, with hundreds and thousands of types; Dao Tribulation Immortal Gold, Feathered Immortal Gold, and Indestructible Immortal Gold are only three kinds among all Immortal Gold.
Great Emperors at the Heaven Imperial Realm master the laws of Dao. When they ascend to immortality, they will integrate one or several mastered laws into a unified whole, allowing their martial Dao to begin to take shape. This can also be referred to as Immortal Dao, the Dao of Immortals.
Apart from the ultimate, singular Dao, all other Daos have rankings, classified into four layers: ordinary, powerful, top-tier, and supreme.
The Sword Dao, Blade Dao, Five Elements and other such Daos belong to the top-tier Daos, while Daos like causality, fate, and space-time are classified as supreme Daos.
Branch Daos that stem from these top-tier and supreme Daos fall into the first three levels; even if a Cultivator comprehends only the early form of an ordinary Dao while breaking through the Hollow Void Stage, they could potentially retrace to the origin and elevate their Dao to higher levels.
The Sword of Humanity was forged from four types of Immortal Gold, among them Feathered Immortal Gold and Indestructible Immortal Gold are only at the Heaven Immortal level, while Dao Tribulation Immortal Gold and Void Immortal Gold are at True Immortal level, rendering it indestructible; the sword moves and worlds perish.
Although the Sword of Humanity only carries a single Dao, it is endowed with the Dao of humanity, and despite being only of Heaven Immortal level, it grants the Sword of Humanity limitless power.
According to the System, although the Sword of Humanity is still a Heaven Immortal Weapon, its might is comparable to many True Immortal Weapons.
With one swing, the sword opens the heavens and earth, cutting down all enemies under the sky!
“Oh, how terrifying~”
Looking at the Sword of Humanity suspended before him, Han Li was filled with many emotions.
In the next instant, the Sword of Humanity burst with radiance, the immortal light stirred the ninth heaven, and a figure stepped out, standing before Han Li.
She was the Sword Spirit of the Sword of Humanity, dressed in multicolored Immortal clothes, with a delicate and curvaceous body, perfect and stirring curves, a peerlessly beautiful face, and an air of graceful nobility.
To Han Li, she felt like a combination of a mature woman and an empress—elegant, pure, lofty, looking down upon all living beings with a face untroubled by the birth and death of the heavens, remaining calm and composed.
“Master~”
The Sword Spirit of the Sword of Humanity moved gracefully toward Han Li, her lips parting slightly, her tone soft.
Han Li’s pupils constricted, he admitted, at that moment, he was moved.
That the Artifact Spirit of the Sword of Humanity would call him master sent a unique thrill through Han Li’s heart.
In terms of looks, temperament, and figure, the Sword Spirit of the Sword of Humanity was the highest, best, and most perfect Han Li had ever encountered.
“Hahaha~”
With a sudden laugh, Han Li asked, “Do you have a name?”
The Sword Spirit of the Sword of Humanity nodded gently, her soft voice replying, “Master can call me… Xi Yue.”
“That’s a beautiful name,” Han Li complimented without stinginess.
After communicating with the Sword Spirit Xi Yue, Han Li gained a detailed understanding of the specific powers of the Sword of Humanity, and his mind was greatly at ease, the previous nervousness gone without a trace.
If the Sword of Humanity were to unleash its full power, it indeed could explode with True Immortal level combat ability and even slay True Immortals, unmatched in might; even if only partially awakened, it could still unleash Heaven Immortal level combat ability, and no ordinary Heavenly Immortal could withstand the Sword of Humanity’s conquest.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 493: 219 Sword Spirit Xi Yue! Immortal Realm? Prison Land? Reporting to the Ancestor, someone is hijacking the wedding!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Chapter 219 Sword Spirit Xi Yue! Immortal Realm? Prison Land? Reporting to the Ancestor, someone is hijacking the wedding!_2
Although powerful, replenishing energy is a major problem.
Han Mansion lacked cultivation resources like Immortal Stones and Immortal Crystals, which contained pure Immortal Qi. Even if the Lower Grade Emperor Level Dragon Vein of Han Mansion was completely exhausted, it still could not fully replenish the energy of the Human Path Sword.
According to the Sword Spirit Xi Yue, she could now only fully activate the Human Path Sword once, or allow it to partially recover three to five times.
If it were just a sliver of power that needed to be unleashed, there wouldn’t be a problem, as the Human Path Sword could draw Immortal Qi from the depths of the void to replenish its energy.
To rely on the Human Path Sword’s automatic charging, it would take three thousand years to fully charge once, after all, times have changed.
“Xi Yue, don’t worry about these matters, I’ll solve them for you,” Han Li boasted confidently.
This Heavenly Immortal Weapon, comparable to a True Immortal Weapon, was Han Li’s most powerful trump card, and he naturally would not use it lightly, only deploying it at critical moments. Generally, it would suffice to partially revive the Human Path Sword’s power.
All the Great Holy Land Schools in Qianyuan Divine Province had Heavenly Immortal Weapons, and Bai Yujing might even possess True Immortal Weapons. The forty-two Emperor Level powers of the Endless Yuankun Domain also had Heavenly Immortal Weapons and True Immortal Weapons.
But they faced the same problem as Han Li, the inability to effectively recharge, and dared not easily awaken their Immortal Weapons – these were their trump cards.
With the Human Path Sword, Han Li suddenly felt full of confidence – so what if Empress Fengyue or Empress Yuanchu came knocking? Everyone had True Immortal Rank trump cards – who would be scared of whom?
With the Human Path Sword, a Heavenly Immortal Weapon, stationed at Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li was not afraid of other Great Holy Land Schools like Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, or Heavenly Demon Hall, even Bai Yujing posed no fear to him.
At this moment, the foundation of Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain surged; with a Human Path Sword that could match the combat ability of True Immortals and six Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapons, they could stand on equal footing with Bai Yujing.
Now that Han Li had revealed his identity, schools like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, and other Great Holy Land Schools could only begrudgingly acknowledge the status of Chengsheng Mountain. Still, Han Li had no intentions of revealing himself. Being a shadow ruler wasn’t bad either, quietly developing behind the scenes, and if anything happened, Bai Yujing and the other Sacred Lands would bear the brunt.
“Thank you, Master,” the gentle voice of the Sword Spirit Xi Yue rang out, causing Han Li’s heart to waver.
Han Li nodded slightly and then said, “Go meet with them.”
“Alright,”
Xi Yue returned to the Human Path Sword, and in the next instant, the Human Path Sword disappeared from the summit of Chengdao Peak, arriving at the special spacetime where the Void Bell, Time-Sky Tower, Emperor Flag, and other Emperor Weapons were located.
Zi Yi, Shi Qi, Yin Ling, and other Emperor Weapon Artifact Spirits of the Heaven Imperial Realm immediately flew out, gaping at the Human Path Sword and Xi Yue, their pretty faces filled with shock.
Then, Zi Yi, Shi Qi, Yin Ling, and the other female spirits exclaimed in unison, “Greetings, Sister~”
As Artifact Spirits of Emperor Weapons, they could clearly feel the imposing pressure emanating from the Human Path Sword and Xi Yue – an aura exclusive to Immortal Weapons.
….
At the summit of Chengdao Peak,
Han Li was still reveling in the joy of obtaining the Immortal Weapon, the Human Path Sword.
He had promised to solve the energy replenishment problem for Sword Spirit Xi Yue. Han Li currently couldn’t achieve this, but he had the system, which would surely be able to help; it all depended on when the system would provide him with something useful.
“How did those Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals from the Ancient Era and even more distant times cultivate?” Han Li suddenly pondered this question.
The Endless Yuankun Domain had Immortals, yet there was no Immortal Qi, an obvious inconsistency.
If there truly existed an Immortal Realm above this world, filled with countless Immortals and saturated with Immortal Qi in every inch of space, then those Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals of the Endless Yuankun Domain were merely lingering in the lower realm, aiming to reign supreme here.
However, Han Li felt this was unlikely.
Every era in the Endless Yuankun Domain faced a great calamity, and even Heavenly and True Immortals would perish, unable to withstand the resurgence of the Xuanshen Sword Mountain’s sword light.
Those Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals lingering in the lower realms would be courting death – upon becoming Immortal, one’s lifespan would be exceedingly long, even a Heavenly Immortal could live for an eon, which was one billion, two hundred ninety-six million years.
The lifespan of True Immortal powerhouses was ten times longer, allowing them to live for tens of billions of years.
If they lingered in the lower realms, they would only live for one era, just over two hundred million years – that would be nothing short of seeking death.
Han Li believed that if there indeed was an Immortal Realm, then those Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals would have ascended long ago to enjoy their blessings.
“Could this world itself be the Immortal Realm? Or perhaps a world similar to the Immortal Realm, where Immortals can exist…”
Han Li’s brows knit together in a ‘川’ shape as he fell into deep thought.
Han Li thought this was quite possible. If this were the lower realm, then those Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals who did not ascend would typically face rejection from this realm. But, as far as he understood, there was no such rejection.
This suggested that the world he resided in was of a high order, capable of accommodating powerful beings like Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals without limiting their powers.
Yet the Endless Yuankun Domain lacked Immortal Qi, which was most peculiar.
Without Immortal Qi, how did those Heavenly Immortal powerhouses manage to cultivate to the True Immortal Realm?
If they absorbed Immortal Qi only from the deep void, that would be far too slow. Such a method could not even compensate for their consumption, let alone allow for cultivation to higher realms.
“It seems that those Great Holy Land Schools still have their secrets,” Han Li murmured to himself.
This must be a core secret of the Great Holy Land Schools, involving how those sanctuaries’ Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals continued to exist and cultivate.
But all of this seems to have been buried with the Ancient Era, leading to the current scarcity among the Great Holy Land Schools. They dare not recklessly use Immortal Weapons and cannot easily recharge them without incurring a great cost.
It could also be possible that such a method could only be used after becoming an Immortal. Without Immortals in the world after the Ancient Era, the Great Holy Land Schools naturally also lost their channels of Immortal Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 494: 219 Sword Spirit Xi Yue! Immortal Realm? Prison Land? Reporting to the Ancestor, someone is hijacking the wedding!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 494: Chapter 219 Sword Spirit Xi Yue! Immortal Realm? Prison Land? Reporting to the Ancestor, someone is hijacking the wedding!_3
He sighed, Han Li gathered his thoughts, and his gaze drifted eastward, where he longed to behold the distant Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
Here, he was immeasurable distances away from the Xuanshen Sword Mountain, and Han Li had thought it impossible to see it. But it seemed that whenever he contemplated Xuanshen Sword Mountain, and looked eastward again, he would sense the majestic vastness of that very mountain.
In a flash, a divine mountain of seemingly infinite height emerged before Han Li’s eyes, becoming ever more magnificent and colossal, drawing ever nearer, and exerting such great pressure on Han Li’s primordial spirit, physical body, and even true spirit that they almost disintegrated.
Shaken, Han Li hurriedly circulated his cultivation technique. His primordial spirit shone with a brilliant light, severing the thought, and he turned his head away from the east.
“What kind of level does the Xuanshen Sword Mountain belong to among immortal swords?” Han Li muttered to himself, still feeling the aftereffects of his shock, with an unsightly expression on his face.
He had only entertained the thought momentarily. Even without the Xuanshen Sword Mountain being fully awakened, it almost obliterated him across the endless span of time and space. Had he not reacted promptly, he would be dead by now.
Renowned as an immortal sword, the Human Path Sword’s might is comparable to that of the True Immortal Realm, but it does not possess such combat ability. Indeed, the difference is vast.
After taking a deep breath of spiritual energy to calm his mind, Han Li came up with another thought.
The Endless Yuankun Domain might be isolated, and the supreme immortal sword that transformed into the Xuanshen Sword Mountain might be what separates it.
It appears that the Endless Yuankun Domain is a land of imprisonment!
Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, and even True Immortals dwelling in the Endless Yuankun Domain are harvested once every epoch without exception, their lives and daos extinguishing.
The great dao has fifty, heaven extends with forty-nine, there is always a glimmer of hope in all things, and it seems that the predicament of the Endless Yuankun Domain is no different.
There are three ancient pathways on Xuanshen Sword Mountain, and anyone who passes the trials can leave the Endless Yuankun Domain for the boundless world beyond.
Perhaps this sliver of hope was utilized by the Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals, allowing them to continuously acquire vast quantities of immortal qi and cultivate to even higher realms.
“Forget it, don’t think about it.”
Han Li sighed, severing all thoughts and entering a state of emptiness.
His cultivation level hadn’t reached that stage yet, pondering these things was useless. When his strength had grown enough, he would find a way to deal with whatever came his way.
Afterward, Han Li’s divine sense surged, sending a message to Long Yue, asking her to come up to him.
The next moment, Long Yue’s figure appeared on Chengdao Peak, standing beside Han Li. Draped in a light-colored flowing gown, her exquisite curves were revealed without reservation.
“My husband, is there something you need?”
Long Yue looked at Han Li, puzzled, a myriad of thoughts flashing through her mind as she guessed the reason he had called her up.
“Yue’er, I have good news. Our Chengsheng Mountain now possesses an Immortal Weapon,” Han Li said with a smile, drawing Long Yue into his embrace and holding her delicate body close.
“An Immortal Weapon?”
Long Yue’s pupils contracted sharply, her eyes filled with shock and disbelief.
Her husband had obtained an Immortal Weapon so quietly, it was simply too incredible, too astonishing.
She did not doubt that Han Li was lying, but rather, she was curious about how he had managed to do it.
An Immortal Weapon was a symbol of the Great Holy Land Schools, representing their strongest foundation. With an Immortal Weapon, Chengsheng Mountain could henceforth consider itself a Sacred Land.
However, Immortal Weapons were extremely rare, and gaining recognition from one was even harder. Yet her husband had succeeded.
In an instant, Long Yue understood why her husband had been so happy earlier, why he had exchanged daos with Nangong Xue for two hours, and why he had called her up.
In the previous years, her husband had accompanied her to the depths of the East Sea, to the Penglai Immortal Sect. They paid a heavy price and finally obtained the Eight Colorful Loaches from the old hermit of Guanhai.
However, that Old Guanhai, with his benign appearance and nefarious heart, did not reveal the grave hidden danger in the Eight Colorful Loaches. Or perhaps, he did it deliberately, aiming to trap Long Yue unawares.
Fortunately, her husband noticed that something was amiss. The Artifact Spirit of the Void Bell, Zi Yi, conducted a thorough investigation and eventually uncovered the hidden danger.
If she had assimilated those Eight Colorful Loaches, she would have suffered greatly, falling into the trap without realizing it, and becoming a devoted follower of the Penglai Immortal Sect.
To resist the temptation, Long Yue gave the Eight Colorful Loaches to Han Li for safekeeping.
Her husband had said that once they possessed an Immortal Weapon, they would attempt to let the Immortal Weapon eradicate all the hidden dangers so she could assimilate them without concern.
After the initial surprise, a hesitant look appeared on Long Yue’s flawless face. She sighed, “My husband, wouldn’t it be too costly for the Immortal Weapon to take action? Maybe we should wait. I’m not in a rush right now.”
She knew well the foundations of Chengsheng Mountain; even with an Immortal Weapon, they couldn’t use it recklessly, just like the Sacred Land schools. After all, Chengsheng Mountain also lacked resources for the Immortal Weapon’s energy replenishment.
The danger within the Eight Colorful Loaches was left by an old Heavenly Immortal ancestor of the Penglai Immortal Sect. To eradicate it, the Immortal Weapon would need to be revived, consuming a significant amount of energy.
She had only just broken through to the Divine Yuan Realm and was far from the time when she needed to assimilate the Eight Colorful Loaches, which required traversing to the Tongxuan Realm. Therefore, Long Yue was not in a hurry.
If her husband could obtain an Immortal Weapon, in the coming years, he might well secure strategic resources like Immortal Stones or Immortal Crystals.
“There’s no need for that,” Han Li shook his head in refusal.
Han Li knew Long Yue’s concerns and explained with a smile, “To eliminate a danger left by a deceased Heavenly Immortal won’t consume much energy from the Immortal Weapon.”
While the Human Path Sword was a Heavenly Immortal weapon, its might rivaled that of True Immortal weapons. Partially reviving its power would suffice to slay an ordinary Heavenly Immortal. For dealing with a mere trap left by a Heavenly Immortal, even less power was needed for the revival.

chapters.title: Chapter 495: 219 Sword Spirit Xi Yue! Immortal Realm? Prison Land? Reporting to the Ancestor, someone is hijacking the wedding!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 495: Chapter 219 Sword Spirit Xi Yue! Immortal Realm? Prison Land? Reporting to the Ancestor, someone is hijacking the wedding!_4
Han Li had already discussed this matter with the Sword Spirit Xi Yue and only after receiving Xi Yue’s reply did he feel so confident.
“Xi Yue.”
Han Li called out softly.
In the next instant, a divine light descended, and the graceful and luxurious Sword Spirit Xi Yue appeared before Han Li and Long Yue.
“Greetings, Master, Mistress.”
Xi Yue bowed slightly, her expression gentle and her posture elegant.
Having communicated with Zi Yi, Shi Qi, Yin Ling, and others, she was fully aware of everything concerning Chengsheng Mountain and naturally recognized who Long Yue was.
Looking at the flawless Xi Yue, Long Yue’s mouth fell open slightly, and a look of surprise surfaced on her pure and white face.
A spirit of an Immortal Weapon could actually be so stunning!
In Xi Yue’s presence, Long Yue felt somewhat ashamed of herself. She knew that her looks, temperament, and physique could all be ranked in the top five on Chengsheng Mountain. Even women like Xue Yueqing and Ling Lingshuang were only on par with her.
The husband is fortunate indeed…
This thought crossed Long Yue’s mind.
She was aware that her husband had already laid hands on Artifact Spirits like Yue Ji, Yin Ling, and Shi Qi, and had it not been for other women like Zi Yi and JianJi not having evolved, he probably would have made his move already.
Now that they had an Immortal Weapon, and Xi Yue with it, her husband probably couldn’t hold back any longer.
However, Long Yue wasn’t sure if Xi Yue would allow her husband to proceed in such a manner. It would be a loss if Xi Yue got angry, so Long Yue planned to find an opportunity to remind Han Li.
Han Li took out the loach, which had already evolved from a Seven Colorful Loach to an Eight Colorful Loach, and indeed, it had a great connection with Long Yue. As Long Yue broke through to the Divine Yuan Realm, the loach evolved as well.
“Let’s start.”
Han Li’s voice sounded.
Long Yue also looked over with anticipation, feeling a bit nervous in her heart.
The sacred and noble Xi Yue nodded slightly, extending her fair and slender right hand, beckoning gently.
A beam of sword light fell from the ninth heaven, without revealing any might, aiming precisely at the Eight Colorful Loach.
At that moment, a trace of panic appeared in the eyes of the Eight Colorful Loach as it sensed the crisis. The hidden Heavenly Immortal technique inside it burst forth.
But under the might of the Sword of Humanity, this concealed Heavenly Immortal technique was of no use, easily extinguished by the sword light, and the hidden troubles within the Eight Colorful Loach were erased as well.
The sentience in the eyes of the Eight Colorful Loach dissipated, and it became muddled again, wandering aimlessly.
Han Li looked towards Long Yue, and Long Yue extended her hand to beckon the Eight Colorful Loach to her.
Long Yue instantly felt a vibration of her bloodline and thought emerged from the depths of her heart, the desire to devour and refine the Eight Colorful Loach to replenish and enhance the origin of her own bloodline.
“Go ahead.”
Han Li said with a smile.
The sooner Long Yue refined the Eight Colorful Loach, the more her source would surge, potentially triggering a new evolution.
Han Li was curious if Long Yue would be able to possess a True Dragon Bloodline ahead of schedule. Even if she didn’t reach that level, getting close would also be splendid.
With that, there would likely be no obstacles for Long Yue’s future ascent to the realm of a Quasi Emperor. Even breaking through to the Heaven Imperial Realm, mastering the Heavenly Sovereign Path, and achieving Great Emperor status, would also be a significant possibility.
“Mhm.”
Long Yue nodded vigorously and then disappeared from sight.
……
East Sea, Penglai Immortal Sect.
“Not good!”
On top of Penglai Divine Mountain, Guanhai the Taoist suddenly cried out in alarm, his tone filled with anger, as his terrifying aura surged out, stirring the clouds.
“It’s you again, ruining my plans!”
Fury flashed across Guanhai’s face as he instantly understood what had happened.
The Heavenly Immortal Ancestor had left a contingency within the Seven Colorful Loach and had passed down some controlling techniques. As the ruler of the Penglai Immortal Sect, Guanhai naturally knew of it.
After the Seven Colorful Loach was returned to Long Yue, he had intended to use these hidden techniques to sense its location and spy on the identity of that mysterious Tongxuan Realm expert, but he had failed.
Han Li had shielded the Heavenly fate and cause with an Emperor’s Weapon throughout the whole process and then discarded the Seven Colorful Loach into the System Space, completely cutting off all detection.
Previously, when the Seven Colorful Loach was taken out, several Emperor’s Weapons and Immortal Weapons were present, blocking everything, and Guanhai didn’t notice.
But when the Heavenly Immortal Ancestor’s contingency was erased, Guanhai sensed it.
“Seems to be in the Xuan Domain?”
Guanhai the Taoist looked towards Qianyuan Divine Province, his expression filled with shock and uncertainty. He had only sensed a vague direction for a moment before it was abruptly cut off.
“No matter who you are, there will be no good end for you.”
Guanhai the Taoist muttered expressionlessly to himself, then turned his gaze towards the Bai Yujing, hesitating before finally making a decision.
He had always suspected that the mysterious Tongxuan Realm power and the one who captured Ling Lingshuang were the same person, but had never found a trace. Now that fate had revealed itself for a moment, he must investigate.
However, it would be dangerous for him to go alone; he needed to make a trip to Bai Yujing and convince his old nemesis.
Time hurried by.
Half a month later,
At Chengsheng Mountain, Yundao Peak.
Han Li called over all the principal members of the Han Mansion, all of them his capable descendants who were diligently managing the family affairs, such as Han Yongfan, Han Yongjin, Han Yongkang, and others.
“I’ve called you all here today to discuss a matter with you,” Han Li said in a deep voice, looking over the descendants in the Yundao Hall.
Han Yongfan, Han Yongjin, Han Yongkang, and the others immediately perked up, listening attentively, not daring to miss a single word.
At the same time, they were curious about what matter their father valued so highly.
“I plan to send some of the Han Mansion’s descendants to establish themselves in other places of the Xuan Domain, such as Da Jing Empire, Da Liang Empire, Ancient Empire, Qitian Teaching, and Emperor Wu’s City, to spread our branches and leaves. What are your thoughts?”

chapters.title: Chapter 496: 219 Sword Spirit Xi Yue! Immortal Realm? Prison Land? Reporting to the Ancestor, someone is hijacking the wedding!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 496: Chapter 219 Sword Spirit Xi Yue! Immortal Realm? Prison Land? Reporting to the Ancestor, someone is hijacking the wedding!_5
Han Li sighed and said.
He had intended to make a decision directly, but after some thought, he still discussed it with his descendants.
With the cultivation environment of Han Mansion now so superior, even better than those of the Great Holy Land Schools, he wanted to let some descendants branch out to other places. He feared none of them would be willing.
Why stay in the harsh cultivation environment outside without any safety guarantee when one can stay at Chengsheng Mountain?
Han Li did this only to spread out the risks. Even though he had the Township Sword, a clan-suppressing immortal weapon, who knew if there might be accidents.
“We’ll listen to Father,”
said Han Yongjin and others in unison.
Han Li frowned slightly, displeased, “I want to hear your true thoughts.”
Han Yongkang, Han Yongfan, and the others exchanged glances, then someone timidly said, “Father, I’m afraid no one would be willing to do this?”
In fact, they did not agree with this matter. If they were chosen, then they would be the ones to suffer, but they did not dare to oppose it openly.
The others also spoke up, circling around the subject to imply their disagreement.
“Enough, discuss this matter among yourselves first and see how it can be implemented. There’s no rush for now,”
Han Li said, shaking his head. His figure disappeared from Yundao Hall, not insisting on his own way.
Upon hearing this, Han Yongjin and the others sighed in relief.
……
Da Liang Empire.
Tian Ya Sect.
Tian Ya Sect was one of the most powerful sects in the Da Liang Empire, strong enough to rank within the top three of the empire, with three Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm backing the sect. Its power was extraordinary.
At this moment, in the main hall where Tian Ya Sect held discussions, resounding and forceful voices rose, each statement landing with weight.
“Since when did Tian Ya Sect become such a sycophantic power? Only knowing how to flatter and fawn, begging Chengsheng Mountain like tail-wagging dogs?”
“Knowing full well it’s a pit of fire, yet still forcing Sister Qingxuan to marry into Chengsheng Mountain. Is this the true face of one of the three strongest sects of the Da Liang Empire? I am truly disappointed!”
This resolute-faced youth clenched his fists, berating the entire hall, his tone filled with indignation, before turning to look at that exquisitely beautiful figure standing at the front of the hall, saying:
“Sister Qingxuan, I know you are being forced. You don’t wish to marry into Chengsheng Mountain, and today I am willing to seek justice for you.”
The youth was named Lin Xiao, a core disciple of Tian Ya Sect with cultivation at the God Refining Realm.
Lu Qingxuan, with eyes like autumn waters, showed no ripples of emotion, her face expressionless. She did not turn around or respond.
“How dare you!”
A furious shout erupted, and an inner sect Elder looked at Lin Xiao with a cold face, his formidable presence bearing down on him.
“How undignified, to roar in the grand hall!”
“Sister Qingxuan’s marriage to Chengsheng Mountain is a decision made collectively by the Sect Leader and all Elders, and she herself has agreed. By talking back to the sect’s upper echelons here, are you seeking death?”
Having Lu Qingxuan marry into Chengsheng Mountain was beneficial for both her and Tian Ya Sect. It was supposed to be a joyous occasion for all, yet someone opposed it, and it was just a mere core disciple.
What would that do to the face of the Sect Leader and the Elders?
The Sect Leader of Tian Ya Sect and many Elders watched Lin Xiao with cold eyes. For a disciple who did not recognize the bigger picture and pursued only personal benefits, even if talented, they had already pronounced his death sentence.
Outside the grand hall, many core disciples watched, looking at Lin Xiao as if he were a fool. They pointed and whispered among themselves, with none in support of him.
Some had courted Lu Qingxuan, but the overwhelming trend could not be resisted. Lu Qingxuan’s marriage to Chengsheng Mountain also brought them significant benefits.
With the Sect Leader and all Elders having made a decision, Lin Xiao’s opposition was like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.
“Sister Qingxuan, are you willing to leave with me?”
Amidst the noisy chatter around him and suppressing the oppressive aura of a Guru in the Void Realm, Lin Xiao’s complexion grew red as he called out loudly.
He would not bow his head; he would not shrink back. He was determined to take the Sister Qingxuan he loved and flee far away.
Lin Xiao also believed he had the strength to back up his bold actions.
“Lin Xiao, you are being too presumptuous. Dare to speak another word and I will cripple your cultivation and expel you from the sect,”
another inner sect Elder spoke out, his tone cold to the extreme. He was Lin Xiao’s master.
He thought Lin Xiao’s actions were unwise. Even if dissatisfied, one had to endure and speak out only when one’s cultivation was stronger. Acting like this now was courting death.
Knowing that the Sect Leader and others had already condemned Lin Xiao to death, he intended to save Lin Xiao’s life in consideration of their master-disciple relationship, hence he spoke so.
Lin Xiao looked at him deeply, then at the stunning back of Lu Qingxuan, his face filled with frustration and humiliation, and he shouted angrily:
“Today, I leave Tian Ya Sect. The humiliation Tian Ya Sect has brought upon me, Lin Xiao will remember, and one day, I shall return it a hundredfold!”
“Courting death!”
The inner sect elder who initially spoke couldn’t hold back anymore, reaching out his hand towards Lin Xiao, attempting to suppress and kill him.
No one stopped him; they just watched silently.
“Hahaha~ You think you can kill me?”
Lin Xiao burst into wild laughter, an equally domineering aura exploding from within him, not at all inferior to the assaulting inner sect elder.
He was actually a Guru in the Hollow Void Stage!
The two clashed with one move; Lin Xiao didn’t take a single step back, his gaze maliciously fixed on the inner sect elder, as if he had just added him to his must-kill list.
“What a pity.”
