The Second Elder of Tian Ya Sect sighed and struck out a palm towards Lin Xiao.
Lin Xiao’s face changed; this was a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, he couldn’t block it now.
“Young master is leaving, I will remember this grudge, this humiliation,” Lin Xiao said.
Without any hesitation, another powerful force surged into his body, causing Lin Xiao to emit an even more formidable aura, seemingly on par with a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
He unleashed one strike, fending off the Second Elder and, before the other powerhouses could react, his figure disappeared from the main hall where the council was held.
“Chase!”
The Sect Leader said without any expression.
The Great Elder and Second Elder sighed and vanished in pursuit of Lin Xiao.
Although they didn’t know why Lin Xiao was able to emit an aura like that of a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, they were certain that the secret technique couldn’t last long. Having offended the entire Tian Ya Sect, he couldn’t be allowed to live.
They feared Lin Xiao might interfere with the marriage procession and were also concerned about the possibility of his future revenge, so they had to eradicate him completely.
Assisted by another strong force within him, Lin Xiao fled swiftly without daring to stop, sensing that two Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm were pursuing him from behind.
He had to quickly shake off the pursuit; he couldn’t use this great force for too long, otherwise, how would he have the strength to disrupt the wedding?
That’s right, Lin Xiao was indeed planning to disrupt the wedding!
He firmly believed that Sister Lu Qingxuan was being forced, and that she remained silent earlier because of the pressure from the Sect Leader and the Elders.
In the future, he would return for revenge, he had the potential, he had the confidence.
The mere Tian Ya Sect was nothing; once he fully matured, he could crush them with a flick of his hand.
Now, he needed to find a chance to whisk Sister Qingxuan away and then elope with her, to live together from then on, enjoying a carefree life as a couple.
Memories of his past with Lu Qingxuan surfaced in Lin Xiao’s mind, believing that Sister Qingxuan had feelings for him too.
Actually, Lu Qingxuan had always been indifferent towards him, treating him only as a junior brother, but Lin Xiao didn’t see it that way.
With his aptitude, he could have joined a much more powerful faction, but for the sake of the one he admired from the first sight, Lu Qingxuan, he joined Tian Ya Sect, a force of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
“Sister Qingxuan, wait for me,” Lin Xiao murmured softly.
“Silly boy, don’t wait or not wait, run now!”
The next moment, a voice echoed in Lin Xiao’s mind, snapping him out of his momentary distraction.
“Lin Xiao, where do you think you’re running to?”
A figure appeared in front of Lin Xiao; it was the Great Elder of Tian Ya Sect, who coldly shouted.
In an instant, a terrifying aura pressed down on Lin Xiao, his own martial intent also striking out, as he threw a punch with the intention of suppressing and killing Lin Xiao.
Not far behind him, the Second Elder had caught up, holding a Lower Grade Heaven Rank treasure blade, he chopped down at Lin Xiao without any reservations.
Facing this situation, Lin Xiao could only resist fiercely; there was no escape, he was tightly ensnared.
Against two Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, Lin Xiao was no match and quickly fell into a disadvantage, surrounded by dangers.
“Sigh~”
A sigh rang out in Lin Xiao’s mind, and the following instant, the owner of that voice forcibly took control of Lin Xiao’s body, unleashing even greater combat prowess.
Before long, an opportunity was found to repel the Great Elder and Second Elder, and Lin Xiao disappeared without a trace.
The two Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm chased for a while but, finding that Lin Xiao’s trace had vanished, had no choice but to return.

chapters.title: Chapter 497: 220: Lin Xiao and His Great-Grandfather! Han Laozu Strikes, Killing with a Flick, Gaining a Huge Surprise!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 497: Chapter 220: Lin Xiao and His Great-Grandfather! Han Laozu Strikes, Killing with a Flick, Gaining a Huge Surprise!_1
Chengsheng Mountain, Yundao Peak.
“Elder Ancestor, someone is trying to hijack the marriage,”
Han Shigao briskly walked into Yundao Hall and said, bowing toward the figure deep within the great hall.
He was Han Li’s grandson; his father was Han Yongfu, and Han Yongfu was the eldest son of Wu Yalin, Han Li’s second concubine.
Originally, the aptitudes of early descendants like Han Yongfu and Han Shigao were rather poor, virtually negligible or of ninth grade, and their cultivation levels were also low.
Now, after much hardship, the early concubines and descendants of Han Li all saw an improvement in their aptitudes to fifth grade and above, and their cultivation advanced by leaps and bounds.
Take Han Shigao, for example, one of the more outstanding individuals of the Han Family’s third generation. He received Han Li’s attention from an early age and was given many advantages, which made him far more exceptional than his peers.
At seventy-five, Han Shigao possessed fourth grade aptitude and had reached the pinnacle of the God Refining Realm, even surpassing his father, Han Yongfu.
Having grown up in the Han Mansion, Han Shigao had witnessed the family’s rapid rise to power firsthand, with the family’s growth far outpacing his own cultivation speed.
Han Li held deep authority within the Han Mansion. All descendants held him in reverence, commonly addressing him as Elder Ancestor in formal settings, and were more intimate in private.
Counting from Han Li’s generation, the Han Mansion had already developed to the seventh generation. In another ten years, perhaps even less, the Han Mansion would see the birth of the eighth generation.
Han Li had sons, grandsons, great-grandsons, and great-great-grandsons among his many descendants. They each had different familiar terms for him: father, grandfather, great-grandfather, great-great-grandfather, heavenly ancestor, and fierce ancestor, to name a few.
When Han Li’s first great-great-grandson was born, his rank would rise to that of the great progenitor. As the ninth and tenth generations were born, additional titles like the primal ancestor and the origin ancestor would be added to his names.
“Hijack the marriage? Whose marriage?”
Han Li, with hands clasped behind his back, turned around, a hint of surprise flashing in his eyes. Such scenarios seemed quite unheard of in these times, tsk tsk.
He assumed that one of his descendants was encountering a marriage hijack while taking a wife or concubine. It couldn’t possibly be his own marriage; after all, who would dare to do so? He was Han Li, the revered Elder Ancestor who commanded respect across the Xuan Domain.
Han Shigao kept his head lowered and spoke with extreme caution, “Elder Ancestor, it’s your marriage that someone is trying to hijack…”
Even Han Shigao was taken aback upon receiving this news. Having organized so many weddings for his grandfather, he had never come across a marriage hijack before.
From Leizhou’s Lingjun City to Yuanzhou’s Chengsheng Mountain, Grandfather’s marriage prospects came from forces in the Innate Realm to those from the True Martial Realm; everything had always gone smoothly, with no one foolish enough to seek death.
Even top-tier Xuan Domain forces like the Da Jing Empire and Emperor Wu’s City had offered women to the Elder Ancestor without any incidents. Yet, here was Tian Ya Sect, a Myriad Phenomena Realm force under the Da Liang Empire, actually daring to oppose their marriage, even harboring thoughts of hijacking it.
“Go on in detail,”
Han Li laughed, sensing a good story brewing.
From his experience, the one wishing to hijack the marriage could very well be a child of fortune, possibly leading to quite the melodramatic turn of events.
It was a fool’s errand for an antagonist to continuously send disposable lackeys to their deaths, equipping the protagonist and watching them rapidly grow stronger, all while waiting for that protagonist to strike them down. That was a move only a foolish villain would make.
Having become the “antagonist,” Han Li had no intention of playing along in any drama with a child of fortune. He was very straightforward, preferring to personally eliminate any danger in its infancy.
There might even be some unexpected gains.
“Elder Ancestor, Tian Ya Sect under the Da Liang Empire has sent a messenger, saying…” Han Shigao recounted the events precisely as they had happened.
After failing to eliminate Lin Xiao, Tian Ya Sect sent a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster to Chengsheng Mountain in haste to notify them, hoping to alert them to send someone to receive the bridal procession.
Tian Ya Sect had three Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters, with an even stronger late-phase Myriad Phenomena Realm practitioner as Sect Leader. But with one of the Great Grandmasters needed to guard the Sect, only two could be sent for the bridal procession. Given the goal’s vast distance, over eight million miles away, Tian Ya Sect feared unexpected mishaps.
Lin Xiao, known for his eccentricities and his infatuation with Lu Qingxuan, had even abandoned Tian Ya Sect. After deliberation, they believed Lin Xiao intended to hijack the marriage, and should he ally with enemy forces, the bridal procession might face complications.
When Lin Xiao joined the sect, his aptitude was only of fifth grade, and he did not stand out normally. This year, he revealed cultivation at the first layer of the God Refining Realm and was promoted to Core Disciple.
Without this incident, Tian Ya Sect would have remained ignorant that Lin Xiao had quietly advanced to the middle phase of the Hollow Void Stage, and could even temporarily exert the combat ability of a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster using a certain secret technique to escape from the main hall and successfully flee from the hands of the two Great Grandmasters.
“Interesting, really interesting,” Han Li chuckled softly, his face revealing genuine interest.
Lin Xiao hailed from a minor place in the Da Liang Empire, came from a declining small family, and fought his way through numerous trials to secure the tenth place and enter Tian Ya Sect…
Considering the words Lin Xiao spoke in Tian Ya Sect’s main hall, Han Li found it difficult to believe that this Lin Xiao wasn’t a child of fortune.
“Elder Ancestor, should we send someone to receive the bride?” Han Shigao inquired.
The hidden strength of the Han Mansion was formidable, but it couldn’t be gratuitously exposed. Nonetheless, even by revealing just the tip of the iceberg of its power, the Han Mansion was more than capable of handling this matter.
Ever since the Elder Ancestor demonstrated his True Martial Realm strength and the identity of a reincarnated powerful being and obtained the backing of Elder Bai Yujing, a multitude of Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters had joined Chengsheng Mountain.
Within just a few months, eight Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters had pledged allegiance, all of whom could be sent. Simply dispatching a few Great Grandmasters to the Da Liang Empire for the bridal procession would suffice.

chapters.title: Chapter 498: 220: Lin Xiao and His Great-Grandfather! Han Laozu Strikes, Killing with a Flick, Gaining a Huge Surprise!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: Chapter 220: Lin Xiao and His Great-Grandfather! Han Laozu Strikes, Killing with a Flick, Gaining a Huge Surprise!_2
“`
“You don’t need to worry about this matter.”
Han Li waved his hand, encouraged Han Shigao a bit, and after rewarding him, Han Shigao left contentedly, his face flushed with joy.
Of course, such a matter required his personal attention!
If he sent a Guest Elder from Myriad Phenomena Realm, Han Li was certain that Lin Xiao would definitely be able to escape. Didn’t having that kind of capability make one deserving of the title ‘Child of Destiny’?
……..
Meanwhile, in the Da Liang Empire.
In a range of endless mountains, Lin Xiao, who had betrayed his Sect and escaped from the pursuit, hid here to heal his wounds.
He was only in the mid stages of the Hollow Void Stage, but his body was used by someone to fight against two Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm. Although he didn’t suffer any external injuries, he did sustain some internal ones.
“Hu~”
After circulating his Cultivation Technique through many heavenly cycles and successfully resolving his internal injuries, Lin Xiao’s breathing returned to its peak condition, and he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
“Tian Ya Sect!”
The thought of his beloved Sister Qingxuan being forced to marry an old ancestor from Han Mansion ignited a fiery blaze in Lin Xiao’s eyes, and rage surged within him.
“I won’t let you go!” Lin Xiao whispered fiercely.
When he rose to power, he vowed to personally destroy Tian Ya Sect. He even hated Chengsheng Mountain and Han Mansion; if not for the lecherous old ancestor of Han Mansion, the higher-ups of Tian Ya Sect wouldn’t have thought about offering up a girl in exchange for great benefits.
After standing quietly for a while, Lin Xiao prepared to leave. He needed to gather information and find out when Tian Ya Sect’s wedding procession would leave and what route they would take to Chengsheng Mountain.
Only then could he seize the opportunity to ambush them on their way and unexpectedly whisk away Sister Qingxuan.
“Stop!” A voice suddenly echoed in Lin Xiao’s mind.
Lin Xiao halted and said discontentedly, “Brother Hu, even you won’t help me?”
Brother Hu was his closest companion, who had accompanied him in his growth up to this point. His achievements today could be said to be inseparable from Brother Hu.
“Sigh~”
A sigh emerged from Lin Xiao’s chest where, if one were to strip away the clothing, a mark could be found, beautifully crafted like a small Jade Talisman.
Following that, the mark of the Jade Talisman glowed, and a hazy figure appeared beside Lin Xiao, that of a handsome young man dressed in yellow and white garments.
“Lin Xiao, it’s not that I don’t want to help you. Do you really know what you’re doing?” the handsome young man said gravely to Lin Xiao.
Lin Xiao snorted, “Of course, I do.”
Seeing his disgruntled face, the handsome young man gave a bitter smile and said with seriousness, “Lin Xiao, you don’t understand.”
“If you go through with this bride snatching, you will undoubtedly offend Tian Ya Sect and Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain. This is simply foolhardy.”
“Tian Ya Sect is not much of an issue; I can protect you. But as for Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, that’s a different story. That Han Li, he’s the reincarnation of an old monster and is stronger than I was at my peak.”
“Brother Hu, you’re overthinking it. I’ll make my move before Tian Ya Sect’s wedding convoy leaves the Da Liang Empire, then flee far away with Sister Qingxuan. If it really comes to it, we’ll just take refuge in the territories of Yinyang Sect or Kurong Sect. Would Han Li dare to come after me to kill me then?”
“Tian Ya Sect wants to form a marital alliance with Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain. If the bride doesn’t reach them, it’s no big deal to Han Li. Besides, Han Li has countless wives and concubines, surely he won’t miss Sister Qingxuan.”
Lin Xiao shook his head confidently. He had already thought it through and felt that Han Li probably wouldn’t pursue him. Even in the worst-case scenario, if he just fled into the territories of Yinyang Sect or Kurong Sect, he would be fine.
“Lin Xiao, Lin Xiao, Han Li is not as simple as you think,” the handsome young man continued to persuade.
“Despite Han Li’s low profile, he conceals great depth. His strength is definitely not just mid True Martial Realm, and his actions are notoriously ruthless. Just take Dugu Bing as a warning. We really can’t afford to provoke him now.”
“With Han Li taking so many wives, even powers of the True Martial Realm try to ingratiate themselves with him. It has never gone wrong. If you go through with this bride-snatching, it would be a slap in his face, and Han Li will not let you off easily.”
Seeing that Lin Xiao was dismissive and not taking his words to heart, the handsome young man sighed helplessly and decided to try a different angle. He said again,
“Lu Qingxuan doesn’t even like you. No matter what you do, it’s useless. Otherwise, why didn’t Lu Qingxuan speak up before?”
“She’s afraid to speak…” Lin Xiao said with less conviction.
“Marrying into Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain was Lu Qingxuan’s idea to begin with. She wanted to use it as a springboard to attempt breaking into the True Martial Realm. If you snatch her away, she will definitely not follow you but will hate you instead for your willful obstruction,” the handsome young man sighed.
Ever since he became bonded with Lin Xiao through the Jade Talisman, he had always been with Lin Xiao, residing within the Jade Charm Space, silently observing the outside world from within.
As the saying goes, those directly involved can’t see as clearly as those watching. From his observations, Lu Qingxuan indeed had no feelings for Lin Xiao; it was all one-sided on Lin Xiao’s part.
Lin Xiao was naive and fell for Lu Qingxuan at first sight, and her mere conversation with him caused his feelings for her to grow continuously.
He had told Lin Xiao this before, but Lin Xiao hadn’t taken him seriously, so he did not press further. After all, once Lin Xiao grew up, he would be capable of winning his ladylove.
But now, things are different, little brother.
Lin Xiao’s face turned red and his fists clenched. He wanted to argue back, but he felt so powerless. The truth was exactly as Brother Hu described.
Lin Xiao opened his mouth, remained silent for a moment, and then spoke, “That was before. Now that I have shown my strength and potential, Sister Qingxuan will choose me, because I can provide her with a better future.”
Even though Han Li is a reincarnated powerhouse, the True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, his future would at most revert to his peak strength, reaching the heights of a Tongxuan Realm power.
With Han Li already having countless wives and concubines, Lu Qingxuan won’t be given much attention if she marries into his household, and whether she can be trained into the True Martial Realm by Han Li remains uncertain.

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - 220: Lin Xiao and His Great-Grandfather! Han Laozu Strikes, Killing with a Flick, Gaining a Huge Surprise!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: Chapter 220: Lin Xiao and His Great-Grandfather! Han Laozu Strikes, Killing with a Flick, Gaining a Huge Surprise!_3
“`
But he was different.
According to Brother Hu, this Jade Talisman was at least an Emperor’s treasure. With the assistance of the Jade Talisman, his future achievements would definitely be above the Tongxuan Realm, and it was not impossible for him to become a Quasi Emperor or even a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Lu Qingxuan marrying him meant she would be his only Dao companion, and with his strong support, her future prospects would not just stop at the True Martial Realm, but reaching the Divine Yuan Realm or the Tongxuan Realm was also within the realm of possibility.
“Do you still want to go?”
“You must think carefully. If Han Li really comes to kill you, I can’t save you. By then, both of us could end up dead, and even the Jade Talisman would fall into Han Li’s hands.”
The handsome young man furrowed his brows tightly.
Lin Xiao looked directly into the handsome young man’s eyes and said firmly, “I want to give Sister Qingxuan a choice, and also find an answer for myself.”
The handsome young man sighed helplessly and said, “Since that’s the case, I’ll join you in this folly one more time.”
He knew that without getting a clear answer from Lu Qingxuan, Lin Xiao would not be able to let go.
He might as well let him go and sever the attachment so that he could focus on cultivation and reach the Saint Abyss Realm sooner.
If Han Li really did come to kill him, he was prepared to pay a certain price to get away. After all, at his peak, he was a Demon Emperor at the pinnacle of the Divine Yuan Realm, just half a step away from the Tongxuan Realm.
When the Jade Talisman first appeared, he had gone to fight for it and luckily obtained it. However, a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse suddenly attacked, and his body was destroyed while his Primordial Spirit was nearly annihilated.
In desperation, the last light of his Primordial Spirit fled into the Jade Talisman, and unexpectedly discovered the secret of the Jade Talisman. After activating it, he fled, traveling through space and time, and finally landed in the Xuan Domain of the Da Liang Empire in the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Activating the Jade Talisman consumed his last bit of strength, and the handsome young man fell into a deep sleep. Later, Lin Xiao stumbled upon the Jade Mansion, and with Lin Xiao’s help, he gradually recovered some strength.
A Saint in the Saint Abyss Realm has the amazing power to recreate a body. Originally, the handsome young man helped Lin Xiao with the intention that Lin Xiao would one day create a body for him when he rose to power. However, their relationship grew closer with time, and they even became sworn brothers.
Naturally, as the elder brother, he had to catch Lin Xiao when he acted recklessly.
……
Danyuan Mountain Range.
This was the border region of the Da Liang Empire. Although it didn’t share a border with the Daqian Empire, it was less than two million li away through a diagonal crossing.
However, the Kurong Sect and the Yinyang Sect had each annexed three provinces of the Daqian Empire’s territory, which made this region even more distant from the Daqian Empire.
In the distance, several figures flew in and landed on the main peak of the Danyuan Mountain Range for a temporary rest.
“Beyond this point is the territory of the Yinyang Sect. Let’s proceed according to our original plan,” said the leader, a Great Grandmaster from the Myriad Phenomena Realm, after sweeping his Spiritual Sense around and conducting a thorough investigation.
They were from the Tian Ya Sect, heading to Chengsheng Mountain as part of the wedding procession. There were only seven of them.
For safety, both the Great Elder and the Second Elder of the Tian Ya Sect were escorting the group, bringing only Lu Qingxuan, while the other four were Gurus in the Hollow Void Stage.
The Second Elder nodded somberly, “Lin Xiao wouldn’t be so foolish as to come and disrupt the wedding, would he?”
Upon hearing this, Lu Qingxuan’s delicate eyebrows slightly furrowed, but she said nothing. In her heart, she didn’t want Lin Xiao to cause trouble either; marrying into the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain was in everyone’s best interest.
Lin Xiao had shown that he was at the Hollow Void Stage, and considering his young age, his potential was indeed astonishing, but the highest he could achieve would be the True Martial Realm. Becoming an Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm? How difficult would that be?
For one Emperor Wu at the True Martial Realm to help another cultivator break through to the True Martial Realm would be extremely difficult, and Lin Xiao was not the reincarnation of a powerful being.
After all, a growing genius who hadn’t fully developed was nothing special.
“I actually hope he comes; it will be his time to die,” stated the Great Elder indifferently, a hint of murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
The failure to kill Lin Xiao still irked the Great Elder, making Lin Xiao a lingering threat to the Tian Ya Sect.
Only with Lin Xiao’s appearance could they eliminate the threat, allowing the Tian Ya Sect to rest easy.
“Indeed, the Great Elder speaks wisely.”
The other four Elders agreed wholeheartedly with this statement.
Lin Xiao had been lucky to escape last time, but if he dared to come again, he wouldn’t be so fortunate. Not to mention the vigilant protection of the two Great Grandmasters from the Myriad Phenomena Realm, the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain would also send people to partake in the wedding procession.
Facing this procession, the Yinyang Sect wouldn’t dare to cause trouble, otherwise the ancestor of the Han Mansion would be forced to draw his sword and march to their sect’s doors.
With the Demon Clan and the Heavenly Demon Hall backing the Yinyang Sect, Elder Bai Yujing from the Bai Yujing would support the ancestor of the Han Mansion as well. Neither the Sect Hierarch of the Yinyang Sect nor Dugu Bing were a match for the ancestor of the Han Mansion.
The Great Elder withdrew his Spiritual Sense, somewhat disappointed for not detecting Lin Xiao, and said, “Let’s go.”
The group turned into beams of light, pressing onward.
In another part of the Danyuan Mountain Range, Lin Xiao observed all this without showing any emotion. With Brother Hu and the Jade Mansion concealing him, even the Great Grandmasters from Myriad Phenomena Realm would fail to find him.
“It’s our turn to move.”
The voice of the handsome young man rang out, and Lin Xiao’s figure disappeared from the mountain.
He had already used his Divine Sense to scout the area, and within a radius of a hundred thousand li, there was no True Martial Realm, indicating that Han Li hadn’t come to welcome the bride. They were only forty thousand li away from entering Yinyang Sect territory, making it a prime opportunity for them to act.
In the Ninth Heaven,
Han Li stood with his hands folded behind him, silently watching everything unfold.
Both groups were under Han Li’s watchful eye, yet he hadn’t taken any action. Amused, he wished to see how the situation would develop.
“That voice came from the imprint of the Jade Talisman on Lin Xiao’s chest; it seems that is Lin Xiao’s grand opportunity,” he mused.
“Tsks, he even has Divine Sense. It looks like Lin Xiao’s ‘Grandfather’ is no ordinary being, at least an Emperor Wu of the Divine Yuan Realm. It’s just that he’s fallen into a state of such weakness.”

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 220: Lin Xiao and His Great-Grandfather! Han Laozu Strikes, Killing with a Flick, Gaining a Huge Surprise!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: Chapter 220: Lin Xiao and His Great-Grandfather! Han Laozu Strikes, Killing with a Flick, Gaining a Huge Surprise!_4
Han Li murmured softly to himself, his Divine Sense probing back and forth over the jade seal on Lin Xiao’s chest, unbeknownst to Lin Xiao or his grandfather.
Lin Xiao and the handsome youth were communicating through secret sound transmission; even though the handsome youth was deliberately concealing it, Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm wouldn’t hear the content without intentionally eavesdropping. However, to Han Li, this was akin to no defense at all.
His Divine Sense was extremely powerful, comparable to a Saint of the Fifth Heaven in the Saint Abyss Realm. Even when scattered casually, he could hear every word of their conversation clearly.
“The show starts now.”
Han Li noticed that Lin Xiao had caught up with the Tian Ya Sect’s marriage procession and immediately took a step forward, appearing silently above everyone’s heads in the firmament.
Below was the territory of the Yinyang Sect, with Lin Xiao blocking the way of the Great Elder, Lu Qingxuan, and others, exuding a momentum as if he would go forth even against thousands of foes.
“Sister Qingxuan, I’ve come to take you away. Are you willing to go with me?”
Lin Xiao’s handsome face was filled with anticipation, his fists clenched tightly as he awaited Lu Qingxuan’s response.
In his mind, the chances of Lu Qingxuan agreeing were high. As long as Lu Qingxuan agreed, he would take her away even if it cost him his life.
The marriage procession came to a halt.
Seeing Lin Xiao’s one-sided infatuation, the Great Elder and the Second Elder snickered, thinking Lin Xiao really dared to come.
“Qingxuan, just give him an answer so Lin Xiao can die with a clear understanding.”
The Great Elder had already locked Lin Xiao tightly with martial intent as he spoke to Lu Qingxuan.
The Second Elder glanced at the four Hollow Realm Elders, everyone making their preparations. Once they received the Great Elder’s command, they would strike with full force to suppress Lin Xiao, the traitor.
The breeze passed by, revealing a part of Lu Qingxuan’s exceptionally beautiful visage under the light veil, dimming the surrounding scenery.
Looking at Lin Xiao across from her, Lu Qingxuan said indifferently, “Junior Brother Lin, you shouldn’t have come. You know I have no feelings for you.”
“What kind of joke is this?”
Lin Xiao staggered, unable to help taking several steps back, his face filled with shock and unwillingness.
He was so outstanding. Why wouldn’t Lu Qingxuan choose him instead of becoming one of Han Li’s many wives?
Just because Han Li’s cultivation was higher than his?
Just because Han Li was more handsome?
Just because Han Li had more resources?
Just because Han Li was a reincarnated powerhouse?
….
“Pff~”
Lin Xiao suddenly spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, overwhelmed by rage and frustration.
He wished he hadn’t compared himself to Han Li, for the comparison revealed that, aside from potential, he was inferior in every way.
Lu Qingxuan watched unmoved, thinking that Lin Xiao had brought this upon himself. Surely she wasn’t required to agree to be his dao companion just because of his unrequited feelings.
The Great Elder secretly communicated to the other Elders, and the six of them seized the opportunity to quietly close in on Lin Xiao.
“Lin Xiao, don’t just stand there stunned. Run,” said the voice of the handsome youth from within the Jade Talisman, as he noticed this development, urgent in Lin Xiao’s mind.
Lin Xiao came back to his senses, gave Lu Qingxuan one last look, and then attempted to flee.
But the Great Elder, Second Elder, and the others would not let him escape. Before he could even react, they had already struck out at him.
Lin Xiao activated the Secret Technique bestowed by Brother Tiger, barely blocking the attack, but his body was sent tumbling away, vomiting several more mouthfuls of blood.
“Brother Tiger, I can’t hold on. You take over,” Lin Xiao said, prompting Brother Tiger to take control of his body and show his strength to escape.
“It should’ve been this way from the start.”
The handsome youth’s voice echoed in his mind, as he took over Lin Xiao’s body, his right hand turning into a claw and striking out at the Tian Ya Sect’s Elders.
In an instant, a colossal Demon Tiger tens of zhang in size condensed and launched an attack on the Tian Ya Sect’s Elders, clashing with their onslaught.
Seizing the chance, the handsome youth controlled Lin Xiao’s body, intending to escape directly.
Lin Xiao’s silhouette vanished from the original spot. The faces of the Tian Ya Sect’s Elders changed as they no longer sensed Lin Xiao’s presence — not this move again.
But the next moment, their faces lit up with surprise. Lin Xiao’s figure reappeared dozens of zhang away, blood overflowing from the corners of his mouth, clearly forced out of hiding.
Their first thought was that the patriarch of the Han Mansion had arrived; only Emperor Wu of the True Martial Realm was capable of this feat.
In the next instant, they saw a figure in white robes emerging from the nine heavens, hands clasped behind his back, his demeanor graceful and calm, with a smile on his lips, looking down tranquilly at everything unfolding below.
It was as if an Immortal had descended to the mortal realm!
It was Han Li.
“We greet Patriarch Han!”
The Elders of Tian Ya Sect immediately called out with utmost respect.
The patriarch of the Han Mansion had actually come in person. This was a sign of high regard for Lu Qingxuan and Tian Ya Sect, and it also relieved them.
With Patriarch Han here, there was no escape for Lin Xiao—he was doomed today.
“What’s happening?”
The handsome youth, controlling Lin Xiao’s body, tried to escape but realized that an invisible barrier surrounded them, one he couldn’t pass through.
Seeing this, Lin Xiao was also panicking; if he couldn’t flee, it was all over for him.
“Brother Tiger, quick, think of something,” Lin Xiao urged frantically.
The handsome youth said nothing; he had heard the cries of the Tian Ya Sect’s Elders, his expression turning ugly as the worst scenario unfolded.
The patriarch of the Han Mansion, Han Li, had actually come in person!
They had considered this situation, but it seemed too improbable, especially since Han Li hadn’t even attended the marriage processions of Emperor Wu’s City and the Da Jing Empire.
The handsome youth took a deep breath and said to Lin Xiao, “Second brother, there’s no other choice now. I must use my last strength to take you away.”
“However, I’ll have to sleep for a while afterward, and you’ll be on your own. Don’t be reckless again in the future,” he continued.
Lin Xiao’s eyes immediately moistened as he hastily replied, “Don’t worry, Brother Tiger. I won’t ever behave like this again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 501: 220: Lin Xiao and His Great-Grandfather! Han Laozu Strikes, Killing with a Flick, Gaining a Huge Surprise!_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 501: Chapter 220: Lin Xiao and His Great-Grandfather! Han Laozu Strikes, Killing with a Flick, Gaining a Huge Surprise!_5
The handsome young man gave a slight nod, and his dim Primordial Spirit burst into a resplendent glow. A formidable power infused into Lin Xiao’s body, causing Lin Xiao’s aura to climb incrementally, astonishingly reaching a level comparable to the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm.
The next moment, the handsome young man activated a secret technique, and Lin Xiao’s figure vanished again, attempting to escape from there. If successful, they would randomly appear millions of miles away.
Lu Qingxuan, the Great Elder, and others were struck by this powerful aura, repeatedly retreating while looking towards Lin Xiao in shock. How could he possibly unleash the strength of the True Martial Realm?
“Not good!” Immediately, the Great Elder, the Second Elder, and others exclaimed in alarm, Lin Xiao was going to run.
“Thinking of leaving, did you ask the permission of our ancestor?”
At that moment, Han Li’s indifferent voice came, startling both the handsome young man and Lin Xiao.
Lin Xiao’s figure was revealed once again, having failed to escape.
The handsome young man gritted his teeth, desperate now, and applied the secret technique again, boosting his aura even higher, breaking into the late-stage of the True Martial Realm, and then his figure vanished once again.
A moment later, Lin Xiao’s figure was revealed again.
“How is that possible?!”
The handsome young man was utterly appalled. Knowing his own affairs best, he had forcibly elevated Lin Xiao’s strength to the late-stage of the True Martial Realm and employed the escape secret technique, which theoretically should have been a challenge even for a typical Divine Yuan Realm War Emperor to thwart.
Yet, he had been blocked repeatedly. Han Li even stood there without even moving a finger.
At this moment, he knew they were in big trouble.
He regretted deeply, realizing he shouldn’t have indulged Lin Xiao in this folly. Han Li was even stronger than he had anticipated, probably having recovered to the middle or later stages of the Divine Yuan Realm.
“Tiger brother… Tiger brother…”
Lin Xiao’s Divine Spirit called urgently, full of anxiety, but the handsome young man did not hear him, as his mind was entirely occupied with thoughts of how to escape.
Having used his power twice consecutively, the light of his already dim Primordial Spirit grew even more illusory, almost about to fade from the world.
If he could go into hibernation, quietly absorbing Spiritual Energy and Lin Xiao’s Gang Yuan, he might slowly recover. But now he had no chance. If he dared to hibernate, Lin Xiao would surely die, and with the Jade Talisman falling into Han Li’s hands, he too would be doomed.
So, the handsome young man had no choice but to persevere.
Lu Qingxuan watched this scene in a daze, understanding clearly. Han Li had concealed his cultivation level. She felt he was at least at the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm, possibly even a Divine Yuan Realm War Emperor.
After all, Han Li was a reincarnated strong person; his previous life could have been as a powerful Saint. It wasn’t strange that he could do these things.
She glanced coldly at Lin Xiao, a flicker of disgust flashing in her eyes, nearly having her marriage ruined by Lin Xiao.
Compared to Han Li, Lin Xiao was inferior in every aspect, the difference between them was vast. She would rather marry a strong man like Han Li, even if she were only one of his dozens of companions, rather than be Lin Xiao’s companion, whom she never liked in the first place.
Seeing this, the many Elders of Tian Ya Sect were first shocked, then baffled, and finally terrified.
The fact that Han Li was strong was good, as it prevented Lin Xiao from escaping and ensured he could be killed on the spot, eliminating future troubles.
But witnessing Han Li’s true strength was a bad development.
The ancestor of Han Mansion had concealed his cultivation level and surely didn’t want others to know. Now that the six of them had seen it, would they be silenced afterward?
The Elders felt their hearts tremble as they glanced at Han Mansion’s ancestor, who seemed like a banished immortal in the sky above, finally resting their gaze on Lu Qingxuan, hoping that for her sake, the elder Han would spare them.
Han Li’s gaze turned towards the Tian Ya Sect’s Elders, and his indifferent voice reached them, “Do not worry, after this, I will remove this segment of your memories.”
Lu Qingxuan’s beautiful eyes flickered slightly, and the Elders of Tian Ya Sect instantly breathed a sigh of relief. Erasing their memories was a good thing; this way, they wouldn’t know Han Li’s secret and would avoid calamity.
Han Li then looked towards Lin Xiao, speaking indifferently, “I’ll give you one chance. Use whatever means you have at your disposal. If you can withstand even one of my fingers, I will grant you a path to live.”
Of course, this was false.
Even if Lin Xiao’s grandfather truly withstood it, Han Li would still kill them both.
He preferred to eradicate the roots, not fond of releasing the tiger back to the mountain. Lin Xiao, who was practically a protagonist template, would be a big trouble if let go.
As his words fell, Han Li pointed a finger toward Lin Xiao.
God Desolation Imprisoning Finger!
This martial technique of middle grade at the Earth level, bolstered by his ultimate martial way, now rivals a martial technique of supreme grade at the Heaven level.
When Han Li employed this technique with his current cultivation level, he could unleash the combat power of the peak of the Tongxuan Realm, making short work of Lin Xiao and that other individual.
As Han Li pointed out his finger, the handsome youth was suddenly like facing a formidable enemy, and the pale light of his Primordial Spirit was about to shatter under this terrifying might, while Lin Xiao’s Divine Spirit trembled uncontrollably in extreme fear.
At that moment, they felt as if they were trapped in the dark abyss of hell, subjected to its rules that locked and suppressed them, causing their strength to be weakened by several degrees.
Another finger, white as jade, descended from the heavens, carrying a vast and desolate aura, like that of an invincible Divine Emperor striking at them, causing their physical bodies, Divine Spirits, and Primordial Spirits to fissure.
“Kill!”
Before the attack even reached him, Lin Xiao’s Divine Spirit directly shattered, and the handsome youth had no time to bother with him, shouting out loud.
He activated a forbidden secret technique, causing his aura to surge and astonishingly return to the realm of the Divine Yuan, but he did not choose to fight head-on, because he knew it was futile, that one finger was definitely the combat power of the Tongxuan Realm.
He funneled all his energy into the Jade Talisman, hoping to use it to traverse time and space just as he did at the beginning, to escape from Qianyuan Divine Province. Whether he could survive afterwards, the handsome youth did not know, but he had no other choice.
The Jade Talisman separated from Lin Xiao’s body, hovering in front of him, radiating brilliant light and even slowing the descent of Han Li’s finger.
A look of joy appeared on the handsome youth’s face as he seemed to see the vision of the Jade Talisman fleeing away and himself awakening after many years due to fortuitous encounters.
The next instant, the handsome youth lost consciousness, unable to hold on any longer.
“Suppress~”
Han Li uttered a single word.
Just as his word became the law, all the radiance of the Jade Talisman dissipated, and with a ‘bang’, it fell to the ground.
With him were the Immortal Sword Humanity, the Time-Sky Tower, the Void Bell, and the Emperor Flag, among other supreme grade Emperor weapons, and he was draped in the Sky Concealing Formation Map. With just a thought, by triggering a strand of might from any of the supreme grade Emperor weapons, he suppressed the Jade Talisman.
Han Li beckoned, and the Jade Talisman appeared in his hand. He gently grasped the Jade Talisman, and the dim, almost completely extinguished light of the handsome youth’s Primordial Spirit was captured.
Then, with a flick of his finger, Han Li channeled a stream of mana into the wisp of light, restoring much of the handsome youth’s Primordial Spirit, who slowly woke up.
Upon awakening, the handsome youth’s first sight was Han Li’s enormous face. Realizing he had shrunk and was laying in Han Li’s palm, with the Jade Talisman beside him, the realization left him shocked.
Before he could react, he found himself unable to move, and the next instant, a terrifying and vast Divine Sense entered his Primordial Spirit, copying a portion of his memories.
Han Li flicked his finger, extinguishing the light of the handsome youth’s Primordial Spirit.
He had obtained what he wanted; according to the memories of the handsome youth, even in death, he could not bring trouble to Han Li.
Playing with the Jade Talisman in his hand, Han Li wore a look of satisfaction, the trip was not in vain.
This Jade Talisman was no simple matter.
According to the investigation by the Sword Spirit Xi Yue, this Jade Talisman was not only an Emperor-level treasure but also a component of an Immortal-level treasure.
As part of a Heaven Immortal Rank Treasure, this Jade Talisman was top grade at the Emperor Level, consisting of nine pieces in total. Gathering all nine would restore the Immortal Treasure.
Han Li casually stored the Emperor treasure, planning to study it slowly later, and then looked towards Lu Qingxuan and the various Elders of the Tian Ya Sect.
Without waiting for them to speak, Han Li snapped his fingers again, and six beams of light imbued with his finger force flew into the sea of consciousness of the Great Elder, the Second Elder, and the four other Elders, severing this segment of memory from their Divine Spirits.
Lu Qingxuan was momentarily stunned, realizing her own memories were intact, she couldn’t help but look up at Han Li in the sky, like a banished immortal, and a smile suddenly bloomed on her stunning face.
“You’re not bad,” Han Li said with a smile.
Although Lu Qingxuan was only of Third Grade talent, her beauty was exceptional, not a whit inferior to his beloved wives Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi.
With a thought from Han Li, Lu Qingxuan appeared beside him, his large hand reaching out to encircle her soft, slender waist.
Just as Lu Qingxuan was about to instinctively struggle, she heard Han Li say, “Do not resist.”
So, Lu Qingxuan remained still, silently accepting everything. She now considered herself fiancée to Han Li, and with his power surpassing expectations, her future looked even brighter.
The next moment, Han Li, holding Lu Qingxuan close, used his mana to capture the six Elders of the Tian Ya Sect and returned to Chengsheng Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 502: 221: The Jade Talisman of Creation! The Taichu Realm! The Cosmic Sea! Jiang Baiye's Inborn Constitution! Long Yue Evolves into a True Dragon_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 502: Chapter 221: The Jade Talisman of Creation! The Taichu Realm! The Cosmic Sea! Jiang Baiye’s Inborn Constitution! Long Yue Evolves into a True Dragon_1
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li and Lu Qingxuan stood on the mountain peak, overlooking the beautiful scenery of Chengsheng Mountain.
As for the six Elders of the Tian Ya Sect, Han Li had tossed them to Yundao Peak, leaving others to receive them.
Seeing that Lu Qingxuan remained silent, Han Li also did not speak; instead, he began to organize the gains from this trip.
He had killed Lin Xiao, the “child of destiny,” and obtained a Jade Talisman, and after killing the handsome young man, he obtained all his memories.
From his memories, it was known that the handsome young man’s true form was a Howling Sky Tiger, coming from a Divine Province in the central part of the Endless Yuankun Domain. The Howling Sky Tiger Clan was a Saint Abyss Realm power, and the handsome young man was the young clan leader of the Howling Sky Tiger Clan.
A thousand years ago, when the handsome young man was traveling through another Divine Province, he happened upon the emergence of a Jade Talisman. With his formidable strength, he seized it but was then attacked by a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, who triggered the Jade Talisman to transport him through time and space, landing in Qianyuan Divine Province.
All his spatial artifacts were destroyed, and Han Li could only reap some benefits from his memories, gaining a more detailed understanding of the Endless Yuankun Domain, learning many of the Howling Sky Tiger Clan’s secrets, as well as the clan’s Cultivation Techniques, martial skills, and Secret Techniques, etc.
Regarding these memories, Han Li’s consideration was to handle them in the same way as the City Lord of Emperor Wu’s City had, refining them into memory crystals to nurture the descendants of Han Mansion.
Since the Howling Sky Tiger Clan was a Saint Abyss Realm power with only two Quasi-Emperor weapons, Han Li was not worried about any trouble. Instead, he set his sights on the beauties of the Howling Sky Tiger Clan.
But considering the great distance, Han Li had no plans for the moment. When Han Mansion’s reputation extended to the central part of the Yuankun Domain, he could consider taking some beautiful female cultivators from the Howling Sky Tiger Clan as brides.
As for the Jade Talisman, it was indeed extraordinary, an Emperor Level top-grade emperor’s treasure, one-ninth of a Heavenly Immortal weapon.
Han Li shared the details about the Jade Talisman with Yin Ling and Yue Ji, hoping to learn its origins, though he did not hold much hope. Unexpectedly, Yin Ling did know something, which surprised him.
Yin Ling was the Artifact Spirit of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, which was one of the auxiliary supreme treasures of the Crimson Divine State’s first Sacred Land in the Ancient Era, the Nine Solar Heavens, an immensely powerful realm that was feared throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Therefore, Yin Ling was privy to many secrets, including the celestial treasure that was originally the Jade Talisman, which she came upon by chance.
According to Yin Ling, there was once a Heavenly Immortal weapon in the Primordial Ages called the Jade Talisman of Creation, which carried the Grand Dao of Creation of the Heavenly Immortal level, possessing endlessly profound and powerful capabilities.
It was said that a Heavenly Immortal powerhouse once used the Jade Talisman of Creation to fight a True Immortal, matching them blow for blow without falling behind, thus shaking the Endless Yuankun Domain.
This Heavenly Immortal powerhouse had once founded a Supreme Territory, one of the most powerful Sacred Lands of the Primordial Ages, but when the great Primordial Calamity arrived, both the Heavenly Immortal powerhouse and the Supreme Territory perished.
The Jade Talisman of Creation disappeared without a trace. Some said it was shattered under the sword light of Xuanshen Sword Mountain, some said it escaped, and others said it broke apart…
With diverse opinions, the Jade Talisman of Creation indeed had not reappeared for billions of years, until the middle and late Ancient Era, when it once again appeared in the world, possessed by a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
Then the world knew that the Jade Talisman of Creation really had shattered during the great Primordial Calamity, breaking into nine pieces, scattered throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain.
This Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor obtained the most central piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation shards, possessing power comparable to a Heavenly Immortal weapon. He rose to power with it, attained imperial status by proving the Dao, and later even ascended to become an Immortal.
In the years that followed, the other eight pieces of the Jade Talisman of Creation gradually came into the world, and Nine Solar Heavens also fought for and acquired one piece.
The appearance of that piece of the Jade Talisman was exactly the same as the one Han Li had obtained, only containing different profound mysteries, focused on offense, and its power was comparable to a Supreme Grade Emperor weapon.
“If only I could obtain the complete Jade Talisman of Creation,” Han Li thought to himself.
The complete Jade Talisman of Creation was mysteriously profound. Although it was a notch below the Human Path Sword, it was more powerful than most Heavenly Immortal weapons and its power was comparable to that of a True Immortal weapon.
If he had both the Human Path Sword and the Jade Talisman of Creation, as well as a way to replenish the energy source for celestial weapons, then from then on, Chengsheng Mountain would no longer have to fear any power. It would leap to become one of the most powerful forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, if not the most powerful.
Unfortunately, he only possessed one piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation, and he had no means to replenish the energy source for celestial weapons. For now, he could only reign supreme in Qianyuan Divine Province, acting as a behind-the-scenes ruler.
With a flip of his hand, Han Li caused the Jade Talisman to appear in his grasp. His vast and majestic Divine Sense poured into it, exploring the mysteries of the Jade Talisman.
After some investigation, Han Li indeed discovered many profound mysteries of the Jade Talisman, which only intensified his desire to obtain the complete Jade Talisman of Creation.
This piece of Jade Talisman in his hand possessed the profound and powerful capability to snatch the creation of heaven and earth. Its main function was to absorb Spiritual Energy, Spirit Stones, Spiritual Medicine, Spirit Pills, etc., and refine them into more pure and higher-grade Spirit Liquids, Spirit Crystals, Spirit Sources, and Spiritual Medicine, as well as Spirit Pills, and so on.
After refinement by the Jade Talisman, the grade of these items would rise by several levels. The lower the original grade, the better the improvement, but the higher the initial grade, the longer the consumption time needed for refinement. However, the refined items would not surpass the Emperor Level top-grade.
Secondly, the Jade Talisman also had two secondary functions. The first was traversing time and space: once the Jade Talisman was activated for this function, it couldn’t be blocked, unless by someone two Big Realms higher than the host, excluding Immortals.
The second function was the extrapolation of Cultivation Techniques and martial skills: the Jade Talisman contained a space within it that could, by consuming energy, use the Jade Talisman to extrapolate corresponding Cultivation Techniques and martial skills, displaying images for the host to watch, accelerating the host’s martial skill cultivation speed, and even pushing the Techniques and martial skills to higher grades.
One could say, this piece of Jade Talisman was also a supreme treasure for aiding cultivation, with functions that were differently focused compared to the Life-Prolonging Furnace. In combination with the Sky Tower, Combat Tower, and other Emperor weapons, it could better nurture the descendants of Han Mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 503: 221: The Jade Talisman of Creation! The Taichu Realm! The Cosmic Sea! Jiang Baiye's Inborn Constitution! Long Yue Evolves into a True Dragon_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 503: Chapter 221: The Jade Talisman of Creation! The Taichu Realm! The Cosmic Sea! Jiang Baiye’s Inborn Constitution! Long Yue Evolves into a True Dragon_2
No wonder Lin Xiao could rise swiftly; it’s all thanks to this Jade Talisman.
If he had progressed along a normal trajectory, Lin Xiao might have been the child of destiny in the Endless Yuankun Domain, advancing with great strides with this Jade Talisman in Qianyuan Divine Province. Then he’d look for the other fragments of the Jade Talisman of Creation within the domain.
Lin Xiao would have gone on to become an emperor, transcend tribulations to become an immortal, and ascend to the True Immortal stage. Perhaps, he would have even stepped out of the Xuanshen Sword Mountain to explore the more vast and Boundless Universe.
Unfortunately for Lin Xiao, he encountered Han Li, and Lin Xiao’s opportunity became Han Li’s opportunity; it became a great fortune for the entire Han Mansion.
“Lin Xiao, you’re truly a great benefactor.”
Han Li chuckled quietly, meeting Lu Qingxuan’s gaze with a smile on his face—he was very pleased with this woman.
Her aptitude, appearance, and cultivation level were secondary in Han Li’s view; the key was that she brought forth Lin Xiao, the “child of destiny,” delivering a great surprise to the ancestor of the Han family.
Killing Lin Xiao and the young master of the Howling Sky Tiger Clan was effortless for Han Li, akin to picking up a powerful imperial treasure for free.
The sudden glance from Han Li made Lu Qingxuan’s heart flutter, her stunning face instantly blushing with a touch of redness.
Standing atop Chengdao Peak, Lu Qingxuan took a casual breath and could sense the rich and pure Spiritual Energy here, improving her cultivation a bit. This was thousands, even tens of thousands of times stronger than the Tian Ya Sect.
If she were still in Tian Ya Sect, it would have taken her ten years to break through to the Hollow Void Stage. However, staying on Chengsheng Mountain and merely absorbing Spiritual Energy would allow her to break through within a year.
Lu Qingxuan had visited the great Capital City and experienced the density of its Spiritual Energy. Even within the Imperial Palace, it couldn’t compare to this mountain, not even one percent of it.
As for Chengsheng Mountain, Lu Qingxuan felt extremely satisfied. Just the density of the Spiritual Energy here made marrying into the Han Mansion a stroke of luck; she suspected that not even the Great Holy Land Schools could match Chengsheng Mountain.
Her fiancé, Han Li, had also concealed his cultivation level. He might be a Divine Yuan Realm martial emperor, an elder of Bai Yujing, and extraordinarily handsome to boot—who wouldn’t be smitten upon meeting him?
Lost in her thoughts, Lu Qingxuan couldn’t help but steal glances at Han Li with her peripheral vision, spotting the Jade Talisman in his hand that seemed to come from Lin Xiao. But Lu Qingxuan was undisturbed, lost in delightful fantasies.
“Han… Old…”
With her heart racing, Lu Qingxuan stumbled over her words, trying to address Han Li but unsure how to refer to him.
Was it too impersonal to call him “Han Li” or “Ancestor”?
To call him “husband” directly wouldn’t be right either; she hadn’t married into the family yet.
“Qingxuan, there’s no need to be so formal—just call me Han Li. Relax, yes, just like that…”
As Han Li spoke, he unconsciously wrapped his arms around Lu Qingxuan and then bent down to kiss her tender, glossy, moist red lips.
Lu Qingxuan was caught off guard, unsure where to put her hands.
Since it was both the first time they met and Lu Qingxuan’s first visit to Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li planned to personally show her around, help her get accustomed to the environment, and relax together with some sightseeing and leisure.
Elsewhere, on Yundao Peak,
The elders from Tian Ya Sect were discussing with Han Yongjin, Han Shigao, and others about setting a date for the ancestor’s wedding.
Regarding the dowry, Han Li had already set regulations. The gifts for women cultivators with Fifth Grade and Fourth Grade talent varied slightly, while those for beauties with Third Grade and higher talent were much more generous.
The Great Elder, Second Elder, and others burst into smiles upon hearing about their rewards, feeling it was well worth it to have married Lu Qingxuan off to Chengsheng Mountain.
For this, Tian Ya Sect lost Lu Qingxuan, a Third Grade talent, as well as Lin Xiao, who had even greater potential.
But compared to the rewards they received, all this was insignificant. Moreover, these benefits allowed their cultivation and strength to increase further, with some even hoping to break through to the True Martial Realm.
They also felt the Spiritual Energy on Chengsheng Mountain was extremely dense. Even on the secondary peaks where they stayed, the Spiritual Energy was several times denser than in the great Capital, let alone the main peak.
In the following days, the six elders encountered some secrets on Chengsheng Mountain. While not the core secrets of the mountain, these revelations still opened their eyes wide with wonder while also causing them to worry secretly; surely they wouldn’t get into any trouble?
This was naturally the result of Han Li’s indulgence. Since there were only six outsiders, Han Li wouldn’t go to great lengths to hide the scenery of Chengsheng Mountain; erasing part of their memories later would suffice.
On the fifth day,
The old ancestor of Han Mansion took yet another wife!
The wedding ceremony was held on Chengsheng Mountain, and various forces that had learned of the event came of their own accord, though it was less grand than the previous two times.
Han Li was unconcerned about this; after all, he was collecting gifts. Taking it slow with time, the frequency would increase, leading to a steady stream of income.
The common people within hundreds of miles around Chengsheng Mountain didn’t mind either. They didn’t have to give gifts and could feast on meat and fish for free—they’d be overjoyed if the Han Mansion’s old ancestor got married and took concubines every day.
After the wedding ceremony, Han Li went to the bridal chamber that had been arranged for Lu Qingxuan, stepping into the bridal room.
Night falls, and sleep may not be what enters your body,
The morning sun may not be what shines on your face,
A knife in the back may not be what pierces your body,
Heart-wrenching screams may not mean you’re aggrieved.
After several days of exchanging knowledge with Lu Qingxuan, during which Han Li and Lu Qingxuan visited various places and engaged in all kinds of civilized behavior,
Upon realizing he had successfully sown the seeds of life within Lu Qingxuan, Han Li agreed to her request for a truce.
After letting Lu Qingxuan loose, Han Li devoted his time to his loving wives and concubines, and occasionally instructed his descendants, imparting knowledge of the Dao.

chapters.title: Chapter 504: 221: The Jade Talisman of Creation! The Taichu Realm! The Cosmic Sea! Jiang Baiye's Inborn Constitution! Long Yue Evolves into a True Dragon_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: Chapter 221: The Jade Talisman of Creation! The Taichu Realm! The Cosmic Sea! Jiang Baiye’s Inborn Constitution! Long Yue Evolves into a True Dragon_3
Now, Han Li rarely concocts pills anymore. He only needs to refine one of each kind, and the rest can be handled by the Chengdao Vial; the general concocting is left to the Guest Elders.
Artifact Refining, Talisman Making, and Formation research are also occasionally delved into by Han Li, all of which take place in the Time-Sky Tower, allowing for a great saving of time.
…..
Taichu Realm.
The Taichu Realm is vast and boundless, immense and infinite, huge and limitless, encompassing endless opportunities.
The Taichu Realm is divided into one hundred and twenty-nine thousand six hundred domains, with Yuankun Domain being just one of them, located at the southeast corner of the Taichu Realm, behind Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
Above the one hundred and twenty-nine thousand six hundred domains, there are the Thirty-three Heavens, each heaven infinitely vast and expansive.
The Thirty-three Heavens are the dwellings of Immortals, looming over the one hundred and twenty-nine thousand six hundred domains, looking down upon all living beings.
Within the Thirty-three Heavens dwell countless Immortals and innumerable blessed lands of Immortal families, rich with Immortal Qi and strewn with Immortal treasures.
After ascending to Immortality, cultivators from the lower realms generally choose to go to the Thirty-three Heavens. It can be said to be ascension, but without the need for tribulation or metamorphosis.
There are also those who, after becoming Immortals, choose to remain in the one hundred and twenty-nine thousand six hundred domains. However, since the lower realms lack Immortal Qi and the substance of longevity, they need special methods to channel these from the Thirty-three Heavens of the upper realm.
Even so, although their lifespans do not diminish, their cultivation speed is much slower than that in the Thirty-three Heavens.
The Thirty-three Heavens are closely linked to the one hundred and twenty-nine thousand six hundred domains with many passageways that allow cultivators to ascend to Immortality. These pathways can only be navigated by Immortals, with restrictions imposed by the rules.
Generally speaking, Supreme Territories, great teachings, and Eternal Clans all have special channels that lead to the Thirty-three Heavens, pathways opened by powerful Immortals for the lower realms’ dao inheritances.
These channels allow Saints, Quasi Emperors, and even Great Emperors to enter the Thirty-three Heavens, but due to the suppression of the rules of the upper realms, they cannot live there for long.
In the Thirty-three Heavens, there are no ordinary creatures, but there are lower realm cultivators who are the descendants of Immortals, belonging to the native population of the upper realm, and are not suppressed by the rules.
Apart from this, there are some special places within the Taichu Realm that are unrestricted and simultaneously exist within both the one hundred and twenty-nine thousand six hundred domains and the Thirty-three Heavens.
These include the Land of the Supreme Heaven, Ancient Immortal River, Origin Sea, Endless Star Pathway, Space Bridge, and so forth.
Xuanshen Sword Mountain can only be considered half of one.
The Cosmic Sea is also one of them.
The Cosmic Sea is a vast and endless ocean, emanating a terrifying aura, where ordinary cultivators dare not approach. A single wave can crush a Heavenly Immortal to dust, and a splash can overwhelm even an Immortal King of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
The Cosmic Sea consists of innumerable, limitless universes, each droplet of water being a broken universe, each wave representing thousands upon thousands of desolate worlds.
This is the final resting place for universes and worlds within the Taichu Realm—once blown apart artificially or naturally extinguished, they end up in the Cosmic Sea.
In the Cosmic Sea, space and time are chaotic, and even Immortal Kings who overlook the cycles of reincarnation lose their way upon entering, unable to find direction.
At this moment, deep within the Cosmic Sea.
Here, an island rises and falls, unmoved by the battering of waves and tides, eternally resolute and unyielding.
In the center of the island, stands a man with his hands behind his back, his face indistinct, surrounded by diffusing light. The occasional release of his breath calms the raging waves.
Next to him, there is a sword scabbard planted in the ground. Strangely, it contains no Immortal Sword, yet the scabbard itself was sharp beyond measure and incredibly powerful; any cultivator who laid eyes on it felt as though they were gazing upon a Sword Dao Great Emperor.
In front of this man is a tripod furnace, colossal in size, with countless points of light swirling around its exterior and a violent fire raging within, as if burning something.
“Not enough.”
After an unknown amount of time, the man with his hands behind his back suddenly spoke.
His voice was like the Dao itself, imbued with boundless profound and majestic power, causing the surrounding waters of the island to evaporate for miles and countless universes to come to their end. For a moment, space and time ceased their chaos and clarity was restored.
But then the vast waters surged back, filling in what was lost, leaving the sea’s surface untouched.
After uttering just those three words, the man fell silent again. He looked towards the scabbard, which radiated sword light and revealed an expanse of infinite domain. He shook his head, averted his gaze, and as the sword light vanished, so did his figure, and the island concealed itself deep within the Cosmic Sea.
…….
Qianyuan Divine Province, Chengsheng Mountain.
It has been over a month since Han Li’s wedding to Lu Qingxuan. In this time, he opened a treasure chest once but did not obtain anything noteworthy.
He suspects that his fortune was temporarily exhausted after previously opening a chest and obtaining the Heavenly Immortal weapon, the Sword of Humanity.
This past month, Han Li lived a leisurely life, spending his days arranging flowers and visiting scenic spots, enjoying the beautiful vistas of Chengsheng Mountain with his lovely wife and concubines.
The scenery was beautiful, the beauties even more so.
During this time, the population of Han Mansion increased rapidly. The new birth encouragement policy had been officially announced, triggering a sudden surge in the desire to expand the family’s lineage.
As of yesterday, the total number of Han Mansion’s descendants had reached 5,822, with 2,740 of them showing exceptional talent, further increasing the population of Han Mansion.
With an increase of over eight hundred in the population, Han Li’s cultivation and lifespan also increased by more than eight hundred. Coupled with what he had left before, he now had accumulated over a thousand years’ worth of cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 505: 221: The Jade Talisman of Creation! The Taichu Realm! The Cosmic Sea! Jiang Baiye's Inborn Constitution! Long Yue Evolves into a True Dragon_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: Chapter 221: The Jade Talisman of Creation! The Taichu Realm! The Cosmic Sea! Jiang Baiye’s Inborn Constitution! Long Yue Evolves into a True Dragon_4
All the cultivation levels he had collected were kept by Han Li, and he didn’t plan to use them to enhance his realm just yet, since even if he used all of them, it wouldn’t increase his combat ability by much.
After all, his combat ability exceeded his cultivation level by far.
It would require several minor realm upgrades to increase the upper limit of his combat ability.
One day, Han Li was frolicking with his charming wives and beautiful concubines, playing some small games.
Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang, and many other stunning wives were all present, not attending to cultivation or other matters.
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, Chu Yumeng, Zhou Zhiruo, Zhang Lan, and many other lovely concubines were also gathered here, numbering in the hundreds, like a flock of beautiful birds; all were extremely beautiful and a delight to the eye.
Even the most recent additions to Han Mansion, like Zhao Wanling, Nangong Xue, Lu Qingxuan, and more than a dozen other wives and concubines, had integrated into the large family of Han Mansion without the slightest rejection.
Han Li looked at this harmonious scene with a smile on his face. All this was thanks to the great work of the old ancestor of the Han, resulting in an extremely harmonious harem.
Han Li lay on the master’s chair, enjoying the feeding from his wives and concubines, eating various kinds of fruits, each tasting exceptionally delicious.
These were cultivated at great cost; each type of fruit was in plentiful supply, with almost none unripe.
Han Li sent a wisp of his Divine Sense to Yangdao Peak, waiting for a result.
Jiang Baiye was not present today; she had gone to Yangdao Peak to undergo the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s baptism. According to Jiang Baiye, she felt that undergoing the baptism at this time would bring surprises.
What else could Han Li say? Of course, he let Jiang Baiye go for the baptism, wanting to see if she could successfully give birth to a special physique.
Even if a special physique wasn’t birthed, Jiang Baiye’s baptism would still promote her to first-class talent, which was a significant benefit.
Jiang Baiye had been in the Life-Prolonging Furnace for some time now. Timing it out, it was about right now; anticipation flickered across Han Li’s face.
Would Jiang Baiye be able to give birth to a special physique?
And what kind of physique would Jiang Baiye bring forth?
Before long, the Life-Prolonging Furnace suddenly shone with divine lights, shaking Yangdao Peak, causing various mystical phenomena to appear on it, and making all the swords within Chengsheng Mountain hum in response.
The next moment, a strikingly gorgeous figure stepped out of the Life-Prolonging Furnace. It was indeed Jiang Baiye.
Jiang Baiye had an excited expression on her face, eager to share her joy with Han Li.
At that moment, Han Li descended, standing in front of Jiang Baiye without speaking.
“My lord, I have developed a physique, the Transparent Sword Physique, which belongs to the king’s class of physiques,” said Jiang Baiye excitedly.
“Good, good, good, Jiang Jiang, you have a physique now. With Jiang Jiang’s assistance, your husband will henceforth be like a tiger that’s gained wings, like a fish that’s found water…”
Han Li said excitedly, showering Jiang Baiye with a string of praises and sweet nothings, extolling her to the skies.
A radiant smile appeared on Jiang Baiye’s face. Although she knew her lord was flattering her and that a king’s physique was not that important to Chengsheng Mountain, the fact that her husband was willing to say so in public made Jiang Baiye extremely satisfied, happy, and touched.
Han Li’s gaze was sharp as he saw the source of Jiang Baiye’s special physique—a bone of the sword inscribed with countless dense runes, and amidst them, a powerful Sword Dao Divine Skill was breeding.
“Jiang Jiang, you are truly amazing.”
Han Li couldn’t help but cup Jiang Baiye’s flawless face and plant a kiss on it.
Jiang Baiye had developed the Transparent Sword Physique, and Han Li couldn’t wait to exchange and discuss the Dao with her, to open up new horizons, to go through fire and water for her, just so that Jiang Baiye would continue to be pregnant.
If the child could inherit Jiang Baiye’s Transparent Sword Physique, that would truly be great!
In that case, Han Li could earn another batch of Physique Points.
Physique Points were something that accumulated over time; Han Li would wait until a considerable amount was gathered before making a choice, whether to create an exclusive physique.
Holding Jiang Baiye, he returned to the scenic area, where Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Ling Lingshuang, Xue Qingyi, and other wives and concubines came over one after another.
They chatted excitedly with Jiang Baiye, with only blessings pouring from their lips and envy on their faces, but not a single one was jealous.
In Chengsheng Mountain, as wives and concubines of Han Li, they would have a chance to undergo the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s baptism periodically; with more time and several sessions, they would eventually develop a special physique.
Nangong Xue, Zhao Wanling, Lu Qingxuan, and other newlywed wives and concubines were astonished at the scene.
Special physiques really could be created!
In this period, they had learned all about the benefits at Han Mansion, including how the Life-Prolonging Furnace could enhance talent and create physiques.
However, they had yet to undergo baptism and hadn’t seen anyone develop a special physique, so they still harbored some doubts.
But now, they had no more doubts, as this was something they had witnessed with their own eyes.
Jiang Baiye hadn’t possessed a special physique before, yet now she had the Transparent Sword Physique, which had occurred after the Life-Prolonging Furnace’s baptism.
Nangong Xue, Zhao Wanling, Lu Qingxuan, and others looked at their lord Han Li with even deeper affection in their eyes, casting tender and loving glances at their beloved.
As the great and loving patriarch, Han Li had taken hundreds of wives and concubines and had long established a set of mature tactics. These wives and concubines had succumbed to Han Li’s continuous seduction shortly after marrying into Han Mansion, having their hearts captured by him.
After all, Han Li was no longer the weak patriarch of the past. His strength, status, cultivation, and much more had undergone earth-shattering changes.

chapters.title: Chapter 506: 221: The Jade Talisman of Creation! The Taichu Realm! The Cosmic Sea! Jiang Baiye's Inborn Constitution! Long Yue Evolves into a True Dragon_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: Chapter 221: The Jade Talisman of Creation! The Taichu Realm! The Cosmic Sea! Jiang Baiye’s Inborn Constitution! Long Yue Evolves into a True Dragon_5
That evening, Han Li engaged Jiang Baiye in a discussion about Daoist ways, and Jiang Baiye, fearless, debated with Han Li till dawn.
Just like Han Li, Jiang Baiye also wanted to have another child.
She hadn’t given birth for several years, not wanting to, just waiting for the right moment like this.
Now that her cultivation had risen to first-grade, and with her special physique, the offspring produced by their union was sure to be one in a million – an exceptional prodigy.
At the very least, it would have first-grade talents.
Han Li was someone who did not know how to refuse, so of course, he went to great lengths to satisfy such requests from his beloved wife, Jiang Baiye.
Seven days later,
while Han Li was enlightening his descendants and resolving their confusions in the Dao, he received a transmitted message from Long Yue that brought him good news.
After her efforts in the Time-Sky Tower, Long Yue had successfully refined the Eight Colorful Loaches, making them one with her and dramatically increasing the essence of her bloodline.
Originally just a Jiao dragon, the refining of the Eight Colorful Loaches had infinitely purified Long Yue’s bloodline, and she astonishingly evolved into a True Dragon in one go.
In other words, Long Yue had successfully transformed from Jiao to dragon – now she was a Young True Dragon!
Generally, when True Dragons are born, they possess the cultivation of a Quasi Emperor; with a bit of cultivation, they can reach the Great Emperor level of Heaven Imperial Realm, and as adults, they become Heavenly Immortals.
Owing to the great opportunity left by a Heavenly Immortal, Long Yue had swallowed and refined the Eight Colorful Loaches, purifying her bloodline to the utmost and breaking her restraints to evolve.
This saved Long Yue untold time and negated countless risks.
Currently at the Divine Yuan Realm, if Long Yue had chosen to slowly purify her bloodline, she would at least have to break through to Quasi Emperor before possibly transforming from Jiao to dragon.
If she chose the path of facing the vast oceans, she would need to reach the peak of the Tongxuan Realm, and at the moment of advancing to the Saint Abyss Realm, yet this could attract the covetous eyes of countless cultivators and carried tremendous risks.
“That will be all for today,”
Han Li said to his descendants before his figure vanished from the foot of Chengdao Peak, appearing at Long Yue’s location.
“Yue’er, congratulations on your evolution into a True Dragon.”
Han Li congratulated her with excitement spread across his face.
Now, Long Yue was the only True Dragon in the Endless Yuankun Domain, and though only a youngling, she possessed endless allure.
For instance, Han Li now wanted to take Long Yue then and there.
Unfortunately, Long Yue was already several months pregnant, with about two months to go before giving birth, or otherwise Han Li would have really liked to immediately engage in dual cultivation with Long Yue.
Because the child born from Long Yue, who’d evolved into a True Dragon, might inherit her bloodline, or her bloodline might transform into a physique, which would be akin to an Imperial body.
In the Han Mansion at Chengsheng Mountain, there are currently only two with Imperial bodies; one is Han Yongqian’s Supreme Bone and the other is Han Yongmu’s Divine Emperor body. If Long Yue gave birth to another Imperial body, that would be excellent.
He would gain a hundred Physique Points, and the future of the Han Mansion would have another pillar of support, allowing him to proudly say, “My child has the makings of a Great Emperor.”
“It’s all thanks to my husband’s efforts.”
Long Yue said sweetly, flashing a coquettish smile as she threw herself into Han Li’s arms, offering herself for a kiss.
Without her husband’s help, how could she have obtained such fortune in this life?
Not to mention currently being unable to procure the Seven-Color Loaches from the Penglai Immortal Sect, even if she could, she would fall into the trap set by that Heavenly Immortal ancestor from Penglai Immortal Sect, losing her freedom and becoming a puppet of the sect.
With her husband by her side, she didn’t need to worry about anything; he would naturally take care of everything for her.
The couple were affectionate and doting on each other, and after some tender interaction, Long Yue hesitantly asked, “Husband, do you think our child will inherit the True Dragon bloodline?”
She was referring to the child in her womb.
Divine light burst forth in Han Li’s eyes as he looked towards Long Yue’s abdomen, and seeing the situation inside, a smile instantly spread across his face.
“Yue’er, our child will be an exceptional prodigy,” Han Li said with a smile.
He discovered that Long Yue’s True Dragon bloodline was nourishing the unborn infant, gradually strengthening its foundation and deepening its potential.
Given time, once the child was born, even if he couldn’t manifest an Imperial body or a True Dragon bloodline comparable to an Imperial body, he was likely to manifest a royal body or inherit part of the True Dragon bloodline.
“That’s a relief, so I can rest assured,”
said Long Yue, her face lighting up with even more excitement; her jade-like hands continuously caressed her belly, and she softly spoke, sharing words with the unborn child.
Han Li watched this scene with a gentle smile.
Long Yue was too anxious and overly thrilled – otherwise, with her strength, she herself could feel and fully understand this, without needing him to explain.
Han Li stayed by Long Yue’s side, chatting leisurely and whispering sweet nothings to her.
Meanwhile, in the Dao Domain, Bai Yujing.
Guanghai the Taoist walked out from the elusive Bai Yujing, his expression somewhat unpleasant.
“Being a Dao Lord is so great, huh? To be so ungrateful, pah!”
