The more Guanghai the Taoist thought, the angrier he became, turning his head and spitting towards Bai Yujing.
He had come from the Penglai Immortal Sect to seek help in Bai Yujing, to rescue his missing disciple Ling Lingshuang, and to find Long Yue. He had swallowed his pride and pleaded with humility.
But the conditions the Dao Lord of Bai Yujing proposed were too much; he couldn’t agree to them.
So Guanghai the Taoist could only leave.
After considering the Xuan Domain for a moment, Guanghai decided not to go there directly but to return to the Penglai Immortal Sect first.
This time, he had only brought one Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapon with him, thinking that Bai Yujing would provide assistance. Now, without their help, it seemed wiser to also bring another Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapon from the Penglai Immortal Sect.
The mysterious cultivator of Tongxuan Realm had possession of a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapon and an Emperor Formation Array Diagram of Heaven Imperial Realm level.
If he acted carelessly and went ahead, even if he found traces of his goal, he could potentially face an ambush; if he didn’t die, he would likely sustain severe injuries.

chapters.title: Chapter 507: 222: Ancestor Han Explodes Daoist Guanhai! The Sword of Humanity Destroys the Immortal Flying Map!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: Chapter 222: Ancestor Han Explodes Daoist Guanhai! The Sword of Humanity Destroys the Immortal Flying Map!_1
Having returned to the Penglai Immortal Sect,
the Daoist Guanhai kept the Top Grade Emperor Weapon, the Dragon Binding Rope, on his person, along with the Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, the Primordial Clock, which he always carried with him. Daoist Guanhai felt that this trip to the Xuan Domain would be relatively safe.
With one step, Daoist Guanhai crossed the void, heading towards Qianyuan Divine Province.
However, halfway there, as he was about to enter the Divine Continent, Daoist Guanhai’s brow suddenly furrowed, and he turned his head back to return to the Penglai Immortal Sect.
Upon reaching the highest point of Penglai Divine Mountain, Daoist Guanhai cast a profound spell with one hand, opening a gate before him, which he entered.
Behind the gate was a world brimming with the essence of spring, lush vegetation, and rich Spiritual Energy, a celestial paradise belonging to the Penglai Immortal Sect.
Every Great Holy Land School had its own celestial paradises, and the Penglai Immortal Sect was no exception. The Sect’s Heavenly Immortal ancestors used to live here.
After the ancient great calamity, the only thing left in the celestial paradise was the Immortal Weapon left by the Heavenly Immortal ancestors, which suppressed fate and safeguarded the paradise. It contained extremely important foundations of the Penglai Immortal Sect.
Daoist Guanhai arrived at a Divine Mountain, where two individuals were engrossed in a game of weiqi, taking a long time with each move.
One of them had a face like Pan An, wearing a green robe, with every motion exuding a refreshing aura; the other had sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes, a gallant demeanor, dressed in blue, giving off an unfathomable presence.
Daoist Guanhai waited silently. After the youth in blue made a move, he turned to Daoist Guanhai and said indifferently, “Guanhai, you’re carrying two Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapons, and you’re still worried?”
Daoist Guanhai nodded and replied with a bitter smile, “I have a baleful premonition, feeling as though something bad will happen.”
If not for this, Daoist Guanhai wouldn’t have turned back. He was truly concerned; if anything went awry, the immense Penglai Immortal Sect would suffer a great blow.
“So why have you come? I’ve said that I will not intervene,” the youth in blue raised an eyebrow.
With the foundation of the Penglai Immortal Sect plus the Immortal Qi he had accumulated on his own, he could act with full force only thrice, and would do so only at critical moments, after all, this era was just beginning.
“I’m not here to request Sir to take action, but to ask Sir to grant me a strand of might for self-protection,” Daoist Guanhai said earnestly.
The youth in blue was the Artifact Spirit of the Immortal Flying Map, an Immortal Weapon of the Penglai Immortal Sect, and the other was the Heavenly Immortal ancestor of the sect. However, the Heavenly Immortal ancestor had long since passed away, only manifested to accompany the youth in blue in this game of weiqi.
As an Immortal Weapon, the Immortal Flying Map carried the Heavenly Immortal ancestor’s Dao. Even a mere strand of its might held tremendous power and could be critical at pivotal moments.
“It is possible.”
This time, the youth in blue did not refuse. Just a strand of might, he could replenish it after some time.
Moments later, Daoist Guanhai left the celestial paradise and flew directly toward the Divine Continent.
All the way to the Xuan Domain, no one could detect Daoist Guanhai’s presence, as he had the Primordial Clock to shield his fate and conceal his aura.
Above the nine heavens,
Daoist Guanhai took out a jade Soul Plate, which belonged to Ling Lingshuang and contained a sliver of her Divine Spirit.
Aside from confirming whether the owner of the Soul Plate had perished, it could be used to track her whereabouts at a critical moment.
Daoist Guanhai performed a ritual with one hand, releasing divine light that shone upon the Soul Plate, which rippled out in circles, covering ten thousand li, a hundred thousand li, a million li…
“It’s still not working,” Daoist Guanhai frowned slightly.
He had tried many times before, all without success. He had thought that now, with fate revealing itself upon reaching the Xuan Domain, he might succeed, but he still failed.
Daoist Guanhai had the Primordial Clock emit a strand of Emperor’s Light, infusing it into the Soul Plate to try and discover Ling Lingshuang’s whereabouts, but to no avail.
“It looks like I’ll have to resort to more cumbersome methods.”
Daoist Guanhai murmured, holding the Soul Plate, vanishing from his original position to appear at various locations across the Xuan Domain.
If Ling Lingshuang was within a thousand li radius of her Core Soul Plate, it would react. Daoist Guanhai had not done this before because the situation did not allow it.
Qianyuan Divine Province was vast, with the Divine Continent alone extending over fifty billion li. Including the East Sea and the South Sea, it was even vaster and more sprawling.
Searching with the Soul Plate would be a lengthy and time-consuming process.
Even a Divine Yuan Realm martial emperor couldn’t handle this task without a Heaven Imperial Realm-level Emperor Weapon to conceal them. Even if they managed to find something by a stroke of luck, they would be silently annihilated.
If carrying an Emperor Weapon, it would be too easy to be targeted and neither the Dragon Binding Rope nor the Primordial Clock could be lost. Only Daoist Guanhai himself had to take up the task.
As the Sect Master of the Penglai Immortal Sect, he could not afford to be away from the sect for too long, or else unexpected events could occur.
Now that the search range had been greatly narrowed, and Ling Lingshuang was likely within the Xuan Domain, he had the time and patience to find her.
On Chengsheng Mountain, atop Chengdao Peak.
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back at the summit, his brow furrowed in thought.
Daoist Guanhai thought that nobody could detect his presence, but the moment he entered the Xuan Domain, Han Li knew it.
To prevent accidents, Han Li always had a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon surveilling the Xuan Domain. If anyone of the Divine Yuan Realm or above intruded, he would be informed.
Ever since obtaining the Human Dao Sword, Han Li had instructed the Sword Spirit Xi Yue to carry out this surveillance. With the level of the Human Dao Sword, just a strand of its might was enough to easily monitor the entire Xuan Domain, and no one could escape Xi Yue’s eyes.
Although Daoist Guanhai had the Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, the Primordial Clock, to shield his fate, he was still effortlessly detected by Sword Spirit Xi Yue.
“What could this old fellow have possibly discovered?”
Watching Daoist Guanhai’s actions, Han Li murmured to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 508: 222: Ancestor Han Explodes Daoist Guanhai! The Sword of Humanity Destroys the Immortal Flying Map!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 508: Chapter 222: Ancestor Han Explodes Daoist Guanhai! The Sword of Humanity Destroys the Immortal Flying Map!_2
“`
He felt there was a high probability.
It was impossible for the senior Taoist from Yinyang Sect to do such a thing without a reason, perhaps it was because Long Yue had refined the Eight Colorful Loaches and inadvertently provided some clues that led him to investigate the Xuan Domain.
“This is what you’ve brought upon yourself,” Han Li snorted coldly, his figure disappeared from Chengdao Peak.
One cannot stand firm without being ruthless.
Since the senior Taoist had come to the Xuan Domain in an attempt to trouble him and take away his beloved wife, he couldn’t blame him for being impolite.
With someone from Chengsheng Mountain wielding Personage Sword, Emperor Flag, Time-Sky Tower, and Void Bell to obscure the heavenly secrets, distort time and space, and shield causality, Han Li was confident he would not be discovered.
But Han Li would not sit around and wait for death, watching with his own eyes as the senior Taoist roamed under his nose; Penglai Immortal Sect might have some method to lock onto Ling Lingshuang and Long Yue’s trace.
By then Chengsheng Mountain would be exposed.
For the time being, he preferred not to reveal himself. With the deterrence of divine soldiers at Chengsheng Mountain, it was possible that Great Holy Land Schools such as Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Myriad Demon Mountain might abandon their hostility and recognize Chengsheng Mountain’s status. However, it was also possible they’d join forces at all costs to destroy Chengsheng Mountain.
Chengsheng Mountain wasn’t yet invincible, wasn’t yet capable of truly suppressing everything. It still needed to stay hidden in the background; only when Chengsheng Mountain could suppress a united front from the seven Great Holy Land Schools would there be no need to hide any longer.
The area the senior Taoist first investigated was the territory of Yinyang Sect, which was in a rather chaotic state. He believed that the possibility of the opponent hiding there was not small.
As the Taoist held the jade tablet and conducted his investigation, he still had the leisure to scan every place and every creature with his Divine Sense, hoping to discover a golden leek.
However, this was just a facade. He had a sense of crisis in his heart and was constantly in communication with the Primordial Clock and the Binding Dragon Rope, using the Primordial Clock to keep watch and prevent a surprise attack from that mysterious powerful being.
For Ling Lingshuang, for Long Yue, the senior Taoist was willing to go all out, even considering using himself as bait to lure out the enemy for an attack.
As long as the mysterious powerful being dared to show up, the senior Taoist would win.
The opponent didn’t have a divine weapon, while he brought the Primordial Clock, Binding Dragon Rope, and a trace of Immortal Flying Map’s power. The enemy couldn’t possibly defeat or kill him in a very short time, nor could they keep their actions hidden.
The Demon Lord of Myriad Demon Mountain, Dongfang Qingcang, would surely take action immediately to seek revenge and see if he could recapture the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing.
For the greater scheme, the masters of Sacred Lands such as Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and House of Divine Armies would also take action. Then, without using divine weapons, the enemy couldn’t possibly withstand it if seven or eight or even more than ten Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapons were deployed simultaneously; they would undoubtedly be suppressed.
If the enemy didn’t show up, then he would just continue his investigation slowly and turn the Xuan Domain upside down; he refused to believe that the enemy could remain hidden.
Atop the skies of the Yinyang Sect, Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, unnoticed by the senior Taoist.
Han Li didn’t move to action immediately; he was communicating with Xi Yue, Zi Yi, Shi Qi, and the others.
“Are you confident we can do this without causing a disturbance?”
“If the Personage Sword revives part of its power, no problem,” came the response.
Han Li’s brow raised; the cost was too significant. If the Personage Sword revived part of its power, it could slay weaker Heavenly Immortal powerhouses.
To use it against the senior Taoist would be overkill, yielding only a Top Grade Emperor Weapon and a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, which would be a tremendous loss and could trigger a commotion across the Qianyuan Divine Province.
“Besides the two Emperor Weapons, I have also detected the aura of a divine weapon on that old Taoist,” Xi Yue said.
“The divine weapon from Penglai Immortal Sect, he brought it with him?” Han Li’s face showed surprise. If that was the case, using the Personage Sword to kill the senior Taoist wouldn’t be out of the question.
Xi Yue shook her head and said, “No, it should only be a wisp of its power, which might descend as a coordinate in a crucial moment.”
“Then forget it.”
Han Li immediately lost interest. The arrival of a divine weapon from Penglai Immortal Sect would cause a significant commotion, and Sacred Lands like Bai Yujing would be aware, preventing him from taking the divine weapon.
After some thought, Han Li said with a smile, “Let’s just give him a profound lesson then, make sure he doesn’t bother me for a long time to come.”
Since he couldn’t suppress everything now, it was better to bide his time. The advantage was on his side; the longer he could drag on time, the stronger he would become, and by then he would be able to sweep away all enemies.
“Zi Yi, you’ll be in charge of sealing the void.”
“Shi Qi, you will fend off those two Emperor Weapons later.”
“Xi Yue, if Penglai Immortal Sect decides to descend, break the channel temporarily.”
As Han Li’s words rang out, he arranged his forces.
“Master, what about me?” asked the Artifact Spirit of the Emperor Flag, eager to join the fray.
“You’ll reserve the rear; do not act without my command.”
“Sure~”
“Be obedient.”
Han Li stroked her lovely face in reassurance.
This time, he didn’t plan to reveal too much of his strength since the senior Taoist wouldn’t die anyway.
He would lay down a great formation with the Sky Concealing Formation Map and then have the Void Bell assist. This way, the chances of the Void Bell being revealed were minimal, the Emperor Flag wouldn’t need to act, and most likely, the Personage Sword wouldn’t be needed either.
Only the Time-Sky Tower and Emperor Formation would be exposed, which didn’t matter as the several Sacred Lands already knew he possessed Emperor Weapons and Array Diagrams.
As for the senior Taoist, of course, he would personally… send a Primal Spirit to act. Without triggering Divine Sense, the combat ability of a Primal Spirit was even slightly stronger than his true body.
Having made up his mind, Han Li didn’t delay and took action immediately.
Upon his intent, his Primal Spirit appeared not far from the senior Taoist. The Emperor Formation was activated instantly, and the Immortal Sky Concealing Formation instantly unfurled, covering a hundred thousand miles.
“It’s you!”
Although Han Li’s Primal Spirit wore a bronze mask, the senior Taoist recognized him instantly, his face lit up with joy.
At that moment, the Binding Dragon Rope flew out, attempting to trap Han Li, and the bell of the Primordial Clock rippled, sealing heaven and earth, aiming to suppress Han Li.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 509: 222: Ancestor Han Explodes Daoist Guanhai! The Sword of Humanity Destroys the Immortal Flying Map!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 509: Chapter 222: Ancestor Han Explodes Daoist Guanhai! The Sword of Humanity Destroys the Immortal Flying Map!_3
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, his expression indifferent, as if he hadn’t seen the two Great Imperial Weapons bombarding towards him, and walked leisurely towards Guan Hai the Taoist.
Boom!
A nine-layered Emperor Tower appeared above his head, emitting a brilliant light that blocked the attacks of the Binding Dragon Rope and the Primordial Clock.
The Time-Sky Tower and the Binding Dragon Rope, along with the Primordial Clock, opened up a battlefield in the sky, each restraining their power to avoid spreading downwards.
The Primordial Clock kept booming, trying to make the Binding Dragon Rope assist Guan Hai the Taoist in capturing the enemy, but to their shock, the nine-layered Emperor Tower was too strong for the Binding Dragon Rope to break free.
The Time-Sky Tower engaged the Primordial Clock and Binding Dragon Rope in a separate dimension of its own for battle, suppressing the two Great Imperial Weapons with its power alone, its radiance shining across all ages, and its might shaking the heavens.
Without uttering a word, Han Li made his move as soon as the Time-Sky Tower took away the Primordial Clock and Binding Dragon Rope.
He raised his hand and made a grasping motion towards Guan Hai the Taoist, instantly immobilizing the entire heaven and earth, as if time had been put on pause.
Although separated by hundreds of miles, Guan Hai the Taoist felt extremely unsettled, his heart racing with alarm, his body bursting with divine light, breaking free from the restraint, and rapidly changing form, attempting to dodge this strike.
Han Li’s expression remained indifferent, his slender right hand gently clenched, and the entire space instantly shattered.
Guan Hai the Taoist’s formidable body was on the verge of exploding, with his bones crackling loudly, and he hurriedly circulated his Cultivation Technique to suppress it, but he still sustained serious injuries and kept coughing up blood.
“Are you kidding me?!”
Guan Hai the Taoist’s face twitched, feeling for the first time that he had been too reckless. This person’s strength was beyond his expectations and was likely that of a Saint at the Saint Abyss Realm. Even if not, this person’s combat ability had touched that domain.
This man was alarmingly strong!
He himself was a powerful figure in the fourth level of the Tongxuan Realm, yet a mere clench from the air by Han Li had broken thirteen of his bones, the broken bones piercing through his organs, flinging him backwards, vomiting blood continuously.
It must be noted that he was a master of a Sacred Land, not just any ordinary Tongxuan Realm power in the other Divine Provinces, his combat ability far surpassing his cultivation level.
Having cultivated the Immortal Cultivation Scripture and mastering several Saint Abyss Realm and even Quasi Emperor Rank martial skills, though not perfected, he had achieved major and minor successes. His combat ability was comparable to that of an ordinary practitioner at the ninth level of the Tongxuan Realm, or even the peak of the Tongxuan Realm.
Of course, compared to the ordinary Tongxuan Realm of the outer Qianyuan Divine Province, in the Divine Province itself, where everyone is a master of a Sacred Land, combat ability still depends on the true cultivation level.
This mysterious strong figure who appeared out of nowhere was outrageously powerful.
Guan Hai the Taoist wanted to leave, but discovered he couldn’t escape, as the Emperor Formation had covered the area, preventing his escape on his own.
The Primordial Clock and Binding Dragon Rope were held back by the enemy’s nine-layered Emperor Tower and could not assist him; he could only rely on himself.
Guan Hai the Taoist wanted to use the strand of might from the Immortal Flying Map, but he held back. He needed to find an opportunity to catch the enemy off guard with it and suppress him.
After swiftly consuming and refining a few Divine Pills, Guan Hai the Taoist’s injuries rapidly improved, and a vast and majestic Primordial Spirit appeared behind him, thousands of millions of feet tall.
The patterns interwoven in the eyes of Guan Hai the Taoist’s Primordial Spirit were brilliant, with runes shining brightly, showing the spectacle of stars being born and destroyed, and two beams of divine light flew out, piercing through the void towards Han Li.
These two beams of divine light were terrifying, like two indestructible celestial swords, with overwhelming might, instantly reaching in front of Han Li.
To Guan Hai the Taoist’s shock, Han Li casually slapped his hand, and a palm print that obscured the sky easily destroyed these two beams of divine light.
Guan Hai the Taoist used a Secret Technique, his aura climbing steadily, and his Primordial Spirit executed thirty-six slashes in an instant, each slash like an indomitable celestial saber, locking the space in an attempt to pin down Han Li.
The thirty-six celestial sabers pierced through the void silently, aiming to obliterate Han Li from every direction, with the wild ambition of annihilating him.
Han Li’s expression remained calm, his right hand forming a fist seal, with brilliant fist light booming across the universe, illuminating the heavens. With one punch, he shattered the immobilized void, and the thirty-six celestial sabers were extinguished under the radiant fist light.
Guan Hai the Taoist’s face stiffened, the enemy was too strong, definitely at the combat level of the Saint Abyss Realm.
Before Guang Hai the Taoist could strike again, Han Li pointed his joined fingers as if they were a sword, the sharp metal sword qi stirring the heaven and earth. With a flick of his finger, a sword wheel appeared, bombarding towards Guan Hai the Taoist.
The sword qi was dazzling, and the void exploded.
In his hands, a Sacred Soldier materialized, and he fiercely invoked the might of the Sacred Soldier to collide with the metal sword wheel.
Guan Hai the Taoist exerted his power, his body rippling with radiance, vanishing from the spot, instantaneously traversing the void, suddenly appearing behind Han Li, and launching an attack on him.
Han Li pointed out with his finger, and a dazzling beam of light flew out, destroying Guan Hai the Taoist’s attack, and with a bang, the beam penetrated Guan Hai the Taoist’s heart, creating a gaping hole in his torso, with the wound continually spreading cracks, threatening to shatter him completely.
Han Li raised his hand, delivering a slap across Guan Hai the Taoist’s face, sending him flying, nearly blasting his head apart.
As he was sent spiraling through the air, Guan Hai the Taoist could no longer hold back and chose to activate the strand of might from the Immortal Flying Map; he was certain to die if things continued this way.
In an instant, divine light blossomed above Guan Hai the Taoist’s head, and the Immortal Flying Map emerged, with the Immortal about to ascend taking step by step outwards, seemingly about to descend to the mortal realm.
The divine might of the Immortal shook the heaven and the earth, the terrifying aura sweeping across all directions. A look of joy appeared on Guan Hai the Taoist’s face, but it immediately turned to horror the next moment.
A splendid sword light descended from the ninth heaven, annihilated the illusion of the Immortal Flying Map, and rendered all its might to nothingness.

chapters.title: Chapter 510: 222: Ancestor Han Explodes Daoist Guanhai! The Sword of Humanity Destroys the Immortal Flying Map!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 510: Chapter 222: Ancestor Han Explodes Daoist Guanhai! The Sword of Humanity Destroys the Immortal Flying Map!_4
“Boom~”
Han Li’s fist struck the horrified Elder of the Sea, whose injuries could no longer be contained. His entire body’s bones shattered and tendons snapped; he was sent flying backward, crashing into a divine mountain tens of thousands of zhang high.
Just as the Elder of the Sea thought his death was certain, he discovered that no further attacks came. His Divine Sense surged forth and found that the enemy’s figure had disappeared.
The Elder of the Sea dared not be careless. He merged with his Primordial Spirit to become whole again, suppressing his injuries while cautiously healing and staying on guard.
The next moment, a ray of immortal light tore through time and space, descending upon this region. The supreme might of an immortal being unfolded undisguised, shaking the entirety of Qianyuan Divine Province and causing all the Great Sacred Lands to awaken in alarm.
They looked toward the source of the immortal might and saw an Immortal Flying Map stretched across the sky, cleansing strand after strand of immortal light, evolving into one dazzling miraculous scene after another.
The Immortal Flying Map!
Various powers recognized the weapon of the Heavenly Immortal at once, their expressions varied as they speculated why the Penglai Immortal Sect’s Immortal Flying Map had suddenly appeared over the Yinyang Sect of the Xuan Domain.
Only the lord of Bai Yujing’s expression changed; he immediately came bearing imperial arms and saw the disheveled and weakened Elder of the Sea.
The immortal light descended and repaired most of the Elder of the Sea’s injuries, eliminating all his path injuries and saving him from the brink of death.
Soon, figure after figure arrived, including the Demon Lord, the Demon Lord, the female bodhisattva, and the Ancestor of Weapons, etc. Once again, they gathered in the Xuan Domain, their Divine Senses swirling and communicating innumerable thoughts.
Chengsheng Mountain,
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, enjoying the scenery with a buoyant mood, finally venting his frustrations. He paid no attention to the aftermath of the battle as Xi Yue was keeping watch.
After his human path sword had eradicated the phantom of the Immortal Flying Map and Han Li had delivered another punch to the Elder of the Sea, he directly retracted the Emperor Formation Diagram, then returned to Chengsheng Mountain with imperial weapons like the Void Bell and the Time-Sky Tower, going to great lengths to obscure fate and disturb space-time so the outside world could not detect them.
As expected, after the Six Great Sacred Lands learned of the situation, they simultaneously used imperial weapons to divine fate. The Penglai Immortal Sect’s Immortal Flying Map had even recovered some of its might, but they were unable to trace Han Li’s whereabouts.
They were profoundly shocked, the situation surpassing their expectations, the balance of power now beyond their control.
According to the Elder of the Sea, that mysterious being from the Tongxuan Realm possessed the combat abilities of the Great Abyss Realm, wielded one Emperor Formation Diagram, a powerful Supreme Grade imperial weapon, and, it was suspected, another imperial weapon.
As for the Immortal Flying Map, it claimed that it should have descended immediately after its phantom was eradicated, yet it was interfered with and couldn’t arrive in time. By the time it descended, the enemy had already fled.
The opponent also had an immortal weapon!
This was undoubtedly the worst news for Great Holy Land Schools like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, and others.
An openly armed force with immortal and imperial weapons wasn’t frightening, but a mysterious force that possessed immortal weapons in secret and remained undetectable was truly terrifying.
The Sacred Land Masters, such as the Dao Lord, Demon Lords, and the like, after discussing among themselves, departed with heavy hearts.
The Immortal Flying Map also enveloped the Elder of the Sea and took him back to the Penglai Immortal Sect, warning him not to go to the Divine Continent for the next few decades, as there were brewing undercurrents that could lead to earth-shattering changes.
The Elder of the Sea was silent; he no longer wished to go. It was fine if Ling Lingshuang remained missing.
This time, he almost died within the territory of the Yinyang Sect, and if that person had not held back, he would have had no opportunity to survive until the arrival of the Immortal Flying Map.
He had accounted for a thousand possibilities, but he had not anticipated that the enemy would also have an immortal weapon.
Sighing, the Elder of the Sea went into seclusion.
After the Sacred Land Masters departed, Han Li instantly received the news, a smile spreading across his face.
He knew that the Xuan Domain would become a land of hidden currents, with all the Six Great Sacred Lands keeping a discreet eye on it.
But what did that have to do with him?
He was an Elder of Bai Yujing, having already infiltrated the ranks; Bai Yujing would probably still need to leverage his strength to secretly investigate the Mysterious Forces.
Han Li had long planned to continue keeping a low profile until he had sufficient confidence in his own strength.
This period was just right for continuing the development of Han Mansion. Once the foundation was solid enough, it wouldn’t be long before he could send his descendants out for training.

chapters.title: Chapter 511: 223: Treasure Chest Explosion! The Ancestor Marries Again! Long Yue Gives Birth, Xuanhuang Dragon Pupil! Thoughts of the Saintess!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 511: Chapter 223: Treasure Chest Explosion! The Ancestor Marries Again! Long Yue Gives Birth, Xuanhuang Dragon Pupil! Thoughts of the Saintess!_1
At this moment, atop Chengdao Peak.
Han Li was engaged in a very meaningful task.
He utilized great mana to summon the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain, preparing it for transformation.
Standing beside Han Li were a number of his charming wives and concubines, bringing delight to his eyes.
As the saying goes, “Men and women match, work feels less like a stretch.”
This secret territory was opened during the time the Life-Prolonging Furnace was healing injuries, spanning only forty to fifty thousand miles, and Han Li attempted to transform it into a paradise realm.
Paradise realms are a standard feature of the Great Holy Land Schools, with significant meaning, as they are core strategic locations.
According to Han Li’s plan, he wanted to refine the secret territory, expanding it to an area of one hundred thousand miles, focusing mainly on achieving the desired size.
That way, should a major catastrophe occur, he could use the secret territory to bundle up everything from Chengsheng Mountain, then shrink it, and carry it away with him.
Although the System Space also served this purpose, it had major flaws: it required the consent of living beings, could only sustain life for one day, and was much smaller than the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain.
“Xi Yue, Zi Yi, Shi Qi… begin,” he said.
As his thoughts flowed, Han Li looked at the women in front of him and a smile spread across his face.
Such tasks naturally did not require Old Ancestor Han to act personally. If he had to do everything himself, where would he find the time?
“Alright.”
The women responded one after another and began the transformation project of the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain.
For this transformation, Han Li mobilized many immortal and emperor level artifacts, including the Emperor Flag, Void Bell, Time-Sky Tower, Emperor Flag, Life-Prolonging Furnace, Chengdao Vial, Chengdao Sword, and pieces of the Jade Talisman of Creation, among others.
He wanted to add more capabilities to the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain. Since he could not do it alone, he let the immortal and emperor level artifacts take charge.
“Xiangxiang, Qing’er… don’t you think that waterfall is magnificent?” Han Li asked with a smile.
Chengsheng Mountain had many waterfalls cascading down from various minor peaks, a sight to behold.
There is a poem to prove it:
The sun shines on the incense burner, producing purple smoke; from afar, waterfalls drape the front stream.
The cascading flow drops three thousand feet, as if the Milky Way has descended from heaven.
As Han Li recited these lines, admiration flashed in the beautiful eyes of the stunning beauties beside him— their husband truly had talent.
At this moment, not only the waterfalls were plunging downward, but Han Li was also not the only one singing proudly.
Two hours later, the transformation project of the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain was finally completed, and a nine-colored pearl appeared in Han Li’s hand.
Han Li’s divine sense surged into it, probing the changes, soon after, a satisfied smile appeared on his face.
The Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain, transformed by Xi Yue, Zi Yi, Shi Qi, and the others, met his requirements, with some aspects even surpassing his expectations.
The time and space of the secret territory were reinforced by the Time-Sky Tower and Void Bell, such that even Great Emperors from the Heaven Imperial Realm couldn’t tear through the time-space barrier to intrude, unless they wielded immortal artifacts.
The power of the path granted by the Emperor Flag allowed the secret territory to extract higher level spiritual energy and Immortal Qi from the unknown. Although the absorption rate of higher-level spiritual energy was not slow, over the years, this could enable the secret territory to transform into a true paradise realm.
The rate of Immortal Qi absorption was particularly slow. After all, it was just the power of the path from the Emperor Flag, far inferior to the flag itself, but it still provided an additional source of Immortal Qi. With time, as more Immortal Qi accumulated, it would become significantly useful.
Time-Sky Tower and Void Bell combined forces, with the support of the Emperor Flag and Chengdao Sword, to carve out a unique temporal-spatial zone within the secret territory. This zone’s flow of time was faster than other places, able to accommodate more cultivators than the first level of the Time-Sky Tower, with even better effects.
The Life-Prolonging Furnace, Chengdao Vial, and pieces of the Jade Talisman of Creation imprinted their own laws into the nine-colored pearl, endowing it with partial effects of three emperor level artifacts.
….
“Very good,” Han Li said.
With a flick of his finger, the nine-colored pearl flew into the sky and re-evolved into the secret territory. He praised Xi Yue, Zi Yi, and the others.
This transformation project of the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain had consumed some of their energy, but the results were excellent. From now on, Han Mansion had another core strategic location.
Han Li felt that the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain was now no less impressive than those paradise realms of today’s Great Holy Land Schools.
Of course, compared to the paradise realms at the pinnacle of the Ancient Era’s Great Holy Land Schools, there was still a significant gap.
Time swiftly passed, and in the blink of an eye, half a month had gone by.
It was time for the thrilling moment of opening the treasure chest.
This month’s opportunity to open the treasure chest had been refreshed early on, but Han Li had not used it, waiting for the right moment.
He felt that this matter was quite mystical, so he decided to treat it in a mystical way.
Therefore, when Han Li felt the time was right, he found Lu Qingxuan and discussed the path with her.
If Lin Xiao was the “Child of Destiny,” then Lu Qingxuan’s destiny wouldn’t be poor either. Perhaps after Lin Xiao’s death, his destiny might even flow into hers.
Since Han Li didn’t possess such grand fortune himself, he had no choice but to mooch off others.
After an in-depth exchange of the path with Lu Qingxuan, and successfully making a cream-filled puff, Han Li opened the treasure chest page and directly spent five years of cultivation to open the treasure chest.
In an instant, the treasure chest blazed with golden light, and a smile appeared on Han Li’s face.
“Ding~ Treasure chest opening was successful, congratulations to the host for obtaining the Emperor Level Supreme Grade Treasure [Creation Stone]!”
Another Creation Stone!
Indeed, he had successfully mooched destiny again.
Han Li observed the Immortal Stone floating above the treasure chest, his heart throbbing with excitement.
This was the third Creation Stone he had obtained.
The first one was given to the Time-Sky Tower, allowing it to evolve into a supreme grade emperor artifact, and the second one was given to the Life-Prolonging Furnace, creating yet another supreme grade emperor artifact.

chapters.title: Chapter 512: 223: The Treasure Box Explosion! The Ancestor Marries Again! Long Yue Gives Birth, Xuanhuang Dragon Pupil! The Thoughts of the Saintess!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 512: Chapter 223: The Treasure Box Explosion! The Ancestor Marries Again! Long Yue Gives Birth, Xuanhuang Dragon Pupil! The Thoughts of the Saintess!_2
“`
Which of the Divine Weapons or Emperor Level weapons should be given the third Creation Stone?
In his possession were many powerful instruments, including Top Grade Divine Weapons like the Sky God War Chariot, Yuan Refining Furnace, Nine Mysterious Heavenly Knife, and so on, Supreme Grade Divine Weapons like the Dao Decapitating Sword and Heavenly Moon Wheel, as well as five or six Lower and Middle Grade Emperor weapons like the Cangdao Hall, Combat Tower, and Square Sky Halberd.
The Chengdao Vial and Chengdao Sword, already Top Grade items at the Emperor Level, could also use a Creation Stone to ascend to Supreme Grade.
After some consideration, Han Li decided to bestow the Creation Stone upon the Dao Decapitating Sword.
Once his exchange of Daoist teachings with Lu Qingxuan had concluded, Han Li made his way to the summit of Chengdao Peak, summoned the Dao Decapitating Sword, and handed the Creation Stone to JianJi.
JianJi was ecstatic, and after refining the Creation Stone, she successfully elevated the Dao Decapitating Sword to a Supreme Grade Emperor weapon.
The evolved Emperor weapon underwent a significant transformation, taking the form of an unrivaled beauty of striking elegance, who shyly and timidly took the initiative to offer repayment for her master’s great kindness.
For such matters, Han Li had always been accommodating, swiftly and decisively carrying out the action.
With an additional Supreme Grade Emperor weapon on Chengsheng Mountain, it was indeed a cause for celebration. Han Li decided to treat himself to a cream puff.
It was only when the cream puff burst open, its cream continuously flowing out, that Han Li finally felt satisfied.
……
Daqian Empire, Capital City.
Mingyu Palace.
The Mingyu Palace had a vast rear garden, flourishing with clusters of flowers in full bloom, a dazzling array of colors, and overwhelmingly beautiful.
Two figures sat there, enjoying tea and admiring the flowers. One was Emperor Qian, and the other was his older sister, Princess Chu Mengyao.
“Little sister, have you made up your mind?” Emperor Qian set down his teacup, looking forward with anticipation.
With Chu Mengyao, Emperor Qian always played the emotional card, never putting on airs, hoping only for the Princess to have a change of heart.
Chu Mengyao sipped her Spiritual Tea calmly, giving Emperor Qian a deep look before speaking,
“You’ve changed.”
In her memory, her brother wasn’t like this. Although he was supported to assume the throne, serving as a puppet, he did so willingly, striving to strengthen the empire together.
Previously, Emperor Qian was a person of integrity and courage, upright and unyielding. As the Crown Prince of the Daqian Empire, although he wasn’t as talented as Prince Wu’an, the Ninth Prince, his character was superior.
Now, in order to curry favor with Emperor Wu, not only did Emperor Qian constantly supply women, but he even set his sights on her, the Prince Wu’an’s wife, and the Empress, drastically disappointing her.
Among them, one was his younger sister, one was his sister-in-law, and one was his queen.
She often pondered why Emperor Qian had become like this.
“I had to change,” Emperor Qian sighed, his expression tinged with sorrow.
For the sake of sustaining the Qian Dynasty, he had exhausted himself, desiring only a closer relationship with the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
Not to mention recovering lost territories through the intervention of the Han Mansion’s ancestor, it was essential that the ancestor continued to support the Qian Dynasty for another four hundred years.
Without Han Li’s support, the Qian Dynasty would perish overnight.
If the Zhenxiong Ancestor and the late emperor were still here, if Prince Wu’an had broken through to the True Martial Realm, then Emperor Qian would rather not bear the title of Emperor Qian, nor carry such a heavy burden.
Each day was an agony for him.
Suddenly, Princess Chu Mengyao said, “I’ve agreed to this matter, but let’s not involve Zhi Lan and Jun Er.”
Chu Mengyao felt a sense of helplessness in her heart; the situation compelled her, and she could only comply. Who could blame her for being the Princess of the Qian Dynasty and the optimal candidate?
When she had first broken through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm, becoming a Great Grandmaster, Chu Mengyao was full of spirit and resolve, believing she could ascend to the rank of a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu before the alliance term ended.
Thus, she rejected Emperor Qian’s request, unwilling to marry into the Han Mansion and bind herself to Han Li.
Emperor Qian did not make things difficult for her, but instead offered various forms of support. The Qian Dynasty’s precious medicines and rare resources were made available to her, as Emperor Qian also wanted to see if she could truly soar.
Unfortunately, reality delivered a harsh blow to Chu Mengyao. After so many years and numerous supplementary resources, she barely managed to cultivate to the second layer of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, with the prospect of advancing to the True Martial Realm remaining distant.
After much deliberation, Chu Mengyao ultimately conceded.
She decided to go to the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, taking advantage of its resources to hasten her cultivation. Once she broke through to the True Martial Realm, having a say in matters would allow her to start cultivating talents for the Qian Dynasty, ensuring a future lineage.
“Since you’ve agreed, that’s good.”
Emperor Qian was overjoyed, relieved, and promptly assured, “Rest assured, if the old ancestor of the Han Mansion has no demands, I will not force them any further.”
If possible, he would not wish to do so either.
Emperor Qian had always made a point of initiating diplomatic engagements with Princess Chu Mengyao, harboring this mindset.
“Sigh,” Princess Chu Mengyao sighed.
To avoid a reunion with Zhi Lan and Jun Er at the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, she would have to marry and make an effort to dissuade Han Li from such notions.
That day, Han Li received the message from Emperor Qian and was somewhat surprised.
He was aware that the Qian Dynasty had a Princess; she was one of the candidates being considered for marriage. But Princess Chu Mengyao was unwilling, and Han Li had not insisted.
A mere Third Grade talent and a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm wasn’t worth Han Li personally intervening, given his lofty standards.
Now that Princess Chu Mengyao had compromised and was willing to marry, Han Li would not refuse, but his anticipation was not as strong.
Seven days later, a vast procession arrived at Chengsheng Mountain from the Capital City of the Daqian Empire, none other than the Qian Dynasty’s wedding entourage.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 513: 223: The Treasure Box Explosion! The Ancestor Marries Again! Long Yue Gives Birth, Xuanhuang Dragon Pupil! The Thoughts of the Saintess!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 513: Chapter 223: The Treasure Box Explosion! The Ancestor Marries Again! Long Yue Gives Birth, Xuanhuang Dragon Pupil! The Thoughts of the Saintess!_3
On this day, Han Li took yet another wife.
The bride was none other than the eldest princess of the Daqian Empire, Chu Mengyao, which left various forces speechless; Ancestor Han’s speed in taking a wife was indeed fast.
After the grand wedding ceremony had ended, Han Li entered the bridal chamber to spend this wonderful night.
To his surprise, he unexpectedly obtained an item with a reputation, a road twisted and turning with countless reversals, giving Han Li a unique taste of life.
In the following period, Han Li was busy diligently tilling the fertile ground, only ceasing when he successfully planted the fruits, feeling truly satisfied.
On this day, Han Li arrived at Long Yue’s palace bedroom full of anticipation.
Today was the day Long Yue would give birth, and Han Li was full of hope, wishing that the child would be born with a special constitution.
He and Long Yue already had one child, but unfortunately, Han Yonglong did not inherit Long Yue’s previous physique. Now that Long Yue had evolved into a True Dragon with a powerful bloodline and had been nourished for two months, it remained to be seen whether this second child could inherit any part of Long Yue’s True Dragon bloodline.
Soon after, a baby’s cry rang out, and Han Li walked in.
Sitting on the edge of the bed, Han Li let Long Yue lean on him as he restored her energy and conversed with her, all while using his Divine Sense to examine the newborn child.
Another boy.
Han Li felt neither joy nor disappointment; to him, boys and girls were the same, lacking the concept of favoring one gender over the other.
“Yue’er, our child is really something special,”
Withdrawing his Divine Sense, Han Li received the results and said to Long Yue with a smile.
“That’s wonderful,” an excited look appeared on Long Yue’s face.
If her husband said so, then this child must possess extraordinary qualities that set him apart.
“He has a first-rate aptitude; not only does he have part of your True Dragon bloodline, but he was also born with a special physique,” Han Li said, also filled with emotion – the child was truly fortunate.
It just so happened that Long Yue transformed from a Jiao to a True Dragon, elevating her bloodline. If the birth had been delayed by two months, the child would not have benefitted so greatly, lacking both the partial True Dragon bloodline and possibly even a special physique.
Long Yue’s Divine Sense inspected the child as well and saw the True Dragon blood coursing through him, roughly two or three tenths as pure as hers.
It was not enough to be considered a True Dragon, but it was much stronger than a Jiao Dragon, and powerful Divine Skills could still be born from the bloodline.
This child’s special physique was concentrated in his eyes, which were Dragon Pupils containing the essence of Xuanhuang, and within the depths of both eyes, a powerful Divine Skill was nurtured.
These were the Xuanhuang Dragon Pupils – although they were only of King Status, they were exceptionally outstanding among others of the same tier, belonging to the top echelon.
“My son has a part of the True Dragon bloodline as well as the Xuanhuang Dragon Pupils, and his future achievements will not be inferior to those peerless geniuses with Emperor Bodies,” Han Li commented.
He had once cultivated the Xuanhuang Tyrant Body, making his own body incomparably strong and never expected that his union with Long Yue would accidentally produce a child with the Xuanhuang Dragon Pupils.
This event also occurred in ancient history but was rather rare.
“Husband, what should we name our child?”
Hearing Han Li’s appraisal, Long Yue’s lips curled into a smile, displaying joy and excitement on her flawless face.
After some contemplation, Han Li gave his answer: “Han Yongxuan.”
For it is said: Heaven is Xuan, and Earth is Huang.
And again: Xuan upon Xuan, the gateway of the manifold secrets.
Long Yue nodded, feeling that the name was very good, perfect for their second son.
……
Luming Divine Province.
This area was once under the rule of Qianyuan Divine Province during the Ancient Era, closely governed by it and belonging to Qianyuan Divine Province’s core ruling area.
Including Luming Divine Province, there are a total of seven Divine Provinces surrounding Qianyuan Divine Province, encircling it.
During the Ancient Era, these seven Divine Provinces reaped the most benefits from Qianyuan Divine Province, but now they are the ones resisting it most fiercely.
All the major powers on these seven Divine Provinces did not wish to see Qianyuan Divine Province rise again, for if it did, they would be the first to be governed, as they were situated right next to it.
Within these seven Divine Provinces, Luming was also a force to be reckoned with, containing two Quasi Emperor Rank powers and five Saint Abyss Realm Powers.
Such a foundation was quite formidable even across the entire Endless Yuankun Domain, only second to the forty-two Heavenly Governing Forces, yet Luming, despite coveting the legacy left by Qianyuan Divine Province, did not dare to invade.
The two Quasi Emperor Rank powers in Luming had Emperor Level weapons of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and the other five Saint Abyss Realm Powers possessed Quasi Emperor weapons. These appeared formidable, but not even the weakest legacy of Qianyuan Divine Province, the Penglai Immortal Sect, was comparable.
However, both sides were restraining themselves, not daring to act recklessly, for that would lead to great trouble.
At this moment, in Luming Divine Province, two Quasi Emperor Rank powers simultaneously welcomed two absolute female saints.
Since the battle in Guanghan Divine Province, Ji Mingyue and Zimiao Zhen had just been lingering like this, appearing together as if inseparable.
If not for the known discord between the two peerless female saints, who occasionally engaged in skirmishes, all the powers would think they were close sisters.
For example, right now, as Ji Mingyue went to the Extinguishing Site in Luming, Zimiao Zhen went to the other Quasi Emperor Rank power, Liangjie Mountain.
Ji Mingyue was annoyed by Zimiao Zhen and tried many times to drive her away and prevent her from following, but she could not manage it.
Though Ji Mingyue was stronger than Zimiao Zhen and could at most defeat her, she couldn’t extinguish her presence, as Zimiao Zhen also possessed an Emperor weapon of the Heaven Imperial Realm
Ji Mingyue was fully aware of Zimiao Zhen’s motives but had no effective solution, only able to take things one step at a time.

chapters.title: Chapter 514: 223: The Treasure Box Explosion! The Ancestor Marries Again! Long Yue Gives Birth, Xuanhuang Dragon Pupil! The Thoughts of the Saintess!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 514: Chapter 223: The Treasure Box Explosion! The Ancestor Marries Again! Long Yue Gives Birth, Xuanhuang Dragon Pupil! The Thoughts of the Saintess!_4
By the time they found the fragmented soul of Empress Huangyue, they wouldn’t rush to go immediately but first plan to get rid of Zi Miaozhen before anything else to avoid any mishap.
After visiting the Extinguishing Site, Ji Mingyue had obtained the information she wanted, gaining a profound understanding of the situation in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Luming Divine Province is right next to Qianyuan Divine Province, and as one of the two hegemonies of Luming Divine Province, the Extinguishing Site is very concerned about Qianyuan Divine Province.
Upon exiting the Extinguishing Site, Ji Mingyue was deep in thought.
Her next destination was Qianyuan Divine Province, but at this moment, the undercurrents in Qianyuan Divine Province were surging violently; a Mysterious Force was watching in the dark, causing Great Holy Land Schools such as Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Myriad Demon Mountain to be on high alert.
“Could it be this Mysterious Force causing trouble?” A guess suddenly emerged in Ji Mingyue’s mind.
According to the Quasi Emperor of the Extinguishing Site, that Mysterious Force possessed Emperor’s weapons of the Heaven Imperial Realm level, very adept at concealing the Heavens’ secrets, making them undetectable even by the seven Great Holy Land Schools.
Regarding the Mysterious Forces possessing immortal weapons, Great Holy Land Schools like Bai Yujing and Xumi Mountain deliberately concealed it, not wanting to expose it, as this could undermine the dignity of the Sacred Land.
Ji Mingyue felt that it was possible; if the Empress’s fragmented soul was lost and the seal not yet broken, and if Imperial weapons were indeed obstructing and veiling the secrets of Heaven, then it was indeed likely that Empress Huangyue would not be able to detect it.
“Once Luming Divine Province has finished its investigation, I will secretly head over to Qianyuan Divine Province to conduct a thorough search; I want to see who exactly is this holy figure,” Ji Mingyue secretly said.
She wanted to avoid startling the enemy; if she were to search as grandly as before, the other party might hide even deeper after receiving the news, increasing the difficulty of her search.
Ji Mingyue was not worried about her personal safety at all; after all, she was a Saint of the Sacred Abyss realm, with an Emperor’s weapon in hand. Even if the fragmented soul of the Empress really fell into the hands of that Mysterious Force, she would be able to destroy them.
After all, the cultivating environment of Qianyuan Divine Province was just so-so, with not even a single Saint from the Sacred Abyss realm; the master of the Mysterious Force was at most at the Tongxuan Realm level. Even with an Emperor’s weapon, they would not be a match for her.
Moreover, if a great battle should arise, the opposing party would be exposed, and Great Holy Land Schools like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, and Penglai Immortal Sect in Qianyuan Divine Province would not sit idly by; they would definitely step in to help.
Whether it was to eliminate a threat or to give face to the Huangyue Imperial Empire, they would not stand by and watch.
Ji Mingyue was not alone in her thoughts; Zi Miaozhen, another peerless Saintess, shared similar views.
She was quite knowledgeable about Qianyuan Divine Province but had not expected that in just a few decades, such a powerful Mysterious Force would emerge, making even the Great Holy Land Schools apprehensive.
Zi Miaozhen was aware that Great Holy Land Schools like Bai Yujing and Myriad Demon Mountain were not incapable of finding that Mysterious Force but were unwilling to pay such a great price. They preferred to take their time, considering that each of the schools had immortal weapons for defense, and as soon as the Mysterious Forces dared to show up, they would be ensnared.
“Forget it, I won’t follow Ji Mingyue this time,”
Upon leaving Liangjie Mountain, Zi Miaozhen glanced in the direction where Ji Mingyue was located and murmured to herself.
Things seemed more lively over at Qianyuan Divine Province, so she planned to go and check out the situation first. Let Ji Mingyue continue her search here; perhaps the fragmented soul of Empress Huangyue really did fall into the hands of that Mysterious Force.
Qianyuan Divine Province, Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li suddenly felt a bit uneasy, sensing something in the depths of his consciousness, prompting him to call for Xi Yue to discuss and exchange ideas.
Ever since breaking through to the Tongxuan Realm, his perception had become even stronger. He had gone farther in the field of Divine Sense and was able to do some degree of crisis forecasting.
However, Han Li did not know where the crisis came from, nor did he know the strength of the enemy.
Seeing the elegant and dignified Xi Yue appear, Han Li briefly explained the situation. Xi Yue’s eyebrows slightly furrowed, and she nodded and said, “Then let me deduce it.”
Ren Sword was not particularly skilled at deduction, but it was, after all, a Heavenly Immortal weapon with combat ability comparable to that of a True Immortal, stronger than Supreme Grade Emperor’s weapons that specialized in deduction.
Moments later, Xi Yue provided an answer.
Han Li was taken aback; what was inevitable would eventually come.
In that case, he needed to make some preparations.

chapters.title: Chapter 515: 224: Unparalleled Power and Foundation! A Destructive Battle! Elder Han Captures the Female Saint Zimiao Zhen!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 515: Chapter 224: Unparalleled Power and Foundation! A Destructive Battle! Elder Han Captures the Female Saint Zimiao Zhen!_1
Chengdao Peak.
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, gazing towards the East Sea with a thoughtful look.
After the Sword Spirit Xi Yue had deduced some insights using the Dao Decapitating Sword, Han Li learned that there were two individuals harboring hostile intentions in Luming Divine Province.
One of them was still in the Luming Divine Province, while the other was on their way to the Qianyuan Divine Province and would arrive shortly.
After a bit of consideration, Han Li realized the likely individuals were envoys of Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, both coming for their split spirits.
He had been staying in the Qianyuan Divine Province all this time, so low-profile that he practically had no known enemies within the province, let alone outside of it; the outside world didn’t even know of his existence.
According to Xi Yue, the two individuals coming were both Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm, though their precise level of Heaven was unknown. However, that was enough information.
Han Li could handle Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm, but if they were Quasi Emperors or Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm, he could also deal with them, albeit with great cost and unavoidable commotion.
To him, two Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm were merely small fries, even if they possessed Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons.
Moreover, these two Saints from the Saint Abyss Realm were separated, allowing him to defeat them individually, for which Han Li had already made some preparations.
Han Li decided to intercept the Saint Abyss Realm Saint who was arriving first; he couldn’t act within the Qianyuan Divine Province, as it could lead to accidents.
After all, the opponent was carrying a divine weapon of the Heaven Imperial Realm level; any slight commotion could prompt Great Holy Land Schools closely watching him, such as Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, or Myriad Demon Mountain, to strike. The situation could become uncontrollable then.
With a thought from Han Li, several figures appeared by his side—those were his Dao bodies.
The Sanxuan Dao body, originally Divine Rank Lower Grade martial arts, had, under his ultimate martial path enhancement, power comparable to Emperor Level Top Grade martial arts.
In other words, Han Li had mastered a martial skill of the Heaven Imperial Realm level, complete to the finest degree. Although limited by his mana and unable to fully unleash the skill’s power, it was still a significant boost for Han Li.
The evolved Sanxuan Dao bodies could manifest even more Dao bodies, each with combat abilities equal to the original body and lasting up to five days without dissipating within a billion li radius.
These Dao bodies were clad in various robes, all wearing bronze masks, and each holding a Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapon in their hands.
The Void Bell, Time-Sky Tower, Emperor Flag, Dao Decapitating Sword, Chengdao Sword—five Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons in total. As for the Chengdao Vial, Life-Prolonging Furnace, pieces of the Jade Talisman of Creation, they were left on Chengsheng Mountain to guard the Han Mansion.
Around Han Li’s waist was the Dao Decapitating Sword, and he was clothed in garments made from the Sky Concealing Formation Map. For the task of assassinating the enemy Saint, he could be said to have employed most of his resources.
The Saint that came was naturally not worth his serious attention, but with either Empress Huangyue or Empress Yuanchu behind the Saint, he had to take them seriously. It was not yet time to confront these two peerless Empresses openly.
He had to make all necessary preparations to ensure a silent suppression or killing of the Saint Abyss Realm Saint without alerting the two peerless Empresses.
“Depart~”
The surge of Han Li’s divine sense informed his beloved wives, and his figure vanished from Chengdao Peak, traversing the void in an instant, covering billions of li.
In just two breaths’ time, Han Li had traveled from the Xuan Domain Great Qian Dynasty to the shores of the East Sea.
The Qianyuan Divine Province and the Luming Divine Province were separated by a vast sea, with the East Sea being just a part of it. The sea area was enormous, exceeding thirty billion li.
After inquiring with Sword Spirit Xi Yue, Han Li learned that a figure was approaching from the Luming Divine Province at a leisurely pace, crossing a million li of sea in a single breath, apparently enjoying the magnificent sea view in a relaxed manner.
He was now halfway across the sea, without making any effort to conceal his traces, and Xi Yue easily detected him.
“Saints coming from far-off lands really are arrogant,” Han Li said with a light chuckle.
Did the Saint Abyss Realm Saint from one of the nine strongest forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain hold such contempt for the Qianyuan Divine Province because he knew that there were no Saint Abyss Realm Saints there, strutting so boldly?
Perhaps their background gave the Saint considerable confidence.
After all, who in the Endless Yuankun Domain would dare attack Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm from Yuanchu Mountain or the Huangyue Imperial Empire?
The next instant, Han Li’s figure disappeared. Concealed by several immortal and divine weapons, he traversed toward the Saint Abyss Realm Saint.
When he was two billion li from the opponent, Han Li stopped. What followed would be up to the Dao bodies; he would not personally risk danger.
As the saying goes, wise ancestors do not stand under shaky walls.
If that Saint had any powerful trump cards, he could let the Dao bodies perish. The Void Bell and the Time-Sky Tower, among others, would not break and could return.
If his true body went and an accident occurred, he would deeply regret it.
Ever since he gained the Sanxuan Dao bodies, Han Li no longer fought personally and relied on the Dao bodies instead. His true body would stay back to reinforce, achieving surprise attacks from unexpected angles and taking the enemy unawares with cunning moves.
“Go.”
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back as six Dao bodies, bearing divine weapons and Emperor Formation Maps, descended in an instant. Han Li’s divine sense followed to observe the battle.
Now, his divine sense was comparable to that of a Fifth Heaven of the Saint Abyss Realm, covering a range of five hundred million li and as fast as the Fourth Heaven of the Saint Abyss Realm, crossing four billion li of void in a breath.
Meanwhile, Xi Yue’s regal, resplendent, and absolutely gorgeous Holy Elegance figure emerged beside Han Li. Without the Emperor Formation Map, Sword Spirit Xi Yue was entirely responsible for protection, and it was even safer.
“Xi Yue, why didn’t you tell me?”
Suddenly, Han Li turned towards Xi Yue with a tone of surprise and a look of delight on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 516: 224: Unparalleled Foundation! Decisive Battle! Elder Han Captures the Female Saint Zimiao Zhen!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 516: Chapter 224: Unparalleled Foundation! Decisive Battle! Elder Han Captures the Female Saint Zimiao Zhen!_2
He had just realized that the Venus Abyss Saint he had sought was actually a female saint, and what’s more, she was a breathtakingly beautiful woman in white. This nearly cost him his old life.
Up to now, among the delicate wives he had married, the highest in cultivation was only in the later stage of God Yuan Realm; not even one had reached the Tongxuan Realm. He did want to catch a female Bodhisattva, but since the last time, the female Bodhisattva had holed up in Xumi Mountain and refused to come out.
With celestial soldiers guarding Xumi Mountain and an Immortal Formation in place, even with the Man-Path Sword, he dared not to forcefully intrude. To capture a female Bodhisattva and expend too much energy from the Man-Path Sword would simply be a bloody loss.
Now, he actually saw a breathtakingly beautiful white-clothed female saint.
Han Li decided in an instant that he would not kill her. The female saint must be suppressed and brought back to Chengsheng Mountain. Having a female saint as a Dao companion was simply delightful; not only could she bear him children with great physiques, but he could also use this opportunity to learn more about Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu.
It was perfect preparation for the future, whether it was to avoid the sharp edges of the two peerless empresses or to suppress them in the future.
To know your enemy and know yourself results in a hundred victories in a hundred battles.
“Isn’t this meant to surprise the master?” Xi Yue said with a smile, making the sun and the moon pale in comparison.
Han Li was also stunned, feeling an itching desire, but he still restrained himself.
Having obtained the Man-Path Sword for so long, Han Li had never had an in-depth interaction with Xi Yue, mainly because his own power was too weak, his cultivation too low—it would have to wait until he reached the level of Quasi Emperor or a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
Xi Yue said that at that time, he would receive great benefits.
“Indeed a surprise,” Han Li said, his face full of smiles.
Elsewhere,
Aboard a light boat, a figure in white, ethereal and exquisite, reclined elegantly at the bow.
She had dreamlike purple hair, a perfect and slender form, skin like jade, her celestial beauty unparalleled and pure, her features flawless beneath her sheer veil, as if a Heavenly Immortal had descended to earth, her aura holy and otherworldly, shining with charisma.
In her right hand, she held a bamboo flute to her soft and rosy lips, playing gently, stirring melodies resounding over the vast expanse of the ocean, perfectly harmonizing with the surroundings, enhancing each other’s beauty.
“After Ji Mingyue finishes searching Luming Divine Province, perhaps I will have already found Huang Yue Empress’ soul fragment and return to complete my mission.”
After finishing a piece, Zimiao Zhen put down her flute, leisurely admiring the sky and ocean, her fair face sparkling with a divine light.
As she neared Qianyuan Divine Province, Zimiao Zhen felt a curious sensation in her heart; this mission might turn out to be quite out of the ordinary.
Upon arrival in Qianyuan Divine Province, she would go undercover to discreetly gather information, and if necessary, join forces with Bai Yujing and other great holy land schools.
She didn’t want to put herself at risk, confident though she was in her own strength.
If the mysterious force had indeed captured Huang Yue Empress’ soul fragment, it was audacious to the extreme and would definitely target her; if they were lying in wait for her, she might also face danger.
It was also possible that the mysterious force had no idea about the identity behind the soul fragment. Zimiao Zhen felt this was more likely; otherwise, they would have kept it hidden rather than causing continuous trouble over the past few years.
No matter what, they were unaware of her presence; the enemy was in the light, and she was in the dark—she had the advantage.
“I’ll find a chance to go there once more.”
Thinking of the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor suppressed beneath the Xuan Domain Great Qian Dynasty, a glint of excitement passed through Zimiao Zhen’s beautiful eyes.
She headed to Qianyuan Divine Province ahead of schedule partly because of that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor. Zimiao Zhen wanted to interact with him once more to see if she could gain some benefits.
Zimiao Zhen had encountered that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor twice before and remained indifferent to the temptations, aware that she didn’t need them for the time being and wary of potential traps.
This time, having cultivated to the Venus Abyss Realm and carrying a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor-level weapon, she was ready to try her luck.
She possessed a top-tier royal physique, known as the Mysterious Sound Spiritual Body, nurtured by the White Emperor, and had a great chance of breaking through to the Quasi Emperor level; however, her chances of ascending to the Heaven Imperial Realm were much slimmer.
She had to seize opportunities for herself; the competition in White Emperor City was fierce, and the White Emperor had many powerful subordinates; she was just one of them and relied little on their help.
The White Emperor sending her here implied this expectation; the rest was up to her.
Thinking of what the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor had once promised, a fire of eagerness burned in Zimiao Zhen’s heart—if it truly was a supreme treasure that could evolve her physique, she had to seize it.
Regarding this Great Emperor, Zimiao Zhen’s knowledge was substantial; his background was extraordinary, having mastered the Heavenly Sovereign Path and ascended to Emperor by the end of the Ancient Era.
As Zimiao Zhen was lost in her thoughts, her expression suddenly shifted, and an immense, deep, and ocean-like aura erupted, sweeping outwards in all directions.
But it was too late; a firmament descended in silence, isolating the area, and Zimiao Zhen’s formidable power only caused ripples upon striking the firmament.
Emperor Formation!
Zimiao Zhen understood instantly, without any hesitance, she made her bamboo flute shine with a dazzling eleven-colored divine light, unleashing Quasi Emperor Rank power in another strike.
This was her personal Quasi Emperor weapon. Although it was only of lower grade on the Emperor Level, it was more than enough for her, who had just broken through to the Venus Abyss Realm.
Meanwhile, a Jade Bowl appeared above Zimiao Zhen’s head, palm-sized, crafted entirely of jade green, its surface shimmering with water, seemingly containing an immense and boundless ocean within.
The Jade Bowl erupted with Infinite Light at that moment, beam after beam shooting into the sky, imbued with the potent Way of Water, every beam holding what seemed like an ocean the size of a star domain crashing forth.

chapters.title: Chapter 517 - 224: Unparalleled Dominance and Foundation! A Dominating Battle! Elder Han Captures the Female Saint Zimiao Zhen!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 517: Chapter 224: Unparalleled Dominance and Foundation! A Dominating Battle! Elder Han Captures the Female Saint Zimiao Zhen!_3
The flawless visage under the light veil of Zimiao Zhen flashed a faint smile, thinking that ambushing her would not be so easy.
Although she was languid and had relaxed her vigilance, her imperial weapon had not, always monitoring the surrounding tens of millions of miles, precisely to prevent being caught off guard.
But in the next moment, the smile on Zimiao Zhen’s face vanished, replaced by endless solemnity; her brows furrowed tightly, sensing a bad premonition in her heart.
Could it be that the opponent had deployed a divine weapon, seeing as the attack unleashed by either the quasi-emperor weapon or the emperor weapon had been instantly shattered?
Zimiao Zhen found it unbelievable that someone would use an Emperor Formation to trap her and then employ a divine weapon to strike at her; this seemed too exaggerated.
She didn’t think she warranted being struck down by a divine weapon.
Generally speaking, divine weapons were wielded by Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and only when facing other Great Emperors might they resort to using divine weapons; against Saints and Quasi Emperors, they could squash them with a single palm.
The terrifying Emperor’s Might surged like a tide, wave after wave, bringing endless oppression. A ray of Emperor’s Light descended upon the jade, covering Zimiao Zhen and shielding her from the might of the Array Diagrams.
Holding a bamboo flute, Zimiao Zhen’s Divine Sense surged out, probing the nine heavens and the ten earths, searching in all directions, but she could not find the enemy’s figure.
Zimiao Zhen’s lips parted slightly, about to say something when she sensed six figures appearing in the sky, surrounding her.
These six figures wore robes of different colors and all donned bronze masks. However, to her surprise, the aura emitted by these six figures was only that of the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm.
Zimiao Zhen breathed a sigh of relief and said, “Such a grand array to deal with a weak woman like me, does the person behind the scenes dare to show themselves?”
She did not believe that these six cultivators of the Tongxuan Realm were the masterminds; they were merely pawns, and even with the support of the Emperor Formation, they would not be able to trouble her.
“A female Saint of the Heavenly Abyss Realm is hardly a ‘weak woman,'” one of the figures spoke.
Zimiao Zhen was constantly communicating with the Jade Bowl, inquiring whether it could break the Emperor Formation and take her away.
Being trapped within the Emperor Formation was too dangerous, not conducive to battle; it was better to escape this perilous situation before making plans.
Zimiao Zhen also wanted to know who was taking action against her.
Before Zimiao Zhen could communicate in detail with the imperial weapon, Han Li’s six Dao Bodies activated, and imperial weapons like the Void Bell, Time-Sky Tower, Emperor Flag, Dao Decapitating Sword, and Chengdao Sword, all of Heaven Imperial Realm quality, appeared and launched an attack on Zimiao Zhen.
At this sight, Zimiao Zhen’s thoughts halted, her pupils constricted, and her face filled with shock.
Had she breached some heavenly law?
The person able to mobilize so many Heaven Imperial Realm imperial weapons against her, four of which even exude the aura of Supreme Grade imperial weapons, were so much stronger than her Jade Bowl.
Zimiao Zhen knew that this time things had gone too far; she had no chance of escape.
An Emperor Formation sealed the heavens and the earth; Time-Sky Tower and Void Bell isolated time and space; Emperor Flag concealed the heavenly secrets; Dao Decapitating Sword annihilated causality…
Nothing that happened here would be known to the outside world.
Faced with the attack of multiple imperial weapons, Zimiao Zhen simply gave in; she couldn’t resist, for not just a newly ascended Saint like her, but even a White Emperor, without the use of a divine weapon, could not withstand such an onslaught.
The Jade Bowl, not willing to concede, abandoned Zimiao Zhen, attempting to flee, but where could it escape to?
It was quickly suppressed by imperial weapons like the Time-Sky Tower, Void Bell, Emperor Flag, Dao Decapitating Sword, and others from the Heaven Imperial Realm.
One of Han Li’s Dao Bodies appeared in front of Zimiao Zhen, extending a large hand, with Mana surging, intending to seal her cultivation.
This time, to avoid any accidents, Han Li mobilized most of his resources, not wishing to waste words with Zimiao Zhen. He spoke only once, then crushed everything in his path with overwhelming force, easily suppressing everything around him.
Feeling the Mana nearing, Zimiao Zhen’s eyes flickered, wishing to fight to the death, trying to hold this powerful cultivator of the Tongxuan Realm hostage, yet she hesitated.
With so many imperial weapons and formations deployed, the worth of a powerful cultivator at the Tongxuan Realm likely was insignificant; taking him hostage might be useless, potentially facing even more brutal suppression.
“You might not be my match,” she said tentatively.
Han Li’s majestic Mana poured into Zimiao Zhen’s body, quickly sealing her Dantian, Primordial Spirit, Heavenly Abyss, and more.
Zimiao Zhen offered no resistance, letting Han Li do as he pleased. After it was over, she spoke with a semblance of a smile, “You think you, a mere cultivator of the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm, can overpower me?”
Boom!
Han Li released his aura without reservation, the powerful momentum blasting forth and striking Zimiao Zhen full on the face.
Feeling the overwhelming aura assaulting her, Zimiao Zhen’s light veil was blown away, revealing her shocked expression.
Was this person really just at the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm?
Why was his aura so powerful, truly no weaker than hers?
What kind of monster was he?
Zimiao Zhen glanced again at the five figures standing in the sky, involuntarily swallowing hard. Could these five cultivators also be such monsters?
Since when had the Endless Yuankun Domain seen the rise of so many unparalleled freaks of nature…
This was simply preposterous.
Even the battle power of a cultivator at the Tongxuan Realm’s first layer rivaling that of a mid-stage Saint of the Heavenly Abyss Realm was overstated for even supreme beings like the White Emperor, Empress Huang Yue, and Empress Yuanchu at that stage, wasn’t it?
And to think, six of them appeared all at once.
Han Li, looking at the changing colors on Zimiao Zhen’s face, paid her no heed, capturing the suppressed Jade Bowl into his hand, and then with a single thought.
Three rays of Emperor’s Light descended instantly upon Zimiao Zhen from the Void Bell, Time-Sky Tower, and Emperor Flag, completely sealing her so that she could no longer use any of her methods.
Earlier, when Han Li came to seal Zimiao Zhen’s cultivation, it was merely to probe and see if Zimiao Zhen had any cards left to play. This was just one of his Dao Bodies; if it died at Zimiao Zhen’s hands, there was no real loss.

chapters.title: Chapter 518 - 224: The Unmatched Foundation of Strength! A Battle That Crushes All Resistance! Elder Han Captures the Female Saint Zimiao Zhen!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 518: Chapter 224: The Unmatched Foundation of Strength! A Battle That Crushes All Resistance! Elder Han Captures the Female Saint Zimiao Zhen!_4
“`
Since Purple Mystique is willing to be sealed, then seal her thoroughly and don’t let her play any more tricks.
“You!”
Purple Mystique’s beautiful eyes glared at Han Li, filled with shock and fury.
She indeed had a trump card unplayed, thinking to act only upon seeing the mastermind behind the scenes; she did not expect the opponent to be so ruthless and cautious in their actions.
Directly using three Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons to seal her, now she truly cannot utilize her trump card, not even capable of sensing it.
What qualifications does he have!
As Purple Mystique was in shock and rage, Han Li’s multiple Dao incarnations retracted the Emperor Weapons, then wrapped Purple Mystique in the Sky Concealing Formation Map, instantly returning to Han Li’s side.
Fiddling with the black sphere in his hand and looking at the helpless Purple Mystique within, Han Li retracted all his Dao incarnations and turned his gaze towards Luming Divine Province.
Should he go all the way, suppress another Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm too?
After thinking it over, Han Li temporarily abandoned this thought. That Saint was still leisurely searching in Luming Divine Province; a sudden disappearance could easily lead to complications.
It would be better to wait until that Saint headed to Qianyuan Divine Province, where he could then easily suppress them just like this, unknown to everyone in these vast seas.
“Xi Yue, please take action and erase all traces.”
Withdrawing his gaze, Han Li spoke to the perfect and flawless Sword Spirit Xi Yue beside him.
With the Time-Sky Tower, Void Bell, Emperor Flag, Dao Decapitating Sword, and the Chengdao Sword, combined with the Emperor Formation Map all deployed, they had already concealed the workings of fate, isolated space-time, and severed causality.
Even the Empress Huangyue or Empress Yuanchu wielding a Heavenly Immortal weapon might not be able to trace it back.
