However, Han Li wanted to be even more cautious, asking the Way of the Sword Spirit to sever all traces so that even if a Heavenly Immortal were to search through space-time, they would find no trace of this event in any timeline.
“Alright~”
With a thought from Xi Yue, the sword at Han Li’s waist unsheathed half an inch, its cold light shooting out, slashing billions of miles away, across past and future, erasing all traces.
After this was completed, Han Li and Xi Yue disappeared from the vast seas, swiftly returning to Chengsheng Mountain in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Purple Mystique was merely suppressed by him; Han Li would not kill her. Not to mention Han Li’s own thoughts on the matter, even if the opponent was a male Saint, he would not kill, only suppress.
Killing her would really complicate things.
These Saints hail from the nine most powerful factions within the Endless Yuankun Domain, each with life lamps, Soul Plates, among other items; once dead, the other side would immediately be aware.
Then, it would provoke retaliation from the two most powerful forces, the Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain, potentially bringing more terrifying powerful individuals, perhaps even a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor with a divine soldier in tow.
That would completely disrupt his plans.
If he only seals them, pretending they are still on their mission, then it’s possible to keep buying time.
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li, with his white clothes spotless, is like a suave gentleman unmatched in this world, akin to an exiled fairy.
Purple Mystique, also in white garments pure as snow, boasts a graceful, slender figure with undulating curves and a beauty unmatched in all the world, akin to a Heavenly Fairy.
The two of them standing here was like a match made in heaven, a divine couple.
But the atmosphere at the scene was not good.
Purple Mystique glared at Han Li with anger, her flawless face still showing a trace of astonishment.
Han Li, on the other hand, was somewhat speechless, feeling that things had become even more complicated.
He had just asked her whether she came from Huangyue Imperial Empire or Yuanchu Mountain, only to learn that Purple Mystique hailed from White Emperor City.
Han Li naturally knew that White Emperor City was another of the strongest forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, with the White Emperor’s combat ability unparalleled, a peerless Great Emperor at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
But why would Purple Mystique come to Qianyuan Divine Province for no reason?
Could he have captured the wrong person?
Have the envoys of Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu hidden themselves?
Looking at the unrivaled beauty before him, Han Li felt a headache coming on. Captured she was, so he could only keep up the mistake to the end.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 519: 225: Reincarnation of a True Immortal? Grand Patriarch of Great Love Remarries! Zimiao's True Grand Gift! The Empress Takes Maternity Leave_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 519: Chapter 225: Reincarnation of a True Immortal? Grand Patriarch of Great Love Remarries! Zimiao’s True Grand Gift! The Empress Takes Maternity Leave_1
“Han Li, what do you want?”
Dressed in white clothes purer than snow, her flawless face bore a complex expression as she recalled this man.
She could never have imagined that the man she had once glimpsed by chance had now become the underground ruler of Qianyuan Divine Province, the uncrowned king, with power rivaling the foremost Sacred Land, Bai Yujing.
Even White Emperor City, where she was from, was one of the nine mightiest powers in Endless Yuankun Domain, governing 53 Divine Provinces and holding sway over the entire Yuankun Domain, with several Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, as well as the supreme White Emperor, not much stronger than Chengsheng Mountain.
After all, Chengsheng Mountain possessed the man-made sword, comparable to True Immortal weapons, which neutralized the greatest advantage of White Emperor City. Compared to Chengsheng Mountain, White Emperor City only had a few more Heavenly Immortal weapons and high-level cultivators.
Imagine, decades ago, during her second crossing over Beiming to reach Qianyuan Divine Province, she strengthened the seal for that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor. As she was about to leave, she happened to glance and spot this person.
At that time, he was only at the peak of the God Refining Realm, and he had even concealed his cultivation to the Pihai Realm, enjoying the beautiful scenery in a canyon and couldn’t help but utter the exquisite verse, “Casting light dances on the gold, still shadows sink into jade, with fishermen’s songs answering one another, is there an end to this joy?”
Zi Miao Zhen found it interesting, and that was all. She didn’t take any action, thinking the two of them would never meet again.
But Zi Miao Zhen could never have expected that they would meet again, and that she would end up in Han Li’s hands, in such a humiliating manner no less.
In just a few decades, how had this person cultivated from the God Refining Realm, crossing the Hollow Void Stage, Myriad Phenomena Realm, True Martial Realm, and Divine Yuan Realm, to directly reach the Tongxuan Realm?
The key was that not only was Han Li’s cultivation speed fast, but his combat ability was also incredibly strong. A combat strength of just the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm was already comparable to the middle stages of the Sacred Realm, which was absolutely unheard of, and unseen before.
Even the stunningly talented Empress Huangyue, Empress Yuanchu, and the Great Emperors like White Emperor, the Lords of Yuankun Domain, couldn’t compare with this man in terms of cultivation speed and combat ability within the same realm.
Could it be that Han Li is a reincarnation of a True Immortal?
But she had never heard of True Immortals reincarnating in the world, and even those who were reincarnated from Heavenly Immortals were few and far between.
Could it be that Han Li’s aptitude and constitution are even higher than those of Immortal Grade?
Zi Miao Zhen felt somewhat bewildered, her heart surging like the tides, and with her vast experience, she now didn’t know how to evaluate him.
“Fortunately, Han Li doesn’t know that I’ve seen him once before.”
Zi Miao Zhen suddenly felt a sense of relief; in this way, it won’t be too embarrassing. She could pretend she had never met Han Li before, as if this was their first encounter.
Otherwise, if this news got out, the entire Endless Yuankun Domain would be shaken.
She was one of the three fairies of White Emperor City, a peerless figure on the Heavenly Immortal list, celebrated across the Endless Yuankun Domain, pursued by countless cultivators, esteemed and dignified, almost like a banished fairy.
She had come to this area of Qianyuan Divine Province by the order of White Emperor to search for a fragment of Empress Huangyue’s soul. It should have been an easy task with a reward whether she succeeded or not, and she could even try her luck at a chance with the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
Unfortunately, reality was harsh compared to her ideal vision.
She ended up “trapped before achieving her mission”—not even reaching Qianyuan Divine Province when she was caught on the way and fell into Han Li’s hands.
Forget about seeking fortune from the Great Emperor, she couldn’t even return to Taibai Divine Province now, and in this man’s hands, her safety was in peril.
If Han Li dared to intercept her halfway, using many Immortal and Imperial weapons, she could guess with her toes that Empress Huangyue’s fragment, Yao Xi, and Empress Yuanchu’s fragment, Murong Ying, must have been captured by Han Li, and the disappearance of Empress Yuanchu’s fragment might also be connected to him.
Knowing Han Li’s secret and identity, how could Han Li let her go?
Having made his decision, Han Li looked at Zi Miao Zhen, whose expression was changing, and smilingly said, “It is, of course, to take you as my wife.”
“You’ve come to me on your own. If I don’t accept you, wouldn’t it be a waste of heaven’s gifts?”
Ironically, this turned out to be a lucky mistake; he captured an extraordinary female saint, fulfilling one of his wishes.
It was even better that Zi Miao Zhen was not from the Huangyue Imperial Empire or Yuanchu Mountain. This way, he might be able to catch two more exceptional female saints if they happened to be saints.
What if Zi Miao Zhen was from White Emperor City? What if it was one of the dominant powers of the Endless Yuankun Domain?
He had already married off Yao Xi, the soul fragment of Empress Huangyue, and Murong Ying, the soul fragment of Empress Yuanchu, offending two unparalleled empresses. What’s another offense against the White Emperor?
The White Emperor didn’t even know it was his doing. As long as he could delay for a while, by then, not to mention the White Emperor, he wanted to overturn even Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu.
Zi Miao Zhen was indeed very beautiful, and among Han Li’s wives and concubines, there were very few that could compare with Zi Miao Zhen.
Zi Miao Zhen’s temperament, status, cultivation, and constitution all had a tremendous appeal to Han Li. It was impossible for him to let her go; he’d rather turn the raw rice into cooked rice and then discuss the matter.
Zi Miao Zhen’s complexion changed slightly, and with furrowed brows, she asked, “Did you really take the soul fragments of Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu as your wives?”
According to the information she had, the soul fragments of these two unparalleled empresses were not dead, and the best-case scenario was that they had married someone else, with the worst-case scenario being a dire one.
“That’s correct.” Han Li acknowledged it openly, with one hand, he pinched Zi Miao Zhen’s tender and soft chin and said lightly, “So, do you want to join them?”
Zi Miao Zhen pulled away from Han Li’s hand. A trace of indignation emerged on her flawless face, which then settled into calm, and she sighed,
“You truly are audacious.”
She had seen many audacious cultivators, but Han Li was the first she had encountered who was so daring, to the point of meddling with the soul fragments of two unparalleled empresses. No wonder Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu had been seething with anger before.

chapters.title: Chapter 520: 225: Reincarnation of a True Immortal? Grandmaster Da'ai Marries Again! Zimiao's Generous Gift! The Empress Takes Maternity Leave_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 520: Chapter 225: Reincarnation of a True Immortal? Grandmaster Da’ai Marries Again! Zimiao’s Generous Gift! The Empress Takes Maternity Leave_2
As for herself, she was merely a female saint at the Holy Abyss Realm, who, even as a Heavenly Immortal on the Celestial Ranking, ranked far below the split souls of the two peerless female emperors.
“As long as one has the courage, even empresses need to take maternity leave,” Han Li said indifferently.
Zi Miao Zhen gazed at Han Li in front of her, unable to deny that the man had an audacious spirit unlike any she had seen in the Tongxuan Realm.
Han Li not only married the split souls of the two peerless empresses but also wished to marry the empresses themselves and even hoped they would become pregnant, which was incredibly brazen.
If the Empress Yuan Chu and Empress Huang Yue knew about this, they would probably cross endless time and space to slap Han Li… but it seems they couldn’t kill him…
Suddenly, Zi Miao Zhen remembered that Han Li possessed a holy weapon whose might rivaled that of a True Immortal’s weapon, so even the Empress Yuan Chu and Empress Huang Yue might not be able to suppress him.
This man truly had confidence!
Zi Miao Zhen sighed inwardly and after some thought, decided not to dwell on the two peerless empresses and their split souls, but instead asked seriously, “Do you really want me to be your Dao companion?”
Zi Miao Zhen didn’t care much about this.
Becoming someone’s Dao companion was quite normal, wasn’t it?
Although Han Li was audacious, he was indeed a match for her; or rather, it was she who was reaching above her station by being his Dao companion.
She was a well-known Heavenly Immortal from the Endless Yuankun Domain, but apart from having a higher cultivation level, she was inferior to Han Li in every other aspect.
Putting aside Han Li’s audacious nature, he was the best suitor she could choose.
Han Li had high aptitude, a strong constitution, good looks, and was young. Whether it was a once-in-a-lifetime genius or the reincarnation of an immortal, Han Li’s potential was limitless and his future bright; there was no doubt about it.
Equipped with holy weapons and so many Heaven Imperial Realm level emperor weapons, Han Li was also stable and cautious in his actions. He had concealed two Big Realms of cultivation upon their first meeting and had sensed the upcoming crisis well in advance, quietly extinguishing the danger in the shadows…
This unmatched individual was destined to rise like the wind, soaring directly to the pinnacle of the Endless Yuankun Domain, possibly achieving even more than the peerless Great Emperor like White Emperor in the future.
After all, White Emperor’s achievements at Han Li’s current realm didn’t come close to what Han Li had accomplished.
Being Han Li’s Dao companion and with his support, she wouldn’t need to toil for the great emperor’s opportunity; she could likely grasp the Heavenly Sovereign Path and become an empress herself.
Or rather, with Han Li’s help, seizing a great emperor’s opportunity would become much easier. With the holy weapon to back her up, she wouldn’t have to worry about any tricks from that Heaven Imperial Realm emperor.
“Of course, it has to be you,” Han Li said solemnly.
If Zi Miao Zhen could come to terms with this, then that would be great for both, but if she couldn’t reconcile with the idea, he would have no choice but to take a more forceful approach, since the gentler one was no longer an option.
Zi Miao Zhen sighed and hesitated to speak.
Unconsciously, she compared Han Li with White Emperor.
The female cultivators living in White Emperor City, Taibai Divine Province, and the other fifty-two Divine Provinces under White Emperor City’s jurisdiction mostly dreamt of becoming White Emperor’s Dao companion.
White Emperor was too strong and too outstanding, causing every other male cultivator to pale in comparison, not accounting for even one ten-thousandth of White Emperor.
Zi Miao Zhen had never entertained such thoughts; she knew she wasn’t a match for White Emperor, who pursued Empress Huang Yue and had no interest in other female cultivators. Zi Miao Zhen didn’t bother to join the throng.
She only wanted to become stronger!
She wanted to become a peerless empress like Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuan Chu.
Once she achieved that, she would naturally exude unrivaled elegance and brilliance, illuminating the endless Yuankun Domain and courted by all the Heaven Imperial Realm emperors.
Although Han Li’s current cultivation level was not on par with White Emperor’s, in the future, he could possibly be stronger and even more outstanding.
“Hesitant to speak… is there something you’re concerned about?”
Seeing Zi Miao Zhen’s demeanor, Han Li had a hunch; it seemed that she wasn’t too opposed to him.
This was also within Han Li’s expectations; he had encountered such situations before, and adults were adept at weighing the pros and cons. Unless one loses their sanity, they wouldn’t act foolishly.
Taking a deep breath, Zi Miao Zhen said straightforwardly, “How do you plan to deal with White Emperor?”
“Oh?”
Han Li raised an eyebrow and replied indifferently, “Is there any hidden danger concerning White Emperor?”
Zi Miao Zhen had vanished in the vast sea between Luming Divine Province and Qianyuan Divine Province. The outside world was completely unaware of her disappearance, assuming she was still carrying out her mission for White Emperor City.
By the time White Emperor City realized what happened, who knew how much time would have passed.
By then, tracing her whereabouts would become even more difficult, and even if White Emperor could trace back through time, so what?
He had already ordered Sword Spirit Xi Yue to extinguish all traces, and even if White Emperor deployed a True Immortal’s weapon, unless it was particularly adept at divining the workings of heaven, it was impossible to trace back to him, and even if it was, it might not succeed.
By the time, Han Li believed he should have the ability to cope with White Emperor.
Seeing Han Li’s unconcerned expression, Zi Miao Zhen sighed and said solemnly, “Han Li, do not underestimate White Emperor, his methods are unfathomable.”
“I know you have many tricks up your sleeve, and you have a holy weapon, but there are some things you might have overlooked, and if they’re not addressed in time, they can lead to major trouble,” she added.
“Let’s hear it,” Han Li said earnestly.
Zi Miao Zhen breathed a sigh of relief, glad that Han Li was heeding her advice. If he had been too arrogant, she would have had to reconsider.
“I have a life lamp in White Emperor City; if I died, White Emperor City would discover it immediately, they would lock onto the murderer by tracing the soul strand in that lamp with karmic methods.”
“The Bihai Bowl is a Top Grade emperor weapon. Although White Emperor has not refined it, the Artifact Spirit still has a connection to White Emperor, transmitting messages every three years.”

chapters.title: Chapter 521: 225: Reincarnation of a True Immortal? Grandmaster Da'ai Marries Again! Zimiao's Generous Gift! The Empress Takes Maternity Leave_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 521: Chapter 225: Reincarnation of a True Immortal? Grandmaster Da’ai Marries Again! Zimiao’s Generous Gift! The Empress Takes Maternity Leave_3
“Even if you suppress the Bihai Bowl, it will be of no use. In one year, the Bihai Bowl must initiate transmission to White Emperor City. If White Emperor City doesn’t receive the transmission from the Bihai Bowl, it will actively start an investigation.”
“The last time I appeared was in Luming Divine Province. Afterwards, I went to Qianyuan Divine Province. These are all clues. When the time comes, fingers will be pointed at Qianyuan Divine Province, and your Mysterious Forces will be the prime suspects.”
“Besides, I must return within ten years to report back. Although the White Emperor hasn’t set a deadline for the mission, the search mission shouldn’t take more than a decade at most.”
Zi Miao, the True Immortal, spoke gravely, concluding, “Han Li, you should think carefully. Without resolving these hidden dangers, it would be useless for me to be your Dao Companion. When the time comes, it won’t be just the White Emperor coming after us.”
According to Han Li’s methods, Ji Mingyue of the Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuan Youwei of the Empress Yuanchu’s reign would eventually have to be suppressed by Han Li as well.
The female saints, Quasi Emperors, and even Empresses of the three most powerful entities—the Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, and White Emperor City—having their spirits fall in Qianyuan Divine Province, would shock the entire Endless Yuankun Domain.
Though Qianyuan Divine Province has seven Great Holy Land Schools with profound foundations and is not easily provoked by the most powerful forces on normal days, when the time comes, with the personal arrival of the White Emperor, the Huangyue Empress, and the Empress Yuanchu, and the exhibition of three True Immortal weapons, Qianyuan Divine Province will have to compromise.
Moreover, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain doesn’t have good relations with the likes of Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Myriad Demon Mountain. These Great Holy Land Schools all want to eliminate the Mysterious Forces represented by Chengsheng Mountain.
By then, it’s likely they’ll be attacked from all sides.
If she were to become Han Li’s Dao Companion and Chengsheng Mountain fell in ten years, her fate wouldn’t be good either. If that were the case, she wouldn’t want it.
Hearing this, Han Li’s eyebrows slightly furrowed. Zi Miao, the True Immortal, mentioned issues he indeed hadn’t considered.
The matter of the transmission by the Bihai Bowl, a Top-Grade Emperor Weapon, was easy to manage with a mix of coercion and persuasion, but Zi Miao, the True Immortal, was supposed to return to White Emperor City after her mission ends, and that couldn’t take too long; only eight years were left.
Naturally, Han Li wouldn’t let Zi Miao go. If Zi Miao returned to White Emperor City, the trouble would be significant. Even if Zi Miao didn’t speak of it, the White Emperor with his profound divination abilities would surely detect the changes in Zi Miao.
After all, by eight years later, Zi Miao would have given birth to a few children, her aura would have shifted, various habits changed, making discovery all the more likely.
After thinking it over, Han Li said, “I will make the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl obediently follow orders, transmitting some information on schedule without revealing our secrets.”
“As for your return to White Emperor City in eight years, that’s only theoretical, assuming it could be resolved in at most ten years.”
“That’s also manageable. As long as the split souls of the two female emperors aren’t found, you can continue staying here in Qianyuan Divine Province. Just make an occasional appearance. Like with the Bihai Bowl, maintain communication with White Emperor City.”
“If it really comes down to it, I can create some trouble for White Emperor City under a different identity, drawing their attention for a while so they won’t focus on you,” Han Li spoke confidently, as if he had full control of the situation.
“Is that safe?” asked Zi Miao, the True Immortal, hesitantly. She felt that the plan didn’t seem very reliable…
“It’s definitely safe, and…”
Han Li said indifferently, his tone shifting, but he didn’t finish his sentence.
Zi Miao understood what he wanted to say, and she didn’t have a choice. Captured by Han Li, her cultivation sealed, she might be unwilling, but Han Li would probably force his way.
Pursing her delicate, pink lips, Zi Miao fell silent for a while before finally asking, “If I agree, what’s in it for me?”
After wrestling with her thoughts, she had made her decision; she just wanted to negotiate some benefits for herself.
“The Bihai Bowl will be yours,” Han Li said flatly.
Zi Miao was somewhat taken aback. Han Li was really generous, though it was generosity at the White Emperor’s expense.
But fair is fair, Zi Miao was genuinely tempted. This was a Heavenly Sovereign level Emperor weapon, and although she held high status, she only had an ordinary Quasi Emperor weapon at her disposal.
“You are currently at the first layer of the Sacred Abyss Realm. I will provide all resources for your cultivation in the future, ensuring sufficiency. You can claim the benefits of Chengsheng Mountain according to your privileges, and I won’t disappoint you.”
“I’ll also give you a Taoism Pill to help you better advance into the Quasi Emperor domain and lay the best foundation for breaking into the Heaven Imperial Realm.”
“Right now, you’re merely a King’s Physique, but I have a way to evolve you into an Emperor’s Physique. When you ascend to the Heaven Imperial Realm in the future, mastering the Heavenly Sovereign Path will be a matter of course.”
Han Li listed all the key benefits for Zi Miao in one breath, the details of which didn’t matter much, for Zi Miao would soon discover them herself.
The Taoism Pill was intended to help Great Saints ascend to the Quasi Emperor level. He had copied ten of them using the Chengdao Vial, prepared especially for a future female saintly Dao Companion like Zi Miao.
He indeed had a method to elevate a King’s Physique to an Emperor’s Physique, requiring only the expenditure of Physique Points. Of course, Zi Miao would have to wait for a considerable amount of time, but certainly before she cultivated to the peak of the Quasi Emperor level.
“Hiss~”
Listening to Han Li’s promises, even the worldly Zi Miao’s breathing quickened, and she involuntarily took a deep breath of Spiritual Energy.
Han Li was truly generous!
He was really investing heavily for her!
A Top-Grade Emperor weapon, all cultivating resources, a Taoism Pill for advancing to the Quasi Emperor domain, ascending to an Emperor’s Physique…
Even within White Emperor City, one of the strongest forces in the Yuankun Domain, she would not receive such treatment. It was much too far removed.
Within White Emperor City, there were many prodigies, fierce competition, and limited resources. Even for her to secure a part of them required great effort.

chapters.title: Chapter 522: 225: Reincarnation of a True Immortal? Grandmaster Da'ai Marries Again! Zimiao's Generous Gift! The Empress Takes Maternity Leave_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 522: Chapter 225: Reincarnation of a True Immortal? Grandmaster Da’ai Marries Again! Zimiao’s Generous Gift! The Empress Takes Maternity Leave_4
And to become Han Li’s Dao companion, she could easily obtain all these, making Zhen Miaozhen feel somewhat surreal.
It was as if Chengsheng Mountain were one of the nine strongest forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, and White Emperor City was merely a small power within the Divine Province.
Looking at the earnest Han Li, what could Zhen Miaozhen say? She had nothing to offer in return and could only agree to marry him with her body.
“I agree,” Zhen Miaozhen said earnestly.
Once she had decided to become Han Li’s Dao companion, she would not change her mind. As long as Han Li did not let her down, she would not harbor any other thoughts. Zhen Miaozhen also had her pride.
The White Emperor treated her well, but becoming Han Li’s Dao companion did not harm the interests of White Emperor City. Some things were out of her control, and should a conflict arise between Chengsheng Mountain and White Emperor City in the future, she would still lobby on behalf of White Emperor City.
After marrying Han Li, she would need to keep a low profile for a long time. Once Chengsheng Mountain officially made its appearance in the Yuankun Domain, then she could return to the public eye. At that time, she would be able to climb many ranks on the Heavenly Immortal list in one breath, once again becoming famous throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain.
“Since you are my Dao companion and have this hobby, then I will give you two more great gifts,” Zhen Miaozhen said, a sly gleam flashing in her beautiful eyes.
“Oh? Let’s hear it,” Han Li was also curious about what gift Zhen Miaozhen would give him.
“The women sent by Empress Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu to search for their split souls are all peerless beauties, all of whom exist on the Heavenly Immortal list, and not a bit inferior to me.”
Zhen Miaozhen said with a smile, blatantly selling out Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei.
Now that she, Zhen Miaozhen, had become Han Li’s Dao companion, her rival Ji Mingyue could not escape, and as for Yuan Youwei, Zhen Miaozhen bore no grudge against her.
However, Yuan Youwei was also part of the investigation and would eventually come to scrutinize Chengsheng Mountain. Now that Zhen Miaozhen was part of Chengsheng Mountain, she naturally could not let Yuan Youwei succeed, otherwise her own interests would be harmed.
“Heavenly Immortal list?” Han Li raised an eyebrow.
After Zhen Miaozhen explained, and he heard that the nine female emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm, including Empress Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu, were on it, a very bold idea formed in Han Li’s heart.
He was going to monopolize this Heavenly Immortal list!
Wasn’t the Heavenly Immortal list prepared for the old ancestor? How could he be called the great loving ancestor if he didn’t take all the fairy daughters back to Chengsheng Mountain in one go?
Zhen Miaozhen was just the first, followed by Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei, these two fairy daughters from the Heavenly Immortal list, and he was somewhat impatient.
Han Li learned that Ji Mingyue was under Empress Phoenix Moon, at the fourth level of the Sanctified Abyss Realm, while Yuan Youwei was under Empress Yuanchu, with Quasi Emperor cultivation.
Currently, Ji Mingyue was still in the Luming Divine Province, while Yuan Youwei’s whereabouts were unknown. Zhen Miaozhen had not seen her, but Yuan Youwei must be somewhere in the Qianyuan Divine Province region.
“This is fantastic.”
Han Li embraced Zhen Miaozhen into his arms, feeling the warmth and softness of her body, and he suddenly became restless, involuntarily leaning down his head.
Zhen Miaozhen’s delicate body trembled, being held in the arms of the opposite sex for the first time, feeling Han Li’s body heat, her heart fluttering. She wanted to struggle, but did not resist.
Now and soon to be Han Li’s Dao companion, it was better not to make any futile resistance.
Seeing Han Li lower his head, Zhen Miaozhen’s tender, glossy lips were tightly sealed, until at last, she involuntarily closed her eyes, quietly waiting for Han Li to act.
When Han Li broke through her teeth guard, Zhen Miaozhen’s delicate body was struck like by lightning, shivering with tingling sensations, feeling utterly weak.
At that moment, Zhen Miaozhen only had two thoughts.
She had lost her first kiss.
This taste seemed quite nice.
In the following days, Han Li introduced Zhen Miaozhen to Lingshuang, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang, and many other wives and concubines, helping Zhen Miaozhen integrate into the family.
When Zhen Miaozhen learned that Chengsheng Mountain had numerous treasures such as the Fighting Tower, the Time-Sky Tower, the Life-Prolonging Furnace, Pieces of Natural Jade Symbol, Chengdao Vial, and many others that aid in cultivation, she was once again shocked and felt fortunate for her decision.
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Chu Yutong, Lin Yiwu, Zhou Zhirou, and other wives and concubines were even more astounded when they learned of Zhen Miaozhen’s cultivation level.
Has their lord begun to welcome female saints of the Sanctified Abyss Realm as Dao companions?
This made all the wives and concubines, including Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang, and others, feel somewhat surreal, but they also accepted the result.
Having Zhen Miaozhen, an absolute female saint, join their large family was a good thing.
Two days later, Han Li held a grand wedding ceremony on Chengsheng Mountain and brought Zhen Miaozhen over the threshold.
When the news that old ancestor Han had taken yet another wife spread, the various powers of the Xuan Domain became numb. Truly worthy of the great loving ancestor.
Many great powers were curious about the origins of Han Li’s newlywed wife, but no one knew.
Those who were willing to offer face sent a congratulatory gift to Han Mansion, those unwilling to do so simply ignored it; after all, the old ancestor’s marriage pace was too fast, and they had not had time to prepare any gifts.
After the wedding, Han Li arrived at Zhen Miaozhen’s chamber, entered the bridal room, and enjoyed a wonderful night.
For this occasion, Han Li had already undone the seals on Zhen Miaozhen’s physical body, Primordial Spirit, and all but her cultivation level.
As the saying goes: “The private chamber is a humble abode, yet it is renewed only by us.”
At this moment, like Boya meeting Ziqi, with mountains flowing with water, and the sound of exquisite music never ceasing.
This time, Han Li and Zhen Miaozhen’s discussion of the Dao lasted very long.
Zhen Miaozhen, indeed a peerless female saint of the Sanctified Abyss Realm, was experienced and knowledgeable, with profound cultivation, deep Daoist foundations, a strong physical body, and a magnificent Primordial Spirit, providing Han Li with a completely different experience from before.
Han Li was also surprised to discover that Zhen Miaozhen had the legendary treasured body “Seven Orifices Exquisite Heart,” which greatly shocked him.
Thus, in addition to the physical struggle, Han Li also had a spiritual communion with Zhen Miaozhen’s Primordial Spirit.
Because the action became too intense, Han Li directly isolated the chamber, to avoid the exquisite sounds from leaking outside, which would have caused his wives and concubines to flush with embarrassment.

chapters.title: Chapter 523: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 523: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
At dawn,
where sunlight could not reach, Han Li had penetrated.
“Want another round?”
Zi Miao Zhen, who had discussed the Dao all night, lay on the bed without a stitch, lazily propping up her chin.
After a prolonged battle, Zi Miao Zhen no longer bore yesterday’s innocent and holy Heavenly Immortal appearance, her face flushed with a healthy glow, her eyebrows suggestive of spring, her eyes alluring as silk.
Han Li was about to leave, but turned around at her words, seeing Zi Miao Zhen’s slender jade hand on her thigh, and her other hand brought her delicate, white fingertips to her red lips and teeth.
She was no Heavenly Fairy but a peerless enchantress!
Zi Miao Zhen was one of the three great fairies of White Emperor City, renowned throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain. If her suitors saw her now, their Dao hearts would surely shatter.
Luckily the senior’s heart was kind, and such scenes were for his eyes alone.
“What a little vixen.”
Han Li was someone who didn’t know how to refuse, so under these circumstances, he had no choice but to continue exchanging Daoist insights with Zi Miao Zhen.
“Zhen’er, take as you wish.”
As the words fell, Han Li approached, sat on the bed, and readied himself for a seated wait ().[Fill in the blank]
After finishing the morning’s “lessons,” Han Li imparted profound Daoist knowledge to Zi Miao Zhen, making her submit wholeheartedly.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li flipped his palm, revealing a palm-sized, jade-green bowl, unremarkable at first glance.
These days, Han Li had been busy exchanging affections with Zi Miao Zhen and preparing to wed this unparalleled saintess, and had yet to deal with the Bihai Bowl, a Top Grade imperial weapon.
“Xi Yue.”
With a soft call from Han Li, Xi Yue’s perfect form appeared beside him, her face brimming with smiles as she looked at him.
“Master.”
“Extract the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, and if it harbors any ill intent, teach it a severe lesson,” Han Li said indifferently.
“Okay.”
Xi Yue nodded, her fair and delicate fingers gingerly hooking toward the Bihai Bowl.
A beam of light uncontrollably soared from the bowl, growing larger, then landed on the ground.
As the light dissipated, it revealed a stunning beauty in a green dress, her figure ravishing, with voluptuous curves, long white and slender legs adorned with a white leg ring on the left.
“Han Li, what do you want to do?”
The Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit, appearing weak and delicate, asked Han Li feebly.
Although the Bihai Bowl was sealed, the Artifact Spirit had heard every word of Han Li’s discussion with Zi Miao Zhen.
“Of course, I want to…you.”
As Han Li gazed upon the woman in the green dress, his eyes lit up; he had expected a burly man, but instead before him stood a beauty. He thought silently, then said lightly, “Don’t you know perfectly well what I want to do?”
“I won’t agree,” the lady in green scoffed coldly.
As one of the Lords of Yuankun Domain, and one of the nine supreme Immortal Emperors, betraying Bai Di was out of the question for her.
Even with Han Li’s boundless potential, before he could grow strong, Bai Di could easily crush him—betrayal carried too high a cost.
“You won’t agree, eh?”
Han Li raised an eyebrow and said indifferently, “Xi Yue, infuse her body with a sliver of immortal light.”
With a flick of Xi Yue’s fingers, a thread of immortal light entered the green-dressed woman’s body, making her initially ethereal form solidify, indistinguishable from a real creature.
“You…you…you…what are you going to do?” The green-dressed woman suddenly panicked, fearing the possibility that crossed her mind.
She couldn’t possibly be targeted by Han Li, could she?
After all, she was an Artifact Spirit!
Who would do such a thing with an Artifact Spirit? The very idea was twisted.
Nevertheless, judging by Han Li’s visage, it seemed he might do as she feared. As he approached, the green-dressed woman’s heart raced in wild throbs, her fragrant heart pounding.
“Please no!” She begged inwardly.
Han Li reached out, lifting the green-dressed woman’s chin and unceremoniously stamped a kiss on her.
Feeling her rigid body under his touch, Han Li was dissatisfied and pried her teeth apart for a more aggressive kiss.
The green-dressed woman was stupefied, her flawless pale face filled with confusion.
Who am I?
Where am I?
What am I doing?
Once out of her daze, the green-dressed woman tried to resist, aiming to at least bite Han Li’s tongue as a lesson to him.
But her cheeks were firmly held by Han Li, her luscious lips involuntarily parting, her teeth unable to close, utterly controlled by Han Li.
Afterward, Han Li licked his lips as if savoring the moment, then spoke to the glaring green-dressed woman, “Calm down, if you don’t agree, there’s more to come that’s even more thrilling.”
“You!”
The green-dressed woman bared her small fangs, gesticulating fiercely at Han Li before finally speaking coldly, “Whatever, I could never betray Bai Di.”
“Oh, I see you’re quite loyal to Bai Di.”
Han Li clicked his tongue twice and, without further ado, pulled the green-dressed woman into his embrace. The two vanished from Chengdao Peak, returning to his chamber.
The Daoist exchange that followed was fiery and intense.
Like white garments stripped away by day, like the Yellow River flowing into the sea…
“Shameless! I would never betray Bai Di.”
“Bastard, you’re hurting me.”
“Han Li, be gentle.”
“Han Li, why have you stopped moving?”
“….”
When her melodious voice subsided, Biyuan could not help but pull over a blanket to cover her exhausted body.
“Han Li, you truly are a shameless lecher—remember, I am an Artifact Spirit, what do you take me for?”
Biyuan, the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, fumed, her voice brimming with anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 524: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 524: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
Han Li leisurely tidied his clothes, and a smile surfaced on his face upon hearing her words, as he uttered two characters.
Biyuan’s exquisitely flawless face instantly flushed red. She felt insulted by Han Li, yet, for some reason, there was a hint of excitement in her heart. So this was what lovemaking was like?
As Han Li wantonly appraised her body, carved as if from pure white jade, Biyuan, angry and embarrassed, shouted, “Get out!”
“Tsk, that’s not what you said when we were discussing the Dao just now. You were the one who told me to hurry up, even saying ‘don’t stop…’” Han Li teased.
Although he had tasted the flavor of many Artifact Spirits, like Shi Qi, Yin Ling, Yue Ji, and Jian Ji, engaging in Dao discussion with Biyuan still felt uniquely delightful to Han Li.
Indeed, as the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, she was truly as boundless as the ocean. Han Li could describe her in only one word: incredibly smooth!
Looking at a somewhat shy and furious Biyuan, Han Li calmly asked, “Have you made up your mind?”
“I would never betray the White Emperor,” Biyuan muttered softly.
Soon after, Biyuan cried out, “White Emperor, come quickly! Otherwise, Han Li won’t make his move…”
An hour later, a cream puff freshly baked.
Han Li and Biyuan appeared atop Chengdao Peak. Han Li asked again, “Biyuan, fancy another challenge match?”
Biyuan’s pretty face turned deathly pale, and she waved her hands frantically, vehemently shaking her head.
During their previous discourse, she had been tormented by Han Li. Her true form was sealed, and even her strength as an Artifact Spirit was bound. She was no match for Han Li.
“Are you so loyal to the White Emperor?” Han Li inquired.
Biyuan remained silent. Han Li arched an eyebrow. Did the White Emperor possess such a charismatic personality?
She shook her head, hesitating to speak.
“Speak whatever is on your mind,” Han Li said indifferently.
After hesitating, Biyuan stammered, “That… You’ve already… done that to me… do you only know how to be forceful… and ask for my submission?”
“Can’t you… like with… Zimiao Zhen, offer me some… benefits?”
Biyuan’s cheeks reddened, and she involuntarily lowered her head, her voice dropping lower and lower.
She wasn’t particularly loyal to the White Emperor. She just wanted to get some benefits from Han Li, but all he did was impose his will upon her.
Biyuan was infuriated. Why be so generous with Zimiao Zhen?
Although she was an Artifact Spirit, she was not inferior to Zimiao Zhen at all. She had once served him so well, did he only want to freeload?
Her true form was, after all, a Top Grade Imperial Weapon, far more useful than Zimiao Zhen. Yet he only whined and complained at her, never offering any tangible benefits.
Han Li possessed such vast wealth. He had many Supreme Grade Imperial Weapons and even Immortal Weapons, with unfathomable resources.
What would it cost him to offer her a small share?
A flicker of surprise crossed Han Li’s face.
Clever Biyuan, stammering like that, why couldn’t you be so eloquent when discussing the Dao before?
Han Li chuckled. He suddenly understood—he had misunderstood Biyuan. But it turned out to be quite nice; he had never before forcefully discussed the Dao with an Artifact Spirit.
After a moment of thought, Han Li proposed, “I’ll help you ascend to the rank of a Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon within a century. How about that?”
Biyuan’s head shot up, her heart pounding violently. She struggled to contain her excitement and asked, “With extra pay!”
Pausing, Biyuan hurriedly added, “That way, I could also sell you some information about the White Emperor and White Emperor City that Zimiao Zhen doesn’t know.”
Without hesitation, Biyuan betrayed the White Emperor.
Previously, she had insisted she would never betray the White Emperor, but only because the price wasn’t right. After all, Han Li had shown her such disregard and offered no respect for her position.
“I’ll help you ascend to a Heavenly Immortal Weapon within a millennium,” Han Li offered, painting a grand vision.
For Biyuan, rising from a Top Grade Imperial Weapon to a Heavenly Immortal Weapon in a millennium was unimaginable. Yet for Han Li, it was nothing extraordinary.
In fact, he even overstated it. Otherwise, he could have straight up promised to help Biyuan become an Immortal Weapon within a century, something entirely within his power to achieve.
Heavenly Immortal Weapon!
Biyuan’s breathing quickened as she nodded emphatically like a pecking chicken, her voice filled with excitement, “Deal!”
Whether Han Li could fulfill the promise was inconsequential. Either way, she had bitten off a piece of that grand promise and was now overstuffed. After all, she had eaten quite a lot earlier.
She still couldn’t comprehend how she, an Artifact Spirit, was even capable of taking in all those things.
After swearing on the Oath Stone, Biyuan allowed Han Li to channel his Mana into the core region of the Bihai Bowl, accepting his refinement and making Han Li the new master of the Bihai Bowl, a Top Grade Imperial Weapon.
Having successfully managed Biyuan, the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, Han Li breathed a sigh of relief as likely troubles were substantially minimized.
Over the next ten days, Han Li took Zimiao Zhen on a leisurely tour of the mountains and waters, experiencing the awe of looking down on all peaks and the mystery of peering into the profound depths of valleys.
It was only after Zimiao Zhen became pregnant that Han Li reluctantly let go of this peerless female sage.
Throughout these days, he gained a deeper understanding of the White Emperor, White Emperor City, and the Endless Yuankun Domain. While Zimiao Zhen had some reservations, Biyuan was meticulous in telling Han Li everything, finally copying the relevant memories for him.
Honesty was key.
From Zimiao Zhen, Han Li also learned about her purpose for coming to Qianyuan Divine Province, and that the White Emperor was actually coveting the wife he intended for himself, deciding to teach the White Emperor a small lesson in the future.
He also discovered that Zimiao Zhen was planning to snatch opportunities from a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, who was suppressed under Leizhou in the mighty Emperor Formation.
Han Li was supportive of this, though he suggested she wait a while longer.
Afterward, Han Li found Lu Tianxiang and strolled with her on Chengsheng Mountain, enjoying the scenery and casually discussing various matters.

chapters.title: Chapter 525: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 525: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
Ever since Lu Tianxiang had conceived the Fragrant Body, she had become pregnant again. Several months have passed already, a joint effort from both Han Li and Lu Tianxiang.
Under these circumstances, the Sect Hierarch naturally couldn’t engage in discourse about the Dao. However, the Sect Hierarch is not limited to a single path. Guess what Lu Tianxiang’s delicate and stunning red lips are used for?
When Lu Tianxiang swallowed a large amount of essence, she couldn’t help but give Han Li a glare. At that moment, her eyes seductive like silk and oozing with allure, she presented a variety of charming expressions that gave Han Li the impulse to take her right then and there.
Suppressing the flames in his heart, Han Li decided to later engage Xue Yueqing, that vixen, in a serious discourse. He solemnly asked, “Yongzhen is almost ready to go out for training, isn’t he?”
Lu Tianxiang nodded lightly in response.
Han Yongzhen, her eldest son, was not even twenty years old yet and had already reached the Initial Stage of the Hollow Void Realm. He had cultivated powerful techniques and mastered several high-level martial arts, far surpassing the combat ability of ordinary people.
Han Yongzhen originally had only Third Grade talent, but he had now advanced to Second Grade. In half a month, it would be his turn for the second baptism in the Life-Prolonging Furnace, and he would ascend to First Grade talent.
In Lu Tianxiang’s plan, after reaching the Hollow Void Stage, Han Yongzhen was to venture out for training. It was not good to always stay in the Han Mansion; he needed to broaden his horizons, and perhaps he would encounter some chances of his own.
But due to the upcoming baptism in the Life-Prolonging Furnace, after discussing with Lu Tianxiang, Han Yongzhen agreed to postpone his training journey by half a month.
After receiving the baptism of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, not only would Han Yongzhen’s talent improve to First Grade, but he might also develop a special constitution.
As the once greatest talent of the Han Mansion, Han Yongzhen was the center of attention. Han Li had also poured much of his efforts into him, enlightening and resolving his doubts many times.
With the Enlightenment Stone left by Han Li on Enlightenment Peak and the stone stele at the foot of the mountain, the disciples of the Han Mansion often gained insights, which enhanced their perceptiveness, and the Life-Prolonging Furnace could also enhance their understanding.
When Han Yongzhen broke through to the Hollow Void Stage, he experienced a kind of top-tier martial concept and grasped the embryonic form of this supreme martial truth.
Within the Han Mansion, many elder brothers and sisters, older and with higher cultivation than him, were no match for Han Yongzhen.
Han Yongzhen’s performance in the Combat Tower was particularly outstanding. Han Li had always kept an eye on his capable eldest son, showing great care and concern.
“Remember to take the Formation Breaking Bead with you,” Han Li instructed.
On the periphery of Leizhou’s underground world was a True Martial Realm array of Third Grade. It seemed that even the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor couldn’t lead people into it. To enter, one would have to rely on oneself.
Since Han Yongzhen’s strength wasn’t enough, he would have to carry the Formation Breaking Bead. As for how to explain and dupe that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, that would depend on Han Yongzhen’s performance.
This was also a test—if he could fool him, perhaps he could gain some fortunate encounters from the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
“I’ll remind him,” said Lu Tianxiang with a smile, nodding her head.
She had already discussed with Han Yongzhen: after going out for training, his first destination would be Leizhou, to seek fortunes at Dingyuan Manor.
As for how to beguile the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, Lu Tianxiang had already taught Han Yongzhen.
Zhang Wuji’s mother once said: The prettier the woman, the more deceptive she is.
Half a month later.
Han Yongzhen left the Yangdao Peak with a tinge of regret. Though his talent had elevated to First Grade, he had ultimately not developed a special physique. He could only wait for the next opportunity.
His expedition wouldn’t take long; he would return within a year, and then he could receive the next baptism in the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
Training outside for a year might not have the abundant cultivating environment of the Han Mansion, but it wouldn’t significantly hinder his progress. He carried many pills that could enhance his cultivation with him.
Arriving at Chengdao Peak, entering the main area with its palatial complexes, Han Yongzhen saw his mother, Lu Tianxiang.
“Mother, isn’t father coming?”
After looking around for a bit, Han Yongzhen didn’t see Han Li, and a hint of disappointment flickered in his eyes.
His father doted on him greatly. Now that he was venturing out for the first time, Han Yongzhen wondered, didn’t his father worry about his safety?
“Rest assured, Yongzhen, your father is a little tied up right now, but he’ll come to see you before you leave,” Lu Tianxiang said with a smile.
Han Yongzhen nodded and relaxed.
“Do you have everything you need? Make sure nothing is missing. Be careful and cautious when you are outside, and don’t trust others too easily…” Lu Tianxiang spoke gently.
Han Yongzhen listened attentively. Although his mother had told him this countless times, he didn’t feel the slightest bit annoyed. All he felt was moved by her care and concern.
“Don’t worry, Mother. The pills, talismans, weapons, array plates, and so on that you and father prepared for me, I’ve brought them all,” Han Yongzhen said with a smile.
He felt really lucky to be a second-gen Immortal.
His father, Han Li, had struggled all his life to build this great family fortune. From the moment of his birth, Han Yongzhen had been living in luxury, never wanting for anything, and even his training outside seemed free of dangers.
For instance, he carried several Top Grade and Supreme Grade Heaven Rank Artifacts on him—each for offense, defense, escape, and travel…
The power of those talismans, array plates, and secret treasures spanned from the Hollow Void Realm to the True Martial Realm. He also had several life-saving items given to him by his father, which could even slay those at the Divine Yuan Realm if necessary.
Of course, Han Yongzhen wouldn’t recklessly use these treasures. He would only employ them when his life was in danger; otherwise, he kept them stowed away to ensure he gained the full experience of training.
Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen continued to communicate, discussing various family matters, and when the time was almost up, Han Li finally made an appearance.

chapters.title: Chapter 526: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 526: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
“Father.”
Han Yongzhen immediately called out, his voice filled with excitement and respect. Father had finally arrived.
“Husband.” Lu Tianxiang said softly and did not speak further, allowing father and son to talk.
“Yongzhen, your first journey out for experience also comes with an assessment task, which I believe you’re well aware of.”
Looking at Han Yongzhen, Han Li’s face bore a smile as he spoke unhurriedly.
Han Yongzhen nodded and said, “Father, I understand.”
It was not just him, all the Han Mansion’s young who went out for experience had assessment tasks to complete. They would be rewarded and evaluated based on their performance, and this would be recorded in their respective files.
Han Yongzhen did not dare be negligent, as he aimed to achieve perfection and make his father proud.
Father’s beloved wives and concubines were numerous, and Mother Lu Tianxiang was just one among them. Although Mother was Father’s first wife and was implicitly referred to as the lady of the Han Mansion, Father had never made any formal declaration.
Among Father’s favored wives, there were not a few whose cultivation, status, and identity were far higher than his mother’s. For example, the recently wedded Zi Miaozhen, Mother had let slip some secrets, revealing that this lady was an unparalleled Saint, a noble figure from the lofty Saintly Yuan Stage.
He himself had over a thousand siblings, with many more outstanding than him; it was just that most had not yet begun their cultivation. Hence, Han Yongzhen wanted to use this time to stand out.
In the future, he could elevate his mother Lu Tianxiang’s status through his own achievements.
“Go, do not disappoint me.”
“Rest assured, Father.”
“Mother, I’m leaving now.”
Han Yongzhen bowed to Han Li and Lu Tianxiang, then turned and left without looking back from Chengdao Peak.
After leaving, Han Yongzhen did not return to his residence on Dengdao Peak. He had long packed his luggage into his Space Ring.
Upon reaching the foot of Chengsheng Mountain, two people were waiting for him.
“You need not accompany me.” Han Yongzhen said.
These two were Han Mansion’s Guest Elders and protectors, with cultivations at the later stages of the Hollow Void Stage. They had been arranged to assist Han Yongzhen on his journey this time.
The two exchanged glances but said nothing.
“You may go back.”
Han Yongzhen looked back at Chengsheng Mountain and stepped out of the Mountain Protection Array.
The two Hollow Void Stage Guest Elders looked at each other, unsure of what to do, standing frozen until a voice reached their ears, allowing them to return to Chengsheng Mountain with a sense of relief.
After leaving Chengsheng Mountain, Han Yongzhen did not immediately hurry to Leizhou. He intended to travel leisurely there.
Atop Chengdao Peak,
Han Li, with his arm around Lu Tianxiang, gently caressed her stomach and said with a smile, “This child, let him be.”
“Could there be any accidents?” Lu Tianxiang frowned slightly.
Although she knew Han Yongzhen had many hidden strengths, it was his first time venturing out. As a mother, she was still somewhat worried.
“Rest easy. Leizhou is not far, and should there be any mishap, I can arrive there in an instant.”
Han Li was still very confident. With his speed, he could traverse half the Xuan Domain in a single breath and appear in Leizhou in the blink of an eye without any issues.
“Then that’s good.” Lu Tianxiang’s stunning face relaxed with relief upon hearing his words.
…..
In the Taichu Realm,
Guanghan Heaven.
This place was one of the Thirty-three Heavens, vast and boundless, infinitely expansive, filled with endless worlds.
Within Guanghan Heaven there was a power named Guanghan Immortal Palace, renowned throughout the Thirty-three Heavens, with a fame that spread widely across the entire Taichu Realm.
Currently, in the depths of Guanghan Immortal Palace, upon an imperial seat crafted from Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade,
leaned a delicate figure clad in immortal garments, slim and graceful, enveloped in Infinite Immortal Light.
“How odd, why is my red phoenix star pulsing?”
On the imperial seat, the female immortal’s brows furrowed gently, her eyes shimmering with immortal light that held the birth and death of numerous universes. A mere leak of her aura could shatter the Nine Heavens.
“Will I have a companion in the future?”
After some calculation, the female immortal arrived at a startling conclusion.
What a joke! Would she, the Guanghan Empress?
She alone had battled through the Three Thousand Realms and had overpowered the Eighty Thousand Domains with a single palm, unmatched under the heavens, her fame shocking all worlds and domains.
Throughout countless eras, she had grown accustomed to solitude, spending her life pursuing the path, seeking to step into the fourth stage of cultivation.
But now, she had foreseen such a result. Most crucially, the opportunity she had sought so arduously seemed to lie with this companion.
The Guanghan Empress restored her calm in an instant, smiling faintly as she mused to herself, “Let’s see how far my future companion has come.”
She planned to personally assess him, and if he passed her test, she wouldn’t mind gaining a companion after countless lonely millennia. If not, even if it meant missing the chance for a breakthrough, she refused to settle.
She was confident that, even by herself, she would certainly transcend the Immortal Emperor Realm and step into the fourth stage of cultivation in the future.
“My future companion is actually in the Yuankun Domain? That’s the domain of that individual.” The Guanghan Empress chuckled lightly, unafraid.
Where others dared not enter that individual’s domain, she dared!
At worst, they would clash—who would fear whom?
She also wished to weigh the might of the former Emperor of Heaven and see who was truly stronger, provided that individual dared to show himself.
That day, a strand of immortal light descended from Guanghan Heaven to the Endless Yuankun Domain, almost going unnoticed.
That day, in the northwestern part of Lanyu Divine Province in the Yuankun Domain, an immortal infant was born.

chapters.title: Chapter 527: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 527: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
In the early morning,
in a place where the sunlight couldn’t reach, Han Li had penetrated.
“Want some more?”
The body of Zi Miao Zhen, who had discussed Dao all night, lay across the bed in a languid pose, propping up her chin and speaking.
After the lengthy battle, Zi Miao Zhen no longer had the pure and holy appearance of a Heavenly Immortal; instead, she was flushed with a rosy glow, her eyebrows hinted springtime, and her eyes were seductive like silk.
Han Li was prepared to leave, but upon hearing her words, he turned around only to see one of Zi Miao Zhen’s slender jade hands resting on her thigh, while the other hand extended her pale and delicate fingers to be nibbled between her ruby lips and pearly teeth.
This was no Heavenly Fairy; she was a peerless beauty!
Zi Miao Zhen was one of White Emperor City’s three great fairies, her beauty renowned across the Endless Yuankun Domain. Were her admirers to witness this scene, their Dao hearts would likely shatter.
Luckily the old ancestor had a kind heart, and these images were for his eyes only.
“You little enchantress.”
Han Li was a man who didn’t know how to reject, and in such a situation he could only continue to exchange Dao with Zi Miao Zhen.
“Zhen’er, just take as you please.”
As his voice trailed off, Han Li walked over, sat on the bed, and prepared for another seated session (fill in the blank).
After finishing his morning practice, Han Li imparted his profound Dao knowledge to Zi Miao Zhen, making her completely submissive in heart, mouth, hands, and legs.
At the peak of Chengdao Peak, Han Li turned over his palm and took out a palm-sized emerald-colored bowl that looked rather unassuming.
These days, Han Li had been busy exchanging affection with Zi Miao Zhen and preparing for the grand wedding with this exceptional woman, so he had not yet dealt with the Bihai Bowl, a top-grade imperial weapon.
“Xi Yue.”
With a soft call, the perfect figure of Xi Yue appeared beside him, smiling at him.
“Master.”
“Conjure out the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl. If it has any ulterior motives, teach it a profound lesson,” Han Li said indifferently.
“Okay.”
Xi Yue nodded, her fair, delicate fingers lightly beckoning towards the Bihai Bowl.
A glowing orb involuntarily flew out of the Bihai Bowl, growing larger as it descended to the ground.
When the light dissipated, the visage of an incredibly beautiful woman dressed in an emerald green dress was revealed. She was gorgeous, with a curvaceous body, full and lithe; her legs were long and fair, with a white band adorning one of them.
“Han Li, what are you trying to do?”
The Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, a stunning woman who appeared delicate and weak, asked Han Li feebly.
Although the Bihai Bowl was sealed, she had clearly heard Han Li’s previous conversation with Zi Miao Zhen.
“Of course I’m going to do… you.”
Looking at the woman in the green dress before him, a bright light flashed in Han Li’s eyes; he had thought she was a burly man. He murmured in his heart, then lightly said, “You already know full well what I intend to do, don’t you?”
“I will not agree,” the woman in the green dress gave a cold laugh.
The Lord of Yuankun Domain was one of the nine supreme rulers; betraying the Lord was something she could not bring herself to do.
Even with Han Li’s boundless potential, he would be crushed by the Lord before he could grow; betrayal came with too great a cost.
“You won’t agree, huh?”
Han Li slightly raised his eyebrows and indifferently said, “Xi Yue, infuse her body with a strand of Immortal light.”
Xi Yue flicked her finger, and a strand of Immortal light entered the body of the woman in the green dress, solidifying her previously ephemeral body to be as real as any living being.
“You… you… you… what are you going to do?” The woman in the green dress suddenly got flustered, as a dreadful thought flashed through her mind.
Could it be Han Li intended to lay hands on her?
She was an Artifact Spirit!
No one had ever been with an Artifact Spirit in that way; it was far too depraved.
But judging by Han Li’s expression, it seemed that her fears might be coming true. As Han Li approached, the woman in the green dress’s heart pounded erratically with fright.
“Please don’t let it be!” she silently pleaded in her heart.
Han Li reached out his hand, lifted the chin of the woman in the green dress, and unabashedly stamped a kiss on her lips.
Feeling her rigid body, Han Li unsatisfiedly pried open her teeth and helped himself as he pleased.
The woman in the green dress was completely stupefied, her immaculate face filled with bewilderment.
Who am I?
Where am I?
What am I doing?
After coming to her senses, the woman in the green dress wanted to resist, to at least bite Han Li’s tongue as a lesson to him.
But her cheeks were pinched by Han Li, her luscious lips involuntarily opened, and her teeth couldn’t close, entirely dominated by Han Li.
After it was over, Han Li licked his lips as if savoring the moment, then said to the fuming woman in the green dress, “Calm down, if you don’t agree, there are more thrilling things to come.”
“You!”
The woman in the green dress showed her fangs and flailed at Han Li before coldly saying, “Do whatever you want, I will never betray the Lord.”
“Oh, I didn’t expect you to be so loyal to the Lord.”
Han Li clicked his tongue twice, wasting no words; he directly embraced the woman in the green dress and vanished from Chengdao Peak, returning to his own chamber.
He then began a passionate process of exchanging Dao.
It could be described as clothes flying off in broad daylight, like the Yellow River flowing into the sea…
“Shameless! I will never betray the Lord.”
“Bastard, you’ve hurt me.”
“Han Li, be gentle.”
“Han Li, why have you stopped moving?”
“….”
As the beguiling singing ceased, Biyuan involuntarily pulled over the covers, hiding her exhausted body.
“Han Li, you truly are a shameless lecher. I am an Artifact Spirit, what do you take me for?”
Angrily, the Artifact Spirit Biyuan of the Bihai Bowl scolded.

chapters.title: Chapter 528: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 528: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
Han Li leisurely tidied his clothes, his face brightening into a smile as he uttered two words.
Biyuan’s delicate, flawless face instantly flushed red. She felt insulted by Han Li, yet for some reason, a hint of excitement stirred within her. Was this what lovemaking was about?
As Han Li brazenly surveyed her body, as exquisitely sculpted as jade, Biyuan shouted in angry embarrassment, “Get lost!”
“Tsks, that’s not what you said when we were discussing the Dao just now. You told me to hurry and even said ‘don’t stop’…” Han Li teased.
Although he had tasted the flavor of many Artifact Spirits, like Si Qi, Yin Ling, Yue Ji, and JianJi, engaging with Biyuan in discussion brought Han Li a different delight.
As expected of the Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit, truly as boundless as the ocean. Han Li could only think of one word to describe it: so lubricating!
Watching Biyuan, who was a mix of shy and angry, Han Li asked indifferently, “Have you made up your mind?”
“I would never betray the White Emperor,” Biyuan muttered softly.
Soon, Biyuan changed her tune, crying out, “White Emperor, come quickly, or Han Li won’t proceed…”
Half an hour later, a fresh cream puff was out of the oven.
Han Li and Biyuan appeared atop Chengdao Peak, and Han Li asked again, “Biyuan, care for a rematch to up the stakes?”
Biyuan’s pretty face turned deathly pale as she waved her hands and shook her head furiously.
In the previous discussion, she had been tormented by Han Li. Her physical form was sealed, and even her Artifact Spirit strength was sealed. She was no match for Han Li.
“Are you that loyal to the White Emperor?”
Looking at the silent Biyuan, Han Li arched an eyebrow. Did the White Emperor really have such charisma?
Biyuan shook her head, hesitating to speak.
“Speak your mind,” Han Li said lightly.
Biyuan hesitated, then stammered, “That… you… took me… that way, just… forcefully… demanding my submission?”
“Can’t you… like with… Zi Miao Zhen, give me some… benefits?”
Biyuan’s cheeks were burning, and she involuntarily lowered her head, her voice growing softer.
She wasn’t particularly loyal to the White Emperor. She just wanted to gain some benefits from Han Li, but Han Li only dominated her.
Biyuan was annoyed. Why treat Zi Miao Zhen so well?
She was an Artifact Spirit, but she was no inferior to Zi Miao Zhen. She had served him so well before, and now he only wanted to freeload?
Her main body was a Top Grade Emperor Weapon, far more useful than Zi Miao Zhen. And all he did was nag, never offering anything substantial.
Han Li had many Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons and even Immortal Weapons, his resources were unfathomably deep.
What was wrong with giving her some benefits?
A look of surprise flashed across Han Li’s face.
You’re quite the subtle one, Biyuan, why couldn’t you speak so coyly during our previous discussion?
A smile touched Han Li’s lips, and he quickly realized his misunderstanding of Biyuan. But it turned out rather nicely; it was his first time forcibly discussing the Dao with an Artifact Spirit.
Han Li thought for a moment and then offered, “Within a hundred years, I’ll help you ascend to Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, how about that?”
Biyuan abruptly lifted her head, her heart pounding. She tried to contain her excitement and said, “There’s got to be extra pay!”
Pausing, Biyuan quickly added, “That way I can also betray some information about the White Emperor and White Emperor City to you, secrets that Zi Miao Zhen doesn’t know.”
Without hesitation, Biyuan betrayed the White Emperor.
Her previous claims of undying loyalty to the White Emperor were just a matter of an insufficient price. Han Li didn’t respect her or her status at all.
“A thousand years to ascend you to a Heavenly Immortal Weapon,” Han Li proclaimed generously.
A thousand years from Top Grade Emperor Weapon to Heavenly Immortal Weapon sounded incredible to Biyuan, but it wasn’t much for Han Li.
He was speaking generously; he might as well have promised to help Biyuan ascend to Immortal Weapon in a hundred years—it was entirely feasible.
Heavenly Immortal Weapon!
Biyuan’s breathing quickened, nodding rapidly like a pecking chick, she exclaimed, “Deal!”
Whether or not Han Li could fulfill his promise was beside the point; she had bitten into the huge pie he offered.
Though, she didn’t understand how she, an Artifact Spirit, could indulge in such things.
After taking an oath with the Oath Stone, Biyuan allowed Han Li to infuse his Mana into the core region of the Bihai Bowl and accepted his refinement, making him the new master of the Top Grade Emperor Weapon, the Bihai Bowl.
Having secured the Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit, Biyuan, Han Li sighed in relief, knowing that potential troubles would now be greatly reduced.
Over the next ten days, Han Li and Zi Miao Zhen took pleasure in roaming the mountains and waters, feeling the might of their majestic views and delving into their deepest, secret valleys.
It wasn’t until Zi Miao Zhen became pregnant that Han Li reluctantly let go of the peerless female saint.
In these days, he had gained a deeper insight into the White Emperor, White Emperor City, and the Endless Yuankun Domain. Zi Miao Zhen had some reservations, but Biyuan had told Han Li every detail, finally copying the relevant memories for him.
Honesty was the main point here.
From Zi Miao Zhen, Han Li also learned why she had come to the Qianyuan Divine Province, discovering that the White Emperor was coveting his intended wife, deciding to teach the White Emperor a lesson in the future.
He also found out that Zi Miao Zhen wanted to seize an opportunity from the Great Emperor in the imperial realm imprisoned under Leizhou, within the Emperor Formation.
Han Li agreed with this though suggested she should wait a bit longer to proceed.
Later, Han Li found Lu Tianxiang, accompanying her on strolls around Chengsheng Mountain and enjoying the views while discussing some matters.

chapters.title: Chapter 529: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 529: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
Ever since Lu Tianxiang gave birth to her fragrant body, she conceived again, and now it has been several months. This is the joint effort of both Han Li and Lu Tianxiang.
In her current state, Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang naturally couldn’t engage in discussion about the Dao. However, Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang wasn’t only about one path, guess what Lu Tianxiang’s gorgeous, seductive red lips were for?
When Lu Tianxiang swallowed a large chunk of essence, she couldn’t help but give Han Li a white look. At this moment, her seductive eyes were silky, full of allure, and flirtatious in many ways, which gave Han Li a strong impulse to take her on the spot.
Suppressing the flames in his heart, Han Li decided to go discuss the Dao with that fox demon Xue Yueqing. He said seriously, “Yongzhen is about to go out for experience, right?”
Lu Tianxiang nodded slightly at his words.
Han Yongzhen was her eldest son. He was not even twenty years old and had already reached the Initial Stage of the Hollow Void Realm. He cultivated powerful techniques, mastered many high-level martial arts, and his combat ability far surpassed that of ordinary people.
Han Yongzhen originally had Third Grade talents, but he had now advanced to Second Grade. In half a month, it would be his second turn for the Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism, and then he would ascend to First Grade talents.
According to Lu Tianxiang’s plan, once Han Yongzhen reached the Hollow Void Realm, he should go out for experience. Staying always at the Han Mansion wasn’t good; going out would broaden his horizons, and he might even encounter some opportunities of his own.
But because the Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism was approaching, Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen discussed it and agreed to postpone his departure for experience by half a month.
After receiving the Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism, not only would Han Yongzhen’s talents rise to First Grade, but he might also develop a special constitution.
As the once number one talent of the Han Mansion, Han Yongzhen was in the spotlight. Han Li had also put much effort into him, providing guidance and solving doubts for him many times.
With the Enlightenment Stone left by Han Li on Enlightenment Peak, and the stele at the foot of the mountain, the disciples of Han Mansion improved their understanding if they meditated frequently, and the Life-Prolonging Furnace could also enhance their comprehension.
When Han Yongzhen broke through to the Hollow Void Realm, he felt a top-level martial understanding and grasped the true meaning of this supreme martial path.
Many older brothers and sisters within the Han Mansion who were older and had higher cultivation than him were no match for Han Yongzhen.
Han Yongzhen’s performance in the combat tower was outstanding, and Han Li always kept a watchful eye on his eldest son, treating him with immense care.
“Remember to take the Formation Breaking Bead when the time comes,” Han Li reminded him.
On the outskirts of the underground world of Leizhou, there is a Third Grade True Martial Realm formation. It seemed the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor couldn’t lead people inside; if one wanted to enter, they had to rely on themselves.
Han Yongzhen’s strength was not enough, so he had to bring the Formation Breaking Bead. As for how to explain it and fool that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, it was up to Han Yongzhen’s own performance.
This was also a test; if he could fool them, he might be able to gain some opportunities from that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
“I’ll remind him,” Lu Tianxiang said with a smile, nodding.
She had already discussed with Han Yongzhen that after going out for experience, his first destination would be Leizhou, to gain opportunities at Dingyuan Manor.
As for how to fool that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, Lu Tianxiang had already taught Han Yongzhen that.
Zhang Wuji’s mother once said: “The prettier the woman, the better liar she is.”
Half a month later.
Han Yongzhen left Yangdao Peak with a touch of regret on his face. Although his talents had risen to First Grade, he ultimately didn’t develop a special constitution. He could only wait for the next opportunity.
His time out for experience wouldn’t be too long, and he would return within a year, at which point he would be able to take part in the next Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism.
Going out for a year’s experience, although he wouldn’t have the abundant cultivation environment of the Han Mansion, he wouldn’t fall behind much in his cultivation progress, as he carried many pills that could enhance his cultivation with him.
Arriving at Chengdao Peak and entering the palace complex in the first area, Han Yongzhen saw his mother, Lu Tianxiang.
“Mother, isn’t father coming?”
Han Yongzhen looked around, but didn’t see Han Li, and a hint of disappointment inevitably flashed in his eyes.
His father doted on him very much. Now that he was going out for experience for the first time, didn’t his father worry about his safety?
“Don’t worry, Yongzhen. Your father is a bit busy right now, but he will come to see you before you leave,” said Lu Tianxiang with a smile.
Han Yongzhen nodded and let out a sigh of relief.
“Have you got everything ready? Don’t leave anything behind. When you’re out, be careful and cautious, don’t trust others lightly…” Lu Tianxiang murmured softly.
Han Yongzhen listened intently. Although this was the umpteenth time his mother had told him this, Han Yongzhen wasn’t the least bit annoyed. All he felt was moved, knowing his mother wished him well.
“Don’t worry, mother. The pills, talismans, weapons, array plates, and so on that father and you prepared for me, I’ve brought them all,” Han Yongzhen said with a smile.
He felt it was really good to be a Second Gen Immortal.
Father Han Li had struggled his entire life to build up such a large family enterprise. Since his birth, he had lived in fortune, never lacking anything. Even when going out for experience, there was no danger.
For instance, he carried several Top Grade and Supreme Grade Heaven Rank Artifacts, including ones for attack, defense, escape, and travel…
The talismans, array plates, and secret treasures he carried ranged in power from the Hollow Void Realm to the True Martial Realm. He also possessed some life-saving items given to him by his father, Han Li, which could even slay beings of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Of course, Han Yongzhen wouldn’t casually use these treasures. He would only use them if truly necessary to save his life; otherwise, he kept them hidden, as using them pointlessly wouldn’t benefit his experience.
Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen kept talking, going over various family matters, and when the time was nearly up, Han Li’s figure appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 530: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 530: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
“Father.”
Han Yongzhen immediately called out, his tone excited and respectful, his father had finally arrived.
“Husband.” Lu Tianxiang said softly, without speaking further, letting the father and son have their chat.
“Yongzhen, this is your first venture out for experience, and there is an assessment task as you are aware,”
Han Li looked at Han Yongzhen with a smile on his face and said unhurriedly.
Han Yongzhen nodded and said, “Father, I understand.”
Not just him, all the Han Mansion descendants who went out for experience had assessment tasks. Rewards and evaluations would be given based on completion, which were to be recorded in the respective archives.
