Han Yongzhen took this seriously. He wanted to do as perfectly as possible, to make his father proud.
His father had too many pampered wives and concubines. His mother, Lu Tianxiang, was just one of them. Although his mother was his father’s first wife and was implicitly referred to as the Han Mansion’s Lady, his father had never officially confirmed it.
Among his father’s pampered wives, there were many whose cultivation, status, and identity were much higher than his mother’s, like the recently married Zimei Zhen, who his mother had hinted was a peerless female saint from the high and lofty Hollow Void Stage.
He himself had over a thousand siblings, many of whom were more notable than he was; it’s just that most had not yet begun to cultivate. Therefore, Han Yongzhen wanted to take this time to shine a little brighter,
So that in the future, his mother, Lu Tianxiang, could gain status through her son.
“Go, and don’t disappoint me.”
“Father, rest assured.”
“Mother, I’m leaving now.”
Han Yongzhen bowed to Han Li and Lu Tianxiang and then left Chengdao Peak without looking back.
After leaving, Han Yongzhen did not return to the dwelling at Dengdao Peak but had already packed his luggage into the Space Ring.
He arrived at the foot of Chengsheng Mountain where two people were waiting for him.
“There’s no need for you to accompany me,” Han Yongzhen said.
These two were Guest Elders and protectors from the Han Mansion with cultivation in the mid to late stages of the Hollow Void Stage, and they were assigned to run errands for Han Yongzhen’s journey this time.
The two exchanged a glance but remained silent.
“Go back.”
Han Yongzhen looked back at Chengsheng Mountain for the last time and stepped out of the Mountain Protection Array.
The two Hollow Void Stage Guest Elders looked at each other, unsure of what to do, and stood still until a voice reached their ears, after which they returned to Chengsheng Mountain with a sense of relief.
After leaving Chengsheng Mountain, Han Yongzhen did not rush to Leizhou directly but planned to travel leisurely along the way.
Atop Chengdao Peak,
Han Li wrapped his arms around Lu Tianxiang and gently stroked her belly, smiling as he said, “This child, let him be.”
“Could there be any dangers?” Lu Tianxiang’s brows furrowed slightly.
Even though she knew Han Yongzhen had many aces up his sleeve, it was his first time venturing out, and being a mother, she still worried.
“Rest easy, Leizhou is not far, and should any trouble arise, I can descend in an instant.”
Han Li was very confident. With his speed, he could traverse most of the Xuan Domain in a single breath, so reaching Leizhou instantly wasn’t a problem at all.
“That’s good then,” Lu Tianxiang said with relief, a relaxed expression appearing on her stunning face.
…..
In the Taichu Realm,
Guanghan Heaven.
This was one of the Thirty-three Heavens, vast and boundless, immeasurably expansive, containing endless worlds within.
Within Guanghan Heaven, there was a power known as Guanghan Immortal Palace, whose fame reverberated throughout the Thirty-three Heavens and was widely celebrated across the entire Taichu Realm.
At this moment, deep within Guanghan Immortal Palace, on an throne made of Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade,
A delicate figure clad in immortal garments, graceful and light, shrouded in Infinite Immortal Light, leaned back.
“Strange, why is my Red Phoenix Star pulsing?”
On the throne, the female immortal furrowed her brows while her eyes shone with immortal light, depicting the birth and demise of great universes. The mere leaking of a wisp of her aura could collapse the Nine Heavens.
“In the future, will I have a dao companion?”
After some divination, the female immortal arrived at a startling conclusion.
What a joke! She was the Guanghan Empress!
She had journeyed alone through Three Thousand Realms, suppressed Eighty Thousand Domains with one hand, unmatched under the heavens, her fame resounding throughout the myriad worlds and realms.
Eon after eon, she grew accustomed to solitude, pursuing the dao, aiming to step into the fourth stage of cultivation.
But now, she had divined such an outcome, and most significantly, the opportunity she had been desperately seeking seemed to be tied to this prospective dao companion.
The Guanghan Empress regained her composure in an instant, smiling faintly as she murmured to herself, “Let’s see how far this future dao companion of mine has come.”
She decided to investigate personally. If he could pass her test, after countless eons of loneliness, she would not mind having a dao companion. But if he could not, even if he offered that glimmer of breakthrough opportunity, she would not settle.
She was confident that even on her own, she would eventually transcend the Immortal Emperor Realm and step into the fourth stage of cultivation.
“My future dao companion is actually in the Yuankun Domain, that guy’s territory.” The Guanghan Empress chuckled lightly, but with no fear.
Others may be afraid to enter that guy’s territory, but she was not!
At worst, they would have a fight. Who was afraid of whom?
She also wanted to gauge the heft of the former Emperor of Heaven, to see who was stronger, provided that guy dared show himself.
That day, a strand of immortal light descended from Guanghan Heaven to the Endless Yuankun Domain, almost unnoticed by anyone.
That day, in the northwestern part of the Lanyu Divine Province in the Yuankun Domain, an Immortal Infant was born.

chapters.title: Chapter 531: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 531: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
At dawn,
where sunlight couldn’t reach, Han Li did.
“Coming again?”
Zi Miao Zhen, who had debated Dao all night, lay sprawled across the bed in a lazy pose, propping up her chin as she spoke.
After the prolonged battle, Zi Miao Zhen no longer had the pure and sacred look of a Heavenly Immortal from the day before; her face now glowed with a ruddy flush, her brows hinted at springtime, and her eyes were as seductive as silk.
Han Li was about to leave, but turned back at her words, only to see Zi Miao Zhen’s slender jade hand resting on her thigh while her other hand brought her delicate, onion-white fingers to her vermilion lips and teeth.
This was no Heavenly Immortal Fairy, but rather a peerless beauty!
Zi Miao Zhen was one of the three great fairies of White Emperor City, her beauty famous throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain. Had any of her admirers seen this, their Dao hearts would likely have shattered.
Luckily, the elder was kind-hearted; he was content with keeping these scenes to himself.
“What a little enchantress.”
Han Li, a man unskilled at refusal, had no choice but to continue exchanging Daoist insights with Zi Miao Zhen.
“Zhen’er, speak as you need,” he said.
As soon as he finished speaking, Han Li walked over, sat on the bed, and prepared for a session of seated waiting ( ). [Fill in the blank]
After they completed their morning routine, Han Li imparted his profound Daoist knowledge to Zi Miao Zhen, leaving her utterly convinced in mind, speech, hand, and leg.
Atop Chengdao Peak, Han Li flipped his hand and brought out an emerald-colored bowl, palm-sized and rather ordinary-looking.
These days, Han Li was busy exchanging affections with Zi Miao Zhen and preparing to marry this peerless holy woman, so he hadn’t yet addressed the matter of the Bihai Bowl, a Top Grade imperial weapon.
“Xi Yue.”
With a soft call from Han Li, Xi Yue’s perfect form appeared beside him, smiling fondly at him.
“Master.”
“You summon the Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit. If it harbors any ill intent, give it a profound lesson,” Han Li said calmly.
“Alright.”
Xi Yue nodded and with a gentle hook of her fair, onion-like fingers towards the Bihai Bowl,
a burst of light involuntarily flew out of the bowl, growing larger and then landing onto the ground.
When the light faded, there appeared a stunningly beautiful woman dressed in a jade-green gown, her figure breathtakingly exquisite, curves elegant, and her long, fair legs adorned with a white leg band.
“Han Li, what do you intend to do?”
The Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit, a seemingly delicate and beautiful woman, asked Han Li weakly.
Although the Bihai Bowl was sealed, she had heard every word of the previous conversation between Han Li and Zi Miao Zhen.
“Of course, I’m going to… you.”
Looking at the woman in the jade-green dress, a spark of interest lit in Han Li’s eyes. He had thought the spirit would be a burly man, and while correcting himself, he said indifferently, “What do I want to do? Don’t you already know?”
“I will not consent,” the jade-dress beauty said with a cold laugh.
The White Emperor was one of the lords of the Yuankun Domain and one of the nine Supreme Beings. Betrayal was not an option for her, sorry, she just couldn’t do it.
Even if Han Li had boundless potential, the White Emperor would crush him before he grew powerful, and the price of betrayal was too steep.
“You won’t consent, eh?”
Han Li raised an eyebrow and said coolly, “Xi Yue, infuse her body with a strand of Immortal light.”
With a flick of Xi Yue’s finger, a strand of Immortal light entered the jade-dress beauty’s body, turning her ethereal form solid, indistinguishable from a real living being.
“You… you… you… what are you going to do?” The jade-dress beauty suddenly panicked, a terrible thought flashing through her mind.
Could Han Li actually lay hands on her?
She was an Artifact Spirit!
Who would get involved with an Artifact Spirit like that? That was just perverted.
But judging by Han Li’s demeanor, it seemed he might actually do as she feared. As Han Li drew closer, her heart pounded fiercely under her breast, full of trepidation.
“Please don’t!” she silently pleaded.
Han Li reached out with his right hand, lifted the jade-dress beauty’s chin, and rather rudely stamped a kiss on her lips.
Feeling her rigid body, Han Li, dissatisfied, pried open her mouth for a give-and-take.
The jade-dress beauty was dumbstruck, her flawless pale face etched with bewilderment.
Who am I?
Where am I?
What am I doing?
As she came to her senses, the jade-dress beauty wanted to resist, to at least bite his tongue as a lesson to Han Li.
But her cheeks were held tight by Han Li; her pretty lips involuntarily parted, her teeth unable to close, completely under Han Li’s control.
Afterward, Han Li wore a satisfied smile, seemingly reminiscing, and said to the fiery-eyed jade-dress beauty, “Cool your temper. If you don’t agree, there’s more excitement to come.”
“You!”
The jade-dress beauty bared her little fangs, clawing at Han Li before finally saying coldly, “Whatever, I will never betray the White Emperor.”
“Oh, didn’t know you were so loyal to the White Emperor,” Han Li clicked his tongue, and without further ado, he embraced the jade-dress beauty and disappeared from Chengdao Peak, returning to his chambers.
The exchange of Daoist methodologies continued with great vigor.
It was like washing away the robe by day, the Yellow River flowing into the sea…
“Shameless! I will never betray the White Emperor.”
“Bastard, you’ve hurt me.”
“Han Li, be gentle.”
“Han Li, why have you stopped moving?”
“….”
As the melodious singing halted, Biyuan couldn’t help but pull over the blanket, covering her exhausted body.
“Han Li, you truly are a shameless lecher. I am an Artifact Spirit, what do you take me for?”
The Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit Biyuan, utterly infuriated, shouted angrily.

chapters.title: Chapter 532: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 532: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
Han Li leisurely packed his clothes, and upon hearing the words, a smile bloomed on his face as he uttered two words.
Instantly, Biyuan’s exquisitely flawless face flushed red with anger, feeling insulted by Han Li. Yet, for some reason, her heart throbbed with a faint excitement. So this was dual cultivation?
As Han Li brazenly scrutinized her body, sculpted as if from the finest white jade, Biyuan angrily shouted, “Get lost!”
“Tsk, you didn’t say that when we were discussing the Dao earlier. You even asked me to press ‘K’, and said something about not wanting ‘T’…” Han Li teased.
Although he had tasted the flavors of many Artifact Spirits, such as Shi Qi, Yin Ling, Yue Ji, JianJi, and the other four women, engaging in Dao conversation with Biyuan gave Han Li a unique delight.
As expected of the Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit, truly as boundless as the ocean, Han Li could only describe it in one word: too ‘run’!
Looking at a somewhat furiously blushing Biyuan, Han Li asked indifferently, “Have you made up your mind?”
“I would never betray the White Emperor,” Biyuan muttered softly.
Soon after, Biyuan changed her tune, crying out, “White Emperor, come quickly, otherwise Han Li won’t proceed…”
An hour later, a fresh cream puff was out of the oven.
Han Li and Biyuan appeared atop Chengdao Peak, and Han Li asked again, “Biyuan, how about another enhanced match?”
Biyuan’s pretty face instantly turned pale, and she shook her head frantically, waving her hands in refusal.
The previous Dao discussion had left her tormented by Han Li; her main body sealed, her Artifact Spirit’s powers bound, she stood no chance against Han Li.
“Are you that loyal to the White Emperor?”
Looking at the silent Biyuan, Han Li raised an eyebrow. Did the White Emperor possess such charismatic appeal?
Biyuan shook her head, hesitant to voice her thoughts.
“If you have something to say, say it,” Han Li said lightly.
After some hesitation, Biyuan stammered, “That… after you… did that to me… you just know how to be forceful… demanding my submission, right?”
“Can’t you… like with… Zimei Zhen, offer me some… benefits?”
Biyuan’s face turned crimson, unconsciously lowering her head, her voice becoming quieter and quieter.
She wasn’t really that loyal to the White Emperor; she just wanted to receive some benefits from Han Li. But all Han Li did was bully her.
Biyuan was angry. Why was he so nice to Zimei Zhen?
Even though she was an Artifact Spirit, she was in no way inferior to Zimei Zhen. She had served him so well earlier—was he only thinking about freeloading off her?
After all, her main body was a Top-Grade Imperial Weapon, much more useful than Zimei Zhen. Yet he just nagged and nagged at her, without offering any substantial benefits.
Han Li, with his vast resources, owned many Supreme-Grade Imperial Weapons and even Immortal Weapons, his foundations deep and unfathomable.
What would giving her some benefits cost him?
A hint of surprise flickered across Han Li’s face.
Slick move, Biyuan, with all that mumbling. Why couldn’t you be so eloquent during our Dao discussion?
Han Li chuckled, having a moment of enlightenment. He realized he had misunderstood Biyuan, but he didn’t mind—this was his first time forcefully discussing the Dao with an Artifact Spirit.
After some thought, Han Li said, “Within a hundred years, I’ll help you ascend to a Supreme-Grade Imperial Weapon. How about that?”
Biyuan suddenly lifted her head, her heart pounding, barely containing her excitement as she asked, “I want an added bonus!”
Pausing, Biyuan quickly added, “Then I could also betray some secrets of the White Emperor and White Emperor City to you, things Zimei Zhen doesn’t know.”
Biyuan didn’t hesitate to sell out the White Emperor.
She had repeatedly claimed she wouldn’t betray the White Emperor, but it was only because the price hadn’t been right. After all, Han Li had shown her such little respect and appreciation for her status.
“Within a thousand years, I’ll help you advance to a Heavenly Immortal Weapon,” Han Li declared, painting a grand future.
From a Top-Grade Imperial Weapon to a Heavenly Immortal Weapon in a thousand years was inconceivable for Biyuan, but for Han Li, it was trivial.
He was actually overstating—it was entirely possible for him to help Biyuan ascend to an Immortal Weapon status within a hundred years.
A Heavenly Immortal Weapon!
Biyuan’s breath quickened, and she nodded eagerly like a chicken pecking at grains, thrilled as she agreed, “Deal!”
Whether Han Li could fulfill his promise or not, Biyuan was sold on the idea. Having overindulged on this “big pancake” previously, she now felt stuffed. She had eaten her fill.
Yet she couldn’t understand how she, an Artifact Spirit, could even consume such things.
After swearing on the Oath Stone, Biyuan allowed Han Li to channel his mana into the core area of the Bihai Bowl, subjecting herself to his refinement and acknowledging him as the new master of the Top-Grade Imperial Weapon.
Having successfully dealt with Biyuan, the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, Han Li breathed a sigh of relief as the amount of trouble ahead seemed to diminish significantly.
In the following ten days, Han Li enjoyed sightseeing with Zimei Zhen, experiencing the grandeur of overlooking all the smaller peaks and the secrets hidden within the deep valleys.
It wasn’t until Zimei Zhen was pregnant with a child that Han Li reluctantly let go of this peerless sacred woman.
During these days, he had gained deeper insights into the White Emperor, White Emperor City, and the Endless Yuankun Domain. Zimei Zhen had some reservations, but Biyuan had detailed everything to Han Li, eventually copying the related memories for him.
Focus on honesty.
From Zimei Zhen, Han Li also learned her purpose for coming to Qianyuan Divine Province and discovered that the White Emperor was coveting his predestined wife, deciding to give the White Emperor a small lesson in the future.
He was also aware that Zimei Zhen intended to snip opportunities from the peerless Emperor Formation binding the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor beneath Leizhou.
Han Li actually agreed with this plan, but suggested she wait a while before attempting it.
Later, Han Li found Lu Tianxiang and accompanied her for a walk and to admire the scenery in Chengsheng Mountain, casually discussing some matters.

chapters.title: Chapter 533: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 533: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
Ever since Lu Tianxiang gave birth to her fragrant body, she became pregnant again, and now several months have passed—this is the joint effort of Han Li and Lu Tianxiang.
Under such conditions, Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang is naturally not in a good state to discuss the Dao. But Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang is not limited to a single path. Guess what the delicate and stunningly beautiful red lips of Lu Tianxiang are used for?
When Lu Tianxiang swallowed a large amount of essence, she couldn’t help but glare at Han Li. Her eyes were seductive like silk, oozing charm and sensuality, presenting a scene of allure that gave Han Li an urge to sanction her on the spot.
Suppressing the flame in his heart, Han Li decided that afterward, he would have a proper discussion of the Dao with Xue Yueqing, that fox spirit. He asked with a serious tone, “Yongzhen is about to go out for his trials, right?”
Lu Tianxiang nodded slightly in response.
Han Yongzhen was her eldest son. Not yet twenty, his cultivation had reached the Initial Stage of the Void Realm; he had practiced powerful cultivation techniques and mastered several high-level martial arts, his combat ability far surpassing ordinary people.
Han Yongzhen was originally of Third Grade talent, but now he had advanced to Second Grade. In half a month, it would be Han Yongzhen’s turn for his second Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism, by which time he would ascend to First Grade talent.
In Lu Tianxiang’s plan, Han Yongzhen was to go out for trials after reaching the Hollow Void Stage. It wasn’t good for him to stay in Han Mansion all the time—it was better to go out and gain some experience, and perhaps he could even find some fortuitous encounters of his own.
But because the Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism was approaching, Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen, after discussing, agreed to postpone his departure for trials by half a month.
Receiving the Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism, Han Yongzhen’s talent would not only increase to First Grade, but there was also a possibility of developing a special physique.
As the once-first talent of the Han Mansion, Han Yongzhen was the center of attention. Han Li, too, had poured much effort into him and had guided and resolved his doubts on numerous occasions.
There were the Enlightenment Stone left by Han Li on Enlightenment Peak and the stele at the foot of the mountain. Disciples of Han Mansion often contemplated these for enhancement of their understanding, and the Life-Prolonging Furnace could also elevate their perception.
When Han Yongzhen broke through to the Hollow Void Stage, he sensed a top-tier level of martial arts and conceived an embryonic form of its profound essence.
Many elder brothers and sisters in Han Mansion, older and with higher cultivation than him, were no match for Han Yongzhen.
Han Yongzhen’s achievements in the Battle Tower were truly remarkable; Han Li had been keeping an eye on his talented son, lavishing care and attention on him.
“Remember to bring the Formation Breaking Bead with you,” Han Li reminded him.
The surroundings of the underground world of Leizhou were protected by a Third Grade True Martial Realm formation; it seemed that the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor couldn’t lead people in—entry had to be on their own.
Since Han Yongzhen’s strength wasn’t enough, he would need to bring the Formation Breaking Bead with him. As for how to explain and deceive that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, that was for Han Yongzhen to perform himself.
This too was a test—if he could deceive successfully, he might be able to gain some opportunities from that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
“I will remind him,” said Lu Tianxiang with a smile and a nod.
She had already spoken with Han Yongzhen. Once he went out for his trials, his first destination would be Leizhou, to seek opportunities at Dingyuan Manor.
As for how to deceive that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, Lu Tianxiang had already taught Han Yongzhen all she knew.
Zhang Wuji’s mother once said, “The prettier the woman, the more deceitful she is.”
Half a month later.
Han Yongzhen left Yangdao Peak with a trace of regret on his face. Although his talent had been promoted to First Grade, he ultimately did not develop a special physique, leaving that chance for next time.
His trial wouldn’t last long; he would return within a year, and then he could receive the next Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism.
A year of trial outside—though not as comfortable as the cultivation environment in Han Mansion—wouldn’t delay his progress much, as he carried with him many elixirs that could enhance cultivation.
Arriving at Chengdao Peak and entering the palace complex of the first area, Han Yongzhen met his mother, Lu Tianxiang.
“Mother, isn’t father coming?”
Han Yongzhen looked around but did not see Han Li, an inevitable disappointment flashing in his eyes.
His father doted on him, and now that he was going out for trials for the first time, wasn’t his father worried about his safety?
“Yongzhen, don’t worry, your father is a bit busy now but he will come to see you before you leave,” Lu Tianxiang said with a smile.
Han Yongzhen nodded and breathed a sigh of relief.
“Did you bring everything? Make sure nothing is missed. When you are on your trials outside, be very careful and cautious, don’t trust others lightly…” Lu Tianxiang murmured softly.
Han Yongzhen listened attentively. Although his mother had told him countless times, he wasn’t the least bit annoyed; what he felt was only emotion, as all his mother did was for his own good.
“Don’t worry, mother. The elixirs, talismans, weapons, array plates, and so on that father and you have prepared for me, I’ve brought them all,” Han Yongzhen said with a smile.
He felt great to be a Second Gen Immortal.
His father, Han Li, had fought throughout his life to build such a massive family fortune. Born into it, he had never wanted for anything, and there seemed to be no danger even when going out for trials.
For instance, he carried several Top Grade and Supreme Grade Heaven Rank Artifacts on his person, including those for attack, defense, escape, and travel…
The power of the talismans, array plates, and secret treasures ranged from the Hollow Void Stage to the True Martial Realm, and he had some life-saving items from his father, Han Li, capable of slaying even those in the Divine Yuan Realm.
Of course, Han Yongzhen would not use these treasures recklessly. He would only use them when absolutely necessary to save his life. Otherwise, he would treasure them, as overuse would diminish the effectiveness of his trials.
Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen continued to communicate, sharing family and mundane matters until the time was nearly up, and the figure of Han Li arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 534: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 534: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
“Father.”
Han Yongzhen immediately called out, his voice filled with excitement and respect, for his father had finally arrived.
“Husband,” Lu Tianxiang whispered softly, not saying more, letting father and son talk.
“Yongzhen, this is your first time going out to gain experience, and there is also an assessment task, which I believe you are well aware of,”
Han Li looked at Han Yongzhen with a smile on his face and said unhurriedly.
Han Yongzhen nodded, “Father, I understand.”
Not just him, but all members of the Han Mansion venturing out to gain experience had assessment tasks. They were to be rewarded and evaluated based on completion, and this was to be recorded in their corresponding files.
Han Yongzhen didn’t dare take this lightly; he wanted to do as well as possible, to make his father proud.
His father had too many pampered wives and concubines, with his mother, Lu Tianxiang, being just one of many, though she was his father’s first wife and was implicitly referred to as the Lady of Han Mansion, but his father had never officially said so.
Among his father’s pampered wives, there were many with cultivation levels, statuses, and identities far exceeding that of his mother, like the recently wedded Zimiao Zhen. His mother had revealed some secrets to him; this lady was a peerless Saint, exalted and supreme within the Saint Abyss Realm.
He himself had over a thousand brothers and sisters, many of whom were more outstanding than he was, though most hadn’t started cultivating yet, so Han Yongzhen hoped to use this period to make a particularly good impression.
Only then could he uplift his mother, Lu Tianxiang, through his own achievements.
“Go then, and do not disappoint me.”
“Father, rest assured.”
“Mother, I shall take my leave now.”
Han Yongzhen bowed to Han Li and Lu Tianxiang, then turned and left Chengdao Peak without looking back.
After leaving, Han Yongzhen did not return to Dengdao Peak where he lived; he had already packed his belongings into his Space Ring.
He made his way to the foot of Chengsheng Mountain, where two people were waiting for him.
“There’s no need for you to accompany me,” Han Yongzhen said.
The two individuals were Guest Elders and protectors of Han Mansion, their cultivation at the Hollow Void Stage, late phase. They were assigned to run errands for Han Yongzhen during his trial.
The two exchanged fleeting glances, remaining silent.
“You may go back.”
Han Yongzhen cast one last glance at Chengsheng Mountain and stepped out beyond the Mountain Protection Array.
The two Hollow Void Stage Guest Elders looked at each other in bewilderment, unsure of what to do, until a voice reached their ears, allowing them to return to Chengsheng Mountain, relieved.
After leaving Chengsheng Mountain, Han Yongzhen didn’t head directly to Leizhou. Instead, he planned to travel there by way of a leisurely journey.
Atop Chengdao Peak,
Han Li, embracing Lu Tianxiang, gently stroked her belly and smiled, “Let the child be.”
“Could there be any mishap?” Lu Tianxiang furrowed her brows slightly.
Although she knew Han Yongzhen had many trump cards, it was still his first time venturing out, and as a mother, she couldn’t help but worry.
“Rest easy,” Han Li assured, “Leizhou isn’t far away. If there’s any trouble, I can be there in an instant.”
Han Li was very confident about this; with his speed, he could traverse a great part of the Xuan Domain in a single breath, so getting to Leizhou instantly was no issue at all.
“That’s a relief,” Lu Tianxiang sighed lightly, a relaxed expression appearing on her lovely face.
…..
Tai Chu Realm,
Guanghan Heaven.
This was one of the Thirty-three Heavens; vast and boundless, expansive and infinite with endless worlds within.
Within Guanghan Heaven, there was a power known as Guanghan Immortal Palace, renowned across the Thirty-three Heavens, with a reputation that spread far throughout the entire Tai Chu Realm.
Currently, in the depths of Guanghan Immortal Palace, a throne, crafted from Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade, was occupied.
Reclining there was a delicate figure in immortal garb, graceful and lithe, her entire being shrouded in Infinite Immortal Light.
“Odd, why is my Red Luan star throbbing?”
On the throne, the brow of this female Immortal furrowed slightly as her eyes, filled with the shimmer of immortal light, reflected the birth and death of vast universes. An inadvertent release of her breath could bring down the Nine Heavens.
“Could I have a destined partner in the future?”
After divining, the female Immortal arrived at a startling conclusion.
What a joke! She was the Guanghan Empress!
Alone, she had traversed the Three Thousand Realms, and with a single hand, suppressed the Eighty Thousand Domains; heavens above, earth below, she had no rival, her fame echoing through the myriad realms.
For endless epochs, she had grown accustomed to solitude, ever in pursuit of the Dao, aiming to step into the fourth stage of cultivation.
Yet now, she divined an outcome like this, and most crucially, the opportunity she’d ardently sought seemed to lie with this destined partner.
The Guanghan Empress regained her composure in an instant and smiled faintly, murmuring to herself, “Let’s see how far along my future partner has come.”
She decided to personally investigate. If he could pass her test, she, who had been solitary for eons, wouldn’t mind an additional partner. If he couldn’t, even if it meant the chance for a breakthrough, she wouldn’t settle for less.
She believed that even on her own, she was bound to transcend the Immortal Emperor Realm and enter the fourth stage of cultivation in the future.
“My future partner is actually in the Yuankun Domain, which belongs to that person’s territory,” the Guanghan Empress chuckled lightly, yet without a hint of fear.
Others might dread entering that person’s domain, but she dared!
If it came to it, they would fight. Who would be afraid? She too wished to gauge the weight of the former Emperor of Heaven, to see who was stronger, provided that person dared to reveal themselves.
On that day, a strand of immortal light descended from Guanghan Heaven to the Endless Yuankun Domain, virtually unnoticed by all.
On that day, in Lanyu Divine Province within the northwest of the Yuankun Domain, an Immortal Infant was born.

chapters.title: Chapter 535: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 535: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
Early in the morning,
where the sunlight could not reach, Han Li could.
“Han Li, are you coming again?”
Having debated the Dao all night, Zimiao Zhen’s enchanting body sprawled across the bed. She lazily lay there, propping up her chin.
After the prolonged battle, Zimiao Zhen no longer possessed the pure and holy appearance of a Heavenly Immortal from the day before. Her face glowed with a rosy flush, her brows hinted at spring, and her eyes were as seductive as silk.
Han Li was about to leave but, hearing this, turned around and saw Zimiao Zhen place one slender jade hand on her thigh, while she drew another tender white fingertip between her rosy lips and teeth.
This was no Fairy. She was an unparalleled enchantress!
Zimiao Zhen was one of the three great Fairies of White Emperor City, her beauty renowned throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain. If her suitors were to see her like this, surely all of their Dao hearts would shatter.
Fortunately, the old ancestor had a kind heart, content to keep these visions to himself.
“Truly a little she-devil.”
Han Li, not knowing how to refuse, simply had to continue exchanging the knowledge of the Dao with Zimiao Zhen.
“Zhen’er, just as you need, take as you wish,” he said.
As his voice fell, Han Li walked over, sat on the bed, and prepared for a session of seated cultivation (). [Fill in the blank]
Once the morning’s practices were complete, Han Li imparted to Zimiao Zhen the vast and profound knowledge of the Dao, leaving her entirely convinced and submissive in mind and body.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li flipped his palm and produced a jade-green bowl the size of a palm, quite ordinary looking.
In these days, Han Li had been busy cultivating a relationship with Zimiao Zhen and preparing to marry this peerless saintess, so he hadn’t yet managed the Top Grade imperial weapon, the Bihai Bowl.
“Xi Yue.”
With a soft call from Han Li, Xi Yue’s perfect figure appeared by his side, a smile gracing her face as she gazed at him.
“Master.”
“Summon the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl. If it harbors any ill intentions, teach it a profound lesson,” Han Li said indifferently.
“Alright.”
Xi Yue nodded, her fair, tender fingers lightly beckoning towards the Bihai Bowl.
A sphere of light involuntarily flew out from the Bihai Bowl, growing larger, and then landed on the ground.
When the light dissipated, it revealed a stunningly beautiful woman dressed in an emerald-green robe. Her beauty was ravishing, and her body elegantly curvaceous, with long, fair legs; a white anklet adorned her left leg.
“Han Li, what do you want to do?”
The Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, an apparently fragile and ravishing beauty, asked Han Li weakly.
Although the Bihai Bowl was sealed, she had heard every word of Han Li’s previous conversation with Zimiao Zhen loud and clear.
“Of course, it’s to play an interesting game for two,” he replied.
Gazing at the beauty in the green robe before him, Han Li’s eyes brightened. He had assumed it would be a man, and while holding back a silent prayer, he said indifferently, “What do you think I want to do, given that you heard everything?”
“I will not agree,” the beauty in the green robe said with a sneer.
The Lord of Yuankun Domain was one of the Nine Great Supreme Beings, and to betray the Lord was something she believed she was incapable of.
Even if Han Li had immense potential, he would be crushed by the Lord of Yuankun Domain long before coming into his full power. The cost of betrayal was too high.
“You won’t agree, huh?”
Han Li’s eyebrows raised slightly as he commanded, “Xi Yue, infuse a strand of Immortal light into her body.”
With a flick of Xi Yue’s finger, a thread of Immortal light entered the body of the green-robed beauty, solidifying her form from spectral to flesh, indistinguishable from a living being.
“You…you…you… what are you going to do?” The green-robed beauty became panicked, a terrible notion flashing through her mind.
Could Han Li be intending to lay hands on her?
She was an Artifact Spirit, after all!
To engage in that kind of activity with an Artifact Spirit was utterly perverse.
Yet as she watched Han Li approach, the green-robed beauty’s heart raced and pounded uncontrollably at the thought.
“Please not that!” she kept silently imploring.
Han Li reached out his right hand, lifted the chin of the green-robed beauty, and unceremoniously planted a seal.
Feeling the stiff body of the green-robed beauty, Han Li was not satisfied. He pried open her clenched teeth and claimed what he wished.
The green-robed beauty was completely stupefied, her flawless white face etched with confusion.
Who am I?
Where am I?
What am I doing?
After her initial daze, the green-robed beauty wanted to resist. At the very least, she tried to bite Han Li’s tongue as a lesson to him.
But Han Li held her cheeks, forcing her lips open involuntarily; her teeth could not meet, and she was completely at the mercy of his control.
After the deed, Han Li’s face was all smiles, seeming to savor the moment, then spoke to the fiery-eyed green-robed beauty, “Calm down. If you don’t agree, there’s more excitement to come.”
“You!”
The green-robed beauty bared her little tiger teeth, waving her claws at Han Li, and finally said coldly, “Do whatever you want, I will never betray the White Emperor.”
“Oh, I didn’t expect you to be so loyal to the White Emperor,” Han Li clicked his tongue twice, not bothering with further words. He embraced the green-robed beauty and disappeared from Chengdao Peak, returning to his own bedroom.
The vigorous exchange of Dao began anew.
One could say alike the white robes that drape in daylight, akin to the Yellow River flowing into the sea…
“Shameful! I will never betray the White Emperor.”
“Scoundrel, can you be gentler?”
“Han Li, hurry up…”
“Han Li, why have you stopped?”
“….”
When the songs of great passion ceased, Biyuan couldn’t help but pull over the blanket, covering her exhausted body.
“Han Li, you truly are a shameless lecher. I am an Artifact Spirit, what do you take me for?”

chapters.title: Chapter 536: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 536: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
The Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit Biyuan was fuming with anger, huffing as she shouted.
Han Li leisurely tidied up his clothes, a smile appearing on his face as he heard her, and spat out two words.
Biyuan’s delicate and flawless face instantly flushed red, she felt insulted by Han Li, yet for some reason, there was a hint of excitement in her heart. So this is what dual cultivation is like?
As Han Li brazenly sized up her body, sculpted as if from white jade, Biyuan, angry and ashamed, shouted, “Get lost!”
“Tsk, that’s not what you were saying during our scholarly discussion, you even let me impart my teachings and essence as much as I wanted…” Han Li teased.
Although he had tasted the flavor of quite a few Artifact Spirits like Shi Qi, Yin Ling, Yue Ji, JianJi, and the other four women, Han Li still found his discussion with Biyuan to be a different taste altogether.
Worthy of being the Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit, truly as boundless as the ocean, Han Li could only describe it with one word: too lewd!
Looking at Biyuan, with a mix of shame and anger on her face, Han Li said indifferently, “Have you made up your mind?”
“I would never betray White Emperor.” Biyuan murmured softly.
Soon, Biyuan changed her tune, crying out, “White Emperor, come quickly, otherwise Han Li will stop…”
An hour later, a fresh cream puff came out of the oven.
Han Li and Biyuan appeared atop Chengdao Peak, where Han Li asked again, “Biyuan, how about another intensified match?”
Biyuan’s pretty face turned deathly pale, she waved her hands frantically and shook her head vigorously.
During the previous discussion, she was tormented by Han Li. Her actual body was sealed, even her Artifact Spirit form had its strength sealed, nowhere near a match for Han Li.
“Are you truly so devoted to White Emperor?”
Seeing Biyuan remain silent, Han Li raised an eyebrow. Was that White Emperor really so charismatic?
Biyuan shook her head, wanting to speak but stopping herself.
“Speak whatever’s on your mind,” Han Li said flatly.
After hesitating, Biyuan began haltingly, “That… you’ve… taken me… that way, can you… not just forcefully… demand my submission?”
“Can’t you… like with… Zimei Zhen, give me some… benefits?”
Biyuan’s face grew redder, her head involuntarily lowered, and her voice became quieter and quieter.
She wasn’t actually that loyal to White Emperor, she just wanted to get some benefits from Han Li, but all he did was dominate her.
Biyuan was upset. Why was he so nice to Zimei Zhen?
Even though she was an Artifact Spirit, she was not inferior to Zimei Zhen at all. She had served him so well previously, and all he wanted was to freeload?
Her actual body was, after all, a Top Grade Emperor Weapon, far more useful than Zimei Zhen’s services. Yet, all he did was nag at her, never offering any tangible benefits.
Han Li, with his vast arsenal of Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons and even Immortal Artifacts, had unfathomable depth.
What was wrong with giving her some benefits?
A look of surprise flashed across Han Li’s face.
Good for you, Biyuan, knowing how to coyly express yourself. Why couldn’t you be so eloquent during our discussion earlier?
Han Li smiled; he had an epiphany and knew he had misunderstood Biyuan. But this was quite nice too; it was his first time being so forceful in a discussion with an Artifact Spirit.
After thinking it over, Han Li said, “How about I help you ascend to Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon within a hundred years?”
Biyuan’s head shot up, her heart pounding, and she fought back her excitement, asking, “I need a better deal!”
After a moment, Biyuan quickly added, “That way, I can also sell you some information about White Emperor and White Emperor City that even Zimei Zhen doesn’t know.”
Biyuan didn’t hesitate to betray White Emperor.
She had insisted she wouldn’t betray White Emperor earlier, only because the price wasn’t high enough. Han Li was to blame for underestimating her, showing no respect for her status.
“I’ll help you become a Heavenly Immortal Weapon within a thousand years,” Han Li offered grandly.
A thousand years to ascend from a Top Grade Emperor Weapon to a Heavenly Immortal Weapon seemed inconceivable to Biyuan, but for Han Li, it wasn’t much at all.
He was actually overestimating; he could have said that he would help Biyuan become an Immortal Weapon within a hundred years, and it would have been entirely within the realm of possibility for him.
Heavenly Immortal Weapon!
Biyuan’s breathing quickened, and like a pecking chick, she nodded repeatedly and said excitedly, “Deal!”
It didn’t matter whether Han Li could do it or not; she had taken that huge promise, and it had even left her feeling stuffed, after she had already eaten quite a bit before.
She didn’t understand how she, an Artifact Spirit, could even digest these things.
After swearing on the Oath Stone, Biyuan allowed Han Li to transfer his mana into the core area of the Bihai Bowl, accepting his refinement and allowing Han Li to become the new master of the Top Grade Emperor Weapon, the Bihai Bowl.
Having successfully dealt with the Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit Biyuan, Han Li also breathed a sigh of relief, as potential troubles were significantly reduced.
In the following ten days, Han Li and Zimei Zhen went on a tour of the mountains and waters, experiencing the grandeur of looking down at all the mountains and delving into the deepest valleys for secrets.
It wasn’t until Zimei Zhen became pregnant that Han Li reluctantly let go of this exceptional female saint.
During these days, he gained a deeper understanding of White Emperor, White Emperor City, and the Endless Yuankun Domain. Zimei Zhen had some reservations, but Biyuan told Han Li everything in great detail, finally copying the relevant memories to give to him.
She played the card of honesty.
From Zimei Zhen, Han Li also learned her purpose for coming to Qianyuan Divine Province and that White Emperor was coveting the bride that was intended for him, deciding to give White Emperor a small lesson in the future.
He also learned that Zimei Zhen was planning to seize an opportunity from a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm who was suppressed under Leizhou, within the Emperor Formation.
Han Li agreed with this plan, but suggested she wait a bit longer before trying.

chapters.title: Chapter 537: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 537: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
Afterward, Han Li found Lu Tianxiang and accompanied her for a walk to enjoy the scenery at Chengsheng Mountain, while casually discussing some matters.
Ever since Lu Tianxiang developed her “Heavenly Fragrance” physique, she became pregnant and was already several months along; this was a joint endeavor by both Han Li and Lu Tianxiang.
Given her current condition, it naturally wasn’t appropriate for Sect Hierarch Tianxiang to discuss the Dao, but Sect Hierarch Tianxiang wasn’t just proficient in one Dao. Take a guess, what could Lu Tianxiang’s delicate and stunning red lips be used for?
When Lu Tianxiang swallowed a large amount of essence, she couldn’t help but give Han Li a white-eyed glance. At this moment, her eyes were charming like silk, brimming with allure, and exuding a multitude of amorous feelings, which gave Han Li the impulse to take her then and there.
Suppressing the flame in his heart, Han Li decided he would later seek out Xue Yueqing, that vixen, to properly discuss the Dao and seriously said, “It’s almost time for Yongzhen to go on his training adventure, right?”
Lu Tianxiang nodded slightly upon hearing this.
Han Yongzhen was her eldest son, still under twenty years old, yet his cultivation had already reached the Initial Stage of the Void Realm, possessing powerful cultivation techniques and mastering several high-level martial skills, far exceeding the combat ability of an ordinary person.
Han Yongzhen was originally of Third Grade talent, but he had now advanced to Second Grade, and in half a month’s time, it would be his turn for the second Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism, which would elevate him to First Grade talent.
As per Lu Tianxiang’s plan, Han Yongzhen would go out for experience after reaching the Hollow Void Stage; it wasn’t good for him to always stay in Han Mansion. Going out to broaden his horizons might even bring him some opportunities that belong uniquely to Han Yongzhen.
However, as the baptism in the Life-Prolonging Furnace was drawing near, Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen agreed to postpone his adventure outside for half a month.
Through the baptism of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, not only would Han Yongzhen’s talent be elevated to First Grade, but he might also develop a special constitution.
As once the premier prodigy of Han Mansion, Han Yongzhen received considerable attention, and Han Li had poured much effort into him, enlightening and resolving his doubts on many an occasion.
With the Enlightenment Stone left by Han Li at Enlightenment Peak and the stone stele at the mountain’s foot, the disciples of Han Mansion would have improved comprehension if they regularly studied them, and the Life-Prolonging Furnace could also enhance comprehension.
When Han Yongzhen made his breakthrough to the Hollow Void Stage, he sensed a top-tier level of martial arts and grasped the embryonic form of this elite martial understanding.
Many of his brothers and sisters in Han Mansion, older and with higher cultivation levels than him, were no match for Han Yongzhen.
Han Yongzhen’s achievements in the combat tower were quite outstanding; Han Li had always kept a close eye on his capable son, showing great care and concern.
“Remember to take the Formation Breaking Bead with you,” Han Li reminded.
On the periphery of Leizhou’s underground world lies a Third Grade True Martial Realm grand array, and it seems that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor cannot lead people inside; to enter, one must rely on oneself.
Han Yongzhen’s abilities aren’t quite enough, so he must take the Formation Breaking Bead with him. As for how to explain it and bluff the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, that’s up to Han Yongzhen to handle.
This is also a test; if he can convincingly bluff, he might be able to glean some opportunities from the hands of the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
“I will remind him,” said Lu Tianxiang with a smile, nodding her head.
She had already discussed with Han Yongzhen that after going out for experience, his first destination would be Leizhou, to seek opportunities at Dingyuan Manor.
As for how to bluff the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, Lu Tianxiang had already taught Han Yongzhen the tricks.
The mother of Zhang Wuji once said: “The prettier the woman, the more deceptive they are.”
Half a month later.
Han Yongzhen left Yangdao Peak with a trace of regret on his face; although his talent had been elevated to First Grade, he ultimately did not develop a special constitution and could only wait for the next opportunity.
His journey for outside experience wouldn’t be too lengthy; he would return within a year, by which time he could undergo the next baptism by the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
A year of adventure, although not as conducive for cultivation as the environment in Han Mansion, wouldn’t delay his progress much, as he carried with him many pills that would boost his cultivation level.
Arriving at Chengdao Peak, entering the palace complex of the first area, Han Yongzhen met his mother, Lu Tianxiang.
“Mother, isn’t father coming?”
Han Yongzhen looked around but did not see Han Li, a hint of disappointment inevitably flashing in his eyes.
His father doted on him dearly. Now that he was setting out on his first training adventure, wasn’t his father worried about his safety?
“Don’t worry, Yongzhen, your father has some matters to attend to right now, but he will come to see you before you leave,” Lu Tianxiang said with a smile.
Han Yongzhen nodded and relaxed.
“Did you pack everything? Make sure nothing is missing. Be careful and cautious when you’re outside, don’t trust others too easily…” Lu Tianxiang gently reminded.
Han Yongzhen listened attentively, and although this was the umpteenth time his mother had told him, he didn’t feel the slightest bit annoyed. All he felt was moved; his mother was doing all this for his own good.
“Don’t worry, mother, I have brought all the pills, talismans, weapons, array plates, and so on that father and you have prepared for me,” Han Yongzhen said with a smile.
He thought being a Second Gen Immortal is truly great.
His father, Han Li, had struggled all his life to create their vast wealth. Since his birth, he had been enjoying the fruits of his father’s labor; he had never lacked for anything, and even going out on training adventures entailed no real danger.
For instance, he carried several Top Grade and Supreme Grade Heaven Rank Artifacts, suitable for attacking, defending, escaping, and traveling quickly…
The might of those talismans, array plates, and secret treasures ranged from Hollow Void Stage to True Martial Realm, and he also had some life-saving items given to him by his father, Han Li, capable of slaying even Divine Yuan Realm opponents.
Of course, Han Yongzhen wouldn’t use these treasures recklessly, only utilizing them when absolutely necessary to save his life; otherwise, he kept them treasured away so as not to diminish the challenge of his training.

chapters.title: Chapter 538: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 538: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen kept exchanging news, discussing some family matters. When the time was almost right, the figure of Han Li descended upon them.
“Father.”
Han Yongzhen immediately called out, his tone excited and respectful; father had finally arrived.
“My Lord.” Lu Tianxiang spoke softly, then fell silent, letting father and son talk.
“Yongzhen, your first journey out for experience also involves an assessment task, which I’m sure you are aware of.”
Looking at Han Yongzhen, Han Li had a smile on his face as he spoke unhurriedly.
Han Yongzhen nodded and said, “Father, I understand.”
Not just him, all the Han Mansion’s disciples who left for experience had assessment tasks. They would be given rewards and evaluations based on their performance, which was to be recorded in their respective files.
Han Yongzhen was serious about this; he wanted to be as perfect as possible and make his father proud.
His father had many beloved wives and concubines, with Lu Tianxiang being only one of them. Although his mother was father’s first wife and was implied to be the Lady of Han Mansion, father had never made it official.
Among father’s wives, there were many who had cultivation levels, status, and identities far above that of his mother. For example, the recently wed Zi Miao Zhen, as his mother had hinted at some secrets, was an unparalleled female Saint from the lofty echelons of the Saintly Abyss Realm.
He himself had over a thousand siblings, many of whom were more outstanding than him, but most had not begun their cultivation. Therefore, Han Yongzhen hoped to use this opportunity to stand out.
In the future, it could elevate his mother Lu Tianxiang’s status through her child’s achievements.
“Go forth, and do not disappoint me.”
“Rest assured, Father.”
“Mother, I must leave now.”
Han Yongzhen bowed to Han Li and Lu Tianxiang, then left Chengdao Peak without looking back.
After departing, Han Yongzhen did not return to his residence on Dengdao Peak; he had already packed his luggage into his Space Ring.
Upon reaching the foot of Chengsheng Mountain, two individuals were waiting for him.
“You two don’t need to accompany me,” said Han Yongzhen.
Both people were Guest Elders and protectors from Han Mansion, with cultivation levels in the later stages of the Hollow Void Stage. For this journey of Han Yongzhen’s, they were assigned as his attendants.
The two exchanged a look, neither speaking.
“Go back.”
Han Yongzhen turned to glance at Chengsheng Mountain one last time, then stepped out of the Mountain Protection Array.
The two Guest Elders from the Hollow Void Stage looked at each other, uncertain of what to do, frozen in place until a voice reached their ears, and they retuned to Chengsheng Mountain with a sense of relief.
Han Yongzhen did not immediately head for Leizhou after leaving Chengsheng Mountain; he planned to make his way there by traveling through different places.
Atop Chengdao Peak,
Han Li embraced Lu Tianxiang, gently caressing her belly, and smiled as he said, “Let him be, then.”
“Will there be any accidents?” Lu Tianxiang furrowed her brows slightly.
Although she knew Han Yongzhen had many trump cards, it was his first time going out for experience, and as a mother, she was still somewhat concerned.
“You can rest assured. Leizhou is not far; if any mishap occurs, I can arrive in an instant.”
Han Li was very confident in this regard. With his speed, he could cross most of the Xuan Domain in a single breath, so instantly arriving at Leizhou would present no problem at all.
“Then that’s good,” said Lu Tianxiang, her beautiful face relaxing with relief upon hearing this.
…..
In the Taichu Realm,
Guanghan Heaven.
This was one of the Thirty-three Heavens, vast and boundless, immeasurably spacious, with endless worlds within.
Within Guanghan Heaven, there was a power known as Guanghan Immortal Palace, revered throughout the Thirty-three Heavens, its fame wide-spread across the entire Taichu Realm.
Right now, deep within Guanghan Immortal Palace, there was a throne made of Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade.
Leaning against it was a figure in immortal attire, her body lithe and graceful, engulfed in Infinite Immortal Light, looking delicate yet substantial.
“How odd, why is my Red Luan star fluttering?”
On the throne, the female immortal furrowed her brows, and her eyes rippled with immortal light, within which universes were born and extinguished. Accidentally releasing a wisp of her aura could collapse the Nine Heavens.
“I will have a destined partner in the future?”
After calculating, the female immortal came upon an astonishing result.
What a joke! She was the Guanghan Empress!
Alone, she had traversed the Three Thousand Realms, her sole hand dominating the Eighty Thousand Domains, peerless under the heavens, her mighty name echoing through the Worlds of Myriad Realms.
For eons on end, she had grown accustomed to solitude, forever pursuing the Way, striving to step into the fourth stage of cultivation.
But now she had foreseen such an outcome, and most crucially, the chance she had been arduously seeking seemed to lie with this destined partner.
The Guanghan Empress regained her composure in an instant, smiled indifferently, and muttered to herself, “Let’s see how far my future partner has come.”
She decided to check him out personally; if he could pass her test, she would not mind having a partner after billions of lonely years. If he could not, even if that meant missing the chance for breakthrough, she would not concede to compromise herself.
She was confident that even on her own, in the future, she would transcend the Immortal Emperor Realm and enter the fourth step of cultivation.
“My future partner is actually in the Yuankun Domain? That’s where that fellow’s territory is,” chuckled the Guanghan Empress, yet without a hint of fear.
Others might not dare to enter that fellow’s domain, but she did!
If it came down to it, they could just have a fight. Who would be afraid? She also wanted to measure the weight of the former Emperor of Heaven and see who was stronger, provided that fellow dared to show himself.
That day, a strand of immortal light descended from Guanghan Heaven to the Endless Yuankun Domain, nearly undetected by anyone.
That day, in the northwest of Lanyu Divine Province within the Yuankun Domain, an immortal infant was born.

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empr
chapters.content:
Chapter 539 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
```
Early in the morning,
In places where sunlight could not reach, Han Li could.
"Han Li, are you coming over again?"
Having discussed profound doctrines all night, Zimei's lovely body lay across the bed, lazily reclining and propping up her chin as she spoke.
After a long-lasting battle, the present Zimei had lost her yesterday's innocence. Originally a holy Heavenly Immortal, she now glowed with a healthy radiance, her eyebrows suggestive of spring, her eyes as seductive as silk.
Just as Han Li was about to leave, he turned around at her words and saw Zimei's slender jade hand resting on her thigh, while her other hand's delicate, pale fingers were between her cherry lips and pearly teeth.
This was no Heavenly Fairy, but rather an unrivaled beauty!
Zimei was one of the three fairies of White Emperor City, famous throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain. If her admirers saw her now, their cultivation would surely shatter.
Luckily, the old ancestor was kind-hearted, content to keep these scenes to himself.
"What a little enchantress."
Han Li was not one to refuse, so he had no choice but to continue interacting with Zimei and exchanging knowledge of the doctrines.
"Zimei, help yourself,"
Once he had finished speaking, Han Li walked over and sat on the bed, ready for an accommodating session. [Fill in the blank]
The morning lessons began, with Han Li imparting profound doctrine knowledge to Zimei, engaging in a new round of exchanges to ensure her complete agreement.
Later, arriving at the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li flipped his palm to reveal a palm-sized, jade-green bowl that looked rather ordinary.
These days, Han Li had been busy interacting with Zimei and preparing to marry this exceptional female saint, and had not yet dealt with the Bihai Bowl, a Top Grade imperial weapon.
"Xi Yue."
At Han Li's soft call, Xi Yue's perfect figure appeared beside him, smiling at him.
"Master."
"Extract the Artifact Spirit from the Bihai Bowl. If it harbors any ill intentions, teach it a profound lesson," Han Li said indifferently.
"Okay."
Xi Yue nodded and gently curled her fair, delicate fingers towards the Bihai Bowl.
A sphere of light involuntarily flew out from the bowl, growing larger and larger before falling to the ground.
As the glow faded, a breathtaking woman in a green dress appeared, with an exquisite figure and alluring curves, her long and fair legs adorned with a white ankle bracelet.
"Han Li, what do you intend to do?"
The Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, who appeared to be a delicate and stunning woman, asked Han Li in a weak voice.
Although the Bihai Bowl was sealed, the Artifact Spirit had clearly heard Han Li's previous conversation with Zimei.
"Of course, I'm going to play an interesting game for two with you."
Looking at the woman before him, Han Li's eyes brightened. He had initially thought it would be a man. With a silent thought, he indifferently said, "What I want to do, don't you know perfectly well?"
"I will not agree," the green-dressed woman said with a cold smile.
The Lord of the Yuankun Domain was one of the rulers and one of the nine supremes. She couldn't betray the Lord of the Yuankun Domain; sorry, she just couldn't do it.
Even if Han Li had limitless potential, he would be easily crushed by the Lord of the Yuankun Domain before he could grow, making betrayal too great a cost.
"You won't agree, huh?"
Han Li arched an eyebrow and indifferently instructed, "Xi Yue, infuse a strand of Immortal light into her body."
Xi Yue flicked her finger, and a strand of Immortal light entered the body of the green-dressed woman, solidifying her ethereal form to become indistinguishable from a real being.
"You... you... you... what are you going to do?" The green-dressed woman suddenly grew panicked at a terrifying thought.
Could it be that Han Li was going to lay hands on her?
But she was an Artifact Spirit!
Who would do that with an Artifact Spirit? That's just too twisted.
Yet judging by Han Li's demeanor, he seemed to be exactly as she feared. As Han Li drew closer, the Artifact Spirit's heart raced with panic.
"Please don't!" She called out in her heart, over and over.
Han Li extended his right hand and lifted the green-dressed woman's chin, then unapologetically sealed her lips with a kiss.
Feeling the woman's rigid body, Han Li was unsatisfied and pried her mouth open. He simply acted, while she was to just enjoy.
The green-dressed woman was stunned into inaction, her flawless, white face filled with bewilderment.
Who am I?
Where am I?
What am I doing?
After snapping out of her daze, the green-dressed woman tried to resist, at the very least to bite Han Li's tongue as a lesson.
But her cheeks were held by Han Li, her luscious lips involuntarily parting and her teeth unable to close, completely controlled by him.
After the deed, Han Li's face bore a smile, seemingly reminiscing, then he said to the green-dressed woman, who was looking at him furiously, "Calm down, if you don't agree, what follows will be even more thrilling."
"You!"
The green-dressed woman bared her tiny fangs and clawed wildly at Han Li, finally saying coldly, "Do whatever you want, I'll never betray the Lord of the Yuankun Domain."
"Oh, I didn't expect you to be so loyal to the Lord of the Yuankun Domain,"
Han Li clicked his tongue twice, wasting no words as he pulled the green-dressed woman into his embrace. His figure vanished from Chengdao Peak, returning to his own chamber.
The fervent exchange of doctrines began.
It could be said to be a deluge of clothes by daylight, like the Yellow River's endless flow...
When the enchanting singing ceased, Biyuan couldn't help but tug at the blanket to cover her exhausted body.
"Han Li, you really are an unashamed lascivious scoundrel. I'm an Artifact Spirit, what do you take me for?"
The Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, Biyuan, raged, shouting indignantly.
Han Li leisurely got dressed, a smile appearing on his face as he spoke two words.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empr
chapters.content:
Chapter 540 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
Biyuan's exquisite and flawless face instantly turned red, feeling insulted by Han Li, yet for some reason, there was a faint sense of excitement in her heart. So this is what dual cultivation is like?
Watching Han Li brazenly sizing up her body, which seemed carved from pure white jade, Biyuan angrily shouted, "Get lost!"
"Tsk, that's not what you said when we were discussing the Dao earlier. You even let me freely impart my teachings and fluid..." Han Li teased.
Although he had already savored the flavors of several Artifact Spirits such as Shi Qi, Yin Ling, Yue Ji, and JianJi, Han Li still found engaging in Dao discussions with Biyuan to be a unique experience.
As expected of the Bihai Bowl's Artifact Spirit, truly as boundless as the ocean, Han Li could only describe it with one word: too abundant!
Looking at Biyuan's somewhat ashamed and angry expression, Han Li casually asked, "Have you thought it over?"
"I would never betray the White Emperor," Biyuan muttered softly.
Soon after, Biyuan changed her tune, crying out, "White Emperor, come quickly, or Han Li won't proceed..."
An hour later, a fresh batch of cream puffs was out of the oven.
Han Li and Biyuan appeared on Chengdao Peak, and Han Li asked again, "Biyuan, do you want another enhancement match?"
Biyuan's pretty face turned deathly pale, and she waved her hands frantically, shaking her head desperately.
She had been tormented badly by Han Li during their previous discussion. Her main body was sealed, even her strength as an Artifact Spirit was restricted, leaving her no match for Han Li.
"Are you that devoted to the White Emperor?"
Looking at Biyuan, who remained silent, Han Li raised an eyebrow. Did the White Emperor really have such great charisma?
Biyuan shook her head, hesitating to speak.
"If you have something to say, say it," Han Li said indifferently.
Biyuan was silent for a moment, then hesitantly said, "That... you've... done that to me... and... only know how... to forcefully... demand my obedience, right?"
"Can't you... like you did with... Zi Miao Zhen, give me some... benefits?"
Biyuan's cheeks flushed crimson, as she unconsciously lowered her head, her voice becoming lower and lower.
She was not particularly loyal to the White Emperor; she simply wanted to gain some benefits from Han Li, but Han Li only dealt with her forcefully.
Biyuan was frustrated. Why be so good to Zi Miao Zhen?
Although she was an Artifact Spirit, she was not inferior to Zi Miao Zhen at all – she had served him so well before, and all he wanted was to freeload?
Her own main body was at least of the Top Grade Imperial Arms, much more useful than Zi Miao Zhen, yet he only nagged and niggled at her without offering any substantial benefits.
Han Li had a vast wealth, many Supreme Grade Imperial Arms, and even Immortal Arms—his depth was unfathomable.
What was wrong with giving her some benefits?
A look of surprise crossed Han Li's face.
Oh Biyuan, how capable you are at swallowing and spouting. Why couldn't you talk so cleverly during our Dao discussion earlier?
Han Li smiled. He suddenly came to a realization, knowing he had misunderstood Biyuan. But this was also quite good; it was the first time he had forcefully discussed the Dao with an Artifact Spirit.
After some thought, Han Li said, "I'll help you ascend to a Supreme Grade Imperial Arm within a hundred years, how about that?"
Biyuan's face shot up, her heart pounding wildly. Suppressing her excitement, she asked, "That needs a higher bid!"
Pausing briefly, Biyuan hurriedly said, "That way, I can also sell you some information about the White Emperor and White Emperor City that Zi Miao Zhen doesn't know."
Biyuan didn't hesitate to betray the White Emperor.
She had insisted that she would never betray the White Emperor earlier, but that was only because the price wasn't high enough. Who told Han Li to look down on her so much, showing her no respect for her identity?
"I'll help you ascend to the Heavenly Immortal rank within a thousand years," Han Li offered offhand, drawing a large pie.
For Biyuan, ascending from a Top Grade Imperial Arm to a Heavenly Immortal Arm in a thousand years seemed unbelievable, but for Han Li, it was no big deal.
He was actually overshooting the offer. Otherwise, he could directly say he'd help Biyuan ascend to Immortal rank within a hundred years, which was entirely within the realm of possibility.
Heavenly Immortal Arm!
Biyuan's breathing quickened, nodding eagerly like a pecking chicken, excitedly agreeing, "Deal!"
No matter whether Han Li could achieve it, she had bitten off that pie, even stuffed from it; she had consumed her fair share before.
What she couldn't understand, though, was how she, an Artifact Spirit, could even consume these things.
After swearing on the Oath Stone, Biyuan let Han Li transfer mana to the core region of the Bihai Bowl, accepted his refinement, and allowed Han Li to become the new master of this Top Grade Imperial Arm.
After successfully handling Biyuan, the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, Han Li breathed a sigh of relief; now, the potential troubles might be significantly reduced.
Over the next ten days, Han Li and Zi Miao Zhen had a leisurely time admiring mountains and exploring the deep grasslands.
It wasn't until Zi Miao Zhen became pregnant that Han Li could reluctantly let go of this peerless saint, allowing her to finally catch her breath.
During these days, his understanding of the White Emperor, White Emperor City, and the Endless Yuankun Domain deepened. Zi Miao Zhen was somewhat reserved, while Biyuan told Han Li everything in great detail, even giving him a copy of the relevant memories in the end.
Being straightforward was the key.
Through Zi Miao Zhen, Han Li also learned about her purpose in the Qianyuan Divine Province, and finding out that the White Emperor was coveting the wife he had set his sights on, he decided to teach the White Emperor a lesson in the future.
He also came to know that Zi Miao Zhen actually hoped to snare an opportunity from that Heavenly Imperial Realm Great Emperor suppressed under the Emperor Formation in Leizhou.
Han Li agreed with this, but suggested she wait a little while before attempting it.
Afterward, Han Li found Lu Tianxiang and accompanied her for a walk and sightseeing on Chengsheng Mountain, chatting about various matters on the way.

“Remember to take the Formation Breaking Bead with you,” Han Li reminded him.
The outskirts of Leizhou’s underground world were encased by a Third Grade True Martial Realm array. It seemed that the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor couldn’t directly guide people in. If one wanted to enter, they’d have to rely on themselves.
Since Han Yongzhen’s strength wasn’t sufficient, he would have to take the Formation Breaking Bead. As for how to explain it and bluff the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, that would be up to Han Yongzhen’s own performance.
This was also a test—if he could successfully bluff, perhaps he could glean some opportunities from that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
“I will remind him,” Lu Tianxiang said with a smile, nodding.
She had already discussed with Han Yongzhen that after setting out for his trials, his first destination would be Leizhou, to obtain opportunities at Dingyuan Manor.
As for how to bluff the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, Lu Tianxiang had already instructed Han Yongzhen on this matter.
Zhang Wuji’s mother once said: The more beautiful the woman, the better she is at deception.
Half a month later.
Han Yongzhen left Yangdao Peak with a hint of regret on his face. His talent had indeed been raised to First Grade, but in the end, he did not develop a special physique and had to wait for the next opportunity.
His current outing wouldn’t be too long; he intended to return within a year to receive the next baptism from the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
A year of outside trials wouldn’t be as luxurious as the cultivation environment at Han Mansion, but it wouldn’t delay his progress much, as he carried many elixirs to improve his cultivation with him.
Upon reaching Chengdao Peak and entering the palace complex of the first zone, Han Yongzhen met his mother, Lu Tianxiang.
“Mother, isn’t father coming?”
Han Yongzhen looked around, not seeing Han Li’s figure, and a tinge of disappointment flickered in his eyes.
His father was very fond of him, and now that he was going out on his first trial, didn’t his father worry about his safety?
“Don’t worry, Yongzhen. Your father is a bit tied up at the moment but will come to see you before you leave,” Lu Tianxiang said with a smile.
Han Yongzhen nodded and breathed a sigh of relief.
“Have you brought everything with you? Make sure nothing is missing. Be careful when you’re out there, and don’t be too trusting of others…” Lu Tianxiang said softly.
Han Yongzhen listened intently. Even though this was the nth time his mother had said these things to him, Han Yongzhen didn’t feel annoyed; he was touched, knowing his mother was doing this for his benefit.
“Don’t worry, mother. The pills, talismans, weapons, array plates and so on that you and father prepared for me—I’ve brought them all,” Han Yongzhen said with a smile.
He thought being a “Second Gen Immortal” was fantastic.
With his father, Han Li, fighting hard his whole life to build such a vast family fortune, after he was born, he’d been enjoying it since, never lacking anything. Even going out for trials had no real danger.
Take, for example, the several Top Grade and Supreme Grade Heaven Rank Artifacts he carried—there were ones for attack, defense, escape, and travel…
The powers of those talismans, array plates, and secret treasures ranged from the Hollow Void Realm to the True Martial Realm, and he also had some life-saving items given to him by his father, Han Li, capable of slaying Divine Yuan Realm beings should he encounter them.
Of course, Han Yongzhen wouldn’t misuse these treasures; he would only use them when his life was at stake; otherwise, he stored them away to maintain the efficacy of his trials.
Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen continued to converse, talking about family affairs. When it was almost time, Han Li’s figure appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 542: 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 542: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
“Father.”
Han Yongzhen immediately shouted with an excited and respectful tone, as his father had finally arrived.
“Husband,” Lu Tianxiang said softly, without saying anything more, letting the father and son have their chat.
“Yongzhen, for your first journey of experience, you also have an assessment task, which, I believe, you already know,” Leizhou said, looking at Han Yongzhen with a smile on his face, his words neither hurried nor slow.
Han Yongzhen nodded and said, “Father, I understand.”
Not just him, all the Han Mansion descendants who went out for experiential training had assessment tasks, which would be rewarded and evaluated according to their level of completion and recorded in their respective files.
Han Yongzhen took this very seriously; he wanted to do as well as possible to make his father proud.
His father had too many pampered wives and concubines, and his mother, Lu Tianxiang, was just one of them. Although his mother was his father’s first wife, subtly referred to as the mistress of Han Mansion, his father had never officially acknowledged it.
Among his father’s pampered wives, there were many whose cultivation level, status, and identity were much higher than his mother’s, such as the recently married Zimei Zhen. His mother had revealed some secrets to him, suggesting this woman was a peerless Saint, a high and lofty figure from the profound Saint Abyss Realm.
He had thousands of brothers and sisters, many of whom were more outstanding than him, but most had not yet started cultivating, so Han Yongzhen wanted to take this opportunity to stand out.
Only then could his mother, Lu Tianxiang, gain prestige through her son.
“Go then, don’t disappoint me.”
“Rest assured, Father.”
“Mother, I’m leaving now.”
Han Yongzhen bowed to Han Li and Lu Tianxiang and then left Chengdao Peak without looking back.
After leaving, Han Yongzhen did not return to his residence on Dengdao Peak; he had already packed his belongings into his Space Ring.
On his way to Chengsheng Mountain’s foot, two people were waiting for him.
“You don’t need to accompany me,” Han Yongzhen said.
These two were Guest Elders and protectors from Han Mansion, with cultivation at the later stages of the Hollow Void Stage. They had been arranged to accompany Han Yongzhen on his journey as attendants.
The two exchanged glances, neither speaking.
“Go back.”
Han Yongzhen looked back at Chengsheng Mountain one last time and then stepped out of the Mountain Protection Array.
The two Hollow Void Stage Guest Elders looked at each other, unsure of what to do, and stood there frozen until a voice reached their ears, after which they returned to Chengsheng Mountain with a sense of relief.
After leaving Chengsheng Mountain, Han Yongzhen did not head straight to Leizhou but planned to travel leisurely there.
Atop Chengdao Peak,
Han Li wrapped his arms around Lu Tianxiang, gently caressing her belly, and said with a smile, “Let the child be, let him go.”
“Could there be any accidents?” Lu Tianxiang’s eyebrows furrowed slightly.
Although she knew Han Yongzhen had many trump cards, it was still his first time going out for experiential training, and as a mother, she couldn’t help but worry.
