“You can put your mind completely at ease; Leizhou is not far, and I can descend there instantly should there be any accidents,” Han Li said, very confident in his ability. With his speed, he could traverse half the Xuan Domain in a single breath, arriving in Leizhou in an instant without any trouble.
“That’s good,” Lu Tianxiang said, her breathtakingly beautiful face relaxing with ease upon hearing the words.
…..
In the Taichu Realm,
Guanghan Heaven.
This place is one of the Thirty-three Heavens, vast and boundless, with infinite worlds within.
In Guanghan Heaven, there was a power known as Guanghan Immortal Palace, famous throughout the Thirty-three Heavens, its reputation spread wide across the entire Taichu Realm.
Right now, deep within Guanghan Immortal Palace, a throne made of Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade was in place.
Upon it leaned a delicate figure clad in immortal garments, graceful and light, with a body shrouded in Infinite Immortal Light.
“Strange, why is my Red Luan star throbbing?”
On the throne, the female immortal furrowed her brows slightly. Her beautiful eyes shimmered with immortal light, displaying the birth and death of countless universes, and a mere breath from her could crush the Nine Heavens.
“Will I have a companion in the future?”
After some divination, the female immortal arrived at a startling conclusion.
What a joke! She was the Guanghan Empress!
Single-handedly, she had fought her way through the Three Thousand Realms, dominated the Eighty Thousand Domains with one hand, unmatched in the heavens and earth, her fame resounding through the myriad worlds.
Accustomed to solitude through the endless eons, she had only ever pursued the Dao, seeking to ascend to the fourth step of cultivation.
But now, she had divined such a result, and what’s more critical, the opportunity she had long sought seemed to lie with this future partner.
The Guanghan Empress regained her composure in an instant, smiling lightly to herself, “Let’s see how far along my future companion is.”
She planned to personally assess him. If he could pass her test, she, who had been alone for eons, wouldn’t mind having a companion. If not, even if it meant missing a chance for a breakthrough, she was not willing to settle.
She was confident that she could transcend the Immortal Emperor Realm and step into the fourth level of cultivation on her own in the future.
“My future companion is actually in the Yuankun Domain, the territory of that person,” the Guanghan Empress laughed lightly, showing no fear.
Others might hesitate to enter that person’s territory, but she dared!
If it came down to it, they’d fight. Who would be afraid? She wanted to gauge the worth of the former Emperor of Heaven, to see who was stronger or weaker, provided that person dared to reveal themselves.
One day, a strand of immortal light descended from Guanghan Heaven into the Endless Yuankun Domain, almost undetected by all.
That day, in the northwestern part of the Yuankun Domain’s Lanyu Divine Province, a celestial infant was born.

chapters.title: Chapter 543 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 543: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
In the early morning,
where sunlight could not reach, Han Li could.
“Han Li, are you coming or not?”
Having stayed up all night exchanging ideas and discussing the Dao with Han Li until dawn, Zimei Zhen languidly lay in bed, propping her chin up with her arm.
After enduring a prolonged battle, Zimei Zhen no longer had the pure and innocent look of the previous day. Initially a sanctified Heavenly Immortal, she now took on a seductive air, with eyes like silk.
As Han Li was preparing to leave, he turned around upon hearing her words and saw Zimei Zhen’s long, jade-like legs intertwined, with one of her graceful hands bringing her tender white fingers to her cherry lips and pearly teeth.
This was no fairy, but a peerless enchantress!
Zimei Zhen was one of the three great fairies of White Emperor City, with her beauty renowned across the Endless Yuankun Domain. Should her many admirers see her now, their faith would likely shatter into pieces.
Luckily, the elder’s heart was kind; these visions were for his eyes only.
“What a little seductress.”
Han Li, never one to refuse, could only continue exchanging Dao insights with Zimei Zhen in such circumstances.
“Zier, take what you need.”
With those words, Han Li walked over, sat on the bed, and prepared for a seated encounter ( ).[Fill in the blank]
The morning session began, with Han Li imparting his profound knowledge of the Dao to Zimei Zhen, engaging in a new round of Dao exchange, determined to make her utterly convinced.
Latter, he reached the summit of Chengdao Peak, where Han Li flipped his hand and took out a jade-colored bowl, palm-sized and ordinary-looking.
In recent days, Han Li had been busy exchanging affections with Zimei Zhen and arranging to marry such an exceptional female saint; hence, he hadn’t dealt with the Bihai Bowl, a top-grade imperial soldier.
“Xi Yue.”
With a gentle call from Han Li, Xi Yue’s perfect figure appeared by his side, smiling at him.
“Master.”
“Summon the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl. If it harbors any ill intentions, give it a harsh lesson,” Han Li said indifferently.
“Okay.”
Xi Yue nodded, her fair, tender fingers delicately hooked towards the Bihai Bowl.
A burst of light involuntarily flew out from the Bihai Bowl, growing larger before landing on the ground.
When the light dispersed, it revealed a beautiful woman dressed in a jade green skirt, with a strikingly beautiful face, a petite and curvy body, with gorgeous lines, and long, fair legs adorned with a white leg ring.
“Han Li, what do you want to do?”
The Artifact Spirit, a seemingly delicate and beautiful woman, asked Han Li weakly.
The Bihai Bowl might have been sealed, but she had heard every word of Han Li’s conversation with Zimei Zhen.
“To play an exciting two-player game, of course.”
As he looked at the jade-skirted beauty before him, Han Li’s eyes brightened; he had thought she might be a burly man. He murmured to himself, then said lightly, “You know exactly what I want you to do, don’t you?”
“I won’t agree,” retorted the jade-skirted beauty, scoffing.
Lord of the Yuankun Domain and one of the nine supreme beings, she couldn’t possibly betray the Lord of White Emperor City. Sorry, but that was not something she could do.
Han Li, though full of potential, could be easily crushed by the Lord of White Emperor City before rising to power. The cost of betrayal was too great, and it wasn’t worth it for her.
“You won’t agree, is that so?”
Han Li raised an eyebrow and said indifferently, “Xi Yue, infuse her body with a thread of Immortal light.”
With a flick of Xi Yue’s finger, a thread of Immortal light entered the body of the jade-skirted beauty, rendering her previously ethereal form solid, indistinguishable from a real creature.
“You… you… what are you going to do?” In sudden panic, the jade-skirted beauty had a terrifying thought flash through her mind.
Han Li wouldn’t act against her, would he?
After all, she was an Artifact Spirit!
No one had ever done “that” with an Artifact Spirit; that would be far too indecent.
Yet, judging by Han Li’s demeanor, it seemed he might just act on her fears. As he drew closer, her heart pounded wildly in her chest.
“Please don’t!” she silently pleaded.
Han Li extended his right hand, lifting the chin of the jade-skirted beauty, and unceremoniously sealed the deal with a kiss.
Feeling her rigid body beneath his touch, Han Li wasn’t satisfied and pried open her clenched teeth. “I will take action, you just bear it,” he thought.
The jade-skirted beauty was stunned, her porcelain face clouded with confusion.
Who am I?
Where am I?
What am I doing?
As she snapped out of her daze, the jade-skirted beauty wanted to resist, at least bite his tongue as a lesson to Han Li.
But Han Li held her cheeks in his grasp, her rosy lips inevitably parting, her teeth powerless to close—she was completely under his control.
After it was over, Han Li’s face was all smiles, seemingly savoring the moment, and said to the fiery-eyed jade-skirted beauty, “Calm down, if you don’t agree, there’s more excitement to come.”
“You!”
The jade-skirted beauty bared her tiny fangs and clawed at Han Li before saying coldly, “Whatever, I could never betray the Lord of White Emperor City.”
“Yo, I didn’t realize you were so loyal to the Lord of White Emperor City.”
With a tsk, Han Li wasted no more words, pulling the jade-skirted beauty into his arms and vanishing from Chengdao Peak, returning to his own chamber.
The exchange of Dao ensued with great vigor.
The pleasures of this need no elaboration, as everyone understands.
When the ravishing song finally ceased, Biyuan couldn’t help but pull the quilt over herself, her face full of discontent, glaring at Han Li.
“Han Li, you truly are a shameless libertine. I am an Artifact Spirit, what do you take me for?”
The Artifact Spirit Biyuan, furious and huffing, chided him.

chapters.title: Chapter 544 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 544: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
Han Li leisurely tidied up his clothes, and as he heard her, a smile emerged on his face. He exhaled two words.
Biyuan’s exquisite, flawless face instantly flushed red. She felt humiliated by Han Li, yet for some reason, her heart stirred with excitement. So this is what dual cultivation is like?
Watching Han Li brazenly appraise her shapely and alluring body, Biyuan snapped in anger and embarrassment, “Get out!”
“Tsks, you weren’t saying that during our debate,” Han Li teased. “You even told me to generously impart my teachings and fluids to you…”
Although he had already tasted the flavors of several Artifact Spirits, such as the four ladies Shi Qi, Yin Ling, Yue Ji, and JianJi, engaging in a theoretical exchange with Biyuan, Han Li found a uniquely different pleasure.
As expected of the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, truly as boundless as the ocean, Han Li could describe it with only one word: incredibly moist!
Looking at the somewhat bashfully incensed Biyuan, Han Li casually asked, “Have you made up your mind?”
“I would never betray the White Emperor,” Biyuan muttered softly.
Quickly, Biyuan changed her tune, crying out, “White Emperor, come quickly, or Han Li will not…”
After half an hour, a batch of fresh cream puffs came out of the oven.
Han Li and Biyuan appeared on Chengdao Peak. Han Li asked again, “Biyuan, care for another rematch to strengthen the bond?”
Biyuan’s pretty face turned deathly pale as she waved her hands frantically, shaking her head in desperation.
During their previous debate, she had been tormented by Han Li. Her main body was sealed, her Artifact Spirit’s strength was bound, and she was no match for Han Li.
“Are you really that loyal to the White Emperor?”
Looking at the silent Biyuan, Han Li raised his eyebrow. Did this White Emperor possess such great personal charm?
Biyuan shook her head, hesitant to speak.
“Speak if you have something to say,” Han Li said indifferently.
After a moment of silence, Biyuan tentatively said, “That… you already… with me… did that, and… only know… to forcefully… demand my submission?”
“Can’t you… like with… Zimiao Zhen, give me some… benefits?”
Biyuan’s face turned crimson, and she involuntarily lowered her head, her voice getting softer.
She wasn’t truly loyal to the White Emperor; she just wanted to gain some benefits from Han Li, who was only harsh with her.
Biyuan was angry. Why treat Zimiao Zhen so well?
As an Artifact Spirit, she was in no way inferior to Zimiao Zhen. She had previously served him so well, and all he wants is to take advantage of her for free?
Her true form, after all, was a Top Grade Imperial Weapon, far more useful than Zimiao Zhen. He always nagged at her but never offered any substantial benefits.
Han Li had a considerable fortune with numerous Supreme Grade Imperial Weapons and even Immortal Weapons. His foundation was unfathomable.
What was wrong with giving her some benefits?
A flicker of surprise crossed Han Li’s face.
Well played, Biyuan, so eloquent with your words. Why couldn’t you be like this with me during our debate? Were you deliberately playing coy?
Han Li chuckled, having an epiphany. He realized he had misunderstood Biyuan, but this mistake turned out to be rather delightful. This was the first time he was so forceful with an Artifact Spirit during a debate.
After thinking for a moment, Han Li said, “Within a hundred years, I’ll help you ascend to a Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon. How about that?”
Biyuan’s head shot up, her heart pounding. Fighting down her excitement, she asked, “There has to be an extra fee!”
Pausing, Biyuan hurriedly added, “That way, I can also sell you some inside information about the White Emperor and White Emperor City that Zimiao Zhen doesn’t know.”
Without hesitation, Biyuan was ready to betray the White Emperor.
Previously, when she claimed she would not betray the White Emperor, it was only because the price wasn’t right. Why had Han Li belittled her, showing no respect for her identity?
“Within a thousand years, I’ll help you ascend to a Heavenly Immortal Weapon,” Han Li said, offering a grand promise.
To Biyuan, the thousand-year journey from a Top Grade Imperial Weapon to a Heavenly Immortal Weapon seemed incredulous, but to Han Li, it meant little.
He was speaking generously; otherwise, he could have simply said a hundred years to ascend Biyuan to an Immortal Weapon, which was entirely possible.
Heavenly Immortal Weapon!
Biyuan’s breathing quickened, and she nodded eagerly like a pecking chick, excitedly saying, “Deal!”
Whether Han Li could deliver was irrelevant; she had taken the bait, and it left her stuffed with more than she could have imagined.
She didn’t understand how she, an Artifact Spirit, could digest such things.
After swearing on the Oath Stone, Biyuan allowed Han Li to transfer his mana into the core area of the Bihai Bowl and accept his refinement, making Han Li the new master of the Top Grade Imperial Weapon of the Bihai Bowl.
Having successfully dealt with the Artifact Spirit Biyuan of the Bihai Bowl, Han Li also breathed a sigh of relief, significantly reducing any potential troubles.
Over the next ten days, Han Li and Zimiao Zhen traveled through mountains and waters, experiencing the grandeur of looking down upon lesser peaks and exploring the depths of the grasslands.
It wasn’t until Zimiao Zhen became pregnant that Han Li reluctantly let go of this extraordinary saintess, much to her relief.
These days, he had gained a more detailed understanding of the White Emperor, White Emperor City, and the Endless Yuankun Domain. Zimiao Zhen had some reservations, but Biyuan detailed everything to Han Li, who then copied her memories and handed them over to him.
The main focus was honesty.
Han Li also learned about Zimiao Zhen’s purpose in the Qianyuan Divine Province from her and that the White Emperor had his sights set on his intended woman. Han Li decided to teach the White Emperor a lesson in the future.
He also found out that Zimiao Zhen wanted to take advantage of an opportunity from a Heavenly Immortal Realm Great Emperor trapped beneath Leizhou in a World-Shaking Emperor Formation.
Han Li agreed with the idea, but suggested she wait a while before trying.

chapters.title: Chapter 545 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 545: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
Subsequently, Han Li found Lu Tianxiang and accompanied her on a walk to enjoy the scenery of Chengsheng Mountain while casually discussing some matters.
Ever since Lu Tianxiang developed the “Fragrance of Heaven” body, she had become pregnant once more, and several months had already passed. This was a joint effort between Han Li and Lu Tianxiang.
In such a condition, it was naturally not a good time for Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang to discuss the Dao. However, Sect Hierarch Xiangxiang had more than one path. Guess what Lu Tianxiang’s delicate and stunningly beautiful red lips were for?
When Lu Tianxiang gracefully exhaled a breath of essence, she couldn’t help but give Han Li a look, her eyes at that moment sultry as silk, full of charm, exuding alluring elegance, which made Han Li feel the urge to ravish her right there and then.
Suppressing the flame in his heart, Han Li decided to find Xue Yueqing, that cunning fox spirit, later to properly discuss the Dao. He said seriously, “Yongzhen will soon go out for experiential training, right?”
Lu Tianxiang nodded slightly upon hearing this.
Han Yongzhen, her eldest son, was not yet twenty years old and had already reached the Initial Stage of the Hollow Void Realm. He practiced a powerful cultivation technique, mastered many high-level martial skills, and his combat ability was far above ordinary people.
Han Yongzhen originally had only Third Grade talent, but now he had been promoted to Second Grade talent. In half a month, it would be Han Yongzhen’s turn for his second Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism, by which time he would be elevated to First Grade talent.
Under Lu Tianxiang’s planning, Han Yongzhen was to travel outside for experiential training after reaching the Hollow Void Realm. It was not good for him to stay in Han Mansion all the time. Going out would broaden his horizons and perhaps even grant him some fortunes unique to Han Yongzhen himself.
However, with the Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism approaching, Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen agreed after discussing to postpone the timing of the experiential training by half a month.
With the Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism, not only could Han Yongzhen’s talent be elevated to First Grade, but there was also the possibility of developing a special constitution.
As the once-acclaimed number one genius of Han Mansion, Han Yongzhen was the center of attention; Han Li had poured much effort into him and had instructed and resolved his doubts countless times.
With the Enlightenment Stone left by Han Li at Enlightenment Peak and the stone stele at the foot of the mountain, the disciples of Han Mansion who regularly contemplated them experienced an increase in their perceptiveness, and the Life-Prolonging Furnace could also enhance one’s perceptiveness.
When Han Yongzhen broke through to the Hollow Void Realm, he felt an understanding of martial arts at the topmost level, and he grasped the rudimentary realization of this pinnacle martial Dao.
Many brothers and sisters within Han Mansion who were older and had higher cultivation levels were not opponents for Han Yongzhen.
Han Yongzhen had outstanding performances in the combat tower; Han Li always watched him closely and cared for him immensely.
“Don’t forget to take the Formation Breaking Bead with you,” Han Li reminded.
The outskirts of Leizhou’s underground world are guarded by a True Martial Realm grand formation of the Third Grade level; it seemed like the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor couldn’t personally lead people inside. If one wanted to enter, they’d have to rely on themselves.
Han Yongzhen’s strength wasn’t sufficient, so he needed to carry the Formation Breaking Bead. As for how to explain and deceive that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, it would be up to Han Yongzhen himself to perform.
This was also a kind of test; if he could deceive successfully, perhaps he could gain some opportunities from that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
“I’ll remind him,” smiled Lu Tianxiang, nodding in agreement.
She had already agreed with Han Yongzhen that his first destination after leaving would be Leizhou, to seek opportunities in Dingyuan Manor.
As for how to deceive that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, Lu Tianxiang had already taught Han Yongzhen the methods.
As Zhang Wuji’s mother once said, “The more beautiful a woman is, the more she can deceive.”
Half a month later.
Han Yongzhen left Yangdao Peak with a trace of regret. Although his talent had improved to First Grade, he ultimately failed to develop a special constitution, leaving the opportunity for next time.
His journey would not be too long; he planned to return within a year to receive the next baptism of the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
Training outside for a year, though lacking the advantageous cultivation environment of Han Mansion, would not delay his progress significantly as he carried many pills that could enhance his cultivation.
Arriving at Chengdao Peak and entering the palace complex of the first zone, Han Yongzhen met his mother, Lu Tianxiang.
“Mother, isn’t father coming?”
Han Yongzhen looked around, not spotting Han Li, and couldn’t help but feel a touch of disappointment flicker in his eyes.
His father doted on him, so wasn’t his father worried for his safety now that he was going out for training for the first time?
“Don’t worry, Yongzhen, your father has something to attend to right now, but he will see you before you leave,” Lu Tianxiang said with a smile.
Han Yongzhen nodded and sighed with relief.
“Have you packed everything? Don’t leave anything behind. Be very cautious during your training outside, don’t trust others easily…” Lu Tianxiang murmured softly.
Han Yongzhen listened attentively, and even though it was the umpteenth time his mother was telling him, he didn’t feel a hint of irritation, only moved, knowing that his mother was doing all of this for his sake.
“Don’t worry, mother, I’ve brought along all the pills, talismans, weapons, array plates, and so on that father and you have prepared for me,” Han Yongzhen said with a smile.
He felt being a Second Gen Immortal was truly wonderful.
His father Han Li had fought all his life to establish such a vast family fortune, and since his birth, he had relished in comfort, never lacking anything, even when setting out on training there were no dangers.
For instance, he carried several Top Grade and Supreme Grade Heaven Rank Artifacts with him, be it for attacking, defense, escape, or swift travel…
Those talismans, array plates, and secret treasures all extended their might from Hollow Void Realm to True Martial Realm, and he also had some life-saving items from Han Li, capable of slaying those of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Of course, Han Yongzhen would not use these treasures indiscriminately, only employing them when it was vital for survival. Otherwise, he would treasure them away, as their use otherwise would go against the purpose of his training.

chapters.title: Chapter 546 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 546: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen kept communicating, talking about some familial trivialities, and when the time was about right, Han Li’s figure descended.
“Father.”
Han Yongzhen immediately called out, his tone excited and respectful, for his father had finally arrived.
“Husband.” Lu Tianxiang said softly, without saying more, allowing father and son to chat.
“Yongzhen, this is your first time venturing out for experience, and there are also assessment tasks involved, which I believe you know,” said Han Li, smiling at Han Yongzhen, his words unhurried.
Han Yongzhen nodded and replied, “Father, I understand.”
Not just him, all the Han Mansion descendants who ventured out had assessment tasks, which would garner rewards and evaluations according to their completion, and these were to be recorded in their respective files.
Han Yongzhen dared not take this lightly, as he wanted to do as well as possible to satisfy his father.
His father had too many cherished wives and concubines, and his mother, Lu Tianxiang, was just one of them. Although his mother was the father’s first wife and implicitly known as the mistress of the Han Mansion, his father had never formally said as much.
Among his father’s beloved wives, there were many with cultivation, status, and identity far exceeding that of his mother, such as Zi Miaozhen, who had married into the family recently. His mother had hinted to him in secret that this woman was an unparalleled female saint of lofty status within the Saint Abyss Realm.
He himself had over a thousand siblings, with many more outstanding than he, though most had not started cultivating yet. Therefore, Han Yongzhen wanted to use this period to make a striking impression.
So that in the future, he could bring honor to his mother, Lu Tianxiang, through his achievements.
“Go now, do not disappoint me.”
“Father, rest assured.”
“Mother, I will take my leave first.”
Han Yongzhen bowed to Han Li and Lu Tianxiang and then left Chengdao Peak without looking back.
After leaving, Han Yongzhen did not return to his residence at Dengdao Peak, as he had long packed his luggage into the Space Ring.
Upon reaching the foot of Chengsheng Mountain, two people were waiting for him.
“You don’t need to accompany me,” Han Yongzhen said to them.
These two were Guest Elders and protectors of the Han Mansion, with cultivation at the latter stages of the Hollow Void Stage. They were assigned to be Han Yongzhen’s attendants during his training.
The two exchanged a glance, remaining silent.
“Go back,” Han Yongzhen said, turning back to glance at Chengsheng Mountain before stepping out of the Mountain Protection Array.
The two Hollow Void Stage Guest Elders looked at each other, unsure of what to do, and stood frozen in place until they heard a voice, allowing them to return to Chengsheng Mountain with a sense of relief.
After leaving Chengsheng Mountain, Han Yongzhen did not head straight for Leizhou. Instead, he planned to travel there leisurely.
Atop Chengdao Peak,
Han Li held Lu Tianxiang in his arms, gently stroking her belly and said with a smile, “Let the child be.”
“Could there be an accident?” Lu Tianxiang asked with a tinge of worry in her brows.
Although she knew that Han Yongzhen had many trump cards, this was his first time venturing out for experience, and as a mother, she was still somewhat anxious.
“Set your mind at ease. Leizhou is not far away, I can descend in an instant if any accidents occur,” Han Li assured her with considerable confidence. With his speed, he could cross most of the Xuan Domain in a single breath and appear in Leizhou in an instant without any trouble.
“That’s reassuring,” said Lu Tianxiang, her stunning face relaxing with those words.
…..
In the Taichu Realm,
Guanghan Heaven.
This place was one of the Thirty-three Heavens, vast and boundless, with infinite expanses within it.
In Guanghan Heaven existed a power known as the Guanghan Immortal Palace, whose reputation resounded throughout the Thirty-three Heavens and was widely recognized across the entire Taichu Realm.
At the moment, deep within Guanghan Immortal Palace, on an imperial throne made from Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade,
There leaned a delicate figure clad in immortal robes, graceful and lithe, enshrouded in Infinite Immortal Light.
“Strange, why is my Red Luan star throbbing?”
On the throne, the female immortal furrowed her brows slightly, her beautiful eyes shimmering with immortal light, within them, entire cosmos birthed and perished. Merely the leakage of a trace of her aura could crush the Nine Heavens.
“Will I have a fated partner in the future?”
After divining for a while, the female immortal arrived at a startling result.
What a joke! She was the Guanghan Empress!
Alone, she had traversed through the Three Thousand Realms, wielded power over Eighty Thousand Domains single-handedly, unrivaled both on earth and in the heavens, and her fame shook the myriad worlds.
In the countless eras that had passed, she had grown accustomed to solitude, pursuing the path alone and seeking to ascend to the next great step in cultivation.
But now, her divination revealed this unexpected outcome, and most crucially, the chance she had been so ardently searching for seemed to be linked with this fated partner.
The Guanghan Empress regained her composure in an instant and murmured with a faint smile, “Let’s see how far this future partner of mine has come.”
She planned to investigate personally. If he could pass her test, then she, who had been alone for eons, wouldn’t mind having a partner. If not, even with the prospect of that breakthrough opportunity, she would not settle.
She was confident that, even relying solely on herself, she could transcend the realm of the Immortal Emperor in the future and step into the fourth stage of cultivation.
“So, my future partner is in the Yuankun Domain, which is that fellow’s territory,” the Guanghan Empress chuckled lightly, yet with not a trace of fear.
Others might hesitate to enter that fellow’s territory, but she dared!
If it came to a fight, so be it—she feared no one!
She was also curious to see how she measured up against the former Emperor of Heaven, to determine who was the stronger, provided that fellow dared to show himself.
On this day, a strand of immortal light descended from Guanghan Heaven to the Endless Yuankun Domain, nearly undetectable to everyone.
On this same day, within the Divine Province of Lanyu in the northwest of the Yuankun Domain, an immortal infant was born.

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 547: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_1
At dawn,
where the sunlight couldn’t reach, Han Li could.
“Han Li, are you coming again?”
Zi Miao Zhen, who had debated the Dao with Han Li until dawn last night, lay languidly in bed, propping up her chin with a hand and asking in a tender voice.
After a continuous exchange of Daoist techniques, Zi Miao Zhen no longer possessed the innocence of the previous day. Originally a saintly Heavenly Immortal, she now appeared captivating, with eyes like flowing silk.
Han Li was about to leave when, upon hearing her, he turned around, only to see Zi Miao Zhen with her slender, jade-like legs entwined, as she extended a fair, delicate finger to beckon him.
This was no Heavenly Immortal, but a peerless enchantress!
Zi Miao Zhen was one of White Emperor City’s top three fairies, famous throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain. If those suitors saw her now, their Daoist hearts would surely shatter.
Fortunately, the old ancestor was kind-hearted. These images were meant for his eyes only.
“What a little demoness.”
Han Li wasn’t one to refuse; in such a situation, he had no choice but to continue exchanging Daoist knowledge with Zi Miao Zhen.
“Zhen’er, take what you need,” he said.
As his words fell, Han Li walked over and sat on the bed, ready for a (fill in the blank).[Fill in the Blank Question]
The morning lesson began, with Han Li imparting countless profound Daoist teachings to Zi Miao Zhen, starting a new round of Daoist debate, determined to make her wholeheartedly convinced.
Later, arriving at the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li turned his palm over and took out an emerald-colored bowl, no bigger than a palm and rather ordinary looking.
Lately, Han Li had been busy with his relationship exchange with Zi Miao Zhen and preparing for their wedding, the great female saint of her time, and had yet to deal with the Bihai Bowl, a Top Grade imperial weapon.
“Xi Yue.”
With a soft call from Han Li, Xi Yue’s perfect figure appeared beside him, her face full of smiles as she looked at him.
“Master.”
“Bring out the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl. If it harbors any ill intent, teach it a profound lesson,” Han Li said indifferently.
“Okay.”
Xi Yue nodded, and with a delicate, creamy finger, she gently hooked towards the Bihai Bowl.
A beam of light involuntarily flew out from the Bihai Bowl, grew larger, then landed on the ground.
As the light dissipated, it revealed an exquisitely dressed woman in a green dress. Her beauty was stunning, her figure curvaceous, with graceful lines, legs long and fair, adorned with a white leg ring on her left leg.
“Han Li, what are you planning to do?”
The Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl was a delicate-looking stunning beauty who weakly inquired what Han Li intended.
The Bihai Bowl might have been sealed, but she had overheard Han Li’s previous conversation with Zi Miao Zhen loud and clear.
“Of course, to play an interesting two-player game with you.”
As Han Li gazed at the woman in the green dress before him, his eyes brightened; he had thought she was a burly man. Muttering to himself, he said flatly, “Don’t you already know exactly what I want you to do?”
“I won’t agree,” the woman in the green dress said with a cold snort.
The Lord of Yuankun Domain was one of the sovereigns of the Endless Yuankun Domain, one of the nine supreme beings of Yuankun Domain. To betray the Lord for Han Li, who had great yet untapped potential, wasn’t a risk she was willing to take, no matter the cost.
“Not agreeing?”
Han Li raised an eyebrow and said indifferently, “Xi Yue, infuse her with a strand of Immortal light.”
With a flick of Xi Yue’s fingers, a strand of Immortal light entered the woman in the green dress’s body, making her ethereal form solidify and become indistinguishable from a real being.
“What… what… what are you doing?” The woman in the green dress was suddenly flustered, a terrible thought crossing her mind.
Could it be that Han Li would lay his hands on her?
She was an Artifact Spirit, after all!
Who would have thought of doing ‘that’ with an Artifact Spirit? That was just too much.
However, judging by Han Li’s demeanor, it seemed as if he would indeed do what she feared. As Han Li drew closer, the woman in the green dress’s heart pounded tumultuously, thumping wildly.
“Please, don’t let it be so!” she cried inwardly.
Han Li extended his right hand and lifted the woman in the green dress’s chin unceremoniously, pressing his lips against hers.
Feeling the stiffness of her body, Han Li, dissatisfied, pried open her teeth. He would act, and she had only to endure.
The woman in the green dress was left dazed, her flawless pale face filled with bewilderment.
Who am I?
Where am I?
What am I doing?
After her momentary daze, the woman in the green dress wanted to resist, to at least bite his tongue as a lesson for Han Li.
But her cheeks were held by Han Li, her lovely lips involuntarily parting, her teeth unable to close, completely under Han Li’s control.
After it was over, Han Li wore a beaming smile, seemingly savoring the moment, he said to the fiery-eyed woman in the green dress, “Calm down. If you don’t agree, there’s something even more thrilling to come.”
“You!”
The woman in the green dress showed her tiny canines and made a furious display at Han Li, then said coldly, “Whatever, I will never betray the White Emperor.”
“Yo, I didn’t expect you to be so loyal to the White Emperor.”
With a couple of tsk-tsks, Han Li didn’t waste any more words and pulled the woman in the green dress into his embrace. They vanished from Chengdao Peak to his sleeping chamber.
The fiery exchange of Daoist teachings commenced.
The delight of it all naturally goes without saying; everyone understands.
When the ecstatic singing ceased, Bi Yuan couldn’t help but pull over the covers, her face full of displeasure, glaring angrily at Han Li.
“Han Li, you truly are a shameless lecher. I am an Artifact Spirit. What do you take me for?”
The Bihai Bowl’s Artifact Spirit, Bi Yuan, was fuming, huffing in anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 548 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 548: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_2
Han Li leisurely packed his clothes and, upon hearing the words, a smile surfaced on his face as he uttered two words.
Biyuan’s exquisite, flawless face instantly flushed with redness. She felt insulted by Han Li, yet for some reason, there was a faint excitement within her heart. So this is what dual cultivation is like?
As Han Li brazenly surveyed her curvaceous and alluring body, Biyuan, infuriated and embarrassed, shouted, “Get lost!”
“Tsk, you weren’t saying that during our discourse; you even asked me to eagerly pass on knowledge and resolve your confusions…” Han Li teased.
Although he had tasted the flavor of many Artifact Spirits like Shi Qi, Yin Ling, Yue Ji, and JianJi, dual cultivating with Biyuan still gave Han Li a unique satisfaction.
She was truly the Artifact Spirit of the Bihai Bowl, vast as the ocean. Han Li could only describe it with one word: amazing!
Looking at Biyuan, who was a mix of embarrassment and anger, Han Li casually asked, “Have you made up your mind?”
“I would never betray the White Emperor,” Biyuan muttered softly.
Soon, Biyuan changed her tune, crying out, “White Emperor, come quickly, otherwise Han Li will not…”
An hour later, Han Li finished his satisfying exchange of Daoist teachings.
Han Li and Biyuan appeared at Chengdao Peak, where Han Li asked again, “Biyuan, how about another enhanced match?”
Biyuan’s pretty face instantly turned pale as she waved her hands frantically and shook her head desperately.
During their previous discussion, she had been tormented by Han Li; her true form was sealed, and even as an Artifact Spirit, her strength was bound, making her no match for Han Li.
“Are you that devoted to the White Emperor?”
Seeing Biyuan silent, Han Li raised an eyebrow. Did the White Emperor really possess such great personal charm?
Biyuan shook her head, hesitated, and then stopped herself.
“Speak your mind,” Han Li said indifferently.
After a moment of silence, Biyuan said hesitantly, “That…you…did that to me…you only know…to forcefully…demand my submission, right?”
“Can’t you…like with…Zi Miao Zhen, offer me some…benefits?”
Biyuan’s face was crimson as she involuntarily lowered her head, her voice getting lower and lower.
To her, loyalty to the White Emperor wasn’t really an issue; she only wanted to gain some benefits from Han Li. But Han Li was only forceful with her.
Biyuan was furious, why was he so good to Zi Miao Zhen?
Although she was an Artifact Spirit, she was in no way inferior to Zi Miao Zhen. Earlier, she had served him so well, and now he just wanted to take advantage?
Her true form was, after all, a Top Grade Imperial Weapon, far more useful than Zi Miao Zhen, yet he was always complaining and never provided any tangible benefits.
Han Li had a substantial family resource, owning many Supreme Grade Imperial Weapons and even Immortal Weapons, his depth was unfathomable.
What was wrong with giving her some benefits?
Surprise flickered across Han Li’s face.
Clever Biyuan, so articulate. Why hadn’t she spoken to him like this during their earlier discussion? Was she intentionally hiding her proficiency?
Han Li smiled, he instantly understood his misunderstanding with Biyuan, but he didn’t mind; this was after all his first time forcefully discussing Dao with an Artifact Spirit.
After some thought, Han Li said, “I’ll help you advance to a Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon within a hundred years, how about that?”
Biyuan’s head shot up, her heart pounding, as she fought back her excitement and asked, “There’s got to be an extra charge!”
Pause for a moment, Biyuan quickly added, “I can also sell you some information about the White Emperor and the White Emperor City that Zi Miao Zhen doesn’t know.”
Without any hesitation, Biyuan was ready to sell out the White Emperor.
Earlier, her repeated claims of loyalty to the White Emperor were just because the price hadn’t been right. Why should she respect Han Li for undervaluing her so much?
“I’ll help you ascend to a Heavenly Immortal Weapon within a thousand years,” Han Li casually promised a grand prospect.
The idea of a Top Grade Imperial Weapon ascending to a Heavenly Immortal Weapon within a thousand years was unbelievable to Biyuan but was nothing difficult for Han Li.
He was speaking generously; otherwise, he could directly promise to help Biyuan become an Immortal Weapon within a hundred years, which was entirely feasible.
Heavenly Immortal Weapon!
Biyuan’s breath quickened, nodding eagerly like a pecking chick, she exclaimed, “Deal!”
Whether Han Li could fulfill his promise didn’t matter; the grand vision he offered was too tempting for her, especially since she had already taken so much from him before.
It puzzled her that, as an Artifact Spirit, she could actually receive such things.
After swearing an oath on the Oath Stone, Biyuan allowed Han Li to transfer his mana into the core area of the Bihai Bowl and accept his refinement, making him the new master of the Top Grade Imperial Weapon Bihai Bowl.
Having secured the Artifact Spirit Biyuan of the Bihai Bowl, Han Li breathed a sigh of relief, drastically reducing any potential troubles.
For the following ten days, Han Li and Zi Miao Zhen frolicked through the mountains and waters, thoroughly enjoying the magnificent scenery of Chengsheng Mountain.
Only when Zi Miao Zhen became pregnant did Han Li, with reluctance, let this peerless female saint go, to her great relief.
During these days, his understanding of the White Emperor, White Emperor City, and the Endless Yuankun Domain deepened. Zi Miao Zhen still had reservations, but Biyuan told Han Li everything in painstaking detail, finally copying relevant memories for him.
She played the honest card well.
From Zi Miao Zhen, Han Li also learned about her purpose in coming to the Qianyuan Divine Province and that the White Emperor was coveting his predestined wife, deciding to teach the White Emperor a small lesson in the future.
He also learned that Zi Miao Zhen wanted to take advantage of the chance with the Great Emperor beneath the supreme Emperor Formation in Leizhou, in the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Han Li agreed with the idea but suggested she wait a little longer to go.

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - : 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 549: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_3
Afterward, Han Li found Lu Tianxiang and accompanied her for a stroll on Chengsheng Mountain to enjoy the scenery, while casually discussing some matters.
Ever since Lu Tianxiang had given birth to a “Heavenly Fragrant Body,” she had become pregnant again, and it had already been several months; this was a joint effort between Han Li and Lu Tianxiang.
In her current state, Sect Hierarch Xiāngxiāng was naturally not suited to debate the Dao, but Sect Hierarch Xiāngxiāng had more than one Dao to consider. Guess what the delicate and peerlessly beautiful red lips of Lu Tianxiang were for?
After Lu Tianxiang gulped a few times, she couldn’t help but give Han Li a white look. At this moment, her charming eyes were like silk, full of allure, and radiating charm in every gesture, making Han Li feel an impulse to take her right there and then.
Suppressing the flames in his heart, Han Li decided he would find Xue Yueqing, that fox spirit, and have a proper debate on the Dao afterward. He earnestly asked, “Yongzhen is about to go out for life experience, isn’t he?”
Lu Tianxiang nodded slightly at his words.
Han Yongzhen, her eldest son, was not yet twenty years old and his cultivation had already reached the initial stage of the Hollow Void Realm. He practiced powerful cultivation techniques, had mastered many high-level martial skills, and his combat ability far surpassed ordinary people.
Originally just a Third-Grade talent, Han Yongzhen had now advanced to Second Grade, and in half a month it would be his turn for the second Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism, by which time he would ascend to First Grade talent.
In Lu Tianxiang’s plan, Han Yongzhen was to go on his life experience journey after reaching the Hollow Void Stage. Always staying in Han Mansion wasn’t ideal; going outside to broaden his horizons might bring opportunities that were uniquely his.
However, with the Life-Prolonging Furnace baptism drawing near, Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen discussed and agreed to postpone his life experience journey by half a month.
Through the baptism of the Life-Prolonging Furnace, not only would Han Yongzhen’s talent ascend to First Grade, but he also had the potential to develop a special physique.
As the once top talent of Han Mansion, Han Yongzhen was the center of attention. Han Li had also invested a lot of effort in him, enlightening and resolving Han Yongzhen’s doubts many times.
With the Enlightenment Stone left by Han Li on Enlightenment Peak and the stele at the foot of the mountain, disciples of Han Mansion often contemplated them, enhancing their comprehension, and the Life-Prolonging Furnace could also improve their perception.
When Han Yongzhen was breaking through to the Hollow Void Stage, he experienced a top-tier level of martial arts and comprehended the embryonic form of this top-tier martial arts’s true meaning.
Many of Han Mansion’s brothers and sisters who were older and had higher cultivation than him were no match for Han Yongzhen.
Han Yongzhen’s performance in the Combat Tower was exceptionally outstanding, and Han Li, watching his eldest son, was filled with care and concern.
“Remember to take the Formation Breaking Bead with you,” Han Li reminded him.
The periphery of the underground world at Leizhou is protected by a True Martial Realm formation of Third Grade, and it seems that the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor cannot lead people into it; one must rely on oneself to enter.
Since Han Yongzhen’s strength is not sufficient, he will need to take the Formation Breaking Bead. As for how to explain it, to trick the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, it’s up to Han Yongzhen to perform.
This is also a test; if he can trick him, maybe he can snatch some opportunities from that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
“I will remind him,” Lu Tianxiang said with a smile, nodding her head.
She had already discussed with Han Yongzhen that after going out for his life experience journey, his first destination would be Leizhou, to grab opportunities at Dingyuan Manor.
As for how to trick that Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, Lu Tianxiang had already taught Han Yongzhen.
Zhang Wuji’s mother once said: “The prettier the woman, the more deceptive she is.”
Half a month later.
Han Yongzhen left Yangdao Peak with a hint of regret on his face; although his talent had risen to First Grade, he ultimately did not develop a special physique. He could only wait for the next opportunity.
He won’t be away for his life experience journey for too long and will return within a year. By that time, he will be ready for the next baptism in the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
Spending a year outside for a life experience journey might not have the conducive cultivation environment of Han Mansion, but it won’t delay his cultivation progress by much as he was carrying many elixirs that enhance cultivation with him.
Arriving at Chengdao Peak and entering the palace complex in the first district, Han Yongzhen saw his mother, Lu Tianxiang.
“Mother, is Father not coming?”
Han Yongzhen looked around but did not see Han Li’s figure, and a touch of disappointment inevitably flashed in his eyes.
His father doted on him a lot. Now that he was going out for his life experience journey for the first time, wasn’t his father worried about his safety?
“Don’t worry, Yongzhen, your father is a bit busy right now, but he will come to see you before you leave,” Lu Tianxiang said with a smile.
Han Yongzhen nodded and breathed a sigh of relief.
“Have you packed everything? Make sure nothing is missing. When you’re out, you must be careful and cautious, and not too trusting of others…” Lu Tianxiang spoke softly.
Han Yongzhen listened intently. Even though his mother had told him this countless times before, Han Yongzhen wasn’t annoyed at all. He only felt moved, knowing his mother was doing all this for his sake.
“Don’t worry, Mother, I’ve brought all the elixirs, talismans, weapons, and array plates etcetera that Father and you prepared for me,” Han Yongzhen said with a smile.
He felt it was truly wonderful to be a Second Gen Immortal.
Father, Han Li, had struggled his whole life to build up such a huge family business. He, Han Yongzhen, had enjoyed its benefits since birth, never lacking anything, even when going out for life experience, there was no danger.
For example, he carried several Top Grade and Supreme Grade Heaven Rank Artifacts with offensive, defensive, escape, and travel purposes…
The power of those talismans, array plates, and secret treasures ranged from the Hollow Void Realm to the True Martial Realm. He also had some life-saving items given to him by his father, Han Li, which could even slay beings of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Of course, Han Yongzhen would not use these treasures recklessly, only in life-threatening situations; otherwise, he would keep them tucked away, as using them casually would not serve the purpose of life experience.

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 550: Chapter 226: Alone, She Slaughtered Through the Three Thousand Realms, With a Single Palm Suppressing the Eighty Thousand Domains! Guanghan Empress!_4
Lu Tianxiang and Han Yongzhen continually exchanged words, recounting various family trifles. When the time was almost up, Han Li’s figure descended.
“Father.”
Han Yongzhen immediately called out, his tone filled with excitement and respect. His father had finally arrived.
“Husband.” Lu Tianxiang said softly, not speaking further, letting father and son talk.
“Yongzhen, your first venture out for training also includes an assessment task, something I believe you are aware of,”
Han Li said with a smile, speaking unhurriedly as he looked at Han Yongzhen.
Han Yongzhen nodded and responded, “Father, I understand.”
Not just him – all Han Mansion descendants who ventured out for training had assessment tasks and would receive rewards and evaluations based on their completion. These were to be recorded in their respective profiles.
Han Yongzhen did not dare to take this lightly. He wanted to perform as perfectly as possible to make his father proud.
His father had many cherished wives and concubines, and his mother Lu Tianxiang was just one among them. Even though his mother was his father’s first wife, subtly referred to as the Manor Lord’s wife, his father had never formally stated so.
Among his father’s wives, there were many with cultivation levels, standings, and identities much higher than his mother’s. For example, the recently married Zimei Zhen, whom his mother had revealed some secrets about. This lady was an unmatched Saint, an exalted figure of the Holy Abyss Realm.
He himself had over a thousand siblings, many of whom were more distinguished than him, though most had yet to begin cultivation. Therefore, Han Yongzhen wanted to use this time to make a more impressive display.
In the future, this could elevate his mother’s status through his own success.
“Go and do not disappoint me.”
“Rest assured, Father.”
“Mother, I shall take my leave.”
Han Yongzhen bowed to Han Li and Lu Tianxiang, then left Chengdao Peak without looking back.
After departing, Han Yongzhen did not return to the residence on Dengdao Peak, as he had already packed his luggage into his Space Ring.
On his way to the foot of Chengsheng Mountain, two people were waiting for him.
“You don’t need to accompany me,” Han Yongzhen said.
These two were Guest Elders and protectors from the Han Mansion with cultivations in the latter stages of the Hollow Void Stage, assigned to run errands for Han Yongzhen during his training period.
The two exchanged glances but said nothing in response.
“Go back.”
Han Yongzhen looked back at Chengsheng Mountain and stepped out of the Mountain Protection Array.
The two Hollow Void Stage Guest Elders looked at each other in confusion, unsure of what to do, standing motionless until a voice reached their ears, and they returned to Chengsheng Mountain, relieved of their burden.
After leaving Chengsheng Mountain, Han Yongzhen did not head straight for Leizhou. Instead, he planned to travel there by taking his time and enjoying the journey.
Atop Chengdao Peak,
Han Li wrapped his arms around Lu Tianxiang, gently stroking her belly and said with a smile, “Let the child go.”
“Could there be any mishaps?” Lu Tianxiang’s brows furrowed slightly.
Despite knowing that Han Yongzhen had many hidden aces, it was his first time going out for training, and as a mother, she still worried.
“Rest easy, Leizhou is not far and should there be any trouble, I can arrive in an instant,” Han Li replied with confidence. With his speed, he could cross most of the Xuan Domain in a single breath, making his instant arrival in Leizhou a trivial matter.
“Well then.” Lu Tianxiang’s strikingly beautiful face relaxed at the words.
…..
In the Taichu Realm,
Guanghan Heaven.
This place was one of the Thirty-three Heavens, vast and boundless, filled with infinite lands.
Within Guanghan Heaven was a power known as Guanghan Immortal Palace, renowned throughout the Thirty-three Heavens with a reputation spread far across the Taichu Realm.
At this moment, deep within Guanghan Immortal Palace, atop an imperial throne made of Nine Heavenly Immortal Jade,
leaned a graceful figure clad in immortal garments, her lithe body enveloped in Infinite Immortal Light.
“How odd, why is my Red Phoenix Star throbbing?”
Upon the throne, the eyebrows of this immortal woman knitted slightly. Her eyes shimmered with immortal light that seemed to create and extinguish vast universes. The mere release of a whiff of her aura could collapse the Nine Heavens.
“Will I have a companion in the future?”
After some calculation, the immortal woman arrived at a startling conclusion.
What a joke!? She was the Guanghan Empress!
Alone, she had slain her way through the Three Thousand Realms, single-handedly dominating the Eighty Thousand Domains, unrivaled under heaven, her fame shaking the myriad realms.
For countless eons, she had grown accustomed to solitude, pursuing the Dao, striving to step into the fourth stage of cultivation.
But now, her calculations pointed to such a conclusion, the most critical aspect being that the elusive opportunity she had long sought seemed tied to this destined companion.
The Guanghan Empress instantly regained her composure, smiling faintly to herself, and murmured, “Let’s see how far my future companion has come.”
She intended to assess him personally. If he could pass her test, she, who had been solitary for billions of years, would not mind having a companion. If not, even with the breakthrough opportunity promised, she would not settle for less.
She was confident that even by herself, she would eventually transcend the Immortal Emperor Realm and step into the fourth stage of cultivation.
“My future companion is actually in the Yuankun Domain—it’s that guy’s territory.” The Guanghan Empress chuckled, showing no sign of fear.
While others dared not enter that guy’s territory, she dared!
If it came down to it, why not have a fight? Who was afraid of whom?
She was curious to weigh the former Emperor of Heaven’s worth and see who was stronger, assuming the guy dared to show himself.
That day, a strand of immortal light descended from Guanghan Heaven to the Endless Yuankun Domain, going almost undetected by all.
That day, in the northwest of Lanyu Divine Province within the Yuankun Domain, a celestial infant was born.

chapters.title: Chapter 551 - 227: Han Yongzhen Grabs Opportunities! Emperor Changfeng's Plot! The Peerless Female
chapters.content:
Chapter 551: Chapter 227: Han Yongzhen Grabs Opportunities! Emperor Changfeng’s Plot! The Peerless Female
Yinyang Sect, Leizhou.
A figure stood tall on a mountain peak that pierced the clouds, looking down at the majestic rivers and mountains below, murmuring softly to himself.
“Is this my hometown?”
The speaker was a handsome young man with a full forehead and sharp brows, his eyes sparkling. His face, chiseled as if by knife and axe, brimmed with heroic vigor. He was dressed in an ornate green robe, with a jade pendant hanging from his waist. One hand rested on his back while the other held a folding fan.
It was none other than Han Yongzhen, who had left Chengsheng Mountain to travel the world.
It had been some time since he left the Han Mansion—starting from Yuanzhou, passing through Jizhou, and entering the territory under the control of the Yinyang Sect, he had made his way from Qingzhou to Leizhou.
Naturally, many things had occurred along the way, all of which Han Yongzhen had resolved. Especially after entering the territory of the Yinyang Sect, he had been the target of numerous assassination attempts, all by those seeking to kill for treasure.
With a low-key and steady father, Han Yongzhen had learned much essence. Although he was at the Hollow Void Stage, he only revealed the strength of the later stages of the Pihai Realm. Even so, he was quite eye-catching.
A Pihai Realm late-stager not yet twenty years old clearly showed the signs of a little genius from a major sect, exactly the type of target that cultivators of the demon path loved to ambush.
Such young geniuses usually came from wealthy backgrounds. Though they knew the Cultivation Realm was perilous, they were not particularly cautious, believing they had sufficient confidence to handle any danger.
But clearly, Han Yongzhen was not among them. Those cultivators of the demon path who came to kill Han Yongzhen were defeated by him, after which he destroyed the corpses and erased all traces, continuing on with the innocuous appearance of a harmless individual.
After multiple counter-kills, word spread, and those without substantial strength dared not appear before Han Yongzhen.
The most dangerous assassination attempt had been by a Grandmaster in the middle stages of the Hollow Void Stage, who, with two Gurus in the God Refining Realm, had ambushed Han Yongzhen. They failed to even damage Han Yongzhen’s battle garment, and with one move, he obliterated the Grandmaster, leaving the two Gurus of the God Refining Realm with no chance to escape.
After a modest gain, Han Yongzhen changed his appearance to what it was now, altered his route, and crossed the borders of Qingzhou and Leizhou, entering the territory of Leizhou.
Han Yongzhen vanished from the mountaintop and headed toward the Tianxuan Mountain Range, wishing to visit the ruins of Tianxuan Mountain.
His father had studied there for over a hundred years, and his affectionate Aunt Gongsun Yue had once been the young master of Tianxuan Mountain.
Han Yongzhen was fast, his speed comparable to the Peak of the Hollow Realm, and he soon arrived at the Tianxuan Mountain Range.
Leizhou had been annexed by the Yinyang Sect more than a decade ago, fully digested, and places like the lush Tianxuan Mountain Range had been occupied by Hollow Void Stage Forces.
“Things have changed beyond recognition.”
Looking at the utterly transformed gate and dojo, Han Yongzhen, reflecting on Aunt Gongsun Yue’s stories, couldn’t help but sigh.
Afterward, Han Yongzhen vanished again, seeing that there was no point in staying longer as Tianxuan Mountain Range had changed so much.
Throughout, Han Yongzhen never revealed himself, with even the Guru in the Void Realm secluded in the Demon Sect unaware of his presence.
After leaving the Tianxuan Mountain Range, Han Yongzhen sped towards Dingyuan Manor, hiding his form and aura along the way, making him undetectable even by Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
As he passed by Fengyang Manor, Han Yongzhen flew over a city called Lingjun City.
“Who would have thought that the Han Mansion was just a small family in Lingjun City decades ago? Now it’s a True Martial Realm force that commands respect throughout the Xuan Domain.”
Gazing at the site of the Han Mansion, Han Yongzhen felt a rush of emotions.
He knew deeply that the foundation of his family was far more complex than what appeared on the surface. What the outside world knew was only the tip of the iceberg in Chengsheng Mountain—its true foundation was no less significant than that of the Great Holy Land Schools.
As the eldest son of Lu Tianxiang and a core disciple of the Han Mansion, his status was high, allowing him to access many secrets.
“Father truly is an exceptional genius.”
Thinking of Han Li, Han Yongzhen’s face showed a look of worship and reverence. His father was the lighthouse on his path of cultivation, guiding him forward. He was also pursuing his father’s footsteps.
Han Yongzhen silently looked down at Lingjun City, taking in the bustling scene, and an involuntary smile appeared on his face.
If Lingjun City had reached this day, it was all thanks to their Han Mansion. Even after the Han Mansion moved away, Lingjun City remained flourishing, one of the most prosperous counties in Fengyang Manor.
Suddenly, Han Yongzhen’s Spiritual Sense heard people discussing his father, Han Li. In a flash, he silently appeared in a teahouse, watching a storyteller passionately speaking. His smile grew wider.
“… Not only is the ancestor of the Han Mansion highly skilled and a benefactor to many, but he also saw opportunities ahead, leading the people of Han Mansion on a long journey, spanning millions of miles, to relocate to Chengsheng Mountain in Yuanzhou.”
“That ancestor of Han Mansion, it is said he was an Immortal reincarnated from the heavens. He has now regained his cultivation, becoming one of the significant figures in our world.”
“Speaking of the Han Mansion’s ancestor, we must mention his hobbies. Back then, he married one after another beauty as enchanting as a Heavenly Immortal. He often held great banquets in Lingjun City, and I believe many here have received the generosity of the Han Mansion’s ancestor…”
Han Yongzhen flicked a finger, and a Gang Yuan silently entered the storyteller’s body, facilitating the circulation of his Qi and blood, which could help the man extend his life and health for a year.
After that, Han Yongzhen’s figure disappeared again, hurrying at full speed toward Dingyuan Manor.
Upon entering Dingyuan Manor, Han Yongzhen slowed down and continued his planned journey toward a small one-hundred-meter mountain to settle down.
As Han Yongzhen entered within a hundred miles of this small mountain, the Great Emperor in the Heaven Imperial Realm within the Emperor Formation detected him but did not make a move, silently observing.

chapters.title: Chapter 552 - 227: Han Yongzhen Grabs Opportunities! Emperor Changfeng's Plot! The Peerless Female Saint Ji Mingyue Arrives!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 552: Chapter 227: Han Yongzhen Grabs Opportunities! Emperor Changfeng’s Plot! The Peerless Female Saint Ji Mingyue Arrives!_2
When he saw Han Yongzhen settle down to rest on the small hill, his eyes brightened for a moment, then dimmed again.
What’s the use of another person coming, if they can’t even enter.
The Great Emperor lamented with a sigh, feeling that he was extremely unlucky, with such poor foresight.
In the past five hundred years, he had encountered three people, and each time he had held out hope, only for it to come to nothing.
The first was a Pihai Realm minor cultivator, to whom he had expended some energy to bring inside and given a Pill Formula for a Rebirth Pill, hoping to lure some covetous individuals.
However, there was no word from that minor cultivator afterwards, which to the Great Emperor seemed like his death, as the Pihai Realm couldn’t protect the Pill Formula. Yet the cultivator who obtained the Pill Formula was overly cautious, actually not returning to seek further opportunities.
This made the Great Emperor, who was fishing for the first time, a bit uncomfortable, as the bait had been taken but the fish didn’t bite.
The second was Zimiao Zhen at the peak of the Tongxuan Realm. The Great Emperor had taken Zimiao Zhen very seriously, offering many great fortunes and even painting him grand pictures, but Zimiao Zhen didn’t bite.
The third was a cultivator from the first layer of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, into whom the Great Emperor had invested his last bit of energy to get inside, instructing Lu Tianxiang to seize the Pill Formula.
He had painted some grand pictures for Lu Tianxiang as well, promising that if she returned, she could obtain the continuation of the Living Beings Immortal Transformation Scripture’s cultivation technique and even be accepted as his disciple among other things. Unexpectedly, this female cultivator also never returned.
How infuriated the Great Emperor was, as Qianyuan Divine Province had declined, but was the Xuan Domain not dangerous? Logically speaking, Lu Tianxiang, a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster, should have the power to protect herself. Yet, twenty years had passed with no return.
Was it because she did not manage to seize the Pill Formula for the Rebirth Pill, or was she still investigating?
How foolish, whether you failed to seize it or still couldn’t find it, you could come back to me, I would simply give it to you.
The Great Emperor deeply regretted not giving that Myriad Phenomena Realm female cultivator more benefits earlier. That way he could have kept her attention, making her linger and not stay away for so long.
Over the years, some cultivators passed by the small hill but couldn’t detect anything unusual and failed to meet the Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor.
The Emperor thought this cultivator at the Hollow Void Stage would be the same; although Han Yongzhen had concealed his cultivation, he couldn’t hide it from him.
“Eh?”
Suddenly, the Great Emperor uttered a surprised exclamation; it seemed that this person had come prepared, aware of some secrets?
He saw that the Hollow Void Stage cultivator from above took out a Third Grade Formation Breaking Bead from his Space Ring, activated its power, passed through the True Martial Realm’s outer formation, and successfully entered the Underground World.
Han Yongzhen’s Spiritual Sense surged out, surveying the surroundings and found everything exactly as his mother, Lu Tianxiang, had described; there was not a single change, even after twenty years.
Looking at the nine-colored light screen ahead, Han Yongzhen’s eyes flashed with intrigue as he walked straight towards it.
When he approached the nine-colored light screen, Han Yongzhen stopped and gazed silently inside, feeling somewhat expectant and nervous. According to his mother, a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor was suppressed within.
Inside the Emperor Formation, the Emperor continuously watched Han Yongzhen who entered, taking in every move he made, understanding that this Hollow Void Stage cultivator must have had guidance from an expert.
Even through the Emperor Formation, with his eyesight, he could tell Han Yongzhen was not older than twenty, exceptionally talented, who would have been considered a genius even in the Ancient Era.
“Are you a descendant of Qiu Xuan, or perhaps Lu Tianxiang, or from a Great Holy Land School in the Qianyuan Divine Province?”
The voice of the Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor suddenly rang out, echoing throughout the Underground World and causing Han Yongzhen’s brow to furrow slightly.
The Emperor was forthright; since this person had come prepared, he must be aware of his existence, and it was unlikely that he was a descendant of Qiu Xuan, the Pihai Realm minor cultivator.
Perhaps Qiu Xuan had offered the Rebirth Pill Formula, which eventually fell into the hands of a major power that had been cautious and only sent someone today.
Or maybe Lu Tianxiang had acquired the Pill Formula for the Rebirth Pill, offered it to the power behind her, and thus climbed in status, reaching the True Martial Realm or even the Divine Yuan Realm.
If Lu Tianxiang had kept the secrets of this place hidden, then it’s true that outsiders wouldn’t know the mysteries within. This person being not even twenty years old, indeed matches the time when Lu Tianxiang left.
But Lu Tianxiang was, after all, a Myriad Phenomena Realm Grandmaster, who had obtained the Pill Formula, so why would she rush into marriage and bear a child?
The Great Emperor couldn’t understand it, naturally unaware that Lu Tianxiang had been captured by Han Li and then gave birth to Han Yongzhen.
“My mother, Lu Tianxiang.”
Han Yongzhen bowed towards the nine-colored light screen and spoke solemnly.
This scenario was also anticipated by his mother, who had already given him a corresponding strategy. Han Yongzhen had rehearsed it many times.
“Where is your mother? Why doesn’t she come to see me, the Emperor!”
The Emperor snorted coldly, his overwhelming aura crushing down on Han Yongzhen, instantly inverting heaven and earth, reversing the cosmos, shattering mountains and rivers, collapsing the sun and the moon…
Han Yongzhen remained fearless; he knew well that these were all illusions, frightening to behold but the Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor was trapped in the Emperor Formation, and his Emperor’s Might couldn’t escape, everything was an illusion, as long as he stayed resolute in his Dao heart, nothing would happen.
“My mother has urgent matters to attend to and can’t extricate herself, but she is greatly concerned about the Emperor, hence she sent me to pay a visit,” said Han Yongzhen, calm and unhurried.
The Emperor narrowed his eyes slightly, feeling a tick of irritation. So Lu Tianxiang took his benefits and didn’t show up. Was he supposed to eat her up?
He grew more averse to beautiful women; in the Ancient Era, he had been fooled before, and Zimiao Zhen had disappointed him twice, as had Lu Tianxiang.
Lu Tianxiang truly knew no bounds in her greed, didn’t she? Not daring to come herself, she actually sent her offspring instead, still wanting to get benefits from him, really treating him like a great philanthropist?

chapters.title: Chapter 553 - 227: Han Yongzhen Grabs Opportunities! Emperor Changfeng’s Plot! The Peerless Female Saint Ji Mingyue Arrives!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 553: Chapter 227: Han Yongzhen Grabs Opportunities! Emperor Changfeng’s Plot! The Peerless Female Saint Ji Mingyue Arrives!_3
“I have an Emperor Scripture here that once shook the Ancient Era. Would you like to have it?” After pondering, the Great Emperor indifferently said.
“Yes.”
Han Yongzhen nodded without hesitation.
Although Han Mansion also had Emperor Scriptures, one could never have too many at the Emperor Level. If he could obtain the Emperor Scripture, it would mean great fortune. Bringing it back to present to his family would surely delight his father, and the benefits for him would be numerous.
“If you want me to pass it on to you, it’s not impossible, but you shall need to do something for me. I need you to…” The Great Emperor stated his conditions and quietly waited for Han Yongzhen’s response.
This time, the Great Emperor did not wish to fish slowly; he got straight to the point, providing tangible benefits to willingly enslave the person. Of course, certain restrictions were necessary.
Upon hearing this, Han Yongzhen showed a troubled expression and feigned hesitation, “Great Emperor, this is a matter of great importance, and we need to think it over carefully.”
The Great Emperor’s face darkened, but he did not get angry and continued, “After the deed is done, this Emperor will take you as my personal disciple, teach you all my knowledge, and help you condense a king’s body. How does that sound?”
“Not enough,” Han Yongzhen said frankly.
“Great Emperor, the task you want me to undertake is too great. I cannot do it alone; I must go back to consult my Mother, who will then ask my Father, and my Father will have to solicit one strong figure after another. The difficulty is immense, and without something substantial, it’ll be very hard for me to persuade them.”
The Great Emperor’s pupils shrank slightly. Good fellow, are you playing matryoshka dolls with me?
Offering you such immense benefits for a task, yet you still think about satisfying one after another, your appetite is so large, are you not afraid of overeating?
However, the greedier Han Yongzhen was, the better for manipulation. Hence, the Great Emperor indifferently offered, “I can give you three more Pill Formulas and three Refining Blueprints, one for each realm from Myriad Phenomena Realm to Divine Yuan Realm.”
“Deal,” Han Yongzhen took the offer without further bargaining.
In fact, for the Great Emperor to so readily give him such benefits was beyond his expectations.
According to his mother, this Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor was a stingy person. His deceased Uncle Qiu Xuan only received one Rebirth Pill Formula, and when his mother came here, aside from finding a clue and eating some pastries, she got nothing.
Han Yongzhen also came with the mindset of just giving it a try, thinking it would be a victory if he could snatch any opportunity and was prepared for the possibility of returning empty-handed. He never expected the Great Emperor to change his ways and show such generosity.
Seeing that Han Yongzhen had agreed, the Great Emperor immediately imparted a mantra to Han Yongzhen, allowing him to cultivate it with ease and master it quickly.
Afterward, as they had previously agreed, Han Yongzhen performed the mantra and suddenly felt an immense and vast willpower. He frowned slightly but still solemnly swore:
“I call upon the great existence as witness, if Emperor Changfeng provides me with an Emperor Scripture from the Heaven Imperial Realm… afterward, takes me as his personal disciple, imparts all his learned knowledge, and helps me condense a king’s body, within a hundred years, I will…”
Han Yongzhen recounted all the conditions they had previously agreed upon, plugging all the loopholes, leaving no stone unturned, and making it impregnable.
Upon hearing this, Emperor Changfeng breathed a sigh of relief, a smile appearing on his face. He passed on an Emperor Level Top Grade Cultivation Technique to Han Yongzhen, along with three Pill Formulas and three Refining Blueprints.
The two chatted for a while longer before Han Yongzhen bid farewell and left.
Watching the disappearing figure, Emperor Changfeng’s face revealed a mysterious smile.
“Han Yongzhen, heh~ You’re still too naive,” Emperor Changfeng sneered.
All the conditions he mentioned to Han Yongzhen were fake, none of them mattered. His real goal was to impart the Emperor Scripture to Han Yongzhen.
He didn’t want to wait any longer, didn’t want to continue languishing unseen underground. He wanted to go out.
Thus, upon seeing Han Yongzhen, Emperor Changfeng made a tough decision.
He intended to seize a body and be reborn!
Trapped in this supreme Emperor Formation, even if he died, he could not reincarnate, let alone seize a body and be reborn. However, under certain conditions, it could still be possible.
This was the reason for his generous imparting of the Emperor Scripture to Han Yongzhen. This Emperor Scripture was no simple matter, indeed very sinister.
He had spent over a hundred thousand years creating this Emperor Scripture, all for today’s purpose. As the creator of the Emperor Scripture, he had left himself a way out.
As long as Han Yongzhen cultivated this Emperor Scripture, he would gradually become an Immortal Fetus. Regardless of his talents, insight, or physique, all would significantly improve, or emerge out of nothing.
As the cultivation of this technique reached the Divine Yuan Realm, he would be able to birth himself from the Immortal Fetus and then gradually erode and seize everything from Han Yongzhen.
When Han Yongzhen advanced to the Tongxuan Realm, Emperor Changfeng would exert his power, completely abandoning his current body and Primordial Spirit, exchanging a strand of his True Spirit for the newly born True Spirit of Han Yongzhen, completely replacing Han Yongzhen.
Though the risk was great, and he would have to cultivate back up to the Heaven Imperial Realm, Emperor Changfeng could care no more.
When he became powerful in the future, he could retrieve his body and Primordial Spirit later. By then, merging the achievements of two lives, he might even advance to become a supreme being, or even transform into a War Immortal.
Emperor Changfeng believed that Han Yongzhen would surely cultivate it, since no one could resist the temptation of the Emperor Scripture, especially someone like Han Yongzhen from a minor power, who had not cultivated high-level techniques. The Emperor Scripture was an incredible opportunity.
Han Yongzhen would not realize that Changfeng had tampered with the scripture. He gave Han Yongzhen such great benefits not truly wishing for Han Yongzhen to come to his rescue.
Meanwhile,
After leaving, Han Yongzhen vanished without looking back, moving away from the hundred-meter hill, his face unable to hide the smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 554 - 227: Han Yongzhen Grabs Opportunities! Emperor Changfeng’s Plot! The Peerless Female Saint Ji Mingyue Arrives!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 554: Chapter 227: Han Yongzhen Grabs Opportunities! Emperor Changfeng’s Plot! The Peerless Female Saint Ji Mingyue Arrives!_4
This time, the gains were enormous!
A Heaven Imperial Realm level Emperor Scripture, one Pill Formula and Refining Blueprint each from the Myriad Phenomena Realm, True Martial Realm, and Divine Yuan Realm—what a tremendous opportunity.
Han Yongzhen indeed hadn’t realized the trap within, but he also didn’t plan on cultivating the Emperor Scripture right away, as he wasn’t someone who had never seen Emperor Scriptures; he had even seen Immortal Scriptures before.
He kept his parents’ instructions in mind, that no matter what opportunity he gleaned from Emperor Changfeng, he had to take it back for them to check before doing anything further, so as to avoid any traps.
As for the prior oath, Han Yongzhen didn’t care about it at all.
He had been sincere when making the vow, but he never considered fulfilling it. Although the consequences of breaking an oath were terrifying, leading to being devoured by that great existence, he wasn’t going to break it.
Tsk, tsk, a hundred years…
According to what his father, Han Li, had said, Emperor Changfeng was intentionally left for Lu Tianxiang’s lineage as an opportunity—how much they could get depended on their abilities.
Decades later, his father would descend upon Leizhou with that newly taken aunt, the unparalleled female saint, Ji Mingyue, to deal with Emperor Changfeng.
