Whether Emperor Changfeng died or his father broke open the Emperor Formation and suppressed the Great Emperor again, his oath would be broken and wouldn’t matter anymore.
“When I return, Mother will definitely be very pleased.”
Han Yongzhen left Leizhou and entered Huozhou, planning to take a different route back home, his heart brimming with excitement.
…..
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Inside Ji Mingyue’s bedchamber, Han Li was discussing profound and obscure Daoist principles with her.
Ji Mingyue lay lazily on the bed, striking an extremely seductive pose, giving Han Li an urge that was difficult to suppress.
Han Li was a very passionate person, always happy to help others, but since Ji Mingyue didn’t accept his goodwill, Han Li could only give up and proceed in a proper and orderly manner.
While exchanging profound Daoist theories with the unparalleled female saint Ji Mingyue, Han Li decided to leech off her luck and open this month’s treasure chest.
As Han Li’s thoughts moved, the treasure chest page appeared before his eyes, situated above two dazzling headlights. When the chest opened, the gold and silver lights intertwined, nearly blinding the old ancestor Han.
“Ding, treasure chest opened successfully, congratulations master on acquiring the Emperor Level Supreme Grade Cultivation Technique ‘Heavenly River Scripture’!”
Seeing a top-tier Heaven Imperial Realm Cultivation Technique for the first time made Han Li so excited that he couldn’t help but grip the steering wheel to continue driving; he wanted to thank Ji Mingyue for her contribution and carve out a road to happiness.
The Chaos Scripture that he currently focused on was only of Top Grade at the Emperor Level, reaching the level of the Heaven Imperial Realm. If he integrated the Heavenly River Scripture into it, absorbing its essence, though it wouldn’t elevate the level of the Chaos Scripture, it would significantly enhance its power.
The top-tier Emperor Scripture, Heavenly River Scripture, could also be placed into the Cangdao Hall for some key individuals of the Han Mansion to cultivate, enhancing their strength.
Ji Mingyue glared at Han Li, silently enduring the storm following her previous lesson. Without uttering a word, even when she could hardly hold back, she kept her voice very low, accentuating a “dare not speak loudly for fear of startling the beings in heaven.”
The more she did this, the more excited the old ancestor Han became, gleefully discussing the ultimate truths of life with Ji Mingyue.
“Zhen’er, do you want to come with me?”
After the exchange of Daoist knowledge ended, Han Li invited Ji Mingyue.
The Sword Spirit Xi Yue had already sent him a warning. Ji Mingyue, who had been exploring in Luming Divine Province, had finished and was currently heading toward Qianyuan Divine Province.
If Han Li was to act, it would be best to set off immediately, to intercept Ji Mingyue in the vast sea, and like when he captured Ji Mingyue, do the same to this Heavenly Immortal list’s unparalleled female saint.
“Of course I’m going for such a good opportunity,” Ji Mingyue immediately said, her fatigue replaced with a surge of energy, a smile appearing on her face.
Since she had fallen into Han Li’s hands and married him unwillingly, now even pregnant with his child, she wanted to drag her nemesis, Ji Mingyue, down with her.
But Han Li delayed taking action, and Ji Mingyue didn’t feel comfortable urging him. Now that the chance had come, Ji Mingyue naturally wanted to witness it.
She wanted to see for herself how Ji Mingyue would be panic-stricken and despair before being captured by Han Li.
She knew very well how proud Ji Mingyue was—tougher to handle than her own case. She also wanted to see if Han Li could tame Ji Mingyue and if Ji Mingyue would be willing to sink into the mire with her.
“We shouldn’t delay, let’s set off now,” Han Li said as his Divine Sense moved, immediately changing his clothes and speaking to Ji Mingyue.
“Alright,” Ji Mingyue quickly dressed and was swept away by Han Li, disappearing from sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 555 - 228: The Unexpected Appearance of Yuan Youwei! Ji Mingyue VS Yuan Youwei! The Great Elder Ancestor Makes a Move, Capturing Them All in One Go_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 555: Chapter 228: The Unexpected Appearance of Yuan Youwei! Ji Mingyue VS Yuan Youwei! The Great Elder Ancestor Makes a Move, Capturing Them All in One Go_1
Han Li sped through the void with Zimiao Zhenfeng at his side, hurtling toward their destination with incredible speed.
“Han Li, how can you move so fast?”
Zimiao Zhenfeng nestled in Han Li’s arms, her white clothes fluttering and her delicate body graceful, as she looked at him in surprise.
She had initially thought that Han Li’s combat ability was on par with the mid-stage of the Saint Abyss Realm, but his speed was no worse than hers. How on earth did he cultivate like this?
She was quite suspicious that Han Li was the reincarnation of a Heavenly Immortal; otherwise, it made no sense for him to be so monstrously powerful in every aspect, beyond all reason.
Previously she was unaware, but now as a member of the Han Mansion, and with Han Li not keeping secrets from her, she understood quite a bit about his past and the foundations of Chengsheng Mountain.
Although Han Li had been cultivating for over two hundred years, his true rise began more than fifty years ago. After advancing from the pinnacle of the Innate Realm to the Pihai Realm, his progress became unstoppable, and he soared rapidly to great heights.
The key point was that she rarely saw Han Li cultivate. Apart from arranging flowers and enjoying his jade collection, Han Li spent most of his time enjoying life, hardly ever practicing martial techniques. It was known that, in the past, there was no Time-Sky Tower in Chengsheng Mountain.
Whether it was cultivating techniques to elevate one’s realm or practicing martial skills to boost combat ability, both required a lot of time, but Han Li did not seem to need as much.
Zimiao Zhenfeng felt there was some truth in the outside world rumors: Han Li was the reincarnation of a powerful being, if not a great existence from the Tongxuan Realm or a Saint from the Saint Abyss Realm, then at least a Heavenly Immortal.
Only then would it be possible for him to advance so quickly in cultivation with minimal practice, and for powerful martial skills to naturally reach perfection—all fruits of his past life.
If Han Li had been an Immortal in his previous life, then he surely cultivated Immortal Scriptures and mastered many immensely powerful martial techniques. With the awakening of his Dormant Wisdom after reincarnation, he would need only a bit of practice to bring these skills back to perfection.
Han Li smiled and changed the subject instead of answering, “Although it’s said in martial arts that nothing is indestructible except for speed, sometimes a combination of fast and slow is the key to endurance.”
Zimiao Zhenfeng: “???”
Zimiao Zhenfeng felt a bit confused. What was Han Li talking about? She was asking about his flying speed, not how fast he drove.
The sharply intuitive woman quickly understood his implication. Her creamy and flawless face blushed pink, admiring Han Li’s point that a blend of fast and slow had, indeed, left her breathless.
“Hahaha~” Han Li laughed heartily, finding Zimiao Zhenfeng even more attractive at that moment.
“You jerk~”
Zimiao Zhenfeng playfully punched his chest; she didn’t use much force, or else Han Li would have been yelping in pain.
After all, Zimiao Zhenfeng was a true Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm, while Han Li was only in the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm. His physical body might be strong, but still not as powerful as a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm.
Hesitating for a moment, Zimiao Zhenfeng said in a low voice, “Come to my chamber tonight.”
She had no intention of discussing cultivation with Han Li; instead, she wanted to improve her realm through dual cultivation, although it wasn’t very effective since her realm was an entire Big Realm higher than Han Li’s.
“What about Ji Mingyue?” Han Li teased.
Zimiao Zhenfeng gave him a white look, discontentedly saying, “Ji Mingyue isn’t yours yet, and you’re already arranging things for her, huh? Is she as sweet as me?”
She knew Han Li was joking—Ji Mingyue’s proud temperament wouldn’t allow her to agree on the first day and even if she did, Han Li would wait for their wedding night to pluck the flower.
Nevertheless, Zimiao Zhenfeng was still annoyed; after all, Han Li brought up another woman in front of her, and that woman was Ji Mingyue.
“Yes, yes, you’re the best, Zhen’er.”
Han Li’s face was filled with smiles as he leaned into Zimiao Zhenfeng’s ear, bit her earlobe, and whispered, “Then tonight, can your husband switch to a different style of discussion?”
Zimiao Zhenfeng bit her lip and asked in a soft voice, “What style?”
“You know me well, Zhen’er. I’m easy to please—from the front, the back, above, or below,” said Han Li with a gleeful laugh.
“Get lost~”
A hint of anger showed on Zimiao Zhenfeng’s face. This lecherous man always had such bad ideas. Couldn’t he take the normal path?
“We’re here, we’re here.”
Han Li interrupted Zimiao Zhenfeng’s indignation and hurriedly spoke, for it’s never easy to appease a woman once she gets angry.
The two had come from Chengsheng Mountain in the Xuan Domain, traveled ten billion li beyond the East Sea in just three or four breaths.
Han Li did not continue forward, for Xi Yue had informed him that Ji Mingyue was just hundreds of billions of li ahead, and she would soon pass by this area.
Elsewhere.
The female Saint Ji Mingyue was on her way to the Qianyuan Divine Province. Her war chariot surged through the void, drawn by two peak Tongxuan Realm azure luan birds, covering the vast, boundless sea. Her speed was neither fast nor slow, maintaining a pace of tens of millions of li per breath.
Ji Mingyue sat in the war chariot, propping her chin with one hand. Her beauty was unparalleled, with phoenix brows and starry eyes, and her body curvaceous in all the right places, like an exiled fairy beyond this world.
She had spent a month in the Luming Divine Province with no findings, so she decided to leave for her next destination, the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Ji Mingyue also paid some attention to Zimiao Zhenfeng, who had long disappeared from the Luming Divine Province and headed for the Qianyuan Divine Province.
This gave Ji Mingyue a sense of urgency, hoping that Zimiao Zhenfeng wouldn’t find the split soul of the Phoenix Moon Empress.
Although the split soul would eventually return to the Phoenix Moon Empress, Ji Mingyue didn’t want to leave an impression of incompetence on her; otherwise, the Phoenix Moon Empress wouldn’t need to owe a favor to the White Emperor.
After all, the Phoenix Moon Empress preferred not to have too much contact with the White Emperor; her heart was set only on the Great Dao.
Despite the sense of urgency in her heart, Ji Mingyue remained unhurried. The Qianyuan Divine Province was vast, and without the proper items to aid her search, how easy could it be for Zimiao Zhenfeng to find the Empress’s split soul?

chapters.title: Chapter 556 - 228: The Unexpected Appearance of Yuan Youwei! Ji Mingyue VS Yuan Youwei! Grand Elder of Great Love Intervenes, Catching All in One Fell Swoop_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 556: Chapter 228: The Unexpected Appearance of Yuan Youwei! Ji Mingyue VS Yuan Youwei! Grand Elder of Great Love Intervenes, Catching All in One Fell Swoop_2
Moreover, it’s not even certain that the Empress Huangyue’s split soul is in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Before long, the peerless beauty clad in azure, Ji Mingyue of the eminent female saints, arrived within three hundred million li of Han Li and Zi Miaozhen.
“Aren’t you going to take action?”
Zi Miaozhen looked up at Han Li in some surprise.
According to the plan Han Li had previously shared with her, now was the time to strike. With just a thought, Han Li could send his Dao body over, just like he did against her, easily suppressing and capturing Ji Mingyue.
“Wait a little longer,” Han Li said, shaking his head slightly.
Zi Miaozhen’s beautiful brows furrowed slightly as she said, “You’re not planning to wait until she comes to us before taking action, are you? That’s not your style.”
She knew that when Han Li had dealt with her before, he had sent out his Dao body while his true body remained at a distance, protected by immortal soldiers, cautious and steady.
Han Li smiled and said, “Zhen’er, you worry too much. The reason I haven’t made a move is because a variable has appeared.”
“A variable?” A flicker of surprise crossed Zi Miaozhen’s eyes.
Han Li nodded, explaining, “Xi Yue told me that ahead of us, there is not just Ji Mingyue. Between us and Ji Mingyue, there’s also a Quasi-Emperor, precisely the one you mentioned from Yuanchu Mountain, Yuan Youwei.”
Just to be cautious, neither Han Li nor Zi Miaozhen had used their Divine Sense to probe, relying instead on a few imperial and immortal soldiers for detection. This was very discreet and unlikely to be discovered.
Han Li was about to take action when Yuan Youwei suddenly appeared in front of Ji Mingyue, causing him to hold back for now. He wanted to see what Yuan Youwei was up to and then seize the opportunity to catch them all in one go, so he wouldn’t have to wait for Yuan Youwei slowly.
Yuan Youwei hailed from Yuanchu Mountain, and Ji Mingyue from the Huangyue Imperial Empire; the two women were naturally at odds. If they started to fight, that would be excellent.
Not only could he enjoy an alluring spectacle, but he could also reap the benefits of a fisherman, capturing both Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue.
Upon hearing this, Zi Miaozhen laughed, “Yuan Youwei is in such a hurry to deliver herself to you.”
“Tsk tsk, she probably doesn’t know that you, the great Casanova, have already been coveting her body for a long time.”
“Pah, what Casanova? I am a gentleman of noble character,” Han Li sternly corrected.
“How about you take your hands off first before saying that?” Zi Miaozhen scoffed coldly.
Unperturbed, Han Li remained indifferent, as though his hands were not involved in any frivolous wandering.
On the other side, Ji Mingyue advanced some distance, her chariot suddenly coming to a halt.
In the saintess Ji Mingyue’s perception, a hundred thousand li ahead stood an incomparably radiant and exquisite figure, smiling at Ji Mingyue with mirth in her eyes.
Ji Mingyue’s delicate brows furrowed as she recognized the person and a look of surprise appeared in her eyes. Why would she come to block my way?
The person before her was none other than the Quasi-Emperor Yuan Youwei from Yuanchu Mountain!
Although Ji Mingyue had been in the area of Qianyuan Divine Province for two to three years, she still was well aware of the situation in the Endless Yuankun Domain and kept abreast of any major events.
For example, Empress Yuanchu followed in Empress Huangyue’s footsteps, causing consecutive furies.
Yuan Youwei was an emissary of Empress Yuanchu, her movements unpredictable as she traveled across the Divine Provinces, her whereabouts not hidden intentionally. They had long been leaked out, and so Ji Mingyue knew of them.
Yuan Youwei was searching for Empress Yuanchu’s split soul while she sought Empress Huangyue’s; as long as they did not interfere with each other, why would Ji Mingyue come to find her?
Could it be that Yuan Youwei had accidentally discovered that Empress Huangyue’s split soul was in Qianyuan Divine Province, and had come to obstruct her path to create interference?
Due to the discord between Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, friction was incessant between the two mighty forces of the Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain, and Yuan Youwei had motive to do so.
If Yuan Youwei succeeded in stopping Ji Mingyue, even if she failed to find Empress Yuanchu’s split soul, it would still be considered a merit.
A multitude of thoughts flashed in an instant, and Ji Mingyue, with a mind full of concerns, stepped out of her Cyan Phoenix Chariot, put away the chariot with a wave of her hand, and walked step by step toward Yuan Youwei, taking on a solemn expression as if she were an exiled immortal.
To Zi Miaozhen who had just broken through to the Saint Abyss Realm, she could be dismissive, but Yuan Youwei had to be taken seriously, for her cultivation was a Big Realm higher.
“Yuan Youwei, what are you trying to do?”
When she arrived within a hundred li, Ji Mingyue stopped and spoke indifferently.
“Retreat!”
Yuan Youwei stood loftily in the ninth heaven, her proud and sleek figure flawlessly perfect. Her purple dress danced in the wind, her charisma breathtakingly stunning.
She had a beauty unrivaled, sublime and peerless, slightly surpassing Ji Mingyue, and at this moment, she was utterly imperious.
Ji Mingyue’s intuition was correct; Yuan Youwei had come to stop her, not wanting her to set foot in Qianyuan Divine Province.
When she left Yuanchu Mountain, Empress Yuanchu, besides bestowing an imperial weapon for the mission, also gave her several hints.
Empress Yuanchu suspected that the disappearance of her split soul was the work of some Great Holy Land School in Qianyuan Divine Province. Those Great Holy Land Schools, with their imperial and immortal weapons, could conceal the divine mysteries and sever her connection.
If it were not for being tied up and uncertain of the target, Empress Yuanchu would have made her move long ago, just like she had once exterminated a Peak Quasi-Emperor who had defied her authority with a single palm strike across endless space.
Yuan Youwei originally suspected Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Penglai Immortal Sect, Myriad Demon Mountain, and other Great Holy Land Schools in Qianyuan Divine Province were responsible, but after investigation, she found there was another suspect.
That was the Mysterious Forces that stirred up stormwind and rain in Qianyuan Divine Province, causing unrest among those Great Holy Land Schools, a force that also possessed a Heaven Imperial Realm level imperial weapon, making all seven Great Holy Land Schools wary.
Due to certain reasons, Yuan Youwei had not approached Qianyuan Divine Province, instead wandering around its surroundings, with another Divine Province lying in between.

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - 228: The Unexpected Appearance of Yuan Youwei! Ji Mingyue VS Yuan Youwei! The Great Elder Ancestor Makes a Move, Capturing Them All in One Go_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 557: Chapter 228: The Unexpected Appearance of Yuan Youwei! Ji Mingyue VS Yuan Youwei! The Great Elder Ancestor Makes a Move, Capturing Them All in One Go_3
Zi Miao Zhen and Ji Mingyue had arrived in Luming Divine Province, and Yuan Youwei knew immediately. She stayed hidden in the shadows, only occasionally showing herself in the far distance before swiftly escaping; neither of the peerless saintesses discovered her presence.
Yuan Youwei watched as Zi Miao Zhen headed to Qianyuan Divine Province, but she didn’t stop her. She wanted Zi Miao Zhen to scout ahead for her, to test the waters of Qianyuan Divine Province and see if it was the doing of some Mysterious Forces.
Zi Miao Zhen was from White Emperor City and didn’t carry a token for seeking, so she would probably start with those Mysterious Forces, which could easily alert them.
If it was the work of Mysterious Forces, she could strike directly, intercept and not only take away Empress Yuanchu’s soul fragment but also the Huangyue Imperial Empire empress’s soul fragment.
If not, then it was very likely the work of major Holy Land Schools like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, or Penglai Immortal Sect, and she would have to plan carefully.
In any event, letting Zi Miao Zhen scout ahead was a win for her.
However, Zi Miao Zhen had been gone for a month without any news, vanishing without a trace. Yuan Youwei did not know if she was still investigating in secret, and even through Tianji Pavilion’s resources, she couldn’t find Zi Miao Zhen’s whereabouts.
But Yuan Youwei wasn’t in a rush. She was very patient and just waited; with her cultivation level, she was definitely going to be the biggest winner.
As for Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei would not allow her to go. That would disrupt her plans.
Ji Mingyue was from the Huangyue Imperial Empire and didn’t get along with Zi Miao Zhen. If she caused a ruckus, it could alert the quarry prematurely, and she might not find out anything.
Moreover, Yuan Youwei did not want Ji Mingyue to find the soul fragment of the empress. She wanted to take Huangyue Imperial Empire empress’s soul fragment herself, which would undoubtedly be a great achievement.
She had cultivated to the second level of Quasi Emperor and had been eager to acquire a weapon of the Heaven Imperial Realm, then use its power to venture into forbidden places to seize great opportunities, increasing her chances of mastering the Heavenly Sovereign Path and becoming an emperor.
If she managed this task well, Empress Yuanchu might even bestow her a Top Grade imperial weapon.
Ji Mingyue also had an imperial weapon with her, and if she found the empress’s soul fragment first, it would be hard for Yuan Youwei to snatch it away; if Yuan Youwei also managed to get Empress Yuanchu’s soul fragment, Yuan Youwei wouldn’t even accomplish her primary objective.
So, no matter what, Ji Mingyue could not go to Qianyuan Divine Province; even if it meant fighting with Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei would stop her.
“Yuan Youwei, who do you think you are? What gives you the right to speak to me like this?”
The saintess Ji Mingyue was not at all intimidated and directly clashed with Yuan Youwei. Their imposing auras churned between heaven and earth, causing tumultuous waves in the surrounding seas.
When Empress Yuan Youwei in the purple dress spoke these words, Ji Mingyue knew there was no peaceful resolution; Yuan Youwei indeed came to block her.
“Because I am stronger than you,” Yuan Youwei stated calmly.
Above her head, an imperial weapon materialized, its dazzling Emperor’s Light illuminating all of heaven and earth as it pressed towards Ji Mingyue.
“Hmph~”
Ji Mingyue snorted coldly, and an imperial weapon also appeared above her head, shooting out strands after strands of Emperor’s Might like a rising sun, rays glittering in thousands, overshadowing the cosmic starry sky.
Both imperial weapons had only awakened a sliver of their power, facing off without the intention to fight.
They were both Top Grade imperial weapons and sensed that they contained two types of laws; their strengths were similar, and it wasn’t worth it to fight seriously over the pride of Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue.
The Artifact Spirits of the two imperial weapons reached a tacit understanding in an instant, letting Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue settle it between themselves.
“Ji Mingyue, without the help of your imperial weapon, do you really think you are my match?”
Yuan Youwei’s overpowering aura surged towards Ji Mingyue. Her face was full of smiles; this was the situation she wanted. Her cultivation was higher, wasn’t it?
Ji Mingyue’s eyebrows knitted tightly, and behind her emerged a colossal Primordial Spirit, thousands of fathoms tall. A Quasi Emperor weapon shone brilliantly, forcefully countering Yuan Youwei’s pressure.
“Wen Yu, are you really not going to make a move?”
Ji Mingyue communicated with the spirit of her imperial weapon, somewhat dissatisfied.
“Mingyue, I can’t make a move, I’m tied down by her.”
“You know, me using all my power wouldn’t make much of a difference, her strength is almost equal to mine.”
The alluring voice of Artifact Spirit Wen Yu also entered Ji Mingyue’s mind.
Ji Mingyue’s face showed unwillingness; without an imperial weapon, and given the significant difference in their cultivations, she truly was no match for Yuan Youwei.
But Ji Mingyue didn’t want to give up like this. If she did, she would have to retreat today. With Yuan Youwei blocking her, it would be difficult to enter Qianyuan Divine Province later on.
On the other hand, Ji Mingyue didn’t want to lose face. Like Yuan Youwei, she was a Heavenly Immortal famed throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain, and even though Yuan Youwei ranked higher, was it only because her cultivation was higher?
“Ji Mingyue, if you don’t retreat, I won’t show mercy,” Yuan Youwei said indifferently, her demeanor cold and ready to act. She, too, wanted to gauge Ji Mingyue’s Combat Ability and suppress her reputation.
“Dream on!”
Ji Mingyue snorted coldly and exploded into action, charging towards Yuan Youwei.
Even if she was defeated, with Wen Yu’s protection, she wouldn’t die. At worst, she could retreat. But if she withdrew without fighting, she would be displeased with herself, and it would be hard to explain to the empress when she returned.
“Bang!”
With a raise of her hand, Yuan Youwei shattered Ji Mingyue’s attack and said calmly, “If that’s the extent of your strength, you’re in for a tough time today.”
“Hmph~”
Ji Mingyue snorted again, her imposing Primordial Spirit returning to her body. She grasped the Quasi Emperor weapon, fully activating it, and charged at Yuan Youwei once more.
With the Quasi Emperor weapon in hand, Ji Mingyue’s combat ability greatly increased, temporarily matching that of a Quasi Emperor. However, this consumed a lot and the weapon’s energy wouldn’t last long.

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - 228: The Unexpected Appearance of Yuan Youwei! Ji Mingyue VS Yuan Youwei! The Great Elder of Love Takes Action, Capturing Them All in One Net_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 558: Chapter 228: The Unexpected Appearance of Yuan Youwei! Ji Mingyue VS Yuan Youwei! The Great Elder of Love Takes Action, Capturing Them All in One Net_4
“Clang~”
Yuan Youwei’s jade hand swept through the air, unleashing strand after strand of radiant light, as if she was creating the world, directly clashing with Ji Mingyue’s Quasi Emperor weapon.
Yuan Youwei took a slight step back, but Ji Mingyue, holding the Quasi Emperor weapon, was sent flying back, a shocked expression surfacing on her stunning face.
“Yuan Youwei, have you mastered that Emperor Level martial art?” Ji Mingyue blurted out.
Yuan Youwei had not made a move for a long time, and her first action now gave such a big shock to Ji Mingyue. She actually stood toe-to-toe with a Quasi Emperor weapon barehanded—was her physical body too strong?
“Indeed.”
A hint of pride appeared on Yuan Youwei’s face. To master this Emperor Level martial art, she had paid a great price and endured much suffering, but it was all worth it.
The martial art she practiced was of the Top-Grade Emperor Level. In the previous years, she finally achieved a minor level of mastery, which made her physical body comparable to a Lower-Grade Emperor weapon.
If she reached the major level of mastery, her physical body would be comparable to a Mid-Grade Emperor weapon, which is to say, a top-notch Quasi Emperor weapon. Once it was perfected, her physical body would be comparable to a Top-Grade Emperor weapon.
At that time, even if she hadn’t achieved the Emperor status through the traditional path, she would still be considered to have succeeded in an alternative way, with a physical body incredibly powerful, capable of rivaling the Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
“Boom!”
Seizing this opportunity, Ji Mingyue made her move, exerting her full strength without any reserves.
“It’s useless, your strength is too weak.”
Yuan Youwei blocked Ji Mingyue’s Quasi Emperor weapon with just one hand, her expression remaining calm as ever.
“Really?”
Ji Mingyue let out a cold laugh as her Heavenly Abyss manifested, pressing down fiercely, heavily suppressing Yuan Youwei.
Yuan Youwei’s figure halted momentarily, but she quickly regained her composure. A hint of surprise appeared on her stunning face as she said, “Ji Mingyue, I didn’t expect you to have learned that Secret Technique from Yuanchu Mountain.”
“The same goes for both of us.”
Ji Mingyue’s Primordial Spirit glowed as she communicated with Yuan Youwei, her figure resembling a bright moon, her pure moonlight illuminating three thousand worlds, continuously bombarding Yuan Youwei.
Yuanchu Mountain has a Secret Technique capable of enhancing the Saints’ Heavenly Abyss. Once mastered, it can make the Heavenly Abyss extremely powerful, possessing a terrifying suppressive force.
Ji Mingyue caught Yuan Youwei off guard by using her Heavenly Abyss to suppress her, significantly weakening Yuan Youwei’s strength.
At this moment, Yuan Youwei’s left hand was supporting Ji Mingyue’s Quasi Emperor weapon, an Emperor Sword, while her own body was also under the suppression of Ji Mingyue’s Heavenly Abyss, causing Ji Mingyue’s back to slightly bend.
Yuan Youwei fought against Ji Mingyue with her right hand, still composed and calm, even with one hand she overwhelmed Ji Mingyue.
“Ji Mingyue, aren’t you going to give up yet?”
“Heh~ Yuan Youwei, I’m not that easily bullied either.”
“Tsk tsk, even if I’m holding the Cold Moon Emperor Sword and bearing the Heavenly Abyss, I can still suppress you with one hand.”
“Are you dreaming?”
The two engaged in fierce battle, exchanging hundreds of moves in an instant, but throughout it all, Yuan Youwei remained unharmed. On the other hand, Ji Mingyue, who was constantly on the offensive, ended up in a sorry state.
“It’s about time for the warm-up to end.”
Yuan Youwei let out a light laugh, preparing to go all out and thoroughly crush Ji Mingyue.
Her cultivation was profound, her strength formidable. Up until now, she hadn’t used a weapon and had only relied on one martial art, but she had kept Ji Mingyue from lifting her head in the fight.
“You!” Ji Mingyue was both ashamed and furious.
She was about to retreat when her face suddenly changed dramatically, and she exploded with all her might in an attempt to escape.
Not just Ji Mingyue, even the usually composed Yuan Youwei’s face underwent a drastic change. Her entire being was in full operation, her Dao unfolding at full strength, sending her Emperor Sword and Heavenly Abyss flying away.
Then, a top-notch Quasi Emperor weapon appeared in her hand, with which she struck at the heavens, trying to break through and escape.
But both Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei failed.
Fear flashed in the eyes of the green-clad Saint Ji Mingyue and the purple-dressed Empress Yuan Youwei as they joined hands. They watched as their Emperor weapons fell from the skies, now dull and lusterless.
Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei’s hearts sank, sensing a significant turn of events that was beyond their expectations.
“Clap clap clap~”
At that moment, a round of applause sounded, and Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei looked up to see Zi Miao Zhen in white standing there, her purple hair dancing wildly.
To the dismay of the green-clad Saint and purple-dressed Empress, Zi Miao Zhen was actually nestled in the arms of a young man. Was this the Zi Miao Zhen they knew?
“Zi Miao Zhen, what are you trying to do?”
“Zi Miao Zhen, who is he?”
Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue asked almost simultaneously, their tone hostile, as Emperor weapons hovered above their heads, recovering from the sudden attack.
Both women had various conjectures in their minds, but now was not the time for guessing. They realized they were enveloped by an Emperor Formation, and numerous Emperor weapons had isolated this place, making it impossible for them to escape.
The two Emperor weapons also informed them of the situation. When they learned of the presence of multiple Supreme Grade Emperor weapons, their hearts turned cold.
The other party had come prepared, deploying so many Supreme Grade Emperor weapons; they were also trapped within the Emperor Formation, utterly outmatched.
The key issue was that they couldn’t guess the identity of their opponent, despite such a grand display. Could it be that White Emperor City had made its move?
“You’ll find out soon,” Zi Miao Zhen said lightly, a smile on her flawless face.
“You’ve been fighting for so long, you must be tired. How about coming to Chengsheng Mountain for tea? Then we can have another battle after that. If you don’t mind, I can join in,” Han Li said with a smile, looking at the green-clad Saint Ji Mingyue and purple-dressed Empress Yuan Youwei.
This time, he didn’t use his Dao body but came in person. The Human Path Sword hung at his waist, with Xi Yue constantly protecting him.
“Presumptuous!”
“You’re courting death!”
Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue were furious upon hearing his words. This man dared to flirt with them.
He even wanted to have a threesome with them, seriously provoking Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei, touching their bottom line.
“Do you know what you’re doing?” Ji Mingyue said coldly.
Yuan Youwei’s expression was also icy, “Zi Miao Zhen, he might not know, but don’t you? Is this provoking Yuanchu Mountain and Huangyue Imperial Empire?”
“Do you think you can still leave?” Zi Miao Zhen said indifferently.
Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue’s pupils shrank suddenly.

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - 229 Thunderous Suppression of Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei! Choosing a Husband to Marry! Both Women are Stunned and Numb_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 559: Chapter 229 Thunderous Suppression of Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei! Choosing a Husband to Marry! Both Women are Stunned and Numb_1
“Don’t bother wasting your effort.”
Han Li watched the woman in green, Fairy Ji Mingyue, and the woman in purple robes, Empress Yuan Youwei, and spoke indifferently.
The expressions of Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei changed slightly. Had Han Li noticed their little actions?
Just now, the two women had simultaneously used a secret technique in an attempt to transmit a message to the outside world, and they had also made the two legendary weapons do the same thing.
As long as the news of their encirclement got out, they wouldn’t be the unlucky ones today but rather Zimei Zhen and this mysterious man wearing yellow. Neither the wrath of Huangyue Imperial Empire nor Yuanchu Mountain was something anyone could withstand easily.
Even if the man allied with Zimei Zhen had several supreme grade legendary weapons, he would be easily crushed in front of the two most powerful forces.
In the Endless Yuankun Domain, the nine most powerful forces each had double-digit Heaven Imperial Realm legendary weapons, several Heavenly Immortal weapons, and even some True Immortal weapons.
Besides, these nine strongest forces also had a supreme existence at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, as well as two to three ordinary Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, not to mention the numerous Quasi Emperors and Saints under their command.
If their message got out successfully, the Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain behind them would react swiftly. Even if the supreme existence didn’t come, any Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor with an immortal weapon would suppress everyone present just by arriving.
“Zimei Zhen, do you know the consequences of what you’re doing?”
Clad in fluttering green, Ji Mingyue’s incomparable elegance was shown on her flawless and radiant face, which was now full of anger.
Zimei Zhen actually colluded with someone else to target her and Yuan Youwei. Could it be just for the soul fragment of Empress Huangyue?
This was too much. Even the White Emperor would not tolerate it. When it was time for Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu to settle the score, Zimei Zhen would be doomed.
“This is for your own good,” said Zimei Zhen, her gaze shifting back and forth between Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei before letting out a long sigh.
Han Li now subduing and capturing Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei would mean everything was settled quietly to everyone’s satisfaction. But if it caused a stir in the future and angered Han Li, Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei would be captured just the same, except the treatment they’d receive would be vastly different.
Zimei Zhen naturally knew how splendid Chengsheng Mountain was, much better than where she was in White Emperor City. She wasn’t worried that Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei’s arrival would encroach on her cultivation resources and status. Han Li was known for being quite fair in his dealings.
By helping Han Li take down Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei, she would perform a great service and naturally be placed above Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue.
“For our good?”
Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei nearly laughed in anger. Zimei Zhen’s words sounded righteous yet shameless.
Zimei Zhen and this mysterious man from Tongxuan Realm ambushed them together, wanting to capture them in one fell swoop. Based on the man’s earlier words, he was definitely a lecher. He was coveting their bodies.
How utterly vile!
Moreover, Zimei Zhen had actually submitted herself to a cultivator who was merely at the first level of Tongxuan Realm. As fellow Heavenly Immortals on the Heavenly Immortal List, they considered Zimei Zhen’s actions shameful, which could lower their own stature.
“Zimei Zhen, your side retreats now, and I’ll pretend this never happened,” said Yuan Youwei with a tightly furrowed brow, a cold and incomparably beautiful visage.
“Hehe, Sister Youwei, you’re a prisoner now and have no right to order me around,” Zimei Zhen suddenly laughed, her beauty shining brightly enough to overshadow all things.
“Does the White Emperor know what you are doing?”
Yuan Youwei’s expression grew colder, her aura surged, filled with shame and anger as she exclaimed, “Or should I say, you’ve betrayed the White Emperor?!”
She knew that Zimei Zhen’s actions were not instructed by the White Emperor. The White Emperor would never allow Zimei Zhen to do such a thing, as it would infuriate Empresses Huangyue and Yuanchu, spoiling the White Emperor’s plans and causing more loss than gain.
The alternative was that Zimei Zhen was acting on her own. But Zimei Zhen couldn’t possess so many supreme grade legendary weapons nor the Emperor Formation Array Diagrams, which likely meant she had betrayed the White Emperor and then sold their information to this lecherous man.
Otherwise, even with a rich background, the lecherous man wouldn’t possibly have known that they would pass by this location well in advance and have set an ambush since they were also covered by legendary weapons.
“So that’s it!”
“Zimei Zhen, you’re truly bold.”
A look of realization dawned on Ji Mingyue’s face, as if she suddenly understood the whole situation.
This mysterious man was deeply rooted, owning multiple supreme grade legendary weapons, including some that could isolate space and time and conceal the workings of fate. It was very likely that he was the one who had done something amiss and violated the soul fragments of Empresses Huangyue and Yuanchu.
Given that this man was only at the first level of the Tongxuan Realm yet dared to desecrate a woman saint from the Sacred Abyss Realm and an empress from the domain of a Quasi Emperor, it was obvious that he was audaciously lecherous.
The soul fragments of the two legendary women were not of high cultivation level, and if they encountered this man who sensed their secrets, they were likely to fall into his evil hands, and he had the power to prevent the legendary empresses from discovering it for a time.
The lecherous man was probably the master of the Mysterious Forces causing chaos in Qianyuan Divine Province. Everything fit, and it made sense that with his resources, places like Bai Yujing, Penglai Immortal Sect, and Myriad Demon Mountain, as well as other great Holy Land Schools, would fail to notice.
Zimei Zhen had gone to Qianyuan Divine Province a month in advance, apparently to investigate these Mysterious Forces. It was likely she inadvertently alerted this person and fell into his hands.
Given this lecherous man’s nature, perhaps Zimei Zhen had already been deflowered, no longer the ice-pure and widely revered Heavenly Immortal she once was in the vast Endless Yuankun Domain.
Zimei Zhen, in possession of their information, knew they were going to Qianyuan Divine Province to investigate the disappearance of the soul fragments of Empresses Huangyue and Yuanchu. It wasn’t surprising that she reported to this man.

chapters.title: Chapter 560 - 229 Thunderous Suppression of Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei! Choosing a Husband to Marry! Both Women are Stunned and Numb_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 560: Chapter 229 Thunderous Suppression of Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei! Choosing a Husband to Marry! Both Women are Stunned and Numb_2
Zi Miao truly betrayed White Emperor City and the White Emperor, thus prioritizing her own interests. Their investigation would offend Zi Miao’s interests, and it would be odd if Zi Miao didn’t target them.
Only by suppressing her and Yuan Youwei in advance could the shocking deeds of this audacious, lascivious scoundrel remain concealed, preventing them from being blasted by the two peerless Empresses.
She harbored enmity towards Zi Miao, as they couldn’t stand each other, and she and Yuan Youwei were both peerless beauties, absolute Fairy Heavenly Immortals. Handing her and Yuan Youwei over to this man would certainly be a great service.
Ji Mingyue’s Primordial Spirit light fluctuated, instantly clarifying all cause and effect, restoring the true nature of the events.
Yet Ji Mingyue was curious as to what was so appealing about this man that he could make Zi Miao leave White Emperor City behind, leave the White Emperor behind.
After all, White Emperor City is one of the nine mightiest forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, its might shaking the Eight Hundred Divine Regions. The White Emperor is also one of the nine supreme beings, sweeping invincibly across heaven and earth, unmatched under the nine skies and ten lands.
This man was but a mighty being from the Tongxuan Realm. Even if he had owned many Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons, compared to White Emperor City and the White Emperor, there was still a wide difference.
With such actions, Zi Miao risked irrevocable doom, as the Huangyue Imperial Empress and Empress Yuanchu would not let her off, nor would the White Emperor.
Not just Ji Mingyue, but Yuan Youwei too came to a sudden realization. A flash of brilliance passed through her beautiful eyes as she sized up Zi Miao and Han Li, her heart filled with curiosity about the reasons behind Zi Miao’s betrayal of the White Emperor.
Just as Zi Miao was about to speak, Han Li stretched out his hand to stop her. Looking over at Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue, he said to the two exceptional beauties,
“What betrayal? As the saying goes, ‘A good bird chooses a tree to nest in, a good minister chooses a master to serve…'”
“Zi’er has simply chosen a king to marry, that’s all.”
“Ha ha!”
Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue scoffed in unison. Do you believe such words?
The two peerless Fairy Heavenly Immortals glanced at Zi Miao and noticed a flicker of complex emotion in her eyes, which sent a thrill through their hearts.
Perhaps Zi Miao was also coerced by this audacious, lascivious scoundrel and had her own unspeakable hardships.
Otherwise, having never met this man without any emotional foundation, how could Zi Miao consent to marry him and become his Dao companion?
Ji Mingyue took a deep breath, looked towards Han Li, and inquired, “How shall I address you?”
“Han Li, though I’d prefer it if you called me ‘husband,'” Han Li replied with a chuckle.
Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue’s expressions turned frosty, ignoring the latter part of his words. Han Li’s attitude only made them more certain of their suspicions.
In a grave tone, Yuan Youwei said, “There’s no room for discussion anymore?”
She had a bright future ahead, aspiring to become the twelfth Heavenly Sovereign Empress of the Endless Yuankun Domain. Still young and steering the Heavenly Sovereign Path, her chances of attaining Empress status were high.
Once she became a Heavenly Sovereign Empress, even if she didn’t strike out on her own, her status in Yuanchu Mountain and the Endless Yuankun Domain would skyrocket.
Hence, Yuan Youwei did not wish to be captured by Han Li, especially since he lusted after her body, which was something she found utterly intolerable.
Ji Mingyue shared the same sentiment. Her beautiful eyes were fixed on Han Li, holding a glimmer of expectation that soon shattered,
“As long as you’re willing to become my Dao companions, everything is up for discussion,” Han Li said, his handsome and poised face still carrying a smile.
“Don’t even think about it!”
Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue simultaneously snorted coldly, refusing to consider his condition.
“You have already offended White Emperor City. If you also offend the Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain, you’ll find no refuge in the Endless Yuankun Domain. The Eight Hundred Divine Provinces may be vast, but even there, you won’t escape death.”
Ji Mingyue clenched her jade hands into fists, holding back her anger as she spoke.
Beneath another’s roof, one has no choice but to bow their head.
She was left with no choice, otherwise, Ji Mingyue would have long since slapped to death a mere Tongxuan Realm powerhouse who dared covet her body, not caring about his origins.
No matter how significant his background was, would he dare trouble her in the Huangyue Imperial Empire?
“You underestimate Han Li, belittle the foundation he has,” Zi Miao thought to herself silently, without speaking.
In the end, Ji Mingyue, the lady in green, and Yuan Youwei, the lady in purple, would repeat history and walk the same path she had.
Seeing the outcome for Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue, she felt a surge of satisfaction; she had been wounded in the back by Han Li, blood flowing freely. So she wanted to drag Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue down with her, to have Han Li stab them from behind too.
Han Li indicated, “Stabbing from the front works as well.”
“Are you done speaking?”
Han Li listened quietly until Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei finished speaking, then said slowly, “Once you’re done, come back to Chengsheng Mountain with me.”
Boom!
Before Han Li’s words even settled, Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue suddenly erupted into action, attacking simultaneously, giving it their all, not holding back in the slightest as if to drain every last drop of their mana.
Not just them, the two Top Grade Emperor Weapons above their heads also unleashed their power, instantly reviving fully and displaying their ultimate strength, as if two Heavenly Sovereign Realm Great Emperors descended to the world.
Of course, they weren’t real Heavenly Sovereign Realm Great Emperors. The two Top Grade Emperor Weapons weren’t anything special, still much inferior to the strength of ordinary Heavenly Sovereign Realm Great Emperors.
“A futile struggle.”
With one arm around Zi Miao, the peerless beauty, Han Li remained unperturbed and motionless, his composure undisturbed as he stated unhurriedly.
Xi Yue had not even activated the Dao Decapitating Sword; Zi Yi, JianJi, and Shi Qi revived directly into their true forms, causing the Void Bell, Sky Tower, Emperor Flag, Dao Decapitating Sword, and many other Heavenly Sovereign Realm Emperor Weapons to burst forth with terrifying might.

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - 229 Thunderous Suppression of Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei! Choosing a Husband to Marry! Both Women are Stunned and Numb_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 561: Chapter 229 Thunderous Suppression of Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei! Choosing a Husband to Marry! Both Women are Stunned and Numb_3
Brilliant flashes of Emperor’s Light descended, not only annihilating the offensive from Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, and their two Top Grade imperial weapons but also suppressing them all.
Facing six Heaven Imperial Realm imperial weapons, among which were four Supreme Grade top-notch imperial weapons, Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei, even each with a Top Grade imperial weapon, were far from being a match.
Han Li and Zimiao Zhen simply watched quietly as a beam of immortal light flitted before them; all the residual effects of the attacks automatically dissipated, unable to harm them in the slightest, let alone disturb their composure.
“This is Han Li’s foundation,” Zimiao Zhen murmured to herself, her heart also filled with amazement.
Last time, when Han Li captured her with suppression, he hadn’t used Immortal weapons. It was only afterward that he ordered the Dao Decapitating Sword to slice through time and space, cutting off all karmic traces so they couldn’t be traced back.
This time was the same; merely a few imperial weapons were enough to easily suppress both Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, and their Top Grade imperial weapons.
Zimiao Zhen had some understanding of Chengsheng Mountain’s foundation; she knew that Han Li had created a blessed land capable of attracting Immortal Qi not so long ago. Although it was very little and not much useful for Immortal weapons.
But it was barely enough to replenish the energy for Supreme Grade imperial weapons like the Emperor Flag, Dao Decapitating Sword, Time-Sky Tower, and Void Bell.
Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei’s counterattacks were shattered by Han Li as easily as dry weeds and rotten wood, also incidentally suppressing a peerless female saint, a peerless empress, and two Top Grade imperial weapons.
“My child, the matter is settled; we should head back,” he said.
In front of Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue, Han Li gently kissed Zimiao Zhen’s pearly white forehead with a smile.
Zimiao Zhen’s delicate body trembled slightly, and she shot him a glance. Did he really have to be affectionate with her in front of Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue, two Heavenly Fairies?
But Zimiao Zhen still obediently nodded.
Han Li waved his hand, and the Emperor Formation Array Diagrams swept up Yuan Youwei, Ji Mingyue, and the two Top Grade imperial weapons before returning to his hand.
When the Immortal Sky Concealing Formation disappeared, Han Li and Zimiao Zhen appeared above the vast seas, calm and tranquil, as if nothing had happened.
Although a great war had erupted within the Emperor Formation, one that could be said to be on the Heaven Imperial Realm level, it was concealed by the Immortal Sky Concealing Formation and isolated by the Time-Sky Tower, Void Bell, and Emperor Flag; not the slightest disturbance reached the outside world.
“Xi Yue,” called Han Li softly, and in the next moment, the Dao Decapitating Sword at his waist unsheathed an inch, a brilliant sword light slashing out, annihilating time and space, cutting away karma, leaving no trace behind.
Only then did Han Li nod in satisfaction and, taking his gaze back, he held Zimiao Zhen’s slender, soft waist that was barely a handful and vanished from the boundless vastness above the sea.
Zimiao Zhen did not resist at all, acting exceptionally gentle and well-behaved.
Although she had not yet called Han Li “husband,” the two had agreed that when Han Li’s cultivation surpassed hers, she would willingly become one of his Dao companions and sweetly call him ‘husband.’
Now, even though Zimiao Zhen was one of Han Li’s Dao companions, both were aware that circumstances had forced them together; Zimiao Zhen was still somewhat unwilling in her heart, still holding some resentment.
Not long after, Han Li and Zimiao Zhen returned to Chengsheng Mountain, standing atop Chengdao Peak.
Han Li was in no hurry to release Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue, choosing instead to cultivate affection through intimate and tender moments with Zimiao Zhen atop the peak.
“Aren’t you going to release them? Should I step aside?” Zimiao Zhen said with a playful smile.
She knew what Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue were about to endure, having gone through it herself once.
“No rush,” replied Han Li, shaking his head slightly and continuing his intimacy with Zimiao Zhen, whispering sweet nothings.
Zimiao Zhen glared at him, knowing that Han Li was just sweet-talking her, but she was a sucker for it and felt very happy inside, even though she didn’t show it on her face.
“All right, let’s release Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue,” Zimiao Zhen urged with a flushed face.
Her neck and everything above had turned a faint shade of pink; she knew if this continued, Han Li would take it a step further and be ready to pierce her with that ‘thing.’
“Okay then,” Han Li said with a hint of reluctance, but he didn’t push further, deciding it was best to attend to more serious matters first.
He wasn’t in a rush to release Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue, as the intimacy with Zimiao Zhen was merely a side activity. His main intention was to temper the dispositions of the two extraordinary Heavenly Maidens.
If he had captured only one, like what he did with Zimiao Zhen, threats and incentives could have quickly worked.
But with both Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue captured and taken back to Chengsheng Mountain simultaneously, these two women were likely to be a tough challenge.
Han Li could tell, and Zimiao Zhen had told him, that Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue were both exceedingly proud Heavenly Maidens who valued their bodies highly, had grand ambitions, and their own standards for future Dao companions—standards that were exceptionally high.
Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue were both the kind who cared about face, and even if they were moved by Han Li’s threats and incentives and wanted to agree, they couldn’t say so in front of the other Heavenly Maiden.
Therefore, Han Li decided to take a long-term approach, not in a hurry—which was just as well, since Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue were already in his grasp; what was there to worry about devouring them?
Han Li was known as a grand ancestor of love, adept at these matters; even if Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei were a female saint and a Quasi Emperor respectively, they would surely not escape from the clutches of his Devil’s Palm.
With a thought from Han Li, the Emperor Formation Array Diagrams lit up, and two divine lights descended onto Chengdao Peak, revealing the peerless figures of Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue; both women were Heavenly Maidens of exceptional beauty and grace, like fallen fairies.

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - 229 Thunderous Suppression of Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei! Choosing a Husband to Marry! Both Women are Stunned and Numb_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 562: Chapter 229 Thunderous Suppression of Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei! Choosing a Husband to Marry! Both Women are Stunned and Numb_4
In their hands, they each held a Top Grade Imperial Weapon, yet the might of these two Top Grade Imperial Weapons was sealed, unable to release even a trace of their power.
After Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue came out, they exchanged glances and looked at Zi Miao Zhen and Han Li in front of them, both remaining silent.
“Let’s have some tea.”
With a wave of his hand, Han Li produced a set of exquisite tea equipment, accompanied by four tea stools, all of which were Heaven Rank Artifacts carefully crafted by himself.
Han Li and Zi Miao Zhen sat down, and after a moment’s thought, Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue also sat down, facing the two of them.
“This is a divine tea that I cultivated myself. Although it’s only Lower Grade Divine Rank, it’s one of my favorites, named Lingjun Tea.”
“I usually can’t bear to invite ordinary people to drink it, but today, I will have you two taste it.”
Han Li, holding the tea set, brewed the tea with a smile on his face that never faded, as he patiently introduced it to Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue.
Lower Grade Divine Rank corresponds to the Tongxuan Realm. To cultivate the Lingjun Tea to this grade, Han Li had put in a great deal of effort.
As for why it was named Lingjun Tea, it was merely to commemorate the place Lingjun City, which could be considered his hometown.
When the Lingjun Tea was ready, Ji Mingyue was the first to take a small sip. A warm current circulated through her body several times, slightly enhancing her cultivation level. A touch of surprise flickered in her eyes as she said, “Not bad.”
Although she spoke only two words, Ji Mingyue did not show any disrespect. The Lingjun Tea might only be Lower Grade Divine Rank, but its taste and charm were not much different from the Top Grade Divine Teas she had tasted before.
Yuan Youwei also picked up the teacup in front of her, covered her jade-like hand lightly and took a small sip. A warm current also formed within her body, but it had an insignificant effect on her cultivation since she was already a Quasi Emperor, and Lower Grade Divine Teas were of little use to her.
“Quite good.”
After a moment of thought, Yuan Youwei offered her evaluation.
Having received appraisals from Ji Mingyue, the lady in cyan, and Yuan Youwei, the lady in purple, a look of pride flitted across Han Li’s eyes. Zi Miao Zhen had also tasted it before and had found it agreeable.
Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue placed their teacups down and quietly watched Han Li, neither saying a word. Zi Miao Zhen behaved the same, sipping her own tea and showing no intention to speak.
She wanted to witness Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue’s subdued demeanor and enjoy the process, as well as discern how Han Li would manage to win over Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei.
However, contrary to expectations, Han Li did not even bring up these matters, as if his previously displayed lecherous tendencies were mere pretense, portraying himself as a paragon of virtue.
With two peerlessly beautiful women sitting opposite him, Han Li was quite the conversationalist, here discussing the world, recounting interesting tales of the Endless Yuankun Domain, revealing various secrets, and speaking fluently without end.
Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue appeared quite indifferent, only speaking a few words on matters of particular interest to them; otherwise, they would not utter an extra word.
For several consecutive days, Han Li did not mention any serious matters but spent time with Zi Miao Zhen, Yuan Youwei, and Ji Mingyue enjoying the mountains and waters and admiring the landscape.
Han Li’s wives and concubines residing on Chengdao Peak were all aware that Chengsheng Mountain had welcomed two peerless beauties, both with saintly and elegant demeanors, clear and exceptionally beautiful, no less impressive than the saintly woman Zi Miao Zhen.
It seemed as if their lord had captured them himself.
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang, and the other wives and concubines watched silently, gathering some information through Zi Miao Zhen and learning that Ji Mingyue was a saintly woman and Yuan Youwei a Quasi Emperor.
They too were curious to see how their lord Han Li would manage to win over Yuan Youwei and Ji Mingyue, for with the temperaments of such stunning women, their lord might find the task rather challenging.
Otherwise, he would not have deviated from his usual approach of threat and temptation.
On Yangdao Peak, Han Li showed the Life-Prolonging Furnace to Zi Miao Zhen, Ji Mingyue, and Yuan Youwei. They then visited Yandao Peak to see the Combat Tower, and on Enlightenment Peak, they saw the Time-Sky Tower…
Han Li enthusiastically introduced the beauties of Chengsheng Mountain to Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei, incidentally explaining the mountain’s profound heritage and benefits.
Though he said nothing, Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei felt an increasing heaviness in their hearts, their thoughts of escaping growing fainter.
Despite their disdain for Han Li, a man prone to lust, they had to admit the daunting depth of Chengsheng Mountain’s heritage, where various relics assisting in cultivation were extraordinarily potent.
Even though one came from the Huangyue Imperial Empire and the other from Yuanchu Mountain, both dominant forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain, they were astounded by the heritage of Chengsheng Mountain.
Yuanchu Mountain and Huangyue Imperial Empire naturally also possessed many treasures that aided cultivation, with different focal points, some even surpassing those of Chengsheng Mountain, but most were inferior.
Moreover, they learned from Zi Miao Zhen a very crucial piece of information: Han Li possessed an Immortal Sword, one that rivaled a True Immortal Sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 563: Chapter 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_1
Half a month later, Han Li decided to let Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei calm down and gave them one day to think things over.
When the time came, Han Li would go to them to discuss life’s ideals, and if they still didn’t understand the situation, if they didn’t obediently comply, the old ancestor Han was ready to use force.
He didn’t have too much patience, and the only reason he gave Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei so much time was out of respect for their statuses as the female saint of the Sacred Abyss Realm and the female emperor of the Quasi Emperor Realm. When his patience ran out, he would let both women know the consequences of defying him.
Chengdao Peak, Cloud View Terrace.
Ji Mingyue stood with her green clothes billowing, her figure graceful and striking, her face breathtakingly beautiful, her demeanor exceptional and refined;
Beside her, in a purple dress, was Yuan Youwei, with a slender and curvaceous figure, beautiful lines, like an exiled immortal descending onto the dusty world.
At the moment, Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei were quietly watching the waves of clouds. Neither spoke, yet the atmosphere was quite heavy.
“Sigh~”
With a long sigh, Ji Mingyue turned to Yuan Youwei, her lips tightly pressed together, and after a long while she finally asked, “What are you planning to do?”
Ji Mingyue’s mind was in turmoil, feeling at a loss for the first time, even though she had some composure when she was previously suppressed by Han Li, because she had deep confidence in her heart, from the Huangyue Imperial Empire.
But in the past half month, as she followed Han Li and Zimiao Zhen around Chengsheng Mountain, and seeing its various foundations, Ji Mingyue’s confidence was shattered step by step.
To this day, there was no longer any confidence in her heart, only shock, panic, despair, regret…
In many aspects, Chengsheng Mountain still fell far short when compared to the Huangyue Imperial Empire, but in the most critical aspect of immortal soldiers, it was no less impressive. In Han Li’s hands, it was extremely difficult for the Empress of Huangyue to rescue her.
The Empress of Huangyue couldn’t find Chengsheng Mountain in a short time, and even if she did, she couldn’t easily destroy it.
Giving time to Han Li, giving time to Chengsheng Mountain, the future of the Endless Yuankun Domain will see the rise of another Supreme Being, another powerful force.
Ji Mingyue finally understood why her nemesis Zimiao Zhen would succumb and agree to become Han Li’s Dao companion.
Although Han Li had not said it outright, both Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei knew what Han Li was thinking, wanting both women to become his Dao companions.
Han Li’s actions over these days were an attempt to achieve submission without a fight.
In fact, it indeed had a significant effect; at least Ji Mingyue’s once firm conviction was shaken.
“Ji Mingyue, you are wavering,” Yuan Youwei said indifferently.
“Han Li is just a little cultivator at the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm, and you are a female saint of the fourth layer of the Sacred Abyss Realm. You wouldn’t consider yielding to him, would you? Ridiculous!”
Yuan Youwei stared directly into Ji Mingyue’s beautiful eyes, making Ji Mingyue avert her gaze, yet she did have such thoughts.
“Ji Mingyue, I advise you to think carefully. Han Li is not worthy of you,” Yuan Youwei continued.
“Whether Han Li is a reincarnated Immortal or has risen abruptly by obtaining Immortal treasure, with his current strong foundations, but you must understand, he is after all only at the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm.”
“With Zimiao Zhen, you, and myself all going missing at the same time in Qianyuan Divine Province, it will definitely cause a tremendous uproar. Han Li won’t be able to hide it, and when Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and White Emperor City all direct their spears at him, what will Han Li have to resist with?”
Yuan Youwei turned away, gazing at the vast expanse of cloud waves, her long, fair hands clasped behind her, and softly said,
“I admit Han Li’s foundation is beyond my expectations, but it’s just that. In front of the three greatest forces, it’s still not enough. Even the most powerful Mantra Sword can’t withstand the attacks of three True Immortal weapons, not to mention that the three greatest forces have more than ten Heavenly Immortal weapons.”
“And don’t forget, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain in Qianyuan Divine Province is also a force that everyone wants to attack. It may look good on the surface, but once exposed, Great Holy Land Schools such as Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Penglai Immortal Sect will also join in the attack, and Chengsheng Mountain won’t be able to withstand it.”
“If you marry Han Li as a Dao companion, you would be betraying the Huangyue Imperial Empire, abandoning the Empress of Huangyue, and becoming of the same ilk as Zimiao Zhen. When Chengsheng Mountain falls, you both will suffer retribution.”
“Even if you are lucky enough to survive, you will face severe punishment, your future prospects completely ruined. For Han Li, for a fleeting moment of survival, do you really think it’s worth it?”
After Yuan Youwei finished speaking, she no longer paid attention to Ji Mingyue and continued to enjoy the scenery, appearing as if her Dao heart was calm and unaffected by the current predicament.
But in reality, Yuan Youwei also had her considerations, just that after weighing the pros and cons, she decided against them. Compared to Chengsheng Mountain and Han Li, she trusted Yuanchu Mountain and Empress Yuanchu more.
Han Li’s cultivation was too low, even if his potential was boundless and his future prospects limitless, he had yet to grow strong and would be easily crushed by the three Supreme Beings.
Whether it was Zimiao Zhen, Ji Mingyue, or herself, they all had connections with the strongest forces behind them. If the connection was interrupted for too long, it would draw the probe of the strongest forces.
By then, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain would have nowhere to hide, falling into the dire situation described by Yuan Youwei, and she certainly didn’t want to perish alongside Han Li.
She was a Quasi Emperor with a bright future ahead of her. She still aspired to ascend to the Heaven Imperial Realm, to master the Heavenly Sovereign Path, to achieve eminence as an emperor, to become one of the supreme rulers of the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Talking so much to Ji Mingyue was not because Yuan Youwei was kind-hearted or had any relationship with Ji Mingyue; Yuan Youwei just wanted to involve Ji Mingyue together, to at least buy some more time, to make Han Li wary and indecisive.

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 564: Chapter 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_2
Yuan Youwei felt a sense of smugness in her heart. As long as she could pull Ji Mingyue onto her side, based on Han Li’s behavior over the past half month, he was unlikely to act against either of them easily, which would allow them to maintain their Primordial Yin Bodies. If she were alone, she would be isolated and vulnerable, which didn’t seem very safe.
Unfortunately, Yuan Youwei was mistaken; she didn’t understand Han Li at all. Most of his behavior during these days was a façade, and her actions would only exhaust his last bit of patience, ultimately causing more harm than good.
But Yuan Youwei didn’t know this.
Every word Yuan Youwei spoke was like a hammer, striking hard against Ji Mingyue’s resolve and turning her face pale with uncertainty.
Seeing Yuan Youwei’s cold and peerlessly graceful silhouette, Ji Mingyue’s delicate lips were tightly pursed, and she remained silent, her heart torn in an internal struggle.
Taking a deep breath, Ji Mingyue spoke again, her voice heavy with inquiry, “Yuan Youwei, what if Han Li isn’t as you expect?”
“What you’re doing is bound to enrage Han Li. When that happens, we’ll meet a terrible end. Do you really think we can last until something happens at Chengsheng Mountain?”
Ji Mingyue understood exactly what Yuan Youwei was thinking, but she dared not agree. Yuan Youwei’s approach was too risky.
Yuan Youwei seemed to have forgotten that Han Li was a daring man. If he had the audacity to defile the divided souls of the Empress Yuanchu and the Empress of the Huangyue Imperial Empire, how could they possibly escape the Devil’s Palm of Han Li?
Ji Mingyue didn’t believe that Han Li was a gentleman; his demeanor these past days had merely been an act.
If Han Li imposed himself on them, they would still be forced to lose themselves to him and fall into his hands. To think that they could still preserve their virtue was as unrealistic as daydreaming.
Based on what Han Li had implied over the past half month, there was a difference in the outcome between submitting willingly or being coerced.
Agreeing to marry Han Li willingly, with their status, cultivation, and beauty, they would be his Cultivator partners with esteemed standing on Chengsheng Mountain; if forced, it was questionable whether they could become his partners at all.
The term “Cultivator partner” signified one’s status on Chengsheng Mountain and entitled one to cultivation resources and privileges.
The reason why Ji Mingyue was wavering and no longer insisted on her own opinion was that she saw the truth of the matter. After all, she was only at the mid-stage of the Heavenly Immortal realm, and in terms of combat ability, Han Li was not much weaker than her. Becoming Han Li’s partner wouldn’t be disgraceful.
Otherwise, if they were forced and lost their honor, their circumstances would be miserable. By the time White Emperor City, Yuanchu Mountain, and the Huangyue Imperial Empire came to their rescue, they would have lost everything.
They would not only have lost their virtue by then, but they might also be stripped of their cultivation or even killed outright. Even if Chengsheng Mountain were destroyed, it would be of no use to Ji Mingyue, making it utterly worthless.
“Dare he?” Yuan Youwei said lightly, seemingly confident.
She was a Quasi Emperor, a future Empress of the Heaven Imperial Realm. To be forced to marry a mere first-level Cultivator of the Tongxuan Realm would be too humiliating. Yuan Youwei’s pride wouldn’t allow it.
If Han Li only had her as a partner, or just her, Zimiao Zhen, and Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei could reluctantly agree. But Han Li had too many wives and concubines, which she couldn’t accept.
Yuan Youwei was certain that Han Li wouldn’t dare kill her, for it would immediately reveal what was occurring on Chengsheng Mountain, and Han Li was far from a match for Empress Yuanchu.
She believed that if she used some strategies, she could ensure that Han Li wouldn’t dare act against her forcefully, preventing her from being forced to lose her virtue.
Ji Mingyue opened her mouth to speak, hesitant, wanting to say that Han Li might really dare, but ultimately she remained silent.
What Yuan Youwei was willing to accept didn’t necessarily align with Ji Mingyue’s wishes.
“Ji Mingyue, think carefully about it. Don’t make any foolish decisions,” Yuan Youwei turned, looked at the conflicted Ji Mingyue, lightly caressed her stunning face with her hand, and left.
Silently watching Yuan Youwei leave, Ji Mingyue glanced at the sea of clouds before departing back to her own quarters, wanting some peace and quiet.
Chengdao Peak, Qiandao Hall.
Han Li was discussing the Dao with Zimiao Zhen, exploring the great avenues of life and researching the lesser paths among the trees. For a time, it was like flowers cascading from the sky and golden lotuses springing from the ground, with a ceaseless harmony of divine music.
Han Li also devoted some of his divine sense to monitor Cloud View Terrace, listening clearly to the conversation between Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei. He made no comment, saving his thoughts for another day.
Withdrawing his Divine Sense, Han Li then wrapped his arms tightly around the beautiful Zimiao Zhen, fully engrossed.
In an instant, Zimiao Zhen’s eyes glazed over, seductive and affectionate beneath her dancing purple hair.
At some point, the Supreme Grade glazed jade mirror lifted to show a human figure.
…..
The next day, Han Li arrived alone at Cloud View Terrace, with Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei arriving punctually as well.
Han Li’s hands rested on the balustrade, gazing into the distance at the sunrise, waiting for the first ray of sunlight to break through the perpetual night, inhaling the morning glow and purple mist as it entered his mouth.
Only then did Han Li turn around to look over Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei.
Ji Mingyue had removed her veil, revealing her exquisite beauty to Han Li, a gesture that seemed to indicate her stance.
Yuan Youwei, still veiled, remained aloof, her face stern as if Han Li owed her ten Heavenly Immortal Weapons. Her arms were crossed over her chest in an attempt to look down on Han Li.
“Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, have you two made your decision?” Han Li asked with a smile on his lips.
Yuan Youwei looked towards Ji Mingyue, subtly shaking her head, but Ji Mingyue ignored Yuan Youwei’s hint and said indifferently, “I am willing to be your Cultivator partner.”

chapters.title: Chapter 565 - 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 565: Chapter 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_3
“Whatever you give to Zi Miao Zhen, you must give me the same. You cannot treat me any less favorably,”
Ji Mingyue said in a stern voice, staring into Han Li’s eyes.
After thinking it over for another night, she finally decided to agree to Han Li’s proposal and become his cultivation partner.
If Zi Miao Zhen could do it, she, Ji Mingyue, could do it too!
Ji Mingyue had her conditions; she did not wish to be undervalued and desired the same treatment as Zi Miao Zhen. She had observed Zi Miao Zhen for quite a while and found that Zi Miao Zhen indeed led a comfortable life on Chengsheng Mountain.
“That’s possible,” Han Li nodded.
Ji Mingyue’s response wasn’t beyond his expectations. This proud Heavenly Immortal Fairy had finally bowed her proud head to him.
Judging by the height difference between Ji Mingyue and Han Li, Ji Mingyue would be just about right if she were to kneel.
Ji Mingyue, after all, was a mid-stage Sacred Abyss realm female saint, ranked twenty-seventh on the Heavenly Immortal list. She not only had a higher cultivation than Zi Miao Zhen, but also a higher ranking.
If Ji Mingyue willingly became his cultivation partner, Han Li would not treat her any less favorably than Zi Miao Zhen. Whatever Zi Miao Zhen had, Ji Mingyue would have as well.
Of course, this referred to the things Han Li had promised to Zi Miao Zhen. Things Zi Miao Zhen acquired later on her own merit were not included; those were gained through her own abilities.
Hearing this, Ji Mingyue relaxed, and a stunningly radiant smile appeared on her flawless face, making even the dawn sky seem dull in comparison, casting all other things into shame.
Han Li turned his gaze to the cold and proud Yuan Youwei and asked, “Yuan Youwei, what about you?”
“Heh heh~”
Yuan Youwei let out a cold laugh but didn’t answer Han Li’s question. Instead, she spoke to Ji Mingyue: “Ji Mingyue, you have disappointed me.”
Since Ji Mingyue didn’t follow her plan, Yuan Youwei felt frustrated, as it cost her a significant bargaining chip, and now she felt somewhat helpless on her own.
You still don’t have the right to speak to me,” Ji Mingyue retorted unabashedly.
Half a month ago, Yuan Youwei took advantage of her higher cultivation to bully the younger, leaving a bad taste in Ji Mingyue’s mouth.
Now that they had both fallen into Han Li’s hands and their abilities were completely sealed, Yuan Youwei still carried herself with an air of superiority, which irritated Ji Mingyue even more.
Sensing the irritation, she was not going to indulge Yuan Youwei.
Now that she had become Han Li’s cultivation partner, she had no need to worry about Zi Miao Zhen targeting her, but she could certainly look for ways to target Yuan Youwei. She believed Han Li would turn a blind eye.
“Hmph~”
After being retorted by Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei snorted coldly, no longer paying her any attention, and spoke to Han Li:
“Han Li, I’m not against becoming your cultivation partner either, but you have to defeat me without the help of any external objects or give me a Heavenly Immortal weapon. Just one of these conditions will suffice.”
“You must be dreaming,” Han Li said calmly with an unchanged expression.
Since Yuan Youwei was indulging in daydreams, Han Li decided it was time to awaken her to reality, leaving her with only her dreams.
Following that, Han Li left Cloud View Terrace with Ji Mingyue, leaving only Yuan Youwei behind.
“Sigh~”
It was only after Han Li and Ji Mingyue had been gone for a long time that Yuan Youwei exhaled a breath, feeling considerably more relaxed in her heart.
She had deliberately set those two conditions to trouble Han Li, knowing he could not meet them. Han Li was not capable of defeating her, nor would he give his only Heavenly Immortal weapon to her.
As long as she provoked Han Li effectively, he would not dare hurt her easily, and she would still be able to keep herself intact.
Unlike the foolish woman Ji Mingyue, who chose to debase herself for temporary benefits, to hide away and steal a life under Han Li’s pleasure, how lowly.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Han Li and Ji Mingyue stood there, with Ji Mingyue embraced in his arms, her delicate body trembling, but she did not struggle.
Breathing in the strong scent of the man, Ji Mingyue took a deep breath and asked, “Han Li, what are you planning to do with Yuan Youwei?”
She was very curious about what fate would befall Yuan Youwei.
Ji Mingyue did not believe that Han Li could be outmaneuvered by Yuan Youwei; Han Li was not some naive young man. He was a deeply calculating and insidious person.
“Mingyue, you will find out soon enough,” Han Li smiled, offering no explanation.
But in his heart, he had already sentenced Yuan Youwei.
If you refuse to become my cultivation partner, then become a female slave to this old ancestor!
That’s right, Han Li had demoted Ji Mingyue from the status of cultivation partner to that of a female slave, not even conferring the status of concubine or servant concubine upon her.
This was the path Ji Mingyue chose, so she must kneel and endure Han Li’s lashes.
He had yet to try taming a Quasi Emperor female slave. After marrying Ji Mingyue, he could teach Yuan Youwei a lesson.
The lessons from Old Ancestor Han run deep, so Yuan Youwei’s lesson would undoubtedly be profound.
“Let’s not talk about it then,”
Ji Mingyue huffed softly, feigning anger, yet her heart fluttered. It was her first time being so close to the opposite sex.
Han Li immediately transformed into a charmer, his honeyed words quickly cheering up Ji Mingyue, and he swiftly got to work.
Ji Mingyue silently endured as her originally pale, fairy-like skin turned faintly pink all over, even her earlobes blushed deeply.
