Han Li, that lustful man, had taken liberties with her even before she was married off to him, causing Ji Mingyue’s breathing to become hurried.
As Han Li finished surveying the great mountains and rivers and passed the flat terrain of her abdomen, ready to press forward, Ji Mingyue suddenly caught his hand and shook her head at him.
Han Li chose to respect Ji Mingyue’s wishes and did not explore further, merely cuddling with the beautiful woman in his arms, whispering sweet nothings.
As their emotions deepened, Han Li couldn’t help but lower his head, and Ji Mingyue voluntarily closed her beautiful eyes, silently savoring everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 566 - 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 566: Chapter 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_4
She felt that it actually seemed quite nice.
When everything ended and he successfully took Ji Mingyue’s luscious lips, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face as he said, “Mingyue, keep this well.”
Han Li took out a Mutton Fat Jade Vial, which sealed a pill inside.
Ji Mingyue accepted the Mutton Fat Jade Vial, somewhat surprised at what Han Li was doing, her face carrying a look of confusion as she gazed at him.
With a tender and affectionate tone, Han Li said, “Mingyue, inside this is a Taoism Pill.”
Ji Mingyue’s pupils abruptly contracted, her hand nearly letting the jade vial fall due to her instability, her flawless countenance filled with shock.
“You aren’t joking, are you?” Ji Mingyue swallowed, asking incredulously.
She certainly knew what the Taoism Pill was. It was an Emperor Pill that could help a Great Saint ascend to the rank of Quasi Emperor, possessing miraculous effects against the heavens and coveted by all Saints in the Saint Abyss Realm.
Besides increasing the success rate of breakthroughs, the Taoism Pill also held another miraculous effect, which is what Ji Mingyue valued the most.
“Open it and you’ll find out,” said Han Li with a smile.
“As I’ve said, what Zhen’er has, you’ll have too. The Taoism Pill is just one of them.”
After a moment of hesitation, Ji Mingyue still opened the Mutton Fat Jade Vial. When the rich fragrance of the pill hit her face, and she smelled the fragrance and saw the pill’s patterns, Ji Mingyue was suddenly enraptured.
Her Dao companion really was quite generous. No wonder Zi Miaozhen willingly became one of Han Li’s Dao companions.
And this was only one of them.
Just how many benefits did Zi Miaozhen get from Han Li?
“If Yuan Youwei knew about the treatment I have here, she’d probably be green with regret by now,” Ji Mingyue said with a laugh, putting away the Mutton Fat Jade Vial and taking a deep breath to calm her emotions.
“One makes their own choices,” Han Li said with a smile, not elaborating further.
Several days later,
The Grand Love Ancestor has taken another wife again!
This news spread quickly throughout the Daqian Empire and the entire Xuan Domain.
However, aside from the Daqian Empire and some nearby forces, the rest of the forces in the Xuan Domain had become numb to the news, unmoved and unsurprised.
If the Ancestor of the Han Mansion did not frequently take wives and concubines, could he still be termed the Grand Love Ancestor?
During this time, Han Li had not only married Zi Miaozhen but had also taken many beautiful wives and concubines, all high-quality and beautiful female cultivators sent by various forces in the Xuan Domain.
Those whom Han Li admired he received wholeheartedly, and those he did not, he still didn’t send back, leaving them to his descendants instead.
After the grand wedding ceremony concluded, Han Li couldn’t wait to arrive at Ji Mingyue’s bridal chamber.
He had endured for several days for this moment; except for the final step, he had completed all others.
Ji Mingyue insisted that he could only achieve full victory on their wedding night, so Han Li endured it, not wanting to force her. After all, Ji Mingyue was his Dao companion, and Han Li would try his best to respect their wishes.
When Han Li entered the bridal chamber, he saw Ji Mingyue dressed in full bridal red, her beauty breathtaking.
With an excited heart, Han Li lifted her red veil, saw her perfect, ethereal beauty, and his burning passion could no longer be contained.
(Here is an indescribable scene, dear readers, please imagine it yourselves.)
The next day, early morning.
Han Li held Ji Mingyue’s peerless and exquisite body, his expression still excited, feeling not the slightest fatigue even after a whole night of exchanging Taoism practices.
After in-depth exchanges, Han Li felt that Ji Mingyue was not as aloof as she had previously shown, but instead very tender.
Her body was warm inside, her delicate body soft.
Looking at Ji Mingyue, now sound asleep, Han Li gently kissed her forehead, then his figure disappeared.
Arriving at the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li opened the System’s treasure chest page, and seeing the item that appeared, joy overflowed on his face.
The opportunity to open the System’s treasure chest had naturally refreshed this month, and Han Li had not used it, just waiting for this moment.
Last night was naturally the perfect opportunity; Han Li had capitalized on Ji Mingyue’s good fortune, indeed blessed with luck, achieving a full hit and reaping a great reward.
“Ding, the treasure chest is opened successfully, congratulations to the master on obtaining a Heaven Immortal Rank Treasure [Primordial Chaos Cauldron]!”
Han Li, looking at the System prompt flowing on the top of the treasure chest page, couldn’t help laughing heartily.
The second Heaven Immortal weapon was in hand!
The Primordial Chaos Cauldron!
He, Ancestor Han, had finally risen again.
With the Heaven Immortal weapon Primordial Chaos Cauldron in hand, the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain had surged once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 567 - 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 567: Chapter 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_1
After half a month, Han Li decided to give Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei some time to think, allowing them a day to contemplate thoroughly.
When the time came, Han Li would go to talk with them about their aspirations in life. If they still failed to appreciate his position and didn’t comply willingly, then the Patriarch Han was ready to resort to force.
He didn’t have much patience to spare, offering Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei this much time was solely due to their status as the female saint of the Holy Abyss Realm and the female emperor of the Quasi-Emperor Realm. Once his patience ran out, he would make the two women understand the consequences of defying him.
Chengdao Peak, Cloud View Terrace.
Ji Mingyue, dressed in flowing cyan robes, stood graceful and elegant, her beauty stunning and her demeanor otherworldly;
By her side, Yuan Youwei wore a purple dress, her slender and exquisite figure perfectly curved, as if a banished immortal had descended to the mortal realm.
At this moment, Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei were silently watching the surging sea of clouds, no words spoken between them, but the atmosphere was heavy with tension.
“Sigh~”
With a long sigh, Ji Mingyue turned to look at Yuan Youwei, her lips tightly pursed, and after a long while, she finally spoke, “What do you plan to do?”
Ji Mingyue felt turmoil within her, an unfamiliar sensation of being completely lost, even though when previously suppressed by Han Li, she still retained some composure, bolstered by the strong backing of her Huangyue Imperial Empire.
But in the past half month, as she accompanied Han Li and the Purple Miao True Immortal in touring Chengsheng Mountain, witnessing all its resources and foundations, Ji Mingyue’s confidence was shattered piece by piece.
By today, no trace of confidence remained in her heart, only shock, panic, despair, and regret…
Although Chengsheng Mountain still fell short compared to the Huangyue Imperial Empire in many aspects, in the most crucial aspect of immortal soldiers, it was not inferior at all. With it in Han Li’s possession, it was incredibly difficult for the Empress of Huangyue to rescue her.
The Empress of Huangyue could not locate Chengsheng Mountain in a short time, and even if she could, it wouldn’t be easy to obliterate it.
Given time to Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain, the Endless Yuankun Domain would soon have another supreme being, a new powerful force established.
Ji Mingyue finally understood why her archenemy, Purple Miao True Immortal, would succumb and agree to become Han Li’s partner.
Although Han Li hadn’t stated it outright, Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei both knew his intentions: he wanted them both as his partners.
Han Li’s actions these days were aimed at conquering without fighting.
Indeed, this strategy was quite effective as Ji Mingyue’s once resolute belief had begun to waver.
“Ji Mingyue, you are wavering,” Yuan Youwei stated blandly.
“Han Li is merely a minor cultivator at the first level of the Tongxuan Realm. You, a female saint at the fourth level of the Holy Abyss Realm, surely wouldn’t consider yielding to him? Ridiculous!”
Yuan Youwei’s gaze pierced into Ji Mingyue’s beautiful eyes, causing Ji Mingyue to look away, yet she harbored such thoughts herself.
“Ji Mingyue, I urge you to think it over, Han Li is not worthy of you,” Yuan Youwei continued.
“Regardless of whether Han Li is the reincarnation of an immortal or has acquired the treasure of an immortal to rise swiftly, possessing his current formidable foundation, you must understand, he is ultimately just at the first level of the Tongxuan Realm.”
“With the disappearance of Purple Miao True Immortal, you, and myself from Qianyuan Divine Province, it will certainly cause an uproar. Han Li won’t be able to hide it. When Yuanchu Mountain, the Huangyue Imperial Empire, and White Emperor City all set their sights on him, what will Han Li have to fend them off?”
Turning away, Yuan Youwei gazed at the vast sea of clouds, her long, fair hands clasped behind her back as she spoke detachedly,
“I admit that Han Li’s foundation is beyond my expectations, but that’s all there is to it. He’s still no match for the three major forces. Even the Human Path Sword, no matter how strong, cannot withstand the assault of three True Immortal weapons, let alone the fact that the three major powers possess more than ten Heavenly Immortal weapons.”
“And don’t forget, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain in Qianyuan Divine Province is also a target for all. Now it might seem glorified on the surface, but once exposed, Great Holy Land Schools like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Penglai Immortal Sect will come to attack in unison. Chengsheng Mountain won’t be able to hold back.”
“If you marry Han Li as his partner, you will be betraying the Huangyue Imperial Empire, forsaking the Empress of Huangyue, sinking to the same level as Purple Miao True Immortal. When Chengsheng Mountain falls, you will face reckoning.”
“Even if you are lucky enough to survive, you will face severe punishment, your future completely ruined. For Han Li, for a momentary reprieve, do you really think it’s worth it?”
Having said her piece, Yuan Youwei no longer paid attention to Ji Mingyue, simply enjoying the scenery on her own as if her heart, like a still well, wasn’t disturbed by the current dilemma.
In fact, Yuan Youwei also had her considerations, but after weighing the pros and cons, she chose to cut them off. Compared to Chengsheng Mountain and Han Li, she placed more trust in Yuanchu Mountain and Empress Yuanchu.
Han Li’s cultivation level was too low. Even with boundless potential and a promising future, he was still not fully grown and would be easily crushed by the three sovereigns.
Whether it was Purple Miao True Immortal, Ji Mingyue, or herself, they all had ties to their own powerful backers. If they were missing for too long, it would invite investigation from those powerful forces.
At that time, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain would have nowhere to hide, falling into the desperate situation Yuan Youwei described. Chengsheng Mountain simply didn’t have enough time to develop, and Yuan Youwei had no intention of joining Han Li in his downfall.
She was a Quasi-Emperor with a bright future ahead, aspiring to advance into the Heaven Imperial Realm, to master the Heavenly Sovereign Path, to become an emperor and rise to the highest ranks in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Talking so much with Ji Mingyue wasn’t because Yuan Youwei was kind-hearted or had any relationship with her. Yuan Youwei simply wanted to pull Ji Mingyue along, at least to buy more time, making Han Li wary and indecisive.

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 568: Chapter 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_2
Yuan Youwei felt a sense of smug satisfaction within. As long as she could align with Ji Mingyue, given Han Li’s behavior over the past half-month, he wouldn’t easily harm either of them. It would allow them to maintain their Primordial Yin Body. However, if she were alone, her position would be weak and not very secure.
Unfortunately, Yuan Youwei was wrong. She didn’t understand Han Li at all. Most of his recent conduct around her was a pretense, and such actions of hers would only exhaust the last bit of Han Li’s patience, ending in a loss greater than the gain.
But Yuan Youwei didn’t know this.
Each of Yuan Youwei’s words struck Ji Mingyue’s resolve like a heavy hammer, her face turning pale with increasing uncertainty.
Watching Yuan Youwei’s chilly and peerless silhouette, Ji Mingyue’s delicate lips were tightly pursed, not uttering a single word, as a battle raged within her heart.
Taking a deep breath, Ji Mingyue spoke up again with a heavy voice, “Yuan Youwei, what if Han Li is not as you imagine?”
“What you are doing will definitely anger Han Li, and when that time comes, there won’t be a good outcome for us. Can you really endure until the incident at Chengsheng Mountain unfolds?”
Ji Mingyue clearly understood Yuan Youwei’s thoughts, but she did not dare agree with her method, which was far too risky.
Yuan Youwei seemed to forget that Han Li was a man of audacious courage, who had even dared to defile the split souls of the two supreme Empresses, Empress Yuanchu and the Huangyue Imperial Empress. How then could the two of them escape from Han Li’s Devil’s Palm?
Ji Mingyue certainly didn’t believe that Han Li was a paragon of virtue; his recent behavior had all been an act.
If Han Li were to force himself upon them, they would still be coerced into losing their chastity to Han Li and fallen into his hands, aspiring to maintain their purity would be but a fool’s dream.
Based on the information subtly revealed by Han Li during the half-month, their end would be different if they were to willingly marry him or be forced.
Volunteering to marry Han Li, with their status, cultivation, and beauty, would make them Han Li’s Dao companions, giving them a high status on Chengsheng Mountain; if they were forced to marry Han Li, it was uncertain if they could become Dao companions.
The term “Dao companion” represented status and position on Chengsheng Mountain, and it determined the cultivation resources and privileges they would enjoy.
The reason Ji Mingyue wavered and didn’t hold on to her own opinions was that she understood this point. After all, she was only in the mid-stage of the Holy Abyss Realm, and in terms of combat ability, Han Li was not much weaker than her. It wouldn’t be disgraceful to become Han Li’s Dao companion.
Otherwise, if they were forced and lost their chastity, their plight would be very miserable. By the time White Emperor City, Yuanchu Mountain, and Huangyue Imperial Empire came to their rescue, everything would have been lost.
Not only would they have already lost their chastity, but in such a situation, they likely would have their cultivation abolished or even be directly killed. Even if Chengsheng Mountain were destroyed, it would be of no use to Ji Mingyue, not worth it at all.
“Dare he?” Yuan Youwei said lightly, as if she was very confident.
She was, after all, a Quasi Emperor, a future Empress of the Heaven Imperial Realm. The idea of being forced to marry a Cultivator of the Tongxuan Realm’s first layer was too humiliating for her, and Yuan Youwei’s pride would not allow her to do so.
If Han Li had only her as his Dao companion, or only had Zimei Zhen, Ji Mingyue, and the three as his Dao companions, Yuan Youwei could reluctantly agree. But Han Li had too many wives and concubines; she could not accept it.
Yuan Youwei was sure that Han Li wouldn’t dare to kill her, otherwise, the matter of Chengsheng Mountain would be exposed instantly, and Han Li was far from a match for Empress Yuanchu.
If she were to use some tactics, she also had the confidence to deter Han Li from forcefully defiling her and being coerced into losing her chastity.
Ji Mingyue opened her mouth, wanting to speak but then hesitating, as if to say Han Li really might dare, but she ultimately didn’t say it out loud.
Yuan Youwei’s situation was different from hers. What Ji Mingyue was willing to accept, Yuan Youwei might not be.
“Ji Mingyue, think carefully about this. Don’t make a foolish decision.”
Yuan Youwei turned around, looked at the conflicted Ji Mingyue, gently touched her stunning face with her hand, and then left.
Silently watching Yuan Youwei leave, Ji Mingyue glanced at the surging sea of clouds and also left, heading back to her chamber. She wanted to be alone with her thoughts.
Chengdao Peak, Qiandao Hall.
Han Li was discussing the Dao and contemplating the great paths of life with Zimei Zhen, and they were also examining unprecedented strategies. For a moment, the sky rained flowers and the ground sprouted golden lotuses, with heavenly sounds and wondrous melodies never ceasing.
Han Li had also divided a portion of his focus to control his Divine Sense and monitor Cloud View Terrace, listening to the conversation between Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei in its entirety. He did not make any comment for now, and would address it later.
Withdrawing his Divine Sense, Han Li then tightly embraced the beautiful and sweet Zimei Zhen, devoting himself entirely.
In a flash, Zimei Zhen’s beautiful eyes became hazy, and under her dancing purple hair was a charming and passionate countenance.
At some point, a figure appeared reflected in a mirror made from Supreme Grade lapis lazuli.
…..
The next day, Han Li arrived alone at Cloud View Terrace, and Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei also arrived on time.
With his hands resting on the balustrade, Han Li looked into the distance at the rising morning sun, waiting for the first rays of daylight to pierce the long night, and inhaled a wisp of morning glow as the sky turned purple.
It was then that Han Li turned around and looked over Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei.
Ji Mingyue had removed her veiled scarf, revealing her stunning face to Han Li, seemingly indicating her attitude.
Yuan Youwei, still veiled and cold, wore an expression as if Han Li owned her a set of Heavenly Immortal weapons. Her arms crossed over her chest, she attempted to present a condescending posture toward Han Li.
“Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, have you considered your decision?” Han Li said with a smile.
Yuan Youwei glanced at Ji Mingyue and subtly shook her head. Ji Mingyue ignored Yuan Youwei’s gesture and said calmly, “I am willing to become your Dao companion.”

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 569: Chapter 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_3
“Whatever you give to Zimiao Zhen, you must give the same to me, and you absolutely must not treat me any less favorably.”
Ji Mingyue stared into Han Li’s eyes, speaking in a grave tone.
After thinking it over for another night, she finally decided to accept Han Li’s proposal to become his Dao Companion.
If Zimiao Zhen could do it, so could Ji Mingyue!
However, Ji Mingyue had her conditions too; she didn’t want to be undervalued and demanded to receive the same as Zimiao Zhen. She had observed Zimiao Zhen for quite some time and noticed that Zimiao Zhen really thrived on Chengsheng Mountain.
“Agreed,” Han Li nodded.
Ji Mingyue’s reaction did not surprise him; the proud Heavenly Immortal Fairy ultimately lowered her haughty head before Han Li.
Considering the height difference between Ji Mingyue and Han Li, if Ji Mingyue were to kneel, it seemed just about the right height.
Ji Mingyue was a mid-stage St. Yuan realm female Saint, ranking twenty-seventh on the Heavenly Immortal list, not only with a higher cultivation level than Zimiao Zhen but also a higher standing.
If Ji Mingyue willingly became his Dao Companion, Han Li would not treat her any less favorably; whatever Zimiao Zhen had, Ji Mingyue would have too.
Of course, this referred to what Han Li had promised Zimiao Zhen. What Zimiao Zhen later obtained on her own did not count, for she had earned those through her own abilities.
Upon hearing this, Ji Mingyue breathed a sigh of relief, a gorgeous radiant smile spreading across her flawless visage, outshining the morning glow and making all else seem inferior.
Han Li turned to the coldly exquisite Yuan Youwei, saying, “Yuan Youwei, what about you?”
“Heh.” Yuan Youwei let out a cold laugh but did not answer Han Li’s question. Instead, she addressed Ji Mingyue, saying, “Ji Mingyue, you have disappointed me.”
Ji Mingyue hadn’t followed her plans, which greatly irritated Yuan Youwei. This cost her a significant bargaining chip, and now she felt somewhat powerless.
“Yuan Youwei, you’re not yet qualified to speak to me,” Ji Mingyue retorted without any courtesy.
Half a month ago, Yuan Youwei took advantage of her higher cultivation level to bully Ji Mingyue, leaving Ji Mingyue feeling very uncomfortable;
Now that they had both fallen into Han Li’s hands, with their cultivation and strengths completely sealed, Ji Mingyue still considered herself high and mighty, looking down upon her with an air of superiority, which annoyed Ji Mingyue even more.
Since Ji Mingyue was annoyed, she was not about to indulge Yuan Youwei.
Now that she was Han Li’s Dao Companion, she didn’t have to worry about Zimiao Zhen targeting her; instead, she could devise ways to target Yuan Youwei, believing that Han Li would turn a blind eye.
“Hmph,” Yuan Youwei huffed after being rebuked by Ji Mingyue and stopped acknowledging her, turning to Han Li to say:
“Han Li, I am not completely opposed to becoming your Dao Companion either. Just either defeat me without the help of external objects or give me a Heavenly Immortal weapon; achieving either one will suffice.”
“I suppose you’re dreaming a pipe dream,” Han Li replied calmly and indifferently.
Since Yuan Youwei was indulging in pipe dreams, Han Li decided to jolt her awake, leaving her only her dreams.
After that, Han Li left the Cloud View Terrace with Ji Mingyue, leaving Yuan Youwei there alone.
“Sigh,”
Only after Han Li and Ji Mingyue had been gone for quite a while did Yuan Youwei exhale deeply, relaxing significantly.
She had deliberately set those two conditions to trouble Han Li, knowing he wouldn’t be able to fulfill them. Han Li was no match for her in combat, nor would he give her the only Heavenly Immortal weapon he had.
As long as she could provoke Han Li, he wouldn’t lay a hand on her easily, and she could still preserve her chastity.
Unlike Ji Mingyue, this foolish woman who chose to live a subservient life for short-term benefits, willingly seeking Han Li’s favors from a position of inferiority – truly despicable.
Atop Chengdao Peak.
Standing there with Han Li, Ji Mingyue was held in his embrace, her delicate body trembling, but she didn’t struggle.
As she inhaled the heavy masculine scent, Ji Mingyue took a deep breath and said, “Han Li, what plans do you have for Yuan Youwei?”
She was curious about the fate that awaited Yuan Youwei.
Ji Mingyue didn’t believe Han Li would be outwitted by Yuan Youwei. Han Li was no naive youngster; he was cunning and deceitful.
“Mingyue, you’ll find out later,” Han Li said with a smile, offering no explanation.
But in his heart, he had already passed judgment on Yuan Youwei.
If you won’t be my Dao Companion, then become a female slave for this old ancestor! Indeed, Han Li directly demoted Ji Mingyue from the status of Dao Companion to that of a female slave, unwilling to even grant her the status of a concubine or servant concubine.
This was the path Ji Mingyue had chosen for herself, so she had to kneel and accept Han Li’s punishment.
He had yet to experience the punishment of a Quasi Emperor female slave, but after marrying Ji Mingyue, he would have the chance to teach Yuan Youwei a lesson.
Old Ancestor Han’s methods were profound, so Yuan Youwei’s lesson would surely be profound as well.
“Let’s not talk about it, then,” Ji Mingyue huffed, feigning anger, while her heart thumped with excitement. This was her first time in such close quarters with a man.
Han Li immediately transformed into a charmer, showering Ji Mingyue with sweet nothings, cheering her up. Old Ancestor Han’s skills were coming into play.
Ji Mingyue silently endured; her originally snow-white skin took on a faint blush, from head to toe, even her earlobes turned thoroughly red.
This lecherous Han Li – before she had even become his bride, he started taking liberties, causing Ji Mingyue’s breathing to grow increasingly hurried.
As Han Li finished his exploration of mountains and valleys, passing by the flat terrain of her abdomen and preparing to venture further south, Ji Mingyue suddenly caught hold of Han Li’s hand and shook her head.
Han Li chose to respect Ji Mingyue’s wishes, not venturing further, and merely cuddled with the exquisite beauty in his arms, whispering sweet nothings to each other.
When emotions ran deep, Han Li couldn’t help but lower his head, and Ji Mingyue instinctively closed her eyes, silently savoring the moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 570: Chapter 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_4
She felt that this was actually quite nice.
When everything was over and he had successfully claimed Ji Mingyue’s tender, moist lips, a smile surfaced on Han Li’s face. “Mingyue, keep this well,” he said with a smile.
Han Li took out a Mutton Fat Jade Vial, which contained a pill inside.
Ji Mingyue received the Mutton Fat Jade Vial with some surprise, wondering what Han Li was doing, and looked at him with confusion.
With affectionate tenderness, Han Li said, “Mingyue, there is a Taoism Pill inside this vial.”
Ji Mingyue’s pupils contracted sharply, her jade hand nearly letting the vial slip through her fingers as shock covered her flawless face.
“You aren’t joking, are you?” Ji Mingyue swallowed, asking in disbelief.
Of course, she knew what a Taoism Pill was. It was an Emperor Pill that could assist Great Saints in advancing to Quasi Emperors. It possessed miraculous effects against the norm, coveted by all Saints in the Saint Abyss Realm.
Besides increasing the success rate of breakthroughs, the Taoism Pill had other miraculous effects, which were what Ji Mingyue valued most.
“Open it and see for yourself,” Han Li said with a smile.
“As I’ve said, what Yuan Youwei has, you will have as well. The Taoism Pill is just one of them.”
Ji Mingyue hesitated but eventually opened the Mutton Fat Jade Vial, and as the intense fragrance of the pill wafted out, inhaling the scent and observing the pill pattern, she was momentarily entranced.
Her Dao mate really was generous. No wonder Zi Miaozhen willingly became one of Han Li’s Dao mates.
And this was only one of them.
How many benefits must Zi Miaozhen have gained from Han Li?
“If Yuan Youwei knew about the treatment I’m getting, she would probably be regretting it so much her guts would be green,” Ji Mingyue said with a smile as she put away the Mutton Fat Jade Vial and took a deep breath to calm her emotions.
“One chooses their own path,” Han Li said with a smile, not elaborating further.
Several days later,
The grand patriarch of the Han Mansion is getting married again!
This news spread swiftly throughout the Daqian Empire and into the whole Xuan Domain.
But aside from the Daqian Empire and some nearby forces, the other powers of Xuan Domain had become numb to it and were unmoved, not surprised at all.
If the grand patriarch of the Han Mansion didn’t frequently take wives and concubines, how could he be called the grand patriarch of love? During this period, Han Li had not only welcomed Zi Miaozhen but also taken many charming wives and beautiful concubines, all high-quality female cultivators presented by various forces of the Xuan Domain.
Han Li accepted all those he fancied, and even those he didn’t appreciate, he would not send back; he left them for his descendants.
After the immensely grand wedding ceremony had concluded, Han Li couldn’t wait to head over to Ji Mingyue’s bridal chamber.
For this moment, Han Li had been restraining himself for several days, having passed all barriers except the last one.
Ji Mingyue insisted on waiting till the wedding night to let him claim final victory; Han Li could only endure, not wishing to force her, since Ji Mingyue was his Dao mate, and he tried his best to respect their wishes.
When Han Li walked into the bridal chamber, he saw Ji Mingyue drenched in red wedding attire, her allure unsurpassed and breathtaking.
With an excited heart, Han Li lifted her red veil and saw that perfect, peerless beauty, his burning desires no longer containable.
(This part describes scenes that cannot be depicted; dear readers, please use your imagination.)
The next morning, at dawn.
With Ji Mingyue’s unparalleled figure in his arms, Han Li’s expression was still one of excitement, and even after exchanging the Dao for an entire night, he didn’t feel the slightest fatigue.
After an in-depth exchange, Han Li felt that Ji Mingyue was not as cold as she had appeared to be before, but rather, very gentle.
Her body was warm, her figure soft.
Looking at the deeply sleeping Ji Mingyue, Han Li gently kissed her forehead, then his figure vanished.
Arriving at the peak of Chengdao Peak, Han Li opened the treasure chest interface, and the joy on his face spoke volumes as he looked at the treasure that had appeared.
The opportunity to open a treasure chest had naturally refreshed for the month, and Han Li had been waiting for this moment without using it.
Last night was naturally the perfect time. Utilizing Ji Mingyue’s luck, sure enough, good fortune shined upon him, and in one go, he got something good.
“Ding, treasure chest opened successfully; congratulations to the master for obtaining a Heaven Immortal Rank treasure, the Primordial Chaos Cauldron!”
Han Li looked at the system notice scrolling at the top of the treasure chest page and couldn’t help but burst into hearty laughter.
He had obtained the second piece of Heaven Immortal weaponry!
The Primordial Chaos Cauldron!
He, Patriarch Han, had finally risen again.
With the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, a Heaven Immortal weapon, the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain had greatly increased once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 571: Chapter 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_1
Half a month later, Han Li decided to give Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei a breather, allowing them one day to think things through.
When the time came, Han Li would seek them out for a heart-to-heart talk about life’s ideals, and if they still didn’t know what was good for them, refusing to comply obediently, Patriarch Han was ready to use force.
He wasn’t a man of great patience, and the only reason he had granted Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei so much time was out of respect for their standings as the Saint of the Sacred Abyss Realm and the Empress of the Quasi Emperor Domain. Once his patience ran out, he would make the two women understand the consequences of defying him.
Chengdao Peak, Cloud View Terrace.
Ji Mingyue’s green garments fluttered, her figure graceful and poised, her face exquisitely beautiful, her demeanor transcendent and ethereal;
beside her stood Yuan Youwei in a purple dress, her slender and exquisite body curving alluringly, beautiful as a banished immortal descending to the mortal world.
At that moment, Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei were quietly watching the billowing sea of clouds, neither of them speaking, yet the atmosphere was heavy with tension.
“Sigh~”
With a long sigh, Ji Mingyue turned to Yuan Youwei, her lips tightly pressed, and it was a long time before she spoke, asking, “What do you plan to do?”
Ji Mingyue’s mind was in turmoil, for the first time feeling utterly at a loss. Even when Han Li had overpowered her, she still retained some composure, depending on the strong backing of the Huangyue Imperial Empire.
But over the past half-month, following Han Li and Zi Miao really on the tour around Chengsheng Mountain, Ji Mingyue’s confidence was systematically dismantled as she witnessed the various foundations of Chengsheng Mountain.
By today, she had lost all her confidence, replaced by shock, panic, despair, and regret…
In many respects, Chengsheng Mountain was indeed far from matching the Huangyue Imperial Empire, but in the most critical matter of Immortal Soldiers, it was on par. With Han Li in charge, it would be extremely difficult for the Empress of Huangyue to rescue her.
The Empress of Huangyue would not find Chengsheng Mountain easily, and even if she did, she couldn’t just obliterate it with ease.
Giving Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain time meant that the Endless Yuankun Domain would soon have another supreme being, an additional powerful force to reckon with.
Ji Mingyue finally understood why her arch nemesis, Zi Miao really, had submitted and agreed to become Han Li’s Dao Companion.
Although Han Li had not said it outright, both Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei knew what he wanted: for both women to become his Dao Companions.
These past few days, Han Li’s approach was to try to conquer without fighting.
This had indeed had a significant effect, at least shaking the firm beliefs in Ji Mingyue’s heart.
“Ji Mingyue, you are wavering,” Yuan Youwei said indifferently.
“Han Li is just a minor cultivator at the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm, while you are the Saintess of the fourth layer of the Sacred Abyss Realm. You surely don’t want to lower yourself to him, do you? Ridiculous!”
Yuan Youwei’s gaze pierced Ji Mingyue’s, causing her to avert her eyes, yet she had indeed begun to entertain such thoughts.
“Ji Mingyue, I urge you to think carefully. Han Li isn’t worthy of you,” continued Yuan Youwei.
“Whether Han Li is a reincarnation of an Immortal or has obtained an Immortal’s treasure and risen to power in one fell swoop, you must realize that he is ultimately only at the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm.”
“With both Zi Miao really, you, and me gone from the Qianyuan Divine Province, it will undoubtedly cause an uproar. Han Li won’t be able to hide it. When Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and White Emperor City all aim at him, what will Han Li have to fend them off?”
Yuan Youwei turned away, her gaze returning to the majestic sea of clouds. With her slender and fair hands clasped behind her, she spoke calmly,
“I admit Han Li’s foundation has exceeded my expectations, but that’s as far as it goes. He doesn’t compare to the three greatest powers. No matter how strong the Human Path Sword is, it cannot withstand the attacks from three True Immortal weapons, let alone that the three great powers also possess more than ten Heavenly Immortal weapons.”
“Don’t forget, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain is also an entity that everyone in the Qianyuan Divine Province wants to strike down. It merely has a veneer of glory, which will vanish once its true nature is exposed. Great Holy Land Schools like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Penglai Immortal Sect will all converge to attack, and Chengsheng Mountain won’t be able to hold,” she continued.
“If you marry Han Li as a Dao Companion, you would be betraying the Huangyue Imperial Empire, forsaking the Empress of Huangyue, descending to the same level as Zi Miao really. When Chengsheng Mountain falls, you two will also face retribution.”
“Even if you somehow survive, you will be severely punished, and your futures ruined. For Han Li, for a fleeting moment of comfort, do you really think it’s worth it?”
After saying her piece, Yuan Youwei ignored Ji Mingyue and continued to enjoy the scenery, seemingly unaffected by the predicament they were in.
In fact, Yuan Youwei also had her own considerations, but after weighing the pros and cons, she had discarded them. She placed more trust in Yuanchu Mountain and the Empress Yuanchu over Chengsheng Mountain and Han Li.
Han Li’s cultivation was too low. No matter how boundless his potential, he had yet to grow up, and the three sovereigns would easily crush him.
Zi Miao really, Ji Mingyue, and herself had connections with powerful backers. If they were absent for too long, it would elicit searches from those powers.
Once that happened, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain would have nowhere to hide and fall into the dire situation Yuan Youwei described, not having nearly enough time to develop. Yuan Youwei did not want to be buried with Han Li.
She was a Quasi Emperor, with a bright future ahead of her. She still aspired to ascend to the Heaven Imperial Realm, master the Heavenly Sovereign Path, realize the Dao to become an Emperor, and reign supreme in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
She spoke so much to Ji Mingyue not out of kindness or any particular affection, but only to keep her as an ally, hoping it might buy them more time, making Han Li wary and hesitant.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 572: Chapter 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_2
Yuan Youwei felt somewhat smug inside. As long as she could get Ji Mingyue on her side, based on Han Li’s behavior in the past half month, he would not easily harm the two of them. This allowed them to maintain their Primordial Yin Body. If it were just her alone, her situation would be precarious and far less secure.
Unfortunately, Yuan Youwei was mistaken. She didn’t understand Han Li at all. The majority of Han Li’s behavior while interacting with her these days had been a pretense. Her actions would only exhaust Han Li’s last bit of patience and result in a loss not worth the gain.
But Yuan Youwei didn’t know this.
Each of Yuan Youwei’s words struck Ji Mingyue’s Daoist heart like a heavy hammer, causing her complexion to turn ashen and leaving her even more at a loss.
Gazing upon Yuan Youwei’s cold, otherworldly figure from behind, Ji Mingyue’s delicate lips were tightly pressed together, not saying a word, her heart in turmoil.
Taking a deep breath, Ji Mingyue spoke up again, her voice grave, “Yuan Youwei, what if Han Li isn’t as you imagine him to be?”
“What you are doing will certainly anger Han Li, and when the time comes, there won’t be a good outcome. Can you really hold out until the incident at Chengsheng Mountain happens?”
Yuan Youwei’s thoughts were clear to Ji Mingyue, but Ji Mingyue couldn’t agree with her. Yuan Youwei’s approach was too risky.
It seemed that Yuan Youwei had forgotten that Han Li was a daring and audacious person. He had even dared to defile the split souls of Empress Yuanchu and the Huangyue Imperial Empire’s empress, two unparalleled female emperors. How then could the two of them escape from Han Li’s Devil’s Palm?
Ji Mingyue didn’t believe for a second that Han Li was a gentleman; it had all been an act these past days.
If Han Li were to force himself upon them, they would still be compelled to lose their chastity to him. Thinking they could remain chaste in Han Li’s grasp was just a fool’s dream.
From the information that had subtly transpired from Han Li in this half month, the outcomes of them giving in willingly or being forced were different.
To willingly marry Han Li, with their status, cultivation, and appearances, they would be Han Li’s Dao companions, holding extremely high positions at Chengsheng Mountain. If they were forced into marriage, it was uncertain whether they could become Dao companions at all.
The term “Dao companion” represented the status one held at Chengsheng Mountain, indicative of the cultivation resources obtained and the privileges and benefits enjoyed.
The reason Ji Mingyue was wavering and no longer holding onto her own opinions was that she had come to understand this fact. After all, she was only in the mid-stage of the Saint Abyss Realm. When it came to combat ability, Han Li was not much weaker than her, so becoming his Dao companion was not shameful.
Otherwise, being forced would make their situation miserable. By the time White Emperor City, Yuanchu Mountain, and the Huangyue Imperial Empire arrived for rescue, they would have lost everything.
Not only would they have lost their chastity by then, but in such circumstances, they would likely have their cultivation destroyed, or even be killed outright. Even if Chengsheng Mountain were to be destroyed, it would be of no use to Ji Mingyue and not worth it at all.
“Would he dare?” Yuan Youwei said indifferently, seemingly full of confidence.
She was a Quasi Emperor, a future empress of the Heaven Imperial Realm. To be forced into marriage with a Cultivator of the first level of the Tongxuan Realm would be a great insult, and Yuan Youwei’s pride wouldn’t allow that.
If Han Li only had her as a Dao companion or only sought her, Zimiao Zhen, and Ji Mingyue as his three Dao companions, Yuan Youwei might reluctantly agree. However, Han Li had too many wives and concubines, which she could not accept.
Yuan Youwei was convinced that Han Li would not dare to kill her, otherwise the incident at Chengsheng Mountain would be exposed instantly, and Han Li was far from being a match for Empress Yuanchu.
If she were to use some tactics, she also had the confidence that Han Li would neither dare nor be able to force himself upon her, resulting in her forced loss of chastity.
Ji Mingyue opened her mouth, wanting to speak, then hesitated. She wanted to say that Han Li might indeed dare, but ultimately, she kept silent.
Yuan Youwei’s situation was different from hers. What Ji Mingyue was willing to do, Yuan Youwei might not be willing to.
“Ji Mingyue, think it over carefully. Don’t act foolishly,” Yuan Youwei said as she turned around. Looking at the troubled and hesitant Ji Mingyue, she reached out her jade hand to caress her stunning face and then left.
Quietly watching Yuan Youwei depart, Ji Mingyue glanced at the surging clouds and also left, heading back to her own chamber to reflect in solitude.
Chengdao Peak, Qiandao Hall.
Han Li was discussing the Tao with Zimiao Zhen, contemplating the profound truths of life. For a time, flowers seemed to rain from the sky and golden lotuses sprung from the earth, with the sound of celestial music endlessly lingering in the air.
Han Li was also using a portion of his mental energy to control his Divine Sense to monitor Cloud View Terrace, listening to every word of the conversation between Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei. He made no comment, leaving the matter for another day.
Withdrawing his Divine Sense, Han Li then tightly embraced the beautiful and sweet Zimiao Zhen, giving her his full attention.
In a moment, Zimiao Zhen’s eyes became dreamy, her face showing a wealth of tenderness under her fluttering purple hair.
Unbeknownst to when, the supreme grade glass jade mirror reflected the figure of a person.
…..
The next day, Han Li came alone to Cloud View Terrace, and Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei arrived punctually as well.
Han Li’s hands rested on the balustrade as he gazed into the distance at the rising morning sun, waiting for the first ray of light to break the eternal night, when a stroke of morning glow tinged with purple qi was inhaled by Han Li.
Only then did Han Li turn around, appraising Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei.
Ji Mingyue had removed the light veil from her face, revealing her breathtaking visage to Han Li, signaling her stance.
Yuan Youwei, still clad in her veil, remained unapproachable and cold, looking as if Han Li owed her ten Heavenly Immortal weapons. Her arms were crossed as she tried to adopt a condescending posture toward Han Li.
“Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, have you two come to a decision?” Han Li inquired with a smile lingering in his tone.
Yuan Youwei glanced at Ji Mingyue and shook her head slightly. Ji Mingyue ignored Yuan Youwei’s gesture and said indifferently, “I can be your Dao companion.”

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 573: Chapter 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_3
“Whatever you gave Zimiao Zhen, you must give me the same. You can’t shortchange me at all,”
Ji Mingyue said to Han Li, staring into his eyes with a grave voice.
After pondering for another night, she finally decided to accept Han Li’s proposal to become his Dao companion.
If Zimiao Zhen could, then she, Ji Mingyue, could do it too!
However, Ji Mingyue had her conditions; she didn’t want to be deemed unimportant and sought to obtain the same treatment as Zimiao Zhen. She had observed Zimiao Zhen for quite some time and realized that Zimiao Zhen truly thrived on Chengsheng Mountain.
“Agreed,” Han Li nodded.
Ji Mingyue’s reaction was within his expectations; this proud Fairy ultimately lowered her noble head to Han Li.
Considering the height of Ji Mingyue and Han Li, it seemed just right if Ji Mingyue were to kneel on the ground.
After all, Ji Mingyue was a mid-stage Saint Abyss cultivator, ranking twenty-seventh on the Heavenly Immortal list—her cultivation level and ranking both higher than Zimiao Zhen’s.
If Ji Mingyue willingly became his Dao companion, Han Li wouldn’t mistreat her in the slightest; she would have everything that Zimiao Zhen had.
Of course, this referred to what Han Li had promised Zimiao Zhen, not including the things Zimiao Zhen later obtained on her own merit.
Upon hearing this, Ji Mingyue breathed a sigh of relief, her flawless face bursting into a beautiful radiant smile that made the morning glow pale in comparison and all things beneath the heavens feel inferior.
Han Li turned his gaze to the cold and stunning Yuan Youwei, asking, “And you, Yuan Youwei?”
“Hehe~”
Yuan Youwei let out a cold laugh, not answering Han Li’s question, but instead said to Ji Mingyue, “Ji Mingyue, you’ve disappointed me.”
Ji Mingyue did not follow her scheme, greatly annoying Yuan Youwei, causing her to lose a significant leverage, and now she felt somewhat helpless.
“Yuan Youwei, you’re not in a position to discuss me,” Ji Mingyue responded without any courtesy.
Half a month ago, Yuan Youwei, relying on her higher cultivation level, bullied the weaker, causing Ji Mingyue much resentment;
Now that both were in Han Li’s hands with their cultivation bound, Ji Mingyue, still highly regarded herself, looking down on Yuan Youwei with an elevated attitude, infuriating Ji Mingyue even more.
If she was annoyed, then she wouldn’t indulge Yuan Youwei.
Now that she had become Han Li’s Dao companion, she didn’t have to worry about Zimiao Zhen targeting her, and she could figure out a way to target Yuan Youwei instead, believing that Han Li would turn a blind eye.
“Hmph~”
After being rebuffed by Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei snorted coldly and stopped bothering with her, turning to Han Li to say:
“Han Li, I don’t mind becoming your Dao companion either, but only if you beat me without the help of external forces or gift me a Heavenly Immortal weapon—just meet one of these conditions,” she stated.
“I see you’re daydreaming,” Han Li said indifferently, his expression unchanged.
Since Yuan Youwei was daydreaming, Han Li decided to awaken her and let her just dream on.
Afterwards, Han Li left Cloud View Terrace with Ji Mingyue, leaving Yuan Youwei there alone.
“Whew~”
Long after Han Li and Ji Mingyue had left, Yuan Youwei exhaled a deep breath, her heart significantly relaxed.
She purposefully set these two impossible conditions to trouble Han Li, knowing he could never achieve them: Han Li could not defeat her, nor would he give his only Immortal weapon to her.
As long as she could provoke Han Li sufficiently, he would not move against her easily, and she could still preserve her complete purity.
Unlike Ji Mingyue, this foolish woman who chose to survive by compromising for short-term benefits, going beneath Han Li’s knee to receive delight, truly despicable.
At the peak of Chengdao Peak.
Han Li and Ji Mingyue stood there, with Ji Mingyue in Han Li’s embrace, trembling, but she did not struggle.
Feeling the dense masculine scent, Ji Mingyue took a deep breath and asked, “Han Li, what do you plan to do with Yuan Youwei?”
She was curious to know what fate would befall Yuan Youwei.
Ji Mingyue didn’t believe Han Li would be provoked by Yuan Youwei; he was no naive youth. This man was cunning and crafty.
“Mingyue, you’ll find out later,” Han Li said with a smile, offering no explanation.
But he had already sentenced Yuan Youwei in his heart.
If you won’t be my Dao companion, then become a slave girl for this old ancestor!
Indeed, Han Li had downgraded Ji Mingyue from the status of a Dao companion directly to a slave girl, not even willing to bestow the status of concubine or servant concubine upon her.
This was the path Ji Mingyue had chosen, so now she must kneel and endure Han Li’s punishment.
He hadn’t yet had the chance to punish a Quasi Emperor female slave; after he married Ji Mingyue, he would teach Yuan Youwei a lesson.
Han Li, the old ancestor, was profound, so Yuan Youwei’s lesson would surely be profound too.
“Let’s not talk about it then,”
Ji Mingyue snorted coyly, pretending to be angry, but in reality, her heart was racing. This was her first time being so close to someone of the opposite sex.
Han Li instantly transformed into the god of romance, speaking all manner of sweet nothings, which soon cheered Ji Mingyue up, and the old ancestor got the hang of it.
Ji Mingyue silently endured. Her skin, originally as fair as immortal jade, had unknowingly blushed faintly pink, from head to toe—even her ear tips had turned utterly red.
Han Li, the lecherous rogue, behaved improperly towards her even before she had married in, causing Ji Mingyue’s breathing to become more and more rapid.
As Han Li toured past majestic mountains and valleys, crossing the flatlands of Ji Mingyue’s abdomen, ready to advance southward, Ji Mingyue suddenly seized Han Li’s hand and shook her head at him.
Han Li chose to respect Ji Mingyue’s wishes and refrained from further exploration, merely cuddling with the breathtakingly beautiful woman in his arms, nuzzling against her.
When passion deepened, Han Li couldn’t help but lower his head, and Ji Mingyue instinctively closed her eyes, quietly savoring it all.

With an excited heart, Han Li lifted her red veil and saw her flawless, peerless beauty. His burning heart could no longer endure.

The next day, early morning.
Han Li was embracing Ji Mingyue’s incomparably delicate body, still excited, even after a whole night of exchanging Taoist arts, without the slightest sign of fatigue.
After a deep exchange, Han Li felt that Ji Mingyue was not as cold as she had appeared to be before, but rather quite tender.
Her body was warm, and her delicate figure was soft.
Looking at Ji Mingyue, who had fallen into a deep sleep, Han Li gently kissed her forehead and then disappeared from sight.
Arriving at the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li opened the treasure chest interface, with joy apparent on his face as he looked at the item that popped out.
This month’s opportunity to open treasure chests had naturally refreshed, and Han Li hadn’t used it, just waiting for this moment.
Last night was indeed the best opportunity. Han Li had leached off Ji Mingyue’s luck, and truly, fortune smiled upon him, succeeding in one go and obtaining something valuable.
“Ding, treasure chest opening successful, congratulations to the master for obtaining the Heaven Immortal Rank treasure[Primordial Chaos Cauldron]!”
Han Li looked at the system notification scrolling at the top of the chest interface and couldn’t help but burst into hearty laughter.
He’s got his second Heaven Immortal weapon in hand now!
The Primordial Chaos Cauldron!
At last, he, Old Ancestor Han, had risen again.
With the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, this Heaven Immortal weapon, the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain had skyrocketed once more.

Chapter 575: Chapter 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_1
After half a month, Han Li decided to give Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei some time to reflect quietly, allowing them a day to consider their options.
When the time came, Han Li would go to talk to them about life and aspirations. If they still failed to understand the situation and obediently submit, Elder Han was ready to resort to force.
He did not have much patience. The time he gave to Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei was purely out of consideration for their statuses as a Saintess of the Sacred Abyss Realm and a Quasi Emperor of the imperial domain. Once his patience ran out, he would make the two women realize the consequences of defying him.
Chengdao Peak, Cloud View Terrace.
Ji Mingyue, in her flowing green robe, stood with a gracefully curved figure, exceptional beauty, and an extraordinary aura;
beside her was Yuan Youwei, dressed in a purple gown, with a slender and exquisite figure, beautifully curved, like an exiled immortal gracing the mortal world.
At this moment, Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei were silently observing the waves of the cloud sea, speaking no words, but the atmosphere was quite tense.
“Sigh~”
Ji Mingyue took a long sigh, turned to Yuan Youwei, her lips tightly pressed together, and after a long while, she finally asked, “What do you plan to do?”
Ji Mingyue’s mind was in turmoil, feeling ungrounded for the first time. Even when previously suppressed by Han Li, she had some composure because of her strong backing from the Huangyue Imperial Empire.
However, during this half-month, as she followed Han Li and Zimei Zhenyan through Chengsheng Mountain and witnessed its various foundations, Ji Mingyue’s confidence started to crumble step by step.
Today, she was devoid of any confidence, overwhelmed with shock, panic, despair, and regret.
While Chengsheng Mountain was far inferior to the Huangyue Imperial Empire in many aspects, in terms of the most critical aspect, immortal soldiers, it did not fall short. In Han Li’s hands, it would be very difficult for the Empress of Huangyue to rescue her.
The Empress of Huangyue would not be able to find Chengsheng Mountain anytime soon, and even if she did, she could not easily destroy it.
Given time to Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain, the Endless Yuankun Domain would soon witness the rise of a new supreme being and a potent force.
Ji Mingyue finally understood why her archenemy Zimei Zhenyan had submitted, willing to become Han Li’s Dao companion.
Although Han Li had not explicitly stated it, both Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei knew what Han Li wanted—both women to become his Dao companions.
Han Li’s approach these days was to conquer without fighting.
In fact, this indeed had a significant impact; at least Ji Mingyue’s firm beliefs were shaken.
“Ji Mingyue, you are wavering,” said Yuan Youwei indifferently.
“Han Li is merely a small cultivator at the first tier of Tongxuan Realm. You, however, are a fourth-tier Saintess of the Sacred Abyss Realm. You wouldn’t really consider submitting to him, would you? Ridiculous!”
Yuan Youwei gazed straight into Ji Mingyue’s eyes, causing Ji Mingyue to look away, but indeed, she was harboring such thoughts.
“Ji Mingyue, I advise you to think carefully. Han Li is not worthy of you,” continued Yuan Youwei.
“Regardless of whether Han Li is the reincarnation of an Immortal or has obtained an Immortal’s treasure to rise rapidly, possessing his current powerful foundation, you must realize that he is ultimately only at the first tier of the Tongxuan Realm.”
“With Zimei Zhenyan, you, and me all missing from Qianyuan Divine Province, it will cause an uproar. Han Li won’t be able to hide it. When Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and White Emperor City all point their spears at him, what will he use to resist?”
Yuan Youwei turned around to look at the vast waves of the cloud sea, her slender and fair hands clasped behind her, and calmly said:
“I admit Han Li’s foundation took me by surprise, but that’s all it is. In front of the three most powerful forces, he is insignificant. Even the powerful Human Path Sword cannot withstand the attacks of three True Immortal soldiers, not to mention that the three strongest forces have more than ten Heavenly Immortal soldiers.”
“And don’t forget, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain is also a despised force in Qianyuan Divine Province. Right now, it only appears to be thriving on the surface, but once exposed, Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Penglai Immortal Sect, and other Great Holy Land Schools will also join in the attack. Chengsheng Mountain won’t be able to withstand it.”
“If you were to marry Han Li and become his Dao companion, you would be betraying the Huangyue Imperial Empire, abandoning the Empress of Huangyue, and becoming a partner in crime with Zimei Zhenyan. When Chengsheng Mountain falls, you too will be held accountable.”
“Even if you were to survive by chance, you would face severe punishment, and your future prospects would be completely destroyed. For Han Li, for a brief reprieve, do you really think it’s worth it?”
After speaking, Yuan Youwei no longer paid attention to Ji Mingyue, enjoying the scenery on her own, seemingly undisturbed by the predicament at hand.
In fact, Yuan Youwei also had her own thoughts but dismissed them after weighing the pros and cons. Compared to Chengsheng Mountain and Han Li, she put more faith in Yuanchu Mountain and Empress Yuanchu.
Han Li’s cultivation base was too low. Regardless of his boundless potential and limitless prospects, he had not yet fully grown and could be easily crushed by the three supreme beings.
Whether it was Zimei Zhenyan, Ji Mingyue, or herself, they all had connections with the strongest forces behind them. If their absence became prolonged, it would spark investigations by these powerful entities.
When that happened, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain would have nowhere to hide and would fall into the deadlock Yuan Youwei mentioned. Chengsheng Mountain simply did not have enough time to develop, and Yuan Youwei did not intend to perish alongside Han Li.
She was a Quasi Emperor with a bright future ahead. She still aspired to ascend to the Heaven Imperial Realm, to master the Heavenly Sovereign Path, to become a True Emperor, and to reign supreme over the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Discussing so much with Ji Mingyue was not because Yuan Youwei was kindhearted or had any particular affection for Ji Mingyue; Yuan Youwei just wanted to drag Ji Mingyue along, at least to buy some time, hoping to make Han Li wary and indecisive.

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: Chapter 230: The Beloved Ancestor Marries! The Joyful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon is Obtained!_2
Yuan Youwei felt a bit smug in her heart, thinking that as long as she could bring Ji Mingyue onto her side, based on Han Li’s behavior these past half a month, he would not easily harm either of them. This would allow them to maintain their status as Primordial Yin Bodies. If it were just herself, she would be isolated and vulnerable, not quite safe.
But Yuan Youwei was wrong; she didn’t understand Han Li at all. His behavior these past days had mostly been a pretense; her actions would only exhaust the last of Han Li’s patience and ultimately be counterproductive.
Yuan Youwei didn’t know this.
Every word from Yuan Youwei struck Ji Mingyue’s resolve like a hammer, turning her already pale complexion even whiter and leaving her even more at a loss.
Observing Yuan Youwei’s cool and peerless retreating figure, Ji Mingyue’s delicate lips were tightly pursed, and she remained silent, internally torn.
After taking a deep breath, Ji Mingyue spoke again, her voice grave, “Yuan Youwei, what if Han Li isn’t what you think?”
“Your actions will certainly provoke Han Li, and the outcome will be bad. Can we really hold out until the incident at Chengsheng Mountain?”
Ji Mingyue could clearly see what was going on in Yuan Youwei’s mind, but she dared not agree with her approach, as it was far too risky.
Yuan Youwei seemed to have forgotten that Han Li was a daring and bold man. He had even dared to defile the soul fragments of two peerless Empresses Yuanchu and Huangyue. How could they possibly escape the clutches of Han Li?
Ji Mingyue certainly didn’t believe Han Li to be a gentleman; his actions these days were surely just a facade.
If Han Li decided to force himself on them, they’d still end up being coerced into yielding to him, falling into his hands. They might wish to remain chaste, but fantasizing about it with no basis in reality was useless.
And from the information subtly revealed by Han Li over the past half month, the end result of willing and coerced unions were different.
If they willingly married Han Li, with their status, cultivation level, and beauty, they would be his Dao Companions, which would grant them a high status on Chengsheng Mountain. However, if they were coerced into marriage, whether they could become his Dao Companions was debatable.
The term “Dao Companion” represented their status and identity on Chengsheng Mountain, the cultivation resources they would receive, and the privileges and benefits they would enjoy.
The reason Ji Mingyue wavered and no longer stuck to her own opinion was that she now understood this point. After all, she was only at the mid-stage of the Saint Abyss Realm. In terms of combat ability, Han Li was not much weaker than her, so being his Dao Companion was not embarrassing.
Otherwise, if they were forced into submission, their situation would be dire. By the time reinforcements from White Emperor City, Yuanchu Mountain, and Huangyue Imperial Empire arrived, they would have lost everything.
Not only would they have already lost their chastity by then, but in such a scenario, they might also have their cultivation crippled or even be killed outright. Even if Chengsheng Mountain was destroyed, it would be of no use to Ji Mingyue; it would not be worth it at all.
“Would he dare?” Yuan Youwei said lightly, seemingly confident.
She was a Quasi Emperor, the future Empress of the Heaven Imperial Realm. To be forced to marry a cultivator of only the first level of the Tongxuan Realm would be too humiliating for her. Yuan Youwei’s pride did not allow for this.
If Han Li wanted her alone, or only wanted her, Ji Mingyue, and Zi Miao Zhen as his three Dao Companions, Yuan Youwei might reluctantly agree. But Han Li had too many wives and concubines; she could not accept this.
Yuan Youwei was certain that Han Li wouldn’t dare to kill her; otherwise, the issues at Chengsheng Mountain would be exposed in an instant, and Han Li was far from being a match for Empress Yuanchu.
If she employed some strategies, she also had the confidence to make Han Li neither dare nor be forceful enough to defile her against her will.
Ji Mingyue opened her mouth to speak but then hesitated. She wanted to say that Han Li might indeed dare, but in the end, she remained silent.
Yuan Youwei’s situation was different from hers; what Ji Mingyue was willing to do, Yuan Youwei might not be.
“Ji Mingyue, think carefully about it. Don’t do anything foolish,” Yuan Youwei turned around, glanced at the hesitant and conflicted Ji Mingyue, gently touched her exquisite face with her hand, and then left.
Watching Yuan Youwei depart silently, Ji Mingyue looked once more at the churning sea of clouds before leaving to return to her own chamber, needing solitude.
Chengdao Peak, Qiandao Hall.
Han Li was discussing the Dao with Zi Miao Zhen, debating the great truths of life. For a moment, flowers rained down from the heavens, and golden lotuses sprouted from the ground, with constant divine music gracing their ears.
Han Li had also spared a portion of his mind to control his Divine Sense, keeping watch over Cloud View Terrace and listening intently to every word exchanged between Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei. He made no comments, deciding to address it later.
After retracting his Divine Sense, Han Li wrapped his arms tightly around the beautiful and sweet Zi Miao Zhen, focusing entirely on her.
In a flash, Zi Miao Zhen’s eyes became dazed, and beneath her floating, violet hair was her enchantingly affectionate and exquisite face.
…..
The next day, Han Li came alone to Cloud View Terrace, with Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei also arriving on time.
Han Li’s hands rested on the balustrade as he gazed into the distance at the rising morning sun, waiting for the first rays of light to pierce the perpetual night and a streak of dawn’s purple qi to be drawn into his mouth.
It was then that Han Li turned around to take a good look at Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei.
Ji Mingyue had removed the light veil from her face, presenting her stunning visage to Han Li, seemingly indicating her attitude.
Yuan Youwei, still veiled and as cold as ever, maintained an aloof expression as if Han Li owed her ten Heavenly Immortal weapons. Her arms were crossed, attempting to convey a superior attitude towards Han Li.
“Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, how have you two decided?” Han Li asked, his tone laced with a smile.
Yuan Youwei looked at Ji Mingyue and shook her head slightly. Ignoring Yuan Youwei’s hint, Ji Mingyue spoke indifferently, “I am willing to be your Dao Companion.”
“Whatever you give to Zi Miao Zhen, you must give to me as well. You cannot treat me any less fairly,” she added.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 577: Chapter 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_3
Ji Mingyue stared into Han Li’s eyes and spoke solemnly.
After pondering for another night, she ultimately decided to accept Han Li’s offer. If she was going to be Han Li’s Dao companion, so be it.
If Zimei could do it, so could Ji Mingyue!
But Ji Mingyue had her conditions; she didn’t want to be undervalued. She wanted to receive the same as Zimei. She had observed Zimei for quite some time and noticed that Zimei truly thrived at Chengsheng Mountain.
“Okay,” Han Li nodded in agreement.
Ji Mingyue’s reaction was within his expectations. This proud Heavenly Immortal eventually lowered her haughty head to Han Li.
Given the heights of Ji Mingyue and Han Li, if Ji Mingyue were to kneel on the ground, it seemed just right.
Ji Mingyue, after all, was a mid-stage Saint Abyss Realm female saint, ranked twenty-seventh in the Heavenly Immortal list, not only having a higher cultivation than Zimei but also a higher ranking.
If Ji Mingyue willingly became his Dao companion, Han Li wouldn’t wrong her in the slightest. Whatever Zimei had, Ji Mingyue would have as well.
Of course, what he referred to were the things he had promised Zimei; those she obtained later on her own were excluded, as those were earned by Zimei’s own capabilities.
Upon hearing this, Ji Mingyue let out a sigh of relief, and a radiant, breathtakingly beautiful smile blossomed on her flawless face, making the morning dawn seem dull in comparison and all things appear ashamed.
Han Li turned to the cold and proud Yuan Youwei and said, “Yuan Youwei, what about you?”
“Hehe~”
Yuan Youwei let out a cold chuckle without answering Han Li’s question and instead said to Ji Mingyue, “Ji Mingyue, you have disappointed me.”
Ji Mingyue hadn’t followed her scheme, and Yuan Youwei was quite annoyed. It cost her a significant bargaining chip, and now she felt somewhat at a disadvantage.
“Yuan Youwei, you’re not yet qualified to talk about me.” Ji Mingyue rebuffed her without mincing words.
Half a month ago, Yuan Youwei took advantage of her higher cultivation to bully her, which had been irritating for Ji Mingyue;
Now that they were both in Han Li’s hands, with their cultivation and power completely sealed, Ji Mingyue still considered herself superior, looking down on her, which made Ji Mingyue even more annoyed.
If she was annoyed, then she wouldn’t indulge Yuan Youwei.
Now that she had become Han Li’s Dao companion, she didn’t have to worry about Zimei targeting her; she could find ways to target Yuan Youwei instead, believing that Han Li would turn a blind eye.
“Humph~”
After being rebuffed by Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei snorted coldly and ignored her, turning to Han Li and saying,
“Han Li, if you want me to be your Dao companion, it’s not impossible. Either defeat me without using any external aids, or give me a Heavenly Immortal weapon. Just fulfill one of these conditions.”
“I think you’re dreaming,” Han Li said indifferently, his expression unchanging.
Since Yuan Youwei was daydreaming, Han Li decided to wake her up to reality, leaving her with only her dreams.
Then, Han Li left the Cloud View Terrace with Ji Mingyue, leaving Yuan Youwei behind.
“Hoo~”
It wasn’t until long after Han Li and Ji Mingyue had left that Yuan Youwei exhaled deeply, feeling significantly more at ease.
She intentionally set those two conditions to trouble Han Li, knowing that he wouldn’t be able to fulfill them. Han Li couldn’t defeat her, nor would he give her his only Immortal weapon.
As long as she could provoke and restrain Han Li, he wouldn’t lay hands on her easily, and she could still maintain her complete state.
Unlike the foolish Ji Mingyue, who chose a life of base subservience for short-term benefits, disgracefully accepting Han Li’s favor on bended knee. Truly despicable.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Han Li and Ji Mingyue stood there, with Ji Mingyue held in Han Li’s embrace, her delicate body trembling, but she made no struggle.
Feeling the potent masculine scent, Ji Mingyue took a deep breath and asked, “Han Li, what are your plans for Yuan Youwei?”
She was curious to see what would become of Yuan Youwei.
Ji Mingyue didn’t believe that Han Li would be easily provoked by Yuan Youwei. Han Li was no naive youth; he was a man of cunning and deceit.
“Mingyue, you will find out later,” Han Li said with a smile, offering no explanation.
But he had already sentenced Yuan Youwei in his heart.
If you won’t be my Dao companion, then become my servant concubine! That’s right, Han Li had demoted Ji Mingyue from the status of Dao companion to that of a female slave, not even willing to grant her the dignity of a consort or servant concubine.
This was the path Ji Mingyue had chosen for herself, and so she must kneel and bear Han Li’s punishment.
He hadn’t yet tried punishing a Quasi Emperor female slave, and once he married Ji Mingyue, he could teach Yuan Youwei a lesson.
Since Elder Han’s machinations ran deep, Yuan Youwei’s lesson would undoubtedly be profound.
“Let’s not talk about it then,”
Ji Mingyue huffed pretentiously, feigning anger, yet her heart pounded with nervous excitement; this was her first time being so close to a man.
Han Li immediately transformed into the ultimate lover, his sweet nothings effortlessly making Ji Mingyue happy again, and Elder Han was on a roll.
Ji Mingyue silently endured, not knowing when her originally fair skin turned a faint shade of pink. Her entire body blushes, even to the tips of her ears.
Han Li, that lecher, hadn’t hesitated to take his liberties, causing Ji Mingyue’s breathing to become increasingly rapid.
As Han Li explored her high mountains and great rivers and passed her flat belly, preparing to march downwards, Ji Mingyue suddenly grasped Han Li’s hand and shook her head at him.
Han Li chose to respect Ji Mingyue’s wishes and did not pursue further; instead, he simply cuddled with the stunning beauty in his arms, whispering sweet nothings.
When passion escalated, Han Li inevitably lowered his head, and Ji Mingyue willingly closed her eyes, enjoying the moment in silence.
She thought that perhaps this wasn’t too bad.
When it all ended, having successfully claimed Ji Mingyue’s soft lips, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face as he said, “Mingyue, take good care of this.”

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_4

Chapter 578: Chapter 230: The Great Loving Ancestor Gets Married! Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_4
Han Li took out a Mutton Fat Jade Vial, inside which was sealed a Taoism Pill.
Ji Mingyue received the vial, somewhat surprised by what Han Li was doing, her face filled with confusion as she looked at him.
Han Li spoke tenderly, “Mingyue, this is a Taoism Pill.”
Ji Mingyue’s pupils constricted sharply, her jade hand trembling, nearly dropping the vial; her flawless face was covered in shock.
“You’re not joking, are you?” Ji Mingyue swallowed hard, asking in disbelief.
She certainly knew what a Taoism Pill was. It was an Emperor Pill that could help a Great Saint ascend to the rank of Quasi Emperor, possessing heaven-defying effects that all Saints of the Saint Abyss realm yearned for.
Beyond increasing the chances of a successful breakthrough, the Taoism Pill had another wondrous effect, which was precisely what Ji Mingyue valued most.
“Open it and see,” Han Li said with a smile.
“I have said before, what Yuan Youwei has, you will also have. The Taoism Pill is just one of these things,” Han Li continued.
Ji Mingyue hesitated but eventually opened the Mutton Fat Jade Vial. As the rich fragrance of the pill hit her, she inhaled the scent and observed the pill patterns, becoming slightly dazed by them.
Her Dao companion was truly generous. No wonder Zi Miaozhen was willing to become one of Han Li’s Dao companions.
And this was only one of them.
What benefits had Zi Miaozhen received from Han Li after all?
“If Yuan Youwei knew about the treatment I have, she would probably regret it to the point of turning green with envy,” Ji Mingyue said with a laugh as she put away the Mutton Fat Jade Vial and took a deep breath to calm her emotions.
“One makes their own choices,” Han Li said with a smile, not adding anything more.
Several days later,
The venerable ancestor of Han Mansion has taken another wife—again!
This news spread rapidly throughout the Daqian Empire and the entire Xuan Domain.
However, apart from the Daqian Empire and some nearby forces, other powers in the Xuan Domain had become numb to it, showing no surprise or shock whatsoever.
If the old ancestor of Han Mansion didn’t frequently take wives and concubines, would he truly live up to the title of the Great Love Ancestor?
During this time, Han Li had not only married Zi Miaozhen but also taken many beautiful wives and concubines, all high-quality and beautiful female cultivators sent by various forces of the Xuan Domain.
Han Li welcomed those he took a liking to, keeping them all, and those he didn’t fancy were not returned but left for his descendants.
Shortly after the grandiose wedding ceremony concluded, Han Li couldn’t wait to enter Ji Mingyue’s bridal chamber.
For this moment, Han Li had held back for several days, having cleared all but the final hurdle.
Ji Mingyue had insisted on waiting until their wedding night for him to ultimately prevail, and Han Li had no choice but to bear it. He didn’t want to force her since Ji Mingyue was his Dao companion, and Han Li would try his best to respect their wishes.
When Han Li entered the bridal chamber, he saw Ji Mingyue dressed in full bridal red, her beauty mesmerizing.
Brimming with excitement, Han Li lifted her red veil and gazed upon her perfect and unparalleled beauty, his passion no longer containable.
(The following content is unsuitable for description; dear readers, please use your imagination)
The next day, early morning.
Han Li held Ji Mingyue’s peerless form in his arms, still exhilarated, even after selflessly sharing countless profound Daoist teachings; he was having the time of his life.
After constant interaction, Han Li felt that Ji Mingyue was not as aloof as she had seemed before, but was, in fact, very gentle.
Her body was warm, and her figure was soft.
Gazing at the deeply sleeping Ji Mingyue, Han Li gently kissed her forehead and vanished.
Arriving at the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li opened the treasure chest page and his face beamed with joy as he looked at the prize revealed.
The chance to open a treasure chest refreshed naturally each month, and Han Li had not used it yet; he was waiting for this moment to ride on the wave of fortune.
The previous night had been the best opportunity. Han Li had ridden on Ji Mingyue’s good luck, and truly like a lucky star, he struck gold with a wonderful item.
“Ding, treasure chest opened successfully, congratulations to the master for obtaining the Heaven Immortal Rank Treasure – Primordial Chaos Cauldron!”
Han Li could not help but laugh heartily as he looked at the system notice scrolling at the top of the treasure chest page.
The second Heaven Immortal weapon was in his hands!
The Primordial Chaos Cauldron!
He, Elder Han, had finally risen once more.
With the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, an Immortal Rank Treasure, the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain surged greatly.
