Yuan Youwei stared directly into Ji Mingyue’s beautiful eyes, causing Ji Mingyue to avert her gaze, though such thoughts indeed had crossed her mind.
“Ji Mingyue, I urge you to think it over carefully; Han Li is not worthy of you,” Yuan Youwei continued.
“Whether Han Li is a reincarnation of an immortal or has risen suddenly due to finding an immortal treasure and possessing his current formidable resources, you must remember that he is ultimately just at the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm.”
“With the disappearance of Zimei, you, and me all at once in the Qianyuan Divine Province, it will undoubtedly cause a stir. Han Li won’t be able to hide it, and once Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and White Emperor City all set their sights on him, how will Han Li withstand their pressure?”
Yuan Youwei turned away, looking at the vast sea of clouds with her slender, fair hands clasped behind her back, and spoke lightly:
“I admit Han Li’s resources were beyond my expectations, but that’s all. He doesn’t stand a chance against the three paramount forces. The Path-seeking Sword, no matter how powerful, cannot withstand the attack from three True Immortal weapons, let alone the fact that the three paramount forces possess over ten Heavenly Immortal weapons.”
“And don’t forget, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain is also a target for all in the Qianyuan Divine Province. Right now, its surface may seem splendid, but once exposed, schools such as Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Penglai Immortal Sect will also join the attack, and Chengsheng Mountain won’t be able to withstand it.”
“If you marry Han Li as a Dao companion, that would mean betraying the Huangyue Imperial Empire, forsaking the Huangyue Empress, and wallowing with Zimei in infamy. When Chengsheng Mountain falls, you too will be held accountable.”
“Even if you’re lucky enough to survive, you’ll face severe punishment and your future will be ruined. For the sake of Han Li, for a brief respite, is it really worth it?”
After saying her piece, Yuan Youwei no longer paid attention to Ji Mingyue, instead enjoying the scenery by herself, as if her Dao heart was undisturbed by the crisis at hand.
In truth, Yuan Youwei also had her own considerations but had dismissed them after weighing the pros and cons. She believed more in Yuanchu Mountain and Empress Yuanchu than in Chengsheng Mountain or Han Li.
Han Li’s cultivation was too low, and even with boundless potential and a limitless future, he had not yet matured and would easily be suppressed by the three supreme beings.
Whether it was Zimei, Ji Mingyue, or herself, each was connected to a powerful force behind them. Should that connection be severed for too long, it would attract the search and vengeance of those forces.
At that time, Han Li’s Chengsheng Mountain would have nowhere to hide and would fall into the predicament Yuan Youwei described. Chengsheng Mountain simply didn’t have enough time to expand, and Yuan Youwei had no desire to be buried alongside Han Li.
She was a Quasi Emperor, with a bright future ahead of her; she aspired to advance to the Heaven Imperial Realm, wield the Heavenly Sovereign Path, ascend to emperorship, and become the exalted empress of the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Speaking so much to Ji Mingyue wasn’t because Yuan Youwei was kind-hearted or had a relationship with Ji Mingyue. Yuan Youwei merely wanted to bring Ji Mingyue along to buy more time, at least to make Han Li wary and hesitant.

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - 230: Han Laozu Gets Married Again! The Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 580: Chapter 230: Han Laozu Gets Married Again! The Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_2
Yuan Youwei felt somewhat self-satisfied in her heart, believing that as long as she aligned herself with Ji Mingyue, based on Han Li’s conduct over the past half month, he would not easily harm either of them. This alliance would allow them to maintain their Primordial Yin Bodies. Had it been only her, she would have been isolated and vulnerable, which felt much less secure.
Unfortunately, Yuan Youwei was mistaken. She didn’t understand Han Li at all. Most of his behavior during these days was a facade, and her actions would only exhaust his last bit of patience, ultimately backfiring on her.
But Yuan Youwei didn’t know this.
Every word spoken by Yuan Youwei struck Ji Mingyue’s cultivator’s heart like a heavy hammer, her complexion turning deathly pale and leaving her even more at a loss.
Looking at Yuan Youwei’s cold and peerless departing figure, Ji Mingyue’s delicate lips were tightly pursed, silent, waging an internal battle within her heart.
Taking a deep breath, Ji Mingyue spoke up again, her voice heavy as she asked, “Yuan Youwei, what if Han Li is not as you expect?”
“By acting this way, you will definitely anger Han Li. When that happens, there will be no good outcome, can you really last until the incident at Chengsheng Mountain?”
It was clear to Ji Mingyue what Yuan Youwei was thinking, but she dared not agree with it. Yuan Youwei’s approach was much too risky.
Yuan Youwei seemed to have forgotten that Han Li was a man of tremendous daring, who even dared to defile the split souls of the two peerless Empresses of Empress Yuanchu and the Huangyue Imperial Empire. How could the two of them escape the Devil’s Palm of Han Li?
Ji Mingyue didn’t believe Han Li was a gentleman; his behavior these days was just an act.
If Han Li were to force himself on them, they would still be compelled to lose their chastity to Han Li, falling into his hands, still wishing to maintain their virtue as if they were dreaming.
And based on the information that had subtly transpired from Han Li over the past half month, the outcomes of submitting willingly and being forced were not the same.
If they were to marry Han Li willingly, with their status, cultivation, and beauty, they would become Han Li’s Cultivation companions, holding a very high status on Chengsheng Mountain; whereas if they were forced, whether they could become Cultivation companions was another matter.
The term “Cultivation companions” represented their status on Chengsheng Mountain, signifying the cultivation resources they acquired and the privileges and benefits they enjoyed.
The reason Ji Mingyue was wavering, no longer holding to her own views, was because she saw this clearly. After all, she was merely at the middle stage of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and in terms of combat ability, Han Li was not much weaker than her; becoming Han Li’s Cultivation companion wouldn’t be disgraceful.
Otherwise, if she was forced to lose her chastity, their situation would be quite miserable. By the time White Emperor City, Yuanchu Mountain, and the Huangyue Imperial Empire came to the rescue, they would have lost everything.
Not only would they have already lost their chastity, but under those circumstances, they would likely be stripped of their cultivation or even killed outright. Even if Chengsheng Mountain was destroyed, it would be of no use to Ji Mingyue—not worthwhile at all.
“Would he dare?” Yuan Youwei said faintly, seemingly very confident.
She was a Quasi Emperor, the future Empress of the Heaven Imperial Realm. The idea of being forced to marry a mere Cultivator of the Tongxuan Realm was an insult to her. Yuan Youwei’s pride would not allow that.
If Han Li had only her as his Cultivation companion, or just Zimei Zhen, Ji Mingyue, and the three of them, Yuan Youwei could reluctantly agree. But Han Li’s wives and concubines were too numerous; she couldn’t accept that.
Yuan Youwei was convinced Han Li wouldn’t dare kill her, otherwise the truth about Chengsheng Mountain would be revealed in an instant, and Han Li was far from being a match for Empress Yuanchu.
If she were to employ some strategies, she was also confident that she could make Han Li neither dare nor force her, thus preventing forced loss of chastity.
Ji Mingyue opened her mouth as if she wanted to say that Han Li might really dare, but ultimately she remained silent.
Yuan Youwei’s situation was different from hers; what Ji Mingyue was willing to do, Yuan Youwei might not be.
“Ji Mingyue, you should think carefully again and not do anything foolish,” Yuan Youwei said.
Yuan Youwei turned around, looked at the conflicted and hesitating Ji Mingyue, and, stretching out her jade hand, caressed her stunning face before leaving.
Watching Yuan Youwei depart in silence, Ji Mingyue glanced at the surging sea of clouds and left as well, returning to her own chambers. She wanted to be alone with her thoughts.
At Chengdao Peak, inside Qiandao Hall.
Han Li was discussing cultivation and the great paths of life with Zimei Zhen. Flowers rained down chaotically, golden lotuses sprung up from the ground, and melodious sounds of immortality filled the air continuously.
Han Li also diverted a portion of his concentration to control his Divine Sense, monitoring the Cloud View Terrace. He heard every word of the conversation between Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei, clearly, but he made no judgments, deciding to deal with it later.
Withdrawing his Divine Sense, Han Li focused entirely on exchanging cultivation insights with his sweet and lovely wife, Zimei Zhen.
Sometime later, the eyes of Zimei Zhen became hazy, and beneath her dancing purple hair was an alluring and passionate visage that was absolutely beautiful.
…..
The next day, Han Li came alone to the Cloud View Terrace, and Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei arrived on time as well.
Han Li’s hands rested on the railing as he gazed into the distance at the rising sun. As the first ray of sunlight broke through the night, a trace of the morning’s purple dawn qi was inhaled by Han Li.
Only then did Han Li turn around to assess Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei.
Ji Mingyue had removed her veil, revealing her stunning visage before Han Li, apparently indicating her disposition.
Yuan Youwei, still wearing her veil, remained cold and distant, her face set like she was being owed ten Heavenly Immortal Weapons by Han Li. Her arms were crossed, and she tried to exhibit a posture of looking down upon Han Li.
“Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, have the two of you come to a decision?” Han Li said with a hint of a smile.
Yuan Youwei glanced at Ji Mingyue, shaking her head slightly, but Ji Mingyue ignored Yuan Youwei’s hint and calmly said, “I can become your Cultivation companion.”
“Whatever you give Zimei Zhen, you must give me the same. You shall not wrong me in the slightest.”

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - 230: Han Laozu Gets Married Again! The Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 581: Chapter 230: Han Laozu Gets Married Again! The Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_3
Ji Mingyue stared into Han Li’s eyes, her voice grave.
She had thought about it all night, and ultimately decided to agree to Han Li’s proposal. If she was going to become Han Li’s Dao companion, she would just be it.
If Zimiao could do it, she, Ji Mingyue, could do it too!
However, Ji Mingyue had her conditions; she didn’t want to be undervalued and demanded the same treatment as Zimiao, who, she noticed, was living a good life on Chengsheng Mountain.
“Agreed,” Han Li nodded.
Ji Mingyue’s response hadn’t been unexpected to him—the proud Heavenly Immortal fairy ultimately bowed her haughty head to Han Li.
Considering the height difference between Ji Mingyue and Han Li, it seemed she would be at just the right height if she kneeled before him.
Ji Mingyue, after all, was a female Saint of the mid-stage Sacred Abyss realm, ranked twenty-seventh on the Heavenly Immortal list. Her cultivation was not only higher than Zimiao’s but her ranking was as well.
If Ji Mingyue was willing to become his Dao companion voluntarily, Han Li would not treat her any less favorably than Zimiao. What Zimiao had, Ji Mingyue would have as well.
Of course, this referred to the things that Han Li had promised Zimiao; anything Zimiao later obtained on her own merit was not included, as those were earned by her own abilities.
Upon hearing these words, Ji Mingyue breathed a sigh of relief. A brilliantly beautiful smile emerged on her flawless visage, outshining the morning sun and making all else look drab in comparison.
Han Li turned his gaze to the cold and proud Yuan Youwei, asking, “What about you, Yuan Youwei?”
“Heh~”
Yuan Youwei let out a cold laugh, ignoring Han Li’s question and instead spoke to Ji Mingyue: “Ji Mingyue, you’ve disappointed me.”
Ji Mingyue had not followed her plans, which greatly annoyed Yuan Youwei, causing her to lose a significant bargaining chip, leaving her somewhat helpless.
“Yuan Youwei, you’re not yet qualified to speak about me,” Ji Mingyue retorted without giving an inch.
Half a month ago, Yuan Youwei took advantage of her higher cultivation to bully her, which had really irked Ji Mingyue;
Now, both of them had fallen into Han Li’s hands, their cultivation and strength completely sealed. Ji Mingyue still held herself in high regard, looking down on her, which irritated her even more.
If she was irritated, then she wouldn’t indulge Yuan Youwei.
Now that she had become Han Li’s Dao companion, she no longer needed to worry about Zimiao targeting her. Instead, she could think of ways to target Yuan Youwei, believing Han Li would turn a blind eye.
“Hmph~”
After being rebuffed by Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei snorted coldly and stopped paying her any attention. She looked at Han Li and said, “I’m not against the idea of becoming your Dao companion, Han Li. Either defeat me without relying on external forces or give me a Heavenly Immortal weapon. Fulfilling either condition would suffice.”
“You must be dreaming,” Han Li replied, his expression unchanged.
Seeing that Yuan Youwei was indulging in daydreams, Han Li decided to wake her up and let her keep dreaming alone.
Han Li then left Cloud View Terrace with Ji Mingyue, leaving Yuan Youwei behind.
“Phew~”
It was a while after Han Li and Ji Mingyue had left when Yuan Youwei finally exhaled, feeling considerably relaxed.
She had deliberately set those two conditions to trouble Han Li, knowing he couldn’t meet them. He wouldn’t be able to defeat her, nor would he give her the only Heavenly Immortal weapon he had.
As long as she could provoke Han Li sufficiently, he would not dare to touch her lightly, and she could still retain her intactness.
Unlike the foolish woman Ji Mingyue who, for the sake of fleeting benefits, chose to live on her knees and become Han Li’s Dao companion—how lowly.
Atop Chengdao Peak.
Han Li and Ji Mingyue stood there, Ji Mingyue wrapped in his embrace, her delicate body trembling, but she did not struggle.
Feeling the strong masculine scent, Ji Mingyue took a deep breath and asked, “Han Li, what are your plans for Yuan Youwei?”
She was curious to know what fate would befall Yuan Youwei.
Ji Mingyue did not believe that Yuan Youwei could provoke Han Li into inaction. Han Li was not some naive youngster; he was deeply scheming and cunning.
“Mingyue, you will find out soon enough,” Han Li smiled and didn’t elaborate.
But he had already sentenced Yuan Youwei in his heart.
If you will not become my Dao companion, then become my female slave!
Indeed, Han Li had directly demoted Ji Mingyue from the status of Dao companion to that of a female slave, not even considering her for the position of a secondary wife or servant concubine.
This was the path Ji Mingyue had chosen for herself, so she would have to kneel and accept Han Li’s punishment.
He had not yet experienced punishing a Quasi Emperor female slave, but once he married Ji Mingyue, he could set an example for Yuan Youwei.
Grand Ancestor Han’s lessons were profound, so Yuan Youwei’s lesson would certainly be a deep one.
“Never mind then,” Ji Mingyue hummed softly, pretending to be annoyed while her heart actually pounded with excitement, as this was her first time being so close with someone of the opposite sex.
Han Li immediately transformed into a romantic, cooing sweet nothings that cheered Ji Mingyue up, showing how skilled Grand Ancestor Han was at courtship.
Ji Mingyue endured silently, her normally pale skin like fine jade somehow taking on a light blush, her entire body flushed with the same hue, even to her earlobes.
Han Li, that lustful man, didn’t hesitate to get frisky even before she had married into his household, leading to Ji Mingyue’s breathing becoming more rapid.
When Han Li’s exploration moved from the peaks and valleys to her flat belly, preparing to venture further, Ji Mingyue suddenly grabbed his large hand and shook her head at him.
Han Li chose to respect Ji Mingyue’s wishes and did not proceed further, simply cuddling with the stunning beauty in his arms, their cheeks brushing against each other’s.
As emotions deepened, Han Li instinctively lowered his head, and Ji Mingyue voluntarily closed her eyes, silently savoring the moment.
She thought to herself that this didn’t seem too bad.

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - 230: Han Laozu Gets Married Again! The Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 582: Chapter 230: Han Laozu Gets Married Again! The Blissful Ji Mingyue! Treasure Chest Explosion, the Second Immortal Weapon Obtained!_4
Han Li took out a Mutton Fat Jade Vial, sealed inside was a pill.
Ji Mingyue received the Mutton Fat Jade Vial, somewhat surprised at what Han Li was doing, and looked at him with puzzled eyes.
With deep feeling and affection, Han Li said, “Mingyue, inside there is a Taoism Pill.”
Ji Mingyue’s pupils constricted sharply, her jade-like hand nearly lost its grip, almost dropping the jade vial; her flawless face was filled with shock.
“You’re not joking, are you?” Ji Mingyue swallowed, asking disbelievingly.
She certainly knew what a Taoism Pill was—it was an Emperor Pill that helped Great Saints ascend to the Quasi Emperor level, possessing miraculous effects coveted by all Saints of the Saint Abyss realm.
Besides increasing the success rate of a breakthrough, the Taoism Pill had another wondrous effect, which was what Ji Mingyue most valued.
“Just open it and you’ll see,” Han Li said with a smile.
“I’ve said before, what Zhen’er has, you will have too; the Taoism Pill is just one of them.”
Ji Mingyue hesitated, but still opened the Mutton Fat Jade Vial. As the rich scent of the pill assailed her, smelling its fragrance and observing its patterns, Ji Mingyue was momentarily entranced.
Her Dao companion was truly generous. No wonder Zi Miaozhen was willing to become one of Han Li’s Dao companions.
And this was just one of them.
How many benefits had Zi Miaozhen received from Han Li in the end?
“If Yuan Youwei knew the treatment I had, she probably would already be regretting to the point of turning green,” Ji Mingyue muttered to herself as she put away the Mutton Fat Jade Vial, taking a deep breath to calm her emotions and smiling.
“Choices are made by oneself,” Han Li said with a laugh, not elaborating further.
Several days later,
The Grand Love Ancestor married yet again!
This news spread rapidly throughout the Daqian Empire and into the entire Xuan Domain.
But aside from the Daqian Empire and some nearby forces, other powers in the Xuan Domain were numb to it, unshaken and not at all surprised.
If the ancestor of the Han Mansion didn’t frequently take wives and concubines, could he still be called the Grand Love Ancestor?
In this period, Han Li had welcomed more than just Zi Miaozhen but also married many beautiful and tender wives and concubines, all of whom were high-quality and beautiful female cultivators sent by various powers of the Xuan Domain.
Whomever Han Li fancied, he accepted them all without exception; and those whom he did not favor, he wouldn’t send back but leave them for his descendants.
After the grand and magnificent wedding ceremony had concluded, Han Li was eager to go to Ji Mingyue’s bridal chamber.
He had endured for several days for this moment; besides the last hurdle, he had already passed all the others.
Ji Mingyue insisted that it would be only on the wedding night that she would let him claim victory; Han Li had no choice but to be patient, unwilling to force her, since Ji Mingyue was his Dao companion, and he would try to comply with their wishes.
When Han Li entered the bridal chamber, he immediately looked at Ji Mingyue, clad in bridal red; she was stunningly breathtaking.
With an excited heart, Han Li lifted her red bridal veil, gazing upon her perfect, peerless face; his burning heart could no longer contain itself.
(This is a plot that cannot be described; dear readers, please use your imagination.)
The next day, in the early morning.
Han Li, still excited, cradled Ji Mingyue’s incomparably delicate body. Even after selflessly offering countless profound Daoist teachings, Han Li enjoyed himself immensely.
Through constant exchange, Han Li felt that Ji Mingyue wasn’t as cold as she had initially seemed but rather very gentle.
Her body was warm, her tender body was soft.
Looking at Ji Mingyue, who had fallen into a deep sleep, Han Li gently kissed her forehead and disappeared from sight.
Arriving at the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li opened the treasure chest page, and his face showed sheer joy upon seeing the treasure that was revealed.
This month’s opportunity to open the treasure chest had naturally refreshed; Han Li had not used it, waiting for this moment to use it to ride on his luck.
Last night was naturally the best time, Han Li used Ji Mingyue’s fortune, and indeed, fortune smiled upon him; he hit the jackpot and unveiled something good.
“Ding, treasure chest opened successfully; congratulations, master, on obtaining the Heaven Immortal Rank Treasure[Primordial Chaos Cauldron]!”
Han Li, seeing the system notification flowing at the top of the treasure chest page, couldn’t help but burst into hearty laughter.
The second Heaven Immortal weapon was in his hands now!
Primordial Chaos Cauldron!
He, Old Ancestor Han, had finally risen again.
With the possession of the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain rose tremendously once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - 231: The Primitive World! Regretful Yuan Youwei! The blissful life of Elder Han! Zimiao Zhen has given birth!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 583: Chapter 231: The Primitive World! Regretful Yuan Youwei! The blissful life of Elder Han! Zimiao Zhen has given birth!_1
Primordial Chaos Cauldron!
In Han Li’s right hand, he cradled a small cauldron, square-shaped with four legs and two ears. On each of its four sides, there seemed to be murals that faintly emitted a terrifying aura.
Both the Primordial Chaos Cauldron and the Path of Man Sword could only carry one Grand Dao. However, the might of the Primordial Chaos Cauldron was much weaker compared to the Path of Man Sword, being only a top-grade Heavenly Immortal weapon.
Nevertheless, Han Li was quite satisfied. At last, he had a second Immortal weapon, which would give his words more weight.
Han Li’s eyes emitted two beams of divine light as he gazed at the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, discovering that it seemed to truly contain a primitive world within. It was vast and chaotic, with the clear and turbid yet to separate, the Grand Dao looming within the endless expanse.
Han Li stared intently at the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, which was bobbing up and down in his hand. A trace of an unusual color flashed in his eyes as he suddenly had a bold idea.
Could he completely open up the primitive world within the Primordial Chaos Cauldron?
If he succeeded, he would become a man who possessed a world.
In the future, when facing danger, he could take all of the Han Mansion’s clan members into the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, allowing them to live inside or perhaps even move in directly.
This would significantly reduce Han Li’s restraints; even in the face of irresistible events, he would be able to flee with ease with the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, ensuring a lifetime of effort wouldn’t be destroyed in an instant.
As long as his descendants remained, the speed of his strength increase would not slow down. He wouldn’t have to start over, and Han Li certainly did not fancy making a comeback.
“What a pity,” he lamented, retracting his thoughts with a sigh.
His strength was insufficient—he couldn’t force open the heavens and earth. Not everyone could emulate the great God Pangu.
He could only wait for an opportunity in the future.
“Hongyun.”
Han Li called out.
In a flash, the Primordial Chaos Cauldron burst forth with a beam of immortal light, and a lovely, flawless figure appeared beside Han Li.
When she appeared, brilliant immortal light swirled around her, transforming into countless flower petals that set off her ethereal beauty, as if she was about to ascend to the heavens.
She was a Fairy of the Ripples, otherworldly and pure. Clad in red, her unparalleled beauty shone. Her long, jet-black hair fell straight to her slender waist, and her figure was tall and perfect, with looks unrivaled in the world.
Her body was as exquisite as Jade Stone, smooth and snow-white, suffused with immortal light. Her beautiful eyes were misty, stirring hearts, and her lips were thin and stunning, with a complexion of astonishing loveliness.
She was the Artifact Spirit of the Primordial Chaos Cauldron: Hongyun.
Although Hongyun was not a true Heavenly Immortal, she resembled one astoundingly—a flawless being, her temperament transcending the mundane world.
“Master~”
Hongyun’s voice, soothing and melodious like the music of immortals, cleansed Han Li’s Primordial Spirit as if bathing in the spring breeze.
Looking at the red-clad Heavenly Immortal before him, Han Li would be lying if he said he wasn’t moved. However, he swiftly contained himself and asked with a smile, “Hongyun, is it possible for you to create a conduit to absorb Immortal Qi?”
Han Li was hopeful. If it were possible, then the accumulation of Immortal Qi within the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain would speed up significantly.
Currently, only the Dao Force granted by the Path of Man Sword enabled the Secret Territory to slowly absorb Immortal Qi, albeit at a very slow pace, able to take in only a wisp of Immortal Qi each day.
The quality of Immortal Qi was very high, containing energy more refined and vast than Higher Level Spiritual Energy. Five wisps of Immortal Qi would fully revive a top-grade Emperor Weapon, equivalent to two thousand Spirit Sources.
Twenty-five to fifty wisps of Immortal Qi could fully revive a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon, while a standard Heavenly Immortal Weapon would require thousands of wisps of Immortal Qi for full revival.
The Primordial Chaos Cauldron, as a top-tier Heavenly Immortal Weapon, needed even more Immortal Qi, not to mention the Path of Man Sword, which at full revival would consume at least tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of wisps of Immortal Qi.
Relying on the slow accumulation within the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain, it would take a hundred years for the Path of Man Sword to gather enough strength for a full-force battle. With other consumptions in between, it might take even longer.
“Master, no problem at all.”
Hongyun’s voice was light and graceful, her stunning face wearing a smile that made even the sun and moon lose their luster.
Han Li let out a sigh of relief. With a slight beckoning of his right hand, a nine-colored pearl descended from the heavens to hover before him.
“Hongyun, it’s up to you,” said Han Li with a smile.
Hongyun looked at the nine-colored pearl, and a flash of surprise appeared in her beautiful eyes as she immediately recognized the extraordinary nature of the pearl.
Inside it, multiple top-grade Supreme Emperor Weapons were engraved with Dao Principles, and there was a wisp of Dao Force absorbing Immortal Qi. The source of that Dao Force was even stronger than the Grand Dao she controlled.
With a nod, Hongyun guided the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, which flew over the nine-colored pearl. As her thoughts moved, the Primordial Chaos Cauldron sent down a dazzling beam of immortal light into the pearl.
In an instant, the nine-colored pearl burst into brilliance, gaining an additional hue, transforming it into a ten-colored pearl. Great changes occurred within its inner world.
Particularly in the region for absorbing and storing Immortal Qi, a new Rune Altar was added, engraved with five-colored Dao Principles meant for drawing in Immortal Qi.
“Master, it’s done.”
Han Li took the ten-colored pearl, his Divine Sense flooding in to inspect the changes within the Secret Territory. He now had a clear understanding of the alterations.
With the Dao Force of the Primordial Chaos Cauldron as a boost, the speed at which the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain absorbed Immortal Qi had indeed increased significantly, by roughly a quarter or a third.
Nonchalantly tossing the ten-colored pearl aside, Han Li turned to Hongyun and said, “Go have a chat with Xi Yue and the others.”
He had just spent the night discussing Dao with Ji Mingyue, experiencing the charms of the Green Clad Woman Saint, and Yuan Youwei, the Purple Skirted Female Emperor, was waiting for him. Thus, Han Li did not take any further action with Hongyun.
Just like with Xi Yue, he would leave it for later.
When the Primordial Chaos Cauldron vanished, Han Li retracted his gaze, and his figure disappeared from the summit of Chengdao Peak to join his other beloved wives and concubines.
Though Han Li was a Grandmaster of time management, the number of his beloved wives and concubines was too great, and he wished for a thousand hours in a day.

chapters.title: Chapter 584 - 231: The Primitive World! Regretful Yuan Youwei! The blissful life of Elder Han! Zimiao Zhen has given birth!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 584: Chapter 231: The Primitive World! Regretful Yuan Youwei! The blissful life of Elder Han! Zimiao Zhen has given birth!_2
“`
Fortunately, Han Li was very robust and had strong combat abilities. After discussing the Dao with one of his delicate wives or beautiful concubines, he could hold out for quite some time.
In the following dozen days or so, Han Li did not bother Yuan Youwei, letting her breathe a sigh of relief. The best for her was Han Li’s indifference; being an invisible person on Chengsheng Mountain was also not bad.
Han Li deliberately spent more time with Ji Mingyue, the newly initiated female saint, and for the rest of his time, he was with Zimiao Zhen, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang, Long Yue, Lu Tianxiang, and other delicate wives and beautiful concubines.
One day, Han Li did not get out of bed until the sun was high in the sky.
Ji Mingyue lay in his arms, her slender jade hand caressing his flat and smooth abdomen, her flawlessly beautiful face filled with a look of helplessness.
“Can we not do it?”
Han Li had restored some of her cultivation, and she could clearly feel an additional sign of life in her belly.
This damn lecher, Han Li, had actually gotten her pregnant.
What a shameless bastard.
He sneakily blocked her sensation in this regard until she was thoroughly pregnant before letting her know.
Ji Mingyue did not want to be pregnant at all, having a child would only slow down her cultivation progress.
Han Li shook his head slightly, embracing the warm fragrance of soft jade in his arms, kissed her beautiful face, and said with a smile,
“Mingyue, Zhen’er has been pregnant for over a month now. Do you really want to be outdone by her?”
“Bastard!”
Ji Mingyue was speechless and spat out in annoyance. Can this even be compared? She thought.
She and Zimiao Zhen competed against each other in charm and grace, and that was about cultivation, status, temperament, beauty, and figure. Who would compete in giving birth?
“Don’t worry, it won’t delay your cultivation. Once the child is born, you can go practice in the Time-Sky Tower. Your cultivation is guaranteed to make leaps and bounds,” Han Li said soothingly.
“That’s more like it.”
Ji Mingyue glanced at Han Li and reluctantly agreed to the arrangement. Now that she was pregnant, what choice did she have? Terminate the pregnancy?
That would be akin to killing her own child, something that Ji Mingyue could not bear, and besides, that bastard Han Li would definitely not agree.
Ji Mingyue also knew about the effects of the Time-Sky Tower; with her cultivation and the Tower’s support, even if she couldn’t reach the ninth level, reaching the eighth would be no issue.
In the eighth level, a day on the outside equated to five years inside, and with Han Li providing her with ample Quasi-Saint Realm elixirs to boost her cultivation, her progress would be a hundred, if not a thousand times faster than before.
Han Li smiled, continuing to spout sweet nothings and even started to get handsy, coaxing Ji Mingyue into a good mood.
Half an hour later, Ji Mingyue was drenched in fragrant sweat.
“Bastard.”
Once again, Ji Mingyue cursed, her cheeks flushed. What happened to the gentleman who was all talk and no action?
Han Li shrugged his shoulders; he was not a righteous gentleman after all. He wouldn’t just act with his hands; he was ready to use his “gun” too.
The two maintained a close and intimate conversation when suddenly Ji Mingyue asked, “Are you really not going to bother with Yuan Youwei anymore?”
Ji Mingyue felt it was incredible. Han Li, a man of bold and amorous pursuits, hadn’t resorted to force, and it had been a month since he brought Yuan Youwei here.
Had she misjudged him?
Was Han Li actually afraid of the three mighty powers: White Emperor City, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and Yuanchu Mountain?
But Ji Mingyue didn’t regret it. With things having come this far, she had accepted the reality. Whatever should or shouldn’t have been done had already been done.
The cultivation environment of Chengsheng Mountain was no less than that of the Huangyue Imperial Empire and was even better in some aspects.
“Isn’t it because I’ve been accompanying you? When would I have the time to deal with her?” Han Li said with a smile. He was also ready to handle Yuan Youwei.
He had been putting it off just so he could impregnate Ji Mingyue in one fell swoop and then deal with that purple-robed empress.
Tsk tsk, a female slave at the Quasi Emperor second heaven’s level, wonder what that’ll taste like.
“Seems like you’ve already got a plan.”
Ji Mingyue freed herself and walked toward the bath area of the bedroom, stepping into a pool of flowers filled with bright and fragrant petals that had just been picked, all of them specially cultivated spiritual flowers.
Han Li, very much aware of the protocol, walked over too and joined her in the flower pool, aiming for a third round.
……..
After leaving Ji Mingyue’s bedroom, Han Li headed straight for Yuan Youwei’s bedroom.
Yuan Youwei was leisurely painting inside, a hobby of hers from the past that she hadn’t had the time to delve deeper into due to her cultivation pursuits.
Now with her powers sealed and unable to practice cultivation, Yuan Youwei had picked up her hobby once more, engaging in painting daily to refine her temperament.
At the moment, Yuan Youwei was painting a picture of a beauty coming out of the bath, lifelike and exquisite, with the beauty in the painting being none other than herself.
When she finished, looking at her work, satisfaction appeared on her face; her technique was improving.
But what Yuan Youwei didn’t know was that Han Li was standing right behind her, taking in all of her actions and expressions.
“Applause.”
The sound of Han Li clapping filled the air as he appraised the lifelike, semi-concealed, semi-naked beauty emerging from the bath in the painting and praised, “You paint quite well.”
Startled, Yuan Youwei turned around, and seeing Han Li, she frowned and coldly asked, “What do you want, Han Li?”
“You,” Han Li said succinctly.
Yuan Youwei’s expression turned cold as she snapped, “Shameless!”
“Slap!”
Han Li slapped her delicate, flawless, and extremely beautiful face, sending Yuan Youwei flying back, where she crashed heavily onto the floor.
He hadn’t used much force; otherwise, the Yuan Youwei in her current state would have died from his slap.
Han Li said indifferently, “Mind your status.”
He had two female slaves before, but they were more compliant and submissive, completely devoted to Han Li after he had bedded them, with no thoughts of rebellion.
Yuan Youwei was different. Her cultivation was much higher than that of Li Na and Yan Liulong, a strong Quasi Emperor who was renowned far and wide, a Heavenly Immortal acknowledged by the Heavenly Immortal list, adorned with the prestige of Yuanchu Mountain and holding herself in high regard.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 585 - 231: The Primitive World! Regretful Yuan Youwei! The blissful life of Elder Han! Zimiao Zhen has given birth!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 585: Chapter 231: The Primitive World! Regretful Yuan Youwei! The blissful life of Elder Han! Zimiao Zhen has given birth!_3
For a woman whose status, level of cultivation, and identity were all higher than his, Han Li had no intention of being meek; otherwise, the other party might take an inch and want a mile. He had always been straightforward and unyielding.
“You!”
Yuan Youwei collapsed to the ground, her pale and delicate fingers pointing at Han Li, her face full of disbelief.
Han Li actually dared to hit her!
She had always been high above, looking down upon all beings as a Quasi Emperor. When had she ever suffered such humiliation? Never had she been treated like this before.
“What’s with the ‘you’? Do you find the slap uncomfortable? Shall I switch to a different tool? Would you prefer a whip or a stick?” Han Li said with a chuckle.
Yuan Youwei’s pretty face flushed with anger, then turned even colder. She looked at Han Li with an indifferent gaze, wishing she could kill him with her eyes, and said word by word:
“Han Li, you will surely pay the price!”
“I’m waiting,” Han Li replied nonchalantly.
“The one who needs to pay the price now is you. From the moment you refused me, you lost the right to discuss anything else with me.”
“From now on, you are my female slave, a Quasi Emperor female slave at that. Even those Great Emperors don’t have one, do they?”
“Ah ah ah~”
Yuan Youwei screamed in anger, her eyes flashing with panic, rage, regret, resentment, and more.
She was, after all, a Quasi Emperor! How could Han Li treat her this way, making her a female slave!
This was something Yuan Youwei had never imagined.
Had she known this would happen, she wouldn’t have haughtily and coldly refused him—she might as well have directly agreed to become Han Li’s Dao companion.
Now, Zi Miaozhen and Ji Mingyue were enjoying privileges at Chengsheng Mountain, while she had fallen to the status of Han Li’s female slave. The difference in treatment was just too great; it was like heaven and earth.
Her cultivation was higher, her beauty greater, her elegance superior, and even on the Heavenly Immortal rankings, she far surpassed both Zi Miaozhen and Ji Mingyue.
Number nineteen on the Heavenly Immortal list!
It could be said that she was one of the twenty most beautiful female cultivators in the entire Endless Yuankun Domain.
“Han Li, you can’t do this to me.”
“I am a Quasi Emperor; I can’t be your female slave. Please let me go.”
“I agree now, I’ll be your Dao companion, is that okay? Let me be your Dao companion…”
“I’ll obey you obediently; whatever you ask me to do, I’ll do it. With me, a Quasi Emperor at Chengsheng Mountain, our strength will greatly increase.”
“Han Li, don’t come over; please don’t, I beg you~”
At this moment, watching Han Li approaching with a wicked smile, Yuan Youwei’s last line of defense crumbled, and she spoke in a panic.
Her eyes were filled with pleading as she looked at Han Li. At that moment, she cared about nothing else. As long as she wasn’t a female slave, becoming Han Li’s Dao companion no longer felt demeaning.
“Too late.”
With a wave of his hand, Han Li shattered Yuan Youwei’s clothes, leaving her with no place to hide, her delicate body completely exposed to Han Li’s view.
“Not bad at all,” Han Li remarked with a smile after taking a few glances.
“Don’t come any closer… Let me… go…” Yuan Youwei screamed.
But it was of no use whatsoever, as Han Li began to enjoy his Quasi Emperor female slave.
Two hours later, Han Li left Yuan Youwei’s chamber, thoroughly satisfied.
The bedchamber was in a shambles, Yuan Youwei lying on the ground, powerless and covered in various injuries, her flesh mottled with shades of blue and purple.
She wanted to move, but she had no strength at all.
“I will definitely kill you,” she swore.
Having recovered a bit of strength, Yuan Youwei broke down and screamed.
She had fainted several times before, but that beast Han Li still didn’t let her be, keeping Yuan Youwei in a constant state of being abused.
“Wuu wuu wuu~”
After a long while, Yuan Youwei suddenly started to sob, recalling the days she had gone through, thinking of the two hours of humiliation by Han Li as if it were a dream.
A month ago, she was a high and mighty Quasi Emperor powerhouse, but a month later, she fell into a position of no status, being humiliated by Han Li as a female slave.
Yuan Youwei truly regretted it.
She shouldn’t have come to the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Nor should she have rejected Han Li’s request; how much better it would have been to simply become Han Li’s Tao companion in earnest.
But it was all too late.
……..
Time flies like an arrow, the years are like a weaving shuttle.
In the blink of an eye, eight months had passed.
During this time, Han Li took many beautiful wives and concubines, but his main focus was still on cherished wives like Zi Miaozhen, Ji Mingyue, Ling Lingshuang, Xue Yueqing, Long Yue, and Lu Tianxiang, who were more satisfying for Han Li.
Of course, during this time, Han Li also did not neglect to satisfy Yuan Youwei, humiliating the Quasi Emperor female slave harshly and inventing various ways to torment her.
Yuan Youwei attempted suicide many times, but it was completely futile; Han Li’s manipulation of time by reversing it filled Yuan Youwei with terror.
After a long period of taming, Yuan Youwei had now become much more docile and obedient in the image of Han Li, and was even pregnant.
Although Yuan Youwei had been turned into a female slave, the child still had to be born; with such good congenital talent and constitution as Yuan Youwei’s, it would be a sheer waste of resources not to have a child.
In this period, Han Li also refined the Top Grade Imperial weapons that Ji Mingyue brought, the Hanxue Sword, and the Sky Pavilion weapon that Yuan Youwei carried.
With Han Li’s promises and witnessing Yuan Youwei’s plight, the spirits of both Imperial weapons were terrified; they did not want to end up like Yuan Youwei, in a state too miserable where they could neither live nor die as they wished.
Having dealt with these matters, Han Li directly implemented his Deceiving Heaven and Crossing the Sea plan. With the cooperation of Zi Miaozhen, Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, and the three Imperial weapon spirits, Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and White Emperor City would not detect anything amiss for a short period.
Over these eight months, Han Li had opened treasure chests eight times in a row, but unfortunately, there weren’t any particularly good treasures.
Two Emperor Level Lower Grade Cultivation Techniques, one Emperor Level Middle Grade Cultivation Technique, one Emperor Level Middle Grade Immortal Pill to enhance Quasi Emperor cultivation, and the rest were all Divine Rank Top Grade and Supreme Grade pills, weapons, and the like.
There was not a single item that reached the level of the Heaven Imperial Realm, let alone the Immortal weapons, treasures, pills, and scriptures that Han Li had been hoping for.
Han Li suspected that the time he obtained the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, a Heavenly Immortal weapon, had exhausted all his luck, resulting in none of the eight treasure chests yielding anything worthwhile.
Han Li could only console himself, anticipating it was the mechanism’s fault, not his own lack of luck; he imagined it as laying the groundwork for future opportunities.
One day, Han Li came to Zi Miaozhen’s bedchamber.
Not to discuss the Tao with Zi Miaozhen, of course, but because it was the day Zi Miaozhen was to give birth.
Han Li was very much looking forward to it; would the child Zi Miaozhen bore inherit both of their aptitudes and constitutions?
Han Li was of Top Grade aptitude, and so was Zi Miaozhen, the peerless female saint who also possessed unique talents; despite being only of King body, she was exceptionally strong.
Han Li waited patiently, and when cries echoed from the bedchamber, a look of relief crossed his face, and he immediately went inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 586 - 232: Dusk King Body! Ji Mingyue Gives Birth! Han Yongzhen Returns! Bi Luo Imperial Body! Bai Keqing Breaks Through Divine Yuan_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 586: Chapter 232: Dusk King Body! Ji Mingyue Gives Birth! Han Yongzhen Returns! Bi Luo Imperial Body! Bai Keqing Breaks Through Divine Yuan_1
Zimiao True Sleeping Chamber.
Han Li sat on the edge of the bed, one arm cradling the tender and delicate waist of Zimiao Zhen, who nestled in his embrace.
The two were tender and affectionate with each other, whispering sweet nothings and utterly content.
Han Li was very happy now. He had seen the child born to Zimiao Zhen, and, true to his expectations, the child had not disappointed him. Therefore, Han Li showered her with an outpouring of sweet words and praises.
“Husband… Han Li, what kind of physique does our child have?”
Gazing at the child, a maternal glow appeared on Zimiao Zhen’s face. She instinctively wanted to call out “my lord,” but quickly corrected herself.
Her cheeks flushed with a pink hue, realizing that after nearly a year at Chengsheng Mountain, interacting with Han Li’s wives and concubines as close sisters, she almost adopted their way of addressing him.
Han Li smiled, appreciating Zimiao Zhen’s progress. He chose not to press further and explained, “This child is rather extraordinary. Although he didn’t inherit your Mysterious Sound King’s Body, he was born with another special physique, also a king’s body.”
Han Li knew why the child hadn’t inherited it: Zimiao Zhen’s Mysterious Sound King’s Body was more suitable for girls, and this time, a boy was born. Under the influence of both their strong genes, the child still developed a special physique.
This physique was called the Dusk King Body, and it harbored a Dusk Cauldron Phantasm within. It would provide formidable combat ability to the child. As the child grew and his cultivation strengthened, the Dusk Cauldron would gradually become more solidified until it could even materialize, turning into a mighty weapon.
The Dusk King Body could also nurture an Innate Divine Ability and wield the Dusk Cauldron as a weapon. It naturally contained elements of Dao and was close to the corresponding Laws, ranking as a top-tier king’s body.
“Dusk King Body…”
Joy flickered in Zimiao Zhen’s beautiful eyes. She had heard of this kind of physique, which, while rare in the Ancient Era, had quite a reputation in the Prehistoric Ages.
She suspected the child was born with this unique physique partly due to her own body constitution and partly due to Han Li’s.
The fact that Han Li didn’t possess a special physique was kept secret from others. Zimiao Zhen, Ji Mingyue, and his other beautiful wives all believed that Han Li had a powerful physique of his own.
Now, the number of people with special physiques at Chengsheng Mountain was not small, all of them being Han Li’s wives and descendants. Zimiao Zhen was familiar with them.
For instance, Long Yue’s Dark Yin King’s Body, Lu Tianxiang’s Heavenly Fragrance King’s Body, her own Mysterious Sound Spirit Body; and both Ji Mingyue and Yuan Youwei had their unique physiques.
Among Han Li’s descendants, Han Yonghao had the Mortal King Body, Han Yongkun possessed the Tianhu King’s Body, and while Han Yongxuan only had the King Body Mysterious Yellow Dragon Eye, he also had a share of True Dragon Bloodline, rivaling that of an imperial body.
Not to mention Han Yongqian’s Supreme Bone and Han Yongmu’s Divine Emperor Body, both formidable imperial bodies.
Zimiao Zhen felt no jealousy. She had early on learned of Murong Ying and Yao Xi’s identities, the targets of her and Ji Mingyue’s journey to Qianyuan Divine Province—the split souls of Empresses Yuanchu and Phoenix Moon.
These peerless empresses both had Immortal Bodies, and since their split souls contained some of their original essence, it was not surprising for their children to have imperial bodies—especially given that Han Li might possess both imperial and immortal physiques himself.
Now that her own child had a king’s body, he stood out among the thousands of descendants in Han Mansion, guaranteeing he would receive the best nurturing from Han Li.
Although Zimiao Zhen initially didn’t wish to have children, now that she had given birth, naturally she wanted to raise and cultivate her own child.
“Then, what shall we name our child?” Zimiao Zhen looked expectantly at Han Li.
Gazing upon her flawless beauty at close quarters and her exceedingly lovely face, Han Li could not help but lean down and capture her tender red lips.
After a long while, Han Li released Zimiao Zhen and finally said, “Han Yongding.”
He had recently obtained a Heavenly Immortal weapon, the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, and now had a son with the Dusk King Body. His connection to cauldrons seemed destined, so this name was fitting.
Although the Primordial Chaos Cauldron was a product of his discussions with Ji Mingyue, that detail was insignificant—and unknown to Zimiao Zhen.
“That’s wonderful,” Zimiao Zhen said, smiling.
The character for “cauldron” was no ordinary choice. Had her son not been born with the Dusk King Body, he likely wouldn’t have been granted such a name.
She had studied Han Li’s naming conventions for his offspring: the Han surname came first, followed by the generation marker, according to “Eternal Prosperity, Cauldron’s Growth, Inheritance of Saints, Blessings of Glory, Sage Wisdom, Spread of Propitiousness…” The last character was the most important.
After all, the first two characters of Han Li’s children’s names were “Han Yong,” and only the third character differed, which contained Han Li’s hopes and embodied various auspicious meanings.
Zimiao Zhen noticed that for the children born to Han Li previously, especially those before moving to Chengsheng Mountain, the third characters of their names were quite common. Only in the recent decade had the names become increasingly better.
While conversing with Zimiao Zhen, Han Li also checked the System’s notifications.
“Ding~ Congratulations, my lord, for gaining a first-rank talent descendant. You have received a talent feedback, your talent has improved by one-tenth.”
“Ding~ As this descendant possesses a King’s Body [Dusk King Body], you receive a physique feedback, gaining 10 Physique Points.”
After reading these two System notifications, the smile on Han Li’s face broadened. His talent had now surpassed 50% of first-rank, and he had accumulated over two hundred Physique Points.
Seven days later,
A dusty figure flew in from the horizon, with sword-like eyebrows and bright eyes, exuding a heroic spirit. It was Han Yongzhen.
After grabbing the opportunity from the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor in Leizhou, Han Yongzhen left contentedly.
Han Yongzhen changed his route, toured through Da Jing Empire and then travelled from the north of the Daqian Empire to the south, before finally returning to Yuanzhou in the south.

chapters.title: Chapter 587 - 232: Dusk King Body! Ji Mingyue Gives Birth! Han Yongzhen Returns! Bi Luo Imperial Body! Bai Keqing Breaks Through Divine Yuan_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 587: Chapter 232: Dusk King Body! Ji Mingyue Gives Birth! Han Yongzhen Returns! Bi Luo Imperial Body! Bai Keqing Breaks Through Divine Yuan_2
On this journey, Han Yongzhen also faced many dangers, although they were less severe than those encountered in the Yinyang Sect’s territory, yet they brought him some fortuitous opportunities.
After a year of trials, Han Yongzhen had matured a lot, growing rapidly, and even his cultivation level had soared; he had already advanced to the fourth level of the God Refining Realm.
“Young Master.”
As Han Yongzhen arrived at the mountain gate, some people were there to welcome him, all of whom were close to either Lu Tianxiang or Han Yongzhen’s lineage.
“Thank you for waiting.”
Han Yongzhen waved his hand and, with the crowd escorting him, made his way up the mountain. Along the way, he encountered many disciples and guards from the Han Mansion, as well as Guest Elders and protectors, all of whom greeted him with respect, their eyes flashing with envy.
Being a Second Gen Immortal is really awesome!
Han Yongzhen returned to his residence at Dengdao Peak in his coarse clothes, first arriving at the first area of Chengdao Peak to wait for his mother, Lu Tianxiang, and father, Han Li.
After a year without seeing them, he missed his parents deeply and often felt emotional, realizing that the outside world was much more dangerous than Chengsheng Mountain and lacked kind-hearted people.
If not for the trump cards given by his parents, even if he had managed to return to Chengsheng Mountain alive, he would have suffered greatly, a stark contrast to his current state of ease and comfort.
When encountering powerful cultivators of the Myriad Phenomena Realm who were Great Grandmasters, Han Yongzhen simply mentioned his father Han Li’s name and most would step aside, not wishing to trouble him.
As for one unperceptive Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster, he was easily subdued and killed by Han Yongzhen using his trump cards, and now his reputation had begun to spread in the outside world.
Two divine lights flashed by, and the figures of Han Li and Lu Tianxiang appeared in the grand hall.
“Father.”
“Mother.”
Seeing his parents arrive so quickly, Han Yongzhen excitedly called out.
“It’s good that you’re back safely.”
Lu Tianxiang pulled Han Yongzhen over and scrutinized him carefully, and upon finding not a single scratch, she finally spoke.
Han Yongzhen nodded vigorously and then turned to his father, Han Li, who said with satisfaction, “I am almost fully aware of your experiences this past year, and you’ve done very well.”
Hearing this, Han Yongzhen’s face lit up with excitement as he hurriedly replied, “It’s all thanks to your excellent guidance, Father.”
Afterwards, Han Yongzhen took the initiative to share his experiences from underground in Leizhou, bringing out the Emperor’s Scripture, Pill Formula, and Refining Blueprints.
“Has that Great Emperor changed his ways?” Lu Tianxiang’s face showed a look of surprise.
When she had gone in, Emperor Changfeng had tricked her quite a bit, withholding any benefits and only providing a clue to the Rebirth Pill Formula.
Was this the difference between being captured and entering willingly?
Even if she hadn’t been taken away by Han Li, after getting the Rebirth Pill Formula, Lu Tianxiang had no intention of returning, at least not until her cultivation reached the True Martial Realm or the Divine Yuan Realm.
The Emperor of Heaven in the Heaven Imperial Realm was too dangerous!
In comparison, her cultivation was too low; a mere glance could slay her countless times.
She hadn’t expected that her son’s one visit would yield so many treasures, especially that Emperor’s Scripture, which was a huge opportunity.
For an ordinary cultivator to obtain a Top Grade Emperor’s Scripture, it was enough to defy the heavens and change fate, rising to power in the mortal realm. If one’s good fortune continued to soar, the future would be limitless.
Lots of thoughts flashed through Lu Tianxiang’s mind, and she made a decision on the spot. Since Emperor Changfeng had changed his ways, they had to seize the opportunity.
From now on, she should have her children visit Emperor Changfeng more often to take advantage of his opportunities—aside from Han Yongzhen, she also had Han Yongxiang, Han Yonglu, Han Yonglu, and five other children.
The younger ones could wait, but the first three could be gradually arranged to go. When it came to opportunities, one shouldn’t pass up the chance to seize them.
“Maybe.”
Han Li said with a smile, closely examining the inscribed Top Grade Emperor’s Scripture.
He had to admit, this Emperor’s Scripture was truly formidable, worthy of a technique from the Heaven Imperial Realm. An ordinary cultivator obtaining this technique was indeed a heaven-defying opportunity, truly capable of changing one’s fate.
“Xi Yue.”
Han Li called out, and the flawlessly pure and elegantly noble Xi Yue appeared beside him.
“Please check if there’s anything wrong with this Emperor’s Scripture.”
Given such a significant change in Emperor Changfeng, Han Li felt somewhat surreal, and although he couldn’t tell if there was anything wrong with the Emperor’s Scripture, he could consult others.
After all, there were two Heavenly Immortal weapons in his home. They ought to be able to discern whether there was an issue with a Top Grade Emperor’s Scripture.
“Yes, Master.”
Xi Yue responded and began to investigate the Scripture known as the Sky Seizing Emperor Scripture.
Lu Tianxiang glanced at Xi Yue, her eyes filled with envy. Xi Yue was too perfect, even more stunning than herself.
Although Lu Tianxiang had seen Xi Yue before, she was always amazed by Xi Yue’s beauty every time.
Han Yongzhen, on the other hand, saw Xi Yue for the first time and was momentarily mesmerized, never having thought that the world could harbor such a perfect woman.
However, Han Yongzhen quickly lowered his head, not daring to look again.
As Han Li’s son, he was very aware that aside from the maids, all women on Chengdao Peak were his father’s cherished wives and concubines.
This Xi Yue, so perfect, was probably also one of his father’s wives. Even though he had never met her, she was still his stepmother, someone he must not disrespect in any way.
Han Li noted Han Yongzhen’s reaction and nodded in satisfaction.
Shortly after, Xi Yue provided an answer: the Top Grade Emperor’s Scripture did have issues that could not be hidden from her far-sighted scrutiny.
After listening to the hidden problems outlined by Xi Yue, Han Yongzhen’s forehead was covered with sweat. He was frightened.
Emperor Changfeng had appeared rather approachable, yet Han Yongzhen hadn’t expected him to be so malicious. If he had practiced that Sky Seizing Emperor Scripture, his future would have been ruined.

chapters.title: Chapter 588 - 232: Dusk King Body! Ji Mingyue Gives Birth! Han Yongzhen Returns! Bi Luo Imperial Body! Bai Keqing Breaks Through Divine Yuan_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 588: Chapter 232: Dusk King Body! Ji Mingyue Gives Birth! Han Yongzhen Returns! Bi Luo Imperial Body! Bai Keqing Breaks Through Divine Yuan_3
“Deserves to die!”
Lu Tianxiang was also seething with murderous intent; Emperor Changfeng was indeed plotting against her son.
Lu Tianxiang looked toward her husband, Han Li. Such matters could only be dealt with by her husband. Emperor Changfeng was of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and she couldn’t handle him.
Although her husband was only a powerful being in the Tongxuan Realm, he possessed so many Supreme Grade Emperor’s Weapons and even Immortal Weapons, so killing an Emperor Changfeng wouldn’t be difficult.
“Indeed, he deserves to die.”
Han Li nodded and said, “But there’s no rush for now, let’s stick to the original plan.”
“As for this Heaven-seizing Emperor’s Scripture, I can’t modify it right now. Let’s store it in the Cnagdao Hall for the time being.”
Han Li planned to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm before he would modify and perfect this Top Grade Emperor’s Scripture, to eliminate any hidden dangers and enrich the foundation of the Han Mansion.
For now, he could also cultivate it himself; dual cultivation was not a problem—it would all be nourishment for his Chaos Decision.
“Yongzhen, this time you’ve offered up an Emperor’s Scripture and six decent Pill Formulas and Refining Blueprints; your contribution is significant. Your Contribution Value has already been given to you, and I shall grant you some additional rewards.”
Looking at his son, Han Yongzhen, Han Li said with a smile, then took out some top-quality treasures to bestow upon Han Yongzhen.
Medicinal pills, weapons, talismans, Array Plates, cultivation techniques, martial skills and so on—Han Li had prepared a variety for Han Yongzhen.
“Thank you, Father, for your generous reward.”
Han Yongzhen was overjoyed beyond measure, not expecting that apart from the Contribution Value, his father would bestow upon him so many fine items.
……
One month later,
Ji Mingyue also gave birth to a child, a boy.
Ji Mingyue was of first-rate aptitude and possessed a special physique named “Spirit Moon King Body,” related to the Taiyin Star and quite extraordinary.
According to Ji Mingyue, on the day she was born, the Taiyin Star had descended a beam of starlight, revealing all sorts of omens.
Such a significant event naturally wouldn’t be missed by Han Li; he accompanied Ji Mingyue carefully and named the child Han Yongming.
Han Yongming also had first-rate aptitude and a physique known as the “Great Sun King Body,” in no way inferior to Han Yongding.
The reason for choosing the word “Ming” was clearly related to Han Yongming having the Great Sun King Body, and his mother being called Ji Mingyue and having the Spirit Moon King Body.
Sun and moon both shine bright!
The meaning behind the name “Ming” was also quite good.
Ji Mingyue was quite satisfied with this name.
With the birth of Han Yongming, Han Li’s aptitude had increased by another ten percent, and he’d gained another 10 Physique Points, which made the elder Han quite happy.
At this rate, his aptitude and Physique Points would only grow faster and faster.
Another month went by since Ji Mingyue had her child, and Yuan Youwei also gave birth.
On the day Yuan Youwei delivered her child, Han Li treated her well, refraining from any beastly behavior and giving Yuan Youwei face in front of the child.
Primarily because Yuan Youwei had not only given birth to a child of first-rate aptitude, but the child surprisingly possessed a royal body, which astonished Han Li.
Considering that Yuan Youwei only had a top-tier king body, quite a distance from a royal one, and that Han Li himself had no physique.
Now obedient and gentle, Yuan Youwei was delighted, thinking it was due to Han Li, who might be a reincarnation of an immortal.
Han Li, however, felt it might be related to Yuan Youwei’s cultivation level. After all, Yuan Youwei was a Quasi Emperor who had grasped an embryonic form of a Dao principle, and thus had a small chance of having an offspring with a royal body.
But now, it had indeed happened.
Han Li and Yuan Youwei’s child was named Han Yongyuan, who possessed a royal body called the “Azure Descent Royal Body.”
The birth of Han Yongyuan brought Han Li a 10% aptitude feedback, pushing his aptitude beyond eighty percent of first-rate.
He also received another 100 Physique Points, accumulating a total of 330, getting him ever closer to the requirements for creating his own unique king body.
Due to Han Yongyuan’s influence, and because Yuan Youwei, this Quasi Emperor female slave, had become increasingly obedient and well-behaved, making Han Li very comfortable, he could indulge in any pleasure without restraint.
Therefore, Han Li decided to raise Yuan Youwei’s status from a female slave to a servant concubine.
If Han Yongyuan had just a king body, Han Li wouldn’t have considered it, but now, with a royal body and the surprise it brought, he decided to give Yuan Youwei a surprise as well.
Yuan Youwei felt doubly blessed in an instant.
The hard days of the past were finally over, and she had risen in status through her son.
Now, with her son’s royal body elevating her status, her treatment would be much improved, at least many times better than that of a female slave.
As Han Yongyuan continued to grow and become stronger in the future, her status would also rise higher and higher. Even if she couldn’t be promoted to the level of a wife, she would definitely be able to attain the status of a concubine.
As for whether Han Yongyuan would harbor resentment due to her mother’s identity and experiences, naturally, she wouldn’t.
Yuan Youwei didn’t dare teach these things. Even if Han Yongyuan grew up, he would only be an Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm; in front of Han Li, he was nothing.
Han Li could deal with Han Yongyuan at his peak right now, let alone when Han Yongyuan grew up. By then, Han Li would have been an Immortal for many years.
Yuan Youwei understood this too. She had no other thoughts now and was staying obediently in the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, sharing Han Li’s glory as well as his losses.
After the initial surprise, looking at Han Li in front of her, Yuan Youwei timidly spoke up, “Husband~”
Yuan Youwei also cautiously raised her head to steal a glance at Han Li, afraid that he would become angry. This past year, she had suffered a lot and had also consumed many dragon heads.
Previously, as Han Li’s female slave, she only had the status to call him master and didn’t dare to overstep. Otherwise, she would be severely punished by Han Li.
Han Li nodded and said, “Tonight, I will discuss the Dao with you and reward you well.”
Han Li didn’t reject this form of address. Since he had elevated Yuan Youwei’s status, she then had the right to address him as such.
Speaking of which, among the three peerless beauties, Zi Miaozhen, Ji Mingyue, and Yuan Youwei, Yuan Youwei was the first to address him as husband.
In the past, as Yuan Youwei’s master, Han Li had indeed played many role-playing games. Aside from being the master of a female slave, he also had different identities…
That night, Yuan Youwei felt extremely joyful.
For the first time, she discovered that discussing the Dao could actually be so comfortable.
Previously, Han Li would never show mercy, but today, he showed a lot of tenderness toward her, which touched Yuan Youwei deeply.
……..
Time flew by,
Not long after Yuan Youwei gave birth to Han Yongyuan, Han Li’s beloved wife Bai Keqing experienced a significant breakthrough in her cultivation.
Bai Keqing, who had been honing her skills at the peak of the True Martial Realm for a long time, finally launched an offensive today, easily breaking through to the Divine Yuan Realm, becoming a Demon Emperor of the Divine Yuan Realm.
With the help of Han Li, Bai Keqing also nurtured an Emperor-grade martial Dao Primordial Spirit, and although it was only eighteen thousand zhang tall, Bai Keqing was very excited and rewarded Han Li generously that night.
Having been married to Han Li for less than twenty years, she had rapidly broken through from the first level of the True Martial Realm to the first level of the Divine Yuan Realm.
Such a speed of cultivation was something Bai Keqing had never even dreamed of.
The Demon Clan’s speed of cultivation was originally much slower than the Human Clan. Before meeting Han Li, it would have taken Bai Keqing a hundred years to break through to the second level of the True Martial Realm.
Not only did Bai Keqing make significant progress in her cultivation, but the cultivations of Han Li’s other beloved wives and beautiful concubines also advanced by leaps and bounds.
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, Long Yue, Yao Xi, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang, and many others among Han Li’s beloved wives.
There were also Liu Yuexin, Wu Yalin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, Lin Yiyin, Chu Yumeng, Zhang Yuyan among his beautiful concubines.
Among all of Han Li’s beloved wives and beautiful concubines, the ones with the lowest cultivation had reached the Hollow Void Stage. These Hollow Void Stage individuals were newly accepted wives and concubines; the lowest among Han Li’s previous wives and concubines were all Great Grandmasters of the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak,
Han Li stood there, hands clasped behind his back, gazing down at the entirety of Chengsheng Mountain.
“The Chengsheng Mountain Range is still too short,” Han Li retracted his gaze and said indifferently.
The main peak, Chengdao Peak, was only ten thousand meters tall, and the secondary peaks such as Yundao Peak, Yangdao Peak, Yandao Peak, and Enlightenment Peak were only three to five thousand meters tall.
This did not match the heritage of Chengsheng Mountain.
Therefore, Han Li decided to make a change and raise all the peaks of Chengsheng Mountain Range, so they would be fitting for the status and stature of the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
Of course, Han Li wouldn’t raise them by a lot in one go as that would attract too much attention; it was better to do it gradually.
With Han Li’s capabilities, setting up a formation would ensure that Chengdao Peak, Yangdao Peak, Zaidao Peak, Dengdao Peak, and all other peaks would gradually grow taller over time.
According to Han Li’s plan, Chengdao Peak would grow by one zhang every day, and the other secondary peaks would grow based on their importance—some would increase by two meters every day, and the rest by one meter.
One or two meters, or even one zhang, were inconspicuous to the Chengsheng Mountain Range, and outsiders would fail to notice.
By the time Chengsheng Mountain Range had significantly increased in height, and outsiders started to notice, Han Mansion would also possess the corresponding strength.
