chapters.title: Chapter 589 - 233: Inviting the Ancestor to Descend! Who Dares to Destroy Chengsheng Mountain?_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 589: Chapter 233: Inviting the Ancestor to Descend! Who Dares to Destroy Chengsheng Mountain?_1
Qianjue Mountain.
A breath surged to the sky, lightning formed naturally, thousand miles of rosy clouds, ten thousand miles of thunder, creating a magnificent display that shook the eight directions.
“Finally succeeded!”
At the peak,
a figure stood with hands clasped behind his back, dressed in a luxurious blue-green robe, with a blue jade tied around his waist and boots of gold-threaded jade under his feet, his aura immensely powerful.
Above this handsome young man’s head, a Martial True Pill spun round and round, shedding beams of light and enveloped in true essence, with a thunder dragon faintly visible, resonating with the celestial phenomenon.
Looking at the Martial True Pill, the handsome young man’s mouth curved, a satisfied smile appearing on his face.
Two years of arduous refinement, venturing to the harsh and cold land of the Barbarian Region to cultivate, were all for this Martial True Pill.
His Martial True Pill had reached the limit of King Grade, merging perfectly into a whole, as one with the chaotic primordial, in terms of realm not inferior to the Emperor Wu’s at the pinnacle of True Martial Realm.
With such a foundation laid, his cultivation to the pinnacle of the True Martial Realm would be a smooth journey, his speed of cultivation advancing by leaps and bounds, without any bottleneck to speak of, capable of reaching the pinnacle of True Martial Realm within twenty years.
If he obtained some opportunities outside, or returned to Chengsheng Mountain, he could achieve this goal within five years.
“Retrieve~”
The handsome young man’s thoughts moved, and the Martial True Pill returned inside his body, his sharp and overpowering aura quickly receding, with the celestial phenomenon in the sky also dissipating.
“It’s also about time to head back.”
The handsome young man murmured, looking down at the magnificent mountains and rivers beneath his feet.
The place where he currently stood was Qianjue Mountain in the Barbarian Region, an area with poor conditions for cultivation, even worse than most areas in the Barbarian Region.
As the saying goes: Paths are manifold, hundred rivers vie to flow, reaching a thousand mountains to meet an end, hence Qianjue Mountain.
The Qianjue Mountain Range stretches across thirty thousand miles, majestic and vast, with peaks upon peaks, the main peak standing ninety thousand feet tall, standing like a precipice, piercing the clouds, with a thousand subsidiary peaks of varying heights.
Surrounding the mountain range are countless paths leading here, as well as hundreds of rivers winding and rushing, only to end abruptly, the mountains marking their terminus.
The terrain of Qianjue Mountain forms a natural grand formation, of very high rank, only accessible to those above the True Martial Realm, and in some perilous areas, even powerful beings of the True Martial Realm and Divine Yuan Realm could perish.
Qianjue Mountain is well-known throughout Qianyuan Divine Province. Although the environment is harsh for cultivation, it contains great opportunities. The mountains are covered with thunderstorms all year round, the lightning destroys life but also gives birth to fortunes.
Each peak contains treasures of heaven and earth, with some being spiritual grasses, some spiritual flowers, and some divine trees, all nurtured slowly by the power of lightning, with grades ranging from fifth to first.
On the main peak of Qianjue Mountain, there is a Thousand Thunder Spiritual Tree, which matures once every hundred years. Because Qianjue Mountain experiences a thunder waterfall every hundred years, this tree rapidly blooms and bears fruit upon absorbing the power of the thunder waterfall, producing three fruits which ripen within ten days.
If nobody picks them, within a month, the Thousand Thunder Spiritual Tree will wither on its own, the three fruits falling and their spiritual energy gradually dissipating, until a hundred years later when the thunder waterfall descends, the tree will revive once more.
The handsome young man came for the fruits of the Thousand Thunder Spiritual Tree.
His name is Han Yongting, twenty-two years old this year, the son of Han Li and Yun Miaoyi, the second child born after Yun Miaoyi’s particular constitution came into being, her sixth child.
Han Yongting was born with a special constitution, the Thunder Body, belonging to the royal class, and possessed first-grade talent. His natural abilities were outstanding, deeply cherished by Han Li.
Han Yongting traveled from Chengsheng Mountain in the Xuan Domain to Qianjue Mountain in the Barbarian Region, aiming to pick the Thousand Thunder Spiritual Fruits. Two years ago, he had reached the pinnacle of Myriad Phenomena Realm and was ready to ascend to the True Martial Realm and condense a King Grade Martial True Pill.
It so happened that there were two more years until the once-in-a-century thunder waterfall of Qianjue Mountain occurred, when the Thousand Thunder Spiritual Tree would bear fruit again. These fruits were of great use to Han Yongting.
With his Thunder War Body, comprehending the essence of thunder, obtaining one fruit could help his Martial True Pill reach the King Grade limit.
Therefore, after discussing with his mother Yun Miaoyi and consulting Han Li’s opinion, Han Yongting decided to continue refining his foundation, so he could go further in the future.
Han Yongting set out to travel incognito and made his way to Qianjue Mountain. He was a peak Grandmaster, and many in Qianyuan Divine Province had higher cultivation and strength than he did, but very few could kill him.
A year ago, Han Yongting arrived at Qianjue Mountain, broke through the formation with his own strength, and even encountered an ambush by a True Martial Realm expert, whom he killed.
Later, three more True Martial Realm experts came, some from the Barbarian Clan, some from the Human Clan. Because of Han Yongting’s formidable strength, these three True Martial Realm experts could only seek fortune on other peaks.
In the end, Han Yongting acquired three Thousand Thunder Spiritual Fruits. After refining them, he not only condensed a King Grade Martial True Pill to its limits in one fell swoop and ascended to the True Martial Realm, but also significantly strengthened the foundation of his Thunder War Body, ultimately cultivating his first Innate Divine Ability successfully.
Han Yongting was quite satisfied with his cultivation. A True Martial Realm expert at twenty-two years of age would be considered a peerless genius in Qianyuan Divine Province, and even in the Endless Yuankun Domain, he would be an unrivaled talent.
But within Chengsheng Mountain, Han Yongting didn’t shine as brightly, for there were too many monstrous geniuses there, many of whom were stronger than him, and now the competition was becoming increasingly fierce.
With a silent sigh in his heart, Han Yongting’s figure disappeared from Qianjue Mountain, ready to rush back to Chengsheng Mountain in the Xuan Domain.
Having ascended to the True Martial Realm, and with his first Innate Divine Ability of the Thunder Body successfully nurtured, his combat ability had increased manyfold, and in the upcoming Han Mansion’s genius battle, he might just seize one of the top three spots.
No sooner had Han Yongting left than three figures arrived, enshrouded in faint starlight. These were three True Martial Realm Barbarian Kings.

chapters.title: Chapter 590 - 233: Inviting the Ancestor to Descend! Who Dares to Destroy Chengsheng Mountain?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 590: Chapter 233: Inviting the Ancestor to Descend! Who Dares to Destroy Chengsheng Mountain?_2
The Barbarian Clan of the Barbarian Region were all Star Barbarians, who enhanced their strength by absorbing the power of the sun, moon, and stars. They had profound knowledge of the celestial bodies and were all muscular brutes.
“Someone from the Human Clan has broken through to the True Martial Realm at Qianjue Mountain, should we pursue?”
A late-stage True Martial Realm Barbarian King conducted a probe and discovered that the person who had caused the anomaly was already gone.
The leading Barbarian King, though also in the late stage of the True Martial Realm, possessed the combat ability of a peak True Martial Realm warrior. His eyes shimmered with the power of the stars as image after image flashed by until he saw the figure of Han Yongting. Then, staggering, he spat blood from the corner of his mouth.
“Are you alright?” another middle-stage True Martial Realm Barbarian King quickly asked.
The leading Barbarian King shook his head, his face still marked with horror as he said in a trembling voice, “That person is from Chengsheng Mountain.”
“Hiss!”
The other two True Martial Realm Barbarian Kings simultaneously drew a sharp breath, their faces showing signs of relief. Fortunately, they were slow to arrive and didn’t run into him, otherwise, they would have been in great trouble.
The people from Chengsheng Mountain were not to be trifled with. Even those who had just broken through to the True Martial Realm, they dared not confront them, for those from Chengsheng Mountain who ventured out for experience had many hidden cards up their sleeves.
Not to mention these True Martial Realm Barbarian Kings, even a Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu would perish if they acted rashly—there had been precedents for this.
Seven years ago, a True Martial Realm Emperor Wu from Chengsheng Mountain came to the Barbarian Region to issue challenges. Although he was only at the fourth level of the True Martial Realm, he managed to defeat all the Barbarian Kings at the Pinnacle of Stars.
Afterwards, a Divine Yuan Realm Barbarian Emperor who attempted an ambush halfway discovered that this True Martial Realm warrior from Chengsheng Mountain unexpectedly possessed the combat ability of someone on the threshold of the Divine Yuan Realm. The Emperor went mad with killing intent, determined to exterminate this peerless genius of the Human Clan.
But with a casual flick of his hand, the Chengsheng Mountain Emperor Wu unleashed a talisman that killed the ambushing Divine Yuan Realm Barbarian Emperor on the spot, which infuriated everyone at the Pinnacle of Stars.
The enraged Barbarian Lord of the Pinnacle of Stars invoked an imperial weapon intending to kill the Chengsheng Mountain warrior from afar, but was unsuccessful and blocked by another powerful one-time talisman.
The Barbarian Lord personally descended with the imperial weapon, blocking the way of the Chengsheng Mountain warrior, only to discover his special physique. Wishing to capture him and take him back to the Pinnacle of Stars to seize his fortune and strip him of his physique, he sparked a great problem.
Then, a mighty being crossed the void and descended upon them, proclaiming himself as “Kui Yi, under the old patriarch of Chengsheng Mountain,” and he brought with him a supreme grade imperial weapon.
That supreme grade imperial weapon suppressed the top grade imperial weapon of the Pinnacle of Stars, and Kui Yi struck the Barbarian Lord with a palm. Had it not been for the Barbarian Lord’s Quasi Emperor armor, he would have been obliterated; even so, he suffered grave injuries.
The Barbarian Lord, having never suffered such a loss, was furiously enraged. The other three Heaven Imperial Realm imperial weapons of the Pinnacle of Stars were summoned, and even fairy weapons started to appear, all to seek vengeance.
This scene immediately caught the attention of the strong forces throughout Qianyuan Divine Province, filling their hearts with shock. The usually low-key Chengsheng Mountain had such a strong foundation?
For decades, Chengsheng Mountain had kept a very low profile; aside from the great patriarch who occasionally took wives and concubines, it was basically ignored. Over time, even the patriarch’s marriages and consorts ceased to attract attention.
No one expected that Chengsheng Mountain actually had a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm and a supreme grade imperial weapon, and that they had nurtured a genius of the True Martial Realm.
As the various powers were in shock and doubt, they also felt that Chengsheng Mountain had become too arrogant. Having a Saint Abyss Realm Saint and a supreme grade imperial weapon, they were considered the foremost power beneath the Great Holy Land Schools.
But Chengsheng Mountain dared to provoke the Pinnacle of Stars, weren’t they getting tired of living?
The Pinnacle of Stars was the third-ranked Sacred Land in Qianyuan Divine Province, home to all the powerful warriors of the Barbarian Clan. Not only did it have fairy weapons to stabilize its fate, but it also possessed as many as four Heaven Imperial Realm imperial weapons, far beyond what Chengsheng Mountain could compare with.
In the eyes of the various forces, Chengsheng Mountain appeared to be fortunate to have found a Great Emperor’s treasure; although rising quickly, its foundation was not deep, and it became too arrogant, exposing itself too soon.
Chengsheng Mountain would surely be annihilated!
The master of the Pinnacle of Stars was about to explode with rage, and they would not let go of the Saint and the supreme grade imperial weapon that came to their aid. Sacred Land Schools like Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and Myriad Demon Mountain would join forces to maintain their own interests and would also seek to destroy Chengsheng Mountain.
Forces that recalled the mysterious powers that stirred up trouble decades ago now suspected Chengsheng Mountain to be this mysterious force. Schools like Bai Yujing, Penglai Immortal Sect, and Myriad Demon Mountain had more reasons to deal with Chengsheng Mountain.
But what made the masters of the Great Holy Land Schools extremely wary and shocked other forces was that this battle ended with the defeat of the Pinnacle of Stars.
In that battle, the Pinnacle of Stars brought out its full foundation, with all four Heaven Imperial Realm imperial weapons revived and even parts of the fairy weapon, the Celestial Star Chart, reawakened. Still, they couldn’t stop Chengsheng Mountain.
The three True Martial Realm Barbarian Kings remembered that battle from seven years ago vividly, even harboring a deep-rooted fear, casting a large shadow over their hearts.
They had observed the battle from the Pinnacle of Stars, yet nearly encountered disaster themselves, with the Pinnacle of Stars almost being overturned.
At that time, Kui Yi was obstructed in his rescue attempt, but he and Han Yongchen, faced with the grand formation at the pinnacle of stars, showed no fear, their expressions calm and composed.
Barbarian Lord, “Killing our Barbarian Emperor, does Chengsheng Mountain have such a gallant nerve?”
“Do you really think with a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon, you can do as you please in Qianyuan Divine Province? If Chengsheng Mountain had continued to hide, we would still fear you somewhat, but since you dare to reveal yourselves, it’s only right to eradicate you!”
“Not only will you die today, but Chengsheng Mountain will also be obliterated!”
After swallowing several Divine Pills, the Barbarian Lord’s injuries were almost completely healed, and his shock and fury were palpable, his killing intent pervading the sky and the earth.
As soon as Kui Yi appeared with the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon and declared his sect, the Barbarian Lord instantly guessed which Mysterious Forces Chengsheng Mountain used to belong to.
More than twenty years ago, that Mysterious Forces vanished without a trace, never to reappear, undetectable even by the Great Holy Land Schools, who remained vigilant as if there were a fishbone stuck in their throat.
Who would have thought that in pursuing an exceptional genius of the Human Clan, an unexpected delight would emerge, revealing the previously elusive Mysterious Forces, infamous for their major crimes.
If it hadn’t been for a Saint and a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon descending on Chengsheng Mountain, the Barbarian Lord would still worry about interference from Bai Yujing and other Sacred Lands of the Mortal World, who might rescue this peerless talent of the Human Clan.
But once Chengsheng Mountain’s identity was exposed, the Barbarian Lord had no worries, for Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, House of Divine Armies, and the rest of the Four Sacred Lands of the Mortal World wouldn’t just refrain from hindering him, they would actually assist him in annihilating Chengsheng Mountain.
Not only would the Myriad Demon Mountain of the Demon Clan lend a hand, but the Penglai Immortal Sect from the deeps of the East Sea would as well, for these Great Holy Land Schools each had Divine Yuan Realm masters captured by Chengsheng Mountain.
The barbarian lord was extremely confident in these declarations; he was surrounded by four Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons, and the Heavenly Immortal weapon—Zhou Tian Star Chart from the pinnacle of stars—was already radiating a strand of might, ready to provide support at any time.
The Barbarian Lord had also received transmissions from Monarch of Bai Yujing, the Bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain, the Demon Lord of Heavenly Demon Hall, and other Sacred Land Masters, encouraging him to act boldly and promising their intervention should any mishaps arise.
In obliterating Chengsheng Mountain, the interests of the various Great Holy Land Schools were aligned, even if Chengsheng Mountain was ostensibly under Bai Yujing’s command and considered a supreme power of the Human Clan.
But Qianyuan Divine Province wouldn’t permit another Great Holy Land School to rise, as this would disrupt the entrenched power dynamic. Neither the Barbarian Clan nor the Demon Clan wished for the Human Clan to grow stronger, and even the Four Sacred Lands of the Mortal World didn’t want another Sacred Land encroaching on their interests.
Without Chengsheng Mountain, the Human Clan would still reign supreme over the Demon Barbarian clans, maintaining their dominance in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Facing the arrogant and powerful Barbarian Lord of the pinnacle of stars, Han Yongchen remained silent, Kui Yi stepped in front of him, the Supreme Grade Divine Weapon hung high, warding off the might of the four Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons.
“We respectfully invite the ancestor to descend!”
Kui Yi and Han Yongchen bowed deeply, the tone of their voices exceedingly reverent.
All powers were baffled, wondering what good would it do to summon the ancestor of Han Mansion?
Twenty-three years ago, the ancestor of Han Mansion was still in the True Martial Realm, and even if he reincarnated as a powerful being, he would at most have cultivated to the Divine Yuan Realm, with an extremely slim chance of reaching the Tongxuan Realm.
Even if Han Mansion’s ancestor was a Tongxuan Realm expert, his arrival in the Barbarian Region wouldn’t change the overall situation, and couldn’t reverse the tide.
In the blink of an eye, a golden war chariot tore through the void, directly descending upon the Barbarian Region.
All forces witnessed this scene, their pupils constricting, nearly scared to death—the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain was indeed unfathomable.
That golden war chariot turned out to be a Heaven Imperial Realm level Divine Weapon, pulled by nine-headed dragons, each dragon exuding the aura of the peak of the Sacred Abyss Realm.
One must know, these nine-headed dragons were alive, not just a part of the golden war chariot.
The Chariot of Nine Dragons!
Along with the arrival were miraculous phenomena: flowers from heaven spilled down, divine lights shimmered, celestial music entwined, and fairies danced in the air…
From the Chariot of Nine Dragons, Han Li, dressed in white, stepped out unhurriedly, standing high above the ninth heaven, overlooking the world, casting his gaze down upon the Barbarian Region.
“Who dares obliterate my Chengsheng Mountain?”
Han Li’s gaze swept across the land, landing on the Barbarian Lord, his tone dominant, his stance overbearing.
