chapters.title: Chapter 591 - 234 Qianyuan Divine Province in Shock! Han Li Strikes, a Palm that Covers the Sky! Pressing Down the Four Great Emperor Weapons, Blasts Away Barbarian Lord_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 591: Chapter 234 Qianyuan Divine Province in Shock! Han Li Strikes, a Palm that Covers the Sky! Pressing Down the Four Great Emperor Weapons, Blasts Away Barbarian Lord_1
Han Li makes his entrance!
Stunning the entire arena!
At this moment, even the strongest beings watching from the Barbarian Region and throughout the entire Qianyuan Divine Province had looks of shock and awe on their faces. The ancestor from Han Mansion, who used to be low-profile and known only for taking wives and concubines, appeared today with an unprecedented high profile, domineering and overbearing.
Gazing at the nine peak Saint Abyss Realm flood dragons, and the golden war chariot emitting dazzling light, cleansing the Qianyuan Divine Province, every cultivator watching felt their scalp tingle.
Are you kidding me?!
There wasn’t a single Saint at the Saint Abyss Realm throughout the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, yet Chengsheng Mountain had one emerging one after another, the first time it was just one, and moments later a direct entrance of nine Great Saints, it was absolutely terrifying.
Feeling the vast, sacred might towering the heavens and earth, no one doubted its authenticity, but everyone felt as if they were dreaming.
“Slap~”
Many powerhouses slapped themselves, only to find out that they were not dreaming. Ignoring the pain, they were even more shocked.
They knew that from this moment on, the Qianyuan Divine Province was about to change!
Nine flood dragons that could be called Great Saints pulling the chariot, this lineup was too grand, not even the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors from the Endless Yuankun Domain had such grandeur, only the nine supreme beings could.
Now, there was an additional one.
To pull the war chariot alone required nine peak Saint Abyss Realm flood dragons. Just how many Saints did Chengsheng Mountain have?
Does Chengsheng Mountain have Quasi Emperor powerhouses?
With the ancestor from Han Mansion being so dominant, could he have reached the Quasi Emperor level already?
A Quasi Emperor so young, could the ancestor from Han Mansion have been an Immortal in a previous life?
Everyone watched the figure standing aloft in the sky, clad in white like an exiled Immortal, standing with arms behind back, overlooking all beings. Many powerhouses felt dazed and couldn’t help but bow their heads as if they dared not gaze directly at an exiled Immortal.
“How terrifying!”
“The war chariot itself is a Heaven Imperial Realm imperial weapon; does Chengsheng Mountain have even more imperial weapons than Bai Yujing?”
“Bai Yujing used to be the first Sacred Land, but from now on, I’m afraid it will change to Chengsheng Mountain. Chengsheng Mountain possesses too many high-end combat forces.”
“Not necessarily, you should know that Bai Yujing’s foundation is unfathomable. They have several Heavenly Immortal weapons, and it is said that they even have True Immortal weapons. No matter how many imperial weapons Chengsheng Mountain has, they won’t stand a chance.”
“Heh~ you guys don’t understand that Han Mansion ancestor. He has been so low-key and steady, yet this time he’s made such a high-profile entrance, forcefully overpowering the Barbarian Lord and the peak of all stars. He must have a trump card and no longer fears the great holy land schools.”
In no time, discussions erupted in all corners of the Qianyuan Divine Province. With the aid of various means, everyone was fixated on the Barbarian Region, not wanting to miss any detail.
The change of times begins today!
The pattern of the Six Great Sacred Land ruling the Divine Continent for countless years and epochs will be broken today!
Chengsheng Mountain might leap to become the first Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province, pressuring the great holy land schools, becoming the new overlord.
At this instant, within the great holy land schools across the Qianyuan Divine Province, the atmosphere was extremely somber; Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors and Tongxuan Realm powerhouses all stepped forward, silently watching the battlefield of the Barbarian Region.
Bai Yujing.
“Master, what should we do?”
The Second Grandmaster, Qi Chunfeng, shakingly asked the white-haired, immortal-like Monarch of Bai Yujing.
Next to the Second Grandmaster, the Sect Leader, the Third Grandmaster, and other Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors of Bai Yujing also arrived at Heavenly Bai Yujing.
“No worries, just watch and see what happens.”
The Monarch glanced over the anxious faces of the Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors, waved his hand, and calmly said.
How could Chengsheng Mountain be stronger than Bai Yujing?
Although Bai Yujing has declined, a camel dead is still bigger than a horse; its foundation is far beyond what Chengsheng Mountain can compare to.
As the ruler of Bai Yujing, the Monarch was very aware of how strong Bai Yujing’s foundation was. Any force that attempted to shake Bai Yujing’s ruling status would be easily crushed.
The Monarch was still somewhat surprised in his heart. Chengsheng Mountain had at least ten Saints at the Saint Abyss Realm, which puzzled him since he had been stuck at the peak of the Tongxuan Realm for thousands of years. How did Chengsheng Mountain cultivate so many Saints?
However, as the Monarch of Bai Yujing, he would not be flustered or moved. He needed to remain calm and composed, even if Mount Tai were to crumble in front of him, otherwise if he panicked, how would those below him remain calm?
“Han Li, you’ve revealed yourself too soon, but fortunately, you did. Otherwise, it would have been a real problem.”
The Monarch’s gaze fell upon the figure in the sky above the Barbarian Region and muttered to himself.
If Han Li had continued to lie low, remaining under the radar for a few hundred more years, Bai Yujing’s ruling position might indeed be threatened, but not anymore.
Chengsheng Mountain had not even been there for a hundred years, and even counting its predecessor, Lingjun City’s Han Family, it was just over a hundred years old. How deep could its foundation be?
In the beginning of the Ancient Era, Bai Yujing rose and had been ruling the Qianyuan Divine Province ever since, for hundreds of millions of years. Tracing back in history, Bai Yujing had already existed since the Primordial Ages.
What could Chengsheng Mountain have to compare with Bai Yujing?
The Monarch was very composed, feeling confident about Han Li, thinking that if the peak of all stars failed to prevail, he would support them, using Bai Yujing’s foundation to crush Han Li, and annihilate Chengsheng Mountain.
He was quite interested in the secrets of Chengsheng Mountain. If he could obtain them, not only could he advance to the Saint Abyss Realm, but others from Bai Yujing might also have a chance.
Seeing the Monarch so calm and composed, all the Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors also breathed a sigh of relief, calming down, it seemed that Bai Yujing was still the most powerful.
“Such a monster~”
With a complex expression, Second Grandmaster Lu Zhen looked at the white-clothed exiled Immortal in the sky and sighed.
More than twenty years ago, it was he who personally brought Han Li into Bai Yujing, granting him the position of Elder, to check the Yinyang Sect and Kurong Sect. He wouldn’t have expected that he’d misjudged, essentially shooting himself in the foot.
Now, how could he not understand that Chengsheng Mountain was that mysterious force from before? It wasn’t that he’d been too careless, but that Han Li was too cunning and profound, deceiving everyone with his charade, using Bai Yujing’s name to continue his concealment.

chapters.title: Chapter 592 - 234 Qianyuan Divine Province in Shock! Han Li Strikes, a Palm that Covers the Sky! Pressing Down the Four Great Emperor Weapons, Blasts Away Barbarian Lord_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 592: Chapter 234 Qianyuan Divine Province in Shock! Han Li Strikes, a Palm that Covers the Sky! Pressing Down the Four Great Emperor Weapons, Blasts Away Barbarian Lord_2
Lu Zhen’s heart still overflowed with regret. If only he had gone to look inside Chengsheng Mountain back then, he might have found some clues.
Chengsheng Mountain belonged to those mysterious forces, which meant that Ling Lingshuang, the Fairy of Penglai Immortal Sect whom he longed for, must have fallen into Han Li’s hands. Given Han Li’s lascivious nature, Ling Lingshuang probably had already been taken as his bride.
No wonder Han Li had married so many times, yet never disclosed the identities of his brides. These brides must have been captured by Han Li, and naturally, could not show their faces.
Every time Lu Zhen thought of his beloved senior sister Ling Lingshuang pleasuring Han Li beneath him, his heart ached terribly. The Fairy Ling Lingshuang had been missing for nearly thirty years now; she probably had given birth to several of Han Li’s children by now.
“He truly is a monster,” the Sect Leader said with a dispirited expression.
After years of seclusion, he had finally broken the shackles of his realm and made a breakthrough to the Tongxuan Realm, becoming the third great power of Bai Yujing, essentially the next Dao Lord.
He was gifted and brilliant, a peerless genius among geniuses. He broke through to the Tongxuan Realm before even reaching two thousand years of age, with countless laudatory phrases to his name.
But compared to Han Li, the Sect Leader realized he was nothing, and those laudatory phrases seemed more appropriate for Han Li.
Han Li was not yet three hundred years old and was suspected of having stepped into the realm of a Quasi Emperor, becoming the strongest in the Qianyuan Divine Province.
“Lin’er, you need not compare yourself to Han Li. He is the reincarnation of a Heavenly Immortal; it is normal for him to cultivate rapidly,” the Dao Lord suddenly spoke up.
His first disciple, Tang Lin, had been disheartened. Regardless of whether Han Li was truly the reincarnation of a Heavenly Immortal or not, he had to say so; otherwise, the geniuses of Bai Yujing, after being struck down, might never recover.
Xumi Mountain.
“Boom!”
The face of the female Bodhisattva was filled with shock and fury. With a casual wave of her hand, she shattered a ten-thousand-foot-high mountain in the Buddha Domain.
The lecher who dared defile her, that mysterious strong man, turned out to be the lascivious Han Li, which left the female Bodhisattva utterly astonished.
Given Han Li’s nature, frequently taking wives and concubines, had she been slightly negligent before, she too might have been defiled by him.
The female Bodhisattva did not believe that Han Li lacked the capability. Both Xue Yueqing, the Demon Emperor of Myriad Demon Mountain, and Ling Lingshuang, the Fairy of Penglai Immortal Sect, had been captured by Han Li, who had even tried to ambush her back then.
“Hmph!”
Looking at the white figure in the sky, the female Bodhisattva snorted coldly, her eyes brimming with murderous intent.
If the Barbarian Lord couldn’t deal with Han Li, she would take matters into her own hands!
Both personally and on behalf of her sect, Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain could not be allowed to exist; it would be an opportunity to avenge a past grievance.
The female Bodhisattva was not someone who easily let go of her grudges; she had always dwelled on the past incident, only temporarily setting it aside because she couldn’t find any clues about the mysterious forces.
Penglai Immortal Sect.
“Could it really be him?”
Atop Penglai Divine Mountain, Old Immortal Guanhai exclaimed in shock.
He had never expected that the mysterious Tongxuan Realm powerhouse from back then turned out to be that great elder of love from the Xuan Domain Great Qian Dynasty.
But it all seemed to make sense in hindsight.
The Demon Queen Bai Keqing had disappeared in the Daqian Empire, the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing went missing in the Xuan Domain while searching for Bai Keqing, Long Yue, the reincarnation of the Jiao Saint, vanished from the East Sea Dragon Palace when she left for the Xuan Domain, and his excellent disciple Ling Lingshuang, also disappeared in the Xuan Domain at Dangyang Mountain…
Han Li, well-known for his licentiousness and audacity, had kidnapped one distinguished maiden after another, making them his wives and concubines.
Based on the timeline, these disappearances match up closely with Han Li taking brides shortly thereafter, his marriages never revealing the brides’ identities.
However, back when Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, and Ling Lingshuang disappeared, Han Li only showed off a God Refining Realm cultivation base and was merely a minor figure, easily dismissed from suspicion.
If it weren’t for Han Li displaying his strength decades later, exposing Chengsheng Mountain to the eyes of the Great Holy Land Schools of Qianyuan Divine Province, nobody would have suspected him.
After all, Han Li later became an Elder of Bai Yujing, his status endorsed by the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, Lu Zhen.
“Han Li, today I will see how you can still hide!” Old Immortal Guanhai snorted coldly.
From Long Yue to Ling Lingshuang, to that seven-colored horned loach, Han Li had caused significant loss and dishonor to his Penglai Immortal Sect. He would never swallow this resentment. If the Zenith of All Stars couldn’t suppress him, he himself would make a move.
Old Immortal Guanhai believed that he was not the only one with such thoughts.
Indeed, at this moment, the Demon Lord of Myriad Demon Mountain, Dongfang Qingcang, also felt the same, instantly realizing that the Demon Queen Bai Keqing and the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing had both been captured by Han Li.
The Demon Lord of Heavenly Demon Hall and the Ancestral Master of House of Divine Armies were also watching the battle, both shocked, yet they too quickly made up their minds.
No matter what, both Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain had to be eradicated from Qianyuan Divine Province today.
If Han Li couldn’t be contained by the Zenith of All Stars, then the collaboration of the seven Great Holy Land Schools would take action, and Han Li would surely not be able to withstand them, no matter how many Saints or Quasi Emperors he had.
Unless Chengsheng Mountain had a True Immortal army or a Heavenly Immortal.
But was that possible?
Utterly impossible!
……..
Barbarian Region,
The face of the Barbarian Lord darkened. Han Li, a mere junior, dared to threaten him, clearly having no regard for him or the Zenith of All Stars.
He had lived for more than twenty thousand years, outlasting two Dao Lords of Bai Yujing. No matter how powerful Han Li was in his previous life, in this life he was nothing but a brash young man under three hundred years old.
“I said it,” the Barbarian Lord stated indifferently.
“Now that you, the mastermind behind the scenes, have shown yourself, I don’t mind repeating myself. Today, both you and Chengsheng Mountain must die.”
The Barbarian Lord ascended, seeking to be on the same level as Han Li. Han Li’s attitude of looking down on him was intolerable to the Barbarian Lord.

chapters.title: Chapter 593 - 234 Qianyuan Divine Province in Shock! Han Li Strikes, a Palm that Covers the Sky! Pressing Down the Four Great Emperor Weapons, Blasts Away Barbarian Lord_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 593: Chapter 234 Qianyuan Divine Province in Shock! Han Li Strikes, a Palm that Covers the Sky! Pressing Down the Four Great Emperor Weapons, Blasts Away Barbarian Lord_3
But what made the Barbarian Lord’s face grow even uglier was that he was suppressed by a powerful aura, consistently standing a head shorter than Han Li.
“Han Li, you are being too presumptuous!”
The Barbarian Lord roared in fury as four powerful Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons erupted simultaneously, sending a terrifying surge of power sweeping through, aiming to teach Han Li a lesson.
Even though Han Li appeared very domineering and full of confidence, the Barbarian Lord didn’t care.
What use is it to say there are ten or even a hundred or a thousand Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm?
Chengsheng Mountain only has two Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons now; what difference would another ten make?
Without immortal weapons, they are nothing in the eyes of the Barbarian Lord.
In the Barbarian Lord’s view, Han Li was getting carried away, severely underestimating the foundations of these Great Holy Land Schools.
Did Han Li think that just because he had many Saints, Quasi Emperors, and Emperor weapons, he could run rampant across Qianyuan Divine Province and disregard these Great Holy Land Schools?
Ridiculous!
Although these Great Holy Land Schools had neither Saints nor Quasi Emperors, they possessed immortal weapons that could be fully resurrected and could easily annihilate everything at Chengsheng Mountain.
That’s what you call foundation!
It’s not something that Chengsheng Mountain, with its mere hundred years of history, can compare with.
The Barbarian Lord felt that Han Li’s forcefulness and high-profile stance today must be because he got hold of a Heavenly Immortal weapon and thought he could sit on an equal footing with Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, and the other Holy Land Schools, or even sit atop them.
If Han Li were causing trouble in the Mortal Territory, the Barbarian Lord might have watched coldly from the sidelines, letting the Four Sacred Lands of the Mortal World suppress it and then decide whether or not to intervene afterward.
But Han Li actually wants to climb to the top by stepping on the others; this was a slap in the face of the Barbarian Clan, and today he must suppress Han Li at all costs.
A Heavenly Immortal weapon, that’s all it is—who doesn’t have one?
His stronghold, the summit of the stars, has two!
One is the Zhou Tian Star Chart, and the other is the mountain of the summit of the stars itself, whose might surpasses even that of the Zhou Tian Star Chart.
Even if Han Li has an immortal weapon, he couldn’t withstand his attack.
“Boom!”
Seeing the Barbarian Lord shouting and commanding from afar, Han Li’s expression turned cold and he lifted his hand, bringing it down in a palm strike.
A palm that obscured the heavens!
Han Li’s palm covered the sky and blotted out the sun, brimming with terrifying might, suppressing all four Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons.
Even with the protection of four Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons, the Barbarian Lord still suffered heavy injuries, his figure exploding in the sky before quickly reconstituting, his complexion turning deathly pale and his vital energy severely damaged.
“How is this possible?!”
The Barbarian Lord cried out in alarm, his face filled with disbelief.
Han Li stood motionless, merely lifting his hand to suppress the four Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons—was this a dream?
Among the four Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons of the summit of the stars, two were Top Grade and two were Supreme Grade; even if only partially resurrected, they could bombard and kill the most powerful Quasi Emperor, and even an ordinary Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor couldn’t withstand them.
Yet they were suppressed by one hand of Han Li!
And he was directly blasted apart through the protection of those four Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons!
This combat ability was too terrifying!
At this moment, the Barbarian Lord was almost scared to death, regretting that he had spoken too loudly earlier.
He highly suspected that Han Li must have regained the cultivation of the Heaven Imperial Realm; otherwise, he shouldn’t have such dreadful combat ability.
If it wasn’t because he was the ruler of the summit of the stars, with many methods and countless trump cards, he would have died from Han Li’s strike just now.
The Barbarian Lord was now truly frightened, wiping the nonexistent cold sweat from his forehead. He communicated with the Artifact Spirits of the four Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons and the Artifact Spirit of the Zhou Tian Star Chart, urging them to protect himself at all costs and not give Han Li another chance.
The Barbarian Lord wanted to retreat; he feared Han Li immensely. Just now, he saw that Han Li’s palm strike was casually delivered without using all his strength, yet it possessed such prowess. How terrifying must his true combat ability be?
His arrogance earlier was based on the belief that Han Li was at most a Quasi Emperor, and even with a Heavenly Immortal weapon, he would easily be suppressed by the summit of the stars.
But if Han Li was a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, the outcome would be utterly different.
A Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor’s mana is vast and boundless, and after mastering the Heavenly Sovereign Path, his might is unparalleled, capable of fully resurrecting and sustaining an immortal weapon in combat.
If Han Li were a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor with an immortal weapon, his combat ability would be unquestionably the strongest in Qianyuan Divine Province, beyond the capacity of the summit of the stars to cope with.
Although the summit of the stars has two immortal weapons, supplying energy to them is a big problem—they cannot fight for long.
The so-called full resurrection only lasts for a brief moment, at most only half an incense stick’s time, usually enough to resolve any issue, but not against a Heavenly Immortal weapon-wielding Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
Facing a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor with an immortal weapon, the Barbarian Lord felt a chill in his scalp—for over twenty thousand years, it was the first time he experienced fear.
He was merely in the Tongxuan Realm, and if the immortal weapons on both sides were to fight fully resurrected, he might not be able to protect himself; dying here would be too unjust.
The Barbarian Lord did not want to die—he still had more than ten thousand years of life ahead, and if he used life-extending treasures, he could extend it by a few thousand years more.
But he realized that he couldn’t retreat even if he wanted to; he had spoken too loudly earlier, and all the strong forces in Qianyuan Divine Province were paying attention here.
If he retreated, it would be tantamount to admitting defeat to Han Li, not only severely damaging his own reputation but also diminishing the prestige of the summit of the stars. From then on, Chengsheng Mountain would overshadow them.
“Damn it, why haven’t the Dao Sovereign, Demon Lord, Goddess and the others arrived yet? If they don’t come soon, I’m not serving anymore.”
Watching Han Li standing with his hands behind his back, looking down on him, the Barbarian Lord felt immense pressure and cursed inwardly.
The reason he still held on was that he was waiting for the rulers of Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Penglai Immortal Sect, and the other Great Holy Land Schools to arrive with Emperor and Immortal weapons, which would lessen his pressure and allow them to encircle and suppress Han Li.
No matter how strong Han Li was, facing the encirclement of the seven Great Sacred Lands, he would still die.
The Barbarian Lord’s Primordial Spirit was exceedingly powerful, already comparable to an ordinary Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm, and all these thoughts occurred in the blink of an eye.
Just as the Barbarian Lord was stunned, Qianyuan Divine Province was shocked all over.
At that moment, the Divine Province trembled!
Strong figures from various powers wore expressions of shock on their faces—what did they see?
The old ancestor of Han Mansion suppressed the four great Emperor weapons with one palm and blew up the Barbarian Lord of the summit of the stars!
PS: There will be a second update after 11 PM.

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - 235: The Seven Sovereigns Join Forces! Han Li Clashes with Five Imperial Weapons Barehanded! Arrival of the Immortal Weapons, Might of the Human Path Sword!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 594: Chapter 235: The Seven Sovereigns Join Forces! Han Li Clashes with Five Imperial Weapons Barehanded! Arrival of the Immortal Weapons, Might of the Human Path Sword!_1
“Hiss~”
At this moment, every cultivator watching the battle couldn’t help but draw in a breath of cold air, their faces displaying extreme shock.
“One palm suppressing four Great Emperor weapons! Am I dreaming?”
“The Barbarian Lord was nearly annihilated with one palm strike, and he is a long-established power of the Tongxuan Realm, having outlived two Monarchs of Bai Yujing.”
“Terrifying, this is absolutely the combat ability of the Heaven Imperial Realm!”
“Could the ancestor of Han Mansion be a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm?”
Amidst their shock, many powerhouses immediately began to communicate, feeling as though they were witnessing history.
After the ancient catastrophe tens of thousands of years ago, not a single Saint of the Holy Abyss Realm had been born in the Qianyuan Divine Province, yet now there appeared to be an invincible existence akin to a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
If Han Li doesn’t die today, he is destined to become the tenth Supreme of the Endless Yuankun Domain in the future, leading the Qianyuan Divine Province to revival and glory once again.
At this moment, the Great Holy Land Schools collectively lost their voices, also frightened.
Han Li’s strength was far beyond their expectations.
A Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm!
The Yuankun Domain encompasses endless territories, vast and boundless, yet there are less than a hundred Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, concentrated within the nine strongest forces and thirty-three Heavenly Governing Forces.
The Monarch of Bai Yujing fell silent, his face changing color for the first time in five thousand years; the old master of Penglai Immortal Sect observing the sea twitched, his right hand trembling non-stop, as he had caused enmity with a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm who could kill him across billions of miles of space with just a glance.
The Buddhist Goddess from Xumi Mountain stumbled, nearly falling from the Ninth Heaven, and silently resolved that if she couldn’t kill Han Li this time, she would hide away in Xumi Mountain and not venture out again, else she would follow in the footsteps of Xue Yueqing and Ling Lingshuang.
The Demon Lord of Heavenly Demon Hall, the Demon Lord of Myriad Demon Mountain, and the Armament Ancestor of House of Divine Armies, these three Sacred Land Masters, were all dumbfounded, their faces filled with disbelief.
The appearance of a Saint of the Holy Abyss Realm in the Qianyuan Divine Province, they could barely accept, but a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm emerging without any sound or sign, what kind of epochal joke was this?
Although the six Sacred Land Masters were shocked and incredulous, they acted immediately.
Six beams of Emperor’s Light descended upon the Barbarian Region, appearing behind the Barbarian Lord and revealing the figures of six Tongxuan Realm powerhouses including the Monarch, the Demon Lord, the Buddhist Goddess, and the Armament Master.
“You’ve finally arrived.”
The Barbarian Lord breathed a sigh of relief upon the arrival of his six comrades, his expression relaxing quite a bit.
He felt he was back in the game.
Although Han Li stood at the pinnacle above all stars, the Barbarian Lord never considered solely relying on the pinnacle to fight to the death against Han Li. Even if he could repel or slay Han Li, the pinnacle and the Barbarian Clan would be finished.
With all their heritage expended on Han Li, even if Han Li died, the hidden Barbarian Clan of Chengsheng Mountain would gain nothing and would still have to submit to the Human Clan and pay tribute for peace.
Now that the seven Great Holy Land Schools of the Qianyuan Divine Province had arrived, dealing with Han Li would involve a joint effort, a revival of the holy armaments, allowing everyone to expend their heritage and easily annihilate Han Li.
The Monarch nodded slightly, the Buddhist Goddess let out a cold laugh, and both the Armament Master and the old master observing the sea remained silent.
“Barbarian Lord, you’re getting old, you’ve lost all your spirit. It’s time you stepped down and let someone more capable take over,” teased the Demon Lord of the Heavenly Demon Hall.
He had seen the Barbarian Lord’s pathetic state very clearly; if they hadn’t come, the Barbarian Lord would definitely have retreated.
If the Barbarian Lord had fought to the death against Han Li, the pinnacle and Chengsheng Mountain would have both suffered heavy losses. It would have not only reduced a major external threat for the Human Clan but also eliminated an internal danger.
From then on, the Demon Clan, unable to stand alone, would eventually have to submit to the Human Clan, and the Human Clan would completely dominate the Qianyuan Divine Province. As one of the Four Sacred Lands of the Mortal World, Heavenly Demon Hall would also gain more benefits.
It was a pity that now they couldn’t just reap the benefits, and would need to exhaust the heritage of their own Sacred Lands.
“Demon Lord, you’re young and vigorous. Why don’t you and Heavenly Demon Hall handle Han Li yourselves? After all, you’re both from the Human Clan, and it’s not appropriate for my Barbarian Clan to intervene,” said the Barbarian Lord with a cold laugh, clearly very displeased. The little devil always spoke out of turn without considering the situation.
Previously, the Barbarian Lord did not want to deal with the Demon Lord, worrying he might go mad, but now the Barbarian Lord no longer gave face, having nearly died, and the Demon Lord still dared to mock him, utterly disgusting him.
“Enough, let’s all say a little less. Right now, we need to unite and combine the forces of our three clans to solve this common threat,” said the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang, looking displeased with Demon Lord Dugu Weizun as he tried to mediate.
The Barbarian Lord and the Demon Lord exchanged glances and then looked away, refraining from further sparring. With a great enemy before them, all else could wait.
“What a grand alliance of three clans.”
High above the Ninth Heaven, Han Li stood at the front of his chariot, arms folded behind his back, gazing at the seven Sacred Land Masters opposite him and spoke indifferently.
“Demon Lord, it seems you’ve forgotten that I too am from the Human Clan. Do you think the Monarch, the Demon Lord, the Armament Ancestor, or the Buddhist Goddess would support you?”
“If they support you, then it would mean colluding with the Demon Barbarians, wielding weapons against their own kind, betraying the Human Clan, and they would be scorned by all of the Human Clan.”
Han Li’s voice sounded like a resonant, large bell, echoing through heaven and earth, spreading through the entire Qianyuan Divine Province, shaking the world.
Countless people from the Human Clan looked up, their expressions horrified. The Four Sacred Lands of Mortal World conspiring with Demon Barbarians to jointly slaughter the Human Clan?
“Han Li, you’re quite good at slapping labels on people,” the Buddhist Goddess scoffed, none too afraid of Han Li’s accusatory rhetoric.
Her Buddhist Sect prioritized faith, and those who believe, honor, and worship Buddha won’t be swayed by Han Li’s few words.
“What a joke, you think I’d fear your label?” Demon Lord Dugu Weizun sneered dismissively.
The Demon Clan had countless labels slapped on them already. One more from Han Li wouldn’t make a difference.

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - 235: The Seven Sovereigns Join Forces! Han Li Clashes with Five Imperial Weapons Barehanded! Arrival of the Immortal Weapons, Might of the Human Path Sword!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 595: Chapter 235: The Seven Sovereigns Join Forces! Han Li Clashes with Five Imperial Weapons Barehanded! Arrival of the Immortal Weapons, Might of the Human Path Sword!_2
The founder of House of Divine Armies’s complexion changed slightly, as House of Divine Armies has always been neutral, and colluding with the Demon Barbarians would affect the Human Clan’s internal perception of them.
Nevertheless, now that things have come to this, Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain’s existence could no longer be tolerated.
Monarch of Bai Yujing maintained a celestial demeanor, still calm and composed, and said indifferently, “The words of Bai Yujing represent the will of the Human Clan.”
As the foremost Sacred Land of the Human Clan and even the Qianyuan Divine Province, Bai Yujing’s authority is unshakable, and it has historically been the best at representing the Human Clan.
Han Li casually slandering them meant nothing, since once Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain were wiped out, a single statement from Bai Yujing could eliminate all impacts and further label Han Li as an evil heretic.
The Guanhai Elder from Penglai Immortal Sect was just about to rebuke Han Li when Han Li had already spoken.
“From now on, I call the shots in Qianyuan Divine Province. Chengsheng Mountain is the number one Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province. Who agrees? Who opposes?”
Han Li’s gaze was domineering as he looked down upon the heroes, his tone supremely authoritarian.
Putting on airs is something anyone can do. When he worked at the inflatable doll factory, it was his specialty.
“Presumptuous!”
“Arrogant!”
“Courting death!”
The Demon Lord, Demon Lord, Barbarian Lord, and other Sacred Land Masters were furious. Han Li was on the brink of death and still wanted to perform miracles in front of others.
Since he liked to show off so much, they would send him on his way to do so.
Seeing Han Li’s fearless demeanor, the Monarch’s brow furrowed slightly, and he said angrily, “Han Li, you are too arrogant. The vast Qianyuan Divine Province cannot accommodate you.”
This thieving Han Li, with just an opening statement, intended to dethrone Bai Yujing, along with dethroning him, the Monarch. He was far too presumptuous.
Even with his five thousand years of cultivating character and temperament, his patience was wearing thin.
“Even if you truly were a Great Emperor from the Heaven Imperial Realm, there would be no escape for you today,” the Monarch continued.
Although a Great Emperor from the Heaven Imperial Realm was formidable, they now viewed him with indifference.
The Barbarian Lord had four Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons hovering above his head, the Monarch had brought three Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons with him, and other Sacred Land Masters like the Demon Lord, the founder of the House of Divine Armies, and the Demon Lord each brought two Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons.
At this moment, seventeen Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons dominated the sky, among them eight Supreme Grade and nine Top Grade Divine Weapons, radiating Emperor’s Might so vast it suppressed the heavens and earth, shaking the timeless blue sky.
Even if Han Li were a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, with only two Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons, he stood no chance against them.
This significant turmoil was immediately noticed by the nearby Divine Provinces like Luming Divine Province, and all were astonished as they looked towards Qianyuan Divine Province and employed various means to watch the battle.
As they saw those nineteen Divine Weapons hovering over the Barbarian Region and those eight figures, they were collectively silenced. It seemed that Qianyuan Divine Province was about to turn upside down.
Pausing, the Monarch continued, “Besides, you are not a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.”
An ascension from Quasi Emperor to Heaven Imperial Realm requires a tribulation, a phenomenon of significant magnitude. If Han Li had broken through to the Heaven Imperial Realm, it would have been impossible to conceal.
Therefore, the Monarch was convinced that Han Li had not yet broken through and had only reached the combat ability of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
In fact, the Monarch had guessed correctly.
Han Li smiled, ignoring the Monarch of Bai Yujing and instead turned to the female bodhisattva of Xumi Mountain, asking cheerfully,
“Bodhisattva, we meet again. Have you missed me?”
The female bodhisattva’s face immediately turned cold, and unable to suppress her anger, she said coldly, “Han Li, do you wish to die?”
“I don’t wish to die; I miss you,” he replied.
Seeing the bodhisattva angry, the smile on Han Li’s face grew even wider.
“The Buddhist Sect has always been suppressed by the Dao Sect. Doesn’t Xumi Mountain wish to overturn Bai Yujing and become the number one Sacred Land?”
“I’m willing to lend you a hand in the future, as long as you help me out a few times today, how about it?”
“Boom!”
Without a word, the bodhisattva’s Seven Treasures Pagoda above her head burst with Buddha light, and a beam of it shot towards Han Li.
Han Li, that dead man, still thought to fool her – too naive. She wasn’t fond of the old bull eating tender grass.
Han Li flicked his finger, piercing through the Buddha light, and then, with his palm as a blade, he slashed horizontally and vertically, instantly making three thousand cuts, morphing into three thousand heavenly blades, shattering the void and blasting towards her.
As the female bodhisattva made her move, the Monarch, Barbarian Lord, Demon Lord, and others also took action. The Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons above their heads erupted, fully awakening and unleashing terrifying power at Han Li.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The three thousand heavenly blades collided with the seventeen Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons and quickly disintegrated, yet the remaining power was still fearsome, continuing to blast towards Han Li, but were blocked by Han Li’s protective Divine Garments and Divine Skills.
“You all go first.”
Han Li waved his hand as the golden chariot and the nine dragons, along with Kui Yi and Han Yongchen, converged. The golden chariot radiated a protective force, shielding them.
Although the golden chariot had earlier protected the nine dragons, it wouldn’t last if the battle continued. Han Li didn’t want his chariot to be destroyed by the aftermath.
The Monarch, Demon Lord, Guanhai Elder, and others paid no attention to Kui Yi, Han Yongchen, and the rest. Killing Han Li would make dealing with the others easy. Seizing the moment Han Li gestured, their Divine Weapons attacked once more.
This time, the seventeen Divine Weapons did not explode with divine essence but directly bombarded with their bodies. They wanted to see if Han Li could withstand this.
Han Li’s expression remained unchanged, still serene, strolling through the heavens as if an Immortal King surveying the realms.
As the Divine Weapons approached, five Divine Weapons also emerged above Han Li’s head, all Supreme Grade, fending off twelve Divine Weapons.
Han Li threw punches and palms, his fists piercing the universe and his palms suppressing the heavens, clashing fiercely with the remaining five Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons.
“Bang!”
Han Li slapped away the Seven Treasures Pagoda with a palm, punched the Primordial Clock out of the sky, kicked over the Heaven Burning Furnace, and with two more punchs, sent two other Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Weapons flying.

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - 235: The Seven Sovereigns Join Forces! Han Li Clashes with Five Imperial Weapons Barehanded! Arrival of the Immortal Weapons, Might of the Human Path Sword!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 596: Chapter 235: The Seven Sovereigns Join Forces! Han Li Clashes with Five Imperial Weapons Barehanded! Arrival of the Immortal Weapons, Might of the Human Path Sword!_3
The five Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Armies kept hammering down but were easily blocked by Han Li, who dominated the battlefield with an invincible sweeping gaze, toppling the Divine Armies barehanded without sustaining a single injury.
At this moment, countless spectating cultivators were dumbfounded, and even the Sacred Land Masters such as Dao Lords, Demon Lords, female Bodhisattvas, and the old Daoist watching the sea felt their scalps tingle and their hearts go cold.
Han Li’s combat ability was just too monstrous!
Fully awakened, Top Grade Emperor Armies have combat abilities ranging from the threshold of the Heaven Imperial Realm to that of an ordinary Heaven Imperial Realm cultivator.
Fully awakened, Supreme Grade Emperor Armies are similar, with combat abilities ranging from a strong Heaven Imperial Realm cultivator to a top-notch one, though slightly weaker than those at the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Among those Han Li clashed with were three Supreme Grade Emperor Armies and two Top Grade ones, equivalent to the collaborative effort of three strong Heaven Imperial Realm cultivators, one at the threshold, and one ordinary, yet Han Li suppressed them all by himself.
Had they not witnessed it with their own eyes, they would have certainly called it a rumor.
Had Han Li really not undergone the Emperor Tribulation, ascended to the Heaven Imperial Realm, and become a Great Emperor?
This physical body was too terrifying—facing fully awakened Supreme Grade Emperor Armies with his bare hands, he even managed to utterly suppress the five Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Armies. Was this even conceivable?
It wasn’t just Han Li’s strength; his foundation also left the seven Sacred Land Masters feeling deeply shaken.
Chengsheng Mountain alone had seven revealed Heaven Imperial Realm Divine Armies, six of which were Supreme Grade. This was simply preposterous, even more formidable than Bai Yujing.
In the Ancient Era, even the weakest Penglai Immortal Sect had such a foundation, but during the great catastrophe, most of the immortal and emperor weapons perished or vanished.
“What should we do now?” the Barbarian Lord was somewhat panicking at this moment.
He felt inadequate again.
His previous confidence was gone, all because Han Li’s might was too formidable.
The Demon Lord, the female Bodhisattva, the Demon Lord, and other Tongxuan Realm powers didn’t ridicule him, as they were themselves in disarray and dread.
The Dao Lord from Bai Yujing took a deep breath and solemnly said, “Use the Immortal implements.”
“Are we really going to use the Immortal implements?”
“The cost of awakening the Immortal implements is too great.”
“We must use them. Han Li must also have Immortal implements; otherwise, he wouldn’t be so rampant. Without our Immortal implements, we are utterly incapable of handling him.”
“Correct, even if Han Li is strong, he is still in the Heaven Imperial Realm. Once our seven Heavenly Immortal implements awaken, that’s the combat power of seven Heavenly Immortals. Even if Han Li wields a Heavenly Immortal weapon, he can’t withstand that.”
The several Sacred Land Masters exchanged words, and ultimately they made their decision.
Once decided, they no longer hesitated. Watching Han Li still in combat with the five Emperor Armies, they transmitted their Primordial Spirits’ messages at the same time.
As the Masters of the Great Holy Land Schools, deep within their Primordial Spirits were the imprints of Immortal implements, enabling communication with these implements at any time, and allowing the implements to descend for rescue in case of emergencies.
The next instant, seven rays of Immortal Light descended instantly from various parts of the Qianyuan Divine Province, revealing one Immortal implement after another, unleashing terrifying Immortal might that caused the Qianyuan Divine Province to tremble.
The Azure Heaven Ruler from Bai Yujing, the Zhou Tian Star Chart from the Summit of Myriad Stars, the Heavenly Demon Tower from Myriad Demon Mountain, the Seven Treasures Tree from Xumi Mountain, the Thousand Devil Spear from Heavenly Demon Hall, the World-Shaking Sword from the House of Divine Armies, and the Immortal Flying Map from Penglai Immortal Sect.
Han Li forced back the five Divine Armies with a single punch, and a large cauldron appeared above his head, emitting vast Primordial aura, as if a Primitive World was rising and falling, blocking the Immortal might of the seven grand Immortal implements.
“You really do have a Heavenly Immortal weapon,” said the female Bodhisattva with a darkened expression. The Dao Lord, the Demon Lord, the Demon Lord, and others also looked disturbed.
Although it had been anticipated, the fact that Han Li actually produced a Heavenly Immortal Weapon, and a top-tier one at that, made it very difficult for the seven Sacred Land Masters. It significantly increased the difficulty of suppressing Han Li.
“So only you are allowed to possess Immortal Weapons?”
With the Primordial Chaos Cauldron suspended above his head and streams of primordial chaos energy flowing down to block all immortal might, Han Li stood with his hands behind his back and spoke indifferently.
“A single Heavenly Immortal Weapon, can it stop us?”
Demon Lord Dugu Weizun let out a cold laugh.
Bang!
Han Li directly slapped across, his terrifying might shattering the void.
Above the Demon Lord’s head, the Thousand Devil Spear aimed from a distance, causing the might of Han Li’s slap to dissipate, but Dugu Weizun was startled and his complexion turned ashen.
After he carelessly spoke, Han Li took immediate action. Had he not had the Immortal Weapon Thousand Devil Spear, he might have repeated the same fate and been blasted apart like the Barbarian Lord.
“What pointless chatter.”
Han Li looked down upon the Demon Lord, imposing tremendous pressure on him.
“Kill!”
The Dao Lord, Demon Lord, Demon Lord, Barbarian Lord, and other Sacred Land Masters had been communicating through their Primordial Spirits and shouted in unison.
In an instant, the Azure Heaven Ruler, the Immortal Flying Map, the Thousand Devil Spear, and other seven Heavenly Immortal Weapons fully awakened without any reservations and directly assaulted Han Li.
The Primordial Chaos Cauldron struggled to resist, the power of primordial chaos erupted, and Infinite Immortal Light bloomed with each strand of light containing a world. Worlds were being both born and annihilated at this moment, with the terrifying force of creation and destruction sweeping all directions.
Despite the strength of the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, it couldn’t withstand the combined force of the seven Heavenly Immortal Weapons, among which were top-tier ones, their collective power too terrifying.
Even just the residual impact of their collision could obliterate an ordinary Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
The Dao Lord, Demon Lord, Old Daoist Guanhai, and others were all protected by their respective Immortal and Divine Weapons, and so was Han Li. They all controlled the situation, preventing the might from affecting the area below.
Otherwise, the vast and boundless Qianyuan Divine Province would have been destroyed today, and the Divine Province would have sunk into the earth.
In the next instant, Han Li’s right hand drew the sword at his waist, the Human Dao Sword, and a resplendent sword light was unleashed. It cut through heaven, earth, humans, gods, immortals, even time and space were annihilated under this sword, causality was erased, and fate dissipated without a trace.
The Human Dao Sword, capable of slashing through everything!
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
Seven huge booming sounds spread, resonating through the expansive Qianyuan Divine Province, and even in the surrounding thirty-six Divine Provinces.
The Azure Heaven Ruler, the Zhou Tian Star Map, the Heavenly Demon Tower, the Seven Treasures Tree, the Thousand Devil Spear, the World-shattering Sword, and the Immortal Flying Map were simultaneously sent flying at that moment.
The might they had unleashed was eradicated by this sword, and the Human Dao Sword also simultaneously struck the seven Immortal Weapons, causing four of the ordinary Heavenly Immortal Weapons to show cracks on their surface.
All this happened too quickly, and the situation was reversed in an instant.
This was something no one had expected.
Han Li not only possessed a Heavenly Immortal Weapon but also a True Immortal Weapon!

chapters.title: Chapter 597 - 236: Blowing Up Seven Sacred Land Masters! The Shift of Smiles! Who Dares to Oppose Now?_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 597: Chapter 236: Blowing Up Seven Sacred Land Masters! The Shift of Smiles! Who Dares to Oppose Now?_1
“Are you kidding me?!”
Dao Lords, Demon Lords, Demon Lords, and the Elder of Observing the Sea, along with other Sacred Land Masters, felt their scalps tingle, their expressions filled with horror.
They could accept Han Li possessing a Heavenly Immortal weapon, but Han Li having a True Immortal weapon was far beyond their expectations.
True Immortals stood at the pinnacle of the Endless Yuankun Domain, their numbers extremely few, with only three to five per era, unbeatable throughout an era.
True Immortal weapons, which bear the True Immortal Dao, are slightly more numerous due to historical remnants, but they are also limited in number, each with its own glorious combat record.
Heavenly Immortals have a lifespan of one epoch, True Immortals ten, and the weapons that bear their Dao are no exception to this rule; once their time comes, they decay, even if forged from Immortal Gold.
This is why the Yuankun Domain endures six great calamities every epoch, yet very few immortal weapons remain in the world.
Immortal weapons are limited by lifespan, with each great calamity destroying and obliterating a batch, and some even shatter in combat, leaving only those that survive to be passed down.
The immortal weapons that are passed down are mostly possessed by owners and held by the top powers of the Endless Yuankun Domain. Occasionally, lost immortal weapons surface to assist the rise of an unparalleled genius.
During this era, no True Immortal has appeared, yet True Immortal weapons have always existed, albeit in small numbers, with only twelve known publicly, and whose hands they are in are clear to all.
Of these, nine, including Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, and White Emperor City, the strongest of nine great powers, hold nine, with the remaining three True Immortal weapons in the hands of three ancient powers from a brilliant and prosperous Ancient Era, with Bai Yujing being one of them.
Gaining the recognition of Emperor Level weapons is extremely difficult, let alone immortal weapons, and being acknowledged by True Immortal weapons, willing to emerge and assist, is so rare that it might only occur once or twice every two billion and one hundred and sixty million years, sometimes not at all.
So, the seven Sacred Land Masters didn’t even consider this possibility, not believing that Han Li would have a True Immortal weapon; having one Heavenly Immortal weapon was already remarkable.
Now the worst-case scenario had occurred, Han Li did indeed have a True Immortal weapon, otherwise his sword could not be so domineering.
With a single strike, he suppressed seven immortal weapons, including three top-tier Heavenly Immortal weapons, and even caused cracks to appear on four ordinary Heavenly Immortal weapons. That was a true mark of a True Immortal weapon.
Yet, they couldn’t recognize the origin of the True Immortal Sword in Han Li’s hands; its history should date back to over three epochs, and the records from that period were somewhat vague.
At this moment, the whole world fell silent, both inside and outside of Qianyuan Divine Province, everyone was scared, shocked beyond belief.
Qianyuan Divine Province was truly about to undergo a dramatic change.
The status of Bai Yujing as the first Sacred Land was likely no longer secure.
If Chengsheng Mountain were to rise above Bai Yujing, it would become not only the first Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province but also of the surrounding Thirty-Three Divine Provinces.
In a flash, Dao Lords, Bodhisattvas, Demon Lords, Barbarian Lords, and the other seven Sacred Land Masters communicated countless times via their Primordial Spirits, their expressions growing more and more solemn, knowing today would be difficult to resolve.
Han Li, suspected to be a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, could provide endless energy for Heavenly Immortal weapons and also power True Immortal weapons partially; now with the True Immortal weapon revived, it would be very difficult to stop with only seven Heavenly Immortal weapons.
As the seven Sacred Land Masters covertly communicated, Han Li made his move, not one to wait for his enemies to be ready before striking.
All saw Han Li’s organs roaring as surging Five-Coloured Divine Light burst forth, filling the sky with Five-Coloured Runes that formed into Five-Coloured Wheels of light, bombarding the likes of Dao Lords, Demon Lords, and Bodhisattvas.
Wherever the Five-Coloured Wheels passed, the force of the Dao swept through, shattering the void inch by inch, and in a flash, they struck the seven Sacred Land Masters.
From the moment the Human Dao Sword suppressed the seven immortal weapons to Han Li striking, it was but an instant. The seven Heavenly Immortal weapons were too slow to react, still contending with the Human Dao Sword.
Some Emperor Level weapons of the Heaven Imperial Realm reacted in time, attempting to block Han Li’s Five-Coloured Wheels, but they failed, only managing to reduce the power of the Wheels significantly.
The remaining power struck Bodhisattvas, Dao Lords, Barbarian Lords, and others, causing them to explode directly, their Primordial Spirits torn asunder, blood splattering and flesh flying chaotically, an exceedingly gruesome sight.
Han Li didn’t make a follow-up attack primarily because the Emperor Level and immortal weapons on the opposite side had reacted, and another strike from him would be of little use. Instead, he stood with his hands clasped behind him, towering above the heavens, looking down at the seven Sacred Land Masters.
After a moment, the seven Sacred Land Masters’ bodies regenerated one by one, their flesh reconvened, and their Primordial Spirits returned to their bodies, faces filled with terror. They had nearly died just now, especially the Barbarian Lord, who had been exploded for the second time.
Immortal lights descended to protect them, and Emperor Level weapons surfaced to guard them; however, the seven Sacred Land Masters were still uneasy, watching Han Li, who looked down upon them with immense wariness.
Han Li’s combat ability was too strong, far surpassing theirs. Some among them already had the combat power of Saints of the Saint Abyss Realm, but they were powerless against a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
If it weren’t for their Quasi Emperor Rank battle garments reducing the power of the Five-Coloured Wheels further, no secret trump card would have spared them from being suppressed in one strike.
At this moment, both sides were caught in a standoff, but it was clear to all that the seven Sacred Land Masters were at a disadvantage.
Even though they had seven people, seventeen Emperor Level weapons of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and seven immortal weapons, whereas Han Li stood alone, with five Emperor Level weapons and two immortal weapons.
“Does anyone still object?” Han Li spoke again, revisiting the matter at hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 598 - 236: Blowing Up Seven Sacred Land Masters! The Shift of Smiles! Who Dares to Oppose Now?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 598: Chapter 236: Blowing Up Seven Sacred Land Masters! The Shift of Smiles! Who Dares to Oppose Now?_2
Standing with his hands behind his back high above the nine heavens, his white garments fluttering, the Primordial Chaos Cauldron diffused rays of primordial Immortal light. It made Han Li appear as if standing in the midst of divine sunlight, draped in a layer of Immortal garments, shrouded in a brilliant divine halo, like a banished Immortal descending to the mortal world, gazing down at all living beings, looking down on all strong contenders.
The Barbarian Lord, Demon Lord, Ancestor of Armies, Female Bodhisattva, Old Daoist of the Sea, and the Demon Lord all turned their gazes to the Daoist Lord, waiting for him to make a decision.
Having witnessed Han Li’s terrifying strength and foundation, the six of them already harbored thoughts of retreat, knowing that continuing the fight would mean they couldn’t overcome Han Li, unless the Daoist Lord was willing to use the ultimate trump card of Bai Yujing.
The rise of Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain was certainly not good for the Great Holy Land Schools like Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, and Penglai Immortal Sect, and it harmed their interests, but it was Bai Yujing that suffered the most serious damage.
As for past grievances, in the face of Han Li’s strength that could potentially overpower everything, those were trivial matters. The Female Bodhisattva, Demon Lord, Old Daoist of the Sea, and others silently swallowed their bitterness and decided to let bygones be bygones.
Now it all depended on the Daoist Lord. If he decided to summon the True Immortal weapon of Bai Yujing, then they would join the fight. In that case, there still might be a chance of turning the tide.
If the Daoist Lord chose not to summon the True Immortal weapon, then they were prepared to disperse, at worst cede some territory and make reparations, conceding some benefits to Han Li to resolve this “misunderstanding.”
Based on their understanding of Han Li, resolving this “misunderstanding” wouldn’t be difficult. Han Li had a fondness for high-quality beautiful female cultivators, and they would just need to send some his way.
With the six Sacred Land Masters staring at him, the pressure suddenly shifted onto the Daoist Lord.
The Daoist Lord could no longer maintain his kindly and benevolent facade, his expression ugly, his eyebrows tightly furrowed, feeling both furious and helpless at the thought of the six dragging their feet.
Faced with Han Li’s intimidation, the Daoist Lord truly wanted to summon the True Immortal weapon, the “Contrary Dao Banner,” and suppress Han Li right here.
But the Daoist Lord was not certain.
He had been communicating with the Artifact Spirit of the Azure Heaven Ruler, asking if bringing out the Contrary Dao Banner could ensure the suppression of Han Li.
The Artifact Spirit of the Azure Heaven Ruler informed him that even if the Contrary Dao Banner took action, it could not suppress Han Li. Whether it could even defeat Han Li was an unknown, and the chances were not high.
Therefore, the Daoist Lord hesitated to make a decision.
Using the True Immortal weapon came with too great a cost. The consumption of Immortal Qi and Immortal Stones was too much for Bai Yujing to bear.
Since the great calamity of the Ancient Era, amidst the internal strife of the Qianyuan Divine Province, when the Human Clan and the Demon Barbarians fought three great wars, Bai Yujing had never resorted to the Contrary Dao Banner. It was not worth it, as the Four Great Sacred Lands joined forces were enough to suppress the Demon Barbarians.
The Demon Barbarian clans also knew that Bai Yujing would not summon the Contrary Dao Banner, which is why they dared to start a war, attempting to swallow some of the Mortal Territory. But all their attempts failed.
In the past 110,000 years, Bai Yujing had only used the Contrary Dao Banner twice.
The first time was shortly after the great calamity, when a Quasi Emperor with a True Immortal weapon attacked, trying to seize the foundation of Bai Yujing.
The second time was 40,000 years ago, when the master of the Western Sky Palace intruded into the Qianyuan Divine Province, wanting to take an Immortal Elixir from Bai Yujing.
The True Immortal weapons of both sides were revived, and after a fierce battle, the master of the Western Sky Palace was forced to retreat unwillingly.
This battle also made all the top forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain understand that Bai Yujing was not to be provoked, so even the most powerful forces showed restraint when dealing with Bai Yujing, not acting recklessly.
Now, Bai Yujing’s foundation had been greatly depleted, and the Contrary Dao Banner was only capable of fully reviving for combat three more times, but this era was just beginning and still had a long way to go.
If today the Contrary Dao Banner were to be revived and could suppress or subdue Han Li, then all would be well. But if not, then Bai Yujing would suffer a great loss, and its vitality would be seriously damaged.
If that happened, they would only have two more opportunities to use the trump card, and they would still have to face the watchful Han Li, as well as those top powers in the Yuankun Domain coveting the foundation of Bai Yujing. Bai Yujing would gradually decline.
The Daoist Lord knew that the master of the Western Sky Palace still coveted the Immortal Elixir of Bai Yujing. According to him, that Immortal Elixir was crucial for his spiritual path, and he could not give it up.
Besides the Western Sky Palace, the great forces of the Endless Yuankun Domain, such as the Heavenly Cult and Tai Shi Mountain, were also eyeing Bai Yujing. They were just lying low, waiting for the right moment.
If they failed to achieve any results after using the Contrary Dao Banner this time, anyone could see that Bai Yujing had weakened. If the majority turned against them, and the Western Sky Palace, the Heavenly Cult, and Tai Shi Mountain secretly joined forces to continuously probe Bai Yujing, then it would be in danger.
After all, the Contrary Dao Banner could only be used twice more, and even considering the stored energy of the Contrary Dao Banner, it could only barely withstand a third confrontation.
After that, Bai Yujing would no longer be able to activate the Contrary Dao Banner. If another powerful enemy attacked, Bai Yujing wouldn’t be able to hold out. Once they couldn’t hold out anymore, Bai Yujing’s destruction wouldn’t be far off.
“`
In the Ancient Era, there were a total of five glorious and thriving powers, one of which was destroyed during the great ancient catastrophe, and another was obliterated sixty thousand years ago.
That power had frequently utilized True Immortal Weapons, and in the end, its foundation was exhausted. Unable to resurrect the True Immortal Weapons, they couldn’t fend off the coveting forces and were mercilessly vanquished, their resources divided amongst the four top powers.
The Dao Lord heaved a silent sigh, looked around, and his gaze swept over the Demon Lord, the Demon Lord, the Barbarian Lord, the female Bodhisattva, the old man of Guanghai, and the Progenitor of Armies, transmitting his voice:
“My fellow leaders, I am willing to summon the Inverse Banner to suppress Han Li. Would you be willing to lend me your support?”
The six Sacred Land Masters’ eyes lit up as they each spoke up, willing to lend a hand if it meant suppressing or killing Han Li; after all, they did not relish the idea of someone else gaining supremacy over them.
“Rest assured, Dao Lord, if you are willing to summon the Inverse Banner, my Barbarian Clan will support you with all our might, and even the Summit of Stars will take action,” the Barbarian Lord stated first.
The events of today were instigated by him as he sought to kill the offspring of Han Li, thereby forging a deep enmity.
“Old Dao Lord, Xumi Mountain will not drag its feet,” the female Bodhisattva spoke second.
The female Bodhisattva was feeling a bit anxious; if they couldn’t suppress or kill Han Li this time, her future would be precarious, especially since Han Li was still mindful of her. Even hiding in Xumi Mountain wouldn’t guarantee her safety.
After the female Bodhisattva, the Demon Lord and the old man of Guanghai also spoke up, indicating they would do their utmost to help.
Myriad Demon Mountain and Penglai Immortal Sect both had Divine Yuan Realm martial emperors abducted by Han Li. Penglai Immortal Sect had also suffered secret losses, including Long Yue and the Seven-Colored Dragon Loach, harboring great resentment.
The Demon Lord and the Progenitor of Armies exchanged a glance before expressing their stance; if the Inverse Banner was summoned, they would not stand idly by.
Although there was no enmity between Han Li, Chengsheng Mountain, Heavenly Demon Hall, and House of Divine Armies, it was about upholding a common interest.
Upon hearing this, the Dao Lord breathed a sigh of relief, a smile spreading across his face as he continued, “Then, I ask my fellow Dao friends to each support the old Dao with two thousand strands of Immortal Qi or Immortal Stones of equivalent value.”
Activating the Inverse Banner once required thirty thousand strands of Immortal Qi. If the six Great Holy Land Schools could provide twelve thousand strands of support, then he was willing to stake eighteen thousand strands of his own Immortal Qi on the gamble.
What the Dao Lord had not expected was that the six Sacred Land Masters, who had previously supported him, now fell silent, each adopting an introspective stance.
“Perhaps it’s better to let it be,” said the old man of Guanghai with a cough, the first to speak up.
The remaining Immortal Qi and Immortal Stones in Penglai Immortal Sect amounted to only about two or three thousand, and he couldn’t possibly commit it all to funding the Dao Lord. Even if they won, Penglai Immortal Sect would be left weakened.
“I think it’s still possible to have a talk with Han Li.”
“Indeed, we all belong to Qianyuan Divine Province; there’s no need to fight and kill when we encounter each other.”
“Xumi Mountain will not participate.”
“Dao Lord, as you know, House of Divine Armies does not have deep reserves and can’t produce such an amount of Immortal Qi or stones.”
“If Han Li wants to be the first in Qianyuan Divine Province, let him have it. It’s all but a vain title.”
Seeing the old man of Guanghai speak up, the Demon Lord, the Barbarian Lord, the female Bodhisattva, the Progenitor of Armies, and the Demon Lord followed suit one by one.
Their wealth was meager compared to the ample resources of Bai Yujing, and they dared not squander it in such a manner.
The Dao Lord’s smile suddenly froze and disappeared.
As everyone knows, a smile doesn’t vanish; it just moves elsewhere.
Sure enough, a faint smile now appeared on Han Li’s face. His cultivation was far superior to that of the Dao Lord, the Demon Lords, the female Bodhisattva, and others. Their Primordial Spirit transmissions couldn’t be concealed from him; Han Li intercepted them all and thus learned of Bai Yujing’s trump cards.
“Dao Lord, do you need me to lend you some?” Han Li asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 599 - 237: Speak the Harshest Words, Do the Most Cowardly Deeds! Lady Bodhisattva, Wait for Me at Xumi Mountain! The Battle Concludes_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 599: Chapter 237: Speak the Harshest Words, Do the Most Cowardly Deeds! Lady Bodhisattva, Wait for Me at Xumi Mountain! The Battle Concludes_1
“If possible, this old Daoist naturally wouldn’t refuse.”
The Daoist Lord coughed a few times, his expression revealing not the slightest embarrassment.
The Demon Lord, the Demon Lady, and the female Bodhisattva looked at the Daoist Lord’s face repeatedly, finally sighing inwardly. Before, they hadn’t realized just how thick-skinned this old fellow was.
However, they said nothing. What they had just done was not honorable either. Who would’ve thought this old Daoist Lord could be so cunning, actually wanting them to each contribute two thousand strands of Immortal Qi, he might as well have asked for their lives.
Compared to two thousand strands of Immortal Qi, their lives didn’t amount to much and were not even worth comparing.
Although they were the masters of the Great Holy Land Schools, they could not decide on the use of core strategic resources like Immortal Qi and Immortal Stones, which were stored in the sanctuaries within their respective Sacred Lands, guarded and overseen by the Immortal Soldiers.
In addition to Immortal Qi and Immortal Stones, there were many core strategic resources and important strategic resources they could not use or could not use lightly.
For example, Immortal Elixirs were core strategic resources, cultivated within the sanctuaries and nourished by Immortal Qi,
for example, Emperor Pills of the Heaven Imperial Realm level also resided within the sanctuaries, and Sacred Land Masters had to meet certain conditions to utilize them.
After the ancient Great Cataclysm, the splendor of the Great Holy Land Schools was no more. Most of these resources were either non-renewable or regenerated very slowly, making it most suitable for the Immortal Soldiers to oversee them.
Only by doing so could the Great Holy Land Schools be sustained for a longer time, and could they hope to revive. Otherwise, if left to the whims of the Sacred Land Masters, disaster would strike.
If the Sacred Land Masters were to recklessly squander Immortal Qi, Immortal Stones, Immortal Pills, Emperor Pills, and Emperor Elixirs, only looking after themselves, then it would only be a matter of time before the Sacred Lands met their demise.
These resources were in the hands of the Immortal Soldiers and Artifact Spirits, given only to those who met the requirements, helping the Sacred Land Masters break through.
When the Daoist Lord requested Immortal Qi just now, the Artifact Spirits of the Immortal Soldiers from the Heavenly Demon Hall, Myriad Demon Mountain, Xumi Mountain, and other Great Holy Land Schools transmitted their voices to the Demon Lord, the Demon Lady, and others, instructing them to refuse.
The Old Watcher of the Sea, the Ancestor of Soldiers, the Barbarian Lord, and others all looked up at the white-robed exiled immortal above the ninth heaven with complex expressions, eager to know how Han Li would respond.
“Han has always been generous and kindly. Since the old Daoist Lord has spoken, naturally, I won’t refuse.”
Standing within his dazzling divine halo with his hands behind his back, Han Li, like an Immortal King who overlooked all heavens and worlds, spoke with a smile.
The Daoist Lord’s expression stiffened, and the female Bodhisattva, the Demon Lord, and others were also shocked, having never expected Han Li to agree.
Had Han Li gone mad?
Setting aside whether Han Li could produce twelve thousand strands of Immortal Qi or an equivalent amount of Immortal Stones, he was actually planning to fund the enemy to fight against himself. Was he tired of living?
Before the Daoist Lord and others could speak, Han Li made his move.
From every pore of his body burst forth sword lights shooting towards the sky, evolving into one Immortal Sword after another, a full twelve thousand of them. They shone brilliantly, emitting a dazzling light that shook Qianyuan Divine Province.
The next instant, under Han Li’s prompt, all the Immortal Swords shot out, clanking as they fell from the ninth heaven, forming a long river of sword Dao. Those were twelve thousand Immortal Swords, each possessing tremendous might. Any marginally weaker Quasi Emperor who encountered them would die on the spot, and even a mere graze would result in grave injury.
“Old Daoist Lord, catch the twelve thousand swords you requested,” said Han Li nonchalantly.
At that moment, Han Li was enveloped in a layer of divine glow, like he was cloaked in radiant immortal robes, making him shine like a divine sun that illuminated all worlds.
If said to borrow twelve thousand, then Han Li would give exactly twelve thousand, not one more or one strand less.
“Damn it!”
Witnessing this terrifying scene, the Daoist Lord’s eyes nearly popped out of their sockets, and he couldn’t help but curse.
He had asked to borrow twelve thousand strands of Immortal Qi, but damned if you didn’t give me twelve thousand Immortal Swords instead, each bringing tremendous lethal power upon me; you’re after my old life!
The power of the Immortal Swords was too strong; even the old Daoist Lord at full strength couldn’t withstand a single Immortal Sword, as both his body and Primordial Spirit would be suppressed and killed.
“Everyone, attack together!”
The Daoist Lord bellowed, activating a top-notch Quasi Emperor weapon while his Quasi Emperor battle armor also revived, preparing to withstand the residual power.
The Demon Lord, the female Bodhisattva, and the Old Watcher of the Sea didn’t hesitate at all. The long river of swords was terrifying and was not simply targeting the Daoist Lord but had locked onto all of them.
Even with several Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapons to block, they didn’t dare to be careless. They had already been blasted apart once before, so they also each brought out Quasi Emperor weapons, their Quasi Emperor armors rippling in the wind.
Han Li did not strike again, merely looking on indifferently. He knew that under this strike, all seven Sacred Land Masters would fail to withstand.
The Azure Heaven Ruler, the Heavenly Demon Pagoda, the Seven Treasures Tree, and seven other Immortal Weapons unleashed radiant Immortal Glow, attempting to shatter the long river of swords. However, a slash of the Human Dao Sword filled the skies, the sword light brilliant, shining upon every inch of space, dazzling from the nine heavens to the ten lands, pressing down the seven Immortal Weapons.
The Seven Treasures Pagoda, the Heavenly Star Diagram, the Primordial Clock, and seventeen Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapons all burst forth, trying to grind away at the river of sword Dao. Slightly above Han Li’s head, the Primordial Chaos Cauldron vibrated gently, releasing the power of the primordial chaos, as three thousand worlds faded into oblivion, heavily pressing towards the seventeen Emperor weapons.
The faces of the Daoist Lord, the Barbarian Lord, the female Bodhisattva, and the other seven Sacred Land Masters drastically changed. Was Han Li determined to eradicate them?
Before the Demon Lord, the Demon Lady, or the Ancestor of Soldiers could speak, the Barbarian Lord could no longer hold back. He had been in communication with the Artifact Spirit of the Pinnacle of Stars and called upon its power.
The battlefield where everyone was engaged in was located in the Barbarian Region, and this battle was too intense. If they were not careful, not only would the Barbarian Region be destroyed, but they too would perish here.
The Artifact Spirit of the Pinnacle of Stars did not refuse and directly revived part of its might, intending to block the long river of sword Dao.

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - 237: Speak the Harshest Words, Do the Most Cowardly Deeds! Lady Bodhisattva, Wait for Me at Xumi Mountain! The Battle Concludes_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 600: Chapter 237: Speak the Harshest Words, Do the Most Cowardly Deeds! Lady Bodhisattva, Wait for Me at Xumi Mountain! The Battle Concludes_2
The zenith of the myriad stars is the highest Divine Mountain in Qianyuan Divine Province, where, in ancient times, Immortals from the Barbarian Clan plucked stars and captured moons, refining countless great stars within an entire star domain to construct this Divine Mountain.
This is not just a Divine Mountain, it is also a top-notch Immortal Weapon, possessing unlimited might. One strike can obliterate a Zhoūtiān world, and destroying a great universe is but a trivial matter.
In an instant, the Zhoūtiān stars atop the zenith of the myriad stars trembled, endless starlight cascaded down like a river of stars, crossing the void, with the Zhoūtiān Star River rushing towards the Sword Dao river.
Boom!
The terrifying collision erupted, the Immortal Sword radiated dazzling sword light, shattering the power of the stars, the starlight of the Zhoūtiān Star River was surging, obliterating one Immortal Sword after another.
In the end, the river of Sword Dao was completely shattered and dissipated, with the residual force of the Zhoūtiān Star River continuing to charge towards Han Li, seeking to take advantage of the opportunity to vanquish him.
Han Li still stood with his hands behind his back, his expression calm, not taking the attacking Zhoūtiān Star River seriously. It should be known that even a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor facing such an attack would need to be cautious, or they might easily be severely injured.
The Primordial Chaos Cauldron quivered gently, the rampaging Zhoūtiān Star River was instantly frozen in the void, unable to approach Han Li by an inch, and then shattered inch by inch, exploding in the sky, with all the power of the stars dissipating.
Boom!
The horrifying aftershocks swept through everything in all directions, and Han Li was naturally unharmed, while Kui Yi, Han Yongchen, and the nine flood dragons were also safe under the protection of the imperial weapons.
On the contrary, the seven Sacred Land Masters, caught off guard once again, were hit by the aftershocks and burst apart; this was still after their Quasi Emperor weapons and armor had blocked most of the power.
It took a full three breaths of time for the Dao Lord, Guanhai Old Daoist, the female Bodhisattva, and the other six Sacred Land Masters to resurrect, while the Barbarian Lord took ten breaths of time before he recovered, his face as white as a sheet.
“My apologies, everyone,” said the Barbarian Lord, ready to retreat.
He had already been blown apart three times. Even if he had backup plans, another two times and he would be completely dead.
The Barbarian Lord did not wish to die; he could still live for another ten or twenty thousand years. He didn’t need to oppose Han Li to the death here.
Let Han Li rise to power if he will. After all, Chengsheng Mountain was in the Xuan Domain, far away from the Barbarian Region, so the impact on the Barbarian Clan was not substantial. Conversely, the Four Sacred Lands of Mortal World would be greatly affected, as they were all around Chengsheng Mountain.
The Dao Lord opened his mouth to persuade but could not bring himself to say the words. Could he really ask the Barbarian Lord to stay and continue to wait for death?
The Demon Lords, the Demon Lord, Guanhai Old Daoist, the female Bodhisattva, and the rest of them exchanged glances, each silently sighing and giving up completely.
If the Dao Lord was willing to use Bai Yujing’s True Immortal weapon, the Inverted Dao Banner, they might still have a fight left in them, but the Dao Lord was reluctant to expend Bai Yujing’s heritage, and thus they had no means to continue the battle.
They had originally wanted to retreat, but they were swayed by the Dao Lord’s rhetoric, leading them to get blown apart once again, and they already harbored great resentment towards the Dao Lord.
But no one said anything; in any case, from now on, Bai Yujing would also fall from their altar and never regain their former glory, while Chengsheng Mountain would shine resplendently, becoming the new overlord of Qianyuan Divine Province.
“Did I allow you to leave?” Han Li said indifferently.
Standing amid a dazzling ring of divine light, Han Li extended his long, fair right hand with slightly curved fingers, distorting space and time. His hand hovered above the Barbarian Lord’s head, patting his crown.
The Barbarian Lord’s body immediately stiffened and he dared not move an inch. He hadn’t expected Han Li to attack without honor, launching a surprise attack.
As the master of the zenith of the myriad stars and the shared ruler of the Barbarian Clan, it was the first time the Barbarian Lord had been touched on the head, and he regarded it as a tremendous humiliation.
But with his life in Han Li’s grasp and the Zhoūtiān Star Chart and the zenith of the myriad stars unable to come to his aid in time, the Barbarian Lord’s complexion turned from green to white, uncertain of what to do.
“Han Li, don’t push me,” the Barbarian Lord shouted sternly.
Are you forcing me to kneel and beg for mercy before you will let me go?
