Dao Lord, Demon Lord, female Bodhisattva, and the others remained silent, merely watching quietly. The situation was now clear—they had lost. If they tried to hinder Han Li further, they worried he might take out his anger on them.
“Barbarian Lord, you brought all this upon yourself. Just bear the consequences,” the six Sacred Land Masters said to themselves.
Today they had given up much, employing a great amount of Spirit Source to fully revive two or three emperor weapons, and to fully restore an Immortal Weapon, they had expended over a thousand threads of Immortal Qi.
Yet they reaped no benefits, instead suffering a great loss of face and being blown apart twice, an utter defeat.
They didn’t blame the Barbarian Lord, as it was their choice to make these sacrifices in order to deal with the threat of Han Li.
Now they simply wished for Han Li to cool off and then let them leave without causing further trouble, so that everyone could live in peace without crossing each other’s paths.
Let Chengsheng Mountain take over the rise, and they would concede the Xuan Domain to Chengsheng Mountain. After all, the Xuan Domain was empty, and they would have to swallow their resentment.
Afterward, they would still have to go to Chengsheng Mountain to seek peace, apologize to Han Li, offer marriages and territory, and pay compensation to avoid Han Li holding a grudge.
“So what if I am forcing you?” Han Li said flatly.
With a few pats on the head of the Barbarian Lord, he suddenly slapped him across the face.
Bang!
The Barbarian Lord’s face was half obliterated, flesh and blood blurred. He was sent flying, crashing into the ground and kicking up a cloud of dust.
A mere Tongxuan Realm upstart, given face, you are called the Barbarian Lord, without it, simply a slap would kill you.
He had slumbered for many years, his cultivation base had changed drastically compared to before, reaching an extremely high level, with nothing left to fear.
Over these years, Han Li had gained plenty in terms of Heavenly Immortal weapons and True Immortal weapons alone, his foundation unimaginably strong. Not just in Qianyuan Divine Province, but even in the Endless Yuankun Domain, he was the overlord.

chapters.title: Chapter 601 - 237: Speak the Harshest Words, Do the Most Cowardly Deeds! Lady Bodhisattva, Wait for Me at Xumi Mountain! The Battle Concludes_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 601: Chapter 237: Speak the Harshest Words, Do the Most Cowardly Deeds! Lady Bodhisattva, Wait for Me at Xumi Mountain! The Battle Concludes_3
If he continued to cower and fear this and that, he would truly become a pig.
He was just biding his time, not being a coward!
This was a perfect opportunity to declare that Chengsheng Mountain’s rise was unstoppable and would facilitate his marriage to even more high-quality wives and concubines.
In Han Li’s eyes, the Barbarian Lord was nothing, and the Barbarian Clan had but two celestial weapons; the Zhou Tian Star Chart was a common Heavenly Immortal weapon, and the Summit of Stars was a top Heavenly Immortal weapon, neither of which Han Li took seriously.
If he were to fear even the Barbarian Lord’s harsh words, wouldn’t that mean his strength and foundation had been improved in vain?
“Hiss~”
At that moment, all six Sacred Land Masters simultaneously gasped, unconsciously touching their left cheeks, as if Han Li’s slap had also landed on their faces.
The Barbarian Lord was indeed too pitiful.
Just watching it made them feel the pain.
Yet no one spoke up; there was no intention to support the Barbarian Lord. Letting Han Li vent was good enough.
Even the “youngest and most vigorous” Demon Lord was not acting nervously at the moment, but was dutifully bowing his head, fearing that Han Li would slap him too.
The female Bodhisattva’s fair face was full of shock, and she, too, lowered her head, trying to focus on the tips of her toes to shift her attention, yet she couldn’t see them no matter how hard she tried.
She was worried that Han Li would go mad and abduct her there, which would be the end of everything.
The likes of Dao Jun, Demon Lord, and others wouldn’t help her, as eliminating one threat would be good for them, given the profound enmity between the Buddhist Sect and the Dao Sect, Demon Clan, and even the Demon Clan.
The Demon Lord, the Old Daoist of Guanhai, and others were also looking around as if searching for something, pretending not to see the Barbarian Lord’s pitiful state.
At that moment, they realized that it was a good thing for Xue Yueqing and Ling Lingshuang to have been abducted by Han Li; they probably had become one of his Dao companions, bringing Myriad Demon Mountain and Penglai Immortal Sect closer to Chengsheng Mountain.
With the rise of Chengsheng Mountain, they could also bask in its glory; perhaps they might even receive some benefits from Han Li.
“Ahhh~”
As the dust settled, the figure of the Barbarian Lord was revealed, utterly disheveled. He roared to the skies, his eyes bloodshot as he stared at Han Li standing with his hands behind his back high above in the heavens.
The Barbarian Lord burst forth with overwhelming momentum, his rage peaking, bellowed, “Han Li, you’ve forced my hand!”
Dao Jun, Demon Lord, female Bodhisattva, and others were startled, fearing the Barbarian Lord really sought death.
The next moment, the Barbarian Lord knelt on the ground and “bang bang bang” kowtowed three times before angrily shouting, “Since you absolutely demand it, I’ll kneel down and beg you, is that satisfactory now?”
Demon Lord, Dao Jun, the Old Daoist of Guanhai, and others: “???”
The six Sacred Land Masters were stunned, never having imagined the Barbarian Lord would do such a thing, shattering their previous impression of him.
They questioned themselves, if they were the Barbarian Lord, they definitely wouldn’t be able to carry out such an act of extreme humiliation.
He was indeed speaking the harshest words yet performing the most cowardly act.
Han Li’s eyebrows rose, the Barbarian Lord’s actions were unexpected, and he had been ready to slap him again, potentially to death.
Now, it didn’t seem right to do so.
The Barbarian Lord had knelt and kowtowed for mercy; one had to give him some face, after all, he didn’t intend to annihilate all the sacred lands of Qianyuan Divine Province.
His purpose for coming out today had been achieved.
“Fine.”
Han Li’s expression was indifferent as he remained with his hands behind his back and uttered a single word.
The Barbarian Lord instantly breathed a sigh of relief; he had been scared to death, previously sensing Han Li’s intense killing intent. If he didn’t submit, he would surely die there.
As for the disdain from Dao Jun, Demon Lord, the Old Daoist of Guanhai, and others, the Barbarian Lord didn’t care. What did their mockery matter? Staying alive was of utmost importance.
Besides, he felt that if others were in his shoes, they too would have to kneel and kowtow for mercy or die.
Was kneeling to a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm shameful? Not shameful at all!
It was even a great honor.
After all, not everyone could battle a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm and live to tell the tale.
Han Li’s gaze swept over Dao Jun, Barbarian Lord, Demon Lord, the Old Daoist of Guanhai, Demon Lord, and the God of War, finally landing on the female Bodhisattva.
“Female Bodhisattva, wait for me at Xumi Mountain.”
With Han Li’s words falling, nine dragons pulling a golden chariot flew in. Han Li entered, and the golden chariot tore through the sky as it departed.

chapters.title: Chapter 602 - 238: A battle shocks the world, with repercussions felt in all directions! Losing the lady and the troops! Setting aside the facts..._1
chapters.content:
Chapter 602: Chapter 238: A battle shocks the world, with repercussions felt in all directions! Losing the lady and the troops! Setting aside the facts…_1
Barbarian Region battlefield.
Gazing at Han Li, enveloped by a resplendent divine halo as he departed on a golden chariot, like an Immortal King ruling over the world, the seven Sacred Land Masters fell into silence.
Today’s battle had shattered the power structure of Qianyuan Divine Province that they had striven to maintain, with Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain rising to the top, seizing the top divine seat in Qianyuan Divine Province and oppressing it.
“A great paradigm shift unseen in a billion years,” declared the Ancestor of Weapons, profoundly moved.
From the Ancient Era until now, Bai Yujing was revered in Qianyuan Divine Province, but now Chengsheng Mountain took its place, welcoming the seventh and most powerful Sacred Land to the Divine Continent, which could be called the Supreme Territory.
In terms of heritage, Bai Yujing possessed the True Immortal weapon, the Reversal Banner, while Chengsheng Mountain also had that True Immortal Sword. Chengsheng Mountain even outstripped Bai Yujing in terms of Immortal and Imperial weapons.
As for strength, the mightiest in Bai Yujing could only be considered great beings of the Tongxuan Realm, and even stronger Dao Lords could only exhibit the combat ability of the Saint Abyss Realm, still falling short of the dragon pulling Han Li’s chariot.
As the master of Chengsheng Mountain, even though Han Li might not be a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, he possessed the combat ability of that realm, enough to suppress the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths, sweeping through all enemies in the universe.
Such strength and heritage, even if not comparable to that of Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, Heavenly Cult, and the other nine mightiest forces, were not far behind, and in the future, it would become the tenth such ultimate power.
The Ancestor of Weapons saw this as a good thing. In the short term, the rise of Chengsheng Mountain indeed affected their interests, but looking at the long term, if Chengsheng Mountain led Qianyuan Divine Province back to its glory, standing at the pinnacle of the Endless Yuankun Domain, they too could venture out and achieve the status of Saints.
Furthermore, his House of Divine Armies had always remained neutral in the strife within the Human Clan, only trading in weapons and even giving them as gifts to heroes from all sides to forge good karma.
The rise of Chengsheng Mountain didn’t significantly impact the House of Divine Armies; in fact, it might even reap considerable benefits, such as gaining a massive market for weapon sales.
There were no shortage of people in the Han Mansion of Chengsheng Mountain, with many new lives born each day. Han Li and his descendants did not cease in their marital unions, encouraging procreation and the spreading of their branches and leaves.
The Old Daoist of the Sea and the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang both sighed, feeling an unbearable sense of frustration in their hearts.
If only they had known how strong Han Li was, they wouldn’t have come. They should have let the Barbarian Clan deal with this themselves. Now they had suffered great losses, which could be described as a substantial weakening of their vital energy.
Fully resurrecting an Immortal weapon and two to three Heaven Imperial Realm Imperial weapons had consumed an immense amount of Immortal Qi and Spirit Source. Having been obliterated twice and then resurrected, they too had exhausted a great deal.
Compared to the depletion of their heritage, the loss of face was a minor matter; after all, they had lived for thousands to tens of thousands of years, and their skins were incredibly thick.
Xue Yueqing and Ling Lingshuang had been captured by Han Li. They wanted to settle accounts with Han Li, but…
They even had to proactively offer their daughters to Han Li, hoping he would be generous and forgiving, dismissing this “misunderstanding,” otherwise, life would be difficult for them in the days to come.
This was truly a case of losing the wife and the soldiers.
Regarding Han Li, they could no longer harbor resentment; instead, they felt somewhat grateful, for after all, Han Li had refrained from annihilating them, allowing them to escape with their lives.
The female Bodhisattva’s face remained expressionless, as she stared intensely in the direction where the golden chariot had disappeared. The turmoil in her heart was far from the calm she outwardly displayed.
The Penglai Immortal Sect and Myriad Demon Mountain could resolve the situation by offering daughters to Han Li, but what about her Xumi Mountain?
Han Li, that lascivious scoundrel, had his eyes fixed on her, even wanting her to wait at Xumi Mountain. Was he planning to commit dishonorable acts in the Buddhist Sacred Land?
The more the female Bodhisattva thought about it, the angrier she became. Waves of emotions churned within her; what could she do to escape Han Li’s influence…
She had no desire to proactively marry Han Li as his Dao companion, nor did she wish to be passively abducted by him for the same purpose. A solution was imperative.
Yet, with Han Li now leading with overwhelming momentum, the female Bodhisattva found herself outclassed in every aspect compared to Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain.
Although she lacked a solution at the moment, the female Bodhisattva had no intention of sitting idly and awaiting her fate.
Han Li: Indeed, only I would be sitting and waiting for pressing demands.
While the four Tongxuan Realm mighty beings were lost in thought, the Demon Lord spoke up, turning his aggressive attention toward the Barbarian Lord.
“Barbarian Lord, we came here to lend you a helping hand. Shouldn’t you reimburse us for our aid?” the Demon Lord asked coldly, his demeanor suggesting he might strike at any disagreement.
Demon Lord Dugu Weizun was the youngest among the seven Sacred Land Masters and had nothing but contempt for the Barbarian Lord’s shameful and lowly actions of begging and kowtowing for mercy.
They had come from afar to assist in the Barbarian Region, at great expense, nearly perishing here without surrendering.
Yet the one they had come to help, the Barbarian Lord, had surrendered first.
There was a sense of tragic irony in their sentiment, akin to “While your subjects are ready to die fighting, why has your majesty already surrendered?”
As for the fact that they had previously ignored the Barbarian Lord’s plight and did not lend assistance, the Demon Lord conveniently overlooked this detail.
Facing such a cowardly Barbarian Lord, the Demon Lord would not be polite; he had to extort some compensation; otherwise, it would be a total loss.
The Barbarian Lord was weak at the knees, and so the Demon Lord would take advantage of the situation to recoup some of the losses for the Heavenly Demon Hall. He believed the others would join him in this cause.
As expected, the female Bodhisattva, the Old Daoist of the Sea, the Dao Lord, and even the Ancestor of Weapons, who was planning to leave, as well as the Demon Lord Dongfang Qingcang, who was bound by a shared fate with the Barbarian Clan, all turned their gaze toward the Barbarian Lord, applying pressure in unison.
The Dao Lord regained his composure and divine presence, looking impassively at the Barbarian Lord, “Barbarian Lord, today’s events are all because of you, causing us immense loss. It’s also due to your actions that our reputation suffered greatly; you need to give us an explanation.”
Had it not been for the Barbarian Emperor’s breach of martial honor, attempting to assassinate Han Li’s descendants, none of these subsequent events would have unfolded.
With Han Li so powerful and Chengsheng Mountain’s heritage so formidable, the Dao Lord would rather have preferred for Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain to continue lurking in silence, allowing Bai Yujing to remain the dominant force in Qianyuan Divine Province without suffering such a heavy blow to their dignity and merely sustaining a minor depletion of their strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 603 - 238: A battle shocks the world, with repercussions felt in all directions! Losing the lady and the troops! Setting aside the facts..._2
chapters.content:
Chapter 603: Chapter 238: A battle shocks the world, with repercussions felt in all directions! Losing the lady and the troops! Setting aside the facts…_2
Given Han Li’s low-profile disposition, he would not expose himself proactively. Things could have remained peaceful, with each minding their own business—Chengsheng Mountain even technically belonged to Bai Yujing.
Daojun naturally knew that this view was somewhat biased. Everyone’s goal was the same: to maintain common interests. But who’s to blame for the failure?
Someone had to bear the responsibility for the failure, and who better than the Barbarian Lord, the chief culprit, to take the blame? It would also prevent any disagreement among the others, and they might even recoup some losses from the Barbarian Lord.
“That’s not quite right, everyone.”
Feeling the icy gazes of the six Sacred Land Masters, the Barbarian Lord shuddered and hurriedly spoke.
“In order to eliminate our common threat, I, Old Barbarian, risked my life to lure Han Li’s arrival, creating this situation. You all were slacking. If you hadn’t been hiding your true strength, we definitely would have won.”
The Barbarian Lord spoke with a bluster that seemed ill-founded, even hinting at more.
Had the Daojun of Bai Yujing been willing to pay the price to use the Contrary Dao Banner, today’s outcome would have been uncertain. They had a fair chance of suppressing Han Li.
Before Daojun could speak, the Barbarian Lord continued, “If we’re comparing tragedies, who has suffered more than I have, more than the Barbarian Clan with its grievous losses?”
“This time, a mid-stage Divine Yuan Realm Barbarian Emperor from my clan has perished. He was our future successor. Without him, my Barbarian Clan will never recover.”
True or not, he claimed the title first.
“In this battle, my Barbarian Clan deployed four Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapons, all fully restored, consuming more resources than any of you; the partial revival of the Summit of Celestial Stars, the full restoration of the Zhou Tian Star Chart for combat, also cost no less than two thousand strands of Immortal Qi.”
“How substantial are your losses compared to those of my Barbarian Clan? They are far less.”
“Moreover, Old Barbarian here exploded three times in succession. In the end, half of my face was smashed. You all stood by, silent as I was humiliated.”
“Do you think I wanted to kneel and beg for mercy? As a co-leader of the Barbarian Clan, do I not have face to keep? Even if I can abandon my own dignity, does the Barbarian Clan not need to uphold its honor?”
“How I wanted you to speak out for me, even if just a word; Old Barbarian was willing to fight Han Li to the death, even if it meant dying right here.”
“Seeing Han Li about to slaughter us, I sacrificed myself and the Barbarian Clan for the sake of all our lives, to preserve our honor. Now I’m a laughingstock to the world. Aren’t you satisfied yet?”
“I’ve fallen to such lows; what more do you want? Do you really want to push me to Han Li’s side? Leaving aside the facts, do you not share some of the blame? Isn’t what I’m doing considering everyone’s well-being? Can’t you think about me for once?…”
The Barbarian Lord started by playing the victim, then grew more impassioned as he spoke, as if he were a hero who faced power without fear and was prepared to die for a just cause.
Daojun, the Demon Lord, the Demon Lord, the Female Bodhisattva, the Warrior Ancestor, and the Old Sea Watcher looked surprised. Perhaps the Barbarian Lord had a point?
Yet, they all felt something was off, but couldn’t quite pinpoint what it was.
Suddenly, the atmosphere grew tense.
The Barbarian Lord and his clan had suffered greatly; this time, their losses were indeed far greater than those of the others. If they still demanded compensation from the Barbarian Lord, would they still be human?
So, they needed to demand more compensation, so that the Barbarian Clan would suffer even more. In that case, it wouldn’t matter if they acted inhumanely.
“Ahem, Barbarian Lord, no matter what, you have to take responsibility for this,” said the Demon Lord, the first to break the silence.
The Barbarian Lord’s eyes widened in shock as he looked at him. Well, that was unexpected. They had agreed to stand together, form an alliance against the Human Clan, yet this burly fellow was the first to stab him in the back.
“Barbarian Lord, I know you’ve suffered a lot. So, just compensate my Penglai Immortal Sect with five hundred strands of Immortal Qi, no more,” said Old Sea Watcher, his face expressionless.
Barbarian Lord: ???
Not ask for more?
He might as well just ask for my life.
The Female Bodhisattva, the Demon Lord, the Warrior Ancestor, and Daojun and others in turn spoke up, all with the core message: the Barbarian Lord had to compensate them for their losses, the more the better.
Anyway, the rise of Chengsheng Mountain had become a fact, and no one could change that. They might as well kick the Barbarian Clan while it was down, eradicating them. This way, Qianyuan Divine Province would still have only seven Great Holy Land Schools.
Boom!
The Barbarian Lord’s expression turned cold, and a terrifying aura erupted, revealing that he, too, possessed combat ability at the Saint Abyss Realm.
Above his head, the four Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapons shone with frightening Emperor’s Might. The Zhou Tian Star Chart unfurled like a thunderclap overhead, seemingly ready to create a vast universe. Even the distant Summit of Celestial Stars seemed to respond, as strands of Immortal Might burst forth.
“Don’t push me,” the Barbarian Lord shouted.
“What if we do?” Daojun said placidly, while the Demon Lord, the Demon Lord, and others wore cold smiles, disbelieving that the Barbarian Lord would dare fight them to the death.
The Barbarian Lord had already knelt faster than anyone before. If he could kneel and beg for mercy from Han Li, why not from them as well?
The six Sacred Land Masters unleashed their own auras to suppress the Barbarian Lord. Their Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapons and Immortal Weapons also radiated a trace of their power, countering the Barbarian Clan’s Emperor and Immortal Weapons.
For a moment, the battlefield was filled with an aura of slaughter.
“Then let it be a fight to the death!” the Barbarian Lord declared, each word intensifying his aura, without showing any sign of submission.
He had indeed no intention to submit. He was well aware that he could bow to Han Li, but he must not bow to the others.
Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain stood too high to concern themselves with him or the Summit of Celestial Stars. But if he submitted to these six, then the Barbarian Clan would truly be finished.
The support of the Barbarian Clan was already dwindling. If he were to compensate the six Great Holy Land Schools as well, then the foundation of the Barbarian Clan would be utterly drained, leaving nothing behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - 238: A battle shocks the world, with repercussions felt in all directions! Losing the lady and the troops! Setting aside the facts..._3
chapters.content:
Chapter 604: Chapter 238: A battle shocks the world, with repercussions felt in all directions! Losing the lady and the troops! Setting aside the facts…_3
By then, even if we had imperial and immortal weapons, we wouldn’t be able to activate them, and would have no choice but to be at the mercy of others.
Henceforth, the Barbarian Clan would become a subordinate to the Human Clan and the Demon Clan, having to surrender to one of them in order to secure a chance to survive, and the Barbarian Clan would no longer be able to occupy the vast Barbarian Region.
The Barbarian Lord also clearly understood that these characters were only Saber-rattling, seemingly strong but withering inside, not daring to make a move.
Even if they joined forces to annihilate the Barbarian Clan, so what?
Let’s not mention how the Barbarian Clan would fight back in desperation, but just to fully revive the thirteen Heaven Imperial Realm imperial weapons and six immortal weapons would consume a tremendous amount of resources, and the remaining heritage of the Barbarian Clan would not be enough to offset that consumption.
Indeed, seeing the Barbarian Lord so steadfast, the Daoist, Female Bodhisattva, Demon Lords, and others hesitated, caught in a dilemma.
Figures such as the Ancestor of Soldiers, the Old Mystic of Watching the Sea, and the Demon Lord began to waver and considered giving up, for destroying the Barbarian Clan would prove to be a pyrrhic victory.
The Demon Lord still wanted to take a bite out of the Barbarian Clan, but relying solely on the Heavenly Demon Hall, he couldn’t confront the Barbarian Clan.
The Daoist took a deep look at the Barbarian Lord and finally said, “Old Barbarian, we all know you’ve been through a lot, we were just joking with you earlier, don’t take it to heart.”
Barbarian Lord: ???
That was supposed to be a joke?
My Barbarian Clan almost perished at your hands.
“If you know I’ve suffered, then don’t pressure me, I, Old Barbarian, don’t like to joke,” said the Barbarian Lord with a stern voice and face still cold.
“Hmmph!”
The Female Bodhisattva snorted coldly, realizing she wouldn’t be getting any compensation, decided not to stay any longer, and disappeared with the Seven Treasures Pagoda and Seven Treasures Tree.
She had to return to Xumi Mountain to prepare.
The Daoist, Demon Lords, and others also left one after the other, and eventually, the battlefield was left with only the Barbarian Lord, Han Yongchen, and Kui Yi.
Han Li, as he departed, didn’t take them with him, letting Han Yongchen continue his trials.
The Barbarian Lord glanced at the two of them, descended and said with a smile, “May I ask how to address this senior?”
“I’m Han Yongchen, brother. How has your journey been? I, Old Barbarian, would like to visit the Han Ancestor at Chengsheng Mountain.”
In front of Kui Yi and Han Yongchen, the Barbarian Lord changed his tune rapidly, eager to ingratiate himself, a stark contrast from his previous defiance.
This battle came quickly and ended just as fast, but its impact continued to spread.
At this moment, the major powers within Qianyuan Divine Province were all abuzz, having witnessed the display of divine might by the Han Ancestor, and the rise of Chengsheng Mountain.
Even the seven Great Holy Land Schools had yielded, and from that moment on, Chengsheng Mountain became the undisputed premier Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province.
Suddenly, forces related to Chengsheng Mountain and Han Mansion by marriage found themselves rejoicing at the unexpected windfall, now backed by a powerful ally, the surprise coming all too suddenly.
Hence, these forces decided to make an extra effort, selecting the finest from within their ranks, aiming to offer additional daughters to the Han Ancestor, to maintain relations.
Those that weren’t related by marriage and had previously looked down on Chengsheng Mountain and Han Mansion now scrambled in a frenzy, holding grand selections within their domains, declaring their intent to send their most outstanding female disciples to Chengsheng Mountain.
Not just in Qianyuan Divine Province, but powerful forces from other Divine Provinces who had witnessed the battle were also stunned and beyond shocked.
What followed was an immense pressure.
Chengsheng Mountain, akin to an ancient Divine Mountain, now loomed over their heads, an entity they couldn’t resist.
Bai Yujing was still okay, as it had reached its peak in the Ancient Era but was now in decline, confined to Qianyuan Divine Province, lacking influence over other Divine Provinces.
But Chengsheng Mountain was different; its heritage and strength far surpassed that of Bai Yujing.
The rise of Chengsheng Mountain meant the revival of Qianyuan Divine Province to its ancient glory. The thirty-six Divine Provinces, once dominated by Qianyuan Divine Province, would likely become its vassals once again.
But this time, the ruler had changed, shifting from Bai Yujing to Chengsheng Mountain.
These forces dared let Bai Yujing’s disciples leave Qianyuan Divine Province, but they didn’t dare hinder Chengsheng Mountain – how could they when Chengsheng Mountain boasted a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor?
Provinces near Qianyuan Divine Province, like Luming Divine Province, were already pondering a visit to Chengsheng Mountain, as being the first to ally often came with great benefits.
PS: Continuing with the bonus chapters for monthly tickets, including a second update with four thousand words.

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - 239: The Eternal Great Emperor! Xuxian Realm! Thirty Years of Time! Han Yongting Enters Thousand Soldiers Alley_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 605: Chapter 239: The Eternal Great Emperor! Xuxian Realm! Thirty Years of Time! Han Yongting Enters Thousand Soldiers Alley_1
Qianjue Mountain lay in the western part of the Barbarian Region. After leaving Qianjue Mountain, Han Yongting headed southeast.
According to the route, he would diagonally cross the Sword Domain, passing by the House of Divine Armies on the way before reaching Xuan Domain, entering the territory of the Ancient Empire, and finally making his way back to Chengsheng Mountain.
Now, Han Yongting had entered the territory of the Sword Domain.
The Sword Domain was vast, stretching over eight hundred million li from east to west and over seven hundred million li from north to south, covering an area of approximately six billion li, which was much larger than Xuan Domain.
As the territory of the Sacred Land known as the House of Divine Armies, the cultivators within predominantly wielded weapons. Hundreds of types of weapons, such as swords, spears, and halberds, were in use, among which swords, knives, spears, and staves were the most commonly used by cultivators.
In addition to the House of Divine Armies, there were many Divine Yuan Realm and True Martial Realm powers in the Sword Domain, all intricately related to the House of Divine Armies.
Mingjian Mountain Villas, Shushan Sword Sect, Heartless Sword Tomb, Nanyue Sword Pool, and other four major sword schools, Wenxin Sword Sect, and three major knife sects such as Canghai Sword Cult, had two top forces each for spears and staves.
Han Yongting was in no rush to return to Chengsheng Mountain; there was still some time before the next event, which afforded him plenty of opportunity to travel at leisure and broaden his horizons.
To gain the full experience, Han Yongting went to great lengths to change his name and disguise his identity, concealing his cultivation level to blend into this treacherous Cultivation Realm.
Otherwise, bearing the name of Chengsheng Mountain and as the descendant of the Ancient Great Emperor, he would not face any danger at all, which would be too bothersome.
The Ancient Great Emperor was Han Li’s new title.
Ever since the battle in the Barbarian Region seven years ago, when Han Li demonstrated combat ability worthy of the Heaven Imperial Realm, suppressing all challengers beneath the heavens, and becoming an undefeated force throughout Qianyuan Divine Province, he gradually came to be known by the title of Great Emperor.
However, he was not initially called the Ancient Great Emperor, but rather the Romantic Great Emperor, a term that unofficially spread in private circles.
Some even brazenly called him the Emperor of Wives or the Emperor of Concubines. These two titles circulated in a limited scope, mainly because others dared not use them openly.
The moniker of Romantic Great Emperor was somewhat better as it was more subtle. If one were to call him the Emperor of Wives or the Emperor of Concubines, that would be too direct. Didn’t the ancestor of Han Mansion care about his reputation?
If the ancestor of Han Mansion became enraged, the entire Qianyuan Divine Province would run red with blood.
Han Li wasn’t a narrow-minded person, but after taking action only once, he wiped out an entire Divine Yuan Realm Power who dared to secretly bestow upon him some more distasteful, shameful names, which was pushing it too far.
Did they really think that just because he had strength, he would refrain from taking action just to maintain a so-called dignity?
They thought too much!
After descending from the mountain, he had painstakingly laid low for over a hundred years, wasn’t it all so that when he became powerful he could do as he pleased?
To dare to slander him and ruin his good name was simply seeking death.
When Han Li took action, the Qianyuan Divine Province was once again shaken.
From then on, no cultivator, even in private, dared to use any unseemly titles for Han Li; they unanimously referred to him as the Ancient Great Emperor.
The title of Ancient Great Emperor was given by Han Li himself; he coined it casually to prevent others from spreading rumors.
Han Li had lived a clean and honest life, and he wasn’t about to let anyone destroy his good name.
……
Han Yongting visited Mingjian Mountain Villas to appraise famous swords, observed the Demon-Subduing Tower at Shushan Sword Sect, and went to the Wenxin Sword Sect to ask questions at the Wenxin Cliff…
Along the way, Han Yongting visited every illustrious sword school in the Sword Domain. Disguising his identity, he approached as a Loose Cultivator, issuing challenges, discussing the sword with sword sects, comparing knives with knife sects, and competing with spear factions…
Han Yongting only revealed cultivation at the Hollow Void Stage; he took every challenge seriously, keeping his true strength under wraps, hoping to gain insights from these contests and integrate them into his own martial path.
Han Yongting’s challenge was a smooth journey; there were no short-sighted powerhouses who dared to bully the weaker, nor would they dare to do such a thing.
In the past, it was a tradition in Qianyuan Divine Province for cultivators to issue challenges, such as the Third Patriarch of Baiyujing, Lu Zhen, who had often gone to the Sword Domain to issue challenges.
However, it used to be more dangerous. If one made too much of a show of strength, suppressing the sect too harshly, there was a risk of being assassinated.
The descendants of Han Mansion often went out for cultivation trials, issuing challenges here and there, and had encountered several assassination attempts, all of which were turned around on their attackers.
But ever since that battle seven years ago, no sect dared to act in such a manner anymore. The peak of all stars, unable to accept defeat, invoked the colossal presence of Chengsheng Mountain, and the Ancient Great Emperor Han Li arrived, defeating all undefeated forces under the heavens.
Before Han Yongting, many descendants had already emerged from Han Mansion, including Han Li’s children and grandchildren, as well as outstanding individuals from the fourth generation.
These individuals, bearing hidden surnames, were undergoing tribulations throughout the Qianyuan Divine Province and loved issuing challenges. They hardly ever lost, creating an illusion amongst the various forces of the Divine Province.
The assumption was that the waters of Qianyuan Divine Province ran deep: beyond Chengsheng Mountain lay numerous dormant powerful forces and those incredible geniuses were cultivated by these reclusive powers.
For a time, there was a sense that the realm was flourishing with diverse talents vying with each other, as if the Divine Province was teeming with unparalleled prodigies, each one stepping on the various powers to emerge.
Little did they know, all these individuals hailed from Chengsheng Mountain and Han Mansion.
It was Han Li’s intention to have them venture out for cultivation; Qianyuan Divine Province was much like a backyard to Chengsheng Mountain and Han Mansion, where cultivation trials carried no danger.
This was only the first step of cultivation. Once their cultivation reached the True Martial Realm, they could begin the second step of their trials: to travel throughout the entire Endless Yuankun Domain. If they reached the Tongxuan Realm, that would mark the start of the third step of their cultivation journey, allowing them to enter the Xuxian Realm, where they would compete with the geniuses and extraordinary talents from the entire Tai Chu Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - 239: The Eternal Great Emperor! Xuxian Realm! Thirty Years of Time! Han Yongting Enters Thousand Soldiers Alley_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 606: Chapter 239: The Eternal Great Emperor! Xuxian Realm! Thirty Years of Time! Han Yongting Enters Thousand Soldiers Alley_2
Every trial comes with a set mission, and upon completion, there will be a reward; if one exceeds expectations, then there is an additional generous reward.
As for the Xuxian Realm, it is a spiritual world, spanning the entire Tai Chu Realm’s twelve hundred and ninety-six thousand domains, where numerous exceptional prodigies and demonic geniuses dwell. The entry threshold is the Divine Yuan Realm because only then does one cultivate the martial soul of Primordial Spirit.
Han Li had his descendants enter only after reaching the Tongxuan Realm as a precaution to avoid failure upon entry and the resulting blow to their psyche.
Over the years in hiding, Han Li had acquired many treasures, one of which was a magical treasure named “Door to the Xuxian.”
As the name suggests, the Door to the Xuxian is the gateway to the Xuxian Realm. Activating the Door to the Xuxian will open a passage into the Xuxian Realm, allowing a cultivator’s Primordial Spirit to enter the Xuxian Realm through this passage.
Han Li also learned about the vast and boundless world beyond the Xuanshen Sword Mountain known as the Tai Chu Realm from the Xuxian Realm.
The domain he resided in, the Yuankun Domain, was but one of the vast and immeasurable twelve hundred and ninety-six thousand domains of the Tai Chu Realm, a notion that filled Han Li with longing.
It is important to note that even the Yuankun Domain is incredibly vast, home to eight hundred Divine Regions and a multitude of seas, inhabited by countless trillions of beings.
Though the Yuankun Domain is renowned for being endless, it is merely a corner of the Tai Chu Realm, separated from the outside world by the Xuanshen Sword Mountain, with hardly any contact with the outside.
How vast is the Tai Chu Realm?
Han Li had no idea, nor did the exceptional prodigies and demonic geniuses in the Xuxian Realm; even the Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm were incapable of traversing the entire Tai Chu Realm.
Beyond the twelve hundred and ninety-six thousand domains, the Tai Chu Realm also comprises the Thirty-three Heavens and numerous forbidden lands, life-forbidden zones, and special regions.
According to Han Li’s understanding, the majority of immortals in the Tai Chu Realm reside within the Thirty-three Heavens, each Heaven being boundlessly vast, not any smaller than the twelve hundred and ninety-six thousand domains, with the Divine Provinces of the strongest Heavens being even more expansive.
In the Xuxian Realm, the prodigies and demonic geniuses are mostly from the twelve hundred and ninety-six thousand domains. Rarely do those from the Thirty-three Heavens descend, holding themselves in high esteem.
There are simply too many exceptional beings in the Xuxian Realm, plentiful as cabbages, each capable of dominating an era in the Yuankun Domain, with few true matches.
Therefore, Han Li was extremely cautious in selecting descendants to enter the Xuxian Realm; he had no intention of sending them into torment.
Generally speaking, if a Primordial Spirit dies within the Xuxian Realm, the physical body in the outside world does not perish. What actually enters the Xuxian Realm is merely a strand of the Primordial Spirit’s light, which is reconstructed by the rules of the Xuxian Realm, indistinguishable from the original self.
However, there are exceptions. If someone targets them specifically and employs forbidden weapons, it can still affect the Primordial Spirit in the outside world. Even with ample protection, the Primordial Spirit might be obliterated.
…….
Two months later,
Han Yongting arrived at the center of the Sword Domain, where the House of Divine Armies was located.
The House of Divine Armies was one of the predetermined trial locations for Han Yongting. He planned, upon leaving the Barbarian Region’s Qianjue Mountain to break through to the True Martial Realm, to return and visit the Sword Domain’s House of Divine Armies to see if there were any great opportunities for him.
As one of the seven Great Holy Land Schools in Qianyuan Divine Province, at least one-third of the weapons in Qianyuan Divine Province were forged by the House of Divine Armies.
The House of Divine Armies also established goodwill by selling weapons at low prices from time to time. Thus, countless cultivators held the House of Divine Armies in high esteem, hoping to acquire powerful Heaven Rank Artifacts, Divine Weapons, and even Emperor-level weapons at a relatively small cost here.
Han Yongting’s target was the Thousand Soldiers Alley at the House of Divine Armies. As the progeny of Yun Miaoyi and a scion of the Han Mansion, in possession of the Thunder War Body, Han Yongting was quite wealthy and could even afford Tongxuan Realm Weapons.
But that would cost him most of his fortune, and just any Tongxuan Realm Weapon was not enough for Han Yongting, who already possessed Sacred Soldiers.
What Han Yongting needed was an Emperor-level weapon, preferably a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapon, or at the very least a Quasi Emperor weapon. Whether for presenting to his family or for personal use, acquiring such a weapon would reap him enormous benefits.
Paying a hundred Top Quality Spirit Stones allowed one to stay half a day in the Valley of Ten Thousand Treasures, said to contain countless weapons ranging from Lower Grade Heaven Rank Magical Treasures to Emperor-level weapons.
As long as one could gain recognition from a weapon, they could pull it out and take it away freely; even if unsuccessful, they would still be gifted a Lower Grade Earth-Level Magical Treasure upon departure.
For Han Yongting, the hundred Top Quality Spirit Stone entrance fee was quite cheap; if he could obtain a Quasi Emperor weapon or a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapon from the Valley of Ten Thousand Treasures, then he would make a fortune.
He felt there was a chance for him to acquire an Emperor weapon, especially since he possessed the Thunder War Body.
Judging from the experience of his brothers and sisters, those with special physiques had a twenty to thirty percent chance of obtaining an Emperor weapon when visiting the Thousand Soldiers Alley, a chance thousands of times higher than for ordinary cultivators.
Indeed, Han Yongting was not the first Han Mansion offspring to visit the House of Divine Armies.
Seven years ago, it was not common for Han Mansion descendants to come to the House of Divine Armies seeking Emperor-level weapons, but in the last seven years, every descendant who left the Chengsheng Mountain to experience the world made a trip to the House of Divine Armies’ Thousand Soldiers Alley, attempting to acquire Emperor-level weapons.
There were not a few who succeeded.
Although most obtained Quasi Emperor weapons, some managed to obtain Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapons.
At that moment, Han Yongting stood before the House of Divine Armies.
Compared to other Great Holy Land Schools such as Myriad Demon Mountain, The Pinnacle of Stars, Penglai Immortal Sect, and Xumi Mountain, the entrance to the House of Divine Armies was not very towering.
The House of Divine Armies was situated within the Divine Weapons Mountain Range with three main peaks and thirty-three secondary peaks.
Each of the three main peaks reached thirty-three thousand zhang high, resembling the three legs of a furnace, while the thirty-three secondary peaks, each rising three thousand zhang tall, surrounded the main peaks, forming the body of the furnace—an inverted three-legged furnace.

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - 239: The Eternal Great Emperor! Xuxian Realm! Thirty Years of Time! Han Yongting Enters Thousand Soldiers Alley_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 607: Chapter 239: The Eternal Great Emperor! Xuxian Realm! Thirty Years of Time! Han Yongting Enters Thousand Soldiers Alley_3
“Tsk, tsk, the Heavenly Immortal from the House of Divine Armies really doesn’t hold back.”
Looking at the House of Divine Armies, Han Yongting muttered to himself.
Such a grand gesture could only come from a Heavenly Immortal. The Heavenly Immortal from the House of Divine Armies was not only an expert at treasure refinement but was also highly skilled in formations. Artifact refining and array setup often went hand in hand since powerful weapons typically had formations inscribed within them.
The Heavenly Immortal from the House of Divine Armies transformed the Divine Weapons Mountain Range; he plucked stars and seized moons, refining all the stars from three Star Domains to establish an Immortal Array in its entirety.
“When will the main peak of Chengsheng Mountain ever surpass the main peak of the House of Divine Armies?”
Han Yongting’s eyebrows rose as this thought surfaced in his mind.
About thirty years ago, long before his birth, the main peak and the secondary peaks of Chengsheng Mountain began to grow taller. The main peak grew a Zhang (3.3 meters) each day, while the five secondary peaks grew two meters daily, and the nine smaller peaks grew one meter.
To this day, Chengdao Peak, the main peak, had risen from over three thousand Zhang to more than fourteen thousand Zhang and was still climbing.
A thought flashed through Han Yongting’s mind, and he quickly calculated the exact number. According to the current growth rate of Chengdao Peak, it would surpass the main peak of the House of Divine Armies in a thousand more years.
Although Chengdao Peak was not forged from stars, its foundation was no less robust than that of the House of Divine Armies or the Peaks of Stars. It involved the forces of the Great Dao from multiple Immortal Weapons.
Pushing his thoughts aside, Han Yongting walked into the House of Divine Armies.
Soon, Han Yongting followed the crowd to Thousand Soldiers Alley, located in the midst of the three main peaks. Every day, many cultivators from all over Qianyuan Divine Province would flock there, the stream of people never ceasing.
Han Yongting spent a hundred Top Quality Spirit Stones to enter as a Loose Cultivator, leisurely strolling through Thousand Soldiers Alley.
Thousand Soldiers Alley was vast, spanning a hundred thousand li when viewed from the outside; its interior was a separate space, nearly half the size of the Sword Domain.
Within Thousand Soldiers Alley, weapons were planted everywhere — swords, spears, halberds, axes, maces, whips, and so on. If finely categorized, there would be tens of thousands of varieties. Not only was there a wide array of weapons, but weapons of all levels could be found here, except for Immortal Weapons.
Han Yongting’s Divine Sense swept the area, finding that within the range of his scan alone, there were over a thousand cultivators, ranging from Grandmasters in the Hollow Void stage to Martial Emperors in the Divine Yuan Realm. No one was fighting; all were choosing weapons, sensing for a perfect match.
Some stood still in front of a weapon, touching it, mumbling to themselves, while others kept moving, trying to find the weapon that fit best with their own being.
“Indeed, the benefits of the House of Divine Armies are not easy to come by,”
Han Yongting observed for a while and arrived at this conclusion in his mind.
Thousand Soldiers Alley was too vast, and the majority were Heaven Rank or lower weapons. The higher-grade Divine and Emperor-level weapons were fewer in number and had returned to simplicity, indistinguishable from ordinary weapons — it all depended on one’s discerning eye.
Although one could fly here, for those with weaker cultivation, not to mention covering the entirety of Thousand Soldiers Alley, it would be difficult to traverse even a tenth of it in half a day. How would one be able to select a fine weapon?
However, Han Yongting had no such troubles. He had ample experience; when he left Chengsheng Mountain for training, he had sought advice from brothers and sisters who had visited Thousand Soldiers Alley.
Han Yongting continued his leisurely stroll, but the source of the Thunder War Body within him was emitting reverberations of the Dao sound. Formless and intangible, this sound was almost imperceptible to cultivators but was highly effective in attracting recognition from Emperor-level weapons.
It wasn’t long before the Dao sound permeated the entire Thousand Soldiers Alley, and Han Yongting immediately felt a series of special sensations arise within him.
PS: Three days of added updates in a row, will there be more tomorrow?

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - 240: Top Grade Imperial Arms! I’m Not Capable, But My Father Is! Returning to Han Mansion! How Strong is Han Li’s Power?_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 608: Chapter 240: Top Grade Imperial Arms! I’m Not Capable, But My Father Is! Returning to Han Mansion! How Strong is Han Li’s Power?_1
Han Yongting’s divine spirit investigated and his eyes suddenly brightened, a smile appearing on his handsome face.
Within his perception, countless weapons resonated with him, all compatible with his martial path and physique, although the vast majority were below the rank of Divine Weapons.
Among them, there were thirty-six Tongxuan Realm Weapons, thirteen Sacred Soldiers, five Quasi Emperor Weapons, and the strongest of them were two medium-grade Emperor Level weapons, one a sword, and the other a spear.
“It seems that Thousand Soldiers Alley is fated for me,” Han Yongting muttered to himself.
This treatment could be considered above average among his siblings, with a whole five Quasi Emperor Weapons that suited him, although it was a pity that there were no Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapons, and he could only choose one.
After thinking it over, Han Yongting actively cut off most connections, including those to three lower-grade Emperor Weapons, leaving only the two medium-grade Emperor Weapons’ resonance as a backup.
He still had time and planned to keep trying to see if he could capture the heart of a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapon…
Han Yongting continued to fly through Thousand Soldiers Alley, and half an hour later, he stopped to watch the happenings around him.
In front of him, a broken sword was slanted into the earth, its mysterious black color revealing that one-third of it, including the tip, was missing, with the remaining blade embedded half a foot deep in the ground.
Before this mysterious black broken sword, two people stood in indecision, arguing in low voices.
“Junior Sister, I feel this sword suits me very well. How about I choose this sword?”
“Senior Brother, are you stupid? This is a broken sword, and by the looks of it, it’s not of high quality. Even if you pull it out, you’ll lose a lot of spirit stones.”
“But I feel there’s more to it…”
“Don’t be foolish, Senior Brother. Do you feel a connection with this broken sword? Even if you want to take it with you, it also depends on whether it’s willing, right?”
“I…”
The Senior Brother was suddenly at a loss for words. He looked left and right, still somewhat wanting the broken sword.
He felt that there was something extraordinary about this sword, as if it carried an immense background, but he was unable to articulate this, and indeed, he felt no resonance with the broken sword.
Lacking a resonance meant that he couldn’t pull the broken sword out.
The Senior Brother sighed, and his Junior Sister pulled him away. After they hadn’t gone far, the Senior Brother flew back, stood before the broken sword, and murmured to himself. Then he stretched out his right hand toward the hilt as if he wanted to give it a try.
The Junior Sister stamped her foot but ultimately did not stop him again, letting the Senior Brother proceed.
A look of anticipation appeared on her face; she hoped that her Senior Brother could pull it out and that his judgment was not wrong, otherwise, they would waste an opportunity.
To enter Thousand Soldiers Alley, one had to pay a fee of one hundred Top Quality Spirit Stones, with each cultivator getting five chances to try pulling out weapons a maximum of five times.
This was to prevent cultivators from pulling out weapons one by one, selecting the best among them, and causing significant damage to the interests of the House of Divine Armies.
By limiting the number of attempts, cultivators wouldn’t act recklessly but would carefully resonate with the weapons before making their decision.
Han Yongting watched as well. With his cultivation level, he couldn’t discern the mystery of the black broken sword using his naked eye—it seemed just like a regular weapon.
As for the brother and sister, managing to put out two hundred Top Quality Spirit Stones at the God Refining Realm, they must come from a major sect. It remained to be seen if they had such good fortune.
Suddenly, Han Yongting’s eyebrows raised; the broken sword had indeed been pulled out, and its quality was not low.
The Senior Brother held the hilt and slowly pulled out the broken sword, his expression changing from tension to excitement, and a look of exhilaration also appeared on his Junior Sister’s face.
The might of the weapons in Thousand Soldiers Alley would manifest when pulled out, making it easy to determine the quality.
Both Han Yongting and the brother-sister pair realized that this broken sword was a Divine Sword of Divine Rank lower-grade, with exceptional might.
“Fantastic!”
After pulling out the broken sword, the Senior Brother tenderly stroked the blade as if caressing his most beloved lover.
“Congratulations, Senior Brother,” his Junior Sister said sincerely.
The emergence of a Divine Sword made a lot of noise and immediately attracted the attention of many people around, with countless gazes and spiritual senses sweeping over. Upon seeing this, envy appeared on their faces.
Another lucky one!
With a lower-grade Divine Sword in hand during the later stages of the God Refining Realm, the future looked promising, and advancing to the True Martial Realm would be easy, barring unexpected circumstances.
The value of a Tongxuan Realm Weapon was extremely high, countless times more than a hundred Top Quality Spirit Stones.
This motivated others even more. Indeed, good treasures could be found in Thousand Soldiers Alley. If one person could achieve this, they too had the hope of obtaining Divine Weapons or Emperor Weapons.
After the Divine Sword was pulled out, Han Yongting left and continued to explore deeper. He chose a direction at random, seemingly aimless but actually following his inner guidance.
The previous scene had made him realize that not having a resonance wasn’t a problem; as long as he could persuade the Artifact Spirit and gain its approval, he could also pull out a weapon.
Weapons that reached Divine Rank would birth Artifact Spirits, though the spiritual intelligence of lower-grade and medium-grade Divine Weapons’ spirits were lower. The intelligence of the spirits of Top Grade Divine Weapons was quite high, while Supreme Grade Divine Weapon spirits could fully manifest themselves.
Han Yongting aimed for Top Grade and Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons. Since he could not sense them, he had to rely on his own judgment and inner guidance to find his target, then persuade the Artifact Spirit of the Emperor Weapon.
After flying around Thousand Soldiers Alley for approximately an hour and a half, Han Yongting stopped again; he had found his target.
A purple-red long spear was in front of him, buried deep into the ground, looking quite ordinary.
“There should be no mistake.”
Han Yongting circled the purple-red long spear a few times, confirming his inner guidance was correct and that he was drawn to the long spear from a distance.
He tried to activate his Thunder War Body. The purple-red long spear trembled slightly, but it did not establish a resonance with him. Han Yongting’s eyebrows furrowed slightly, but he did not give up.

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - 240: Top Grade Imperial Arms! I’m Not Capable, But My Father Is! Returning to Han Mansion! How Strong is Han Li’s Power?_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 609: Chapter 240: Top Grade Imperial Arms! I’m Not Capable, But My Father Is! Returning to Han Mansion! How Strong is Han Li’s Power?_2
Han Yongting felt that this purple-red long spear must be a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapon, suitable for his martial path and physique, otherwise the spear would show no response at all, and he was already proficient in wielding long spears.
As for why he didn’t sense it, Han Yongting thought it must be because the Artifact Spirit of the long spear looked down upon him.
After all, his Thunder War Body was only a King Body; cultivators with King Bodies found it easy to attain sainthood and not difficult to become a Quasi Emperor, but ascending to the Heaven Imperial Realm was extremely challenging.
If this purple-red long spear were a Top Grade Emperor’s Weapon, it likely awaited a cultivator with an Emperor’s Body, one with a flourishing destiny, or someone whose martial path had a very high compatibility with the purple-red long spear to gain its favor.
If it were a Supreme Grade Emperor’s Weapon, then its standards would be even higher, and it would not easily acknowledge a cultivator; persuading the Artifact Spirit of a Supreme Grade Emperor’s Weapon would be very difficult.
However, this was not a problem for Han Yongting.
His Spiritual Sense surged forth, entering the purple-red long spear, speaking some words, and displaying some scenes; the purple-red long spear immediately began to tremble.
A smile appeared on Han Yongting’s face.
He might not be up to par, but his father was!
He was the progeny of the Eternal Great Emperor Han Li; although the Artifact Spirit of the spear was proud, he had still managed to persuade it.
At this moment, atop one of the main peaks of the Divine Weapons Mountain Range, within a splendid and magnificent great hall, two Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors were watching a scene being projected.
The scene displayed the entirety of Thousand Soldiers Alley, but the two Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors were focusing on a specific area, precisely where Han Yongting was located.
“Again?”
The Sword Emperor Liu Yunzhi’s expression darkened, and then he silently cursed a few times.
Truly shameless!
“Damn, and here I thought this guy was a Loose Cultivator, turns out he’s yet another bastard from the Han Mansion of Chengsheng Mountain,” Jiang Taijing of the Prison Guard Spear Emperor also looked full of resentment.
Over the years, the scions of Han Mansion from Chengsheng Mountain frequently came to their Thousand Soldiers Alley to snatch opportunities, much to the distress of the House of Divine Armies.
Moreover, the disciples of Han Mansion always liked to enter disguised as Loose Cultivators, with very clever ways of concealing their identities, which even the two Divine Yuan Realm Martial Emperors could not detect.
Those able to enter Thousand Soldiers Alley and gain approval from Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapons, and to extract them, were very few and far between; most of the identities of those from Han Mansion were discovered after the fact by the House of Divine Armies.
Although the foundation of the House of Divine Armies was wealthy, it could not withstand such losses and wished to secretly retrieve the Emperor’s Weapons.
The House of Divine Armies previously would not resort to such means, but in recent years, driven to despair, they resorted to this strategy, only to discover that these “Loose Cultivators” had complex backgrounds, all coming from Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
Once their identities were exposed, the disciples from Han Mansion stopped pretending, directly leaving with the Emperor’s Weapons while the powerhouses of the House of Divine Armies could only watch helplessly, daring not to intervene.
The great battle seven years ago shook Qianyuan Divine Province and astonished the Endless Yuankun Domain, firmly establishing the position of Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
Although the House of Divine Armies was a Sacred Land, they did not dare to provoke Han Mansion of Chengsheng Mountain. After all, the disciples from Han Mansion abided by the rules of the House of Divine Armies. If the House of Divine Armies dared to play dirty, the consequences would be dire; the Eternal Great Emperor was known for being protective.
Although Han Yongting had not yet extracted the spear, Liu Yunzhi and Jiang Taijing had already deduced his identity; only the rascals from Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain would act this way, and this was not their first experience with such behavior.
In the scene, Han Yongting’s right hand had already reached out to grab the body of the spear, attempting to pull it out.
The spear had only been extracted slightly when an overwhelming Emperor’s Might burst forth, instantly covering the entire Thousand Soldiers Alley and drawing the attention of all cultivators. Countless cultivators immediately hurried towards the location.
They all wanted to know which lucky individual had managed to gain the favor of the Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapon.
“What should we do?”
Jiang Taijing looked towards the Sword Emperor Liu Yunzhi, his expression filled with bewilderment.
Liu Yunzhi opened his mouth, about to speak when a figure descended into the great hall. It was the master of the House of Divine Armies, the Ancestral Master of Armies.
“Master.”
Jiang Taijing and Liu Yunzhi both turned their attention to the Ancestral Master of Armies, waiting for him to decide.
The Ancestral Master of Armies looked at the purple-red long spear being gradually pulled out by Han Yongting, his expression was extremely grim, but he made no move; in his heart, he cursed profusely.
“Master, are we really not going to stop it?” Jiang Taijing asked again.
“Master, the scions of Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain have already taken away sixteen Quasi Emperor’s Weapons and three Top Grade Emperor’s Weapons from our House of Divine Armies,” Liu Yunzhi chimed in, his eyes brimming with unwillingness, confusion, and resentment.
“If the Thunderstorm Spear, another Top Grade Emperor’s Weapon, is also taken away, that would make four Top Grade Emperor’s Weapons. No matter how big our House of Divine Armies is, we cannot sustain such losses…”
Through their secret investigations, they found that a significant number of Han Mansion’s disciples came to Thousand Soldiers Alley, but only nineteen had obtained Emperor’s Weapons, while the others received only Sacred Soldiers.
They had tolerated the Sacred Soldiers, but they could not tolerate the loss of the Emperor’s Weapons.
Although the House of Divine Armies excelled at refining treasures and did not suffer heavy losses during the ancient cataclysm, leaving most of the Emperor’s Weapons intact, they had less than fifty pieces altogether, including only nine Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapons.
Due to insufficient resources, the House of Divine Armies could not sustain so many Emperor’s Weapons. The frequently used Emperor’s Weapons comprised only two Supreme Grade Emperor’s Weapons and one Top Grade Emperor’s Weapon; the rest slumbered in Thousand Soldiers Alley.
The House of Divine Armies also used this as an attraction to lure cultivators from Qianyuan Divine Province, amassing countless Top Quality Spirit Stones every year and becoming very wealthy.
In the past 110,000 years, only one Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapon had been taken from Thousand Soldiers Alley, and only three Quasi Emperor’s Weapons had been taken, which was within the House of Divine Armies’s capacity to bear.
But with the continuous raids by Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, the number of Emperor’s Weapons in Thousand Soldiers Alley had drastically declined. If Han Yongting were to take the Thunderstorm Spear as well, then only one would remain in Thousand Soldiers Alley.

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - 240: Top Grade Imperial Arms! I’m Not Capable, But My Father Is! Returning to Han Mansion! How Strong is Han Li’s Power?_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 610: Chapter 240: Top Grade Imperial Arms! I’m Not Capable, But My Father Is! Returning to Han Mansion! How Strong is Han Li’s Power?_3
The three Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapons they kept for their own use would never be put into Thousand Soldiers Alley, especially after the ruffians from Han Mansion of Chengsheng Mountain made an appearance. They were worried someone would take them away.
“I wish I could do something about it, but what can your master do?” The House of Divine Armies’ master said with an ugly expression on his face.
In the presence of Han Li, this master of the House of Divine Armies was nothing.
After the Barbarian Lord visited Chengsheng Mountain, he too had made a pilgrimage there in recent years, but without achieving his purpose.
Over the years, as he watched Han Mansion’s offspring pluck away his Divine Weapons and Emperor’s Weapons one after another, his heart was filled with extreme annoyance. Countless times he thought of intervening, but could only watch helplessly as it happened.
Neither he nor the House of Divine Armies could withstand the wrath of Han Li— the House itself might be destroyed as a result.
Since that battle seven years ago, the great holy land schools of Qianyuan Divine Province had lost their cohesion, unable to stand together any longer. They had no choice but to observe the expressions of the Chengsheng Mountain and act accordingly, whether they liked it or not.
Who else but Chengsheng Mountain could claim to be the new overlord of Qianyuan Divine Province?
Glancing over at Liu Yunzhi and Jiang Taijing, the master pondered for a moment before saying, “I’ll give it a try.”
Perhaps this offspring of Han Mansion would be reasonable?
This was not his first attempt.
The figure of the master vanished from the great hall, but his heart was filled with regret. If only he had listened to Liu Yunzhi and Jiang Taijing, setting new rules after the second Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapon had been taken, keeping the people from Han Mansion off Chengsheng Mountain.
Although a Divine Yuan Realm martial emperor could not detect it, an Emperor’s Weapon indeed could uncover the hidden identity of Han Mansion offspring. Yet the master hesitated to agree, fearing it would offend Han Li.
In Thousand Soldiers Alley, Han Yongting had already pulled out most of the Thunderstorm Spear, his face alight with excitement and joy.
He, Han Yongting, was about to possess a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapon!
At that moment, Han Yongting sensed the arrival of the master of Divine Armies next to him. He frowned, but his hand did not cease its motion.
“Wait a moment—could we talk?”
The master hastily spoke, “As long as you don’t pull out the Thunderstorm Spear, my House of Divine Armies is willing to compensate you.”
“This purple-red long spear is called Thunderstorm? I like it!”
Han Yongting’s hand was on the shaft of the spear, just an inch from pulling it out completely. He turned to look at the master and said indifferently,
“Do you think I care about your compensation?”
He had recognized the master’s identity but didn’t give it any significance, knowing the master had also recognized who he was and wouldn’t dare to harm him.
The master’s face turned ashen. Han Yongting, being in the True Martial Realm and a recent ascendant, dared to speak to him in such a manner. Did he really think the master, a Tongxuan Realm powerhouse, was a pushover?
Therefore, in a pleading tone, the master said, “Don’t rush to refuse, friend. I am willing to compensate you with a Supreme Grade Emperor’s Scripture, plus…”
“No need.” Han Yongting cut off the master’s words.
What did it matter if the House of Divine Armies offered him a Supreme Grade Emperor’s Scripture?
In his opinion, it was not as valuable as the Thunderstorm Spear. Chengsheng Mountain was not lacking Supreme Grade Emperor’s Scriptures, which Han Yongting himself had the qualifications to learn, but he lacked a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapon.
Unless the House of Divine Armies was willing to teach him the Immortal Scripture, Han Yongting would, of course, agree.
The value of a Top Grade Emperor’s Weapon was still less than the Immortal Scripture. If he could bring back an Immortal Scripture, his father would surely reward him handsomely, not only with a vast amount of Contribution Value but also a bestowed Top Grade Emperor’s Weapon.
Han Yongting didn’t know exactly how many Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapons there were in Chengsheng Mountain, only that there were many—a number that, even without plucking from the House of the Divine Armies, still exceeded all the combined Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor’s Weapons of the divine province’s sacred land schools.
The master was about to speak when Han Yongting suggested exchanging for the Immortal Scripture, and he fell silent.
The Thunderstorm Spear was important, but it paled in comparison to the Immortal Scripture. The Immortal Scripture, the strongest cultivation technique of the House of Divine Armies, absolutely could not be leaked.
Han Yongting scoffed and pulled out the Thunderstorm Spear completely.
In an instant, a vast Emperor’s Might echoed throughout Thousand Soldiers Alley, forcing all cultivators to lower their heads and avert their eyes, daring not to look directly.
A thunderous roar, as if coming from the depths of time and space, resounded through Thousand Soldiers Alley, suppressing the Divine Spirits and Primordial Spirits of all cultivators.
The Thunderstorm Spear left Han Yongting’s hand, hovering in midair. Strand after strand of Emperor’s Light emerged, with all the hidden lightning patterns on the spear becoming visible, enveloped by the dao.
“Good, good, good!”
Looking at the Top Grade Emperor’s Weapon Thunderstorm Spear before him, Han Yongting repeated the word ‘good’ three times, his joy apparent.
As the master watched this scene, he felt as though he was mourning the death of his mother, deeply pained. He let out a sigh as his figure vanished from sight, out of sight, out of mind.
He had decided then and there to immediately change the rules of Thousand Soldiers Alley. He could no longer allow people from Han Mansion to enter, regardless of whether it would offend Han Li.
If it came to it, he would just send Han Li a high-quality, beautiful female cultivator as compensation. Surely, Han Li wouldn’t blame him then.
This scene was witnessed by countless cultivators, all of whom were astonished and filled with shocked admiration, but none dared to harbor ill thoughts.
They had all seen that man ignore the dignity of the master of Divine Armies. The master himself was powerless to act against him.
Any thoughtful person could guess that the man was definitely from Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, likely an outstanding descendant of the Longevity Great Emperor—otherwise, he would not dare to be so bold.
Despite feelings of envy and resentment, all cultivators understood that Chengsheng Mountain was an entity they could not afford to offend.
Chengsheng Mountain was the heaven of Qianyuan Divine Province!
Han Yongting paid no attention to the surrounding cultivators. He reached out once more and grabbed the Thunderstorm Spear as a voice echoed in his mind.
Han Yongting’s Divine Spirit replied, “Rest assured, I won’t deceive you.”
In the next moment, all the phenomena of the Thunderstorm Spear disappeared, and the spear itself surged into Han Yongting’s sea of consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - 240: Top Grade Imperial Arms! I’m Not Capable, But My Father Is! Returning to Han Mansion! How Strong is Han Li’s Power?_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 611: Chapter 240: Top Grade Imperial Arms! I’m Not Capable, But My Father Is! Returning to Han Mansion! How Strong is Han Li’s Power?_4
Han Yongting burst into loud laughter once again, glanced at two directions where those two mid-grade Emperor Weapons were, and then left Thousand Soldiers Alley.
After leaving Thousand Soldiers Alley and exiting the House of Divine Armies, Han Yongting once again switched his identity, then hurriedly flew toward Chengsheng Mountain.
Along the way, he didn’t encounter any danger; the Artifact Spirit of the Thunderstorm Spear was constantly scouting, and no one came after him to kill him.
After spending some time, Han Yongting successfully returned to Chengsheng Mountain.
Standing at the foot of Chengsheng Mountain, Han Yongting paused for a moment, and then began to ascend the mountain.
He was still dressed in a blue-green robe, with golden-threaded jade boots on his feet, and a bright, sunny smile always on his face.
If there was any difference, it was that Han Yongting had a purple-red long spear on his back—the Thunderstorm Spear.
Han Yongting didn’t intend to hide it; owning a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapon by his own ability was a matter of great pride, not just for showing off to his brothers and sisters, but also so his mother, Yun Miaoyi, could hold her head high among the other wives.
Besides, such news couldn’t be hidden anyway, and Chengsheng Mountain must have known long before that he had obtained the top-grade Emperor Weapon, Thunderstorm Spear, from the House of Divine Armies.
Indeed, as soon as Han Yongting stepped into the Mountain Protection Array, several figures rushed towards him, all closely related brothers and sisters, one of whom was also born to Yun Miaoyi.
“Yongting, I heard you got a top-grade Emperor Weapon from the House of Divine Armies. Take it out and show it to your brother.”
“Brother Ting, congratulations.”
“Big Brother Ting, is that the Thunderstorm Spear on your back?”
“Sixth Brother, mother heard as well and wants you to visit Chengdao Peak after you get back.”
Seven or eight brothers and sisters chattered away, but Han Yongting responded with a smile, showing no sign of impatience.
Han Yongting enjoyed the admiring glances of his siblings and patiently answered their questions before continuing up the mountain with them.
Along the way, when Han Yongting saw other brothers and sisters he wasn’t on good terms with, he still took the initiative to greet them; it was always the same few words exchanged back and forth.
“How did you know I obtained the top-grade Emperor Weapon, Thunderstorm Spear?”
“Brother Yun, you’re not mistaken; this purple-red long spear is indeed a top-grade Emperor Weapon.”
“Sister Li, I got a top-grade Emperor Weapon from Thousand Soldiers Alley. Do you want to take a closer look for your little brother?”
After taking the Thunderstorm Spear around Chengsheng Mountain several times, Han Yongting, still not quite satisfied, headed towards Chengdao Peak.
Upon entering Chengdao Peak and arriving in the main hall of the first area, Han Yongting found his mother Yun Miaoyi already waiting there and quickly jogged over.
Casually placing the Thunderstorm Spear on the ground, Han Yongting hurried to massage and knead Yun Miaoyi’s shoulders, serving her with all sorts of sweet words.
Yun Miaoyi was disarmed by Han Yongting’s whole act, pointed at his forehead, sighed, and said, “No more of this next time, okay?”
“Of course, mother, I promise there won’t be a next time,” Han Yongting said with a smile.
The mother appeared to be scolding him, but her face was filled with laughter, clearly happy for him.
Han Yongting moved in front of Yun Miaoyi to massage her legs, while she placed her right hand on his head caressing gently and said softly:
“You should get along well with Yongli and Yongyun; they are your brothers and sisters, too. Any conflicts should be resolved in time.”
“Yes, mother, I will go and apologize to my brothers and sisters right away,” Han Yongting agreed without any objection.
The mother didn’t want him to be at odds with his siblings as it would affect the father’s view of him. Even though she was a favored wife, the other concubines were no pushovers, plus rumors could easily cause trouble.
Once he got the Thunderstorm Spear, Han Yongting’s grudge against the other siblings dissipated. Now that he had a top-grade Emperor Weapon, he didn’t bother about petty squabbles anymore, knowing they couldn’t compete with him.
After putting on a show of goodwill, Han Yongting planned to proactively reconcile with Han Yongli, Han Yongyun, and the others. His father always preferred his descendants to have a broad mind.
Half an hour after chatting with Yun Miaoyi, Han Li arrived, taking his time to give mother and son some time to catch up.
“Your son greets you, father.”
When Han Li appeared, Han Yongting immediately became serious and greeted his father with a respectful bow.
Over the years, Han Li’s authority had grown even more profound, and even Han Yongting and the other key descendants didn’t dare to be the slightest bit careless in front of him.
Han Li had become accustomed to this; it was quite satisfactory.
Han Li nodded slightly and said, “I know everything.”
Seeing that his father didn’t say much more, Han Yongting breathed a sigh of relief, then picked up the Thunderstorm Spear and presented it respectfully with both hands.
“Father, please look, this is the Thunderstorm Spear.”
Han Yongting wasn’t the least bit worried that his father would covet his top-grade Emperor Weapon; it was beneath his father’s notice.
Watching Han Yongting offer his cherished Thunderstorm Spear, Han Li did not refuse. He casually picked up the spear to look at it, then carelessly stuck it into the ground.
“From now on, you will follow Yongting,” Han Li said indifferently.
A figure stepped out from within the Thunderstorm Spear, resembling a middle-aged man, his face still showing shock as he respectfully said, “Your command will be obeyed.”
With just a few casual touches, Han Li had revealed a bit of his strength, filling the Artifact Spirit of the Thunderstorm Spear with fear, suspecting he could break its body with his bare hands.
The Artifact Spirit was naturally aware of the reputation of the Great Emperor Han Li but had not expected him to be this powerful.
Han Li looked at Han Yongting and bestowed many rewards upon him; his recent training could be considered as having been exceptionally successful.
“Thank you, father,” Han Yongting said, excited.
PS: This part is completed; tomorrow we will return to the main storyline and explain some aspects that need to be clarified.

chapters.title: Chapter 612 - 241: Three Major Events! The First, True Immortal Armaments! Attack on the Five Great Supreme Powers! The Arrival of the Two Great Empresses!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 612: Chapter 241: Three Major Events! The First, True Immortal Armaments! Attack on the Five Great Supreme Powers! The Arrival of the Two Great Empresses!_1
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li stood with his hands clasped behind his back, his splendid green robe fluttering as he gazed at the prosperity of Han Mansion, overcome with a multitude of emotions.
“In the blink of an eye, thirty years have passed,” Han Li murmured to himself softly.
Ever since he decided to further keep a low profile and nurture his growth, causing Chengsheng Mountain to rise higher day by day, thirty years had elapsed.
In these thirty years, many events had transpired, but only three truly mattered to Han Li.
The first event happened twenty-one years ago.
