Before that, within a mere year, Han Li had intercepted the stunning Saintesses Zi Miao Zhen and Ji Mingyue, along with the Purple-dressed Empress Yuan Youwei, and captured them back to Chengsheng Mountain. The three women subsequently bore him offspring one after another.
Standing behind Zi Miao Zhen, Ji Mingyue, and Yuan Youwei were the three immense powers of White Emperor City, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and Yuanchu Mountain. Naturally, abducting them came with its troubles.
Han Li wasn’t concerned; compared to the benefits he gained from the three women, taking on some trouble was worth it. Besides, the three had come for him, and if not dealt with promptly, that would have led to even greater issues.
At the time, Han Li handled Zi Miao Zhen, Ji Mingyue, and Yuan Youwei, as well as the Imperial Weapons they brought to Qianyuan Divine Province: the Bihai Bowl, the Cold Snow Knife, and the Sky Pavilion.
With various moves made by Han Li, Yuanchu Mountain, White Emperor City, and Huangyue Imperial Empire did not immediately realize the disappearance of Zi Miao Zhen, Ji Mingyue, and Yuan Youwei.
It wasn’t until nine years later, twenty-one years ago, that the matter finally came to light.
The Qianyuan Divine Province region, despite its vastness covering thirty-seven divine provinces, should have yielded results after the explorations of two Saintesses and one Quasi Emperor over twelve years.
Yet, without any good news from the three women or their return to Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, or White Emperor City, suspicions arose in Empress Yuanchu, the Huangyue Empress, and the Emperor of White Emperor City.
The three supreme powers of the Yuankun Domain began to react, showing a trend of joining forces to force their way into Qianyuan Divine Province to find the culprit, sending shockwaves through the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Soon after the exposure of the events, Han Li learned of this news from the Artifact Spirits of the three Heaven Imperial Realm Imperial Weapons and immediately took action.
Han Li first changed his identity to gather intelligence outside of Qianyuan Divine Province and, after obtaining accurate reports, began to set countermeasures in place.
The three great powers each dispatched a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor with Heavenly Immortal weapons to Qianyuan Divine Province. Their forces were significant, and they made no effort to hide their tracks, in order to pressure the Great Holy Land Schools in Qianyuan Divine Province not to meddle.
If the three Emperors arrived at Qianyuan Divine Province, even Bai Yujing would not be able to withstand the pressure and would have to yield in the face of such a lavish array. After all, Bai Yujing’s True Immortal weapon, the Adverse Dao Banner, could not be easily wielded, and the three Emperors represented the three strongest powers of the Yuankun Domain, each with True Immortal weapons at their command.
In such a situation, Han Li made his move.
He decided to “circle around Wei to rescue Zhao.”
After keeping a low profile for nine years, Han Li had broken through from the first layer of the Tongxuan Realm to the Saint Abyss Realm. When he opened the Heavenly Abyss, he also shattered the limits of Top Grade Sacred artifacts, venturing into the unknown.
Han Li obtained from the treasure box an Immortal Treasure known as the Promotion Card, which came in three grades: Heaven Immortal Rank, True Immortal Rank, and Golden Immortal Rank. The one Han Li obtained was of the True Immortal Rank.
Promotion Card: Using a Promotion Card of the corresponding grade can evolve Supreme Grade Imperial Weapons and above into Immortal Weapons of the respective grade.
Promotion Cards cannot be used on Top Grade Imperial Weapons; Supreme Grade Imperial Weapons are the minimum requirement. The laws within Supreme Grade Imperial Weapons are already nearly perfect, only a step away from becoming Immortal Weapons.
At the time, Chengsheng Mountain had more than ten Supreme Grade Imperial Weapons, including the likes of the Void Bell, Time-Sky Tower, Emperor Flag, Life-Prolonging Furnace, Dao Decapitating Sword, and so on.
After much consideration, Han Li decided to use the Heaven Immortal Rank Promotion Card on the Emperor Flag. Actually, he had wanted to use it on the Humanity Sword. If the Humanity Sword evolved into a True Immortal weapon, it might have had the combat ability of a Golden Immortal, but unfortunately, it failed.
The Emperor Flag contained nine kinds of laws: metal, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, thunder, light, and darkness, pushing it to the limits of what a Supreme Grade Imperial Weapon could achieve, making the Emperor Flag exceedingly powerful, not in the least inferior to the Void Bell or the Time-Sky Tower.
The Emperor Flag also possessed multiple functionalities such as slaughter, defense, speed, and concealing heavens’ secrets, each capability reaching the peak of what an Imperial Weapon could offer, making it an ideal candidate for the use of the Promotion Card.
After the Emperor Flag was evolved with the Promotion Card, it successfully transformed into a True Immortal weapon. The nine types of laws it contained were elevated to nine True Immortal level Great Dao, with its power reaching the utmost limit of True Immortal weapons, truly demonstrating its supreme grace of “commanding all the paths under the heavens.”
The Emperor Flag became Han Li’s first True Immortal weapon and was the most powerful among all his weapons. While the Humanity Sword was comparable to True Immortal weapons, it was ultimately just a Heavenly Immortal weapon.
Having made his decision, Han Li then caused a stir in the Endless Yuankun Domain, wielding the Emperor Flag and launching swift raids on the Heavenly Cult and the Western Sky Palace.
Beyond that, Han Li also launched attacks on White Emperor City, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and Yuanchu Mountain, the three strongest powers, to confuse and mislead, keeping his true intentions obscured from the world.
Han Li’s targets were the pocket paradises of the strongest forces. He aimed to seize the opportunity to plunder treasures to enrich Chengsheng Mountain’s foundation, thus compelling each of the great powers to pay more attention.
The first he attacked was the Western Sky Palace, followed by the Heavenly Cult, both with success.
From the Western Sky Palace, Han Li snatched a Heavenly Immortal Elixir and from the Heavenly Cult he seized thirty thousand Immortal Stones, reaping immense benefits. This left the lords of the Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult fuming mad, wielding True Immortal weapons to hunt down Han Li’s whereabouts, determined to kill him.
Since the Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult no longer had True Immortal weapons for protection, Han Li dared not attack them again. He had achieved his goal, and with precautions in place, attacking these two powers again would bring the other great forces rushing in instantly, trying to subdue him.

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - 241: Three Major Events! The First, True Immortal Armaments! Attack on the Five Great Supreme Powers! The Arrival of the Two Great Empresses!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 613: Chapter 241: Three Major Events! The First, True Immortal Armaments! Attack on the Five Great Supreme Powers! The Arrival of the Two Great Empresses!_2
Who would have thought that Han Li would be so bold as to strike out at two of the strongest forces one after another, seriously crossing the line for all of the top factions.
Han Li knew very well that his initial success was because he had caught the two most powerful forces off guard, making it much harder for him to take action thereafter.
The third attack was on White Emperor City. Han Li first made a feint at Western Sky Palace and then immediately headed to White Emperor City.
During the attack on White Emperor City, Han Li also allowed the Emperor Flag to injure the White Emperor, who had been coveting his wife the Empress. Although White Emperor City also had a True Immortal weapon, it was somewhat inferior to the Emperor Flag.
With formidable strength and the protection of the True Immortal weapon, in addition to the timely arrival of the head of Western Sky Palace and the Butian Sect Master, the White Emperor was not seriously hurt, but he was extremely agitated, seeing this as an unprovoked disaster.
However, recalling what had happened to Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult, the White Emperor could not help but feel pleased. It was all about perspective; he had only suffered minor injuries, whereas the leaders of Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult had suffered great losses.
Facing three True Immortal weapons and three supreme beings, Han Li had no intention of continuing to fight and directly retreated from White Emperor City.
After that, Han Li did not seriously strike at Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain, only visiting to see the two future Empresses, whom he had been looking forward to meeting for a long time.
Indeed, he was not disappointed, as a split soul could never compare to the original.
For the first time, Han Li met the Empresses of Huangyue and Yuanchu. Upon laying eyes on the two peerless Empresses, Han Li regarded Empress Yuanchu and the Empress of Huangyue as “one of his own” and did not harm them.
He initially planned to make a pretense of attacking their blessed lands, but sensing that the White Emperor, the head of Western Sky Palace, and the Butian Sect Master were about to arrive, along with other supreme beings from Yuankun Domain, he fled without hesitation.
With the Emperor Flag in hand, all the most powerful forces had no way to deal with him. They could not defeat him in single combat, nor catch him in a joint pursuit; even after the Emperor Tianji used his means to obscure the truth, they still could not deduce his whereabouts.
To completely stir up the situation, Han Li also visited several Heavenly Governing Forces. Although he did not attack, he brought significant pressure to all forces.
Five of the strongest forces were attacked in a short period of time, a major event that shook the entire Endless Yuankun Domain and garnered widespread attention. It should be noted that there are only nine top forces in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Within no time, the Endless Yuankun Domain was shaken by a storm brewing on the horizon, with every Heavenly Governing Force and top faction on high alert, worried about being targeted by a mysterious assailant.
The situation in the Yuankun Domain became chaotic and tense, with the nine most powerful forces and the thirty-three Heavenly Governing Forces recalling their high-level combatants to avoid any accidents.
Under such circumstances, the rulers of Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and White Emperor City, all from the Heaven Imperial Realm, returned to their respective forces. Even though they were close to reaching Qianyuan Divine Province, they dared not continue their journey.
On one hand, they needed to return to protect their domains, and on the other, they feared being attacked by the mysterious assailant. After targeting the strongest forces, this mysterious being seemed to be choosing ordinary Heavenly Governing Forces as potential targets for attack.
The crisis at Chengsheng Mountain was thus directly lifted.
When Han Li quietly returned to Qianyuan Divine Province, the Endless Yuankun Domain was swirling with undercurrents. All forces and countless Cultivators were buzzing with speculation about who this sudden and mysterious powerhouse was and what his ultimate aim might be.
The power landscape of the Endless Yuankun Domain had remained stable for a hundred thousand years, with no new top forces emerging, and existing top forces rarely engaging in severe battles or conflicts. Although there were frictions, a certain level of intensity was maintained.
Yet today, the situation had changed.
A mysterious power had suddenly risen, audaciously attacking five of the major forces. This enigmatic being also possessed an immensely powerful Immortal Artifact, potentially the first in the Yuankun Domain, leaving the other top forces helpless.
While the Supreme Territories, the Great Supreme Sects, the Eternal Clans, and the Imperial Empires all took precautions, the search for Han Li never ceased; they were determined to discover his origins and whereabouts.
The threat posed by Han Li was too great!
If he were to act recklessly, no one could guard against him. After all, there are days when one can be a thief, but can one be on guard against a thief every day?
Lurking in the shadows, Han Li was like a venomous snake that could strike at any moment and execute a surprise assassination—extremely dangerous.
If Han Li’s whereabouts were exposed, they could feel a bit more at ease with the strongest forces watching over him. And if his identity was also discovered, causing him some concerns, then they would be even more relieved.
Compared to the unaffiliated Loose Cultivators, those powerful beings with ties to a faction were more easily accepted. As long as there were concerns, they would not dare to act rashly and could be dealt with gradually.
But no one could find any trace of Han Li, as if he had vanished into thin air. This became a dark cloud over the heads of the nine most powerful forces and various Heavenly Governing Forces, who were constantly worried about being under attack.
In such a situation, even though Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu were concerned about their split souls and their respective Sacred Ladies, they opted not to send anyone to investigate Qianyuan Divine Province until they dealt with the influence of the mysterious powerhouse.
Even though the mysterious being had not acted against them, both peerless Empresses had an ominous feeling. If they did not deal with the issue promptly, great calamities might lie ahead.
The White Emperor of White Emperor City also restrained from sending people, allowing Yuan Youwei to be temporarily compromised. There was still a connection with White Emperor City, and her life signal was intact, indicating she was not in grave danger.
The urgent matter at hand was to resolve the trouble caused by the mysterious figure.
After Han Li returned to Chengsheng Mountain, he continued to remain low-key, shielded by the Emperor Flag that obscured the heavens and the Human Path Sword that severed fate. Not even Emperor Tianji with his True Immortal weapon could find him.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - 241: Three Major Events! The First, True Immortal Armaments! Attack on the Five Great Supreme Powers! The Arrival of the Two Great Empresses!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 614: Chapter 241: Three Major Events! The First, True Immortal Armaments! Attack on the Five Great Supreme Powers! The Arrival of the Two Great Empresses!_3
Han Li felt that this operation was a huge success.
Not only did he fall in love at first sight with the two future Empress wives, but he also injured Bai Yujing, his rival in love. While disrupting the situation, he relieved the crisis at Chengsheng Mountain and managed to seize a Heavenly Immortal Elixir from Western Sky Palace, as well as thirty thousand Immortal Stones from the Heavenly Cult.
It was indeed killing several birds with one stone!
This time, the Emperor Flag was fully revived for combat, and Han Li expended a hundred thousand strands of Immortal Qi. Naturally, this wasn’t accumulated in the Secret Territory; it came from treasure chests he had opened. Among four treasure chests, he had found Immortal Qi, totaling one hundred and ten thousand strands.
The Heavenly Immortal Elixir was called Galaxy Flower, and each mature Galaxy Flower would result in the desolation of an entire Star Domain, with all of its energy absorbed by the Galaxy Flower.
One Galaxy Flower was roughly equivalent to fifty thousand Immortal Stones, more valuable than the one hundred thousand strands of Immortal Qi, which were only equivalent to twenty thousand Immortal Stones.
Not to mention that Han Li had also plundered thirty thousand Immortal Stones from the Heavenly Cult, which was equivalent to gaining sixty thousand Immortal Stones—it was an outrageous profit.
Han Li even considered continuing to plunder the most formidable forces, as the money came too easily.
The nine most powerful forces had risen rapidly after the Great Calamity of the Ancient Era, having divided and inherited the legacies of many glorious and prosperous forces from the Ancient Age, rich enough to exude Immortal Qi.
Of course, that was just a thought. Han Li certainly wasn’t looking for trouble without a reason. The main goal this time was to resolve the crisis, and plundering the most powerful forces was just an incidental benefit.
After resolving the crisis, Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain continued to lay low and hibernate.
Fourteen years later, which was seven years ago from now, the second major event occurred.
Han Li’s fourth child with the Demon Emperor Xue Yueqing, Han Yongchen, broke through to the True Martial Realm. He set out on a journey to gain experience, and by the time he arrived in the Barbarian Region, he had already cultivated to the fourth level of the True Martial Realm.
Han Yongchen also possessed a king’s body and had exceptional combat ability. He defeated all the True Martial Realm cultivators at the pinnacle of stars, which invited the pursuit of the Divine Yuan Realm Barbarian Emperor. Han Yongchen counter-killed him, sparking the subsequent Wars of the Barbarian Region.
This battle established Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain’s reputation, resonating throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Chengsheng Mountain not only became the number one Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province but was also listed by Tianji Pavilion as the tenth greatest force in the Endless Yuankun Domain, just behind the nine most formidable forces.
Chengsheng Mountain possessed True Immortal weapons and even surpassed Bai Yujing in its rise to power, which was greatly revered. Although some other forces of the Heaven Imperial Realm were somewhat dissatisfied, they dared not trouble Chengsheng Mountain.
Since then, there has been much discussion within the Endless Yuankun Domain about when Chengsheng Mountain would become a new formidable force.
To become a formidable force, in addition to having a True Immortal weapon to suppress fortune, the leader of the force had to be a supreme being of the Heaven Imperial Realm’s peak. This was commonly acknowledged.
The rise of Chengsheng Mountain naturally caused shockwaves across the Endless Yuankun Domain, perplexing many great forces.
In just fifteen short years, two True Immortal weapons had surfaced, one from a mysterious Loose Cultivator and the other from Chengsheng Mountain.
If the two True Immortal weapons weren’t different, all the great forces would have speculated that the mysterious powerful figure who made waves in the Yuankun Domain was Han Li.
However, no one believed this; no one thought that Han Li could possess two True Immortal weapons, which was almost impossible. Having one True Immortal weapon was already a great fortune and a massive opportunity.
Even today’s nine most formidable forces only have one True Immortal weapon each. Even in the Ancient Era, the Prehistoric Ages, or even further back, very few forces wielded two True Immortal weapons, and all of those force leaders were supreme True Immortals.
How could Han Li have the luck and merit to be recognized by two True Immortal weapons?
Especially since the power of that flag was formidable, ranked by Tianji Pavilion as the first True Immortal weapon of the Yuankun Domain.
After becoming famous, Chengsheng Mountain and Han Li drew countless attentions, including those from the nine most formidable forces like White Emperor City, Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, Western Sky Palace, and the Heavenly Cult.
Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult wanted to divide and conquer Chengsheng Mountain, which was an up-and-coming Supreme Territory, to compensate for their tremendous losses from a decade ago.
In their view, Chengsheng Mountain’s rise was too rapid, its heritage still far short of Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult. However, possessing a great stroke of luck, if they succeeded, they could make up for their losses.
But the two formidable forces of Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult did not make a move, still observing slowly, planning to wait a little longer before deciding on a joint operation.
Over a decade ago, the three Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors of Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and White Emperor City, each bearing an Immortal weapon, headed towards Qianyuan Divine Province. Although they did not reach their destination, the commotion they caused was immense.
Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult did some slight probing and quickly understood the causes and consequences. Combining the rise of Chengsheng Mountain, they instantly surmised that Chengsheng Mountain was the force that had offended the three most formidable forces.
Since Chengsheng Mountain had a True Immortal weapon to suppress its fortune, it dared to act against the soul fragments of Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, and dared to target the female saints and Quasi Emperors of the three formidable forces.
Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult did not wish to be at the forefront, perfectly content to let Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and White Emperor City take the vanguard, to gauge the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain.
As Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult expected, Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, and White Emperor City also suspected the same, believing Han Li of Chengsheng Mountain to be that daring and audacious Cultivator.
Only Han Li had the strength, and only Chengsheng Mountain had the foundation, to dare lay hands on their soul fragments. Not only did he destroy the soul fragment’s bodies, but he also caused them to have children in succession.
Zi Miaozhen, Ji Mingyue, and Yuan Youwei’s disappearances were likely also a result of Han Li of Chengsheng Mountain’s vile actions, possibly kidnapped by him.
Combining the intelligence they had gathered, Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Li was deemed a flirtatious debauchee, who in the past often engaged in abducting beautiful female Cultivators. Moreover, he frequently married and took concubines, many of whom were likely abducted.

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - 241: Three Major Events! The First, True Immortal Armaments! Attack on the Five Great Supreme Powers! The Arrival of the Two Great Empresses!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 615: Chapter 241: Three Major Events! The First, True Immortal Armaments! Attack on the Five Great Supreme Powers! The Arrival of the Two Great Empresses!_4
Based on the timing of when Zi Miao Zhen, Ji Mingyue, and Yuan Youwei disappeared, and when Han Li married his unidentified partner, the timelines seem to roughly match up.
Although they learned who the main culprit behind the disgrace of the women was, Huangyue Empress and Empress Yuanchu did not hastily set out for Qianyuan Divine Province.
They still had some arrangements to make to ensure that their other split souls wouldn’t cause trouble and to prevent that mysterious powerhouse from launching another attack, potentially leading to greater losses.
Only after all these preparations were in place could they set off for Qianyuan Divine Province with peace of mind and settle accounts with Han Li.
So what if Han Li has True Immortal weapons?
They have them too!
Their power even surpasses Han Li’s!
While the Huangyue Empress and Empress Yuanchu did not act, the White Emperor of White Emperor City also did not make a move, though he was somewhat worried about Yuan Youwei; he did not act rashly.
Yuan Youwei was probably long deflowered by Han Li, but after so many years, there was no urgency at this moment.
If he were to go alone, he would merely be paving the way for the empresses.
Although the White Emperor was pursuing Huangyue Empress, he had no plans of challenging Han Li head-on alone, as the loss would not be worth it.
Everyone had True Immortal weapons, and in a fight, what mattered was the strength of the True Immortal weapons. He might not be able to do anything to Han Li, and trying could just diminish his own resources, inadvertently building up Han Li’s reputation.
Thus, the White Emperor patiently waited, planning to assist when Huangyue Empress and Empress Yuanchu made their move.
Once the three supreme beings arrived with their True Immortal weapons, even the brazen and powerful Han Li of Chengsheng Mountain wouldn’t be able to withstand them.
With the Empress Yuanchu, Huangyue Empress, and White Emperor holding back, Western Sky Palace and Heavenly Cult similarly bided their time, waiting for an opportunity to act like opportunists, to be the mantis stalking the cicada.
Tianji Pavilion, the Longevity Qin Family, the Longevity Jiang Family, and the Solar Imperial Empire, these four formidable forces, were all watching. They were well aware of the grudges between the newly risen Chengsheng Mountain and White Emperor City, Yuanchu Mountain, and Huangyue Imperial Empire.
Within the Endless Yuankun Domain, across the Eight Hundred Divine Regions, the thirty-three Heavenly Governing Forces, as well as various Quasi Emperor and Saint Abyss Realm Powers, were all watching to see if Chengsheng Mountain could survive this ordeal.
In Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li was well aware of the reactions of the various powerful forces and other entities.
He feared nothing!
He was fearless in the face of everything!
Fourteen years ago, the power he possessed just barely surpassed any of the formidable forces.
In the fourteen years since, Han Li’s cultivation had improved further. He had stepped into the Quasi Emperor realm and had begun to grasp the rudiments of the ultimate martial dao, his combat ability rivaling that of a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
Otherwise, he couldn’t have clashed barehanded against a Heaven Imperial Realm Imperial weapon, and his physical body had grown incredibly powerful, comparable to a mid-stage Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
Beyond his own power, Han Li had acquired two more True Immortal weapons, several Heavenly Immortal weapons, and many Heaven Imperial Realm Imperial weapons, as well as numerous Immortal Stones, Immortal Qi, Immortal Elixirs, etc.
It can be said that Chengsheng Mountain’s strength alone was sufficient to robustly withstand a joint assault by several formidable forces without defeat.
He had three True Immortal weapons, one human path sword that could rival True Immortal weapons, six Heavenly Immortal weapons, and numerous Heaven Imperial Realm Imperial weapons. It can be said that Chengsheng Mountain was rightfully the number one Sacred Land in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Even if Yuanchu Mountain, White Emperor City, and Huangyue Imperial Empire joined forces against him, Han Li would not fear in the slightest and would still remain calm and composed.
Of course, Han Li still preferred to keep a low profile. He currently didn’t have the strength to suppress the entire Endless Yuankun Domain, he wasn’t invincible yet, so he needed to remain cautious.
Therefore, Han Li did not intend to reveal most of his strength, deciding that showing just enough foundation to repel the three supreme beings would suffice.
Two years later, the third grand event unfolded.
Huangyue Empress and Empress Yuanchu made their arrangements and descended upon Qianyuan Divine Province with the imposing pressure of their True Immortal weapons; White Emperor also arrived wielding his True Immortal weapon.
The arrival of the three supreme beings outside Qianyuan Divine Province, along with their three True Immortal weapons hanging high, immediately caused a stir throughout the entire Endless Yuankun Domain.
Under the pressure of the Huangyue Empress, Empress Yuanchu, and White Emperor, the Daoist Lord of Bai Yujing did not come forward to help; the Daoist Lord would at best not kick them while they were down but certainly wouldn’t expend a great cost to assist Chengsheng Mountain and Han Li.
After all, there were still grudges between them, as Chengsheng Mountain had ascended to become the premier Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province by stepping over Bai Yujing.
Han Li didn’t need Bai Yujing’s assistance either. Merely relying on Chengsheng Mountain was enough to easily cope with the Huangyue Empress, Empress Yuanchu, and White Emperor—the three top forces of the Yuankun Domain.
Empress Yuanchu, clad in silver war armor and wielding a silver long spear, was stunningly beautiful and had a voluptuous figure with undulating curves, a vision of unmatched splendor.
Huangyue Empress, dressed in golden war armor and holding a golden long spear, was radiantly gorgeous with a willowy and elongated form, her silhouette etched with surging waves and graceful lines, peerless in all the land.
The two empresses were the most dazzling female cultivators in the Endless Yuankun Domain, and now together, they were here for one man.
On the other side of the Nine Heavens, the White Emperor was in pure white attire, with a solemn expression, and a knife sheath at his waist containing a long knife.
“Longevity Great Emperor Han Li, you have quite the nerve to desecrate my split soul,” declared Empress Yuanchu with a voice of regal coldness, accompanied by a supremely domineering Emperor’s Might.
Empress Yuanchu was communicating using her Primordial Spirit; she did not wish for the matter to be completely exposed, to avoid damaging her reputation.
Huangyue Empress shared the sentiment; her expression was icy as she said indifferently, “Han Li, come out!”

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - 242: Domineering Empress! Murdering Her Own Husband? You Should Be the Supreme of the Path of Survival! The Sword of Humanity VS Wuxian Palace!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 616: Chapter 242: Domineering Empress! Murdering Her Own Husband? You Should Be the Supreme of the Path of Survival! The Sword of Humanity VS Wuxian Palace!_1
“`
Three supreme beings from the Yuankun Domain had arrived in the Qianyuan Divine Province, instantly igniting the entire Endless Yuankun Domain as countless Divine Senses probed this place, watching from afar.
Aside from the major incident that shook the Endless Yuankun Domain over a decade ago, the Yuankun Domain had not been this lively in a long time.
Amidst the surging undercurrents, each power within the Yuankun Domain was on guard, wary of disaster, after all, that mysterious strong figure had gained too much prominence, daring to attack even the five most powerful forces, let alone these Heavenly Governing Forces and Quasi Emperor powers.
Chengsheng Mountain, which had risen prominently two years ago, was particularly famous throughout the Yuankun Domain, but the well-informed major powers were aware Chengsheng Mountain had offended the three strongest forces—White Emperor City, Yuanchu Mountain, and the Huangyue Imperial Empire—and a battle between them was inevitable.
Now, that battle had finally arrived.
Even the Tianji Pavilion, the Solar Empire, the Longevity Qin Family, the Longevity Jiang Family, and other formidable forces were curious whether Chengsheng Mountain and the Great Emperor Han Li could survive this ordeal.
Chengsheng Mountain was known as a quasi-dominant force, possessing one of the symbols of a dominant force, the “True Immortal Weapon”. Once it acquired another symbol, “Supreme Grade”, it could remove the quasi from its title.
Since Chengsheng Mountain had previously kept a low profile, all the forces did not know whether its foundations were deep enough, a factor crucial to whether it could stand at the pinnacle of the Yuankun Domain.
The key here was Immortal-level energy, such as Immortal Qi and Immortal Stones.
The Mana of a Heavenly Immortal-grade emperor could support the operation of a Heavenly Immortal weapon, but it was far from satisfying the needs of a True Immortal weapon, which required ample Immortal-level energy to unleash its combat ability.
If Chengsheng Mountain did not possess much Immortal-level energy, then they would be in danger this time, as the three supreme beings were well-prepared. Great Emperor Han Li would have to activate the True Immortal Weapon to stand a chance, which meant pitting their foundation against each other.
The nine dominant powers had divided the legacies of many glorious powers from the Ancient Era, possessing vast quantities of Immortal-level energy with unfathomably deep foundations; Chengsheng Mountain was very likely to fall short in comparison.
If Chengsheng Mountain’s resources were exhausted without being able to repel the three supreme beings, then Chengsheng Mountain would be doomed.
Even if the three supreme beings were to graciously spare Chengsheng Mountain, other formidable forces and Heavenly Governing Forces would still step in to divide Chengsheng Mountain among themselves.
This fight was Chengsheng Mountain’s battle for existence within the Endless Yuankun Domain!
If they could withstand this, they could perhaps even remove the prefix ‘quasi’ ahead of schedule, leaping forth to become the tenth true dominant power of the Yuankun Domain.
Repelling the three supreme beings would be a feat enough to attest to Chengsheng Mountain’s strength as equal to that of the other dominant powers.
“Scram!”
Sensing the numerous prying Divine Senses, Empress Yuanchu, clad in silver armor holding a halberd, uttered sharply, shattering all the attentive Spirits, for she did not wish to be watched by so many cultivators.
Soon, several more Divine Senses came probing, and while Empress Yuanchu’s brows slightly furrowed, she did not take further action.
The masters of these Divine Senses were beings of her level, not afraid of her, and it was unnecessary to provoke trouble.
In Yandao Province, Tianji Pavilion.
Inside the topmost floor, Emperor Tianji stood with his hands behind his back in front of the window, gazing towards Qianyuan Divine Province, a smile playing on his lips.
“Empress Yuanchu is still as domineering as ever,” he remarked.
His gaze was profound, containing visions of the cosmos being annihilated and worlds being conceived. His left eye reflected Chengsheng Mountain, and his right eye reflected Han Li’s figure as he attempted to deduce the outcome once more.
Emperor Tianji had attempted such deductions before but had not obtained any useful information. He surmised that the True Immortal Sword concealed by Han Li was masking everything.
He knew Han Li’s Immortal Sword was not adept at concealing the secrets of heaven, but its tier was too high, and even if he wanted to extract useful intelligence, the cost would be enormous.
Emperor Tianji was unwilling to pay that price.
He had always been like this. When the White Emperor sought his help for deducing the secrets of heaven, Emperor Tianji took the opportunity to extort him, asking for five Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons. The White Emperor, deeming the price too high, declined.
Looking back now, it was fortunate that the White Emperor did not agree, for otherwise, he would have suffered a great loss.
With Han Li’s True Immortal Sword concealing him, for Emperor Tianji to deduce his information would cost at least the value of one Heavenly Immortal Weapon, not something five Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons could compare to.
Now, the moment for deduction had come. He wished to probe Han Li’s strengths and verify if the rumors were true.
As the three supreme beings from the White Emperor, Empress Yuanchu, and Huangyue Imperial Empire arrived in Qianyuan Divine Province, Great Emperor Han Li could neither hide nor avoid them; he had to fight.
Han Li’s True Immortal Sword was not adept at hiding the secrets of heaven, so when the battle began and it confronted the three True Immortal Weapons, it would be even less able to conceal anything.
Then, he could effortlessly deduce Han Li’s intelligence, revealing every detail about him—that information would be incredibly valuable.
He also had only this one opportunity, if successful, he knew there would be many cultivators willing to buy detailed intelligence on Han Li.
Emperor Tianji’s smile grew wider, as though he could see countless streams of Immortal Qi, Immortal Stones, Immortal Elixirs… filling his pockets.
In Qianyuan Divine Province, Chengsheng Mountain.
Seeing the worried expressions of his many beautiful wives and concubines, Han Li wore a calm and composed smile as he reassured them, “Do not worry, I’ll be back soon.”
With their husband appearing so unconcerned, his wives and concubines, including Lu Tianxiang, Ling Lingshuang, Xue Yueqing, and Li Mingmeng, who were initially quite tense, relaxed a little.
Zi Miaozhen, Ji Mingyue, and Yuan Youwei were also there, looking up through the Immortal Array into the heavens, beholding the three supreme beings that commanded the world, their emotions varied.
They had been married to Han Li for twenty-six or twenty-seven years, and had developed deep affections for him, their hearts tied to him, but the inevitable was finally upon them.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - 242: Domineering Empress! Murdering Her Own Husband? You Should Be the Supreme of the Path of Survival! The Sword of Humanity VS Wuxian Palace!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 617: Chapter 242: Domineering Empress! Murdering Her Own Husband? You Should Be the Supreme of the Path of Survival! The Sword of Humanity VS Wuxian Palace!_2
Han Li was their husband, while the Empress of Phoenix Moon, Empress Yuanchu, and the White Emperor were their benefactors. They had cultivated to the Saint Abyss Realm and the Quasi Emperor domain, receiving much grace from various supreme beings.
Now, as a great war was about to ensue between them, their hearts were deeply troubled, yet they still hoped that their husband Han Li could withstand the pressure and overcome this calamity.
Even Yuan Youwei thought so.
When she first fell into Han Li’s hands, she became a female slave due to various reasons, but her status gradually improved thereafter.
Her first child Han Yongyuan was of the imperial body type, and Han Li elevated her status to that of a servant concubine.
Later, Yuan Youwei gave birth to several princes of the royal body, and although her status did not change, her position continued to rise, for the mother’s value increases with her children’s.
Two years ago, Yuan Youwei bore her fifth descendant, another imperial body, and Han Li, overjoyed, once again promoted her status, and Yuan Youwei became a concubine.
Although she was still not as prestigious as Purple Miao Zhen and Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei was already very satisfied. Her status, benefits, and treatment had improved countless times compared to before, and she still had room for promotion. As long as she bore more children for her husband, she could certainly ascend to the status of a dao companion in the future.
Yuan Youwei, her edges smoothed by Han Li, became more rounded, docile, compliant, utterly different from her initial self, and had turned into a reflection of Han Li’s will.
Like Purple Miao Zhen and Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei had many ties to Chengsheng Mountain, such as their descendants, the cultivation environment, benefits, and so on.
The three women had spent over two decades at Chengsheng Mountain, and their cultivation had advanced significantly, especially Purple Miao Zhen and Ji Mingyue, for, being Han Li’s dao companions, they had access to resources far beyond Yuan Youwei.
No matter the reason, they did not wish for their husband to be defeated or for Chengsheng Mountain to fall.
Apart from Yuan Youwei, Ji Mingyue, and Purple Miao Zhen, there were two other peerless beauties with complicated expressions—Yao Xi and Murong Ying.
The Divine Spirit seals on Yao Xi and Murong Ying had been lifted, and they had regained their respective memories. Han Li was not concerned about the secrets being leaked; Chengsheng Mountain had many True Immortal and Heavenly Immortal weapons to suppress, no one in the Endless Yuankun Domain could pry into it.
Even though Yao Xi and Murong Ying were part of the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu’s souls and had special connections, such ties were also severed. Within Chengsheng Mountain, they were independent beings.
“Is that my true self?” Yao Xi whispered, a hint of strangeness flashing across her breathtaking face.
Murong Ying nodded slightly. Looking at Empress Yuanchu, she felt a complex mix of emotions, unsure if they could survive this ordeal.
“Ying’er, would they be considered as plotting to kill their own husband?” Yao Xi suddenly asked.
Murong Ying was stunned.
“Ah, this…Shouldn’t count… Right?” Murong Ying stuttered blankly.
She was somewhat unable to keep up with Yao Xi’s train of thought. How could she come up with such an absurd question?
Yao Xi smiled, took Murong Ying’s jade-like hand, and said, “I think it counts, Ying’er, think about it. We are indeed their split souls, in essence the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu, aren’t we?”
“We are the husband’s wives, so wouldn’t the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu be the husband’s wives, too?”
“If both the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu are the husband’s wives, and they still join forces with outsiders to threaten the husband, seeking to annihilate our Chengsheng Mountain, isn’t that conspiring to murder one’s husband?”
Murong Ying tilted her head to look at Yao Xi, and then at the glorious Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu in the sky, before nodding unintentionally, “It seems to make sense.”
Seeing that Murong Ying agreed with her view, Yao Xi’s flawless face broke into a beautiful smile, and she whispered, “Should we stop them then?”
“Uh… How would we stop them? With what?” Murong Ying suddenly became a bit dazed. She genuinely wanted to delve into Yao Xi’s sea of consciousness, engage deeply with her Divine Spirit, and see what Yao Xi was truly thinking.
They were both only of the Tongxuan Realm. How could they stop their true selves, who were supreme beings at the absolute summit of the Heaven Imperial Realm?
Yao Xi raised her small fist, giggled, and said, “It’s easy, I’ve come up with five ideas to stop the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu…”
While Purple Miao Zhen, Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, Murong Ying, Yao Xi, and the other beloved wives and beautiful concubines whispered among themselves, Han Li had already taken action.
With his hands clasped behind his back, he strode out of Chengsheng Mountain, toward the three supreme beings oppressing Qianyuan Divine Province.
Han Li, in his green robe fluttering, bore a calm and unhurried demeanor. With each step ascending through the skies, he quickly reached the same height as Empress Yuanchu, the Empress of Phoenix Moon, and the White Emperor.
Gazing at the three eager supreme beings, Han Li disregarded the White Emperor. His Primordial Spirit shining, he secretly communicated to Empress Yuanchu and the Empress of Phoenix Moon, chuckling as he spoke:
“Do my two ladies wish so eagerly to enter the bridal chamber with your husband?”
“Impudent!”
“Seeking death!”
Cold glints flashed simultaneously in the eyes of Empress Yuanchu and the Empress of Phoenix Moon, their murderous intent shaking the heavens and earth, disturbing the timeless azure sky. One unleashed a punch while the other swung her palm, directly aiming to obliterate Han Li.
Neither had expected that Han Li would dare to tease them so brazenly in the face of their interrogation, bold enough to flirt with the two exceptional empresses to their faces.
Truly audacious to the extreme!
In that moment, Empress Yuanchu and the Empress of Phoenix Moon both recalled the embarrassing sensations that had suddenly emerged decades before—the pain of losing their virginity and the agony of childbirth.
Although it was not experienced by themselves, but by their split souls, they felt as though they had lived it.
Latterly, they actively shielded themselves from such perceptions, to avoid provoking some negative thoughts.
Yet, those two experiences were imprinted in their memories, indelible. Whenever the two extraordinary empresses recalled them, rage would surge, stirring the weighty tides of their conscience in tumultuous waves.

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - 242: Domineering Empress! Murdering Her Own Husband? You Should Be the Supreme of the Path of Survival! The Sword of Humanity VS Wuxian Palace!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 618: Chapter 242: Domineering Empress! Murdering Her Own Husband? You Should Be the Supreme of the Path of Survival! The Sword of Humanity VS Wuxian Palace!_3
White Emperor stood on the other side, and when Han Li appeared, his gaze was sizing up the man. He secretly exerted his Divine Skills, attempting to see through the secrets of the Eternal Emperor, but was unable to succeed.
Then, he saw Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu suddenly strike out to attack Han Li, their expressions full of anger. It was clear that Han Li had said some unpleasant words to the two peerless empresses through a private message.
Without any hesitation, White Emperor also made his move, fingers forming a sword, instantly slashing out thirty-six thousand swords.
In an instant, sword light soared to the sky, its brilliance cold and reaching ten directions, as if it could sever the starry seas and annihilate the great universe.
The dazzling sword light shone between heaven and earth, resplendent and blinding, the sword aura was magnificent. One sword beam after another rushed to the sky, pierced the heavens, and slashed towards Han Li.
Han Li, undaunted by the imminent peril, brandished his right palm as if it were the sharpest heavenly blade, casually swinging two cuts. The dazzling and blinding blade light tore through time and space, landing on the fist and palm imprints, erasing their intrinsic Dao.
Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu, although striking in anger, did not use their full strength, whereas Han Li gave it his all. His combat ability had grown even stronger over the past two years.
After the two cuts, Han Li’s right palm swung out another, but this one was directed towards White Emperor.
The blade light, billions of strands, covered the heaven, a terrifying force sweeping across all directions, more radiant than any great sun of myriad realms, more glaring and piercing, as if it could dissolve everything in the world, even shattering the void.
White Emperor had slashed out thirty-six thousand swords, but Han Li had only swung a single cut.
Blade and sword roared, clashed, and fiercely battled!
Above the firmament, the blinding sword beams and blade light ground against each other, casting alternating light and shadow, inducing a massive collapse of the void.
Eventually, Han Li’s billions of strands of blade light were worn away. The terrifying sword beams, still numbering in the tens of thousands, continued to attack Han Li.
Han Li waved his hand, sending out a palm strike with dazzling runes that overpowered all. Billions of runes combined into a giant palm that shielded “Heavenly Space”, beneath which the star sea surged, countless bright stars twinkling as if there was a real star sea in the palm.
Boom!
The remaining tens of thousands of sword beams shattered one after another, and Han Li’s star sea giant palm also dissipated.
“The two of you hold on a moment; we can settle our scores slowly. Let Han first have a word with White Emperor.”
Han Li said to Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu, speaking out loud and clear this time.
Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu’s eyes flickered with a spark of light, and after exchanging glances, the two peerless empresses truly refrained from attacking again.
Only then did Han Li turn towards White Emperor and spoke indifferently, “White Emperor, why aren’t you comfortably nestled in your White Emperor City? What brings you to my Qianyuan Divine Province?”
Me, lying low?
A look of surprise crossed White Emperor’s face. Even Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu were shocked, all three thinking Han Li was truly shameless.
According to the intelligence they had gathered, Han Li was undoubtedly very cautious. After seemingly regaining memories of his past life, Han Li became extremely low-key. With his strong foundation and deep reserves, he was very steady, or rather, excessively so.
Had he not taken action to establish his authority two years ago, the world would not have known that Han Li had reached the Heaven Imperial Realm’s combat ability and possessed a True Immortal weapon.
Or perhaps, Han Li lay low until he reached the Heaven Imperial Realm’s combat ability and acquired a True Immortal weapon before he took action to establish his authority.
Where does he get the face to call White Emperor cautious?
The surprise faded, and White Emperor’s expression turned impassive as he calmly said, “Compared to you, I am still inferior.”
“I think you should not call yourself Eternal Emperor anymore, but Gou Dao Emperor instead. Once you cultivate to the very pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, you can be known as Gou Dao Supreme.”
“Oh and by the way, you may never get the chance to be called Gou Dao Supreme, for who gave you the audacity to seize someone from my White Emperor City?”
Murderous intent boiled within White Emperor; he had a very low opinion of Han Li.
The enmity between him and Han Li was not shallow.
In the Endless Yuankun Domain, who didn’t know that he was pursuing Empress Huang Yue?
Han Li dared to meddle with Empress Huang Yue’s split soul and had the audacity to marry it, effectively cuckolding him!
And there was Zi Miao Zhen, whom he had sent to the Qianyuan Divine Province to search for Empress Huang Yue’s split soul, hoping Zi Miao Zhen would demonstrate her worth. Yet, she ended up being captured by Han Li and married off as well.
While he fancied Empress Huang Yue, Zi Miao Zhen wasn’t bad either; he had been nurturing her as a reserve option, but Han Li cut in early and put another hat on him.
Now, when White Emperor looked at Han Li, it was like a wronged soul staring at a brigand, especially since Han Li, this audacious fellow, strutted right in front of him.
Since Han Li’s arrival, he had been putting on airs, and was even secretly whispering with Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu, ignoring him. Was he trying to romance them right in front of him?
White Emperor finally got a word from Han Li, but the first thing he did was mock him, calling him cautious, truly insufferable.
Uncle might endure, but auntie cannot!
If it weren’t for preserving his own face, White Emperor would have launched a killing spree against Han Li long ago.
Han Li ignored White Emperor’s murderous intent, turned his head with a smile towards Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu, “The title ‘Gou Dao Supreme’ isn’t bad; I find it quite fitting for me.”
Empress Huang Yue: ???
Empress Yuanchu: “Hehe~”
Cold light overflowed White Emperor’s eyes; he was almost unable to hold himself back any longer. Han Li truly did not regard him at all.
“White Emperor, why are sparks flying from your eyes? Oh right, you indeed do not exist in my eyes, for you are not an unmatched great beauty,” Han Li suddenly said.
Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu maintained expressionless faces, yet secretly communicated through voice transmission, laughing inwardly.
Han Li was indeed shameless.
But White Emperor was also quite detestable, and the two peerless empresses did not like him, finding many of his actions intolerable.

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - 242: Domineering Empress! Murdering Her Own Husband? You Should Be the Supreme of the Path of Survival! The Sword of Humanity VS Wuxian Palace!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 619: Chapter 242: Domineering Empress! Murdering Her Own Husband? You Should Be the Supreme of the Path of Survival! The Sword of Humanity VS Wuxian Palace!_4
Today, as they arrived in Qianyuan Divine Province, the two peerless empresses set off together, unlike White Emperor, who shamelessly tagged along. Hence, Han Li declared that he wanted to resolve some issues with White Emperor first, to which the two empresses tacitly agreed after a moment of deliberation.
Especially Empress Phoenix Moon, who harbored not a shred of affection for White Emperor; she knew exactly what he desired—coveting her body and targeting her unique physique.
If she were to fall into White Emperor’s hands, he would probably rapidly achieve victory and transform into a War Immortal.
If only White Emperor had been willing to sacrifice more for her, to give more of himself, Empress Phoenix Moon might have seen him in a new light. But White Emperor wanted to gain without giving, aiming to freeload off her.
Everyone was well aware of White Emperor’s intentions, including Empress Phoenix Moon herself.
In the vast Endless Yuankun Domain, very few cultivators were deemed worthy of becoming her dao companion, and White Emperor was one among them. Empress Phoenix Moon had once given White Emperor an opportunity, but he failed to cherish it.
She yearned to become a War Immortal and required an incredibly precious treasure from White Emperor City. When she sought it from White Emperor, willing to trade treasures in return, he was unwilling.
For example, White Emperor could have taken the lead earlier, scouted Han Li’s capabilities on her behalf, but instead, he chose to depart only after she and Empress Yuanchu set out.
Empress Phoenix Moon saw through White Emperor’s intentions crystal clear; he was simply afraid that Han Li’s foundation was too formidable, unwilling to deplete too much of his own.
Upon hearing this, White Emperor could no longer restrain himself and immediately took action. He was aware that this was his chance to prove himself, knowing well that if a fight broke out, the two supreme empresses would surely not stand idly by, for it was a prime opportunity to capture Han Li.
Above his head, a jade pavilion materialized, magnificent and grand, brilliantly splendid, with Immortal Light illuminating both past and present. This was the True Immortal armament of White Emperor City, the Wuxian Palace.
One of the gates of the Wuxian Palace opened and a ruler flew out, made entirely of immortal jade and exceedingly beautiful.
In the next instant, the Jade ruler radiated terrifying might, with billions of runes erupting forth. Infinite laws intertwined as it lightly struck, shooting out two beams of light that pierced through space and time.
The moment the jade pavilion appeared above White Emperor’s head, Han Li instantly reacted. Above his head manifested a mirror named “Yin Yang Mirror,” a top-tier Heavenly Immortal armament.
The Yin Yang Mirror shed strand after strand of Immortal Light. In a flash, Infinite Immortal Light burst forth, the highest laws overshadowing “Heavenly Space”, casting a vast Yin Yang diagram as expansive as a star-filled sea above Han Li’s head.
The Yin Yang diagram whirled, with strands of Yin Yang Immortal Light slashing out. Each strand could penetrate the great cosmos, destroy starry seas, sever star rivers, plunging the world into silence.
After striking a blow, Han Li spoke leisurely, “You think you’re the only one with an Immortal armament?”
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The clash between the Jade ruler and the Yin Yang Mirror unfolded in the ninth heaven, evenly matched, neither able to gain the upper hand over the other.
The Yin Yang Mirror was a top-tier Heavenly Immortal armament, and the Jade ruler, as part of the Wuxian Palace, was also equivalent to a top-tier Heavenly Immortal armament.
Empress Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu, witnessing this scene, their beautiful eyes flickered with surprise. Han Li indeed possessed more than one Heavenly Immortal armament.
Two years ago, during the great battle in the Barbarian Region of Qianyuan Divine Province, Han Li had revealed a cauldron-shaped Heavenly Immortal armament and a True Immortal Sword, yet they suspected Han Li still had Immortal armaments hidden.
White Emperor’s brow furrowed slightly as he failed to force Han Li’s True Immortal Sword into action. The presence of another Heavenly Immortal armament in Han Li’s arsenal was within his expectations.
“Let me see what’s behind your arrogant confidence.”
With a mere thought from White Emperor, the Wuxian Palace fully awakened. It burgeoned across the sky, expanding immensely to cover “Heavenly Space,” and dwarfed even the entirety of Qianyuan Divine Province, seemingly filling the nine heavens and ten earths.
In an instant, the Wuxian Palace unleashed unparalleled might. Majestic and vast, the palace materialized a white cosmic starry sea in the firmament. Each strand of its might could suppress both heaven and earth, pinning down space and time.
Countless stars fell, one galaxy after another swept in, one sea after another surged forward, numerous Star Domains intertwined in the celestial ambiance, with thunder echoing across the heavens.
Han Li drew his sword, and instantly, radiant sword lights slashed through, rippling across space-time, shining between heaven and earth. The dazzling lights were potent enough to cleave through the causality of space-time, shattering the cosmic starry rivers.
For the first time, the two True Immortal armaments engaged in fierce collision, both exerting full strength, holding nothing back.
The vast cosmic starry sea pressed down, intending to suppress and annihilate the world, while the splendid sword light soared, tearing through the cosmic starry sea. Countless stars fell, boundless realms were destroyed, and innumerable starry seas instantly evaporated.
PS: Tomorrow’s monthly ticket addition is an extra 2000 words, still two chapters, with at least 8000 words updated.

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - 243: Time to Compete with Foundations! Reincarnation of an Ancient Immortal? Emperor Tianji Coughs Blood! Bursting White Emperor’s Confidence!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 620: Chapter 243: Time to Compete with Foundations! Reincarnation of an Ancient Immortal? Emperor Tianji Coughs Blood! Bursting White Emperor’s Confidence!_1
Above the firmament,
the clash between Wuxian Palace and the Sword of Humanity fiercely collided, slashing through the vast galaxies with brilliant sword light, causing cosmic explosions. Sword beams shot up from the ground, tearing the entire sky apart, as if Immortals were ascending from the mortal world in feathery flight.
Each tremble of the Sword of Humanity sent out chilly radiance from its frosty blade, shocking the heavens. With the flow of endless sword light, the skies trembled. Billions of strands of sword qi swept across, collapsing the starry river.
But the cosmos and galaxies were vast and boundless, one after another falling, emitting thirteen-color glows, as if thirteen real universes were pressing down. Each time one was destroyed, it was immediately replenished in an endless cycle.
“Since you want to reason things out with this emperor, come then,”
Seeing the Wuxian Palace and the Sword of Humanity locked in a stalemate, unable to determine a victor for the time being, Emperor Bai’s brows furrowed slightly, then a faint smile appeared on his face.
The strength of Han Li’s True Immortal weapon was somewhat beyond Emperor Bai’s expectations, almost on par with his own Wuxian Palace.
Keep in mind that his Wuxian Palace was an immortal treasure handed down from the last era, acquired by chance, and it had helped him get to where he was today.
In terms of power, the Wuxian Palace was ranked among the top five in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Emperor Bai had not discerned the origin of Han Li’s True Immortal Sword, guessing that it was also very ancient, probably having gone through more than one or two eras, otherwise it would not be so obscure.
But no matter how powerful the True Immortal weapon was, Han Li’s cultivation was a severe flaw, far inferior to his own.
According to Emperor Bai’s observation, Han Li’s maximum combat ability would not exceed the mid-stage of the Heaven Imperial Realm, whereas he himself had reached the zenith of the Heaven Imperial Realm. Han Li could not possibly be his opponent.
With the True Immortal weapons stalemated, it was the perfect opportunity for him to deal with Han Li. Even if that True Immortal Sword wanted to rescue Han Li, it would be futile; Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu would not agree.
“As you wish,” said Han Li indifferently.
Emperor Bai wanted to take advantage of the situation, but Han Li would not let Emperor Bai take more than one shot. If there were to be multiple shots, they would have to be from Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu.
Emperor Bai thought he was easy to bully, but Han Li had a plan. He wanted to see if he could directly obliterate Emperor Bai today, whose understanding of him fell far short.
Han Li looked towards the two peerless empresses, his handsome face showing a faint smile, “The two empresses wouldn’t intervene, right?”
Empress Huang Yue: “You’re free to do as you please.”
“I’m watching your performance,” said Empress Yuanchu.
The gazes of the two peerless empresses shifted between Han Li and Emperor Bai, communicating silently. Although they did not get along, on some occasions, they would come together.
As for Emperor Bai’s remark, Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu initially thought Han Li would refuse, considering his obvious weakness compared to Emperor Bai. But unexpectedly, Han Li agreed.
Was he trying to show off in front of them to gain their favor?
Or did Han Li truly have the confidence to not fear Emperor Bai?
After exchanging thoughts, the two peerless empresses believed it was more likely the latter, for while Han Li was lascivious and thick-skinned, he was indeed very cautious and would not take such a risky move to show off.
The two women were even more curious to know what other cards Han Li had up his sleeve.
They would use Emperor Bai as their vanguard for the time being; they had no intention of getting involved just yet, waiting for all of Han Li’s final cards to be forced out by Emperor Bai. Then, they could quickly subdue Han Li, avenging their split soul.
In doing so, they would incur the smallest loss, with Emperor Bai paying the highest price.
Emperor Bai glanced at Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu and let out a cold snort in his heart. These two really made no attempt to conceal their intentions, planning to make use of him as a pawn.
Nevertheless, Emperor Bai restrained himself. He knew he had to perform well before Empress Huang Yue, so he was ready to pay some price today to gain much more in the future.
“Huang Yue, Yuanchu, just watch. I’ll turn this ‘Gou Dao Emperor’ into the ‘Dog Headed Emperor’ and make him…” Emperor Bai said calmly.
Before Emperor Bai could finish his sentence, Han Li had already made his move. He had no intention of waiting for Emperor Bai to show off in front of the two peerless empresses.
The Yin Yang Mirror atop Han Li’s head rotated to its reverse side, bursting with Infinite Immortal Light. The laws of the Immortal Dao enveloped “Heavenly Space”, and destructive beams of light shot out one after another toward Emperor Bai, cracking open the void.
Facing the assault of the Yin Yang Mirror, Emperor Bai chose not to block. The Jade Ruler had already returned to the Wuxian Palace, and he directly summoned a new Heavenly Immortal weapon, an Immortal Sword.
Was this not just a contest of foundations? Han Li could not possibly outmatch him.
Once Han Li’s True Immortal and Heavenly Immortal weapons were depleted, it would be time for them to fight in the flesh. By then, he would see if this Gou Dao Emperor could still be so arrogant.
The Immortal Sword clashed with the Yin Yang Mirror, carving out a new battleground in the void. Chaos Qi surged, colliding thousands of times in an instant, creating and destroying countless worlds.
Realms were born, and realms perished!
Emperor Bai stood with hands behind his back, releasing his terrifying aura unabashedly. That was the breath of someone at the zenith of the Heaven Imperial Realm, intimidating all nine heavens and ten lands, making all beings in Qianyuan Divine Province feel as if an Ancient Immortal Mountain was descending upon them, forcing them to bow down. Many cultivators even knelt on the ground outright.
And this was simply because they were inadvertently swept by his excess might. If Emperor Bai targeted them intentionally, just his aura alone could wipe out most life in the Qianyuan Divine Province.
“Come on, let me see how many Heavenly Immortal weapons you have left,” Emperor Bai said.
His aura fully suppressed Han Li as he stepped forward, speaking with overbearing confidence.
With each step, a second Heavenly Immortal weapon appeared above Emperor Bai’s head, a short mace that awoke in full force and attacked Han Li with all its might.

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - 243: Time to Compete with Foundations! Reincarnation of an Ancient Immortal? Emperor Tianji Coughs Blood! Bursting White Emperor’s Confidence!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 621: Chapter 243: Time to Compete with Foundations! Reincarnation of an Ancient Immortal? Emperor Tianji Coughs Blood! Bursting White Emperor’s Confidence!_2
Han Li stood unmoved, his body radiating divine light, forming halos around him that dazzled brilliantly. At that moment, he seemed like an Immortal Emperor, supreme above all of ancient and modern times.
As soon as White Emperor spoke, Han Li had already launched the second round of attack. The Primordial Chaos Cauldron materialized, teetering as it pressed down on the short mace, with the chaotic energy of the Primitive World surging wildly as the entire world seemed to crush down.
The two Heavenly Immortal weapons created another void battlefield.
White Emperor didn’t stop moving; he summoned another Heavenly Immortal weapon, this time a nine-tiered immortal pagoda. The pagoda roared towards him, each tier of its structure like a layer of “Heavenly Space,” filling the firmament with immense pressure.
This time he had brought most of White Emperor City’s foundations, including one True Immortal weapon and four Heavenly Immortal weapons, all to utterly destroy Han Li.
He had thought that with three Supremes teaming up, they would easily kill Han Li. Unexpectedly, both Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, the parties involved, were staying out of it for the time being, which irritated White Emperor.
Even so, he could suppress Han Li all on his own.
Han Li was nothing; how dare he compete with him for a woman, and act so arrogantly, disregarding him as the supreme power of the Yuankun Domain.
Han Li was just a newly risen cultivator whose foundation was still weak. It was questionable whether he could even produce a third Heavenly Immortal weapon.
If Han Li didn’t have a third Heavenly Immortal weapon, then he was doomed today. White Emperor wouldn’t even need to make a move; the nine-tiered immortal pagoda alone could completely annihilate Han Li.
“That’s it?”
Han Li’s expression remained calm and composed, utterly unfazed.
He too summoned another Heavenly Immortal weapon, a heavenly blade named Ruyi. The blade swept across, its radiance flashing, cleaving through the great cosmos, shattering layers of “Heavenly Space.”
“He actually has another Heavenly Immortal weapon.”
Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu exchanged glances, a hint of surprise flickering in their beautiful eyes.
Was Han Li really a new rising star?
This foundation was terrifying!
The nine mightiest forces of the Endless Yuankun Domain had varied strengths: the weaker ones had four Heavenly Immortal weapons, the stronger ones five, while Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and Longevity Jiang Family were the strongest of all, each possessing six Heavenly Immortal weapons.
The foundations of the nine mightiest forces were so substantial because they had divided the legacy of the glorious powers from the Ancient Era. But how did Han Li come to have such resources?
Han Li possessed one True Immortal weapon and three Heavenly Immortal weapons, yet he had been cultivating for less than three hundred years.
Could it be that Han Li was the reincarnation of an ancient Immortal from before the Ancient Era, or even before this epoch?
Both Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu thought it was very likely.
If Han Li was indeed the reincarnation of an ancient Immortal, then everything would have a more reasonable explanation.
Ancient Immortals didn’t know how many lives they had reincarnated through, and with each life, the difficulty of awakening their Dormant Wisdom greatly increased; which is why Han Li only awoke at the age of 195, just before his life limit.
After awakening, Han Li cautiously continued his cultivation. As his power gradually returned, he started to unseal the emperorial and immortal weapons one by one, transforming Chengsheng Mountain into an extraordinarily powerful force overnight.
Only the reincarnation of an ancient Immortal could explain why Han Li had so many True Immortal and Heavenly Immortal weapons.
Both exceptional empresses didn’t believe that Han Li obtained these through luck alone; that would require immense fortune and opportunity.
Otherwise, they, with their Immortal Grade qualifications and Immortal Bodies, who were also true descendants of Heavenly Immortals, felt that their own fates and fortunes were somewhat inferior to Han Li’s.
“Do you think Han Li has more immortal weapons?” Empress Yuanchu’s eyes were sparkling.
Empress Huangyue glanced at the void battlefields around them, her phoenix brows slightly furrowed, and after some thought, she said, “No more True Immortal weapons, but there might still be one more Heavenly Immortal weapon.”
Empress Yuanchu nodded slightly, having the same thought.
It was already shocking enough that Han Li possessed one True Immortal weapon and four Heavenly Immortal weapons. This is likely his last resort. If he were to produce another True Immortal weapon, even the two empresses would have to be extremely cautious of him.
The nine mightiest forces only had one True Immortal weapon each. If Han Li had two, and if he also had enough immortal-level energy, even if he had slightly fewer Heavenly Immortal weapons, he could leap from being a nearly-mighty force to the number one mightiest force in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
In Yandao Province, Tianji Pavilion.
“How is this possible?”
A voice of shock arose from the top floor of Tianji Pavilion, echoing within but not reaching the outside world.
At this moment, Emperor Tianji had blood on the corner of his mouth and his face was slightly pale, but he quickly returned to his peak state. Shocked, he stared at the Heavenly Path Roulette floating above him.
That was Tianji Pavilion’s True Immortal weapon: [Heavenly Path Roulette]!
With this True Immortal weapon and Emperor Tianji’s cultivation level, he could calculate all things in the world without exception.
Even for supreme beings like Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, Emperor Tianji could deduce everything about them, even if True Immortal weapons shrouded them, it was useless.
The premise was that Emperor Tianji was willing to pay a huge price.
But he was not willing to pay such a price, so he rarely calculated these supremes, and even if he occasionally did, he would do so obliquely, which cost less.
However, today, Emperor Tianji wanted to deduce everything about Han Li, to see his growth trajectory and to understand his origins, to prepare for the future.
But Emperor Tianji failed.
Why did he fail?
Emperor Tianji couldn’t understand.
Han Li’s cultivation was much lower than his, and without a True Immortal weapon to shield him, it shouldn’t be difficult to deduce; only a small price was required to succeed.
To increase the success rate, Emperor Tianji had even waited until Han Li’s third Heavenly Immortal weapon was revealed before starting the deduction. Without the cover of a Heavenly Immortal weapon, his chances of success greatly increased.
Expectation was full, reality was harsh.

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - 243: Time to Compete with Foundations! Reincarnation of an Ancient Immortal? Emperor Tianji Coughs Blood! Bursting White Emperor’s Confidence!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 622: Chapter 243: Time to Compete with Foundations! Reincarnation of an Ancient Immortal? Emperor Tianji Coughs Blood! Bursting White Emperor’s Confidence!_3
When Emperor Tianji attempted to divine Han Li’s information, he immediately encountered an obstacle. Emperor Tianji paid a price to clear away the outer fog only to discover an even denser fog within.
Having begun the divination, Emperor Tianji refused to give up easily. He gritted his teeth and paid a higher price, parting the next layer of fog, yet within it was still more fog, Han Li’s fate remained obscured by the mists.
Emperor Tianji stubbornly continued to pay the price, clearing away five layers of fog, but there was still only fog within, leaving Emperor Tianji dumbfounded.
He wanted to give up, but could not bear the losses already incurred, worth half a Heavenly Immortal weapon—was he to let that go to waste?
He had a feeling in his heart, as though if he cleared away just one more layer of fog, everything would become clear, and he would peer into all that was Han Li.
After hesitating only a moment, Emperor Tianji clenched his teeth and spent the resources of half a Heavenly Immortal weapon, clearing away the sixth layer of fog, but what lay within was still fog.
At that point, Emperor Tianji nearly ground his teeth to powder, but ultimately, he gave up.
To divine Han Li’s information, he had expended resources worth two Heavenly Immortal weapons, yet he had obtained nothing, a grievous loss indeed.
Emperor Tianji was furious, having never suffered such a loss before. He silently took out his notebook and jotted down this debt under Han Li’s name, planning to recoup his losses from Han Li in the future.
Looking in the direction of Qianyuan Divine Province, a wry smile appeared on Emperor Tianji’s face—he knew that the White Emperor was going to encounter great misfortune.
If he could not divine Han Li’s fate even after paying the price of two Heavenly Immortal weapons, it meant that Han Li must be concealing some powerful celestial treasure, so great that not even his Heavenly Path Roulette could divine it.
Han Li was the first being that he could not see through!
No wonder Han Li was still so calm and composed, that was true strength; they couldn’t compare.
At that moment, Emperor Tianji also felt that Han Li truly might be the reincarnation of an ancient immortal, perhaps a powerful True Immortal who had reclaimed the celestial treasures of his past life.
Meanwhile, the master of the Western Sky Palace and the Butian Sect Master were both watching the battle in Qianyuan Divine Province and exchanging thoughts.
They were prepared; once all of Han Li’s trump cards were revealed and after he was bombarded to death by the joint hands of the three supremes, the two of them would join forces to descend upon Qianyuan Divine Province, directly breaking into Chengsheng Mountain and taking all its treasures.
It was suspected that Han Li possessed one True Immortal weapon and four Heavenly Immortal weapons, a foundation comparable to some of the most powerful factions. It was very likely that Chengsheng Mountain still hid many treasures, such as Immortal Stones, Immortal Qi, Immortal Elixirs, Immortal Scriptures, and so on.
But in the next moment, the smirks on their faces froze, and their expressions turned extremely grave.
“Are you kidding me?” said the master of the Western Sky Palace and the Butian Sect Master in unison.
Qianyuan Divine Province.
The White Emperor pressed closer once again, now less than ten miles away from Han Li. He sent forth his fourth Heavenly Immortal weapon, also the last one he had brought, which was a rod-shaped Heavenly Immortal weapon.
A smile of victory appeared on the White Emperor’s face.
It didn’t matter whether Han Li still had a fourth Heavenly Immortal weapon or not; Han Li was finished. He wouldn’t be able to beat him.
Without a Heavenly Immortal weapon, his Zhenxian Rod would annihilate Han Li. With a Heavenly Immortal weapon, the White Emperor would personally deal with Han Li; either way, Han Li’s death was inevitable.
But in the very next instant, the White Emperor’s smile twisted into horror, astonishment, shock, and panic, as a multitude of emotions flickered across his face. He retreated at an unbelievably rapid pace.
His form was teleporting, vanishing from the spot in an instant, reappearing billions of miles away, still in frenzied flight.
But it was all in vain!
Han Li had brought out his second True Immortal weapon, not the Emperor Flag, but the Qiankun Bracelet, forged from three types of Immortal Gold, encapsulating the profound Great Dao of the cosmos at the level of a True Immortal.
The Qiankun Bracelet hurled forward with the force of thirty-three heavens, as if thirty-three vast universes were crashing down simultaneously, collapsing the void, obliterating all in its path, locking onto the White Emperor.
It arrived above the White Emperor’s head in an instant and smashed down on his skull with a thunderous impact, interweaving countless immortal laws, as dazzling as Daoist runes burst forth.
Seeing that escape was futile, the White Emperor also grew desperate. In an instant, he activated hundreds of secret techniques and sacrificed numerous Emperor weapons, attempting to withstand it all.
Then, the White Emperor exploded!

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - 244: Daring to Contend with Me? Supreme Being vs. Heavenly Immortal! The Reckoning Begins! The Astonishing Transformation of the Female Bodhisattva_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 623: Chapter 244: Daring to Contend with Me? Supreme Being vs. Heavenly Immortal! The Reckoning Begins! The Astonishing Transformation of the Female Bodhisattva_1
White Emperor City exploded!
Literally exploded.
Smashed by the True Immortal artifact, the Qiankun Bracelet, it was like thirty-three major universes had struck White Emperor City, blowing it to smithereens. Flesh and blood flew in all directions, soaking everything in gore as the once majestic Primordial Spirit shattered instantaneously.
Countless droplets of blood rained down, each one carrying the power to destroy worlds, capable of obliterating a whole galaxy. This brought despair to all living beings within the Qianyuan Divine Province, as they felt the suffocating sense of complete destruction.
Han Li waved his hand, gathering all of White Emperor City’s flesh and blood without allowing the Qiankun Bracelet to destroy it. This was the supreme blood and flesh, all of it an exceedingly precious treasure.
Violently annihilated by the True Immortal weapon, every principle and mark within White Emperor City’s flesh had perished, leaving behind nothing but pure energy. To the ordinary cultivators of the Heaven Imperial Realm and below, this was equivalent to supreme imperial medicine.
“You little shit, you think you can strut in front of your ancestors without any real substance?”
“Heh, you think you’re worthy of challenging me?”
Han Li collected the flesh and blood of White Emperor City into his System Space, his Divine Sense surged forth, searching the surroundings, yet no trace of White Emperor City’s storage treasures could be found, causing his brows to slightly furrow.
White Emperor City had fallen; logically, its inheritance should have been his own, but now he could not find White Emperor City’s legacy.
