“No need to search any longer. White Emperor City did not bring any storage treasures here.”
At that moment, the Empress of the Phoenix Moon spoke, her tone surprised as her beautiful eyes fixed steadfastly onto Han Li, as if trying to see through him.
The Empress of the Phoenix Moon had never imagined that Han Li would actually bring out a second True Immortal weapon. She, along with Empress Yuanchu, was so shocked that they failed to react in time to assist White Emperor City, resulting in White Emperor City’s annihilation by Han Li’s True Immortal weapon, even to the point where all its flesh and blood were taken.
The True Immortal weapon, Wuxian Palace, and the three other True Immortal weapons brought by White Emperor City were entangled by Han Li’s immortal weapons, unable to assist in time. The Artifact Spirits of the four immortal weapons had not expected that Han Li would have another True Immortal weapon, nor its sudden lethal move, which led to the death and vanishing of White Emperor City’s spirit.
Meanwhile, the fourth Heavenly Immortal weapon unleashed by White Emperor City struck the Qiankun Bracelet and nearly shattered. It was just an ordinary Heavenly Immortal weapon.
If it hadn’t been for that Heavenly Immortal weapon’s momentary obstruction, White Emperor City wouldn’t have made it billions of miles away and would have been crushed to death by the Qiankun Bracelet much sooner.
The Empress of the Phoenix Moon heaved a sigh, her expression complex as she looked at Han Li.
Although she detested White Emperor City, she had not expected White Emperor City to die here—it was only supposed to test Han Li’s true capabilities.
White Emperor City was arrogant, confident in its superior cultivation and deeper foundation compared to Han Li, and failed to take Han Li seriously. It was this careless oversight at the critical moment that lead to its current grim fate.
If White Emperor City had regarded Han Li with due seriousness, being cautious and asking them to join forces against him, even Han Li with his two True Immortal weapons and three Heavenly Immortal weapons could not have withstood them.
As one of the nine supreme beings of the Yuankun Domain, the Empress of the Phoenix Moon knew White Emperor City rather well.
White Emperor City had cultivated to the level of True Immortal scriptures, mastered numerous Immortal Grade Martial Skills, and even entered the Divine Sense domain. Its Primordial Spirit and physical body were both at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, its combat ability was incredibly powerful, almost reaching Heavenly Immortal status.
The supreme beings at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm might seem only a step away from becoming a Heavenly Immortal, but the difference in strength is vast. Dozens or even hundreds of such supreme beings would not necessarily match up to a single Heavenly Immortal.
The Heaven Imperial Realm is merely the last Big Realm of the second step in cultivation, whereas Heavenly Immortal is the first Big Realm of the third step in cultivation, and the distance between them is like a chasm.
The key lies in whether one can transcend the Immortal Tribulation. After transcending it, the Mana within one’s body is transformed into immortal power, one’s physique evolves into a genuine Immortal Body, and the principles one has mastered evolve into corresponding great laws. The physical body, Primordial Spirit, and so forth, all receive terrifying enhancements…
From the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm to Heavenly Immortal, all aspects of one’s strength soar by many multiples. A Heavenly Immortal can easily overpower a supreme being at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm with a single palm strike.
If a supreme being at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm progresses further, reaching the combat ability of the Heavenly Immortal realm and transforming into a Battle Immortal, and then transcends the Immortal Tribulation, they will emerge with far greater prowess than an ordinary Heavenly Immortal upon achieving immortality.
When a Battle Immortal cultivates to the peak of the Heavenly Immortal realm, their combat ability could potentially reach the True Immortal realm, and even if not, they would at least qualify to strive for it with diligence, possibly stepping into it.
Here, a Battle Immortal refers to a supreme being at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm who, without relying on external forces like immortal weapons (for example), uses Secret Techniques, Martial Skills, invokes Divine Sense, among other abilities, to match a Heavenly Immortal in combat power.
Like her, like Empress Yuanchu, and like White Emperor City and other supreme beings, their combat abilities have not reached the realm of Heavenly Immortal without relying on immortal weapons.
They are all supreme beings at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, trying to cross this chasm. The gap between the two Big Realms is so immense that even the nine supreme beings have been accumulating their foundations, aiming to break through in one fell swoop.
With the aid of immortal weapons, their combat ability could naturally reach the level of Heavenly Immortals, but this is of no use—they don’t need such false Battle Immortals. Their goal is to have Golden Immortal Battle Power at the peak of True Immortals in the future, so they cannot afford any mistakes in their steps towards becoming immortals. They must reach the level of Battle Immortals first.
“Then it seems I’ll just have to make a trip to Taibai Divine Province, seize White Emperor City’s inheritance for myself, and take over White Emperor City as well,” Han Li said with a smile, exuding a strong sense of confidence.
“Han Li, you don’t think that by killing White Emperor City, you can scare us off, do you? We still have unfinished business,” Empress Yuanchu said, her voice bearing a smile that was not quite a smile as she looked at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - 244: Daring to Contend with Me? Supreme Being vs. Heavenly Immortal! The Reckoning Begins! The Astonishing Transformation of the Female Bodhisattva_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 624: Chapter 244: Daring to Contend with Me? Supreme Being vs. Heavenly Immortal! The Reckoning Begins! The Astonishing Transformation of the Female Bodhisattva_2
Empress Yuanchu donned Silver Immortal Armor, which beautifully showcased her exquisite and curvaceous figure. The Silver Long Spear in her hand made her appear even more valiant and exceptional, unrivaled in beauty and poise.
Although Bai Yujing had perished, the scores between her and Han Li still had to be settled.
Han Li had dared to defile her divided soul, which was an affront to her, the Empress Yuanchu. If Han Li were not executed on the spot, how could she uphold her majesty?
With a mere thought, a great bell materialized above Empress Yuanchu’s head, entirely Xuanhuang in color and exuding a thick and domineering aura of immortal presence. This was a True Immortal weapon forged from Xuanhuang Immortal Gold, and it even embodied the Xuanhuang Path at the True Immortal tier.
It could be said that the material and Path of the Xuanhuang Bell were in perfect harmony, unleashing an incredibly potent force, surpassing even the Wuxian Palace.
Before the coming of Han Li’s Emperor Flag, the Xuanhuang Bell was acclaimed as one of the top three True Immortal weapons in the Endless Yuankun Domain. Even after the Emperor Flag had emerged, the Xuanhuang Bell remained a strong contender for the top three.
“You no longer have a chance,” declared the Empress of Huangyue, her tone indifferent once again.
So Bai Yujing was dead; their primary purpose for coming here was to settle accounts with Han Li. Even if they could not vanquish him, they intended to extract a hefty toll.
She had brought one True Immortal weapon and three Heavenly Immortal weapons with her, and Empress Yuanchu had done the same. Although the Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain were somewhat more profound than White Emperor City, they still had to suppress their own divided souls and be on guard against other enemies, not daring to mobilize their full strength.
Han Li possessed only two True Immortal weapons and three Heavenly Immortal weapons; he could not withstand a joint attack by her and Empress Yuanchu.
Besides, though Bai Yujing was gone, the True Immortal weapon and four Heavenly Immortal weapons that he had brought with him remained and were likely to ally with them for vengeance, considering their next moves only after the battle.
This left Han Li with even less of a chance.
“Is that so?”
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, radiating divine brilliance, like a sun god illuminating the nine heavens and ten earths, dazzling and captivating.
Facing a combined assault from two peerless empresses, he now had but a single True Immortal weapon, the Qiankun Bracelet, yet Han Li remained calm and composed.
The pupils of Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu contracted slightly, unsure of their assessment. Was Han Li merely feigning strength and composure, or did he truly possess a formidable foundation?
Surely Han Li did not have yet another True Immortal weapon?!
In fact, the two peerless empresses were mistaken.
Han Li did not have just one more True Immortal weapon, but two; it was just that he could not yet reveal the Emperor Flag.
Having used the Emperor Flag to commit his deeds, he had raised a storm across the Endless Yuankun Domain, putting every major power in fear for their safety. If his identity were exposed, it might provoke all the forces of the Heavenly Governing Realm and the strongest powers to unite against him in collective hatred, to exterminate him.
Chengsheng Mountain currently lacked an invincible foundation and could not withstand the onslaught of all the Emperor Level forces of the Yuankun Domain.
Yandao Divine Province, Tianji Pavilion.
“Bai Yujing just died like that?” Emperor Tianji was shocked.
He had only expended resources equivalent to two Heavenly Immortal weapons, whereas Bai Yujing had suffered far more. His physical body had exploded, his Primordial Spirit had shattered, and he had met his end at the hands of Han Li.
“No, it seems Bai Yujing is not entirely dead?”
Emperor Tianji hurriedly employed the Heavenly Path Roulette to deduce once more and, with a flick of his hand, an image appeared before him.
It depicted the scene within the domain of White Emperor City in Taibai Divine Province. Without the concealment of the True Immortal weapon, he was able to glimpse, albeit with some effort and without incurring significant cost, into the interior of White Emperor City’s heavenly blessed land.
In the center of the blessed land hovered a Heavenly Immortal weapon, emitting strand upon strand of immortal light, blanketing the entire heaven and earth.
Below the Heavenly Immortal weapon was a small pond filled with rich immortal nectar. In the middle of the pond was an Immortal Lotus, seemingly the legendary Creation Immortal Lotus.
“The Creation Immortal Lotus has actually fallen into the hands of Bai Yujing, tsk tsk, what a deeply hidden secret,” Emperor Tianji remarked with great sentiment.
He had now ascertained that Bai Yujing had not completely perished and was in the process of resurrection.
The Creation Immortal Lotus belonged to a splendid and prosperous force of the Ancient Era, the Ancient Immortal Court. During those ancient times, the Ancient Immortal Court had True Immortals at its helm, its might formidable and not inferior to Bai Yujing.
The Creation Immortal Lotus possessed the miraculous effect of bringing the dead back to life. Even Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals could be revived through it. The master of the Ancient Immortal Court rose to prominence with the help of the Immortal Lotus and eventually established this glittering force.
However, when the calamity of the ancient times came, the master of the Ancient Immortal Court ultimately perished and did not resurrect from the Immortal Lotus, indicating that it was not as potent as the legends suggested.
Another possibility was that the master of the Ancient Immortal Court had not died but merely vanished, which was why the Creation Immortal Lotus could not revive him.
After the demise of the Ancient Immortal Court’s master, the True Immortal weapon was lost without a trace, and only one Heavenly Immortal weapon remained, which was insufficient to protect the Creation Immortal Lotus. Consequently, the Ancient Immortal Court collapsed.
In the fierce battles that followed, the Creation Immortal Lotus disappeared. Some said it had escaped, while others claimed a supreme being had taken it. Since then, it had left no trace and was unseen for over a hundred thousand years.
Emperor Tianji believed that it was Bai Yujing who had seized the Creation Immortal Lotus. At that time, Bai Yujing had already reached the late stage of Quasi Emperor cultivation and possessed a Heavenly Immortal weapon, making him one of the strongest in that battle.
Had it not been for Bai Yujing’s unexpected death today, with most of White Emperor City’s immortal weapons engaged in combat in the Qianyuan Divine Province, and the defenses of White Emperor City’s blessed land weakened, Emperor Tianji would not have been able to discover this truth.
With a sigh, Emperor Tianji waved his hand to make the image vanish, lest the resurrecting Bai Yujing become aware of it.
Although he coveted the Creation Immortal Lotus, Bai Yujing was not yet fully gone, and the foundation of White Emperor City remained intact. Unable to seize it, he had no choice but to give up and wait for another opportunity.

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - 244: Daring to Contend with Me? Supreme Being vs. Heavenly Immortal! The Reckoning Begins! The Astonishing Transformation of the Female Bodhisattva_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 625: Chapter 244: Daring to Contend with Me? Supreme Being vs. Heavenly Immortal! The Reckoning Begins! The Astonishing Transformation of the Female Bodhisattva_3
On the other side, the Western Sky Palace Master and the Butian Sect Master had recovered from their shock and dumbfounded state, their expressions extremely grave.
The worst-case scenario had occurred, with the Longevity Great Emperor Han Li actually possessing a second True Immortal weapon. Now, their hopes of snatching the inheritance of Chengsheng Mountain had become much more difficult.
With two True Immortal weapons in hand, along with three Heavenly Immortal weapons, Han Li was basically unable to die. Even if the Empress Huangyue, Empress Yuanchu, and the five immortal weapons of White Emperor City joined forces, it wouldn’t be enough.
Even if the two supreme beings intervened directly, with the protection of the five immortal weapons, Han Li had a great chance to retreat with his whole body, of course, at the expense of forsaking Chengsheng Mountain.
This was something that neither the Western Sky Palace Master nor the Butian Sect Master were willing to do. Even if they partitioned Chengsheng Mountain, it would be of no use. As long as Han Li was still alive, they would face retribution.
Even as a single supreme power on their own, they couldn’t withstand an attack from Han Li, after all, that would mean facing two True Immortal weapons and three Heavenly Immortal weapons.
Thus, after weighing the pros and cons, the Western Sky Palace Master and the Butian Sect Master sighed and decided not to intervene. They would let Empress Huangyue, Empress Yuanchu, and Han Li fight it out, truly becoming spectators.
It wasn’t just them. Other once-interested supreme forces such as the Solar Empire, the Longevity Qin Family, and the Longevity Jiang Family also gave up and chose to completely stay out of the fray.
Qianyuan Divine Province.
Bai Yujing, Xumi Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain, Penglai Immortal Sect, and other Great Holy Land Schools had been watching the battle the whole time, using their Heavenly Immortal weapons to block the aftermath. However, they were now trembling with fear.
One by one, they felt a deep sense of relief. Fortunately, they had retreated during the great battle in the Barbarian Region two years ago, allowing Chengsheng Mountain to rise and Han Li to take a position of advantage over them; otherwise, they and their respective Great Holy Land Schools would have been finished.
With two True Immortal weapons and three Heavenly Immortal weapons in Han Li’s possession, even if the seven Great Holy Land Schools joined hands, they couldn’t withstand the assault, and their inevitable end would be destruction.
Atop Xumi Mountain,
The female Bodhisattva wore a complicated expression, her stunningly beautiful face clouded with gloom, her legs involuntarily clenching together.
For the past two years, she had constantly been guarding against Han Li climbing Xumi Mountain to coerce her into marriage, and she had been terrified.
The female Bodhisattva worried day and night, her mind constantly filled with the thought of when Han Li might suddenly arrive.
This caused her to develop a very complex perspective on Han Li, after all, he occupied her thoughts day and night, constantly, for two years.
At this moment, as she watched Han Li wield the Qiankun Bracelet to kill the White Emperor, who had shaken the Endless Yuankun Domain for a hundred thousand years, the female Bodhisattva felt a wetness, and a different thought suddenly rose in her heart.
“I might as well just give in to him. He’s too strong, I can’t withstand it, I really can’t withstand it…”
No sooner had this thought emerged than it became unstoppable. The female Bodhisattva’s fair face quickly flushed, two red clouds emerged, and a pink hue spread over her snow-white swan neck, reaching all the way to her reddened ears.
Unconsciously, as she looked at the majestic and invincible Han Li, the female Bodhisattva began to feel a sense of anticipation.
When would Han Li climb Xumi Mountain, climb her, the female Bodhisattva?
In the past, she had been repulsed, not wanting Han Li to come; but now, she anticipated his arrival, impatient for Han Li to come and fiercely conquer her.
In the heavens above,
Han Li confronted both Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu.
The People’s Path Sword, Primordial Chaos Cauldron, Yin Yang Mirror, and the Ruyi Knife—the four immortal weapons of Chengsheng Mountain—were still in battle, being held back by the immortal weapons of White Emperor City.
“Being stubborn is useless,” said Empress Yuanchu with a cold snort, ready to make a move as the Xuanhuang Bell shone with bright immortal light.
“Putting on airs won’t save you from our reckoning,” said Empress Huangyue, her expression icy as she too prepared to act. A lamp appeared above her head, the lamp oil golden as if fueled by the world itself. The light was not very bright, but it seemed capable of dispersing the mists of time and illuminating the eternal night.
The True Immortal weapon of Huangyue Imperial Empire: the Combustion Lamp!
“Not only is my mouth hard, but there’s another place that’s very hard too. Don’t you want to try it out?” Han Li teased with a laugh, not waiting for the two Empresses to respond, and added, “While your mouths may not be hard, there is a place on your bodies that is.”
“You’re courting death!”
The fury of Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu erupted as the Xuanhuang Bell and the Burning Lamp unleashed their power, ready to strike Han Li down.
Just then, a wail that crossed through space and time came through.
“Han Li, I will never let you go!”
PS: The second update is complete!

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - 245: Taking Advantage of the Fire, White Emperor City is Attacked! Han Laozu, the Supreme Treasure Master! A Battle that Shook the World Finally Ends!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 626: Chapter 245: Taking Advantage of the Fire, White Emperor City is Attacked! Han Laozu, the Supreme Treasure Master! A Battle that Shook the World Finally Ends!_1
“Indeed, the White Emperor has been resurrected.”
“Tsk tsk, one wonders if the White Emperor dares to go to Qianyuan Divine Province again to settle scores with Han Li?”
Inside Tianji Pavilion, Emperor Tianji stroked his chin with his right hand, talking to himself.
He believed that the White Emperor wouldn’t dare.
Despite the White Emperor’s loud threats, there was a sense of bluster beneath weakness. The battle had greatly damaged his reputation and served to enhance that of Great Emperor Han Li.
If Han Li could escape unscathed from the hands of Empress Huangyu and Empress Yuanchu, then the power structure of the Endless Yuankun Domain would change.
From then on, the Endless Yuankun Domain would have ten supremely powerful forces, with Chengsheng Mountain and Great Emperor Han Li held in the highest regard.
Who could blame Han Li when he possessed two True Immortal weapons?
Considering the current situation, Han Li must have a significant amount of Immortal Qi to recklessly sustain the resurrection and battle readiness of two True Immortal weapons and three Heavenly Immortal weapons.
As long as Han Li’s supply of Immortal Qi persisted, his status and that of Chengsheng Mountain would remain unshakable, and any lack of foundation in certain aspects would be filled over time.
On the other hand,
“The White Emperor hasn’t died?” The Butian Sect Master was taken aback, a strand of Divine Sense arriving outside Taibai Divine Province to spy.
“How is that possible? A full-strength blow from a True Immortal weapon would cause even a Heavenly Immortal to die or be gravely wounded on impact, but the White Emperor was just a sovereign.”
The master of Western Sky Palace was also shocked, the White Emperor’s resurrection being too unexpected.
They were both owners of True Immortal weapons and extremely aware of the terrifying power of True Immortal weapons, a hit to a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor would result in certain death.
Even if a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor’s body bore countless Dao patterns and their Primordial Spirit carried their martial arts, they would still perish and their spirit dissipated, even their True Spirit would be extinguished.
“Creation Immortal Lotus?!”
Suddenly, both the Butian Sect Master and the master of Western Sky Palace exclaimed in unison.
Apart from the Creation Immortal Lotus, they could think of no other treasure capable of resurrecting a cultivator from the dead, and there was only one of its kind in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
“It seems that during the battle for the Ancient Immortal Court’s destruction, the White Emperor seized the greatest benefits,” the master of Western Sky Palace lamented.
“The White Emperor has kept it very well hidden.”
The Butian Sect Master’s eyes were profound, his face carrying a shade of gloom.
The Heavenly Cult also had a Quasi Emperor wielding a Heavenly Immortal weapon who participated in that battle, jointly destroying the Ancient Immortal Court and engaging in a fierce battle with the White Emperor, managing to plunder some of the court’s foundations, which included scriptures, Immortal Stones, Immortal Qi, Immortal Elixirs, and so on.
“Damn it!”
The Butian Sect Master cursed inwardly. The Creation Immortal Lotus could have potentially fallen into his hands; it was all the White Emperor’s fault.
He was remarkable from a young age, his talents unparalleled. When he was at the True Martial Realm, he was chased into a perilous place within the Yuankun Domain, where he accidentally discovered a True Immortal weapon and, after enduring numerous hardships, passed the test.
Afterward, he became the posthumous disciple of the fallen True Immortal, received the True Immortal’s inheritance, inherited the True Immortal weapon, and from then on rose to prominence within the Endless Yuankun Domain.
The Butian Sect Master was ruthless and ambitious, craving higher status and more resources to aid his cultivation, but the existing Butian Sect Master, the Quasi Emperor, did not comply and instead focused on nurturing his own descendants. This eventually incensed the incumbent Butian Sect Master.
When an opportunity arose, the Butian Sect Master had the True Immortal weapon strike, killing the Quasi Emperor, annihilating all cultivators from that lineage, and successfully assumed the role of Sect Hierarch.
If the White Emperor had not obtained the Creation Immortal Lotus back then, it would have been his after killing the former Sect Hierarch.
The master of Western Sky Palace noticed the Butian Sect Master’s expression, remaining unshaken. He was well aware of the Butian Sect Master’s past.
As birds of a feather flock together, he was no better a person. The two had worked together in the shadows to ensure the swift rise and expansion of both Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult.
“We might not be able to carve up Chengsheng Mountain. How about going to White Emperor City?” the Butian Sect Master suggested with a smile.
“Let’s go!”
The master of Western Sky Palace agreed without hesitation.
They preferred dealing with White Emperor City and the White Emperor, who were much weaker compared to the peak state, and the extremely powerful Chengsheng Mountain and Han Li.
After all, White Emperor City was in its most vulnerable state. The White Emperor needed time to recover to his peak condition, and most of White Emperor City’s Immortal weapons were in Qianyuan Divine Province for the war; their home base was emptily exposed, making it ripe for their machinations.
White Emperor City was far wealthier than Chengsheng Mountain, making it a lucrative target to plunder. Not only could they recover the losses from a recent mystery marauder, but they could also make a huge profit.
Moreover, both sovereigns were greatly coveting the Creation Immortal Lotus in White Emperor City.
The Longevity Qin Family, Longevity Jiang Family, and Solar Empire, the three major supremely powerful forces, had also made their choices, wanting to take advantage of White Emperor City’s crisis. The timing couldn’t be better.
Among them were individuals who had dealings with the White Emperor, but friendships were one thing and interests were another. If they did not act, other powerful forces would, and White Emperor City would ultimately not escape this calamity.
Nobody felt any shame about it; this was how they had all come up. White Emperor City’s current status was also achieved through plundering and dividing the legacy of other great forces at opportune times.
In Taibai Divine Province, within White Emperor City.
The blessed land of White Emperor City was known as “Taibai Immortal Realm”, atop the massive tree in the western district of the city, spiraling like a vast river of stars.
It was also one of the beautiful sights of White Emperor City.
At this moment, within the Taibai Secret Realm.
By the central pool, the White Emperor stood tall, with the Creation Immortal Lotus behind him, his face etched with shock, unwillingness, anger, resentment, and various other emotions.
“This is just too damn treacherous.”
Recalling the last moment when he was ambushed by Han Li using the True Immortal weapon, leading to his death and the dispersal of his spirit, the White Emperor was filled with indignant fury; he had almost had victory in his grasp.

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - 245: Taking Advantage of the Fire, White Emperor City is Attacked! Han Laozu, the Supreme Treasure Master! A Battle that Shook the World Finally Ends!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 627: Chapter 245: Taking Advantage of the Fire, White Emperor City is Attacked! Han Laozu, the Supreme Treasure Master! A Battle that Shook the World Finally Ends!_2
Han Li really lived up to his reputation as the supreme master of dodging; he was too cunning, and even I, the magnificent White Emperor, fell for it and capsized in the gutter.
If Han Li had revealed his foundation with two True Immortal weapons hanging high, I would never have provoked Han Li, and both the Empress Fengyue and Empress Yuanchu would have considered carefully.
But Han Li just had to hide it, is there any sense in that?
Thinking of Han Li’s intelligence, a wave of frustration washed over me. I had been too careless, thinking that the three supremes working together could easily take care of Han Li, but it turned out to be a miscalculation; Han Li was just too good at dodging.
In despising Han Li’s underhandedness, I also came to resent the two peerless empresses, Empress Fengyue and Empress Yuanchu.
Had they not stood by passively, I would not have ended up like this, ambushed and killed by Han Li.
The damn culprit was clearly Han Li!
If only Empress Fengyue and Empress Yuanchu had joined forces, even with Han Li’s two True Immortal weapons, they would have hoped to annihilate Han Li.
“Don’t let me catch an opportunity.”
A cold gleam flashed in my eyes. If Empress Fengyue and Empress Yuanchu fell into a tight spot, I would not hesitate to plunder amidst the chaos, to force the issue.
I’m fed up with this kind of loss; having made a fool of myself today, it’s obviously impossible to catch up with Empress Fengyue through normal means and possess her.
White Emperor roared, and his angry voice traveled to Qianyuan Divine Province, startling the three about to engage in fierce combat.
But I had no intention of going to support Empress Fengyue and Empress Yuanchu; let the two peerless empresses fight Han Li. It would be best if they both suffered, then perhaps I could profit from their misfortune.
I had lost too much already; I didn’t want to lose even more. Even if I went in support, I wasn’t guaranteed to kill Han Li; I might just further deplete my resources.
I had developed a phobia towards Han Li; worried that damn cur was still hiding something up his sleeve. Who knew if he would produce a third True Immortal weapon?
If he ambushes me again, then my death will truly be certain.
Better to recuperate and maybe catch the mantis stalking the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.
Thinking of today’s losses, a terrifyingly dark expression occupied my face, as if droplets might seep out of it.
Activating one True Immortal weapon and four Heavenly Immortal weapons for combat depleted much of my Immortal Qi and Immortal Stones, and the fourth, a staff-like Heavenly Immortal weapon, was even crippled, requiring a vast amount of resources to repair.
Moreover, my body is gone, the one I painstakingly cultivated for over a hundred thousand years using endless resources, immensely powerful; in the Endless Yuankun Domain, there were no more than three who could rival me in terms of physical might.
Additionally, the exposure of the Creation Immortal Lotus has brought plenty of trouble, not to mention the massive resources consumed for my resurrection.
The Creation Immortal Lotus is a top-level True Immortal Medicine and a special spiritual root. By engraving all of oneself into the Creation Immortal Lotus—body, Primordial Spirit, True Spirit, martial path, and more—one can resurrect from the Creation Immortal Lotus in a very short time after death.
I glanced at the pond behind me, now dry. This was the price of my resurrection; although the pond seemed small, the resources it condensed were massive. Aside from the few Immortal weapons, this pond’s water could compare to one-eighth of White Emperor City’s foundation.
This made me incredibly heartache. Once I advance to Heavenly Immortal, the foundation of White Emperor City won’t be sufficient for a single resurrection, and I would have to accumulate slowly.
Redirecting my gaze, my Divine Sense communicated with the Heavenly Immortal weapon in the sky above, instructing it to notify the five Immortal weapons in Qianyuan Divine Province to return to White Emperor City promptly.
My aura continued to climb swiftly, already restored to the Tongxuan Realm. In another breath, my cultivation would return to the Saint Abyss Realm, in five breaths the Quasi Emperor field, in thirty breaths the Heaven Imperial Realm, and only in a hundred breaths will I be able to fully recover my peak strength.
These hundred breaths are when I am most vulnerable, and I need strong protection to avoid any accidents. Powers like the Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult, as well as other supreme forces, may take advantage of this.
Currently, the defenses of White Emperor City are weak. Only when the five Immortal weapons return will White Emperor City be secure as a bastion, and other supreme powers won’t dare to covet it.
“Good~”
The Artifact Spirit of the Heavenly Immortal weapon responded heavily, immediately notifying the five Immortal weapons far away in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Half a breath later, my expression drastically changed.
Even hidden within the Taibai Immortal Realm, I could feel a terrifying oppression descending; it was the aura of True Immortal weapons, and not just one piece.
They arrived so quickly!
My complexion worsened, yet I didn’t dare go out to confront it; I couldn’t withstand it.
With a thought, White Emperor City revived, acting as another Heavenly Immortal weapon, also arranged with an Immortal Array. Their cooperation should be able to buy some time.
“In a moment, just protect me and the important treasures and resources.”
That instant, I said to the Heavenly Immortal weapon.
If the Wuxian Palace and other Immortal weapons cannot return in time, White Emperor City is definitely going to suffer heavy losses today.
Outside, several figures descended, each with a True Immortal weapon hovering above their heads, dominating Taibai Divine Province.
These supremes and their True Immortal weapons were all shrouded in a layer of Immortal light, concealing their identities.
Boom!
Several True Immortal weapons struck at once, shattering the Immortal Array of White Emperor City, which was then suppressed, lost all potency, and began to fall downwards.
The Western Sky Palace Master, Butian Sect Master, and others wasted no time, wielding True Immortal weapons as they broke into the Taibai Secret Realm to begin their plundering.
The supremes had just broken in when the Wuxian Palace and the other five Immortal weapons returned, immediately rushing into the Taibai Secret Realm, fully unleashing their firepower.
Though it was only for an instant, the five supremes had already succeeded, each grabbing a part of White Emperor City’s foundation. The five True Immortal weapons struck together, driving back Wuxian Palace and the other Heavenly Immortal weapons and vanishing from sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - 245: Taking Advantage of the Fire, White Emperor City is Attacked! Han Laozu, the Supreme Treasure Master! A Battle that Shook the World Finally Ends!_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 628: Chapter 245: Taking Advantage of the Fire, White Emperor City is Attacked! Han Laozu, the Supreme Treasure Master! A Battle that Shook the World Finally Ends!_3
The five Supreme Beings came swiftly and left just as quickly, leaving behind a messy Taibai Immortal Realm, while the White Emperor watched indifferently under the guard of the Heavenly Immortal soldiers.
None of the five Supreme Beings had intended to lay a finger on him, there was no need; they were here to rob, and attacking the White Emperor would be obstructed by the Heavenly Immortal weapon. Dealing with the Heavenly Immortal weapon would take some time, by which the other immortal weapons of White Emperor City would have returned.
The White Emperor’s expression was icy, his gaze sweeping across the Taibai Immortal Realm, his heart ablaze with towering rage.
The losses this time were too great!
White Emperor City had already expended much of its foundation, and now after being plundered, its resources weren’t even a third of what they were yesterday; most had been stolen.
As the five Supreme Beings burst in, a single Heavenly Immortal weapon could only barely protect him and some core resources and treasures. The rest was practically swept away by the five Supreme Beings.
“Damn it all!”
After a long silence, the White Emperor could not help but curse out loud.
He absolutely believed Han Li was bad luck incarnate, that he shouldn’t have provoked Han Li. Now that he had suffered greatly, he decided to keep his distance from Han Li in the future, not considering revenge unless he was absolutely certain of success.
Following this looting, White Emperor City had lost most of its foundation, and for many years to come, it would have to lie low, waiting for the opportunity to take revenge one by one.
Although the five Supreme Beings had concealed their identities, not even revealing their True Immortal weapons, the White Emperor still had a rough idea of who they were.
After all, there were only so many Supreme Beings in the Endless Yuankun Domain; including Han Li and that mysterious powerful being from over a decade ago, there were only eleven in total.
Han Li was still in Qianyuan Divine Province; the mysterious powerful being likely also did not come, otherwise White Emperor City would have fared even worse, implying that Emperor Tianji, the master of Western Sky Palace, the Butian Sect Master, and the other six Supreme Beings were responsible for this crime.
……
Qianyuan Divine Province.
Han Li was battling the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu.
The roar from the White Emperor had caught all three by surprise a moment ago.
None of the two peerless empresses had expected the White Emperor to still be alive, no wonder the five immortal weapons of White Emperor City were still engaged in battle here—they intended to avenge the White Emperor.
The Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu’s thoughts were as quick as lightning, understanding everything in an instant, realizing that the White Emperor had obtained the Creation Immortal Lotus.
However, the two peerless empresses didn’t care much about it; their purpose today was to settle scores with Han Li, to make him pay the price.
Even if they wanted to go to White Emperor City to get a share of the loot, it was too late; as soon as they left, the five immortal weapons including the Wuxian Palace would return instantly to White Emperor City, giving them no chance.
Consequently, the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu launched their attacks on Han Li, resolving to finish him off before anything else.
The White Emperor was not dead, which came as a shock to Han Li, who did not know the secrets of the Creation Immortal Lotus, but he quickly regained his composure. If the White Emperor did not die, then Han Li would just find the opportunity to kill him later; he did not believe the White Emperor could come back from the dead.
At that time, he would watch over the body himself to see whether the White Emperor could revive and what secrets lay hidden.
Time was on his side, and as the years went by, his strength would grow more and more boundless, far beyond what any creature in the Yuankun Domain could imagine.
Facing the onslaught of the two empresses, Han Li was unfazed, his expression calm. The Qiankun Bracelet flew out, colliding with the Xuanhuang Bell and the Burning Lamp, an intense battle ensuing.
Seeing their own True Immortal weapons held at bay, the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu were unconcerned. All they needed was to suppress Han Li’s Qiankun Bracelet.
All their Heavenly Immortal weapons were unleashed, a total of six Heavenly Immortal weapons waking up to their full potential, bombarding Han Li with their attack.
The golden-armored Empress of Phoenix Moon stood firm on the left side of the firmament, while the silver-armored Empress Yuanchu stood on the right, both displaying peerless grace and unparalleled beauty that rivaled true Heavenly Fairies.
They were like the most dazzling supernovae in the Ninth Heaven, shining the brightest light, illuminating the entire Endless Yuankun Domain.
The two peerless empresses watched Han Li with chill in their eyes, cold light flashing within, for Han Li had not only defiled their clones but also brazenly flirted with them face-to-face.
The White Emperor may tolerate it, but they would not!
They were eager to see whether Han Li still had any trump cards left, what he could use to withstand the attack of the six Heavenly Immortal weapons?
With Han Li’s True Immortal weapons and Heavenly Immortal weapons all tied up, unable to come to his aid, if he couldn’t block them he would die.
Yet, the lesson from the White Emperor was still fresh in the minds of the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu, who were prepared for any contingencies.
If Han Li brought out a third True Immortal weapon, the six Heavenly Immortal weapons would block it, then the Empress of Phoenix Moon’s Burning Lamp would engage the Qiankun Bracelet, while Empress Yuanchu’s Xuanhuang Bell would strike at Han Li.
They believed it was unlikely for Han Li to wield a third True Immortal weapon, thinking it more probable that he’d continue using Heavenly Immortal weapons instead.
Indeed, Han Li did not deploy a third True Immortal weapon, for although he possessed one, he couldn’t afford to use it for the time being, lest it attracted great trouble.
Two True Immortal weapons would make the nine most powerful forces wary but not reckless; if he revealed a third, it would heighten their wariness to a great extent.
Under the influence of Empress Yuanchu, the Empress of Phoenix Moon, and the White Emperor, it was possible that they could join forces and eliminate him and Chengsheng Mountain together.
That would not only remove a thorn in their side but also allow them to carve up the legacy of Chengsheng Mountain; they would revel in that opportunity.
With only three True Immortal weapons and one quasi-True Immortal weapon, the Human Path Sword, totaling four, he was not yet invincible in the Yuankun Domain and couldn’t suppress every power, so he still needed to bide his time.
In time, when he had enough True Immortal weapons to suppress all opposing forces, that would be when Han Li, the great ancestor, could swagger openly.

chapters.title: Chapter 629 - 245: Taking Advantage of the Fire, White Emperor City is Attacked! Han Laozu, the Supreme Treasure Master! A Battle that Shook the World Finally Ends!_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 629: Chapter 245: Taking Advantage of the Fire, White Emperor City is Attacked! Han Laozu, the Supreme Treasure Master! A Battle that Shook the World Finally Ends!_4
By then, the likes of Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu, along with other Heaven Imperial Realm empresses and female Quasi Emperors from the Yuankun Domain, would all have to submit to his favor.
When the six Heavenly Immortal weapons attacked, Han Li directly deployed three Heavenly Immortal weapons, leaving behind the last two True Immortal weapons as reserves.
The three Heavenly Immortal weapons were the Immortal Extinguishing Sword, the Immortal Beating Whip, and the Immortal Locking Pillar. The latter two were Supreme Grade Heavenly Immortal weapons, capable of blocking the six Heavenly Immortal weapons wielded by Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu. They also only had two Supreme Grade Heavenly Immortal weapons each.
As Han Li had anticipated, his three Heavenly Immortal weapons, once revived, successfully blocked the attack from the six Heavenly Immortal weapons of the two unparalleled empresses. Although at a disadvantage, no attack reached Han Li himself.
All of this was within Han Li’s calculations. If there were any mishaps, the Emperor Flag wouldn’t move, and the other True Immortal weapon would revive in an instant and block all attacks. At that point, he wouldn’t care about anything else.
Now, he didn’t need to go that far.
Since the White Emperor wasn’t dead, the five Immortal weapons of White Emperor City would soon return to White Emperor City. They wouldn’t stay long in the Qianyuan Divine Province. Otherwise, with White Emperor City defenseless, it might face a great calamity.
With White Emperor City’s five Heavenly Immortal weapons gone, his Qiankun Bracelet, Human Path Sword, and another six Heavenly Immortal weapons would be enough to block the Immortal weapons of Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu. They would not be able to do anything to him.
Looking at the unscathed Han Li, both Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu frowned slightly, their pupils constricting.
They had thought Han Li would only take out a Heavenly Immortal weapon to defend desperately. Instead, Han Li directly deployed three Heavenly Immortal weapons. Including those engaged in battle, Han Li had already brought out six Heavenly Immortal weapons.
Just how many Immortal weapons did Han Li have?
At this thought, the two unparalleled empresses both felt a tremor in their hearts.
Han Li dominated the strongest nine forces with True Immortal weapons, and even on the front of Heavenly Immortal weapons, he was comparable to the three most powerful forces. It was too shocking, too unbelievable.
Had they not seen it with their own eyes, the two unparalleled empresses would not have believed that a cultivator could amass such a powerful force, deemed the first in the Endless Yuankun Domain, in just three hundred years.
However, Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu still sighed in relief, thankful that Han Li didn’t have a third True Immortal weapon. The threat of a True Immortal weapon was much greater than that of three Heavenly Immortal weapons.
“Don’t think this means we have no way to deal with you,” Empress Yuanchu scoffed coldly, closing in with her Silver Long Spear, which was her lifebound Emperor weapon and a Supreme Grade weapon.
Empress Huang Yue also advanced with her golden long spear, which was her lifebound Emperor weapon, equally Supreme Grade, “No one can save you today.”
The two unparalleled empresses gradually closed in, their powerful auras pressing down, seeking to suppress Han Li.
Han Li remained calm and said with a smile, “If you push too hard, it’s going to hurt when I fight back.”
“I’d advise you to keep your distance from me. Don’t force me to take up arms.”
Although he couldn’t use the Emperor Flag and the other True Immortal weapon, Han Li was fearless. He had a large number of Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapons, enough to block or even suppress Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu.
He felt he should add another title to his name, aside from the Eternal Great Emperor and the Supreme Dao Lord:
The True·Supreme Treasure Lord!
“Han Li, do you realize how utterly annoying you look?” Empress Huang Yue frowned deeply, very much disliking Han Li’s composed appearance.
From beginning to end, Han Li had maintained this demeanor, which gradually eroded Empress Huang Yue’s confidence.
“I find it extremely irritating as well.”
Empress Yuanchu huffed coldly, her Silver Long Spear slicing through the air, as she and Empress Huang Yue attacked Han Li together.
At Han Li’s thought, four Supreme Grade Emperor weapons and six Top Grade Emperor weapons appeared above his head, all fully revived, charging towards the two empresses.
In his hand materialized a Supreme Grade Emperor Sword, and right in front of him a Supreme Grade defensive Emperor weapon, while he wore a Supreme Grade Emperor garment. He spoke indifferently:
“So what if you find me annoying? What can you do to me?”
“You’ll like it in the future,” Han Li said calmly, still surveying the two unparalleled empresses’ stunning figures.
“Dammit!”
Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu were both furious but with ten Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapons surrounding them, even their remarkable combat abilities couldn’t break free immediately.
Before their arrival, they hadn’t anticipated so many unforeseen situations. They had only brought four Immortal weapons. Apart from their lifebound Emperor weapons, they hadn’t brought the other Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapons, leading to their current predicament.
Seizing the opportunity, Han Li crept silently closer, his sword aimed at the back of Empress Yuanchu’s head, but it was promptly blocked.
He vanished from sight, leaving Empress Huang Yue tensely on guard. Han Li again appeared behind Empress Yuanchu for a sneak attack but still did not succeed.
Han Li disappeared once more, this time attacking Empress Huang Yue by surprise, and again without success.
This made Han Li sigh deeply. These two women, worthy of the title unparalleled empresses, had astonishing combat abilities; he simply couldn’t best them.
After battling fiercely for a while, the Wuxian Palace and the four Heavenly Immortal weapons from White Emperor City suddenly fled, and then both Han Li and the two empresses sensed that something had happened in Taibai Divine Province.
Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu broke out, rapidly exchanging innumerable messages telepathically, and after a final fierce glare at Han Li, prepared to retreat.
Previously, they had been unable to handle Han Li, and without the five Immortal weapons from White Emperor City, they stood even less of a chance. If they continued to stay, something unexpected might happen.
“Ladies, go slowly. In a few years, your husband will come knocking for your hands in marriage,” Han Li’s voice carried far, causing Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu to pause, then completely disappear from sight.
PS: Tomorrow continues with additional chapters for monthly tickets, still divided into two updates, over eight thousand words.

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - 246 First Place in the Main Ranking: Chengsheng Mountain! The Ninth Generation, Han Changsheng! New Standards for Taking a Wife and Concubines!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 630: Chapter 246 First Place in the Main Ranking: Chengsheng Mountain! The Ninth Generation, Han Changsheng! New Standards for Taking a Wife and Concubines!_1
A battle shocked the world!
In the time that followed, the information about this battle spread far and wide, leaving various powers amazed and speechless.
The battle in Qianyuan Divine Province triggered a massive upheaval within the province and throughout the entire Endless Yuankun Domain; countless cultivators felt an unbelievable suffocation upon hearing this news.
Unbeknownst to all, a colossal force had risen in the Endless Yuankun Domain—there was a new powerhouse, a new overlord.
In the midst of this atmosphere, a piece of news once again detonated throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Emperor Tianji from the Tianji Pavilion actually announced that he would create a ranking of forces, divided into a main list and a subsidiary list. The main list had only ten spots, for the ten mightiest forces. The subsidiary list would contain thirty-six spots, featuring the Heavenly Governing Forces and Quasi Emperor forces.
According to the message from Tianji Pavilion, the rankings were still being sorted, with only one spot confirmed—the very first on the main list.
Main List, First Place: Chengsheng Mountain!
After this news was released, the Endless Yuankun Domain was in turmoil, and countless cultivators debated fiercely without cease.
The Tianji Pavilion had previously not ranked the forces, fearing it would offend other formidable forces and Heavenly Governing Forces as such rankings were tricky to determine. So why suddenly decide to rank them now?
And why elevate the newly risen Chengsheng Mountain to the top spot on the main list?
First place on the main list meant that Chengsheng Mountain was now the top force in the entire Endless Yuankun Domain!
Was this a deliberate move by Tianji Pavilion or mere flattery?
Chengsheng Mountain was now on the rise, its fame shaking the Endless Yuankun Domain, with every cultivator both respecting and fearing the very mention of its name.
This was a strong, glorious, and flourishing supreme power!
In just two short years, Chengsheng Mountain had risen abruptly within Qianyuan Divine Province, suppressed Bai Yujing, Myriad Demon Mountain, Penglai Immortal Sect, and the other seven Great Holy Land Schools in the Barbarian Region, and its fame was unparalleled for a time.
Thereafter, the three formidable forces — Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, and White Emperor City — pressured Chengsheng Mountain. The Empress Huangyue, Empress Yuanchu, and the White Emperor, three supreme sovereigns, lorded over Qianyuan Divine Province, and the masses thought Chengsheng Mountain would be in big trouble; if not destroyed, it would at least suffer severe damage.
But no one expected that Chengsheng Mountain’s roots were too formidable, even stronger and deeper than the nine major forces.
Chengsheng Mountain, with its strength alone, fended off the assaults from the three formidable forces, revealing an invincible foundation with two True Immortal weapons and six Heavenly Immortal weapons, astounding the heavens and the earth.
Chengsheng Mountain didn’t just possess numerous Immortal weapons, but the number of Heavenly Imperial Realm divine weapons was also exceptionally high. Han Changsheng, the Great Emperor Han Li, blocked both Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, two peerless empresses, with thirteen Heavenly Governing divine weapons, leaving them in dire straits.
They had no choice but to retreat, which displayed overwhelming strength.
What’s most crucial was that the White Emperor, one of the three supreme sovereigns in Qianyuan Divine Province, was obliterated by Great Emperor Han Li in a battle, falling in a rain of blood, his body destroyed and spirit dissipated.
Although the White Emperor revived from death in White Emperor City, it led to severe consequences. Five unidentified supreme beings wielding True Immortal weapons stormed into the Taibai Immortal Realm in White Emperor City and looted wildly, causing great damage to the city’s foundation.
All this was because White Emperor City and the White Emperor opposed Chengsheng Mountain and Great Emperor Han Li, resulting in such a fate.
The White Emperor, who had been decimated by Great Emperor Han Li, dared only to howl in White Emperor City and did not venture back to Qianyuan Divine Province, a clear sign of fear towards Great Emperor Han Li.
Now that Tianji Pavilion has released a ranking of forces with Chengsheng Mountain at the top of the main list, wouldn’t it mean that White Emperor City comes last?
Before, White Emperor City was considered middle-tier among the nine mighty forces, but since this battle, signs of decline were evident. The foundation was severely damaged, its vitality greatly impaired, and it’s unknown how many ten-thousands of years it would take to recover.
The other eight mighty forces reacted differently upon hearing this news, yet none openly refuted Chengsheng Mountain’s status as the top force in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Chengsheng Mountain possesses two True Immortal weapons and six Heavenly Immortal weapons; its foundation is indeed deeper than that of other formidable forces. Besides, vying for the top title is pointless; it’s all just a nominal distinction.
……
Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, separated by hundreds of Divine Provinces, simultaneously snorted in disdain, each harboring discontent for Chengsheng Mountain and Han Li.
Their avatar souls, their subordinates, all remained on Chengsheng Mountain, now wives and concubines to Han Li, which greatly infuriated the two peerless empresses.
This brazen rascal Han Li not only flirted with them face to face but also set his sights on them, enraging the two peerless empresses even more.
They had already discussed in secret, henceforth to ally covertly. Yuanchu Mountain and Huangyue Imperial Empire would advance or retreat together to fend off Han Li’s prying eyes.
Their immediate priority was to lie low. Everything would wait until they transformed into war immortals and then transcended to become immortals. By that time, their power would surge enormously, and even if Han Li brought out another True Immortal weapon, he would no longer be a match for them.
…….
White Emperor City, the Taibai Immortal Realm.
The White Emperor also heard this news, and though his face remained expressionless, his eyes sparkled with a cold light.
Emperor Tianji had pushed him too far!
Previously, he had a good relationship with Emperor Tianji. Yet Emperor Tianji had deceived him time and again, and now he added insult to injury, as if the White Emperor was easily bullied.
The White Emperor snorted coldly, feeling extremely annoyed inside.
He once went to ask Emperor Tianji for assistance in divining Han Li’s fate, but Emperor Tianji refused without proper payment, demanding five supreme grade imperial weapons as a fee, treating him like a sucker.
Han Li was the one he sought to divine, and the White Emperor felt that Emperor Tianji had probably long since discovered Han Li’s destiny. He knew much about Han Li but didn’t warn him, allowing him to suffer a grievous loss and bringing disaster upon White Emperor City.

chapters.title: Chapter 631 - 246 First Place in the Main Ranking: Chengsheng Mountain! The Ninth Generation, Han Changsheng! New Standards for Taking a Wife and Concubines!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 631: Chapter 246 First Place in the Main Ranking: Chengsheng Mountain! The Ninth Generation, Han Changsheng! New Standards for Taking a Wife and Concubines!_2
White Emperor City suffered an attack from five supreme beings, and originally, the White Emperor suspected the likes of the master of Western Sky Palace, Butian Sect Master, and three others, but now he felt it very likely that Emperor Tianji was involved as well.
Otherwise, why would Emperor Tianji kick him when he’s down and release an influence ranking at this critical time? Was he implying that White Emperor City hadn’t been humiliated enough?
Emperor Tianji was bootlicking his enemies, elevating Chengsheng Mountain to the top while demoting his White Emperor City to the bottom, which felt like an extreme insult.
Indeed, the White Emperor also felt that White Emperor City definitely deserved the tenth place. Who could blame them when White Emperor City was seriously weakened?
“Don’t let me catch the opportunity, otherwise you all will die!”
Murderous intent filled the White Emperor’s eyes, shaking the entire Taibai Immortal Realm as he awarded the honor of top enemy to Han Li, followed by Emperor Tianji, Empress Huangyue, with Empress Yuanchu in the fourth place, and the rest were those unknown supreme beings.
“White Emperor!”
Suddenly a shout echoed in the White Emperor’s mind, jolting him back to clarity.
“Don’t worry, I won’t act recklessly.”
The White Emperor reassured the Artifact Spirit of Wuxian Palace, regaining his composure.
He was well aware that what White Emperor City needed now was to lie low, to patiently wait for an opportunity to become a war immortal and successfully transcend the tribulation. Only then could he deliver a fatal blow to his enemies.
……..
Qianyuan Divine Province, Chengsheng Mountain.
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, his blue robes fluttering, no longer dwelling on those memories.
“It’s been thirty years already, huh.”
Han Li heaved a light sigh once more.
Thirty years of growth had made Chengsheng Mountain the universally acknowledged supreme power in the Endless Yuankun Domain, unmatched in its prestige.
Even after two years, Chengsheng Mountain’s momentum hadn’t waned, and its reputation continued to echo across the vast territories of the Eight Hundred Divine Regions.
The influence ranking by Tianji Pavilion had not been released for two years, and to this day, the main list only featured Chengsheng Mountain, with no entries in the subsidiary list.
Tianji Pavilion used this to attract a massive following, as their intelligence business soared to new heights.
Han Li felt it was time to demand protection money from Tianji Pavilion.
Tianji Pavilion had clearly capitalized on his popularity for their traffic, raking in resources. Shouldn’t they share a portion with him?
After all, he had a large family to provide for!
The descendants of Han Mansion at Chengsheng Mountain were numerous, consuming a vast amount of resources daily, and needed a greater influx of resources to meet their needs.
Getting a share of the profits from Tianji Pavilion was the best choice.
During the great battle two years ago, Han Li was aware that Emperor Tianji had seized the moment to deduce his secrets. The Emperor Flag had informed him of this, though Han Li hadn’t paid much attention to it at the time.
This influence ranking by Tianji Pavilion seemed to have the intention of inciting conflict between Chengsheng Mountain and the other five mighty forces of the Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, Longevity Qin Family, Longevity Jiang Family, and the Solar Empire.
Now that he had already offended the Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, and White Emperor City, if he were to also offend those five mighty forces, Chengsheng Mountain would not withstand a collective assault from all eight powers.
In these past two years, he had only acquired one ordinary Heavenly Immortal weapon, called Lightning Boat, which embodied the great Dao of lightning and possessed the ultimate speed of a Heavenly Immortal.
Fortunately, powers such as the Western Sky Palace and Longevity Qin Family weren’t fools; they didn’t fall for Tianji Pavilion’s scheming, preferring to bide their time and observe.
In fact, they too had greatly benefited from Han Li, plundering a vast amount of resources from White Emperor City, including treasures like Immortal Stones, Immortal Qi, and Immortal Elixirs.
“In a few more years, perhaps ten or twenty, the time will come when Chengsheng Mountain stands invincible in the Yuankun Domain, the time when I, Han Changsheng, reign supreme over the Yuankun Domain.”
Gazing upon the lively and flourishing Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li talked to himself with a hint of anticipation on his face.
At that time, he could have proposed marriage upfront and honorably. Neither the Empress of Huangyue nor the Empress Yuanchu would have been able to refuse, and if they disagreed, he would have taken a more forceful approach.
He hoped that they wouldn’t shamelessly reject the favor.
Han Li was kind to them at first, then became tough, which was more satisfying than being tough right from the start.
As for taking dividends from Tianji Pavilion, there was no need to wait so long. As soon as he had some free time, he could just notify Yu Fengzi, the person in charge of Tianji Pavilion in Qianyuan Divine Province.
Yu Fengzi would naturally relay the situation back to the headquarters of Tianji Pavilion in Yandao Province. If Emperor Tianji agreed, all would be well. If not, once he became invincible, he would settle accounts with Tianji Pavilion and take over all its assets.
Han Li exhaled a breath, dispelling his distracting thoughts, and his gaze fell upon a particular area of Chengdao Peak. There were many exceptionally beautiful women there, each one a top-tier beauty, capable of overthrowing states and cities, and stunning for their generation.
In these thirty years, the descendants of Han Mansion had married a great many wives and concubines, diligently branching out the family tree and causing Han Li’s descendants to surge in number. Each year more were added, and now they had already expanded to the ninth generation.
The first of the ninth generation, a cloud grandchild, was born six years ago, a year after the battle in the Barbarian Region. That was the year when Han Li’s title of Great Emperor of Longevity was established.
Based on the generational naming conventions of Han Mansion, it just so happened to be the turn of the “Long” generation.
Thus, Han Li named the first cloud grandchild Han Changsheng.
If one traced Han Changsheng’s lineage, he was a descendant of the first concubine Li Mingmeng, whom Han Li had married after breaking through to the Pihai Realm.
Li Mingmeng was once considered the number one beauty of Lingjun City and has now cultivated to the pinnacle of the Tongxuan Realm. Her features, temperament, and figure have improved significantly since the beginning, continuously refined as her strength progressed.
Han Changsheng’s favorable name owed partly to Li Mingmeng’s influence.
After all, Han Changsheng had no special physique, and his aptitude was average, but he was lucky enough to be the first-born of the ninth generation, earning Han Li’s favor.
Of course, luck was also a part of strength, something Han Li always acknowledged.
The moment Han Li named the first cloud grandchild Han Changsheng, it signified that he would achieve great things in the future and receive key cultivation from Han Li.
In Han Mansion, it didn’t matter if one’s aptitude was poor; there was always a chance to improve. Even without a special physique, if Han Li wished, he could create one.
Over the thirty years, many of Han Li’s wives and concubines had acquired special physiques. Among his beloved wives, such as Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and others, had already developed special physiques, with only the wives married in recent years yet to develop one.
Among his stunning concubines, Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Chu Yutong, Zhou Zhirou, and others had successively upgraded their aptitudes to First Grade, birthing their special physiques.
However, Han Li had many concubines, and about two-thirds of them still lacked a special physique, most of whom were the newly wedded concubines.
Seven years ago, Han Li raised the standards for taking wives and concubines once again. Only those with Fourth Grade aptitude and Third Grade aptitude, and a beauty score above ninety could become his concubines, while those with Second Grade aptitude and First Grade aptitude, and a beauty score above ninety-five could become his wives.
Exceptions were made for those with special bonuses.
Previously, Han Li’s scope for marriage was limited to the Xuan Domain, where he married many beautiful wives and concubines over twenty-three years.
Seven years ago, after a battle confirmed Chengsheng Mountain’s dominant position in Qianyuan Divine Province, Han Li expanded his scope to the whole Qianyuan Divine Province, necessitating a raise in his standards, otherwise, the number of wives and concubines he could take would be enormous.
Two years ago, after Han Li vanquished the White Emperor and defeated both the Huangyue Empress and the Empress Yuanchu, his fame shook the entire Endless Yuankun Domain, establishing Chengsheng Mountain as the First Power in the Yuan Kun Realm. Once again, he raised the standards for marrying and taking concubines.
Fourth Grade aptitude was no longer sufficient to be a concubine for Han Li, the supreme being of the Yuan Kun Realm with Heaven Imperial Realm combat ability. Only those with Third Grade aptitude and Second Grade aptitude, and a beauty score above ninety-two could be concubines; while only those with First Grade aptitude or higher, and a beauty score above ninety-six could be wives.
Of course, if one possessed a special physique, even with slightly lesser aptitude and beauty, they could still become a wife; others with additional bonuses were also within the range of becoming concubines.
As the standards for marrying and taking concubines increased, the number of wives and concubines Han Li could take was significantly reduced, but still, he took quite a few wives and concubines over the past two years.
After all, in these two years, Han Li was marrying and taking concubines from the entire Endless Yuankun Domain.
He just needed to spread the word. With his status and the power of Chengsheng Mountain, the forces wanting to align with him would willingly send their daughters thousands of miles to Chengsheng Mountain.
It wasn’t just Han Li who benefited from this, but also his descendants. The beautiful female cultivators overlooked by Han Li were offered to the descendants of Han Mansion as wives and concubines by those very forces, gradually increasing the quality of Han Mansion’s new generations.
PS: There will be a second update.

chapters.title: Chapter 632 - 247: Explosion in the Number of Descendants! Attaining Longevity! The Seven Big Realms of the Third Step in Cultivation!_1
chapters.content:
Chapter 632: Chapter 247: Explosion in the Number of Descendants! Attaining Longevity! The Seven Big Realms of the Third Step in Cultivation!_1
The next day, morning.
Han Li finished his morning exercises and sat on the bed in a daze.
Before long, a pair of jade arms stretched from behind him, encircling him. Ji Mingyue nestled against Han Li’s back, her substantial conscience weighing down on him as she asked softly,
“Husband, what are you doing?”
Ji Mingyue was somewhat puzzled; she noticed that her husband was a little different today.
Han Li caught Ji Mingyue’s teasing hand and said with a smile, “Mingyue, I am following the ancient teachings and engaging in self-reflection.”
The ancients said: Reflect on oneself three times daily.
This was something Han Li had only recently started. Each day after completing his tasks, he would engage in at least three moments of self-reflection. Only through disciplined introspection could one continuously improve oneself.
Of course, this wasn’t because Han Li was in a period of sagacity.
Ji Mingyue rolled her eyes, got up casually, and then pushed Han Li down, transforming into a female knight.
If the husband was not up to the task, then she would just have to suffice for herself.
Ji Mingyue was initially reluctant to do so, but after so many years, she had become very familiar with it and was always very proactive.
After completing another round of morning exercises, Han Li left Ji Mingyue’s sleeping chamber.
Ji Mingyue stretched out her waist, her perfect, delicate body fully displayed. She walked off the bed and stepped into a side hall with a hot spring to bathe.
Atop Chengdao Peak, Han Li stood, drawing in the morning’s purple qi.
Well, he had missed the purple qi. Who could blame him when Han Li, the ancestor, had done the morning exercises twice? He was just going through the motions.
Afterwards, Han Li began calculating the days.
He realized that only the tenth day of the month had passed, but for him, it had been well over a hundred days—about five hundred, in fact.
The Time-Sky Tower was something magnificent.
To satisfy the growing needs of his beloved wives and beautiful concubines, Han Li now conducted most of his exchange of Daoist teachings inside the Time-Sky Tower.
Furthermore, each time he entered either the eighth or ninth level of the Tower. A day outside equated to five to ten years inside, allowing him to enjoy many days of leisure daily.
His physical body was comparable to a mid-stage Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, so he had no worries about his body not being able to take it. On the contrary, every time they debated the Dao, his beloved wives and beautiful concubines were forced into retreat, unable to withstand his onslaught, leading to…(fill in the blank).
“I truly am a master of time management,” Han Li said with a light chuckle.
Compared to him, the real master of time management, all other time management gurus are inferior—in every sense of the word.
Sighing, Han Li’s gaze swept across various places and peaks of Chengsheng Mountain, a satisfied smile appearing on his face.
Thirty years of breeding, thirty years of branching out. Han Li’s descendants had undergone explosive growth, spreading across all of Chengsheng Mountain.
Thirty years ago, the total number of Han Li’s descendants was less than six thousand, with less than three thousand possessing talent. Now, a tremendous change had taken place.
In just thirty years, the total number of Han Li’s descendants had nearly reached a million, with the exact number being 999,987; 788,652 of them possessed talent.
Originally, the ratio of total descendants to those with talent was about two to one; now it had shifted dramatically to 1.268 to one.
This was because the number of talented descendants began to exceed those without talent. Those with talent could cultivate, were more powerful, and could marry more and better wives and concubines. Other powers were also more willing to have their female cultivators become the wives and concubines of Han Mansion’s talented descendants.
Those descendants of Han Mansion without talent mostly had to marry mortal women as their wives and concubines. Although they could take elixirs, their bodies ultimately couldn’t endure it, and they couldn’t reproduce as vigorously as those descendants on the cultivation path.
In Chengsheng Mountain alone, there were nearly a million descendants of Han Li, not to mention the maids, guards, protectors, Guest Elders, and so on, whose numbers would multiply by tenfold or even dozens of times.
To avoid overcrowding Chengsheng Mountain, many places were equipped with spatial formations that opened up countless caves. The caves, while appearing small from the outside, contained worlds of their own within.
Even so, Han Li felt the population on Chengsheng Mountain was getting a bit large, so he had already made a decision.
Once the total number of descendants officially broke through the one million mark, it would be time to relocate some of them. For now, they could move to various places in Qianyuan Divine Province to continue breeding and branching out.
Nowadays, Chengsheng Mountain’s status was solid. In Qianyuan Divine Province, no matter who they were—be it the Great Holy Land Schools or the vilest of powers—no one dared to offend Han Mansion.
Therefore, Han Li was not worried about his descendants facing any danger once scattered.
Whichever place in Qianyuan Divine Province these descendants went to, the local powers would likely treat them as honored guests, willingly allocating benefits to them. Even if they didn’t rally around Han Mansion’s descendants, no one would dare to offend them.
The mention of Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion was like a golden signboard!
After all, who would dare to offend the first great power of the Endless Yuankun Domain?
Han Li’s gaze swept from the million descendants to the various lesser peaks of Chengsheng Mountain, a smile spreading across his face.
Chengsheng Mountain consisted of one main peak and fourteen lesser peaks, among which five lesser peaks were taller and nine were shorter.
Because of Han Li’s earlier decision, the entire Chengsheng Mountain continued to grow. The main peak, Chengdao Peak, had surpassed fourteen thousand zhang, the five taller lesser peaks were over eight thousand zhang, and the nine shorter ones were close to five thousand zhang.
Each of the lesser peaks had a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapon, either Top Grade or Supreme Grade, all of the auxiliary type.
And as for the main peak, Chengdao Peak, it had five auxiliary-type Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapons to better aid the cultivation of his beloved wives and beautiful concubines.

chapters.title: Chapter 633 - 247: Explosion in the Number of Descendants! Attaining Longevity! The Seven Big Realms of the Third Step in Cultivation!_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 633: Chapter 247: Explosion in the Number of Descendants! Attaining Longevity! The Seven Big Realms of the Third Step in Cultivation!_2
The outside world believes that Chengsheng Mountain only has two True Immortal Weapons and six Heavenly Immortal Weapons, but they are greatly mistaken—the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain is far stronger than what is known to the outside.
The two True Immortal Weapons known to the outside are the Human Path Sword and the Qiankun Bracelet, but the Human Path Sword is only a Heavenly Immortal Weapon, comparable to a True Immortal Weapon in power.
Now, Han Li has, in addition to the True Immortal Qiankun Bracelet, two other True Immortal Weapons: the Emperor Flag and the Heavens Opening Axe. Among them, the Emperor Flag is the strongest, followed by the Qiankun Bracelet, and then the Heavens Opening Axe.
The Heavens Opening Axe is just an ordinary True Immortal Weapon, significantly weaker in power compared to the Human Path Sword.
Apart from the Human Path Sword, Han Li also possesses seven other Heavenly Immortal Weapons, which are the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, Yin Yang Mirror, Immortal Beating Whip, Immortal Locking Pillar, Immortal Extinguishing Sword, Ruyi Saber, and Lightning Boat.
From the Primordial Chaos Cauldron to the Immortal Locking Pillar, all are top-grade Heavenly Immortal Weapons, while the Immortal Extinguishing Sword, Ruyi Saber, and Lightning Boat are just ordinary Heavenly Immortal Weapons.
In addition, Han Li has a great number of Emperor Weapons of the Heaven Imperial Realm, amounting to over sixty, including twenty-two Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons and forty-five Top Grade Emperor Weapons.
Two years ago, during the battle with Empress Phuong Yue and Empress Yuanchu, Han Li only revealed a portion of his Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapons, but it was enough to put the two peerless empresses in a tough spot.
As for the Quasi Emperor Weapons, Sacred Weapons, and Divine Weapons, Han Li has an even greater number of them. The lower the grade, the higher the quantity. During the past thirty years, the majority of treasures Han Li obtained from the treasure boxes were of these three grades.
Over the years, Han Li also acquired quite a few Creation Stones, which elevated a few Supreme Grade Divine Weapons such as the Heavenly Moon Wheel to the status of Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons, fulfilling his initial promise to Yue Ji.
Additionally, when subduing the Top Grade Emperor Weapons like the Bihai Bowl, Sky Pavilion, and Cold Snow Saber, he also made promises to their Artifact Spirits to help them ascend to Supreme Grade Emperor Weapons, a promise Han Li has kept.
While Han Li was keeping his promises, he also personally experienced and savored their tastes.
“Huff~”
Han Li let out a heavy breath, standing with his hands behind his back as he looked towards the east, gazing towards the distant Xuanshen Sword Mountain, but he did not dare to utter its name in his heart, worrying about falling into crisis once again.
As things have developed to this point, Chengsheng Mountain is already the First Power in the Endless Yuan Kun Realm. The next phase is to be invincible throughout the Yuan Kun Realm. Once invincibility in the Yuan Kun Realm is achieved, the next phase will be to consider the matters of Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
Xuanshen Sword Mountain has always been the Immortal Sword hanging over the Endless Yuan Kun Realm, and it is an Immortal Sword of an extremely high grade, with unparalleled power, invincible, so fearsome that not even a True Immortal could withstand a single ray of its sword light.
Fortunately, he still has ample time.
More than two hundred million years remain until the Yuan Kun Realm’s next great calamity, which also is the last one of this era.
Han Li felt that with his current rate of progress, he did not need to wait two hundred million years; in a mere thousand years, ten thousand years, or at most a hundred thousand years, he could attain the status of an Eternal Golden Immortal.
According to legends, becoming a Golden Immortal would allow one to pass the test of Xuanshen Sword Mountain, leave the Endless Yuan Kun Realm, and venture into the limitless vastness beyond.
Compared with the infinite expanse of the Tai Chu Realm, the Yuan Kun Realm is just a small place, also known as a place of comfort, yet Han Li still wishes to venture out, and he intends to take the entire Chengsheng Mountain with him.
Who would have let the Yuan Kun Realm face a great calamity in every era?
Han Li did not believe that even as an Eternal Golden Immortal, he could solve the great calamity of the Yuan Kun Realm. Eternal Golden Immortals are only qualified to pass through Xuanshen Sword Mountain and leave the Yuan Kun Realm to head for the Tai Chu Realm.
