Withdrawing his gaze, Han Li suddenly pondered a question, his solemn expression turning to a smile.
“I suppose this could be considered achieving the path to eternal life, couldn’t it?”
His current realm is Quasi Emperor, and Quasi Emperors possess a lifespan of three hundred thousand years, which could be extended by tens of thousands of years through the use of rare heavenly and earthly treasures.
Han Li, however, does not need to resort to using those rare treasures—his lifespan far exceeds that of all Quasi Emperors and even all of the Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
The Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm have a lifespan of only one million years, and even with the use of life-extending elixirs, at most, they can only extend their lives by two hundred thousand years.
As for Han Li, his lifespan is nearly approaching one million three hundred thousand years!
Nearly a million descendants provided him with a lifespan of almost a million years, on par with that of a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor who had died a natural death.
A lifespan of over a million years, that could be considered eternal life, couldn’t it?
In this world, ordinary people have a lifespan of only a hundred years; his was tens of thousands of times longer than that of an ordinary person.
It was precisely because he had an ample lifespan that Han Li was very confident in leaving the Endless Yuankun Domain to enter the boundlessly vast Taichu Realm.
As his cultivation increased, and as the number of his descendants grew, Han Li’s lifespan would continue to increase, becoming more and more plentiful.
As long as he didn’t use any secret techniques that burned his lifespan recklessly, he’d never run out of lifespan, not ever!
Apart from his lifespan, Han Li’s talent had already broken through the constraints of Ninth Grade, reaching the Immortal Grade.
Thirty years ago, Han Li’s lifespan was approaching Ninth Grade; he had reached the limit of Ninth Grade in his third year of seclusion, but he hadn’t been able to break through.
From Ninth Grade talent to Immortal Grade talent is a chasm, and there are two ways to cross this threshold in the Taichu Realm.
One is to cultivate into an immortal; no matter by what means one becomes an immortal, once one becomes an immortal, even if just possessing Ninth Grade talent, a cultivator’s talent will be uplifted to Immortal Grade.
The other is to cultivate a special physique, giving birth to a King’s Body or Emperor’s Body, thereby shortening the gap between Ninth Grade and Immortal Grade talent.
However, Han Li couldn’t take either path; he couldn’t achieve either—becoming an immortal was too far-fetched, and cultivating a physique might hold some hope, but he didn’t have enough Physique Points.
Therefore, the System provided Han Li with a third path, which was to expend his cultivation. As long as he spent a certain amount of cultivation, the System would help him bridge this chasm, advancing from Ninth Grade talent to Immortal Grade talent.
Han Li agreed, saved up several years of cultivation, and then spent it all to transform directly into Immortal Grade talent.
With Immortal Grade talent, Han Li discovered that the entire world looked different. Before, he was a counterfeit extraordinary prodigy, relying on the System; with Immortal Grade talent, even without relying on the System, the speed at which he cultivated was incredibly fast, and he was truly an extraordinary prodigy.
Thus, Han Li still chose to rely on the System.
Why put in the effort when one can lie down?
Wasn’t it comfortable to live a godly life every day, arranging flowers and managing a myriad of duties?
As for now, Han Li’s talent had improved again.
Immortal Grade talent was just a broad concept, from low to high ranging from Immortal Grade First to Ninth Grade, corresponding to the seven Big Realms and two special domains of the Immortal Domain.
Han Li’s talent was now of Immortal Grade Second Grade, holding the potential of a True Immortal, though cultivating to the level of a Golden Immortal would be very difficult.
Because of his Immortal Grade talent, Han Li asked the System about the realm divisions within the Immortal Domain; the System finally provided him with the answers.
It might be because the System had undergone two upgrades in the last thirty years, which was why his permissions had increased.
According to the System, the Immortal Domain is the third step in the path of cultivation, consisting of seven Big Realms, which are:
Heavenly Immortal, True Immortal, Golden Immortal, Immortal Monarch, Immortal King, Quasi Immortal Emperor, Immortal Emperor!
The two special domains are Quasi Immortal Monarch, bridging Golden Immortal to Immortal Monarch, and Quasi Immortal King, bridging Immortal Monarch to Immortal King.
These are two realms that one could bypass and still break through to higher realms without entering, but by stepping into them, one could gain significant benefits.
PS: I can’t finish writing today, a bit is still missing; I’ll make it up tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 634
chapters.content:
Chapter 634: Chapter 248: Han Li’s Strength!
Taking Turns to be Emperor of Heaven, This Year it Comes to My House!
Heavenly Court!
Guanghan Empress’s Conjecture_1 Chapter 634: Chapter 248: Han Li’s Strength!
Taking Turns to be Emperor of Heaven, This Year it Comes to My House!
Heavenly Court!
Guanghan Empress’s Conjecture_1 The Seven Big Realms of the Immortal Domain!
...
There are also two special realms, Quasi Immortal Monarch and Quasi Immortal King, so strictly speaking, there are nine realms.
Although one can breakthrough to Immortal Monarch and Immortal King without entering the realms of Quasi Immortal Monarch and Quasi Immortal King, everyone knows that making a breakthrough from the Quasi Immortal Monarch or Quasi Immortal King realm will result in much greater strength and enable one to go much further.
Anyway, Han Li had no intention of skipping these, as there were no such restraints for him.
As long as he had sufficient cultivation, he could break through directly.
Han Li’s heart burned with eagerness; he wanted to see the scenery of the third, and even the fourth step of cultivation.
The final big realm of the second step of cultivation is the Heaven Imperial Realm, which commands the Heavenly Sovereign Path, also known as the Great Emperor Realm.
The final realm of the second step of cultivation is the Great Emperor, while the final realm of the third step is the Immortal Emperor.
Though both bear the title ’emperor,’ the difference in their powers is immense.
The Great Emperor is merely the strongest in the Mortal Realm, whereas the Immortal Emperor is the strongest in the Immortal Domain; there’s no comparison.
As for the landscape of the fourth step of cultivation, Han Li had no clear idea.
Is there only one big realm, or are there several?
He was merely a Quasi Emperor at the moment, although he possessed the combat ability of the Heavenly Abyss, was the supreme of the Yuankun Domain, and even ranked first in the Yuankun Domain, he was still considered a Quasi Emperor.
Therefore, Han Li decided to train diligently.
Once a day was definitely not enough, but once every hundred days seemed quite good.
Han Li’s continuous cultivation and love for discussing the Dao were not because he could benefit from dual cultivation; he simply enjoyed the exhilarating feeling of engaging in discussions on the Dao.
When the number of future generations reached one thousand, the Longevity Family System upgraded for the first time.
In the past thirty years, as the number of descendants reached ten thousand and then a hundred thousand, the Longevity Family System underwent two more upgrades, bringing it to the 4.0 version.
Soon, when the number of future generations breaches the one million mark, the Longevity Family System should be welcoming its fifth upgrade.
As the old adage goes, “A new version breeds new gods.”
With each system upgrade, the system provided greater and greater assistance to Han Li, with more and more functions coming into play.
After the second system upgrade, Han Li was able to improve his cultivation every time he dual cultivated with his charming wives and beautiful concubines, without the slightest decrease in effects.
This also provided Han Li with another channel for accumulating cultivation.
Upon careful calculations, there were already quite a few channels, but Han Li still felt it was too few.
The first one was the birth of new descendants, with every new descendant bringing one year of cultivation.
The second was the birth of special descendants, such as the first Third Grade talent, the first top talent, and so on, each time granting him a certain amount of cultivation.
The third was reaching certain milestones in the total number of descendants and talented descendants, which also rewarded him with a certain amount of cultivation, with later rewards being more generous.
The fourth was feedback from the cultivation of descendants.
The higher the cultivation level of the descendants, the more cultivation feedback they could contribute to Han Li.
For example, a descendant at the Pihai Realm could only provide one year of cultivation feedback, a Divine Yuan Realm descendant could provide 500 years of feedback, while a Heaven Imperial Realm descendant could contribute a direct 50,000 years of cultivation feedback.
The fifth was dual cultivation.
Based on Han Li’s cultivation as a benchmark, being at the Quasi Emperor Realm himself, dual cultivating once with another Quasi Emperor would grant him a certain amount of cultivation.
The effectiveness of dual cultivation would gradually diminish when he cultivated with wives or concubines of lower cultivation levels due to the gap in realms, and vice versa.
After the third system upgrade, some original features were strengthened, and two more functions were added, one of which was the Martial Skill Panel.
The martial skills Han Li obtained from the system were all directly at the perfected stage, but the skills he acquired in the Tai Chu Realm still required diligent practice.
After the emergence of the Martial Skill Panel, Han Li’s problem was solved.
The Martial Skill Panel listed all the martial skills Han Li possessed, whether mastered or not; all that belonged to him appeared there.
Han Li merely had to will it, and he could upgrade a set of powerful martial skills to their perfected stage, sparing him the need for personal arduous practice.
Of course, this came at a cost and required Han Li to expend his cultivation.
The amount of cultivation consumed varied according to the grade of the martial skill and the level to which it had been cultivated.
Although some were somewhat expensive, Han Li, a man of great wealth and boldness, did not mind these small expenses as they could save him countless hours.
His path of martial arts was to integrate thousands of methods and gather myriad paths.
The more perfected martial skills he mastered, the deeper his insight into his own martial path, requiring attention to both quantity and quality.
This gave Han Li another pathway; he no longer had to wait for the System to reward him with good skills.
He could simply…
ahem, ask various forces to make tributes, exchanging resources or other martial skills and techniques, and only resort to force as a last option.
Gathering his thoughts, Han Li opened his personal panel.
Name: Han Li
Age: 281 years old
Realm: Quasi Emperor Realm Sixth Heaven
Mana: Heaven Imperial Realm Fifth Heaven
Primordial Spirit: Heaven Imperial Realm Sixth Heaven
Divine Sense: Heaven Imperial Realm Sixth Heaven
Physique: Heaven Imperial Realm Fifth Heaven
Strength: Heaven Imperial Realm Fifth Heaven
Speed: Heaven Imperial Realm Eighth Heaven
Defense: Heaven Imperial Realm Sixth Heaven
Combat Ability: Heaven Imperial Realm Sixth Heaven
……
Having glanced over his various status, Han Li was still very satisfied with them.
Though his cultivation was only at the level of Quasi Emperor Realm Sixth Heaven, his combat strength was stronger than that of most Great Emperors in the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Han Li felt a slight regret that the space for him to fight across realms had diminished.
Previously, he could leap across one big realm and several smaller ones, but now, he could only leap across one big realm.
Too tragic!
Han Li also knew why; the gaps between realms were becoming increasingly wider.

chapters.title: Chapter 635
chapters.content:
Chapter 635: Chapter 248: Han Li’s Strength!
Taking Turns to be Emperor of Heaven, This Year it Comes to My House!
Heavenly Court!
Guanghan Empress’s Conjecture_2 Chapter 635: Chapter 248: Han Li’s Strength!
Taking Turns to be Emperor of Heaven, This Year it Comes to My House!
Heavenly Court!
Guanghan Empress’s Conjecture_2 Han Li had been continuously progressing, unrivalled in his realm in every aspect, looking towards the next Big Realm.
...
Otherwise, he wouldn’t even be able to transcend a single Big Realm.
Everyone was progressing, and even if they were still in the same minor realm, if you didn’t progress, you would be overtaken by others and ultimately end up at the bottom.
Being capable of fighting across a Big Realm, Han Li was quite satisfied with himself.
Once he broke through to the later stages of the Quasi Emperor Realm, his combat ability would grow accordingly.
If he could master higher-level martial techniques, his combat ability could match that of the late Heaven Imperial Realm.
And in other aspects, he was fairly balanced, all within the mid Heaven Imperial Realm, except for his speed, which was particularly outstanding.
With a speed comparable to that of the Eighth Heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm, there weren’t many in the Endless Yuankun Domain who were faster than him.
Beyond that, Divine Sense was worth mentioning.
According to the intelligence he gathered and ancient histories he consulted over the years, Divine Sense was not unique to him alone, but it was also not possessed by many.
Only those Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm and peerless prodigies likely to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm could enter this mysterious domain, which also happened to be called “Divine Sense”.
Han Li felt that when he originally named this special domain Divine Sense, it might have been a sympathetic response to the heavens : an intuitive perception that inspired the name.
Initially, Divine Sense amplified combat abilityâ€”such as increasing it by fivefold or tenfoldâ€”but as the gap in realms grew too wide, and Divine Sense Exploration reached a certain extent, it evolved and directly enhanced realm combat ability, such as increasing it by one or two minor realms.
Han Li discovered from the secretive ancient histories that most Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm’s Divine Sense were in the Second Stage, able to enhance their combat ability by one minor realm.
Only a few Great Emperors in the Heaven Imperial Realm were in the Third Stage, enhancing their combat ability by two minor realms.
Some exceptionally monstrous Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm even stepped into the Fourth Stage of Divine Sense, capable of enhancing their combat ability by three minor realms.
Han Li suspected that Empress Guanghan and Empress Yuanchu were at this stage.
Even though the two peerless empresses had reached the absolute pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, they could not possess combat ability that matched a Heavenly Immortal when they activated their Divine Sense, but the gap was narrowing.
During their battle, neither Empress Guanghan nor Empress Yuanchu activated their Divine Sense, seeming to intentionally conceal it, not wishing to reveal their secrets.
Han Li did not activate his Divine Sense either.
He had ventured very far and deep into the domain of Divine Sense.
Now at the Sixth Stage, he could enhance his combat ability by five minor realms.
Which meant, Han Li now had the combat ability of the Sixth Heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
If he were to fully activate Divine Sense, his combat ability would be even stronger than that of a peak Heaven Imperial Realm who hadn’t activated Divine Sense.
If his opponent also activated Divine Sense, Han Li felt he would not be a match for them.
Any Great Emperor who could cultivate to the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm would have reached at least the Third Stage in the domain of Divine Sense, capable of enhancing their combat ability by two minor realms.
After all, his own cultivation level was too low, and the duration which his Divine Sense could be maintained was limited.
Once activated, Divine Sense could be maintained for fifty breaths.
There needed to be a gap of one hundred breaths between each activation of Divine Sense, starting from the end of the last Divine Sense activation.
If Divine Sense was activated consecutively, the duration would progressively shortenâ€”forty breaths for the second time, thirty for the third, twenty for the fourth, ten for the fifth, and five for the sixth, allowing for a maximum of six continuous activations.
After consecutive activations of Divine Sense, one’s spirit would fall into a weakened state, requiring three days before Divine Sense could be activated again.
Both Empress Guanghan and Empress Yuanchu didn’t want to expose their Divine Sense, and neither did Han Li.
He still needed to keep his capabilities hidden until he possessed enough True Immortal weapons, and then he would no longer need to hide.
Having read through the information, Han Li closed his personal panel contentedly and set a small goal for himself.
To breakthrough to the Heaven Imperial Realm before turning 300!
This pace of cultivation was much faster than all the Great Emperors of Heaven Imperial Realm throughout the history of the Yuankun Domain.
Normally, many Great Emperors would break through between the age of 100,000 and 200,000 years.
A few did so between 200,000 and 300,000 years.
Breaking through to the Heaven Imperial Realm before the age of 100,000 years surpassed the average speed in historical records.
Around 50,000 years was considered a medium standard, and roughly 10,000 years was an upper standard.
If one’s cultivation lasted less than 10,000 years, say 8,000 or 3,000, that would already be top-notch in the annals of the Yuankun Domain.
If one were to become a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm in less than 1,000 years, that would be among the highest echelons throughout all ancient history, with very few comparable examples.
For instance, Empress Guanghan of this era broke through to the Heaven Imperial Realm at the age of 400; Empress Yuanchu, a few years later than Empress Guanghan, did so at the age of 406.
Apart from these two peerless empresses, the other Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm within the Yuankun Domain typically broke through at the age of thirty to fifty thousand years, with only two or three doing it within ten thousand years.
If Han Li were to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm before the age of 300, he would be the fastest in his generation to reach Heaven Imperial Realm cultivation in the whole of the Endless Yuankun Domain.
There wouldn’t be more than ten individuals throughout the entire history of the Yuankun Domain quicker than him.
Those were the most outstanding offspring of the True Immortals, being vigorously nurtured during the most glorious eras and benefitting from immense fortunes to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm before the age of three hundred.
Han Li believed that he definitely couldn’t become the fastest man to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm, but he could become the fastest to break through to the Heavenly Immortal, the fastest to the True Immortal, the fastest…
He now had nearly a million descendants, and each year saw the birth of a great number of offspring.
The snowball effect would grow larger and larger, and his pace of accumulating cultivation would only get faster, eventually making him invincible in the Tai Chu Realm.
The role of Emperor of Heaven would come around; this time, it’s my turn!

chapters.title: Chapter 636
chapters.content:
Chapter 636: Chapter 248: Han Li’s Strength!
Taking Turns to be Emperor of Heaven, This Year it Comes to My House!
Heavenly Court!
Guanghan Empress’s Conjecture_3 Chapter 636: Chapter 248: Han Li’s Strength!
Taking Turns to be Emperor of Heaven, This Year it Comes to My House!
Heavenly Court!
Guanghan Empress’s Conjecture_3 Indeed, the Tai Chu Realm does have an Emperor of Heaven, as well as a Heavenly Court, with the Emperor of Heaven being the master of that court.
...
This information was learned by Han Li from the Xuxian Realm.
The Tai Chu Realm is vast and boundless, and most of the powerful practitioners of the Immortal Dao reside within the Thirty-three Heavens.
Above the Thirty-three Heavens are countless Immortal Dao forces, among which there are no shortage of forces of Immortal Emperor Rank, such as the Guanghan Immortal Palace, Longhan Immortal Court, and Nine Tribulation Mountain, which Han Li has heard about.
Although the Tai Chu Realm does not have thirty-three Immortal Emperor Rank forces, it certainly has more than three.
The Guanghan Immortal Palace, Longhan Immortal Court, and Nine Tribulation Mountainâ€”these three major Immortal Emperor Rank forcesâ€”are ones Han Li has heard of by chance.
Each Immortal Emperor Rank force occupies one of the Heavens, such as the Guanghan Heaven of the Guanghan Immortal Palace, the Longhan Heaven of the Longhan Immortal Court, and the Nine Tribulation Heaven of Nine Tribulation Mountain.
Within their respective Heavens, these Immortal Emperor Rank forces are absolute rulers, governing boundless and countless territories.
Above the Immortal Emperor Rank forces is the Heavenly Court.
The Heavenly Court governs the Thirty-three Heavens, with the Emperor of Heaven as the co-ruler of all Thirty-three Heavens, at least nominally.
Many Immortal Emperor Rank forces do not heed the decrees of the Heavenly Court, setting up their own domains.
They acknowledge the Emperor of Heaven in name only, and the Emperor is unable to do anything about it, allowing things to take their own course.
But no matter what, the power of the Emperor of Heaven is definitely one of the strongest among all the Immortal Emperors, otherwise, he could not secure his position.
Only those with the greatest power can become the Emperor of Heaven!
“Then I will be the one with the greatest power.”
Han Li silently set a grand goal for himself and scheduled it for one epoch.
There is no clear concept of a calendar in the Yuankun Domain, perhaps because it has been isolated from the Tai Chu Realm for too long.
It is unknown whether it’s been ten epochs, a hundred epochs, or even hundreds to thousands of epochs…
In the Tai Chu Realm outside of the Yuankun Domain, there is a uniform calendar system named after the Emperor of Heaven.
It is now the year two quadrillion eight hundred fifty-nine million eight hundred eighty-four thousand six hundred thirty-two of the Calendar of Heaven Emperors.
According to the rules of the Tai Chu Realm, one epoch consists of twelve billion nine hundred sixty million years, with three thousand six hundred epochs comprising one Eon.
The current Heavenly Court was established three Eons ago, and the present Emperor of Heaven also ascended to his position by overthrowing the previous emperor along with other Immortal Emperors in that era.
As for what exactly happened, Han Li was not clear.
It was too far in the past.
He only gathered some information after hearing about the Immortal Emperor Rank forces.
“Whew~”
Exhaling a long breath, Han Li cast aside these thoughts; they were still too distant from his current situation.
He then opened another system panel, which recorded his achievements in the Four Arts of Cultivation.
Alchemy: Emperor Level Top Grade
Artifact Refining: Emperor Level Mid Grade
Formation: Emperor Level Top Grade
Talisman Making: Emperor Level Lower Grade
Han Li nodded slightly; his achievements in the Four Arts of Cultivation were definitely among the top few in the Yuankun Domain today.
Perhaps there are Alchemists, Artifact Refiners, Formation Masters, and Talisman Makers who have surpassed him in their respective specialties, but none have surpassed him in all four areas.
Only a few individuals could match Han Li’s achievements in the Four Arts of Cultivation.
With his profound mastery of the Four Arts of Cultivation, Han Li had been widely collecting Pill Formulas and Blueprints without any reservations.
After all, Chengsheng Mountain had already come into the open and became the foremost major power in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
In the past two years, many forces had voluntarily offered Pill Formulas and Blueprints, and even some rare proprietary goods to Chengsheng Mountain, hoping to curry favor and seek protection, as well as to gain some benefits in the process.
In just two short years, Chengsheng Mountain’s business had spread across the surrounding thirty-seven Divine Provinces, and Han Li, within the Time-Sky Tower, had crafted a vast quantity of high-tier medicinal pills, weapons, Array Plates, and superior talisman papers.
Aside from retaining one-third of the finished products, two-thirds were sold off, saturating the markets of thirty-seven Divine Provinces with goods that were cheaper and of higher quality than other products of the same level.
Once Chengsheng Mountain’s products hit the market, they instantly became a hit.
These items, branded by Chengsheng Mountain, were already very enticing.
Once people saw the high quality and low prices, regardless of their financial constraints, they felt Chengsheng Mountain provided the best value for money and bought them in large quantities.
This was exactly in line with Han Li’s intentions.
Han Li followed the path of low-cost dumping.
For instance, if a medicinal pill cost one hundred Spirit Stones to produce and the market price was two to three hundred Spirit Stones, Chengsheng Mountain sold it for only one hundred fifty Spirit Stones.
Even if it meant earning far fewer Spirit Stones, it was worthwhile.
Thin profits and high turnover were the strategyâ€”to collapse the local markets, form a monopoly, and then make back an even greater amount of Spirit Stones.
As the leading force in the Endless Yuankun Domain, when the smaller forces were impacted by Chengsheng Mountain’s products, leading to their bleak business, they dared not meddle with Chengsheng Mountain’s affairs for fear of severe retaliation and the potential destruction of their own operations.
However, Han Li also knew restraint.
He didn’t allow Chengsheng Mountain’s business to expand further but limited it to the Qianyuan Divine Province and the thirty-six Divine Provinces it once governed.
If the expansion continued further, it could easily encroach upon the territories of other Heavenly Governing Forces or most powerful forces.
The Heavenly Governing Forces might tolerate it, but the most powerful forces might not.
If Han Li kept up with such dumping, it could disrupt the entire Yuankun Domain market and affect the interests of all the most powerful forces and Heavenly Governing Forces, which would then band together against Chengsheng Mountain.
Therefore, Han Li was well aware of the boundaries and, for the time being, did not provoke these Heavenly Governing Forces or the most powerful forces.
The market of the thirty-seven Divine Provinces was already sufficient for Chengsheng Mountain to digest for quite some time.

chapters.title: Chapter 637
chapters.content:
Chapter 637: Chapter 248: Han Li’s Strength!
Taking Turns to be Emperor of Heaven, This Year it Comes to My House!
Heavenly Court!
Guanghan Empress’s Conjecture_4 Chapter 637: Chapter 248: Han Li’s Strength!
Taking Turns to be Emperor of Heaven, This Year it Comes to My House!
Heavenly Court!
Guanghan Empress’s Conjecture_4 As for those forces that were influenced by Chengsheng Mountain and consequently declined, Han Li couldn’t concern himself with that.
...
Competition is always like this, a life-and-death struggle, whether it be in the Cultivation Realm or any other world.
Only the intervention of the most powerful forces, establishing rules and striking at those who don’t follow them, can ensure that the majority of forces obediently abide by the rules.
With a sigh, Han Li’s figure vanished from the summit of Chengdao Peak, entering the ninth level of the Time-Sky Tower, where a figure immediately pounced on him.
Faced with Long Yue’s invitation to discuss the Dao, Han Li naturally wouldn’t refuse and embarked on a hearty and invigorating exchange of Daoist knowledge with her.
In Qianyuan Divine Province, above the nine heavens,
a graceful and peerless figure stood tall, shrouded in endless celestial light that obscured everything, disturbing the celestial designs, causality, time, and destiny here…
“Ambitions are grand,” the flawless, peerless figure suddenly spoke.
Following her gaze, it became clear that she was looking towards Chengsheng Mountain, directly at Han Li at the pinnacle of Chengdao Peak, even clearly hearing Han Li’s mutterings.
If Han Li knew someone was secretly observing him, he would be utterly shocked.
According to Han Li’s speculations, the Yuankun Domain was likely to be a prison, cut off by Immortal Kings or even Immortal Emperors, for some sort of scheme.
Such great beings couldn’t possibly spy on the entire Yuankun Domain all the time; otherwise, there wouldn’t be a calamity breaking out only once every era.
In the Endless Yuankun Domain, the most powerful beings of the Ancient Era were only True Immortals, and in this era the strongest were only at the Heaven Imperial Realm’s utmost summit.
Even with the aid of True Immortal weapons, it wasn’t possible to silently observe him without Han Li noticing anything amiss.
Chengsheng Mountain possessed three True Immortal weapons, one of which was the Humanity Sword, comparable to True Immortal weapons.
Among them, the Emperor Flag was a top-tier True Immortal weapon, particularly adept at concealing celestial designs.
If someone were spying, the Emperor Flag would detect it immediately and notify Han Li.
However, at this moment, the figure above the nine heavens was clearly spying on him, but the Emperor Flag had no inkling of it.
“This Emperor is curious to see if you can achieve it,” she declared.
This flawless, unparalleled figure was the Guanghan Empress.
She spoke again, yet no one could hear her words.
Thirty years ago, the Guanghan Empress was resting within the Guanghan Immortal Palace of Guanghan Heaven when she suddenly sensed a disturbance in her Red-Luan Star.
After divining, she learned of part of the future.
Therefore, the Guanghan Empress sent a strand of her Primordial Spirit down to the Yuankun Domain, born in Lanyu Divine Province, intending to personally observe her future companion and see if he was qualified.
If he was worthy, she would follow the future and lend some help to accelerate his growth so they could advance together; if not, the Guanghan Empress wouldn’t resort to killing him, but would simply leave.
As a fragment of an Immortal Emperor’s spirit, she was born a Heavenly Immortal, and upon reaching adulthood she automatically became a True Immortal; she is now a supreme True Immortal.
In the first year of her birth in the Endless Yuankun Domain, the Guanghan Empress found Han Li and has since been quietly observing him.
Even with True Immortal weapons in his possession, Han Li couldn’t obstruct her scrutiny or sense anything at all.
With just a casual application of a Secret Technique, she could shield herself from Han Li and those True Immortal weapons, rendering herself invisible to them.
Over these thirty years, the Guanghan Empress has seen everything about Han Li.
Indifferent to Han Li’s romantic exploits, the Guanghan Empress remained detached; having lived for countless years and being an Immortal Emperor since the former dynasty, Han Li’s behaviour couldn’t sway her in the slightest.
Yet, the Guanghan Empress was also curious; what was Han Li’s origin?
She could clearly see that in the past thirty years, Han Li rarely cultivated, spending years fighting frequently within the Time-Sky Tower.
Strangely enough, Han Li’s cultivation progressed by leaps and bounds.
As time passed, he gradually mastered more powerful martial techniques and Secret Techniques, and even increased his proficiency in the Four Arts of Cultivation.
The Guanghan Empress also felt that Han Li might truly be the reincarnation of an ancient immortal, with an extremely ancient origin, whose pinnacle was definitely not that of any minor Immortal Lord or Immortal King.
Han Li must have been at least an Emperor of Heaven level powerhouse in the past, and it was even possible that he was a fourth-step powerhouse.
Why did the Guanghan Empress think so?
Because she had divined Han Li’s fate with her Immortal Emperor true self and could only see his past hundred lifetimes, unable to divine anything beyond that, as it was blocked off.
When divining his future, she saw that Han Li’s destiny was closely intertwined with hers, and she was his Dao Companion.
From the farthest future she could divine, Han Li would at least be an unrivaled powerhouse in the Immortal Emperor Realm.
Beyond that, she could no longer divine, not even as an Empress, leading the Guanghan Empress to speculate that it involved the fourth step.
As an Immortal Empress, she could see through the past and future of all beings at a glance, and no secret could be hidden from an Immortal Empress.
The Guanghan Empress had divined that, with her strength, she was actually incapable of slaying Han Li, even though he was merely a Quasi Emperor at the moment.
No matter what method she used, she couldn’t eliminate Han Li.
Even if she erased Han Li from all timelines, he would reappear and then grow to become an unrivaled Immortal Emperor.
This was an unstoppable great trend!
Therefore, the Guanghan Empress felt that Han Li could possibly be a fourth-step being.
Only those who had transcended the Immortal Emperor Realm, transcended the third step, and stepped into the fourth step had such tremendous power.
Thus, the Guanghan Empress made a decision.
Her true self took action, using Great Divine Power and mana to conceal Han Li; from now on, even ordinary Immortal Emperors would not be able to spy on Han Li’s fate.
With her strength, there were very few in the Taichu Realm who could break her isolation, and they would need an important medium.
Moreover, as soon as someone tried to divinate Han Li’s fate, the Guanghan Empress would know instantly.
The Guanghan Empress did this, of course, to step into the fourth step.
From the future scenes, it could be seen that she was Han Li’s true Dao Companion, below whom were all Han Li’s cherished wives and concubines in status.
If Han Li were to return to the fourth step in the future, then it was very likely that she could also break through with Han Li’s help.
Another reason was to guard against other Immortal Emperors, to prevent them from discovering Han Li prematurely and making a move against him.
Even though the Guanghan Empress knew that all methods would not kill Han Li, she was still somewhat worried.
The behind-the-scenes mastermind of the Yuankun Domain was an Immortal Emperor, or rather, an Emperor of Heaven, a former Emperor of the previous court.
The Guanghan Empress had clashed with the former Emperor of Heaven during the battle when the Old Heavenly Court fell, being slightly inferior.
But after so many years, she now believed herself to be no less than the former Emperor of Heaven.
The Guanghan Empress worried that the former Emperor of Heaven’s schemes might involve Han Li.
Even though Han Li could resolve them, there would still be some twists and turns.
As Han Li’s future Dao Companion, she felt it was her duty to assist him.
With her protection, Han Li’s future could be free of worries, and he could grow smoothly and unimpeded.
Even if the former Emperor of Heaven noticed something amiss, without knowing the importance of Han Li, would he dare to battle her?
The former Emperor of Heaven’s secret plotting within the Yuankun Domain could be deemed very covert, yet it could not be concealed from other Immortal Emperors and the current Emperor of Heaven naturally knew as well, but no one acted.
The current situation in the Heavenly Court was also in a state of balance.
The Emperor of Heaven wanted to completely eliminate the former Emperor to eliminate future troubles, but he could not find his whereabouts, even through the Yuankun Domain.
Moreover, there were few Immortal Emperors willing to obey the command of the Emperor of Heaven, who also did not dare to engage in a fight to the death with the former Emperor, otherwise he could very well become the new former Emperor of Heaven.
Of course, the former Emperor of Heaven did not dare to show himself openly, or else many Immortal Emperors would still target him.
If he stayed hidden, everyone would turn a blind eye.

Chapter 638: Chapter 249: Breaking Off the Engagement!
The New Child of Destiny?
Different Choices!

Han Li’s Exclusive Immortal Body!_1 Yuankun Domain, Fenghu Divine Province.
...
Daliang Empire, Black Dragon City.
Black Dragon City is a major city in the northern border of the Daliang Empire, bustling and teeming with strong figures, including plenty of Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmasters.
The Yan Family is one of the four great clans of Black Dragon City, immensely powerful and ranked second, with a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster seated within.
At this moment, inside the Yan Family’s main hall, the atmosphere was extremely heavy.
“Does it have to be this way?”
The man seated at the head was a middle-aged man looking at the three figures in the hall, his tone tinged with a hint of anger.
“Yan Family head, you know this isn’t up to me, nor is it up to you, we have no choice.”
The one answering the Yan Family head was an elder in black clothes, his eyes and brows exuding authority, clearly accustomed to a high position.
He was the Shen Family’s Great Elder, Shen Wen.
Among the four great families in Black Dragon City, Yan Family was ranked second, and the Shen Family was ranked first!
“What if I don’t agree?”
The head of the Yan Family clenched his fists tightly, his tone cold, his eyes filled with humiliation, anger, and unwillingness.
Standing next to the Shen Family’s Great Elder was a young-looking cultivator in purple robes.
Hearing this, he said indifferently, “Then the Yan Family will be annihilated in an instant.”
The young man in purple spoke plainly, his demeanor haughty, his words forceful and domineering.
A murderous intent flickered in the depths of the Yan Family head’s eyes.
After glancing at another figure beside the Shen Family’s Great Elder, he addressed Shen Wen gravely, “Shen Wen, do you share this opinion?”
While the atmosphere in the main hall was becoming increasingly tense,
in Black Dragon City, a joyful young man in brocaded clothes was swiftly making his way toward the Yan Family residence.
He was eager to share the great news with his father.
He was the eldest son of the head of the Yan Family, named Yan Nanxiao, a renowned prodigy in Black Dragon City.
Even in the vast Daliang Empire, he held a respectable reputation.
Yan Nanxiao, at only twenty-one this year, possessed Fourth Grade aptitude and had already reached the peak of the Pihai Realm, but this was merely what the outside world knew.
In fact, Yan Nanxiao stumbled upon a fortuitous encounter years ago, his aptitude rising to Third Grade.
His cultivation had already broken through to the Gangyuan Realm, and he was close to the latter stages of the Gangyuan Realm now.
Today, Yan Nanxiao had chanced upon a piece of bronze fragment in the city that he felt was quite extraordinary.
After haggling with the stall owner, he finally purchased it for one hundred and thirty-five Lower Grade Spirit Stones.
After the transaction was successful, a sly smile appeared on the stall owner’s face.
He’d managed to swindle another gullible youth.
He had bought the bronze fragment for half a Lower Grade Spirit Stone and had tested it; it was only somewhat hard.
The profit of over a hundred times had the stall owner’s face nearly splitting with glee.
Passing cultivators gave Yan Nanxiao sympathetic looksâ€”it was clear who was the naive rich kid, easily fooled despite his wealth.
But Yan Nanxiao didn’t see it that way.
When he had accidentally glanced at the piece of bronze, he had felt it was extraordinary and upon obtaining it, discovered a fleeting warm flow.
That’s why Yan Nanxiao decided to buy it and then left without looking back.
The moment he turned around, a smile emerged on his face.
Every five breaths, Yan Nanxiao could feel a warm flow through the bronze fragment in his palm, firmly believing it to be a treasure.
Perhaps it was part of a Heaven Rank Artifact or even a Divine Weapon, its value far exceeding a hundred and more Lower Grade Spirit Stones; if it was part of an imperial weapon, then he would be truly fortunate.
Therefore, Yan Nanxiao was in a hurry to return home, hoping for his father, a Great Grandmaster of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, to appraise it with his extensive knowledge and experience.
But just as he reached the street where the Yan Family resided, Yan Nanxiao saw a family servant rushing out in a panic, his face filled with urgency.
A shadow crossed Yan Nanxiao’s eyesâ€”could something have happened to the family?
Yan Nanxiao quickly approached and stopped the family servant, asking in a deep voice, “A Yong, what’s happened that has you in such a hurry?”
Upon seeing Yan Nanxiao, relief washed over the servant’s face.
He hurriedly said, “Young Master, it’s terrible.
I was on my way to find you.
You should hurry back and see for yourself.”
“Talk as we walk.”
Yan Nanxiao’s pupils contracted as he pulled A Yong and quickly returned to the Yan Family.
“Young Master, I passed by the main hall earlier and saw the Shen Family’s young miss and the Great Elder there.
I happened to hear their purpose.
It seems like they want to annul an engagement, so you should hurry back.”
Yan Nanxiao let go of A Yong, his blood boiling with rage, the joy on his face replaced by shock and fury.
He dashed into the Yan Family home and arrived at the main hall.
He was about to enter when he heard his father confront the Shen Family’s Great Elder with “What if I don’t agree?” Yan Nanxiao stomped his foot and stopped outside for the moment.
Listening to the conversation inside, Yan Nanxiao’s face was expressionless, but his heart burned with rage.
Inside the main hall,
The Shen Family’s Great Elder sighed.
Just as the young man in purple was about to speak, the Great Elder shook his head at him, signifying that he would handle it.
The young man in purple huffed coldly but did not overstep his place.
“Yan Ge, you may take this as my opinion.
I hope you won’t act recklessly, as the consequences are more than you can bear,” said the Shen Family’s Great Elder somberly.
He and the head of the Yan Family were considered friends with a deep relationship.
Before this incident, the Shen Family and Yan Family’s relationship had been good, jointly dominating over half of Black Dragon City’s resources.
It was precisely because of this that Shen Wen had personally come to the Yan Family to call off the marriage.
He hoped to give Yan Ge an explanation, to leave him some dignity.
Otherwise, Shen Wen could have simply notified the Yan Family with a message, unilaterally breaking off the engagement.
Even if the Yan Family was dissatisfied, unwilling, or angry, what could they do?
The Shen Family was already somewhat stronger than the Yan Family, and, moreover, the order to annul the marriage came from the main house.
The Shen Family branch in Black Dragon City had to execute this, and anyone who dared to block it would be suppressed.

chapters.content:
Chapter 639: Chapter 249: Breaking Off the Engagement!
The New Child of Destiny?
Different Choices!

Different Choices!
Han Li’s Exclusive Immortal Body!_2 “`
“Hahaha~”
Yan Ge laughed out of frustration, stood up, and released the aura of a Myriad Phenomena Realm Great Grandmaster without any reservation.
...
His expression turned extremely cold.
Yan Ge’s indifferent gaze swept over the purple-robed young man and the Great Elder of the Shen Family, before it settled on another figure in the hallâ€”a petite and stunningly beautiful woman dressed in a light blue gown.
His eyes softened somewhat as he asked in a deep voice,
“Youchu, I want to know what you’re thinking?”
Yan Ge knew some of Shen Youchu’s background, but he never cared about it before.
The Yan and Shen families had a good relationship, and his eldest son, Yan Nanxiao, and Shen Youchu had known each other since childhood, having engaged to marry at a young age.
The families had agreed to wait until both Yan Nanxiao and Shen Youchu broke through to the God Refining Realm before marrying.
Yan Ge had been looking forward to this, knowing how much his son Yan Nanxiao liked Shen Youchu and thinking highly of their union.
But he never expected the Shen Family to give him such a “surprise”!
Yan Ge was extremely angry but still rational.
After the Great Elder of the Shen Family explained Shen Youchu’s true identity and the intentions of the Shen Family’s main branch, he knew today’s matter wouldn’t be easy to resolve.
If he agreed to the annulment, how could he face his eldest son, Yan Nanxiao?
If he refused to annul the marriage, the Shen Family in Tiannan City might become furious, and all members of the Yan Family could possibly die.
The main branch of the Shen Family was an enormous entity; they were not someone the Yan Family could afford to offend, so he wanted to hear Shen Youchu’s thoughts.
If Shen Youchu also intended to annul the marriage…
Shen Youchu was wearing a light blue gown, with a delicate and graceful waist, her beauty was unparalleled, and her demeanor was like that of a fairy, as if she stepped right out of a painting.
Feeling the gazes converging on her, Shen Youchu pursed her thin red lips and remained silent.
She was born into the Shen Family of Tiannan City, where her father was the current family head.
Wanting to give her a quiet and warm childhood, he had sent her to the Shen Family’s branch in Black Dragon City.
Later, Shen Youchu developed a liking for Yan Nanxiao from the Yan Family.
The two gradually became good friends, and she even secretly engaged herself to Yan Nanxiao without her father’s knowledge.
Shen Youchu knew that marrying her would be difficult for Yan Nanxiao, given the disparity in power between their families, but she went ahead with the engagement anyway.
She knew she wouldn’t be able to stay in Black Dragon City for many years and would eventually return to Tiannan City.
If Yan Nanxiao truly liked her, he would certainly work hard in his cultivation to seek her hand in marriage with great glory, just like those recorded in ancient histories.
But unforeseen events occurred, leading to changes in Shen Youchu’s thoughts, forcing her to reconsider.
Chengsheng Mountain emerged out of nowhere, becoming the First Power in the Endless Yuankun Domain, with numerous powers seeking to align with Han Mansion of Chengsheng Mountain, hoping to rapidly rise in status, including the Shen Family.
Fenghu Divine Province was one of the thirty-six Divine Provinces under the rule of Qianyuan Divine Province in the Ancient Era.
After the great calamity, it became independent, but now it seems to be aligning itself once again.
The First Power in the Yuan Kun Realm was located in Qianyuan Divine Province, bringing back its former splendor.
As the strongest power, it would govern a large number of Divine Provinces as its territory.
Soon, the thirty-six Divine Provinces surrounding Qianyuan Divine Province would one by one voluntarily submit to Chengsheng Mountain, including Fenghu Divine Province’s turn to undergo this process.
During this allegiance movement, each Divine Province’s major powers are eagerly preparing to curry favor with the Long-Living Supreme of Chengsheng Mountain.
The simplest and most direct way to do this is to offer wives and concubines to the Long-Living Supreme.
The Shen Family of Tiannan City was a Divine Yuan Realm Power, and the family head was only an Emperor Wu at the True Martial Realm.
This decision was made by the Divine Yuan Realm ancestor, and all the other Emperor Wus at the True Martial Realm agreed, leaving the family head with no right to object.
When selecting beautiful female cultivators, the Shen Family only had three who met the requirements, after all, Han Li’s criteria for taking wives and concubines were very high.
Among these three, one was of Fourth Grade talent, and one was of Third Grade talent; both were extremely beautiful and met the standards of Long-Living Supreme’s concubines.
The last one was Shen Youchu, who had Second Grade talent and was even more beautiful than the other two, fully meeting the standards of the Long-Living Supreme’s wife.
Sending two concubines was of little use to the Long-Living Supreme, but one wife and two concubines would be of great significance.
Thus, this matter was decided, and the three women, including Shen Youchu, would be sent to Chengsheng Mountain to gain the greatest benefits for the Shen Family.
The family head of the Shen Family naturally didn’t want to send his own daughter away, but he also didn’t object.
To marry the Long-Living Supreme as a Dao companion was an immense honor, benefiting not only the Shen Family but him personally and Shen Youchu immensely.
The family head of the Shen Family decided to bring Shen Youchu back early.
She naturally disagreed, as she had already secretly set her marriage with Yan Nanxiao and did not wish to marry off to Qianyuan Divine Province.
Upon learning of this, the family head of the Shen Family was enraged.
Even without the matter of Chengsheng Mountain, he would not have agreed to this marriage.
So, he personally went to Black Dragon City in the Daliang Empire to have a face-to-face discussion with Shen Youchu, laying out the pros and cons.
In the end, Shen Youchu still agreed to annul her marriage with Yan Nanxiao.
After a long silence, Shen Youchu finally spoke up, “Uncle Yan, this is also my intention…”
She knew that saying this would be a great humiliation to the Yan Family and a severe blow to Yan Nanxiao, but Shen Youchu had no choice.
This matter was decided by the Divine Yuan Realm ancestor and the various Emperor Wus at the True Martial Realm.
Her father had no place to oppose it, and he didn’t object either.
As the family head of the Shen Family put it, if she didn’t agree and insisted on being with Yan Nanxiao, it would only harm Yan Nanxiao and the Yan Family.
The Shen Family would never allow such a thing to happen.
Should it come to pass, the Divine Yuan Realm ancestor would personally eliminate the Yan Family and Yan Nanxiao, and even the Black Dragon City branch would suffer the consequences.

Han Li’s Exclusive Immortal Body!_3 Furthermore, the Shen Family’s patriarch will also be implicated, stripped of his position, and confined to the forbidden area behind the mountain to be punished for a thousand years.
...
In order to protect her father, and to protect Yan Nanxiao so that the Yan Family would not perish, Shen Youchu struggled and hesitated before finally agreeing.
“No!”
Before Shen Youchu could utter her last word, Yan Nanxiao burst in, his eyes bloodshot, looking incredulously at the girl in the light blue dress.
“…decision.”
At his words, Shen Youchu’s body trembled slightly as she struggled to maintain her composure and finished her last word.
“Great Elder, cousin, let’s go.”
After a pause, Shen Youchu said softly, then turned to leave without casting a glance at Yan Nanxiao, afraid that she wouldn’t be able to restrain herself.
“Stop, Shen Youchu, explain to me, have you forgotten our agreement?”
Yan Nanxiao shouted hoarsely, extending his arms in an attempt to stop Shen Youchu, but was instead blocked.
“Kid, don’t be mistaken and do not disgrace yourself,” said the young man in purple, placing a hand on Yan Nanxiao’s shoulder, his voice light.
Yan Nanxiao’s strength erupted as he desperately struggled to break free from the control of the young man in purple, but to no avail.
A chill flashed in the eyes of the young man in purple, tempted to slap Yan Nanxiao to death, but ultimately he restrained himself, remembering Shen Youchu’s warning that she would speak ill of him if he killed Yan Nanxiao after she was wed to the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
Shen Youchu didn’t look at Yan Nanxiao and walked straight out of the grand hall, a silent tear slipping from the corner of her eye.
Seeing this, the Great Elder of the Shen Family sighed and shook his head slightly, yet said nothing.
“Release him,” came the cold voice of Yan Ge, his presence locking onto the young man in purple.
With a cold huff, the young man in purple injected a surge of True Yuan into Yan Nanxiao’s body, then threw him aside and departed with Shen Youchu.
Yan Ge, though powerful, did not intimidate him, but he also did not wish to complicate matters further.
Today’s mission was accomplished, and a bright future awaited him.
“Pfft~”
Yan Nanxiao collapsed to his knees, his mind filled with the image of Shen Youchu’s heartless departure.
Even as he spat blood incessantly, he paid it no mind.
Yan Ge quickly rushed to Yan Nanxiao’s side, propped him up, and infused him with a massive amount of True Yuan to expel the foreign True Yuan and heal his son.
While physical injuries could be healed, Yan Ge found himself unable to mend the wounds of the heart and spirit.
So Yan Ge stood there, supporting his son, his expression grim and silent, planning to have a talk with Yan Nanxiao after he had somewhat recovered.
Neither noticed that some of the blood Yan Nanxiao had spat out inadvertently stained the bronze shard in his hand, which then disappeared.
…..
In the Qianyuan Divine Province, on Chengsheng Mountain.
It was well past dawn when Han Li arrived at Chengdao Peak.
Looking at the dawn light in the sky and the rising sun, Han Li’s face bore a smile.
The thought of the cultivation he had accumulated made Han Li’s heart burn with anticipation.
Although he had spent much in the past thirty years, what remained was still an astronomical figure.
Just a little longer, until the descendants of the Han Mansion exceeded one million in number and he received that extremely generous reward, then he would have enough cultivation to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm and even cultivate to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm in one go.
After breaking through to the Quasi Emperor’s Sixth Heaven, Han Li hadn’t continued to advance.
He saved his cultivation, as he realized that there was no need to rush the breakthroughs as long as he had enough Immortal Qi, Immortal Stones, and so on.
Therefore, Han Li held back, planning to accumulate more cultivation, to temper himself further in the Quasi Emperor realm, and then advance to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm in one stroke.
By then, even without learning any new Powerful Martial Techniques, his combat ability would be strong enough to break into the Heavenly Immortal realm, become a War Immortal, and achieve the long-coveted goal of supreme beings like Empress Yuanchu of the Yuankun Domain.
And with mastery over even more Powerful Martial Techniques, his combat ability would surge even higher.
After all, he had already crafted his own unique Immortal Body over the past thirty years!
