This was a tailor-made physique that perfectly matched one’s cultivation techniques, martial skills, Primordial Spirit, physique, and so on, allowing one’s strength to be fully leveraged and even unleash greater combat ability.
Han Li’s exclusive Immortal Body was called the Chaos Body, which cost him a total of 60,000 Physique Points, emptying his reserves.
There was only one source of Physique Points, and that was through the birth of offspring with special physiques.
When Han Li was a mortal, for every King Physique offspring born, he would gain 10 Physique Points; for every Emperor Physique offspring, 100 Physique Points; and for each Immortal Physique offspring, 1000 Physique Points.
However, to date, Han Li did not have any offspring with an Immortal Body; instead, there were about three thousand with King and Emperor Bodies, mostly King Bodies, maintaining a ratio of three to one.
Because after Han Li gave birth to King Physique offspring, the Physique Points he could gain would decrease by 90%, and if it was an Emperor Physique, it would decrease again by 90%, the same applied for Immortal Bodies, which was why Han Li had not previously created an exclusive physique for himself.
This could be somewhat troublesome as it led to a decrease in the number of special physiques born among his descendants, but this was considered worthwhile compared to obtaining drastically reduced rewards after gaining a physique.
Otherwise, the Physique Points he had accumulated would probably only be enough to create an exclusive Emperor Body, which required 6,000 Physique Points.
If only one parent had a special physique, the chances of bearing offspring with special physiques were undeniably much smaller, after all, even if both parents had special physiques, it wasn’t guaranteed to have offspring with special physiques.
Therefore, Han Li decided to work on both fronts, ensuring he was strong on either hand.
Over the past thirty years, Han Li had been searching for beautiful female practitioners with special physiques to marry into the Chengsheng Mountain, constantly finding new sources.
As his strength gradually became public, this task undoubtedly became much easier; there were even Loose Cultivators who volunteered to cast themselves into his arms.
On the other hand, Han Li helped his original beloved wives and concubines, such as Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Ling Lingshuang, Jiang Baiye, Xue Yueqing, Li Mingmeng, and others, to give birth to offspring with special physiques.
To achieve this goal, the Life-Prolonging Furnace had been running non-stop for the past thirty years, resulting in many of Han Li’s beloved wives and concubines as well as descendants with special physiques.
Han Li could also use the System to generate physiques for others, though doing so was much more expensive than activating a physique for himself.
Gifting a King Physique would cost 130 Physique Points, an Emperor Physique 1,300 Physique Points, and an Immortal Physique 13,000 Physique Points; thankfully, the cost did not increase.
Han Li had also spent a lot of his accumulated Physique Points in this area, gifting special physiques to his beloved wives and concubines but not to his descendants, mainly because it was too expensive, and he did not have enough Physique Points.
His descendants could slowly birth their own through the Life-Prolonging Furnace.
After all, descendants born with special physiques were all natural talents, most of whom focused on diligent cultivation and seldom took wives or had children early on.
Gifting them was not cost-effective and would not lead to an increase in Physique Points.
On the other hand, gifting it to beloved wives and concubines was different.
They could continue to have children, and each new offspring had a chance to possess a special physique.
This way, the Physique Points Han Li accumulated would keep increasing.
For the time being, Han Li would gift the Emperor Body to his wives and the King Physique to his concubines, planning to evolve their physiques further when he had more Physique Points in the future.
The order of gifting was arranged according to the sequence of their marriage to Han Li.
For example, as Lu Tianxiang was the first wife and only had a King Physique, Han Li directly evolved her to an Emperor Body, saving a considerable amount of Physique Points.
If there were already wives with an Emperor Physique or concubines with a King Physique, they would be skipped.
After the battle two years ago, Han Li realized his deficiencies, which led him to decide to create an exclusive physique for himself; another reason was that he had accumulated enough Physique Points.
With many beloved wives, concubines, and descendants with physiques, it was his turn now.
He couldn’t be bothered to evolve step by step, choosing instead to directly create an Immortal Body, fitting for his status.
After spending a total of 60,000 Physique Points, Han Li’s reserves were completely emptied, but fortunately, he had accumulated quite a few more over these two years.
Initially, Han Li thought that after obtaining an Immortal Body, the Physique Points reward for bearing King Physique offspring would shrink to 0.1, but in reality, it remained at 1 point; the reward for Emperor Physique fixed at 10 points, and presumably 100 points for Immortal Physique.
Once he had his Immortal Body, the number of his newly born children with King and Emperor Physiques greatly increased, with a ratio of about 2 to 3.
Han Li naturally welcomed this development, as he had always been committed to expanding Han Mansion into an everlasting noble family, overseeing all realms.
His current goal was to dominate the Yuankun Domain, using the strength of Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion to overshadow the entire Yuankun Domain, which seemed achievable.
After all, he had thousands of beloved wives, concubines, and descendants possessing King and Emperor Bodies.
As these people grew up, they would become thousands of Saints, Quasi Emperors, and Great Emperors.
Of course, to nurture so many powerhouses, endless resources were needed, so Han Li paid special attention to the Four Arts of Cultivation, constantly striving to earn more resources.
Moreover, Han Li was intentionally spreading his influence, preparing to gradually take over the territories of the surrounding Thirty-three Divine Provinces.
With an expansion of territories, they could seize more cultivation resources, thereby supporting the development of Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion.
The neighboring Thirty-three Divine Provinces were only a temporary measure.
Once assimilated, Han Li’s ultimate goal was to occupy at least seventy-two subsidiary Divine Provinces and at most one hundred and eight Divine Provinces.
These would be directly controlled territories, allowing access to each Divine Province’s various veins of minerals, medicinal herbs, and taxation from all forces, while other Divine Provinces would be targeted for market domination to acquire more cultivation resources.

chapters.title: Chapter 642
chapters.content:
Chapter 642: Chapter 250 Chaos Body!
Inferior to me by a billion points!
New treasure chest gameplay!
How much cultivation have I accumulated?_2 Chapter 642: Chapter 250 Chaos Body!
Inferior to me by a billion points!
New treasure chest gameplay!
How much cultivation have I accumulated?_2 Chengsheng Mountain is indeed the First Power in the Endless Yuankun Domain, possessing such confidence and status, even a small place like White Emperor City holds jurisdiction over the territories of fifty-one Divine Provinces.
...
“Huff~”
After exhaling a long breath, Han Li pondered for a moment and opened his Physique panel.
[Physique Panel]
Physique: Chaos Body (Immortal Body)
Physique Points: 1858 points
Physique to be activated: [King Body], [Emperor Body], [Immortal Body]…
(Click to expand for details)
Available Physique to bestow: None
Physique Evolution: Chaos Body (Immortal Body Second Stage)[Inactive]
Shaping Physique: [Usable]
….
Han Li’s gaze swept over the first few items, landing on the Physique Evolution category, and after detailed inspection, he let out a slight sigh.
Although he possessed a Chaos Body of Immortal Body rank, it was only at the first stage of the Immortal Body, corresponding to the rank of a Heavenly Immortal, and it was still incomplete.
A complete form would only be activated upon becoming a Heavenly Immortal.
According to the realm classifications in the Immortal Domain, the Immortal Body is divided into seven stages, and possessing the seventh stage Immortal Body is truly remarkable.
That would be an Immortal Body of Immortal Emperor Level.
An Immortal Emperor’s body is in close harmony with the Dao, perfectly integrated within it, forming an Immortal Body on its own, far beyond what a Heavenly Immortal’s Immortal Body can compare to.
One embodies the Dao at the Immortal Emperor Rank, while the other is merely at the Heaven Immortal Rank level; the difference between them is immense, beyond measure.
“Damn, that’s expensive.”
Han Li looked at the number of Physique Points needed to evolve the Chaos Body from the first stage of Immortal Body to the second stage and couldn’t help but grunt.
100,000 Physique Points!
Yes, one hundred thousand Physique Points, Han Li almost thought he had seen it wrong.
Activating any Immortal Body cost him only 10,000 points, and shaping a unique Immortal Body cost only 60,000 points, yet evolving to the next stage required a hundred thousand points.
Therefore, Han Li decided to temporarily remain at the first stage of the Immortal Body and focus on producing more offspring with the Immortal Body, gradually accumulating enough points.
Another method was to elevate his realm to that of a True Immortal, which would naturally evolve his Chaos Body to the second stage of the Immortal Body.
Seeing such an exorbitant price, Han Li instantly lost interest in system-based evolution.
It was better to wait until his cultivation was sufficient to directly break through to True Immortal, driving the evolution of his Chaos Body.
Those accumulated Physique Points would be used to shape the physique of his beloved wife, concubines, and offspring, evolving their physiques.
Han Li felt this was the correct way to use them.
After contemplating, Han Li clicked on the “Physique to be Activated,” and within it, he chose the Immortal Body.
Countless Immortal Bodies appeared on the virtual screen before Han Li’s eyes.
His gaze swept over and quickly found the target, Immortal Body: Chaos Body!
The System also had a Chaos Body to be activated, just different from Han Li’s Chaos Body.
The former carries the Dao of Chaos.
Those born with a Chaos Body naturally resonate closely with the myriad Daos, better comprehending the myriad laws and Daos.
The latter carries all Daos, able to wield myriad laws, commanding myriad Daos directly.
To be accurate, Han Li’s physique should be called the Myriad Dao Immortal Body, but he was too lazy to name it, thinking that since his cultivation technique was called [Chaos Scripture], he decided to name his physique Chaos Body.
It’s worth mentioning that Han Li’s cultivation technique had also been upgraded to the level of Immortal Scripture, currently at the peak of the Heavenly Immortal Scripture, still some way from advancing to True Immortal Scripture.
Even at the Sixth Heaven of the Quasi Emperor, Han Li was able to possess the combat ability of the Sixth Heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
His cultivation technique and physique played a substantial role in this, in addition to martial skills and divine weapons.
Han Li then opened another information panel.
[Name]: Han Li
[Age]: 281 years old
[Realm]: Sixth Heaven of the Quasi Emperor
[Talent]: Second Grade of Immortal Grade
[Physique]: Chaos Body (Immortal Body First Stage)
[Cultivation Technique]: Chaos Scripture (Heavenly Immortal Scripture)
[Martial Skills]: Seven Annihilations Undying Body, Tai Yin Destroying Realm Finger, Nine Dao Stepping Heaven Walk, Opening Heaven Palm…
[Divine Sense]: Sixth Stage
After mulling it over, Han Li closed the information panel and compared himself with the nine supreme beings of the Yuan Kun Realm.
All nine of these beings have cultivated to the ultimate pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, known as supreme beings, at least practicing Heavenly Immortal scriptures, masters of many Immortal Grade martial skills, with Immortal Grade talents, Immortal Bodies, and also possessing Divine Sense.
It can be said that each one is a supreme genius overshadowing the era.
“They are all very strong, just a tiny bit inferior to me.”
With this thought, a brilliant smile spread across Han Li’s face.
“Still a bit more to go,” Han Li opened the cultivation panel to glance at the accumulated cultivation.
In the past thirty years, he had accumulated more than a million years’ worth of cultivation, though he definitely didn’t have that much now, as it was continuously being consumed.
From the first heaven of the Tongxuan Realm to the peak of the ninth heaven, then breaking through the Heavenly Abyss to forge the realm, using the Primordial Spirit to support the Heavenly Abyss; only then could one ascend to Saint Abyss Realm;
From the first heaven of Saint Abyss Realm to the peak of the ninth heaven, then drawing a strand of personal martial Dao from heaven and earth to inscribe upon one’s Primordial Spirit, body, and True Spirit; only then could one advance to the Quasi Emperor Domain.
And then, breaking through continuously from the first heaven of the Quasi Emperor to the Sixth Heaven, allowing the strand of Dao drawn from the universe to gradually strengthen and progressively perfect.
Each of these steps required a massive amount of cultivation, especially after advancing to the Saint Abyss Realm and Quasi Emperor Domain; each ascension and breakthrough into a Big Realm demanded a vast amount of cultivation for support.
Even though Han Li’s talent had gradually improved to the First Grade of Immortal Grade, the Second Grade of Immortal Grade over the years, reducing the amount of cultivation needed, it was still an astronomical figure for other cultivators.

chapters.title: Chapter 643
chapters.content:
Chapter 643: Chapter 250 Chaos Body!
Inferior to me by a billion points!
New treasure chest gameplay!
How much cultivation have I accumulated?_3 Chapter 643: Chapter 250 Chaos Body!
Inferior to me by a billion points!
New treasure chest gameplay!
How much cultivation have I accumulated?_3 “`
Secondly, Han Li spent a massive amount of cultivation resources to fully master high-level martial arts techniques he had found, thereby perfecting his ultimate martial path.
...
Then, Han Li also spent a vast amount of cultivation resources on opening treasure boxes, counting by tens of thousands of years.
The system’s first upgrade introduced the treasure box function, which granted one free opportunity to open a treasure box annually and three paid opportunities monthly.
After the system’s third upgrade, the treasure box function was optimized, adjusting various rules.
From that point on, Han Li had one free opportunity to open a treasure box each month, amounting to 360 times over thirty years; he never missed out and indeed opened quite a few valuable items.
The rules for paid treasure box openings were also adjusted, increasing from three times a month to ten times, with the required cultivation resources changing accordingly.
The first time required 1 year’s worth of cultivation, the second 5 years, the third 10 years, the fourth 50 years, the fifth 100 years, the sixth 500 years, the seventh 1,000 years, the eighth 5,000 years, the ninth 10,000 years, and the tenth 50,000 years.
According to the new rules, the more times the treasure box was opened, the higher the probability of obtaining various treasures, with the chance resetting monthly.
In this way, there were a total of eleven opportunities to open treasure boxes in a month, one free and ten paid, adding up to 132 opportunities in a year.
If opening the treasure box for the first time had a 1% chance to obtain a True Immortal weapon, the second time 2%, the third time 3%, with each treasure box opening the probability would increase by 1%, reaching an 11% chance to obtain a True Immortal weapon on the 11th attempt.
Han Li thought this was quite good; only after spending gold to increase the drop rate could one attract more to continue spending.
A drop rate that never changes is a true money pit.
Since the optimization of the treasure box function, Han Li began to spend progressively more cultivation resources on it.
He used to open a treasure box only once a month, but now he had to open at least six times, and on occasion, even nine times a month.
Thinking back, Han Li felt a sense of ruefulness; previously, he spent 5 years’ worth of cultivation each month to open treasure boxes.
After the function was optimized, he had to spend between 666 to 6666 years’ worth of cultivation every month.
Mostly, Han Li opened treasure boxes six times a month, one free and five paid, only opening nine times when he felt particularly impulsive.
The cultivation resources spent here were literally Han Li’s tears, and thankfully he managed to open many valuable items, otherwise, he would have nowhere to cry.
The benefits of opening at least six treasure boxes each month were clear.
The foundation of Han Mansion grew rapidly, with the treasures from the boxes covering all aspects of cultivation, filling in the gaps in various fields within Han Mansion.
Besides, there was another enhancement to the treasure box function.
Previously, the rank of the treasures obtained from the boxes was based on Han Li’s cultivation level and fluctuated between two ranks.
After the optimization, this rule was removed; the rank of treasures was no longer limited, allowing any rank of treasure to be obtained from the boxes.
Mundane treasures, Yellow Rank Treasures, Profound Rank Treasures…
Emperor Rank Treasures, Heaven Immortal Rank Treasures…
If one was extremely lucky, it was not impossible to obtain Golden Immortal Rank Treasures, Immortal King Rank Treasures, or even Immortal Emperor Rank Treasures.
However, Han Li knew that with the system’s quirks, lower-ranked treasures had a higher drop rate and higher-ranked treasures had a much lower drop rate.
The chance for True Immortal Rank Treasures was just 1%, for Golden Immortal Rank Treasures was only 0.1%, and kept decreasing further, with Immortal Emperor Rank Treasures having a rate so low it was despairing to Han Li.
Fortunately, the damn system knew to offer some consolation to him, its master, stating plainly that each system upgrade would optimize the probabilities of each treasure rank.
The higher the system version, the higher the probabilities of obtaining high-rank treasures.
Those times when Han Li felt impulsive, he was trying his luck to see if he could open a weapon of Golden Immortal Rank or above.
What he wanted most was a weapon, but he never succeeded.
This month had only passed halfway, and Han Li hadn’t opened a single treasure box; he was waiting for the right moment, planning to use metaphysics to battle the drop rates.
After reflecting, Han Li turned his gaze toward that astronomical number of cultivation years.
484,922 years!
PS: There will be a second update tonight.

chapters.title: Chapter 644
chapters.content:
Chapter 644: Chapter 251: Only the Weak Complain!
Yan Nanxiao’s Golden Finger!
The Ancestor Married Again!_1 Chapter 644: Chapter 251: Only the Weak Complain!
Yan Nanxiao’s Golden Finger!
The Ancestor Married Again!_1 480,000 plus years of cultivation.
It seems like a lot, and indeed, it really is a lot.
With such astronomical numbers of cultivation years, he could accomplish many things.
...
Of course, the displayed cultivation years here is the total of all cultivation years accumulated, including the part that reflected back from his descendants.
Although that portion didn’t leave much after being consumed.
Han Li’s goal was to advance from the Quasi Emperor Sixth Heaven to the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm in one go, which required a tremendous amount of cultivation years, and he was still somewhat short of the necessary amount.
This was still because he possessed Immortal Grade second-class talent, which greatly reduced the cultivation years consumed to elevate his realm.
Now at the Quasi Emperor Sixth Heaven, ascending to the peak of Quasi Emperor Ninth Heaven still required 30,000 years of cultivation, which was a full 30,000 years less than what was needed years ago for someone with first-class Immortal Grade talent.
The original consumption of numerous cultivation years to break the shackles between first-class talent and Immortal Grade talent, as well as between Immortal Grade first-class to second-class, was all worth it.
To break through from the pinnacle of Quasi Emperor to the Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm consumed even more cultivation years, needing as many as 100,000 years.
Once in the Heaven Imperial Realm, one’s life span reached a million years.
The cultivation years needed to advance a minor realm during secluded and arduous cultivation also skyrocketed.
Advancing from the first layer of the Heaven Imperial Realm to the third required 40,000 years of cultivation, advancing from the third layer to the Sixth Heaven needed 120,000 years, and from the Sixth Heaven to the peak of the Nine Heavens required 240,000 years of cultivation.
In other words, if Han Li wanted to reach the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm in one go, he would need to consume 530,000 years of cultivation.
Han Li had only accumulated just over 480,000 years of cultivation so far, still falling short by quite a significant 40,000 plus years.
Though the cultivation years needed for realm breakthroughs were substantial, Han Li no longer complained.
At his level of cultivation, being able to breakthrough while lying down, what more could he ask for?
The System calculated each year of cultivation as if spent in secluded and intense cultivation, but could over 500,000 years really be enough to break through to the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm?
Clearly, it was not possible.
But Han Li had the System, which removed the barriers of the cultivation realms; as long as he had enough cultivation years, he could break through.
Other cultivators faced bottlenecks, a blockage that could last tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of years without any progress, which was quite normal.
Only the weak complain, Elder Han was a strong man.
With nearly a million descendants, in at most a year, or possibly even just half a year, he could accumulate the rest of the cultivation years he needed.
There was nothing to complain about.
…….
Fenghu Divine Province, Daliang Empire.
Black Dragon City, Yan Family.
At this moment, the head of the Yan Family, Yan Ge, once again came to this small courtyard, attempting to persuade his eldest son, Yan Nanxiao, to see reason.
This was his sixth visit to this small courtyard.
Since the Shen Family called off the engagement seven days ago, his eldest son, Yan Nanxiao, had been immensely impacted and had never recovered since.
Yan Ge fully understood why Yan Nanxiao was in such a state: love wounded him, love trapped him.
Shen Youqing and Yan Nanxiao were childhood sweethearts, innocent and carefree, but Shen Youqing had suddenly called off the engagement without even looking at Yan Nanxiao, heartlessly turning away from him.
This deeply hurt Yan Nanxiao, but his heart still pined for Shen Youqing, unable to let her go.
Yan Ge had wanted to explain to Yan Nanxiao, but these days his son was too dejected and listless.
Whatever he said was useless, Yan Nanxiao remained blank, not taking in a single word.
After entering the courtyard, Yan Ge immediately saw Yan Nanxiao sitting dejectedly on the ground, leaning against a pillar with a wine pot in his right hand, continuously pouring wine into his mouth, surrounded by a mess of empty wine pots scattered on the ground.
Seeing this scene, Yan Ge’s brows furrowed tightly, and he barked angrily, “Enough!”
“Look at yourself!
Do you still resemble the famous pride of Black Dragon City?”
Yan Ge was greatly dissatisfied, full of the disappointment of “iron not becoming steel,” unable to bear the sight of his son’s degeneration.
If Yan Nanxiao continued this way, not to mention advancing in cultivation, he might even regress.
How could he then take over the Yan Family?
On the day of the broken engagement, he discovered that Yan Nanxiao had hidden his strength, much stronger than what he had shown before, nearing the late stage of the Gangyuan Realm.
At Yan Nanxiao’s age, to have cultivated to the peak of Gangyuan Realm Sixth Heaven was to be counted among the top talents in the entire Daliang Empire, and even in Fenghu Divine Province, he could be called a genius.
If Yan Nanxiao had not encountered this calamity of love, he would have had a good chance of advancing to the True Martial Realm, and possibly restore the glory of the Yan Family.
Love’s trial ensnares, yet if one surpasses it, one’s resolve becomes unbreakable.
The chances of advancing to the True Martial Realm would greatly increase for Yan Nanxiao, and with the right opportunities, he might even break through to the Divine Yuan Realm, becoming a legendary martial emperor.
Yan Nanxiao turned a deaf ear, his eyes lifeless, focused solely on drinking.
In his mind, images constantly alternated.
One moment was the memory of his childhood with Shen Youqing, the next was the memory of her calling off their engagement with utter indifference.
Seeing that Yan Nanxiao showed no response, Yan Ge’s brows knotted into a frown; he wanted to slap Yan Nanxiao awake but couldn’t bring himself to do it.
After watching for a long time, Yan Ge finally said softly, “Don’t you want to take revenge, to know why Shen Youqing called off the engagement?”
At the sound of those words, Yan Nanxiao abruptly looked at him, silent, but a glimmer of hope flashed across his dispirited face.
“Speak up!” Yan Ge demanded discontentedly.
“Why?” came Yan Nanxiao’s hoarse voice.
A hint of joy flashed in Yan Ge’s eyes; it seemed there was an effect.
“What if I said that Shen Youqing actually still likes you?
What do you think?” Yan Ge asked indifferently.
From his perspective, he clearly understood that Shen Youqing was compelled by circumstances since the Great Elder of the Shen Family had confided in him some secrets.
Shen Youqing was protecting Yan Nanxiao.
At that time, there was an outstanding member of the Tiannan City Shen Family present; if Shen Youqing had shown any affection towards Yan Nanxiao, both he and the Yan Family would have suffered consequences.

chapters.title: Chapter 645
chapters.content:
Chapter 645: Chapter 251: Only the Weak Complain!
Yan Nanxiao’s Golden Finger!
The Ancestor Married Again!_2 Chapter 645: Chapter 251: Only the Weak Complain!
Yan Nanxiao’s Golden Finger!
The Ancestor Married Again!_2 The Shen Family of Tiannan City is quite domineering.
Shen Youqing is destined to marry into Chengsheng Mountain, and the Shen Family doesn’t want any other entanglements on her, which might displease the Eternal Sovereign.
If it weren’t for Shen Youqing’s insistence, the Shen Family would have wiped out the Yan Family, a minor clan, long ago.
...
“Hehe~”
Yan Nanxiao sneered emotionlessly, “Then why did she break off the engagement?
Why was she so heartless that day?”
He could not forget Shen Youqing’s ruthless demeanor, which caused him extreme heartache.
Hesitating for a moment, Yan Ge explained the reasons and his own speculations.
“Huff~ Huff~”
Yan Nanxiao’s breathing became more rapid and his face flushed; he shouted, “No, I have to find Youqing.
I need to get some clarity.”
“Are you trying to get the Yan Family killed?”
Yan Ge yelled angrily, thinking that after explaining the situation, Yan Nanxiao would pull himself together, but instead, he was being so reckless.
Rebuked by his father, Yan Nanxiao fell silent and calmed down.
“I’m going to Taibai Divine Province to join White Emperor City.”
After a long while, Yan Nanxiao spoke up decisively.
According to what his father said, Shen Youqing broke off their engagement because the Shen Family of Tiannan City wanted to curry favor with the Eternal Sovereign of Chengsheng Mountain and planned to send three female cultivators from their clan, including Shen Youqing, to become his wives and concubines.
If Shen Youqing had not broken off the engagement with him, the Shen Family would have unhesitatingly destroyed the Yan Family and killed him, while Shen Youqing would still have to marry into Chengsheng Mountain.
Everything Shen Youqing did was to protect him.
Yan Nanxiao was simultaneously elated and saddened; he was too weak to even protect his childhood sweetheart.
Without a word from the Eternal Sovereign, the Shen Family of Tiannan City was already eagerly planning to send daughters to flatter him, hoping to cling to powerful coattailsâ€”this is the power of strength.
That’s why Yan Nanxiao wanted to have great strength.
The Yan Family was too weak to help him, and if they didn’t agree to the breakup, the Yan Family would have been destroyed.
After all, the Yan Family was only a Myriad Phenomena Realm clan of Black Dragon City, and among the entire Daliang Empire, there were many powers of this level.
Even the Daliang Empire itself was only a True Martial Realm force with just five or six True Martial Realm Emperor Wu, not even worth the Shen Family’s attention.
The Fenghu Divine Province didn’t have Quasi Emperor Rank forces, but there were six Saint Abyss Realm Powers with Emperor Weapons to stabilize their fortune.
Yan Nanxiao knew all this, but he had no intention of joining any Saint Abyss Realm Power of the Fenghu Divine Province.
The future of Fenghu Divine Province belonged to Chengsheng Mountain, which would be one of the Divine Provinces governed by Chengsheng Mountain.
How could those Saint Abyss Realm Powers afford to offend Chengsheng Mountain when they couldn’t even curry favor fast enough?
If they knew of his intention, they would probably suppress him at the first opportunity and take him to Chengsheng Mountain to claim credit.
Moreover, the Saint Abyss Realm Powers did not have the heritage to challenge Chengsheng Mountain and could not cultivate him to the level where he could challenge the Eternal Sovereign and snatch back his beloved.
Therefore, Yan Nanxiao wanted to go to Taibai Divine Province, hoping to join White Emperor City.
Although Chengsheng Mountain is the number one force in the Endless Yuankun Domain, it does not lack enemies, and its obvious foes include Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, and White Emperor City, three of the strongest forces.
Yan Nanxiao chose White Emperor City mainly because the enmity between its ruler and Han Li was the deepest.
The White Emperor had been blown apart by Han Li, nearly resulting in his death and extinction, causing White Emperor City to suffer a huge loss.
This was outright mortal enmity!
If he joined White Emperor City, he wouldn’t have to worry about being betrayed, and the White Emperor would train him wholeheartedly since they shared a common enemy.
And Yan Nanxiao had his reasons for being so confident, of course.
During these days, although Yan Nanxiao had been in a daze, he also noticed the reaction of the piece of bronze fused with his palm, which was his biggest source of confidence.
He had felt that the bronze fragment was extraordinary that day, which was why he bought it, intending to bring it home for his father, Yan Ge, to evaluate.
He didn’t expect to encounter Shen Youqing’s breakup and be so devastated that he shut himself off.
In recent days, the bronze fragment had shown some reactions, as if there were voices coming from within it; however, Yan Nanxiao, wallowing in his stupor, did not want to deal with it and would rather drown his sorrows in alcohol.
“Good!”
Yan Ge agreed right away.
It was enough that his eldest son could pull himself together, and if he could truly join White Emperor City, he would have some security for the future.
Yan Ge didn’t believe that Yan Nanxiao had any chance of being accepted by White Emperor Cityâ€”that was a supreme force, and with his Fourth Grade talent, he fell short of even the basic threshold to enter, which required a grade higher.
But it was enough for him to leave Fenghu Divine Province, so as to avoid any scheming by the Shen Family of Tiannan City.
If Shen Youqing were sent away and the Shen Family suddenly attacked, the Yan Family would inevitably face destruction.
As long as Yan Nanxiao left Fenghu Divine Province, the Shen Family wouldn’t be able to pursue him across Divine Provinces.
Upon hearing this, for the first time since the breakup, a smile appeared on Yan Nanxiao’s face.
He clenched his fists tightly, with only one thought in mind.
After becoming stronger, he would ascend Chengsheng Mountain and take back his moonlight.
After resting and preparing for a few days at the Yan Family, Yan Nanxiao set out alone, leaving Black Dragon City and the Daliang Empire, heading for the Sacred City in the Purple Moon Divine Realm.
Taibai Divine Province was very far from Fenghu Divine Province, and there were only two ways to get there.
The first was to take an inter-provincial flying ship, which was slower but cheaper; however, it consumed a lot of time, with over a dozen transfers needed to reach Taibai Divine Province.
The second way was to use a Cross Borders Teleporting Formation, which was fast; although it couldn’t directly reach Taibai Divine Province, it would only take two or three transfers, but it was extremely expensive.
Yan Nanxiao, with his finances, of course, couldn’t afford the Teleportation Formation.
Even if he sold the entire Yan Family, it would still be the case, so he chose to take an inter-provincial flying ship.

chapters.title: Chapter 646
chapters.content:
Chapter 646: Chapter 251: Only the Weak Complain!
Yan Nanxiao’s Golden Finger!
The Ancestor Marries Again!_3 Chapter 646: Chapter 251: Only the Weak Complain!
Yan Nanxiao’s Golden Finger!
The Ancestor Marries Again!_3 Whether it be interstate ships or teleportation arrays, there are only six places in Fenghu Divine Province where one can find them, and those are the Sacred Cities of the Six Great Sacred Lands, which are trade cities specifically built by these powerful domains.
The Daliang Empire lies within the jurisdiction of the Purple Moon Divine Realm, but even so, Black Dragon City is still very far from Purple Moon Divine City, not a distance a Great Master of the Gang Yuan Realm like him could reach.
Therefore, Yan Nanxiao decided to make his way by experiencing trials and hardships, cultivating and tempering himself, seeking fortunes and opportunities, and incidentally amassing wealth along the way, so that he could afford the interstate ship to Taibai Divine Province.
...
Yan Nanxiao’s confidence in joining the White Emperor City, avenging his grudges, and snatching back Shen Youqing has multiplied countless times, stemming from the bronze fragment in his palm.
Over the past few days, he had figured out the effects of the bronze shard.
According to the Artifact Spirit of the bronze shard, its original form was once the famous Jade Talisman of Creation from ancient history.
Although it was a Heavenly Immortal weapon, it possessed power comparable to that of a True Immortal weapon.
The piece Yan Nanxiao obtained was the core of the Jade Talisman of Creation and held the rank of Supreme Grade Emperor weapon, with the power of an ordinary Heavenly Immortal weapon, the bronze appearance simply a disguise.
Yan Nanxiao believed that with the help of the core of the Jade Talisman of Creation, finding its other pieces and rising to prominence was inevitable.
His future was boundless, becoming a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm would be effortless.
His target was to be a Heavenly Immortal, a True Immortal, and then to rule over Chengsheng Mountain, slay the Supreme Ruler Han Li, and reclaim his beloved Silver Moon, Shen Youqing.
…….
When Yan Nanxiao set out on his journey, Han Li was unaware of this minor character.
If he had known about him, he would have directly turned into the arch-villain.
He would arrive in Fenghu Divine Province in person, kill Yan Nanxiao, and then take away the core of the Jade Talisman of Creation.
Currently, Han Li was preparing to marry his new wife.
Of course, this was not Shen Youqing from Fenghu Divine Province; this time, his wife was from Luming Divine Province.
Luming Divine Province borders Qianyuan Divine Province and has already accepted the rule of Chengsheng Mountain, acknowledging its supreme authority.
Luming Divine Province boasts two Quasi Emperor Rank powers and five Saint Abyss Realm Powers, all competing to present a bride to curry favor with the Eternal Supreme Ruler.
The new bride Han Li was about to welcome was named Lu Yuan, from Liangjie Mountain, one of the Quasi Emperor Rank powers of Luming Divine Province, endowed with first-rate talent and a royal physique.
Just ninety-eight this year, Lu Yuan has already cultivated to the early stages of the Divine Yuan Realm.
As a true successor disciple of Liangjie Mountain and a personal disciple of the Quasi Emperor Ancestor, she was given considerable attention and resources were poured into her development.
When Lu Yuan learned of Liangjie Mountain’s intention to offer a bride to the Eternal Supreme Ruler, she volunteered and approached the Quasi Emperor Ancestor with a proposition to marry into Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
The Quasi Emperor Ancestor was somewhat shocked.
Originally, she did not wish for Lu Yuan to marry over.
She had high hopes for Lu Yuan, believing that under her guidance, it was inevitable for Lu Yuan to become a Saint of the Saint Abyss Realm and hopeful to break through to the Quasi Emperor level.
But she was persuaded by Lu Yuan.
Lu Yuan, with her excellent potential and special physique, was sure to hold a high status after marrying into Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
By then, Lu Yuan could use the countless cultivation resources of Chengsheng Mountain, the leading power in Yuan Kun Realm, to swiftly enhance her cultivation.
Her future potential would not be limited to just the Quasi Emperor level.
Having Lu Yuan in Chengsheng Mountain would bring much greater benefits to Liangjie Mountain, far more than the female cultivators she had prepared earlier could offer.
So, after some consideration, she agreed.
The Eternal Supreme Ruler is marrying yet again!
This news spread far and wide in Qianyuan Divine Province and the neighboring Divine Provinces, attracting innumerable powers to Chengsheng Mountain to witness the wedding and offer their congratulations with gifts.
The isolation between Qianyuan Divine Province and the surrounding Divine Provinces had been broken.
Many teleportation formations and interstate ships had been set up, greatly enhancing accessibility and convenience for the powers of each Divine Province to participate in the wedding.
After experiencing many weddings, the powers from other Divine Provinces also felt the strain and finally understood the difficulties faced by the forces of Qianyuan Divine Province.
They had to present precious congratulatory gifts with each wedding attendance; Chengsheng Mountain was truly adept in amassing wealth.
But failing to attend or offer gifts weren’t options either, nor was it acceptable to give gifts that were too light.
The current Chengsheng Mountain was not the inconsequential force it used to be; as the most powerful entity in the Endless Yuankun Domain, who would dare to slight them?
What’s more, they were from the Thirty-six Divine Provinces near Qianyuan Divine Province; to disrespect the Eternal Supreme Ruler of Chengsheng Mountain was to court death.
While other powers suffered, Han Li was extremely pleased.
With each marriage he contracted, not only did he take several beautiful wives and concubines, but he also received a plethora of congratulatory gifts, becoming a significant source of wealth for Chengsheng Mountain.
After the grand wedding, Han Li leisurely made his way to the bridal chamber and became a groom once again.
A poem in his honor read: “The flower path had not been swept for guests, It is today that for you, Penglai is opened!”

chapters.title: Chapter 647
chapters.content:
Chapter 647: Chapter 252: Isn’t This a Bit Inappropriate?
The Proud Empress Huang Yue!
Ninth on the Heavenly Immortal Rank!
The Generous Gesture of Chengsheng Mountain_1 Chapter 647: Chapter 252: Isn’t This a Bit Inappropriate?
The Proud Empress Huang Yue!
Ninth on the Heavenly Immortal Rank!
The Generous Gesture of Chengsheng Mountain_1 At the peak of Chengdao, Han Li and Lu Yuan were nestled together, admiring the sunset on the horizon.
...
The golden twilight embraced the couple, who seemed to be a match made by heaven itself.
It had only been a few days since Han Li wed Lu Yuan, but it felt to him like dozens or even hundreds of days had passed.
There is a saying: “Tomorrow after tomorrow, how many tomorrows there are.
I wait for tomorrow, and all things are delayed.”
Han Li never wasted time; day after day, he toiled diligently, tending to his garden, often cultivating the soil, planting seeds, watering, and fertilizing, to make the flowers bloom and the beauty vie for attention.
“Husband~”
Nestled in Han Li’s arms, Lu Yuan looked up at Han Li with a hint of confusion in her eyes and softly called out to him.
“What’s wrong, Yuan’er?”
Han Li slightly bowed his head, gazing at the flawless visage of the exquisite beauty in his arms, his handsome, jade-like face adorned with a faint smile.
Meeting Han Li’s gaze, Lu Yuan’s face flushed with a touch of shyness, she gently said, “I’m missing my mentor a little.”
The experiences of the past few days made Lu Yuan feel somewhat unreal, as if living in a dream.
After all, she hailed from the Liangjie Mountain, one of the two Quasi Emperor Rank forces in the Luming Divine Province, and she was a direct disciple of the Quasi Emperor.
With broad knowledge, wide perspective, and herself being of extraordinary beauty, she was a woman of unmatched elegance.
In the Luming Divine Province, there was a ranking similar to the Heavenly Immortals, listing all the beautiful female cultivators of the Divine Province.
Lu Yuan was ranked in the top five, indicating her exceptional beauty, which even surpassed Han Li’s standards for a bride by quite a margin.
Those ranked above her were not much different from Lu Yuan, except for having stronger cultivation, with the exception of the one ranked first who was more beautiful by a degree.
That person was her mentor!
The Quasi Emperor of Liangjie Mountain, Shi Yanmeng.
But in Chengsheng Mountain, Lu Yuan found that her looks, figure, and temperament were all quite ordinary, and even the talents and constitutions that she was proud of seemed unremarkable on Chengsheng Mountain, at least among Han Li’s various beloved wives.
Moreover, as Han Li’s wife on Chengsheng Mountain, the benefits, status, and privileges she could enjoy were many times greater than she had anticipated.
Her mentor, Shi Yanmeng, might be revered on Liangjie Mountain, one of the two strongest in the Luming Divine Province, but the resources available for her cultivation paled in comparison to those of her disciple.
So much so that when Lu Yuan discussed the Dao with Han Li, she sometimes entertained a bold thought.
Missing your mentor?
Han Li looked at Lu Yuan with surprise.
It had only been a few days since Lu Yuan came to Chengsheng Mountain, including the time taken to travel through the Cross Borders Teleportation Formation and her days on the mountain, no more than ten days in total.
Missing home and family in less than ten days away from Liangjie Mountainâ€”was her mentor, Shi Yanmeng, her biological mother?
After a bit of internal snark, Han Li couldn’t quite figure out why Lu Yuan said that.
Thinking it over, he suggested, “Shall I issue a decree to have your mentor come to Chengsheng Mountain for an audience?”
He certainly had no intention of making the trip himself, and neither did Lu Yuan, as they were newlyweds, a perfect time to cultivate their relationship.
It could only mean troubling Shi Yanmeng to come to Chengsheng Mountain.
“Would that really be appropriate…”
Surprise flickered in Lu Yuan’s eyes, and she hesitated in response.
Despite her bold idea, she wasn’t sure she could persuade her mentor, who was known to be pure and aloof, stunningly cold and beautiful.
It seemed unlikely she would agree.
If that were the case, it might cause a rift between them, something Lu Yuan didn’t want to see.
“There’s nothing inappropriate about it,”
Han Li said without much thought, his tone casual and confident.
The Divine Province of Luming was one of the provinces governed by Chengsheng Mountain.
Being a power within that province, Liangjie Mountain was a subordinate force to Chengsheng Mountain, so in a way, Lu Yuan’s mentor was also subordinate to him.
“Then…
alright,”
Lu Yuan’s heart fluttered, her eyes brimming with anticipation, as she already began thinking of ways to convince her mentor to stay.
Afterward, the couple continued to cling to each other affectionately on the mountaintop, whispering sweet nothings.
Listening to Han Li’s love talk, Lu Yuan’s face radiated with happiness.
As the sunset died away, Han Li whispered into Lu Yuan’s ear, “Yuan’er…”
At these words, Lu Yuan’s cheeks turned crimson, even the lobes of her ears took on a pink hue, displaying extreme shyness.
She ducked her head, her voice as soft as a mosquito, “I will listen to my husband~”
Han Li laughed heartily, scooping up Lu Yuan and disappearing from the mountaintop.
They entered the ninth layer of the Time-Sky Tower, where Han Li was to impart profound Dao teachings to Lu Yuan, the female Emperor Wu, sharing his knowledge without reservation.
……
The Huangyue Imperial Dynasty.
The Imperial Capital, the Imperial Palace.
The Huangyue Empress, clad in golden armor, stood with her hands behind her back before the palace, her proud figure undulating with grace, with her golden spear beside her.
Gazing towards Xuanshen Sword Mountain to the east, the Huangyue Empress sighed softly.
Turning her gaze westward to Chengsheng Mountain, a fleeting expression of indignation crossed the Empress’s flawless face before vanishing without a trace.
Her feelings toward that man from Chengsheng Mountain were complicated.
That shameless lecher, though less advanced in cultivation and weaker in strength than her, was someone she frustratingly could not handle, even in alliance with Empress Yuanchu.
Between Chengsheng Mountain and Xuanshen Sword Mountain, the two loomed like gigantic burdens over her, though, of course, Chengsheng Mountain didn’t come close to comparing with Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
“Don’t let this Empress find an opportunity,”
Remembering the last words Han Li said to her and Empress Yuanchu two years ago, the Huangyue Empress snorted.
In order to step out and avoid the great calamity of the Yuankun Domain, and incidentally to punish Han Li, the Huangyue Empress had been keeping a low profile for the past two years, refraining from troubling Han Li.
Over these years, she had once again split off a sliver of her Divine Spirit to reincarnate, waiting for this part of her soul to grow.

chapters.title: Chapter 648
chapters.content:
Chapter 648: Chapter 252: Isn’t This a Bit Inappropriate?
The Proud Empress Huang Yue!
Ninth on the Heavenly Immortal Rank!
The Generous Gesture of Chengsheng Mountain_2 Chapter 648: Chapter 252: Isn’t This a Bit Inappropriate?
The Proud Empress Huang Yue!
Ninth on the Heavenly Immortal Rank!
The Generous Gesture of Chengsheng Mountain_2 To prevent any accidents, Empress Huangyue didn’t leave things to chance this time and had already found and retrieved her soul fragment early, allowing it to cultivate under her watchful eye in Kunji Divine Province.
...
“I hope it can be successful,” she mused.
Thinking of the scenarios she had deduced, Empress Huangyue’s heart tightened, feeling the immense pressure and the heavy conscience that came with turbulent waves.
Once the new soul fragment had cultivated to the Heaven Imperial Realm, she would then be able to merge the nine great soul fragments, drastically increasing her own combat ability and attempt to step into the Heavenly Immortal domain in one fell swoop.
However, Empress Huangyue didn’t have absolute certainty of success, mainly because her Primordial Spirit was no longer perfect.
One of her soul fragments had fallen into the hands of that scoundrel Han Li, and although it was just a sliver of her Divine Spirit, sometimes that small difference was critical.
Han Li would not return that soul fragment to her, so she had only two options to achieve her goal.
The first was to ally with several supreme forces, or even all the supreme forces, to march to Chengsheng Mountain, to annihilate Han Li, and to retrieve her soul fragment.
She believed Empress Yuanchu shared the same idea, and although White Emperor City bore a grudge against them, it would likely take action against Han Li.
As for Tianji Pavilion, Solar Empire, Longevity Qin Family, Longevity Ji Family, Western Sky Palace, and Heavenly Cult, whether these six supreme forces would be willing to risk themselves was uncertain; they might take advantage of the situation, but acting as the vanguard was another matter.
Unless the Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, and White Emperor City took the lead against Chengsheng Mountain, the six supreme forces might be willing to help as opportunists.
However, such an action would be detrimental to them, causing severe injury to their vital energies and possibly leading to their complete downfall, much to the benefit of the other supreme forces.
If there was no rush, they could also wait; as Chengsheng Mountain was still rapidly expanding, when it generated significant conflicts with other supreme forces, that would provide the basis for alliance, and the three great powers might not have to be the vanguard.
But this could take tens of thousands of years; could they really afford to wait?
More importantly, Han Li’s strength and Chengsheng Mountain’s power were expanding too rapidly.
Were they to wait tens of thousands of years, or even longer, would Chengsheng Mountain still be something they could contend with?
In less than three hundred years, Chengsheng Mountain had grown immensely; what behemoth would Han Li create with tens of thousands of years to build?
Beyond the first method, Empress Huangyue had a second option, one that she didn’t want to resort to unless absolutely necessary.
That was to trade herself in exchange for the soul fragment.
Han Li had coveted her body for more than a day or two and had even blatantly expressed his desires.
If she willingly married into Chengsheng Mountain and became Han Li’s Dao companion, with the condition of retrieving her soul fragment, she believed Han Li would agree.
After all, she was Empress Huangyue!
Yet, Empress Huangyue desperately did not want to use this method, as it would damage her pride.
She planned to continue waiting, to see if the soul fragment’s growth could make her whole again; if not, she would then make a decision.
On the other side, in Yuanchu Province.
Atop Yuanchu Mountain, Empress Yuanchu, clad in Silver War Armor and wielding a Silver Long Spear, contemplated the same things as Empress Huangyue.
Their thoughts aligned.
After wrestling with the idea, she too decided to wait and see if the situation would turn around; if not, she would have no choice but to…
In Taibai Divine Province, White Emperor City.
The White Emperor was contemplating his life.
He didn’t have the same worries as Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, with no need to fret over soul fragments, as his path was different.
But compared to the two peerless empresses, the White Emperor’s situation was much more pitiable.
While Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu only lost soul fragments, the White Emperor had been killed once by Han Li, causing the Taibai Immortal Realm of White Emperor City to be plundered and its vital energy severely damaged.
Even though he loathed the Supreme Longevity Han Li, he did not entertain thoughts of a desperate fight; instead, he planned to emulate Han Li and be a low-key immortal cultivator.
He intended to keep a low profile until he transformed into a Battle Immortal and then ascended to become a Heavenly Immortal, gaining the strength to confront Han Li.
Before that, he felt he could no longer be conspicuous.
The White Emperor also restrained White Emperor City, ordering its internal forces and disciples to keep a low profile and avoid stirring up trouble.
“I hope there will be some good news,” the White Emperor muttered, his brows furrowed with worry.
The domineering White Emperor of the past, who commanded with authority and strategized over territories, was long gone.
In these two years, the White Emperor had been scheming to enhance the foundation of White Emperor City, but such things couldn’t be rushed and had to be done covertly to avoid attracting the attention of the other supreme forces in Yuankun Domain, especially Chengsheng Mountain.
At present, the biggest disparity between White Emperor City and Chengsheng Mountain lay in the True Immortal weapons.
Their Heavenly Immortal weapons were comparable, while the Heaven Imperial Realm imperial weapons had become less significant.
White Emperor City only possessed Wuxian Palace, a single True Immortal weapon, while Chengsheng Mountain boasted both the Human Dao Sword and Qiankun Bracelet, suppressing White Emperor without contest.
Even if he ascended as a Battle Immortal, it would be hard for him to subdue Chengsheng Mountain; at best, he could only achieve an equal standing.
To confront Chengsheng Mountain, his only choice was to continue enhancing White Emperor City’s foundations.
Thus, the White Emperor had been searching for True Immortal weapons over the past two years.
The vast Yuankun Domain, with its endless expanse built up over countless years, held no small number of True Immortal weapons, yet acquiring them was exceedingly difficult.
True Immortal weapons could mask their presence from destiny, nearly impossible to predict, and could only be found through fate, facing trials and earning recognition.
But to counter Han Li, the White Emperor would send avatars to explore any leads, regardless of their credibility; his main body would stay hidden in the Taibai Immortal Realm, protected by a True Immortal weapon, safe from any threats.

chapters.title: Chapter 649
chapters.content:
Chapter 649: Chapter 252: Isn’t This a Bit Inappropriate?
The Proud Empress Huang Yue!
Ninth on the Heavenly Immortal Rank!
The Generous Gesture of Chengsheng Mountain_3 Chapter 649: Chapter 252: Isn’t This a Bit Inappropriate?
The Proud Empress Huang Yue!
Ninth on the Heavenly Immortal Rank!
The Generous Gesture of Chengsheng Mountain_3 The White Emperor’s goal was to acquire two True Immortal weapons.
...
He knew this was difficult, but no matter how challenging, he was determined to strive toward that direction.
Given Han Li’s cunning nature, it was hard to say whether there was a third True Immortal weapon.
The White Emperor estimated the chances to be fifty-fifty.
Therefore, he needed to ensure that White Emperor City possessed three True Immortal weapons.
That way, even if Chengsheng Mountain did have a third True Immortal weapon, it wouldn’t be able to stop him.
After all, Han Li had not even reached the Heaven Imperial Realm, whereas he was at the absolute summit of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Within at most ten thousand years, he was confident he could transform into a Battle Immortal and ascend to immortality through tribulation.
With a composed demeanor, the White Emperor paced back and forth with his hands behind his back in the Immortal Hall, contemplating another immature idea.
Where had the mysterious powerhouse, who appeared in the Yuankun Domain twenty-some years ago and attacked the top five strongest forces, gone?
That person wielded the number one ranked True Immortal weapon in the Yuankun Domain.
If he could contact this mysterious powerhouse and make use of them, perhaps he could strike indirectly at others.
Whether it was Han Li dying, the mysterious powerhouse dying, or both suffering heavy losses, any outcome would please the White Emperor.
He had not forgotten how he was injured by that mysterious powerhouse back then.
But that mysterious powerhouse had disappeared for over twenty years without any trace, and no one could track down where they had gone.
As the White Emperor was lost in his many thoughts, a stunningly beautiful silhouette suddenly appeared in the Immortal Hall.
With an incomparably beautiful face and a proud figure, she wore luxurious immortal garments.
Compared to Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, the two most extraordinary empresses, she was only slightly inferior.
Seeing this figure, the White Emperor’s eyes brightened as he eagerly said, “Shiyin, is there any news?”
Qin Shiyin’s eyebrows knitted slightly as she responded indifferently, “There is a piece of news, but I’m not sure of its authenticity.”
“Speak.”
The White Emperor couldn’t wait.
He had asked merely out of routine and did not expect Qin Shiyin to actually have a lead.
Qin Shiyin didn’t immediately answer.
After a moment of silence, she asked, “Do you still stand by your promise?”
“Of course,” the White Emperor said without hesitation.
Qin Shiyin looked deeply at the White Emperor, sighed, and then revealed, “The core piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation is suspected to have appeared in Fenghu Divine Province.”
The White Emperor’s pupils narrowed, a look of excitement crossing his face as he said with a smile, “Don’t worry, Shiyin.
Once I obtain the core of the Jade Talisman of Creation, I will make sure you are amply rewarded.”
“I hope so,” Qin Shiyin said plainly.
With a thought from the White Emperor, a stream of immortal light silently flew out from the Taibai Immortal Realm, heading toward Fenghu Divine Province.
Although Fenghu Divine Province was about to be governed by Chengsheng Mountain, for the core piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation, it didn’t matter whether it was already under the mountain’s control or notâ€”the White Emperor had to make the trip.
Naturally, he would do so in secret, ideally finding the core piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation without any commotion to avoid trouble.
For the past two years, he had been dedicated to searching for clues to True Immortal weapons, with his main focus on the Jade Talisman of Creation.
Though it was only a Heavenly Immortal weapon, it possessed might that rivaled True Immortal weapons.
Coincidentally, one of the empresses under his command had risen to power by relying on a piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation.
The White Emperor knew this very well and hadn’t cared much in the past.
Now, the White Emperor had Empress Qin Shiyin sense the core piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation.
If she could provide him with a lead and then give him that piece of the talisman, the White Emperor promised to exchange a Heavenly Immortal weapon for it and provide her with additional generous compensation.
If he got his hands on the core piece and another piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation, with his strength and methods, it would be possible to sense the other pieces one by one, even if it took a long time.
But for the illustrious Jade Talisman of Creation, all of these efforts were worthwhile.
“Shiyin, have you thought over my previous proposal?” the White Emperor asked with a smile, his mind somewhat relaxed after dispatching his incarnation.
“I will think about it some more,”
Qin Shiyin responded lightly, her eyes reflecting a ripple of emotion.
As her voice faded, Qin Shiyin’s figure vanished from the Immortal Hall.
The White Emperor frowned heavily, his face showing displeasure followed by a cold sneer.
After giving up on Empress Huangyue, he had shifted his focus to one of the Heaven Imperial Realm empresses within his own forces, intending to take a consort.
Qin Shiyin was his target.
Although Qin Shiyin’s constitution was of little benefit to him, far less so than Empress Huangyue, it was better than nothing and was ultimately somewhat helpful.
However, Qin Shiyin’s lack of response to his proposal had displeased the White Emperor greatly.
Empress Huangyue was a supreme being, just like him, and her strength was even slightly superior.
But what was Qin Shiyin?
Merely an empress of the second level of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
If he didn’t need to use Qin Shiyin and wasn’t worried about the potential negative repercussions, which could make other Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors and Quasi Emperors within White Emperor City have second thoughts, the White Emperor would have considered taking what he wanted by force.
His probing just now was his final attempt.
If Qin Shiyin still didn’t agree, once he obtained the two pieces of the Jade Talisman of Creation, she would have no one to blame but himself.
If he handled things well and there was no commotion, no one outside would be the wiser.
Atop a Divine Mountain in the western part of Taibai Divine Province, there was an Immortal Palace.
Deep within this palace sat a figure in meditation.
Suddenly, this figure opened her eyesâ€”it was none other than Qin Shiyin.
The one who had gone to White Emperor City was merely an incarnation she had formed with her mana.
“It seems the pressure the Eternal Sovereign has put on the White Emperor is too great,”
Qin Shiyin murmured to herself, recalling the White Emperor’s earlier state, as well as his recent actions.
Being someone who had risen to power with a piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation herself, she too had thought about collecting all the fragments to restore the Jade Talisman of Creation and become the new extraordinary empress of the Yuankun Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 650
chapters.content:
Chapter 650: Chapter 252: Isn’t This a Bit Inappropriate?
The Proud Empress Huang Yue!
Ninth on the Heavenly Immortal Rank!
The Generous Gesture of Chengsheng Mountain_4 Chapter 650: Chapter 252: Isn’t This a Bit Inappropriate?
The Proud Empress Huang Yue!
Ninth on the Heavenly Immortal Rank!
The Generous Gesture of Chengsheng Mountain_4 “`
But that was too difficult.
...
Only the core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation could sense the location of all other talisman fragments vaguely, and Qin Shiyin had no other means to seek them.
After many years of searching, she had found no clue.
Two years ago, the White Emperor found her and made a deal with her.
Qin Shiyin originally did not want to agree, but after deep thought, she still accepted.
She had not held out much hope, but to her surprise, recently her fragment of the jade talisman showed some unusual fluctuations.
Qin Shiyin immediately performed a divination and it pointed to the Fenghu Divine Province.
She suspected that the core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation was there.
As for becoming the Dao companion of the White Emperor, Qin Shiyin was unwilling in her heart.
If the White Emperor had chosen her from the start, she would not have minded, but he came to her only after his failed pursuit of the Empress Phoenix Month, treating her as a backup plan.
After all, Qin Shiyin was a female emperor in the Heaven Imperial Realm, ranking in the top ten among the Heavenly Immortals.
Was she that inadequate?
Qin Shiyin had her own pride, but she had to bend under the eaves.
She did not dare to outright refuse the White Emperor, fearing that he might turn against her.
She planned to stall for time.
But after meeting with the White Emperor today, Qin Shiyin realized she could no longer delay.
She had only two choices.
The first was to accept the White Emperor and become his Dao companion.
The second was to flee White Emperor City and find a new backing.
But where should she go?
Qin Shiyin frowned deeply, her primordial spirit’s light flickering rapidly as countless thoughts flashed through her mind.
“How about going to Chengsheng Mountain?”
Qin Shiyin’s lips parted slightly as she voiced the boldest idea in her mind.
Originally, she had wanted to wait until the transaction with the White Emperor was finished before making a decision, but plans could not keep up with changes.
The situation was urgent and she had to choose before the White Emperor reclaimed the core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation.
Although White Emperor City had declined quite a bit, it was still a preeminent force.
Other powers might not wish to offend the White Emperor for her sake.
However, the Eternal Supreme of Chengsheng Mountain could.
After all, Chengsheng Mountain was the leading power in the Endless Yuankun Domain, and the miserable state of White Emperor City today was largely due to the Eternal Supreme’s efforts.
The Eternal Supreme Han Li and the White Emperor were mortal enemies.
With the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain, even if she defected, the White Emperor could do nothing to her.
But it would not be easy to make Han Li willingly protect her.
Her biggest bargaining chip was herself.
If she had to choose a Dao companion, it certainly had to be the best and strongest one.
While Han Li’s cultivation might be lesser, he was undoubtedly the best candidate for a Dao companion.
The foundation of Chengsheng Mountain spoke for itself, and furthermore, Han Li’s background was not simple.
The future would definitely belong to Han Li.
As far as Qin Shiyin knew, Han Li did not yet have a Dao companion in the Heaven Imperial Realm.
If she took the initiative to defect to him, she might be able to settle in as the lady of Chengsheng Mountain.
The lady of the numero uno power and the lady of the tenth ranked powerâ€”Qin Shiyin could certainly tell which was better.
After much hesitation, Qin Shiyin made her decisionâ€”to go to Chengsheng Mountain.
Herself alone was’nt enough.
Qin Shiyin also wanted to present several grand gifts to her future Dao companion of Chengsheng Mountain to secure her status.
Two fragments of the Jade Talisman of Creation were just one of them.
……..
Qianyuan Divine Province, Daqian Empire.
Ever since Chengsheng Mountain and Han Li rose to power, the Daqian Empire also basked in their glory and prospered much more than before.
Many cultivators from the surrounding Thirty-six Divine Provinces and even further came to the Daqian Empire to travel, scattering some fortunes, thus creating many talents.
This place was under the protection of Chengsheng Mountain, right under its watchful eyes.
No one dared to cause trouble.
At this moment, a sumptuously decorated pleasure boat came sailing from the sky, entering the territory of the Daqian Empire and heading toward Chengsheng Mountain.
There were two figures standing on the boat, a man with a heroic presence and extraordinary martial prowess, and a woman of peerless beauty and exceptional bearing, both emanating a powerful aura, actually two Tongxuan Realm mighties.
“Ninth Sister, do you think that Eternal Supreme will meet with us?”
The heroic man stood at the bow with his hands behind his back, a hint of nervousness in his voice.
“Have no worries, brother.”
The exceptionally beautiful woman smiled reassuringly.
Her gaze looked forward to meeting the Eternal Supreme as she gazed at the majestic Chengsheng Mountain piercing the clouds.
“Hmm.”
The man nodded slightly, returning to his calm demeanor as he scanned his surroundings.
He saw many other pleasure boats, cloud vessels, and sky ships, all bearing many powerful cultivators, all heading for Chengsheng Mountain.
“Truly, the nascent foremost power in the Yuankun Realm,” the man thought to himself.
He and his sister had come from the distant Solar Empire, on an important mission that could not afford failure.
With that in mind, the man’s gaze stealthily glanced at his gorgeous Ninth Sister.
If the mission was accomplished perfectly, she wouldn’t have to go back.
Before long, the boat sailed into the Yuanzhou Territory, heading toward Chengsheng Mountain amid the ethereal Immortal Qi.
Seeing the sights of Chengsheng Mountain, the man’s eyes revealed a flash of astonishment, murmuring, “What a grand gesture.”
He observed that the terrain of Chengsheng Mountain was extraordinarily auspicious, with dragon veins undulating, multiple veins converging into a land of creation, where the spiritual energy was even denser than in the Solar Emperor City.
“Indeed, a grand gesture.
It is said that Chengsheng Mountain has also opened up a blessed land of immense scopes, crafted from hundreds of vast Star Domains, with countless wonders within, a creation of immeasurable fortune,” the woman said.
The two disembarked from the boat and arrived at the entrance gate of Chengsheng Mountain, only to see nine “gatekeeper dogs” lying at the foot of the mountain.
But upon closer inspection, one would realize that these were exotic White Tigers, each representing nine different types, each exuding Quasi Emperor aura.
The two Tongxuan Realm powerhouses from the Solar Empire changed their expression slightly upon seeing this, profoundly shocked by this display.
Nine Quasi Emperor level exotic White Tigers serving as gatekeepers!
These White Tigers, if placed in other preeminent powers, would be treasured and meticulously nurtured, but at Chengsheng Mountain, they were merely nine “gatekeeper dogs.”
For instance, in their Solar Empire, there was an exotic beast that could rival White Tigers, pampered by the Solar Supreme and fed countless precious treasures.
Not only them, but other cultivators who arrived at Chengsheng Mountain’s gate were also stunned by this scene.
