chapters.content:
Chapter 651: Chapter 253: The Number One Person in the Yuankun Domain!
The Sincerity of the Solar Sovereign!
Daily Life with My Lovely Wife!
I Will Kill the White Emperor_1 Chapter 651: Chapter 253: The Number One Person in the Yuankun Domain!
The Sincerity of the Solar Sovereign!
Daily Life with My Lovely Wife!
I Will Kill the White Emperor_1 “Halt, who goes there!”
A giant rose to his feet, his body immensely huge, towering tens of thousands of feet tall, radiating silver light all over.
...
Even his hair shimmered silver, like a galaxy cascading from the heavens above, exuding an overpoweringly strong aura.
This was actually a Peak Quasi-Emperor.
“Hiss~”
Including the two from the Solar Empire, every cultivator who came to Chengsheng Mountain was shocked by this scene, involuntarily taking a sharp intake of cold breath.
Just how profound was Chengsheng Mountain’s heritage?
Ten Quasi-Emperors guarded the mountain gate, one of whom was a Peak Quasi-Emperor, half a step into the Heaven Imperial Realm, his mere presence making it difficult for everyone to breathe.
The cultivators from the Saint Abyss Realm Power and Quasi-Emperor Powers were completely stunned, their faces filled with disbelief.
The strongest in their forces were not even comparable to the gatekeepers of Chengsheng Mountain…
This was just too much of a blow to their pride.
Even the supreme geniuses from the Heavenly Governing Forces, who came from the Heaven Imperial Realm, fell silent at this moment.
Quasi-Emperors and Peak Quasi-Emperors in the Heavenly Governing Forces were the absolute elite, their authority and status second only to the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors who were the heads of their powers.
“Truly worthy of being the First Power in the Endless Yuankun Domain.”
Yang Dingjue’s face bore a solemn expression as he looked at the Silver Giant, his heart full of wonder.
This was a Peak Quasi-Emperor!
Although the Solar Empire was a supreme power, it ranked third among the original nine great powers.
Apart from the Supreme Sun Emperor, there were only two Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors.
Sharing a similar predicament with the Solar Empire were Tianji Pavilion and the Heavenly Cult, with roughly the same number of Immortal Soldiers and Great Emperors.
Further up in the second tier were White Emperor City, the Longevity Jiang Family, and the Western Sky Palace, each stronger by a notch.
In addition to the supreme beings at the absolute pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, they had three Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors.
For instance, White Emperor City had Qin Shiyin, a female emperor in the second tier of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Standing at the top tier were Yuanchu Mountain, Huangyue Imperial Empire, and the Longevity Qin Family.
Aside from a sovereign, they had four to five Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors each.
The foundations of these three top-tier forces were unfathomably deep.
The Empress Yuanchu of Yuanchu Mountain and the Huangyue Empress of the Huangyue Imperial Empire, these two peerless empresses, each had several Heaven Imperial Realm split souls.
When calculating strength, the split souls of these two peerless empresses were not included; they were all attributed to the strength of their original selves, as they were ultimately meant to merge into one.
From this, one could see just how powerful the Longevity Qin Family was.
The head of the Qin Family had the top ranked strength in the entire Endless Yuankun Domain, even surpassing the Huangyue Empress and Empress Yuanchu.
After Chengsheng Mountain rose in power, the structure of the ten greatest powers was redefined.
Chengsheng Mountain became the top tier, a league of its own.
However, in terms of personal combat ability, the head of the Qin Family was still number one.
Yang Dingjue was very curious about just how many Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors Chengsheng Mountain had, to allow a Peak Quasi-Emperor to guard the mountain gate, and to have nine Quasi-Emperor rank exotic White Tigers as guards.
In the Solar Empire, there weren’t many Quasi-Emperor level powerhouses.
Counting both openly and in secret, there were still less than fifteen, and of those at the Peak Quasi-Emperor level, there were merely two or three.
“The Emperor has made a most wise decision.”
Yang Zhiyun, the ninth sister of Yang Dingjue, and the current ninth daughter of the Solar Emperor, spoke in a severe tone.
Before they set out, the Solar Emperor had convened a high-level meeting to discuss whether to actively seek an alliance with Chengsheng Mountain.
Some Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors and Quasi-Emperors thought it best to wait and see, believing they shouldn’t actively curry favor, as it would diminish the Solar Empire’s dignity.
Another group of high-ranking officials argued for the need to actively foster good relations and establish a marriage alliance with Chengsheng Mountain, to protect the Solar Empire’s interests to the greatest extent possible.
The Solar Empire was very close to Chengsheng Mountain, being the nearest of the nine great powers to it.
Once Chengsheng Mountain had dominion over the surrounding Thirty-three Divine Provinces, the distance to the Solar Empire’s territories would only span eight Divine Provinces.
If Chengsheng Mountain were to continue expanding outward, covering those eight Divine Provinces, the Solar Empire’s territories would be next.
The strength of Chengsheng Mountain was clear for all to see, solidly the number one in Qianyuan Divine Province, with the Solar Empire only able to rank eighth or ninth, slightly better than White Emperor City.
Should Chengsheng Mountain invade, the Solar Empire would not be able to withstand them.
The Solar Emperor believed this too, hence he made the decision to send envoys to Chengsheng Mountain in Qianyuan Divine Province to seek an alliance through marriage.
There were many possible candidates for marriage; they could propose to Han Li, the Supreme Sovereign, or any of his descendants, given that Han Li and his descendants were notoriously known for taking multiple wives and concubines.
This would secure Chengsheng Mountain’s stability and deter them from encroaching upon the Solar Empire’s territories at their leisure.
Of course, if there was a chance to overthrow Chengsheng Mountain, the Solar Emperor would not mind joining hands with other supreme powers, but until the right moment came, they had to keep Chengsheng Mountain in check.
Yang Dingjue nodded slightly and transmitted a message to Yang Zhiyun, “Ninth sister, it will be up to you later.”
“Don’t worry, third brother.”
Yang Zhiyun’s face bore a smile.
She was quite interested in the Supreme Sovereign Han Li; otherwise, she wouldn’t have actively taken part in this mission.
After a few exchanges through messaging, the two of them said aloud simultaneously, “The envoys of the Solar Empire have come to pay respects to the mountain.”
“What?”
Some cultivators who had already announced their affiliations, along with many who had not, now stared in surprise at the two Tongxuan Realm powerhouses.
The Solar Empire, one of the strongest forces, had also come!
All the cultivators present were immensely shocked, their minds racing as they pondered why the Solar Empire would take such an action.
The nine exotic White Tigers took on a more solemn expression, while the Silver Giant’s pupils shrank slightly, but without losing composure, he said indifferently, “Please wait a moment, I will go and report this.”

chapters.title: Chapter 652
chapters.content:
Chapter 652: Chapter 253: The Number One Person in Yuankun Domain!
The Sincerity of the Solar Monarch!
Daily Life with My Delicate Wife!
I Will Kill the White Emperor_2 Chapter 652: Chapter 253: The Number One Person in Yuankun Domain!
The Sincerity of the Solar Monarch!
Daily Life with My Delicate Wife!
I Will Kill the White Emperor_2 The nine Quasi Emperor Rank mystical White Tigers continued to guard the mountain gate, their gazes sweeping over each cultivator who came to pay their respects.
...
The Silver Giant, however, had vanished, heading straight to Yundao Peak to report.
Amidst the convergence of all these gazes, Yang Dingjue and Yang Zhiyun remained calm.
They hailed from the Solar Empire, as members of the direct lineage, they were brimming with confidence, having been the center of attention on numerous occasions before.
At the same time, Yang Dingjue and Yang Zhiyun were also secretly sending messages to each other, both pondering over the same question: Would the revered Eternal Sovereign grant them an audience?
Or would they be received by just a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor?
Both scions of the heavens, a single man and woman, were also growing nervous at this moment; they were about to meet the lord of Chengsheng Mountain, the premier power of the Endless Yuan Kun Domainâ€”strictly speaking, the Eternal Sovereign was the foremost individual in the Yuan Kun Domain!
It didn’t take long before celestial tones emanated from within Chengsheng Mountainâ€”the entire sky was enveloped in mystical lights, and splendid arrays of rainbows concealed the heavens, as many extraordinary scenes unfolded.
A grand avenue laid out before them, surrounded with Divine Light, and many mystical creatures soared along both sides of the Divine Path.
More than a dozen individuals emerged from the Divine Path, led by a mighty being of the Tongxuan Realm named Han Yongqian, the eldest son of Han Li and Yao Xi.
Not only was he phenomenally talented, but he also possessed the Emperor Level Supreme Bones.
In just over thirty years, Han Yongqian had already advanced to the later stages of the Tongxuan Realm.
Of course, the Time-Sky Tower’s aid was an indispensable part of his progress; he had spent two years adventuring in the Xuxian Realm and had only recently returned.
“We failed to greet our honored guests from afar, and we hope that you will forgive us,” said Han Yongqian as he approached, followed by other descendants of Han Li as well as some elders and protectors who had pledged allegiance to Chengsheng Mountain.
To Han Li, a mere prince and princess from the Solar Empire did not warrant his personal reception.
It would be a different matter if it had been the Solar Monarchâ€”their presence would be more appropriate for Han Yongqian to receive.
Han Li also sought to discover what the Solar Empire was plotting, as this was the first time a formidable power had formally contacted Chengsheng Mountain.
After Han Yongqian introduced himself briefly, he casually introduced those standing beside himâ€”key figures of Chengsheng Mountain.
“It is presumptuous of us to arrive unannounced, Brother Han.
I hope you won’t find it offensive.”
Yang Dingjue responded with a smile, also introducing himself and Yang Zhiyun.
Han Yongqian gave a slight nod and said, “Please, come with me, dear guests.”
Yang Dingjue and Yang Zhiyun immediately followed as the three stood on the Divine Path, which stretched all the way to Yundao Peak.
As for the other people from Chengsheng Mountain, they were responsible for welcoming the other cultivators.
All of these individuals had extraordinary backgrounds and almost identical motives for visiting Chengsheng Mountain, so they could not be neglected.
Yundao Peak, Yundao Hall.
Han Yongqian, leading Yang Dingjue and Yang Zhiyun, entered and came to a quiet space deep within the grand hall, waiting patiently.
The Yang siblings felt a rush of excitement as they waited patiently, wondering when the Eternal Sovereign would make an appearance.
As for the possibility that the Eternal Sovereign was awaiting them inside the grand hall, neither sibling had considered that this mighty being would do such a thingâ€”they knew their place and waited obediently.
While chatting idly with Han Yongqian, the siblings were also trying to fish for some information.
Han Yongqian responded casually as well.
After a short while, Han Li arrived.
With a single glance, the hearts of Yang Dingjue and Yang Zhiyun reflected an immensely towering figure, their entire being swirling with the mightiest aura and the highest order of principles, the boundless light of the Dao stirring so intensely that the hearts of both scions nearly shattered, causing blood to seep from the corners of their mouths.
Fortunately, the towering figure dissolved its presence of its own accord, saving the two prodigies of the Solar Empire from further distress.
As they regulated their force to heal and looked downward, they dared not peer at this ultimate being any longer.
“Why doesn’t the Solar Monarch come out for a chat?”
Han Li’s gaze briefly swept over them, falling on Yang Dingjue as he spoke indifferently.
Though Han Li’s tone was calm, it sounded vast and supreme in the ears of Yang Dingjue and Yang Zhiyun, making them bow even lower.
The siblings were surprised for a moment, wondering to whom the Eternal Sovereign was speaking.
There were only two of them on this mission to Chengsheng Mountain, and their father, the Solar Monarch, had not come with them.
Just as they were contemplating this, they heard a hearty laugh, and then a figure clad in Solar Battle Armor stepped out from within Yang Dingjue.
“Brother Han, please excuse this impoliteness from Yang,” said the figure.
“It is an honor for Chengsheng Mountain to be graced by Brother Yang’s presence, so there is certainly nothing to forgive,” replied Han Li with a smile, his tone light as a breeze.
The Solar Monarch was not his true self but merely a Divine Sense hidden within Yang Dingjue.
If Han Li had not noticed, he would have silently observed the essence of Chengsheng Mountain; having been discovered, he made a frank appearance.
After a brief exchange with the Solar Monarch, Han Li waved his hand, signaling Han Yongqian to take Yang Dingjue and Yang Zhiyun for a tour while he had a detailed discussion with the Solar Monarch.
Half an hour later,
only Han Li remained in Yundao Hallâ€”the Solar Monarch’s shred of Divine Sense had dissipated.
Han Li rubbed his brow, recollecting the conversation with the Solar Monarch word for word, feeling somewhat of a headache coming on.
“That old fox,” Han Li remarked.
The two had agreed on quite a few matters, forming a secret alliance, albeit an unreliable one with no binding commitments.
The two powers would bond through marriage, with Yang Zhiyun, the ninth daughter of the Solar Monarch, becoming the wife of Han Li.
The wedding was to be held in two months, at which time the Solar Empire would send generous wedding gifts to show their sincerity.
Han Li had no objections to this point.
Yang Zhiyun was undoubtedly beautiful, even exceeding his standard for a spouse in terms of both talent and appearance.
Though Yang Zhiyun’s cultivation aptitude was of first rank and she did not possess an imperial physique, she was indeed of a top-notch royal physique and an unparalleled beauty.

chapters.title: Chapter 653
chapters.content:
Chapter 653: Chapter 253: The Number One Person in the Yuankun Domain!
The Sincerity of the Solar Emperor!
Daily Life with My Darling Wife!
I Must Kill Emperor Bai_3 Chapter 653: Chapter 253: The Number One Person in the Yuankun Domain!
The Sincerity of the Solar Emperor!
Daily Life with My Darling Wife!
I Must Kill Emperor Bai_3 Han Li naturally wouldn’t miss the opportunity to contribute to Han Mansion’s expansion and prosperity.
...
As for Yang Zhiyun’s intention to leak Chengsheng Mountain’s confidential information to the Solar Empire, if she could pull it off, he would consider it a loss.
He smiled and shook his head, then Han Li’s figure disappeared from Yundao Hall and reappeared at the summit of Chengdao Peak.
There, three figures stood waiting, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyiâ€”Han Li had been communicating with his three beautiful wives just moments before.
“Husband~”
The three ladies called out simultaneously, their faces adorned with beaming smiles.
Han Li nodded slightly and took the initiative to say, “The main purpose of the envoy from the Solar Empire is for a marriage alliance.
That Solar Emperor has quite a few plans in mind, but our Chengsheng Mountain won’t end up at a disadvantage.
It’s all up to him to seize the opportunity.”
“Let’s hope he doesn’t make a foolish mistake,” Lu Tianxiang said with a laugh.
Yun Miaoyi raised her eyebrows and looked at Han Li to inquire, “Is that the new wife the Solar Emperor plans to send to you?”
Yun Miaoyi’s gaze fell on Yang Zhiyun, and Jiang Baiye and Lu Tianxiang turned to look as well.
At that moment, Yang Zhiyun was strolling through Chengsheng Mountain with her brother under Han Yongqian’s guidance.
The Solar Emperor had already transmitted a message to them before his Divine Sense dissipated.
“Indeed, she is of nation-toppling beauty.
Husband, congratulations,” Jiang Baiye withdrew her gaze, her silver hair fluttering, and a smile graced her stunning face.
“Hahaha~”
Han Li couldn’t help but laugh heartily.
It wasn’t because he was about to welcome a new wife, but because of the attitudes of his three beautiful wives, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi.
After chatting about this topic for a while, Han Li thought for a moment and then said, “Xiangxiang, Jiang Jiang, Yunyun, would you like to take a trip outside Qianyuan Divine Province?”
In the coming period, he might be quite busy, mainly because there would be quite a few new brides marrying into the family, and he had many matters to arrange.
He wanted to take advantage of the current lull to spend more time with his three lovely wives.
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi were his earliest three wives, and Han Li’s affection for them had deepened with time, becoming ever more profound.
The eyes of Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, and Jiang Baiye lit up immediately, their hearts bursting with excitement as Yun Miaoyi was the first to speak, “Husband, you can’t go back on your word.”
“Of course not,” Han Li extended his index finger, curved it, and playfully flicked Yun Miaoyi’s delicate nose.
“Will you accompany us, Husband?” Jiang Baiye looked at Han Li with deep affection, filled with boundless anticipation.
“Jiang Jiang, rest assured, I will definitely accompany you.
Otherwise, I wouldn’t feel at ease either,” Han Li said as he wrapped his arm around Jiang Baiye’s slender waist, drawing her close to his chest.
“Husband, you shouldn’t underestimate us,” Lu Tianxiang pouted, feigning anger on her flawless, porcelain-like face.
Over the years, their cultivation levels had soared, reaching realms they once dared not even dream of.
Now, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi had all broken through to the Saint Abyss Realm, with Lu Tianxiang’s cultivation even higher, reaching the late stages of the Saint Abyss Realm.
As wives of Han Li and one of the mistresses of Chengsheng Mountain, their status was extremely high, with benefits and treatments that were certainly the best of the best.
Their talents had long been elevated to the first rank, and with the birth of their physiques, they evolved into Imperial Bodies with Han Li’s help, their innate abilities and talents truly astonishing.
With their cultivation continuously improving and reaching the current realm, their appearance, figure, and presence had all enhanced, with a beauty and elegance comparable to those sacred females of the Heavenly Immortal ranks, worthy of contention.
Han Li had long bestowed each of the three women with their own Heaven Imperial Realm imperial weapons, and they were also quite familiar with some of Chengsheng Mountain’s divine artifact spirits, such as Xi Yue, the spirit of the Human Dao Sword, and Hong Yun, the spirit of the Primordial Chaos Cauldron.
Should danger arise, they could call upon these divine weapons for aid.
“I wouldn’t dare to underestimate you all; the three of you, plus Yue’er, possess exceptionally high combat power.
I would have to use all my skills to defeat you all,” Han Li said with a laugh.
“Pfft~”
Jiang Baiye’s cheeks flushed slightly, Yun Miaoyi snorted, and Lu Tianxiang spat playfully in response.
But what my husband said is indeed true.
Practice is the sole criterion for testing truth, and each time they made a breakthrough in their realms, they would seek Han Li to exchange knowledge and test their strength.
“Should we also call upon Yue’er to join us?” Jiang Baiye looked up at his beloved and whispered.
Han Li glanced at Yun Miaoyi and Lu Tianxiang, found them without objections, so he said, “Then let’s bring Yue’er along.”
Compared with Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Yun Miaoyi, the senior martial sister Gongsun Yue could barely be considered his childhood sweetheart and first love.
Gongsun Yue was his fourth wife.
Han Li conveyed the message to Gongsun Yue using his Divine Sense, and in the next instant, the lunar-white-robed Gongsun Yue appeared, floating, and immediately started to chat incessantly with Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, and Jiang Baiye.
Han Li just watched them quietly, admiring four different unparalleled beauties.
His four beloved wives were so gorgeous they could make fish sink and birds alight, eclipse the moon, and shame flowers by their mere presence, exceptional in elegance, each with her own distinctive charm.
Suddenly, Han Li’s face revealed an amused expression, and after a moment of thought he said,
“Xiangxiang, Jiang Jiang, Yunyun, Yue’er, you all chat.
I’ll be away for a while.”
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue simply nodded, as Han Li vanished from the mountaintop and left Chengsheng Mountain.
Just now, the Artifact Spirit of the Emperor Flag informed him that a female Heaven Imperial Realm Empress had come to the outskirts of Qianyuan Divine Province, purposely transmitting a message to Chengsheng Mountain, asking Han Li to meet her outside.
After seeing the image materialized by Emperor Flag, Han Li recognized the Heaven Imperial Realm Empress at a glanceâ€”it was Qin Shiyin from White Emperor City.
Over the years, Han Li had collected all sorts of information about every Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor and Quasi Emperor in the Yuankun Domain, so of course, he recognized Qin Shiyin’s identity instantly.
However, he was very curious as to why Qin Shiyin sought him out.
She had even concealed her identity.
Qin Shiyin was a Heaven Imperial Realm Empress from White Emperor City.
White Emperor City and Chengsheng Mountain harbored deep animosity, with the White Emperor considering him a nemesis.
Under such circumstances, what could Qin Shiyin’s motive possibly be for coming to Qianyuan Divine Province?
Although Qin Shiyin had come in a clone, the implications were indeed thought-provoking.
For the sake of caution, Han Li brought along his Human Path Sword and Qiankun Bracelet.
He arrived at the “Heavenly Space” where Qin Shiyin stood, concealing his form throughout the journey.
When he arrived, Qin Shiyin did not detect him.
Han Li observed her carefully and found that this Heaven Imperial Realm Empress was indeed beautiful, only slightly less so than the Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu he often thought about.
But at that moment, the flawless and exquisite face of the Heaven Imperial Realm Empress betrayed a hint of sorrow.
A flash of interest crossed Han Li’s eyes as he revealed himself and simultaneously asked,
“What important matter brings you to seek Han, fellow Daoist Qin?
Don’t tell me you wish to marry Han and become Dao companions?”
Seeing Han Li appear, Qin Shiyin showed no surprise.
She responded in a gentle tone, “Becoming your Dao companion is not impossible.”
Han Li had been joking, but Qin Shiyin’s affirmative reply took him aback.
“However, I have one condition,” Qin Shiyin continued.
Han Li raised his eyebrow and said, “Let’s hear it.”
He hadn’t taken a Heaven Imperial Realm Empress as a Dao companion yet, so if Qin Shiyin’s condition wasn’t too outrageous, he was willing to agree.
“I want to kill the White Emperor,” Qin Shiyin said lightly.
Han Li’s pupils contracted, and a look of astonishment flitted across his face.
As if understanding what Han Li was thinking, Qin Shiyin explained, “He hasn’t gone that far with me yet, but it will happen soon.
As long as you can do it, I will keep my word.”

chapters.content:
Chapter 654: Chapter 254: The Trade with the Empress!
Han Li Goes Out with Four Beauties!
The Death of Yan Nanxiao!
The Dumbfounded White Emperor_1 Chapter 654: Chapter 254: The Trade with the Empress!
Han Li Goes Out with Four Beauties!
The Death of Yan Nanxiao!
The Dumbfounded White Emperor_1 Han Li was deep in thought.
...
The White Emperor’s pursuit of Empress Huang Yue had failed, and he had turned his attention to Qin Shiyin, who had not agreed, so he planned to use force?
Qin Shiyin had sensed the danger in advance and wanted to escape her predicament, so she sought him out, hoping to use his hand to kill the White Emperor, and for this, she was willing to become his Dao companion.
Han Li guessed that this was what Qin Shiyin meant.
Between the White Emperor and him, Qin Shiyin had chosen him, preferring to seek refuge with him, to indulge under his knee rather than to give the White Emperor any advantage, tsk tsk…
It must have been his handsome and unrestrained appearance that captivated the heart of the Heaven Imperial Realm empress.
The White Emperor was one of the ten supreme beings in the Yuankun Domain and the master of the powerful White Emperor City, not only possessing immense combat ability but also guarded by many immortal soldiers.
Killing him was extremely difficult and fraught with great troubles.
If this had been in the past, Han Li would certainly not have agreed.
Previously, he needed to stay underground, develop quietly; time was on his side.
As long as he didn’t mess things up and lay low, he could grow stronger without having to do such earth-shattering deeds.
But now, it was different; he wanted to travel with his four beautiful companions around the Endless Yuankun Domain, and it would be convenient to take care of the White Emperor along the way.
The White Emperor was his enemy, and White Emperor City was a snake lurking in the shadows, ready to strike at any moment and keen on biting Han Li.
If given the chance, Han Li wouldn’t mind making a move against the White Emperor, causing the already weakened White Emperor City to suffer another blow and heavy losses.
The opportunity had now presented itself.
White Emperor City was currently in a “weak” state, and the White Emperor would not expect Han Li to strike at this time.
Moreover, with Qin Shiyin as the insider, they could collaborate from within and without; this move should yield a substantial profit.
Han Li’s target was to plunder the rare cultivation resources of White Emperor City, such as Immortal Qi, Immortal Stones, Immortal Elixirs, Immortal Scriptures, and so on.
Not only could it make up for some of the deficits at Chengsheng Mountain, but it could also further weaken White Emperor City, leaving it with no chance to cause trouble.
As for the reactions of the other supreme forces, Han Li did not care much.
As long as he did not go too far, those forces would not jointly trouble him.
At most, they would voice their support for White Emperor City, and to Han Li, that was neither painful nor itchy.
Initially, five supreme forces had plundered the White Emperor City’s Taibai Immortal Realm.
Han Li was simply following the path they had carved out; the precedent was there, and they were all the same.
Besides, this time Han Li could claim he had just cause, as it was the Heaven Imperial Realm Empress of White Emperor City, Qin Shiyin, who had asked for his action.
All these thoughts flashed through his mind in an instant, and Han Li made his decision, smiling as he said, “Since you’ve put it that way, Shiyin, I will certainly agree.”
Upon hearing Han Li switch to a more intimate form of address, Qin Shiyin furrowed her brow slightly but thought of their agreement and quickly recovered.
After a pause, Qin Shiyin continued, “I have a piece of important intelligence…”
Next, Qin Shiyin had a private discussion with Han Li and, wearing a satisfied smile, said, “I’ll wait for you in White Emperor City,” before disappearing.
Han Li continued standing there, his eyes flickering with a divine light, for Qin Shiyin had revealed many core secrets of White Emperor City.
As one of only four Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors in White Emperor City, Qin Shiyin had a very high status and access to most of the city’s secrets.
Only the most core secrets were beyond her reach; those were known only to the White Emperor himself.
“I never expected the core piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation to appear; tsk, the White Emperor is indeed a good man,” Han Li thought to himself with some schadenfreude, recalling what Qin Shiyin had just said.
He had a piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation in his possession, which he had obtained from the “son of fate,” Lin Xiao.
It had been decades since he’d obtained this piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation.
Previously being quite low-key, Han Li hadn’t made an effort to search for the other pieces.
On the one hand, this piece wasn’t a core piece, unable to sense other pieces; on the other hand, he had gradually come into possession of many Heavenly Immortal soldiers and True Immortal soldiers, hence the Jade Talisman of Creation wasn’t as desirable to him.
Of course, given the chance, Han Li would still want to obtain it; it was a supreme Heavenly Immortal soldier after all, with power comparable to a True Immortal soldier, similar to the Humanity Sword, carrying very powerful Dao within it.
The appearance of the core piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation in the Fenghu Divine Province was unexpected, but such details were unimportant.
No matter who the “son of fate” possessing the core piece was, it would ultimately end up in Han Li’s hands.
As for the White Emperor?
He was simply a caretaker of it for him.
As per the agreement made earlier, Han Li would kill the White Emperor and take the core piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation, then hand it over to Qin Shiyin.
Qin Shiyin claimed she also owned a piece of the Jade Talisman, one that had aided her rise to power, and she did not hide this from Han Li.
Although Qin Shiyin did not say it outright, Han Li was aware that this was probably one of the main reasons she came to him.
Without Han Li’s assistance, Qin Shiyin couldn’t possibly obtain the core piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation; even her own piece would be taken away.
In the end, Qin Shiyin might lose everything.
Han Li had agreed to her request, with a single conditionâ€”that she would only receive it after she married him, including his own piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation.
Compared to the Heaven Imperial Realm empress Qin Shiyin, Han Li didn’t place much importance on the Jade Talisman of Creation, even if three pieces combined could potentially rival the top-tiered Heavenly Immortal soldiers in power.
He had many Heavenly Immortal soldiers, but only one Heaven Imperial Realm empress as a Dao companion.
Moreover, wasn’t everything that belonged to Qin Shiyin already his?
There was no need to be so clearly demarcated.
After gathering his thoughts, Han Li returned to Chengdao Peak, where he saw Lu Tianxiang, Gongsun Yue, Yun Miaoyi, and Jiang Baiye, his four stunning wives, still engaged in animated conversation.
Han Li did not interrupt them, quietly appreciating the harmonious scene.

Dumbfounded White Emperor_2 Chapter 655: Chapter 254: The Deal with the Empress!
Han Li Outing with Four Beauties!
The Death of Yan Nanxiao!
Dumbfounded White Emperor_2 Looking at beauties always seems to make one’s mood pleasant, which might just be what they call “a feast for the eyes,” especially when there were four ravishing women who were the epitome of stunning beauty.
...
By the time the four lovely wives finally finished their discussion, it was already half an hour later, and Han Li had no idea how they could have so much to talk about, but he was relieved nonetheless.
Taking advantage of this time, Han Li had arranged everything regarding Chengsheng Mountain and was now waiting for Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue.
“Husband, when are we setting off?” Yun Miaoyi asked, her eyes brimming with anticipation.
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Gongsun Yue also looked over, waiting for Han Li to make the decision.
“Of course, we’re setting off right now,” Han Li said with a smile.
“That’s great.”
“Finally, we can go out and have a look around.”
“Yuankun Domain is vast and endless, with a hundred famous attractions.
Should we go see them all?”
“Let’s go, let’s go, we must see them all.”
Hearing this, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue had smiles all over their faces, chattering nonstop.
They were happy to go out and see the world, but even happier that Han Li would accompany them.
Han Li waved his hand, and a majestic golden war chariot appeared in the sky, extravagantly decorated and pulled by nine Quasi Emperor Rank flood dragons.
This chariot was originally a Sky God War Chariot, a mere Top Grade Divine Weapon, but later Han Li used the Creation Stone to evolve it into a Top Grade Emperor Weapon.
As a means of transportation, the nine flood dragons were also a product of evolution.
Now that they were traveling, of course, they needed a means of transportation; Han Li didn’t want to fly with his four beautiful wives when they could gallivant in a chariot, right?
They could also discuss the ways of the Dao and explore life while in the chariot.
“Let’s go.”
Han Li was the first to step into the lavish golden war chariot.
Inside, the space was vast, with various facilities to meet all of Han Li’s needs, extremely luxurious.
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue looked at each other and followed suit, entering one by one.
Soon, the Sky God War Chariot broke through the air and disappeared from the peak of Chengdao.
……
Fenghu Divine Province.
Luoyan Hills.
Yan Nanxiao landed on a mountain peak, his mood quite uplifting.
Having left from Black Dragon City of the Daliang Empire, and having been on his way to Purple Moon Divine City for some time, Yan Nanxiao had long left the domain of the Daliang Empire.
At this moment, he was within the territory of Jibing Palace and had just experienced a thrilling battle.
On his journey, with the help of the core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation, Yan Nanxiao’s talents had further improved, and his cultivation had broken through from the sixth heaven of Gangyuan Realm to the early stage of God Refining Realm in one fell swoop.
Thinking about the Spirit Fruit he just managed to snatch, a smile spread across Yan Nanxiao’s face.
The fruit was of great help to a real person in the God Refining Realm, aiding in the advancement of cultivation.
If he refined this Spirit Fruit, Yan Nanxiao was confident that he could break through to the mid-stage of the God Refining Realm within a year.
For that Spirit Fruit, he had used up quite a few trump cards, pulling out all the stops.
Fortunately, his combat ability had greatly increased lately; he was much stronger than a typical early God Refining Realm cultivator, otherwise, he definitely wouldn’t have gotten the fruit.
Thinking of the Shen Family’s wedding procession from Tiannan City, which had already set off, Yan Nanxiao’s face turned sour, but recalling that the Shen Family would also use the Cross Borders Teleporting Formation in Purple Moon Divine City, a glint of excitement flashed in his eyes.
“Youqing, wait for me,” Yan Nanxiao murmured softly.
He chose to take the Teleportation Formation in Purple Moon Divine City because he wanted to see Shen Youqing one last time, even if it was just a glance.
As for whether he could actually meet her, Yan Nanxiao knew the chances were slim.
He was only at the God Refining Realm, which meant his traveling speed was quite slow, and he had to avoid various dangers along the way.
Meanwhile, the Shen Family of Tiannan City placed great importance on the wedding, and it was likely that an ancestor of the Divine Yuan Realm would personally escort them.
Moreover, with many True Martial Realm Emperors and tools like war chariots and cloud boats, their speed was many times faster than his, with little to no danger.
After thinking it over, Yan Nanxiao took out the Spirit Fruit and swallowed it directly.
The violent medicinal power rampaged through his body, recklessly damaging his meridians, but Yan Nanxiao didn’t care at all.
The next instant, a cooling force surged in, rapidly refining all the medicinal power, making it purer and aiding Yan Nanxiao’s breakthrough.
Feeling that everything was going well inside his body, Yan Nanxiao prepared to leave this place.
He needed to refine the Spirit Fruit while traveling, as he couldn’t afford to waste time here, or he would truly miss his chance.
Just then, Yan Nanxiao’s figure stiffened, and he looked ahead in a daze, his face showing a mixture of confusion, shock, panic, and other emotions.
A figure appeared far away in the sky, and in the next instant, arrived at Luoyan Hills, looking down upon the frail figure on the mountaintop.
Although it was just the avatar of Emperor Wu, who had concealed his cultivation, he was after all from Heaven Imperial Realm.
A mere hint of his aura, emanating from the disparity in life levels, made Yan Nanxiao extremely uncomfortable.
In his eyes, Emperor Wu was majestic and boundless, his entire being radiated Emperor’s Light, grand celestial music echoed, Yan Nanxiao’s gaze became vacant, his mind was overtaken, and involuntarily bowed his head.
He couldn’t withstand even this faint breath, his legs gave way, and he kneeled on the ground, his forehead touching the dirt.
“It’s you.”
A smile appeared on Emperor Wu’s face.
Following the clues provided by Qin Shiyin, he had gone through some trouble and finally found his target.
The core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation released a force into Yan Nanxiao’s body, barely clearing the effects, but Yan Nanxiao still couldn’t stand up.
“Who are you?”
Yan Nanxiao wanted to raise his head, but he couldn’t.
Sweat covered his forehead, face, back, and his entire body.
A great fear spread to his flesh and Divine Spirit.

Dumbfounded White Emperor_3 Chapter 656: Chapter 254: The Deal with the Empress!
Han Li Outing with Four Beauties!
The Death of Yan Nanxiao!
Dumbfounded White Emperor_3 “I am the White Emperor!”
The indifferent voice of the White Emperor echoed between heaven and earth.
...
The moment he arrived, he had concealed this place; whatever happened here, the outside world would never learn of it.
“White…
White Emperor?”
Upon hearing this, Yan Nanxiao’s face displayed a look of astonishment and shock, which quickly turned from fear to excitement and enthusiasm.
He had been planning to go to White Emperor City to become a disciple and learn, and with the power of the Pieces of the Jade Talisman of Creation, he was certain to rise quickly, becoming an unrivaled genius in White Emperor City and catching the White Emperor’s attention.
Then, he might have the chance to be taken as a disciple by the White Emperor, receive the White Emperor’s nurturing, and have a limitless future.
Once he became a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, or even a Heavenly Immortal, he could join forces with his master, the White Emperor, to deal with Han Li and thus avenge his grievances.
But he had only just set out when, to his surprise, the White Emperor had personally left White Emperor City to come here.
Could it be that he had foreseen the future?
Yan Nanxiao felt that this was very likely.
Although the White Emperor had suffered a terrible defeat at the hands of Han Li, he was still a supreme being at the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and perhaps he could glimpse into the future….
The White Emperor might have seen Yan Nanxiao’s future achievements in a vision, so he came in advance to take him as a disciple and cultivate him carefully to join forces against Han Li in the future.
Lost in his dreams of a bright future, Yan Nanxiao’s fear was gone, and he shouted with all his might, “Your Majesty the White Emperor, I wish to become your disciple and am willing to pay any price.”
Yan Nanxiao was just a fledgling cultivator, ignorant of the cruelty within the Cultivation Realm, truly believing the White Emperor had come to take him as a disciple.
Otherwise, why would the White Emperor come to find him?
The worst possibility was that he had come for the core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation, but Yan Nanxiao deliberately ignored this thought.
The White Emperor was too strong, and he could only hope for the best.
After all, if the White Emperor wanted to deal with him, he had no power to resist.
“Hahahaha~”
Looking at the thin and weak figure bowing and scraping before him, the White Emperor suddenly laughed heartily.
“Then give me your life and the core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation.”
Yan Nanxiao’s thoughts were no secret to him; in an instant, he had scrutinized all of Yan Nanxiao’s memories and thoughts, but the White Emperor didn’t care.
Although Yan Nanxiao bore a grudge against Han Li and wanted to join forces with him against Han Li, was Yan Nanxiao worthy?
Did Yan Nanxiao, of such lowly status, really have a common enemy with him and wish to fight alongside him?
Cultivating Yan Nanxiao would be too bothersome, too much of a waste of time and energy, and it was uncertain whether he would be able to grow successfully in the future.
It was far better to kill Yan Nanxiao straight away and take the core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation.
In his hands, the core fragment of the Jade Talisman would be assembled with all the other pieces at the fastest speed, which was far better than leaving it to gather dust in Yan Nanxiao’s hands.
“No!
No!
Great White Emperor, you can’t do this to me…”
Yan Nanxiao was dumbfounded, struck by great terror and beginning to struggle frantically.
He didn’t want to die.
He had only recently acquired an unprecedented opportunity, and with the help of the core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation, he was destined to become at least a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
How could he die here?
He still wanted to ascend Chengsheng Mountain, invite the Elder Han to his death, and reclaim Shen Youqing, his childhood sweetheart.
How could he possibly die?
In that instant, myriad thoughts flashed through his mind; Yan Nanxiao was filled with endless unwillingness, but under the gaze of the White Emperor, he died, annihilated without a trace of resistance.
The White Emperor beckoned, taking the bronze fragment into his hand to examine it, confirming it was correct, and then erased all traces from the place before returning to White Emperor City.
With the core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation, once he acquired the piece in Qin Shiyin’s possession, he could secretly begin searching for all the fragments of the Jade Talisman of Creation.
But before that, he had one more thing to do, and that was to deal with Qin Shiyin.
Rather than completing the transaction, the White Emperor preferred to get something for nothing; he didn’t want to give up a Heavenly Immortal weapon and also sought Qin Shiyin’s body and her piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation.
For this, the White Emperor had already made plans.
However, when the White Emperor’s incarnation returned to White Emperor City, something happened that he hadn’t anticipated.

Chapter 657: Chapter 255: Sneaking into Taibai Immortal Realm!
Slaying the White Emperor!
Pillaging Taibai Immortal Realm!
The Silent Supreme Beings_1 Chapter 657: Chapter 255: Sneaking into Taibai Immortal Realm!
Slaying the White Emperor!
Pillaging Taibai Immortal Realm!
The Silent Supreme Beings_1 White Emperor City, Taibai Immortal Realm.
...
The White Emperor stood beside the Creation Immortal Lotus, pondering life and awaiting good news from his second self.
“The Creation Immortal Lotus and the Jade Talisman of Creation both bear the way of Creation; can they complement each other?”
With hands clasped behind his back, the White Emperor circled around the Pool of Creation and Destruction again and again, his gaze fixed on the Creation Immortal Lotus the whole time.
After the White Emperor invested a vast amount of resources, the Pool of Creation and Destruction once more brimmed with water, with the Creation Immortal Lotus in its center, occasionally radiating light of creation.
Although the Creation Immortal Lotus was an Immortal Elixir and the Jade Talisman of Creation an Immortal Weapon, the White Emperor felt these two could augment each other since both contained the way of Creation.
The Creation Immortal Lotus harbored the way of Creation of a True Immortal level, while the Jade Talisman of Creation held that of a Heavenly Immortal level.
The lofty plane of the way of Creation enabled the Jade Talisman of Creation to rival weapons of True Immortals, and the Creation Immortal Lotus could almost match a Golden Immortal Elixir.
This was the common speculation among the White Emperor and other powerhouses, but since no one had seen a Golden Immortal or their weapons and elixirs, they couldn’t make accurate judgments.
“If the Creation Immortal Lotus could advance the Jade Talisman of Creation even further, and the latter in turn could advance the Creation Immortal Lotus,” he mused, anticipation coloring his thoughts.
At that thought, a look of excitement flashed across the White Emperor’s face.
The next moment, his excitement was even more pronounced, and he couldn’t help but exclaim aloud, “Perfect.”
His consciousness was linked with that of his second self, and when it managed to find Yan Nanxiao and obtain the core fragments of the Jade Talisman of Creation, the White Emperor was overjoyed.
Given the speed of his second self, it would not be long before it returned from Fenghu Divine Province to Taibai Divine Province.
Thinking of this, the White Emperor’s Divine Sense surged out, sending a message to Qin Shiyin, asking her to pay a visit to the Taibai Immortal Realm.
He planned to deal with Qin Shiyin here.
Unless something unforeseen occurred, she would not be able to escape the palm of his hand and would have to submit to him completely.
Soon, Empress Qin Shiyin arrived.
Qin Shiyin was dressed in an elegant black gown, her figure exquisite and curves beautiful, with a pair of long, slender jade legs beneath, white and smooth, in perfect golden ratio, especially tantalizing in white stockings made from Thousand Ice Spider Silk.
Her long, jet-black hair reached to her waist, adding charm to her allure.
Her skin was whiter than snow, like fine jade, with arched eyebrows like crescents enamoring the soul, and beneath those crescents were a pair of light purple eyes, clear as glass and intoxicatingly beautiful.
Her features were delicate and flawless, her expression always calm, like a tranquil pool of water, her lustrous eyes captivating, as though nothing in the world could warrant her gaze.
The moment Qin Shiyin entered the Taibai Secret Realm, the White Emperor frowned slightly, but upon seeing Qin Shiyin’s stunning form, he shrugged off the tremor in his heart.
The White Emperor scrutinized Qin Shiyin closely, his gaze aggressive and unrestrained, already viewing Qin Shiyin as a “spoils of war.”
From the instant Qin Shiyin stepped into the Taibai Immortal Realm, her fate was sealed.
Therefore, the White Emperor saw no point in pretending anymore, or in continuing to indulge Qin Shiyin with niceties.
Sensing the White Emperor’s gaze, Qin Shiyin’s crescent brows furrowed, a hint of discontent shimmering in her glass-like eyes, confirming what she had anticipated.
Qin Shiyin sneered inwardly and approached the Pool of Creation and Destruction with graceful steps in just a few strides.
“You got the core fragment of the Jade Talisman of Creation?” she asked, her beautiful eyes flashing with curiosity as she looked at the Creation Immortal Lotus in the pool.
In the past, even as one of the top figures in White Emperor City and one of the three Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors under the White Emperor’s command, she would not have been able to come close to this pool.
This place was a forbidden area of the Taibai Immortal Realm, always guarded by a weapon of Heavenly Immortal quality.
If they, the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, intentionally approached, the weapon would strike.
But now, the White Emperor had actually invited her here, presenting the Creation Immortal Lotus right before her eyesâ€”a sign he was confident in his victory over her.
Withdrawing his gaze, the White Emperor also looked at the Creation Immortal Lotus, without answering her question, he spoke softly, “Shiyin, have you considered it well?”
Toward this Heaven Imperial Realm Empress, the White Emperor still hoped she would be sensible and willingly become his dao companion, saving him the trouble of exerting extra effort.
Qin Shiyin’s eyebrows raised in amusement, and she responded with a smile that was not quite a smile, “White Emperor, you should continue your pursuit of Empress Phoenix Moon.”
The White Emperor’s face turned cold.
Qin Shiyin had touched on the very topic he wished to avoid.
Not only had she rejected him, but she also brought up Empress Phoenix Moon, much to the White Emperor’s displeasure.
White Emperor’s voice grew colder, his tone left no room for refusal, “Shiyin, hand over that piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation.”
“What about my weapon of Heavenly Immortal quality?”
Unfazed, Qin Shiyin’s voice also chilled.
As she’d suspected earlier, the White Emperor had no intention of trading with her; he was determined to have his way.
Luckily, she had made preparations in advance.
The White Emperor watched Qin Shiyin without speaking further, and she too remained silent, the atmosphere immediately tensing.
After a moment, just as Qin Shiyin was about to speak, the entrance to the Taibai Immortal Realm opened once more, and a figure flew in, quickly reaching the edge of the Pool of Creation and Destruction.
It was the White Emperor’s second self.
The White Emperor took the bronze fragment from his second self and casually toyed with it, looking at Qin Shiyin and asking indifferently, “Are you really going to persist in your folly?”
Qin Shiyin took a deep breath; her vast conscience suddenly roiling tumultuously, she said coldly, “White Emperor, do you know what you’re doing?”
“You have no chance,” the White Emperor replied simply.
Qin Shiyin’s delicate frame trembled, realizing the White Emperor was finally showing his true colors.

Chapter 658: Chapter 255: Sneaking into Taibai Immortal Realm!
Slaying the White Emperor!
Pillaging Taibai Immortal Realm!
The Silent Supreme Beings_2 Chapter 658: Chapter 255: Sneaking into Taibai Immortal Realm!
Slaying the White Emperor!
Pillaging Taibai Immortal Realm!
The Silent Supreme Beings_2 “In the Taibai Immortal Realm, I am the heaven, I am the path, If I want to have you, I can have you.
...
Do you think you can resist?”
“I gave you a chance before and you didn’t cherish it.
Instead of being the lady of White Emperor City, you actually chose to become a concubine under my knee.
Well, then I’ll just have to grant you your wish.”
White Emperor stood with his hands behind his back, his gaze unabashedly scanning Qin Shiyin, as if to pierce through her black dress and glimpse the perfect delicate body inside.
“You’re insane.”
Qin Shiyin looked at White Emperor with complex eyes.
She really hadn’t expected the White Emperor to say such things.
Since taking control of the Heavenly Sovereign Path and becoming the Heavenly Imperial Realm empress, she had always stayed in White Emperor City.
Apart from repaying some of the White Emperor’s kindness, the reason she had progressed further in White Emperor City was partly out of reverence for him.
The former White Emperor had an image of grandeur and righteousness in the outside world.
Aside from being somewhat selfish, he was never this paranoid and mad, never capable of such heartless acts or saying such malicious words.
In just a few years, the White Emperor had changed so much that she no longer recognized him.
With these thoughts, the last trace of recognition in Qin Shiyin’s heart vanished without a trace.
She no longer regretted asking Han Li for help; she only felt fortunate.
If she hadn’t made a deal with Han Li in advance, she would have truly been finished today, with no future and a miserable end that was too heartbreaking to witness.
“Mad?
No, I’m simply going back to being myself,” White Emperor scoffed coldly.
He had always been this way; before, it was just a disguise.
He had packaged his image nicely to facilitate achieving his goals.
But since he had failed, he saw no need to pretend any longer.
He was an evil person, and his ruthless heart and merciless actions had brought him to this day.
“Today, not only will I obtain that piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation, but I’ll also have you.
Even if you scream your throat hoarse, it will be utterly useless.”
“Whatever happens here, the outside world will never know.”
An evil smile appeared on White Emperor’s face before he reached out to grab Qin Shiyin.
“Really?”
Just then, a voice suddenly rang out, causing a great shock in White Emperor’s heart and bringing back unpleasant memories.
Without any hesitation, White Emperor’s hand moved even faster toward Qin Shiyin, trying to snatch her away.
At the same time, the Heavenly Immortal soldiers above the Pool of Creation and Destruction came to life instantly, and streams of Infinite Immortal Light fell, guarding the Pool of Creation and Destruction and the Creation Immortal Lotus.
Hidden in the sky of the Taibai Immortal Realm, the Wuxian Palace and several other Heavenly Immortal weapons descended in an instant.
Terrifying power unfolded, with one part protecting White Emperor, and another part lashing out at the emerging figure.
The moment he spoke, Han Li appeared, the Immortal Extinguishing Sword unsheathed, its brilliant light cutting through eternity, extinguishing all power.
The Qiankun Bracelet was hurled out, unleashing boundless immortal light, the Thirty-three Heavens striking down, frightening White Emperor into hastily retracting his hand, no longer caring about Qin Shiyin.
Wuxian Palace grappled with the Immortal Extinguishing Sword, while the other Heavenly Immortal weapons combined their strength to fend off the Qiankun Bracelet.
White Emperor withdrew to the protective barrier of the Heavenly Immortal weapons, his face ashen as he watched the scene unfold.
“How dare you betray me!”
Staring at the still Qin Shiyin, White Emperor’s tone was extremely cold and filled with murderous intent.
No wonder he had felt something was off when Qin Shiyin entered the Taibai Immortal Realm, but he hadn’t thought much of it, which led to her bringing Han Li inside.
“You forced me,” Qin Shiyin replied, her voice equally cold, laced with hatred.
“White Emperor, nice to see you again.
Are you happy?” Han Li stood by Qin Shiyin’s side, smiling as he spoke.
Just a moment ago, he was still enjoying the scenery and having fun with Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Gongsun Yue, his four beautiful wives.
The golden chariot intentionally headed towards Taibai Divine Province, with the Emperor Flag concealing their movements from heaven’s watch, no one able to detect their traces.
In order to kill the White Emperor along the way, raid White Emperor City, and prevent any surprises, Han Li had brought most of Chengsheng Mountain’s heritage with him this time.
Aside from the Heaven-opening Axe, a True Immortal weapon left behind to guard Chengsheng Mountain, suppress fortune, and block prying eyes, the Emperor Flag, Qiankun Bracelet, as well as the Divine Sword, Primordial Chaos Cauldron, Yin Yang Mirror, two True Immortal weapons, and eight Heavenly Immortal weapons were all brought by Han Li.
With this arrangement, even if White Emperor City had an ambush, he would be able to retreat unscathed.
Thinking of ambushing him would be impossible.
The Divine Sword was comparable to a True Immortal weapon, and the Qiankun Bracelet was also a top-tier True Immortal weapon, one equal in power to two or three ordinary True Immortal weapons.
Then there was the Emperor Flag, the strongest of all True Immortal weapons, comparable to at least two or three top-tier True Immortal weapons.
With such a luxurious lineup, even if the Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, White Emperor City, and the other nine strongest powers joined forces, they could not capture him.
As far as he knew, the nine strongest forces only possessed four top-tier True Immortal weapons.
The other five were ordinary True Immortal weapons.
Moreover, with a mere thought from Han Li, the Heaven-opening Axe would arrive at White Emperor City in an extremely short time, catching the enemy by surprise.
However, Han Li didn’t think anything would go awry.
Qin Shiyin would not joke with her own life.
If she were to act as bait, she would surely die.
After the White Emperor contacted Qin Shiyin, she also used a secret technique to communicate with Han Li in his heart sea.
Thus, Han Li informed his four beautiful wives and temporarily stored the battle chariot and them away.
Assisted by the Emperor Flag, he arrived quickly and stealthily at Qin Shiyin’s location.
Of course, before descending, the Emperor Flag had already scanned the area to confirm there were no ambushes.
Then, in accordance with the plan, Han Li hid inside the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, which Qin Shiyin carried with her after it shrunk.
She used the Emperor Flag to conceal their fates, and the Qiankun Bracelet, Divine Sword, and other Heavenly Immortal weapons, whether proficient or not at concealing fate, were all activated to some extent.
By the time they entered the Taibai Immortal Realm, all of Han Li’s Immortal weapons were already prepared, waiting for an opportunity to strike.
The White Emperor stood by the Pool of Creation and Destruction, with a barrier formed by Heavenly Immortal weapons in front of him, protecting both him and the Creation Immortal Lotus.
Upon hearing Han Li’s words and seeing his detestable figure, the White Emperor looked indifferent.
Originally, he didn’t want to speak, but to stall Han Li, he decided to talk anyway.
The White Emperor acknowledged that even in his own base, he could not handle Han Li as there was no True Immortal Rank formation in Taibai Immortal Realm, and so he needed to buy time.
The commotion from several True Immortal weapons and a dozen Heavenly Immortal weapons clashing was huge, unable to be sealed by Taibai Immortal Realm, and would travel to the outside world, causing a tremendous upheaval.
No matter whether the other strongest powers had grievances with White Emperor City or not, they wouldn’t sit idly by and watch the newly rising Chengsheng Mountain destroy White Emperor City.
They would definitely come to support as quickly as possible.
After all, Chengsheng Mountain had only risen a few years ago.
If it were to destroy White Emperor City now, would the next target be the other strongest powers?
This was something all the strongest powers could not allow.
If Han Li were allowed to annihilate White Emperor City and gain the city’s inheritance, Chengsheng Mountain would become even harder to deal with.
Therefore, the White Emperor didn’t intend to fight to the death with Han Li.
He only needed to preserve his life and stall Han Li.
“Han Li…” The White Emperor began to speak, but before the second word could leave his mouth, Han Li launched his attack.
He knew the opportunity was fleeting and had no intentions of continuing the conversation with the White Emperor.
The Immortal Beating Whip, Immortal Locking Pillar, Immortal Extinguishing Sword, Wish-Fulfilling Blade, Primordial Chaos Cauldron, Lightning Boat, and six other Heavenly Immortal weapons descended onto the battlefield, taking over from the Qiankun Bracelet to suppress the four Heavenly Immortal weapons of White Emperor City.
The Yin Yang Mirror streaked across the sky, its Yin Yang immortal light sweeping over the entire Taibai Immortal Realm.
Along its path, all formations and prohibitions were ground to dust, and all treasures within them were seized by the Yin Yang Mirror.
The White Emperor’s face drastically changed, no longer caring about speaking to Han Li.
His Primordial Spirit’s light flickered as he communicated with Artifact Spirits of the Wuxian Palace and other Heavenly Immortal weapons, asking them to free themselves up to guard the treasures of Taibai Immortal Realm.
In that instant, the Qiankun Bracelet flew over, and the Heavenly Immortal weapons above the Pool of Creation and Destruction were knocked away.
The Infinite Immortal Light swept over and instantly killed the White Emperor’s clone.
The White Emperor himself was also struck down.
The Immortal Light swept over, seizing both the bronze fragment and the entire Pool of Creation and Destruction.
The Heavenly Immortal weapon tried to escape but was eventually suppressed by the Qiankun Bracelet.
Qin Shiyin was still in a daze, watching the scene unfold with an overwhelming force that seemed unstoppable.
The Immortal weapons of White Emperor City were suppressed, the White Emperor was instantly slain, and even the Pool of Creation and Destruction and the Creation Immortal Lotus were snatched away.
Han Li didn’t hesitate for a moment and, with a big hand, embraced Qin Shiyin’s slender waist and disappeared directly from the Taibai Immortal Realm.
The Divine Sword, Wish-Fulfilling Blade, Primordial Chaos Cauldron, and other Immortal weapons launched their attacks simultaneously with the Qiankun Bracelet’s strike, unleashing their fullest power to overpower the Wuxian Palace’s Immortal weapons, then fleeing together with the Qiankun Bracelet.
Not even half a breath after Han Li’s escape, stream after stream of Immortal Light descended in Taibai Immortal Realm.
Looking at the ravaged Immortal Realm, the supreme beings fell silent.

Chapter 659: Chapter 256: Shocking the Yuankun Domain!
Eight Supreme Beings on the Verge of Conflict!
All I Want is to Live a Low-Profile Life as a Daoist Chapter 659: Chapter 256: Shocking the Yuankun Domain!
Eight Supreme Beings on the Verge of Conflict!
All I Want is to Live a Low-Profile Life as a Daoist At this moment, countless gazes from all over the Endless Yuankun Domain were cast towards Taibai Divine Province.
The Battle of White Emperor City, though lasting only a mere moment, had shaken the entire Endless Yuankun Domain.
So many immortal soldiers were revived and engaged in full-scale battle, among them were even three True Immortal weapons, their terrifying power sending shockwaves throughout the Yuankun Domain.
...
“Again?”
“What on earth happened?”
“Hiss~ White Emperor City seems to have suffered a calamity again…”
“For decades now, the Yuankun Domain has erupted into battles of this magnitude numerous times; truly a period beset by endless troubles.”
“Who is attacking White Emperor City?
Even the Taibai Immortal Realm seems about to shatter.”
Among the many forces, Saints, Quasi Emperors, and even Great Emperors watched in shock towards the direction of White Emperor City.
Especially those Divine Provinces near the Taibai Divine Province.
Due to their proximity, when the battle’s power swept over, everyone felt their scalps tingle, fearing they would perish in the next moment.
Fortunately, the aftermath swept across the sky, sparing the various Divine Provinces, otherwise it would have surely resulted in utter devastation.
Countless Saintly Abyss Realm experts, Quasi Emperors, and two other Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors within the 53 Divine Provinces governed by White Emperor City were desperately rushing towards the Taibai Immortal Realm.
No matter what they thought, they had to rush over to protect their ruler; once the White Emperor died, the entire White Emperor City would fall apart, and this supreme power would cease to exist.
Without White Emperor City, even the status of a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor would greatly diminish.
The leaders of ordinary Heavenly Governing Forces and the Great Emperors within supreme powers had quite a difference in status and access to resources, not to mention other cultivators.
All cultivators of White Emperor City were in a terrible mood at this moment, feeling that their fortunes were ill-fated.
In just over twenty years, White Emperor City had faced three calamities.
It’s worth noting that in these years, the Endless Yuankun Domain had only witnessed three True Immortal Rank great wars, each coincidentally befalling White Emperor City.
The first was when a mysterious strong being launched a surprise attack on the five supreme powers.
During that time, Western Sky Palace and Heavenly Cult incurred some losses, while White Emperor City only suffered the injury of the White Emperor without other losses.
The second was the Battle of Qianyuan Divine Province two years ago, when the White Emperor took the bulk of White Emperor City’s heritage to join the battle and was blown up on the spot.
During White Emperor City’s moment of weak defense, five Supreme Leaders of unidentified status entered the Taibai Immortal Realm, looting outrageously and causing severe losses and damage to White Emperor City’s vital energy.
The third time is this one, with powerful forces breaking into the Taibai Immortal Realm and engaging in fierce battle with the White Emperor, the outcome still unknown.
However, the many experts of White Emperor City had a bad premonition.
White Emperor City owned only one True Immortal weapon, but earlier, fluctuations from three True Immortal weapons were detected, indicating that either someone with two True Immortal weapons or two Supreme Leaders had broken in together.
At this moment, the other eight Supreme Leaders of the Yuankun Domain had also arrived, virtually confirming the identity of the invaders in Taibai Immortal Realm.
The Great Emperor of Eternal Life from Chengsheng Mountain!
Could the White Emperor really withstand him?
The many experts had no confidence in their hearts.
The White Emperor had once been suppressed by the Great Emperor of Eternal Life in battle.
Inside the Taibai Immortal Realm.
The Empress Huangyue, Empress Yuanchu, Emperor Tianji, Butian Sect Master, Solar Deity Monarch, Western Sky Palace Master, Supreme Leader of the Qin Family and Supreme Leader of the Jiang Familyâ€”these eight Supreme Leaders almost arrived at the same time.
When they saw the drifting desolation and mess of the Taibai Immortal Realm, the expressions of the eight Supreme Leaders varied, but they all felt a strong sense of apprehension.
Han Li was too reckless!
Because of his grudge against the White Emperor, he directly stormed into the Taibai Immortal Realm, causing this chaos.
The White Emperor seemed to have died here too.
For someone like Han Li, who does not adhere to the rules, even if he is strong, they dislike him.
Some Supreme Leaders already had thoughts of joining forces to strike at Chengsheng Mountain, to destroy this newly risen First Power in the Yuankun Domain, and then to kill the Great Emperor of Eternal Life, Han Li.
They could not help but think this way.
If today, Han Li dared to invade the Taibai Immortal Realm and slay the White Emperor, then tomorrow or the day after, he might dare to break into other supreme powers’ heaven-blessed lands and slay them as well.
No matter whether they harbored enmity against the White Emperor or not, they now all shared a sense of mournfulness as one does when his kind meets with misfortune, nursing murderous intentions.
But before they joined forces to strike at Chengsheng Mountain, they had another task at handâ€”to take over the “legacy” of White Emperor City.
Since the White Emperor was dead, the vast power of White Emperor City should be divided among them.
After dividing the legacy of White Emperor City, they would go and kill Han Li, and incidentally take over Chengsheng Mountain as well.
Some Supreme Leaders suddenly discovered that this might not be such a bad turn of events; at least the outcome was greatly in their favor, with all the benefits falling into their laps.
With no more White Emperor City, and the White Emperor and Han Li, along with Chengsheng Mountain as the First Power of the Yuankun Domain gone, only the eight great supreme powers would remain in the Yuankun Domain.
They stood to gain very significant benefits.
“Is the White Emperor really dead?”
Emperor Tianji took the lead in breaking the silent atmosphere.
“He’s completely dead,” said Empress Yuanchu in a calm voice, holding a silver halberd.
“He must be truly dead.
Otherwise, he would have appeared by now,” said the Butian Sect Master with a meaningful smile on his face.
The Supreme Leader of the Jiang Family frowned slightly, “Do you think there’s a possibility that the White Emperor was not in the Taibai Immortal Realm and managed to escape this disaster by chance?”
The Western Sky Palace Master shook his head calmly, “Did you not feel the White Emperor’s Dao laws shattering?
They’ve spread disorderly throughout the Taibai Immortal Realm, nearly completely annihilated.”
“Since the White Emperor is dead, let’s start allocating,” Empress Huangyue said directly.
The death of the White Emperor was just that; even if they were to go after Han Li, it wouldn’t be to avenge the White Emperor, but for their own safety.
As these words were spoken, the scene fell silent once more.
The Supreme Leaders exchanged glances, each seeing the wariness in the others’ eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 660
chapters.content:
Chapter 660: Chapter 256: Shocking the Yuankun Domain!
Eight Supreme Beings on the Verge of Conflict!
All I Want is to Live a Low-Profile Life as a Daoist_2 Chapter 660: Chapter 256: Shocking the Yuankun Domain!
Eight Supreme Beings on the Verge of Conflict!
All I Want is to Live a Low-Profile Life as a Daoist_2 The inheritance of White Emperor City was too rich, even if the Immortal Elixir, Immortal Qi, Immortal Stone, and other resources of the Immortal path had been plundered by Han Li, the Immortal Scripture, Immortal Grade Martial Skill, and other treasures were still there; it was a great treasure trove.
Besides, what they valued even more were the divine weapons of White Emperor City, the Heavenly Immortal Weapons from Wuxian Palace as well as the other six Heavenly Immortal Weapons.
Obtaining one Heavenly Immortal Weapon could enhance the foundation of a supreme power slightly, but if one were to seize the Wuxian Palace, then the power to which the winner belonged would become the new First Power in the Yuan Kun Realm.
...
The Supreme Leaders found in each other’s eyes, from amongst the other Supreme Leaders, that everyone was determined to win over Wuxian Palace; even if relationships were good, even if they were allies, it would be impossible to yield a True Immortal Weapon.
“It seems that the Creation Immortal Lotus was taken away by Han Li, and it seems that a Heavenly Immortal Weapon was also taken,” the Solar Monarch mused, speaking up first.
The Supreme Leader of the Qin Family nodded slightly, but didn’t care much; his gaze swept around the circle, passing over the seven Supreme Leaders before he said indifferently,
“I only want Wuxian Palace; apart from that, you all can divide up everything else in White Emperor City as you wish.
Any objections?”
He was already the strongest person in the Yuan Kun Realm, with unfathomable strength, rumored to be just one step away from entering the Battle Immortal Realm.
If he were to obtain Wuxian Palace, from then on, there would be no one in the Endless Yuan Kun Realm who could threaten him.
Facing the domineering aura of the Supreme Leader of the Qin Family, the seven Supreme Leaders all sneered coldly, releasing their remarkably overwhelming auras to contend with him.
Usually, they would give the Supreme Leader of the Qin Family some face, but in front of the True Immortal Weapon that was Wuxian Palace, they didn’t care about whether he was the strongest in the Yuan Kun Realm.
As long as they obtained Wuxian Palace, they themselves would become the strongest in the Yuan Kun Realm, and the power that they represented would also become the First Power in the Yuan Kun Realm.
The master of the Western Sky Palace said with a smile that was not quite a smile, “Qin Changsheng, do you think we will let you have it?”
“Then my Butian Sect will also only want Wuxian Palace, and the rest of you can have everything else,” the Butian Sect Master followed.
“What this Emperor values has never been handed over voluntarily,”
The tone of Empress Huang Yue was calm, but her words were rather domineering, causing the Supreme Leaders to frown slightly.
Not counting divine weapons and other external things, purely based on strength, Empress Huang Yue ranked among the top three among them and might even compete with the Supreme Leader of the Qin Family for the top spot.
Empress Yuanchu glanced at her and said coldly, “Wuxian Palace, this Empress will take it.”
The Solar Monarch looked left and right, also wanting to make such a domineering declaration, but eventually, he sighed inwardly and did not speak.
In terms of strength, amongst the Supreme Leaders, he was almost at the bottom, presumably only slightly stronger than Emperor Tianji; they were both at the absolute pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, yet there was a significant gap in their combat abilities.
In terms of power, his Solar Empire was also close to the bottom among the supreme powers; he really didn’t have the confidence to speak in such a manner.
Besides, he didn’t even have an ally.
Chengsheng Mountain could barely be considered half an ally; his ninth daughter was over there, and it was almost certain that she would marry Han Li, but now both Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain were in danger, so he dared not involve himself further.
“Then it’s down to each one’s ability,”
The Supreme Leader of the Qin Family stood with his hands behind his back beneath the sky, expressionless, his gaze slightly lowered as if he wanted to look down on the Supreme Leaders.
“Just the opportunity to see whether you all have made any progress.”
As he watched the tense and confrontational scene unfold, Emperor Tianji gave a bitter smile; he was not one for competing.
Although he was also covetous of Wuxian Palace, he knew that he did not have much chance to snatch it away.
Much like the Solar Monarch, he also disliked fighting and killing.
Emperor Tianji’s gaze swept over the Supreme Leaders and looked towards Wuxian Palace as well as the other four Heavenly Immortal Weapons; he decided it was better to give up and claim one Heavenly Immortal Weapon for himself first.
“I will not vie for Wuxian Palace.
I shall take a Heavenly Immortal Weapon, and everyone has no objection…
Eh?
White Emperor is not dead?”
As Emperor Tianji withdrew his gaze and spoke deliberately, he suddenly stopped, his tone full of surprise.
In the moment Emperor Tianji discovered it, other Supreme Leaders like the Supreme Leader of the Qin Family, Empress Huang Yue, Empress Yuanchu, and the master of the Western Sky Palace also noticed, their faces showing astonishment.
The White Emperor was alive again!
Watching the slowly coalescing figure of White Emperor, the eight Supreme Leaders looked on with inscrutable expressions, coldly observing.
No one wished for White Emperor to be alive.
They would rather that White Emperor truly died at the hands of Han Li, so that they could divide the inheritance of White Emperor City, even if it meant a fierce battle.
Unfortunately, White Emperor ultimately did not die but luckily survived, or perhaps the Great Emperor Changsheng never meant to completely suppress White Emperor and might have been there just to plunder the Taibai Immortal Realm.
Although very annoyed, the Supreme Leaders inexplicably breathed a sigh of relief; it seemed that Great Emperor Changsheng had not yet lost his mind, at least he had some measure of restraint.
“What a pity.”
Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu exchanged a glance, both understanding the regret in the other’s eyes.
If White Emperor had truly died, then they could have pushed the eight great powers to join forces, go to Chengsheng Mountain, and get rid of that insidious rascal Han Li.
It would be best to snatch back the split soul; not that it mattered much if they couldn’t since they would not need much time to recover and could still enter the Battle Immortal Realm in peak condition.
In the center of the Taibai Immortal Realm, Wuxian Palace emitted rays of Immortal Qi, aiding White Emperor in reassembling his scattered flesh and blood, and even his Primordial Spirit, shattered into countless fragments, began to return.
The True Spirit of White Emperor emerged from Wuxian Palace and returned to its physical body, reestablishing connections with the body, Primordial Spirit, and martial path.
All of this progressed smoothly.
The White Emperor, having successfully resurrected, breathed a sigh of relief.
Looking at the surrounding eight Supreme Leaders, his expression was very cold, with no trace of gratitude.
He knew that the last thing these eight wanted was for him to be alive.
Had he not been protected by Wuxian Palace and the five Heavenly Immortal Weapons, these eight Supreme Leaders might have directly moved to suppress him and lay the blame on Han Li.
