chapters.content:
Chapter 661: Chapter 256: Shocking the Yuankun Domain!
Eight Supreme Beings on the Verge of Conflict!
All I Want is to Live a Low-Profile Life as a Daoist_3 Chapter 661: Chapter 256: Shocking the Yuankun Domain!
Eight Supreme Beings on the Verge of Conflict!
All I Want is to Live a Low-Profile Life as a Daoist_3 “Gentlemen, please return,” said the White Emperor, his face expressionless.
Empress Yuanchu, Supreme Leader of Qin Family, the master of Western Sky Palace, and the other five supreme beings glanced at the White Emperor and then at the five immortal weapons above his head, sighing inwardly.
They had thought about taking the opportunity to kill the White Emperor, but none made a move.
...
The reason was the lack of unity; if only a part of them acted, the others might interfere, needlessly offending the White Emperor to death.
Not all of them wished to see the White Emperor revived only to die again.
Supreme beings like Emperor Tianji and the Sun Emperor preferred the White Emperor alive to continue ruling over White Emperor City, so the Wuxian Palace would not fall into other supreme beings’ hands, and the gap between them would not be insurmountable.
With Chengsheng Mountain already reigning supreme over them, none wished to be dominated by another, especially a rival they knew well.
Following this, the eight supreme beings went their separate ways.
Some, like the Sun Emperor, Emperor Tianji, and the Supreme Leader of Jiang Family, even exchanged some pleasantries before leaving, while Empress Yuanchu and Empress Yuanchu scoffed and departed directly, the Supreme Leader of Qin Family leaving most decisively.
“Congratulations to Brother White on your rebirth.
I hope such a tragedy does not occur again,” said one of them politely.
“White Emperor, we came to assist you.
Why do you greet us with such a cold face?
If you seek vengeance, go find Han Li,” another remarked.
With a tone neither salty nor bland, the master of Western Sky Palace and the Butian Sect Master left unwillingly after a few sarcastic comments.
Throughout it all, the White Emperor remained expressionless, not uttering a word even as he faced the supreme beings’ ridicule.
After all the supreme beings had left, the White Emperor looked at the wreckage that was Taibai Immortal Realm, his eyes blazing with a fury that could destroy worlds, yet he still said nothing.
The close call was too much; he had nearly died in his own sanctuary.
Having obtained the core piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation and being on the verge of acquiring another Piece of Natural Jade Symbol, as well as the body of Empress Qin Shiyin, the White Emperor had been overly confident, assured he could easily manipulate Qin Shiyin and had become a bit arrogant.
He had never expected that Qin Shiyin would collude with his nemesis, Han Li, especially since Qin Shiyin did not previously know Han Li.
And Han Li had actually agreed, truly helping Qin Shiyin against him.
Was he not afraid of an ambush?
The White Emperor could not understand this, and even less so why Qin Shiyin would choose Han Li over him.
What did he lack compared to Han Li?
She would rather be with a stranger than let him have her.
In just a few decades, Zimei had betrayed him, Empress Yuanchu looked down on him, and now Qin Shiyin had also betrayed him.
His dignity and reputation had been damaged time and time again.
To the White Emperor, this was an intolerable humiliation.
Yet, the White Emperor did not shout or wail; all his frustration, rage, and resentment were deeply buried in the deepest recesses of his heart.
He had been thwarted by Han Li once again, a severe blow to the White Emperor.
But, every setback is a setup for a comeback!
Previously, he had not been meticulous enough in practicing the Tao of survival, leading to such a disaster.
This bloody lesson was an awakening for the White Emperor.
He decided, from this day forward, to be a low-profile practitioner of the Tao of survival.
In everything he did, he would be cautious and make sure he was completely confident before acting.
He could not afford to repeat past mistakes; he no longer had the capital for a comeback.
As long as he could endure, there would always be a chance for revenge in the future.
He set a small goal for himself: survive for ten thousand years.
If that wasn’t enough, then a hundred thousand years, a million years, ten million years…
During this time, he would quietly and inconspicuously search for clues to True Immortal weapons, slowly accumulating his foundation.
Even if Han Li wanted to kill him again, he would not dare to do so openly without incurring the wrath of all supreme beings and being jointly suppressed by them.
Even if Han Li became strong enough to defy all supreme beings, unless he had Golden Immortal Battle Power and Golden Immortal weapons, he would not break the taboos of Yuankun Domain.
Like today, Han Li did not dare to kill him and could only snatch what he wanted and flee.
What the White Emperor did not know was that while he planned to endure for millions of years before dealing with Han Li, Han Li had no intention of giving him that much time.
According to Han Li’s estimates, in just another thirty years, and if all went well, within twenty or even ten years, he would have the power to be invincible in Yuankun Domain.
Then the time for reckoning would come.
For now, he was merely letting the White Emperor live a little longer.
Just as the White Emperor had suddenly realized his mistakes and decided to quietly practice the Tao of survival, the cultivators of White Emperor City finally arrived.
Upon entering Taibai Immortal Realm, the faces of all cultivators turned pale: Taibai Immortal Realm was in a state of disorder, almost stripped bare.
Had thieves looted the place clean?
When they saw the White Emperor at the center along with the five immortal weapons, the multitude of cultivators breathed a sigh of relief.
It was a relief that the White Emperor was alive; otherwise, White Emperor City would have truly fallen.
“Greetings to Your Majesty, the White Emperor!”
“Your Majesty, the White Emperor, what has happened?”
“Did Han Li come knocking at our door?”
The powerhouses of White Emperor City asked noisily, feeling quite uneasy.
Taibai Immortal Realm had already been plundered once by the five supreme beings, with heavy losses incurred.
Now Han Li had ransacked it again, nearly emptying their foundation.
Did they still have resources for cultivation in the future?
The many cultivators asked a few questions, then fell silent.
Perhaps it would have been better if the White Emperor had died.
This way, the inheritance of White Emperor City could be divided, and they could choose to join other powerful forces, avoiding the current predicament.
But with the White Emperor still alive, controlling immortal weapons of both the Heavenly Immortal and True Immortal caliber, no one dared openly rebel.
The White Emperor’s gaze swept over the many cultivators, fully aware of their thoughts, yet he said nothing; times had changed.
Taking a deep breath, he said firmly, “My friends, only we are left in White Emperor City.
I hope you will all work together with me.
With unity, we can rise again.”

chapters.content:
Chapter 662: Chapter 256: Shocking the Yuankun Domain!
Eight Supreme Beings on the Verge of Conflict!
All I Want is to Live a Low-Profile Life as a Daoist_4 Chapter 662: Chapter 256: Shocking the Yuankun Domain!
Eight Supreme Beings on the Verge of Conflict!
All I Want is to Live a Low-Profile Life as a Daoist_4 Speaking, the White Emperor bowed deeply to the many cultivators of White Emperor City.
He would never have done that before, for the proud him always summoned subordinates at his beck and call without much care.
Now, all of White Emperor City’s immortal cultivation resources, most of the Emperor-level resources were gone, even the Creation Immortal Lotus, the Pool of Creation and Destruction, and a Heavenly Immortal weapon had been stolen by Han Li.
...
If it weren’t for his forethought in hiding part of his True Spirit in the core of Wuxian Palace to prevent accidents, he would have truly died.
The many cultivators of White Emperor City were stunned by this scene, then their faces all showed excitement, regardless of its authenticity, and they shouted in unison.
“We swear to follow His Majesty the White Emperor to the death!”
The news of the battle at White Emperor City quickly spread throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain, and the reputation of White Emperor City suffered greatly, falling into complete silence, while Chengsheng Mountain rose in fame once more, shaking the entire domain.
At this time, in Qianyuan Divine Province, at Penglai Immortal Sect.
Upon Penglai Divine Mountain, two figures stood on a cliff, secretly discussing while looking over the East Sea.
These two figures were none other than the master of Penglai Immortal Sect, Guanhai Elder, and Monarch of Bai Yujing’s third Sect Leader, Lu Zhen.
“Uncle-Master, are you truly going to ignore Elder Sister Lingshuang?” Lu Zhen asked angrily.
Ling Lingshuang was his unrequited love, and he had been uneasy about her.
Ever since he learned that Ling Lingshuang had been captured by Han Li and had become Han Li’s Dao companion, he was extremely sad.
Lu Zhen had sought out his Sect Master, asking him to plead on his behalf, even if it was just for a chance to see Elder Sister Lingshuang.
But the Monarch of Bai Yujing refused him and even confined Lu Zhen, forbidding him to take a single step out of Bai Yujing.
The Monarch, of course, knew of Lu Zhen’s situation, but he wouldn’t dare to confront Han Li.
As Han Li’s strength kept growing and Chengsheng Mountain’s influence continued to expand, becoming the foremost power in Yuankun Domain, Bai Yujing didn’t dare to provoke them.
With no other options, Lu Zhen pretended to have given up, and only recently the Monarch allowed him out; Lu Zhen immediately ran to Penglai Immortal Sect.
He hoped to persuade Guanhai Elder to step in.
He knew regaining Elder Sister Lingshuang was hopeless, yet he still wanted to see her, to ask how Ling Lingshuang was doing lately.
In truth, he could go himself, but for various reasons, he dared not.
“Lu Zhen, give it up,” Guanhai Elder said, shaking his head.
He and the Monarch of Bai Yujing had long discussed the matter and had reached a consensus with the other Sacred Land Masters not to provoke Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain.
“Can’t I even see her once?” Lu Zhen roared.
He couldn’t wait any longer; if he did, his Elder Sister Lingshuang would probably have gone from aaa to AAA.
“Then you go by yourself; my Penglai Immortal Sect will not accompany you,”
Guanhai Elder said in a cold voice, signaling the end of the visit.
Chengsheng Mountain was now too powerful, the first in Yuankun Domain.
Having Ling Lingshuang at Chengsheng Mountain was a good thing; Penglai Immortal Sect might even benefit from it and use it as an opportunity for revival.
He had already visited Chengsheng Mountain once, had seen Ling Lingshuang, and had also met several of her children, but these words he could not say to Lu Zhen.
Otherwise, Lu Zhen would probably go mad.
Lu Zhen was just about to leave when he and Guanhai Elder looked towards the sky, toward the direction of Taibai Divine Province.
“That’s the fluctuation of a True Immortal weapon,”
Guanhai Elder said with a solemn expression.
Lu Zhen nodded and stood still, waiting for news, fearing that a great upheaval had occurred in Yuankun Domain.
Indeed, they didn’t have to wait long.
A piece of news swiftly spread to them, and upon hearing it, both Lu Zhen and Guanhai Elder fell silent.
Guanhai Elder sighed, patted Lu Zhen on the shoulder, and disappeared from the cliff.
After this battle, Chengsheng Mountain became even stronger, and no one in Yuankun Domain dared to trouble them.
Lu Zhen clenched his fists tightly, but eventually let go, his body deflated like a punctured ball, dazedly leaving Penglai Immortal Sect.
He stepped onto a Divine Sword, having no plans to return to Bai Yujing, took out a liquor flask, and kept pouring it into his mouth, trying to drown his sorrows with drink.
However, indulging in wine only deepened his sorrow.
Lu Zhen then disappeared from Qianyuan Divine Province and wasn’t seen again until tens of thousands of years later, by which time he had become known as the Wine Sword Immortal.

chapters.title: Chapter 663
chapters.content:
Chapter 663: Chapter 257: Old Han, do you want a wife?
Offering a Supreme Female!
Ding, new achievement unlocked!
Seeking the Female Bodhisattva_1 Chapter 663: Chapter 257: Old Han, do you want a wife?
Offering a Supreme Female!
Ding, new achievement unlocked!
Seeking the Female Bodhisattva_1 Qianyuan Divine Province, Chengsheng Mountain.
...
Han Li and his four beautiful wives, Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Gongsun Yue, descended from the Sky God War Chariot and returned to Chengdao Peak.
Besides them, there was another person who also came down, and that was the Quasi Empress Qin Shiyin.
After raiding the Taibai Immortal Realm and once again defeating White Emperor, Han Li directly escaped with Qin Shiyin in his arms.
Only after putting some distance from Taibai Divine Province did he release the Sky God War Chariot and his four wives.
Worried that the eight Supreme Beings might join forces and attack Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li explained the situation to his wives.
They all gave up any thought of continuing their leisurely trip, agreeing to return directly to Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li knew it was highly unlikely that the eight Supreme Beings would come after him; after all, he hadn’t actually killed the White Emperor.
However, just to be safe, he returned quickly.
In the chariot, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and the other ladies eyed Quasi Empress Qin Shiyin with curiosity, wondering how their husband had managed to bring back a peerless beauty even more stunning than themselves.
But the chariot was exceedingly fast, and it wasn’t long before they were back at Chengsheng Mountain.
There was no time for introductions, so none of them recognized the other.
After touching down, Han Li waited a while and, upon realizing that the Supreme Beings congregated at White Emperor City had each gone their separate ways, he breathed a sigh of relief and then introduced them, saying,
“Xiang Xiang, Jiang Jiang, Yun Yun, Yue’er, this is Qin Shiyin, a Quasi Empress from the Heavenly Governing Forces.”
A Quasi Empress from the Heavenly Governing Forces?
Upon hearing this, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue all constricted their pupils, their flawless faces filled with shock.
They had long anticipated that their husband would eventually take a Heavenly Governing Forces’ Quasi Empress as his wife, but they didn’t expect it to happen so soon.
Thirty years ago, their husband had only taken a Quasi Empress.
Strictly speaking, he had yet to marry a wife of Quasi Emperor Rank.
Although Yuan Youwei was a Quasi Emperor, Han Li never married her.
Yuan Youwei was merely a female servant, with very low status.
Later she rose by virtue of her child, her status continually changing, but even now she was still a concubine.
If speaking of wives of Quasi Emperor Rank, Han Li indeed had oneâ€”Ji Mingyue, who had broken through to the Quasi Emperor domain.
Zimei Zhen was stuck at the peak of the Saint Abyss realm, continuing to hone her skills.
However, Ji Mingyue had advanced in cultivation later; even when she married Han Li, she was only in the mid-stage of the Saint Abyss realm.
In just these short thirty years, their husband was about to marry a Quasi Empress from the Heavenly Governing Forces, skipping the rank of Quasi Empress altogether, which was beyond their expectations.
All four ladies knew that, given their husband Han Li’s strength, identity, status, and so on, marrying a Quasi Empress from the Heavenly Governing Forces was only a matter of time.
They thought he would first marry a few Quasi Empresses before, perhaps decades later, taking a Quasi Empress from the Heavenly Governing Forces as his wife.
Seeing the expression of his four beautiful wives, Han Li knew what they were thinking and shrugged helplessly.
He hadn’t expected it either.
Who could blame the White Emperor for being so keen on providing him with wives?
The White Emperor called him the Path of Survival Supreme Being, and Han Li was more than willing to acknowledge the White Emperor as the Supreme Being of Providing Daughters.
First, it was the female saint Zimei Zhen, and now it was the Quasi Empress Qin Shiyin.
Although Qin Shiyin came of her own free will, the White Emperor was still a major factor.
What a pity that the White Emperor had no chance to utter the famed words, “Old Han, do you want a wife?
Just give the word, and I’ll immediately send her over,” which would have been perfect.
Even more unfortunate was that the White Emperor hadn’t sent him a Quasi Empress wife.
Otherwise, he would have completed a new set of achievements, with him and the White Emperor mutually benefiting one another.
Female Saint, Quasi Empress, Empress!
But Han Li didn’t plan to give up on this achievement.
The White Emperor definitely wouldn’t send another, so Han Li was preparing to just take what he wanted by force.
Now, White Emperor City was severely damaged, its vitality sapped, and its foundation deeply compromised, becoming the weakest among the strongest powers.
Though Han Li didn’t utterly slay the White Emperor, he destroyed part of his True Spirit, and some of the laws contained within his body and Primordial Spirit also shattered.
Even if the White Emperor revived and temporarily restored his strength to its peak, his foundations would be damaged, a segment severed by Han Li, placing him further from becoming a Battle Immortal.
Therefore, Han Li planned to continue preying on White Emperor City, the “fat sheep,” shearing it as much as possible.
Other supreme powers, even if dissatisfied, wouldn’t take drastic measures, since Han Li hadn’t crossed the line.
Han Li also had his eyes on Fairies from other Heavenly Governing Forces and supreme powers.
He just couldn’t forcefully take them yet.
Doing so without cause would unite all powers against Chengsheng Mountain, resulting in losses outweighing the gains.
He would shear the White Emperor bald first.
According to Zimei Zhen, there were three Fairies in White Emperor City.
Zimei Zhen herself was one of them, and the other two were also female saints of the Saint Abyss realm.
Besides, in the domain of Quasi Emperors, White Emperor City boasted two more fairies with widespread reputations.
In the domain of the Heavenly Governing Forces, there was only Qin Shiyin.
Now that Qin Shiyin and Zimei Zhen had been “given” to him by the White Emperor, the latter would surely be “generous” enough to “give” him the other two female saints and two Quasi Empresses.
“Tsk tsk!”
Han Li suddenly thought higher of the White Emperor and couldn’t help but click his tongue in wonder.
The White Emperor was truly the good Samaritan of the Yuankun Domain!
So, Han Li decided to let the White Emperor keep growing taller, at least in appearance.
This was not difficult for Han Liâ€”it only involved a few hats.
…
In a flash, numerous thoughts crossed the minds of the four women.
They exchanged glances, then smilingly said to Qin Shiyin, “Nice to meet you, Sister Qin~”
Although their husband hadn’t said it outright, they were confident that Quasi Empress Qin Shiyin was definitely going to be one of their sisters.
Knowing their husband’s nature, he would not let Qin Shiyin go.
It was only that this Quasi Empress from the Heavenly Governing Forces didn’t seem to have been brought by force.
Seeing her calm and composed demeanor, it appeared to be of her own volition?
That was indeed quite curious…

Chapter 664: Chapter 257: Old Han, do you want a wife or not?
Offering a Female Supreme!
Ding, new achievement unlocked!
Off to find the Female Bodhisattva_2 Chapter 664: Chapter 257: Old Han, do you want a wife or not?
Offering a Female Supreme!
Ding, new achievement unlocked!
Off to find the Female Bodhisattva_2 “I’ve met all four younger sisters.”
Qin Shiyin accepted this address with equanimity, her smile bright as blossoms, her face radiant with joy.
...
Having made a deal with Han Li, and with Han Li having fulfilled his end by killing the White Emperor, she was now essentially his dao companion, at the very least his fiancÃ©e.
Whether in terms of cultivation strength or age, after marrying Han Li, she should be considered the elder sister among Han Li’s beautiful wives.
Clearly, Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, and the others thought the same, or they would not have addressed her thus.
But Qin Shiyin also knew that Lu Tianxiang and the others were only paying lip service to this, and would not readily acknowledge her status as above theirs.
In terms of status, everyone was Han Li’s wife, his dao companion, with no difference in rank.
In terms of position, Lu Tianxiang and the others had married Han Li before her, and objectively, their status was indeed somewhat higher, even if she was a Heaven Imperial Realm Empress.
But at Chengsheng Mountain, the level of cultivation wasn’t importantâ€”these four women were all female saints of the Holy Abyss Realm, and they had hopes of reaching the Heaven Imperial Realm in the future.
Han Li then introduced Yun Miaoyi, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, and Gongsun Yue to Qin Shiyin one by one and explained the arrangements for her, planning to marry her in three months.
Qin Shiyin was the first Heaven Imperial Realm Empress Han Li was to marry, and he wanted to make the ceremony grand to match Chengsheng Mountain’s current status.
Jiang Baiye, Gongsun Yue, and the other four women were slightly startled, but agreed that it was appropriate, and then began chatting with Qin Shiyin.
They soon seemed as close as sisters, at least on the surface.
Han Li chimed in from time to time.
An hour later, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, and Lu Tianxiang, Han Li’s beautiful wives, left one after another, leaving only Han Li and Qin Shiyin at the peak of Chengdao Peak.
Because their traveling had been interrupted, Han Li promised to take them on a trip next time and offered a generous compensation.
“So this is your Chengsheng Mountain?
It’s quite a surprise,” Qin Shiyin remarked abruptly.
Lost in thought, Han Li was suddenly addressed by Qin Shiyin.
As a Heaven Imperial Realm Empress, her divine sense had long scoured Chengsheng Mountain, glimpsing most of its secrets, which she knew Han Li had intentionally allowed her to see.
Given their relationship, learning these secrets was inevitable and Han Li would not keep them from her.
Thus, Qin Shiyin was taken by surprise.
The scenery and heritage of Chengsheng Mountain were much stronger and more profound than the outside world had speculated.
It seemed she had made an extremely wise decision.
“It’s ours,” Han Li corrected her.
A flash of surprise crossed Yin Shiyin’s eyes as she responded softly, “Mhm~”
“Here, this is for you.”
Han Li casually tossed over a bronze fragment and another piece of the Jade Talisman of Creation.
According to their previous agreement, these pieces of the Jade Talisman of Creation were meant for Qin Shiyin.
Han Li had no intention of reneging; what belonged to Qin Shiyin was his as well.
Staring at the two pieces of the Jade Talisman of Creation in her hands, Qin Shiyin was stunned.
She was absolutely certain that these were pieces of the Jade Talisman of Creation, including the most crucial core piece.
“You…
just gave these to me?” Qin Shiyin’s eyes flashed with astonishment and disbelief.
This was the Jade Talisman of Creation!
Although there were only two pieces, their power was no less than a Heavenly Immortal weapon, and their value even higher.
After becoming a Heaven Imperial Realm Empress and mastering the Heavenly Sovereign Path, she had always sought a Heavenly Immortal weapon.
Only with such a weapon could her strength rapidly increase and her life be secure.
Yet she had never found one.
Later, the White Emperor gave her hope, but Qin Shiyin realized he was only leading her on, with no intention of giving her the Jade Talisman, even coveting her body.
That’s why Qin Shiyin decided to rebel outright.
Now, she actually had them in her possession.
Where the White Emperor merely tantalized her with promises, Han Li promptly doubled them, increasing Qin Shiyin’s favorable impression of him.
Initially, Qin Shiyin had seen this only as a transaction, and marrying Han Li as a way to use him to gain more resources to cultivate to higher realms.
But now, her thoughts began to shift.
Perhaps even developing feelings for Han Li wouldn’t be so bad.
Nevertheless, Qin Shiyin merely entertained the thought.
Having cultivated to the Heaven Imperial Realm, she had experienced much and knew all too well the treacherous nature of the human heart, and wouldn’t be easily moved by Han Li.
She had countless suitors, but those were merely seeking benefits from her, such as her beauty or treasures like cultivation techniques, and even the White Emperor was no different.
“It’s what you deserve,” Han Li said with a smile.
Looking at the black-robed Empress, her battle attire could not hide her exquisite figure, but instead highlighted her perfect curves, along with the white silk stockings that adorned her long, fair legs, stirring a hint of desire in Han Li.
However, Han Li made no move.
Qin Shiyin was already in his grasp, and there was no need for haste.
Though Han Li had an inkling of what Qin Shiyin might be thinkingâ€”as a seasoned lover, he had a rough ideaâ€” he did not plan to play any courtship games with her.
She was already within his reach.
His plan was to make the relationship official, have a few children with her, and then work on cultivating their emotions slowly over time.
After a good conversation with Qin Shiyin to further her fondness for him, Han Li called over Zimiao Zhen to arrange Qin Shiyin’s chambers.
Zimiao Zhen was naturally surprised to see Qin Shiyin, but without asking any questions, she led Qin Shiyin away.
They would have plenty of time to chat later.
Once Zimiao Zhen and Qin Shiyin had departed, Han Li began to take stock of the spoils of the war.
The raid on the White Emperor City within the Taibai Immortal Realm had reaped many benefits, even after five Supreme beings had already plundered it once before, showing just how wealthy White Emperor City had been.

Off to seek the Female Bodhisattva_3 Chapter 665: Chapter 257: Old Han, do you want a wife or not?
Offering a Female Supreme!
Ding, new achievement unlocked!
Off to seek the Female Bodhisattva_3 He gained an immense amount of cultivation resources, such as Immortal Qi and Immortal Stones, practically emptying out the Dao resources of White Emperor City.
...
He also obtained three Heaven Rank Immortal Elixirs, as well as the most important Creation Immortal Lotus, even the pond it was in was uprooted by Han Li.
Han Li was naturally very clear about the effects of the Creation Immortal Lotus, he intended to use it for himself, as it was a heaven-defying treasure.
The White Emperor had even considerately prepared an enormous amount of resources refined into creation fluid for him, so Han Li could directly use it.
Unfortunately, when the White Emperor saw that the situation wasn’t right, he had already removed all traces of his flesh body, Primordial Spirit, True Spirit, and martial arts from the Creation Immortal Lotus, otherwise, Han Li would have been able to explore all there was about the White Emperor through it.
Though it wasn’t of much use to him, it was extremely useful for the descendants of the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain as well as his beloved wives and concubines.
With a casual toss, Han Li placed the Creation Immortal Lotus and the Pool of Creation and Destruction upon Chengdao Peak, to accompany the Nine Calamities Immortal Lotus.
The Nine Calamities Immortal Lotus had already matured twice, and the cultivation of loving wives like Zi Miao Zhen and Ji Mingyue had made great strides forward, with the Nine Calamities Immortal Lotus playing no small part.
After doing all this, Han Li summoned the Qiankun Bracelet and released the sealed Heavenly Immortal Soldier within itâ€”though its power was sealed.
This was a Tower-type Heavenly Immortal Soldier.
Han Li flicked his finger towards the Heavenly Immortal Soldier, the divine light hit the body of the tower, and a figure was shaken out, falling onto Chengdao Peak.
To Han Li’s surprise, the Artifact Spirit of the Heavenly Immortal Soldier was also female, and her appearance, grace, and figure were not a whit inferior to Empress Qin Shiyin.
Tsk, buy one get one free!
“Now you only have two choices, first, submit to me; second, submit to me,” Han Li said indifferently to the exquisitely beautiful Artifact Spirit.
Upon hearing this, Yan Xuan’s lips twitched slightly.
Was this really giving me two choices?
Yan Xuan really wanted to retort, but as her original body’s power was sealed and she also felt at least three True Immortal Soldiers locking onto her, she silently retracted her snarky remark.
Shocked by the hidden strength Han Li possessed, Yan Xuan very straightforwardly chose the first option; after all, there was no real choice to be made.
“Very good,” Han Li said with a smile on his face.
With Yan Xuan’s cooperation, Han Li successfully left his mark at her core, making Yan Xuan his own.
Afterwards, Han Li inquired about some intelligence from Yan Xuan, related to both her true form and the White Emperor.
This Immortal Tower was called the Seven Immortal Pagoda, a top-notch Heavenly Immortal weapon that could unleash seven Immortal Dao Domains, exceedingly powerful, second only to Wuxian Palace in White Emperor City, hence the White Emperor used it to guard the Creation Immortal Lotus.
After unsealing the Seven Immortal Pagoda and testing it, Han Li was very pleased with its power.
Even though there were many immortal soldiers in Chengsheng Mountain, the Seven Immortal Pagoda could still be ranked sixth, slightly stronger than the Yin Yang Mirror.
So, the White Emperor truly was a great benefactor.
Looking at Yan Xuan, who was dressed in a rainbow-colored skirt, Han Li had a thoughtâ€”perhaps the White Emperor didn’t just “send” him a Heaven Imperial Realm empress, but also a Heavenly Immortal.
As the Artifact Spirit of a top-notch Heavenly Immortal weapon, Yan Xuan might not compare to a top-notch Heavenly Immortal, but she was still stronger than a regular Heavenly Immortal.
Feeling Han Li’s unusual gaze, Yan Xuan suddenly shivered.
What did Han Li want to do to her?
“Go play with Xi Yue and Hong Yun,” Han Li said, momentarily having no plans for her.
After speaking, he left Chengsheng Mountain and headed straight for Xumi Mountain.
He planned to visit the female Bodhisattva to vent his frustrations.
PS: Not feeling well today, will make up for it tomorrow, and also plan to release more chapters, so I’m asking for monthly votes.

Chapter 666: Chapter 258: The Diary of a Female Bodhisattva!
Ascend Xumi Mountain!
An Uncontrollable Blaze_1 Chapter 666: Chapter 258: The Diary of a Female Bodhisattva!
Ascend Xumi Mountain!
An Uncontrollable Blaze_1 Qianyuan Divine Province, Xumi Mountain.
Xumi Mountain reaches the heavens, and it is said that the Buddha who founded the Xumi lineage possessed the ability to reach the heavens.
With the Great Divine Power to “contain Xumi in a mustard seed,” he created this Sacred Land.
...
Here lies the Sacred Land of the Buddhist Sect and the ancestral seat of Buddhism in the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Atop it sits the Great Leiyin Temple, governing the Million Buddha Kingdom of the Buddha Domain.
At this moment, atop Xumi Mountain, thunderous chants and Buddhist hymns resonated, turning mysterious Buddhist principles into skies of flowers, forming golden lotuses and manifesting celestials and Buddha maidens.
A Heavenly Abyss appeared overhead, growing larger and more tangible, bursting forth with boundless Buddha light, illuminating the myriad beings and shaking the various realms.
In the next instant, a dominantly strong aura of a Saint swept in all directions, shaking Qianyuan, drawing the attention of the rulers of the six Great Holy Land Schools.
“The female Bodhisattva has also broken through to the Saint Abyss Realm.”
Dao Lords, Demon Lords, Barbarian Lords, Ancestral Warriors, Demon Lords, and the Old Taoist of Guanhai simultaneously murmured to themselves, each with a different expression.
Among them, some had stepped into the Saint Abyss Realm before the female Bodhisattva, like the Dao Lords, some were still accumulating power, just a step away from the Saint Abyss Realm, like the Old Taoist of Guanhai, and some were quite far from the Saint Abyss Realm, like the Demon Lords.
This was all thanks to the benefaction of that everlasting Great Emperor from Chengsheng Mountain.
Seven years ago, in the battle of the Barbarian Region, though Chengsheng Mountain rose on top of them, tarnishing their renown, it also brought substantial benefits.
Apart from Xumi Mountain, practically all the Great Holy Land Schools had formed marital alliances with Chengsheng Mountain, offering numerous high-quality and beautiful female cultivators to Han Li.
Afterward, the powerful beings of the Tongxuan Realm from these Sacred Lands took a trip outside of the Qianyuan Divine Province to peruse their martial paths and thereby made further advancements.
Because of Chengsheng Mountain, the Saint Abyss Realm Power and Quasi Emperor Rank powers from the neighboring Divine Provinces didn’t dare cause chaos, nor was there a need to.
In the past, the isolation of the Qianyuan Divine Province was to prevent its revival and a return to grandeur.
Now, with the rise of Chengsheng Mountain, the revival of the Qianyuan Divine Province was a natural trend; if they tried to stop it, they would be like the mantis trying to stop a chariot, doomed without a burial place.
Upon Xumi Mountain, the female Bodhisattva successfully opened the Heavenly Abyss and, using her Primordial Spirit, supported it, successfully connecting, and suspending the Heavenly Abyss behind her Primordial Spirit’s head, the size at will.
By achieving this step, the domain of the female Bodhisattva completely stepped into the Saint Abyss Realm, thereby becoming a Bodhisattva of the Saint Abyss Realm.
“So this is the Saint Abyss Realm?
Truly a power mighty to the extreme.”
Feeling the profound and abyssal mana within her, capable of incinerating the starry seas, the female Bodhisattva whispered softly, her fair face revealing a smile long missed.
As the ruler of Xumi Mountain, the female Bodhisattva cultivated the Heavenly Immortal Scripture and mastered many martial techniques of the Saint Abyss Realm and Quasi Emperor levels, gaining the ability to fight across levels upon her breakthrough.
During the Tongxuan Realm, techniques of the Heaven Imperial Realm were too profound and esoteric for her, barely graspable.
After ascending to the Saint Abyss Realm, the female Bodhisattva was confident in cultivating the Heaven Imperial Realm techniques to a deeper level, enhancing her combat ability.
Yet this smile didn’t last long and soon vanished, replaced by a face full of concern.
Although she had broken through to the first layer of the Saint Abyss Realm and possessed combat ability comparable to the third layer or even stronger, what did that amount to in front of that scoundrel?
The latest intelligence showed that Han Li, with the might of thunder, entered White Emperor City’s Taibai Immortal Realm, once again defeating the White Emperor, plundering the remaining essence of the Taibai Immortal Realm and sweeping away White Emperor City’s foundations.
Without a doubt, Han Li possessed the combat ability of the Heaven Imperial Realm, or he himself might be a Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor.
Moreover, Han Li harbored desecrating intentions towards her, so what could she, a mere Bodhisattva of the Saint Abyss Realm, do to resist?
What the female Bodhisattva didn’t know was that Han Li’s strength was far greater than she imagined; he currently possessed the combat ability of the Sixth Heaven in the Heaven Imperial Realm, and when stimulating Divine Sense, he could even surpass a peak Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor without Divine Sense activated.
Although Han Li was currently at the Quasi Emperor Sixth Heaven, the cultivation he had accumulated was almost enough to raise him to the Eighth or Ninth Heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm, just a bit away from reaching the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Han Li refrained from advancing to conceal his prowess.
Now he was in the spotlight, with too many powerful beings watching him.
If people knew he was a late-stage Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor, the nine supreme beings of the Endless Yuankun Domain would view him differently.
Everyone knew that Han Li was the reincarnation of an ancient immortal, and that it was only a matter of time before he became a Heavenly Immortal or even a True Immortal.
However, time was required.
Han Li had yet to achieve the Heaven Imperial Realm, while they were already at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, possessing a significant advantage over him.
Even if they were apprehensive of Han Li, they could tolerate it to some extent.
However, if Han Li depleted his cultivation and advanced to the Eighth or Ninth Heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm in one breath, and the nine supreme beings became aware of it, it wouldn’t be mere apprehension anymore; it would be about snuffing him out.
Chengsheng Mountain’s foundations were already stronger than theirs, and Han Li’s small gap in cultivation levels with them meant he could potentially step into the Battle Immortal Realm and transcend to become a Heavenly Immortal before them.
From then on, Han Li would always ride on the heads of the most powerful forces, growing ever stronger.
The gap between them would widen, significantly harming the interests of these nine supreme forces.
Therefore, to prevent this scenario, the nine strongest forces might band together to eradicate Chengsheng Mountain altogether, for even Chengsheng Mountain could not withstand a united front from all the most powerful forces.
This was Han Li’s concern; Chengsheng Mountain’s foundations were not deep enough, its strength not powerful enough to be invincible in the Yuankun Domain, to suppress everything non-compliant.
So he had to conceal his prowess to avoid forcing the nine strongest forces into a desperate corner and having them resort to total annihilation.

chapters.content:
Chapter 667: Chapter 258: The Diary of the Female Bodhisattva!
Ascending Xumi Mountain!
A Spark Sets the Kindling Ablaze Beyond Control_2 Chapter 667: Chapter 258: The Diary of the Female Bodhisattva!
Ascending Xumi Mountain!
A Spark Sets the Kindling Ablaze Beyond Control_2 Although he had made a breakthrough in one go, those supreme powers might not be able to detect it, but to be on the safe side, Han Li still decided to lay low.
He had been lying low for thirty years, a few more years wouldn’t make a difference.
…..
...
The bodhisattva gathered all her aura, calmed her emotions, then stepped into Little Western Heaven.
Little Western Heaven was the name of the blessed land within Xumi Mountain, even larger than White Emperor City’s Taibai Immortal Realm.
The bodhisattva’s expression was impassive, her lotus steps light as she quickly made her way to the central part of Little Western Heaven, where there was also a mountain, only a hundred feet tall, identical to the outside world’s Xumi Mountain, except in size.
The bodhisattva ascended to the summit and walked into a temple filled with Buddha’s light, to its most secluded part, and then began to write in her diary, a habit she had formed five years ago.
Every time she thought of Han Li, her heartstrings would flutter uncontrollably, pulling her thoughts to certain matters, and the bodhisattva did not know why she felt compelled to record them.
Five years ago, Empress Fengyue, Empress Yuanchu, and the White Emperor had descended upon Qianyuan Divine Province, only to have one of them blown to pieces by Han Li, and the other two driven away, shocking the world.
Han Li’s valiant and martial figure at that time was deeply imprinted in the bodhisattva’s soul.
In the earlier battles in the Barbarian Region, where Han Li had successfully risen, he also uttered those meaningful words to the bodhisattva, frightening her and constantly making her wonder when Han Li might suddenly assail Xumi Mountain.
Day and night, the bodhisattva’s mind was struck by Han Li’s heroic deeds, breaking down the last of her stubbornness.
In this world, women are drawn to strength, and the bodhisattva was no exception.
Although she was the ruler of the Sacred Land of Xumi Mountain, compared to Han Li, she was far inferior, whether it was status, cultivation level, combat ability, or the power she controlled.
As a result, the bodhisattva’s feelings shifted, and she began to admire Han Li, looking forward to his arrival on Xumi Mountain.
After recording her initial thoughts, the bodhisattva looked at the thick diary book and fell into deep contemplation.
Within those five years, she wrote in her diary every day, and the most frequent entries were, “When will Han Li come?” “Why hasn’t Han Li come yet?” “Could it be that Han Li won’t come?” “Is Han Li deceiving my feelings?”…
After some thought, the bodhisattva opened the diary, ready to read it again and reminisce about her thoughts over the years.
On the first page, it recorded the scene the bodhisattva had witnessed five years ago, highlighting how Han Li had summoned the Qiankun Bracelet to kill the White Emperor who had terrorized the Endless Yuankun Domain for a hundred thousand years, along with her thoughts at the time.
It was there she recorded a sudden rise of a daring idea in her mind, marking the beginning of her change.
“I might as well give in to him.
He’s too strong; I really can’t withstand it…
I really can’t…”
Seeing this, the bodhisattva’s fair face swiftly blushed, a rosy hue spreading over her white, swan-like neck, reaching to the very tips of her ears, and her long, white jade legs involuntarily clenched together.
Even though she had recorded these words herself, reading them again made the bodhisattva feel extreme embarrassment, to the point where she felt the impulse to destroy the diary, but she managed to suppress this urge.
The bodhisattva continued to flip through the diary, one page after another, her mind full of Han Li’s heroic and invincible image, causing her heart to tremble in turmoil.
As she turned the pages faster and faster, when she arrived at the last page and saw what she had written that day, the bodhisattva took a deep breath, closed the diary, and waved it away.
“Han Li isn’t truly toying with me, is he?” The bodhisattva felt a bit gloomy, even a bit resentful.
She had always been waiting for Han Li to climb Xumi Mountain and, incidentally, flatter her, the bodhisattva, yet Han Li had never come.
Was she, as a bodhisattva, no longer attractive?
According to the intelligence gathered earlier, Han Li in White Emperor City had not only snatched away the Heavenly Immortal weapon and the Creation Immortal Lotus along with many immortality resources but also a Heaven Imperial Realm empress.
This empress of the Heaven Imperial Realm was named Qin Shiyin, one of the mere four Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm in White Emperor City, and she was just taken away by Han Li in broad daylight.
This was the narrative spread by White Emperor City.
Though the White Emperor had decided to discreetly live as one retreating from power struggles, he still wanted to cause Han Li some trouble, thus he altered the story about Qin Shiyin.
He had already severed ties with Qin Shiyin and did not want her to spread stories about their past, which would greatly damage his reputation and image; the White Emperor still aspired to be seen as a noble and righteous powerhouse.
Therefore, the White Emperor did this so that even if Qin Shiyin spoke ill of him later, with this foundation, most people would not believe her, thinking that it was Han Li who forced Qin Shiyin to speak against him.
In the eyes of many, Han Li indeed had such a motive : why wouldn’t he when he and the White Emperor were arch-enemies?
Besides that, it was to cause some troubles for Han Li.
Through the White Emperor’s deliberate propaganda, the motive for Han Li’s attack on White Emperor City became his intent to kidnap the Heaven Imperial Realm empress Qin Shiyin, and plundering Taibai Immortal Realm was just a side note.
Only by portraying Han Li as audacious and unrestrained would the other eight supreme powers grow even more wary of him, and in the case of any conflict, they might directly join forces to attack Chengsheng Mountain.
After all, if Han Li dared to attack White Emperor City and take away Empress Qin Shiyin today, wouldn’t he possibly attack the other supreme powers tomorrow and abduct their Heaven Imperial Realm empresses?

Chapter 668: Chapter 258: The Diary of the Female Bodhisattva!
Ascending Xumi Mountain!
A Spark Sets the Kindling Ablaze Beyond Control_3 Chapter 668: Chapter 258: The Diary of the Female Bodhisattva!
Ascending Xumi Mountain!
A Spark Sets the Kindling Ablaze Beyond Control_3 The Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, Longevity Qin Family, and other supreme forces harbored some skepticism towards the claims about White Emperor City.
According to their analysis of intelligence on Han Li, his personality didn’t quite seem like one that would commit such acts.
While Han Li did have the bad habit of plundering beautiful female cultivators to become his Dao companions, he had never directly attacked a force to snatch someone by force; he always acted covertly.
...
Therefore, they suspected that this might be a frame-up by White Emperor City, meant to cover something up, but they also couldn’t uncover the truth.
On the other hand, Empress Yuanchu and the Huangyue Imperial Empress believed it, as Han Li had a very bad image in their hearts.
He first meddled with their separated souls, performing various acts that left them ashamed and furious, and later, he snatched away the saintess Ji Mingyue and Quasi Empress Yuan Youwei, whom they had sent, turning them into his wives and consorts.
Later on, Han Li even openly flirted with them, declaring he would personally visit Yuanchu Mountain and the Huangyue Imperial Empire to propose marriage.
Compared to this, they felt that Han Li was capable of attacking White Emperor City and forcibly taking the Empress Qin Shiyin.
Upon hearing this intelligence, the thirty-three Heavenly Governing Forces became somewhat alarmed and fearful.
Unaware of the truth, they even thought Han Li might have really done such a deed, and they had varied reactions.
Especially those female emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm felt they were in personal danger.
Qin Shiyin, just like them, was a female emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and she came from the supreme force of White Emperor City, holding a higher status and position.
If Han Li dared to barge into White Emperor City and take Qin Shiyin, wouldn’t it be even simpler for him to attack their forces and abduct them?
As for these rumors, Han Li only became aware of them later on, but he had already prepared and taken precautions, planning to clarify everything during the wedding ceremony to welcome Qin Shiyin in three months, when the top forces of the Yuankun Domain would all attend.
It is worth mentioning that the female Bodhisattva was very much a believer in these rumors.
Han Li was indeed capable of such deeds.
Therefore, the female Bodhisattva began to doubt her own charm.
After all, Han Li had snatched away a Heaven Imperial Realm Empress; could he still be attracted to her, a Bodhisattva?
Just as the female Bodhisattva was feeling resentful, Han Li arrived.
With the help of True Immortal soldiers, Han Li quietly passed through the formations and restrictions of Xumi Mountain, barged into Little Western Heaven, and descended into this Buddhist Temple.
When Han Li appeared behind her, the female Bodhisattva’s tightly knitted eyebrows suddenly relaxed, and a look of surprise appeared on her stunningly beautiful face.
Even with the assistance of the True Immortal soldiers, when Han Li broke into Little Western Heaven, the female Bodhisattva sensed it.
She was about to take action when she realized the person was Han Li.
It could be said that no sooner had she mentioned Han Li, he arrived.
She had waited for him for too long that day, so much so that she was soaked.
Seeing the female Bodhisattva in such a state, Han Li also revealed a smile, instantly understanding.
His plan had worked perfectly.
The reason Han Li hadn’t come to Xumi Mountain to look for the female Bodhisattva was exactly to “fish” : he wanted to properly train the female Bodhisattva.
Now it seemed he had succeeded, the change in the female Bodhisattva was almost exactly as he had expected.
“You have finally come,” the female Bodhisattva exhaled softly, looking at Han Li with a resentful gaze.
She was dressed in her Buddhist robes, which accentuated her perfect curves.
Her delicate body undulated, and the thin clothing seemed hardly able to restrain that weighty granary, giving off the impression that it was about to burst open at any moment.
Looking at the female Bodhisattva before him, Han Li found that she was no longer the dignified and pure figure she usually was, but rather, somewhat seductive.
Thereupon, Han Li made his move, and the female Bodhisattva did not refuse.
Under the dry wood and raging fire, things quickly became uncontrollable.
At least ten rounds.
PS: There will be a second chapter tonight.

chapters.title: Chapter 669
chapters.content:
Chapter 669: Chapter 259: Elder Han’s Diary!
A Million Descendants!
Extremely Generous Rewards!
New True Immortal Soldier_1 Chapter 669: Chapter 259: Elder Han’s Diary!
A Million Descendants!
Extremely Generous Rewards!
New True Immortal Soldier_1 “`
The second day, in the morning.
...
Han Li sat on the bed while the Female Bodhisattva knelt in front of him, her stunningly beautiful face blushing pink.
Han Li was flipping through the Female Bodhisattva’s diary.
Feeling slightly embarrassed, she uttered, “Attainment through words falls short, one must experience to know; thus she tackled it from both ends.”
“Very well written,”
With the diary in his left hand and his right hand caressing her blushing cheek, Han Li complimented her.
From her diary, he had glimpsed the journey of her heart over the past seven years and was very pleased.
The Female Bodhisattva heaved a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, it was Han Li who was reading the diary; if she had to recite it herself, she would have died of embarrassment.
A quarter of an hour later, Han Li put down the diary and suddenly, his vision blurred, and he saw a white waterfall appearing within the palace.
Han Li blinked, and the white waterfall vanished.
“Strange, with my realm, I’m still seeing things?” Han Li was puzzled.
But when he looked at the Female Bodhisattva’s face, all became clear.
That was a waterfall created by the Female Bodhisattva.
It seemed that after her ascension to the Saint Abyss Realm, her powers had indeed increased greatly, her mana was vast, and her Divine Skills were profound, capable of conjuring such a waterfall filled with endless Spiritual Energy and essence at will.
“Linxi, do you want to return to Chengsheng Mountain with me?”
Her perfect form was before his eyes, but Han Li spoke with a firm tone.
The Female Bodhisattva’s name was Han Linxi, her name from before; since becoming the ruler of Xumi Mountain, everyone called her the Female Bodhisattva, and few knew her real name, which Han Li found very pleasant.
“Han Li, what do you mean?” Han Linxi’s brows furrowed slightly, her tone somewhat dissatisfied.
She discerned the implication in Han Li’s words.
Was he reluctant to marry her outright, to have her wed into Chengsheng Mountain?
Otherwise, given Han Li’s lascivious nature, having coveted her for so long, would he ask such a question?
Should he not bring her directly to Chengsheng Mountain and marry her openly with fanfare?
Feeling unjustly treated by Han Li’s swift coldness, Han Linxi was greatly dissatisfied; she had put in a lot of effort last night, her profound prowess enabling her to achieve many challenging and embarrassing poses.
And this was how Han Li treated her?
After thinking it over, Han Linxi continued, “Of course, I will return with you.”
Whatever Han Li was thinking, the idea of him getting his way without a proper relationship was out of the question.
She had to fight for the status, position, and treatment she deserved; otherwise, how would she face others if word got out?
She wondered how her old friends would joke about her behind her back.
“Linxi, you’re overthinking it, that’s not what I meant.” Holding Han Linxi close, Han Li savored the sensation of her soft, fragrant body and whispered into her blushing ear.
“Then what do you mean?” Han Linxi sneered, unrelenting.
“Rest assured, Linxi, now that we’ve come this far, I will certainly take responsibility for you.
Let me prepare upon my return, and I will marry you with pomp and ceremony, how does that sound?” Han Li said earnestly.
Truth be told, he was not particularly keen on taking Han Linxi back to Chengsheng Mountain; after all, there was a difference in status, and it made him feel differently.
If Han Linxi were to marry him, most likely she would no longer be the Female Bodhisattva, merely one of the many unremarkable members of his harem, lacking any distinctive features to attract him.
If Han Linxi didn’t marry him and stayed at Xumi Mountain, she would still be the Female Bodhisattva, retaining that status which still held great allure for Han Li.
Moreover, this continued to provide Han Li with a sense of thrill from the clandestine encounter.
But this was unfair to Han Linxi.
If she was unwilling, then Han Li would not force her; he could only pin his hopes on a new Female Bodhisattva, should the new ruler of Xumi Mountain be female.
“Humph~”
Han Linxi humphed softly as she struggled out of Han Li’s arms and gave him a deep look.
Suddenly, Han Linxi sighed, “I have a pretty clear idea of what you’re thinking.”
“If that’s really what you want, I’m not saying I can’t agree, but…”
“Really?” Han Li looked at Han Linxi in surprise.
To hear Han Linxi say such things genuinely surprised Han Li, giving him a feeling of the tables turning, though he had experienced it many times the previous night, this felt different.
“Heh~ Stupid man!”
Interrupted by Han Li before she could finish her sentence, Han Linxi rolled her eyes at him and scoffed.
So this despicable man was indeed thinking that way, utterly shameless and an absolute scoundrel.
Had she known, she wouldn’t have taken the initiative.
But Han Linxi still said, “Of course, only I have some conditions.”
Reminded by Han Li’s comment, Han Linxi also came to her senses, recognizing her advantages.
After a moment’s hesitation, she made up her mind.
A mere title didn’t matter to her; she wasn’t particularly concerned about it.
What she wanted was Han Li himself.
There were many charming wives and concubines in Chengsheng Mountain, and she knew of several who were more outstanding than her, such as Zimiao Zhen, Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, Empress Fengyue, and a fragmentary soul of Empress Yuanchu, among others.
The Ninth Princess of the Solar Empire was also at Chengsheng Mountain, while the Imperial Heir had left.
The message was clear: that princess was likely to wed Han Li, serving as a means of alliance between the Solar Empire and Chengsheng Mountain.
There was also the Heaven Imperial Realm Empress Qin Shiyin, whom Han Li had recently captured; she outshone Han Linxi in all regards.
Were she to truly marry into Chengsheng Mountain, that would mean giving up her advantages and competing from a position of weakness against Han Li’s other charming wives and concubines, without any edge.
With so many wives and concubines, how distinguished would she be among them and how much affection could she expect to receive?

A Million Descendants!
Extremely Generous Rewards!
New True Immortal Soldier_2 Chapter 670: Chapter 259: Elder Han’s Diary!
A Million Descendants!
Extremely Generous Rewards!
New True Immortal Soldier_2 “`
She might as well stay in Xumi Mountain.
...
With this identity, Han Li would pay her more attention, and she would be able to better grasp his heart.
Xumi Mountain is at the center of the Buddha Domain, while Chengsheng Mountain is at the center of the Xuan Domain.
It’s a place far beyond the reach of ordinary people and cultivators, but for Han Li, it was just a matter of moments to rush over for a clandestine meeting with her.
The female Bodhisattva could tell that Han Li was very fond of the aura she possessed; without the status of a female Bodhisattva, she would be much less appealing.
Such are the common failings of men!
Though the female Bodhisattva was inexperienced in romantic affairs, it didn’t mean she was ignorant.
Having lived for thousands of years, she had a clear understanding of these matters.
“Xier, if you have any conditions, feel free to mention them.”
Han Li took the opportunity to pull the female Bodhisattva, Han Linxi, into his embrace and kissed her glossy, soft red lips.
The female Bodhisattva didn’t struggle, and after Han Li released her, she said indifferently, “I must have the same treatment as your other wives, and even more so.”
“Rest assured, Xier,” Han Li immediately promised and informed her of the detailed benefits.
The extra part was compensation for the female Bodhisattva since he hadn’t given her a formal status, and indeed, it wasn’t as convenient for her to enjoy the benefits of Chengsheng Mountain as it was for his other pampered wives and concubines.
The corner of the female Bodhisattva’s mouth curled up into a smile.
She was very satisfied with the treatment Han Li had promised and also shocked; the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain was even more profound than she had anticipated.
The female Bodhisattva mentioned a few more minor conditions, all of which Han Li agreed to, even thoughtfully adding things she hadn’t considered, which greatly improved her impression of him.
“Xier, it’s time for your morning lessons,” Han Li said cheerfully.
After the morning lessons, Han Li left her with a tool for communication and left reluctantly.
As a responsible good man, today’s diary entry was written by Han Li.
Back at Chengsheng Mountain, standing atop Chengdao Peak, Han Li felt refreshed and invigorated.
He had already decided that for the next while, he would visit the female Bodhisattva to continue their unfinished business, to study diligently, and attend class daily.
Han Li’s vast and boundless Divine Sense surged out, ready to envelop Chengsheng Mountain and carry out his daily task of observing Han Mansion.
Just then, a series of system notification sounded in his mind, causing Han Li to pause, and then a great joy spread across his face.
He had waited for so long, and finally, the day had come.
The number of his descendants had finally reached a hundred!
This meant that his pursuit of immortality had entered a new phase.
From now on, the speed of his cultivation progress would increase substantially.
It also meant that his system was about to be upgraded.
Han Li was unsure of the benefits that would come with it, but he was very excited.
With an eager heart, Han Li opened the system’s message panel, and one notification after another appeared before him.
“Ding~ The number of your descendants has reached one million.
You have gained a hundred thousand years of cultivation experience, a hundred thousand years of lifespan, a million pills (click to expand), a hundred thousand years of free experience, a True Immortal Rank Cultivation Technique [Five Immortal Dao Xuan Technique], and a True Immortal weapon [Crimson Spear].”
“Ding~ Since the number of the master’s descendants has reached one million, the system will undergo its fourth version upgrade.
The upgrade will take three days.
Please look forward to it.”
“Upgrade in progress, current completion: 0.1%!”
“Hahaha~”
Looking at the system notifications on the message panel, Han Li laughed heartily, his face full of excitement.
He had anticipated the fourth system upgrade when his descendants reached one million, but the timing was unexpected.
The first system upgrade was quick; the second took four hours, and the third, an entire day.
However, reaching a million descendants provided him with rewards far beyond his expectations, including some prizes he hadn’t anticipated before.
The first prize was a hundred thousand years of cultivation!
This was enough for him to rise from obscurity to the heavens, from a mere mortal to a Quasi Emperor powerhouse.
“`
When the number of his descendants reached one hundred thousand, the System only gave him ten thousand years of cultivation as a reward, but this time it had increased tenfold.
Originally, he was only forty thousand years of cultivation away from advancing to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm in one go, but now with these one hundred thousand years of cultivation, he wouldn’t have to wait another year and a half, he could directly advance to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
The second reward was one hundred thousand years of lifespan, which was a new reward added for reaching this new stage that hadn’t existed before.
The System was also very generous, directly granting one hundred thousand years of lifespan, which greatly increased his lifespan from thirteen million years to fourteen million years.
Moreover, from then on, each time the number of his descendants reached a certain stage, he would continue to gain lifespan, and his lifespan would grow as rapidly as his cultivation, without any worry about living a short life.
The third reward was one million Immortal Pills, an award that previously existed but had been optimized to include pills of various ranks, with the highest being a True Immortal Pill.
Mainly divided into two categories, the first being Realm Breaking Pills and the second Lifespan Extension Pills, both awarded according to grade, with fewer in quantity the higher the grade.
For example, the highest-grade True Dao Pill is a True Immortal Rank pill that can help those at the peak of the Heavenly Immortal rank to break through to the True Immortal Realm.
There are also True Immortal Rank Lifespan Extension Pills that can help a True Immortal extend their lifespan by ten epochs, immeasurable in value.
There is only one of both the True Dao Pill and the True Immortal Rank Lifespan Extension Pill, and there are ten pills of the Heaven Immortal Rank…
Han Li was very satisfied with this, as the cap for the rewarded pills had been raised again; before, the highest was merely the pill for an anxious heart.
The fourth reward was one hundred thousand years of free experience, which corresponded to the Four Arts of Cultivation.
Previously these were separate, and each time only one type of experience would be rewarded, such as Alchemy, Artifact Refining, and so on; this time it was combined into free experience, with the quantity of the reward having increased by many multiples.
This meant that Han Li could freely distribute these one hundred thousand years of experience in Alchemy, Artifact Refining, Formation, and Talisman Making, which would maximize his ability to handle the current situation.
For this point, Han Li was also very satisfied, as the System had finally become more user-friendly, understanding him so well.
The fifth reward was a True Immortal Rank Cultivation Technique “Five Immortal Dao Xuan Technique”!
This reward also previously existed, only the reward level had been upgraded.
This wasn’t fixed and would change among Cultivation Techniques, martial arts, Secret Techniques, etc., depending on the mood of the System.
Regarding this True Immortal Rank Cultivation Technique, Han Li was very pleased, mainly because his Chaos Scripture had been stuck at the peak of the Heavenly Immortal rank for some time.
Once he cultivated the Five Immortal Dao Xuan Technique, his main Cultivation Technique might be able to advance to the True Immortal Rank in one fell swoop; by then, his strength would also increase considerably.
The sixth reward was a True Immortal weapon, the “Crimson Spear”!
This reward was new this time and hadn’t existed before.
Han Li could hardly help praising the generosity of the System, awarding him with a True Immortal weapon for the first time; it was simply marvelous.
This Crimson Spear was formed by refining an entire large universe into a red sun, then fusing it with Indestructible Immortal Gold, Solar Immortal Gold, and Prime Immortal Goldâ€”these three types of Immortal Goldâ€”followed by the imprinting of True Immortal level Dao.
Its power was much stronger than ordinary True Immortal weapons, belonging to the top-tier True Immortal weapons.
Han Li directly took out the Crimson Spear and carefully inspected and admired it; he was very satisfied with this True Immortal weapon.
With the addition of the Crimson Spear, the foundation of the Chengsheng Mountain had been significantly elevated, bringing him a step closer to his small goal of being unrivaled in the Yuankun Domain.
Today, Chengsheng Mountain had four True Immortal weapons, the Emperor Flag, Crimson Spear, Qiankun Bracelet, and Heaven Opening Axe, as well as the Human Path Sword that was comparable to True Immortal weapons.
There were also eight Heaven Immortal weapons, the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, Seven Immortal Pagoda, Yin Yang Mirror, Immortal Beating Whip, Immortal Locking Pillar, Immortal Extinguishing Sword, Wishful Knife, and Lightning Boat; its foundation was much stronger than any other supreme power.
Each Immortal weapon was a major consumer of Immortal Tao Energy.
Han Li had yet to acquire an Immortal Vein, but fortunately, he had some savings and had looted thirty thousand Immortal Stones from the Heavenly Cult, as well as raided the Taibai Immortal Realm.
Otherwise, Han Li wouldn’t be able to support so many True Immortal and Heaven Immortal weapons.
Even so, if he frequently used the Immortal weapons, the resources of Immortal Tao within his possession wouldn’t last long.
Before acquiring an Immortal Vein, Han Li decided to reduce the frequency of using Immortal weapons, as this period was a good time to keep a low profile.
PS: Presenting the second update.

The new feature that interests Han Li_1 “Huff~”
Han Li released a long breath, then took a step and entered the Tiansheng Realm.
...
The Tiansheng Realm was formerly the Secret Realm of Chengsheng Mountain, which had been continuously transformed and now was no less than the paradisiacal havens like the Little Western Heaven.
According to Han Li’s plan, once he obtained the Immortal Vein, he would be able to further transform the Tiansheng Realm into a domain comparable to the havens created by ancient True Immortals.
The Tiansheng Realm concentrated most of Chengsheng Mountain’s heritage; out of the thirteen Immortal Weapons of Chengsheng Mountain, besides the Humanity Sword Han Li carried with him, the Qiankun Bracelet and the Primordial Chaos Cauldron guarding the outside, the remaining ten Immortal Weapons were all within the Tiansheng Realm.
Besides, all the Immortal Dao resources were stored inside, along with the ever-accumulating and flowing Immortal Qi, as well as at least half of the Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapons.
Even the gateway to the Xuxian Realm was moved in by Han Li.
To enter the Tiansheng Realm required high authority, such as core descendants of the Han Mansion, key trainees, Han Li’s beloved wives and concubines, as well as Guest Elders, Protectors, and Elders with significant contributions.
Han Li went straight to the core area of the Tiansheng Realm, which was his private territory.
Without his permission, even his Dao companion couldn’t enter.
Sitting casually on a Purple Jade Cushion, Han Li began to receive his rewards.
Out of the one million pills, Immortal Pills and Emperor Pills such as True Dao Pills, Flying Immortal Pills, Galaxy Pills, and Yudao Pills were collected by him while the rest of the pills were placed in another treasure vault within the Tiansheng Realm.
The Flying Immortal Pill was a pill that could help an Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm to ascend to immortality, whereas the Yuan Dao Pill could help a Quasi Emperor break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm, Galaxy Pill…
After dealing with the pills, Han Li looked at the ten million years of free experience and, after briefly pondering, decided on the allocation, mainly focusing on Formations.
After spending some time receiving the related knowledge and experience, Han Li glanced at the panel for the Four Arts of Cultivation and saw earth-shattering changes to the four skills.
Alchemy: Heaven Immortal Rank Lower Grade
Artifact Refining: Heaven Immortal Rank Lower Grade
Formation: Heaven Immortal Rank Top Grade
Talisman Making: Emperor Level Supreme Grade
Han Li closed the panel with satisfaction; his accomplishments in alchemy, artifact refining, and formations were now unrivaled in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Only in talisman making was there someone in the Yuankun Domain who could compare to himâ€”the supreme of the Longevity Jiang Family was particularly adept at it.
Next, Han Li comprehended the Five Immortal Dao Mystic Arts, a True Immortal level Cultivation Technique, and then appeared on the ninth floor of the Time-Sky Tower to begin cultivation.
The Five Immortal Dao Mystic Arts mainly cultivated the five viscera, engendering Immortal Fetuses within them.
At the highest level of cultivation, it was possible to cultivate five True Immortal avatars controlling the Five Directions and Five Elements.
Whether forming a battle array or combining them within oneself, both could significantly enhance one’s strength.
After spending decades on the ninth floor of the Time-Sky Tower, Han Li successfully cultivated this technique and merged it with his Chaos Scripture.
Having absorbed the essence of the Five Immortal Dao Mystic Arts, the Chaos Scripture advanced and became a True Immortal level technique.
As the Cultivation Technique progressed, Han Li’s mana became even purer, although its quantity decreased.
However, the mana storage limit soared from the Fifth Heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm to the Seventh Heaven, which he could replenish with time.
When the Cultivation Technique was in operation, Han Li’s visceral organs would also nurture Immortal Fetuses, but they were no longer of the Five Elements attribute; instead, they contained chaos, embodying Han Li’s ultimate martial way.
Han Li also discovered that when the new Chaos Scripture was in operation, it would slowly strengthen his Chaos Body (Myriad Dao Immortal Body), making it gradually stronger, although it could not evolve to the second stage of the Immortal Body.
After leaving the Time-Sky Tower, Han Li appeared at the peak of Chengdao Peak, discovering that the Empress Qin Shiyin, clad in a black dress and white silk, was there.
“Shiyin, are you getting used to it?”
Standing next to Qin Shiyin, smelling the faint fragrance emanating from her, a shallow smile surfaced on Han Li’s face.
At this intimate address, Qin Shiyin’s crescent eyebrows furrowed slightly, but soon smoothed out, and she nodded in affirment.
Then, with a meaningful look, she said, “The outside world says that I was snatched from White Emperor City by you.
Do you feel any pressure?”
“What pressure could there be?”
Han Li shrugged his shoulders, his expression calm, seemingly unperturbed by the rumors and gossip from the outside world.
The White Emperor was nothing but a nobody.
What was his status?
And he even thought about competing with him for a wife.
Would it not have been better for him to kindly send his wife over?
If the White Emperor knew his place and sent the two female saints and the two Quasi Empresses from White Emperor City, perhaps Han Li might have spared him.
At most, he would have just beaten him up one more time and “reclaimed” the Immortal Weapons of the White Emperor, never intending to kill him.
Of course, if Han Li chose not to kill him, once stripped of his Immortal Weapons, the White Emperor’s enemies might want to kill him.
Han Li couldn’t help with that; whether the White Emperor could survive would depend on his own skills.
“It seems your abilities are even greater than I had anticipated,” Qin Shiyin remarked thoughtfully, and then she smiled sweetly at Han Li.
Last night, she and Purple Miao Zhen talked all night long.
She now mostly understood the situation with Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain and realized that making a deal with Han Li was the right decision.
“Shiyin, not only are my abilities great, but I have something even bigger.
Do you want to see?
Do you want to taste?
Do you want to try?” Han Li said with a smile.
At his words, Qin Shiyin’s beautiful face turned pink, and she gave Han Li an annoyed glance, feeling somewhat helpless inside; Sister Purple Miao Zhen had not been wrong.
“When will you be able to advance to Heaven Imperial Realm?” Qin Shiyin quickly changed the subject, not wanting to continue this line of discussion with Han Li.
Although she was an Empress of the Heaven Imperial Realm and had lived for a long time, she was still a virgin in that respect.
Aside from occasionally chatting with a few close friends about it, she had no other experience.
