...
Qin Shiyin was extremely delighted about the importance Han Li placed on her.
She was now Han Li’s fiancÃ©e, but she still had not made the necessary preparations.
Everything had happened too quickly; it had only been a short two days since she had betrayed the White Emperor and thrown herself into Han Li’s arms.
After spending two days together, although Qin Shiyin had developed some good feelings for Han Li, she was still far from being completely captivated by him.
What she was more concerned about was Han Li’s cultivation level.
She had asked Zimiao Zhen about Han Li’s true level of cultivation, but even Zimiao Zhen couldn’t say for sure, suggesting that he might be a Quasi Emperor or even a Great Emperor.
Qin Shiyin had also heard from the White Emperor that Han Li had not yet broken through to the Heaven Imperial Realm, but some years had passed, and who knows?
Maybe Han Li had quietly achieved a breakthrough.
Glancing at Qin Shiyin, Han Li thought for a moment and said, “It should be very soon.”
After the number of his descendants reached one million, he gained a hundred thousand years of cultivation, which was enough to boost him to the pinnacle of Heaven Imperial Realm in one breath.
However, whether to break through or not, Han Li was still hesitant.
With no way to be invincible just yet, he could only survive with great effort, like a forceful clap.
Although the situation seemed favorable to him now, Han Li couldn’t be careless.
Too many people have been careless just before victory, resulting in a complete and utter defeat.
Victory or defeat could change in the blink of an eye.
Although Han Li had decided to keep a low profile and not to flaunt his strengths, some situations could not be avoided, such as his upcoming marriages to the Ninth Princess of the Solar Empire, Yang Zhiyun, and to the Empress, Qin Shiyin.
Such wedding affairs had to be conducted with great pomp and circumstance.
At that time, countless forces from the Yuankun Domain would come to offer their congratulations, and those supreme beings would likely make an appearance, probably in their avatars.
This was the closest opportunity to observe Han Li, to see the extent of his cultivation progress.
All because he’s too handsome!
Han Li was confident in defending against all prying eyes, but there was always the chance of an unexpected incident, which could lead to big trouble.
However, no matter how much he might delay, at the latest in three months, after marrying Qin Shiyin, Han Li would break through.
Afterwards, he would have no need for such grand wedding arrangements.
When marrying an ordinary cultivator as a partner, those supreme beings would certainly not send avatars to pay their respects.
Qin Shiyin nodded and said with a gentle tone, “It seems you’ll surpass me very soon.”
“Not for a while yet,” Han Li responded with a laugh, though he found Qin Shiyin’s comment somewhat odd.
It kind of sounded like he would soon surpass her.
It seemed that wasn’t wrong.
All because the scene brought feelings to mind.
……
During the day, Han Li spent his time on Chengsheng Mountain accompanying his wives and concubines, either strolling through the scenic spots, exploring secretive places, playing group games, arranging flowers in the garden, enjoying various fruits in the orchard, or discussing the Dao and its intricacies within the Time-Sky Tower.
Come nightfall, after a busy day, the old ancestor Han Li would descend upon Xumi Mountain to dote on his lovely young wife kept in Little Western Heaven.
He truly lived up to the mantra of first marrying the bodhisattva, then seeking the scripturesâ€”faithful both to Buddha and his beloved.
The next day, in the morning.
The old ancestor Han Li had already completed his morning routine.
The female bodhisattva, looking at Han Li ready to leave, said with a somewhat hoarse voice, “Won’t you stay with me a little longer?”
Don’t get the wrong idea, the female bodhisattva wasn’t injured, it was just that last night she was handled quite harshly by Han Li.
All because the old ancestor Han Li had an exceptional bearing, profound and profound, making the female bodhisattva feel as if there was fishbone stuck in her throat.
Then, the old ancestor even said he liked her hoarse voice, so what could the female bodhisattva do but follow the old ancestor’s words?
“Xi’er, be good.
Your husband will come to you again tonight,” Han Li said tenderly as he caressed the female bodhisattva’s smooth cheek, speaking deeply and affectionately.
In the end, Han Li gently kissed her smooth, jade-like forehead before disappearing from sight.
“Tch!”
Such damn coldness.
The female bodhisattva spat disdainfully, then laid down in bed for a deep sleep, letting the infinite scenery reveal itself.
After all, nobody here could see.
Little Western Heaven was a Sacred Land of the Buddhist Sect, and currently, only the female bodhisattva, the ruler of this place, could move about freely.
Other Buddhist Sect disciples needed her permission to enter.
“Cough cough~ Han Linxi, is it really okay for you to do this?” Suddenly, a voice echoed in the Buddhist hall.
The female bodhisattva didn’t even lift an eyelid, responding indifferently, “What’s wrong with it?”
“This is a Sacred Land of the Buddhist Sect, and it might not be appropriate for you and Han Li to be fooling around here,” the voice continued.
“Then would you like to join?
I’m very welcoming, and I believe Han Li would be too,” said the female bodhisattva, her face breaking into a smile.
“Forget it, I’m not interested in him.”
“Are you sure about that?
You’ve been peeping these past few days.”
“Nonsense, why would I peep at that sort of thing?”
“Look at you getting all worked up.
If you didn’t peep, why are you so flustered?”
“Heh~ Do you think I would let you slander my innocence?”
“What innocence?
I am the innocent one here, what innocence does an Artifact Spirit have?”
“What, Artifact Spirits don’t have the right to be innocent?”
“Nope~”
“Han Linxi, if you keep this up, believe it or not, I’ll fight you for the man.”
“See, there it is, your true nature’s showing.
And you said you didn’t peep.”
“….”
A series of conversations echoed through the solemn Buddhist hall, dispelling the tranquility that once was.
In a certain part of Little Western Heaven, there was a tree where a little girl sat, supporting her chin with one hand and looking somewhat listless.
“Is that sort of thing really that enjoyable?”
“I don’t know what Han Linxi was thinking, giving herself to that Han Li for nothing, it’s so infuriating~”
The little girl murmured a few words to herself, then jumped down from the tree, transforming into a peerless beauty with tall and tempting figure, wearing light-colored silk robes, and headed towards the Buddhist hall.

Time passed, and in the blink of an eye three days had gone by.
Atop Chengdao Peak, Han Li was spending time with his four beautiful wives, Bai Keqing, Xue Yueqing, Ling Lingshuang, and Long Yue.
With Han Li’s help, the four ladies had consecutively broken through to the middle and later phases of the Holy Abyss Realm.
Moreover, given that they cultivated immortal arts and mastered Emperor Level martial techniques, their combat ability was exceedingly strong.
At present, all four beautiful wives possessed Emperor’s Bodies.
Bai Keqing was bestowed with the Serpent’s Body, and she chose not to transform into a flood dragon but rather to continue walking this path.
Han Li thought this was good; he could always play the role of Xu Xian.
Xue Yueqing had acquired the Tianhu Emperor’s Body, now with her tenth tail grown, which Han Li also found pleasing.
Others might increase their attack speed with twin ponytails, but Xue Yueqing’s ten Tianhu tails directly maxed out Han Li’s attack speed.
Ling Lingshuang’s physique was the Frosty Profound Body.
Since the birth of this physique, her temperament became even more aloof, like frost, completely different from Jiang Baiye’s type of coldness.
Long Yue, the Young True Dragon, also developed a special physique, named the Heavenly Dragon Battle Body, which complimented her True Dragon Bloodline, greatly augmenting her physical strength to the point where she didn’t fall much behind when physically sparring with Han Li.
Han Li noticed that Long Yue’s expression hesitated, as if she wanted to say something, causing him to slightly furrow his brow.
“Yue’er, if there’s something on your mind, you can speak freely,” he said.
“Husband, Yongxuan told me he wants your help in perfecting his True Dragon Bloodline.
How should I respond to him?” Long Yue sighed, her expression complex.
She actually didn’t want to bring this matter to her husband, Han Li, but her son had implored her, leaving her with no other choice than to seek Han Li’s assistance.
Upon hearing this, Ling Lingshuang, Bai Keqing, and Xue Yueqing all raised their eyebrows, a sharp gleam flashing in their eyes.
Although they were still chatting, their attention shifted to Long Yue and Han Li.
They too were curious to see how their husband would handle this situation.
Each of them had many children, some of whom were born with special physiques, like Xue Yueqing’s eldest son, Han Yongkun, who had the Tianhu King’s Body, and Ling Lingshuang’s eldest son, Han Yonghao, who possessed the Mortal King Body, among others.
However, some did not possess any special physique.
Especially Bai Keqing, who had married Han Li relatively early on and initially gave birth to four children for him, namely Han Yongbai, Han Yongqing, Han Yongke, and Han Yonghe, none of whom had physiques.
Subsequently, she bore him over a dozen more children, with only a minority possessing special physiques.
They had also encountered problems like what Long Yue was facing.
After all, they now had physiques, specifically Emperor’s Bodies, whereas they previously did not.
Even if they didn’t mention it, their children could guess that these gifts must have come from their father’s hand.
Consequently, some of their children approached them, hoping they would plead with their father, Han Li, to help them manifest special physiques.
However, the three of them declined and did not choose to speak about this to Han Li.
The situation on Chengsheng Mountain and their husband’s way of doing things were all too clear to them; he couldn’t take care of all their children equally.
According to their husband, activating Emperor’s Bodies for them had already consumed too much of the foundation.
Now that Long Yue had brought it up, they were interested in seeing how their husband would respond.
If he helped Han Yongxuan, then there was hope for their own children too.
They could simply wait in line, taking their turn patiently.
Hearing Long Yue’s words, Han Li frowned slightly and said with a hint of displeasure, “Yue’er, let Yongxuan figure it out on his own.
Over the years, the family has not spared any effort in helping him, but he has become somewhat negligent.
This isn’t good.”
Han Yongxuan was Long Yue’s eldest son, born with the Xuanhuang Dragon Pupil, a supreme king’s body, and possessing a portion of the True Dragon Bloodline.
The mutual enhancement they provided was comparable to some Emperor’s Bodies.
With such favorable conditions, along with Han Yongxuan’s first-grade talent, it was greatly dissatisfying to Han Li that he was still only at the middle stage of the Divine Yuan Realm.
His siblings, who had similar talent and physiques, had already reached the latter stages, peak, or even broken through to the Tongxuan Realm, whereas some of Han Yongxiang’s siblings, who only had Mortal King Bodys, had successively advanced to the Divine Yuan Realm.
Against this backdrop, Han Yongxuan appeared notably negligent in cultivation, a matter which Han Li had not intervened in.
But if Han Yongxuan himself did not aspire for progress, did not venture out for experience and opportunities to perfect the True Dragon Bloodline, and just stayed around Chengsheng Mountain, either pursuing love with maids or indulging in frivolity, it was unbecoming to ask Han Li for help, in which case, Han Li had to criticize him.
Han Li provided such a favorable cultivation environment, conditions, and resources for his descendants to be ambitious and strive hard in their cultivation.
If he was to do everything for them, he would effectively become a nanny, and what time would he then have for himself?
Ever since the Han Mansion moved to Chengsheng Mountain, he rarely dealt with affairs anymore, delegating authority and letting capable descendants handle them.
He could indeed help Han Yongxuan perfect the True Dragon Bloodline, but it would cost a considerable amount of Physique Points.
Han Li was not willing to do so.
Moreover, Han Yongxuan was not favored, so helping him would be unfair to the other descendants.
Long Yue nodded and said softly, “Then I’ll respond to him in this way.”
“He has indeed been negligent these past years, not focusing on cultivation and only concerned with trivial matters.”
With regard to her eldest son, Long Yue was also somewhat dissatisfied.
As devoted wives and consorts of their powerful husband, they may not compete, but their children could, as they would not receive the same cultivation resources if they didn’t strive like their siblings.
Han Yongxuan represented her, and with her firstborn showing no ambition, there was a period when even Long Yue’s voice lacked authority.
Han Yongxuan even had the audacity to claim he was emulating his father, Han Li, following his encouragement of propagation, which greatly annoyed Long Yue.
Her husband was a reincarnation of an ancient immortal, who, even without cultivation, could still effortlessly reach today’s heights.
How could Han Yongxuan even compare?

Chapter 674: Chapter 260: Secrets of the Tiansheng Realm!
Little Western Heaven Fun Facts!
System Upgrade!
A New Feature that Captivates Han Li_4 Chapter 674: Chapter 260: Secrets of the Tiansheng Realm!
Little Western Heaven Fun Facts!
System Upgrade!
A New Feature that Captivates Han Li_4 Han Yongxuan had everything because his husband provided it, and without these resources from his husband, even with high talent and strong physique, it would take Han Yongxuan ten to dozens of times longer to cultivate to the Divine Yuan Realm.
...
After thinking it over, Long Yue made up her mind to have a good talk with her eldest son when she got back, hoping to get him to turn over a new leaf and start cultivating diligently.
Seeing that her husband, Han Li, had turned down Han Yongxuan’s request, Ling Lingshuang, Xue Yueqing, and Bai Keqing also extinguished the bit of hope they had harbored.
With that topic concluded, Han Li continued to entertain his four beautiful wives by talking about all things delightful and occasionally enjoying some delicious fruit.
A moment later, two system notifications sounded in Han Li’s mind.
A sharp glint flashed in his eyes, but his expression remained unchanged as he continued to accompany his four beautiful wives.
Meanwhile, Han Li diverted part of his attention to checking the system notifications.
“Ding~ Congratulations, Master, the Longevity Family System upgrade is complete.
Version 5.0 has been successfully loaded.”
“The system has optimized some functions and added new ones; please check them out as soon as possible, Master.”
Han Li was delighted and, while conversing with Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, and Ling Lingshuang, started to look through the updated content of the system.
This time, the system had optimized two functions.
The first was the System Space, which had its length, width, and height expanded tenfold again, resulting in a thousandfold increase in the overall volume of the space.
Now, the System Space measured ten million miles in length, width, and height, making it even more vast than the Daqian Empire at its peak.
In addition, the System Space’s ability to conceal fate had also been enhanced, and it was now possible to forcibly include living beings without their consent.
Living beings could now survive in the System Space for a year, after which, if they didn’t leave, they would be annihilated by the space’s rules.
The second optimized function was the Treasure Box Function, which had already been optimized during the last system upgrade and had been improved again.
After this optimization, the odds of treasures appearing from treasure boxes had increased further; for example, the odds of obtaining True Immortal Rank treasures had increased from 1% to 5%, and even Golden Immortal Rank treasures had a 0.5% chance….
Although the other mechanisms of the Treasure Box Function remained unchanged, Han Li was still very pleased; it was a significant improvement.
To be honest, he was quite eager to open treasure boxes.
This month he hadn’t used any of his chances to open treasure boxes, including the free one, as he was waiting for the system to upgrade to see if the Treasure Box Function would be optimized.
He had not anticipated that his wait would actually pay off.
Casting a glance at the four stunning beauties beside him, Han Li suddenly had an idea.
Now was not the best time to open treasure boxes.
He would open them later during the discourse, perhaps even drawing on some good fortune in the process.
Returning his gaze from the beauties, Han Li continued to browse the system’s updated content, remembering there were also some new features added which he was curious about.
So, he looked, and his pupils narrowed slightly.
This system upgrade included only one new feature, but Han Li found it quite nice and was very interested.
This new feature was called “Thousand Realm Fishing,” which seemed to suggest that Han Li become a fisherman.
The Thousand Realm Fishing feature had a corresponding panel.
Upon opening it, a virtual screen that only he could see appeared in front of Han Li.
On the screen was a vast ocean, within which was a solitary island with a circumference of only one mile, equipped with ten fishing rods of different colors.
Han Li pulled up the system’s instructions and immediately became even more interested.
This ocean was called the Thousand Realm Ocean, and using those ten fishing rods, one could fish for treasures from the ocean.
What somewhat irked Han Li was that the Thousand Realm Fishing also incurred a charge, and quite a pricey one at that, without even a single free chance.
The ten fishing rods on the solitary island were one-time-use items.
The first fishing attempt required one year of cultivation, the second ten years, the third a hundred years…
the ninth one required one hundred million years of cultivation, and the tenth astonishingly demanded one billion years of cultivation.
Seeing that string of numbers, Han Li was somewhat dumbfounded; the cultivation he had accumulated was only enough for six fishing attempts.
Thus, Han Li made a decision that went against his ancestors’ wishes.
The ten fishing rods would refresh every ten years, so he would fish at most five times within ten years, the fifth requiring ten thousand years of cultivation.
He absolutely couldn’t go for the sixth time, as he couldn’t afford to lose one hundred thousand years of cultivation.
After all, fishing depended on luck and nothing but luck; skill was secondary.
This was the Thousand Realm Ocean.
Most importantly, it was possible to come back from the Thousand Realm Fishing empty-handed.
If he spent one hundred thousand years of cultivation and caught nothing, Han Li’s heart would bleed.

Chapter 675: Chapter 261: Fishing Alone Through the Ages!
The Scope is Too Small, Caught a Spirit Phoenix!
If It Doesn’t Transform, Just Roast and Eat It_1 Chapter 675: Chapter 261: Fishing Alone Through the Ages!
The Scope is Too Small, Caught a Spirit Phoenix!
If It Doesn’t Transform, Just Roast and Eat It_1 After reviewing the System upgrade content, Han Li withdrew his thoughts and continued chatting with his four stunning wives: Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Ling Lingshuang, and Xue Yueqing.
It is said that three women make a show, but Han Li, in the face of four women, and not just any women but four breathtaking beauties, handled it with ease.
After bombarding them with sweet nothings, Han Li found an excuse to leave the place, as he was ready to try out the new function.
...
Although fishing here was possible, Han Li still worried about unforeseen events, which he might not be able to explain.
Han Li was someone who took great interest in novel things and was filled with a desire to explore, especially dangerous peaks and perilous caverns.
Returning to Qiandao Hall, Han Li appeared in the depths of the grand hall, sitting on a cushion releasing a misty purple aura, and once again summoned the virtual screen for fishing across realms.
Before him was an immense and boundless ocean, the surface calm and silent, yet it exuded an overwhelming presence that seemed about to break through the virtual screen.
Han Li looked at the ten fishing rods on the isolated island, which from right to left corresponded to crimson, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet, silver, gold, and a blend of black and whiteâ€”eleven colors in total.
Han Li focused on the five rods to the left, which considerately displayed text revealing the amount of spiritual cultivation required to use each rod.
“System, what can be caught with that black and white rod that needs ten billion years of cultivation?” Han Li asked softly.
The other nine rods were all of a single color, but the last one was dual-colored, standing out prominently, its special nature self-evident.
The System, perhaps thinking that Han Li was too poor to ever use the black and white rod, actually answered his question.
“Using the black and white rod, one may catch beings and objects from the fourth step.”
Han Li’s gaze flashed.
He was surprised that the System provided an explanation; he had expected an answer like “Insufficient authority, unable to access.”
What shocked him even more was the explanation from the System.
The black and white rod, rightfully the most expensive rod requiring ten billion years of cultivation, could reach the fourth step.
With such stakes, it was all worth it.
Did you not see the vast and limitless Taichu Realm where the strongest are but peak third-step Immortal Emperors?
Even if one could not succeed in a single attempt, fishing ten, a hundred, or even a thousand times, as long as one caught beings or objects from the fourth step, it would be a massive gain.
Han Li continued to inquire until he had a clear understanding of the scope of “beings and objects”: “people” included both genders and beings from myriad races, while “objects” encompassed everything else apart from the living beings, such as weapons, elixirs, Cultivation Techniques, and so on.
The crux was that using a rod of a specific level could only catch “beings and objects” of that same level, never anything above it.
For instance, using the black and white rod, one could only catch “beings and objects” from the fourth step and nothing from the first to third steps of cultivation.
If one used the Crimson Fishing Rod, only “beings and objects” of the Heaven Immortal Rank could be caught.
The nine rods of crimson, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet, silver, and gold corresponded to the nine realms of the Immortal Domain, from Heavenly Immortal to Immortal Emperor.
Naturally, Han Li was extremely pleased with this.
The randomness of treasure chests was too great; although the maximum value of treasures obtained could be higher, fishing across realms was more stable, starting at Heaven Immortal Rank.
Theoretically, using the blue rod could result in catching treasures like Immortal Monarch Soldiers and Immortal Monarch Elixirs, which had much higher chances than obtaining Immortal Monarch Rank Treasures from treasure chests, though the required cultivation expenditure was also higher.
After some thought, Han Li voiced a few questions he was particularly concerned about.
“System, does this Thousand Realm Ocean truly connect to the myriad worlds of the heavens?
Is the Taichu Realm also within it?
If I were to fish for a female Immortal Emperor, would I fail to pull it up?
Would it trigger a response based on karma, resulting in her coming after me?”
Han Li waited for a while, and the System still provided an explanation.
“The Thousand Realm Ocean connects to the real myriad worlds of the heavens, which include the world where the master’s previous life took place, as well as the Taichu Realm; and it involves the past, present, and future of these myriad worlds.”
“If the master manages to fish up a female Immortal Emperor, do not worry about being unable to pull her up.
The rod possesses great power and will swiftly seal the strength of anything caught.”
“All ten rods are Karma Fishing Rods; even beings of the fourth step cannot trace the related karma, so the master need not worry about that.”
After researching and understanding clearly, Han Li breathed a sigh of relief and prepared to begin.
He was going to fish across realms!
He was determined to be the sole fisher through all ages!
(Picture for the Easter egg chapter)
“System, how should I go about fishing?”
Han Li suddenly paused; he did not know how to use the ten rods.
“The master simply needs to have the intention, to enter the Thousand Realm Ocean, and pick up the corresponding rod to start fishing.”
After hearing the System’s answer, Han Li was somewhat astonished; he could actually enter the Thousand Realm Ocean within the virtual screen.
However, Han Li didn’t dwell on it much.
With a single thought, he transformed into a rainbow light and entered the virtual screen.
As soon as Han Li entered it, the virtual screen closed, leaving no trace for anyone to detect any anomalies.
Thousand Realm Ocean, Thousand Realm Island.
Han Li descended from the sky, landing at the center of the island.
He looked around with keen interest, surveying the island and the ocean before walking towards a large rock, where the ten colored rods were neatly lined up.
Without hesitation, Han Li picked up the Crimson Fishing Rod on the far right; a system notification sounded and deducted a year of his cultivation.
Han Li examined the rod carefully, noting it was crafted from a material he did not recognize, but it felt good in his hand.
With a light lift, the fishing line of the Crimson Fishing Rod slowly emerged from beneath the sea, and on the hook was a large, bloody, and very fresh chicken leg.

chapters.title: Chapter 676
chapters.content:
Chapter 676: Chapter 261: Fishing Alone Through the Ages!
The Scope is Too Small, Caught a Spirit Phoenix!
If It Doesn’t Transform, Just Roast and Eat It_2 Chapter 676: Chapter 261: Fishing Alone Through the Ages!
The Scope is Too Small, Caught a Spirit Phoenix!
If It Doesn’t Transform, Just Roast and Eat It_2 “Sss~”
Han Li felt somewhat disappointed, but when his divine eyes opened and swept over, he suddenly inhaled sharply.
This was by no means a chicken leg, but actually the thigh of a pure-blooded Sky Phoenix, containing the corresponding great Dao, revealing a powerful Dao’s charm.
Looking at the Heaven Phoenix Leg before him, Han Li admitted he was tempted and couldn’t help sticking out his tongue to lick his lips.
...
There were only two thoughts in his mind now.
The first thought: Is this the opportunity I fished up with the Crimson Fishing Rod?
The second thought: I really want to roast this pure-blooded Sky Phoenix’s thigh and eat it!
“Master, you’re thinking too small, this is just bait,” the System coldly interjected.
Then Han Li fell silent.
This was the first time he had seen the System take the initiative to speak, and it was done with such sass that even Han Li, who prided himself on his thick skin, felt somewhat embarrassed.
Luckily, no one saw this scene.
“Can I take the bait directly?” After thinking for a moment, Han Li asked.
Thinking small is no issue; the important thing is to get a hold of it first.
He had only expended a year’s worth of cultivation, and compared to the clearly Heavenly Immortal domain Sky Phoenix thigh, that was truly nothing to mention.
Not to speak of a year’s cultivation, even if it cost ten thousand years of cultivation, Han Li would be willing.
“No,” the System replied with just two words, and with a slight emotion this time, not as cold and mechanical as before.
It seemed that after several upgrades, the System was gradually becoming more humanized.
The fact that the System had taken the initiative to speak with emotion was a sign of this change.
Han Li didn’t dwell on it and immediately started his fishing journey.
He wanted to see what treasure he could fish up with a Sky Phoenix thigh as bait.
According to the fishing rules, as long as there were no empty hooks, he was bound to fish up something of Heaven Immortal Rank.
Han Li gently flicked the Crimson Fishing Rod, which automatically cast the line.
Waves rose in the distant sea area as the hook entered the water.
Han Li waited a while and, seeing no reaction from the fishing rod, asked, “System, how long will it take for results to show up?”
“Master, please be patient.
Once the hook has entered the sea, there will definitely be a result within two quarters of an hour.”
Upon hearing this, Han Li narrowed his eyes and waited patiently.
It was only two quarters of an hour; he could afford to wait.
About a quarter of an hour later, the distant sea surface suddenly churned with waves, a significant disturbance.
It seemed the Crimson Fishing Rod had truly hooked something.
Han Li was overjoyed.
To fish up a treasure on his first attempt, was this the legendary beginner’s protection period for fishers?
A whirlpool appeared on the distant sea surface, the Crimson Fishing Rod automatically reeled in, pulling the fish line outward to fish out the fortune from the sea.
Han Li watched the whirlpool closely, and a Spirit Phoenix flew out from it.
Instantly, myriad rays of rosy light illuminated a vast area of sea, entwined with Infinite Immortal Light.
The Spirit Phoenix struggled desperately, attempting to break free from the hook’s constraints.
But the hook was one of the rules, and the Spirit Phoenix couldn’t resist at all, being forcefully pulled over by the Crimson Fishing Rod.
As the Spirit Phoenix gradually approached Thousand Realm Island, its massive body slowly shrank until it was only three meters in size when it landed on the island.
“I’ve struck it rich, so rich.”
Looking at the Spirit Phoenix beside him, Han Li’s eyes widened.
Luckily, he couldn’t remove the bait from the Crimson Fishing Hook; otherwise, he would’ve been at a great loss.
The bait was only the thigh of a Heavenly Immortal Rank Phoenix, but now he had fished up an entire Heavenly Immortal Rank Spirit Phoenix.
It was simply a windfall.
As Han Li looked at the Heavenly Immortal Rank Spirit Phoenix, considering whether to keep it as a pet or roast it to eat, the Spirit Phoenix was also sizing up Han Li.
Feng Mianâ€”don’t get caught up in the nameâ€”although her cultivation was sealed, her eyesight was intact.
After a careful examination, she reached the following conclusions.
This fisherman is very handsome.
(Scratch that; it’s not the main point.)
This fisherman isn’t even an immortal yet!
(Main point.)
Feng Mian’s phoenix eyes widened, her expression showing human-like shock, bewilderment, disbelief, and anger.
She had been quite content on the island, but she had suddenly been fished away.
Although she wanted to leave that island, certainly not in this manner.
After being caught by the hook, her cultivation was sealed, then she was whisked away as if traveling through time and space, across thousands of realms, into a boundless sea, and from there, dragged up to the surface and pulled onto an island.
Considering the magnitude of the act, Feng Mian thought the fisherman was a supremely powerful being whose cultivation shook heaven and earth, but it turned out this fisherman wasn’t even an immortal.
Feng Mian was furious and felt utterly humiliated; she, a Heavenly Immortal, had been fished up by a mortal.
Was there no justice in the world?
Was there no law of the land?
“Who are you?” Looking down at the fisherman, Feng Mian’s eyes were filled with coldness, her tone equally frosty.
On hearing this, Han Li’s pupils constricted, but the thoughts in his mind changed.
This Spirit Phoenix seemed to be female?
Han Li decided to see what this transformed Spirit Phoenix looked like.
If she was just average, he would eat her; if she was as stunning as a celestial, well, he would still eat her.
Without answering, Han Li silently asked in his mind, “System, how can I unseal her cultivation?”
“Master, you just need to say ‘unseal,’ and the seal on her cultivation will be lifted,” the System answered.
After receiving the answer, Han Li finally replied to the Spirit Phoenix’s question.
“Tai Chu Realm, Han Li.”
Feng Mian pondered for a moment, unfamiliar with that name and the Tai Chu Realm.
But Feng Mian fell silent.
It seemed she had truly left her original world and been fished away to this so-called Tai Chu Realm by this fisherman.
“What do you want to do?” Feng Mian asked in a cold tone.
She was panicking now.
Forced to leave her world, her cultivation sealed, she was like a fish on a chopping block, defenseless.

chapters.title: Chapter 677
chapters.content:
Chapter 677: Chapter 261: Fishing Alone Through the Ages!
The Scope is Too Small, Caught a Spirit Phoenix!
If It Doesn’t Transform, Just Roast and Eat It_3 Chapter 677: Chapter 261: Fishing Alone Through the Ages!
The Scope is Too Small, Caught a Spirit Phoenix!
If It Doesn’t Transform, Just Roast and Eat It_3 And the person before her didn’t look like a good one.
If he did anything to her, she would have no way to resist.
“Can you transform?”
Han Li suddenly asked.
...
Although Feng Mian didn’t know why Han Li would ask such a thing, she still responded, “My powers are sealed, I cannot transform.”
Suddenly, she felt a glimmer of hope.
Did this fisherman develop some improper thoughts toward her?
As a member of the Linghuang Clan, her transformed state was naturally extremely beautiful; perhaps this man was tempted by her body, which would be perfect.
Once this fisherman unlocked her powers, she could turn the tables and have him in her grasp.
A mere mortal who hasn’t become a True Immortal, how could he stand a chance against her, a noble Heavenly Immortal of the Linghuang Clan?
“Is that so?
Then let me unseal your powers for you,” Han Li said directly.
This caught Feng Mian off guard.
Was he being so straightforward?
He had no defenses against her, wasn’t he afraid she would counterattack?
While Feng Mian hesitated over whether to say anything, she saw Han Li lightly tap her and utter two words.
Her powers were truly released.
Boom!
A powerful and boundless aura soared to the sky, a terrifying might emanating from the body of the Linghuang.
Feng Mian joyfully circled in the sky for a round, letting out a happy screech.
Her body was immensely huge, at least a million zhang in size.
“Young man, how dare you unseal my powers!
How dare you?!”
Feng Mian circled around Thousand Realm Island, her tone full of joy and pride, speaking recklessly as if she had Han Li completely under control.
“Buzz~”
Han Li said nothing.
An inch of his sword at his waist unsheathed, and a brilliant sword light burst forth, instantly striking the immensely huge Linghuang.
The Linghuang was instantly split in two, falling onto the island, her body reverting to its original size.
“You actually have a True Immortal weapon!”
Feng Mian’s tone was filled with incredible shock, regret flooding her heart.
She had been too careless.
If he, not yet a True Immortal, had been able to fish her, a Heavenly Immortal, from another world with such a miraculous fishing rod, it was clear he had deeply hidden trump cards.
But she was reeled over so suddenly and her powers were swiftly unsealed by Han Li, she hadn’t thought of this until now, which led to such a terrible outcome.
“Transform.”
Watching the Linghuang’s body merge and restore itself, Han Li spoke indifferently.
“I won’t!”
Feng Mian turned her head away, outright refusing.
“Then I will roast you to eat.”
Han Li’s tone was indifferent, his left hand grasping the hilt of his sword, slowly pulling it outward.
Feeling the terrifying sword light locking onto her, Feng Mian panicked instantly.
This man was truly capable of doing such a thing.
He had already dealt her one sword strike, and now, if she didn’t transform, this fisherman might just deliver a few more strikes to kill her, to actually roast and eat her.
“No no no, I’ll transform,” Feng Mian said, panicking.
Then, a series of celestial lights rose from her Phoenix body, and once the lights dispersed, an extremely beautiful person appeared before Han Li.
She was a youthful and icy beauty with light green hair hanging down her back, a golden collar around her delicate neck, her makeup exquisite, her face flawless and magnificent, a Phoenix Feather Mark on her forehead.
She was dressed in gorgeous, detailed clothes, adorned with various accessories.
Gold patterns graced her jade hands and feet, and her bare toes were light blue.
Floating three inches off the ground, her feet never touched it.
PS: My eyes are uncomfortable, writing at a snail’s pace, it took four to five hours to write just this little, sigh.
I’ll try to make up for it tomorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 678
chapters.content:
Chapter 678: Chapter 262: A Heaven Immortal Rank Companion?
The Second Fishing, Caught a Golden Immortal Weapon!
Ancestor, Unbeatable!_1 Chapter 678: Chapter 262: A Heaven Immortal Rank Companion?
The Second Fishing, Caught a Golden Immortal Weapon!
Ancestor, Unbeatable!_1 Watching the transformed youthful beauty of Juvenile Giant Peak, Han Li’s eyes flashed with a glint, and a shallow smile appeared on his face.
This Heavenly Immortal-rank Spirit Phoenix was quite sensible after all, knowing that she had spoken too loudly just now.
“Name.”
After taking a careful look, Han Li said in an indifferent tone.
...
When his predatory gaze disappeared, Feng Mian breathed a sigh of relief, hesitated for a moment, her phoenix lips slightly parting, and still revealed her own name.
“Feng Mian.”
Han Li nodded slightly, his gaze flickering, already having plans for this Heavenly Immortal-level Spirit Phoenix.
“Han Li, what…
what do you want to do?”
Biting her crimson lips, Feng Mian still asked, her heart filled with unease.
Having been fished here by Han Li, she didn’t know where this place was, how to get out, or how to return to her own world.
Han Li frowned slightly and then said after a thought, “Just stand there quietly.”
Fishing across the Thousand Realm Ocean was one of his core secrets, which normally should not have been known to others; however, Feng Mian was an exception.
Feng Mian was fished out from the Thousand Realm Ocean by him, so it was impossible to hide the secret from her, as she had discovered the ten Karma Fishing Rods on the island the moment she emerged from the ocean.
He had plans for Feng Mian, this phoenix lady whom he had “finally” fished up, and he already considered her his future wife.
Feng Mian’s beauty matched his taste perfectly, her visage was flawlessly beautiful, and considering the entire Endless Yuankun Domain, she was second to none, matched only by the likes of Empress Yuanchu and Empress Huangyue.
Moreover, Feng Mian was also a Heavenly Immortal-rank powerhouse.
Once he successfully captivated her, it would greatly assist the affairs of Chengsheng Mountain, and he would gain a Heavenly Immortal-rank companion.
Just the thought of it was exhilarating.
Empress Huangyue was also a phoenix, one whose beauty Han Li had long coveted but had not yet obtained, only to fish up an even more powerful Spirit Phoenix.
Although he hadn’t completely secured her yet, it was only a matter of time.
As a seasoned Romeo, Han Li was experienced.
From their brief interaction, he had already figured out Feng Mian’s personality: she seemed like an icy beauty on the outside, but was warm and slightly proud inside.
Han Li planned to pursue her over the course of a year.
Feng Mian, being a Heavenly Immortal, deserved his respect.
But for now, he had to continue fishing, pressing on to see if he could catch something of True Immortal rank or higher.
He couldn’t leave yet, so Feng Mian would have to just watch.
He would take Feng Mian with him after completing this round of fishing across the Thousand Realm Ocean.
“Okay, okay.”
Feng Mian readily agreed, her exquisite face filled with anticipation, seemingly quickly forgetting her predicament.
Looking at the Crimson Fishing Rod in Han Li’s hand that lacked bait, then at the other nine fishing rods on the rock, Feng Mian’s eyes brimmed with curiosity.
Han Li had used that Crimson Fishing Rod to fish her up previously.
These fishing rods clearly possessed supreme power, capable of traversing through time and space, and even she, a Heavenly Immortal Realm great expert, had no power to resist.
Of course, her succumbing to temptation played a part.
That Heaven Phoenix Leg appeared on the island out of nowhere, and Feng Mian sensed that it was fated for her.
If she could refine it, her bloodline would further purify and evolve, increasing her chances of advancing to the True Immortal Realm and even the Golden Immortal Realm.
But just as she reached out to take the Heaven Phoenix Leg, she was caught by an invisible hook that turned into a net made of rules and vanished from her original world.
Now, she didn’t get the Heaven Phoenix Leg and had instead become a prisoner under Han Li, which was really unfortunate.
Han Li still had nine more fishing rods, and Feng Mian was very curious about what else he could catch.
Were they also Heavenly Immortal Realm powerhouses?
Was this ocean only connected to her world, or did it include other worlds as well?
“Come.”
Looking at the excited Feng Mian, Han Li ignored her and called out sharply.
A ray of celestial light descended, embedding itself straight into the center of the island, and when the celestial light dissipated, it revealed the Emperor Flag.
Although Han Li had entered the Thousand Realm Ocean, he still maintained contact with the outside world.
With just a thought from him, the celestials from Chengsheng Mountain would descend.
Of course, this required a little time.
Key moments were usually hair-trigger, so Han Li chose to summon the Emperor Flag in advance to take position.
It was the strongest True Immortal weapon in his possession.
It would serve both to prevent Feng Mian from attacking him and to guard against the True Immortal-rank powerhouses he might fish up next, provided his cast wasn’t fruitless.
“There’s actually another True Immortal weapon, and it seems even more powerful.”
Feng Mian glanced at the banner fluttering in the wind, then at the sky above, her expression one of surprise, as she quietly put away any minor schemes.
“Behave, or else I’ll strip you naked and here with you…
(fill in the blank).”
Han Li issued another warning to Feng Mian.
This Spirit Phoenix seemed naÃ¯ve and innocent, but who knew if it was just an act.
After all this, Han Li looked toward the nine fishing rods on the big rock; his gaze shifted between the orange, yellow, green, and blue rods.
After contemplating, Han Li did not reach for the orange True Immortal-rank fishing rod but instead took hold of the yellow Golden Immortal-rank fishing rod.
A prompt sounded in his mind: a hundred years of cultivation were gone.
He was taking a chance to see if he could fish up a Golden Immortal weapon.
Next, a Golden Immortal Realm powerhouse, followed by cultivation techniques, pills, and so on.
As for that Crimson Fishing Rod, it had already disintegrated and disappeared.
He didn’t know if the System had reclaimed it or if it had truly been extinguished.
At that moment, a seductive and entrancing voice suddenly rang out in Han Li’s ear.
“Hey, Han Li, why didn’t you take that orange fishing rod?”

chapters.title: Chapter 679
chapters.content:
Chapter 679: Chapter 262: A Heaven Immortal Rank Dao Companion?
The Second Fishing Session, Caught a Golden Immortal Weapon!
Ancestor, Undefeated!_2 Chapter 679: Chapter 262: A Heaven Immortal Rank Dao Companion?
The Second Fishing Session, Caught a Golden Immortal Weapon!
Ancestor, Undefeated!_2 Han Li glanced back at her and, struck by a whim, said with a smile, “Do you want to give it a try?”
“Ah?
Can I really do it?” Feng Mian was taken aback, her face full of anticipation as she looked at Han Li.
She would certainly love to try her hand at it, knowing it was a treasure.
...
She was sure Han Li would never let her touch it, so she never mentioned it, but now it was Han Li himself who offered.
Feng Mian graciously consented.
“Of course you can, but I have one small condition,” Han Li said, wagging a finger.
Feng Mian regarded Han Li with suspicion, always feeling he was up to no good: “What condition?”
“This orange fishing rod is a supreme treasure.
It can be used to fish up powerhouses of the True Immortal Realm, and anything of True Immortal Rank, but the rod can only be used once, and its value is immeasurable,” Han Li pointed at the orange fishing rod and spoke with a solemn expression.
“So?” Feng Mian asked cautiously.
Although she was somewhat skeptical about the magic Han Li claimed the orange fishing rod possessed, trying it would be the proof.
Perhaps she really would fish up treasure of True Immortal Rank.
But with the orange fishing rod being so precious and disposable, she feared it would cost her greatly to use it.
Feng Mian thought it over.
All of her treasures combined seemed hardly to match the value of this orange fishing rod.
“So, if you want to use this precious opportunity to fish, just agree to a small condition of mine, which will be easy for you,” Han Li said in a tempting tone, trying to keep Feng Mian mesmerized.
A mere chance at True Immortal Rank fishing compared to getting a beautiful wife of Heaven Immortal Rank, he valued the latter more.
After all, the former happened once every ten years, consuming only ten years of cultivation, while a beautiful wife of Heaven Immortal Rank was far more important.
Seduced by Han Li, Feng Mian found herself tempted, stammering as she asked, “What condition?”
A radiant smile unfolded on Han Li’s face as he said with sincere tones,
“Just become my Dao companion.”
Feng Mian’s expression changed, the anticipation vanishing, replaced by intense wariness and defensiveness, even stepping back a few paces.
Biting her vermilion lips, her beautiful face turned ice-cold.
With her arms crossed over her chest, she said coldly,
“Are you dreaming?”
“You’re just a mortal, and I am a Heavenly Immortal.
How could I possibly become your Dao companion?”
As Feng Mian spoke, she noticed the unwelcoming look on Han Li’s face and gradually softened her tone, continuing weakly,
“Besides, even if you lust for my body, you can’t break through, can you?”
Han Li’s expression stiffened, and he let out a cold snort.
Although he was annoyed by Feng Mian’s words, she was telling the truth.
He had yet to become immortal, while Feng Mian had already stepped into the third phase of cultivation, existing on a higher plane of life than him.
Becoming immortal inherently meant a dramatic increase in the strength of body and Primordial Spirit.
Add to that Feng Mian’s pure-blooded phoenix lineage, which made her body even stronger than that of an ordinary Heavenly Immortal, in that aspect as well.
Even if Feng Mian agreed, he would still be unable to break her defenses and claim her virginity for the time being.
Suddenly, the stiffness in Han Li’s expression eased, and a smile returned.
If one “o” didn’t work, what about a second or even a third “o”?
Besides, he could breach other barriers and checkpoints, which was also a kind of pleasure.
Seeing Han Li’s rigid expression, Feng Mian initially thought she might have avoided the issue, but then Han Li quickly recovered, even wearing a smile, which she found somewhat sinister.
It sent a shiver through Feng Mian.
Han Li was still fixated on her.
Feng Mian was genuinely worried Han Li might force himself on her, unsure whether she could resist the invasion of the Golden Cudgel with her cultivation sealed.
And even if she could resist, her pure and delicate body would be sullied.
Biting on her silver teeth, Feng Mian wanted to punch Han Li twice, but after sneaking a glance at the Immortal Sword at Han Li’s waist and casting a sideways look at the flag, she prudently abandoned this unrealistic notion.
After some thought, Feng Mian’s gaze turned to the eight fishing rods on the large boulder.
A bright light flashed in her eyes, and she suddenly had an idea.
“Han Li, I’m not entirely against the idea of becoming your Dao companion.
As long as you let me fish with that black and white rod, I’ll agree,” she said.
After speaking, Feng Mian’s gaze stayed on Han Li, her heart filled with extreme nervousness and trepidation.
She had a hunch, not certain if it was true, but she had no choice but to try it.
If she was successful, she could temporarily stabilize Han Li, perhaps causing him to back off; if she failed, she would think of another way.
She simply wasn’t willing to surrender herself to a mere mortal.
Han Li had used the Crimson Fishing Rod to fish her up, and by color ranking, the crimson should be placed on the far right.
Han Li had said that the orange fishing rod was of True Immortal Rank, so the crimson rod must be of Heavenly Immortal Rank, potent enough to pull her up.
If her guess was correct, then the rods to the left would each be of higher quality, with the black and white rod on the far left being the highest rank.
She thought the black and white rod might be of Immortal King Rank, or perhaps Quasi Immortal King Rank.
As for higher ranks, Feng Mian was skeptical.
Han Li, not even a Heavenly Immortal himself, possessing an Immortal King Rank fishing rod was extraordinary enough, so how could he have a Quasi Immortal Emperor Rank or Immortal Emperor Rank rod?
As for the legendary fourth step, Feng Mian didn’t even entertain the thought.
If the black and white rod truly was of Immortal King Rank, then Han Li might not agree to her condition.
She admitted that she wouldn’t agree either if she were in his shoes.
How could a mere Heavenly Immortal compare to a treasure of Immortal King Rank?

chapters.title: Chapter 680
chapters.content:
Chapter 680: Chapter 262: A Heaven Immortal Rank Dao Companion?
The Second Fishing Session, Caught a Golden Immortal Weapon!
Ancestor, Invincible!_3 Chapter 680: Chapter 262: A Heaven Immortal Rank Dao Companion?
The Second Fishing Session, Caught a Golden Immortal Weapon!
Ancestor, Invincible!_3 Han Li gave Feng Mian a deep look, then suddenly smiled and said, “You have a good eye.”
“Of course,” Feng Mian’s mouth curled slightly.
“However, I cannot meet your conditions,” Han Li shook his head with a light sigh.
The black and white fishing rod was a fourth-step rod, not to mention he didn’t have enough cultivation to use it, even if he did, he wouldn’t let Feng Mian use it.
...
There were many reasons for that.
At most, Han Li could offer a True Immortal Rank orange fishing rod for exchange, even if the True Immortal Rank treasures he fished out didn’t belong to him, Han Li didn’t care.
However, it seemed there was no such rule for the ten Karma Fishing Rods, so the treasures Feng Mian fished out would still be his, here he was the biggest, the longest, the strongest.
Upon hearing this, the corners of Feng Mian’s mouth curled upward even more.
As expected, she had won the bet, Han Li was still caught in her grasp.
“Put away your clever tricks, a melon forcibly twisted is not sweet, but it is quite quenching.”
After speaking, Han Li ignored Feng Mian’s complex emotions, held the yellow fishing rod gently lifted it up, the latter half of the fishing line emerged from below the sea, and the bait on the hook also appeared in front of Han Li.
Looking at the bait, Han Li’s eyes narrowed slightly.
It was an egg, covered with purple-golden scales, emitting bursts of Immortal light and meaning, an intact egg about one-meter in size, Han Li didn’t know how the hook got inside.
“System, what kind of creature’s egg is this?” Han Li asked inwardly.
“Master, this is not an egg, this is a sealed ‘Dao,’ a sort of Golden Immortal level Great Dao.”
The System’s voice still carried a hint of emotion, seemingly suggesting that its master’s eyesight wasn’t great.
Han Li blinked, opened his divine eye, and examined it carefully, only to find it was still an egg.
He immediately knew that the gap was too large, he could only see the superficial appearance, not the true nature of the purple-golden egg.
“Using a Golden Immortal Rank egg as bait?”
Feng Mian’s face showed a shocked expression, her eyes filled with disbelief.
She had advanced quite far in the Heavenly Immortal realm, was among the later stage powerhouses, and was well-versed in many matters.
Regarding the Dao intentions swirling around the purple-golden egg, she deduced it was mostly likely of the Golden Immortal level.
Feng Mian looked at the yellow fishing rod in Han Li’s hand, then glanced over at the other fishing rods, a daring thought arising in her mind.
She seemed to have underestimated these fishing rods.
The Crimson Fishing Rod was of Heaven Immortal Rank, the orange rod was of True Immortal Rank, and the yellow rod was of Golden Immortal Rank.
If one rod corresponded to one realm, then these rods were indeed terrifying.
Was the ninth golden rod of Immortal Emperor Rank?
Could the tenth black and white rod surpass the Immortal Emperor Realm and be of the fabled fourth step in cultivation?
“Hu~”
Feng Mian exhaled, cutting away these terrifying thoughts, feeling she was thinking too much.
Otherwise, could the bait on the ninth rod be an Immortal Emperor Rank treasure, and the tenth rod’s bait a fourth-step treasure?
Impossible!
Ignoring Feng Mian’s reaction and having received the explanation from the System, Han Li flicked the yellow fishing rod in his hand, and the line automatically cast out, landing in the sea hundreds of miles away to the southeast.
This time, Han Li changed his position, then patiently waited to see if he could fish out treasures from other worlds.
Unconsciously, Han Li’s breathing quickened and his palms began to sweat, which shouldn’t have been possible with his cultivation.
This was the closest he had ever been to Golden Immortal Rank treasures and powerhouses.
Han Li muttered inwardly, hoping he wouldn’t come up empty.
Feng Mian watched intently, sometimes glancing at Han Li, sometimes at the distant sea area where the hook had fallen, and sometimes at the eight rods on the large rock.
In this tense atmosphere, she wanted to speak but dared not to interrupt.
Feng Mian could tell this was extremely important to Han Li; that was a Golden Immortal Rank rod and the bait was a Golden Immortal Rank egg, and it was one-time use only.
If she disturbed him and caused Han Li to fail to fish anything, he certainly wouldn’t spare her.
She clearly understood that Han Li hadn’t dealt with her because he didn’t regard her as a threat, and that was the only reason she could stay here unharmed; if she angered Han Li, she would likely suffer hellish torment.
“Can I fish up a Golden Immortal Rank treasure, or a Golden Immortal Realm powerhouse?”
Feng Mian murmured to herself, her gaze locked on the southeastern sea, her face filled with anticipation.
As time ticked by second by second, it was the first time Han Li felt as if time was dragging on endlessly.
Although the yellow fishing rod had only consumed a hundred years of his cultivation, from the moment it was cast, its value became immeasurable.
“I must catch a Golden Immortal Rank treasure,” Han Li silently wished.
In just a moment and a half, Han Li’s palm was already covered in sweat, yet his right hand didn’t shake at all.
With half a moment left until the end, Han Li grew more anxious.
According to the fishing rules, if nothing was caught within two moments, the rod would automatically reel in, signifying nothing was caught.
After a while, Han Li’s back began to sweat when he saw waves arising in the distant sea, quickly forming a whirlpool.
A smile spread across Han Li’s face, filled with excitement, he almost wanted to laugh out loud three times.
Indeed, he, Old Ancestor Han, was a fishing genius!
It was only his second cast, and he had already caught something of the Golden Immortal level.
“A Golden Immortal weapon, please let it be a Golden Immortal weapon,” Han Li screamed inwardly.
Although a Golden Immortal Realm powerhouse was more valuable than a Golden Immortal weapon, it was beyond his control, and the value of a sealed Golden Immortal Realm powerhouse greatly diminished, and if their cultivation wasn’t sealed, Han Li might be killed with a counterattack.
Therefore, Han Li hoped to catch a Golden Immortal weapon more than anything.
It would be most beneficial to him and was what he hoped to obtain the most.

chapters.title: Chapter 681
chapters.content:
Chapter 681: Chapter 262: A Heaven Immortal Rank Dao Companion?
The Second Fishing Session, Caught a Golden Immortal Weapon!
Ancestor, Invincible!_4 Chapter 681: Chapter 262: A Heaven Immortal Rank Dao Companion?
The Second Fishing Session, Caught a Golden Immortal Weapon!
Ancestor, Invincible!_4 With a Golden Immortal weapon in hand, Han Li would fear nothing, directly dominating the vast and endless Yuankun Domain.
Even if he lacked sufficient Immortal Tao Energy to power the Golden Immortal weapon’s consumption, the weapon itself contained a massive amount of Immortal Tao Energy, enough to support one full-fledged battle.
Moreover, Han Li didn’t need the Golden Immortal weapon to recover fully for battle, just showing it off would have the greatest deterrent effect, making all forces obediently submit, including the mightiest powers who would not dare to act rashly.
...
Otherwise, even if the Golden Immortal weapon recovered only a part of its might, it could suppress the entire Endless Yuankun Domain and steamroll all enemies.
“I actually managed to fish it out.”
Seeing this scene, Feng Mian’s ruby lips gradually parted into an O shape, which anyone would want to stick a rod into.
But Han Li wasn’t paying attention to any of this at the moment; he didn’t even glance at Feng Mian, his eyes solely fixed on the Golden Immortal Rank Treasure on the fishhook.
“What could it be?” Feng Mian continued to muse to herself, observing the man with an intense focus, a hint of wonder flashing in her eyes.
Seeing Han Li’s earlier nervousness, she knew that these fishing rods weren’t guaranteed successes and might come up empty.
While Feng Mian’s thoughts were scattered, the item, pulled up by the yellow fishing rod hundreds of miles away in the ocean, broke the surface and came into view of Han Li and Feng Mian.
It then moved at a considerable speed towards Thousand Realm Island.
Seeing the item on the hook, excitement flushed across Han Li’s face, while Feng Mian’s red lips parted even wider.
Finally relaxing, Han Li could now spare a moment to notice Feng Mian, and what he saw was incredibly beautiful, making his throat dry, his heart blaze with desire, and his Golden Cudgel ready to rise.
Reverting his gaze and cutting off his thoughts, making his body and mind return to calm, Han Li knew then was not the time for such distractions.
Feeling Han Li’s scorching and undisguised gaze upon her, Feng Mian had already lowered her head with a blush on her cheeks, gripping the corners of her dress tightly with both hands.
“Bang!”
With the sound of landing, the treasure fished up by the yellow fishing rod from the Thousand Realm Ocean fell onto Thousand Realm Island.
It was a round tripod with three legs and two ears, from within which Chaos Qi surged, spewing out stream after stream, and the tripod’s walls were engraved with laws, currently emitting Infinite Immortal Light.
In just a short time, an area with a radius of ten meters around the tripod turned into a Chaos World.
The Chaos Qi expelled from the tripod transformed the area into innumerable universes, each with boundless star seas, endless starry skies, infinite Star Domains, and countless stars rising and falling.
Seeing this spectacle, the smile on Han Li’s face grew more intense until he burst into loud laughter.
This tripod seemed to be a Golden Immortal Rank offensive Immortal Weapon!
And it was exactly the type of Golden Immortal weapon he urgently needed!
However, Han Li’s smile soon froze, with his brows gradually furrowing.
The fantastical Chaos World outside the tripod fractured like a bubble, all the grand universes disappeared without a trace, leaving only the three-legged and two-eared tripod where once had been all that seemed like an illusion to Han Li.
“System, what’s going on?” Han Li asked internally.
“That was merely the lingering charm of the Golden Immortal weapon after being sealed.”
The System’s tone was calm, which made Han Li sigh in relief, but then he tensed again.
He suddenly realized a very serious problem: even having acquired the Golden Immortal weapon, he might not be able to use it…
Just like a Golden Immortal Realm expert wouldn’t listen to his commands or submit to him, the Artifact Spirit of this Golden Immortal weapon probably wouldn’t easily submit either.
After all, this wasn’t an Immortal Weapon awarded by the System; the Artifact Spirit wouldn’t be absolutely loyal to him.
“System, does using the Karma Fishing Rod to fish out weaponry make them automatically submit to me?” Han Li raised the question of utmost concern to him.
“Master, rest assured, only the living creatures you fish out require effort from you to make them submit.”
Upon hearing this answer, Han Li’s anxious heart finally settled.
The rules of fishing in the Thousand Realm were simply fantastic!
Looking at the round tripod not far away, Han Li’s eyes gleamed as if he were staring at his most beloved lover, to the point where even Feng Mian, the Heavenly Immortal beauty, couldn’t draw his gaze anymore.
“Ancestor, I am invincible!” Han Li murmured softly, then burst into hearty laughter.

chapters.title: Chapter 682
chapters.content:
Chapter 682: Chapter 263 Don’t come over!
Screaming is useless!
You have to take responsibility for me!_1 Chapter 682: Chapter 263 Don’t come over!
Screaming is useless!
You have to take responsibility for me!_1 “Did you really catch a Golden Immortal weapon?”
Feng Mian of Juvenile Giant Peak was somewhat dumbfounded as she looked back and forth between Han Li and the cauldron, her flawless face filled with shock.
Feng Mian’s emotions were very complicated.
After all, she herself was fished out of the Thousand Realm Ocean by Han Li, and now she had witnessed him catching a Golden Immortal weapon, completely failing to manage her expression.
...
“Genuine and unaltered.”
Han Li was in high spirits, his gaze toward Feng Mian even more fervent.
With the acquisition of this Golden Immortal weapon, he would practically own the Endless Yuankun Domain from this point forward.
He, Old Ancestor Han, could swagger around, fearing no enemy.
Even if all the forces within the Yuankun Domain banded together, Han Li wouldn’t be the slightest bit afraid, perfectly poised to capture all his enemies in one fell swoop.
By then, the list of Heavenly Immortals within the Yuankun Domain would truly become his selection roll for consorts.
All females within the Heaven Imperial Realm of the Yuankun Domain, including Empresses Phoenix Feather and Empress Yuanchu, would fall into his hands.
“So, do you want to give it a shot?” Han Li continued to tempt her.
Upon hearing this, Feng Mian really did feel tempted.
Hues of amazement danced in her beautiful eyes as she scanned back and forth between Han Li and the orange fishing rod, her lips lightly biting with hesitation, “Perhaps I’d better not.”
While she was tempted to have a go to see what she could fish out of this ocean area, Feng Mian was still unwilling to pay with her body as the price.
Her gaze swept over the cauldron, and suddenly, a bold thought surfaced in her heart.
Could she snatch the Golden Immortal weapon for herself?
The cauldron-shaped Golden Immortal weapon had just been fished out of the Thousand Realm Ocean by Han Li and certainly hadn’t acknowledged a master.
Since Han Li wasn’t in control of the Golden Immortal weapon, she saw her opportunity.
If she could snatch the Golden Immortal weapon, Han Li’s two True Immortal weapons would pose no threat, and she could easily suppress them.
At that point, the Golden Immortal weapon, Han Li’s two True Immortal swords, and those eight fishing rods would all fall into her hands.
In comparison to the Golden Immortal weapon, Feng Mian was more eager to possess those eight fishing rods, which could grant her treasures ten times, a hundred times, or even a thousand to ten thousand times more powerful than a Golden Immortal weapon.
Feng Mian’s heart thumped rapidly.
She quickly lowered her head to avoid Han Li’s gaze, lest he discover her intention.
A gleam of speculation flashed in Han Li’s eyes.
Despite her efforts, he noticed Feng Mian’s expression as she stared at the tripod-shaped cauldron, and he made a guess.
Han Li spoke calmly, “Are you sure you don’t want to reconsider?”
“Well…
it’s not that I couldn’t.”
“If you allow me to fish with the green or blue rod, and promise that whatever I catch will be mine…”
Feng Mian lifted her head, feigning indecision, and subtly moved towards the cauldron.
Even though she was only a few meters away from the cauldron, a very short distance for her as a powerful Heavenly Immortal, Feng Mian still wasn’t entirely confident.
Han Li was even closer than she was, with a True Immortal Sword at his waist and another pole-like True Immortal weapon planted not far away, putting significant pressure on Feng Mian.
Han Li pretended not to notice her slight movement, but discreetly unlocked the seal on the cauldron before saying, “Feng Mian, if you want more, you have to give more, you know.”
An expression as if laden with deeper meaning appeared on Han Li’s face.
Originally, he intended to cultivate just one ‘cavity’, but now he wanted to cultivate three.
As a conscientious land developer in the wilderness of morality, his only aim was to ensure a good life for his service targets.
Feng Mian paused mid-step, her heart skipping a beat.
Had Han Li discovered something?
Forcing a calm smile, Feng Mian stealthily moved closer to the cauldron while continuing to speak, “I understand the principle.
As long as you can do it, I might reveal something more to you.”
“Oh?
How deep is your ‘something more’?”
“Unfathomably deep.”
“Tch, I don’t believe it unless I probe it myself to test its depths.”
“Not now.”
“Then when would it be possible?”
“Of course, it’s when…”
As she spoke, Feng Mian uttered words that even made her own cheeks flush red, all to capture Han Li’s attention.
In order to lay her hands on the Golden Immortal weapon, to defy heaven and change her fate, to escape her plight, she threw caution to the wind and said things she once deemed incredibly shameful.
Fortunately, she succeeded.
Unnoticed, she had gotten close to the cauldron, and Han Li was obliviously captivated by her beauty.
Indeed, she was born with irresistible beauty; no one could escape her charm.
Feng Mian internally gloated, outwardly humoring Han Li with a slight smile on her lips, then she suddenly made her move.
One of her slender hands reached for the Golden Immortal weapon close at hand, emitting a bright radiance, hoping to grab the cauldron in one go.
At the same time, a Phoenix Feather appeared above her head, resplendent and emitting Infinite Immortal Light, shielding her to prevent Han Li’s two True Immortal weapons from striking her down.
As a powerful being in the late stages of the Heavenly Immortal realm, Feng Mian naturally possessed True Immortal weapons but had opted not to use them until the right moment came.
When Han Li had previously struck at her with the True Immortal Sword, Feng Mian, for a moment of hesitation due to her concerns, hadn’t employed her True Immortal weapons, allowing Han Li to cut her in half.
The subsequent developments were within her control; appearing weak before the enemy, the self-righteous Han Li hadn’t thought to seal her again, believing he had her firmly under control.
Boom!
Just as Feng Mian’s hand was about to touch the Golden Immortal weapon, the cauldron suddenly erupted with an extremely fierce aura, shattering the Phoenix Feather’s protective Immortal Light, sending both the feather and Feng Mian flying away.
With a thud, Feng Mian crashed to the ground, the Phoenix Feather falling askew beside her.
Feng Mian was stunned, ignoring her injuries as she stared fixedly at the cauldron, her face full of astonishment.
Wasn’t the cauldron supposed to be sealed?
How could it still unleash the power of a Golden Immortal?

chapters.title: Chapter 683
chapters.content:
Chapter 683: Chapter 263 Don’t come over!
Screaming is useless!
You have to take responsibility for me!_2 Chapter 683: Chapter 263 Don’t come over!
Screaming is useless!
You have to take responsibility for me!_2 The might of the Golden Immortal soldiers was too strong; compared to them, the True Immortal soldiers were worlds apart, not to mention that Feng Mian was merely a Heavenly Immortal, even weaker than her own True Immortal combat ability.
Even a burst of might from the cauldron was enough to send Feng Mian and her Phoenix Feather flying, with Feng Mian sustaining serious injuries.
“It’s now, isn’t it?”
Han Li, with his hands clasped behind his back, walked step by step toward Feng Mian, a shallow smile on his face, completing the words she hadn’t finished.
...
“You tricked me?”
Feng Mian instantly realized that her subtle movements had not escaped Han Li’s notice.
Han Li had turned the tables on her, genuinely injuring her and exposing her trump card, which made turning the tables incredibly difficult.
When exactly did this bastard gain control of this Golden Immortal weapon?
“Realizing it now?
It’s too late.”
Han Li continued to close the distance, the smile on his face growing wider, looking at Feng Mian like prey.
He had suspected all along that this Feng Mian possessed a True Immortal weapon, but since the other party had never revealed it, probably harboring grand schemes, Han Li simply decided to turn the tables, and indeed he managed to probe it out.
“Don’t you come over here.”
Feng Mian’s voice was innocent yet seductive, captivating, and, in conjunction with the current scene, made Han Li unstoppable.
Far from halting, his pace quickened.
Watching Han Li draw closer and hearing his moderate footsteps, Feng Mian’s face turned pale, one hand in front of her, continuously moving backward.
Han Li put tremendous pressure on her.
In such a situation, she genuinely feared Han Li forcing his way, as she was not yet prepared.
“Go ahead and scream.”
“There’s nobody around here.
Even if you scream your throat raw, no one will come to save you.”
“Oh right, better save your voice.
Leave it for me to cut open.”
A malicious smile spread across Han Li’s face, considering Feng Mian as something in the bag, looking forward to playing a big scene with her afterward.
Since Feng Mian was playing dirty, not following the rules, he wouldn’t feel bad about playing dirty as well.
Originally, he had planned to spend a year to conquer Feng Mian, but now he could skip the process and proceed to the final step.
If Feng Mian still had disordered thoughts afterward, Han Li wouldn’t mind having an extra Heavenly Immortal female slave to slowly tame.
He believed it would be quite satisfying.
Of course, he would still continue to enhance Feng Mian’s status and position according to her performance, just like with Yuan Youwei.
After all, Feng Mian was a Heavenly Immortal; with Han Li’s current qualifications and physique, combining with Feng Mian, it would be easy to produce offspring with Immortal Bodies and dazzling talents.
Such offspring were destined to be unrivaled prodigies, who, if they rose smoothly in the future, would become famous and revered, intimidating in all directions, and become supreme beings.
Han Li certainly didn’t want a melodramatic plot like “Han Yong-X pleads with the old ancestor for death” to happen in his family.
Although he could easily suppress any offspring, that would be too embarrassing; where would that leave the face of him, the Old Ancestor Han?
“Shameless!”
“Vile!”
“Bastard!”
Feng Mian railed with a “three-hit combo”.
She wanted to hurl even nastier words, but she simply couldn’t find the terms.
“Even your cursing is adorable, so tempting; I like you more and more, Feng Mian.”
Han Li spoke nonchalantly, his steps relentless as he was now just a few strides from Feng Mian.
“If you dare mess around, I’ll definitely kill you.”
Thinking of the image of her throat being punctured, Feng Mian shuddered and warned coldly.
Han Li suddenly paused, surveyed Feng Mian a few times, and said with a smile:
“Actually, you don’t need to worry.
Doing this thing is like surgery.
I can start by injecting you with a super-sized syringe, numbing you, so you won’t feel the pain.

Unexpected?”

Chapter 684: Chapter 263 Don’t come over!
Screaming is useless!
You have to take responsibility for me!_3 Chapter 684: Chapter 263 Don’t come over!
Screaming is useless!
You have to take responsibility for me!_3 Han Li approached Feng Mian, looking down at her from his superior position as she lay on the ground.
He took in the breathtaking view before him and immediately felt a surge of heat that needed to be quenched.
And so, Han Li made his move.
...
Person, from, now, this, cold, place, thing, ever, so…
Heaven as the canopy, Earth as the bed, the vast island was their battleground.
Han Li’s affection for someone was never just about getting her into bed; sofas, living rooms, kitchens, balconies, corners, and studies were all fair game.
Although Thousand Realm Island had nothing much, Han Li’s System Space was well-stocked with spare tools of all sorts, which he fully utilized in a display of martial prowess on the island.
When the fierce battle finally came to a close, Han Li felt somewhat exhausted.
Feng Mian truly was a siren of energy.
Her cultivation level was higher than his, her physical strength surpassing his, and she had a formidable constitution.
Han Li’s endurance and physical strength were inferior to Feng Mian’s, leading him to ultimately bring an end to the intense battle by his own volition.
“The fact proves that a Heavenly Immortal, when sealed, can be desecrated by a mere mortal,” he said.
Looking at the beauty in his arms, delicate as a flower, with heavenly fragrance and drenched in sweet perspiration, Han Li laughed triumphantly.
Indeed, he had let down his guard, and so had she.
“Hmm~ Hmm~”
Feng Mian lay in Han Li’s arms, letting out a couple of hums without saying a word, her perfect, lovely face flushed a deep shade of red.
Thinking back on her own forward behavior earlier, Feng Mian felt immensely ashamed.
Her heart might have been resistant, so why had her body been so honest?
Feeling Han Li’s warmth, Feng Mian was silent for a long while before finally exhaling deeply, raising her head to look at Han Li and said coldly,
“You must take responsibility for me.”
Being quite a traditional member of the Linghuang Clan, now that she had become intimate with Han Li, losing her virginity to him, she viewed Han Li as her man, whether she was willing or not.
That was right, it certainly wasn’t because of Han Li’s length, which could reach her depths.
She was the most outstanding prodigy of her generation from the Linghuang Clan, interested solely in Han Li’s potential.
After all, he was enigmatic and even possessed a Golden Immortal weapon.
A look of surprise flashed across Han Li’s face, as he hadn’t expected Feng Mian to say such a thing.
The surprise quickly faded, replaced by a deep expression of joy.
A woman’s portal indeed is the window to her soul.
Immediately, Han Li responded, “Rest assured, I will definitely take responsibility.”
“From now on, you are my Dao companion, Han Li, and you will not lack any of the treatments a Dao companion deserves.”
“I will take care of your breakthrough to the True Immortal Realm.
You can keep using that orange fishing rod, and I will provide for your cultivation resources…”
Han Li spoke at length, finally producing the single True Dao Pill he had, and placed it in Feng Mian’s soft, delicate palm.
Since Feng Mian had been so cooperative and understanding, Han Li naturally wouldn’t think of demoting her to a mere concubine.
Having a docile and gentle Heavenly Immortal Dao companion was certainly a wonderful thing.
Listening to Han Li’s affectionate words and looking at the Immortal Pill in her hand, Feng Mian fell silent.
This bastard was truly unfathomable.
Even though he was not even a Heavenly Immortal, he had managed to produce a True Dao Pill, an incredible pill that could help a Heavenly Immortal deepen their understanding of the Dao and break through to the True Immortal Realm.
When she told Han Li to take responsibility, she hadn’t had any of these in mind, yet Han Li had given her so much, offering all kinds of benefits that dazzled her, even providing her with the True Dao Pill directly.
“If you had said all this earlier, I might have agreed on the spot,” Feng Mian thought to herself.
Han Li had given far too much, having previously supplied her with trillions upon trillions of cultivation resources, and now all of this, overwhelming Feng Mian completely.

You have to take responsibility for me!_1 “Did you really fish up a Golden Immortal artifact?”
