Feng Mian’s emotions were complicated.
She herself had been fished up by Han Li from the Thousand Realm Ocean, and now she had witnessed him fishing up a Golden Immortal artifact, failing to keep her expression in check.
...
“Absolutely genuine.”
Han Li was in high spirits, his gaze toward Feng Mian growing even hotter.
Having fished up this Golden Immortal artifact, from now on the Endless Yuankun Domain would bear the name Han, and he, Patriarch Han, could strut around confidently, fearing no foes.
Even if all the forces within the Yuankun Domain banded together, Han Li would remain undaunted, ready to sweep all his enemies into his net.
At that point, the list of Heavenly Immortals in the Yuankun Domain would truly become his selection roster for consorts.
All the Heaven Imperial Realm empresses within the Yuankun Domain, including Empress Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu, would all fall into his hands.
“So, do you want to have a go?” Han Li continued to tempt her.
At these words, Feng Mian was genuinely tempted.
Her beautiful eyes flashing with myriad colors, she scanned back and forth between Han Li and the orange fishing rod, biting her phoenix lips in hesitation, she said, “Maybe not.”
Although she was curious about what she could fish up from this sea region, if it meant exchanging her body, Feng Mian was unwilling.
Her gaze swept over the round cauldron, and suddenly, a bold thought emerged in Feng Mian’s mind.
Could she snatch the Golden Immortal artifact for herself?
This round cauldron-shaped Golden Immortal artifact had just been fished up by Han Li from the Thousand Realm Ocean, undoubtedly unclaimed.
Since Han Li hadn’t taken control of it, she might have a chance.
If she could snatch this Golden Immortal artifact, Han Li’s two True Immortal Swords would be nothing to fear, and she would easily suppress them.
Once that happened, this Golden Immortal artifact, Han Li’s two True Immortal Swords, and even those eight fishing rods, would all fall into her hands.
Compared to a Golden Immortal artifact, Feng Mian was even more eager to acquire those eight fishing rods, which could grant her treasures a hundred, a thousand, even ten thousand times more powerful than the Golden Immortal artifact.
Feng Mian’s heart pounded fiercely, and she quickly lowered her head, avoiding Han Li’s gaze to prevent him from discovering her intentions.
A glimmer of insight flashed in Han Li’s eyes; he had noticed Feng Mian’s expressions as she eyed the tripod with three legs and two handles, immediately guessing her intent.
Without changing his expression, Han Li said, “Are you sure you don’t want to reconsider?”
“Uh…
it’s not completely out of the question.”
“If you let me fish with either the green or the blue rod, and promise that whatever I fish up will belong to me…”
Feng Mian raised her head, feigning indecision, and subtly inched toward the round cauldron.
Although she was only about ten meters away from the cauldron, which was very close for someone as powerful as a Heavenly Immortal like her, Feng Mian still lacked confidence.
Han Li was closer to it than she was, with a True Immortal Sword at his waist and another pole-like True Immortal Weapon not far away, putting substantial pressure on Feng Mian.
Acting as if he hadn’t noticed her subtle movements, Han Li secretly unsealed the cauldron before suggesting, “Feng Mian, to achieve more, you must also risk more, you know.”
With a meaningful look on his face, Han Li thought to himself that originally he had intended to exploit only one vulnerability, but now he wanted to exploit three.
As a conscientious developer in the wasteland of conscience, the Patriarch only wished to provide a better life for his service targets.
Feng Mian hesitated for a moment, a sense of alarm rising in her heart.
Had Han Li detected something?
Forcing a calm smile, Feng Mian continued to approach the cauldron nonchalantly, continuing, “I understand the principle, as long as you can do it, I might also allow you a peek underneath.”
“Oh?
How deep is your ‘underneath’?”
“Unfathomably deep.”
“Tsk, I don’t believe that unless I get to gauge the depth myself.”
“Not now.”
“Then when is the right time?”
“Of course, it’s…”
Feng Mian uttered some words that embarrassed even herself, designed to capture Han Li’s attention.
Desperate for the Golden Immortal artifact to change her fate and escape her predicament, she risked it all, saying things that would have mortified her previously.
Fortunately, she succeeded.
Without realizing it, she got close to the cauldron while Han Li was still oblivious, entranced by her beauty.
Indeed, mother was born with natural beauty that nobody could resist.
Feng Mian quietly congratulated herself in her heart, deftly handling Han Li with a small smile curling on her lips before she suddenly made her move.
Her slender jade hand reached out for the Golden Immortal artifact just within reach, shining brightly, hoping to snatch away the cauldron in one fell swoop.
Simultaneously, a Phoenix Feather appeared above her head, radiating with majestic splendor and bursting forth Infinite Immortal Light, protecting her and preventing Han Li’s two True Immortal Weapons from striking her down.
Feng Mian, as a late-stage Heavenly Immortal, naturally possessed a True Immortal Weapon, which she hadn’t used previously in order to wait for the right moment.
When Han Li struck at her with his True Immortal Sword earlier, Feng Mian, with certain reservations, had hesitated, allowing Han Li to slice her in two without using her True Immortal Weapon.
The subsequent turn of events was also within her control.
After showing weakness, this arrogant and conceited Han Li hadn’t sealed her again, thinking he had her completely under his thumb.
Boom!
Just as Feng Mian’s hand was about to touch the Golden Immortal artifact, the round cauldron suddenly erupted with an immensely powerful aura, shattering the Immortal Light cascading from the Phoenix Feather, blasting both the feather and Feng Mian away.
With a heavy thud, Feng Mian crashed onto the ground, the Phoenix Feather falling awkwardly beside her.
She was taken aback and, disregarding her injuries, she stared dead at the cauldron, her face full of shock.
Wasn’t the cauldron supposed to be sealed?
How then could it unleash the power of a Golden Immortal?

Once she subdued Han Li, gripping his life in her hands, even if Han Li had two True Immortal weapons and one Golden Immortal weapon, he would have to obediently listen to her, not the other way around.
Quietly observing Feng Mian, just when she couldn’t bear it and was about to take action, Han Li stepped forward once more.
A glint of joy flashed in Feng Mian’s eyes, but in the next instant, her expression froze.
She saw Han Li’s right hand move in front of him, in his palm was a three-legged, two-eared cauldron.
The cauldron emitted a strand of immortal light, instantly forming a large net that enveloped Feng Mian.
Before she could even react, she found her cultivation sealed again, and the Phoenix Feather she had been in constant communication with was sealed as well.
“Surprised?
Unexpected?”
After sealing Feng Mian again, Han Li’s face revealed a look of satisfaction, and he stepped forward confidently.
“You…
you…
don’t come closer.
I’m really going to scream…”
With her cultivation sealed and unable to use her trump card, watching Han Li approach and overshadow her, Feng Mian was truly panicking.
She seemed to envision the scene where Han Li would inject her with Treatment Liquid.
“Go on, scream.
Do it quickly.
Let the old ancestor hear how you scream.”

Han Li walked towards Feng Mian with his hands behind his back, a faint smile on his face as he completed the sentence Feng Mian had left unfinished.
...
“You’re setting me up?”
Feng Mian instantly realized that Han Li had seen through her little ruse.
Han Li had turned the tables on her, and now she was truly injured, with her trump card exposed.
Turning the tables now would be extremely difficult.
When on earth did this bastard gain control of this Golden Immortal’s weapon?
“Finding out now?
Too late, oh.”
Han Li continued to approach, his smile growing wider as he looked at Feng Mian as if she were prey.
He had suspected Feng Mian had a True Immortal’s weapon all along, but she had never revealed it, likely harboring grand schemes.
Thus, Han Li decided to let the plan unfold, and indeed, he managed to probe the truth.
“Don’t come any closer.”
The voice of Feng Mian was both pure and sultry, enticing to the core, and in this moment, it made Han Li’s anger burn even hotter.
He did not slow down, but instead moved faster.
Feng Mian’s face paled as she watched Han Li getting closer, listening to his measured footsteps.
With one hand in front, she continuously moved backward.
Han Li exerted enormous pressure on her.
Under such circumstances, she truly feared Han Li would force himself upon her, and she was not prepared for it yet.
“You scream, go on.”
“There’s no one here.
Even if you scream until~ your throat is raw, no one will come to save you.”
“Oh right, don’t bother screaming.
Save your throat for me to pierce~ through it.”
Han Li’s face showed a wicked smile as he already considered Feng Mian as his prey, ready to put on a drama with her.
If Feng Mian was going to play dirty and not follow the rules, she couldn’t blame him for doing the same.
He had initially planned to take a year to conquer Feng Mian, but now it seemed he could skip the process and proceed directly to the last step.
If Feng Mian harbored any messy thoughts afterward, Han Li would not mind having an additional Heavenly Immortal female slave to slowly subdue.
It would certainly be quite a feat.
Of course, he would continue to elevate Feng Mian’s status, watching her performance, just like Yuan Youwei.
After all, Feng Mian was a Heavenly Immortal.
Given Han Li’s current talents and physique, coupling with Feng Mian could easily result in offspring with Immortal Bodies and divine appearances.
Such offspring were destined to be peerless geniuses, who, if they rose smoothly in the future, would gain fame and power, shocking the lands and becoming unspeakably powerful.
Han Li certainly didn’t want his family to produce a dog-blood drama like “Han YongX requests the old ancestor to die.”
Although he could easily subdue any descendant, doing so would be too embarrassing.
Where would he, Old Ancestor Han, put his face?
“Shameless!”
“Low!”
“Bastard!”
Feng Mian unleashed a three-hit combo.
She wanted to curse even harsher words, but couldn’t find the vocabulary.
“Even your cursing is cute and tempting.
I like you more and more, Feng Mian,” Han Li said calmly, never stopping his approach, now only a few steps from Feng Mian.
“If you dare to mess around, I will definitely kill you.”
Thinking of being pierced through her throat and into the wilderness, Feng Mian shuddered and warned coldly.
Han Li suddenly paused, observed Feng Mian for a few moments, and smiled, “You don’t need to worry.
Doing this sort of thing is like performing surgery.
I can first inject you with an oversized syringe, to make you numb.
That way, you won’t feel pain, you won’t even notice a severe blood loss, and you’ll feel light and ecstatic.”
“Oh, you don’t know what surgery is?
No matter, you’ll find out soon enough.”
Han Li motioned with the hand he had kept behind him, and the round cauldron quietly fell into his grasp, leaving only an illusion in its place.
Listening to Han Li’s nonsense, Feng Mian’s pretty face turned deathly pale, her heart squeezed tight with urgency, silently urging Han Li to proceed further, faster, come closer.
That way, she could catch Han Li off guard, reverse their roles, and regain control.
Feng Mian still had a powerful trump card up her sleeve; all of this was an act she was putting on.
Otherwise, she wouldn’t have let Han Li get close; she would have flown away long ago.
As long as she subdued Han Li and got hold of his life, even if Han Li had two True Immortal weapons and one Golden Immortal weapon, he would have to obediently listen to her, not the other way around.
After quietly observing Feng Mian for a few moments, just as Feng Mian could no longer bear it and was about to make a move, Han Li took another step forward.
A glint of joy flickered in Feng Mian’s eyes, but in the next instant, her expression froze.
She saw Han Li’s right hand move in front, holding a round cauldron with three legs and two handles.
The cauldron radiated a strand of Immortal light that instantly turned into a large net, enveloping Feng Mian.
Before she could resist, she found her cultivation sealed once more, and the Phoenix Feather, which she was always in touch with, was sealed as well.
“Surprised?
Or not?”
After sealing Feng Mian again, Han Li revealed a satisfied smile and took big steps forward.
“You…
you…
don’t come any closer, I really will scream…”
With her cultivation sealed and unable to use her trump card, Feng Mian truly panicked as Han Li’s figure loomed over her.
She seemed to envision herself being injected with the Treatment Liquid by Han Li.
“Go on, scream.
I want to hear how you’d scream,” Han Li urged.

chapters.title: Chapter 690
chapters.content:
Chapter 690: Chapter 263: Don’t come over!
Please, ancestor, go to die!
You have to take responsibility for me!_3 Chapter 690: Chapter 263: Don’t come over!
Please, ancestor, go to die!
You have to take responsibility for me!_3 Han Li walked up to Feng Mian, looming over, and looked down at Feng Mian, who was on the ground.
Taking in the beautiful scene before him, he immediately felt an intense urge to quench his fiery passion.
So, Han Li made his move.
...
Person, from, now, on, cold, people, mortals, long, short…
Heaven as the cover, earth as the bed, the vast island became their battlefield.
Han Li felt that liking someone wasn’t just about taking her to bed.
The sofa, living room, kitchen, balcony, corner, study, there were all suitable places for their passions.
Although Thousand Realm Island had nothing, Han Li’s System Space was well-prepared, stocked with various tools, and they performed an all-out battle on Thousand Realm Island.
As the intense battle drew to a close, Han Li felt somewhat exhausted.
Feng Mian truly was a succubus.
With cultivation higher than his and a body stronger than his, coupled with a powerful physique, Feng Mian’s stamina and strength outmatched Han Li’s by far.
Eventually, he took the initiative to end this vigorous battle.
“It proves that even after a Heavenly Immortal is sealed, mortals can still break through their defenses,” he said.
Looking at the exquisite beauty in his arms, her natural grace shining even through the sweat of exertion, Han Li smiled proudly.
That’s right, he broke through her defenses, and she broke through too.
“Hmm~ Hmmm~”
Feng Mian lay in Han Li’s arms, humming twice, saying nothing, her perfect face flushed with a rosy hue.
Thinking about how proactive she had been earlier, Feng Mian felt utterly embarrassed.
She wanted to refuse in her heart, so why did her body have to be so honest?
Feeling Han Li’s body heat, Feng Mian stayed silent for a long while, then finally took a deep breath, looked up at Han Li, and said coldly,
“You have to take responsibility for me.”
She was a rather traditional member of the Linghuang Clan; now that she had been intimate with Han Li, whether willingly or not, Han Li was her man.
Yes, that’s right, it’s certainly not because Han Li was so capable and profound that she was interested.
She was the most outstanding prodigy of her generation in the Linghuang Clan, interested only in Han Li’s potential, for he was enigmatic and also possessed a Golden Immortal weapon.
A look of surprise flashed across Han Li’s face, not expecting Feng Mian to say such a thing.
The surprise quickly faded, replaced by an expression of deep joy.
The portal of a woman indeed was the window to her soul.
Immediately, Han Li said, “Don’t worry, I will definitely take responsibility.”
“From now on, you are my Dao companion, Han Li, and you will not lack any benefits that a Dao companion should have.”
“Leave the breakthrough to True Immortal Realm to me, and keep using that orange fishing rod.
I will supply all your cultivation resources…”
Han Li went on and on, eventually taking out his only True Dao Pill and placing it into Feng Mian’s delicate and smooth hands.
Seeing how cooperative and understanding Feng Mian was, Han Li naturally no longer considered demoting her to a female slave.
Having an obedient and gentle Heavenly Immortal Dao companion was a marvelous thing indeed.
Listening to Han Li’s heartfelt declarations of love, looking at the Immortal Pill in her hand, Feng Mian fell into silence.
This bastard really was unfathomable.
He wasn’t even a Heavenly Immortal himself, yet he could produce a True Dao Pill, an against-heaven medicinal pill that could help a Heavenly Immortal deepen their understanding and control of the Dao, breaking through to the True Immortal Realm.
When she asked Han Li to take responsibility, she hadn’t imagined all this; she hadn’t expected Han Li to give her so much, with a dizzying array of benefits and even a True Dao Pill given directly to her.
“If you had said this earlier, I might have agreed right away,” Feng Mian silently grumbled to herself.
Han Li had given too much, billions upon billions of cultivation resources, and now even more, enough to completely overwhelm Feng Mian.

chapters.title: Chapter 691
chapters.content:
Chapter 691: Chapter 264: Husband, Let’s Go Fishing~ Moved Feng Mian, Mobius Ring?
Han Li and the Artifact Spirit of the Round Cauldron_1 Chapter 691: Chapter 264: Husband, Let’s Go Fishing~ Moved Feng Mian, Mobius Ring?
Han Li and the Artifact Spirit of the Round Cauldron_1 “Alright, Mian’er, you should keep the Immortal Pills first.”
Gazing at the soft and warm jade in his arms, Han Li’s face was full of tenderness.
“Yes, hus…
husband~”
Feng Mian lightly bit her rosy lips, and it took a few tries before she finally spoke out, her beautiful face blushing.
After speaking, she buried her head into Han Li’s chest.
(Insert a picture I made, it will show up once approved.)
She didn’t really want to call him that, as she had just met Han Li not long ago, but the two had already reached a level of mutual understanding regarding each other’s depth and thickness.
...
Plus, with Han Li’s insistence, Feng Mian reluctantly agreed.
Upon hearing that pure yet lustful seductive voice, Han Li couldn’t hold back and went for a second round on the spot.
Afterwards, Feng Mian couldn’t help but give Han Li a sidelong glance, casting doubt on Han Li’s strength.
Han Li claimed he was only a Quasi Emperor, but with this fighting power, he was stronger than many of the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, and even she, a Heavenly Immortal, had to use all her strength to suppress him.
“Now that we’re done, shouldn’t we do the proper business?”
Feng Mian wriggled free from Han Li’s embrace and looked towards the large rock, her mind still on those fishing rods.
Although Han Li had only promised her the use of that orange fishing rod and forbade using the others, Feng Mian was still very curious and asked if the fishing rods to the left were of Immortal King Rank or Immortal Emperor Rank.
Han Li gave no answer, just smiled without a word, which irritated Feng Mian to the point of punching his chest with her little fists.
This bastard had just slept with her and now he was ignoring her.
“Weren’t we just doing the proper business?” Han Li said with a look of total honesty on his face.
For him, doing that was the proper business.
After all, how could he propagate his lineage and expand his family if he didn’t do it?
Only if he could, would he have many blessings and numerous descendants.
“Pfft~”
Feng Mian spit at him and chose not to argue with him on this matter.
Seeing that Han Li was still acting languid, Feng Mian bit her silver teeth and had no choice but to pull out her trump card, “Husband~ let’s go fishing, please~ I beg you~”
Han Li didn’t expect Feng Mian to resort to this tactic, and although he had heard it countless times before, hearing Feng Mian, a Heavenly Immortal, act sweetly still made his bones soften.
“We’ll go now.”
Without hesitation, Han Li immediately agreed to Feng Mian’s request.
Han Li waved his hand to put away the tools of Dao exchange and, holding Feng Mian’s soft hand, he led her to the edge of the large rock.
“Mian’er, go ahead and fish.”
Han Li looked towards the orange fishing rod, signaling for Feng Mian to fulfill her dream of becoming a fisherman.
The reason he hadn’t used the orange True Immortal Rank fishing rod to fish before was that he wanted to test whether there was still a beginner’s protection period.
Using the yellow Golden Immortal Rank fishing rod for the test was most appropriate.
Now that someone else was going to fish, Han Li wasn’t sure if the beginner’s protection period still existed; was it shared?
Regardless, he had already obtained what he wanted from this multi-realm fishing trip, even completing the task with a surplus.
A Heavenly Immortal Rank partner and a Golden Immortal Rank weaponâ€”with these two, what need did he have for a bicycle?
Feng Mian walked toward the rock and, reaching the front of it, she beheld the eight rods of nine different colors.
She extended her slender and fair hand toward the orange rod.
Yet she did not grasp it, stopping about an inch away, and then she looked back at Han Li, her curiosity prompting her to ask, “Hus…
husband, do you really trust me that much?
Aren’t you afraid I’ll use the other rods?”
These rods were clearly extremely precious, supreme treasures.
Could Han Li truly trust her with them?
After all, they had only known each other for less than a day.
Although they had become intimate, this connection was not as solid as the eight fishing rods.
If she were to use any other rod and potentially fish out treasures of Immortal Monarch level, Immortal King level, or even higher, and managed to control them, how could Han Li turn the situation around?
Although she was a rather traditional spiritual phoenix, she wouldn’t be utterly committed to Han Li just because they had slept together twice.
Burdened with all sorts of doubts, Feng Mian decided to simply voice her concerns.
Facing Feng Mian’s questions, Han Li’s face bore an indulgent smile as he tenderly said, “Silly girl, we are that kind of couple now.
You are my Dao companion.
Why distinguish between yours and mine?”
“My things are yours.
If you want to use any other rod to fish, just pick it up.
Everything you fish up is yours,” Han Li said earnestly.
“I will never covet even a bit of it because you, my dear, are the woman I love.”
Though he said this, Han Li knew that Feng Mian couldn’t possibly move any of the other rods.
The rods had fixed rules on them and one could not fish with them without paying the corresponding price.
Even he could not use them without trying, although he had never tried it.
The orange rod that Feng Mian was about to take had been unlocked by him in advance using ten years’ worth of his cultivation, so she could confidently pick it up and fish.
If Feng Mian tried to take any other rod, Han Li wouldn’t stop her.
As long as she could pick it up, Han Li would never go back on his word.
Let Feng Mian test it for him; if she could lift rods of any other color, then Han Li wouldn’t need to keep consuming his cultivation.
He could just take action directly.
Moved by Han Li’s affectionate words, Feng Mian’s eyes began to mist, “Husband~”
She secretly repented for her previous thoughts.
Han Li was so good to her, providing her with countless resources for cultivation, even giving her the True Dao Pill for breaking through to the True Immortal Realm.
Now he was willing to let her use all the fishing rods…
Feng Mian made a silent vow to herself that from now on, she would sincerely be with Han Li, spend the rest of her life with him, advance together and climb to the pinnacle of the Dao.
Han Li was her only Dao companion, and he had given her all the good things.
What more could she ask for?

chapters.title: Chapter 692
chapters.content:
Chapter 692: Chapter 264: Husband, Shall We Go Fishing?
Touched Feng Mian, Mobius Ring?
Han Li and the Round Cauldron Artifact Spirit_2 Chapter 692: Chapter 264: Husband, Shall We Go Fishing?
Touched Feng Mian, Mobius Ring?
Han Li and the Round Cauldron Artifact Spirit_2 “`
As for the original world, it’s fine not to go back.
Taking a deep breath, Feng Mian picked up the orange fishing rod within reach, no longer harboring any greed for other grades of rods in her heart.
Han Li treated her with sincerity, and she would not be ungrateful.
...
She would surely return the favor abundantly.
Seeing this, Han Li nodded secretly, having achieved his goal, he said, “Start now, my Meng’er.
You will definitely fish up a good treasure.”
Han Li didn’t know that part of the reason why Feng Mian was so moved was that she thought Han Li was her only dao companion, otherwise, he would have a headache.
“Mhm~”
Feng Mian squeezed her little pink fist with her left hand, shook the orange fishing rod with her right hand, and saw the rod automatically cast the line towards the sea in the northeast direction.
In the end, the fishhook, along with the bait, landed three hundred miles away in the sea and plunged down.
It’s worth mentioning that the bait on the orange fishing rod was also extraordinary, being a piece of a True Dragon’s tail, which belonged to a True Immortal level True Dragon.
“I must fish up a treasure!”
Feng Mian, holding the orange fishing rod tightly in her right hand, her red lips slightly parted, muttering to herself.
Earlier, Han Li had already told her the fishing rules, and Feng Mian easily understood them thoroughly.
She was just inevitably nervous; this was her first time “fishing.”
The sea she was fishing was none other than the Thousand Realm Ocean, connecting the myriad worlds and the timeless space.
With this orange fishing rod, she could fish up any True Immortal Rank treasure.
“Meng’er, don’t be nervous, it’s just a True Immortal Rank treasure.
Relax,” Han Li said.
Han Li walked over to Feng Mian’s side, his large hand wrapping around her slender waist, soft and easy to grasp, feeling extremely pleasant.
Feng Mian gave him a white glance.
Is this how you comfort someone?
She hadn’t failed to notice earlier that when Han Li was fishing with the yellow rod, he was much more nervous than her, almost wishing he could run to the sea where the hook was located to check on it.
Moreover, she only had one True Immortal weapon and one True Immortal Rank treasure.
Her foundation was not deep, and she eagerly anticipated what the orange fishing rod could fish up.
If she could fish up one of the top True Immortal Rank treasures, it might possess power comparable to that of a Golden Immortal weapon.
According to Han Li’s promise to her, no matter what treasure she fished up, it would belong to her, and he would not take it from her.
Naturally, Feng Mian believed Han Li’s words, especially since he had previously allowed her to freely use all the rods without any concerns, which moved her tremendously.
“Humph~”
Feng Mian huffed softly, not bothering to answer him, her beautiful eyes staring intently at the sea area.
Luckily, this scoundrel Han Li had unlocked some of her cultivation for her.
Otherwise, with her vision, she wouldn’t have been able to see that far.
Han Li shook his head with a smile, staying by Feng Mian’s side for a while, one of his hands still wrapped around her slender waist.
His other hand however, held out in front of him, palm up, was a round cauldron with three legs and two ears.
Han Li inspected the cauldron for a moment, Divine Sense pouring into it, finding that within was a vast and boundless Chaos World.
This feared Chaos World was fundamentally different from the world inside the Primordial Chaos Cauldron.
The Primordial Chaos Cauldron was merely a Heavenly Immortal weapon; its inner world was illusory and unstable, not truly forged.
Divine Sense took form within the Chaos World, turning into the likeness of Han Li, clad in resplendent armor, striding towards the center of the Chaos World with his hands behind his back.
In the center of the Chaos World was a Chaos River, coiling into a circular shape, endless and ever-flowing.
Time and space circled here, like a Mobius Ring.
The Chaos River surged tirelessly, roaring and tumultuous.
At times the water formed tides that covered both banks, causing countless great stars to be born and perish on the riverbanks.
At this moment, in the center of the circular Chaos River, there was a throne of stars piled up from endless large stars.
Seated upon it was a divinely beautiful, elegant and tall woman with a curvy figure.
She had a pair of long, white, straight, and round legs.
The stunning beauty rested her chin on one hand, her white legs crisscrossed and extending down over the stars, while her other jade hand stretched out slender and tender fingers, constantly flicking out trails of Immortal Tao Energy.
Every flicker of Immortal Tao Energy that struck the Chaos River caused huge waves of chaos, with the waves emerging, universes opened, and as the waves fell, universes were destroyed.
Han Li came over, stood still to watch for a while, and gained some insight.
This circular Chaos River was the cauldron’s energy source, accumulating endless energy.
This allowed the Golden Immortal weapon to unleash formidable power.
A mere flicker of its power could annihilate a major universe, destroying countless Star Domains.
“`
Yet those cosmos that were born and perished among the surging waves were not truly real, or to be more precise, they were only partially real.
The Artifact Spirit of the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, that stunningly beautiful woman, could only achieve this much.
Unless the Primordial Chaos Cauldron evolved into an Immortal Monarch Soldier, it might be possible to go a step further, transforming all the born and perishing universes from illusion into reality, thereby possessing even more terrifying might.
“Why don’t you come out?”
Han Li took a step forward, crossed the Chaos River, and arrived in front of the throne studded with stars, gazing directly at the stunning beauty leaning gracefully against the throne.
He had called to this Golden Immortal Soldier’s Artifact Spirit before, but she had not appeared; nevertheless, she had let him command her, allowing the Golden Immortal Soldier to unleash the corresponding might.
Otherwise, with Han Li’s current level of cultivation, he naturally wouldn’t be able to activate a Golden Immortal Soldier; he couldn’t even summon a sliver of its might with his mana.
Now, when he let the True Immortal Soldiers and Golden Immortal Soldiers fight, it was the Artifact Spirits themselves that activated their powers, consuming the corresponding energy.
Although he couldn’t control them as freely as he would like, this compensated for his lack of mana.
All he needed was the support of sufficient Immortal Tao Energy.
Previously, with four True Immortal Soldiers and a Humanity Dao Sword comparable to True Immortal Soldiers, Han Li did not dare act recklessly or claim himself as the invincible in the Yuankun Domain.
The reason was his insufficient cultivation level.
Although he had Immortal Tao Energy to supply the True Immortal Soldiers for battle, the other nine Supremes of the Yuankun Domain could do the same; united, they had nine True Immortal Soldiers at their disposal, which he could not contend against at the time.
After all, once all his True Immortal Soldiers were tied up in battle, his Heavenly Immortal Soldiers wouldn’t be able to withstand the Heavenly Immortal Soldiers of the nine mighty powers.
Even if they did withstand it, he alone couldn’t fend off the nine Supremes.
Han Li always believed that weapons were important, but one’s own level of cultivation and strength were even more crucial; without the support of weapons, it would all come down to true ability.
However, for now, his cultivation was insufficient, and he still needed to rely on weapons to shelter him from the storm.
Luckily, he had fished a Golden Immortal Soldier from the Thousand Realm Ocean, which was enough to suppress the Yuankun Domain.
With the domain under his control, he could cultivate in peace, raising his level of cultivation as quickly as possible and stepping into the third stage of the cultivation path.
In some time, Han Li planned to enter the Xuxian Realm again, where his strength could help him uncover more information.
Relying only on a few outstanding individuals was not enough; they were not exceptional in the Xuxian Realm either.
Within the Xuxian Realm, where weapons could not be used, battles tested one’s own intrinsic strength, influenced by a multitude of factors such as cultivation level, Cultivation Techniques, martial skills, Secret Techniques, Divine Sense, and so forth.
A myriad of thoughts flashed through his mind in an instant as Han Li looked expressionlessly at the beautiful woman before him.
Although he now possessed a Golden Immortal Soldier, its Artifact Spirit seemed to be quite disobedient.
Han Li could see that this beautiful woman seemed to have some grievances against him, and he could roughly guess the reason.
“I don’t want to go out,” said the beautiful woman indifferently.
As Lu Yao’s eyes flickered with annoyance at the handsome man in front of her, she thought to herself how outrageous it was for him to have followed her inside.
If she had known earlier, she wouldn’t have consumed that chunk of Dao rules, which led to her falling into this man’s hands, her body being forced to accept his branding, and consequently being controlled by someone else.
Since being fished out from the ocean, Lu Yao had observed everything from above the sea surface, seeing Han Li and Feng Mian.
However, she had not the slightest desire to go out.
After all, she was the Artifact Spirit of a Golden Immortal Soldier who had enjoyed unbridled freedom for dozens of epochs.
She desired freedom and sought the Dao, with no interest in fighting for others.
Besides, Han Li was just a little Quasi Emperorâ€”what right did he have to be her master?
But now that her body had been branded, under Han Li’s control, there was nothing Lu Yao could do to stop the Primordial Chaos Cauldron from unleashing its power when Han Li desired; she could only assist him.
Lu Yao sighed internally.
If given the chance to do it all over again, she suspected she would still be unable to resist; the egg-shaped Dao rules were too tempting, capable of helping her advance even further.
Han Li’s brow furrowed slightly as he watched the beautiful, emotional woman before him without pressing her further.
After pondering for a moment, he asked, “What is the name of this Primordial Chaos Cauldron, and what are its effects?”
Even a Heavenly Immortal like Feng Mian had her own temperament, let alone the Artifact Spirit of this Golden Immortal Soldier.
If it weren’t for the fact that the Primordial Chaos Cauldron had automatically recognized him as its master and branded itself to him after being fished up, this beautiful woman might have wanted to activate the Primordial Chaos Cauldron to kill himâ€”a consequence of his being merely a Quasi Emperor.
Han Li was well aware of this and didn’t really care.
No matter how reluctant the beautiful woman was, the deed was done, and she had no say in the matter anymore.
However, Han Li didn’t plan to force her either.
Since he was currently unable to activate the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, he needed to maintain a good relationship with the beautiful Artifact Spirit to persuade her to activate it.
