chapters.title: Chapter 693
chapters.content:
Chapter 693: Chapter 265: The Golden Immortal Rank Soldiers and the Mixed Dao Cauldron!
The Surprised Feng Mian, True Immortal Rank Treasure: Fire Phoenix Fish!
Han Li’s Decision_1 Chapter 693: Chapter 265: The Golden Immortal Rank Soldiers and the Mixed Dao Cauldron!
The Surprised Feng Mian, True Immortal Rank Treasure: Fire Phoenix Fish!
Han Li’s Decision_1 “Chaos Cauldron.”
“As for the functions, it possesses the capabilities of slaughter, suppression, and refinement.”
The stunning beauty was sparing with her words, unwilling to say one more than necessary.
Han Li looked deep into her eyes and said in a deep voice, “I don’t care what you’re thinking, just don’t hold me back.”
Having said that, Han Li’s Divine Sense incarnation withdrew from the Chaos World, having achieved his objective for entering.
Although the Artifact Spirit of the Chaos Cauldron was exceptionally beautiful, her allure was not that great to him; the only thing that attracted Han Li was her identity, a Golden Immortal Artifact Spirit.
...
But Han Li knew to keep a sense of proportion, there was plenty of time in the future to settle scores with this stunning beauty.
Doing her now was pointless, aside from a momentary pleasure, and she couldn’t bear him children anyway, there was no need to offend her.
With the Chaos Cauldron, a Golden Immortal weapon, Chengsheng Mountain could from now on rest easy and be unrivaled in the Yuankun Domain.
He could also start working on his own plans and then begin preparations for moving out of the Yuankun Domain.
As for unraveling the mystery of the great calamity in the Yuankun Domain, finding out the mastermind behind Xuanshen Sword Mountain, or slaying that hidden manipulator, Han Li had no interest.
It was obvious at a glance that the other party was a major antagonist, with unfathomably deep cultivation; at the very least, a starting point of an Immortal King.
Han Li had no interest in provoking them.
The best strategy was to avoid them, to find a place in the Taichu Realm and continue to grow in power discreetly.
Within the Chaos World, atop the Throne of Stars.
“Hmph~”
Watching Han Li disappear, Lu Yao let out a cold snort; there was a hint of malice in Han Li’s gaze that, although very well concealed, she still felt.
All she could say was that her new master was worse than a beast, not even sparing an Artifact Spirit.
Previously, she had witnessed two interesting scenes, and Han Li’s passionate encounters with Feng Mian were engraved in her field of vision.
How Han Li lured Feng Mian and deceitfully got his way, Lu Yao saw it all clearly.
“I hope you know your place, otherwise…
hmph hmph~”
Lu Yao snorted softly a few times, a tone of discontent mixed with a sense of smugness.
The new master, although no better than a beast, still had some restraint and did not take advantage of her relying on his status.
Otherwise, Lu Yao would not be so accommodating.
Although she could not act against Han Li, hiding herself in this Chaos World was easy.
Furthermore, without her effort, Han Li would not be able to harness the power of the Chaos Cauldron.
After all, Han Li was just a Quasi Emperor, and even if his mana was strong, comparable to a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, it was still nothing compared to a Golden Immortal weapon.
Upon Thousand Realm Island,
Han Li withdrew his Divine Sense, casually put away the Chaos Cauldron, and continued to embrace his Heavenly Immortal partner at her waist, watching her fish.
His entry into the Chaos Cauldron did not take much time; all in all, it was less than half a quarter of an hour, and Feng Mian had not yet had any response from her fishing.
“Husband, it’s not that I won’t catch anything, right?”
Feng Mian suddenly asked, her tone very anxious.
It was her first time fishing, how could she fail to catch a treasure?
Moreover, this was her only chance; if she couldn’t catch a treasure, she would be unwilling to accept it.
Although Han Li said she could also use the other fishing rods, Feng Mian knew to keep a sense of proportion.
Those rods were clearly of higher grade, and with Han Li reluctant to use them, she naturally would not.
“Mian’er, don’t worry, fishing includes a beginner’s protection period, specifically to protect beginners like you.
You’ll definitely catch something,” Han Li said reassuringly.
In truth, Han Li wasn’t certain whether there actually was any beginner’s protection period for fishing in Thousand Realm, or if it had just been his good luck.
Moreover, whether the beginner’s protection was limited to the first two rods, more, or just the first roundâ€”Han Li had no idea.
He had inquired of the System, but it hadn’t provided an answer.
“Really?” Feng Mian looked up at Han Li, hope flickering in her eyes.
She hadn’t heard of any beginner’s protection period for fishing, nor was she concerned with it, much less experienced in fishing.
It was just that the fishing rod would fish automatically, and one only needed to choose a direction and distance.
“Of course it’s true,” Han Li said with affirmation.
No sooner had he spoken than he leaned on Feng Mian’s shoulder and blew into her delicate ear; inexperienced in such matters, her ears promptly flushed pink.
“Husband, stop it~ Let me finish fishing first; after that, you can do whatever you want,” Feng Mian shivered at the sensation like electric lightning inside her body, nearly losing her balance, and quickly resorted to acting coy.
She discovered that this tactic was very effective on Han Li.
As expected, Han Li surrendered as soon as Feng Mian acted spoiled and stopped teasing her.
Feng Mian breathed a sigh of relief; if Han Li continued, they would likely put on quite the show there and then, and how could she continue fishing?
As time ticked by, another good while passed.
Han Li was actually quite patient, cradling a peerless Heavenly Immortal in his arms, his hands boldly scaling peaks without haste.
Feng Mian, however, was growing anxious, her patience nearly exhausted.
She felt as though she wasn’t fishing but rather engaged in a tug-of-war of wills, on the brink of surrendering defeat.
Fortunately, a turning point occurredâ€”a vortex appeared in the sea three hundred li northeast, a sign that a treasure had been hooked.
“That’s amazing~”
Feng Mian recognized it at once; she had seen it before and was overjoyed, almost jumping up but held by Han Li, she could only excitedly stamp her feet.
Han Li raised an eyebrow, an expression of surprise on his face, but still congratulated, “Mian’er, I told you there was a beginner’s protection periodâ€”you’re sure to fish up a great treasure.”
In fact, he was quite astonished; was the beginner’s protection period refreshed with a change of person?
Or did it protect the first three rods?
Or indeed the entire first round?

chapters.title: Chapter 694
chapters.content:
Chapter 694: Chapter 265: The Golden Immortal Rank Soldiers and the Mixed Dao Cauldron!
The Surprised Feng Mian, True Immortal Rank Treasure: Fire Phoenix Fish!
Han Li’s Decision_2 Chapter 694: Chapter 265: The Golden Immortal Rank Soldiers and the Mixed Dao Cauldron!
The Surprised Feng Mian, True Immortal Rank Treasure: Fire Phoenix Fish!
Han Li’s Decision_2 Han Li couldn’t be sure, but he felt eager to try, his gaze falling on the fourth fishing rodâ€”a green one that signified the Quasi Immortal Monarch level.
Using this rod to fish would grant a chance to reel in treasures of the Quasi Immortal Monarch level.
“Should I try fishing or not?”
Han Li’s eyes shone, but after some hesitation, he decided to give up.
...
As the saying goes, “Strike while the iron is hot, but do not overdo it,” and “All good things come in threes.”
He felt that if he really used the green fishing rod, there probably wasn’t much hope of catching a treasure, with a high probability of coming up empty-handed.
That would mean wasting a thousand years of cultivation in vain, and although he had accumulated over five hundred thousand years of cultivation by now, it wasn’t something to be squandered carelessly.
Better to wait a while and come back to fish later; after all, the valid period was ten years.
He just needed to use the green and cyan fishing rods within that time.
Then he could wait for the Myriad Realms Fishing event to refresh and fish again in the next ten years.
“Humph~ What newbie protection period?
That was all my Heavenly Immortal technique.”
Feng Mian gave him a sidelong glance, seeing the surprise on Han Li’s face and smiling smugly, unapologetically taking credit for herself.
“Ah right, right, right, Mian’er, your skills are indeed excellent.
If you improve further, you’ll find a whole new world,” Han Li said with a grin.
Feng Mian blinked, taking a moment to catch on before spitting in disdain.
This rascal was always looking for a chance to tease her.
Never mind, let it be; as his only Dao Companion, if she didn’t allow him to flirt with her, should she let him flirt with others?
Feng Mian was not willing.
Watching the changes in Feng Mian’s expression, Han Li raised an eyebrow, reading certain information in her looks and suddenly feeling a bit guilty.
He seemed to have forgotten to tell his precious darling Feng Mian some important things.
After some thought, Han Li decided to hold back for now, better to tell her after they leave.
First, he should deepen their bond, so that even if Feng Mian discovered the truth, she probably wouldn’t get angry…
right?
“You, really…”
Feng Mian sighed softly, her lips lightly biting, but eventually, she said nothing.
She might as well spoil her own man.
Han Li had been so good to her; no need to nitpick over trivialities.
So, Feng Mian ignored Han Li’s teasing hand and focused intently on the distant whirlpools, awaiting the treasures she would fish from the sea.
Her flawless face was filled with anticipation, reveling in what True Immortal Rank treasures she might snag.
For a moment, Feng Mian’s mind raced with dozens, if not hundreds of treasures, all renowned at the True Immortal level, but they were all from her world.
“Dammit.”
For the first time, Feng Mian felt her knowledge was too limited.
This was the Thousand Realm Ocean, connected to all the myriad realms, and her world was but one of many.
Her world was not particularly strong, with only the Immortal Monarch as the highest realm.
There were legends of Immortal Kings and Immortal Emperors in the ancient history, but none had appeared for countless years.
In her world, what was known as a prestigious treasure might not be much in the Thousand Realm Ocean, perhaps just an ordinary itemâ€”it might even be quite common in Han Li’s Tai Chu Realm.
In their conversations, Han Li had mentioned some situations in the Tai Chu Realm.
That place actually had the existence of Immortal Emperors, not just one, but many, which made it countless times stronger than her own world.
Therefore, Feng Mian was not very resistant to coming to the Tai Chu Realm.
She had already become Dao companions with Han Li, and she had no attachments left in her original worldâ€”it was a good opportunity to pursue the Great Dao in the Tai Chu Realm wholeheartedly.
Just then, a streak of golden light leaped out of the sea, startling both Han Li and Feng Mian, who looked over in unison.
“Husband, what is this?”
Feng Mian, seeing the True Immortal Rank treasure on the hook, was dumbfounded, realizing she didn’t recognize it, and couldn’t help but ask her dear husband.
Han Li examined the treasure that had fully surfaced, a large fire-red fish measuring thirty feet in length, but he also did not recognize what kind of fish it was.
Hearing Feng Mian’s question, Han Li blinked.
Would Feng Mian think less of him if he admitted he didn’t know it?
Mainly because he hadn’t become an Immortal yet, he had very little exposure to the various treasures of the Heavenly Immortal and True Immortal levels and lacked a systematic knowledge of them.
“System, what is this fish called, and what effects does it have?”
Han Li quickly asked internally, and the System immediately responded, giving Han Li a sense of confidence.
With an even tone, he said, “Mian’er, you’ve really hooked a great treasure this time.”
“Ah?
Really?”
Feng Mian’s porcelain-like face showed utter surprise as she snuggled into Han Li’s embrace and coquettishly said, “Husband~ don’t keep me in suspense, tell Mian’er quickly.”
Han Li extended his right hand and gently scraped her delicate and proud nose, saying with a smile, “Mian’er, you are a spiritual phoenix, and this big fish is also related to the phoenix, named the Flame Phoenix Fish.”
“This Fire Phoenix Fish contains a mutated Phoenix bloodline, and if it cultivates to the Golden Immortal Realm, it can transform from fish to phoenix, becoming a true phoenix that soars through the nine heavens.”
“The Fire Phoenix Fish is extremely rare.
A True Immortal Rank Fire Phoenix Fish is one of the supreme treasures at this level, and it has a strong attraction to immortals who cultivate the fire attribute Dao.”
“Mian, if you refine this True Immortal Realm Fire Phoenix Fish, your bloodline will advance further, your potential will surge, and your future will be bright.”
Han Li conveyed the information the system told him, speaking with a sense of emotion.
Feng Mian was indeed lucky.
This Fire Phoenix Fish could greatly enhance her bloodline, providing a strong boost on her path to climbing the Dao, an enormous opportunity for any cultivator.
“Hehe~ Thank you, husband~”
Upon hearing this, Feng Mian was overjoyed, tilting her head up and taking the initiative to give a kiss.
She felt more and more that becoming Dao companions with Han Li was an extremely correct decision.
Otherwise, how could such a great opportunity like the Fire Phoenix Fish fall into her lap?
The reason she was fished out from the Thousand Realm Ocean by Han Li was to obtain a Heaven Phoenix Leg that had fallen from the sky, which could assist in her bloodline enhancement considerably, but that was only a Heavenly Immortal Realm Phoenix.
Although the Fire Phoenix Fish before her eyes was not a phoenix, it was of the True Immortal Realm and possessed half the phoenix bloodline, which helped her far more than the Heaven Phoenix Leg.
It’s a bit of a pity, in the end, she did not get the Heaven Phoenix Leg.
It was locked by the rules of the Karma Fishing Rod and ended up being fished up.
The Artifact Spirit Lu Yao of the Mixed Dao Cauldron didn’t get to consume that mass of Dao rules either.
Hence, she was quite angryâ€”she didn’t get anything and was fished up by someone, branded on her main body and put to use.
Ordinary mortals fishing would at least allow the fish to eat the bait, but Han Li was so stingy, which made Lu Yao very angry.
Han Li, of course, was unaware of these things, but he had his guesses.
“Husband, wasn’t our bait a True Dragon’s tail?
How did we end up attracting a Fire Phoenix Fish?”
As the Fire Phoenix Fish drew closer, Feng Mian suddenly asked.
Being of the Phoenix bloodline, would it be interested in a True Dragon’s tail?
“Silly girl, the other half of the Fire Phoenix Fish’s bloodline is that of a True Dragon.
It’s of a Dragon-Phoenix mixed breed, so of course it would be attracted to a True Dragon’s tail,” Han Li said, patting Feng Mian’s head with an extremely doting tone.
“Oh~” Feng Mian nodded dumbly, feeling that she had asked a very foolish question.
What was wrong with her?
She used to be a cool and aloof goddess, intelligent and pure-hearted.
How did she become somewhat flustered with her intelligence after becoming Dao companions with Han Li?
“Alright, stop thinking so much and go claim the Fire Phoenix Fish,” Han Li said, fondly touching Feng Mian’s soft, light green hair and speaking with a smile.
The orange fishing rod had already brought the Fire Phoenix Fish onto Thousand Realm Island, not far from the two of themâ€”just some dozen meters away.
Given the ten-zhang size of the Fire Phoenix Fish, it was very close to them.
“Husband~ Are you really giving it to me?”
Looking up at Han Li, Feng Mian stared into his eyes and asked again.
“Mian, you are my Dao companion.
I will never deceive you.
If I said it’s yours, then it’s yours,” Han Li said with a smile.
A Fire Phoenix Fish was nothing compared to Feng Mian.
He valued her far more, his Dao companion of Heavenly Immortal stature.
“Husband is the best~”
Feng Mian kissed Han Li again on her own initiative, touched in her heart, and immediately walked over.
Gazing at the massive Fire Phoenix Fish, Feng Mian’s beautiful eyes shined, and she couldn’t help but lick her cherry lips.
“Husband, I really want to eat it in one bite, it’s a pity…”
Feng Mian lightly bit her silver teeth and mumbled, a trace of regret flashing across her exquisite and perfect face.
The Fire Phoenix Fish was already in the mid-stage of the True Immortal Realm, and she was only in the late stage of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
She couldn’t consume so much Fire Phoenix Fish; it would be too much for her to handle.
“Mian, the Fire Phoenix Fish is all yours now; no one will compete with you for it.
Enjoy it slowly and gradually enhance your bloodline,” Han Li said, standing with his hands behind his back, the sea breeze causing his clothes to flutter as he watched the adorable Feng Mian and spoke with a smile.
“Okay~”
“Then I will listen to my husband~”
Feng Mian nodded, her face showing happiness, and she waved her hand to collect the Fire Phoenix Fish.
PS: Two more updates tomorrow, making up for the previous 2,000 words that were owed.

chapters.title: Chapter 695
chapters.content:
Chapter 695: Chapter 266: Returning to Chengsheng Mountain, Feng Mian’s Mentality Collapses!
Feng Mian and Qin Shiyin!
The Shock Brought by the Heavenly Immortal Couple_1 Chapter 695: Chapter 266: Returning to Chengsheng Mountain, Feng Mian’s Mentality Collapses!
Feng Mian and Qin Shiyin!
The Shock Brought by the Heavenly Immortal Couple_1 “Husband, shall we continue fishing?”
After they had put away the Fire Phoenix Fish, Feng Mian’s face lit up with joy, her exquisite features brimming with excitement.
She bounced over to Han Li’s side and took his hand.
Gazing at the octacolored fishing rods on the large rocky outcrop, Feng Mian couldn’t help but drool with desire, now completely convinced of their tremendous power.
...
She had been caught by the Heavenly Immortal rank Crimson Fishing Rod, and her husband had even caught a Golden Immortal weapon with the yellow rod.
She herself had used the orange rod to fish up the Fire Phoenix Fish.
It was a complete bumper harvest!
Although her husband said she could use the other rods, Feng Mian did not take action.
However, she could watch Han Li fish.
All she wanted was to satisfy her curiosity and see what level of treasures the remaining rods could hook.
The third yellow rod was already at the Golden Immortal level, and there were seven rods left.
If they could fish up treasures of the Immortal Monarch or Immortal King level, their path of cultivation would be secured.
Facing Feng Mian’s expectant look, Han Li found it hard to refuse, but he still did, “Mian’er, let’s not fish for now.
We’ll come back after a while.”
Han Li was unsure about the fourth attempt at fishing; perhaps their luck had been expended during the previous three attempts.
It would be good to test their luck with the treasure chest once they got out.
“Okay~”
Upon hearing this, Feng Mian looked a bit downcast, but she quickly perked up and asked, “Husband~ when will we go fishing next time?”
She couldn’t find this place on her own and could only enter with Han Li’s help, which Feng Mian was well aware of.
However, Han Li was her husband, and she was his only dao companion.
Given their relationship, Han Li would surely bring her along next time.
She just wanted to know when the next time would be so that she could look forward to it.
After thinking for a moment, Han Li stroked Feng Mian’s smooth, lustrous hair and said tenderly, “Don’t worry, Mian’er, at most ten years.”
Han Li was very honest in his words without a trace of deception.
The Thousand Realm Fishing would refresh every ten years; he wouldn’t allow the fishing opportunities to go to waste.
Snuggling into Han Li’s embrace, her head resting on his chest and listening to his heartbeat, Feng Mian looked at his handsome face with a satisfied hum.
She could feel that Han Li wasn’t lying, which touched Feng Mian’s heart a little.
Ten years was nothing to her, akin to a mere snap of the fingers, and it would pass in no time.
As a Heavenly Immortal, Feng Mian used to spend tens of thousands of years in minor seclusion without a second thought.
She had long since ceased to care about the passage of time.
“Husband, how do we get out of the Thousand Realm Ocean?”
After a tender moment with Han Li, Feng Mian looked out at the boundless Thousand Realm Ocean and raised a serious question.
“It’s simple, we just walk out.”
A gentle smile graced Han Li’s face, his tone casual.
Feng Mian sent out her Divine Sense, scanning back and forth over Thousand Realm Island dozens of times, but she found no passage in or out, her expression turning somewhat strange.
How are we supposed to walk out?
Could her husband be too carefree?
If they couldn’t walk out, they would be trapped on Thousand Realm Island where there was nothing.
Although their storage spaces were filled with plenty of supplies and cultivation resources, they would not last against the ravages of time, and the cultivation environment here was quite harsh.
She might survive an era as a Heavenly Immortal, but her husband was merely at the Quasi Emperor rank, with a mere three hundred thousand years of lifespan.
If they were to die trapped here, wouldn’t she end up a widow?
Should she choose to die with her husband when the time came…
While Feng Mian’s mind raced with wild thoughts, she saw Han Li flick his finger, releasing a beam of divine light that formed a large gateway in front of them.
Feng Mian was stunned.
Was her husband really just a Quasi Emperor?
Her Divine Sense had probed the structure, and it formed a stable space-time passage, with the end of the tunnel leading to the Tai Chu Realm, as her husband had said.
Such a feat was not something a Heavenly Immortal like herself could achieve, let alone an Immortal Monarch level powerhouse.
“Mian’er, let’s go.”
Han Li beckoned, and the Emperor Flag flew into his body.
Gazing at the still dazed Feng Mian, he wrapped his arms around her and walked towards the passage.
Naturally, this was not within Han Li’s powers to accomplish, but with a mere thought, he could open this space-time channel and exit the virtual dashboard of the Thousand Realm Fishing.
As soon as the two stepped through the gateway, they found themselves back in Qiandao Hall on Chengsheng Mountain.
Witnessing the disappearing gateway, a flicker of curiosity appeared in Han Li’s eyes.
Even he couldn’t fully understand whether the so-called Thousand Realm Ocean and Thousand Realm Island truly existed or were constructs of the system.
“Husband, have we arrived at the Tai Chu Realm?” Feng Mian was somewhat dazed.
This was her second experience with space-time travel; the first time was involuntary when she was fished out of her original world to Thousand Realm Island.
This time, it was a conscious journey from Thousand Realm Island to the Tai Chu Realm.
The second journey was much quicker than the first.
Could it be because Tai Chu Realm was closer to the Thousand Realm Ocean than her original world?
“Mian’er, we are indeed in the Tai Chu Realm now, but only in a remote part of it.”
“Tai Chu Realm comprises the Thirty-three Heavens and 129,600 domains; where we are now is the Yuankun Domain, and our Chengsheng Mountain is the leading power in the Yuankun Domain…”
Lying on a comfortable old-style armchair, Han Li held Feng Mian in his arms, ready to enlighten her with his knowledge.
Their time spent fishing in the Thousand Realms had caused a bit of a delay, mostly due to the two discussions with Feng Mian, and it was now evening.
Han Li’s original plans had to be postponed.
He had to reschedule his meeting with Bai Keqing, Long Yue, Ling Lingshuang, and Xue Yueqing to discuss the Dao.
Still, Han Li notified the four women with his Divine Sense, telling them not to wait and suggesting they either help each other out or proceed with their cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 696
chapters.content:
Chapter 696: Chapter 266: Returning to Chengsheng Mountain, Feng Mian’s Mentality Collapses!
Feng Mian and Qin Shiyin!
The Shock Brought by the Heavenly Immortal Couple_2 Chapter 696: Chapter 266: Returning to Chengsheng Mountain, Feng Mian’s Mentality Collapses!
Feng Mian and Qin Shiyin!
The Shock Brought by the Heavenly Immortal Couple_2 Now, tonight he belonged to Feng Mian.
This Heavenly Immortal Realm spirit phoenix left Han Li very desirous, and in recent times he planned to engage in a thorough and deep exchange of Daoist teachings with Feng Mian.
While Han Li explained, Feng Mian’s Divine Sense scouted Chengsheng Mountain and discovered it thriving and bustling, with many immortal soldiers hidden; it must be her husband’s power base.
...
However, the Cultivators on Chengsheng Mountain generally had low realms of cultivation, the highest being a female Cultivator in the second layer of the Heaven Imperial Realm, far inferior to herself.
Suddenly, Feng Mian’s expression subtly changed, and a layer of frost appeared on her pretty face.
What had she seen?
This Chengdao Peak was teeming with a large group of delicate beauties, breathtakingly gorgeous, and possessing the grace of celestial beings.
What had she heard?
Why did all these celestial beauties call Han Li their husband?
Including that Heaven Imperial Realm Empress in black dress and white stockings.
Feng Mian pushed away Han Li’s hand, which was on her soft waist, stood up, and looked at the leisurely Han Li with an unhappy expression.
Feng Mian’s charming face was frosted over, once again becoming a cold and aloof ice beauty, gazing at Han Li with a chill, biting her red lips slightly before she finally spat out a sentence,
“How much longer do you plan on deceiving me?”
She had always thought that Han Li had only her as a Dao Companion, so despite Han Li’s repeated disrespect and making her assume various embarrassing and difficult poses, Feng Mian had endured it all.
She was a Heavenly Immortal Realm spirit phoenix, while Han Li was merely a Human Clan at the Quasi Emperor Realm, their statuses and strengths vastly different.
Falling into Han Li’s hands by chance, as a traditional spirit phoenix, even though she was extremely displeased after being slept with by Han Li, she still agreed to be his Dao Companion.
Luckily, Han Li treated her exceptionally well, offering her very generous benefits, even giving her a True Dao Pill, a heaven-defying medicinal pill, allowing her to smoothly break through to the True Immortal Realm in the future.
She also used Han Li’s orange fishing rod, catching a phoenix fish, and after breaking through to the True Immortal Realm, refining the fish to enhance her bloodline would make breaking through to the Golden Immortal Realm much easier.
All of these were gifts from Han Li, completely changing her future.
So, even though they hadn’t known each other for long, their relationship was deep, and Feng Mian gradually grew fond of him, feeling that having Han Li as a Dao Companion on the path of cultivation was a great fortune.
Initially, Feng Mian felt that calling Han Li “husband” was quite cheesy, somewhat reluctantly, but later on, she began to call him that of her own accord, finding it quite nice.
As a late-stage Heavenly Immortal Realm spirit phoenix, Feng Mian naturally experienced many dangers and witnessed the treachery of the world.
If it hadn’t been for Han Li treating her so well, and after having been slept with and captured by him, she wouldn’t have gotten together with him.
Feng Mian was prepared for the future when Han Li might have more than her as a Dao Companion, for she saw his excellence with her own eyes.
But that was the future.
Now, she should be the only one; even if Han Li had previous Dao Companions, there shouldn’t be many.
However, Feng Mian never expected Han Li to have so many wives and concubines.
This mountain, besides the Maids, was filled with Han Li’s wives and concubines, truly making the phrase “a thousand beauties” a reality.
Feng Mian’s heart turned cold, and she was on the verge of dying of anger, Han Li had deceived her feelings.
Had she known Han Li had so many wives and concubines, she would definitely not have compromised so easily.
She would certainly have…
Seeing Feng Mian’s expression, Han Li knew things were out of the bag, but he wasn’t the least bit worried; all this was within his expectations.
Her cultivation had been previously unsealed by him, limited to only Saint Abyss Realm standards, capable of using Divine Sense, so it was normal for her to find out the truth upon arriving at Chengsheng Mountain, as Han Li had not deliberately hidden anything.
Facing this situation, Han Li had already made preparations.
Han Li stood up and walked towards Feng Mian, who took a few steps back, but he caught up and reached out to pull her into his embrace.
“Don’t touch me, stay away from me.”
Feng Mian was clearly fuming, saying so bitterly.
Han Li’s face was filled with deep affection, he completely ignored what Feng Mian said and dominantly pulled her into his arms; Feng Mian only struggled symbolically a few times.
Then she looked at Han Li, her perfect face now puffed up with anger, clearly waiting for Han Li’s explanation.
She and Han Li had a deep connection, and Feng Mian knew she couldn’t leave him, but that didn’t stop her from being angry, it was a woman’s prerogative.
“Mian’er, it’s all my fault…..”
Han Li bit down on Feng Mian’s exquisitely flawless earlobe, which was one of her sensitive zones, and then showered her with sweet nothings.
As a Great Grandmaster in the art of emotions, Han Li had mastered countless ways to charm women.
After making some promises and uttering a basketful of sweet words, he had Feng Mian nearly smitten.
Next, Han Li carried Feng Mian to the ninth floor of the Time-Sky Tower and proceeded with the final step, exchanging insights on the Dao to deepen their connection.
By the time the two returned to Qiandao Hall, it was already the next morning, and the plum blossoms had bloomed to an unknown degree.
Feng Mian became docile and obedient overnight, sweet and well-behaved, and utterly devoted to Han Li.
Thereafter, Han Li took Feng Mian to another area of Chengdao Peak and formally introduced her to his beloved wives and beautiful concubines such as Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, and Qiu Yueyao.
When they heard that Feng Mian was a Heavenly Immortal phoenix, all of Han Li’s wives and concubines, including several fiancÃ©es, were astonished.
There is a branch of the phoenix clan in the Yuankun Domain known as the Moon Phoenix Clan, which is part of the Huangyue Imperial Empire.
Every generation in the imperial empire has a few pure-blooded Moon Phoenixes, and the current Empress of Huangyue is the one with the purest lineage.
The emergence of a spiritual phoenix in the Yuankun Domain was surprising to Zi Miaozhen, Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, Lu Yuan, and others, but when compared to Feng Mian’s cultivation level, this was insignificant.
You see, there has yet to be a Heavenly Immortal in the Yuankun Domain today; even the nine supreme beings are only at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Even if they have the capacity to break through to the Heavenly Immortal Realm, it doesn’t count until they do.
Yet Feng Mian is in the late stages of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Such a cultivation level, combined with her bloodline, physique, and other abilities, probably gives her the combat ability of a peak Heavenly Immortal.
All the wives and concubines looked at Han Li, incredibly curious as to where their husband had found a late-stage Heavenly Immortal phoenix to be his Dao companion.
Bai Keqing, Ling Lingshuang, Xue Yueqing, and Long Yue exchanged glances, even more astonished in their hearts.
They had been with their husband Han Li that afternoon, and in less than a day, their husband had brought back a Heavenly Immortal Dao companion.
Their minds all drifted to the previous night; their husband hadn’t joined them in discussing the Dao, likely because he was bringing Feng Mian home at that time.
Looking at Feng Mian’s expression, there was no sign of coercion, which was even more curious.
The four women were extremely eager to find out what methods their husband Han Li had used to conquer this Heavenly Immortal phoenix.
Regarding all this, Han Li casually brushed it off with a few words and didn’t elaborate.
He didn’t want to explain in detail either.
The issue of fishing in the Thousand Realm Ocean was of great significance, and could not be shown lightly.
If Feng Mian hadn’t been a Heavenly Immortal Dao companion he fished out from the Thousand Realm Ocean, Han Li wouldn’t have wanted her to know.
Seeing that Han Li didn’t mention the Thousand Realm Ocean or the Thousand Realm Fishing, Feng Mian was somewhat surprised, but still echoed Han Li, simultaneously feeling secretly pleased.
That only she and her husband Han Li knew of this meant that he valued her a bit more, even though she was a newcomer.
But her cultivation was high!
It vastly surpassed that of all Han Li’s other wives and concubines.
Even her figure, appearance, and demeanor were of the highest quality.
Compared to her, these sisters paled in comparison.
After settling this matter and asking Feng Mian to get along well with the others, Han Li left temporarily.
As Han Li had anticipated, Feng Mian, the Heavenly Immortal with the appearance of a youthful giant peak, soon joined the black-dressed, white-stocking Empress Qin Shiyin and became good friends, quickly forming a close sisterhood.
Both women were Han Li’s fiancÃ©es: one was a Heaven Imperial Realm empress, and the other a real Heavenly Immortal.
In many respects, they were both stronger than Han Li’s other wives and concubines and had more common topics.
Qin Shiyin’s wedding was set for three months later, while Feng Mian’s wedding was scheduled for five months later, staggered a bit, at which time he would take significant action.
“Sister.”
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Qin Shiyin and Feng Mian stood side by side, with Qin Shiyin being the first to speak.
Looking at the peerlessly beautiful, youthful, and irresistibly seductive Heavenly Immortal, Qin Shiyin sighed inwardly.
She had thought that she would be the first among Chengsheng Mountain for a long time, but before she had even officially joined the family, her biggest advantage was gone.
(There is an illustration of Qin Shiyin here.
If the submission is approved, you can see it.
If some readers can’t see it, please update the APP.)
“Sister Qin, I’m new here, so please take good care of me.”
Feng Mian was still very polite to the black-dressed empress beside her.
While the two women were talking, Han Li had already arrived at Xumi Mountain and entered the Little Western Heaven, deftly sitting down.
Conversing with the female Bodhisattva led Han Li’s thoughts to drift.
With the Mixed Dao Cauldron, a Golden Immortal weapon, he could do as he pleased in the Yuankun Domain and no longer needed to accumulate cultivation.
Han Li decided he would break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm upon returning from Xumi Mountain.
PS: Early update, requesting votes for the monthly ticket.

chapters.title: Chapter 697
chapters.content:
Chapter 697: Chapter 267: Han Li’s Plan, Savage Development for Two Hundred Million Years, Han Condemnation Alliance, Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!_1 Chapter 697: Chapter 267: Han Li’s Plan, Savage Development for Two Hundred Million Years, Han Condemnation Alliance, Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!_1 Xumi Mountain, Little Western Heaven.
Han Li and the female Bodhisattva were having a meal.
Although they had reached a state where eating was no longer necessary, trying food occasionally was still acceptable.
...
The feast was personally prepared by Han Li for the female Bodhisattva.
“Husband, what do you plan to do in the future?”
While eating and chatting, the female Bodhisattva Han Linxi brushed her temple hair aside with her jade hand.
“Focus on eating, don’t you know ‘not to talk while you eat’?” Han Li frowned slightly, his large hand stroking the female Bodhisattva’s black and lustrous waterfall-like hair.
The female Bodhisattva gave him a glanceâ€”have you ever seen someone invite you for a meal without providing utensils?
It made her have to move her own hands to put the delicious dishes into her beautiful red lips.
Seeing the female Bodhisattva devour the food, a content smile appeared on Han Li’s face; his culinary skills were genuinely outstanding, honed through practice.
When the female Bodhisattva swallowed the last white pastry, her delicate face full of satisfaction, she continued to ask vaguely, “Husband, you still haven’t answered my question?”
Han Li remained silent until he also finished enjoying the meal, then he slowly said, “Let’s start by being number one in the Yuan Kun Realm.”
“But, husband, isn’t Chengsheng Mountain already the number one force in the Yuan Kun Realm?” the female Bodhisattva asked, puzzled.
Han Li smiled, his handsome face brimming with utmost confidence as he said spiritedly, “It’s different.
My number one means being invincible in the Yuan Kun Realm, pushing through all enemies.”
Admiration filled the beautiful eyes of the female Bodhisattva as her heart fluttered, gazing at Han Li.
Once upon a time, Han Li was just an obscure figure; the first time he entered her view, Han Li was merely at the True Martial Realm.
Just a few decades had passed, and now Han Li possessed combat ability at the Heaven Imperial Realmâ€”being one of the top ten supreme beings in the Yuan Kun Realm and controlling Chengsheng Mountain, the strongest power there.
What formidable and domineering presence?
It was for this reason that she was subdued by Han Li and willingly became one of his beautiful wives.
“Husband, are you confident?
The Huangyue Imperial Empire, Yuanchu Mountain, and the Longevity Qin Family among other nine major powers are not to be trifled with,” the female Bodhisattva said, wearing a worried look.
The female Bodhisattva was quite aware of who Han Li’s enemies were.
Within the Qianyuan Divine Province, nearly all foes had turned their hostilities into alliances with Chengsheng Mountain as kinship forces, and only if Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain declined would they turn against him and seek revenge.
But beyond the Qianyuan Divine Province, in the vast and endless Yuan Kun Realm, Chengsheng Mountain had no shortage of formidable enemies.
White Emperor City, the Huangyue Imperial Empire, and Yuanchu Mountain, that bore grudges against Chengsheng Mountain due to soul division issues, constituted three of the most powerful forces.
The speed of Chengsheng Mountain’s rise, along with its high potential, had brought a great impact on the existing order of the Yuan Kun Realm, seriously affecting the interests of powerful forces like the Longevity Qin Family, the Longevity Jiang Family, Western Sky Palace, and the Heavenly Cult.
While Chengsheng Mountain was keeping a low profile, the other powerful forces had no excuse to cause trouble; but if the husband made a high-profile move, the nine major forces might join forces to attack Qianyuan Divine Province.
Although her husband Han Li possessed profound strength and countless secret weapons, and the female Bodhisattva had faith in him, the nine major forces were also not easy to provoke, with their fame spreading across tens of thousands of years.
“Xier, rest easy, I’ve got this.”
Seeing the female Bodhisattva reveal a rare girlish manner, Han Li felt a surge of satisfaction.
Han Linxi had once been a lofty, cool, and proud female Bodhisattva.
With a pull of his big hand, the female Bodhisattva was drawn into his arms.
Enjoying the warmth and softness, he sniffed her subtle fragrance, and Han Li started to become somewhat restless.
As for Han Linxi’s worries, Han Li was not concerned at allâ€”who would worry, having obtained the Golden Immortal weapon, the Mixed Dao Cauldron?
Though he had the Golden Immortal weapon at hand, Han Li hadn’t thought to annihilate all nine major powers completely.
With such a trump card, from then on he could walk horizontally in the Yuan Kun Realm, so there was no need to deliberately keep a low profile.
After marrying Yang Zhiyun, Qin Shiyin, Feng Mian, and the others, it would then be time to seek matrimony with Empress Yuanchu and the empress of Huangyue.
If the two female empresses were to join the other major powers in besieging him, Han Li would not be polite.
It would be an excellent opportunity to let the Mixed Dao Cauldron show its might and capture them all in one fell swoop.
“It’s good that my husband has a plan.”
The female Bodhisattva gazed steadily at Han Li, her heart filled with boundless joy, and with her arms around his neck, she forgot her blushing cheeks and leaned forward.
In such a moment, Han Li could no longer contain himself, and things quickly got out of hand.
………..
Chengdao Peak.
After spending time in Little Western Heaven with the female Bodhisattva, Han Li returned here in an instant.
He found that Empress Qin Shiyin and Heavenly Immortal Feng Mian were still chatting and laughing at the peak’s summit.
As Han Li appeared behind Feng Mian and Qin Shiyin, he went straight for a hug from the left and a hug from the right, thoroughly enjoying the moment.
Feng Mian’s delicate body trembled slightly, and after a mild resistance, she ceased to struggle.
She merely gave him a look.
Qin Shiyin’s body, on the other hand, was quite stiff and she wanted to pull away, to break free from Han Li’s powerful grip, but after a thought, she remained still.
After all, she was Han Li’s fiancÃ©e in name, and he had restrained himself from taking her virginity before the marriage.
Holding hands, embracing, and kissing, these of course, had been done.
What Qin Shiyin wasn’t accustomed to was Han Li’s simultaneous embrace of both her and another, especially when that other was Feng Mian, whose cultivation was much higher than hers.
“What are you two chatting about, looking so happy?” Han Li asked with a smile.
He hadn’t deliberately eavesdropped on the two women’s conversation, so he wasn’t particularly aware of what Feng Mian and Qin Shiyin were discussing.
After adjusting for a while, Qin Shiyin accepted the situation and her body relaxed.
She was the first to speak, “We were discussing when you, husband, are going to make a move on the empress of Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu.”

chapters.title: Chapter 698
chapters.content:
Chapter 698: Chapter 267: Han Li’s Plan, Savage Development for Two Hundred Million Years, Han Condemnation Alliance, Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!_2 Chapter 698: Chapter 267: Han Li’s Plan, Savage Development for Two Hundred Million Years, Han Condemnation Alliance, Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!_2 Qin Shiyin’s tone was somewhat sour, difficult to conceal, and despite her efforts to restrain herself, she couldn’t help it.
After chatting with Feng Mian, she learned many secrets.
Although Feng Mian did not disclose the matter of fishing in the Thousand Realm Ocean, she did mention the matter of the Golden Immortal troops.
...
This was something Han Li had not specifically instructed Feng Mian to keep secret; speaking of it had no impact, as not many would know anyway, being limited to Han Li’s cherished wives and concubines, and perhaps only his cherished wives.
Now that Han Li had the Golden Immortal troops and had successfully taken control, he was undoubtedly the first person in the Yuankun Domain, and Chengsheng Mountain would be invincible across the entire Yuankun Domain.
Who in the Endless Yuankun Domain doesn’t know about Han Li’s covetous thoughts toward the Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu?
In the versions of the rumor circulating outside, Han Li has long coveted the two peerless empresses, regarding them as possessions within his grasp, deliberately marrying the split souls of the two peerless empresses first, entangling himself with Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu.
For this, the Eternal Golden Immortal even repeatedly destroyed the White Emperor who pursued Empress Huangyue, plundered Taibai Immortal Realm, causing White Emperor City to fall into decay, becoming the weakest among the mighty powers.
In Qin Shiyin’s view, Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu could not escape Han Li’s clutches, even if the two peerless empresses were the rulers of the two mighty forces of Yuanchu Mountain and the Huangyue Imperial Empire, and were also supreme beings at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Even if Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu achieved their ambitions, transformed into war immortals, succeeded in overcoming tribulation to become Heavenly Immortals, and even obtained True Immortal weapons, what could they do in the face of the overwhelming trend?
They would still have to submit.
And Han Li, who controls the Golden Immortal troops, is that overwhelming trend!
He could suppress everything that does not submit, exterminating all beings in the Yuankun Domain, including the nine mighty powers.
This is the Golden Immortal troops we’re talking about!
The Yuankun Domain has gone through countless eons, and across the ages, ancient history has only vaguely recorded a few Golden Immortals, with only vague accounts concerning the Eternal Golden Immortals.
In the eyes of strong beings like Qin Shiyin, there is naturally much exploration of the secrets of Golden Immortals, all hoping to escape the great calamity of the Yuankun Domain, to leave Xuanshen Sword Mountain and survive in the vast outside world in pursuit of the Dao.
According to Qin Shiyin’s own investigation and the secret ancient history she viewed in White Emperor City, no Eternal Golden Immortal has been born in the Yuankun Domain in over a dozen eons.
Only sixteen eons ago, ancient history ambiguously recorded a Golden Immortal, and even then, it was only a few words.
After that powerful being became a Golden Immortal, he soon disappeared, and people believed that this supremely talented Golden Immortal of unmatched talent had left Xuanshen Sword Mountain and had already become a dominant force in the outside world, which is what Qin Shiyin also believed.
Whether that powerful Golden Immortal had Golden Immortal weapons was hard to say; after all, he vanished less than a million years upon achieving Golden Immortal status, and even if he forged Golden Immortal weapons, he certainly took them out of the Yuankun Domain.
So, in Qin Shiyin’s view, her fiancÃ© Han Li possessing Golden Immortal troops meant he truly was invincible in the Yuankun Domain.
The two peerless empresses, Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, could only obediently become Han Li’s consorts.
But the problem is, she, an empress of the Heaven Imperial Realm, hadn’t even officially married Han Li.
If Han Li were to promptly make a marriage proposal, forcefully marrying Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, her status would not just plummet once, but continue to fall.
Qin Shiyin spoke, turning her breathtakingly beautiful face to look at Han Li.
Although she didn’t want Han Li to propose so soon, she couldn’t stop his decision either.
“The Yuankun Domain is indeed a place of outstanding people and spiritual land, where prodigies with exceptional talents are constantly emerging,” Feng Mian commented with a sense of emotion.
After chatting with Qin Shiyin, she generally understood the situation of the Yuankun Domain and Chengsheng Mountain, and didn’t underestimate them in the slightest.
Although the Yuankun Domain hasn’t had a Heavenly Immortal to date, it doesn’t mean that it is inferior to her original world; it’s just that it recently suffered a great calamity.
An eon is only twelve billion nine hundred sixty million years, while the Yuankun Domain faces a great calamity every two billion one hundred sixty million years, surely impeding the true growth of its prodigies.
Every era of the Yuankun Domain has a few True Immortals, all of whom are incredibly talented and exceptional individuals.
Compared to other True Immortals in the Taichu Realm who take hundreds of millions of years to break through, they have a very short cultivation time.
After all, they don’t have much time; they must break through to Heavenly Immortals within two billion one hundred sixty million years, then break through to True Immortals, and finally sprint to the peak of True Immortals, attempting to break through to the Golden Immortal Realm.
Though the great calamity caused the Yuankun Domain to suffer heavy losses, it also spurred the potential of the beings in the Yuankun Domain.
From Feng Mian’s perspective, if the True Immortals of the Yuankun Domain were placed in her original world, they would likely each become Immortal Lords.
Especially since the Yuankun Domain has her husband, Han Li, a supreme prodigy with talent unmatched since ancient times.
Upon learning about the great calamity of the Yuankun Domain, Feng Mian didn’t worry like Qin Shiyin, even though she herself was now trapped.
Feng Mian knew just how unfathomably deep her husband was, and not something the mere Xuanshen Sword Mountain could block.
Moreover, there are more than two billion years until the next great calamity of the Yuankun Domain, and once her husband fishes a few more times from the Thousand Realm Ocean, it is inevitable that he will safely leave the Yuankun Domain.
Han Li turned to look at Qin Shiyin, his fiery gaze making her involuntarily lower her head, her heart pounding like a startled deer.
What Qin Shiyin was thinking, Han Li was of course clear about, including Yang Zhiyun, Feng Mian, and the others.
Han Li would make proper arrangements for all of them, or else the first thing he would do after leaving the Thousand Realm Ocean would be to propose to Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu.
For now, he was not in a hurry.
Firstly, he would marry Qin Shiyin, Feng Mian, and the others, one by one.
With Golden Immortal troops in hand, Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu would sooner or later be his, and no one could compete with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 699
chapters.content:
Chapter 699: Chapter 267: Han Li’s Plan, Savage Development for Two Hundred Million Years, Han Condemnation Alliance, Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!_3 Chapter 699: Chapter 267: Han Li’s Plan, Savage Development for Two Hundred Million Years, Han Condemnation Alliance, Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!_3 Whoever dares to compete with him, he will beat them to death!
“Shiyin, I will marry you first, don’t worry.”
Han Li leaned in and kissed her delicate face gently, his tone warm.
“As for Empress Yuanchu and Huangyue Imperial Empress, there’s no rush.
...
Once I have married all of you, I will then formally propose.”
Upon hearing this, Qin Shiyin’s hanging heart finally settled, and she felt quite moved.
She had not expected Han Li to consider her feelings.
She and Han Li did not have much affection for each other, after all, their alliance as Dao companions was a transaction, each getting what they needed.
But now, her fondness for Han Li had grown.
Putting herself in Han Li’s shoes, she probably wouldn’t have done the same.
With the Golden Immortal soldiers, all the beautiful female cultivators in the Yuankun Domain were at his beck and call.
After exchanging sweet nothings with Qin Shiyin and Feng Mianqing, Han Li left.
He was ready to ascend to the Heaven Imperial Realm, to master the Heavenly Sovereign Path, and become a true Great Emperor.
Before that, there was still some preparation needed, after all, proving oneself as emperor meant overcoming tribulations, which was a significant affair.
This news quickly spread throughout Chengsheng Mountain, first reaching Han Li’s numerous cherished wives and concubines, who were very excited; their husband was finally breaking through to the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Although the husband’s breakthrough to the Heaven Imperial Realm would not make Chengsheng Mountain invincible, it would bring enormous benefits to them; dual cultivation with the husband would lead to much more rapid progress in their cultivation.
Next to know were Han Li’s descendants, who heard about it from their own mothers and were greatly exhilarated, sharing in the glory.
Then it was the turn of the Han Mansion’s guest elders, protectors, maids, and so on.
The news spread layer by layer, reaching the Daqian Empire, Xuan Domain, Qianyuan Divine Province, and finally spread throughout the entire Endless Yuankun Domain in a very short time.
For a while, the whole Yuankun Domain was in a stir, causing a huge commotion.
Bai Yujing.
“He is finally breaking through?”
The Dao Sovereign and his two disciples heard this news with complex expressions.
Chengsheng Mountain was too powerful, even Bai Yujing had to submit, even sending some beautiful cultivators from Myriad Phenomena Realm, True Martial Realm, and Divine Yuan Realm to Chengsheng Mountain as wives and concubines for Han Li.
Thinking of his third disciple, Lu Zhen, the Dao Sovereign sighed deeply; he genuinely couldn’t help this disciple, even if he had high hopes for him.
It was clear that Ling Lingshuang was one of Han Li’s Dao companions, and if Lu Zhen approached her, Han Li might not show mercy.
“I hope Lu Zhen can survive this ordeal.”
……
Xumi Mountain.
“It looks like I need to speed up my cultivation, otherwise I won’t be able to keep up with my husband’s progress.”
The female bodhisattva, gazing towards Chengsheng Mountain, thought silently with a smile blooming on her face.
Han Li was her husband, and the stronger Han Li became, the happier she was.
As Han Li’s Dao companion, she had a token bestowed by Han Li, allowing her to arrive at Chengsheng Mountain in an instant without any obstacles to enjoy her rightful treatment.
The female bodhisattva planned to take a stroll around Chengsheng Mountain after Han Li’s breakthrough and see what was going on inside.
What was hers, she intended to claim it all.
……
Myriad Demon Mountain.
“Han Li truly is a peerless genius of ancient and modern times.”
Dongfang Qingcang, the lord of Myriad Demon Mountain, praised energetically, not sparing any laudatory words.
Among Han Li’s wives and concubines were already Bai Keqing, Xue Yueqing, Bi Xinlei, and Fang Yousi; later, he personally sent more, and relatives of Bai Keqing and Xue Yueqing also married over, making the relations between the two very close.
With the current status of Chengsheng Mountain, Myriad Demon Mountain was also honored; they could strut out of the Qianyuan Divine Province magnificently, claiming to be under the protection of Chengsheng Mountain.
The few Demon Emperors standing behind Dongfang Qingcang made faces; in the past, he hadn’t spoken that way, almost scolding Han Li to his face.
Of course, Dongfang Qingcang noticed the expressions of the few Demon Emperors, but he didn’t care; he was such a free-spirited person.
……
“Have you heard?
The Eternal Great Emperor was not from the Heaven Imperial Realm after all.”
“What does it matter?
No one in the Yuankun Domain can contest the status of Eternal Great Emperor Han anyway.”
“Yeah, the Eternal Great Emperor is about to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm and become a real Great Emperor in name and in reality.”
“It’s just maddening to compare, isn’t it?
The Eternal Great Emperor has been cultivating for less than three hundred years, and now he’s about to prove the Heavenly Sovereign Path, it’s terrifying.”
“Huangyue Imperial Empress and Empress Yuanchu are considered the most outstanding prodigies of this age.
They have Heavenly Immortal Bloodline, stunning beauty, and Immortal Bodies, but even they can’t compare to the Eternal Great Emperor.”
“The Eternal Great Emperor is a reincarnated ancient immortal.
In the past, he was at least a Heavenly Immortal, if not a True Immortal, and there’s even a possibility that he was the legendary Eternal Golden Immortal.
How can others compare to him?”
All over the Yuankun Domain, countless forces and endless beings were discussing fervently, passionate about this news.
The number of Great Emperors in the Heaven Imperial Realm in the Yuankun Domain was not high.
There are the leaders of thirty-three Heavenly Governing Forces, the nine supreme force leaders, and other Heavenly Imperial Realm Great Emperors within the supreme forces.
In total, there would not be more than eighty.
This includes some Loose Cultivator Emperors, as well as those who retreat from fame and hide their identities in the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Every additional Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor would cause a sensation in the Yuankun Domain, let alone Han Li, the Eternal Great Emperor.
Countless beings were speculating about how strong the Eternal Great Emperor would be after breaking through to the Heaven Imperial Realm, as he already possessed mid-stage Heaven Imperial Realm combat ability even at the Quasi Emperor level.
In the Huangyue Imperial Empire, the Imperial Capital.
Within the grand and majestic imperial palace, upon hearing the news, the Huangyue Imperial Empress, clad in golden armor and holding the Golden War Spear, momentarily lost herself in thought.
“This guy really knows how to stir things up,”
the Huangyue Imperial Empress murmured to herself softly, her face showing a thoughtful expression.
She was certain that this intelligence was leaked by Han Li himself; otherwise, no one could have known such detailed information, including the timing and location of his tribulation.

chapters.title: Chapter 700
chapters.content:
Chapter 700: Chapter 267: Han Li’s Plan, Savage Development for Two Hundred Million Years, Han Condemnation Alliance, Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!_4 Chapter 700: Chapter 267: Han Li’s Plan, Savage Development for Two Hundred Million Years, Han Condemnation Alliance, Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!
Breakthrough!_4 After hesitating, Empress Phoenix Moon still planned to go and see for herself when the time came.
When other supreme beings attempt to obstruct the way, whether to watch quietly, lend a hand, or block the way, she would decide at that moment.
Her thoughts were somewhat chaotic, always feeling that Han Li’s intentional leak of information was far from simple.
...
…….
Yuanchu Mountain.
A silvery battle skirt outlined Empress Yuanchu’s perfect figure, curvaceous and well-proportioned, fueling one’s imagination.
In her hand was a Silver Long Spear, as she gazed in the direction of Qianyuan Divine Province, a hint of unusual light flickering in her beautiful eyes.
“What exactly gives him such confidence?
The two True Immortal weapons?”
Empress Yuanchu felt puzzled in her heart.
Han Li’s recent behavior was too abnormal, completely out of line with his usual low-profile ways.
Han Li’s high-profile stance this time likely means that quite a few supremes will obstruct his way, hoping to quash the significant threat he poses in a battle.
Even with two True Immortal weapons, Chengsheng Mountain would not be able to withstand the collective force of all these supremes.
“Let me see what gives you the audacity.”
Like Empress Phoenix Moon, Empress Yuanchu also planned to go there when the time came, and would decide how to act at that moment.
……
White Emperor City.
Taibai Immortal Realm.
“Bang!”
The White Emperor exploded a Divine Mountain with a slap, his face still seething with anger.
“Damn it, how can Han Li cultivate so quickly?” the White Emperor cursed and muttered.
He wanted to emulate Han Li’s low-profile approach, to live quietly as someone who keeps a low profile, enduring through the long years before seeking revenge against Han Li.
But with Han Li’s speed of cultivation, he felt he couldn’t hold on : it was like waiting for death.
Given the enmity between him and Han Li, once Han Li becomes powerful enough to be unmatched in Yuankun Domain, he would definitely kill him.
“Don’t blame me for being ruthless; you forced my hand.”
The White Emperor’s mind raced with countless thoughts, and he finally resolved that the low-profile path was ultimately not for him.
One day, the White Emperor stealthily left Taibai Immortal Realm and headed to the Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, Longevity Qin Family, and other such formidable forces.
He intended to unite all parties to form the Han Condemnation Alliance and obliterate Chengsheng Mountain.
……
Han Li, however, was unconcerned about all this, as he had leaked the information on purpose, intending to bait his enemies.
The time of tribulation was the most vulnerable to disruption, and if anyone intended to block his path, Han Li wouldn’t hesitate; he would kill them on the spot, assume command of their forces, and thereby strengthen Chengsheng Mountain’s foundation.
Now his progeny numbered in the millions, and along with their wives, husbands, Guest Elders, protectors, maids, and guards, the count had surpassed ten million.
If not for the numerous Qiankun Spells laid out within Chengsheng Mountain, it wouldn’t have been possible to accommodate so many.
In response, Han Li implemented three strategies: one was to continually raise the height of more than a dozen peaks of Chengsheng Mountain, another was to expand the mountain range and grab more territory, and the last was to relocate descendants to develop other areas.
Now that he had Golden Immortal weapons, he would surely be unrivaled in Yuankun Domain in the future.
The future of Han Mansion was no longer in great danger, so spreading out his descendants to various locations in Qianyuan Divine Province and even throughout Yuankun Domain was the best choice.
Doing so would allow for better control of Yuankun Domain, acquiring more wealth and resources, and speeding up the population growth of Han Mansion.
In time, only the exceptional descendants who passed through various selections would be brought to Chengsheng Mountain for further advancement, to enjoy all kinds of welfare and cultivate to even higher realms.
As for whether this approach was not favorable for the future relocation of Han Mansion outside of Yuankun Domain?
Han Li wasn’t too concerned, because there was still a very long time before the next major catastrophe in Yuankun Domain.
He planned to let Han Mansion grow wildly for two hundred million years; by then, he might even have the power to confront an Immortal Emperor directly and would naturally not have to worry about the mastermind behind the scenes.
Inside Qiandao Hall.
Han Li sat cross-legged on a Purple Jade Cushion, calming his mind and spirit, then began his breakthrough.
After consuming a vast amount of cultivation, he finally pushed his ultimate martial dao principle to the peak of Quasi Emperor.
Han Li’s aura surged, and his cultivation reached the pinnacle of Quasi Emperor.
Then, once he was ready, and all parties were also prepared, Han Li left Chengsheng Mountain.
He arrived at the vast sea area between Qianyuan Divine Province and Luming Divine Province, where he had chosen to undergo his tribulation.
Han Li intended to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm here, and kill those who would obstruct his way, if they dared to do so.
PS1: This book will not be abandoned; don’t believe any rumors.
It will be written to at least two million characters.
As for requesting leave, I’ve taken one day off in the past two months, and one day this month as well; after requesting off yesterday, there will be no more leaves in July.
PS2: Starting tomorrow I will be making up for the updates, with daily releases of eight to ten thousand characters, and I’ll push the plot further back, striving to end Volume Three this month.

chapters.title: Chapter 701
chapters.content:
Chapter 701: Chapter 268: All Parties Arrive, Hongshang and Weiyang Break Through Heaven Imperial Realm, Certifying the Great Tribulation!_1 Chapter 701: Chapter 268: All Parties Arrive, Hongshang and Weiyang Break Through Heaven Imperial Realm, Certifying the Great Tribulation!_1 Yuankun Domain, Han Sea.
The Han Sea, vast and boundless, stretches to Luming Divine Province in the east and to Qianyuan Divine Province in the west.
Atop a majestic Divine Mountain in Luming Divine Province stood two peerless beauties with exquisite figures.
One was dressed in a silver battle skirt, the other in golden armorâ€”none other than Empress Yuanchu and Empress Huangyue, two peerless empresses.
Both empresses, harboring the same intentions, had come to this spot, and the coincidence of their choice could only be described as fate.
“Hongshang, what do you plan to do?”
Empress Yuanchu looked at the empress beside her, whose beauty was not inferior to her own, lips slightly parted as her melodious voice flowed smoothly.
Upon hearing the name “Hongshang,” Empress Huangyue’s phoenix brows raised slightly.
...
It had been a long time since anyone had called her by that name.
In fact, few knew her real name, as people simply referred to her as Empress Huangyue.
Empress Yuanchu was, of course, aware of her real name, but given the unease in their past relationship, she would not have referred to her so intimately.
“Let’s just take it one step at a time.”
Empress Huangyue looked out toward the Han Sea, her tone indistinct, tinged with a hint of powerlessness.
Empress Yuanchu keenly picked up on this detail, her heart skipping a beatâ€”it seemed her ancient rival felt the same as herself.
“The Bai Emperor has become active these days, eagerly rallying various formidable forces.
Will you make a move?”
Casting aside distracting thoughts and calming her mind, Empress Yuanchu asked again.
Ever since the news spread that Han Li intended to transcend tribulation and prove his dao, the Bai Emperor eventually couldn’t contain himself.
After connecting with powerful forces like the Western Sky Palace and the Heavenly Cult, he even visited Yuanchu Mountain and Huangyue Imperial Empire, the purpose being self-evident.
Empress Yuanchu and Empress Huangyue had a complicated relationship with Han Li.
Although they initially wished nothing more than his demise, no action had been taken for so long.
Moreover, considering the words once spoken by Han Li, rumors had already been flying everywhere.
The Bai Emperor was worried that the two peerless empresses would aid Han Li, so he went to test the waters and was somewhat satisfied with the results.
It seemed that Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu were leaning towards staying neutral.
Although the Bai Emperor was not entirely content with them not obstructing the path, as long as the two empresses did not side with Han Li, it was the best result possible.
Otherwise, the opposition would possess four True Immortal weapons.
Their “Han Condemnation Alliance” might not even succeed, likely shaking the troops’ morale, causing some vacillating forces to directly pull out.
“Weiyang, since both of us have appeared here, why speak of such matters?” Empress Huangyue smiled, a smile so radiant that it overshadowed all the mountains, rivers, and all living beings.
Empress Yuanchu shrugged, creating surging waves with the motion, and even her stunningly beautiful face showed a smile.
“Then let them fight it out.”
“Okay, and let’s see what other abilities Han Li has.”
“I think he’s quite extraordinary.
With his behavior, if he’s not absolutely confident, he wouldn’t have been so high-profile.”
“Could it be Han Li is full of pride, getting carried away by his success?”
“Do you think that’s likely?”
“Hard to say.”
“Hongshang, do you think there’s a possibility that Han Li is not from our Yuankun Domain…”
“What is Weiyang trying to say?”
“Beyond the Yuankun Domain.”
Empress Huangyue’s pupils contracted sharply.
Empress Yuanchu, looking towards Xuanshen Sword Mountain, felt an unrest in her heart.
……..
Qianyuan Divine Province, Chengsheng Mountain.
Lu Tianxiang, Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, and other beloved wives and consorts of Han Li gathered together.
Even Feng Mian, Qin Shiyin, and Yang Zhiyun, his fiancÃ©es, were present.
The atmosphere was somewhat heavy.
“Will our husband encounter any mishaps doing this?” Lin Yiwu was the first to break the silence.
Some remained silent, clearly uncertain.
“We must have faith in our husband.”
“Exactly, if he’s doing this, he must have planned everything meticulously.”
“I think we just go about our business as usual, no need to worry here.
When our husband returns, he’ll be a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.”
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yuan Youwei, and others voiced their great confidence in Han Li.
Zhang Yuyan, Yao Xi, Murong Ying, Xue Qingyi, Qiu Shuhui, Chu Yumeng, and other adoring wives and consorts also expressed their opinions one after another.
Heavenly Immortal Feng Mian and the empress Qin Shiyin did not utter a word, merely observing, yet in their hearts, there was not a trace of worry.
They were all aware that Han Li wielded a Golden Immortal weapon.
This public act of proving himself in the Heaven Imperial Realm was a clear bait.
Should anyone dare to obstruct him!
Feng Mian and Qin Shiyin had no doubt that their husband Han Li would wreak havoc, heads rolling in carnage, blood staining the Han Sea crimson.
“Shiyin and I should go take a look,” Feng Mian suddenly said, facing a room of discussing sisters.
Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, Bai Keqing, Ji Mingyue, Chu Xianlin, Zhou Zhirou, and other women exchanged glances, agreeing with her decision.
Among all Han Li’s beloved wives and consorts, it was the fiancÃ©es Qin Shiyin and Feng Mian who had the highest cultivation levels.
If they went to watch the battle, they would also possess the strength to defend themselves.
If an accident occurred, they could even provide some assistance.
“Sounds good,” Qin Shiyin nodded, still clad in a black dress with white stockings, perfectly highlighting her superb figure.
Seeing that all her sisters agreed, Qin Shiyin, along with Feng Mian, vanished from Chengdao Peak and rushed towards the Han Sea at incredible speed.
As the stakes were high, to prevent anyone from seizing the opportunity to attack his stronghold, Han Li had left the Primordial Spirit-imbued Heavenly Axe at Chengsheng Mountain to stand guard.
With their profound cultivation, Qin Shiyin and Feng Mian soon arrived at the Han Sea.
They saw Han Li, standing in the middle of the Han Sea, hands behind his back, his demeanor peerless.
The two women did not approach but watched from afar, concealing their auras to avoid detection by others.
Feng Mian, as a late-stage Heavenly Immortal of the Linghuang Clan, possessed a True Immortal weapon, a Phoenix Feather named Jade Phoenix Feather.
It was crafted from the tail feathers of a dying Linghuang True Immortal combined with Jade Phoenix Immortal Gold and branded with the laws of a True Immortal rank.
