chapters.content:
Chapter 702: Chapter 268: All Parties Arrive, Hongshang and Weiyang Break Through Heaven Imperial Realm, Certifying the Great Tribulation!_2 Chapter 702: Chapter 268: All Parties Arrive, Hongshang and Weiyang Break Through Heaven Imperial Realm, Certifying the Great Tribulation!_2 “`
Qin Shiyin, though without a True Immortal weapon and not even possessing a Heavenly Immortal weapon, had in her hands three pieces of the Jade Talisman of Creation, one of which was a core fragment.
Now that the three pieces had merged, the grade remained at Supreme Grade Imperial weapons, yet its power was no weaker than most Heavenly Immortal weapons.
Qin Shiyin had already made up her mind that once she marries Han Li, she would go in search of other fragments of the Jade Talisman of Creation, hoping to eventually restore it to the world.
The complete Jade Talisman of Creation was powerful enough to rival True Immortal weapons; although it couldn’t further elevate the status of Chengsheng Mountain, it could certainly raise her own status there.
Among Han Li’s numerous beloved wives and concubines, how many actually possessed True Immortal weapons?
…….
At this moment, in the central region of the Han Sea.
...
Han Li stood leisurely with his hands behind his back, his figure tall and straight, his face jade-like, adorned in fluttering white robes, radiating an extremely formidable aura that stirred the waves and surges of the vast ocean.
Han Li’s gaze burned bright, sweeping across skies and sea floors, taking in everything from every direction, with a faint smile playing on his lips.
Those people indeed had come!
In the surroundings of the Han Sea, an immense congregation of Saints, Quasi Emperors, and even Great Emperors gathered, all silently observing this place.
Normally, a Quasi Emperor’s ascension wouldn’t attract so many Saints and Quasi Emperors, let alone a host of Great Emperors, but who asked for today’s ascendant to be Han Li?
The moment the news of Han Li’s impending ascension spread throughout the Yuankun Domain, it set off a sensation.
Anyone with a nimble mind knew that this day would go down in history.
The reason for this, perhaps, was that the most intense and brutal battle of this era was poised to erupt today.
Above the Han Sea, several supreme beings were concealed, the Master of Western Sky Palace, the White Emperor, the Butian Sect Master, the Master of Tianji Pavilion, the Supreme Leader of Qin Family, the Supreme Leader of Jiang Family, and the Solar Deity, all positioned in various places.
Although they concealed their auras with True Immortal weapons, they couldn’t evade Han Li’s eyes, since he had borrowed the power of a strand of the Chaotic Cauldron.
To Han Li’s surprise, the two he had most eagerly anticipated, the Guanghan Empress and Empress Yuanchu, who were far away, hiding atop a Divine Mountain in the central part of the Luming Divine Province, hadn’t come to join the siege against him.
Had they discovered something was amiss in advance?
Whether they had uncovered some clues or it was the intuition of the empresses, Han Li was indifferent.
After this battle, the Yuankun Domain would be his.
Even if he didn’t retain the Guanghan Empress and Empress Yuanchu, these peerless empresses, once returned, would likely live in trepidation, awaiting his arrival to propose marriage, wouldn’t they?
This made Han Li think of the Bodhisattva Han Linxi.
“Huffâ€””
Withdrawing his gaze, he exhaled softly.
Han Li stopped suppressing his own aura.
Boom!
Han Li’s aura, comparable to that of an Emperor in the Heaven Imperial Realm, burst forth unrestrained, darkening the sun and moon, bringing winds and clouds to change color, piercing through the clouds, and shaking the Nine Heavens.
The terrifying aura swept through heavens and earth in all directions, causing the spectators to pale at the sight.
It appeared that the strength of the Longevity Emperor had grown even more formidable than before.
“Late stage of Heaven Imperial Realm?”
Supreme leaders like those from the Qin Family, the White Emperor, the Master of Western Sky Palace, the Butian Sect Master, and others had their expressions change.
This was definitely the aura of the late stage of the Heaven Imperial Realm, yet Han Li was just at the pinnacle of a Quasi Emperor!
Previously, Han Li hadn’t been so strong.
Could it be that he had not reached the pinnacle of Quasi Emperor before?
This was too terrifying!
Fortunately, they had come today; otherwise, were Han Li to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm and undergo a heaven-shaking transformation in strength, he might catch up with supreme beings like them at the absolute summit of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Given Han Li’s rate of growth, it wouldn’t take many years for him to surpass them and enter the Battle Immortal Realm, at which point the threat he posed would be even greater.
Today, Han Li must be slain!
The threat must be eradicated in advance!
The White Emperor’s eyes were heavy with a fierce intent to kill, and so were the Master of Western Sky Palace, the Butian Sect Master, and others, extremely wary of Han Li.
Even the strong figures like those from the Qin Family, the Supreme Leader of the Jiang Family, who had not previously taken a stand and came just to watch, now revealed a hint of killing intent in their eyes.
The threat Han Li posed was too significant for them to remain seated.
The Solar Deity was expressionless; even though Han Li posed such a great threat, he did not show any intent to kill, and only he knew what he was thinking.
The Solar Empire and Chengsheng Mountain were on the verge of a marital alliance, and his daughter, Yang Zhiyun, was staying at Chengsheng Mountain.
Counting their connection, Han Li would soon be calling him father-in-law.
“`
Yang Zhiyun and Han Li had not yet married, so if Han Li were to die, he would be able to protect his daughter in time.
But, would Han Li really die here?
Yang Zhiyun, being at Chengsheng Mountain, had been exposed to many of Han Li’s core secrets.
Although she couldn’t reveal them to her father, she still gave him some hints.
That’s why the Solar Empire’s ruler hesitated, unsure whether to join the Han Condemnation Alliance.
Emperor Tianji, on the other side, with the Heavenly Path Roulette above his head, had an ever-changing expression.
He too was uncertain whether to take action.
Han Li posed a great threat and was seeking to settle scores with him, but Emperor Tianji could handle all these issues.
As a neutral force, Han Li wouldn’t rashly attack Tianji Pavilion given his nature.
If he took action, although he would be targeting Han Li, he would also break the principle of neutrality.
Henceforth, maintaining neutrality would be impossible, as other Supreme Leaders wouldn’t allow it, which troubled him most.
But if he didn’t take action, the other Supreme Leaders would certainly demand accountability afterward, and when the time came to divide Chengsheng Mountain, Tianji Pavilion would have no share.
“With five Supreme Leaders acting, can they kill Han Li?” Emperor Tianji muttered to himself.
The involvement of five Supreme Leaders meant that the five most powerful forces will also deploy their True Immortal Weapons.
Han Li’s two True Immortal Weapons could barely compete, and even if he had two more, it would not make a difference.
When the True Immortal Weapons clash, it’s all about the other hidden strengths.
Han Li’s Heavenly Immortal Weapons would also be suppressed.
What else would Han Li have then?
Even if he had numerous Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor Weapons, it wouldn’t change the situation.
The five most powerful forces joined together would certainly have more Emperor Weapons than Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li, alone and unsupported, even with late-stage Heaven Imperial Realm combat ability, how could he contend against the five Supreme Leaders at the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm?
He was doomed without a doubt!
But such an obvious fact, could Han Li be unaware of it?
Emperor Tianji didn’t believe that Han Li would make such a decision in a muddled state.
If Han Li was aware and still dared to do this, where did his confidence come from?
Just as various powerhouses were deep in thought, Han Li began his breakthrough.
With a single thought from Han Li, a massive amount of cultivation was consumed instantaneously, bringing him into an ultimate state of Enlightenment.
In just a moment, Han Li completed the final piece of his ultimate martial dao doctrine’s rudimentary framework, achieving a complete and mastered doctrine.
In an instant, Han Li’s aura surged, his realm grew rapidly, advancing toward the Heaven Imperial Realm.
His martial prowess, physical body, Primordial Spirit, Divine Sense, five senses, Divine Sense, mana, and all other aspects were strengthening.
With every passing moment, Han Li’s aura became several times stronger.
Climbing higher and higher, rapidly gaining strength, a formidable aura spread out in all directions, each wave several times stronger than the one before.
Han Li hadn’t completed his breakthrough, and the sky was already gathering a dark sea of clouds, thunderclouds covering the sun and sky, imposing and profound, like a vast world of thunder spanning across the Nine Heavens.
Within the thunder sea, infinite thunder of destruction rapidly converged, each bolt terrifyingly boundless, capable of annihilating a common Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, able to destroy vast Star Domains.
This once again changed the expressions of all who were watching.
Han Li’s tribulation for proving his dao was much more terrifying than those recorded in ancient history or experienced by them.
“Truly worthy of being my future husband.”
Above the Nine Heavens of Han Sea, the Guanghan Empress watched this scene with a slight smile on her lips.
The creatures in the Yuankun Domain might not comprehend, but as an Immortal Emperor, she had seen much and guessed that Han Li’s tribulation for proving his dao was one of the few strongest kinds, as told in legends.
Indeed, only by overcoming the strongest tribulation could one break through all the way up, have an unlimited future, be invincible on the third step, and be unkillable.
The Guanghan Empress waved her sleeves lightly, concealing all fluctuations of Han Li’s tribulation, preventing it from being detected by certain powers, like the former Emperor of Heaven.
Although she was merely a wisp of a Divine Spirit, she had mastered extremely profound and powerful immortal Divine Skills.
The former Emperor of Heaven was not here, and the Emperor Sword left behind had been in deep slumber all along.
The Emperor Sword would quietly awaken only after certain intervals, most of its power used to conceal the divine secrets and isolate space-time, and with just a sliver of its might, it pierced through the Yuankun Domain.
With her covering, no one could detect someone undergoing the strongest tribulation for proving the dao in the Yuankun Domain.
At that moment, the thunder sea in the sky fully formed, boundless and infinite, actually covering the entire Yuankun Domain.
Boom!
The first heavenly thunderbolt ferociously descended.
PS: There will be a second chapter tonight to finish this part.

chapters.content:
Chapter 703: Chapter 269: The Intentions of the Two Empresses, the Ninety-Nine Heavenly Tribulations, Slaying the Young Quasi Immortal Emperor, the Advent of the Human Tribulation!_1 Chapter 703: Chapter 269: The Intentions of the Two Empresses, the Ninety-Nine Heavenly Tribulations, Slaying the Young Quasi Immortal Emperor, the Advent of the Human Tribulation!_1 The ferocious and violent tribulation descended, carrying the might to destroy heavens and earth.
Han Li stood resolute and unafraid, calm and composed, flicking his fingers lightly and shattering the thunder that could have slain a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor.
Han Li became more cautious in his heart, knowing that his greatest enemy was not the supremes of Yuankun Domain, but the tribulation itself.
When undergoing the tribulation to prove his Dao, he could use his own life-bound imperial weapon, but not other weapons, otherwise the might of the tribulation would increase dramatically.
One must rely on oneself to pass the tribulation; external objects are useless.
Fortunately, Han Li had already been preparing for this, and although his tribulation was difficult, Han Li was confident he could pass through it.
Yet, the power of this tribulation still somewhat exceeded Han Li’s expectations, the first strike of the tribulation already possessed the full power of a first-layer Heaven Imperial Realm.
...
For ordinary beings proving their Dao at the Heaven Imperial Realm, the last strike of the tribulation would only be at this level.
Han Li estimated this was most likely the influence of his cultivation in the ultimate martial way.
It seemed Han Li’s disdainful attitude incensed the boundless sea of thunder, causing it to become agitated, as thunderbolts fell one after another, quickly reaching thirty-six thunderbolts.
The further it went, the stronger the might of the thunderbolts became.
After every nine thunderbolts, the might would undergo a qualitative transformation, and even Han Li’s expression gradually turned solemn.
In Luming Divine Province, at Guangming Divine Mountain.
Empress Yuanchu and Empress Huang Yue exchanged glances, both seeing boundless gravity and infinite shock in each other’s eyes.
Han Li’s potential was much higher than they had anticipated, which was no wonder the White Emperor was so eager to unite with other supremes to seize the chance to kill Han Li.
“Hongshang, what level do you think Han Li’s tribulation is?
Really just the fifty-nine heavenly tribulations?”
Empress Yuanchu’s expression was extremely solemn, and her voice even trembled slightly.
In this era, Yuankun Domain had actually produced such a supreme being like Han Li, whom even exceptional empresses like themselves did not match.
If Han Li could successfully overcome this tribulation, she would willingly become Han Li’s Dao companion, as only Han Li was worthy of her.
But passing the tribulation was not so easy; apart from the heavenly tribulation, there was also a human tribulation.
Those supremes would definitely take advantage of the situation to kill Han Li.
“Could it be the sixty-nine heavenly tribulations?”
“Miyang, could he truly be a supreme being from the outside world, reincarnated here?” Empress Huang Yue’s red lips parted to ask, her voice resonating like the heavens, yet her mood was far from calm.
From ancient times in Yuankun Domain, the tribulation for proving the Heaven Imperial Realm consisted of the nineteen heavenly tribulations, the twenty-nine heavenly tribulations…up to the fifty-nine heavenly tribulations.
Ordinary Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors would face nine bolts of heavenly thunder.
The more bolts they endured, the greater their potential was and the stronger they became after the breakthrough.
For empresses like Huang Yue and Yuanchu, who had undergone the fifty-nine heavenly tribulations, comprised of a total of forty-five bolts of thunder, it was extremely terrifying, with might that had reached the third layer of the Heaven Imperial Realm and even touched upon the fourth layer.
Even for these peerless empresses, to pass through such a frightening tribulation required pulling out all the stops; they nearly died in the process.
And as for the sixty-nine, seventy-nine, eighty-nine, and ninety-nine heavenly tribulations, these were Immortal Tribulations which, in theory, could transform into tribulations for proving the Dao, but even Empress Huang Yue had never seen them before and there were no records of them in ancient histories.
How long had it been for Han Li?
He had already gone through the forty-nine heavenly tribulations, and the might of the tribulation already surpassed their fifty-nine heavenly tribulations.
“The signs so far indicate that Han Li must be a supreme being reincarnated from the outside world; otherwise how could he be so monstrous?” Empress Yuanchu said with a complex expression.
They were about to witness history today, as the ancient records of Yuankun Domain would notch a page unparalleled in both past and future.
Judging by Han Li’s current momentum, it was definitely not just the fifty-nine heavenly tribulations, not even just the sixty-nine heavenly tribulations, and perhaps it could even touch upon the legendary ninety-nine heavenly tribulations.
“Miyang, if he truly passes, he will become the number one person in Yuankun Domain.”
“His future will be immeasurable, and although Yuankun Domain faces a great calamity, it won’t be able to stop him, so…”
Empress Huang Yue stopped suddenly, her thoughts complicated.
Empress Yuanchu understood her meaning, but her heart was in turmoil, unable to make a decision in the moment.
They would have to wait and see.
If their conjecture was true, and Han Li was a supreme being from the outside world, then why would he reincarnate in a prison land like Yuankun Domain?
It was probably to avoid calamity.
……
Above the Han Sea, the numerous supremes watched Han Li undergoing tribulation with chilling expressions and intense killing intent.
The forty-nine heavenly tribulations that Han Li was going through actually possessed the might of a fourth-layer Heaven Imperial Realm, far stronger than their own tribulations.
If Han Li were allowed to continue growing, in the future there would be no place for them in Yuankun Domain; although Han Li was relatively restrained for now, once his strength became unmatched, he would inevitably infringe upon their interests.
Not to mention other things, just Han Li’s frenzy of taking wives and concubines was something they couldn’t tolerate.
If Han Li became invincible in Yuankun Domain and completely dominated them, they would be forced to offer their daughters to Han Li, sending him beauties with outstanding talent and breathtaking beauty from within their forces.
From then on, the high-quality beautiful female cultivators of Yuankun Domain would have nothing to do with themâ€”how could they bear this?
The descendants of Han Mansion were already numerous, and another thousand years of development would see them spread across Yuankun Domain.
These descendants of Han Mansion also enjoyed frequently taking wives and concubines.
The disciples within their own forces would lack competitiveness, unable to contend with the progeny of Han Mansion, and as this continued, Han Mansion would accumulate all of Yuankun Domain’s chosen ones.
In the end, these forces might well be silently and imperceptibly assimilated by Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion.
“Han Li’s tribulation is too strong; we must not let him live,” the master of Western Sky Palace declared in a deep voice.
“This is about to break the records of ancient history.
What a monster,” the Supreme Leader of Jiang Family exclaimed with emotion.

chapters.content:
Chapter 704: Chapter 269: The Intentions of the Two Empresses, the Ninety-Nine Heavenly Tribulations, Slaying the Young Quasi Immortal Emperor, the Advent of the Human Tribulation!_2 Chapter 704: Chapter 269: The Intentions of the Two Empresses, the Ninety-Nine Heavenly Tribulations, Slaying the Young Quasi Immortal Emperor, the Advent of the Human Tribulation!_2 “Heh, the more monstrous his talent, the harder the tribulation he faces to prove his path.
Maybe we won’t even have to lift a finger, and Han Li will die in the heavenly tribulation,” said the Butian Sect Master expressionlessly.
“Let’s hope so,” the Supreme Leader of Qin Family replied succinctly.
“I actually hope he makes it through, to give him hope before plunging him into despair,” the Empress Yuanchu said, her face so cold it might drip with chill.
She was very glad of her decision; if she had continued to play it safe, it would have been a slow suicide.
Fortunately, she acted in time, contacting the various supremes to come and stop the tribulation and to kill Han Li beforehand.
Han Li’s tribulation was so powerful that even they, at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, dared not interfere, lest they bring disaster upon themselves and their fates become unpredictable.
...
After passing the tribulation, it’s often the time when Great Emperors of Heaven Imperial Realm are at their weakest, so the Empress Yuanchu and the other four supremes chose this moment to strike, planning to kill Han Li outright.
Within the Han Sea, the wild thunder continued to fall, intent on destroying Han Li.
The Thirty-seventh Heavenly Thunder!
The Fortieth Heavenly Thunder!
The Forty-fifth Heavenly Thunder!
When Han Li shattered this thunder with one punch, the entire sea of thunder trembled, as if it was about to disperse, or perhaps it was brewing an even more terrifying heavenly tribulation.
Han Li’s expression became slightly grave; he knew that the upcoming thunder tribulations would get stronger and stronger, making it more and more difficult for him.
Fortunately, he hadn’t completely stepped into the Heaven Imperial Realm yet.
His strength was still skyrocketing, or else fighting against the fifty-ninth heavenly tribulation wouldn’t have been so easy, obliterated with a single punch.
Before his tribulation, he was at the peak of the Quasi Emperor stage, his combat ability reaching the late stages of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
If he invoked his Divine Sense domain, it would be incomparably powerful; although not touching upon the Battle Immortal Realm, it was nonetheless not inferior to most supremes.
And now, his combat ability was nearing that of a Battle Immortal.
Even the Immortal Kings and the Empress Yuanchu couldn’t match him when they invoked their Divine Sense.
Once he stepped into the Heaven Imperial Realm, his strength would undergo a radical transformation, which also had to do with the heavenly tribulation.
If he didn’t overcome the tribulation, he would die; but with each round of tribulation passed, he would gain fortune and further enhance his combat ability.
Han Li had a premonition that once he truly passed the great tribulation of proving his path, even without invoking his Divine Sense, his combat ability might approach that of a Battle Immortal, or even truly touch its threshold.
As Han Li, numerous supremes, and the two peerless empresses, as well as countless onlookers watched, the new heavenly tribulation descended, causing an outcry of shock.
Weapon Tribulation!
With the fifty-ninth heavenly tribulation, the first in this sequence actually took the form of weapons, different from the Immortal Tribulation, but equally terrifying.
This heavenly thunder took the form of a celestial blade, forged entirely of thunder, containing boundless might.
With a single slash, countless great stars could be destroyed in an instant.
Looking at this thunderous celestial blade, Han Li’s expression also grew more serious.
Unlike the beings in the Yuankun Domain, he knew more about the proving tribulation.
In the Tai Chu Realm, there are at most nine rounds of tribulations, known as the Nine-Nine Heavenly Tribulations; the fifty-ninth is the Weapon Tribulation.
The tribulation brings forth the strongest nine imperial weapons, imprinted in the annals of history, possessing extremely powerful might.
And by the seventy-ninth heavenly tribulation, they would face nine young Immortal Kings; the eighty-ninth brings forth nine young Immortal Kings, and the ninety-ninth summons nine young Immortal Heirs.
Han Li circulated his Cultivation Technique, his vast and boundless mana surged forth, supporting him as he activated various formidable martial techniques to fight against the tribulation.
The Fifty-Ninth Heavenly Tribulation!
The Seventy-Ninth Heavenly Tribulation!
The Eighty-Ninth Heavenly Tribulation!
The Ninety-Ninth Heavenly Tribulation!
The final young Quasi Immortal Emperor emerged from the sea of thunder, his gaze serene, exuding the aura of one who reigns supreme over the world, capable of suppressing the heavens and the earth with his invincible presence.
Even Han Li revealed an extremely solemn expression.
His combat ability had reached the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and this young Quasi Immortal Emperor was likewise at the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, terrifyingly formidable.
You should know, their realms were only at the first layer of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Facing the strongest young Quasi Immortal Emperor, Han Li also had to be serious; although their realms were the same, the other’s true body had long reached the realm of the Quasi Immortal Emperor, wielding incredibly powerful Dao.
Under the interference of the Dao, his combat ability was much stronger than that of the average pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Han Li was acutely aware of this.
He had already slain eight young Quasi Immortal Emperors who had emerged from the tribulation â€” he was very aware of how terrifying they were.
Being imprinted in the heavenly tribulation was an honor, an affirmation.
How glorious, how affirming was it?
Only the nine most powerful unbeatable warriors of that realm gained such distinguished honor.
Although Han Li had slain the eight young Quasi Immortal Emperors, it didn’t mean he would be stronger than those eight once he himself became a Quasi Immortal Emperor; it only meant he was stronger than they were during the Heaven Imperial Realm.
“You, are quite remarkable.”
It was at this moment that the ninth young Quasi Immortal Emperor suddenly spoke.
A trace of surprise appeared in Han Li’s eyes; this was not consistent with the intelligence he had, the Tai Chu Realm also had no lack of strong men and women who had transcended the Ninety-Ninth Heavenly Tribulation, but there had never been records of figures shown by the heavenly tribulation being able to speak.
Was this consciousness?
Or was their true body controlling it?
As Han Li’s pupils constricted, the young Quasi Immortal Emperor clad in sumptuous purple garments once again became cold and merciless, ceased speaking, and directly attacked Han Li.
Han Li did not hesitate to engage, soaring into the air to engage the young Quasi Immortal Emperor in fierce combat, easily calling forth numerous powerful martial techniques, slightly suppressing the opponent.
Boom!
The young Quasi Immortal Emperor’s aura suddenly surged, transforming into a Battle Immortal with a strike of his palm that shattered the void and seemed to halt time itself.
Simultaneously, Han Li also unhesitatingly invoked his Divine Sense, punching out to clash directly with the young Quasi Immortal Emperor.
The two engaged in fierce battle high in the heavens, and on the Han Sea, even descending to the bottom of the Han Sea to fight, causing vast amounts of the sea to evaporate in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 705
chapters.content:
Chapter 705: Chapter 269: The Intentions of the Two Empresses, the Ninety-Nine Heavenly Tribulations, Slaying the Young Quasi Immortal Emperor, the Advent of the Human Tribulation!_3 Chapter 705: Chapter 269: The Intentions of the Two Empresses, the Ninety-Nine Heavenly Tribulations, Slaying the Young Quasi Immortal Emperor, the Advent of the Human Tribulation!_3 After clashing once again, both parties were thrown backward simultaneously, Han Li’s expression grew deeply serious, as he had sustained serious injuries.
When he had subdued the previous eight junior Quasi Immortal Emperors, he had only been lightly wounded, but in fighting against the ninth junior Quasi Immortal Emperor, without even having defeated him yet, he had already suffered quite severe injuries.
Although the injuries soon healed, it also indicated that this junior Quasi Immortal Emperor was much stronger than the previous eight.
“If this is all you’ve got, then prepare to die,”
With his Cultivation Technique in motion, Han Li’s injuries were completely healed, and his aura surged even higher as he actively charged towards the junior Quasi Immortal Emperor.
With every step he took, a layer of heaven would condense beneath his feet, and by the time he reached the junior Quasi Immortal Emperor, he had swiftly taken thirty-six steps.
In an instant, the power of thirty-six heavens were bestowed upon Han Li, who, with a single point of his finger, aimed to annihilate the junior Quasi Immortal Emperor.
Luming Divine Province.
...
“This is terrifying!”
The Phoenix Moon Empress and Empress Yuanchu exchanged a glance, both filled with endless horror, genuinely frightened, with indescribable feelings stirring within them.
Han Li had truly accomplished it.
His tribulation not only exceeded the Five Nine Heavenly Tribulation, but had actually brought forth the Nine Nine Heavenly Tribulation all at once.
This terrifying tribulation would have been certain death for them if faced during their initial ascendance.
Even now, if they were to confront the Eight Nine Heavenly Tribulation, they wouldn’t be confident in overcoming it, let alone the Nine Nine Heavenly Tribulation.
The nine mighty figures manifested from the Nine Nine Heavenly Tribulation truly possessed the capability to dominate the heavens and the earth, with an invincible bearing that surpassed both the ancient and modern times, each akin to a Battle Immortal, comparable to a Heavenly Immortal when Divine Sense was invoked.
And Han Li, the one who had designs on them, turned out to be just as formidable.
The first eight junior Battle Immortals were subdued by Han Li, and even though the final junior Battle Immortal was extremely powerful, Han Li had him pinned down, with the outcome about to be revealed.
“To have combat ability at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm with just one layer of Heaven Imperial Realm, and even stepping into the Battle Immortal Realm upon invoking Divine Sense, is truly monstrous,” Empress Yuanchu said with fascination sparkling in her beautiful eyes.
“Yes, indeed, we are witnessing history today.
Our Yuankun Domain is going to see the rise of a supreme powerhouse.”
The Phoenix Moon Empress also had continuous flashes of brilliance in her eyes, thoroughly admiring Han Li’s strength, her attitude unconsciously shifting.
What they had sought all their lives and still hadn’t achieved until today, remaining outside the realm of Battle Immortals, was something Han Li had attained.
Keep in mind, they were at the very peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, while Han Li was merely at the first layer of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
The gap between them was as vast as that between a firefly and the bright moon.
“Once Han Li gets through the great tribulation, I will make my move,” the Phoenix Moon Empress said solemnly, naturally intending to assist.
Empress Yuanchu suddenly extended her soft, boneless hand to caress the Phoenix Moon Empress’s flawless face, teasing, “Hong Chang, you haven’t fallen for him, have you?”
The Phoenix Moon Empress swatted away Empress Yuanchu’s hand with a cold snort and said indifferently, “That I have not.
Unless he comes knocking for marriage.”
“Also, don’t think I’m unaware of the naughty thoughts in your head.
Don’t bother pretending with me,”
Empress Yuanchu replied with a charming smile, “Well, I’m curious to see to which family Han Li will propose first.”
While the two peerless Empresses were chatting casually, the master of the Western Sky Palace, the Supreme Leader of the Qin Family, the White Emperor, and five other supremes were also conspiring with limitless murderous intent.
They decided that the moment the great calamity passed, they would immediately strike and kill Han Li without giving him any chance to escape.
Although Han Li was a Battle Immortal with two True Immortal weapons and infinite potential, after all, he would be unable to withstand their five True Immortal weapons.
