chapters.content:
Chapter 706: Chapter 270: The World-Shocking Spear of the Great Dao!
The Five Grand Supremes Launch an Assault!
The Five Terrified Grand Supremes_1 Chapter 706: Chapter 270: The World-Shocking Spear of the Great Dao!
The Five Grand Supremes Launch an Assault!
The Five Terrified Grand Supremes_1 Boom!
The ninth young Quasi Immortal Emperor’s body exploded into pieces, flung backwards, reassembling in the distance.
His eyes burned brightly, as if to speak again, but ultimately, he failed to do so.
...
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back at the summit of the heavens, his white robe peerless, his face, sculpted like jade, adorned with a faint smile, quite satisfied with that one finger strike.
That finger contained the power of thirty-six heavens, and even the mightily unrivaled Quasi Immortal Emperor youth could not withstand it.
In the Taichu Realm, Quasi Immortal Emperors are also known as Immortal Heirs, positioned between Immortal Kings and Immortal Emperors.
To break through from King to Emperor, one must first achieve Quasi Immortal Emperor status, with great disparities in strength between realms.
As one of the most powerful Quasi Immortal Emperors from ancient times to the present, his youthfulness at the Heaven Imperial Realm was not to be underestimated.
The purple-robed youth closed his sword-like eyes, then instantly reopened them, causing the nine heavens and ten lands to quake in tandem, a terrifying array of Dao patterns sweeping forth.
His left eye turned a golden red, resembling the grand sun of countless worlds, his right eye silver-white like the moon of the heavens.
Within both eyes, sacred Dao patterns intertwined, verging on the Dao itself.
In the next instant, sacred Dao ripples emanated from his eyes.
Countless Dao patterns intertwined, centering around this purple-robed youth, the sacred Dao ripples swiftly spreading to all corners of the universe, creating a dense, Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc.
The Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc, enshrouded by heavenly Dao patterns, burst forth with brilliantly dazzling immortal light.
With each rotation, sacred ripples spread, endowed with immensely terrifying power.
“What a fearsome Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc!”
“Is this the manifestation of the Yin Yang Dao?”
“Or perhaps the Tai Ji Dao…”
“No, the Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc mainly utilizes the Yin Yang Dao, but also incorporates many other formidable Daos.”
“……”
The countless strong spectators around the battlefield felt their scalps tingle with dread.
Even at a great distance, and not being the direct targets, the mere echoes were enough to make them feel as if their flesh, Primordial Spirits, and martial paths were all being obliterated.
Everyone knew this was not an illusion; facing such a strike would surely make it reality.
In fact, even Han Li was affected, his body slightly trembling and his Primordial Spirit vibrating subtly as the Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc pulled at him.
However, when Han Li’s ultimate martial Dao sent out a slight ripple, it smoothed out all disturbances.
“How will Han Li respond?”
The many strong beings once again focused their gaze on Han Li, eager to know if he could withstand this invincible strike.
“Even an ordinary Heavenly Immortal taking it head-on would die.”
“What is the origin of this purple-robed youth, to appear in the Ninety-Nine Heavenly Tribulation, and as the final tribulation at that?”
“Indeed, the Dao he cultivates is terrifying, harmonized by the Yin Yang Dao, even stronger than many of the Heavenly Immortal-level Daos.”
“Probably Han Li won’t be able to withstand this hit, will he?”
Upon this remark, the Western Sky Palace Master, the Supreme Leader of Qin Family, and the White Emperor, among the five Supremes, all fell silent.
Han Li’s combat ability had greatly exceeded their expectations; the heavenly tribulation was not only terrifying beyond legend but was also brought to the final tribulation by Han Li.
Now, Han Li, only one step away from successfully transcending the tribulation to prove his Dao, had a combat ability no less than theirs, perhaps even stronger.
“The purple-robed youth’s strike is extremely powerful.
Even if Han Li blocks it, he will be heavily wounded, and we should take action immediately,” said the Supreme Leader of Qin Family with an impassive gaze that swept across the other Supremes.
While seeming indifferent, everyone knew his thoughts were extremely complex.
Indeed, the Supreme Leader of Qin Family was feeling exactly as they had expected.
Previously, he had been the first in combat ability within the Yuankun Domain, but now he paled in comparison to Han Li.
Even if he invoked his Divine Sense, he might not defeat Han Li, who hadn’t even invoked his.
Han Li’s combat ability was approaching the realm of combat immortals; if he invoked his Divine Sense, he would directly possess the combat ability of a Heavenly Immortal.
The Supreme Leader of Qin Family would not tolerate such a powerful being’s emergence and saw killing Han Li as aligned with his interests.
No matter what trump cards Han Li held, he couldn’t ward off the joint effort of the five Supremes.
If things went smoothly, even the Solar Deity and Empress Phoenix Moon, and Empress Yuanchu, would make their move.
With eight True Immortal weapons, what could Han Li possibly use to resist?
……..
On Guangming Divine Mountain in Luming Divine Province,
“Mingyue, prepare to take action,” said Empress Phoenix Moon suddenly as she observed the dire situation in the Han Sea.
“Yo yo, you called me a frivolous girl, but now you can’t wait even before Han Li runs into trouble?
Seems like you’re the frivolous one,” teased Empress Yuanchu.
Empress Phoenix Moon rolled her eyes at her, and though Empress Yuanchu laughed, she too was ready.
They had indeed not liked Han Li before; the gap between them was too great, and he had a bevvy of wives and concubines.
If it weren’t for their souls being involved, there wouldn’t have been any intersection.
But now the situation had changed.
Han Li had shown his supreme potential and proved himself worthy of them, altering their perspectives.
Based on Han Li’s pace of cultivation, breaking through to the Golden Immortal Realm in the future was a certainty, perhaps even reaching higher realms, given that Han Li was suspected to be a reincarnation of a supreme being from another realm.
Becoming Han Li’s Dao partner meant that they could also evade the great calamity of the Yuankun Domain and leave Xuanshen Sword Mountain for a broader world in the future.
They were confident in themselves but not blindly so.
They knew that advancing out of Xuanshen Sword Mountain on their own would be extremely difficult.
However, both Empress Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu were the top empresses of the Yuankun Domain, each with her own pride and reserve, unwilling to throw themselves at anyone.
They planned to take this opportunity to help Han Li,
And form a good relationship with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 707
chapters.content:
Chapter 707: Chapter 270: The Shocking Spear of the Great Dao!
Five Supreme Beings Attack!
The Frightened Five Supremes_2 Chapter 707: Chapter 270: The Shocking Spear of the Great Dao!
Five Supreme Beings Attack!
The Frightened Five Supremes_2 “`
Han Li wasn’t coveting them, so he collected their split souls and told them to come after him.
When the time was right, and Han Li came to ask for their hands in marriage, they would agree.
If Han Li knew what Empress Huanyue and Empress Yuanchu were thinking, he would just laugh.
...
The two empresses were only wishfully thinking; Han Li wouldn’t walk the path they anticipated.
The two peerless empresses didn’t know that Han Li possessed Golden Immortal weapons and didn’t need their assistance at all.
Above the Han Sea.
“It’s over.”
Facing the strongest strike from the young Quasi Immortal Emperor, Han Li didn’t underestimate him in the slightest, his body radiating Infinite Immortal Light, expanding swiftly in all directions, a splendid rain of light obscuring “Heavenly Space”.
His physical body shattered the void, its speed surpassing the extreme.
His towering form seemed limitless, like the sovereign of all between heaven and earth, with Immortal Light around him giving birth to many great universes, countless starry seas emerging, the vast stars nothing but specks of dust compared to Han Li’s hair.
A war spear appeared in Han Li’s hand, embodying his martial principles and concentrating vast Mana, adorned with sacred patterns, thrusting towards the Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc.
The spear of the Great Dao burst forth, carrying the mighty force that could penetrate heaven and earth, time and space, everything, and took the initiative to strike at the pressing Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc.
Boom, Boom, Boom~
As the Great Dao war spear collided with the Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc, massive tremors spread throughout the Endless Yuankun Domain; the Eight Hundred Divine Regions shook violently, as if they were about to collapse.
When the light filling the world dissipated, the Yin Yang Great Grinding Disc had already crumbled and disintegrated, with the Great Dao spear piercing through the purple-robed young Quasi Immortal Emperor with supreme force.
The young Quasi Immortal Emperor spilled blood from the corner of his mouth, one hand gripping the war spear, Yin Yang energy swirling around him, the realms of all heavens heaving, attempting to grind him into nothing.
At that moment, Han Li instantly appeared before the young Quasi Immortal Emperor, pressing down with a palm that shattered space, froze time, and severed cause and effect.
“Bang!”
The young Quasi Immortal Emperor was directly obliterated by Han Li, his core principles and marks erased, blood rain filling the sky, which then transformed into thunder, promptly dispersed by a wave of Han Li’s sleeve.
After the ninth young Quasi Immortal Emperor was slain by Han Li, the dark and heavy sea of thunder that obscured the starry space finally scattered.
“Be careful!”
Just then, several exclamatory voices rang out.
Han Li’s expression remained unchanged as he looked towards the five great supremes coming to attack him.
The heavenly tribulation hadn’t fully dissipated, and the Supreme Leader of Qin Family, the master of Western Sky Palace, the White Emperor, the Butian Sect Master, and the Supreme Leader of Jiang Family descended one after another, surrounding Han Li.
The True Immortal weapons above their heads erupted with power, ready to annihilate Han Li on the spot.
The Human Dao Sword and Qiankun Bracelet flew out, one attacking and one defending, striving to block the five True Immortal weapons.
Seeing that Han Li wasn’t instantly suppressed, the five great supremes were not surprised; it was all within their expectations.
Han Li had two True Immortal weapons and wasn’t so easy to kill.
“Boom!”
Before the five great supremes could speak, Han Li’s aura suddenly surged several times over, his realm also completely stepping into the first level of the Heaven Imperial Realm, with the great tribulation for proving the Dao fully dissipated.
“Hahahaha!”
Han Li laughed unbridledly, his face brimming with endless joy.
Having received the final blessing of the heavenly tribulation, his combat ability had taken another leap forward, evolving from nearly a Battle Immortal to a true Battle Immortal.
Now, even without invoking his Divine Sense, Han Li possessed combat ability comparable to that of a Heavenly Immortal.
The five great supremes witnessed this scene, their expressions subtly changing while simultaneously guessing what was happening.
Han Li actually entered the Battle Immortal Realm right in front of them, making the five great supremes envy, jealous, and hate.
Thinking of Han Li’s impending death, the faces of the five great supremes also showed smiles, with the White Emperor particularly scoffing, “Han Li, facing imminent death, what’s the use of becoming a Battle Immortal?”
“A Battle Immortal is only comparable to a Heavenly Immortal after all.
We have five True Immortal weapons and twenty Heavenly Immortal weapons, can you withstand them?”
“Hahahahaha~”
Watching the calm and collected Han Li, the White Emperor burst into laughter, feeling extremely refreshed in his heart.
Han Li was about to die; the humiliation he had given him would also disappear.
From now on, he would still be the high and mighty White Emperor, free to look down upon the Endless Yuankun Domain.
“A mere buffoon.”
Han Li said indifferently.
The White Emperor’s frantic actions didn’t catch Han Li’s attention; he was just a dead man, after all.
Han Li didn’t even look at the White Emperor, his gaze sweeping over the Supreme Leader of Qin Family, the Supreme Leader of Jiang Family, the master of Western Sky Palace, and the Butian Sect Master, he said calmly, “Thank you all for coming to deliver your deaths.”
The White Emperor, enraged by Han Li’s taunt and indifference, shouted furiously, “Han Li, is all you can do is put on airs?”
The expressions of the Supreme Leader of Qin Family, the Supreme Leader of Jiang Family, the master of Western Sky Palace, and the Butian Sect Master were ice-cold, their killing intent covering the Nine Heavens.
Without a word, they had already sentenced Han Li to death.
They came to suppress Han Li, but Han Li claimed they were here to die, so they wanted to see what confidence he had to say such things.
“White Emperor, in front of my husband, you indeed are nothing but a buffoon,” came a delicate and charming voice, echoing across heaven and earth.
Many eyes turned to see two figures emerging elsewhere above the Han Sea, one of them the black-dressed, white-silk-clad Empress Qin Shiyin, the same person who had spoken.
Qin Shiyin’s words struck White Emperor where it hurt, angering him immensely, “Disloyal and shameless wretch!”
If it weren’t for Qin Shiyin, that seductive traitor, luring Han Li into the Taibai Immortal Realm, how could it have led to his disastrous defeat and heavy losses?
Furthermore, Qin Shiyin now directly addressed Han Li as “my husband” in a sweet and affectionate manner, which made it even more unbearable for the White Emperor.
Fury overpowered the White Emperor, and the Wuxian Palace immediately showed its power, striking out at Qin Shiyin with one blow.
Now the White Emperor just wanted to suppress Qin Shiyin, to avenge his humiliation and alleviate the discomfort in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 708
chapters.content:
Chapter 708: Chapter 270: The Shocking Spear of the Great Dao!
Five Supreme Beings Attack!
The Frightened Five Supremes_3 Chapter 708: Chapter 270: The Shocking Spear of the Great Dao!
Five Supreme Beings Attack!
The Frightened Five Supremes_3 “`
Just when countless strong figures thought Qin Shiyin was undoubtedly doomed, silently lamenting the pity, they witnessed a scene that left them utterly shocked.
“Boom!”
To their amazement, a divine Phoenix Feather appeared above the extremely beautiful figure standing beside Qin Shiyin, who was clad in luxurious, exquisite attire and whose face was obscured by celestial light.
With a gentle shake, the Phoenix Feather instantly shattered the strike from the Wuxian Palace.
...
“A True Immortal weapon?!”
The White Emperor’s eyes almost burst with rage.
Who was this woman beside Qin Shiyin, and why did she have a True Immortal weapon?
The Supreme Leader of the Western Sky Palace, Butian Sect Master, Supreme Leader of Qin Family, and Supreme Leader of Jiang Family also showed grave expressions; things were slipping out of their control.
Another unheard of, unseen True Immortal weapon had emerged in the Yuankun Domain, and crucially, its master was standing with Han Li.
The Supreme Leaders exchanged glances, and the True Immortal weapons above their heads fully awakened, directly assaulting Han Li.
No matter what, the urgent priority was to suppress Han Li; they could not allow him to escape.
The forces of Wuxian Palace came flying, blocking Feng Mian’s True Immortal weapon, while the other four True Immortal weapons faced off against the Dao Sword and the Qiankun Bracelet, suppressing Han Li’s True Immortal weapon.
Then, the five Supreme Leaders summoned all their Heavenly Immortal weapons, fully reviving them, and bombarded Han Li, intent on killing him.
This scene turned the complexions of all the onlookers, as they expected Han Li to counter with a Heavenly Immortal weapon from Chengsheng Mountain.
However, without any sign of panic, Han Li took out a red long spear.
With the Crimson Spear in hand, Han Li thrust effortlessly, the spear light piercing through time, and a round of crimson sun emerged, overshadowing heaven and earth, as if a vast universe had descended.
The Crimson Spear was a top-tier True Immortal weapon; even the combined strike of more than twenty Heavenly Immortal weapons was equally shattered by it.
“How is this possible?”
The White Emperor, Supreme Leader of Qin Family, the Western Sky Palace Master, and the other Supreme Leaders’ faces darkened as they looked at the Crimson Spear, their moods exceedingly grim.
They had finally found an opportunity to kill Han Li, but it was thwarted, and the worst-case scenario they had feared had occurred.
Not only did Han Li actually have a third True Immortal weapon, but a helper owning a True Immortal weapon had also appeared.
Now it wasn’t five True Immortal weapons against two; it was five against four, and they no longer held any advantage.
Mainly because Han Li’s True Immortal weapons were very powerful, most of them being top-tier, and their potency was even deeper.
“Kill!”
The five Supreme Leaders shared a glance, squeezing out the word through their teeth, and continued their onslaught towards Han Li.
One of the four True Immortal weapons dueling the Dao Sword and the Qiankun Bracelet attacked the Crimson Spear, with the rest of the Heavenly Immortal weapons continuing their barrage.
They refused to believe that Han Li could keep withstanding it.
The advantage was theirs!
Just then, a flag emerged, its surface making a gentle slice, and the light of the Emperor’s Way burst forth, instantly obliterating all attacks.
“It’s actually you!”
The moment the White Emperor saw the Emperor Flag, he immediately realized the truth and his fury intensified.
It turned out that the mysterious strong figure who had attacked White Emperor City before was Han Li.
This Emperor Flag was proof.
As the number one True Immortal weapon of Yuankun Domain, it was not difficult to defeat a True Immortal weapon and more than twenty Heavenly Immortal weapons.
“Han Li, you deserve to die!”
The Western Sky Palace Master and Butian Sect Master, red-eyed with fury, roared in rage.
They had previously investigated the identity of the mysterious figure without success, and never imagined that it had been Han Li who, over twenty years ago, had attacked Western Sky Palace and Heavenly Cult, stealing a vast amount of their immortal resources.
PS: There’s a second update, definitely concluding this plotline.

chapters.title: Chapter 709
chapters.content:
Chapter 709: Chapter 271: Desperate Five Great Supremes!
Mixed Dao Cauldron Strikes, Han Li Kills Five Great Supremes with One Punch, The End Falls_1 Chapter 709: Chapter 271: Desperate Five Great Supremes!
Mixed Dao Cauldron Strikes, Han Li Kills Five Great Supremes with One Punch, The End Falls_1 It’s infuriating!
The enemy they have been searching for all over the world was right under their noses, brazenly taking wives and concubines.
It’s like they are being treated as blind, even with their eyes open.
One had a Heavenly Immortal Elixir stolen by Han Li, another had 30,000 Immortal Stones taken, and both were utterly humiliated.
Worst of all, when the five most powerful forces were attacked, only their two houses suffered losses.
...
They had no grievances with Han Li at all!
At this moment, the Sect Hierarch of Western Sky Palace and the Butian Sect Master harbored even greater intent to kill Han Li.
Before, they had some reservations, but now they had none whatsoever, as Han Li was already their enemy.
They deeply regretted not joining forces with the three Supreme Leaders when they arrived at Qianyuan Divine Province.
If they had killed Han Li then, none of this would be happening.
Not only these two Supreme Leaders felt this way, but the White Emperor did as well.
When Han Li attacked the five strongest forces, the Western Sky Palace and the Butian Sect only had their resources plundered, but he was injured by Han Li, and later suffered two more defeats by Han Li’s hands, which was excessive and humiliating!
What made the White Emperor feel most unbalanced was that the Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu, who were also among the strongest forces attacked and held grudges against Han Li, had yet to suffer any loss till now.
The Supreme Leader of Qin Family and Supreme Leader of Jiang Family also had murderous intent that could cover the Nine Heavens.
The threat posed by Han Li was too greatâ€”if he did not die today, they would be the ones to die in the future.
Setting aside the potential Han Li possessed, just the profound background of Chengsheng Mountain was enough to incite their murderous intent.
Before, Han Li had only two True Immortal weapons, which made many of the strongest forces wary, but it wasn’t to the extent of joining forces to attack him.
But now?
Han Li possessed four True Immortal weaponsâ€”the Human Path Sword, the Crimson Spear, the Qiankun Bracelet, and the Emperor Flag.
Among them, the Crimson Spear was a top-tier True Immortal weapon, and the Emperor Flag was even more formidable, being the strongest True Immortal weapon in the Yuankun Domain.
Han Li also had an external ally who possessed a True Immortal weapon.
That is to say, the Chengsheng Mountain camp had five True Immortal weaponsâ€”how terrifying was that?
Bear in mind, all other strongest forces in the entire Yuankun Domain combined had only nine True Immortal weapons.
Now, the five Great Emperors also had five True Immortal weapons; their overall strength was somewhat inferior to Han Li’s.
Han Li was truly frightening, with strengths not revealed to the world.
The two Supreme Leaders suspected that Han Li had possessed so many True Immortal weapons all along, but he had been concealing them, not daring to expose them.
Today, Han Li dared to proclaim his ascension to the Heaven Imperial Realm so openly, probably because he had found that ally and was no longer afraid of their combined forces.
The Supreme Leader of Qin Family and Supreme Leader of Jiang Family’s expressions changed unpredictably, but they showed no signs of retreat.
Today, they would kill Han Li at any cost, or else they had no future.
Although the five Great Emperors were shocked and enraged, they maintained rationality.
They analyzed the situation instantly and communicated secretly, deciding their next move immediately.
They communicated with Emperor Tianji and the Solar Emperor through divine sense, hoping to persuade these two Great Emperors to lend their aid.
They went as far as to exaggerate Han Li’s threat, listing numerous dangers if he remained alive.
At the same time, the divine sense of the five Great Emperors descended upon Guangming Divine Mountain in Luming Divine Province, trying to enlist the support of Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu.
If the nine Great Emperors joined forces, wielding nine True Immortal weapons together, even if Han Li had five True Immortal weapons, he could hardly escape death today.
Emperor Tianji and the Solar Emperor hesitated.
Without needing a list from the five Great Emperors, they too knew the danger posed by Han Li.
If Han Li did not die today, the power structure of the Yuankun Domain would be redrawn.
From then on, Han Li and Chengsheng Mountain would tower over the entire Yuankun Domain, with all the powerhouses and forces below them.
But could they really kill Han Li if they took action?
Emperor Tianji and the Solar Emperor had doubts.
They had hesitated before for the same reasonâ€”not daring to choose sides and act, they did not dare to make a move now either.
The two Great Emperors hesitated, but Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu, the two peerless female emperors, outright refused.
Asking them to move against Han Li?
You must be dreaming!
They were actually planning to help Han Li, only they hadn’t expected Han Li to have so many cards up his sleeve, such a strong foundation, and it wasn’t yet necessary for them to act.
“Of course it’s me.”
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, his gaze sweeping over the Sect Hierarch of Western Sky Palace, the Supreme Leader of Qin Family, the White Emperor, and other Great Emperors, his tone remaining calm and composed.
That year, with my hands in my pockets, I didn’t know what an opponent was.
Honestly, Han Li was somewhat disappointed.
He had made such a grand display of his ascension, and only these five Great Emperors had come to dieâ€”a pity, wasn’t it?
He wished the Solar Emperor and Emperor Tianji would also take action, so Han Li could righteously eliminate both Great Emperors as well.
But neither the Solar Emperor nor Emperor Tianji, nor Empress of Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu, took action or even made an appearanceâ€”Han Li had no opportunity to act.
Just the White Emperor, Butian Sect Master, Supreme Leader of Jiang Family, and the other five Great Emperors were not enough for him to kill.
And they thought to kill him?
In your dreams!
Just in the comparison of foundations, Han Li was at an advantage with True Immortal weapons, able to suppress the five True Immortal weapons, including those of Wuxian Palace.
Even if his Heavenly Immortal weapons were no match for the five Great Emperors, don’t forget, Han Li also possessed the Heaven-opening Axeâ€”a True Immortal weapon.
Along with the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, the Seven Immortal Pagoda, and other Heavenly Immortal weapons, he could easily block and even suppress them.
In terms of Heaven Imperial Realm divine weapons, Han Li was not at all inferior, possessing dozens of them, capable of contending with the five strongest forces.
With the standoff in profound backgrounds, it came down to individual capabilities.
Han Li’s basic combat ability alone was comparable to a Heavenly Immortal, more than enough to overwhelm the five Great Emperors.
Not to mention, he could also utilize Divine Sense to elevate his combat ability to an even stronger state.

chapters.title: Chapter 710
chapters.content:
Chapter 710: Chapter 271: The Despair of the Five Great Supremes!
The Primordial Cauldron Strikes, Han Li Annihilates the Five Great Supremes with One Punch, Bringing an End to the Battle Chapter 710: Chapter 271: The Despair of the Five Great Supremes!
The Primordial Cauldron Strikes, Han Li Annihilates the Five Great Supremes with One Punch, Bringing an End to the Battle No matter how one looked at it, the five Supreme Leaders were no match for him today.
“The ones who should die are you.”
Han Li sneered coldly, his eyes finally revealing a chilling intent to kill that caused half the Han Sea to instantly freeze over.
“If you’ve come to seek death today, I will oblige you.”
If the five Supreme Leaders hadn’t come, Han Li would at most have taken action against the White Emperor, and he couldn’t really strike at the others without a good reason; he needed justification so his actions would be beyond reproach.
The True Immortal weapons of the five Supreme Leaders flew back towards each of them, fixing their gaze on Han Li with extreme malice, wishing they could tear him to pieces.
The fact that the Empress of the Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu refused to help, combined with the indecision of Emperor of the Sun and Emperor Tianji, put great pressure on the five Supreme Leaders.
...
“Don’t be intimidated by Han Li; we still have a chance of winning.”
“That’s right, although Han Li’s few True Immortal weapons are slightly stronger than ours, as long as we can hold him off, we’ve won.”
“Yes, as long as the True Immortal weapon battlefield is at a stalemate, we have many more Heavenly Immortal weapons than Han Li.
Even if he is a War Immortal, he will definitely die.”
After a secret exchange among the five Supreme Leaders, they encouraged each other and instantly felt they could manage.
“Words are useless; today it’s either you die, or we live.”
The White Emperor sneered, and together with the Supreme Leader of the Qin Family, Supreme Leader of the Jiang Family, Master of the Western Sky Palace, and the Butian Sect Master, they all made their move.
Their five True Immortal weapons immediately shone with brilliant immortal light and charged towards Han Li’s True Immortal weapons, while their twenty-plus Heavenly Immortal weapons were also sacrificed once again.
No matter the consumption of immense Immortal Tao Energy, they were prepared to pay any price to kill Han Li.
Facing such an onslaught, Han Li remained unmoved, his expression as still as an ancient well, still standing with his hands behind his back, looking down at the five Supreme Leaders with an air of composure, as if he were an emperor who reigned supreme over all, spanning the ancient and modern eras.
“You got one thing wrong; today, only you will die,” Han Li said indifferently.
Seeing Han Li still playing the sage in front of others, the five Supreme Leaders were actually delighted.
The more careless and confident Han Li was, the greater the chance they believed they had of winning this great battle.
At this moment, countless powerhouses surrounding the battlefield of the Han Sea held their breath uncontrollably, staring fixedly at the battlefield, afraid to miss a single second.
They were very curious to know whether Han Li, the Long-Living Emperor, was truly confident, or just showing a brave front.
Facing dozens of immortal weapons attacking him without putting up a resistance; was he courting death?
Or was it that Han Li believed, now that he had become a War Immortal, he could do whatever he wanted and even True Immortal weapons were nothing in his eyes?
Not to mention a mere War Immortal, even a True Immortal would need to defend with all their might against such an attack, and would probably have to flee immediately, otherwise they would be either gravely injured or killed outright.
“What is Han Li doing?”
“Should we make a move?”
The Empress of the Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu both felt a bit stunned when they saw this scene, and at the same time, they said aloud.
They really wanted to say: “Han Li, stop pretending, and start defending quickly, otherwise, you truly won’t be able to withstand it.”
Indeed, under Han Li’s carelessness, even if his True Immortal weapons were stronger, a hasty defense would surely not be fully effective.
If any backlash struck him, Han Li would be, at the very least, severely wounded.
Therefore, both peerless empresses truly did not understand why Han Li could remain so calm.
What kind of confidence did he have?
The Empress of the Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu looked at each other, seeing the resolve in each other’s eyes.
If Han Li were to be injured in this wave of attacks, the five Supreme Leaders would surely take the opportunity to pursue and kill Han Li.
At that moment, they would directly take action, descending upon the battlefield of the Han Sea to assist Han Li against the five Supreme Leaders.
“Mingyue (Hongshang), do you think Han Li might have a golden…”
The Empress of the Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu suddenly spoke in unison, but before they could finish, they were both stunned.
They had intended to stop themselves as they thought this possibility was completely unthinkable.
In the endless years of the Yuankun Domain, there had never been any Golden Immortal weapon passed down.
How could Han Li possibly have one?
Even if Han Li had been the reincarnation of a supreme being from the outside world, he wouldn’t have been able to carry weapons with him through reincarnation and likely would need to leave the Yuankun Domain to summon them back.
But the two peerless empresses did not stop themselves on purpose; they were shocked by what they saw on the battlefield of the Han Sea.
Their beautiful lips formed an O-shape, their pupils constricted sharply, and their expressions turned dull.
At that moment, only four thoughts echoed in their minds.
Han Li truly has a Golden Immortal weapon!
The five Supreme Leaders are as good as dead!
Han Li is invincible in the Yuankun Domain!
They were certain to become Han Li’s consorts!
….
The battlefield of the Han Sea.
Facing the cold murderous intent of the five Supreme Leaders, facing the onslaught of dozens of immortal weapons, Han Li finally reacted.
In the blink of an eye, at the very moment everything unfolded, an ancient and weathered tripod with three legs and two ears appeared above Han Li’s head, with fierce and brutal Chaos Qi roiling within it.
From within the Chaotic Cauldron, Lu Yao, the Artifact Spirit and stunning imperial sister, let out a cold snort, still only partially activating the cauldron’s mighty power.
In an instant, boundless light of Chaos shone throughout the nine heavens and earth, sparkling across all ages and every sky.
A River of Chaos surged out of the Chaotic Cauldron with limitless power, crushing space, grinding time, severing cause and effect, erasing destiny, and annihilating everything in its path.
The countless powerhouses watching from around could only see the River of Chaos emerge and the ages darken.
When the River of Chaos rolled past, all the incoming attacks were completely obliterated.
With a slight tremor of the Chaotic Cauldron, terrifying power descended upon the five True Immortal weapons and the twenty-plus Heavenly Immortal weapons, completely suppressing all of these Heavenly Immortal weapons.
The gap between True Immortals and Golden Immortals was immense, and the same held true for their weapons.
If Han Li so wished, he could even blast all these True Immortal and Heavenly Immortal weapons to smithereens.

chapters.title: Chapter 711
chapters.content:
Chapter 711: Chapter 271: The Despair of the Five Great Supreme Beings!
Han Li Strikes with the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, Killing the Five Great Supreme Beings with One Punch, Bringing an End to the Saga_3 Chapter 711: Chapter 271: The Despair of the Five Great Supreme Beings!
Han Li Strikes with the Primordial Chaos Cauldron, Killing the Five Great Supreme Beings with One Punch, Bringing an End to the Saga_3 Of course, Han Li was unwilling to do so.
These were his spoils of war, from then on destined to become the immortal weapons of Chengsheng Mountain.
Even if he couldn’t use them himself, he could pass them on to his outstanding descendants.
The five Supreme Leaders were completely dumbfounded at this scene, standing there in shock.
At that moment, they were utterly despondent!
...
The Western Sky Palace Master, Butian Sect Master, Emperor Bai, Supreme Leader of Qin Family, and Supreme Leader of Jiang Family seemed to have had their strength sapped, their complexions pale as death, whiter than a seven-day-old corpse.
They had never imagined that Han Li would actually possess Golden Immortal weapons.
How could this possibly be?!
How did Han Li come to possess Golden Immortal weapons?
Could it be that Han Li’s origins were even more ancient and powerful than they had speculated?
The Supreme Leaders felt this must be the truth.
They had already had such suspicions, otherwise, Han Li wouldn’t have been able to produce so many True Immortal weapons.
It’s just that they were unwilling to ponder this possibility too deeply; otherwise, they wouldn’t even have the courage to fight a desperate battle, hoping against hope that Han Li did not have such a formidable background.
But the truth was right before their eyes; their immortal weapons were completely suppressed by Han Li’s Golden Immortal weapons.
All their trump cards were gone, and they couldn’t run even if they wanted to.
Even if they could escape, where could they go?
In the vast endlessness of the Yuankun Domain, there was no place for them to hide!
“Emperor Bai, this is all your fault!”
The Western Sky Palace Master suddenly lashed out with a palm strike towards Emperor Bai, his tone vicious and wishing to tear Emperor Bai to shreds.
“Boom!”
The Butian Sect Master made a move too, throwing a punch at Emperor Bai.
Taken off-guard by the two attacks, Emperor Bai was struck dumb, exploding on the spot into a rain of blood that took a while to reassemble.
After Emperor Bai managed to reform, the Supreme Leader of Qin Family and Supreme Leader of Jiang Family also took action immediately and once more caused Emperor Bai to explode.
They felt extreme hatred towards Emperor Bai.
If it wasn’t for Emperor Bai persuading them, though they feared Han Li, they wouldn’t have rushed into action so hastily.
Now, as Han Li had predicted, they were indeed on a mission to deliver their own deaths.
The Western Sky Palace Master and Butian Sect Master exchanged glances before suddenly kneeling down in mid-air, starting to kowtow towards Han Li.
“Great Emperor, we are willing to submit to you, to be your cattle and horses, at your beck and call, hoping only that you spare us our lives.”
Under such hopeless circumstances, with no chance of turning the tables, the Western Sky Palace Master and Butian Sect Master ultimately knelt in humiliation begging for mercy.
Although such an act was profoundly humiliating, if it meant they could survive, all else was irrelevant; what counted a little shame?
As long as they lived, even without immortal weapons, they could still dominate the Yuankun Domain, their power and status towering over countless beings.
If they were favored by Han Li, their status might rise even higher.
The Supreme Leader of Qin Family and Supreme Leader of Jiang Family watched this unfold in silence, their expressions stiff.
They wanted to follow suit like the other Supreme Leaders, but couldn’t let go of their pride, and also didn’t believe that doing so would make Han Li spare them.
In the distance, Emperor Tianji and Solar Emperor emerged from their concealment.
With Han Li possessing Golden Immortal weapons, he likely had discovered them long ago; remaining hidden had become pointless.
They were extremely relieved that they had hesitated and not taken sides; otherwise, they too would have died here today.
Following his two explosions, Emperor Bai saw the Western Sky Palace Master and Butian Sect Master kneeling and begging for mercy just as he was about to do the same, but his body froze.
“What use do I have for you?”
Han Li said flatly, then punched out.
The force of his punch dominated the world, covering the five Supreme Leaders.
“No!”
“Spare me!”
“I am willing to submit!”
“….”
Emperor Bai, the Western Sky Palace Master, Butian Sect Master, Supreme Leader of Jiang Family, and Supreme Leader of Qin Family couldn’t hold back anymore, screaming for mercy while desperately resisting.
Although the five Supreme Leaders resisted with all their might, unleashing all their ultimate techniques, the gap in power was too great.
They were all killed by a single punch from Han Li, obliterating their physical bodies, Primordial Spirits, Dao, and everything else.
In the battle of the Han Sea, Han Li slaughtered the five Supreme Leaders!

chapters.title: Chapter 712
chapters.content:
Chapter 712: Chapter 272: Sensation in the Yuankun Domain, He Who Understands the Times Is a Great Man, Fengyue: When Will You Come to Ask for Marriage?_1 Chapter 712: Chapter 272: Sensation in the Yuankun Domain, He Who Understands the Times Is a Great Man, Fengyue: When Will You Come to Ask for Marriage?_1 Above the Han Sea, Han Li stood aloft with his hands behind his back, clad in white and peerless.
His aura was overwhelmingly powerful and domineering, like a supreme monarch who commanded the heavens and the earth, subduing the universe and the wilderness.
In fact, Han Li had truly achieved this.
After the battle today, no one in the vast Yuankun Domain would dare to compete with Han Li.
Han Li had become the foremost figure in the Endless Yuankun Domain, the true Lord of Yuankun Domain.
Whether it was his personal cultivation, combat ability, or the strength and heritage of his forces, he was undeniably the number one in Yuankun Domain, many times stronger than any other forces or powerhouses.
Seeing the Longevity Emperor Han Li kill the Western Sky Palace Lord, Butian Sect Master, White Emperor, Supreme Leader of Qin Family, and Supreme Leader of Jiang Family with one punch, all who were watching were speechless.
...
Whether it was Emperor Tianji, the Solar Sovereign, or Empress Phoenix Moon, Empress Yuanchu, or other Heavenly Governing Forces Emperors, Quasi Emperors, Saints, they were all frightened by Han Li’s ferocity.
Those were five supreme beings at the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, with a great chance of transcending tribulation to become immortals.
At least two would become Heavenly Immortals, and facing such aides, the Longevity Emperor did not waver and directly executed them.
This magnitude of boldness, this degree of ruthlessness, made countless people shudder in fear and others to wholeheartedly admire and submit.
At this moment, there was only one thought in everyone’s mind, the Yuankun Domain had welcomed its new master, its sole master.
That was Chengsheng Mountain, the Longevity Emperor Han Li who had killed the five supreme beings with his own fists.
Looking at the majestic Han Li, Emperor Tianji and the Solar Sovereign had extremely complicated feelings.
They had not expected that the five supreme beings, who they had fought against for over a hundred thousand years, would all perish at Han Li’s hands.
Neither of them had any intention of seeking revenge for the White Emperor, Supreme Leader of Qin Family, Western Sky Palace Lord, and the other three supreme beings.
Their relationships were not that good, or else they would have joined forces earlier.
In the eyes of Emperor Tianji and the Solar Sovereign, the five supreme beings died somewhat grievously, as no one could have expected that Han Li actually possessed a Golden Immortal weapon.
To them, suppressing Han Li seemed like a sure thing.
Even if there were surprises, such as Han Li having five True Immortal weapons, it wasn’t a big deal.
They wouldn’t be able to kill Han Li, and he couldn’t kill them either.
At most, it would have been an outright conflict and a fierce struggle for the future.
After all, the five supreme beings had five True Immortal weapons and over twenty Heavenly Immortal weapons.
Even if they couldn’t stop Han Li, they wouldn’t be harmed by him.
No matter what, they should have been able to escape unscathed.
Not just the five supreme beings, but Emperor Tianji, the Solar Sovereign, Empress Phoenix Moon, Empress Yuanchu, and all the other powerhouses thought this way.
Unfortunately, no one expected that Han Li would have a Golden Immortal weapon, which directly broke the situation and gave him an overwhelming advantage to suppress the five supreme beings.
This also showed that Han Li was incredibly cunning, truly a sovereign of the survivalists’ path.
If Han Li had revealed his Golden Immortal weapon earlier, he could have rightfully become the Lord of Yuankun Domain, governing the strongest forces, the Heavenly Governing Forces, and all other large and small powers.
The five supreme beings naturally would not dare to provoke him, and would have to obediently offer their daughters to Han Li to maintain their relationship.
However, Han Li did not do so, blaring his trumpets to ascend to the Heaven Imperial Realm, openly luring them into the trap, and the five supreme beings fell for it.
Emperor Tianji, the Solar Sovereign, and the others knew that they couldn’t blame the five supreme beings for being careless.
After all, no one could have predicted that Han Li had a Golden Immortal weapon.
They expected, at most, one or two more True Immortal weapons.
The death of the five supreme beings filled the two sovereigns with many emotions, but it was only a fleeting moment.
The urgent matter at hand was to deal with their relationship with Han Li.
If Han Li thought they were allies of the five supreme beings, then they would be in a terrible predicament.
They had realized that not only was Han Li cunning, but he also enjoyed laying traps.
By playing this move and killing the five supreme beings, he could take over the White Emperor City, Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, and other strongest forces, vastly enhancing Chengsheng Mountain’s heritage in an instant.
Although the two sovereigns had never intervened from the beginning, the fact that they had secretly come to witness Han Li’s ascension to the Heaven Imperial Realm was indisputable.
If Han Li seized on this point and didn’t let go, they might indeed share the fate of the five supreme beings.
The Solar Sovereign and Emperor Tianji didn’t want to die yet; they still had their vast forces, and they still aspired to become immortals, to survive the great calamity of the Yuankun Domain.
For this reason, they wanted to minimize risks, which is why both sovereigns had hesitated earlier and dared not act rashly.
This hesitation allowed them to escape with their lives.
“Fellow Daoist Han.”
Emperor Tianji and the Solar Sovereign exchanged glances, then bowed their hands in greeting to Han Li simultaneously, their tone respectful and their stance very humble.
The two sovereigns were very clear-headed; although they were supreme beings of the Yuankun Domain and lords of the strongest forces, they were not enough in front of Han Li.
After killing the five supreme beings, Han Li’s status, authority, and power underwent a dramatic transformation, and now he held life and death over everyone.
If they showed the slightest neglect and displeased Han Li, they might invite fatal disaster upon themselves.
Whether Han Li would do so or not, it is always best to be cautious and vigilant.
Han Li’s gaze swept over Emperor Tianji and the Solar Sovereign, making them shiver, their smiles becoming somewhat stiff, until he finally said indifferently:
“Fellow Daoists have quite the interest, taking the trouble to come to the Han Sea to watch Han’s ascension to the Heaven Imperial Realm.”
The Solar Sovereign’s heart stirred, immediately following Han Li’s lead and said, “That traitor White Emperor plotted to disrupt Fellow Daoist Han’s ascension, and Sun certainly does not want to associate with him.
Specifically, I came to protect the Dao for you.”
“Fortunately, Fellow Daoist Han is blessed with great fortune and extraordinary talent, suppressing those five traitors like the Western Sky Palace Lord and White Emperor.
Otherwise, our Yuankun Domain would have suffered a great blow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 713
chapters.content:
Chapter 713: Chapter 272: Sensational Yuankun Domain, The Wise Knows When to Advance or Retreat, Fengyue: When Will You Come to Ask for Marriage?_2 Chapter 713: Chapter 272: Sensational Yuankun Domain, The Wise Knows When to Advance or Retreat, Fengyue: When Will You Come to Ask for Marriage?_2 “…”
The Solar Emperor spoke a plethora of complimentary words, making his stance clear.
He labeled the White Emperor and the other four supremes as rebellious ministers and traitors, claimed he came to protect the Dao, and went on to praise Han Li lavishly, using countless flattering wordsâ€”it was only shy of declaring Han Li as the most talented being of the Yuankun Domain across all ages, present and future.
Even though his daughter was still at Chengsheng Mountain, betrothed to Han Li, the Solar Emperor was extremely calculating.
He maintained his individuality while heaping praises on Han Li.
He also made many promises, such as sending a few heavenly fair cultivators as gifts to celebrate Han Li’s successful ascension to immortality.
Emperor Tianji felt somewhat speechless inside.
Having known the Solar Emperor for so many tens of thousands of years, only now did he realize how thick-skinned the Solar Emperor could be, able to pick up and let go as he wished, without a care about the disgraceful impression his groveling before Han Li would make if it spread.
...
“Hehe~”
Emperor Tianji let out a cold laugh, then…
also began lavishly praising Han Li, to the point where even Han Li felt somewhat embarrassed.
Emperor Tianji even took the initiative to have Tianji Pavilion merge under the banner of Chengsheng Mountain, stating that Chengsheng Mountain would lead and would receive a hefty dividend every year.
Whatever information Han Li needed, whatever beautiful Heavenly Immortals he desired, Tianji Pavilion could gather them and deliver them to Han Li at the earliest opportunity…
The Solar Emperor watched the scene in stupefied amazement.
He truly hadn’t expected that Emperor Tianji, with his thick brows and honest appearance, could outdo him in bootlicking.
Seeing Han Li’s face, which remained all smiles and grew even more radiant, was truly shameless.
Han Li, however, was quite satisfied with Emperor Tianji and the Solar Emperor’s perceptiveness.
He had no intention to kill the two supremes; such an act would have only brought more chaos to the Yuankun Domain.
It was not bad to have the two supremes work for him, but a necessary warning was still required.
“I understand why you have come here, and since you have not done anything, I won’t pursue the matter.
However, from this point on…”
Han Li rattled off a bunch, giving the two supremes a few metaphorical sticks and then a few candies.
Emperor Tianji and the Solar Emperor dared not object, compliantly accepting the terms and leaving with mixed feelings.
Han Li’s gaze swept across the surrounding Han Sea and over those strong beings who were still in shock, and he said indifferently,
“White Emperor City, Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, Longevity Qin Family, Longevity Jiang Familyâ€”these five major powers shall henceforth come under the jurisdiction of Chengsheng Mountain.
Members of these five powers shall come to Chengsheng Mountain to pay their respects within ten days.”
Han Li’s tone was mild, yet it was supremely domineering, engulfing the five strongest forces in one bite.
The strong beings from the various major powers who had already speculated about this now felt shocked once more upon hearing his words.
They left the scene and spread the news of the battle, swiftly reaching every corner of the Yuankun Domain.
No one dared to speak ill of Chengsheng Mountain or Han Li.
Everyone knew that from this day forward, Han Li was the supreme ruler of the Yuankun Domain, and Chengsheng Mountain was the overlord above all other forces.
Han Li withdrew his gaze and looked at the various True Immortal and Heavenly Immortal weapons left behind by the five strongest forces, a sharp gleam flashing in his eyes.
Upon his command, the Chaotic Cauldron emitted a brilliant primordial light, gathering all thirty-one Immortal weapons, including those from Wuxian Palace.
Han Li extended his hand, and the Chaotic Cauldron returned to him.
True Immortal and Heavenly Immortal weapons like the Human Dao Sword, Emperor Flag, Qiankun Bracelet, and Crimson Spear were also repossessed by Han Li.
After finishing this, Han Li glanced at Feng Mian and Qin Shiyin, transmitted a few words to them through Divine Sense, and then disappeared from the Han Sea.
…
Luming Divine Province, Guangming Divine Mountain.
The Silver Armor Empress, peerless in grace, and the Golden Armor Empress, unparalleled in elegance, were still immersed in the shock of the recent events.
Han Li’s foundation was exceptionally strong, greatly exceeding their expectations.
The two empresses speculated that Han Li was the reincarnation of some supreme being from outside the domain, hiding in the Yuankun Domain to evade calamity.
It seemed unlikely that he would possess a Golden Immortal weapon, yet Han Li had indeed produced one.
This was virtually an unprecedented occurrence in the annals of Yuankun Domain’s history.
Since ancient times, there had been no strong being in the Yuankun Domain who possessed a Golden Immortal weapon, not even the vaguely mentioned Eternal Golden Immortals from ancient history were necessarily equipped with one.
Possessing a Golden Immortal weapon, Han Li was now able to walk sideways throughout the Yuankun Domain, suppressing anything that defied him in heaven and earth, and unopposedly sweeping through all under the heavens.
The situation at the Han Sea also confirmed the two peerless empresses’ perspectives.
Once Han Li’s Golden Immortal weapon appeared, it directly suppressed all the weapons of the five supremes, causing the five supremes to lose all their trump cards, leaving them isolated and at Han Li’s mercy.
What especially alarmed Empress Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu was that, faced with the pleas of the five supremes, Han Li remained unmoved and with a single punch obliterated them into dust.
It’s worth noting that the Supreme Leaders of the Qin Family, the Jiang Family, the White Emperor, the owner of the Western Sky Palace, and the Butian Sect Master were all supremes at the pinnacle of Heaven Imperial Realm, whose might wasn’t far different from theirs, yet they were destroyed by one punch from Han Li.
This meant that even if the two of them joined forces, they would not survive a single move from Han Liâ€”this realization shocked the two peerless empresses immensely, while also filling them with bitter helplessness.
Han Li was simply too strong!
Barely at the first level of Heaven Imperial Realm, he already possessed combat ability comparable to that of a Heavenly Immortal, and this was all without invoking Divine Sense.
What exactly was his origin?
Empress Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuanchu were extremely curious.
This surpassed their understanding, and even after scouring ancient histories, they couldn’t find a single entity that could rival Han Li at this stage of cultivation.
To fight across an entire Big Realm at such an early stage â€” what kind of monstrous genius was this?!
In the early stages of their cultivation, crossing an entire Big Realm was not difficult for either Empress Phoenix Moon or Empress Yuanchu, and history was replete with cultivators who could achieve this feat.

chapters.title: Chapter 714
chapters.content:
Chapter 714: Chapter 272: Sensation in the Yuankun Domain, He Who Understands the Times Is a Great Man, Phoenix Moon: When Will You Come to Ask for Marriage?_3 Chapter 714: Chapter 272: Sensation in the Yuankun Domain, He Who Understands the Times Is a Great Man, Phoenix Moon: When Will You Come to Ask for Marriage?_3 But as one’s realm increased, it wasn’t just about transcending a Big Realm, even surpassing several minor realms in combat was extremely difficult.
After all, those Cultivators who were able to cultivate to a deep realm were all geniuses; each had their unique abilities, various trump cards, and outstanding combat ability.
Only those cultivators making rapid and soaring progress, advancing triumphantly, could fight across realms at each Big Realm level, and even so, the gap would grow increasingly narrow.
Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu were well aware of this.
They were peerless geniuses who, at the peak of the Quasi Emperor stage, had been able to challenge Great Emperors and, after breaking through to the Heaven Imperial Realm, could fight across several minor realms.
But once they reached the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, they couldn’t fight across realms anymore, let alone compare their combat ability to that of a Heavenly Immortal, nor could they gain an overwhelming advantage over other supreme beings at the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
At this stage of cultivation, without breaking through the shackles of combat immortals, everyone’s combat ability was more or less the same.
...
But Han Li was different!
Not yet at the peak of Quasi Emperor, his combat ability was already comparable to the mid-stages of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and upon reaching the peak of Quasi Emperor, his combat ability was comparable to the late stages of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
When Han Li faced the great tribulation of proving his path, his combat ability surged by countless multiples, quickly reaching the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, growing ever stronger as he advanced toward becoming a combat immortal.
After Han Li passed the great tribulation of proving his path, his combat ability thoroughly entered the Heavenly Immortal domain, making him a true combat immortal.
Too terrifying!
Even the unrivaled female empresses of the Yuankun Domain like Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu could only look up to Han Li.
They had known Han Li for only a few years, and before they knew it, Han Li’s strength had far surpassed theirs.
This brought a sense of indelible loss to the hearts of the two peerless empresses.
“How on earth did Han Li manage this?”
Empress Yuanchu, in her silver battle dress that perfectly accentuated her proud figure, pursed her red lips and was the first to speak, breaking the silence.
“Could it be that the martial path Han Li cultivates is too powerful?”
Empress Huang Yue, clad in golden battle attire, with her delicate and curvaceous body, pondered and offered an answer.
Empress Yuanchu nodded, she felt it was indeed the case.
Han Li could stand shoulder to shoulder with a Heavenly Immortal in the first layer of Heaven Imperial Realm, and it wasn’t because of weapons or external objects; his own strength had reached this level.
There were actually quite a few internal factors that allowed Han Li’s combat ability to match that of a Heavenly Immortal, such as martial skills and cultivation techniques that surpassed those of a True Immortal and so on, but these all required time to cultivateâ€”not something you could instantly perfect during a tribulation.
So, after eliminating various factors, Empress Yuanchu and Empress Huang Yue agreed that it was the martial path that made Han Li’s combat ability so formidable.
The two peerless empresses had a clear understanding of the martial path; they had grasped top-level martial paths when they were young, which was the main reason why they had progressed rapidly and had outstanding combat ability.
However, according to the secret records of ancient history in the Yuankun Domain, the martial path was divided into three levels: ordinary, powerful, and top tier.
Beyond that, there was nothing more.
But now it seemed obvious that there were more powerful martial paths beyond the top tier, and the martial path cultivated by Han Li was even stronger than the top-tier martial path by more than just one level.
Otherwise, Han Li’s combat ability wouldn’t be so much stronger than theirs at the first layer of the Heaven Imperial Realm, given that they too mastered a top-tier martial path.
While the two peerless empresses discussed Han Li, he arrived silently at Guangming Divine Mountain, observing Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu with interest.
Regarding their perception of him, Han Li neither agreed nor disagreed.
It must be said, Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu were truly deserving of being the two most stunning empresses in Yuankun Domain, deducing Han Li’s hidden strength from mere hints and clues.
Just as the two peerless empresses had said, Han Li’s immense strength, comparable to that of a Heavenly Immortal, all stemmed from his ultimate martial dao.
Although he was still at the first level of the Heaven Imperial Realm and, in theory, should only have begun to grasp the rudiments of the Dao, his ultimate martial dao was so powerful, the strongest in all the realms of heaven and earth, that even a wisp of his Dao was on par with the Heavenly Immortals’ Great Dao, and not just any Great Dao, but that of the top-tier Heavenly Immortals.
In other words, Han Li was essentially on par with a Heavenly Immortal, and the power of his ultimate martial dao exacerbated the might of his martial techniques, thus allowing his combat ability to smoothly step into the realm of Heavenly Immortals.
“Wei Yang, Hong Shang, we meet again,”
As the two peerless empresses conversed, they suddenly heard Han Li’s voice and, turning towards a direction, saw the ethereal and handsome Han Li in white appear before them.
Although Han Li had been present at the Han Sea Battlefield, he had not paid much attention to the five supreme beings; in his eyes, they were as good as dead.
Instead, Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu had been the focus of his attention, secretly listening to their conversation.
The names Wei Yang and Hong Shang had just been overheard by Han Li, and he casually mentioned them.
Seeing Han Li appear with a somewhat intimate address, both Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu frowned, but soon relaxed their expressions.
Empress Yuanchu wore a light smile, looking directly at Han Li and sizing him up, while Empress Huang Yue had a cool expression, turning her pretty face to the side, but her gaze was also assessing Han Li.
The reactions of the two peerless empresses did not escape Han Li’s notice, and he smiled before speaking again, “Am I not welcome?”
“Hmph, who would welcome you?”
“That’s right, do you think you’re popular?”
Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu sneered, keeping their thoughts about Han Li to themselves for the time being.
“Tsk, tsk, who was it that said if I came to propose marriage, she would be my dao companion?” Han Li said with a chuckle.
A blush instantly rose on the flawless faces of both Empress Huang Yue and Empress Yuanchu, now aware that Han Li had eavesdropped on their earlier conversation.
“Shameless, even eavesdropping on our conversation,” Empress Yuanchu spat out contemptuously, sneering once more.
Empress Huang Yue’s expression returned to normal, as she looked at Han Li with a smile that was not quite a smile, suddenly asking, “So, when do you plan to propose?”
Empress Yuanchu looked at Empress Huang Yue in astonishment, not expecting her to betray their united front so quickly.
Han Li also hadn’t expected Empress Huang Yue to be so direct; he’d previously thought Empress Huang Yue was a tsundere, but it seemed he had misjudged her.
Empress Huang Yue, facing the surprise of Empress Yuanchu and Han Li, remained composed; however, inside she was anything but calm.
Previously, she indeed didn’t think this way; Han Li had shown unparalleled potential, worthy of her, and she had wanted Han Li to pursue her before accepting him.
But now the situation was different.
With Han Li possessing the Golden Immortal weapon, he was set to rule the entire Yuankun Domain.
Given Han Li’s lascivious nature, they would inevitably fall prey to his clutches, and Han Li probably wouldn’t bother to court her.
Therefore, Empress Huang Yue boldly decided to strike first, stating her intention before Empress Yuanchu could.
