chapters.title: Chapter 715
chapters.content:
Chapter 715: Chapter 273 Lift the Butcher’s Knife and Let the Blood Flow like a River, Continue to Break Through, Heaven Imperial Realm Peak!
Heavenly Immortal Peak Combat Ability_1 Chapter 715: Chapter 273 Lift the Butcher’s Knife and Let the Blood Flow like a River, Continue to Break Through, Heaven Imperial Realm Peak!
Heavenly Immortal Peak Combat Ability_1 “One year later,”
Han Li didn’t hesitate much and directly answered the Phoenix Moon Empress’ question.
He had already considered the matter of proposing marriage; after all, everything would proceed according to his plan.
Neither the Phoenix Moon Empress nor Empress Yuanchu had any room for choice.
He was the supreme ruler of the Yuankun Domain, and no one would be able to shake his status for the next two hundred million years or more.
As time passed, his strength would only grow stronger.
...
He wouldn’t need to pay attention to anything else; all beings in the Yuankun Domain would have to act according to his will.
However, Han Li would not meddle in everything.
He largely let things take their own course so that the Yuankun Domain could continue to operate, only interfering when it came to beautiful female cultivators.
Having reached his current state, Han Li no longer planned to marry many more wives.
He would simply take those with renowned beauty in the Yuankun Domain for now, and then strike again when the list of Heavenly Immortals was updated.
In fact, the vast majority were being prepared for the descendants of Han Mansion.
His offspring would multiply, and they would require increasingly more beautiful female cultivators as wives and concubines to breed more outstanding descendants.
Of course, those geniuses and heroes with exceptional talent joining their ranks were also indispensable.
As for the concerns about the cultivation resources, Han Li was not worried at all.
The forces of White Emperor City, Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, Longevity Qin Family, and Longevity Jiang Family would be entirely taken over by Chengsheng Mountain.
All the territories, cultivators, and resources of these five greatest powers would now belong to Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li was more than willing to act as the one who would take them over.
Although the supreme leaders of the five great powers had died this time, losing most of their Heavenly Immortal and True Immortal soldiers, there were still a few Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors and many other strong individuals left, who probably would not willingly submit to Chengsheng Mountain.
He hoped that the cultivators from these five great powers were wise enough not to harbor any ill intentions, or to make any untoward moves toward his beauties or treasures, otherwise Han Li would raise his slaughtering knife and cause a bloodbath.
As for the direct descendants and forces of supreme leaders like the White Emperor, Western Sky Palace master, and the Butian Sect Master, Han Li would uproot them completely, showing no mercy or soft-heartedness.
Other cultivators would probably be pleased with this outcome.
With most of the rulers gone and the major resource holders eliminated, other cultivators would be able to emerge, take charge, and gain access to more cultivation resources.
“You really are domineering,” Empress Yuanchu looked at him deeply.
A trace of dissatisfaction appeared on the Phoenix Moon Empress’s face, followed by a helpless nod; there was no other choice now.
At least Han Li still had some conscience and gave them face.
He did not take advantage of his invincible strength to simply snatch them, demanding marriage and taking their bodies on the spot.
This one year was the preparation time for them, whether mentally or physically, they needed to be ready to accept Han Li.
Fortunately, the two peerless Empresses had stopped opposing Han Li.
Initially, they already had an ambiguous relationship with him, and after a shift in mindset, they had developed some positive feelings.
Otherwise, they would not have thought to help Han Li through his tribulation earlier.
In the past, those in the Yuankun Domain qualified to be their Dao companions, such as the White Emperor, Supreme Leader of Qin Family, and a few others, were considerable.
But now that they were gone, and the more outstanding Han Li had stepped into the picture, the only one left in their eyes who was eligible was Han Li.
“Then you’d better get ready,” Phoenix Moon Empress pursed her lips and said.
“Don’t worry, I won’t mistreat you.
The wedding ceremony will match your status,” Han Li said with a smile.
“Wait.”
Empress Yuanchu glared at Han Li discontentedly and said coldly, “Are you only preparing for Red Garment?”
“You never said you wanted to marry me as a Dao companion,” Han Li shrugged.
“Shameless.”
Empress Yuanchu laughed out of anger, truly finding Han Li shameless.
This bastard had set his sights on her long ago, had personally spoken years before about visiting Yuanchu Mountain to propose.
And now that she had agreed, this bastard was making such comments.
Seeing Empress Yuanchu about to explode, Han Li hastened to say, “Don’t worry, Wuyang, the same goes for you.
I’ll prepare and come to propose.”
“You two will be the same in everything,” he added after a thought.
Empress Yuanchu and Phoenix Moon Empress were like nemeses.
Although things seemed harmonious now, if he favored one over the other, he would not have good grapes to eat in the future.
“You have some sense,” Empress Yuanchu huffed a couple times, a smile touching her flawlessly beautiful cheeks.
Han Li couldn’t help but swallow.
Even though he already had many tender wives and beautiful concubines, Empress Yuanchu was different.
She could bring him a sense of novelty in all aspects, and was a great attraction to Han Li.
It was the same with Phoenix Moon Empress.
Currently, there were no female cultivators in the Yuankun Domain more outstanding than Phoenix Moon Empress and Empress Yuanchu, excluding the Heavenly Immortal Feng Mian from another world.
Therefore, Han Li was more tolerant towards these two exceptional Empresses, not intending on any aggressive strategies.
With his current strength, status, identity, and influence, he had passed the stage of forcefulness and did not deign to abduct beautiful female cultivators.
These beauties would naturally throw themselves into his embrace.
“Wuyang, Red Garment, what are your full names?”
After conversing with Phoenix Moon Empress and Empress Yuanchu for a while, Han Li asked with a chuckle.
He only knew them by their titles, not their surnames.
Though he could find out from the Tianji Pavilion if he wanted to look into it, Han Li couldn’t be bothered with the effort.
It was better to ask directly.
“Tsk, I thought you knew, you bastard,” Empress Yuanchu said with a flirtatious glance at Han Li.
“You sure are direct,” the Phoenix Moon Empress was a bit speechless too.
Han Li had already been considering them, yet he didn’t even know their names, which was downright despicable.

chapters.title: Chapter 716
chapters.content:
Chapter 716: Chapter 273 Lift the Butcher’s Knife and Let the Blood Flow Like a River, Continue to Break Through, Heaven Imperial Realm Peak!
Heavenly Immortal Peak Combat Ability_2 Chapter 716: Chapter 273 Lift the Butcher’s Knife and Let the Blood Flow Like a River, Continue to Break Through, Heaven Imperial Realm Peak!
Heavenly Immortal Peak Combat Ability_2 “Yuan Weiyang.”
“Huang Hongshang.”
Despite mentally complaining about Han Li countless times, Empress Yuanchu and Empress Huangyue still briskly revealed their given names.
“Nice names.”
Han Li was not stingy with his compliments, spouting a stream of praise and even citing classics to analyze the virtues of their names.
The sweet flattery from Han Li managed to please Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu for a moment.
Although Yuan Weiyang and Huang Hongshang showed no favor to men, it still depended on who the man was.
Someone like the ruler of White Emperor City, they’d tell to get lost.
...
As for Han Li, they didn’t mind showing their true selves.
“If there’s nothing else, we’ll be taking our leave,” said Empress Huangyue.
“Wouldn’t you want to keep us around?
Who knows, tonight you might get lucky with ‘a dragon amidst two phoenixes’?” quipped Empress Yuanchu with a chuckle.
Confronted with Empress Yuanchu’s burning gaze, Han Li shrugged and said, “Next time for sure.”
He knew quite clearly that now was not the time.
Despite what Empress Yuanchu had said, if he agreed, Yuan Weiyang would certainly back out.
Given the pride of Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu, these peerless empresses had already made a significant compromise by agreeing to marry the same man; it was out of the question for them to also share his bed, especially on the first night.
However, there would be opportunities in the future.
He would just have to bide his time and strike when the time was right.
Watching the two peerless empresses leave, Han Li’s thoughts were swirling, and he decided to raise his standards for taking wives and concubines again, commencing after the weddings with these two peerless empresses.
After marrying Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu and adding Feng Mian, the Heavenly Immortal, and Empress Qin Shiyin to his court, his standards had naturally heightened.
Tearing his gaze away, Han Li’s figure vanished from the Divine Mountain in Luming Divine Province, appearing next to Feng Mian and Qin Shiyin.
After being affectionate with the two women, he returned to Chengsheng Mountain with one in each arm.
Upon returning to Chengsheng Mountain, the first thing Han Li did was to summon the Hundaoding cauldron, releasing thirty-one immortal weapons from forces including the Wuxian Palace.
He also appointed Lu Yao to take command of the cauldron.
He called forth all the spirits of these immortal weapons and “reasoned” with them.
After a period of harmonious communication, all the spirits were touched by Han Li’s words and eagerly embraced him.
Only after Han Li branded his mark in the core of all the immortal weapons, becoming their master, did he rest easy.
Right after that, Han Li immediately deployed troops and called for the capable descendants from the Han Mansion at Chengsheng Mountain.
Soon, a large number of exceptional descendants from the True Martial Realm, Divine Yuan Realm, and even Tongxuan Realm gathered at the Yundao Peak and Yundao Hall.
Han Li assigned them tasks and ordered them to immediately head for locations such as White Emperor City, Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, Longevity Qin Family, and Longevity Jiang Family.
To facilitate their missions and smoothly take over the “legacy” of the five most powerful forces, as well as to eliminate the direct lineage of the five supremes, Han Li bestowed various trump cards.
Under Han Li’s orders, the exceptional descendants split into five teams, each comprising dozens of members.
Depending on their cultivation levels, the weapons Han Li granted to these descendants varied.
True Martial Realm Emperor Wu was given a Quasi Emperor weapon, Divine Yuan Realm monarchs received Heaven Imperial Realm Emperor weapons one by one, and the mighty individuals of the Tongxuan Realm were each granted a Heavenly Immortal weapon.
Each team was led by two or three Tongxuan Realm exceptional descendants, meaning they each had two or three Heavenly Immortal weapons.
Though the five most powerful forces still possessed a Heavenly Immortal weapon each, they were not to be feared.
Moreover, with Han Li here to intimidate, if those descendants really couldn’t handle the situation, Han Li would directly use his True Immortal weapon to strike from afar and suppress all enemies.
Watching his descendants carrying Emperor weapons and Heavenly Immortal weapons cross the void towards White Emperor City, Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, Longevity Qin Family, and Longevity Jiang Family, taking over the foundations of the five most powerful forces, a smile spread across Han Li’s face.
Originally, he had thought of waiting to see if anyone would dare to jump out, and then capture them all in one swoop.
But upon reflection, he found it unnecessary.
Just kill, kill, kill.
Anyone who doesn’t submit, just kill them all.
After all, in the Yuankun Domain, he was the one who called the shots, and no one dared to oppose him.
Although there were still four most powerful forces left in the Yuankun Domain, the Solar Empire and Tianji Pavilion had already submitted and become vassals to Chengsheng Mountain, offering up vast profits annually.
Han Li would also reconsider the territorial distribution of these two greatest forces.
The Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain could be considered semi-independent, but the leaders of both forces had already reached an agreement with him to marry him as consorts in a year’s time.
Whether the Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain would still exist by then was another matter.
Han Li hadn’t decided yet whether to directly annex these two most powerful forces or let them share the same fate as Tianji Pavilion and the Solar Empire.
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back at the peak of Chengdao Peak, glanced toward Xuanshen Sword Mountain in the far east, and sighed slightly before disappearing without a trace.
The next moment, Han Li appeared in the Qiandao Hall.
He planned to continue his breakthrough, having spent most of his cultivation already, aiming to ascend from the first heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm in one fell swoop, thereby greatly enhancing his strength.
Sitting cross-legged on a cushion swirling with purple mist, Han Li took a deep breath and pressed on with his endeavor to break through the realms.
If this scene were seen by the outside world, it would certainly cause a huge sensation, shaking the entire Yuankun Domain to its core, probably causing even greater shockwaves than the deaths of the five most powerful forces’ supremes.
After all, in the ancient history of the countless ages of the Yuankun Domain, there have been many strong individuals who reached the absolute peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, countless of whom have died, but none had just grasped the Heavenly Sovereign Path, ascended to the Heaven Imperial Realm, become a Great Emperor, and then made a single leap from the first heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm to the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 717
chapters.content:
Chapter 717: Chapter 273 Lift the Butcher’s Knife and Let the Blood Flow Like a River, Continue to Break Through, Heaven Imperial Realm Peak!
Heavenly Immortal Peak Combat Ability_3 Chapter 717: Chapter 273 Lift the Butcher’s Knife and Let the Blood Flow Like a River, Continue to Break Through, Heaven Imperial Realm Peak!
Heavenly Immortal Peak Combat Ability_3 “`
If this were to spread, countless powerhouses from outside would likely think Han Li had gone mad, become a lunatic.
This is utterly the thought of a madman!
Yet Han Li didn’t care about that much; at this moment, his mind was pure, focused solely on breaking through to the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm in one go.
With a shift of his Divine Sense, the massive mana he had accumulated began to burn.
Every instant, hundreds to thousands of years of cultivation were consumed, and Han Li entered into an Enlightenment State unique to him.
...
In this Enlightenment State, Han Li’s understanding of ultimate martial arts soared dramatically.
Every moment, countless epiphanies emerged, and he could constantly feel his mastery over the ultimate martial arts laws deepening.
The passage of time in the Enlightenment State was swift.
In the blink of an eye, a thousand years passed.
Even so, it took Han Li a while in this state to exhaust the cultivation he had prepared.
The instant Han Li exited the Enlightenment State, his comprehension of the ultimate martial arts laws was finally complete, and his mastery over them reached perfection.
In an instant, Han Li’s cultivation rose steadily, his presence surged explosively, ascending rapidly, and even accelerating with time.
His aura vibrated throughout the Three Thousand Realms, with his might overwhelming all from ancient times.
If not for the Emperor Flag exerting its power to cover all movements, an earth-shattering commotion would have already arisen, attracting the attention of the entire Qianyuan Divine Province and even a significant part of the Yuankun Domain.
Heaven Imperial Realm Second Heaven!
Heaven Imperial Realm Fourth Heaven!
Heaven Imperial Realm Seventh Heaven!
With each passing instant, Han Li’s cultivation ascended by one heaven, the violent and potent force within him proliferating without causing him the slightest discomfort.
On one hand, this was because he had already achieved perfect mastery of the ultimate martial arts laws, and the next step was to commence understanding ultimate martial arts and ascend to Immortality through tribulation.
On the other hand, Han Li’s constitution was incredibly robust, a unique Immortal Body of myriad paths that appeared once in an eternity, with a physical strength unmatched, capable of tolerating the power surge brought about by his rapid increase in cultivation.
As Han Li’s cultivation skyrocketed, his Primordial Spirit, Immortal Body, mana, Divine Sense, five senses, and so on, all soared, enhancing madly every moment.
Finally, Han Li’s aura reached a pinnacle, his momentum ceased to climb, stabilizing at last, signifying that Han Li’s cultivation had attained the peak of the Ninth Heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Feeling the invincible power of the Endless Yuankun Domain within him, and the boundless, endless mana, Han Li laughed.
This effort had nearly drained the cultivation he had accumulated over many years, but it was all worth it, as his realm, in a single day from the previous rank of the Sixth Heaven of the Quasi Emperor, had soared to the peak of the Ninth Heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
In terms of realm alone, Han Li was now on par with Empress Huang Hongshang of the Phoenix Moon and Empress Yuan Weiyang of Yuanchu, at the absolute apex of the Yuankun Domain.
But his combat ability was countless times stronger than these two peerless empresses.
After all, when he first broke through to the First Heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm, he already possessed combat ability comparable to a common Heavenly Immortal, let alone now.
Although the nine minor realms within the Heaven Imperial Realm and the nine minor realms within the Immortal Domain were vastly different, Han Li could strive to bridge the gap, which for him was not insurmountable.
“Huff~”
Han Li exhaled softly, and his breath transformed in front of him, within which countless stars sparkled, galaxies rushed forth, and infinite mysteries blossomed…
Seeing this scene, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face as he was quite satisfied with his strength.
Rising from the purple mist-covered meditation cushion, Han Li disappeared from Qiandao Hall, reappearing at the summit of Chengdao Peak, gazing quietly at the world below.
This breakthrough had been long, taking up to half an hour, significantly longer than it usually took for Han Li’s past realm advancements.
“Now I’m truly unmatched in the Yuankun Domain,” Han Li murmured softly, his gaze inadvertently falling on Xuanshen Sword Mountain in the far east.
Only by stepping out of the Yuankun Domain would he encounter new opponents, but for a long time, Han Li would not entertain this thought.
Accustomed to enduring, and not fond of war, there was no need for him to step out of the Yuankun Domain, to clash with the eminent powers of the Tai Chu Realm any time soon.
Now that he was invincible in the Yuankun Domain, it was the most suitable place for his development.
Han Mansion’s rule over the Yuankun Domain was uncontested, and within the Endless Yuankun Domain, no one dared to disrespect him; otherwise, Han Li would not mind making an example of them.
Within the Yuankun Domain, he could develop unrestrainedly, free from the interference of stronger beings from higher realms, without the risk of external threats.
As long as he continued to develop for tens of thousands, or even a hundred thousand years, he would likely have the foundation to step out of the Yuankun Domain and face the Thirty-three Heavens.
The Yuankun Domain was vast, encompassing Eight Hundred Divine Regions, infinite and boundless.
Yet the Yuankun Domain was also small, merely one of the 129,600 realms in the Tai Chu Realm, above which were the Thirty-three Heavens.
For Han Li, anything beyond the Yuankun Domain was extremely dangerous; it wasn’t a place where he could roam freely just because he possessed a Golden Immortal weapon.
Indeed, within the Taichu Domain, save for isolated and remote territories like the Yuankun Domain, other domains each had their profound heritage.
From these domains, innumerable Immortal Domain powerhouses had emerged, including Immortal Kings, Immortal Emperors, and even Immortal Sovereigns.
In the mainstream perspective of the Tai Chu Realm, any domain that had never produced even an Immortal King was seen as a backwater.
Such weaker domains were plentiful, comprising nearly half of the Tai Chu Realm.
Most domains had at least given birth to one Immortal King or an even stronger entity, and even in the weaker domains, many Eternal Golden Immortals had appeared.
The majority of Immortals in the Tai Chu Realm resided within the Thirty-three Heavens, but a small number also lived within the Taichu Domain, among which were Immortal King Rank powerhouses and even reclusive Quasi Immortal Emperors (Immortal Heirs).

chapters.title: Chapter 718
chapters.content:
Chapter 718: Chapter 273 Lift the Butcher’s Knife and Let the Blood Flow Like a River, Continue to Break Through, Heaven Imperial Realm Peak!
Heavenly Immortal Peak Combat Ability_4 Chapter 718: Chapter 273 Lift the Butcher’s Knife and Let the Blood Flow Like a River, Continue to Break Through, Heaven Imperial Realm Peak!
Heavenly Immortal Peak Combat Ability_4 Some domains, even without a powerful Immortal presiding, yet have the great forces within the domain with Immortal ancestors in the Thirty-three Heavens.
If necessary, they could kill their way back to the lower world.
Han Li was quite knowledgeable about these matters, having gathered intelligence from within the Xuxian Realm, so he had no thoughts of venturing out and decided to just survive in the secluded Yuankun Domain.
Actually, the Yuankun Domain also contained a terrifying calamity that was even more dangerous than other domains in the Taichu Realm.
Once it erupted, perhaps not even Golden Immortals or Immortal Kings could withstand it.
...
Fortunately, such a calamitous disaster followed a pattern, erupting only six times each era, and over countless eras, there had never been one more or one less.
Therefore, Han Li didn’t take the great calamity of the Yuankun Domain to heart, as it was still very far from him.
There were still over two hundred million years left in this era, and he was barely three hundred years old.
Even if Han Li were to rule and dominate within the Yuankun Domain, causing slaughter on a massive scale, it wouldn’t catch the attention of the master of Xuanshen Sword Mountain, as his combat ability was at best that of a Heavenly Immortal, and there were not a few True Immortals in every era of the Yuankun Domain.
Moreover, Han Li had no intentions of doing so.
He only wanted to live a low-key life, surviving while also taking in some peerlessly beautiful wives and concubines to grow his family, increasing the population of his descendants.
“Sigh~”
Han Li let out a light sigh and diverted his gaze; thinking about these things was too far off in the future.
This time, having advanced to the peak of the Nine Heavens in the Heaven Imperial Realm in one breath, his cultivation reserves had drastically reduced to only about twenty-five thousand.
He planned to use it sparingly.
While this amount of cultivation was not enough for him to break through to the Heavenly Immortal Realm, he still needed to open the monthly treasure chest and to go fishing in the Myriad Realms.
After ascending to the Heaven Imperial Realm, Han Li’s lifespan was extended by seven hundred thousand years, now totaling over two million years, reaching two million one hundred thousand years, over twice the lifespan of other emperors at the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Han Li’s combat ability had also greatly increased, making rapid progress within the realm of Heavenly Immortals.
Now, he was comparable to those in the Seventh Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and if he activated his Divine Sense, he could reach the peak of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Although his combat ability still could not touch the realm of True Immortals, once he activated his Divine Sense, he was undoubtedly an ultimate force among Heavenly Immortals, invincible in the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Why couldn’t his combat ability reach the peak of the Heavenly Immortal Realm when his cultivation had reached the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm?
Han Li knew the reasons.
On one hand, each minor realm within the Heavenly Immortal domain had a great disparity, and on the other hand, it was because the grade of his martial techniques couldn’t keep up.
If he learned higher-grade martial techniques and combined them with the boost from the ultimate martial path, his combat ability would smoothly reach the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and he might even step into the realm of True Immortals upon activating his Divine Sense.
Han Li was never worried about martial techniques, as he only needed to spend some time to enhance them.
In addition to mastering high-grade martial techniques rewarded by the system, he could also spend cultivation to deduce martial techniques from the Taichu Realm to perfection.
It just so happened he had killed the five supreme beings and taken over White Emperor City, Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, and other top five powerful forces, which would grant him access to all kinds of Immortal Grade martial skills stored by these five forces.
The five top forces certainly had Heaven Immortal Rank cultivation techniques and martial skills.
He wondered if there were any True Immortal Rank techniques.
If so, that would be great, as it could further perfect his Chaotic Decision.
After some thought, Han Li opened his personal panel.
Age: 284
Realm: Peak of Heaven Imperial Realm
Mana: Seventh Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm
Primordial Spirit: Seventh Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm
Divine Sense: Seventh Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm
Physique: Fourth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm
Strength: Fifth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm
Speed: Fifth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm
Defense: Fourth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm
Combat Ability: Seventh Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm
After just a glance, Han Li understood his own situation like the back of his hand.
Having the System quantify the data was much better than his own guessing.
Han Li decided that from now on, he would train in several more powerful Immortal Grade martial skills in speed, defense, strength, and the physical body to compensate for these shortcomings.
PS: Happy birthday to our Alliance Leader “Lu Bi”!

chapters.title: Chapter 719
chapters.content:
Chapter 719: Chapter 274: The Greatest Genius from Time Immemorial, The Changes in the Divine Sense Domain, Misfortune and Fortune Depend on Each Other, One Path Leads to Ten Thousand Paths!_1 Chapter 719: Chapter 274: The Greatest Genius from Time Immemorial, The Changes in the Divine Sense Domain, Misfortune and Fortune Depend on Each Other, One Path Leads to Ten Thousand Paths!_1 Finally, Han Li shifted his gaze to the first section of his personal panel.
284 years old!
This was indeed an extremely dazzling number.
In the ancient history of the Yuankun Domain, there were only a few who broke through to the Heaven Imperial Realm and mastered the Heavenly Sovereign Path to become Great Emperors before the age of three hundred.
And Han Li was the only one who had cultivated to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm and became a war immortal before the age of three hundred.
He had broken historical records and could be called the unparalleled first in the eternal history of the Yuankun Domain, without predecessors and likely without successors.
Han Li had many reflections on this.
...
The world was unpredictable; back when he was cultivating on Tianxuan Mountain, he was just a weak cultivator who had just stepped onto the path of cultivation, as insignificant as an ant.
Now, he had become the lord of the Yuankun Domain, determining the fate of its countless beings.
Who could clearly articulate the bizarre twists and turns in between?
At the age of one hundred and fifty, he had reluctantly descended the mountain, married, and had children, not expecting that from then on, things would spiral out of control.
At the age of one hundred and ninety-five, Han Li had accumulated enough to make a decisive breakthrough, and he surged forward to the Pihai Realm, thereafter breaking various records with his cultivation speed.
Now, at just two hundred and eighty-four years old, Han Li had already cultivated to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, standing at the peak of the entire Yuankun Domain, as the foremost individual in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
In just ninety years, Han Li’s cultivation had broken through from the Pihai Realm, Gangyuan Realm, God Refining Realm, Hollow Void Stage, Myriad Phenomena Realm, True Martial Realm, Divine Yuan Realm, Tongxuan Realm, Quasi Emperor Realm, and up to the Heaven Imperial Realm.
To break through more than a dozen Big Realms in ninety years, that cultivation speed was frighteningly fast.
Even for a normal Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, with a lifespan of a million years, being under three hundred years old was far too short against a million-year lifespan, let alone Han Li’s lifespan, which exceeded two million years.
“Let’s set another small goal then,” Han Li said softly to himself, his face brimming with a confident smile, full of vigor.
Previously, he had set a small goal to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm before the age of three hundred, and he had achieved it so quickly.
Now, Han Li set his new small goal to break through to the Heavenly Immortal Realm before the age of three hundred, which still held considerable hope.
If need be, he would just have to work a bit harder.
At that moment, Feng Mian and Qin Shiyin appeared beside Han Li, and a look of surprise flashed in his eyes.
Since coming out from the Thousand Realm Ocean, Feng Mian seemed to get along very well with Qin Shiyin, almost inseparable.
He wondered if there was something more between them.
Han Li didn’t care about these things, as he could handle it all.
Playing together was more fun anyway.
He wrapped his left arm around the soft waist of Feng Mian and his right arm around the slender and seemingly fragile waist of Qin Shiyin, embracing both, and even planted a kiss.
A look of helplessness flashed in Feng Mian’s eyes, yet she did not stop him, as she had already accepted her fate.
Qin Shiyin shot Han Li a glare, understanding his intentions all too well, but she did not expose them.
She was still Han Li’s fiancÃ©e and had not yet formally become his dao companion, with her purity intact, so talking about it was of little use.
After thinking it over, Qin Shiyin’s lips parted slightly, and she asked a question that had long piqued her curiosity.
“My Lord, to what level has your Divine Sense reached?”
Feng Mian’s eyes lit up, and she too turned to look at Han Li, very curious about this question.
When Han Li first fished her out of the Thousand Realm Ocean, Feng Mian could still see through his cultivation level.
Even after Han Li ascended to become a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, by observing his aura, Feng Mian could roughly estimate that his strength was not as strong as hers.
But from the time Han Li returned from his ordeal on Chengsheng Mountain to now, not even two hours had passed, and Feng Mian found that she could no longer see through Han Li at all.
Even the faint aura that Han Li inadvertently revealed made her feel threatened.
This made Feng Mian extremely curious about what had happened to Han Li to cause such a drastic change.
She had witnessed Han Li overcoming the great trial that proved his way and knew that Han Li had the combat ability of a Heavenly Immortal.
But he was just an ordinary Heavenly Immortal, at most comparable to the first or second stage of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Once Han Li activated his Divine Sense, his combat ability would soar, possibly reaching the fourth or fifth stage of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and even possibly to the sixth stage.
However, compared to her, Han Li was still lacking.
After all, she was at the Seventh Stage of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and her Divine Sense had reached the Fourth Stage, the same as Empress Yuanchu Yuan Weiyang and Huang Hongshang, which could increase her combat ability by three minor realms.
In other words, Feng Mian’s peak combat ability was comparable to the pinnacle of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
But now, the aura that Han Li was displaying was no less potent than hers, and perhaps even slightly stronger.
How could Feng Mian not be curious?
“My Lord, please tell us, I want to know too,” Feng Mian implored, hugging Han Li’s arm and shaking it coquettishly, unwilling to let go.
The surprising softness snapped Han Li out of his reverie.
Looking at Qin Shiyin, then at Feng Mian, he noticed that both women were very expectant.
He had just been considering how to respond.
Divine Sense was something that could be shared, but how much to reveal was up to him to decide.
For some highly potential prodigies, Divine Sense was not a secret, and among the Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, it was openly known information.
Every Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor mastered Divine Sense; it was just the level of mastery that varied.
When Han Li was at the Sixth Stage of the Quasi Emperor Realm, he had already delved deeply into Divine Sense, reaching the Sixth Stage, which could elevate his combat ability by five minor realmsâ€”a unique achievement in the Yuankun Domain.
Upon breaking through to the Heaven Imperial Realm and successfully proving his way as an Emperor, Han Li’s Divine Sense had advanced further to the Seventh Stage, which could elevate his combat ability by six minor realms.
Just now, in one breath, he had risen to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, causing his Primordial Spirit, Divine Sense, and all senses to multiply by many times.
Astonishingly, this had led to another step forward in the field of Divine Sense, reaching the Eighth Stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 720
chapters.content:
Chapter 720: Chapter 274: The Greatest Genius from Time Immemorial, The Changes in the Divine Sense Domain, Misfortune and Fortune Depend on Each Other, One Path Leads to Ten Thousand Paths!_2 Chapter 720: Chapter 274: The Greatest Genius from Time Immemorial, The Changes in the Divine Sense Domain, Misfortune and Fortune Depend on Each Other, One Path Leads to Ten Thousand Paths!_2 Now, Han Li’s combat ability had reached the seventh heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and the Eighth Stage Divine Sense allowed him to ascend seven minor realms in combat strength, but it was still not enough to step into the True Immortal domain in one fell swoop.
The reason for this was the huge restraint between the Heavenly Immortal and True Immortal Realms, with a world of difference in strength between the two Big Realms.
Even with the stimulation of Divine Sense, Han Li’s combat ability could only reach the pinnacle of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Of course, there was also a great disparity in strength among those at the pinnacle of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
With the same cultivation level, factors such as Cultivation Techniques, martial abilities, Divine Sense, physical body, Primordial Spirit, and the path of martial arts affected one’s power, resulting in unequal strengths.
All being at the pinnacle of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, whether one was stuck at a level or deliberately suppressing their realm, the improvement of combat ability had to be approached from various aspects, continually advancing toward the True Immortal domain.
Comparing Feng Mian with Han Li, Feng Mian was barely on the same level as Han Li, both ranked in the seventh heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
...
Feng Mian’s Divine Sense was at the Fourth Stage, and activating it would only be equivalent to the most ordinary peak of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Han Li’s Divine Sense, on the other hand, was at the Eighth Stage, and activating it not only granted him the peak combat ability of the Heavenly Immortal Realm but also allowed him to break through four more levels on this basis.
Although both were at the peak of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, there was still a disparity of four minor realms in strength between Feng Mian and Han Li, and Han Li could slay an ordinary combatant of the peak Heavenly Immortal Realm with a single move.
Because the exploration and records of Divine Sense in the Yuankun Domain were limited and, while extremely profound in the Taichu Realm, it was also a secret that Han Li could not consult about.
He did not know the limit of Divine Sense, whether it was the Tenth Stage, increasing seven minor realms of combat strength, or if there were deeper levels that could help one break the restraint of a Big Realm and promote one’s combat ability by an entire Big Realm.
“Shiyin, Mian’er, I have already explored up to the Sixth Stage of Divine Sense,” Han Li said with a smile.
In the end, he decided to keep some secrets to himself, otherwise, it would seem too shocking, although his current achievements were already shocking the world.
“Sss~”
Qin Shiyin and Feng Mian both gasped in shock, making a small contribution to warming the Taichu Realm.
“My goodness, husband, have you really reached the Sixth Stage of Divine Sense?”
“Isn’t Divine Sense only comprised of four stages?
How did you achieve this?”
“Ah, this is…
truly too incredible, husband, you truly deserve the title of the unparalleled genius of the Yuankun Domain throughout the ages!”
Qin Shiyin’s mouth gaped open in an ‘O’ shape, her face filled with shock, her speech rendered incoherent, making Han Li abandon any thought of interrupting her.
Qin Shiyin was genuinely astounded by her fiancÃ©’s earth-shattering accomplishments, looking at Han Li with eyes full of admiration.
Her betrothed Han Li had not only survived the unprecedented ninety-nine Heavenly Tribulations during his ascension to the Heaven Imperial Realm, but had also possessed the combat ability of a Heavenly Immortal while at the first heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm, another unprecedented feat.
It was unexpected that Han Li’s talent in Divine Sense was so terrifying, having reached the Sixth Stage and thus setting a new record in the Yuankun Domain for all of time.
Divine Sense at the Sixth Stage, enhancing one’s combat ability by five minor realms : no wonder her husband had the power to rival the mid-stage of the Heaven Imperial Realm when he was only at the Quasi Emperor level.
Plus, Han Li had become the foremost individual in the Yuankun Domain before even reaching three hundred years of age, adorned with various dazzling auras, all of which left Qin Shiyin moved and full of admiration.
As Han Li achieved such brilliant success, Qin Shiyin felt honored, and being one of the companions to such a man was a great privilege.
Qin Shiyin’s own talents and wit were not lacking either, far outstripping the vast majority of beings in the Yuankun Domain.
She possessed Immortal Grade aptitude and was of imperial lineage, and despite her not having cultivated for longâ€”merely under six thousand years oldâ€”her progress was indeed among the top tier in the ancient history of the Yuankun Domain, hence her high standards.
In the entire Yuankun Domain, only Yuan Weiyang and Huang Hongshang, the two peerless empresses, surpassed Qin Shiyin.
Other female sovereigns of the Heaven Imperial Realm were about the same as her, all at the Third Stage of Divine Sense.
Qin Shiyin looked affectionately at Han Li without suspicion that he was lying, as there was no need for him to deceive her in this regard, and Han Li’s achievements were there for all to see.
Han Li blinked, since when did he hold the title of “Unparalleled Genius of the Yuankun Domain Throughout the Ages”?
“It’s true that there are six stages of Divine Sense, it’s just that I didn’t expect my husband to have explored to such an extent,” Feng Mian said with a complex tone, her beautiful eyes intently observing Han Li, as if trying to see right through him.
She came from another world and was a late-stage Heavenly Immortal Phoenix, so her outlook and knowledge far exceeded Qin Shiyin’s.
In her world, there were indeed six stages of Divine Sense, but those who reached that height in each epoch were few and far between, sometimes even nonexistent.
According to Feng Mian’s understanding, Divine Sense could, in some ways, reflect a cultivator’s potential.
Reaching the Second Stage of Divine Sense indicated potential for the Heaven Imperial Realm, the Third Stage for the Heavenly Immortal Realm, the Fourth Stage for the True Immortal Realm, and the Fifth Stage for the potential of the Golden Immortal Realm.
Reaching the Sixth Stage of Divine Sense indicated potential for the Immortal Emperor level, and every Immortal Emperor on record had explored up to the Sixth Stage of Divine Sense.
She herself had only reached the Fourth Stage of Divine Sense, and it was profoundly more difficult to reach the Fifth Stage than to advance to the True Immortal Realm.
Qin Shiyin was probably a stage below her, while the other two empresses who appeared earlier were probably around her level.
Upon hearing this, Qin Shiyin glanced at Feng Mian thoughtfully, how did she know these secrets?
“Mian’er, there’s still much you haven’t imagined,” Han Li said with a smile, winking at Feng Mian.

chapters.title: Chapter 721
chapters.content:
Chapter 721: Chapter 274: The Greatest Genius from Time Immemorial, The Changes in the Divine Sense Domain, Misfortune and Fortune Depend on Each Other, One Path Leads to Ten Thousand Paths!_3 Chapter 721: Chapter 274: The Greatest Genius from Time Immemorial, The Changes in the Divine Sense Domain, Misfortune and Fortune Depend on Each Other, One Path Leads to Ten Thousand Paths!_3 Feng Mian instantly grasped the meaning behind Han Li’s words and silently sighed, realizing it was indeed so.
Before, she had never expected to be lured into another world, which could be described as a calamity falling from the sky.
However, with good fortune often comes hidden in misfortune, and she might just turn her misfortune into fortune.
Whether it would be fortune or misfortune depended on how Han Li treated her in the future.
Merely sweet nothings were of no use, as they could only make her happy temporarily.
She planned to quietly observe Han Li’s actions.
Next, Han Li spoke many more words of affection, all of which were full of deep and endless love, making Qin Shiyin, who already somewhat admired him, even more infatuated.
...
Even Feng Mian was firmly grasped by Han Li.
“Shiyin, would you like to join us?”
Han Li wrapped his arms around Feng Mian’s soft waist, ready to discuss the Dao, and extended the invitation to Qin Shiyin.
Qin Shiyin hesitated a bit but ultimately shook her head.
If possible, she would prefer to save herself for their wedding day to give herself to Han Li, but if Han Li insisted, she would not stand her ground.
Seeing that Qin Shiyin was unwilling, Han Li did not force her.
He was no longer the same man as before and no longer harbored those wicked tastes.
After some more time, regardless of whether Yuan Youwei continued to bear descendants with the royal physique, Han Li would keep raising her status to become his true Dao companion.
“Jerk.”
Feng Mian muttered under her breath with clenched teeth but said nothing more.
By now, she had given up and resigned herself to fate.
Han Li had more than her as his Dao companion, and she was not the only one.
Han Li had so many cherished wives and beautiful concubines, and would welcome even more in the future.
Situations like today’s were bound to happen again, and although Feng Mian felt uneasy, what could she possibly say?
For the sake of daily discussions on the Dao, Han Li made full use of the Time-Sky Tower, engaging in intense physical battles with Feng Mian on the ninth level.
By the time Han Li appeared again, it was already the next morning.
Han Li felt like a master of time management, firmly upholding the principle that “time is money,” able to split a single day into a hundred.
“Huff~”
Gazing at the dawning day, Han Li absorbed the first ray of morning purple energy between heaven and earth before turning to look at the female Bodhisattva, Han Linxi, standing beside him.
The female Bodhisattva had arrived yesterday.
Not long after Han Li passed his tribulation, she had come to Chengsheng Mountain and looked around, gaining a new understanding of her status and treatment.
The female Bodhisattva was very satisfied with all of this.
The only dissatisfaction was that Han Li had gone to fool around, and he hadn’t spent much time with her last night.
It had only been a few days since she and Han Li had gotten together, and during these days, Han Li would spend the nights with her.
However, last night he did not.
If she hadn’t come to Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li, that jerk, probably wouldn’t have even thought of her.
“My husband, is it time for early morning lessons?” The female Bodhisattva smiled with allure and without a hint of shyness.
“Yes.” Han Li was succinct.
“Then what are you waiting for?”
“You little vixen, take a hit from Old Han’s staff.”
“Pah, I’m a female Bodhisattva, not some vixen~”
“You demon, still pretending?
I can see at a glance that you’re not a female Bodhisattvaâ€”take this: Supreme Dragon Strike!”
……
When Han Li appeared again at the summit of Chengdao Peak, it was already two hours later.
This time, he was without his other beautiful wives and concubines.
Han Li calmly focused his mind, carefully perceiving the will of the heavens, comprehending the myriad aspects of the mortal world, delving into the profound laws, and naturally entered the Enlightenment State.
The enlightenment was not long, lasting only a moment, but it was enough for Han Li.
“So that’s how it is.”
After the enlightenment ended, Han Li reflected on it thoroughly, absorbing and digesting all insights before he finally opened his eyes and muttered to himself.
He had fully understood how to break through to the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Han Li was cultivating the ultimate martial path, the strongest of all times.
It was only now that he had truly begun to appreciate the power of this ultimate path.
To reach the Heaven Imperial Realm, one must grasp the Heavenly Sovereign Path, mastering the will of the heavens and subduing the laws of the Dao.
Only with both could one be called a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Previously, Han Li thought that Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm were already formidable, but after his enlightenment, he realized that the Heaven Imperial Realm was merely the first step in the martial path.
From Han Li’s perspective, he believed that the last Big Realm of the second step in cultivation was the true starting point, where one began to cultivate the laws of their own martial path.
Once one cultivates a certain law to perfection, they would naturally reach the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
The next step would be to formally cultivate the martial path, but this is not easy, as one must break through to the Heavenly Immortal Realm and step onto the third phase of cultivation.
Some cultivators choose to focus solely on one law to break through from the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm to the Heavenly Immortal Realm and then further their mastery, while others choose to merge several perfected laws into one, gaining an even stronger mastery over the Dao thereafter.
Han Li was walking both paths, truly taking a dual approach, ensuring strength in both.
Although he was only cultivating the laws of the ultimate martial path, this path encompasses all other laws.
As they say, “All techniques lead to one, all paths converge into one,” and they all converge into Han Li’s ultimate martial path.
When he perfected the law of the ultimate martial path, he naturally perfected the laws of other great paths as wellâ€”mastering one technique is mastering all, achieving one path is achieving all.
This was why Han Li’s combat ability was far stronger than others; otherwise, he could not have had the combat ability of a seventh-tier Heavenly Immortal while only in the first tier of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
In terms of martial skills, Han Li didn’t have much of an advantageâ€”his techniques were at most perfectedâ€”but with the ultimate martial path’s enhancement, it was a different story altogether, making his combat ability surge countless times.
If he wanted to break through from the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm to the Heavenly Immortal Realm, he needed to incorporate more martial paths until he could officially construct the framework of the first stage of the ultimate martial path.
Even though Han Li could cheat the system, accomplishing this still required a significant amount of time.
So Han Li chose to use a bigger cheat, which was to stop cultivating and wait until his cultivation was sufficient; then, he could break through to the Heavenly Immortal Realm in one goâ€”the more efficient, labor-saving approach.
Thinking about the cultivation needed for the breakthrough to the Heavenly Immortal Realm, Han Li also felt a headacheâ€”it was not a small amount.
With some effort, there was hope that he could accumulate enough within 16 years.
Now that he had successfully transcended the tribulation and was unrivaled in the Yuankun Domain, once the teams sent to take over the legacies of the five strongest forces returned and after spending some time integrating the Yuankun Domain and establishing rules, he could then disperse the descendants of the Han Mansion spread across Chengsheng Mountain.
At this point in its development, only by spreading the Han Mansion’s descendants across the Eight Hundred Divine Regions could their number grow more rapidly.
Han Li had ensured cultivation resources, a cultivation environment, and personal safety.
After establishing branches of the Han Mansion in the Eight Hundred Divine Regions, those descendants could take local beautiful female cultivators as wives or recruit handsome male cultivators as sons-in-law.
If all went smoothly, by the time he reached three hundred years old, there was hope that the number of Han Mansion’s descendants could break through to the next numerical level.

Chapter 722: Chapter 275: The Grand Assembly of Guanghan, the Great Eternal Realm, Crimson Heaven Court and Longhan Heavenly Court, the Lost Ancient History_1 Chapter 722: Chapter 275: The Grand Assembly of Guanghan, the Great Eternal Realm, Crimson Heaven Court and Longhan Heavenly Court, the Lost Ancient History_1 Taichu Realm, Guanghan Heaven.
Guanghan Heaven was not only boundlessly vast but also thriving and prosperous, inhabited by countless Immortals, among them Noble Immortals, Immortal Kings, and even Quasi Immortal Emperors.
These Immortals were spread across Guanghan Heaven, each with their own territories, establishing and overseeing various Immortal mansions and paths, either serving directly in the Guanghan Immortal Palace, as forces under direct command of the palace, or as semi-independent powers that recognized the supreme status of Guanghan Immortal Palace.
Every 12.96 billion years, Guanghan Heaven would hold a Guanghan Grand Assembly.
Influential powers within Guanghan Heaven were invited to the gathering, where significant figures from all quarters would convene, including those from other Immortal Palaces and even from the Heavenly Court.
Each Guanghan Grand Assembly saw countless exceptional prodigies striving by all means to participate, all hoping to stand out during the Grand Assembly, to be noticed by significant figures, to soar to the heavens in a single bound, or simply wanting to use the platform of the Grand Assembly to make a name for themselves throughout the entire Taichu Realm.
After all, who could resist the Guanghan Grand Assembly, one of the seven grand assemblies of the Taichu Realm?
...
There were still ten thousand years till the next Guanghan Grand Assembly, yet the Guanghan Immortal Palace had already begun preparations, sending out invitations to notable figures, requesting those of Guanghan Heaven as well as other heavenly domes to join the grand event.
The master of the Guanghan Immortal Palace was none other than the Guanghan Empress, whose strength was overwhelmingly mighty and unfathomably deep.
She ranked among the top five, if not stronger, in the entire Taichu Realm.
Even though the Taichu Realm had no official ranking for Immortal Emperors, a rough estimate could still be made based on the number of years each had been in the Immortal Emperor Realm, along with their past achievements.
The Guanghan Empress had a world-shocking record of achievements.
She had been a veteran powerhouse within the Immortal Emperor Realm even during the Old Heavenly Court era, rumored to have played a crucial role in the battle that led to the Old Heavenly Court’s downfall, having clashed with the former Emperor of Heaven.
After the establishment of the current Crimson Heaven Court, the Guanghan Empress battled with several Immortal Emperors.
The outcomes were mostly unknown, but subsequent developments seemed to suggest that the Guanghan Empress had the upper hand.
Thus when the Guanghan Empress hosted the Guanghan Grand Assembly, more and more significant figures began to attend each session, with each event being grander than the last, and many unparalleled geniuses rising to fame in the Taichu Realm.
At this moment, in the Guanghan Immortal Palace, within the Guanghan Emperor’s Palace, a bright moon hung high, its moonlight dazzling, as if it were the true Taiyin Star itself.
The Guanghan Empress, clad in a moon-white luxurious Immortal robe, stood with her hands behind her back, silently gazing at the bright moon.
The brilliant moonlight swirled around her, highlighting her graceful and exquisitely contoured perfect form even more enticingly.
In her presence, the bright moon seemed to fade in comparison.
“Still not quite there, where exactly is the problem?”
The Guanghan Empress’s eyebrows were knitted, lightly powdered, her beautiful eyes full of deep thought and puzzlement.
The bright moon in the Emperor’s Palace was naturally not the true Taiyin Star; it was the manifestation of the Guanghan Empress’s Great Path, a display of her cultivation, her understanding of the Great Path.
Even Immortal Kings would fall into sudden enlightenment at a glance, with endless Dao mysteries hidden within.
The Guanghan Empress, who had divined the secrets of creation, had already pushed her cultivation to the very brink of the Immortal Emperor Realm.
Her strength was unfathomable, nearly invincible, and even the current Emperor of Heaven had to give her some deference.
However, like other peak Immortal Emperors, she had reached the end of her path.
Despite knowing that there was a legendary fourth step in cultivation ahead, she could not cross it, unable to witness the more wondrous scenery of the Great Path.
“Four calamities have passed, how much longer will they confine me?” The Guanghan Empress murmured, her vermilion lips slightly moving, a bit of frustration in her words.
She had reached the pinnacle of the Immortal Emperor Realm before the fourth calamity.
She could still improve her strength during the first three calamities, but during the fourth, her strength had stagnated, unable to advance further.
For the duration of four calamities, she had waited for countless ages.
If this continued, her ambition and grand vision would gradually wear away, and she would forever remain at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.
Note: One calamity equals 3,600 kalpas, one kalpa equals 12.96 billion years.
This was not what the Guanghan Empress desired.
If there truly were no paths ahead, if she had reached the end of the Great Path, the Guanghan Empress would not be so troubled.
The key was that the fourth step of cultivation really did exist.
Naturally, as one of the strongest in this world, the Guanghan Empress knew much about it, and she recognized its greatness.
Mortals and Cultivators living on stars believed the universe to be endlessly vast and immensely large, encompassing innumerable star domains, star rivers, and boundless giant stars.
Many Saints vie for supremacy, Quasi Emperors contend for dominance, Great Emperors struggle for power, and even Heavenly Immortals reside permanently in the great cosmos, their glory dazzling.
But in the eyes of the Immortals of the Taichu Realm, these were all insignificant.
The so-called great universe was not worth mentioning.
A Heavenly Immortal could easily destroy a great cosmos, wiping out infinite lives with a mere wave of their hand.
The Taichu Realm stood supreme above the great cosmos, located in a higher dimension.
For example, the Cosmic Sea of the Taichu Realm was formed by countless shattered great universes, a single drop of which was equivalent to one great universe.
In fact, in the space where the Taichu Realm resided, a great universe was just a drop of water.
The higher dimension was truly infinite and endlessly vast, immeasurable and limitless.
Even the Taichu Realm, an immensely large entity, seemed minuscule in this higher dimension, occupying only a tiny area.
This higher dimension, referred to by its ancient name, was called the Great Eternal Realm.
Ever since that incident occurred, the Great Eternal Realm had acquired another name, known as the “Myriad Heavenly Realms.”
Within the Great Eternal Realm, there existed countless superior worlds, each with different names, collectively referred to as the Myriad Heavenly Realms.

Chapter 723: Chapter 275: The Grand Assembly of Guanghan, the Great Eternal Realm, Crimson Heaven Court and Longhan Heavenly Court, the Lost Ancient History_2 Chapter 723: Chapter 275: The Grand Assembly of Guanghan, the Great Eternal Realm, Crimson Heaven Court and Longhan Heavenly Court, the Lost Ancient History_2 “`
The Taichu Realm is one of the myriad heavens and possesses an extraordinary brilliance that allows it to rank among the top ten realms, showcasing its remarkable splendor and prosperity.
Such might of the Taichu Realm naturally relates to its heritage and strength, which confidently secures its position among the top ten of the myriad heavens without even mentioning its historical background.
The Taichu Realm is not short of Immortal Emperors, with over a dozen known publicly, spread throughout the Heavenly Court and various immortal palaces.
There are legends of Immortal Emperors dwelling in forbidden areas such as the Land of the Supreme Heaven, the Cosmic Sea, Emperor Yuan’s Plain, the Ancient Immortal River, the Ancient Reincarnation Land, the Origin Sea, and others.
The martial exploits of the Taichu Realm’s Immortal Emperors are formidable.
For instance, the Guanghan Empress once rampaged across the Great Eternal Realm, alone piercing through the Three Thousand Realms with her fists governing the heavens and her palm pressing down upon the myriad realms, defeating many at the Immortal Emperor Realm and even slaying some Immortal Emperors.
Yet, strong as the Guanghan Empress was, she remained confined to the peak of the third step in cultivation, unable to glimpse the fourth step, as if held in check by an invisible barrier.
...
“Where have the fourth-step powerhouses of the Great Eternal Realm gone?”
Gazing at the bright moon before her, the Guanghan Empress’s brows slightly furrowed, a look of perplexity flashing in her beautiful eyes.
This was her question, and it was also the shared inquiry among countless Quasi Immortal Emperors and Immortal Emperors of the myriad heavens, concerning their path and serving as the driving force for the Immortal Emperors to keep exploring.
There is no doubt that the fourth-step powerhouses once existed in the Great Eternal Realm, for there is evidence of their presence.
Take, for instance, the Taiyin Star and the Thousand Realm Star, the two greatest celestial bodies in the Great Eternal Realm.
Their luminous sun and moonlight illuminate the myriad heavens.
The suns and moons scattered throughout the endless universe are merely the projections of a single thread of light from the Taiyin Star and the Thousand Realm Star, and a single thread of sunlight or moonlight can cast innumerable suns and moons across a great universe.
The Taiyin Star and the Thousand Realm Star are supreme stars of the Great Eternal Realm, suspended high above, visible from any corner of the myriad heavens.
But to approach the Taiyin Star and the Thousand Realm Star, one must at least possess the cultivation of a Quasi Immortal Emperor.
And if one reaches the Immortal Emperor Realm, then one can closely observe these supreme stars, with only peak Immortal Emperors qualifying to step onto them, yet they too cannot delve deep within.
In her travels across the myriad heavens, the Guanghan Empress once visited the Taiyin Star, reaching the surface of this greatest celestial body.
Even someone as formidable as her could not penetrate its core, where great horrors lay.
Even peak Immortal Emperors would perish should they venture within.
For the Guanghan Empress, the Taiyin Star was the ideal place for enlightenment.
She once secluded herself in meditation there for over a thousand eons, eventually condensing the Taiyin Star before her and significantly enhancing her strength during that period.
This star, manifested from her own cultivation path, had reached what the Guanghan Empress considered perfection, unable to advance further, much like her own cultivation and strength.
The Guanghan Empress and all the Immortal Emperors of the myriad heavens shared a common belief: the Taiyin Star and the Thousand Realm Star represented the materialization of the fourth step, or rather that these two greatest celestial bodies were created by fourth-step powerhouses.
Therefore, although the Immortal Emperors of the myriad heavens have reached the end of the third step in their cultivation, they firmly believe in the existence of the fourth step.
Moreover, in the Great Eternal Realm, there are more than just the Taiyin Star and the Thousand Realm Star that relate to the fourth step of cultivation.
The traces of fourth-step powerhouses have always been the direction pursued by many Immortal Emperors of the myriad heavens, but despite the passage of countless ages, there have been few discoveries, yet each one validates the real existence of fourth-step powerhouses.
Suddenly, the Guanghan Empress recalled something, an event from an ancient time that may have been related to the disappearance of the fourth-step powerhouses.
However, the time was far too distant, and even though she could reverse the flow of time, disrupt yin and yang, and observe all timelines of past, present, and future, she could not see beyond that particular event.
The Guanghan Empress had once ascended the river of time towards its source, but she could not reach beyond that time node.
As far as she knew, not just her but no Immortal Emperor of the Taichu Realm or the myriad heavens had ever succeeded in reaching back through the river of time to uncover the truth.
“Sigh~”
With a soft sigh, the Guanghan Empress withdrew her gaze, shifting her thoughts to another matter closely related to the elusive fourth step that she yearned for day and night.
That was her future Dao companion, Han Li, who was still in the Yuankun Domain, yet to achieve immortality.
From what she had seen of the future, Han Li simply could not be killed, which was inconceivable for a peak Immortal Emperor, particularly since the Guanghan Empress was considered a powerhouse among them.
In the future, Han Li would stand invincible in the Immortal Emperor Realm, overshadowing all Immortal Emperors of the myriad heavens.
This implied that Han Li might very well break through to the fourth step of cultivation in the future and enter that unknown realm.
Only a fourth-step powerhouse could wield such tremendous power; otherwise, even if Han Li were to be invincible within the Immortal Emperor Realm, as long as he remained within the bounds of the third step, he could still be killed.
Thinking of her future Dao companion Han Li, the Guanghan Empress sighed once again, not out of frustration over Han Li’s many lovely wives and concubines, but rather over his potential.
“The Ninety-Nine Heavenly Tribulations, truly remarkable.”
The Guanghan Empress murmured to herself, her gaze fixing on Han Li in the Yuankun Domain, as she reversed time to replay the scene of his tribulation.
In the Taichu Realm, the highest tribulation in the Heaven Imperial Realm is the Ninety-Nine Heavenly Tribulations.
Surviving it signifies the potential to become an Immortal Emperor.
The Nine Layers of the Ninety-Nine Heavenly Tribulations each have a youthful Quasi Immortal Emperor as a guardian, and they are the most outstanding of the ten Quasi Immortal Emperors throughout the ancient history of the Taichu Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 724
chapters.content:
Chapter 724: Chapter 275: The Grand Assembly of Guanghan, the Great Eternal Realm, Crimson Heaven Court and Longhan Heavenly Court, the Lost Ancient History_3 Chapter 724: Chapter 275: The Grand Assembly of Guanghan, the Great Eternal Realm, Crimson Heaven Court and Longhan Heavenly Court, the Lost Ancient History_3 Like the Guanghan Empress, when such an Immortal Emperor ascended to the Heaven Imperial Realm, she passed the ninety-nine heavenly tribulations.
Among the strong in the Immortal Emperor Realm throughout ancient and modern times, very few have not passed ninety-nine heavenly tribulations.
The Guanghan Empress suddenly laughed, her smile blooming like a flower, making the bright moon pale in comparison.
She suddenly thought of when Han Li became a Quasi Immortal Emperor or even an Immortal Emperor, with Han Li’s strength he would definitely appear in the heavenly tribulation.
At that time, would anyone still be able to pass the ninety-nine heavenly tribulations?
The answer is: impossible!
After all, Han Li is very likely to become a fourth-step powerhouse in the future.
...
With such a supremely strong figure appearing in the tribulation of the Heaven Imperial Realm, no one would be able to pass it, even if another with the potential for the fourth step appeared, success would not be guaranteed.
She couldn’t help but feel pity for those peerless geniuses of the future, so very pitiable.
Scanning all the vistas of Chengsheng Mountain with her eyes, the Guanghan Empress saw Han Li communicating the Dao with his charming wives and concubines at the Time-Sky Tower, and couldn’t help but hold her forehead and sigh:
“My future Dao companion sure knows how to enjoy himself.
Oh well, let him have his fun for now.”
Now that Han Li had just straightened out the Yuankun Domain, the future could be peaceful for a long time, with no one in the Yuankun Domain posing a threat to him.
The highest cultivation level in the Yuankun Domain is currently only the pinnacle of Heaven Imperial Realm, while Han Li in the first Heaven of the Heaven Imperial Realm already has the combat ability of a Heavenly Immortal, and that is without even considering his Divine Sense.
Now that Han Li has reached the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, his combat ability has reached the seventh Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Han Li also has the Divine Sense of the eighth stage, making him invincible in the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Truth be told, she thought Han Li was really playing it close to the chest, keeping a few tricks up his sleeve even with his charming wives and concubines, only revealing the sixth stage of his Divine Sense when it was actually the eighth.
But she wasn’t fooled by this.
Plus, with her around, the former Emperor of the Heavenly Court scheming in the Yuankun Domain wouldn’t detect anything unusual about Han Li, adequately protecting him for a long time.
Given Han Li’s rate of growth, he should be able to cultivate to the Immortal King Realm, or perhaps the Quasi Immortal Emperor during this time?
The Guanghan Empress indeed only intended to let Han Li play for a while, and after some time when the grand event of Guanghan was convened, she would bring Han Li over.
However, before that, she would send her avatar to make contact with Han Li.
With her avatar’s cultivation level, appearance, temperament, figure, and so on, she would definitely become Han Li’s Dao companion.
Thinking of the grand event of Guanghan, a shadow flashed in the eyes of the Guanghan Empress; over the years, quite a few rumors had spread about someone wanting to stir up trouble at her grand event.
According to intelligence, the plausible troublemakers were the Crimson Emperor and the Northern Black Emperor.
These two Immortal Emperors were at odds with her, and she didn’t know what tricks they planned to play.
When the time came, she would let Han Li take the lead.
The current Heavenly Court had been established for just over two thousand epochs and three tribulations, known as the Crimson Heaven Court.
The Old Heavenly Court was known as the Longhan Heavenly Court, which lasted for nearly fifteen tribulations but had not passed the fifteenth great calamity, allowing the current Chiming Heavenly Emperor to take over.
The Crimson Heaven Court has a total of six Immortal Emperor realm powerhouses, with the Chiming Heavenly Emperor being the strongest, followed by the Eastern Green Emperor, the Northern Black Emperor, the Southern Crimson Emperor, the Western White Emperor, and the Emperor of the Netherworld.
The four Immortal Emperors preside over the four celestial realms among the Thirty-three Heavens, while the Emperor of the Netherworld presides over the Nether Heaven in the Thirty-three Heavens.
Naturally, the Crimson Emperor and the Northern Black Emperor were no match for the Guanghan Empress.
In fact, in the Heavenly Court, only the Chiming Heavenly Emperor and the Emperor of the Netherworld were the ones she truly considered a threat.
However, since the Crimson Emperor and the Northern Black Emperor both represent the Heavenly Court and plan to cause trouble at her Guanghan grand event, the Chiming Heavenly Emperor definitely knows about it.
He is simply turning a blind eye, and it might even be a sign from the Chiming Heavenly Emperor.
“Hmph~” Going through all her thoughts once more, the Guanghan Empress snorted coldly.
If they want to cause trouble at her Guanghan grand event, then they can’t blame her for being disrespectful to the Heavenly Court.
If they truly anger her, she would slay the Immortal Emperors of the Heavenly Court just the same; it wouldn’t be the first time she had killed an Immortal Emperor.
After contemplating, the Guanghan Empress withdrew her gaze from Chengsheng Mountain and placed it upon the Xuanshen Sword Mountain in the far east of the Yuankun Domain.
This was the sword sheath transformed from the Emperor Sword of Emperor Longhan from the former Heavenly Court.
The Guanghan Empress was aware of it, and so were the other Immortal Emperors of the Tai Chu Realm, more or less.
“`
But no one dared to provoke the former Emperor Longhan of Heaven, who was not one to be trifled with.
Even when many Immortal Emperors joined forces, they only allowed him to escape one calamity.
His strength is absolutely among the strongest in the Great Eternal Realm.
Just the sword sheath alone was not enough to trace back to Emperor Longhan of the previous dynasty, so the Crimson Heaven Court had been waiting for an opportunity while plotting to deliver a deadly blow to Emperor Longhan.
As for the stagnation of the Yuankun Domain, the numerous Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, True Immortals, and even Golden Immortals who perished through the one hundred and thirty-six eras were deemed insignificant by the Longhan Heavenly Court and were not worth mentioning.
Guanghan Empress’ beautiful eyes flickered with light as she considered whether she should personally take a trip to collaborate with Emperor Longhan.
Although she had assisted the Chiming Heavenly Emperor in overthrowing the Longhan Heavenly Court, after more than three tribulations, Guanghan Empress, along with the other emperors, had occupied many resources of the Thirty-three Heavens yet rarely heeded the Heavenly Court’s orders, much to the displeasure of the Chiming Heavenly Emperor.
Guanghan Empress was one of the main forces that overthrew the Longhan Heavenly Court, and she had a deep grudge against Emperor Longhan, but when it came to benefits, Emperor Longhan would not be overly concerned and might even take the initiative to offer her many advantages.
Collaborating with Emperor Longhan naturally had many benefits.
Opposing the Crimson Heaven Court was only one aspect; she also wanted to learn some secrets from Emperor Longhan.
Although she was one of the strongest Immortal Emperors of the Taichu Realm, she did not know as many secrets as Emperor Longhan.
After all, Emperor Longhan had sat on the Heavenly Emperor’s throne for nearly fifteen tribulations and knew too many secrets.
The secrets Guanghan Empress wanted to know the most were only two: one was the fourth step of the path of cultivation, and the other was somewhat relatedâ€”it was what exactly happened in ancient times.
She was from the Human Clan, the current Chiming Heavenly Emperor was from the Human Clan, and Emperor Longhan of the former dynasty was also from the Human Clan.
Many Immortal Emperors throughout the history of the Taichu Realm had originated from the Human Clan.
Although there were also Immortal Emperors from other races within the Taichu Realm, the Human Clan undoubtedly held a dominant position.
Not just in the Taichu Realm, but also throughout the entire Great Eternal Realm, the Human Clan held a position of dominance.
All the races combined could only contend with the Human Clan, but it was impossible for them to unite.
According to truths that Guanghan Empress had incidentally discovered, in ancient times there was a Heavenly Court as well, but the Human Clan did not hold a dominant position.
The naming conventions of the Heavenly Courts from the ancient times differed from those of later ages, as deduced by Guanghan Empress.
She knew only the names of two Heavenly Courts from ancient times.
Sacred Heavenly Court!
Wudao Heavenly Court!
It seemed that the prefix for the Heavenly Courts of ancient times was always some kind of “Dao,” and Guanghan Empress believed that these “Sacred Dao” and “Wudao” were races that still existed in the present Great Eternal Realm, but these races had no knowledge of their corresponding ancient history.
Based on this speculation, the Heavenly Court from the times that followed should actually be calledâ€”the Mortal Heavenly Court!
It was just unknown why, the Mortal Heavenly Court either did not exist, or had vanished in the long river of history, beyond all searching.
“Hu~”
Guanghan Empress let out a long breath, her beautiful eyes bright, yet she decided not to ponder these matters anymore.
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li was in the Time-Sky Tower exchanging knowledge of the profound laws with his beloved wives and concubines, imparting them with vast and profound knowledge of the laws.
As the strongest in the Yuankun Domain and their husband, Han Li felt it was his duty to help them grow stronger as quickly as possible.
When the teaching of the laws became too taxing, Han Li would also play some stress-relieving games with them.
For example: stacking Arhats.
Layered gates and doors, ten become one!

chapters.title: Chapter 725
chapters.content:
Chapter 725: Chapter 276: The Five Teams Return, Han Li’s Drastic Reforms, The First Division of the Family, Opening the Treasure Chest_1 Chapter 725: Chapter 276: The Five Teams Return, Han Li’s Drastic Reforms, The First Division of the Family, Opening the Treasure Chest_1 When Han Li emerged from the Time-Sky Tower, the five teams he had dispatched to various parts of the Yuankun Domain to take over the five strongest forces had successively returned.
At the Yundao Hall on Yundao Peak, Han Li met with these elite descendants.
His calves were trembling slightly, perhaps from having exerted himself too much, so this time he chose to sit on a throne forged from Immortal Gold.
Previously, he would stand, looking down at the people in the hall.
When Han Li appeared in Yundao Hall, what had been a somewhat noisy hall instantly fell silent, all eyes turning to his towering figure.
Han Li’s gaze fell upon those gathered in the hall: Han Yonghao, Han Yongmu, Han Yongqian, Han Yongkun, Han Yongding, Han Yongming, Han Yongyuan…
All of them were core descendants whom he’d vigorously cultivated.
...
Most of these descendants possessed royal or emperor bodies, with cultivation ranging from the True Martial Realm to the Tongxuan Realm.
They had achieved these realms within thirty to fifty years, thanks not only to their extraordinary talents, but most importantly, to Han Li’s assistance.
Of course, Han Mansion had more descendants with royal or emperor bodies than these; the ones in the hall were just a small portion.
Most of the descendants with special constitutions had not practiced long enough to even reach the rank of Emperor Wu in the True Martial Realm.
“Greetings, Father~”
After Han Li was seated, dozens of excited, exuberant voices rang out in unison, reverberating through the great hall.
“You may dispense with the formalities.”
With a casual wave of his hand, Han Li allowed all the bowing descendants to rise to their feet involuntarily.
“Yongzhen, Yongjiang, Yongqian, Yongmu, Yongyuan, report to me the situation,” Han Li said, his gaze sweeping over the many descendants in the hall, casually selecting five of them.
“Yes!”
Han Yongzhen, Han Yongjiang, Han Yongqian, and the others immediately responded with excitement.
Each came from one of the five teams, but as each team had two or three siblings in the Tongxuan Realm, being named by their father to give reports was indeed a great honor.
“Father, we went to White Emperor City….”
“Father, we went to the Western Sky Palace….”
“Father, we went to the Longevity Qin Family….”
Although Han Li had already familiarized himself with the details, he patiently waited for Han Yongzhen, Han Yongjiang, Han Yongqian, Han Yongmu, and Han Yongyuan to finish recounting various situations.
This also granted them an opportunity to make an impression.
To take over the five strongest forces, each of the five teams had taken many Heavenly Immortal weapons and Great Emperor weapons with them, yet there were still risks involved.
Han Li didn’t want to see any problems befall his dozens of carefully cultivated exceptional descendants.
