That would be a heavy loss, so he had sent five true Immortal weapons from the Wuxian Palace and others to secretly follow them.
On one hand, this was to protect the descendants, and on the other, it was surveillance.
It was a test from Han Li to see these descendants’ adaptability and whether they would hide any reckless actions from him, such as embezzling treasures.
Minor issues could be overlooked by Han Li, as no one is flawless, but if they committed grave errors, there would be no leniency from him.
Although there may not be punishment this time, he would not focus on cultivating them or entrust them with important tasks in the future.
In another aspect, it was also a test for the five true Immortal weapons.
The true Immortal weapons that were sent out this time were precisely those that had recently been subjugated from the five mighty forces.
If the Artifact Spirits of these true Immortal weapons were so inclined, they might persuade some cultivators from the five strongest forces to surrender, easing Chengsheng Mountain’s absorption of these forces.
To Han Li’s satisfaction, both the five true Immortal weapons and all descendants had not made any mistakes.
They had sincerely completed the tasks he’d arranged.
As for those minor flaws, Han Li simply turned a blind eye.
“This time you have all done very well, living up to my expectations.
With you to share my concerns in the future, our Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain will….”
Han Li spoke at length, voicing nothing but praise.
In the end, he rewarded Han Yongqian, Han Yongzhen, Han Yongyuan, and the dozens of other descendants who had been sent out on the mission quite generously.
“Thank you for the rewards, Father.
We will devote all our efforts to sharing your burdens…”
Han Yongqian, Han Yongzhen, Han Yongmu, Han Yonghao, and the other descendants responded with emotion, their gaze towards Han Li filled with adoration.
Their father was now a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm, currently the first War Immortal of the Yuankun Domain, with combat ability unrivaled throughout the Yuankun Domain, invincible throughout the universe.
As Han Li’s children, they shared in his glory.
Moreover, Han Li was generous with his rewards.
This time, he had bestowed a host of rewards upon them, enough to significantly advance their cultivation or even break through to the next Big Realm.
Han Li then chatted with the many exceptional descendants, inquiring about each one’s cultivation progress, offering guidance, and eventually delegating individual tasks.
When all the descendants had dispersed from the great hall, only Han Li remained in Yundao Hall.
He disappeared from the hall as well, arriving at the peak of Chengdao Peak.
He stood with his hands clasped behind his back, gazing beyond Qianyuan Divine Province with a confident smile on his face.
Overall, Han Li was quite satisfied with the operation.
Although there had been some resistance from cultivators within the five strongest forces, those who dared to rebel were executed under the merciless repression of the Immortal and Emperor weapons.
The direct lineages and powers of the White Emperor City, Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, Longevity Qin Family, and Longevity Jiang Family had all been completely eradicated, as per Han Li’s orders.
He chose to directly eliminate the roots.
In the future, Han Mansion’s descendants would be dispersed throughout the Yuankun Domain; it would be impossible to oversee all branches of the Han family.
If those powerful enemies harboring enmity toward Han Li sought revenge, he did not want to see his descendants dying in droves : a situation Han Li wished to avoid.
Therefore, he chose to nip the risks in the bud.
After this display of killing the chicken to scare the monkeys, other cultivators, even if reluctant or displeased at heart, dared not openly defy the rule of Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.
They would likely only grumble in their hearts and engage in minor subterfuge in private.

chapters.title: Chapter 726
chapters.content:
Chapter 726: Chapter 276: Five Teams Return, Han Li’s Drastic Reforms, The First Family Split, Opening the Treasure Chest_2 Chapter 726: Chapter 276: Five Teams Return, Han Li’s Drastic Reforms, The First Family Split, Opening the Treasure Chest_2 Han Li scoffed at such trivial matters.
He didn’t need to personally handle cultivators who engaged in petty schemes; those powerhouses who had joined him and wanted to prove their worth would take the initiative to strike out, resolving Han Li’s worries and troubles.
“The top forces really are wealthy.”
Thinking of the cultivation resources and various treasures he had brought back from the five strongest powers, Han Li couldn’t help but sigh with emotion.
Even though Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion was the First Power in the Yuankun Domain and he was the strongest, aside from Immortal and Emperor Level weapons, the Chengsheng Mountain Han Mansion’s foundation in other aspects was far from comparable to that of the major supreme forces.
These supreme forces had not only divided the legacy left by the glorious powers before the ancient catastrophe but had also developed for tens of thousands of years, indeed having an incredibly strong foundation.
But now, all of these were Han Li’s.
Most filled the treasure vaults of Chengsheng Mountain Han Mansion, and the most important resources of the Immortal’s path were thrown into the Tiansheng Realm.
...
After the transformation with the Golden Immortal weapons and many True Immortal weapons, along with the foundations of Chengsheng Mountain, White Emperor City, Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, and the other six major forces, Tiansheng Realm had become the most deserving number one blessed land in the Yuankun Domain.
With the massive influx of Immortal Qi, Immortal Stones, Immortal Elixirs, Immortal Scriptures, and other resources of the Immortal’s path, Han Li planned to reformulate the family’s next-generation training plan, improve clan welfare, and incidentally carry out the previously planned family branch separation.
Beyond Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li also had to outline the entire power structure and benefit distribution of the Yuankun Domain.
Since he was to rule the Yuankun Domain, he couldn’t let it continue to develop in the disordered fashion it had before.
Although the five most powerful forcesâ€”White Emperor City, Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, Longevity Qin Family, and Longevity Jiang Familyâ€”were received by Han Li, he didn’t bring all of their resources back to Chengsheng Mountain, just the majority.
He left a portion for the operation of the five forces.
The Heavenly Immortal weapons of the five forces were also subdued by Han Li but remained stationed with the forces.
Even though Han Li took away most of the foundation of the five forces, they could still operate well because a portion of their cultivators diedâ€”from those in power to ordinary cultivators.
Some of the powerhouses and cultivators with exceptional talents were brought back to Chengsheng Mountain for training.
In the end, the direct forces of the five forces now accounted for less than half of their original number.
As for these five forces, Han Li would not change their names for the time being.
He would take some time until he had full control, at which point he could fully integrate the five forces into Chengsheng Mountain.
Currently, they were acting as subsidiary forces.
The territory of the five forces was also drastically reduced.
The subtracted territories were all incorporated directly under Chengsheng Mountain.
With the Cross Borders Teleporting Formation, management was relatively easy, and Chengsheng Mountain had enough deterrent power.
Han Li temporarily left Huangyue Imperial Empire and Yuanchu Mountain untouched, not interfering with the interests of the two Empresses, nor offering them benefits, waiting instead until after their marriages to address the matter.
The Solar Empire and Tianji Pavilion both acknowledged the sovereign position of Chengsheng Mountain, regularly offered substantial benefits, and demarcated a portion of their territory for Chengsheng Mountain.
As for the other Heavenly Governing Forces and Quasi Emperor Rank powers, Han Li also temporarily left them be.
These were not urgent, as he had plenty of time to slowly make adjustments.
……
Days went by and the rules Han Li had re-established rapidly began to operate.
From Chengsheng Mountain Han Mansion to the entire Yuankun Domain, no one dared to openly defy them.
When the family branches separated, although many descendants of Han Mansion were dissatisfied and didn’t want to move out from Chengsheng Mountain, they still moved to the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of the Yuankun Domain to establish branches of the Han Mansion.
Despite the relocation of tens of thousands of descendants and their families, maids, and guards from Chengsheng Mountain, the population of the mountain did not decrease but instead increased.
The population increase partly came from the powerhouses and geniuses drawn from the five major forces and partly from the other Divine Provinces and forces of the Yuankun Domain, which they joined voluntarily.
As the cultivators from the five forces joined, they soon discovered that the cultivation environment of Chengsheng Mountain was many times better than that of their original forces, and the resources were more abundant.
This news quickly spread throughout the entire Yuankun Domain, causing a huge sensation.
The major forces of the Yuankun Domain and countless powerhouses finally understood just how strong and extraordinary Han Li’s descendants were.
The dozens of Han Mansion descendants had caused an uproar in the Yuankun Domain when the five forces were initially received.
Han Li didn’t mind the leaking of Chengsheng Mountain’s cultivation environment and welfare details.
It was his intention to let newly joined cultivators spread the news.
Now that Chengsheng Mountain was the ruler and the Lord of the Yuankun Domain, no one could threaten the governing status of Chengsheng Mountain.
Times had changed, so Han Li no longer needed to be as cautious as before, fearing that leaking information about possessing precious treasures would attract the covetous glances of powerhouses.
Many powerhouses and outstanding talents from other forces within the Yuankun Domain eagerly joined Chengsheng Mountain Han Mansion precisely for this reason.
Now, Chengsheng Mountain Han Mansion was the strongest force in the Yuankun Domain and the largest and best platform for development.
By joining Chengsheng Mountain Han Mansion, those cultivators could have better prospects.
During this period, Han Li devoted himself to handling family affairs as well as his personal matters.
As Han Li had many beloved wives and concubines, he no longer restricted childbirth, and every day he would have dozens of new biological children.
Therefore, Han Li also changed his approach.
He would only visit when significant wives and concubines were giving birth; otherwise, he simply couldn’t manage to attend to them all.
Beyond these, Han Li also took in some more wives and concubines recently, including two female saints and one Quasi Empress, all of whom had come to his side, and he married them as his dao companions.

chapters.title: Chapter 727
chapters.content:
Chapter 727: Chapter 276: Five Teams Return, Han Li’s Drastic Reforms, The First Family Split, Opening the Treasure Chest_3 Chapter 727: Chapter 276: Five Teams Return, Han Li’s Drastic Reforms, The First Family Split, Opening the Treasure Chest_3 Among the newly married wives and concubines was a woman named Shen Youqing, who had only Second Grade aptitude.
She had been eligible to become Han Li’s Dao companion, but Han Li had recently raised the standards so only those with First Grade aptitude or a special physique could become his wife; Shen Youqing just missed the timing, arriving a little too late.
However, after learning about Shen Youqing’s circumstances, Han Li changed his mind, mainly because he discovered a minor causal entanglement between them.
Upon divining further, he saw images of Shen Youqing and her childhood sweetheart Yan Nanxiao, with Yan Nanxiao obtaining a core shard of the Jade Talisman of Creation and other scenes where Yan Nanxiao was killed by the White Emperor who then stole the Immortal Treasure.
Influenced by this factor, Han Li generously changed his mind and ultimately took Shen Youqing as his wife.
This thrilled the Shen family, who were initially filled with regret.
Although the process of sending off their daughter was fraught with ups and downs, they ultimately achieved their goal.
...
During this time, Han Li was exceptionally busy, dividing each day into a hundred, transforming into a hardworking master cultivator, sowing seeds upon the unexploited fertile wastelands.
Fortunately, he was powerful, with a body comparable to a Heavenly Immortal.
Even when repeating the days a hundred times, he remained strong and robust, not only maintaining his strength but becoming even stronger.
One day, Han Li was inside the Time-Sky Tower, exchanging Daoist teachings with his beautiful wives and concubines, imparting profound techniques to them, and playing some stress-relief games, such as “Line Up and Lie Down.”
Meanwhile, Han Li was also distracted by another task: opening treasure boxes.
Today was the last day of the month, and not opening the treasure boxes would mean missing the opportunity.
Han Li had thought about opening the treasure boxes earlier but wanted to wait for a good moment.
Then he became too busy and temporarily forgot about it.
Now, he took the chance to open this month’s treasure boxes while playing games.
Han Li lay back in his chair, handsomely sprawled out, glanced at Zi Miao Zhen who was enjoying a buffet, and then activated the treasure box functionâ€”the splendid treasure box interface appeared before him.
Although Zi Miao Zhen was chatting with him, Han Li did not want to dawdle; he multitasked and began opening the treasure boxes.
“Ding~ Master, you still have one free opportunity to open a treasure box this month.
Would you like to use it?”
“Use it,” Han Li replied without hesitation.
Watching the virtual panel as the treasure box burst forth with golden light, Han Li’s expression was as serene as an ancient well, yet he secretly harbored an eager anticipation.
Would his first treasure box of the month hit the jackpot?
“Ding~ Treasure box opening was successful, congratulations Master on obtaining Heaven Immortal Rank Treasure ‘Lower Grade Immortal Vein’ *2!”
Han Li’s pupils contracted slightly, and a smile spread across his face.
Since the System’s last upgrade, the odds of obtaining Immortal Treasures from treasure boxes had improved significantly.
For example, the chance of obtaining a Heaven Immortal Rank Treasure on the first try was 20%, and 30% on the second, so on and so forth.
The probability of True Immortal Rank Treasures was much lower, only 5% on the first try and 10% on the second, with Golden Immortal Rank even lower.
Despite only obtaining a Heaven Immortal Rank Treasure, Han Li was very pleased because what he got were Immortal Veins, which were superior to Dragon Veins and contained a vast amount of Immortal Stones.
Although the drop rate for Heaven Immortal Rank Treasures was 20%, there were many types of such treasuresâ€”the Heaven Immortal Elixir, Heaven Immortal Weapons, Heaven Immortal Rank Immortal Pills, Cultivation Techniques, Martial Skills, Immortal Veins, among others.
Immortal Veins were more rare among these treasures, translating to an even lower drop rate comparatively.
Moreover, Han Li was in dire need of Immortal Veins to sustain the vast Chengsheng Mountain.
Relying only on those Immortal resources would inevitably lead to depletion, but with Immortal Veins to share the burden, the resources could last more than ten times longer.
Not to mention that acquiring two Lower Grade Immortal Veins was, in Han Li’s eyes, no less valuable than a True Immortal Weapon.
Han Li casually clicked to view the details of the Lower Grade Immortal Vein.
‘Lower Grade Immortal Vein’: Heaven Immortal Rank Treasure, contains a billion Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
When transplanted into a Daoist site, it can increase the Spiritual Energy inside by fivefold.
With just one look, Han Li was moved.
One billion Immortal Stones!
Lower Grade Immortal Veins and Lower Grade Immortal Stones both correspond to the Heavenly Immortal Realm; the Immortal Qi contained within a single Immortal Stone can sustain a Heavenly Immortal’s cultivation for one day.
Ten billion Immortal Stones would be enough to supply two hundred Heavenly Immortals with cultivation resources for over ten thousand years, which shows just how wealthy a Lower Grade Immortal Vein can be.
In the market, a Lower Grade Immortal Stone is equal to one hundred strands of Immortal Qi, which highlights the high value of Immortal Stones.
So, when Han Li seized thirty thousand Lower Grade Immortal Stones from the Heavenly Cult, the Butian Sect Master was furious, scouring everywhere for Han Li’s whereabouts in order to take them back.
Now, Han Li has two Lower Grade Immortal Veins, that is, two billion Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
If mined slowly, the veins will automatically nurture new Immortal Stones, and the final count might well be thirty billion.
This is an enormous fortune.
It is even several hundred times more than what he took from the five major powers.
Currently, the Yuankun Domain has no Immortal Veins left, as they were destroyed in the ancient catastrophe, and the Immortal Stones and Immortal Qi the major powers possess are inheritances from ancient forces.
Following the established trajectory, when a Heavenly Immortal emerges in this era, it would take another thirty million years to nurture a Lower Grade Immortal Vein.
Time is not a constant; the higher the cultivation level of the Heavenly Immortal nurturing the vein, the more it reduces the time needed.
If a True Immortal were to do it, it would only take a few hundred thousand years.
For Immortals to nurture Immortal Veins is a tremendous expenditure; it also requires their whole-hearted devotion.
Neither Heavenly Immortals nor True Immortals would nurture too many veins, generally between one to three.
True Immortal Realm powerhouses basically don’t nurture Lower Grade Immortal Veins; this task is left to Heavenly Immortals.
They nurture Second Grade Immortal Veins, increasing the depth of their power.
Successful nurturing can also cause their stagnant cultivation to enter a rapid advancement phase, after all, having cultivation resources.
In the Yuankun Domain, there is only one Heavenly Immortal, which is Feng Mian.
Han Li had no intention of letting Feng Mian do such a thing.
Spending millions of years to nurture an Immortal Vein would not be worth it; it is better to exchange cultivation insights with him.
After all, he could obtain Immortal Veins from the treasure box function, so it’s better to leave Feng Mian’s time for cultivation, to become a True Immortal sooner, refine the Fire Phoenix Fish, and in the future, ascend to the Golden Immortal Realm.
He was delighted to obtain good items on his first free attempt.
Therefore, Han Li, undeterred, expended one year of cultivation to open the second treasure box, and this time he got a bottle of Heavenly Immortal Pills that could enhance cultivation.
He spent five years of cultivation to open the third treasure box, and this time he got a True Immortal weapon called the Yuandao Spear.
He spent ten years of cultivation to open the fourth treasure box, and this time he got a set of True Immortal Rank Cultivation Technique named “Great Universe Inheriting Dao Scripture.”
He spent fifty years of cultivation to open the fifth treasure box, and this time he got a set of True Immortal Rank Martial Skill called “Four Styles of the Leveling Heaven.”
Subsequently, Han Li spent six hundred years of cultivation to open the sixth and seventh treasure boxes, only to receive two Imperial Rank Treasures.
Han Li was somewhat dissatisfied and wanted to open the eighth treasure box, but this required five thousand years of cultivation, and he was worried that his luck might run out, resulting in a loss greater than the gain.
Considering he had only over twenty thousand years of cultivation left, Han Li hesitated for a while but ultimately decided not to open the eighth treasure box.
The risk was too great.
After all, tomorrow marks the beginning of the next month.
At that time, the chances and rates for treasure box openings will reset, so there’s no hurry to try again later.
After consoling himself, Han Li came to terms with it.
He had already obtained quite a few good items today: a True Immortal weapon, True Immortal Scripture, and a True Immortal Rank Martial Skill, each one of a kind, not to mention the two Lower Grade Immortal Veins, each worth as much as a True Immortal Rank Treasure.
With a thought, he closed the treasure box interface and immersed himself wholeheartedly into playing the game.
This time, the game was about precipitous mountain ranges, convoluted paths, and each following their own course.

chapters.title: Chapter 728
chapters.content:
Chapter 728: Chapter 277: Combat Ability Surge, Comparable to a True Immortal!
Evolve, Miniature Immortal Realm!
Han Yongji and Emperor Changfeng_1 Chapter 728: Chapter 277: Combat Ability Surge, Comparable to a True Immortal!
Evolve, Miniature Immortal Realm!
Han Yongji and Emperor Changfeng_1 At dawn,
Han Li did a good deed, bringing sunlight to the places it couldn’t reach.
Soon after, Yuan Youwei took over, continuing with the buffet breakfast.
Han Li caressed her soft and shiny hair, admiring the battlefield filled with birdsong and fragrant flowers.
...
This was the ninth level of the Time-Sky Tower, which Han Li had set up with great mana to be his private battleground.
After an exciting session, Han Li frowned slightly and immediately gave Yuan Youwei some strict guidance.
She listened obediently, not showing any sign of dissatisfaction, and her beautiful face even showed a look of contentment.
She was very satisfied with her life.
Recently, her status had been officially elevated from concubine to wife, enabling her to rightfully claim she was Han Li’s Dao companion.
Moreover, she recently made a breakthrough to the Quasi Emperor Realm, which was truly a double blessing.
Although her cultivation level was lower than that of Zi Miaozhen, Yuan Youwei held no grudge against her.
It was her own fault for making big mistakes in the past, which resulted in a long period of her having little status, let alone resources for cultivation, causing her progress to stagnate.
But once she came to her senses, she became obedient and docile, and her husband’s affection for her grew, along with her status.
With the rise in status, she was able to continue cultivating and gain corresponding resources.
Everything was moving in a positive direction.
After being promoted to wife, Yuan Youwei obtained more and more precious cultivation resources and benefits, enabling her to make a breakthrough to the first level of the Quasi Emperor Realm.
With nearly ten children and another on the way, her children were all developing well and were highly regarded by her husband, so she worked hard to please Han Li, not wanting to return to her former state.
Now, her husband Han Li had broken through to the Heaven Imperial Realm, becoming a War Immortal, and was the strongest in the Yuankun Domain, the master of the supreme power, Chengsheng Mountain.
Surrounded by glory, Yuan Youwei shared in the honor.
Yuan Youwei was well aware that even as a Quasi Empress, she didn’t count for much among her husband’s wives.
Not to mention that Han Li already had several Dao companions in the Quasi Emperor Realm, a Heaven Imperial Realm Empress, and a Heavenly Immortal for a fiancÃ©e.
Quasi Empresses from other parts of the Yuankun Domain, Heaven Imperial Realm Empresses, and even the Empress Fengyue and Empress Yuanchu would gradually become her sisters in the future.
This gave Yuan Youwei a sense of fantasy.
In the past, she was a subordinate of Empress Yuanchu, valued but not holding a very high position as she was merely a Holy Abyssal Realm Saintess.
But now, Empress Yuanchu would become her sister, theoretically equal in status.
She had always chased after Empress Yuanchu, hoping to one day stand shoulder to shoulder with her, and now, that ambition was indirectly achieved.
Lost in her wild thoughts, Yuan Youwei began to sing out loud, her clear and beautiful music echoing.
She couldn’t help but let out her voice, singing the most wonderful melodies of this world.
When everything was over, Han Li also began his daily self-reflection.
Even with Yuan Youwei standing before him, barely clothed, he had no interest.
The main reason was that he had played for too long.
A true feeling of making days seem like years!
After his self-reflection, Han Li glanced at the disorganized beauty scattered all over the place, smiled proudly, and disappeared from the Time-Sky Tower.
Han Li arrived at the summit of Chengdao Peak and sat cross-legged, basking in the gentle morning light, and took in the first breath of dawn’s purple aura.
After finishing these rituals, Han Li didn’t get up, ready to attend to serious matters.
It’s often said gaming harms the body, a feeling Han Li could relate to.
He frequently played games, especially multiplayer shooters, honing his skills as a sharpshooter with every shot and headshots aplenty.
His gaming sessions often lasted day and night, day after day, making days seem like years.
If it were not for his strong body, invincible flesh akin to a Heavenly Immortal, he wouldn’t have been able to endure the continuous battles.
The saying goes, “Two fists are no match for four hands.” He only had two fists, but his enemies were always more than four-handed.
He played so intensely that he would forget important matters.
That’s why Han Li left the serious stuff for this morning, but thankfully, the Time-Sky Tower did not cause any delay.
While playing games yesterday with his beloved wives Zi Miaozhen, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Lu Tianxiang, he had opened last month’s treasure box and, indeed, acquired many wonderful items.
Han Li first claimed the True Immortal Rank Cultivation Technique, the Da Yu Cheng Dao Scripture.
An Immortal Golden Jade Book appeared in Han Li’s hand, and simultaneously, countless golden characters filled his mind.
There were only a few thousand, but each one contained endless mysteries, as if they were the incarnations of the Great Dao, vast like entire worlds.
Casually putting away the Immortal Golden Jade Book, Han Li savored the True Immortal Rank Cultivation Technique.
After a while, he opened his eyes, a sharp gleam flashing within.
The Da Yu Cheng Dao Scripture was of great use to him.
As a True Immortal Rank Cultivation Technique, it could be integrated into his Thousand Path Scripture, enhancing its inclusiveness and power.
In particular, the Dao encompassed by the Da Yu Cheng Dao Scripture perfectly supplemented the missing parts of his Thousand Path Scripture, which was why Han Li was so pleased.
The Thousand Path Scripture, previously known as the Chaos Decision, had recently been renamed by Han Li.
Even his physique had been transformed from Chaos Body to Thousand Path Immortal Body.
His previous titles were only provisional, and he would continue to rename them if he thought of something better and more suitable in the future.
Then, Han Li claimed the True Immortal Rank Martial Skill, the Ping Tian Four Forms.
Over ten thousand golden characters emerged in his mind, then exploded.
Each character generated an image, filled with countless cultivation experiences and combat scenes.
It took Han Li a full five breaths to absorb and digest the Ping Tian Four Forms, completely mastering this True Immortal Rank Martial Skill and causing a surge in his combat ability.

chapters.title: Chapter 729
chapters.content:
Chapter 729: Chapter 277: Combat Ability Surge, Comparable to a True Immortal!
Evolve, Miniature Immortal Realm!
Han Yongji and Emperor Changfeng_2 Chapter 729: Chapter 277: Combat Ability Surge, Comparable to a True Immortal!
Evolve, Miniature Immortal Realm!
Han Yongji and Emperor Changfeng_2 During the first and second steps of cultivation, cultivation techniques and martial skills each had four stages: lower, middle, upper, and extreme.
However, once a practitioner reached the third step of cultivation, things became less complex.
Now, cultivation techniques and martial skills were uniformly classified into ranks: Heaven Immortal Rank, True Immortal Rank, Golden Immortal Rank, Immortal Monarch level, Immortal King Rank, Quasi Immortal Emperor Rank, and Immortal Emperor Rank.
...
Han Li’s highest martial skills were previously only at the Heaven Immortal Rank, such as the Seven Destructions Undying Body, the Taiyin Extinction Finger, the Nine Heavens Steps, and so on.
The Flat Sky Quadruple was the first True Immortal Rank martial skill he mastered.
That’s not to say Han Li didn’t possess any True Immortal Rank martial skills.
In fact, he had many, which he acquired from the five major powers: White Emperor City, Western Sky Palace, Heavenly Cult, Longevity Jiang Family, and Longevity Qin Family.
The Solar Empire and Tianji Pavilion also each contributed one True Immortal Rank cultivation technique or martial skill.
However, to fully master a True Immortal Rank martial skill to completion required ten thousand years of cultivation.
Han Li did not have many years of cultivation saved up at the moment, so he set them aside for the time being.
The martial skill, Flat Sky Quadruple, was extremely powerful, encompassing fist, palm, leg, and finger techniques, which delighted Han Li greatly.
It’s worth mentioning that after his breakthrough into the Heaven Imperial Realm, his ultimate martial path underwent a new transformation, not only could it enhance the power of martial skills, but it also could raise the rank of cultivation techniques.
When enhanced by his ultimate martial path, Immortal cultivation techniques and martial skills could be raised by one rank.
This kind of enhancement was semi-permanent.
For example, the True Immortal Rank martial skill, Flat Sky Quadruple, that Han Li had just obtained could unleash the power of a Golden Immortal Rank martial skill with the enhancement from his ultimate martial path.
Since Han Li had mastered the Flat Sky Quadruple to perfection, when used, it was not inferior to some beginner level Immortal Monarch rank martial skills and was only slightly weaker than those at the minor achievement stage of Immortal Monarch rank.
With the enhancement of his ultimate martial path, Han Li’s Thousand Path Scripture could rival many Golden Immortal Rank cultivation techniques, which was one of the foundations that supported Han Li in his battle against Heaven Immortals.
After mastering the Flat Sky Quadruple to perfection, Han Li’s combat ability skyrocketed.
According to the data on his personal panel, his combat ability had reached the peak of the nine heavens of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Moreover, it wasn’t just an ordinary peak of the Heavenly Immortal Realmâ€”it was at least two minor stages higher.
In such a condition, if Han Li activated his Divine Sense and enhanced his combat ability by seven minor realms, he could already be comparable to a True Immortal powerhouse.
Comparable to one that had not long achieved their breakthrough into the True Immortal.
In any case, Han Li could barely be considered to have True Immortal Realm combat ability now.
With a wave of his hand, he could obliterate peak Heavenly Immortal realm powerhouses, his dominance unparalleled.
After experiencing the explosive increase in combat ability, Han Li was very satisfied.
He then took out a bottle of Heaven Immortal Rank pills, two Lower Grade Immortal Veins, and two Imperial Rank Treasures.
The pills were called Dao Enhancing Pills, which covered ranks from Heavenly Immortal Realm to Immortal King Realm.
Different grades of Dao Enhancing Pills could promote the cultivation of Immortals in different realms, manifesting in helping the Immortals to strengthen their comprehension of their own Dao.
A bottle of Dao Enhancing Pills contained only ten pills and was quite expensive.
A single Dao Enhancing Pill could be sold for a sky-high price of ten thousand Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
The two Imperial Rank Treasures were Creation Stones.
After some consideration, Han Li used them on a Supreme Grade Divine Weapon and a Lower Grade Emperor Level weapon, assisting them to evolve into Supreme Grade Emperor Level weapons.
Having done all this, Han Li looked at the two Immortal Veins in his hands, pondering where to place them.
One Immortal Vein could enhance the spiritual energy concentration around Chengsheng Mountain by five times, not by consuming the energy of the Immortal Vein, but as a byproduct of the Immortal Vein absorbing higher level energy from the void.
Han Li was uncertain whether placing the Immortal Veins in the Tiansheng Realm would increase the spiritual energy concentration around Chengsheng Mountain, considering the changes in Tiansheng Realm; a Lower Grade Immortal Vein might not affect the outside Chengsheng Mountain.
The spiritual energy concentration around Chengsheng Mountain was already far higher than when the Han Mansion had just moved there.
At that time, although Han Li had set up many Spirit Gathering Arrays, limited by the materials available and his formation knowledge, he didn’t set up very high-grade Spirit Gathering Arrays.
As his strength and formation knowledge grew, he continued to improve the arrays and created many more efficient Spirit Gathering Formations.
Nowadays, Chengsheng Mountain was outfitted with an Immortal Grade Spirit Gathering Array, which was enough on its own.
Its area of influence reached eighteen Divine Provinces, and it continuously drew in vast amounts of spiritual energy into Chengsheng Mountain, making the concentration terrifyingly highâ€”the highest in the Yuankun Domain without a doubt.
Even the Xuan Domain and Qianyuan Divine Province benefited greatly; the closer one was to Chengsheng Mountain, the higher the concentration of spiritual energy.
The Immortal Grade Spirit Gathering Array could also open channels for Immortal Qi, incessantly producing Immortal Qi.
Although it wasn’t much, the constant trickle was advantageous.
Given the previous foundation of Chengsheng Mountain, it was only sufficient to set up one Immortal Grade Spirit Gathering Array.
Now that the foundation of Chengsheng Mountain had increased by many times, Han Li was planning to set up two more Immortal Grade Spirit Gathering Arrays, one on Chengdao Peak and the other within the Tiansheng Realm.
This was precisely why Han Li was uncertain whether a Lower Grade Immortal Vein could still enhance the spiritual energy concentration fivefold considering the already high concentration around Chengsheng Mountain.
After some thought, Han Li consulted the System, and indeed, it provided an answer.
A Lower Grade Immortal Vein could still increase the spiritual energy concentration around Chengsheng Mountain, but it would not be fivefoldâ€”only about a thirty percent increase was possible.
With the answer in hand, Han Li no longer hesitated and directly threw the two Lower Grade Immortal Veins into the Tiansheng Realm, merging them with the center of the realm.
Chengsheng Mountain was not easy to move, but the Tiansheng Realm could be.
In an instant, the spiritual energy concentration within the Tiansheng Realm soared, multiplying many times over.
Influenced by the two Lower Grade Immortal Veins, endless higher level spiritual energy poured from the void, causing the Tiansheng Realm to begin a rapid and intense expansion.
The expansion of the Tiansheng Realm continued for ten days.
Once the two Lower Grade Immortal Veins were fully integrated into the Tiansheng Realm, it had tripled in size compared to before, with an area almost half the size of the Qianyuan Divine Province.

chapters.title: Chapter 730
chapters.content:
Chapter 730: Chapter 277: Combat Ability Surge, Comparable to a True Immortal!
Evolve, Miniature Immortal Realm!
Han Yongji and Emperor Changfeng_3 Chapter 730: Chapter 277: Combat Ability Surge, Comparable to a True Immortal!
Evolve, Miniature Immortal Realm!
Han Yongji and Emperor Changfeng_3 After evolving, the Tiansheng Realm underwent many changes, such as the simultaneous existence of both Immortal Qi and higher level spiritual energy, although the area covered by Immortal Qi was very small, limited to a range of ten thousand miles at the center of the Tiansheng Realm.
Han Li had also set up a barrier to prevent the overflow of Immortal Qi, making the central world akin to a Miniature Immortal Realm, albeit with a very low concentration of Immortal Qi.
Nevertheless, Han Li was very satisfied, for from then on, there would be no lack of Immortal Qi.
...
The Tiansheng Realm even surpassed those True Immortal level forces’ blessed lands from the Ancient Era.
Two lower grade Immortal Veins served as channels producing Immortal Qi.
Han Li possessed a Golden Immortal weapon, several True Immortal weapons, and dozens of Heavenly Immortal weapons, all of which were utilized to help this Miniature Immortal Realm increase its concentration of Immortal Qi.
Given time, without expanding the Miniature Immortal Realm, the concentration of Immortal Qi would grow progressively higher, sufficient to enable the lives and cultivation of the Immortals that would later be born into the Han Mansion at Chengsheng Mountain.
…….
Daqian Empire, Qingzhou.
A handsome young man dressed in fine blue garments, with a tall and sturdy figure and a chiseled face, was lying comfortably on a cloud boat, heading towards Leizhou.
The young man casually picked up a red jade gourd next to him and gulped down a few mouthfuls of wine, a look of enjoyment crossing his face.
“This Flying Immortal Brew is well-known, but its taste is quite ordinary,” the young man casually critiqued.
He had bought this gourd of wine while passing through Jizhou, having heard of the Flying Immortal Brew’s fame on the mountain, which ranked among the top ten of the Daqian Empire.
It was only because of this that he had gone out of his way to purchase it.
Sadly, it did not meet his expectations.
The cloud boat wasn’t very fast, but they could already see Leizhou.
The young man couldn’t help but rise to his feet, standing at the prow of the boat with his hands clasped behind him, looking down at the mountains and rivers below and muttering, “The demon spawns of Jizhou and Qingzhou have all scattered.
I wonder if the demon spawns of Leizhou have fled.
If not, I should catch a few demonesses to play with.”
After the battle in the Barbarian Region, Chengsheng Mountain had become the premier force in Qianyuan Divine Province, awe-inspiring in all directions, even Bai Yujing had to make way.
Princess Chu Mengyao, one of Han Li’s wives, was also a cultivator who had secluded herself in the mountains.
She didn’t wish to rely on Chengsheng Mountain’s power to reclaim the lost territories of the Daqian Empire, even though she knew Chengsheng Mountain was far more powerful than the outside world understood.
Chu Mengyao possessed a competitive spirit and had repeatedly refused Emperor Qian’s requests.
She believed that with Chengsheng Mountain’s cultivation environment and her status, it wouldn’t take many years to achieve this goal.
In fact, Chu Mengyao had recently broken through to the Saint Abyss Realm but didn’t have the chance to reclaim the lost lands.
Years ago, Yinyang Sect, Da Jing Dynasty, Fengbo Pavilion, and Kurong Sect had voluntarily withdrawn, returning the occupied territories of the Daqian Empire without taking anything with them.
Naturally, this was at the behest of major powers like Heavenly Demon Hall, Xumi Mountain, and Emperor Mingtian, who didn’t dare to oppose Chengsheng Mountain, even though no such request had been made by Chengsheng Mountain.
Thus, the Daqian Empire reclaimed its lost lands, but Emperor Qian wasn’t particularly thrilled.
He only wanted to hold tightly to Chengsheng Mountain’s coattails, making trips there to pay respects under the pretext of reminiscing with his sister, Chu Mengyao.
The young hero was well aware of all this because he was a member of Han Mansion from Chengsheng Mountain, and furthermore, he was of the direct lineage, being the seventh child of Han Li and Lu Tianxiang.
The valiant young man was named Han Yongji.
He possessed first-rate talent and the Extreme Yang King Body.
At just eighteen years old, he already attained the late stage of cultivation in the Myriad Phenomena Realm.
Being born in the Han Mansion, Han Yongji enjoyed unparalleled wealth and honor.
He was one of the core descendants fostered by the mansion and had consumed countless heavenly materials, treasures, and exquisite cuisines since childhood.
This had made Han Yongji quite discerning in taste, finding the Flying Immortal Brew to be rather ordinaryâ€”simply because the food and drinks he normally consumed were far too sumptuous.
On the way, the cloud boat met numerous cultivators, among them many from the Divine Yuan Realm and Tongxuan Realm, with many hailing from outside the Qianyuan Divine Province.
Seeing the emblem of Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion on Han Yongji’s clothing, even powerful cultivators of the Tongxuan Realm were exceedingly polite and dared not offend him in the slightest.
Some more opportunistic individuals even wished to pledge their allegiance to Han Yongji, hoping to become his followers.
However, Han Yongji did not accept any of them.
Having received the best instruction at Chengsheng Mountain, he knew well that accepting followers was a serious matter.
He wouldn’t just take anyone as a follower; he needed to be responsible both to himself and to his followers.
Moreover, it was not convenient for him to take followers at the moment.
Today, leaving Chengsheng Mountain, he was tasked with a missionâ€”to travel to Leizhou’s Dingyuan Manor and enter the Emperor Formation to meet Emperor Changfeng.
Han Yongji felt that this task was not at all easy to complete, but he couldn’t refuse it.
Meeting Emperor Changfeng was once a matter of fortune, but now that it had fallen to him, it had become a mission.
This opportunity, specific to Lu Tianxiang’s lineage, had brought considerable fortune to his eldest brother, Han Yongzhen, from Emperor Changfeng.
Following that, Han Yongxiang, Han Yonglu, and other older siblings had also gained considerable opportunities.
But Emperor Changfeng had become increasingly cautious and impatient; snatching opportunities from him had grown quite difficult.
Two years ago, his sixth brother went and nearly got expelled by Emperor Changfeng, had the Emperor been allowed to use force.
Therefore, when Lu Tianxiang scheduled Han Yongji to go, he tried to delay and firmly argued against it, but in the end, he agreed to take on the mission.
He had no choice but to accept; it was a test for him.
If he didn’t handle it well, it would affect the image he held with his father.
This was why Lu Tianxiang sent Han Yongji despite knowing the difficultyâ€”it was to prove that Han Yongji was exceptionally capable if he could achieve the seemingly impossible.
The descendants of Han Li were now too numerous, and the competition among them was fierce.
If Lu Tianxiang wished to procure some advantages for Han Yongji, then he had to achieve some results.
The other cherished wives and concubines of Han Li were aware of Emperor Changfeng’s existence, but none interfered; their children each had their own fortunes and trials to face.
“I hope Emperor Changfeng will show me some favor and lend me a hand, otherwise…” Han Yongji slightly furrowed his brows, his thoughts swirling.
Before his departure, Lu Tianxiang had made various arrangements, and with the experiences of a few older siblings to guide him, Han Yongji had gained a thorough understanding of Emperor Changfeng and prepared a slew of dialogue tactics.
He wasn’t afraid of Emperor Changfeng’s anger; he was afraid that Emperor Changfeng wouldn’t grant him an opportunity.
According to the information revealed by his mother, Lu Tianxiang, this should be his last time taking advantage of Emperor Changfeng.
After this, Emperor Changfeng would no longer be associated with his line.
At that time, his aunt, Zimiao Zhen, would go to see Emperor Changfeng and decide how to deal with himâ€”whether to subdue, kill, or continue to suppress him.

chapters.title: Chapter 731
chapters.content:
Chapter 731: Chapter 278: Pulling Wool and Raising Pigs, The Stunned Emperor Changfeng, Several Buddhist Girls, Han Li’s Big Move_1 Chapter 731: Chapter 278: Pulling Wool and Raising Pigs, The Stunned Emperor Changfeng, Several Buddhist Girls, Han Li’s Big Move_1 The setting sun dipped low in the west, casting its lingering glow across the land and painting the scenery in hues of orange and red.
A cloud boat sailed in from the horizon, entering Leizhou.
It made its way forward and eventually came to a stop above Dingyuan Manor.
Han Yongji, dressed in splendid green garments, looked down languidly at the mountains and rivers below, and immediately his gaze fell upon the exceptionally short hill amongst the range of mountains.
With a casual gesture, Han Yongji put away the cloud boat and flew down toward the area, making no attempt to hide his tracks.
Han Yongji had initially wanted to find a few witches to entertain himself with, only to discover that not a single Cultivator of the demon path remained in Sanzhou territory; they had all completely vanished.
Instead, there seemed to be a lot more of other cultivators.
...
Right now, many were watching Han Yongji, curious to see what he was up to in Leizhou.
As a direct descendant of Chengsheng Mountain, Han Yongji’s every move attracted great interest and had already drawn the attention of numerous cultivators, who followed him, eager to discern his purpose.
But it was mere curiosity.
Even if there were some fortuitous opportunity, no one would dare to rob a direct descendant of Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion in the Xuan Domain, let alone think about killing him.
If there were any danger, that would be their chance.
Extending a helping hand to Han Yongji and offering some assistance, or even saving him, would bring them astonishing rewards, and they might even use this as a chance to join Chengsheng Mountain.
“What is Han Yongji doing in Leizhou when he should be at Chengsheng Mountain?”
“Maybe he’s coming back to visit his hometown?
But that’s not right either; the Han Mansion’s hometown is in Fengyang Manor’s Lingjun City, and yet Han Yongji has come to Dingyuan Manor.”
“It is said that Han Yongji belongs to the line of Lu Tianxiang, the first wife of ‘that one,’ whose status is incredibly high.
And it seems that several of Lu Tianxiang’s children have been to Dingyuan Manor in Leizhou before…”
“It looks like Dingyuan Manor must have some grand opportunity, perhaps a secret territory left by someone from a previous life that bestows against-the-Heaven’s-creation rewards to those who pass the test?”
“I have heard a rumor that beneath the hundred-meter hill in Dingyuan Manor lies suppressed a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor who lived through the ancient catastrophe.”
Many cultivators watched as Han Yongji flew toward the small mountain.
They stopped following him, some standing high in the firmament, others on their cloud boats, all discussing animatedly.
They were all communicating via voice transmission, careful not to let Han Yongji hear some of their more taboo words, fearing trouble if Han Yongji was not open-minded.
Han Yongji, unbothered by these cultivators, landed behind the small mountain.
In his right hand appeared a crystal bead, which at the next moment burst into a dazzling white light.
Han Yongji’s figure then disappeared.
The underworld world.
“Get out!”
No sooner had Han Yongji arrived than he heard an angry roar by his ear.
He dug into his ear with his slender finger and wore a gentle smile on his face as he said, “Great Emperor, why such anger?”
Of course, Han Yongji knew why Emperor Changfeng was seethingâ€”it was all because of the trouble his brothers and sisters had caused, so he paid it no mind.
On the contrary, he even coaxed Emperor Changfeng.
Otherwise, how would he complete his task?
“Has the Han Mansion had enough?
One comes after another; what, do you want to fleece me till I’m bare?”
Within the nine-colored light barrier, Emperor Changfeng spoke with a cold and shadowy voice, as dark as water.
“The Great Emperor jests.
With your esteemed self being a powerhouse of the Heaven Imperial Realm, possessing immeasurable strength, how could our Han Mansion dare to offend you?”
“Moreover…
as a legendary powerhouse who survived the ancient catastrophe, even a mere trifle from you counts as an against-the-Heaven’s-creation opportunity for us.”
Han Yongji was full of flattery, always maintaining a warm smile for Emperor Changfeng.
Yet internally, he was full of sarcasm.
They in the Han Mansion really did defer to Emperor Changfeng, having sent only a few.
They had to understand, there were over a million descendants in the Han Mansion…
A single Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor wasn’t enough for them to plunder!
“Hehe~”
Emperor Changfeng chuckled coldly.
“The little brats who came before you said the same thing.”
“Can’t you come up with a different set of flattering lines for me?
Do you really think I’m that foolish?”
Emperor Changfeng laughed out of frustration.
These whelps from the Han Mansion were too muchâ€”everyone who came here spoke nearly the same words.
“You’re mistaken, Great Emperor.
You misunderstand us; these are words from the heart.”
“Before coming to see you, my eldest brother, second sister, third sister, fourth brother…
they all instructed me well, to treat the Great Emperor with the utmost respect.
After all, you are our benefactor.”
Han Yongji spoke calmly and confidently, unswayed by the emotions of Emperor Changfeng.
“Hehe~”
“You Han’s, not a single one of you is any good.”
Emperor Changfeng scoffed coldly, unmoved.
He had already guessed that the newcomer was the younger brother of Han Yongzhen, Han Yongxiang, and Han Yongluâ€”and now it seemed he was correct.
Birds of a feather flock together.
It’s like they’re intent on shearing me to death!
Despite his dissatisfaction with the Han Mansion, Han Yongji, and his siblings, Emperor Changfeng also had his own schemes in mind, otherwise, he wouldn’t keep falling for their tricks.
What was called being tricked was actually part of his own plans, including his reactions, which were just for show to those from the Han Mansion.
While the Han Mansion hoped to continuously gain fortunes from him, Emperor Changfeng was no easy mark.
He had already harbored a deep-seated hatred for the Han Mansion, always plotting carefully.
He had opted for a more cautious and steady approach in his schemes.
If the Han Mansion kept on fleecing him, it suited his plans perfectly, allowing him to avoid rushing and risking the failure of his schemes.
As long as the Han Mansion continued sending people, Emperor Changfeng could bide his time, casting out bait bit by bit, luring the Han Mansion to keep sending more people.
Each opportunity Emperor Changfeng provided had been tampered with.
It wasn’t as obvious as the first time, but it was very secretive, each time involved only a part of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 732
chapters.content:
Chapter 732: Chapter 278: Shearing Wool and Raising Pigs, the Stupefied Emperor Changfeng, Several Buddhist Girls, Han Li’s Major Move_2 Chapter 732: Chapter 278: Shearing Wool and Raising Pigs, the Stupefied Emperor Changfeng, Several Buddhist Girls, Han Li’s Major Move_2 In the end, some key members of the Han Mansion were bound to be under his control; by then, the already grown Han Mansion would be just the help he needed to break free.
Once freed, he’d exterminate the entire Han Mansion.
As long as he could get out of the grand formation, he’d quickly return to his peak.
With his strength, although he couldn’t provoke the several Sacred Lands of Qianyuan Divine Province, wasn’t dealing with the little Han Family as easy as capturing them in the palm of his hand?
This was Emperor Changfeng’s plan, and he called it: fattening the pig.
When the Han Mansion, this pig, had been fattened, it would be time for his reckoning, a ruthless harvest to avenge the hatred festering in his heart.
As for whether the Han Mansion would grow beyond his control, Emperor Changfeng had considered this, but he did not care.
...
Because it was impossible for them to grow beyond his control.
In his eyes, the Han Mansion was just a minor family.
It was not about claiming power in Qianyuan Divine Province, they would even need to keep their tails between their legs in the Xuan Domain.
That Lu Tianxiang had been at the Myriad Phenomena Realm for decades, and Han Li was almost the same, decades had passed, even with his help, at most they might have cultivated to the Divine Yuan Realm.
Another hundred years and Han Li and Lu Tianxiang achieving the Tongxuan Realm would be heralded as a prodigious talent.
Yet, in his eyes, they were still as insignificant as ants, whether in the Tongxuan Realm or the Sacred Abyss Realm, he could kill countless with just a slap.
The only thing that surprised Emperor Changfeng was the talent of Han Li and Lu Tianxiang’s descendants.
Lu Tianxiang had only second or third-grade talent; Han Yongzhen was mostly the same, but the ones that followed, up to Han Yongji, had increasingly higher talent.
Through the Emperor Formation, although he couldn’t inspect them closely, he could still see the cultivation and ages of people like Han Yongji, and it was impossible to hide these from him at a glance.
Every descendant from the Han Mansion that came here was below twenty years old and in the Myriad Phenomena Realm, seemingly with some unique opportunity.
But that was it; Emperor Changfeng did not take them to heart.
The higher their talent, the better it was for him.
With his help, Han Yongzhen, Han Yongxiang, and others grew rapidly, yet would eventually be under his control, just in time to aid in his escape.
“Great Emperor, your prejudice against us runs too deep, It truly saddens us.”
“Big brother and the others have learned your cultivation techniques and martial skills; they can be considered your disciples.
They hold you in the utmost admiration.
There’s no need for such wariness, we’re all family here.”
“In order to bring us closer together, I ask you, Great Emperor, to bestow upon me some Emperor Level cultivation techniques and martial skills.
And if you could also provide some high-level pill formulas and blueprints, if you could even grant me a few Emperor weapons, that would be the icing on the cake…”
Han Yongji nattered on and on, maintaining a gentle tone from beginning to end without showing any impatience.
Although Han Mansion of Chengsheng Mountain was the First Power in the Yuankun Domain, possessing many Immortal weapons capable of easily slaying Emperor Changfeng, it was none of his concern.
Han Yongji just wanted to snatch some opportunities from Emperor Changfeng and then go back to report; otherwise, if he performed too poorly, he’d lose face in front of his father, Han Li, making his future much less pleasant.
A missed step leads to a cascade of mistakes, a slight misstep here means extra effort is needed later to compensate.
Therefore, Han Yongji strove to make the most out of this single opportunity.
How Aunt Purple Miao and his father decided to deal with Emperor Changfeng was no longer his concern.
“Dreaming in broad daylight, are you?”
Watching the young man in blue shamelessly make his requests, Emperor Changfeng couldn’t help but ridicule him.
Although he was plotting, he was no wish-granting machine.
“Great Emperor, start with a high bid and settle for a lower price.
I’m not even asking for your most precious Immortal Scriptures or Immortal Grade Martial Skills and the like.
Of course, if you insist on giving them to me, I won’t refuse,” Han Yongji cheerfully said.
He even stepped forward, crossing the kilometer red line, seemingly unaware of any danger.
In fact, there was indeed no danger to him; he carried Supreme Grade Emperor weapons with him.
As long as Emperor Changfeng had no Immortal weapons, he couldn’t harm him.
“You really are insatiable, just like your annoying brothers and sisters,” Emperor Changfeng said through gritted teeth.
He had heard this several times already; Han Yongxiang, Han Yonglu, and others all wanted to snatch away his Immortal Scriptures and Immortal Grade Martial Skills.
Emperor Changfeng indeed possessed them but would not give them away because otherwise, the attraction to the Han Family’s descendants would greatly diminish.
If he were not trapped and forced to continually lay out plans, he would have already killed these descendants of the Han Family.
Han Yongji shrugged, not saying anything.
He was well aware of Emperor Changfeng’s plotting, but it didn’t matterâ€”it was all for nothing regarding him and the Han Family.
The fear is the silence that comes out of the blue.
After a moment of silence, Emperor Changfeng took the initiative to ask, “What’s your name?”
“Han Yongji,” replied Han Yongji with a flash in his eyes.
“Your name happens to be better than your brothers’ and sisters’.”
“Thanks for the compliment.”
“You’ve got thick skin.”
“Thanks for the compliment.”
“Heh~”
Emperor Changfeng chuckled coldly, no longer desiring any interaction.
Seeing Han Yongji remain silent, staring straight at him with a look that said he wouldn’t leave without an opportunity, Emperor Changfeng wanted to slap him dead.
“Your father, does he still refuse to come and see me?” Emperor Changfeng sighed.
Han Yongji gave Emperor Changfeng a surprised look and said, “Is that how much you want to find…
my father?”
He initially wanted to say “seek death,” but it wasn’t appropriate to say it now; it could easily make Emperor Changfeng suspicious, and that would make it difficult for him to complete his task.
So, Han Yongji decided to snatch some opportunities first, since their line had no more chances left anyway.
Emperor Changfeng nodded, “I want to see him.”
For the man who repeatedly thwarted his plans, Emperor Changfeng’s teeth itched with hatred, yet Han Li never came here, which aggravated him even more.

chapters.title: Chapter 733
chapters.content:
Chapter 733: Chapter 278: Shearing Wool and Raising Pigs, the Stupefied Emperor Changfeng, Several Buddhist Girls, Han Li’s Major Move_3 Chapter 733: Chapter 278: Shearing Wool and Raising Pigs, the Stupefied Emperor Changfeng, Several Buddhist Girls, Han Li’s Major Move_3 “There will be a chance,” Han Yong Ji said with a smile.
Emperor Changfeng looked at him intently, feeling somewhat odd.
This was different from the responses of the other Han Mansion brats.
Could it be that Han Li, who clung to life so desperately, had a change of heart?
Or was it that Han Li was planning to show up in person, wanting to snatch the Immortal Scripture and Immortal Grade Martial Skill from his hands?
All sorts of speculations flashed through his mind, and Emperor Changfeng suddenly laughed, then said, “Seeing as you’re so honest, I can give you one Saint Abyss Realm level Cultivation Technique and Martial Skill each.”
“Not enough.”
“I want Heaven Imperial Realm level Cultivation Technique and Martial Skill, and the more, the better.”
Han Yong Ji flatly rejected the offer, as the Saint Abyss Realm Cultivation Technique and Martial Skills were of no use to him; he was already cultivating at the Heaven Immortal Rank.
The reason he was the last one was because Emperor Changfeng was no longer of any value; having gained the foundations of the five major powers, Chengsheng Mountain looked down upon Emperor Changfeng.
...
“Han Yong Ji, do you think that’s possible?” Emperor Changfeng sneered.
“Nothing’s impossible.
I’m very easy to talk to; we can discuss anything.
Whatever conditions you have, I can agree to all of them,” Han Yong Ji claimed, covering all the bases, as he scoffed to himself.
Unlike his brothers and sisters, he truly could agree to anything, since Emperor Changfeng was going to be dealt with anyway.
A glint flashed in Emperor Changfeng’s eyes as he tested with a few rather excessive demands, and Han Yong Ji agreed to all of them.
This abnormal behavior made Emperor Changfeng feel uneasy, but he also couldn’t fathom the reason, clueless about what Han Yong Ji and Han Li were scheming.
Emperor Changfeng stated several more conditions, two of which were crucial, and Han Yong Ji intentionally rejected them without hesitation.
This, in turn, relieved Emperor Changfeng.
If Han Yong Ji truly agreed to everything, he would have become anxious and would not have given Han Yong Ji anything.
After negotiating for a while, Han Yong Ji also thoughtfully swore an oath with the Oath Stone, putting Emperor Changfeng at ease.
Yet, his confusion deepened.
How much did this young man hate Han Mansion?
He betrayed many of the mansion’s interests to obtain opportunities from him.
“Han Yong Ji, you can leave now.
Don’t forget our agreement, or else…
Heh~” Emperor Changfeng’s face was expressionless, a touch of murderous intent fleeting.
Unhearing, Han Yong Ji was less than a hundred meters from Emperor Changfeng when he suddenly laughed, his laughter unrestrained.
He had already reaped enough opportunities from Emperor Changfeng, even exceeding his task, hence there was no need to pretend anymore.
Besides the Immortal Scripture and Immortal Grade Martial Skills of Emperor Changfeng, they had more or less taken everything else that they could value, basically plucking Emperor Changfeng clean.
“What are you laughing at?” Emperor Changfeng’s brow furrowed, a bad premonition rising in his heart.
“Nothing much, just a piece of news for you,” Han Yong Ji replied.
“Speak.”
“The White Emperor is dead, killed by my father.”
“Boom!”
Before Han Yong Ji’s words had finished, Emperor Changfeng explosively unleashed a terrifying aura.
Such force made the Emperor Formation shake, and even strands of the Emperor’s Might seeped out under his full blast, but Han Yong Ji seemed as if he didn’t feel it.
Through the rainbow barrier, Emperor Changfeng’s eyes were bloodshot with raging fury, staring intently at Han Yong Ji, and his ice-cold voice said with emphasis, “Is what you said true?!”
“Absolutely true,” Han Yong Ji replied with a shrug.
As the words settled, without waiting for Emperor Changfeng to speak again, Han Yong Ji left him with a cool silhouette, disappearing into the Underground World.
“Damn it!!!” Emperor Changfeng roared.
As a Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperor, his schemes were unfathomable, and he normally would not show his emotions, but now he truly couldn’t hold back.
“I was pretending before, now it’s real.”
He felt life was a dull gray.
The White Emperor is dead!
His nemesis, the White Emperor, was dead.
Normally, he should’ve been delighted, but now he couldn’t feel any joy at all.
No wonder Han Yong Ji agreed so readily to his many demands, no wonder Han Yong Ji said Han Li would come to see him.
This was a clear case of using him up and then squeezing out whatever value was left.
He probably couldn’t escape death.
Emperor Changfeng couldn’t fathom why Han Li had grown so fast, why he was so strong, strong enough to even kill the White Emperor who wielded True Immortal weapons and was a supreme being of the Yuankun Domain.
But he knew that if what Han Yong Ji had said was true, he was finished.
“I hope it’s not true, alas.”
Emperor Changfeng looked at the empty Underground World with a complex expression, sighed, and for the first time, sat down on the ground in despair.
In his heart, he hoped it was false, but given Han Yong Ji’s performance today, it could well be true.
…….
Chengsheng Mountain, Chengdao Peak.
Han Li’s figure descended upon the mountaintop.
With his hands behind his back, he admired the grand beauty of the world, feeling very pleased.
He had just returned from Little Western Heaven at Xumi Mountain.
This time, the female bodhisattva Han Linxi, in an effort to please him, not only obediently performed many challenging poses but also introduced him to several stunning buddhist nuns.
With the female bodhisattva being so courteous, how could Han Li hold back?
He naturally engaged in intimate exchanges of dao with them, imparting the profound truths of the great dao that he had mastered, helping their minor ways to expand.
Under Han Li’s personal guidance, the nuns deeply felt his immense sincerity.
They became utterly devoted and grateful to him, unable to help themselves from singing beautiful melodies.
Han Li, with his acute perception while teaching the dao, noticed that the female bodhisattva and the nuns seemed somewhat distracted.
Therefore, he spared no courtesy in administering a “stick” education, beating them until they knelt begging for mercy, bowing before and behind him.
After reflecting on his actions thrice daily, Han Li then returned to Chengdao Peak.
No sooner had he returned than Lu Tianxiang appeared beside him, her face beaming with a smile.
“Husband, have you returned from Sister Linxi’s place?” Lu Tianxiang asked with a smile.
The female bodhisattva Han Linxi had visited Chengsheng Mountain a few days earlier but didn’t stay long before returning to Xumi Mountain; she wasn’t used to being there, mainly because Chengdao Peak had too many sister wives.
It was better to stay at Xumi Mountain; out of sight, out of mind.
Han Li nodded slightly, pulled Lu Tianxiang into his embrace, and his hand casually stroked her, “Has there been an outcome with Yong Ji?”
“He has completed the task you set.
He thoroughly bamboozled Emperor Changfeng,” Lu Tianxiang couldn’t help laughing.
Han Yong Ji had gone to see Emperor Changfeng, and although Lu Tianxiang did not follow, she used a Heavenly Immortal weapon to monitor the situation, watching everything that happened in the Underground World.
As Han Li’s first wife, Lu Tianxiang was also one of his most favored wives, even slightly more so than Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue.
Her authority on Chengsheng Mountain was considerable, allowing her to use Heavenly Immortal weapons and even command True Immortal weapons at critical moments.
“That’s good.”
Han Li wasn’t surprised.
He had high hopes for Han Yong Ji, and this was just a small test, easily passed.
“We’ll discuss the rest when Yong Ji returns.”
“Xiangxiang, it’s time for our morning practice.”
“My dear, didn’t you just get out of the female bodhisattva’s bed?”
“Isn’t this for you…”

chapters.title: Chapter 734
chapters.content:
Chapter 734: Chapter 279: Talent Battle at the Han Mansion, Xuxian Realm, Dongchen Domain, Han Li and Emperor Changfeng_1 Chapter 734: Chapter 279: Talent Battle at the Han Mansion, Xuxian Realm, Dongchen Domain, Han Li and Emperor Changfeng_1 In the Yundao Hall.
Han Li summoned Han Yongji who returned from Leizhou, rewarded him, and arranged a new challenge for him to complete within a year.
Han Yongji left joyfully and went straight to Cangdao Peak, entering the Cangdao Hall to select a set of powerful martial techniques suitable for himself.
In another month, it would be the annual Han Mansion Talent Battle, and Han Yongji believed that this time he had a chance to make it into the top ten of the Myriad Phenomena Realm group.
The Han Mansion Talent Battle was a competition established by Han Li decades ago, intended to encourage the descendants of Han Mansion to cultivate diligently and select the most outstanding ones for training.
The Talent Battle was held once a year, divided into five groups: God Refining Realm, Hollow Void Stage, Myriad Phenomena Realm, True Martial Realm, and Divine Yuan Realm.
The top ten in each group would receive generous rewards and come under the focused attention of Han Li.
...
Han Yongji originally thought that making it into the top ten of the Talent Battle was a far-fetched dream, since he was only in the late stages of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, and there were many extraordinary talents in the Han Mansion who were stranded at the peak and whose combat ability was extremely powerful even among those in the True Martial Realm.
However, this time he had splendidly completed the challenge task set by his father and had received many resources, such as the opportunity to choose a Heavenly Imperial Realm level martial technique from the Cangdao Hall, and under the Artifact Spirit’s blessing, he could master the basics in the span of a few breaths.
Even just attaining the rudimentary level of a Heavenly Imperial Realm martial technique would boost Han Yongji’s combat ability by many times, making him a strong contender for the top ten of the Myriad Phenomena Realm group.
He could also practice for ten days in the fifth layer of the Time-Sky Tower, where five years would pass inside for every ten days outside.
With his high aptitude, it was very likely that he could cultivate this Heavenly Imperial Realm martial technique to near completion, or even reach the minor completion stage, within those five years.
No matter which outcome, his combat ability would surge once again, and one could say that his place in the top ten of the Myriad Phenomena Realm group was practically secured.
“Impetuous.”
Han Li said with a smile to the beauty by his side.
Lu Tianxiang rolled her eyes at him, “Yong Ji is doing it to enter the top ten of the Myriad Phenomena Realm group and receive your distinguished regard.”
Han Li wrapped his arm around Lu Tianxiang and said with a sheepish smile, “Whether or not he makes it into the top ten doesn’t matter, as long as Yong Ji is earnestly cultivating, then he hasn’t let down our nurturing efforts.”
Lu Tianxiang’s eyes flickered, and she remained silent.
For Han Li, it was acceptable either for Han Yongji to enter the top ten of the Myriad Phenomena Realm group or for anyone else to do so; all were his outstanding offspring, the future Heavenly Imperial Realm Great Emperors or Immortals of Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion.
But for Lu Tianxiang, naturally she hoped Han Yongji could enter the top ten and obtain more cultivation resources since Han Yongji was her own child, while the others were her sisters’ children.
There were some things neither of them said aloud, but both understood.
If they did speak frankly, it would just be awkward.
“Husband, I heard you’re going to enter the Xuxian Realm again soon?” Lu Tianxiang sat on Han Li’s lap, her slender jade arms wrapped around his neck, speaking in a soft voice.
Han Li nodded his head.
“Yongzhen ran into some trouble last time in the Xuxian Realm, being oppressed by a peerless talent from the Dongchen Domain.
Husband, you should take revenge for him.”
Lu Tianxiang leaned closer, her face like jade next to Han Li’s, murmuring softly.
Han Yongzhen was their first child.
Originally, he had only Third Grade aptitude and no special physique, but now, Han Yongzhen’s aptitude had long since been promoted to First Grade.
In terms of physique, the Life-Prolonging Furnace had enabled Han Yongzhen to develop a Kingly Body, and after Han Li assigned several challenging tasks to Han Yongzhen, which he passed, Han Li evolved Han Yongzhen’s physique into an Imperial Body.
In a strict sense, Lu Tianxiang was Han Li’s first wife, which made Han Yongzhen his eldest legitimate son.
Although Han Li didn’t differentiate between legitimate and illegitimate children, he still hoped Han Yongzhen would go further and achieve greater success, after all, he had had high hopes for him when Han Yongzhen was born.
Once Han Yongzhen broke through to the Tongxuan Realm, he ventured into the Xuxian Realm, making a small name for himself and stirring up some trouble.
The peerless talent from the Dongchen Domain had a not-so-small reputation in the Xuxian Realm, with many followers.
One of those followers approached Han Yongzhen, wishing to recruit him into their ranks, but Han Yongzhen, proud as he was, naturally refused.
As a result, he was defeated by that Divine Yuan Realm follower and woke up humiliated on Chengsheng Mountain, with some damage to his Divine Spirit.
This was the kind of matter Han Li usually wouldn’t bother with; the strife in the Xuxian Realm was far more intense than in the Taichu Realm.
It was just a minor incident for Han Yongzhen, and at the time, he might not have been able to prevail against that peerless talent from the Dongchen Domain anyway.
Lu Tianxiang certainly knew her husband’s nature, so she didn’t raise the issue, merely keeping it in mind.
Now that her husband was about to enter the Xuxian Realm again, with his current combat ability, he was likely to have very few adversaries in that realm.
That peerless talent from the Dongchen Domain was said to be at the Heavenly Imperial Realm, with combat prowess comparable to a Heavenly Immortal, but likely not quite as strong as her husband.
How powerful her husband was, she vaguely knew some parts; he had even weathered the ninety-nine Heavenly Tribulations and had transcended into a War Immortal.
Given her husband’s nature, he wouldn’t enter the Xuxian Realm without the strength to dominate; now that he was set to venture there, it indicated he had attained the level of power he anticipated.
So, Lu Tianxiang brought it up intentionally, as she was quite vengeful.
“Don’t worry; I’ll take good care of him,” Han Li said.
Raising an eyebrow, Han Li embraced Lu Tianxiang’s delicate waist, recalling the details of that peerless talent from the Dongchen Domain.
He was vengeful too.

chapters.title: Chapter 735
chapters.content:
Chapter 735: Chapter 279: Talent Battle at the Han Mansion, Xuxian Realm, Dongchen Domain, Han Li and Emperor Changfeng_2 Chapter 735: Chapter 279: Talent Battle at the Han Mansion, Xuxian Realm, Dongchen Domain, Han Li and Emperor Changfeng_2 Although not entirely confident, Han Li preferred to bide his time, allowing his enemies the freedom to roam until his strength was sufficient to dispatch them for good.
The Xuxian Realm has its own set of rules, forbidding Immortals from entering, lest they be eliminated by the realm’s regulations.
However, if one’s power is great enough, for instance, that of an Immortal King, even the Xuxian Realm can do nothing about itâ€”though an Immortal King would not concern themselves with the Xuxian Realm.
The summit of the Heaven Imperial Realm is the highest cultivation level allowed by the Xuxian Realm.
Thus, Great Emperors with combat abilities comparable to those of a Heavenly Immortal are highly influential within the Xuxian Realm, practically moving unimpeded.
The Dongchen Domain is very distant from the Yuankun Domain.
Located in the southeast near the center of the Taichu Realm, it boasts profound heritage and once produced a Quasi Immortal Emperor.
...
It’s said that even now, an Immortal King lies hidden within.
This exceptional prodigy is named Yang Tianxi, an eight-layered Heaven Imperial Realm cultivator, very famous in the Dongchen Domain and one of its top three prodigies.
His reputation in the Xuxian Realm is even greater, as it’s rumored he possesses combat abilities comparable to a second-layered Heavenly Immortal Realm cultivator.
All this information was slowly collected by the talented descendants of the Tongxuan Realm whom Han Li had sent into the Xuxian Realm.
The followers of Yang Tianxi dared to annihilate a wisp of his son’s Divine Spirit, thereby forging a deep enmity that naturally fell upon Yang Tianxi’s head.
By reasoning based on himself, Han Li felt that Yang Tianxiong might have concealed his true strength, perhaps having cultivated to the ninth layer of the Heaven Imperial Realm or even its peak, which would mean even greater combat abilities.
Nevertheless, to him, it was all the same.
………
A silent, light boat silently made its way out of Chengsheng Mountain, towards Leizhou.
Upon the boat, Zimiao Zhen, dressed in pure white that outshone celestial beings, gracefully lifted her jade flute to her red lips to play.
Divine musical notes leaped forth, and a beautiful symphony began to echo.
With Zimiao Zhen’s intentional restraint, the sound of the flute did not carry to the outside world, heard only by her and her husband.
Han Li lay leisurely on the boat, hands placed behind his head, enjoying the view of his beautiful wife and listening to the music, the epitome of relaxation.
With his power, he could arrive instantly in the Underground World of Leizhou, but Zimiao Zhen felt that wouldn’t be proper, so they opted to travel on the light boat “leisurely.”
This light boat was transmuted from a Heavenly Immortal-grade Lightning Boat, possessing incredible speed.
Though “leisurely” traveling, it was still remarkably fast and would reach their destination in no time.
Han Li had long been looking forward to meeting Emperor Changfeng, but due to various reasons, he had not made the trip, delaying it until now when he was already invincible in the Yuankun Domain.
He was indeed very curious about Emperor Changfeng; what grievances he held against the White Emperor, why the White Emperor hadn’t come to slay him, and how he had survived the great calamity of the Ancient Era.
In the Ancient Era, Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals were rare, but there were many Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperorsâ€”seven to eight hundred of them.
Emperor Changfeng was just one of them and not well-known, yet he managed to survive unharmed.
Although constrained within the peerless Emperor Formation, unable to escape, this was already a tremendous blessing.
It’s likely that most Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm from the Ancient Era would have willingly traded places with Emperor Changfeng.
Han Li believed that Emperor Changfeng was not simple; it could be his own doing or the work of someone behind the scenes.
Once the piece was finished, Zimiao Zhen set down the jade flute and walked elegantly to Han Li’s side to sit.
With her slender soft arm propping up her chin, she gazed at Han Li, utterly infatuated.
“Husband, what’s the scenery like within the Xuxian Realm?”
Zimiao Zhen’s lively tone was brimming with curiosity.
She had never been to the Xuxian Realm.
She’d only heard that it was immensely vast, with the Yuankun Domain corresponding to only a small corner of it.
Back when she lived in White Emperor City, she had seen much and was quite knowledgeable.
However, she knew nothing about the world beyond the Yuankun Domain and what it was really like.
Everything was blocked by Xuanshen Sword Mountain; she could only pursue the truth through ancient history and various secret tales, with only vague records of Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
After marrying into Chengsheng Mountain and becoming Han Li’s Dao companion, Zimiao Zhen realized just how superficial her knowledge had been.
The world was vast with so many unknown secrets.
Even some common knowledge from the outside world became clear to her only after arriving at Chengsheng Mountain.
If not for the fact that none of her children had yet reached the Tongxuan Realm, Zimiao Zhen wouldn’t have to ask such a question.
