According to her husband’s rules, only after reaching the Tongxuan Realm would they be eligible to enter the Xuxian Realm to gain experience, broaden their horizons, and seize opportunities.
Her children naturally had excellent talent and constitution, but being young, the one with the highest cultivation had only just managed to reach the Divine Yuan Realm.
Looking at the curious Zimiao Zhen, Han Li’s eyes flickered, and he briefly explained the origins and situation of the Xuxian Realm.
Upon hearing this, Zimiao Zhen’s cherry lips formed a surprised O, stirring something in Han Li.
And so, he did what he felt like doing.
……..
In Leizhou, DIngyuan Manor.
The Lightning Boat descended onto the hundred-meter hill in complete silence, yet Emperor Changfeng below remained utterly unaware.
“I never thought that on my third visit here, everything would have changed so drastically.”
Zi Miao Zhen looked down at the hundred-meter hill, her stunningly beautiful face etched with complex emotions.
The first time she had come here was over five hundred years ago, by the decree of the White Emperor to strengthen the seal.
The second time was forty or fifty years ago, also by the White Emperor’s command, and that was when she first met Han Li.
She had thought that the third visit would not be for another five hundred years, and she had assumed she would no longer encounter Han Li, but how swiftly things changed, leaving her with a deep sense of melancholy.
Not only had she met Han Li again, but she had also become Han Li’s Dao companion.
Even the White Emperor had been killed by Han Li, White Emperor City had been taken over by Chengsheng Mountain, and now Han Li was bringing her to meet Emperor Changfeng.
“Let’s go.”
After retracting the Lightning Boat, Han Li wrapped his arm around Zi Miao Zhen’s slender waist, just enough to encircle with a hand, and both of their figures vanished from the hilltop, entering the Underground World.
This time, Han Li did not hide their presence deliberately.
As soon as they appeared, Emperor Changfeng noticed them.
Behind the nine-colored light curtain, the figure of Emperor Changfeng emerged, looking more haggard and weary than when Han Yongji had seen him.
“Zi Miao Zhen?”
Emperor Changfeng immediately recognized the celestial-like beauty and staggered, nearly falling to the ground.
It was not out of fear of Zi Miao Zhen, but rather his worries seemed to be coming true.
Perhaps Han Yongji did not bluff him.
If the White Emperor was not dead, Zi Miao Zhen should have come here only after another four hundred years, but she was here now, and her cultivation level was unfathomably deep.
Based on his understanding of Zi Miao Zhen, Emperor Changfeng estimated that she had just recently broken through the Holy Abyss Realm, but the aura she was emitting did not seem like that of the Holy Abyss Realm; it was more like that of the Quasi Emperor Realm.
Advancing from the peak of the Tongxuan Realm to the Quasi Emperor Realm in just forty to fifty yearsâ€”Emperor Changfeng did not believe that the White Emperor could have aided Zi Miao Zhen in this.
It must have been Han Li’s doing.
He knew somewhat about Han Li, from what he had learned through the mouths of Han Yongzhen, Han Yongxiang, Han Yongji, and others, and was aware that Han Li had only cultivated for a few centuries.
If Han Li was capable of subduing the White Emperor, then his cultivation must be at least at the Heaven Imperial Realm.
With Han Li’s help, it was understandable that Zi Miao Zhen’s cultivation could have soared within decades.
“Emperor Changfeng, we meet again.” Zi Miao Zhen bowed slightly.
Emperor Changfeng snorted coldly, shifting his gaze from Zi Miao Zhen to Han Li, who was embracing her.
His eyes flickered, and he understood everything.
Seeing Zi Miao Zhen’s tender, compliant demeanor towards Han Li, Emperor Changfeng surmised that she was likely already Han Li’s Dao companion, which made it clear why Han Li would go to great lengths to aid Zi Miao Zhen.
“You are Han Li?”
Though he had his suspicions, Emperor Changfeng still asked out loud.
“I heard Emperor Changfeng has always wished to meet me, so I suppose I should fulfill that wish,” Han Li said casually.
“If I’ve satisfied your wish, Emperor Changfeng, then you should satisfy mine in turn, as courtesy demands.”
“So, Emperor Changfeng, you will need to answer some of my questions.
If I am satisfied, I will release you.
What do you say?”
Han Li looked at Emperor Changfeng within the nine-colored light curtain, his gaze profound, his tone neutral, yet it placed immense pressure on Emperor Changfeng.
Emperor Changfeng was deeply shocked, as he could not discern Han Li’s cultivation level.
This indicated that Han Li’s strength was likely far greater than he had anticipated.
Emperor Changfeng’s gaze flickered, his haggard appearance vanished, and he regained his imposing demeanor, speaking in a grave voice:
“And if I refuse?”

Charging for ten thousand daily, let’s go!

Chapter 736: Chapter 280: Slept Through a Great Calamity?
The Root of the Decline of Qianyuan Divine Province, the Tragic Child of a True Immortal_1 Chapter 736: Chapter 280: Slept Through a Great Calamity?
The Root of the Decline of Qianyuan Divine Province, the Tragic Child of a True Immortal_1 “You won’t agree?”
Han Li’s gaze flickered, and his tone remained calm, as if chatting with an acquaintance, “The White Emperor misses you very much.”
“You…”
Emperor Changfeng’s pupils shrank slightly.
Han Li might seem peaceful, but he was unmistakably threatening him.
The White Emperor had been suppressed and killed by Han Li, and he missed him?
Was this meant to send him to meet the White Emperor below and reminisce with him?
“Sigh~”
After staring intently at Han Li for a while, Emperor Changfeng suddenly sighed; his whole demeanor deflated again.
...
It seemed that Han Li was sure of his position, and Emperor Changfeng appeared to have no choice, not even the strength to resist.
“What do you want to ask?
I’ll try to withhold nothing,” Emperor Changfeng said, his expression one of dejection, as if he had aged a hundred thousand years in an instant.
Even during the Ancient Era, he had never been in such a predicament, as helpless as a lamb at the mercy of others.
A glint flashed in Han Li’s eyes as he pondered the word “try,” then he asked, “How did you survive the Ancient Catastrophe?”
Han Li asked the question that concerned him most.
The calamity of the Yuankun Domain began at the Xuanshen Sword Mountain, which harbored an unfathomable Immortal Sword.
Just a minor revival of its sword light could slash invincibly across the world, annihilating all immortals, and even True Immortals of the Nine Heavens couldn’t withstand a strand of its light.
After the calamity, True Immortals, Heavenly Immortals, and even Great Emperors of the Yuankun Domain all perished, countless imperial and immortal weapons destroyed, yet Emperor Changfeng was still alive and well.
Even though they were separated by the Emperor Formation, Han Li could still see through Emperor Changfeng’s cultivation: merely at the level of the Fifth Heaven in the Heaven Imperial Realm, and at most late-stage Heaven Imperial Realm in terms of combat ability.
This meager strength definitely couldn’t have allowed him to survive the great calamity of the Yuankun Domain.
Emperor Changfeng opened his mouth but, for a moment, said nothing as if he didn’t know what to say.
“Is this what you said about withholding nothing?” Han Li frowned, a hint of dissatisfaction mingling in his even tone.
It was only the first question, and Emperor Changfeng was already reluctant to answer; Han Li would have to deal quite seriously with this uncooperative emperor.
“I…
Brother Han, please, don’t be angry.
It’s not that I won’t tell, but that you wouldn’t believe it even if I did,” Emperor Changfeng said hurriedly when he saw Han Li looking like he was about to get angry, a bitter smile on his face.
A hint of curiosity flashed in Zimiao Zhen’s beautiful eyes.
She had come on orders both previous times and had only a basic understanding of Emperor Changfeng.
How Emperor Changfeng had survived the great calamity of the Yuankun Domain, how he had become enemies with White Emperor City, why the White Emperor himself didn’t travel to the Qianyuan Divine Province to kill Emperor Changfeng…
Zimiao Zhen was completely oblivious to these secrets.
Now that the White Emperor was dead, the only one who likely knew these secrets was probably Emperor Changfeng alone.
“If you don’t speak, how do you know I won’t believe?” Han Li said with a cold snort, his gaze turning somewhat unfriendly.
He suspected that Emperor Changfeng wanted to deceive him and that Emperor Changfeng hadn’t yet figured out how to do so, which was why he was avoiding the question.
Emperor Changfeng felt numbed.
He sighed inwardly and then hesitantly said, “I took a nap, and when I woke up, I had survived the Ancient Catastrophe.”
Survived the Ancient Catastrophe with just a nap?
Han Li blinked, increasingly suspecting that Emperor Changfeng was pulling his leg.
If a nap could lead someone through the Ancient Catastrophe, then throughout the endless ages, so many Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, and True Immortals wouldn’t have perished in the Yuankun Domain.
“Great Emperor, you had better tell the truth, or else…” Zimiao Zhen was also somewhat baffled.
What kind of absurd method was this?
She too felt that Emperor Changfeng was making things up and thus spoke out to remind him.
“Changfeng, do you think I’m easy to fool?” Han Li asked with an unfriendly expression, murderous intent lacing his voice.
“Brother Han, Sister Zi, you misunderstand me.
When I woke up, I truly had passed the Ancient Catastropheâ€”this is absolutely true,” Emperor Changfeng quickly explained with an increasingly distressed look.
“My life is in Brother Han’s hands now; how would Changfeng dare to fabricate stories to deceive you?”
Felling Han Li’s murderous intent, Emperor Changfeng continued to explain, his face growing more and more distressed.
“I said earlier that I didn’t know how to say it.
Even if I told you, you wouldn’t believe me…” Emperor Changfeng felt aggrieved.
He was following Han Li’s requests exactly, yet both of them didn’t believe him, thinking he was deceiving them.
But no matter how wronged he felt, he had to endure it, and keep all the bitterness within; he had to make himself clear, as he certainly didn’t want to be wrongly killed in confusion.
As Emperor Changfeng spoke, both Han Li and the Artifact Spirit of the Lightning Boat probed his words and actions, finding no anomaliesâ€” he probably wasn’t lying.
Still not reassured, Han Li’s Divine Sense surged into the Chaos Cauldron he carried with him, descending into the center of the Chaos River.
His Divine Sense took shape, manifesting his figure.
Lu Yao remained in the same posture, her long, jade-like legs on display.
Upon seeing the manifestation of Han Li’s Divine Sense, she muttered with dissatisfaction, “Don’t you have any manners?
At least say hello when you come in.
What if I was changing clothes and you saw?”
Han Li’s mouth twitched.
You’re just an Artifact Spirit, not even a real body, what clothes do you have to change?
Besides, I’m your master.
What’s wrong with looking?
I’d even be up for more.
He wasn’t in the mood for light-heartedness with Lu Yao at that moment, knowing that she often said the opposite of what she meant, a cold and haughty older sister type.
He directly asked, “Did Emperor Changfeng lie?”
As the Artifact Spirit of a Golden Immortal weapon, Lu Yao would surely notice if Emperor Changfeng spoke any falsehoods, with even the slightest bodily or mental reaction or fluctuation unable to escape her eyes.
“No,” Lu Yao said, her voice cold, her face as frosty as ice.
Just as she was about to speak, Han Li’s Divine Sense manifestation voluntarily dissipated, which annoyed Lu Yao even more.
With a slap, she nearly broke the Chaos River in half.
“Damn it~”
Lu Yao was furious.
Ever since the Chaos Cauldron fell into Han Li’s hands, she hadn’t lived a day in peace.

chapters.title: Chapter 737
chapters.content:
Chapter 737: Chapter 280: Slept Through a Major Catastrophe?
The Root of the Decline of Qianyuan Divine Province, The Pitiful Child of a True Immortal_2 Chapter 737: Chapter 280: Slept Through a Major Catastrophe?
The Root of the Decline of Qianyuan Divine Province, The Pitiful Child of a True Immortal_2 Han Li wasn’t idly teasing her; he either had something to ask her or, having got his answer, would leave her behind and walk away.
“It makes me so mad~” Lu Yao clenched her little pink fists, her eyes falling on the Han Li outside, truly wanting to pound him with her fists.
Emperor Changfeng was still grumbling quietly in his aggrieved voice, but Han Li withdrew his Divine Sense and interrupted, “Give me the specifics, like why you were locked inside this great formation, what you saw when you woke up, and what your origins and footsteps in the Ancient Era were like….”
Emperor Changfeng felt as though he had slept through the great calamity of the ancient times, but Han Li felt there were hidden details, which might uncover many secrets.
“Don’t hide anything,” Han Li added.
Emperor Changfeng did not immediately answer but instead said, “I am willing to tell everything in detail.
...
I just have one request, spare my life.”
He knew very well that once he told everything, he would no longer have any value.
Even if it might offend Han Li, he had to secure a promise first.
“Do you really think you’re in a position to bargain with me?” Han Li’s words were sharp, and he was not at all polite.
Emperor Changfeng’s expression fluctuated, and without speaking, just looked at Han Li, seemingly resolved to die rather than yield.
Han Li looked at him deeply and then suddenly laughed, saying, “Rest assured, Daoist Changfeng, if you satisfy me, I won’t make things difficult for you.”
“After all, you have helped me quite a bit.”
Han Li indeed had no intention of troubling Emperor Changfeng too much.
Although Emperor Changfeng had initially directed Lu Tianxiang to trouble him, he had also facilitated his marriage to Lu Tianxiang.
Later, people like Han Yongzhen, Han Yongxiang, and Han Yongji came along, and Emperor Changfeng provided them with many opportunities, though with malicious intent.
If Emperor Changfeng answered his questions without any reservations, it would be a considerable bonus for him.
So while the death penalty could be forgiven, he could not escape punishment for his misdeeds.
Emperor Changfeng could serve the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain for two hundred thousand years; Han Li thought himself to be too lenient.
With Emperor Changfeng’s lifespan, slaving away for Han Mansion for two hundred thousand years would still leave him with tens of thousands of years of life.
By that time, Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain should be teeming with Heavenly Immortals, and even Great Emperors would be as common as dogs.
“Phew~”
Emperor Changfeng breathed a slight sigh of relief, and although he didn’t get a specific promise from Han Li, it seemed there was something to look forward to.
Seeing that Han Li was a man who kept his promises, he hoped that after Han Li had used him and demolished the bridge, he wouldn’t throw him back into the river.
“Since that’s the case, let me take my time to explain to Daoist Han and Purple Daoist.”
“Back in the day, I, Changfeng, although not renowned in the Ancient Era, had origins and footsteps that were no trivial matter….”
Emperor Changfeng got lost in his memories, continuously narrating the highlights of his past and his dreary life confined within the great formation.
Emperor Changfeng kept talking to himself, clearly immersed in his recollections, or perhaps having been alone for too long, he eagerly wanted to pour out all the feelings he had bottled up for over a hundred thousand years.
Han Li paid no attention to Emperor Changfeng, lost in thought.
Zi Miao Zhen saw this and did not disturb Han Li, quietly standing beside him, looking up in admiration, her eyes filled with adoration.
Emperor Changfeng was the descendant of a True Immortal, born at the end of the Ancient Era.
He had just broken through to the Quasi Emperor Realm, and the great calamity of ancient times was about to erupt.
Hence, Emperor Changfeng’s True Immortal father made a decision to seal Emperor Changfeng inside a Supreme Grade Emperor Formation to protect him.
Once the calamity erupted, whether Heaven Imperial Realm emperors, Heavenly or True Immortals, all were destined to die, harvested by Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
The True Immortal instructed Emperor Changfeng to continue cultivating, but before the end of the great calamity of ancient times, he must suppress his realm and must not break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm.
The True Immortal had an important task to attend to and left behind a Top Grade imperial artifact for Emperor Changfeng; after the calamity passed, he could break through and, with a Heaven Imperial Realm imperial artifact in hand, would be invincible.
Back then, Emperor Changfeng was full of vigor and pride, not willing to live meagerly.
Even trapped within the formation, he continued to cultivate tirelessly, as his father, the True Immortal, had left him enough resources to train.
In less than a hundred years, Emperor Changfeng broke through from the first to the pinnacle of the ninth layer of the Quasi Emperor Realm, ready to ascend to the Heaven Imperial Realm and break the Emperor Formation, to go find his True Immortal father and take part in that great affair.
That’s when the unexpected happenedâ€”the True Immortal had left a failsafe which detected Emperor Changfeng’s impeding breakthrough, triggering it and suppressing Emperor Changfeng’s realm, causing him to fall into a deep slumber.
One day, when Xuanshen Sword Mountain revived, brilliant sword lights burst forth, slaying numerous famous emperors, Heavenly Immortals, and True Immortals of the Yuankun Domain.
That day, Qianyuan Divine Province gathered a vast number of True Immortals, Heavenly Immortals, Great Emperors, and Saints, not only from Qianyuan Divine Province but also from the surrounding Thirty-six Divine Provinces and other strong beings from the domains of the Yuankun Domain, all of whom came together in part.
They were there for the same reason: to borrow the might of a broken Golden Immortal Rank formation, uniting all powerful beings to connect thirty-seven Divine Provinces in an attempt to contend with the sword lights of Xuanshen Sword Mountain and survive the great calamity of ancient times.
Unfortunately, they failed; perhaps only by uniting the powers of all Saints and beings above in the Yuankun Domain could they have stood a chance, or they might have been easily killed.
Under the brilliant sword lights of Xuanshen Sword Mountain, the Golden Immortal Rank formation instantly shattered, killing many powerful beings, with the rest scattering to escape.
The collision between the formation and the sword lights caused a huge tumult, a tremendous roar echoing throughout the entire Yuankun Domain, awakening Emperor Changfeng.

chapters.title: Chapter 738
chapters.content:
Chapter 738: Chapter 280: Did He Overcome the Great Calamity Just By Sleeping?
The Root of Decline in Qianyuan Divine Province, The Tragic Son of a True Immortal_3 Chapter 738: Chapter 280: Did He Overcome the Great Calamity Just By Sleeping?
The Root of Decline in Qianyuan Divine Province, The Tragic Son of a True Immortal_3 He saw one saint after another, Great Emperors mercilessly massacred by the sword light, and Heavenly Immortals, who had traversed the Yuankun Domain for eons, were slain by a single streak of sword light, their bodies tumbling down from the ninth heaven.
Emperor Changfeng was thoroughly frightened, no longer possessing the courage he had before his slumber.
He desperately concealed himself, avoiding being detected by the sword light of the Immortal Sword, even forgetting his father’s admonishment, “The sword light will not actively strike those below the Heaven Imperial Realm.”
At that time, Emperor Changfeng was panic-stricken, forgetting everything as he sought only to hide.
He was afraid, with a deep sense of dread in his heart.
His father, with the remnants of a Golden Immortal formation, had gathered a plethora of powerful individuals and the strength of dozens of Divine Provinces only to fail, dying along with his path.
...
The Heavenly Immortals, high above and looking down upon the world, were no match for a single sword light; he would be courting death by going out.
The ancient calamity came quickly and left just as fast, harvesting all the Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, and True Immortals of the Yuankun Domain in a very short period of time before Xuanshen Sword Mountain returned to its peaceful state.
But the entire Yuankun Domain fell into extreme turmoil and chaos in the aftermath of the ancient calamity, with countless ordinary people, weak cultivators, and even powerful cultivators perishing in this human catastrophe.
Because of that clash, Qianyuan Divine Province suffered the most severe damage, with all Dragon Veins completely collapsing and a great number of Spirit Veins shattering, causing a sharp decline in the Spiritual Energy of Qianyuan Divine Province.
The surrounding Thirty-three Divine Provinces were also affected, although to a lesser extent than Qianyuan Divine Province.
This is also the main reason why no Sacred Abyss Realm beings have emerged in Qianyuan Divine Province since the ancient calamity; it was all caused by that collision.
It was only many years after the calamity that Emperor Changfeng managed to break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm.
During that time, his will was dejected, and he lived in a haze, until he finally pulled himself together and advanced to the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Emperor Changfeng underwent his tribulation in the Underground World.
Despite the Emperor Formation concealing him, it still caused quite a stir, and it was known by all the Sacred Lands of Qianyuan Divine Province and other powerful forces throughout the Yuankun Domain.
After some investigation, the Great Holy Land Schools of Qianyuan Divine Province discovered it was Emperor Changfeng undergoing the tribulation, which led to internal strife.
Although Emperor Changfeng was the son of an ancient True Immortal from Bai Yujing, the ruler of Bai Yujing did not wish to release him.
Otherwise, with Emperor Changfeng’s strength, he would have seized his position and power, no longer being able to monopolize all of Bai Yujing’s resources.
So, that ruler of Bai Yujing imprisoned or suppressed those who supported releasing Emperor Changfeng and reached an agreement with Bai Yujing’s Heavenly Immortal soldiers and True Immortal soldiers.
Even though Emperor Changfeng was the son of a True Immortal, according to the rules passed down in Bai Yujing, the Immortal soldiers had to obey the command of the Monarch.
The Monarch of Bai Yujing knew it was impossible to execute Emperor Changfeng, for those Immortal soldiers would surely rebel.
Therefore, the agreement was to let Emperor Changfeng continue to remain within the Emperor Formation and also took away the Imperial weapon and most of his cultivation resources.
This was a stain on the reputation of Bai Yujing’s Monarch, so he executed or erased the memories of those who knew about it, leaving only each generation’s Monarch aware of the affair.
At the end of the Ancient Era, both the White Emperor and Emperor Changfeng were very prominent, both disciples of Bai Yujing.
However, after the outbreak of the great calamity, White Emperor took a portion of Bai Yujing’s foundation and fled to Taibai Divine Province, where he established White Emperor City.
The enmity between Emperor Changfeng and White Emperor stemmed from that event.
Emperor Changfeng wanted to swiftly kill the disloyal White Emperor, who also sought his life, yet Bai Yujing would not allow it.
They had no choice but to send someone to check on the great formation’s seals periodically and to monitor Emperor Changfeng’s condition.
PS: The first update; there will be a second update tonight after I go for a run.

chapters.title: Chapter 739
chapters.content:
Chapter 739: Chapter 281: Han Bapi, the New Chengsheng Mountain, Grand Atmosphere, All Saints Coming to Court!
Elder Han Takes Another Wife_1 Chapter 739: Chapter 281: Han Bapi, the New Chengsheng Mountain, Grand Atmosphere, All Saints Coming to Court!
Elder Han Takes Another Wife_1 “Fellow Daoist Han, I’ve told you everything in great detail, so…”
Somehow, Emperor Changfeng had come back to his senses and asked cautiously.
He wasn’t welcomed back in Bai Yujing, and he didn’t want to return, either.
With the White Emperor dead, his feelings were still rather complex.
The White Emperor was originally a disciple of his father and was like an elder brother to him, and treated him very well.
That was why when the White Emperor betrayed them, he felt both heartache and hatred.
...
In the past, the White Emperor hadn’t participated in that significant event and was kept as a reserve, almost considered the heir to Bai Yujing.
It was a pity the White Emperor harbored wild ambitions and, unbeknownst to others, had obtained a True Immortal weapon and kept it hidden.
Seeing the decline of Qianyuan Divine Province and the many constraints within Bai Yujing, the White Emperor, who was still in the Quasi Emperor Realm at the time, took advantage of the True Immortal weapon to launch a surprise attack on several of Bai Yujing’s key forbidden areas, stealing treasures and fleeing.
These events were all learned by Emperor Changfeng afterwards.
Initially, of course, he sided with Bai Yujing since it was the legacy his father left behind, but later he lost all hope.
Bai Yujing had changed, become unrecognizable to him, otherwise he wouldn’t be trapped here.
His resentment towards the White Emperor dissipated with the White Emperor’s death.
Now, he just wanted to survive, get out, continue cultivating, break through to Heavenly Immortal, and see if there was any chance in the future to fulfill his father’s last wishes.
Han Li’s eyes twinkled, and he said with a smile, “Relax, Fellow Daoist Changfeng.
My word is my bond.
If you don’t believe me, you can ask Zhen’er.”
Emperor Changfeng glanced at Zi Miao Zhen without saying a word; he didn’t dare ask.
“My husband’s word is as good as gold,” Zi Miao Zhen said, her melodious voice gentle and clear.
Emperor Changfeng let out a sigh of relief.
“Fellow Daoist Changfeng, have you ever done any manual labor?” Han Li suddenly asked.
“Manual labor?”
Emperor Changfeng was baffled.
What was manual labor?
Han Li patiently explained it to him.
Emperor Changfeng shook his head and said, “Why should I do manual labor?
If there’s a shortage of Spiritual Energy or Spirit Source for cultivation, then just use Immortal Stones or keep using elixirs.”
As the son of a True Immortal, Emperor Changfeng was among the Yuankun Domain’s top tier Second Gen Immortals and had never lacked cultivation resources.
Han Li nodded, acknowledging that being born into wealth was indeed different.
“Why are you asking this, Fellow Daoist Han?” Emperor Changfeng inquired cautiously, feeling that something was amiss.
“Oh, nothing much.
I just want to hire you to do some work for me,” Han Li said with a full smile, finding the idea of a Heaven Imperial Realm handyman quite appealing.
Emperor Changfeng froze.
As expected,
Han Li wasn’t going to let him off that easily.
He was going to be put to work, toil like an ox or horse.
“How long do you want me to work for you, Fellow Daoist Han?” Emperor Changfeng asked cautiously, his mind a maelstrom of emotions.
Here he was, a top-tier Second Gen Immortal, now fallen from grace and needing to work for someone else.
How pitiable.
“Not long, just four or five hundred thousand years,” Han Li said offhandedly.
“Four or five hundred thousand years?!”
Emperor Changfeng’s breath hitched, leaving him utterly flabbergasted.
He had a total lifespan of only a million years and had already lived over a hundred thousand.
If he were to work for Han Li for four or five hundred thousand years, two-thirds of his life would pass by.
“That’s right, I find Fellow Daoist Changfeng quite suitable,” Han Li remarked with a light smile.
Emperor Changfeng was staggered by this number.
As he came to his senses, he quickly said, “That won’t do at all, Fellow Daoist Han.
That’s just…too long by far.”
Han Li looked at Emperor Changfeng with an indifferent gaze that made the emperor’s scalp tingle and a chill rise in his heart, worrying that Han Li might actually kill him when Han Li spoke up.
“Then let’s make it two hundred thousand years.”
“Isn’t that still a bit…” Emperor Changfeng started, steeling himself.
“Hmm?” Han Li gave him a disapproving glance.
Emperor Changfeng stopped immediately, sighed, and said, “Then it will be as you say, Fellow Daoist.”
He was the fish on the chopping block, without a choice.
Fortunately, he’d haggled a bit and shaved off two or three hundred thousand years.
Otherwise, if he really had to work for Han Li for four or five hundred thousand years, his life would have been bleak.
Han Li smiled in satisfaction.
He’d intentionally thrown out a high number, knowing Emperor Changfeng wouldn’t agree.
After reducing the time, once Emperor Changfeng weighed his options, he’d agree.
If he had offered two hundred thousand years at the start, Emperor Changfeng would still have found it excessive, but compared to four or five hundred thousand years, two hundred thousand would seem short.
“Uhm…fellow Daoist Han, I should be entitled to some form of compensation, right?” Emperor Changfeng spoke up again, still very tentative.
He didn’t want to provoke Han Li further, but for the sake of his cultivation resources, he had to broach the subject.
Otherwise, he might see little progress in his cultivation for the next few hundred thousand years.
“Of course, there is,” Han Li said, his tone shifting, “But don’t expect much.
Fellow Daoist Changfeng, brace yourself.”
Han Li hadn’t planned on providing Emperor Changfeng with much in terms of cultivation resources.
The emperor should be grateful he hadn’t killed him, and yet he was still making demands.
Moreover, with the Spiritual Energy of Chengsheng Mountain so rich, even with few cultivation resources, Emperor Changfeng’s cultivation progress wouldn’t be too slow.
Emperor Changfeng opened his mouth but ended up not voicing his inner thoughts.
Now that Han Li had what he wanted, Emperor Changfeng held little value.
Continuing to haggle would only bring misfortune upon himself.
Seeing that Emperor Changfeng had no objections, Han Li’s Human Path Sword slid out half an inch from its sheath at his waist, the dazzling sword light easily shattered the nine-colored light barrier.
Trapped for over a hundred thousand years, upon his release, Emperor Changfeng felt a weight lift off his shoulders and had the urge to burst into loud laughter, but he did not make a sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 740
chapters.content:
Chapter 740: Chapter 281: Han Bapi, the New Chengsheng Mountain, Grand Atmosphere, All Saints Coming to Court!
Elder Han Takes Another Wife_2 Chapter 740: Chapter 281: Han Bapi, the New Chengsheng Mountain, Grand Atmosphere, All Saints Coming to Court!
Elder Han Takes Another Wife_2 Han Li and Zi Miaozhen were still nearby, so he couldn’t afford to get carried away, nor did he have any other ideas.
Han Li’s strength was much greater than his; that Immortal Sword was at least suspected to be of True Immortal caliber, capable of shattering a massive array in the Heaven Imperial Realm with just a wisp of its might.
“Let’s go.”
With Zi Miaozhen in his arms, Han Li unleashed his vast ocean-like mana and left, taking Emperor Changfeng with him.
………..
In the blink of an eye, ten days had passed.
...
On this day, Chengsheng Mountain was bustling with extraordinary excitement, gathering many powerful individuals from the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of the Yuankun Domain.
Saints, Quasi Emperors, and Great Emperors mingled and exchanged pleasantries, all there to congratulate the newlyweds.
Ever since his cultivation had broken through to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, Han Li had used his great mana and divine powers to reshape the topography of Chengsheng Mountain.
Now, the Chengsheng Mountain range stretched over three million miles, with one main peak and one thousand seven hundred and sixty-four sub-peaks.
A thousand mountains stood tall, densely packed around the main peak, forming a supreme Immortal Array.
The main peak was Chengdao Peak, towering three million six hundred thousand zhang high.
Among the sub-peaks, there were thirty-six peaks one million zhang high, seventy-two peaks five hundred thousand zhang high, three hundred and sixty peaks two hundred thousand zhang high, and one thousand two hundred and ninety-six peaks one hundred thousand zhang high.
Under Han Li’s meticulous craftsmanship, the current Chengsheng Mountain already possessed the grandeur of a ruler-level force in the Yuankun Domain.
The entire mountain range exuded a majestic and magnificent presence; divine birds soared and spiraled, spiritual beasts roamed and neighed, countless spiritual medicines and spirit fields spread far and wide, and the concentration of spiritual energy was frightfully high.
Han Li did all this not only to give the Chengsheng Mountain face, but also to prepare for his marriage.
Today, he was to wed Yang Zhiyun, the Ninth Princess of the Solar Empire, but this was merely a small taste of what was to come.
The real highlights would follow with his weddings to Qin Shiyin, Feng Mian, as well as the two peerless empresses, Huang Hongshang and Yuan Weiyang.
For these four women, Han Li would offer the most profound and grandest of wedding ceremonies.
Doing so would allow Qin Shiyin, Feng Mian, Huang Hongshang, and Yuan Weiyang to feel honored and ensure that Chengsheng Mountain’s reputation remained intact, especially since the mountain had changed dramatically from before.
As for those concubines married earlier, especially the earliest consorts such as Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, and the earliest wives like Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, Han Li also planned to hold a grand wedding ceremony for them.
Was this to be fair and just?
No, it was to collect countless wedding gifts.
When the time came, those former wives and concubines who wished to participate would all be wedded by Han Li on the same day, followed by their entrance into the bridal chamber.
Having made such grand and solemn preparations, the other forces of the Yuankun Domain would surely pay respects and offer their most precious congratulatory gifts.
As for those who didn’t bring gifts?
Han Li estimated that no force in the Yuankun Domain would dare such a thing.
“Ancient ancestor, I’ve truly worried myself to pieces for you all.”
At the summit of Chengdao Peak, Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, watching as guests converged from all directions.
Countless cloud boats, sky ships, and painted barges filled the heavens and the earth.
He murmured softly to himself.
For the well-being of his wives and concubines, for their cultivation resources, and for the cultivation resources of their descendants, he had no choice but to resort to such means to scrape together the wealth of the Yuankun Domain.
The Yuankun Domain was about to enter a comparatively peaceful era.
Without the threat of external enemies, the descendants of the Han Mansion, numbering in the millions, would surge at an astonishing pace.
If he didn’t strive to gather resources, how would he provide for the welfare and happiness of his descendants?
How could he allow them to lead a joyous life and then happily proliferate?
As the ruler of the Yuankun Domain, he certainly had other means to accumulate wealth, but none were as quickly lucrative as this covert form of plundering.
To overtly plunder would lead to grievances over time, which would not be conducive to the development of the numerous branches of Han Mansion.
By collecting wealth through marriage, there was at least some justification, and it wouldn’t lead to the destruction of any forces or cause any to drain their resources completely; besides, he would also gain the most beautiful and talented female cultivators as his consorts…
It was truly killing several birds with one stone.
Seeing that the time was about right, Han Li finally made his appearance.
He received the countless guests who had come to participate in the wedding ceremony in the newly enshrined Yundao Hall.
When he appeared, the entire hall fell silent in an instant, and all eyes were drawn to Han Li.
Han Li stood at the deepest part of the hall, his gaze sweeping across the entire room.
Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm were seated in the front rows, followed by the Quasi Emperors, and then the Saints.
As for practitioners of the Tongxuan Realm?
They had no right to enter Yundao Hall and could only sit outside the hall, equally silent and subdued; no one dared to speak.
Han Li was very pleased with this, his only regret being that the peerless empresses Yuan Weiyang and Huang Hongshang, as well as the Heavenly Immortal-ranked women emperors of the Heavenly Rankings, had not come.
Indeed, many Quasi Empresses and Female Saints had arrived, most of them possessing majestic beauty, with graceful figures, elegant postures, and distinct temperaments.
As for why the Heaven Imperial Realm Empresses, including Yuan Weiyang and Huang Hongshang, did not come, Han Li naturally knew the reason.
These Heaven Imperial Realm Empresses all knew what kind of person Han Li was, and that they could not escape his Devil’s Palm; in the future, they were bound to become one of Han Li’s spouses, whether they liked it or not.
Considering this, why would they come to partake in Han Li’s wedding ceremony?
Would that not be adding trouble for themselves?
Therefore, Yuan Weiyang, Huang Hongshang, and other Heaven Imperial Realm Empresses stayed comfortably within their own powers, waiting for Han Li to come and propose marriage.
They only sent their subordinates to present gifts and participate in the wedding ceremony.
The Female Saints and Quasi Empresses, however, were not so easy-going.
Although they might also be chosen by Han Li, coming to Chengsheng Mountain felt like walking into a trap.
But for the sake of their future blissful lives and the chance to gain higher status and better benefits at Chengsheng Mountain, they dared not miss participating.
Now that Chengsheng Mountain was open, many secret messages had also spread.
Quasi Empress Yuan Youwei was a warning from the past.
“I thank all of you for participating in Han’s wedding ceremony….”
Han Li spoke sincerely with the usual formalities, for he was genuinely grateful, considering that everyone present had brought him a significant gift.
This was the first time Han Li hosted a wedding ceremony facing the entire Yuankun Domain.
Although it was a mere practice of his powers, all forces took it very seriously and sent many precious treasures.
“Ladies and gentlemen, please be seated.”
Finally, with a wave of Han Li’s hands, all the Great Emperors, Quasi Emperors, and Saints involuntarily sat down, each facing a jade table filled with delicacies from mountains and seas, as well as exquisite food and drinks.
Yet no one had the appetite; they were all too stunned by Han Li’s gesture of motioning them to sit.
In attendance were dozens of Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, hundreds of Quasi Emperors, and tens of thousands of Saints from the Saint Yuan Realm, and they had all been compelled to sit down by just a mere gesture from Han Li.
This level of power and control was simply shocking, beyond what even ordinary Heavenly Immortals were capable of.
At that moment, everyone felt deep reverence in their hearts.
The Great Emperor Changfeng truly deserved to be the most formidable entity in the Yuankun Domain, with combat power that ruled it unquestionably.
The Solar Emperor and Emperor Tianji had personally come this time, representing their respective forces, seated in the first row to Han Li’s right.
At this moment, they both harbored immensely complex feelings.
Han Li’s power seemed to have made substantial progress since he had successfully transcended his tribulation.
Was this the unparalleled genius who had survived the ninety-nine heavenly tribulations, the peerless talent of the Yuankun Domain unmatched in both the past and present?
They too were exceptional geniuses, but under Han Li’s shining brilliance, they paled, like fireflies to the bright moon.
Moreover, the Solar Emperor and Emperor Tianji were no longer supreme rulers.
They had renounced the title themselves.
With the invincible Han Li present, how could they dare to call themselves “the ultimate”?
There was now only one Supreme in the Yuankun Domain, and that was Han Li.
The two thought back to Emperor Bai, who truly had a divine strategy, calling Han Li “Supreme in the Path of Survival” at their first meeting.
Had he foreseen this?
Unfortunately, Emperor Bai had failed to foresee his own demise at the hands of Han Li.
“Congratulations to the Supreme for marrying a beautiful bride~”
The Solar Emperor and Emperor Tianji were the first to speak, offering their congratulations.
Other Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, Quasi Emperors, and Saints also spoke in turn, offering their congratulatory phrases.
They had already communicated through their Divine Sense in advance, so their words were quite coordinated.
“My gratitude to all fellow daoists,” replied Han Li, without moving, simply lowering his eyelids.
At that moment, the bride Yang Zhiyun was escorted in, and Han Li went through the wedding ceremony with her, officially taking her as his wife.
Subsequently, Yang Zhiyun was sent to the pre-arranged bridal chamber, while Han Li continued to entertain guests and drink merrily before leisurely making his way to the nuptial chamber.
A single night of spring is worth a thousand gold!
PS: The second update is complete.
Continue the sprint tomorrow, aiming for a daily ten thousand.

Chapter 741: Chapter 282: Treasure Chest Explosion: Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure!
Han Mansion on the Verge of Boiling, Mass Producing Heavenly Immortals?_1 Chapter 741: Chapter 282: Treasure Chest Explosion: Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure!
Han Mansion on the Verge of Boiling, Mass Producing Heavenly Immortals?_1 At dawn,
the first ray of morning light burst forth between heaven and earth,
and Han Li had also become light, completing his morning routine.
Exhausted from being tossed around all night, Yang Zhiyun had fallen into a deep sleep.
The smooth, jade-like beauty of her back, her flawless figure, those long and straight legs, her heavy conscience, and that delicate and stunning face were all captured in Han Li’s gaze.
At this moment, he had become a saint on earth, engaged in daily self-reflection, seeing every peerless beauty as nothing more than a beautiful skeleton.
Afterwards, Han Li glanced at Yang Zhiyun, intending to leave, but then he thought twice and stayed.
...
As the Ninth Princess of the Solar Empire, Yang Zhiyun was surely blessed with immense luck.
Han Li had planned to open a treasure chest on this occasion, hoping to find something valuable.
But this little temptress was too alluring and quite proactive, letting Han Li experiment with postures, which led to him being busy with the “main event” from evening till morning.
Now that Yang Zhiyun was asleep from fatigue, it was time for him to continue his unfinished business with the treasure chest.
With a single thought, the treasure chest page appeared before Han Li’s eyes.
“Ding~ Master, you still have one free chance to open a treasure chest this month.
Would you like to use it?”
“Use it,” Han Li replied without a hint of hesitation.
The next instant, the lavish treasure chest bloomed with limitless golden light, and a treasure emerged from the chest, floating in the air, stirring boundless anticipation.
“Ding~ The treasure chest has been successfully opened.
Congratulations to the Master for obtaining a True Immortal Rank treasure, the Promotion Card!”
Han Li’s pupils shrank slightly, and a look of shock appeared on his calm face.
This month’s free chance to open a treasure chest had been a bullseye!
A True Immortal Rank Promotion Card!
This was an invaluable treasure.
Han Li had obtained one before and used it to evolve the Emperor Flag from a Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon into a True Immortal Weapon, becoming the strongest True Immortal Weapon in the Yuankun Domain.
Now that he had obtained another True Immortal Rank Promotion Card, he could thoroughly satisfy those little temptresses; whoever pleased him the most would receive it.
The Thousand Dao Immortal Technique circulated, and Han Li’s somewhat hurried breathing calmed down.
He took another look at Yang Zhiyun, his face filled with a smile as he stared at the sleeping beauty.
If it weren’t for Yang Zhiyun having already fallen unconscious, he would definitely have woken her up to reward her properly ten times.
Shifting his gaze away, Han Li continued to focus on the treasure chest panel, ready to keep up the effort.
Subsequent openings of the treasure chest would require the consumption of cultivation energy, but Han Li didn’t care.
Having obtained a True Immortal Rank Promotion Card this month, he was already ahead.
The gorgeous treasure chest shone with golden light.
“Ding, the treasure chest has been successfully opened.
Congratulations to the Master for obtaining a True Immortal Rank treasure, the Promotion Card.”
As the system notification sounded, Han Li’s accumulated cultivation energy was consumed by a year’s worth, yet he was taken aback.
A second True Immortal Rank Promotion Card!
Was this a burst of great fortune?
His luck had never seemed this good before.
At that moment, Han Li felt an urge to go fishing.
The Thousand Realm Fishing Event refreshed every ten years, and until now he had only used the first three fishing rods, with seven more Karma Fishing Rods yet to be utilized.
The fourth rod was a green one, capable of fishing out Quasi Immortal Monarch level treasures from the Thousand Realm Ocean, requiring a thousand years of cultivation to use.
The fifth rod could fetch Immortal Monarch level treasures, the sixth rod could catch Quasi Immortal King level treasures…
Back then, after fishing up treasures three times in a row, Han Li had hesitated to continue, fearing a reverse-fishing situation would lead to a huge waste of cultivation.
Now, after so much time, he was at the peak of his fortune, which might allow him to fish up Quasi Immortal Monarch level treasures or even Immortal Monarch level treasures in one go.
After brief contemplation, Han Li decided to abandon this wildly bold idea.
It was better to stick to opening treasure chests.
With a thought, Han Li used five years of cultivation and opened the treasure chest.
“Ding, the treasure chest has been successfully opened.
Congratulations to the Master for obtaining a Heaven Immortal Rank treasure, the Promotion Card!”
Han Li blinked, finding it somewhat unbelievable.
Another Promotion Card.
Was it challenging him today?
However, this was only a Heaven Immortal Rank Promotion Card, which left Han Li slightly disappointed.
If it wanted to challenge him, what use was a Heaven Immortal Rank Promotion Card?
He wanted a Golden Immortal Rank or even an Immortal Monarch Rank Promotion Card.
“Huff~”
Exhaling a long breath, Han Li didn’t continue to open more treasure chests but instead conjured a basin of clear water to wash his face and then his hands.
He had been favored by fortune just moments ago, but the fickle goddess had quickly changed allegiance, resulting in him obtaining only a Heaven Immortal Rank treasure.
Luckily, he hadn’t given into impulse to fish in the Thousand Realm event, or he might have ended up with nothing, a total loss.
After completing these tasks, Han Li resumed opening the treasure chest.
On his fourth attempt at opening the chest, he spent ten years of cultivation and obtained a True Martial Realm treasure, the Serpent Blood Lotus.
On the fifth try, he spent fifty years of cultivation and acquired a Quasi Emperor Realm treasure, the Blazing Thunder Fist.
….
On the eighth attempt, after spending a thousand years of cultivation, he obtained a Tongxuan Realm treasure, the Tongxuan Pill.
Han Li looked at the treasure chest panel with an expressionless face; the earlier joy had vanished without a trace, leaving him quite irritated.
After five consecutive attempts at the chest, having spent more than a thousand years of cultivation, he ended up with a bunch of junkâ€”the highest being Quasi Emperor Rank, the lowest being a set of ten pairs of black and white stockings fished out during the sixth attempt.
They were Hollow Void Stage level treasures, woven from Heavenly Spider Silk; Han Li found them utterly useless.
Over the years, as his artifact refining skills improved, he had collected many high-grade materials like Cloud Brocade and Heavenly Spider Silk to craft many intimate garments, naturally including various colors of stockings.
Looking at the treasure chest panel, Han Li was in a quandary, wondering whether to continue opening chests.
