Chapter 742: Chapter 282: Treasure Chest Explosion: Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure!
Han Mansion on the Verge of Boiling, Mass Producing Heavenly Immortals?_2 Chapter 742: Chapter 282: Treasure Chest Explosion: Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure!
Han Mansion on the Verge of Boiling, Mass Producing Heavenly Immortals?_2 The next time I open a treasure chest, it will consume five thousand years of cultivation.
The first two times he opened treasure chests, his luck was at its peak, but on the third time, his luck began to decline, and afterwards, it turned abysmal.
However, Han Li didn’t believe it and opened it five times in a row, only to witness disastrous results.
“Keep opening, your bad luck has been exhausted, and the next time will bring a reversal of fortune, and you will definitely unlock a powerful immortal treasure,”
“Don’t do it, you’re just unlucky.
Give up; opening it will only waste your cultivation.
...
You won’t get any good treasures.
Are you really willing to consume five thousand years of cultivation?”
It was as if there were two little people talking in Han Li’s mind, constantly arguing and filling his mind with all sorts of thoughts.
A ray of immortal light flashed by, cutting off all distractions, and Han Li’s Daoist heart became calm again, without a ripple.
With a thought, he directly opened this month’s ninth treasure chest.
Five thousand years of cultivation were instantly consumed.
This time, however, the magnificent treasure chest didn’t open instantly.
Instead, it opened sluggishly, with strand after strand of immortal light bursting forth, casting infinite and wondrous visions.
Han Li’s pupils contracted, and his heartbeat accelerated involuntarily.
It seemed he had made the right gamble!
This time’s treasure chest opening was completely different from the previous ones.
Han Li stared fixedly at the gradually opening treasure chest before him, forgetting the passage of time.
“Ding~ Treasure chest successfully opened, congratulations to the master for obtaining an Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure, the [Tianquan Creation Furnace]!”
“Hiss!”
Han Li took a sharp intake of spiritual energy, contributing to the warming of Chengsheng Mountain.
“I actually unlocked an Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure?”
Han Li’s expression was somewhat dreamy, feeling too surreal.
You must know that the highest grade treasure he had unlocked before was only at the True Immortal rank.
Above the True Immortal rank is the Golden Immortal Rank, followed by the Quasi Immortal Monarch Rank, and then the Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure.
According to the rules of the treasure chest, the probability of unlocking a True Immortal Rank treasure for the first time is 5%, and with each opening, the probability increases by 5%.
And the probability of unlocking a Golden Immortal Rank treasure for the first time is one in two hundred, while unlocking an Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure for the first time is one in twenty thousand.
Even with eight accumulations, the probability of unlocking an Immortal Monarch Rank treasure on the ninth attempt is pitifully small, less than one in two thousand.
“This is great!”
Coming back to his senses, Han Li shouted in surprise, his face full of excitement.
He really did unlock an Immortal Monarch Rank treasure.
Regardless of whether the [Tianquan Creation Furnace] was for offense, defense, or support, Han Li was extremely happy.
This was his first Immortal Monarch Rank treasure.
After the excitement, Han Li’s emotions calmed down.
He glanced at Yang Zhiyun, who had not yet woken up, and then disappeared from the spot.
Han Li’s figure appeared on the summit of Chengdao Peak, toying with a jade cauldron in his hands.
It was the Tianquan Creation Furnace!
The furnace’s outer walls were etched with countless Heavenly Path Runes, and the inner walls were etched with countless Creation Runes, carrying a part of the Heavenly Path and the profound truths of the Immortal Monarch level.
After communicating with the Artifact Spirit of the Tianquan Creation Furnace, Han Li gained a deep understanding of this Immortal Monarch Rank treasure.
This was an auxiliary type of immortal weapon, with effects somewhat overlapping with those of the Life-Prolonging Furnace but far more powerful.
Moreover, the Tianquan Creation Furnace also had a feature that Han Li had been anticipating.
That is, the Tianquan Creation Furnace can also endow ordinary people with cultivation talent!
He hadn’t expected to receive an immortal treasure that could grant cultivation talent to mortals so soon.
He thought it would take much longer, and he had the patience to wait.
Previously, Han Li had executed a decentralization strategy, sending over half of the Han Mansion’s descendants throughout the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of Yuankun Domain.
The remaining descendants all lived on Chengsheng Mountain, including those over 210,000 without any talent.
Without talent, it means they cannot cultivate, and even if they used Lifespan Extension Pills, they could at most live for a hundred or so years.
Therefore, Han Li didn’t make these descendants undertake a long journey to settle outside of Qianyuan Divine Province.
Because once those descendants left, they would basically have no chance of coming back.
Another reason, of course, was that Han Li considered that in the future, he might unlock a treasure like the Tianquan Creation Furnace, which would enable over two hundred thousand descendants to develop cultivation talent.
Looking at the mortal descendants scattered across Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li’s face wore an even brighter smile.
With the Tianquan Creation Furnace, these descendants would gradually develop cultivation talent, and in time, the Han Mansion’s genetic makeup would be thoroughly optimized to become a “perfect” cultivation family.
Once these over two hundred thousand descendants acquired talent, they would step onto the path of cultivation, and as their realms increased, they could continuously feed back cultivation to him.
As they multiplied and continuously produced talented offspring, they could also feed back even more talent to Han Li.
“Immortal Monarch Rank treasures are indeed too powerful,”
Han Li opened the information page of the Tianquan Creation Furnace, looking at its powerful abilities, he couldn’t help but exclaim.
Tianquan Creation Furnace: An Immortal Monarch Rank supreme treasure, it bears part of the Heavenly Path and the profound truths of creation, with four major auxiliary effects, and its offensive and defensive powers are only equivalent to that of a Quasi Immortal Monarch soldier.
The first auxiliary effect: Birth of Talent.
The grand tally for number fifty, uses forty-nine, escape the one, and here is the line of fate.
Bathed in the immortal light of the Heavenly Path and creation, it enables ordinary people to randomly acquire cultivation talent, with a minimum of Ninth Grade and a maximum of top first-grade Immortal Rank.
This effect can be activated once a month, allowing a maximum of one thousand people to use it at a time.
The second auxiliary effect: Enhancement of Talent
Bathed in the immortal light of the Heavenly Path and creation, it can enhance the cultivation talent of a cultivator, up to a maximum of second-grade Immortal Rank.
Each cultivator can only use this three times in their lifetime.
This effect can be activated once a month, allowing a maximum of one person to use it each time.

chapters.title: Chapter 743
chapters.content:
Chapter 743: Chapter 282: Treasure Chest Explosion: Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure!
Han Mansion on the Verge of Boiling, Mass Producing Heavenly Immortals?_3 Chapter 743: Chapter 282: Treasure Chest Explosion: Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure!
Han Mansion on the Verge of Boiling, Mass Producing Heavenly Immortals?_3 The third auxiliary effect: Enhancing Physique
Bathing in the celestial light of creation can enhance cultivators’ special physiques, with the highest enhancement being to a Heavenly Immortal Body.
Each cultivator can only use this effect three times in their lifetime.
This effect can be activated once a month, and at most one person can use it each time.
The fourth auxiliary effect: Assisting Breakthroughs
Entering the space within the Tianquan Creation Furnace can assist cultivators in breaking through Big Realms, increasing the chances of breakthrough by thirty percent, up to the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
This effect, depending on the realm, has varying numbers of times it can be activated and the number of users.
...
To break through to the Heavenly Immortal Realm, it is available once a year, for one person each time.
To break through to the Heaven Imperial Realm, it is available ten times a year, for two people each time.
To break through to the Quasi Emperor Realm, it is available a hundred times a year, for three people each time.
….
Note: All auxiliary functions of the Tianquan Creation Furnace, as well as its use to attack and defend against enemies, require the provision of corresponding Immortal Tao Energy.
“Indeed, an Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure,” Han Li exclaimed once again.
With the Tianquan Creation Furnace, an Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure, Chengsheng Mountain Han Mansion could now rise to become a family of Immortal Dao, capable of consistently producing Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals.
From then on, the descendants of Han Mansion basking in the celestial light of creation, optimizing their genes, would all be born with cultivation talent.
After some years have passed and all of Han Mansion’s mortal descendants have used it up, some adjustments could be made, such as selecting handsome men and beautiful women from the entire Yuankun Domain to continuously replenish Han Mansion with fresh blood.
The handsome men would marry into Han Mansion, and the beautiful women would marry the descendants of Han Mansion, enabling these handsome men and beautiful women to possess cultivation talent and be provided with some cultivation resources.
However, Han Li had no plans to open up the last two functions to outsiders.
These two functions could create Immortal Grade talent and Immortal Bodies; each year, only twelve people could use them, and Han Li had to be extremely cautious in selecting candidates.
Most of his beloved wives and distinguished descendants would not have their turn in the early stages and would have to wait in line patiently.
Compared to their lifespans, this waiting time was not long, as they would eventually have their turn.
These two functions also formed the core of Han Mansion becoming a family of Immortal Dao.
As long as Han Mansion continuously produced Immortal Bodies and Immortal Grade talents, coupled with the cultivation resources provided by Han Mansion and the fourth function, they could essentially guarantee the birth of Heavenly Immortals.
As for the fourth function, it was also very practical and defied the natural order.
Han Li planned to make this open for use.
Not only could the descendants of Han Mansion use it, but also the protectors, Guest Elders, and so on, even everyone in the Yuankun Domain could use it.
Of course, there would be preference based on closeness; different statuses required different conditions to use this function.
For example, the descendants on Han Mansion’s key and core cultivation lists, as well as Han Li’s wives and some favored concubines, could use it without any conditions.
Other descendants and ordinary concubines would need to consume a certain number of contribution points to use this function.
Guest Elders and protectors of Han Mansion who are from outside lines and wish to use this function must not only consume a large amount of contribution points but also need the corresponding privileges.
For cultivators from outside Chengsheng Mountain Han Mansion, whether they are cultivators from kinship forces or not, the cultivation resources they need to provide to use this function would also vary.
This function was incredibly against the natural order, as it could increase the chance of breaking through Big Realms by thirty percent.
Coupled with Realm Breaking Pills, breakthroughs could be basically assured.
Although it was also available to outsiders, it would not harm Han Mansion because the highest enhancement it could assist was a breakthrough to the Heavenly Immortal Realm from the Heaven Imperial Realm.
On the contrary, by leveraging this function, Han Mansion could gather numerous cultivation resources, thus helping the descendants of Han Mansion accelerate their cultivation.
PS: There’s also a second update to come, hoping to reach 6000 words.

chapters.title: Chapter 744
chapters.content:
Chapter 744: Chapter 283: Re-Entering the Xuxian Realm, the Spiritual Sea, the Grand Gathering at Five Immortal City, Arrival at Fire Qilin Cave_1 Chapter 744: Chapter 283: Re-Entering the Xuxian Realm, the Spiritual Sea, the Grand Gathering at Five Immortal City, Arrival at Fire Qilin Cave_1 The first and fourth functions of the Tianquan Creation Furnace can easily be determined for appropriate users, but the second and third functions, that’s a different story.
If he doesn’t handle it well, he might just end up creating a battlefield of carnage.
Both of these functions were evaluated by Han Li at their limits, meaning he would only use them to help cultivators enhance their aptitude to Immortal Grade, evolving into Immortal Bodies.
Given that the second and third effects can only be used twelve times a year, Han Li had no choice but to make the most of them.
Both ascending to first-grade aptitude and birthing special constitutions could be achieved through the Life-Prolonging Furnace, and Han Li could lend his aid, evolving a King Body into an Emperor Body.
Because the annual usage is so limited, even Han Li can’t distribute the opportunities evenly.
Therefore, he decided to pair the two functions together for use.
...
In this way, those who were given the opportunity to bathe in the celestial light of creation would not only have their aptitudes enhanced to Immortal Grade but would also evolve their physique from Emperor Body to Immortal Body, directly forging unparalleled geniuses.
Thus, the selection for these twelve annual spots becomes of utmost importance, and the slightest edge can turn into a whirlwind.
Currently, there are still dozens of descendants within Han Mansion who possess both first-grade aptitudes and Emperor Bodies, and there are also quite a few such individuals among Han Li’s lovely wives and concubines.
Han Li felt a headache coming on and decided to deal with this matter after returning from the Xuxian Realm.
With that in mind, Han Li’s figure flashed into the Tiansheng Realm, where he placed the Gate of the Xuxian Realm, designating a specific area for it.
Upon the vast plains stood a hundred-zhang-tall gateway between heaven and earth, its frame adorned with countless Immortal Runes, and engraved with the figures of three Void Phoenixes.
The Void Phoenix is a rare species among the phoenix clan, extremely adept in the Way of Space and the Mind.
With the Void Phoenix as a guide, one can enter the Xuxian Realm.
The gate to the Xuxian Realm was a treasure Han Li acquired during his time in the Holy Abyss Realm.
He had entered it once before, only to hastily retreat after a brief exploration.
The reason was simple: the realm was too dangerous, bringing together innumerable prodigies and freaks of nature from the twelve thousand nine hundred and sixty domains of the Tai Chu Realm, all fiercely vying against one another.
At that time, Han Li’s strength was only middling at best within the Xuxian Realm, and with his cautious nature, he preferred not to take risksâ€”instead choosing to bide his time until his strength sufficed to dominate.
Over the years, the gate to the Xuxian Realm was rarely opened, as opening it without True Immortal Realm power would consume a significant amount of Immortal Tao Energy.
Han Li, who in the past wouldn’t dare squander Immortal Tao Energy so freely, had less than ten descendants in Han Mansion qualified to gain experience in the Xuxian Realm.
Now that Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion had sufficient Immortal Tao Energy, and with more descendants reaching the Tongxuan Realm, the gate could be opened more frequently.
Allowing those outstanding descendants to enter the realm for experience and adventure, accumulate fame, seize opportunities, while also covertly gathering intelligence about the Tai Chu Realm.
Of course, all the Han Mansion descendants who entered the Xuxian Realm concealed their origins; at most, they would claim to be from Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion, never revealing their connection to Yuankun Domain.
Since ancient times, it’s been said within Yuankun Domain that those with Golden Immortal Realm power or power on par with Golden Immortals can use the three ancient paths on Xuanshen Sword Mountain to travel to the boundless worlds beyond.
Han Li’s instruction for descendants like Han Yongqian and Han Yongzhen to hide their origins was also out of fear that the strong Golden Immortals and Immortal Lords from other domains within the Tai Chu Realm might cross over.
If that happened, the hard-won peace of Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion would be broken again, and Han Li did not want the constant threat of a heaven-sundering blade over his head, regardless of whether it would fall.
Looking at the Xuxian Realm gate shrouded in dense immortal light before him, Han Li’s gaze flickered as he prepared to open the gate.
“Let me see if my current strength can support the opening of the Xuxian Realm gate.”
The Thousand Path Scripture inside him circulated, a surging wave of immortal power instantly boiled, flowing into the gate, and lighting it up progressively, with the immortal light growing increasingly radiant, countless Immortal Runes erupting, and the three Void Phoenixes becoming visible.
With an endless enhancement of Immortal Runes applied to the three Void Phoenixes, they soared against the sky lights, and a Heaven-reaching Road unfolded, dazzlingly opening as if to pierce through the heavens.
The smile on Han Li’s face soon solidified, and he slightly furrowed his brows, sighing, “Indeed, my cultivation is still insufficient.”
Currently residing at the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, he cultivated a True Immortal Rank Cultivation Technique and possessed the Thousand Path Immortal Body, with his mana having been prematurely transformed into immortal power.
Now, his mana was comparable to the peak of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, his Combat Ability was also at the pinnacle of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and after activating his Divine Sense, his Combat Ability could just barely step into the domain of True Immortals.
However, he was not a True Immortal after all.
The mana of True Immortals is purer than that of Heavenly Immortals, and even a first layer True Immortal has far more mana reserves than a Heavenly Immortal.
As a result, with his own immortal power activating the gate, the Heaven-reaching Road only extended about one-fifth of the way.
All thoughts disappearing in a flash, Han Li directly consumed a mass of Immortal Tao Energy, causing the gate to brighten significantly more, with the Heaven-reaching Road expanding at a rapid pace, swiftly piercing through the heavens and leading to a place of profound mystery.
Han Li divided a strand of his Primordial Spirit’s light into form, stepping into the gate, and traversing the celestial pathway, entering the Xuxian Realm.
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back at the forefront of the Heaven-reaching Road, which continued to stretch onward.
This place was only the periphery of the Xuxian Realm, filled with ethereal mist, enigmatic and obscure.
The hazy mist at the fringe of the Xuxian Realm created an aura of profound mystery, impressive to any observer.
Should cultivators from the Divine Yuan Realm, the Tongxuan Realm, or the Holy Abyss Realm come here, they would see nothing clear, feeling only a vague presence all around, as if they were within the Chaos World.

chapters.title: Chapter 745
chapters.content:
Chapter 745: Chapter 283: Re-Entering the Xuxian Realm, the Spiritual Sea, the Grand Gathering at Five Immortal City, Arrival at Fire Qilin Cave_2 Chapter 745: Chapter 283: Re-Entering the Xuxian Realm, the Spiritual Sea, the Grand Gathering at Five Immortal City, Arrival at Fire Qilin Cave_2 With Han Li’s strength, he naturally could peer into the true nature of this place.
This was actually a sea, a spiritual sea, existing in attachment to the Immortal Realm, and also one of the most dangerous places within it.
Without formidable strength, it would be best not to enter the spiritual sea, otherwise one’s primordial spirit incarnation could be worn away, which could endanger reality, causing at the very least heavy damage and mental confusion to the primordial spirit, or at worst its complete obliteration.
Han Li was undaunted by the spiritual sea, but he had no desire to explore it now.
His goal for the day was to enter the interior of the Immortal Realm.
Han Li looked ahead, the mist and haze unable to obstruct his vision.
He saw a vast and magnificent world, emanating an ancient and vast aura.
...
Within this majestic world were innumerable grand palaces and Immortal Halls, with Divine Mountains and Immortal Peaks rising everywhere.
Each site shone brilliantly and prospered, inhabited by powerful cultivators.
“Where did the Immortal Realm actually come from?” Han Li’s gaze flickered as he thought of certain rumors about the Immortal Realm.
Some said the Immortal Realm was opened up by a Great Divine Power using an innate spirit root as the foundation, others claimed it was naturally born during the creation of the world, and yet others believed the Immortal Realm was a spiritual world jointly constructed by ancient immortals…
The origins of the Immortal Realm were extremely ancient, having existed even before the Longhan Heavenly Court, and the Crimson Heaven Court, established afterward, didn’t do anything to it either.
If it was created by someone, how high must that creator’s cultivation have been, to construct a spiritual world covering the Taichu Realm, accommodating countless prodigies and monsters, through endless ages?
The Immortal Realm had existed for countless years and was well known to most beings in the Taichu Realm.
Only a Domain like the Yuankun Domain, which was isolated and even had gaps in ancient history, was unaware of it.
There were several methods of entering the Immortal Realm, with entry through the Gate of the Immortal Realm being just one of them.
Some Domains paid homage to the Immortal Realm year-round and were thereby recognized by the Immortal Realm.
When a cultivator of such a Domain reached the Divine Yuan Realm, they would become attuned to the Immortal Realm, thus being able to enter and exit it.
As Han Li pondered, the path of Heavenly Immortal spread to the Immortal Realm, the surrounding obscure mist dissipated, revealing a bright and vast world.
In front of Han Li was a huge Jade Stone platform, shimmering with immortal light and brimming with Immortal Runes.
He walked in carelessly.
He looked around and noticed that there was no difference compared to the first time he entered.
The descendants of Han Mansion entering from the Immortal Realm within the Tiansheng Realm would all arrive here, serving as a “station” for respite.
In the center of the platform was an altar imbued with mysterious rune power.
Any creature stepping onto it would be transferred inside the Immortal Realm.
Han Li’s gaze penetrated the barrier, seeing the outside of the Immortal Realm.
He did not attempt to force his way in.
His strength was not yet at the level to break the rules of the Immortal Realm, and there was no need to do so.
Proceeding step by step was enough.
Han Li approached the altar.
The numerous runes carved upon it lit up simultaneously, forming layers of Immortal Runes which then transported Han Li away.
The next moment, Han Li appeared in a place dense with Immortal Runes, standing on a Jade Stone path with crystals and beast bones, all engraved with mysterious rune power, embedded on each side.
Reaching the end of the Jade Stone path, one would find that the place is vast, at least the size of a Domain, yet also small, representing just a spot within the Immortal Realm corresponding to each Domain.
For instance, Han Li entering the Immortal Realm from the Yuankun Domain would arrive in the area of the Immortal Realm corresponding to the Yuankun Domain.
After adapting to the Immortal Realm here, one could enter a deeper layer of the Immortal Realm through another Rune Altar.
It was there that the elites of the entire Taichu Realm’s second step of cultivation gathered.
Now, the place was desolate; Han Li was the only one here, and there wasn’t even an Immortal Pavilion Hall for shelter, unlike the bustling and flourishing areas of other Domains.
Han Li didn’t mind.
With a single step, he instantly arrived at a Rune Altar.
There were a total of ten thousand Rune Altars here, but no one was using them.
The rune power was activated, and a streak of immortal light soared, taking Han Li to a higher layer of the Immortal Realm.
When the immortal light descended, Han Li’s figure appeared on a wide road, surrounded by towering mountains and forests, as well as many grand palaces.
“Move it, move it, hurry to the Five Immortal City.
There’s going to be an unprecedented great battle there.”
“Unprecedented great battle?
I hope this isn’t just some trick to lure people in.
Only a battle involving war-immortals worthy of the name ‘prodigies’ deserves such a title.”
“Half a day later, Qi Xingyu of the Feng Peng Domain will fight Guan Shanyue of the Dingyang Realm in Five Immortal City.
Is this not considered a battle of the century?”
“Hiss~ Of course, it is!
Qi Xingyu and Guan Shanyue are both famous battle saints with astonishing achievements.
They have been challenging each other for months, and I didn’t expect them to really start fighting.”
“Let’s hurry, or there won’t be any good spots left if we are late.”
A group of cultivators whizzed past, heading towards the distant giant city.
In even further places, within immortal halls, divine temples, and saintly pavilions, divine and holy lights ascended, all rushing towards Five Immortal City.
These cultivators flew over Han Li’s head, completely ignoring him.
He was just a newbie, how could he compare to the campaign of two battle saints?
Han Li’s gaze flickered, and he followed toward the distant giant city.
The name of that giant city was Ascension City, vast and boundless; it was a true city of immortals, spreading its influence over dozens of domains, including the Yuankun Domain.
Cultivators from these dozens of domains would enter Ascension City’s area upon reaching the Immortal Realm layer of the Xuxian Realm.
Five Immortal City was extremely far from Ascension City, separated by thousands of domains, but with the Rune Altar in Ascension City, one could rapidly cross this endless distance to reach the distant city.
Dongchen Domain was not within the range of the domains influenced by Five Immortal City, but it was close by.
Han Li planned to first witness the epic battle of the geniuses of the Taichu Realm, then proceed to accomplish his goal of entering the Xuxian Realm.
As for teaching Yang Tianxi of the Dongchen Domain a lesson, it was just an incidental matter, not worth making a special trip for.
Han Li entered Ascension City quickly, randomly chose a Rune Altar, and after paying some spirit crystals, he was teleported to Five Immortal City.
At this moment, Five Immortal City was teeming with people, gathering a large number of prodigies from all over Taichu Realm, just to witness the battle.
Qi Xingyu and Guan Shanyue had not yet appeared, and Five Immortal City was almost at capacity.
Fortunately, it was also an immortal city, and not only did it span millions of miles, but it also contained vast expanses within.
Han Li stepped out of the altar, his divine sense surged out, silently covering Five Immortal City.
Even though he knew there were many powerful beings here, he still showed a look of surprise.
At least several hundred million saints of the Saint Abyss Realm had gathered in Five Immortal City, there were also tens of millions of Quasi Emperor realm powerhouses, and several hundred thousand Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors.
Divine Yuan Realm Martial Sovereigns and Tongxuan Realm powers were present by the hundreds of billions.
In such a situation, countless more powerhouses were continuously rushing towards Five Immortal City.
This showed the influence of the battle between the two war saints and the abundance of second-step strong beings in Taichu Realm.
To understand, in the Ancient Era, Yuankun Domain only had a few hundred Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, and around ten thousand Quasi Emperor realm powerhouses, which paled in comparison to the grand occasion at Five Immortal City.
Of course, Yuankun Domain cannot be compared to other domains, having been isolated for too long and being remote and weak.
A typical domain in Taichu Realm would have millions of Quasi Emperors and at least ten thousand Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors.
“When will Han Mansion ever have so many descendants?
When will we have so many outstanding ones?” Han Li muttered to himself.
With several hours until the grand event at Five Immortal City, Han Li didn’t intend to stay there.
He left for Fire Qilin Cave, three hundred billion miles away from Five Immortal City.
With Han Li’s speed, a distance of three hundred billion miles only required a few steps, and he quickly crossed the vast expanse of time, arriving at Fire Qilin Cave.
The Fire Qilin Cave was a dangerous place within the Immortal Realm, inhabited by nine battle-saint level Fire Qilin beasts.
Whoever could defeat these nine Fire Qilins alone could obtain the fortuitous opportunities within the cave.
The Immortal Realm facilitated the exchange between the major domains of the Taichu Realm and could be used to cultivate potential descendants.
From time to time, a debate conference would be held here, and the winner would receive fortuitous opportunities bestowed by the Immortal Realm.
If one were to create some record, break through some extreme conditions, traverse certain dangerous places, etc., one could also receive fortuitous opportunities bestowed by the Immortal Realm.
PS: I sat down to write the second chapter last night, wrote four hundred words in an hour, and when I couldn’t write anymore, I stopped.
This to make up for yesterday’s.
The young author continues to write and aims to finish two more chapters today.

chapters.title: Chapter 746
chapters.content:
Chapter 746: Chapter 284: The Creation of Fire Qilin Cave, Thirty-six Dynasties’ Heavenly Court, The Great Reversal, Shocking Everyone_1 Chapter 746: Chapter 284: The Creation of Fire Qilin Cave, Thirty-six Dynasties’ Heavenly Court, The Great Reversal, Shocking Everyone_1 “The fortune and destiny of this perilous place shall be mine.”
Han Li stood under the firmament, his hands clasped behind him, clad in spotless white robes, valiant and upright, his tone calm and even.
Below lay an immensely large den, from which the energy of fierce flames billowed out, and nine Fire Scale Beast Kings were coiled in various positions, their different flames of Dao converging within the central den.
This not only formed a Heavenly Immortal Rank grand array for slaying and defending against enemies but also transmitted the essence of the flames of Dao, nurturing the creation within the central nest.
At the heart of the den, there bloomed a fire lotus with nine ripe seeds, each containing the flames of nine distinct Dao.
Ordinary people who consumed a single Fire Qilin lotus seed and refined it would gain insight into the nine types of flame Dao, directly mastering the great Dao of fire among the Five Elements and becoming an immortal in one fell swoop.
This was a True Immortal Rank Immortal Elixir, a defiance of the heavens’ will, and any cultivator who practised the Dao of fire and obtained it would see their talent and potential skyrocket, with limitless prospects for the future.
Even those who did not practice the Dao of fire, gaining the fortune from this place and selling it would have countless cultivators waving Immortal Stones to buy it, or exchange it for treasures they needed.
...
What Han Li valued was the Fire Qilin lotus itself; should he bring it back to Chengsheng Mountain, he could nurture a legion of immortals who wielded the Dao of fire.
A great multitude of cultivators had gathered around the Fire Qilin Cave, including several thousand from the Heaven Imperial Realm, among them no shortage of peak powerhouses.
When Han Li arrived, many cultivators cast their gazes towards him.
Since Han Li didn’t hide his words, others naturally heard them, and seeing that Han Li was a newcomer, there were those who spoke out in ridicule.
“You think you can seize the fortune of the Fire Qilin Cave?”
The speaker was a young man dressed in blue, luxurious garments adorned with the images of two White Tigers, which faintly radiated immortal light, as if they were Heavenly Immortal Rank battle clothes.
Most treasures cannot be brought into the Xuxian Realm; to do so would cost a great deal, something ordinary cultivators could not afford.
But for disciples of great powers, this was not much of an issue.
The young man in blue also saw that Han Li was unfamiliar and thus presumed his strength to be weak, probably not even at the Quasi Emperor Realm, which led him to speak sarcastically.
In the Xuxian Realm, where the strong are revered and the weak have no say.
The cultivators who entered the Xuxian Realm were all there to temper themselves and to seek fortunes and opportunities.
Anyone who had spent some time there would undoubtedly experience battles of various scales.
As long as one was strong, their rise would be swift, gaining some fame.
Information about such geniuses would be collected by all factions for their disciples to learn about.
The young man in blue, who came from a powerful faction, had no impression of Han Li at all and naturally thought Han Li lacked strength.
He assumed Han Li was a newbie unaware of the ways of the Xuxian Realm, someone who had overheard about the fortune of the Fire Qilin Cave and foolishly coveted it.
Could Han Li be one of those cultivators who reached the peak of the second step before entering the Xuxian Realm?
Such rare occurrences happened at a minimal rate, with the vastness of the Tai Chu Realm seeing not even one emerge in thousands of years.
Very few would wait until they reached the peak of the second step before entering the Xuxian Realm.
By that time, the fortunes and opportunities to be gained within the Xuxian Realm would be limited; entering earlier would garner much more, accelerating one’s cultivation pace.
Even if Han Li were such an oddity, what would it matter?
If Han Li was strong, did that mean he was weak?
He too was a famous battle immortal, with not many in the Xuxian Realm capable of defeating him.
“Are the newcomers this fierce these days, or did they not receive any warnings from their elders before entering the Xuxian Realm?”
“Probably came from some obscure Domain.”
“Tsk tsk, that’s quite the tall tale to tell.
The fortune of the Fire Qilin Cave isn’t that easy to take, is it?”
“Alas, the Fire Qilin Cave is one of the most famous perilous places in the Xuxian Realm.
Throughout history, very few have ever managed to successfully claim a Fire Qilin lotus seed there.”
“Fellow Daoist, I advise you not to overestimate yourself.
Find somewhere else to gain fortune.
The Fire Qilin Cave is not to be trifled withâ€”falling to the claws of a Fire Scale Beast King could endanger your real Primordial Spirit.”
One after another, the strong voiced their opinionsâ€”some spoke in ridicule, some with disdain, and some with well-meaning adviceâ€”they all considered Han Li to be an inexperienced newcomer to the Xuxian Realm.
Many more powerful figures, however, remained silent, simply watching quietly.
Indeed many of the Heaven Imperial Realm’s great emperors didn’t give him a glance, focusing instead on the Fire Qilin Cave.
Most of the cultivators gathered outside the Fire Qilin Cave were there to spectate, with only a very few believing they had a chance of picking a Fire Qilin lotus seed, albeit not feeling very confident and therefore pondering their strategies.
Some peak emperors had even braved the Fire Qilin Cave several times or even dozens of times but had never succeeded.
There were multiple modes of braving the Fire Qilin Cave, each with its respective difficulty and rewards.
The first mode involved slaying a Fire Scale Beast King of the Heavenly Immortal Realm triple heaven, which upon success, would yield one Fire Qilin lotus seed.
The second mode involved slaying a Fire Scale Beast King of the Heavenly Immortal Realm quadruple heaven, which upon success, would yield three Fire Qilin lotus seeds.
To obtain all nine Fire Qilin lotus seeds at once, one must slay a Fire Scale Beast King of Heavenly Immortal Realm septuple heavenâ€”a feat no strong cultivator had yet achieved.
Bear in mind, the nine Fire Scale Beast Kings would act in concert, akin to an assault by nine battle immortals.
Without greater strength, victory was unattainable.
And according to the rules, each cultivator could only claim the fortune of the Fire Qilin Cave once; there was no chance of plucking multiple fortunes from the cave.
The many Heaven Imperial Realm cultivators present could only sigh in longingâ€”the trial of the Fire Qilin Cave was too difficult for them to overcome.

chapters.title: Chapter 747
chapters.content:
Chapter 747: Chapter 284: The Creation of Fire Qilin Cave, Thirty-six Dynasties’ Heavenly Court, The Great Reversal, Shocking Everyone_2 Chapter 747: Chapter 284: The Creation of Fire Qilin Cave, Thirty-six Dynasties’ Heavenly Court, The Great Reversal, Shocking Everyone_2 Even the simplest mode, when facing the Fire Qilin Beast King with the combat ability of a Heavenly Immortal Realm’s Third Heaven, is impossible to conquer without having the combat ability to sweep through the Third Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm or stronger capabilities.
The highest cultivation level allowed in the Xuxian Realm is the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, and a cultivator who wants to break through the Fire Qilin Cave must first possess a strong foundational combat ability.
For example, one would need to cultivate powerful Immortal Grade Cultivation Techniques, master strong Immortal Grade Martial Skills, and comprehend rules of that sort from the powerful grand paths…
Once these factors are in place, incomparable talents generally have a combat ability close to, or comparable to, the first heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and upon activating their Divine Sense, their combat ability skyrockets directly to the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
The young man in blue was one of the few strongest combatants present, and although he only had the cultivation of the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm, his combat ability was already comparable to the Fourth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and his Divine Sense had reached the Fifth Stage.
The young man in blue was capable of passing the first mode of the Fire Qilin Cave, but he did not take the reward, as his goal was to pass through the second mode and obtain three Fire Qilin Lotus Seeds.
Then, he would exchange the three Fire Qilin Lotus Seeds for an extremely precious Immortal Elixir, which would be highly beneficial to him.
...
…..
Hearing the various discussions around him, Han Li’s eyes flickered, yet he did not respond.
He was indeed a newcomer, this being only his second visit to the Xuxian Realm.
He had not stayed long during his first entry and was virtually unknown to anyone there.
The cultivators on the second step around him had a discussion, but seeing Han Li not responding, they lost interest and nobody else spoke, including the young man in blue who stopped his taunting.
He was not someone who was arrogant or domineering, just someone who could not get through the second mode of the Fire Qilin Cave, and had bottled up frustration inside, only speaking out because he couldn’t contain himself after hearing Han Li’s reckless words.
Han Li’s gaze landed on a stone tablet in front of the Fire Qilin Cave, on which were inscribed records of the incomparable talents who had successfully passed through the Fire Qilin Cave.
“Yun Luo, from the Wenxin Territory, passed through the third stage of the Fire Qilin Cave during the Crimson Heaven Court era.”
“Zhang Zhaidao, from the God Transformation Realm, passed through the second stage of the Fire Qilin Cave during the Longhan Heavenly Court era.”
“Du Rufeng, from the Nanming Territory, passed through the fourth stage of the Fire Qilin Cave during the Wantong Heavenly Court era.”
“Chen Zhiqing, from the Thunder Fire Realm, passed through the fourth stage of the Fire Qilin Cave during the Guangwu Heavenly Court era.”
“…..”
Han Li was somewhat shaken; this stone tablet indirectly reflected how ancient the Xuxian Realm was, having recorded the incomparable talents from various Heavenly Court eras.
Previously, he only knew of the current Heavenly Court as the Crimson one, and the one before that as the Longhan.
He had not imagined that before the Longhan Heavenly Court, there were Wantong, Guangwu, Shen Yuan, and 34 other Heavenly Courts.
Each reign of the Heavenly Court had an extremely long history, and naturally, there were many who had passed through the Fire Qilin Cave, all of them famous talents of their times.
The most recent one who had passed through the Fire Qilin Cave was Yun Luo.
This extraordinary female emperor from the Wenxin Territory had formidable combat prowess, and more than twenty years earlier, she had passed the third stage and obtained five Fire Qilin Lotus Seeds.
What astonished Han Li, however, was that out of the thirty-six Heavenly Courts, there were surprisingly few who had passed the fifth stage of the Fire Qilin Cave, not even a hundred people.
Han Li’s eyes flickered as he speculated in his mind.
The small number of people who had passed through the fifth stage did not mean that there were so few cultivators with the ability to do so across the thirty-six Heavenly Courts.
Innumerable immortals lived in the Thirty-Three Heavens, but there were not only immortals but also descendants of immortals, who undoubtedly possessed exceptional talent.
Especially the descendants of Immortal Kings, Quasi Immortal Emperors, and even Immortal Emperors, certainly had terrifying combat abilities, but they wouldn’t bother descending to the Xuxian Realm, not valuing the opportunities and fortunes it offered.
Only the descendants of weaker immortals would descend to the Xuxian Realm to try their luck and seek opportunities and fortunes.
In the Xuxian Realm, most were second step cultivators from the Myriad Realm, and some powerful combat immortals who did not value the Fire Qilin Lotus Seeds would not come to the Fire Qilin Cave.
While Han Li was lost in thought, he noticed a commotion around him and glanced over at the young man in blue, who had been the first to mock him.
“I refuse to believe I can’t break through,” the young man in blue snorted coldly and flashed into the Fire Qilin Cave.
The Fire Qilin Cave immediately glowed with endless Immortal Runes, concealing everything and preventing those outside from seeing the scene inside.
This was a form of protection for those attempting the trial, to prevent the secrets of the cultivators passing through from being exposed.
After the young man in blue disappeared, a wave of intense discussions erupted in the area, which was many times livelier than the previous discussions about Han Li; evidently, the young man in blue had a very big reputation.
“Lan Ruochen has entered again.
I wonder if he can pass through the second stage of the Fire Qilin Cave this time?”
“I doubt it.
To pass through the second stage smoothly, one must have combat ability at least comparable to the Fifth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.”
“Tsk, if he had the combat ability of the Fifth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, he would be targeting the third stage.”
“It is said that Lan Ruochen has improved his strength further.
He should have some confidence this time; otherwise, he wouldn’t rashly attempt the trial.”
“Improved strength further?
What a joke, this isn’t the outside world.
Lan Ruochen’s strength has already reached its limit, and Divine Sense can’t advance so quickly.”
Various combat immortals freely discussed, while cultivators from the domains of Great Emperors and Quasi Emperors weren’t as unrestrained, at least not daring to call Lan Ruochen by his name outright.
Although most felt Lan Ruochen didn’t stand a chance, the dozen or so combat immortals present still fixed their eyes intently on the Fire Qilin Cave, even if they couldn’t see inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 748
chapters.content:
Chapter 748: Chapter 284: The Creation of Fire Qilin Cave, Thirty-six Dynasties’ Heavenly Court, The Great Reversal, Shocking Everyone_3 Chapter 748: Chapter 284: The Creation of Fire Qilin Cave, Thirty-six Dynasties’ Heavenly Court, The Great Reversal, Shocking Everyone_3 Although one could utilize celestial weapons when challenging the Fire Qilin Cave, only ordinary Heavenly Immortal weapons were permitted, and peerless geniuses with combat ability of a Battle Immortal could just perfectly unleash the full potential of such class of Heavenly Immortal weapons.
These exceptional geniuses who emerged from the Immortal Monarch Line, Quasi Immortal King Line, and even the Immortal King Line naturally brought with them numerous ordinary Heavenly Immortal weapons into the Xuxian Realm to enhance their combat abilities.
Han Li’s gaze flickered, and through the surrounding discussions, he gleaned a fair amount of understanding regarding the blue-clad youth, Lan Ruochen.
Lan Ruochen came from a Quasi Immortal King Rank lineage in the Liyuan Realm and was the prodigious heir that the lineage devotedly nurtured.
His combat ability was unrivaled in the second step of cultivation across the Nine Great Domains, earning him the title of the First Great Emperor of the Nine Domains.
Lan Ruochen was not yet three thousand years old; he had achieved the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm before the age of eight hundred and thereafter constantly refined himself, striving to build an even stronger foundation for greater achievements in the second step, which is why he had not ascended to immortality.
In the Xuxian Realm, Lan Ruochen’s fame was immense, solely because he possessed the combat ability of the fourth tier of the Heavenly Immortal Realm and had set astonishing records all over the Xuxian Realm, as well as many extraordinary and unprecedented battle achievements.
...
Yang Tianxi from the Dongchen Domain had once sparred with Lan Ruochen, who was not as strong back then, but still managed to outclass Yang Tianxi, who was at the eighth tier of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
“I wonder how this Lan Ruochen compares to Qi Xingyu of the Feng Peng Domain and Guan Shanyue of the Dingyang Domain, as to who is stronger or weaker.”
Han Li compared Lan Ruochen with the two Battle Immortals he had heard about upon his entry into the Xuxian Realm.
Qi Xingyu and Guan Shanyue both also possessed the combat ability of the fourth tier of the Heavenly Immortal Realm and were renowned in the Xuxian Realm.
Their duel had caused a huge sensation, drawing countless second-step powerhouses to spectate.
“Boom~”
Suddenly, the Fire Qilin Cave opened, all the Immortal Runes dispersed, and Lan Ruochen walked out looking embarrassed.
“It seems Lan Ruochen has failed.”
“Brother Lan has indeed become stronger.
I estimate it won’t be long before he can pass the second barrier.”
“Indeed, in the past, Daoist Lan never came out.”
As Lan Ruochen’s figure appeared, the surrounding discussions resumed, and the expressions on the faces of many Great Emperors and Battle Immortals varied.
Numerous discussions entered his ears, but Lan Ruochen’s face remained indifferent without the slightest change; he was already used to it.
His gaze swept over the other Battle Immortals, and realizing they had no intention of challenging the Fire Qilin Cave, he prepared to leave.
He was planning to go to Five Immortal City to watch a fight; he had a certain rapport with Qi Xingyu from the Feng Peng Domain, and they often exchanged views on cultivation.
However, Lan Ruochen’s figure suddenly froze, the numerous discussions around him ceased, and the very heavens and earth seemed to fall into a sudden silence.
Everyone’s gaze turned toward the cultivator at the entrance of the Fire Qilin Cave, surprise, astonishment, doubt, disdain, and various other emotions flickering in their eyes.
This newcomer was truly reckless!
Had he not seen a famously powerful Battle Immortal fail the challenge?
Yet he dared to attempt it, truly beyond their expectations.
Some cultivators looked thoughtfully at Han Li’s figure, among them Lan Ruochen, who felt that he might have encountered a real oddity today.
Could this newcomer be at the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm with the strength of a Battle Immortal, venturing into the Xuxian Realm for experience?
“Can he make it through the Fire Qilin Cave?”
Lan Ruochen exchanged glances with other Battle Immortals, all sharing the same thought, before they began communicating with each other through voice transmissions.
Han Li entered the Fire Qilin Cave, endless Immortal Runes reappeared, obscuring the view.
Lan Ruochen and the other cultivators had barely exchanged a few words when they suddenly froze, shock etched on their faces.
For the commotion in the Fire Qilin Cave had ceased, with copious amounts of Auspicious Immortal Qi soaring into the sky, and the ancient stele at the entrance of the cave radiated dazzling immortal light.
All these phenomena indicated that the “newcomer” they talked about had successfully cleared the Fire Qilin Cave.
Lan Ruochen and the other cultivators swallowed hard, their discussions silenced, and other cultivators did likewise, all staring fixedly at the entrance of the Fire Qilin Cave.
It seemed they were about to witness a historic event.
But what astonished everyone was that the recording stele dimmed again, without inscribing Han Li’s name onto it.
“Hiss~”
Many cultivators couldn’t help but suck in a breath of cold air, guessing what Han Li was doing and filled with faint anticipation.
PS: Ah, I only managed to write 8500+ words today, can’t write anymore, I’ll write more tomorrow.
As one gets older, the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak.

chapters.title: Chapter 749
chapters.content:
Chapter 749: Chapter 285: Breaking the Eternal Record, Suppressing Ten Million Great Emperors with One Palm, Reaching the Summit of Wendao Mountain, Claiming the Greatest Fortune_1 Chapter 749: Chapter 285: Breaking the Eternal Record, Suppressing Ten Million Great Emperors with One Palm, Reaching the Summit of Wendao Mountain, Claiming the Greatest Fortune_1 Fire Qilin Cave.
Han Li looked dispassionately at the jade stone in front of him, engraved with mysterious runes, and asked, “I desire the Fire Qilin Lotus.
Is there a more difficult trial ahead?”
Just now, he had entered the Fire Qilin Cave and directly chosen the toughest fifth level.
Nine heads of the Fire Scale Beast King, each with the combat ability of the Seventh Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, had fiercely attacked with unparalleled might.
Han Li had not even used his Divine Sense.
With just three punches, he had shattered all the Fire Scale Beast Kings and passed the level.
The Azure Jade Stele’s runes flickered, and rows of golden text appeared.
...
“To obtain the Fire Qilin Lotus, one must slay nine Fire Scale Beast Kings, each possessing the combat ability of the Nine Heavens of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.”
Han Li’s eyes flickered.
This was truly difficult; no wonder it seemed that no one had ever passed this hidden challenge since ancient times.
To suppress nine Fire Scale Beast Kings, each with the combat ability of the Ninth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, even the peak combatants of the Heavenly Immortal Realm would be unable to accomplish this, and would be blasted away by the Fire Scale Beast Kings.
Han Li soon thought of another possibility.
Perhaps no one was as greedy as Han Li, not satisfied with just nine lotus seeds; he also coveted the Fire Qilin Lotus itself.
Those monstrous geniuses who could pass the fifth level came from major lineages; they didn’t need to scrounge every inch of ground like Han Li.
“Come forth.”
Han Li warmed up his limbs, his tone as steady as an ancient well.
His combat ability was a notch above that of an ordinary pinnacle Heavenly Immortal Realm cultivator.
He wanted to see if he could pass the hidden level without invoking his Divine Sense.
Brilliant Immortal Runes burst forth in the heavens, condensing into nine terrifying Fire Scale Beast Kings.
Their nine pairs of crimson eyes gazed at Han Li, and the next moment they charged to attack, each casual strike having the power to shatter the great cosmos and overturn the heavens and the earth.
“Boom boom boom!”
Han Li did not hold back, freely using the Flat Sky Four Styles to battle fiercely with the nine Fire Scale Beast Kings.
After expending substantial strength, he finally subdued them.
The Azure Jade Stele roared once again.
Endless Immortal Runes shone forth, and the resplendent Immortal light dazzled the heavens.
New golden text emerged.
“Having broken the Fire Qilin Cave record, would you like to leave your true name?”
Han Li’s pupils constricted slightly.
After some thought, he declined and casually gave a name.
The Immortal Runes receded, and a line of golden text surfaced, climbing directly to the summit of the Azure Jade Stele.
“Li Feiyu, with one punch flattening the heavens, one battle subdued nine Fire Scale Beast Kings of the Ninth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, setting the highest record in the Fire Qilin Cave.”
Afterward, the golden text vanished, and three light spheres descended from the sky.
Han Li examined them closely before taking them.
They were nine Fire Qilin lotus seeds, the Fire Qilin Lotus, and a creation reward for breaking the record, much more valuable than the previous two.
When Han Li walked out of the Fire Qilin Cave, the entire world fell silent.
All the second-step cultivators were shocked as they looked at the Azure Jade Stele piercing the heavens, especially the new record at the very top.
“Is this even a newcomer?
He is an invincible powerhouse!”
“What are you joking about?
Slaying nine Fire Scale Beast Kings with the combat ability of the Ninth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm?
The Fire Qilin Cave doesn’t even have a trial of this difficulty.”
“Hissâ€”This Li Feiyu has broken the record of thirty-six heavens of the Heavenly Court.”
“Breaking the highest record and topping the first place in the Fire Qilin Cave, does this mean that Li Feiyu has the unparalleled combat ability of the Heaven Imperial Realm of all time?”
“In our era, a prodigy with potential surpassing the ancients and talents eclipsing the ages has appeared.
We are fortunate to witness it in our lifetimes.”
Innumerable cultivators discussed fervently, no longer showing any trace of contempt for Li Feiyu but rather placing immense importance on him.
When they turned their gaze back to the now-open Fire Qilin Cave, they were all dumbfounded.
Where had Li Feiyu gone?
…….
At this moment, Han Li had returned to Five Immortal City, casually picking a celestial tavern to pour a cup of spirit-clearing liquor into his mouth.
“This spirit-clearing liquor truly is extraordinary.
Even after drinking it, I can feel my Primordial Spirit warming up as if it has become a bit purer,” he mused to himself.
After paying for the drink, Han Li left the tavern and walked through the vast Five Immortal City.
Five Immortal City, it is said, was jointly created by five battle immortals.
These battle immortals were as close as brothers.
After leaving the Xuxian Realm, they made a great name for themselves in the Taichu Realm, with one becoming a Quasi Immortal Emperor and four achieving the level of Immortal King.
The history of Five Immortal City is extremely ancient.
It had changed city masters many times.
Every time, Five Immortal City would have five city masters, each one a battle immortal.
It is the same today in Five Immortal City.
Among the five city masters, the strongest possesses the combat ability of the Fifth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, much stronger than battle immortals like Qi Xingyu, Guan Shanyue, and Lan Ruochen.
As time passed, when billions of cultivators had gathered in Five Immortal City, Qi Xingyu from Feng Peng Domain and Guan Shanyue from Dingyang Domain simultaneously arrived.
The strongest city master of Five Immortal City also appeared to preside over this grand battle.
Han Li did not join the excitement.
He merely observed from afar.
He also saw Lan Ruochen, whom he had encountered in the Fire Qilin Cave, who seemed to know Qi Xingyu.
In the sky battlefield, Qi Xingyu and Guan Shanyue engaged in an exceptional duel.
Both being from the Immoral King Line and their cultivation of the Great Dao, cultivation technique, and such were quite similar.
They effortlessly employed various powerful Immortal Grade Martial Skills and fought fiercely.
This battle was to determine both victory and life or death.
To Han Li’s surprise, although countless cultivators gathered in Five Immortal City due to the two battle immortals, and Qi Xingyu and Guan Shanyue were still fiercely competing, the topic most discussed by the majority of cultivators in the city was the suddenly emerged Li Feiyu.
In the Xuxian Realm, the highest cultivation level is only the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
However, Li Feiyu had passed the hidden test of the Fire Qilin Cave, subdued nine Fire Scale Beast Kings with the combat ability of the Ninth Heaven of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and must therefore have at least the peak combat ability of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 750
chapters.content:
Chapter 750: Chapter 285: Breaking the Eternal Record, Suppressing Ten Million Great Emperors with One Palm, Reaching the Summit of Wendao Mountain, Claiming the Greatest Fortune_2 Chapter 750: Chapter 285: Breaking the Eternal Record, Suppressing Ten Million Great Emperors with One Palm, Reaching the Summit of Wendao Mountain, Claiming the Greatest Fortune_2 In the Xuxian Realm now, even the strongest few battle immortals are merely at the seventh or eighth level of the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
When a supreme demon with peak combat ability of the Heavenly Immortal Realm suddenly emerged, it sent shockwaves throughout the Xuxian Realm, making it difficult to avoid attention.
Amid countless discussions, Han Li just smiled faintly, turning a deaf ear to it all, for he had no intention of standing out.
Without invincible strength, he preferred to lie low.
“Qi Xingyu is going to lose.”
With his hands clasped behind his back, Han Li stood in front of a window, making his judgment internally.
After some observation, he had figured out both Qi Xingyu and Guan Shanyue’s capabilities.
Guan Shanyue was a bit stronger, especially in her mastery of Immortal Grade Martial Skills compared to Qi Xingyu.
...
As Han Li expected, a few moves later, Guan Shanyue unleashed her strongest martial skill, exploding with full force.
Qi Xingyu barely blocked the initial strikes but couldn’t withstand the final blow and was about to be killed by Guan Shanyue.
Once Guan Shanyue used this martial skill, each move was stronger than the last, with each strike accumulating more formidable power for the next.
A hint of surprise flashed in Lan Ruochen’s eyes, not expecting that his friend Qi Xingyu would actually lose.
He leaped out, about to intervene and save Qi Xingyu.
The forehead of the First City Lord of Five Immortal City furrowed, ready to block Lan Ruochen.
He wouldn’t allow anyone to disrupt this duel.
But in the next moment, the expressions of everyone changed, including the First City Lord, Lan Ruochen, Guan Shanyue, and Qi Xingyu, as well as several other powerful battle immortals.
They all looked up in shock at the sky, their mana boiling over as they launched their full strength upwards.
A giant palm covered the sky, radiating the most dazzling immortal light, looking like countless universes combined, pressing down towards Five Immortal City.
“Boom~”
The roar echoed throughout the entire Xuxian Realm, drawing the startled gazes of countless powerhouses.
When the blinding white light dissipated, the cultivators outside Five Immortal City peered inside, their mouths agape and eyes nearly popping out.
Countless powerhouses within Five Immortal City were prostrated, unable to move.
Even the First City Lord, Guan Shanyue, and Qi Xingyu, some of the strongest battle immortals, were now kneeling on one knee, looking up at the sky with shocked expressions.
To suppress over a hundred billion second-stage cultivators with a single palm, among them tens of millions of Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors and dozens of battle immortals, how strong must the person who acted be?
Who could it be?
As this thought emerged, one name simultaneously surfaced in the minds of all the cultivators.
Li Feiyu!
Only that suddenly appeared Li Feiyu had such terrifying strength, to suppress a hundred billion second-stage cultivators with one palm, yet not kill a single person.
“Terrifying indeed~”
In that moment, Li Feiyu’s reputation shook the Xuxian Realm.
His fame spread throughout the entire realm in an extremely short time, drawing the attention of countless sects.
…….
Xuxian Realm, Wendao Mountain.
This place is one of the most famous creation lands in the Xuxian Realm, and its creation veiled as the utmost of the realm.
After a casual palm strike in the Five Immortal City, Han Li quietly left.
To avoid trouble, he even disguised himself.
Before coming to Wendao Mountain, Han Li had visited several other creation lands in the Xuxian Realm, such as Fire Qilin Cave and Wendao Mountain, and had also given a punch to Yang Tianxi of the Dongchen Domain, blasting him out of the Xuxian Realm.
Ignoring the attention and discussions of the surrounding cultivators, Han Li flew into Wendao Mountain with a calm expression, as boundless Immortal Runes erupted, instantly concealing his figure.
The dangerous lands and creation lands within the Xuxian Realm can undergo countless trials simultaneously.
Each trial is completely sealed, with only the challengers knowing what occurred.
Standing at the foot of Wendao Mountain, Han Li looked up.
From the base to the summit, there were ten thousand Jade Stone steps.
That was the content of the trial.
To climb Wendao Mountain, one must question the path, testing the challenger’s comprehension of the great path, which also hones the will, and can even aid in enlightenment.
The creation earned from Wendao Mountain is determined by how many levels of steps were climbed, with at least a thousand levels needed for the basic reward.
After that, with every additional five hundred levels climbed, the creation earned becomes greater.
Legend has it that the cultivator who reaches the top of Wendao Mountain will receive the greatest creation of the Xuxian Realm.
It is said to be an Against the Heaven’s Creation from the beginning of the Xuxian Realm, coveted by countless cultivators.
Even many second-stage cultivators from the Thirty-three Heavens have descended to the Xuxian Realm, all for that greatest creation.
But to this day, no cultivator from the thirty-six Longhan Heavenly Courts has reached the top of Wendao Mountain to take that legendary greatest creation.
Many cultivators bellyache, claiming that the trial of Wendao Mountain is too perverse, and no cultivator could possibly pass it.
Yet many more believe it to be a good thing, as the harder the trial of Wendao Mountain, the more it remains there for anyone and their descendants to have a chance.
The reason the greatest creation of Wendao Mountain is so attractive, aside from the halo of various legends, is also because it is unique.
Once taken, no second will appear.
Han Li glanced at the mountaintop, then his gaze fell on the Ancient Immortal Jade Tombstone ahead, upon which countless golden characters were inscribed, creating a ranking.
“First place, Yu Kunlun, a cultivator from the Jade Void Heavenly Court era, nine thousand eight hundred seventy-seven steps.”
“Second place, Zhan Wushuang, a cultivator from the Mingde Heavenly Court era, nine thousand eight hundred seventy-six steps.”
“Tenth place, Dao Wuya, a cultivator from the Wantong Heavenly Court era, nine thousand six hundred thirty-two steps.”
“Ninety-eighth place, Meng Qingyao, a cultivator from the Longhan Heavenly Court era, nine thousand three hundred ninety-five steps.”
Han Li’s gaze swept over, instantly capturing all the names recorded on the Ancient Immortal Jade Tombstone.

chapters.content:
Chapter 751: Chapter 285: Breaking the Eternal Record, Suppressing Ten Million Great Emperors with One Palm, Reaching the Summit of Wendao Mountain, Claiming the Greatest Fortune_3 Chapter 751: Chapter 285: Breaking the Eternal Record, Suppressing Ten Million Great Emperors with One Palm, Reaching the Summit of Wendao Mountain, Claiming the Greatest Fortune_3 The ranking is not extensive, with only ten thousand spots, seemingly corresponding to ten thousand steps, newcomers claim the last spot when they enter the list.
Han Li discovered that he didn’t recognize a single cultivator listed on the ancient stele ranking.
The ranking spanned the thirty-six dynasties of the Heavenly Court, too ancient for comprehension, most of the named on the stele had likely perished.
Although becoming a Golden Immortal meant eternal life, and advancing to Immortal King would render one’s flesh indestructible and their Primordial Spirit everlasting, they still faced lethal threats from those more powerful.
An Immortal Emperor could peer into countless timelines of past and future, roam the long river of time, and oversee the cycles of reincarnation, resurrecting as long as a single trace remained in the world.
Even the mighty Immortal Emperors would die, slain by even mightier Immortal Emperors.
Therefore, Han Li always upheld the belief of cautious cultivation, never acting recklessly without invincible strength, and if he made an enemy he couldn’t reconcile with, he would eradicate them completely, cutting off all karma.
...
A plethora of thoughts flashed through his mind, and with his hands clasped behind his back, Han Li began his ascent of Wendao Mountain.
Setting foot on the first step, a deafening inquiry of the Dao resonated in his mind, testing his Daoist practice, examining the cultivator’s understanding of the Great Dao.
A flash of light from Han Li’s Primordial Spirit provided the immediate answer to this inquiry, posing no difficulty for him.
Afterward, Han Li continued ascending Wendao Mountain, and without much time spent, he easily reached the nine thousandth step, his expression still calm.
If anyone had witnessed him carelessly ascend to the ninth thousandth step of Wendao Mountain, it would have undoubtedly caused another uproar, astounding countless emperors and war immortals of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Without delay, Han Li pressed on until he reached the nine thousand five hundredth step, where his expression grew solemn, sensing some difficulty.
Nine thousand six hundred steps!
Nine thousand seven hundred steps!
Nine thousand nine hundred steps!
By now, Han Li had broken the highest record since the existence of the thirty-six dynasties of the Heavenly Court, but he still did not stop.
However, as he ascended higher, the inquiries of Wendao Mountain became more challenging, and even with Han Li’s level of Daoist practice, grasping the pinnacle of martial arts, he began to struggle.
Han Li didn’t give up; he had only one purpose for climbing Wendao Mountainâ€” to take the utmost fortune of the Xuxian Realm.
If even he, an emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm who grasped the principles of the ultimate martial arts, could not reach the summit, then perhaps no one from the Taichu Realm, past or future, could either.
On the last hundred steps, with each one he ascended, ten profound inquiries echoed in Han Li’s mind, each one deeply esoteric, and had he not been practicing the ultimate martial arts, he wouldn’t have been able to answer any of them.
Unbeknownst to him, Han Li arrived at the nine thousand nine hundred ninety-ninth step; he glanced at the summit, saw nothing of note, and concentrated on the ninety-nine inquiries of this level.
After an indeterminate amount of time, Han Li finally awakened, having unraveled all the inquiries.
“Huff~”
Gazing at the summit within arm’s reach, Han Li let out a long sigh, rejuvenating his weary spirit and body to their peak.
He stepped forward, reaching the summit of Wendao Mountain!
In that instant, Wendao Mountain erupted with the most dazzling celestial light, shaking the entire Xuxian Realm and even causing momentous reverberations in the Taichu Realm.
After grasping the situation, Han Li collected the greatest fortune bestowed by the Xuxian Realm and slipped away, departing the Xuxian Realm.
Han Li soon returned to the Yuankun Domain, Chengsheng Mountain, yet he was oblivious to the shockwaves he had sent through the entire Taichu Realm.
Countless top-tier Daoist legacies and numerous powerful figures were in search of Han Li, and some were even busily cleaning up after him.
