chapters.content:
Chapter 752: Chapter 286: The Thousand Path Tree Sapling, Marrying Qin Shiyin, The Battle of Geniuses at Han Mansion Begins_1 Chapter 752: Chapter 286: The Thousand Path Tree Sapling, Marrying Qin Shiyin, The Battle of Geniuses at Han Mansion Begins_1 “`
Tiansheng Realm, Yangxin Hall.
After returning from the Xuxian Realm, Han Li arrived here, completely unaware of the great shock he had sparked.
He spread open his right hand, an orb of misty purple qi appeared, emitting endless Dao rhythms and meanings.
Within it was a sapling, also the ultimate fortune for reaching the summit of Wendao Mountain.
Thousand Path Tree sapling.
It was one of the top invincible immortal seeds.
In the Heaven Imperial Realm, Great Emperors cultivated the principles of Dao, mastered these principles, and when transcending calamity to become an immortal, they needed to merge with the Dao, merging is their own cultivated Dao.
...
If one could find an immortal seed in advance and refine it into their body, it would not only increase the chances of merging successfully with the Dao when becoming an immortal but also enhance their strength after becoming an immortal and improve their potential.
Of course, it was also possible to transcend calamity and become an immortal and successfully merge with the Dao without refining an immortal seed into one’s body.
Within the Taichu Realm, there were countless immortal seeds, graded into different qualities.
Among them, the most powerful seeds were known as invincible seeds, such as the seeds of chaos purple qi, Thousand Path Tree, embryonic form of the domain sea, World Tree saplings, and so on.
However, over the thirty-six dynasties of the Tai Chu, the powerful immortal seeds were largely held in the hands of various Dao overlords, and the invincible seeds were all sought out.
In every hundred epochs, it was rare for an invincible seed to appear; on average, there might be one in a thousand epochs.
To obtain one required immense destiny.
But many of the invincible seeds no longer appeared.
The Thousand Path Tree sapling was one of the vanished invincible seeds; the last time it appeared was during the period of the Crimson Heaven Court, but no one managed to capture it.
Han Li never expected that the Xuxian Realm could bring him such a great surprise, for reaching the pinnacle of Wendao Mountain actually yielded the legendary invincible seed, the “Thousand Path Tree sapling”.
It was no wonder when people said that the ultimate fortune of Wendao Mountain was unique and also subtly referred to as the greatest fortune in the Xuxian Realm.
Indeed, they weren’t wrong.
The value of such an invincible immortal seed as the Thousand Path Tree sapling was even higher than that of an Immortal King weapon, at least on par with a Quasi Immortal Emperor weapon.
If one refined an invincible seed before becoming an immortal, their potential would be limitless.
According to ancient records, most owners of invincible seeds eventually became Immortal Emperors, while a few fell unexpectedly during the Immortal King or Quasi Immortal Emperor periods.
Prior to this, Han Li had not considered searching for any immortal seeds, as the Yuankun Domain did not have any, having been isolated for countless epochs.
Even an ordinary immortal seed was hard to find.
Now, having unexpectedly acquired the unbeatable immortal seed, the Thousand Path Tree sapling, he was naturally going to refine it.
The Thousand Path Tree sapling happened to perfectly match his constitution, cultivation technique, and even the Dao.
It was as though it had been tailor-made for him.
“Hoo~”
Looking at the Thousand Path Tree sapling in his hand, Han Li let out a heavy sigh and then began the refinement.
He was now at the peak of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
His next step would be to achieve the Heavenly Immortal Realm and if he did not refine the Thousand Path Tree sapling now, he would not be able to do so after becoming an immortal.
Sensing Han Li’s mana, the Thousand Path Tree sapling actually seemed to cheer, as if it really liked his aura.
Han Li’s eyes flashed.
He was indeed not mistaken; the Thousand Path Tree sapling was a perfect fit for him.
After some time, Han Li successfully refined the Thousand Path Tree sapling into his body, rooting it in his spiritual sea, and connecting it with his flesh, Primordial Spirit, mana, and martial path.
Han Li felt different in some subtle way, but could not articulate exactly what had changed.
Perhaps he would only know after transcending calamity to become an immortal.
The Thousand Path Tree sapling and he were in a mutually beneficial relationship, providing tremendous support for Han Li.
As his cultivation level gradually climbed, the Thousand Path Tree sapling would grow as well, finally becoming a true Thousand Path Tree.
“Could the Thousand Path Tree be the opportunity for me to achieve the fourth step in my cultivation?”
A thought flashed through Han Li’s mind suddenly.
His knowledge of the third step in cultivation was limited, mostly about the Heavenly Immortal Realm and the True Immortal Realm, but he knew little about the following realms : the Golden Immortal Realm, Immortal King Realm, Quasi Immortal Emperor Realm, and the Immortal Emperor Realm except for their names.
Not to mention the fourth step in cultivation : that was an unknown domain even many Immortal Emperors were still exploring.
Despite the passage of countless ages, not a single Immortal Emperor had stepped into the mysterious fourth step.
“Maybe I’m overthinking it.”
Han Li narrowed his eyes and temporarily cast aside this wild, daring thought.
It was best to just keep a low profile and raise his cultivation level first.
By the time he cultivated to the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm, the Thousand Path Tree should also have reached its growth limit.
By then, he would know whether the Thousand Path Tree was his opportunity to break through to the fourth step in cultivation.
Besides, he had the System.
So far, the System had helped him break through big realms; it should also be able to help him break through from the pinnacle of the third step into the fourth step…
right?
Han Li was a bit uncertain; it was still too far away for him, so he put these thoughts aside for now.
Afterward, Han Li took out all the fortunes and opportunities he had collected from the Xuxian Realm, examined them, and a satisfied smile appeared on his face.
Although these fortunes and opportunities were not as valuable as the Thousand Path Tree sapling, they were top-tier within the Xuxian Realm, perfect for aiding the development of Han Mansion and could be given to the most outstanding descendants.
………..
Time passed quickly, and in a blink of an eye, over half a month was gone.
During this time, Han Li spent the beginning period accompanying Shen Youqing.
After Shen Youqing became pregnant, he then reduced the time spent with her.
To Han Li’s slight surprise, Shen Youqing was pregnant for the first time and there were three life auras in her body : it was looking like a set of triplets was on the way.
The rest of the time, Han Li was completely free, spending most of his time at Chengsheng Mountain, researching how to increase the speed of his cultivation breakthroughs and how to facilitate faster growth for the descendants of Han Mansion, as well as accompanying Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Ji Mingyue, Qiu Yueyao, and his other cherished wives and concubines.

chapters.title: Chapter 753
chapters.content:
Chapter 753: Chapter 286: The Thousand Path Tree Sapling, Marrying Qin Shiyin, The Han Mansion Genius Battle Begins_2 Chapter 753: Chapter 286: The Thousand Path Tree Sapling, Marrying Qin Shiyin, The Han Mansion Genius Battle Begins_2 At times like these, Han Li was always magnanimous, striding into the ninth floor of the Time-Sky Tower with great poise, his arms wrapped around his tender wife and beautiful consorts.
There, they would discuss and exchange views on the Dao, exploring life’s aspirations and the profound truths of the Great Way.
Occasionally, Han Li would also make his way to Xumi Mountain, entering Little Western Heaven to find the female Bodhisattva Han Linxi, which also served as a pleasant diversion for him.
He had discovered that leaving Han Linxi to cultivate on Xumi Mountain had been an exceedingly wise decision, as she continued to draw his interest unabated.
The female Bodhisattva was now several months pregnant and had stopped venturing out from Little Western Heaven.
She stayed inside, dealing with the affairs of Xumi Mountain through her avatars, leaving a certain maiden in colorful skirts utterly astounded.
How could someone change so much in just a few months?
...
The maiden in colorful skirts expressed her incomprehension.
She often communicated with the female Bodhisattva, and upon hearing the “obscenities” and exceedingly bold ideas from her, she felt her own purity waning.
On this day, Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain was once again festooned with lights and banners, hosting an extremely grand matrimonial celebration.
Han Li was to wed Empress Qin Shiyin.
This news had already spread throughout the entire Yuankun Domain a month earlier; every power in the Eight Hundred Divine Regions and countless cultivators were aware of it.
This left numerous forces, including the Solar Empire and Tianji Pavilion, in a “blissful vexation.”
After Chengsheng Mountain took control over the entire Yuankun Domain, they certainly maintained their preceding styleâ€”apart from establishing branches of Han Mansion across the Eight Hundred Divine Regions, they refrained from any further major actions, much to the excitement of countless forces.
However, the frequent marriages and concubine intakes of Chengsheng Mountain’s Supreme had them presenting gifts each time, to maintain relations with Chengsheng Mountain, and at last, countless forces beyond Qianyuan Divine Province experienced the troubles of being dominated.
Offering congratulatory gifts was an art of subtlety.
It was about keeping the relationship with Chengsheng Mountain intact without inviting their retaliation, while also trying to minimize the loss.
Thus, the major forces of Yuankun Domain, after collecting intelligence on the gifting practices from the major powers of Qianyuan Divine Province, decided to slightly modify their approach.
They could ignore the matters of Han Li’s descendants marrying or taking concubines, not needing to travel vast distances to present congratulatory gifts.
When Han Li took concubines, based on the stature of the concubines, they would give ordinary gifts.
When Han Li married, if the bride was of ordinary status, they would give somewhat more precious gifts; for those wives whom Han Li valued highly, such as Heaven Imperial Realm Empresses who required grand celebrations, they would present their finest gifts.
By doing so, they significantly reduced the financial strain caused by gift-giving and maintained their relationship with Chengsheng Mountain.
If they gained Han Li’s favor, they could even garner more benefits.
Han Li’s wedding to Qin Shiyin was naturally a grandiose affair; invites were sent directly to the major forces of Yuankun Domain, summoning the heads of these forces to partake.
The date for wedding Qin Shiyin had been set months in advance, as Han Li had thought about legitimizing her status to free her from the stigma created by the White Emperor.
But since the White Emperor had been eradicated by him long ago, there was no longer a need to make arrangements for this matter, and it was never brought up again.
After proceeding through the wedding rituals, Qin Shiyin was escorted to her bridal chamberâ€”this would be their nuptial room.
Han Li didn’t immediately follow; instead, he stayed in Yundao Hall to converse with several Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors and Quasi Empresses.
Only after several rounds of drinks did Han Li leave, pleased.
After the exchange, Han Li already received hints from several Quasi Empresses that should he send an official proposal, they would be willing to marry him as cultivation partners.
Outside Qin Shiyin’s bridal chamber, Han Li arrived leisurely, smiling as he entered.
He was looking forward to itâ€”Qin Shiyin was the first Heaven Imperial Realm Empress he had married, and Han Li had not yet shared the Dao with her, hence Qin Shiyin remained untouched to this day.
All was saved for this day.
When Han Li entered the bridal chamber and saw Qin Shiyin’s enchantingly beautiful form, she was no longer dressed in black with white stockings.
Instead, she wore bridal red, with the only change being the black leg rings on her slender legs replaced by red ones.
Han Li was naturally overjoyed at this sight.
“My dear Han, you’ve finally arrived~”
Qin Shiyin’s voice was laced with a hint of bashfulness and brimming with anticipation.
In the time leading up to this moment, Qin Shiyin had long since prepared herself mentally; after the prior marriage ceremony, she had been waiting to give herself to Han Li.
After a few months of interaction, Han Li had performed exceptionally well, surrounded by various impressive auras, which greatly increased Qin Shiyin’s favorable impression of him.
Although she wasn’t in love with Han Li, she was certainly not averse to discussing the Dao with him anymore.
“Shiyin, I have been looking forward to this day for a long time….”
Han Li sat down beside Qin Shiyin, wrapping one arm around her soft and slender waist tenderly, speaking sweet nothings with deep affection.
Han Li was no longer as impatient as before; now, he was very familiar with the process.
While sharing intimate whispers with Qin Shiyin, he simultaneously began the preamble to their Dao exchange.
Before they knew it, both were being completely open and honest with each other.
Han Li was explaining profound Daoist knowledge to Qin Shiyin in great detail and depth.
…….
The next day,
Han Li and Qin Shiyin shared a tender moment before concluding their morning practice.
Qin Shiyin was somewhat tired and fell into a deep sleep.
Han Li, on the other hand, left the sleeping chamber and headed to the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Taking advantage of the faint morning light, he first absorbed a breath of the morning’s purple essence, and then proceeded to reflect upon himself, as he did thrice daily.
After completing these rituals, Han Li went to find Feng Mian.
This beauty from Juvenile Giant Peak, with her youthful appearance and profound cultivation, held a special place in his heart and he found her irresistible.
Primarily because Feng Mian’s cultivation was advanced and her physical body robust, she could engage in combat with Han Li until the heavens darkened, and the sun and moon lost their lightâ€”a few years of Dao exchange with her posed no problem at all.
As time passed by, in the blink of an eye, six days had gone.
On this day, Chengsheng Mountain was buzzing with activity as numerous disciples of Han Mansion emerged from seclusion, making their way toward Battle Peak.
Today was the day of the annual battle of talents hosted by Han Mansion.
Countless disciples of Han Mansion and many others within the household gathered together to witness and partake in this grand event.
And those who registered to compete were rubbing their hands in anticipation, each with a different expressionâ€”some wore smiles, others were tense, and still, others appeared calm….
Because Han Mansion’s battle of talents was divided into five groupsâ€”God Refining Realm, Hollow Void Stage, Myriad Phenomena Realm, True Martial Realm, and Divine Yuan Realmâ€”five battlefields were opened atop Battle Peak to serve as the arenas for each group.
“Yong Ji, I heard you received a great reward from our father last time and have made significant progress in strength.
Are you confident about making it into the top ten?”
A crew-cut youth dressed in yellow battle armor approached Han Yongji with a gentle smile on his face.
Han Yongji glanced at him, his expression unchanged, and merely said indifferently, “Yong Hui, you don’t need to probe my strength.
When we face each other, you will naturally know how strong or weak I am.”
The crew-cut youth, named Han Yonghui, was a son born of a concubine, but he possessed a decent king’s body and was highly intelligent.
His status within Han Mansion was not lower than the others.
Han Yongji did not like Han Yonghui, mainly because the two of them did not get along and there were some frictions between them.
Because Han Mansion prohibited infighting among kin, competition was allowed within limits, so the two would compete in other areas, and the annual battle of talents was their biggest opportunity to do so.
Han Yongji had also heard that Han Yonghui had encountered a serendipitous opportunity several months ago that advanced his cultivation to the peak of the Myriad Phenomena Realm and greatly enhanced his combat ability.
It was likely that he aspired to be in the top ten in the Myriad Phenomena Realm group.
Nevertheless, Han Yongji was also extremely confident in his own strength.
He had cultivated an emperor-level martial technique to the minor achievement stage, reaching an astonishing level of combat ability.
For this, he had paid a heavy price.
He had been training hard in the Time-Sky Tower all this time without indulging in any comforts.
Han Yonghui narrowed his eyes, sensing Han Yongji’s dislike for him, but he didn’t mind and just said, “Yong Ji, it seems you’re very confident about this battle of talents.
I won’t disturb you then.”
Deciding to leave, Han Yonghui had reached his objective of confirming the rumors about Han Yongji.
Han Yongji watched Han Yonghui walk away, glanced at the few people standing with him, his gaze flickered, but he said nothing and turned his attention to the debate battlefield.
Two descendants of Han Mansion at the Myriad Phenomena Realm were battling it out above.
…..

So far, the System had helped him break through major realms, so it should also be able to help him break through from the peak of the third step to the fourth…
right?
Han Li was somewhat uncertain, as this was still too far off for him, so he chose not to ponder on these matters anymore.
Afterward, Han Li took out the fortunes and opportunities he had gleaned from the Xuxian Realm and observed them.
A satisfied smile appeared on his face.
Although these fortunes and opportunities did not compare to the Thousand Path Tree sapling, they were still considered top-tier in the Xuxian Realm, perfect for aiding the development of the Han Mansion and for bestowing upon a few of the most outstanding descendants.
………..
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, more than half a month had gone by.
During this period, Han Li initially spent time accompanying Shen Youqing.
After she became pregnant, he reduced the time spent with her.
What surprised Han Li a bit was that during Shen Youqing’s first pregnancy, three life forces emerged inside her.
It looked like they were expecting triplets.
In the time that followed, Han Li was completely free.
He spent most of his time at Chengsheng Mountain, researching how to speed up his cultivation breakthrough and how to help the descendants of the Han Mansion grow more quickly, while also spending time with Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Ji Mingyue, Qiu Yueyao, and his other beloved wives and concubines.

chapters.title: Chapter 755
chapters.content:
Chapter 755: Chapter 286: The Thousand Path Tree Sapling, Marrying Qin Shiyin, The Han Mansion Genius Battle Begins_2 Chapter 755: Chapter 286: The Thousand Path Tree Sapling, Marrying Qin Shiyin, The Han Mansion Genius Battle Begins_2 —–
Every time such an occasion arose, Han Li would grandly embrace his delicate wife and beautiful concubines as they entered the ninth level of the Time-Sky Tower.
There, they would exchange and discuss philosophical insights, explore life aspirations, and carefully sip the profound truths of the Great Dao.
Occasionally, Han Li would also make his way to Xumi Mountain and enter the Little Western Heaven to find the female bodhisattva Han Linxi, which always lifted his spirits.
He found that keeping Han Linxi in Xumi Mountain was a very wise decision, as she continued to hold an enduring appeal for him.
Han Linxi was now several months pregnant and had ceased going out even from Little Western Heaven.
She spent all her days inside, only managing the affairs of Xumi Mountain through her incarnations, leaving a certain maiden in colorful robes astounded.
How could someone change so much in just a few months?
...
The maiden in colorful robes couldn’t understand it; she often conversed with the female bodhisattva, and listening to the “vulgar language” and exceedingly bold ideas from her, she felt herself becoming less pure.
On this day, Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain was once again decked out in lights and colors, hosting an immensely lavish wedding ceremony.
Han Li was about to wed the empress, Qin Shiyin.
This news had spread throughout the entire Yuankun Domain a month ago, and every force in the Eight Hundred Divine Regions and countless cultivators knew of it.
This put countless forces, including the Solar Empire and Tianji Pavilion, into “happy trouble.”
After Chengsheng Mountain took command of the whole Yuankun Domain, it continued its former style; other than establishing branches of Han Mansion across the Eight Hundred Divine Regions, it had not made any further major moves, to the excitement of countless forces.
However, Chengsheng Mountain’s supreme lord frequented taking wives and concubines, requiring each force to present a gift each time to maintain relations with Chengsheng Mountain, and countless forces outside Qianyuan Divine Province finally felt the troubles of being dominated.
Giving wedding gifts was also a matter of proportion, an art form.
The forces of the Yuankun Domain aimed to maintain their relationship with Chengsheng Mountain to avoid retribution, and at the same time, they strove to minimize their losses.
Thus, Yuankun Domain’s major forces, after collecting intel on the gifting methods of the major forces in Qianyuan Divine Province, decided to revise their approach slightly.
They could ignore the weddings and concubinage of Han Li’s descendants and need not travel millions of miles to present their congratulations.
When Han Li took a concubine, they would present an ordinary gift, based on the status of the concubine.
When Han Li took a wife, if she was of ordinary status, they would send a somewhat more precious gift; if she was one of Han Li’s valued wives, like a Heaven Imperial Realm empress, requiring grand arrangements, then they would send the best gift.
In doing so, they dramatically reduced the financial strain caused by gifting and still maintained a relationship with Chengsheng Mountain.
If they gained Han Li’s favor, they could obtain even more benefits.
Han Li’s marriage to Qin Shiyin was naturally a grand affair, with invitations sent out directly to the major forces of Yuankun Domain, inviting their leaders to join the celebration.
The day to wed Qin Shiyin had been set several months ago, and at that time, Han Li had wanted to clear Qin Shiyin’s name, so she wouldn’t have to bear the stigma created by the White Emperor.
But since the White Emperor had long been eliminated by him, there was no need to fuss about this matter anymore, and it had not been mentioned again.
After the wedding procedures had been followed, Qin Shiyin was escorted to her bridal chamberâ€”this would be their wedding room.
Han Li, however, did not go there right away.
He stayed in Yundao Hall to mingle with the various Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors and Quasi Empresses.
After three rounds of drinks, Han Li left with satisfaction.
After some mingling, Han Li had already received hints from several Quasi Empresses: if he sent a proposal, they were willing to marry him as Dao partners.
Outside Qin Shiyin’s bridal chamber, Han Li leisurely made his way there, entering with a smile on his face.
He was very much looking forward to this moment.
Qin Shiyin was the first Heaven Imperial Realm empress he had wed, and Han Li had never exchanged Dao with her, which meant she remained untouched to this day.
Everything was reserved for this day.
When Han Li entered the bridal chamber, he saw Qin Shiyin’s enchanting and exquisite figure.
Today, she was no longer in black robes and white silk but dressed in red bridal makeup.
The only difference was that the leg rings on her shapely long legs had changed from black to red.
Han Li was naturally thrilled with this.
“Lord Han, you’ve finally arrived~”
Qin Shiyin’s voice was tinged with shyness and filled with anticipation.
During this time, Qin Shiyin had already mentally prepared herself.
After the earlier wedding ceremony, she had been waiting to give herself to Han Li.
—–
After months of interaction, Han Li had shown remarkable comportment, coupled with various dazzling auras, which greatly increased Qin Shiyin’s favor towards him.
While she wasn’t in love with Han Li, she had no aversions to discussing the Dao with him anymore.
“Shiyin, I’ve been looking forward to this day for a long time….”
Han Li came to sit down beside Qin Shiyin, wrapping one arm around her soft and slender waist, speaking sweet nothings with deep affection.
Han Li was no longer as impatient as he used to be; he was now very familiar with the process.
While intimately whispering with Qin Shiyin, he started the prelude to their exchange of Dao.
Unconsciously, the two had become open and honest with each other; Han Li was explaining profound knowledge of the Dao to Qin Shiyin, penetrating and detailed.
…….
The next day,
Han Li finished his morning lesson with Qin Shiyin after discussing the Dao.
Qin Shiyin was somewhat exhausted and fell into a deep sleep.
Han Li then left the bedroom, heading to the summit of Chengdao Peak.
Taking advantage of the faint morning light, he first drew a breath of the morning’s purple qi, and then began his daily self-reflection.
After completing these rituals, Han Li sought out Feng Mian.
His delicate-featured and attractive wife from Juvenile Giant Peak had won his heart, and he couldn’t get enough of her.
Mainly, it was because Feng Mian had profound cultivation and a powerful physical body; she could battle with Han Li until the heavens turned dusky, the sun and moon lost their light, and discussing the Dao with her for years on end would not be a problem.
As time passed day by day, six days flew by in a blink of an eye.
On this day, Chengsheng Mountain was filled with noise and excitement as numerous descendants of the Han Mansion emerged from their seclusion, heading towards Battle Peak.
The annual Talent Battle of the Han Mansion was being held today.
Countless descendants of the Han Mansion and many others from within the mansion had gathered for the grand occasion.
Those who had registered to compete were warming up, displaying a variety of expressions, some smiling, some tense, some appearing calm…
Since the Talent Battle of the Han Mansion was divided into five groups based on cultivation stagesâ€”God Refining Realm, Hollow Void Stage, Myriad Phenomena Realm, True Martial Realm, and Divine Yuan Realmâ€”there were five battlefields set up on Battle Peak for the different groups to compete.
“Yong Ji, I heard you received a great reward from our father last time and that your strength has improved a lot in this period.
Are you confident about making it into the top ten?”
A young man in yellow battle armor with a crew cut approached Han Yongji, smiling warmly.
Han Yongji glanced at him, his expression unchanged as he replied indifferently, “Yong Hui, there’s no need for you to probe my strength; when we face each other, you’ll naturally find out how strong I am.”
The crew-cut young man was named Han Yonghui.
Though born of a concubine, he had a Royal physique and high aptitude, holding no lower status within the Han Mansion than the others.
Han Yongji did not like Han Yonghui, mainly because they did not get along, and there was friction between them.
Since the Han Mansion forbade kin-slaying and competition was permissible only within certain limits, the two would compete in other ways, with the annual Talent Battle being their biggest rivalry.
Han Yongji had also heard that Han Yonghui had encountered a stroke of luck outside a few months earlier, his cultivation reaching the pinnacle of the Myriad Phenomena Realm, with a significant increase in combat ability.
It seemed he aspired to make the top ten within the Myriad Phenomena Realm group.
However, Han Yongji was also very confident in his own strength.
He had cultivated the Emperor Level martial technique he had chosen to a minor level of accomplishment, and his combat ability had reached an astonishingly high level.
For this, he had paid a great price, as he had consistently been training in the Time-Sky Tower with extreme diligence, without any leisure whatsoever.
Han Yonghui’s eyes narrowed as he sensed Han Yongji’s dislike of him, but he did not take it to heart and simply said, “Yong Ji, it seems you are very confident about this Talent Battle.
I won’t disturb you any longer.”
Han Yonghui decisively left after achieving his purpose of confirming the rumors about Han Yongji.
Han Yongji watched Han Yonghui’s retreating figure, glanced at the few people standing with him, his eyes flickered, but he didn’t say anything.
He simply focused his gaze on the debating battlefield.
Two descendants of the Han Mansion from the Myriad Phenomena Realm were currently in combat.
…..

chapters.title: Chapter 756
chapters.content:
Chapter 756: Chapter 287: The Daily Life of a Charming Wife and Beautiful Concubines, The Dark Horse in the Genius Battle, Master of Lu Yuan Arrives_1 Chapter 756: Chapter 287: The Daily Life of a Charming Wife and Beautiful Concubines, The Dark Horse in the Genius Battle, Master of Lu Yuan Arrives_1 Cloud Ocean Immortal Palace.
Countless beautiful figures stood leaning on the railings, gathering in groups of threes and twos, conversing while watching the battle of geniuses at Battle Peak.
This Cloud Ocean Immortal Palace had been refined by Han Li in recent years.
As a Celestial Artifact Refiner, with enough materials at hand, constructing an Immortal Palace was a piece of cake for him.
Han Li didn’t just refine whimsical trinkets for amusement,
He mostly refined medicinal pills, weapons, talismans, and array plates, exclusively for those in the Heaven Imperial Realm and Heavenly Immortal Realm.
The rest he left to the Guest Elders of Chengsheng Mountain.
Now, there were many cultivators at Chengsheng Mountain who excelled in the four arts of cultivation; some even had attainments reaching the Quasi Emperor Realm.
...
Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Gongsun Yue together formed a dazzling sight, all of them wearing gentle smiles on their faces.
“Sister Xiangxiang, your Yong Ji is sure to make it into the top ten of the Myriad Phenomena Realm group this time, right?” Yun Miaoyi’s beautiful eyes shimmered with light.
“Yunyun, Yong Ji may be a shoo-in for the top ten of the Myriad Phenomena Realm group, but that’s hardly worth mentioning.
I heard your Yongting is aiming for the top ten of the True Martial Realm group?”
Lu Tianxiang crossed her arms, her ample chest heaving slightly with nonchalance.
“Yongting has only broken through to the True Martial Realm less than a year ago, right?
Isn’t it a bit too soon for him to aim for the top ten of the True Martial Realm group this year?” Gongsun Yue’s stunningly beautiful face flickered with surprise.
“Yue’er, Yongting possesses the Thunder War Body.
The Martial True Pill he has condensed has also reached the King Grade limit.
Although his cultivation is only at the mid-stage of the True Martial Realm, there is still hope for him to enter the top ten this year,”
Jiang Baiye said with a smile, dressed in a moon-white gown, resembling a serene fairy from the moon.
She flicked her jade hand on Gongsun Yue’s forehead, giggling.
“The number of individuals with King Grade and Emperor Grade physiques at our Chengsheng Mountain is increasing, though most are below the True Martial Realm.
Those with Emperor Grade physiques are mostly in the Divine Yuan Realm or higher.
This year, the competition in the True Martial Realm group will be less intense.”
Yun Miaoyi nodded slightly, her voice tinged with pride as she lifted her head.
“Look how proud you are.”
Jiang Baiye’s hand moved away from Gongsun Yue’s face and pulled Yun Miaoyi into a hug, nibbling gently on her tender earlobe and breathing softly into it.
Yun Miaoyi’s body momentarily softened, for this was her sensitive spot.
Rushing to get away from Jiang Baiye, she let out a whimper, “Jiang Baiye, are you playing the Void Phoenix game again?
Why don’t you just go and let your husband sate you?”
“Ha~ He’s such a busy man; he hardly has the time to accompany me alone…” Jiang Baiye pouted, sounding somewhat resentful.
Lu Tianxiang and Gongsun Yue looked on at the playful banter between Jiang Baiye and Yun Miaoyi, their lips curling into smiles, yet in their hearts sprang up two entirely different images; they had certainly played their share of games together, as well as with Han Li.
Elsewhere, Long Yue, Bai Keqing, Ling Lingshuang, and Xue Yueqing were also gathered, discussing the same topic.
Though they paid attention to the battle of geniuses, they didn’t take it too seriously.
It happened every year, and whether their children could break into the top ten depended on their own skills.
As wives and concubines of varying ranks, while their statuses differed, it hardly affected their offspring.
The descendants of the Han Mansion shared the same cultivation environment and treatment.
To gain better opportunities, they had to compete on their own merit, appeal to their husband, and be selected for focused or core cultivation lists.
Relatively speaking, they were more attentive to themselves; besides cultivating, spending time with their sisters, visiting offspring, they awaited their husband’s favor.
Unfortunately, with a husband who had numerous wives and concubines, even with the Time-Sky Tower, they were not favored many times a month, and those were typically shared moments.
Fortunately, their husband had now become more temperate, gradually decreasing the number of concubines he took.
It seemed unlikely they would gain many more sisters in the future.
After all, vast as the Yuankun Domain was, there were not many who met the criteria; one could scarcely be found among billions of cultivators.
Zi Miao Zhen, Yuan Youwei, and Ji Mingyue were also chatting, reminiscing about the past.
The glorious days had passed in the blink of an eye, but it was the tranquil days of recent years that lingered in memory.
The three stunning Quasi Empresses exchanged glances, each seeing in the other’s eyes a wistful reflection.
The past was irretrievable.
“I heard that this year’s rewards for the first place in each competition group have increased.
Did our husband bestow some fortunes obtained from the Xuxian Realm?”
Yuan Youwei’s lovely eyes swept over the Tongxuan Realm battlefield atop Battle Peak, her gaze sparkling as she suddenly spoke up.
Zi Miao Zhen and Ji Mingyue were slightly taken aback; upon deeper contemplation, Zi Miao Zhen glanced at Yuan Youwei meaningfully and said, “Indeed, our husband mentioned it once recently.”
With that, Zi Miao Zhen looked towards the Cloud Sea Heavenly Palace, where Han Li was indulging among the flowers, a hint of pride surfacing on her flawless face.
Her husband was not only the greatest genius of the Yuankun Domain from ancient times to the present, but he might also be the greatest talent throughout the entire Taichu Realm.
Her eldest son, Han Yongding, had recently sent a message from the Xuxian Realm with astounding news: the greatest fortune of Xuxian Realm legends had been taken by someone.
That day, the Immortal Jade Stone Tomb of Wendao Mountain appeared in the sky, its celestial light dazzling the Xuxian Realm, shaking the heavens.
All cultivators in the Xuxian Realm witnessed the terrifying sight.
A name suddenly appeared on the Wendao Mountain ranking and soared to the first position in an extraordinarily short time, eclipsing the ancients.
What was crucial was the line of golden text at the top of the ranking list.
First, Li Feiyu, a cultivator from the Crimson Heaven Court era, ten thousand steps!
Many cultivators in the Xuxian Realm were familiar with this name, which had suddenly emerged, breaking the ancient records of the Fire Qilin Cave and rumored to possess the combat ability of a peak Heavenly Immortal Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 757
chapters.content:
Chapter 757: Chapter 287: The Daily Life of a Charming Wife and Beautiful Concubines, The Dark Horse in the Genius Battle, Master of Lu Yuan Arrives_2 Chapter 757: Chapter 287: The Daily Life of a Charming Wife and Beautiful Concubines, The Dark Horse in the Genius Battle, Master of Lu Yuan Arrives_2 In less than half a day, more records were consecutively shattered, refreshing all the major rankings of the Xuxian Realm and claiming the top spot, seizing various great fortunes.
Not even Wendao Mountain could stop Li Feiyu; he directly ascended to the top.
His talent, flair, and potential were incredibly shockingâ€”unmatched throughout history.
Since the era of the Thirty-six Heavenly Courts, countless renowned Immortal Emperors have emerged, shaking the Three Thousand Realms, yet none have eclipsed the fame of Li Feiyu.
On the contrary, Li Feiyu soared above countless Immortal Emperors, instantly becoming the center of attention and creating a sensation throughout the entire Taichu Realm.
From the Emperor of Heaven in the Chiming Heavenly Court to the common cultivators in the Taichu Domain, all came to know the name of Li Feiyu.
Among the top ten on the Wendao Ranking are the supreme Immortal Emperors of the Taichu Realm both ancient and modernâ€”Yu Kunlun, Zhan Wushuang, Dao Wuya…
...
Some have perished, but others are still alive.
Speaking of the highest-ranking individual on the Wendao Ranking who is closest to their era, that person would be Meng Qingyao, ranked ninety-eighth.
This female cultivator from the Longhan Heavenly Court period surpassed all in talent and flair throughout history, astonishing for all time.
She ascended to Immortal Emperor during the Longhan Heavenly Court period in just under a hundred epochs.
From the Longhan Heavenly Court era to the present Chiming Heavenly Court period, Meng Qingyao’s fame remains undiminished.
The upper echelons of the major Dao orders and the unparalleled prodigies all know her as the Lord of Guanghan Heaven, the Guanghan Empress.
She alone fought her way through the Three Thousand Realms, single-handedly dominated the Eighty Thousand Domains, subdued the heavens with her fists, and pushed through the Myriad Realm, defeating and slaying numerous Immortal Emperors.
Her renown spread far and wide throughout the heavens and myriad realms.
The Guanghan Empress could claim to be the most dazzling cultivator in talent and flair from the middle period of the Longhan Heavenly Court to the Chiming Heavenly Court era in the Taichu Realm.
Even the current Chiming Heavenly Emperor does not shine as brightly as the Guanghan Empress; the Chiming Heavenly Emperor ascended to Immortal Emperor much earlier but is said to have done so at the end of the Wantong Heavenly Court era.
However, as Li Feiyu refreshed the records in the Xuxian Realm and reached the peak of Wendao Mountain, the talent and flair of the Guanghan Empress could only rank her second among those who emerged since the middle period of the Longhan Heavenly Court.
As everyone knows, second place is just thatâ€”second.
Soon after, all major Dao orders in the Taichu Realm heard a piece of news that the Guanghan Empress had issued a statement: she wished to battle Li Feiyu in the Heaven Imperial Realm.
Regardless of the outcome, she was willing to take Li Feiyu into the Guanghan Immortal Palace and cultivate him with all her might.
What brilliant sparks would fly from the battle between Li Feiyu and the Guanghan Empress in the Heaven Imperial Realm?
Countless cultivators in the Taichu Realm were looking forward to it, but unfortunately, Li Feiyu had already vanished without a trace, not to be seen again during that time.
People outside didn’t know who Li Feiyu was; Han Yongding was also unclear.
He just felt the name sounded familiar, as if he had heard it somewhere before.
But after Han Yongding mentioned it to his mother, Zi Miaozhen, she instantly knew.
After marrying Han Li, she naturally learned about her husband’s past and knew that there was a time when Han Li went by the name Li Feiyu.
Coupled with the fact that her husband had entered the Xuxian Realm during the same period when Li Feiyu’s name was causing a sensation there, Zi Miaozhen was certain that the Li Feiyu in the Xuxian Realm was none other than her own husband.
Based on her husband’s character, he certainly wouldn’t have used his real name for such fame-seeking endeavors.
Not long after learning this news, and before Zi Miaozhen could inquire, Han Li casually shared some details about the Xuxian Realm with her the following day while they were dual cultivating.
Zi Miaozhen also seized the moment to ask, and Han Li did not deliberately hold back, directly informing Zi Miaozhen.
Ji Mingyue continued the conversation, adding, “My husband indeed mentioned that the greatest fortune was to be obtained by the one who ranked first in the True Martial Realm competition.”
Although there had been some unpleasantness with Yuan Youwei in the past, those grievances had long been resolved, and the two shared a deep bond, often standing together as comrades-in-arms on the battlefield.
Her husband had also mentioned it, albeit not in detail, but Ji Mingyue understood the situation.
Her eldest son Han Yongming had just returned from the Xuxian Realm yesterday to participate in the genius battle and had shared the significant news of the Xuxian Realm with her.
Ji Mingyue knew what Yuan Youwei implied, but it didn’t concern her.
Their eldest sons were both at the Tao-mysterious Realm level, and it was uncertain who would take first place.
Yuan Youwei’s eldest son Han Yongyuan had the Bi Luo Emperor Body, her own eldest son Han Yongming initially had the Great Sun King Body, and Zi Miaozhen’s eldest son Han Yongding initially had the Dusk King Body.
In the beginning, Yuan Youwei’s status was lowly, yet that did not prevent Han Yongyuan from receiving the best cultivation.
Han Li provided Han Yongyuan with plentiful resources.
Han Yongyuan did not disappoint Han Li’s expectations; he cultivated with great diligence.
He was very sensible from an early age and aware of his mother Yuan Youwei’s situation, holding no resentment.
“`
He merely worked hard at cultivation, hoping that once he made progress, he could secure a higher status and better welfare for his mother, and he succeeded.
Han Yongyuan had now reached the Fifth Heaven of the Tongxuan Realm.
Among the descendants of the Han Mansion, there weren’t many with a higher cultivation level than his, only Han Yongzhen and a few others.
But Ji Mingyue and Murong Ying did not feel their children were inferior.
Han Yongding and Han Yongming, despite their inferior physique in the early stages to Han Yongyuan, were granted many additional cultivation resources by Murong Ying and Ji Mingyue, whose status was much higher than Yuan Youwei’s, at the expense of their own share.
Later on, the husband also took action to evolve the physique of Han Yongding and Han Yongming one after another into that of Emperors.
In terms of cultivation, Han Yongding and Han Yongming were not inferior to Han Yongyuan, and their talents and physiques were also comparable.
Who among Han Yongding, Han Yongming, and Han Yongyuan would take first place would still depend on their ultimate combat ability and the level of their Divine Sense.
Besides, Ji Mingyue didn’t think the chances of Han Yongding, Han Yongming, and Han Yongyuan taking first place were very high.
Instead, she was more optimistic about Lu Tianxiang’s eldest son, Han Yongzhen.
Among the descendants of the Han Mansion in the Tongxuan Realm, Han Yongzhen’s cultivation was the highest, and his strength was unfathomable.
Although initially Han Yongzhen lacked talent and physique, he was the legitimate eldest son of the husband, and his treatment was subtly superior.
After being born with the Dusk King Body, he was the first to evolve from a King Body to an Emperor Body.
Ji Mingyue and Lu Tianxiang also had a good relationship, having supported each other in the past.
Through Lu Tianxiang, Ji Mingyue knew some hidden details about Han Yongzhen.
For instance, the foundational level of the martial concepts that Han Yongzhen perceived in the Hollow Void Stage was very high….
In the central area of Cloudsea Heavenly Palace.
Han Li roamed among the pools of wine and forests of meat, tasting various delicious fruits while also drinking milk; he enjoyed playing with fish too.
Although he did not exchange Daoist teachings with them, Han Li allowed them to eat at the buffet and tried to hone their skills in various wonderful places.
He also kept an eye on the geniuses battling at Battle Peak, but with his cultivation, a mere wisp of his Divine Sense was enough to see everything clearly.
In this year’s battle of geniuses, after numerous contests and discussions across five groups, he knew precisely who made errors, who performed mediocrely, who exceeded expectations, and who had breakthroughs during the battle.
As for the rankings of the descendants, Han Li did not care at all.
Whoever made it into the top ten or who won first place was fine; they were all his descendants.
The purpose of the battle of geniuses was multifaceted: on one hand, to further select outstanding talents; on the second, to give some of the more ordinary descendants a platform to stand out; and on the third, to observe the cultivation conditions of the descendants through the battle.
After each battle of geniuses, Han Li would gather all participating descendants to clear their doubts and provide guidance and understanding, allowing them to make better progress.
As time passed, this year’s battle of geniuses also came to a close, bringing joy to some and sorrow to others.
In the five group battles, the five candidates that Han Li favored for first place only saw three succeed.
The Myriad Phenomena Realm group and the Divine Yuan Realm group both saw dark horses emerge, with two descendants who were typically quiet suddenly rising notably.
Han Yongji fought his way to the fifth place in the Myriad Phenomena Realm battle of geniuses.
Although he didn’t reach his goal of breaking into the top three, he achieved his aim of securing a top-five spot.
In the True Martial Realm battle of geniuses, Han Yongting successfully claimed second place, and this year’s first place went to Yao Xi’s fourth son, Han Yongyi.
In the battle of geniuses of the Tongxuan Realm, Han Yongzhen lived up to expectations and took first place, with Yao Xi’s eldest son, Han Yongqian, taking second and Murong Ying’s eldest son, Han Yongmu, taking third.
Han Yongming, Han Yongding, and Han Yongyuan only managed to break into the top ten.
Yuan Youwei was somewhat disappointed, while Murong Ying and Ji Mingyue were quite calm about it.
After the battle of geniuses ended, Han Li’s Divine Sense avatar personally distributed this year’s opportunities and fortunes to the participants, sending ripples throughout the Han Mansion.
The rumors proved trueâ€”the rewards were even better this year.
In the following three days, Han Li summoned batches of descendants who participated in the battle of geniuses, providing guidance and resolving their confusions, pointing out their various inadequacies during the battle.
On the fourth day, Han Li received an unexpected piece of news from his beloved wife, Lu Yuan.
It was not that Lu Yuan was about to give birth; rather, her master, a Quasi Emperor known as Shi Mengyan, had arrived at Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 758
chapters.content:
Chapter 758: Chapter 288: Lu Yuan’s ulterior motives, Shi Mengyan knocked out, Han Li’s decision regarding Liu Yuexin and the other five concubines_1 Chapter 758: Chapter 288: Lu Yuan’s ulterior motives, Shi Mengyan knocked out, Han Li’s decision regarding Liu Yuexin and the other five concubines_1 “`
Chengdao Peak towered majestically, soaring splendidly and reaching straight into the Nine Heavens.
Above the clouds, two figures stood tall, leisurely gazing down upon the splendid tapestry of the world’s mountains and rivers.
“Husband, do you want to meet my master?”
Draped in a gorgeous light yellow dress, Liu Yuexin snuggled into her lover’s embrace, only after relaying the important news did she nervously ask.
All this time, she had returned to Liangjie Mountain several times just to persuade her master to come to Chengsheng Mountain.
Thanks to her relentless efforts, her master had recently changed her mind and crossed the Han Sea with her to enter Chengsheng Mountain, now waiting for an audience with her husband.
If the husband refused to see her, then all the effort she had put in over the past few months would have been in vain, and her master would return disappointed and deflated, impacting even Liangjie Mountain itself.
This was unacceptable to Liu Yuexin.
...
On Chengsheng Mountain, she felt somewhat isolated; although she could converse with anyone, she had no close friends, as they all had their own cliques.
Struggling to blend into the sisterhoods, Liu Yuexin made plans on two fronts: on one hand, getting along well with the newly-arrived sisters on Chengsheng Mountain, intending to find an opportunity to bear arms together.
On the other hand, Liu Yuexin looked for external support, and the best support was her own master, who was not only breathtakingly beautiful but also a Quasi Emperor, and most importantly, shared a teacher-disciple relationship with her.
Although she had only been on Chengsheng Mountain for a few months, Liu Yuexin carefully observed that aside from a few sisters, others with special relationships were more favored, like the teacher-disciple pair Zhang Lan and Zhang Yuyanâ€”though only concubines, they were as pampered as any ordinary wife.
There were also the multiple births and some other relationships that were not easy to describe, which were favored by their husband.
Should her master succeed in joining them, she and her master, uniting their swords, would surely carve out a place for themselves on Chengsheng Mountain.
Liangjie Mountain was only a Quasi Emperor Rank power; it was far from comparable to Chengsheng Mountain, which was openly the First Power in Yuan Kun Realm, before whom countless Heavenly Governing Forces bowed in submission.
As one of the ladies of Chengsheng Mountain, Liu Yuexin had a rather clear understanding of its heritage, while not knowing everything, she grasped much of it.
What Chengsheng Mountain displayed to the outside world paled in comparison to the immense depth of its resources.
In the future, Chengsheng Mountain’s status in Yuan Kun Realm would not diminish; instead, it would only rise higher and higher.
Only by embracing Chengsheng Mountain could one have a better future; Liu Yuexin saw this clearly before she resolutely married into it.
And indeed, her decision proved to be very right.
On Chengsheng Mountain, becoming a Heavenly Immortal Great Emperor in the future wouldn’t be difficult for her.
And with the recent unveiling of that treasure by her husband, her prospects of becoming a Heavenly Immortal, or even a True Immortal, were also promising.
These were the core secrets of Chengsheng Mountain, which Liu Yuexin, of course, dared not reveal, not even to her master Shi Mengyan.
Thus Liu Yuexin skirted around the issue, speaking vaguely and ambiguously, leaving Shi Mengyan unsure and therefore hesitant to agree.
As a Quasi Emperor, Shi Yanmeng had her own pride; even though Han Li had become invincible in the Endless Yuankun Domain, she would not easily surrender herself.
Recently, Han Li’s marriage to the Heavenly Governing female emperor Qin Shiyin had shaken the entire Endless Yuankun Domain.
However, Liu Yuexin wasn’t focused on these events, but rather their potential implicationsâ€”it meant that her husband would, in due course, welcome other female emperors from the Heavenly Governing Forces.
If her master didn’t marry into their family promptly, once Chengsheng Mountain had an abundance of female emperors from the Heavenly Governing Forces, then even if her master Shi Yanmeng married into the family later, it would seem commonplace and not attract much attention.
In that case, the advantage of bringing in her master would be significantly diluted; Liu Yuexin did not want to see this happen.
It was vital to get her master Shi Mengyan married into the family before other empresses from the Heavenly Governing Forces did, as this would pique her husband’s interest.
This was favorable for Liu Yuexin, for if both she and her master were favored, their positions both on Chengsheng Mountain and in the Yuan Kun Realm would rise, bringing more benefits and leading to greater heights in the future.
Although her husband claimed to treat all his wives and concubines equally, with the same basic welfare and benefits, favoritism still had a significant impact.
Those favored might receive the same things first, while the less favored would get them later, which would also indirectly affect how they nurtured their offspring.
Hence, Liu Yuexin returned to Liangjie Mountain a few days earlier, had a long and earnest conversation with Shi Yanmeng about the pros and cons, and made some guarantees, which finally led Shi Yanmeng to agree.
“Yu’er has even called your master over, how could your husband not meet her?”
Han Li embraced Liu Yuexin, biting her rosy earlobe, gently exhaling, his hands involuntarily climbing her substantial bosom.
A few months into Liu Yuexin’s pregnancy, her bosom had grown from a C to a D cup.
“Thank you, husband~”
Liu Yuexin turned around, her flawless jade arms wrapping around Han Li’s neck, tiptoeing closer.
Han Li attacked without reservation, deeply engaging with Liu Yuexin in a might-have-led-to-a-conflagration kind of way.
“Ahem~”
At that moment, a light cough sounded, snapping the two out of their reverie.
Shi Mengyan was somewhat helpless; how did she end up witnessing such a scene upon arrival, and why had her usually reserved and aloof disciple turned into this?
“Master~”
Liu Yuexin quickly disengaged from Han Li’s magical mouth, her cheeks flushed, and walked over to Shi Mengyan’s side, taking her master’s tender hand in her right, while clutching her dress in the left.
She felt somewhat shy.
Having been immersed in the moment, she had forgotten that she’d messaged her master, resulting in her master witnessing that scene, which might have turned her master’s perception of her upside down.
But perhaps this was also good; this way, it would be easier for her to bring up that matter.

She thought of first letting her master Shi Mengyan marry into the family, and then by that time, her master would also agree to stand by her side in battle.
Han Li smiled.
He had noticed Shi Mengyan long ago and had deliberately let Shi Mengyan see him.
Han Li was crystal clear about what Lu Yuan was up to, and it was exactly what he wanted.
Clad in a light purple palace dress, Shi Mengyan’s beauty and stature were flawless, reminiscent of a heavenly nymph, with a temperament that set her apart from Lu Yuan, yet in a way that complemented each other.
Quietly being pulled along by Lu Yuan, Shi Mengyan was sizing up Han Li with a serene gaze, not showing any timidity due to Han Li’s status.
...
This was her first encounter with Han Li.
She was the master of Liangjie Mountain, one of the two Quasi Emperor Rank powers of Luming Divine Province, which bordered Qianyuan Divine Province, separated only by the Han Sea.
Han Li had taken wives and concubines many times, and each time Shi Mengyan had only sent a Saint Abyss realm powerhouse from her subordinates to participate while she herself had never come.
It was because she had reservations in her heart.
Her disciple Lu Yuan often came to persuade her to marry Han Li, but Shi Mengyan had not made up her mind, so she had never come.
Now that she had made up her mind, she came.
Shi Mengyan found that Han Li was somewhat different from what she had imagined, different from the rumors, and somewhat unlike what Lu Yuan had described.
“I’ll just call you Mengyan,” Han Li said, breaking the silence, “Since you’re here, from now on, we are all one family.”
Shi Mengyan’s eyes flashed as she nodded gently.
Yet in her heart, she couldn’t help but sigh : she had still chosen this shortcut.
Afterward, Han Li and Shi Mengyan conversed, with Lu Yuan not saying much, chiming in only occasionally.
Han Li was very forthright, detailing the treatment Shi Mengyan would receive after marrying him, and on the spot, he presented her with treasures, which practically stunned her.
Although Lu Yuan had told her beforehand that this might happen, Shi Mengyan had been somewhat incredulous, but now the reality had truly shaken her.
Han Li was far too generous!
Not to mention the promises made, just the Imperial Realm Treasures and Heavenly Immortal Realm Treasures before her eyes were enough to astonish Shi Mengyan.
Han Li chatted with Shi Mengyan for a while more before leaving, leaving Lu Yuan behind to keep her master company.
Seeing her somewhat disoriented master, Lu Yuan called out, “Master?
Master~”
Shi Mengyan glanced at her, smiled bitterly and said, “Yuan’er, if you had explained it to me clearly earlier, I would have agreed long ago.”
Shi Mengyan did not find this shameful.
Her previous hesitation was mainly because she was worried about her treatment after marrying Han Li since he really had too many cherished wives and concubines.
Even if she wanted to cultivate with Han Li, she would have to wait in a long line.
But after hearing Han Li’s earlier words, Shi Mengyan realized she had been overthinking it.
What she could think of, Han Li had already considered, and what she didn’t think of, Han Li had also prepared for her.
For her as a woman, finding someone to rely on wasn’t a bad thing; it was just that there had been no suitable one before.
“Master, there are some things I can’t speak of,” Lu Yuan sighed with a sense of helplessness.
Knowing was one thing, but being able to talk about it was another.
If she had spoken out, Lu Yuan was certain her husband would have come to know.
Disobedience would mean no good days for her in the future.
Shi Mengyan nodded in understanding of Lu Yuan’s predicament.
Naturally, such conditions could not be disclosed carelessly.
The master and disciple chatted for a long time, sharing their innermost thoughts, and finally, Lu Yuan invited her master Shi Mengyan to her chamber to spend the night together.
She intended to inform her master in bed of the prepared excuses.
Elsewhere, after leaving Chengdao Peak, Han Li went straight to Yuandao Peak.
Yuandao Peak was a subsidiary peak Han Li created later with his great mana, not open to the public and only accessible to him and his cherished wives and concubines, being one of the forbidden areas of Chengsheng Mountain.
Several wives, including Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin, were already waiting there.
Upon Han Li’s arrival, Liu Yuexin, Lin Yiwu, Qiu Yueyao, and the other ladies hurriedly greeted him, joyously calling him “Husband”.
They had come here because Han Li notified them to gather, mentioning an important decision to inform them of, which was good news for them.
So the ladies came early with eager anticipation, sharing speculations among themselves as to why their husband had summoned them here, but they were clueless.
“Yuexin, Mingmeng, Yueyao, Yiwu, Yiyin.”
Han Li embraced Li Mingmeng with one arm and Qiu Yueyao with the other, then lay on the wide, soft chair, with Liu Yuexin, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin attending to him, kneading his legs, giving massages, squeezing his shoulders…
Li Mingmeng and Qiu Yueyao weren’t idle either; they each had their duties.
Han Li enjoyed himself for a while, his eyes sweeping over the expectant, pretty faces of his five beautiful concubines, but he did not speak.
“My lord, why did you summon us here?
Stop keeping us in suspense, tell us~”
Lin Yiyin couldn’t hold back any longer, using her once again enlarged “super-size granary” to press against Han Li, endlessly acting coquettishly.
“My lord~”
Li Mingmeng, Liu Yuexin, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and the others also began to inquire one after another.
Han Li kissed each of them before speaking at last, “You’ve been married to me for quite a while, haven’t you?”
The five women were slightly stunned, not understanding why their husband would suddenly mention this.
“My lord, it has been one hundred and thirty-two years.”
Liu Yuexin was the first to speak, a reminiscent look on her lovely face.
She was the first concubine Han Li had taken, and also the one who had been with Han Li the longest.
Thinking back to those days, Liu Yuexin couldn’t help but sigh; she could never have imagined she would have today, it all felt too fantastic, everything was given to her by the man before her eyes.
She had a Holy Abyss Realm cultivation level, she had a lifespan of a hundred thousand years, she also had many outstanding descendants, she held a very high status in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Previously, her looks and figure could barely be considered top-notch in Lingjun City, but in the Daqian Empire, Qianyuan Divine Province, and even the Endless Yuankun Domain, she was nothing special, an ordinary person among the masses.
Now, her appearance, figure, temperament, and so on, all had undergone earth-shaking changes.
Even among the beauties vying for fame at Chengsheng Mountain or throughout the entire Yuankun Domain, her beauty would be remarkable.
“My lord, I’ve also been with you for eighty-seven years.” Li Mingmeng was the second to speak, her flawless face also full of memories.
“My lord….”
Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, Lin Yiyin also spoke one after another, each stating a number.
They had been with Han Li for seventy to eighty years as well.
Like Liu Yuexin, they too had experienced tremendous changes in all aspects.
Han Li nodded slightly, various memories coming to mind.
The early days were naturally not any heroic epoch, just simple and plain.
After descending Tianxuan Mountain, he had established the Han Family and began to branch out.
From Liu Yuexin to Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, the sister flowers, he had taken over a dozen concubines in total.
Among these concubines, Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin were his most favored; the rest, like Wu Yalin, were much less so.
As for the later-taken twin sisters Chu Yutong and Chu Yumeng, the triplets Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhixuan, Zhou Zhirou, and other concubines, Han Li did not consider them this time.
“Yuexin, Mingmeng, Yueyao, Yiwu, Yiyin, I’ve called you here this time to announce a decision,” Han Li said gently, looking around at the five beautiful concubines.
“My lord, please tell us, we are ready.”
Liu Yuexin, Qiu Yueyao, and the other women couldn’t help but sit up straight, their hearts thumping with anticipation, very curious about their lord’s decision.
“In three days, I will prepare a promotion ceremony for you, promoting you five from concubines to official wives,” Han Li said in one breath.
Upon hearing this, the five women were stunned, and then their faces lit up with excitement and joy, among other positive emotions.
“My lord, are you serious?”
“My lord, I have been waiting for this day for so long.”
“My lord….”
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin couldn’t contain their excitement, chattering nonstop, expressing their joy.
As some of the earliest concubines of Han Li, they had naturally fantasized about being promoted to official wives, and there had been such precedents in Han Mansion before, like with Yuan Youwei.
But Yuan Youwei was much stronger than them in many aspects, and there was a special reason for her low status initially, so they had only dreamt about it.
They never expected the surprise to come so suddenly.
“Of course, it’s true.”
“My lord, let’s go discuss the Dao on the ninth floor of the Time-Sky Tower tonight.”
“My lord, let’s go now~”

A few months into her pregnancy, Liu Yuexin’s baby granaries went from c to d.

Liu Yuexin quickly escaped Han Li’s captivating lips, her cheeks flushed as she walked over to Shi Mengyan, holding her master’s soft hand with her right and pinching her skirt with the left.
She felt a bit embarrassed.
Lost in the moment earlier, she had forgotten to communicate telepathically with her master, causing her to witness such a scene, possibly upsetting the image she had built in her master’s mind.
But perhaps, it was a blessing in disguise, as it would make it easier for her to bring up that matter.

Chapter 762: Chapter 288: Lu Yuan’s ulterior motives, Shi Mengyan knocked out, Han Li’s decision regarding Liu Yuexin and the other five concubines_1 Chapter 762: Chapter 288: Lu Yuan’s ulterior motives, Shi Mengyan knocked out, Han Li’s decision regarding Liu Yuexin and the other five concubines_1 Chengdao Peak stood towering and splendid, its majestic height reaching into the Nine Heavens.
Above the clouds, two figures stood tall, looking down leisurely and contentedly at the magnificent scenery of the world below.
“Husband, do you want to meet Master?”
Clad in a gorgeous light yellow dress, Liu Yuexin nestled in her lover’s arms.
After delivering the important news, she asked tentatively.
For some time now, she had returned to Liangjie Mountain several times, all to persuade her Master to come to Chengsheng Mountain.
Thanks to her relentless efforts, Master had recently changed her mind.
She crossed the Han Sea with Liu Yuexin, entered Chengsheng Mountain, and was now waiting for her husband’s summons.
...
If her husband chose not to meet with her, then not only would Liu Yuexin’s efforts over the past few months have been in vain, but her Master would return disappointed and dismayed, and even Liangjie Mountain would be affected.
This was something Liu Yuexin could not accept.
On Chengsheng Mountain, she was isolated and without allies.
Though she could exchange a few words with anyone, she had no close sisters; all of them had their own circles.
As she could not easily fit into the elder sisters’ circles, Liu Yuexin made preparations on two fronts.
On one hand, she fostered good relations with the newly married sisters of Chengsheng Mountain, planning to join forces with them when the opportunity arose.
On the other hand, Liu Yuexin sought support from outside, and the best help was her Master.
Her Master was extremely beautiful and a Quasi Emperor.
Most importantly, she was Liu Yuexin’s teacher.
Although she had been at Chengsheng Mountain for only a few months, Liu Yuexin had keenly observed that, aside from a few sisters, those with special relationships were favored more, such as the teacher-disciple pair Zhang Lan and Zhang Yuyan.
Despite being concubines, they were no less favored than ordinary wives.
There were also twins and some relationships that were difficult to describe, all greatly favored by her husband.
As long as her Master successfully married in, the two of them, master and disciple, could combine their strengths and surely secure a place for themselves on Chengsheng Mountain.
Liangjie Mountain was merely a Quasi Emperor Rank force, far from comparable to Chengsheng Mountain.
On the surface, Chengsheng Mountain was the First Power in Yuan Kun Realm, with countless Heavenly Governing Forces bowing their heads in subservience.
As one of the main ladies of Chengsheng Mountain, Liu Yuexin had a relatively clear understanding of its heritage.
She might not know everything, but she was well-informed.
The foundation of Chengsheng Mountain was many times deeper than what was shown to the outside world.
In the future, the status of Chengsheng Mountain in the Yuan Kun Realm would not only not weaken but would rise even higher.
Only by embracing Chengsheng Mountain could one have a better future.
Liu Yuexin had seen this clearly a long time ago and decided to marry into it resolutely.
The truth had proven her decision to be very correct.
At Chengsheng Mountain, it wouldn’t be difficult for her to become a Heavenly Imperial Realm Great Emperor in the future.
And with the treasured item her husband had recently presented, her chances of becoming a Heavenly Immortal or even a True Immortal were very promising.
These were the core secrets of Chengsheng Mountain, and of course, Liu Yuexin dared not reveal themâ€”not even if Shi Mengyan was her Master.
Therefore, what Liu Yuexin told her was ambiguous and vague, leaving Shi Mengyan uncertain and hesitant to agree.
As a Quasi Emperor, Shi Yanmeng had her pride.
Even though Han Li had become invincible in the Yuan Kun Realm, she would not easily surrender.
Recently, Han Li’s marriage to the Heavenly Imperial Realm Empress Qin Shiyin had shaken the Endless Yuan Kun Realm.
However, Liu Yuexin’s focus was not on these matters, but rather on the potential implications that they signifiedâ€”that her husband would continue to marry other Heavenly Governing Female Emperors in the future.
If her Master did not marry in now, by the time Chengsheng Mountain had more Heavenly Governing Female Emperors, Shi Yanmeng’s entrance would seem ordinary and she would not receive much attention.
In that case, the benefit of bringing her Master in would be greatly diminished.
Liu Yuexin did not want to see that happen.
It was imperative to have Shi Mengyan marry in before other Heavenly Governing ladies did, thereby piquing her husband’s interest.
This was advantageous for Liu Yuexin.
If both master and disciple were favored, their status on Chengsheng Mountain and in Yuan Kun Realm would be higher, they would receive more benefits, and they could reach greater heights in the future.
Although her husband claimed to treat all his wives and concubines equally and provided the same basic welfare and benefits, being favored or not still had a significant impact.
The same resources might be given first to the favored wives and later to the less favored ones, which would also indirectly affect their cultivation of their offspring.
So, a few days earlier, Liu Yuexin returned to Liangjie Mountain and after a long heart-to-heart with Shi Yanmeng, analyzing the pros and cons, and making certain promises, Shi Yanmeng agreed.
“Yu’er has invited your Master all the way here, how could I not meet with her?”
Han Li held Liu Yuexin close, nibbling on her pink earlobe, exhaling softly, his hands inevitably playing with her granaries.
A few months into her pregnancy, the twin granaries had grown from c to d.
“Thank you, husband~”
Liu Yuexin turned around, her flawless jade arms encircling Han Li’s neck, her toes standing on tiptoe as she leaned in closer.
Han Li took the initiative, savoring the moment with Liu Yuexin, nearly igniting a blazing fire between them.
“Ahem~”
At that moment, a light cough reached them, snapping the pair out of their reverie.
Shi Mengyan was somewhat helpless; how had she come upon such a scene, witnessing her dignified and reserved disciple from Liangjie Mountain transformed into this?
“Master~”
Liu Yuexin quickly pulled away from Han Li’s enchanting mouth, her cheeks blushing as she walked over to Shi Mengyan, holding her Master’s tender hand with her right and clutching her skirt with her left.
She felt somewhat shy.
Immersed in the moment, she had forgotten to send a telepathic message to her Master, resulting in her Master witnessing such a scene, which probably overturned her image in her Master’s mind.
But perhaps it was a blessing in disguise, as it would now be easier to discuss that matter.

chapters.title: Chapter 763
chapters.content:
Chapter 763: Chapter 288: Lu Yuan’s ulterior motives, Shi Mengyan knocked out, Han Li’s decision regarding Liu Yuexin and the other five concubines_2 Chapter 763: Chapter 288: Lu Yuan’s ulterior motives, Shi Mengyan knocked out, Han Li’s decision regarding Liu Yuexin and the other five concubines_2 Lu Yuan didn’t speak out yet because she feared her master would not agree.
She thought to first let her master Shi Mengyan marry into the family and then discuss the matter further; by that time, her master would also agree to stand by her side in battle.
Han Li smiled.
He had indeed noticed Shi Mengyan earlier and had deliberately allowed her to see that.
What Lu Yuan was planning, Han Li understood all too well, and this was exactly what he wanted.
Shi Mengyan, dressed in a light purple palace gown, was flawless in both beauty and posture, like a celestial maiden, her aura distinctly different from Lu Yuan’s, yet complementary in some ways.
Despite being pulled by the gentle Lu Yuan, Shi Mengyan took the time to size up Han Li, her gaze calm, showing no timidity despite Han Li’s status.
...
This was the first time she had met Han Li in person.
She was the master of Liangjie Mountain, one of the two Quasi Emperor Rank powers in Luming Divine Province, which was adjacent to Qianyuan Divine Province with only the Han Sea between them.
Han Li had taken wives and concubines many times before, and each time Shi Mengyan sent just one of her Saint Abyss Realm warriors to participate; she herself had never come.
She had hesitations in her heart, and since her disciple Lu Yuan often came to persuade her to marry Han Li, Shi Mengyan, not yet decided, had thus kept her distance.
Now that she had made up her mind, she came.
Shi Mengyan discovered that Han Li was somewhat different from what she had imagined.
He diverged from the rumors, and even Lu Yuan’s descriptions didn’t quite match up.
“I’ll just call you Mengyan then.
Now that you’re here, we’re family from now on,”
Han Li spoke first, breaking the heavy silence.
Shi Mengyan’s gaze flickered slightly as she nodded lightly.
But inside, she couldn’t help but sigh.
She had still taken this shortcut.
Afterward, Han Li and Shi Mengyan conversed while Lu Yuan remained mostly silent, occasionally adding a word or two.
Han Li was very upfront about the benefits that would come with Shi Mengyan marrying him and even presented her with treasures on the spot, leaving her astonished.
Although Lu Yuan had told her beforehand that this might happen, Shi Mengyan had been somewhat skeptical.
Now that it was actually happening, she was completely taken aback.
Han Li was incredibly generous!
Not to mention the promises he had made, just the Imperial Realm Treasures and Heavenly Immortal Realm Treasures he presented right then were enough to astonish Shi Mengyan.
Han Li chatted with Shi Mengyan for a while longer before leaving, leaving Lu Yuan behind to keep her master company.
Watching her master, who seemed somewhat distraught, Lu Yuan called out, “Master?
Master~”
Shi Mengyan glanced at her and chuckled bitterly, “Yuan’er, if you had explained things to me earlier, I would have agreed much sooner.”
Shi Mengyan did not feel ashamed.
Her hesitation was mainly due to concerns about her treatment after marrying Han Li, as Han Li truly had too many wives and concubines.
Even if she wanted to cultivate with Han Li, she would have to wait in a long line.
But after hearing what Han Li said earlier, Shi Mengyan realized she had been overthinking.
Everything she could think of, Han Li had already considered, and for what she had not anticipated, Han Li had also prepared.
As a woman, finding a reliable partner wasn’t a bad thing; she simply hadn’t found the right match before.
“Master, there are some things I couldn’t say.” Lu Yuan sighed helplessly.
Knowing something is one thing, but being able to speak of it is another.
If she were to divulge it, Lu Yuan was certain her husband would find out.
Without adherence to rules, she wouldn’t have a good life in the future.
Shi Mengyan nodded, understanding Lu Yuan’s predicament.
Such terms certainly couldn’t be disclosed carelessly.
The master and disciple talked for a long time, sharing their inner thoughts.
In the end, Lu Yuan invited her master Shi Mengyan to her own sleeping chamber to spend the night together.
She wanted to share the prepared justifications with her master in bed.
Meanwhile, after leaving Chengdao Peak, Han Li went straight to Yuandao Peak.
Yuandao Peak was a subsidiary peak later created by Han Li using great mana.
It was not open to outsiders; only he and his cherished wives and concubines could enter, making it one of the forbidden areas of Chengsheng Mountain.
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, Lin Yiyin, and several other wives and concubines were already waiting there.
Upon Han Li’s arrival, Liu Yuexin, Lin Yiwu, Qiu Yueyao, and the other ladies hurriedly greeted him, joyfully calling out “Husband.”
The reason for their presence was that Han Li had summoned them, mentioning an important decision that would be good news for them.
So, the ladies arrived early, full of eager anticipation, having exchanged thoughts on why their husband had called them here, yet they had no clue what it could be.
“Yuexin, Mingmeng, Yueyao, Yiwu, Yiyin.”
Han Li was embracing Li Mingmeng with one arm and Qiu Yueyao with the other as he lay on a wide and soft chair.
Liu Yuexin, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin attended to him by his side, massaging his legs, shoulders, and neck…
Li Mingmeng and Qiu Yueyao were also busy, each attending to their tasks.
Han Li indulged in the moment, his gaze sweeping over the expectant faces of his five beautiful concubines, yet he remained silent.
“Husband~ what did you call us here for?
Don’t keep us in suspense, tell us~”
Lin Yiyin could no longer hold back and, using her newly grown oversized “granaries,” she pressed against Han Li, coquettishly nudging him.
“Husband~”
Li Mingmeng, Liu Yuexin, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and the others also began to inquire in succession.
After kissing each of them, Han Li finally said, “You’ve been married to me for quite a long time, haven’t you?”
All five women were slightly stunned, not understanding why their husband would suddenly bring this up.
“Husband, it’s been one hundred and thirty-two years.”
Liu Yuexin spoke up first, a look of reminiscence appearing on her pretty face.
She was the first concubine Han Li had married and the one who had been with him for the longest time.
Thinking back to the past, Liu Yuexin couldn’t help but feel melancholic.
She had never imagined she would be where she is todayâ€”it was all too surrealâ€”but everything she had was thanks to the man before her.
She had the cultivation of the Saint Abyss Realm, a lifespan of a hundred thousand years, many outstanding descendants, and a high status in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
In the past, her beauty and figure might barely have been considered top-grade in Lingjun City, but in the Daqian Empire, the Qianyuan Divine Province, and even the Endless Yuankun Domain, she would have been lost in the crowd, just an ordinary person among the masses.
Now, her beauty, figure, and temperament had undergone a heaven-defying transformation.
Even placed amidst the throngs of beauties on Chengsheng Mountain or across the entire Yuankun Domain, she could be considered unparalleled in splendor.
