“Husband, I’ve been with you for eighty-seven years too,” Li Mingmeng was the second to speak, her flawless face also covered in memories.
“Husband….”
Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin also spoke in turn, mentioning the number of years they had been with Han Liâ€”they too had been with him for seven to eight decades.
Just like Liu Yuexin, they had all experienced earth-shattering changes in various aspects.
Han Li nodded slightly as a myriad of memories surfaced.
His early days were certainly not filled with glory and grandeur; they were quite ordinary.
After descending from Tianxuan Mountain, he established the Han Family and began to expand his lineage.
Starting with Liu Yuexin and then to siblings Lin Yiwu and Lin Yiyin, he had taken in more than a dozen concubines.
Among all these concubines, Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin were his favorites.
Wu Yalin and the rest were far less favored.
As for Chu Yutong and Chu Yumeng, the twin sisters, Zhou Zhiruo, Zhou Zhixuan, Zhou Zhirou, the triplets, and other concubinesâ€”Han Li hadn’t considered them this time.
“Yuexin, Mingmeng, Yueyao, Yiwu, Yiyin, the reason I called you here is to announce a decision,” Han Li said, looking around at the five cherished concubines with a gentle voice.
“Husband, go ahead, we are ready.”
Liu Yuexin, Qiu Yueyao, and the other women immediately sat up straight, their hearts pounding with excitement and curiosity about what their husband’s decision could be.
“In three days, I will prepare a promotion ceremony for you five, elevating you from concubines to wives,” Han Li announced in one breath.
Upon hearing this, the five women were stunned, then elation, excitement, and various other positive emotions surfaced on their faces.
“Husband, are you serious?”
“Husband, I’ve waited so long for this day.”
“Husband,….”
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin were beside themselves with excitement, chattering nonstop and sharing their joy.
As some of Han Li’s earliest concubines, they naturally fantasized about being promoted to wives.
The Han Mansion had set precedents for this before, such as with Yuan Youwei.
But Yuan Youwei was much stronger in many aspects and had special reasons for her initially low status and place, so they only dreamed the thought.
The surprise had come so unexpectedly.
“Of course it’s true.”
“Husband, let’s go to the ninth floor of the Sky Tower tonight to discuss Tao.”
“Husband, let’s go now~”

chapters.title: Chapter 764
chapters.content:
Chapter 764: Chapter 289: The Promotion Ceremony, An Overwhelmed Zhang Xuan in Tears, Han Li Preaching, Shaking the Yuankun Domain Chapter 764: Chapter 289: The Promotion Ceremony, An Overwhelmed Zhang Xuan in Tears, Han Li Preaching, Shaking the Yuankun Domain Three days later,
Jingdao Peak.
The crowd converged, and a continuous buzz of discussions filled the air.
Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, Long Yue, Xue Yueqing, Zi Miaozhen, Ji Mingyue, and other wives gathered together.
Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, Lin Yiyin, Chu Yumeng, Yu Wanying, and other concubines also gathered together.
Han Yongzhen, Han Yongjiang, Han Yongyun, Han Yongyang, Han Yongbai, Han Yonglong, Han Yongqian, Han Yongkun, Han Yongmu, Han Yonghao, and other descendants born from wives were grouped together.
Han Yongfan, Han Yongkang, Han Yongyan, Han Yongfu, Han Yongxuan, Han Yongyun, Han Yonglin, Han Yongyan, Han Yongli, Han Yongchun, and other descendants born from concubines were also together.
Beyond these four groups, three additional groups of people were present.
...
The first group was composed of Han Mansion’s representative figures from the third to the tenth generation, such as Han Shigao, Han Shiyun, Han Changyuan, Han Shengwen, Han Dingyao, Han Xingjun, Han Yanxi, Han Changsheng, and Han Chengdao.
The second group consisted of Guest Elders, protectors, Elders, and representatives like Lu Changming, Yuan Jingsheng, Gu Nanxuan, Zhang Xuan, also numbering in the dozens or hundreds.
The third group included emissaries from Heaven Imperial Realm’s Great Emperors such as the Sun God Emperor, Emperor Tianji, Pavilion Master Taiyi, Sect Hierarch of Heaven, as well as female emperors like Empress Huanyue, Empress Yuanchu.
All parties were extremely shocked by this scene, startled by the supreme Han Li’s emphasis on this matter and even more by his influence in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
From ancient times to the present, it seemed that no era’s powerhouse had such a strong appealâ€”to have all the strong figures of an era pay respects and attend what they considered a trivial matter.
The promotion of Han Li’s five concubines to wives was indeed a minor event for all the powerhouses of the Yuankun Domain.
But Han Li valued it so highly and sent out invitations that no powerhouse dared not to come.
The only consolation for many powerhouses was that they did not need to bring gifts to such a promotion ceremony.
Instead, the guests who participated would receive a gift from Chengsheng Mountain.
After giving so many congratulatory gifts, they finally got something from Chengsheng Mountain, though it wasn’t very precious, it meant a great deal.
In that case, they actually hoped they could come to Chengsheng Mountain a few more times.
After all, they had nothing else to do, could eat and drink for free, and Chengsheng Mountain’s food and fruits were naturally good stuff, plus they could snag some gifts from the mountain.
It’s a pity that such events were destined to happen only a few times and would not occur as frequently as Han Li taking wives and concubines.
“It seems that my husband attaches great importance to this matter, to arrange such a grand display,”
Yun Miaoyi’s beautiful eyes shimmered as she said with a smile.
“Isn’t it?
The ceremony is much bigger than when he married us wives,” Murong Ying said with a touch of sourness.
She was a part of Empress Yuanchu, and she had been with Han Li for quite some time, but back then, Han Li was barely getting by and didn’t hold a grand wedding for her.
Xue Qingyi, Chu Xianlin, Qiu Shuhui, Feng Ziyue, Song Zhixuan, Yao Xi, Ling Lingshuang, Bai Keqing, and other goddesses expressed various emotions, none echoing her remarks.
What they were thinking in their hearts, no one knew.
“You all, why worry about these little things?”
“Yuexin, Yueyao, Mingmeng, Yiwu, Yiyin and other sisters have been with our husband far longer than us, and what they have received is actually even less,”
Lu Tianxiang’s gaze swept over Yang Zhiyun, Shen Youqing, Gongsun Yue, Lu Yuan, Yuan Youwei, and all the sisters, sighing.
Han Li’s group of pampered wives and concubines all nodded in agreementâ€”this statement was indeed true.
The earlier they had married Han Li, the worse the wedding ceremony they got was, a result of the circumstances at the time, for Han Li was not as invincible back then.
Liu Yuexin, Qiu Yueyao, Li Mingmeng, Lin Yiyin, and Lin Yiwu, among other sisters, had married into the Han Mansion during Han Li’s weaker days, qualifying as his true lifelong companions.
Not only had Han Li not shunned his humble spouses, but he had also given them great importance, and they felt extremely gratified in their hearts.
Moreover, not all concubines who married into the Han Mansion early on were promoted to wives, only a small part were.
After a pause, Lu Tianxiang continued, “The husband also said he would find a time to hold a century wedding for us, and when the time comes, the scale will only be grander than this.”
“Really?”
“Xiang sister, did husband say when?”
“I’m so looking forward to it, I wish that day would come sooner.”
“Hehe, I can almost see it now.”
“….”
Jiang Baiye, Bai Keqing, Xue Yueqing, Xue Qingyi, and other beautiful wives quickly spoke up, their tones filled with anticipation.
Qin Shiyin and Feng Mian stood aside, not joining in the discussion.
Qin Shiyin had not been married to Han Li for long, and Han Li had already held a grand wedding ceremony to welcome her, so she had nothing to envy.
Feng Mian, on the other hand, was not yet married to Han Li.
Yet, as a Heavenly Immortal and the only female Heavenly Immortal of the Yuankun Domain, she had nothing to worry about at allâ€”only others envied her.
“Feng Mian, there’s still half a month before the husband will marry you, are you anxious?” Qin Shiyin asked with a smile, becoming even more beautiful and charming as Han Li’s love nurtured her, exuding allure in every move.
Feng Mian chuckled, her tender, boneless hand caressing Qin Shiyin’s pretty face as she replied, “What do I have to be anxious about?
You’re the anxious one, aren’t you?”
Feng Mian saw right through Qin Shiyin’s little schemes, and Qin Shiyin had not concealed anything, having already told her everything.
Feng Mian didn’t mind.
After all, ever since she knew about Han Li’s multitude of wives and concubines, she had gone along with whatever he decided.

chapters.title: Chapter 765
chapters.content:
Chapter 765: Chapter 289: The Promotion Ceremony, An Overwhelmed Zhang Xuan in Tears, Han Li Preaching, Yuankun Domain Shaken_2 Chapter 765: Chapter 289: The Promotion Ceremony, An Overwhelmed Zhang Xuan in Tears, Han Li Preaching, Yuankun Domain Shaken_2 On the other side,
“Yuexin sister, congratulations.”
“Mingmeng sister, congratulations, congratulations.”
“Yueyao sister, you’ve finally achieved true fruition.
I wonder when I’ll have the chance.”
“Yiwu, Yiyin, congratulations to the both of you.”
Wu Yalin, Chu Yumeng, Zhou Zhirou, Zhang Yuyan, Zhang Lan, Fang Yousi, and other ladies congratulated Liu Yuexin and the other four women, surrounding them in the middle, chirping their congratulations without end.
They were, of course, extremely envious of the fortunes of Liu Yuexin, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and the other women, but they did not feel jealousy.
Firstly, because they all got along well, with hardly any conflicts on normal days, and secondly, since their husband had set this precedent, as long as they performed well, they too might have the opportunity to be promoted from concubines to formal wives in the future.
“All of you sisters are also peerless beauties with exceptional grace, having followed our husband for so many years, I believe it won’t be long before each of you will also be promoted in turn.”
Liu Yuexin spoke with elegance and grace, engaging in conversation with her fellow sisters on the topic they found most interesting.
Although she was the first person the husband had married and his first woman, due to various reasons, her status in Chengsheng Mountain had not been particularly high, at most equivalent to an ordinary wife.
Now that she had been promoted to the status of a wife, her position had leaped tremendously, and although she still could not compare to sisters like Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Long Yue, and Yao Xi, she was still far better off than those sisters less favored.
...
Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, Lin Yiyin, and the other women were also engaging in conversation with other sisters, and even after three days, their speech was still filled with excitement.
On the other side,
Han Yongzhen, Han Yongqian, Han Yongmu, Han Yonghao, and other second-generation members of the Han Mansion were also offering their congratulations to Han Yonglin, Han Yongyun, Han Yongfan, Han Yongyan, Han Yongkang, and others.
The mothers of Han Yonglin, Han Yongyun, Han Yongfan, Han Yongyan, Han Yongkang, and other siblings had been promoted from concubines to official wives, which meant that their children’s status and identity would significantly improve, along with their benefits, treatment, and privileges.
Descendants of other generations of the Han Mansion were also congratulating the descendants of Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, and Lin Yiyin.
No matter how many generations had passed, as long as they were descendants of these five women, their status and identity, benefits, and treatment would be correspondingly improved.
Today, every corner of the Han Mansion was filled with voices of congratulations, and Guest Elders, protectors, and Elders of Chengsheng Mountain were also offering their congratulations.
Most people did not belong to any faction, but a few who were good at currying favor had been continuously placing bets, and those who had bet correctly were naturally very happy.
Powerful beings like Emperor Sun and Emperor Tianji watched this scene, their hearts full of shock and sentiment.
The Han Mansion had only been established for a bit over a hundred years and yet had produced so many outstanding descendants, even though the highest cultivation among them had not yet reached the Saint Abyss Realm.
But if this continued, in another hundred or thousand years, without Han Li needing to take action, the descendants of Chengsheng Mountain would be able to dominate the entire Yuankun Domain.
As their gazes swept across, they noticed that many descendants of the Han Mansion possessed first-grade aptitudes and unique constitutions, the proportion of which was astoundingly shocking.
In time, Chengsheng Mountain might have more Great Emperors and Heavenly Immortals than the entire Yuankun Domain.
When the time for the promotion arrived, Han Li also made his appearance, reigning over Jingdao Peak, and his presence overwhelmed everyone.
Next, Han Li personally presided over the promotion ceremony, and elevated the status of Liu Yuexin, Li Mingmeng, Qiu Yueyao, Lin Yiwu, Lin Yiyin, and the other women.
Among the audience below, protector Elder Zhang Xuan cried tears of joy, murmuring to himself in his heart.
“Master, do you see this?
Little sister Qiu has achieved true fruition and is doing very well.
I believe you can rest in peace now.”
Zhang Xuan was also an old member of the Han Mansion, joining together with Qiu Yueyao, later moving with the Han Mansion to Chengsheng Mountain in Yuanzhou.
Originally, his cultivation was extremely low, not even having embarked on the first step of Dao cultivation.
But over nearly a hundred years, Zhang Xuan had worked diligently and devotedly for the Han Mansion, his performance earning Han Li’s recognition, occasionally being granted treasures by him.
Additionally, with Qiu Yueyao’s care, the cultivation resources that Zhang Xuan received ranked among the top in all of Chengsheng Mountain’s external system.
Now, Zhang Xuan’s aptitude had been promoted to Third Grade, and his cultivation level had risen to the True Martial Realm.
Cultivation in the True Martial Realm was not high in Chengsheng Mountain, but Zhang Xuan was already very satisfied, with his identity, status, benefits, living conditions, and treatment being innumerably better than before.
He had married and had children, thoroughly rooting himself in Chengsheng Mountain, ready to serve the Han Mansion for generations.
Sometimes, Zhang Xuan felt it was all too dreamlike.
He, an ordinary person with mediocre talent and the lowest of qualifications, had managed to cultivate to the True Martial Realm within a hundred years, secured a lifespan of two thousand years, and could potentially reach even higher realms in the future.
“I wonder how those junior brothers are doing?
Are they still around?”
“`
Looking up at Qiu Yueyao above, Zhang Xuan couldn’t help but think of his several junior brothers from the past.
They had chosen not to follow Lord Han Li back to Lingjun City, and now everything was beyond their reach.
Zhang Xuan had not gone back either; he hadn’t had the time, nor did he see any necessity to do so.
The path was one they had chosen themselves, and they had to walk it to the end, even on their knees.
Zhang Xuan’s current status, cultivation level, and strength were not due to any nepotistic connections with Junior Sister Qiu.
If he had not worked hard, diligently, and conscientiously, he would not have earned any recognition.
After the ascension ceremony, Han Li directly imparted his teachings on Chengsheng Mountain, sharing all his profound understandings of the Dao with everyone present.
For a moment, endless visions appeared on Chengsheng Mountain: flowers rained down from the sky, golden lotuses sprouted from the earth, celestial maidens scattered blossoms, the stars chimed in unison, and the great Dao Ocean descended…
Sitting in the firmament, Han Li exuded the solemn dignity of an enlightened being.
With each word he spoke, countless images unfolded before the audience, with billions of rays of rosy light and thousands of rainbows shining, the Infinite Immortal Light illuminating the ancient, present, and future.
Two hours later, Han Li concluded his lecture.
Looking at the crowd below, who had listened raptly, he sighed softly in his heart.
He had tried to speak as plainly and openly as possible, not holding anything back.
He wondered how many would gain fortuitous insights from this discourse.
That would depend on their own comprehension.
He hoped that his lecture would add some strong cultivators to Chengsheng Mountain and the Yuankun Domain and serve as a preparation for the future.
Another hour passed, and many cultivators emerged from their immersive state of enlightenment, their faces still showing traces of obsession.
The Dao expounded by Elder Han was so abstruse and profound that they had fallen into a state of enlightenment upon grasping just a hint of its mystery, each obtaining various fortunes.
Afterward, Han Li hosted a grand banquet for everyone, bringing out rare treasures and fine liquors.
When everyone had departed, the influence of the ascension ceremony and the lecture spread rapidly throughout the Yuankun Domain, causing a huge stir in the Eight Hundred Divine Regions.
Countless cultivators beat their chests and stamped their feet, regretting not having gone to Chengsheng Mountain to partake in the grand event and missed out on so many opportunities.
It was mainly because no one expected the reclusive Elder Han to be so generous this time.
Days later, another grand banquet was held on Chengsheng Mountain.
This time, it was for Han Li to marry the master of Liangjie Mountain, Quasi Emperor Shi Mengyan.
Because Shi Yanmeng met all the criteria and Lu Yuan was there too, Han Li granted Shi Mengyan the status of wife.
Cultivators from the Yuankun Domain, who had left only a few days before, returned once more, this time bearing precious gifts to participate in the wedding ceremony and partake in the feast.
Since he was marrying a Quasi Emperor, Han Li did not make too extravagant a display.
The Heaven Imperial Realm emperors who were far away could have stayed away, but they still came.
As they said, this was to repay the great favor they owed to Supreme Han Li for the previous lecture, from which they had benefited enormously.
If Han Li were to marry another Quasi Emperor in the future, they might not necessarily come again; they might only send the high-ranking members of their forces to show support.
Han Li naturally welcomed them all.
Then, with a grand wave of his hand, he lectured once more atop Jingdao Peak, imparting his Dao to all the heavens.
The cultivators who had felt some heartache over their precious gifts suddenly found it worthwhile.
It was fortunate they came, for missing out on this opportunity would have been a lifelong regret.
Elder Han’s lectures brought too many chances for fortunes, a fact attested to by countless cultivators.
Seeing such positive outcomes, Han Li announced that in the future, every time he took a wife or concubine, he would hold a lecture: one hour for taking a concubine, and three hours for taking a wife.
This naturally caused the cultivators to cheer and rejoice.
What were a few rare gifts compared to the fortunes gained from the lectures?
Such a great deal!
As this news spread throughout the Yuankun Domain, it sparked another sensation.
The masses were thrilled, and countless cultivators clamored for Elder Han to take more wives and concubines, promising to bring their finest treasures as offerings.
Han Li did not pay too much attention to these reactions.
After the lecture, he disappeared without a trace, retiring to the bridal chamber with his new bride, Shi Mengyan.
In the following days, Han Li even called Lu Yuan over to pass on his Dao teachings to her as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 766
chapters.content:
Chapter 766: Chapter 290 People’s Will, Marrying Feng Mian, The First Descendant of an Immortal Body_1 Chapter 766: Chapter 290 People’s Will, Marrying Feng Mian, The First Descendant of an Immortal Body_1 Taibai Divine Province, White Emperor City.
Once one of the nine most formidable powers, White Emperor City was no longer glorious and the days were quite difficult.
The city was once splendid, its renown shining throughout the world, intimidating the universe for a hundred thousand years, known to all.
But in less than thirty years, White Emperor City’s splendor had burst like a bubble, mercilessly shattered.
First, the White Emperor was obliterated by Supreme Leader Han Li in Qianyuan Divine Province, then five Supreme Leaders broke into Taibai Immortal Realm and plundered countless treasures.
Not many years later, Supreme Leader Han Li stormed Taibai Immortal Realm again, bursting the White Emperor for a second time and stealing all of Taibai Immortal Realm’s treasures, severely damaging White Emperor City, leaving only some treasures and resources stored outside.
In recent years, as Supreme Leader Han Li traversed the great calamity of proving his Dao, the White Emperor colluded with the Butian Sect Master, the Western Sky Palace Master, the Supreme Leader of the Qin Family, and the Supreme Leader of the Jiang Familyâ€”four Supreme Leadersâ€”to block his way.
...
As a result, the White Emperor was burst by Supreme Leader Han Li for the third time, dying completely, and even involved the four Supreme Leaders in his downfall.
Afterward, a small team from Chengsheng Mountain descended upon White Emperor City and took away most of the remaining resources, leaving the cultivators of White Emperor City in a dire state.
Supreme Leader Han Li redefined the power structure of Yuankun Domain; White Emperor City, which once governed fifty-three Divine Provinces with four Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, was left with only twenty-three Divine Provinces and two Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors after these events.
The two Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors no longer wished to stay in the declining White Emperor City, and the cultivators of the city were eagerly awaiting them to manage the new White Emperor City, hoping for better days.
A cook cannot make meals without rice; the foundation of White Emperor City was exhausted, and its territory drastically reduced.
The resources from the remaining twenty-three Divine Provinces were just enough to sustain the consumption of all the cultivators of White Emperor City.
Yet White Emperor City had lost its attractiveness to cultivators, unable to offer various opportunities and destinies to help cultivators break through to higher realms, causing countless cultivators to want to leave White Emperor City and join Chengsheng Mountain, but Chengsheng Mountain was not accepting them.
Joining other powers wasn’t easy either, as they would infringe on the resources of the cultivators from the original powers.
Times had changed, and many powerful individuals and outstanding talents from various forces were converging towards Chengsheng Mountain, leaving behind cultivators to compete with them.
Chengsheng Mountain was the supreme Sacred Land of Yuankun Domain, not only far exceeding other powers in the domain in terms of cultivation environment but also offering many times better welfare and treatment than other Sacred Lands.
Now, at Chengsheng Mountain, one could listen to the sermons of Supreme Leader Han Li for free, which was an incredible fortune, and one could listen to his teachings regularly.
The two remaining Great Emperors of White Emperor City also wished to join Chengsheng Mountain, but Chengsheng Mountain did not accept them and had raised the threshold for new recruits, strictly controlling the number of cultivators.
With Chengsheng Mountain having no external enemies in Yuankun Domain and holding a monopoly, too many cultivators joining would encroach upon the resources intended for the descendants of Han Mansion.
In such a situation, even if the two Great Emperors wanted to establish their own sect, it wouldn’t be of much use, and they were too lazy to put in the effort.
Fortunately, Chengsheng Mountain had left them an option: if they managed White Emperor City well and after a period of observation, they could join Chengsheng Mountain and become Chengsheng Mountain Elders, with revered status and generous treatment.
At this moment, deep within the imperial palace of White Emperor City, the two Great Emperors were discussing state affairs with worried expressions.
The current state of White Emperor City was truly difficult to manage.
Even if the cultivators of White Emperor City made significant contributions, they couldn’t offer various opportunities and destinies as rewards, and without rewards, they couldn’t retain cultivators.
If it weren’t for the fact that these cultivators couldn’t find anywhere else to go for the time being, they would have already left White Emperor City.
Despite this, countless cultivators were flocking to the thirty Divine Provinces that had been directly governed by Chengsheng Mountain.
As Divine Provinces directly under Chengsheng Mountain, a certain number of slots were allotted each year for joining Chengsheng Mountain.
“Old Qiu, when do you think we will see the light at the end of the tunnel?
What if we were to leave as well?” asked a Red Robed Emperor with a bitter expression.
He had absolutely no desire to deal with the mess that was White Emperor City, which offered no benefit at all, and the hope of joining Chengsheng Mountain seemed distant.
“Old Hu, where could we go if we left?”
The Black Robe Emperor responded with a helpless smile.
The entirety of the Endless Yuankun Domain was under the rule of Chengsheng Mountain, if only in various forms of governance.
Unless they no longer wished to advance and break through to the Heavenly Immortal stage, they couldn’t abandon White Emperor City.
Now, all the major powers of Yuankun Domain were affiliated with Chengsheng Mountain and accepted Chengsheng Mountain’s rule; the connections between these powers and Chengsheng Mountain would inevitably become even tighter in the future.
If they set out on their own, how could they compete with those powers?
Those powers had support, and they couldn’t outfight them or dare to do so.
They would be suppressed at every turn, better to stay in White Emperor City.
“Sigh, you’re right,” the Red Robed Emperor sighed, filled with infinite regrets and some words that couldn’t be spoken.
Chengsheng Mountain had Golden Immortals suppressing the fortunes, had many auxiliary supreme treasures in the past, and recently, another auxiliary supreme treasure had emerged, reportedly capable of bestowing cultivators with Immortal Grade aptitude and Immortal Bodies.
This made countless cultivators even more eager for Chengsheng Mountain, solidifying its ruling position.
As Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm who hoped to advance, they would have to join Chengsheng Mountain, whether to use the supreme treasures for purification or to gain other prospects for improving their cultivation, breaking through their realms, or comprehending the Dao.
“The Supreme Leader has ordered us to manage White Emperor City well, and in return, he will grant us the position of Chengsheng Mountain Elders.
Let’s do it earnestly,” said the Black Robe Emperor.
“The authority and benefits of a Chengsheng Mountain Elder are extremely high, and even the newly emerged supreme treasure can be used once every five hundred years.
If we work hard, it’s possible that we could join Chengsheng Mountain within a thousand years,” he added.

chapters.title: Chapter 767
chapters.content:
Chapter 767: Chapter 290 People’s Will, Marrying Feng Mian, The First Descendant of an Immortal Body_2 Chapter 767: Chapter 290 People’s Will, Marrying Feng Mian, The First Descendant of an Immortal Body_2 The Red Robed Emperor pondered for a moment, nodded his head, and said, “In that case, we will have to pay a steep price.”
Managing White Emperor City well within a millennium is no easy feat, with the most difficult aspect being fortunes and fates, yet they have them.
These are all their own, for their descendants, for their disciples.
Only by offering the corresponding fortunes can they stabilize people’s hearts and have them contribute to White Emperor City.
Only then can the city generate more resources and wealth to offer to Chengsheng Mountain, after which they can join Chengsheng Mountain.
“Simply shedding our blood is not enough.
We must also improve relations with Chengsheng Mountain.
The situation of White Emperor City is quite awkward, and we must handle this well,” the Black Robe Emperor said gravely.
...
The Red Robed Emperor’s pupils contracted slightly.
“You mean?”
“Contact Qin Shiyin.
She was once part of White Emperor City and our relationship with her isn’t bad.
It’s mutually beneficial; she likely won’t refuse,” the Black Robe Emperor said indifferently.
“Also reach out to Zimei Zhen.”
The Red Robed Emperor nodded, agreeing with this suggestion.
Other forces had their people in Chengsheng Mountain, and so did White Emperor City, two of them, both of significant status.
One was Zimei Zhen, and the other was Qin Shiyin.
It’s just that these two had almost no contact with White Emperor City, and they had deliberately ignored them in the past.
Now, however, they could only go and ask for help.
The famous fairies of White Emperor City numbered six, one in the Heavenly Imperial Realm, two in the Quasi Emperor Realm, and three in the Sacred Abyss Realm.
Now, only two Quasi Emperors and two from the Sacred Abyss Realm remained.
These four fairies had stayed, harboring the thought of seizing the opportunity to marry into Chengsheng Mountain.
Even though they were female saints and Quasi Empresses, it was difficult for them now to marry into Chengsheng Mountain.
Becoming concubines wouldn’t be a big problem, but they desired to be wives, which was quite challenging.
Now that Supreme Han Li was tightening the slots, the standards for marrying him were raised once more.
They faced many competitorsâ€”Heavenly Immortal Empresses couldn’t win over him, and yet the number of Quasi Empresses and female saints in the Yuankun Domain was not small.
At least White Emperor City had people in Chengsheng Mountain, two of whom held high statuses as wives.
If they could build connections and operate skillfully, they might just achieve their goals.
When the two Heavenly Immortal Emperors reached out to the four fairies and expressed their intentions, they quickly came to an agreement.
All four fairies said that as long as the two emperors successfully secured their places as Han Li’s wives in Chengsheng Mountain, they would speak for White Emperor City and improve its situation.
Both parties were sincere.
If the four fairies became wives and influenced affairs, White Emperor City’s future situation would improve greatly, and they could hope to join Chengsheng Mountain in advance.
Once they joined Chengsheng Mountain, they would naturally be of the same faction and could support the descendants of the four fairies.
Both sides would benefit immensely from each other’s support.
And Han Li stood to make a killing; he didn’t have to do anything to reap untold benefits.
Not just White Emperor City, but the Solar Empire, Tianji Pavilion, and other Heavenly Governing Forces and Quasi Emperor Rank forces were all scheming, actively maneuvering.
In the past, Han Li proactively sought wives and concubines, needing to beg for countless favors, even resorting to forceful taking.
Now, countless forces were offering themselves, fighting to please Han Li before they argued their cases to Chengsheng Mountain and pushed out competitors.
…..
Time flew by, and half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Chengsheng Mountain once again held a grand wedding ceremony, the scale of which was extremely grand, even more solemn than the previous promotion ceremony and the welcoming of Qin Shiyin as a bride.
This time, Han Li was marrying the Heavenly Fairy from the Linghuang Clan, Feng Mian.
When this news spread, the entire Yuankun Domain was shaken, and countless powerful entities were flabbergasted.
The Supreme of Chengsheng Mountain, the Patriarch of Han Mansion, was actually going to wed a Heavenly Fairy!
Since when did the Yuankun Domain have an additional female Heavenly Immortal?
And one without any reputation to speak of.
Innumerable forces were dumbstruck.
A Heavenly Fairy couldn’t possibly be unknown; even if they were low-profile, their crossing the Truth Confirmation Tribulation and the Immortal Tribulation would certainly cause a huge commotion each time, with each event more significant than the last.
How exactly did Han Li find such a Heavenly Fairy?
Countless powerhouses were puzzled, but when they received the invitation, they joyfully came to attend.
Firstly, to catch a glimpse of this suddenly emerged Heavenly Immortal Realm powerhouse, the first of her kind in the present era of the Yuankun Domain.
Secondly, to offer congratulations to the Supreme Han Li and, incidentally, to make connections with other people from Chengsheng Mountain, paving the way for their future maneuvers.
Thirdly, and most importantly, to listen to the Supreme Han Li’s teachings.
Half a month ago, when the Supreme Han Li married the master of Liangjie Mountain, Quasi Empress Shi Mengyan, he announced significant newsâ€”he would teach for two hours when taking a wife and for one hour when accepting a concubine.
It was also since that day that Supreme Han Li once again raised the standards for taking a wife and consorts, dashing the hopes of countless cultivators who had eagerly anticipated frequent lectures.
So, when Chengsheng Mountain announced the marriage ceremony, all the leaders of various forces within the Yuankun Domain eagerly made their way there, even those not on the invitation list, who came unashamedly.
On this day, Chengsheng Mountain was teeming with countless powerhouses, most of the saints and quasi emperors from Yuankun Domain had come, and nearly all of the Heaven Imperial Realm emperors were present.
Even the previously reserved female emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm personally came to Chengsheng Mountain this time to attend the wedding ceremony.
Originally, they were not in a hurry because their positions were secureâ€”as emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm, they faced little competition and were bound to marry Han Li, being reserved might even make Han Li value them more.
But now they were anxious; a nameless Heavenly Immortal had suddenly appeared in Yuankun Domain and was being welcomed by Han Li as his bride.
How could this be?
The female emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm worried that more Heavenly Immortals would continuously emerge, marry into Chengsheng Mountain, and theyâ€”the emperorsâ€”would find themselves in an awkward position.
Therefore, they came early to probe for information and, incidentally, to connect with Han Li emotionally.
It was a very pragmatic yet unavoidable move.
They didn’t really like Han Li, but they couldn’t escape destiny; since they were going to fall into Han Li’s Devil’s Palm anyway, might as well be practical and strive for their own interests.
Not just these female emperors, the Empresses Guanghan and Yuanchu, although they did not come in person, it was almost the sameâ€”they each sent a Heaven Imperial Realm soul incarnation to represent them.
In recent years, after the situation in Yuankun Domain became clear, the two peerless empresses had reached friendly agreements with their respective soul incarnations, no longer being suppressed and becoming active within their territories.
When the time came, the immensely grand marriage ceremony finally began.
Feng Mian appeared with grace, her Heavenly Immortal aura dominating the entire scene, astonishing countless powerhousesâ€”she truly was a Heavenly Immortal.
Ever since Chengsheng Mountain rose to become the foremost Sacred Land of Qianyuan Divine Province, Han Li never hid his marriages again, unafraid of others knowing the identity of his wives and consorts.
Dressed in radiant red, Feng Mian was so stunning that she made every female saint and empress feel inferior, creating a sense of urgency in their hearts.
Once the ceremony was over, the clamour returned, and Chengsheng Mountain became lively with people congratulating and drinking celebratory wine.
After eating and drinking, Han Li took his place high up in the Nine Heavens and began the promised lectures.
This time, he did not directly share all of his insights into the Great Dao, as the cultivators below would not have been able to comprehend them; thus, he taught gradually and methodically.
The scene was, of course, wondrous and miraculous, with numerous extraordinary phenomena surrounding heaven and earth, making Han Li look exceptionally magnificent.
After the lecture ended, while countless cultivators were still immersed in comprehending the Dao, Han Li had quietly made his way to Feng Mian’s bridal chamber.
Although it was not the first time he had discussed the Dao with Feng Mian, Han Li was still amazed by her beauty upon seeing her.
Because Han Li had formally married her, Feng Mian also made an effort to please him, her tenderness like water, fulfilling any of Han Li’s requests.
To avoid making too much noise and spreading the word, Han Li directly entered the twelfth layer of the Time-Sky Tower with Feng Mian in his arms, where one day spanned more than ten thousand days.
The Time-Sky Tower had been evolved by Han Li using the Immortal Evolution Order.
When Han Li walked out of the Time-Sky Tower the next day, his legs were for the first time a bit weakâ€”he felt he needed to eat a True Dragon to replenish himself.
A few days later, Han Li and Feng Mian lived shamelessly sweet days as immortals, but their two-person world was disrupted by a piece of news.
Han Li arrived at a bedchamber, anxious yet expectant.
This time it was Lu Tianxiang giving birth; she had been resting and preparing for pregnancy for a while, getting her condition just right.
Lu Tianxiang intended to bear Han Li a child with an Immortal Body.
This was of tremendous significance, which is why Lu Tianxiang had prepared for so long.
Naturally, Han Li was supportive; although Lu Tianxiang was not an Immortal Body, he was, and after making many preparations, there was still a good chance of success.
Soon, Lu Tianxiang gave birth to a progeny with an Immortal Body.
Plot Preview: Tomorrow should be the day to welcome the marriages of the Empresses Guanghan and Yuanchu, along with another plotline.
The day after tomorrow, the story will follow the protagonist’s travels and the narrative of the Guanghan Empress’s soul incarnation.
If all goes well, the fourth volume will start the day after that, jumping the timeline, and the protagonist will become immortal.
The pacing of the story will accelerate after achieving immortality.

chapters.title: Chapter 768
chapters.content:
Chapter 768: Chapter 291 Han Yongxian, Immortal Rank Gift Package, Goes to Propose Marriage_1 Chapter 768: Chapter 291 Han Yongxian, Immortal Rank Gift Package, Goes to Propose Marriage_1 “Husband, our child has an Immortal Body.”
When Han Li entered the bedroom, Liu Yuexin’s voice, filled with extreme excitement, reached his ears.
Han Li looked over and saw Liu Yuexin tenderly holding a baby that was white, plump, and lustrous.
Her face was aglow with maternal brilliance.
“Xianger, you’ve worked hard.” Han Li approached and affectionately stroked Liu Yuexin’s pretty face with deep love.
Although Liu Yuexin had the power of the Saint Abyss Realm and was very strong, and had made various preparations, giving birth to an offspring with an Immortal Body had greatly depleted her vital energy and caused serious harm to her essence.
Furthermore, Han Li discovered that not only did the child have an Immortal Body, but he also inherited Han Li’s aptitude, possessing Immortal Grade aptitude.
This was his first offspring with an Immortal Body and Immortal aptitude, and Han Li naturally took great care of him, treating him with extreme protectiveness.
...
“Husband, your concubine is not tired.”
Liu Yuexin’s pretty face radiated with pride.
Giving birth to an offspring with an Immortal Body and Immortal aptitude made her very satisfied and proud, and she harbored some underlying thoughts.
Nowadays, Chengsheng Mountain was the first and most powerful force in the Endless Yuankun Domain, ruling over countless powers within the domain.
Whether it be Saints, Quasi Emperors, or Great Emperors, or even the future Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals, they could only abide by the rules set by Chengsheng Mountain.
Chengsheng Mountain was the supreme ruler of the Yuankun Domain.
As the lord of Chengsheng Mountain and the invincible supreme of the Yuankun Domain, Han Li held the most exalted status and influence.
In the absence of external enemies and without external pressures, the struggles within Chengsheng Mountain had quietly shifted to internal conflicts.
The inevitable clashing for power, factional divides, and quest for benefits were bound to occur.
Han Li was very clear about this but did nothing to stop it, nor did he intervene, allowing them to play their little games.
Only then could Chengsheng Mountain stay vibrant, and a competitive Han Mansion would continue to thrive rather than stagnate.
As long as he was there, Chengsheng Mountain could not be overturned, and everything would revolve around him, with him at the center.
With a single word, he could change the destiny of anyone.
Han Li’s beloved wives and concubines, all his offspring, the Guest Elders and protectors of Chengsheng Mountain, and even the forces and powerful entities outside of Chengsheng Mountain, were all acutely aware of this.
Under these circumstances, Liu Yuexin, Yun Miaoyi, Zimiaozhen, Qiu Shuhui, and other women were competing for certain underlying things and then using them to extend their influence.
Han Li had many beloved wives and concubines, but not all of them fought openly, rather they were divided into factions, rallied behind certain individuals, united to bring more benefits to their own faction.
Sometimes the faction leaders did not want to compete, but once pushed into that position and with the interests of their offspring, numerous sisters, and the offspring of those sisters at stake, they had to fight.
This underlying competition was diverse, like the achievements of outstanding offspring in genius battles, discussions, and combat towers, as well as their performances during external training missions, and their cultivation, aptitude, physique, and so on.
Liu Yuexin was the leader of one such faction, representing the interests of Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, Gongsun Yue, among some twenty or thirty other wives and concubines.
In the last year, the main direction of competition for Liu Yuexin and others was the new offspring.
There were countless offspring with first-grade aptitude in Chengsheng Mountain, but very few with King Bodies, even fewer with Emperor Bodies.
And those with an Immortal Body were nonexistent, and not a single offspring from the Han Mansion had an Immortal Grade aptitude.
Han Li had previously mentioned to his beloved wives and concubines that his own aptitude and physique had been elevated to Immortality Grade, which inspired the idea of competition in Liu Yuexin and the others.
Within that year, Han Li had cultivated with all his wives and concubines many times, and those who wanted offspring were already pregnant, with Liu Yuexin being among the earliest.
If any of the wives or concubines could give birth to an offspring with an Immortal Body and Immortal aptitude, they would receive even more of their husband’s affection, secure a higher position in Chengsheng Mountain, and bring countless benefits to themselves and their faction.
For instance, external powers wanting to build relationships with Chengsheng Mountain would first approach them, offering countless resources, and their offspring would receive various hidden benefits and advantages.
Now, the child born to Liu Yuexin not only possessed an Immortal Body but also Immortal Grade aptitude.
Liu Yuexin understood very well what this meant.
That’s why she needed to avoid showing her intentions too clearly; she knew that her husband understood everything and that she didn’t need to make an overt display.
What should be hers wouldn’t be a bit less but only more.
Moreover, she was her husband’s first wife, and even though Yun Miaoyi, her husband’s first woman, had ascended from a concubine to a wife, she posed no threat to Liu Yuexin’s position.
Liu Yuexin already had several offspring, each with extraordinary talents and outstanding performances.
They stood out from the many offspring of the Han Mansion, which continuously elevated her status.
With the birth of this child, her position in Chengsheng Mountain was even more secure, incomparable even to Qin Shiyin, the Empress of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
“`
Perhaps, only Heavenly Immortal Feng Mian, Empress Phoenixmoon, and Empress Yuanchu could be compared with her.
Han Li nodded slightly, pulling Lu Tianxiang into his embrace, and the two held each other, creating an exceptionally heartwarming feeling.
“Xiangxiangï½ž”
Han Li pressed against Lu Tianxiang’s fair and pretty face, their temples rubbing, and sometimes he would nibble on her earlobe, whispering sweet nothings.
Han Li spoke a lot to her, and Lu Tianxiang’s mood became better and better, her originally somewhat pale face now taking on a rosier hue.
After they doted on each other for a while, Han Li formally said, “Xiangxiang, he is my first descendant with an Immortal Body and Immortal aptitude, of great significance, let’s call him Han Yongxian, how about that?”
Lu Tianxiang’s beautiful eyes sparkled with amazement, and with a beaming smile she replied, “I’ll follow my husband’s wishï½ž”
With that, Lu Tianxiang tiptoed toward Han Li and engaged in a little tussle with him.
Han Yongxian!
She was extremely satisfied with this name in her heartâ€”it really was the best name.
Everything was just right.
Han Yongxian had both an Immortal Body and Immortal aptitude, embodying Han Li’s expectation of becoming an immortal and also bearing Han Li’s hopes for all of Han Mansion’s future generations.
Every person to become an immortal, forever an immortal!
Although, with the Immortal Monarch level treasures, Han Mansion would be able to cultivate many cultivators with Immortal Bodies and Immortal Grade aptitudes in the coming years, resulting in countless Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals.
But Han Yongxian was different, after all.
Therefore, from the moment of his birth, as soon as Han Li had the thought, he had already set a thorough cultivation plan for Han Yongxian, which was many times better than those for the descendants of the Great Emperor bodies.
Han Li stayed with Lu Tianxiang for a long time, discussing some important matters before he took his leave.
Lu Tianxiang wanted Han Li to stay the night and cultivate together.
Since bearing Han Yongxian, the frequency of their dual cultivation had drastically decreased, especially in recent monthsâ€”it was almost nonexistent.
She was already desperate with longing.
However, Han Li did not agree, worrying about Lu Tianxiang’s body.
Consuming too much vital energy now, it was better to rest and recuperate for the time being.
At Chengdao Peak,
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back as the radiant light spilled from the sun, illuminating mountains and rivers with innumerable blossoms.
“Huffï½ž”
Exhaling deeply, Han Li’s slightly agitated emotions calmed down, and he opened the System message panel.
Glancing at the two System prompts that appeared upon Han Yongxian’s birth, his pupils constricted, shocked by the generous rewards.
“The first descendant with an Immortal Body and Immortal Grade aptitude, and to think such generous rewards are given, this is an Immortal Rank Gift Package,” Han Li murmured to himself, his mood extremely excited, his face all smiles.
This provided him with a vast amount of cultivation progress, significantly shortening the time it would take for him to become an immortal through tribulation.
Time passed, and several months quickly went by.
During these months, Han Li opened treasure chests every month, acquiring a vast number of treasures, including Cultivation Techniques, martial skills, weapons, pills, and so forth, overall quite lucky.
Today, having made all the necessary preparations, Han Li set off with a great procession from Chengsheng Mountain.
He was going to propose a marriage to Empress Phoenixmoon and Empress Yuanchu.
PS: Plans cannot keep up with changes, this month I probably won’t finish Volume Three.
Mainly because I was suddenly pulled into Chengdu today, quite busy, and I can’t use a computer, only typing on my phone, which is very inconvenient.
The contents of the Immortal Rank Gift Package will be added up in a couple of days when I return to the small town because I can’t look up the rewards given the first time Immortal Grade aptitude and Great Emperor bodies appeared using my phone, which makes it hard to write.

chapters.title: Chapter 769
chapters.content:
Chapter 769: Chapter 292: Immortal Rank Gift Package, the Second Golden Immortal Weapon.
Hongshang, I’m Here to Marry You_1 Chapter 769: Chapter 292: Immortal Rank Gift Package, the Second Golden Immortal Weapon.
Hongshang, I’m Here to Marry You_1 Upon the Han Sea.
Cloud Plural Battleships, the worldly skyboats, cleaved through the air in great numbers, their banners flamboyant, countless, blotting out the sun and sky, to forge an extremely vast fleet.
Astride the deck of every battleship and skyboat stood cultivators clad in armor.
The weakest among them, from the True Martial Realm, were a million strong, and there were a great many from the Divine Yuan Realm, the Tongxuan Realm, the Sanctified Abyss Realm, as well as the quasi Emperors and the Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
All the battleships were linked to a True Immortal Rank battle formation, enabling them to gather the strength of countless cultivators and concentrate it upon those Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm, exponentially increasing their power, enough to subdue even a Heavenly Immortal.
...
At the same time, within every thirty battleships or skyboats, there lay a Heavenly Immortal weapon as the array’s core; overall, the fleet possessed dozens of such Heavenly Immortal weapons, and even True Immortal weapons.
Furthermore, each battleship and skyboat were equipped with large-scale lethal weapons, fueled by Spirit Crystals, Spirit Source, and even Immortal Qi and Immortal Stones.
A single vessel could vanquish a Quasi Emperor.
Ten battleships joining force could bomb a Great Emperor of the Heaven Imperial Realm.
A hundred warships on the assault, activating their maximum mode, would mercilessly hunt down even a Heavenly Immortal.
With the might of this fleet, it could be said to steamroll over the Endless Yuankun Domain, suppressing any rebellious power within it, even if that power possessed Heavenly Immortal weapons or True Immortal weapons, it would be ruthlessly eradicated by this legion.
However, this time, this formidable fleet of battleships was not setting forth to campaign against other territories within the Yuankun Domain to eradicate rebels but to propose and escort a marriage party.
At the very forefront of the countless battleships and skyboats sailed a flagship, a colossal golden-armored vessel, ten times larger than any other warship or skyboat.
This majestic golden-armored giant ship was a top-notch True Immortal weapon, engraved with three types of grand avenues, each governing attack, defense, and spatial escape, all at the True Immortal tier.
If its three embedded True Immortal weapons were activated and charged, they could easily bombard a True Immortal into oblivion.
When this invincible fleet of battleships sailed out from Chengsheng Mountain in the Qianyuan Divine Province, entering the vast and boundless Han Sea, it caused a titanic sensation throughout the Qianyuan Divine Province, shaking countless powers to their core.
This earth-shattering news spread at an incredibly fast pace through various means to the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of the Endless Yuankun Domain, reaching the ears of those powers’ upper echelons.
It resulted in an uproar like the roar of waves, shaking the numerous cultivators of the Yuankun Domain, striking awe and terror into the heart of any mighty one who heard it.
In the past, factions of the Yuankun Domain feared Chengsheng Mountain because it possessed a Golden Immortal weapon and several True Immortal weapons, unrivaled in the Yuankun Domain.
However, Chengsheng Mountain’s rise was too swift, and its number of strong cultivators too few.
Many powers submitted outwardly but didn’t actually take Chengsheng Mountain too seriously.
After all, even if Chengsheng Mountain didn’t manage affairs much, could it possibly intervene in case of real trouble?
Chengsheng Mountain simply didn’t have the strength to suppress the disputes and rebellions across the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of the Yuankun Domain!
But now, the upper echelons of countless powers realized they had vastly underestimated the depth of Chengsheng Mountain’s resources.
Their understanding of Chengsheng Mountain had been a grave error.
Within this invincible fleet of battleships, there were dozens of Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm, hundreds of quasi Emperors, and even thousands of Saints of the Sanctified Abyss Realm.
Paired with the True Immortal level battleships, the Heavenly Immortal level skyboats, and the Heaven Imperial level vessels, this power could effortlessly extinguish countless powers within the Yuankun Domain simultaneously.
Quasi Emperors stationed in the Qianyuan Divine Province, as well as Great Emperors of the Heaven Imperial Realm who had heard the news and kept watch from afar, probed the actual strength of this fleet of battleships, but with each glance, the shock in their hearts intensified.
Million-second-step cultivators on these countless battleships were mostly unfamiliar, seemingly emerging out of nowhere.
True Martial Realm cultivators could remain unknown, but how could so many quasi Emperors and Great Emperors be obscured from renown?
This discovery terrified the upper echelons of innumerable powers.
They recalled the grand wedding held by Chengsheng Mountain a while back, where the supreme Han Li had suddenly wed a Heavenly Immortal maiden.
That Heavenly Immortal maiden was virtually unknown, without any reputation within the Yuankun Domain, unrecognized by anyone, as if she wasn’t a creature of the Yuankun Domain at all.
Now, considering these innumerable battleships, these countless second-step cultivators, this further substantiated the suspicions of many mighty onesâ€”
Chengsheng Mountain had taken hold of a minor world!
Such a minor world wasn’t like those small heavens and blessed lands constructed by supremely strong forces.
This minor world had its own independently operating grand avenue rules, at least a hundred to a thousand times larger than any small heaven or blessed land, capable of birthing servants of the Heavenly Immortal and even the True Immortal realm.
At this moment, numerous powers and cultivators with ulterior motives promptly ceased their scheming, daring not to entertain any further crooked thoughts, readying themselves to honestly accept the rule of Chengsheng Mountain.
…….
On the golden-armored giant ship,
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, peerlessly clothed in white, his garments fluttering.
He remained as steadfast as a boulder while the gigantic ship traversed the void beneath him.
Originally, he had considered proposing marriage in a different manner, but a few months ago, Lu Tianxiang bore him Han Yongxian, his first Immortal Body offspring and the first with Immortal Grade talent.
He received an exceedingly generous Immortal Rank Gift Package.
After pondering briefly, Han Li decided to proceed to the Imperial Capital of Huangyue in the Kunji Divine Province and Yuanchu Mountain in Yuanchu Province to propose to Empress Huangyue and Empress Yuanchu in such a fashion.
Han Li’s ostentatious move wasn’t carried out via the Cross Borders Teleporting Formation but by traversing the void with battleships, imposing his might upon the world.
This journey served as a patrol across the Endless Yuankun Domain, proclaiming the unrivaled might of Chengsheng Mountain, and deterring any power harboring rebellion.
He commanded everyone to be truly submissive!
The fleet of battleships crossed the void at extreme speed, swiftly exiting the region of the Han Sea and entering Luming Divine Province, streaking across the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 770
chapters.content:
Chapter 770: Chapter 292: Immortal Rank Gift Package, the Second Golden Immortal Weapon.
Hongshang, I’m Here to Marry You_2 Chapter 770: Chapter 292: Immortal Rank Gift Package, the Second Golden Immortal Weapon.
Hongshang, I’m Here to Marry You_2 Countless cultivators in Luming Divine Province gazed up at the sky and were instantly struck by this awe-inspiring sight, feeling an unprecedented sense of reverence, fear, and longing for Chengsheng Mountain.
In the past, the might of Chengsheng Mountain was revealed only to those at the Quasi Emperor Realm, the Heaven Imperial Realm, and at most, to those within the Saint Abyss Realm, while cultivators of lower realms were unaware, their knowledge coming second-hand from word of mouth and various channels of information.
But this time, no matter which Divine Province one resided in, as long as they looked up, they could see the great warship fleet that obscured the sun, traversing the void.
Han Li saw all of this very clearly and was extremely pleased with the result, which had exceeded his expectations.
Now that the Eight Hundred Province of Yuankun Domain was barely unified, and Chengsheng Mountain stood as the supreme ruler, the countless cultivators and living beings were, for the first time, witnessing such a magnificent and startling sceneâ€”how could they not be deeply shaken?
...
Chengsheng Mountain’s formidable power held a fatal attraction for numerous outstanding talents.
Over the next hundreds of years, multitudes of geniuses from the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of the Yuankun Domain would converge on Chengsheng Mountain in Qianyuan Divine Province, all hoping to join its ranks.
However, Chengsheng Mountain had strict rules and brought out the Fighting Tower for talent battles, dividing them into direct lineage talent battles and external talent battles, with more competitions organized, all for the purpose of selecting the best and infusing new blood to maintain the vitality of Chengsheng Mountain.
“Lu Tianxiang has really done me a great favor,”
Han Li, standing with his hands behind his back, muttered to himself, his affection for Lu Tianxiang growing, as did his appreciation for Han Yongxian.
Lost in thought, Han Li couldn’t help but recall the moment, several months prior, when he had been thrilled to see a series of system messages on the system panel.
The first Emperor Child among his descendants was Han Yongqian, the child he had with Yao Xi, which helped Han Li unlock the hidden [Physique] panel and netted him a hundred Physique Points.
Han Li had originally thought that the reward for the first Immortal Body descendant would be a thousand Physique Points, but the reward turned out to be far beyond his expectations.
The appearance of the first Immortal Body descendant not only netted him a thousand Physique Points but also granted Han Li more than a thousand warships and cloud vessels, ranging from Heaven Imperial-level to True Immortal-levelâ€”although there was only one True Immortal warship, it was equipped with three True Immortal weapons, nearly rivaling the might of the Emperor Flag.
Moreover, Han Li received a True Immortal-level practice, a True Immortal-level martial skill, and ten Heaven Immortal-level practices and martial skills each.
The richness of the rewards made Han Li inwardly marvel; they were truly stirring.
Han Li’s first Top Grade talent descendant, Han Yonglong, was his child with Long Yue.
After Han Yonglong, Han Mansion produced countless Top Grade talent descendants, but none of them brought Han Li rewards, at most there were some talent feedbacks.
When Han Yonglong was born, the rewards Han Li received included a thirty percent enhancement in talent, three hundred years’ worth of cultivation, the Supreme Grade Heaven Rank martial skill “Break the Cosmos Spear Technique,” and the Divine Rank Lower Grade Practice “Immortal Sea Scripture.”
As a result, his cultivation talent was upgraded to Top Grade, greatly reducing the energy consumption required for Han Li to break through realms.
This time, with the appearance of an Immortal Grade talent, Han Yongxian, Han Li received rewards for the first time in decades, which were many times more generous than those for his first Top Grade talent descendant.
Firstly, he gained a legion composed of second-step cultivators, named the “Chi Yang Army Corps.”
The Chi Yang Army Corps included fifty Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, five of whom were at the pinnacle of Heaven Imperial Realm, in addition to five hundred Quasi Emperors, five thousand Saint Abyss Realm Saints, fifty thousand Tongxuan Realm mighty beings, five hundred thousand Divine Yuan Realm Emperor Wu, and five million True Martial Realm Emperor Wu.
During this patrol of his, Han Li only took a part of the legion with him, leaving the rest temporarily stationed at Chengsheng Mountain, to be arranged after his return from the wedding.
Secondly, Han Li acquired ten Lower Grade Immortal Veins and a thousand Emperor Rank Dragon Veins, including Lower, Middle, Upper, and Supreme Grades.
Each Lower Grade Immortal Vein contained at least one billion Lower Grade Immortal Stones; if mined slowly, the Lower Grade Immortal Vein would continuously absorb the essence of heaven and earth and indefinitely spawn new Immortal Stones, ultimately yielding up to a hundred and twenty billion, perhaps even a hundred and fifty billion Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
The thousand Emperor Rank Dragon Veins contained Spirit Sources of four different qualities, with the Lower Grade Dragon Veins yielding at least five hundred thousand Spirit Sources, Middle Grade Dragon Veins at least five million Spirit Sources, and Upper Grade Dragon Veins at least fifty million Spirit Sources…
These thousand Emperor Rank Dragon Veins alone could bring Han Li hundreds of billions, even a trillion Spirit Sources, and if mined slowly, it could possibly double in yield.
With such an abundance of Spirit Source and Immortal Stones, Han Li breathed a sigh of relief regarding the energy supply for Chengsheng Mountain.
Even with the addition of the Chi Yang Army Corps and the countless cultivators of the Han Mansion, they could easily sustain supply for over ten thousand years.
Third, Han Li also gained a large amount of free experience, which allowed him to upgrade his skills in Artifact Refining, Alchemy, Talisman Making, and Formationâ€”the Four Arts of Cultivationâ€”from Heaven Immortal Rank Lower Grade to Heaven Immortal Rank Supreme Grade.
Fourth, Han Li obtained numerous cultivation techniques and martial skills: two sets at True Immortal level, twenty sets each at Heaven Immortal level, and hundreds of techniques and skills at Emperor Level….
Fifth, Han Li received one True Immortal weapon, ten Heavenly Immortal weapons…and there were many pills such as True Immortal Pills, Heavenly Immortal Pills, and Emperor Pills.
These two types of rewards were so generous that at first glance, Han Li thought it was definitely an Immortal Rank Gift Package.
These rewards significantly enhanced Han Li’s foundation, filling in all his weaknesses, and from then on, Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion could claim to be a family of the immortal path.
And it wasn’t idle boasting.
With the Immortal Monarch level treasure, Tianquan Creation Furnace at hand, a number of cultivators with Immortal Bodies and Immortal Physiques had been artificially cultivated at the Han Mansion over the past few months.
Coupled with Chengsheng Mountain’s cultivation environment and the endless supply of pills to increase cultivation, there would surely be many who could break through to Heavenly Immortal and True Immortal in the future.
Besides that, during these months, Han Li had opened treasure chests and acquired many treasures.
For instance, one time he was extremely lucky, and directly received a Golden Immortal weapon named World Settling Sword, unmatched in its fierce and killing aura.
After some time, although Han Li’s cultivation level had not improved, he had made some progress in strength, for example, his combat ability stabilized at the peak of Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Having mastered three fully developed True Immortal level martial skills, Han Li’s combat methods became much more flexible, and his somewhat inflated combat ability instantly solidified.
In addition to cultivating three True Immortal level cultivation techniques, Han Li’s Chaos Decision also made some progress, reaching about Top Grade or Supreme Grade of the True Immortal level, and he was getting closer to the promotion to Golden Immortal level techniques.
While Han Li was lost in thoughts, a vast fleet that blotted out the sky crossed the void and set off.
After some time traveling, it arrived first at Kunji Divine Province, causing earth-shattering ripples, and countless cultivators called out the name of Chengsheng Mountain like a tidal wave.
On the prow of the golden-armored giant ship, Han Li stood tall.
His vast and powerful Divine Sense covered the entire Kunji Divine Province.
Seeing the scene below and casting a glance at Huangyue Imperial City ahead, a smile tugged at the corner of his mouth.
“Grant four Emperor Rank Dragon Veins to Kunji Divine Province,” said Han Li.
His voice suddenly echoed throughout Kunji Divine Province, shaking the hearts and minds of countless cultivators.
The cultivators were initially stunned but soon became overjoyed.
Even the Lower Grade Dragon Veins could greatly increase the Spiritual Energy in Kunji Divine Province.
Supreme Han Li was truly generous.
Thinking this, countless cultivators and creatures once again loudly hailed the name of Chengsheng Mountain.
As the cultivators were still in shock, Han Li flexed his finger, releasing four streams of light that transformed into four Dragon Veins of Emperor Rankâ€”each of Lower, Middle, Top, and Supreme Grade respectively.
Once again flicking his finger, Han Li used great mana to transplant the four Emperor Rank Dragon Veins directly into four locations within Kunji Divine Province.
The pure Spiritual Energy generated by the Dragon Veins spread endlessly, covering the entire Divine Province.
Seeing this scene, Han Li’s satisfaction grew even more apparent on his face.
Kunji Divine Province, the homeland of the Huangyue Empress, is home to Huangyue Imperial City, and to Han Li, this place was also of significant importance.
He had positioned his pieces ahead of time and had more arrangements planned for the future.
After this series of actions, the fleet continued to move forward and arrived in front of the magnificent city of Huangyue Imperial City.
Along the walls of Huangyue Imperial City, countless cultivators were already standing.
They had received the news early on and gathered to watch, with Huangyue Imperial City itself decked out in red.
Han Li’s gaze passed over the multitude and settled on the Huangyue Empress, who stood in front of the Immortal Hall in the imperial palace.
He said with a light chuckle,
“Hongshang, I’ve come to marry you.”

Chapter 771: Chapter 293 Where to?
Marry Me!
The Stirring Feelings of a Complex Yuan Weiyang_1 Chapter 771: Chapter 293 Where to?
Marry Me!
The Stirring Feelings of a Complex Yuan Weiyang_1 “`
“You’re here to marry me?”
Looking at the figure in white standing on the bow of the golden-armored giant ship, Empress Huang Hongshang was slightly spellbound, a rare hint of pink blooming on her flawlessly beautiful face.
Jumbled thoughts flooded Huang Hongshang’s heart, yet she only uttered one word, “Good~”
Han Li had once said he would come to propose and marry her, and Huang Hongshang had been wondering how he would arrive; she never expected it to be like this, which stirred ripples in her heart.
Han Li was already marrying a Heavenly Immortal, yet he still regarded her so highly.
...
Several people stood to the left and right of Huang Hongshang, all of them Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors of the Huangyue Imperial Empire.
They all noticed the change in the empress’s demeanor, and were inwardly shocked.
The Huangyue Empress had lived a life of unmatched conquest, pushing across all six directions, suppressing all eight corners, always presenting an image of iron-blooded mercilessness and supreme authority.
When had she ever shown this kind of slightly bashful girlishness?
“Hongshang even said she wouldn’t give Han Li a warm welcome when he arrived, but now that he’s barely here, Hongshang is already showing signs of capitulation, sigh~”
“Hongshang is just being contrary to what she feels.
It’s obvious, she has quite the feelings for Han Li.”
“In all of the vast Yuankun Domain, across the endless territories of the Eight Hundred Divine Regions, only a supreme individual can match up to Hongshang.”
“Hongshang didn’t choose wrong.
Han Li didn’t go to Yuanchu Mountain first but came to our Huangyue Imperial Empire instead, which shows he holds Hongshang in higher regard.”
“Hahaha~ Well said.
Empress Yuanchu must be feeling a tad jealous right now.”
The five Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors, both men and women, conversed through Divine Sense, not bothering to conceal their words.
Huang Hongshang and Han Li, both profound in their cultivation, heard some of what was said, but neither of them commented.
In that moment, their eyes saw nothing but each other.
Under the watchful eyes of the multitude, Han Li strode through the air with steady steps, arriving in front of the Immortal Hall of the imperial palace in just a few steps, right beside the Huangyue Empress.
The five Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors tactfully left the area to welcome Han Li’s massive fleet, which not only included some of the Chi Yang Army Corps but also important figures from Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion, as well as Han Li’s betrothal gifts.
Huang Hongshang was still clad in her golden armor, showcasing her tender and shapely body to perfection.
With a slight sweep of her phoenix eyes, she suddenly flashed a smile.
In an instant, the world lost its color, the sun and moon dimmed, and a hundred charms blossomed, stunning all creatures.
Han Li was momentarily dazed.
He had never seen the Huangyue Empress like this before and hadn’t expected the usually cold Huang Hongshang to have such a beautiful smile, so full of allure, so radiantly divine.
In this moment, Han Li suddenly realized he was moved.
Although he had many beloved wives and concubines, it was rare for him to feel moved by a woman, mostly marrying to advance his cultivation and seldom being moved, except for a fondness that developed over time.
His previous view of Huang Hongshang had also been that wayâ€”seeing something beautiful and wanting to possess it for himself, to have her bear his children.
But now, Han Li’s heart skipped a beat.
Looking at the beauty before him, just as Han Li was about to say something, he heard “Follow me.”
Huang Hongshang’s figure disappeared, and without hesitation, Han Li immediately followed.
In the farthest eastern reaches of the Yuankun Domain was a Divine Province called the Profound Sword Divine Province, named after the Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
Beyond the Profound Sword Divine Province stood the Xuanshen Sword Mountain that pierced the Nine Heavens, immeasurably tall and indescribably magnificent, sharp beyond compare.
It not only severed the connection between the Yuankun Domain and the other domains to the east, but also cut off the links to the south, west, and north, forming a barrier that isolated the Yuankun Domain.
Inhabitants of the Yuankun Domain, ranging from the lowest peddlers to Heavenly and True Immortals, had never been able to leave for hundreds of epochs.
People only knew that there were three ancient roads on the Xuanshen Sword Mountain, and anyone with the strength of a Golden Immortal could traverse them to enter the limitless world beyond.
Yet for countless eons, though some Eternal Golden Immortals had attempted to pass, no one knew if they had succeeded.
Those few who had braved the challenge might have perished on the slopes of Xuanshen Sword Mountain or, if they made it through, could not or did not wish to return.
On the central Divine Mountain of Profound Sword Divine Province,
Han Li and Huang Hongshang stood tall, Huang Hongshang speaking softly, Han Li listening attentively, both gazing at the incomparable Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
Huang Hongshang finished recounting the origin of the Yuankun Domain and Xuanshen Sword Mountain, and with a deep sigh, turned her face towards Han Li, pursed her rosy lips, and whispered:
“Han Li, do you think we can really reach the outside world?”
“I wonder what kind of world lies beyond Xuanshen Sword Mountain…”
“An ancestor had a theory that our Yuankun Domain is the center of all the worlds, suggesting that beyond Xuanshen Sword Mountain, there’s no vast and limitless universe…”
Han Li spoke only after Huang Hongshang fell silent, his tone calm yet assertive.
“Of course we can.”
“Beyond lies the Taichu Realm, with its Thirty-three Heavens and twelve thousand nine thousand six hundred domains.
The Yuankun Domain is just one among the myriad in the Taichu Domain, an isolated and weak place.”
“In the Taichu Realm, Golden Immortals are common as dust, True Immortals no better than dogs.
Even further up, Immortal Kings aren’t much to speak ofâ€”only Immortal Kings can become local powerhouses, Quasi Immortal Emperors dominators, while Immortal Emperors are the true rulers.”
“The Taichu Realm is nominally governed by the Crimson Heaven Court, but many Immortal Emperor lineages do not heed its commands and go their own ways.”
“…”
As Han Li spoke slowly, Huang Hongshang listened, desire apparent on her impeccable face.
When Han Li finished speaking, Huang Hongshang gazed at him intently for a moment before suddenly saying, “Let’s go.”
“Where to?”
“Marry me!”
