chapters.content:
Chapter 772: Chapter 293 Where to?
Marry Me!
The Stirring Feelings of a Complex Yuan Weiyang_2 Chapter 772: Chapter 293 Where to?
Marry Me!
The Stirring Feelings of a Complex Yuan Weiyang_2 “`
Huang Hongshang once again flashed a radiant smile, peerless in elegance, her beauty unsurpassable across all ages.
Gazing at the jade-like figure disappearing from view, Han Li also wore a smile on his face as he followed suit and returned to the Huangyue Imperial City.
Afterward, Han Li ordered the engagement gifts to be brought forth, all of them Immortal Treasures, each item exceedingly precious, ranging from Immortal Pills, Immortal Elixirs, Immortal Stones to Immortal Scriptures, Immortal Laws, Immortal Arrays…
...
There were Heavenly Immortal weapons, and even True Immortal weapons.
As Han Li’s gifts were announced one by one, the news reverberated throughout Huangyue Imperial City, spread across the entire Kunji Divine Province, and shook the myriad realms.
Countless powers and all living beings were stunned by the grandeur of the supreme Han Li’s gestures.
The eyes of all five Heaven Imperial Realm Great Emperors of the Huangyue Imperial Empire widened in awe, especially the female Heaven Imperial Realm Empress, whose heart wandered in endless reverie, wondering if Han Li would have been so considerate had he chosen her for marriage?
A slight curve touched Huang Hongshang’s lips, her heart brimming with joy.
Though the dowry was substantial, she did not hold it in high regard, but rather, it was Han Li’s attentiveness that endeared her.
Given Han Li’s current identity, status, and strength, had he chosen to be forceful with her, she would have been powerless to resist.
Yet, he did not do so, instead, he came forth across the void with a vast fleet to formally propose marriage with great solemnity.
How could Huang Hongshang not be overjoyed by this?
After the complex and solemn ceremonial procedures, Han Li left Huangyue Imperial City with Huang Hongshang, returning to Chengsheng Mountain via another route.
Han Li and Huang Hongshang stood at the prow of the golden armored giant ship,
With Han Li clad in a robe of white, while Huang Hongshang had shed her golden armor in exchange for a red dress.
The magnificent attire, donned upon her, accentuated Huang Hongshang’s even more breathtaking allure.
The golden armored giant ship, accompanied by countless warships, crossed the void and departed.
All cultivators were silent, quietly gazing at the two figures standing side by side.
“Hongshang, when you wear this red dress, you are the epitome of elegance and beauty, incomparably stunning.”
“Is that so?
This is my first time wearing a red dress.”
“Then I am truly fortunate to feast my eyes upon you and be the first to witness you in it.”
“Heh~ such a smooth talker.”
“How do you know if you haven’t tried it?
Want to give it a try?”
“Hehe~”
Han Li and Huang Hongshang chatted freely.
Even when Huang Hongshang occasionally replied with a cold laugh, Han Li didn’t mind and simply shifted the topic to continue their conversation.
Huang Hongshang was usually aloof and spoke little, but now in dialogue with Han Li, she found herself speaking more than she realized.
When she came to her senses, she was slightly taken aback, then suddenly asked, “Aren’t you going to Yuanchu Mountain to propose?”
Han Li shook his head slightly.
Huang Hongshang looked at him with surprise, “Have you given up on Weiyang?
Or…”
Han Li turned around, looked straight into Huang Hongshang’s eyes, and earnestly said, “This visit to propose marriage and the wedding ceremony are solely for you.”
Huang Hongshang turned to the side, avoiding his gaze, but she felt somewhat touched in her heart.
She had considered the possibility that Han Li would first visit Yuanchu Mountain to propose to Yuan Weiyang, or propose to both of them at the same time, then marry them together.
She did not expect Han Li to value her so highly, enough to stir her emotions.
Huang Hongshang felt that her impression of Han Li had been too one-sided, causing her to overlook this aspect.
“Hongshang, a month after we marry, I will go to Yuanchu Mountain and propose to Weiyang,” Han Li said as he extended his hand to take hold of her delicate hand, gently pulling.
Huang Hongshang’s body trembled, but she did not resist, allowing Han Li to pull her into his embrace.
Being embraced by the opposite sex around her soft waist, Huang Hongshang’s thoughts were a whirlwind of complexity, countless notions flashing through her mind, yet never once did she consider breaking free.
She felt that if this continued, she would inevitably ensnare her deeply, more than she already was.
Han Li simply held Huang Hongshang gently in his arms, without further advances, feeling that this was quite pleasant, and his once tumultuous sea of emotions soon calmed.
The setting sun cast a beautiful glow from the horizon, landing on the prow of the ship and on the affectionate couple, framing them in an otherworldly light, like a pair of divine lovers.
……..
Yuanchu Divine Province, Yuanchu Mountain.
This was a top-tier site of creation, surrounded by countless wondrous vistas and phenomena.
The vast river of stars descended from the nine heavens, winding down and complementing Yuanchu Mountain beautifully.
This Sacred Land was forged from thirty-three vast Star Domains, the extremely dense spiritual energy nourished beings, bodies, spirits, and even cultivated the way.
“`
Upon the peak of Yuanchu Mountain,
the Empress Yuanchu stood in her silver battle skirt, facing in the direction of the Kunji Divine Province, her expression complex, with an indelible trace of melancholy on her flawless visage.
“He really didn’t choose me in the end.”
Yuan Weiyang’s lips moved slightly as she sighed softly.
Han Li went to Huangyue Imperial City to propose marriage, a grand gesture known by all in the Endless Yuankun Domain.
Naturally, Yuan Weiyang was also aware of this.
She had been watching from a distance, observing all that Han Li had done for Huang Hongshang, which gave rise to a tumult of emotions within her.
Although she had made some agreements with Huang Hongshang beforehand, Yuan Weiyang still couldn’t hide her sense of loss at this moment.
She too had wanted to be Han Li’s first choice.
But with things having reached this point, she reckoned being the backup wasn’t so bad, especially since Han Li wasn’t a complete scoundrel.
If Han Li had gone to Huangyue Imperial City to fetch Huang Hongshang and had then come to Yuanchu Mountain to propose to her, Yuan Weiyang was sure she wouldn’t have shown him a pleasant face.
If Han Li had been even more of a scoundrel and wanted to marry both of them at the same time, Yuan Weiyang’s mood would have been even worse, giving rise to numerous grievances.
Now, it was better; Han Li hadn’t done so.
He would first marry Huang Hongshang and then come to marry her.
Though she was one step behind Huang Hongshang, the celebrations would be of the same grandeur, with Huang Hongshang receiving just a bit more attention than her.
Yuan Weiyang looked at the couple nestled together on the golden armored ship, feeling a sourness in her heart and sighed, “If only my split soul had met Han Li first…”
A single step missed means every step thereafter is off course.
She was the Empress Yuanchu, the peerless empress of the Endless Yuankun Domain, radiant and unmatched.
She couldn’t possibly lower her dignity to throw herself at him, so this was the only way.
Huang Hongshang and Han Li had known each other longer, so it was only natural for Han Li to marry her first.
…….
In Qianyuan Divine Province, Chengsheng Mountain.
Three days after Han Li returned from Huangyue Imperial City with Huang Hongshang, another extremely grand wedding ceremony was held here.
For a time, guests filled the seats, the halls were brimming with opulence, and high-ranking figures from all major powers were present.
As Han Li went to wed the Empress of Huangyue, powers from across the Endless Yuankun Domain had already begun their preparations, selecting suitable gifts before rushing toward Qianyuan Divine Province.
This time, Han Li even had the Artifact Spirit Lu Yao of the Golden Immortal Soldiers’ ‘Ming Tao Ding’ take action to spread celestial sounds throughout the Yuankun Domain.
Although ‘Ming Tao Ding’ couldn’t cover the entire domain, it could after several relocations.
Han Li personally gave a speech, expounding on his matrimonial connection with Huang Hongshang and many other things, which only made Yuan Weiyang on Yuanchu Mountain feel more sour.
Though she would also enjoy the same, it was still after Huang Hongshang.
After the elaborate and grand wedding ceremony, Han Li once again lectured on the vast ways of the world.
This time, he spoke of the pathway to becoming a Heavenly Immortal.
Although he had yet to break through to the Heavenly Immortal Realm, his understanding of the Heavenly Immortal pathway was no less than that of many Heavenly Immortals, perhaps even stronger.
After the festivities, Han Li came alone to the prepared bridal chamber.
Stepping inside, he saw Huang Hongshang once again.
Tonight, Huang Hongshang was not dressed in the red wedding attire of that day but was still adorned in bridal red.
With just one glance, Han Li felt his heart stir even more.
“Hongshang~”
Han Li sat beside Huang Hongshang, not lifting her red bridal veil but simply holding her hand and whispering sweet nothings.
Huang Hongshang listened quietly, occasionally nodding, her heart racing all the while.
As the night deepened, the two entered the bridal chamber and after an evening of love, they continued their discourse on the Dao until dawn.
In the days that followed, Han Li spent most of his time with Huang Hongshang, using the remainder to accompany Lu Tianxiang, Zi Miaozhen, Li Mingmeng, and his other beloved wives and concubines.
A month later, when Han Li led a massive fleet to marry Yuan Weiyang, Huang Hongshang’s belly was already slightly bulging.

In their honeymoon phase, the three were inseparable, glued to one another.
Although Huang Hongshang and Yuan Weiyang married into Chengsheng Mountain one after the other, they had a prior agreement and hence had a great understanding with each other as Han Li’s wives.
Han Li was also very fond of the two women.
Huang Hongshang had touched his heart from the beginning, and as he spent more time with Yuan Weiyang, he realized she had the quirky temperament of a little girl, as if her exterior was just a faÃ§ade, which made Han Li’s heart flutter as well.
With the two empresses joining forces in Chengsheng Mountain, there really weren’t many who could match them, yet neither woman resorted to currying favor or acting coquettishly.
They were crafty thinkers with impressive means, winning over many female cultivators who had married into Chengsheng Mountain earlier.
...
Their advanced cultivation and formidable strength, coupled with their already extraordinary status and position, naturally gave them an advantage in Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li took all this in stride but made no move to intervene.
As long as his beloved wives and concubines didn’t fight and turn the place upside down, Han Li wouldn’t get involved, nor did he want to.
Early morning, Tiansheng Realm,
Han Li was lounging amidst the clouds, which were dense clusters of Immortal Qi, and taking a single breath made him feel utterly refreshed.
Yesterday, he had been with sixty-six women.
Even with Han Li’s robust body and unparalleled physical strength, he felt almost overwhelmed.
After all, it included Qin Shiyin, Huang Hongshang, Yuan Weiyang, and Feng Mian, all empresses and Heavenly Immortals.
Han Li had transmitted so much “milk” that he urgently needed to replenish his energy.
Otherwise, he suspected he would be drained dry by his lovely wives and concubines within a few days.
The true “Juice Princess”!
Fortunately, what Han Li didn’t lack at the moment was energy, be it Immortal Pills, Immortal Elixirs, Immortal Stones, or Immortal Qi.
He had plenty of all these, especially Immortal Stones, and it would take him many years to deplete them even if he lived lavishly.
Lying in the clouds, Han Li felt a warm sensation throughout his body, moistened by countless streams of pure Immortal Qi.
The Immortal Qi, like gentle streams, flowed into his body, replenishing his energy and even further enhancing his foundation, allowing him to grow stronger with each battle.
He casually took out a bottle of Immortal Pills, poured them all into his mouth like they were beans, and felt waves of powerful energy erupting within his body, yet they couldn’t break his physical limits.
The Thousand Path Scripture operated, quickly refining all the Immortal Pills into docile energy that conditioned Han Li’s physical body.
“Such rare leisure time,” Han Li sighed after conditioning his body to its optimal state.
At that thought, Han Li’s mind shifted, and a phantom interface with a treasure chest appeared before himâ€”the treasure chest page.
Last month, Han Li only opened the treasure chest six times, expending 666 years of cultivation, and didn’t get any significant treasures.
Out of six items, only one True Immortal weapon was decent.
This month’s treasure chest had refreshed.
Having newly married Huang Hongshang and Yuan Weiyang, Han Li was eager to see if he could hit a treasure jackpot.
“Let’s try the free one first and see if I can get anything good without paying,” Han Li muttered to himself, and with a thought, the treasure chest in front of him opened.
In an instant, dazzling golden light flooded the whole page, and numerous visions emerged, causing quite a commotion.
Han Li’s pupils contracted, nearly jumping for joy off the cloud.
Could it be that the free try had actually yielded a huge win?
From his experience, such commotion with the treasure chest often heralded a significant haul.
“Is it a Golden Immortal weapon?
Or a Golden Immortal Rank treasure?
Or perhaps an even more powerful treasure?…”
In that moment, countless thoughts and speculations flashed through Han Li’s mind, eliminating numerous possibilities, ultimately narrowing it down to a few.
“I hope it’s the kind of treasure I’m thinking of,” Han Li mumbled while keeping his gaze fixed on the slowly opening treasure chest.
As the boundless golden light dissipated, the item from the chest appeared before Han Li, prompting his lips to twitch.
An egg?
Indeed, what appeared before him was an egg, approximately three feet in size, adorned with purple scale-like patterns.
“Ding~ Treasure chest successfully opened.
Congratulations to the master on obtaining the Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure [Void Beast Egg],” System’s prompt sounded in Han Li’s ear.
Han Li blinked, finding it a bit absurd that this thing was actually an Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure.
Nonetheless, he’d struck it lucky.
This was the first time he’d opened a treasure chest this month, and it was a free opportunity that became an instant success.
It was the second Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure in his possession.
But how was he supposed to use it?
With a slight gesture of his right index finger, the Void Beast Egg from the phantom treasure chest interface turned real, landing on the cloud in front of him, where it began to frantically absorb Immortal Qi, like a greedy creature devouring gold.
In fact, this thing was a Void Beast.
Han Li just glanced at it without interfering, allowing the Void Beast Egg to wildly absorb Immortal Qi.
He didn’t believe the egg could drain his Miniature Immortal Realm dry.
Initially, Han Li’s Miniature Immortal Realm was only ten thousand li in radius.
After adding ten Lower Grade Immortal Veins, it had expanded to a radius of fifty thousand li, no longer as thin in Immortal Qi.
In some areas of Han Li’s Miniature Immortal Realm that he had planned importantly, the Immortal Qi was even denser, like the clouds beneath him.
Void Beast Egg: An Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure, possessing incredibly high potential.
If cultivated diligently, it can break through to the Immortal Monarch level in the future without any bottlenecks…
After reading through the introduction of the Void Beast Egg, Han Li felt slightly distressed.
The item indeed represented a tremendous aid.
Once hatched, it would be a Heavenly Immortal, and when fully grown, an Immortal Monarch, with no bottlenecks in sight.

chapters.content:
Chapter 774: Chapter 294: Treasure Chest Explosion, Immortal Monarch Level Beast Egg, Golden Immortal Weapon, Lu Yuan Has Given Birth_2 Chapter 774: Chapter 294: Treasure Chest Explosion, Immortal Monarch Level Beast Egg, Golden Immortal Weapon, Lu Yuan Has Given Birth_2 Void Beasts naturally carry the Xukong Realm’s essence, possessing immense combat ability and astonishing destructive power.
They have their own world within and their means of traversing the void is even more formidable; those a Big Realm higher may not necessarily succeed in intercepting them.
Once hatched, the Void Beast Egg could serve as a fine guardian Mystical Beast for Chengsheng Mountain.
In the face of a major crisis in the future, it could simply swallow Chengsheng Mountain whole and flee.
As the Void Beast grows, it can become a powerful enforcer.
It’s just….
Growing such a creature requires a staggering amount of Immortal Tao Energy.
...
Han Li glanced at the astronomical figure and involuntarily took a sharp breath.
Chengsheng Mountain had amassed great wealth by now, owning over a hundred billion Lower Grade Immortal Stones, but to raise a Void Beast to the Immortal Monarch level was just a drop in the ocean, not even enough to fill the gaps between its teeth.
“Stop, stop, stop~”
Han Li sighed and hastily called out.
The beast egg, inscribed with purple kirin patterns, gently shook and then reluctantly came to a halt before bouncing up to Han Li like a cute child, incessantly rubbing against his leg.
Han Li touched the beast egg with his right hand, feeling the obscure consciousness within.
The moment the Void Beast had appeared on the treasure chest page, it had already formed a contract with him.
“It’s not that I don’t want to raise you, it’s just that you have too big of an appetite,” Han Li said with a wry smile.
According to the resource cultivation list that came with the Void Beast Egg, hatching it would require ten million Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
Spending ten million Lower Grade Immortal Stones for a Heaven Immortal Rank guardian Mystical Beast wasn’t a bad deal.
The original guardian Mystical Beast was a Kui Ox, which grew too slowly and had only reached the Quasi Emperor level.
In the meantime, Han Li had acquired nine White Tigers of different species, a Silver Giant, and so on, all Quasi Emperor Rank.
The ten million Lower Grade Immortal Stones were just for hatching.
When a Void Beast is born, it’s already at the first level of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, and while there are no bottlenecks to its future cultivation, the number of Immortal Stones required is astronomical.
To advance to the second level of the Heavenly Immortal Realm, one billion Lower Grade Immortal Stones are needed.
To reach the True Immortal Realm, thirty billion are needed, and for the Golden Immortal Realm, a staggering one trillion Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
In the Tiansheng Realm, this Miniature Immortal Realm has twelve Lower Grade Immortal Veins, which in total would barely yield one hundred and twenty billion Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
This amount of Immortal Stones would only allow the Void Beast to advance to the mid-stage of the True Immortal Realm.
Therefore, Han Li was in a dilemma, somewhat reluctant to cultivate the Void Beast.
Investing resources in the Void Beast seemed less worthwhile than allocating them to his beloved wives and exceptional descendants, allowing them to grow faster and compensate for Han Mansion’s weaknesses.
Naturally, Han Li himself did not need these resources.
Without sufficient Immortal Tao Energy, his own growth rate was much faster than that of the Void Beast.
If he had a vast number of Immortal Stones, like a hundred quadrillion or even ten quintillion, spending fifty quadrillion Immortal Stones to elevate the Void Beast to the Immortal Monarch level would certainly be very profitable.
It could provide powerful protection for Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion, and himself before he had fully grown.
However, with his insufficient Immortal Stones, spending all he had would only advance the Void Beast to the mid-stage of the True Immortal Realm, inadequate to face the hidden dangers within the Tai Chu Realmâ€”it would be a large but useless advantage.
The Void Beast Egg kept frantically rubbing against Han Li’s thigh, wishing it could speak to plead with him to lift the restriction, its thoughts echoing, “Master, please don’t give up on me~”
Han Li extended his hand and tossed the Void Beast Egg aside, saying indifferently, “Wait for a moment.”
Han Li had already made up his mind.
He planned to continue opening treasure chests; if he could get some Immortal Veins, he would cultivate the Void Beast up to the True Immortal Realm.
If not, he would just hatch it and leave it be for now, letting it slowly absorb energy on its own.
“Open~”
Han Li’s gaze fixed on the treasure chest page, and as his thoughts moved, a year’s worth of cultivation was deducted.
The treasure chest blazed with brilliant light.
“Ding~ Treasure chest opening succeeded, congratulations Master on obtaining an Imperial Rank Treasure, Jade’s Heart.”
Han Li’s face remained expressionless as he opened the third treasure chest.
“Ding~ Treasure chest opening succeeded, congratulations Master on obtaining a True Immortal Rank Treasure, Immortal’s Furnace.”
A smile crept onto Han Li’s face; a True Immortal weapon was not bad at all.
He didn’t check immediately, opting to continue opening chests and to review them all later.
The fourth chest opening yielded two Lower Grade Immortal Veins of Heaven Immortal Rank.
Upon opening the treasure chest for the fifth time, he obtained a Quasi Emperor Rank Treasure, “Thunderbolt Finger”.
Upon opening it for the sixth time, he secured a True Immortal Rank Treasure called “Promotion Card”.
Heaving open the seventh chest, he gained a Golden Immortal Rank Treasure named “Sky Measuring Ruler”.
Han Li pondered for a moment but didn’t continue.
This month, he had already drawn an Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure, a Golden Immortal Rank Treasure, and two True Immortal Rank Treasures:his luck was incredible.
If he were to continue, it was very likely that his luck would turn on him, and if it worsened, it would just be a waste of five thousand years of cultivation.
After merely seven treasure chests, he had expended only 666 years of cultivation, but acquired four treasures of True Immortal Rank and above.
It was simply exhilarating.
“Immortal’s Furnace”: A True Immortal Rank Treasure, which can be used as the core for Immortal Tao Energy.
Once activated, it can continuously gather Immortal Qi from other parts of the Taichu Realm, generating one million strands of Immortal Qi every hour.
“Sky Measuring Ruler”: A Golden Immortal Rank Treasure, a powerful offensive celestial weapon capable of bearing two types of Golden Immortal Rank paths.
Once it fully recovers, its combat ability will be comparable to the third level of the Golden Immortal Realm.
Han Li focused on examining the Immortal’s Furnace and Sky Measuring Ruler.
The results left him quite pleased.
The appearance of the Immortal’s Furnace provided Han Li with a continuous channel for Immortal Qi, significantly more efficient than those channeled by other celestial weapons.
In one hour, it could generate one million strands of Immortal Qi, which equaled twenty-four million strands a day or the equivalent of two hundred forty thousand Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
In a year, that would be eight hundred seventy-six million Lower Grade Immortal Stones, and in just over a hundred years, it would be equal to a Lower Grade Immortal Vein.
In just over five hundred thousand years, he could accumulate enough Immortal Tao Energy to nurture a Void Beast into an Immortal Monarch.
Han Li blinked, suddenly feeling that it was a long wait.
Over five hundred thousand years just to cultivate an Immortal Monarch:it was utterly outrageous, yet Han Li still found it too long.
Considering his rate of growth, not to mention five hundred thousand years, perhaps in ten thousand years, his cultivation would have reached the Immortal Monarch Realm, or even the Immortal King Realm.
“Enough, enough, I’ll make do with it.
It’s better than those Lower Grade Immortal Veins,” Han Li muttered.
He casually tossed the Immortal’s Furnace into the center of the Miniature Immortal Realm.
It was immediately activated and began to operate, incessantly gathering deep void Immortal Qi and transforming it into the Tiansheng Realm.
Han Li just glanced at it and turned his attention away, looking over the Sky Measuring Ruler and, with a flick of his hand, sent it into another part of the Tiansheng Realm’s firmament to keep the other celestial weapons company.
Now, he had three Golden Immortal celestial weapons, the most formidable being the World Settling Sword.
It was a top-tier Golden Immortal weapon, with combat ability on par with the Sixth Heaven of the Golden Immortal Realm.
The Mixed Dao Cauldron was somewhat inferior, with power matching the fourth level of the Golden Immortal Realm.
The Sky Measuring Ruler was the weakest, which is why Han Li didn’t pay it much attention.
Having done all this, Han Li stored the True Immortal Rank Promotion Card, considering which Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon would benefit from it.
He also placed the two Lower Grade Immortal Veins within the Miniature Immortal Realm.
Under his deliberate control, the Miniature Immortal Realm did not expand again, which made the Immortal Qi denser.
Thunderbolt Finger was tossed into Cnagdao Hall by Han Li, while he toyed with Jade’s Heart, an Emperor Treasure.
This auxiliary Emperor Weapon had a decent effect, and he contemplated which descendant to bestow it upon.
“Huuh~”
Han Li exhaled gently, his figure vanishing from the Tiansheng Realm, and arrived at Lu Yuan’s chamber.
Lu Yuan’s master, Shi Mengyan, was also there, her belly swollen with pregnancy for several months now.
Though their chambers were separate, the two women often stayed together.
Han Li was not there for a tryst, for he had just recently engaged in self-reflection and was now devoid of any amorous desires.
Lu Yuan was about to give birth.
Just now, Lu Yao had messaged him about Lu Yuan’s situation, and without further ado, Han Li came directly here.
After greeting Shi Mengyan, Han Li quietly waited.
He had been through this scene countless times.
Before long, Lu Yuan’s child was bornâ€”a descendant with Immortal Grade aptitude, pity that only a royal physique was present.
PS: Huang Hongshang’s illustration has been added to the previous chapter.
Those who missed it can go and check it out.
PS: Unless something unexpected happens, this volume should be completed by tomorrow, and then the third step towards becoming an Immortal will commence.

Considering his rate of progress, not to mention five hundred thousand years, it was possible that in ten thousand years, his cultivation would reach the Immortal Monarch Realm, if not the Immortal King Realm.
“Forget it, it will have to do, still better than those Lower Grade Immortal Veins,” muttered Han Li.
He casually threw out the Immortal Gathering Furnace, landing it at the center of the Miniature Immortal Realm.
The furnace was immediately activated and began operating, ceaselessly gathering the deep Xukong Realm’s Immortal Qi and transferring it inside Tiansheng Realm.
Han Li glanced at it briefly before turning his attention away and taking a look at the Sky Measuring Ruler, tossing it off-hand into another area of the Tiansheng Realm’s firmament to join with other divine weapons.
Now, he had three Golden Immortal weapons.
The most formidable among them was the World Settling Sword, a top-tier Golden Immortal weapon with combat ability comparable to the Sixth Heaven of the Golden Immortal Realm.
The Mix Dao Cauldron was somewhat weaker, with combat ability akin to the Fourth Heaven of the Golden Immortal Realm.
The Sky Measuring Ruler was the least impressive, which is why Han Li did not pay much heed to it.
After doing all this, Han Li stored away the True Immortal Rank Promotion Card, pondering which Supreme Grade Emperor weapon to use it on, and placed the two Lower Grade Immortal Veins within the Miniature Immortal Realm.
Under his deliberate control, the Miniature Immortal Realm did not expand again, making the Immortal Qi within it richer.
Han Li tossed the Thunderbolt Finger into the Cnagdao Hall and toyed with Jade’s Heart, an Emperor Rank supportive Treasure whose effect was quite satisfactory.
He contemplated which descendant to bestow it upon.
“Hoo~”
Han Li exhaled softly, his figure disappearing from Tiansheng Realm and arriving at Lu Yuan’s sleeping chambers.
Lu Yuan’s master, Shi Mengyan, was also there, her belly bulging after being pregnant for several months.
Although the sleeping chambers of the two women were separate, they often stayed together.
Han Li’s visit was not for a secret rendezvous; he had just performed his daily self-reflection not too long ago and was not in the mood for such pleasures.
Lu Yuan was about to give birth.
Lu Yao had recently sent him a message about Lu Yuan’s condition, and without another thought, Han Li left behind all the muddle and came straight here.
After greeting Shi Mengyan, Han Li quietly waited; he had been through this scene countless times.
Before long, Lu Yuan’s child was born, a descendant with Immortal Grade talent.
Unfortunately, it only had the Imperial Body.
PS: The image of Huang Hongshang has been created and can be found in the previous chapter for those who haven’t seen it.
PS: If nothing unexpected happens, this volume will be finished by tomorrow, and then it will be the third step to becoming an Immortal.

chapters.content:
Chapter 777: Chapter 294: Treasure Chest Explosion, Immortal Monarch Level Beast Egg, Golden Immortal Weapon, Lu Yuan Has Given Birth_1 Chapter 777: Chapter 294: Treasure Chest Explosion, Immortal Monarch Level Beast Egg, Golden Immortal Weapon, Lu Yuan Has Given Birth_1 Since he had welcomed Huang Hongshang and Yuan Weiyang, two peerless empresses, into his life, one of Han Li’s long-cherished visions had diminished.
In the bliss of newlywed life, he became inseparable from them, nearly as close as shadows to their forms.
Although Huang Hongshang and Yuan Weiyang married into Chengsheng Mountain at different times, they had a prior arrangement, so they were in harmony as Han Li’s wives.
Han Li was quite fond of both women.
He had been somewhat taken by Huang Hongshang from the beginning, and it was only after spending more time with Yuan Weiyang that he discovered her quirky, childlike nature, as if everything about her was but a facade, which made Han Li’s heart flutter.
United on Chengsheng Mountain, the two empresses were formidable adversaries for anyone; yet, being women of intricate thoughts, they did not overtly seek favor or flattery.
They were also cunning, winning over many of the earlier brides of Chengsheng Mountain.
...
With their profound cultivation and formidable strength, along with their extraordinary status, they naturally held advantages on Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li noticed all this but took no action, happy to remain uninvolved as long as his beloved wives and concubines did not fight and disturb the peace.
Early morning, Tiansheng Realm,
Han Li was leisurely lying amidst the clouds, which were made of rich Immortal Qi, taking pleasure from even a single breath.
The day before had been a day with many women,
Even with Han Li’s robust body and peerless physical strength, he was somewhat overwhelmed.
After all, his company included Qin Shiyin, Huang Hongshang, Yuan Weiyang, and Feng Mianâ€”empresses and Heavenly Immortals alike.
Han Li had engaged in lengthy discussions with them and urgently needed to replenish his energy.
Otherwise, he suspected he might be completely drained by his endearing wives and beautiful concubines within a few days.
Luckily, energy was now the least of Han Li’s worries.
Whether it was Immortal Pills, Immortal Elixirs, Immortal Stones, or Immortal Qi, he had plenty, especially of Immortal Stones.
Even if he squandered them, it would take many years for them to run out.
Lying in the clouds, Han Li felt warmth coursing through his body, nourished by countless streams of pure Immortal Qi that reinforced his energy and even strengthened his foundation, making it increasingly robust.
Grabbing a bottle of Immortal Pills, Han Li poured them into his mouth like beans.
Bursts of potent energy erupted within his body but could not break through his flesh.
The Thousand Path Scripture operated, rapidly refining all the Immortal Pills into docile energy that soothed Han Li’s physique.
“Indeed, rare leisure time,” Han Li sighed after conditioning his body to its prime state.
Recalling this, Han Li’s thoughts prompted a holographic panel to appear before him, showcasing a treasure chest at its centerâ€”the very page of the treasure chest.
Last month, Han Li had opened the chest only six times, spending 666 years worth of cultivation without obtaining any impressive treasures, with just one True Immortal weapon being decent among the six items.
The chest for this month had refreshed, and with the addition of Huang Hongshang and Yuan Weiyang to his life, Han Li was curious to see if he could hit a treasure jackpot.
“Let’s start with a free try and see if we can get lucky,” Han Li murmured to himself and with a thought, the treasure chest opened.
In an instant, brilliant gold light blossomed, engulfing the entire panel and accompanied by various visions ebbing and flowing, creating quite a stir.
Han Li’s pupils contracted, nearly leaping for joy from the cloud.
Did he truly hit the jackpot on a free attempt?
From his experience, such commotion from a treasure chest usually signified an explosive outcome.
“Could it be a Golden Immortal weapon?
Or a Golden Immortal Rank Treasure?
Or perhaps an even more powerful treasure?…”
In that moment, countless thoughts and speculations flashed through Han Li’s mind, as he eliminated numerous possibilities, gradually narrowing them down.
“Hopefully, it’s the kind of treasure I’m thinking of,” Han Li whispered, his gaze fixed as the chest slowly opened.
When the boundless golden light dissipated, the treasure within the chest came into Han Li’s view, and he couldn’t help but twitch at the corners of his mouth.
An egg?
Indeed, what appeared before him was an egg, about three feet in size, adorned with purple-scaled patterns.
“Ding~ Treasure chest opened successfully.
Congratulations, Master, on obtaining the Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure[Void Beast Egg].”
Hearing the system’s notification, Han Li blinked.
This object was actually an Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure.
Quite outrageous!
However, he was in good luck since this was the first chest of the month and it was a free opportunity that hit the mark in one go.
It was now the second Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure in his possession.
But how was he to use this thing?
With a slight hook of his index finger, the Void Beast Egg in the holographic treasure chest interface turned tangible and landed on the cloud in front of him.
It voraciously absorbed Immortal Qi like a greedy glutton for gold.
In fact, it was a Void Beast Egg indeed.
Han Li just glanced at it and let it be, confident that a mere egg could not drain his Miniature Immortal Realm dry.
Originally, his Miniature Immortal Realm spanned only ten thousand miles but after adding ten Lower Grade Immortal Veins, it had expanded to fifty thousand miles, and the Immortal Qi was no longer so scarce.
In certain areas that Han Li had specially planned, the Immortal Qi was even richerâ€”like the cloud beneath him.
Void Beast Egg: An Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure with immense potential.
If nurtured diligently, it can break through to the Immortal Monarch realm without any bottleneck…
After reading through the Void Beast Egg’s introduction, Han Li felt a mild headache.
The egg was indeed a tremendous asset; once hatched, it would be at the Heavenly Immortal level, and it could grow to the pinnacle of Immortal Monarch with no bottlenecks to speak of.

chapters.title: Chapter 778
chapters.content:
Chapter 778: Chapter 294: Treasure Chest Explosion, Immortal Monarch Level Beast Egg, Golden Immortal Weapon, Lu Yuan Has Given Birth_2 Chapter 778: Chapter 294: Treasure Chest Explosion, Immortal Monarch Level Beast Egg, Golden Immortal Weapon, Lu Yuan Has Given Birth_2 Void Beasts are naturally endowed with the ability to traverse the Xukong Realm, possessing immense combat abilities and astonishingly destructive power.
They even harbor an entire world within their bodies, and their means of traveling through the void are formidable, not necessarily able to be intercepted even by beings of a Big Realm higher.
After the hatching of a Void Beast Egg, having it as the mountain protection beast of Chengsheng Mountain is actually not bad.
Should a major crisis arise in the future, it is possible to let the Void Beast directly swallow Chengsheng Mountain and flee.
Once the Void Beast matures, it can also serve as a powerful enforcer.
It’s just….
To nurture this creature to full growth consumes a terrifying amount of Immortal Tao Energy.
...
Han Li glanced at the astronomical figures and couldn’t help but inhale sharply.
Chengsheng Mountain has a vast family business now, boasting over a hundred billion Lower Grade Immortal Stones alone.
However, to grow the Void Beast to the Immortal Monarch level, that’s merely a drop in the ocean â€” nowhere near enough to fill the gaps between its teeth.
“Stop, stop, stop~”
Han Li sighed and quickly called out.
The beast egg, adorned with purple kirin patterns, gently wobbled, then reluctantly came to a stop.
It bounced up to Han Li like an adorable toddler, constantly rubbing against his thigh.
With a pat on the beast egg with his right hand, Han Li felt the nebulous consciousness inside.
The moment the Void Beast appeared from the treasure chest page, it had already formed a contract with him.
“It’s not that I don’t want to raise you, it’s just that your appetite is too big,” said Han Li with a bitter smile.
According to the resource cultivation list accompanying the Void Beast Egg, hatching the Void Beast requires ten million Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
Exchanging ten million Lower Grade Immortal Stones for a Heavenly Immortal Rank mountain protection beast isn’t a bad deal.
The original mountain protection beast was a Kui Ox, which grew too slowly.
It’s only at the Quasi Emperor level now.
Han Li has already acquired nine variant White Tigers and Silver Giants, all at the Quasi Emperor level.
The ten million Lower Grade Immortal Stones are just for hatching purposes.
Once born, the Void Beast will already be at the first level of Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Although there are no bottlenecks in its further cultivation, the consumption of Immortal Stones is massive.
To level up to the second level of Heavenly Immortal Realm requires one hundred million Lower Grade Immortal Stones, reaching the True Immortal Realm needs three billion, and advancing to the Golden Immortal Realm takes one hundred billion Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
In the Tiansheng Realm, this Miniature Immortal Realm has twelve Lower Grade Immortal Veins, which, if mined all at once, would yield only 120 billion Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
This amount of Immortal Stones can only allow the Void Beast to reach the mid-stage of the True Immortal Realm.
Thus, Han Li is conflicted; he isn’t too keen on cultivating the Void Beast anymore.
Rather than spending resources on the Void Beast, it would be better to dedicate them to his beloved wives and concubines, or his outstanding descendants, allowing them to grow faster and fill in the gaps at Han Mansion.
Of course, Han Li himself doesn’t need these.
With the shortage of Immortal Tao Energy, his growth speed is much faster than that of the Void Beast.
If there were a vast number of Immortal Stones, for instance, a hundred million billion or ten million billion Immortal Stones, using fifty million billion Immortal Stones to raise the Void Beast to the Immortal Monarch level would certainly be a profitable affair.
It could provide powerful protection for Chengsheng Mountain, Han Mansion, and himself before he grows in strength.
However, his Immortal Stones are insufficient.
Even exhausting all of them can only bring the Void Beast to the mid-stage of the True Immortal Realm, incapable of dealing with the lurking crises in the Tai Chu Realm.
It would be nothing more than a big useless rib.
The Void Beast Egg continued to frantically rub against Han Li’s thigh, wishing it could speak and say, “Master, please don’t give up on me~”
Han Li stretched out his hand and tossed the Void Beast Egg aside, saying indifferently, “Wait a moment.”
Han Li had already made a decision.
He planned to continue opening the treasure chest; if he could get some Immortal Veins, then he would cultivate the Void Beast to the True Immortal Realm.
If not, then just hatching would suffice.
For now, he wouldn’t bother with further development and let it absorb energy on its own.
“Open~”
Han Li’s gaze landed on the treasure chest page and as his thoughts moved, a year of cultivation was deducted.
The treasure chest burst into brilliant light.
“Ding~ Treasure chest opened successfully, congratulations master on obtaining the Imperial Rank Treasure, Jade’s Heart.”
Han Li opened the third treasure chest with an expressionless face.
“Ding~ Treasure chest opened successfully, congratulations master on obtaining the True Immortal Rank Treasure, Immortal’s Furnace.”
Han Li’s face revealed a hint of a smile.
A True Immortal weapon is not too shabby.
He didn’t check it for now, choosing to continue with the treasure chests, planning to inspect them all later.
On the fourth attempt at the treasure chest, he obtained two Heavenly Immortal Rank Treasures, Lower Grade Immortal Veins.
The fifth time opening the treasure chest, Han Li obtained a Quasi Emperor Rank Treasure, the Thunderbolt Finger.
The sixth time opening the treasure chest, he obtained a True Immortal Rank Treasure, Promotion Card.
The seventh time opening the treasure chest, he secured a Golden Immortal Rank Treasure, Sky Measuring Ruler.
Han Li thought for a moment and decided not to go any further.
This month, he had already unboxed one Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure, one Golden Immortal Rank Treasure, and two True Immortal Rank Treasures, so his luck was incredibly great.
If he continued, it might just backfire and if his luck turned sour, it would be a pity to waste five thousand years of cultivation for nothing.
In only seven treasure chests, he had expended 666 years of cultivation but received four True Immortal Rank and higher treasures, which was simply too thrilling.
Immortal’s Furnace: A True Immortal Rank Treasure, it can serve as the core for Immortal Tao Energy.
Once activated, it can continuously gather Immortal Qi from other places in the Taichu Realm, producing one million strands of Immortal Qi every hour.
Sky Measuring Ruler: A Golden Immortal Rank Treasure, a powerful offensive magical weapon that carries two Golden Immortal Rank Realms.
Once fully revived, its combat ability is comparable to the third layer of the Golden Immortal Realm.
Han Li closely checked the Immortal’s Furnace and the Sky Measuring Ruler and was very pleased with the results.
With the appearance of the Immortal’s Furnace, Han Li now had a continuous channel for Immortal Qi, which was much more efficient than the channels created by other magical weapons.
One hour can produce one million strands of Immortal Qi, which means twenty-four million strands a day, equivalent to two hundred and forty thousand Lower Grade Immortal Stones.
In one year, that’s 8,760 million Lower Grade Immortal Stones, which in a little over a hundred years is equivalent to a Lower Grade Immortal Vein.
It would only take a little over five hundred thousand years to accumulate enough Immortal Tao Energy to cultivate a Void Beast into an Immortal Monarch.
Han Li blinked and suddenly felt that was a very long time.
To cultivate an Immortal Monarch Realm being in just a little over five hundred thousand years was absolutely ridiculous, yet for Han Li, it still seemed too long.
Given his rate of growth, not to mention over five hundred thousand years, perhaps his cultivation would reach the Immortal Monarch Realm or even Immortal King Realm in just ten thousand years.
“Forget it, forget it, it will do.
It’s still better than those Lower Grade Immortal Veins,” Han Li muttered to himself.
He tossed the Immortal’s Furnace into the center of the Miniature Immortal Realm, where it was instantly activated and immediately began to operate, continuously gathering deep void Immortal Qi and converting it for the Tiansheng Realm.
Han Li glanced at it and then turned his attention away, looking at the Sky Measuring Ruler and casually threw it into another part of the sky in the Tiansheng Realm, to keep company with his other magical weapons.
Now, he had three Golden Immortal magical weapons, among which the most powerful one was the World Settling Sword, a top-notch Golden Immortal weapon with a combat ability comparable to the Sixth Heaven of the Golden Immortal Realm.
The Mixed Dao Cauldron was slightly less powerful, with combat ability matching the Fourth Heaven of the Golden Immortal Realm, while the Sky Measuring Ruler was the weakest, so Han Li didn’t pay much attention to it.
After doing all this, Han Li put away the True Immortal Rank Promotion Card, contemplating which Supreme Grade Emperor Weapon to use it on, and placed two Lower Grade Immortal Veins in the Miniature Immortal Realm.
Under his deliberate control, the Miniature Immortal Realm did not expand further, resulting in a denser accumulation of Immortal Qi.
He threw the Thunderbolt Finger into the Cangdao Hall, while the Jade’s Heart, an Emperor Level Treasure, he toyed with, as it was an auxiliary Emperor Weapon with quite good effects.
He was thinking about which descendant to bestow it upon.
“Hoo~”
Han Li let out a gentle breath, his figure disappearing from the Tiansheng Realm and arriving at Lu Yuan’s chamber.
Lu Yuan’s master Shi Mengyan was also here, her belly swollen as she was several months pregnant.
Although the chambers of the two women were separate, they often stayed together.
Han Li was of course not here for a tryst; he had just been doing self-reflection not long ago and had no interest in such matters now.
Lu Yuan was about to give birth.
Lu Yao had just sent him a message informing him of Lu Yuan’s situation, and without giving any more thought to the jumble of matters, Han Li directly descended here.
After offering Shi Mengyan a greeting, Han Li quietly waited.
He had experienced this scene countless times by now.
It wasn’t long before Lu Yuan’s child was born, a descendent with Immortal Grade qualifications, a pity it was only born with the Emperor Body.

Those who haven’t seen it can go take a look.
PS: Unless something unexpected happens, this volume should be finished by tomorrow, and then onto the third step of becoming an Immortal.

Chapter 779: Chapter 295: Occupying Half of Eternity, One Can Step into the Fourth?
The Schemes and Killing Intent of the Chiming Heavenly Emperor_1 Chapter 779: Chapter 295: Occupying Half of Eternity, One Can Step into the Fourth?
The Schemes and Killing Intent of the Chiming Heavenly Emperor_1 “`
“His name, Han Yongzhou.”
Han Li looked at the child born to Lu Yuan and named the infant.
This child had Immortal Grade talent and possessed the Emperor Body, his future achievements were destined to be great.
“Good~”
Lu Yuan’s somewhat pale complexion turned rosy, her spirits lifted as she heard the Name, and she was quite fond of this name, too.
“My son, from now on you’ll be called Han Yongzhou.” Lu Yuan whispered softly to the baby in her arms.
Shi Mengyan watched this scene, her jade hand caressing her protruding belly, a hint of envy flashing in her eyes.
...
Would her child, after birth, possess Immortal Grade talent, would it possess an Immortal Body?
Only after marrying into Chengsheng Mountain did Shi Mengyan truly realize the profound depths of Chengsheng Mountain’s heritage.
They could mass-produce those with Immortal Grade talent and Immortal Bodies through two avenues.
It was truly terrifying.
To think that she herself had only Grade One talent and the Emperor Body.
After marrying Han Li, although she was eligible to use the Tianquan Creation Furnace, she still had to queue up and it would take some time before it would be her turn.
Shi Mengyan was already very satisfied with this.
She had thought about improving her talent and physique, but despite struggling for more than 100,000 years and searching for opportunities everywhere, she still hadn’t succeeded.
Yet at Chengsheng Mountain, all she needed to do was wait in line–at most twenty years–and then it would be her turn.
By then, she would be promoted to an Immortal Body and Physique, and with the help of Chengsheng Mountain, advancing to Heavenly Immortal wouldn’t be difficult.
It was like a dream.
But her husband and the child in her belly assured her that all this was real.
Han Li, however, didn’t feel much.
Han Yongzhou might have possessed Immortal Grade talent, but aside from the talent feedback, this did not bring any other rewards, nor was he the second descendant with Immortal Grade talent.
Before Han Yongzhou, after Han Yongxian, Han Li had already had six descendants with Immortal Grade talent, and there were several who possessed either an Immortal Body or both.
The Emperor Body of Han Yongzhou did provide him with some Physique Point feedback, though.
After accompanying Lu Yuan for a while, Han Li left, having made some arrangements that would help train Han Yongzhou from a young age and improved Lu Yuan’s treatment.
After leaving, Han Li became engrossed in busyness.
Even though Chengsheng Mountain was now invincible in the Yuankun Domain, Han Li didn’t slack off.
He still actively encouraged childbirth and the proliferation of his descendants, with the rewards being richer than ever, including some hidden additional benefits.
For instance, if a certain descendant had a certain number of children, he or his descendants would receive a significant reward, something they couldn’t have obtained before.
For example, if a certain branch of the Han Mansion reached a certain number of members, like a hundred, a thousand, or ten thousand, reaching each milestone would net them a large bounty of rewards.
In addition, Han Li was actively planning for the future of Chengsheng Mountain’s Han Mansion, preparing for their journey beyond the Yuankun Domain.
Only with descendants united and diligently practicing cultivation and reproduction could the laid-back Ancestor Han enjoy a leisurely immortal life, advance rapidly in cultivation, and strengthen his power swiftly.
If they didn’t work hard, how would Ancestor Han enjoy blessings?
…….
Tai Chu Realm,
The Thirty-three Heavens contained a Heaven known as Lingxiao Heaven, and the current Crimson Heaven Court was located there, ruling over the entire Tai Chu Realm.
Despite Guanghan Immortal Palace, Nine Tribulation Mountain, Longhan Immortal Court, and other supreme paths each occupying a Heaven and not necessarily heeding commands, the strength of the Crimson Heaven Court was undeniable.
There were only so many Immortal Emperors in the entire Tai Chu Realm, and the Crimson Heaven Court had six of them, with the Chiming Heavenly Emperor recognized as the strongest in the Tai Chu Realm.
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor’s military exploits were illustrious, his fame spreading across myriad realms, and even within the Ancient Eternal Realm, he was one of the most powerful among the top-tiered strong.
In the Tai Chu Realm, there were very few who were qualified to fight him, and even fewer who dared do so.
Lingxiao Heaven was vast and boundless, containing infinity within.
Divine light flourished, Immortal Qi was dense, divine birds circled, and Immortal Elixirs were found everywhere.
It was the most auspicious and also the largest land of creation within the entire Tai Chu Realm.
At the center of Lingxiao Heaven stood palatial towers and regal edifices; there were Immortal Palaces and Halls everywhere–this was the Crimson Heaven Court, towering and splendid, vast and majestic, constantly exuding supreme might that spread throughout Lingxiao Heaven, to all thirty-three Heavens, and to the entire Tai Chu Realm.
At the very heart of the Crimson Heaven Court was the most sacred Immortal Hall called Lingxiao Hall, which was also an overpowering Immortal Emperor Weapon capable of suppressing all Heavens, sweeping across realms, transcending the ancient, present, and future.
Deep within Lingxiao Hall sat a middle-aged man in a purple robe with a distinct face, elegant and handsome.
He was the reigning Chiming Heavenly Emperor.
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor sat on the Emperor of Heaven’s throne in thoughtfulness, murmuring to himself, “Interesting, very interesting, for her to personally intervene to conceal it…
What exactly happened over there?”
“Could she have joined forces with that person?”
These thoughts caused the Chiming Heavenly Emperor’s brow to furrow tightly, forming a Sichuan character, casting a shadow of displeasure over his mood.
There weren’t many in the Tai Chu Realm that the Chiming Heavenly Emperor dreaded, but the Guanghan Empress was definitely one of them.
Her talent and potential were so stunning that they even surpassed his.
The Guanghan Empress had practiced cultivation for several Tribulation periods less than him, but her strength was already catching up to his.
While they were both at the Peak of the Immortal Emperor, exploring the fourth step of the Dao, the Chiming Heavenly Emperor had some clues.
He found that the Guanghan Empress seemed to do so, too, but was just slightly behind him.
If the Guanghan Empress were given another Tribulation period or even longer, the title of the strongest in the Tai Chu Realm might possibly pass to the Guanghan Empress.
This was something the Chiming Heavenly Emperor could not bear.
No matter if the Guanghan Empress was under his command or not, whether she heeded his orders, he could not sit by and allow the Guanghan Empress to continue growing like this.

chapters.content:
Chapter 780: Chapter 295: Occupying Half of Eternity, One Can Step into the Fourth?
The Schemes and Killing Intent of the Chiming Heavenly Emperor_2 Chapter 780: Chapter 295: Occupying Half of Eternity, One Can Step into the Fourth?
The Schemes and Killing Intent of the Chiming Heavenly Emperor_2 “It’s not that I want to kill a meritorious officer but that his merits are so great that they overshadow the master.” Chiming Heavenly Emperor murmured, his expression returning to normal.
Guanghan Immortal Emperor had made great contributions to him.
More than three Tribulation periods ago, during the battle that overthrew Longhan Heavenly Court, if it weren’t for Guanghan Immortal Emperor taking his side and helping him besiege Emperor Longhan, he might not have succeeded.
As the emperor of Heavenly Court and master of Tai Chu Realm, he had to be vigilant.
He didn’t want to lose his current power and become the next Emperor Longhan, whether Guanghan Immortal Emperor harbored such thoughts or not.
...
Chiming Heavenly Emperor had grand ambitions, desiring to stand tall for all eternity, to take the fourth step, and to have the Crimson Heaven Court rule the Tai Chu Realm forever, perhaps even the Great Eternal Realm.
Not just him.
Including Emperor Longhan and Emperor Wantong, thirty-five emperors before Chiming Heavenly Emperor harbored the same idea regarding the Tai Chu Realm.
Some of the emperors realized the unification of the entire Tai Chu Realm, making all doctrines obedient, and expanding towards other areas of the Great Eternal Realm; ultimately, they encountered powerful opponents, and after several defeats, internal conflicts erupted, leading to the disintegration of the Heavenly Court and a change of dynasty.
Taking history as a mirror, learning from the lessons of past Heavenly Courts, Chiming Heavenly Emperor didn’t act rashly but instead planned gradually and carefully.
There was a rumor in the Ancient Eternal Realm that whoever occupied more than half of it could receive the favor of the realm’s Qi, thereby stepping into the fourth stage of cultivation and transcending.
“Rumors are, after all, just rumors,” the Chiming Heavenly Emperor sighed softly.
This rumor had never been confirmed, for no Immortal Emperor had ever achieved it.
The Ancient Eternal Realm was so vast and immeasurable, boundless and without end; a speck of dust, a droplet of water was a vast and expansive cosmos.
How ancient and great was it?
Although the Tai Chu Realm was powerful, there were many worlds within the Ancient Eternal Realm just as great, even a few that were more powerful than the Tai Chu Realm itself.
A ray of immortal light flashed, and a figure appeared in the Lingxiao Hall, dressed in black robes, with a somber temperament but with an extremely handsome face; even describing him as “handsome as a jade” would be an understatement.
“Black Emperor, have you found out anything?”
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor’s eyes flickered as he asked the newly arrived Black Emperor.
“Your Majesty, there is some clue,” the Black Emperor said gravely.
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor showed a hint of a smile, praising, “Black Emperor, your efficiency is still as strong as ever.”
“Thank you for your trust, Your Majesty,” the Black Emperor responded, neither arrogantly nor humbly.
“Go on,” the Chiming Heavenly Emperor nodded slightly.
“Guanghan Immortal Emperor has given birth to a strand of her Divine Spirit in the Yuankun Domain decades ago, very discreetly.
Moreover, she took action personally to conceal it, and she has been concealing the fate of the Yuankun Domain all these years.”
“According to our surveillance, that old man Gu Changge has not appeared; it is difficult to judge whether there is any connection between them,” said the Black Emperor gravely.
The previous Emperor of Longhan Heavenly Court was named Gu Changge.
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor frowned slightly, letting out a cold laugh.
He had not yet made a move against Guanghan Immortal Emperor, yet she could not sit still; did she intend to conspire with Gu Changge?
Or perhaps Guanghan Immortal Emperor sensed something, was this a warning to him?
“Can you find out what Guanghan has been doing in the Yuankun Domain?” Chiming Heavenly Emperor asked coldly.
The Black Emperor shook his head and said, “The Yuankun Domain has been isolated by Gu Changge’s Emperor Sword sheath and protected by his Great Divine Power.
Only an Immortal Emperor has the means to break through.”
“I have descended there before, without finding any traces of Gu Changge, nor discovering Guanghan; with Guanghan stronger than me, after she conceals it, I cannot probe further.”
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor snorted.
His curiosity over what Guanghan Immortal Emperor was doing in the Yuankun Domain grew.
That the Yuankun Domain was cut off by Gu Changge’s methods was a clear fact to many Immortal Emperors, but with no sign of Emperor Longhan, no one had interfered, lest they stir up alarm or had other schemes in mind.
Guanghan Immortal Emperor’s descent to the Yuankun Domain must have been for some reason, and it was not necessarily to contact Emperor Longhan.
Perhaps the Yuankun Domain itself possessed something special.
Otherwise, why would the traitor Emperor Longhan tirelessly cause trouble in the Yuankun Domain for over a hundred epochs?
Was he waiting for something to emerge?
Yet, the Yuankun Domain had nothing special; it was just a remote and insignificant domain, and even before Emperor Longhan’s isolation, it wasn’t very strongâ€”the strongest there were merely at the Golden Immortal Realm.
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor couldn’t figure it out but he wanted to continue paying attention to it; perhaps he could benefit as a third party.
Emperor Longhan was plotting in the Yuankun Domain when Empress Guanghan unexpectedly intervened, which was likely to directly spark a conflict between the two, as they already had a significant grudge against each other.
All he needed to do was to sit on the sidelines and watch the tigers fight.
“Continue to focus on the Guanghan grand event.
If there are no surprises, that’ll be the time,” said the Chiming Heavenly Emperor after pondering.
“As you command.” The Black Emperor had no objections, as he and another Immortal Emperor were also making preparations in this regard.
“What about the investigation into the Longhan Immortal Court?
Is the Longhan Immortal Emperor actually a split soul of that old man, Gu Changge?”
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor suddenly remembered this matter and hastily asked.
The name of the Longhan Immortal Emperor was the same as the former Emperor of Heaven, which made it difficult for him to ignore.
The Longhan Immortal Emperor’s birth was unknown, but just a few dozen epochs after the establishment of his Crimson Heaven Court, he suddenly emerged.
Rising from the True Immortal Realm, he managed to break through to the Immortal Emperor Realm after spending one and a half tribulation periods.
According to the Longhan Immortal Emperor’s public statement, he had been of average talent with exhausted potential but received Against the Heaven’s Creation, which allowed his rise.
The Longhan Immortal Emperor, named Zhousi, only adopted the name “Longhan” after advancing to Immortal Emperor, which caused a sensation throughout the Tai Chu Realm at the time.
Back then, the Longhan Immortal Emperor unified the entirety of “Heavenly Space” by sweeping away the obstacles within one, changed its name to Longhan Heaven, and that infuriated the Chiming Heavenly Emperor.
At that time, he mobilized the troops of the Heavenly Court and personally campaigned against Longhan Heaven, but the Longhan Immortal Emperor had extensive connections.
Various Immortal Emperors, including Empress Guanghan and the Nine Tribulations Immortal Emperor, stepped forward in his support, leaving the Chiming Heavenly Emperor no choice but to withdraw his forces.
The Crimson Heaven Court had only been established for less than two tribulation periods, and he didn’t dare to collide head-on, as there were many Immortal Emperors in the Tai Chu Realm who did not heed his command.
Forbidden lands such as the Land of the Supreme Heaven, Space Bridge, and Cosmic Sea also turned their gaze upon him, and the Chiming Heavenly Emperor had to compromise.
Forbidden lands like the Ancient Reincarnation Land, Emperor Yuan’s Plain, and Origin Sea housed slumbering Immortal Emperors who rarely ventured out, spending most of their time in the forbidden lands comprehending the Dao and pursuing the traces of the fourth step.
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor had always wanted to slay the Longhan Immortal Emperor and remove this threat but had been sorely lacking in means to do so.
For the past two tribulation periods, the Chiming Heavenly Emperor had been plotting and scheming.
He wanted to subdue a group of Immortal Emperors and either annihilate or exile another group to unify the Tai Chu Realm completely.
The Longhan Immortal Emperor was his target to make an example, to establish his power.
Only if he found evidence that the Longhan Immortal Emperor was a split soul of the former Emperor of Heaven, Gu Changge, then other Immortal Emperors would have no reason to obstruct him from taking action.
“Your Majesty, we have a lead and are currently tracing it.
It could be a hundred years at the soonest or three thousand at the latest before we have a result,” the Black Emperor stated solemnly.
“Very good, very good, very good~”
The frown on the Chiming Heavenly Emperor’s face dissolved, and he laughed three times.
“Black Emperor, you’ve done well.
Once the matter is complete, I will give you what you need,” he said.
“Thank you, Your Majesty.” After speaking, the Black Emperor left.
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor rose to his feet, glanced at Longhan Heaven, then shifted his gaze toward Guanghan Heaven, with a surge of murderous intent in his heart.
After quelling the Longhan Immortal Emperor, the Empress Guanghan would be next.
…!
In the Yuankun Domain, at Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li was receiving a Heavenly Imperial Realm Great Emperor from White Emperor City at Yundao Peak.
This Great Emperor soon made his purpose clear, claiming that the two Quasi Empresses and two saintly women of the White Emperor City were smitten with the Supreme’s heroic martial prowess and desired to be married into Chengsheng Mountain, hoping for Supreme Han Li’s gracious approval.
For such matters, Han Li naturally did not refuse.
The four saintly women and empresses from the White Emperor City were as beautiful as Heavenly Immortals and had exceptional cultivation talents.
Since they wished to offer themselves to share his bed, Han Li was also happy to agree.
After some consideration, Han Li gave his response, accepting the two Quasi Empresses as wives and taking the two saintly women as concubines.
Although the two saintly women met the standards to become wives, Han Li did not want to do so just yet.
Otherwise, there would be too many consorts from the White Emperor City, and he would raise their statuses later on.
The Red Robed Emperor of the White Emperor City was taken aback, but he quickly agreed and promised to send the four Heavenly Fairies to Chengsheng Mountain soon.
Then, the Red Robed Emperor, carrying this news, crossed the void and returned to White Emperor City.
PS: There will be another chapter tonight to wrap up the third volume.
It’s time to write about Empress Guanghan’s split soul.
