chapters.content:
Chapter 781: Chapter 296: Fishing Across Worlds, the Dao Command, Han Li and the Guanghan Empress_1 Chapter 781: Chapter 296: Fishing Across Worlds, the Dao Command, Han Li and the Guanghan Empress_1 The next day,
Two saintesses and two Quasi Empresses from White Emperor City had been sent over.
Han Li was somewhat amused and exasperated, how urgent could they be?
After chatting with them for a while, Han Li didn’t take many days to hold a grand marriage ceremony and wed the four beauties, who were as lovely as fairies from heaven.
Some time passed, and Han Li had successfully impregnated them.
He then took his delicate wife, Feng Mian, once more into the Thousand Realm Ocean and descended upon Thousand Realm Island.
After so long, Han Li felt it was time to start the next session of fishing for treasures of the Thousand Realms.
Surrounded by the vast and tranquil expanse of the infinite sea area, Feng Mian’s beautiful eyes gleamed.
...
She hadn’t been here in a while.
The last time was when her husband, Han Li, had fished her out of the Thousand Realm Ocean and she spent some time on Thousand Realm Island, filled with curiosity about everything here.
She even glanced at the place where she had emerged from the sea, wondering if diving down there would take her back to her own world?
Of course, Feng Mian just pondered the thought without any intention of acting on it.
Leaving aside whether she could return or not, Feng Mian didn’t want to return at all.
She had no attachments in her original world and was doing quite fine in the Tai Chu Realm.
At Chengsheng Mountain, she needn’t worry about anything, had a bunch of sisters to chat with, her cultivation had also improved, breaking through to the ninth level of the Heavenly Immortal Realm â€” her future was promising.
Moreover…
Feng Mian tenderly caressed her bulging abdomen, since she now carried Han Li’s child; it was best to just stay faithfully by her husband’s side.
Gathering back her thoughts, Feng Mian saw that Han Li was looking at a few fishing rods on the rock and couldn’t help but ask, “Husband, how many times do you plan to fish this time?”
Fish how many times?
Han Li chuckled bitterly, wrapped Feng Mian in his embrace, and spoke tenderly, “Mian’er, fishing in the Thousand Realms requires a sacrifice.
It’s not as simple as me wanting to fish as often as I’d like.”
Fishing in the Thousand Realms refreshed once every ten years, with each session offering ten rods for fishing.
One could fish out treasures from the Heaven Immortal rank to the 4th step from the Thousand Realm Ocean.
The first fishing session required one year’s worth of cultivation, the second fishing session required ten years’ worth of cultivation, the third fishing session needed a hundred years of cultivation…
the tenth fishing session required a billion years of cultivation.
On his previous visit, Han Li had only fished three times, using up the Heaven Immortal Rank Crimson Fishing Rod, the True Immortal Rank orange rod, and the Golden Immortal Rank yellow rod, consuming a total of 111 years of cultivation.
Going forward, the expended cultivation would be quite substantial, growing tenfold with each session.
Although this amount of cultivation was negligible compared to the corresponding treasures’ value, that was only if one actually managed to fish up the treasures â€” otherwise, it would all be for naught.
Han Li had only about a hundred thousand years of accumulated cultivation, enough for three fishing sessions at most.
He could use the green rod, cyan rod, and blue rod, using up a total of 111,000 years of cultivation.
In doing so, practically all of the cultivation he had accumulated would be used up.
Han Li didn’t quite like this idea; he wanted to save his cultivation for breaking through to the Heavenly Immortal Realm.
Mainly because he didn’t feel confident that he could pull up an Immortal King Rank Treasure on the first try.
“Ah?”
Feng Mian looked a bit dazed, her mouth agape.
She quickly came to her senses and pursed her lips, saying, “Husband, I overlooked that aspect.”
During the previous sessions of fishing in the Thousand Realms, she hadn’t felt that they had paid any price.
Her husband was too mysterious, able to enter the Thousand Realm Ocean and fish there.
Lately, he even possessed an Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure.
This made Feng Mian believe that her husband, Han Li, was all-powerful, inadvertently overlooking the fact that fishing in the Thousand Realms came at a cost.
Indeed, if fishing in the Thousand Realms required no sacrifice, her husband could have used all ten rods last time.
Why then did he use only three rods and even hesitated when using the yellow one?
Han Li ruffled her hair playfully and smiled.
“Husband, what do you plan to do this time?” Feng Mian asked again.
She didn’t ask about the price that was needed.
If her husband intended to tell her, he would do so naturally.
If he didn’t wish to mention it, asking would be useless and would only create distance between them.
“Let’s just fish twice,” Han Li contemplated and then said.
The fourth fishing session required a thousand years of cultivation, and the fifth required ten thousand years.
There was a chance to fish up Quasi Immortal Monarch and Immortal Monarch level treasures, which Han Li found quite tempting.
Such an amount of cultivation wouldn’t have too significant an impact,
As for the other rods of karma, those would have to wait for another time.
After all, the fishing opportunity refreshed every ten years and was always available.
“Mhm~” Feng Mian nodded, understanding.
In her heart, she was still somewhat shocked; her husband could actually fish twice more.
Based on what her husband had previously mentioned, the Crimson Fishing Rod corresponded to the Heaven Immortal rank, the orange rod to the True Immortal rank, and the yellow rod to the Golden Immortal rank.
Thus, the green rod would correspond to the Quasi Immortal Monarch level, and the cyan rod to the Immortal Monarch level.
Using these rods demanded a price.
Previously as a Quasi Emperor, it seemed his limit was to use up to the yellow rod, but now that his cultivation had advanced to the pinnacle of the Heaven Imperial Realm, could he use the cyan rod?
Feng Mian’s thoughts churned as she looked at the seven fishing rods on the big rock, her gaze flickering.
She remained silent.
Although she wanted another turn at fishing in the Thousand Realms, she decided to leave it to her husband.
If she failed to fish up a treasure, it would be unfortunate.
“Mian’er, do you want to try fishing once?” Han Li suddenly asked.
Feng Mian shook her head; she had already thought it through.
“Husband, you should do the fishing.
I believe that you will definitely pull up something good,” Feng Mian said with a smile.
Han Li nodded and replied, “Alright then, I’ll do the fishing myself.”

chapters.title: Chapter 782
chapters.content:
Chapter 782: Chapter 296: Fishing Across Worlds, the Dao Command, Han Li and the Guanghan Empress_2 Chapter 782: Chapter 296: Fishing Across Worlds, the Dao Command, Han Li and the Guanghan Empress_2 Since Feng Mian wasn’t interested, Han Li wouldn’t insist.
Immediately, Han Li released Feng Mian and strode towards the huge reef, grasping the green fishing rod decisively, as a prompt sound echoed in his mind.
“Ding~ Using the green fishing rod will consume a thousand years of cultivation.
May I ask if the master wishes to use it?”
“Use it.”
Han Li picked up the green fishing rod without hesitation.
The slender fishing line was drawn from the Endless Sea Domain, eventually even the hook and bait became visible.
Han Li glanced at it, his eyes narrowed slightly, his heart pounding.
The bait on the green fishing rod was actually a page of jade paper, or rather, a scriptureâ€”a powerful Immortal cultivation technique.
...
Han Li originally wanted to take it and see if he could seize the opportunity, but after thinking it over, he decided not to.
Affecting the Thousand Realm Fishing would be too great a loss.
With a flick of his wrist, the fishing line flew out toward the eastern sea domain, eventually landing in a sea area 1,386 kilometers away.
As soon as the bait completely disappeared below the sea, Han Li began to wait patiently, with Feng Mian coming to his side to wait as well.
About eight minutes passed, and there was a disturbance in the eastern sea domain.
Han Li quickly pulled on the fishing rod, which immediately reeled in automatically, retrieving the prey.
When the treasure hauled up landed on the Thousand Realm Island, a radiant smile spread across Han Li’s face.
No matter what he’d caught, he had caught something.
The thousand years of cultivation he’d spent was well worth it.
“Husband, what did you catch?”
Feng Mian, looking at the treasure on the ground with a look of delight on her pretty face, asked eagerly.
After reading the information, Han Li explained, “Mian’er, this is a token called ‘The Token of Dadao’.”
Han Li took the gray and unadorned token into his hands and examined it closely.
Both sides were engraved with the character for ‘Dao’, but the Dao that it imparted seemed both completely different and yet entirely the sameâ€”an intriguing paradox.
[The Token of Dadao]: A Quasi Immortal Monarch level treasure, holding it allows entry to the Dadao Palace.
Han Li blinked, the information about the Token of Dadao was succinct to the point of being crypticâ€”it seemed to say everything and nothing, leaving him somewhat speechless.
Feng Mian took the Token of Dadao and inspected it but discovered nothing, then returned it to Han Li.
Han Li casually put it away, planning to look into it after leaving, and then proceeded with the second round of Thousand Realm Fishing.
This time, Han Li expended ten thousand years of cultivation, only to come up empty-handed, which made his expression turn somewhat unsightly.
He looked emotionlessly at the remaining five fishing rods but did not attempt a third round of fishing, leaving Thousand Realm Island with Feng Mian.
This expedition cost him eleven thousand years of cultivation to obtain just a single Token of Dadao with an unknown purpose, leading Han Li to feel somewhat disheartened.
After returning to Chengsheng Mountain, Feng Mian went her own way, feeling sweet inside.
No matter how many wives or concubines her husband had, wasn’t she the only one who had accompanied him on the Thousand Realm Fishing?
Han Li went to Tiansheng Realm, activated the gate to the Xuxian Realm, and entered the realm within.
After spending some time in the Xuxian Realm, Han Li emerged once more, arriving at the summit of Chengdao Peak to gaze at the beautiful sunset and sighed.
In the Xuxian Realm, he hadn’t found any useful information.
Nobody knew of the Token of Dadao, leaving him wondering whether his low-profile inquiries or the ignorance of the Xuxian Realm’s chosen ones were to blame.
“Hu~”
Taking a deep breath, Han Li temporarily set the Token of Dadao aside and vanished from Chengdao Peak.
……..
Three months later.
Zhending Province.
Han Li rode a Kui Ox, moving leisurely along the cobblestone road, heading towards a distant city.
Han Li had set out on a journey a month ago.
Having stayed at Chengsheng Mountain for too long, and with no more adversaries inside the Yuankun Domain, he no longer had to worry about himself or Chengsheng Mountain facing danger.
He simply decided to go out and wander the mundane world, to experience it fully one last time.
In a few decades, he would break through to the Heavenly Immortal Realm, undergo the tribulation, and become an Immortalâ€”transcending the ordinary at last.
Over that month, Han Li’s figure appeared in many provinces of the Yuankun Domain, staying in each province only from half a day to two days, following his heart’s desire.
Today, Han Li, riding the Kui Ox, broke through the sky to descend into this province located in the central part of the Yuankun Domain, planning to take a look around.
“`
The Kui Ox moved slowly but covered a great distance with each shift; only when it encountered something that piqued Han Li’s interest would it stop.
Riding the Kui Ox around Zhending Province, Han Li didn’t find anything of interest.
Just as he was about to have the Kui Ox break through the sky towards a branch of the Han Mansion, he halted again.
He discovered that a cultivator thousands of miles away was actually his descendant, possessing cultivation of the Dongxu Realm but disguising his identity by only displaying the prowess of the God Refining Realm.
That descendant was lying in wait for a piece of top-grade spiritual medicine, hidden in darkness while three Dongxu Realm cultivators openly guarded it, engaged in a standoff.
However, the twelve spirit fruits of the spirit tree had yet to mature, so the three Grandmasters of the Hollow Void Stage had yet to come to blows over them.
Han Li found this amusing, thinking maybe he could casually play the role of the “old grandfather” for his descendant.
Thus, a ray of immortal light burst from the tip of Han Li’s finger, tearing through space, silently merging into the spirit tree miles away, instantly causing all the fruits to ripen.
This stunned the four onlookers, who were at a loss, but the three Dongxu Realm Grandmasters immediately began to fight over the fruits.
Such spirit fruits, if one consumes nine, would have the greatest effect, not only helping a cultivator break through to the Myriad Phenomena Realm but also enhancing their innate potential, making it impossible for the three Grandmasters to negotiate a division.
The descendant of the Han Mansion’s eyes lit up; he immediately employed a stealth technique to quietly pick the fruits.
By the time he was picking the ninth one, the three Dongxu Realm Grandmasters finally realized something was amiss.
Seeing a God Refining Realm thief snatching away their spirit fruits, they even managed to take the remaining ones in one fell swoop, the Grandmasters ceased their fight and charged towards the thief.
The descendant of the Han Mansion sneered and, using an escape technique, fled from the scene, leaving the three Grandmasters grasping at air.
He reappeared miles away, ready to enjoy his loot, but found the three Grandmasters had caught up with him.
Somewhat confounded and continuously pursued despite several attempts at escape, he got a bad feeling and decided not to run anymore but to engage the three Grandmasters in intense battle.
Although the three Grandmasters were extremely powerful and attacked together, they were still no match for the descendant of the Han Mansion.
They were beaten back step by step and finally had to scatter and flee.
Han Li watched from afar with a smile playing at the corner of his mouth; naturally, he had had a hand in this mischief.
“I didn’t expect you to take pleasure in such things.”
A cool voice suddenly rang in his ear, causing Han Li’s pupils to constrict and his heart to be on guard, ready to take action at any moment.
Could the Yuankun Domain still be hiding powerful beings capable of infiltrating his immediate surroundings?
“No need to guess anymore; I’m right here.”
The cool voice continued to speak, and when Han Li looked over, he was immediately greeted by an exceptionally beautiful figure.
Feng Mian, Huang Hongshang, and Yuan Weiyang were already stunning beauties, as graceful as Heavenly Immortals, but they paled in comparison to this figure.
“Who are you?” Han Li narrowed his eyes.
“Who am I?”
The embodiment of the Guanghan Empress chuckled and said, “You can call me Chang Xi.”
“Chang Xi?” Han Li murmured the name, recalling information about the Yuankun Domain and the Taichu Realm, but it didn’t ring any bells.
“Don’t bother guessing; I mean you no harm.
My visit today is certainly for a reason,”
“Frankly, we have quite a connection.
You’ve stirred up trouble in the Yuankun Domain and caused a commotion in the Xuxian Realm; I’ve been cleaning up after you, or you wouldn’t be able to travel the world leisurely right now,” said the Guanghan Empress indifferently.
Han Li listened but felt somewhat baffled; was this woman watching him all along?
She seemed to know everything, and a heaviness settled in his heart.
He wondered if his struggles within the Time-Sky Tower had also been observed.
Despite the strain, that inherent power was part of his nature, and he couldn’t do much about it.
Afterward, the Guanghan Empress and Han Li talked about many things, and Han Li gradually let down his guard.
He realized that her cultivation was unfathomably deep, inscrutable even to the spirits of Golden Immortal and Immortal Monarch soldiers.
If such a powerful being wanted to harm him, he would have no means to resist.
Nevertheless, he retained a sliver of vigilance: why did this woman want to help him?
After discussing certain matters, the Guanghan Empress spoke of the token on Han Li’s body.
The token was the credential to enter the Dadao Palace, open to all the heavens and a myriad of worlds.
Only those holding the token could enter, and their cultivation couldn’t exceed that of a True Immortal.
The Dadao Palace contained Against the Heaven’s Creation, said to involve the fourth step, yet no one had attained it to date.
The Dadao Palace would reappear in three hundred years, and at that time, regardless of where the token holders were, they would be taken into the palace without warning.
The Guanghan Empress advised Han Li to prepare well and take a chance in there; perhaps he could obtain that Against the Heaven’s Creation.
After her speech, the Guanghan Empress disappeared without a trace.
Left alone, Han Li stood in a daze, overwhelmed with information that he needed to digest.
PS: This marks the end of Volume Three.
I’m taking a break tomorrow and will resume updating with Volume Four the day after, which will be the final volume of the book.

Chapter 783: Chapter 297: Three Hundred Years in Tranquility, Attaining Dao and Becoming a True Immortal_1 Chapter 783: Chapter 297: Three Hundred Years in Tranquility, Attaining Dao and Becoming a True Immortal_1 Atop the high mountains, beside the great river,
a man in green robes with white hair sat cross-legged, a sword lying across his lap, his right hand ceaselessly pouring liquor from a white jade gourd into his mouth.
After an indeterminate amount of time, having drunk an unknowable quantity of liquor, the white-haired youth suddenly rose with his sword, stumbled, and began to swing the Immortal Sword in his hand.
His face was flushed with drunkenness as he muttered to himself.
“The road ahead is long, its goal far away; I shall search high and low.”
“One slash to break through calamitous ordeals, to sweep away the world’s injustices.”
“Riding the wind with my sword, I vanquish demons from between heaven and earth.
With liquor, I enjoy carefree delight; without, still I reel in ecstasy.”
“……”
In a half-drunken, half-conscious state, the youth practiced his swordsmanship, with sword light rippling across the nine heavens, and sword energy stretching across ten lands, seeming truly intoxicated, yet also as if he were comprehending the Dao.
Thus passed nine days, and then the eyes of the white-haired youth suddenly shone as bright as sword light.
He gave a light shout, and his Immortal Sword slashed forth.
...
Brilliant sword light surged!
A fearsome scene unfolded.
The waters of the river, flowing from the mountain’s summit, were cleft in twain, creating two towering walls of water on either side, revealing the riverbed for thousands of miles.
“Clap clap clap~”
Applause sounded as a youth in black appeared, having witnessed the spectacle.
“Impressive.”
“It seems your recent comprehension has yielded considerable insights,” the youth in black praised, a hint of envy in his tone.
Understanding the Dao was no easy feat, let alone for nine consecutive days.
To understand the Dao in the morning and be content to die in the evening.
He himself sought this but failed to attain it.
With an impassive face, the white-haired youth did not even spare a glance as he nonchalantly returned the sword to its place, took a big gulp of liquor, then said indifferently, “When did you arrive?”
“Shortly after you began your comprehension,” the youth in black said, unfazed by the other’s attitude, and smiled as he spoke.
“Oh~”
“Lu Zhen, you’re not curious why I came looking for you?”
“Not interested.”
“……”
The youth in black, with his prepared speech stuck in his belly, sighed helplessly after glancing at Lu Zhen, then said, “Are you still not over it?”
“Ha~ I’ve long since forgotten,” Lu Zhen scoffed with a sneer, taking another swig of liquor.
“Tsk tsk, Lu Zhen, you can lie to your brother, but don’t deceive yourself.”
Lu Zhen’s brow twitched, but he said nothing.
“See, you still haven’t let go.
This won’t do.
You should know…” the youth in black began earnestly, hoping to enlighten Lu Zhen.
“Wang Teng, haven’t you had enough?” Lu Zhen’s voice was calm but rimmed with a hint of indifference.
He had suppressed those things to the deepest recesses of his heart, only occasionally recalling them.
Yet Wang Teng came to provoke him, making Lu Zhen truly want to slay him with a single sword strike.
Glancing at the Immortal Sword next to Lu Zhen, Wang Teng gave a sheepish laugh, then became serious, “In half a month, the Heavenly Immortal Academy will be enrolling.
Do you want to go with me?”
The Heavenly Immortal Academy was founded three hundred years ago by the supreme Han Li, intended to cultivate the prodigious talents of the Yuankun Domain with the potential to become immortals.
The enrollment was only once every hundred years, open to the Eight Hundred Divine Regions of the Yuankun Domain, with a minimum requirement of the Holy Abyss realm for participation.
Wang Teng himself was in the Holy Abyss realm, having entered this domain just over a decade ago.
His invitation to Lu Zhen, who had broken through later than him, came a few years ago but in terms of combat ability, he was no match for Lu Zhen.
Lu Zhen was originally very gifted and talented, and with an Immortal Sword in hand, had he not indulged in such dissipation and lost himself to wine, he would likely have reached the later stages of the Holy Abyss realm, or even been on the verge of becoming a Quasi Emperor by now.
“What a pity, he will never see through the tribulation in his heart,” Wang Teng murmured within, feeling a sense of regret for his good brother.
He often advised him, but to no avail; he had met Lu Zhen too late.
Enmeshed in his troubles, so long as he remained in the Yuankun Domain, he was fated never to escape his tribulation.
“Why would you think that I would entertain the idea of participating in the Heavenly Immortal Academy selection?
Ridiculous!” scoffed Lu Zhen, continuing to drink nonstop, seemingly trying to drown his sorrows in alcohol and numb himself.
The Heavenly Immortal Academy was founded by that person, and he had no wish to encounter him; otherwise, he would not have avoided him at such lengths.
How could he possibly contemplate participating in the Academy’s selection?
After all, the Heavenly Immortal Academy was in the Qianyuan Divine Province.
If he returned, how would he face that person, how would he face her, and how would he face his Sect Leader and fellow disciples?
Lu Zhen had no face to return, nor had he ever thought of going back.
Wang Teng sighed and said earnestly, “Before coming to see you, I went to the Qianyuan Divine Province and saw your master and two senior brothers; they all miss you dearly.”
Pausing, Wang Teng continued, “Having comprehended such powerful swordsmanship over these nine days, don’t you wish to demonstrate it?”
“If you seek to prove something, why not try at the Heavenly Immortal Academy?”
“Lu Zhen, you are my good brother, we are the twin marvels of the primeval path; I hope you can pull yourself together.”
“That’s all I have to say.
I’ll wait for you at the Heavenly Immortal Academy.”
With that, Wang Teng drifted away, vanishing without a trace.
Lu Zhen kept drinking, as though he hadn’t heard Wang Teng’s words, or perhaps they hadn’t penetrated his thoughts at all.
But was that truly the case?
“Bang~”
The white jade gourd fell to the ground as Lu Zhen stood atop the high mountain, dazed, memories of days gone by flooding his mind, countless images flashing past.
Once, he was the brightest prodigy of the Qianyuan Divine Province, hailed as “undefeated for three thousand years.”
As the Third Patriarch of Bai Yujing, his combat ability was astonishing, his fame resounding far and wide, and he was lauded as the most likely contemporary to break through to the Holy Abyss realm.
Yet all that changed with the meteoric rise of Han Li.
Han Li had taken everything from him, directly or indirectly.
Ironically, Han Li had never deliberately targeted him, and his disconsolate departure from the Qianyuan Divine Province was not due to Han Li’s coercion.

chapters.title: Chapter 784
chapters.content:
Chapter 784: Chapter 297: Three Hundred Years in Tranquility, Attaining Dao and Becoming a True Immortal_2 Chapter 784: Chapter 297: Three Hundred Years in Tranquility, Attaining Dao and Becoming a True Immortal_2 “`
All of this is simply because he cannot let go.
He wanted to hate Han Li, yet he found himself unsure of what exactly he hated Han Li for.
Did he hate him for stealing away the woman he loved, Ling Lingshuang?
“Hehe~” Lu Zhen let out a self-deprecating laugh.
Ling Lingshuang had never liked him, so even if she was in Han Li’s arms, how could he harbor resentment?
After leaving Qianyuan Divine Province, he had traveled far and wide, cultivating his abilities in many Divine Provinces and gradually advancing to the Tongxuan Realm.
Over a hundred years ago, he met Wang Teng, and together they ventured into a significant Secret Territory, getting trapped in a palace.
...
In the end, Lu Zhen passed a trial and obtained a legacy, alongside a true Immortal Sword.
Though it was merely a common Heavenly Immortal weapon, with the Immortal Sword, Lu Zhen’s journey of cultivation became much smoother.
Even if the spirit of the Immortal Sword could only occasionally lend him aid, he still encountered many opportunities for fortuitous advancements, allowing his cultivation to rise rapidly, propelling him into the Saint Yuan Realm a few years ago.
In just three hundred years, he advanced from the Divine Yuan Realm to the Saint Yuan Realm.
In the past, this would have been considered quite a feat of genius, but Lu Zhen felt no pride.
The world had changed since the day the Lord of Chengsheng Mountain dominated the Yuankun Domain.
Peerless geniuses and extraordinary talents from the Yuankun Domain emerged incessantly, most of them being the direct lineage of Han Mansion.
The true geniuses were the descendants of Han Mansion.
Where it took him three hundred years to break through from the Divine Yuan Realm to the Saint Yuan Realm, those Han Mansion prodigies made the same leap from fledgling cultivators up to the Saint Yuan and even Quasi Emperor Realm within three hundred years.
After breaking into the Saint Yuan Realm, Lu Zhen had been staying in Yuandao Divine State, located to the northeast of Yuankun Domain, far, far away from Qianyuan Divine Province.
Wang Teng was also in this Divine Province, and both of them had accrued significant renown.
Once he acquired the Immortal Sword, Lu Zhen thought about returning to seek revenge, but he quickly gave up the idea as an impossible task that had become his inner demon.
His strength wasn’t even sufficient to defeat the fifth or sixth generations of Han Li’s descendants, let alone compete with them.
Even if he cultivated to the Saint Yuan Realm and possessed an Immortal Sword, the descendants of Han Mansion would always cultivate much faster than him.
Not to mention the supreme Han Li of the Yuankun Domain.
More than three hundred years ago, he had reached the Heaven Imperial Realm, mastered the Heavenly Sovereign Path, and survived the first of the greatest Nine-Nine Heavenly Tribulations in ancient and modern times.
Twenty years later, he ascended to become an immortal, and a century after that, he advanced to become a True Immortal.
His cultivation speed was truly unparalleled throughout history.
Now, another one or two hundred years had passed, and no one knows the extent of Supreme Han Li’s cultivation.
He might have already reached the Peak of True Immortals, plotting to step into the Golden Immortal realm and obtain eternal life.
Renowned warriors have sworn that Supreme Han Li had reached the peak of True Immortals a hundred years ago, and his combat ability had already entered the Golden Immortal realm.
Thus, countless powerful beings in the Yuankun Domain are curious if Supreme Han Li will ever venture upon the ancient path of Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
Is he waiting until he truly breaks through to become an Eternal Golden Immortal?
“Gugugu~”
Lu Zhen sat despondently atop the mountain peak, tirelessly drinking.
He would never catch up to that person.
As time slipped by, the gap would only widen, and he could not even catch up to that person’s descendants…
However, Lu Zhen’s slumped back gradually straightened.
His eyes began to shine, clearing of the haze.
He gripped the Immortal Sword tightly, and suddenly let out a loud shout:
“Ahh~”
The sound traveled millions of miles, resonating across all domains.
Countless powerful individuals in the Yuandao Divine State cast their gaze towards the source and, recognizing Lu Zhen, their faces revealed a look of surprise.
Lu Zhen paid them no heed, stood up, and with a flash of sword light, he cleared away the alcohol fumes.
The Immortal Sword was sheathed behind his back as he looked in the direction of Qianyuan Divine Province, his eyes burning with fighting spirit.
If I cannot catch up by myself, then I’ll borrow your resources, Han Li, to catch up.
I’ll start by chasing after the footsteps of your descendants, then surpass them, and after that, I’ll chase after you.
If it’s fruitless, then so be it; I shall have no regrets.
………..
Qianyuan Divine Province, Xuan Domain.
“`
A mountain range spanned for over thirty million li, majestic and grand, sacred and profound, the pure land of immortalsâ€”this was the Chengsheng Mountain Range.
After three hundred years of expansion, the land occupied by Chengsheng Mountain had multiplied many times, and the number of peaks had also increased immensely, each piercing through the Nine Heavens, soaring over one hundred thousand zhang high.
The main peak, Chengdao Peak, even soared to ten million zhang.
Countless divine birds and sacred beasts flew and roamed about, amidst an extremely dense Immortal Qi.
Surrounding the peak, numerous floating islands hovered, each with its array of spectacular phenomena, creating the most holy of pure lands.
At the mountain’s summit, Han Li stood with his left hand held behind his back and his right hand resting in front of him, his fingers twinkling with a point of spirit light.
That was the Innate Spirit Light.
Han Li gazed into the Innate Spirit Light between his fingers, seeing countless points of light, each one a vast cosmos, within which were boundless Star Domains and infinitely many great stars shining in mutual reflection.
Countless stars illuminated the vast cosmos, making them glow and condense into a point of light, these countless cosmoses forming the strand of Innate Spirit Light between his fingers.
In the next instant, the myriad points of light extinguished, the innumerable cosmoses collapsed and vanished, turning to sand that flowed through Han Li’s fingers, bearing a weight that seemed heavy enough to crush the ages and a force capable of destroying the heavens.
Han Li’s brow quirked, his palm turning over, fingers slightly spread, like five ancient Immortal Mountains standing tall against all the realms of heaven, capturing the destructive sands, leading them to demise.
“This Divine Skill is really fascinating, and its power is extremely terrifying,” Han Li murmured to himself.
He was not worried that the flowing sands would destroy Chengdao Peak; Chengdao Peak was protected by an Immortal Monarch level great formation, connected to twelve mid-grade Immortal Veins and ninety-nine lower-grade Immortal Veins.
Even if Immortal Monarch level powerhouses came to attack, they wouldn’t be able to break through it quickly, although causing some commotion would be problematic.
Having casually tested a powerful Divine Skill he had recently acquired, Han Li gained a clearer understanding of his own strength.
That earlier action, had it been taken by a peak True Immortal, would have meant certain death, and even a routine Golden Immortal would have been severely wounded, given its tremendous power.
“Three hundred years have flown by, and I’ve ascended to become a True Immortal,” sighed Han Li.
Since he left the Qianyuan Divine Province and journeyed through the mortal realm, encountering the mysterious and unpredictable Chang Xi in Zhending Province, nearly three hundred years had passed.
Now, his cultivation had reached the summit of True Immortal Peak, his combat ability far surpassed that of a True Immortal, with numerous techniques at his disposal and unparalleled battle prowess.
Yet, recalling the methods used by Chang Xi three hundred years ago still gave him a sense of trepidation.
Back then, even the Artifact Spirit of the Tianquan Creation Furnace was extremely wary of Chang Xi, and it was noteworthy that Chang Xi appeared to be only a True Immortal, whereas the Tianquan Creation Furnace was an Immortal Monarch level treasure.
Though the primary function of the Tianquan Creation Furnace was assistance and its offensive and defensive capabilities come secondarily, it still possessed the power at the level of a Quasi Immortal Monarch, yet it was so apprehensive of a mere True Immortal.
This clearly meant something significant, which Han Li was well aware of.
Thinking of the things Chang Xi had told him, Han Li still felt a profound heaviness in his heart, which had caused him to keep a low profile over the past three hundred years.
Although he had no rivals in the Yuankun Domain, the Yuankun Domain was just a small place in the Tai Chu Realm, an isolated and secluded area.
According to Chang Xi, the Yuankun Domain was a place plotted by Emperor Longhan of the previous dynasty, where he tested his schemes and laid out his plans, and Xuanshen Sword Mountain was not some Immortal Sword, but was transformed from a sword sheath.
Yet this sword sheath was the scabbard of Emperor Longhan’s Emperor Sword, also an Immortal Emperor Weapon, easily capable of isolating an entire domain.
It was only then that Han Li realized why no cultivator could survive the great calamity of the Yuankun Domain, not even the top-notch True Immortals, unable to withstand a single sword ray.
After all, that was an Immortal Emperor Weapon, a sliver of its might able to crush the eternal past.
A single sword ray could split into thousands and still be enough to slay all the Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, and True Immortals within the Yuankun Domain.
In the Ancient Era, a True Immortal and Heavenly Immortal from the Qianyuan Divine Province set up a remnant formation of Golden Immortals to contend with the splintering sword rays and couldn’t withstand it for an instant.
The Yuankun Domain had been isolated for over a hundred epochs, and several Golden Immortals had emerged, averaging one every thirty-six epochs.
All had attempted to conquer Xuanshen Sword Mountain, but none emerged in the Tai Chu Realm.
As Chang Xi had explained, every epoch in the Yuankun Domain saw the harvest of Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, True Immortals, and the occasional Golden Immortal, which seemed to be moved elsewhere, some already dead, some still alive but unable to return, falling into the hands of Emperor Longhan, for purposes unknown.
Han Li was covered with cold sweat upon hearing this; he lost all interest in venturing through the ancient path of Xuanshen Sword Mountain.
If Emperor Longhan didn’t wish to let people go, let alone Golden Immortals, even Immortal Kings wouldn’t be able to break out, which was why no powerful beings from the outside world had ever entered the Yuankun Domain.
After hearing these pieces of information, Han Li also speculated about the identity of Chang Xi; she might be an Immortal Emperor, and she seemed to bear goodwill toward him, otherwise, he wouldn’t have been privy to such secretive information.

Chapter 785: Chapter 298: The Far-Expanding Emperor of Mortal Clan, The Strength of Han Li_1 Chapter 785: Chapter 298: The Far-Expanding Emperor of Mortal Clan, The Strength of Han Li_1 “Dadao Token!”
Han Li flipped his palm, and a token that appeared ancient and time-worn, with the character “Dao” visible on both sides and covered in intricate Dao patterns, materialized in his hand.
Gazing at the token, Han Li’s eyes flashed, and then revealed a profound and meaningful expression.
“Just one more month, and the Dadao Palace will make its appearance.
I’m quite looking forward to it,” Han Li murmured to himself, with a hint of curiosity and anticipation on his handsome face.
This Dadao Token had been acquired by him three hundred years ago during a universal fishing expedition, using up a thousand years of his cultivation and a green fishing rod.
In terms of material, the Dadao Token was merely equivalent to a Quasi Immortal Monarch Rank Treasure, but its true value far exceeded that rank, not even Immortal Monarch Rank Treasures could compare to it, it was at least equal to an Immortal King weapon.
When he first obtained the treasure, Han Li did not understand its worth, but after encountering the mysterious Chang Xi, everything became clear.
...
Chang Xi informed him of all the relevant information about the Dadao Token and the Dadao Palace, truly a creation against the Heavens, one that even Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals couldn’t compare to an Immortal King weapon.
After all, the Dadao Palace involved a fortune that was connected to the fourth step.
According to Chang Xi, the Dadao Palace was one of the greatest sites of fortune in the Ancient Eternal Realm, and if it weren’t for the restriction that only those below the Golden Immortal Realm could enter, and even methods like severing one’s own cultivation or suppressing it being of no use, it would have already been monopolized by the Immortal Emperors.
No one knows the origin of the Dadao Palace; many speculations point towards the fourth step.
The most credible legend suggests that the Dadao Palace was left by an Emperor of the Human Clan from ancient times, to cultivate the later generations of the Human Clan.
As everyone knows, the Emperor of Heaven from ancient times and the modern Emperor of Heaven are not the same; it’s an almost open secret.
Ancient historical records that have been unearthed indicate that in ancient times, the Great Eternal Realm seemed not yet fragmented into the Taichu Realm and other myriad celestial worlds, but a single, complete world.
Later beings called this world the Eternal World, and the Eternal World had a Heavenly Court.
Each era had only one Heavenly Court, and the last of these was the Human Clan’s Heavenly Court, which became the ruler of all clans.
The master of the Heavenly Court was the Emperor of Heaven, a being who had stepped into the fourth step, or perhaps even transcended it, supremely powerful and beyond anyone’s understanding.
Then it seemed something happened which forced the Emperor of the Human Clan to embark on a distant expedition, severing the ancient times, unwilling to involve this Eternal World.
Even so, the Eternal World was shattered by the aftershocks of that war, evolving into the current myriad heavenly worlds.
The Dadao Palace is said to be something the Emperor of the Human Clan cast forth into the void as he embarked on his expedition, which then returned to the Eternal World and transformed.
What exactly happened in ancient times is unclear, only fragments of vague records exist; whether the Emperor of the Human Clan who went on the expedition is still alive, whether his followers in the Heavenly Court still exist, no one knows…
Whereas in the modern era, there are far too many Emperors of Heaven throughout the myriad worlds, and countless Heavenly Courts; virtually every realm ranked in the top hundred has its own Heavenly Court, mostly belonging to the Human Clan.
Regardless of which clan’s Heavenly Court, their Emperor of Heaven is merely at the Immortal Emperor Realm, confined to the peak of the third step, unaware of what the fourth step even looks like, and nothing compared to the Emperor of the Human Clan who embarked on that ancient expedition.
Because it’s related to the myriad heavenly worlds, involves the fourth step, and is connected to that expeditionary Emperor of the Human Clan, the Dadao Palace is shrouded in many layers of mystery, holding unspeakable significance in the Ancient Eternal Realm.
Exactly because the fortune of the Dadao Palace is so immense, its emergence is extremely rare, appearing at least once and at most three times in every Tribulation period.
The entry credential to the Dadao Palace is the Dadao Token.
Every time it opens and takes back the Dadao Tokens, upon their disappearance, they will be expelled into the myriad heavens, waiting for the next emergence to be reclaimed.
The Dadao Token automatically conceals the machinations of fate, not even Immortal Emperors can intercept it nor locate it, unless they are very close to sense it.
Obtaining the Dadao Token is entirely based on fortune and destiny.
Chang Xi told him that she had once entered the Dadao Palace and obtained some major creation against the Heavens from within.
According to her understanding, the total number of Dadao Tokens is fixed at one hundred and twenty-nine thousand six hundred; not even Immortal Emperors can destroy them.
In the Taichu Realm, every Tribulation period has its supreme geniuses participate in the Dadao Palace event, with the least number being twelve True Immortals, and the maximum being sixty-eight True Immortals, including those who had seized some Dadao Tokens from other realms.
This further elevated the value of the Dadao Token.
Before departing, Chang Xi also gave Han Li a partial map of the Dadao Palace, which despite covering only some regions, was tremendously valuable.
It is because of all these reasons that Han Li didn’t rush to break through to the Golden Immortal Realm; he wanted to see the Dadao Palace for himself.
More than eighty years ago, Han Li had already broken through to the pinnacle of the True Immortal Realm, and over twenty years ago, he had gathered enough cultivation to break into the Golden Immortal Realm.
However, for the sake of the Dadao Palace, Han Li decided to wait, not minding these two or three decades.
If he could acquire some of the Dadao Palace’s fortune that involves the fourth step, the strongest creation, then he would truly prosper.
Generally speaking, Han Li wouldn’t participate or even want to compete for such fortunes and creations; he had made this clear since descending the mountain, hence until now, he had never fought with other cultivators for such chances.
But this time was different.
It wasn’t just the immense fortune of the Dadao Palace, nor its connection to the fourth step or the expeditionary Emperor of the Human Clan.
It was simply because Han Li’s strength was formidable enough.
This gave Han Li an overwhelming 98% confidence.

Although his cultivation had only reached the peak of the True Immortal Realm, his strength was not limited by this and had long surpassed the True Immortal domain.
Under normal circumstances, when it came to combat ability alone, Han Li might not compare to an Immortal Monarch, but he was invincible under the Immortal Monarchs.
This was not a guess of Han Li’s own making, but the standard data provided by the “System”.
This meant that Han Li’s normal state combat ability was that of an invincible Quasi Immortal Monarch.
Three hundred years had passed, and his ultimate martial techniques had already reached the perfect stage of the True Immortal phase, allowing his cultivation techniques and martial skills to improve by three grades; True Immortal level cultivation techniques were on par with those of an Immortal Monarch level.
His Divine Sense had also advanced from the original eighth stage to the twelfth stage, increasing his combat ability by more than one Big Realm.
After stimulating his Divine Sense, Han Li’s combat ability would jump to the Immortal Monarch Realm and even surpass it, comparable to that of a Quasi Immortal King.
...
How terrifying was that?
All the martial skills he had acquired from the “System” were at the perfect stage, and those he had obtained from the Yuankun Domain and given by Chang Xi were also cultivated to the perfect stage with the consumption of cultivation points.
His own cultivation technique had already advanced to the level of a Quasi Immortal Monarch, and with the boost of his ultimate martial techniques, it was comparable to those of the Immortal King Rank.
It was precisely because of this level of strength that Han Li dared to participate in the struggle for creation at Dadao Palace.
The creation of Dadao Palace was open to all of the myriad worlds, where at most 129,600 Cultivators below the Golden Immortal level could enter.
Han Li’s opponents would only be those top-tier True Immortals; he held no others in his eyes.
In terms of talent and potential, Han Li believed himself second to none amongst the supreme chosen ones.
His combat ability should be the ceiling of the True Immortal level.
Unless he encountered some extremely abnormal opponents, such as a Quasi Immortal Emperor or the reincarnated body of an Immortal Emperor, there might be a threat to him.
However, the chances of that happening were extremely slim.
Quasi Immortal Emperors and Immortal Emperors would not reincarnate easily, even for the immense creation of the Dadao Palace.
To reincarnate and enter the Dadao Palace, one could only do so through the reincarnation of the true body or the main body; incarnations or divided souls would not work at all.
Reincarnating the true body, that would be dangerous.
If enemies were to find out, whether one could return to their peak was unknown; they would likely die prematurely.
Even if Immortal Emperors would not easily harm themselves, leaving traces across all timelines of ancient and modern times, being intercepted time after time would lead to their demise, becoming completely lost in the cycle of Reincarnation with no chance of return.
Besides strength, Han Li had also prepared some contingencies.
These were supreme treasures he had acquired over three hundred years by opening treasure chests and fishing from the myriad worlds, which could ensure his survival.
Even if he died tens or hundreds of times in the Dadao Palace, he would still revive at Chengsheng Mountain, and any attempt to trace the cause and effect to kill him would be a mere dream.
It was precisely because he had made thorough preparations that Han Li waited for the Dadao Palace to come into the world; otherwise, without such precautions, he would not risk competing.
Survival was of the utmost importance.
“One month later,” Han Li murmured again, his expression slightly solemn this time.
The Dadao Palace could silently transport Han Li away based on the Great Dao Command, but if an Immortal Emperor were deliberately paying attention, it still might be discovered.
Generally speaking, when the Immortal Emperors do not know who possesses the Great Dao Command, they will not pay special attention to anyone or any particular area.
But the Yuankun Domain was different.
It just so happened to be under consistent, deliberate scrutiny by an Immortal Emperor.
According to Chang Xi, the Yuankun Domain was not only under the schemes of a former Emperor of Heaven but often observed by Emperor Longhan, and occasionally swept by the gaze of other Immortal Emperors from the Heavenly Court and the Tai Chu Realm.
At that time, Han Li wanted to back out and decided not to go.
If discovered by multiple Immortal Emperors, that would be a grave issue.
Later, Chang Xi gave him a reassurance, saying she would take action to assist Han Li and would conceal the heavenly secrets and cause and effect well in advance, so that no Immortal Emperor would discover him.
This reassured Han Li, but another thought was pulsing in his heart.
Who was Chang Xi, really?
Why did she protect him so?
Chang Xi seemed to see through Han Li’s thoughts in a glance, saying only, “You will know in the future.”
Chang Xi always kept an eye on Han Li, naturally aware of how unusual and limitless his potential was, with boundless prospects.
Had she not detected changes in the timeline and found Han Li early, she would have been at a disadvantage.
But since she had discovered Han Li first, the initiative was naturally hers.
Later, Chang Xi left, leaving Han Li alone with his thoughts.
“`
Since that time, Han Li had been pondering one question: who exactly was Chang Xi the incarnation of which Immortal Emperor.
Only an Immortal Emperor can hinder another Immortal Emperor!
The number of Immortal Emperors in the entire Taichu Realm was limited.
As far as Han Li knew, there were openly sixteen, among whom only four were female Immortal Emperors.
Could Chang Xi’s real identity be one of these four female Immortal Emperors?
However, there were many forbidden territories within the Taichu Realm, and it was rumored that some Immortal Emperors were in slumber there, including female Immortal Emperors, which made it even harder for Han Li to judge.
Although he couldn’t guess Chang Xi’s identity, Han Li didn’t really care.
After all, Chang Xi posed no harm, always protected him, considered his best interests, and had helped him greatly.
It meant that Old Ancestor Han also had the backing of a female Immortal Emperor.
No wonder the doctor had said to him in a previous life that he had a bad stomach and was suited to living off a woman.
…….

Chapter 787: Chapter 299: The Dice of Fate, Eternal Ark, Taixuan Immortal Emperor_1 Chapter 787: Chapter 299: The Dice of Fate, Eternal Ark, Taixuan Immortal Emperor_1 “No, there’s still half a month before entering the Dadao Palace; I need to make more preparations.”
Han Li suddenly felt something was amiss.
What if there were unexpected situations he hadn’t considered?
Therefore, he needed to prepare several additional countermeasures to remain calm and resolve various crises.
“So, what else do I need to prepare?” Han Li’s gaze flickered, his thoughts flew in all directions, and countless ideas emerged in an instant, simulating various scenarios.
Before long, a smile appeared on Han Li’s face, and his figure vanished from the summit of Chengdao Peak.
In the next instant, Han Li appeared in Tiansheng Realm, entering the Miniature Immortal Realm.
After three hundred years of nourishment, both Tiansheng Realm and the Miniature Immortal Realm had expanded manyfold, and the concentration of Higher Level Spiritual Energy and Immortal Qi had also increased significantly.
...
Han Li entered a celestial palace where a Golden Immortal Rank formation automatically activated, isolating the inside from the outside, and then he sat down cross-legged on a Xuanhuang Cushion.
Once seated, Han Li took out two dice.
These dice looked ordinary on the surface, only engraved with some Dao patterns instead of any numbers.
However, if one were to observe with a spiritual eye, the truth would be revealed.
The dice were glowing, a pure white light.
The source of light came from within the dice, each containing a orb of light, with faint characters emerging, one labeled “Fate” and the other “Luck”.
Destiny Dice!
These were what Han Li had fished out from the Thousand Realm Ocean during his last session of Cosmic Fishing, which cost him a total of ten million years’ worth of cultivation.
That is, Han Li used the eighth silver Karma Fishing Rod capable of fishing out Quasi Immortal Emperor Rank treasures.
At the time, Han Li thought he had failed, but to his surprise, he caught them at the last moment.
When the Destiny Dice surfaced, Han Li let out a sigh of relief.
[Destiny Dice]: Quasi Immortal Emperor Rank Treasure, with incredible and unimaginable effects upon use, recommended to be used with caution.
Like a Dao command, the introduction to the Destiny Dice was brief and perplexing.
But, after some time and verification with the System, Han Li had mostly deciphered the effects of the Destiny Dice.
Looking at the two Destiny Dice in his hand, Han Li’s eyes flickered, and he finally made up his mind, “Today, I want to activate [Eternal Fate] and [Strong Luck].”
The two Destiny Dice could be used separately or together, embodying the Dao of Fate of Quasi Immortal Emperor Rank and possessing indescribable power.
Originally, Han Li intended to keep them as a backup for other uses but, after some thought, decided to use them in his upcoming journey to the Dadao Palace.
Within the Dadao Palace was a fortune tied to the fourth step.
If he succeeded in acquiring it, spending two Destiny Dice would be insignificant.
Han Li was confident in his ability to sweep through the Dadao Palace and suppress any dissent, but passing its tests was another matter entirely.
According to the female Immortal Emperor Chang Xi, the trials of the Dadao Palace were constantly changing, different each time, with no experiences to draw upon.
Given that, with the aid of the Destiny Dice, the situation would inevitably turn in his favor, guiding him through the trials toward the greatest Against the Heaven’s Creation.
“Huff~”
Han Li exhaled a long breath, thinking to himself: I must not disappoint the old ancestor.
With that thought, the dice with the character [Fate] appeared in the palm of Han Li’s left hand, and the dice with [Luck] in his right.
Then, in the next instant, the two Destiny Dice erupted with a blinding white light, so bright that Han Li couldn’t see clearly.
As the blinding light faded, Han Li looked down and found that the two Destiny Dice in his palms had disappeared.
Soon after, two System notifications rang in Han Li’s mind.
“Ding~[Eternal Fate] activation successful!
Duration: one month!”
“Ding~[Strong Luck] activation successful!
Duration: one month!”
Upon hearing this, Han Li’s face showed a relieved smile.
The final preparations were complete, and he was looking forward to the journey to the Dadao Palace, ready for a clash with the supreme talents from myriad realms.
I wonder if there will be any of those old immortals reborn?
………
Tai Chu Realm, Cosmic Sea.
The boundless sea encompassed countless realms, with surging waves, sometimes raging fiercely, causing numerous broken universes to rise and fall.
The Cosmic Sea was filled with chaotic Time-Space Dao, making it unfathomable â€” even Immortal Kings dared not enter to explore, Quasi Immortal Emperors could barely hold their footing, and only the Immortal Emperors could roam the vast and endless Cosmic Sea.
But the Cosmic Sea was fraught with danger, and even supreme Immortal Emperors avoided certain perils, daring not to hazily venture in, lest they become lost in the rifts of space-time, never to return.
A huge battleship sailed from somewhere within the Cosmic Sea, emanating an Eternal Immortal light, calming all the wild waves, leaving calm in its wake.
The Eternal Immortal light was boundless, covering vast areas of the Cosmic Sea, drawing the attention of some powerful beings who ventured there.
They set out, and upon seeing this Eternal Battleship, they couldn’t help but gasp, their eyes glowing with fervent light.
Yet, they only dared to follow from a distance, none daring to approach.
Deep in the Cosmic Sea, endless Time-Space mist appeared out of nowhere, causing the surrounding space and time to distort and become muddled.
Several powerful beings following the Eternal Battleship from afar gasped again, no longer daring to follow and turning to flee.
It is worth noting that among these powerful beings was one Immortal Emperor and six Quasi Immortal Emperors.
As the Eternal Battleship sailed into the Time-Space mist, a figure suddenly appeared nearby, surrounded by brilliant Dao light, that even dispersed the nearby Time-Space mist.
The towering figure stood above the Cosmic Sea, watching as the last part of the Eternal Battleship also entered the Time-Space mist, furrowing his brows.

chapters.title: Chapter 788
chapters.content:
Chapter 788: Chapter 299: The Destiny Dice, Eternal Ark, Immortal Emperor Tai Xuan_2 Chapter 788: Chapter 299: The Destiny Dice, Eternal Ark, Immortal Emperor Tai Xuan_2 “I’ve come a step too late.”
As something crossed his mind, his brows relaxed, and a smile surfaced on his face, “But it’s not without gain, at least it has truly allowed me to witness this legendary treasure.”
The towering figure did not pursue further, standing rooted to the spot, lost in memories.
This warship was the legendary Xuantian treasure, known as the Eternal Ark, rumored to have been created for the purpose of crossing over existence itself.
The Eternal Ark was said to come from a time immemorial, akin to Dadao Palace, both connected to that expeditionary Emperor of Mortal Clan.
Before his long journey, the Emperor of Mortal Clan had crafted the Eternal Ark, entrusting it into the care of someone he trusted, before leading the forces of the Heavenly Court on his expedition.
Many years later, a war erupted across all of time and space, its shockwaves reaching far and wide, awakening those in hibernation.
The awakened being immediately activated the Eternal Ark, intending to carry all beings of the Eternal World to escape, to traverse the void, to leap across time and space, to cross the Bitter Sea, and to reach the far shore.
As the Eternal Ark struggled to cross the Bitter Sea, an accident occurred, and it failed to withstand the tumultuous waters, sinking into the depths of the Bitter Sea.
...
The Eternal World, which it carried, was subsequently scattered across the Bitter Sea and shattered by the aftershocks of the great war, causing the Eternal Ark to disappear.
But in ancient times, the Eternal Ark appeared several times within the Ancient Eternal Realm, witnessed and recorded by certain special beings, confirming the reality of the legend.
Therefore, the towering figure coveted the Eternal Ark.
For the Eternal Ark was a Xuantian supreme treasure, that is, a fourth-step weapon.
The Dadao Palace that occasionally appears during each tribulation period is also a fourth-step weapon, a Xuantian supreme treasure.
However, the Dadao Palace still has a Dao spirit guarding it fiercely, refusing to reveal anything; no one dares to covet it.
Quasi Immortal Emperors and Immortal Emperors who entertained such thoughts have all perished.
The Eternal Ark, on the other hand, seems to lack a Dao spirit.
It’s uncertain whether its Dao spirit is in slumber or was annihilated back then, leading to the Ark remaining uncontrolled.
Even without its Dao spirit now, the Eternal Ark is still a Xuantian supreme treasure, an invincible fourth-step weapon; forcefully seizing it is impossible.
Although the towering figure is extremely powerful, regarded as one of the ten strongest Immortal Emperors across the myriad realms, he wouldn’t dare to clash head-on with a fourth-step weaponâ€”it would be courting death.
“It seems my plan is beginning to bear fruit,” said the towering figure to himself, his eyes twinkling.
He was almost certain that the sudden appearance of the Eternal Ark in the Tai Chu Realm was drawn here by him.
Given the particularity of the Eternal Ark, in the absence of a Dao spirit’s control, it only appears in certain special seas, such as the Cosmic Sea, Reincarnation Ocean, Origin Sea, Dao Ocean, etc., within the myriad realmsâ€”each of these seas possessing similar natures, only differing in the Daos they involve.
The universe encompasses all space, the cosmos spans all time; Cosmic Sea is hence the Space Ocean.
The last sighting of the Eternal Ark traces back to over a hundred tribulation periods ago, appearing in the Origin Sea, a part of one of the most powerful worlds within the Ancient Eternal Realm.
The towering figure had long been paying attention to the Eternal Ark but had not made a move, waiting for a change of circumstances.
After freeing himself, he slowly set his plans into motion, and not long ago, roughly a hundred epochs previously, he discovered a potential method to attract the Eternal Ark.
So, he began to experiment, exhibiting immense patience.
For just over a hundred epochs already, he started to see results; everything was worthwhile.
If he could board the Eternal Ark, he would have the chance to control it through a special method.
Then, he would be the strongest being across the myriad realms, truly invincible, pushing aside all, and suppressing the myriads.
Even if he failed, as long as he could acquire something from the Eternal Ark, he could hope to advance a half-step forward, becoming a “Quasi Fourth Step,” still unbeatable in force.
Although he covets the Eternal Ark greatly, he had not rushed onto it previously, for he dared not, and there’s nothing wrong with admitting that.
On one hand, he feared the Eternal Ark; on the other, he feared the fog of spacetimeâ€”one of the most terrifying dangers of the Cosmic Sea, with no equal.
Only a fourth-step weapon like the Eternal Ark could treat it as flat ground.
If he followed blindly into it, the possibility of becoming lost was real.
As the proverb goes, the wise learn from the misfortunes of others.
The towering figure had to be cautious.
Now that the Eternal Ark has arrived at the Tai Chu Realm’s Cosmic Sea, it proves that his method is feasible.
From now on, there is no fear of losing track of the Eternal Ark.
He can plan slowly, for he possesses immense patience and endless time to bide.
Suddenly, the towering figure’s brows furrowed slightly as he looked towards the distant Cosmic Sea,
A flash of immortal light passed, and a massive figure in purple-gold attire stepped forward, immediately spotting the towering figure in the distance and directly asking,
“Longhan, I heard that the Eternal Ark has appeared in the Cosmic Sea, is that true?”
The towering figure was none other than Emperor Longhan of the previous dynasty, who had been lurking in the depths of the Cosmic Sea, plotting.
At those words, his gaze flickered before he spoke the truth, “That’s correct.”
“Taixuan, shouldn’t you be staying in your Land of the Supreme Heaven, daring to come out?
Aren’t you afraid of being hunted by the five emperors?”
Longhan Immortal Emperor was taken aback, giving Emperor Longhan a deep look.
He hadn’t expected Emperor Longhan to admit so readily.
“Longhan, the five emperors are nothing to worry about, as you know, the real threats are the Yuan Emperor and the Chiming Heavenly Emperor.”
“Compared to me, you are probably the one the five emperors, as well as the Yuan Emperor and the Chiming Heavenly Emperor, most want to kill,” said Longhan Immortal Emperor with a smile.
Emperor Longhan remained expressionless.
He knew that what Longhan Immortal Emperor was saying was true.
Longhan Immortal Emperor was merely the master of a prohibited area.
Although he had grievances with the Crimson Heaven Court, the prohibited area had extensive connections that were not easily provoked.
In contrast, as a former Emperor of Heaven, as long as he was alive, the Chiming Heavenly Emperor, Yuan Emperor, Ming Emperor, Black Emperor, Green Emperor, White Emperor, and Crimson Emperorâ€”these seven Immortal Emperorsâ€”would rest uneasy.
If they knew where his true body was, they would no doubt come to kill him.
Seeing Emperor Longhan remain silent, Longhan Immortal Emperor did not continue this topic and instead probed, “Longhan, since the Eternal Ark has appeared, why haven’t you tried to storm it?”
Emperor Longhan let out a cold laugh and said indifferently, “I dare not board it; if you saw it, would you dare to?”
Longhan Immortal Emperor smiled without answering, but inside, he was gauging Emperor Longhan’s strength.
After a while, Longhan Immortal Emperor cheerfully said, “Longhan, since the Eternal Ark has vanished, I’ll take my leave.”
“You’re not being seen out.”
Emperor Longhan’s tone was cold as he watched Longhan Immortal Emperor disappear.
His eyes flashed, a snort escaped him, and murder flickered in his heart.
Longhan Immortal Emperor’s visit was probably not just to confirm the whereabouts of the Eternal Ark.
If it weren’t for the fact that Longhan Immortal Emperor was not weak, and he wasn’t sure he could suppress him quickly, Emperor Longhan would have made his move long ago.
Later, Emperor Longhan glanced at a certain place in the Cosmic Sea and vanished from where he stood.
After a while, two streaks of immortal light descended, with two Immortal Emperors arriving, tracing cause and effect, backtracking time, but to no avail.
In the depths of the Cosmic Sea, where time and space were chaotic and disordered, even the Immortal Emperors could not backtrack through time, and cause and effect were disturbed as well.
On an island deep within the Cosmic Sea, the figure of Emperor Longhan appeared with a sword scabbard at his side that held no Immortal Sword, and on the other side, there was a tripod furnace enveloped by countless specks of light.
Emperor Longhan, across endless time and space, glanced back at the two Immortal Emperors who had arrived, snorted coldly, but reined in his killer intent.
He looked at the inserted sword scabbard, pondered for a while, sighed, and thought that it had not been long since he last harvested, and to harvest again would require waiting over two hundred million years.
Emperor Longhan then looked towards the tripod furnace beside him; the furnace blazed fiercely, and within it was an Immortal Sword being forged, with only the hilt slightly sticking out.
Emperor Longhan stood with his hands behind his back, his thoughts somewhat drifting as he mused to himself, “What is Guanghan’s soul incarnation doing in the Yuankun Domain?
Did it discover something?”
Emperor Longhan’s thoughts raced as he considered using great mana to disperse the fog enveloping the Yuankun Domain, but hesitated and then decided against it.
He did not want any complications.
The people of the Crimson Heaven Court had been searching for him incessantly, and the Yuankun Domain had long been locked down by them, but the sword scabbard isolating the Yuankun Domain was not the true scabbard of his Bingtian Emperor Sword.
It was a reflection he had created through some heaven-defying Divine Skill.
This had its advantages and disadvantages: the Crimson Heaven Court could not trace him, but he also couldn’t effectively interfere with the Yuankun Domain, especially under the deliberate interference of a peak Immortal Emperor.

Chapter 789: Chapter 300: Top Ten of All Heavens, Attention from Myriad Realms, Han Li’s Guess_1 Chapter 789: Chapter 300: Top Ten of All Heavens, Attention from Myriad Realms, Han Li’s Guess_1 Time passed by,
and as the emergence of Dadao Palace drew ever closer, the entirety of the Heavenly Realms also began to stir.
Countless powerful beings cast their gaze upon Dadao Palace, showing immense interest.
The top ten strongest worlds of the Heavenly Realms, as well as those ranked within the top hundred, saw great Dao lineages from all sides making their final preparations.
Every time Dadao Palace opened, a maximum of one hundred twenty-nine thousand six hundred cultivators below the Golden Immortal Realm with Dadao orders could enter, and the orders were mostly held by the top Dao lineages of various domains.
After the Dadao orders descended onto various places within the Heavenly Realms, promising young cultivators needed to obtain them through fortune and fate, some finding them in ruins, some in Secret Territories, and others having the orders fall directly into their hands…
Although the Dadao orders were difficult to investigate, the top Dao lineages were still persistently searching, and once found, Loose Cultivators’ orders would generally be taken unless they joined that lineage or had powerful strength to directly escape.
This was the grand assembly of prodigies in the Heavenly Realms, gathering the most outstanding and monstrous talents among celestials and True Immortals from the last thousand epochs, destined to shine brightly and stand at incredibly great heights in the future.
...
Excluding those who perished along the way, at the very least, every prodigy who entered Dadao Palace became a Quasi Immortal Emperor, with a few becoming Immortal Emperors, and the best among them being able to sweep through invincibly and become an Emperor of Heaven for one domain.
For this reason, the top Dao lineages placed extreme importance on each prodigy participating in the Dadao Palace event, and prodigies from other Dao lineages were also closely watched.
Among the tens of thousands of promising young cultivators in the Heavenly Realms, none attracted more attention than Han Li.
Although no one knew his true identity, they knew of his deeds; while the Guanghan Empress was aware of Han Li’s identity and some of his deeds, she remained unaware of the most crucial ones.
Hundreds of years ago, a wave of undercurrents had already swept through the Heavenly Realms searching for that peerless figure.
When Han Li broke through to the Hollow Void Stage and grasped the embryonic form of the ultimate martial Dao, it startled the many great existences across the Heavenly Realms.
These supreme beings were unable to deduce Han Li’s whereabouts and information but did not give up their search.
A cultivator who had comprehended the ultimate martial Dao was destined to rise rapidly, shining brilliantly, pressing across the Heavenly Realms, and pushing through all domains as an unrivaled force.
As long as he stepped into the limelight and shone distinctly, he would attract attention, and with further investigation, his identity could be inferred.
However, much to the disappointment of the many supreme beings across the Heavenly Realms, they had yet to find that peerless figure who had comprehended the ultimate martial Dao, even after hundreds of years.
It was unknown whether he was quietly cultivating without venturing out, hence without fame, or if he had already been found by other supreme beings, cultivated in seclusion, and cut off from the external world’s probing.
As for perishing along the way?
That was impossible.
To comprehend the ultimate martial Dao proved he possessed great destiny, an unstoppable momentum and would not fall within a mere few centuries.
Apart from the Guanghan Empress, who had some speculation, other Immortal Emperors were also almost oblivious to Han Li’s identity.
What none could imagine was that Han Li was actually in a secluded place, with the seclusion imposed by an Emperor Level cultivator and a top Immortal Emperor concealing the threads of destiny.
As a result, despite Han Li’s reputation being widespread within Yuankun Domain, shaking all directions and being invincible from the Nine Heavens to the Ten Lands, the outside world remained oblivious; otherwise, he might have found it difficult to maintain his anonymity.
However, had Yuankun Domain not been isolated, considering Han Li’s nature, he would not have been so conspicuous and would still have kept a low profile, undetectably advancing to Immortal Emperor, or even waiting until the fourth step to reveal himself.
All of this was only somewhat speculated by the Guanghan Empress, but she was not certain.
When she turned her attention to Han Li, she probed all possible timelines and discovered that Han Li could not be killed and was ultimately invincible.
At the time, she considered the possibility that Han Li might be a reincarnation of a legendary fourth-step supreme being and also speculated that he might become a fourth-step cultivator in the future, which is why all timelines proved him invincible, suggesting that should a crisis of extinction arise, perhaps his power could instantly soar to the fourth step.
If it were the latter case, then Han Li would be a newly rising future fourth-step cultivator.
To transcend and step into the fourth step, how difficult of a feat that would be?
Even they, the top Immortal Emperors wielding supreme Dao, found it unachievable.
Han Li certainly had the potential to step into the fourth step, and the Guanghan Empress then guessed that he was that figure who had comprehended the ultimate martial Dao.
After arriving in the Yuankun Domain, the Guanghan Empress reviewed all information about Han Li, becoming even more certain that he was the cultivator who had comprehended the ultimate martial Dao.
She was also aware that countless Immortal Emperors across the Heavenly Realms were searching for Han Li, so she took extra care to shield his destiny and causality.
“Dadao Palace will soon emerge, will that peerless individual who comprehended the ultimate martial Dao participate?”
“It’s hard to say, the legend suggests that the ultimate martial Dao is the correct path to the fourth step, so he might not go.”
“It hasn’t even been four hundred years since that person in the Hollow Void Stage comprehended the true meaning of the ultimate martial Dao.
It’s such a short time, it’s uncertain whether he has even achieved immortality.”
“You are underestimating that person, underestimating the ultimate martial Dao.
He has certainly achieved immortality, and it must be as a True Immortal.”
“I think so too; if the supreme prodigies within our Dao lineage can become True Immortals within a few centuries, why not him?”
“Hehe~ after all this talk, what if that person doesn’t have a Dadao order?”
“Impossible!”
In the Heavenly Realms, within various great worlds, Immortal Emperors were conversing, their discussions revolving around Dadao Palace and Han Li.
Each Immortal Emperor had already made arrangements for the upcoming grand assembly of Dadao Palace; as long as that peerless figure who had comprehended the ultimate martial Dao appeared, it would be hard for them to escape their notice.

Chapter 790: Chapter 300: Top Ten of All Heavens, Attention from Myriad Realms, Han Li’s Guess_2 Chapter 790: Chapter 300: Top Ten of All Heavens, Attention from Myriad Realms, Han Li’s Guess_2 “`
When they discovered the whereabouts of this supreme fiend, they could consider either taking them into the Daoist sect or engaging in some vile actions afterward.
………..
Taichu Realm,
Yuankun Domain,
Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li was enjoying the moon with Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue at the mountain summit.
Han Li lay on the soft grass, with Yun Miaoyi and Jiang Baiye nestled in his arms on either side, while Lu Tianxiang massaged his shoulders, and Gongsun Yue pounded his legs.
Han Li felt incredibly leisurely and comfortable as he looked at the bright moon in the sky, finding the moon to be particularly brighter than usual that night.
“Husband, the moon is so bright tonight, more than ten times brighter than before,” Yun Miaoyi was the first to bring up this observation.
...
“Indeed, it’s brighter than any moon I remember seeing,” Gongsun Yue added with a surprised look as she glanced up.
Lu Tianxiang also gazed at the moon, her brow slightly furrowed, and after a moment’s thought, she gently spoke, “Husband, could it indicate that something is about to happen?”
“Sister Xiang is right, I think so too.
Something big must be about to happen; even the moon has been affected,” Jiang Baiye followed.
Han Li kissed Jiang Baiye’s fair and lovely face, saying with a smile, “There is indeed a significant event going to occur soon, something that will have a wide-ranging impact, but I’m not sure if it has anything to do with the moon being so bright tonight.”
Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue lit up at the same time, their husband surely knew something.
They exchanged glances and chorused, “Husband, why not tell us about it~”
As they spoke, the four beautiful wives each used their own ways to act coquettishly, much to Han Li’s enjoyment.
Han Li smiled and said, “In that case, let your husband explain.”
Then, Han Li spoke of the news about the Dadao Palace descending into the myriad realms of the heavens.
Upon hearing this, Lu Tianxiang, Jiang Baiye, Yun Miaoyi, and Gongsun Yue’s eyes sparkled with curiosity, their faces filled with wonder.
It was their first time hearing about the Dadao Palace and such a grand event involving the myriad heavens.
“Husband, so the myriad realms really do exist!
I thought our Tai Chu Realm was the only world,” Gongsun Yue said cutely, her face showing a longing as she pondered the thought.
“Isn’t our Tai Chu Realm the strongest among the myriad heavens?
The myriad heavens are truly terrifying,” Jiang Baiye said, her eyebrows tightly furrowed with apprehension.
After hundreds of years, they now had a lot of knowledge about the Tai Chu Realm, all learned through intelligence from the Xuxian Realm; they had even visited the Xuxian Realm for fun.
It was then that they realized just how vast and boundless the Tai Chu Realm was.
A total of 129,600 domains, with the Yuankun Domain being but one of them : a remote and weak one at that.
Above the Tai Chu Domain, there are the Thirty-three Heavens, where countless immortals reside, each more vast and boundless.
In the Yuankun Domain, where Heavenly Immortals and True Immortals are few and far between, they are infinitely abundant in the Thirty-three Heavens and hold a lower status.
The greatest strength of the Tai Chu Realm lies in the number of Immortal Emperors it has; there are more than a dozen known Immortal Emperors.
That’s not even counting those rumored to be in slumber in forbidden lands like the Ancient Reincarnation Land, the Land of the Supreme Heaven, the Cosmic Sea, Emperor Yuan’s Plain, and others.
Despite being so powerful, the Tai Chu Realm is ranked only tenth in all the myriad realms.
How dreadful then must the worlds that rank in the top nine, top five, or even the top three be?
“I always thought Immortal Emperors were at the pinnacle, but to think there are realms beyond that, the mythical fourth step of cultivation which seems so mysterious and unfathomable.
I wonder what scenery lies at the fourth step,” Lu Tianxiang said softly.
The nine realms of the Immortal Domain were no secret to her, as she was already familiar with them, but the fourth step was legendary, whispered only in small circles.
It was a forbidding frontier of myth, and it seemed no one had ever reached it.
“Husband, you mentioned that the Dadao Palace is related to the strongest of the fourth step, so could the Dadao Palace itself be a weapon of the fourth step?”
Yun Miaoyi’s beautiful eyes gleamed with insight as she made a bold conjecture.
Han Li’s pupils contracted; he hadn’t expected Yun Miaoyi to think of this possibility, so he nodded, “I have speculated this as well.”
The Dadao Palace, with its connection to the most potent cultivators of the fourth step, having existed since time immemorial, appearing in each tribulation period, and being desired and even deeply feared by Immortal Emperors, was evidence enough of its supreme power.
As such, the Dadao Palace’s capabilities must be incredibly terrifying, powerful enough to suppress any Immortal Emperor who coveted them.
“`
“`
Although the Empress Chang Xi did not tell him, Han Li could still make a good guess.
