“If only we could get into Dadao Palace, then we could escape Yuankun Domain, dominate Tai Chu Realm, and even rule over all the heavens and Myriad Realms.”
“Unfortunately, entry into Dadao Palace requires a Dadao Order, and Dadao Palace will descend tomorrow.
We have no chance to seek the Dadao Order now.”
“Lu Tianxiang is right, besides, it’s not certain whether there’s a Dadao Order in Yuankun Domain.
After all, there might be only about a dozen or so in the entire Tai Chu Realm, which is just too vast.”
“One hundred and twenty-nine million six hundred million supreme talents from all the Myriad Realms, this really is the top event of the Myriad Realms.
Whoever shines brightly, eclipsing other supreme talents, will definitely become famous throughout all the heavens and realms.”
Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Gongsun Yue, the four women, discussed animatedly and glanced at their husband, Han Li, with a hint of regret in their words.
Dadao Palace only allows cultivators below the Golden Immortal Realm to enter, and Han Li, who has just reached the True Immortal Peak, qualifies.
Though they did not know the exact extent of their husband’s combat ability, they were certain that he had attained the Golden Immortal Domain without a doubt.
They had absolute confidence in their husband.
If their husband could participate in this grand meeting of Dadao Palace, he might obtain some Against the Heaven’s Creation, paving the way for his future ascension to Immortality Emperor.
If he could seize the strongest and greatest creation, he might even step into the legendary fourth rank, becoming invincible across all the Myriad Realms.
They were his wives, sharing in his glory and his losses.
They very much wished for their husband to grow ever stronger, for then they too would bask in his glory, and with one person’s cultivation ascension, his wives and concubines would ascend as well.
If not for knowing their husband did not need to cultivate and that his cultivation strength was rapidly increasing, all of Han Li’s pampered wives and beautiful concubines would have long urged him to engage in arduous cultivation.
“Ahem~” Han Li coughed lightly, and his four beautiful wives immediately turned to look at him.
“What if, there’s a chance, that your husband actually possesses a Dadao Order?” Han Li said with a smile.
“Really?”
“Husband, you’re not deceiving us, are you?”
“Husband, are you joking with us?”
“Our husband really is omnipotent~”
Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Gongsun Yue widened their eyes in surprise and joy, bombarding him with questions.
“Of course it’s true.”
Han Li smiled, flipped his hand to take out the Dadao Order, and tossed it to his four beautiful wives for inspection.
The four women clumsily caught it, rolled their eyes at Han Li for being so careless, and then carefully examined it.
After looking it over, they returned the Dadao Order to Han Li, and Lu Tianxiang spoke up, “Husband, you mentioned tomorrow is the day Dadao Palace emerges; are you prepared?”
Anxiety showed on the faces of Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Gongsun Yue.
If there was no certainty, they would prefer that he not go.
Nothing was more important than their husband’s safety.
“I am completely confident,” Han Li said earnestly.
His four beautiful wives breathed a sigh of relief and turned their focus away from Dadao Palace, continuing to gaze at the bright moon and returning to their previous topic of conversation.
Han Li also shared his thoughts with them.
The legend says that the bright moon in the heavens also relates to the fourth step, crafted by a fourth step supreme being.
It could very well be the reason for the emergence of Dadao Palace.
These details are not important; that’s why Chang Xi did not tell Han Li.
Looking at the unusually bright moon in the sky, and thinking of Chang Xi, and of the Guanghan Empress of Tai Chu Realm, a spark of realization flashed in Han Li’s mind.
His breathing became a little more rapid.
Which Empress he suspected Chang Xi might be, he seemed to have a clue now.

chapters.title: Chapter 791
chapters.content:
Chapter 791: Chapter 301: Entering Dadao Palace, the Four-Step Test, the Test Begins_1 Chapter 791: Chapter 301: Entering Dadao Palace, the Four-Step Test, the Test Begins_1 “I hope it really is her.”
Gazing at the exceptionally bright moon, Han Li’s gaze flickered as he murmured softly.
“Husband, who is it really?” Yun Miaoyi asked with a smile.
Lu Tianxiang, Gongsun Yue, and Jiang Baiye also looked over; they had all heard their husband’s muttering.
Though the voice was soft, with their present cultivation in the Heaven Imperial Realm, they could still hear it clearly.
Han Li’s gaze swept over their stunningly beautiful faces, and after a slight hesitation, he revealed, “The Guanghan Empress.”
“Ah?”
“What does this have to do with the Guanghan Empress?”
“Husband, do you know the Guanghan Empress?”
“The Guanghan Empress resides in Guanghan Heaven within the Thirty-three Heavens, commanding the Guanghan Immortal Palace.
It is said she is already a peak-level Immortal Emperor, her strength inscrutable, probably no less than that of the current Chiming Heavenly Emperorâ€”she is the goal I pursue.”
Lu Tianxiang, Yun Miaoyi, Jiang Baiye, and Gongsun Yue all spoke up one after another, with Gongsun Yue being the most emotional.
Her martial path was similar to that of the Guanghan Empress.
...
Except her level wasn’t as high as that of the Guanghan Empress; if one had to categorize, it belonged to a branch of the Grand Dao cultivated by the Guanghan Empress.
“Didn’t I tell you before that during my travels in the Yuankun Domain, I encountered a mysterious powerhouse?”
“That mysterious powerhouse, named Chang Xi, told me many secret pieces of information.
Her power was unfathomable; I suspected she was a female Immortal Emperor.”
“Today, seeing this bright moon, it suddenly occurred to me that Chang Xi might just be the Guanghan Empress.”
Han Li looked somewhat peculiar as he narrated.
In the memories of his past life, Guanghan, Chang Xi, and the bright moon were indeed related, but this was the Taichu Realm, so he couldn’t be sure about their correlation.
“So that’s how it is.”
The four women realized with a shock, whispered amongst themselves for a few sentences, and did not ask further.
After moon-gazing, Han Li went to find Zimei Zhen, Ji Mingyue, Yuan Youwei, and other women, then went to see Yuan Weiyang, Huang Hongshang, Feng Mian, and other beautiful wives.
Finally, he entered the Time-Sky Tower to hold the daily Dao discussion conference.
The Time-Sky Tower had evolved to become a Golden Immortal weapon, its power having exponentially increased countless times.
In the fifteenth level, a hundred years passed inside for every day in the outside world.
Ever since the evolution of the Time-Sky Tower, Han Li finally breathed a sigh of relief; this way, he could interact with all his beautiful wives and concubines about the Dao every day.
However, the venerable ancestor Han was quite restrained, splitting his wives and concubines into several groups, discussing the Dao with only one group per day.
The morning sunlight shone on the sacred land of Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li, having finished his daily self-reflection, also appeared at the summit of Chengdao Peak, sitting cross-legged and absorbing the dawn’s purple Qi.
Although this was of little use to him, it was still a show of dedication, proving that the venerable ancestor Han practiced diligently every day.
Han Li spent the morning leisurely as usual.
Having developed the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, with his continuous adjustments to the rules and regulations, a complete development cycle had been established, no longer requiring his personal oversight.
All that was needed was to develop according to plan, and his expectations would be met.
Thinking that he was about to enter the Dadao Palace, unsure of how much time it would take, Han Li informed some of his beautiful wives and concubines of the situation via transmission, then summoned many core disciples from Chengsheng Mountain to teach them about the Dao.
Before he knew it, noon had arrived.
In a certain part of the Ancient Eternal Realm, the grand and ancient Dadao Palace emerged, immediately drawing the attention of countless Immortal Emperors.
The next instant, the Dadao Palace radiated boundless Dao light, spraying towards all the realms of the heavens.
Among them, twenty-six strands of Dao light descended into the Taichu Realm and then vanished without a trace, leaving even the Immortal Emperors unable to trace the owners of the Dao order.
In the Yuankun Domain, on Chengsheng Mountain.
Han Li had already taken out his Dao order; when the moment arrived, an ancient Dao melody reached his ears.
A strand of Dao light quietly landed on the Dao order, activating it.
Right then, Han Li was enveloped by the Dao order and disappeared from the summit of Chengdao Peak, entering inside the Dadao Palace.
Dadao Palace.
A streak of Dao light flashed, and Han Li’s figure emerged.
He casually swept a glance around and found there were already numerous cultivators present, with more streaks of Dao light arriving, each cultivator spaced about thirty feet apart.
After one breath’s time, no more Dao light descended.
The 129,600 cultivators participating in the grand assembly of the Dadao Palace were all present, scattered in all directions.
Han Li had changed his appearance and aura when he was on Chengsheng Mountain, utilizing a secret technique taught by Chang Xi.
In the Dadao Palace, he reckoned no True Immortal would be able to see through his true identity.
Only then did he take a closer look at the interior of the Dadao Palace, and his brow involuntarily furrowed.
The scene was different from what Chang Xi had described, indicating the trials of the Dadao Palace had indeed changed this time.
He stood within an endless expanse where, even with his power, he could not see the limits.
At the center of this realm stood a majestic altar with nine layers, exuding a vast and grand aura.
Han Li was far from the nine-layer altar, and he wasn’t the only oneâ€”every exceptional talent from all the worlds was at a great distance from it.
The cultivators were spread out in every direction, with an ancient path in front of them, leading to the nine-layer altar.
After understanding the situation, the tens of thousands of outstanding talents were mostly dumbfounded, as many of the tactics they had carefully prepared became useless.
Only a few remained calm.
Although the tests of the Dadao Palace were different each time, they were not usually completely different.
According to the process, the trials of the Dadao Palace consisted of four stages, each offering a chance for fortune upon completion.
Generally, the first trial of the Dadao Palace was fixed, seldom changing, with only the latter three trials varying.
But now, even the first trial had changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 792
chapters.content:
Chapter 792: Chapter 301: Entering Dadao Palace, the Four-Step Test, the Test Begins_2 Chapter 792: Chapter 301: Entering Dadao Palace, the Four-Step Test, the Test Begins_2 This means that this time, the trial of Dadao Palace will be more difficult than before, but correspondingly, the divine opportunity and creation acquired after passing the trial will be better.
Han Li frowned slightly and silently retreated to the back of the crowd.
Looking at the dense crowd in front of him and the nine-level altar, Han Li sighed inwardly.
The talents from all the worlds truly had formidable strength.
Each of the eight regions had 16,200 exceptional talents, every one of them at the True Immortal Peak, without exception.
Most of them radiated a powerful aura, with only a few concealing it.
Undoubtedly, anyone who could obtain the command of the Great Way and enter Dadao Palace, these exceptional talents at the True Immortal Peak, must possess at least the combat ability of the Golden Immortal Realm.
...
The cultivators who came here, without a doubt, all had one common goal: to gain the divine opportunities within Dadao Palace.
Most people were aware of their limits and only wished to reach the third step of the trial, to gain some more divine opportunities.
A small part of the cultivators set their sights on the fourth step, which was their goal for entering Dadao Palace.
Legend has it that passing the fourth step’s trial would grant one that Against the Heaven’s Creation involved with the fourth step.
But from ancient times to the present, not a single exceptional talent had successfully passed it, so no one knew if it was true.
There were countless opportunities within Dadao Palace, infinite creations; besides the opportunities tied to the fourth step, there were countless Quasi Immortal Emperor Rank and Immortal Emperor Rank divine creations.
Whatever one could think of, Dadao Palace had it, with the least being at the Quasi Immortal Emperor Level.
“Finally arrived at Dadao Palace, I don’t even know what the test is.
I just hope to pass the first step of the trial, obtain the Quasi Immortal Emperor Level creation, and establish the foundation for the Quasi Immortal Emperor Path.”
“Tsk, you slacker, you really lack ambition.
Someone once obtained the Immortal Emperor Fruit in Dadao Palace, and upon eating it, they instantly became an Immortal Emperor.
Don’t you aspire to that?”
“Dadao Palace has endless opportunities, Against the Heaven’s infinite chances.
There is nothing you can’t think of that isn’t here.
Someone even obtained a Mid Xuantian Treasure and became invincible as soon as they left, becoming the Emperor of a realm.”
In front, many cultivators were discussing and exchanging views.
The cultivators from all realms naturally gathered together, with few exceptions.
They didn’t try to conceal their conversations and didn’t see the need to, as everyone had understood the various legends and matters to note before entering Dadao Palace.
It was just a topic of discussion.
Han Li raised his eyebrows.
He didn’t know about these things; Chang Xi had not told him, only sharing important intelligence.
At this moment, a series of indifferent voices arose and echoed in this realm.
“Welcome to Dadao Palace.”
“Possessing the Great Way command and entering Dadao Palace is a type of opportunity, which will allow you to receive a creation.
All participants won’t leave empty-handed.”
“The place where you now stand is a Dao field I have opened up.
It is vast and boundless, with rules in place.
No cultivator is allowed to break these rules, or they will be punished by me.”
“Within Dadao Palace, the highest allowed realm in any area or trial site is True Immortal Peak.
All cultivators must not take the opportunity to break through to a higher realm.
Violators will be penalized.”
“The trials of Dadao Palace are divided into four steps.
After passing each step, you will gain a tremendous opportunity and a significant creation.
Even if you do not pass, as long as you reach a certain level, you can still get part of the divine opportunity and creation.”
“The first trial is the Great Way altar.
Cultivators from all worlds, from their respective regions, will enter the eight ancient paths leading to the Great Way altar and climb it.”
“For each level of the Great Way altar you climb, you are qualified to receive a type of divine opportunity.
Upon reaching the top of the ninth level, it is considered passing the trial and you will receive the tremendous opportunity and creation of the first step.”
“Note: In every step of the trial, each cultivator can only receive one type of divine opportunity and creation.
If you have received the opportunity of a certain level, even if you climb to a higher level, you cannot receive a better opportunity.”
“Each cultivator who enters Dadao Palace can obtain at most four types of divine opportunities and creations.
Please remember this, all cultivators.”
“Note: Fighting and killing are not prohibited within Dadao Palace, nor is seizing opportunities from others.
Please take care to protect yourselves, all cultivators.”
“Note: After obtaining an opportunity, participants may choose to exit and not proceed with subsequent trials.
All participants who exit will be protected by Dadao Palace, and killing or seizing from them is forbidden.”
In the vast and limitless realm, a wave of restlessness suddenly spread through the air.
Although most of the extraordinary talents had long been aware of the rules of Dadao Palace, they still felt a bit shocked upon hearing them anew.
The gazes they cast towards the cultivators by their side had also changed somewhat, even if they did not wish to kill and snatch opportunities from other cultivators, they still had to prevent other cultivators from killing and snatching opportunities from them.
Han Li’s slightly furrowed brows smoothed out as he stood at the very back of all the cultivators, almost without any presence.
“Are there only four kinds of opportunities to be obtained in Dadao Palace?”
Han Li’s eyes flashed as he thought about the rules that followed, and the corners of his mouth curled up slightly, “I hope they don’t come to provoke me.”
Dadao Palace did not prohibit killing and snatching, which was tantamount to indirectly encouraging all cultivators to fight for survival, as long as they don’t die, at worst they could get one kind of opportunity.
According to the rules of Dadao Palace, even the worst opportunity was at the Quasi Immortal Emperor level, if some weaklings accidentally entered, they just needed to take the opportunity provided upon entry and then choose to leave, and they could make it out safely.
If they chose to continue and were killed by other cultivators before reaching a certain stage or passing the trial, then the opportunity would become someone else’s.
For now, Han Li did not want to start a mass slaughter, which would reveal his strength and draw the attention of all cultivators, He intended to keep a low profile for the time being.
The prodigies and monsters participating in the Dadao Palace grand event came from all the worlds across the heavens.
There were supreme prodigies of this era as well as reincarnations of some powerful beings like Immortal Kings and Immortal Lords.
Having reached the ceiling of their realms, it was difficult for them to break through further, but if they calculated the timing well and reincarnated a few hundred or thousand years earlier, they could cultivate again to the peak of True Immortal and participate in the Dadao Palace grand event.
As long as they stood out from the crowd in Dadao Palace and obtained an against the heaven’s opportunity, they could defy their destiny and climb to a higher realm in this life.
There were also Quasi Immortal Emperors who had reincarnated to partake in Dadao Palace, but they were few.
Even if they obtained an opportunity from Dadao Palace, it was still not guaranteed that they would cultivate to the Quasi Immortal Emperor level, since accidents could happen along the way.
Reincarnations of Immortal Emperors were even rarer; every time Dadao Palace opened, there were no more than ten individuals who could be confirmed as reincarnations of Immortal Emperors, as it was too risky.
Instead of reincarnating to seek the greatest opportunity in Dadao Palace, it made more sense to retain their realm and power to partake in the struggle for other opportunities, as there were more than just Dadao Palace in the myriad worlds containing the fourth step against the heaven’s creation.
In addition, among the prodigies and monsters participating in Dadao Palace were another category of cultivators, those who had taken part in Dadao Palace’s grand event more than once.
Immortal cultivators can live forever once they reach the Golden Immortal Realm, without any lifespan limit, but Dadao Palace has restrictions; only cultivators below the Golden Immortal Realm can participate.
Even the peak of True Immortal has a lifespan of only one hundred eras and can live long, but not eternally.
Even if they prolong their life with longevity treasures to live for more eras, or even another lifetime or two, it’s all pointless.
The emergence of Dadao Palace is too infrequent, once every tribulation period of three thousand six hundred eras, Dadao Palace would only appear one to three times.
True Immortals do not have the longevity to wait for Dadao Palace to reemerge in the world.
However, Quasi Immortal Emperors and Immortal Emperors do exist.
The peak True Immortals who are able to participate in Dadao Palace are undoubtedly supreme prodigies and extraordinary monsters, and they don’t need much time to cultivate to the peak of True Immortal.
If they wish to participate in the next Dadao Palace and have the backing of Quasi Immortal Emperors or Immortal Emperors willing to help, they could be sealed until Dadao Palace emerges again.
After being sealed by Quasi Immortal Emperors or Immortal Emperors, the rate of lifespan depletion can be reduced by a thousandfold or ten thousandfold, allowing them to participate in Dadao Palace multiple times.
The premise is that they have the qualifications and strength; otherwise, even the Quasi Immortal Emperors and Immortal Emperors would not lend a hand.
A cultivator who can’t get far in Dadao Palace won’t benefit from multiple entries.
Because wanting to participate multiple times in the Dadao Palace grand event has one restrictionâ€”you must give up the opportunity obtained each time.
No cultivator can cut corners in Dadao Palace; to aim for a better opportunity next time, they have to give up this time.
As Han Li’s thoughts flowed, the voice of Dadao Palace’s spirit once again rang out.
“The trial begins!”

chapters.title: Chapter 793
chapters.content:
Chapter 793: Chapter 302: Han Li Makes His Move, Crushing All Enemies with a Wave of His Hand, Passing the First Test_1 Chapter 793: Chapter 302: Han Li Makes His Move, Crushing All Enemies with a Wave of His Hand, Passing the First Test_1 “`
“Boom~”
No sooner had the words fallen than some of the chosen fiends charged into the ancient path, heading for the Celestial Altar, while many others directly attacked those beside them, seizing the opportunity to eliminate potential rivals.
Immortal weapons traversed the sky, rules surged to the heavens, Order Runes densely packed, the murderous aura vibrating throughout the Three Thousand Realms.
All kinds of Immortal arts and Divine Skills were unleashed; whether willing or not, everyone was forced into a desperate battle for survival.
There were battle flags shattered, Immortal towers destroyed, and even Immortal Swords broken and heavenly sabers damaged, accompanied by countless True Immortals spilling blood across the sky.
Dadao Palace had restrictions on the Immortal weapons that Cultivators could bring in.
Golden Immortal weapons were permitted, but Immortal Monarch Soldiers and anything above were not.
In this clash, at least a hundred Golden Immortal weapons were destroyed on the spot, and the amount of fallen chosen fiends and beasts was in the hundreds.
...
“Ah~”
A scream sounded in front of Han Li, as another peak True Immortal was about to die.
A long spear pierced his chest, with countless Immortal Runes bursting forth, the terrifying power directly obliterating him.
“I hate this!”
The regretful cry of this chosen resounded through the heavens and earth, dying with a heart full of unwillingness.
The chosen who killed him retreated with his long spear, his expression extremely cold.
Before entering Dadao Palace, they had been instructed that the trial could commence with slaughter to reduce the number of competitors.
Those lacking strength dared to enter Dadao Palace, delusionally seeking to obtain the defy-heaven fortune; that was simply impossible.
However, he also knew that to completely eradicate this person was probably not possible since every chosen fiend who entered Dadao Palace came from major paths among the myriad realms.
They had all prepared contingencies so that even if they perished within Dadao Palace, there was an excellent chance they could be resurrected in the outside world.
Han Li stood at the very back, his brows slightly furrowed as he observed the chaos of the battle.
His position was relatively safe, and since he hadn’t rushed forward initially, no Cultivators had yet attacked him.
“Those who are weaker are doomed, even upon entering Dadao Palace.
If they can’t even get past the first phase of the trial, they can only leave with the most basic opportunities for fortune, a pitiful and lamentable sight.”
Han Li muttered to himself.
His strength was incredibly formidable, almost able to encompass the situations in all eight directions of the arena.
Of the hundreds of chosen fiends and beasts who left the fray, the weakest possessed the Combat Ability of the Golden Immortal Third Heaven, and the strongest had reached Golden Immortal Sixth Heaven.
If not for being entrapped in encirclement, at least they could have progressed to the second phase of the trial.
The trials of Dadao Palace had just begun, already bloodying the battlefield and staining the heavens and earth red, marking the official commencement of this struggle for fortunes of destiny.
Here, everyone was at the peak of True Immortal, and having great backing was of no use.
If your strength was lacking, you were a target to be killed, the cruelty was extreme.
Many chosen fiends and beasts, despite being prepared, were directly frightened; in their own worlds, they were pampered and revered, having long forgotten the bloody reality of killing and combat.
“Buzz~”
A barely perceptible ripple undulated behind Han Li, and an exceptional chosen instantly appeared, launching a sneak attack with the mightiest of Immortal arts and Divine Skills, aiming to annihilate him.
He had already noticed this person sneakily moving to the back, clearly lacking in both courage and strength, making him a perfect target.
The overwhelming power swept towards Han Li, convinced that he wouldn’t be able to withstand it, nor would he have the time, and with the attacker’s Combat Ability of Golden Immortal Realm Fifth Heaven, Han Li was presumed dead without a doubt.
“Bang!”
Without turning his head, Han Li flicked his right hand backwards, causing all the force to explode outwards.
The exceptional chosen who had ambushed him was blasted away, his body shattered, then dissipated into dust and sand.
The chosen fiends and beasts entangled in battle around him were startled; with a wave of his hand, he had quelled an exceptional chosen with the Combat Ability of Golden Immortal Fifth Heaven, this man had to possess the strength of the late Golden Immortal stage at least.
Han Li’s thunderous might made the other powerhouses wary, not daring to approach him too closely, and they retreated to fight from a distance.
Han Li stood still for a moment, waiting as the melee came to an end.
This chaos was only to take the opportunity to eliminate some Cultivators from the arena, and the goal had been achieved.
Now that everyone else was prepared, further conflict would only benefit the others.
All Cultivators entered the ancient paths one by one, heading straight for the Celestial Altar.
Some looked back at Han Li, taking note of this powerful figure.
Not to provoke him unless necessary, but if the opportunity arose, they wouldn’t mind joining forces to quell Han Li.
Han Li stood with his hands behind his back, his blue robes fluttering, in no hurry to advance.
He was continuously observing the entire arena.
Of the 129,600 Cultivators who participated in the first step of the Dadao Palace trial, by now, over a thousand had left the field, and tens of thousands of chosen fiends and beasts had set off early without engaging in battle, now nearing the Celestial Altar.
According to Han Li’s observation, among these chosen fiends and beasts, quite a few formidable individuals were hidden, with at least several hundreds of them having late-stage Golden Immortal Combat Ability, and among them, eight possessed peak Golden Immortal strength.
This was only what he could see; there were likely many more who hadn’t fought or who had concealed their true strength.
“If that’s truly the case, for me, they could all be subdued with a flick of the wrist,” Han Li thought to himself.
Even in his normal state, he possessed the unbeatable Combat Ability of a Quasi Immortal Monarch, and when he activated his Divine Sense, he could even reach the Immortal Monarch Realm, or even the threshold of a Quasi Immortal King.
Even if these chosen fiends and beasts were concealing something, reaching the Combat Ability of an Immortal Monarch would be extremely difficult, let alone defeating him.
Nevertheless, Han Li remained wary, especially of those who were reincarnations of Quasi Immortal Emperors and Immortal Emperors, as well as the supreme fiends who had participated in Dadao Palace multiple times.
Chang Xi had once revealed to him that during her participation in the grand Dadao Palace event, she had encountered many supreme fiends who had joined the trials multiple times, some a few times, others over a dozen, and some even dozens of times.

chapters.title: Chapter 794
chapters.content:
Chapter 794: Chapter 302: Han Li Makes His Move, Crushing All Enemies with a Wave of His Hand, Passing the First Test_2 Chapter 794: Chapter 302: Han Li Makes His Move, Crushing All Enemies with a Wave of His Hand, Passing the First Test_2 Participants who have entered the Dadao Palace multiple times walked farther with each entry, honing their combat ability, which grew stronger with every trial.
Chang Xi had encountered three participants with the combat ability of mid-stage Immortal Monarchs, and even an upcoming supreme Immortal Emperor like Chang Xi had to avoid their sharp edges.
Countless thoughts flashed through his mind, Han Li collected his thoughts, stepped forward with steady strides, hands clasped behind his back, strolling leisurely towards the ritual altar of the Dadao.
While he delayed, the cultivators at the front had already ascended to the first level of the ritual altar, with others following suit, and fighting had become a rarity.
The eight ancient paths leading to the ritual altar were far, but not dangerous; the danger came from the exceptional talents from all the worlds and realms.
The real trials lay within the ritual altar, with a test on each level, accessible only to those who passed the previous one.
Following the ancient path, Han Li was among the last to arrive below the ritual altar, noticing cultivators from other directions who seemed to be “birds of a feather.”
Han Li smiled and didn’t mind, his hands still clasped behind his back, he slightly raised his head to observe the situation atop the ritual altar.
...
At this moment, most people were still on the first level, a small number were on the second, and a few had reached the third, with numbers increasing by the moment.
Han Li’s gaze flickered, and he stepped onto the first level of the ritual altar.
“The trial of the first level of the ritual altar, defeat a cultivator of the same realm,” the indifferent voice of the Dadao Palace’s spirit echoed in Han Li’s ears, making his eyebrows frown slightly.
According to this rule, only about sixty thousand cultivators could pass the first level, and even if the subsequent levels did not increase in difficulty, only about five hundred cultivators would eventually top the ritual altar, with around two hundred fifty passing the first step.
Is the first trial of the Dadao Palace this difficult?
It directly filtered out the vast majority of cultivators, leaving less than one percent.
Or had he thought wrong, and the trials at the later stages of the ritual altar might change?
Han Li’s eyes sparkled faintly, and he didn’t ponder anymore.
After all, he was certain to pass, whoever encountered him was simply unlucky.
At this moment, there indeed was one unlucky fellow.
When Han Li entered, the first prodigy to come in was immediately dumbfounded, inwardly lamenting his plight for running into this freak.
He had personally witnessed this man effortlessly slay a peerless prodigy with the combat power of the Fifth Heaven of the Golden Immortal Realm with a raise of his hand, the might of that thunder was still frightening to him to this day.
His own combat ability was only at the Fourth Heaven of the Golden Immortal Realm, encountering this man would surely mean being effortlessly crushed; but he did not wish to die, nor to be eliminated.
With gritted teeth, the peerless prodigy, seeing Han Li about to make a move, immediately said, “I admit defeat!”
In the next instant, a white light descended and transferred the person away.
Han Li was slightly stunned, so it was allowed to admit defeat.
He took another glance at the ritual altar above and then at the area below, noting that fewer prodigies were eliminated than he had thought.
In other words, the Dadao Palace allowed surrender.
Even if unable to beat the opponent, prompt surrender resulted in being sent out to start over the climb of the ritual altar, defeating other cultivators, and still reaching higher levels to gain fortune and opportunities.
In this manner, it minimized the number of eliminations, selecting the most talented and potential prodigies.
“Hum~”
The indifferent voice of the Dadao Palace spirit rang in Han Li’s ears again, reminding him that he had obtained some kind of opportunity at the Quasi Immortal Emperor level, asking if he wanted to claim it immediately.
Of course, Han Li would not claim it, as doing so would mean the end of his journey in the Dadao Palace.
His goal was to pass the fourth-step trial and obtain the rumored Against the Heaven’s Creation related to the fourth step from within the Dadao Palace.
A white light fell, and Han Li disappeared from the first layer of the altar, entering the second layer.
The third layer.
The fourth layer.
The fifth layer.
The sixth layer.
The opponents Han Li encountered were not very strong, or rather, Han Li was too strong; most of them directly admitted defeat, only the last one dared to fight against Han Li.
Therefore, Han Li raised his hand and slaughtered him, entering the seventh layer of the ritual altar.
“The seventh-floor trial of the Dadao Palace, the killing of three Gold Immortals of the Seventh Heaven realm ‘puppets’.”
The voice of the Dadao Palace spirit sounded, and Han Li’s gaze shifted slightly, realizing that from the seventh floor, the trials of the Daoist Altar were different.
The genius who was killed on the sixth floor only had the combat ability of a Gold Immortal of the Sixth Heaven, and that was after stimulating Divine Sense, yet on the seventh floor, he had to kill three Gold Immortal puppets of the Seventh Heaven.
Calling them puppets, in reality, were cultivators created by the Dadao Palace, seemingly past participants of the Dadao Palace, with cold expressions, devoid of relevant memories, they attacked directly.
The first was a True Dragon, with a massive body and an overwhelming might that rolled in, its body shrouded in the boundless light of the Great Dao, normal Golden Immortals would be injured upon contact, and a direct hit would mean death.
The second was a woman in yellow, with a graceful figure and icy gaze, holding a top-notch Gold Immortal weapon in her hand, a pair of phoenix wings emerged behind her unleashing Infinite Immortal Light, charging at incredible speed.
The third was also from the Human Clan, a middle-aged man in grey armor, and with a raise of his hand, thunder exploded, a small sea of lightning formed overhead, even a thunder pool appeared, bringing down a divine punishment and thundering celestial blades, all to blast Han Li.
Han Li did not dodge or evade, still standing with his hands behind his back.
With a light stomp of his right foot, the entire space violently shook, and the three attacking Gold Immortals were instantly immobilized in mid-air, their offensive might completely shattered.
With another stomp of Han Li’s right foot, three rays of immortal light shot out from the void, piercing through the three Golden Immortal powerhouses, causing them to explode on the spot.
“It’s just that.”
Han Li shook his head slightly.
Those geniuses and monsters from the Human Clan who had come to participate in the grand event of the Dadao Palace, as long as they had not shown a killing intent towards him, Han Li would not commit mass slaughter; he could spare them.
As for those puppets created by the Dadao Palace, Han Li felt no need to hold back, directly obliterating them was the way to go.
A white light descended, and Han Li entered the eighth level of the Daoist Altar.
On this floor, Han Li’s opponents were ten peerless geniuses with the combat capability of the Golden Immortal Realm Eighth Heaven, once again created by the Dadao Palace.
Han Li raised his hand and with a palm strike, he directly exploded all ten peerless geniuses, passing the trial.
His combat ability was too strong, it could be described as slaughtering all in his path, be they human or Buddha, cutting down gods and annihilating immortals, invincible in every respect.
The ninth level of the Daoist Altar presented an even greater challenge, the opponents now were fifteen peerless geniuses with the combat ability of the Golden Immortal Realm Ninth Heaven.
To pass this level, one would need to have combat ability at least at the peak of the Golden Immortal Realm, regardless of whether it was a temporary burst of Divine Sense.
Han Li was actually quite curious about how many geniuses and monsters could pass this level.
To pass this trial, one would have to reveal their true strength, otherwise, they would be eliminated.
Feigning weakness or deception was impossible.
And passing the ninth-level trial meant that one had passed the first step of the Dadao Palace’s trials and could go on to participate in the second stage of trials.
Just as Han Li’s thoughts were turning, those fifteen Golden Immortal Realm Ninth Heaven powerhouses each used their methods and attacked.
For a moment, the space bristled with tens of Golden Immortal weapons, Quasi Immortal Monarch weapons spanning the sky, immortal light shining throughout, with a might that shook the ages;
The fifteen cultivators also each cast powerful immortal arts and Divine Skills, with terrifying destructive force, distorting the void, and descending upon Han Li.
“Break!”
Han Li uttered softly, and a treasure orb appeared, with rays of rosy light shooting out endless blue immortal light covering the sky, confronting the immortal soldiers, immortal arts, and the immortals themselves.
Boom~
An earth-shattering roar exploded, all the luminance fading away, along with those fifteen peerless geniuses of the Golden Immortal Realm Ninth Heaven.
“Congratulations on passing the first step of the trials, you have been awarded a ‘Primordial Dao Fruit’.”
As the voice of the spirit echoed, a fruit covered with mysterious Dao patterns appeared in Han Li’s hand, shrouded with endless Grand Dao principles.
“It’s actually a Primordial Dao Fruit,” Han Li’s lips curved up slightly.
A Primordial Dao Fruit was the top tier of the Quasi Immortal Emperor level creation, awarded only to those cultivators who passed the first step of the trials.
Coupled with the opportunity to enter the Dadao Palace, he now had two types of Quasi Immortal Emperor level creation in his hands.
Primordial Dao Fruit: A peak Quasi Immortal Emperor level Dao Fruit, containing one kind of peak Quasi Immortal Emperor’s Dao.
Upon consuming and refining it, one can immediately master this peak Quasi Immortal Emperor’s Dao and make a cultivation breakthrough to the corresponding level.
Casually storing it away, Han Li stood atop the Daoist Altar, overlooking the entire Daoist field.
Han Li discovered that he was the first to clear the trial.

chapters.title: Chapter 795
chapters.content:
Chapter 795: Chapter 303: Immortal Flower, Wandao Ocean, Dadao Sect, Dadao Mountain, Myriad Daos Descend_1 Chapter 795: Chapter 303: Immortal Flower, Wandao Ocean, Dadao Sect, Dadao Mountain, Myriad Daos Descend_1 “Are there still so many people left?”
Han Li overlooked the entire Dadao altar, his eyes capturing the exceptional young talents of various levels, and a look of surprise flickered across his face.
There were more people left than he had anticipated, as many as forty to fifty thousand.
“It’s a pity that no matter how many there are, it’s useless, most are stuck below the seventh level of the Dadao altar.” Han Li shook his head slightly.
There were just over five thousand people on the seventh level of the Dadao altar, just over three thousand on the eighth level, and just over one thousand six hundred cultivators attempting to break through the ninth level.
The last three levels changed the content of the challenges, and with the option to concede and retry, the number of eliminated competitors could be greatly reduced, but not many among the exceptional geniuses from all worlds had the combat ability of the later stage of the Golden Immortal Realm whilst at the peak of True Immortal.
Han Li shifted his gaze towards those undergoing trials in the ninth level of the Dadao altar, his eyes flickered, and he muttered softly,
“I wonder how many exceptional talents will pass the trials of the ninth level.”
Although he had already passed and stood at the top of the Dadao altar, he still couldn’t see clearly what was inside.
He could only see over a thousand orbs of light suspended in this level, each containing an extraordinary talent undergoing their trial.
...
No sooner had his words fallen silent than an orb exploded.
A young man in red with a calm expression and a sword mark on his forehead stepped out with an easy stride.
His body was permeated with a rich Daoist charm and wrapped in dazzling Infinite Immortal Light, like a young Immortal Emperor, his brilliance captivating, with all the endless rules of order bowing in worship before him.
The youth in red glanced over the ninth level, a satisfied look flashed across his face, and he said to himself, “Indeed, I’m still the first to pass…”
Just as he was about to say the word “through,” he caught sight of Han Li’s silhouette and paused, his expression changing.
There was another talent who had passed the trials of the Dadao altar’s ninth level even faster than him.
“Which sacred being might you be, fellow Daoist?”
The youth’s expression changed repeatedly before he stepped forward to inquire, his tone tinged with wariness.
Han Li smiled without speaking.
He had no desire to say much to this person, just patiently waiting for the first step of the trial to end would suffice.
If it weren’t for the restrictions of the first step of the trial, which lasted for half a day, requiring them to wait for it to end before proceeding to the second step, Han Li would have long since left this place.
Seeing that Han Li ignored him, the youth in red’s gaze flashed once more, revealing a dangerous light, but he did not actually make a move, somewhat wary of this cultivator who had passed before him.
“Hmph~”
The youth in red snorted and returned to his original spot.
Before long, three beams of immortal light shone brightly, and three paramount talents emerged, two men and one woman.
Upon seeing Han Li and the youth in red, their expressions changed as well, and they waited in silence.
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, half a day had gone by.
The first step of the trial at Dadao Palace came to an end, with just over one thousand people passing the first step and moving on to the second step of the trial to gain more opportunities for fortune.
“Buzz~”
Beams of immortal light descended, enshrouding all the cultivators on the ninth level of the Dadao altar.
As the immortal light faded, the figures of Han Li and the others disappeared.
A beam of immortal light descended, and Han Li’s figure reappeared.
This time, he found himself in a vast and beautiful world with the sounds of birds and fragrant flowers, tranquil and serene.
The over one thousand people from the top of the Dadao altar all entered this new world but were not in the same location, scattered across multiple areas.
Han Li cast his gaze around, taking in the surroundings where he stood.
There were less than two hundred cultivators in his vicinity, coming from thirty-seven different races, with the Human Clan making up the majority.
Han Li retracted his gaze, his brow suddenly raising as he felt gentle ripples in the void, sacred and soothing, flooding him with a sense of tranquility, dissipating all fatigue from his body.
In the distant horizon, boundless Infinite Immortal Light soared to the skies, accompanied by a myriad of miraculous sights and endless anomalies, making that area like the finest Sacred Land.
At the same time, the indifferent voice of a spirit from Dadao Palace also echoed through this beautifully serene new world.
“The second step of the trial is quite simple.
When the Immortal Flower blooms and the Dadao Door appears, push open the Dadao Door and enter it to pass the second step of the trial,”
“Those who do not enter the Dadao Door will be rewarded based on their proximity to it.”
Hearing the words of the spirit from Dadao Palace, a thoughtful expression appeared on Han Li’s face.
When the Immortal Flower blooms and the Dadao Door appears, where will entry lead?
Directly into the third step of the trial?
The trial of the second step was indeed “simple,” even the rules were straightforward, and it did not prohibit slaughter.
He glanced at the cultivators around him.
Han Li smiled, placed his hands behind his back, and walked forward towards the location of the Immortal Flower.
The cultivators watched Han Li’s retreating figure, their eyes glimmering, and murderous intent surging within them.
Many wanted to ambush Han Li, but ultimately, no one dared to act first.
They remembered that Han Li was the first to pass the first step of the Dadao Palace’s trial, a man with an undoubtedly significant background and unfathomable strength.
Whoever struck out first was likely to be the first to die.
Seeing that no one acted, Han Li, who had been on guard, was somewhat disappointed.
He had been prepared to use thunderous methods to crush any cultivator that attacked him, establishing his authority and dealing with any potential trouble; he did not expect these exceptional talents to be so cowardly.
Han Li didn’t consider that, with his unfathomable strength and his status as a newcomer who was the first to pass through the ninth level of the Dadao altar, who could look upon him without utmost dread?
It was quite a distance from where Han Li arrived to this beautiful new world; even with his current speed, it took a full five breaths of time before he reached the vicinity of the Immortal Flower.

chapters.title: Chapter 796
chapters.content:
Chapter 796: Chapter 303 Immortal Flower, Wandao Ocean, Dadao Sect, Dadao Mountain, Thousand Dao Overwhelms_2 Chapter 796: Chapter 303 Immortal Flower, Wandao Ocean, Dadao Sect, Dadao Mountain, Thousand Dao Overwhelms_2 Ten thousand miles away from the Immortal Flower, Han Li stood on the spot.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to move forward, but that he couldn’t.
In front of him was a barrier, its mighty power unknown.
Ten thousand miles away lay the towering Immortal Flower, its petals numbering one hundred and twenty-nine thousand six hundred, each petal representing a different Dao, and the radiance of celestial light was even more dazzling.
The infinite mysteries of the immortal path flowed out from the Immortal Flower, filling the barrier.
The Immortal Flower, seemed like the source of all immortal paths, evolving thousands of Daos.
In a short period of time, the area for ten thousand miles around the Immortal Flower became an ocean of the Dao, with ceaseless surges of Dao patterns and boundless waves of mystical Dao, and infinite rhymes of Dao evolving.
...
Soon, the Immortal Flower fully bloomed, and in the center of its bud, a quaint and vast gate condensed from nothingness, inscribed with countless paths.
At this moment, the ocean of Daos boiled, all the great Daos rushing toward that quaint and vast gate, finally causing it to completely manifest.
Dadao Sect!
Just a gate, it seemed like the source of the Dao.
Witnessing this scene, Han Li was greatly shaken, his heart filled with countless realizations.
He found that this place was truly excellent, very suitable for him.
He cultivated the ultimate martial Dao, which involved the fusion of thousands of Daos.
This ocean of Daos, Dadao Sect, and Immortal Flower were simply treasures for him.
If he could refine the Immortal Flower, what extent would his cultivation reach?
The Thousand Path Tree within him would likely evolve directly to a mature stage, meaning at the very least he could break through to the Immortal Emperor Realm.
If he could further refine the Dadao Sect, then he would have a celestial weapon that matched his own being.
However, this was just wishful thinking.
How could the Immortal Flower and the Dadao Sect, both tests of the Dadao Palace, be taken by him?
Therefore, Han Li turned his attention to the ocean of Daos.
If his guess was correct, this ocean of Daos could also bring him great gains.
Thinking this, Han Li no longer hesitated and stepped forward.
As the Immortal Flower bloomed and the Dadao Sect emerged, the barrier disappeared, and he was faced with the vastness of the Dao.
Beneath Han Li’s feet appeared a boat, not some celestial weapon, but a vessel of the Dao, brought into existence by his own Dao, containing his insights into his own Dao.
In the ocean of Daos, one must traverse with a vessel of the Dao, using one’s own Dao to compete with the various Daos in the ocean.
Should one prevail, they could continuously move forward, reaching the other shore and eventually the site of the Dadao Sect.
The speed of Han Li’s boat of the Dao was not fast; quite slow actually, and that was intentional, for his guess had proven true.
As his boat of the Dao competed with the Daos in the ocean, when it prevailed, it could absorb some of the essence and meaning of the Dao, greatly supplementing the deficiencies in his ultimate martial Dao.
Han Li had already reached the peak of the True Immortal Peak, ready to ascend to the Golden Immortal Realm at any moment.
But now, after absorbing some of the essence and meaning of the Dao, the constraints of his realm began to fade, and signs of a breakthrough to the Golden Immortal Realm were emerging.
Han Li suppressed these signs, for now, in the Dadao Palace, was not the time for a breakthrough.
Once he absorbed more fortune and opportunities within the Dadao Palace, his cultivation would surely see a vast improvement after he left.
Han Li’s progress was observed by other cultivators who breathed a sigh of relief, thinking he wasn’t as formidable as they had thought.
Perhaps it was mere luck that allowed him to be the first to pass the previous test.
Otherwise, why would his speed across the ocean of Daos be so slow?
Han Li had fallen to the very last place.
Still, he remained calm and unrushed.
Though this test had a time limit, the ocean of Daos that spanned ten thousand miles was enough for him.
The other young geniuses made swift progress at first, but their speed swiftly declined in the middle stages.
By the final stretch, their pace had slowed dramatically, occasionally even retreating a distance.
Only a very few supreme geniuses continued to advance, but their momentum had waned.
In contrast, Han Li started slowly, but gradually increased his force.
His boat of the Dao picked up speed in the ocean of Daos, becoming unstoppable, pushing aside all Daos, and suppressing the endless Dao patterns.
After several hours, Han Li was the first to reach the other side, standing before the Dadao Sect, his body swirling with intense essence of the Dao, the radiant light of the Dao struggling to be contained, shooting straight into the sky.
Han Li circulated the Thousand Path Scripture, dispersing all the miraculous sights and apparitions.
Glancing back, he discovered that the cultivator closest to Dadao Sect was still eight thousand li away.
That person was not the red-garbed youth, but a blue-clothed woman of exceptional beauty.
When Han Li looked over, she too just happened to look his way, locking eyes with him for a moment, her beautiful pupils conveying a profound meaning.
Han Li smiled at her but didn’t greet her.
Instead, he turned and walked towards Dadao Sect.
If he wasn’t mistaken, Dadao Sect was the final obstacle of the second trial; only by pushing open the doors of Dadao Sect could one enter.
The moment Han Li’s right hand touched the doors of Dadao Sect, he immediately felt a multitude of aurasâ€”massiveness, vastness, mystery, grandeur, supremacy…
Pushing open the doors was certainly not an easy task, but for him, it wasn’t very difficult either.
Han Li stood with one hand behind his back and the other placed on the doors of Dadao Sect.
He slowly pushed forward, and the gates yielded to his force, releasing an infinite burst of Dao light.
Images of the Dao appeared everywhere, both in the sky and on the ground, as if celebrating something.
Without delay, Han Li strode through the doors of Dadao Sect.
Long after Han Li had departed, the stunningly beautiful blue-clothed woman arrived in front of Dadao Sect.
When she tried to push the doors, her expression subtly changed.
With her strength, she unexpectedly couldn’t push them open effortlessly.
Having seen how relaxed and at ease Han Li had appeared, she had assumed that the doors of Dadao Sect would be easy to push open.
Clearly, she had miscalculated.
After exerting a great deal of effort, the blue-clothed woman finally succeeded in pushing open the doors of Dadao Sect and entered within.
On the other side, after Han Li entered Dadao Sect, an ancient road extended from the horizon.
He tread along the old path, and after passing through a gate made of light, he arrived at the location of the third trial.
In the meantime, the spirit of Dadao Palace said a few words, and then an object appeared in his handâ€”it was the reward for passing the second trial, and it had reached the Immortal Emperor Level.
Upon arrival, Han Li surveyed the area and found that this place was a mountain, quite similar to Wendao Mountain that he had once climbed.
On this mountain, there were nine ancient paths, each with one hundred twenty-nine thousand six hundred steps leading to the summit.
“The third trial requires climbing Dadao Mountain.
Choose any ancient path, ascend the one hundred twenty-nine thousand six hundred steps, and you shall pass the trial.”
“With every step climbed, the pressure of the Dao will increase.
The higher you go, the more intense it becomes.
Only by enduring the force of the Thousand Paths and reaching the top can you undertake the fourth trial.”
The voice of Dadao Palace’s spirit rang out, causing Han Li to slightly furrow his brows.
Reaching the peak of Dadao Mountain was truly not going to be easy.
One had to endure the force of the Thousand Paths, every one of the world’s Daos pressing down.
One misstep could lead to death.
Han Li’s gaze flickered, and he looked at the jade stone steps not far ahead.
Without hesitation, he stepped onto them.
“Dong~”
The sound of a great bell, the voice of the Dao, rang out beside Han Li’s ear.
Standing on the first step of the Dao, Han Li could feel the pressure of a Dao bearing down, yet he stood tall and straight, unaffected.
“Is it only the force of the Golden Immortal Realm?” Han Li’s gaze shifted, sensing that it couldn’t be that simple.
Without giving it much more thought, Han Li continued to ascend.
With each step he climbed, a new force of the Dao pressed down upon his head.
Before long, Han Li had ascended a thousand steps, with a thousand kinds of Dao forces pressing down.
Each was of the Golden Immortal first level, which was quite effortless for Han Li.
As he stepped onto the next level, his brow instantly furrowed.
The power of the Dao grew stronger, reaching the Golden Immortal Realm second level.
“This is getting tricky.”
Han Li muttered under his breath, but he wasn’t afraid and kept moving forward with measured and unhurried steps, as if he were taking a stroll.
It was as if he wasn’t ascending Dadao Mountain, but simply taking a walk on his own Chengsheng Mountain.
Time passed, and before he knew it, Han Li had reached the eighty thousandth step.
The power of the Dao here was incredibly strong, with the might of the Immortal Monarch eighth level.
With eighty thousand Daos weighing down upon him, even Han Li felt a tremendous pressure.

chapters.title: Chapter 797
chapters.content:
Chapter 797: Chapter 304 Immortal King’s Path, Origin Arena, Passing the Fourth Step Test_1 Chapter 797: Chapter 304 Immortal King’s Path, Origin Arena, Passing the Fourth Step Test_1 Dadao Mountain,
Han Li paused briefly before continuing his climb.
With each step up the great Dao’s stairs, an additional Dao force appeared above him, intent on suppressing him.
From the eighty-thousandth to the ninety-thousandth step, every type of Dao force reached the eighth level of the Immortal Monarch Realm.
From the ninety-thousandth to the hundred-thousandth step, every type of Dao force reached the ninth level of the Immortal Monarch Realm.
The Dao forces that pressed down on him from above were becoming more numerous and more powerful, yet the pressure Han Li felt was not increasing but, paradoxically, becoming lighter.
Originally, his normal combat ability was invincible at the Quasi Immortal Monarch level.
To withstand the suppression of tens of thousands of Immortal Monarchs’ Dao, he had to activate his Divine Sense to fight against it.
...
But Divine Sense had a time limit.
Even with consecutive activations, it was only temporary.
If he couldn’t reach the summit in one go, then there was no hope of doing so.
This was equivalent to facing ten thousand Golden Immortals and ninety thousand Immortal Monarchs.
Although these hundred thousand Golden Immortals and Immortal Monarchs did not actively kill, their combined suppression was overwhelming.
Anyone insufficiently strong would be shattered to pieces in an instant.
Han Li started climbing quickly because he wanted to reach the summit before his Divine Sense expired, and he was fully confident he could do it.
However, after crossing the sixty-thousandth step, Han Li suddenly changed his mind and slowed his ascent.
It wasn’t that he couldn’t bear the pressure; he had another plan in mind.
He found that Dadao Mountain suited him all too well, something he hadn’t noticed in his haste to ascend.
First, it was the Immortal Flower and Wandao Ocean in the second stage of the trial, brimming with the myriads of Daos.
Although at a lower level, they were good supplements for Han Li’s ultimate martial Dao.
After absorbing the boundless Dao rhymes from the blooming Immortal Flower and the infinite Dao images from the Wandao Ocean, his inner Thousand Path Tree grew rapidly.
His Thousand Path Scripture and Thousand Path Immortal Body also evolved in succession, rising to higher levels.
If not for the Dadao Palace suppressing his cultivation level to prevent it from surpassing the True Immortal Peak, Han Li felt that without the System’s help, he could break through to the Golden Immortal Realm, or even the Immortal Monarch Realm, all at once.
The realms were defined by predecessors for the mediocre.
With sufficient talent and profound insight into the Dao, one need not follow the norms.
One could break through to a very high realm in one go, rendering all realm restrictions meaningless.
At this moment, Han Li had this feeling.
Having climbed Dadao Mountain so far, the oppressive force of ten thousand Golden Immortals and Immortal Monarchs’ Daos was gradually being assimilated by Han Li’s ultimate martial Dao and merging into his being, fostering rapid growth of his ultimate martial Dao.
As a result, Han Li no longer needed to activate his Divine Sense.
His strength had thoroughly reached the Immortal Monarch Realm, even touching the domain of a Quasi Immortal King.
Apart from his realm, all other aspects had elevated.
After his strength surged, Han Li found climbing Dadao Mountain increasingly effortless, feeling no pressure at all.
Yet he deliberately slowed down to allow his ultimate martial Dao to continue its growth.
When Han Li stepped onto the ninety-nine thousand nine hundred and ninetieth stair, the suppressing Dao from above had already reached the peak might of the Immortal Monarch Realm.
Upon reaching the hundred-thousandth stair, the force of the suppressing Dao advanced to the early stage of the Quasi Immortal King.
When Han Li climbed to the one hundred and twenty-nine thousand five hundred and ninety-ninth stair, the force of the suppressing Dao rose to the peak of the Quasi Immortal King.
Han Li glanced at the last step, just one step away from the summit of Dadao Mountain.
The aura emanating from this stair was already of Immortal King might.
This left Han Li somewhat puzzled.
Was the test when the Dadao Palace emerged in previous times really this difficult?
He looked down to see the exceedingly beautiful woman in blue struggling at around the forty-thousandth step of Dadao Mountain, clearly exhausted and weakening.
According to the information shared by Chang Xi, every session had several or a dozen participants reaching the fourth stage of the trials, even though they did not pass.
This still proved their strength.
However, considering the difficulty of this session’s trial, aside from Han Li, other geniuses probably couldn’t even pass half of the third stage.
Various thoughts flashed through his mind.
Without dwelling on them further, Han Li took another step upward.
“Boom~”
The terrifying might of an Immortal King bore down, causing Dadao Mountain itself to rumble.
Those geniuses still climbing were suddenly pressed to the ground, unable to rise.
But the might of the Immortal King came quickly and left just as fast, effortlessly shouldered by Han Li.
Standing at the summit, Han Li savored the feeling for a moment and then shook his head slightly, “The might of an Immortal King, just so-so.”
With a shrug of his shoulders, the twelve thousand nine hundred and sixty kinds of Dao that pressed down exploded deafeningly, their Daoist roars echoing through countless realms, shaking the past, present, and future.
Seizing this moment, his ultimate martial Dao consumed voraciously, swallowing infinite Dao rhymes, boundless Dao images, endless Dao intents, and limitless Dao principles.
In an instant, Han Li’s aura skyrocketed wildly, yet his realm remained at the True Immortal Peak.
After this consummation, his ultimate martial Dao grew once again, reaching an incredibly high level after digestion.
Han Li made an estimate, swallowed hard, and then confirmed his speculation with the System.
His ultimate martial Dao had actually reached the Immortal King level!
That meant, once Han Li returned to the myriad realms, if he wished, he could break through to the Immortal King Realm in an instant.
“Hiss~”
He couldn’t help but inhale sharply, a trace of excitement flickering in his eyes.
His Dao was the ultimate martial Dao, the highest-level Dao, supreme above all others.
This meant that Han Li’s strength far surpassed that of an Immortal King and now rivaled that of a Quasi Immortal Emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 798
chapters.content:
Chapter 798: Chapter 304: Immortal King’s Path, Origin Arena, Passing the Fourth Step Challenge_2 Chapter 798: Chapter 304: Immortal King’s Path, Origin Arena, Passing the Fourth Step Challenge_2 He was a Quasi Immortal Emperor who had mastered the ultimate path.
The indifferent voice of the Dadao Palace’s spirit echoed in Han Li’s ears, bestowing upon him a treasure that even among Immortal Emperors was considered supreme.
Han Li’s gaze shifted slightly, and instead of immediately proceeding to the fourth trial of Dadao Palace, he stared blankly at Dadao Mountain.
He seemed to have understood something.
Ever since he arrived at Dadao Palace, his system had fallen silent, only responding to him after he called out many times.
Han Li felt somewhat nervous, somewhat uneasy, yet somewhat relieved.
It was all too coincidental.
...
“Huff~”
Han Li took a deep breath, turned around, and walked to the altar at the center of the mountain’s peak.
“Let’s see the whole truth, then.”
Brilliant light of the path descended, and Han Li’s figure vanished from Dadao Mountain.
At this moment, over a hundred outstanding prodigies who were climbing Dadao Mountain were dumbfounded.
Who was that man?
The difficulty of Dadao Palace had increased manyfold this time, and many among them, who would have passed the third trial in previous attempts, were now stuck in the first half of the third trial.
And that mysterious newcomer who appeared out of nowhere, actually breezed through the first three trials without a hitch, coming in first every time, leaving all prodigies far behind.
…….
After a flash of dazzling Dao light, Han Li’s figure appeared.
This time, he did not appear in some world, dojo, or at the foot of a mountain; it seemed he had entered the inner sanctum of the Dadao Palace.
He was in an immensely grand and splendid hall, standing at the entrance.
Han Li looked inside, where colossal pillars reached skyward, each engraved with various symbols of the great Dao.
In the center of this magnificent hall was an expansive area, an arena.
Just as Han Li wanted to continue observing, the voice of the Dadao Palace’s spirit sounded once more.
“Han Li, welcome to the fourth trial of the Dadao Palace.”
“You recognize me?”
Han Li raised an eyebrow, he had completely altered his appearance before coming in.
But then it dawned on him, and he relaxed.
As a weapon of the fourth trial, the spirit had supreme power, so it wasn’t strange that it knew him.
“I recognize all beings from the myriad realms,” the spirit replied.
Han Li’s eyes flashed, and he let go of some of his doubts.
“What is the fourth trial?” Han Li asked straightforwardly.
“Ascend the Origin Arena, overcome all opponents, and you shall pass,” replied the spirit with an indifferent voice.
“How many opponents are there?
What are their origins?
What is their combat ability?” Han Li asked in succession.
“There are a total of thirty-six, all with the combat ability of a Quasi Immortal Emperor.”
Han Li’s brow furrowed slightly; the spirit of the Dadao Palace had not mentioned the origins of these thirty-six opponents.
The combat ability of a Quasi Immortal Emperor was manageable, roughly equal to his own, so Han Li wasn’t worried about being suppressed by cultivation levels.
Suddenly, a thought flashed through Han Li’s mind.
Thirty-six opponents, thirty-six Heavenly Courts…
Could his opponents be the Emperors of Heaven from the Crimson Heaven Court, Longhan Heavenly Court, Wantong Heavenly Court, and the other thirty-six heavenly courts?
Even though they might not be at their peak, even with just the combat ability of a Quasi Immortal Emperor, they would certainly be formidable, arguably the thirty-six strongest individuals in the history of the Taichu Realm.
Wait a moment!
Han Li’s relaxed expression tightened again.
Why would they be the Emperors of Heaven from the thirty-six courts of the Taichu Realm?
That didn’t make sense.
The Dadao Palace was open to all the myriad worlds, and the Taichu Realm ranked only in the last of the top ten.
If they were to choose Emperors of Heaven as guardians, they should select them from the top three, even the strongest realms in all the heavens.
Could it be a case of tailoring the challenge to the individual?
Because he was from the Taichu Realm, the guardians were all past Emperors of Heaven from the Taichu Realm?
Han Li felt confused about this possibility; otherwise, how could there coincidentally be thirty-six…
After voicing his inquiry again, Han Li received no answer from the spirit, which seemed unwilling to discuss it.
After pondering for a moment, Han Li strode towards the Origin Arena, standing below it.
Looking at the scar-covered arena, he seemed to see an immense and glorious world, witnessing some of the tumultuous and grand scenes from ancient times…
“Origin Arena?
Why not call it the Eternal Arena?”
Han Li mumbled to himself, believing that it should be named Eternal Arena, or even Arena of the Heavens, as the Dadao Palace was within the Ancient Eternal Realm (myriad realms).
Without further hesitation, Han Li ascended the Origin Arena and found that this place had its own vast cosmos, filled with supreme rules, invulnerable to even the full might of a Quasi Immortal Emperor.
After a brief wait, the first guardian finally appeared.
“I am Creation, please enlighten me,” said the Creation Daoist clad in a white Daoist robe, his tone even and his expression tranquil.
Han Li was taken aback, as this Creation Daoist seemed to be real.
Wasn’t he supposed to be an illusion created by the Dadao Palace?
He recalled the titles of the Emperors of Heaven from the thirty-six courts of the Taichu Realm, none of which were called Creation.
Disappointed, it seemed his guess was wrong.
After thinking for a moment, Han Li followed the Creation Daoist’s lead and saluted with cupped hands, “I am Han Li.
Greetings, Daoist Creation.”
Since the spirit of the Dadao Palace was aware of his identity, Han Li saw no point in concealing it.
He even revealed his true form, as other cultivators were not able to reach the fourth trial.
He had a feeling that this fourth trial of the Dadao Palace seemed to be prepared for him.
Or perhaps, this emergence of the Dadao Palace, with its greatly escalated difficulty and the trials all having changed, might also be related to him.
Combat was imminent.
The moment they engaged, it was with full force, with no probing, and a victor would be determined in a short amount of time.
Han Li had not wanted it this way, but as Creation Daoist was so ferocious, he had no choice but to oblige.
After three rounds, Han Li vanquished Creation Daoist.

chapters.title: Chapter 799
chapters.content:
Chapter 799: Chapter 304: Immortal King’s Path, Origin Arena, Passing the Fourth Step Challenge_3 Chapter 799: Chapter 304: Immortal King’s Path, Origin Arena, Passing the Fourth Step Challenge_3 After a moment’s wait, the second guardian appeared, calling himself the Daoist of Heaven and Earth, and Han Li quickly subdued him.
The third guardian called himself the Daoist of Origin, and Han Li took five moves to kill him.
The fourth guardian called himself the Daoist of Reincarnation, and it took Han Li six moves to kill him.
The fifth guardian called himself the Daoist of Chaos, and Han Li killed him with seven moves.
Han Li fought his way through, slaying each guardian in turn.
The guardians grew stronger the further he went, so much so that he had to put in all his effort to slay them, and with each encounter, it took him longer and longer.
Moreover, Han Li gradually sustained injuries, with each wound more severe than the last.
...
Fortunately, after each battle, the Dadao Palace would restore him to his peak condition, otherwise Han Li truly wouldn’t have been able to keep winning consecutively.
Each of these guardians possessed the combat ability of a Quasi Immortal Emperor, with immense strength and extremely rich combat experience.
They could be described as godly and peerless, skilled in numerous powerful Divine Skills and mystical arts, leaving Han Li barely able to cope.
Furthermore, each guardian mastered a different Grand Dao, which seemed to be related to their “Daoist titles,” like the first one, the Daoist of Creation, who controlled the Grand Dao of Creation.
When Han Li broke through to the sixteenth level, there was a change in the guardian.
“I am called Tai Ji, and I ask for your guidance, fellow Daoist,” greeted the Daoist of Tai Ji with a cupped fist salute.
Han Li returned the salute, then engaged in fierce combat with him, spending a considerable amount of time before he could slay him.
“I am called Taisu, and I ask for your guidance.”
“I am called Tai Shi, and I ask for your guidance.”
“I am called Tai Chu, and I ask for your guidance.”
“I am called Taiyi, and I ask for your guidance.”
In the following four battles, Han Li encountered Taisu, Tai Shi, Tai Chu, and Taiyi, each Daoist possessing unbelievably powerful and unpredictable Daoist arts.
Were it not for Han Li’s own rapid growth with each battle against the guardians, he would not have been able to reach this level.
After slaying the Daoist of Taiyi, Han Li awaited the twenty-first guardian, who was called Supreme Lord Taiyi.
The twenty-second guardian was called Supreme Lord Taiwu;
The twenty-third guardian was called Supreme Lord Taiming;
The twenty-fourth guardian was called Supreme Lord Taixuan;
The twenty-fifth guardian was called Supreme Lord Taihao.
Han Li vanquished all five Supreme Lords, his own strength growing once again.
His ultimate martial path absorbed the “Ten Great” Dao and finally made another step forward, officially advancing to the Immortal Emperor Level.
When Han Li’s strength broke through, no new guardian appeared on the Origin Arena, as if the Spirit of the Dao intentionally allowed his power to increase.
Han Li couldn’t quite understand but didn’t think too hard about it, focusing on his breakthrough instead.
After he completed his breakthrough, another guardian appeared on the Origin Arena, the twenty-sixth one.
“Please give me guidance, fellow Daoist,” said the guardian, dressed in Heavenly Immortal garb, with an aura of sacred majesty and heroic spirit.
Han Li frowned slightly, this being the first guardian who did not introduce a “Daoist title.” His thoughts flashed briefly before he engaged in fierce combat with the guardian.
From the twenty-sixth guardian onward, Han Li fought his way through to the thirty-fifth guardian.
He discovered that these nine guardians each possessed a different Grand Dao and hailed from nine different races, some of which had already disappeared from the myriad worlds.
Among them were immortals, demons, dragons, phoenixes, witches, fiends, spirits, saints, and those of the thunder clan.
This broadened Han Li’s horizons.
He also found that these nine guardians of nine races all possessed immense dignity, as if they ruled over the myriad worlds through the ages, with an air of dominance over the past and future, akin to the Emperor of Heaven.
Only, Han Li did not remember any such Emperor of Heaven in the Taichu Realm.
Could they be from some other supreme worlds of the myriad heavens?
All thoughts flashed through his mind, and Han Li awaited the thirty-sixth guardian.
A perfect being.
This was the first thought that came to Han Li’s mind upon seeing the guardian.
“`
“Fellow Daoist Han, my name is Da Siming.” The perfect being spoke with a smile.
Han Li’s pupils suddenly constricted.
This title was different from the previous thirty-five guardians, being the only one of its kind, yet he was placed last.
That implied this perfect being possessed extremely formidable strength.
Moreover, this perfect being seemed truly interesting, actually recognizing him.
“Fellow Daoist Han, some things are inconvenient to say in depth, but we will meet again.”
After saying this, Da Siming gave Han Li a Daoist salute and then walked casually toward him, seemingly with no intention of attacking.
Countless thoughts raced through Han Li’s mind, but he did not dwell on them, as he sensed a lethal threat emanating from Da Siming.
This was an invincible being!
Fortunately, his ultimate martial path had advanced further after annihilating the nine tribes’ guardians; otherwise, he might not have been able to overcome Da Siming.
“Fellow Daoist, please~”
Han Li took a deep breath and initiated the offensive.
His fist light illuminated the past, present, and future, tore through eternity, and pierced through boundless spaceâ€”all to pin down Da Siming.
But Da Siming only paused briefly, then continued to advance, exuding a peaceful aura.
Han Li snorted coldly, transformed his palm into a sword, and his sword light dazzled the entire boundless universe, slicing through the fabric of time and fate, eradicating the great Dao’s Reincarnation, and simultaneously reflecting in the minds of all beings across all timelines.
Da Siming stretched out his perfect right hand and gently tapped, extinguishing the brilliant golden light that could vanquish an Immortal Emperor.
“Fellow Daoist Han, show your true abilities, or you won’t pass my test.”
“With it supervising, I can’t go easy on you.
If you can’t pass, you won’t see the ‘truth’.”
Da Siming’s tone remained even, still advancing toward Han Li with smooth and steady steps, but he imparted a sense of death, as if Da Siming’s approach heralded the moment of Han Li’s demise.
“If that’s the case, I won’t hold back any longer.”
Han Li’s eyes flickered, and he decided to use his trump card, which he had gained after evolving his ultimate martial path to the Immortal King level and then to the Quasi Immortal Emperor level.
When Han Li unleashed his trump card, Da Siming indeed halted, his expression turning solemn.
“That move again.”
Da Siming muttered to himself and finally fought seriously, engaging in a fierce battle with Han Li.
In the end, Da Siming was defeated.
Han Li narrowly won with one move, slaying Da Siming with his battered body.
“Huff, huff, huff~”
Han Li lay on the Origin Arena, his body torn and ragged, a pitiful sight, but ultimately he had defeated the perfect Da Siming and passed the fourth step test of Dadao Palace.
Infinite Light descended, resonating with Han Li’s ultimate martial path and jointly healing his injuries.
When the light dissipated, Han Li was restored to his original state, his ultimate martial path having taken another step forward, nearing the Immortal Emperor level.
This vastly enhanced Han Li’s aura.
Standing up, Han Li fell silent for a moment, then took the lead in asking.
“Dao Spirit, what about the fortune of passing the fourth step test?”
“Walk in.”
The voice of the Dao Spirit resounded, followed by the emergence of a Gate of Great Dao.
Han Li hesitated, then, filled with boundless curiosity, walked through.
PS: If everything goes as planned, the book should be finished tomorrow or the day after.
I’ll try to write a long chapter then.
