Chapter 800: Chapter 305: The Emperor of Heaven!
Stepping Into the Fourth Stride!
Transcending Eternity!
(Grand Finale)_1 Chapter 800: Chapter 305: The Emperor of Heaven!
Stepping Into the Fourth Stride!
Transcending Eternity!
(Grand Finale)_1 In the heart of Dadao Palace.
...
This was the Land of Emptiness, vast and desolate, devoid of the Vitality of Living Beings, yet filled with the breath of the Dao.
Above this land in the sky, there was a brilliant source of light that radiated the aura of myriad paths.
Endless Daoist rules blossomed and extended from it, as if it were the ultimate source of Dao for all the heavens and myriad worlds.
Han Li suddenly felt an intense yearning, a yearning from his flesh, Primordial Spirit, Cultivation Technique, Dao, and Dao seed, desiring to touch that source of light, as though it could grant him an Against the Heaven’s Creation.
However, Han Li did not gaze further at that mass of light; instead, he stared intently at the figure beneath the light.
It was a member of the Human Clan.
Standing with his back to him, hands clasped behind his back.
About eight feet tall, the entire figure emitted an aura of lonely desolation that had endured through countless vicissitudes.
Seemingly an illusion, surrounded by ripples of time, as if he were not a person from this ancient history.
Before Han Li could even speak, the man began to talk, his voice ethereal and lofty, elusive to the listener.
“You have finally arrived.”
Han Li’s gaze flickered.
Did this person know him?
Was he specifically here waiting for him?
“Who are you?” After thinking for a moment, Han Li cautiously asked.
“Congratulations, you have passed the trial.
It is now yours.”
The man did not respond to Han Li’s question and continued to speak.
Although he didn’t specify what it was, Han Li subconsciously looked towards the light in the sky.
The man’s enigmatic words clarified some things for Han Li, that the increased difficulties in Dadao Palace’s trials and the various challenges were indeed related to him.
But what was the purpose of doing so?
Han Li was puzzled; his mind was full of questions, hoping someone would provide answers.
“I know you have many doubts, but you will soon know the answers,” the man continued to say.
Han Li had thought that the man would provide some kind of explanation, but instead, the figure became even more indistinct, seemingly about to vanish from this time and space at any moment.
At that moment, a certain guess in Han Li’s heart was confirmed.
This man was not part of this time and space; what Han Li was seeing was merely a segment of imagery left by this person, and the words had been pre-recorded, so he could not answer his questions.
But that did not lessen the doubts in his heart; on the contrary, they grew stronger.
“I look forward to our next meeting.”
Before the silhouette completely disappeared, these words were transmitted.
Han Li’s brows furrowed; he seemed to be experiencing an event of special significance.
“Our next meeting?
I’m starting to look forward to it as well,” Han Li murmured to himself inwardly.
Casting aside all distractions, he looked towards that mass of ultimate Daoist source, his eyes flickering, and gently beckoned with his hand.
Indeed, the ultimate Daoist source immediately flew towards him, eventually coming to rest in Han Li’s hands.
Feeling the craving from his entire insides and outsides, Han Li did not rush to devour and refine it but looked it over carefully, whispering to himself, “Is this the most Against the Heaven’s Creation in Dadao Palace?”
If this truly was the ultimate source of Dao, then indeed it was the Against the Heaven’s Creation for the fourth step.
“Huh~”
As various thoughts flashed through his mind in an instant, Han Li pressed the mass of the ultimate Daoist source into his body, merging with his flesh, Primordial Spirit, Cultivation Technique, Dao seed, and Dao.
Once the ultimate Daoist source fully integrated with these five aspects, a profound and mysterious feeling arose within Han Li’s heart.
His understanding of the ultimate martial path reached a new height.
If he advanced further, he could step into that legendary fourth phase of cultivator’s path.
Han Li had finally understood how he could step into the fourth phase of cultivation.
It required “Five in One”!
One must bring flesh, Primordial Spirit, Cultivation Technique, Dao seed, and Dao to the fulfillment of the Immortal Path, and integrate them completely into one.
Only then, can one step into the fourth phase of cultivation.
Not one could be absent; even the slightest discrepancy meant failure.
After devouring and refining that mass of the ultimate Daoist source, Han Li’s ultimate martial path also reached the Immortal Emperor Level, or rather, all aspects of him reached the Immortal Emperor Level.
Moreover, the shackles that limited cultivators from breaking through to the fourth phase of cultivation were now lifted.
He only needed to spend tens of thousands of years to solidify his realm of cultivation to stride into the fourth step of cultivation in one go.
Although tens of thousands of years may seem long, to an Immortal Emperor, it was insignificantâ€”like a second in the eyes of a common person.
At the same time, after refining the ultimate Daoist source, Han Li also learned much information, and most of the doubts in his heart were resolved.
The member of the Human Clan who embarked on the expedition, the Emperor of Heaven at that time, led the forces of the Heavenly Court to form array in the Boundless Space to fend off enemies.
After slaying countless mighty foes, he captured the ultimate Daoist source, thoroughly refined it, and merged it into the Dadao Palace, becoming its core.
Then, the Emperor of Heaven cast Dadao Palace forth, crossing the endless void of space to fall into the fragments of the Origin World that had plummeted deep into the Bitter Sea.
The Eternal Ark was not loaded with an Eternal World but with fragments of the Origin World, which had shattered before the Emperor of Heaven’s expedition in an ancient battle.
Dadao Palace, carrying with it the fragments of the Origin World, left the Bitter Sea.
As it could not reach the other shore, it came to the current space and time, a space-time long ago explored by the Emperor of Heaven, yet it could not fully escape the flames of war.
In this space and time, the fragments of the Origin World evolved into the myriad worlds of the Ancient Eternal Realm we see today, and the timeline also began anew from then on.
The traces of the past were severed, and only those who reached the fourth step could investigate and set forth upon the path.
Though an Immortal Emperor could reverse the years, trace all the timelines of the past and future, and roam through infinite parallel spaces, he could not trace back to the times before antiquity.
For in this space and time, the era before ancient times did not existâ€”it was complete nothingness, concealed by mists.

chapters.content:
Chapter 801: Chapter 305: The Emperor of Heaven!
Stepping Into the Fourth Stride!
Transcending Eternity!
(Grand Finale)_2 Chapter 801: Chapter 305: The Emperor of Heaven!
Stepping Into the Fourth Stride!
Transcending Eternity!
(Grand Finale)_2 From the ancient times to the present, the Taichu Realm has passed through thirty-six dynasties of the Heavenly Court, for a total of one thousand two hundred and ninety-five tribulation periods.
...
The other great realms within the Ancient Eternal Realm follow the same cycle.
One thousand two hundred and ninety-six tribulation periods make up one Reincarnation!
The Human Clan Emperor of Heaven, who led an expedition, captured the origins of myriad paths to refine the Dadao Palace and threw it back for a reason : to cultivate a supreme being within three Reincarnations.
This Reincarnation is about to end.
During this period, the Dadao Palace’s Spirit has cultivated several fourth-step powerhouses.
In places like the Taiyin Star, Thousand Realm Star, Eternal Mother River, and Ancient Land of Destiny, creations of these fourth-step powerhouses exist.
These four fourth-step powerhouses have already set out, leaving behind scant traces within the Ancient Eternal Realm, shrouded in mystery.
Han Li was selected as the fifth to be cultivated, but he is different from the previous four; he has “uniqueness.”
In his previous life, Han Li’s world was part of the Taichu Realm’s vast universe, where parts of that universe fell into a declining era without Spiritual Energy, turning to climb the technology tree.
Selected by the Spirit of the Dadao Palace, Han Li was brought to Lingjun City in Fengyang Manor of Leizhou within the Great Da Qian Dynasty in the Xuan Domain of Qianyuan Divine Province in the Yuankun Domain of the Taichu Realm, where he became an impoverished fifteen-year-old boy.
Under the manipulation of the Palace Spirit, Han Li experienced over a hundred years of hardships and returned to Lingjun City at the age of one hundred fifty.
Once honed, the Dadao Palace Spirit activated a system for Han Li.
It split off a strand of its consciousness to become the System Spirit, while the main body continued to slumber.
Han Li’s swift progression to where he is now is entirely due to the nurturing by the Spirit of the Dadao Palace.
When Han Li assimilated the core of the Dadao Palace, that mass of origins of myriad paths, he took control over the Dadao Palace, formally becoming the Master of Dadao Palace.
The previous system became dispensable, subject to his whims.
The Longevity Family System was an artifact created by the Dadao Palace, solely to nurture Han Li more effectively and smoothly.
After coming to terms with everything, Han Li let out a long sigh.
He thought he would be angry, that he would feel his life and destiny were being manipulated, but in reality, Han Li didn’t feel that way.
He actually thought it was quite nice.
His current life was countless times better than his past life.
If he could choose again, he would still take this same path.
This path seemed prearranged, but it was also related to his choices.
After arriving in the Yuankun Domain, before the Spirit of the Dadao Palace intervened, he had over a hundred years, during which the Palace Spirit did not involve itself, only observed him.
Once the observation ended, based on his performance over those hundred-plus years and his final thoughts, this cultivation plan was devised.
Han Li had always been walking on his own; he just needed to reach the predestined end point.
But the predestined end point was not the actual final destination.
Once he stepped into the fourth step, he had to set out; it could also be said that he would transcend, transcend the Ancient Eternal Realm.
After he set out, the Spirit of the Dadao Palace could no longer assist him, nor would it accompany him, even though he bore “uniqueness.” It would remain in the Ancient Eternal Realm, continuing the preset mission.
“This feeling, it’s really not great~” Han Li felt somewhat helpless.
He didn’t have much time left to enjoy his carefree life.
After reaching the fourth step, it was time for him to set out on his own, following the path laid down by his predecessors.
Now his cultivation had reached the Immortal Emperor Level, and with the control over the Dadao Palace, even if he didn’t return to the Taichu Realm, he could elevate his cultivation in a moment’s thought.
After a moment of silence, Han Li communicated with the Spirit of the Dadao Palace, and after obtaining certain answers, he left the Dadao Palace.
Han Li did not take the Dadao Palace with him, a fourth-step divine artifact of Xuantian treasure.
It was unnecessary for him; with his strength, he could dominate the Taichu Realm and even all the divine realms.
Upon leaving the Dadao Palace, Han Li’s aura surged rapidly.
He did not suppress it, allowing his cultivation level to soar.
Otherwise, even though his cultivation had reached the Immortal Emperor Level, his Mana and other aspects would have remained at the peak of the True Immortal level, which would have put him at a great disadvantage.
The Golden Immortal Realm!
The Immortal Monarch Realm!
The Immortal King Realm!
The Quasi Immortal Emperor Realm!
The Immortal Emperor Realm!
Han Li pushed his cultivation to the Immortal Emperor Realm in one go and reached deep into this domain, matching his level of cultivation.
Standing within the Ancient Eternal Realm and looking at the Taichu Realm, Han Li’s mood was complex.
With his deliberate concealment, not a single Immortal Emperor in the Taichu Realm noticed his presence.
His gaze landed on the Taichu Realm, seeing through the entire realm, imprinted with all the events occurring across every timeline past and future.
All the Immortal Emperors who have existed in the Taichu Realm past, present, and future were explored by Han Li.
He is now in an invincible state on the third step; he has traced back to before the opening of this space-time and covered the endless years of the future of this space-time.
His existence spans all space-time, all timelines, all parallel universes, where he remains invincible.
If he wishes, the Han Li who just arrived in the Taichu Realm could become invincible instantly, the Han Li who left the mountain in sorrow could also be invincible : he could be invincible in any timeline.
“Indeed, it’s you.”
Han Li’s gaze shifted towards Guanghan Heaven, seeing the Guanghan Empress.
Tracing cause and effect, even the Guanghan Empress, as a supreme Immortal Emperor, could not block his tracing.
He saw everything and finally understood why the Guanghan Empress was helping him : she was to be his “future” partner, or rather, his partner very soon.
He also saw the Guanghan Empress’s crisis.
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor would strike at her during the Guanghan grand event.
Though she was prepared, ultimately she could not overcome it.
Some other Immortal Emperors would even take the opportunity to kick her while she’s down, leading to the loss of Guanghan Heaven, and she would be seriously injured and forced to flee.

chapters.title: Chapter 802-END
chapters.content:
Chapter 802: Chapter 305: The Emperor of Heaven!
Stepping Into the Fourth Stride!
Transcending Eternity!
(Grand Finale)_3 Chapter 802: Chapter 305: The Emperor of Heaven!
Stepping Into the Fourth Stride!
Transcending Eternity!
(Grand Finale)_3 This is just the future of one timeline.
...
He looked into the futures of other timelines as well, and eventually pondered deeply.
Han Li did not immediately go to meet the Guanghan Empress.
Now was not the time, so he went directly back to Chengsheng Mountain.
He was now aware of everything that would happen in the Taichu Realm’s future.
Without making a move himself, the future timeline was nearly fixed.
In eight hundred years, the Chiming Heavenly Emperor would join forces with five other emperors to march against the Longhan Heavens and kill the Longhan Immortal Emperor.
The Longhan Immortal Emperor indeed was a split incarnation of Emperor Longhan, laid as a piece during the era of the Longhan Heavenly Court.
At the Guanghan grand gathering ten thousand years later, the Chiming Heavenly Emperor would make a move against the Guanghan Empress.
Two ultimate battles caused the Taichu Realm to fall into chaos.
Hiding in the Cosmic Sea, Emperor Longhan seized this opportunity to create disorder, expanding the “sealing realm” to cover over a hundred domains, killing countless Great Emperors, Heavenly Immortals, and True Immortals in one fell swoop and summoning the Eternal Ark again in an attempt to take control.
In the end, Emperor Longhan failed to take control, but from the Eternal Ark, he gained tremendous fortune, advancing his cultivation even further.
Although he was not invincible in the third step, his strength had significantly increased.
After he came out of seclusion, he stirred up trouble in the Taichu Realm, gathering a group of Immortal Emperors to re-establish the Longhan Heavenly Court and contend with the Crimson Heaven Court, ultimately both suffering heavy losses.
Because the disturbances of the Taichu Realm were too great, they affected the myriad worlds of the Ancient Eternal Realm.
Some of the strongest worlds intervened, each supporting a side, simply to deplete the foundations of the Taichu Realm.
After that, the Immortal Emperors of the Taichu Realm suffered heavy casualties, with few remaining.
From then on, it never recovered, falling from the position of one of the ten strongest worlds in the myriad heavens.
…….
All of this happened without Han Li’s intervention.
Would Han Li intervene?
Of course he would.
There were things he needed, events he did not want to see, so he would intervene.
After returning to Chengsheng Mountain, Han Li did not reveal his Immortal Emperor cultivation level.
Instead, he continued as usual, visiting mountains and playing in the water with his beloved wives and concubines.
Now, he no longer felt pressured.
No one in the Ancient Eternal Realm could threaten him.
As for achieving higher realms, that would be after he broke through to the fourth step.
He didn’t want to break through just yet.
He had plenty of time, needing only to step into the fourth step of cultivation before this cycle of reincarnation.
By his calculations, there were still over one thousand four hundred eons left, with each eon lasting twelve billion nine hundred sixty million years.
He could still live and enjoy countless ages of happiness and freedom.
These were just Han Li’s temporary thoughts.
Perhaps when the day came that he had enjoyed enough and had made proper arrangements for the Han Mansion on Chengsheng Mountain, he would step into the fourth step ahead of time, transcending the Ancient Eternal Realm.
Eight hundred years later, the Longhan Immortal Emperor died, and Han Li did not interfere.
Five thousand years later, Han Li visited the Cosmic Sea, beat up Emperor Longhan, and found the Eternal Ark, stepping aboard and acquiring this ultimate treasure of the fourth step.
According to what the spirit of the Dadao Palace had said, Han Li could not take away the Dadao Palace, but he could take the Eternal Ark with him, which would be convenient for travel and other matters.
He had learned of these matters when he refined the core of myriad paths.
Han Li had agreed to them, having received such a tremendous blessing and all of today’s success was thanks to that person.
It was time to give back.
Nearly ten thousand years later, the Guanghan Empress held the grand Guanghan gathering, attracting countless powerhouses and prodigies from the Taichu Realm to converge.
The Crimson Heaven Court had made preparations in advance, hiding their intentions, and suddenly struck at the Guanghan gathering.
Then, Han Li shattered the Chiming Heavenly Emperor and six other Immortal Emperors with a single slap.
Han Li did not kill them, mainly because they still had their uses.
The Chiming Heavenly Emperor, however, was terrified and fled from the Taichu Realm directly alongside Emperor Longhan.
The two laughed off their grudges, now sharing a common enemy.
At the Guanghan gathering, Han Li married the Guanghan Empress, becoming Dao companions, shaking the Taichu Realm and spreading throughout the Ancient Eternal Realm.
Billions of years later, Han Mansion’s descendants had spread across the myriad worlds, becoming the eternal and immortal Eternal Clan.
That day, Han Li sat high in the Nine Heavens, overlooking his countless descendants below, recounting his glorious history.
Supreme Immortal Emperors crossed worlds to converge, gathering over a hundred Immortal Emperors.
Among them were the Longhan Immortal Emperor and Chiming Heavenly Emperor, who were coordinating this endeavor.
Over these billions of years, as Han Mansion expanded throughout the myriad worlds, it encroached on the interests of other supreme worlds and large domains.
However, those Immortal Emperors, after acting several times, had always relented.
But today, the confrontation finally erupted.
Over a hundred Immortal Emperors came from different worlds, including several peak Immortal Emperors, all to annihilate Han Mansion and suppress Han Li, forcing him to reveal the Against the Heaven’s Creation he obtained from the Dadao Palace.
Han Li’s rise was so rapid, unparalleled throughout history.
They had inferred that Han Li was the one who had comprehended the ultimate martial path and was also the cultivator who had obtained the Against the Heaven’s Creation from the Dadao Palace.
Faced with such a force, the Old Ancestor Han Li furrowed his brows, shielded everyone behind him, sighed, and then with a flick of his finger, he annihilated a portion of the deeply sinful Immortal Emperors.
At that moment, the heavens shook, worlds trembled, and countless powerful beings couldn’t believe what had just happened, then another earth-shattering thought emerged, and they exclaimed, “Old Ancestor Han Li is invincible.”
They had not guessed that Han Li had already stepped into the fourth step of cultivation.
He was about to transcend, which is why he was expounding on the great Dao to the world today, also to resolve some grievances.
After completing these things, Han Li stepped into the river of time once more, traveling upstream, tracing back to the ancient past, pushing aside the mists, and glimpsing the path ahead.
Then he returned, made some preparations, left some countermeasures, and ascended beyond.
Transcending the Ancient Eternal Realm.
Embarking on the path of the predecessors.
End of the book!!!
